q_0.question: In which scenarios can the RAN send ANBR recommending UE transmission at an uplink bitrate R1 greater than the current rate R0?
q_0.ground_truth: The RAN can send ANBR recommending UE transmission at an uplink bitrate R1 greater than the current rate R0 in the case of GBR bearer/GFBR flow and assuming GBR/GFBR < recommended bitrate < MBR/GFBR, or in the case of non-GBR bearer/non-GFBR flow.

q_1.question: What does the abbreviation "IAB" stand for in the context of NR Integrated access and backhaul?

q_2.question: What should the UE do if it is unable to report the requested GPS assistance data?
q_2.ground_truth: The UE may send a measurement report containing the "UE positioning error" and should not send another measurement report for at least 20s to request the same GPS assistance data.

q_3.question: What are the main functions of the RLC/MAC layer in the GPRS radio interface?
q_3.ground_truth: The RLC/MAC layer provides services for information transfer over the physical layer in the GPRS radio interface. It includes backward error correction procedures enabled by the selective retransmission of erroneous blocks and arbitrates access to the shared medium between multiple MSs and the Network.

q_4.question: What action should the RNC take when it receives a RESET RESOURCE message from the CN, indicating that the CN is releasing resources and references associated with the Iu signalling connection identifiers in the received message?
q_4.ground_truth: The RNC should release locally the resources and references associated to the Iu signalling connection identifiers indicated in the received message, and should return a RESET RESOURCE ACKNOWLEDGE message to the CN after all Iu-related resources and references have been released.

q_5.question: Who is the father of computer science?

q_6.question: What networks can be used for connectivity between the UAV and the USS/UTM?
q_6.ground_truth: A dedicated APN is used for UAV connectivity to USS/UTM in EPC, and may also be used for UAV3/UAV5 connectivity. In 5GS, connectivity is established via the UFES to the USS/UTM.

q_7.question: What is the role of the SMF in the PDU session modification when a new DNAI is received?
q_7.ground_truth: When a new DNAI is received, the SMF inserts the new ULCL and new L-PSA, which is better serves the new EAS.

q_8.question: What is the role of the LMA in the PMIPv6-based network?
q_8.ground_truth: The LMA (Local Mobility Anchor) is a key component of a PMIPv6-based network that manages the Local Mobility Anchor functionality, handling IPv4 and IPv6 traffic, and assigning GRE keys, LMA addresses, and UE Interface Identifiers.

q_9.question: How is a deliveryMethod element related to a Session Description fragment in MBMS?
q_9.ground_truth: Each deliveryMethod instance in an instance of the userServiceDescription element must refer to one Session Description fragment.

q_10.question: What happens if no packets were detected for the duration of the Summary Timer in the EPS bearer packet flow?
q_10.ground_truth: The Packet Data Summary Report shall not be sent.

q_11.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Specification define in relation to Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD)?
q_11.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification defines the requirements for handling USSD at the MS and network entities. It does not include specification of particular applications, nor does it specify how a particular application is selected.

q_12.question: What are the guidelines for constructing the profile schema in 3GPP GUP?
q_12.ground_truth: The guidelines emphasize on modularity, extensibility, readability, easy support for versioning, and isolation of the schema components.

q_13.question: What is the purpose of "Index of selected SCCPCH" in 3GPP TS 25.321?
q_13.ground_truth: The "Index of selected SCCPCH" identifies the selected SCCPCH with the PCH and the uniquely associated PICH to be used by the UE in 3GPP TS 25.321. It is selected based on "Initial UE Identity" as follows: "Index of selected SCCPCH" = "Initial UE Identity" mod K.

q_14.question: Which TS in the 3GPP technical specification series defines the procedures used for Short Message Control (SMC) and Short Message Relay (SM-RL) functions across various mobile radio interfaces (A/Gb mode, GPRS, EPS, and 5GS)?

q_15.question: What is the conductive test tolerance for the mandatory spurious emissions requirements for OTA transmitter and receiver?
q_15.ground_truth: The conductive test tolerance for the mandatory spurious emissions requirements for OTA transmitter and receiver is zero.

q_16.question: What is the purpose of aligning channel model clusters with probe locations in an optimized chamber design?
q_16.ground_truth: The purpose of aligning channel model clusters with probe locations in an optimized chamber design is to emulate clusters from arbitrary angles if desired and to obtain a more precise Angle Spread for test signals.

q_17.question: What is the default priority assigned to a location service request if the LCS Priority parameter is absent in a BSSMAP-LE Perform Location request?
q_17.ground_truth: If the LCS Priority parameter is absent in a BSSMAP-LE Perform Location request, the lowest priority shall be assumed.

q_18.question: What is the focus of the enhanced FR2 HST requirements in 3GPP TS 38.854 v0.4.0?
q_18.ground_truth: The enhanced FR2 HST requirements in 3GPP TS 38.854 v0.4.0 focus on cell re-selection, RRC connection mobility control, gradual timing adjustment, SSB based radio link monitoring and beam failure detection, intra-frequency measurement, and L1-RSRP/SINR measurement for specific scenarios. Additionally, it specifies the new requirements of one shot large UL timing adjustment and TCI state switch delay for FR2 HST scenarios.

q_19.question: What are the four requirements specified for the flexible layer one in the context of IMS services?
q_19.ground_truth: The four requirements specified for the flexible layer one in the context of IMS services are: (1) to fulfill most of the IMS requirements in terms of radio bearer service attributes, (2) to support the multiplexing of parallel flows onto a basic physical subchannel, (3) to provide an optimisation of spectral efficiency through the support of different interleaving depths, unequal error protection/detection, reduced channel coding rate granularity, and support of 8PSK and GMSK modulations, and (4) to provide an efficient support of real-time IMS services.

q_20.question: What should the receiving side of an AM RLC entity do if it receives an AMD PDU with a sequence number (SN) outside of the receiving window?
q_20.ground_truth: The receiving side should discard the received AMD PDU.

q_21.question: What should the SME do in the case where all automatic attempts fail in sending an SMS-SUBMIT?
q_21.ground_truth: If all automatic attempts fail, the user shall be informed and the failed message should be stored in the mobile in such a way that the user can request a retransmission using the same TP-MR value, without the need to re-enter any information.

q_22.question: What is the purpose of the propagation condition "Case 2" in the UTRA simulations?
q_22.ground_truth: The purpose of the propagation condition "Case 2" in the UTRA simulations is to test the receiver under high delay spread conditions, ensuring efficient support of repeaters and not exceeding reasonable complexity or performance impact on the receiver.

q_23.question: What is the channel coding for the RATSCCH mechanism defined in 3GPP TS 28.062?
q_23.ground_truth: The channel coding for the RATSCCH mechanism is defined in 3GPP TS 45.003.

q_24.question: What is the responsibility of the GERAN in the establishment and association of TBF and TFI?
q_24.ground_truth: The GERAN establishes the association between RB~Id and TFI when the TBF is established for SBPSCHs and for DBPSCHs, the TFI equals the RB~Id.

q_25.question: What are the three conformance testing functions that can be activated (and deactivated) in the UE, as specified in the document?
q_25.ground_truth: UE test loop function, UE radio bearer test mode, and Electrical Man Machine Interface (EMMI).

q_26.question: In a FDD system, when will the Node B activate the inner loop DL power control for all RLs?
q_26.ground_truth: The Node B shall activate the inner loop DL power control for all RLs, if the received Inner Loop DL PC Status IE is set to "Active" in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message.

q_27.question: What should a SMLC do when it receives a Request for an unforeseen operation?
q_27.ground_truth: The SMLC sends an Error with the indication 'Unforeseen Operation' and ignores the Request.

q_28.question: What is the role of the "Security Function" clause in TS 23.060 in the authentication process between the MS and the network?
q_28.ground_truth: The "Security Function" clause in TS 23.060 defines the authentication functions. It is mandatory in the network to perform authentication if there is no existing MM context for the MS.

q_29.question: How is the high frequency band signal generated in the source-filter model for the high-band?
q_29.ground_truth: The high frequency band signal is generated using a source-filter model where the filter is an LP filter derived from the LP filter in the low-band. The LP filter in the high-band is preliminarily equalized to match the levels of the two LP filters at a given frequency point of 6000 Hz.

q_30.question: What command is sent by the MRFC to start an announcement?
q_30.ground_truth: The MRFC sends an ADD or MODIFY command to start an announcement.

q_31.question: What is the purpose of the "Spare extension" field in the error handling procedure?
q_31.ground_truth: The "Spare extension" field is included in the error handling procedure to allow for the addition of new fields or information in later versions of the document, without being interpreted by the receiver in the current version of the document.

q_32.question: In what circumstances should the UE abort the registration procedure for initial registration and re-initiate it immediately when changing into a new tracking area?
q_32.ground_truth: When the UE changes into a new tracking area before receiving the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_33.question: What does this solution introduce to reuse CAPIF for Edge application architecture?
q_33.ground_truth: This solution introduces the serving area to the service API information and query information in the service API publish and discover procedures in CAPIF.

q_34.question: What actions are taken in a successful Write-Replace procedure?
q_34.ground_truth: In a successful Write-Replace procedure, the CN initiates the process by sending a WRITE-REPLACE message to the RNC, which then broadcasts a new message or replaces an existing one as requested in the Service Areas List IE. The RNC uniquely identifies the CBS message using the Message Identifier IE and the leftmost bits of the Serial Number IE and Service Area Identifier IE.

q_35.question: What is the range of values for the I bit in the ISDN access indicator?
q_35.ground_truth: The I bit in the ISDN access indicator can have a value of either 0 or 1, where 0 indicates an originating access non-ISDN and 1 indicates an originating access ISDN.

q_36.question: In what mode should the network operation be the same in each cell of a routing area for proper operation?
q_36.ground_truth: The network operation should be the same in mode I or II in each cell of a routing area for proper operation.

q_37.question: What is the role of the "source BSS" in the PS handover preparation phase?
q_37.ground_truth: The source BSS is responsible for requesting a PS handover for an MS with one or more PFCs subject to handover, and signalling radio resources and system information to the MS before it moves to the target cell. The source BSS also ensures that the target BSS/GANC reserves necessary resources for the active PFCs in the target network nodes.

q_38.question: Which ID has a criticality value of "ignore" and a presence indicator of "mandatory" in the MBMSSessionStartResponse-IEs?
q_38.ground_truth: id-MME-MBMS-M3AP-ID has a criticality value of "ignore" and a presence indicator of "mandatory" in the MBMSSessionStartResponse-IEs.

q_39.question: What is the role of the Session Management Function (SMF) in the MBS service context?
q_39.ground_truth: The Session Management Function (SMF) may receive the UE's MBS context message from the AMF, classify UEs into different MBS service groups, and associate each group with a QoS profile.

q_40.question: What audio-related information should be included in the SDP payload when the ICS UE proposes an audio stream over a circuit-switched bearer?
q_40.ground_truth: The ICS UE should include a "c=" line with the nettype portion set to "PSTN", a CS media "m=" line with the media portion set to "audio", and a=setup attribute set to "active". Additionally, it should add an a=cs-correlation attribute with the MSISDN of the ICS UE in the CS domain, in international E.164 number format.

q_41.question: What is the Intermediate Rate field of the ISDN Bearer Capability information element value when the User Rate is 19.2 kbit/s?
q_41.ground_truth: The Intermediate Rate field of the ISDN Bearer Capability information element value is 32 kbit/s when the User Rate is 19.2 kbit/s.

q_42.question: What action should an SGSN take when it receives an MBMS De-registration Request?
q_42.ground_truth: An SGSN should send an MBMS De-registration Request to an GGSN to inform it that it no longer requires to receive session attributes and data for a particular MBMS service. The SGSN should include the End User Address and APN information in the request message.

q_43.question: Which UICC application's AIDs can be included in "Provisioning.xml" for the Contact Manager Server to be associated with?
q_43.ground_truth: One or several UICC applications' AIDs can be included in "Provisioning.xml" for the Contact Manager Server to be associated with.

q_44.question: What procedure does the Access Server (AS) use to determine the UE capabilities (e.g. video) when providing announcements during a communication session?
q_44.ground_truth: The AS takes the media feature tags into account to determine the UE capabilities when providing announcements.

q_45.question: How does a functional entity indicate support of a specific CAMEL phase 4 CSI?
q_45.ground_truth: To indicate support of a specific CAMEL phase 4 CSI, a functional entity shall have the ability to trigger on any initial service event possible for that CSI. For example, if a functional entity supports the CAMEL phase 4 O-CSI, it shall indicate this in its registration request to the HLR.

q_46.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Specification Group produce in terms of mobile networks?
q_46.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group produces technical specifications for 3GPP (Third Generation Partnership Project) systems, including UTRAN, E-UTRAN, and Iu mode GERAN.

q_47.question: What is the behavior of an IMS-AGW when it receives an SDP answer containing an "a=setup:passive" attribute when the IMS-ALG indicated to start a TCP connection establishment?
q_47.ground_truth: The IMS-AGW should indicate to the IMS-AGW to start a TCP connection establishment at the termination towards the SDP answerer.

q_48.question: What is the role of the MAC-m entity in the UE side for MTCH channels?
q_48.ground_truth: If MTCH channels are selectively combined, there is one MAC-c/sh/m for the current cell and one MAC-m entity for each neighboring cell in the UE. Otherwise, the MAC-m entity does not exist.

q_49.question: What are the two reporting levels for Credit-Control in SCUR?
q_49.ground_truth: The two reporting levels for Credit-Control in SCUR are per rating group, and per combination of the rating group and service id.

q_50.question: What is the minimum latency until a UE can start receiving SIB8 after the cmas-indication is received in the paging message?

q_51.question: What is the parameter used by the PDCP entity to determine the ciphering or deciphering algorithm and key for DAPS bearers?
q_51.ground_truth: The parameter used by the PDCP entity to determine the ciphering or deciphering algorithm and key for DAPS bearers is based on the cell from/to which the PDCP SDU is transmitted/received.

q_52.question: What is the network capacity gain for MDSR compared to EGPRS with MRC for different 10th percentile session bit rate requirements in the 4/12 re-use scenario?
q_52.ground_truth: Network capacity gain is 200~% to 270 % for 100 kbps requirement and 340 % to 550 % for the 144 kbps connection average bit rate requirement.

q_53.question: What is the difference between a user channel and a control channel?
q_53.ground_truth: User channels are intended to carry user information, while control channels are used to provide signalling information for connection management, mobility management, and radio resource management.

q_54.question: What is the purpose of the Improved Synchronized RRC Indicator?
q_54.ground_truth: The Improved Synchronized RRC Indicator is used to handle the improved synchronized RRC procedures.

q_55.question: What is the purpose of the dispatcher capabilities in the MCVideo service?
q_55.ground_truth: Dispatchers need advanced capabilities for managing MCVideo services for MCVideo Users and fixed cameras under their control, such as requesting a monitoring camera to transmit a video to the dispatcher, terminating the video transmission from the monitoring camera, and distributing a video to MCVideo Group Members.

q_56.question: How is the number of PCOMP values determined in protocol control information compression?
q_56.ground_truth: The number of PCOMP values is determined dynamically based on the negotiation of the XID parameters for protocol control information compression. Each assigned PCOMP value denotes one compressed frame type of that compression algorithm.

q_57.question: What should the initiating UE do upon receiving a DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST to add a QoS flow to be used on an added unicast SL-DRB?
q_57.ground_truth: The initiating UE should be able to communicate using the newly added QoS flow on added SL-DRB.

q_58.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a UEInformationRequest message with the idleModeMeasurementReq?
q_58.ground_truth: If the UE has stored VarMeasIdleReport that contains measurement information concerning cells other than the PCell, the UE should set the measResultIdleEUTRA and measResultIdleNR in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of measReportIdleEUTRA and measReportIdleNR in the VarMeasIdleReport.

q_59.question: What should the MME do if it does not receive UE EPS security capabilities from the SGSN during a handover?
q_59.ground_truth: The MME shall assume that the default set of EPS security algorithms is supported by the UE.

q_60.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects' Performance Management (PM) specifications?
q_60.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects' Performance Management (PM) specifications is to define the concept, requirements, and performance measurements for the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's telecommunication network.

q_61.question: What is the maximum number of intra frequency TDD cells that a UE is required to be able to monitor?
q_61.ground_truth: A UE is required to be able to monitor up to 32 intra frequency TDD cells (including serving cell).

q_62.question: What is the purpose of the "Wait Time" between consecutive windows of time in the registration procedure?
q_62.ground_truth: The "Wait Time" is used to determine the start and end time of each consecutive window of time. It ensures that UEs only attempt registration during specific windows of time, allowing for a more staggered and manageable registration process.

q_63.question: What information does the MAC sub-layer send to the physical random-access procedure when it is initiated?
q_63.ground_truth: The Transport Format to be used for the specific PRACH message, the ASC for the specific Random Access procedure, and the data to be transmitted (Transport Block Set).

q_64.question: In what scenario is the WLAN offload indication information element not taken into account for the Access stratum indication via untrusted WLAN?
q_64.ground_truth: When the move-traffic-to-WLAN indication is received from the access stratum layer of the 3GPP access, and the local operating environment information in the UE does not contain non-radio-related conditions that prohibit the use of WLAN access.

q_65.question: What is the objective of the measurements from all cells as identified in section 7.1.1?
q_65.ground_truth: The objective of the measurements from all cells as identified in section 7.1.1 is to obtain useful information from its surrounding cells for purposes such as interference management.

q_66.question: What is the purpose of the "Restriction Timer" information element?
q_66.ground_truth: The "Restriction Timer" information element indicates to the mobile station whether any actions shall be performed on the target cell.

q_67.question: What are the options for the applicable clause for lower power SRS relaxation due to TxD?
q_67.ground_truth: The options for the applicable clause for lower power SRS relaxation due to TxD are Option 1: Same as general, 6.2.4 (Ericsson, Oppo, Huawei), and Option 2: TxD suffix G (Samsung, ZTE, Qualcomm).

q_68.question: What is the difference between user-plane (UP) and controlled-plane (CP) based solutions for UE-to-Network Relay authorization and security?
q_68.ground_truth: UP based solutions use a UP connection to a PKMF while CP based solutions use the primary authentication for PC5 keys establishment.

q_69.question: What is the purpose of the "Promiscuous" approach in MBMS download?
q_69.ground_truth: Instructs FLUTE to receive all files available in the session.

q_70.question: What should the UE do upon reception of a DL NAS TRANSPORT message with the Payload container type IE set to "N1 SM information" and the 5GMM cause IE set to the 5GMM cause #78 "PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location"?
q_70.ground_truth: The UE should pass to the 5GSM sublayer an indication that the 5GSM message was not forwarded because the UE is registered to a PLMN via a satellite NG-RAN cell that is not allowed to operate at the present UE location along with the 5GSM message from the Payload container IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

q_71.question: What value does the Next Extension Header Type field have when no other Extension header follows?
q_71.ground_truth: When no other Extension header follows, the value of the Next Extension Header Type field is 0.

q_72.question: What happens if all checks are successful and the new 3G-SGSN decides to construct MM and PDP contexts for the MS?
q_72.ground_truth: The new 3G-SGSN responds to the MS with a Routeing Area Update Accept (P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, IMS voice over PS Session Supported Indication, Emergency Service Support) message.

q_73.question: What action has no impact on the control procedures and the operation of the service?

q_74.question: How are CCNR requests and CCBS requests from different users handled if they are directed towards the same terminating party?
q_74.ground_truth: CCNR requests and CCBS requests from different users are queued in the same queue.

q_75.question: In what mode and state does an SMC entity enter after completion of the NAS signalling connection establishment and receiving confirmation from the lower layer?
q_75.ground_truth: After completion of the NAS signalling connection establishment, the SMC entity forwards the CP-DATA message to the lower layer, sets the timer TC1* and enters the Wait for CP-ACK state.

q_76.question: What is the requirement for an IRPManager to remove a partial suspension of Itf-N?
q_76.ground_truth: An IRPManager shall be able to remove a partial suspension of Itf-N.

q_77.question: What is one of the typical cause values for Radio Network Layer Causes?
q_77.ground_truth: One of the typical cause values for Radio Network Layer Causes is UL Radio Resources not Available.

q_78.question: What should a mobile station do when the PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message commands it to a frequency band not supported by the mobile station?
q_78.ground_truth: The mobile station should regard this as the network controlled cell reselection procedure has failed and stop timer T3174. It shall then start timer T3176, return to the old cell, and send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message to the network in the old cell.

q_79.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives an initiating message that does not have a message to report unsuccessful outcome and contains one or more IEs/IE groups marked as "Reject IE" that it does not comprehend?
q_79.ground_truth: The receiving node should initiate the Error Indication procedure to report that one or more IEs/IE groups have been rejected.

q_80.question: What is the purpose of an IOPS MC service group ID in the IOPS mode of operation?
q_80.ground_truth: An IOPS MC service group ID is used for identifying an MC service group in the IOPS mode of operation, and it allows the MC service UE to make communication with other member UEs within the same IOPS MC service group ID.

q_81.question: What is the purpose of the silence descriptor (SID) frame in GSM mobile communications?
q_81.ground_truth: The SID frame conveys information on the acoustic background noise and initiates the comfort noise generation on the receive side.

q_82.question: What is the advantage of adding new SDP attributes over solution D in terms of SDP processing load?
q_82.ground_truth: The new attribute appears only one time for each media line (and not potentially multiple times in the SDP offer) in the SDP answer, making the SDP processing load smaller compared to solution D.

q_83.question: How can a 3GP-DASH client determine if a highlight is captured in the Media Presentation?
q_83.ground_truth: A DASH client can determine if the highlight(s) is/are captured in the Media Presentation, and if so, it can select Adaptation Sets that contain the highlight(s) without having to look into the Segments. A user or client is able to retrieve a full description of highlights independently from the MPD in order to minimize the size of the MPD.

q_84.question: What is the purpose of the "ManifestUri" parameter in the e Media Streaming Services?
q_84.ground_truth: The "ManifestUri" parameter provides an HTTP URL where the Manifest for the Media Streaming Application Service is hosted and available for Media Clients access.

q_85.question: What does the "carrier" parameter in the ConnectArgExtension sequence represent?
q_85.ground_truth: The "carrier" parameter in the ConnectArgExtension sequence represents the carrier used for the call.

q_86.question: Which document provides a system-wide view of the operation of DRX in the GSM system?
q_86.ground_truth: The present document, 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network; Discontinuous Reception (DRX) in the GSM system (Release 17), provides a system-wide view of the operation of DRX in the GSM system.

q_87.question: Which PDU types are contained in the RP-ERROR PDU?
q_87.ground_truth: SMS-DELIVER-REPORT and SMS-SUBMIT-REPORT can be carried as a RP-User-Data element within an RP-ERROR PDU.

q_88.question: What is the cause for the "No radio resource available" mapping in RANAP Relocation Failure to BSSMAP Handover Failure?
q_88.ground_truth: This mapping indicates that there is no radio resource available for the handover.

q_89.question: How many new multislot classes need to be supported by the chipset and the software?
q_89.ground_truth: New multislot classes numbering up to 12 need to be supported by the chipset and the software.

q_90.question: What are the different encoded block formats for the message in sub-clause 9.1.12a?
q_90.ground_truth: The message in sub-clause 9.1.12a can be encoded in five different formats: 176 bits, 304 bits, 11 bits or 8 bits, 75 bits or 67 bits, and 64 bits.

q_91.question: How can the target UE be addressed in LCS?
q_91.ground_truth: The target UE can be addressed using MSISDN, SIP-URI, IP address, or a pseudonym based on IMSI or MSISDN.

q_92.question: What is the purpose of the iE-Extensions field in the GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item?
q_92.ground_truth: The iE-Extensions field is used to include additional information as a ProtocolExtensionContainer in the form of GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item-ExtIEs.

q_93.question: Which RRC message is received at the UE to indicate a successful outgoing inter-RAT handover in the context of circuit switched traffic?
q_93.ground_truth: Transmission of a RRC-message HANDOVER FROM UTRAN COMMAND indicating a successful outgoing inter-RAT handover.

q_94.question: What is an approach to determining the presence of victim UEs in the vicinity of a HeNB based on reported UE measurements?
q_94.ground_truth: The macro or HeNB could share the information of reported UE measurements in a standardized or non-standardized interface to determine if there are victim UEs in the vicinity of a HeNB.

q_95.question: What should a UE do if the barred cell meets the same frequency and reselection criteria?
q_95.ground_truth: The UE should exclude the barred cell as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for 300 seconds.

q_96.question: What conditions are necessary for PDCP entity re-establishment during handover?
q_96.ground_truth: PDCP entity re-establishment during handover is supported for DRBs using RLC AM mode with a security key change, for DRBs using RLC AM mode with a data recovery procedure without a key change, for DRBs using RLC UM mode with a security key change, and for SRBs with a security key change or remaining as it is without a key change.

q_97.question: What is the significance of the MPD in DASH-enabled environments?
q_97.ground_truth: The MPD (Media Presentation Description) in DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) is significant as it sets up the live Media Presentation and provides crucial information such as availabilityStartTime, minimumUpdatePeriod, suggestedPresentationDelay, minBufferTime, timeShiftBufferDepth, and start times for the Period and SegmentTemplate in the Representation to enable access to media content closer to the live edge.

q_98.question: In the scenario with FR2, Dense Urban, DL, single stream traffic model, 30Mbps, 60FPS, 400MHz bandwidth, PDB increase from 10ms to 15ms, what is the increase in mean capacity performance for a mean capacity performance of 34 UEs per cell to 36 UEs per cell?
q_98.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is increased by about 5.9%.

q_99.question: What is the mechanism for reporting RAN user plane congestion information (RUCI) to the PCRF?
q_99.ground_truth: RUCI includes information such as UE IMSI, eNB identifier, APN for which congestion information is reported, and congestion level. It is reported to the PCRF by the RCAF to enable the PCRF to take RAN user plane congestion status into account for policy decisions.

q_100.question: What should a packet attached UE do when there is a temporarily loss of coverage to not lose its EPS Bearer/PDP context?
q_100.ground_truth: The UE should not lose its EPS Bearer/PDP context in case of a temporarily loss of coverage. The network can use timers to detect if a UE has been out of coverage for a long period of time and then remove unused EPS Bearer/PDP contexts, dependent upon operator policy.

q_101.question: Which network mode of operation (NMO I) value indicates unrestricted network access?
q_101.ground_truth: NMO I value of 0 or '1' indicates unrestricted network access.

q_102.question: What is the difference between "ng-eNB-CU" and "ng-eNB-DU"?
q_102.ground_truth: ng-eNB-CU is a logical node hosting RRC, SDAP, and PDCP protocols of the ng-eNB that controls the operation of one or more ng-eNB-DUs, while ng-eNB-DU is a logical node hosting RLC, MAC, and PHY layers of the ng-eNB, and its operation is partly controlled by ng-eNB-CU.

q_103.question: What action should an MS take if it declares a radio link failure in the MS during a voice group call or voice broadcast?
q_103.ground_truth: An MS, upon a downlink radio link failure during a voice group call or voice broadcast, shall return to idle mode and perform cell re-selection.

q_104.question: What action is taken by the source SRNC regarding uplink and downlink data transfer during SRNS relocation for RABs requiring delivery order?
q_104.ground_truth: The uplink and downlink data transfer is suspended in the source SRNC for RABs, which require delivery order during SRNS relocation.

q_105.question: What are the three options for the privacy verification of a value-added LCS client in the call/session unrelated class?
q_105.ground_truth: The three options are positioning allowed without notifying the UE user, positioning allowed with notification to the UE user, and positioning requires notification and verification by the UE user (allowed only if granted by the UE user or if there is no response to the notification).

q_106.question: What action should an MRFC take upon reception of an RTCP feedback message with the "DBI" signalling and the "query parameter q" set to '1'?
q_106.ground_truth: The MRFC may adjust the delay of the outgoing media stream, if possible.

q_107.question: What is the general principle behind the hybrid ACELP/TCX core encoding algorithm?
q_107.ground_truth: The hybrid ACELP/TCX core encoding algorithm is based on deciding (in open-loop or closed-loop) which encoding model (ACELP or TCX) is best for encoding every block of input signal. ACELP is a time-domain, predictive encoder while TCX is a transform-based encoder. Different frame lengths are possible in TCX mode depending on the signal structure.

q_108.question: In single stream region-independent coding for VR video streaming, how is the content encoded?
q_108.ground_truth: In single stream region-independent coding, the content is encoded with the same resolution and quality settings over the complete 360 content and delivered as a single stream. The client decodes the complete stream but shows only the cropped part corresponding to the viewport.

q_109.question: What is an option for the IWU when it receives a response to a SIP INVITE without an ALLOW header listing the UPDATE method from an external SIP-I network?
q_109.ground_truth: The IWU can return the response to the preceding 3GPP node containing an ALLOW header listing the UPDATE method or consider the response received from the external network as erroneous and reject the call accordingly.

q_110.question: What is used to multiplex data from multiple RLC instances onto a TBF?
q_110.ground_truth: TBF stealing, where the MAC layer selects one of the TBFs currently established on an SBPSCH for the MS in question and adds the SRBid to the RLC/MAC header to allow the receiving MAC entity to detect that TBF stealing is used.

q_111.question: What should the UE do upon receiving the UEInformationRequest message if it has stored VarMeasIdleReport that contains measurement information concerning cells other than the PCell?
q_111.ground_truth: The UE should set the measResultIdleNR in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of measReportIdleNR in the VarMeasIdleReport, if available.

q_112.question: In the context of GPRS MS, what do the terms MS operation modes A, B, and C refer to?
q_112.ground_truth: MS operation modes A, B, and C are sometimes referred to as GPRS class-A MS, GPRS class-B MS, and GPRS class-C MS respectively.

q_113.question: When using the SCS-AS-Address AVP, which AVP should be used additionally if the 3GPP-Charging-ID is expected to be used?
q_113.ground_truth: The SCS-Realm AVP should be used if the 3GPP-Charging-ID is expected to be used.

q_114.question: What attribute is used to specify the location of the stream of updates in the dims:updates element?

q_115.question: What is the meaning of CSG Indicator in a 3GPP system?
q_115.ground_truth: A CSG Indicator is an indication transmitted on the broadcast channel of the CSG cell that allows the UE to identify such a CSG cell.

q_116.question: What are the conditions for exchange of data between the terminating service provider and the trusted data source?
q_116.ground_truth: The conditions for exchange of data are governed by regional regulatory administration and through service provider agreement.

q_117.question: What action does the IMS-ALG take if the "a=3ge2ae:requested" SDP attribute is present and the IMS-ALG indicated support of e2ae-security during registration?
q_117.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG allocates resources, includes the IMS-AGW in the media path, and proceeds as specified in the clause.

q_118.question: What is the procedure followed when a UE removes the Trusted WLAN access from a PDN connection under certain conditions?
q_118.ground_truth: The PDN GW indicates to the PCRF the removal of TWAN access for the multi-access PDN connection via IP-CAN Session Modification procedures, if dynamic PCC is applied for the PDN connection (step 4).

q_119.question: What is the suggested presentation delay in the MPD example for Use Case B?
q_119.ground_truth: The suggested presentation delay in the MPD example for Use Case B is 10 seconds.

q_120.question: What is the UDP destination port number for GTP-C request messages?
q_120.ground_truth: The UDP destination port number for GTP-C request messages is 2123.

q_121.question: What is the impact of the reduction in duplexer TX port signal power on the required minimum IIP3?
q_121.ground_truth: The required minimum LNA IIP3 is 32.3 dBm and the required minimum post-filter receiver IIP3 is 16.2 dBm.

q_122.question: What protocol is used between the AF and NEF to secure their communication in the solution for key issue 7?
q_122.ground_truth: The AF establishes a TLS (Transport Layer Security) session with the NEF to secure their communication.

q_123.question: When operating in MIMO mode, how does the scheduler use the redundancy version coding to indicate a new transmission or a retransmission?
q_123.ground_truth: When operating in MIMO mode, the scheduler uses the redundancy version coding to indicate a new transmission by setting the value to 0, and retransmission to any other value greater than 0.

q_124.question: What is the maximum RF output power reduction capability of the BSS from its maximum level, as defined in 3GPP TS 45.005?
q_124.ground_truth: The BSS shall be capable of reducing its RF output power from its maximum level by nominally 30 dB, in 15 steps of nominally 2 dB.

q_125.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of this 3GPP technical specification?
q_125.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the status of the document within the TSG, while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, including technical enhancements, corrections, and updates.

q_126.question: What does the OIP service provide to the terminating user?
q_126.ground_truth: The OIP service provides the terminating user with the possibility of receiving trusted (i.e. network-provided) identity information in order to identify the originating user.

q_127.question: What 2nd priority channels do not meet the absolute MPL target in the Urban 28GHz TDD NLOS O2I scenario?
q_127.ground_truth: PUSCH with SIP invite DDDSU, PUSCH for CSI 11bits DDDSU, PUSCH for CSI 22bits DDDSU, PRACH Format C2, PDSCH of Msg2 DDDSU, PDSCH of Msg2 DDSU, PUCCH with HARQ-ACK Msg4.

q_128.question: What is one way a UE can access disaster roaming in a PLMN with Disaster Condition?
q_128.ground_truth: A UE can access disaster roaming in a PLMN with Disaster Condition if the "List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition" is provided by the UE's home PLMN during a rejected registration, and the UE is successfully authenticated in the PLMN without Disaster Condition with activated integrity protection.

q_129.question: How does a UE activate separate MBMS bearer services for the same MBMS user service for different access technologies?
q_129.ground_truth: A UE activates separate MBMS bearer services by receiving multicast MBMS bearer service instructions from the BM-SC, which sends the instructions within a service announcement message.

q_130.question: What action must the UE take if it receives a Service Gap Time in the Registration Accept message?
q_130.ground_truth: The UE must store the Service Gap Time value and apply Service Gap Control as specified in TS~23.501 clause~5.31.16.

q_131.question: What is the role of the MBS-Aware Application in deactivating the MBS User Service Session?
q_131.ground_truth: The MBS-Aware Application invokes a client API exposed by the MBSF~Client to deactivate the MBS User Service Session, which in turn deactivates the MBS Distribution Sessions and sends the Distribution Session deactivated event to the MBS Application Provider.

q_132.question: What is the format of the domain in the measurement name and what does it identify?
q_132.ground_truth: The format of the domain in the measurement name is the format of the domain name information in the SIP messages, and it identifies the network domain

q_133.question: What is the relationship between the CDF and the CGF in the 5G ProSe architecture for ProSe Function generating charging information with an integrated CDF?
q_133.ground_truth: If the ProSe Function generating the charging information has an integrated CDF, then the ProSe Function can produce CDRs. The CGF may also be integrated in the ProSe Function, or it may exist as a physically separate entity.

q_134.question: Which band is affected by 2nd order harmonics of Band n28 uplink for EN-DC in NR FR1?
q_134.ground_truth: 2nd order harmonics of Band n28 uplink may fall into the own Rx of band 32.

q_135.question: What information is provided by the UTC parameters in the TLM Word broadcasted by the GPS satellite?
q_135.ground_truth: The UTC parameters provide Coordinated Universal Time to the UE.

q_136.question: What is the significance of the Precedence field in a routing rule for the PCRF?
q_136.ground_truth: The Precedence field in a routing rule defines in what order the routing rules is used by the PCRF to determine where to route a service data flow. It is derived from the priority included in the Binding Update.

q_137.question: How should the timestamps in PM files be represented as per 3GPP TS 32.432?
q_137.ground_truth: All timestamps in PM files should follow the representations allowed by the ISO 8601 standard. The precise format for timestamp representation should be derived from ISO 8601. The representation should refer to either UTC time or local time or local time with an offset from UTC.

q_138.question: What is the general method for QPSK used as input in calculating eplus, eminus, and eini in the hybrid ARQ rate matching stage?
q_138.ground_truth: The general method for QPSK is used to calculate eplus, eminus, and eini in the hybrid ARQ rate matching stage with Nsys, Np1, Nap2, and Nedata,j as input parameters.

q_139.question: What tunnels are used for transferring user data during a PS handover from GERAN A/Gb mode/GAN mode to GERAN A/Gb mode?
q_139.ground_truth: BSSGP PFCs tunnel(s) between the source GANC and SGSN, and GTP tunnel(s) between the SGSN and GGSN are used for transferring user data during a PS handover from GERAN A/Gb mode/GAN mode to GERAN A/Gb mode.

q_140.question: How are the individual Unicast PC5 DRXs determined for each UE engaged in Unicast Link communication?
q_140.ground_truth: The individual Unicast PC5 DRXs are determined based on all the ongoing traffic of the UE's Unicast Links, other than just the traffic of this current Unicast Link. Consequently, the individual Unicast PC5 DRX of each UE can be different.

q_141.question: What is the role of the NAF in this process?
q_141.ground_truth: The NAF initiates the UE authentication, validates the response digest, and retrieves the shared application specific NAF key to validate the assertion received from the OpenID Provider.

q_142.question: What is the principle used in phase extrapolation for quasi-stationary signals?
q_142.ground_truth: The principle of group delay conservation.

q_143.question: What is the function of the UP Transport Layer Information IE in 5G networks?
q_143.ground_truth: The UP Transport Layer Information IE identifies a W1 transport bearer associated to a DRB and contains a Transport Layer Address and a GTP Tunnel Endpoint Identifier for the W1 user plane transport.

q_144.question: What is the significance of the notation 'Mandatory' when discussing SIP extensions in the context of the NGCN-NGN interface?
q_144.ground_truth: The notation 'Mandatory' refers to SIP extensions that the NGCN is required to support for the NGCN-NGN interface.

q_145.question: How does the VAE layer provide dynamic information towards the V2X application specific layer?
q_145.ground_truth: The VAE layer provides dynamic information towards the V2X application specific layer through the group management service procedures such as creation, join, and leave.

q_146.question: What are the typical sources of interference in a SAIC receiver?
q_146.ground_truth: The typical sources of interference in a SAIC receiver are co-channel and adjacent channel interference. For adjacent channel interference, a realistic Adjacent Channel Protection (ACP) should be used.

q_147.question: How does the user equipment measure the timing deviation with respect to the reference time Tref of the received first path in time from the UpPCH?
q_147.ground_truth: The user equipment measures the timing deviation by subtracting the reference time Tref from the time at which the first path of the UpPCH is received.

q_148.question: What does the SMF do after receiving the positive response from the AF for the early notification?
q_148.ground_truth: After receiving a positive response from the AF, the SMF establishes a temporary N9 forwarding tunnel and keeps the current Source BP/ULCL and Source UPF (PSA2) for some time, allowing the UE traffic to continue reaching the old EAS.

q_149.question: What are the two service access points defined on signalling layer 2 and what are their functions?
q_149.ground_truth: The two service access points defined on signalling layer 2 are SAPI 0 and SAPI 3. SAPI 0 supports the transfer of signalling information, including user-user information, while SAPI 3 supports the transfer of user short messages.

q_150.question: What is the definition of "personal data" in the document?
q_150.ground_truth: Personal data is defined as information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person; an identifiable natural person is one who can be identified, directly or indirectly, in particular by reference to an identity such as a name, an identification, location data, an online identifier or to one or more factors specific to the physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural or social identity of that natural person.

q_151.question: What information element is used by the SCC AS to convey to the ICS UE the identity of the conference focus in an I1 message?

q_152.question: What should a recipient do when it receives a message with a non-essential information element that has a too short length?
q_152.ground_truth: When a recipient detects this event, it should ignore the information that it is unable to understand and treat the message based on the information that remains.

q_153.question: What must the IRPManager do after creating a to-be-HNBProfile instance in subclause 7.2.1?
q_153.ground_truth: The IRPManager must prepare the value of the attribute criterion and attribute userLabel of the to-be-created HNBProfile, and then use either Basic CM IRP IS createMO or Bulk CM IRP IS BulkCmCreateMo (Create MO Sub-operation) to create the HNBProfile instance.

q_154.question: How are multi-lateral CAs formed and extended in the two approaches?
q_154.ground_truth: In the first approach (A set of bi-lateral CAs), joining in a multi-lateral CA is always done through one of the member CCNs, and the composed CCN does not need to reveal its identity to the outside. In the second approach (A multi-lateral CA), joining in a multi-lateral CA is always done by directly contacting the composed CCN, which needs to reveal its identity to the outside. The first approach has the advantage of possibility not to reveal the composed CCN's identity, while the second approach has the advantage of using an existing multi-lateral business/technical agreement for new members to join in.

q_155.question: What is the orientation of the base station (BS) during the installation in the quiet zone of the probe?
q_155.ground_truth: The manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the BS is set to be aligned with the testing system.

q_156.question: When must the I-MGCF send a 183 Session Progress response with the P-Early-Media header field indicating that the backward early media is not authorized?
q_156.ground_truth: If the I-MGCF has received a P-Early-Media header field in the initial INVITE request and has not already sent a provisional response including the P-Early-Media header field with parameters indicating that a backward early media is not authorized, then it shall send the 183 Session Progress response with the P-Early-Media header field indicating the backward early media is not authorized.

q_157.question: What is the role of the ProSe layer in the Discovery Complete message in the context of PC5 group communication?
q_157.ground_truth: The ProSe layer of each member UE passes groupcast related information/parameters such as Layer-2 ID information (i.e. source Layer-2 ID and destination Layer-2 ID), QoS related information, HARQ operation related information to the AS layer.

q_158.question: What should the UE do if the network-initiated NBIFOM mode is selected and the UE detects that the untrusted WLAN has become unusable?
q_158.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the PDP context modification procedure if the PDN connection is a multi-access PDN connection for IP flows over GERAN or UTRAN and WLAN and the UE detects that the untrusted WLAN has become unusable.

q_159.question: What is the name of the operation package in CAP that includes callHandlingPackage and is invoked by the gsmSSF?

q_160.question: What is the function of UTC-based counter in ProSe Public Safety Discovery?
q_160.ground_truth: The UTC-based counter provides freshness for the protection of the restricted discovery message on the PC5 interface and helps protect against replays.

q_161.question: What is the process of partial media transfer in a multimedia session between UE-1 and UE-2 when UE-1 changes to a new IP-CAN?
q_161.ground_truth: UE-1 transfers part of the multimedia session with UE-2 to the new IP-CAN and keeps the remaining part on the original IP-CAN by updating session information over the old access leg after sending an INVITE message in step 3 indicating the media flow(s) that need to be transferred to the new IP-CAN.

q_162.question: What state is entered when a first intensive search for fixed parts fails in the 5G system?

q_163.question: How is the initial grant size determined for the Random Access procedure on the E-UTRA side in EN-DC?
q_163.ground_truth: The initial grant size is 208 bits for the Random Access procedure on the E-UTRA side in EN-DC.

q_164.question: What happens when a user is enjoying high quality video but the network is congested?
q_164.ground_truth: The operator may communicate to the user's UE to decrease the bitrate of the video to a certain value that would allow the cell to accommodate the load. If the user has a "multimedia premium" monthly option, they may continue to enjoy high quality video even in congested situations.

q_165.question: What does the "L" in the length indicator indicate?
q_165.ground_truth: The "L" in the length indicator indicates the number of octets contained in the information field of UI, SABM, UA or I frames.

q_166.question: What is the significance of shared key material between UE and the mobile operator's PKI portal?
q_166.ground_truth: UE and the mobile operator's PKI portal must share key material for the certificate request and operator CA certificate retrieval to be protected. This requirement ensures secure communication between the UE and the mobile operator's PKI portal.

q_167.question: What is the significance of version numbering x.y.z in the NBAP document?
q_167.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the stage of the document (presented for information, presented for approval, or approved under change control). The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated.

q_168.question: What does the SS check in step 13 to determine if the test has passed or failed?
q_168.ground_truth: The SS checks the rstd value for nCell 2 in the OTDOA-SignalMeasurementInformation IE to determine if it meets the required tolerance levels. For the overall test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_169.question: What does the "rPCause" parameter indicate in the ReleaseSMS procedure?
q_169.ground_truth: The "rPCause" parameter gives an indication to the smsSSF about the reason of releasing a specific Short Message.

q_170.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_170.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals is responsible for specifying the principles of interworking between the 3GPP IM CN subsystem and BICC/ISUP based legacy CS networks.

q_171.question: What is the purpose of the DIMS Scene Commands?
q_171.ground_truth: DIMS Scene Commands are a set of one or more commands used to modify the state of a DIMS Scene.

q_172.question: What should the SAS assume for the GANSS timing if the GANSS Measured Results IE in the POSITION PERIODIC REPORT message does not contain the GANSS Time ID IE?
q_172.ground_truth: The SAS shall assume that the corresponding GANSS timing refers to the "Galileo" timing.

q_173.question: What should the terminating AS do if some elements of the eCNAM metadata are unavailable from the data sources?
q_173.ground_truth: The terminating AS shall deliver the available data to the terminating UE in Call-Info header fields, and shall not deliver the string "unavailable" for the missing elements.

q_174.question: What are some potential benefits of deploying wireless medical equipment in operating rooms for hospitals and healthcare providers?
q_174.ground_truth: Some potential benefits of deploying wireless medical equipment in operating rooms include equipment sharing for efficient resource optimization, on-demand addition of complementary imaging equipment during surgeries, suppression of hazardous cables, and improved infection control by reducing the number of medical devices and cables. In summary, going wireless in operating rooms can make procedures planning easier for hospitals and help improve the quality of care provided to patients by healthcare providers.

q_175.question: What information is used by the SMF to perform UPF selection and send an N4 establishment request to the UPF in the context of UE-UE TSC communication?
q_175.ground_truth: The SMF performs UPF selection based on the information provided in the PDU session establishment request from UE1. This information includes the destination address of UE2 and, optionally, a port-pair suggestion of UE2-DS-TT.

q_176.question: What is the purpose of the XnAP IAB Resource Coordination procedure introduced in Rel-17?
q_176.ground_truth: The purpose of the XnAP IAB Resource Coordination procedure introduced in Rel-17 is to allow source and target IAB-donors to coordinate the use of radio resources used on parent and child links.

q_177.question: What is the expected time limit for making the Minimum Set of Data (MSD) available to the PSAP in eCall?
q_177.ground_truth: The MSD should typically be made available to the PSAP within 4 seconds, measured from the time when the end-to-end connection with the PSAP is established.

q_178.question: Which UE category does the test 9.2.5A.2 apply to?
q_178.ground_truth: This test applies to E-UTRA TDD UE Category 1bis release 13 and forward that support inter-frequency RSTD measurements.

q_179.question: What should the controller UE do upon receiving a SIP REFER response with a non-2xx final response?
q_179.ground_truth: The controller UE should consider the transfer operation failed and continue the existing session with media components prior to the failed transfer attempt.

q_180.question: What is the objective of step A.0 in the dedicated bearer procedure for a PMIP-based S5/S8 in E-UTRAN Access?
q_180.ground_truth: The objective of step A.0 is for the PCRF to request or de-allocate resources in the BBF access network, including the QoS Information such as SDF, QCI, ARP, GBR, and MBR.

q_181.question: What is the use of PCOMP values in TCP/IP header compression?
q_181.ground_truth: PCOMP values are used in TCP/IP header compression to distinguish the three types of compressed N-PDUs, specifically "Uncompressed TCP", "Compressed TCP", and "Type IP".

q_182.question: What message does the fixed part return to the mobile station to indicate the successful initiation of the START DTMF procedure?

q_183.question: How are the supported per-cause measurements for Iu release request handled when only a subset is supported?
q_183.ground_truth: In case only a subset of per-cause measurements is supported, a sum measurement subtype will be provided first.

q_184.question: In step c) of the procedure in section 10.1.3.4.2, what message does the E-USS send to the UE and what information is included in the message?
q_184.ground_truth: In step c) of the procedure, the E-USS sends the AttachAccept message to the UE, including the TAI (MCC/MNC/TAC) 246/081/0001 and GUTI "24608100010266345678".

q_185.question: What is the purpose of recording the use of call forwarding?
q_185.ground_truth: Recording the use of call forwarding allows the Billing Domain (BD) to specify the supplementary service actions (invocation, registration, etc.) and determine how these events are to be recorded. Non-call related events are recorded as supplementary service action records, while call related events are recorded in-line in the appropriate CDR and/or in a separate SS-action record.

q_186.question: What is the intended audience for the ISIM API specification?
q_186.ground_truth: The ISIM API specification is intended for network operators, service providers, server-ISIM, and database manufacturers.

q_187.question: What is the purpose of the Serving Cell Identifier parameter in the BSSMAP-LE ASSISTANCE INFORMATION REQUEST message?
q_187.ground_truth: This parameter identifies the serving cell of the target MS for which the SMLC is requesting assistance information.

q_188.question: What is the purpose of the Operations Systems interoperability architecture in a 3GPP system?
q_188.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable interoperability between operations systems in a 3GPP system, allowing different organizations to share information and interoperate, which is critical for managing third generation systems.

q_189.question: What is the maximum number of Data-Reference AVPs that can be present in a Profile-Update-Request message?
q_189.ground_truth: More than one Data-Reference AVP may be present in the message only if both the AS and the HSS support the Update-Eff-Enhance feature.

q_190.question: When should relevant measurement entities be reported based on the Report Characteristics IE set to "Event A" in 1.28Mcps TDD or FDD?
q_190.ground_truth: The Node B shall initiate the Common Measurement Reporting procedure when the measured entity rises above the requested threshold and stays there for the requested hysteresis time.

q_191.question: What is the role of the MPD information for DASH-based VR video services?
q_191.ground_truth: The MPD information is used for content quality evaluation in DASH-based streaming video applications. For VR services, it needs to include additional information such as the audio bandwidth and projection methods, to better understand and manage the delivered media characteristics.

q_192.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_192.ground_truth: A collaboration between multiple standards organizations to define specifications for 3GPP wireless communication.

q_193.question: What is the role of the Transport Network Layer (TNL) in the UTRAN Iub interface user plane protocols?
q_193.ground_truth: The Transport Network Layer (TNL) is expected to provide delivery of Frame Protocol PDUs. In-sequence delivery is not required, but frequent out-of-sequence delivery may impact the performance and should be avoided.

q_194.question: What is the purpose of the Paging Filtering Rules in solution #10?
q_194.ground_truth: The Paging Filtering Rules in solution #10 are used to filter paging based on user preferences and settings, and to specify which services are eligible for paging.

q_195.question: What is an example of a situation where IP addresses may not be re-allocated to other SMFs in 5G networks?
q_195.ground_truth: An SMF has failed without restart.

q_196.question: What is the requirement for the protection of PHS when UTRA-FDD Repeaters are deployed in the same geographic area and at specified frequencies?
q_196.ground_truth: The power of any spurious emission should not exceed the limits specified in the document for co-existence with PHS.

q_197.question: What is the action in the Originating Basic Call State Model when an exception condition is encountered?
q_197.ground_truth: Default handling of the exception condition is being provided, which includes general actions to ensure no resources remain inappropriately allocated, like sending an error information flow indicating that outstanding call handling instructions will not run to completion and making use of vendor-specific procedures to release resources within the (G)MSC.

q_198.question: What does the Occurrence property of the node "<X>/V2XoverPC5/NotServedByEUTRAN/RadioParameters/<X>" indicate?
q_198.ground_truth: The Occurrence property being "OneOrMore" indicates that this node must appear at least once and can appear multiple times.

q_199.question: During a MO-LR operation, what happens if the network is unable to receive a new location request operation or a RELEASE COMPLETE message from the MS after a PLMN administered time period has elapsed?
q_199.ground_truth: The network may clear the transaction by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message if it has returned a result to the MS in a FACILITY message but does not receive a new location request operation in a FACILITY message or a RELEASE COMPLETE message from the MS after a PLMN administered time period has elapsed.

q_200.question: What procedures are specified for on-demand location reporting in the SEAL location management procedures?
q_200.ground_truth: The on-demand location reporting procedure is specified in subclause 9.3.4 of the SEAL location management procedures. It allows the location of a device to be requested at any time, without waiting for a periodic report.

q_201.question: What is the purpose of the "2 out of 3 approach" in clause 5.4?
q_201.ground_truth: It ensures that at least two out of the three measurement types defined in clause 5.4 are available to provide reliable statistics for monitoring the transfer of G-CDRs to the CGF.

q_202.question: What is the result of the REFRESH 1.2.1B command?
q_202.ground_truth: The result of the REFRESH 1.2.1B command is REFRESH performed with additional EFs read.

q_203.question: Which new elements are defined in HTML5 to standardize content embedding on a web page?
q_203.ground_truth: HTML5 defines new elements such as Video, Audio, Canvas, Svg, and Source, which allow for standardized ways to embed various types of media content, like video and audio, on a web page without using plugins.

q_204.question: What is a requirement for indirect network communication paths in 5G?
q_204.ground_truth: Support for establishing a connection between Remote UE and a UE-to-Network Relay to ensure connectivity to the network for the Remote UE and end-to-end requirements, including QoS (such as data rate, reliability, latency) and handling of PDU Session related attributes (e.g. S-NSSAI, DNN, PDU Session Type and SSC mode).

q_205.question: Under which RRC states do TDD UEs operating on a carrier not dedicated to MBSFN follow MBMS procedures?
q_205.ground_truth: TDD UEs operating on a carrier not dedicated to MBSFN shall follow MBMS procedures specified with respect to RRC states in Section 10.

q_206.question: What information does the GAN Iu Mode Cell Description information element provide?
q_206.ground_truth: The GAN Iu Mode Cell Description information element provides a minimum description of a GAN Iu mode cell, which can be used to identify the GAN Iu mode cell in order to perform handover from GERAN/UTRAN.

q_207.question: What is the maximum number of elements in the RL-Set-InformationList-RL-FailureInd sequence, and what does each element contain?
q_207.ground_truth: The RL-Set-InformationList-RL-FailureInd sequence can contain a maximum of maxNrOfRLSets elements, each of which is a ProtocolIE-Single-Container that includes the RL-Set-InformationItemIE-RL-FailureInd.

q_208.question: What is the role of the SEAL NRM server when acting as a TSN AF for TSN integration?
q_208.ground_truth: When acting as a TSN AF for TSN integration, the SEAL NRM server interacts with the CNC via the NRM-S reference point using the IEEE 802.1Qcc management protocol, and sets up TSN flows across the 5GS virtual bridges.

q_209.question: What is the difference in resource consumption between Local switch and N19-based or N6-based traffic forwarding methods?
q_209.ground_truth: Local switch consumes less network resources compared to N19-based and N6-based traffic forwarding methods.

q_210.question: What is the purpose of the present document in the context of the 3GPP GERAN NRM IRP?
q_210.ground_truth: The present document specifies the Solution Set definitions for the 3GPP GERAN NRM IRP, which is related to 3GPP TS 28.655 V14.0.X.

q_211.question: What is the use of the OAuth 2.0 based authorization framework for the long-term key in the UDR?
q_211.ground_truth: The OAuth 2.0 based authorization framework is used to protect the long-term key from retrieval by unauthorized NFs and restrict modification to the sequenceNumber attribute.

q_212.question: What is the mapping of a burst for EC-PACCH/D/M in the document?
q_212.ground_truth: The mapping of a burst is given by the rule e(B,j) = pc(j) and e(B,59+j) = pc(57+j) for j = 0,1,...,56 and B=0,1,2,3; and e(B,57) = q(2B) and e(B,58) = q(2B+1) for B = 0,1,2,3 in the document, where q(0),q(1),...,q(7) = 0,0,0,1,0,1,1,0 in the document.

q_213.question: What should the UE do if none of the access identities 1, 2, 11, 12, 13, 14, and 15 are applicable for the request?
q_213.ground_truth: In this case, access identity 0 is applicable.

q_214.question: What does the MCVideo service provide in order to initiate an Automatic Commencement Private Communication off-network?
q_214.ground_truth: The MCVideo service shall provide a means by which an MCVideo User initiates an Automatic Commencement Private Communication to any MCVideo User for which the MCVideo UE's current MCVideo User is authorized.

q_215.question: What is the main problem arising from an excessive delay in a speech channel?
q_215.ground_truth: The main problem arising from an excessive delay in a speech channel is the subjective effects of echo and simultaneous speech in both directions, which can negatively impact the user's communication experience.

q_216.question: What is the function of the ng-eNB-CU-CP in NG-RAN?
q_216.ground_truth: The ng-eNB-CU-CP in NG-RAN hosts the RRC and the control plane part of the PDCP protocol of the ng-eNB-CU.

q_217.question: When does Priority Service assume a signalling channel is always available?
q_217.ground_truth: Priority Service assumes a signalling channel is always available when a Priority Service call encounters a "no radio available" condition in the call path involving an access or egress air-interface, or both.

q_218.question: Which HTTP header should be used to identify the type and host name of the responding server when responding to an HTTP request?
q_218.ground_truth: The Server response header should be used to identify the type and host name of the responding server when responding to an HTTP request.

q_219.question: What is the function of the MAC value calculated in step 1 of the authentication procedure?
q_219.ground_truth: The MAC value calculated in step 1 of the authentication procedure is used to ensure the integrity and authenticity of the SQN, Random, and capabilities indicator, which are sent in the registration request message.

q_220.question: What action should the AMF take upon receiving a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message after sending a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message over 3GPP access?
q_220.ground_truth: The AMF should stop timer T3550 and change to the state 5GMM-REGISTERED. The 5G-GUTI, if sent in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, should be considered as valid.

q_221.question: What action does the AMF take when the de-registration procedure for 5GS services is performed and the UE has one or more PDU sessions?
q_221.ground_truth: The PDU sessions are released locally without peer-to-peer signalling between the UE and the network.

q_222.question: Why should the new BSS provide information about the traffic load of the target cell to the old BSS in the New BSS to Old BSS information element?
q_222.ground_truth: The old BSS may use the information to update the information about the load on the new cell, which may be used in the initiation of future cell load based handover procedures.

q_223.question: What is the impact of the 3GPP PS Data Off feature on downlink traffic and 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services?
q_223.ground_truth: When the 3GPP PS Data Off feature is activated by the user, downlink traffic is prevented, except for 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services.

q_224.question: What are the Single-slot TCH loops used for in the MS?
q_224.ground_truth: The Single-slot TCH loops are used to establish transparent loops for TCH blocks with different error detection capabilities, providing access to isolated functions of the MS for type approval testing.

q_225.question: What should the mobile station do if it receives a HANDOVER COMMAND message that contains a cipher mode setting IE indicating "start ciphering" and it has not received a CIPHERING MODE COMMAND message or a group cipher key number different from zero for this voice group call via any channel earlier in the RR connection?
q_225.ground_truth: The mobile station should consider the HANDOVER COMMAND message as erroneous, send an HANDOVER FAILURE with cause "Protocol error unspecified", and take no further action.

q_226.question: What is the name of the request types that can be contained in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body for SIP INVITE requests for standalone SDS over media plane for terminating participating MCData function?
q_226.ground_truth: The request types that can be contained in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body for SIP INVITE requests for standalone SDS over media plane for terminating participating MCData function are "one-to-one-sds" and "group-sds".

q_227.question: What is the expected behavior of the NGCN site in terms of association during successful registration as per subclause 6.2.1.3?
q_227.ground_truth: Successful registration will result in an association between the NGCN site and the P-CSCF used for registration, based on mutual authentication between NGCN site and S-CSCF. The NGCN should be prepared to receive signalling traffic from the NGN over this association and in turn is expected to use this association when sending signalling messages to the NGN.

q_228.question: What are the main differences between Class A and Class B mobile stations in the context of mobile communications?
q_228.ground_truth: Class A and Class B are short forms for "class A mode of operation" and "class B mode of operation," respectively. Class A mobile stations can operate in circuit-switched (CS) and packet-switched (PS) domains simultaneously, while Class B mobile stations can only operate in CS or PS domains but not both at the same time.

q_229.question: What should the UE do if there is at least one applicable neighbouring cell to report and the reportType is set to eventTriggered or periodical?
q_229.ground_truth: The UE should set the measResultNeighCells to include the best neighbouring cells up to maxReportCells in accordance with the specified conditions, and include the physCellId for each cell that is included in the measResultNeighCells.

q_230.question: What should UTRAN/GERAN (in Iu mode) support for IP multicast reception to avoid TEID coordination clashes?
q_230.ground_truth: UTRAN/GERAN (in Iu mode) should support TEID coordination, i.e. avoid using the same value ranges for its own unicast TEIDs as are used by the GGSN and MBMS GW for the Common TEID-Us (C-TEIDs).

q_231.question: What is the length of a PCM frame?

q_232.question: What is the step where the IBCF replaces the IP address inside the SDP answer using the information coming from the TrGW and sends the new SDP answer to the network at the incoming side, in the example where media transcoding is not required?

q_233.question: What are the two modes of the MCID service as defined in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_233.ground_truth: The two modes of the MCID service are permanent mode, where the MCID service is invoked for all incoming communications, and temporary mode, where the MCID service is invoked only for the incoming communications declared by the served user.

q_234.question: Which 3GPP Technical Specification describes the requirements and information model necessary for Telecommunications Management (TM), and specifies the TM principles and TM architecture?

q_235.question: Which message type is used for sending one extended measurement report by the network to a mobile station and in what mode is it transmitted?
q_235.ground_truth: The message type is EXTENDED MEASUREMENT ORDER, and it is transmitted on the SACCH by the network to the mobile station in unacknowledged mode.

q_236.question: What is the effect of the "Cell Reserved for CSG" indication on a UE when the cell status is indicated as "not barred", "not reserved" for operator use, and "reserved" for future extension?
q_236.ground_truth: If the "Cell Reserved for CSG" is indicated, the UE shall treat this cell as a candidate for cell selection and cell re-selection procedures in Idle mode and Connected mode.

q_237.question: What are the types of triggers that can be used for data collection and analytics?
q_237.ground_truth: The types of triggers for data collection and analytics include immediate, time period, location, network performance, NF load, UE status, UE performance, application status, and application performance.

q_238.question: What information should be included in the LIID format?
q_238.ground_truth: The LIID format should consist of alphanumeric characters, such as a lawful authorization reference number and the date when the lawful authorization was issued.

q_239.question: In the "Cause" definition, which is the last ENUMERATED type defined?

q_240.question: How does the UE handle the case where no ACK for a transmission is received from the RLS containing the serving cell?
q_240.ground_truth: The UE will keep re-transmitting the Scheduling Information or UL MAC Control Information until an ACK is received from the RLS containing the serving cell or the maximum number of re-transmissions is reached.

q_241.question: What is the performance of TS103-HS in comparison to ES202 for the noise field simulation in TS 103 224 (8-channel)?
q_241.ground_truth: The per-DUT results obtained with TS103-HS are comparable to ES202 for the noise field simulation in TS 103 224 (8-channel).

q_242.question: What is the purpose of the PCAP User Adaption (PUA) in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification?
q_242.ground_truth: The PCAP User Adaption (PUA) in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification provides the signalling service between the Home Node B (HNB) and the Home Node B Gateway (HNB-GW) that is required to fulfil the PUA functions described in Clause 7.

q_243.question: What message should be used to establish a new transport bearer for common transport channels instead of using an IP unicast transport bearer?
q_243.ground_truth: The COMMON TRANSPORT CHANNEL SETUP REQUEST message should be used instead of the IP unicast transport bearer in this situation.

q_244.question: What are the two interfaces defined in ETSI NFV specification that are identified as critical assets for a GVNP of type 1?
q_244.ground_truth: The two interfaces are the interface between VNF and VNFM, and the interface between 3GPP VNF and virtualisation layer.

q_245.question: What is the communication control capability in USAT/Network interaction?
q_245.ground_truth: The communication control capability is a mechanism whereby the use of communication resources is either initiated by the USAT application or modified by the USAT application subsequent to a user action.

q_246.question: What does the "3GPP" refer to in the context of the document?
q_246.ground_truth: The "3GPP" is a partnership project that works on the technical specifications of mobile communication systems.

q_247.question: What are the different grant allocation types when the UE is in connected mode for PUCCH synchronization?
q_247.ground_truth: The different grant allocation types include grant allocation by RACH procedure, grant allocation type 1: uplink grant triggered by SR, grant allocation type 2: periodic uplink grant, grant allocation type 3: single uplink grant, and grant allocation type 4: periodic uplink grant triggered by SR.

q_248.question: What is the value of the GUTI sent in step g) of the procedure in 7.4.3.4.2?

q_249.question: What are the different types of power control specified in the 3GPP MS standard?
q_249.ground_truth: The different types of power control specified in the 3GPP MS standard are normal power control, fast power control (FPC), and enhanced power control (EPC), which are used for uplink power control and/or downlink power control.

q_250.question: What happens to the counters in the PCF when a PDU Session Establishment fails or an ongoing PDU Session is released for an S-NSSAI subject to counting?
q_250.ground_truth: The PCF decrements the PDU Sessions counter for the S-NSSAI and the counter of UEs per Network Slice only if this was the last PDU Session in the Network Slice for the UE.
