q_251.question: What information does a network function of a network slice in an O&M system make available regarding the network slice quota checking on the maximum number of UEs for a certain S-NSSAI?
q_251.ground_truth: Whether a certain S-NSSAI is subject to a network slice quota checking on the maximum number of UEs.

q_252.question: What is the impact of the CLIR Supplementary Service on the CLIP Supplementary Service?
q_252.ground_truth: The CLIR Supplementary Service takes precedence over the CLIP Supplementary Service, unless the called user has an override category.

q_253.question: Under what conditions should the PCRF disable usage monitoring for sponsored data connectivity?
q_253.ground_truth: When the AF disables sponsoring a service, the PCRF disables the usage monitoring for the sponsored data connectivity, regardless of whether the solutions defined in Annex~F are used. This results in PCRF obtaining the accumulated usage of the sponsored data connectivity.

q_254.question: What is the integer value range for the mean transmitted non-HS carrier power of an UTRAN cell in downlink, valid for TDD mode and packet switched traffic, with a minimum granularity of a Time Slot (TS)?

q_255.question: What does the TDP list in the O-CSI consist of?
q_255.ground_truth: The TDP list in the O-CSI is a list of TDP descriptions that contain the DP value, gsmSCF address, serviceKey, default call handling, and DP criteria.

q_256.question: What is the difference between the high-level structure of the high-rate HQ coder and the normal mode?
q_256.ground_truth: The high-level structure of the high-rate HQ coder includes different operating modes for transient, strongly harmonic, and normal signals at different bit-rates. The normal mode uses scalar quantization with 40 steps for the norms and differentially codes the norms in each frame.

q_257.question: What is the CAMEL message sent by the gsmSCF of the home PLMN to the gsmSSF controlling the call for IST?
q_257.ground_truth: The CAMEL message sent by the gsmSCF of the home PLMN to the gsmSSF controlling the call for IST is "ReleaseCall".

q_258.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 15.2.3?
q_258.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 15.2.3 is to verify that the ME forwards the RAND and AUTN received in 5G authentication challenge data to the USIM and returns the Synchronization-Failure in the AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message if the verification of AUTN failed due to a synchronization failure.

q_259.question: Which solutions provide a way for disaster no longer applicable notification to UE's in 5GMM-IDLE mode transitioning to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over 3GPP access?

q_260.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of the roamers visiting other IMS network domains at S-CSCF, with a single integer value, and has the format RU.RmgUsersOut?
q_260.ground_truth: Roaming users to other IMS network domains

q_261.question: What is the role of the TC-USER in sending a TC-BEGIN request for Dialogue establishment?
q_261.ground_truth: The TC-USER needs to store the AC-name and user-information parameter before issuing a TC-BEGIN request primitive. After processing the last invocation request, the TC-USER should issue a TC-BEGIN request primitive.

q_262.question: What is the format of the "UARFCN" field in the "Unsuccessful-UARFCNItem-PSCH-ReconfFailureTDD" sequence?
q_262.ground_truth: The "UARFCN" field is of type "UARFCN," which is a common data type used to indicate a UTRA absolute radio-frequency channel number in the NBAP protocol.

q_263.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of transactions per hour that result in check IMEI allow list responses from the EIR in SGSN?

q_264.question: What is the common maximum accepted test system uncertainty value (in dB) for FR2, for OTA OBUE (Operating Band Unwanted Emission) and OTA SEM (Spectrum Emission Mask) tests in Reverberation Chamber, taking into account the calibration and measurement procedures for FR2 and the shorter wavelengths and larger relative array apertures?
q_264.ground_truth: The common maximum accepted test system uncertainty value is 2.5 dB for FR2, for OTA OBUE and OTA SEM tests in Reverberation Chamber.

q_265.question: What is the purpose of the receive state array V(N) in a TBF with FANR activated?
q_265.ground_truth: The array V(N) in a TBF with FANR activated indicates the receive status of RLC data blocks that are supposed to follow the block BSN=V(Q)-1. It is indexed relative to the receive window state variable V(Q) modulo SNS.

q_266.question: What is the purpose of the energy stability analysis in the excitation type classification?
q_266.ground_truth: The energy stability analysis is used to compute the average difference of the energies of the concatenated excitation vectors of two adjacent frames, and then compare it to a threshold to determine the extend of noise reduction between harmonics.

q_267.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with Identity type IE set to "SUCI" and timer T3519 is running?
q_267.ground_truth: The UE sends an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the stored SUCI.

q_268.question: What shall the MGCF include in the "local IMS resources" Parameter when requesting the MGW to detect incoming telephone events?
q_268.ground_truth: The MGCF shall include "telephone event" along with the selected speech codecs within the "local IMS resources" Parameter to request the MGW to detect incoming telephone events.

q_269.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the context of the present document?
q_269.ground_truth: In the context of the present document, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_270.question: What is the consequence of sending a DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message with a layer-2 ID conflict?
q_270.ground_truth: The target UE will send a DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the cause value #3 "conflict of layer-2 ID for unicast communication is detected."

q_271.question: What is the outcome for the mobile station and the network when the packet downlink assignment procedure is completed?
q_271.ground_truth: The packet downlink assignment procedure is completed when the network sends a PACKET ASSIGNMENT message and the mobile station receives it.

q_272.question: How often should the UE measure PCCPCH RSCP for inter-frequency cells in the 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
q_272.ground_truth: The UE shall measure PCCPCH RSCP at least every (Ncarrier-1) * TmeasureNTDD for inter-frequency 1.28 Mcps TDD OPTION cells.

q_273.question: What is the procedure for MBMS Streaming session teardown from the UE's perspective?
q_273.ground_truth: The UE receives streaming content from the BMSC.UPF, initiates a SIP BYE message to SCF to close the MBMS Streaming session, and receives a SIP 200 OK message from SCF when the session is successfully terminated. The UE can then stop receiving the MBMS Streaming session.

q_274.question: What information is included in the Core Network part (i.e. NAS Container for PS HO) for PS handover from UTRAN to GAN mode?
q_274.ground_truth: The Core Network part (i.e. NAS Container for PS HO) for PS handover from UTRAN to GAN mode consists of an XID Command indicating Reset or 'Reset to old XID parameters' and the new IOV-UI for the target cell, and the GPRS ciphering algorithm to be used in the target cell if it is different from the ciphering algorithm used in the source cell.

q_275.question: What type of location information is being requested in a BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION REQUEST message?
q_275.ground_truth: The Location Type parameter in the BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION REQUEST message defines the type of location information being requested.

q_276.question: What technology was used to transmit the video and audio stream during Mark's skin cancer screening at the MSP?
q_276.ground_truth: A stereoscopic video camera with optical zooming produced a 4K video stream, while an audio system enabled EVS full band voice communication with the remote specialist in the MSP.

q_277.question: What is the maximum number of secondary serving HS-DSCH cells that can be active at the same time?
q_277.ground_truth: A maximum of 7 secondary serving HS-DSCH cells can be active at the same time.

q_278.question: What communication service does TCP provide at the transport layer in the RESTful Rx reference point between AF and PC?
q_278.ground_truth: TCP provides the communication service at the transport layer in the RESTful Rx reference point between AF and PC.

q_279.question: What should the MAC entity do if the transport block size of the MSGA payload corresponds to the transport block size of the MSGA payload associated with Random Access Preambles group B during 4-stepRA switch?
q_279.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select the Random Access Preambles group B.

q_280.question: What is the function of the linear filter with impulse response in GSM/EDGE Modulation?
q_280.ground_truth: The linear filter with impulse response is used to filter the modulating data values excites a linear filter with impulse response.

q_281.question: What is the function of the "Speech Version" element and which octet is it coded in?
q_281.ground_truth: The "Speech Version" element indicates the speech version being used by the BSS and it is coded in the same way as the permitted speech version identifier in the Channel type information element.

q_282.question: What are the conditions that enable the source RNC to initiate the Relocation Cancel procedure during or after the Relocation Preparation procedure?
q_282.ground_truth: The Relocation Cancel procedure can be initiated by the source RNC if it has not yet initiated the execution of relocation of SRNS via the Iur or Uu interface, or if after initiating the execution of relocation of SRNS, the UE returns to the source RNC by transmitting an RRC message indicating that the UE considers the source RNC as its serving RNC.

q_283.question: What does the "3GPP-TS-Buffer" header indicate in the time-shifting functionality?
q_283.ground_truth: The "3GPP-TS-Buffer" header describes the current available range for PSS time shifting, and it may use one of three descriptive formats depending on the current state of the time-shift buffer.

q_284.question: What operation is the ME required to support for SELECT ITEM as per 27.22.4.9.1.2 conformance requirement?
q_284.ground_truth: The ME is required to support the Proactive SIM: Select Item facility as defined in TS11.14 clause 5, 6.4.9, 6.6.8, 6.8, 12.6, 13.4 and 14.

q_285.question: What operation does the PDN GW provide to the PCRF when there is no TFT operation or the TFT is missing?
q_285.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides to the PCRF no Gx filter operation when the TFT operation is "No TFT operation" or the TFT is missing.

q_286.question: What functionality is added to the interface between the MS and GANC in GAN Iu mode?
q_286.ground_truth: Functionality is added to the interface between the MS and GANC in GAN Iu mode to support the GAN Iu mode service.

q_287.question: What does the acronym "3GPP" in the document title stand for?

q_288.question: How many consecutive radio blocks does a mobile station need to retransmit over the uplink timeslot if the uplink TBF is established using 16QAM modulation scheme and the downlink is 32QAM modulated?
q_288.ground_truth: The mobile station needs to retransmit over five consecutive radio blocks on the matching uplink timeslot.

q_289.question: What is the lower limit that applies to all numbers N of active carriers in subclause 6.5.1.3.2?
q_289.ground_truth: The absolute lower limit in item 4) in subclause 6.5.1.3.2 shall apply for all numbers N of active carriers.

q_290.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a RLC/MAC control message addressing the mobile station by TLLI or TFI value associated with the uplink TBF during contention resolution?
q_290.ground_truth: The mobile station shall act on the message but shall not accept a PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER message, a PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message and a PACKET POWER CONTROL/TIMING ADVANCE message addressing the mobile station with the TFI value associated with the uplink TBF.

q_291.question: Which enumerated value in the GPS-UTC-Model enumeration indicates the current date in UTC Model?

q_292.question: What is the term used to describe the results averaged across all noise types for SWB mode?
q_292.ground_truth: Each combination of device and room represents one dot in these scatter plots.

q_293.question: What should a mobile station do if it is unable to access the old cell after the network controlled cell reselection procedure has failed?
q_293.ground_truth: If a mobile station is unable to synchronize to the old cell or if timer T3176 expires, the mobile station should cancel the sending of the PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message and perform an autonomous cell re-selection.

q_294.question: How does the P.NATS quality model handle video and audio quality estimation?
q_294.ground_truth: The P.NATS quality model is composed of separate modules for estimating audio and video quality, and combines them with stalling events that may have occurred on the client. The model is modular, allowing quality estimation to be separated into a server-side estimation of audio and video coding quality and a client-side integration of coding quality in combination with stalling events. The sampling frequency for the audio and video quality estimation module output is 1 Hz.

q_295.question: When would the Extended Reference E-TFCI Power Offset IE be used instead of the Reference E-TFCI Power Offset IE?
q_295.ground_truth: The Extended Reference E-TFCI Power Offset IE is used if the range of the Reference E-TFCI Power Offset IE is insufficient to represent the value of the Reference E-TFCI Power Offset to be sent to the Node B.

q_296.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do if there is uplink user data pending for one or more PDU sessions when building a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message, regardless of the access category for which the access barring check is performed?
q_296.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the respective PDU sessions as specified in subclause 5.6.1.2.2.

q_297.question: What action does the UE take if it determines a higher priority PLMN for registration and is in automatic network selection mode?
q_297.ground_truth: The UE either releases the current N1 NAS signalling connection and attempts to obtain service on the higher priority PLMN, or does not release the connection and skips certain steps in the registration process.

q_298.question: What should the network do when it receives a RR STATUS message from a RR entity?
q_298.ground_truth: The actions taken by the network when it receives a RR STATUS message from a RR entity are implementation dependent.

q_299.question: What is the minimum number of frames that a MS must measure the received signal level in for each TDMA frame on at least one of the BCCH carriers?
q_299.ground_truth: The MS must measure the received signal level in at least one of the BCCH carriers in every TDMA frame, with up to 8 frames per SACCH multframe optional.

q_300.question: What is the purpose of the GPRSMSClass parameter in the eZone?
q_300.ground_truth: The GPRSMSClass parameter is used to specify the GPRS Mobile Station Class in the eZone.

q_301.question: When does the BM-SC send the IMPI of the user along with the GBA-keys?
q_301.ground_truth: The BM-SC sends the IMPI of the user along with the GBA-keys when the UE has bootstrapped, in order to bind the old and the new B-TID together.

q_302.question: What does the SLMAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE class do in the SLmAP protocol?
q_302.ground_truth: The SLMAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE class is a user-defined class in the SLmAP protocol that defines the structure of the elementary procedure with PROCEDURE CODE and CRITICALITY as its components.

q_303.question: Where should the SDP offer received from the initial SIP INVITE request be added in the response generated by the SCC AS when correlating the SCC AS PSI DN with an existing session?
q_303.ground_truth: The SDP offer received from the initial SIP INVITE request should be added in the SDP of the SIP INVITE request generated by the SCC AS.

q_304.question: What shall the user equipment do with the received Extended local emergency numbers list when the registered PLMN has changed and the EENLV field within the Extended emergency number list IE indicates "Extended local Emergency Numbers List is valid only in the PLMN from which this IE is received"?
q_304.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the stored Extended local Emergency Numbers List in the user equipment.

q_305.question: What should the MME do if the UE sends an Extended Service Request message for non-SMS activity during SMS transfers?
q_305.ground_truth: The MME handles the Extended Service Request message as if no SMS transfers are ongoing, which may lead to disruption of the SMS delivery.

q_306.question: What is the suggested method for sending/receiving BFCP m-lines?
q_306.ground_truth: The BFCP m-lines are suggested to be sent using UDP transport, as industry best current practice, instead of TCP transport which is currently referred to in 3GPP specifications.

q_307.question: What principles is the UE-UE TSC communication with VN group solution based on?
q_307.ground_truth: The solution is based on the principles of the 5GS knowing UE/DS-TT pairs that can perform UE-UE TSC communication, the SMF and optionally AF knowing VN group information, and the SMF pairing UEs/DS-TTs and reporting port pair numbers to the TSN AF.

q_308.question: In what situations would the network include the "NSSAA to be performed" indicator in the 5GS registration result IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_308.ground_truth: The "NSSAA to be performed" indicator is included in the 5GS registration result IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure will be performed by the network for a network slice.

q_309.question: What is the effect of RAN service based on network slice on the current NSaaS and NSP concepts?
q_309.ground_truth: There is no or minor impact, but the meaning of NSaaS will vary depending on the scenario.

q_310.question: What is the difference in technical complexity between solutions 12 and 13?
q_310.ground_truth: Solution 12 is more complicated than Solution 13, at least partly due to support of more KIs.

q_311.question: What does the Keyword processor do during compression?
q_311.ground_truth: During compression, the Keyword processor replaces sequences of characters in the input stream with keyword dictionary entries as specified by the Keyword Match bit stream.

q_312.question: What is the abbreviation for Network Functions Virtualization in the 3GPP Technical Specification?

q_313.question: What is the role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in the telecommunications industry?
q_313.ground_truth: The 3GPP is an organization that develops technical specifications for the telecommunications industry. The document in question defines the interfaces and Terminal Adaptation Functions (TAF) for enabling the attachment of synchronous terminals to a Mobile Termination (MT) within the 3GPP system.

q_314.question: What is the maximum number of g.3gpp.ussd USSD+xml messages that can be sent in a single SIP INFO request?
q_314.ground_truth: Only one g.3gpp.ussd USSD+xml message can be sent in a single SIP INFO request.

q_315.question: In the context of Gateway Control session establishment, what is the difference between the number of attempted session establishments and the number of successful session establishments?
q_315.ground_truth: The number of attempted session establishments refers to the total number of session establishment procedures initiated by BBERF, regardless of the outcome, while the number of successful session establishments refers to the number of session establishment procedures that were initiated by BBERF and resulted in a successful establishment.

q_316.question: What is the primary function of the Transport Network Control Plane in the context of UMTS?
q_316.ground_truth: The Transport Network Control Plane is responsible for the transport bearer management in UMTS.

q_317.question: What is the purpose of "Remote ID" for UAS?
q_317.ground_truth: Remote ID for UAS allows the identification and tracking of unmanned aircraft during flight, providing regulatory agencies with necessary information.

q_318.question: What is the purpose of the 13-bit Uniform PCM Interface (UPCMI) introduced in the document?
q_318.ground_truth: The UPCMI is introduced for design purposes in order to separate the speech transcoder impairments from the basic audio impairments of the MS.

q_319.question: Which release enabled offload at Iu-PS for UTRAN in the "UserPlaneInformation" sequence?
q_319.ground_truth: The offload at Iu-PS for UTRAN was enabled in Release 10.

q_320.question: What is the role of the MAC control entity in the 3GPP TS 44.060 and 3GPP TS 44.160 MAC model?
q_320.ground_truth: The MAC control entity is specific to an MS and is controlled by RRC. It sets up the functions needed to support the Radio Bearer at RB establishment, and can be in one of four states: MAC-Idle state, MAC-Shared state, MAC-Dedicated state, or MAC-DTM state.

q_321.question: What does the "AccessId" leaf represent in the context of flow distribution rules?
q_321.ground_truth: The "AccessId" leaf represents an access network identifier. Its absence indicates that the UE can consider any available WLAN access network for the network selection.

q_322.question: What is a requirement for the MCVideo service to support Private Communications Off-Network when a receiving MCVideo User has signed on to the service with multiple MCVideo UEs?
q_322.ground_truth: The MCVideo service shall provide a mechanism for the Private Communication to be set up with the MCVideo UE designated by the receiving MCVideo User to be used for Private Communications.

q_323.question: What should the Node B report to the CRNC when the resource operational state of the HS-DSCH resources has changed?
q_323.ground_truth: The Node B shall report the new resource operational state by sending a RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message containing a "Service Impacting" Indication when the resource operational state of the HS-DSCH resources has changed.

q_324.question: What information is included in the ATSSS Capability in step 3?
q_324.ground_truth: The ATSSS Capability includes the QUIC functionality in step 3.

q_325.question: Which GNSS-Almanac model is to be used if both GPS and GLONASS are supported by the UE?
q_325.ground_truth: The GNSS-Almanac (Model-2) for GPS shall be used if both GPS and GLONASS are supported by the UE.

q_326.question: What is the rejectionCause for RRCConnectionReject-r3-IEs?
q_326.ground_truth: A RejectionCause value from RRCConnectionReject-r3-IEs which is an enumerated type

q_327.question: What algorithms are used for integrity and confidentiality protection in the PC5 unicast link?
q_327.ground_truth: UEs shall implement NIA0, 128-NIA1, and 128-NIA2 for integrity protection and NEA0, 128-NEA1, and 128-NEA2 for confidentiality protection.

q_328.question: What is the INITIATING MESSAGE for the informationExchangeTermination PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
q_328.ground_truth: The INITIATING MESSAGE for the informationExchangeTermination PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE is InformationExchangeTerminationRequest.

q_329.question: What is the function of NRF in the context of NWDAF and AIF?
q_329.ground_truth: NRF is used for the discovery of ML models supported by AIF and related parameters, which is aligned with Key Issue #19: Trained data model sharing between multiple NWDAF instances.

q_330.question: What is a significant consideration in the design of HEVC (single-layer coding) HLS, regarding future extensions?
q_330.ground_truth: Extensibility mechanisms, or hooks, which allow for backward compatibility with earlier versions of the standard.

q_331.question: What action should the MS take if it receives a message with semantically incorrect contents?
q_331.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the message and return a (GA-CSR, GA-PSR or GA-RRC) STATUS message with the cause 'semantically incorrect message'.

q_332.question: Which codecs are used for PSS and MBMS services in 3GPP Releases 6, 7, and 8 for terminals supporting the H.264 codec?
q_332.ground_truth: In 3GPP Releases 6, 7, and 8, the recommended codec for MBMS and PSS services is the H.264 codec. In Release 6, PSS and MBMS level 1b is recommended, while in Release 7 and 8, level 1.2 is recommended.

q_333.question: What happens if the initial service event is triggered and the call attempt is unsuccessful in the VPLMN/IPLMN network?
q_333.ground_truth: The VPLMN/IPLMN network will suspend call processing, make contact with the CSE, and await further instructions. The CSE will then instruct the VPLMN/IPLMN network to perform charging activities, activate other control service events for the call, or order in-band user interaction.

q_334.question: Based on the results from the selection tests, what are the trends in intrinsic quality comparison between AMR-WB+ and Enhanced aacPlus?
q_334.ground_truth: The results suggest that AMR-WB+ tends to perform better for speech than for music, while Enhanced aacPlus scores better for music at all tested bit-rates.

q_335.question: How many error patterns were created to represent varying channel conditions in the eCall test setup?
q_335.ground_truth: 10 error patterns were created to represent varying channel conditions in the eCall test setup.

q_336.question: What is the purpose of the Gs interface in the 3GPP system?
q_336.ground_truth: The Gs interface in the 3GPP system provides a reliable transfer of signalling messages between the Serving GPRS Support Node (SGSN) and the Visitors Location Register (VLR) for coordination between GSM circuit switched services and GSM packet data services.

q_337.question: What is the main motivation for the use of Peer-to-Peer technology in content distribution services?
q_337.ground_truth: The main motivation is to alleviate the need for a linear increase in the number of media servers and to reduce the demands on backbone IP network bandwidth by spreading traffic across the edge of the network.

q_338.question: Which network element is responsible for managing node-internal resources in UMTS?
q_338.ground_truth: Each UTRAN node is considered a network element on its own, and the knowledge about the equipment of a network element is kept within the network element itself and its management system.

q_339.question: What certificate should H(e)NB and SeGW devices conform to for IKEv2 CA certificates?
q_339.ground_truth: They should conform to the requirements set out for NE CA certificates in clauses 6.1.1 and 6.1.4b of TS 33.310.

q_340.question: In the definition of M3AP-PDU, what does "InitiatingMessage" represent?
q_340.ground_truth: "InitiatingMessage" is a choice within the definition of M3AP-PDU, and it represents a message that initiates a new procedure.

q_341.question: What measures should the MGW take to guarantee the desired acoustic quality on the bearer terminations for voice calls?
q_341.ground_truth: The MGW may include a speech transcoder and a voice processing function based upon the speech coding information provided to each bearer termination.

q_343.question: What is the name of the reference jitter buffer management (JBM) implementation used in the listening only tests, which has a fixed end-to-end delay over a session but can not be used in real-life implementations?

q_344.question: What action should the SGSN take when it receives a Detach Request from an MS in a non-Gs-NULL state, indicating an IMSI detach or combined IMSI and GPRS detach?
q_344.ground_truth: The SGSN should send a BSSAP+-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message to the VLR indicating 'Explicit MS initiated IMSI detach from non-GPRS service' or 'Combined explicit MS initiated IMSI detach from GPRS and non-GPRS services'.

q_345.question: What is the eCall In-band Modem and what is its purpose?
q_345.ground_truth: The eCall In-band Modem is a modem pair that operates full-duplex and allows reliable transmission of eCall Minimum Set of Data (MSD) from an In-Vehicle System (IVS) to the Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) via the voice channel of the emergency voice call through cellular and PSTN networks.

q_346.question: What is the difference between online and offline charging?
q_346.ground_truth: Online charging affects real-time service rendering, requiring direct interaction with bearer/session/service control, while offline charging does not affect service rendering and charging information is processed after the service is delivered.

q_347.question: What exception is thrown by the method "copy" if the dstBuffer parameter is null?

q_348.question: What is the purpose of the "Classmark Information Type" fields in the protocol extension container?
q_348.ground_truth: The "Classmark Information Type" fields in the protocol extension container define certain attributes of the mobile station equipment in use on a particular transaction. They are used to indicate specific characteristics of the mobile station relevant to the current transaction.

q_349.question: What must the BSS do if the requested channel type is not available?
q_349.ground_truth: If the requested channel type is not available, the BSS sends a VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message to the MSC, with an appropriate failure cause included in the message.

q_350.question: What is the purpose of the "minimumNbOfDigits" and "maximumNbOfDigits" parameter in the PromptAndCollectUserInformation procedure?
q_350.ground_truth: These parameters specify the minimum and maximum number of valid digits to be collected from the user.

q_351.question: What is the role of the IRI in the interception of information from a HNB?
q_351.ground_truth: The IRI should be sent to DF2 using a reliable transport mechanism for intercepting information from a HNB.

q_352.question: What is a MTC Device in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification for Network Improvements for Machine Type Communications?
q_352.ground_truth: A MTC Device is a UE equipped for Machine Type Communication, which communicates through a PLMN with MTC Server(s) and/or other MTC Device(s).

q_353.question: What is the main focus of Key Issue #19: Trained data model sharing between multiple NWDAF instances?
q_353.ground_truth: This key issue aims to study the sharing of trained data models between multiple NWDAF instances and the related aspects, such as providing and discovering data models, standardizing interfaces, and sharing features and components.

q_354.question: How many sub-frame bits are used in the RPE-LTP encoder for the LTP parameters and RPE parameters?
q_354.ground_truth: Each sub-frame of the RPE-LTP encoder has 26 bits for the LTP parameters and 102 bits for the RPE parameters.

q_355.question: What protocol is used for the BEST service between the UE and the HSE in 3GPP?

q_356.question: What action is taken by the target RNC/BSS after receiving the Relocation Request Acknowledge message?
q_356.ground_truth: Upon sending the Relocation Request Acknowledge message, the target RNC/BSS shall be prepared to receive downlink GTP PDUs from the new SGSN for the accepted RABs.

q_357.question: What is the interface defined in the document that provides logical service to interwork and to communicate between UE and System Simulator during the test of a UE?

q_358.question: What should be included in the MBMS reception report when SHQoEProcedure is active and DASHQoESamplePercentage is absent?
q_358.ground_truth: A DASH QoE metrics report should be included in the MBMS reception report every time it is sent.

q_359.question: What is the role of the HS-SCCH Code Change Indicator and HS-SCCH Code Change Grant in 3GPP TS 25.331?
q_359.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH Code Change Indicator indicates whether the HS-SCCH Code change is needed, and the HS-SCCH Code Change Grant indicates that modification of HS-SCCH Codes is granted.

q_360.question: Why was it agreed that no BS spurious emissions limits be specified for protection of RAS services?
q_360.ground_truth: The potential effects of any possible protection required for the RAS services protection are considered to be under the responsibility of each administration, considering aspects such as distance separation, site engineering solutions, etc.

q_361.question: What is the role of the Serving Gateway/BBIFF in the S8HR roaming architecture?
q_361.ground_truth: The Serving Gateway/BBIFF in the S8HR roaming architecture is responsible for extracting data from the IMS signalling bearer of S8HR APNs and delivering it to the LMISF. It also provides the LMISF with media bearer information of S8HR APNs and extracts packets from the associated media bearer to deliver to the LMISF.

q_362.question: In what situations is access identity 1 considered valid by the UE when it is not in its HPLMN?
q_362.ground_truth: The UE considers access identity 1 to be valid when it receives the MPS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message set to "Access identity 1 valid in RPLMN or equivalent PLMN" in the UE is not in the country of its HPLMN.

q_363.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives IEs or IE groups in wrong order or with too many occurrences or erroneously present in a message initiating a procedure?
q_363.ground_truth: The receiving node should reject the procedure and report the cause value ``Abstract Syntax Error (Falsely Constructed Message)'' using the message normally used to report unsuccessful outcome of the procedure.

q_364.question: What should a Mobile Station do when it receives a message with message type not defined or not implemented?
q_364.ground_truth: The Mobile Station should ignore the message and return a CP-ERROR message with cause #97 "message type non-existent or not implemented" if an appropriate connection exists.

q_365.question: When the SGW-C provides the number/fraction of packets/bytes drop threshold value during the PDN GW Pause of Charging procedure, what action should the SGW-U take when the threshold is reached?
q_365.ground_truth: When the threshold is reached, the SGW-U should send an Sx report message (drop threshold reached) to the SGW-C.

q_366.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of GTP data PDUs which have been generated by the GTP-U protocol entity on the Iu interface?

q_367.question: What mechanism has been included in the agreement between the operator and MyDASH to ensure content delivery accuracy?
q_367.ground_truth: A provision has been included that commits MyDASH to a specified level of content delivery accuracy, with penalty provisions if the specified level of accuracy is not achieved.

q_368.question: How many encoder input sequences are provided in the present document for 8kHz and 16kHz sampling rates?
q_368.ground_truth: Forty-three encoder input sequences are provided in the present document, 22 with 8kHz sampling, and 23 with 16kHz sampling.

q_369.question: What percentage of the data transmissions in control-to-control communication consist of periodic traffic in the 1 Gbit/s links?

q_370.question: What is the responsibility of the 3GPP network regarding E-UTRAN resources in Indirect 3GPP Communication?
q_370.ground_truth: The 3GPP network shall manage the E-UTRAN resources used for the communication path between the Evolved ProSe Remote UE and the network when it accesses the 3GPP network via an Indirect 3GPP Communication, in an efficient manner.

q_371.question: In which frequency range is the coding demand increased by a factor of 0.25 to modify the threshold in the TNS filtering process?
q_371.ground_truth: The coding demand is increased in the frequency range from 380Hz to the start frequency of the TNS filter.

q_372.question: What should the IWF do in case the modems change the data rate during an ongoing multimedia call?
q_372.ground_truth: The IWF shall initiate a MODIFY message to indicate the new data rate to the UE and use HDLC flag stuffing or the stuffing mode defined in ITU-T Recommendation H.223 to adapt the data rate.

q_373.question: What is the impact of confidentiality protection being disabled for roaming targets with S8HR?
q_373.ground_truth: The SIP messages and the voice-media content are always visible in clear form (i.e. no encryption) at the Serving Gateway/BBIFF, making the communication less secure.

q_374.question: What is used in the TFI field if TFCI bits are not used in a CCPCH?
q_374.ground_truth: DTX is used in the TFI field if TFCI bits are not used in a CCPCH.

q_375.question: What is the result if the timer T390 expires or is stopped and timer T302 is not running?
q_375.ground_truth: Consider the barring for this Access Category to be alleviated.

q_376.question: What is the identity used for signalling the intended recipient UE in the restricted HS-SCCH?
q_376.ground_truth: The 16-bit H-RNTI is used as the UE identity.

q_377.question: In the context of Deployment Option 2, what information does the VLR include in the Paging message if it receives the SM Delivery Timer and SM Delivery Start Time IEs in the Forward Short Message from the SMS-GMSC?
q_377.ground_truth: The VLR includes these IEs in the Paging message to indicate to the MME the time until which the VLR supports buffering the Short Message.

q_378.question: When requesting the IMS-ALG to support the RTP Header Extension capability as defined in IETF RFC 5285 for Coordination of Video Orientation, what should the IMS-ALG optionally request the IMS-AGW to do?
q_378.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should optionally request the IMS-AGW to support the RTP Header Extension capability as defined in IETF RFC 5285 for Coordination of Video Orientation.

q_379.question: What is the RAB abnormal release rate KPI used to measure?
q_379.ground_truth: The RAB abnormal release rate KPI is used to measure service retainability across UTRAN and is the ratio of the number of RAB release requests to the number of the successful RAB establishments.

q_380.question: What is one of the difficulties faced by a UC reputation system when considering the legality of marked UC communication?
q_380.ground_truth: The reputation system needs to determine the valid legislation for the UC communication by identifying the countries involved, and ensure that the technical UC classification corresponds to the legal situation.

q_381.question: What does "shall" and "shall not" mean in the context of the present document?
q_381.ground_truth: In the present document, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something. They are used in the context of normative provisions.

q_382.question: What does MSD stand for in the context of this text?

q_383.question: What are two of the KPIs necessary for the 5G network to support autonomous UAVs controlled by AI?
q_383.ground_truth: The 5G network needs to provide high precision positioning information, support high uplink high rate transmission, and low delay downlink transmission, to support autonomous UAVs controlled by AI.

q_384.question: What should be used to distinguish BSSAP and MAP in separate SSNs?
q_384.ground_truth: The chosen SSNs are network specific and may need to differ from those assigned to other applications.

q_385.question: What are the two sub-classes of Immediate messaging?
q_385.ground_truth: The two sub-classes of Immediate messaging are where the user can send and receive messages without any prior actions, or where the user is required to join a messaging session before the message exchange can take place.

q_386.question: How can the new ACK/NACK reporting mechanism co-exist with legacy procedures in 10.2.1.3.2.4?
q_386.ground_truth: The new reporting mechanism can co-exist with legacy procedures by ensuring compatibility with existing standards and methods, and using different message formats or indicator bits to differentiate between the old and new procedures.

q_387.question: How is the TFCI encoded for long TFCI lengths in the 3.84 Mcps TDD option?
q_387.ground_truth: The TFCI is encoded using a (32, 10) sub-code of the second order Reed-Muller code. The coding procedure involves padding with zeros to 10 bits, if there are less than 10 bits of TFCI, and encoding by the (32,10) sub-code of second order Reed-Muller code.

q_388.question: What is the role of the master node in intra-secondary node mobility within the context of dual connectivity between LTE and NR?
q_388.ground_truth: The master node is involved in and takes the final decision before the secondary node change occurs for intra-secondary node mobility.

q_389.question: In the RL-InformationResponse-RL-ReconfRspTDD sequence, what does the max-UL-SIR field represent?
q_389.ground_truth: The maximum UL SIR value, a unitless number.

q_390.question: Why is it recommended to pre-calibrate the reference sleeve dipoles in a laboratory specialized in high accuracy antenna calibrations?
q_390.ground_truth: The theoretical formulas used to predict the performance of the dipole is unable to account for the impact of the choke, thus an accurate pre-calibration of the reference sleeve dipoles in a laboratory specialized in high accuracy antenna calibrations is recommended to ensure the accuracy of the calibration.

q_391.question: What should the MRFP do when mixing all received audio streams?
q_391.ground_truth: The MRFP may mix all the received audio streams from all other conference participants and send the resulting audio stream(s) to a conference participant. If two audio streams were reserved towards a conference participant, the MRFP may distribute the received audio stream from each other conference participant in a specific way to render a stereo impression.

q_392.question: What is the acceptance criteria after step f)?
q_392.ground_truth: After step f), the terminal shall have read record 4 of EFSDN and a call to "+007" shall have been established.

q_393.question: What triggers a cell change by a MS in group receive mode?
q_393.ground_truth: A cell change by a MS in group receive mode is triggered by the path loss to the serving cell becoming too high, a radio link time-out, or the presence of a better cell (in terms of criterion C2) in the same LA or a much better cell in another LA with NCC permitted.

q_394.question: What is the consequence of initiating a reset procedure for an NS-VC?
q_394.ground_truth: When a reset procedure is initiated, data in transfer may be lost.

q_395.question: For which channels are representative values computed for FR1 in order to identify bottlenecks and draw observations?
q_395.ground_truth: Representative values are computed for various channels such as PUSCH for eMBB, PUSCH for VoIP, PUCCH Format 1 with 2bits, PUCCH Format 3 with 11bits, and others for FR1.

q_396.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA in applying Reflective QoS for UE authentication?
q_396.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA takes the decision to apply Reflective QoS based on the capabilities of the UE, the type of access, and local policies, and informs the UE.

q_397.question: What should a mobile station do when it receives a message with a unknown message type?
q_397.ground_truth: A mobile station not supporting GPRS shall treat the SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 13 as an unknown message type.

q_398.question: What does the OCS return to the ProSe Function after performing the Debit Units operation for "Restricted Match"?
q_398.ground_truth: The OCS returns the Debit Units Response to ProSe Function.

q_399.question: What type of AVP is the CSG-Membership-Indication AVP and what values are defined for it?
q_399.ground_truth: The CSG-Membership-Indication AVP is of type Enumerated and it indicates whether the UE is a member of the accessing CSG cell, if the access mode is Hybrid. The defined values are: Not CSG member, CSG Member.

q_400.question: What are the two main categories of schemes used for CRS interference handling in the evaluation?
q_400.ground_truth: The two categories of schemes used for CRS interference handling are LTE CRS interference mitigation (CRS-IM) and LTE CRS Rate matching (CRS-RM).

q_401.question: In Suspension of shared MBS session (Alternative A), what action is taken by the NG-RAN node after receiving the N2 Session Suspend request from the AMF to release any outstanding PTM resources?
q_401.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node transmits an N2 Session suspend response message to the AMF to acknowledge the suspension of the shared MB session.

q_402.question: What is the maximum number of channels allowed in the AAC encoder for the aacPlus general audio codec?
q_402.ground_truth: The maximum number of channels allowed in the AAC encoder for the aacPlus general audio codec is two. This is due to the fact that the aacPlus general audio codec implements the High Efficiency AAC Profile at Level 2, which restricts the number of channels to two.

q_403.question: What is the difference between Mobile Assisted positioning and Mobile Based positioning in the context of location determination in cellular networks?
q_403.ground_truth: In Mobile Assisted positioning, the mobile station provides position measurements to the network for computation of a location estimate by the network, while in Mobile Based positioning, the mobile station performs both position measurements and computation of a location estimate, with assistance data provided by the network.

q_404.question: What is the cause of the unequal total insertion loss in the two TX paths during dual carrier mode?
q_404.ground_truth: The unequal total insertion loss is caused by the absence of an additional switch in the upper TX path, which is used only during dual carrier mode, while the lower TX path is reused for single carrier mode and has an additional switch.

q_405.question: What are the main objectives for the EVS codec development work item?
q_405.ground_truth: The main objectives include enhancing quality and coding efficiency for narrowband and wideband speech services, introducing super-wideband speech, improving conversational music quality, increasing robustness to packet loss and delay jitter, and maintaining backward interoperability with the AMR-WB codec.

q_406.question: What burst type is used for the MICH when the entire carrier is dedicated to MBSFN operation?
q_406.ground_truth: When an entire carrier is dedicated to MBSFN operation, the MICH shall use burst type 4.

q_407.question: What information does the W-APN Authorised field contain?
q_407.ground_truth: The W-APN Authorised field contains authorization information for each W-APN, including the list of allowed W-APNs, the access environment, charging data, static IP address and maximum number of accesses.

q_408.question: In the context of 3GPP TS/TR documents, what do the verbs "shall" and "shall not" indicate?
q_408.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP TS/TR documents, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

q_409.question: What should the UE do if the "TFCS Removal Information" IE is included?
q_409.ground_truth: The UE removes the TFC indicated by the IE "TFCI" from the current TFCS and regards the position in the TFCS as vacant.

q_410.question: What is the procedure for mutual authentication between the UE and the DCS in the onboarding network?
q_410.ground_truth: The onboarding network, which does not have a direct trust relationship with the UE, allows initial access based on the UE and DCS's mutual authentication using any key-generating EAP method such as EAP-TLS. The DCS verifies the default UE ID received in the SUOI by verifying the digital signature, and a key is derived for the 3GPP network based on the verified default UE ID. Any additional data about the UE and PS address are provided as a data set to the SNPN.

q_411.question: What is the minimum requirement for the in-channel selectivity in the presence of an interfering signal with a larger power spectral density?
q_411.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for in-channel selectivity is that the interfering signal shall meet the throughput requirement for a specified reference measurement channel in the condition that an E-UTRA signal is received at a larger power spectral density.

q_412.question: What is the significance of the Source statistics descriptor in network traffic?
q_412.ground_truth: The Source statistics descriptor specifies characteristics of the source of submitted SDUs and allows the network to calculate a statistical multiplex gain for use in admission control on the relevant interfaces, particularly in the case of conversational or streaming speech.

q_413.question: What is the effect of the terminating party invoking the OCB service while the originating party has a CCBS request?
q_413.ground_truth: If the originating party then invokes OCB before the terminating party becomes free, the CCBS communication may be rejected due to the OCB invocation.

q_414.question: How many group calls and group call areas can an operator define for a 8-digit group ID?
q_414.ground_truth: An operator can define one group call and one group call area for a 8-digit group ID.

q_415.question: What should the UE do if both timers T314 and T315 have not started while transitioning from connected mode to idle mode?
q_415.ground_truth: The UE should enter idle mode and release the established signalling connections and established radio access bearers to upper layers.

q_416.question: What are the limits for less than 0.02 % of the frames being detected as error free (FEI=0) in steps 1 and 2 of the 3GPP TS 45.005 subclause~6.4 for GSM and EC-RACH?
q_416.ground_truth: The limits for less than 0.02 % of the frames being detected as error free (FEI=0) in steps 1 and 2 of the 3GPP TS 45.005 subclause~6.4 for GSM and EC-RACH are specified in 3GPP TS 45.005 subclause~6.4.

q_417.question: What is the expected outcome when the "GET INPUT" command is executed, and the requested icon could not be displayed?
q_417.ground_truth: The TERMINAL RESPONSE will indicate that the command was performed successfully, but the requested icon was not displayed.

q_418.question: What are the two pieces of information requested from the MRFP for each offered audio and video media stream?
q_418.ground_truth: The local IP address and the port for each offered audio and video media stream.

q_419.question: What is the UE's response to an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message during a 5GMM signalling procedure?
q_419.ground_truth: CR4 states that the UE shall abort any 5GMM signalling procedure, stop any running timers, delete stored SUCI, and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.

q_420.question: What should the SON function below Itf-N do if there is a conflict with non-SON CM operations via Itf-N after the non-SON operation has finished modifying parameters?
q_420.ground_truth: The SON function below Itf-N should take the non-SON CM operation changes into account for further SON analysis.

q_421.question: What are the key features of the anechoic chamber measurement system using phase shifters, power dividers, and attenuators instead of a commercial channel emulator?
q_421.ground_truth: The key features are the ability to emulate a realistic fading channel environment, reduce the influence from measurement equipment, and perform calculations in the RF band to reduce the need for complex post-processing.

q_422.question: What is the function of the "CFN" field in the control frame payload for timing adjustment?
q_422.ground_truth: The CFN (Communication Frame Number) represents the time when the RNC sends the corresponding DL data frame through the SAP to the transport layer. The CFN value is extracted from the corresponding DL data frame and is used for timing adjustment.

q_423.question: What is inter-layer prediction in SVC?
q_423.ground_truth: Inter-layer prediction in SVC refers to three different inter-layer prediction modes that allow for single-loop decoding, with texture prediction, motion prediction, and residual prediction from the base layer.

q_424.question: In the context of TS 38.331, clause 5.7.10.3, when rlf-ReportReq is set to true and the UE has radio link failure or handover failure information available in VarRLF-Report, what should be set as the rlf-Report in the UEInformationResponse message?
q_424.ground_truth: The value of rlf-Report in VarRLF-Report.

q_425.question: What message is sent by BSS-A to MSC-A to initiate the handover procedure?

q_426.question: What is the keying model used in GBA Push?
q_426.ground_truth: The Disposable-Ks model is the keying model used in GBA Push. In this model, a Ks is only used once to derive a single set of NAF-keys and other keying material, after which the Ks is erased or its further use is denied.

q_428.question: What is the process of spreading for the 3.84 Mcps MBSFN IMB option?
q_428.ground_truth: The spreading operation includes a modulation mapper stage, a channelisation stage, an IQ combining stage, and a scrambling stage. For all physical channels, the I and Q branches are spread to the chip rate by the same real-valued channelisation code. The sequence of complex-valued chips output from the spreading stage is then scrambled (complex chip-wise multiplication) by a complex-valued scrambling code.

q_429.question: Which country is the reference location request for with AdditionalGPSAssistDataRequired?
q_429.ground_truth: It depends on the context of the application. The reference location request could be for any country, depending on the location of the device or user requesting assistance.

q_430.question: What media is reused after Access Transfer in PS to CS direction within 3GPP access networks?
q_430.ground_truth: The media established upon the transfer of the currently active session is reused for the held session.

q_431.question: What is the measurement type that provides the number of attempted relocation resource allocations with UE involved for PS domain?

q_432.question: Which function is responsible for the control of connection element set-up and release in the E-UTRAN?

q_433.question: What should the data link layer entity do if it has not received the correct response after N200 attempts to recover and timer T200 has expired?
q_433.ground_truth: The data link layer entity should enter the idle state and inform the layer~3 entity using the primitive DL-RELEASE-CONFIRM and MDL-ERROR-IND with cause "Timer T200 expired (N200+1) times: perform abnormal release".

q_434.question: Which network entities store data related to MSP in 3GPP network?
q_434.ground_truth: In a 3GPP network, the HLR (Home Location Register) and the VLR (Visitor Location Register) are the network entities that store data related to MSP.

q_435.question: Which events are applicable when an IoT UE attaches for NIDD using SCEF in a CSP network?
q_435.ground_truth: The events applicable when an IoT UE attaches for NIDD using SCEF in a CSP network are IoT UE Attach for NIDD using SCEF, MME originated connection request, and SGSN originated connection request.

q_436.question: How are the filtered tonality values for the original and SBR signals obtained in this algorithm?
q_436.ground_truth: The regions for the original and SBR signals are obtained by finding the region that has an upper border higher than the present value, and a lower border lower or equal to the present value. This means that if the present value is smaller than the first value in the border vector, the region returned will be zero, and so on.

q_437.question: What is the purpose of the "gapTreatment" parameter in the CallGap procedure?
q_437.ground_truth: The "gapTreatment" parameter specifies how calls that were stopped by the call gapping mechanism shall be treated, such as sending an announcement, repeating a message, or releasing the call with a specific cause value.

q_438.question: What is the goal of a spoofing attack in the context of GNSS?
q_438.ground_truth: The goal of a spoofing attack is for the attacker to threaten the integrity and confidentiality of a GNSS transmission by broadcasting false signals, making the receiver misinterpret them as authentic, and compute a false position and time.

q_439.question: What is the procedure used in LTE Rel-15 to establish a UE context at the secondary eNB (SeNB) to provide radio resources from the SeNB to the UE, as part of DC mobility scenario?

q_440.question: How can the UE distinguish whether the call is coming from a conference or a single-stream UE, to disable unnecessary multi-stream functionality in point-to-point?
q_440.ground_truth: The UE can look for the "isFocus" tag in the SIP header, which a conference will include, but a UE will never include.

q_441.question: What is the purpose of the "SV Global Health" information that may accompany the almanac information?
q_441.ground_truth: The purpose of "SV Global Health" information is to provide additional information about the current status and health of each satellite in the GPS constellation.

q_442.question: What is required to protect management and control systems (MnS) and corresponding managed resources from unauthorized access in the 3GPP management system?
q_442.ground_truth: Access control, including identification, authentication, authorization and auditing, is required to protect MnSs and corresponding managed resources from unauthorized reading and writing.

q_443.question: What function allows the CN to operate the mode in which the UTRAN reports the location of the UE?

q_444.question: How does the MRFP select which video streams to send to a conference participant?
q_444.ground_truth: The MRFP selects the video streams to be sent to a conference participant from among the videos received from the other conference participants in such a way that from each other conference participant at most one main video is sent to this conference participant, and at most one screenshare video stream is sent to this conference participant.

q_445.question: What is the difference between the general use case for media coverage and the breaking news reporter use case?
q_445.ground_truth: The general use case for media coverage prefers high-quality uncompressed audio and video content delivered via FLUS, while the breaking news reporter use case has several production levels available based on the network conditions and productions needs.

q_446.question: What does the "HNB Name" IE contain?
q_446.ground_truth: The "HNB Name" IE contains information about the name of a Home NodeB (HNB), which is a type of wireless network node.

q_447.question: When should a mobile station perform neighbour cell measurements?
q_447.ground_truth: The mobile station shall perform neighbour cell measurements during any unused PDCH or group of unused PDCHs where the MS's Measurement Capabilities indicate that the mobile station is capable of making a neighbour cell measurement.

q_448.question: What procedure is used when the UE decides to release the multicast service context and corresponding multicast session resources?
q_448.ground_truth: The User Multicast Service Release procedure is used in this case, which includes sending an IGMP (IPv4) or MLD (IPv6) Leave message, and if individual delivery method is used, the PDU Session Modification is performed.

q_449.question: What is required for the inclusion of the "GANSS TOD msec" information element in a measurement report?
q_449.ground_truth: The "GANSS TOD msec" information element should be included in a measurement report if the UE supports the capability to provide the GANSS timing of the cell frames measurement and the IE "GANSS timing of Cell wanted" is not included or set to zero, and any of the GANSS signals are measured.

q_450.question: What is the purpose of Home Link Detection in DSMIPv6?
q_450.ground_truth: The UE needs to perform Home Link Detection before it initiates registration with the HA, in order to detect if it is attached to the home link from a DSMIPv6 perspective.

q_451.question: What is the role of padding in HSCSD?
q_451.ground_truth: Padding refers to the fill bits needed to adapt the maximum possible AIUR supported by a given number of TCH/F with a given channel coding to a FNUR that is lower than the maximum possible AIUR.

q_452.question: What should the network do if the acquisition of system information is completed after it has sent the PACKET CS RELEASE INDICATION message?
q_452.ground_truth: The network should send a CHANNEL RELEASE message on the main DCCH with the Enhanced DTM CS Release Indication field indicating that the mobile station is allowed to continue in packet transfer mode after the release of the RR connection.

q_453.question: What should be the user interface guidelines for presenting warning notifications in a PWS?
q_453.ground_truth: The warning notification delivered to the user's terminal should be understood by the user with minimal knowledge of the UE. The user interface guidelines should include activation of a special acoustic/visual signal dedicated to PWS, terminal behaviour when a warning notification is received in IDLE mode, and terminal capability for user operation when/ after a warning notification is received.

q_454.question: What mode is only applicable for mobile stations supporting GPRS and has no temporary block flow?

q_455.question: How can multi-vendor scenarios influence standardized interfaces for 5G network management?
q_455.ground_truth: In a multi-vendor scenario, higher autonomous network levels may require simpler standardized interfaces (i.e. MnS) to reduce interoperability complexity and improve network operating efficiency and automation performance.

q_456.question: What is the purpose of the interpolating filter in the fractional pitch search in the AMR-WB codec?
q_456.ground_truth: The interpolating filter in the fractional pitch search has a low pass frequency response and is used to update the target signal by removing the adaptive codebook contribution.

q_457.question: What are the parameters that must be met in the shielding effectiveness of the chamber for being able to measure sensitivity for the mobile equipment?
q_457.ground_truth: The measured level of external signals at the frequency of interest(UMTS frequency band) has to be 10dB below sensitivity level of the mobile equipment.

q_458.question: What is the purpose of this test as defined in 10.1.1.3?
q_458.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the ME only selects a CSG cell if the CSG IDs of the cell is found in the allowed CSG IDs from EFACSGL.

q_459.question: What action should the UE take if a matching criterion is found and the value of Tsor-cm timer in the new SOR-CMCI is smaller than the current value of the running Tsor-cm timer for the associated PDU session or service?
q_459.ground_truth: The Tsor-cm timer value for the associated PDU session or service shall be replaced with the value in the new SOR-CMCI without stopping and restarting the timer.

q_460.question: What is the significance of the three digits in the version numbering system used in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
q_460.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the stage of development of the specification, with "0" indicating that it is presented to the TSG for information, "1" for approval, and "3" or higher for TSG approved documents under change control. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates. The third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been made.

q_461.question: Who is responsible for checking the user consent for requested/collected UE related data in the URDCF hosted by NWDAF or DCCF?
q_461.ground_truth: The URDCF checks the user consent for the requested/collected UE related Data.

q_462.question: What is the first protocol data unit specified in the DirectTransferIEs?
q_462.ground_truth: The first protocol data unit specified in the DirectTransferIEs is id-NAS-PDU, which is a NAS PDU used for transferring signaling messages.

q_463.question: What is the role of the IMS-ALG (IP Multimedia Subsystem - Access Link Gateway) while interworking SIP messages?
q_463.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG behaves as a SIP B2BUA (Back-to-Back User Agent) when interworking SIP messages. It modifies SDP based on specific rules and forwards SIP messages transparently with respect to all methods, result codes, headers, and attachments.

q_464.question: What is the detection level (a) that u and Weinzierl assumed to reach "plausibility" in a simulation, defined as agreement with the listener's expectation towards an equivalent real acoustic event?

q_465.question: What is the role of the CPCN in charging for a PDN connection and NIDD submissions?
q_465.ground_truth: The CPCN is responsible for collecting charging information per user per PDN connection and per NIDD submission in both originating and terminating directions for each data network with associated volume counts.

q_466.question: What are the three notifications for each object?
q_466.ground_truth: The notifications for each object are objectCreation, objectDeletion, and AttributeValueChange.

q_467.question: What type of geometric description is used to model the arrival and departure angles in the channel generation process?
q_467.ground_truth: The geometric description covers arrival angles from the last bounce scatterers and respective departure angles to the first scatterers interacted from the transmitting side.

q_468.question: As per requirement R-5.1.4.2-004 and R-5.1.4.2-005, what functionality does the MCVideo service provide in terms of recording, capturing, and activating multiple video cameras?
q_468.ground_truth: The MCVideo service can record video content for video processing, capture video content using coordinated multiple video cameras, determine if presented video content was captured with multiple cameras simultaneously, and provide simultaneous activation and control of multiple video cameras.

q_469.question: What type of activity does the SGSN report to the MSC/VLR when the MS is both IMSI- and GPRS-attached and it does not lead to any procedure towards the MSC/VLR?
q_469.ground_truth: The SGSN sends an MS Activity Indication (IMSI) message towards the MSC/VLR when the MS is both IMSI- and GPRS-attached and it does not lead to any procedure towards the MSC/VLR.

q_470.question: What is the overall gain in call throughput for users using the Type 2i and Type 3i receivers, considering all users?
q_470.ground_truth: The overall gain is 3 % with Type 2i and 6 % with Type 3i.

q_471.question: What is not allowed for burst type 1 when beacon channels use Space Code Transmit Diversity (SCTD) in 4.6.3.1?

q_472.question: What is done with received BSSMAP messages at the non-anchor 3G MSC?
q_472.ground_truth: The received BSSMAP messages are mapped into the corresponding RANAP messages to be sent to the RNS, and the received RANAP messages are mapped into the corresponding BSSMAP messages to be sent over the E-interface to the anchor MSC.

q_473.question: How do the potential impacts on legacy UEs when coexisting with RedCap UEs in a shared CORESET depend on scheduling strategies and system parameters?
q_473.ground_truth: If legacy UEs are prioritized over RedCap UEs, there is no coexistence impact on the legacy UEs at the cost of increased latency at the RedCap UE side.

q_474.question: What is the role of the EES (Edge Enabler Server) in policy authorization and update in the 3GPP network?
q_474.ground_truth: The EES can act as an AF and is a peer of the PCF if they share an N5 interface. It can trigger the Policy Modification procedure if needed, and authorize policy authorization and update for the Edge Application Servers.

q_475.question: What is the structure of the filter bank used in the VAD algorithm's technical description?
q_475.ground_truth: The filter bank consists of 9 bands, each divided into high-pass and low-pass parts by 5th and 3rd order filter blocks, which decimate the sampling frequency by 2 in each filter block. The filter blocks are implemented as first order direct form all-pass filters and the signal level is calculated at the output of the filter bank for each frequency band.

q_476.question: What action does the MS take when it receives an Attach Accept message that includes the IMS voice over PS session supported Indication?
q_476.ground_truth: The MS activates IMS voice over PS session if the Indication is set.

q_477.question: What is the reduction in transaction time for downloading 100 email message headers when the TTI is reduced from 20 ms to 10 ms?
q_477.ground_truth: The transaction time is reduced from 8 seconds to 6 seconds, a reduction of 25%.

q_478.question: What is the MAIO hopping scheme used for VAMOS second sub-channel users in the 3GPP 45.002 sequence generation?
q_478.ground_truth: The MAIO hopping scheme is applied to all VAMOS second sub-channel users for 20% of the frames, and it activates on the last frame within each five frames.

q_479.question: Which series of specifications, TS 24.08x and 24.09x, deal with the procedures used at the radio interface for the operation, registration, erasure, activation, deactivation, invocation, and interrogation of supplementary services?
q_479.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 24.08x and 24.09x-series specify the procedures used at the radio interface for normal operation, registration, erasure, activation, deactivation, invocation, and interrogation of supplementary services.

q_480.question: What is the difference between Solution #6 and Solution #21 for PC5 communication?
q_480.ground_truth: In Solution #6, the Remote UE calculates a message authentication code (MAC~REAR) and includes it in the Direct Communication Request to the UE-to-network relay, while in Solution #21, this is not the case. Additionally, in Solution #6, the Remote UE and UE-to-network relay belong to the same HPLMN, whereas in Solution #21, they belong to different HPLMNs.

q_481.question: What is the significance of the variable "a single integer value" in relation to the measurements in sections 5.1.3.1 to 5.1.3.6?
q_481.ground_truth: This indicates that the measurement gives a single numerical value as a result.

q_482.question: What problem was found with using FOA signals with two instances of eAAC+ encoding at low bit-rates?
q_482.ground_truth: The occurrence of out-of-phase components between each of the channel pairs was the issue found.

q_483.question: Under what circumstances will the SGSN include the IMEI in the message when sending data to the GGSN?
q_483.ground_truth: The SGSN will include the IMEI in the message if the MS is emergency attached and the MS is UICCless or the IMSI is unauthenticated.

q_484.question: What information is included in the request service provided by the AF in the solution for key issue 7?
q_484.ground_truth: The AF provides the Key-ID (Key identifier) to NEF in the request service.

q_485.question: Which capability IE should the Node B include in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message if the Local Cell is F-DPCH-capable when it becomes Existing?
q_485.ground_truth: The Node B shall include the F-DPCH Capability IE set to "F-DPCH Capable" for the Local Cell.

q_486.question: What is the role of the MCData Service in robot control communication within a 3GPP system?
q_486.ground_truth: The MCData Service provides the necessary mechanisms to enable and control robot communication within a 3GPP system, ensuring smooth integration of various robots and provision of a common transmission framework.

q_487.question: What is the maximum bit rate for the downlink?
q_487.ground_truth: The maximum bit rate for the downlink is 8 kbps.

q_488.question: What should the IMS-ALG do if an indication that the allocation of a primary local MR is not required has been stored?
q_488.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should compare the realm instances and MRs that can be bypassed, and use local policy to select whether to allocate a primary local MR.

q_489.question: What procedure does the SGSN initiate when a PDP context using streaming or conversational traffic class is deactivated in architecture variants using S4 based interaction with S-GW and P-GW?
q_489.ground_truth: The SGSN initiates the SGSN-initiated PDP Context Deactivation procedure to deactivate the PDP context.

q_490.question: What is the higher layer parameter that determines the transmission gap for BL/CE UEs in frame structure type 1, when associated with Temporary C-RNTI and PRACH CE level 2 or 3 is used for the last PRACH attempt?

q_491.question: What is the function of the Non-IP Packet Data Header Information event in the SCEF related events?
q_491.ground_truth: The Non-IP Packet Data Header Information event is used to provide packet header reports on a per packet basis for a target.

q_492.question: What is the value of the general result for the successfully performed "SEND DATA" command?

q_493.question: What functional entity performs application's traffic detection and reporting?
q_493.ground_truth: The TDF (Traffic Detection Function) performs application's traffic detection and reporting.

q_494.question: How are the noise estimates obtained in DTX-off mode in the CNA?
q_494.ground_truth: By applying the FD-CNG noise estimation algorithm at the output of the core decoder during speech pauses

q_495.question: What action is taken by the source NG-RAN in the Xn based handover procedure to release the forwarding tunnel with the source NG-RAN once the switching to unicast mode is confirmed?
q_495.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN releases the forwarding tunnel with the source NG-RAN after the switching to unicast mode is confirmed. This action helps in freeing up resources in the source NG-RAN and prevents any unnecessary data transmission to the target NG-RAN.

q_496.question: What should the UE do when it has changed to S1 mode or E-UTRA connected to 5GCN?
q_496.ground_truth: The UE should treat the indication from the lower layers as successful completion of the procedure and stop timer T3517.

q_497.question: What is the instruction given by the CSE if the attach request is rejected in the attach procedure?
q_497.ground_truth: If the CSE rejects the attachment request, the VPLMN shall reject the attachment request and continue.

q_498.question: What should the UE do when barring for an Access Category is considered being alleviated and the Access Category is '8'?
q_498.ground_truth: The UE shall perform actions specified in 5.3.13.8 if barring is alleviated for Access Category '8'. These actions may include triggering uplink transmission if needed.

q_499.question: What procedure does the Trusted Non-3GPP Access follow for PMIPv6 PDN Connection Creation in PMIPv6 mode?
q_499.ground_truth: In PMIPv6 mode, the Trusted Non-3GPP Access follows the MAG procedure for the PMIPv6 PDN Connection Creation as outlined in subclause 5.1.2.

q_500.question: What should the LMISF do upon receiving a notification of an IMS Signalling Bearer creation due to S-GW relocation?
q_500.ground_truth: The LMISF should examine whether the IMS Signalling Bearer is associated with an intercepted IMS session, and if so, whether the intercepted IMS session requires CC interception. If it does, the LMISF should inform the S-GW/BBIFF with the IMS Signalling Bearer information and an instruction to deliver (to LMISF) the packets from the Media Bearer associated with the IMS Signalling Bearer.

q_501.question: What was the average interference power over the burst length used in the asynchronous scenario to match the synchronous case?
q_501.ground_truth: Two consecutive bursts with independent fast fading were generated to provide the same average interference power over the burst length as in the synchronous case.

q_502.question: What is the format of the information reported in the InformationReport message?
q_502.ground_truth: The InformationReport message contains information about the results of an information exchange. It consists of protocolIEs, protocolExtensions, and one of the following: cell, commonRGCHCell, or ANR-Cell-InfEx-Rsp. The exact format of the information reported depends on the specific type of information exchange object.

q_503.question: What is the role of the recovery message in the SMF set in case of UE IP address/prefix release?
q_503.ground_truth: The SMF broadcasts the available UE IP address(es)/prefix(es) message towards all other SMFs in the SMF set if the released UE IP address(es)/prefix(es) does not belong to its individual UE IP address/prefix list.

q_504.question: What is the role of the jamming graph in the distributed FFR algorithm for HeNB network interference?
q_504.ground_truth: The jamming graph in the distributed FFR algorithm for HeNB network interference is used to convert the planning problem into a graph coloring problem, which can be solved in a distributed manner at low complexity.

q_505.question: What does the ProtectedStreaming attribute indicate?
q_505.ground_truth: It indicates whether the device supports streamed protected PSS as defined by Annex R.

q_506.question: What is the purpose of the on-demand request of location information procedure in the primary MC system?
q_506.ground_truth: The MC service server or location management client in the primary MC system can request on-demand location information of an MC service user in the partner MC system at any time.

q_507.question: What action does the UE take when the TTL corresponding to a Discovery Filter expires?
q_507.ground_truth: When the TTL corresponding to a Discovery Filter expires, the ProSe Function in the UE removes the entry related to that Discovery Filter from the UE context.

q_508.question: How are MBMS User Services defined in the present document?
q_508.ground_truth: MBMS User Services are defined as an end-user service for which all associated resources are delivered through an MBMS User Service via broadcast and/or unicast bearers and which is accessible through the MBMS-API.

q_509.question: What is the purpose of "omr-s-cksum" and "omr-m-cksum" in the initial SDP offer when sending an initial SDP offer in IMS-ALG?
q_509.ground_truth: To ensure the integrity of the media line and session level lines in the SDP offer.

q_510.question: What action does the target RNC/BSS take when it receives downlink packets from the 3G/2G SGSN?
q_510.ground_truth: The target RNC/BSS may start blind transmission of downlink user data towards the MS over the allocated radio channels.

q_511.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in the MDAS system?
q_511.ground_truth: The NWDAF may consume the MDAS for identified scenarios and provide analytics service for 5GC NF for control purpose.

q_512.question: What is the purpose of Ga reference point in the 3GPP offline charging architecture?
q_512.ground_truth: The Ga reference point in the 3GPP offline charging architecture is intended for the transport of Charging Data Records (CDRs) between the Charging Data Function (CDF) and Charging Gateway Function (CGF).

q_513.question: What message is used to report detected errors in one incoming message when an appropriate failure message cannot be used?
