q_1043.question: What are the different modes a Generic Access capable terminal may support?
q_1043.ground_truth: A Generic Access capable terminal may support any IP access technology in addition to the GERAN and possibly UTRAN radio interfaces. The MS may be either in the GERAN/UTRAN/E-UTRAN mode or in GAN mode of operation.

q_1044.question: What file contains the EPS update status and GUTI in 7.3.7.5 to verify CR2?

q_1045.question: What is the mechanism used to prepare and execute the relocation between the HNB and the RNC?
q_1045.ground_truth: The mechanism used to prepare and execute the relocation between the HNB and the RNC follows the standardised Enhanced SRNS Relocation procedure as defined between two RNCs.

q_1046.question: What features does the network inform the UE about in the 5GS network feature support information element?
q_1046.ground_truth: The network informs the UE about the support of specific features, such as IMS voice over PS session, emergency services or emergency services fallback in the 5GS network feature support information element.

q_1047.question: When is it not necessary for the SMF to update the UE with the DNS server address and security parameters when ULCL or IPV6 BP insertion/change happens?
q_1047.ground_truth: If the local DNS resolver or DNS forwarder is reachable by an anycast address, then it is not required for the SMF to update the UE with the DNS server address and security parameters.

q_1048.question: Which network element stores the Paging Filtering Rules in solution #10 when the UE is in the 5GS RRC Inactive state?
q_1048.ground_truth: The NG-RAN stores the Paging Filtering Rules in solution #10 when the UE is in the 5GS RRC Inactive state.

q_1049.question: What is the function of the INFO octets in the STATUS frame?
q_1049.ground_truth: INFO octets contain state-specific information. In BCS-REC state, it contains 8 bits received from the BCS modem. In all other states, an idle code (hex code 0F) is inserted.

q_1050.question: What is the default General Operation requirement for the SCR mechanism within the 3GPP system?
q_1050.ground_truth: The default SCR mechanism requires a Voice Activity Detector (VAD) on the transmit side, evaluation of the background acoustic noise on the transmit side, and generation of similar noise on the receive side during periods where the transmission is switched off.

q_1051.question: Which European country was the first to grant women the right to vote?

q_1052.question: What is the purpose of the interleaving in the transient detection algorithm?
q_1052.ground_truth: The interleaving is used to combine the coefficients of the equivalent four 5-ms transforms after the short transform. This provides higher time resolution, which is useful for detecting transients.

q_1053.question: What factors are used to estimate the gains of the high frequency band signal in the bandwidth extension algorithm?
q_1053.ground_truth: The gains of the high frequency band signal are estimated using pitch, noise gate factor, voice factor, classification parameter, and LPC.

q_1054.question: How many carriers are used in UTC3 to test multi-band operation aspects with maximum supported number of carriers?
q_1054.ground_truth: The number of carriers of each supported operating band in UTC3 is the declared maximum number of supported carriers in multi-band operation.

q_1055.question: How are relationships represented in clause Y5.2.1 of the IRP IS specification?
q_1055.ground_truth: Relationships are represented in UML compliant class diagrams, including class cardinalities for associations and containment relationships, and only depicting the relationships relevant to the system.

q_1056.question: What is the modulation scheme applied to the shared data channel in E-UTRAN downlink?
q_1056.ground_truth: Link adaptation (AMC: adaptive modulation and coding) with various modulation schemes and channel coding rates is applied to the shared data channel in E-UTRAN downlink.

q_1057.question: What is the meaning of an error distance of 2 in an Iu UP-Status indication?
q_1057.ground_truth: The error report relates to an error at the other side reported by the upper layers.

q_1058.question: What message does UE-1 send to initiate a one-to-one ProSe Direct Communication with UE-2?
q_1058.ground_truth: UE-1 sends a Direct Communication Request message to UE-2.

q_1059.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request towards an MCPTT group session that has reached its maximum participant count and an existing user in the group session is deemed to have a lower priority?
q_1059.ground_truth: The IWF performing the controlling role should not admit the new user and return a SIP 486 (Busy Here) response with the warning text set to "122 too many participants" to the originating network.

q_1060.question: Which function is allowed by the Presence interworking between GSM-R and FRMCS Users use case?
q_1060.ground_truth: This use case allows FRMCS User(s) to see the status of GSM-R user(s), and vice versa, by presenting the changed status of GSM-R User B in FRMCS User A, and the changed status of FRMCS User A in GSM-R User B.

q_1061.question: What operation is performed to generate the decoder output signal in the AMR-WB codec?
q_1061.ground_truth: The decoder output signal(s) are generated by combining the low and high band signal to produce full band signals, which is the inverse of the encoder band-splitting operation.

q_1062.question: How does the system handle different bearers with different policies and QoS in this solution?
q_1062.ground_truth: The system can establish different bearers with different policies and QoS as it was used to. When a certain UE and gNB start a PDCP entity with one of the new nia4, nia5, nia6, nia7 integrity algorithm identifiers, all Transport Blocks to and from the UE are integrity protected using the cryptographic CRC. This does not influence the data rates/QoS of the other PDCP entities.

q_1063.question: What is the procedure for the UE to discover the V2X application server address for downlink transport, as specified in the first step?
q_1063.ground_truth: If the V2X service of the V2X message is identified by a V2X service identifier, and this V2X service identifier is associated with a V2X application server IP address and a TCP port for bidirectional transport in the list of V2X services authorized for V2X communication over LTE-Uu for the serving PLMN and the geographical area in which the UE is located, the UE shall use this IP address and the TCP port for V2X communication over LTE-Uu.

q_1064.question: What information is required by a national regulation for interception based on the HLR using the DF2?
q_1064.ground_truth: National regulations require interception based on the HLR using the DF2 with a delivery through the HI2 interface.

q_1065.question: What are the two main ways to realize the mobile station for the facsimile teleservice within the PLMN?
q_1065.ground_truth: The two main ways to realize the mobile station are by using a separate "Fax Adaptor" device for existing Group 3 facsimile apparatus or by combining a standard group 3 facsimile machine and the Fax Adaptor into a specially developed "PLMN facsimile machine".

q_1066.question: In what scenario should the IBCF set the Through-Connection information element to "sendrecv"?
q_1066.ground_truth: The IBCF should set the Through-Connection information element to "sendrecv" if the received em-param(s) in the P-Early-Media header field is set to "sendrecv".

q_1067.question: How can the power/delay profile be enhanced when a MIMO channel emulator and reverberation chamber are cascaded?
q_1067.ground_truth: The power/delay profile can be enhanced beyond the single decaying exponential by programming the channel emulator with fading taps set at the desired excess delays, resulting in the convolution of the taps provided by the channel.

q_1068.question: What is the functionality provided by the MCVideo service for controlling camera functions not specifically related to the video stream?
q_1068.ground_truth: The MCVideo service provides the ability for authorized MCVideo Users to control pan, tilt, and zoom (PTZ) functions of cameras, including placing a capable camera in and out of an automatic detection, activation, and tracking mode.

q_1069.question: What is the function of the Charging function in a GERAN?
q_1069.ground_truth: The Charging function formats and transfers information related to a chargeable event in order to determine usage for which the charged party may be billed.

q_1070.question: What should the UE do when it performs a TAU procedure caused by a RAT change?
q_1070.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST with N1 mode capability set to 'N1 mode not supported'.

q_1071.question: What is the purpose of the Retransmission Sequence Number (RSN) in the E-DPCCH information field?
q_1071.ground_truth: The RSN indicates the redundancy version of each HARQ transmission and helps the Node B manage its soft buffer to avoid corruption.

q_1072.question: What should the Node B do when the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT OBJECT TYPE is indicated as "RL" in the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message?
q_1072.ground_truth: The Node B shall measure and report results for all indicated Radio Links if the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT OBJECT TYPE is "RL".

q_1073.question: What is the format of the Request-URI in the HTTP POST message when the SCF sends a register deregister request to the BM-SC?
q_1073.ground_truth: The Request-URI in the HTTP POST message takes the form of "keymanagement?requesttype= sip-based-deregister".

q_1074.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to Proximity Services (ProSe)?
q_1074.ground_truth: The 3GPP is a partnership that specifies the Stage 2 of the Proximity Services (ProSe) features in EPS. ProSe features consist of ProSe discovery and ProSe Direct Communication.

q_1075.question: Who is able to install or remove third party root public keys on an MExE device?
q_1075.ground_truth: The user is able to securely install or remove third party root public keys at any time using a system administrative tool. The Manufacturer, Operator, and Administrator may also install certificates containing Third Party root public key(s) on behalf of the user, such as at the time of manufacture by the Manufacturer.

q_1076.question: What shall the MRFP do when the maximum record time has elapsed in a multimedia recording?
q_1076.ground_truth: The MRFP shall stop the multimedia recording and save the recorded content to the specified URI if the multimedia recording is successful. If not, the MRFP shall discard the recorded content.

q_1077.question: What is the procedure for the QUIC connection establishment between the User Equipment (UE) and the remote host in the 3GPP network?
q_1077.ground_truth: In the 3GPP network, the QUIC connection establishment between the UE and the remote host is done by the ATSSS-LL functionality when the UPF is aware that the application supports QUIC. If the UPF identifies the QUIC packets, the traffic switching or splitting per packet based on the steering mode and link performance measurement of PMF can be performed by the ATSSS-LL functionality.

q_1078.question: What is the procedure for selecting a PLMN/access technology combination when the MS supports CAG and is provisioned with a "CAG information list"?
q_1078.ground_truth: The MS first considers the HPLMN or the highest priority EHPLMN if the EHPLMN list is present. If registration fails, the MS then considers PLMN/access technology combinations in the "User Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" and "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" data files, and finally any available PLMN/access technology combinations with high signal quality.

q_1079.question: What should be used for data and fax, in addition to speech, to be transported as RTP Payload in the SIP-I based Nc?
q_1079.ground_truth: Speech in various encodings packed in corresponding RTP payload types may be transported as RTP Payload, as well as data and fax packed in corresponding RTP payload types.

q_1080.question: What protocol is used to establish a Diameter session for each TDF session in the Sd application?
q_1080.ground_truth: The Diameter Base Protocol and the Diameter Credit Control Application are used to establish a Diameter session for each TDF session in the Sd application.

q_1081.question: What is the purpose and length of the message sent on the EC-SCH?
q_1081.ground_truth: The purpose of the message is to support the synchronization of an EC-capable mobile station to a BSS when a cell supports EC operation, and its length is 30 bits.

q_1082.question: In which database(s) is the UE Reachability Request Parameter (URRP) conditionally stored?
q_1082.ground_truth: URRP is conditionally stored in the MME, SGSN, and HSS.

q_1083.question: What message is sent by the HNB to the HNB-GW when the Iuh disconnect procedure is initiated?
q_1083.ground_truth: The HNB sends a Disconnect message to the HNB-GW, indicating the end of the UE-associated signalling connection, along with the RANAP Release Iu Connection Complete message.

q_1084.question: What do End users desire in all use cases?
q_1084.ground_truth: End users want a seamless user experience in viewing HTTP streamed content and be fully agnostic of any underlying DRM and decryption mechanisms.

q_1085.question: What is the sublayer of L2 that is responsible for adapting broadcast and multicast services on the radio interface in 3GPP networks?

q_1086.question: What are the two transparent containers defined for the PS handover in GERAN A/Gb mode and GAN mode?
q_1086.ground_truth: The two transparent containers defined for the PS handover in GERAN A/Gb mode and GAN mode are Source BSS to Target BSS Transparent Container and Target BSS to Source BSS Transparent Container.

q_1087.question: What should be the first step taken in the procedure for management of PFDs where there is any change to the PFD (s) due to pull mode or push mode procedure?
q_1087.ground_truth: PGW-C/TDF-C sends PFD management request to the PGW-U/TDF-U to provision/update/remove the PFD (s) when there is any change to the PFD (s) due to pull mode or push mode procedure.

q_1088.question: In the context of 3GPP, what does the term "E-DCH" refer to?

q_1089.question: What is the basic approach used for amplitude quantization in PPP coding?
q_1089.ground_truth: The DFS amplitude is first normalized by two scaling factors at the encoder, one for the low band and one for the high band. These scaling factors are vector-quantized in the logarithmic domain and transmitted to the decoder. The normalized spectrum is non-uniformly-downsampled/averaged to transform a variable dimension vector to a fixed dimension vector. The downsampled spectrum is then split into a low band and high band spectra, each of which is separately quantized.

q_1090.question: What is the role of the NAF Key Center in the key establishment process using a shared-key based mutual authentication between the Terminal and the NAF Key Center?
q_1090.ground_truth: The NAF Key Center is responsible for establishing a secure tunnel with the Terminal for the key establishment process. This secure tunnel can be based on a shared-key based mutual authentication between the Terminal and the NAF Key Center using PSK TLS.

q_1091.question: How are "modal verbs" used in the document?
q_1091.ground_truth: Modal verbs, like "shall" and "shall not," indicate mandatory requirements, interdictions, recommendations, permissions, possibility, or impossibility in the normative elements of the document.

q_1092.question: What type of audio/video DASH Media Presentation does the first User Service carry?
q_1092.ground_truth: The first User Service carries an English audio track audio/video DASH Media Presentation.

q_1093.question: Which vulnerability testing requirements apply to all types of GVNP?
q_1093.ground_truth: The requirements for port scanning, vulnerability scanning, and robustness and fuzz testing in TS 33.117, clause 4.4 apply to all types of GVNP.

q_1094.question: What is the purpose of down-sampling or up-sampling in the content re-targeting operation?
q_1094.ground_truth: The purpose of down-sampling or up-sampling is to match the depth information (disparity map) to the new viewing distance, screen resolution, and pixel density.

q_1095.question: What is the input power level that the Home BS receiver must meet the requirements for, as specified at the Home BS antenna connector?
q_1095.ground_truth: The input power level is specified at 0 dBi for Home BSs without measurement capability.

q_1096.question: What is the maximum number of HARQ processes per HS-DSCH per TTI for single stream transmission in the MAC-ehs entity in the UE side?
q_1096.ground_truth: There shall be one HARQ process per HS-DSCH per TTI for single stream transmission.

q_1097.question: What is the mandatory mode of operation for NR UEs supporting MBS?
q_1097.ground_truth: UE test loop mode C is mandatory for NR UEs supporting MBS.

q_1098.question: What is the test object specified in 27.22.4.11.4.2.4.2 for the ME to operate on?
q_1098.ground_truth: The test object is Expected Sequence 4.2A or 4.2B, which are SEND SS commands with specific parameters and attributes to test the ME's operation.

q_1099.question: What is the CRITICALITY of the informationExchangeInitiation PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
q_1099.ground_truth: The CRITICALITY of the informationExchangeInitiation PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE is reject.

q_1100.question: Which device is specified as the source device in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP MENU 1.2.1"?
q_1100.ground_truth: The source device is specified as "SIM".

q_1101.question: In event 2b, what is the triggering condition for a non-used frequency if detected set cells are not considered?
q_1101.ground_truth: The non-used frequency must have an estimated quality above a certain threshold and this quality must be significantly better than the quality of the currently used frequency.

q_1102.question: What is the maximum number of retransmissions allowed for an HS-DSCH transport block when using CRC attachment method 2 and HS-SCCH type 2?
q_1102.ground_truth: The maximum number of retransmissions allowed for an HS-DSCH transport block when using CRC attachment method 2 and HS-SCCH type 2 is two.

q_1103.question: What does the Serving GW do after receiving the Delete Bearer Command message?
q_1103.ground_truth: The Serving GW sends the Delete Bearer Command (EPS Bearer Identity) message to the PDN GW.

q_1104.question: How does Group 2 propose to change paging strategies to avoid PF/PO collision for multi-USIM devices?
q_1104.ground_truth: Solutions in Group 2, like #18 and partial #17, suggest changing paging strategies to avoid PF/PO collision, such as paging on consecutive POs or using UE assistant info to influence paging strategy. However, these changes may increase paging resource usage, delay, and affect RAN paging implementation.

q_1105.question: When is the one phase packet access procedure considered completed and the mobile station has entered the packet transfer mode or MAC-Shared state?
q_1105.ground_truth: The one phase packet access procedure is completed upon a successful contention resolution and the mobile station has entered the packet transfer mode or MAC-Shared state.

q_1106.question: What is used for transferring substream numbering information in the parallel data substreams between Split/Combine-functions?
q_1106.ground_truth: The status bits S1, S3, and the X-bit between data bits D12 and D13 are used for transferring substream numbering information in the parallel data substreams between Split/Combine-functions.

q_1107.question: What is the responsibility of the Non-3GPP message client in MSGin5G service?
q_1107.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP message client provides client-side functionality for a Non-3GPP messaging service.

q_1108.question: What is the role of the SMF/UPF in the 5G Core Network for SNPN UEs in temporary leave procedure?
q_1108.ground_truth: The SMF/UPF in the 5G Core Network for SNPN UEs supports buffering downlink data when the UE is in temporary leave and supports the establishment and re-activation of a PDU Session for back-up purpose.

q_1109.question: What is the role of the line spectral pairs (LSPs) in speech processing?
q_1109.ground_truth: The line spectral pairs (LSPs) are a set of parameters that represent the spectral envelope of the speech signal in the cosine domain, which are used to quantize and code the LPC coefficients in speech processing applications.

q_1110.question: In the XML syntax for a reception report request, what does the "fileURI" element represent?
q_1110.ground_truth: The "fileURI" element in the XML syntax for a reception report request represents a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for a file.

q_1111.question: How is the communication between the ASP Application Client and the AF for UE data collection protected?
q_1111.ground_truth: The communication between the ASP Application Client and the AF for UE data collection is protected using HTTPS. Integrity protection and ciphering may also be applied to the data. The ASP is responsible for ensuring that user privacy is not compromised and the ASP's UE Application Client is instructed by the ASP to establish a connection with the MNO AF only if that agreement allows the client to share data with the MNO.

q_1112.question: What should the UE do when the timer T3585 is running upon entering state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED and remains the same when the UE switches on again, if the UE is not capable of determining the time elapsed between switch off and switch on?
q_1112.ground_truth: The UE shall restart the timer T3585 with the value t1, where t1 is the time remaining for T3585 timeout at switch off.

q_1113.question: What action is taken by the SGSN when re-activating the GA-RRC PTC while the PS domain GA-RRC sublayer entity in the MS is in the GA-RRC-CONNECTED and the MS is in the PMM-CONNECTED state?
q_1113.ground_truth: The SGSN, MS, and GANC perform the RAB assignment and PTC activation procedure, and the SGSN sends the downlink PDU to the MS to transfer additional data.

q_1114.question: What is the role of the Viterbi algorithm (VA) in a rate-1/2 convolutional code?
q_1114.ground_truth: The Viterbi algorithm (VA) is used to find the minimum distortion path in a rate-1/2 convolutional code.

q_1115.question: What are the network's responsibilities in handling alternate speech/facsimile group 3 service calls in 3GPP TS 27 series?
q_1115.ground_truth: The network should provide a rapid and reliable changeover of capability upon request from the mobile user during the alternate speech/facsimile group 3 service calls and initiate the changeover on the receipt of the "MODIFY" message from the UE.

q_1116.question: What is the purpose of Charging Gateway Functionality (CGF)?
q_1116.ground_truth: The Charging Gateway Functionality (CGF) is a function of the Offline Charging System (OFCS), which is used for offline charging.

q_1117.question: What should the ProSe Function do when it receives a ProSe Initial Location Information Request?
q_1117.ground_truth: The ProSe Function shall include the corresponding IMSI in the user profile of the targeted user in the request.

q_1118.question: What is the difference between the states "Gs-NULL" and "Gs-ASSOCIATED" at the VLR in the 3GPP system?
q_1118.ground_truth: In "Gs-NULL" state, the VLR considers that the MS is IMSI detached for GPRS services, and sends no BSSAP+-MS-INFORMATION-REQUEST or BSSAP+-MM-INFORMATION-REQUEST messages to the SGSN. In "Gs-ASSOCIATED" state, the VLR considers that the MS is attached to both GPRS and non-GPRS services, and sends BSSAP+-PAGING-REQUEST messages to MSs in class-A and class-B mode of operation via only the Gs interface.

q_1119.question: How can a terminal avoid the need for codec re-negotiation during initial call set-up in MCPTT?
q_1119.ground_truth: The terminal can use only mandatory codecs, or attempt to determine out-of-band the codec capabilities of all the terminals beforehand.

q_1120.question: What is the purpose of the "ProtocolIEs" field in the "RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD" sequence in NBAP?
q_1120.ground_truth: The "ProtocolIEs" field in the "RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD" sequence specifies the protocol IEs used in NBAP for FDD. It includes a mandatory "c-ID" element, while the other elements are optional.

q_1121.question: What must the NAF indicate to the BSF to request key material for a specific Ua security protocol?
q_1121.ground_truth: The NAF shall be able to indicate to the BSF the protocol identifier of the Ua security protocol for which it requires the key material.

q_1122.question: What does the "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence contain?
q_1122.ground_truth: The "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence contains information about the measurement of the MBS system, including the transmitterID, codephase, codephaseRMS, and iE-Extensions.

q_1123.question: What shall be the "unspecified connection address" for IPv4 implementations?
q_1123.ground_truth: The "unspecified connection address" shall be defined by the IPv4 unspecified address (c= IN IP4 0.0.0.0) for IPv4 implementations.

q_1124.question: What is the condition that a CSCS is not empty in OACS determination?
q_1124.ground_truth: A CSCS is not empty in OACS determination if both radio legs support ACS change and there is a common set of supported codec modes.

q_1125.question: What should the system simulator set as the PCell, PSCell on FR2, and inter-frequency neighbor cell on FR2, for the pre-test conditions in 8.2.3.11.2.3.1?
q_1125.ground_truth: E-UTRA Cell 1 is PCell, NR Cell 1 is PSCell on FR2 and NR Cell 3 is inter-frequency neighbor Cell on FR2.

q_1126.question: What should the IWF do when processing a SIP re-INVITE request for an in-progress emergency call cancellation and the <emergency-ind> element is set to "false", and the request is an authorized request but the in-progress emergency state is "true"?
q_1126.ground_truth: The IWF should validate that the SIP re-INVITE request includes a Resource-Priority header field is populated correctly. If not, the IWF should perform the actions specified in clause~6.6.3.1.5 and, upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP UPDATE request sent in clause~6.6.3.1.5, proceed with the rest of the steps. After validation, set the in-progress emergency group state of the group to "false" and clear the cache of the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user identified as having an outstanding MCPTT emergency group call.

q_1127.question: What does the USF field in the downlink RLC/MAC blocks indicate?
q_1127.ground_truth: The USF field in the downlink RLC/MAC blocks indicates the owner or use of the next uplink radio block on the same timeslot.

q_1128.question: What is the purpose of the UE identifying whether PO collisions can occur in Solution #19?
q_1128.ground_truth: The UE identifies whether PO collisions can occur to minimize the impact of page loss due to collisions.

q_1129.question: When is the release of an RLC entity on a downlink TBF initiated?
q_1129.ground_truth: The release of an RLC entity on a downlink TBF is initiated by sending an RLC data block with the Final Block Indicator (FBI) set to the value '1' and with a valid RRBP field, and starting timer T3191 for the RLC entity.

q_1130.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification (TS) in the document presented?
q_1130.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP TS in the document presented is to describe and define the measurements for FDD done at the UE and network in order to support operation in idle mode and connected mode.

q_1131.question: What are the supported update periods for an object manifest?
q_1131.ground_truth: The update period for an object manifest can be specified in a pull-based object acquisition method where the MBSTF polls for updates to the object manifest at this interval. In a push-based object acquisition method, any update period indicated in the object manifest is ignored, and object updates are provided as soon as they become available.

q_1132.question: In which mode is the FD-CNG noise levels used for estimating the noise spectrum in the CNA?
q_1132.ground_truth: DTX-on mode and provided that FD-CNG is triggered

q_1133.question: Which extension is used for 1.28Mcps TDD only and the HS-SICH ID IE is more than 31 in the RNSAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
q_1133.ground_truth: HS-SICH-ID-Extension with criticality ignore and the presence optional

q_1134.question: What is the security mechanism employed in the GAN for signaling and user-plane traffic over the Up interface?
q_1134.ground_truth: All signalling traffic and user-plane traffic sent between MS and GANC over the Up interface is protected by an IPsec tunnel between the MS and GANC-SEGW, that provides mutual authentication (using SIM credentials), encryption and data integrity using similar mechanisms as specified in 3GPP TS~33.234.

q_1135.question: What are the two optional features introduced for RedCap UEs in RRC idle/inactive states?
q_1135.ground_truth: The two optional features introduced for RedCap UEs in RRC idle/inactive states are Extended DRX cycles and RRM measurement relaxation for neighbor cells.

q_1136.question: What is the data type for the "radioFrequency" element in the schema?
q_1136.ground_truth: The data type for the "radioFrequency" element is "xs:unsignedInt".

q_1137.question: What AVP should be populated with the value received within the imsi parameter of PurgeMS-Arg while constructing a PUR command in step 8.4.3?
q_1137.ground_truth: The User-Name AVP should be populated with the value received within the imsi parameter of PurgeMS-Arg while constructing a PUR command in step 8.4.3.

q_1138.question: What is the content of the SI 14 Rest Octets information element?
q_1138.ground_truth: The SI 14 Rest Octets information element contains information about dynamic ARFCN mapping, and allows to allocate ARFCN values and dynamically map them to physical frequencies, see 3GPP~TS~45.005. It is a type 5 information element with 16 octet length.

q_1139.question: What are the two separate warning types in ETWS?
q_1139.ground_truth: The two separate warning types in ETWS are the ETWS Primary Notification and the ETWS Secondary Notification, with different delivery requirements.

q_1140.question: How is Graceful Degradation applied to MBMS services when entering bad reception conditions and traffic congestion in the 9th release?
q_1140.ground_truth: Graceful Degradation is applied to MBMS services by allowing differentiation transmission robustness for different parts of the video stream and by reducing bandwidth of the streams with graceful quality degradation using IVS, allowing service quality to be recovered as congestion state of the cell is relieved.

q_1141.question: What is the first message sent by the network during a mobile terminating call establishment?

q_1142.question: What action shall the eP-CSCF (IMS-ALG) take when it receives an SDP offer for new media streams that need to be transported within a WebRTC data channel on the WebRTC access network and media plane optimization is not to be applied?
q_1142.ground_truth: Determine if it can reuse an existing DTLS association and SCTP association or if it needs to set up a new DTLS association and SCTP association. If a new DTLS association and SCTP association are to be set up, request a new termination towards the WebRTC access network from the eIMS-AGW, request a deaggregation stream to handle the SCTP association and DTLS association, request the local UDP port and SCTP port from the eIMS-AGW, insert the local UDP port and SCTP port received from the eIMS-AGW into the SDP offer towards the WebRTC access network, and request the eIMS-AGW to provide its own local SCTP maximum message size. Additionally, indicate "UDP/DTLS/SCTP" as the transport protocol, include the Local certificate fingerprint Request information element, and insert the SCTP maximum message size received from the eIMS-AGW into the SDP offer towards the WebRTC access network.

q_1143.question: What actions are taken by the MT when it autonomously exits from SMS/CBS mode?
q_1143.ground_truth: When the MT autonomously exits from SMS/CBS mode, it shall issue the 'END SMS MODE' indication and revert to default mode, connecting any incoming data call through the TAF. The TE shall change back to default mode whether or not such a response is received. The MT may also indicate that it has exited from the SMS/CBS mode through the use of CT 107 and CT 109.

q_1144.question: What does MBSFN transmission enable in LTE?
q_1144.ground_truth: MBSFN transmission enables highly efficient MBMS in LTE, allowing for over-the-air combining of multi-cell transmissions in the UE, by utilizing the cyclic prefix to cover the difference in the propagation delays.

q_1145.question: When does the MO-SMC entity transition to the MO-Wait for CP-ACK state?
q_1145.ground_truth: The MO-SMC entity transitions to the MO-Wait for CP-ACK state after initiating the transfer of a CP-DATA message.

q_1146.question: How should a network handle repeated EARFCN values in the Repeated E-UTRAN Neighbour Cells IE that correspond to the same physical E-UTRAN frequency?
q_1146.ground_truth: A network should assign each repeated EARFCN an index in the E-UTRAN Neighbour Cell list, but only consider the EARFCN with the highest index in the list for measurement reports.

q_1147.question: What are the key components of a BTS energy consumption breakdown?
q_1147.ground_truth: The main components of a BTS energy consumption breakdown are BBU, REs, power supply, coaxial feed, and other related consumptions. The RE component usually contributes the most to the total BTS power consumption.

q_1148.question: What is the purpose of the UE Beamlock test function?
q_1148.ground_truth: The UE Beamlock test function is used to lock the antenna pattern of all active intra-band component carriers and all MIMO layers affected by the test function, in preparation for subsequent test procedures.

q_1149.question: What is the impact of activating the Originating Identification Presentation (OIP) for the FA Pilot Identity on incoming calls to the FA Pilot Identity?
q_1149.ground_truth: If the FA Pilot Identity has OIP activated, incoming calls to the FA Pilot Identity apply OIP to the members of the FA group.

q_1150.question: What is the purpose of the P-Charging-Vector header field that is added to a REGISTER request in the visited network?
q_1150.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header field is added to the REGISTER request to provide an ICID value and to identify the visited network for charging purposes.

q_1151.question: What information does the "RNC Trace Session Information" field provide?
q_1151.ground_truth: The "RNC Trace Session Information" field indicates the information on a Trace Session activated by Management in the RNC.

q_1152.question: How many bits are required for the initial state in a BC-TCVQ structure that allows N initial trellis states and exactly M terminal trellis states for each allowed initial trellis state?
q_1152.ground_truth: k bits are required for the initial state in a BC-TCVQ structure that allows N initial trellis states and exactly M terminal trellis states for each allowed initial trellis state.

q_1153.question: What is added to the physical layer procedures in TS 25.201 REL-7 to support HS-SCCH less operation?
q_1153.ground_truth: The list of physical layer procedures is updated to add HS-SCCH less operation and procedures related to discontinuous transmission and reception.

q_1154.question: What message is used to forward the packet page for PS services to the MS?

q_1155.question: What should a mobile station do if it receives an uplink assignment message that provides an uplink TBF allocation for a PFI not indicated in the request for uplink TBF sent by the mobile station?
q_1155.ground_truth: The mobile station should abort the procedure and perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_1156.question: What is the benefit of the Interactive Personal Broadcast Services to the operator in section 5.2.2?
q_1156.ground_truth: The Interactive Personal Broadcast Services offer the benefit of generating upstream data through service interaction, which improves operator revenue. It also offers a new revenue creating service through multi-party conversation using interactive PBS.

q_1157.question: What actions should the UE perform when the IE "HARQ Info for E-DCH" is included?
q_1157.ground_truth: The UE should perform the actions specified in subclause 8.6.5.17.

q_1158.question: What should the UE set the APMQF bit to in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it can perform access performance measurements using the QoS flow of the non-default QoS rule?
q_1158.ground_truth: The UE should set the APMQF bit to "Access performance measurements per QoS flow supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it can perform access performance measurements using the QoS flow of the non-default QoS rule.

q_1159.question: What information is included in an ADC rule for application detection and control?
q_1159.ground_truth: An ADC rule includes information to identify the rule, detect the start and stop of traffic for a certain application, apply enforcement actions and charging for the application traffic, and the application identifier that is used for matching service data flows.

q_1160.question: What bit is used for determining the position of a frame in a substream modulo 31 using the PN-sequence?
q_1160.ground_truth: The S4-bit is used for determining the position of a frame in a substream modulo 31 using the PN-sequence 0000 1001 0110 0111 1100 0110 1110 101.

q_1161.question: What is the purpose of the MDA process in the MDAS system?
q_1161.ground_truth: The MDA process is used to train the ML model, analyze management data, and provide analytics reports to the consumer for validation and feedback, which is used to optimize the ML model.

q_1162.question: What action does the SMS-SC take when it receives an Alert service centre message from the SMS-IWMSC, as part of the Alert service centre procedure to re-send a stored message?
q_1162.ground_truth: The SMS-SC re-attempts to send the stored Short Message to the IP-SM-GW and then to the UE.

q_1163.question: What is the typical data rate required for HD video feeds in newsgathering?
q_1163.ground_truth: For HD video feeds, 5-10 Mbit/s are needed as minimum.

q_1164.question: What are the two types of mobility that are taken into account when considering small cell enhancement for indoor and outdoor deployments?
q_1164.ground_truth: The two types of mobility are low UE speed (up to 3 km/h) for indoor and low to high UE speed (up to 30 km/h and potentially higher) for outdoor.

q_1165.question: What state should the UE enter if it is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and the current TAI is in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_1165.ground_truth: The UE should enter the state 5GMM-DEREGESTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and not attempt to perform registration if it re-selects a cell belonging to the TAI where it was rejected.

q_1166.question: What should the UE do if there is a resumption of the RRC connection triggered due to an RNA update and no ongoing emergency service RRC?
q_1166.ground_truth: The UE should select '8' as the Access Category and perform the unified access control procedure.

q_1167.question: Which network options is Solution #16 applicable to?
q_1167.ground_truth: Option 1 - eUTRA with EPC and Option 3 - EPC based Dual Connectivity of eUTRA and NR RAT

q_1168.question: What is the purpose of the correlation reinforcement with pitch lag multiples?
q_1168.ground_truth: The correlation reinforcement with pitch lag multiples is used to avoid selecting pitch multiples within each pitch delay range, and emphasize the weighted normalized correlation in a lower pitch delay section if one of its multiples is in the neighborhood of the pitch lag in a higher section.

q_1169.question: What is the shape of the adaptive window used for signal windowing in stereo signal low-band encoding?
q_1169.ground_truth: The shape of the adaptive window used for signal windowing is similar to that described in section 5.3.5.4.

q_1170.question: What is the difference between the V-to-H XPD and H-to-V XPD in the context of cross-polarized antennas?
q_1170.ground_truth: The V-to-H XPD and H-to-V XPD are the coupled power of waves that go from vertical to horizontal and horizontal to vertical, respectively. These draws are independent of each other.

q_1171.question: What is the parameter that the NodeB lowers when it estimates that the UE has no data to transmit in uplink?
q_1171.ground_truth: The SIR target is lowered by z dB in the power control loop to reduce interference.

q_1172.question: What is the name of the network element that manages the MBMS bearer service in the 3GPP Technical Specification?

q_1173.question: What is an SEI message related to decoder rendering metadata for omnidirectional media in the SDP?
q_1173.ground_truth: It is a SEI message that describes bitstream characteristics for omnidirectional media in the Session Description Protocol (SDP) using the 'sprop-sei' parameter, allowing a decoder to rely on the bitstream characteristics for the entire duration of the session.

q_1174.question: What is one of the options provided by Solution #17 for the AMF to determine the service area restriction?
q_1174.ground_truth: Solution #17 enables the AMF to use the service area list in the case when the registration area contains TAIs that are more than the TAIs of the area that is considered to correspond to the area of the disaster condition.

q_1175.question: What is the role of the floating-point ANSI-C code in the TS?
q_1175.ground_truth: The floating-point ANSI-C code is the only standard conforming non-bit-exact implementation for the Adaptive Multi-Rate speech transcoder, Voice Activity Detection, comfort noise generation, and source controlled rate operation. It also contains example solutions for substituting and muting of lost frames.

q_1176.question: What is the impact of increased straight-line distance on mortality for Red 1 calls?
q_1176.ground_truth: Increased straight-line distance correlates with increased risk of death; e.g., a 1% absolute increase in mortality is associated with each 10 km increase in straight-line distance, especially for Red 1 calls, which cover cardiac arrests and patients who are not breathing anymore.

q_1177.question: When would the speech insertion procedure described in clause~6.3 be applied in the context of call forwarding services?
q_1177.ground_truth: The speech insertion procedure is applied to apply the confirmation tone to the originating party in case of call forwarding services.

q_1178.question: When is a ciphering activation time in downlink considered pending?
q_1178.ground_truth: A ciphering activation time in downlink is considered pending until the RLC sequence number of the next RLC PDU to be transmitted for the first time is equal to or larger than the selected activation time.

q_1179.question: How does the UE determine the sorting quantity when the report type is set to eventTriggered?
q_1179.ground_truth: When the report type is set to eventTriggered, the UE considers the trigger quantity as the sorting quantity if available. If not, it uses RSRP, RSRQ, or SINR as the sorting quantity, in that order.

q_1180.question: What additional information is included in the AF report to the NWDAF?
q_1180.ground_truth: In addition to the performance data, the AF report to the NWDAF includes the UE IP address, the address/ID of the edge application server instance hosting the application, a timestamp denoting when the performance was measured, and an identifier for the application. The report may be sent to the NWDAF via the NEF.

q_1181.question: What is the significance of the radix in the test data provided for the 3GPP authentication and key generation functions?
q_1181.ground_truth: The radix refers to the base of the number system used in the test data, which is hexadecimal in this case. It is specified to ensure accurate interpretation and implementation of the test data.

q_1182.question: What must the R-GMLC do if the V-GMLC address is different from its own?
q_1182.ground_truth: The R-GMLC sends the location request to the V-GMLC if the V-GMLC address is different from its own.

q_1183.question: What is the expected result for the SEND SHORT MESSAGE command in Expected Sequence 3.1 and 3.2?
q_1183.ground_truth: In Expected Sequence 3.1, the expected result is "Command performed successfully" and in Expected Sequence 3.2, the expected result is "Command performed successfully, but requested icon could not be displayed".

q_1184.question: What is the function of the association between the number of resource element groups not assigned to PCFICH and the time-domain index in the mapping to resource elements process?
q_1184.ground_truth: The association between the number of resource element groups not assigned to PCFICH and the time-domain index in the mapping to resource elements process defines the specific mapping of the PHICH resource elements to the appropriate time-domain slots.

q_1185.question: When should a receiving node report a missing IE/IE group with specified criticality "Reject IE" or "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" using the Error Indication procedure?
q_1185.ground_truth: The receiving node should report a missing IE/IE group with specified criticality "Reject IE" or "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" using the Error Indication procedure when the information received in the initiating message was insufficient to determine a value for all IEs that are required to be present in the response message.

q_1186.question: What are the two modes of signalling message transfer provided by the radio bearers?
q_1186.ground_truth: The two modes of signalling message transfer provided by the radio bearers are through an unacknowledged mode RLC entity and through an acknowledged mode RLC entity.

q_1187.question: What is the term used to describe the results averaged across all noise types for WB mode?
q_1187.ground_truth: Each combination of device and room represents one dot in these scatter plots.

q_1188.question: What is the recommended option for aggregate report format between the two options mentioned, to avoid the report server having to look into the header portion of each component XML file to determine the composition of the aggregated report?
q_1188.ground_truth: Option 1 is recommended as the aggregate report format since it avoids the report server having to look into the header portion of each component XML file to determine the composition of the aggregated report.

q_1189.question: What triggers the AMF to assign a Registration Area List to the UE with associated validity times in the Registration Accept?
q_1189.ground_truth: The indication received from the RAN informing the AMF of satellite access.

q_1190.question: When is the Send N-PDU Number used?
q_1190.ground_truth: When acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation is used for the PDP context

q_1191.question: What is the purpose of the enhanced bandwidth negotiation mechanism in Hanism as defined in 3GPP-TS-26.114?
q_1191.ground_truth: The enhanced bandwidth negotiation mechanism in Hanism is used to negotiate additional bandwidth properties end-to-end based on the "a=bw-info" SDP attribute.

q_1192.question: What should be included in the SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT emergency call, unless the procedures of clause~6.6.3.1.5 were performed?
q_1192.ground_truth: The SIP 200 (OK) response should include an SDP answer, the Session-Expires header field with a recommendation, the "timer" option tag in a Require header field, and the required information in a Contact header field.

q_1193.question: Which frame rates are valid for a Bitstream conforming to the H.265/HEVC Full HD HDR HLG Operation Point?
q_1193.ground_truth: A Bitstream conforming to the H.265/HEVC Full HD HDR HLG Operation Point shall have one of the following frame rates: 24; 25; 30; 50; 60; 24/1.001; 30/1.001; 60/1.001 Hz.

q_1194.question: What self-optimization features does LTE-Advanced use to ensure good mobility performance across the cellular network?
q_1194.ground_truth: LTE-Advanced uses self-optimization features such as coverage and capacity optimization, mobility robustness optimization, mobility load balancing, and RACH optimization. These features are used to reduce radio link failures, balance the trade-off between coverage and capacity, and minimize access delays.

q_1195.question: What is the requirement for the activation of UUS3?
q_1195.ground_truth: UUS3 can only be activated explicitly, either when originating a call or after the connection has been established, and automatically deactivates when the call is released. The SS Version Indicator value 3 or above has to be used for UUS3 activation.

q_1196.question: What is the purpose of the default midamble allocation by layer 1 in the 3.84 Mcps TDD?
q_1196.ground_truth: The default midamble allocation by layer 1 is used to assign associations between midambles and channelisation codes, as given in Annex AA.2.

q_1197.question: What should the IWF do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request with an imminent peril indication and if the group's in-progress imminent peril state is true and the MCPTT user is indicating a new imminent peril indication?
q_1197.ground_truth: The IWF should generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the MCPTT user's imminent peril indication to each of the other affiliated members of the group.

q_1198.question: What action does the VLR take when it receives a CCBS Recall signal and the response to the CCBS Recall is received?
q_1198.ground_truth: The VLR shall subsequently send a CCBS Call Report when the relevant processing for the outgoing CCBS call to the destination network is completed.

q_1199.question: What should the SAS do if it receives an Abort message while in the RNC centric mode?
q_1199.ground_truth: The SAS should cease positioning attempts and return a POSITION CALCULATION RESPONSE message to the SRNC carrying any location estimate already obtained or a POSITION CALCULATION FAILURE message if no location estimate was obtained. After sending an Abort message, the SRNC should cease positioning activity, if any.

q_1200.question: Which clause in TS 31.111 does the SEND SHORT MESSAGE facility refer to?
q_1200.ground_truth: The SEND SHORT MESSAGE facility refers to clauses 6.1, 6.4.10, 6.6.9, 8.1, 8.2, 8.6, 8.7, 8.13, 8.31, 8.67, and 5.2 in TS 31.111.

q_1201.question: What should a client do if the new content stream consists of more media components than the ongoing content stream?
q_1201.ground_truth: The client is recommended to switch to the new content with the already established resources and add further components afterwards using the "3gpp-pipelined" feature if supported.

q_1202.question: What is the primary OTDOA measurement used to calculate an estimate of the position and optionally the velocity of the UE in 3G UMTS network?
q_1202.ground_truth: The primary OTDOA measurement used to calculate an estimate of the position and optionally the velocity of the UE in 3G UMTS network is the "SFN-SFN observed time difference" observed at the UE.

q_1203.question: How do PLMN-1 and PLMN-2 handle paging notifications when they are the same PLMN?
q_1203.ground_truth: If PLMN-1 and PLMN-2 are the same PLMN, there is no difference in behavior as the handle identifies a specific UE-PLMN pair rather than just a PLMN. The notifications and security associations will still function as expected.

q_1204.question: What is the purpose of the key set identifier (KSI) in 3GPP authentication and key agreement functions?
q_1204.ground_truth: The key set identifier (KSI) is used to identify the cipher key CK and integrity key IK stored in the mobile station, allowing for re-use in subsequent connection set-ups.

q_1205.question: What information is needed to instantiate the EAS VNF?
q_1205.ground_truth: The EAS VNF information includes the software image information and the requirements for virtual compute resources.

q_1206.question: What is the procedure called to obtain the current cell information of the MC service UE?
q_1206.ground_truth: The procedure is called "get cell info" and it involves the MC application querying the cell information from the MC MBMS user agent, which then responds with the cell information of the UE's current location.

q_1207.question: What should the RNC do if SIPTO at Iu-PS functionality is supported by the UTRAN, and the MSISDN IE is present in the RAB ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message?
q_1207.ground_truth: The UTRAN may offload the RABs where the Offload RAB Parameters IE is present in the RABs To Be Setup Or Modified Item IEs IE. The Access Point Name IE and the Charging Characteristics IE within the Offload RAB Parameters IE and the MSISDN IE may only be used for the SIPTO at Iu-PS function.

q_1208.question: What action should the BSS take if it receives unknown fields within a known Access Technology Type in the MS Radio Access Capability field?
q_1208.ground_truth: The BSS should ignore the unknown fields when it receives unknown fields within a known Access Technology Type in the MS Radio Access Capability field.

q_1209.question: What specification defines the AKMA TLS protocol profiles for providing secure TLS connections between the UE and an Application Function (AF) in the 5G system?

q_1210.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "should" in a 3GPP TS?
q_1210.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "should" indicates a recommendation to do something.

q_1211.question: Which interface is defined as the interface between 2G-SGSN and BSS?

q_1212.question: What does the UE do when the Direct Communication Request is received and reporting criteria are met in ProSe Unicast Direct Communication over PC5?
q_1212.ground_truth: The UE sends the usage information report to the CTF(ADF) after successful completion of the authentication procedure.

q_1213.question: In the 6.4.2.2 test procedure, what operation is done on the returned bytes from CatGetTimer()?
q_1213.ground_truth: The returned bytes from CatGetTimer() are typecasted to (BYTE) and used to free a timer in CatFreeTimer().

q_1214.question: What is the purpose of Iupc mapping of PCAP transaction IDs in the SAS-HNB signalling connectivity?
q_1214.ground_truth: The purpose of Iupc mapping of PCAP transaction IDs is to provide the SAS with a consistent view aligned with the HNB-GW, acting as one RNC.

q_1215.question: Where are the technical provisions of the 3GPP technical specification document contained?
q_1215.ground_truth: The technical provisions of the 3GPP technical specification document are contained in the 3GPP Task Force Specification document.

q_1216.question: What steps occur over PC5 in ProSe Direct Communication for Model A?
q_1216.ground_truth: Steps 11 to 16 in ProSe Direct Communication for Model A occur over PC5.

q_1217.question: What is the structure of the MSK verification message in MIKEY?
q_1217.ground_truth: The MSK verification message in MIKEY consists of the fields HDR || TS || IDr || V, where HDR is the header, TS is the timestamp, IDr is the ID of the UE, and V is the V field from the MIKEY common header.

q_1218.question: What is the purpose of the U1-AE reference point in the UAS application layer architecture?
q_1218.ground_truth: The U1-AE reference point supports the UAS application related interactions between UAS UE and UAS AS.

q_1219.question: What is the role of a floor chair in the context of floor controlled media types?
q_1219.ground_truth: A floor chair is responsible for granting, revoking, and adjusting floors of a media type or combination of media types for a set of participants.

q_1220.question: What is the size of the Cipher Mode Command message for GSM/GPRS network, and how many public keys can it carry at maximum?
q_1220.ground_truth: The size of the Cipher Mode Command message for GSM/GPRS network is 3 bytes, and it can carry 2304 bytes of public keys, which means it can carry 2*3*384=2304 public keys.

q_1221.question: How does a mobile station that has enabled PEO where eDRX is used support reachability while in packet idle mode?
q_1221.ground_truth: A mobile station that has enabled PEO where eDRX is used supports reachability while in packet idle mode by using the lowest eDRX cycle while the Ready timer is running and re-entering the eDRX based power saving state for the time remaining until its next paging occasion upon expiration of the Ready timer or waking up and determining it has not been paged using its nominal paging group.

q_1222.question: What should the IWU do if it receives an initial SIP INVITE request with the UPDATE method in the ALLOW header from the external SIP-I network?
q_1222.ground_truth: The IWU shall advertise its support for the UPDATE method to the succeeding 3GPP node by listing the UPDATE method in the ALLOW header field.

q_1223.question: What should the UE do upon receiving ue-TimersAndConstants in SIB1 for a target cell group?
q_1223.ground_truth: The UE should use the values for timers T311 and constants N310, N311 for the target cell group, as included in ue-TimersAndConstants received in SIB1.

q_1224.question: When do the two trains switch their connection from the 3GPP network to the PC5 interface?
q_1224.ground_truth: When the following train further approaches the leading train and requires a connection with a very short end-to-end latency for delicate train control.

q_1225.question: What is the procedure when the UE sends an UL NAS TRANSPORT message to the AMF for an MBS service?
q_1225.ground_truth: The AMF checks whether it has an MBS session context for the MBS service requested by the UE, and selects the SMF serving the requested MBS session if exists, or an MBS-capable SMF if it has no MBS session context.

q_1226.question: How can the PCRF activate or deactivate a PCC rule predefined at the PCEF?
q_1226.ground_truth: The PCRF can activate or deactivate a PCC rule predefined at the PCEF by provisioning a reference to this PCC rule within a Charging-Rule-Name AVP and indicating the required action by choosing either the Charging-Rule-Install AVP or the Charging-Rule-Remove AVP.

q_1227.question: What is the minimum uplink rate for the combination described in 7.4.8.1?

q_1228.question: How does the network set a priority for PLMNs in the disaster roaming scenario?
q_1228.ground_truth: The disaster roaming assistance information can consist of a prioritized list of PLMNs, a weighted list of PLMNs, or an indication of the capacity of PLMNs without Disaster to accept Disaster Inbound Roamers.

q_1229.question: What is the purpose of measuring the frequency responses in the silence condition?
q_1229.ground_truth: The purpose of measuring the frequency responses in the silence condition is to describe the differences between the devices by single values.

q_1230.question: What command type was used in the REFRESH 1.3.1B response?

q_1231.question: What is the difference between the spectral filling for transient mode and normal HQ mode?
q_1231.ground_truth: The spectral filling in transient mode does not include bandwidth extension, while in normal HQ mode it does.

q_1232.question: In the case of an abnormal situation between application entities in the TC environment, what procedure is used to report the rejection of a TC component by the TC-user?
q_1232.ground_truth: The TC-user uses the TC-U-REJECT request primitive to report the rejection of a TC component, indicating an abnormal situation in the communication between two application entities.

q_1233.question: How are RSRP and RSRQ measured in relation to actual user plane transmissions?
q_1233.ground_truth: RSRP and RSRQ are measured separately from actual user plane transmissions.

q_1234.question: When can the dialogue be terminated by TC-END request primitive with basic end?
q_1234.ground_truth: The dialogue can be terminated by TC-END request primitive with basic end in case of ending from the gsmSCF when the gsmSSF has sent the last EventReportBCSM, ApplyChargingReport or CallInformationReport.

q_1235.question: What is Key Issue #5 about in the context of Short Message Service?
q_1235.ground_truth: Key Issue #5 is about studying protocol selection mechanisms in the SMSF, SMS-GMSC, and UDM/HSS/HLR for the right protocol selection for Short Message Service.

q_1236.question: When the IMS-ALG determines that end-to-access edge security is applicable for RTP based media, what transport protocol will it indicate in the corresponding SDP media lines?
q_1236.ground_truth: When e2ae security is applicable, the IMS-ALG will indicate "RTP/SAVP" or "RTP/SAVPF" in the corresponding SDP media lines.

q_1237.question: What should 5GMM do if it receives a request to modify an existing PDU session and barring is still in effect for the associated access category?
q_1237.ground_truth: 5GMM shall not initiate the NAS transport procedure to send the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

q_1238.question: What happens if the value of the "granularityPeriod" attribute is set to 0?
q_1238.ground_truth: If the value of the "granularityPeriod" attribute is set to 0, it is not required to periodically generate results, and only the current measurement results can be requested from the "simpleScanner" instance.

q_1239.question: What is the purpose of the IMS NRM IRP: IS in 3GPP TS 28.704?
q_1239.ground_truth: The IMS NRM IRP: IS in 3GPP TS 28.704 specifies the requirements for the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP), including the definition of a protocol neutral Information Service (IS).

q_1240.question: When should the first attempt be made by the MS in the fast first higher priority PLMN search?
q_1240.ground_truth: The first attempt by the MS should be made after a period of at least 2 minutes and at most T minutes, either after switch on if the fast first higher priority PLMN search is disabled, or after switch on or upon selecting a VPLMN if the fast first higher priority PLMN search is enabled.

q_1241.question: What is the length of the RL-InformationIE-RL-ReconfPrepTDD sequence?
q_1241.ground_truth: The RL-InformationIE-RL-ReconfPrepTDD sequence contains a fixed length sequence, with the size of "SIZE (1..maxNrOfRLs)".

q_1242.question: What is the state of the UE in the initial conditions of the test execution?
q_1242.ground_truth: The UE is in state Registered, Inactive mode (state 2N-A) on NR Cell 1.

q_1243.question: What is the purpose of the Delay Value field in the BVC Measurement information element?
q_1243.ground_truth: The Delay Value field describes average queuing delay for a BVC in the network, in units of centi-seconds.

q_1244.question: What are the maximum luma samples, picture size, and frames per second for HEVC-FullHD-Enc as defined in 3GPP services?
q_1244.ground_truth: The HEVC-FullHD-Enc is capable of encoding a video signal with up to 133,693,440 luma samples per second, up to a luma picture size of 2,228,224 samples, and up to 240 frames per second, with chroma format 4:2:0 and bit depth of 8 or 10 bit.

q_1245.question: What is the purpose of the Communication Surveillance Integration Reference Point (CSIRP) in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_1245.ground_truth: The CSIRP is defined as a capability to ensure the availability and reliability of the communication between the managing system (manager) and the managed system (agent) by automatically surveying their communication. It is part of the 3GPP's technical specifications for telecommunication management in 3G systems.

q_1246.question: What action does the MSC-1 server take after receiving the Handover Required message from the serving BSS?
q_1246.ground_truth: The MSC-1 server requests the MGW to provide a binding reference and a bearer address using the Prepare Bearer procedure and uses the Change Flow Direction procedure to set the Handover Device to the initial state.

q_1247.question: What is the difference between DNS-SD and DNS SRV?
q_1247.ground_truth: DNS-SD (DNS-based Service Discovery) and DNS SRV are both methods of service discovery using DNS infrastructures, but DNS-SD is more flexible and includes the ability to discover services through multicast DNS (mDNS) and unicast DNS (uDNS), while DNS SRV is more limited and only works through unicast DNS.

q_1248.question: What are the symbols used in the present document?
q_1248.ground_truth: Bi: Reference point for the CDR file transfer from the IMS CGF to the BD, Ga: Reference point for CDR transfer between a CDF and CGF, Rf: Offline Charging Reference Point between an IMS Network Entity or an AS and CDF, Ro: Online Charging Reference Point between an AS or MRFC and IMS-GWF and the OCS, Nchf: Service based interface exhibited by CHF.

q_1249.question: What should a CDP do if the UE does not indicate support for the MIME type associated with Tariff Information in the Accept header?
q_1249.ground_truth: The CDP should assume that the UE supports version 1.0 of the MIME type associated with Tariff Information if it is not indicated in the Accept header.

q_1250.question: What is the triggering condition for event 3b in inter-RAT measurements?
q_1250.ground_truth: The triggering condition for event 3b is that the estimated downlink signal quality of the other RAT is above a certain threshold.

q_1251.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Mobile IPv6 Option?
q_1251.ground_truth: The 3GPP Mobile IPv6 Option is used to encode 3GPP Specific Information Elements within the protocols based on Mobile IPv6 (MIPv6).

q_1252.question: What indicates what charging method shall be used for every PCC rule where the charging method is omitted?
q_1252.ground_truth: The default charging method indicates what charging method shall be used for every PCC rule where the charging method is omitted.

q_1253.question: What are some information elements for peer-to-peer communication?
q_1253.ground_truth: Some information elements for peer-to-peer communication include protocol data units, general information, MAC PDU (not HS-DSCH or E-DCH), MAC-d PDU (HS-DSCH), and MAC PDU (HS-DSCH).

q_1254.question: What status code is used by the PFDF to indicate "too short allowed delay" when the provisioning is rejected?
q_1254.ground_truth: If the provisioning is rejected due to "too short allowed delay", the PFDF shall indicate the reason using an HTTP status code 412 Precondition Failed.

q_1255.question: What is the purpose of the Require header field in the message sent by the UE-A?
q_1255.ground_truth: The Require header field in the message sent by the UE-A contains the option-tag "100rel" and "precondition" which indicates reliable sending of the 183 (Session Progress) response and usage of the precondition mechanism.

q_1256.question: What information is required by NWDAF to reallocate traffic from some UPF instances to other UPF instances?
q_1256.ground_truth: NWDAF requires information on how UEs are characterized as low or high priority, where to get information on UE priority, whether UE priority is relative to within a given network slice or across network slices, if UE priority or time of day is the main criteria for reallocating traffic, knowledge of the network slices associated with UPF instances, knowledge of which UPF instances can receive traffic from other UPF instances, and information about isolation requirements and server locations.

q_1257.question: What QoS parameters should be set up for the Sync frame delivery when limiting bridge residence time to 10 ms, as specified in step 3?
q_1257.ground_truth: PDB1, which is the UL PDB for the QoS flow of PDU session for UE1, should be less than 10ms

q_1258.question: What is the purpose of the S-CCPCH-InformationListExt-AuditRsp field?
q_1258.ground_truth: The S-CCPCH-InformationListExt-AuditRsp field contains information about the status and availability of an S-CCPCH resource on a LTE network.

q_1259.question: What message does the network send to initiate the handover to CDMA2000 procedure?
q_1259.ground_truth: The network sends an INTER SYSTEM TO CDMA2000 HANDOVER COMMAND message to the mobile station on the main DCCH.

q_1260.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_1260.ground_truth: The version numbering system used in the 3GPP Technical Specification indicates the level of approval and revision of the document. A version number of x.y.z indicates that the document is presented to TSG for information (x=0), contains technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc. (y=incremented), or contains only editorial changes (z=incremented).

q_1261.question: What does the acronym "3GPP" stand for in the context of the document?

q_1262.question: What is the set of general parameters required to describe the mapping of any logical channel onto one or more physical channel(s)?
q_1262.ground_truth: The set of general parameters required to describe the mapping of any logical channel onto one or more physical channel(s) includes: i) the set of radio frequency channels used in the cell together with the identification of the BCCH carrier and ii) the TDMA frame number (FN), which can be derived from the reduced TDMA frame number (RFN).

q_1263.question: What action does the IM-MGW take, after receiving the appropriate remote codec(s), remote UDP port and IP address from the MGCF during the IM CN subsystem side termination reservation process?
q_1263.ground_truth: The IM-MGW replies to the MGCF with the selected local codec(s) and the selected remote codec(s) and the selected local UDP port and IP address, and reserves resources for those codecs.

q_1264.question: What is the 3GPP and what is its role in the development of the X2 interface for E-UTRAN?
q_1264.ground_truth: The 3GPP is a partnership between several telecommunications standardization bodies, including organizations from several countries. They produce technical specifications, such as those defining the X2 interface for E-UTRAN, which allow for the interconnection and interoperability of different network components.

q_1265.question: What is the first step in the joining sequence for UEs in idle mode in a UMTS network?
q_1265.ground_truth: UEs in idle mode first perform RRC connection establishment.

q_1266.question: What is the Code for the CAG human-readable network name broadcasted in the network parameters for Cell 1 in sequence 1.30?
q_1266.ground_truth: There is no CAG human-readable network name broadcasted for Cell 1 in sequence 1.30.

q_1267.question: In the "Connect" PUA-PDU-Contents, what is the name of the first optional field?

q_1268.question: What is the minimum output power required for a Relay backhaul link with multiple transmit antenna connectors?
q_1268.ground_truth: For a relay backhaul link with multiple transmit antenna connectors, the minimum output power level is defined with respect to the sum of the mean power at each relay node backhaul antenna connector in one sub-frame (1 ms). The sum of these mean powers will be subject to the -50 dBm minimum output power requirement.

q_1269.question: What is the difference between the "Required" and "Supported" header fields in RTSP?
q_1269.ground_truth: The "Supported" header field is used to enumerate all the extensions supported by the sender, while the "Required" header field is used to ensure that a certain feature is supported by the recipient, causing the request to fail if the required feature is not supported.

q_1270.question: What information should be included in the jitter analysis report provided by the MDAS producer?
q_1270.ground_truth: The jitter analysis report should contain details such as the identifier of the jitter issue, type, start and end times, location, root cause, affected objects, severity level, jitter values, and recommended actions to solve the issue.

q_1271.question: What is the role of the Relay Entity within the L2R?
q_1271.ground_truth: The Relay Entity within the L2R provides the mapping between the NTP Entity and the L2R Entity. It may also contain the data compression function and negotiate parameters with the remote Relay Entity.

q_1272.question: What happens when the ProSe Application Server receives a PXR command for discover authorization update for restricted ProSe direct discovery and the Result-Code AVP indicates SUCCESS?
q_1272.ground_truth: The ProSe Application Server waits for the result of this discovery authorization update.

q_1273.question: What is the 3GPP technical specification group that deals with the technical aspects and services of 3GPP systems related to eCall?
q_1273.ground_truth: Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects

q_1274.question: What is the MPQUIC-LL composed of and what functions does it provide?
q_1274.ground_truth: The MPQUIC-LL is composed of the MPQUIC Tunnel Client (MQTC) and MPQUIC Tunnel Server (MQTS). The MQTC operates in the UE as a MPQUIC client application and provides the functionality of establishing N MPQUIC connections with the MQTS in the UPF.

q_1275.question: How is a transmission in the MBMS Streaming Delivery Method initiated?
q_1275.ground_truth: Mobile terminals retrieve transmission details like Multicast IP Address, TMGI and the used ports before the MBMS UEs can activate the reception. Upon interaction of the user and when all parameters are known, the UE "tunes in" the transmission and stays until the user decides to leave the transmission, which can happen before the transmission ends.

q_1276.question: What is the procedure for terminating EGPRS Switched Radio Block Loopback Mode?
q_1276.ground_truth: The SS orders the MS to terminate EGPRS Switched Radio Block Loopback Mode by transmitting a Packet TBF release, releasing the uplink and downlink TBFs, or if timer T3190 expires EGPRS Switched Radio Block Loopback Mode shall also be terminated.

q_1277.question: What action should the BBERF take if the resources associated to a QoS rule are successfully allocated?
q_1277.ground_truth: The BBERF should inform the PCRF about the successful resource allocation.

q_1278.question: What is the main purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group in the "MBMS Extensions for Provisioning and Content Ingestion" document?
q_1278.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group is responsible for identifying key functionality of an interface from external application service/content providers to the BM-SC for provisioning and content ingestion in order to leverage all delivery methods and procedures through the interface.

q_1279.question: What is the role of the MBSF in the MBS service?
q_1279.ground_truth: The MBSF generates and manages MBS service context and requests an MB session setup from the MB-SMF. It also controls the MBSU for user plane management, which is the media anchor of MBS traffic in 5GS.

q_1280.question: What is a UE not required to do if it operates an IDLE eDRX cycle longer than the modification period and the systemInfoModification-eDRX bit of a Short Message is set?
q_1280.ground_truth: Apply the SI acquisition procedure as defined in clause 5.2.2.3 from the start of the next eDRX acquisition period boundary.

q_1281.question: What action does the MFAF take after verifying the access token provided by NF Service Producer and receiving data from NF Service Producer?
q_1281.ground_truth: The MFAF then forwards the provided data to the NF Service Consumer as a notification in step 3.

q_1282.question: What is the initiating message for the "commonMeasurementInitiation" RNSAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_1283.question: What should the IWF do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with an <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true" and is an authorized request to initiate an MCPTT emergency group call?
q_1283.ground_truth: The IWF should cache the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user that has initiated an MCPTT emergency call.

q_1284.question: What is the format of the Name leaf in the IMS conferencing management object?
q_1284.ground_truth: The Name leaf is a character string used as a name for the conferencing settings.

q_1285.question: What is the standard Schmidt-Normalized Ambisonics (FOA) signal format referred to as?
q_1285.ground_truth: This format is also known as AmbiX format.

q_1286.question: What should the UE do if the maximum number of retransmissions for an AM SL DRB is reached in the sidelink connection with the peer UE?
q_1286.ground_truth: The UE should release the PC5-RRC connection, indicate the release to the upper layer, and send a SidelinkUEInformationNR message to indicate SL RLF (Sidelink Radio Link Failure).

q_1287.question: What are the issues raised by network slicing scenarios where one or more network slice constituents are provided by a second operator?
q_1287.ground_truth: The issues include terminology, modelling, APIs, abstraction level, and security.

q_1288.question: What is the effect of invoking Priority Service if a radio channel is not available and the queue for the cell is full, and the user's priority is higher than one or more Priority Service calls already in the queue?
q_1288.ground_truth: The lowest, most recent call in the queue is dropped from the queue, and the user's call is placed in the queue in accordance with the user's priority level and call initiation time.

q_1289.question: What are the maximum frame rates for the PD Media Profile in the DECE specification on Common File Format & Media Formats?
q_1289.ground_truth: The maximum frame rate for the PD Media Profile is 30 Hz, and it supports 23.97, 24, 29.97, and 30 Hz for 24 and 30 Hz contents, and 25 Hz for 25 Hz contents.

q_1290.question: What is the format of the Cause enumerated type?
q_1290.ground_truth: Cause is a CHOICE enumerated type, with options for Radio Network, Transport, Protocol, and Miscellaneous causes.

q_1291.question: What is the minimum coupling loss in dB for Local Area Base Stations?
q_1291.ground_truth: The minimum coupling loss for Local Area Base Stations is 45 dB.

q_1292.question: What are the two MBMS traffic delivery methods possible from the 5G Core Network's point of view?
q_1292.ground_truth: The two MBMS traffic delivery methods possible from the 5G Core Network's point of view are the 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery method and the 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery method.

q_1293.question: What is the requirement for CR1 in step 2 to be verified?
q_1293.ground_truth: The requirement for CR1 in step 2 to be verified is that the UE sends a RRC CONNECTION REQUEST-NB to the BCCH transmitting MCC/MNC 244/083 to the NB-SS.

q_1294.question: What is the purpose of using long-term or permanent identifiers to intercept communications?
