q_2067.ground_truth: Only the emergency proving period and status indications should be used by the BSS for both E1 and T1 links in Level 2.

q_2068.question: What is the method used to ensure mono compliance in the encoder's bandwidth extension operation?
q_2068.ground_truth: Mono compliance is ensured by using a modified instance of the reference encoder that operates only in TCX modes and prohibits ACELP mode usage, and by comparing the trace of TCX mode selection between the reference and test encoder outputs.

q_2069.question: What is the function of the MGCF in the signalling network?
q_2069.ground_truth: The MGCF provides the interaction between the SS7 MTP3-User part information, such as ISUP, and SIP through its interworking function, and also provides the translation between SS7 MTP3-User part information and SIP.

q_2070.question: What is the action taken by a mobile station when it receives an uplink assignment message for one or more ongoing TBFs in EC operation?
q_2070.ground_truth: The mobile station shall release the downlink TBF at the establishment of the uplink TBF and stop timer T3192, if running.

q_2071.question: What is the unit of time granularity for adjusting the time period of CQI (Channel Quality Measurements) reporting in E-UTRAN scheduling?
q_2071.ground_truth: The time granularity for adjusting the time period of CQI reporting in E-UTRAN scheduling is sub-frame units (periodic or triggered).

q_2072.question: What is one of the general requirements related to MM creation in MMS?
q_2072.ground_truth: The MMS should be able to support a request for MM creation by the user or an application.

q_2073.question: For FR2, Dense urban, DL, for VR/AR, with single stream traffic model, DDDSU TDD format, with SU-MIMO, 30Mbps, 10ms PDB, and network/outer coding (100% redundancy), 2CC (30&39GHz) CA, periodic blocking (4/10ms) on 30GHz CC with blocking probability 1 and channel strength attenuation of 30dB due to blocking, what was the capacity performance compared to the case without network/outer coding?
q_2073.ground_truth: The capacity performance was 5 UE per cell.

q_2074.question: What are the business-level requirements for the 3GPP management system in network policy management?
q_2074.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system should be able to support the capability for network policy management, including creating, deleting, updating, querying, activating, and deactivating network policies.

q_2075.question: In what situations is the user plane established to deliver buffered DL data?
q_2075.ground_truth: The user plane is established in two situations: during user plane setup to the RAN and during RAU procedures with SGSN change.

q_2076.question: In the context of successive short message transfers, what is the recommended practice for Transaction Identifiers when using different RR or signalling connections?
q_2076.ground_truth: For old and new MM connections, the SM is recommended to use different Transaction Identifiers to avoid confusion and ensure the proper processing of the short message transfers.

q_2077.question: How many slots before the start of the HS-DPCCH slot containing the first CQI report in Tmeasure is the measurement equipment allowed to start ramping Ior/Ioc, as specified in 9.3.2 and 9.3.3.3.1?
q_2077.ground_truth: The measurement equipment is allowed to start the ramping of Ior/Ioc 13 slots before the start of the HS-DPCCH slot that contains the first CQI report in Tmeasure.

q_2078.question: What is the difference between Alternative 1 and Alternative 2 in the IM NRM for network resource modeling?
q_2078.ground_truth: Alternative 1 in the IM NRM is used for NE structure and hardware inventory, while Alternative 2 is an extended version that includes inventory information modeling for NE structure, hardware, software, and license data.

q_2079.question: When should a UE stop the Tsor-cm timer?
q_2079.ground_truth: The Tsor-cm timer shall be stopped when the associated PDU session is released or the associated service is stopped.

q_2080.question: In the context of cell selection, what is the requirement for UEs assigned to Access Identity 11 or 15 operating in their HPLMN/EHPLMN when the cell status is indicated as "not barred" and "reserved" for operator use for any PLMN and not "true" for other use?
q_2080.ground_truth: The UE shall treat this cell as a candidate during the cell selection and reselection procedures if the field cellReservedForOperatorUse for that PLMN is set to "reserved".

q_2081.question: Where are the credentials for EAP-AKA based hosting party authentication stored?
q_2081.ground_truth: An AKA credential is stored in HPM in H(e)NB, and in the MNO HLR/HSS to use EAP-AKA for hosting party authentication.

q_2082.question: What should the UE do if the resumption of the RRC connection is triggered by upper layers and an Access Category and one or more Access Identities are provided?
q_2082.ground_truth: The UE should perform the unified access control procedure as specified in 5.3.14 using the Access Category and Access Identities provided by upper layers.

q_2083.question: What should the UE do when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause value #10 from the AMF during a mobility and periodic registration procedure on an NGC cell?
q_2083.ground_truth: The UE should delete any mapped 5G security context or partial native 5G security context, enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE, and initiate a new registration procedure for initial registration.

q_2084.question: What is the push notification solution in the 5GS/EPS system for MT service and enabling paging reception?
q_2084.ground_truth: The push notification solution in the 5GS/EPS system for MT service and enabling paging reception applies to single Rx Multi-USIM devices only. It relies on a push notification that is delivered via the Internet, and the UE registers for paging events at Paging Server A via the Internet for MT service.

q_2085.question: What is the Mobile Country Code (MCC) and Mobile Network Code (MNC) for the NG-RAN system simulator?

q_2086.question: What is the advantage of using a regular array of rectangular or hexagonal based grid points for fixed TAs?
q_2086.ground_truth: Using a regular array of rectangular or hexagonal based grid points for fixed TAs can help manage access to moving NGSO satellites from the 5GCN, but is excluded from the Virtual Cells Approach with Reduced Impacts due to the potential for significant 5GCN impact.

q_2087.question: What is an IRPManager in the context of AAM?
q_2087.ground_truth: In the context of AAM, an IRPManager is a management system's client that utilizes the AAM Information Service (IS) to categorize alarm notifications.

q_2088.question: Which records are added to the Record-Route header field by the IBCF-hA1 and the IC-A1?
q_2088.ground_truth: The IBCF-hA1 adds the records-route with the home-A.net and IC network (Type 1 home) and the ICa.1 interconnection network. The IC-A1 adds the records-route with the ic-A1.interconnection-A.net.

q_2089.question: What is the maximum speech coding rate allowed for Application A?
q_2089.ground_truth: The maximum speech coding rate allowed for Application A is 14.4 kbit/s.

q_2090.question: What is the term used to describe Hybrid Automatic Repeat Request in the context of HSDPA?

q_2091.question: How does an MS determine the priority ordering amongst the access technologies in i, ii, iii, iv, and v when using a SIM without access technology information storage?
q_2091.ground_truth: The priority ordering amongst the access technologies is implementation dependent, and the MS can use location information to determine which PLMNs are available in its present location.

q_2092.question: What is the procedure for CS network originated session initialization in the MGCF?
q_2092.ground_truth: The MGCF initiates the session by selecting an IM-MGW, reserving the IM CN subsystem side termination, establishing the IM CN subsystem session, preparing the CS network side bearer establishment, and connecting the terminations using the Change Through-Connection procedure.

q_2093.question: What is the role of the IMS UE-A and MRFC in the "dial-in" conference procedure for one MSRP session using TLS and KMS based security?
q_2093.ground_truth: The IMS UE-A creates an SDP offer with an MSRP based media over TLS transport protocol and the MRFC receives a trigger to create an ad-hoc conference and performs IMS "dial-out" conference session set-up.

q_2094.question: What is the general result when the ME performs the PROACTIVE COMMAND: RUN AT COMMAND 3.4.1 command successfully?
q_2094.ground_truth: The ME shall return "IMSI<CR><LF>OK<CR><LF>" in the TERMINAL RESPONSE, indicating a successful command execution.

q_2095.question: Which GANSS IE(s) need to be present when the Requested Data Value IE contains the GANSS Common Assistance Data IE?
q_2095.ground_truth: At least one of the GANSS Reference Time, GANSS Ionospheric Model, GANSS Reference Location, GANSS Additional Ionospheric Model, or GANSS Earth Orientation Parameters IEs needs to be present.

q_2096.question: What is an important aspect to remember when developing interconnect agreements?
q_2096.ground_truth: When developing interconnect agreements, it is important to remember the routing of calls through the interconnected network, as international calls can be routed through Digital Circuit Multiplication Equipment (DCME) and Digital Speech Interpolation (DSI) systems that add delay, distortion, and clipping.

q_2097.question: What does the F1 interface in NG-RAN provide means for interconnecting?
q_2097.ground_truth: The F1 interface in NG-RAN provides means for interconnecting a gNB-CU and a gNB-DU of a gNB or for interconnecting a gNB-CU and a gNB-DU of an en-gNB within an E-UTRAN.

q_2098.question: What is the component that decides whether to start the L1 PRACH procedure for a specific persistence value Pi in the present transmission time interval?

q_2099.question: What is the impact of increasing SCS on the PRACH link budget for coverage?
q_2099.ground_truth: Increasing SCS negatively impacts coverage in terms of maximum isotropic loss (MIL) and maximum coupling loss (MCL) in the PRACH link budget.

q_2100.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in collecting performance data from EDN networks?
q_2100.ground_truth: The NWDAF is responsible for collecting performance data from EDN networks to measure the performance of UE communication sessions with each EDN.

q_2101.question: Which functional blocks are the main contributors to the cost reduction achieved by relaxing the maximum DL modulation order?
q_2101.ground_truth: The main contributors to the cost reduction are the RF: Transceiver, Baseband: ADC/DAC, Baseband: Receiver processing block, Baseband: LDPC decoding, and Baseband: HARQ buffer.

q_2102.question: What does the term "Solution Set (SS)" mean in the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications?
q_2102.ground_truth: The term "Solution Set (SS)" refers to a specification defined by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) that outlines a set of technical solutions for a specific aspect of telecommunication management, such as the Home enhanced Node B Subsystem (HeNS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP).

q_2103.question: How should a mobile station attempt an establishment of uplink TBF when the Packet Downlink Assignment IE in IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message or IPA Downlink Assignment struct in IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message indicates a downlink TBF during the packet transfer mode?
q_2103.ground_truth: The mobile station shall use the procedure specified in 3GPP TS 44.060.

q_2104.question: In the 3GPP technical specification, what does the IOC TestManagementIRP inherit from, and what does it represent?
q_2104.ground_truth: The IOC TestManagementIRP inherits from the IOC ManagedGenericIRP. It, together with the IOC TestActionPerformer, represents the test management capabilities defined by this specification. It includes the capabilities required to conduct a test of network resources.

q_2105.question: In subclause 6.1.1.3.4.2, what windowing function is applied before the time-to-frequency transform?
q_2105.ground_truth: A windowing is performed on the concatenated excitation using a window with a flat top corresponding to the current frame and decreasing with the Hanning function to 0 at each end.

q_2106.question: What message is sent to the UE at the beginning of sub-test cases 19, 20, and 21 to clear stored assistance data?
q_2106.ground_truth: The RESET UE POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message is sent to the UE at the beginning of sub-test cases 19, 20, and 21 to clear stored assistance data.

q_2107.question: Who makes the final decision to authorize the UAV in the UUAA procedure?
q_2107.ground_truth: The USS/UTM makes the final decision to authorize the UAV in the UUAA procedure.

q_2108.question: What is the role of the storage function in the BMC?
q_2108.ground_truth: The storage function in the BMC is responsible for storing Cell Broadcast Messages.

q_2109.question: What is the maximum value of the Session-Expires header field in SIP session continuity?
q_2109.ground_truth: The maximum value of the Session-Expires header field in SIP session continuity is 30 minutes as per IETF RFC 4028. However, it may choose values of less than 30 minutes but greater than the absolute minimum of 90 seconds within the 3GPP CS core network.

q_2110.question: What is one of the high-level objectives of an AIPN?
q_2110.ground_truth: One high-level objective of an AIPN is to provide universal seamless access, allowing users to connect to services from a variety of device-types and access systems using common protocols, addressing schemes, and mobility management mechanisms.

q_2111.question: What is the TFCS for the 258.4 kbps PS RAB with 40 ms TTI?
q_2111.ground_truth: The TFCS for the 258.4 kbps PS RAB with 40 ms TTI is specified in subclause 7.2.10.1.2 of the document.

q_2112.question: What should the SFR enabled Feed Reader be able to identify when making the feed URI available to the SFR enabled feed reader?
q_2112.ground_truth: The SFR enabled Feed Reader should be able to identify whether the feed is an SFR optimized feed or a regular ATOM/RSS feed.

q_2113.question: What is the difference between EGPRS MCS-9, MCS-8 and MCS-7 in terms of data transmission?
q_2113.ground_truth: In EGPRS MCS-9, two normal bursts are used to carry one RLC block, while in MCS-8, four normal bursts are used to carry one RLC block. In MCS-7, two bursts are used to carry two RLC blocks, but the second block is transmitted within the second burst only.

q_2114.question: What type of handover is triggered by an evaluation made in the mobile, based on the measured radio environment and network-defined criteria?
q_2114.ground_truth: Mobile evaluated handover is the type of handover that is triggered by an evaluation made in the mobile.

q_2115.question: What action will a UE take when it detects a barred cell during cell re-selection in Idle mode?
q_2115.ground_truth: If the IE "Intra-frequency cell re-selection indicator" is set to "not allowed", the UE shall not re-select a cell on the same frequency as the barred cell. After expiry of the time interval Tbarred, the UE shall again check whether the status of the barred cell has changed.

q_2116.question: How does Bob watch a TV program on his HMD while his family watches their favourite program on TV?
q_2116.ground_truth: Bob receives the TV programs distributed over 3GPP services to his smartphone and maps it into a 360 environment on his HMD with various virtual environment options.

q_2117.question: How long shall an instance of timer T3112 relating to an RP-Data message be started for when the mobile station first receives a segment of the message?
q_2117.ground_truth: An instance of timer T3112 relating to an RP-Data message shall be started for 30 seconds (including the initial transmission) when the mobile station first receives a segment of the message.

q_2118.question: What is the role of inter-PLMN backbone network?
q_2118.ground_truth: The inter-PLMN backbone network is the IP network interconnecting SGSNs, GGSNs, Serving GWs and PDN GWs with intra-PLMN backbone networks in different PLMNs.

q_2119.question: What information does the V-GMLC include in the MO-LR Location Information message when sending it to the H-GMLC?
q_2119.ground_truth: The V-GMLC includes the MSISDN/IMSI of the UE, the event causing the location estimate (CS-MO-LR), the location estimate and its age, and the identity of the LCS Client in the MO-LR Location Information message.

q_2120.question: What is the minimum SNR required for the SA channel to achieve a data channel BLER of 8.0% for EVS-SWB CA?
q_2120.ground_truth: The minimum SNR required is 3.63 dB.

q_2121.question: What is the purpose of the Iu UP Frame Control Part and the Iu UP Frame Check Sum Part in the Iu UP PDU Type 14 for positive acknowledgement?
q_2121.ground_truth: The Iu UP Frame Control Part and the Iu UP Frame Check Sum Part constitute the Iu UP PDU Type 14 Frame Header for positive acknowledgement.

q_2122.question: What are the three types of virtualised network product class described?
q_2122.ground_truth: The three types of virtualised network product class described are type 1, implementing 3GPP defined functionalities only; type 2, implementing 3GPP defined functionalities and virtualisation layer; and type 3, implementing 3GPP defined functionalities, virtualisation layer, and hardware layer.

q_2123.question: In which situations can a mobile station use the "reduced NCH monitoring" mechanism for voice group call notifications?
q_2123.ground_truth: The "reduced NCH monitoring" mechanism can be used by mobile stations when they are able to receive voice group calls and either can use the reduced NCH monitoring mechanism or can read all possible paging or access grant channels.

q_2124.question: What is the goal of the recommended requirements in the Feedback-enabled Control of Uplink Streaming use case?
q_2124.ground_truth: The goal of the recommended requirements in the Feedback-enabled Control of Uplink Streaming use case is to enable the SNS provider and/or FLUS service provider to influence the uplink streaming behavior of the FLUS source based on network conditions, access network information, and location of the FLUS source.

q_2125.question: Which APIs are required for a UE in the 3GPP HTML5 profile?
q_2125.ground_truth: In the 3GPP HTML5 profile, UEs shall support the Forms API, Canvas API, XMLHttpRequest API, Media Source Extensions, ISO BMFF Byte Stream Format with the MIME type and subtypes audio/mp4 and video/mp4. Additionally, UEs should support the GeoLocation API, Encrypted Media Extensions, Web Socket API with the protocol defined in RFC 6455, Server-Sent Events API, and WebCrypto API.

q_2126.question: What is the 3GPP User Data Convergence (UDC) concept?
q_2126.ground_truth: The UDC concept is a 3GPP system feature that separates user data from the application logic, allowing access from core and service layer entities, named Application Front Ends. It ensures data consistency, simplifies creation of new services, and minimally impacts network elements.

q_2127.question: What does the "qoeMetrics" element represent in the XML syntax for a reception report request?
q_2127.ground_truth: The "qoeMetrics" element in the XML syntax for a reception report request contains metrics related to Quality of Experience (QoE).

q_2128.question: What mode should the DRNS activate for the HS-DSCH Radio Link in FDD, if the MIMO Activation Indicator IE is included in the HS-DSCH FDD Information IE?

q_2129.question: What is the minimum TPC command error ratio level at which the threshold Qsbout should correspond to a level of DPCH quality where no reliable detection can be made?
q_2129.ground_truth: The threshold Qsbout should correspond to a level of DPCH quality where the TPC command error ratio level is e.g. 30 for the purpose of monitoring synchronization during downlink DTX.

q_2130.question: What are the two performance measures considered in the link level performance evaluation?
q_2130.ground_truth: The two performance measures considered are the CIR required to achieve a decoded frame erasure rate (FER) of less than 1 and the CIR required to achieve a raw bit error rate (raw BER) of less than 10.

q_2131.question: What does Feedback N-PDU mean?
q_2131.ground_truth: Feedback N-PDU is an N-PDU which is generated by an SNDCP protocol control information compression entity or data compression entity and contains only control information for its peer compression entity, but no payload from any SNDCP user.

q_2132.question: What action should be taken if the group identity contained in the SIP INVITE request is not a constituent MCPTT group ID and the user is not allowed to join the prearranged group session?
q_2132.ground_truth: A SIP 403 (Forbidden) response should be returned with the warning text set to "121 user is not allowed to join the group call".

q_2133.question: What information should the DRNS include in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message if the E-DCH Semi-Persistent scheduling Indicator IE is included in the E-DCH Semi-Persistent scheduling Information LCR IE?
q_2133.ground_truth: The DRNS should apply this information for E-DCH Semi-Persistent scheduling operation.

q_2134.question: What is the effect of using modulation types other than GMSK on the BCCH carrier in certain cells on cell selection, cell reselection and handover procedures?
q_2134.ground_truth: The procedures will be somewhat sub-optimal due to the impact of lower output power level of the modulation types other than GMSK on signal measurement by MS.

q_2135.question: What is used for the direct communication between collaborating mobile robots or AGVs carrying a large or heavy work piece together in a coordinated way?
q_2135.ground_truth: Layer 2 or layer 3 multicast communication from the source mobile robot or AGV to all the other collaborating mobile robots or AGVs (5.11.3).

q_2136.question: What is a special case of the network element management architecture in a 3GPP system?
q_2136.ground_truth: An important special case is where one type of network element, such as the RNC, needs management information for coordination of a subnetwork of other types of network elements, like the NodeB.

q_2137.question: Which type of alignment is required for 3GP-DASH as defined TS 26.247?
q_2137.ground_truth: A profile aligned with existing industry practices is currently lacking.

q_2138.question: When does the SGSN update the value of the bucket counter for a LLC-PDU(s) associated with the old BVC?
q_2138.ground_truth: The SGSN updates the value of the bucket counter for a LLC-PDU(s) associated with the old BVC when it receives a FLUSH-LL-ACK PDU by the SGSN, indicating that the LLC-PDU(s) associated with the old BVC have been "deleted" or "transferred" within the NSE.

q_2139.question: When can the network send an empty return result to the MS after a CFNRy erasure request?
q_2139.ground_truth: The network may send an empty return result if the erasure was successful for all basic services and the MS did not send an SS Version Indicator.

q_2140.question: What are the main delivery methods for MBMS User Services?
q_2140.ground_truth: The main delivery methods for MBMS User Services are: download and streaming.

q_2141.question: How much was the capacity performance increased for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, for CG, with single stream traffic model, DDDUU/DDDSU TDD format, with SU-MIMO, 30Mbps, 15ms PDB, when using delay-aware scheduler compared to the PF scheduler?
q_2141.ground_truth: The capacity performance was increased by 4.1%.

q_2142.question: What is the purpose of the authentication parameter SRES information element?
q_2142.ground_truth: The authentication parameter SRES information element provides the service node with the authentication response signature calculated in the fixed part.

q_2143.question: What type is the "subcarrierSpacing" attribute restricted to, as specified in the XML schema?
q_2143.ground_truth: The "subcarrierSpacing" attribute is restricted to type "xs:decimal" in the XML schema.

q_2144.question: What is the purpose of the "Non-Seamless Offload indication" in UE-to-Network Relay operation?
q_2144.ground_truth: The "Non-Seamless Offload indication" can indicate if the offloading is via non-3GPP access or a Layer 3 UE-to-Network Relay.

q_2145.question: What is the role of the TCQ quantized component in the lag search process?
q_2145.ground_truth: In the lag search process, the TCQ quantized component is used as the low-frequency MDCT coefficients for the lag search, while both the TCQ-quantized and noise-filled low-frequency MDCT coefficients are used for generating high-frequency spectrum and calculating the scaling factors.

q_2146.question: What is the role of the DASH client in controlling playout and handling special content?
q_2146.ground_truth: The DASH client is not aware that controlling playout is due to segment requests and assumes that the availability of segments depends only on time advancing. Therefore, additional information is necessary for the DASH client to understand that controlling playout is due to segment requests.

q_2147.question: What is the format of each SOR-CMCI rule?
q_2147.ground_truth: Each SOR-CMCI rule consists of a criterion (PDU session attribute type, service type, SOR security check, or match all) and a value for Tsor-cm timer associated with that criterion.

q_2148.question: Why can't 5G ProSe fully reuse the security mechanisms from the 5G V2X scenario for one-to-one communication?
q_2148.ground_truth: They may use different processing procedures.

q_2149.question: What is the scope of the UTRAN Iupc interface layer 1 (Release 17) specification?
q_2149.ground_truth: The UTRAN Iupc interface layer 1 specification (Release 17) outlines the standards for implementing Layer 1 on the Iupc interface. However, it does not cover transmission delay requirements or O&M (operations and maintenance) requirements.

q_2150.question: What is the frequency range for measuring the received power in step b)?
q_2150.ground_truth: The frequency range for measuring the received power in step b) is 1.8 MHz <= f < 6 MHz from the carrier frequency and within the BTS relevant transmitter band.

q_2151.question: What protocols are required to be supported by a TP UE for the exchange of CLUE messages?
q_2151.ground_truth: A TP UE needs to support DTLS/SCTP (Datagram Transport Layer Security / Stream Control Transmission Protocol) protocols for the exchange of CLUE messages.

q_2152.question: When does the target AMF perform a new NAS SMC procedure with the UE?
q_2152.ground_truth: The target AMF performs a new NAS SMC procedure to take the new horizontally derived Kamf key into use before initiating a primary authentication and to generate a new Kamf-2 key shared with the UE. This is done to provide forward security and ensure initial AMF has no access to the new key.

q_2153.question: How does bandwidth affect video and imaging applications?
q_2153.ground_truth: High bandwidth requirements in video and imaging applications can result in degradation of picture quality when compression is used, affecting onward processing required by some applications.

q_2154.question: Under what conditions must the accuracy requirements for inter-frequency relative accuracy be met for the 7.68 Mcps TDD option?
q_2154.ground_truth: The conditions include P-CCPCH RSCP1,2 being greater than or equal to -102 dBm, and the relative Io difference being less than or equal to the relative RSCP difference.

q_2155.question: Which interface is used in the SLF routing information interrogation procedures when data is received from CSCF and AS?
q_2155.ground_truth: The Dx interface is used in the SLF routing information interrogation procedures when data is received from CSCF, and the Dh interface is used when data is received from AS.

q_2156.question: What is the Failure State in the TFO Protocol caused by?
q_2156.ground_truth: The Failure State is entered when the distant partner shows an incorrect behavior, and the TC then sends pure PCM samples and waits for the failure to disappear without sending TFO Frames or TFO Messages.

q_2157.question: What is the purpose of the MonitoredEntity class in the document?
q_2157.ground_truth: The MonitoredEntity class represents classes that can have an alarmed state. It is used in the AlarmInformation class to identify the instance that is in alarmed state and to identify a back up network resource for the instance that is in alarmed state.

q_2158.question: What are the services provided by the MAC layer to upper layers?
q_2158.ground_truth: The MAC layer provides the service of data transfer between peer MAC entities, which includes unacknowledged transfer of MAC SDUs, but does not provide data segmentation.

q_2159.question: Who is the source device and destination device for the Timer Management commands in the first passage?
q_2159.ground_truth: In the first passage, the source device is ME and the destination device is SIM.

q_2160.question: What is an Intermediate GSN and what is its role in the UMTS Core Network?
q_2160.ground_truth: An Intermediate GSN (IM-GSN) is a logical node used to represents the SGSN for certain GTP signalling termination in a GLR-equipped VPLMN. It acts as an SGSN for specific GTP signalling messages from the HPLMN and terminates them towards the actual SGSN.

q_2161.question: What does the Mobile-Station-Memory-Capacity-Exceeded-Flag (MCEF) indicate?
q_2161.ground_truth: The Mobile-Station-Memory-Capacity-Exceeded-Flag (MCEF) within the HLR is a Boolean parameter with the value TRUE if an attempt to deliver a short message to an MS has failed with a cause of MS Memory Capacity Exceeded, and with the value FALSE otherwise.

q_2162.question: What is the purpose of the GANC in the network initiated PTC re-activation scenario?
q_2162.ground_truth: The GANC is responsible for establishing the GA-RRC Packet Transport Channel (PTC) and deactivating it during the network initiated PTC re-activation scenario.

q_2163.question: What is the range of power saving gains for FR1 with same-slot scheduling and 2 Rx antennas, when maximum PDCCH blind decoding is reduced by 25% and 50% for the instant message traffic model?
q_2163.ground_truth: The power saving gains are in the range of approximately 0.44%~6.20% when maximum PDCCH blind decoding is reduced by 25%, and 0.82%~12.30% when reduced by 50%.

q_2164.question: What information is sent in an EGPRS MULTILATERATION REQUEST message when using the RLC Data block method?
q_2164.ground_truth: The information includes a random reference which is drawn randomly from a uniform probability distribution.

q_2165.question: What are some Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that are considered in the Performance Management (PM) of a 3G PLMN?
q_2165.ground_truth: KPIs include call setup success rate, dropped call rate, call blocking rate, handover success rate, resource utilization, and QoS parameters.

q_2166.question: When does an HLR supporting the "mobile terminating roaming retry" feature sends a MAP Cancel Location message to the old VLR?
q_2166.ground_truth: An HLR supporting the "mobile terminating roaming retry" feature sends a MAP Cancel Location message to the old VLR upon receipt of the MAP Update Location from the new VLR.

q_2167.question: When is a PLMN network being adjusted for long-term requirements in CM?
q_2167.ground_truth: The PLMN network is adjusted for long-term requirements when the network is updated or upgraded to meet the long-term needs of the network operator and the customer for improved performance, capacity, and customer satisfaction.

q_2168.question: What is the eCall In-band Modem specified in?
q_2168.ground_truth: The eCall In-band Modem is fully specified by 3GPP TS together with the C-code reference as provided in 3GPP TS 26.268.

q_2169.question: What is the first condition that the new cell must meet for reselection by the UE?
q_2169.ground_truth: The new cell must be better ranked than the serving cell during a time interval TreselectionRAT.

q_2170.question: What protocol does the IMS-ALG use as the transport protocol when indicating e2ae security support for an application-agnostic media stream to the IMS-AGW?
q_2170.ground_truth: For application-agnostic e2ae security support, the IMS-ALG uses "TCP" as the transport protocol at the termination towards the core network and "TCP/TLS" as the transport protocol at the termination towards the access network.

q_2171.question: What does the P-Charging-Vector header field parameter value "icid-value" identify in step 9?
q_2171.ground_truth: It identifies the home network of the remote user

q_2172.question: What is the role of UxNB in the 3GPP system?
q_2172.ground_truth: UxNB is a radio access node on-board UAV that provides connectivity to UEs (User Equipments) carried in the air by an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). It can also connect with 3GPP core network like a normal ground Base Station.

q_2173.question: What is the difference between ACS and ACLR in the context of mobile communication?
q_2173.ground_truth: ACS (Adjacent Channel Selectivity) is a measure of a receiver's ability to receive a signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an adjacent channel signal at a given frequency offset. ACLR (Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio) is the ratio of the transmitter's power in an adjacent channel to the transmitter's power in the desired channel.

q_2174.question: What is the purpose of the "UE to UE ToD session-oriented service termination over PC5" procedure?
q_2174.ground_truth: This procedure allows the termination of a tele-operated driving session between two V2X UE devices over the PC5 reference point.

q_2175.question: What format is the "SSID" and "HESSID" in ANDSF/WLANSP/<X>/SelectionCriteria/<X>/PreferredSSIDList/<X> represented as?
q_2175.ground_truth: The "SSID" and "HESSID" in ANDSF/WLANSP/<X>/SelectionCriteria/<X>/PreferredSSIDList/<X> are represented as chr format.

q_2176.question: What is the requirement for determining authorization for cancelling an MCPTT emergency alert?
q_2176.ground_truth: The IWF may authorize the MCPTT emergency alert cancellation if it has received a SIP request with the <alert-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body set to a value of "false".

q_2177.question: What should the UE do if the N-th (N=1..5) PLMN in the "Multiple PLMNs" is chosen by the UE?
q_2177.ground_truth: The UE should apply the domain specific access restrictions and paging permission with access control as indicated in the IE "Domain Specific Access Restriction For Shared Network" and "Paging Permission with Access Control For Shared Network".

q_2178.question: What are the key terms and abbreviations used in the present document as per 3GPP TS 32.366 V14.0.0?
q_2178.ground_truth: The key terms and abbreviations used in the present document include: CORBA, DN, EM, EP, EPIRP, IRP, IOC, IS, NE, NL, NM, SS, WSDL, and XML.

q_2179.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Relay User Key (PRUK) in the process of establishing a secure communication between a Remote UE and a UE-to-network relay?
q_2179.ground_truth: The PRUK is used to generate KD for any of the relays under a particular PKMF. Once calculated, KD serves to derive session keys between the Remote UE and the UE-to-network relay.

q_2180.question: What does DL stand for in the context of DL-CCTrCH-LCR-InformationList-RL-AdditionRspTDD768?

q_2181.question: What message does the BSS send to the MS to initiate the handover?
q_2181.ground_truth: The BSS sends the "PS Handover Command (RN part)" message to the MS to initiate the handover.

q_2182.question: In Solution #24, when must the UE consider forbidden PLMNs for PLMN selection?
q_2182.ground_truth: In Solution #24, if the UE detects a "Disaster Condition" based on the solution for Key Issue #1, then the UE shall perform a PLMN selection and consider the list of "PLMNs to be used while in Disaster condition" in the PLMN selection. If the UE finds a forbidden PLMN that is present in the list of PLMNs to be used while in Disaster condition, then the UE shall consider the forbidden PLMN for PLMN selection.

q_2183.question: What is the role of the CSI AS in supplementary services?
q_2183.ground_truth: The CSI AS determines the application of Call Forwarding and Call Barring to terminating CUA, and performs corresponding session modification toward the originating UE if the terminating CUA applies call hold or call retrieval.

q_2184.question: Which entity is responsible for routing associated uplink signaling via E-UCCH and MAC-i PDU in TDD only?
q_2184.ground_truth: The Scheduling Access Control entity is responsible for routing associated uplink signaling via E-UCCH and MAC-i PDU in the case that E-DCH resources are assigned.

q_2185.question: What is the size and type of the Mobile Allocation information element in 3G UMTS?
q_2185.ground_truth: The Mobile Allocation information element is a type 4 information element with a length of 3 to 10 octets in 3G UMTS, except for the cases specified in sub-clauses 9.1.18.1 and 9.1.19.2.

q_2186.question: How does the 3GPP define personal data in the context of this study?
q_2186.ground_truth: Personal data is defined as any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person, including physical, physiological, mental, economic, cultural, or social factors specific to that person.

q_2187.question: What does the bandwidth efficient mode of RFC 4867 offer in the context of AMR?
q_2187.ground_truth: The bandwidth efficient mode of RFC 4867, when used in the context of AMR, allows for a more efficient use of available bandwidth for conversational speech telephony services. This mode does not apply CRC and robust sorting.

q_2188.question: What does the acronym "LEMF" stand for in the context of telecommunications?

q_2189.question: What is the event that will increment the measurement of the number of dropped RAB connections for CS domain, and under which condition is the counter not pegged?
q_2189.ground_truth: The event is the transmission of the RANAP Iu Release Request by the HNB, and the counter is not pegged if the RRC Connection Release was triggered by Signaling Connection Release from the UE.

q_2190.question: What actions does the new 3G-SGSN take if it receives a Downlink Data Notification message or any other downlink signalling message while the MS is still connected?
q_2190.ground_truth: The new 3G-SGSN may prolong the PS signalling connection with the MS.

q_2191.question: What is the term used in the 3GPP technical specification to refer to the frequency ranges in which NR can operate in the range of 24250 MHz - 52600 MHz?

q_2192.question: In the document, what is the difference between A/Gb mode and Iu mode?
q_2192.ground_truth: A/Gb mode refers to the MS operating in GERAN A/Gb mode, while Iu mode refers to the MS operating in UTRAN or GERAN Iu mode.

q_2193.question: What is the main function of the Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) in the GSM system?
q_2193.ground_truth: The Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) in the GSM system is a mode of operation in which the transmitters are switched on only for those frames which contain useful information, with the purpose of prolonging battery life, reducing RF spectrum and improving the measurement of the radio link quality.

q_2194.question: What are the two distribution methods defined for use by MBS User Services?
q_2194.ground_truth: The two distribution methods defined for use by MBS User Services are the Object Distribution Method and the Packet Distribution Method.

q_2195.question: What is the typical range of the wall penetration loss?
q_2195.ground_truth: The typical wall penetration loss ranges between 10 and 30dB.

q_2196.question: When is the USS UAV Authentication & Authorization (UUAA) performed in the 3GPP system?
q_2196.ground_truth: The UUAA is performed by the USS/UTM via a USS UAV Authentication & Authorization (UUAA) with the support of the 3GPP system before connectivity for UAS services is enabled. The UUAA can be performed during the 5GS registration procedure, when the UAV requests user plane resources for UAV operation, or during the attach procedure and PDN connection establishment in EPS.

q_2197.question: What are the performance requirements defined for media production over 5G NPN?
q_2197.ground_truth: Performance requirements for media production over 5G NPN are defined in TR 26.805, and focus on identifying how media production can beneficially use 5G systems for media production.

q_2198.question: How should the network treat information elements (IEs) that are unknown in a message and are not encoded as "comprehension required"?
q_2198.ground_truth: The network should ignore all unknown IEs in a message which are not encoded as "comprehension required".

q_2199.question: What should the EF and the PCRF include in the Auth-Application-Id AVP and Vendor-Id AVP of the Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP when advertising support for an Nt specific application?
q_2199.ground_truth: The value of the application identifier in the Auth-Application-Id AVP and the value of the 3GPP (10415) in the Vendor-Id AVP.

q_2200.question: What type of address is used as the target destination in the Redirect parameter?
q_2200.ground_truth: The Redirect Destination parameter specifies the target redirect address in case the uplink part of the service data flow should be redirected to a controlled address.

q_2201.question: How many octets is the Frequency Channel Sequence information element long?
q_2201.ground_truth: The Frequency Channel Sequence information element is 10 octets long.

q_2202.question: How does human UC identification by the callee happen in the terminating network?
q_2202.ground_truth: Human UC identification by the callee happens in the terminating network as the caller is the only instance who can identify UC. This caller-based UC identification can then be used as input to an IMR-based PUCI AS to prevent UC.

q_2203.question: What are the two kinds of links that NM can monitor for communication failure?
q_2203.ground_truth: The two links that NM can monitor are link-a-1 and link-a-2, which are used by the IRPManager and various xxxIRPs to execute 3GPP Interface IRP defined operations.

q_2204.question: What entity in the 5G Multicast-Broadcast Service (MBS) architecture sends a session modification request to the MB-UPF, including new tunneling information, after associating a PDU session with the MB Session context?

q_2205.question: What is the initial message content in the case of Expected Sequence 1.1?

q_2206.question: How many different coverage classes are defined for the downlink in the EC-GSM-IoT system?

q_2207.question: How is the corresponding SNPN identified for IMS users?
q_2207.ground_truth: The corresponding SNPN for IMS users can be identified based on the home network domain and IMPI/IMPU identifiers generated and provided by the UE during the IMS registration procedure.

q_2208.question: What is the service procedure that the provided document measures for the Call Barring service, which results in a 603 (Decline) response being sent to the calling user?
q_2208.ground_truth: Number of Outgoing Communication Barring (OCB) procedure

q_2209.question: What is the main objective of the test case described in the process for moving scenario and periodic update performance?
q_2209.ground_truth: The main objective of the test case is to verify the UE's position estimates after the first reported position estimate meet the minimum requirements under GNSS satellite signal conditions that simulate a moving scenario. A good tracking performance, with regular position estimate reporting is essential for certain location services.

q_2210.question: What existing functionality is suggested to be re-used for the screen share use case to control the "regular" camera video m-line in SDP?

q_2211.question: What is required for hosting models identified in clause~5.1 to be supported in this solution?
q_2211.ground_truth: Private edge hosted resources may be secured via zero trust models with per application session authorization, or with VPNs and may have no direct access to central DN.

q_2212.question: What action does the UE take after receiving the Discovery Response message from the ProSe Function in HPLMN when stopping the announcement of a ProSe Application Code before the associated validity timer expires?
q_2212.ground_truth: The UE removes and stops announcing the ProSe App Code corresponding to the Discovery Entry ID, and informs the lower layers to take any appropriate action.

q_2213.question: What happens in step 3b and 3c in the procedure described in clause 6c.2.3.1?
q_2213.ground_truth: If there is a match with any transferable session, the EATF proceeds with the Access Transfer and sends a 200 OK response to the I-CSCF.

q_2214.question: What information does the PGW trigger the PGW send the updated list of available P-CSCFs towards the UE via the ePDG if the UE indicates support for the P-CSCF restoration extension for the untrusted WLAN access in the IMS PDN connection establishment?
q_2214.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a P-CSCF restoration indication from the 3GPP AAA Server, the PGW may invoke this P-CSCF restoration extension procedure if the UE and the ePDG support this extension for the untrusted WLAN access. This triggers the PGW to send the updated list of available P-CSCFs towards the UE via the ePDG.

q_2215.question: When would a TBF establishment failure occur due to an EC IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT TYPE 2 or EC IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT TYPE 4 message indicating a PDCH in a non-supported frequency band?
q_2215.ground_truth: A TBF establishment failure occurs if an EC IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT TYPE 2 or EC IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT TYPE 4 message indicates a PDCH in a non-supported frequency band, as this indicates that the required frequency band is not supported for the TBF.

q_2216.question: What is the goal of Solution #35 in the context of edge relocation with user plane latency requirements?
q_2216.ground_truth: The goal of Solution #35 is to provide a solution for enabling an edge computing relocation with considering user plane low latency, when required by the edge application server (EAS) and/or the edge enabler server (EES).

q_2217.question: What action should the receiver take when it receives a LPP message carrying the same sequence number as that last received for the associated location session?
q_2217.ground_truth: The receiver should discard the LPP message.

q_2218.question: What is a key consideration for Model A procedure of ProSe Direct discovery?
q_2218.ground_truth: A key consideration for Model A procedure of ProSe Direct discovery is that it requires the announcing UE to periodically broadcast the direct discovery message, which may consume more announcing UE power.

q_2219.question: What is the goal of having one QUIC Connection across two accesses in solutions 7 and 8?
q_2219.ground_truth: The goal of having one QUIC Connection across two accesses in solutions 7 and 8 is to support traffic splitting with support for re-ordering. This approach allows for the efficient use of network resources by allowing traffic to be distributed across two accesses, even if they have different characteristics such as RTT or loss rate.

q_2220.question: How is the fourth packet in a TCX1024 frame calculated if the third packet is lost?
q_2220.ground_truth: If the third packet is lost in a TCX1024 frame, "index1" is replaced by the logical XOR combination of "parity" and "index0". That is, "Bit 3" is generated from the logical XOR of "Parity Bit 2" and "Bit 6", "Bit 2" is generated from the logical XOR of "Parity Bit 1" and "Bit 5", and "Bit 1" is generated from the logical XOR of "Parity Bit 0" and "Bit 4".

q_2221.question: What is the impact of the GERAN enhancements on the existing network architecture and core network?
q_2221.ground_truth: The GERAN enhancements are expected to have minimal impact on the existing network architecture and should be based on the existing network architecture. The enhancements should also be applicable for Dual Transfer Mode and A/Gb mode interface.

q_2222.question: What is the maximum length of the short message within the TP-UD field in the case of 16 bit uncompressed USC2 data?
q_2222.ground_truth: The maximum length is 66 ((140-7)/2) characters. A UCS2 character shall not be split in the middle.

q_2223.question: What is the difference between an Identity Provider (IdP) and a Liberty-Enabled User Agent or Device (LUAD) in the Liberty Alliance architecture?
q_2223.ground_truth: An Identity Provider (IdP) is a system entity that manages identity information on behalf of Principals and provides assertions of Principal authentication to other providers. A Liberty-Enabled User Agent or Device (LUAD), on the other hand, is a device or user agent that has specific support for one or more profiles of the Liberty specifications. A LUAD may perform one or more Liberty system entity roles as defined by the Liberty specifications it implements.

q_2224.question: What are two possible ways of making transmission in the context of Real-time Transport Protocol (RTP) packets?
q_2224.ground_truth: The two possible ways of making transmission are Variable Bit Rate Packet (VBRP) transmission and Constant Bit Rate Packet (CBRP) transmission.

q_2225.question: What must the RCAF do upon reception of a NSR command including the Ns-Request-Type AVP with the value 1 (cancellation request)?
q_2225.ground_truth: The RCAF must remove the related SCEF instructions associated with the SCEF reference ID and send a Network-Status-Answer (NSA) command to acknowledge the cancellation.

q_2226.question: What is the difference between radio-related measurements and information for QoE?
q_2226.ground_truth: Radio-related measurements for QoE are collected for all types of supported services, and they include MDT-like measurements and, potentially, additional measurements related to the radio interface. They are reported for assisting application-related QoE measurements. Radio-related information, on the other hand, may be reported even when radio-related measurements are not triggered over the radio.

q_2227.question: What is the service for the gateway address?

q_2228.question: What shared secret is used for MSK messages between the BM-SC and the UE in the pre-shared secret mode of MIKEY?
q_2228.ground_truth: The MUK (Multicast-key usage key) is used for MSK messages between the BM-SC and the UE in the pre-shared secret mode of MIKEY.

q_2229.question: Which network entity is responsible for collecting charging information related to PS domain resources usage for IP-CAN bearers?
q_2229.ground_truth: The PCNs shall collect charging information on usage of the PS domain network resources for IP-CAN bearers.

q_2230.question: What is the difference between a CBS message and an emergency message?
q_2230.ground_truth: A CBS message is an information message broadcasted in unacknowledged mode to mobile stations in a specific area, while an emergency message is a warning message conveying a small amount of data indicating the imminent occurrence of an emergency, such as earthquake or tsunami, and is broadcasted to mobile stations in various modes and locations within the Cell Broadcast area.

q_2231.question: What is the format of the RAB-SubflowCombinationBitRate in the 3GPP TS 25.427 standard?
q_2231.ground_truth: The RAB-SubflowCombinationBitRate is an integer value ranging from 0 to 16000000, indicating the maximum bit rate for an RAB subflow.

q_2232.question: When using the noise field simulation and eight-channel background noise scenarios from TS 103 224 for handset UE testing, which issue needs to be resolved?
q_2232.ground_truth: Availability of two-channel/binaural recordings in the required eight-channel format

q_2233.question: In what type of network should the "Uplink Timing Advance Control" have a value of "disabled" in order to reset timing advance to 0 and disable calculated timing advance following handover?

q_2234.question: Which network options are affected by the "Zero-overhead user plane integrity protection on the link layer" solution?
q_2234.ground_truth: Option 2 - NR standalone with 5G Core, Option 3 - EPC based Dual Connectivity of eUTRA and NR RAT, Option 4 - 5G core based Dual Connectivity (NR master - eUTRA secondary) and Option 7 - 5G core based Dual Connectivity (eUTRA master - NR secondary).

q_2235.question: In the "UL-CCTrCH-ID" part of the protocol, what does the acronym "CCTrCH" stand for?

q_2236.question: What should the UE do after keeping the Dedicated EPS bearer active for 5 seconds for WB-S1 or after keeping the Default EPS Bearer active for 5 seconds for NB-IoT, as per step j)?
q_2236.ground_truth: The network sends RRCConnectionRelease to the UE for WB-S1 or RRCConnectionRelease-NB to the UE for NB-IoT during step j).

q_2237.question: What is the action taken by the PCRF when path-switch occurs and the PCEF informs the PCRF of a new IP-CAN type for UE initiated resource reservation through the non-primary BBERF?
q_2237.ground_truth: The PCRF shall reject the request if a non-primary BBERF request results in a change of the QoS rules active in the primary-BBERF.

q_2238.question: What is the purpose of the spectral envelope concealment in synthesizing the decoded speech?
q_2238.ground_truth: The spectral envelope is moved to an estimated reference envelope to synthesize the decoded speech. The estimated LSF vector is converted to an LSP vector and interpolated with the last frame's LSP vector for 4 or 5 subframes.

q_2239.question: What are the four categories of control channels defined in the document and what are their intended use?
q_2239.ground_truth: The four categories of control channels defined in the document are broadcast, common, dedicated and CTS control channels. They are intended to carry signalling or synchronization data.

q_2240.question: How many correct events must be observed during repeated tests with a confidence level of 95% in order to meet the conformance requirements for WLAN AP Identification and reporting delay under nominal conditions?
q_2240.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests must be at least 90%.

q_2241.question: What should the ME display as the Operator 5G PLMN name after the UE registers to a TAI with the MCC/MNC of 244/010 using the null-scheme for SUCI calculation?
q_2241.ground_truth: The ME should display "PLMN 5G" as the Operator 5G PLMN name.

q_2242.question: When does a Network Element transmit ACR Interims during a session in offline charging?
q_2242.ground_truth: A Network Element may transmit multiple ACR Interims during a session based on the progression of the session or when charging conditions change.

q_2243.question: What is the purpose of the "stereo-to-mono downmix tool" in the Enhanced aacPlus decoder?
q_2243.ground_truth: The "stereo-to-mono downmix tool" in the Enhanced aacPlus decoder enables a decoder only capable of mono output to downmix a stereo bitstream.

q_2244.question: What is the format of the time specified for the start and stop time in the Schedule Description instance document?
q_2244.ground_truth: The time is specified as the absolute date and UTC time.

q_2245.question: What happens to time measurement for a Monitoring key when time based usage monitoring is disabled before the Inactivity Detection Time is reached?

q_2246.question: What is the main benefit of the FNIM's decoupling of tool, platform, and solution technology from access protocol design?
q_2246.ground_truth: The decoupling allows for flexibility in choosing the best tool for the job, select the most appropriate platform for development or testing, and avoids dependency between model design and access protocol design.

q_2247.question: What is the length of the FSN/DRT Reset field in bits?
q_2247.ground_truth: The length of the FSN/DRT Reset field is 1 bit.

q_2248.question: What action will the UE take if the validity conditions of a WLANSP rule are not met?
q_2248.ground_truth: The UE will consider the rule as invalid.

q_2249.question: What are the three procedures the network can use to request a dispatcher to join a voice group call channel as a talker, besides the channel assignment procedure?
q_2249.ground_truth: A handover procedure, a channel mode modify procedure, or a channel release procedure can be used to request a dispatcher to join a voice group call channel as a talker.

q_2250.question: What is the expected sequence for the SEND USSD procedure with 7-bit default coding and text attribute?

q_2251.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in producing the "User Equipment (UE) conformance specification; Part 3: Abstract Test Suite (ATS)" technical specification?
q_2251.ground_truth: The 3GPP produced this specification to provide a detailed TTCN test design framework and the specific test specifications in TTCN for UE at the Uu interface.

q_2252.question: What does the new SGSN do after receiving the Forward SRNS Context message from the source RNC?
q_2252.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends a Forward SRNS Context Acknowledge message to the old SGSN to confirm the receipt.

q_2253.question: What is the result if the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure fails for a certain S-NSSAI?
q_2253.ground_truth: If the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure fails for a certain S-NSSAI, the AMF may initiate the PDU Session Release procedure to release the PDU sessions associated with that S-NSSAI.

q_2254.question: How does a UE know to remove stored Disaster Condition information after receiving a de-registration request?
q_2254.ground_truth: Upon receiving a registration reject, service reject, or de-registration request with 5GMM cause #11 (PLMN not allowed), the UE removes the stored information on Disaster Condition from its storage.

q_2255.question: What message does the MS include in the Initial Direct Transfer message (RRC) when requesting a Routeing Area Update?
q_2255.ground_truth: The RNC includes the old P-TMSI, old RAI, and old P-TMSI Signature in the Initial Direct Transfer message (RRC) from the MS to the RNC when requesting a Routeing Area Update.

q_2256.question: What is the acceptance criterion for step h) in sequence A?
q_2256.ground_truth: After step h), the Terminal indicates that the PIN2 has been blocked.

q_2257.question: What is the maximum code block size for turbo coding?
q_2257.ground_truth: The maximum code block size for turbo coding is 5114.

q_2258.question: What interface does NR-SS-UE 1 use for sidelink communication?

q_2259.question: What is the pre-condition for establishing a session-oriented service update in Solution #6?
q_2259.ground_truth: The pre-condition for establishing a session-oriented service update is that the VAE client (remote controller) has established a session-oriented service with a VAE client (remote vehicle) via the VAE server.

q_2260.question: How are new service names registered by 3GPP assigned?
q_2260.ground_truth: The name of a new service registered by 3GPP starts with "3gpp-", followed by a name identifying the application protocol defined by 3GPP.

q_2261.question: What command is used to order an individual mobile station to apply the CCN procedures in the serving cell or a new cell?
q_2261.ground_truth: The PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER message, PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message, or PS HANDOVER COMMAND message.

q_2262.question: What is an MBSFN cluster in the UTRAN network?
q_2262.ground_truth: An MBSFN cluster is a set of cells operating in MBSFN mode, providing only MBMS service in PtM mode, and appearing as a single cell to a UE in terms of radio frequency.

q_2263.question: What is the role of the Authorization Function in the local user authentication architecture?
q_2263.ground_truth: The Authorization Function acts as a proxy to the multi-factor authentication server (e.g., OP/NAF) and carries out authentication on behalf of the server. It confirms assertions generated from user credentials and provides authorization to use the GBA authentication.

q_2264.question: What should a UE do if the conditions for using the "mediasec" header field parameter for media plane security mechanisms are met?
q_2264.ground_truth: The UE may initiate the media security mechanism on a media level when it initiates new media in an existing session.

q_2265.question: What should the SCF do upon receipt of a SIP BYE message in PSS streaming session teardown?
q_2265.ground_truth: The SCF shall forward it to the PSS adapter and send a SIP BYE message to the IM CN Subsystem, and then to the UE.

q_2266.question: What element in a X.509 certificate contains the subject's public key information?

q_2267.question: What is the aim of the "Successful sessions forwarded to IBCF" measurement?
q_2267.ground_truth: The aim of the "Successful sessions forwarded to IBCF" measurement is to provide the number of successful sessions forwarded to the IBCF in the selected network for sessions routing to another IMS network or other SIP-based multimedia networks, if local policy requires IBCF capabilities towards another network.

q_2268.question: What information is included in the MBMS NOTIFICATION UPDATE COMMAND message?
q_2268.ground_truth: The MBMS NOTIFICATION UPDATE COMMAND message includes the NI Information IE, Modification Period IE, and MICH CFN IE.

q_2269.question: In the E-DCH FDD DL Control Channel Information IE in the E-DCH Serving Cell Change Information Response IE of the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message, what must the DRNS include for the other E-DCH Radio Link that has not been included in the E-DCH FDD DL Control Channel Information IE in RL Information Response IE, if the Serving E-DCH RL is not in the DRNS?
q_2269.ground_truth: The DRNS may include the E-RGCH/E-HICH Channelisation Code IE and/or the E-HICH Signature Sequence IE and/or the E-RGCH Signature Sequence IE, or alternatively include the E-RGCH Release Indicator IE in the E-DCH FDD DL Control Channel Information IE for the other E-DCH Radio Link.

q_2270.question: What should be the PLMN-BC parameter Information Transfer Capability when interworking with an indirectly connected restricted 64 kbit/s network is required?
q_2270.ground_truth: The PLMN-BC parameter Information Transfer Capability should be set to "Other ITC" and Other ITC parameter is set to "restricted digital" when interworking with an indirectly connected restricted 64 kbit/s network is required.

q_2271.question: What are the two main modes of operation for the mobile station in the GERAN architecture?
q_2271.ground_truth: The two main modes of operation for the mobile station in the GERAN architecture are A/Gb mode, used by pre-Release 5 terminals or Release 5 terminals when connected to a GERAN without an Iu interface towards the Core Network, and Iu mode, used by Release 5 terminals when connected to a GERAN with Iu interfaces towards the Core Network. Both modes must be supported by the standard, and no other modes are allowed.

q_2272.question: What frame rates are allowed for H.264/AVC Full HD Operation Point?
q_2272.ground_truth: A Bitstream conforming to the H.264/AVC Full HD Operation Point shall have one of the following frame rates: 24, 25, 30, 50, 60, 24/1.001, 30/1.001, 60/1.001 Hz.

q_2273.question: If the MS supports CAG, what information does the MS present to the user for each PLMN/access technology combination for NG-RAN access technology?
q_2273.ground_truth: The MS presents the PLMN/access technology combination, a list of CAG-IDs, and the PLMN/access technology combination without a list of CAG-IDs, if there is an available NG-RAN cell which is not a CAG cell for the PLMN.

q_2274.question: What is the method for identifying narrow band responses in receivers or duplex transceivers for the FDD and 3,84 Mcps TDD option?
q_2274.ground_truth: The method involves increasing and decreasing the unwanted signal frequency by 10 MHz and observing if the deviation disappears or not.

q_2275.question: In which direction does the BSSGP perform flow control between the SGSN and the BSS?

q_2276.question: What is the aim of the relations between the UIM model component and other model components?
q_2276.ground_truth: The aim is to have identical R0 for use between the UIM model component and other model components while the UIM model component needs to have no knowledge of its usage by classes of other model components, ensuring consistency in managing mobile managed resources and other managed resources.

q_2277.question: What is the function of the Automatic Neighbour Relation (ANR) in UTRAN?
q_2277.ground_truth: The Automatic Neighbour Relation (ANR) in UTRAN is responsible for detecting and managing the neighbour cells of a serving cell in order to improve the handover performance and network stability.

q_2278.question: What is the first byte in the UE operation mode coding in EFAd?
q_2278.ground_truth: The first byte in the UE operation mode coding in EFAd has the following possible values: '00' for normal operation, '80' for type approval operations, '01' for normal operation + specific facilities, '81' for type approval operations + specific facilities, and '02' for maintenance (off line).

q_2279.question: What is the function of FCS1-3 flow control signals in RTR Flow Control?
q_2279.ground_truth: The flow control signals FCS1-3 are combined with the RTR signal from the opposite 27.010 instance to create the local RTR input signal that signals flow control to the local application.

q_2280.question: Which information element is used to indicate the caused of a Position Periodic Termination?

q_2281.question: What is the suggested format for the title of a 3GPP TS or TR?
q_2281.ground_truth: The title of a 3GPP TS or TR should have three elements, proceeding from the general to the particular: (1) an introductory element "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group nn;" where nn is the full name of the TSG, (2) a main element indicating the principal subject treated within that general field, (3) a complementary element (optional) indicating the particular aspect of the principal subject.

q_2282.question: What actions should the UE take after successfully receiving a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message containing a 5G-GUTI and a network assistance required indicator of "true" during a mobility and periodic registration procedure on an NGC cell?
q_2282.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3519 if it is running and delete any stored SUCI.

q_2283.question: What is the function of the Request-URI with SIP URI in the SDP information of the SIP INVITE request or SIP re-INVITE request?
q_2283.ground_truth: The Request-URI with SIP URI in the SDP information specifies the remote UE's identity and the IP address and port for the media to be transferred.

q_2284.question: In what state will the UE be after successfully receiving a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message containing a 5G-GUTI and sending a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF?
q_2284.ground_truth: The UE will be in the state 5GMM-REGISTERED and the 5GS update status will be set to 5U1 UPDATED.

q_2285.question: What are the two implementations of IST described in the technical specification?
q_2285.ground_truth: The two implementations are based on CAMEL and a new MAP message.

q_2286.question: What is the purpose of the Authentication request during the onboarding procedure?
q_2286.ground_truth: The Authentication request is used to authenticate the supplied SUPI during the onboarding procedure.

q_2287.question: Which information element in the UTRAN mobility IEs contains the integrity protection mode info, ciphering mode info, new U-RNTI, new C-RNTI, and new H-RNTI?

q_2288.question: What is the purpose of the MeasurementJob in the context of the 3GPP TS 32.412?
q_2288.ground_truth: The MeasurementJob represents a task that monitors and collects performance measurement data of multiple measurementTypes of multiple ManagedEntity instances, at regular time intervals. The attributes of MeasurementJob, JobMeasurementSchedule and MeasuredAttribute can not be modified once a measurement job is created.

q_2289.question: How does the OCS specify the behavior on consumption of the final granted units when terminating an ABC Credit-Control session?
q_2289.ground_truth: The OCS may specify the behavior on consumption of the final granted units when terminating an ABC Credit-Control session through the use of a termination action. The required termination action is indicated with Final Unit Action, which can be either TERMINATE or REDIRECT. This is used to instruct the TDF on handling the application traffic once the granted quota is exhausted.

q_2290.question: What message is sent by the new SGSN if the security functions do not authenticate the MS correctly during a routeing area update?
q_2290.ground_truth: The old SGSN shall continue as if the Context Request was never received if the security functions do not authenticate the MS correctly.

q_2291.question: How can the MPS Service User invoke MPS for all participants on an MMTEL video conference call?
q_2291.ground_truth: The MPS Service User can invoke MPS for all participants using a customized feature of the video conference service that indicates a request for priority to the MPS capable 3GPP system.

q_2292.question: What does the "3GPP" refer to in the document title?

q_2293.question: What is the role of the symbols and abbreviations defined in 3GPP TS 37.571-1?
q_2293.ground_truth: The symbols and abbreviations defined in 3GPP TS 37.571-1 are used to define the terms and measurements related to the testing of positioning methods for User Equipment (UE) in FDD or TDD mode of UTRA and FDD or TDD mode of E-UTRA, NB-IOT and NR.

q_2294.question: What is the procedure for network registration in 5G network?
q_2294.ground_truth: The UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST to the NG-SS indicating the 5GS registration type IE as "initial registration" and 5GS mobile identity information element type "SUCI". Upon reception of REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with a 5G-GUTI, the UE sends REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the NG-SS.

q_2295.question: What is the difference between the Continue procedure and the ContinueWithArgument procedure in the IM-SSF?
q_2295.ground_truth: The Continue procedure does not provide additional service-related information to the user, while the ContinueWithArgument procedure does.

q_2296.question: What is the maximum number of reporting criteria that a UE should support in total for Intra-frequency, Inter frequency, and Inter-RAT measurements in the 8.3, 8.3A, and 8.3B sections?
q_2296.ground_truth: The UE should not support more than 14 reporting criteria in total for Intra-frequency, Inter frequency, and Inter-RAT measurements in the 8.3, 8.3A, and 8.3B sections.

q_2297.question: What does the TRS performance for handheld UE in FR1 apply to?
q_2297.ground_truth: The TRS performance for handheld UE in FR1 applies to both NR SA and EN-DC.

q_2298.question: What message does the UE provide in the UL NAS Transport message when establishing a MA PDU session?
q_2298.ground_truth: The UE provides a "MA PDU Request" indication in the UL NAS Transport message.

q_2299.question: What is the format and occurrence of the PriorityLevel leaf for V2X communication over the NR-PC5?
q_2299.ground_truth: The format is int and it occurs zero or one time.

q_2300.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the technical report produced on the measurement of user equipment (UE) over-the-air (OTA) performance for NR FR1?
q_2300.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing the technical report in question, which outlines the test methodology for Total Radiated Power (TRP) and Total Radiated Sensitivity (TRS) for NR FR1 in both standalone (SA) and non-standalone (NSA) operation modes.

q_2301.question: What is the role of the Announcing UE in the 5G ProSe restricted discovery?
q_2301.ground_truth: The Announcing UE is responsible for sending a Discovery Request message containing the ProSe Application ID to the DDNMF in its HPLMN to get permission to announce on its serving PLMN.

q_2302.question: What is the purpose of the Unblock PIN2 command as defined in ETSI TS 102 221?
q_2302.ground_truth: The Unblock PIN2 command is used to unblock the PIN2 on a multi-verification capable UICC, regardless of whether the PIN2 is currently blocked or not.

q_2303.question: What should the UE do if it receives the 5GMM cause value #13 (Roaming not allowed in this tracking area) in a REGISTRATION REJECT message and the TAI of the current cell is in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_2303.ground_truth: The UE should not attempt to registration.

q_2304.question: What are the responsibilities of a Data Collection Coordination Functionality (DCCF) and a Data Repository Functionality (DRF) as per 3GPP?
q_2304.ground_truth: A DCCF coordinates data collection from one or more NFs based on data collection requests from one or more Consumer NFs, while a DRF stores collected data and analytics. Both DCCF and DRF expose standardized interfaces for this purpose.

q_2305.question: How are the extra symbols obtained in timeslot aggregation?
q_2305.ground_truth: After the removal of guard period and tail bits between the two bursts, and the training sequence of one burst, 40.25 extra symbols will be retrieved from each aggregated fat burst, resulting in 80 or 240 extra bits for each block using MCS1-4 or MCS5-9 respectively.

q_2306.question: What is the sum of all supported per cause measurements for "Attempted outgoing intra-eNB/RN handovers per handover cause" measurement?
q_2306.ground_truth: The sum of all supported per cause measurements shall equal the total number of outgoing intra-eNB/RN handover events.

q_2307.question: How does the 4.2.2.3 test case verify the Charging ID Uniqueness requirement in 3GPP TS 32.251?
q_2307.ground_truth: The test case verifies that the P-GW assigns a unique Charging ID to every IP-CAN bearer requested by different CreateSessionRequest. This is done by triggering multiple consecutive CreateSessionRequest and checking that the Charging ID within Bearer Contexts Created in each generated CreateSessionResponse are different.

q_2308.question: What are the principles of the 3GPP network NF introduced in Solution 25?
q_2308.ground_truth: The 3GPP network NF UAVF is introduced to provide location information about the UAV and UAVC, monitor the UAV presence in the monitoring area, and expose other monitoring events notifications to UAVF. It is operated by the PLMN serving the target UAV/UAVC UE.

q_2309.question: What is the DTMF string sent to the network in expected sequence 1.1 and 1.2?
q_2309.ground_truth: The DTMF string sent to the network in expected sequence 1.1 is "1" pause "2", and in expected sequence 1.2 is "1234567890".

q_2310.question: Which network parameter is transmitted by the TT (NG-SS) on the BCCH in step 1 of the test case 1?
q_2310.ground_truth: The TAI (MCC/MNC/TAC) is transmitted by the TT (NG-SS) on the BCCH in step 1 of the test case 1.

q_2311.question: Who is responsible for the analysis and validation of noise suppression solutions for the AMR speech encoder in SMG11?
q_2311.ground_truth: SMG11 is responsible for analyzing and validating any AMR noise suppression solution which is voluntarily brought to their attention, using the requirements set out in this specification.

q_2312.question: Under what circumstances will UE-1 not signal additional delay availability to UE-2?
q_2312.ground_truth: UE-1 will not signal additional delay availability to UE-2 if it's already close to its JBM constraint and cannot tolerate any additional delay or jitter, as it would lead to more packets being dropped.

q_2313.question: What happens to the timer T3526 associated with the removed S-NSSAI(s) when the timer expires due to the maximum number of UEs reached being rejected?
q_2313.ground_truth: The timer T3526 associated with the removed S-NSSAI(s) shall be stopped, if running.

q_2314.question: In Solution #5, what access token method is utilized for authentication and authorization purpose of the UE to obtain the MSGin5G service from MSGin5G server?
q_2314.ground_truth: Access token is used for authentication and authorization purpose of the UE to obtain the MSGin5G service from MSGin5G server. This authorization method (OAuth2.0) is already being utilized in Mission Critical Services and Service-Based procedures.

q_2315.question: What should the UE do when the timer T3526 expires for the rejected NSSAI with the rejection cause of "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached"?
q_2315.ground_truth: The UE shall remove the S-NSSAI in the rejected NSSAI and initiate a registration procedure.

q_2316.question: What is required for outgoing international communications to be true?
q_2316.ground_truth: Outgoing international communications is true when the request URI of the outgoing SIP request corresponds to a telephone number, and does not point to a destination served by a network within the country where the originating user is located.

q_2317.question: What should the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure be instructed to generate and transmit when the Single Entry PHR MAC CE is used, as defined in subclause 6.1.3.8?
q_2317.ground_truth: The Multiplexing and Assembly procedure should be instructed to generate and transmit the Single Entry PHR MAC CE based on the values reported by the physical layer.

q_2318.question: What is the sequence and individual importance of the parameters in the encoded speech output in the AMR wideband speech codec?
q_2318.ground_truth: The encoder will produce the output information in a unique sequence and format, and the individual parameters of the encoded speech have unequal importance with respect to subjective quality. The output and input frame formats for the AMR wideband speech codec are reordered to optimize the speech quality.

q_2319.question: What information must the MSC/SGSN send when initiating the periodic location cancellation request to the UE?
q_2319.ground_truth: The MSC/SGSN must include the LDR reference number and H-GMLC address when initiating the periodic location cancellation request to the UE.

q_2320.question: What is the issue described in Key Issue #3 regarding UE support of UP IP at the full uplink data rate?
q_2320.ground_truth: The issue described in Key Issue #3 is that it is not possible to support UP IP at the UE's full data rate in all cases due to certain delay sensitive use cases. This key issue aims to study solutions for supporting UP IP at the UE supported full data rate on the uplink.

q_2321.question: What is the operation used to instruct the gsmSSF on the charging information to send?

q_2322.question: What type of changes are considered minor in CAP protocol?
q_2322.ground_truth: A minor change is a change of a functionality which is not essential for the requested IN service. It can be a modification of an existing function or additional functionality that is not executed at all, and the peer Application Entity (AE) need not know about the effects of the change.
