q_2565.ground_truth: The SMF sends event exposure to AF (late notification) about the new UP path after Target BP/ULCL and Target UPF (PSA3) have been activated, indicating that context migration between old and new EAS is completed and the application client is instructed for when and how to switch to the New EAS, using Application Layer procedures.

q_2566.question: What does the abbreviation "GEO" stand for in the context of non-terrestrial networks?

q_2567.question: What is the role of the 5GPRUK in the UE-to-network relay security flow?
q_2567.ground_truth: The 5GPRUK is a relay key generated by the 5GPKMF of the relay service for the Remote UE, used for establishing a secure connection between the Remote UE and the UE-to-network Relay UE. The 5GPRUK is generated based on an AV of the Remote UE or derived from the SUCI if the Remote UE does not already have a 5GPRUK.

q_2568.question: What is the value of Subsession-Operation AVP in the V-PCRF when an existing S9 session for the roaming user is already established and if no Gateway Control Session for the same PDN ID exists?
q_2568.ground_truth: The value of Subsession-Operation AVP in the V-PCRF is "ESTABLISHMENT".

q_2569.question: What is the purpose of the common objectives stated in the 3GPP Technical Report 38.802?
q_2569.ground_truth: The common objectives are to further discuss and agree on the UE MOP, MPR, and ACLR, taking into account their interactions and other related parameters during the WI phase.

q_2570.question: What measures should be taken in the "non-transparent case" regarding data and status lines in the RLP?
q_2570.ground_truth: In the "non-transparent case," the RLP satisfies the requirement for both data and status lines.

q_2571.question: How does the NM-RMS collect PEE parameters in the 3GPP network?
q_2571.ground_truth: The NM-RMS collects PEE parameters from part or whole of the radio access network and may control PEE-related parameters through DM(s) and/or XCU/DGU(s) and/or VS-RMS(s).

q_2572.question: What does "User Connectivity" refer to in the context of networks?
q_2572.ground_truth: User Connectivity refers to the capability to establish and maintain data transfer between networks and terminals.

q_2573.question: In the LTE download tab, what does the "Kt" column represent?
q_2573.ground_truth: The total number of source symbols for the test cases for the RFC 5053 code.

q_2574.question: What is the technique used to ensure all symbols are transmitted at least once after 3 transmissions of a block?
q_2574.ground_truth: Modification to the scheme includes the transmission of all symbols at least once after 3 transmissions of a block to improve throughput performance.

q_2575.question: What is the event listed in the "EVENT DOWNLOAD - IMS Registration 7.1.1" log?

q_2576.question: What information does the PLCCH Sequence Number represent in 3G UMTS?
q_2576.ground_truth: This sequence number represents a portion of a PLCCH used to signal TPC / SS bits to a single UE. A value of zero indicates that the PLCCH assignment has been deleted.

q_2577.question: Which timer should the mobile station start when the last allocated RLC data block of an initial fixed uplink allocation has been transmitted?
q_2577.ground_truth: The mobile station starts timer T3226 after transmitting the last allocated RLC data block.

q_2578.question: What is the responsible entity for intercepting MMS messages at the GSN?
q_2578.ground_truth: The GSN is not responsible for recovering individual MMS messages from the user PDP context IP stream.

q_2579.question: What is the purpose of user plane tunnelling in EGAN handovers and LA/RA Update signalling?
q_2579.ground_truth: The purpose of user plane tunnelling is to identify the flow inside the IPsec for EGAN handovers and LA/RA Update signalling.

q_2580.question: What IF is used by the gsmSSF to report to the gsmSCF the information requested in the Apply Charging IF?

q_2581.question: What is the effect of the activation and deactivation of the discontinuous downlink reception operation?
q_2581.ground_truth: The activation and deactivation of the discontinuous downlink reception operation is applied by the UE 12 slots after the ending of the HS-SCCH subframe delivering the order.

q_2582.question: What is the maximum number of timers that can be allocated for all applets?

q_2583.question: Where are the privacy profile data stored for EPS?
q_2583.ground_truth: The privacy profile data for EPS are stored in H-GMLC/PPR.

q_2584.question: Which command type is used to set up idle mode text, and what is its command qualifier?
q_2584.ground_truth: The command type used to set up idle mode text is "SET UP IDLE MODE TEXT," and its command qualifier is "RFU."

q_2585.question: In downlink RLC/MAC control blocks, what does the TFI field identify?
q_2585.ground_truth: The TFI field in downlink RLC/MAC control blocks identifies the Temporary Block Flow (TBF) to which the RLC data block belongs.

q_2586.question: What is the purpose of sending multiple IEs in the PFCP Session Establishment Response message from UP Function to CP Function?
q_2586.ground_truth: The order of the IEs in the message indicates the priority of the DNS or NBNS server addresses, with the first IE containing the primary address and the second IE containing the secondary address.

q_2587.question: What is the default value of the Mobile Country Code (MCC) in the E-UTRAN parameters of the system simulator?
q_2587.ground_truth: The default value of the Mobile Country Code (MCC) in the E-UTRAN parameters of the system simulator is 001.

q_2588.question: In the context of failed GPRS inter-SGSN Routing Area update procedures, what does the "2 out of 3 approach" refer to?
q_2588.ground_truth: It means that at least two out of the three defined measurements (Combined, GSM, UMTS) need to be supported for each specific reject cause.

q_2589.question: Which network entities does CAMEL support for IP multimedia sessions?
q_2589.ground_truth: CAMEL supports IP multimedia sessions addressed by either E.164 numbers or SIP URLs.

q_2590.question: What is the implication of Level 5 in the Generic Autonomy Capability Description for Management System?
q_2590.ground_truth: Level 5 implies that the entire fault management workflow is accomplished by the telecom system without human intervention, but human supervision is optional.

q_2591.question: What is the TERMINAL RESPONSE COMMAND when the PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL 8.2.1 is sent and received successfully?
q_2591.ground_truth: TERMINAL RESPONSE (Command performed successfully) with Channel status CHANNEL STATUS: Channel identifier 1 and link established.

q_2592.question: What is the responsibilities of the Control Plane Charging Nodes (CPCN) in the 3GPP charging architecture?
q_2592.ground_truth: The CPCN records Control Plane data transfer and generates charging information, which can be used for Offline Charging.

q_2593.question: What is the role of IKEv2 in negotiating the IPsec security association?
q_2593.ground_truth: The UE supports the IKEv2 protocol for negotiating the IPsec security association to secure DSMIPv6 signalling, and uses EAP over IKEv2 for authentication with an AAA server. The UE supports IPsec ESP and multiple authentication exchanges in the IKEv2 protocol to support authentication with an external AAA server, and the redirect mechanism is also supported.

q_2594.question: How does the Terminal control network access based on the access classes as signaled by the E-USS?
q_2594.ground_truth: If the UE is a member of at least one access class which corresponds to the permitted classes as signaled over the air interface, and the access class is applicable in the serving network, access attempts are allowed. Otherwise, access attempts are not allowed.

q_2595.question: What is the purpose of Solution #3.2 in the converged charging architecture?
q_2595.ground_truth: Solution #3.2 relies on CHF/5G Converged Charging System for 5G VN group unicast communication charging, and addresses the Key Issue #3.1 with the different that UPF1 reports the usage volume per PDU session per UE to SMF.

q_2596.question: What information is required to define a solution similar to the Ua protocol given in 3GPP TS 33.222 for shared key-based mutual authentication between UE and AF?

q_2597.question: What does the State attributes IE specify in the STATUS message?
q_2597.ground_truth: The State attributes IE specifies information about the state of a call or the connection.

q_2598.question: What type of information is specified in the "cn-CommonGSM-MAP-NAS-SysInfo" field?

q_2599.question: What type of channel is the Dedicated Traffic Channel (DTCH) in LTE?
q_2599.ground_truth: The Dedicated Traffic Channel (DTCH) is a point-to-point bi-directional channel dedicated to one UE for the transfer of user information in LTE.

q_2600.question: What should a UE do with GRUUs if it indicated support for GRUU in the Supported header field of the REGISTER request and used the procedures specified in RFC 6140?
q_2600.ground_truth: The UE should store the value of the "pub-gruu" header field parameter for use for generating public GRUUs for registering UAs and the value of the "temp-gruu-cookie" header field parameter for use for generating temporary GRUUs for registering UAs.

q_2601.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS Key Management function?
q_2601.ground_truth: The MBMS Key Management function is used to distribute MBMS keys to authorized UEs for securing MBMS user services data.

q_2602.question: What field does the HS-DSCH data frame header include to which the RNC can include the received measurement results on RACH?
q_2602.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH data frame header includes a "RACH Measurement Result" field.

q_2603.question: What is the function of the serviceArea element within the availabilityInfo element of an MBMS User Service Description?
q_2603.ground_truth: The serviceArea element within the availabilityInfo element indicates the one or more service areas over which this MBMS User Service is provided, and is designated by the MBMS Service Area Identity.

q_2604.question: What is the purpose of the ABIM object classes for authentication methods?
q_2604.ground_truth: The purpose of the ABIM object classes for authentication methods is to represent data that is required to perform Authentication and Key Agreement (AKA) for different types of services, such as GPRS, EPS, CS, IMS, and others. Each object class represents the data that is required to perform AKA for a specific type of service.

q_2605.question: What information must be provided by the SMF during initial registration for enabling P-CSCF restoration in 5G networks?
q_2605.ground_truth: The SMF must provide sufficient information, including DNN for IMS and callback URI for P-CSCF restoration, to the UDM during initial registration to trigger P-CSCF restoration.

q_2606.question: What is the maximum allowed peak code domain error for spreading factor 256?
q_2606.ground_truth: The peak code domain error shall not exceed -35 dB at spreading factor 256.

q_2607.question: What happens if the mobile station is unable to establish a connection on the channel(s) in GERAN Iu mode?
q_2607.ground_truth: The mobile station reactivates the old channel(s), reconnects TCHs, triggers the establishment of the main signalling link and sends a HANDOVER FAILURE message on the main signalling link before resuming normal operation.

q_2608.question: What information does the AMF of SNPN#2 provide to the UE about where each PDU session anchors?
q_2608.ground_truth: The AMF of SNPN#2 can provide the UE with information on where each PDU session anchors and the corresponding mobility indication indicating which procedure to use for handover of each PDU session. This information can be provided in the AMF's response to the UE's registration request.

q_2609.question: What is actualUESliceAMBR defined as in this solution?
q_2609.ground_truth: In this solution, actualUESliceAMBR is defined as the accumulated session AMBR across all the active PDU sessions associated with the same network slice per UE in UL and DL + accumulated MFBR across all active GBR flows associated with the same network slice per UE in UL and DL.

q_2610.question: What is the role of the GUP Component Language (GCL) in 3GPP GUP?
q_2610.ground_truth: The GCL is used for referencing components in 3GPP GUP. It is a subset of the XPath 1.0 language and is used to define the language syntax for GUP.

q_2611.question: What is the action taken by the UE if an access attempt is barred?
q_2611.ground_truth: If the access attempt is barred, the NAS shall not initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt.

q_2612.question: What is the consequence of the absence of the OSId leaf in ANDSF/IARP/<X>/ForNonSeamlessOffload/<X>/IPFlow/<X>/App-ID?
q_2612.ground_truth: The absence of the OSId leaf in ANDSF/IARP/<X>/ForNonSeamlessOffload/<X>/IPFlow/<X>/App-ID indicates that the operating system identifier is not examined when matching packets against the IP flow description of the rule.

q_2613.question: Which type is the attribute that has legal values "NPT" or "UTC" and follows the append resolution rule?

q_2614.question: What is the length of the CRC for HS-DSCH using CRC attachment method 1?
q_2614.ground_truth: The length of the CRC for HS-DSCH using CRC attachment method 1 is always 24 bits.

q_2615.question: What should be done in the case where the AOC information is transported in a message and the AS is forwarding the message and there is already a content body, but the user's UE has not indicated support for multipart content?
q_2615.ground_truth: The AS should forward the message unchanged.

q_2616.question: What are the measurements related to CSCF defined in the present document?
q_2616.ground_truth: The measurements defined in clause 4.1 are related to the functionality aspect performance, and the detailed measurements for CSCF are defined in subclauses 4.1.1, 4.1.2, and 4.1.3.

q_2617.question: What should the UE do upon the expiry of a periodical reporting timer for a measId?
q_2617.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5.

q_2618.question: What are the two main sub-frequency ranges in FR2?
q_2618.ground_truth: FR2 has been divided into two sub-frequency ranges: FR2-1 which covers the original range of 24.25-52.6 GHz, and FR2-2 which extends NR operation from 52.6 to 71 GHz.

q_2619.question: What is the role of the least common multiple in PRS resource sets with different periodicities?
q_2619.ground_truth: The least common multiple of the periodicities of PRS resource sets is used to derive a time period for PRS resource measurements.

q_2620.question: What is the role of the Aggregator NWDAF in the multiple NWDAF deployment scenario?
q_2620.ground_truth: The Aggregator NWDAF aggregates per Analytics ID Data and/or Output Analytics coming from multiple Data Sources, including one or more distributed NWDAFs and/or from NFs, and supports aggregating Output Analytics per Analytics ID. The Aggregator NWDAF may require additional data, such as metadata along with analytics output data provided by multiple NWDAFs, to create a single Output Analytics.

q_2621.question: Under what conditions should the UE delete the stored Rejected NSSAI and attempt to use the rejected NSSAI in the current PLMN?
q_2621.ground_truth: The UE should delete the stored Rejected NSSAI and attempt to use the rejected NSSAI in the current PLMN if the UE has been switched off, then switched on, after receiving a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with rejected NSSAI with the reject cause "S-NSSAI not available in the current PLMN".

q_2622.question: What types of information are defined in Annex B of the 3GPP Technical Specification for Trace Management?
q_2622.ground_truth: Annex B of the 3GPP Technical Specification for Trace Management provides the XML definitions. It includes definitions for XML schemas, XML complex types, XML element types, XML namespaces, and other XML related terms.

q_2623.question: In what type of scenarios does the V-PCRF proxy the Gateway Control Session Termination or the Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision between the BBERF in the VPLMN and the H-PCRF when home routed access is used or case 2a applies for Local Breakout?

q_2624.question: What is the definition of DSCH in the UTRAN?
q_2624.ground_truth: DSCH is a shared downlink channel for which resource allocation is performed by RRC in Controlling RNC, it exists in downlink only, it has impact on the physical and transport channel levels, it supports code multiplexing, and it is transmitted in a single cell only.

q_2625.question: In Release of shared MBS session (Alternative B), what message is sent by the AMF to the MB-SMF after releasing the MB session management context for the shared MBS session?
q_2625.ground_truth: The AMF transmits an Nsmf Release SMContext response message to the MB-SMF.

q_2626.question: What is the 3rd IMD product generated by dual uplink of Band n66 and Band n77 in the 5DL/2UL CA scenario?
q_2626.ground_truth: The 3rd IMD generated by dual uplink of Band n66 + Band n77 may fall into own Rx of band n29.

q_2627.question: When a UE should consider an MBSFN cluster as a candidate during the MBSFN cluster selection and MBSFN cluster re-selection procedures?
q_2627.ground_truth: A UE should consider an MBSFN cluster as a candidate during the MBSFN cluster selection and MBSFN cluster re-selection procedures if the UE is assigned to access class 11 or 15 and the MBSFN cluster belongs to the home PLMN or to any EHPLMN.

q_2628.question: What should the UE include in the INVITE request when initiating an emergency call as an unregistered user?
q_2628.ground_truth: The UE should include a To header field with the same emergency service URN as in the Request-, a service URN in the Request- of the initial INVITE request, a P-Access-Network-Info header field in any request for a dialog, the UE's IP address and an unprotected port in the Contact header field, the IP address of the UE in the Via header field, and if the UE has its location information available, a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request.

q_2629.question: What is the effect of N1 on the maximum frame size in the case of a Type 2 convergence layer being used?
q_2629.ground_truth: The maximum frame size should be chosen carefully to ensure that it can contain a complete protocol frame.

q_2630.question: What is the minimum time shift buffer depth in the MPD example for Use Case D?
q_2630.ground_truth: The minimum time shift buffer depth in the MPD example for Use Case D is 3600 seconds (1 hour).

q_2631.question: What is the role of the 3GPP system in UAV connectivity to USS over UAV9?
q_2631.ground_truth: The 3GPP system provides enablers to support geofencing functionality for in-flight UAVs and geocaging functionality for UAVs on the ground intending to fly, and allows UAVs to establish connectivity with a DNN to exchange traffic with the USS without USS authorization, based on existing MNO policies.

q_2632.question: How can a UE perform onboarding and remote provisioning with SNPN?
q_2632.ground_truth: A registration procedure should be supported that enables UE onboarding using Default UE credentials with an O-SNPN as the Onboarding Network, and one SNPN can take the role of both Onboarding Network (ON) and SO, and it should be possible for the ON and SO to be different SNPNs (O-SNPN and SO-SNPN). Regarding UE onboarding using Default UE credentials and O-SNPN as the Onboarding Network (ON), the distribution of security functions when primary authentication is used should be decided by SA~WG3.

q_2633.question: What is the peak data rate increase that can be achieved by combining HOMTC including 32QAM and a 5 timeslot allocation as compared to EGPRS?
q_2633.ground_truth: The peak data rate increase can exceed 100%.

q_2634.question: What is the purpose of the Heartbeat Mechanism in 3GPP Proximity-Based MIPv6 path management?
q_2634.ground_truth: The Heartbeat Mechanism in 3GPP Proximity-Based MIPv6 path management is used for Failure Detection and Restart Detection between a LMA or MAG. It is defined in IETF RFC 5847 and sends Heartbeat Request messages periodically (no more often than every 60 seconds) to detect path failures.

q_2635.question: What information does the MS include in the GAN-RR HANDOVER REQUIRED message to the GANC during the handover process?
q_2635.ground_truth: The MS includes the Channel Mode and a list of GERAN cells, identified by CGI, in order of preference for handover.

q_2636.question: What does the Iur interface provide capability for in regard to data streams?
q_2636.ground_truth: The Iur interface provides the means for transport of uplink and downlink Iub/Iur DCH data streams.

q_2637.question: What information is carried in the MMS CC PDU to be sent to the LEMF when CC is reported?
q_2637.ground_truth: The MMS CC PDU to be sent to the LEMF when CC is reported contains information such as the time of the MMS, the source and destination addresses, and the message size.

q_2638.question: What is the maximum number of successive data blocks in one RTP packet for CSData?
q_2638.ground_truth: The maximum number of successive data blocks in one RTP packet for CSData is 3, known as redundancy level 3.

q_2639.question: What is the difference between the first digit of the version number in the 3GPP 3GPP technical specifications, and how it is used to indicate the approval status of the document?
q_2639.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the approval status of the document by the 3GPP Technical Specification (TSG). The values can be 0 for presented to TSG for information, 1 for presented to TSG for approval, and greater than 1 for TSG approved document under change control.

q_2640.question: How many bits are used for number of transport blocks preferred in Type A CQI bit mapping?
q_2640.ground_truth: Two bits are used for number of transport blocks preferred in Type A CQI bit mapping.

q_2641.question: What does the mobile station do when the GERAN receives an MBMS SESSION STOP REQUEST message from the SGSN, indicating that the MBMS session can be released?
q_2641.ground_truth: The mobile station ignores this message, as it is only relevant for the network.

q_2642.question: How often should a mobile station attempt to receive the SI13 or PSI13 message when camped on a cell where PBCCH is not present?
q_2642.ground_truth: A mobile station should attempt to receive the SI13 or PSI13 message at least every 30 seconds when camped on a cell where PBCCH is not present.

q_2643.question: What action is taken if the CLI measurement resource is removed from the cli-TriggeredList in the VarMeasReportList for a specific measId?
q_2643.ground_truth: The concerned CLI measurement resource(s) are removed from the cli-TriggeredList in the VarMeasReportList for that measId.

q_2644.question: How does the adaptive bit-allocation scheme work in allocating bits to bands?
q_2644.ground_truth: The adaptive bit-allocation scheme uses the quantized band energies to allocate the available bits in a frame among the bands. It adaptively groups the band energies into a number of groups and allocates variable number of bits to each group based on characteristics between the groups. Then, it allocates bits to bands within groups based on the available bit budget to the groups. The energy difference between maximum energy of a subvector in a group and average subvector energy of the rest of the groups is calculated to determine the energy difference between groups.

q_2645.question: What information should be included in the GANSS Real Time Integrity IE if the GANSS Signal ID IE is not present in a Satellite Information IE?
q_2645.ground_truth: It is associated with all the signals of the corresponding satellite by default.

q_2646.question: Which two network entities are involved in the HPLMN and IPLMN when an MS is being called in another PLMN?
q_2646.ground_truth: HPLMN contains HLRB and IPLMN contains GMSCB.

q_2647.question: What message is sent from RNC2 to RNC1 to indicate an information exchange failure in the described procedure?
q_2647.ground_truth: The INFORMATION EXCHANGE FAILURE INDICATION message

q_2648.question: What is a Mobile Termination (MT) in the context of the 3GPP system?
q_2648.ground_truth: A Mobile Termination (MT) in the 3GPP system is a functional entity that contains the Terminal Adaptation Functions (TAF) which enables the use of synchronous bearer services in the PLMN and the attachment of Synchronous Terminals to an MT.

q_2649.question: What is the difference between autonomous mode and coordinated mode in RAN delay budget reporting?
q_2649.ground_truth: In autonomous mode, MTSI sender and MTSI receiver independently use RAN delay budget reporting mechanisms toward adjusting air interface delay in their respective RANs without coordination. In contrast, in coordinated mode, MTSI sender and MTSI receiver trigger and use RAN delay budget reporting mechanisms in a coordinated fashion, and exchange delay budget information with each other.

q_2650.question: What is the purpose of a User Agent in ATSC 3.0 standard?
q_2650.ground_truth: A User Agent is a W3C-compliant execution environment for broadcaster applications in ATSC 3.0. It enables a broadcaster application to run and may employ graphical capabilities of the ATSC 3.0 receiver to render the user interface.

q_2651.question: What does the SS send to the UE to request location information?
q_2651.ground_truth: The SS sends a LPP REQUEST LOCATION INFORMATION message, including the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation IE.

q_2652.question: What shall a secondary device do if it receives a message which addressed device subunit does not exist?
q_2652.ground_truth: If a secondary device receives a procedure message which addressed device subunit does not exist, it shall respond with "FormatError".

q_2653.question: What will the BSS do upon reception of an MBMS-SESSION-UPDATE-REQUEST PDU with new MBMS Service Area(s)?
q_2653.ground_truth: The BSS may send assignments for the ongoing MBMS broadcast service session to the mobile stations in the new MBMS Service Area(s) and repeat notifications to the mobile stations in the old MBMS Service Area(s).

q_2654.question: What is the content distribution approach using satellite backhaul and traditional caching policies?
q_2654.ground_truth: The content distribution approach using satellite backhaul and traditional caching policies involves storing popular content in the edge and streaming it from a location closer to end-users. Satellite backhaul provides large bandwidth and multicast capabilities, which can lead to a more efficient content distribution process.

q_2655.question: What is the message type of the Interworking Security Data (InterSD) message?
q_2655.ground_truth: The message type of the Interworking Security Data (InterSD) message is InterSD-MESSAGE.

q_2656.question: Which element is used to indicate the version of the Associated Delivery Procedures schema being used?

q_2657.question: What is the duration of the first session in the session schedule?
q_2657.ground_truth: The first session in the session schedule lasts for 30 minutes, starting from UTC March 1st 2012 23:00:00 and ending at UTC March 1st 2012 23:30:00.

q_2658.question: How many octets long can the Field length of Spare Extension IE be in the HS-DSCH DATA FRAME TYPE 1?
q_2658.ground_truth: The Field length of Spare Extension IE in HS-DSCH DATA FRAME TYPE 1 is 0-25 octets.

q_2659.question: What are the two layer 1 options for implementing the Iuant interface in UTRA, E-UTRA, and NR?
q_2659.ground_truth: The two layer 1 options are the RS485 option, which uses a screened multicore cable, and the Modem option, which uses a connection to a RET and/or TMA control unit by way of a coaxial cable.

q_2660.question: What is the maximum possible equal frequency spacing (Deq) in the declared maximum Base Station RF bandwidth (RF-BWmax) for test case b)?
q_2660.ground_truth: Deq is a multiple of 200 kHz within RF-BWmax.

q_2661.question: What fields does the UE need to set in the ra-InformationCommon while setting the contents in it?
q_2661.ground_truth: The UE needs to set the absoluteFrequencyPointA, locationAndBandwidth, subcarrierSpacing, msg1-FrequencyStart, msg1-FDM, msg1-SubcarrierSpacing, msg1-FrequencyStartCFRA, msg1-FDMCFRA and msg1-SubcarrierSpacingCFRA in the ra-InformationCommon while setting the contents in it.

q_2662.question: What is the main difference between the reference picture management in H.264 (AVC) and H.265 (HEVC)?
q_2662.ground_truth: H.264 (AVC) uses a sliding window plus adaptive memory management control operation (MMCO) based reference picture marking mechanism, while H.265 (HEVC) specifies a reference picture set (RPS) based reference picture management and marking mechanism.

q_2663.question: What should the O&M system be informed and the reset procedure stopped if the EI received in an NS-RESET-ACK PDU is different from the NSEI locally associated with the NS-VC?
q_2663.ground_truth: The O&M system should be informed of an unexpected EI value in an NS-RESET-ACK PDU.

q_2664.question: What is the Far scatterer cluster model used for in the context of urban macro-cells?
q_2664.ground_truth: The Far scatterer cluster model is used to represent the bad-urban case in urban macro-cells where additional clusters are seen in the environment. This model is used to represent the primary and far scattering cluster (FSC) in the environment.

q_2665.question: What must a mobile station do if it supports multiple TBF procedures and MBMS and has received multiple MBMS radio bearers in decreasing order of priority?
q_2665.ground_truth: The mobile station shall be able to receive as many MBMS sessions as possible in decreasing order of priority, and transmit MBMS DOWNLINK ACK/NACK messages for as many MBMS sessions as possible in decreasing order of priority.

q_2666.question: What is the difference between a Radio Bearer and a Radio Access Bearer in a telecommunications network?
q_2666.ground_truth: A Radio Access Bearer is the service that the access stratum provides to the non-access stratum for transfer of user data between User Equipment and CN, while a Radio Bearer is the service provided by the Layer 2 for transfer of user data between User Equipment and UTRAN.

q_2667.question: What are the two possible reporting intervals that can be set for the UE in some systems?
q_2667.ground_truth: The two possible reporting intervals are every 1h when the UE becomes in-coverage, or a longer interval if there is no requirement of timely report.

q_2668.question: What should a UE registered over both 3GPP and non-3GPP access in different PLMNs do to initiate a UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure?
q_2668.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the procedure over 3GPP access and non-3GPP access sequentially and consider the MA PDU session established once it receives the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message over one access. The UE should then initiate the procedure over the other access to establish user plane resources on both 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

q_2669.question: When can a mobile station return to packet transfer mode after a channel release procedure in group transmit mode?
q_2669.ground_truth: A mobile station can maintain its radio resources allocated on one or more PDCHs and enter packet transfer mode if it is operating in dual transfer mode and the network and mobile station support enhanced DTM CS release procedure when the RR connection is released.

q_2670.question: In which state can the procedure for CS handover from GAN A/Gb mode be initiated?
q_2670.ground_truth: The procedure for CS handover from GAN A/Gb mode can be initiated in the GA-CSR-DEDICATED state.

q_2671.question: How many received signal level measurement samples are required per RSSI value for a UE not requiring measurement occasions?
q_2671.ground_truth: At least 3 received signal level measurement samples are required per RSSI value for a UE not requiring measurement occasions.

q_2672.question: What is the role of the ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHighRAN threshold condition in the context of UTRAN?
q_2672.ground_truth: The ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHighRAN threshold condition is evaluated to determine if a high threshold value of beacon RSSI threshold provided by E-UTRAN/UTRAN is being taken into account when evaluating the validity of a rule. If the threshold value has not been received from E-UTRAN/UTRAN, the UE considers this node as not matching.

q_2673.question: What is the default behavior of the UE when the R value of multiple cells is within the rangeToBestCell of the highest-ranked cell during the reselection procedure?
q_2673.ground_truth: The UE will perform cell reselection to the highest ranked cell among them.

q_2674.question: What does the abbreviation SA denote in SAI in RL-InformationResponse-RL-AdditionRspTDD768?

q_2675.question: What is the protected NAS security context container in the 5G network?
q_2675.ground_truth: The protected NAS security context container is a container that includes the security context, keyAmfHDerivationInd indicator (if needed), and potentially UL/DL NAS COUNTs. It is used to protect the 5G NAS security context and is created by the initial AMF using an ephemeral encryption key and ephemeral MAC key generated with the target AMF's public key.

q_2676.question: What is the definition of LC, LR and LSA in this telecommunication management context?
q_2676.ground_truth: LC stands for LSA Controller which is a part of the NMLS (Network Management Layer Service). LR stands for LSA Repository, a repository containing LSA information. LSA stands for Licensed Shared Access which refers to a system allowing access for mobile/fixed communication networks (MFCNs) in the 2 300 MHz - 2 400 MHz band under licensed shared access (LSA) conditions.

q_2677.question: What information is added to the complete layer 3 information message for an exclusive access cell during location updating?
q_2677.ground_truth: The LSA ID(s) of the current cell is added to the complete layer 3 information message for the exclusive access cell during location updating.

q_2678.question: In the context of the first paragraph, what is the user rate when the user information layer 1 protocol is V.110, I.460/X.30 and the BC retrieved from the VLR indicates FTM?

q_2679.question: What is the requirement for the selection of the local IP endpoint for a given NSEI in the LSP?
q_2679.ground_truth: The LSP is used by an NS entity to select a local IP endpoint from the available local IP endpoints for the given NSEI, based on an implementation-dependent function.

q_2680.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS User Service Consumption Reporting functionality?
q_2680.ground_truth: The MBMS User Service Consumption Reporting functionality enables the MBMS service operator to make dynamic decisions on whether to establish or tear down service delivery over an MBMS bearer based on real-time demand. This helps the MBMS service operator to better utilize overall network resources in supporting unicast and/or MBMS services delivery.

q_2681.question: In what format are the test sequence files provided in the archive files (ZIP format) that accompany the present document?
q_2681.ground_truth: The test sequence files are provided in PC (little-endian) byte order in the archive files (ZIP format).

q_2682.question: What is one use of interactivity usage information in the use cases?
q_2682.ground_truth: Interactivity usage information is used to derive statistics on the amount of viewing of interactive advertisements.

q_2683.question: How does the User Equipment (UE) initiate QUIC Connections for QoS Flows over 3GPP access?
q_2683.ground_truth: The UE initiates a new QUIC Connection for each access and QoS Flow. This can be triggered when a new QoS Flow is created, either when the UE receives a QoS Rule with a new QFI (QoS Flow Identity) from the network or when a derived QoS Rule is created with a new QFI.

q_2684.question: What is the purpose of allocating a link-specific IP address for the User Equipment (UE) in cases where MP-TCP functionality is used?
q_2684.ground_truth: Allocating a link-specific IP address for the UE is not necessary when using ATSSS-LL functionality, as it handles traffic steering, switching, or splitting without the need for a link-specific IP address.

q_2685.question: What is the condition that needs to be satisfied for a code to be used in a timeslot in the code tree method?
q_2685.ground_truth: A code can be used in a timeslot if and only if no other code on the path from the specific code to the root of the tree or in the sub-tree below the specific code is used in this timeslot.

q_2686.question: What should a receiving entity do when receiving a message with a syntactically incorrect mandatory information element?
q_2686.ground_truth: The receiver should ignore the message and return a corresponding response message with the cause IE set to "Mandatory IE incorrect", together with the type of the offending mandatory IE.

q_2687.question: What is the difference between Filter Criteria and Transit Invocation Criteria in IMS communication service?
q_2687.ground_truth: The set of Filter Criteria is user specific, while the set of Transit Invocation Criteria is not user specific, but instead is based on the originating and terminating networks. The purpose and handling of Transit Invocation Criteria is identical to the handling of Filter Criteria. However, the procedures in subclause 5.2.2 associated with the handling of SIP REGISTER request do not apply to the handling of Transit Invocation Criteria.

q_2688.question: What is the role of AF1 in the initial PDU Session establishment procedure?
q_2688.ground_truth: AF1 is involved in the initial PDU Session establishment procedure with SMF/5GC.

q_2689.question: What ciphering algorithms should ProSe enabled Public Safety UEs implement for ciphering one-to-many traffic?
q_2689.ground_truth: ProSe enabled Public Safety UEs should implement EEA0, 128-EEA1, 128-EEA2, and may implement 128-EEA3.

q_2690.question: What is the function of the P-CSCF and PDN-GW or IMS-AGW in generating IRI and CC messages?
q_2690.ground_truth: The P-CSCF generates IRI messages, and the PDN-GW or IMS-AGW generates CC messages in the VPLMN for IMS.

q_2691.question: What was the significance of the difference in equalization results between ES202 and TS 103 224 in the noise field simulations?
q_2691.ground_truth: The binaural equalization using TS 103 224-4.0, TS103-4.1, and TS103-8.0 systems yielded smoother equalization compared to ES202.

q_2692.question: What action should the UE take if it receives 5GMM cause value #28 (Restricted service area) in a SERVICE REJECT message and the service type is set to "elevated signalling"?
q_2692.ground_truth: The UE should not re-initiate the service request procedure until it enters an allowed area or leaves a non-allowed area, except for emergency services, high priority access, or responding to paging or notification.

q_2693.question: What is one example of a scalable and loudspeaker-independent sound-field representation used in Scene-based Audio for VR?
q_2693.ground_truth: Scene-based Audio, as defined in ITU-R BS.2266-2, is a scalable and loudspeaker-independent sound-field representation based upon a set of orthogonal basis functions such as spherical harmonics. Examples of Scene-Based audio formats commercially deployed for VR include B-Format First Order Ambisonics (FOA) and Higher-Order Ambisonics (HOA).

q_2694.question: What is the maximum number of retries for an EXTENDED MEASUREMENT ORDER message if the mobile station receives a new EXTENDED MEASUREMENT ORDER message with a different sequence code?
q_2694.ground_truth: The mobile station shall abort any pending measurements or reporting related to an EXTENDED MEASUREMENT ORDER message received on the old channel and treat the new message if it receives a new EXTENDED MEASUREMENT ORDER message with a different value of the sequence code before starting the reporting related to the earlier EXTENDED MEASUREMENT ORDER message.

q_2695.question: What information is sent to the UE in the MEASUREMENT CONTROL request for positioning operations?
q_2695.ground_truth: The MEASUREMENT CONTROL request may contain a request for periodic reporting with an amount of reports greater than one. In networks that include an SAS, the assistance data is generated within the SRNC or in the SAS and passed to the SRNC over the Iupc interface.

q_2696.question: What is the maximum number of priority levels supported by eMLPP?
q_2696.ground_truth: eMLPP supports a maximum of seven priority levels.

q_2697.question: What is the protection against side-channel attacks in MILENAGE?
q_2697.ground_truth: The protection against side-channel attacks in MILENAGE is achieved through the selection of a kernel that allows for a protected implementation within the time constraints given by the requirements. No attempts were given to provide such protection by the surrounding architecture.

q_2698.question: What is pushed in push mode file transfer and by whom?
q_2698.ground_truth: In push mode file transfer, the CGF pushes the CDR files to the BD at a time and/or frequency controlled by the CGF.

q_2699.question: What is the purpose of the Aggregated-Congestion-Info AVP (AVP code 4000)?
q_2699.ground_truth: The Aggregated-Congestion-Info AVP (AVP code 4000) contains a list of user ids identified by IMSI and optionally the congestion location id in which the list of user ids are located.

q_2700.question: What message does the UP Function send to the CP Function upon receiving a PDN Connection Release Request or PDU Session Release Request from the UE?
q_2700.ground_truth: The UP Function initiates the PFCP session deletion procedure and sends a PFCP Session Deletion Request to the CP Function to delete the existing PFCP session.

q_2701.question: What is the impact on UE power consumption for obtaining satellite ephemeris information in the short sporadic connections use case?
q_2701.ground_truth: The required power consumption to read SIB containing satellite ephemeris information for the short sporadic connections use case is not significant.

q_2702.question: In scenario 2.1, what are the different types of UEs and how do they communicate with the Application Server to send messages to Controlled UEs?
q_2702.ground_truth: UEs can be MSGin5G UE, Legacy 3GPP UE or Non-3GPP UE. MSGin5G UE sends messages via the 5GMSG transport, Legacy 3GPP UE replies messages via legacy 3GPP Message Gateway, and Non-3GPP UE replies messages via the Non-3GPP Message Gateway. All UEs send messages to the Application Server via the 5G access network, which terminates at Controlled UEs, connected directly to the MSGin5G application layer.

q_2703.question: When is DBU.NbrRegPubUserId incremented?
q_2703.ground_truth: When a Public User Identity's Registration Status changes to "registered".

q_2704.question: What is the default packetization time for PCM encoded speech in a BICC based Core Network over the Nb interface?

q_2705.question: What is the purpose of the UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE in the context of non-GBR bearers?
q_2705.ground_truth: The UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE is used to define the maximum bit rate for all non-GBR bearers in the uplink and downlink directions, for each UE in a Local Cell.

q_2706.question: Which capability information is indicated by the Dual Band Capability Info IE in the context of TS 25.214?
q_2706.ground_truth: The Dual Band Capability Info IE indicates the Dual Band capability information for a Local Cell in the context of TS 25.214.

q_2707.question: What action should the MS take when it receives a DTM Assignment Command message after sending a request for uplink TBFs but before receiving any uplink allocation?
q_2707.ground_truth: The MS shall act on the DTM Assignment Command message and after successful reallocation of resources, wait for the response from the network to the uplink TBF request on the newly allocated resources.

q_2708.question: What are the main differences between Solution #13 and Solution #15 regarding charging for PC5 data transfer?
q_2708.ground_truth: Solution #13 involves UE reporting Data transfer on PC5 to SMF over NAS, with existing PDU session UE sends the SMF a NAS message with PC5 usage information report. Solution #15 involves UE reporting Data transfer on PC5 to AMF over NAS, leaving PC5 data reporting criteria UE implementation specific, and delivery of charging policy to the UE is missing.

q_2709.question: What is the definition of ACK false alarm for 4C-HSDPA in multipath fading conditions?
q_2709.ground_truth: ACK false alarm for 4C-HSDPA in multipath fading conditions is defined as the maximum error ratio allowed when the receiver input signal is at a specified Ec/N0 limit, and it is measured by the probability of incorrectly detecting a HS-DPCCH signal (P(DTX->ACK)) when there is only DPCCH and DPDCH (+interference) at the receiver input.

q_2710.question: What should the UTRAN not do if the only changed IE in a SIB occurrence is the "Transmission TOW"?
q_2710.ground_truth: The UTRAN should not increment the value tag of the SIB occurrence.

q_2711.question: What is the format of the CellAdjustmentInfo-SyncAdjustmentRqstTDD sequence?
q_2711.ground_truth: The CellAdjustmentInfo-SyncAdjustmentRqstTDD sequence is a sequence of one to maxCellinNodeB ProtocolIE-Single-Container containing a CellAdjustmentInfoItemIE-SyncAdjustmntRqstTDD.

q_2712.question: What is the procedure that is performed once the Cell Reselection Indication has been accomplished or terminated?
q_2712.ground_truth: MAC informs RRC the termination of the Cell Reselection Indication procedure with CMAC-STATUS-Ind primitive.

q_2713.question: What is the name of the mobile additional function for Pre-Paging in the PLMN?

q_2714.question: What should the HTTP status code be set to in the HTTP header for a successful file repair response message?
q_2714.ground_truth: The HTTP status code should be set to 200 OK.

q_2715.question: What is the role of DIMS units in the processing order for scene updates?
q_2715.ground_truth: DIMS units are processed in decoding order, i.e. sequence number order in RTP or order inside a sample in the 3GP file format. However, the present document does not mandate any relative timing or processing order for DIMS units, scripts, or events that shall be processed at the same scene time.

q_2716.question: What organization produced the technical specification for full rate speech transcoding in digital cellular telecommunications?

q_2717.question: What is the main source of interference in the scenario where the repeater has an adjacent channel gain less than 55 dB?
q_2717.ground_truth: Most interference comes from the selectivity in the receiving mobile.

q_2718.question: What message is sent by the UE to the USS during registration on CS/PS after receiving the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT and/or ATTACH ACCEPT message from the USS?
q_2718.ground_truth: TMSI REALLOCATION COMPLETE and/or ATTACH COMPLETE and P-TMSI signature value

q_2719.question: What is the defined procedure when using SDP negotiation for data channel establishment and closing?
q_2719.ground_truth: When using SDP negotiation for data channel establishment and closing, the WIC and eIMS-AGW follow the procedures defined in RFC 8864.

q_2720.question: What is the difference between the RLC Data Block and Extended Access Burst methods of performing the Multilateration Timing Advance procedure?
q_2720.ground_truth: In the RLC Data Block method, the MS sends a single MCS-1 coded RLC data block containing specific parameters, while in the Extended Access Burst method, the MS sends an Extended Access Burst where the payload space contains the MS identity, MS Sync Accuracy, and MS Transmission Offset.

q_2721.question: What are the common characteristics of Category A games in the context of online gaming?
q_2721.ground_truth: The common characteristics of Category A games in the context of online gaming are low to medium dynamicity and complexity, with the playability supporting longer interaction delay tolerance.

q_2722.question: What is the purpose of the SEAL GM server and when is it used?
q_2722.ground_truth: The SEAL GM server is used to create a group ID for a pair of UAV and UAV-C when a QoS degradation occurs, and the UAE server sends a group creation request to the SEAL GM server.

q_2723.question: Which RFC in addition to RFC 5280 should be supported to include ECDSA with Brainpool elliptic curve domain parameters?

q_2724.question: What kind of information is negotiated between the RNC and the Node B via the Iub interface?
q_2724.ground_truth: Radio resources, such as adding or deleting cells controlled by the Node B, broadcast channel control, and logical O&M between the Node B and RNC.

q_2725.question: What should the DRNS do when the HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling Information LCR IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message in the 1.28 Mcps TDD scenario?
q_2725.ground_truth: The DRNS shall allocate the HS-SICH information needed for HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling operation and include the HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling Information Response LCR IE in the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message.

q_2726.question: How are notifications of actions to be taken by broadcaster applications delivered in an ATSC 3.0 system?
q_2726.ground_truth: Notifications of actions to be taken by broadcaster applications, or Events, may be delivered by broadcast or broadband in an ATSC 3.0 system. For broadcast streaming services associated with a broadcast application, the DASH Event mechanism is used for the notification delivery.

q_2727.question: What is the test purpose when the UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state and 5GMM-IDLE mode, and has stored an Extended local emergency numbers list?
q_2727.ground_truth: The UE must delete the stored Extended local Emergency Numbers List in the user equipment when it is switched off or the USIM is removed.

q_2728.question: What is the expected action from the UE when it receives the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message and the OTDOA assistance data during T1?
q_2728.ground_truth: The UE is expected to report RSTD measurements performed on the SCC only.

q_2729.question: What message is used by the UE to confirm the UTRAN Mobility Information to the Target RNC during the re-establishment of the RRC connection in dedicated transport channel (DCH) state?
q_2729.ground_truth: The UE sends a UTRAN Mobility Info Confirm message on the new DCCH to the Target RNC (new SRNC) to confirm the UTRAN Mobility Information during the re-establishment of the RRC connection in dedicated transport channel (DCH) state.

q_2730.question: Which interfaces are used by the elements involved in the A&A procedure in this solution?
q_2730.ground_truth: The NEF or the Common API framework (CAPIF) is used for communication between UAS AF and USS/UTM. For the communication between the UAV, UAS AF, and USS/UTM, the solutions use well-known web security mechanisms such as HTTPS.

q_2731.question: What is the Diameter application identifier assigned to the Zh interface application?
q_2731.ground_truth: The Diameter application identifier assigned to the Zh interface application is 16777221.

q_2732.question: What is the procedure for the automatic transmission of off-network stored location reports in Solution 8?
q_2732.ground_truth: The procedure involves the location management client sending any stored location information report(s) to the location management server upon entering on-network operation.

q_2733.question: What happens when the monitored UE transitions to Connected Mode, Idle Mode, or eDRX paging occasion?
q_2733.ground_truth: The 3GPP Network entities detect the change in UE reachability status and send a Monitoring Notification message for UE reachability to the MSGin5G Server. The notification may include idle mode information such as active time granted to the UE, eDRX cycle length, periodic RAU/TAU timer, etc.

q_2734.question: Who is calling C, and what does C do with the incoming call?
q_2734.ground_truth: B is calling C, and C rejects the incoming call by disconnecting it.

q_2735.question: When will the S-CSCF-hA1 add the P-Charging-Vector header field to the initial INVITE request?
q_2735.ground_truth: The S-CSCF-hA1 will add the P-Charging-Vector header field to the initial INVITE request.

q_2736.question: What is the type of the Proximity-Alert-Timestamp AVP and what information does it hold?
q_2736.ground_truth: The Proximity-Alert-Timestamp AVP is of type Time and it holds the timestamp when proximity alert is sent, to indicate two UEs are in proximity.

q_2737.question: What is the difference in the number of transport bearers used between Iub and Iur interfaces in the 3GPP network?
q_2737.ground_truth: There are as many transport bearers between Iub interfaces as there are sets of coordinated transport channels and Iub DCH data ports for that communication. However, in Iur interface, every set of coordinated transport channels related to one UE context that is communicated over a set of cells that are macro-diversity combined within Node B or DRNC, is carried on one transport bearer. This means that the number of transport bearers in Iur interface is equal to the number of set of coordinated transport channels and Iur DCH data ports.

q_2738.question: In which mode(s) can a mobile station attempt to acquire an ETWS Primary Notification message?
q_2738.ground_truth: In idle mode or packet idle mode (applicable only to a GPRS mobile station).

q_2739.question: What is the role of the Local Mobility Anchor and Mobile Access Gateway in 3GPP Proximity-Based MIPv6 when revoking bulk PMIPv6 bindings?
q_2739.ground_truth: The Local Mobility Anchor (LMA) or Mobile Access Gateway (MAG) can be the initiator or receiver of a Binding Revocation Indication (BRI) message to evoke bulk PMIPv6 bindings. The BRI message includes the Fully Qualified PDN Connection Set Identifier Mobility Option, and the receiving node follows the Local Mobility Anchor Revokes Bulk PMIPv6 Bindings or Mobile Access Gateway Revoke Bulk PMIP6 Bindings proceedings accordingly.

q_2740.question: What is the main difference between inter-RNS hard handover with switch in CN and inter-RNS hard handover with switch via Iur interface?
q_2740.ground_truth: Inter-RNS hard handover with switch in CN is performed with two CN nodes simultaneously, whereas inter-RNS hard handover with switch via Iur interface is performed with the UE connected to two CN nodes simultaneously and using one node B under the target RNC after the handover. The main difference is the way the handover is performed and the handover decision made by the serving RNC.

q_2741.question: What is one impact to the network from Solution 20?
q_2741.ground_truth: One impact to the network from Solution 20 is the need to determine an MCC list and provision it to the UE, which is expected to impact the UE to network procedures and is not in the scope of this TR.

q_2742.question: What is the equation for determining the angle at the Tx side for the reflected path in the ZOD (Zenith-Orientation-Departure) direction?
q_2742.ground_truth: The equation for determining the angle at the Tx side for the reflected path in the ZOD direction is given by equation (7.6-37a), which is a function of the 2D distance between the Tx and Rx and the heights of the Tx and Rx above the ground.

q_2743.question: Where are the SMF and UPF co-located when interworking between 5GS and EPS?
q_2743.ground_truth: The SMF is co-located with PGW-C, and UPF is co-located with PGW-U.

q_2744.question: In 3GPP TS 24.501, what identifier is used to represent a set of UE radio capabilities in RACS?
q_2744.ground_truth: The UE radio capability ID is used to represent a set of UE radio capabilities in RACS.

q_2745.question: What is one of the target applications for the Multi-Dimensional Audio (MDA) standard?
q_2745.ground_truth: One of the target applications for the Multi-Dimensional Audio (MDA) standard is cinema.

q_2746.question: How is the Node B synchronization procedure performed over the air?
q_2746.ground_truth: The Node B synchronization procedure over the air is performed in 3 distinct phases: (1) Initial synchronization, where regular DwPCHs are used as cell sync bursts, (2) Steady-state phase, where the regular DwPCHs are used as cell sync bursts, and (3) Late entrant cells, which involves the continuous measurement of the DwPCHs of the neighbouring cells and adjustment of the late entrant cell to allow it to enter steady state phase.

q_2747.question: Which mode of operation of a mobile station shall perform the service information sending procedure at the earliest opportunity after the early Classmark sending procedure?

q_2748.question: What is the primary purpose of the Repository Access Function (RAF) in the GUP architecture?
q_2748.ground_truth: The RAF realizes the harmonized access interface and hides the implementation details of the data repositories from the GUP infrastructure. It also performs protocol and data transformation where needed.

q_2749.question: What is the function of the NSSF (Network Slice Selection Function) in Solution #3?
q_2749.ground_truth: The NSSF is responsible for determining the allowed NSSAI (Network Slice Selection Assistance Information) for a UE and indicating to the AMF which S-NSSAIs subject to quota management need to be updated.

q_2750.question: How is the useful output of 5GC defined in the generic 5GC EE KPI proposal?
q_2750.ground_truth: The useful output of 5GC in the generic 5GC EE KPI proposal is defined as the useful output of 5GC (UsefulOutput5GC) divided by the Energy Consumption of 5GC (EnergyConsumption5GC).

q_2751.question: What message does the MSC-A server send when it uses the Change Flow Direction procedure to request the MGW-A to set the Handover Device to initial state?

q_2752.question: What is the sparsity factor used for in the sparse angular sampling with a correction factor method?
q_2752.ground_truth: The sparsity factor is used to save measurement time in sparse angular sampling. It calculates the angular steps differently based on whether it is for non-harmonic frequencies, harmonic frequencies with a fixed beam test signal, or harmonic frequencies with a beam sweeping test signal.

q_2753.question: What were the key performance factors compared between the adaptive JBM and the fixed reference JBM?
q_2753.ground_truth: The performance of the JBM directly impacts the voice quality, with the adaptive JBM providing equal or better voice quality than the reference non-causal fixed JBM, particularly in dealing with large variations in channel delay.

q_2754.question: What procedure is used by the CRNC to inform the Node B that one or several E-RNTIs may be released as the UE no longer uses the E-RNTI?
q_2754.ground_truth: The UE STATUS UPDATE COMMAND message procedure.

q_2755.question: What is the term "Subject Based Interception" defined as in the TS?
q_2755.ground_truth: Subject Based Interception is defined as interception invoked using a specific Target Identity, which is a technical identity that uniquely identifies a target of interception.

q_2756.question: What is the main difference between MR-VoD and SVC-VoD in terms of the number of video clips stored in the cache?
q_2756.ground_truth: By using SVC in MR-VoD, much more video clips at different representations can be stored in the cache, while with MR-VoD many files have to be removed from the cache to obtain additional space for new incoming files or their versions.

q_2757.question: Which IE defines the time to live for a MAC-hs SDU in the HSDPA Priority Queue?
q_2757.ground_truth: The Discard Timer IE defines the time to live for a MAC-hs SDU starting from the instant of its arrival into an HSDPA Priority Queue.

q_2758.question: What should the MME do if the UE cannot successfully complete the AS security mode command?
q_2758.ground_truth: Reply with an unprotected security mode failure message

q_2759.question: What procedures are executed in A/Gb mode regarding BSS packet flow context?
q_2759.ground_truth: In A/Gb mode, BSS packet flow context procedures are executed for radio access bearer modification.

q_2760.question: What does the term TV Video Profiles represent in the context of 3GPP services?
q_2760.ground_truth: TV Video Profiles in 3GPP services address coded representations of TV distribution signals up to UHD-1 phase 2, with each Operation Point having a specific Profile, Level, and Tier.

q_2761.question: What should a mobile station supporting extended EARFCNs do if it receives a PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER message with both Repeated E-UTRAN Neighbour Cell IE and E-UTRAN NC with extended EARFCNs IE included?

q_2762.question: What is an essential component of VR mixing for both cinematic and live content, ensuring that audio elements are positioned in space to match the visual reference?
q_2762.ground_truth: Positioning of audio elements, or panning

q_2763.question: What is the function of the local non-3GPP anchor for roaming?
q_2763.ground_truth: A local non-3GPP anchor serves as the anchor point for non-3GPP interfaces when a UE is roaming. Its functions include handling the user plane anchor point for non-3GPP interfaces, supporting interworking between 3GPP and non-3GPP access, and providing local mobility anchoring for inter-rat handover.

q_2764.question: What is the purpose of the PC8 reference point in Prose, as specified in the present document?
q_2764.ground_truth: The PC8 reference point in Prose is used to transport security material to UEs for ProSe one-to-many communications. It relies on EPC user plane for transport and is used by both ProSe Direct Discovery and ProSe Direct Communication.

q_2765.question: What is the purpose of "FDD DCHs to Modify" in "RadioLinkAdditionFailureTDD-Extensions RNSAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION"?
q_2765.ground_truth: It is likely a field used to specify the Downlink Channel(s) to be modified when adding or modifying the radio link for FDD.

q_2766.question: What is the role of the Packet Flow Description Function (PFDF) in the Nu reference point?
q_2766.ground_truth: The PFDF is a functional element that receives and manages PFDs associated with application identifiers from the SCEF via the Nu reference point. It provisions the PFDs for the corresponding application identifiers to the PCEF/TDF.

q_2767.question: What is the role of the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay in Public Safety use?
q_2767.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-Network Relay is responsible for relaying UE-to-Network messages in Public Safety use.

q_2768.question: What is the role of the "a=flute-tsi:" attribute in FLUTE SDP session description?
q_2768.ground_truth: The "a=flute-tsi:" attribute defines the Transport Session Identifier (TSI) in a FLUTE SDP session description, which uniquely identifies a FLUTE session for a given IP source address during the time that the session is active.

q_2769.question: What event is indicated by the hexadecimal code 01 in the "Abis Channel" attribute?
q_2769.ground_truth: The Abis Channel attribute's hexadecimal code 01 represents the identification of the Abis channel.

q_2770.question: What message does the HLR send to the old SGSN when it receives the Update Location message from the new SGSN?
q_2770.ground_truth: Cancel Location (IMSI, Cancellation Type) message with Cancellation Type set to Update Procedure

q_2771.question: What is the purpose of the CounterThreshold AVP?
q_2771.ground_truth: The CounterThreshold AVP contains a threshold value for the addressed counter. If the value of the specified counter reaches this threshold value, all tariff information contained in the TRS message expires, and the OCF shall send a new TRQ message to the RF.

q_2772.question: What happens if the PS resources in the target cell are not valid when the mobile station performs access in the target cell?
q_2772.ground_truth: It is possible that the PS resources in the target cell will not be valid when the mobile station performs access in the target cell, and in this case, it is up to the source BSS and the mobile station to handle the situation appropriately.

q_2773.question: What information is recorded in the 'CAMEL Call Leg Information' grouped field per outgoing leg?
q_2773.ground_truth: The fields related to the outgoing legs of that call segment are recorded in the respective grouped field (CAMEL call leg information) per outgoing leg.

q_2774.question: What are the two measurements related to HSUPA radio bearer setup?
q_2774.ground_truth: Two measurements are defined for HSUPA radio bearer setup: attempted radio bearer setups (4.34.1.2.1) and successful radio bearer setups (4.34.1.2.2). These measurements help estimate the efficiency and success rate of establishing HSUPA radio bearers.

q_2775.question: What is the purpose of the query port numbers procedure in this protocol?
q_2775.ground_truth: The purpose of the query port numbers procedure is for the originator to query the list of port numbers that are reserved for use with a specific application and the associated serialization format.

q_2776.question: In which two parts of the communication system does the DL Inner Loop Power Control function reside?

q_2777.question: What is the property "UP Mode of operation" defined in the 3GPP specification for further details on its possible values?

q_2778.question: What supports bearer services and applications to provide MC services over the IOPS MC system in the IOPS mode of operation?
q_2778.ground_truth: UE 1 is an MC service UE that supports bearer services and applications to provide MC services over the IOPS MC system in the IOPS mode of operation.

q_2779.question: What should the IWF determine when sending a SIP re-INVITE for an existing private call session?
q_2779.ground_truth: The IWF should determine the MCPTT ID of the calling user.

q_2780.question: Which attribute holds a reference to the clock reference for the stream referred to by the video, audio, and animation elements in DIMS?

q_2781.question: In what situations can the network trigger the mobile station to transmit a PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message when sending a PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message?
q_2781.ground_truth: When valid timing advance is not available for the mobile station

q_2782.question: What is created when the automated management process for a Network Element (NE) starts?
q_2782.ground_truth: An instance of the Software Management Process (swMProcess) is created.

q_2783.question: What should the IWF do if it is unable to identify the controlling MCData function for standalone SDS over media plane?
q_2783.ground_truth: The IWF shall complete any further actions to notify the user homed in the IWF and shall not continue with the remaining steps if it is unable to identify the controlling MCData function for standalone SDS over media plane.

q_2784.question: What action does the new SGSN take when it receives the PS Handover Request Acknowledge message from the target BSS?
q_2784.ground_truth: Upon receiving the PS Handover Request Acknowledge message from the target BSS, the new SGSN sends the PS Handover Request Acknowledge message to the old SGSN, indicating that it is ready to receive packets forwarded from the old SGSN for the accepted PFCs.

q_2785.question: What is the purpose of the deregistration of functional identities in the FRMCS System when a user logs out?
q_2785.ground_truth: When a user logs out of the FRMCS System, the system deregisters all functional identities of the FRMCS User. This ensures that the user is logged out of the system and is no longer reachable by other FRMCS Users.

q_2786.question: How many frames does the UTRAN wait before sending another Special Burst, as specified in TS 25.224, with SBSP = 4?
q_2786.ground_truth: The UTRAN sends a Special Burst in the first frame without data transmission, followed by 3 frames with no transmission; followed by a Special Burst, and so on.

q_2787.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe-Authorization-Request (PAR) Command in this specification?
q_2787.ground_truth: The ProSe-Authorization-Request (PAR) Command is used by the ProSe Function in the HPLMN to request authorization from the ProSe Function in Local PLMN/VPLMN.

q_2788.question: In the procedure for Deployment Option 3, what are the steps taken when the UE is considered unreachable for paging due to using extended idle mode DRX or PSM?
q_2788.ground_truth: When the UE is considered unreachable for paging due to using extended idle mode DRX or PSM in Deployment Option 3, the MME sends a Service Request message to the MSC/VLR. The MSC/VLR builds the SMS message and forwards it to the MME in a Downlink Unitdata message. The MME stores the received SMS message, pages the UE, and establishes the radio bearers for the network. The UE sends a Service Request message to the MME, and the MME encapsulates the SMS message in a NAS message and sends the message to the MS/UE.

q_2789.question: What is the requirement for the UE and N3IWF with regards to the liveness check procedure and IPsec connectivity?
q_2789.ground_truth: The UE and N3IWF shall use the liveness check procedure over NWu interface, and NAT-Traversal and NAT-Keepalive shall be used to keep NAT entries alive.

q_2790.question: What video resolution and bitrate were used for WiFi tests in office environment?

q_2791.question: How are NAS messages between the UE and N3IWF exchanged after the signaling IPsec tunnel is established?
q_2791.ground_truth: NAS messages between the UE and N3IWF are exchanged via the signaling IPsec SA over TCP/IP after the tunnel is established.

q_2792.question: What is the size of the "Cell-Portion-ID" field?
q_2792.ground_truth: The "Cell-Portion-ID" field is an integer with a range of 0 to 255, or 256 to 4095.

q_2793.question: What should be the throughput of a channel in relation to its maximum throughput to meet the minimum requirement?
q_2793.ground_truth: The throughput should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput.

q_2794.question: Which CR specifies procedures to detect and report the peer GTP-U entity restart?
q_2794.ground_truth: CR 17.4 specifies procedures to detect and report the peer GTP-U entity restart.

q_2795.question: What is the difference between the two types of concealment methods in the repetition and smoothing processing?
q_2795.ground_truth: The two types of concealment methods are repetition and smoothing method for the next good frame after an erased frame, and repetition and smoothing method for the next good frame after burst erasures.

q_2796.question: What should be included in the Contact header field when sending a SIP INVITE request to establish a private MCPTT call?
q_2796.ground_truth: The Contact header field should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag with the "require" and "explicit" parameters.

q_2797.question: How is "GNSS" defined in the document?
q_2797.ground_truth: GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) consists of three functional elements: Space Segment (satellites), User Segment (receivers), and Control Segment (maintenance etc.). The GNSS receiver calculates its own position based on the received time differences for several satellites. It includes systems like Global Positioning System (GPS) and GALILEO.

q_2798.question: What component determines the modulation scheme for UEs in normal coverage or enhanced coverage in the transport block processing chain?
q_2798.ground_truth: The MAC Scheduler decides the modulation scheme for UEs in normal coverage or enhanced coverage in the transport block processing chain.

q_2799.question: What bit is used to inform the DTX handler in the remote transcoder whether downlink DTX may be applied or not for Adaptive Multi-Rate and Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband speech?
q_2799.ground_truth: The DTXd bit (C19) is used to inform the DTX handler in the remote transcoder whether downlink DTX may be applied or not for Adaptive Multi-Rate and Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband speech.

q_2800.question: What determines the priority of the HPLMN derived from the IMSI when the EHPLMN list is present?
q_2800.ground_truth: The priority of the HPLMN derived from the IMSI is given by its position in the EHPLMN list.

q_2801.question: What are the steps followed by UE-1 to perform PS-PS Access Transfer with full media transfer for an outgoing call in early dialog phase?
q_2801.ground_truth: UE-1 connects to a new IP-CAN (IP-CAN 2), registers to the S-CSCF via IP-CAN 2, sends an INVITE message on IP-CAN2 towards the SCC AS including the STI identifying the session and indicating full media transfer access transfer, and updates the session over the remote access leg.

q_2802.question: Who determines the service to be intercepted in the TS?
q_2802.ground_truth: National regulations specifying the interception requirements will define the service to be intercepted.

q_2803.question: What is the initial UE transmit power level during the start of Tests 1 and 2?
q_2803.ground_truth: The UE transmit power shall be initialized to -15 dBm before the start of Tests 1 and 2.

q_2804.question: What is the implied significance of the term "Texture" in the context of VR support in MTSI and IMS telepresence?
q_2804.ground_truth: In the context of VR support in MTSI and IMS telepresence, the term "Texture" refers to the decoder output signal of the HEVC decoder, which is used in the rendering phase to generate a spherical video based on the decoded output signal.

q_2805.question: What is the definition of "virtual leased line" in the context of the present document?
q_2805.ground_truth: Virtual leased line refers to the interconnection of NGCN sites through the NGN, allowing for the creation of a dedicated communication link between the two.

q_2806.question: What triggers the network to assign a new UE radio capability ID to the UE when a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message is sent without the UE radio capability ID availability IE set to "UE radio capability ID available"?
q_2806.ground_truth: The network can assign a new UE radio capability ID to the UE when the UE operates in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode state EMM-REGISTERED and includes a UE radio capability information update needed IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message under certain conditions, such as a reselection to a new PLMN or a revocation of network-assigned UE radio capability IDs by the serving PLMN.

q_2807.question: What is the issue with the current E.164 numbering resources for Machine Type Communication (MTC) services?
q_2807.ground_truth: The current demands for E.164 MSISDNs resources are high and are expected to accelerate in the future, leading to a significant risk of some national numbering/dialling plans running out of numbers. This impacts not only MTC services but also GSM/UMTS service providers in general.

q_2808.question: What should the protocol entity in the MS do when it receives a message with an unimplemented message type?
q_2808.ground_truth: The protocol entity in the MS should ignore the message except for returning a STATUS message with cause "message type non-existent or not implemented" and including the message type of the message received as diagnostics.

q_2809.question: What is the process of redirection in 3GPP technical specification for GAN?
q_2809.ground_truth: Redirection is the process by which a Default or Serving GANC redirects an MS to an alternative Serving GANC, which is likely to become the Serving GANC for the MS.

q_2810.question: What is the use of soft stealing for FACCH with subchannel specific power control?
q_2810.ground_truth: Soft stealing for FACCH with subchannel specific power control improves the FACCH and the robustness of RR signalling without performing double stealing of voice blocks from both subchannels.

q_2811.question: What is the purpose of the Advice Of Charge (AOC) service in the IP Multimedia (IM) Core Network (CN) subsystem?
q_2811.ground_truth: The AOC service in the IM CN subsystem is used to provide charging information to the user related to IP Multimedia sessions. This can include charging rates at communication set-up time, as well as charging information during and at the end of the communication.

q_2812.question: What is one of the solutions for Key Issue #13 that proposes handling of mixed and distributed NWDAF deployments?

q_2813.question: How is the destination Layer-2 ID updated in the secure creation of the destination Layer-2 ID in groupcast communication?
q_2813.ground_truth: The destination Layer-2 ID is updated using the next random number in the sequence when the timer T expires.

q_2814.question: Which software tool performs byte swapping on a binary data file?
q_2814.ground_truth: The program swapbin is located in the "utils" subdirectory and provides byte swapping on a binary data file.

q_2815.question: How many bits are there in a 3GPP PDTCH block type 34, including both an eTFI and a PAN?

q_2816.question: What is the role of the Follow Me function node in the PLMN operator of the remote party?
q_2816.ground_truth: The Follow Me function node is a network node in the PLMN operator of the remote party that stores the FM data of the remote party.

q_2817.question: What should the TP-PID element be set to for the SME-to-SME protocol?
q_2817.ground_truth: The TP-PID element should be set to 00000000 for the SME-to-SME protocol.

q_2818.question: What should the UE do if it receives an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with 5GMM cause #71 "ngKSI already in use" while T3520 is running?
q_2818.ground_truth: The UE should locally release the RRC connection and treat the active cell as barred.

q_2819.question: What were the conclusions for 50ms DTMF digits for the AMR speech codecs in the AMR codec mode tests?
q_2819.ground_truth: The 10.2 and 12.2 kbit/s AMR modes appeared to be essentially transparent to DTMF signals under error free conditions, whereas the lower rate modes did not appear to be transparent.

q_2820.question: What is the primary difference between the single cluster SCME and the full SCME?
q_2820.ground_truth: The primary difference is that in the single cluster model, the mean Angle-of-Arrival (AoA) of each cluster is turned to the same primary direction, while in the full SCME, they are not.

q_2821.question: What is the second stage of the mode selection process?
q_2821.ground_truth: ECR, which is performed after open-loop LTP analysis.

q_2822.question: What is the purpose of the "related-icid" header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field?
q_2822.ground_truth: The "related-icid" header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field is used to correlate charging when the IC network releases one connection and establishes another, even if the IC network is not aware of any link between the two connections.

q_2823.question: What is the total bandwidth when UE-B sends 1 frame in the packet with 100 packets per second in the B->A direction in Use case B?
q_2823.ground_truth: The total bandwidth is 56 kbps, assuming that no redundancy is used.

q_2824.question: What steps are taken by NG-RAN when inter-system redirection to EPS is initiated?
