q_2824.ground_truth: NG-RAN initiates either handover or AN Release via inter-system redirection to EPS, and the UE initiates TAU procedure if in 5GS to EPS handover, or Attach with PDN connectivity request with request type "handover" if inter-system redirection to EPS without N26 interface.

q_2825.question: Why is it important to send the hostname of the NAF when the UE sends the ClientHello message as a part of the TLS handshake?
q_2825.ground_truth: It is important to send the hostname of the NAF when the UE sends the ClientHello message because the hostname is needed by the BSF during key derivation, and the NAF can be addressed using different hostnames, and the NAF cannot otherwise discover what is the hostname that the UE used to contact the NAF.

q_2826.question: Which Octet is included in the downlink RLC/MAC header if the value of the first instance of the Length indicator in the RLC data block is 123 and both the network and MS support MS assisted Dedicated Core Network selection in the context of EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT Downlink RLC/MAC header?
q_2826.ground_truth: Octet M+1 and the following two Octets.

q_2827.question: What should the mobile station do upon expiry of timer T3172 if both the mobile station and the network support multiple TBF procedures and the mobile station has additional RLC data blocks to transmit?
q_2827.ground_truth: The mobile station shall initiate a new uplink TBF establishment but is not allowed to make a new attempt for an uplink TBF establishment in the same cell until timer T3172 expires. It may, however, attempt to enter the dedicated mode in the same cell before timer T3172 has expired. During the time T3172 is running, the mobile station shall ignore all received PACKET PAGING REQUEST messages except paging request to trigger RR connection establishment.

q_2828.question: What is the name of the coding scheme used in the transcoding procedure outlined in the document?
q_2828.ground_truth: The Regular Pulse Excitation - Long Term prediction - Linear Predictive Coder (RPE-LTP)

q_2829.question: What occurs when an HTTP session is terminated when using HTTP for provisioning and content ingest?
q_2829.ground_truth: When the HTTP session is terminated, all sessions that are still created or active will be deleted automatically by the BM-SC. The BM-SC sends a service termination response.

q_2830.question: In a mobile station with an uplink TBF for which EFTA is used, how should the mobile station perform uplink transmissions?
q_2830.ground_truth: Transmissions should be performed on the uplink PDCHs or PDCH-pairs allocated in the uplink assignment message from the network.

q_2831.question: What parameter is used to determine the physical resources used for PUCCH format 1/1a/1b and PUCCH format 2/2a/2b?
q_2831.ground_truth: The parameters and used to determine the physical resources used for PUCCH format 1/1a/1b and PUCCH format 2/2a/2b.

q_2832.question: What does the "Unconfirmed send state variable" IE indicate in the range of 0 to 511?
q_2832.ground_truth: Octet 2 and bit 1 of octet 3 of the "Unconfirmed send state variable" IE contain a number in binary representation ranging from 0 to 511.

q_2833.question: What services are exempted from being forced to release the related established PDU session?
q_2833.ground_truth: Emergency services and high priority access in the selected PLMN or SNPN.

q_2834.question: What is the content of the Via header fields in the message sent by IBCF-hA1?
q_2834.ground_truth: The Via header fields in the message sent by IBCF-hA1 include the address of the intermediate nodes such as scscf-hA1.home-A.net, icscf-hA1.home-A.net, ibcf-hA2.home-A.net, ic-T1.interconnection-T.net and the originating network.

q_2835.question: What happens after the initial SpIM has been created?
q_2835.ground_truth: After the initial SpIM has been created, AIMs are imported and consolidated into it, taking into account the specific applications, functionality, and business information.

q_2836.question: What is the function of the TSN AF in the 5GS network?
q_2836.ground_truth: The TSN AF supports Rel-16 PMIC signalling via PCF, supports the BMCA result report as requested by NEF, and provides (g)PTP parameters including (g)PTP version, domain number(s), sending rate, initial Announce interval, etc. to DS-TT.

q_2837.question: What should the UE do when it has to transmit a SDAP PDU with header in the UE-initiated data transfer?
q_2837.ground_truth: The UE builds an SDAP PDU from the SDAP SDU including the header and maps it to the DRB as per stored DRB mapping rule for the QoS flow.

q_2838.question: What message does the network send to the UE to pass the result of the location procedure?
q_2838.ground_truth: The network sends a FACILITY message to the UE containing a LCS-MOLR return result component.

q_2839.question: Which physical layer primitive is used to request the transmission of a message unit in the MS?
q_2839.ground_truth: PH-DATA-REQUEST primitive is used to request the transmission of a message unit in the MS.

q_2840.question: What is the sum of the number of timeslots listened to by an MS for the reception of one or more broadcast/multicast sessions (m) and the number of timeslots used by the MS for the transmission on PACCH/U within a TDMA frame (n) for a multislot class type 1 MS receiving more than one broadcast/multicast session?
q_2840.ground_truth: m + n does not exceed 6 (or 5 if the mobile station needs to listen to the (P)BCCH and (P)CCCH in addition to the timeslots assigned for MBMS data transfer).

q_2841.question: What is the triggering condition for event 2e in inter-frequency measurement?
q_2841.ground_truth: The estimated quality of a non-used frequency is below a certain threshold.

q_2842.question: What is the recommended use of ITU-R BT.2020 color space in the 3GPP specification?
q_2842.ground_truth: Although ITU-R BT.2020 is originally only recommended for 2160p/4320p resolution, this specification recommends supporting BT.2020 across all resolutions to maintain consistent color space representation for TV services on 3GPP radio bearers.

q_2843.question: In 5.3a.5, what two actions does the MS need to send when sending a random access message carrying 30 information bits for Multilateration Timing Advance procedure using ecc(thum) method?
q_2843.ground_truth: AMS sends two random access messages: the first one carries 11 information bits, and the second one carries 30 information bits, after the network grants access.

q_2844.question: What is the rule for switching time location between NR Uu and NR SL when they have different priorities?
q_2844.ground_truth: The switching time shall be located on the radio access technology (RAT) of low priority when NR Uu and NR SL have different priorities based on priority information specified in TS 38.321 and TS38.213.

q_2845.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of RABs failed to modify for PS domain in which a queuing process has been involved?

q_2846.question: What is the difference in throughput at the cell border between DSR and EGPRS with a 2dB lower power for DSR?
q_2846.ground_truth: DSR achieves a 29% better throughput (34 kbit/s for EGPRS and 44 kbit/s for DSR) at the cell border with a 2dB lower power.

q_2847.question: What action does the source BSS take after receiving the DELETE-BSS-PFC PDU from the SGSN in relation to radio resource release?
q_2847.ground_truth: The source BSS releases the radio resources in the source cell after receiving the DELETE-BSS-PFC PDU from the SGSN.

q_2848.question: What media is given priority treatment once MPS MMTEL voice is activated by a MPS Service User in the 3GPP system of the MPS Service Provider RPLMN?
q_2848.ground_truth: The 3GPP system provides priority treatment to the audio media flows once the MPS Service User is authenticated and authorized by the 3GPP system.

q_2849.question: What are the different types of privacy check in LCS Authorisation Request?
q_2849.ground_truth: There are two types of LCS Authorisation Request: LCS Authorisation Request without location estimate (sent by H-GMLC before location request) and LCS Authorisation Request with location estimate (to check location related privacy settings).

q_2850.question: What condition causes the "QoS parameter mismatch" cause in 3GPP TS~23.203~?
q_2850.ground_truth: The SGSN uses the "QoS parameter mismatch" cause in the Delete PDP Context Request message to indicate that the PDP can not be established due to a QoS parameter mismatch.

q_2851.question: What type of information is required in the FPACH-LCR-InformationList-AuditRsp field?
q_2851.ground_truth: The FPACH-LCR-InformationList-AuditRsp field contains information about the physical channel status for an LTE network.

q_2852.question: What is the minimum number of measurements and the time difference between the first and last measurements used for filtering CPICH RSCP of a non-identified inter-frequency cell?
q_2852.ground_truth: The minimum number of measurements is 2, and the time difference between the first and last measurements used for filtering CPICH RSCP of a non-identified inter-frequency cell should be at least 30 seconds.

q_2853.question: What is the capacity performance range for FR2, Dense Urban, DL, with 400MHz bandwidth for CG traffic model, 15ms PDB, and SU-MIMO when the data rate is 8Mbps and 30Mbps, respectively?
q_2853.ground_truth: The capacity performance range is decreased from >30 UEs per cell with 8Mbps to 25 UEs per cell with 30Mbps for FR2, Dense Urban, DL, with 400MHz bandwidth for CG traffic model, 15ms PDB, and SU-MIMO.

q_2854.question: What is the purpose of sending the local DN binding context control information to the UE during local PSA relocation in 6.34.2.1?
q_2854.ground_truth: The purpose is to control whether the upper layer context information such as DNS cache and/or Layer 4 context in High Layer OS should be refreshed or not during local PSA relocation.

q_2855.question: What happens when the oBSS receives the LCLS connect request for an associated call leg?
q_2855.ground_truth: The oBSS does not change the LCLS-BSS status since it has not yet received the LCLS connect request for the associated call leg.

q_2856.question: What is the role of the CTS-FP in the OFO measurement process?
q_2856.ground_truth: The CTS-FP orders the CTS-MS to assess the frequency offset between the BCCH carrier and the CTS-FP. The CTS-MS reports the measurement status to the CTS-FP, which then uses the reported OFO measurements to correct its frequency source.

q_2857.question: Who initiates the Load Indication procedure in this network?
q_2857.ground_truth: The BSS of the concerned cell initiates the Load Indication procedure.

q_2858.question: What is the role of the Non-serving Relative Grant in FDD E-DCH?
q_2858.ground_truth: The Non-serving Relative Grant allows neighboring Node Bs to adjust the transmitted rate of UEs that are not under their control in order to avoid overload situations.

q_2859.question: What should the UE do when receiving an ESM DATA TRANSPORT message in UE test loop I?
q_2859.ground_truth: Submit the received IP PDU in the User data container of each received ESM DATA TRANSPORT without any modification of the IP header to the UL TFT handling SAP for transmission in uplink.

q_2860.question: What is the purpose of the DC SAP in the Uu Stratum?
q_2860.ground_truth: The DC SAP in the Uu Stratum provides services for establishment/release of a connection and transfer of messages using this connection. It also enables transfer of a message during the establishment phase.

q_2861.question: What action is taken by the RAN and UE in Step 7, using the rekeying token?
q_2861.ground_truth: In Step 7, new multicast keys (both integrity key KMTint and encryption key KMTenc) are generated at RAN and UE, using the rekeying token.

q_2862.question: What is the role of the TXX<mode>.COD sequences in the decoder output test?
q_2862.ground_truth: The TXX<mode>.COD sequences are provided for the static mode tests of the decoder. In a correct implementation, the resulting speech decoder output should be identical to the corresponding TXX<mode>.OUT sequences.

q_2863.question: Who initiates the channel mode modify procedure?
q_2863.ground_truth: The network initiates the channel mode modify procedure.

q_2864.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation scheme in the FR1, UL only evaluation, DU, AR UL 2 streams and high load scenario from Source 18?
q_2864.ground_truth: The R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation scheme provides a mean power saving gain of 23.02% with marginal loss in UL UE satisfied rate in the FR1, UL only evaluation, DU, AR UL 2 streams and high load scenario from Source 18.

q_2865.question: What is the purpose of the DEACTIVATE POWER LIMIT REQUEST message?
q_2865.ground_truth: The purpose of the DEACTIVATE POWER LIMIT REQUEST message is to request the UE to deactivate from the power limit state.

q_2866.question: What is the relationship between URA/GRA, LA, RA and TA in the RAN?
q_2866.ground_truth: One LA consists of a number of cells belonging to RNCs that are connected to the same CN node, one RA consists of a number of cells belonging to RNCs that are connected to the same CN node, one TA consists of a number of cells belonging to eNodeBs that are connected to the same CN node, and there is no relation between TAs and LA/RAs.

q_2867.question: Which solutions to the event exposure service have minimal impact on the deployment of the NF acting as the event exposure service producer?
q_2867.ground_truth: Solution #33 has the minimum impact on the deployment of the NF acting as the event exposure service producer.

q_2868.question: What is the interleaving rule for coded bits in this data transmission system?
q_2868.ground_truth: i(B,j) = c(n,k) where k = 0,1,...,455, n = 0,1,..., with B = B0 + 4n + (k mod 8) - 4((k mod 8) div 6) and j = 2((49k) mod 57) + ((k mod 8) div 4)

q_2869.question: When can the dialogue be terminated in gsmSSF FSM related messages?
q_2869.ground_truth: The dialogue can be terminated in case of a non-error state transition to "Idle" with one or more pending operation and TC dialogue established, when the last event is sent, or when there is no operation to be sent. It also can be terminated if there is no pending call information request or armed EDP, and it is not initiated by the gsmSCF.

q_2870.question: What is the ability to render video on the UE to an external screen called and how is it currently done?
q_2870.ground_truth: The ability to render video on the UE to an external screen is called the Mobile UE Playback Displayed on External Monitors and HDTVs. It is currently done via cables and more recently via short-range wireless using DLNA standards.

q_2871.question: What is the expected sequence in the PROACTIVE COMMAND: REFRESH 1.5 in the REFRESH 1.4.1B response?
q_2871.ground_truth: The expected sequence is REFRESH, UICC Reset.

q_2872.question: What can uniquely identify an interactivity application data file within a service signaling of an interactivity-enabled User Service?
q_2872.ground_truth: A specific interactivity use case associated with the interactivity application logic.

q_2873.question: Which RANAP message is transmitted by the target RNC to the CN to indicate a failed incoming circuit switched inter-RAT handover in the context of UMTS?
q_2873.ground_truth: Transmission of a RANAP message RELOCATION FAILURE from the target RNC to the CN indicating a failed incoming inter-RAT handover in UMTS.

q_2874.question: Which test case is related to the FR2 scenario in the NR RSTD measurement accuracy test?
q_2874.ground_truth: The 14.3.3 NR RSTD measurement accuracy test case for single positioning frequency layer in FR2 SA.

q_2875.question: What is the purpose of the reportInterval attribute in the consumption reporting of MBMS User Service?
q_2875.ground_truth: The reportInterval attribute specifies the periodicity by which the UE performs consumption reporting, which uses the 'report interval' timer.

q_2876.question: What is the action taken if received upper layer PDUs exceed the maximum size limit in A/Gb mode?
q_2876.ground_truth: Any octet received beyond the maximum limit and until the next identified upper layer PDU boundary is discarded.

q_2877.question: What happens to a request for activation of certain diversion services when the OCB service has already been activated?
q_2877.ground_truth: The request will be rejected if the user's communication would be barred by the OCB service at the time of the activation attempt. However, the OCB service can still be activated even if communication forwarding services have already been activated. When both services have been activated, a request to invoke a communication forwarding service will be rejected if the forwarding party's communication would be barred by the OCB service at the time of the invocation attempt.

q_2878.question: How many different modulation and coding schemes are defined for the EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT Radio Blocks carrying RLC data blocks?
q_2878.ground_truth: Nine different modulation and coding schemes, MCS-1 to MCS-9, are defined for the EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT Radio Blocks carrying RLC data blocks.

q_2879.question: Which RLC mode should be used for real-time data in a UE with 3 or more uplink logical channels?

q_2880.question: What is the step where the IMS UE B sends a TCP SYN to establish the TCP connection in the IMS terminating session set-up procedures for one MSRP media stream using e2ae security?

q_2881.question: In which situations can the CS to PS SRVCC procedure be requested?
q_2881.ground_truth: The CS to PS SRVCC procedure can be requested by the network RR sublayer when switching to E-UTRAN/UTRAN PS bearers is needed in dedicated mode or dual transfer mode.

q_2882.question: What is the role of the MSGin5G Client in the process of forwarding stored messages?
q_2882.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client is responsible for delivering the stored messages to the Application Client once the message target becomes available.

q_2883.question: What is one of the benefits of using a new slot format with fewer pilot bits but more TPC bits?
q_2883.ground_truth: It gives similar performance as slot format 1 in terms of throughput.

q_2884.question: What is the definition of a general test function in UE special conformance test functions in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_2884.ground_truth: A general test function is a command sent by the SS to trigger a certain UE behavior, or to provide information to the UE needed for conformance testing, based on 3GPP core spec requirements or to facilitate conformance testing and not part of any 3GPP core spec requirements.

q_2885.question: What should the IWF do if it needs to aggregate MCData disposition notifications and the current MCData disposition timer is not running?
q_2885.ground_truth: The IWF should start the MCData disposition timer (TDC1) with a timer value as specified in 3GPP TS 24.282 clause F.2.2.

q_2886.question: In what scenario should the MME include the NBIFOM container IE in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message or MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message?
q_2886.ground_truth: The MME should include the NBIFOM container IE in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message or MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message if the selected NBIFOM mode is the network-initiated NBIFOM mode and the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure or the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure is initiated.

q_2887.question: What is the purpose of the Inform Response message during the registration process?
q_2887.ground_truth: The Inform Response message from the HMS is used to accept the HNB general information during the registration process.

q_2888.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what does its Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) focus on?
q_2888.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between multiple telecommunications standardization bodies, while the Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) focuses on the radio access network technologies used in 3GPP mobile networks.

q_2889.question: What action should a UE take upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the Identity type IE set to "SUCI" and timer T3519 not running?
q_2889.ground_truth: The UE should generate a fresh SUCI, send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the SUCI, start timer T3519, and store the value of the SUCI sent in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.

q_2890.question: How many tail bits are added to the code block before convolutional coding is performed in the channel coding step in Flexible Layer One?
q_2890.ground_truth: Before convolutional coding, 6 tail bits with binary value 0 are added to the end of the code block.

q_2891.question: What is the difference between Explicit CUG invocation and Implicit CUG invocation?
q_2891.ground_truth: Explicit CUG invocation is where a calling user attempts to invoke a CUG by passing CUG information to the network in a call request, while implicit CUG invocation is where the user invokes some default characteristic of a CUG without providing any CUG information in the call request.

q_2892.question: What is the difference between a CSG HNB and a non CSG HNB?
q_2892.ground_truth: A CSG HNB serves a CSG Cell, broadcasting a CSG Indicator and a specific CSG identity, while a non CSG HNB serves a cell which neither broadcasts a CSG Indicator nor a CSG Identity.

q_2893.question: What is the purpose of the "Assignment Requirement" element's octet 2 and what are the meanings of its different value-states?
q_2893.ground_truth: The "Assignment Requirement" element's octet 2 indicates the delay allowed and whether resources can be de-allocated before or after the end of the call. The value-states are: 1) Delay allowed, 2) Immediate and resources not de-allocated until end of call, and 3) Immediate with possible de-allocation. All other values are reserved.

q_2894.question: In the context of IP-CAN session modification, what is the difference between the number of attempted IP-CAN session modifications and the number of successful IP-CAN session modifications?
q_2894.ground_truth: The number of attempted IP-CAN session modifications refers to the total number of IP-CAN session modification procedures initiated by the UE, regardless of the outcome, while the number of successful IP-CAN session modifications refers to the number of IP-CAN session modification procedures that were initiated by the UE and resulted in a successful modification.

q_2895.question: What is the role of the target GANC in the execution phase of an inter-SGSN PS handover for GERAN A/Gb mode cells?
q_2895.ground_truth: The target GANC makes a decision about whether or not to activate a GA-PSR Transport Channel and prepares the Target BSS to Source BSS Transparent Container for the set up BSS PFCs.

q_2896.question: What is the objective of UE test loop procedures in general?
q_2896.ground_truth: The UE test loop procedures are intended for testing various aspects of the UE, such as receiver characteristics based on BER measurement, transmitter characteristics, uplink packet filtering, and others.

q_2897.question: What procedures are not supported in this version of the specification for the IWF performing the participating role in a remotely initiated group call?
q_2897.ground_truth: In this version of the specification, originating procedures in a remotely initiated group call for the IWF performing the participating role and terminating procedures in a remotely initiated group call for the IWF performing the participating role are not supported.

q_2898.question: What action should be taken by the system if T2 or T3 expires before the reception of a connection demand in the MSC?
q_2898.ground_truth: The call between C and B should be released with a cause of no reply. If T3 expired, the waiting call from C should be forwarded on no reply.

q_2899.question: What modifications are needed to the PLMN selection procedure to handle PLMN IDs with shared MCC?
q_2899.ground_truth: When the UE performs periodic search for higher priority PLMN, it should not eliminate any candidate PLMN due to the value of its MCC being different from the MCC of the serving PLMN if the candidate PLMN has a PLMN ID with shared MCC or the serving PLMN has a PLMN ID with shared MCC.

q_2900.question: What type of priority services does the signalling in ISUP and BICC have difficulty distinguishing between?

q_2901.question: What is the value of TSN when the length is 6 bits in a 1.28 Mcps TDD multi-frequency HS-DSCH cell?
q_2901.ground_truth: The value of TSN can be between 0 and 63 when the length is 6 bits in a 1.28 Mcps TDD multi-frequency HS-DSCH cell.

q_2902.question: What is the behavior of the MS when USF is correctly decoded but there is a CRC error on the payload data?
q_2902.ground_truth: If required by the USF, the MS shall transmit the received payload data when the USF field is correctly decoded but there is a CRC error on the payload data.

q_2903.question: What actions does the SMF take upon detecting a change in PDU session status?
q_2903.ground_truth: The SMF sends a notification message to the PCF, re-evaluates the Session-AMBR for the related PDU session, and initiates a PDU session modification procedure to deliver the changed Session-AMBR to the RAN and UPF.

q_2904.question: What is the role of the IRP in the 3GPP system architecture?
q_2904.ground_truth: The IRP (Integration Reference Point) is a standardized interface that enables the integration and interaction between different functional entities in the 3GPP system.

q_2905.question: Which downlink reference channels are to be used to fulfill the MIMO performance requirement for HS-DSCH in multi-path fading environments for DL reference channels H-Set 9/9A/9B/9C/9E?
q_2905.ground_truth: The reference channels H-Set 9/9A/9B/9C/9E are to be used in accordance with the MIMO performance requirements for the HS-DSCH, as specified in section 9.2.4.1. The primary precoding vector should correspond to the preferred primary precoding vector reported immediately before the start of the HS-SCCH subframe.

q_2906.question: What is the expected sequence for the ME to support class "e" commands in the TS 31.111 standard?
q_2906.ground_truth: The ME is expected to support the class "e" commands as defined in the TS 31.111 standard.

q_2907.question: What is the access independence and fundamental importance of IMS in providing vertical services in 3GPP network?
q_2907.ground_truth: IMS is access independent and provides IP based transport for both real-time and non real-time services, and a multimedia call model based on IETF SIP for session control layer. It also supports endpoint registration and routing of SIP signaling messages to the application server related to a specific service.

q_2908.question: What action should the MAC entity take if there is a resource conflict between two uplink grants with lch-basedPrioritization?
q_2908.ground_truth: If the data based on the lower priority grant causes a resource conflict, the MAC entity should prioritize the uplink grant with higher priority and autonomously retransmit the MAC PDU associated with the de-prioritized grant.

q_2909.question: What is the PLMN Management Architecture largely based on?
q_2909.ground_truth: The PLMN Management Architecture is largely based on TMN, which provides an architecture, interfaces, methodology, and a number of generic and/or common management functions to be specialised/applied to various and specific TMN interfaces. However, the new challenges of 3GPP Telecom Management may require the exploration and incorporation of other concepts.

q_2910.question: What should the UE do if it has not received all segments of a warning message within a period of 3 hours?
q_2910.ground_truth: The UE should discard any stored warningMessageSegment and the current value of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7 if the complete warning message has not been assembled within a period of 3 hours.

q_2911.question: What should a UE do when it receives an undefined non-critical message extension in a system information block on the BCCH?
q_2911.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the content of the extension and the system information block contents after the extension, but treat the parts of the system information block up to the extension normally.

q_2912.question: What are the 3 functional areas of service layer features defined in 3GPP MBMS and PSS specifications that might be considered relevant for interactivity support?
q_2912.ground_truth: The 3 functional areas of service layer features defined in 3GPP MBMS and PSS specifications that might be considered relevant for interactivity support are transport, signaling, and general "service management" such as security and reporting of interactivity usage.

q_2913.question: What functions does the SRNC perform in the UTRAN UE Positioning process?
q_2913.ground_truth: The SRNC is responsible for requesting information from other RNCs, flow control of positioning requests, positioning method selection, position calculation, providing UE Positioning assistance data, overall UE Positioning coordination and control, and record information on the usage of the UE Positioning for administrative purposes.

q_2914.question: What type of AVP is the Routing-Rule-Definition in the 5.3.70 section?
q_2914.ground_truth: The Routing-Rule-Definition AVP is of type Grouped in the 5.3.70 section.

q_2915.question: When should the DRNS include the Secondary CPICH Information IE in the Radio Link Set Up Response message?
q_2915.ground_truth: The DRNS should include the Secondary CPICH Information IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Information Response IE in the Additional E-DCH Cell Information Response IE in the Radio Link Set Up Response message if the secondary CPICH may be used as a phase reference for the radio link on the secondary UL frequency.

q_2916.question: How is the versioning of 3GPP documents determined?
q_2916.ground_truth: The versioning of 3GPP documents uses a three-part numbering system. The first digit indicates the stage of approval of the document, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial-only changes.

q_2917.question: What is the maximum length of the MAC field in version 1 of the GPI?
q_2917.ground_truth: The MAC field in version 1 of the GPI is 32 bits.

q_2918.question: How is the pre-emphasis factor used in the weighted speech calculation?
q_2918.ground_truth: The pre-emphasis factor of 0.68 is used to pre-emphasize the signal in the weighted speech calculation, and the LP filter coefficients are used to form the perceptual weighting filter.

q_2919.question: What is the duration of a radio frame in frame structure type 1?
q_2919.ground_truth: A radio frame in frame structure type 1 consists of 10 subframes and is long, with each unit being a time unit second.

q_2920.question: What does TNSCO define in the context of 3GPP TS 23.003?
q_2920.ground_truth: TNSCO defines together with TNSCN the ordered couple (TNS1, TNS2) used to form the timeslot shifting sequence.

q_2921.question: What is the role of the subcycle counter "j" in this synchronization process?
q_2921.ground_truth: The subcycle counter "j" represents the number of subcycles per cycle in the synchronization frame. It is used to define the synchronization frames within a synchronization period of 4096 frames.

q_2922.question: What is the effect of releasing a media flow on the Controllee UE in the pre-requisite that there exists a Collaborative Session with two media flows?
q_2922.ground_truth: If a media flow from a Controllee UE is released, the SCC AS sends the Release Media Request to the UE-2, where the media flow is removed. If no more media flows remain on UE-2 that are participating in the Collaborative Session, the SCC AS releases the access leg from UE-2. The Collaborative Session continues to exist after the media flow has been released.

q_2923.question: What is the dialling number string for the ME in Expected Sequence 4.1.3B?
q_2923.ground_truth: The dialling number string for the ME in Expected Sequence 4.1.3B is "123456".

q_2924.question: How many cells are included in the OTDOA assistance data neighbor cell list in Test 1 and Test 2?
q_2924.ground_truth: In Test 1, the assistance data neighbor cell list includes 15 cells, where 14 of the cells are not simulated. In Test 2, it includes 13 cells, where 13 of the cells are not simulated.

q_2925.question: What is the format of the network access name for the default bearer in the OPEN CHANNEL command?
q_2925.ground_truth: The network access name for the default bearer in the OPEN CHANNEL command is TestGp.rs.

q_2926.question: What should the mobile station do upon a change in the PNI value while acquiring an ETWS Primary Notification message?
q_2926.ground_truth: If the mobile station detects a change in the PNI value prior to acquiring a complete ETWS Primary Notification message, it shall abort the current message, restart timer T3232 and attempt to acquire the new message.

q_2927.question: What are the benefits of using a multi system terminal for a user?
q_2927.ground_truth: The benefits of using a multi system terminal for a user are increased coverage area, wider range of services, and the ability to use one terminal for both 3GPP and non-3GPP systems.

q_2928.question: When does a HLR implementing the Mobile Terminating Roaming Retry feature delay the sending of the PRN message?
q_2928.ground_truth: A HLR implementing the Mobile Terminating Roaming Retry feature delays the sending of the PRN message till completion of any on-going Location Update procedure.

q_2929.question: What is the role of the cell ID in the cell ID based positioning method?
q_2929.ground_truth: The cell ID based method determines the position of the UE regardless of the UE RRC mode (i.e. connected or idle) by mapping the cell ID to a corresponding SAI to match the service coverage information available in the CN.

q_2930.question: What REFSENS requirement is specific to the IMD issue that the 3rd IMD generated by dual uplink of Band n5 + Band n25 may fall into the own Rx of band n78?
q_2930.ground_truth: The same MSD value as 16.1 dB is reused.

q_2931.question: What does the term "Management Service (MnS)" refer to in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_2931.ground_truth: Management Service (MnS) refers to a service provided by the 3GPP system to manage network functions and services.

q_2932.question: What does the "Message ID" consist of in the Segmentation Information encoding?
q_2932.ground_truth: The "Message ID" consists of a 16-bit binary representation of the message identity used to identify to which messages different segments belong to.

q_2933.question: How does the PCRF handle multiple BBERFs with flow mobility within an IP-CAN session?
q_2933.ground_truth: The PCRF does not differentiate between primary and non-primary BBERFs when associating IP flow mobility routing rules. However, the PCRF may associate the default route with one of the BBERFs based on the IP flow mobility routing rule information received from the PCEF.

q_2934.question: What is the limit of out-of-band emissions, in terms of a spectrum emission mask, for UE in 6.6.2.1 in frequencies 2.5 MHz and 12.5 MHz away from the UE center carrier frequency?
q_2934.ground_truth: The spectrum emission mask of the UE applies to frequencies, which are between 2.5 MHz and 12.5 MHz away from the UE center carrier frequency. The out of band emission limit is specified in terms of a spectrum emission mask.

q_2935.question: What information is included in the BEGIN record in the context of I-WLAN interworking communication interception?
q_2935.ground_truth: The BEGIN record conveys the first event of I-WLAN interworking communication interception. It is triggered when there is a successful establishment of an I-WLAN tunnel, or when the interception of a target's communications is started and at least one I-WLAN tunnel is established.

q_2936.question: What is the main purpose of the MBS-5 interface in the 5MBS client architecture?
q_2936.ground_truth: The main purpose of the MBS-5 interface in the 5MBS client architecture is to provide an API from the 5MBS client to the MBSF for the purpose of 5MBS control plane and service handling.

q_2937.question: What happens to the waiting call, after the mobile station receives a SETUP message with Signaling IE indicating Call Waiting, if it does not indicate the bearer to be used for accepting the waiting call?
q_2937.ground_truth: The network does not release the traffic channel, if the cleared call was the last activity on the traffic channel, and there exists no retained bearer for the waiting call.

q_2938.question: What is GAN's relationship to traditional GSM/GPRS radio coverage?
q_2938.ground_truth: GAN is a complement to traditional GSM/GPRS radio coverage, used to enhance customer premises coverage, increase network capacity, and potentially lower costs.

q_2939.question: What is the presence of the "id-E-DPCCH-Power-Boosting-Capability" in the provided code?

q_2940.question: What is the maximum transmission time allowed for each single transmission simulation in the FoM metric for performance tests over-the-air or in lab environments?
q_2940.ground_truth: The maximum transmission time allowed for each single transmission simulation in the FoM metric for performance tests over-the-air or in lab environments is 200 seconds.

q_2941.question: In which scenario does the Browser Agent send a User-Supplied Identifier directly to the Relying Party?

q_2942.question: What are the priority network scenario and Subcarrier Spacing (SCS) for the impact of LTE and NR interference in the document?
q_2942.ground_truth: The priority network scenario is synchronous and the priority Subcarrier Spacing (SCS) for NR is 15 kHz in the context of LTE and NR interference in the document.

q_2943.question: What should the SGSN do in step 7 if ISR is active and the old SGSN is different from the serving SGSN?
q_2943.ground_truth: The old SGSN returns a Suspend Response to the serving SGSN.

q_2944.question: What does CAMEL stand for in the context of mobile network enhanced logic?
q_2944.ground_truth: Customised Applications for Mobile network Enhanced Logic

q_2945.question: What is the data rate reduction of the GSM full-rate speech codec compared to an uncompressed speech signal?
q_2945.ground_truth: The GSM full-rate speech codec reduces the data rate to 13 kbit/s compared to 64 kbit/s of an uncompressed speech signal (G.711 PCM).

q_2946.question: What should the Target AMF do if it receives a Reroute NAS message with reroute due slicing and Routing Information but cannot identify the related old AMF?
q_2946.ground_truth: The Target AMF initiates an identity request procedure with UE and gets the SUCI.

q_2947.question: What is the network setup for test case 8.1.6.3.3.1.3?
q_2947.ground_truth: The network setup for test case 8.1.6.3.3.1.3 includes NR Cell 1, NR Cell 2, Bluetooth beacon 1 (Cell 40), and Bluetooth beacon 2 (Cell 41).

q_2948.question: What is the maximum bitrate attribute used for in UMTS bearer service?
q_2948.ground_truth: Maximum bitrate is used to make code reservations in the downlink of the radio interface and limit the delivered bitrate to applications or external networks with limitations. It also allows the maximum wanted user bitrate to be defined for applications able to operate with different rates.

q_2949.question: What is the purpose of the "gapIndicator" parameter in the CallGap procedure?
q_2949.ground_truth: The "gapIndicator" parameter indicates the gapping characteristics, such as the time interval between calls being allowed through and the total time duration of call gapping.

q_2950.question: What is the difference between a dedicated channel and a common channel in the context of the document?
q_2950.ground_truth: Dedicated channels are transport channels that use inherent addressing of UE, while common channels are transport channels that use explicit addressing of UE if addressing is needed.

q_2951.question: What is defined in the STN NRM but not in the generic NRM in TS 28.622?
q_2951.ground_truth: Signalling Transport specific Managed Object Classes

q_2952.question: What happens to an incoming Priority Service call that terminates to a Service Provider network when a radio traffic channel is not available and the cell's queue is full, but the call's priority level is less than or equal to the priority level of the lowest priority request in the queue?
q_2952.ground_truth: The new Priority Service call request is given the same treatment as appropriate for non-Priority Service calls that do not get a radio traffic channel.

q_2953.question: What should be done when the SCC AS is aware that preconditions are met on all legs of a session?
q_2953.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP UPDATE request towards the remote UE indicating that local preconditions are met.

q_2954.question: How is the ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHigh thresholdANDSF condition evaluated?
q_2954.ground_truth: The ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHigh thresholdANDSF condition is evaluated by comparing the measured Beacon RSSI value with the threshold value contained in the leaf. If the measured value is greater than the threshold, the node is considered a match, otherwise, it is not.

q_2955.question: What is the primary difference between "Single encoded stream with higher quality in the viewport region" and "Tiled Video with Multiple Quality Levels" approaches in the ITT4RT context?
q_2955.ground_truth: In the single encoded stream approach, the full 360-degree video is delivered as a single encoded stream with higher quality in the viewport region. This method delivers the entire 360-degree video in a single stream but provides better quality in the viewport region. In contrast, the tiled video approach uses tiled encoding with multiple quality levels to create a low-quality version for the non-viewport region and a high-quality version for the viewport region. This allows more efficient handling of lower-end devices by adjusting tile size and quality based on viewport and device capabilities.

q_2956.question: What message is sent by the BSS to the mobile station in an Intra-BSS DTM handover using the optimized PS handover procedure to request it to perform a DTM handover and switch to a different cell managed by the same BSS?

q_2957.question: What is the BM-SC derived from Geographical Area as provided by the V2X Application Server when using xMB interface, and what does it provide towards the downlink signalling path towards the RAN nodes?
q_2957.ground_truth: The BM-SC derives the MBMS Service Area and the SAI list for the availability information from Geographical Area as provided by the V2X Application Server when using xMB interface. The BM-SC provides both the MBMS SAI(s) and Cell ID(s) towards the downlink signalling path towards the RAN nodes.

q_2958.question: Which channels support unacknowledged operation only in LAPDm protocol?
q_2958.ground_truth: BCCH and CCCH channels support unacknowledged operation only.

q_2959.question: How should clause headings in a 3GPP TS or TR be formatted?
q_2959.ground_truth: Clause headings in a 3GPP TS or TR should use the appropriate Heading styles, starting from Heading~1, e.g. for clause A.1 use Heading 1, for A.1.1 use Heading 2.

q_2960.question: Under what circumstance will a MS not be required to send measurement reports and not obey any cell re-selection commands while in DTM?
q_2960.ground_truth: When a circuit switched connection is established, which takes precedence over GPRS cell re-selection, including an MS operating in DTM.

q_2961.question: What should the UE do if the status code of the Binding Acknowledgment indicates failure with an unspecified reason (128)?
q_2961.ground_truth: The UE should re-send the Binding Update including the 0.0.0.0 address in the IPv4 Home Address option.

q_2962.question: What is the size of the groups of bits taken from the input sequence in the mapping for 64QAM?
q_2962.ground_truth: The bits are taken in groups of 6.

q_2963.question: What is temporal scalability in Scalable Video Coding (SVC)?
q_2963.ground_truth: Temporal scalability in SVC refers to the ability to produce scalable bitstreams that support different frame rates, allowing for efficient compression and smooth playback.

q_2964.question: What was the test design methodology used in the second listening test over headphones, after the results of the first one were found to be inconclusive?
q_2964.ground_truth: The conclusions in the second listening test over headphones were based on the conclusions from the 2nd GAL report, which was designed after the first test plan results were found to be inconclusive.

q_2965.question: What action does the UE take if a cell is indicated as "reserved" for operator use but not "true" for other use, and the UE is assigned to an Access Identity other than 11 or 15 operating in its HPLMN/EHPLMN?
q_2965.ground_truth: The UE behaves as if the cell status is "barred" and does not attempt to reselect to the higher ranked cell.

q_2966.question: What must the UE do if it intends to request an S-NSSAI in the Rejected S-NSSAI with a new cause value indicating it is supported by the current Tracking Area but is incompatible with the Allowed NSSAI?
q_2966.ground_truth: The UE must perform registration with the rejected S-NSSAI within the current Registration Area, not set the 5G-S-TMSI or GUAMI in the AS layer, and may set the new requested S-NSSAI that it requests in the RRC message.

q_2967.question: What information is stored in EF~5GS3GPPNSC file present in the USIM?
q_2967.ground_truth: The EF~5GS3GPPNSC file contains the 5GS 3GPP access NAS security context, consisting of K~AMF with the associated key set identifier, the UE security capabilities, and the uplink and downlink NAS COUNT values.

q_2968.question: What is the meaning of "Isochronous" and its significance in the context of the 5G system?
q_2968.ground_truth: Isochronous refers to a time characteristic of an event or signal that is recurring at known, periodic time intervals. In the context of the 5G system, isochronous data transmission ensures that data between the source and the sink of the AV application flows continuously and at a steady rate.

q_2969.question: Which TS specifies the network sharing concepts and requirements for 5G?
q_2969.ground_truth: TS 32.130: "Telecom management; Network sharing; Concepts and requirements"

q_2970.question: What is the name of the technical specification document produced by the 3GPP?
q_2970.ground_truth: The name of the document is 3G Security; Specification of the A5/3 encryption algorithms for GSM and ECSD, and the GEA3 encryption algorithm for GPRS; Implementors' test data (Release 17).

q_2971.question: What type is the Required-Access-Info AVP in the QoS-Rule-Remove AVP?
q_2971.ground_truth: The Required-Access-Info AVP is of type Grouped

q_2972.question: What should the DRNS include in the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message in 1.28 Mcps TDD, if HS-PDSCH resources could be allocated on TS0 for the UE?
q_2972.ground_truth: The DRNS may include the TS0 HS-PDSCH Indication LCR IE in the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message.

q_2973.question: When the reportType is EventTriggered, what will the system do if a first transmission resource pool triggers the event and there is no measurement reporting entry for the given measId?
q_2973.ground_truth: In this case, the system will include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for the given measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned transmission resource pools in the poolsTriggeredList, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5.

q_2974.question: What happens when the validity timer associated with a ProSe Application Code expires?
q_2974.ground_truth: The ProSe Function removes the entry related to that ProSe Application Code from the UE context.

q_2975.question: What is the result of the LANGUAGE NOTIFICATION test requirement?
q_2975.ground_truth: The result of the LANGUAGE NOTIFICATION test requirement is that the ME shall conclude the command by sending the TERMINAL RESPONSE (OK) to the SIM as soon as possible, after receiving the LANGUAGE NOTIFICATION proactive SIM command.

q_2976.question: Where should the IP destination address of the GTP request message be?
q_2976.ground_truth: The IP destination address in a GTP request message should be an IP address of the destination GSN/RNC.

q_2977.question: What is the difference between RAck, StaR, StaR-all, and StaR-only reportTypes?
q_2977.ground_truth: RAck reports only successful file reception without reception details, StaR reports successful file reception with reception details, StaR-all reports both successful and failed file reception, and StaR-only reports only reception details for successful and failed reception sessions.

q_2978.question: How does the MCVideo system handle group communication and affiliation?
q_2978.ground_truth: Users can be a member of several groups, with membership determined by administration control. Each user chooses to affiliate to the groups they want to receive video communication from, and once successfully affiliated, they will begin to receive video communications directed to that group.

q_2979.question: What action should the SGSN take when deactivating a Trace Session to GGSN?
q_2979.ground_truth: The SGSN should include the Additional Trace Info in the message and set the Trace Activity Control to Trace Deactivation.

q_2980.question: What should the controller UE include in the SIP URI when sending a SIP REFER request to transfer media components?
q_2980.ground_truth: The controller UE should include the SIP URI of the controllee UE, the URI header field with hname "body" containing SDP for each of the media (m=) lines in the session, the Accept header field with the MIME type message/sipfrag, and the Target-Dialog header field containing the dialog parameters for the existing session.

q_2981.question: Which field is present in the diversityIndication-RL-AdditionRspTDD2 structure if the diversityIndication field is present?
q_2981.ground_truth: The diversityIndication field is present in the diversityIndication field if CHOICE = nonCombining in the DiversityIndication-RL-AdditionRspTDD2 structure.

q_2982.question: What must the conditions in a communication barring rule evaluate to for the rule to match and execute the specified action?
q_2982.ground_truth: The conditions in a communication barring rule must all evaluate to true for the rule to match and execute the specified action.

q_2983.question: What is the expected sequence in 5.1.4.4.2 for Expected Sequence A if the USS sends PAGING TYPE 1 to the UE using the TMSI stored in the USIM?
q_2983.ground_truth: After the USS sends PAGING TYPE 1 to the UE using the TMSI stored in the USIM, the UE will send a RRC CONNECTION REQUEST, the USS will send RRC CONNECTION SETUP, the UE will send RRC CONNECTION SETUP COMPLETE, the USS will send RRC CONNECTION RELEASE, and the UE will send RRC CONNECTION RELEASE COMPLETE.

q_2984.question: What action should the BSS take if both an uplink and downlink TBF exist during U-TDOA positioning?
q_2984.ground_truth: The BSS may use either TBF for MS location using the U-TDOA location method, and should not terminate the TBF until the Packet polling procedures have been completed.

q_2985.question: What is one of the functions of the MBS assistance information?
q_2985.ground_truth: One of the functions of the MBS assistance information is to assist the NG-RAN in deciding the delivery mode of AN resources for MBS services.

q_2986.question: What is the role of the StartDestPortNumber leaf in a flow distribution rule?
q_2986.ground_truth: The StartDestPortNumber leaf indicates the first destination port number of the destination port numbers range in the IP flow description.

q_2987.question: What is the purpose of the Implicit Reject Status field within the EC-SCH in EC-GSM-IoT?
q_2987.ground_truth: It is used for overload control by PLMN specific barring

q_2988.question: What value should the port field have in the 'm' line for the HTTP download channel in the SDP answer?
q_2988.ground_truth: The port field should be set to the value of the HTTP Server for the download channel, such as 80.

q_2989.question: What is the handling of charging events when using an external CGF?
q_2989.ground_truth: An external CGF can be used by other non-Monitoring Event network elements, and may also be integrated with the BD, in which case the Bmn interface does not exist. The relationship between MECN/CDF and CGF is m:1 for an external CGF, and 1:1 for an integrated CGF. At least one of the Rf, Ga, or Bmn interfaces must be supported.

q_2990.question: How does the MS move to the PMM-CONNECTED state from the PMM-IDLE state?
q_2990.ground_truth: The MS moves to the PMM-CONNECTED state when the PS signalling connection is established between the MS and the 3G-SGSN in the IDLE state.

q_2991.question: What is the benefit of power reduction on BCCH carrier for the cell reselection process in idle mode?
q_2991.ground_truth: It results in a significant reduction of the number of cell reselections in idle mode, with the extent being dependent on the traffic load.

q_2992.question: What action should the IP-SM-GW take if the content of the body in Short Message format is greater than the allowed message length of a Short Message?
q_2992.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW should send concatenated Short Messages in such a case.

q_2993.question: What is the name of the group that produced the technical specification for E-UTRAN?

q_2994.question: What entity sends a request to DCCF to collect historical data?

q_2995.question: What is the focus of the technical aspect 2 in the 5G Stage-1 Requirements for 3GPP Conversational Services?
q_2995.ground_truth: The focus of technical aspect 2 is on efficient video user plane, including efficient user plane routing and achieved media quality per transmitted bit for video.

q_2996.question: What actions should the MS take if it is provided IP connectivity by an AP on the AP Exclude List?
q_2996.ground_truth: If the MS is provided IP connectivity by an AP on the AP Exclude List, it shall not initiate discovery or GAN registration until the relevant AP has been removed from the AP Exclude List.

q_2997.question: How does the BBERF handle the QoS Rules request for Emergency services?
q_2997.ground_truth: The BBERF executes the same procedure as for a Gateway control and QoS Rules request unrelated to Emergency Services described in clause~4a.5.1.1 with some differences in specific AVPs and values for the BBERF and PCRF.

q_2998.question: What is the name of the echo canceller algorithm used in the eCall modems for echo cancellation?
q_2998.ground_truth: A normalized Least-Mean-Square (NLMS) algorithm for adaptive filtering

q_2999.question: What is the purpose of the iE-Extensions in the HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify?
q_2999.ground_truth: The iE-Extensions in the HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify specify optional or critical IEs that are added to modify the secondary serving information in the modified cell. The exact set of IEs contained in the iE-Extensions is determined by the specific needs of the network and may include indicators for HARQ-Preamble-Mode, Multiflow-OrdinalNumberOfFrequency, and power-offset-for-S-CPICH-for-MIMO-withfourtransmitantennas-Request-Indicator, among others.

q_3000.question: How does the cell re-selection criteria work for E-UTRA and NR cells?
q_3000.ground_truth: The cell re-selection criteria are based on various factors such as the Absolute Priories of different E-UTRAN frequencies or inter-RAT frequencies, the current cell state, and the cell detection capability of the UE. The UE reselects the cell based on these criteria during the inter-RAT cell reselection test.

q_3001.question: Which method is used to look for the first occurrence of a TLV element and copy its value into a destination buffer in CRRN1?

q_3002.question: What message is sent by the network to the MS to initiate a location update procedure?
q_3002.ground_truth: A REGISTER message containing an LCS Location Update invoke component is sent by the network to the MS to initiate a location update procedure.

q_3003.question: What is the number of rows in the matrix for the block interleaver in the case of QPSK?
q_3003.ground_truth: The interleaver is a block interleaver consisting of a matrix with 30 columns and R2 rows. The number of rows (R2) is determined based on the number of bits in one TTI, by finding the minimum integer R2 such that R <= 30*R2.

q_3004.question: What network operator option is described to avoid sending of a progress indicator with specific progress information to avoid call release by an ISDN terminal?
q_3004.ground_truth: As a network operator option, the value I = 0 "no interworking encountered" or K = 1 "ISDN user part/BICC used all the way" can be used for unrestricted TMR = 64 kBit/s to avoid sending the progress indicator that would cause the call to be released.

q_3005.question: What is the purpose of the "3gpp.iut.replication" SDP attribute?
q_3005.ground_truth: The "3gpp.iut.replication" SDP attribute is used to indicate replication of a media component, either at the session level or at the media level.

q_3006.question: What is the required minimum LNA IIP2 value that was found from using the second order interferer with the highest power level at the LNA input?
q_3006.ground_truth: The required minimum LNA IIP2 of 74.8 dBm.

q_3007.question: What is the purpose of allocating persistent addresses for mobile UEs that need MEC access?
q_3007.ground_truth: The purpose is to address the problem of UE IP address change, which is a part of Key Issue #2: Edge relocation.

q_3008.question: What measures should be taken to ensure that a PSAP of the country where the UE is located can be selected for an emergency call?
q_3008.ground_truth: The UE should include UE location information in the SIP INVITE, as per existing IMS specification, and the emergency service system can use this information to route the emergency service call to a local PSAP and as an initial approximate UE location.

q_3009.question: What message is used to set up a network provided Connected Number with an Address not Available indication in accordance with ISUP procedures?

q_3010.question: What actions can a UE take when scanning for CSG cells?
q_3010.ground_truth: During manual CSG ID selection, a UE scans all frequencies in the supported frequency bands, displays a list of found CSG IDs or HNB Names, and selects a CSG cell or hybrid cell among the ones with the same CSG ID and PLMN ID. A UE may normally camp on the chosen cell if it is a CSG member cell or a hybrid cell.

q_3011.question: In RL-InformationResponse-RL-AdditionRspTDD768, what is the meaning of "ul-PhysCH-SF-Variation"?
q_3011.ground_truth: It is the Uplink Physical Channel Spreading Factor variation for the UE.

q_3012.question: When a Re-INVITE is sent in step 6a-1, what does it add to the active session, if UE-1 is using ICS capabilities?
q_3012.ground_truth: The Re-INVITE adds Gm service control to the active session when sent in step 6a-1, if UE-1 is using ICS capabilities.

q_3013.question: What happens when the HLR receives an erasure request without a basic service group code for CFU?
q_3013.ground_truth: The erasure request applies to all basic service groups for which CFU is registered.

q_3014.question: What value should be inserted in the Call-Identifier (Part-1) subfield when the ICS UE wants to establish an I1 session for a mid-call supplementary service?
q_3014.ground_truth: All bits in the Part-1 subfield should be set to values "1" (i.e. "11111111").

q_3015.question: What consists of a MAC subheader in 3GPP TS 38.321?
q_3015.ground_truth: A MAC subheader, excluding fixed-sized MAC CEs and padding, consists of four header fields: R, F, LCID, and L in 3GPP TS 38.321.

q_3016.question: When is traffic mapping information generated for a dedicated bearer if there is no uplink SDF filter with an indication to signal corresponding traffic mapping information to the UE?
q_3016.ground_truth: The PCEF/BBERF derives traffic mapping information based on implementation-specific logic, which may disallow any useful packet flows in the uplink direction. This is to ensure that the state of TFT packet filters is maintained for an IP-CAN session.

q_3017.question: What should the originator of the SABM command do upon reception of the UA response with the F bit set to 1?
q_3017.ground_truth: The originator of the SABM command should reset timer T200, set V(S), V(R), V(A), and B to 0, and enter the ABM state and inform layer 3 using the LL-ESTABLISH-CNF or LL-ESTABLISH-IND primitive.

q_3018.question: What actions should the IWF performing the controlling role take if it is unable to process a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification due to lack of resources or risk of congestion?
q_3018.ground_truth: The IWF performing the controlling role may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response.

q_3019.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 36.301, what is the "User Equipment (UE)" and what does it do?
q_3019.ground_truth: The User Equipment (UE) is the device that receives and processes signals from the Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (UTRA) network. Its main function is to establish a connection with the UTRAN and communicate using the specified protocols and interfaces.

q_3020.question: What is one scenario where the TrGW can use the "Additional Bandwidth Properties" information element?
q_3020.ground_truth: The TrGW can use this information for rate adaption, such as selecting an appropriate encoding and redundancy when transcoding media streams.

q_3021.question: What is the function of the IED's Information-Element-Data (IED) octet in the context of the length indicator?
q_3021.ground_truth: The IED octet indicates the length of the IETF RFC 5322 E-Mail Header located at the beginning of the data part of the current SM segment or, in case of concatenated SM, indicates the length of that fraction of the IETF RFC 5322 E-Mail Header located at the beginning of the data part of the current segment of the concatenated SM.

q_3022.question: In FR1, DL only evaluation, UMa, VR45, what is the mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced CDRX scheme with marginal loss in DL UE satisfied rate?
q_3022.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced CDRX scheme in FR1, DL only evaluation, UMa, VR45 is 18.22%.

q_3023.question: What security context data can be distributed between R98- VLRs/SGSNs?
q_3023.ground_truth: Current security context data can be distributed between R99+ VLRs/SGSNs, but R98- VLRs/SGSNs are not prepared to distribute current security context data.

q_3024.question: Which parameter defines the SixteenQAM uplink capability for a Local Cell?

q_3025.question: What should the UE do if there are not enough GPS satellites for a location estimate?
q_3025.ground_truth: The UE should set the "Error reason" to "Not Enough GPS Satellites" in the "UE positioning Error" information element of the MEASUREMENT REPORT message.

q_3026.question: What is the maximum length of the GTP header, which includes a variable length header used for both the GTP-C and GTP-U protocols?
q_3026.ground_truth: The minimum length of the GTP header is 8 bytes.

q_3027.question: What should a receiving node do if it receives a message initiating a procedure with IEs/IE groups marked with "Reject IE" that it does not comprehend?
q_3027.ground_truth: The receiving node should terminate the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure.

q_3028.question: What message does the SMF send to the UPF in step 2 of the procedure "MBS session joining via PDU Session Establishment"?
q_3028.ground_truth: The SMF sends an N4 Session Establishment/Modification Request to the UPF in step 2 of the procedure "MBS session joining via PDU Session Establishment".

q_3029.question: What is the description of the Train dispatch order data communication use case between the controller and driver?
q_3029.ground_truth: This use case involves the FRMCS system transmitting the train dispatch order between the controller and driver, including train orders, station receiving route, running tokens, etc. to avoid any collision with other trains.

q_3030.question: What is the variable Ninfo used for in the calculation of TBS?
q_3030.ground_truth: Ninfo is an unquantized intermediate variable used in the calculation of TBS.

q_3031.question: What is the purpose of the Power, Energy and Environmental (PEE) parameters control and monitoring in the GSM, UTRAN, and E-UTRAN Radio Access Networks?
q_3031.ground_truth: The present document specifies the requirements for controlling and monitoring PEE parameters in GSM, UTRAN, and E-UTRAN Radio Access Networks.

q_3032.question: What should the AS indicate in a reliable response to the UE to use the SIP INFO mechanism for DTMF transport?
q_3032.ground_truth: The AS should include a Recv-Info header field with a "infoDtmf" value in the reliable response.

q_3033.question: What is the maximum segmentation size of the MSGin5G message in the non-IMS messaging?
q_3033.ground_truth: The maximum segmentation size of the MSGin5G message is 2048 bytes.

q_3034.question: What is the function of the AssuranceReport class in the assurance closed control loop?
q_3034.ground_truth: The AssuranceReport class represents the attributes of assurance report, and contains information about one or multiple AssuranceGoalStatus and one or multiple AssuranceTargetStatus. It represents the monitoring information of an assurance closed control loop for an observation time, and is used by the consumer to perform closed control loop governance.

q_3035.question: What is the purpose of the supplementary service during a combinational session?
q_3035.ground_truth: To emulate the behavior of common supplementary services from the circuit switched domain for combinational sessions.

q_3036.question: What does the UARFCNforNt ID represent in the HS-DSCH-Resources-Information-AuditRsp-ExtIEs NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION field?
q_3036.ground_truth: The UARFCNforNt ID represents the UARFCN (Unit ARFCN) or frequency that the HS-DSCH resource is associated with.

q_3037.question: What is the range of RSARP values in degrees?
q_3037.ground_truth: The RSARP value is multiplied by 100 and binary coded with P15 as the most significant bit and P0 as the least significant bit. The RSARP value is in the range of 0 to 359.99 degrees.

q_3038.question: What should an IMS-ALG do when it receives an SDP offer with a "a=setup:active" attribute for a new TCP based media stream and the IMS-ALG is handling a UE behind a remote NAT?
q_3038.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should replace the "a=setup:active" attribute with a "a=setup:actpass" or "a=setup:passive" attribute and should not indicate to the IMS-AGW to use the incoming TCP connection establishment request as a trigger for sending a TCP connection establishment request.

q_3039.question: What should the RAN ensure when duplicate messages are delivered to the CN because of uplink message delivery?
q_3039.ground_truth: The RAN should ensure that the protocol permits correct discarding by a specified network mechanism (N(SD)) of any duplicate messages.

q_3040.question: In the context of slot formats using TFCI, what does the TFCI value in each radio frame correspond to?
q_3040.ground_truth: The TFCI value in each radio frame corresponds to a certain transport format combination of the FACHs currently in use.

q_3041.question: In which range of frequencies should the out of band gain be measured for the Repeater?
q_3041.ground_truth: The out of band gain should be measured for the Repeater immediately outside the pass band, up to a frequency offset of 10.8 MHz for certain regions.

q_3042.question: How does the k layer entity behave when timer T200 expires while there are outstanding I-frames?
q_3042.ground_truth: When timer T200 expires, the k layer entity follows the recovery procedure as defined in sub-clause 8.5.7 for the unacknowledged I-frames.

q_3043.question: What are the two possible values of boolean indicators?
q_3043.ground_truth: The two possible values of boolean indicators are true and false.

q_3044.question: What is the function of the Congestion-Level-Definition AVP (AVP code 4002)?
q_3044.ground_truth: The Congestion-Level-Definition AVP (AVP code 4002) is used to define a congestion level set and corresponding congestion level(s) to be used by the RCAF for a specific user id and PDN ID at congestion reporting.

q_3045.question: What is the impact on the MIL values for results assumed to have a maximum TRP of 23 dBm?
q_3045.ground_truth: The corresponding MIL values have been reduced by 11dB for these results.

q_3046.question: Which error is used when the gsmSRF is not able to perform its function and cannot be replaced, and the error is indicated to the gsmSCF?

q_3047.question: What is the difference between the three versions of the document presented to the TSG?
q_3047.ground_truth: Version numbering in 3GPP documents has three parts. The first digit indicates the stage of approval, "1" for information, "2" for approval, and "3" or greater for TSG-approved documents under change control. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, while the third digit is only incremented for editorial changes.

q_3048.question: What should be done if all reporting quantities for a triggered measurement are set to FALSE?
q_3048.ground_truth: If all reporting quantities for a triggered measurement are set to FALSE, then the UE should not set the IE "measured results" or "measured results on secondary UL frequency" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT message.

q_3049.question: What is the effect of fine time assistance in the LPP message of type PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION?
q_3049.ground_truth: Fine time assistance provides an improved GNSS time accuracy and the relationship between the GNSS system time and the current E-UTRAN time to the UE.

q_3050.question: What is the purpose of the measurement defined in section 9.8.3 of the document?
q_3050.ground_truth: The purpose of the measurement defined in section 9.8.3 of the document is to verify that the RSTD TDD inter-frequency measurement reporting delay is within the specified limits for NB-IOT Standalone Mode in enhanced coverage.

q_3051.question: What is the purpose of the "Coding of usage (bits 3-1)" field in the mobile positioning methods?
q_3051.ground_truth: The "Coding of usage (bits 3-1)" field in the mobile positioning methods indicates the success or failure of the positioning method and whether the results were used to generate or verify the location.

q_3052.question: What does the "id-Cause" parameter contain in the "Iu-ReleaseCommandIEs" sequence?
q_3052.ground_truth: The "id-Cause" parameter in the "Iu-ReleaseCommandIEs" sequence contains a cause value which indicates the reason for releasing the RAB in the Iu-ReleaseCommand message.

q_3053.question: What is the measure of music clarity, as defined in the technical report, in terms of the early and late sound energy?
q_3053.ground_truth: Music clarity is the ratio of the early sound energy (between 0 and 80 ms) to the late sound energy (that arrives later than 80 ms), typically reported in dB.

q_3054.question: What is supported in Rel-17 for multi-TRP PUCCH repetition in NR FR1 and FR2?
q_3054.ground_truth: Up to two sets of power control parameters in NR FR1 or up to two PUCCH-SpatialRelationInfo in NR FR2 can be activated per PUCCH resource or per PUCCH resource group via MAC-CE.

q_3055.question: What is the difference in the loudness ratings between the normal position and the vertical position of the devices in the silence condition?
q_3055.ground_truth: The loudness ratings increase by at least 3.1 dB for the devices when comparing the vertical position to the normal position.

q_3056.question: What is the purpose of step 7 in the Activation of enhanced security for S2c procedure over trusted Fixed Broadband Access?
q_3056.ground_truth: In step 7, if no Gateway Control session over S9a for this UE exists, then the PCRF initiates the Gateway Control Session Establishment procedure with the BPCF. Otherwise, the PCRF provides new QoS rules corresponding to the new PDN connection to the BPCF using the Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision procedure.

q_3057.question: Which explicit information item must be included in the Explicit Information Item IE in order for the SAS to include the GANSS Additional Time Models IE in Requested Data Value IE with the requested time information for each GANSS?
q_3057.ground_truth: GANSS Generic Data, with the GANSS Time Model GNSS-GNSS IE having more than one bit set to value "1" in the GNSS-GNSS Time ext IE

q_3058.question: What action is taken to determine the appropriate transport protocol for the data channel, as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229?
q_3058.ground_truth: The WIC performs the ICE procedures as defined in RFC 8445 and RFC 8839, and determines the appropriate transport protocol (UDP or TCP) for the data channel.

q_3059.question: What is the procedure to create an MME-MSC/VLR association?
q_3059.ground_truth: The MME-MSC/VLR association is created when a UE performs a combined EPS/IMSI attach or when there is a combined TA/LA Update.

q_3060.question: What message does the CN node send to the target RNC to allocate resources for the radio links to be used after the handover?
q_3060.ground_truth: The CN conveys a Relocation Request message to the target RNC to allocate resources.

q_3061.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for 10.1B.3?
q_3061.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for 10.1B.3 are the same as defined in clause 10.1.3.

q_3062.question: What happens if a legacy UE is handed over from a legacy source eNB to an upgraded target eNB that supports UP IP?
q_3062.ground_truth: The UP IP policy will not be forwarded by the legacy source eNB to the target eNB, and the target eNB will not be able to activate UP IP even if the UE supports UP IP.

q_3063.question: Who sends the SIP BYE message to initiate session termination in the IM CN subsystem?
q_3063.ground_truth: The SCF sends the SIP BYE message to initiate session termination in the IM CN subsystem.

q_3064.question: In the context of the 3GPP technical specification's IOC TesterObject, what is the purpose of the test category specific TOs and VSE TOs, and why is each test invocation associated with only one TO?
q_3064.ground_truth: IOC TesterObject is a generic test object that serves as an abstract class. More specific tester objects are derived from it for each test category. These test category specific TOs and VSE TOs can be system-specific. Each test invocation is associated with only one TO, because each test execution shall have only one test result that should be reported.

q_3065.question: What is the purpose of the Paging Area function in the HLR?
q_3065.ground_truth: The Paging Area function allows the HLR to be updated with the current Paging Area, which can then be used for paging optimization after a MSC/VLR restart.

q_3066.question: What algorithm is used in the GIA4 integrity algorithm?
q_3066.ground_truth: The KASUMI algorithm is used in the GIA4 integrity algorithm.

q_3067.question: What is the functionality of the ATSSS-LL in relation to traffic steering, switching, or splitting?
q_3067.ground_truth: The ATSSS-LL functionality is responsible for traffic steering, switching, or splitting in the network.

q_3068.question: What does the AMF need to do to take the new Kamf-1 key into use?
q_3068.ground_truth: The AMF needs to initiate a new NAS SMC procedure with the UE to take the new Kamf-1 key into use.

q_3069.question: What action should MSC-A take if the traffic channel allocation is queued by the BSS-B' in the subsequent handover procedure from MSC-B to MSC-B'?
q_3069.ground_truth: MSC-A may optionally send the A-QUEUING-INDICATION back to MSC-B.

q_3070.question: What is the responsibility of UE-B when initiating IP-CAN bearer setup for the media?
q_3070.ground_truth: UE-B must immediately initiate IP-CAN bearer setup for the media when required, without alerting the user, and send a 200 OK with the media components marked 'inactive' upon successful setup.

q_3071.question: What should the UE do if it has initiated a 2-step RA type Random Access procedure in NR SpCell, and the SS sends a MSGB including a Backoff Indicator and the Random Access Preamble identifier is different from the value received from UE?
q_3071.ground_truth: The UE should perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure for 2-step RA type Random Access after a random time between 0 and the indicated Backoff parameter from the same group.

q_3072.question: What is the main difference between "MGW Register" and "MGW Re-register" procedure?
q_3072.ground_truth: The main difference between "MGW Register" and "MGW Re-register" procedure is that, in MGW Re-register, the MGW has already registered before but it has lost the registration and trying to register again. While MGW Register is the initial registration process of the MGW.

q_3073.question: What interfaces and procedures are supported in the present document and how are the asynchronous data rates between the MT and the IWF defined?
q_3073.ground_truth: The present document covers support of services for the following interfaces and procedures: ITU-T V.14, ITU-T V.21, ITU-T V.22bis, ITU-T V.32, ITU-T I.420, and ITU-T V.250. The asynchronous data rates between the MT and the IWF are defined in 3GPP TS 22.002.

q_3074.question: What is required for a 3GPP MSC-S initiating an offer to include in the offer?
q_3074.ground_truth: The OoBTC Indicator is required to be included in the offer.

q_3075.question: What should the Node B do if the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message includes the Number of Supported Carriers IE in the UE Capabilities Information IE in the HS-DSCH Information IE in an FDD system?
q_3075.ground_truth: The Node B should use this information to allocate HSDPA resources over multiple carriers for the UE.

q_3076.question: What should be set in the identity field in CancelLocationArg when constructing a MAP-CancelLocation message as a result of receiving a CLR command in step 8.3.3?
q_3076.ground_truth: The identity field in CancelLocationArg should be populated with the imsi value of the User-Name AVP received within CLR.

q_3077.question: What is the purpose of using the source IP address and UDP port of the IuUP Init packet received from the radio access network as the destination address for subsequent downlink packets?
q_3077.ground_truth: This method ensures that downlink packets are sent to the correct destination, improving network efficiency and reducing the risk of miscommunication.

q_3078.question: What type of information is used to enable a personalized interactivity experience in the use cases?
