q_3078.ground_truth: Information about the user, such as their profile, is used to enable a personalized interactivity experience in the use cases.

q_3079.question: What is the purpose of the TMGI Allocation Procedure?
q_3079.ground_truth: The TMGI Allocation Procedure is used by the GCS AS to request a set of TMGIs or renew the expiration time for already allocated TMGIs.

q_3080.question: What is the purpose of the UP bit in the S and I+S frame headers?
q_3080.ground_truth: The UP bit in the S and I+S frame headers is used by the IWF to indicate to the UE that a service level upgrading will increase the throughput. Its usage is negotiated by XID exchange.

q_3081.question: What information does the "Global eNB ID" information element provide?
q_3081.ground_truth: The "Global eNB ID" information element is used to globally identify an eNB (evolved NodeB) in the Evolved Packet System (EPS).

q_3082.question: What should the I-CSCF do when receiving Server-Name AVPs within the Server-Capabilities AVP from the HSS when steering users to certain S-CSCFs?
q_3082.ground_truth: The I-CSCF shall discard any Mandatory-Capability AVP and any Optional-Capability AVP received within the Server-Capabilities AVP.

q_3083.question: What is the measurement result in the leaving condition (A3-2) for this event, expressed in the same unit as Ms?
q_3083.ground_truth: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off

q_3084.question: What is the maximum number of dynamic PDP addresses that can be assigned to an MS for each PDP type?
q_3084.ground_truth: For every IMSI, zero, one, or more dynamic PDP addresses per PDP type can be assigned.

q_3085.question: What is the purpose of the Liberty Alliance Data Service Template specification in the 3GPP Generic User Profile (GUP) architecture?
q_3085.ground_truth: The Liberty Alliance Data Service Template specification proposes a framework for web services that offer access to data in general. In the context of GUP, the data services should be restricted to GUP user profile data, and the guidelines and naming conventions recommended by Liberty Alliance are directly applicable to GUP.

q_3086.question: What information must be stored and remembered by the RNC for the duration of the Iu connection if the CN MBMS Linking Information IE is included in the RELOCATION REQUEST message?
q_3086.ground_truth: The Iu Signalling Connection Identifier IE should be stored and remembered by the RNC for the duration of the Iu connection if the CN MBMS Linking Information IE is included in the RELOCATION REQUEST message.

q_3087.question: What is the maximum usage of energy allowed for a UE's listening mode per year in order for the business model to be viable for the industry?
q_3087.ground_truth: The maximum usage of energy allowed for a UE's listening mode per year is 1% of its initial battery capacity.

q_3088.question: What happens to the statistics when they have been sent to the Target NWDAF?
q_3088.ground_truth: The Source NWDAF purges the statistics when all statistics have been sent to the Target NWDAF or when the pre-defined time has passed.

q_3089.question: What is the purpose of the "Abnormal PDP context Deactivation procedures" in a UMTS network?
q_3089.ground_truth: The "Abnormal PDP context Deactivation procedures" in a UMTS network provides the number of PDP context deactivation procedures initiated by the SGSN and is split into subcounters per cause, representing abnormal deactivations.

q_3090.question: What are the minimum coupling loss (MCL) values assumed for the links MS-to-BS, BS-to-MS, and MS-to-MS?
q_3090.ground_truth: The minimum coupling loss (MCL) values assumed are 70 dB for the links MS-to-BS and BS-to-MS, and 40 dB for the link MS-to-MS.

q_3091.question: Which TS specifications does the conformance requirement reference for the Proactive UICC: RUN AT COMMAND facility?
q_3091.ground_truth: The ME shall support the Proactive UICC: RUN AT COMMAND facility as defined in TS~31.111 and TS~27.007.

q_3092.question: For what purpose is the SNR/SINR or the TX b/N0 considered in the conducted test setup?
q_3092.ground_truth: The SNR/SINR or the TX b/N0 is considered in the conducted test setup to determine the MU for OTA demodulation requirements.

q_3093.question: What establishes an MBS User Service Session in the MBS System when the current time enters the time window of a provisioned MBS User Data Ingest Session?
q_3093.ground_truth: The MBSF establishes an MBS User Service Session by establishing an MBS Session in the MBS System.

q_3094.question: What does GERAN/UTRAN PS coverage mean in the present document?
q_3094.ground_truth: It is defined as an MS being able to access GPRS services via GERAN or UTRAN, where the services may be provided in A/Gb mode or Iu mode.

q_3095.question: Which CP length is recommended to utilize for subcarrier spacing of 240 kHz or below in the candidate subcarrier spacings?

q_3096.question: What happens to additional sessions if the Gm reference point is retained after PS handover procedure completion?
q_3096.ground_truth: The SCC AS will use the C-MSISDN or GRUU to correlate the Access Transfer request and select the correct session.

q_3097.question: What happens if the RR message indicates an implicit reject for the PS domain, when starting the packet access procedure?
q_3097.ground_truth: If the RR message indicates an implicit reject for the PS domain, the mobile station should abort the packet access procedure and initiate the implicit reject procedure.

q_3098.question: What is the purpose of the SCUDIF feature in 3GPP TS?
q_3098.ground_truth: The SCUDIF feature in 3GPP TS allows users to achieve successful call establishment when end-to-end circuit-switched (CS) multimedia is not possible or when signaling of the feature is not possible in the network.

q_3099.question: What is the purpose of the SIM sending the RUN AT COMMAND to the ME in Expected Sequence 1.3?

q_3100.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of the Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals in this partnership?
q_3100.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between several telecommunications standards organizations, with the aim of developing global specifications for the third generation of mobile systems. The Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals focuses on the development of specifications for the core network and terminals of mobile systems.

q_3101.question: What was the number of tests defined in the selection test plan?
q_3101.ground_truth: The selection test plan defined 24 P.800 experiments consisting of 7 ACR and 17 DCR tests.

q_3102.question: What is the length of the Serving Cell Latitude/Longitude information in bits?
q_3102.ground_truth: The Serving Cell Latitude and Longitude each have a fixed length of 24 bits.

q_3103.question: What is the action of the Node B when the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the DL Reference Power IE in the context of FDD?
q_3103.ground_truth: The Node B shall activate the power balancing and use the DL Reference Power IE for the power balancing procedure in the new RL(s), if activation of power balancing by the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message is supported.

q_3104.question: Which PDP type is defined as the default in E-UTRAN parameters?
q_3104.ground_truth: The default PDP type is defined as "IP" in the E-UTRAN parameters.

q_3105.question: In what scenario is the APN provided by the PCRF to the TSSF for traffic steering control information?
q_3105.ground_truth: The APN is provided from PCRF to the TSSF for the cases when the PCEF supports multiple APNs with overlapping IP addresses.

q_3106.question: What does the Notification Log (NL) Integration Reference Point (IRP) provide in the context of 3GPP telecommunication management?
q_3106.ground_truth: The Notification Log (NL) Integration Reference Point (IRP) provides a standard general-purpose mechanism for managing logs containing selected notifications from the network. This mechanism allows for historical analysis of faults and conditions in the network.

q_3107.question: What is the function of the BMCA procedure in Method 3?
q_3107.ground_truth: In Method 3, the BMCA procedure is supported via interworking between the DS-TT and NW-TT. When a DS-TT receives an announce message over the Master port, it selects the announce message which is better than the latest Port Priority Vector on NW-TT to double check the received announce message based on the latest port priority vector. Then, the NW-TT determines the best grand master based on the received announce messages, the port number of the received port on the DS-TT(S) and NW-TT, and the System Priority Vector.

q_3108.question: What identifies the start and stop time of a single sessionSchedule in the Schedule Description instance document?

q_3109.question: How is the GSM-RR protocol replaced in the GAN architecture for the CS domain signalling?
q_3109.ground_truth: The GSM-RR protocol is replaced with a GAN-RR protocol in the GAN architecture to adapt to the characteristics of the IP access network.

q_3110.question: What is the role of the SMF in the communication between a Remote UE and a UE-to-Network Relay?
q_3110.ground_truth: The Session Management Function (SMF) provides the PC5 QoS parameters to the UE-to-Network Relay during the PDU session modification procedure. It also forwards the IP info of the Remote UE to the PCF.

q_3111.question: What information does the synchronization channel (SCH) contain?
q_3111.ground_truth: The SCH contains the base transceiver station identity code (BSIC) and the reduced TDMA frame number (RFN).

q_3112.question: What system management functions are required for direct transfer of trace records by the trace control function?
q_3112.ground_truth: The required system management functions for direct transfer of trace records by the trace control function are: creating/setting/getting/deleting eventForwardingDiscriminator, and notification traceReport.

q_3113.question: What is the aim of the extension of the audio test specifications in TS 26.131 and TS 26.132?
q_3113.ground_truth: The aim of the extension is to ensure proper interoperability between the interface and headsets for analogue (wired) and digital (wired and wireless) electrical interfaces.

q_3114.question: What was the experimental design for the listening test, in terms of the number of test conditions and assessors?
q_3114.ground_truth: All listeners listened to all test conditions for each system under test. The listening panel contained eight assessors.

q_3115.question: What should the BSS do if all attempted CN operators have replied with a Redirection Indication IE?
q_3115.ground_truth: The BSS should select the most appropriate Layer 3 Information received from the attempted CN nodes based on the stored information and send it back to the MS.

q_3116.question: What should the UE include in the INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO message if it supports multiple UTRA FDD Frequency Bands?
q_3116.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "UE radio access capability" with associated IEs for each supported UTRA FDD frequency band, the IE "UE radio access capability extension" with associated IEs for each supported UTRA FDD frequency band, and should omit IEs for supported inter-RAT bands.

q_3117.question: What is the requirement for the BTS frequency source accuracy in the pico-BTS and Local Area multicarrier BTS classes?
q_3117.ground_truth: The BTS frequency source accuracy requirement is relaxed to 0.1 parts per million (ppm) for the pico-BTS and Local Area multicarrier BTS classes.

q_3118.question: What are the two types of location service requests in the LCS network?
q_3118.ground_truth: The two types of location service requests are Location Immediate Request (LIR) and Location Deferred Request (LDR). LIR is a real-time request for a location estimate of a UE, while LDR is a deferred request for a location estimate based on specific events or time intervals.

q_3119.question: What is the purpose of the SLmAP protocol in the E-UTRAN radio network layer?
q_3119.ground_truth: The SLmAP protocol supports the functions of the SLm interface in the E-UTRAN radio network layer by specifying the E-UTRAN radio network layer signalling protocol.

q_3120.question: What is the definition of the PMM-DETACHED state in the 3GSGSN?
q_3120.ground_truth: The PMM-DETACHED state in the 3GSGSN is the state where the network has released the PS signalling connection after a GPRS detach, a RAU is rejected, or a GPRS attach is rejected.

q_3121.question: What is the criteria value format if the connection failure criterion is based on SACCH error rate?
q_3121.ground_truth: The criteria value is a one octet binary presentation of the number of SACCH multiframes used in the procedure.

q_3122.question: What should be provided by the TTCN in the special mode of NR MAC operation, where it does not add or remove MAC headers in SL-DRB port?
q_3122.ground_truth: The TTCN shall provide the final MAC PDU, including padding.

q_3123.question: What parameters are used to form the input S for deriving the P-TID from KAUSF?
q_3123.ground_truth: FC, P0 (with the value of SUPI), L0 (length of SUPI), P1 (with the value of "P-TID"), and L1 (length of "P-TID").

q_3124.question: What information is included in the Protocol Error component when the SMLC receives an incomplete Positioning Capability Request component?
q_3124.ground_truth: The Protocol Error component includes a more specific reason for the incomplete component.

q_3125.question: What should the UE do if there are not enough subframes for SI message transmission in the provided radio frames?
q_3125.ground_truth: The UE should continue to receive the SI message transmission in the following radio frames as provided in the si-RepetitionPattern.

q_3126.question: What is the role of the UAV Flight Enablement Subsystem (UFES) in the solution for UAV Remote Identification?
q_3126.ground_truth: The UFES is a 3GPP subsystem that interfaces the 3GPP System with the USS and supports Remote Identification and tracking of UAVs. It terminates UAV2 towards a TPAE, either directly or via NEF/SCEF interfacing. The UFES can also provide remote identification and tracking information to TPAEs/USS/UTM and support the USS in the 3GPP-assisted CAA-Level UAV ID assignment.

q_3127.question: What should be done to the PDCP and RLC entities for a radio bearer, when re-establishing a radio access bearer?
q_3127.ground_truth: They should be released for that radio bearer.

q_3128.question: What does TrCH number represent in the context of L1 in the 3GPP TS?
q_3128.ground_truth: The transport channel number (TrCH number) identifies a transport channel (TrCH) in the context of L1, with the L3 transport channel identity (TrCH ID) mapping onto the L1 transport channel number.

q_3129.question: Who creates and processes the Source BSS to Target BSS Transparent Container in PS handover from GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode?
q_3129.ground_truth: The Source BSS to Target BSS Transparent Container in PS handover from GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode is created by the source BSS or GANC and processed by the target BSS for PS handover from a source GANC.

q_3130.question: How does the SGSN deal with PDP Context Activation request when there is a Maximum APN restriction stored and the value indicates the most restrictive type?
q_3130.ground_truth: The SGSN shall reject any Activate PDP Context requests to a different APN.

q_3131.question: What must the HSS include in the V2X-Notify-Flags to indicate revocation of authorization for V2X service on one PLMN?
q_3131.ground_truth: The HSS must set the "Revocation of Authorization for V2X Service" bit in the V2X-Notify-Flags to indicate that the V2X service authorization is being revoked for one PLMN.

q_3132.question: What is the rule used to determine the two flags hu(B) and hl(B) in the discussed data transmission system?
q_3132.ground_truth: hu(B) = 1 for the first 4 bursts (even numbered bits are stolen) and hl(B) = 1 for the last 4 bursts (odd numbered bits are stolen) for FACCH/F, and hu(B) = 1 for the first 2 bursts (even numbered bits are stolen) and hl(B) = 1 for the last 2 bursts (odd numbered bits are stolen) for FACCH/H.

q_3133.question: What information is contained in the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT and EC IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT TYPE 1 messages?
q_3133.ground_truth: The information field of the CHANNEL REQUEST, EGPRS PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST, or EC PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST message, packet channel description, initial timing advance, packet uplink assignment or EGPRS packet uplink assignment construction, and the packet resources used for the uplink EC TBF.

q_3134.question: What is the main disadvantage of authentication methods that rely on (public, private) key pairs and digital certificates?
q_3134.ground_truth: The main disadvantage is that a PKI is needed, and asymmetric key cryptographic operations often require substantially more computational effort than symmetric key operations.

q_3135.question: What is the role of the HS-SICH type 2 information field mapping in the coding and multiplexing flow?
q_3135.ground_truth: The HS-SICH type 2 information field mapping is the first step in the coding and multiplexing flow for HS-SICH type 2. It defines how the RMF, RTBS, and ACK/NACK information bits for each stream are mapped.

q_3136.question: What should the UE do if it leaves the proximity of all CSG member cells on a frequency of the enabled RAT?
q_3136.ground_truth: If the last "CSG Proximity Indication" transmitted for the concerned RAT and frequency was an entering indication, the UE should set the "CSG Proximity Indication" to "leaving" and set the "CSG Frequency info for UTRA" or "CSG Frequency info for E-UTRA" to the frequency of the cell(s) for which the Proximity Indication was triggered.

q_3137.question: In what type of network would the GCSE AS be, when it is part of the operator's network?
q_3137.ground_truth: The GCSE AS would be in the operator's network, when it is part of the operator's network.

q_3138.question: What are the two entities with enhanced functionality in the Iu mode GAN architecture?
q_3138.ground_truth: The two entities with enhanced functionality in the Iu mode GAN architecture are the Mobile Station (MS) and the Generic Access Network Controller (GANC).

q_3139.question: How does a user initiate service from a CTS-MS (Cordless Terminal System Multi-System) on a CTS-FP (Cordless Terminal System Fixed Part)?
q_3139.ground_truth: To have service granted, a CTS-MS needs to attach at the CTS-FP by being enrolled with the CTS-FP, brought in range of the CTS-FP, and the appropriate operation mode selected.

q_3140.question: What information should be set in the Contact header field when the SIP REFER request is used for transferring an existing media type to a controllee UE?
q_3140.ground_truth: The Contact header field should contain a SIP URI with the hname "body" URI header field containing SDP for the media lines with media types for all the media components of the existing session and listed with non zero port value.

q_3141.question: What is the state of the multi-party conversation after the release is confirmed?
q_3141.ground_truth: There is no longer a held multi-party conversation

q_3142.question: What must the RCAF send to the PCRF in the ARA command for aggregated RUCI report?
q_3142.ground_truth: The RCAF must send related info and respond with an ARA command, including the PCRF id within the Destination-Host AVP, Aggregated-RUCI-Report AVP(s) with a congestion level set id and a list of aggregated congestion information in an ARR command for aggregated RUCI report.

q_3143.question: What action shall be taken by the MGW after completing the Iu UP initialisation and receiving the "Confirm Characteristics" procedure for a Codec Modification Failure?
q_3143.ground_truth: The MGW may decrease the bandwidth of the corresponding bearer performing the "Modify Bearer" procedure (if needed).

q_3144.question: What actions does the network take when controlling network slices simultaneous usage incompatibility?
q_3144.ground_truth: The network checks for network slice simultaneous usage incompatibility between the new network slice and the network slices on which there are already established PDU sessions. If there is simultaneous usage incompatibility, the PDU Session Establishment Request on the new network slice is rejected.

q_3145.question: What is the default ciphering mode if the cipher mode setting IE is omitted in the HANDOVER COMMAND message for inter-RAT or inter-mode handover to GERAN A/Gb mode?
q_3145.ground_truth: The default ciphering mode is "no ciphering" if the cipher mode setting IE is omitted in the HANDOVER COMMAND message for inter-RAT or inter-mode handover to GERAN A/Gb mode.

q_3146.question: What is the purpose of the Non-3GPP Message Gateway with respect to the MSGin5G service and non-3GPP message service?
q_3146.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP Message Gateway facilitates the translation between the MSGin5G Service and non-3GPP message service.

q_3147.question: In the context of cell selection, what does it mean for a UE to treat a cell as if the cell status is "barred"?
q_3147.ground_truth: It means that the UE is not permitted to select/reselect this cell, not even for emergency calls, and shall exclude the barred cell as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for up to 300 seconds. The UE shall also exclude the barred cell and the cells on the same frequency as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for 300 seconds.

q_3148.question: What should the UE do when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause value #9 from the AMF during a mobility and periodic registration procedure on an NGC cell?
q_3148.ground_truth: The UE should delete any 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI and ngKSI, enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED 5U2 NOT UPDATED, and subsequently automatically initiate the initial registration procedure.

q_3149.question: What is the purpose of the "CN domain system information" information element?
q_3149.ground_truth: It identifies the type of core network domain

q_3150.question: What is the difference between an Elementary Procedure with response and without response, in the context of the PCAP protocol?
q_3150.ground_truth: Class 1 Elementary Procedures are those with a response (whether successful or unsuccessful), while Class 2 Elementary Procedures are those without a response. Class 2 EPs are considered always successful. The types of responses for Class 1 EPs include successful (explicitly indicating that the elementary procedure was successfully completed) and unsuccessful (explicitly indicating that the EP failed).

q_3151.question: What type of events can trigger a container to send an alarm in pre-conditions 5.2.2?
q_3151.ground_truth: Critical events like shocks, door opening, or meeting specified conditions can trigger a container to send an alarm.

q_3152.question: What operation does the PDN GW provide to the PCRF when deleting packet filters from an existing TFT?
q_3152.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides to the PCRF the Gx operation "delete filters" when the TFT operation is "Delete packet filters from existing TFT".

q_3153.question: What was the mean power saving gain provided by making random traffic arrival offset in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30Mbps-60Fps?
q_3153.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by making random traffic arrival offset in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30Mbps-60Fps was 5.96%.

q_3154.question: What is the principle used in the File Repair Procedure to protect network resources?
q_3154.ground_truth: The principle used in the File Repair Procedure to protect network resources is to spread the file repair request load in time and across multiple servers.

q_3155.question: What is the procedure for the PCEF/TDF to retrieve PFDs for an Application Identifier from the PFDF?
q_3155.ground_truth: The PCEF/TDF sends a Fetch PFD Request to the PFDF, which responds with the list of Application Identifier and all associated PFDs in the Fetch PFD Response message. The PCEF/TDF then binds the PFDs received from the PFDF to the respective Application Identifier.

q_3156.question: What is the role of the UAVF in the UAV A&A procedure?
q_3156.ground_truth: The UAVF authenticates and authorizes the USS/UTM during the UAV A&A procedure using aviation domain provisioned certificates and associates a USS/UTM identifier with the 3GPP UAV ID and CAA level UAV ID of the successfully authenticated UAV.

q_3157.question: Which parameter is used to indicate the length of digits in Generic Number and Generic Digits?
q_3157.ground_truth: The length of the timeAndTimeZone parameter

q_3158.question: What is the purpose of the "CSG ID" in the User CSG Information (UCI) message?
q_3158.ground_truth: The "CSG ID" in the User CSG Information (UCI) message consists of 4 octets and is used to define a CSG cell. The coding of the CSG ID is the responsibility of the operator that allocates the CSG ID by administrative means.

q_3159.question: What information categories are supported by the layer 2 procedures on the A-bis interface?
q_3159.ground_truth: The layer 2 procedures on the A-bis interface support the following information categories: signalling including Short Message Service (SMS) information, operation and maintenance, and layer 2 management.

q_3160.question: What is ProSe discovery in the context of EPS?
q_3160.ground_truth: ProSe discovery is a procedure that identifies that ProSe-enabled UEs are in proximity, using E-UTRAN (with or without E-UTRAN), WLAN technology or EPC.

q_3161.question: What is the function of the combining network in this process?
q_3161.ground_truth: The combining network is used for diversity reception from the two Base Station (BS) antenna connectors.

q_3162.question: How does the BSS handle existing location related procedures for a target MS if the SCCP connection to the SMLC is released?
q_3162.ground_truth: The BSS shall abort all existing location related procedures for the target MS without notifying the MS, and attempt to notify the SMLC using a BSSAP-LE Perform Location Abort if no BSSLAP procedure is active.

q_3163.question: What is the purpose of the "Virtual Reality (VR) Streaming Interoperability and Characterization (Release 17)" document?
q_3163.ground_truth: The document provides reference test material and test results for improved usability of VR streaming technologies.

q_3164.question: What does the EVS Codec generic frame format in CS Networks consist of?
q_3164.ground_truth: The EVS Codec generic frame format in CS Networks consists of the "generic frame format" of the EVS Codec in 3G CS networks for the Speech and SID frames of the primary modes of operation and the Speech and SID frames of the EVS AMR-WB IO mode of operation.

q_3165.question: In which clause is the coding of the INVITE for Carrier Routeing described?
q_3165.ground_truth: Clause 7.2.3.2.2B describes the coding of the INVITE for Carrier Routeing.

q_3166.question: What is the purpose of the Initial UE Message procedure?
q_3166.ground_truth: The Initial UE Message procedure establishes an Iu signalling connection between a CN domain and the RNC, and transfers the initial NAS-PDU to the CN node as determined by the NAS Node Selection Function.

q_3167.question: What is the expected result for Test case 1?
q_3167.ground_truth: The expected result for Test case 1 is that the I-CSCF under test encrypts the hiding information elements when forwarding the SIP message to the network element outside the hiding network's domain.

q_3168.question: What is the role of the SS in the NR/5GC Layer 3 normal mode for SRB0 in the uplink and downlink port?
q_3168.ground_truth: In the NR/5GC Layer 3 normal mode, for SRB0, the uplink port is above RLC and the downlink port is above RLC in the SS.

q_3169.question: In order to support NBIFOM, what is one of the capabilities of the PDN GW?
q_3169.ground_truth: It needs to be capable of Receiving UE request on a default access for NBIFOM in UE-initiated NBIFOM mode.

q_3170.question: What is required for lossless service continuity in terms of PDU Sessions in the context of the described network?
q_3170.ground_truth: For lossless service continuity, the user equipment (UE) is required to keep at least one PDU Session active if the multicast session requests it.

q_3171.question: What are the new features introduced in TR 23.501 related to the QoS aspects of satellite backhauling in 5GC?
q_3171.ground_truth: Reporting of satellite backhaul category to the 5G Core Network, and new 5G QoS Indicator (5QI) defined for satellite backhaul and satellite access.

q_3172.question: What should the UE do if the UE encounters SOR security check not successful on the received steering of roaming information and a matching criterion "SOR security check not successful" is included in the SOR-CMCI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME?
q_3172.ground_truth: If the timer value is not zero, the UE shall start an associated Tsor-cm timer with the value included in the SOR-CMCI, stop all other running Tsor-cm timers, and not start any new Tsor-cm timer while Tsor-cm timer associated with "SOR security check not successful" criterion is running.

q_3173.question: What is the method to compute the message authentication code for data integrity (MAC-I) using the integrity algorithm f9?
q_3173.ground_truth: The MAC-I is computed by taking the input parameters such as the Integrity Key (IK), the integrity sequence number (COUNT-I), a random value generated by the network side (FRESH), the direction bit (DIRECTION) and the signalling data (MESSAGE) and processing them through the integrity algorithm f9.

q_3174.question: What is the purpose of the Downlink Power Control procedure?
q_3174.ground_truth: The Downlink Power Control procedure is used to change the power in DL transmission based on the report of the quality measure.

q_3175.question: What is the method described to minimize uplink traffic when only a few symbols are lost?
q_3175.ground_truth: Only the initial symbol ESI and the amount of requested consecutive symbols are sent.

q_3176.question: What action does the UE take if the SS/PBCH block-based measurement quantities are available?
q_3176.ground_truth: If the SS/PBCH block-based measurement quantities are available, the UE sets the rsIndexResults in measResultLastServCell to include all the available measurement quantities of the source PCell or PCell, ordered such that the highest SS/PBCH block RSRP is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRP measurement results are available.

q_3177.question: What information is collected in a PGW-CDR when IP-CAN session charging is active?
q_3177.ground_truth: Two types of data can be collected: traffic volumes used for IP-CAN bearer charging and service data used for FBC.

q_3178.question: What is studied in section 7.167.2 regarding DC?
q_3178.ground_truth: Channel bandwidths per operating band for DC

q_3179.question: What causes the abortion of the dialogue in MSC-B' during a handover scenario?
q_3179.ground_truth: The abortion of the dialogue in MSC-B' is triggered by the failure of the handover, which can occur due to various reasons, including poor radio quality, resource optimization, better cell, directed retry, etc.

q_3180.question: What is the name of the list of HS-SICH measurement values used for the 2nd and beyond measurements of a RL when multiple HS-SICH measurement values need to be reported in TDD only?

q_3181.question: What is the purpose of using QUIC PING frames in the QUIC-PROXY solution?
q_3181.ground_truth: QUIC PING frames are used in the QUIC-PROXY solution to verify that the UE is still reachable over an access, to check reachability to the peer, and to send over one QUIC connection or multiple QUIC connections per access as necessary.

q_3182.question: What should the RNC do if the WRITE-REPLACE message contains both the New Serial Number IE and the Old Serial Number IE?
q_3182.ground_truth: The RNC should make an entry in the Number of Broadcasts IE in the Number of Broadcasts Completed List IE for each included Service Area in the corresponding WRITE-REPLACE COMPLETE message and release the involved old messages and their status stored for each service area.

q_3183.question: What should the IP-SM-GW do if the associated SIP MESSAGE request received before was delivered as concatenated Short Messages and at least one of the SMSIP MESSAGE contains RP-ERROR message in the body for the concatenated Short Messages?
q_3183.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW should send the Instant Message Delivery Notification with a "failed" indication to the associated SIP MESSAGE request sender.

q_3184.question: What new parameter is introduced to mitigate the SUCI guessing attack in the solution?

q_3185.question: How can PUCCH resources be allocated in a HeNB to reduce interference with macro-eNB UEs?
q_3185.ground_truth: By not allocating PUCCH resources on edge RBs and pulling the PUCCH resources inward so they do not overlap with the macro-eNB UE region.

q_3186.question: What is used to indicate authorization for a UE to use a L2 or L3 UE-to-Network Relay in NG-RAN?
q_3186.ground_truth: Authorization IEs are introduced in NG-RAN to indicate whether the UE is authorized to use a 5G ProSe Layer-3 and/or Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay and 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Remote UE.

q_3187.question: Which UE categories support the combination described in 7.4.8?

q_3188.question: What message is sent by the RNC to inform the CN that an enhanced relocation is completed?

q_3189.question: How does the MAC entity determine the number of parallel UL HARQ processes?
q_3189.ground_truth: The number of parallel UL HARQ processes per HARQ entity is specified in TS 38.214.

q_3190.question: What effect does the hysteresis parameter for this event have on event triggered measurements?
q_3190.ground_truth: The hysteresis parameter for this event is used as a hysteresis when determining if the entering or leaving conditions for event triggered measurements have been satisfied. The event will not be triggered if the measured value is close to the threshold, but the value of the hysteresis parameter determines how close the measured value must be to the threshold for the event to be triggered.

q_3191.question: What triggers the authorization revocation in this solution?
q_3191.ground_truth: The authorization revocation can be triggered by the USS/UTM through the NEF API AsSessionWithQoS used to activate, modify, and revoke policies for specific data flows on a specific PDU-session/PDN-connection.

q_3192.question: How does SHVC inter-layer motion prediction work in the enhancement layer (EL) decoder?
q_3192.ground_truth: In SHVC inter-layer motion prediction, the base layer's motion information is mapped to the EL's resolution, and a scaling operation is applied to the base layer motion vectors to account for the upsampling ratio. The scaled base layer motion information is then used as a reference to predict the EL's motion information.

q_3193.question: What message does the target HNB use to forward the RRC Cell/URA update message received from the UE?
q_3193.ground_truth: The target HNB forwards the received RRC Cell/URA update message via a RNSAP Uplink Signalling Transfer Indication message encapsulated in a RNA CONNECT message to the source HNB.

q_3194.question: What action should the UE take if the initial eCall request fails due to the emerg-request timer expiring?
q_3194.ground_truth: The UE should consider the emergency service request as failed and perform the procedures defined in 3GPP TS 23.167 subclause 7.3.

q_3195.question: What action does the SRNC take when it receives a RANAP MBMS Session Update message after a RA filtering option has been used in the network?
q_3195.ground_truth: The SRNC updates the MCCH using RRC MBMS Modified Services Info message on MCCH in all the cells indicated to request UE to establish PMM connection. This is done by the SRNC as CRNC after it has received a RANAP MBMS Session Update message from the CN and updated the RA list containing UEs.

q_3196.question: How are the bits distributed among different physical channels through physical channel segmentation?
q_3196.ground_truth: Physical channel segmentation distributes the bits among the different physical channels based on the number of PhCHs and the number of bits input to the physical channel segmentation block. The bits before and after physical channel segmentation are denoted by s and up,k, where p is the PhCH number and k is the TTI index.

q_3197.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 5GSM message including an unassigned or reserved PDU session identity value?
q_3197.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message if it receives a 5GSM message which includes an unassigned or reserved PDU session identity value.

q_3198.question: What is the purpose of the mapped QoS flow within related PDU session(s) during MBS session establishment or user join procedure?
q_3198.ground_truth: The mapped QoS flow is used to correlate the MBS QoS flow with the related PDU session, enabling the transfer of multicast service data to the UE based on the NG-RAN's ability to handle multicast data.

q_3199.question: When does the session start and stop for the Video Clip Distribution Service in the provided metadata fragment?
q_3199.ground_truth: The session start for the Video Clip Distribution Service in the provided metadata fragment is the 5th of August 2005, 00:00:00 (in NTP format 3332188800) and the session stop is the 18th of December 2005, 00:00:00 (in NTP format 3343766400).

q_3200.question: What is the concept of QoS in NR and NextGen Core?
q_3200.ground_truth: The QoS architecture in NR and NextGen Core involves mapping packets to appropriate QoS Flows and DRBs to ensure quality of service. The RAN establishes at least one default DRB for each PDU Session indicated by the CN upon PDU Session establishment. The RAN maps packets belonging to different PDU sessions to different DRBs. NAS level packet filters in the UE and in the NextGen Core associate UL and DL packets with QoS Flows. AS-level mapping in the UE and in the RAN associate UL and DL QoS Flows with Data Radio Bearers (DRB). In NR, the data radio bearer (DRB) defines the packet treatment on the radio interface. A DRB serves packets with the same packet forwarding treatment. Separate DRBs may be established for QoS flows requiring different packet forwarding treatment.

q_3201.question: What is the use of NM centralized Coverage and Capacity Optimization?
q_3201.ground_truth: The NM centralized Coverage and Capacity Optimization is used to identify and optimize coverage and capacity problems in a network, such as cell coverage adapting to traffic demand, coverage and accessibility, LTE coverage holes with underlaid UTRAN/GERAN, LTE connection failure, and radio link quality.

q_3202.question: Which timers are requested for getting the current value from the Timer in the first passage?
q_3202.ground_truth: Timer with identifier 2 is requested for getting the current value from the Timer in the first passage.

q_3203.question: What is the purpose of the near field to far field transformation in the NFTR testing procedure?
q_3203.ground_truth: The near field to far field transformation is a mathematical computation that is applied to the near field measured radiation pattern to compute the far field radiation pattern.

q_3204.question: What function does the GA-RRC DEACTIVATE CHANNEL REQUEST message serve in the procedure of MS initiated PTC de-activation?
q_3204.ground_truth: The GA-RRC DEACTIVATE CHANNEL REQUEST message is used by the MS to indicate to the GANC the request to de-activate a PTC.

q_3205.question: How does UTRAN control measurements in the UE?
q_3205.ground_truth: UTRAN may control a measurement in the UE by broadcast of SYSTEM INFORMATION and/or by transmitting a MEASUREMENT CONTROL message. The UE then uses the provided information, such as measurement identity, measurement command, measurement type, measurement objects, measurement quantity, reporting quantities, measurement reporting criteria, measurement validity, measurement reporting mode, and additional measurement identities to perform and report measurements as required.

q_3206.question: What are the key features of the third variant of the distributed approach for UC identification and scoring?
q_3206.ground_truth: In this third variant, UC functionality is available in several networks, but UC entities in different networks do not communicate scores to each other, allowing each operator to react independently to locally determined scores.

q_3207.question: Which protocol layer is responsible for management of transport network resources in UMTS?
q_3207.ground_truth: Management of transport network resources belongs to the Transport Layer in UMTS.

q_3208.question: What is the difference between Single User Busy and Multiple User Busy in Flexible Alerting?
q_3208.ground_truth: Single User Busy returns a busy indication if any group member indicates busy before the call is answered, while Multiple User Busy returns a busy indication if all accessible members indicate busy in that FA group.

q_3209.question: What is the role of the AMF in the 3GPP network, and what does it store in the UE context?
q_3209.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) is a 3GPP network entity responsible for managing the user equipment (UE) context, which includes storing data such as IP addresses, security keys, and handles. These handles are used to identify specific UE-PLMN pairs and secure the communication between UEs and the network.

q_3210.question: What is the length of a recording interval in terms of the granularity period?
q_3210.ground_truth: The length of a recording interval is a multiple of the granularity period.

q_3211.question: How is the UE location calculated for GNSS scenario #4B?
q_3211.ground_truth: The UE location is calculated as a random offset from the reference location using the method described in subclause 6.2.1.2.6. The reference location for GNSS scenario #4B is given by the latitude of 3 degrees 56 minutes 31.668 seconds north and longitude of 73 degrees 29 minutes 26.0376 seconds east, with a height of 50m.

q_3212.question: In what 51-multiframe should a MS that has selected downlink CC1 start looking for a matching response if it used uplink 51-multiframe N to send the last blind physical layer transmission?
q_3212.ground_truth: The MS that has selected downlink CC1 should start looking for a matching response within downlink 51-multiframe N.

q_3213.question: What happens when the UE loses coverage of the registered PLMN?
q_3213.ground_truth: If the UE loses coverage of the registered PLMN, either a new PLMN is selected automatically (automatic mode) or an indication of available PLMNs is given to the user so that a manual selection can be performed (manual mode).

q_3214.question: What factors does a UE consider when deriving reselection priorities for slice-based cell reselection?
q_3214.ground_truth: A UE derives reselection priorities for slice-based cell reselection using NSAGs and their priorities provided by NAS, sliceInfoList and sliceInfoListDedicated per frequency with nsag-CellReselectionPriority per NSAG, and cellReselectionPriority per frequency provided in system information and/or dedicated signalling.

q_3215.question: What is the structure of the M2AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURES data type?
q_3215.ground_truth: It is a sequence of M2AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURES-CLASS-1 and M2AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURES-CLASS-2, where each class contains a list of M2AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURES with a specific set of procedures.

q_3216.question: When using the File Repair Using the FileSchedule procedure, what element in the Schedule Description metadata fragment is used to request the file of interest?
q_3216.ground_truth: The fileURI element in the fileSchedule is used to request the file of interest in the File Repair Using the FileSchedule procedure.

q_3217.question: What action is taken by the IBCF-hA1 and the IC-A1 when releasing resources for a call?
q_3217.ground_truth: The IBCF-hA1 and the IC-A1 release resources reserved in the media gateway for the call.

q_3218.question: In what cases must the Tunnel Endpoint Identifier (TEID) be set to all zeroes in a GTP-C message?
q_3218.ground_truth: The TEID must be set to all zeroes in several GTP-C messages, including Create PDP Context Request, Identification Request/Response, SGSN Context Request, Echo Request/Response, Supported Extension Headers notification, Version Not Supported, Forward Relocation Request, PDU Notification Request, MBMS Notification Request, RAN Information Relay, Relocation Cancel Request, Location Management messages, and PDU Notification Request.

q_3219.question: What are the actions taken by the IMS Messaging Service when the recipient is unavailable in scenario 6.2.9, IMS Messaging Selects Appropriate Delivery Methods?
q_3219.ground_truth: The IMS Messaging Service automatically stores the message, waiting for Sally to be available, and then delivers the message to Sally when she turns on her phone.

q_3220.question: How many fallback options can be chosen for a session?
q_3220.ground_truth: There can only be one fallback option for a session.

q_3221.question: What is the purpose of the "AuditValue" and "AuditCapabilities" commands in the Command API?
q_3221.ground_truth: The "AuditValue" and "AuditCapabilities" commands in the Command API are used for auditing purposes, allowing the IMS-ALG and IMS-AGW to determine the capabilities of their peers and audit the values of the relevant descriptors.

q_3222.question: What should the UE measure during the initial cell search for determining the DwPTS synchronisation?
q_3222.ground_truth: The UE searches for a cell and then determines the DwPTS synchronisation, scrambling code and basic midamble code, control multi-frame synchronisation and then reads the BCH.

q_3223.question: In which operation must at least one valid packet filter be included?
q_3223.ground_truth: When creating a new TFT or modifying an existing TFT, at least one valid packet filter must be included in the procedure. If not, the procedure should fail, and an error code should be returned.

q_3224.question: When must the MS use regular discontinuous reception instead of extended idle mode DRX, even if negotiated earlier?
q_3224.ground_truth: The MS must use regular discontinuous reception when it has PDP context for emergency bearer services, and must not use extended idle mode DRX at any time when PDP context for emergency bearer services is active.

q_3225.question: What type of AVP is used to define a name for a PCC rule at the PCRF or PCEF?
q_3225.ground_truth: The Charging-Rule-Name AVP is used to define a name for a PCC rule at the PCRF or PCEF.

q_3226.question: What is the color that represents the parts that are new for the enhanced GAN in the MA-SM terminal architecture for the PS domain?
q_3226.ground_truth: The blue color represents the parts that are new for the enhanced GAN in the MA-SM terminal architecture for the PS domain.

q_3227.question: What is the role of a Detection Point (DP) in the context of CAMEL network?
q_3227.ground_truth: Detection Points (DPs) are points in processing at which notifications to the service logic can occur and transfer of control to the gsmSCF is possible in the CAMEL network.

q_3228.question: What is the primary goal of Solution #48 in the context of ProSe Direct discovery and UE-to-Network Relay?
q_3228.ground_truth: The main goal of Solution #48 is to address Key Issue #1 (ProSe Direct discovery) and Key Issue #3 (UE-to-Network Relay) by advertising the Relay UE's serving cell information for L3 UE-to-network relay solutions.

q_3229.question: When can a three-way session be created by a user in SIP sessions?
q_3229.ground_truth: A three-way session can be created by a user participating in two or more SIP sessions who wants to join together two of these active sessions to a so-called three-way session.

q_3230.question: What type of propagation condition is required for testing Slow Frequency Hopping (SFH) channels with an interfering signal on the same ARFCN as the wanted signal?
q_3230.ground_truth: Multipath propagation condition TU50 (no SFH) for normal and micro-BTS systems, and multipath propagation condition TI5 (no SFH) for pico-BTS systems

q_3231.question: What payload format options are required for MCPTT clients?
q_3231.ground_truth: MCPTT clients are required to support the bandwidth-efficient option, mode-set offering all modes, mode-change-period of 1 or not included, mode-change-capability of 2, mode-change-neighbor of 0 or not included, and channels of 1.

q_3232.question: What does the ProXimity-Action-Request command indicate and what is its Command-Code field value?
q_3232.ground_truth: The ProXimity-Action-Request command (PXR) is indicated by the Command-Code field value 8388676. It is sent by the ProSe Function to the ProSe Application Server as part of the procedures specified for EPC-level ProSe discovery and ProSe direct discovery.

q_3233.question: What is the difference between online and offline charging in the 3GPP charging architecture?
q_3233.ground_truth: Online charging involves real-time charging, while offline charging occurs after the fact, using stored charging data.

q_3234.question: How were the signals under test assigned for each listener?
q_3234.ground_truth: The signals under test were randomly assigned for each listener, with a different assignment for each subject, and randomized for each subject within a session to avoid sequential effects.

q_3235.question: What should be included in every RLC data block transmission during contention resolution until contention resolution is completed on the mobile station side?
q_3235.ground_truth: The TLLI of the mobile station and the TFI value associated with the TBF.

q_3236.question: What are the two existing NAS procedures for public key distribution?
q_3236.ground_truth: The two existing NAS procedures for public key distribution are including integrity protected public keys in existing NAS messages and creating a new NAS procedure for PWS key distribution.

q_3237.question: What can the 3GPP management system do to support management data isolation for different network slice customers or groups?
q_3237.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system should have the capability to support management data isolation for different network slice customers or groups, in network slice management, network slice subnet management, and network function management layers. This also includes supporting management data isolation when data is collected, transmitted, at rest, or in use, and providing different isolation and protection requirements for various types of management data.

q_3238.question: What is the purpose of allocating service codes in USSD operations?
q_3238.ground_truth: The purpose of allocating service codes in USSD operations is to standardize the codes used for control of Supplementary Services, to prevent unauthorized usage by PLMNs, and to ensure smooth communication between the UE and the network.

q_3239.question: How is the weighting mask used to enhance the excitation in the frequency post-processing?
q_3239.ground_truth: The weighting mask is used to define a frequency-dependent gain function that further enhances the excitation before converting it back to the time domain. It is created based on the normalized energy of the spectrum of the concatenated excitation and is used to eliminate coding noise, especially in the higher frequency bands.

q_3240.question: What are the two formats for entering called numbers in the user equipment?
q_3240.ground_truth: The user can enter a called number in two formats: "International format" (preferred for roaming and international calls) which starts with a '+' and is followed by the country code, and "Open format" (for national calls) which does not require a '+' and follows the normal way for that network.

q_3241.question: Which protocol extension contains id-MIMO-N-M-Ratio, id-PrecoderWeightSetRestriction, id-NonCellSpecificTxDiversity?

q_3242.question: What action does a BSS/MGW take when it receives an unknown RTCP Multiplexing packet?
q_3242.ground_truth: The BSS/MGW ignores the unknown RTCP Multiplexing packet and continues to send data for the user connection without applying multiplexing.

q_3243.question: How is the timing advance determined in UTRAN?
q_3243.ground_truth: The initial value for timing advance (TAphys) will be determined in the UTRAN by measurement of the timing of the PRACH or E-RUCCH, and the required timing advance will be represented as a 9-bit number (0-511) multiplier of 4 chips. The UE adjusts the timing of its transmissions accordingly, and continuously measure the timing of the UE transmission by higher layer messages.

q_3244.question: What are the parameters associated with the DL-RELEASE primitive?
q_3244.ground_truth: The parameters associated with the DL-RELEASE primitive are the type of channel and the release mode.

q_3245.question: What is the purpose of the test for verifying the ME's response to a RUN AT COMMAND with large font size?
q_3245.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the ME responds to an AT Command with large font size as though it were initiated by an attached TE and returns an AT Response within a TERMINAL RESPONSE to the UICC.

q_3246.question: What is the requirement for the Access Domain Parameter values when granting access rights to an application and defining the access parameters at the USAT Framework/Terminal interface level?
q_3246.ground_truth: CRRN2 under 5.3.6.3.1.1 states that the access rights granted to an application and defined in the access parameter shall be independent from the access rights granted at the USAT Framework/Terminal interface level.

q_3247.question: What actions should the IWF perform upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request for a private MCPTT call?
q_3247.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request, the IWF should interact with the media plane, perform the actions specified in 3GPP TS 24.379, clause 6.2.8.3.4 if the MCPTT emergency private call state is set to "MEPC 2: emergency-pc-requested" or "MEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted", and consider the call successfully established.

q_3248.question: What should the UE do if it receives a 5GMM cause #21 "synch failure" message from the network during the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure?
q_3248.ground_truth: The UE shall send an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with 5GMM cause #21 "synch failure" to the network and start the timer T3520. Furthermore, the UE shall stop any retransmission timers that are running.

q_3249.question: What is the purpose of the "Placing an individual call party on hold" procedure?
q_3249.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the CSE to instruct the IPLMN/VPLMN to place an individual call party on hold at any point during the active phase of the call leg if a control relationship exists.

q_3250.question: What information is indicated by the GSM Time Present IE in the DGPS Correction Data?
q_3250.ground_truth: The GSM Time Present IE indicates whether GSM air-interface timing information values for the serving cell are present or not in the message.

q_3251.question: How many maximum percentage options are available for the CCCH Load Threshold attribute, as per the hexadecimal values?
q_3251.ground_truth: There are 65 maximum percentage options for the CCCH Load Threshold attribute, as it is coded as a binary presentation of maximum (manufacturer-dependent) percentage in the range of <0-64>.

q_3252.question: What type of logical channel is used for EC-GSM-IoT overlaid CDMA?
q_3252.ground_truth: 3GPP TS~45.004 addresses differential encoding, modulation, and EC-GSM-IoT overlaid CDMA.

q_3253.question: What effect does the Radio Links without DPCH/F-DPCH Indication IE have in the context of FDD?
q_3253.ground_truth: If the Radio Links without DPCH/F-DPCH Indication IE is present in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message, the DRNS starts operation with Radio Links without DPCH/F-DPCH in FDD.

q_3254.question: What benefit does a value-added service provider gain from using GUP mechanisms to obtain terminal capability information?
q_3254.ground_truth: GUP mechanisms allow value-added service providers to reliably obtain terminal capability information from a user's device, which is crucial for providing high-quality services.

q_3255.question: What is the format of the files included in each test area in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_3255.ground_truth: Test files include a test source, a test applet, and a cap file. The naming convention and contents of these files are specified in the Technical Specification.

q_3256.question: What is the purpose of the UDR in UDC?
q_3256.ground_truth: The UDR is a logically unique repository where user data is accessible in the context of UDC. Dataless applications, such as front ends or application servers, can access the user data stored in the UDR.

q_3257.question: What is the recommendation for assessing the performance of handsets in noise?
q_3257.ground_truth: It is recommended to avoid using P.862.1 and P.862.2 for assessing the performance of handsets in noise, as they produce misleading results when used in conjunction with noise suppression algorithms.

q_3258.question: What is an IRP Reference in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_3258.ground_truth: An IRP Reference defines the network management service access point in the managed system. It is the point where the managing system (manager), such as the Network Manager (NM), connects to request and obtain network management services provided by that IRP.

q_3259.question: What are the two methods for multiplexing logical channels in GERAN systems?
q_3259.ground_truth: The two methods for multiplexing logical channels in GERAN systems are in a fixed predefined manner (multiframe structure) and dynamically by the MAC on basic physical subchannels.

q_3260.question: What is the purpose of the General Result: Command performed successfully in the RECEIVE DATA command?
q_3260.ground_truth: The General Result: Command performed successfully message indicates that the RECEIVE DATA command has been executed successfully and the Channel Data specified in the command has been transmitted correctly. It confirms that the data has been received and processed by the ME (Mobile Equipment) without any errors.

q_3261.question: What is the parameter PRP for PRS positioning occasions in TDD-TDD inter-frequency RSTD measurement reporting delay?
q_3261.ground_truth: PRP is the reference signal received power for PRS positioning occasions in TDD-TDD inter-frequency RSTD measurement reporting delay, with a target value of 1,2dBm for a corresponding Band.

q_3262.question: What is one of the functions of the IP-SM-GW in IMS when performing service-level interworking between Short Messages and CPM Messages?
q_3262.ground_truth: Translating a chat session invitation to a short message, including instructions for the SMS user on how to react to the invitation.

q_3263.question: What action does the Target HNB take after receiving the RNA:DIRECT TRANSFER message containing an RNSAP:ENHANCED RELOCATION RESPONSE message from the Source HNB?
q_3263.ground_truth: The Target HNB sends an RNA:DIRECT TRANSFER message containing an RNSAP:ENHANCED RELOCATION RESPONSE message back to the Source HNB to indicate that it has successfully prepared the relocation.

q_3264.question: What is the role of the "Modify Media" procedure in the media update process following a Floor Request Decision?
q_3264.ground_truth: It is used by the MRFC to set the media properties of the associated Termination/Stream on the MRFP

q_3265.question: What is the difference between 8.3.3.4.2 and 8.3A.4.2.2 in terms of the emissions generated for the test?
q_3265.ground_truth: 8.3.3.4.2 generates only the dedicated physical channels (DPCH1 and DPCH2), while 8.3A.4.2.2 generates, in addition to the dedicated physical channels, a band-limited white noise source that simulates interference from other cells.

q_3266.question: What are the key concepts highlighted in the document for dealing with a broader coherent vision of the problem and progress on the long journey of converging the information models of various organizations?
q_3266.ground_truth: The document highlights the challenges of differing methodologies, the need for a new governance regime, gradual restructuring, and the need for a federated model to enable a shared understanding through uniform semantic analysis of the area covered by the umbrella information model.

q_3267.question: What are the two parameters that the "chargingRollOver" parameter may contain?

q_3268.question: What should the UE do if the common E-DCH TTI selection threshold is met for preamble transmissions other than the first?
q_3268.ground_truth: The UE should calculate a transmit power headroom and if the resulting "Headroom" value is less than the "Common E-DCH TTI selection threshold", it should indicate a selection of common E-DCH TTI of 10 ms to the physical layer for the preamble transmission.

q_3269.question: What are the access types available for the "RPLMN" leaf?

q_3270.question: What are some applications where positioning integrity could be employed in the railway domain?
q_3270.ground_truth: Applications include Automatic Train Protection (ATP), Enhanced Odometry, Absolute Positioning, Cold Movement Detection, Train Integrity and Train Length Monitoring, Track Identification, Odometer Calibration, Level Crossing Protection, Asset Management, Emergency Management, Traffic Management, and Industrial IoT.

q_3271.question: What does bit 8 in octet 5 indicate in the case of speech or speech + CTM Text Telephony?
q_3271.ground_truth: Bit 8 in octet 5 indicates extension of octet 5 when octet 3 indicates speech or speech + CTM Text Telephony. A value of "0" indicates that octet 5 is the last octet, while a value of "1" indicates that at least one additional octet is included.

q_3272.question: What abbreviations are used in the document for different types of modulation?
q_3272.ground_truth: The abbreviations used in the document for different types of modulation are 16QAM, 4PAM, 64QAM, 8PAM, BPSK, and QPSK.

q_3273.question: What type of node does the "OSAppId" leaf act as a placeholder for in this interior node?

q_3274.question: What determines whether the IED's value should be based on compressed or uncompressed data in the case of compressed data?
q_3274.ground_truth: The IED's value should be based on the amount of uncompressed data (before compression is performed) in the case of compressed GSM 7 bit default alphabet, compressed 8 bit data, or compressed UCS2 data.

q_3275.question: What is the purpose of creating MTSI client profiles for a selected set of market verticals in 5G deployments?
q_3275.ground_truth: The purpose of creating these profiles is to address a wide range of media handling capabilities for emerging 5G usages, allowing for enhanced media handling for certain verticals on the high end and minimizing potential transcoding needs for low-end 5G verticals.

q_3276.question: What is the purpose of the P-bit in a command frame?
q_3276.ground_truth: The P-bit in a command frame is used by an LLE to solicit a response frame from the peer LLE

q_3277.question: How is the charging process affected when the tariff is changed with restart of the charging process?
q_3277.ground_truth: When the tariff is changed with restart of the charging process, it restarts with the first communication subtariff of the new tariff sequence, the new non-periodic tariff is applied, and the new communication attempt and communication setup charge are not applied.

q_3278.question: In what scenario should a UE retransmit the INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message on the uplink DCCH using AM RLC for signalling radio bearer RB3?
q_3278.ground_truth: The UE should retransmit the INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message in this way if a re-establishment of the transmitting side of the RLC entity occurs for the signalling radio bearer RB3 before the successful delivery of the INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message has been confirmed by RLC.

q_3279.question: What is the role of the SMF in the 5G VN group communication for a certain 5G VN group?
q_3279.ground_truth: The SMF handles the user plane paths of the 5G VN group, including selecting a single PSA UPF and establishing N19 tunnels between PSA UPFs if needed.

q_3280.question: What is the definition of Supplementary service?
q_3280.ground_truth: A Supplementary service is a service which modifies or supplements a basic telecommunication service. It cannot be offered to a user as a standalone service, and must be offered together with or in association with a basic telecommunication service. The same supplementary service may be common to a number of basic telecommunication services.

q_3281.question: What is the user of the services provided by SNDCP?
q_3281.ground_truth: The user of the services provided by SNDCP is a packet data protocol (PDP) at the mobile Station (MS) or the Relay at the Serving GPRS Support Node (SGSN). Additionally, a control entity, e.g. AT command interpreter, may be an SNDCP user.

q_3282.question: What does the most significant bit in bit 8 of the first octet represent in the description of access bursts?
q_3282.ground_truth: It indicates whether a busy count signal level threshold has been exceeded.

q_3283.question: What is the purpose of a QoS flow in network information provisioning with ECN?
q_3283.ground_truth: A QoS flow, such as QoS flow with 5QI=80, is used for low latency traffic in network information provisioning with ECN. RAN uses ECN to provide fast feedback with low latency to endpoints, indicating potential congestion and allowing them to adjust their flow accordingly.

q_3284.question: In the mobile network, what happens if the ringing tone is needed but no traffic channel is allocated?
q_3284.ground_truth: The network cannot send a ringing tone, so it has to be generated locally at the mobile station.

q_3285.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Public Safety Direct Services Provisioning MO in managing ProSe direct discovery and communication authorization and provisioning information for a ProSe-enabled public safety UE?
q_3285.ground_truth: The ProSe Public Safety Direct Services Provisioning MO is used to manage ProSe direct discovery and ProSe direct communication authorisation and provisioning information for a ProSe-enabled public safety UE.

q_3286.question: What function increments the data pointer by one and returns the byte at the current data pointer?

q_3287.question: What should be the frequency of the RF input signal when measuring the maximum rated output power per channel of a repeater?
q_3287.ground_truth: The RF input signal should be set to the center frequency of the repeater's pass band.

q_3288.question: When must a UE include "Ellipsoid point with uncertainty circle" or "Ellipsoid point with uncertainty ellipse" or "Ellipsoid point with altitude and uncertainty ellipsoid" as the position estimate during a location request?
q_3288.ground_truth: When the "Horizontal Accuracy" in "UE positioning reporting quantity" has been assigned a non-zero value, and "Vertical Accuracy" has not been included in "UE positioning reporting quantity".

q_3289.question: What is the significance of the Leaf node ThreshServingOffloadWLANLowP?
q_3289.ground_truth: The ThreshServingOffloadWLANLowP leaf node acts as a placeholder that indicates the low threshold value of RSRP threshold for E-UTRAN, CPICH RSCP threshold for UTRAN FDD, or P-CCPCH threshold for UTRAN TDD. It is used by the UE for traffic steering to WLAN.

q_3290.question: In the context of 3GPP technical documents, what does "shall" indicate?
q_3290.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_3291.question: What information is included in a TDF-CDR for a TDF session?
q_3291.ground_truth: A TDF-CDR for a TDF session includes details such as Record Type, Served IMSI, Sequence Number, and the application specific charging data. It also includes complete time envelopes determined by mechanisms defined in TS 32.299, with separate counts for volume, elapsed time, or number of events within each TDF-CDR.

q_3292.question: What are the conditions that need to be satisfied for the envelope adjustment flag to be set to 1 in equation (1685)?
q_3292.ground_truth: The envelope adjustment flag is set to 1 in equation (1685) if and , or the coder type is GENERIC.

q_3293.question: How many normal (Gaussian) distributions does each statistical model in the first stage of the speech/music classifier represent?
q_3293.ground_truth: Each statistical model in the first stage of the speech/music classifier is represented by a mixture of six normal (Gaussian) distributions.

q_3294.question: What are the two distributions used to model the per-path Power Azimuth Spectrum (PAS) at the MS?
q_3294.ground_truth: The two distributions used are the Laplacian distribution and the Uniform distribution.

q_3295.question: What does MPS for DTS provide for an IoT device?
q_3295.ground_truth: MPS for DTS provides the IoT device with priority for applications using a specific default bearer towards a single specified PDN/DN, and in the case of IoT connectivity with an enterprise, also provides priority for the terminating access network to the enterprise.

q_3296.question: When should the MAC entity not transmit padding BSR and/or padding?
q_3296.ground_truth: If the MAC entity is given a UL grant size that is equal to or larger than 8 bytes while having data available for transmission, the MAC entity shall not transmit only padding BSR and/or padding.

q_3297.question: What information does the HNB GW need to transfer to the DF2 for a DF2 to perform its functionality in intercepting information from a HNB?
q_3297.ground_truth: The HNB GW needs to transfer the target identity, events and associated parameters, HNB location and date/time of HNB location, and HNB Identity to the DF2.

q_3298.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of failed PUCCH allocations in the PCell for SCell scheduling in Carrier Aggregation, split into subcounters for PUCCH format 3 and PUCCH format 1bwcs?

q_3299.question: What action should the BSS take if it does not support any MBMS Service Area in the received MBMS-SESSION-UPDATE-REQUEST PDU?
q_3299.ground_truth: The BSS should send an MBMS-SESSION-UPDATE-RESPONSE PDU to the SGSN with a Cause Value indicating that none of the listed MBMS Service Areas are supported by the BSS.

q_3300.question: What is the channel filter requirement for a BS supporting 16QAM?
q_3300.ground_truth: The same procedure specified in 6.6.2.2.4.2.1 applies to 3,84 Mcps TDD option BS supporting 16QAM.

q_3301.question: What kinds of networks are protected by the SS7 Security Gateway in 3G systems?
q_3301.ground_truth: The SS7 Security Gateway in 3G systems is used to protect inter-network SS7 signalling protocols in 3G systems.

q_3302.question: What must the MS include in the attach request message when requesting to enable extended idle mode DRX?
q_3302.ground_truth: The MS must include the DRX parameters for regular idle mode DRX in the attach request message.

q_3303.question: What indication is sent by the UE to the MME when the Access Stratum indicates move-traffic-from-WLAN?
q_3303.ground_truth: The UE sends the Request Bearer Resource Modification message including a move-from-WLAN indication.

q_3304.question: Which 3GPP messaging service is an evolution and enhancement of the current 3GPP multimedia messaging user experience?
q_3304.ground_truth: IMS Messaging is an evolution and enhancement of the current 3GPP multimedia messaging user experience, with the goal of reusing industry-wide specifications where possible and proposing extensions as necessary.

q_3305.question: What is the function of reflective QoS in the UE for uplink IP packets for WLAN case?
q_3305.ground_truth: The function of reflective QoS in the UE for uplink IP packets for WLAN case is that the UE creates a 5-tuple rule from the corresponding downlink 5-tuple derived from the downlink IP traffic and associates that uplink rule with the DSCP received in corresponding downlink 5-tuple. Each uplink packet matching that uplink rule is marked with the associated DSCP.

q_3306.question: What do TP-UDHI, TP-SRI and TP-RP stand for in the TP-MTI SMS-DELIVER?
q_3306.ground_truth: TP-UDHI stands for TP-UD field contains user data header and a short message, TP-SRI stands for A status report will not be returned to the SME and TP-RP stands for TP-Reply-Path is not set in this SMS-DELIVER.

q_3307.question: How should the center frequency of the interfering signal be set in relation to the assigned channel frequency of the wanted signal for the 3,84 Mcps TDD option?
q_3307.ground_truth: The center frequency of the interfering signal should be set to 5 MHz above and 5 MHz below the assigned channel frequency of the wanted signal for the 3,84 Mcps TDD option.

q_3308.question: What is Channel-ID value used for in the SFR system?
q_3308.ground_truth: The Channel-ID value identifies specific syndicated feeds during later transactions and is used to associate syndicated feeds with the corresponding channels. The Channel-ID value is present at any syndicated feed related transaction to facilitate identification.

q_3309.question: What is the method used for noise-filling and high frequency noise generation in 6.2.3.2.1.3.2?
q_3309.ground_truth: The noise filling is achieved by building a spectral codebook from the received (decoded) normalized transform coefficients, concatenating the perceptually relevant coefficients of the decoded spectrum, and spectral folding of the low-frequency spectrum. The high frequency noise is generated based on the low frequency filled spectrum and prior to noise level attenuation.

q_3310.question: What does the eighteenth bit of the "PA and Single Stream MIMO Dual Band Support Indicator" indicate?
q_3310.ground_truth: The eighteenth bit indicates Frequency specific Compressed Mode Support.

q_3311.question: In the context of 6a.9.1.3, what action does UE-2 take after the user requests media transfer from UE-1 to UE-2?
q_3311.ground_truth: UE-2 updates its status, indicating that it solicits an IUT of a media flow from UE-1.

q_3312.question: What happens if there is an attempt to register a profile that is already the registered profile?
q_3312.ground_truth: In this case, the registration or selection shall continue uninterrupted and the user shall not be informed.

q_3313.question: What is the format of the "Logically: Device identities" section when the source device is the UICC and the destination device is the ME?
q_3313.ground_truth: Source device: UICC, Destination device: ME

q_3314.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in 3GPP networks?
q_3314.ground_truth: The NWDAF is a 3GPP network function that provides analytics capabilities and can aggregate output analytics. It can also request "aggregation analytics metadata" to be included in the output analytics.

q_3315.question: What should the DRNS do if the Diversity Control Field IE is set to "May" in the context of combining a new RL with existing RLs?
q_3315.ground_truth: The DRNS can decide for any of the alternatives.

q_3316.question: What is the procedure for extending the application by adding new AVPs for a feature on the Ns reference point?
q_3316.ground_truth: The new AVPs should have the M bit cleared and should not be defined mandatory in the command ABNF. They shall be used to identify features that have been defined by 3GPP in the Ns reference point.

q_3317.question: What service does the NEF provide for negotiation of transfer policy for VIAPA applications?
q_3317.ground_truth: The NEF provides a new UE Policy (method 2) or a URSP Rule (method 1) to route VIAPA traffic via a different Network.

q_3318.question: What is the difference between the NEF-edge and NEF-central in the 5G network?
q_3318.ground_truth: The NEF-edge is deployed close to the edge network, while the NEF-central is deployed in the core network. The NEF-edge communicates with the MnS producer to support low latency exposure to the edge network, while the NEF-central handles non-RAN related event exposure.

q_3319.question: What message is sent from the GANC to the MS in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to provide it with PS service related information as perceived by the GANC which may result in the MS triggering the PS handover procedure?
q_3319.ground_truth: The GA-PSR UPLINK QUALITY INDICATION message is sent from the GANC to the MS in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to provide it with PS service related information as perceived by the GANC which may result in the MS triggering the PS handover procedure.

q_3320.question: What are the two optional transmission systems for the A-Interface User Plane, as defined in 3GPP TS 48.0xx?
q_3320.ground_truth: The two optional transmission systems for the A-Interface User Plane are TDM (using 1 or more 2 048 kbit/s digital transmission system interfaces) and IP (supporting User Plane and/or Control Plane using SIGTRAN).

q_3321.question: Which documents describe the technical realization of supplementary services at the radio interface?
q_3321.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 23.011 and GSM 23.08x and 23.09x-series describe the technical realization of supplementary services at the radio interface.

q_3322.question: In what scenario would the Chargeable Duration (CDUR) be suspended for an MS originated call?
q_3322.ground_truth: The Chargeable Duration (CDUR) shall be suspended when the MS detects a radio link failure and shall resume when an MM connection has been successfully completed and a TCH has been successfully seized in the appropriate mode, in the case of an MS originated call.

q_3323.question: In the HQ coder, what are the supported modes per bitrate and bandwidth, and how are they transmitted to the decoder?
q_3323.ground_truth: The supported modes per bitrate and bandwidth in the HQ coder are Transient, Normal, and Harmonic. These modes are transmitted to the decoder using one bit for Transient/non-Transient, and one bit for Normal/Harmonic.

q_3324.question: What is the decrease in maximum output power observed from GSM850 to EGSM900?
q_3324.ground_truth: The maximum output power decreases by approximately 1 dB from GSM850 to EGSM900.

q_3325.question: What is the initial state of the 27.010 entity in terms of data flow?
q_3325.ground_truth: The initial state of the 27.010 entity is with data flow enabled.

q_3326.question: Which element can indicate the measurement quantity for intra-frequency measurement?
q_3326.ground_truth: The "MeasurementQuantity-Intra" element can indicate the measurement quantity for intra-frequency measurement.

q_3327.question: What should the IWU do if it receives a SIP INVITE from the external SIP-I network without the "100Rel" tag?
q_3327.ground_truth: As an option, the IWU may consider the INVITE request as erroneous and reject it with a 421 "Extension Required" response.
