q_3328.question: What should the Node B do when the "Frequency Acquisition" is indicated within the Synchronisation Report Type IE and the frequency locking is performed successfully?
q_3328.ground_truth: The Node B shall start transmitting the indicated cell synchronisation bursts if the frequency locking is performed successfully and "Frequency Acquisition completed" is reported to the RNC.

q_3329.question: What is the impact of user settings on disabling MMI functions in the user equipment (UE)?
q_3329.ground_truth: Users may set the ME to disable some or all of the MMI functions defined in the present document. However, this setting shall only apply when the same SIM/USIM is in use. Otherwise, the ME shall enable the standard MMI.

q_3330.question: What is the purpose of the PDN GW in the EMSDP protocol when the UE selects the non-IP PDU data type?
q_3330.ground_truth: The PDN GW encapsulates the non-IP EMSDP payload in PtP (IP and UDP) for the communication with the HSE.

q_3331.question: In what scenarios is the SOR-CMCI feature applicable?
q_3331.ground_truth: The SOR-CMCI feature is applicable only when the UE is in automatic network selection mode.

q_3332.question: What is the purpose of the Gate Function in the context of ADC rules?
q_3332.ground_truth: The Gate Function is a user plane function that enables or disables the forwarding of application traffic. The Flow-Status AVP of the ADC rule describes whether the possible uplink and downlink gate for the detected application traffic is opened or closed, allowing or disallowing corresponding detected application traffic uplink and/or downlink.

q_3333.question: What unit is used for the measurements of "Number of octets of DL LWIPEP PDUs" and "Number of octets of UL LWIPEP PDUs"?

q_3334.question: What is the function of the MAC-d entity in the UE side?
q_3334.ground_truth: The MAC-d entity in the UE side is responsible for transport channel type switching, multiplexing of several dedicated logical channels onto one transport channel or one MAC-d flow, ciphering for transparent mode data to be ciphered, deciphering for ciphered transparent mode data, and uplink TFC selection.

q_3335.question: How does the classification of RF (Class A or Class B) affect the message flows in the Re interface?
q_3335.ground_truth: In Class A, a TariffRequest is sent by the OCF only when an online charging request is received from the network and no valid tariff is known. In Class B, a TariffRequest is sent by the OCF after every online charging request received from the network. Therefore, the distinction between different TariffRequest scenarios is necessary in Class A but not in Class B.

q_3336.question: How is the signal classification parameter determined for FEC?
q_3336.ground_truth: The signal classification parameter is determined based on the classification for FEC, using five classes to classify speech signals: UNVOICED, UNVOICED TRANSITION, VOICED TRANSITION, ONSET, and VOICED.

q_3337.question: What is the purpose of the second part of the administrator determination mechanism in clause~6.13.3.2?
q_3337.ground_truth: The second part of the administrator determination mechanism deals with the case where the MExE-(U)SIM supports third-party certificates and is used to determine whether the user or a third-party is the administrator.

q_3338.question: Which bits represent the "Explicit Call Barring Indicator" in the IMSI field of the HLR?

q_3339.question: What should the Node B do if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the Maximum MAC-d PDU Size Ext IE for a E-DCH Logical Channel in the E-DCH MAC-d Flows Information TDD IE in the E-DCH Information IE?
q_3339.ground_truth: The Node B should ignore the MAC-d PDU Size IE in the MAC-d PDU Size List IE and use Maximum MAC-d PDU Size Ext IE to optimise capacity allocation for the related E-DCH Logical Channel and use the indicated format in user plane frame structure for E-DCH channels and MAC.

q_3340.question: What message does the MME send to the eNodeB during the CS-MT-LR procedure while the UE is in an IMS VoIP session and has provided location update information using the SGs interface?
q_3340.ground_truth: The MME sends an S1-AP Request message to eNodeB that includes the UE Radio Capabilities and a CS Fallback Indicator.

q_3341.question: Which functional element uses service data flow filters received from the PCRF for service data flow detection?

q_3342.question: What is the role of the Group Call Register (GCR) in the VBS?
q_3342.ground_truth: The Group Call Register (GCR) is a functionality in the network that contains the broadcast call attributes, such as group call area and dispatcher identities.

q_3343.question: What identifier is used to identify a UE having a RRC connection within a cell?
q_3343.ground_truth: The C-RNTI (Cell RNTI) identifies a UE having a RRC connection within a cell.

q_3344.question: What is the effect of DSR on voice quality with different data loads, based on the simulation results?
q_3344.ground_truth: The simulation results indicate that DSR has a similar impact to voice quality as EDGE at lower data loads, but a smaller impact than EDGE with higher data loads.

q_3345.question: What should the UE do if the whole SDU fits into the remaining resources of the associated MAC entity?
q_3345.ground_truth: The UE should not segment an RLC SDU (or partially transmitted SDU or retransmitted RLC PDU) if the whole SDU fits into the remaining resources of the associated MAC entity.

q_3346.question: When is the Extended Quality of Service information element included in the message?
q_3346.ground_truth: The Extended Quality of Service information element is included in the message only if the UE wishes to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the network and at least one of the values exceeds the maximum value specified in the EPS quality of service information element.

q_3347.question: What is the purpose of the LL-STATUS-IND primitive?
q_3347.ground_truth: The LL-STATUS-IND primitive is used to inform layer 3 when an LLC error that cannot be corrected by the LLC layer has occurred.

q_3348.question: What is the function of the "E-TTI" parameter in the UTDOA positioning method?
q_3348.ground_truth: The "E-TTI" parameter in the UTDOA positioning method indicates the Transmission Time Interval for E-DPCH operation.

q_3349.question: What is the role of PCF in providing QoS control information to SMF, including the specific QoS requirements for the MBS service data flows of the UE?
q_3349.ground_truth: The PCF determines provides PDU Session policy control information to the SMF including the specific QoS requirements for the MBS service data flows of the UE, based on the received information from the AF.

q_3350.question: What is the purpose of the "Not Reachable for NIDD Flag" and where is it conditionally stored?
q_3350.ground_truth: The Not Reachable for NIDD Flag indicates that Non-IP Data has been attempted to be delivered by one or more SCEF(s) to a UE that is temporarily not reachable and that the corresponding SCEF(s) need to be notified when the UE is reachable or about to become reachable. The Not Reachable for NIDD Flag (together with the list of SCEF(s)) is temporary data conditionally stored in the MME.

q_3351.question: What is the purpose of Service Point Triggers (SPTs) in IMS communication service?
q_3351.ground_truth: Service Point Triggers (SPTs) are those points in the SIP signalling on which Filter Criteria can be set. They define specific conditions in the SIP message that can trigger a service or a request to be sent to a specific application server.

q_3352.question: What is the performance of the speech users when mapped to the different strength bits in the modulation constellation?
q_3352.ground_truth: By simple mapping, it is possible to support speech users in conditions that are only 6 dB worse than legacy speech channels, as it is possible to support 3 and 4 users in such conditions with minor modifications.

q_3353.question: What does the CLTD-R field in a DL DATA FRAME structure indicate?
q_3353.ground_truth: The CLTD-R field in a DL DATA FRAME structure indicates if CLTD-R is present or not in the octet following the New IE Flags IE.

q_3354.question: What is the role of the Front End Identifier and Front End Cluster Identifier in these procedures?
q_3354.ground_truth: The Front End Identifier and Front End Cluster Identifier are used to identify the FE or group of FEs that are interacting with the UDR. The Front End Identifier can be used to derive the Front End Cluster Identifier, which may be used to determine which FEs should be used for notifications.

q_3355.question: Which three characteristics must be supported by transactions carried out over the Ud reference point?

q_3356.question: How does the UE determine whether a particular new access attempt is allowed or not?
q_3356.ground_truth: The UE maps the kind of request to one or more access identities and one access category and performs access barring checks for that request based on the determined access identities and access category.

q_3357.question: What is the difference between P.NATS Modes 0, 1, and 3?
q_3357.ground_truth: P.NATS Mode 0 estimates quality based on audio and video codecs and bitrates, requiring very low processing power. Mode 1 adds GOP structure and frame sizes, providing better video quality estimation over Mode 0, and also requiring low processing power. Mode 3 takes the bitstream itself into account, providing a more significant estimation of video coding quality, but requiring more processing power and an unencrypted bitstream.

q_3358.question: What is the approach to multiplexing RLC services in the testing architecture?
q_3358.ground_truth: For the RRC and NAS testing, the TTCN RRC test steps and emulators share the same service access point (AM SAP) and provide separate message queues for the TTCN RRC test steps and the RRC emulator for the TTCN NAS test cases.

q_3359.question: What is the purpose of step 4 in the procedure for DSMIPV6 on S2c when accessing a trusted Fixed Broadband Access for EPC-routed Traffic?
q_3359.ground_truth: In step 4, the PCEF acknowledges the provisioning of PCC Rules in the PCEF.

q_3360.question: What is the role of the ID and criticality fields in the protocol's mechanism for forwards and backwards compatibility?
q_3360.ground_truth: The ID and criticality fields are used to ensure that all current and future messages, IEs, or groups of related IEs can always be decoded, regardless of the standard version.

q_3361.question: What is the format of maxCallPeriodDuration in the CAMEL-AChBillingChargingCharacteristics choice?
q_3361.ground_truth: It is an integer with a range of 1 to 864000, measured in 100 millisecond units.

q_3362.question: What is the function of the SGSN in providing the MS radio access capability to the BSS?
q_3362.ground_truth: The SGSN provides the MS radio access capability as an information element on the Gb interface and is responsible for providing the BSS with the most recent MS radio access capability received from the MS.

q_3363.question: What are the requirements of the edge enabling application architecture, related to the Edge Enabler Client registration?
q_3363.ground_truth: The requirements of the edge enabling application architecture related to the Edge Enabler Client registration are mechanisms for a UE to register and de-register from the Edge Enabler Server, mechanisms for the Edge Enabler Server to detect an abnormal termination of a UE registration, and mechanisms to notify a UE about relevant changes in availability of the Edge Application Servers.

q_3364.question: What is the minimum number of consecutive active frames required for the hangover logic to start adding the hangover in the final decision for WB signals?
q_3364.ground_truth: The hangover logic starts adding the hangover after at least three consecutive active frames for WB signals.

q_3365.question: What is the role of grid points in the virtual cell approach for the 5G satellite network?
q_3365.ground_truth: In the virtual cell approach, the coverage area is divided into virtual cells with well-defined geographic boundaries, defined by an array of grid points. A serving cell for any UE is defined by the cell associated with the grid point which is closest to the current UE location.

q_3366.question: In the document, what does the acronym FDD stand for?

q_3367.question: What are the four network scenarios considered in the analysis?
q_3367.ground_truth: The four network scenarios considered are: Scenario A - 4/12 BCCH from WIDER-1, Scenario B - 1/1 TCH from WIDER-1, Scenario C - 3/9 TCH from WIDER-2, and Scenario D - 4/12 BCCH+3/9 TCH from WIDER-3.

q_3368.question: What are the units for the parameters fz,n and fp,m in the multi-pole/zero model (Eq. 4.2.3.2-1) for phase noise profile parameterization?
q_3368.ground_truth: The parameters fz,n and fp,m are in the unit of frequency offset (f0) in Eq. 4.2.3.2-1.

q_3369.question: What is the purpose of the Asserted-Identity header field in the context of subclause 6.2.1.1.3?
q_3369.ground_truth: The Asserted-Identity header field can be used by the NGCN site to provide a P-Asserted-Identity or P-Preferred-Identity. The NGN will use a provided PAI or PPI if it matches one of the registered public user identities.

q_3370.question: What is In-band TFO and how is it established in MS-to-MS calls?
q_3370.ground_truth: In-band TFO aims to remove the speech coding and decoding done in the BSS in MS-to-MS calls. It is established after call set-up using in-band signaling, which is controlled by the TRAU, using the link between the TRAUs that remains transparent, meaning the digital content of what is emitted by a TRAU is not modified.

q_3371.question: What should the Node B do if the TSN-Length IE is included in the HS-DSCH TDD Information IE in a 1.28Mcps TDD system?
q_3371.ground_truth: The Node B should use the TSN bits applied to the MAC-hs PDU frame as indicated by the TSN-Length IE.

q_3372.question: Which type in the protocol messages is used to confirm a UE context modification?
q_3372.ground_truth: UEContextModificationConfirm is used to confirm a UE context modification.

q_3373.question: What is the purpose of the homing frames in the speech encoder and decoder INP and COD files?
q_3373.ground_truth: The homing frames in the INP files for the speech encoder are used to reset the speech encoder state variables to their initial value. The homing frames in the COD files for the speech decoder are used to reset the speech decoder state variables to their initial value. The function of these homing frames is to ensure that the initial values of the state variables are set correctly in the ANSI-C simulation and the hardware implementation being tested.

q_3374.question: What is the MCC (Mobile Country Code) and MNC (Mobile Network Code) that the USS starts sending on the second BCCH with after powering on the UE?

q_3375.question: What should the SMF do if seamless Edge relocation is needed and a dedicated QoS Flow needs to be bound to the application flow?
q_3375.ground_truth: The SMF should bind the application flow to a dedicated QoS Flow and make sure to include the 'seamless Edge relocation' indication in the PCC rule.

q_3376.question: What is the purpose of the PRUK (ProSe Remote User Key) Request message and Key Request message in Solution #18?
q_3376.ground_truth: The PRUK Request message is sent by the remote UE to the PKMF of the UE-to-network relay to receive UE-to-network relay service and the key request message is sent by the UE-to-network relay to the PKMF to request KNRP freshness parameter 2 and the encrypted key for the secure communication with the remote UE.

q_3377.question: What network option allows the O-MGCF to store PSTN XML elements within a dialog?
q_3377.ground_truth: The PSTN XML body as a network option.

q_3378.question: What should the UE do if the authentication verification fails during an AKA run while a PDN connection for emergency bearer services exists?
q_3378.ground_truth: Upon authentication verification failure in the UE, the UE shall send an Authentication Failure message to the MME. The UE shall continue using the current EPS security context. If the UE receives a NAS security mode command selecting NULL integrity and ciphering algorithms, the UE shall accept this as long as the IMS Emergency session progresses.

q_3379.question: Which entity transfers MAC-c PDU to the peer MAC-c entity in the UE using the services of the FACH Frame Protocol (FACH FP) entity?
q_3379.ground_truth: The Common MAC (MAC-c/sh/m) entity in the RNC

q_3380.question: What is the purpose of the test for the Repeater input power?
q_3380.ground_truth: The purpose of the test for the Repeater input power is to verify that the Repeater can operate with an ideal LCR TDD signal in the pass band of the Repeater and produce the maximum rated output power per channel.

q_3381.question: What does the OIR service restrict for the originating user?
q_3381.ground_truth: The OIR service restricts presentation of the originating user's identity information to the terminating user.

q_3382.question: How are the Measurement types and families in UMTS and LTE networks administered?
q_3382.ground_truth: In UMTS and LTE networks, Measurement types and families may be administered per individual measurement type or per measurement family, which comprises a collection of related measurement types. The measurement types and families for UMTS and combined GSM/UMTS networks are specified in TS 32.405, TS 32.406, TS 32.407, TS 32.408 and TS 32.409, for IMS in TS 32.409, for E-UTRAN in TS 32.425, for EPC in TS 32.426, for Home Node B (HNB) Subsystem (HNS) in TS 32.452, and for Home enhanced Node B (HeNB) Subsystem (HeNS) in TS.32.453.

q_3383.question: What is a possible approach to synthesizing multiple interfering signals in real-time for SAIC terminal assessment?
q_3383.ground_truth: A possible approach involves using a general-purpose streaming signal source to generate multiple interfering signals that are agile in terms of embedded training sequence, delay, and frequency offset.

q_3384.question: What should a mobile station operating in Iu mode or E-UTRAN do if a PS handover to A/Gb mode fails?
q_3384.ground_truth: If a PS handover to A/Gb mode fails while a mobile station is in Iu mode or E-UTRAN, the mobile station should return to the cell it was in prior to receiving the Handover from UTRAN Command message if T3216 or T3218 expired.

q_3385.question: What is the role of the ASP interface in the SS through a PCO in type of SatS PCO?
q_3385.ground_truth: The ASP interface in the SS through a PCO in type of SatS PCO is used to load a pre-defined test scenario into the satellite simulator, start or stop generating and broadcasting satellite signals from the satellite simulator, and retrieve the GPS assistance data from an assistance data source.

q_3386.question: What should the LMA do when it receives a PBU message during the Initial MAG Initiated PDN Connection Deletion procedure as per the PMIPv6 and IPv4 support specifications?
q_3386.ground_truth: The LMA should initiate the "Binding De-Registration" procedure while parameters in the PBA are set as specified by the PBA parameters section for this procedure.

q_3387.question: What is the action required of the UE when High-mobility state is detected, as per TS 38.304, clause 5.2.4.3.1?
q_3387.ground_truth: If High-mobility state is detected, the UE needs to add the sf-High of "Speed dependent ScalingFactor for Qhyst" to Qhyst and multiply TreselectionNR by the sf-High of "Speed dependent ScalingFactor for TreselectionNR" if broadcasted in system information.

q_3388.question: How often might the technical specification be updated or revised?
q_3388.ground_truth: The specification may be updated or revised with an increment of the second or third digit depending on the nature of the changes (technical or editorial).

q_3389.question: What is the definition of "credit control" in the context of 3GPP TSs?
q_3389.ground_truth: Credit control is a mechanism that interacts with a user's account and controls or monitors the charges related to the service usage. It involves checking if credit is available, reserving credit, deducting credit from the user's account when service is completed, and refunding reserved credit not used.

q_3390.question: What is the difference between Centralized SON and Distributed SON?
q_3390.ground_truth: Centralized SON is a SON solution where SON algorithms are executed in the OAM system, which has two variants -NM-Centralized SON and EM-Centralized SON. Distributed SON is a SON solution where SON algorithms are executed at the Network Element (NE) level.

q_3391.question: What is the term used in the document to describe the interruption of a TrFO connection for a certain point in the path due to a supplementary service invocation or for handover/relocation?

q_3392.question: Which simulation method has a difference range of 1 dB to 8 dB, mostly below 5 dB from 10 - 20 kHz, and less than 2 dB from low frequency to about 2 kHz?

q_3393.question: What message is sent by the WT to indicate that the requested measurement is successfully initiated?

q_3394.question: What is the unit of measurement for the "Mean processor usage" in the equipment-related measurements?
q_3394.ground_truth: The unit of measurement for the "Mean processor usage" in the equipment-related measurements is %.

q_3395.question: In what situation should a UE delete 5G-GUTI, TAI list, list of equivalent PLMNs, ngKSI, and set 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED after a de-registration request?
q_3395.ground_truth: If the de-registration type is "re-registration not required" and the 5GMM cause indicators abnormal cases or no 5GMM cause IE is included.

q_3396.question: What is the difference between the test requirement principle between MSR single-RAT and multi-RAT requirements?
q_3396.ground_truth: The principle used to define the test requirement for MSR single-RAT requirements remains from the existing specifications, while the minimum requirements developed in the present Technical Report for MSR multi-RAT requirements make no allowance for measurement uncertainty. The measurement results are compared against the Test Requirements as defined by the shared risk principle for both MSR single-RAT and multi-RAT requirements.

q_3397.question: What is the maximum C/I ratio at which the AMR codec outperforms the GSM FR codec in all conditions?
q_3397.ground_truth: The AMR codec outperforms the GSM FR codec down to 13 dB C/I in error-free conditions and down to 7 dB C/I in other cases.

q_3398.question: What procedure does the Trusted Non-3GPP Access follow for PMIPv6 MAG Initiated PDN Connection Deletion in each PDN connection of the UE?
q_3398.ground_truth: In PMIPv6 mode, the Trusted Non-3GPP Access follows the MAG procedure for the PMIPv6 MAG Initiated PDN Connection Deletion as outlined in subclause 5.4.2 for each PDN connection of the UE.

q_3399.question: What is the capacity performance for FR2, Indoor Hotspot DL, with 400MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, SU-MIMO, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, 45Mbps, Option 1 UE Antenna parameters: (M, N, P) = (1, 4, 2), 3 panels (left, right, top)?
q_3399.ground_truth: The capacity performance is 27 UEs per cell.

q_3400.question: What information must be registered in the network for CFNRy?
q_3400.ground_truth: The ForwardedToNumber, which may be accompanied by a ForwardedToSubAddress, information as to whether all calls or all calls of a specific basic service should be forwarded, and the duration of the no reply condition timer.

q_3401.question: What is the function of the local quota in the primary PCF?
q_3401.ground_truth: The primary PCF provides local slice SLA information including local quotas of the maximum number of allowed UEs per S-NSSAI to its secondary PCF instances, keeps a shared quota of the maximum number of allowed UEs per S-NSSAI, and decides the acceptance or rejection of the UE registration request for a specific S-NSSAI based on the sum of the local quotas to the associated secondary PCF instances of S-NSSAI, which shall be less or equal to the network slice related global quota of the maximum number of UEs per S-NSSAI.

q_3402.question: What is the function of the "Call waiting" supplementary service?
q_3402.ground_truth: The "Call waiting" supplementary service is a feature that allows a user to be notified of a second incoming call while they are already engaged in a call.

q_3403.question: What is the format of the technical report?
q_3403.ground_truth: The technical report is divided into several clauses, annexes, and a foreword. It provides information on the scope and abbreviations, a general overview of the project, history and selection process of the codec, performance requirements, and the results of the subjective listening tests and verification phase of testing. Additionally, the annexes contain detailed information about the AMR-WB selection phase and floating-point verification phase.

q_3404.question: What is the role of MCEG in controlling access for 3GPP management system components?
q_3404.ground_truth: MCEG provides exposure governance on MnS components A, B, C in the 3GPP management system.

q_3405.question: Which message is used in the Handover Required Indication procedure to request the handover for a particular MS by the BSS?

q_3406.question: What is the expected action by the MS when it receives the EAP Success message from the EAP-SIM authentication procedure?
q_3406.ground_truth: After the MS receives the EAP Success message from the EAP-SIM authentication procedure, the MS and GANC-SEGW complete the setup of the SA.

q_3407.question: In the context of 6a.9.2.1, what happens after UE-2 sends a request to UE-1 to transfer Media-B from UE-1 to UE-2?
q_3407.ground_truth: A Collaborative Session is established, in which UE-1 is Controller UE and UE-2 is Controllee UE.

q_3408.question: What is the (E/5G)SM cause for the data connection drop event?

q_3409.question: How does the performance of AMR-WB compare to AMR 12.2 kbit/s mode for narrowband speech at a bit-rate of 12.65 kbit/s or higher?
q_3409.ground_truth: AMR-WB offers similar performance as AMR 12.2 kbit/s mode for narrowband speech when the bit-rate of the AMR-WB is 12.65 kbit/s or higher.

q_3410.question: What does the UE do upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measId?
q_3410.ground_truth: The UE initiates the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

q_3411.question: What information must be included in the End User Address information element in a 3GPP network?
q_3411.ground_truth: A valid IPv4 or IPv6 address must be included in the End User Address information element in a 3GPP network.

q_3412.question: What is the purpose of using a similar quantization range for TBE gain frame in Unvoiced coding mode as that of the primary frame?
q_3412.ground_truth: The purpose is to preserve the dynamic range of the amplitude (TBE gain frame) in Unvoiced coding mode.

q_3413.question: What are the interface protocols that need to be tested for interoperability in a 3GPP TMN system?
q_3413.ground_truth: Interoperability testing in a 3GPP TMN system includes testing of the interface protocols, the shared/exposed information over those interfaces, and the interface functionality of the system to ensure that different implementations can interwork.

q_3414.question: What is the format of the MIB-SB-SIB-InformationItem-SystemInfoUpdateRqst in the MIB-SB-SIB-InformationList-SystemInfoUpdateRqst?
q_3414.ground_truth: The MIB-SB-SIB-InformationItem-SystemInfoUpdateRqst is a sequence that contains several parameters including iB-Type, iB-OC-ID, deletionIndicator, iE-Extensions (optional), and a few other optional parameters.

q_3415.question: What is the short message compression algorithm described in 3GPP TS 23.042?
q_3415.ground_truth: The algorithm describes a method for compressing short message data for transmission over the radio interface. Compression applies only to the TP-User-Data part of the TPDU and excludes any TP-User-Data-Header, and theCompression Header must commence at the first octet of the TP-User-Data field immediately following any TP-User-Data-Header field which may be present.

q_3416.question: What is one specific aspect to be considered for XR and Cloud Gaming?
q_3416.ground_truth: One specific aspect to be considered is the role of Edge Computing as a network architecture to enable XR and Cloud Gaming.

q_3417.question: What is the preferred IP version for IMS networks interconnecting to other networks that minimizes the need for IP address and/or protocol translation, as per clause 5.3.5.1?
q_3417.ground_truth: It is recommended for IMS networks to apply an IP version for interconnecting to other networks that minimizes the need for IP address and/or protocol translation, which is typically achieved by using IPv6 as early as possible.

q_3418.question: What message is sent by the AS after the SIP REFER is accepted by user-A, in the Blind Transfer scenario?
q_3418.ground_truth: The AS sends a SIP BYE message for terminating the original SIP INVITE session with user-A and User B.

q_3419.question: When can a base station choose constellation rotation to minimize PAR?
q_3419.ground_truth: A base station can choose constellation rotation to minimize PAR when two alpha-QPSK MUROS mobiles are paired together on orthogonal sub-channels, and if there is no legacy mobile in at least one of the sub-channels.

q_3420.question: What is the function of the SMF in the handover preparation phase during Xn handover?
q_3420.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for invoking the N4 Session Modification procedure with the UPF (PSA) only for unicast PDU Sessions and determining the delivery method (i.e., 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery or 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery) for MBS data transferring based on whether the target NG-RAN supports MBS.

q_3421.question: What is the set of security features that enable applications in the user and in the provider domain to securely exchange messages?

q_3422.question: What is the role of UPF1 (PSA UPF) in the SMF based solution-CTF for session based charging?
q_3422.ground_truth: UPF1 (PSA UPF) determines how to adapt unicast communication based on the destination and traffic forwarding way, and reports the usage reporting of the traffic forwarding to SMF and the identifier of the traffic forwarding way.

q_3423.question: What is the maximum bit rate offered to the user for a given time period for the transfer of a bursty signal?

q_3424.question: How is the number of segments (parts) computed in the PVQ decoding process?
q_3424.ground_truth: The number of segments (parts) is computed using the formula in subclause 5.3.4.2.7.2.1, with a small adjustment to the formula based on the band bit rate and the flag read from the bit stream.

q_3425.question: When should the Receiver assemble an MRW SUFI?
q_3425.ground_truth: The Receiver should assemble an MRW SUFI if the STATUS PDU includes negatively acknowledged AMD PDUs or the DISCARD SUFI, and take the corresponding actions specified in subclauses 11.6.3, 11.6.4, or 11.6.5.

q_3426.question: What action should an SGSN take when it receives a PS-HANDOVER-CANCEL PDU for an unknown MS/UE?
q_3426.ground_truth: The SGSN shall ignore such a PDU.

q_3427.question: What indication does the SGSN give to the UE if it can obtain SMS services via PS domain NAS from the SGSN?
q_3427.ground_truth: The SGSN signals to the UE "SMS-Supported" in every Attach/RAU procedures to inform the UE that it can obtain SMS services via PS domain NAS from the SGSN.

q_3428.question: How are the E-AGCH, E-ROCH, E-RGCH, E-HICH, and F-TPICH transmitted if a UE is receiving a DPCH on which transmit diversity is used from a cell?
q_3428.ground_truth: The E-AGCH, E-ROCH, E-RGCH, E-HICH, and F-TPICH from the same cell are transmitted using STTD.

q_3429.question: What is the purpose of Step 6 in the relay service code setup process?
q_3429.ground_truth: In Step 6, the UE-to-Network relay's AMF adds the necessary information to the NAS Relay Authorization Response/Key Response message, which includes the decrypted Relay Service Code, encrypted and integrity protected new Relay Service Code and User Info ID, and a fresh 5G-GUTI if received from the Remote UE's AMF.

q_3430.question: What are the roles of a PoC participant in PoC session charging?
q_3430.ground_truth: The roles of a PoC participant in PoC session charging are PoC session owner and PoC participant. The PoC session owner is charged for session participation, while the PoC participant is charged for talk burst exchange.

q_3431.question: What information fields does the transaction ID criticality contain in the 3GPP protocol?
q_3431.ground_truth: The transaction ID criticality field contains information about the type, presence, and criticality of the transaction ID.

q_3432.question: What is the purpose of the back-off timer in the context of network slice quota management?
q_3432.ground_truth: The back-off timer is used to suppress further signalling load for a subsequent request of the same S-NSSAI when a network slice quota is overflown.

q_3433.question: What should the NAS do if the event which triggered the access attempt was a request from upper layers to establish a new PDU session, and the NAS did not initiate the NAS transport procedure?
q_3433.ground_truth: Upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category, the NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

q_3434.question: What is the use of the ToConRef interior node in the ProSe Direct Services Provisioning MO?
q_3434.ground_truth: The ToConRef interior node is used to allow an application to refer to a collection of connectivity definitions for establishing the PDN connection for reaching the HPLMN ProSe Function.

q_3435.question: What failure cause identification is included in the name of the measurement type that provides the number of failed relocation preparations for outgoing circuit switched inter-RAT handovers per neighbour cell per cause?

q_3436.question: What does the AVP "IMSI-Unauthenticated-Flag" indicate when it is set to "Unauthenticated"?
q_3436.ground_truth: The IMSI-Unauthenticated-Flag AVP indicates that the served IMSI is not authenticated when it is set to "Unauthenticated".

q_3437.question: What type of data does the "Northbound-Exposure-API-Identifier" AVP contain for each API invocation?
q_3437.ground_truth: The "Northbound-Exposure-API-Identifier" AVP holds an OctetString that contains the identification of the northbound exposure API for each API invocation.

q_3438.question: What is the device identity of the source device in the SEND DATA proactive command in expected sequence 2.1?
q_3438.ground_truth: The source device in the SEND DATA proactive command in expected sequence 2.1 is the UICC.

q_3439.question: What is the purpose of priority markings in the context of MPS for MMTEL video or video conference call/sessions?
q_3439.ground_truth: The purpose of priority markings is to allow a receiving network to accept MPS priority markings from another network and handle the call/session with priority.

q_3440.question: What is the color of the foreground in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.7.1?
q_3440.ground_truth: The color of the foreground is Dark Green in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.7.1.

q_3441.question: What is the type of information in "Cell-InformationItemIE-AuditRsp" and "Cell-InformationItemIE-AuditRsp-ExtIEs"?
q_3441.ground_truth: The type of information in "Cell-InformationItemIE-AuditRsp" is of type "Cell-InformationItem-AuditRsp" and in "Cell-InformationItemIE-AuditRsp-ExtIEs", it is of type "NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION".

q_3442.question: What is the definition of a CUG call in signalling terms?
q_3442.ground_truth: A CUG call, in signalling terms, is a call where CUG information is passed from the originating switching entity to the destination entity.

q_3443.question: What should the PDN GW/GGSN do when there is already an emergency bearer activated?
q_3443.ground_truth: The SGSN shall reject any PDP context activation request for normal services if the mobility and access restrictions do not allow the MS to access normal services.

q_3444.question: What are the conditions that must be satisfied for the SACCH mappings in DRSACCH to be applicable?
q_3444.ground_truth: The conditions include the MS being MUROS-capable, the MUROS subchannel being in DTX mode, and the designated TDMA frame for transmission of SACCH repetition not being occupied for any other purposes.

q_3445.question: What is the setting of the sub-state U2sl in terms of the dedicated one-to-one RR connection between MS and network?
q_3445.ground_truth: A dedicated one-to-one RR connection exists between MS and network.

q_3446.question: How many channels are used for Hybrid ARQ in the second system-level study (Nokia)?
q_3446.ground_truth: Six parallel stop-and-wait (SAW) channels are used for the Hybrid ARQ in the second system-level study (Nokia).

q_3447.question: What is the condition for the MT-SMC entity to enter the MT-MM-connection established state?
q_3447.ground_truth: The MT-SMC entity enters the MT-MM-connection established state after receiving the acknowledgement, CP-ACK or the CP-DATA message.

q_3448.question: What is the method used for session set-up and session control for continuous media streams in this specification?
q_3448.ground_truth: RTSP (Real-time Transport Protocol for Streaming) is used for session set-up and session control.

q_3449.question: What is the expected V/H ratio for the 3GPP SCME Umicro model and Umacro model?
q_3449.ground_truth: The expected V/H ratio for the 3GPP SCME Umicro model is 0.74 dB and for the Umacro model is 8.13 dB.

q_3450.question: What should the AS do when sending the charging information for AOC-D service to the user during the active phase of the communication?
q_3450.ground_truth: The AS should include the AOC information in the content body of a mid-dialog request or mid-dialog response forwarded by the AS to the served user or an INFO request to the served user generated by the AS. The supplied charging information shall be provided as a cumulative charge incurred so far for the communication.

q_3451.question: Which type of payload is added to MIKEY to keep track of MSKs and MTKs, as specified in RFC 4563?
q_3451.ground_truth: The Extension Payload (EXT) is added to MIKEY to keep track of MSKs and MTKs, as specified in RFC 4563.

q_3452.question: In what ways can the PCAP Position Initiation Request message be sent in the described process?
q_3452.ground_truth: The PCAP Position Initiation Request message is sent via the Iupc interface from the SRNC to the SAS after receiving a location request from the core network, and includes any periodic reporting information, cell ID, and UE capability information.

q_3453.question: What is the difference between roll-off factor, alpha, and RRC filtered mean power?
q_3453.ground_truth: Roll-off factor, alpha, is a measure used in root raised cosine filtering, while RRC filtered mean power represents the mean power as measured through a root raised cosine filter with roll-off factor alpha and a bandwidth equal to the chip rate of the radio access mode.

q_3454.question: What is the effect of outgoing communication barring-fixed on Communication Diversion (CDIV) service?
q_3454.ground_truth: If the outgoing communication barring-fixed service has already been activated, a request to activate any CDIV service shall be rejected if the forwarding party's communication to the diverted-to party would be barred by the outgoing communication barring-fixed service.

q_3455.question: What is the definition of iE-Extensions in Additional-CSPS-coordination-information?
q_3455.ground_truth: iE-Extensions is a ProtocolExtensionContainer with Additional-CSPS-coordination-information-ExtIEs, which contains additional extension information.

q_3456.question: What is the impact of the solution on the SMF/MME/PGW-C entities?
q_3456.ground_truth: The solution requires the SMF/MME/PGW-C entities to handle dedicated APN/DNN for UAV communication and handle UAV communication indication in connectivity establishment request to modify the UP connectivity to enable C2 communication.

q_3457.question: In which mode can a mobile station start listening to an MBMS radio bearer?
q_3457.ground_truth: In packet idle mode, it can start listening to an MBMS radio bearer by entering broadcast/multicast receive mode.

q_3458.question: What is the SEAL-UU reference point used for in 3GPP TS 23.434?
q_3458.ground_truth: The SEAL-UU reference point is used as a generic reference point for interactions between a SEAL client and a corresponding SEAL server.

q_3459.question: What should the UE do when it receives the rejected NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REJECT message with the rejection cause of "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached" while in the 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state?
q_3459.ground_truth: The UE shall store the rejected NSSAI and start the timer T3526.

q_3460.question: What is the role of the Segmentation/Concatenation function in the AM RLC entity?
q_3460.ground_truth: It segmented or concatenates RLC SDUs to create AMD PDUs that are larger than or equal to the Minimum UL RLC PDU size and smaller than or equal to the largest UL AMD PDU size.

q_3461.question: What is the definition of a "Gateway UE" in the context of the 3GPP system?
q_3461.ground_truth: A Gateway UE is a user equipment (UE) that acts as a gateway, providing access to and from the 3GPP network for one or more non-3GPP devices that are connected to the gateway UE.

q_3462.question: What is the MSR blocking requirement for out-of-band blocking in Band Category 1, based on the requirements for UTRA and E-UTRA?
q_3462.ground_truth: The MSR blocking requirement for out-of-band blocking in Band Category 1, based on the requirements for UTRA and E-UTRA, is based on a CW interferer at -15 dBm and excludes the frequency range from 20~MHz below the lowest frequency of the uplink operating band up to 20~MHz above the highest frequency of the uplink operating band. The requirements include a maximum BER for any UTRA carrier and a minimum throughput for any E-UTRA carriers.

q_3463.question: How does a UE determine the schema version required to parse a received instantiation?
q_3463.ground_truth: The UE checks the schema that has the highest schema version attribute value that is equal to or less than the value in the received schemaVersion element.

q_3464.question: What is the signal used for presetting the amplitudes in the 5.90 kbit/s mode?
q_3464.ground_truth: The signal used for presetting the amplitudes in the 5.90 kbit/s mode is equal to the input signal.

q_3465.question: When the resumption of the RRC connection is triggered due to an RNA Update, what access category shall RRC select if there is no ongoing emergency service?
q_3465.ground_truth: If there is no ongoing emergency service, RRC shall select '8' as the Access Category and perform the unified access control procedure.

q_3466.question: What is the purpose of the EMMI in conformance testing of a Mobile Station (MS)?
q_3466.ground_truth: The EMMI is used to connect the System Simulator (SS) to the MS during conformance testing. If an adapter is used, it shall be provided by the manufacturer.

q_3467.question: What should the mobile station do if there is an incoming call and there is an existing call that has not reached the established phase?
q_3467.ground_truth: The mobile station may initiate call clearing with cause #47 "no resources available, unspecified".

q_3468.question: What is the role of the GANC in the NAS signalling procedure?
q_3468.ground_truth: The GANC is responsible for establishing a signalling connection to the indicated core network domain entity and relaying the NAS-PDUs between the MS and the core network.

q_3469.question: What precautions should be taken when changing the key for PWS?
q_3469.ground_truth: PWS keys should not be updated immediately after a Warning Notification has been sent to avoid rejection of secondary warning messages due to mismatch in keys. Additionally, there should be a policy for key lifetime expiration and the key lifetime could be in the order of months or years.

q_3470.question: What should the transmitting PDCP entity do when it receives a request to submit a PDCP PDU for a bearer with PDCP duplication that is activated?
q_3470.ground_truth: If the PDCP PDU is a PDCP Data PDU, the PDCP entity should duplicate the PDU and submit it to the associated RLC entities. If the PDCP PDU is a control PDU, the PDCP entity should submit it to the primary RLC entity.

q_3471.question: What is the role of the Gateway Node (P-GW/GGSN) in a GPRS network?
q_3471.ground_truth: The Gateway Node (P-GW/GGSN) provides interworking with packet data networks and is connected with other core network nodes via an IP-based packet domain PLMN backbone network.

q_3472.question: What two candidate codecs were evaluated for SES by IBM and Scansoft?
q_3472.ground_truth: The two candidate codecs evaluated were the ETSI Standard for the DSR Extended Advanced Front-end (ES 202 212) and the AMR and AMR-WB audio codec.

q_3473.question: What are the possible solutions for identifying RedCap UEs during the cell access procedure?
q_3473.ground_truth: The possible solutions include identifying RedCap UE type(s) during Msg1 transmission, Msg3 transmission, post Msg4, or during MsgA transmission.

q_3474.question: How long is the network-side nonce FRESH in 3G UMTS network?
q_3474.ground_truth: The network-side nonce FRESH is 32 bits long in 3G UMTS network.

q_3475.question: What actions should the system take when the measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for a given measId is empty?
q_3475.ground_truth: The system should remove the measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId and stop the periodical reporting timer for this measId, if it is running.

q_3476.question: In the provided code, what is the condition for "E-DCH Capability IE" to be present in the "id-E-DCH-TTI2ms-Capability"?
q_3476.ground_truth: The "E-DCH Capability IE" must be set to "E-DCH Capable" for "id-E-DCH-TTI2ms-Capability" to be present.

q_3477.question: Which service APIs are required to be supported at the factories of the future application enabler layer to obtain private slice network status?
q_3477.ground_truth: Additional service APIs related to private slice network status

q_3478.question: What is the purpose of pairing authorization in the solution for Key Issue #2?
q_3478.ground_truth: Pairing authorization is requested during a PDU Session establishment/modification procedure and allows C2 communication based on UAV-C peer connectivity authorization information when granted by USS/UTM in the solution for Key Issue #2.

q_3479.question: What are the requirements for the latency and coverage area of the high altitude, long range non-public 5G network?
q_3479.ground_truth: The latency of the network is 6 ms with long range coverage of up to 200 km and a wide coverage area of 130 square km.

q_3480.question: What does the ACDC category indicate in the ACDC MO?
q_3480.ground_truth: The ACDC category indicates the category to which the identified application belongs, with the highest ranked ACDC category meaning the least restriction to access attempts and the lowest ranked ACDC category meaning the most restriction to access attempts.

q_3481.question: Which LL protocol states are identified for a logical link connection in the LLC layer?
q_3481.ground_truth: A logical link connection is always in one of the following three states in the LLC layer: TLLI Unassigned, TLLI Assigned/ADM, or ABM.

q_3482.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
q_3482.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals is responsible for defining and standardizing the technical specifications for the core network and terminals of mobile communication systems.

q_3483.question: What is the name of the composite dependent variable used to represent the underlying variable for the WB/ASY conditions in the wideband asymmetric condition conversation tests?

q_3484.question: What is the IRAP picture type used in the first picture of an IRAP for CRA?

q_3485.question: What is the procedure for resuming GPRS service after it has been suspended while the mobile station was in dedicated mode?
q_3485.ground_truth: The GANC sends a GA-CSR RELEASE message to instruct the MS to release the GA-CSR Connection and the MS resumes GPRS service internally.

q_3486.question: In what situation does the GAN de-registration procedure occur and what are the subsequent steps taken by the GANC?
q_3486.ground_truth: The GAN de-registration procedure is initiated either by the MS or GANC when the GAN de-registration procedure occurs due to the loss of the signalling connection. The GANC responds to the SGSN with an Iu Release Complete message after receiving the Iu Release Command message and implicitly de-activates all associated PTCs.

q_3487.question: What measurements are taken to report channel quality in a downlink multi carrier assignment?
q_3487.ground_truth: Measurements specified in subclause 10.2.3.2.1 are made on each radio frequency channel separately in case of a downlink multi carrier assignment.

q_3488.question: Which sets of training sequences are used for different domains with Extended TSC Sets?
q_3488.ground_truth: For the circuit switched domain, two new GMSK sets referred to as GMSK TSC Set 3 and GMSK TSC Set 4 are defined. For the packet switched domain, including EGPRS and EGPRS2-A, one additional set of eight training sequences is defined for each of GMSK, 8PSK, 16QAM, and 32QAM normal bursts, referred to as TSC Set 2 for 8PSK, 16QAM, and 32QAM modulation, while for GMSK, TSC Set 3, which is identical to TSC Set 3 used for circuit switched channels, is used.

q_3489.question: What is the effect on the SN field after the UE transmits 4096 SDUs in AM RLC with 12-bit SN?
q_3489.ground_truth: The SN field wraps around after the UE transmits 4096 SDUs.

q_3490.question: What is the constant algorithmic codec delay for the Enhanced aacPlus codec for the downmix component?
q_3490.ground_truth: The delay is 25 (fixed point encoder) or 6 (floating point encoder) samples for a 2:1 downsampling filter.

q_3491.question: What is the Gw reference point used for?
q_3491.ground_truth: The Gw reference point is used for retrieval, provisioning and removal of PFDs from the PFDF to the PCEF and reporting the handling result of PFDs from the PCEF to the PFDF.

q_3492.question: What is the issue with using the existing NetworkSliceSubnet IOC to represent the consumed NSSaaS?
q_3492.ground_truth: The issue is that the same IOC is used to represent a network slice subnet managed by the 3GPP Management System and one that is managed by an external 3GPP Management System, but the allowed management actions on the IOC are different for these two cases.

q_3493.question: What is the purpose of the PSI 14 message in dual transfer mode?
q_3493.ground_truth: The PSI 14 message in dual transfer mode contains most of the information in SI 13, if the PBCCH is not allocated, or the location of the PBCCH, if present. It is sent by the network to the MS to maintain the packet resources after release of the CS connection, and to reduce the interruption of the GPRS session at call release.

q_3494.question: What procedure does the UE initiate to activate the unicast path during a mode switch to unicast?
q_3494.ground_truth: The UE may initiate PDU Session Establishment / Modification procedure or Service Request procedure to activate the unicast path with the AF.

q_3495.question: What is the Serving Grant Update function in the context of E-TFC selection?
q_3495.ground_truth: The Serving Grant Update function provides the E-TFC selection function with the maximum E-DPDCH to DPCCH power ratio that the UE is allowed to allocate for the upcoming transmission for scheduled data (held in the Serving Grant state variable). This power ratio is used to determine a maximum number of bits of scheduled data with a 1 bit granularity for the upcoming transmission.

q_3496.question: During a transient phenomenon test for ancillary equipment, what is prohibited after the test, regarding performance and loss of function?
q_3496.ground_truth: After the test, no degradation of performance or loss of function is allowed below the specified performance level.

q_3497.question: What does the CSFB Indication information element provide in a 3GPP network?
q_3497.ground_truth: The CSFB Indication information element indicates that the connection was established as a result of a CSFB (Circuit Switched Fallback) procedure in a 3GPP network.

q_3498.question: What potential data is required for network slice throughput statistics/predictions for the RAN domain?
q_3498.ground_truth: The potential data required for network slice throughput statistics/predictions for the RAN domain includes parameters such as the number of UEs, the number of RBs, and the bandwidth, as per 6.3.4.3.2.

q_3499.question: What is the purpose of the Sequence-ID field in the I1 message common part?
q_3499.ground_truth: The Sequence-ID field guarantees the proper ordering of the I1 message by incrementing the Message sequence number value by one for each new I1 message forwarded to its peer.

q_3500.question: What is the purpose of defining the "communication services" term in the document?
q_3500.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the "communication services" term in the document is to provide a subset of 3GPP defined services and specify the requested level of communication service quality.

q_3501.question: What should a mobile station do if timer T3168 expires and the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message has already been transmitted four times?
q_3501.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_3502.question: When does the SMF send the changed AS IP address to the UE?
q_3502.ground_truth: The SMF sends the changed AS IP address to the UE via NAS PCO after receiving it from the AF.

q_3503.question: What information does the network data analytics provide in the solution for Key Issue #16?
q_3503.ground_truth: The network data analytics provides information on network data traffic related measurements, such as per DNAI measurement of traffic volume, number of packets, and network performance per DNAI for a specific service.

q_3504.question: What are the possible result codes that can appear in "CreateResponse" of the Rp interface?
q_3504.ground_truth: ActionNotAuthorized, ActionNotSupported, ExtensionNotSupported, Failed, InvalidData, InvalidRequestorData, InvalidResourceID, MissingNewDataElement, MissingResourceIDElement, NoMultipleAllowed, NoMultipleResources, OK, RequestorNotAuthorized, TimeOut, UnexpectedError.

q_3505.question: How does the BM-SC specify the location reporting in the consumption reporting of MBMS User Service?
q_3505.ground_truth: The BM-SC can specify whether the UE shall include its current location by serving cell-ID or MBMS SAI when it performs consumption reporting via the location child element of r12:consumptionReport.

q_3506.question: What is the feature of the conferencing application that allows Anne to localize the voices of all participants in a spatially aligned manner?
q_3506.ground_truth: The feature is a stereo headset that provides spatial audio for Anne.

q_3507.question: What is the purpose of the Unified Access Control procedure as per 5.4.11.1?
q_3507.ground_truth: The purpose of the Unified Access Control procedure is to perform access barring check for a 5GS access attempt associated with a given Access Category and one or more Access Identities upon request from upper layers or the RRC layer.

q_3508.question: What are the two maximum limitations for the CATR measurement system of TX requirements?
q_3508.ground_truth: The two limitations are the maximum size of the BS and the unsuitability of the CATR for low frequency measurements.

q_3509.question: What is the official floating-point version of the EVS codec standard described in the 3GPP TS 26.443?
q_3509.ground_truth: The official floating-point version of the EVS codec standard is described in the 3GPP TS 26.443.

q_3510.question: What sequence numbering mechanism is used by the RR sublayer to avoid message loss or duplication in the case of a channel change?
q_3510.ground_truth: Each concerned upper layer message must be marked with a send sequence number, denoted by the send state variable V(SD), to allow the CTS-FP to detect any duplicated received messages, which are then ignored. For historical reasons, messages sent with the CC, SS, and MM PDs share the same sequence numbering.

q_3511.question: What is the role of the Second bit allocation block in the TCQ and USQ with second bit allocation scheme for fine structure decoding?
q_3511.ground_truth: The Second bit allocation block is responsible for using the surplus accumulated during decoding to decode two bands determined by the second bit allocation procedure described in encoder in subclause 5.3.4.1.4.1.5.1.2.

q_3512.question: What does Solution 12 require in terms of UE and sNB related changes?
q_3512.ground_truth: Solution 12 requires changes in UE and sNB related features, including UE awareness of its geo-location, geo-location-based TA and Cell Selection, awareness of geographical zones and capability to receive updates from the network for Geographical zone option, dynamic assignment of TAs to NGSO satellites, handover procedures, position determination of UEs for trusted location service for some services, delivery of NAS information on the desirable TA for UE that is not aware of its location, and more.

q_3513.question: What is the purpose of the Proxy Mobile IPv6 Mobile Network Prefix Allocation procedure?
q_3513.ground_truth: The Proxy Mobile IPv6 Mobile Network Prefix Allocation procedure assigns a delegated mobile network prefix to the UE's PDN connection with a shorter prefix length than the default /64 prefix.

q_3514.question: What is the effect of a CCBS recall on Communication Diversion (CDIV)?
q_3514.ground_truth: CCBS recalls shall never be diverted. They shall be provided to the original originating party. CCBS can not be activated on a diverted communication.

q_3515.question: What is the objective of LSB TCQ for USQ?
q_3515.ground_truth: The objective of LSB TCQ for USQ is to use the advantages of both quantizers (USQ and TCQ) in one scheme and exclude the path limitation from the TCQ for quantizing the LSBs of quantized data.

q_3516.question: What type of equipment was used by listeners to evaluate the test items?
q_3516.ground_truth: The tests were performed on the headphone STAX Signature SR-404 (open) and its amplifier SRM-006t.

q_3517.question: What is the maximum power allowed for any spurious emission in the Category B limits for 3.84 Mcps TDD option?
q_3517.ground_truth: The power of any spurious emission shall not exceed the value specified in 6.6.3.1.2.1.1, where the limit is based on the lower and upper frequency of the band in which TDD operates.

q_3518.question: What should the MS do when it receives a GA-CSR DOWNLINK DIRECT TRANSFER message and is not in GA-CSR-DEDICATED state?
q_3518.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the contents of the message, transmit a GA-CSR STATUS message with the appropriate error code, and continue with any ongoing procedure as if the message was not received.

q_3519.question: What is the purpose of the "SplitLeg" operation in the "11.31 SplitLeg Procedure" section?
q_3519.ground_truth: The gsmSCF uses this operation to request the gsmSSF to separate one party from the source Call Segment and place it in a new target Call Segment.

q_3520.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what does it produce?
q_3520.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between groups of telecommunications standards associations. It produces technical specifications for the 3GPP technical specification family, which covers services and system aspects for telecommunication management, including the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP).

q_3521.question: What are the mechanisms for rate adaptation in the order of least graceful to most graceful?
q_3521.ground_truth: The order of least graceful to most graceful mechanisms for rate adaptation is as follows: RAN-assisted rate adaptation, ECN-based rate adaptation, and the use of an intermediate node for rate adaptation.

q_3522.question: What is the relaxed measurement criterion for a stationary UE as per TS 38.304 clause 5.2.4.9.3?
q_3522.ground_truth: The relaxed measurement criterion for a stationary UE is met when (SS-RSRPRefStationaryConnected - SS-RSRP) < SSearchDeltaP-StationaryConnected.

q_3523.question: What is the IMS application that provides functionality for IMS Centralized Services and service continuity of multimedia sessions?
q_3523.ground_truth: The SCC AS (Service Centralization and Continuity Application Server)

q_3524.question: What is the role of pitch coherence in determining the final pitch lags?
q_3524.ground_truth: Pitch coherence is used to find the right pitch value by further weighting the weighted normalized correlation function in each section of each half-frame in each pitch delay range. This weighting is based on pitch coherence of the initial set of pitch lags with pitch lags from the other half-frames, and favors section-wise stability.

q_3525.question: What is the service provided by the 3GPP for customizing the media played to the called party during communication establishment?

q_3526.question: What is a possible method for the UE to enforce changes in the application to PDU session association based on the UE location?
q_3526.ground_truth: If multiple location specific URSP rules are used, the UE may need to re-evaluate the application association with a PDU session when the UE location does not match the Location Criteria. If the re-evaluation leads to a change of the application to PDU session association, the UE may enforce such changes in a timely manner based on implementation, e.g. immediately or when UE enters CM-IDLE state.

q_3527.question: What is the duration of available PRS in the positioning frequency layer i to be measured during?
q_3527.ground_truth: Tavailable is the time duration of available PRS in the positioning frequency layer i to be measured during.

q_3528.question: What must the UE do before sending a request to the P-CSCF if it does not have a TCP connection towards the P-CSCF yet?
q_3528.ground_truth: The UE shall set up a TCP connection to the port of the P-CSCF before sending a request to it in the TCP case.

q_3529.question: What does the term "UE headset electrical interface" mean in the context of the document?
q_3529.ground_truth: UE headset electrical interface refers to the electrical connections between the user's headset and the user equipment (UE), providing a convenient access point for testing by removing acoustic interface-related aspects from the measurement.

q_3530.question: What is the definition of a "Routing Rule" in the context of NBIFOM?
q_3530.ground_truth: A Routing Rule is a set of information that enables the association of a routing filter with a routing access type, used for the routing of IP flows.

q_3531.question: What happens if the UE is not authorized to access the requested MBMS user services?
q_3531.ground_truth: If the UE is not authorized to access the requested MBMS user services, the SCF will terminate the registration procedure and the BM-SC will not store the received information or return an HTTP 200 OK message to the SCF.

q_3532.question: What should the IM CN subsystem do upon receipt of a SIP 200 OK from the SCF in case of IMS-based MBMS file repair?
q_3532.ground_truth: The IM CN subsystem shall forward the SIP 200 OK to the UE.

q_3533.question: What action should be taken if CAMEL Phase 2 or higher is not supported in the HLR when processing CFNRc with CAMEL Phase 2 or higher?
q_3533.ground_truth: Processing continues from the "No" exit of the test "Result=Pass".

q_3534.question: What is the update procedure for the "ue-RadioAccessCapability" field in the "SRNC-RelocationInfo-r9-IEs" sequence?
q_3534.ground_truth: The "ue-RadioAccessCapability" field in the "SRNC-RelocationInfo-r9-IEs" sequence can be updated with the Rel-5 radio access capability extensions and later.

q_3535.question: What is the purpose of the User Info ID in ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery?
q_3535.ground_truth: The User Info ID is used in ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery to identify a user within the discovery group and is used in various scenarios, such as when the UE is acting as an announcing UE, discoverer UE, or discoveree UE.

q_3536.question: What is the limitation of using a Plane Wave Synthesizer in the test method for measuring the antenna performance?
q_3536.ground_truth: The maximum rated Power Density (PD) per section of the PWS area might be restricted depending on the implementation.

q_3537.question: How should a receiving node handle missing IEs/IE groups with the "Reject IE" or "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" marking in a response message defined for the procedure?
q_3537.ground_truth: The receiving node should include the Information Element Criticality Diagnostics IE in the Criticality Diagnostics IE for each reported IE/IE group in the response message defined for the procedure.

q_3538.question: How many GSM cells does a UE need to maintain the timing information of for BSIC re-confirmation, in the procedure for UE to perform BSIC verification on a GSM cell?
q_3538.ground_truth: The UE shall maintain the timing information of 6 identified GSM cells for BSIC re-confirmation, as required in section 8.4.2.5.2.

q_3539.question: What changes are implemented in the Node B to support Enhanced Uplink?
q_3539.ground_truth: New MAC entities (MAC-e and MAC-i) are added in the Node B to handle HARQ retransmissions, scheduling, and MAC-e/i demultiplexing.

q_3540.question: Which type of interference is considered in the MTS-1 scenario?
q_3540.ground_truth: In the MTS-1 scenario, a single synchronous co-channel interferer is present when a legacy DARP MS receives an alpha-QPSK MUROS sub channel.

q_3541.question: What should the RLC endpoints in the network and in the mobile stations do during an MBMS data transfer?
q_3541.ground_truth: The RLC endpoints should not expect that every RLC block is correctly received at the mobile station side and should consider as valid RLC blocks those that are higher than the next expected highest numbered RLC block or those starting from the next expected highest numbered RLC block onwards.

q_3542.question: What is the action taken by the UE when the ICS UE in the response to the INVITE request includes a P-Access-Network-Info header field with an access-type field set to "3GPP-GERAN", and both the UE and the network support dual transfer mode?
q_3542.ground_truth: The UE shall use a CS bearer for the related audio media stream.

q_3543.question: What should the "RRC Message sequence number" in the IE "Integrity check info" in the message be set to when calculating the message authentication code in step 8.5.10.3?
q_3543.ground_truth: The "RRC Message sequence number" in the IE "Integrity check info" in the message should be set to zero when calculating the message authentication code.

q_3544.question: What is an "Absolute priority layer" as defined in the document?
q_3544.ground_truth: An "Absolute priority layer" is a priority level that can be defined for a UTRA frequency, a group of GSM frequencies, or a E-UTRA frequency.

q_3545.question: What is the purpose of using low-pass filtered pulses in the artificial onset reconstruction?
q_3545.ground_truth: The purpose of using low-pass filtered pulses in the artificial onset reconstruction is to place them in the adaptive excitation buffer and construct the last glottal pulse in the erased frame. This significantly improves the performance of the consecutive good frames and accelerates the decoder convergence to actual decoder states.

q_3546.question: What does the Message Type field in the second octet and third of the I1 message common part indicate?
q_3546.ground_truth: The Message Type field identifies the type of the I1 message, and the Reason fields provide additional information about the respective I1 message.

q_3547.question: What security measure should be taken to protect the TUAK TOPc value during transfer out of the UDR?
q_3547.ground_truth: It shall be protected during transfer out of the UDR against eavesdropping by unauthorized network elements and by unauthorized persons, and it shall be protected against modification during transfer out of the UDR.

q_3548.question: What is the requirement for mobile station support for PBCCH and PCCCH in A/Gb-mode of operation?
q_3548.ground_truth: Mobile station support for PBCCH and PCCCH is optional for A/Gb-mode of operation. The network shall never enable PBCCH and PCCCH.

q_3549.question: What are the target identities that can be used for intercepting communications in IMS WLAN Interworking?
q_3549.ground_truth: The target identities for IMS WLAN Interworking interception can be MSISDN, IMSI, or NAI.

q_3550.question: What is the minimum requirement for intermodulation response rejection for the received wanted signal at its assigned channel frequency with two interfering signals?
q_3550.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for intermodulation response rejection is that the BER shall not exceed 0.001 for any UTRA carrier, and the throughput shall be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel for any E-UTRA carrier.

q_3551.question: How does deferred system information acquisition help reduce energy consumption in packet idle mode?
q_3551.ground_truth: Deferred system information acquisition enables the mobile station to apply a relaxed timing requirement for acquiring EC System Information and reduces the frequency at which it reads the EC-BCCH. The mobile station can also identify if a cell is part of a specific Idle Mode Mobility cell group, reducing the need to read the EC-BCCH after cell reselection.

q_3552.question: What action does the UDR take when it detects a potential corruption or inconsistency of data?
q_3552.ground_truth: The UDR sends a notification request to the callback URI (for the default notification type: PotentialUDRDataInconsistency) defined in the UDM/PCF/NEF profile to notify the restoration information.

q_3553.question: What is the term used to describe the number of attempted outgoing intra-DeNB handover preparations from DeNB cell to RN per handover cause?
q_3553.ground_truth: Attempted outgoing intra-DeNB handover preparations from DeNB cell to RN per handover cause

q_3554.question: What will the network do if no result is returned by the MS for the "Get password" operation invoked by the network?
q_3554.ground_truth: The "register password" procedure is terminated, and the old password remains registered.

q_3555.question: What will be the result of transforming the 3GPP system into an AIPN in terms of the threat environment?
q_3555.ground_truth: Transforming the 3GPP system into an AIPN will introduce changes in the threat environment, introducing new threats and changing the risk levels of existing threats. This is mainly due to qualitative and quantitative changes in the threat environment, system heterogeneity and multi-access, fragmentation of security solutions, usage patterns, requirements of user convenience, and usage of trust establishment mechanisms.

q_3556.question: What is a disadvantage of CBR rate control in video encoding?
q_3556.ground_truth: CBR rate control can result in a fluctuating quality and varying frame rate, which has a negative impact on the subjective quality of the compressed video stream. This is due to the limitation of bits used for compressing each picture, regardless of the complexity of the content.

q_3557.question: What is the function of the Gi reference point in the IMS network?
q_3557.ground_truth: The Gi reference point ties the UE towards the APN used to access GPRS and the relevant IP version supported over this APN.

q_3558.question: What is the speeches codec mapping used in case of Transcoder Free Operation (TrFO) in a BICC-based Core Network?
q_3558.ground_truth: In case of Transcoder Free Operation (TrFO) in a BICC-based Core Network, the MGW relays the SDUs unaltered between Iu and Nb Interfaces.

q_3559.question: What is the difference between a transit network and a terminating network in a PLMN connection?
q_3559.ground_truth: A transit network is a network that carries data and signals between two other PLMN networks or between two sections of the same PLMN network. A terminating network, on the other hand, is a PLMN network that provides a link between a PLMN user access point and a transit network or between a PLMN network and a terminating network. It provides access to a PLMN network and may also provide network capabilities such as connection and transmission means, control functions and protocols, and operations and management functions.

q_3560.question: What happens to the BBERF classification during handover from PMIP to GTP, when a new IP-CAN type is reported by the PCEF?
q_3560.ground_truth: The BBERF is classified as a non-primary BBERF.

q_3561.question: What is the role of the GA-Cell field in the GA-Cell structure?
q_3561.ground_truth: The GA-Cell field in the GA-Cell structure indicates a Circle Redundancy Group cell in a macro diversity area.

q_3562.question: What are Common Transport Channels, as defined by the TSG RAN UTRAN Iur Interface Data Transport and Transport Signalling (Release 17)?
q_3562.ground_truth: Common Transport Channels are defined as transport channels that are shared by several users, including RACH, FACH, DSCH (TDD), USCH (TDD) and HS-DSCH.

q_3563.question: What should the CCU do if either TsyncR or TsyncD expires before frame synchronization is again obtained?
q_3563.ground_truth: The call is released as specified in 3GPP TS 48.058 or GSM~08.58 with the case field set to " Remote Transcoder Failure".

q_3564.question: What should the UE do with the CQI report it derives from a HS-DSCH transmission?
q_3564.ground_truth: The UE should report the CQI report to the Node B in the next HS-SICH available to the UE following that HS-DSCH transmission, unless that HS-SICH immediately follows the last allocated HS-DSCH timeslot.

q_3565.question: In step 5, what action does the SCC AS take to release the SIP dialog on the Source Access Leg?
q_3565.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends a SIP BYE request via the SIP dialog over the Gm reference point on the Source Access Leg, if the SIP dialog is still active.

q_3566.question: What is the name of the allocation (1RB43) that experiences a sudden drop in boosting capability in the new-inner region?

q_3567.question: What are the parameters that the MBS Application Provider can update in an MBS Distribution Session?
q_3567.ground_truth: The MBS Application Provider can update the target service areas, MBS Frequency Selection Area (FSA) Identifier, and QoS information in an MBS Distribution Session.

q_3568.question: Which TS specifies the formats and coding for supplementary services?
q_3568.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 24.080 specifies the formats and coding for supplementary services.

q_3569.question: What should the Node B do when it detects that the signaling bearer for the control of the Node B Communication Context needs to be rearranged and receives a BEARER REARRANGEMENT INDICATION message from the CRNC?
q_3569.ground_truth: The Signalling Bearer Requested Indicator IE shall be included in the BEARER REARRANGEMENT INDICATION message.

q_3570.question: What message does the BSS send to the mobile station after sending an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message and contention resolution is completed?
q_3570.ground_truth: The BSS sends a CHANNEL RELEASE message to the mobile.

q_3571.question: What message is omitted in case of called party pre-emption?

q_3572.question: What conditions must be satisfied for the entering condition A5-1 to be considered as fulfilled in the context of event triggered measurements?
q_3572.ground_truth: The entering condition A5-1 is considered as fulfilled when the measurement result of the PCell/ PSCell becomes worse than the absolute threshold1.

q_3573.question: How is the TFCI encoded for transportation?
q_3573.ground_truth: The TFCI is encoded using a (32, 10) sub-code of the second order Reed-Muller code. Padding with zeros is done to make it 10 bits, if the TFCI consist of less than 10 bits. The length of the TFCI code word is 32 bits, which represents a linear combination of 10 basis sequences.

q_3574.question: In what situations can there be no Tsor-cm timer started for any PDU session or service?
q_3574.ground_truth: There is no Tsor-cm timer started for any PDU session or service if the SOR-CMCI used contains no SOR-CMCI rule, or there are no criteria matched with any ongoing PDU session or service, or there is no criterion matched, but all timer values are equal to zero.

q_3575.question: What is the purpose of the "Maximum total number of transport blocks received within TTIs that end within the same 10~ms interval" parameter?
q_3575.ground_truth: This parameter is used to determine the processing requirements for CRC in the downlink and the maximum number of transport blocks that can be simultaneously received by the UE on DCH, FACH, PCH, and DSCH transport channels.

q_3576.question: What are the primary responsibilities of a Content Cache Server in a Peer-to-Peer Content Distribution Network?
q_3576.ground_truth: A Content Cache Server is responsible for caching partial or entire source content for distribution to end users. It obtains data from the Content Source Server or other Content Cache Servers via pre-distribution or upon users' requests. Content Cache Servers are usually deployed at the edge of the network to accelerate content distribution.

q_3577.question: What mechanism is defined for future extensions in TFO messages?
q_3577.ground_truth: The number of local used codec types for one system identification, the codec list, and the codec attributes can be extended in future.

q_3578.question: What happens when a SMF recovers from a failure in the SMF set?
q_3578.ground_truth: The SMF broadcasts a recovery message towards all other SMFs in the SMF set. Upon receiving the recovery message, other SMFs share their maintained IP address/prefix list with usage indication records. The recovered SMF can then update its records based on this shared information.

q_3579.question: What operation does the PDN GW provide to the PCRF when deleting an existing TFT?
q_3579.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides to the PCRF the Gx operation "delete filters" when the TFT operation is "Delete existing TFT".
