q_3580.question: What does the "package" term mean in the context of H.248 protocol?
q_3580.ground_truth: In H.248, packages are used to accommodate variations in terminations by grouping related properties into sets. A termination may realize a set of such packages.

q_3581.question: How many bits is the RAT discriminator field in the SON Transfer Application?
q_3581.ground_truth: The RAT discriminator field is 4 bits.

q_3582.question: What is the purpose of the list length field in a CCM message?
q_3582.ground_truth: The list length field in a CCM message indicates the total length of the fingerprint list not including the final CCM signature. It shall be zero when certificate advice is set to enable-all, disable-all, or enable present list.

q_3583.question: What action does the MS take upon receiving a downlink GTP-U G-PDU message for the MS from the CN, and what is the purpose of relaying the GTP-U G-PDU payload within a GA-RRC PDU message to the MS using the associated GA-RRC PTC?
q_3583.ground_truth: The MS immediately forwards any downlink PS domain user data packets for the RAB to itself (the MS) using the PTC. The purpose of relaying the GTP-U G-PDU payload within a GA-RRC PDU message to the MS using the associated GA-RRC PTC is to ensure proper processing of the data packet.

q_3584.question: What should the receiving entity do with the Cause IE when the functional handling of the Cause IE is not specified in the service description?
q_3584.ground_truth: The receiving entity may ignore the Cause IE when the functional handling of the Cause IE is not specified in the service description.

q_3585.question: What is the requirement for storing EPS security context parameters on the non-volatile memory in the ME together with the IMSI from the USIM?
q_3585.ground_truth: CR~1 states that the EPS security context parameters shall be stored on the non-volatile memory in the ME together with the IMSI from the USIM if the corresponding file to store EPS security context parameters is not present on the USIM.

q_3586.question: What is the mean capacity performance of FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for CG traffic model, 30Mbps, with MU-MIMO and 32 TxRU BS antenna?

q_3587.question: In what occasions is the SGSN-MSC/VLR association removed?
q_3587.ground_truth: The SGSN-MSC/VLR association is removed at IMSI detach, GPRS detach, SGs association establishment, and when the MSC/VLR receives an LA update via the A or Iu interface from an MS or establishes a SGs association with an MME for which a Gs association exists for that MS.

q_3588.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TS 24.010 standard in relation to the MultiParty supplementary service?
q_3588.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 24.010 outlines the general aspects of specifying supplementary services at the layer 3 radio interface.

q_3589.question: What is the role of the HO Parameter Optimization Monitor Function in the eNodeB?
q_3589.ground_truth: The HO Parameter Optimization Monitor Function is used for monitoring the handover parameter optimization in the eNodeB.

q_3590.question: What string is added to the "User-Agent" HTTP header at step 2 in the procedures of solution 6.24.2.2.1?

q_3591.question: What must the GUP server do if the application indicates that it can support the Redirect mode?
q_3591.ground_truth: The GUP server will respond to the application with reference(s) to the GUP data repositories and additionally authorization credentials with limited lifetime, allowing the application to access the GUP data repositories by means of the Rp reference point.

q_3592.question: How many different frequency granularities are supported for CSI reporting for a component carrier?
q_3592.ground_truth: Three different frequency granularities are supported: wideband CSI, partial band CSI, and subband CSI.

q_3593.question: What is the trigger for telling the EGAN access mode switch to start sending user plane data to the GPRS layers in PDP context activation on the GERAN/UTRAN side?
q_3593.ground_truth: The MA-SM layer decides that the GPRS side has the active PDP context for the session.

q_3594.question: What does a conforming 3GPP SMIL user agent need to recognize in order to be considered conforming?
q_3594.ground_truth: A conforming 3GPP SMIL user agent needs to recognize the URIs of all included SMIL 2.0 modules, as well as the URIs referring to all modules and semantics of specific versions of the 3GPP SMIL profile defined in releases 4, 5, and 6.

q_3595.question: What octet limit is specified for the payload of a cell broadcast message, and how does it compare to the maximum payload length of 2048 bytes?
q_3595.ground_truth: The octet limit for the payload of a cell broadcast message is 1230 octets, which is lower than the specified maximum payload length of 2048 bytes. However, it is not specified how 2048 octets can be encoded in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN IE.

q_3596.question: What is the difference between large scale calibration and full calibration in the context of the channel model?
q_3596.ground_truth: Large scale calibration does not model fast fading, while full calibration includes the modeling of fast fading.

q_3597.question: What message does the SRNC send to the UE when setting up a radio access bearer, and what parameters does it include?
q_3597.ground_truth: The SRNC sends the RRC message Radio Bearer Setup to the UE, and it includes the Transport Format Set and Transport Format Combination Set.

q_3598.question: What should the MAC entity do if the first successfully received Random Access Response contains a C-RNTI MAC CE for the subsequent uplink transmission?
q_3598.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate the preambleReceivedTargetPower and the amount of power ramping applied to the latest Random Access Preamble transmission to lower layers, and process the received UL grant value and indicate it to the lower layers.

q_3599.question: What protocols are used in the control plane of GERAN when connected to a packet switched core network domain?
q_3599.ground_truth: The Iu-ps protocol stack is used in the control plane of GERAN when connected to a packet switched core network domain, as inherited from UMTS specifications. The GERAN expects more transport layer options than ATM. RRC uses the services of LAPDm only on broadcast control channels.

q_3600.question: What is the device identity for the destination device in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: RECEIVE DATA" commands with a command number of 1.3.5, 1.3.6, and 1.3.7?
q_3600.ground_truth: The destination device in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: RECEIVE DATA" commands with a command number of 1.3.5, 1.3.6, and 1.3.7 is Channel 1.

q_3601.question: What is the maximum allowed level of Macro eNodeB for protecting the receivers of other BSs from desensitisation?
q_3601.ground_truth: The maximum allowed level of Macro eNodeB for protecting the receivers of other BSs from desensitisation is -96~dBm with 100kHz bandwidth.

q_3602.question: What are the two main structures of protocols over Uu and Iu interfaces in UMTS?
q_3602.ground_truth: User plane protocols and control plane protocols

q_3603.question: What is the maximum allowable number of hops a relay UE can have in PR 5.1.6-5a?
q_3603.ground_truth: The maximum allowable number of hops for relaying traffic for other UEs is defined by network operator's authorization.

q_3604.question: In what situation will the HSS set the registration state of the Public User Identity to Not Registered and clear the S-CSCF name associated with it, if the Public User Identity is registered with only one Private User Identity?
q_3604.ground_truth: When the Public User Identity is currently registered with only one Private User Identity and the HSS receives a request for administrative deregistration.

q_3605.question: What is the purpose of adding a Record-Route header field in the INVITE request?
q_3605.ground_truth: The purpose of adding a Record-Route header field in the INVITE request is to include all entries included in the received INVITE request plus an entry of the incoming IBCF-hA2.

q_3606.question: What is the function of the USF (Uplink State Flag) in the downlink PDCH?
q_3606.ground_truth: The USF is used by the network to control the multiplexing of different mobile stations and TBFs on an uplink PDCH.

q_3607.question: What is the role of the viewport feedback triggering threshold?
q_3607.ground_truth: The viewport feedback triggering threshold is used to determine when the ITT4RT-Tx client should update the high-quality region (viewport and viewport margin) based on the viewport margins and the threshold value.

q_3608.question: What should be the USS/SS parameters on BCCH for a Terminal accessing UTRAN or GERAN in testing?
q_3608.ground_truth: The USS/SS parameters on BCCH for a Terminal accessing UTRAN or GERAN in testing are: Attach/detach: disabled, LAI (MCC/MNC/LAC): 246/081/0001, and Access control: unrestricted.

q_3609.question: When can the MT be attached or detached to the Packet Domain network?
q_3609.ground_truth: The MT may be attached and detached using the +CGATT command. However, it may not be necessary to use the command since attachment may occur on power up or reset, when an attempt is made to activate a context, or when the mobile class is changed. Detachment may occur as a result of a PDP termination procedure or when the mobile class is changed.

q_3610.question: What technique is used to determine the cut-off frequency for the temporal contribution in 6.8.1.4.2.3.1?
q_3610.ground_truth: The cut-off frequency is determined by keeping at least the lower frequencies of the temporal contribution based on the pitch value, with a minimum of 1.2 kHz, and up to the 8th harmonic.

q_3611.question: What is the challenge in setting handover thresholds for eNB in the context of VoLTE connections?
q_3611.ground_truth: The challenge is to ensure that the end-to-end error rate across the transport path from the media sender to a media receiver does not exceed the maximum packet loss that the codec, the PLC implementation, and the JBM implementation in the receiving UE can handle.

q_3612.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives an RLC/MAC control message with a different downlink Coverage Class than what is assigned to it?
q_3612.ground_truth: The mobile station should accept the RLC/MAC control message even if the Coverage Class is different, but may use the Coverage Class information to avoid listening to the EC-PDTCH/EC-PACCH during transmissions for a higher Coverage Class to another mobile station.

q_3613.question: What functions are provided by the SCC AS in IMS Service Centralization and Continuity?
q_3613.ground_truth: The SCC AS provides SIP UA behaviour on behalf of the UE for setup and control of IMS sessions using CS bearers, processes SIP signalling for interworking with other IMS functional elements, and influences the selection of an access network for delivery of incoming sessions to the UE.

q_3614.question: What information does the PCRF provide upon the initial interaction with the TDF that controls TDF behavior regarding online and offline charging?
q_3614.ground_truth: The PCRF provides Charging Characteristics to the TDF, defining how to control TDF behavior regarding online and offline charging.

q_3615.question: In EC, what algorithm is used to classify the excitation?
q_3615.ground_truth: The algorithm is based on the frequency content of the input signal using the VAD algorithm filter bank to analyze the energy levels in each band.

q_3616.question: What triggers the sending of an XON message by the MS?
q_3616.ground_truth: The MS sends an XON message when it is ready to receive frames.

q_3617.question: What is the default bearer type specified in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL" for the first sequence?
q_3617.ground_truth: The default bearer type specified in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL" for the first sequence is the default bearer for the requested transport layer.

q_3618.question: What is the effect of including the Content-Version AVP in the QoS-Rule-Definition AVP when a QoS rule is installed or modified?
q_3618.ground_truth: Including the Content-Version AVP indicates the version of the QoS rule that is installed or modified, allowing the PCRF and BBERF to keep track of changes to the QoS rule.

q_3619.question: What is the RIM Protocol Version Number Information Element used for in the Radio Access Network?
q_3619.ground_truth: The RIM Protocol Version Number IE indicates the version of the RIM protocol used in the BSS that issued the PDU. If this Information Element is omitted, the receiving BSS should behave the same as if the value of the RIM Protocol Version Number IE was "Version 1". The RIM Protocol Version Number IE can be used to determine the protocol version of the receiving BSS and to ensure backward compatibility.

q_3620.question: What is the role of the Multipath Fading Simulators (MFS) in this process?
q_3620.ground_truth: The Multipath Fading Simulators (MFS) are used to simulate multipath fading conditions in this process.

q_3621.question: Which identity should be used for interception in the S-GW and PDN-GW: IMSI or NAI?
q_3621.ground_truth: The note recommends using IMSI as it may be a temporary ID, but NAI can also be used.

q_3622.question: What measures can a network operator use to protect against Unsolicited Communications (UC) in the absence of sender identity verification in IMS?
q_3622.ground_truth: Measures such as DoS protection mechanisms, content filtering mechanisms, and "Restricted Sending" mechanisms for Messagas over IP can be used.

q_3623.question: What is the GGSN responsible for when performing interception of content of communications as a national option?
q_3623.ground_truth: The GGSN is responsible for continuing to report interception of specific events (such as PDP context activation, deactivation, modification, etc.) when it is performing interception of the content of communications.

q_3624.question: What is the difference in sensitivity and specificity between WL and BL in the context of SS (CI) and SS?
q_3624.ground_truth: In the context of SS (CI), sensitivity and specificity (false acceptance, false rejection) are issues and scores are evaluated that provide a certain SPIT/UC probability. In contrast, for SS, sensitivity and specificity (false acceptance, false rejection) are not issues for WL, but for BL, the protection of SS depends on unambiguously identified UC sources, and hence, the possibility of erroneous actions exists.

q_3625.question: What is the measurement period for intra frequency Timeslot ISCP measurements on arbitrary DL timeslots, including Beacon timeslots?
q_3625.ground_truth: The measurement period for intra frequency Timeslot ISCP measurements on arbitrary DL timeslots, including Beacon timeslots is 400 ms.

q_3626.question: What is the role of the RAN in enforcing the UE AMBR?
q_3626.ground_truth: The RAN enforces the UE AMBR in uplink and downlink, limiting the overall bit rate a UE can experience.

q_3627.question: What is the biggest challenge in blind modulation detection?
q_3627.ground_truth: The biggest challenge in blind modulation detection is not to detect the modulation of a 16QAM or 32QAM modulated radio block, but to correctly detect the modulation of a robustly encoded GMSK modulated radio block, which is typically used in the worst radio conditions.

q_3628.question: What should the UE do with the V2X message when it contains non-IP data before passing it to the lower layers for transmission?
q_3628.ground_truth: The UE should include an indication to set the non-IP type field of the non-IP type PDU to the value corresponding to the V2X message family used by the V2X service as indicated by upper layers.

q_3629.question: What is the purpose of the RPTA Integration Reference Point (IRP) as specified in the document?
q_3629.ground_truth: The RPTA Integration Reference Point (IRP) allows the Network Manager (NM) to read site and antenna data from RPTs.

q_3630.question: What entity in the CAMEL architecture receives an O/D/T-CSI from the HLR indicating to request instructions from the gsmSSF for calls requiring CAMEL support?

q_3631.question: Will the contents of the 3GPP technical specification document be subject to change following TSG approval?
q_3631.ground_truth: Yes, the contents of the 3GPP technical specification document may change following TSG approval, as it is a living document under continuous development.

q_3632.question: What is the procedure for sending network information from the 5G Node to the EAS using the User Plane?
q_3632.ground_truth: The procedure involves the EAS including the Network Information Provisioning (NIP) request in the Option field of the DL IP/TCP header or generating an ICMP ECHO packet with the request in the data field. The 5G Node then checks the packet and forwards it to the Application if it is a valid request. If the 5G Node decides to provide NI to the EAS, it can generate an ICMP ECHO with the provided NI in the data field and send it to the EAS.

q_3633.question: What message is sent by the mobile station to the GANC to initiate downlink flow control?
q_3633.ground_truth: The mobile station sends a GA-PSR FC REQ message to the GANC to initiate downlink flow control.

q_3634.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption time for inter-frequency measurements in FDD for measuring known FDD inter-frequency neighbors?

q_3635.question: What is the role of the Mobile Station in automatic answering or called-party pre-emption for point-to-point calls?
q_3635.ground_truth: If the user is in idle mode, the Mobile Station automatically connects to an incoming call of a sufficient priority level. In dedicated mode with Call Waiting, the Mobile Station gives a Call Waiting indication with the priority level of the call, automatically accepting the waiting call. There is no called party pre-emption for point-to-point calls without Call Waiting.

q_3636.question: What is the purpose of the "SM.NbrActPdpCtxt.Apn.Bgrd" counter in a GGSN?
q_3636.ground_truth: The "SM.NbrActPdpCtxt.Apn.Bgrd" counter provides the number of simultaneous active sessions with background priority, per APN in a GGSN.

q_3637.question: What should the MS be able to read after detecting the legacy stealing flags set to indicate CS1 in case of GMSK modulation?
q_3637.ground_truth: The MS should be able to read distribution messages that are CS1-coded.

q_3638.question: What is the Broadcast Call Control (BCC) protocol used for in the context of the Voice Broadcast Call Service (VBCS)?
q_3638.ground_truth: The BCC protocol is used to control the establishment, maintenance, and release of broadcast calls within the VBCS on the radio interface.

q_3639.question: Who are the potential roles involved in non-public networks (NPNs) as defined in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_3639.ground_truth: The potential roles involved in non-public networks (NPNs) as defined in the 3GPP technical specification are NPN operator, NPN service provider, and NPN service customer.

q_3640.question: On which channel(s) should a mobile station read paging messages during an MBMS session?
q_3640.ground_truth: The mobile station reads paging messages from the (P)CCCH unless the network has indicated that paging messages are sent on the PACCH of the MBMS radio bearer, and the mobile station has received an MS_ID.

q_3641.question: What message does the PGW-U send to the PGW-C in step 16b?
q_3641.ground_truth: The PGW-U sends "Sx session modification response" message to the PGW-C.

q_3642.question: What information does the MAG need to include in the PDN Connection Creation procedure or Handover procedure when supporting multiple PDN connections to the same APN for the S2a/S2b reference points?
q_3642.ground_truth: The MAG needs to provide the PDN connection ID, which is unique per MN-ID per APN.

q_3643.question: What is the hysteresis parameter for event 3d in inter-RAT measurements?
q_3643.ground_truth: The hysteresis parameter for event 3d in inter-RAT measurements is H3d.

q_3644.question: What happens to the active PDP context if the MS initiates the deactivation procedure?
q_3644.ground_truth: The active PDP context is moved to INACTIVE state.

q_3645.question: What operation is not impacted by the compressed mode in the radio frames that do not overlap an uplink compressed mode transmission gap?

q_3646.question: What is the maximum accepted test system uncertainty for OTA co-location spurious emissions measurements in General Chamber under normal test conditions (FR1)?
q_3646.ground_truth: The maximum accepted test system uncertainty for OTA co-location spurious emissions measurements in General Chamber under normal test conditions (FR1) is derived based on test system specific values in clause~13.3.2.

q_3647.question: How is a Management Information Base (MIB) defined in the present document?
q_3647.ground_truth: A MIB is an instance of an NRM and has some values on the defined attributes and associations specific for that instance. It includes a Name Space, a number of Managed Objects with their attributes, and a number of Associations between these MOs.

q_3648.question: How does the NF determine which profiles need synchronization when it receives a "UDR recovery message"?
q_3648.ground_truth: The NF identifies profiles requiring synchronization by checking if the impacted resource names in the scope match a profile and if the last synchronization time of the profile falls within the period between partialLastReplicationTime and partialRecoveryTime.

q_3649.question: What is the purpose of the Relay UE initiating a re-key procedure over the PC5 link with the Remote UE?
q_3649.ground_truth: The Relay UE initiates a re-key procedure over the PC5 link with the Remote UE to generate fresh new Krelay-session, Krelay-enc, Krelay-int after a successful re-authentication/authorization of the Remote UE.

q_3650.question: What is the purpose of the ID id-MIMO-withfourtransmitantennas-ModeIndicator in the HS-DSCH-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify-ExtIEs?
q_3650.ground_truth: The ID id-MIMO-withfourtransmitantennas-ModeIndicator in the HS-DSCH-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify-ExtIEs is a protocol extension

q_3651.question: What is the purpose of the DayOfWeek leaf in an ISMP rule?
q_3651.ground_truth: The DayOfWeek leaf in an ISMP rule indicates the day(s) of the week for which the corresponding rule is valid. The value of this leaf is an 8-bit integer formatted as a bit map representing days of the week. If the bit corresponding to a day of the week is set, the rule is valid on that day.

q_3652.question: How does the Disaster Roaming PLMN AMF handle notifying Disaster Inbound Roamers that the Disaster Condition is no longer applicable?
q_3652.ground_truth: When the Disaster Roaming PLMN AMF is notified that the Disaster Condition is no longer applicable for Disaster Inbound Roamers, it initiates a network-initiated de-registration procedure to minimize service interruption.

q_3653.question: What action should the Node B take upon receiving a DEDICATED MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message with a specific Node B Communication Context ID IE set to "All NBCC"?
q_3653.ground_truth: The Node B shall apply the measurement request to all current and future Node B Communication Contexts controlled via the Communication Control Port on which the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message was received.

q_3654.question: How should 3GPP networks protect the interface between SCEF and SCS/AS?
q_3654.ground_truth: Integrity protection, replay protection, confidentiality protection, privacy protection, mutual authentication, and authorization (per UE or per service per UE) should be implemented for SCEF - SCS/AS communication to ensure the security of 3GPP networks.

q_3655.question: What are the possible types of UAS UEs?
q_3655.ground_truth: The UAS UEs, UAS UE1, and UAS UE2 may be a UAV-Controller or a UAV.

q_3656.question: What type of speech sentence pair is recommended for consistency in comparing P.863 scores across different laboratories?
q_3656.ground_truth: A fullband speech sentence pair from ITU-T Recommendation P.501 Annex D, with American English samples, is recommended.

q_3657.question: Which two Solution Sets are defined in the 3GPP TS 28.673 V14.0.x specification?
q_3657.ground_truth: The two Solution Sets defined in the 3GPP TS 28.673 V14.0.x specification are the 3GPP HNS NRM IRP CORBA SS and the 3GPP HNS NRM IRP XML Definitions.

q_3658.question: What is the significance of Id and criticality fields in the context of the PCAP protocol?
q_3658.ground_truth: The Id and criticality fields ensure forwards and backwards compatibility of the protocol. These fields are coded in a standard format that will not be changed in the future, and can always be decoded regardless of the standard version.

q_3659.question: What is the limitation on the length of the signature and related security parameters in ETWS Primary Notifications if ETWS Primary Notifications over GERAN are supported?
q_3659.ground_truth: If ETWS Primary Notifications over GERAN are supported, the total length of the signature and related security parameters cannot exceed 75 bytes.

q_3660.question: What are the two main requirements for IoT tracking solution in the assets tracking domain?
q_3660.ground_truth: The two main requirements for IoT tracking solution are: (1) coverage, which includes support for indoor, urban, rural, harsh environments, and metallic obstructions, and (2) battery consumption efficiency, designed to last for 15 years without battery replacement.

q_3661.question: What is the role of the Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT) proforma in the document?
q_3661.ground_truth: The Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT) proforma is a document in the form of a questionnaire that, when completed for a User Equipment (UE), becomes an IXIT. It contains all the information related to the UE and its testing environment required to run an appropriate test suite against the UE.

q_3662.question: When is there no need for rekeying procedure during handover in mobility usecase?
q_3662.ground_truth: When the SMF distributes the same rekeying token to all RANs, there is no need for rekeying procedure during handover in mobility usecase.

q_3663.question: What is the role of the DeliveredAlternatives SAND message in a DASH-based streaming system?
q_3663.ground_truth: The DeliveredAlternatives SAND message is used as a response to an AcceptedAlternatives message sent by a DASH client, where a DANE may deliver an alternative segment rather than the requested segment.

q_3664.question: What should be inserted into the list of the MCData user information entries of the served MCData group information entry if the MCData user information entry does not exist?
q_3664.ground_truth: An MCData user information entry with the MCData ID set to the handled MCData ID.

q_3665.question: What is the purpose of the DTM Handover procedure?
q_3665.ground_truth: The purpose of the DTM Handover procedure is to handover the dedicated channel and packet resources while in dual transfer mode when a cell is changed, allowing for intercell change of dedicated and packet data channel(s).

q_3666.question: What is the test level for fast transients common mode test for signal ports, telecommunication ports, and control ports?
q_3666.ground_truth: The test level for fast transients common mode test for signal ports, telecommunication ports, and control ports is 0.5 kV open circuit voltage as given in IEC 61000-4-4.

q_3667.question: What is the significance of the "Latitude" and "Longitude" leaves in the context of defining the geographical coordinates of a polygon geographical area for ProSe direct discovery when the UE is not served by E-UTRAN?
q_3667.ground_truth: The "Latitude" leaf contains the latitude of a geographical coordinate outlining the border of the polygon geographical area, while the "Longitude" leaf contains the longitude of a geographical coordinate outlining the border of the polygon geographical area. These values are used to define the geographical area where the UE can perform ProSe direct discovery.

q_3668.question: What functionality should the MBMS client support to provide a valid HLS Media Presentation?
q_3668.ground_truth: If the MBMS client supports the HLS Server functionalities, the MBMS client shall support sufficient functionalities to provide a valid HLS Media Presentation. This may include rewriting the Master Playlist and the Media Playlist to provide a valid service based on the data received.

q_3669.question: What were the EVS-WB bit rates used in the NTIA report?
q_3669.ground_truth: The EVS-WB bit rates used in the NTIA report were 6.6kbps, 8.8kbps, 12.65kbps, and 23.85kbps with DTX/CNG enabled and at a lower bit rate than AMR-WB.

q_3670.question: What is the smallest threshold for the number of allocated bits for each of the 3 sub-band groups?
q_3670.ground_truth: The smallest threshold for the number of allocated bits for each of the 3 sub-band groups are 5, 6, and 7.

q_3671.question: What action does the PGW-C request from the PGW-U in the "GGSN Initiated PDP Context Deactivation Procedure"?
q_3671.ground_truth: In the "GGSN Initiated PDP Context Deactivation Procedure", the PGW-C requests the PGW-U to stop counting and stop forwarding packets for the affected bearers.

q_3672.question: How does glottal pulse resynchronization correct the difference between the target transmitted position of the last glottal pulse and its actual position in the concealed adaptive codebook excitation signal?
q_3672.ground_truth: By searching for the pulse closest to the actual pulse, finding the error in pulse position, and performing glottal pulse resynchronization by inserting or removing samples around a determined position based on the error in pulse position. The resynchronization is performed only if and, where is the absolute difference between the decoded pulse position and the pitch lag of the first subframe in the future frame. The samples to be added or deleted are distributed across the different pitch cycles in the frame, with the minimum energy regions being determined by computing the energy using a sliding 5-sample window. The minimum energy position is set at the middle of the window at which the energy is at a minimum. The search performed between two pitch pulses is restricted between and, where and are the pitch pulses in the frame. The samples to be added or deleted are distributed based on the number of pulses to be removed/added and the number of minimum energy regions. Removing samples is straightforward, while adding samples is performed by copying the last samples after dividing by 20 and inverting the sign. Using this procedure, the last maximum pulse in the concealed adaptive codebook excitation is forced to be aligned with the actual maximum pulse position at the end of the adaptive codebook frame which is transmitted in the current frame.

q_3673.question: What is the result of maintaining transcoder resources in the BSS when TrFO operation is not possible/desirable?
q_3673.ground_truth: It does not allow exploiting a 3G-like architecture.

q_3674.question: What is the procedure for the test described in section 5.3.12.4.2?
q_3674.ground_truth: The procedure for the test described in section 5.3.12.4.2 involves powering on the UE, sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST to the NG-SS with the 5GS registration type IE as "initial registration" and 5GS mobile identity information element type as "SUCI", sending a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with a 5G-GUTI, and sending a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the NG-SS.

q_3675.question: What entity plays the central role during the observation phase, the analytics phase, and the decision phase in Potential Solution #1?
q_3675.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system, in particular the MDAF.

q_3676.question: What is the effect of an old SGSN storing New SGSN Address in its context during a combined RA/LA update?
q_3676.ground_truth: It allows the old SGSN to forward data packets to the new SGSN when the old MM context is cancelled.

q_3677.question: What is the measurement described in 5.2.4.6, "Successful outgoing initial UP on the Iu interface" related to?
q_3677.ground_truth: This measurement provides the successful outgoing initialization of UP on the Iu interface for GSM/UMTS networks, specifically for circuit switched traffic.

q_3678.question: What is the primary cause of the challenges associated with the expiry of MAC timers in NR NTN and IoT NTN?
q_3678.ground_truth: The high Round Trip Time (RTT) in NTN is the primary cause of these challenges.

q_3679.question: When is access to the CTS-FP allowed for any enrolled CTS-MS?
q_3679.ground_truth: Access to the CTS-FP is allowed for any enrolled CTS-MS when the CTSBCH status field indicates idle.

q_3680.question: What protocol does the IMS-ALG provide to the IMS-AGW as "MSRP Path" in SIP/SDP signalling?

q_3681.question: In what scenarios does the initial direct transfer procedure occur in the UE for signalling connection establishment?
q_3681.ground_truth: The initial direct transfer procedure is initiated when the upper layers request the establishment of a signalling connection and for carrying an initial upper layer (NAS) message.

q_3682.question: What should the DRNS do when the Diversity Control Field IE is set to ``Must'' in the FDD scenario?
q_3682.ground_truth: The DRNS shall combine the RL with one of the other RLs.

q_3683.question: What are the two sub-classes of immediate messaging?
q_3683.ground_truth: The two sub-classes of immediate messaging are sessions where the user can both send and receive messages without any prior actions, and sessions where the user may be required to join a messaging session before the message exchange can take place.

q_3684.question: When does interception of IMS conference services begin if the target of interception has requested a conference to be created?
q_3684.ground_truth: Interception of IMS conference services begins regardless of whether the target of interception has joined the conference if the target has provisioned or requested a conference to be created.

q_3685.question: What kind of measurements are provided in subclause 4.9 of the TS 25.423 and TS 25.433?
q_3685.ground_truth: The following measurements are provided in subclause 4.9 of the TS 25.423 and TS 25.433: Radio Link Setup (NBAP), Radio Link Addition (NBAP), Radio Link Deletion (NBAP), Radio Link Setup (RNSAP), Radio Link Addition (RNSAP), and Radio Link Deletion (RNSAP).

q_3686.question: What is the order of the active PDP contexts in the SGSN Context Response if the PDP Context Prioritization IE is included?
q_3686.ground_truth: The active PDP contexts are included in an implementation dependant prioritized order, and the most important PDP context is placed first.

q_3687.question: What is the role of the Application Layer Group ID in ProSe Direct Communication?
q_3687.ground_truth: The Application Layer Group ID identifies an application layer group that the UE belongs to and is used in ProSe Direct Communication to enable one-to-one, one-to-many, or ProSe UE-to-Network Relaying communication. This ID is one of the parameters that need to be provisioned to the UE for ProSe Direct Communication.

q_3688.question: What is the E-UTRAN and NB-IoT tracking area code (TAC) and NG-SS cell identity for cell 1 and cell 2?
q_3688.ground_truth: For cell 1, TAC for E-UTRAN is 0001, NB-IoT TAC is 0001, and NG-SS cell ID is 0001 (36 bits). For cell 2, TAC for E-UTRAN is 0002 and NB-IoT TAC is also 0002. NG-SS cell ID for cell 1 is 0001 (36 bits) and for cell 2 is 0002 (36 bits).

q_3689.question: What is the coupling loss between a Repeater and a UTRA TDD BS receiver that the 73 dB coupling loss requirement is based on?

q_3690.question: What is the interface standardized in the 3GPP TS 36.411 specification?
q_3690.ground_truth: The S1 interface between the eNB and the E-UTRAN core network.

q_3691.question: What action does the 5GC take when it receives a Path Switch Request message from the target NG-RAN node during handover, and the source NG-RAN node supports MBS?
q_3691.ground_truth: The 5GC infers the delivery method (i.e. shared or individual MBS traffic delivery) for MBS data transferring based on the information received in the N2 SM information from the SMF.

q_3692.question: What does the mobile station do when it receives an ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message with a description of a channel to be used after an indicated time?
q_3692.ground_truth: The mobile station shall wait up to the starting time before accessing the channel if the ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message received contains only the description of a channel to be used after the starting time. If the starting time has already elapsed, the mobile shall access the channel as an immediate reaction to the reception of the message.

q_3693.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 38.412, what is the role of the Controlling RNC?
q_3693.ground_truth: The Controlling RNC is an RNC that controls the use and integrity of the radio resources for a specific set of Node B's, with only one Controlling RNC for any Node B.

q_3694.question: What does the MAC entity do when it receives a retransmission and the data has not been successfully decoded?
q_3694.ground_truth: The MAC entity combines the received data with the data currently in the soft buffer for this TB and attempts to decode the combined data.

q_3695.question: What is the Selected Codec if the multimedia BC-IE is the first BC-IE and the speech BC-IE is the second BC-IE in the SETUP message?
q_3695.ground_truth: The Selected Codec is the 3G-324.M codec if the multimedia BC-IE is the first BC-IE and the speech BC-IE is the second BC-IE in the SETUP message.

q_3696.question: What is the difference between "High-CL Relay" and "Low-CL Relay" in 3GPP E-UTRA?
q_3696.ground_truth: "High-CL Relay" is characterized by requirements derived from outdoor relay scenarios with a minimum coupling loss of 59 dB, while "Low-CL Relay" is characterized by requirements derived from indoor relay scenarios with a minimum coupling loss of 45 dB.

q_3697.question: What is one of the advantages of an OFDM/SC-FDMA based system like E-UTRAN?
q_3697.ground_truth: One of the advantages is that it allows for implementation of a lower complexity receiver at wider bandwidths.

q_3698.question: What command is used in this test to verify that the ME uses the FETCH command to obtain the proactive UICC command?
q_3698.ground_truth: The MORE TIME proactive command is used in this test.

q_3699.question: What is the primary purpose of the Download Delivery Method in MBMS?
q_3699.ground_truth: The MBMS Download Delivery Method allows the error-free transmission of files via unidirectional MBMS Bearer Services. The files are downloaded and stored in the local files-system of the user equipment.

q_3700.question: What should the NAS do when the UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode, has received a request from the upper layers for an access attempt, and has been informed by the lower layers that the access attempt is allowed?
q_3700.ground_truth: The NAS shall initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt if allowed.

q_3701.question: What conformance requirement specifies that the ME shall calculate the SUCI using the null-scheme if no Protection Scheme Identifier is provisioned in the USIM?

q_3702.question: In the scenario described, what is the network type used by UE1 to communicate with UE2 that uses MSGin5G service and is 5GMSG transport capable?
q_3702.ground_truth: UE1 communicates with UE2 using the 5G system and MSGin5G service.

q_3703.question: What is the purpose of the TDD intra-frequency RSTD Measurement Accuracy test in CE Mode A for Category M1?
q_3703.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the RSTD measurement accuracy for UE Category M1 is within the specified limits in normal coverage mode in an environment with fading propagation conditions.

q_3704.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects in the context of Telecommunication management and the Transport Network (TN) interface?
q_3704.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects is responsible for creating technical specifications related to Telecommunication management and the Transport Network interface, including the Network Resource Model (NRM) and Integration Reference Point (IRP) components.

q_3705.question: What is the name of the interference signal that is simulated in the measurement setup using a separate signal generator?
q_3705.ground_truth: The interference signal is generated using a separate signal generator to simulate the interference signal from the other antenna.

q_3706.question: What is the meaning of the "Information Transfer Mode" attribute in the minimal set of attributes for Bearer Services?
q_3706.ground_truth: The "Information Transfer Mode" attribute in the minimal set of attributes for Bearer Services has the value "Circuit", indicating that the information transfer is circuit-switched.

q_3707.question: What is the purpose of keeping track of the receiver buffer status through OBSN reports?
q_3707.ground_truth: The purpose of keeping track of the receiver buffer status through OBSN reports is to avoid underflow and overflow of the receiver buffer.

q_3708.question: What action does the IP-SM-GW take when it decides to perform service-level interworking of an Instant Message from a UE with an SMS user?
q_3708.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW translates the Instant Message to a Short Message carrying the SMS-SC address, and then forwards it towards the SMS-SC via the SMS-IWMSC. If the Instant Message size is larger than one Short Message, the IP-SM-GW splits the content into several parts and forwards them as concatenated Short Messages.

q_3709.question: What should the SMF include in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message if it decides to establish a single access PDU session for a MA PDU session with the network upgrade allowed?
q_3709.ground_truth: The SMF shall not include the ATSSS container IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message in this case.

q_3710.question: What message overrides a broadcast PSI5 message when the network sends the PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER message in an assigned downlink block?
q_3710.ground_truth: The PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER message itself

q_3711.question: What is the DAC (Digital-to-Analog Converter) requirement for implementing DSR (Dual Symbol Rate) in a mobile station?
q_3711.ground_truth: The DAC would have to run at a higher sampling rate which would require a wider filter after the DAC, thus increasing the Tx noise power.

q_3712.question: What is the purpose of the Ndata,j in the CCTrCH?
q_3712.ground_truth: Ndata,j is the total number of bits that are available for the CCTrCH in a radio frame with transport format combination j.

q_3713.question: What information shall the BM-SC send to the GCS AS in case of an expiring TMGI at timer expiry?
q_3713.ground_truth: The BM-SC shall notify the GCS AS by sending a GCS-Notification-Request (GNR) command including one TMGI-Expiry AVP in case of an expiring TMGI at timer expiry. If there are active MBMS bearer(s) related to an expiring TMGI, the BM-SC shall terminate those bearer(s) and shall notify the GCS AS about the bearer termination by including MBMS-Bearer-Event-Notification AVP(s) in the GNR in accordance with the MBMS Bearer Status Indication Procedure in clause 5.3.5.

q_3714.question: What is the purpose of the tonality flag in the described concealment method?
q_3714.ground_truth: The tonality flag is used to indicate the type of the current frame and to determine the concealment method to be used in the decoder.

q_3715.question: What is the role of the "packages" attribute in the PLMN performance measurement system?
q_3715.ground_truth: The "packages" attribute is used to inquire the measurement types supported by a "measurementFunction" object from the system in the PLMN performance measurement system.

q_3716.question: What should the MS do when receiving an unknown or unforeseen transaction identifier with COMM=T?
q_3716.ground_truth: The MS should answer with a STATUS message with same TI value, cause "invalid transaction identifier value", and including, if possible, as diagnostics the complete message received.

q_3717.question: What is the purpose of the "PDP-Identifier" field in the "PDPContext" definition?
q_3717.ground_truth: The "PDP-Identifier" field in the "PDPContext" definition is used to identify a specific PDP Context within a control relationship between gprsSSF and gsmSCF.

q_3718.question: What does the RRCConnectionSetup-v4b0ext-IEs sequence contain?
q_3718.ground_truth: The RRCConnectionSetup-v4b0ext-IEs sequence contains the CapabilityUpdateRequirement-r4-ext and CellIdentity-PerRL-List parameters.

q_3719.question: What should the SCC AS do upon sending a SIP re-INVITE request toward the CS domain and receiving a SDP offer from the CS domain in response?
q_3719.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send an initial SIP INVITE request toward the remote UE, including the information from the SDP offer received from the CS domain.

q_3720.question: What should an AIPN provide to support multi-access within the same coverage area?
q_3720.ground_truth: Support for appropriate handover between access systems, reachability over multiple access systems, access system-aware services, and optionally simultaneous multi-access.

q_3721.question: What is the role of the midamble allocation scheme flag in the HS-SCCH type 4 information field mapping?
q_3721.ground_truth: The midamble allocation scheme flag decides the mapping of the channelisation code set information in HS-SCCH type 4 information field mapping.

q_3722.question: What should be considered when evaluating the reaction time of the eNB to requests from the UE in terms of processing time?
q_3722.ground_truth: A minimum of 100ms processing time should be considered, along with possible pre-emption by more critical eNB processing such as handovers.

q_3723.question: What should the VLR or SGSN do if the HLR detects missing mandatory parameters during a dialogue?
q_3723.ground_truth: The VLR or SGSN can either reject all messages with missing mandatory parameters, or accept all messages and check for missing parameters after the dialogue has ended.

q_3724.question: What is the role of the MME when mapping an EPS bearer to an E-RAB on the S1 interface?
q_3724.ground_truth: The MME needs to repeat the UP IP policy on the S1 interface for each EPS bearer established for the same PDN connection.

q_3725.question: How many frames does it take before pnup reaches 0, signaling the subsequent logic that background noise energy can be updated, if it is not incremented in any of the conditions from the above diagram?
q_3725.ground_truth: It takes at least 6 frames before pnup reaches 0.

q_3726.question: What is the requirement specified in TS 33.203 clause 7.4.0 for an S-CSCF when receiving an unprotected REGISTER message from the UE?
q_3726.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall authenticate the user by means of the AKA protocol.

q_3727.question: What should the UTRAN do as soon as possible after CS handover or SR-VCC handover without a simultaneous PS handover is completed?
q_3727.ground_truth: After CS handover or SR-VCC handover without a simultaneous PS handover is completed, the UTRAN should provide the UE with the CN system information of the PS domain as soon as possible.

q_3728.question: What is the TEST REQUIREMENT for Method of Test 10.2 in the USIM Application Toolkit?
q_3728.ground_truth: The TEST REQUIREMENT for Method of Test 10.2 in the USIM Application Toolkit is that the ME shall operate in the manner defined in Expected Sequence 10.1, which involves DISPLAY TEXT for UCS2-coded Katakana characters of Max length.

q_3729.question: What are the two communication paths mentioned for the VR based interactive service?
q_3729.ground_truth: The two communication paths mentioned for the VR based interactive service are the ProSe Communication path (direct) and the 5GC path.

q_3730.question: What actions should the LLE take if timer T100 expires in the XID negotiation procedure?
q_3730.ground_truth: If timer T100 expires, the LLE is allowed to initiate the XID negotiation procedure again.

q_3731.question: What level of horizontal positioning accuracy is achieved by Rel.16 in the UMa scenario without modeling synchronization and gNB/UE TX/RX timing errors?
q_3731.ground_truth: A 10 m level @ 90% of horizontal positioning accuracy is achieved by Rel.16 in the UMa scenario without modeling synchronization and gNB/UE TX/RX timing errors.

q_3732.question: What is the purpose of using the Extended Estimation Window (EEW) in E-RUCCH?
q_3732.ground_truth: The EEW is used to prevent the UE from sending unnecessary E-RUCCH by estimating whether there is a valid Grant before sending Scheduling Information. This is particularly useful in determining if there is a Non-scheduled Grant available in the near future.

q_3733.question: What entities are assumed to have trust in the Control Plane-based onboarding solution?
q_3733.ground_truth: TheDefault Credential Server (DCS), Provisioning Server, O-SNPN, and SO-SNPN are all assumed to have trust in the Control Plane-based onboarding solution.

q_3734.question: What should the UE do if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message includes the horizontal derivation parameter indicating "KAMF derivation is required"?
q_3734.ground_truth: The UE shall derive a new K'AMF as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501 and set both uplink and downlink NAS COUNTs to zero.

q_3735.question: What is the effect of a PDP context deactivation on SNDCP XID negotiation in 3GPP?
q_3735.ground_truth: A PDP context deactivation triggers an SNDCP XID negotiation to remove the NSAPI from the Applicable NSAPIs of the compression entity.

q_3736.question: In what state does a UE consider the current frequency to be the lowest priority, if it only has dedicated priorities other than for the current frequency while in the camped normally state?
q_3736.ground_truth: The current frequency is considered to be the lowest priority frequency for a UE, if it only has dedicated priorities other than for the current frequency while in the camped normally state.

q_3737.question: When is the base layer bitstream obtained via external means in the SHVC architecture?
q_3737.ground_truth: The base layer bitstream is obtained via external means when it is coded using a non-HEVC single-layer codec, or through other system-level multiplexing methods. This is referred to as hybrid codec scalability and allows SHVC to support non-HEVC coded base layer bitstreams.

q_3738.question: In which scenario will the UE consider the ThreshBackhRateULWLANLowRAN node as not matching?
q_3738.ground_truth: The UE will consider the ThreshBackhRateULWLANLowRAN node as not matching if the ThreshBackhRateULWLANLowRAN leaf is present and the ThreshBackhRateULWLANLow threshold value has not been received from E-UTRAN/UTRAN.

q_3739.question: What are the two possible outcomes if a measurement job is not completed and an indication of validity of the result value(s) is required?
q_3739.ground_truth: The two possible outcomes are: the result value(s) are valid or the result value(s) are invalid and an indication of the reason is provided.

q_3740.question: What is the command type used in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE" command with sequence 1.4.1B?
q_3740.ground_truth: The command type used in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE" command with sequence 1.4.1B is "SEND SS".

q_3741.question: What is the purpose of the V2X authorization procedure?
q_3741.ground_truth: The V2X authorization procedure enables the UE to retrieve V2X communication parameters from the V2X control function.

q_3742.question: What network element enforces the APN-AMBR?

q_3743.question: What is used to calculate the spectral sparseness of a frame in this process?
q_3743.ground_truth: The sum of the log energy spectrum is calculated to determine the spectral sparseness of a frame.

q_3744.question: When will the UE initiate a first measurement report when the purpose is set to 'reportStrongestCellsForSON'?
q_3744.ground_truth: The UE initiates a first measurement report when it has determined the strongest cells on the associated frequency.

q_3745.question: What action does the gsmSSF take if there is no gap interval active for call gapping?
q_3745.ground_truth: An "InitialDP" operation may be sent including the "cGEncountered" parameter in accordance with the specified controlType. A new gap interval shall be initiated as indicated by "gapInterval".

q_3746.question: What is the main Phase 2 change request that combined GSM900 and DCS1800 specifications?
q_3746.ground_truth: CR 05.01-04 "Combination of GSM900 and DCS1800 specifications" is the main Phase 2 change request that combined GSM900 and DCS1800 specifications.

q_3747.question: What is the effect of specifying a single address or a range of addresses in the IMS-ALG address filtering request?
q_3747.ground_truth: If a single address or a range of addresses is specified in the IMS-ALG address filtering request, incoming media packets are screened against the specified address(es).

q_3748.question: What protocol is used to transport files in MBMS download?

q_3749.question: What must the UE do if it is authorized to modify the polling interval and/or disable the UICC interface during extended DRX cycle in EFAD in USIM?
q_3749.ground_truth: The UE must not deactivate the UICC in case the ME is not authorized to modify the polling interval and/or disable the UICC interface during extended DRX cycle in EFAD in USIM.

q_3750.question: Which protocol sends timing deviation measurements from Node B to SRNC?
q_3750.ground_truth: Rx Timing Deviation Frame Protocol sends timing deviation measurements from Node B to SRNC.

q_3751.question: What should the SNPN take into account when determining the UP or CP provisioning method?
q_3751.ground_truth: The SNPN should consider UE capabilities, onboarding agreements with the ON, local policy, and in some cases, the UE's preferences.

q_3752.question: What is the average combined visual field for both eyes in the vertical direction and horizontal direction?
q_3752.ground_truth: The average combined visual field for both eyes is around 130-135 degrees vertical and 200 degrees horizontal.

q_3753.question: What possible Cause value indicates that the GTP-MAP protocol-converting GSN accepted the request for a Send Routeing Information for GPRS Response message?

q_3754.question: How does the Peer-to-Peer CoD service help reduce backbone bandwidth consumption and workload on the content source server?
q_3754.ground_truth: The Peer-to-Peer CoD service allows content to be obtained from multiple sources rather than the central source server, reducing the load on the content source server and backbone bandwidth consumption.

q_3755.question: What is the definition of an Outer contiguous allocation in NR intra-band V2X concurrent operation with adjacent channel?
q_3755.ground_truth: An Outer contiguous allocation is not an Inner contiguous allocation.

q_3756.question: What is the purpose of the Warning header field in SIP responses in the interworking procedures?
q_3756.ground_truth: The Warning header field in SIP responses in the interworking procedures is used to convey a free text string describing the warning, such as "user not authorized to transmit data".

q_3757.question: How does the SGSN determine if it is connected to the BSS of the destination cell address?
q_3757.ground_truth: The SGSN determines if it is connected to the BSS of the destination cell address by checking the Routeing Area Identity (MCC+MNC+LAC+RAC) of the destination cell address.

q_3758.question: What is used as the basis for the "Successful incoming CS data calls" measurement?
q_3758.ground_truth: On transmission by the MSC-S of an "ACM" or "CON" message for the CS data service.

q_3759.question: What are the available enablers for access services signalling in a 3GPP environment?
q_3759.ground_truth: 3GP-DASH supports signalling using the Accessibility descriptor and using the MPEG DASH Role scheme.

q_3760.question: How is the high band gain calculated for 23.85 kbit/s mode in the high-band gain generation process?
q_3760.ground_truth: The high band gain is calculated as the ratio of the cross-correlation of the band-pass filtered input speech and high-band speech synthesis to the energy of the band-pass filtered input speech.

q_3761.question: What does the abbreviation E-UTRAN stand for in the context of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_3761.ground_truth: Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network

q_3762.question: What is the condition for performing the intra-row permutation for the i-th row when C is equal to p-1?
q_3762.ground_truth: The intra-row permutation is performed for the i-th row when C is equal to p-1 using the formula found in step (1), where j ranges from 0 to p-2, j is the original bit position of the permuted bit of the i-th row, and the permuted bits are written in the same order as the original bits for the i-th row.

q_3763.question: What type of audio signal is not actively transmitting data when the channel is muted?
q_3763.ground_truth: An active channel may be temporarily muted, where it may be required but the UE is not transmitting any data.

q_3764.question: What is the minimum UE class supporting the combination of UL: 12.2 kbps and DL: 12.2 kbps with CS RAB for DCCH in conversational classes?
q_3764.ground_truth: The minimum UE class supporting this combination is UL: 128kbps; DL: 128kbps.

q_3765.question: What should the Node B do upon reception of the BLOCK RESOURCE RESPONSE message, if the Node B has initiated an Unblock Resource procedure on the same logical resources as the ongoing Block Resource procedure?
q_3765.ground_truth: The Node B shall ignore the response to the Block Resource procedure.

q_3766.question: What should the target UE include in the DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACCEPT message when the PC5 unicast link modification procedure is to add a new V2X service or modify any existing PC5 QoS flow(s) in the PC5 unicast link?
q_3766.ground_truth: The target UE shall include the PQFI(s), the corresponding PC5 QoS parameters and the V2X service identifier(s) that the target UE accepts in the DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACCEPT message.

q_3767.question: How does the UTRAN UE Positioning coordination function determine the mode of operation?
q_3767.ground_truth: The UTRAN UE Positioning coordination function determines the mode of operation by querying the UE or other elements of the UTRAN to determine their capabilities. This information is then used to select the most appropriate mode of operation.

q_3768.question: What steps should the MS follow if the GANC selection process is finished unsuccessfully during the registration procedure?
q_3768.ground_truth: If the GANC selection process is finished unsuccessfully, the MS shall include the received GAN PLMN List information in the GA-RC REGISTER REQUEST message. If the MS fails to register during the last registration it attempted with a GANC (Default or Serving), it shall include the Register reject Cause IE, Redirection Counter IE, and address information of the last GANC and last GANC-SEGW.

q_3769.question: How should the UE behave if the entering condition for event A2 is satisfied and the measurement is for the NR PSCell?
q_3769.ground_truth: When the serving NR cell becomes worse than the absolute threshold minus hysteresis, the UE should send the MeasurementReport message at regular intervals until the condition is no longer satisfied.

q_3770.question: What is the consequence if the gsmSCF does not recognize an explicitly selected profile for MO call handling?
q_3770.ground_truth: The registered profile is used by the gsmSCF for the MO call handling.

q_3771.question: In the "UL-SIR-Target-CCTrCH-InformationItem-RL-SetupRspTDD" part of the protocol, what does the acronym "CCTrCH" stand for in the name of the "SEQUENCE" type?

q_3772.question: What MIME type is used to carry USSD related information between the UE and the network for the g.3gpp.ussd info package?

q_3773.question: What does the DL Reference Power Information IE provide in the RL?
q_3773.ground_truth: The DL Reference Power Information IE provides the reference power of the power balancing to be used in the relevant RL(s).

q_3774.question: What parameter in the Discovery Request message indicates the length of validity timer associated with the ProSe Application Code that the UE expects to receive from the ProSe Function?

q_3775.question: What is the security mechanism used for UE initiated messages between the UE and ProSe Function in V2X services?
q_3775.ground_truth: PSK TLS with GBA including the option of the co-located BSF and NAF is used for UE initiated messages between the UE and ProSe Function in V2X services.

q_3776.question: What is the purpose of broadcasting a neighboring cell list with associated timing information in a wireless communication system?
q_3776.ground_truth: The purpose of broadcasting a neighboring cell list with associated timing information in a wireless communication system is to enable shorter cell search time for user equipment (UE), save UE battery, potentially lower BCH Tx power for cells in a synchronized cluster, and enable more efficient and faster procedures involving switching from one cell to another such as searching for new cells, locking to new cells, or handover.

q_3777.question: In interworking from ISUP to SIP-I at O-IWU, what shall the IWU do with the ISUP information received?
q_3777.ground_truth: The IWU shall encapsulate any ISUP information received in a SIP message in a MIME body.

q_3778.question: How does an AS support IMS communication services and handle SIP signalling?
q_3778.ground_truth: An AS that supports a IMS communication service can insert an ICSI appropriate to the service in the SIP request and response messages, and indicate its capabilities, including ICSI, in the SIP request and response. If an AS is acting as an initiating B2BUA, it can insert an ICSI appropriate to the service in other legs and in appropriate SIP response messages.

q_3779.question: What do the "offsetTime" and "randomTimePeriod" attributes specify in the "keyManagement" element?
q_3779.ground_truth: The "offsetTime" and "randomTimePeriod" attributes in the "keyManagement" element define the back off behavior of the UE when requesting MSKs. The "offsetTime" specifies the offset time and "randomTimePeriod" specifies the length of the random window.

q_3780.question: What entity is responsible for handling a UE's request for Push Notification via SMS in the AMF?

q_3781.question: How quickly must the BSIC for each of the 6 strongest non-serving cell BCCH carriers be checked by the MS?

q_3782.question: What is the role of an IRPManager and IRPAgent in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_3782.ground_truth: An IRPManager manages the integration reference point, while an IRPAgent is responsible for the communication of network resource information.

q_3783.question: What is the scenario where a substantial relative gain was observed for a type 3i receiver over a type 3?
q_3783.ground_truth: At the low geometries of 0 and -3 dB, particularly for QPSK at useful throughput values.

q_3784.question: What are the benefits of using H.265 (HEVC) Main Still Picture profile over legacy still picture codecs?
q_3784.ground_truth: H.265 (HEVC) Main Still Picture profile has high coding efficiency and provides significant benefits in compression capability compared to legacy still picture codecs. It also includes tile support which provides various useful functionalities such as easy browsing of extremely large pictures.

q_3785.question: What is the model used to calculate the pathloss for the microcell LOS case?
q_3785.ground_truth: The pathloss is calculated using the COST 231 Walfish-Ikegami street canyon model for the microcell LOS case.

q_3786.question: What should the SMF include in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, if the network wants to remove the UE from one or more multicast MBS sessions?
q_3786.ground_truth: The SMF shall include the multicast MBS session IDs that the UE is removed from, if any, in the Received MBS container IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message and shall set the MBS decision to "Remove UE from multicast MBS session" for each of those Received MBS information.

q_3787.question: What is the purpose of the ADF/CTF entity in the UP system?
q_3787.ground_truth: The ADF/CTF entity in the UP system is responsible for accessing the CHF via the service based interface Nchf.

q_3788.question: What types of network elements does the Home enhanced Node B Subsystem (HeNS) consist of?
q_3788.ground_truth: The Home enhanced Node B Subsystem (HeNS) consists of a Home Node B (HeNB) and an optional Home Node B Gateway (HeNB GW), both connected by the standard S1 interface to the Evolved Packet Core (EPC).

q_3789.question: What is the effect of enabling or disabling the fallback option?
q_3789.ground_truth: Enabling fallback ensures operational network resources can be restored after activation or preactivation. Disabling it prevents this function from being available. The fallback operation can only be initiated by the IRPManager, and the IRPAgent shall not initiate fallback autonomously within a session. The fallback option should be enabled during an initial activate or preactivate operation to execute the fallback function.

q_3790.question: How does the hysteresis parameter limit the amount of event-triggered reports in a UTRAN system?
q_3790.ground_truth: The hysteresis parameter ensures that a reporting event is not triggered until the difference in measurement is equal to the hysteresis value, preventing rapid and unnecessary report generation.

q_3791.question: What is the GI value for both 5G MBS and eMBMS?
q_3791.ground_truth: The GI value is the same for both 5G MBS and eMBMS.

q_3792.question: What protocol shall be used for SCTP over IP in the transport for NBAP signalling bearer on Iub Interface Release 17?
q_3792.ground_truth: The checksum method specified in IETF RFC 3309 shall be used instead of the method specified in IETF RFC 2960.

q_3793.question: What is the expected sequence of events for PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1?
q_3793.ground_truth: The expected sequence of events for PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1 is as follows: PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1, TERMINAL RESPONSE: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1, EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.1, and EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.1A.

q_3794.question: What is the role of the IOPS MC connectivity function when receiving session packets carrying the IOPS MCData data disposition notification?
q_3794.ground_truth: The IOPS MC connectivity function checks if the MCData UE 1's IP address corresponds to a discovered MC user and distributes the received session packets to the target MCData client over unicast transmissions.

q_3795.question: What problem does using E.212 numbers for MTC device addressing create for existing billing systems?
q_3795.ground_truth: Using E.212 numbers as an address for MTC devices may require modifications to existing billing systems.

q_3796.question: How does FLO handle multiple transport channels in a single radio block?
q_3796.ground_truth: In FLO, the transport format combinations allow multiple transport channels to be multiplexed within the same radio block. This multiplexing allows for more efficient use of available radio resources, as multiple logical channels can be sent per radio block.

q_3797.question: In the scenario of location acquisition, what role does the MSC-I act as in this procedure?
q_3797.ground_truth: The MSC-I acts as the BSS in the Location Acquisition procedure.

q_3798.question: In the context of 9.3.1A, what is the formula for CFN initialization after the UE has completed OFFk and Tmk measurements for all target cells?
q_3798.ground_truth: After the UE has completed OFFk and Tmk measurements for all target cells, the UE initializes the CFN with the value given by formula (9.7), which is CFN = (SFNj - ((DOFFFDD * 512) div 38400)) mod 256.

q_3799.question: What should the MME do if it has a non-current native EPS security context for the user who sent the TAU request?
q_3799.ground_truth: The MME may run a NAS security mode command procedure with the UE to activate the non-current native EPS NAS security context. It may also change the KeNB on the fly.

q_3800.question: What is the purpose of the "4 out of 5 approach" in the 4.1.3 clause, and what does it apply to?
q_3800.ground_truth: The "4 out of 5 approach" in the 4.1.3 clause means that four out of the five measurement types defined for PS domain are subject to this approach. It applies to the attempted RAB establishments and successful RAB establishments in the PS domain.

q_3801.question: What does an Iur E-DCH data stream correspond to in the UTRAN?
q_3801.ground_truth: An Iur E-DCH data stream corresponds to the data carried on one MAC-d flow for one UE.

q_3802.question: How does UE select the new target network in this solution after receiving the steering indication?
q_3802.ground_truth: UE selects the new target network in two possible ways after receiving the steering indication: (a) using the stored preferred network list to find the most preferred and available network, or (b) moving directly to the target network listed in the steering indication if it contains one.

q_3803.question: What type of traffic is valid for the measurement type "IRATHO.AttOutCS" in the context of outgoing circuit switched inter-RAT handovers?

q_3804.question: What should the UE do if both "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" and "QqualminEUTRA-WB" are present in the IE "E-UTRA frequency and priority extension"?
q_3804.ground_truth: Calculate the value of "QqualminEUTRA" - "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" and store it in "EUTRA-RSRQ-OnAllSymbolsOffset", calculate the value of "QqualminEUTRA" - "QqualminEUTRA-WB" and store it in "EUTRA-RSRQ-offsetWB", and calculate the value of "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" - "EUTRA-RSRQ-offsetWB" and store it in "QqualminEUTRA".

q_3805.question: What is the update rate for the LP coefficients in ACELP and TCX coding?
q_3805.ground_truth: In ACELP, which is based on the AMR-WB encoder, the LP coefficients are transmitted every 256 samples. In contrast, the LPC coefficients are transmitted at different update rates for TCX (every 256, 512, or 1024 samples) depending on the selected TCX frame length.

q_3806.question: What is the "Address value" in the "CALL CONTROL RESULT" when the call control result is "Allowed with modifications"?
q_3806.ground_truth: The "Address value" in the "CALL CONTROL RESULT" is "24680" when the call control result is "Allowed with modifications".

q_3807.question: What is the range of priority numbers assigned to a data stream?
q_3807.ground_truth: Each data stream has a priority associated with it, which is a number in the range 0-63 with lower numbers having higher priority.

q_3808.question: What should the MRFC do if no image size is supported by the MRFP when it receives the generic image attributes?
q_3808.ground_truth: The MRFC should not send the generic image attribute parameter to the MRFP.

q_3809.question: What is the format of a message sent from the MT to the TE or vice versa?
q_3809.ground_truth: Each message consists of a start transmission sequence (00010000 00000010), message content, and an end transmission sequence (00010000 00000011).

q_3810.question: What should the Terminal give as an indication after executing the unblocking procedure successfully?
q_3810.ground_truth: After successfully executing the unblocking procedure, the Terminal should indicate that the new PIN has been accepted.

q_3811.question: In the scenario where a 2G ME of Rel-5 has a 2G SIM, but the HLR is 3G, can the system work normally?
q_3811.ground_truth: Yes, if the option for 2G SIM support is taken in the 3G ME, the system will work normally, as there is no difference in functionality compared to the "old" 2G case.

q_3812.question: What is the function of the Sx Association Update Procedure?
q_3812.ground_truth: The Sx Association Update procedure is used to modify an existing Sx association between the CP function and the UP function. It may be initiated by the UP function or CP function to update an existing Sx association between the two functions.

q_3813.question: How Network Operator can make use of the IMEI in the PLMN as per the 3GPP TS 23.003?
q_3813.ground_truth: The network operator can make administrative use of the IMEI in the PLMN by defining three registers, known as "allowed lists", "tracked lists" and "prohibited lists". The use of such lists is at the operators' discretion. The allowed list is composed of all number series of equipment identities that are permitted for use, the prohibited list contains all equipment identities that belong to equipment that need to be barred and equipment on the tracked list are not barred, but are tracked by the network for evaluation or other purposes.

q_3814.question: What information should the MS forward to the upper layers if the system information broadcasted for the SNPN includes the human-readable network name for the SNPN?
q_3814.ground_truth: For each of the SNPNs indicated to the user, the UE shall forward a human-readable network name along with the SNPN identity to the upper layers if the system information broadcasted for the SNPN includes the human-readable network name for the SNPN.

q_3815.question: What is the meaning of "TS" in the context of the document?

q_3816.question: What are the benefits of using local video composition in multimedia group communication?
q_3816.ground_truth: Using local video composition in multimedia group communication allows for decreased end-to-end delay, increased video quality, and reduced resources required in the conference focus for video composition, as the process of composing the continuous presence image is done in the receiving UE, rather than the conference focus.

q_3817.question: In the case of a message initiating a procedure with specified criticality "Ignore IE and Notify Sender", and one or more of the specified IEs/IE groups are missing, what should the receiving node do?
q_3817.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore that those IEs are missing and continue with the procedure based on the other IEs/IE groups present in the message, and report in the response message or initiate the Error Indication procedure that one or more IEs/IE groups were missing.

q_3818.question: What are the required values for the horizontal accuracy indicator (bit 8) and horizontal accuracy (bits 7-1) when they are both set to 1?
q_3818.ground_truth: When bit 8 (HA) is set to 1, it means that Horizontal Accuracy is specified. The horizontal accuracy, represented in bits 7-1, should be set as a 7-bit uncertainty code as defined in 3GPP TS 23.032.

q_3819.question: What kind of information container is DL-CodeInformationList-RL-AdditionRspFDD?
q_3819.ground_truth: DL-CodeInformationList-RL-AdditionRspFDD is a type of data container that holds a list of DL-CodeInformation data.

q_3820.question: In Use Case 5, what is the new requirement needed to support the use case for simultaneous voice service for one USIM and data service for the other USIM scenario?
q_3820.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall be able to allow a MUSIM UE to provide voice from one USIM and data services from another USIM simultaneously.

q_3821.question: What is the ciphered mode defined for in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_3821.ground_truth: The ciphered mode is defined for when a new TMSI is allocated to an MS and it is transmitted to the MS in a ciphered mode, as well as when the network requires the identification of the MS in clear in the 3GPP technical specification.

q_3822.question: What requirements must be met for the standardization of UICC OTA message contents?
q_3822.ground_truth: USIM files for PWS Security must be agreed upon and the UICC must support USIM Application Toolkit.

q_3823.question: What are session setup messages in GA-RRC protocol?
q_3823.ground_truth: GA-RRC protocol uses session setup messages to establish and manage the connections between GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) and GERAN (GSM EDGE Radio Access Network) elements. These messages contain control information needed for the connection setup and management, such as GA-RRC PDU message sequence numbering and GA-RRC message types.

q_3824.question: What is the relationship between the capacity (C) and the rate (R) in the Keccak permutation?
q_3824.ground_truth: The capacity (C) and the rate (R) in the Keccak permutation are related such that R + C = B, where B is the block size.

q_3825.question: What are the spreading factors that can be applied to the E-PUCH?
q_3825.ground_truth: The spreading factors that can be applied to the E-PUCH are SF = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32.

q_3826.question: What are the initial conditions specified in Clause 27.22.4.8.6.1.4.1 for the ME to fulfill the test requirements?
q_3826.ground_truth: The ME should be in its normal standby display, powered on, and have performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure. It should also be connected to the USIM Simulator, with the elementary files coded as Toolkit default.

q_3827.question: What is the role of the '3G application code' in the AID (Application Identifier) of an HPSIM compliant to the present document?
q_3827.ground_truth: The '3G application code' in the AID of an HPSIM compliant to the present document should start with '100A'.

q_3828.question: What should the UE do with the S-NSSAI if the back-off timer value received along with the S-NSSAI in the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached is zero?
q_3828.ground_truth: If the back-off timer value received along with the S-NSSAI in the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached is zero, the UE does not consider the S-NSSAI as the rejected S-NSSAI.

q_3829.question: What is the specified coded format for the SGSN number?
q_3829.ground_truth: The SGSN number uses TBCD digits compressed two into each octet, with a length indicator and in international E.164 format. The value part of the SGSN number information element shall not exceed 15 digits.

q_3830.question: What information does the "Cell identifier list Information Element" contain in the LOAD INDICATION message?
q_3830.ground_truth: The "Cell identifier list Information Element" contains the cell identifier of the affected neighbor cells in the LOAD INDICATION message.

q_3831.question: What happens to the PTC when the serving RR entity is switched to GSM-RR/UTRAN-RRC while in GAN mode?
q_3831.ground_truth: When the serving RR entity is switched to GSM-RR/UTRAN-RRC in GAN mode, the GA-PSR is disconnected from the GPRS SAPs, and the MS releases the associated PTC, regardless of the PTC Timer status.

q_3832.question: What is the purpose of calibrating the reverberation chamber in the described test methodology?
