q_3832.ground_truth: The purpose of calibrating the reverberation chamber is to measure the losses in the chamber using a broadband antenna and a network analyzer, ensuring accurate measurements of UE sensitivity and UE radiated power.

q_3833.question: What is the LCS Client functional group responsible for in the context of LCS?
q_3833.ground_truth: The LCS Client functional group consists of logical functional entities that contain an LCS component with one or more clients, which by using location information can provide location-based services. The LCS client is a logical functional entity that requests location information for one or more target UEs within a specified set of parameters.

q_3834.question: What should the AMF include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message when it determines that the maximum number of UEs is reached for one or more S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI?
q_3834.ground_truth: The AMF should include the rejected NSSAI containing one or more S-NSSAIs with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached" in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_3835.question: What is the difference between time-critical and non-real-time communication in the context of the mobile operation panel?
q_3835.ground_truth: Time-critical communication refers to safety-critical functions such as emergency stops or enabling or changing the position of robots and other machines, which have strict ultra-low latencies and reliable transmission requirements. Non-real-time communication refers to monitoring data, which is generally considered to be less time-critical.

q_3836.question: If a request from upper layers was made to send a mobile originated SMS over NAS, what action does 5GMM take if the NAS transport procedure is not allowed due to access barring?
q_3836.ground_truth: 5GMM shall not initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the SMS in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message. Upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, 5GMM may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the SMS in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message, if still needed.

q_3837.question: What is one of the capabilities used to support GI-DS-lite via GRE encapsulation?
q_3837.ground_truth: Procedures for the PDN Gateway to support UE with overlapping IPv4 addresses.

q_3838.question: When can the MRFP transcode the input codec into the session codec in the General Play Multimedia function?
q_3838.ground_truth: The MRFP may transcode the input codec into the session codec when the multimedia file provides a different audio or video codec with the session codec.

q_3839.question: What should the affiliation status be set to if the MCData group information entry is in the list of MCData group information entries of an MCData client information entry and the MCData client ID matches the served MCData client ID, and the MCData user information entry is in the list of MCData user information entries described in clause 8.3.2.2, for which the SIP NOTIFY request does not contain the specified elements?
q_3839.ground_truth: The affiliation status should be set to "deaffiliated."

q_3840.question: What is the limit of the occupied channel bandwidth for UE in UL CLTD activation state 1, UL MIMO operation, and DB-DC-HSUPA operation?
q_3840.ground_truth: The occupied channel bandwidth for UE shall be less than 5 MHz based on a chip rate of 3.84 Mcps, in all the mentioned cases.

q_3841.question: Where can the AI/ML model training be located in the mentioned solutions?
q_3841.ground_truth: The AI/ML model training can be located in OAM or in gNB, depending on the solution.

q_3842.question: What procedure is applicable when the UE accesses a trusted Fixed Broadband Access network for EPC-routed traffic?
q_3842.ground_truth: The procedure described in 8.2.8 of the document is applicable.

q_3843.question: What does the "rate" attribute in the SDP description for QoE metrics represent in MBMS?
q_3843.ground_truth: The "rate" attribute in the SDP description for QoE metrics specifies the sending rate of reports, either "End" for one report at the end of the session or "Periodic" for reports at periodic time intervals in MBMS.

q_3844.question: What is one of the IMS interworking requirements with non-3GPP networks?
q_3844.ground_truth: The IMS shall support the capability for interoperability with other non-3GPP networks providing IP Multimedia sessions.

q_3845.question: What is the meaning of "shall" and "shall not" in 3GPP technical documents?
q_3845.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, and "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

q_3846.question: What is the number of bits per segment (Yi) in terms of the number of bits in a radio frame before rate matching on TrCH i with transport format combination j (Nij)?

q_3847.question: What is the role of clause 6.3.2 in addressing the key issue of media protocols on 5G?
q_3847.ground_truth: Clause 6.3.2 outlines the categorization of application flows, including media, communications, and control flows, into three priority groups: Group 1 (highest priority), Group 2 (medium priority), and Group 3 (lowest priority).

q_3848.question: What information controls the transmission of a full header packet for a TCP stream in PDCP?
q_3848.ground_truth: If the PDCP receives from lower layer the information of failed transmission of a single packet, the PDCP may send the next packet as a full header for a TCP stream.

q_3849.question: What is the condition for determining potentially valid symbols for PUSCH repetition Type B transmission?
q_3849.ground_truth: The condition for determining potentially valid symbols for PUSCH repetition Type B transmission is that the number of potentially valid symbols must be greater than zero for a nominal repetition.

q_3850.question: What is the role of the Path header field in the registration process of a roaming user in interconnection networks?
q_3850.ground_truth: The Path header field is added to the REGISTER request to inform the S-CSCF where to route terminating requests and to ensure that the recipient correctly handles the Path header field.

q_3851.question: What action does the UE take upon receipt of an EAP-request message in the EAP message IE of the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message?
q_3851.ground_truth: The UE passes the EAP message received in the EAP message IE to the upper layers and creates a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message.

q_3852.question: What interfaces are used for connecting CS nodes to the Billing Domain in the 3GPP common charging architecture?

q_3853.question: Who receives information about the created 3GPP segment when a new one is created?
q_3853.ground_truth: The interworking management function receives information about the created 3GPP segment when a new one is created.

q_3854.question: What is the purpose of the uniform digital PCM to analogue conversion in the terminal equipment?
q_3854.ground_truth: The purpose of uniform digital PCM to analogue conversion in the terminal equipment is to convert the 13-bit uniform PCM signal to an analogue signal that can be output to an earphone or loudspeaker.

q_3855.question: What functionality is supported by the PTC Server to trigger the PTC Target Presence Report Record, with the PTC Server assuming the role of a Presence Source?
q_3855.ground_truth: The Presence functionality is supported by the PTC Server to publish network presence information to the Presence server on behalf of the PTC target, triggering the PTC Target Presence Report Record.

q_3856.question: When must the SMF proceed with the UUAA-SM procedure as specified in 3GPP TS 23.256?
q_3856.ground_truth: The SMF must proceed with the UUAA-SM procedure as specified in 3GPP TS 23.256 if the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message includes the Service-level-AA container IE with the service-level device ID set to the CAA-level UAV ID, and the SMF is provided by the UAS-NF the successful UUAA-SM result and the CAA-level UAV ID.

q_3857.question: What are the mandatory and optional message authentication mechanisms for third-party applications acting as a GUP Requestor over the Rg reference point?
q_3857.ground_truth: The mandatory message authentication mechanism for third-party applications acting as a GUP Requestor over the Rg reference point is urn:liberty:security:2003-08:TLS:SAML. The optional message authentication mechanisms are urn:liberty:security:2004-04:TLS:Bearer and urn:liberty:security:2003-08:TLS:X509. The use of the null message authentication profile is not recommended.

q_3858.question: How many periods are included in the MPD?
q_3858.ground_truth: There are two periods included in the MPD.

q_3859.question: What should be done if the allocated power of a supported operating band(s) exceeds the declared rated total output power of the operating band(s) in multi-band operation?
q_3859.ground_truth: The exceeded part shall, if possible, be reallocated into the other band(s).

q_3860.question: What is a GIN in the context of NPNs (Non-Public Networks)?
q_3860.ground_truth: A GIN (Generic Interface Node) in the context of NPNs refers to a network function that is used for both onboarding and access to SNPN (Non-Public Network) using external CHs (Core Networks).

q_3861.question: What is the purpose of the "TransmissionDiversityApplied" field?
q_3861.ground_truth: The "TransmissionDiversityApplied" field indicates whether transmissions diversity is applied (true) or not (false).

q_3862.question: What is the requirement for Access Identity 1 to be valid in the UE?
q_3862.ground_truth: Access Identity 1 is valid if the RPLMN is the HPLMN, EHPLMN, or visited PLMN of the home country.

q_3863.question: When is the contention resolution procedure used to resolve contentions for layer 2 SABM frames?
q_3863.ground_truth: The contention resolution procedure is used to resolve contentions in the case where several mobile stations have accessed at the same random access slot and with the same random reference and one has succeeded due to capture.

q_3864.question: What is the goal of the Enhanced Voice Services (EVS) codec standardization work item in 3GPP?
q_3864.ground_truth: The goal of the EVS codec standardization work item in 3GPP is to provide clear benefit in terms of overall service quality, service efficiency and interoperability in 3GPP LTE networks.

q_3865.question: What is the maximum number of speech frames it takes for a MS to apply the corresponding codec mode in uplink direction after the reception of a Codec Mode Command?
q_3865.ground_truth: The MS shall apply the corresponding codec mode in uplink direction for the next possible speech frame and, and no more than three speech frames later

q_3866.question: Which modulation is mandatory for EC-GSM-IoT capable mobile stations?
q_3866.ground_truth: GMSK modulation is mandatory for EC-GSM-IoT capable mobile stations.

q_3867.question: What is the purpose of the Relocation Request message from the new SGSN to the target RNC?
q_3867.ground_truth: The Relocation Request message from the new SGSN to the target RNC is used to setup Iu Bearers of the RABs between the target RNC and the new-SGSN.

q_3868.question: What is the main focus of the optimization opportunities for Multimedia telephony over IP in 3GPP Release 17?
q_3868.ground_truth: The main focus is on optimizing voice calls, while also considering other core media components such as video. Specific areas with optimization opportunities include handling of degraded channels, delay jitter, packet losses, and inter-working with other voice systems.

q_3869.question: What information is included in the Pairing Authorization Request that the SMF sends to the UFES?
q_3869.ground_truth: The SMF sends UAV ID, Target UAV-C ID, UAS ID, UAV Authorization Token, UAS Security Context Identifier, GPSI, and UAV IP address to the UFES.

q_3870.question: What purpose does the Paging procedure serve in the W1 interface?
q_3870.ground_truth: The Paging procedure provides the paging information to enable the ng-eNB-DU to page a UE using non-UE-associated signalling. The ng-eNB-CU initiates the procedure by sending a PAGING message and the ng-eNB-DU performs the paging of the UE in cells as indicated in the Paging Cell List IE. The Paging DRX IE may be included in the PAGING message to determine the final paging cycle for the UE, and the Paging Origin IE may be included in the PAGING message to transfer it to the UE.

q_3871.question: What action does the mobile station interpret as a requirement for a hook flash to be sent in a START DTMF message on an established FACCH?

q_3872.question: What is the abbreviation of "SMSoNAS" in the 3GPP technical report?
q_3872.ground_truth: SMSoNAS stands for SMS over NAS.

q_3873.question: What is the purpose of including a layer identifier (ID) in the NAL unit header in HEVC single-layer coding and multi-layer extensions?
q_3873.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow for the same NAL unit header syntax to be used for both single-layer coding and multi-layer extensions, promoting backward compatibility.

q_3874.question: What decision does the target BSS make upon receiving the PS Handover Request message from the SGSN?
q_3874.ground_truth: The target BSS makes a decision about which PFCs to assign radio resources based on the ABQP for each PFC. The algorithm by which the BSS decides which PFCs that need resources is implementation specific. Due to resource limitations not all downloaded PFCs will necessarily receive resource allocation.

q_3875.question: What should the MS A do if the remote party does not respond with an explicit service 3 acceptance or rejection for UUS3?
q_3875.ground_truth: If the remote party does not respond with an explicit service 3 acceptance or rejection, DISCONNECT message is sent to the MS A with Facility information element including Return Error component with error value "rejectedByUser".

q_3876.question: What message does NM send to NFVO to indicate the start of adding a PNF to the NS instance?
q_3876.ground_truth: NM sends an UpdateNsRequest message indicating updateType = "AddPnf" to NFVO.

q_3877.question: What is being ignored in the second statement?
q_3877.ground_truth: The impact of the harmonics and IMD (Intermodulation Distortion) issues between bands below 6GHz and bands above 24.25GHz inside UEs (User Equipment) is being ignored.

q_3878.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group in the document?
q_3878.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group is responsible for producing the technical specification of the Codec for Enhanced Voice Services (EVS) and Adaptive Multi-Rate - Wideband (AMR-WB) backward compatible functions.

q_3879.question: In the context of 8.1.3.1.13.2, what is the maximum number of cells to be included in measResultNeighCells for eventTriggered and periodical report types?
q_3879.ground_truth: The maximum number of cells to be included in measResultNeighCells for eventTriggered is the best neighbouring cells up to maxReportCells, while for periodical it is the best neighbouring cells up to maxReportCells, including the cells included in the cellsTriggeredList as defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId.

q_3880.question: What does the acronym "3GPP" stand for in the context of the present document?

q_3881.question: What is the role of Role management and presence application in voice communication?
q_3881.ground_truth: Role management and presence application is responsible for providing appropriate addresses or identities, as well as routing and presenting the identities of Drivers and Ground FRMCS Users during voice communication.

q_3882.question: What does the property "delerrsdu" indicate and what are its possible values?
q_3882.ground_truth: The property "delerrsdu" indicates how erroneous SDUs should be handled. The possible values it can take are "Yes", "No", and "NA".

q_3883.question: What is the responsibility of the MSGin5G Client in delivering the contents of the MSGin5G message to the targeted Application Client?
q_3883.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client delivers the contents of the MSGin5G message to the targeted Application Client. If MSGin5G client has not received all messages (even after recovery procedure) or reassembly of segments failed for any reason (e.g. corrupt data) then the MSGin5G client will notify receiving of failed message to application client.

q_3884.question: What is the state of the MCPTT emergency group call when an IWF receives a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request to cancel an in-progress emergency state?
q_3884.ground_truth: The MCPTT emergency group call state is set to "MEGC 1: emergency-gc-capable" when the IWF receives a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request to cancel an in-progress emergency state.

q_3885.question: What are the steps involved in the MAC transmission control procedure for RACH in FDD?
q_3885.ground_truth: The MAC transmission control procedure for RACH in FDD involves selecting the ASC from the available set of ASCs, deciding whether to start the L1 PRACH transmission procedure based on the persistence value, initializing access information upon preamble acknowledgement on AICH, and reporting successful completion or failure to higher layers.

q_3886.question: How is the position codevector integrated in the impulse response of the weighted synthesis filter prior to the search of the optimum impulse position?
q_3886.ground_truth: The position codevector is integrated in the impulse response of the weighted synthesis filter by representing each glottal shape as an impulse response of a shaping filter and then integrating it in the impulse response of the weighted synthesis filter prior to the search of the optimum impulse position.

q_3887.question: When is an additional Location Area Identity (LAI) required for a GERAN cell supporting Iu mode of operation in a network that does not support common Location Areas for the 2G and 3G CNs?
q_3887.ground_truth: An additional LAI is required for a GERAN cell supporting Iu mode of operation in a network that does not support common Location Areas for the 2G and 3G CNs.

q_3888.question: What are the two types of data that the MCData SDS can provide in the payload?
q_3888.ground_truth: The two types of data that the MCData SDS can provide in the payload are limited size, variable content messages, and a field indicating the location of the sending user/UE.

q_3889.question: What is the formula used to calculate the number of UEs per sub-frame for uplink?
q_3889.ground_truth: The number of UEs per sub-frame for uplink is calculated by rounding down the total number of resource blocks for the system divided by 16.

q_3890.question: What is the purpose of the Incremental Redundancy for Higher Order Modulation and Turbo Coding Schemes (HOMTC) subclause?
q_3890.ground_truth: This subclause discusses the inclusion of Type I and Type II ARQ capabilities for the HOMTC proposal.

q_3891.question: What triggers the relocation of the edge application server in clause~6.29.2.2 of the document?
q_3891.ground_truth: The relocation of the edge application server can be initiated from the application side in clause~6.29.2.2 of the document.

q_3892.question: What is the definition of a non-contiguous RB allocation in NR intra-band V2X concurrent operation with adjacent channel?
q_3892.ground_truth: A non-contiguous RB allocation is defined as RBStart1 + LCRB1 < NRB1, or RBStart2 > 0, when both SL CC and UL CC are activated and allocated with RB(s), where RBStart1, LCRB1, and NRB1 are for SL CC1, RBStart2, LCRB2, and NRB2 are for UL CC2.

q_3893.question: What is the role of the PDN GW when it detects a change in NBIFOM support during inter PLMN mobility?
q_3893.ground_truth: The PDN GW initiates the procedure to remove the 3GPP access from the multi-access PDN connection.

q_3894.question: What does "FDD" stand for in the context of 3GPP TS 36.301?

q_3895.question: What does the combined 2G 3G Call Drop Ratio KPI measure?
q_3895.ground_truth: The combined 2G 3G Call Drop Ratio KPI measures the drop calls in 2G and 3G related to the total number of establishment calls and provides a global indication of drop calls when an important part of 2G traffic comes from 3G network via handover.

q_3896.question: What is the meaning of "shall" and "shall not" in the context of the present document?
q_3896.ground_truth: In the context of the present document, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, and "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something. These constructions are used only in the context of normative provisions.

q_3897.question: What is one of the recommended requirements for MCPTT terminals?
q_3897.ground_truth: At least one of the codecs supported in all MCPTT terminals should be capable of providing equivalent or better performance than 3GPP wideband voice ("HD Voice") in terms of coverage, error-resiliency, speech quality, speech intelligibility, and call capacity across all MCPTT radio bearers.

q_3898.question: What is the TRP summation error (SE) defined as in OTA testing?
q_3898.ground_truth: The TRP summation error (SE) is defined as the absolute difference between the estimated and reference TRP values in dB, which is caused by the numerical integration of measured values on the grid to obtain TRP Estimate.

q_3899.question: What is the purpose of a DNS SRV record?
q_3899.ground_truth: A DNS SRV record provides the port number and host name of the target nodes supporting a specific service, and the A/AAAA records for the target host namelisted in the SRV record are also provided.

q_3900.question: What message is displayed when the user busiest status is determined by the user (UDUB) and the call fails with impossible call notification (OR1:N)?

q_3901.question: What is the role of the priority queue MUX function in MAC-ehs?
q_3901.ground_truth: The priority queue MUX function in MAC-ehs determines the number of octets to be included in a MAC-ehs PDU from each priority queue based on the scheduling decision and available TRFC for this function.

q_3902.question: What information does each occurrence of "<bsic : bit(6)>" specify?
q_3902.ground_truth: Each occurrence of "<bsic : bit(6)>" specifies a BSIC by encoding its binary representation.

q_3903.question: Which term refers to the time characteristic where similar data frames are sent linked to a periodic clock pulse?

q_3904.question: What indications are given to the PLMN terminal for interworking with the PSTN in speech calls?
q_3904.ground_truth: The PLMN terminal is given indications that it may receive out-of-band tones or announcements in-band, that the compatibility information available will be not exhaustive, and that in-band handshaking signals should be anticipated for certain types of failure conditions.

q_3905.question: What is the length of the channel data for RECEIVE DATA 1.5.2 and 1.5.3 in the logs?
q_3905.ground_truth: The length of the channel data in RECEIVE DATA 1.5.2 and 1.5.3 is FF (255 in decimal representation).

q_3906.question: What is the purpose of the CCA messages in 3GPP online charging?
q_3906.ground_truth: The CCA messages, indicated by the Command-Code field set to 272 is sent by the OCF to the CTF in order to reply to the CCR.

q_3907.question: What does the technical specification provide measurements for?
q_3907.ground_truth: The technical specification outlines performance measurements specific to Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) for all measurement types provided by an implementation of a WLAN, excluding vendor-specific measurement types.

q_3908.question: What is the format of the digital test sequence files and how are they provided?
q_3908.ground_truth: The digital test sequence files are provided in PC (little-endian) byte order, in archive files using the ZIP format. There are three types of files: 1) files for input to the speech encoder, 2) files for comparison with the encoder output and for input to the speech decoder, and 3) files for comparison with the decoder output. Additionally, there is a mode control file for the mode switching test.

q_3909.question: What is the purpose of the sessionId attribute in the Reception Report for MBMS?
q_3909.ground_truth: The sessionId attribute in the Reception Report is used to identify the corresponding delivery session for an instance of a service or a file.

q_3910.question: In what way do standardized features relate to autonomous network levels and the general network autonomy workflow?
q_3910.ground_truth: Standardized features may have different autonomy capabilities, leading to different capabilities of autonomy on various workflow stages and management scopes. These features may also lead to different requirements for analysis, decision-making, and execution based on the desired autonomous network level.

q_3911.question: What must the mobile station do to receive paging messages while in group transmit mode or group receive mode?
q_3911.ground_truth: The mobile station may read its paging subchannel in the current cell to receive paging messages while in group transmit mode or group receive mode.

q_3912.question: How is a UE declared as a satisfied UE in XR applications in NR systems?
q_3912.ground_truth: A UE is declared as a satisfied UE if all the considered streams meet their own PER and PDB requirements, i.e., if more than a certain percentage of packets are successfully transmitted within a given air interface PDB.

q_3913.question: What result is given when the card is not present in the card reader 1, and the GET CARD READER STATUS command is issued?
q_3913.ground_truth: Card reader present: No, Card present in reader: No, Card powered: N/A.

q_3914.question: What should be declared by the manufacturer in the case of an extreme temperature test environment?
q_3914.ground_truth: The manufacturer should declare the standard minimum and maximum operating temperatures for the equipment under test and the test procedure to be used, conforming to IEC 60 068-2-1 for minimum temperature and IEC 60 068-2-2 for maximum temperature.

q_3915.question: What is the compatibility of DRSACCH with existing channel organization and mobile terminals in telecommunications?
q_3915.ground_truth: The DRSACCH is compatible with existing channel organization and mobile terminals in telecommunications, as it preserves the TDMA frame arrangement for the TCH frames and the normal SACCH frames for both MUROS subchannels, and it does not impact the performance of speech or normal SACCH blocks on the same or other subchannels.

q_3916.question: What is the highest boundary of the UE occupied bandwidth, based on the two measured occupied bandwidths, in UL CLTD activation state 1?
q_3916.ground_truth: The upper boundary of the UE occupied bandwidth is the highest boundary of the two measured occupied bandwidths.

q_3917.question: When should the System information type 7 and 8 messages be analyzed by the mobile station?
q_3917.ground_truth: The mobile station shall analyze the SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 7 and 8 messages when it is sent on the BCCH by the network giving information about cell reselection parameters to be used in that cell.

q_3918.question: What is the effect of transmitting more data than the GBR requirements allow for in a network?
q_3918.ground_truth: If more data is transmitted from the application than allowed by the GBR requirements, delivery within the Packet Delay Budget cannot be guaranteed for packets that exceed the Maximum Data Burst Volume or GBR requirements.

q_3919.question: What is the recommended syntax for defining commands and attributes in the Diameter application for the Sh interface?
q_3919.ground_truth: The recommended syntax for defining commands and attributes is the ABNF syntax, which is based on the Command Code Format (CCF) specification defined in IETF RFC 6733.

q_3920.question: How is the energy calculated for each scalefactorband in the MPEG-4 standard?
q_3920.ground_truth: The energy for each scalefactorband is calculated as the squared average energy, except for scalefactorbands with detected missing harmonics, where the energy is calculated as the maximum energy.

q_3921.question: What should be the response when the B party wants to retrieve the held call?
q_3921.ground_truth: The call can be retrieved by sending the retrieve req (A-B) and retrieve ack (A-B).

q_3922.question: What must be obtained from a trusted source when retrieving eCNAM identity data?
q_3922.ground_truth: The eCNAM identity data is obtained from a trusted source, which can be the originating service provider or a third party with a business arrangement with the originating service provider.

q_3923.question: In what circumstances is a session request dropped from the queue during session establishment?
q_3923.ground_truth: If the session request is queued for a resource, but the user loses coverage, the session request is removed from the queue and is dropped.

q_3924.question: What is the purpose of the Data Rate Averaging Window in the context of network scheduling?
q_3924.ground_truth: The Data Rate Averaging Window is used to calculate the GBR and MBR for a GBR SDF aggregate in the RAN, PDN-GW, and UE.

q_3925.question: What is the name of the 3D video rendering technology that uses a lens sheet to direct light in different viewing angles?

q_3926.question: What information does the "offeredCamel4Functionalities" parameter contain?
q_3926.ground_truth: The "offeredCamel4Functionalities" parameter contains the CAMEL phase 4 functionalities that are offered by the SSF or SCF.

q_3927.question: What is the pathloss through the external wall, PLtw, in O2I building penetration loss modeled as in Clause 7.4.3-1?
q_3927.ground_truth: PLtw is characterized as in Clause 7.4.3-1, where it is the sum of an additional loss for non-perpendicular incidence and the penetration loss of materials present in the wall.

q_3928.question: What function is the MGCF in 3GPP TS 29.163 equivalent to in the present specification?
q_3928.ground_truth: In the present specification, the MGCF in 3GPP TS 29.163 is equivalent to IWU, which is the Interworking Media Gateway Function.

q_3929.question: In what state should the UE be before sending a SERVICE REQUEST message when it has uplink user data pending in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access?
q_3929.ground_truth: The UE should be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.

q_3930.question: What action should a BSS take if it receives a RIM PDU in a case not covered by the RIM procedures specified in sub-clause 8c2?
q_3930.ground_truth: The BSS should discard the RIM PDU without further action.

q_3931.question: What should the UE consider as the entering condition for event A4 in the measurement reporting procedure?
q_3931.ground_truth: The entering condition for event A4 is defined in Inequality A4-1, which outlines the specific requirements that must be met for the event A4 to be triggered.

q_3932.question: What are the two main approaches to providing video experiences for HMD-based VR?
q_3932.ground_truth: The two main approaches are Tethered and Untethered systems. Tethered systems rely on dedicated screens integrated into the system and running with external computers, while Untethered systems rely on a smartphone inserted into the HMD.

q_3933.question: What is the effect of the idle frame used as dummy data block?
q_3933.ground_truth: The idle frame used as dummy data block eliminates the extra delay at sender side otherwise caused by data redundancy.

q_3934.question: What is the Call Control Function (CCF) in the context of network call/service processing and control?
q_3934.ground_truth: The Call Control Function (CCF) is the network function that provides call/service processing and control in the network.

q_3935.question: What happens when the Key Request message is sent to request the ProSe Key Management Function to send PGKs or change the groups for which it wants to receive keys?
q_3935.ground_truth: When the UE sends a Key Request message to request the ProSe Key Management Function to send PGKs or change the groups for which it wants to receive keys, the UE includes the indication of security algorithms that it supports for one-to-many communications, a list of Group Identities for which it would like to receive keys, the PGK IDs of any keys for that group, and a list of Group Identities for which it would like to stop receiving keys.

q_3936.question: What services does online charging utilize for PoC session charging?
q_3936.ground_truth: Online charging utilizes session charging for PoC session and PoC talk burst exchange, and event charging for early (pre-established) sessions (session set-up is charged only) and instant personal alerts.

q_3937.question: What is the role of the GCS AS in MBMS data transfer?
q_3937.ground_truth: The GCS AS is responsible for transferring data from one or multiple GCS AS sessions to authorized UEs via a single MBMS bearer.

q_3938.question: In the context of intermodulation performance, what is the definition of intermodulation response rejection?
q_3938.ground_truth: Intermodulation response rejection is a measure of the capability of the receiver to receive a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency in the presence of two interfering signals which have a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal.

q_3939.question: What is the synchronous acknowledgement delay in the HS-HARQ mechanism?
q_3939.ground_truth: The synchronous acknowledgement delay in the HS-HARQ mechanism is around 60 msec.

q_3940.question: What are the security services provided by TCAPsec?
q_3940.ground_truth: TCAPsec provides data integrity, data origin authentication, anti-replay protection, and optional confidentiality for TCAP user signalling.

q_3941.question: What is the purpose of generating a SIP UPDATE request for Resource-Priority header field correction during an MCPTT session?
q_3941.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide the correct Resource-Priority header field when the received SIP INVITE request did not include a correctly populated Resource-Priority header field.

q_3942.question: In what order should the Random Access Preambles be selected if at least one of the SSBs with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB is available?
q_3942.ground_truth: The Random Access Preambles associated with the selected SSB should be selected randomly with equal probability.

q_3943.question: Which command is sent by a Diameter Multimedia server to a Diameter Multimedia client in order to request the de-registration of a user?
q_3943.ground_truth: The Registration-Termination-Request (RTR) command is sent by a Diameter Multimedia server to a Diameter Multimedia client in order to request the de-registration of a user.

q_3944.question: What is provisioned by the PCF to the UE for ProSe direct communications over the PC5 reference point?
q_3944.ground_truth: The list of ProSe services with Geographical Areas that require privacy and security support are provisioned by the PCF to the UE for ProSe direct communications over the PC5 reference point.

q_3945.question: What is the delay from initial (EC-)RACH transmission to a received matching Immediate Assignment called?

q_3946.question: What is the purpose of the issue and expiry timestamps in a CCM message?
q_3946.ground_truth: The issue and expiry timestamps in a CCM message are used to identify the issue and expiry date of the CCM. They are used to detect replay attacks and maintain information on the last valid CCM message received.

q_3947.question: What is the frequency range for measuring the received power in step c)?
q_3947.ground_truth: The frequency range for measuring the received power in step c) is >=6 MHz from the carrier frequency and within the BTS relevant transmitter band.

q_3948.question: How can high resolution perception data be shared by an RSU to vehicles A, B, and C?
q_3948.ground_truth: High resolution perception data can be shared by an RSU to vehicles A, B, and C through point-to-point transmission or multicast/broadcast.

q_3949.question: In the case where the PNI-NPN has no dedicated 5GC, how is the NG-RAN of PNI-NPN connected to the UPF?
q_3949.ground_truth: In such case, the NG-RAN of PNI-NPN may be connected to UPF 1 via N3 interface.

q_3950.question: What does the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document indicate?
q_3950.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document indicates the approval status of the document within the Technical Specification Group (TSG) of the 3GPP. A first digit of '0' means the document is presented to TSG for information, '1' means it is presented to TSG for approval, and '3' or higher indicates that it is an approved document under change control.

q_3951.question: What should the SAS assume for the GANSS timing if the GANSS Measured Results IE is included in the POSITION ACTIVATION RESPONSE message and does not contain the GANSS Time ID IE?
q_3951.ground_truth: The SAS shall assume that the corresponding GANSS timing refers to the "Galileo" timing.

q_3952.question: When should the file repair point-to-point connection be used for reception reporting?
q_3952.ground_truth: The file repair point-to-point connections can be used for reception reporting if the system bottleneck is in the server handling of reception reporting and the forceTimeIndependence attribute is set to true.

q_3953.question: What is the formula for calculating the "Mean Dedicated Bearer Set-up Time by MME" KPI?
q_3953.ground_truth: The "Mean Dedicated Bearer Set-up Time by MME" KPI is calculated by taking the valid time per dedicated bearer set-up procedure by MME. Its formula is DBSTM= SM.EstabActDedicatedEpsBearerTimeMean, where SM.EstabActDedicatedEpsBearerTimeMean is used to compute the value.

q_3954.question: How is the interferer's calibration procedure carried out in relation to the wanted signal?
q_3954.ground_truth: The interferer path is calibrated using the same procedure as the wanted signal, but with appropriate antennas to account for the unique characteristics of the interfering signal.

q_3955.question: What is the main step in the MO creation for a specified VNF instance?
q_3955.ground_truth: The main step is for NM to send a createMO to EM to create MOI(s) corresponding to the specified VNF instance with VNF instance identifier included, and for EM to create the MOI(s) and send a notifyObjectCreation to NM to indicate the result of the MO creation.

q_3956.question: How does the Node B determine the initial, maximum, and minimum DL power for each timeslot within a DCH type CCTrCH in a 1.28 Mcps TDD system?
q_3956.ground_truth: The initial DL power is determined by using the Initial DL Transmission Power IE included in the DL Timeslot Information LCR IE if it is present, otherwise the initial DL power is the Initial DL Transmission Power IE included in the RL Information IE. The maximum DL power is determined by the Maximum DL Power IE included in the DL Timeslot Information LCR IE if it is present, otherwise the maximum DL power is the Maximum DL Power IE included in the RL Information IE. The minimum DL power is determined by the Minimum DL Power IE included in the DL Timeslot Information LCR IE if it is present, otherwise the minimum DL power is the Minimum DL Power IE included in the RL Information IE.

q_3957.question: What should the 3GPP MSC-S terminating the codec negotiation do if it receives an offer with the OoBTC Indicator?
q_3957.ground_truth: It shall include the OoBTC Indicator in the Answer and return the codec list as a 3GPP Selected Codec List and Available Codec List.

q_3958.question: Which key update condition is addressed by updating the GK in a regular basis based on a policy deployed to RAN?
q_3958.ground_truth: To address key update condition 1, the GK needs to be updated in a regular basis based on a policy deployed to RAN.

q_3959.question: What is the requirement for the IWU when DMTF signaling via RTP Telephony Event is supported over the Nb interface for SIP-I based Circuit Switched Core Network on Nc Interface?
q_3959.ground_truth: The IWU must support the DMTF signaling via RTP Telephony Event.

q_3960.question: What should be considered as the beam sorting quantity if reportQuantityRS-Indexes is set to rsrq?
q_3960.ground_truth: RSRQ (Reference Signal Received Power Quality) should be considered as the beam sorting quantity.

q_3961.question: What can the Node B use the TNL QoS IE for if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes it for an E-DCH MAC-d flow and if ALCAP is not used?
q_3961.ground_truth: The Node B can use the TNL QoS IE to determine the transport bearer characteristics to apply in the uplink for the related MAC-d flow.

q_3962.question: What is the significance of an increment in the first digit of a 3GPP technical specification version number?
q_3962.ground_truth: An increment in the first digit of a 3GPP technical specification version number indicates that the document is presented to the TSG for approval, or that the TSG has approved the document under change control.

q_3963.question: What is the size and the polynomial of the Frame Check Sequence (FCS) field in the LLC frame?
q_3963.ground_truth: The FCS field consists of a 24-bit cyclic redundancy check (CRC) code. The CRC-24 is used to detect bit errors in the frame header and information fields. The CRC-24 generator polynomial is x24 + x23 + x21 + x20 + x19 + x17 + x16 + x15 + x13 + x8 + x7 + x5 + x4 + x2 + 1.

q_3964.question: What is the "AS" bandwidth modifier used for in the FLUTE session?
q_3964.ground_truth: The "AS" bandwidth modifier is used in the FLUTE session to specify the maximum bit-rate required, which is the largest sum of the sizes of all packets transmitted during any one second long period of the session, expressed as kilobits.

q_3965.question: Which field in the fourth sequence is used to add additional secondary cells for the EUTRA band of an E-UTRA UE?

q_3966.question: What must a 3GPP AAA Server do if it receives a P-CSCF restoration indication from the HSS, but the IMS PDN connection was not established and the PGW does not support the P-CSCF restoration mechanism for WLAN?
q_3966.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Server shall ignore the P-CSCF restoration indication.

q_3967.question: How is a CBS message identified in the CBSP?
q_3967.ground_truth: A CBS message is identified by a CBS message reference, which uniquely identifies it with four elements: Message Identifier, Serial Number, Cell Identifier, and Channel Indicator.

q_3968.question: What action is taken by the service node when it agrees to enrol the mobile station onto the fixed part?
q_3968.ground_truth: When the service node agrees to enrol the mobile station onto the fixed part, it sends a CTS-SPM ENROLMENT ACCEPT message. This message may include an enrolment validity time and is used to confirm the enrolment of the mobile station onto the fixed part.

q_3969.question: What is the recommended action for a URCMP entity when it encounters a semantically incorrect optional IE in a URCMP signalling message?
q_3969.ground_truth: A URCMP entity should discard this IE, treat the rest of the message as if this IE was absent, and continue processing. The receiver shall not check the content of an information element field that is defined as "spare".

q_3970.question: How is a unique identifier generated for a PDN connection in the SCEF?
q_3970.ground_truth: The SCEF generates a unique identifier when creating a PDN connection, which is forwarded to the MME to allow correlation of MME PDN connection CDRs with SCEF CDRs in the BD.

q_3971.question: What is the method for identifying narrow band responses in receivers or duplex transceivers for the 1,28 Mcps TDD option?
q_3971.ground_truth: The method involves increasing and decreasing the unwanted signal frequency by 3.2 MHz and observing if the deviation disappears or not.

q_3972.question: How many bytes is the maximum size of the data payload containing the status information related to a wagon?
q_3972.ground_truth: The maximum size of the data payload containing the status information related to a wagon is 2500 bytes.

q_3973.question: What action does the RF take if the calculated price is higher than the account balance?
q_3973.ground_truth: The RF adjusts the counter reservation based on the actual number of service units consumed, and the OCF re-calculates the price and the number of granted service units based on the received tariff information and the account balance.

q_3974.question: When can VBR video rate control strategies be used?
q_3974.ground_truth: VBR video rate control strategies can be used if the low-delay or constant transmission rate constraint of the application is relaxed. They allow video bitrate variation, providing more consistent visual quality by restricting less the inherent variable rate nature of video compression.

q_3975.question: Which reference point, as defined in section 4.3.6, is used for the S-CSCF to provide IMS-specific presence information?
q_3975.ground_truth: The Pi reference point, as defined in section 4.3.6, is used for the S-CSCF to provide IMS-specific presence information.

q_3976.question: What is the result of a successful 5G authentication process?
q_3976.ground_truth: An EMSK is established from the keying materials obtained in step 16, the AUSF derives the KAUSF from the EMSK, and an EAP-Success message is sent to the UE.

q_3977.question: What type of data can the "IntraFrequencyEventIdentity" element hold?
q_3977.ground_truth: The "IntraFrequencyEventIdentity" element can hold a string type of data.

q_3978.question: Which criteria are important for determining whether User Peer functionality can be enabled or disabled on PC/Laptop type of UEs vs mobile handsets type of UEs?
q_3978.ground_truth: The key factor for enabling User Peer functionality on PC/Laptop type of UEs is the upload/download bandwidth, while for mobile handsets type of UEs, the crucial factors are storage space, computing capability, and battery, which are usually limited.

q_3979.question: What is the recommended action for the network and UE to support the Network Identity part of the Network Identity and Time Zone (NITZ) feature?
q_3979.ground_truth: It is recommended for the network and the UE to support the Network Identity part of the Network Identity and Time Zone (NITZ) feature to provide the UE with the name of the serving PLMN operator.

q_3980.question: By how much was the cumulated TRX power consumption reduced in Scenario S2 compared to Scenario S1?
q_3980.ground_truth: The cumulated TRX power consumption in Scenario S2 was 6.3% less than Scenario S1.

q_3981.question: What is the channel identifier used in SC Mode 1?
q_3981.ground_truth: The channel identifier used in SC Mode 1 is 1 as an example.

q_3982.question: How does the network handle the AoC (Charging) supplementary service for mobile originated calls when the ACM value is equal to or greater than ACMmax?
q_3982.ground_truth: The network prevents a call set-up attempt for mobile originated calls when the ACM value is equal to or greater than ACMmax in the AoC (Charging) supplementary service.

q_3983.question: What is the purpose of the Supported-Features AVP and what AVP is used to identify features defined by 3GPP in this AVP?
q_3983.ground_truth: The Supported-Features AVP is used to inform the destination host about the features that the origin host supports for the application. The Vendor-Id AVP is used to identify features defined by 3GPP.

q_3984.question: What is the result if more than one DCH has the QE-Selector IE set to "selected" in a set of coordinated DCHs?
q_3984.ground_truth: The DRNS will reject the Radio Link Setup procedure and respond with a RADIO LINK SETUP FAILURE message.

q_3985.question: What is the recommended bitrate value R2 in the described uplink bitrate boost scenario?
q_3985.ground_truth: The recommended bitrate value R2 is higher than R0 but lower than R1.

q_3986.question: What must be supported by each implementation concerning measurement result transfer to an external OS?
q_3986.ground_truth: Each implementation must support a file transfer facility to an external OS, such as an NM, implemented using FTAM ISO 8571, (T)FTP protocol, or FTIRP, located either in the NEs or the EM.

q_3987.question: What is the difference between the first digit in the version numbering system presented in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_3987.ground_truth: The first digit in the version numbering system denotes the stage of approval and change control. A value of 0 or 1 indicates that the TS is presented to the TSG for information or approval, while a value of 2 or greater signifies a TSG-approved document under change control.

q_3988.question: What is the default behavior when the samplePercentage attribute is not present in a delivery session?
q_3988.ground_truth: The default behavior is that each UE which entered the associated session shall send a reception report.

q_3989.question: Which term is used to indicate a mandatory requirement to do something in the context of the present document?
q_3989.ground_truth: The term "shall" is used to indicate a mandatory requirement to do something in the context of the present document.

q_3990.question: What is the measurement method for the OTA REFSENS requirement?
q_3990.ground_truth: The measurement methods for the OTA REFSENS requirement are the same as those for the OTA sensitivity requirement, except that the required level is EISREFSENS in the measurement procedure.

q_3991.question: What is the UP Function required to indicate in the UP function feature IE during PFCP Association Setup procedure for L2TP support?
q_3991.ground_truth: The UP Function is required to indicate its support of L2TP in the UP function feature IE during PFCP Association Setup procedure.

q_3992.question: What is the test purpose for expected sequence 3.1?
q_3992.ground_truth: The test purpose for expected sequence 3.1 is to verify that the ME can handle a GET INKEY command with a UCS2-coded text string and return the result.

q_3993.question: Which component is mandatory in the "DSCH-InformationResponseList-RL-AdditionRspTDD-RL-AdditionRspTDD" sequence?

q_3994.question: What is the role of the GAA Server in 3GPP TS 33.234?
q_3994.ground_truth: The GAA Server is responsible for communicating with the SIM/USIM/ISIM application in the UICC, and with external entities for possible key generation processes. It also functions as a public API towards the GAA Clients in the terminal.

q_3995.question: In spatial audio setups, what are the three primary signal types that can describe 3-dimensional audio as necessary for an immersive VR experience?
q_3995.ground_truth: Channel, Object and Scene-based audio representations.

q_3996.question: How many unique base layer ratios were used for encoding the SVC streams?
q_3996.ground_truth: Two unique base layer ratios, roughly 30% and 50%, were used for encoding the SVC streams.

q_3997.question: What action does the PGW-C take when initiating the procedures with handover from 3GPP access?
q_3997.ground_truth: The PGW-C allocates F-TEIDu for each and every bearer, and sends an Sx Session Establishment Request to the selected PGW-U for modifying the Sx session for the UE.

q_3998.question: What is the minimum number of antenna ports supported for NR-PSS transmission?
q_3998.ground_truth: The number of antenna ports of NR-PSS is 1.

q_3999.question: What should the UE do upon detection of a connection resume failure in NR?
q_3999.ground_truth: The UE should store the connection resume failure information in VarConnEstFailReport and clear VarConnEstFailReport upon successful establishment of RRC connection.

q_4000.question: What is the recommended ECS deployment scenario in the solution for efficient service delivery?
q_4000.ground_truth: The preferred ECS deployment scenario is when the ECS is located in the serving network or hosted by a 3rd party service provider, near the UE's access point of attachment, to achieve efficient service delivery through reduced end-to-end latency and load on the transport network.

q_4001.question: Which parameter is being used in "cap-InformationObjects" for "CAP-operationcodes" and "CAP-IMS-classes"?
q_4001.ground_truth: The parameter being used in "cap-InformationObjects" for "CAP-operationcodes" and "CAP-IMS-classes" is "opcode-activityTest, opcode-applyCharging, opcode-applyChargingReport, ...".

q_4002.question: What are the user plane modes supported for the Full MBMS service mode in the IP-based mode of the pass-through system?
q_4002.ground_truth: The user plane modes supported for the Full MBMS service mode are DASH Streaming Services using the appropriate 3GPP profile, RTP Streaming service using the appropriate 3GPP profile, and File-delivery services for which the content complies with the appropriate 3GPP profile.

q_4003.question: What message does the network include in the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT message?
q_4003.ground_truth: The network includes the new TMSI in the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT message.

q_4004.question: What are the two types of cell coverage that NGSO satellites can provide?
q_4004.ground_truth: NGSO satellites can provide either quasi-Earth-fixed cell coverage or Earth-moving cell coverage.

q_4005.question: What does the Proxy Function in a Domestic Service Provider (DSP) specify?
q_4005.ground_truth: The Proxy Function in a DSP specifies the architecture and functions of the Proxy Function logical components, which derives the functionality of the Proxy Function interfaces.

q_4006.question: What should the UE do when there are multiple applicable Tsor-cm timers for different ongoing PDU sessions or services?
q_4006.ground_truth: If there are multiple applicable Tsor-cm timers for different ongoing PDU sessions or services, the UE should start all the applicable Tsor-cm timers and follow the further handling described in clause~C.4.2.

q_4007.question: What is used by the FLUS Sink to measure estimate delay and delay jitter during the transmission of MMTP packets?
q_4007.ground_truth: The MMTP packet timestamp, which reflects the time when the MMTP stack queues the packet for transmission, is used by the FLUS Sink to measure estimate delay and delay jitter during the transmission of MMTP packets.

q_4008.question: What are the actions taken by a mobile station during the circuit switched domain of the DTM handover procedure?
q_4008.ground_truth: During the circuit switched domain of the DTM handover procedure, the mobile station suspends normal operation, disconnects the main signalling link and TCH, and disconnects and deactivates the dedicated channel until the DTM handover procedure is successfully completed.

q_4009.question: What action is taken by the SGSN when it cannot deliver the SM to the MS in a mobile-terminated SMS transfer?
q_4009.ground_truth: The SGSN sets the Mobile station Not Reachable for GPRS flag (MNRG), and returns a failure report to the SMS-GMSC.

q_4010.question: What is the purpose of generating re-synchronisation token in the USIM?
q_4010.ground_truth: The re-synchronisation token is generated in the USIM upon the assertion of a synchronisation failure, it is used to provide data origin authentication for the synchronisation failure information sent by the USIM to the AuC and to provide user identity confidentiality during re-synchronisation.

q_4011.question: What does the "Combined-MME/SGSN-Supporting-Optimized-LCS-Proc" bit indicate in the RIA-Flags AVP?
q_4011.ground_truth: The "Combined-MME/SGSN-Supporting-Optimized-LCS-Proc" bit of the RIA-Flags AVP is set if the UE is served by the MME and SGSN parts of the same combined MME/SGSN, the combined MME/SGSN supports optimized LCS procedure, and the HSS supports this optimized LCS procedure.

q_4012.question: What is the primary objective of the DVB-MABR Phase 1 technical specification?
q_4012.ground_truth: The primary objective of the DVB-MABR Phase 1 technical specification is to provide linear and non-linear media services efficiently at scale over a combination of multicast transport sessions, with optional Application-Level Forward Erasure Correction (AL-FEC) for the repair of lost multicast packet payloads.

q_4013.question: Under what circumstances is the CTSPCH indicator flag set to "CTSPCH~to~decode"?
q_4013.ground_truth: The CTSPCH indicator flag is set to "CTSPCH~to~decode" when the CTS-FP initiates the alive check or hunting procedure.

q_4014.question: What is the maximum number of subframes indicated by the Number of Subframes field for FDD and 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_4014.ground_truth: The maximum number of subframes indicated is 16.

q_4015.question: What is the unit and type of the RAB Establishment Success Rate KPI?
q_4015.ground_truth: The unit of this KPI is percentage and its type is RATIO.

q_4016.question: What should the UE do when editing Mobility Registration Update if it is aware of its location?
q_4016.ground_truth: The UE should limit its PLMN selection to only PLMNs of the country of the present UE location to ensure proper network registration.

q_4017.question: What is the impact of the transmission occurrences in the traffic channel on the channel control information?
q_4017.ground_truth: The alignment of channel control information for remote control of the DTE/DCE control interchange-circuits between the UE and the MSC/IWF requires taking into account the transmission occurrences in the traffic channel within the PLMN.

q_4018.question: What is the definition of "control information" in the present document?
q_4018.ground_truth: Control information is the information that can be formatted as rules or policies to assist or control the system to perform corresponding tasks in an autonomous manner.

q_4019.question: What is the purpose of using conducted or radiated two-stage methods for testing MIMO antennas' performance?
q_4019.ground_truth: The purpose is to measure the signal that the DUT's receivers would have seen if the DUT had been placed in the desired radiated field.

q_4020.question: Why would a mobile station abort ongoing TBFs when establishing an RR connection in packet transfer mode?
q_4020.ground_truth: A mobile station that has enabled PEO may use mobile originated RR connection establishment for GSM services while in packet transfer mode. In this case, it shall abort the ongoing TBFs, leave packet transfer mode and enter packet idle mode when the RR connection is released.

q_4021.question: What is the center point in a 3DOF FLUS source system?
q_4021.ground_truth: The center point in a 3DOF FLUS source system is a physical location that may be moving, and is defined by a set of three coordinates (x, y, z) in a 3D space.

q_4022.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS Bearer Status Indication Procedure?
q_4022.ground_truth: The MBMS Bearer Status Indication Procedure is used by the BM-SC to notify the GCS AS of conditions affecting the delivery of services that use MBMS Delivery, such as MBMS bearer activation failure due to no established MBMS-GW, MBMS-GW transient error or SGmb path failure.

q_4023.question: What information can be requested from the FRMCS System related to location services?
q_4023.ground_truth: The location information of an FRMCS Equipment consisting of geographic location, velocity, infra location, and quality of service information can be requested.

q_4024.question: What does the "RANValidityCondition" node represent in the context of flow distribution rules?
q_4024.ground_truth: The "RANValidityCondition" node acts as a placeholder for RAN validity condition for a particular flow distribution rule. This node and its descendants are used to define the RAN validity condition for the network selection.

q_4025.question: What is the BCM used for by the SGSN in the GGSN's Create PDP Context Response message?
q_4025.ground_truth: The BCM is used by the SGSN to handle unexpected session management signalling.

q_4026.question: When can an abstract syntax error occur due to a missing IE/IE group in RANAP messages?
q_4026.ground_truth: An abstract syntax error occurs due to a missing IE/IE group when the receiver expects a specific IE or IE group as per the procedure, but it is not present in the received message. This subtle difference can result in an abstract syntax error, which depends on the specified presence and conditions of the concerning object.

q_4027.question: What is the trust relationship based on in this solution regarding the EDGE-6 interface?
q_4027.ground_truth: The trust relationship is based on a business relationship for each EDGE-6 interface described above.

q_4028.question: What measures should be taken while transferring the control of UEs from one hovering RAN to another?
q_4028.ground_truth: Interference between the hovering RANs should be minimized, handover procedure should be quick and minimized, and information exchange among the hovering RANs should be quick and minimized during the transfer.

q_4029.question: What should the MAC entity do if at least one SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB is available during contention-based Random Access preamble selection?
q_4029.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select an SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB.

q_4030.question: What is the default behavior of a UE in a VPLMN not supporting CS fallback, in regards to autonomously selecting the E-UTRAN?
q_4030.ground_truth: The default behavior of the UE is not to autonomously attempt to (re-)select the E-UTRAN for the duration of the time the UE stays in a VPLMN and PLMNs equivalent to the VPLMN.

q_4031.question: Which subfunction is responsible for supporting the reception of a packet sequence at reference point Nmb2 from authorized sources?
q_4031.ground_truth: The Packet ingest subfunction supports the reception of a packet sequence at reference point Nmb2 from authorized sources.

q_4032.question: In what scenarios does the "ThreshBackhRateDLWLANHighAndSF" threshold condition need to be evaluated?
q_4032.ground_truth: The "ThreshBackhRateDLWLANHigh" threshold condition needs to be evaluated if the UE is using WLAN for traffic steering and the available downlink bandwidth is higher than the threshold value.

q_4033.question: What is the desired target for the UE battery life for mMTC?
q_4033.ground_truth: The desired target for the UE battery life for mMTC is 15 years.

q_4034.question: What is the role of PLMN A and PLMN D in Solution #7?
q_4034.ground_truth: PLMN A is a PLMN without Disaster Condition, and PLMN D is another PLMN in the same country as PLMN A.

q_4035.question: What is the role of CN (Circuit Network) in the handover process?
q_4035.ground_truth: The CN selects a target GERAN cell and requests it to allocate the necessary resources, using Handover Request.

q_4036.question: What should mobile stations not supporting VGCS talking do when they receive an ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message with certain inclusions?
q_4036.ground_truth: Mobile stations not supporting VGCS talking should ignore the ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message and send an RR STATUS message to the network with cause #96 when the VGCS target mode information element or the VGCS Ciphering Parameters Information Element are included in the message.

q_4037.question: What is the purpose of the delegation request from a PCF instance to its primary PCF?
q_4037.ground_truth: The PCF instance may send a delegation request of quota enforcement for the indicated S-NSSAI to its primary PCF when the local quota is to be consumed by the PCF instance, as an alternative to rejecting the UE request for PDU session establishment.

q_4038.question: How does the IRPAgent resolve concurrency problems in the Bulk CM IRPAgent state machine?
q_4038.ground_truth: The IRPAgent resolves concurrency problems on a "first come - first serve" basis, meaning that the first request will be progressed to completion and subsequent requests will be rejected.

q_4039.question: What are the impacts of introducing SBI-based MT SM transfer with SMS Router/IP-SM-GW deployed?
q_4039.ground_truth: The introduction of SBI-based MT SM transfer will change steps 2, 4, and 6 of the current procedure, while steps 1, 3, and 5 will remain the same.

q_4040.question: What information does the UE(USIM) provide to the network to assist with MT service delivery in Section 6.5.2?
q_4040.ground_truth: The UE(USIM) may provide MUSIM Release assistance Information (MUSIM-RAI) to the network to assist with MT service delivery in Section 6.5.2.

q_4041.question: What should the MAC-ehs entity do with the soft memory buffer in case the "Memory Partitioning" is set to 'Implicit' and the division of the soft memory buffer results in a non-integer value?
q_4041.ground_truth: The MAC-ehs entity should round down the partition memory size to the nearest integer value.

q_4042.question: What is one use case in AV production that involves the transfer of file-based AV content?
q_4042.ground_truth: Transferring file-based AV content between the broadcasting facility and an event location.

q_4043.question: What must be invoked separately for interception of multi-media service in order to intercept the content of communications?
q_4043.ground_truth: Activation and invocation of lawful interception for multi-media service only at the CSCF(s) does not produce interception of content of communications. A separate activation and invocation of lawful interception shall occur at a node that has access to the CC.

q_4044.question: What is the purpose of the M2 interface and M2AP in the E-UTRAN radio network layer?
q_4044.ground_truth: The M2 interface and M2AP support the functions of the M2 interface by signalling procedures in the E-UTRAN radio network layer, allowing communication between eNBs and the MCE.

q_4045.question: What is the purpose of the "mit parameter" in the UTDOA positioning method?
q_4045.ground_truth: The "mit parameter" in the UTDOA positioning method is used to minimize the number of dedicated physical channels by indicating the limit in the amount of puncturing that can be applied.

q_4046.question: What is the default assumed value for the "SMS Data Confidentiality Ind" and "SMS Guaranteed Privacy Ind" if not present?
q_4046.ground_truth: The default assumed value is "1" for both fields.

q_4047.question: What is the main difference between Multi-slot mechanism 1 and 2 in HSCSD?
q_4047.ground_truth: Multi-slot mechanism 1 loops the TCH data for a specific downlink slot onto the TCH of the main uplink slot, while Multi-slot mechanism 2 loops as many downlink slots as possible to the corresponding uplink slots based on specific rules.

q_4048.question: What is the requirement for service-level interworking regarding SMS, OMA SIMPLE IM service, and OMA CPM service?
q_4048.ground_truth: The service-level interworking is required to support interworking between OMA SIMPLE IM service and Short Message Service, as well as between OMA CPM service and Short Message Service, taking the terminating UE capabilities into account and being transparent to the end user.

q_4049.question: Which error code is related to the 'establish temporary connection' in the CAP-operationcodes module?

q_4050.question: What should the old SGSN include in the Forward Relocation Request message if it receives the Reliable INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO in a PS Handover Required message from the BSS?
q_4050.ground_truth: The old SGSN should include the "Reliable INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO" if received in a PS Handover Required message from the BSS, in the Forward Relocation Request message.

q_4051.question: What does the 1.28 Mcps TDD uplink physical channel capability IE define for 1.28 Mcps TDD?
q_4051.ground_truth: The 1.28 Mcps TDD uplink physical channel capability IE defines the UE uplink physical channel capability for 1.28 Mcps TDD.

q_4052.question: Which new MAC entities are added in the UE for supporting Enhanced Uplink?
q_4052.ground_truth: New MAC entities (MAC-es/MAC-e and MAC-is/i) are added in the UE for handling HARQ retransmissions, scheduling, and MAC-e/i multiplexing, E-DCH TFC selection.

q_4053.question: What happens during a Voice group call when a new talker starts to speak in the 1 channel model?
q_4053.ground_truth: The talker's speech is transferred to the MGW on the termination of the traffic channel serving the cell and is transferred to the conference function where the summarized conference signal is calculated. The resulting stream is then transferred to all conference terminations.

q_4054.question: What is the goal of the energy control during frame erasure concealment?
q_4054.ground_truth: The goal of the energy control is to minimize energy discontinuities by scaling the synthesized signal to render the energy of the signal at the beginning of the recovery frame to be similar to the energy of the synthesized signal at the end of the last frame erased during the frame erasure.

q_4055.question: What should the UE do if the security check of the steering of roaming information is not successful and it is in automatic network selection mode?
q_4055.ground_truth: If the security check is not successful, the UE shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN.

q_4056.question: Which command number and type should the ME send if it responds with 'MORE TIME' command in sequence 1.3 of the test procedure?
q_4056.ground_truth: The command number should be '1' and the command type should be 'MORE TIME'.

q_4057.question: What is the minimum performance requirement for LEE TRS for E-UTRA FDD, as specified in section 7.3.4?
q_4057.ground_truth: The LEE TRS minimum performance requirements for E-UTRA FDD in data transfer position mode for throughput greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels are specified in section 7.3.4.

q_4058.question: What is the GPRS service described in the document?
q_4058.ground_truth: The GPRS is a packet bearer service and a main part of the packet domain in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) technical specification.

q_4059.question: What is hosted by the Hosting Party Module (HPM) in the H(e)NB?
q_4059.ground_truth: The Hosting Party Module (HPM) hosts the credentials used to authenticate the Hosting Party in the respective H(e)NB.

q_4060.question: What is the PAR (Peak to Average Power Ratio) for a single 8-PSK carrier?
q_4060.ground_truth: The PAR of a single 8-PSK carrier is approximately 3.2~dB.

q_4061.question: What is the difference between CSMT flag and CSMO flag in the 3GPP Technical Specification document?
q_4061.ground_truth: CSMT flag is used in CS fallback for MT call to avoid missing paging in roaming retry, while CSMO flag is used in CS fallback for MO calls in the CM Service Request and LA Update request message.

q_4062.question: What is a Client in the context of the Streaming Service?
q_4062.ground_truth: In the context of the PSS, the client is a device or service that receives media objects and/or multimedia composition instructions from a server.

q_4063.question: What is the difference between real-time and non-real-time messaging services in the 3GPP context?
q_4063.ground_truth: Real-time messaging services refer to services where messages are delivered in what is perceived as real-time by the user, while non-real-time services are designed to store messages for later delivery or collection. In 3GPP, SMS is typically considered a non-real-time service, while instant messaging is a real-time service.

q_4064.question: What does the first digit of the version number indicate?
q_4064.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the status of the document within the TSG: 1 for presented to TSG for information, 2 for presented to TSG for approval, and 3 or greater for TSG approved document under change control.

q_4065.question: What should the SGSN do if it receives an Update MBMS Context Response with a Cause value of "Non-existent"?
q_4065.ground_truth: The SGSN shall delete the MBMS UE Context.

q_4066.question: What is the purpose of the "GammaQ" function?
q_4066.ground_truth: The "GammaQ" function is used to compute gamma values for BCJR algorithm and takes in Int16 k (bit position), Int16 l (state), const IntLLR* parity (received parity bits) and const IntLLR* extrinsic (sum of extrinsic and systematic bits).

q_4067.question: What input parameters are required for the 128-EIA algorithms to integrity-protect the user plane data?
q_4067.ground_truth: A 128-bit integrity key, a 5-bit bearer identity, the direction of transmission, and a bearer specific, time and direction dependent 32-bit input COUNT.

q_4068.question: What is the role of the GMSCB in the retrieval of routing information procedure for an MT call?
q_4068.ground_truth: The GMSCB receives an IAM, analyses the called party address, and if it can derive an HLR address from the B party address, it sends a request for routing information to the HLR. The HLR then sends a request for a roaming number to the VLR via the GLR, which returns the roaming number in the PRN ack via the GLR, and the GMSCB constructs an IAM using the roaming number and sends it to the VMSCB.

q_4069.question: What is a requirement for value-added services and PLMN operator services in terms of location requests?
q_4069.ground_truth: The network shall provide statistical reporting of reliability data for these services.

q_4070.question: What should the Node B include in the RL Information IE for Serving E-DCH RL in FDD UL MIMO DL Control Channel Information IE?
q_4070.ground_truth: The Node B should include the Secondary Transport Block E-HICH Signature Sequence IE or the Secondary Transport Block E-HICH Release Indicator IE for every RL indicated by the E-DCH RL Indication IE, set to "E-DCH", in the RL Information IE in FDD UL MIMO DL Control Channel Information IE.

q_4071.question: What are the available signaling options for picture resolution in DASH?
q_4071.ground_truth: The available signaling options for picture resolution in DASH include Adaptation Set Parameters @maxWidth and @maxHeight, Common Adaptation Set or Representation Parameters @width and @height, and Width and height in track header box of the ISO BMFF.

q_4072.question: Which IE is mandatory in DL-PowerTimeslotControlRequest if Mcps is 3.84?

q_4073.question: In TS 36.331, clause 5.6.13.2, what should the UE perform upon initiating the procedure to report EUTRA SCG failures when neither NR MCG nor EUTRA SCG transmission is suspended?
q_4073.ground_truth: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE should include the failureType within failureReportSCG-EUTRA and set it to indicate the SCG failure in accordance with TS 36.331 clause 5.6.13.4; and submit the SCGFailureInformationEUTRA message to lower layers for transmission.

q_4074.question: When is the network required to use the PACCH for paging initiation?
q_4074.ground_truth: The network initiates the paging procedure by sending a PACKET PAGING REQUEST message on an appropriate paging subchannel on PCCCH if the mobile station is GPRS attached, in packet transfer mode or broadcast/multicast receive mode, and the network is able to co-ordinate the allocation of radio resources for the paging request with the radio resources allocated for the mobile station on a PDCH.

q_4075.question: In what mode does the mobile station enter the MBMS non-DRX mode period when it sends the MBMS SERVICE REQUEST message, unless the MBMS packet access procedure is performed on MPRACH during fast reception resumption?
q_4075.ground_truth: If not already in the MBMS non-DRX mode period, the mobile station enters it when it sends the MBMS SERVICE REQUEST message, unless the MBMS packet access procedure is performed on MPRACH during fast reception resumption.

q_4076.question: What is the purpose of the Location Related Data procedure in the 3GPP network?
q_4076.ground_truth: The Location Related Data procedure allows the CN to handle additional location-related requests over the Iu interface, such as retrieving deciphering keys for broadcast assistance data or requesting the RNC to deliver dedicated assistance data to the UE.

q_4077.question: What is the interface between the Node B and RNC (Radio Network Controller) components of the UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network (UTRAN) in UMTS system?
q_4077.ground_truth: The Iub interface is the logical interface for the interconnection of Node B and RNC components of the UTRAN for the UMTS system.

q_4078.question: In the "DSCH-InformationList-RL-SetupRspTDD" part of the protocol, what does the acronym "DSCH" stand for in the "DL-DPCH-InformationItem-RL-SetupRspTDD-ExtIEs" type?

q_4079.question: What functionalities will the MBSF-U support in addition to the N4 session management extended by Packet Processing Rules?
q_4079.ground_truth: In addition to the N4 session management extended by Packet Processing Rules, the MBSF-U will support media processing such as transcoding, FEC, and ROHC, as well as media reception using HTTP streaming.

q_4080.question: What state will the gsmSSF FSM transit to if there are no pending reports or armed EDPs and the call has been released but not due to call duration limit being reached?
q_4080.ground_truth: The gsmSSF FSM will transit to the "Idle" state in this case.

q_4081.question: What kind of data is the RPT exposing for read access by the NM?
q_4081.ground_truth: The RPT exposes Planned Data, which includes site and antenna data, for read access by the NM.

q_4082.question: What is the definition of AllocationOrRetentionPriority in the protocolIEs of UeRegistrationQueryResponse?
q_4082.ground_truth: AllocationOrRetentionPriority is a SEQUENCE containing priorityLevel, pre-emptionCapability, pre-emptionVulnerability, queuingAllowed, and iE-Extensions, where the latter is a ProtocolExtensionContainer with AllocationOrRetentionPriority-ExtIEs.

q_4083.question: What is the purpose of using a lag candidate representation in low-frequency spectrum offsets?
q_4083.ground_truth: The purpose of using a lag candidate representation in low-frequency spectrum offsets is to enable a wide search range for actual lag information even with a small bit budget, while ensuring that at least one non-zero spectrum is generated.

q_4084.question: What should the UE do if it receives an invalid HANDOVER FROM UTRAN COMMAND message?
q_4084.ground_truth: The UE should set the failure cause to "Inter-RAT protocol error" and include the invalid Inter-RAT message. It should then transmit a HANDOVER FROM UTRAN FAILURE message on the uplink DCCH using AM RLC.

q_4085.question: What is the purpose of modeling the eNB as an implementation-specific issue?
q_4085.ground_truth: The purpose of modeling the eNB is to demonstrate that end-to-end delay budget adjustments can deliver performance enhancements for a wide range of eNB behaviors based on its processing capabilities and corresponding delays.

q_4086.question: What is the definition of the presentation indicator (PI) in the 3GPP system?
