q_4086.ground_truth: The presentation indicator (PI) can have three values: "presentation allowed," "presentation restricted," and "number not available." It indicates whether the calling line identity is presented to the terminating party or not.

q_4087.question: What is the role of the source SRNC after it receives the Forward Relocation Response message in the SRNS relocation procedure?
q_4087.ground_truth: The source SRNC begins forwarding downlink data for the RABs subject to data forwarding through the Iu interface and performs data forwarding for downlink user data only. The data forwarded is duplicated and routed at the IP layer towards the target RNC.

q_4088.question: What are the three concepts used to achieve the requirement of low generated interference in the CTS radio interface?
q_4088.ground_truth: The three concepts used to achieve the requirement of low generated interference in the CTS radio interface are the beacon concept, Adaptive Frequency Allocation (AFA) concept, and Total Frequency Hopping (TFH) concept.

q_4089.question: What is the purpose of the bandwidth switching detector employed before bandwidth switching post-processing?
q_4089.ground_truth: The bandwidth switching detector is employed to detect if there is bandwidth switching or not, and to calculate the counters of bandwidth switching from WB to SWB and from SWB to WB.

q_4090.question: When are the GNSS-AcquisitionAssistance and GNSS-AcquisitionAssistElement fields used for GLONASS in the satellite system?
q_4090.ground_truth: The GNSS-AcquisitionAssistance and GNSS-AcquisitionAssistElement fields are used for GLONASS when the satellite system is supported by the UE.

q_4091.question: Under what circumstances can an E-UTRA neighbor cell not be considered in cell reselection by the user equipment (UE)?
q_4091.ground_truth: If it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

q_4092.question: What is the main feature of the video glasses when used for a simulated large screen viewing experience?
q_4092.ground_truth: The main feature of the video glasses is their ability to display the left view on the left eye and the right view on the right eye, creating a depth effect for the user.

q_4093.question: What is the definition of the BBF network elements?
q_4093.ground_truth: The BBF network elements include BRAS, BNG, RG, BBF AAA proxy, and BPCF. These elements are defined in BBF TR-058, BBF TR-101, BBF~TR-145, and BBF TR-134. The BBF device represents any devices defined by Broadband Forum or supported by Fixed Broadband Access.

q_4094.question: When can the UE perform an initial registration procedure using the 5G NAS security algorithms "0" and 5G-IA0 for integrity protection and 5G-EA0 for ciphering?
q_4094.ground_truth: The UE can perform an initial registration procedure using these algorithms when registering for emergency services, performing initial registration for emergency services, or establishing an emergency PDU session.

q_4095.question: How can the AF control the DNS resolver used by the UE in a negotiated DNN/S-NSSAI?
q_4095.ground_truth: The AF can control the DNS resolver used by the UE in a negotiated DNN/S-NSSAI by providing information about the IP address of the DNS server and corresponding security related information to the 5GC.

q_4096.question: What new functionalities in the 5GS are needed to support network slice-related quota on the maximum number of UEs?
q_4096.ground_truth: The new functionalities required include storing network slice-related quota information, managing and updating the network slice quota, enforcing the network slice quota, and a new NF to support the storing and access control of network slice information.

q_4097.question: What is the goal of the open systems approach in a 3GPP system?
q_4097.ground_truth: The goal of the open systems approach in a 3GPP system is to choose commercially supported specifications and standards for selected system interfaces and build systems based on modular hardware and software design.

q_4098.question: What is the function that enables the transfer of NAS messages within the Access Stratum in the RRC protocol and S1AP?

q_4099.question: What is the range of the first digit in the version numbering of the 3GPP technical specification?
q_4099.ground_truth: The first digit ranges from presented to TSG for information (1) to TSG approved document under change control (3 or greater).

q_4100.question: What action does the BCC entity in the MS take when it receives a TERMINATION message in any state?
q_4100.ground_truth: When the BCC entity in the MS receives a TERMINATION message in any state, it informs higher layers, asks lower sub-layers to release the broadcast call, clears the context related to the broadcast call, and returns to state U0, NULL.

q_4101.question: What is the focus of the Service Management & Operations (SM&O) processes?
q_4101.ground_truth: The focus of the SM&O processes is on the knowledge of services and their management and operations, as opposed to the management of the underlying network and information technology.

q_4102.question: In which conditions should the UE wait before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN?
q_4102.ground_truth: If the UE fails the security check of the SOR information and is in automatic network selection mode, it shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN.

q_4103.question: What is the function of the Bearer Binding Function (BBF) in BBERF?
q_4103.ground_truth: The Bearer Binding Function in BBERF ensures that a service data flow is carried over the bearer with the appropriate QoS class.

q_4104.question: When should the UE set the contents of the IE "UE positioning Error" to 'Not Enough GANSS Satellites'?
q_4104.ground_truth: The UE should set the contents of the IE "UE positioning Error" to 'Not Enough GANSS Satellites' when it does not receive enough satellite signals to compute a position.

q_4105.question: What is the procedure that needs to be followed if a service-related entity wants to be notified when a UE becomes reachable at NAS level?
q_4105.ground_truth: The UE Reachability Notification Request procedure is followed, where the service-related entity requests the HSS to provide an indication regarding UE reachability and the HSS sends a UE-REACHABILITY-NOTIFICATION-REQUEST to the SGSN if the value of URRP-SGSN parameter has changed to "set".

q_4106.question: What is the maximum size of the Ge Content NG-RAN IE in octets?
q_4106.ground_truth: The maximum size of the Ge Content NG-RAN IE is 9600 octets.

q_4107.question: What is the significance of the "Call control result" field?
q_4107.ground_truth: The "Call control result" field specify the outcome of the call control operation as allowed, not allowed or allowed with modifications.

q_4108.question: What is the function of the EMSDP Session Request message in initiating a BEST session?
q_4108.ground_truth: The EMSDP Session Request message in the BEST service includes the UE Identity, BEST capabilities of the UE, details of the enterprise service, and the Enterprise server Id that the BEST service is being used for. This message is used to initiate a BEST session after the establishment of the PDN connection or PDU Session.

q_4109.question: What is the function of the UTRAN-GPSReferenceTimeResult in Extension-ReferenceTimeChoice-IE?
q_4109.ground_truth: The UTRAN-GPSReferenceTimeResult in Extension-ReferenceTimeChoice-IE represents the UTC time of the frame when the UE is reporting the position.

q_4110.question: What are the minimum bandwidth requirements for the TDD RSTD Measurement Reporting Delay test for Carrier Aggregation for 5 MHz + 5 MHz Bandwidth?
q_4110.ground_truth: The minimum bandwidth requirement for this test is 10 MHz.

q_4111.question: What is the purpose of the Local Call Local Switch (LCLS) feature in 3GPP networks?
q_4111.ground_truth: The LCLS feature allows for the user plane to be locally switched for calls generated and terminated by users served by the same BSS, resulting in saving on transmission resources.

q_4112.question: For which of the additional requirements for DC-HSUPA, UL OLTD, UL CLTD and UL MIMO are specified the parameters in clause 6 at the UL E-DCH reference measurement channel?
q_4112.ground_truth: The parameters for the additional requirements for DC-HSUPA, UL OLTD, UL CLTD and UL MIMO are specified in clause 6 at the UL E-DCH reference measurement channel, specified in subclause A.2.6, as per the given text.

q_4113.question: What does the "EL" bit in the length indicator field indicate?
q_4113.ground_truth: The "EL" bit in the length indicator field indicates the final octet of the field.

q_4114.question: What action does the SCC AS take when it receives an INVITE from the S-CSCF?
q_4114.ground_truth: The SCC AS invokes a B2BUA, terminating the UE A Leg and originating the Remote Leg for presentation of an IMS session towards the B-party on behalf of UE A.

q_4115.question: What should the MAC entity do if a set of Random Access resources is not associated with any feature indication?
q_4115.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the set of Random Access resources to not be associated with any feature indication.

q_4116.question: What event is used to report the result of the protocol negotiation in UMTS Circuit Switched Data package?

q_4117.question: What steps are taken if the USS/UTM determines that the UAV authorization is to be revoked?
q_4117.ground_truth: The USS/UTM sends an Authorization revocation request to the A&A Proxy, providing the 3GPP UAV ID of the target UAV. The Proxy A&A determines the AMF serving the UAV, and the AMF checks if there are any active PDU sessions used for UAS communications. If there are, the AMF initiates a PDU session release procedure for all applicable PDU sessions and revokes authorization information stored in the UE. The AMF sends an Authorization revocation response to the A&A Proxy, confirming revocation of UAV authorization.

q_4118.question: What action is taken by the Provisioning GANC if it cannot accept the GA-RC DISCOVERY REQUEST message?
q_4118.ground_truth: The Provisioning GANC returns a GA-RC DISCOVERY REJECT message indicating the reject cause.

q_4119.question: What information does the RAB.SuccRelCS.Cause measurement provide?
q_4119.ground_truth: The RAB.SuccRelCS.Cause measurement provides the number of successfully released RABs for CS domain, split into subcounters per release cause.

q_4120.question: What is the 3GPP Technical Specification group that focuses on the Common IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS)?
q_4120.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specifications and Technical Reports relating to the Common IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) is the 3GPP Technical Specifications Group that focuses on IMS.

q_4121.question: What must be present in the HANDOVER COMMAND message if the Synchronization Indication information element indicates a pseudo-synchronous handover?
q_4121.ground_truth: The Real Time Difference information element must be present in the HANDOVER COMMAND message if the Synchronization Indication information element indicates a pseudo-synchronous handover.

q_4122.question: What is the result of indicating support for redirect instructions in a request?
q_4122.ground_truth: If the application indicates support for redirect instructions, the GUP server may decide to return redirect instructions based on policies, allowing the application to receive and process these redirections accordingly.

q_4123.question: What is the role of the tilt compensation filter in speech processing?
q_4123.ground_truth: The tilt compensation filter is used to compensate for the frequency response tilt of the speech production mechanism in speech processing applications.

q_4124.question: In which frequency range do IMT and DTV coexistence require additional consideration on a per-country basis in Region 3?
q_4124.ground_truth: Digital television (DTV) and IMT coexistence may require additional consideration on a per-country basis in the 470-694 MHz frequency range in Region 3, potentially leading to the need for a guard band.

q_4125.question: What type of AVP is the Monitoring-UE-VPLMN-Identifier, and what information does it contain?
q_4125.ground_truth: The Monitoring-UE-VPLMN-Identifier AVP is of type UTF8String and contains the identifier of the monitoring UE's VPLMN.

q_4126.question: What is excluded from the scope of the present document?
q_4126.ground_truth: The specification of transmission delay requirements and O&M requirements are not included in the scope of the present document.

q_4127.question: What is the purpose of the "id-ngeNB-CU-UE-W1AP-ID" field in the UEContextReleaseCompleteIEs list?
q_4127.ground_truth: The "id-ngeNB-CU-UE-W1AP-ID" field is a mandatory identifier of the NGENB-CU-UE-W1AP-ID type in the UEContextReleaseCompleteIEs list, which is used to indicate the identity of the UE context in the Core Network for this W1AP message.

q_4128.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TS 25.41x series of Technical Specifications?
q_4128.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 25.41x series of Technical Specifications defines the Iu interface for the interconnection of Radio Network Controller (RNC) component of the UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network (UTRAN) to the Core Network of the UMTS system.

q_4129.question: What is the condition for the IWF to revert the MCPTT emergency alert state to its value prior to entering the current procedure?
q_4129.ground_truth: If the IWF receiving a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request did not contain an <originated-by> element and did not contain an <originated-by> element, the IWF shall revert the MCPTT emergency alert (MEA) state to its value prior to entering the current procedure.

q_4130.question: What is one of the benefits of SON (Self-Organizing Network) for AAS (Active Antenna Systems) ?
q_4130.ground_truth: SON mechanism with OAM (Operation, Administration, and Maintenance) support can optimize the inter-operability of AAS operations for cell splitting, cell merging, and cell shaping.

q_4131.question: What channel is used for data transmission in a special burst for S-CCPCH, DL DPCH, PUSCH, and PDSCH?
q_4131.ground_truth: The data portions of the Special Burst are filled with an arbitrary bit pattern.

q_4132.question: What is the difference between an assertion and an attribute in the Liberty Alliance architecture?
q_4132.ground_truth: An assertion is an XML-based data structure defined by SAML v2.0 that contains one or more statements made by a SAML authority about a Principal, such as an authentication statement or attribute statement. An attribute, on the other hand, is a distinct, named characteristic of a Principal or other system entity.

q_4133.question: What is the main difference between the synchronization procedure for 1.28 Mcps TDD and 3.84 Mcps TDD?
q_4133.ground_truth: The main difference is the use of the DwPCH for synchronization burst transmission and reception instead of the PRACH in the 1.28 Mcps TDD.

q_4134.question: What is the significance of the Cause value "No resources available" in an MBMS Registration Response?
q_4134.ground_truth: The Cause value "No resources available" indicates that there are not enough resources within the network to allow the MBMS Context to be created.

q_4135.question: What is the Test Procedure for CatPollingOff in 6.8.3.2?
q_4135.ground_truth: The Test Procedure for CatPollingOff in 6.8.3.2 is to set the test to CatPollingOff and execute the test case mentioned for turning polling off.

q_4136.question: What response does hA1 send to S-CSCF when a PRACK request is received and precondition mechanism is used?
q_4136.ground_truth: hA1 sends a 200 (OK) response to the PRACK request.

q_4137.question: What is the percentage increase in mean capacity performance when bandwidth is increased from 100MHz to 400MHz for FR2, Dense Urban, UL, for CG (8 Mbps, 15ms PDB, 60FPS), DDDSU TDD format based on Source 16?
q_4137.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is increased by more than 100%.

q_4138.question: What is the role of the SUPI in the 5G authentication and key agreement procedure?
q_4138.ground_truth: The SUPI from the USIM is used as the 5GS mobile identity in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message during the 5G authentication and key agreement procedure. The ME shall use this value in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message to establish a successful primary authentication and agree on the keys KAUSF, KSEAF, and KAMF.

q_4139.question: What does the "E-DCH Processing Overload Level" information element define?
q_4139.ground_truth: The "E-DCH Processing Overload Level" information element defines the threshold for indicating processing issue problems to the SRNC (Serving Radio Network Controller) in a radio network.

q_4140.question: What is the binary flag used to indicate a speech frame or a SID frame by the TX DTX handler?
q_4140.ground_truth: The SP flag, with SP flag ="1" indicating a speech frame and SP flag ="0" indicating a SID frame.

q_4141.question: What is the role of an LCS client in the LCS server's logical reference model?
q_4141.ground_truth: An LCS client is a functional entity that makes a request to the LCS server for location information for one or more target UEs within a specified set of parameters. The LCS client may reside in an entity within the PLMN or in an entity external to the PLMN.

q_4142.question: What information should be exchanged between NWDAF instances for real-time communication?
q_4142.ground_truth: For centralized NWDAF architecture, both Central NWDAF and Local NWDAF need to support the exchange of profile, load information, and negotiate how to transfer analytics and data collection tasks. For distributed NWDAF architecture, NWDAFs need to support the same functions, exchanging information and negotiating to transfer analytics tasks.

q_4143.question: What is the format of the End-Marker Control PDU, as specified in TS 37.324 clause 6.2.3?
q_4143.ground_truth: The End-Marker Control PDU consists of a Start Flag, a QoS Flow ID, a Length, a Next Extension, and an Extension field.

q_4144.question: What is the requirement for master station (BTS) and mobile station in terms of channel spacing?

q_4145.question: What interface is used for communication between UDM and HSS FE in the 5G system?
q_4145.ground_truth: The Sh interface, as defined in clause~6.2.2.1, is used for communication between UDM and HSS FE in the 5G system.

q_4146.question: What is the target data rate and latency requirement for the 5G system to optimize for transfer of continuous uplink data in cloud robotics applications?
q_4146.ground_truth: The target data rate is 10 Mbps and the latency is 1-10 ms.

q_4147.question: What message is sent by the mobile station after receiving a PAGING REQUEST message to initiate the immediate assignment procedure?

q_4148.question: What is the primary purpose of MPS for Voice?
q_4148.ground_truth: The primary purpose of MPS for Voice is to provide the Service User with priority voice communication sessions in periods of severe network congestion during which normal commercial voice service is degraded.

q_4149.question: What action does the Proxy-Gn take when it receives a Delete PDP Context towards the GGSN from the serving GA-SM entity?
q_4149.ground_truth: The Proxy-Gn forwards Delete PDP Context to the GGSN and the EGAN Access Termination enters the INACTIVE state.

q_4150.question: What is the function of the BM-SC in the TMGI Allocation Procedure?
q_4150.ground_truth: The BM-SC determines whether the GCS AS is authorized to receive the TMGIs, allocates a set of TMGIs, and determines an expiration time for the TMGIs.

q_4151.question: What should the network do if it receives the PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message with Ctrl Ack bits set to '00' or the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message for a TBF in the radio block indicated by the RRBP field?
q_4151.ground_truth: The network shall respond with the PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message including Single Block Allocation structure or the PACKET ACCESS REJECT message on the same PDCH as the mobile station has sent the PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message, and use the same procedures as are used for TBF establishment.

q_4152.question: In the context of resource authorization procedures, what does the term "AF" refer to?
q_4152.ground_truth: In the context of resource authorization procedures, "AF" refers to the Application Function, which is a functional entity responsible for enforcing policy rules on the PDN connection.

q_4153.question: What are the two frequency offsets that determine the different parts of the PN model's domination in TR 38.803?
q_4153.ground_truth: When the frequency offset is less than LoopBW, the PN is dominated by ref noise and Loop components. When the frequency offset is greater than LoopBW, the PN model is dominated by VCO.

q_4154.question: What is the size of the TSN field in MAC-e header parameters for FDD in 9.2.4.2 of the document?
q_4154.ground_truth: The TSN field in MAC-e header parameters for FDD is 6 bits.

q_4155.question: What is the maximum number of timeslots per frame that a UE can transmit in uplink for 3.84 Mcps and 7.68 Mcps TDD physical channel parameters?
q_4155.ground_truth: The maximum number of timeslots per frame that a UE can transmit in uplink for 3.84 Mcps and 7.68 Mcps TDD physical channel parameters is defined by the parameter "Maximum Number of timeslots per frame".

q_4156.question: What is the procedure for IP-CAN session termination for offloaded traffic in the case when dynamic policy provisioning is not deployed in trusted Fixed Broadband Access network?
q_4156.ground_truth: If dynamic policy provisioning is not deployed, the Fixed Broadband Access network employs local policies for IP-CAN session termination. The PCRF does not execute a Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision procedure or a PCRF-Initiated Gateway Control Session Termination Procedure with the BPCF over S9a.

q_4157.question: What is the UE's response to an IDENTITY REQUEST message containing an Identity type of "SUCI"?
q_4157.ground_truth: CR2 states that the UE shall send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with a fresh SUCI if timer T3519 is not running, and with the stored SUCI if timer T3519 is running.

q_4158.question: What is required for the H(e)NB to check the revocation status of certificates?
q_4158.ground_truth: The H(e)NB may check the revocation status of certificates using either CRLs or OCSP.

q_4159.question: How is the measurement of the mean number of the radio link established by other UTRAN cells obtained?
q_4159.ground_truth: This measurement is obtained by RNC sampling at a pre-defined interval the number of the radio link established by other UTRAN cell that is other than the best UTRAN cell of active set (UE side), and then taking the arithmetic mean.

q_4160.question: What is the effect of including an SGSN Address for user traffic in the Create PDP Context Request?
q_4160.ground_truth: The GGSN shall store this SGSN Address and use it when sending G-PDUs to the SGSN for the MS.

q_4161.question: When should the UE include measurement results for neighboring cells in the logMeasInfoList?
q_4161.ground_truth: The UE should include measurement results for at most 6 neighboring cells on the NR serving frequency and for at most 3 cells per NR neighboring frequency and for the NR neighboring frequencies that are included in both interFreqTargetInfo and SIB4.

q_4162.question: Under what circumstances will activating barring of all incoming calls deactivate barring of incoming calls when roaming outside the home PLMN country?
q_4162.ground_truth: When barring of all incoming calls and barring of incoming calls when roaming outside the home PLMN country were both already activated, activating barring of all incoming calls will deactivate barring of incoming calls when roaming outside the home PLMN country.

q_4163.question: What is the main focus of closed-loop automation mechanisms in Intent-driven MnS Producer?
q_4163.ground_truth: Closed-loop automation mechanisms in Intent-driven MnS Producer focus on continuously monitoring the intent fulfillment status, analyzing service and network information, and automatically meeting the intent requirements.

q_4164.question: What procedure is used in LAPDm protocol to pass unacknowledged information from Layer 3 to Layer 1 for transmission?
q_4164.ground_truth: Unacknowledged information is passed to the data link layer by layer 3 using the primitive DL-UNIT DATA-REQUEST. The layer 3 message unit is then transmitted in a UI command frame using the primitive PH-DATA-REQ.

q_4165.question: What is the optional parameter of the CID that is used to uniquely identify the relevant network element carrying out the LI operations?
q_4165.ground_truth: The Communication Identity Number (CIN) is the optional parameter of the CID that is used to uniquely identify the relevant network element carrying out the LI operations.

q_4166.question: What is the purpose of the speech decoder performing a plausibility analysis of the received frame parameters and of the output signal in case of unreliable frames?
q_4166.ground_truth: The purpose is to detect and conceal erroneous frames which are not marked with the Bad Frame Indication (BFI) flag.

q_4167.question: What should the ICS UE follow when it wants to establish a new I1 session using an existing CS bearer leg?
q_4167.ground_truth: The ICS UE should send an I1 Invite message toward the SCC AS, and populate the I1 Invite message as specified in subclause~6.2.1.2.1 with the following additions: set the Reason in the I1 Invite message to value hex "003" to indicate to the SCC AS that the existing CS bearer leg will be used for this call, and ignore the SCC AS PSI DN, if included in the I1 Progress message with Progress reason set to Call progressing received from the SCC AS, i.e. the ICS UE shall not initiate a call toward the CS domain.

q_4168.question: What type of measurements are included in Enhanced Cell ID methods?
q_4168.ground_truth: Enhanced Cell ID methods include measurements such as UE Rx-Tx Time Difference (FDD), pathloss, CPICH RSCP (FDD), CPICH Ec/No (FDD), Timing Advance (TDD), RTT (FDD), Rx Timing Deviation (TDD), and Angle of Arrival (1.28 Mcps TDD) to estimate the location of the target UE.

q_4169.question: Which common channel takes precedence over Primary CCPCH and Secondary CCPCH in case the physical allocations of different channels overlap?
q_4169.ground_truth: PICH takes precedence over Primary CCPCH and Secondary CCPCH.

q_4170.question: What is the main motivation for expanding the role of AFs in influencing 5GS?
q_4170.ground_truth: The main motivation is that AFs can provide valuable information to 5GS, so that 5GS NFs can better make use of its resources and provide adequate services to the UEs and/or group of UEs related to such AFs.

q_4171.question: What is the advantage of providing a range and having the UE draw a random value within that range, compared to providing only a "wait timer" or a "minimum wait time"?
q_4171.ground_truth: Providing a range and having the UE draw a random value within that range offers an upper bound for the wait time, providing more flexibility and limiting service interruption.

q_4172.question: What are the main scenarios considered in software management for 3rd Generation networks?
q_4172.ground_truth: The two main scenarios are the Main Software Management process and Software Fault Management.

q_4173.question: What instance number should the IMS-ALG supply when no visited-realm instances are present in the SDP offer?
q_4173.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should supply the instance number 2 when no visited-realm instances are present in the SDP offer.

q_4174.question: What is the size of the output returned by the KDF in the process of deriving CKSRVCC and IKSRVCC from KASME and the NAS downlink COUNT?

q_4175.question: What does HEVC Main-10 Tier Main Profile level 5.1 support in terms of resolution?

q_4176.question: What is the role of the NWDAF (Network Exposure and Control) in the deterministic communication solution?
q_4176.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides network analytics on Observed Service Experience to the PCF, which can decide if QoS parameters fulfill the QoS requirements for a target UE or application.

q_4177.question: What are the three charging methods used in MMTel online charging scenarios?
q_4177.ground_truth: The three charging methods used are Immediate Event Charging (IEC), Event Charging with Unit Reservation (ECUR), and Session Charging with Unit Reservation (SCUR).

q_4178.question: What is required for a UE supporting UAS services to establish a PDU session for USS communication?
q_4178.ground_truth: The UE needs to provide CAA-level~UAV~ID to the network when requesting to establish a PDU session for USS communication.

q_4179.question: In Solution #13, what is the recommended encryption algorithm and method for the handling of encryption/decryption key(s) for storing the TUAK TOPc in the UDR?
q_4179.ground_truth: This solution recommends the use of NIST approved algorithms and reminds that the selection of encryption algorithm and encryption/decryption key(s) is operator dependent.

q_4180.question: What is a possible composition type when resources have different levels of co-operation?
q_4180.ground_truth: In such cases, the composition type is determined by the highest level of co-operation required by any of the resources, and in this example, it would be Control Sharing with a new CCN.

q_4181.question: What is the purpose of the BSSAP on the E-interface in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_4181.ground_truth: The BSSAP on the E-interface provides a mechanism for the reliable transfer of signalling messages within the 3GPP system for the initiation and execution of handover between MSCs and the subsequent control of resources allocated to the Mobile Station.

q_4182.question: How often does the Reference Time IE have a periodicity in the broadcast message?
q_4182.ground_truth: The Reference Time IE has a periodicity of 10 minutes in the broadcast message.

q_4183.question: What are the two options for a UE in EMM-CONNECTED mode if the above conditions are met?
q_4183.ground_truth: The two options for a UE in EMM-CONNECTED mode are a) performing a detach procedure as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301 and then performing PLMN selection triggered by V2X communication over PC5 as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122, or b) not initiating V2X communication over PC5.

q_4184.question: What type of interactivity experience can be provided by the service signaling mechanism without requiring unicast transactions between the interactivity application and a network server?
q_4184.ground_truth: Customized or personalized interactivity experiences can be provided among users in a pure broadcast service/content delivery context.

q_4185.question: What is the conclusion on the maximum channel bandwidth accountability for regulatory rules in NR operation in the 52.6 - 71 GHz frequency range?
q_4185.ground_truth: The maximum channel bandwidth should account for the regulatory rules with agreed band plan and may be revised accordingly.

q_4186.question: What should the VLR do upon receiving a BSSAP+-RESET-INDICATION message from the SGSN?
q_4186.ground_truth: The VLR is informed that all associations with the SGSN are no longer reliable and should either set the 'Confirmed by Radio Contact' restoration indicator to 'false' or keep it unchanged for all the Gs associations containing the restarted SGSN.

q_4187.question: What should the UE do when it receives an outgoing call request using any of the emergency numbers in the Local emergency numbers list?
q_4187.ground_truth: The UE must establish an IMS Emergency call when the UE receives an outgoing call request using any of the emergency numbers in the Local emergency numbers list.

q_4188.question: What does the gprsSSF return when it receives the Error "MissingParameter" from the gsmSCF?
q_4188.ground_truth: The gprsSSF returns to the state "Idle" upon receiving the Error "MissingParameter" from the gsmSCF.

q_4189.question: What is the purpose of the "Subgroup ID selection" test in the 9.1.14.1.1 test case?
q_4189.ground_truth: The purpose of the "Subgroup ID selection" test in the 9.1.14.1.1 test case is to ensure that the UE monitors its associated paging occasions (PEI) that indicate the paged subgroups when the UE receives a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE, including the Paging subgroup IDs.

q_4190.question: What is the PLMN selection mode of the UE in the test described in 6.3.1.10?
q_4190.ground_truth: The UE is in Manual PLMN selection mode in the test described in 6.3.1.10.

q_4191.question: In the context of FDD, what is the method of mapping a segmented physical channel onto multiple DL DPDCHs when there are more than one DL DPDCHs assigned per RL?
q_4191.ground_truth: The first pair of DL Scrambling Code and FDD DL Channelisation Code Number corresponds to "PhCH number 1", the second to "PhCH number 2", and so on until the pth to "PhCH number p".

q_4192.question: What action is taken when User A wants to establish a call between A and C?
q_4192.ground_truth: A call request A-C is made.

q_4193.question: What information is included in the ENCRyption CoMmanD message?
q_4193.ground_truth: The ENCRyption CoMmanD message contains all information required to select and load the user data and encryption device with the appropriate key and also the complete Ciphering Mode Command message to be sent to MS.

q_4194.question: How is ECT service invoked by mobile stations (MS) that do not support ECT explicitly?
q_4194.ground_truth: Where operators support this option, mobile stations that do not explicitly support ECT can invoke the ECT service using a call independent supplementary service (SS) transaction, with the facility information element indicating ProcessUnstructuredSS-Request. The network then offers the ECT service to these MSs using the USSD mechanism. However, not all ECT features may be available using this mechanism.

q_4195.question: What is the purpose of the Monitoring-Time AVP in the TDF?
q_4195.ground_truth: The Monitoring-Time AVP in the TDF is used to receive reports for the accumulated usage before and after the monitoring time occurs within the report triggered by certain events. It allows for two instances of Granted-Service-Unit AVP within Usage-Monitoring-Information AVP per monitoring key, with one indicating the threshold levels before the monitoring time occurs and the other after.

q_4196.question: What action does the UDM take upon receiving the SOR-CMCI (in plain text) if the UE is registered in the HPLMN or a VPLMN?
q_4196.ground_truth: Upon receiving the SOR-CMCI (in plain text) from the UE, the UDM shall include the SOR-CMCI, the "Store SOR-CMCI in ME" indicator, and an HPLMN indication that no change of the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list is needed.

q_4197.question: What is the measurement name for the maximum number of simultaneous online sessions which have been answered at the P-CSCF or S-CSCF?

q_4198.question: What is the purpose of the IP address replacement mechanism in supporting ACR to a different DN?
q_4198.ground_truth: The IP address replacement mechanism allows the UPF to replace the IP address and port number of the Source EAS with that of the Target EAS, facilitating a smoother relocation process.

q_4199.question: What is the purpose of the IRI as defined in clause 6.3, and what interface does it use for transferring information?
q_4199.ground_truth: The Intercept Related Information (IRI) is used to provide necessary information at the beginning and end of a call, for supplementary services during a call, and for information which is not call-associated. The IRI should be sent to DF2 with a reliable transport mechanism.

q_4200.question: How does the GLR determine which HLR numbers to allocate as multiple GLR numbers in Tool 2?
q_4200.ground_truth: The GLR statistically keeps the correspondence between HLR numbers and GLR numbers in the non-volatile memory. If one GLR number is assigned to a group of HLRs, the group can be grouped by various parameters such as country code or network destination code.

q_4201.question: What does the SCC AS include in the INVITE it sends to the B-party when establishing a new session?
q_4201.ground_truth: The SCC AS includes options that enable UE-B to choose a CS bearer for bidirectional speech media transport and a dynamic SCC AS PSI to correlate the outgoing service control signalling with the incoming CS bearer control signalling.

q_4202.question: What is the purpose of the Correlation ID in clause 4.2.3.5.1?
q_4202.ground_truth: The Correlation ID in clause 4.2.3.5.1 is used to enable the direct user plane path between the HeNB and L-GW during the setup of the direct user plane path between them.

q_4203.question: When does the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay stop broadcasting the eMBMS traffic upon loss of TMGI?
q_4203.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-Network Relay stops broadcasting the eMBMS traffic upon detection of loss of TMGI, and may optionally send a positive indication of loss of TMGI to accelerate the detection in the UE.

q_4204.question: What media stream directionality towards the IMS UE is not interworked for a call hold request?
q_4204.ground_truth: If a media stream directionality towards the IMS UE was "sendonly" or "inactive", a call hold request is not interworked.

q_4205.question: What is the purpose of the 5MBS Aware-Application in the 5MBS client architecture?
q_4205.ground_truth: The 5MBS Aware-Application in the 5MBS client architecture is used to manage and control 5MBS services, and receive user data information about 5MBS services.

q_4206.question: What are the two different direction sets for declaring directional requirements in radiated TX requirements?
q_4206.ground_truth: The two direction sets are the OTA coverage range and the OTA peak directions set.

q_4207.question: What is the significance of the first digit in the version numbering of the Technical Specification?
q_4207.ground_truth: The first digit in the version numbering of the Technical Specification indicates the stage of development, with '1' indicating a TSG information document, '2' indicating a TSG approval document, and '3' or greater indicating a TSG approved document under change control.

q_4208.question: What protocol does the IBCF use to send a H.248 ADD request command to the TrGW to create the outgoing termination and request IP resources in the example where media transcoding is required?

q_4209.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role do if it is unable to process a SIP MESSAGE request due to a lack of resources or a risk of congestion exists?
q_4209.ground_truth: The IWF performing the controlling role may reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field to the SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response if it is unable to process the request.

q_4210.question: What is the size of the Alt-RAB-Parameter-ExtendedMaxBitrateList?

q_4211.question: What is the purpose of eventTypeCriteriaPackage in traceControl object class?
q_4211.ground_truth: The eventTypeCriteriaPackage provides the attribute to specify eventType record generation criteria in traceControl object class. It is a conditional package, which means it can be optional.

q_4212.question: What is the 3GPP system required to support in terms of position accuracy between UEs supporting V2X application?
q_4212.ground_truth: The 3GPP system is required to support relative lateral position accuracy of 0.1 m between UEs supporting V2X application.

q_4213.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the MBSF in relation to multicast services?
q_4213.ground_truth: The MBSF generates MBS context and sends it to the MB-SMF.

q_4214.question: What is the maximum number of CCTrCHs in the DL-CCTrCH-InformationList-RL-ReconfRspTDD field in the RL-InformationResponse-RL-ReconfRspTDD sequence for TDD ?
q_4214.ground_truth: maxNrOfCCTrCHs, which is a positive integer.

q_4215.question: What is the expected result when the ME receives a proactive command with an empty or missing alpha identifier and text string?
q_4215.ground_truth: The ME rejects the command with the general result "Command data not understood by ME".

q_4216.question: What indication does the UE provide when it creates the corresponding CS call states in the SIP sessions?
q_4216.ground_truth: The UE continues to indicate the user about the incoming waiting call when it creates the corresponding CS call states in the SIP sessions.

q_4217.question: What shall the gsmSRF do if it receives invalid input digits after the end of input is received, if the RF parameter is set to TRUE?
q_4217.ground_truth: The gsmSRF shall not announce back invalid input digits to the calling user if the RF parameter is set to TRUE.

q_4218.question: What is the method for decoding algebraic codebook gains at the highest bit-rates?
q_4218.ground_truth: In this method, before calculating the adaptive and algebraic codebook gains in each subframe, the predicted algebraic codevector energy is first decoded for the whole frame. Then, two indexes are retrieved from the bitstream and used to decode the adaptive codebook gain and a correction factor. The decoded algebraic codebook gain is then obtained using equation (1453).

q_4219.question: What is the condition for a demodulation reference signal associated with EPDCCH/MPDCCH/SPDCCH to be transmitted only on the physical resource blocks upon which the corresponding EPDCCH/MPDCCH/SPDCCH is mapped?
q_4219.ground_truth: The EPDCCH/MPDCCH/SPDCCH transmission should be associated with the corresponding antenna port.

q_4220.question: What is the role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in the development of the UTRAN Iub interface data transport and transport signalling for Common Transport Channel data streams?
q_4220.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is the organization responsible for the development of the present document, which specifies the UTRAN Iub interface data transport and transport signalling for Common Transport Channel data streams.

q_4221.question: How is the TEC parameter estimated in the encoder?
q_4221.ground_truth: The TEC parameter is estimated by calculating the variances of the temporal envelopes of the high and low frequency bands.

q_4222.question: What does DER stand for in the context of these measurements?
q_4222.ground_truth: DER stands for "Differentiated Explicit Rate" and refers to a granularity period used to measure certain specific events, such as the beginning and end of unavailability of MTP3/MTP3B signalling links.

q_4223.question: How much of an improvement in link performance was observed when using candidate pulse shape OPT 1 and OPT 2 compared to the legacy GMSK pulse shape?
q_4223.ground_truth: There was an improvement of about 2.5 dB for candidate pulse shape OPT 1 and about 1.5 dB for candidate pulse shape OPT 2 at 1% FER.

q_4224.question: What is the extension offered by Alternative #2 for the existing Observed Service Experience analytics?
q_4224.ground_truth: The extension offered by Alternative #2 for the existing Observed Service Experience analytics provides enhanced analytics per access type and uses the extended Observed Service Experience analytics to set the steering mode in PCC rules.

q_4225.question: What is the initial command for setting up the event list in expected sequence 1.1, as defined in the 3GPP TS 31.111 clause 7.5.12?
q_4225.ground_truth: PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1

q_4226.question: What should a mobile station do if it has been allocated a single block in the PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message and the purpose of the packet access procedure is to send a Measurement Report message?
q_4226.ground_truth: If the mobile station has indicated "Single block without TBF establishment" in the PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST message, it shall follow the procedure defined in sub-clause 7.3.1.

q_4227.question: Which network devices employ voice switching?
q_4227.ground_truth: Echo suppressers, echo cancellers with centre clippers, digital speech interpolators (DSI), discontinuous transmission (DTX) devices, and loudspeaking telephones employ voice switching.

q_4228.question: What functionalities should be standardized to reduce the amount of information per Event Report in the DCCF/messaging framework?
q_4228.ground_truth: Additional parameters on Event Exposure service such as value granularity.

q_4229.question: What is the purpose of inter-column permutation in the 1st interleaving process?
q_4229.ground_truth: The purpose of inter-column permutation in the 1st interleaving process is to permute the columns of the matrix based on a specific pattern.

q_4230.question: Why is it important to reduce procedure duration in robotic kidney transplant surgery?
q_4230.ground_truth: Reducing procedure duration helps keep warm ischemia time low, which can help prevent graft failure.

q_4231.question: What feature is intended for monitoring specific events in the 3GPP system and reporting such events via the NEF in Use Case #6?
q_4231.ground_truth: The Monitoring Events feature is intended for this purpose in Use Case #6.

q_4232.question: What is the RLC-SAP used in the "UE CAPABILITY INFORMATION" message?

q_4233.question: What is the purpose of the Emergency Access Flag?
q_4233.ground_truth: The Emergency Access Flag is used to control access to I-WLAN for emergency purposes. It can take the values of access for emergency purposes or not for emergency purposes.

q_4234.question: What is the focus of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group's study on improved end-to-end Quality of Service (QoS) handling for Multimedia Telephony Service for IMS (MTSI) in terms of network elements?
q_4234.ground_truth: The focus is on network elements involved in the session setup and resource reservation. Clause 6 describes the use cases analyzed, while Clause 7 describes the recommended requirements derived from the gap analysis. Clause 8 describes and evaluates potential solutions, and Clause 9 provides conclusions and recommendations for further standardization efforts.

q_4235.question: What was the agreement in RAN4#101-e regarding the UE's power class in standalone mode?
q_4235.ground_truth: The agreement in RAN4#101-e was that if the UE is scheduled for single antenna-port PUSCH transmission, the power class requirements would apply based on the ue-PowerClass field in capability signaling.

q_4236.question: What is the purpose of the C code provided in the present document and in which systems has it been verified to work?
q_4236.ground_truth: The purpose of the C code provided in the present document is to serve as a standard conforming non-bit-exact implementation of the Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband speech transcoder, Voiced Activity Detection, comfort noise generation, and source controlled rate operation. The C code has been verified to work in IBM PC/AT compatible computers with Windows NT40 and Microsoft Visual C++ v.6.0 compiler and IBM PC/AT compatible computers with Windows NT40 and Intel C/C++ v.4.0 compiler.

q_4237.question: In what mode does the UE proceed if it is operating in the dual-registration mode and receives an MO-IMS-registration-related-signalling-started indication?
q_4237.ground_truth: The UE may proceed in S1 mode with the appropriate EMM specific procedures and ESM procedures to make a PDN connection providing access to IMS available.

q_4238.question: What must the UE do when it receives a UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message from the peer UE in unicast sidelink PC5 RRC connection?
q_4238.ground_truth: The UE must send a UECapabilityInformationSidelink message to the peer UE.

q_4239.question: What is the responsibility of RAN in controlling the rate of sources requesting a guaranteed bitrate?
q_4239.ground_truth: RAN includes a rate control protocol, making it able of controlling the rate of sources requesting this rate, provided that they are periodic and that SDU format information is specified. RAN is allowed to control the rate between Guaranteed bitrate and Maximum bitrate.

q_4240.question: What is the function of the disassembly entity in the MAC-ehs entity in the UE side?
q_4240.ground_truth: The disassembly entity in the MAC-ehs entity in the UE side is responsible for disassembling the MAC-ehs PDUs by removing the MAC-ehs header and possible padding. It discards the MAC-ehs PDU if the L field in MAC-ehs header is zero in 1.28 Mcps TDD.

q_4241.question: What is the definition of a BSS using antenna arrays, as per 4.10.5?
q_4241.ground_truth: A BSS using antenna arrays is defined in 4.10.5 as a cellular communications system that meets at least one of the following conditions: (1) the transmitter output signals from one or more TRX appear at more than one antenna port, (2) there is more than one receiver antenna port for a TRX or per cell and an input signal is required at more than one port for the correct operation of the receiver, or (3) transmitters and receivers are connected via duplexers to more than one antenna.

q_4242.question: What is the impact of phase error on PRS aggregation gains?
q_4242.ground_truth: One source observed that PRS aggregation shows potential gains without modeling phase error, but these gains are lost when the phase error between channel carriers becomes too large.

q_4243.question: Which sampling rate is observed to be higher with a larger subcarrier spacing and channel bandwidth larger than 2 GHz?
q_4243.ground_truth: Higher sampling rates and channel bandwidth larger than 2 GHz are associated with increased complexity.

q_4244.question: In the naming convention, what is the meaning of the symbol w(k) before rearrangement in preliminary channel encoding for EFR only?
q_4244.ground_truth: w(k) represents the kth bit of data delivered by the preliminary channel encoding unit for EFR only before bits rearrangement.

q_4245.question: What potential security threats are identified for EES capability exposure in TS 23.558?
q_4245.ground_truth: Without authentication and authorization, an attacker may eavesdrop, manipulate, or replay the communication on the new interface between UPF and local NEF/local AF/EAS.

q_4246.question: What are the two network types in the UTRAN/GERAN that can be used for the initiation and termination of MBMS transmissions?

q_4247.question: Which facility is required for the Terminal in 27.22.4.22.5.2 in order to support Chinese?
q_4247.ground_truth: The UCS2 facility for the coding of the Chinese character, as defined in: ISO/IEC 1064617a/17b

q_4248.question: In the "Multi-train voice communication for Drivers and Ground FRMCS User(s)" use case, what is the role of the prioritisation application?
q_4248.ground_truth: The prioritisation application is used to manage the priority of the Multi-train voice communication for Drivers and Ground FRMCS User(s) in the "Initiation of Multi-train voice communication for Drivers and Ground FRMCS User(s)" use case.

q_4249.question: What should the UE do if both condition B2-1 and condition B2-2 for entering event B1 are satisfied?
q_4249.ground_truth: The UE should consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied.

q_4250.question: How is the average spectral energy per critical frequency band calculated?
q_4250.ground_truth: The average spectral energy per critical frequency band is calculated by adding up the squared magnitudes of the frequency bins within a critical frequency band and then dividing by the number of bins in that band.

q_4251.question: What step does the MS take if it receives a downlink GA-RRC PDU message before sending the response to a received PTC activation request?
q_4251.ground_truth: The MS shall queue the received GA-RRC PDU message and process the message immediately after completing the PTC activation.

q_4252.question: What is the function of the "Preemption Capability indicator" in the protocol extension container?
q_4252.ground_truth: The "Preemption Capability indicator" in the protocol extension container is used to indicate the behavior of an allocation request in regards to preemption of existing connections. It can indicate that an allocation request may or may not preempt an existing connection.

q_4253.question: What is one of the objectives of the A-interface specification?
q_4253.ground_truth: One objective of the A-interface specification is to allow the connection of various manufacturers' BSSs to the same MSC.

q_4254.question: What is the difference between Pull mode, Push mode, and Combination mode in the context of the present document?
q_4254.ground_truth: Pull mode is when the PFDs are sent by the PFDF at reception of an HTTP request from the PCEF/TDF, Push mode is when the PFDs and/or notification of PFD deletion are sent by the PFDF in an HTTP request to the PCEF/TDF and Combination mode is when both pull and push exist, allowing the PFDF to send the PFDs at reception of an HTTP request from the PCEF/TDF and provision PFD changes (creation/update/deletion) and/or notification of PFD creation/update/deletion in the HTTP request to the PCEF/TDF.

q_4255.question: What message does the source RNC/BSS send to the new SGSN after sending the Handover from UTRAN Command message to the MS?
q_4255.ground_truth: The source RNC sends a Forward SRNS Context (RAB contexts) message to the new SGSN, via the old SGSN.

q_4256.question: What message does the GGSN send to any added or removed SGSN after comparing the new list of downstream nodes with the stored list in the MBMS Bearer Context?
q_4256.ground_truth: MBMS Session Start Request message, MBMS Session Stop Request message, or MBMS Session Update Request message

q_4257.question: What is the purpose of the system information broadcasting function in UMTS?
q_4257.ground_truth: The system information broadcasting function provides the mobile station with the Access Stratum and Non Access Stratum information that are needed by the UE for its operation within the network.

q_4258.question: What is the delivery method switch from shared to individual in Solution 29?
q_4258.ground_truth: Solution 29 in the document addresses reliable delivery mode switching between unicast and multicast for a UE moving between two gNBs, one enhanced for multicast and one not, with shared delivery method at source gNB and individual delivery method at target gNB.

q_4259.question: In the context of TS~24.587, subclause 6.1.2.8.5.1, what is the action taken by the initiating UE when timer T5004 expires, as specified in 13.2.6.2?
q_4259.ground_truth: The initiating UE retransmits the DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE REQUEST message with the last used value of the keep-alive counter and restarts timer T5004.

q_4260.question: If a DCF is used only for controlling signalling, how does the data transfer occur between the data consumer NWDAF and the data provider?
q_4260.ground_truth: In this architecture, the required data is transferred directly between the data consumer NWDAF and the data provider, avoiding additional data transfer steps with the DCCF.

q_4261.question: What procedure does the PDN GW follow for LMA Initiated IPv4 Address Release procedure if UE is assigned both IPv6 HNP and IPv4 HoA?
q_4261.ground_truth: The PDN GW follows the LMA procedure for the LMA Initiated IPv4 Address Release procedure as defined in sub clause 5.7.3.

q_4262.question: What is required for the negotiation of uplink and downlink codecs during a SRF session?
q_4262.ground_truth: Codec negotiation during a SRF session should be optionally supported, and can be motivated by factors such as the expected or observed acoustic environment, the service package purchased by the user, the user profile, or service needs.

q_4263.question: How does Personal UE redirection work in Personal UE Networks?
q_4263.ground_truth: Personal UE redirection in Personal UE Networks allows users to register and deregister UEs to their PN and activate a certain UE as the default UE for terminating services. This enables users to manage their devices and receive communication on their preferred device, even when they have multiple devices.

q_4264.question: What is a use case for multiple spectator views offered with DASH?
q_4264.ground_truth: Media is recorded by multiple spectators of an event in different locations and/or recording orientations on handheld devices and uploaded to a server. The transfer of the media content from the recording device to the server is outside the scope of 3GP-DASH.

q_4265.question: What is the role of the Enhanced Firewall Traversal Function (EFTF) in the FTT-IMS protocol?
q_4265.ground_truth: The EFTF handles the TCP connection setup and TLS connection establishment, and uses the connection as the FTT-IMS after receiving a valid TLS Finished message over the TCP connection.

q_4266.question: What is the difference between fixed-point and floating-point implementations of the AMR-WB speech codec?
q_4266.ground_truth: Fixed-point implementations use integer arithmetic, while floating-point implementations use real number arithmetic. The floating-point implementation of the AMR-WB speech codec may be preferable when the implementation platform is better suited for a floating-point implementation, but the bit-exact fixed-point ANSI-C code remains the preferred implementation for all applications.

q_4267.question: Which European country did Greece achieve independence from in 1829?

q_4268.question: What is needed for an authorized MCVideo User to retrieve and view a video that has been identified in a notification?
q_4268.ground_truth: The MCVideo service shall provide a mechanism for an authorized MCVideo User to retrieve and view a video that has been identified in a notification.

q_4269.question: What is the effect of OTA emissions requirements on the total emissions from the BS?
q_4269.ground_truth: The sum of the total emissions from the BS is intended to be no greater than that of a non-AAS system with equivalent number of MIMO branches, and emission are capped at a level consistent with the maximum MIMO capability of the appropriate RAT.

q_4270.question: What must the VLR derive to address the HLR in the Restore Data procedure?
q_4270.ground_truth: The VLR must derive the HLR's address information from the roaming number request's associated address information. This can be either the IMSI received as a parameter of the MAP message or the Calling Party Address associated with the MAP message.

q_4271.question: What are the primary elements constituting the management domain's MIB in PLMN network CM?
q_4271.ground_truth: The management domain's MIB consists of existing managed objects, with their attributes, in the PLMN network, which may be distributed over multiple OS and NEs.

q_4272.question: What unit is used for the constant bandwidth of 1.25 MHz in SCH (Synchronization Channel) structure for initial cell search?
q_4272.ground_truth: The constant bandwidth of 1.25 MHz is used for the SCH (Synchronization Channel) structure for initial cell search.

q_4273.question: What is an example of two assurance closed loops that can execute related actions on a managed entity, possibly causing a conflict?
q_4273.ground_truth: ACL1 and ACL2 for coverage optimization, which can both change the azimuth to optimize coverage and potentially cause unnecessary coverage-overlap.

q_4274.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the Serving GW in step A2 to confirm the completion of the handover process?

q_4275.question: What is the difference in criticality and presence between the id-Cause and id-SRBID fields in the UEContextReleaseCommandIEs list?
q_4275.ground_truth: The id-Cause field has a criticality of "ignore" and is mandatory, while the id-SRBID field has a criticality of "ignore" and is optional.

q_4276.question: What is the composition of the MT Correlation ID?
q_4276.ground_truth: The MT Correlation ID is composed of the Mobile Country Code (MCC), Mobile Network Code (MNC), and a Sender ID with nine decimal digits.

q_4277.question: What is the maximum allowed accuracy level for AAC-LC test in 3GPP conformance for implementing Enhanced aacPlus audio codec?
q_4277.ground_truth: The maximum allowed accuracy level for AAC-LC test in 3GPP conformance for implementing Enhanced aacPlus audio codec is K<15 for the "RMS/LSB Measurement" test.

q_4278.question: What is the primary purpose of the Multicast rendezvous service in the DVB-MABR Phase 1 reference architecture?
q_4278.ground_truth: The Multicast rendezvous service in the DVB-MABR Phase 1 reference architecture has the primary purpose of specifying a Multicast rendezvous service that makes the delivery system as transparent as possible to the Content playback function, allowing the latter to remain unaware of the multicast optimisation.

q_4279.question: What is the maximum possible value for the long term lag, Lmax, in the implementation of the long term predictor?
q_4279.ground_truth: Lmax is the maximum possible value for the long term lag in the implementation of the long term predictor.

q_4280.question: What information does the "Reliable Inter-RAT Handover Info" element provide to the target BSS?
q_4280.ground_truth: It indicates that the source BSS has received the Inter RAT Handover Info for UTRAN from the SGSN upon successful completion of PS handover or a PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST PDU with "Reliable Inter RAT Handover Info Indicator" set to "1".

q_4281.question: What does the Code specific field in the SCC-AS-id information element specify?
q_4281.ground_truth: The Code specific field in the SCC-AS-id information element specifies the type of information that is used to identify the SCC AS PSI DN.

q_4282.question: What is the role of the Session Description document (SDP) in the MBS User Service Description?
q_4282.ground_truth: The Session Description document (SDP) is referenced in a MBS Distribution Session Description metadata unit and contains information about media streams in the MBS User Service Session.

q_4283.question: What should the BSS do if it receives a BVC-RESET PDU for a BVCI that is unknown to it?
q_4283.ground_truth: The BSS should return a STATUS PDU towards the SGSN including the BVCI and the cause value 'BVCI unknown'.

q_4284.question: In the network initiated mobile originating call establishment with assignment before B party alerting, what message does the network send if the calling user accepts the recall and the call initiation in the fixed network?
q_4284.ground_truth: The CONNECT message and its acknowledgement CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE.

q_4285.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's (3GPP) Technical Specification Group that the given document is a part of?
q_4285.ground_truth: Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication Management

q_4286.question: What is required to solve the difficulty in distinguishing between Priority Service and eMLPP in ISUP and BICC?
q_4286.ground_truth: Expanding the existing MLPP parameter, introducing a new parameter for Priority Service, or reusing an existing parameter in ISUP or BICC.

q_4287.question: What is the purpose of the noisiness parameter in UC mode?
q_4287.ground_truth: The noisiness parameter in UC mode is required for an anti-swirling technique used in the decoder for enhancing the background noise representation during inactive speech.

q_4288.question: What information is included in the commonLocationInfo of the locationInfo when available and detailed location information has not been reported?
q_4288.ground_truth: The locationTimestamp, locationCoordinate, velocityEstimate, locationError, locationSource, and gnss-TOD-msec, if available, are all included in the commonLocationInfo of the locationInfo.

q_4289.question: What is the purpose of the Disassembly function in the MAC-is sublayer?
q_4289.ground_truth: The Disassembly function is responsible for disassembling MAC-is PDUs to extract the MAC-d PDUs and forwarding them to the MAC-d layer.

q_4290.question: What happens when the 3GPP PS data off status changes and the user is registered over EPS IP-CAN, GPRS IP-CAN and 5GS IP-CAN?
q_4290.ground_truth: When the 3GPP PS data off status changes, the UE reregisters over EPS IP-CAN, GPRS IP-CAN, and 5GS IP-CAN.

q_4291.question: Why might AF1 decide to relocate to AF2?
q_4291.ground_truth: AF1 might decide to relocate to AF2 due to a decision to relocate to a local Edge Application Server, due to a change in DNAI, or due to EAS load balancing.

q_4292.question: What should the UE do when a higher priority NG-RAN PLMN becomes available while camped on an NG-RAN VPLMN cell?
q_4292.ground_truth: The UE should select and camp on a cell of the highest priority PLMN and attempt registration with mobility on the selected cell when the higher priority PLMN search timer T expires.

q_4293.question: What is the requirement for the minimum average relative code domain error dB for 64QAM modulated codes?
q_4293.ground_truth: The average relative code domain error for 64QAM modulated codes shall not exceed -21 dB at spreading factor 16.

q_4294.question: How many reception sites are needed to obtain a unique location estimate using the U-TDOA method?
q_4294.ground_truth: A minimum of four reception sites are needed to obtain a unique location estimate.

q_4295.question: What type of AVP is the Supported-Features AVP?
q_4295.ground_truth: The Supported-Features AVP is of type grouped.

q_4296.question: What should the UE do when it receives a downlink assignment with MAC PDU scheduled for its G-RNTI and decodes it successfully in the NR cell?
q_4296.ground_truth: The UE does not send HARQ feedback and forwards the MAC PDU to the higher layer.

q_4297.question: What is the significance of the second digit in the version number of the 3GPP Technical Specification documents?
q_4297.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates.

q_4298.question: What is the single-step, single delay unit, non-recursive filter used in the Adaptive Multi-Rate codec?
q_4298.ground_truth: The single-step, single delay unit, non-recursive filter used in the Adaptive Multi-Rate codec is referred to as the adaptive codebook. It contains excitation vectors that are adapted for every subframe and derived from the long-term filter state.

q_4299.question: What measures can be taken to protect against UC in real-time applications?
q_4299.ground_truth: Content filtering mechanisms may be unlikely to be effective against real-time UC.

q_4300.question: What action does the IMS-ALG take when it sends an SDP offer and creates a new DTLS association identity?
q_4300.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG includes the "a=tls-id" SDP attribute with the new DTLS association identity in the SDP offer.

q_4301.question: What is the first message sent from the SRNC to the DRNC in the Radio Link Addition (Branch Addition) procedure?
q_4301.ground_truth: In the Radio Link Addition (Branch Addition) procedure, the SRNC sends the RNSAP message Radio Link Setup Request to the DRNC as the first message.

q_4302.question: What does the CSE instruct the IPLMN/VPLMN to do when the calling party abandon event occurs in notify mode?
q_4302.ground_truth: Notify the CSE and continue with the call.

q_4303.question: How many 3G cells can the GPRS 3G Cell Reselection list contain at most, in a cell with a PBCCH allocated?

q_4304.question: What is the process of requesting flight authorization from the UTM/USS for a UAV flight?
q_4304.ground_truth: The process involves the UAS operator requesting flight authorization from the UTM/USS, which then assigns a Flight Authorisation ID to associate the authorized flight with the UAV.

q_4305.question: What are the different enhancements introduced in the WI on NR demodulation performance?
q_4305.ground_truth: The different enhancements introduced in the WI on NR demodulation performance are PDSCH demodulation and CQI reporting requirements of MMSE-IRC receiver for suppressing inter-cell interference in FR1 with slot-based transmission and aligned SCS among cells scenario, and PDSCH demodulation requirements of MMSE-IRC receiver for suppressing intra-cell inter-user interference in FR1 with slot-based transmission and aligned SCS among cells scenario.

q_4306.question: When does the integrity check fail in the downlink integrity protection procedure?
q_4306.ground_truth: The integrity check fails if the calculated expected message authentication code and the received message authentication code differ, during the downlink integrity protection procedure.

q_4307.question: What are the aspects considered for adopting option b) within option 2?
q_4307.ground_truth: The aspects considered are QoE metrics, network control, unified QoE measurements, and network optimization.

q_4308.question: What is the priority of the first HARQ-ACK codebook when a UE is indicated to generate two HARQ-ACK codebooks?
q_4308.ground_truth: The first HARQ-ACK codebook is associated with a PUCCH of priority index 0.

q_4309.question: What is the frequency range for which OTA requirements only will be introduced into the requirements for this mm Wave frequency range in NR?
q_4309.ground_truth: The frequency range for which OTA requirements only will be introduced into the requirements for this mm Wave frequency range in NR is above 24 GHz.

q_4310.question: What is the responsibility of the Actor function in the functional framework for RAN intelligence?
q_4310.ground_truth: The Actor function receives the output from the Model Inference function and triggers or performs corresponding actions, which may include triggering actions directed to other entities or to itself. It may also provide feedback needed to derive training data, inference data or to monitor the performance of the AI/ML Model and its impact to the network.

q_4311.question: What action is taken by the SGSN regarding active PDP contexts in the GGSNs when the SGSN is informed that it has been detached by the MS in the HLR-Initiated Detach Procedure?
q_4311.ground_truth: The active PDP contexts in the GGSNs regarding this particular MS are deactivated by the SGSN sending Delete PDP Context Request (TEID, CGI/SAI) messages to the GGSNs.

q_4312.question: In the calculation of TBS, what is the purpose of the round function and how are ties broken?
q_4312.ground_truth: The round function is used to determine the value of TBS. In the case of ties, the ties are broken towards the next largest integer.

q_4313.question: What is the step where the P-CSCF~(IMS-ALG) sends the updated SDP answer to the core network in the IMS terminating session set-up procedures for one MSRP media stream using e2ae security, where the IMS-ALG requests sending an outgoing TCP bearer establishment?

q_4314.question: What recommendation is given regarding user-influenced access system selection for an AIPN?
q_4314.ground_truth: An AIPN shall provide support for access system selection based on combinations of AIPN operator policies, user preferences, service requirements of applications, access system conditions, and/or other AIPN operator-defined criteria.

q_4315.question: What message does the UE send to the ProSe Function in the HPLMN when it receives a ProSe Restricted Code over the air that matches the Discovery Filter and it doesn't have a corresponding RPAUID?
q_4315.ground_truth: The UE sends a Match Report (RPAUID, UE Identity, Discovery Type, Application ID, ProSe Restricted Code, Metadata Requested, Monitored PLMN ID) message to the ProSe Function in the HPLMN to get the Target RPAUID.

q_4316.question: What is the significance of the fully allocated bits in the first-stage iterations of the bit allocation process?
q_4316.ground_truth: The fully allocated bits in the first-stage iterations represent the number of bits assigned to each band after the initial allocation. These values serve as a starting point for the iterative process of re-distributing the allocated bits to the bands with non-zero bits.

q_4317.question: What type of security context does the MME try to obtain from the AMF when receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message from the UE?
q_4317.ground_truth: The MME tries to obtain a mapped EPS security context from the AMF.

q_4318.question: In 6.2.6.1, what is the role of the "intelligent routeing function" in the provision of business trunking applications?
q_4318.ground_truth: The "intelligent routeing function" is responsible for the provision of business trunking applications, and may involve an Application Server (AS) depending on the actual enterprise specific data.

q_4319.question: What is the significance of the version numbering in the 3GPP Technical Specification documents?
q_4319.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the approval status, the second digit is incremented for changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial changes.

q_4320.question: What is the role of CHF in 5G Converged Charging System for network slice management?
q_4320.ground_truth: The CHF enforces slice quota management associated with attributes in the GST, including Maximum number of UEs and Maximum number of PDU sessions, based on Slice SLA availability.

q_4321.question: What should the UE do if it fails to transmit the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message or AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message indication from lower layers during a 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure triggered by a service request procedure?
q_4321.ground_truth: The UE should stop the timer T3520, if running. If the current TAI is not in the TAI list, the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure should be aborted and a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update should be initiated.

q_4322.question: What should be set in the measResultServingCell when the UE is in any cell selection state?
q_4322.ground_truth: The measResultServingCell should be set to include the quantities of the last logged cell the UE was camping on.

q_4323.question: What is the maximum allowed number of spurious response frequencies in the in-band frequency region for DCS 1800 and PCS 1900 MS?
q_4323.ground_truth: The maximum allowed number of spurious response frequencies in the in-band frequency region for DCS 1800 and PCS 1900 MS is two.

q_4324.question: What is the priority group order for selecting a synchronization reference if sl-SyncPriority corresponding to the concerned frequency is set to gnbEnb?
q_4324.ground_truth: The priority group order is (1) UEs of which SLSSID is part of the set defined for in coverage, and inCoverage is set to true; (2) UEs of which SLSSID is part of the set defined for in coverage, and inCoverage is set to false; (3) GNSS that is reliable; (4) UEs of which SLSSID is 0, and inCoverage is set to true or SLSS is transmitted on slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3; (5) UEs of which SLSSID is 0 and SLSS is not transmitted on slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3, and inCoverage is set to false; (6) UEs of which SLSSID is 337 and inCoverage is set to false; (6) Other UEs.

q_4325.question: What should the UE do when initiating the procedure to transfer measurement results from the UE to the network after successful AS security activation?
q_4325.ground_truth: The UE should set the measResults within the MeasurementReport message to include the best neighbouring cells up to maxReportCells. The cells should be ordered in decreasing order of the sorting quantity. The physCellId should be included for each cell that is included in the measResultNeighCells.

q_4326.question: What is the purpose of including routing rules in step 2 during the addition of an untrusted WLAN access using S2b?
q_4326.ground_truth: Including routing rules in this step allows the UE to add a new access to a multi-access PDN connection without an associated routing rule, and it also enables IP address preservation by including the same IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) that was allocated during its attachment to 3GPP access.

q_4327.question: How do the EVS modes impact speech quality and intelligibility compared to AMR-WB?
q_4327.ground_truth: The EVS modes offer significantly improved voice quality over "HD Voice" center of cell experience for 80% of links, while AMR-WB meets the reference speech intelligibility for unicast bearers but not for LTE-D bearers or MBMS SC-PTM bearers.

q_4328.question: What is the purpose of the delay introduced by the hybrid filter bank?
q_4328.ground_truth: The delay introduced by the hybrid filter bank is 6 subband samples, which is used for synchronization in the parametric stereo processing.

q_4329.question: What is the format of the MeasurementReport-vd20ext-IEs sequence?
q_4329.ground_truth: The MeasurementReport-vd20ext-IEs sequence is a SEQUENCE that consists of the measuredResults field and the applicationLayerMeasurementReporting field, both of which are optional.

q_4330.question: What is the purpose of the T21.MOD control file in relation to the mode switching sequence?
q_4330.ground_truth: The T21.MOD control file is used together with the mode switching sequence for testing. It specifies the format of the control file.

q_4331.question: What is the protocol for CELL SETUP REQUEST FDD?
q_4331.ground_truth: The protocol for CELL SETUP REQUEST FDD is described in 3GPP TS25.331."

q_4332.question: What is the flag of frame type set to if the smaller value between the number of frequency points of the MDCT coefficients and 200 is greater than a threshold for a certain frame?
q_4332.ground_truth: If the smaller value between the number of frequency points of the MDCT coefficients and 200 is greater than a threshold, the flag of frame type is set to non-tonal type.

q_4333.question: When should the MS start transmitting RTP packets with the new size?
q_4333.ground_truth: The MS should start transmitting RTP packets with the new size after sending the GA-CSR CHANNEL MODE MODIFY ACKNOWLEDGE message.

q_4334.question: Which network parameters should the GSM SS transmit on for the second BCCH in the initial conditions of step 7.4.2.4.1?
q_4334.ground_truth: The GSM SS should transmit on the second BCCH with the network parameters MCC=244, MNC=081, and LAC=0001.

q_4335.question: What is the purpose of a Time reference cell in Multiflow mode?
q_4335.ground_truth: The Time reference cell is used as the time reference for the uplink HS-DPCCH when operating in Multiflow mode.

q_4336.question: What is the consequence of not providing flow control at the L2R function?
q_4336.ground_truth: No flow control initiation/removal will take place by the MSC/IWF, and data might be lost without any indication by the MSC/IWF to the end systems involved.

q_4337.question: How many files are listed in the REFRESH command with 3G Session Reset procedure for the IMSI changing procedure?
q_4337.ground_truth: Two files are listed, which are EF IMSI and EF EPSLOCI.

q_4338.question: What is the transport protocol used by the eIMS-AGW to send and receive SRTP/SRTCP packets over TCP when the DTLS session is established between the WIC and the eIMS-AGW?
