q_4339.question: When is an extended idle mode DRX parameter included in the Attach Request message during the GPRS Attach procedure?
q_4339.ground_truth: The extended idle mode DRX parameter is included in the Attach Request message if the MS needs to enable extended idle mode DRX during the GPRS Attach procedure.

q_4340.question: What are some of the main features of the Multimedia Priority Service?
q_4340.ground_truth: The Multimedia Priority Service allows qualified and authorized users to obtain priority access to the next available radio channel, provides end-to-end priority treatment, and sets uniform, nationwide operating access procedures.

q_4341.question: What is the initial condition for the intermodulation characteristic test in the 1,28 Mcps TDD option?
q_4341.ground_truth: An UE simulator operating at the assigned channel frequency of the wanted signal and two signal generators should be connected to the antenna connector of one Rx port, with the other Rx ports disabled.

q_4342.question: What is the relationship between the "elementary procedures" and the "structured procedures" in the layer 3 protocol?
q_4342.ground_truth: The layer 3 protocol consists of "elementary procedures" that are provided by the protocol control entities of the three sublayers: Radio Resource Management, Mobility Management, and Connection Management. Complete layer 3 transactions consist of specific sequences of elementary procedures, which are called "structured procedures."

q_4343.question: What does the "PAUSE" request in MMCMH RTCP feedback messages indicate?
q_4343.ground_truth: The "PAUSE" request in MMCMH RTCP feedback messages is used to request an RTP stream sender to pause an RTP stream, allowing for a more efficient use of resources during multi-stream multparty conferences.

q_4344.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced CDRX scheme in FR1, DL only evaluation, InH, VR45?
q_4344.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced CDRX scheme in FR1, DL only evaluation, InH, VR45 is 20.81%.

q_4345.question: What is the RSTD measurement reporting delay for Test 1 and Test 2 in the TDD 3 DL CA RSTD Measurement Reporting Delay test?
q_4345.ground_truth: The RSTD measurement reporting delay for Test 1 is 2560 ms and for Test 2 is 4960 ms.

q_4346.question: What is the purpose of the Traffic-Data-Volumes AVP and what type of AVP is it?
q_4346.ground_truth: The Traffic-Data-Volumes AVP is of type Grouped, and its purpose is to allow the transmission of the IP-CAN bearer container, on encountering change on charging condition for this IP-CAN bearer.

q_4347.question: In what scenario would a radio bearer be mapped to the DCCH and have IE "DCCH Fallback" set to TRUE?
q_4347.ground_truth: When the radio bearer is mapped to the DCCH and the network has indicated that fallback to the DCCH is allowed for the radio bearer.

q_4348.question: In the "GANSS-PositioningInstructions-ExtIEs" PCAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION, what is the meaning of the "CRITICALITY" field in the "ID" field within the "id-MeasurementValidity" structure?
q_4348.ground_truth: The "CRITICALITY" field in the "ID" field in the "id-MeasurementValidity" structure in the "GANSS-PositioningInstructions-ExtIEs" PCAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION represents the criticality of the ID. It belongs to the "criticality" enumeration type. It can take values such as "IGNORE" (if the extension should not be used) or "MANDATORY" (if the extension must be used).

q_4349.question: What should be included in the SDP offer when sending a SIP INVITE request to establish an MCPTT call?
q_4349.ground_truth: The SDP offer should include a media stream of the offered media-floor control entity and comply with the clarification given in clause 6.1.1 of 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_4350.question: What is the purpose of the restricted feature of the UE to allow AMF re-allocation via the RAN?
q_4350.ground_truth: The purpose of this feature is to ensure secure signalling between the initial AMF and the UE when the UE supports the enhanced functionality to allow AMF re-allocation via the RAN as a non-cleartext IE in the case the Registration Request contains a GUTI.

q_4351.question: What should the UE do if it fails to transmit the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message during a mobility registration update procedure that triggered a 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure?
q_4351.ground_truth: The UE should re-initiate the mobility registration update procedure.

q_4352.question: What is the suggested size of the EPS (Evolved Packet System) reporting related information that can be sent at attach/tunnel activation on interfaces s2a and s2c, session modification, detach/tunnel deactivation, start of interception with active tunnel etc.?
q_4352.ground_truth: The allowed size of the information is not specified.

q_4353.question: What must be done by the SCC AS before sending a request to UE-2 to become the new Controller UE?
q_4353.ground_truth: The SCC AS must ensure that UE-2 can act as the Controller UE and that it shares the same service profile as UE-1.

q_4354.question: What triggers the registration of an Application Server to the MSGin5G Server?
q_4354.ground_truth: The Application Server is responsible for triggering the registration to the MSGin5G Server.

q_4355.question: What does the SABM command do in the data link layer?
q_4355.ground_truth: The SABM command is used to place the addressed user side or network side into the modulo 8 multiple frame acknowledged operation.

q_4356.question: What is the method header for the getValueByte method?
q_4356.ground_truth: public byte getValueByte(short valueOffset) throws ToolkitException

q_4357.question: What are the three measurement types defined for GTP-U protocol entity on the Gn interface for outgoing GTP signalling packets, from SGSN to GGSN?

q_4358.question: Which software tool was used to develop the Software Tool used for the optimization of the Half Rate GSM codec?
q_4358.ground_truth: The "IUT-T Software Tool Library Manual," ITU-T Users' Group on Software Tools, Geneva, May 1996, was used to develop the Software Tool used for the optimization of the Half Rate GSM codec.

q_4359.question: What should the E-SMLC do if the requested location information and the location accuracy within the QoS can be satisfied based on parameters received from the MME?
q_4359.ground_truth: If the requested location information and the location accuracy within the QoS can be satisfied based on parameters received from the MME, the E-SMLC may send a Location Response immediately. If the requested location information indicates a last known location, the E-SMLC shall determine a last known location based on the cell identity and send a Location Response immediately.

q_4360.question: What is the abbreviation for E-DCH Dedicated Physical Control Channel in 3GPP TR 21.905?

q_4361.question: What is the function of the Alpha-Identifier in EF~SMSP?
q_4361.ground_truth: It is a unique alpha tag for the associated SMS-parameter stored within a record.

q_4362.question: What should a UE do in a limited service state to camp on a RAT?
q_4362.ground_truth: A UE in a limited service state should camp on a RAT which is likely to support emergency calls.

q_4363.question: In the procedure of Release due to BSS generated reasons, what role does the MSC-I take?
q_4363.ground_truth: The MSC-I acts as the BSS in the Release due to BSS generated reasons procedure.

q_4364.question: If the UE is in manual PLMN selection mode and the current VPLMN is not part of the "PLMNs where registration was aborted due to SOR" list or the "User Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list, and the UE receives steering of roaming information for initial registration in a VPLMN but the security check is unsuccessful, what should the UE do?
q_4364.ground_truth: The UE should send the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the serving AMF without including an SOR transparent container and stay on this VPLMN.

q_4365.question: Which network entities are notified of the authentication result in Solution #20?
q_4365.ground_truth: The SMF is notified of the authentication result in Solution #20.

q_4366.question: What is not available in FDD in terms of transmit diversity handling for multi-cell operation?
q_4366.ground_truth: Cell-specific Tx diversity handling for multi-cell operation is not available in FDD.

q_4367.question: What is the purpose of the APN Control List service as defined in TS 31.102?
q_4367.ground_truth: The APN Control List service is used to control the list of allowed APNs (Access Point Names) that a UE can use when connecting to the E-UTRAN/EPC.

q_4368.question: What is the test purpose for 8.1.6.3.4.1?
q_4368.ground_truth: The test purpose is to ensure that the UE properly handles Bluetooth measurement logging and reporting in the event of a connection establishment failure.

q_4369.question: What are the potential requirements for network slice resource allocation that the existing 3GPP management system capabilities cannot support?
q_4369.ground_truth: The existing 3GPP management system capabilities cannot support granular isolation requirements for network slice and flexible inclusion/exclusion rules between network slices.

q_4370.question: What is the user login and password required to access the "TestGp.rs" network access name?
q_4370.ground_truth: The user login is "UserLog" and the user password is "UserPwd" for the "TestGp.rs" network access name.

q_4371.question: What message is sent by the MT to the TE to confirm receipt of the command indicating that all incoming SMS messages are to be transferred?

q_4372.question: What are the factors affecting the overall performance for ER tools in video telephony calls?
q_4372.ground_truth: The two main factors are the video bitrate and the frame rate, while other factors like video resolution, content, and codec type have minimal impact.

q_4373.question: How does the MBMS client select a file repair URI from the list of provided URIs in the Associated Delivery procedure fragment?
q_4373.ground_truth: Within a list of one or more types of file repair URIs, the UE randomly selects one of the service URIs from the list, with uniform distribution. The priority of file repair URI lists is: byte-range based repair servers included as "Alternate-Content-Location-1", byte-range based repair servers included as "Alternate-Content-Location-2", and symbol-based repair servers.

q_4374.question: What does a high inter-correlation among dependent variables in the GAL test plan indicate?
q_4374.ground_truth: A high degree of inter-correlation among dependent variables indicates the presence of a reduced set of underlying variables.

q_4375.question: What does best effort QoS refer to in the document?
q_4375.ground_truth: Best effort QoS refers to the lowest quality of service traffic class; if guaranteed QoS cannot be delivered, this is the QoS that will be provided.

q_4376.question: What is the meaning of "donor coupling loss" as defined in the document?
q_4376.ground_truth: Donor coupling loss is the coupling loss between the repeater and the donor base station.

q_4377.question: What is the default action taken by the MGCF if it forwards a SIP request and Max-Forwards header, and if the MGCF does not forward Max-Forwards decremented by one or set the Max-Forwards header to a default value?
q_4377.ground_truth: The MGCF shall reject the request with a 483 (Too Many Hops) SIP final response.

q_4378.question: What operation is used to check for the continued existence of a relationship between the gsmSCF and IM-SSF in CAMEL Phase 4 for IP Multimedia call sessions?
q_4378.ground_truth: The ActivityTest procedure is used to check for the continued existence of a relationship between the gsmSCF and IM-SSF in CAMEL Phase 4 for IP Multimedia call sessions.

q_4379.question: What is the format of the Auth Response message if restricted Direct Discovery with application-controlled extension is used in step 2.b?
q_4379.ground_truth: The Auth Response message includes the ProSe Restricted Code Suffix pool which contains the Suffix(es) allocated by the ProSe Application based on the inputs in step 2.a.

q_4380.question: What is the typical data rate (in Mbit/s) for a process automation sensor that sends images for health monitoring of plant assets such as pumps, pipes, instruments, etc.?

q_4381.question: What should the mobile station do if it loses the voice group call channel or voice broadcast channel?
q_4381.ground_truth: The mobile station shall search all possible channel positions on the current cell and the neighbor cells for which a channel description is known for that call.

q_4382.question: What is the role of an IRPVersion in the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_4382.ground_truth: An IRPVersion uniquely identifies a supported Interface IRP SS or NRM IRP SS in the 3GPP technical specifications.

q_4383.question: When should the IWF modify the SIP 200 (OK) response to a SIP re-INVITE request as specified in clause~6.3.3.2.3.2 with the IWF acting as the controlling function?
q_4383.ground_truth: The IWF should modify the SIP 200 (OK) response if the SIP response has not yet been sent towards the inviting MCPTT client and it is specified in clause~6.3.3.2.3.2 with the IWF acting as the controlling function.

q_4384.question: For which modulation schemes do the BTS requirements for RX performance apply for higher symbol rate?
q_4384.ground_truth: The BTS requirements for RX performance based on input signals using wide pulse shaping filter apply for modulation schemes using higher symbol rate.

q_4385.question: Where is the information stored in subclause 8.2.1 duplicated?
q_4385.ground_truth: The information stored in subclause 8.2.1 needs to be stored in both the SIM and USIM.

q_4386.question: What is the function of the Stop-All Indicator IE in a warning message?
q_4386.ground_truth: The Stop-All Indicator IE indicates that all messages in the area should be referred to and the cells in the area should be forced into their Warning Message Delivery initial state.

q_4387.question: Which type of data is used for Operator Determined Barring and where is it stored conditionally?
q_4387.ground_truth: Operator Determined Barring uses permanent data that is stored conditionally in the HLR, SGSN, MME, VLR, and HSS.

q_4388.question: What message is sent by the HNB-GW to the HNB when the IURH setup procedure is unsuccessful?
q_4388.ground_truth: The IURH SETUP FAILURE message is sent by the HNB-GW to the HNB when the IURH setup procedure is unsuccessful.

q_4389.question: What is a home environment requirement for multicast services?
q_4389.ground_truth: The PLMN operator shall be able to provision one or more multicast services, with individual multicast service areas that may overlap and cover parts of one or more PLMNs.

q_4390.question: What does the UDR facility represent in the 3GPP UDC system?
q_4390.ground_truth: The UDR, or User Data Repository, is a facility where user data can be accessed, stored, and managed in a common way.

q_4391.question: What is the purpose of the Client Information API in the solution described?
q_4391.ground_truth: The Client Information API is used to enable Edge Application Servers to use the services of an Edge Enabler Server, such that it can be provided with information about capabilities of Edge Enabler Clients and Application Clients, as well as facilitate communication with the Application Clients. The API is based on the existing EEC (Edge Enabled Client) registration procedure defined in Solution #8.

q_4392.question: What information does the EARFCN-Extended define?

q_4393.question: In base 10, 16 different polynomials are used in division. What is the relationship of the Reed Solomon code polynomial with these polynomials?
q_4393.ground_truth: The Reed Solomon common polynomials, which have a wide variety of applications, are used in Galois field division in conjunction with these polynomials.

q_4394.question: What factors determine the EIRP level for the repeater?
q_4394.ground_truth: The EIRP level is calculated using the Repeater unwanted emission level at the antenna connector, Repeater antenna gain, and feeder loss.

q_4395.question: What is the code power of the last transmitted PRACH preamble plus the power offset between the power of the last transmitted preamble and the initial DPCCH transmission power in the equation for initial E-TFC restriction for UE in CELL_FACH state and Idle mode?
q_4395.ground_truth: An estimate of PDPCCH, target = Ppreamble + PP-e

q_4396.question: Why is authorization of NF service consumers for data access via DCCF necessary in 5GS?
q_4396.ground_truth: To ensure that only authorized data consumers can access data from a data source via the DCCF and to access data from DRF (directly or via DCCF). This is necessary to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive data and ensure system security.

q_4397.question: What is the quality measure reported by the UE to the NAS if the high-quality criterion is met?
q_4397.ground_truth: The quality measure reported by the UE to the NAS is the same for each PLMN found in one cell if the high-quality criterion is met.

q_4398.question: What is the recommended audio mixing gain in the WI on ITT4RT for enhanced user experience in immersive teleconferencing and telepresence?
q_4398.ground_truth: The recommended audio mixing gain in the WI on ITT4RT for enhanced user experience in immersive teleconferencing and telepresence is 6dB.

q_4399.question: In what circumstances can the H-GMLC initiate the cancellation procedure for an outstanding Deferred Location Request?
q_4399.ground_truth: The H-GMLC may initiate the cancellation procedure if the UE's privacy profile stored in the H-GMLC or in the PPR was changed, or if the expiry of the validity timer specified by the start time and stop time, or if the expiry of an implementation dependent timer specified by the Operator as a default value in the R-GMLC when the stop time is undefined or exceeds the maximum allowed value.

q_4400.question: What is the service type in this case in the 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_4400.ground_truth: The service type is set to 'mobile terminating call'.

q_4401.question: When would a PTC Instant Personal Alert Report Record be sent from the MF/DF to the LEMF?
q_4401.ground_truth: When an Instant Personal Alert (IPA) is initiated or sent to the PTC target, the PTC Instant Personal Alert Report Record is sent.

q_4402.question: What is the purpose of the Decomposition process described in section 5.9.1, and what are its pre-conditions?
q_4402.ground_truth: The Decomposition process is triggered by the operator to cancel the dynamically established cooperation between the 3GPP network and the I-WLAN. Its pre-conditions are that both the 3GPP network and the nomadic I-WLAN are Core Network Communications Nodes, and they are composed following the use case in section 5.2.1. The 3GPP operator should trigger the Decomposition process.

q_4403.question: What are the two ways of realizing Timed Graphics in 3GPP?
q_4403.ground_truth: The two ways of realizing Timed Graphics in 3GPP are SVG-based timed graphics, where the layout and timing are controlled by the SVG scene, and simple timed graphics mode, where a binary representation format is defined to enable simple embedding of graphics elements.

q_4404.question: What should be the value of the Expires header field when sending a de-affiliation request in the SIP PUBLISH request?
q_4404.ground_truth: The Expires header field should be set to zero when sending a de-affiliation request in the SIP PUBLISH request.

q_4405.question: What must the SGSN do if the MS includes the Tear down indicator at PDP Context Deactivation initiated by MS in the Deactivate PDP Context Request message?
q_4405.ground_truth: The SGSN shall include the Teardown Ind information element with its value set to "1" in the Delete PDP Context Request message to the GGSN.

q_4406.question: What is the order in which resources are allocated to logical channels?
q_4406.ground_truth: Resources are allocated to logical channels in a decreasing priority order based on the Bj value. If the PBR of a logical channel is set to infinity, the MAC entity shall allocate resources for all the data that is available for transmission on the logical channel before meeting the PBR of the lower priority logical channel(s). If any resources remain, all the logical channels are served in a strict decreasing priority order until either the data for that logical channel or the UL grant is exhausted.

q_4407.question: What should the UE consider to satisfy the entering condition for a specific event in the measurement reporting procedure?
q_4407.ground_truth: The UE should consider the entering condition for a specific event to be satisfied when the inequality A2-1 is fulfilled. This inequality specifies that Ms + Hys < Thresh, where Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell (taking into account any offsets), Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event.

q_4408.question: What should the UE include in the response for multi-cell operation in more than two cells?
q_4408.ground_truth: If the UE supports multi-cell operation in more than two cells, it should include the "More than two cell or MIMO mode with four transmit antennas support" information element and set it to either "higher rate" or "lower rate" depending on whether the UE supports HS-DSCH category 30, 32, 34, 35, 36, 38, or 37.

q_4409.question: What is the main purpose of network slicing in the 5GS as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501 clause 5.15?
q_4409.ground_truth: The main purpose of network slicing is to support network service differentiation and meet the diversified requirements from tenants like vertical industries.

q_4410.question: What is the purpose of the TMGI Deallocation Procedure?
q_4410.ground_truth: The TMGI Deallocation Procedure is used by the GCS AS to immediately release a set of TMGIs, irrespective of their expiration times.

q_4411.question: When is the session management based network slice admission control not applicable for a PDU session?
q_4411.ground_truth: The session management based network slice admission control is not applicable for PDU sessions for emergency services, priority services, or onboarding services in SNPN.

q_4412.question: What are the potential device features that could impact the user experience of VR services?
q_4412.ground_truth: A typical VR device may include features such as screen size, resolution, pixel size, field of view, refresh rate, head-tracking/eye-tracking latency, degree of freedom, weight, and audio bandwidth. All of these features could potentially impact the user experience.

q_4413.question: What is the impact of Solution #52 on the N2 protocol interface?
q_4413.ground_truth: Solution #52 does not introduce any new impacts on the N2 protocol interface.

q_4414.question: What can the offerer do when it learns that the answerer will not use the multistream functionality, to optimize bandwidth allocation?
q_4414.ground_truth: The offerer can send an updated SDP offer where the multistream functionality is disabled, and adjust the bandwidth accordingly.

q_4415.question: What must the network do in order to provide the UE with the mapped EPS bearer context for a PDU session when interworking with EPS is supported for a PDU session before attempting to transfer it from N1 mode to S1 mode?
q_4415.ground_truth: The SMF must provide the UE with the mapped EPS bearer context for a PDU session.

q_4416.question: What is the role of the OCS in the voice call service online charging architecture?
q_4416.ground_truth: The OCS (Online Charging System) is responsible for processing online charging requests for voice call services. The OCS utilizes Diameter Ro for the voice call service online charging as specified in the 3GPP document.

q_4417.question: What message is sent by a mobile station when certain conditions are met in CCN mode?
q_4417.ground_truth: A PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION message is sent by a mobile station when the specified conditions are met in CCN mode, indicating the CSG cell as the target cell.

q_4418.question: What means does the 3GPP system support for MPS activation when data service is congested?
q_4418.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support a means for MPS for DTS activation when data service is congested at the request of the MPS Service User or IoT device and a means for MPS for DTS activation when data service is congested at the request of a roaming MPS Service User.

q_4419.question: In the context of HS-DSCH and E-DCH, what is the size of a transport block set?
q_4419.ground_truth: The transport block set consists of one transport block only in the case of HS-DSCH and E-DCH.

q_4420.question: What would be the impact on legacy UEs if a 50 MHz bandwidth option for FR2 UEs is used?
q_4420.ground_truth: If a 50 MHz bandwidth option for FR2 UEs is used, it may result in coverage loss for PDCCH reception in CORESET#0 and require scheduling restrictions, impacting legacy UEs.

q_4421.question: What is the expected behavior of an ETWS incapable UE when it receives the ETWS PRIMARY NOTIFICATION WITH SECURITY message?
q_4421.ground_truth: An ETWS incapable UE is expected to ignore the ETWS PRIMARY NOTIFICATION WITH SECURITY message when it is received.

q_4422.question: What is a "Registration Area" as defined in the document?
q_4422.ground_truth: A "Registration Area" is an area in which the UE may roam without a need to perform location registration, which is a NAS procedure.

q_4423.question: In scenario 1.4, what is the role of the Legacy 3GPP Message Gateway in the communication between UE1 and UE2 when both are connected to the 5G system?
q_4423.ground_truth: The Legacy 3GPP Message Gateway converts the message format between UE1 and UE2, enabling communication between MSGin5G UE and Legacy 3GPP UE.

q_4424.question: What is the expression for the measurement result of the inter-RAT neighbor cell in dBm or in dB, depending on the measurement quantity of the inter-RAT neighbor cell?

q_4425.question: What is the User controlled PLMN selector list in the context of 3GPP UEs?
q_4425.ground_truth: The User controlled PLMN selector list is a list of preferred PLMNs provided by the user in order of priority on which the UE shall register.

q_4426.question: What should the MAC entity do if the ra-ResponseWindowBFR expires and the PDCCH addressed to the C-RNTI has not been received?
q_4426.ground_truth: If the ra-ResponseWindowBFR expires and the PDCCH addressed to the C-RNTI has not been received, the UE should retransmit the PRACH Preamble.

q_4427.question: What is the main focus of section 5.2 in the report?
q_4427.ground_truth: Section 5.2 of the report discusses the resolution of issues that arise when two operators have a CS (Circuit Switched) roaming agreement but no GPRS roaming agreement. This can cause the user's SIM to be invalidated for GPRS service, leading to inconsistencies in GPRS service levels. The report suggests a modification to the GPRS specifications to address this issue.

q_4428.question: What action does the IWF perform when a user is no longer affiliated to an MCPTT group in the second scenario?
q_4428.ground_truth: The IWF shall determine that the user homed in the IWF is not affiliated to the MCPTT group at the determined client and skip the rest of the steps.

q_4429.question: What information is included in the Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation during PDU session establishment?
q_4429.ground_truth: The indication of Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation is included in the Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation.

q_4430.question: What is the difference between BTS output power on frames containing PBCCH or PPCH and on other PDCH radio blocks?
q_4430.ground_truth: The BTS shall use constant power on those PDCH radio blocks which contain PBCCH or PPCH. This power may be lower than the output power used on BCCH. On the other PDCH radio blocks, downlink power control may be used. Thus, a procedure may be implemented in the network to control the power of the downlink transmission based on the Channel Quality Reports.

q_4431.question: What is the representative value for PDSCH for RedCap UE with maximum 50MHz BW and 1Rx?
q_4431.ground_truth: The representative value for PDSCH is approximately 2.2 dB for RedCap UE with maximum 50MHz BW and 1Rx.

q_4432.question: What is the encapsulation format required for 5GMS downlink and uplink streaming in 3GPP services?
q_4432.ground_truth: Common Media Application Format (CMAF) encapsulation as defined in ISO/IEC 23000-19.

q_4433.question: What is the "current MM system information" for a UE in RRC idle mode?
q_4433.ground_truth: The "current MM system information" for a UE in RRC idle mode is the broadcasted MM system information of the chosen cell, which is determined by the UE idle mode cell selection/re-selection process.

q_4434.question: What is the packet switched domain in the context of GSM/UMTS?
q_4434.ground_truth: The packet switched domain is a domain within GSM/UMTS where data is transferred in packet switched mode, and it corresponds to the term "GPRS".

q_4435.question: What are two features of HSDPA that affect the handling of multimedia telephony?
q_4435.ground_truth: The two features of HSDPA that affect the handling of multimedia telephony are fast H-ARQ re-transmissions on the radio layer, which makes packet losses due to bad radio conditions infrequent, and the scheduler that needs to prioritize between different users and services, inducing varying transport delay to the user equipment (UE).

q_4436.question: How many logical states does the call waiting service have?
q_4436.ground_truth: The call waiting service has 3 logical states: (Not Provisioned, Not Applicable, Not Active), (Provisioned, Not Applicable, Not Active), and (Provisioned, Not Applicable, Active and Operative).

q_4437.question: What is the purpose of the QoS-Rule-Base-Name AVP in the Diameter protocol?
q_4437.ground_truth: The QoS-Rule-Base-Name AVP is used as a reference for activating a group of QoS rules predefined at the BBERF.

q_4438.question: What is the use of the HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling Information to modify LCR?
q_4438.ground_truth: This IE is used for the modification of HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling information for 1.28 Mcps TDD.

q_4439.question: What is a "native application" in the context of the present document?
q_4439.ground_truth: A "native application" is an application developed specifically for a particular mobile device/operating system and is installed directly onto that device.

q_4440.question: How does the UE determine which frequency to reselect first when more than one cell meets the cell reselection criteria?
q_4440.ground_truth: The UE selects the highest-priority frequency first and then the highest ranked cell among the cells on that frequency meeting the criteria.

q_4441.question: Which subfunction is responsible for placing the payload units and, optionally, FEC data into Nmb9 transmission packets?
q_4441.ground_truth: The Packetisation subfunction is responsible for placing the payload units and, optionally, FEC data into Nmb9 transmission packets.

q_4442.question: What is the purpose of the Code-Receiving Security Parameters in the ProSe Function?
q_4442.ground_truth: The Code-Receiving Security Parameters in the ProSe Function indicate whether a Match Report will be used for MIC checking and provide the information needed by a UE to undo the protection applied to the ProSe Query Code and ProSe Response Code by the other UE.

q_4443.question: What is the purpose of the "ErrorIndicationIEs" in the RNA-PROTOCOL-IES group?
q_4443.ground_truth: The "ErrorIndicationIEs" in the RNA-PROTOCOL-IES group provide criticality, type, and presence information for various error indication cases, such as cause, criticality diagnostics, Iurh-Signalling-Context-ID, HNB-RNL-ID, and ErrorIndicationExtensions.

q_4444.question: What is the purpose of the Flexible Alerting (FA) feature in the IP Multimedia (IM) Core Network (CN) subsystem?
q_4444.ground_truth: The Flexible Alerting feature causes a call to a pilot identity to branch the call into several legs, alerting several termination addresses simultaneously. The first leg to be answered is connected to the calling party, while the other call legs are abandoned.

q_4445.question: What organization is working on a new version of the Diameter Base Protocol for improved application design?
q_4445.ground_truth: IETF DIME WG (Diameter Maintenance and Extensions)

q_4446.question: What is the impact of receiving a limit on the number of PDU sessions from the network?
q_4446.ground_truth: Receiving a limit on the number of PDU sessions from the network cannot be used by the UE to perform PLMN reselection.

q_4447.question: What happens if user B's UE receives a CANCEL request or BYE request from user C during a CW condition?
q_4447.ground_truth: User B's UE shall stop the timer T~UE-CW (if necessary), stop providing the CW indication to user B, and apply the terminating UE procedures upon receipt of CANCEL or BYE request.

q_4448.question: What event triggers the MBMS Registration procedure?
q_4448.ground_truth: The MBMS Registration procedure is initiated when a downstream node informs an upstream node that it would like to receive session attributes and data for a particular MBMS bearer service in order to distribute it further downstream.

q_4449.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Service Notification message?
q_4449.ground_truth: The ProSe Service Notification message is used to send the updated ProSe Discovery UE ID to the UE immediately or to notify the updated authorization for ProSe Direct Discovery or ProSe Direct Communication to the UE.

q_4450.question: What is an Elementary Procedure (EP) in the context of 3GPP TS 36.468?
q_4450.ground_truth: An Elementary Procedure (EP) is a unit of interaction between the HNB and HNB-GW in the 3GPP SA WG5 protocol.

q_4451.question: What should the UE do when it receives a "HOLD" (i.e. DTX) from the Serving E-DCH RLS while applying a Delta to calculate its new SG?

q_4452.question: What is the post-condition for the Train Integrity monitoring data communication use case?
q_4452.ground_truth: The post-condition is that the FRMCS System will be used to exchange train integrity information, ensuring the continuous verification of the train completeness for the time of mission.

q_4453.question: What is the function of the new AS sublayer introduced in NR for the user plane?
q_4453.ground_truth: The AS sublayer introduced in NR for the user plane performs the functions listed in sub-clause 9.5 of the document.

q_4454.question: What is the purpose of the "Channel Mode" information element in GAN?
q_4454.ground_truth: The Channel Mode information element gives information of the mode on coding/decoding and transcoding in GAN.

q_4455.question: What must a mobile station supporting the "GPRS" option do when it receives an Immediate Assignment message to a Channel?
q_4455.ground_truth: A mobile station supporting the "GPRS" option must not obey this command when it receives an Immediate Assignment message to a Channel.

q_4456.question: When can a UE initiate IP flow mapping over GERAN or UTRAN?
q_4456.ground_truth: A UE can initiate IP flow mapping over GERAN or UTRAN if it is operating in A/Gb mode or Iu mode, and the PDN connection applies to NBIFOM, and the network-initiated NBIFOM mode is selected.

q_4457.question: What is the purpose of the LSA controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) management operations and notifications as specified in the present document?
q_4457.ground_truth: The purpose of the LSA controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) management operations and notifications as specified in the present document is to enable communication of management information between an IRPAgent and one or several IRPManagers in a protocol and technology neutral way.

q_4458.question: What is one of the main differences between 2D video streaming and VR video streaming from a user's perspective?
q_4458.ground_truth: The main difference is the notion of a viewport. In VR video streaming, the user only sees a cropped part of the video (the viewport) depending on the direction of the device, while in 2D video streaming, the user always sees the complete video.

q_4459.question: What is the effect of an allow list in the context of the communication barring service?
q_4459.ground_truth: An allow list is used to specify a list of identities towards which outgoing communications are always allowed.

q_4460.question: What is the recommended approach to support access to an SNPN using credentials from a separate entity?
q_4460.ground_truth: It is recommended to enhance Nudm, Nausf, Namf, and Nsmf services to support this, with the limitation that Session Management procedures are only supported for PDU Sessions terminating in the SNPN.

q_4461.question: What events can trigger the clearing of Radio Resources on the A-Interface in 3GPP TS 29.010?
q_4461.ground_truth: The clearing of Radio Resources on the A-Interface can be triggered by a positive empty result in MSC-B, a circuit connection abortion or dialogue abortion in MSC-B, or the clearing of the SCCP connection between MSC-B and BSS-B.

q_4462.question: What action should the MS take if there is a change in the MS's capabilities while having an active RR connection?
q_4462.ground_truth: The MS should send a CLASSMARK CHANGE message to the network not later than 1 second after the change in capabilities.

q_4463.question: What information is required in a Filter Criteria of IMS communication service?
q_4463.ground_truth: A Filter Criteria contains the address of the Application Server to be contacted, priority of the Filter Criteria, Trigger Point composed by 1 to n instances of the Service Point Triggers (SPTs), default handling, optional Service Information that shall be added to the message body before it is sent to the Application Server.

q_4464.question: What should the UE do when it detects physical layer problems?
q_4464.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T310 and not initiate any RRC connection re-establishment procedure before expiring of timer T310.

q_4465.question: What additional functionality is suggested for detection of video calling capability during a voice call in the 3GPP Technical Report?
q_4465.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Report suggests that it would be useful for mobiles to indicate whether they support 64 kbit/s video in their current location when using UTRAN, and whether UMTS coverage is available and can support 64 kbit/s video when using GERAN.

q_4466.question: How does the SCC AS identify the session to be transferred?
q_4466.ground_truth: The SCC AS identifies the session to be transferred using the STI (Session Transfer Identity) and the media flow(s).

q_4467.question: What information does the Handover Complete message contain regarding the LCLS status of the call?
q_4467.ground_truth: The Handover Complete message includes the LCLS-BSS-Status that indicates whether the call is locally switched or not after the internal handover.

q_4468.question: What is the functionality of the adaptation layer in L2 UE-to-Network Relay?
q_4468.ground_truth: The adaptation layer in L2 UE-to-Network Relay architecture is used for bearer mapping, data multiplexing, and supporting Remote UE identification for both uplink and downlink traffic. It is placed over the RLC sublayer for both CP and UP at the Uu interface between Relay UE and gNB, but its presence at the PC5 interface between Remote UE and Relay UE is left to WI phase.

q_4469.question: What are the tunneling protocols used for softwire tunneling between the PDN Gateway and the CGN to support GI-DS-lite?
q_4469.ground_truth: GRE with GRE-key extensions or alternative schemes such as MPLS.

q_4470.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Report 22.886 specify in terms of V2X use cases?
q_4470.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Report 22.886 specifies the following V2X use cases: remote driving, information sharing for high/full automated driving, advanced driver assistance systems, and road management, traffic, and network management.

q_4471.question: What is the most widely consumed cereal grain crop in the world?

q_4472.question: What is the requirement if a repeater is intended for combination with additional apparatus connected to a repeater port?
q_4472.ground_truth: The combination of repeater together with the additional apparatus shall also fulfill the repeater requirements.

q_4473.question: What is the leaving condition for event A4 in the measurement reporting procedure?
q_4473.ground_truth: The leaving condition for event A4 is defined in Inequality A4-2, which outlines the specific requirements that must be met for the event A4 to no longer be satisfied.

q_4474.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 43.064, what does the term "PLMN" refer to?
q_4474.ground_truth: PLMN stands for Public Land Mobile Network

q_4475.question: What needs to be achieved in order to have a controlled return of UEs during the winding down phase in 6.47.1.1?
q_4475.ground_truth: The time period for which PLMN A keeps the broadcast indication active and the time period for which it accepts registration requests by inbound roamers need to be different.

q_4476.question: What information is included in the Set-up message sent from VMSCB to MSB?
q_4476.ground_truth: The Set-up message may include bearer capability information for the call.

q_4477.question: What exception is thrown in 6.2.7.22.1.2 if value2 is null?

q_4478.question: When can the multimedia recording be completed as per 3GPP TS 26.244?
q_4478.ground_truth: The multimedia recording can be completed when the maximum time period of multimedia recording has elapsed, a DTMF digit that represents to finish or cancel the multimedia recording is detected by the MRFP, the MRFC requests the MRFP to stop the audio recording, or the multimedia recording is not successful.

q_4479.question: In the context of 3GPP systems, what does the MBMS service key (MSK) refer to?
q_4479.ground_truth: The MSK is a key securely transferred from the BM-SC to the UE, which is used to protect the point-to-point transfer of MBMS keys, but not used directly to protect MBMS user service data.

q_4480.question: What action results in the SGSN sending an MBMS UE Context Deactivation Request to the GGSN?
q_4480.ground_truth: The SGSN sends an MBMS UE Context Deactivation Request to the GGSN upon receiving a UE Removal Request or for other reasons, such as a change in the roaming restrictions for the user.

q_4481.question: What should the UE do when it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND indicating access type IE as "3GPP access" while in PDU SESSION ACTIVE state and the MA PDU session has user-plane resources established only on 3GPP access?
q_4481.ground_truth: The UE should transmit PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE message and the whole MA PDU session should be released.

q_4482.question: What should the mobile station do, after releasing the last active traffic channel, if it receives a SETUP message with Signaling IE indicating Call Waiting?
q_4482.ground_truth: The mobile station should not request a new SI value before releasing any other call that leads to release any other bearers than the retained bearer.

q_4483.question: What is the purpose of the Serving and Neighbour Cell Pathloss (SNPL) field in a carrier's scheduling information?
q_4483.ground_truth: The SNPL field in a carrier's scheduling information indicates the SNPL value of a carrier and is used by the Node-B to estimate the degree of intercell interference and determine the absolute grant power value and physical resources to assign.

q_4484.question: What is the purpose of the Higher priority PLMN search period timer in conformance requirement 7.4.2.2?
q_4484.ground_truth: The Higher priority PLMN search period timer determines the time interval between searches for a higher priority PLMN. This is used to ensure that the UE searches for a higher priority PLMN, as defined in TS 22.011.

q_4485.question: In what scenario is the UE required to perform PLMN selection triggered by V2X communications over PC5 reference point?
q_4485.ground_truth: If the UE finds a cell that belongs to a PLMN authorized for V2X communications over PC5 reference point and provides radio resources for V2X service but not in the registered PLMN or a PLMN equivalent to the registered PLMN.

q_4486.question: What information is used to set the Route Selection Descriptor Precedence in the Route Selection Descriptor?
q_4486.ground_truth: The DN priority that results from the DNAI applicability evaluation is used to set the Route Selection Descriptor Precedence in the Route Selection Descriptor.

q_4487.question: What should the Serving GW do for the PMIPv6 LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion on the S8 interface as per clause 11.8.3?
q_4487.ground_truth: Follow the MAG procedure for the PMIPv6 LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion on the S8 interface

q_4488.question: What is the recommended way to request a metadata fragment and its associated envelope in a single MBMS download session?
q_4488.ground_truth: It is recommended that only the metadata fragment (fileURI) be requested from the download client, which will result in both fragment and envelope being received using the grouping mechanism.

q_4489.question: What is a "secondary resource" in the context of HTTP?
q_4489.ground_truth: A secondary resource is a subset or portion of a primary resource that is identifiable and can be accessed using a URI that is a specific portion of the URI of the primary resource.

q_4490.question: What parameter is sent to the MS in the Facility information element in the FACILITY or CALL PROCEEDING message towards MSa when the network indicates that a CUG has been invoked for the outgoing call?
q_4490.ground_truth: The cug-Index parameter is sent to the MS in the Facility information element.

q_4491.question: What must be included in the SIP re-INVITE request when sending an MCPTT emergency private call?
q_4491.ground_truth: The SIP re-INVITE request must include a Resource-Priority header field populated with the values for an MCPTT emergency private call as specified in clause 6.6.3.1.12.

q_4492.question: When should a mobile station send an RR STATUS message to the network with cause #96?
q_4492.ground_truth: If the mobile station does not support VGCS talking, and the VGCS target mode information element is included in the CHANNEL MODE MODIFY message, the mobile station should send an RR STATUS message to the network with cause #96.

q_4493.question: What is the requirement for using non-specific references in a series of parts under the control of the same TSG?
q_4493.ground_truth: Corresponding changes must be implemented simultaneously in all parts.

q_4494.question: What is the difference between centralized quota check and distributed quota check in the context of network slice quota enforcement?
q_4494.ground_truth: In centralized quota check, the NW Slice quota enforcement functionality checks every new PDU Session request against the global S-NSSAI quota at one centralized quota enforcement point. In distributed quota check, the local quota is distributed to one or more NW Slice quota enforcement functionalities and every new PDU Session request is checked against local quota of one or more distributed quota enforcement points before checking against the global quota.

q_4495.question: What entity is responsible for managing Multicast session in the AMF-enhanced design?
q_4495.ground_truth: The AMF is responsible for managing Multicast session, including UE authorization, determining the delivery mode, maintaining session context, controlling activation/deactivation of the MBS session, sending notifications to UE, and selecting (MB-)SMF for the MBS session.

q_4496.question: What is the maximum accepted test system uncertainty for the frequency range up to 4.2 GHz?
q_4496.ground_truth: The maximum accepted test system uncertainty for the frequency range up to 4.2 GHz is the same as for E-UTRA.

q_4497.question: What should be the range of the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the stream and cell-specific CQI median, as per the requirement for UE HS-DSCH categories 19-20?
q_4497.ground_truth: If the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the stream and cell-specific CQI median is less than or equal to 0.1, the BLER using the transport format indicated by (stream and cell-specific CQI median + 2) must be greater than 0.1. If the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the stream and cell-specific CQI median is greater than 0.1, the BLER using transport format indicated by (stream and cell-specific CQI median -1) must be less than or equal to 0.1.

q_4498.question: What is the purpose of defining signal strength measurement requirements for normal operation of the BTS using only GMSK modulation on the BCCH carrier?
q_4498.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure reliable handover and/or cell reselection for MS in normal operation.

q_4499.question: What is the reference point between the SCEF and the HSS/HLR for general access to the capabilities and data of the HSS from the SCEF?

q_4500.question: What technique can be used to accelerate delivery of segmented content in a CDN?
q_4500.ground_truth: One way to do this is to have the proxy server pre-fetch the next segment from the origin at the same time as it retrieves the current segment, so that the segment is ready and waiting when the next request arrives from the client.

q_4501.question: What should the UE do when the fifth expiry of timer T3521 occurs during the de-registration procedure in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state?
q_4501.ground_truth: The deregistration procedure shall be aborted and the UE performs local detach.

q_4502.question: What is the role of the Content Handler Function (CHF) in the MBMS system?
q_4502.ground_truth: The CHF handles the separation of unicast and MBMS bearer content and makes the content available in operators CDN for unicast access.

q_4503.question: What is the effect of calling the getVersion() request function as per clause 6.2.3.21.1?
q_4503.ground_truth: The getVersion() request function returns the version of the implemented APIs of the MBMS client.

q_4504.question: What can the M operation via Itf-N attempt to do with the CIO parameter to affect the HO trigger between cells?
q_4504.ground_truth: The M operation via Itf-N can try to reduce the CIO parameter, making the HO trigger between cells more difficult, or it can try to increase the CIO parameter, making the HO easier.

q_4505.question: What is required for 3GPP to agree on allocating a sub-range for new mobile technology applications?
q_4505.ground_truth: The requirement for 3GPP to agree on allocating a sub-range for new mobile technology applications is for the IETF to agree on allocating a sub-range to 3GPP or agree on allocating some port numbers for every generation of mobile technology or agree on the new IETF RFC submitted by 3GPP.

q_4506.question: What is the function of the MBMS session duration value in the MBMS SESSION STOP REQUEST message?
q_4506.ground_truth: The MBMS session duration value in the MBMS SESSION STOP REQUEST message indicates the remaining duration of the MBMS session.

q_4507.question: What is required for the integrity of the H(e)NB to be validated before establishing a connection to the H(e)NB-GW or the core network?
q_4507.ground_truth: The H(e)NB's integrity is validated by using algorithms of adequate cryptographic strength to authenticate and protect confidentiality and integrity.

q_4508.question: What is the value of the constant MIN(a,b)?
q_4508.ground_truth: The smaller of a and b

q_4509.question: What is the difference between the first digit values in the version number of a 3GPP document?
q_4509.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number in a 3GPP document indicates the stage of the document's approval within the TSG (Technical Specification Group). A value of "0" indicates that the document is presented to the TSG for information, a value of "1" indicates that the document is presented to the TSG for approval, and a value of "2" or greater indicates that the document is TSG approved and under change control.

q_4510.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving an ANTENNA INFORMATION REQUEST message from the SS?
q_4510.ground_truth: Upon receiving the ANTENNA INFORMATION REQUEST message, the UE is required to perform an RSAP measurement on the specified carrier number (CN) using its supported receivers, and then report the results to the SS using an ANTENNA INFORMATION RESPONSE message.

q_4511.question: What should the Node B do upon receiving a DL NODE SYNCHRONISATION control frame?
q_4511.ground_truth: The Node B should respond with a UL NODE SYNCHRONISATION control frame, indicating the T1 and T2 parameters from the received DL NODE SYNCHRONISATION control frame.

q_4512.question: What message does the MME send to the MSC/VLR in step 5 if the cause indicates "IMSI Detach only" in a UE-initiated Detach procedure for GERAN/UTRAN with ISR activated?
q_4512.ground_truth: The MME sends an IMSI Detach Indication (IMSI) message to the MSC/VLR.

q_4513.question: What triggers service continuation between FRMCS and GSM-R systems for multi-train voice communication?
q_4513.ground_truth: Service continuation between FRMCS and GSM-R systems for multi-train voice communication is triggered when the Driver or Ground FRMCS User moves from one system to another.

q_4514.question: How many symbols does the data field of burst type 4 have, when the spreading factor is 16?
q_4514.ground_truth: When the spreading factor is 16, the data fields of burst type 4 have 132 symbols.

q_4515.question: If the user homed in the IWF declines the MCPTT session invitation when performing the manual commencement mode procedures, what should the IWF performing the participating role do?
q_4515.ground_truth: The IWF should send a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response towards the MCPTT controlling function with the warning text set to: "110 user declined the call invitation".

q_4516.question: What signalling flow is used to inform UEs about all the available MBMS services in a cell in PMM IDLE and PMM-CONNECTED mode?
q_4516.ground_truth: The MBMS SERVICE INFORMATION signalling flow is used for this purpose.

q_4517.question: What is the difference between the first digit values in the version number of the 3GPP technical specification?
q_4517.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of the 3GPP technical specification represents the stage of approval. A value of 1 indicates that the document has been presented to the TSG for information, a value of 2 means that it has been presented to the TSG for approval, and a value of 3 or greater indicates that it is a TSG approved document under change control.

q_4518.question: What are the different categories of faults that can occur in a 3GPP system?
q_4518.ground_truth: The different categories of faults that can occur in a 3GPP system are hardware failures, software problems, functional faults, faults due to overload situations, and communication failures.

q_4519.question: What information must the UE include in the LCS PS-MO-LR Location Services invoke message when requesting its own location or that its own location be sent to an external LCS client?
q_4519.ground_truth: The LCS requested QoS information, the requested maximum age of location, and the requested type of location. If the UE is requesting that its location be sent to an external LCS client, the message shall also include the identity of the LCS client and may include the address of the GMLC.

q_4520.question: What is the initial condition of the UICC's PIN when the UE is powered on?
q_4520.ground_truth: When the UE is powered on, the UICC's PIN is enabled by default.

q_4521.question: What are the expected sequences defined for the ME to operate in the manner defined for test requirement 27.22.6.1.5?
q_4521.ground_truth: Expected sequences 1.1 to 1.14 for test requirement 27.22.6.1.5

q_4522.question: What does the Num Sat field represent in the TOD GANSS Signals message?
q_4522.ground_truth: The Num Sat field contains a binary representation of the number of GANSS satellites for which the Data Bit Assistance is requested. It may contain a value between 0 and 15, representing the number of satellites for which Data Bit Assistance is requested or no GANSS satellite ID is specified. When the Num Sat field is 0, there are no GANSS satellite IDs present.

q_4523.question: When does the procedure for initiating the measurement reporting procedure start?
q_4523.ground_truth: The measurement reporting procedure is initiated when a measurement reporting entry is included within the VarMeasReportList for a measId, or when a first measurement report is triggered for the 'reportStrongestCells' or 'reportStrongestCellsForSON' purpose. The procedure can also be initiated upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measId, or upon expiry of T321 for a measId.

q_4524.question: What is an example use case of audio spatialization based on head-tracking tools at the rendering device?
q_4524.ground_truth: The audio from conference participants can be steered based on head tracking tools at the rendering device, integrated into HRTF functions to rotate the sound field based on individual talkers' seating location.

q_4525.question: What is the role of the WT in the Xw UP protocol for LWA option?
q_4525.ground_truth: The WT provides information in the Xw UP protocol for LWA option, such as successful transmission towards or sequence delivery to the UE, indication of transferred LWA PDUs, and desired buffer sizes for the eNB and the UE.

q_4526.question: What is the significance of the envelope of the current frame at 13.2kbps in the context of bit-rate switching?
q_4526.ground_truth: The envelope of the current frame at 13.2kbps is preserved for the envelope estimation for 7.2kbps and 8kbps when bit-rate switching from 13.2kbps to 7.2 or 8kbps.

q_4527.question: What is the purpose of the bearer type selection for MBMS transmissions in functionality 6.1?
q_4527.ground_truth: The purpose of bearer type selection for MBMS transmissions in functionality 6.1 is to determine the type of bearer to be used for MBMS transmissions based on information in the CRNC MBMS Service Context. This decision-making process involves interworking with Radio Resource Management and with the UE's SRNC in the case of p-t-p bearers.

q_4528.question: What is the difference in decibels (dB) between the interferer level and IM2 product in the setup used to investigate the impact of IM2?
q_4528.ground_truth: The IM2 product was found at -69 dBm at an interferer level of 10 dBm, and has disappeared in the noise floor at -80 dBm at an interferer level of -13 dBm, indicating a difference of 11 dB.

q_4529.question: What is the type of codec used in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group's AMR-WB speech codec?
q_4529.ground_truth: Algebraic Code Excited Linear Prediction Coder (ACELP)

q_4530.question: What is the procedure followed when a MS uses an unknown TMSI in a location area managed by the same VLR?
q_4530.ground_truth: This procedure, called "Local TMSI unknown", involves the network performing a variant of the procedures described in subclauses 2.3.1 and 2.3.2, and occurs when a data loss has occurred in a VLR and when the MS uses an unknown TMSI for a communication or location updating request.

q_4531.question: What is the typical minimum requirement for EVM (Error Vector Magnitude) in other cellular systems?
q_4531.ground_truth: The typical minimum requirement for EVM in other cellular systems is 12.5%.

q_4532.question: Which leaf in the document is used as a placeholder for location conditions for a particular flow distribution rule?
q_4532.ground_truth: The ValidityArea node acts as a placeholder for location conditions for a particular flow distribution rule, and it is defined in the "ANDSF/IARP/<X>/ForInterAPNRouting/<X>/RoutingCriteria/<X>/ValidityArea" leaf.

q_4533.question: What is the field name for "Mandatory for 1.28Mcps TDD. Not Applicable to 3.84Mcps TDD."?

q_4534.question: What is the requirement for the MS when the last received steering of roaming information contains a list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations?
q_4534.ground_truth: The MS shall use the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" stored in the ME when following the procedure for selecting a PLMN/access technology combination, if the last received steering of roaming information contains a list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations.

q_4535.question: What is the role of the RRLP Flags information element in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard?
q_4535.ground_truth: The RRLP Flags information element carries control information for RRLP in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard.

q_4536.question: What is the effect of setting the TFO Activity Control property to "On"?
q_4536.ground_truth: Setting the TFO Activity Control property to "On" means that TFO is enabled and the TFO protocol is supported.

q_4537.question: What method is used in PSS for requesting the retransmission of RTP packets?
q_4537.ground_truth: PSS clients shall use the NACK feedback message format as defined in the "Extended RTP Profile for RTCP-based Feedback (RTP/AVPF)" for requesting the retransmission of RTP packets.

q_4538.question: What is the role of the Mobile Station Classmark 2 and 3 information elements in the GA-RRC RELOCATION REQUEST message?
q_4538.ground_truth: The Mobile Station Classmark 2 and 3 information elements are included in the GA-RRC RELOCATION REQUEST message to provide information about the MS's capabilities and to ensure compatibility with the target network.

q_4539.question: Who are the parties involved in the mutual authentication and establishment of new cipher and integrity keys between the VLR/SGSN and the MS?
q_4539.ground_truth: The parties involved are the AuC of the user's HE (HE/AuC) and the USIM in the user's mobile station.

q_4540.question: What is the highest target value for RTT for satellite systems involving user equipment in the case of GEO satellite systems?
q_4540.ground_truth: The highest target value for RTT for satellite systems involving user equipment in the case of GEO satellite systems is 600ms.

q_4541.question: Which entity determines the weight factors for the transmit diversity schemes for PDSCH, DPCH, HS-SCCH, HS-PDSCH and E-AGCH?

q_4542.question: What should the target UE do when Timer T5005 expires?
q_4542.ground_truth: The target UE should either initiate a PC5 unicast link keep-alive procedure to check the link or initiate the PC5 unicast link release procedure.

q_4543.question: What condition triggers the use of the integrity key of the key set used in the first security mode control procedure following the Inter-RAT handover procedure?
q_4543.ground_truth: If the source RAT is not E-UTRAN, if the procedure is not an rSR-VCC handover, and it is not a SR-VCC handover from NR, and if ciphering has been active for the CS domain in the source RAT, then the UE activates integrity protection using the integrity key of the key set used in the first security mode control procedure following the Inter-RAT handover procedure.

q_4544.question: What channels require coverage compensation in Urban 4 GHz O2I scenario with ISD 500m for FR1?
q_4544.ground_truth: PUSCH eMBB, PUSCH VoIP, Msg3, PRACH B4, PUCCH Format 1 with 2 bits, PUCCH Format 3 with 11 bits and PUCCH Format 3 with 22 bits

q_4545.question: What are the four components of a 3GPP system?
q_4545.ground_truth: The four components of a 3GPP system are: (1) one or more Access Networks, (2) one or more Core Networks, (3) one or more Intelligent Node Networks, service logic and mobility management, and (4) one or more transmission networks.

q_4546.question: What is the purpose of the RPAUID in the ProSe query procedure?
q_4546.ground_truth: The RPAUID is used to identify the application that triggered the ProSe query procedure and to indicate what the UE is interested to announce.

q_4547.question: When using the HS-DPCCH slot format 0 and 1, in which order are the input bits transmitted over the air with respect to k?
q_4547.ground_truth: The input bits are transmitted over the air in ascending order with respect to k for both slot format 0 and 1.

q_4548.question: What are the different architectures for implementing SON use cases?
q_4548.ground_truth: The four different architectures for implementing SON use cases are Centralized SON, NM-Centralized SON, EM-Centralized SON, and Distributed SON. The architecture is selected depending on the needs of the SON use cases.

q_4549.question: What is the role of the N1 SM container (PDU Session Modification Command) in this process?
q_4549.ground_truth: The N1 SM container (PDU Session Modification Command) is provided to the UE to modify the PDU session.

q_4550.question: What is the function of the "Cell Identifier List" information element in GAN?
q_4550.ground_truth: The "Cell Identifier List" information element is used to transfer multiple Cell Global Identifications in GAN.

q_4551.question: What is the format of each test described in clause X of the document?
q_4551.ground_truth: Each test in the following clauses has a standard format, including the test title, its definition and applicability, the minimum requirement, the test purpose, method of test, and test requirement.

q_4552.question: What is the role of the NSQ-NF in the 5GS network?
q_4552.ground_truth: The NSQ-NF is responsible for providing network slice quota event notifications to the AF in the 5GS network.

q_4553.question: What is the function of the Bearers layer in MBMS-based services?
q_4553.ground_truth: The Bearers layer provides the mechanism for transporting IP data in an efficient one-to-many manner, using MBMS bearers as defined in 3GPP TS 23.246 and 3GPP TS 22.146.

q_4554.question: What do the padlock icons in the list of Technical Specifications and Technical Reports signify?
q_4554.ground_truth: The padlock icons in the list of Technical Specifications and Technical Reports indicate whether the documents are intended for adoption by partner Standards Development Organizations or if they are internal working documents of the 3GPP TSGs.

q_4555.question: What is the task of a MUSHRA test subject when evaluating the audio conditions?
q_4555.ground_truth: The subject is required to listen to the OR, then to each of the test conditions, the Hidden Reference (HR), and two or more degraded Anchor conditions. The subject's task is to identify the HR condition and give it a rating of 100, then rate the remaining conditions relative to the HR condition.

q_4556.question: What is the role of Minimum Requirement in this specification?
q_4556.ground_truth: In this specification, the Minimum Requirement is a value determined relative to a nominal value specified by the manufacturer for a parameter, for tests that measure a parameter relative to a value that is not fully specified in the E-UTRA specifications.

q_4557.question: What is the role of the USS/UTM in the 5GS registration procedure for a UAV?
q_4557.ground_truth: The USS/UTM does verification checks on the UAV as part of the 5GS registration procedure for a UAV. It can decide to keep the existing CAA-Level UAV ID or issue a new one.

q_4558.question: What is the purpose of the requestReportGPRSEvent operation in the eZone?
q_4558.ground_truth: The requestReportGPRSEvent operation is used to request the gprsSSF to monitor for an event, then send a notification back to the gsmSCF when the event is detected.

q_4559.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS point-to-multipoint Scheduling Channel (MSCH)?
q_4559.ground_truth: The MBMS point-to-multipoint Scheduling Channel (MSCH) is used for a point-to-multipoint downlink transmission of MBMS service transmission schedule between network and UEs in RRC Connected or Idle Mode.

q_4560.question: Which reference point is used between the TDF and the PCRF for online charging based on the Diameter credit control application?
q_4560.ground_truth: The Gyn Reference Point is used for the online charging based on the Diameter credit control application between the Online Charging System (OCS) and the TDF.

q_4561.question: What is the maximum frame buffer size for FDD in 3rd generation UEs?

q_4562.question: What should be avoided when introducing a candidate solution for new MSs?
q_4562.ground_truth: Changes to MS hardware, additional complexity in terms of processing power and memory, and impacts to power consumption.

q_4563.question: What is the role of the CDF in the ProSe Direct Communication?
q_4563.ground_truth: The CDF generates the charging data records (CDR), sends the Charging Data Response corresponding to the received Charging Data Request, and opens, updates, and closes the PF-DC-CDR for the UE in the ProSe Direct Communication.

q_4564.question: How does the NG-RAN differentiate between multicast and unicast QoS flows in the QoS profile information?
q_4564.ground_truth: The NG-RAN receives both the unicast part and multicast part in the QoS profile information. The mapping from multicast QoS flow to unicast QoS flow is a 1 to 1 mapping, i.e. one multicast QoS flow is mapped to one unicast QoS flow.

q_4565.question: What should a Mobile Station do when it receives a message not consistent with the protocol state?
q_4565.ground_truth: The Mobile Station should ignore the message and return a CP-ERROR message with cause #98 "Message type not compatible with the short message protocol state" if an appropriate connection exists.

q_4566.question: What is the information included in the EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.2B?
q_4566.ground_truth: EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.2B includes the following information: MCC & MNC (001110), LAC (0002), and Cell ID (0002).

q_4567.question: What is the value of M for PCCCH when there are 25 uplink and 25 downlink channels in the cell?
q_4567.ground_truth: M = 12*64 = 768 when there are 25 uplink and 25 downlink channels in the cell.

q_4568.question: What are the two new inputs provided by OAM to the NWDAF in comparison to UE level network data from OAM?
q_4568.ground_truth: The two new inputs provided by OAM to the NWDAF are "Timestamp" and "Cell Energy Saving State".

q_4569.question: What should the MME do after receiving a WRITE-REPLACE WARNING REQUEST message, regardless of whether it can be processed or not?
q_4569.ground_truth: The MME shall always return a WRITE-REPLACE WARNING RESPONSE to the CBC immediately after receiving the request, with the cause IE set to 'Message accepted'.

q_4570.question: What is the definition of Composition Capable Network (CCN) as given in the document?
q_4570.ground_truth: A Composition Capable Network (CCN) is a network or user device capable of Network Composition. A network may be a 3GPP network or non-3GPP network.

q_4571.question: What types of data are transmitted in real-time in a 5G connected ambulance?
q_4571.ground_truth: In a 5G connected ambulance, high-definition video and audio streams, as well as physiological data from medical equipment, are transmitted in real-time. An example of physiological data includes ECG data, vital signs monitoring, and CT scan images. All data streams are synchronized to enable recording and offline synchronized playback of medical interventions.

q_4572.question: What are the two types of physical layer protocol headers defined in the16-octet information field?
q_4572.ground_truth: The two types of physical layer protocol headers defined in the 16-octet information field are the two octet physical header and the downlink blocks transferred via the PTCCH.

q_4573.question: What is specified in the 3GPP STN NRM IRP XML Definitions?
q_4573.ground_truth: The 3GPP STN NRM IRP XML Definitions specify the XML schema, XML namespace, XML complex type, and XML element type for the STN NRM IRP IRPAgent and IRPManager.

q_4574.question: What is used to measure the Doppler spectrum in the channel model validation setup?
q_4574.ground_truth: A spectrum analyzer is used to measure the Doppler spectrum in the channel model validation setup.

q_4575.question: What is the role of r in the alternative channel generation method?
q_4575.ground_truth: r is a proportionality factor used to scale the values of DS, ASD, ASA, ZSD, and ZSA. It is set to 1.5.

q_4576.question: What are the responsibilities of an AIPN operator in regard to controlling user access to the public network and managing the prime commercial relationship with the user?
q_4576.ground_truth: The AIPN operator controls access of the user to the public network and has the prime commercial relationship with the user.

q_4577.question: How should NR combinations be sorted in details?
q_4577.ground_truth: NR combinations should be sorted by the first band number, then the first bandwidth character, then the second band number, and so on. For combinations with () should be sorted alphanumerically within the brackets after the contiguous combinations.

q_4578.question: What must the new 3G-SGSN do if it receives only emergency services from the old S4-SGSN and the UE is UICCless, making it impossible to include the IMSI in the MM and PDP contexts in SGSN Context Response message?
q_4578.ground_truth: The new 3G-SGSN shall mark the IMSI as unauthenticated if it cannot be authenticated for emergency attached UEs.

q_4579.question: What is the function of the Extended HS-SCCH ID IE in 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_4579.ground_truth: The Extended HS-SCCH ID LCR identifies unambiguously a HS-SCCH and its paired HS-SICH within the set of HS-SCCHs in a cell for 1.28Mcps TDD.

q_4580.question: What is the role of the Solution Set (SS) in the RPTA IRP?
q_4580.ground_truth: The Solution Set (SS) in the RPTA IRP specifies the definitions of the solution sets for the RPTA IRP. These definitions include CORBA, XML, HTTP, and SOAP solution sets.

q_4581.question: What does the Conditional-APN-Aggregate-Max-Bitrate AVP define in the IKEv2 tunnel when a NAT is detected?
q_4581.ground_truth: The Conditional-APN-Aggregate-Max-Bitrate AVP defines the conditional APN policy info, including the total bandwidth usage in bps for the uplink and downlink directions for non-GBR QCIs at the APN.

q_4582.question: What is the function of timer T3130 in the uplink access procedure?
q_4582.ground_truth: Timer T3130 is used to control the priority uplink request procedure and determines when the mobile station should repeat the priority uplink request.

q_4583.question: What are the two delivery methods for the transmission of MBS packet flows over radio in the RAN?
q_4583.ground_truth: The two delivery methods are the Point-to-Point (PTP) delivery method, where separate copies of MBS data packets are delivered over radio to individual UEs, and the Point-to-Multipoint (PTM) delivery method, where a single copy of MBS data packets is delivered over radio to a set of UEs.

q_4584.question: What is the triggering condition for pathloss in equation 1?
q_4584.ground_truth: The triggering condition for pathloss is given by equation 1, which states that the new measurement result should be less than or equal to the old measurement result minus a certain offset.

q_4585.question: What is the purpose of the NPN type in the on-boarding procedure?
q_4585.ground_truth: The NPN type indicates whether the on-boarding procedure is for SNPN or PNI-NPN via the PLMN.

q_4586.question: What is the difference between On-network only communication, Off-network only communication, and Combined On-network and Off-network communication in the FRMCS environment?
q_4586.ground_truth: On-network only communication uses the bearer services that are provided by the FRMCS land mobile network, while Off-network only communication uses a dedicated radio bearer service for proximity communication. Combined On-network and Off-network communication encompasses the parallel use of the FRMCS land mobile network and the radio bearer service for proximity communication.

q_4587.question: What is the minimum performance requirement for the transmission of radio signals in the frequency band above 2 GHz?
q_4587.ground_truth: The minimum performance requirement for the transmission of radio signals in the frequency band above 2 GHz is 40 dB above the GSM 850/900 sensitivity level.

q_4588.question: What is the number of tail bits used in the convolutional coding for the DBC-450 code with a swap value of 0?

q_4589.question: What should the MME do before the NAS uplink or downlink COUNT wraps around with the current security context?
q_4589.ground_truth: The MME should activate fresh NAS keys from an EPS AKA run or activate a native security context with sufficiently low NAS COUNT values.

q_4590.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) responsible for?
q_4590.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing technical specifications for telecommunications, including the 3GPP charging functionality and charging management for GSM/UMTS networks.

q_4591.question: In what scenario will the UE calculate the value of the received IE "QqualminEUTRA" minus the value of the received IE "QqualminEUTRA-WB"?
q_4591.ground_truth: This calculation will be done if the IE "QqualminEUTRA-WB" from the IE "E-UTRA frequency and priority extension" occurrence is present.

q_4592.question: What needs to be enhanced to achieve the target MPL calculated from 1732m ISD in the Rural 700MHz FDD NLOS O2I scenario?
q_4592.ground_truth: PUSCH with SIP invite and PRACH format B4

q_4593.question: What is the purpose of the Channel-Guide List in SFR?
q_4593.ground_truth: The Channel-Guide List in SFR is an initial list of syndicated feeds received with the ApplicationRegistrationResponse message.

q_4594.question: What should the UE do when the entering condition for Event A3 is satisfied?
q_4594.ground_truth: The UE should consider the SpCell for Mp, Ofp and Ocp and use the SpCell for the measurement, measurement object specific offset, and cell specific offset.

q_4595.question: What is the effect of increasing the modulation order to 32QAM or 64QAM on receiver complexity?
q_4595.ground_truth: Increasing the modulation order to 32QAM or 64QAM is likely to result in an increase in receiver complexity, requiring new hardware for both base stations and mobile stations.

q_4596.question: What is the purpose of the BEGIN record in the HI2 protocol?
q_4596.ground_truth: The BEGIN record in the HI2 protocol is used to convey the first event of packet-data communication interception.

q_4597.question: What type of interface is specified in Release 17 of the 3GPP Technical Specification for the interconnection of Node B and RNC components in UTRAN?
q_4597.ground_truth: The Iub interface is a logical interface

q_4598.question: What is the requirement for the LPP REQUEST CAPABILITIES message in the test procedure?
q_4598.ground_truth: The LPP REQUEST CAPABILITES message is used by the SS to request the UE to send the OTDOA capabilities supported in the OTDOA-ProvideCapabilities IE.

q_4599.question: What is the initial state of the UE before the test procedure sequence?
