q_4599.ground_truth: The UE is in Automatic PLMN selection mode, registered to NR Cell 1, and then Switched OFF (State 0N-B).

q_4600.question: What records should be reported from DF2 to the LEMF when SMS is used in conjunction with GPRS or UMTS for separate delivery?
q_4600.ground_truth: SMS MO and SMS MT Communication REPORT Records, HLR Related REPORT Records (Serving System REPORT Record, Cancel location REPORT Record, Register location REPORT Record, and Location information request REPORT Record) should be reported from DF2 to the LEMF when SMS is used in conjunction with GPRS or UMTS for separate delivery.

q_4601.question: What information does the application client in the UE provide to the ProSe Application Server when requesting its own PDUID?
q_4601.ground_truth: The application client in the UE provides its own PDUID to the ProSe Application Server when requesting an RPAUID.

q_4602.question: What action should the UE take after receiving a REGISTER message containing a Facility IE with a LCS Location Notification Invoke message set to notifyAndVerify-LocationAllowedIfNoResponse?
q_4602.ground_truth: The UE should notify the user of the request and indicate that the default response is location allowed if no response and provide the opportunity to accept or deny the request. The UE should then send a RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a LocationNotification return result with verificationResponse set to permissionDenied or permissionGranted as appropriate.

q_4603.question: How does the algorithm determine the normalization length in the control of dynamics?
q_4603.ground_truth: The normalization length is obtained by calculating the envelope of the processed spectrum, then dividing the spectrum by this envelope. This normalization length is used to normalize the spectrum and control its dynamics.

q_4604.question: How is the value of the receive window state variable V(Q) updated in RLC acknowledged mode when the RLC receiver receives the RLC data block whose BSN is equal to V(Q)?
q_4604.ground_truth: The value of V(Q) is set to the BSN value of the next RLC data block in the receive window (modulo SNS) that has not yet been received when the RLC receiver receives the RLC data block whose BSN is equal to V(Q) in RLC acknowledged mode.

q_4605.question: What should a UE do when it cannot acquire the MIB and a cell is to be treated as if the cell status is "barred"?
q_4605.ground_truth: The UE may exclude the barred cell as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for up to 300 seconds, and select another cell on the same frequency if the selection criteria are fulfilled.

q_4606.question: What is the restriction on negotiating parameters of a compression entity used with unacknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation?
q_4606.ground_truth: Only the applicable NSAPIs can be negotiated for a compression entity used with unacknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation, all other parameters are non-negotiable.

q_4607.question: What does the "Service Handover" information element indicate in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_4607.ground_truth: The "Service Handover" information element defines information to use for handover to UTRAN or cdma2000. It is coded as follows: Octet 2 is a binary indication of the length of the remainder of the element in octets.

q_4608.question: What should the terminating UE do if it receives one or more Call-Info header fields in the incoming SIP INVITE request?
q_4608.ground_truth: The terminating UE shall retrieve the metadata of the originating user from the Call-Info header fields.

q_4609.question: What should the H(e)NB do if the PIN verification procedure is not successful during the HPSIM initialisation?
q_4609.ground_truth: If the PIN verification procedure is not successful, the HPSIM initialisation stops.

q_4610.question: What does ANR stand for in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?

q_4611.question: What is MBSFN mode, and how is it used for p-t-m transmissions?
q_4611.ground_truth: MBSFN mode is a form of combining for p-t-m transmissions realized via the utilization of the same scrambling code at a given moment in time by a group of cells covering a geographic area. It is applicable for both FDD and TDD. For TDD, some or all timeslots may utilize an MBSFN mode of transmission, and for FDD, Node-Bs participating in an MBSFN transmission do so on all slots of the radio frame.

q_4612.question: What are the four functional entities that make up the GUP reference architecture?
q_4612.ground_truth: The GUP reference architecture includes the GUP Server, Repository Access Function (RAF), GUP Data Repositories, and Rg and Rp reference points.

q_4613.question: In Expected Sequence 3.1A, what is the Icon identifier for the SET UP CALL command?
q_4613.ground_truth: The Icon identifier for the SET UP CALL command in Expected Sequence 3.1A is "<record 1 in EF IMG>".

q_4614.question: How does the ATCF execute the Access Transfer procedure when the UE chooses to retain some media flow(s) in the transferred-out access?
q_4614.ground_truth: If the UE chooses to retain some media flow(s) in the transferred-out access, the Source Access Leg is updated to indicate which media flow(s) is retained in the transferred-out access. If such update is not done, the SCC AS releases the Source Access Leg and updates the Remote Leg.

q_4615.question: What should the Node B do if the Measurement Filter Coefficient IE is not present?
q_4615.ground_truth: The Node B shall not apply any filtering to the measurement values before measurement event evaluation and reporting.

q_4616.question: When should the MGCF request the IM-MGW provide an awaiting answer indication to the calling party in early-session model?
q_4616.ground_truth: The MGCF shall not request the IM-MGW to provide an awaiting answer indication (ringing tone) to the calling party upon receipt of a SIP 18x provisional response with an early-session SDP.

q_4617.question: How can new performance measurements be defined and included in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_4617.ground_truth: New performance measurements can be defined using a top-down performance measurement definition methodology discussed in Annex B of 32.404, focusing on how end-users can utilize the measurements, and then submitted to 3GPP for potential adoption.

q_4618.question: What are the two modes of operation in 3GPP technical specification for GAN?
q_4618.ground_truth: The two modes of operation for GAN are GAN A/Gb mode and GAN Iu mode.

q_4619.question: What happens to the UI command if a logical link exception occurs during transmission?
q_4619.ground_truth: If a logical link exception occurs during the transmission of the UI command, it may be lost without notification to the layer-3 entity.

q_4620.question: What is the threshold parameter for the event A5-Threshold2 used for?
q_4620.ground_truth: The threshold parameter for the event A5-Threshold2 is used in the inequality A5-2 (Entering condition 2) and inequality A5-4 (Leaving condition 2), which specify the conditions for the event A5 to be triggered and to stop being triggered, respectively. The event A5 is triggered when the entering condition (inequality A5-1 or inequality A5-2) is satisfied and not triggered when the leaving condition (inequality A5-3 or inequality A5-4) is satisfied, where inequality A5-2 and inequality A5-4 include the threshold parameter Thresh2.

q_4621.question: What should be obtained and formatted for 1.28 Mcps TDD when performing transmission on a signalling radio bearer before RAB has been established?
q_4621.ground_truth: The appropriate information should be obtained and formatted on E-UCCH.

q_4622.question: What must the UE do after receiving a DL NAS TRANSPORT message with steering of roaming information from the AMF in the 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive?
q_4622.ground_truth: The UE shall perform a security check on the list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations included in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message to verify that the list is provided by HPLMN.

q_4623.question: In a Combined RA/LA Update Procedure, what should the UE indicate as the old P-TMSI and old RAI in the Routeing Area Update Request when the TIN indicates "GUTI" and the UE holds a valid GUTI?
q_4623.ground_truth: The UE indicates the GUTI as the old P-TMSI and old RAI when the TIN indicates "GUTI" and the UE holds a valid GUTI in the Routeing Area Update Request.

q_4624.question: What operation does the VLR or SGSN use to transfer alert information to the HLR?

q_4625.question: What is the base scene description for the DIMS media type?
q_4625.ground_truth: The base scene description for the DIMS media type is SVG Tiny 1.2, which provides layout, inclusion and referencing of objects, synchronization of object timelines, and a rendering model.

q_4626.question: In what scenario will the measurement request apply to all time slots in all frequencies in 1.28Mcps TDD if the Common Measurement Type IE is not set to "HS-DSCH Provided Bit Rate"?
q_4626.ground_truth: If neither UARFCN IE nor Time Slot LCR IE is present in the COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message.

q_4627.question: How many companies submitted codecs for the Qualification Phase in the EVS codec selection process?
q_4627.ground_truth: Thirteen companies submitted codecs for the Qualification Phase in the EVS codec selection process.

q_4628.question: What should the UE do when it has a stored list of "non-allowed tracking areas" and is successfully registered to a PLMN while camped on a cell whose TAI is in the list of "non-allowed tracking areas"?
q_4628.ground_truth: The UE should enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE, and if it is in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access, it should not initiate a service request procedure except for emergency services, high priority access, responding to paging or notification or indicating a change of 3GPP PS data off UE status.

q_4629.question: What should the controller UE do if it wants to release a media component on the controller UE within a collaborative session?
q_4629.ground_truth: The controller UE should follow the procedures defined in 3GPP~TS~24.229 for removing media, with the difference of including the SDP information for all other media components within the collaborative session in the SIP re-INVITE request and setting all the port numbers of the media on the controllee UEs with value zero.

q_4630.question: Which location types are indicated by the following values of octet 3: 00000000, 00000001, and 00000100?
q_4630.ground_truth: 00000000: Current geographic location, 00000001: Location assistance information for the target MS, 00000100: Assisted GPS if the GANSS Location Type is missing, indicating all satellite systems in GANSS are referenced.

q_4631.question: What is a requirement for MPS priority treatment of an MMTEL voice call in the network?
q_4631.ground_truth: The requirement for MPS priority treatment of an MMTEL voice call in the network is that the MPS Service User is authenticated and authorized for the MPS MMTEL voice call by the MPS Service Provider PLMN.

q_4632.question: What is the purpose of the Extended Dynamic Allocation medium access method?
q_4632.ground_truth: It is used to extend the Dynamic Allocation medium access method for higher uplink throughput.

q_4633.question: Which bits have the highest importance with respect to subjective quality in the encoded speech?
q_4633.ground_truth: The RPE grid position and block amplitude parameters, as well as the LTP lag and gain parameters, have higher importance with respect to subjective quality in the encoded speech.

q_4634.question: What information does an IP flow mobility routing rule consist of in 3GPP technology?
q_4634.ground_truth: An IP flow mobility routing rule consists of a rule identifier, routing filter(s), precedence, and routing address.

q_4635.question: What is the number of bits used for quantizing the adaptive and algebraic codebook gains in a subframe?
q_4635.ground_truth: The adaptive codebook gain is quantized using 5 bits, while the algebraic codebook gain is quantized indirectly with a predicted energy of the algebraic codevector using 3 bits.

q_4636.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) do if neither scheduled nor non-scheduled grants can be taken into account for the upcoming transmission?
q_4636.ground_truth: If neither scheduled nor non-scheduled grants are to be taken into account, the UE shall assume that no grant exists.

q_4637.question: How often are STATUS frames sent during the BCS-REC state, depending on the TCH access rate?
q_4637.ground_truth: Every 8 bits received from the V.21 modem, the appropriate number of STATUS frames (1 or 2 or 4 or 6) will be originated, depending on the current TCH access rate.

q_4638.question: Where is the TFCI code word transmitted in a traffic burst?
q_4638.ground_truth: The TFCI code word is transmitted at the beginning or end of data symbols in a traffic burst.

q_4639.question: How does a "clean" command behave in relation to saving and restoring data?
q_4639.ground_truth: A "clean" command behaves functionally equivalent to a save command that saves no state. It replaces any other saved state with the same domain-name, path, and groupID with an empty set of saved data, effectively deleting that saved state as nothing would be restored from it.

q_4640.question: What is the temporal scalability feature in the context of video coding?
q_4640.ground_truth: Temporal scalability is a feature that allows a video to be encoded at different frame rates, enabling the decoder to play the video back at a range of speeds.

q_4641.question: What type of PDU is sent from the BSS to the SGSN, indicating that a number of buffered LLC-PDUs in a cell for an MS have been deleted, and is used to inform the SGSN that the LLC frames and related octets deleted by the BSS as a consequence of a FLUSH-LL procedure should not be reported again?

q_4642.question: What should the UE do with old SAs when it receives a message protected with the incorrect SA?
q_4642.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall discard the message.

q_4643.question: What is the outcome of a positive result in the interworking between BSSMAP assignment messages in MAP and the RANAP RAB assignment messages?
q_4643.ground_truth: The outcome of a positive result in the interworking between BSSMAP assignment messages in MAP and the RANAP RAB assignment messages is ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE RAB ASSIGNMENT RESPONSE or ASSIGNMENT FAILURE.

q_4645.question: How are the time and date represented in the file opening timestamp binary format?
q_4645.ground_truth: The time and date are represented in the file opening timestamp binary format using various binary bits for the month, day, hour, minute, time differential from UTC, and time deviation towards UTC.

q_4646.question: In what situation will the MME suspend the EPS bearers?
q_4646.ground_truth: The MME suspenss the EPS bearers if the Cause indicates that RRC was released due to abnormal conditions, such as radio link failure.

q_4647.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) Location Measurement Unit (LMU) performance specification?
q_4647.ground_truth: The LMU performance specification outlines the minimum RF characteristics for the FDD mode of UTRA (Universal Terrestrial Radio Access), which is used to ensure correct UE (User Equipment) positioning in UTRAN (UTRA Radio Access Network) in 3GPP specifications.

q_4648.question: What interfaces represent the connection between the LEA and two delivery functions in a packet data GSN network?

q_4649.question: What does the 3GPP system aim to offer from the service perspective?
q_4649.ground_truth: The 3GPP system aims to offer service support transparent to the location, access technique and core network, user to terminal and user to network interface (MMI) regardless of the entities supporting the services required, and multimedia capabilities.

q_4650.question: What are the factors considered when computing the available delay budget for UE-1?
q_4650.ground_truth: The available delay budget for UE-1 is computed based on network delay, jitter, packet loss rate, and potential JBM constraints.

q_4651.question: What function enables an operator to offload certain types of traffic at a network node close to the UE's point of attachment to the access network or to a local network?

q_4652.question: When does Session Start occur in MBMS broadcast service provision?
q_4652.ground_truth: Session Start is the point at which the BM-SC is ready to send data, and it triggers bearer resource establishment for MBMS data transfer.

q_4653.question: What is the functionality of HES in providing break-out for private network traffic?
q_4653.ground_truth: HES providing break-out converts private network traffic to become public network traffic, allowing a call from within the NGCN to reach a user outside the enterprise in the NGN. The NGN operator defines the set of rules or policies under which this should occur.

q_4654.question: What should the UE indicate during step c) of the acceptance criteria in the DEREGISTRATION procedure?
q_4654.ground_truth: The UE should indicate within the REGISTRATION REQUEST that no key is available for the NAS key set identifier.

q_4655.question: What happens to the PRA identifier(s) and Presence Reporting Area elements when there is a change of serving S4-SGSN?
q_4655.ground_truth: Upon change of serving S4-SGSN, the PRA identifier(s) and if provided by the P-GW the list(s) of Presence Reporting Area elements are transferred for all PDN connections as part of MM Context information to the target S4-SGSN during the mobility procedure.

q_4656.question: Who is responsible for standardizing the mobile communication system aspects of the eCall service?
q_4656.ground_truth: The European Telecommunications Standards Institute (ETSI) Mobile Standards Group (MSG) has been assigned by the eSafety Forum to standardize those parts of the eCall service that affect the mobile communication system.

q_4657.question: What message does the UE receive that triggers it to report measurement results in UEInformationResponse after RRC connection re-establishment?

q_4658.question: What use case focuses on the use of wireless, unobtrusive on-body sensors in the context of elderly healthcare in the 5G system?
q_4658.ground_truth: The use case for elderly healthcare focuses on the use of wireless, unobtrusive on-body sensors in the context of elderly healthcare in the 5G system.

q_4659.question: How can the insertion loss of the RX filter at the upper edge degrade for some filter designs in the n71 band?
q_4659.ground_truth: The loss of the RX filter at the upper edge can degrade because the filter curve is shifted to lower frequencies, leading to an increase in the overall insertion loss of the filter, especially at the band edges.

q_4660.question: What action is taken by the MGC when the "Trace Activation result notification" procedure is complete?
q_4660.ground_truth: The MGC initiates the next procedure after completing the processing of the first command.

q_4661.question: What is the technical specification group that produced the 3GPP technical report on Server And Network-assisted Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (DASH) for 3GPP multimedia services?

q_4662.question: What should the UE do with the connEstFailReport in VarConnEstFailReport after the successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message, as per the specification in TS 38.331, clause 5.7.10.5?
q_4662.ground_truth: The UE should discard the connEstFailReport from VarConnEstFailReport upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers.

q_4663.question: How does the DCCF manage requests and cancellations for a Data Repository?
q_4663.ground_truth: The DCCF can manage requests and cancellations for a Data Repository in the same manner as it does for any other Data Consumer.

q_4664.question: What would happen if call A-B is active, call C-B is waiting, and call D-B is held based on the described network?
q_4664.ground_truth: The network has a condition where there is an active call A-B, a waiting call C-B, and held call D-B with B.

q_4665.question: Which burst types can be used for PDSCH and HS-PDSCH in LTE?
q_4665.ground_truth: Burst types 1 and 2 can be used for PDSCH, while burst types 1 or 2 can be used for HS-PDSCH. However, TFCI is not transmitted on the HS-PDSCH and the TF of the HS-DSCH is derived from the associated HS-SCCH.

q_4666.question: How can information on the area where the Disaster Condition applies be provided to other PLMNs?
q_4666.ground_truth: Information on the area where the Disaster Condition applies can be provided through various means, such as through a public warning system, a broadcast message, or through direct communication between networks.

q_4667.question: What is not in the scope of the NG-RAN technical specification in Release 17?
q_4667.ground_truth: Transmission delay requirements and O&M requirements are not specified in the document

q_4668.question: What is the number of bits that increase the input bits in turbo coding after termination and padding bits?
q_4668.ground_truth: 6 additional bits (3 for each constituent encoder) are used after termination and padding in turbo coding.

q_4669.question: What action does the AMF take when sending a MUSIM indication to SMF for a MA PDU Session?
q_4669.ground_truth: The AMF considers the MUSIM indication to initiate a MA PDU Session.

q_4670.question: What is the role of AUSF in the ProSe key management function?
q_4670.ground_truth: AUSF is responsible for the ProSe key management function in this solution, including deriving the P-KID when receives the ProSe indicator from the UDM and storing the P-KID in the UDM.

q_4671.question: Which new service is defined in the SEAL enhancements in Rel-17?

q_4672.question: Which MIME type specifies the Schedule information for the MBMS Metadata?
q_4672.ground_truth: The MIME type for the Schedule information is "application/mbms-schedule+xml"

q_4673.question: What is the role of Nomadic eNB (NeNB) in public safety communication?
q_4673.ground_truth: Nomadic eNBs are intended to provide coverage or additional capacity where it is not present, such as in forest fires or underground rescues, or where coverage is no longer available due to natural disasters.

q_4674.question: What does the Cell Load Information field element include?
q_4674.ground_truth: The Cell Load Information field element includes information about the downlink or uplink traffic load of a cell. It contains the load value, which is the total cell load relative to the maximum planned load, and the ratio of the load generated by Real Time traffic relative to the measured Load Value. It also includes the NRT Load Information Value, which indicates the load situation on the cell for non Real- Time traffic.

q_4675.question: What is the condition that the MAC entity should fulfill in order to consider the TA of the initial CG-SDT transmission to be valid?
q_4675.ground_truth: The MAC entity should fulfill the conditions specified in TS 38.321 clause 5.27.2, such as valid RSRP values, no significant change in RSRP value, and the cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer should be running.

q_4676.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Protocol layer obtaining the PDUID during the service authorization for ProSe Direct Discovery from the ProSe Function of the HPLMN?
q_4676.ground_truth: The PDUID is used to conceal the 3GPP layer identity of the UE from the application layer. The ProSe Function maintains the mapping of the PDUID to the 3GPP layer UE ID.

q_4677.question: What action does the old SGSN take after receiving an SGSN Context Request message from the new SGSN and validating the old P-TMSI Signature?
q_4677.ground_truth: If the old P-TMSI Signature is valid, the old SGSN responds with an SGSN Context Response (Cause, IMSI, MM Context, PDP contexts) message.

q_4678.question: What is the purpose of defining MBMS User Services as compared to the MBMS application independent transport service?
q_4678.ground_truth: The purpose of defining MBMS User Services is to specify the requirements in terms of data rates, quality of service, and typical volumes of data for each service. The MBMS application independent transport service, as defined in TS 22.146, provides the basic multimedia broadcast and multicast service.

q_4679.question: What is an OSDD in the context of BS's receiver directional requirements?
q_4679.ground_truth: OSDD is a declaration of receiver sensitivity directions for conformance testing, declared for OTA sensitivity requirement.

q_4680.question: What is the purpose of GTP in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_4680.ground_truth: GTP (GPRS Tunnelling Protocol) in the 3GPP technical specification defines the functions, procedures and information which apply to GERAN Iu mode for tunnelling packet data between GSNs (GPRS Support Nodes) or between a GSN and a RNC (Radio Network Controller) in the Gn, Gp and Iu interfaces of the General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) and UMTS system.

q_4681.question: What is the effect of the DTM handover procedure on the mobile station's ongoing uplink and downlink TBFs?
q_4681.ground_truth: After terminating the DTM handover procedure, the mobile station resumes all ongoing uplink and downlink TBFs that were ongoing in the old cell prior to receiving the DTM HANDOVER COMMAND message and for which T3180 and T3190 are still running. The RLC state machine reflects the state of each TBF when the last RLC data block was transmitted or received for that TBF in the old cell.

q_4682.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP system supporting selection of one out of potentially several Evolved ProSe UE-to-Network Relays through a defined relay UE selection procedure?
q_4682.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow Evolved Prose Remote UE access to a 3GPP PLMN through an appropriate Evolved Prose UE-to-Network Relay in proximity of the Evolved Prose Remote UE.

q_4683.question: What is the purpose of rrc-TransactionIdentifier in the RRCConnectionSetup-IEs sequence?
q_4683.ground_truth: It is used to uniquely identify the transaction between a particular connection setup.

q_4684.question: What is the use of the new RTP header extension type in the coordinated mode of operation?
q_4684.ground_truth: The new RTP header extension type is used to carry query signals for available additional delay budget information during the RTP streaming of media. It is signalled from the MTSI sender to the MTSI receiver.

q_4685.question: What should be minimized in active data sessions to avoid impact to cell (re)selection and handover?
q_4685.ground_truth: Additional cell reselections and handovers compared to the reference case.

q_4686.question: What action must the PCEF take if it receives certain release causes from the access network during the IP-CAN session termination process?
q_4686.ground_truth: The PCEF must provide the received cause(s) in the Charging-Rule-Report AVP

q_4687.question: What must be added as an indication to the RRC Inactive Assistance Information to ensure that the UE is only released to RRC Inactive?
q_4687.ground_truth: A new indication in the RRC Inactive Assistance Information

q_4688.question: What protocol is used for communication between the eNB-CP and eNB-UP in E-UTRAN, and between the ng-eNB-CU-CP and ng-eNB-CU-UP in NG-RAN?
q_4688.ground_truth: The E1 interface is used between the eNB-CP and eNB-UP in E-UTRAN and between the ng-eNB-CU-CP and ng-eNB-CU-UP in NG-RAN.

q_4689.question: What action is taken by the GCR if an IAM initiated call results in a successful check of the calling party number?
q_4689.ground_truth: If the check is successful, the GCR marks its group call reference record with "on-going call" and returns a positive response including the group call attributes to the MSC. If the calling party number check is not successful, the GCR returns a negative response indicating "failure" to the MSC.

q_4690.question: What action does the UE take when it has been able to calculate a position after performing measurements in OTDOA or GPS positioning?
q_4690.ground_truth: The UE includes the IE "UE positioning Position Estimate Info" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT, containing the GPS TOW msec or the calculated position and any applicable uncertainties.

q_4691.question: Which field is ignored by UEs supporting NTN when multiple PLMNs or NPNs are indicated in the SIB1?
q_4691.ground_truth: cellBarred field is ignored by UEs supporting NTN when multiple PLMNs or NPNs are indicated in the SIB1

q_4692.question: In what scenario is the MSGin5G Gateway involved in sending a group message to a Legacy 3GPP message client?
q_4692.ground_truth: When a 3GPP message client is registered as the recipient of a group message, the MSGin5G server sends the Group Message Request to the MSGin5G Gateway which then translates it to a legacy 3GPP message and sends it to the Legacy 3GPP message client.

q_4693.question: What is the purpose of the "3gpp-Required-Features" header in the REST based Nu interface?
q_4693.ground_truth: The "3gpp-Required-Features" header is used in the REST based Nu interface to advertise the required features supported by the client for interoperability. The server shall include in the HTTP response the set of features it supports in common with the client in the 3gpp-Accepted-Features header.

q_4694.question: What network entities are responsible for handling the PDN connection duration and inactivity timer for Restricted Local Operator Services (RLOS) and emergency services?
q_4694.ground_truth: PCEF controls the duration of PDN connection for RLOS, while handling of inactivity timer for the emergency PDN connection is not applicable for RLOS.

q_4695.question: What is the purpose of the S-CCPCH power offset difference in FDD and P-CCPCH in TDD?
q_4695.ground_truth: The S-CCPCH power offset difference in FDD and P-CCPCH in TDD is used to indicate the S-CCPCH power on neighboring cells, which can be used to complete the ranking of neighboring cells based on P-CPICH power.

q_4696.question: What should the MAC entity do when the timeAlignmentTimer associated with a TAG is not running and an uplink transmission is required, except for the Random Access Preamble and MSGA transmission?
q_4696.ground_truth: Ignore the received Timing Advance Command.

q_4697.question: What actions does the D-SON management function perform when the MRO performance does not meet the targets?
q_4697.ground_truth: When the MRO performance does not meet the targets, the D-SON management function consumes the MnS of provisioning with modifyMOIAttributes operation to update the targets of the MRO function, update the ranges of the handover parameters, or update the control parameters.

q_4698.question: What is the format of the GeneralCauseList-SyncAdjustmntFailureTDD sequence?
q_4698.ground_truth: The GeneralCauseList-SyncAdjustmntFailureTDD sequence is a sequence of one to maxCellinNodeB ProtocolIE-Single-Container with a cause and iE-Extensions.

q_4699.question: What action should an MBMS-aware application take if it receives an "insufficientStorage()" notification?
q_4699.ground_truth: The application should take appropriate measures to enable the continuation of the service, such as changing the service location, clearing storage autonomously, or communicating with the user to release storage.

q_4700.question: What information does the TDD DL Code Information IE provide for RL?
q_4700.ground_truth: The TDD DL Code Information IE provides DL Code information for the RL.

q_4701.question: What is the difference between sphere-locked and viewport-locked rendering in ITT4RT-Rx client?
q_4701.ground_truth: In sphere-locked rendering, the ITT4RT-Rx client reverses the rotation of the received image before rendering, while in viewport-locked, the ITT4RT-Rx client always renders the received image to the center of the viewport.

q_4702.question: What are the conditions for limiting the ratio in the low-frequency emphasis function in spectrum pre-shaping?
q_4702.ground_truth: The two conditions for limiting the ratio in the low-frequency emphasis function are Rm > 10, which means no spectral components in the low-frequency emphasis function will be modified by more than 20 dB, and Rm > Rm-1, which ensures that the ratio function Rm decreases monotonically.

q_4703.question: What is the GNSS-based positioning mechanism that operates in an autonomous or assisted mode for determining the MS's position based on signals received from global navigation satellite systems?
q_4703.ground_truth: GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System)-based positioning mechanism

q_4704.question: What are the two models for O2I penetration loss, and in which scenarios are they applicable?
q_4704.ground_truth: The two models for O2I penetration loss are the low-loss model and the high-loss model. The low-loss model is applicable to UMa, UMi-Street Canyon, and RMa, while the high-loss model is applicable to InF.

q_4705.question: What is the leaving condition for the event A3-2 in the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in clause 5.5.4.4 of TS 38.331?
q_4705.ground_truth: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighboring cell, Ofn is the measurement object specific offset of the reference signal of the neighbor cell, Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbor cell, Mp is the measurement result of the SpCell, Ofp is the measurement object specific offset of the SpCell, Ocp is the cell specific offset of the SpCell, Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Off is the offset parameter for this event.

q_4706.question: What is the purpose of the E-RUCCH in LTE?
q_4706.ground_truth: The E-RUCCH is used to carry E-DCH-associated uplink control signalling when E-PUCH resources are not available.

q_4707.question: What is the difference between SMS offline charging and online charging scenarios?
q_4707.ground_truth: SMS offline charging scenarios are based on SMS Nodes reporting chargeable events associated with SM transactions, while SMS online charging scenarios depend on the specific charging model applied. A "refund" may be necessary for unsuccessful delivery in online charging scenarios.

q_4708.question: What behavior does the UE exhibit in 5GMM-IDLE mode regarding PLMN selection in 3GPP access?
q_4708.ground_truth: The UE shall perform PLMN selection procedures as in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access.

q_4709.question: In Case A, how many premium UEs should be present in an MMVC session for SHVC to result in overall bandwidth reduction compared to HEVC simulcast?
q_4709.ground_truth: There should be 4 or fewer premium UEs for SHVC to result in overall bandwidth reduction.

q_4710.question: What should the MRFC include in the SDP offer regarding image sizes if it supports the negotiation of the image size and the MRFP receives an SDP offer for subsequent call leg in a conference?
q_4710.ground_truth: The MRFC should include the SDP image attribute(s) "a=imageattr", with image sizes as supported by the MRFP and negotiated at other call legs in the session if it supports the negotiation of the image size and if it sends an SDP offer for subsequent call leg in a conference.

q_4711.question: What steps must the IWF performing the participating role take upon receiving a SIP BYE request for private call session?
q_4711.ground_truth: The IWF must follow the procedures as specified in clause 6.3.

q_4712.question: Who wrote the C Programming Language book?
q_4712.ground_truth: Brian Kern, Dennis M. Ritchie and Rob Pike

q_4713.question: What document format is used for the Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT) proforma?
q_4713.ground_truth: The Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT) proforma is in the form of a questionnaire.

q_4714.question: What is the capacity performance for FR2, Indoor Hotspot DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, SU-MIMO, 10ms PDB, 120 FPS, 30Mbps, Option 1 UE Antenna parameters (M, N, P) = (1, 4, 2), 3 panels (left, right, top)?
q_4714.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is 8.87 UEs per cell.

q_4715.question: What is the UE Context in the context of RNSAP protocol?
q_4715.ground_truth: The UE Context is the necessary information for the DRNC/DBSS to communicate with a specific UE. It is created by the Radio Link Setup procedure or by the Uplink Signalling Transfer procedure when the UE makes its first access in a cell controlled by the DRNS/DBSS or by Enhanced Relocation procedure when the procedure is the first dedicated RNSAP procedure for the UE.

q_4716.question: In the second scenario, what action is taken simultaneously with the service delivery?
q_4716.ground_truth: The CTF monitors the consumption of the reserved units.

q_4717.question: What is a Black List in the context of SPIT/UC protection?
q_4717.ground_truth: A Black List is a Supplementary Service used in a SPIT/UC protection mechanism that rejects matching numbers with a Denial Announcement, thus protecting from known SPITters.

q_4718.question: What type of time units are used in "UE call established time" measurement?
q_4718.ground_truth: This measurement is obtained using DER, and it is measured in seconds.

q_4719.question: What message is sent by the network to the mobile station to command it to continue the cell re-selection procedure?

q_4720.question: When is the BM-SC Key Distribution function required to initiate MSK delivery procedure(s)?
q_4720.ground_truth: The BM-SC Key Distribution function initiates MSK delivery procedure(s) for those MBMS User Services for which the response message indicated success.

q_4721.question: What is the expected sequence 1.1 for closing a channel that was already opened?
q_4721.ground_truth: PROACTIVE COMMAND: CLOSE CHANNEL 1.3.1, TERMINAL RESPONSE: CLOSE CHANNEL 1.3.1A or TERMINAL RESPONSE: CLOSE CHANNEL 1.3.1B

q_4722.question: What is the purpose of the 900MHz NR band for Europe for Rail Mobile Radio (RMR) in 3GPP TR 38.853?
q_4722.ground_truth: The purpose of the 900MHz NR band for Europe for Rail Mobile Radio (RMR) in 3GPP TR 38.853 is to address the necessary precautions to make the paired spectrum of 874.6-800/919.4-925MHz usable for 5G NR in Europe.

q_4723.question: What is the purpose of the Cr interface in the IP Multimedia Subsystem?
q_4723.ground_truth: The Cr interface in the IP Multimedia Subsystem allows interaction between an Application Server and an MRFC, and is used when utilizing MRB in Query mode to assign media resources to a call.

q_4724.question: What is the purpose of determining the overlap in the BD-rate computation?
q_4724.ground_truth: The overlap is used to ensure that the area between the two curves is measured in a region with sufficient overlap, making the BD-rate value meaningful.

q_4725.question: What is the MU (in dB) for relative ACLR in the frequency range 0 - 3 GHz and 3 - 6 GHz, for devices designed to operate in licensed spectrum, for OTA ACLR tests in TRP estimation?
q_4725.ground_truth: The MU for relative ACLR is 1.0 dB in the frequency range 0 - 3 GHz and 1.2 dB in the frequency range 3 - 6 GHz, for devices designed to operate in licensed spectrum, for OTA ACLR tests in TRP estimation.

q_4726.question: What is the range of C/I ratios sufficient to multiplex four users with half-rate codecs and full-rate users with TCHAFS 5.9 codec using OSC in downlink?
q_4726.ground_truth: The C/I ratios required are from 10 to 20 dB for half-rate users and from 3 to 15 dB for full-rate users.

q_4727.question: What is the purpose of the iE-Extensions field in MICH-768-Parameters-CTCH-ReconfRqstTDD?
q_4727.ground_truth: The iE-Extensions field in MICH-768-Parameters-CTCH-ReconfRqstTDD allows for the inclusion of additional protocol extension information.

q_4728.question: In what situation must the UE use a feedback command of '0' when transmitting in uplink during downlink compressed mode?
q_4728.ground_truth: This occurs when there is a downlink transmission gap in compressed mode and no estimate of the phase adjustment is calculated for certain slots, and the UE is required to send feedback in the uplink.

q_4729.question: What are the different states defined in the physical layer of the MS?
q_4729.ground_truth: In the physical layer of the MS, there are five states defined: NULL, SEARCHING BCH, BCH, TUNING DCH, and DCH.

q_4730.question: What step is repeated in 8.3A.4.2.2.2 and what is its purpose?
q_4730.ground_truth: Step 4 of 8.3A.4.2.2.2 is repeated, and its purpose is to set up a call between the BS tester generating the wanted signal and the BS, and measure the BLER of the wanted signal at the BS receiver.

q_4731.question: What are the four types of files provided for the digital test sequences in the GSM 06.20 standard?
q_4731.ground_truth: The four types of files provided for the digital test sequences in the GSM 06.20 standard are files for input to the GSM half rate speech encoder (.INP), files for comparison with the encoder output (.COD), files for input to the GSM half rate speech decoder (.DEC), and files for comparison with the decoder output (.OUT).

q_4732.question: What is the process for Scheduled Location Time in 5G network positioning?
q_4732.ground_truth: During the positioning procedure, the LMF obtains the scheduled location time from the AMF and schedules the UE's and/or NG-RAN's location measurements to occur at or near the scheduled location time.

q_4733.question: In what situation is the application relocation exposure provided by the AF in clause~6.29.2.3 of the document?
q_4733.ground_truth: The application relocation exposure is provided by the AF in clause~6.29.2.3 when the SMF can get the notification from the AF for the edge application server relocation.

q_4734.question: Which key derivation function is used to derive CKSRVCC and IKSRVCC from KASME and the NAS downlink COUNT?
q_4734.ground_truth: A one-way key derivation function KDF as specified in clause A.12 is used to derive CKSRVCC and IKSRVCC from KASME and the NAS downlink COUNT.

q_4735.question: What is required to securely exchange multi-modal synchronization in a distributed multi-modal or multidevoice browser?
q_4735.ground_truth: Mechanisms such as encryption and presentation manipulation from trusted/authored parties should be used to securely exchange multi-modal synchronization.

q_4736.question: What is the impact on the data part size in the new formats compared to the old formats?
q_4736.ground_truth: The data part is approximately 21 % larger consistently for all MCS in the new formats compared to the old formats.

q_4737.question: What is currently missing in OAM for identifying a UE connected to a certain gNB?
q_4737.ground_truth: There is currently no UE identifier available in OAM that can be used to identify a UE connected to a certain gNB.

q_4738.question: What should UTRAN not do when sending the "Downlink information per radio link list on secondary UL frequency" IE?
q_4738.ground_truth: UTRAN should not mix radio links which are part of the current secondary E-DCH active set and radio links which are not part of the current secondary E-DCH active set in the same IE.

q_4739.question: What is the significance of the "Change of Location" attribute in the M-CDR?
q_4739.ground_truth: The "Change of Location" attribute in the M-CDR consists of a set of containers that are added when specific trigger conditions are met. It identifies the time stamped routing area on encountering that trigger condition.

q_4740.question: What are the recommended conditions for running the performance evaluations of the SES codecs?
q_4740.ground_truth: The performance evaluations were conducted by two leading companies in the area of speech recognition, IBM and Scansoft, and the "recommendation criteria" have been applied to select the DSR codec for SES.

q_4741.question: Within how many seconds after reselecting a new cell must the network provide relevant reselection parameters to the MS in packet transfer mode or broadcast/multicast receive mode?

q_4742.question: In the context of 8.2.3.6.1a.1, what must the UE do when the entry condition for event A3 is not met for the neighbor NR cell?
q_4742.ground_truth: The UE must not send the MeasurementReport.

q_4743.question: What is the purpose of the procedure described in clause 5.3.14.1 in TS 38.331?
q_4743.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to perform access barring check for an access attempt associated with a given Access Category and one or more Access Identities upon request from upper layers or the RRC layer.

q_4744.question: What is the result if not all the RABs can be allocated in the target RNS in a PS handover?
q_4744.ground_truth: The target RNS indicates this to the new SGSN, which then informs the old SGSN/source BSS on the accepted and failed BSS PFCs.

q_4745.question: What is the condition when the channel is not available?
q_4745.ground_truth: The channel is not available when all the calls are either held, active, or waiting, and there is no user responding or there is a disconnect demand.

q_4746.question: What is the purpose of the 'layer' attribute in the Simple Timed Graphics region definition?
q_4746.ground_truth: The 'layer' attribute in the Simple Timed Graphics region definition specifies the front-to-back ordering of the graphics region, with lower numbers being closer to the viewer and 0 being the normal value.

q_4747.question: What is the Disposable-Ks model in the context of GBA Push?
q_4747.ground_truth: The Disposable-Ks model is a keying model in GBA Push, where only one NAF-key is generated per Ks and the Ks cannot be reused.

q_4748.question: What is the role of the IP-SM-GW in the 3GPP network architecture?
q_4748.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW provides protocol interworking for delivery of short messages between IP-based UE and SMSC, and delivery of short messages to IP-based UE for cases with or without MSISDN.

q_4749.question: What is the purpose of the "Sync" function?
q_4749.ground_truth: The "Sync" function is the main synchronization function and takes in a SyncState* sync struct, a const Int16* pcm (input frame), a const char* caller (modem identification) and a Bool invert (port inversion flag).

q_4750.question: What modifications are needed to the PLMN selection procedure to handle shared/global PLMN IDs?
q_4750.ground_truth: The PLMN selection procedure should accommodate the different behavior of shared/global PLMN IDs. For example, updating the definition of the "country" to allow selection based on RAT types (e.g., satellite), or introducing a new means to define and compare the PLMN in the selection process. In addition, the priority order when selecting a PLMN based on its ID should be adjusted to allow shared/global PLMN IDs to be preferred when appropriate.

q_4751.question: What is the role of a Fully Qualified PDN Connection Set Identifier (FQ-CSID) in 3GPP networks?
q_4751.ground_truth: The FQ-CSID identifies a set of PDN connections belonging to an arbitrary number of UEs on a node such as a MME, SGW, or PGW. It is used in case of partial node failure to identify the PDN connections associated with a Connection Set Identifier.

q_4752.question: What action does the ProSe Function take when it receives a successful discover authorization update for restricted ProSe direct discovery in a PXA command from the ProSe Application Server?
q_4752.ground_truth: The ProSe Function acknowledges the reception of the PXR command and sends a PXA command with the Result-Code AVP set to "SUCCESS".

q_4753.question: What is the scaling factor for Rx beam sweeping when the positioning frequency layer is in FR2 and the UE supports the capability for the band containing the positioning frequency layer?

q_4754.question: What is the purpose of a chargeable event within the context of 3GPP charging functionality?
q_4754.ground_truth: A chargeable event is any activity that utilizes telecommunications network resources and related services, which the network operator may want to charge for. This characterizes resource/service usage and indicates the identity of the involved end user(s).

q_4755.question: What is the code rate used for HS-SCCH type 7?
q_4755.ground_truth: The rate 1/3 convolutional coding is used for HS-SCCH type 7.

q_4756.question: What is the purpose of the SIP OPTIONS exchange is in the context of "intrinsically offloadable" media flows?
q_4756.ground_truth: The SIP OPTIONS exchange is used by UE-A to indicate its ability to offload traffic and to trigger a reachability check with UE-B.

q_4757.question: What is the responsibility of the smoothing block in the phase matching packet loss concealment processing?
q_4757.ground_truth: The smoothing block generates a time domain signal on the concealed current frame by performing smoothing processing through OLA to minimize the discontinuity between the current frame and adjacent frames.

q_4758.question: What should a UE do if it fails to perform a handover and establish a connection to UTRAN?
q_4758.ground_truth: The UE should terminate the procedure, release the associated resources, resume the connection used before the handover, and indicate the failure to the other radio access technology.

q_4759.question: What is the necessity for any complete solution for protection against unsolicited communication in IMS network?
q_4759.ground_truth: A complete solution for protection against unsolicited communication in IMS network should be able to protect IMS network operator and IMS users against forged sender identity, network spoofing, and the attacker versatility threats in an efficient manner.

q_4760.question: What is the mean capacity performance of FR1, Indoor Hotspot, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, 30Mbps, with MU-MIMO, for mobile device with cenband?

q_4761.question: What is the significance of MBS Session-AMBR in solution #36?
q_4761.ground_truth: Solution #36 proposes new QoS parameter (i.e. MBS Session-AMBR) for MBS, but it is not needed to be communicated to the RAN due to the following reason that MBR policing for the MB service data flow will be enforced in the MB-UPF, therefore there is no need for NG-RAN to do MBR policing again.

q_4762.question: For what scenarios does the Gateway Control Session Establishment procedure apply?
q_4762.ground_truth: The Gateway Control Session Establishment procedure applies to two cases, when the PCEF establishes the IP-CAN Session, and when an established IP-CAN Session corresponds to the Gateway Control Session being established.

q_4763.question: What is the mechanism for the source gNB to send multicast data to the target gNB during the Xn based leg addition in the multicast session path addition?
q_4763.ground_truth: The source gNB may replicate multicast data corresponding to the Forwarding TMGIs/MBS Session IDs and sends them to the target gNB via the Direct Forwarding Tunnel, which is dedicated for the MBS sessions.

q_4764.question: What does the captureOnce parameter indicate when set to true in the startFdCapture() API?
q_4764.ground_truth: When captureOnce is set to true, it signals that the file requested via the fileURI or a file matching a BaseURL in fileURI, or any file if the fileURI is empty, is to be captured only once.

q_4765.question: What is the impact on the SGSN' paging for E-UTRAN when the associated MME performs paging?
q_4765.ground_truth: The SGSN's PPF has no impact on whether or not the MME performs paging in E-UTRAN.

q_4766.question: What is the effect of an unspecified value in a service data flow filter pattern?
q_4766.ground_truth: A value left unspecified in a filter matches any value of the corresponding information in a packet.

q_4767.question: What is used to control the user data flow for MAC-c/sh SDUs with the same priority level and size in the FACH transport channel?
q_4767.ground_truth: The FACH Flow Control procedure is used for this purpose.

q_4768.question: What should a mobile station do if it does not support Downlink Dual Carrier and receives a PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message or a MULTIPLE TBF UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message that assigns resources on two carriers?
q_4768.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_4769.question: What is one option for implementing the multi-carrier RF in a mobile station receiver?
q_4769.ground_truth: One option is to have separate receiver chains for each carrier, allowing the receiver branches to be tuned to different frequencies.

q_4770.question: What are the three components of the PSS base vocabulary?
q_4770.ground_truth: The three components of the PSS base vocabulary are PssCommon, Streaming, and ThreeGPFileFormat, describing the common capabilities, streaming, and 3GP file download or progressive download, respectively.

q_4771.question: What type of measurement provides the number of answered session establishments for announcements at the MRFC?

q_4772.question: What is the purpose of starting timer T3126 if the mobile station has initiated the immediate assignment procedure for an emergency call or for sending a paging response and has sent M + 1 CHANNEL REQUEST messages?
q_4772.ground_truth: At expiry of timer T3126, the immediate assignment procedure is aborted, and if the immediate assignment procedure was triggered by a request from the MM sublayer, a random access failure is indicated to the MM sublayer.

q_4773.question: What is the meaning of the term "Haptic" as used in the document?
q_4773.ground_truth: Haptic refers to the sense perceived by touching an object, involving both tactile and kinaesthetic senses.

q_4774.question: What is the role of the U2N Relay in establishing a new PDU session for relaying and setting UP security policies for the PDU session?
q_4774.ground_truth: The U2N Relay initiates a new PDU session establishment procedure for relaying before completing the PC5 connection establishment if there is no PDU session associated with the RSC or a new one is needed. The SMF sets the UP security policies for the PDU session for relaying requested by the U2N Relay, and the NG-RAN activates Uu security protection based on the UP security policies received from the core network.

q_4775.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) do when it receives a message with a syntactically incorrect Information Element (IE)?
q_4775.ground_truth: The MS should send a RELEASE COMPLETE message with cause #96 "Invalid mandatory information" if the message is not a RELEASE COMPLETE. If it is a RELEASE COMPLETE, it should be treated as a normal RELEASE COMPLETE message.

q_4776.question: What is the maximum length of the ProSe Application Code Suffix that the HPLMN ProSe Function in VPLMN or Local PLMN can allocate to the UE based on the input in step 2.a and 2.b ?
q_4776.ground_truth: The choice is per application, but the HPLMN ProSe Function in VPLMN or Local PLMN needs to support a large number of or a range of ProSe Application Code Suffixes.

q_4777.question: How many simultaneous wireless microphones can be expected for an on-site live audio presentation?
q_4777.ground_truth: A number between 5 and 300 simultaneously active wireless microphones can be expected.

q_4778.question: What action does the SGSN take if the GGSN receives new or updated Additional MBMS Trace Info from the new SGSN during Inter SGSN Routeing Area Update procedure?
q_4778.ground_truth: The GGSN sends an Activate Trace (Additional MBMS Trace Info) message to the BM-SC.

q_4779.question: Which entities share the same security requirements with the H(e)NB in terms of secure backhaul link?
q_4779.ground_truth: The Local Gateway (L-GW) shares the same security requirements with the H(e)NB.

q_4780.question: What information does the RAN use when received MBS Session Priority associated with MBS Session ID?
q_4780.ground_truth: The RAN uses this information for local RRM policies to ensure for that UE the QoS level for the respective MBS Session(s) is provided.

q_4781.question: What is the purpose of the Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) pro-forma in 3GPP TS 37.571-1?
q_4781.ground_truth: The purpose of the Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) pro-forma in 3GPP TS 37.571-1 is to serve as a template for the manufacturers to declare the technical features, interfaces, and conformance of their User Equipment (UE) to the 3GPP specifications for UE positioning.

q_4782.question: What is the purpose of the project described in the technical report?
q_4782.ground_truth: The purpose of the project is to provide information on the AMR Wideband (AMR-WB) Characterisation, Verification and Selection Phases, report experimental test results, provide information on the implementation complexity of the AMR-WB codec, and present verification results for the floating-point version of the AMR-WB codec.

q_4783.question: What happens during the update of the MBMS Service Context in functionality 6.3 and 6.4?
q_4783.ground_truth: In functionality 6.3, when a PMM-CONNECTED UE, which has activated an MBMS Service, enters a cell, the MBMS Service Context is updated in the CRNC via Iur by UE Linking. Similarly, in functionality 6.4, when a PMM-CONNECTED UE, which has activated an MBMS Service, leaves a cell, the MBMS Service Context is updated in the CRNC via Iur by UE Un-Linking.

q_4784.question: What is the difference in resource usage between a 9 re-use factor and a 3 re-use factor for the DL and for 23 dBm devices on the UL in the EC-GSM-IoT system?
q_4784.ground_truth: There is a rather large relative impact on the DL, with more resources used for 23 dBm devices on the UL.

q_4785.question: What is the meaning of the term "XML complex type" as used in the document?
q_4785.ground_truth: An XML complex type is defined in an XML schema, cannot be directly used in an XML document, and ultimately defines constraints for an XML element on its XML attribute specifications and/or its XML content.

q_4786.question: What is the purpose of UE test loop mode E in 5GS?
q_4786.ground_truth: UE test loop mode E provides means for either transmission or reception of SDAP SDUs for PC5 QoS Flows while UE is operating in NR sidelink.

q_4787.question: What is the role of CLUE in IMS telepresence?
q_4787.ground_truth: This specification introduces updates and enhancements for IMS to facilitate controlling multiple spatially related media streams in an IM session supporting telepresence. This is done by incorporating CLUE with SIP, SDP and BFCP.

q_4788.question: What is the "Maximum RLC AM Window Size" parameter used for in UE radio access capabilities?
q_4788.ground_truth: This parameter is used to define the maximum transmission and receiving window size of RLC AM entities supported by the UE.

q_4789.question: What issue does the solution in section 6.23.1 address?

q_4790.question: What does the id-Cell-Capacity-Class-Value mean in EnhancedRelocationResourceResponse-IEs in RNSAP protocol?
q_4790.ground_truth: The id-Cell-Capacity-Class-Value represents the cell capacity class value in EnhancedRelocationResourceResponse-IEs of RNSAP protocol.

q_4791.question: What is the responsibility of the 2nd level NWDAF b in the scenario?
q_4791.ground_truth: The 2nd level NWDAF b performs the analytics of Analytics ID1 for the target user equipment (UE) and sends the analytics report to the 1st level NWDAF A.

q_4792.question: What is included in the Direct Communication Request message during PC5 connection establishment?
q_4792.ground_truth: The Direct Communication Request message includes PDU session requirements such as S-NSSAI, DNN, PDU Session Type, SSC mode.

q_4793.question: What is the maximum VCL Bit Rate and cpbBrNalFactor for an H.264 (AVC) Progressive High Profile Level 3.1 decoder that should be supported by a MBMS client for video delivery?
q_4793.ground_truth: The maximum VCL Bit Rate is constrained to be 14Mbps with cpbBrVclFactor and cpbBrNalFactor being fixed to be 1000 and 1200, respectively.

q_4794.question: What is the structure of the PDU-definitions?
q_4794.ground_truth: The PDU-definitions is an AUTOMATIC TAGS definition that includes a number of imported data types and defines various message types for downlink and uplink communication between a user equipment and a network.

q_4795.question: What is the purpose of the UI command in the described data link layer?
q_4795.ground_truth: The UI command is used to send information to its peer in the data link layer.

q_4796.question: What information is provided in the open ProSe Direct Discovery Model A monitoring authorization policy?
q_4796.ground_truth: The PLMNs in which the UE is authorized to perform ProSe Direct Discovery monitoring.

q_4797.question: What is the parameter used to determine whether prioritized LSA cell reselection shall apply, in the context of EC-GSM-IoT capable MS evaluating the cell reselection criterion for a cell capable of EC-GSM-IoT?

q_4798.question: What is the format of the CommonMeasurementFailureIndication message?
q_4798.ground_truth: The CommonMeasurementFailureIndication message is a sequence containing protocolIEs and protocolExtensions, which are optional.

q_4799.question: What is the purpose of using the simulcast attribute in SDP?
q_4799.ground_truth: The simulcast attribute in SDP is used to indicate that multiple streams (using different codecs) are being sent concurrently in the same RTP session.

q_4800.question: What information does the LCS Location Notification Invoke message include?
q_4800.ground_truth: The LCS Location Notification Invoke message includes the type of location request from the LCS Client, the identity of the LCS client, the Requestor Identity (if available), the type of the LCS client name, the type of the Requestor identity (if included), the service type, and the codeword.

q_4801.question: Which clause in the RRC specification lists the RRC functions and the services provided to upper layers?
q_4801.ground_truth: Clause 5 in the RRC specification lists the RRC functions and the services provided to upper layers.

q_4802.question: What is the minimum requirement for spurious emissions under Category A limits?
q_4802.ground_truth: The power of any spurious emission shall not exceed the limits specified in ITU-R Recommendation SM.329-9.

q_4803.question: What is Key Issue #4 about in 3GPP TS 33.501?
q_4803.ground_truth: Key Issue #4 in 3GPP TS 33.501 is about the integrity protection capability imbalance in enodeB connected to 5GC. It discusses the issue of backward compatibility with 2 different generation systems in MR-DC scenarios, where the older system (i.e. eNB) does not support UP integrity protection.

q_4804.question: In which scenarios can a Ground FRMCS User be attached to the FRMCS system, GSM-R system, or both for multi-train voice communication?
q_4804.ground_truth: A Ground FRMCS User can be attached to the FRMCS system, GSM-R system, or both for multi-train voice communication, depending on the migration scenario.

q_4805.question: Which algorithm provides the highest throughput to elastic users, while still considering the needs of video streaming users?

q_4806.question: What is DTM handover, and what is its purpose in the context of mobile communications?
q_4806.ground_truth: DTM handover is a method introduced to support the parallel handover of circuit-switched and packet-switched domains of a mobile station in dual transfer mode or RRC connected mode, from a source cell to a target cell. This ensures seamless connectivity between different radio access technologies (RATs) and operation modes during handover procedures.

q_4807.question: When should the UE transmit a MSGA using a preamble in group A of random access preambles?
q_4807.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a MSGA using a preamble in group A of random access preambles if the UL MAC PDU Size is less than ra-MsgA-SizeGroupA.

q_4808.question: What functionalities does the Work Item introduce for PUSCH repetition Type A?
q_4808.ground_truth: The Work Item introduces an increase in the maximum number of repetitions for PUSCH repetition Type A to 32, as well as enhancements based on available slots, where the maximum number of repetitions is 32 and the UE follows a 2-step procedure for PUSCH transmissions.

q_4809.question: What is transmitted on the E-AGCH?
q_4809.ground_truth: TPC (transmit power control) is transmitted on E-AGCH whereas TFCI (transport format combination indicator) is not.

q_4810.question: What is the role of the RFSP in the 5GS?
q_4810.ground_truth: The RFSP (Radio Frequency Spectrum Parameter) is used to indicate the UE-specific RF-related admission and usage characteristics within the 5GS.

q_4811.question: What actions should the SGSN take upon reception of the PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST-ACK PDU?
q_4811.ground_truth: The SGSN should stop timer T13, end the PS Handover Request procedure, and start timer T14 for supervision of the PS Handover Complete procedure.

q_4812.question: What is the purpose of the procedure described in subclause 8.1.4a, as requested by upper layers?
q_4812.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to release the RRC connection and bar the current cell or cells.

q_4813.question: What TSN system attribute should be taken into account when providing or adapting service requirements to the 5GC or the UE in the integration of 5G networks and TSN networks?
q_4813.ground_truth: Survival time, which reflects an application's resilience to consecutive transmission failures of the application data, should be taken into account by the TSN system.

q_4814.question: What is the effect of the PDCP SN synchronisation procedure being complete on confirmation by the lower layer of the successful transmission of the PDCP SeqNum PDU?
q_4814.ground_truth: The PDCP SN synchronisation procedure is considered complete when the lower layer confirms the successful transmission of the PDCP SeqNum PDU.

q_4815.question: How is the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) document version updated?
q_4815.ground_truth: The version of the 3GPP TSG RAN document is updated with an identifying change of release date and a version number increase, with the first digit representing the stage of approval, the second digit for changes of substance, and the third digit for editorial-only changes.

q_4816.question: What happens if bearer setup fails in the selected terminating access network and other access network(s) is available for the service?
q_4816.ground_truth: The UE may send a message to the SCC AS indicating the failure of bearer setup, and the SCC AS can then update the relevant decision information for T-ADS and reselect a new access network for bearer setup.

q_4817.question: What determines if the UE considers the Recovery criterion for a TFC to be fulfilled?
q_4817.ground_truth: The Recovery criterion for a TFC is considered fulfilled if the estimated UE transmit power needed for the TFC has not been greater than the Maximum UE transmitter power for a specified number of successive measurement periods.

q_4818.question: What are the two methods for discovering a feed specified in SFR?
q_4818.ground_truth: The two methods for discovering a feed specified in SFR are internal discovery and external discovery.

q_4819.question: What is the maximum value that the entity number in protocol control information compression negotiation can take?
q_4819.ground_truth: The entity number is an integer that can take a value from 0 to 31.

q_4820.question: What is the size of the data block after the repetition encoder in the context of PLCCH coding?
q_4820.ground_truth: The size of the data block after the repetition encoder is 88 bits.

q_4821.question: What is the complexity of running EQ-B over a 2-slot aggregation compared to running EQ-A twice over a non-aggregated slot?
q_4821.ground_truth: The complexity of running EQ-B over a 2-slot aggregation is only marginally higher than running EQ-A twice over a non-aggregated slot.

q_4822.question: What are the two charging supplementary services defined in the 3GPP system?
q_4822.ground_truth: The two charging supplementary services defined in the 3GPP system are Advice of Charge (Information) (AoCI) and Advice of Charge (Charging) (AoCC).

q_4823.question: What is the length of the IMEI and IMEISV, and how are they coded?
q_4823.ground_truth: The IMEI is 15 digits long and the IMEISV is 16 digits long, with both coded as a sequence of BCD digits compressed two into each octet.

q_4824.question: What must the C/R bit be set to in a command message?
q_4824.ground_truth: The C/R bit must be set to 1 in a command message.

q_4825.question: What does the measurement SIG.NbrMTP3MSUReceived (SIG.NbrMTP3BMSUReceived) represent in the context of 5.1.3.1?
q_4825.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of message signalling units received on signalling link.

q_4826.question: What is the role of the MDAS producer in analyzing network slice load?
q_4826.ground_truth: The MDAS producer is responsible for correlating and analyzing the ongoing and/or potential network slice load problem based on the current and historical performance data related to resource usage and network traffic for the target network slice. The analysis considers various factors such as number of UEs accessing the network, number of QoS flows, and different NFs resource utilization which is related with the network slice instance. The MDAS producer provides an analytics report as defined in the specification, based on the analysis above.

q_4827.question: What is the format of the Alt-RAB-Parameter-ExtendedMaxBitrates?
q_4827.ground_truth: It is a SEQUENCE (SIZE (1..maxNrOfSeparateTrafficDirections)) OF ExtendedMaxBitrate.

q_4828.question: What is the method used to jointly vector quantize the adaptive codebook gain and the correction factor in the 4.75 kbit/s mode?
q_4828.ground_truth: The adaptive codebook gain and the correction factor are jointly vector quantized in the 4.75 kbit/s mode by minimizing the square of the weighted error between the original and reconstructed speech.

q_4829.question: What would happen if the SAS receives a POSITION CALCULATION REQUEST message without the Horizontal Accuracy Code IE but with the Vertical Accuracy Code IE?
q_4829.ground_truth: The SAS will reject the procedure.

q_4830.question: What must an LLE do to request an acknowledgement from the peer LLE?
q_4830.ground_truth: The LLE must transmit an I+S or S frame with the A bit set to 1 to request an acknowledgement from the peer LLE. The LLE may request an acknowledgement at any time, particularly after transmitting the last I frame in a sequence, when B > M - N201, or when V(S) = V(A) + k after transmitting the I frame.

q_4831.question: In NR positioning, what is the time duration of available PRS resources in the positioning frequency layer i, to be measured during?
q_4831.ground_truth: The time duration of available PRS resources in the positioning frequency layer i, to be measured during, is given by the higher-layer parameter PRS-Duration-to-be-measured for positioning frequency layer i.

q_4832.question: Which TS-family does the present document belong to in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group?
q_4832.ground_truth: The present document belongs to the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication management.

q_4833.question: What should be the destination IP address for an Error Indication message?
q_4833.ground_truth: The IP destination address for an Error Indication message should be the source address of the GTP-PDU that is the cause for the GSN/RNC to send the Error Indication message.

q_4834.question: What should the network do if the initial registration request is rejected due to general NAS level mobility management congestion control?
q_4834.ground_truth: The network should set the 5GMM cause value to #22 (Congestion) and assign a back-off timer T3346.

q_4835.question: What is the required functionality of the kernel function mapping between input and output values in the 3GPP MILENAGE framework?
q_4835.ground_truth: The kernel function in the 3GPP MILENAGE algorithm is responsible for mapping an input value to an output value under the control of a key K. It should hide the key K (i.e., make it infeasible to derive K) and be a bijective function (avoid collisions while ensuring equal input and output block sizes).

q_4836.question: What is the maximum number of antenna ports that can be used for MIMO in LTE downlink?
q_4836.ground_truth: The maximum number of antenna ports that can be used for MIMO in LTE downlink is 32 transmit antenna ports.

q_4837.question: What are the two forms of information transfer services associated with layer 3 in the data link layer?
q_4837.ground_truth: The two forms of information transfer services associated with layer 3 in the data link layer are based on unacknowledged information transfer at the data link layer and acknowledged information transfer at the data link layer using multiple frame operation.

q_4838.question: How many communication systems are expected to coexist during the migration period to FRMCS?
q_4838.ground_truth: Two communication systems (GSM-R and FRMCS) are expected to coexist during a period estimated to be 10 years.

q_4839.question: How are TFCI bits mapped to the TFCI bit positions for a TFCI code word with 6 bits?
q_4839.ground_truth: For a TFCI code word with 6 bits, the TFCI bits are mapped to the TFCI bit positions by repeating each bit to a total of 6 times.

q_4840.question: What is the requirement for the BSS selection of the remote IP endpoint for signalling traffic?
q_4840.ground_truth: Outgoing BVCI=0 NS-SDUs, or SNS PDUs shall be sent to a remote IP endpoint based on the signalling weight assigned by the peer NSE and distributed in equal proportion to the signalling weights assigned to the peer NSE's IP endpoints.

q_4841.question: What is the format of the Request-Line in the RTSP SETUP message constructed by the PSS Adapter when it sends SETUP messages to the PSS Server?
q_4841.ground_truth: The Request-Line is present of format: Request-Line = Method SP Request-URI SP RTSP-Version CRLF where Method is set to SETUP, RTSP-Version is set to RTSP/1.0, and the Request-URI is based on the R-URI, SDP parameters and selected PSS Server.

q_4842.question: Which puncturing pattern is used for the P1 puncturing in the DBC-450 code?
q_4842.ground_truth: The P1 puncturing pattern is determined by the CPS values in the DBC-450 code, with patterns defined in 3GPP TS 44.060.

q_4843.question: What parameter is used to determine if the dialog portion is encrypted or cleartext in the SCCP Data parameter?

q_4844.question: What should be included in the Authorization header field for a REGISTER request?
q_4844.ground_truth: The Authorization header field should include the username directive, set to the value of the private user identity; the realm directive, set to the domain name of the home network; the integrity-protected directive, set to "auth-done"; the uri directive, set to the SIP URI of the domain name of the home network; the nonce directive, set to an empty value; and the response directive, set to an empty value.

q_4845.question: What should the UE do if the new cell is not better than the current cell during the time interval TreselectionRAT after the reselection procedure?
q_4845.ground_truth: The UE should not reselect the new cell, and the current cell will remain as the serving cell.

q_4846.question: What is the impact of T320 expiration on the delete priorities provided by dedicated signalling?
q_4846.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the priorities provided by dedicated signalling when the optional validity time of dedicated priorities (T320) expires.

q_4847.question: What are the available operations for dynamic QoS rules?

q_4848.question: What information does the Dual Transfer Mode field element contain?
q_4848.ground_truth: It contains information about a mobile in dual transfer mode, including whether the MS is in dedicated mode or in dual transfer mode. It also indicates whether the MS has resources allocated exclusively for the CS domain or for both the CS and PS domains in the old cell.

q_4849.question: What is the role of the mobile station option in reading the NCH while in group receive mode, dedicated mode or originator in dedicated channel mode in order to be notified on other voice broadcast calls?
q_4849.ground_truth: This allows the mobile station to ensure a higher probability of receiving notifications for all present voice broadcast calls without degradation of the received speech quality.

q_4850.question: What is the role of the interior node under "/<X>" in the IMS service level tracing management object, and when is it mandatory?
q_4850.ground_truth: The interior node under "/<X>" acts as a placeholder for one or more accounts for a fixed node. It is mandatory if the UE (User Equipment) supports one or more IMS service level tracing capabilities, as defined by the related roles listed in clause 4 of the specification.

q_4851.question: What should the LLE do if it receives an XID command with mD or mU not equal to 0, but does not want to apply the count of outstanding I-frame octets in the corresponding direction?
q_4851.ground_truth: The LLE shall respond with mD=0 or mU=0, and set N201-I and kD or N201-I and kU so that N201-I multiplied with kD or N201-I multiplied with kU is less than or equal to the received MD or MU.

q_4852.question: What is the outcome when OR1:Y occurs?
q_4852.ground_truth: When OR1:Y occurs, the call is forwarded to the requested address.

q_4853.question: What happens to the numbering of UFPS when one or more existing UFPS are deleted?
q_4853.ground_truth: The remaining UFPS are renumbered to ensure sequential UFPS numbering.

q_4854.question: What does the HPLMN ProSe Function do if the ProSe Application Code received from the UE is not authorized for the monitored PLMN?
q_4854.ground_truth: The HPLMN Prose Function ensures that the received ProSe Application Code is authorized to be transmitted on the monitored PLMN.

q_4855.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA Proxy in the Local Breakout (LBO) case of 3GPP mobile network roaming?
q_4855.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy acts as an intermediary, forwarding messages between the 3GPP AAA Server in the Home Public Land Mobile Network (HPLMN) and the PDN GW in the Visited Public Land Mobile Network (VPLMN), and between the PDN GW in the VPLMN and the home PCRF in the HPLMN.

q_4856.question: Which types of E-UTRA UE are not applicable for the coarse time assistance test in section 7.1.1?
q_4856.ground_truth: Category M1 and Category M2 devices that do not support VoLTE are not applicable for the coarse time assistance test.

q_4857.question: What message is sent by a GGSN to SGSN as a response of a MBMS Notification Reject Request?
q_4857.ground_truth: The MBMS Notification Reject Response message is sent by a GGSN to SGSN as a response of a MBMS Notification Reject Request.

q_4858.question: What should the SMLC do if it does not receive a Positioning Capability Response or Protocol Error component from the MS within a set time period after sending a Positioning Capability Request component?
q_4858.ground_truth: The SMLC may abort the Positioning Capability Transfer Procedure attempt or send a new Positioning Capability Request.
