q_5113.question: What is the role of the EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure in 5G?
q_5113.ground_truth: The EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure in 5G enables mutual authentication between the UE and the network and provides keying material for subsequent security procedures.

q_5114.question: What does "LCS Feature" refer to in the context of location services?
q_5114.ground_truth: LCS Feature refers to the capability of a PLMN to support LCS Client/server interactions for locating Target UEs.

q_5115.question: What message is sent from the MS to the target GANC in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to indicate handover completion?
q_5115.ground_truth: The GA-PSR HANDOVER COMPLETE message is sent from the MS to the target GANC in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to indicate handover completion.

q_5116.question: What is the purpose of using the BSN in the fast Ack/Nack reporting structure?
q_5116.ground_truth: The BSN is used to indicate the Block Start Number of the first incorrectly received block, allowing for efficient error reporting.

q_5117.question: In which mode(s) can the RR entity provide indications to the upper layers on received paging messages in group transmit mode?
q_5117.ground_truth: The RR entity can provide indications in dedicated mode, or in group transmit mode.

q_5118.question: What message type is sent on the EC-PACCH from the mobile station to the network to indicate the status of downlink RLC data blocks received and to report the channel quality of the downlink, and may also include a fixed uplink allocation for the mobile station to (re)transmit not yet acknowledged/transmitted RLC Data blocks?

q_5119.question: What is the minimum UE class supporting the combination of DL: 32 kbps with a stand-alone signalling RB for PCCH in 9.4.1 classes?
q_5119.ground_truth: The minimum UE class supporting this combination is DL: 32 kbps.

q_5120.question: How many bits does the Length field of the GTP information elements contain, excluding the Type and Length field?
q_5120.ground_truth: The Length field of the GTP information elements contains the length of the information element excluding the Type and Length field.

q_5121.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Northbound Interfaces and APIs in TS 22.261?
q_5121.ground_truth: The 3GPP Northbound Interfaces and APIs are designed to enable external entities and third-party Application Servers/Functions to securely and controlledly access a set of exposed 3GPP network services and capabilities. They ensure the efficient use and deployment of various applications/services (e.g. V2X, UAS, EDGE) via an optimized application layer framework.

q_5122.question: What is the purpose of the satellite simulator in the context of GNSS testing?
q_5122.ground_truth: The satellite simulator generates all UE supported GNSS satellite signals and provides assistance data based on UE capabilities. It is used to test the signalling of the satellite system.

q_5123.question: What action does the terminal take after deleting an entry from the local phonebook?
q_5123.ground_truth: The terminal indicates that the deletion of the phonebook entry was performed successfully and the respective record is made empty after deletion.

q_5124.question: What type of constellation is used in the downlink concept of the Basic OSC for modulating bits?
q_5124.ground_truth: The downlink concept of the Basic OSC uses a QPSK type of constellation for modulating bits in the downlink.

q_5125.question: What is the role of the inter-PLMN discovery request in the process of selecting the target PLMN?
q_5125.ground_truth: The inter-PLMN discovery request is used by the target PLMN to determine the interface to be used.

q_5126.question: What must the ICS UE do when it detects a request for the establishment of an emergency session in the CS media?
q_5126.ground_truth: The ICS UE shall attempt to initiate a CS emergency call if it detects the request for the establishment of an emergency session, or forwards an IMS session establishment request if it could not detect an emergency call.

q_5127.question: What two media transport protocols does the DVB-MABR Phase 1 specification mandate?
q_5127.ground_truth: The DVB-MABR Phase 1 specification mandates two alternative multicast media transport protocols: Annex~F, an extended profile of the 3GPP FLUTE profile, and Annex~H: an extended profile of the ROUTE protocol specified in ATSC A/331.

q_5128.question: What is the communication protocol used for HeNB management?
q_5128.ground_truth: The communication protocol used for HeNB management is the TR-069 protocol.

q_5129.question: What is the measurement that provides the mean setup time of successful IMS initial registrations at P-CSCF, given as an integer value in milliseconds?

q_5130.question: How does IMS handle call forwarding compared to CS-domain call forwarding?
q_5130.ground_truth: IMS does not have any standard call forwarding service, but it provides the ability to build applications that can redirect sessions on the user's behalf based on many different types of criteria. CS-domain call forwarding provides a standard mechanism to allow users to set forwarding parameters, while IMS servers allow users to change their personal agent's criteria using non-service specific technology.

q_5131.question: Which part of the NAS downlink COUNT value is included in the HO Command to the UE when performing SRVCC from E-UTRAN to Circuit Switched UTRAN/GERAN?
q_5131.ground_truth: The 4 least significant bits of the NAS downlink COUNT value are included in the HO Command to the UE when performing SRVCC from E-UTRAN to Circuit Switched UTRAN/GERAN.

q_5132.question: What purpose does the Positioning Capability Transfer procedure serve?
q_5132.ground_truth: The Positioning Capability Transfer procedure enables the SMLC to obtain the positioning capabilities of the MS, the types of assistance supported and the types of assistance data that may be needed from the SMLC.

q_5133.question: What is the entering condition for event A2 in clause 5.5.4.3 of TS 38.331?
q_5133.ground_truth: The entering condition for event A2 is fulfilled when inequality A2-1 is satisfied, i.e. Ms + Hys < Thresh.

q_5134.question: What does the UL Maximum Packet Loss Rate and DL Maximum Packet Loss Rate indicate?
q_5134.ground_truth: The UL Maximum Packet Loss Rate and DL Maximum Packet Loss Rate indicate the maximum rate for lost packets that can be tolerated in the uplink and downlink directions, respectively.

q_5135.question: What should the NAS do when the barring is alleviated for the access category associated with the access attempt and an uplink user data packet is to be sent for a PDU session with suspended user-plane resources?
q_5135.ground_truth: The NAS should consider that the uplink user data packet is not allowed to be sent and should initiate the service request procedure as specified in subclause~5.6.1, if still needed, when the barring is alleviated for the access category.

q_5136.question: What event triggers the measurement of attempted incoming CS multimedia calls?
q_5136.ground_truth: On receipt by the MSC-S of an "IAM" or "IAI" message and the ISDN BC IE indicates multimedia calls.

q_5137.question: Who is responsible for establishing, re-establishing, and releasing the acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation in the 3GPP TS~24.008 standard?
q_5137.ground_truth: The SNDCP layer is responsible for establishing, re-establishing, and releasing the acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation in the 3GPP TS~24.008 standard.

q_5138.question: What is the maximum number of reporting criteria that a UE should support for Traffic volume and Quality measurements in the 8.3, 8.3A, and 8.3B sections?
q_5138.ground_truth: The UE should not support more than 16 reporting criteria in total for Traffic volume and Quality measurements in the 8.3, 8.3A, and 8.3B sections.

q_5139.question: How many additional UARFCN are specified for the 3.84 Mcps TDD option and the 7.68 Mcps TDD option?
q_5139.ground_truth: 10 additional UARFCN are specified for both the 3.84 Mcps TDD option and the 7.68 Mcps TDD option.

q_5140.question: What should the AMF do upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE REJECT message from the UE?
q_5140.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE REJECT message, the AMF should stop timer T3560 and abort the ongoing procedure that triggered the initiation of the NAS security mode control procedure.

q_5141.question: What is the significance of the s and r combinations in the rate matching stage?
q_5141.ground_truth: The s and r combinations correspond to each RV allowed for the E-DCH, and the parameters of the rate matching stage depend on their values.

q_5142.question: What is the main difference between the Normal mode and Harmonic mode in the high-level decoder structure?
q_5142.ground_truth: The main difference is in the detailed structure of the PFSC block.

q_5143.question: What issue can arise from the introduction of high comfort noise levels in other voice-operated devices?
q_5143.ground_truth: The high comfort noise level may be interpreted as a voice signal, or if detected as noise, another source of comfort noise at a different level may be introduced downstream, thus increasing the noise contrast.

q_5144.question: What measurement is used to provide the number of successful MBMS session start?

q_5145.question: What are the two main types of transport channels specified in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_5145.ground_truth: The two main types of transport channels specified are Dedicated Channels and Common Channels.

q_5146.question: In which clause is the overall procedure for ProSe Direct Discovery via E-UTRAN detailed?
q_5146.ground_truth: The overall procedure for ProSe Direct Discovery via E-UTRAN is detailed in clauses 5.3.2 and 5.3.2A.

q_5147.question: What happens when the VAE server receives a session-oriented service termination request from the V2X application-specific server or from the VAE itself?
q_5147.ground_truth: The VAE server indicates to terminate the session-oriented service with the VAE client upon the request from the V2X application-specific server or the VAE client.

q_5148.question: What is the measurement for the number of outgoing CS multimedia call attempts?
q_5148.ground_truth: The measurement MMC.attOut provides the number of outgoing CS multimedia call attempts.

q_5149.question: What is the role of the "Implicit Reject" functionality in GERAN?
q_5149.ground_truth: The "Implicit Reject" functionality in GERAN inhibits Random Access Channel signalling, which helps in managing large numbers of MSs.

q_5150.question: What parameters should be signalled for a video Adaptation Set in a 3GPP media stream?
q_5150.ground_truth: The Adaptation Set should signal the maximum required capability to decode any Representation in the Adaptation Set by signalling the @codes parameter, the width and height by @width and @height, chroma format by an Essential or Supplemental Descriptor, color primaries and transfer function by an Essential or Supplemental Descriptor, and frame rate by @frameRate. Random Access Points should be signalled by @startsWithSAP.

q_5151.question: What happens if the number of talker permissions is reduced in the FRMCS System?
q_5151.ground_truth: If the number of talker permissions is reduced, the active talkers lose their permission to talk as soon as they stop talking until the new maximum allowed number of talkers is met.

q_5152.question: What is the expected sequence 4.1 in SC Mode 1?
q_5152.ground_truth: The expected sequence 4.1 in SC Mode 1 is SEND DATA, NG-RAN, bearer type '03' - Default PDU Session, immediate mode.

q_5153.question: What should a UE include in the SDP offer when initiating a user-originated USSD session?
q_5153.ground_truth: A UE should include an SDP offer with one media description, but with a zero port number value in order to inform network entities that media resources are not requested for the session.

q_5154.question: What type of AVP is the Time-Stamps AVP, and what information does it contain?
q_5154.ground_truth: The Time-Stamps AVP is of type Grouped and contains the time stamp of the SIP REQUEST and the time stamp of the response to the SIP REQUEST.

q_5155.question: What protocol stack is used by an IAB-node that has the gNB-DU part to communicate with an IAB-donor node that has the gNB-CU part using F1 protocols in the IAB architecture?
q_5155.ground_truth: The same protocol stack as the wireline CU-DU interface is used in the IAB architecture.

q_5156.question: What is the role of the Destination Port Number value in 3GPP TS 36.423?
q_5156.ground_truth: The Destination Port Number value 36422 is assigned by IANA to be used for X2AP in 3GPP TS 36.423, and it should also be used in Source Port Number by all eNBs and en-gNBs within a network.

q_5157.question: What message is sent when a hold request is received for call A-C?
q_5157.ground_truth: A hold acknowledge message is sent for call A-C.

q_5158.question: What should the UE do if it wants to continue using eDRX in a registration procedure for emergency services?
q_5158.ground_truth: The UE should include the Extended DRX parameters IE in each registration procedure to indicate that it wants to keep using eDRX.

q_5159.question: What should the UE do upon successful AS security activation and the availability of a measurement result for a specific measId in the periodical reporting list?
q_5159.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId to 0, and if the reportAmount exceeds 1, initiate the measurement reporting procedure immediately after the quantity to be reported becomes available for the NR SpCell.

q_5160.question: Based on the requirements, what are some of the key features of the MCData Service regarding management of data flow and communication?
q_5160.ground_truth: Some of the key features include controlled access to external services, selection of priorities for data flows, determining permissions to transmit, handling large data file transmissions, withholding and queuing transmissions, and providing notifications for status updates related to group communications.

q_5161.question: In FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR45Mbps-60Fps, what was the range of mean power saving gain provided by making evenly spaced traffic arrival offset?
q_5161.ground_truth: In FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR45Mbps-60Fps, the range of mean power saving gain provided by making evenly spaced traffic arrival offset was 2.69% to 8.55%.

q_5162.question: What entity retrieves the transfer policy for the background data transfer from the SPR in the AF and PCRF communication process?

q_5163.question: What action can the PCRF take if the usage allowance for a certain Monitoring key is at risk of being exceeded?
q_5163.ground_truth: The PCRF can provide new threshold values to the PCEF or TDF to override the existing ones, or it can deactivate monitoring for that Monitoring key.

q_5164.question: What is the XPD ratio in the context of cross-polarized antennas?
q_5164.ground_truth: The XPD ratio (Cross Polarization discrimination) is the ratio of the power in the vertical orientation to the power in the horizontal orientation. It is used to determine the coupled power of each sub-path in the horizontal orientation relative to the power in the vertical orientation.

q_5165.question: What action will the BSS take if the Allocation/Retention Priority IE is not received in the MBMS-SESSION-START-REQUEST PDU?
q_5165.ground_truth: The BSS may pre-empt the connection and consider it as having the lowest priority level.

q_5166.question: Which message does the SS send in step 2 to reset the UE's positioning stored information?
q_5166.ground_truth: The SS sends a RESET UE POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message.

q_5167.question: What message is used for DRNC and Iur to establish synchronism for the Data Transport Bearer?
q_5167.ground_truth: The establishment of synchronism for the Data Transport Bearer between Node B and SRNC is achieved through the exchange of appropriate DCH Frame Protocol frames via Downlink Synchronisation and Uplink Synchronisation, relative to already existing radio link(s).

q_5168.question: What is the consequence if no candidate Controllee UE accepts the offer to become the new Controller UE?
q_5168.ground_truth: The SCC AS releases the Collaborative Session associated with the lost Controller UE.

q_5169.question: What is the action of the UDM when the received cause value is MAC failure?
q_5169.ground_truth: The UDM updates SEAF with MAC failure for the Authentication procedure.

q_5170.question: Which network nodes are responsible for supporting the interception capabilities for Non-IP Data Delivery using SCEF in a CSP network?
q_5170.ground_truth: The nodes responsible for supporting the interception capabilities for Non-IP Data Delivery using SCEF in a CSP network are MME, SGSN, HSS, HLR, SCEF, and IWK-SCEF.

q_5171.question: What is the purpose of the Signalling Indication attribute in QoS attributes?
q_5171.ground_truth: The Signalling Indication attribute allows enhancing the RAN operation for signalling traffic, which can have different characteristics such as higher priority, lower delay, and increased peakiness, as compared to other interactive traffic.

q_5172.question: What is the delivery method for MBMS when MBMS bearers are not available or usable and an alternativeAccessDelivery element is available in the MBMS User Service Description?
q_5172.ground_truth: MBMS Streaming shall perform the functions of a PSS client to deliver content when MBMS bearers are not usable or available.

q_5173.question: What is the minimum altitude for satellites in MEO constellations?
q_5173.ground_truth: The minimum altitude for satellites in MEO constellations is 8000 km.

q_5174.question: How many scenarios are being considered for IMS network associations with 5GC network slices?
q_5174.ground_truth: Three scenarios are being considered: Scenario 1 - Each 5GC network slice is associated with a separate and distinct IMS network, Scenario 2 - Each 5GC slice is associated with a common IMS network, and Scenario 3 - One common 5GC network slice is associated with multiple IMS networks.

q_5175.question: When generating a position estimate for a 2-dimensional position in GPS positioning, what action should the UE take if the IE "Horizontal Accuracy" has been assigned to a value unequal to 0?
q_5175.ground_truth: The UE should include either the IE "Ellipsoid point with uncertainty circle" or the IE "Ellipsoid point with uncertainty ellipse" as the position estimate.

q_5176.question: How are the peer-to-peer communication between remote Network Service Control entities performed over Network Service Virtual Connections (NS-VCs) in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Gb interface?
q_5176.ground_truth: The peer-to-peer communication between remote Network Service Control entities is performed over Network Service Virtual Connections (NS-VCs) which is a virtual communication path between Network Service Control peer entities.

q_5177.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in the provisioning of MBMS user services?
q_5177.ground_truth: The BM-SC provides functions for MBMS user service provisioning, delivery to the content provider, and serves as an entry point for IP MBMS data traffic from the MBMS User Service source.

q_5178.question: What should the Terminal do as part of the USIM-Terminal initialization procedure?
q_5178.ground_truth: The Terminal shall read the access control value as part of the USIM-Terminal initialization procedure, and subsequently adopt this value.

q_5179.question: What is the responsibility of the network in providing bandwidth information when the SDP offer does not include it?
q_5179.ground_truth: The network can influence the required bandwidth by modifying the offered payload types or by reducing the existing b=AS bandwidth modifier as the SDP offer does not include the new bandwidth information.

q_5180.question: What option is possible for UE-to-UE relay in LTE-V2X and NR-V2X to enhance V2V communication coverage?
q_5180.ground_truth: One or more V2X relay UEs may be involved for enhancing V2V communication coverage using UE-to-UE relay in LTE-V2X and NR-V2X.

q_5181.question: If a UE is expected to use a specific frequency for sidelink transmission, what should it do before sending a SidelinkUEInformationNR message for network scheduling?
q_5181.ground_truth: The UE should ensure that the conditions for sidelink communication operation are met and that the frequency is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList or sl-FreqInfoList.

q_5182.question: What is included in Slice SLA for network slice creation?
q_5182.ground_truth: Slice SLA includes attributes such as the maximum number of UEs and maximum number of PDU sessions for each S-NSSAI, as well as other associated attributes defined in the GST.

q_5183.question: What action does MSB take when it receives the Connect message from the called user?
q_5183.ground_truth: MSB sends a Connect ack message towards MSB, sends an ANM to GMSCB, which relays it to the originating exchange, and sends a Complete call ack to VLRB.

q_5184.question: What is the logical interface between the eNB and the WT specified in the document?

q_5185.question: How does a Multicast gateway modify the presentation manifest in the DVB-MABR architecture?
q_5185.ground_truth: The Multicast gateway can modify the presentation manifest by selectively changing the origin in some of the URL base paths for certain media segment requests, directing them to the Multicast gateway at reference point L.

q_5186.question: What message does the SMF send after revoking a Remote UE's authorization?
q_5186.ground_truth: The SMF sends a NAS command message to release the connection with the Remote UE whose authorization has been revoked. The message includes the Remote UE identity, Remote UE addressing info, and an indication of the reason for the release.

q_5187.question: What should the IWF performing the participating role do upon determining that implicit affiliation of a user homed in the IWF is required to an MCData group?
q_5187.ground_truth: Upon determining that implicit affiliation of a user homed in the IWF is required to an MCData group, the IWF performing the participating role should determine the MCData client ID, MCData group ID, and MCData ID associated with the user homed in the IWF, find the served MCData user and client information entries, consider a copy of the list of the MCData group information entries of the served MCData client information entry as the served list of the MCData group information entries, and construct the candidate list of the MCData group information entries.

q_5188.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification defined in the document?
q_5188.ground_truth: The purpose of the specification is to define the protocol for the Nt reference point, which includes Nt application and Nta application. The Nt application supports the negotiation of background data transfer policy and lies between Service Capability Exposure Function (SCEF) and Policy and Charging Rules Function (PCRF).

q_5189.question: What is the impact of handover on the control procedures and operation of the service?
q_5189.ground_truth: Handover has no impact on the control procedures and operation of the service.

q_5190.question: What should be supported in case haptic services are provided via interworking between different domains?
q_5190.ground_truth: UE capability should be exchanged between domains, and haptic information may be transcoded to be delivered between domains.

q_5191.question: What should the SS do when the UE's message in step 10 includes the ackRequested IE set to TRUE?
q_5191.ground_truth: The SS shall send a LPP acknowledgement message.

q_5192.question: What is the format of the protocol message that contains the "TY" type?
q_5192.ground_truth: The format of the protocol message that contains the "TY" type is a ResourceCoordinationTransferContainer.

q_5193.question: Which clause of TS 38.331 specifies the conformance requirements for this process?
q_5193.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for this process are specified in TS 38.331, clauses 5.3.10.5, 5.4.2.3, 5.3.5.3, and 5.7.10.3.

q_5194.question: What action do UEs take in response to group paging in the 5G system?
q_5194.ground_truth: UEs respond to group paging by sending a UL NAS MB Session Join Request (TMGI) to the AMF.

q_5195.question: What does the IMS-ALG do to answer ICE connectivity checks in the IMS-AGW?
q_5195.ground_truth: The STUN server in the IMS-AGW is used to answer ICE connectivity checks.

q_5196.question: What does the failureCause field in the CellUpdate message indicate?
q_5196.ground_truth: The failureCause field in the CellUpdate message indicates whether the AM RLC error indication RB 2-3or4 or AM RLC error indication RB 5orAbove has occurred. The AM RLC error indication RB 2-3or4 is a boolean value that indicates whether the RLC error indication AMD of RB 2 or RB 3 has been triggered. Similarly, the AM RLC error indication RB 5orAbove is a boolean value that indicates whether the RLC error indication RB 5 or RB 6 has been triggered.

q_5197.question: What is the meaning of "IRPVersion" in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects telecommunication management?
q_5197.ground_truth: "IRPVersion" refers to the IRP document version number string, as specified in 3GPP TS 32.311.

q_5198.question: What is the requirement for the initial SIP INVITE request generated by the IWF performing the participating role?
q_5198.ground_truth: The initial SIP INVITE request generated by the IWF performing the participating role should include the Session-Expires header field, should include the option tag "timer" in the Supported header field, should include the P-Asserted-Identity header field with the public service identity of the IWF performing the participating role, and shall include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature.

q_5199.question: What is the role of the Relay UE's AMF in the authorization check for the remote UE?
q_5199.ground_truth: The Relay UE's AMF initiates the authorization check by providing the necessary information to the Relay UDM and receives the authorization result, which it sends to the Relay UE. The Relay UE may forward the authorization result to the remote UE if required.

q_5200.question: What is the action required by the network when the arriving call is the waiting call (C-B) and the already existing call is the active call (A-B) in clause 1.2.2?
q_5200.ground_truth: The network and the mobile station shall release the held call (D-B) first before accepting the waiting call (C-B) and putting the active call (A-B) on hold.

q_5201.question: What service is unaffected by the CFNRc service?

q_5202.question: When should the O-MGCF send the Call Progress message (CPG)?
q_5202.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the SIP 180 Ringing provisional response, 183 Session Progress, 181 Call is Being Forwarded, or as a network option, upon receipt of 183 containing a SIP reason header with a Q.850 Cause Value.

q_5203.question: What is the role of the DC sub-function in the NWDAF?
q_5203.ground_truth: The DC (Data Collection) sub-function of the NWDAF is responsible for collecting data from the NFs (Network Functions) for analytics. It can be a standalone NF or collocated with different NFs for centralized or distributed data collection.

q_5204.question: Which systems were used to verify the C code of the 3GPP technical specification?
q_5204.ground_truth: The C code of the 3GPP technical specification was verified on Sun Microsystems workstations and IBM PC compatible computers with Linux operating system.

q_5205.question: What is the difference between the playout behavior for repetitive content and forced playout use cases?
q_5205.ground_truth: In the repetitive content use case, the client can skip over repetitive content after watching it once, while in the forced playout use case, the client is required to watch the content in its entirety before being able to access the on-demand content.

q_5206.question: What message does the HNB-GW send to the HNB to trigger the release of the RRC connection to the UE?
q_5206.ground_truth: The HNB-GW sends an HNB-GW FORWARD RRC message to the HNB with a RANAP Release Iu connection command message, which triggers the release of the RRC connection to the UE.

q_5207.question: What is the format of the UI Dummy command?
q_5207.ground_truth: The UI Dummy command has a variable length, with a minimum value of 6 octets and a maximum value of 79 octets, and all octets from octet 4 to the last octet are encoded with a hexadecimal value of 2B.

q_5208.question: What is the effect of velocity on the capacity gain with gating mechanism?
q_5208.ground_truth: The capacity gain with gating mechanism is in the order of 80% for 3 km/h and in the order of 70% for 100 km/h.

q_5209.question: What should a UE derive when the sidelink measurement object is associated to NR sidelink and the sl-RS-Type is set to dmrs?
q_5209.ground_truth: The UE should derive the layer 3 filtered NR sidelink measurement result based on DMRS for the trigger quantity and each measurement quantity indicated in sl-ReportQuantity using parameters from the associated sl-MeasObject.

q_5210.question: How is the construction of the SDP offer for session initiation performed?
q_5210.ground_truth: It is performed by considering the maximum number of concurrent codecs that the terminal can decode and listing media lines for each codec accordingly.

q_5211.question: What is one of the goals of Key Issue #15, Solutions #3 and #76, with regard to user consent for UE data collection/analysis?
q_5211.ground_truth: To define the user consent provision in the UDM and its retrieval by the NWDAF and the AMF, as well as to track the distribution and usage of any user related information subject to user consent and delete any user related data subject to the revoked user consent.

q_5212.question: What does CS signify in CS/PS services?

q_5213.question: How does beam nulling technology work to suppress unwanted spatial emission?
q_5213.ground_truth: Beam nulling technology works by inserting nulls in the radiation pattern for the direction of the interference, reducing the transmission power in the side lobes and maintaining the transmission power in the main lobe.

q_5214.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a response message containing one or more IEs/IE groups marked as "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" that it does not comprehend and there is insufficient information to determine a value for all IEs required in the response message?
q_5214.ground_truth: The receiving node should terminate the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure.

q_5215.question: What is one potential requirement for supporting MPS for an MMTEL video call?
q_5215.ground_truth: PR.7.1.6-001 - The 3GPP system shall support MPS for MMTEL video calls.

q_5216.question: What is the time period selected for channel adaptation in the eCall test setup?
q_5216.ground_truth: A time period of 400ms was selected for channel adaptation in the eCall test setup.

q_5217.question: What system uses the N11 and N7 interfaces to transfer the satellite backhaul type?
q_5217.ground_truth: The system uses the N11 and N7 interfaces to transfer the satellite backhaul type between the AMF, SMF, and PCF.

q_5218.question: What is the function of the NWDAF in terms of QoS Sustainability for GBR QoS flows for a 5QI, PDB, PER corresponding to a VIAPA application?
q_5218.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides the number of UEs that will receive VIAPA traffic in the area where QoS Sustainability is requested.

q_5219.question: What is the maximum end-to-end setup time recommended for Group Communication in the 3GPP system?
q_5219.ground_truth: The recommended time interval for Group Communication end-to-end setup time is less than or equal to 300ms.

q_5220.question: What does the system information structure specify in RRC Connection Management Procedures?
q_5220.ground_truth: The system information structure specifies the system information elements that are broadcast in system information blocks, organizing the system information as a tree, with a master information block giving references and scheduling information to system information blocks in a cell, and scheduling blocks for additional system information blocks. Different system information blocks may have different characteristics, such as repetition rate and requirements on UEs to re-read the system information blocks.

q_5221.question: What should the PSS server do upon receipt of an RTSP SETUP?
q_5221.ground_truth: The PSS server executes the requested method and responds with an RTSP status code to the PSS adapter. If the new content channel requires a different number or characteristics of media components or bandwidth, the PSS server should react as defined in 3GPP TS 26.234 clause 5.5.4.

q_5222.question: What is the consequence if the IWF is unable to process a SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group due to lack of resources or risk of congestion?
q_5222.ground_truth: The IWF will reject the request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and may include a Retry-After header field in the response.

q_5223.question: What should be the termination of the relevant output antenna port of a repeater when measuring the spurious emissions?
q_5223.ground_truth: The relevant output antenna port of the repeater should be terminated with 50 ohms.

q_5224.question: What is the unit in which the channel busy ratio Ms is expressed?
q_5224.ground_truth: The channel busy ratio Ms is expressed in decimal, from 0 to 1 in steps of 0.01.

q_5225.question: What is one of the conditions under which the UE is not allowed to get service in Solution #17?
q_5225.ground_truth: If the UE is in the 5GMM-CONNECTED mode after it enters 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE based on the cell identity on which the UE is camped, then the UE will not be able to get service.

q_5226.question: What were the changes made in the fifth proactive command (OPEN CHANNEL 2.5.1)?
q_5226.ground_truth: The buffer size was increased to 65535, and the network access name and user login and password were included in the proactive command.

q_5227.question: How many time slots should be tested on each TRX during the mean transmitted RF carrier power test?
q_5227.ground_truth: At least one time slot should be tested on each TRX during the mean transmitted RF carrier power test.

q_5228.question: What is CAMEL, as defined in the document?
q_5228.ground_truth: CAMEL is a network functionality that provides mechanisms of Intelligent Network to a mobile user.

q_5229.question: What should the network do to initiate the packet paging procedure and cause upper layers in a mobile station to respond?
q_5229.ground_truth: The network can initiate the packet paging procedure by sending an EC PAGING REQUEST message on an appropriate paging subchannel on EC-CCCH. This message shall identify the mobile station by the P-TMSI (GPRS TMSI) or its IMSI and may include more than one mobile station identification.

q_5230.question: Which clause specifies the IMD order for contiguous UL CA?
q_5230.ground_truth: Clause 7.3.2.2 from TR 38.862 specifies the IMD order for contiguous UL CA.

q_5231.question: What should the receiver do when it detects an error in the sequence of received I frames?
q_5231.ground_truth: The receiver should transmit an I or S frame to inform the originator about the error.

q_5232.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a 2xx SIP response containing a SDP answer?
q_5232.ground_truth: The SCC AS needs to send a SIP re-INVITE request including the SDP information from the SDP answer received in the SIP 200 (OK) response.

q_5233.question: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, what are the primary considerations for enabling multi-USIM devices in 3GPP system?
q_5233.ground_truth: The study concentrates on three use cases in enabling multi-USIM devices: 1) support for devices with multiple USIMs, 2) mobile-terminated services for multi-USIM devices, and 3) handling of emergency calls and sessions in multi-USIM devices.

q_5234.question: How are the resulting signals decomposed after being filtered?
q_5234.ground_truth: The resulting signals are further decomposed into two equal critically sampled bands: the lower band signals are obtained by low-pass filtering and critically downsampling to Fs/2 kHz, while the higher band signals are obtained by band-pass filtering to frequencies above Fs/4 kHz and critically downsampling to Fs/2 kHz sampling frequency.

q_5235.question: What does the term "TR" stand for in the technical report?
q_5235.ground_truth: TR stands for Technical Report in the 3GPP documentation.

q_5236.question: What is the nature of the address used in the "REGISTER" command?
q_5236.ground_truth: The nature of the address used in the "REGISTER" command is international.

q_5237.question: What is the role of the terminating CAMEL (TCR) record in the MTRF procedure?
q_5237.ground_truth: The terminating CAMEL (TCR) record contains information about the VT-CSI triggering and release in the MTRF procedure.

q_5238.question: Which two classes of UE/MS products does the measurement procedure apply to?
q_5238.ground_truth: The measurement procedure applies to UE/MS products used under "speech mode" conditions and for laptop mounted equipment.

q_5239.question: What information is included in the identity information of a Remote UE end-to-end Radio Bearer for L2 UE-to-UE Relay?
q_5239.ground_truth: The identity information of the Remote UE end-to-end Radio Bearer is included in the adaptation layer in both the first and second PC5 hops for L2 UE-to-UE Relay.

q_5240.question: What is the output of the second stage classifier used for in the process of excitation?
q_5240.ground_truth: The output of the second stage classifier is used to activate or not different post processing based on content category.

q_5241.question: What should the UE do if the PGK ID is all zeros in the IDi Payload?
q_5241.ground_truth: The UE shall stop processing the message and send a Key Request message.

q_5242.question: What are the responsibilities of SCP in the solution for Key Issue #1 regarding SBI-based SM MT message transfer?
q_5242.ground_truth: SCP is responsible for supporting service discovery requests based on GPSI using NRF, discovering MNP NF profiles from NRF, supporting an SBI interface towards MNP NFs to retrieve the target PLMN ID, supporting service discovery requests based on target PLMN ID using NRF, and forwarding routing information retrieval responses from the UDM to the SMS-GMSC.

q_5243.question: What would be the advantage of an AIPN in terms of accommodating a large number of users and terminals?
q_5243.ground_truth: An AIPN would enable the accommodation of a vast number of users and terminals due to the increasing need to connect objects within a particular area to a mobile network. A large number of these terminals will be data-only and not require the ability for traditional speech communication from person-to-person.

q_5244.question: What is the purpose of the NRF's authorization of NF Service Consumers for data access?
q_5244.ground_truth: The NRF authorizes NF Service Consumers for data access to prevent unauthorized access and assure accurate verification of the NF Service Consumer's identity, ensuring a secure interaction between the NF Service Consumer and the data producer.

q_5245.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals, as detailed in the technical realization of facsimile group 3 transparent (Release 17)?
q_5245.ground_truth: The purpose is to define the procedures for realizing the Group 3 facsimile service within the A/Gb mode PLMN using transparent network support.

q_5246.question: When providing service continuity between the PLMN and NPN, what is required to enable a UE to receive data services from one network (e.g. NPN) and paging as well as data services from another network (e.g. PLMN) simultaneously?
q_5246.ground_truth: A dual-radio UE or a multi-SIM like implementation for single radio UE.

q_5247.question: When should the UE include the UE STATE INDICATION message in the Payload container IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_5247.ground_truth: The UE should include the UE STATE INDICATION message in the Payload container IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE has one or more stored UE policy sections identified by a UPSI with the PLMN ID part indicating the HPLMN or the selected PLMN.

q_5248.question: What is the purpose of the "scheme" and "authority" parts in the URI design for the REST St interface?
q_5248.ground_truth: The "scheme" specifies the application delivery protocol, either HTTP or HTTPS. The "authority" includes the server address and an optional port for the REST St interface.

q_5249.question: What are some haptic devices providing high-fidelity vibration?
q_5249.ground_truth: Devices usually include vibration actuators that provide high-fidelity vibration effects and a vibration player that controls the operation of the actuator. Some examples include thermal display, electrostatic feedback device, and tactile display.

q_5250.question: What is the purpose of adaptive post-filter reset and smoothing during rate switching?
q_5250.ground_truth: The adaptive post-filter can be reset and its effect smoothed when switching it on or off from frame to frame, with the buffer resampling performed only in case of internal sampling rate switching.

q_5251.question: What information is included in the SecurityModeCommand in this protocol?
q_5251.ground_truth: The SecurityModeCommand contains protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container with SecurityModeCommandIEs. It includes ID id-IntegrityProtectionInformation, ID id-EncryptionInformation, and ID id-KeyStatus, with varying criticality and presence requirements.

q_5252.question: What logical control channels and logical traffic channels are defined in the 3GPP document 45.002, and what are their functions?
q_5252.ground_truth: The 3GPP document 45.002 defines various logical control channels and logical traffic channels used by RLC and MAC. Logical control channels include the Broadcast Control Channel (BCCH), Paging Channel (PCH), Random Access Channel (RACH), Access Grant Channel (AGCH), Packet Broadcast Control Channel (PBCCH), Packet Paging Channel (PPCH), Packet Random Access Channel (PRACH), Packet Access Grant Channel (PAGCH), Packet Associated Control Channel (PACCH), and Extended Coverage Packet Data Traffic Channel (EC-PDTCH). Logical traffic channels include Traffic Channel (TCH), Octal Traffic Channel (O-TCH), Enhanced Traffic Channel (E-TCH), Packet Data Traffic Channel (PDTCH), and Extended Coverage Packet Data Traffic Channel (EC-PDTCH). These channels are used for different purposes, including broadcasting cell-specific information, sending page requests, requesting and allocating GPRS resources, and transferring speech or user data.

q_5253.question: How many bits are swapped in the second round of bit swapping for UAS-10 type 0?

q_5254.question: What is the crest factor function used in the IGF tool?
q_5254.ground_truth: The crest factor function is applied with IGF to measure the dynamic range of a signal. It is calculated as the ratio of the peak value to the root mean square value of the power spectrum.

q_5255.question: Which specification provides the standardized format for MExE preferences and personalization as well as their interoperable encoding?
q_5255.ground_truth: The Composite Capability/Preference Profile (CC/PP) specification from W3C allows for the standardized format of MExE preferences and personalization. The Resource Description Framework (RDF) is used by CC/PP for the interoperable encoding of these preferences.

q_5256.question: In the "Data Record Transfer Request" messaging schemes, what is the significance of the CDR generating entity (CDF) and the CDR collecting entity (CGF) in the transfer of CDR packets?
q_5256.ground_truth: The CDR generating entity sends CDR packets to the CDR collecting entity using the Data Record Transfer Request message, and the CDR collecting entity stores the packet contents in a safe way and sends confirmation of the successful packet reception to the CDF.

q_5257.question: What is the maximum allowed uncertainty for the MU in FR1 in the frequency range up to 4.2 GHz?
q_5257.ground_truth: The maximum allowed uncertainty for the MU in FR1 in the frequency range up to 4.2 GHz is 2.5 dB.

q_5258.question: What is the name of the network function that triggers a PCC update to the SMF for the Target DNAI in Step 6?

q_5259.question: What does the logical link release function do?
q_5259.ground_truth: The logical link release function is used to de-allocate resources associated with the logical link connection.

q_5260.question: What is one solution that addresses Key Issue #7 but needs to be combined with other solutions for normative work?
q_5260.ground_truth: Solution #1, which relies on the use of non-3GPP access in specific conditions, could co-exist with solutions based on the use of 3GPP access.

q_5261.question: What should the UE indicate in the ATTACH REQUEST message when it has no valid EPS security context?
q_5261.ground_truth: The UE should indicate in the ATTACH REQUEST (eKSI as '00') and NAS security mode procedure should be successful if the EPS security context is valid. Otherwise, the ME shall signal 'no key available' in the initial NAS message.

q_5262.question: What is the purpose of the CSI state in the 3.6.7 section?
q_5262.ground_truth: The CSI state indicates whether the VT-CSI is active or not.

q_5263.question: Under what condition will both the ThreshBackhRateULWLANHighANDSF and ThreshBackhRateULWLANHighRAN node be considered as matching by the UE?
q_5263.ground_truth: The UE will consider both the ThreshBackhRateULWLANHighANDSF and ThreshBackhRateULWLANHighRAN node as matching if the ThreshBackhRateULWLANHighRAN node is evaluated to be matching, and if the RAN threshold value has not been received from E-UTRAN/UTRAN and the ThreshBackhRateULWLANHighANDSF node is evaluated to be matching.

q_5264.question: What fields are set in the RRCSetupRequest message when the establishment of the RRC connection is the result of release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication (either in NR or E-UTRAN)?
q_5264.ground_truth: The establishmentCause is set to mps-PriorityAccess when the establishment of the RRC connection is the result of release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication (either in NR or E-UTRAN).

q_5265.question: What is the objective of the anechoic chamber defined in 5.2?
q_5265.ground_truth: The anechoic chamber defined in 5.2 is designed to measure UMTS mobile handsets for both Tx and Rx radiated performance. The chamber should be equipped with an antenna positioner that can perform full 3-D measurements for both Tx and Rx. The main measurement set-ups are a spherical scanner system and a dual-axis system.

q_5266.question: What is the principle used for mapping the information elements in the case of transparent procedures?
q_5266.ground_truth: A one-to-one mapping is used for mapping the parameters of the forward BSSAP message into the parameters of the MAP service and vice versa in the case of transparent procedures.

q_5267.question: What happens when OoBTC and TFO negotiation is successful in RNC-RNC call?
q_5267.ground_truth: Compressed speech is carried in all portions of the speech path. Transcoders A' and B' remain in the speech path to perform necessary TFO protocol tasks and decoding, but do not perform transcoding.

q_5268.question: What is a successful call in the context of MBMS?
q_5268.ground_truth: A successful call is a connection that reaches the communication or data transfer phase, also known as the "answered" state for speech connections.

q_5269.question: What CSS features must user-agents support in the 3GPP HTML5 profile?
q_5269.ground_truth: User-agents must support CSS 2.1, CSS Color Module Level 3, CSS Image Values and Replaced Content Module Level 3, CSS Backgrounds and Borders, CSS Basic User Interface, CSS Transforms, CSS Transitions, and CSS Animations in the 3GPP HTML5 profile.

q_5270.question: In the context of UM uplink, when are 7-bit "Length Indicators" used and what value is used for the last data PDU containing padding?
q_5270.ground_truth: If the "largest UMD PDU size" is less than or equal to 125 octets, 7-bit "Length Indicators" are used. For the last data PDU containing padding, the value "111 1100" is used.

q_5271.question: What is the purpose of the FRMCS Naming Authority in the FRMCS system?
q_5271.ground_truth: The FRMCS Naming Authority is a registry service provided by FRMCS System to facilitate the handling of various namespaces, number spaces or other information sets needed to support FRMCS services, such as managing the identification information which shall not be duplicated during its registration process.

q_5272.question: What should the RNC do if it receives an OVERLOAD message from the UTRAN with an included Global RNC-ID IE?
q_5272.ground_truth: The RNC should send an OVERLOAD message to the CN including the Global RNC-ID IE, indicating that the UTRAN is in a congested state.

q_5273.question: What entity receives the time synchronization service policy from the UDR in the context of time synchronization for multiple UEs or future PDU sessions?

q_5274.question: What does the measurement "Mean duration of unavailable MTP3 signalling link" (SIG.MTP3LKUnavailableDuration) unit represent?
q_5274.ground_truth: This measurement is obtained by accumulating the time intervals for beginning of unavailable of MTP3/MTP3B signalling link to the end of unavailable of MTP3 signalling link over a granularity period using DER. The result is a real value expressed in seconds.

q_5275.question: What conformance requirement is verified at step 3) in section 6.1.7.4.2 by analyzing the DISABLE PIN command sent via the ME to the UICC?
q_5275.ground_truth: CR~1 with parameters P1=91 and P2=01.

q_5276.question: What is the purpose of using three different DCHs in the MAC sublayer in 3GPP TS 45.005?
q_5276.ground_truth: The three different DCHs, CDCH, UDCH, and ADCH, are introduced in 3GPP TS 45.005 for separate functions: CDCH and UDCH for data transfer, and ADCH for control blocks transmission.

q_5277.question: What should the SCC AS do with the SDP information after receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response with the SDP answer from the controllee UE during the media component release procedure?
q_5277.ground_truth: The SCC AS should set the port number(s) for each removed media component to zero and set all the ports number of the media on the controllee UEs with value zero in the SIP 200 (OK) response to the controller UE.

q_5278.question: How is the background noise level estimated in the described TCX time domain concealment?
q_5278.ground_truth: The background noise level is estimated using a simplified version of the minimum statistics algorithm that computes a smoothed version of the decoder output frame amplitude and searches for the minimum smoothed amplitude over a sliding temporal window.

q_5279.question: What are the new 3GPP radio access technologies introduced by Candidate Solution #2 to enable satellite access?
q_5279.ground_truth: Candidate Solution #2 introduces new 3GPP radio access technologies for satellite access (RAT Type) to provide the basis for several aspects related to Key Issue #4, including Policy Control, Mobility procedures, Charging specific to satellite access, Location services, and Regulatory requirement.

q_5280.question: What should the MAC entity do if there is one set of Random Access resources available that can be used to indicate all features triggering the current Random Access procedure?
q_5280.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select this set of Random Access resources for the current Random Access procedure.

q_5281.question: What is the NG-RAN initiated connection release procedure in 3GPP TS 23.502?
q_5281.ground_truth: The NG-RAN initiated connection release procedure in 3GPP TS 23.502 includes N2 release and N3 resource release. It includes the indication for UE coordinated leaving to AMF in the N2 UE Context Release Request message. CN paging may not be triggered for a certain period that is up to network implementation, or until the UE contacts the network.

q_5282.question: What is required for a UE to handover a PDU Session from 3GPP access to untrusted non-3GPP access, if the UE is not already registered via untrusted non-3GPP access?
q_5282.ground_truth: The UE needs to initiate the Registration procedure as defined in clause~4.12.2 before performing the PDU Session Establishment procedure.

q_5283.question: What should the IWF do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request for an MCPTT emergency group call, with the Resource-Priority header field not populated correctly?
q_5283.ground_truth: If the Resource-Priority header field is not populated correctly, the IWF should perform the actions specified in clause~6.6.3.1.5 and, upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP UPDATE request sent in clause~6.6.3.1.5, proceed with the rest of the steps.

q_5284.question: What command is sent from the SIM to the ME in the LANGUAGE NOTIFICATION process?
q_5284.ground_truth: The LANGUAGE NOTIFICATION proactive SIM command is sent from the SIM to the ME in this process.

q_5285.question: What is the purpose of the RL Set ID IE in the context of FDD?
q_5285.ground_truth: The RL Set ID IE uniquely identifies an RL as an RL Set within the UE Context, ensuring that each RL in a set has a common generation of TPC commands in the DL.

q_5286.question: What messaging method is used to inform a user on hold of a conference establishment in a Multi Party call?
q_5286.ground_truth: A CPG to inform the user on hold of the conference establishment is sent in a re-INVITE message.

q_5287.question: In which mode does the LLC layer operate for p-t-m transmission of MBMS data in A/Gb mode?
q_5287.ground_truth: The LLC layer always operates in unacknowledged mode for p-t-m transmission of MBMS data in A/Gb mode.

q_5288.question: What is the role of the IBCF in relation to transcoding functionality with the TrGW?
q_5288.ground_truth: The IBCF determines the TrGW transcoding capability and signals media related information to the TrGW for transcoding

q_5289.question: Which AVP in the MMS-Information AVP (AVP code 877) holds the overall content type of the MM content?
q_5289.ground_truth: The MM-Content-Type AVP (AVP code 1203) holds the overall content type of the MM content and includes information about all the contents of an MM.

q_5290.question: What does the DISC command do in the data link layer?
q_5290.ground_truth: The DISC command is transmitted to terminate the multiple frame operation and cannot contain an information field.

q_5291.question: What powers should be taken into account when calculating the remaining power for the UE in FDD when it has more than one Activated Uplink Frequency?
q_5291.ground_truth: For FDD, the HS-DPCCH, DPCCH, DPDCH, and E-DPCCH powers are taken into account when calculating the remaining power.

q_5292.question: Who are the controllers and processors defined in the context of healthcare data security?
q_5292.ground_truth: Controllers are natural or legal persons responsible for handling the entire data life cycle and establishing technical and organizational measures to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Processors, on the other hand, are natural or legal persons that process medical data and are required to maintain records of all processing activities to maintain compliance.

q_5293.question: In the field of 3GPP Technical Specification for security architecture, what is a non-current EPS security context?
q_5293.ground_truth: A non-current EPS security context is a native EPS security context that is not the current one. A non-current EPS security context may be stored along with a current EPS security context in the UE and the MME. A non-current EPS security context does not contain an EPS AS security context.

q_5294.question: What should the IM-MGW do when receiving a request for an ICE user name fragment and password?
q_5294.ground_truth: The IM-MGW shall generate an ICE user name fragment and password and send it to the MGCF within the reply. The IM-MGW shall store the password and user name fragment to be able to authenticate incoming STUN binding requests.

q_5295.question: What network protocol is used to transfer information within the network in the described scenario?
q_5295.ground_truth: The described scenario involves the use of both SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) and ISUP (ISDN User Part) as network protocols for information transfer.

q_5296.question: What is the primary function of an ancillary RF amplifier when connected to a BS?
q_5296.ground_truth: The primary function of an ancillary RF amplifier when connected to a BS is to provide amplification between the transmit and/or receive antenna connector of a BS and an antenna without requiring any control signal to fulfil its amplifying function.

q_5297.question: What is the use of the ProSe Application Code Suffix pool?
q_5297.ground_truth: The ProSe Application Code Suffix pool is a set of ProSe Application Code Suffixes assigned by the ProSe Application Server based on the inputs received from the ProSe Function. The UE can use different suffixes from the ProSe Application Code Suffix pool to form different ProSe Application Codes for announcements.

q_5298.question: What is the purpose of the anti-sparseness post-processing procedure applied to the fixed codebook vector?
q_5298.ground_truth: The anti-sparseness post-processing procedure is applied to reduce perceptual artifacts arising from the sparseness of the algebraic fixed codebook vectors with only a few non-zero samples per subframe. The processing consists of circular convolution of the fixed codebook vector with an impulse response, with the intensity of the modification controlled by a number stored within the encoder.

q_5299.question: In the context of EGPRS acknowledged mode, what is the difference between selective type I ARQ and type II hybrid ARQ mechanisms?
q_5299.ground_truth: Selective type I ARQ uses selective acknowledgements, while type II hybrid ARQ (incremental redundancy) uses additional coded bits for decoding until decoding succeeds.

q_5300.question: What functions does the Rg reference point provide for Applications?
q_5300.ground_truth: The Rg reference point allows applications to create, read, modify and delete user profile data using the harmonized access interface.

q_5301.question: What is the conformance requirement covered in TS 38.322, clause 5.3.3.1, related to an AM RLC entity and its peer AM RLC entity?
q_5301.ground_truth: The conformance requirement covered in TS 38.322, clause 5.3.3.1, specifies that an AM RLC entity can poll its peer AM RLC entity in order to trigger STATUS reporting at the peer AM RLC entity.

q_5302.question: What action does the ng-eNB-CU take when the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message contains the RRC-Container IE?
q_5302.ground_truth: The ng-eNB-DU sends the corresponding RRC message to the UE via SRB1.

q_5303.question: Which Command Code is used to indicate the ProSe-Discovery-Request (PDR) Command?
q_5303.ground_truth: The ProSe-Discovery-Request (PDR) Command is indicated by the Command-Code field set to 8388669.

q_5304.question: What is the measurement period for intra-frequency measurements when no measurement occasion cycle is activated?
q_5304.ground_truth: The measurement period for intra-frequency measurements when no measurement occasion cycle is activated is 200 ms.

q_5305.question: What is the purpose of timer T202 in MSC-B?
q_5305.ground_truth: Timer T202 in MSC-B supervises the time for handover completion for handover between BSSs in MSC-B. If T202 expires, the radio path and the connection on interface B' are released.

q_5306.question: In the 3GPP technical specification, what does "E-DCH" refer to?
q_5306.ground_truth: E-DCH is the Enhanced Dedicated Channel, an uplink transport channel.

q_5307.question: What determines the value of the POI assigned to the LCS client profile?
q_5307.ground_truth: The type of LCS client requesting location information determines the value of the POI assigned to the LCS client profile.

q_5308.question: What is the smallest resource unit for uplink transmissions, as denoted in the document?

q_5309.question: What determines the generation of SID frames for GSM_FR, GSM_HR, and GSM_EFR in the GSM radio network?
q_5309.ground_truth: The generation of SID frames for GSM_FR, GSM_HR, and GSM_EFR in the GSM radio network is determined by the GSM mobile station and the GSM radio subsystem, not primarily by the Speech Encoder.

q_5310.question: What is the minimum thickness of the monoblock palm spacer's wall in hand phantoms?
q_5310.ground_truth: The minimum thickness of the monoblock palm spacer's wall in hand phantoms is less than 2 mm.

q_5311.question: What is the role of the Sd application in the Diameter protocol?
q_5311.ground_truth: The Sd application is a vendor specific Diameter application, where the vendor is 3GPP, and it is used for initialization, maintenance and termination of the connection and session between the PCRF and TDF.

q_5312.question: What transport layer protocol is used in the SLmAP signalling bearer?
q_5312.ground_truth: SCTP (Stream Control Transmission Protocol) is used as the transport layer of SLmAP signalling bearer.

q_5313.question: How does the SRNC modify the SIR target used by the uplink inner loop power control in version 1 of the protocol?
q_5313.ground_truth: Based on the CRCI values and quality estimate in the UL DATA FRAME, the SRNC modifies the SIR target by including the absolute value of the new SIR target in the OUTER LOOP PC control frame sent to the Node B's.

q_5314.question: Which alternative ways can be used to implement the signalling path between a GGSN and an HLR if an SS7 interface is not installed in the GGSN?
q_5314.ground_truth: Any GSN with an SS7 interface installed in the same PLMN as the GGSN can be used as a GTP-to-MAP protocol converter to allow signalling between the GGSN and an HLR.

q_5315.question: What are some terms and definitions specific to the 3GPP Technical Specification on Advanced Alarm Management?
q_5315.ground_truth: Some terms and definitions in the present document include: Alike Alarm, Lower Edge of Time Window, Upper Edge of Time Window, XML file, XML declaration, XML document, XML element, empty XML element, XML content, XML start-tag, XML end-tag, XML empty-element tag, XML attribute specification, DTD, XML schema, XML namespace, XML complex type, and XML element type.

q_5316.question: What attribute does the UpdateNsRequest message for removing a PNF in the NS instance contain?
q_5316.ground_truth: The removePnfId attribute, which is the identifier of the PNF(s) in the NS instance that are to be removed.

q_5317.question: What are the 1st priority channels which do not meet the absolute MPL target with an ISD of 200m for the Indoor 28GHz TDD NLOS scenario?
q_5317.ground_truth: The 1st priority channels which do not meet the absolute MPL target with an ISD of 200m for the Indoor 28GHz TDD NLOS scenario are PUSCH eMBB DDDSU, PUSCH eMBB DDSU, and PRACH Format B4.

q_5318.question: What does the "FEC-Redundancy-Level" declaration attribute represent in FLUTE session?
q_5318.ground_truth: The "FEC-Redundancy-Level" declaration attribute represents the redundant level of FEC protection, as a percentage, applied to the media component(s) carried on the associated MBMS download session.

q_5319.question: What is the purpose of the Evolved Packet Core (EPC) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) as defined in 3GPP TS 28.707?
q_5319.ground_truth: The purpose of the EPC NRM IRP is to define the requirements for the integration of the EPC NRM with other network management systems and networks.

q_5320.question: What is the purpose of the first HARQ-ACK reporting mode in the 5G NR system?
q_5320.ground_truth: The first HARQ-ACK reporting mode is used to indicate the result of the decoding of a DL multicast transmission with G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI.

q_5321.question: What is the difference between scenario A and scenario B in the IP preserving PSA relocation solution?
q_5321.ground_truth: In scenario A, EAS#1 and EAS#2 are located in the same datacentre and have the same DNAI. In scenario B, EAS#1 and EAS#2 are located in different datacentres with different DNAIs.

q_5322.question: In the SRNC-RelocationInfo-r13-IEs sequence, what is the type of the "UESpecificBehaviourInformation1idle" information element?
q_5322.ground_truth: The type of the "UESpecificBehaviourInformation1idle" information element in the SRNC-RelocationInfo-r13-IEs sequence is UESpecificBehaviourInformation1iddle.

q_5323.question: When does a network insert a "Facsimile group 2/3" HLC, if only one PLMN BC is contained in the call set-up request and the "Information Transfer Capability" indicates "Facsimile group 3"?
q_5323.ground_truth: The network will insert a "Facsimile group 2/3" HLC if only one PLMN BC is contained in the call set-up request and the "Information Transfer Capability" indicates "Facsimile group 3".

q_5324.question: What is the meaning of the construction "should" in a 3GPP technical specification?
q_5324.ground_truth: In a 3GPP technical specification, the construction "should" indicates a recommendation to do something.

q_5325.question: What is the definition of a CSI session in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_5325.ground_truth: A CSI session is a multimedia session that uses the CS domain to transport all or some media components (typically, voice) and the IMS/PS domain to transport the other media components.

q_5326.question: What entity sends a request to a Sink Discovery Server for the list of FLUS Sinks?

q_5327.question: What is the minimum length of the UTRAN Freq List and the Cell selection indicator after release of all TCH and SDCCH information elements?
q_5327.ground_truth: The UTRAN Freq List information element has a minimum length of 3 octets, while the Cell selection indicator after release of all TCH and SDCCH information element has a minimum length of 4 octets.

q_5328.question: How many CTS-MSs can be attached to a single CTS-FP, and what is required to make the attachment possible?
q_5328.ground_truth: A minimum of 8 CTS-MSs can be attached to the same CTS-FP, and both the CTS-MS and CTS-FP need to be enrolled and controlled by the CTS-FP operator.

q_5329.question: What is the definition of a "resource" in the context of HTTP and RESTful systems?
q_5329.ground_truth: A resource is a concept identified by a URI in HTTP, and it can be represented by one or more resource representations, which can be for example XML or JSON documents.

q_5330.question: What is the spurious emission limit for a HeNB to protect other HNB/HeNB operating in the same geographic area?
q_5330.ground_truth: The spurious emission limit for a HeNB to protect other HNB/HeNB operating in the same geographic area is -71dBm/100kHz.

q_5331.question: How does the MS indicate the completion of the RRLP MULTILATERATION REQUEST message reception?
q_5331.ground_truth: The MS indicates the completion of the RRLP MULTILATERATION REQUEST message reception by sending a PDAN message with MS accuracy related information (MS Sync Accuracy and MS Transmission Offset) to the BSS.

q_5332.question: Which algorithm is used in the first step of the signal classification procedure to determine if the current frame is active or inactive?

q_5333.question: What happens when a DTM capable mobile station enters dedicated mode from packet idle mode in a cell that supports dual transfer mode?
q_5333.ground_truth: The mobile station will perform a Cell Update procedure.

q_5334.question: What action is taken by the SGSN, the GGSN, and the HLR when the PDP context requested by the GGSN cannot be established due to the MS being GPRS-detached or if the IMSI is not known in the SGSN?
q_5334.ground_truth: The SGSN, the GGSN, and the HLR may perform the Protection and Mobile User Activity procedures.

q_5335.question: What does the D-RNTI identifier represent in the context of a UE Context in the DRNC?
q_5335.ground_truth: The D-RNTI identifies the UE Context in the DRNC.

q_5336.question: What is the procedure if the SCC AS is unable to accurately determine the CS domain should be used and the UE-2 rejects the incoming session?
q_5336.ground_truth: The SCC AS will reattempt the terminating call establishment directly towards the same UE over CS domain if possible.

q_5337.question: Which function provides user data transfer capability across the UTRAN between the Iu and Uu reference points?
q_5337.ground_truth: The function that provides user data transfer capability across the UTRAN between the Iu and Uu reference points is the Transfer of User Data.

q_5338.question: What should the IMS-ALG do if it recognizes that the IMS-AGW is now functioning correctly after a signalling failure?
q_5338.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG can use the IMS-AGW after it recognizes that the IMS-AGW is now functioning correctly.

q_5339.question: What kind of analytics can the NWDAF provide in relation to UE dispersion?
q_5339.ground_truth: The NWDAF can provide data, transactions, failed transactions, sessions drop, and voice calls dispersion analytics and predictions.

q_5340.question: What is the maximum payload size supported by the current 5GMSG Service?
q_5340.ground_truth: The maximum payload size supported by the current 5GMSG Service is 1230 octets.

q_5341.question: What should the UE do if the inter-RAT cell reselection from UTRAN to another radio access technology fails?
q_5341.ground_truth: The UE shall resume the connection to UTRAN using the resources used before initiating the inter-RAT cell reselection procedure.

q_5342.question: How should the IWF notify the affiliated and joined members of the cancellation of the MCPTT group's in-progress emergency group state and emergency alert if applicable?
q_5342.ground_truth: The IWF should generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the cancellation of the MCPTT user's imminent peril call with the IWF acting as the controlling MCPTT function and set the <imminentperil-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body to a value of "false". The IWF should then send the SIP MESSAGE request to the affected MCPTT clients.

q_5343.question: What should a mobile station do when it reselects a new cell and has information about an MBMS bearer being allocated for that session?
q_5343.ground_truth: The mobile station shall immediately switch to this MBMS bearer and continue receiving the MBMS session without waiting to receive a consistent set of (packet) system information messages in the cell.

q_5344.question: What is the recommended handling of data privacy concerns when transferring data between UE and network DNS resolver in a third-party network?
q_5344.ground_truth: Solutions for selecting the DNS resolver as well as for forwarding application data should not reveal any additional information than in the packet headers. Thus, in all cases, E2E encryption of DNS and application packets is required.

q_5345.question: What is the command code for Delivery-Report-Request (DRR) command?
q_5345.ground_truth: The command code for Delivery-Report-Request (DRR) command is 8388644.

q_5346.question: What is one of the capabilities of the 3GPP management system related to NPN provisioning by a network slice of a PLMN?
q_5346.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system has the capability to manage identifiers for a large number of NPNs to minimize collision probability between assigned identifiers.

q_5347.question: What is the role of the 5GMS AF in the optional sub-flow to provision an additional 5GMS AS instance?
q_5347.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF requests the MnS to instantiate a new "5GMS AS" EAS instance with the specified requirements and considering parameters provided in the query by the EEC.

q_5348.question: What is the function of the "Call control result" in the CALL CONTROL RESULT 1.7.1?
q_5348.ground_truth: The "Call control result" in the CALL CONTROL RESULT 1.7.1 indicates that the call is allowed with modifications.

q_5349.question: What type of noise is present in TEST17.INP and TEST19.INP?
q_5349.ground_truth: Babble noise is present in TEST17.INP, while ambient noise is present in TEST19.INP.

q_5350.question: How does the PCRF indicate QoS rules to be applied at the BBERF without obtaining a request from the BBERF?
q_5350.ground_truth: The PCRF may include QoS Rules in an RA-Request message within either the QoS-Rule-Install AVP or the QoS-Rule-Remove AVP.

q_5351.question: What is a Non-Public Network (NPN) as defined in the 5G System?
q_5351.ground_truth: A NPN is a 5G System that is deployed for private use, designed to support requirements and services for scenarios such as businesses-to-business networking. The NPN can be operated by an NPN operator such as the media company or a contracted third party.

q_5352.question: What should the AS do when it has sent an SDP answer in a provisional response and receives a further SDP answer in the initial INVITE request?
q_5352.ground_truth: The AS should not generate an SDP answer in subsequent provisional responses to the initial INVITE request.

q_5353.question: What format is the timed metadata in the 3GPP File Format for Location/Orientation information and MPD indication of highlights and capturing parameters?
q_5353.ground_truth: No specific format is given for the timed metadata in the 3GPP File Format for Location/Orientation information and MPD indication of highlights and capturing parameters.

q_5354.question: What information is included in the user plane management event notify operation?
q_5354.ground_truth: The user plane management event notify operation includes the user plane management event notification information of the UE and optionally the timestamp of the location. The Edge Enabler Server may only provide part of the information included in the user plane management event notification from the 3GPP network, such as the DNAI.

q_5355.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects in the telecommunication management domain?
q_5355.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects is responsible for defining and standardizing the operation, administration, and maintenance (OA&M) requirements for multi-vendor 3G systems, including GSM and UMTS PLMN.

q_5356.question: What is the purpose of the Discovery Response message in ProSe?
q_5356.ground_truth: The Discovery Response message indicates whether the Discovery Request is authorized and contains the Discovery Filter(s) for monitoring. If application-controlled extension is used, the ProSe Application Code is replaced by the ProSe Application Code Prefix. The TTL in the Discovery Filter indicates how long the Discovery Filter is valid.

q_5357.question: What is the difference between carrier textphone mode and carrierless textphone mode in the document?
q_5357.ground_truth: Carrier textphone mode is a mode for text communication where a continuous signal (carrier tone) is present on the connection even when there is no text exchange, while in carrierless textphone mode, signals are only present when text is being exchanged. In this way, carrier textphone mode is defined to be a mode with continuous carrier tone, and carrierless textphone mode is defined to be a mode without carrier tone during text communication.

q_5358.question: What is one of the desired characteristics of billing and accounting administration in a PLMN?
q_5358.ground_truth: The desired characteristic of billing and accounting administration in a PLMN is to support charging across PLMNs, providing and supporting a flexible billing and accounting administration.

q_5359.question: What message is sent from the target RNC to the serving RNC during the re-establishment of the RRC connection in dedicated transport channel (DCH) state?
q_5359.ground_truth: The target RNC sends a Uplink Signalling Transfer Indication message to the serving RNC during the re-establishment of the RRC connection in dedicated transport channel (DCH) state.

q_5360.question: What should the MAC entity do after determining the UL grant and the associated HARQ information for the MSGA payload in the selected PUSCH occasion if the Random Access Preamble was not selected among the contention-based Random Access Preamble(s)?
q_5360.ground_truth: The MAC entity should deliver the UL grant and the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity.

q_5361.question: What should be the digits in the Dialling number string to be sent to the SIM in ENVELOPE CALL CONTROL 2.1.1A and 2.1.1B?
q_5361.ground_truth: "*21**10#" is the digits in the Dialling number string for both 2.1.1A and 2.1.1B.

q_5362.question: What information is included in the PMIP attach/tunnel activation event when it is sent to the DF2 from the PDN-GW?
q_5362.ground_truth: The PMIP attach/tunnel activation event includes information such as the target identity, correlation number, time stamp, direction, and the target location or the IAs in case of location dependent interception.

q_5363.question: What is the requirement for a UE to perform cell reselection evaluation for NR frequencies and inter-RAT frequencies?
q_5363.ground_truth: The UE shall only perform cell reselection evaluation for NR frequencies and inter-RAT frequencies that are given in system information and for which the UE has a priority provided.

q_5364.question: Which PLMN on the User controlled PLMN selector list should the UE prioritize for registration if the ACT identifier is set to E-UTRAN only?
q_5364.ground_truth: The PLMN with the highest priority order in the User controlled PLMN selector list that provides E-UTRAN access.

q_5365.question: What is the main function of the SCC AS in IMS Service Continuity?
q_5365.ground_truth: The SCC AS provides IMS-based mechanisms for enabling service continuity of multimedia sessions, and implements functionalities such as Access Transfer, Inter-UE Transfer, Terminating Access Domain Selection, and Handling of Multiple Media Flows.

q_5366.question: What message is sent by the HNB to the HNB-GW to register a UE at HNB-GW for service?

q_5367.question: Why is it recommended that intermediate nodes do not modify or terminate the message between the IP-SM-GW and the terminating IM UE or CPM UE in IM networks?
q_5367.ground_truth: This is recommended to ensure the integrity of the response messages from the IM UE or the CPM UE, to ensure correct charging and delivery reports on the Short Message Service side.

q_5368.question: What are the different modes referred to in the definitions section of the 3GPP document?
