q_5368.ground_truth: The different modes referred to in the definitions section of the 3GPP document are A/Gb mode, broadcast/multicast receive mode, and packet idle mode.

q_5369.question: In 6.6.1.2, when the UE sends the IKEv2 INFORMATIONAL Request message including a 3GPP unusable indication, what message is sent next by the ePDG?
q_5369.ground_truth: The ePDG sends an IKEv2 INFORMATIONAL Response message to the UE.

q_5370.question: What is the test purpose for the 1,28 Mcps TDD option in terms of limiting interference caused by unwanted transmitter effects?
q_5370.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the ability of the BS to limit the interference caused by unwanted transmitter effects to other systems operating at frequencies which are more than 4~MHz away from the UTRA band used.

q_5371.question: What information about the UAV does the UAV UE provide during the registration process in Case 1?
q_5371.ground_truth: The CAA-Level UAV ID and the USS/UTM address.

q_5372.question: What is the required NR V2X sidelink throughput for intra-band operation?
q_5372.ground_truth: The NR V2X sidelink throughput for the carrier shall be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels.

q_5373.question: What is the purpose of the quality of experience (QoE) information collection in mobile networks?
q_5373.ground_truth: The QoE information collection is used to gather detailed information at the session level on a number of user equipment (UEs) in mobile networks. This is vital for network operators, especially when providing real-time services such as video streaming that require high data rates and low latency.

q_5374.question: What is the procedure for NE alarm correlation made by NM in the context of NFV?
q_5374.ground_truth: When a new failure occurs from the virtualized resource and it impacts corresponding NE application, NM can make the alarm correlation based on the virtualized resource failure report sent from VNFM and VNF application alarms. The VNF and/or VNFC alarms related to virtualized resource include AlarmId, affected VNF identifier, affected VNFC identifiers, and FaultDetails which provides additional information about the virtualized resource fault. EM sends VNF application failure report of a NE to NM over Itf-N. Based on this information, NM makes the alarm correlation and sends the correlated alarm information to the appropriate authorities.

q_5375.question: What is the minimum required P-CCPCH RSCP difference for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option to meet the intra-frequency relative accuracy requirement?
q_5375.ground_truth: The minimum required P-CCPCH RSCP difference is 8 dB.

q_5376.question: What is the significance of the first digit in the version number of the 3GPP Technical Specification documents?
q_5376.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the stage of approval of the document within the 3GPP Technical Specification Group (TSG); 0 indicates it is presented to TSG for information, 1 is presented to TSG for approval, and greater than 1 indicates TSG approval under change control.

q_5377.question: Which information elements are required to uniquely identify the MBMS bearer context in an MBMS Session Stop Request message?
q_5377.ground_truth: The APN, End User Address, and, if present, the MBMS Flow Identifier information elements uniquely identify the MBMS bearer context in an MBMS Session Stop Request message.

q_5378.question: What information does the MME use to determine if the old node is an AMF during a Tracking Area Update from 5GS to EPS?
q_5378.ground_truth: The MME uses the UE's GUTI mapped from 5G-GUTI to determine if the old node is an AMF.

q_5379.question: What happens to the number of PDU sessions in the network slice when a UE hands over from EPS to 5GS and the quota is managed independently?
q_5379.ground_truth: The number of PDU sessions in the network slice remains unchanged.

q_5380.question: What action does the SGW-C take when the request includes a Handover Indication?
q_5380.ground_truth: The SGW-C selects a SGW-U as specified in clause 5.12 and sends an Sx Session Establishment Request to the selected SGW-U for creating Sx session for the UE.

q_5381.question: What action should an IWF take if the selected expiration time in a SIP PUBLISH request is zero?
q_5381.ground_truth: The IWF should remove the MCPTT user information entry corresponding to the served MCPTT group and the handled MCPTT ID.

q_5382.question: What does ICS stand for and what is its purpose in the context of cellular networks?
q_5382.ground_truth: ICS stands for Implementation Conformance Statement and is a statement made by the supplier of an implementation or system, stating which capabilities have been implemented. In the context of cellular networks, an implementation conformance statement would describe which features and capabilities of the network have been implemented in a specific product or system.

q_5383.question: What should the DRNS include in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message, if a reset of the MAC-hs is not required in FDD?
q_5383.ground_truth: If a reset of the MAC-hs is not required, the DRNS shall include the MAC-hs Reset Indicator IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message in FDD.

q_5384.question: Which TS(s) specify Plug and Connect support for network elements in NR and LTE?

q_5385.question: When sending the DNS Response to the UE, what does the local PSA perform in IPv6 multi-homing?
q_5385.ground_truth: The local PSA sends the DNS Response to the UE via ULCL/BP after replacing the target IP address of the DNS query message with the IP of the Local DNS server and keeping a context during the DNS request handling in order to regenerate the address of the DNS server that the UE had put in its request.

q_5386.question: How can the quality of service be minimally affected during emergency situations in an UMTS or EPS network?
q_5386.ground_truth: Mechanisms such as Domain Specific Access Control (DSAC) or Service Specific Access Control (SSAC) can be used to minimize quality of service degradation and maximize the efficiency of the remaining resources in emergency situations.

q_5387.question: What is the focus of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical report in the present document?
q_5387.ground_truth: The focus of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical report in the present document is addressing the case for the indirect reroute procedure for UE (User Equipment) registration.

q_5388.question: What is the technique used in EC-GSM-IoT simulations for modulating and encoding the logical channels, such as FCCH and (EC-)SCH?
q_5388.ground_truth: The logical channels, such as FCCH and (EC-)SCH, are modulated, encoded and mapped in the 51-multiframe as specified in TS 45.002, TS 45.003, and TS 45.004.

q_5389.question: What procedures should be called during a Routeing Area Update if Direct Tunnel cannot be maintained in the SGSN?
q_5389.ground_truth: If Direct Tunnel cannot be maintained during a Routeing Area Update, the SGSN shall re-establish RABs and initiate the Update PDP Context procedure to update the IP Address and TEID for Uplink and Downlink data.

q_5390.question: What is the resolution of the video used in the test, and how does it affect the results?
q_5390.ground_truth: The resolution of the video used in the test is (4096x2048). This resolution is high, but the quality level is low, which affects the confidence intervals of the test results. Increasing the number of testers would only improve the confidence intervals, not change the shape of the curves.

q_5391.question: What operation does the PDN GW provide to the PCRF when creating a new TFT?
q_5391.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides to the PCRF the Gx operation "add filters" when the TFT operation is "Create new TFT".

q_5392.question: What is the focus of the 3GPP study on Multi-stream Multiparty Conferencing for MTSI?
q_5392.ground_truth: The focus of the 3GPP study is to enable support for multi-stream audio/video at terminals in a multiparty conference, support for at least two video contents, talker ID provisioning, compatibility with existing MTSI specifications, and applicability to both mobile and fixed access terminals.

q_5393.question: What was the channel used in all the simulations?
q_5393.ground_truth: A TU3iFH channel was used in all the simulations.

q_5394.question: What is the interference threshold difference between AMR HR 5.9 and AMR FR 5.9?
q_5394.ground_truth: AMR HR 5.9 needs about 7dB higher C/I than AMR FR 5.9.

q_5395.question: What does the acronym BCS represent in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_5395.ground_truth: BCS stands for Binary Coded Signalling phase of Facsimile transmission as per ITU-T T.30.

q_5396.question: What is the result code expected in Expected Sequence 1.1 when the test is successful?

q_5397.question: How are codec mode indications used in the GSM system's AMR speech codec?
q_5397.ground_truth: Codec mode indications are used by the receiving end to select the correct channel and source decoders. In the network, the Codec Mode Indication must also be sent to the Transcoder Units so that the correct source decoding is selected. In both uplink and downlink, codec mode indications are sent to enable the correct decoding of speech data.

q_5398.question: What are the key issues identified in addressing a specific UE for location information when multiple UEs offer the same MC service?
q_5398.ground_truth: The key issues identified are supporting communication with a specific MCX UE when a user operates several UEs simultaneously, when no MCX service clients are active in the MCX UE, and when the MCX service client is in a limited service state.

q_5399.question: How are the past synthesis signal and the filtered signal multiplied for LTP post filtering in the TCX coding mode?
q_5399.ground_truth: The predicted signal is added to the synthesis signal after both are multiplied with the LTP gain

q_5400.question: What is the high-level description of the solution for deployment and coexistence between UDM and existing HSS?
q_5400.ground_truth: This solution proposes to deploy HSS and UDM in a single network entity, referred as Combined HSS/UDM, supporting interfaces and procedures specified for 5GC, EPC, and IMS. The interaction between HSS and UDM within the Combined entity is performed internally, and there is no need for interworking between UDM and existing HSS out of the Combined network entity.

q_5401.question: What should a UE with access class 11 to 15 do if both access class 10 and the relevant access class (11 to 15) are barred when initiating an emergency call?
q_5401.ground_truth: Emergency calls are not allowed for the UE in this case.

q_5402.question: What action is taken if SCG transmissions of radio bearers are not suspended upon SCG failure?
q_5402.ground_truth: If SCG transmissions of radio bearers are not suspended upon SCG failure, the UE suspends SCG transmissions for all radio bearers and reports the SCGFailureInformation to the MN. If SCG failure is detected while MCG transmissions for all radio bearers are suspended, the UE initiates the RRC connection re-establishment procedure.

q_5403.question: What is the role of the Rx reference point in 5G systems?
q_5403.ground_truth: The Rx reference point resides between the AF and the PCRF, and enables transport of application level session information from AF to PCRF. This includes IP filter information, media/application bandwidth requirements, and other information for sponsored data connectivity such as the sponsor's identification, usage threshold, and application service provider information.

q_5404.question: How does the UE determine which S-NSSAIs to register with during the Registration procedure in the 5G network?
q_5404.ground_truth: The UE determines which S-NSSAIs it wants to register with by considering the list of PFBs for the S-NSSAIs included in the Requested NSSAI. If there are more than one S-NSSAIs in the Requested NSSAI, the UE prioritizes the S-NSSAIs and consequently, prioritizes the PFBs to be used for cell selection.

q_5405.question: What is the spreading factor used for PRACH and E-RUCCH in the 7.68 Mcps TDD mode instead of SF 8 and 16 as 3.84 Mcps TDD?
q_5405.ground_truth: The 7.68 Mcps TDD mode will use SF 16 or 32 for PRACH and E-RUCCH, instead of SF 8 and 16 at 3.84 Mcps TDD.

q_5406.question: What type of message should be sent to the RNS in the Security Mode Command or Relocation Request messages, in order to perform integrity protection in the 3GPP network?
q_5406.ground_truth: A sequence of possible integrity protection algorithms.

q_5407.question: What is the function of the CTR field in the RTP payload format for DIMS Streams?
q_5407.ground_truth: The CTR field is used to detect the loss of high priority DIMS units. Encoders and decoders keep a running value of the counter; the encoder places in each packet the current value of the counter; the decoder compares the CTR field of each incoming packet with its running counter, and thereby checks for high-priority loss.

q_5408.question: What is the purpose of the Unified Access Control procedure in the 5G network?
q_5408.ground_truth: The Unified Access Control procedure is used to perform access barring checks for a 5GS access attempt associated with a given Access Category and one or more Access Identities upon request from upper layers or the RRC layer. The 5G network broadcasts barring control information in SIB1, which contains a list of barring parameters associated with an Access Identity and an Access Category.

q_5409.question: In a multi-frequency cell, what should be the course of action when the Common Measurement Type IE is set to "HS-DSCH Provided Bit Rate" in 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_5409.ground_truth: If the UARFCN IE is included in the COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message, the measurement request shall apply to the indicated frequency, otherwise it shall apply to the whole cell.

q_5410.question: What is the format of a ProcedureCode in the Criticality-Diagnostics?
q_5410.ground_truth: ProcedureCode is an optional element of the Criticality-Diagnostics and is represented as an integer between 0 and 255.

q_5411.question: What action should the UE take when the reportType is set to eventTriggered and the entry condition is fulfilled for all measurements?
q_5411.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5.

q_5412.question: What is the requirement for the Support of SIM Application Toolkit for Mobile Equipment if it is optional?
q_5412.ground_truth: The support of SIM Application Toolkit is optional for Mobile Equipment. However, if it is supported, then all functions of the specified letter class must be supported.

q_5413.question: Under what conditions should the local switching be broken in the BSS during an internal handover?
q_5413.ground_truth: The local switching should be broken in the BSS when an internal handover occurs, making the call not local in a locally switched call.

q_5414.question: What is the benefit of using a layered structure of SVC in combination with fast stream switching in eMBMS?
q_5414.ground_truth: The benefit is to provide different quality levels of different robustness and to allow for instant decoding of low resolution video while high resolution video is being switched, complying with the stringent latency requirements in MBMS TV service.

q_5415.question: In what situation would the system simulator release the SCG RLC entity and the SCG DTCH logical channel?
q_5415.ground_truth: When the DRB indicated by drb-Identity is a split DRB, and drb-ToAddModList is received with the drb-Identity value, while drb-TypeChange is included in drb-ToAddModList and set to "toMCG".

q_5416.question: In the context of the creation of default EPS bearer context after inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode, what does the PDN type correspond to in the default EPS bearer context if the PDU session type is IPv4?
q_5416.ground_truth: The PDN type is set to "IPv4" if the PDU session type is IPv4

q_5417.question: What protocol is used as the transport layer for the M2 and M3 signalling bearers in E-UTRAN?
q_5417.ground_truth: SCTP (Stream Control Transmission Protocol) is used as the transport layer for the M2 and M3 signalling bearers in E-UTRAN.

q_5418.question: How does Brian, a security staff member, send an audio message to Alan, the master unit controller, through the intercom system?
q_5418.ground_truth: Brian can send an audio message to Alan by using push-to-talk (PTT) or voice activity detection to transmit his message, and Alan can select Brian as a recipient and press the button on the microphone at the master unit to receive Brian's message.

q_5419.question: When is the initial value of AllocationAndRetentionPriority-Flag set to indicate dynamic allocation success?
q_5419.ground_truth: The initial value of AllocationAndRetentionPriority-Flag is set to "TRUE" to indicate dynamic allocation success.

q_5420.question: What is the role of BPCF and PCRF in PCC Signalling for NS-WLAN offloaded traffic in the Initial Attach procedure with DSMIPv6 on S2c to trusted Fixed Broadband Access?
q_5420.ground_truth: The BPCF and PCRF establish a session for NS-WLAN offloaded traffic to provision policy decisions. The UE local IP address and optionally UDP source port number of the DSMIPv6 binding update signalling are forwarded to the PCRF in the IP-CAN session establishment procedure.

q_5421.question: What is the agreed-upon security protection that is provided once a Security Association (SA) is established between the respective SS7-SEGs in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_5421.ground_truth: Once a Security Association (SA) is established, protected TCAP user signalling traffic is provided the same security protection, which ensures confidentiality, integrity, authentication, and anti-replay protection for the traffic, using standard procedures based on cryptographic techniques.

q_5422.question: What is the definition of Consolidated Data Model in the context of UDC?
q_5422.ground_truth: The Consolidated Data Model is a data model containing all data of the User Data Repository. It is the result of the implementation of the entire SIM in the UDR for all applications.

q_5423.question: In FDD, how does one determine the available signatures for a given ASC (Access Service Class) based on the information in the IE "Available signature Start Index" and "Available signature End Index"?
q_5423.ground_truth: One establishes the available signatures for this ASC by considering as available signatures the signatures included in the renumbered list from the index specified by the "Available signature Start Index" to the index specified by the "Available signature End Index". Renumbering is done separately for each IE "PRACH preamble control parameters extension list" and for the list of available signatures specified in the IE "PRACH info" and "Available signature" in the IE "PRACH preamble control parameters (for Enhanced Uplink)", starting with the lowest available signature number and continuing in sequence, in the order of increasing signature numbers.

q_5424.question: How does the MDAS producer handle the ML model training with validation data in the MDA process?
q_5424.ground_truth: The MDAS producer looks up the historical data that are associated with the validated analytics report and trains the ML model with the historical data and the validation data.

q_5425.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of failed initial registration procedures at the P-CSCF or S-CSCF, with each measurement having a form of UR.FailInitReg.Cause where Cause identifies the status code?

q_5426.question: What is the purpose of the Multimedia Broadcast/Multicast Service (MBMS) Technical Specification?
q_5426.ground_truth: The purpose of the MBMS Technical Specification is to provide application-friendly methods and interfaces to access 3GPP MBMS User services.

q_5427.question: What is the maximum number of times that timer T3130 can be started in the uplink access procedure?
q_5427.ground_truth: Timer T3130 can be started a maximum of 3 times in the uplink access procedure.

q_5428.question: What is the difference between "Stop Sending Event Reports" and "Restart Sending Event Reports" in the "State Management and Event Report Messages" category?
q_5428.ground_truth: "Stop Sending Event Reports" is used to stop event reports concerning events with specific parameter values, while "Restart Sending Event Reports" is used to restart sending event reports concerning events with specific parameter values.

q_5429.question: What is the purpose of the synchronization reference source (re-)selection test cases in this section?
q_5429.ground_truth: The purpose of these test cases is to ensure that the UE selects the correct synchronization reference source based on various conditions, such as the reliability of GNSS signals and the synchronization status of other UEs.

q_5430.question: What is the mapping between one PDP context and one EPS Bearer?
q_5430.ground_truth: There is a 1:1 mapping between one PDP context and one EPS Bearer.

q_5431.question: What is the initial state of a session in the BM-SC?
q_5431.ground_truth: The initial state of a session in the BM-SC is Session Idle.

q_5432.question: What is the purpose of measuring ERLEpv in AEC evaluation?
q_5432.ground_truth: ERLEpv represents the echo return loss measurement at the end of a 5-second echo path variation.

q_5433.question: What is the contents of the Target to Source Transparent Container in GERAN Iu mode to GERAN A/Gb mode handover for PS handover to GERAN A/Gb mode from GERAN Iu mode?
q_5433.ground_truth: The Radio Network part of the Target to Source Transparent Container in GERAN Iu mode to GERAN A/Gb mode handover consists of the required information for access in the target cell and the information on allocated radio resources: uplink and downlink TBF parameters, PS Handover reference and generic parameters for access in the target cell. The Core Network (i.e. NAS Container for PS HO) part consists of an XID Command indicating Reset or 'Reset to old XID parameters' and the new IOV-UI for the target cell, and the GPRS ciphering algorithm to be used in the target cell if it is different from the ciphering algorithm used in the source cell.

q_5434.question: In the LLP-Errors ASN.1 module, which error type is returned when it receives a parameter with an unexpected value, without type violation?
q_5434.ground_truth: The "UnexpectedDataValue" error type is returned by the LMU or the network when it receives a parameter with an unexpected value, without type violation.

q_5435.question: What action does the PCRF take if there is a need to provision QoS rules and there is no Gateway Control and QoS Rules Reply pending?
q_5435.ground_truth: The PCRF initiates a Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision Procedure as defined in clause 7.7.4.

q_5436.question: What actions should be taken if an NS-BLOCK-ACK PDU is not received for an NS-BLOCK PDU within Tns-block seconds?
q_5436.ground_truth: The NS-BLOCK PDU procedure shall be repeated a maximum of NS-BLOCK-RETRIES attempts. After NS-BLOCK-RETRIES unsuccessful retry attempts the procedure is stopped and the O&M system is informed that the blocking procedure has failed. Further actions of the O&M system are out of the scope of the present document. The NS-VC shall be marked as blocked at the originating side of the blocking procedure.

q_5437.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group in producing the Packet-switched Streaming Service (PSS) technical report?
q_5437.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group is responsible for producing the PSS technical report to improve support for Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP in 3GPP networks and architectures.

q_5438.question: What is a supplementary service in the context of 3GPP TS 22.004?
q_5438.ground_truth: A supplementary service modifies or supplements a basic telecommunication service.

q_5439.question: What is the requirement for the cell-specific CQI median under MIMO dual stream conditions for UE HS-DSCH categories 25-28, 30, 32 and 36?
q_5439.ground_truth: The cell-specific CQI median shall be determined over all single transport block Type A CQI reports and all Type B CQI reports that were reported together with PCI reports matching the cell-specific precoding vector embedded in the propagation channel.

q_5440.question: What is the purpose of the CTSMSI update procedure in the 5G system?
q_5440.ground_truth: The CTSMSI update procedure serves to protect a user's identity by providing identity confidentiality.

q_5441.question: What NAS message is used as the NAS message in the Downlink Direct Transfer message r3?

q_5442.question: In what circumstances will the VPLMN establish a follow-on call before the call has reached the active phase?
q_5442.ground_truth: The VPLMN shall establish the follow-on call with the preferred service and the less preferred service that were available during call establishment.

q_5443.question: What information elements are contained in a CLASSMARK CHANGE message?
q_5443.ground_truth: A CLASSMARK CHANGE message contains the mobile station classmark 2 information element, and may also contain a Classmark 3 Information Element.

q_5444.question: Which of the bits (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, or K) should be set to 1 for the UTC Model to be requested?

q_5445.question: What does the "Starting E-RNTI" correspond to in the context of E-RUCH?
q_5445.ground_truth: The "Starting E-RNTI" corresponds to the first E-RNTI in the first group in the context of E-RUCH.

q_5446.question: What is the predefined packetization time for CSData when no redundancy is used?

q_5447.question: How are Information Object Classes (IOCs) used in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_5447.ground_truth: IOCs are used to encapsulate information within an IRPAgent. They are essential for NLIRP operations and notifications, providing an overview of the required information for managing logs in 3GPP telecommunication networks.

q_5448.question: What is the function of the ProSe UE ID in UE-to-UE Relay discovery?
q_5448.ground_truth: The ProSe UE ID is a Layer-2 identifier of the UE-R in the UE-to-UE Relay discovery procedure.

q_5449.question: What is the role of the Message Identifier (MI) on layer 3 of the EMMI protocol?
q_5449.ground_truth: The MI is always the first, and often the only, octet of the message on layer 3. It is used to identify the specific message being sent. The MI range is from (0..255).

q_5450.question: What action does the UE take when the validity time (T320) of dedicated priorities expires or a PLMN selection is performed?
q_5450.ground_truth: The UE shall not consider any exclude-listed cells as candidate for cell reselection and inherits the priorities provided by dedicated signalling.

q_5451.question: What is the purpose of the "uiccKeyManagement" attribute in the "keyManagement" element?
q_5451.ground_truth: The "uiccKeyManagement" attribute in the "keyManagement" element defines whether UICC based key management is required for the present MBMS User Service.

q_5452.question: What is the function of the Common Pilot Channel (CPICH) in a UMTS network?
q_5452.ground_truth: The CPICH is a fixed rate downlink physical channel that carries a pre-defined bit sequence, used as a reference signal for channel estimation and measurement in a UMTS network.

q_5453.question: What must the PCEF do when it receives a PCC Rule with both Rule-Activation-Time and Rule-Deactivation-Time, and time has already passed for both, and the Rule-Deactivation-Time occurs before the Rule-Activation-Time?
q_5453.ground_truth: The PCEF shall immediately set the PCC rule active.

q_5454.question: What is the purpose of using a CAA-Level UAV ID in the 3GPP system?
q_5454.ground_truth: The CAA-Level UAV ID is used in the 3GPP system to discover the USS for the UAV and to invoke MNO services or during authorization or authorization revocation. It must be unique within the geography (e.g. at least country) of the 3GPP network.

q_5455.question: What information is provided in the E-DCH-Resources-Information-AuditRsp field?
q_5455.ground_truth: The E-DCH-Resources-Information-AuditRsp field includes information about the resource operational state, availability status, and iE-Extensions of an E-DCH resource.

q_5456.question: What is the purpose of the IGF temporal flattening in the frequency domain?
q_5456.ground_truth: The IGF temporal flattening is used to smooth out any temporal fluctuations in the reconstructed signal by replacing the spectral contents that are quantized to 0 with spectra that are similarly generated to the filled spectra by IGF. This helps to maintain significant spectral contents and preserve the overall signal quality.

q_5457.question: What would be the impact of using Modified MBMS in a GSM SFN broadcast channel mode, with the exception of the frequency hopping case?
q_5457.ground_truth: There would be a marginal impact on the BTS hardware, as existing transmitter designs can support the required waveform qualities.

q_5458.question: What error is used when the gsmSCF indicates to the gsmSSF that it cannot start the execution of the requested CAP Operation because a SACF or MACF rule is violated or the CAP Operation cannot be executed in the current state of the FSM?

q_5459.question: What is the command number for the TIMER MANAGEMENT command that starts the timer?
q_5459.ground_truth: The command number for the TIMER MANAGEMENT command that starts the timer is 1.

q_5460.question: What does the AN-GW-Address AVP contain and how is it used?
q_5460.ground_truth: The AN-GW-Address AVP contains the control plane IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses of the access node gateway (SGW for 3GPP and AGW/ePDG for non-3GPP networks). It can contain two instances in Diameter commands when both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are provided.

q_5461.question: What should the MCVideo service do when all users have left a video stream?
q_5461.ground_truth: The MCVideo service should give an indication to the sending user that all users have left the video stream, and allow them to choose whether to end the video stream or continue sending it for subsequent download by other users.

q_5462.question: What is the responsibility of the VAE client upon receiving the local service information?
q_5462.ground_truth: Upon receiving the local service information, the VAE client stores the received information.

q_5463.question: What attribute values can the overall connection type have for symmetry?
q_5463.ground_truth: The overall symmetry can be Bidirectional Symmetric or Bidirectional Asymmetric (Multislot connections for data).

q_5464.question: What is the name of the technology that produces a personalized video mix for each cameraman in a point-to-multipoint downlink transmission?

q_5465.question: What procedure is followed to indicate to the MRFC the outcome of a Floor Request decision made by the FCS?
q_5465.ground_truth: The "Report Floor Status Decision" procedure as specified in clause~8.48

q_5466.question: What are the coding schemes used for GPRS PDTCH?
q_5466.ground_truth: Four different coding schemes, CS-1 to CS-4, are used for the GPRS Radio Blocks carrying RLC data blocks, while code CS-1 is always used for Radio Blocks carrying RLC/MAC Control blocks.

q_5467.question: What are the two modes that can be used for uplink transmission in version 1 of the protocol?

q_5468.question: What events trigger the removal of the corresponding PCC/QoS Rules from the PCEF/BBERF in the context of resource sharing for different AF sessions?
q_5468.ground_truth: The AF session termination or modification procedure that removes media flows.

q_5469.question: What is the difference between the security assurance process for 3GPP physical network products and virtualised network products?
q_5469.ground_truth: The security assurance process for 3GPP virtualised network products is generally the same as for 3GPP physical network products. However, the operator gets assurance regarding the security of the virtualised network product in the SECAM evaluation process.

q_5470.question: What are the supported IP versions in the F1-C signalling bearer?
q_5470.ground_truth: The F1-C signalling bearer supports both IPv6 (IETF RFC 8200) and IPv4 (IETF RFC 791).

q_5471.question: What is the purpose of the "TFCI Coding" information element in the UTDOA positioning method?
q_5471.ground_truth: The "TFCI Coding" information element in the UTDOA positioning method describes the way how the TFCI bits are coded.

q_5472.question: What should the old SGSN do upon receiving the SGSN Context Acknowledge message if the Cause value indicates a value other than "Request accepted"?
q_5472.ground_truth: The old SGSN shall continue as if the SGSN Context Request was never received.

q_5473.question: How many levels are in the tree search for the 12.65 kbit/s mode?
q_5473.ground_truth: There are 4 levels in the tree search for the 12.65 kbit/s mode.

q_5474.question: What is an FE in the context of these procedures?
q_5474.ground_truth: An FE, or Front End, is a component that interacts with the UDR (User Data Repository) to retrieve or modify user data, or to perform other actions as part of its application logic.

q_5475.question: What should the DRNS do if the Single Stream MIMO Activation Indicator IE is included in the HS-DSCH FDD Secondary Serving Information IE?
q_5475.ground_truth: The DRNS should activate the Single Stream MIMO mode for the secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link if the Single Stream MIMO Activation Indicator IE is included in the HS-DSCH FDD Secondary Serving Information IE.

q_5476.question: What is antenna gain component 2 expressed as in the TDL channel model option 1 and option 2, and the CDL channel model?
q_5476.ground_truth: Antenna gain component 2 = 0 for the TDL channel model option 2, and CDL channel model. For TDL channel model option 1, antenna gain component 2 is part of the expression Antenna gain component 3 + Antenna gain component 4.

q_5477.question: What should the eP-CSCF remove from the forwarded SDP offer if media plane optimization is not to be applied?
q_5477.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF should remove all received "tra-contact", "tra-m-line", "tra-att", "tra-SCTP-association", "tra-media-line-number" and "tra-bw" SDP attributes from the forwarded SDP offer if media plane optimization is not to be applied.

q_5478.question: What should the IWF do with the received SDP offer when composing the SDP answer for the accepted media-floor control entity, if present in the received SDP offer, when performing the non-controlling role in a 3GPP MCPTT group?
q_5478.ground_truth: The IWF should replace the IP address and port number with the IP address and port number of the IWF performing the non-controlling role, and include 'fmtp' attributes as specified in 3GPP TS 29.380 clause 14.

q_5479.question: What is the role of the 3GPP Task Force in the GIA4 specification?
q_5479.ground_truth: The 3GPP Task Force prepared the detailed specification of the 3GPP integrity algorithm GIA4.

q_5480.question: What should the UE do if it receives rejected NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with a specific rejection cause?
q_5480.ground_truth: If the UE receives rejected NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with a rejection cause of "S-NSSAI not available due to the failed or revoked network slice-specific authentication and authorization", it should store the rejected S-NSSAI(s) and not attempt to use this S-NSSAI in the current PLMN over any access.

q_5481.question: What user identity information is used in the request message for ProSe Discovery Parameter retrieval?
q_5481.ground_truth: User identity information such as ProSe Application ID, RPAUID, and RPAUID(s) that the UE is interested in monitoring are used in the request message for ProSe Discovery Parameter retrieval.

q_5482.question: What is used for conveying common control signaling required by GPRS in the initial phase of packet transfer, when no PCCCH is allocated in a cell?
q_5482.ground_truth: Common control signaling required by GPRS in the initial phase of packet transfer is conveyed on CCCH or EC-CCCH when no PCCCH is allocated in a cell.

q_5483.question: What information is sent to DF2 in the case of a PMIP attach/tunnel activation event in the context of PMIP based S5/S8 interfaces?
q_5483.ground_truth: The following elements are delivered to DF2 for a PMIP attach/tunnel activation event: IMSI, MSISDN, the identifier of the requesting node type and network, target identity, and a correlation number if available.

q_5484.question: What is the ACS definition that was agreed upon by WG4?
q_5484.ground_truth: ACS is a measure of a receiver's ability to receive a signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of a modulated signal in the adjacent channel. ACS is the ratio of the receiver filter attenuation on the assigned channel frequency to the receiver filter attenuation on the adjacent channel frequency, with a noise power bandwidth equal to the chip rate.

q_5485.question: What were the capacities in MUROS-1 that were blocking limited?
q_5485.ground_truth: A0, B0, C0, and D0 were blocking limited in MUROS-1.

q_5486.question: What are some examples of application-specific models not defined within the CBIM?
q_5486.ground_truth: Examples of such models include CS, GPRS, EPS, IMS service profiles, MSISDN, IMSI, IMPI, IMPU, E164, and NAI, which are usually defined by the respective application or system.

q_5487.question: What type of changes are required in the EL decoder of the SHVC codec, compared to a single-layer HEVC codec?
q_5487.ground_truth: The necessary changes in the EL decoder of the SHVC codec are only at slice header-level and above, which means they are at the high level syntax level.

q_5488.question: What is the role of Charge Advice Information in the AoC service?
q_5488.ground_truth: Charge Advice Information is a message that contains the elements which together define the rate at which the call is to be charged, and it is used in both Advice of Charge (Information) and Advice of Charge (Charging) services.

q_5489.question: In the scenario described in 6a, when does the UE initiate the TAU procedure?
q_5489.ground_truth: The UE initiates the TAU procedure during a 5GS to EPS handover or inter-system redirection to EPS with N26 interface.

q_5490.question: What is the maximum level of ACLR for 1,28 Mcps TDD option BS supporting 16QAM?
q_5490.ground_truth: The ACLR requirement is the same as specified in section 6.6.2.2.5.2 applies to 1,28 Mcps TDD option BS supporting 16QAM.

q_5491.question: What happens if the OCS does not provide a termination action before denying credit for a charging key or IP-CAN bearer removal?
q_5491.ground_truth: The PCEF/TDF will perform its default termination action.

q_5492.question: What happens to the L2R transmit buffers in the IWF towards the UE in the absence of out-band flow control functionality at the MSC/IWF and the remote (fixed network) modem?
q_5492.ground_truth: The L2R transmit buffers in the IWF towards the UE shall overbridge temporary throughput problems on the radio interface and the case where the UE initiates flow control. However, the IWF shall release the connection if an overflow of these buffers occurs.

q_5493.question: What is the procedure for PDN GW-initiated PDN disconnection in trusted Fixed Broadband Access with DSMIPv6 on S2c when dynamic policy provisioning is not deployed over S9a?
q_5493.ground_truth: If dynamic policy provisioning is not deployed, the Fixed Broadband Access network employs local policies for PDN disconnection. The PCRF does not execute a Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision procedure or a PCRF-Initiated Gateway Control Session Termination Procedure with the BPCF over S9a.

q_5494.question: What is the purpose of the 8.3.2.1 leaf in the Metrics node?
q_5494.ground_truth: The 8.3.2.1 leaf in the Metrics node provides in textual format the QoE metrics that need to be reported, the measurement frequency, the reporting interval and the reporting range.

q_5495.question: What is the expected outcome for the PROACTIVE COMMAND 1.3.4 in the sequence 1.4?
q_5495.ground_truth: Channel data length is 200 bytes of space available in the Tx buffer.

q_5496.question: What is the role of IRPs in providing integrated management solutions for multi-vendor networks?
q_5496.ground_truth: IRPs ensure interoperability between products of different vendors in a network management system, such as between Product-Specific Applications (PSA) and the Network and System Management Processes (SMP) of the Network Manager (NM).

q_5497.question: How many SCTP associations are established between an eNB and WT pair?
q_5497.ground_truth: There shall be only one SCTP association established between one eNB and WT pair.

q_5498.question: What should the DRNC do if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the Additional E-DCH Cell Information RL Add Req IE in the case of FDD?
q_5498.ground_truth: The DRNS should use the Multicell E-DCH Transport Bearer Mode IE for an Additional E-DCH to be Setup and follow the rules defined in this procedure for Single Carrier mode of operation for establishment of the transport bearer for a MAC-d flow.

q_5499.question: What is the action taken by a MS in order to provide location information to the PLMN and what is this action referred to as in the document?
q_5499.ground_truth: The action taken by a MS to provide location information to the PLMN is referred to as location updating in the document.

q_5500.question: What is the command number for the SEND SS facility required to be supported by the ME as per the conformance requirement in section 27.22.4.11.4.9.2?

q_5501.question: What are the necessary conditions for the SFR server and SFR enabled Feed Reader to support the MBMS delivery?
q_5501.ground_truth: The SFR server and SFR enabled Feed Reader shall support the mbms-access-info parameters in the DCD-2-broadcast-profile element if they are to support Via DCD adaptation to BCAST. Additionally, when MBMS is supported by both the SFR server and SFR enabled Feed Reader, they shall support the mbms-access-info parameters in the DCD-2-broadcast-profile element via OTA-PTM for DCD procedures.

q_5502.question: Which bands in NR CA n5-n25-n77 experience harmonic mixing issues?
q_5502.ground_truth: There is a harmonic mixing relation for the 4th harmonic of n5 downlink and n77 downlink, and for the 2nd harmonic of n25 downlink and n77 downlink.

q_5503.question: What should the IWF do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request for imminent peril session with an unauthorized request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call?
q_5503.ground_truth: The IWF should reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the imminentperil-ind element set to a value of "false".

q_5504.question: What happens if the MAC entity detects that the maximum number of consecutive HARQ DTX has been reached in the sidelink connection with the peer UE?
q_5504.ground_truth: The UE should release the PC5-RRC connection, indicate the release to the upper layer, and send a SidelinkUEInformationNR message to indicate SL RLF.

q_5505.question: What is the goal of the communication service assurance for shared resources use case?
q_5505.ground_truth: The goal of the communication service assurance for shared resources use case is to explore and evaluate communication service realisation and impact on other communication services and continuously monitor SLA fulfilment.

q_5506.question: What is the difference between the HNB-Identity and UE-Identity in the HNBAP-PROTOCOL-IEs?
q_5506.ground_truth: The HNB-Identity is a unique identifier for the HNB, while the UE-Identity is a unique identifier for a UE (User Equipment) in the network.

q_5507.question: On which servers does the PSS client transmit QoE reports?
q_5507.ground_truth: The PSS client transmits QoE reports to the servers specified in the "Servers" leaf of the PSS QoE metrics management object.

q_5508.question: How are the Log-Area Ratios decoded back into reflection coefficients?
q_5508.ground_truth: The Log-Area Ratios are decoded back into reflection coefficients using equation (3.5), which is a piece-wise linear approximation.

q_5509.question: In the filter bank of the VAD algorithm, what is the purpose of the 5th and 3rd order filter blocks?
q_5509.ground_truth: The 5th and 3rd order filter blocks are used to divide the input signal into frequency bands and decimate the sampling frequency. Each filter block decimates the sampling frequency by 2 and divides the input into high-pass and low-pass parts.

q_5510.question: What are the functions of the Iur-g interface protocols?
q_5510.ground_truth: The functions of the Iur-g interface protocols include paging, relocation execution, reporting of general error situations, measurements on common resources, and radio resource reserve handover.

q_5511.question: What is the purpose of performing converged charging for provisioning MnS in network slice management?
q_5511.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide the data required for charging management activities, such as NSI allocation, modification, and deallocation, when the MnS consumer consumes the provisioned MnS.

q_5512.question: What protocol is used for the initialization and maintenance of the connection between the RCAF and PCRF?
q_5512.ground_truth: The initialization and maintenance of the connection between the RCAF and PCRF are defined by the underlying protocol, which is Diameter, as specified in IETF~RFC~6733.

q_5513.question: What is the expected functionality of the user device for supporting interactivity usage measurement and reporting?
q_5513.ground_truth: The user device is expected to collect interactivity usage data, specify the parameters of interactivity events, define reporting occurrence times and durations, and ensure secure storage of interactivity usage data.

q_5514.question: What is the cell ranking criterion Rs for serving cell and Rn for neighboring cells?
q_5514.ground_truth: The cell ranking criterion Rs for serving cell and Rn for neighboring cells is defined by Rs = Qmeas,n - Qmeas,s + ThreshServingHyst, where Qmeas,n and Qmeas,s are the averaged RSRP results of the neighboring cell and the serving cell, respectively, and ThreshServingHyst is the hysteresis value between the serving cell and the neighboring cell that is applied to prevent unnecessary cell reselections.

q_5515.question: What are the two potential standardization areas identified in the 5MBS User Service delivery and control architecture?
q_5515.ground_truth: The two potential standardization areas identified in the 5MBS User Service delivery and control architecture are the interaction between AF and MBSF to support MBS session operations and transport, and the provision of MBSTF functionality related to MBS data handling via xMB-U and MB2-U interfaces.

q_5516.question: What is the final target in the search criterion for bit rates at and above 16.4 kbps?
q_5516.ground_truth: The final target is which can be calculated by using the autocorrelation matrix of the filter and the target residual.

q_5517.question: What are the possible radio interface rate options for the data channel?
q_5517.ground_truth: The possible radio interface rate options for the data channel are 3.6 kbit/s, 6.0 kbit/s, 12.0 kbit/s, 29.0 kbit/s, 32.0 kbit/s, and 43.5 kbit/s.

q_5518.question: What is the HTTP status code that should be returned on failure or redirection in step 6d?
q_5518.ground_truth: The appropriate HTTP status code (e.g. "403 Forbidden") should be returned on failure or redirection in step 6d.

q_5519.question: What is the purpose of testing the Terminal's performance as specified in tests (a)-(e) and (g)-(h)?
q_5519.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the Terminal controls its network access in accordance with its access control class and the conditions imposed by the serving network, including the case when the UE is in HPLMN and when the UE is not in HPLMN.

q_5520.question: What is the purpose of the AUSF/AAA-P in the second architecture approach for SNPN connectivity?
q_5520.ground_truth: The AUSF/AAA-P initiates the authentication and authorization towards the AAA-S based on the SO-ID extracted from the SUPI and the UDM indication when a SUPI with no relation with the UE Identity in E-Sub is provided during the registration procedure.

q_5521.question: Which Relocation scenario, as defined in clause 4.3.2, is subject to the "3 out of 4 approach" NOTE?

q_5522.question: What is the measure of the capability of the receiver to receiver a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency in the presence of two or more interfering signals with a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal in LTE-Advanced?
q_5522.ground_truth: Intermodulation response rejection is the measure of the capability of the receiver to receiver a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency in the presence of two or more interfering signals with a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal in LTE-Advanced.

q_5523.question: What is the requirement for UE and the PDN GW in order to apply NBIFOM?
q_5523.ground_truth: The UE and the PDN GW shall always be aware of which access IP flows of the PDN connection shall use and exchange Routing Rules (RR) that describe the mapping between a set of IP flows and a Routing access type over which to route these IP flows.

q_5524.question: What is the function of the FAE server in Solution #17 of TR23.745?
q_5524.ground_truth: The FAE server in Solution #17 of TR23.745 manages the 5GS TSN bridge, including DS-TT and NW-TT, and interacts with DS-TT over the FAE-S reference point following IEEE 802.1Qcc. It also provides the server side functionalities corresponding to the TSN applications in the FF UE.

q_5525.question: What should the ICS UE do when an I1 Progress message with Progress reason set to Ringing is received while the I1 session is in the "proceeding" state?
q_5525.ground_truth: The ICS UE should set timer E to fire in T2 seconds, retransmit the original I1 Invite message if timer E fires while the session is in the "proceeding" state, and clear the call if timer E fires 5 times or if timer F fires while the session is in the "proceeding" state.

q_5526.question: What is not supported in the existing 3GPP management system regarding access control between MnS producer and external MnS consumer?
q_5526.ground_truth: Identification, authentication, and authorization of an external MnS consumer on behalf of an administrator of a vertical are not supported in the existing 3GPP management system.

q_5527.question: What is a service provider in the context of telecommunications?
q_5527.ground_truth: A service provider is a natural or legal person that provides one or more public telecommunications services, whose provision consists wholly or partly in the transmission and routing of signals on a telecommunications network.

q_5528.question: What happens to the FRMCS Users when an ongoing railway emergency alert is changed by the Controller or an External System?
q_5528.ground_truth: The conditions of the railway emergency alert can be changed, resulting in an expansion or reduction of FRMCS Users to be informed about the emergency.

q_5529.question: How many Iub transport bearers are required for one Iub HS-DSCH data stream?
q_5529.ground_truth: One Iub transport bearer is required for one Iub HS-DSCH data stream.

q_5530.question: What are the objectives of the W1 interface specifications?
q_5530.ground_truth: The objectives of the W1 interface specifications are to facilitate the interconnection of an ng-eNB-CU and an ng-eNB-DU supplied by different manufacturers and support procedures for establishing, maintaining, and releasing radio bearers for the NG-RAN part of PDU sessions and for E-UTRAN Radio Access Bearers.

q_5531.question: What does the P-CSCF need to do before invoking services provided by AMF after receiving the AMF instance ID?
q_5531.ground_truth: Before invoking services provided by AMF, the IMS (P-CSCF) needs to query NRF with the received AMF instance ID to get the AMF endpoints to which it can invoke service request.

q_5532.question: What is the meaning of "CDUR" in the document, and under what circumstances it is measured in the charging process?
q_5532.ground_truth: CDUR stands for Chargeable DURation, and it is measured by the MS from the charging point to the end of call. It applies separately for each call in the charging process.

q_5533.question: What is included in the attachment Attachment-1-Tools.zip?
q_5533.ground_truth: The attachment Attachment-1-Tools.zip includes LossGenerator.zip, pcaploss.zip, Traces.zip, and verifysegm.zip.

q_5534.question: What happens to a UE's registrations to the CN during the lifetime of a dedicated connection?
q_5534.ground_truth: During the lifetime of a dedicated connection, the UE suppresses its registrations to the CN since the UTRAN already handles the mobility.

q_5535.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) UTRAN implementation-specific O&M transport (Release 17) document?
q_5535.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to specify the transport of implementation-specific O&M signaling between Node B and the Management Platform in case the transport is routed via the RNC.

q_5536.question: What is the pre-condition required for an Application Server to send a MSGin5G message request to the MSGin5G Server?
q_5536.ground_truth: The Application server needs to have an established secured communication with the MSGin5G server and get the identifier of MSGin5G UE from the registration procedure.

q_5537.question: What are the non-video aspects of the MCVideo service?
q_5537.ground_truth: Non-video aspects of the MCVideo service include non-speech aspects such as Emergency Alert signaling, Location messaging, camera control, and store and forward video. They may work in the same way between MCVideo and MCData.

q_5538.question: What is the method of testing described in section 15.2.4.4.2?
q_5538.ground_truth: The method of testing described in section 15.2.4.4.2 is a procedure for verifying the UE's behavior in response to changes in the USIM. It involves switching the ME on with different IMSI values and observing how the UE responds to registration requests and authentication procedures.

q_5539.question: What is one potential threat if the pairing authorization of UAV and UAVC is not performed securely?
q_5539.ground_truth: If pairing authorization of UAV and UAVC is not performed securely, an unauthorized UAVC may be able to communicate with the UAV and perform an unauthorized flight, which could cause tremendous risks to the security of UAS and public safety.

q_5540.question: What is the risk of a lower security level in GSM/GPRS for UMTS or LTE capable UEs?
q_5540.ground_truth: The risk is that an adversary could inject false keys and false warning messages in an attempt to cause panic, as UMTS or LTE capable UEs might attach to a GSM network when there is no UMTS or LTE coverage.

q_5541.question: What is the operation performed by the TIMER MANAGEMENT command with the qualifier "start the Timer"?
q_5541.ground_truth: It starts a timer with a specified value.

q_5542.question: What is the role of Information Model (IM) in the FNIM?
q_5542.ground_truth: The Information Model (IM) in the FNIM represents the things, their properties, and their relationships.

q_5543.question: What is the meaning of the difference between the entering and leaving conditions for the event in the measurement reporting procedure?
q_5543.ground_truth: The entering condition for an event in the measurement reporting procedure is used to determine when to start reporting measurements for a specific event. The leaving condition is used to determine when to stop reporting measurements for this event. The entering condition is satisfied when Ms + Hys < Thresh and the leaving condition is satisfied when Ms - Hys > Thresh, where Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell, Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event.

q_5544.question: What is the maximum standard deviation of log-normally distributed shadowing used for the macro cell propagation model?

q_5545.question: What is the purpose of providing a standardized transfer mechanism for each MExE technology?
q_5545.ground_truth: The purpose is to support the capability to transfer new applications and applets to the MExE UE as required, and indicate the type of data being transferred.

q_5546.question: What should the MRFP include in the SDP answer when it receives a BFCP media stream in the SDP offer?
q_5546.ground_truth: When the MRFP receives a BFCP media stream in the SDP offer, it should include an "a=floorctrl:s-only" attribute, "a=confid" attribute indicating the conference identity, "a=userid" attribute indicating the user identity, "a=floorid" attribute lines containing the BFCP floor identity(ies) and "a=label" attribute lines indicating which of the accepted audio and/or video media streams will be BFCP controlled in the SDP answer.

q_5547.question: What actions should a UE take upon acquiring a valid SIB1?
q_5547.ground_truth: Upon acquiring a valid SIB1, the UE should store it, use any stored valid versions of required SIBs or posSIBs, and acquire any missing required SIBs.

q_5548.question: What is the function of the Network Access Control group in GPRS packet domain network?
q_5548.ground_truth: Network Access Control encompasses functions that regulate user access to the network, including registration, authentication, admission control, message screening, and packet terminal adaptation.

q_5549.question: What is the user data length of the short message?

q_5550.question: What is the role of the CBE in Solution #8?
q_5550.ground_truth: The CBE is responsible for informing the CBC or CBCF of PLMN A when Disaster Condition applies or no longer applies for PLMN D in an area.

q_5551.question: What is the minimum frequency spacing difference allowed between two adjacent carriers in test case b)?
q_5551.ground_truth: The difference between two adjacent spacings shall be no more than 200 kHz.

q_5552.question: What is the purpose of the `metadataURI` reference in a metadata envelope item?
q_5552.ground_truth: It is used to reference the associated metadata fragment using the same URI as the fragment file is identified by in the Service Announcement, allowing the metadata envelope to be mapped to its associated metadata fragment.

q_5553.question: What is the role of the "DirectCommunicationRadioParameters" node when the UE is not served by E-UTRAN?
q_5553.ground_truth: The "DirectCommunicationRadioParameters" node acts as a placeholder for the radio parameter information needed for the UE to perform ProSe direct communication when the UE is not served by E-UTRAN.

q_5554.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives a Duplication Activation/Deactivation MAC CE activating the PDCP duplication of a DRB?
q_5554.ground_truth: Indicate the activation of PDCP duplication of the DRB to upper layers.

q_5555.question: What is the purpose of the StreamingAccept-Subset attribute?
q_5555.ground_truth: It describes support for a subset of a specific content type that cannot be expressed with MIME-type parameters.

q_5556.question: Which channel is used to adjust the maximum transmission rank and the secondary stream rate for UEs under the control of the Node B?
q_5556.ground_truth: The E-ROCH channel allows the Node B to directly adjust the maximum transmission rank and the secondary stream rate of UEs under its control.

q_5557.question: What is the purpose of the initial AMF in the RR. UE's capability to process unprotected authentication request and ID request?
q_5557.ground_truth: The initial AMF in the RR. UE needs to support the capability to process unprotected authentication request and ID request in order to maintain communication with unprotected UEs, which allows for seamless handover and mobility between networks.

q_5558.question: How is time encoded in a CCM message?
q_5558.ground_truth: Time is encoded in a CCM message as an OCTET SEQUENCE of seven octets, with each octet representing a specific part of the date and time. For example, the date and time 1st January, 2001 00:00:30 would be encoded as: 07 d1 01 01 00 00 1E.

q_5559.question: What network layer protocol is used as the foundation for the Xn-C signalling bearer in the NG-RAN?
q_5559.ground_truth: The Transport Network Layer in the Xn-C signalling bearer is based on IP transport, comprising SCTP on top of IP.

q_5560.question: What message is sent when the SCCP signalling connection establishment fails?
q_5560.ground_truth: The SCCP sends the CONNECTION REFUSAL message when the SCCP signalling connection establishment fails.

q_5561.question: What information does the GANC provide in the GA-RC REGISTER ACCEPT message when the MS operates in GAN A/Gb mode?
q_5561.ground_truth: The GAN System Information parameters (e.g., Network Mode of Operation, GPRS availability Indicator, etc.)

q_5562.question: What is the structure of the MMI procedure for the control of Supplementary Services in a UE?
q_5562.ground_truth: The MMI procedure for the control of Supplementary Services in a UE consists of a Service Code (SC) and Supplementary Information (SI). The SC is a 2 or 3-digit number that uniquely identifies the Supplementary Service, while the SI is optional and may consist of a PIN code or Directory Number.

q_5563.question: What does a Location Number represent in the context of CAMEL?
q_5563.ground_truth: The Location Number is the number received on the incoming circuit for an incoming call or to be sent on the outgoing circuit for an outgoing call in the context of CAMEL.

q_5564.question: What is the effect of the Session Management back-off timer for the MS when it is provided with an APN in the rejected Session Management Request message or in the Deactivate PDP Context Request message?
q_5564.ground_truth: When the Session Management back-off timer is provided in the rejected Session Management Request message or in the Deactivate PDP Context Request message, the MS shall not initiate any Session Management procedures for the congested APN. The MS may initiate Session Management procedures for other APNs.

q_5565.question: If the UE receives an Absolute Grant, for which PDU will it be used if there are MAC-e or MAC-i PDUs awaiting retransmission and resources assigned by the Grant enable transmission of a MAC-e/i PDU awaiting retransmission?
q_5565.ground_truth: It will be used for the retransmission (oldest first) of the MAC-e or MAC-i PDU awaiting retransmission.

q_5566.question: What should the receiving node do if it receives a message initiating a procedure that does not have a message to report the outcome of the procedure, and it contains IEs marked with "Reject IE" which it does not comprehend?
q_5566.ground_truth: The receiving node should terminate the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure.

q_5567.question: What shall the UE do if it has a valid 5G-GUTI when registering in the same PLMN over 3GPP and non-3GPP access?
q_5567.ground_truth: The UE shall populate the 5GS mobile identity IE with the valid 5G-GUTI.

q_5568.question: What is the goal of the Trigger based Assurance Closed Control Loop (ACCL) use case in the 3GPP management system?
q_5568.ground_truth: The goal is to enable the consumer of an assurance closed loop to set conditions, such as threshold crossings, that trigger changes in ACCL state, such as enabling or disabling an ACCL.

q_5569.question: What is the length and format of the Key Domain ID in BM-SC?
q_5569.ground_truth: The Key Domain ID in BM-SC is 3 bytes long, and is composed of the MCC (Mobile Country Code) and MNC (Mobile Network Code) combined together.

q_5570.question: What is the definition of "AOC" in the document, and what components does it use to compute the charge value?
q_5570.ground_truth: AOC stands for Advice of Charge and is the charge as computed by the MS, expressed in terms of Home Units. It uses three components to compute the charge value: the charging point, the units incremented per interval, and the chargeable duration. The signalling CAI not only provides charging information but initiates the timing of the chargeable duration as well.

q_5571.question: How does 5GS acquire the additional assistance information reflecting survival time in deterministic applications?
q_5571.ground_truth: 5GS can acquire the additional assistance information reflecting survival time in deterministic applications by interworking with AF or NEF, or using other methods such as interworking with CUC.

q_5572.question: In the MBMS metadata envelope, what is the mandatory attribute for a metadata envelope item?
q_5572.ground_truth: metadataURI is the mandatory attribute for a metadata envelope item in the MBMS metadata envelope.

q_5573.question: What is the main challenge that the conventional mobility management method faces in terms of handover in a future high-frequency network?
q_5573.ground_truth: The main challenge is that, for a trial-and-error-based scheme to achieve nearly zero-failure handover, it is difficult, especially for high-mobility UE and stringent QoS applications.

q_5574.question: What is the purpose of the state variable VT(US) in the UM data state management?
q_5574.ground_truth: The state variable VT(US) in the UM data state management contains the "Sequence Number" of the next UMD PDU to be transmitted and is incremented by 1 each time a UMD PDU is transmitted.

q_5575.question: What conditions should be met for the UE to retransmit a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message and the PDU session information which was transported together with the initial transmission of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
q_5575.ground_truth: The UE shall retransmit a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message and the PDU session information which was transported together with the initial transmission of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message on the first expiry of the timer T3580. This retransmission can be repeated up to four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3580, the UE shall abort the procedure, release the allocated PTI and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE.

q_5576.question: What should a UE do if it fails to decode the BSIC after two successive attempts during BSIC re-confirmation?
q_5576.ground_truth: The UE should abort BSIC re-confirmation attempts for that GSM cell, treat it as a new GSM cell with unidentified BSIC, and move it to the initial BSIC identification procedure.

q_5577.question: What happens when a Controller terminates a railway emergency alert?
q_5577.ground_truth: A mobile FRMCS User involved in the railway emergency alert receives a termination notification, which can include additional information presented on their end user device.

q_5578.question: What is the maximum number of physical channels that a UE can transmit in a 1.28Mcps TDD frame?
q_5578.ground_truth: The Maximum Number of UL Physical Channels per Timeslot defines this.

q_5579.question: What are the necessary functions in the OCS to support correlation of bearer, service and IMS charging?
q_5579.ground_truth: The correlation function and notification management are the necessary functions in the OCS to support correlation of bearer, service and IMS charging.

q_5580.question: What method is introduced in the 5GS system to limit the aggregate bit rate that can be expected to be provided across all GBR and Non-GBR QoS Flows corresponding to PDU Sessions of the UE for the same slice (S-NSSAI)?
q_5580.ground_truth: UE-Slice MBR (UE Slice Maximum Bit Rate)

q_5581.question: What should the UE do if it is in the sub state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and enters a cell belonging to a tracking area not in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
q_5581.ground_truth: The UE should attempt to register.

q_5582.question: What is the requirement for EC-GSM-IoT in a BTS supporting it?
q_5582.ground_truth: A BTS supporting EC-GSM-IoT shall fulfill the requirements for EC-channels in at least coverage classes CC1 and CC4, support 1 TS EC-RACH in CC1 and at least one of 1 TS EC-RACH and 2 TS EC-RACH in Coverage Classes higher than CC1. The BTS shall be equipped with RX diversity and support at least MCS-1 and MCS-1/16 for EC-PDTCH.

q_5583.question: What does the GRE tunnel Deletion achieve in the LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion Procedure?
q_5583.ground_truth: The GRE tunnel is removed from the LMA and the MAG, which deletes the GRE tunnel between the MAG and the LMA for the PDN connection.

q_5584.question: In what scenario does the MSGin5G Client-1 send a failure response to the MSGin5G Client-2?
q_5584.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client-1 sends a failure response if it has decided to reject the request to send the message or if it receives a reject response from the MSGin5G Server.

q_5585.question: What should be used when only a few symbols are lost in order to minimize signalling?
q_5585.ground_truth: Option 6.1.3.1 should be used in this case.

q_5586.question: What is the specified mechanism in TS 23.501 for QoS monitoring to assist URLLC?
q_5586.ground_truth: Per-flow monitoring mechanism is specified in clause 5.33.3.2 of TS 23.501 for QoS monitoring to assist URLLC.

q_5587.question: What interaction is required to measure successful incoming inter RAT handover to EPS?
q_5587.ground_truth: Transmission by MME of "Forward Relocation Complete Notification" message to SGSN, or transmission by MME of "Direct Transfer (S101 Session ID, Attach Accept, (and Bearer Setup Request))" to HRPD access network.

q_5588.question: What should be the length of the group ID when more than one call attempt is made to the same group ID?
q_5588.ground_truth: If more than one call attempt is made to a group ID with a length of 8 decimal digits, the network should reject all but one of the call attempts.

q_5589.question: What type of addresses does the F1 interface support for data transport over the IP based Transport layer?
q_5589.ground_truth: The F1 interface supports both IPv4 and IPv6 for data transport over the IP based Transport layer.

q_5590.question: What should the infrastructure do to enable operation of the affected MSs that are unable to handle the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT, ATTACH ACCEPT and ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages when the EPLMN Lists IE is included?
q_5590.ground_truth: The infrastructure may adapt the contents of the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT, ATTACH ACCEPT and ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message it sends to an MS by excluding the EPLMN List IE added in the R99 version of the specifications. This can be done based on the MS Revision Level Indicator.

q_5591.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Application Layer Group ID in ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_5591.ground_truth: The ProSe Application Layer Group ID is used to identify an application layer group that the UE belongs to in ProSe Direct Discovery.

q_5592.question: What are some common types of failures during the PS handover preparation phase?
q_5592.ground_truth: During the PS handover preparation phase, failures can occur due to no resource reservation or allocation, insufficient resource allocation by the target system, the target CSG cell not being allowed for the MS, or loss of signaling messages or incorrect information elements in the signaling messages.

q_5593.question: What are the types of filters that a watcher can define for filtering presence information?
q_5593.ground_truth: The types of filters that a watcher can define for filtering presence information include filters for selecting specific tuples, attributes, and triggers for sending notifications.

q_5594.question: What should the mobile station do if it receives a valid RRBP field as part of the RLC/MAC control block containing the EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK or EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK AND CONTENTION RESOLUTION message?
q_5594.ground_truth: The mobile station shall transmit an EC PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT or EC PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT HIGHER CC message in the uplink resources specified.

q_5595.question: What are the possible drawbacks of triggering a Codec change from the Core Network to the BSS using a new Assignment procedure on the same SCCP connection?
q_5595.ground_truth: The drawbacks include replacing the UDP/IP termination at the BSS and at the MGW without having the old and new terminations in place during the Codec change, and the Core Network not being aware of the current BSS capabilities when initiating the new Assignment procedure.

q_5596.question: What information is provided by the "HS-DSCH FDD Update Information" IE?
q_5596.ground_truth: The "HS-DSCH FDD Update Information" IE provides information for HS-DSCH to be updated, with at least one IE being required.

q_5597.question: What should the network do when it has not received any uplink data in a fixed uplink allocation and timer T3229 has expired?
q_5597.ground_truth: The network can release the TBF (Temporary Block Flow) and reuse the TFI (Temporary Flow Identity) resource.

q_5598.question: What is an Equivalent PLMN list (EHPLMN list) in the context of TS 23.122?
q_5598.ground_truth: The EHPLMN list is a list stored on the USIM that contains PLMN codes, including the HPLMN code derived from the IMSI, for PLMN selection purposes. If the HPLMN code derived from the IMSI is not present in the EHPLMN list, it is treated as a Visited PLMN for PLMN selection purposes.

q_5599.question: What should the UE do when the cell re-selection criteria are met for the cell on a different frequency?
q_5599.ground_truth: The UE reselects the new cell.

q_5600.question: What action should the V-PCRF indicate to the H-PCRF when receiving an indication of an IP-CAN Session Termination from the PCEF and the last S9 subsession for the roaming user is removed?
q_5600.ground_truth: The V-PCRF should indicate to the H-PCRF that the S9 session needs to be terminated.

q_5601.question: What should be the maximum power for intermodulation components, measured in 100 kHz bandwidth, as defined in ITU-R Recommendation SM.329?
q_5601.ground_truth: The intermodulation products shall never exceed -16 dBm, measured in 100 kHz bandwidth, as defined in ITU-R Recommendation SM.329, sub-clause 4.3 and Annex 7.

q_5602.question: What is the limit for BER for each measured carrier in the test?
q_5602.ground_truth: The BER should not exceed 0.001 for each measured carrier in the test.

q_5603.question: What is the purpose of codec homing in a speech encoder and decoder?
q_5603.ground_truth: Codec homing is used to reset the speech encoder or decoder state variables to their initial values. It is implemented in the test sequences as homing frames at the start of the test sequence.

q_5604.question: What is the purpose of RAN-assisted codec adaptation feature in Rel-14?
q_5604.ground_truth: The RAN-assisted codec adaptation feature was developed in Rel-14 to address the limitations of ECN-based solutions for rate adaptation, which are difficult to guarantee that intermediate routers in the core network and along the transmission path would not drop ECN-marked packets, and the lack of explicit indication of supported rate during congestion. The RAN-assisted codec adaptation provides an explicit indication of the uplink and downlink rate supported.

q_5605.question: What are the scaling factors used for in the process of quantizing and de-quantizing a signal in the described 3rd SVQ?
q_5605.ground_truth: The scaling factors are used to minimize computational complexity in the 3rd SVQ. They are used to divide the input signal before quantization and to obtain the quantized signal of the 3rd SVQ by multiplying the quantized output with the scaling factor.

q_5606.question: What is the purpose of the GAA server showing a dialog window to the user when an application attempts to gain access to GAA functionality?
q_5606.ground_truth: The purpose of the dialog window is to allow the user to grant or deny access to the GAA credentials for a specific NAF, and remember the decision for the next time the same application requests the same NAF specific GAA credentials.

q_5607.question: What kind of traffic is CBS and what is its communication direction?
q_5607.ground_truth: CBS traffic is asymmetric in nature, and communication flow is only from the CBC to the UE.

q_5608.question: What information elements are available for normal UE assisted testing?
q_5608.ground_truth: The available information elements for normal UE assisted testing include GPS Reference Time, GANSS Reference Time, GANSS Time Model (for multi-GNSS tests), GANSS Reference UE Position, GPS Navigation Model, GANSS Navigation Model, GANSS Acquisition Assistance, GANSS Auxiliary Information, GPS Acquisition Assistance, GANSS Reference Measurement Information, GPS UTC Model, and GPS Almanac.

q_5609.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the present document?
q_5609.ground_truth: The 3GPP is the organization that produced the present document, which contains technical specifications for supporting location service operation on the mobile radio interface layer 3 between the LMU and SMLC.

q_5610.question: What should the GGSNs update their PDP context fields with when they receive an Update PDP Context Request from a new SGSN?
q_5610.ground_truth: The GGSNs update their PDP context fields with new TEID, Prohibit Payload Compression, APN Restriction, MS Info Change Reporting Action, CSG Information Reporting Action, BCM, and Negotiated Evolved ARP.

q_5611.question: What action does the IMS-AGW take upon completion of the TCP connection establishment?
q_5611.ground_truth: The IMS-AGW starts the establishment of the TLS session and verifies the received fingerprint.

q_5612.question: What action does the HLR/HSS take when it receives a message from any domain indicating that the UE is available again, and it has recorded the MWD with a failure reason that the message failed to be sent by IP-SM-GW due to the UE not being available?
q_5612.ground_truth: The HLR/HSS initiates an Alert service centre procedure to request the SMS-SC to re-send the stored message.

q_5613.question: Which 3GPP TS document outlines the procedures for handling mobile calls in the imcnSSF?

q_5614.question: What does the term "interception" mean in this specification?
q_5614.ground_truth: In this specification, "interception" is the action (based on the law) performed by a network operator / access provider / service provider of making available certain information and providing that information to a law enforcement monitoring facility.

q_5615.question: What is the purpose of the "NF Registration" service in a 5GC aligned SNPN architecture?
