q_5615.ground_truth: The "NF Registration" service is used to register the NF profile(s) of the NF instance(s) deployed in the SP NW with the NRF in SNPN, on behalf of the NF service provider.

q_5616.question: What entity determines the ASC in case of an RRC REQUEST message?
q_5616.ground_truth: The RRC will determine the ASC in case of an RRC REQUEST message.

q_5617.question: What action should a UE take if it receives a USSD operation while already processing another USSD transaction in IMS?
q_5617.ground_truth: The UE should inform the network that it is unable to process the USSD request and set the <error-code> element to "USSD-busy".

q_5618.question: What is the general framework for high-high band combinations in this process?
q_5618.ground_truth: The general framework for high-high band combinations is used for determining relaxation values for certain band combinations.

q_5619.question: What can be used as an identifier to correlate a target's various SIP messages in a communication session?
q_5619.ground_truth: LIID (Local Identification Industry Dealing) or an implementation dependent number (such as Call-id) can be used to correlate a target's various SIP messages in a communication session.

q_5620.question: What is the formula used for calculating the entropy of a spectral line in the envelope scaling section?
q_5620.ground_truth: The formula used for calculating the entropy of a spectral line is, which is an approximation of the entropy formula that assumes the sign of the spectral line is encoded even if it is quantized to zero.

q_5621.question: What is the purpose of the ProtocolIE-Single-Container in the Extension-InformationExchangeObjectType-InfEx-Rqst information element?
q_5621.ground_truth: The ProtocolIE-Single-Container in the Extension-InformationExchangeObjectType-InfEx-Rqst information element is used to define a single protocol information element container for the extension information exchange object type request.

q_5622.question: What does the tBSS do if the GCR correlation has identified the call as an intra BSS call and LCLS is allowed in the BSS?
q_5622.ground_truth: The tBSS returns the ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message with the LCLS-BSS-Status IE indicating "Call not yet locally switched".

q_5623.question: What action does the gprsSSF take when there are no 'Waiting-for-AC' markers remaining in the GPRS_SSF process?
q_5623.ground_truth: The gprsSSF stops the TC guard timer.

q_5624.question: What is the egress TT for synchronizing TSN end stations behind other UE(s) with the TSN GM in the network attached to the device side via 5G System?
q_5624.ground_truth: The egress TT is DS-TT of the other UE.

q_5625.question: Which entities receive the Survival Time in the Survival Time for Deterministic Applications solution?
q_5625.ground_truth: SMF (Session Management Function) and NG-RAN (Next Generation Radio Access Network) receive the Survival Time when it is provided with the TSCAI (TS Control Channel Augmentation Information).

q_5626.question: What should the Node B do in a 1.28Mcps TDD system if the TSTD Indicator IE is included in PDSCH To Add Information LCR IE and is set to "active"?
q_5626.ground_truth: The Node B shall activate TSTD diversity for PDSCH transmissions using the specified PDSCH Set that are not beacon channels if the TSTD Indicator IE is set to "active". If the TSTD Indicator IE is set to "not active" or not included, the Node B shall not activate TSTD diversity for the PDSCH Set.

q_5627.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a PDN CONNECTIVITY ACCEPT message with the NBIFOM container IE set to "Accepted" in the context of a PDN connection with NBIFOM support over untrusted WLAN?
q_5627.ground_truth: The UE should consider that NBIFOM applies to the PDN connection and consider the received NBIFOM mode parameter as the selected NBIFOM mode.

q_5628.question: What are the impacts of Solution #16 on UPF?
q_5628.ground_truth: Solution #16 enforces UL/DL bitrate quota across all GBR and Non-GBR QoS Flows of the PDU Sessions with the S-NSSAI at the UPF. The UPF ensures that the traffics of GBR QoS Flows do not exceed the sum of GFBR value of the respective QoS Flows and shapes the traffic of non-GBR QoS Flows and/or drops packets exceeding the GFBR from GBR QoS Flows with MFBR > GFBR.

q_5629.question: What is the purpose of the control part of the MBMS-APIs?
q_5629.ground_truth: The control part of the MBMS-APIs is used for service discovery, registration, notifications, state changes, and other control messages between the MAA and the MBMS client.

q_5630.question: In the context of 5G networks, what is the difference between primary and secondary authentication?
q_5630.ground_truth: Primary authentication is used for mutual authentication between the UE and the network, while secondary authentication is used for a DN to authenticate and/or authorize a UE to access the DN with EAP framework based authentication between the UE and the DN-AAA server in the DN. The ARPF is only involved in primary authentication, not secondary authentication.

q_5631.question: What is the step where the UE responds with a NAS message Authentication Failure if synchronization failure occurs in USIM?
q_5631.ground_truth: The UE responds with a NAS message Authentication Failure with a CAUSE value indicating the reason for failure if synchronization failure occurs in USIM.

q_5632.question: Under what condition should the MAC entity consider a set of Random Access resources with NSAG indication as not available for the Random Access procedure?
q_5632.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the set of Random Access resources as not available for the Random Access procedure unless it is triggered for the corresponding NSAG indication.

q_5633.question: What is the role of CA (Certificate Authority) in PWS (Public Warning System) security?
q_5633.ground_truth: A CA (Certificate Authority) is responsible for certifying the authenticity of public keys used to verify signed warning messages in PWS security.

q_5634.question: What is the consequence of receiving an IE/IE group marked with "Reject IE" in SABP?
q_5634.ground_truth: If the receiver does not comprehend the IE/IE group marked with "Reject IE", the procedure is rejected, and the receiver initiates the Error Indication procedure.

q_5635.question: What is the purpose of the Survival Time parameter in TSC AI?
q_5635.ground_truth: The Survival Time parameter in TSC AI refers to the time that an application consuming a communication service may continue without an anticipated message.

q_5636.question: What does the MSC-A server use to requests MGW-A to set the Handover Device to initial state when the MSC-A server receives the MAP Prepare Subsequent Handover request containing a Relocation Request message?

q_5637.question: In the scenario where the source RAN supports MBS but the target RAN does not, what information is included in the N2 SM message sent from the SMF to the target RAN?
q_5637.ground_truth: The N2 SM message includes unicast PDU Session information, which also includes the QoS flows of the unicast PDU session associated with the MBS session.

q_5638.question: What bitmap graphics decoders should be supported by an MBMS client?
q_5638.ground_truth: The following bitmap graphics decoders should be supported by an MBMS client: GIF87a, GIF89a, and PNG.

q_5639.question: What is the Service-Specific-Data AVP used for in the 3GPP charging system?
q_5639.ground_truth: The Service-Specific-Data AVP is used to hold the value of the Service-Specific-Data. It is of type UTF8String.

q_5640.question: In subclause 11.1, how many pilot signals does the UE transmit for uplink MIMO?
q_5640.ground_truth: The UE transmits two orthogonal pilot signals on DPCCH and S-DPCCH.

q_5641.question: What happens during an Inter-RNS URA Update without SRNS relocation?
q_5641.ground_truth: The target RNC allocates new C-RNTI and D-RNTI for the UE, the UE is not registered in the target RNC, so the target RNC allocates new C-RNTI and D-RNTI for the UE, and the URA Update Confirm is forwarded from the target RNC to the UE via CCCH with new RNTIs.

q_5642.question: What is the default frame size and FCS in the SS RLP codec for handling RLP frames exchanges in SS?
q_5642.ground_truth: The default frame size in the SS RLP codec is 576 bits and the FCS value is calculated and inserted in the FCS fields in each DL RLP frames. The FCS values in the UL frames are irrelevant in the TTCN.

q_5643.question: What action is taken when the elements in V(N) fall outside the receive window in a TBF?
q_5643.ground_truth: In a TBF, an element in V(N) that falls outside the receive window is set to the value INVALID.

q_5644.question: What message type is sent by the ng-eNB-CU to request the ng-eNB-DU to page UEs?

q_5645.question: What does QoS stand for in the context of telecommunications?

q_5646.question: What parameter in BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION REQUEST message gives the information about the LCS capabilities of the target MS?
q_5646.ground_truth: The LCS Capability parameter provides information about the LCS capabilities of the target MS in the BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION REQUEST message.

q_5647.question: What is network personalisation in the context of 3GPP technical specification?
q_5647.ground_truth: Network personalisation is a feature that allows a Mobile Equipment (ME) to be personalised to a particular network, preventing the use of stolen MEs on other networks.

q_5648.question: How many GSM Neighbour Cells can the GSM Neighbour Cell list contain at most?
q_5648.ground_truth: The GSM Neighbour Cell list may contain up to 96 GSM Neighbour Cells.

q_5649.question: What is the purpose of the Cell Identity in NTN and how is it used for handover messages?
q_5649.ground_truth: The Cell Identity in NTN is a fixed geographical area identified by a Mapped Cell ID. It is used to identify the correct target cell in handover messages. For a BL UE or a UE in enhanced coverage, the Cell Identity included within the target identification of the handover messages allows identifying the correct target cell.

q_5650.question: What action does the SMS-SC take after receiving a "Device Trigger Request" in the IEC operation model for Device Triggering?
q_5650.ground_truth: The SMS-SC triggers a Debit Units Request message to the OCS after receiving a "Device Trigger Request" in the IEC operation model for Device Triggering.

q_5651.question: What is the impact of handover on the control procedures and the operation of the service in the 3GPP system?
q_5651.ground_truth: Handover will have no impact on the control procedures and the operation of the service.

q_5652.question: What should be indicated to the user about the SNPN that does not support emergency calls while the MS is in limited service state and the registration request for emergency services is rejected by the network?
q_5652.ground_truth: The MS should indicate to the user that a different SNPN is available and it will automatically select the SNPN in this case.

q_5653.question: When must a mobile station perform an abnormal release with access retry?
q_5653.ground_truth: A mobile station must perform an abnormal release with access retry when it receives an assignment message with frequency parameters for the carrier supporting the dedicated resources and it is in dual transfer mode or MAC-DTM state.

q_5654.question: What happens in step 5, if no response is received in time to the session invitation?
q_5654.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW will consider the session rejected and send an appropriate response to the session invitation.

q_5655.question: What is the potential of using the 3GPP EVS codec for FOA-based VR audio services?
q_5655.ground_truth: The 3GPP EVS codec can be used to encode super-wideband FOA B-format representations with good to excellent quality for conversational and streaming use cases. It shows the potential of using the 3GPP EVS codec for FOA-based VR audio services.

q_5656.question: Which 3GPP technical specification document defines the Iuh interface for the IuhSignLinkTp IOC and EP-Iuh IOC?

q_5657.question: What action is taken by the MRFP during the SCTP association establishment phase to prevent later usage for a closure procedure?
q_5657.ground_truth: The MRFP denies during the SCTP association establishment phase the negotiation of SCTP extensions (such as the SCTP stream reset capability) in order to prevent their later usage for a closure procedure.

q_5658.question: What is the maximum number of CP-DATA message retransmissions allowed in the Wait for CP-ACK state, if the timer TC1* expires and message is not acknowledged?
q_5658.ground_truth: The maximum number of CP-DATA message retransmissions allowed is 1, 2 or 3.

q_5659.question: What is the purpose of the document with respect to 3GPP TR 21.905?
q_5659.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to gather background information and studies to address the requirements for 2 bands DL/2 band UL Inter-band Carrier Aggregation for Rel-16 band combinations in 3GPP TR 21.905.

q_5660.question: What is the maximum length of the transparent container for backward compatibility when sending the Source to Target Transparent Container IE or the Target to Source Transparent Container IE?

q_5661.question: What are the number of bits used for WB TBE LSF quantization at 9.6 kbps and at 13.2 kbps, respectively?
q_5661.ground_truth: A single stage vector quantizer that utilizes 2 bits and 8 bits for LSF quantization, respectively, at 9.6 kbps and at 13.2 kbps.

q_5662.question: What type of equipment is considered as "telecommunication port"?
q_5662.ground_truth: Ports which are intended to be connected to telecommunication networks (e.g. public switched telecommunication networks, integrated services digital networks), local area networks (e.g. Ethernet, Token Ring) and similar networks are considered as telecommunication ports.

q_5663.question: What should the application do after invoking the fileListAvailable() notification with the given parameters?
q_5663.ground_truth: The application may then ask the client on the status of the file list using the getFdDownloadStateList() method defined in clause 6.2.3.16.

q_5664.question: What is the pre-condition for an Application Client on a UE to request an MSGin5G client to send a message to a group?
q_5664.ground_truth: The MSGin5G client must have registered with the MSGin5G server and information for selecting the group to send the message must be available at the Application Client.

q_5665.question: What does RRC-StateIndicator stand for in the RRCConnectionSetup-IEs sequence?
q_5665.ground_truth: It is used to indicate the RRC state of the UE into which the DRB will be setup.

q_5666.question: In the context of 3GPP specifications, what does the "3rd digit" indicate in the version number x.y.z?
q_5666.ground_truth: The "3rd digit" is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document, indicating minor modifications or revisions.

q_5667.question: What is the effect of a wet road on the noise spectrum above 1 kHz in the context of the present document?
q_5667.ground_truth: If the road is wet, above 1 kHz, the level increases relative to the dry road condition, and increases with the frequency.

q_5668.question: In subclause 4.2.7.2.1.4, when does the UE behavior remain unspecified?
q_5668.ground_truth: The UE behavior is unspecified when there is more than one transport channel with the maximum TTI and more than one of those transport channels having no transport blocks multiplexed into a CCTrCH.

q_5669.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 15.3.1.4.2?
q_5669.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for a single positioning frequency layer in FR1 SA.

q_5670.question: What is the role of the SMF in 5G networks?
q_5670.ground_truth: The SMF processes the session setup request based on the per-slice information and reports the per-slice session status information to the NRF.

q_5671.question: What is the status code that the Control Sink sends to the Control Source if a partial modification update cannot be fulfilled?
q_5671.ground_truth: The Control Sink sends a 403 message to the Control Source if the partial modification update cannot be fulfilled.

q_5672.question: What the UE shall do if one or more preferred frequencies apply for the applicable services?
q_5672.ground_truth: The UE shall acquire the MBMS GENERAL INFORMATION message and perform the MBMS frequency selection procedure as specified in subclause 8.5.27.

q_5673.question: What is the term used to describe the setting of Quality of Service (QoS) for uplink traffic over a fixed broadband access network as specified in 3GPP TS 23.139?

q_5674.question: What should a UE do when receiving a message in RRC Connection Management Procedures?
q_5674.ground_truth: The UE should check that the message is addressed to it, apply integrity check, handle errors, act upon the IE "RRC transaction identifier", and continue with the procedure as specified in the relevant subclause.

q_5675.question: What is the minimum UE category that supports HS-PDSCH and E-DPDCH in the described combinations?

q_5676.question: What is the purpose of the COMPACT synchronization channel (CSCH) in a radio sub-system?
q_5676.ground_truth: The CSCH contains two encoded parameters: Base transceiver station identity code (BSIC) and Reduced TDMA frame number (RFN) for synchronization purposes.

q_5677.question: When must the PCEF derive the NBIFOM routing rules transferred via the Gx interface?
q_5677.ground_truth: The PCEF derives the NBIFOM routing rules transferred via the Gx interface based on the NBIFOM routing rules or IP flow mapping carried via the GTP signalling.

q_5678.question: What is the role of an in-band modem solution in the eCall transmission, as examined in 3GPP TR 22.967?
q_5678.ground_truth: The in-band modem solution is the preferred option for transmitting emergency call data from a vehicle to a PSAP, as identified in 3GPP TR 22.967.

q_5679.question: What is the role of the USS UAS NF in the 3GPP system?
q_5679.ground_truth: An UAS Network function implementing the functionality of the UFES is used to support 3GPP Assisted CAA-Level UAV ID Assignment.

q_5680.question: What is the difference between the ESTABLISHED and ACTIVE states of an MBS Distribution Session?
q_5680.ground_truth: In the ESTABLISHED state, the MBSF reserves resources for the MBS Distribution Session in the MBS System, the MBS Distribution Session is established in the MBSTF, and the MBSF attempts to establish a data ingest session with the upstream data source. In the ACTIVE state, the MBSF informs the MBSTF to commence sending data packets to MBS Clients, which can start receiving data packets.

q_5681.question: What is the initial condition required for testing the ME's text attribute support?
q_5681.ground_truth: The ME is connected to the USIM Simulator, and the TA-TE interface is set to 8-bit operation.

q_5682.question: What is the signal measured result expressed in for UE assisted A-GNSS in the RRC UE POSITIONING GANSS MEASURED RESULTS IE and/or the RRC UE POSITIONING GPS MEASURED RESULTS IE?
q_5682.ground_truth: The measured results are expressed in UE GANSS Code Phase measurements and/or the UE GPS Code Phase measurements.

q_5683.question: What should a mobile station do upon receiving a CHANNEL REQUEST message during the packet access procedure if timer T3204 expires before an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message granting a single block period on an assigned packet uplink resource is received?
q_5683.ground_truth: The packet access procedure is aborted.

q_5684.question: What is the structure of the GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item in the provided ASN.1 definition?
q_5684.ground_truth: The GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item is a SEQUENCE that consists of rAB-ID, cause, gERAN-Classmark, and iE-Extensions.

q_5685.question: What is the action taken by the SMR entity when the RP-SMMA message is not acknowledged by the receiving entity?
q_5685.ground_truth: If the RP-SMMA message is not acknowledged by the receiving entity, the SMR entity in the MS will retransmit the message if the RETRANS flag is not set, or terminate the transmission and reset the RETRANS flag if the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached.

q_5686.question: What is the role of IP Layer in the Xn-C signalling bearer in the NG-RAN?
q_5686.ground_truth: The IP Layer in the Xn-C signalling bearer supports point-to-point transmission for delivering XnAP messages, and supports IPv6 and/or IPv4 for the NG-RAN node. The NG-RAN node supports Diffserv Code Point marking for QoS and traffic management purposes.

q_5687.question: What should a mobile station supporting network sharing do when the SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 22 message is sent in the cell?
q_5687.ground_truth: The mobile station shall read it in an attempt to acquire network sharing information.

q_5688.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a PHYSICAL INFORMATION message?
q_5688.ground_truth: The mobile station stops timer T3124, stops sending access bursts, activates the physical channels in sending and receiving mode, and connects the channels if need be.

q_5689.question: What is the name of the interface used for communications between the XDMS and the UE (PoC Client)?

q_5690.question: What event does the DCCF indicate when it discovers some other NWDAF instance(s) collecting the requested data?
q_5690.ground_truth: The DCCF responds to the requesting NWDAF with a message that indicates the ID or address of the distributed NWDAF.

q_5691.question: What is the subject of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification in Release 17?
q_5691.ground_truth: The technical specification outlines the standards for implementing Layer 1 on the X2 interface in the Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN).

q_5692.question: What should the UE do if the Reflective QoS Indication is not received from the 3GPP AAA?
q_5692.ground_truth: The UE shall not enable the UE reflective QoS function if the received Reflective QoS Indication indicates that the UE reflective QoS function is disabled or the Reflective QoS Indication is not received from the 3GPP AAA.

q_5693.question: How does the system information on the broadcast channel identify a PLMN?
q_5693.ground_truth: The system information on the broadcast channel can identify a PLMN by either a 'PLMN identity' (GSM-MAP) or a 'SID' (System Identification), or both.

q_5694.question: What is the relation between the number of bits in a transport block and the number of bits in the CRC calculation?
q_5694.ground_truth: If the size of a transport block is Ai, and the number of parity bits is Li, then the number of bits after CRC attachment is Bi = Ai + Li.

q_5695.question: What is the purpose of the "3GPP-specified MooD header field" in the MooD redirect response?
q_5695.ground_truth: The MooD header field triggers the activation of the MBMS receiver in the UE, indicating an MCBC (MBMS Consumed By Content) to the BM-SC, and providing entry point information to the USD.

q_5696.question: What should be the behavior of the network when deregistering or deactivating active UEs?
q_5696.ground_truth: Deregistration or deactivation of active UEs should not always require the involvement of the UE affected by the setting. However, the network should only process deactivation and deregistration requests from UEs belonging to the same PN. A UE performing activations should have the capability to perform the deactivations for these settings.

q_5697.question: Which of the following best represents a subframe in this AMR-WB+ codec discussion: 1.25 ms, 5 ms, or 40 ms?
q_5697.ground_truth: 5 milliseconds (ms) at a 12.8 kHz sampling rate.

q_5698.question: What does the "Preemption Capability indicator" bit mean in the VGCS/VBS Assignment procedure?
q_5698.ground_truth: If the "Preemption Capability indicator" bit is set to 1 in the VGCS/VBS Assignment procedure, then this allocation request can trigger the running of the preemption procedure and if set to 0, it cannot trigger the preemption procedure.

q_5699.question: What must the IWF identify in the SIP request to determine the served MCPTT group ID for MCPTT user eligibility?
q_5699.ground_truth: The served MCPTT group ID is identified in the `<mcptt-request-uri>` element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the SIP request.

q_5700.question: What is the reduction in battery life for eMTC/NB-IoT at 164 dB MCL and 144 dB MCL, respectively, for a UE using an integrated GNSS module and IoT module, as observed by Ericsson?
q_5700.ground_truth: The reduction in battery life for eMTC/NB-IoT at 164 dB MCL is up to around 6%, and at 144 dB MCL is up to around 17%, for a UE using an integrated GNSS module and IoT module, as observed by Ericsson.

q_5701.question: What message is sent by the UE when the Access Stratum indicates move-traffic-to-WLAN in multi-connection mode?
q_5701.ground_truth: The UE sends the WLCP PDN Modification Command message including a move-to-WLAN indication.

q_5702.question: What type of HTTP chunk is used to terminate the HTTP Request body in the FLUS system?
q_5702.ground_truth: A zero-size HTTP chunk is used to terminate the HTTP Request body in the FLUS system.

q_5703.question: What is the task of designers of specific managed object classes in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_5703.ground_truth: The task of designers of specific managed object classes in the 3GPP Technical Specification is to model the state conditions of the associated network resources using the generic attributes provided in the State Management Data Definition IRP.

q_5704.question: What modulation is used for each HS-PDSCH in the test models?

q_5705.question: What is the intention behind the introduction of new per-band capability signaling for FR1 UEs supporting transparent TxD in Rel-16?
q_5705.ground_truth: The intention is to enable release independent support of this new capability from Rel-15 for PC2, if possible. RAN4 also respectfully asked RAN2 to define the corresponding signaling in Rel-16 and discuss release independence to Rel-15.

q_5706.question: What does the Radio Access Bearer Service provide in terms of data transport over the radio interface?
q_5706.ground_truth: The Radio Access Bearer Service provides confidential transport of signalling and user data between the Mobile Terminal (MT) and the CN Edge Node with the Quality of Service (QoS) adequate to the negotiated UMTS Bearer Service or with the default QoS for signalling.

q_5707.question: What action does the PGW-C take when initiating the bearer deactivation procedure based on IP-CAN modifications encountered by the PCRF?
q_5707.ground_truth: The PGW-C sends an Sx Session Modification Request to the existing PGW-U for deactivating the dedicated bearer for the UE.

q_5708.question: What is the name of the 3GPP specification, 20.907, that defines script and CSS and various APIs to support media synchronization, SVG animation, scene updates, etc., for use by web app-based interactive apps?

q_5709.question: What is the purpose of the "Inter-working CAT" feature in the CAT system?
q_5709.ground_truth: The purpose of "Inter-working CAT" is to ensure a consistent CAT experience for users, regardless of whether they or the other party are roaming.

q_5710.question: In which order should the UE include resultsSSB-Cell in the measResultNeighCells?
q_5710.ground_truth: The UE should include the resultsSSB-Cell in the measResultNeighCells in decreasing order of the sorting quantity, determined as specified in 5.5.5.3, i.e. the best cell is included first.

q_5711.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in the context of MBMS services and sessions?
q_5711.ground_truth: The BM-SC establishes MBMS User Services and supports the delivery of data through regular 3GPP unicast as well as MBMS multicast/broadcast bearers.

q_5712.question: What is the maximum allowed timing difference between any two TRXs in a BSS as per step f)?
q_5712.ground_truth: The maximum allowed timing difference between any two TRXs is 1/4 symbol, measured at the BSS antenna connector.

q_5713.question: What is the role of the PLMN and the PSTN in service interworking?
q_5713.ground_truth: Service interworking is required when the teleservices at the calling and called terminals are different. However, no service interworking, except for facsimile group 3, has been identified as a requirement of the PLMN system for PSTN/ISDN network-based services.

q_5714.question: What actions should be performed if the network initiates the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update?
q_5714.ground_truth: The UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state should initiate the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF.

q_5715.question: What should a UE do after finding a ProSe Application Code(s) that matches the Discovery Filters, if there are no corresponding ProSe Application ID(s) stored?
q_5715.ground_truth: The UE should re-establish a secure connection with the ProSe Function in HPLMN and send a Match Report message.

q_5716.question: When does a Change of Position (Session) service event get reported within a GPRS Session relationship?
q_5716.ground_truth: A Change of Position (Session) service event gets reported within a GPRS Session relationship when it is the first subsequent event to be reported for a PDP Context within a GPRS Session relationship and the PDP Context Establishment event for this PDP Context was not reported.

q_5717.question: What will the network entity do when it is to process a USSD request locally?
q_5717.ground_truth: The request will be handled by an appropriate application, which may include setting up or releasing signalling and/or speech channels, passing the request to another network entity, passing a different USSD request to another network entity, or requesting further information from the MS.

q_5718.question: What is the purpose of reporting the RSTD measurements for Cell 2 and Cell 3 in the DL-TDOA assistance data?
q_5718.ground_truth: The purpose is to compare the RSTD measurements of these cells with respect to the reference cell, Cell 1, within a specified time duration.

q_5719.question: What types of immediate assignment messages can be contained in a downlink Cell Change Order message?
q_5719.ground_truth: The two types of immediate assignment messages are IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message and IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT EXTENDED message.

q_5720.question: What is the purpose of the "Create Component" procedure in the Rp interface?
q_5720.ground_truth: The "Create Component" procedure is used by the application to add a new profile component in the contacted repository.

q_5721.question: In the static variables defined in the C-code, what is the purpose of the variable 'chLLRbuffer'?
q_5721.ground_truth: The variable 'chLLRbuffer' is a soft bit buffer of the turbo decoder used in the C-code.

q_5722.question: What message is used to confirm the arrival of the MS in the target cell during a handover from a GAN A/Gb mode cell?
q_5722.ground_truth: The MS confirms its arrival in the target cell by sending a message indicating that it has arrived in the target cell.

q_5723.question: How is the disparity of timed graphics handled when accompanying stereo video?
q_5723.ground_truth: The disparity of timed graphics is signalled when accompanying stereo video, in order for it to be displayed at an appropriate depth, avoiding any perceptual depth conflicts with the video. It is measured in the same units as the track dimensions, with positive values moving the timed graphics away from the viewer and negative values moving it towards the viewer.

q_5724.question: What is the function of the MAF027 authorization examination in the context of the Explicit Call Transfer (ECT) supplementary service?
q_5724.ground_truth: The MAF027 authorization examination is a function that determines the authorizations relating to the ECT service.

q_5725.question: What is the role of the common E-RNTI in the E-RNTI collision resolution phase?
q_5725.ground_truth: The common E-RNTI is used as a UE ID in the E-RUCCH and is provided to the Node B to identify the UE. The Node B sends an E-AGCH with the common E-RNTI within the common E-RNTI scheduling window when it receives a random access request from the common E-RNTI. The UE considers the collision resolution phase to be over when it receives an E-AGCH with its common E-RNTI in the common E-RNTI scheduling window.

q_5726.question: What should the SGSN do if it receives a paging request while the Mobility Management back-off timer is running and the MS's TIN indicates "GUTI"?
q_5726.ground_truth: The SGSN should detect that it is an intra-SGSN routeing area update, and no need to inform the GGSNs or the HLR about the new MS location.

q_5727.question: How does the network handle the request for different supplementary service procedures within a single message, and what ensures the correlation of supplementary service operations and their responses?
q_5727.ground_truth: The request for different supplementary service procedures within a single message is identified by the Invoke identifier present within the Facility information element itself. The correlation of supplementary service operations and their responses is facilitated by the combination of the transaction identifier of the messages containing the Facility information element and the Invoke identifier present within the Facility information element itself. This ensures proper tracking and response communication.

q_5728.question: What should the UE do when the T390 timer is running in the 5G System?
q_5728.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T390 for all access categories and perform the actions as specified in 5.3.14.4.

q_5729.question: What does the T3 parameter represent in the hopping sequence generation algorithm?
q_5729.ground_truth: The T3 parameter is a time parameter defined in the hopping sequence generation algorithm, and it is used in the calculation of M'. Along with T1 and T2, the value of T3 is used to calculate M, serving as an input in the creation of the hopping sequence.

q_5730.question: What are the implications of considering COMM = T as inconsistent with certain states and sub-states in the context of Group Call Control?
q_5730.ground_truth: COMM = T is inconsistent with states U0, U3, U4, and with sub-states U2nc and U2r of state U2. This means that the communication should not be established in those states or sub-states.

q_5731.question: What is one of the UL sharing scenarios for LTE-NR co-existence?
q_5731.ground_truth: Collocated LTE and NR base stations with network operating UL on frequency F1 where LTE UL and NR UL share UL subframes of LTE, and LTE DL on a paired frequency F3, NR DL transmission on frequency F2 (different than LTE DL frequency).

q_5732.question: What is the primary reason for requesting port number assignment from IANA?
q_5732.ground_truth: The primary reason for requesting port number assignment from IANA is that it provides a common agreement between all endpoints on the Internet as to the default meaning of a port number, which provides the endpoints with a default port number for a particular protocol.

q_5733.question: What does the first octet of the URCMP header represent?
q_5733.ground_truth: The first octet of the URCMP header represents the message version and should be set to decimal 1 ("001").

q_5734.question: What does the "MM.AttCombiIntraSgsnRaUpdate" measurement represent, and what are the conditions for its increment?
q_5734.ground_truth: The "MM.AttCombiIntraSgsnRaUpdate" measurement provides the number of successful combined RA/LA intra-SGSN Routing Area update procedures. It is incremented when the SGSN receives a "Routing Area Update REQUEST" message from an MS, indicating a combined RA/LA update procedure.

q_5735.question: When is the MBMS UE's termination procedure started immediately, regardless of the protection period?
q_5735.ground_truth: The MBMS UE's termination procedure is started immediately if it is triggered before the session end time or after the protection period end time.

q_5736.question: With respect to the 5GC segment of the PNI-NPN, what is the role of the Network Operator?
q_5736.ground_truth: The Network Operator is responsible for operating the 5GC segment whether it is wholly or partly deployed in Vertical's premises, and may utilize Network Slice as a Service (NSaaS) model or Network Slice as NOP Internals model.

q_5737.question: In what situation should an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body be included in a 3GPP MCPTT floor-request message?
q_5737.ground_truth: This MIME body should be included in the message if the user or participant with permission to send media is either an MCPTT client with location information available, or a participant homed in the IWF with location information available, and that information has either not been sent before or has changed since it was last sent.

q_5738.question: Where are the packets carrying the IOPS call release request transmitted in the described process?
q_5738.ground_truth: The packets carrying the IOPS call release request are transmitted from one MCPTT client to the IOPS MC connectivity function for distribution to the other MCPTT client.

q_5739.question: What should the USIM contain after step d) in the acceptance criteria?
q_5739.ground_truth: The USIM should contain one of the two indicated EFPLMN (Forbidden PLMNs) entries, with specific MCC MNC values.

q_5740.question: What is the method used to estimate Timing Advance (TA) values in the 9.6.2 procedure for the PS domain in A/Gb-mode?
q_5740.ground_truth: The 9.6.2 procedure uses three different methods to estimate TA values: the RLC data block method, the extended access burst method, and the access burst method.

q_5741.question: What is the minimum set of video resolutions and frame rates that the MCVideo service shall support for rendering of video information?
q_5741.ground_truth: The MCVideo service shall support video resolution at least from 320 x 240 at 10 frames per second up to and beyond 1280 x 720 at 30 frames per second.

q_5742.question: What carries information about the number of OFDM symbols used for transmission of PDCCHs in a subframe in 6.7?
q_5742.ground_truth: The physical control format indicator channel carries information about the number of OFDM symbols used for transmission of PDCCHs in a subframe in 6.7.

q_5743.question: What are the applicable bearer services (transport channels) in UTRAN for mapping streaming traffic class RAB?
q_5743.ground_truth: The applicable bearer services (transport channels) in UTRAN for mapping streaming traffic class RAB are DCH (Dedicated Channel) and DSCH (Downlink Shared Channel). DCH is an up- and downlink channel dedicated to one flow and can be used for fairly constant bitrate packet traffic, while DSCH downlink channel is particularly efficient for bursty Non Real Time packet traffic and is good for asymmetric services, where downlink is the main transmission direction.

q_5744.question: How many CRS-IM receiver types for CRS interference handling are considered in the evaluation?
q_5744.ground_truth: Two CRS-IM receiver types for CRS interference handling are considered.

q_5745.question: What is a solution set in the context of the 3GPP GERAN NRM IRP?
q_5745.ground_truth: A solution set is a specification that defines the communication protocol, data model, and information exchange mechanisms for the 3GPPTM GERAN NRM integration. It provides an interface for management of GERAN resources.

q_5746.question: What is the main idea of dynamic PUCCH repetition factor indication?
q_5746.ground_truth: The feature allows network to adjust PUCCH repetition factor in a flexible fashion based on channel conditions and traffic load. Network can use existing PRI in DCI to point to a PUCCH resource where the associated repetition factor will be applied to the PUCCH transmission.

q_5747.question: What is the difference between OpenID Provider driven identifier selection and a user entering their own Identifier in the OpenID field?
q_5747.ground_truth: OpenID Provider driven identifier selection allows a user to enter the URL of their OpenID Provider into an OpenID field, rather than their personal OpenID URL. This allows the web site (RP) to start the OpenID authentication flow and send the user over to the correct OpenID provider. While entering their own OpenID URL will simply authenticate the user with that specific URL.

q_5748.question: What is the difference between "Basic" and "Bilateral" in the context of Called Party Number transfer in the VPLMN or HPLMN?
q_5748.ground_truth: "Basic" refers to the transfer of the full Called Party Number received in VPLMN or HPLMN on its own in the AssistRequestInstructions operation CorrelationID parameter. "Bilateral" refers to the extraction of CorrelationID from Called Party Number in HPLMN or VPLMN and transferring it on its own in AssistRequestInstructions CorrelationID field to a gsmSCF in HPLMN.

q_5749.question: What is the role of the ProSe Key Management Function (PKMF) in the process of establishing a shared key KD between a Remote UE and a UE-to-network relay?
q_5749.ground_truth: The PKMF is responsible for authorizing the Remote UE to receive UE-to-network Relay service, generating a fresh PRUK ID, and generating the KD Freshness Parameter. It then sends the Remote UE Identity, KD, KD Freshness Parameter, and GPI (if used to calculate a fresh PRUK) to the UE-to-network relay.

q_5750.question: What is the role of the Short Message Relay Layer (SM-RL) in the SMS protocol?
q_5750.ground_truth: The SM-RL is a service provided to the Short Message Transfer Layer (SM-TL) that enables it to send and receive Transfer Protocol Data Units (TPDUs) to its peer entity and receive reports about earlier requests for TPDUs to be transferred.

q_5751.question: What are the possible subsequent service events that the CSE can activate when the PDP deactivation event occurs within a GPRS session relationship?
q_5751.ground_truth: The CSE can activate instructions for PDP deactivation, changes of position (PDP context and session), and detach procedure.

q_5752.question: In what situation will the UE take a non-current native 5G NAS security context into use and delete the mapped 5G NAS security context?
q_5752.ground_truth: When the security context flag included in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is set to "native security context", the ngKSI matches a valid non-current native 5G NAS security context held in the UE, and the UE has a mapped 5G NAS security context as the current 5G NAS security context.

q_5753.question: Which mobile station is required to build its 3G Neighbour Cell list from the information received in the PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message?
q_5753.ground_truth: A UTRAN capable mobile station supporting network sharing shall build its 3G Neighbour Cell list from the information received in the PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message.

q_5754.question: What should the MRFC do if the SRGS script is larger than the transport capability of the Mp interface in the ASR procedure?
q_5754.ground_truth: The MRFC should terminate the ASR procedure and return an error.

q_5755.question: What is the effect of the "On Modification" Report Characteristics IE when the SFN IE is provided?
q_5755.ground_truth: If the Report Characteristics IE is set to "On Modification" and the SFN IE is provided, the Node B shall initiate the Common Measurement Reporting procedure using the measurement value reported by the layer 3 filter at the specified SFN.

q_5756.question: What is the purpose of the Link Identifier Update procedure in the relay service code setup process?
q_5756.ground_truth: The purpose of the Link Identifier Update procedure is to change the L2 identifiers of the UEs involved in the PC5 unicast link regularly to mitigate privacy issues in key issue #16. This procedure helps to prevent tracing of the Remote UE during discovery and connection setup.

q_5757.question: What is the format of the UPPCH-LCR-Parameters-CTCH-ReconfRqstTDD sequence?
q_5757.ground_truth: The UPPCH-LCR-Parameters-CTCH-ReconfRqstTDD sequence is a SEQUENCE that consists of uPPCHPositionLCR, uARFCN, and iE-Extensions.

q_5758.question: What is the purpose of the Minimum Supported Bandwidth in the context of TS 26.114?
q_5758.ground_truth: The Minimum Supported Bandwidth is the lowest bandwidth that can be maintained for a session in TS 26.114. If this bandwidth cannot be maintained, the session may be terminated.

q_5759.question: What is the purpose of the "ipdc/realm" property in the IP Termination Identifier?
q_5759.ground_truth: The "ipdc/realm" property allows the IMS-ALG to choose the address space in which the IMS-AGW will allocate an IP address for the termination.

q_5760.question: What should the UE do when lower layers indicate an integrity check failure while T319 is running or SDT procedure is ongoing?

q_5761.question: What is the recommended format for IMS-AGW and IMS-ALG names?
q_5761.ground_truth: It is recommended that IMS-AGW and IMS-ALG names are in the form of fully qualified domain name, for example: "ALG1.whatever.net" or "mg1.whatever.net".

q_5762.question: What is the difference between the "third digit" versions of 3GPP TS specifications, and how do they change?
q_5762.ground_truth: The "third digit" of 3GPP TS specifications is used to reflect changes in the documents, with a higher number indicating an increased number of editorial and technical changes. Each time an editorial change is made, the third digit version number is incremented.

q_5763.question: When should the MME initiate a key change on the fly procedure for the entire EPS key hierarchy?
q_5763.ground_truth: The MME shall initiate a key change on the fly procedure for the entire EPS key hierarchy when the UE has cryptographically protected radio bearers established and the MME wants to activate a non-current native EPS security context.

q_5764.question: What are the postconditions for the gsmSRF when the "DisconnectFromIPForbidden" parameter is FALSE in the "Invoking entity (gsmSRF)" section?
q_5764.ground_truth: The gsmSRF initiates a bearer channel disconnect sequence to the gsmSSF using the applicable bearer channel signalling system after sending the "SpecializedResourceReport" operation to the gsmSCF and transits to the state "Idle".

q_5765.question: How does the PCRF determine the Gx session that corresponds to the Gateway Control session if multiple PDN connections for the same APN are supported?
q_5765.ground_truth: If the Framed-IP-Address AVP and/or Framed-Ipv6-Prefix AVP are received during the Gateway Control Session Establishment, the PCRF links the Gateway Control Session to the existing Gx session where Framed-IP-Address AVP and/or Framed-Ipv6-Prefix AVP are equal and the PDN ID are matched. If the Framed-IP-Address AVP and/or Framed-Ipv6-Prefix AVP are not received during the Gateway Control Session Establishment, the PCRF has to defer the linking with existing Gx session until an IP-CAN Session modification is received with matching UE Identity, PDN Connection ID, and PDN ID.

q_5766.question: What should the CN do if it receives the DIRECT TRANSFER message from the RNC without the SAPI IE?
q_5766.ground_truth: The CN shall continue with the Direct Transfer procedure.

q_5767.question: How is the input speech signal processed in the AMR-WB encoder before it undergoes LP analysis and quantization?
q_5767.ground_truth: The input speech signal is processed by decimating it from 16 kHz to 12.8 kHz, followed by high-pass filtering and pre-emphasizing (down-scaling) to enhance higher frequencies and reduce the possibility of overflows during fixed-point implementation.

q_5768.question: What information is required for the transfer of media from CS to PS direction for access transfers within 3GPP access networks as specified in TS 23.216?
q_5768.ground_truth: The required information includes the user being active or inactive in a CS originating or terminating speech session, procedures and capabilities specified in TS 23.216, and an active IMS registration prior to the transfer.

q_5769.question: What is the organization that produced the "3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) NG-RAN; E1 layer 1 (Release 17)" document?

q_5770.question: What is the purpose of the document "3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects; Enhancement for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles; Stage 1 (Release 17)"?
q_5770.ground_truth: The document provides use cases and analysis of UAV capabilities that may require enhanced 3GPP support, focusing on the use of low altitude UAVs in various commercial and government sectors.

q_5771.question: How is the transport-block size information for the second and the third transport blocks represented?
q_5771.ground_truth: The transport-block size information for the second and the third transport blocks is represented by xtbssb,1, xtbssb,2, ..., xtbssb,6 which are the unsigned binary representation of the transport block size index for the second transport block, where xtbssb,1 is the MSB.

q_5772.question: What is the requirement for AMR-WB mode compliance with DTX enabled and how does the decoder implementation ensure compliance with the test vectors given in Annex B?
q_5772.ground_truth: The AMR-WB modes of AMR-WB+ are required to behave bit-exactly to the FIP reference code, and the decoder implementation shall comply with the test vectors given in Annex B to ensure AMR-WB mode compliance with DTX enabled.

q_5773.question: What action should the SCF take if the SDP parameters are not successfully examined and the MBMS download service is not available to the UE?
q_5773.ground_truth: The SCF shall answer to the UE with a SIP 403 error message indicating that the UE is not authorized to join the multicast session.

q_5774.question: What is the main function of the punctuation processor in the Huffman coding algorithm?
q_5774.ground_truth: The punctuation processor removes leading and trailing spaces from the input stream, replaces repeated spaces within the stream with a single space, removes and inserts spaces following certain punctuation characters, decapitalizes and capitalizes the first character of the stream under certain conditions, and removes or inserts a full stop if it is the last character of the stream.

q_5775.question: What is the purpose of the test in subclause 7.5.3, for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
q_5775.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in subclause 7.5.3, for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option, is to stress the ability of the BS receiver to withstand high-level interference from unwanted signals at frequency offsets of 3.2 MHz or more, without undue degradation of its sensitivity.

q_5776.question: What is a ProSe Layer-2 Group ID used for in the context of Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
q_5776.ground_truth: A ProSe Layer-2 Group ID is used to address a set of users at the 3GPP lower layers for ProSe Direct Communication.

q_5777.question: What is the minimum number of radio terminals in an IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard?
q_5777.ground_truth: The minimum number of radio terminals in an IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard is 1.

q_5778.question: What is the purpose of the additional Secondary Cells field in the fourth sequence?
q_5778.ground_truth: This field indicates the capability of additional secondary cells for the UE while in E-UTRA FDD mode.

q_5779.question: What should the UE do if it is capable of MBMS Service Continuity and is receiving an MBMS service, but the reselected cell is not broadcasting SIB13?
q_5779.ground_truth: The UE cannot consider that frequency to be the highest priority.

q_5780.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of successful outgoing inter-frequency handovers when measurement gaps are not used?

q_5781.question: What is the priority of filter criteria in IMS?
q_5781.ground_truth: The priority of filter criteria determines the order in which the S-CSCF assesses and contacts the application servers when evaluating incoming SIP requests.

q_5782.question: What should be added in the "UE positioning reporting quantity" if a 3-dimensional position estimate is required with GPS TOD and GPS TOW information?
q_5782.ground_truth: The "GPS timing of Cell wanted" should be set to FALSE and the "GPS TOW msec" should be set to the GPS TOD when the position estimate was valid.

q_5783.question: Which 3GPP specification defines the Enhanced Power Control (EPC) concept used in E-UTRAN networks?

q_5784.question: What should the server include in the response if the first byte range is lost and the FDT Instance contains an 'mbms2015:IndependentUnitPositions' attribute with value "0 60000 80000 110000"?
q_5784.ground_truth: The server should include 3gpp-access-position in the response with the value of the position in the 'mbms2015:IndependentUnitPositions' attribute of the corresponding range.

q_5785.question: How does the UE ensure that the ProSe Key Management Function is aware of its correct IP address for PGK deliveries?
q_5785.ground_truth: If the UE detects that a PDN connection, which is used for receiving PGKs is released by the network, the UE should try to send a new Key Request to inform the ProSe Key Management Function of its new IP address. This ensures that the ProSe Key Management Function becomes aware of the new UE IP address for the purpose of performing PGK deliveries.

q_5786.question: Which parameter is used to indicate the combination index in the E-RGCH-Combination-Info sequence class?

q_5787.question: What is the lowest quality of service (QoS) traffic class in a GERAN?
q_5787.ground_truth: Best effort QoS is the lowest of all QoS traffic classes. If the guaranteed QoS cannot be delivered, the bearer network delivers the QoS which can also be called best effort QoS.

q_5788.question: What is the formula used for calculating the IP Latency in DL on E-RAB level?
q_5788.ground_truth: The IP Latency in DL on E-RAB level is calculated using the formula: LatTime/LatSample

q_5789.question: What is the indication flag in the CTS PAGING REQUEST message for initiating the alive check procedure?

q_5790.question: What are Public Safety ProSe-enabled UEs capable of when they have determined autonomously that a discovered ProSe-enabled UE is a public safety UE?
q_5790.ground_truth: Public Safety ProSe-enabled UEs shall be capable of establishing a secure ProSe E-UTRA Communication on a ProSe E-UTRA Communication path and exchange user traffic on public safety spectrum, assuming they are in Communication Range, are authenticated and authorized.

q_5791.question: How can the macro-eNB signal offsets to all HeNBs within its coverage area?
q_5791.ground_truth: By signalling over the backhaul to avoid uplink interference from UEs connected to HeNBs with the macro-eNB receiver.

q_5792.question: What entities can the Cancel operation be sent to, and for what purposes?
q_5792.ground_truth: The Cancel operation can be sent to the gsmSRF to cancel the "PlayAnnouncement" or "PromptAndCollectUserInformation" operation. It can also be sent to the gsmSSF to disarm all armed EDPs and cancel all pending reports, allowing the gsmSSF FSM to transit to the "Idle" state.

q_5793.question: What is the transport protocol used to open the channel in the first sequence?

q_5794.question: How does the UE determine the range of ESIs for requesting repair symbols?
q_5794.ground_truth: The UE uses one of the algorithms defined in clause 6.1.3 to determine a range of ESIs that will result in successful reception.

q_5795.question: What is the function of NWDAF after receiving the requested UE data from DC-AF?
q_5795.ground_truth: NWDAF can use the UE data for analytics requested by consumer NF after receiving it from DC-AF.

q_5796.question: What should the UE do when located in the geographical area and requested by a service to transmit a V2X packet after receiving V2XP over PC5 from SS and initiating a UE-requested V2X policy provisioning procedure?
q_5796.ground_truth: The UE should initiate a V2X communication on the frequency associated with the service.

q_5797.question: How many sets of 51 52-multiframes are there in the timeslot shifting sequence for a given set of parameters in the context of 3GPP TS 23.003?
q_5797.ground_truth: There are 8 sets of 51 52-multiframes in the timeslot shifting sequence for a given set of parameters in the context of 3GPP TS 23.003.

q_5798.question: What action does the UE take when it receives the "UE positioning GANSS reference UE position" IE in a setup message?
q_5798.ground_truth: The UE stores the information in "UE positioning GANSS reference UE position" and uses it as a priori knowledge of the approximate location of the UE.

q_5799.question: What is the purpose of the "Security Mode Command" in the EPS?
q_5799.ground_truth: The Security Mode Command is a message that the MME sends to the UE to establish the security mode and algorithms to be used for protecting the NAS messages.

q_5800.question: What is the role of the AUSF in the 5G authentication process?
q_5800.ground_truth: The AUSF is responsible for checking with the UDM within the SNPN for the authentication method to be executed for the UE and for running EAP-TTLS phase 1 towards the UE.

q_5801.question: What should the MGW do upon reception of the Stop DTMF procedure?
q_5801.ground_truth: The MGW shall ensure the minimum digit duration is kept and then terminate the digit transmission by sending RTP Telephony Event with "End-bit" set to YES.

q_5802.question: Which procedure allows the MS and GGSN to modify any TFT while in 'MS/NW' mode?

q_5803.question: What is the function of the ENUM response in the process of selecting the target PLMN based on MSISDN belonging to a different PLMN without NP?
q_5803.ground_truth: The ENUM response indicates to the local NRF that the MSISDN belongs to a different PLMN including a URI pointing to the NRF in the target PLMN.

q_5804.question: What is the format of the "payload" field in the "SystemInformation-BCH" sequence?
q_5804.ground_truth: The "payload" field in the "SystemInformation-BCH" sequence is a choice between 11 different cases, including "noSegment", "firstSegment", "subsequentSegment", "lastSegmentShort", "lastAndFirst", "lastAndComplete", "lastAndCompleteAndFirst", "lastAndComplete", "lastAndCompleteAndFirst", "completeSIB-List", "completeAndFirst", "completeSIB", "lastSegmentShort", "spare5", "spare4", "spare3", "spare2", and "spare1". Each case represents a different format for "payload".

q_5805.question: What is the purpose of the ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHigh node leaf in the context of UTRAN?
q_5805.ground_truth: The ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHigh node leaf acts as a placeholder for high threshold value of beacon RSSI thresholds provisioned by ANDSF and/or by RAN in the context of UTRAN. It is used to determine if a node is a match for traffic steering to WLAN.

q_5806.question: What type of burst is used for the CTSBCH-FB and CTSBCH-SB in the CTSBCH format?
q_5806.ground_truth: Frequency Correction Burst (FB) is used for the CTSBCH-FB, and Synchronisation Burst (SB) is used for the CTSBCH-SB.

q_5807.question: What is the purpose of the 'Frequency hopping flag' field in non-PUSCH hopping with resource allocation type 1?
q_5807.ground_truth: The 'Frequency hopping flag' field is a 1-bit indicator that triggers frequency hopping for resource allocation, as detailed in TS 38.214.

q_5808.question: What should the initiating UE do to form the new KNRP ID for a PC5 unicast link after a direct link release procedure?
q_5808.ground_truth: The initiating UE should form the new KNRP ID by combining the Most Significant Bits (MSB) of the KNRP ID included in the DIRECT LINK RELEASE REQUEST message and the Least Significant Bits (LSB) of the KNRP ID received in the DIRECT LINK RELEASE ACCEPT message.

q_5809.question: In what type of UTRAN mode is the success of outgoing inter-RNC hard handovers via Iur measured?

q_5810.question: What is the relationship between the Minimum Requirements and Test Requirements in the 3GPP specification?
q_5810.ground_truth: The Minimum Requirements in the 3GPP specification make no allowance for measurement uncertainty, while the Test Requirements are created by relaxing the Minimum Requirements using Test Tolerances defined in the specification. The test results are then compared against the Test Requirements.

q_5811.question: How is the number of neighbour cell measurement samples per SACCH period calculated in connected mode?
q_5811.ground_truth: The number of neighbour cell measurement samples per SACCH period in connected mode is calculated by dividing 100 by the number of neighbour cells (N) when 4 search frames are used for BSIC decoding and other measurement tasks.

q_5812.question: How does the network indicate to the UE that it has accepted the request to use eDRX?
q_5812.ground_truth: The network provides the Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE when accepting the registration procedure to indicate that the UE can use eDRX.

q_5813.question: What entities interact with the ProSe AS to get the authorization for restricted discovery in the ProSe Direct Discovery procedure?
q_5813.ground_truth: In the ProSe Direct Discovery procedure, the 5G DDNMF may interact with the ProSe AS to get the authorization for restricted discovery and retrieve the PDUID corresponding to the RPAUID before it generates the ProSe Discovery Code (ProSe Restricted Code for Model A and ProSe Query Code and ProSe Response Code for Model B) corresponding to PDUID.

q_5814.question: What action does the mobile station take when the user indicates that the hook flash generation should cease?
q_5814.ground_truth: The mobile station sends a STOP DTMF message to the fixed part

q_5815.question: What is the impact of the tracing variant in this solution?
q_5815.ground_truth: The EC related AF, acting as a MnS client, requests tracing from MnS producer for TCE. This variant does not require any interaction with SA~WG5 as Rel-16 SA~WG5 specifications are reused.

q_5816.question: Which SIP cause code is used when an IMS node receives/initiates a 4xx error response?
q_5816.ground_truth: The cause "4xx Request failure" is used when the SIP transaction is terminated due to an IMS node receiving/initiating a 4xx error response.

q_5817.question: What is the purpose of IoE (Internet of Everything) based social networking services in 5G systems?
q_5817.ground_truth: IoE based social networking aims to provide an enhanced user experience, enabling remote users to interact with local users in a real-time community virtual scene setup.

q_5818.question: What masking is applied to the CRC for HS-SCCH type 3 when two transport blocks are transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCHs?
q_5818.ground_truth: The sequence of bits c1, c2, ..., c16 is masked with the UE Identity xue,1, xue,2, ..., xue,16 and then appended to the sequence of bits x2,1, x2,2, ..., x2,20 to form the sequence of bits y3,1, y3,2, ..., y3,36, where xi = (ck-i-10) mod 2, i ranging from 1 to 36, when two transport blocks are transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCHs.

q_5819.question: What is a potential drawback of using over-the-air information, direct eNB to HeNB approach?
q_5819.ground_truth: The eNB may not always be visible from the HeNB, and broadcasting over the air would prevent sending different information to different groups of eNBs or HeNBs.

q_5820.question: What is the role of the AS (Any Service System) in the FA (Flexible Alerting) process, when a SIP INVITE request is forwarded to the "Pilot Identity"?
q_5820.ground_truth: The AS implementing FA maps the "Pilot Identity" to the list of FA group members (UE-B and UE-C) and forwards the SIP INVITE to all FA members.

q_5821.question: What should the IWF do with the Max-UE-Availaibility-Time AVP within Ready-For-SMArg when constructing a NOR command as a result of receiving a MAP-ReadyForSM message?
q_5821.ground_truth: The IWF should include the Max-UE-Availaibility-Time AVP within the NOR command when it is received within the Ready-For-SMArg, and populate it with the received value.

q_5822.question: What is the result of the expected sequence 1.6 and 1.7 in the second TERMINAL RESPONSE?
q_5822.ground_truth: In expected sequence 1.6, the ME (Mobile Equipment) is currently unable to process the command due to being busy on another call, and in 1.7, the Network is currently unable to process the command due to call hold not being allowed, causing the system simulator to reject the call.

q_5823.question: When is the "UE" required to consider a flow distribution rule as valid?
q_5823.ground_truth: The "UE" shall consider the corresponding flow distribution rule as valid only if all the present interior nodes within a single instance of "ANDSF/IARP/<X>/ForNonSeamlessOffload/<X>/RoutingCriteria/<X>" node indicate matching validity condition.

q_5824.question: Which of the FDD specific cause values indicate that certain types of MIMO and certain QAM operations are not supported or available?

q_5825.question: What should the RAN Access node do when it receives user data frames over the M1 UP interface and SC-PTM is used?
q_5825.ground_truth: The RAN Access node should provide other correctly received user data to the radio interface protocol entities.

q_5826.question: What is the purpose of the "policy query" procedure?
q_5826.ground_truth: The purpose is to query a policy instance.

q_5827.question: What is the architecture of L2 UE-to-UE Relay similar to?
q_5827.ground_truth: The architecture of L2 UE-to-UE Relay is similar to L2 UE-to-Network Relay, except that the termination points are two Remote UEs instead of a UE and a network.

q_5828.question: What does the term "proposal" indicate in the context of the 3GPP technical specification?
q_5828.ground_truth: The term "proposal" is not used in the 3GPP technical specification to indicate a normative requirement.

q_5829.question: What is the abbreviation for "Message Service over 5G System" in the context of the present document?

q_5830.question: What is the name of the new QoS parameter introduced in the 5GS system to limit the aggregate data rate per UE across all GBR and Non-GBR QoS Flows for all PDU sessions associated with an S-NSSAI for the UE?

q_5831.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving a 403 response from SCF during PSS session initialization?
q_5831.ground_truth: The UE may issue an SIP request to get the program allowed by his/her parents.

q_5832.question: When should the UE request an update of the rules for the HomeNetworkPreference?
q_5832.ground_truth: The UE is required to request an update of the rules for the HomeNetworkPreference if the value of the UpdatePolicy leaf is 1. This indicates that the UE is required to request an update of the rules for the HomeNetworkPreference. If the value of the UpdatePolicy leaf is 0, or if this leaf is not provisioned, the UE is not required to request an update of the rules for the HomeNetworkPreference.

q_5833.question: What are the three deployment scenarios considered in the analysis of HNB power control with respect to macro layer?
q_5833.ground_truth: The three deployment scenarios considered are: HNB and MNB operate in either co-channel or adjacent channel, HNB situated far away from the MNB (i.e. cell edge scenario), and HNB situated close to the MNB (i.e. cell site scenario).

q_5834.question: What is the objective of the EASDF instantiation, described in section 6.2.15?
q_5834.ground_truth: The goal is to enable the PLMN operator to instantiate one or more EASDF for supporting Edge Computing.

q_5835.question: How are the Enhanced Full Rate (EFR) and Full Rate (FR) codecs used in the AMR speech codec in a GSM system?
q_5835.ground_truth: The Enhanced Full Rate (EFR) and Full Rate (FR) codecs are used as the most robust codec modes in the AMR speech codec, ensuring maximum robustness to channel errors, and can be used to extend coverage in marginal signal conditions or to improve capacity by using a tighter frequency re-use.

q_5836.question: What are the two modes of operation for V2X communication?
q_5836.ground_truth: The two modes of operation for V2X communication are over the PC5 and LTE-Uu interfaces. LTE-Uu provides the conventional point-to-point or point-to-many transport services at high bit-rate or QoS, while PC5 is limited in reachable range but is generally better at localization of the communications, has shorter delays, and is less impacted by coverage issues.

q_5837.question: What happens when a PDP context is deactivated in 3G networks and a UE is re-establishing it?
q_5837.ground_truth: When the network deactivates the PDP context, the UE re-establishes a PDP context as long as a push user agent is active on the UE, as long as the deactivation cause allows it.

q_5838.question: What is a Realization of the "Live Video from multiple cameras angles into a stadium" use-case in the provisioning and ingestion procedure?
q_5838.ground_truth: The procedure describes the provisioning for a Live DASH service into a single broadcast area using a push interface as the ingestion method for the user-plane data. The source of the user plane data (CP Source) are the DASH Media Segments as produced by a Live Encoder / Segmenter. The Media Presentation Description (MPD) URL for the Live DASH session is provided to BM-SC during Session creation or on a subsequent update request.

q_5839.question: What is the purpose of the CTS detach procedure in the 5G system?
q_5839.ground_truth: The purpose of the CTS detach procedure is to detach a mobile station from a fixed part.

q_5840.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a message with a Procedure Code IE marked as "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" that it does not comprehend?
q_5840.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the content of the not comprehended IE, continue with the procedure using the understood IEs, and report in the response message that one or more IEs have been ignored.

q_5841.question: What is the role of the AMF in the N2 based shared to individual switch procedure?
q_5841.ground_truth: The AMF performs PDU Session resource update procedure for PDU Sessions and multicast session join procedure with the (MB-)SMF, (MB-)UPF, target gNB, and UE in the N2 based shared to individual switch procedure.

q_5842.question: What is the maximum allowed power for spurious emissions in the bands 460,4 - 467,6 MHz and 488,8 - 496,0 MHz?
q_5842.ground_truth: The maximum allowed power for spurious emissions in the bands 460,4 - 467,6 MHz and 488,8 - 496,0 MHz is -57 dBm.

q_5843.question: What is the format of the Request-URI in the SIP PUBLISH request when generating an affiliation request?
q_5843.ground_truth: The Request-URI in the SIP PUBLISH request is set to the public service identity of the controlling MCData function associated with the handled MCData group ID.

q_5844.question: What is a cross-polarized model used for in the context of antennas?
q_5844.ground_truth: A cross-polarized model is used to describe polarized antennas, particularly in handheld devices where the spacing between antennas is much less than half the wavelength. It represents the portion of each signal that leaks into the cross-polarized antenna orientation due to scattering.

q_5845.question: In what way is the use of E-PS address and Authentication Token in the Device Triggering procedure in step 8A and in step 9 not impactful to network entities and the UE?
q_5845.ground_truth: The use of E-PS address and Authentication Token in the Device Triggering procedure in step 8A and in step 9 is not impactful to network entities and the UE because it is limited to application container information.

q_5846.question: What are the key parameters assumed in the link-level simulation for the interfering cells?
q_5846.ground_truth: The key parameters assumed for interference cells in the link-level simulation include a 4 CRS ports synchronous network with 15 kHz SCS, and interference modelling using probabilities of occurrence and power as specified in TR 36.863.

q_5847.question: What is the role of NWDAF in providing analytics to consumer NFs?
q_5847.ground_truth: NWDAF is responsible for providing analytics to consumer NFs such as PCF. It provides information on services in use, time and location of the UE, and estimates the application in use.

q_5848.question: What happens if the content of the buffer increases due to the ARQ techniques of the RLP?
q_5848.ground_truth: If the buffer size inside the FA is more than 256 kbytes, the facsimile coded data being received from the T-FAX is transcoded and written into the buffer, with FILL information stripped off. When data is read out from the buffer, an FA protocol element is generated and processed.

q_5849.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of a SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and a PDU session ID?
q_5849.ground_truth: The UE passes the service-level-AA payload received in the Service-level-AA container IE of the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message to the upper layers, and the service-level authentication and authorization procedure initiated by the DN is transparent to the 5GSM layer of the UE.

q_5850.question: What is the purpose of the "paging cause field with only one codepoint voice" introduced in the NR/LTE Uu paging message, S1AP/NGAP paging message, and XNAP/F1AP paging message?
q_5850.ground_truth: To indicate to the MUSIM UE whether an incoming paging is for voice service.

q_5851.question: What security mechanism is used to protect the transfer of encrypted long-term keys in this solution?
q_5851.ground_truth: The security mechanisms defined in 3GPP TS~33.501~, clause 13.1 are used to protect the transfer of encrypted long-term keys in this solution.

q_5852.question: What is the limit for the GSM co-existence requirements with other GSM bands for frequencies below 1 GHz?
q_5852.ground_truth: The limit for the GSM co-existence requirements with other GSM bands for frequencies below 1 GHz is -57 dBm/100 kHz.

q_5853.question: What is the primary goal of introducing the autonomous network level for radio network coverage optimization?
q_5853.ground_truth: The primary goal of introducing the autonomous network level for radio network coverage optimization is to help the operator achieve the full autonomy goal step by step and address typical issues using autonomy mechanisms.

q_5854.question: What is the initial procedure a MS goes through when connecting to a Provisioning GANC-SEGW and GANC in the home network of the MS?
q_5854.ground_truth: The MS first connects to the Provisioning GANC-SEGW and GANC by establishing a secure IPsec tunnel and a TCP connection using the provisioned or derived addresses. The MS then obtains the FQDN or IP address of the Default GANC and its associated SEGW through the Discovery procedure.

q_5855.question: When should the UE know which default UE credentials are applied for protection?
q_5855.ground_truth: The UE may know which default UE credentials are applied for protection optionally via SNPN identity or default UE credential identity. This is necessary when a UE is requested to onboard multiple SNPNs that are managed by different parties.

q_5856.question: What action should the Node B take if it receives an unknown TFI combination while building the TFCI value for the S-CCPCH in the UTRAN Iub interface user plane protocols?
q_5856.ground_truth: In case the Node B receives an unknown TFI combination, it shall apply DTX, i.e. suspend transmission on the corresponding S-CCPCH - except if this S-CCPCH provides the "beacon function", in which case the Node B shall maintain the physical layer transmission as specified in TS.

q_5857.question: What is the abbreviation for Algebraic Code Excited Linear Prediction in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification?

q_5858.question: When is the PDN GW initiated resource releasing procedure performed in this specification?
q_5858.ground_truth: The PDN GW initiated resource releasing procedure is performed in this specification due to IP-CAN session modification requests from the PCRF or due to handover from Fixed Broadband Access network to 3GPP.

q_5859.question: What is the term for the 3GPP system feature that allows any entity to address the correct USS for retrieval of UAV information?
q_5859.ground_truth: The CAA-Level UAV ID (Civil Aviation Administration-Level UAV ID) is the term for this feature.

q_5860.question: What action does the NWDAF take when it determines that UE quota-C1 is reached?
q_5860.ground_truth: The NWDAF notifies the CHF about the event that quota-C1 is reached.

q_5861.question: What is the name of the write-replace message component in SABP that contains a list of protocol data units with their corresponding updated values, and is used to replace the data of a specific service in a controlled manner?

q_5862.question: What would trigger the IWF performing the controlling role to release the MCPTT session for a pre-arranged group call?
q_5862.ground_truth: The IWF performing the controlling role would release the MCPTT session for a pre-arranged group call if the T4 (Inactivity) timer expires and there is at least one MCPTT user in the call, or if less than the minimum number of affiliated group members is present, among other conditions.

q_5863.question: What is the purpose of the document "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network; W1 interface; Layer 1 (Release 17)"?
q_5863.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to specify the standards for implementing Layer 1 on the W1 interface in 3GPP's 5G network.

q_5864.question: What should the Common PLMN ID be communicated to the GGSN when the SGSN and GGSN pertain to the same PLMN and support UEs?
q_5864.ground_truth: The Common PLMN ID should be communicated in SAI/CGI.

q_5865.question: Under what conditions should a UE consider the current frequency to be the lowest priority frequency when in camped normally state?
q_5865.ground_truth: If the UE has received absolute priority information for inter-frequency layers and has only dedicated priorities other than for the current frequency, the UE shall consider the current frequency to be the lowest priority frequency.

q_5866.question: What does the IWU act as in the context of BICC or ISUP compatibility procedures?
q_5866.ground_truth: The IWU shall act as a Type~A or Type B exchange for the purposes of ISUP and BICC compatibility procedures in the present specification.

q_5867.question: What is the goal of the 6.2.4.10 Synchronization Information Test?
q_5867.ground_truth: The aim of the Synchronization Information Test is to ensure that the RTCP sender information sent from the SUT and corresponding RTP for two or more streams sent simultaneously from the SUT can be used for RTP receiver-side synchronization.

q_5868.question: What action should the GGSN take if it detects a change in the 3GPP PS Data Off UE Status?
