q_5868.ground_truth: The GGSN should indicate this event to the charging system for both offline and online charging.

q_5869.question: In the three different sets of modulation and coding schemes compared, what is the name of the scheme that combines 16QAM modulation with turbo coding?

q_5870.question: What algorithm is used for hopping logical channels in GSM-CTS?
q_5870.ground_truth: The TFH algorithm (Total Frequency Hopping) is used for hopping logical channels in GSM-CTS.

q_5871.question: Which protocol should be used for high speed and low latency to support 7.68 Mcps TDD?
q_5871.ground_truth: For high speed and low latency to support 7.68 Mcps TDD, the PCCPCH-768 protocol should be used, as indicated in the PCCPCH-768:Information-Cell-SetupRqstTDD NBAP-PROTOCOL-IEs.

q_5872.question: What is a DRNC in the context of UTRAN UE positioning?
q_5872.ground_truth: A DRNC is a UTRAN element that has an active link to the UE that shall be located and also provides CRNC functionality regarding UE Positioning for its associated Node Bs and LMUs.

q_5873.question: What happens if the INTER SYSTEM TO UTRAN HANDOVER COMMAND message refers to a not known cell in the handover to UTRAN procedure?
q_5873.ground_truth: This shall not be considered as an error.

q_5874.question: What is required for a UE to register for MSGin5G service?
q_5874.ground_truth: A UE must follow the registration procedures outlined in clause 6.2 of the MSGin5G solution and include an Application Profile in the registration request to use MSGin5G service.

q_5875.question: What is the maximum output power of the switchplexer in the GSM850 band?
q_5875.ground_truth: The maximum output power of the switchplexer in the GSM850 band is 27.3 dBm.

q_5876.question: What should a mobile station in EGPRS TBF mode not supporting the "Modulation based multislot class support" use for the EGPRS multislot class?
q_5876.ground_truth: A mobile station in EGPRS TBF mode not supporting the "Modulation based multislot class support" should apply the GPRS multislot class.

q_5877.question: What is the purpose of the Parameters Enhancing Delivery (PED) messages in the SAND reference architecture?
q_5877.ground_truth: The purpose of Parameters Enhancing Delivery (PED) messages in the SAND reference architecture is to be exchanged between DASH-aware network elements (DANEs) to improve efficiency of streaming sessions by providing information about real-time operational characteristics of networks, servers, proxies, caches, CDNs, and DASH client's performance and status.

q_5878.question: What is the requirement for the adjacent channel protection of the optimized pulse shape in the frequency domain?
q_5878.ground_truth: The adjacent channel protection of the optimized pulse shape (including transmission impairments) shall be 50 dB at the 400 kHz offset and 58 dB at the 600 kHz offset.

q_5879.question: What are the pre-conditions for setting the number of simultaneous talkers in a voice communication?
q_5879.ground_truth: An active communication application capable to use the multi user talker control is required for setting the number of simultaneous talkers in a voice communication.

q_5880.question: What is the charging method used for a single PCC rule with non-IP data traffic?
q_5880.ground_truth: The charging method can be online, offline, both, or neither for a single PCC rule with non-IP data traffic.

q_5881.question: What happens if the block is not received correctly after Transmission 2?
q_5881.ground_truth: If the block is not received correctly after Transmission 2, Transmission 3 will be sent using another redundancy version of the bits.

q_5882.question: What indication is given to the UE to initiate an outgoing TCP connection to the HTTP Server?
q_5882.ground_truth: The "a=setup" attribute is present and set to "active" in the SDP offer to indicate that the UE will initiate an outgoing TCP connection to the HTTP Server.

q_5883.question: Under what conditions will a user be informed that CCNR is possible at user C?
q_5883.ground_truth: If user B has activated CFU and the forwarded communication results in a communication completion on no reply condition at user C, user A will be informed that CCNR is possible at user C.

q_5884.question: What are the responsibilities of radio resource management functions?
q_5884.ground_truth: Radio resource management functions are concerned with the allocation and maintenance of radio communication paths and are performed by the Radio Access Network.

q_5885.question: What would be the impact of using a more aggressive spectral shape filter on the PAPR performance and Bler performance for all channel models and RBs?
q_5885.ground_truth: The PAPR would be smaller, but the Bler performance would be worse for all channel models (e.g., TDL-A, TDL-C, TDL-D) and RBs (2RB and 8RB).

q_5886.question: What is the role of the SAS Indicator IE in the Connect procedure and Direct Transfer procedure, in the PCAP User Adaption (PUA)?
q_5886.ground_truth: The SAS Indicator IE included in the Connect procedure is used by the Home Node B (HNB) to allow the Home Node B Gateway (HNB-GW) to use it to select a SAS for connection. Similarly, in the Direct transfer procedure, the SAS Indicator IE is used by the Home Node B (HNB) to allow the HNB-GW to use it to select a SAS as the destination of the message.

q_5887.question: What is the purpose of the Notification Distribution Service in the managed system?
q_5887.ground_truth: The Notification Distribution Service in the managed system provides notification controlling and forwarding functions as per ITU-T Recommendation X.734.

q_5888.question: What is the purpose of the CTS MS AUTHENTICATION REQUEST and CTS MS AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE messages?
q_5888.ground_truth: These messages are used in the mutual authentication process between the CTS and MS.

q_5889.question: What is the EFS file used for in H.265/HEVC anchors?
q_5889.ground_truth: The files with '*.bis' suffix are used for bitrate computation.

q_5890.question: What should the "Current TGPS Status Flag" for a pattern sequence be set to when beginning inter-frequency measurement reporting for an active set of transmission gap pattern sequences?
q_5890.ground_truth: The "Current TGPS Status Flag" for a pattern sequence should be set to "active" when beginning inter-frequency measurement reporting for an active set of transmission gap pattern sequences.

q_5891.question: What is the purpose of the "end marker" packets that the UPF sends on the old path to the source gNB per PDU session/tunnel during a 5GC switch?
q_5891.ground_truth: The "end marker" packets indicate the release of any uplink/TNL resources towards the source gNB after the UPF sends them.

q_5892.question: What is the purpose of the E-DCH RL Set ID IE in the context of FDD?
q_5892.ground_truth: The E-DCH RL Set ID IE identifies E-DCH RLs that have or can have a common generation of E-RGCH information, allowing the SRNC to optimize E-DCH scheduling decisions.

q_5893.question: When downlink resource allocation of type 1 consists of a downlink type 1 resource allocation field, what size is the resource indication value (RIV) in the downlink type 1 resource allocation field?
q_5893.ground_truth: The resource indication value (RIV) is of size 2 or 3.

q_5894.question: What is the requirement for the initial convergence time of the noise suppression function tested as an integral part of the AMR speech codec?
q_5894.ground_truth: The initial convergence time shall be a maximum of 2 seconds.

q_5895.question: What is the main factor affecting the standard deviation when measuring the DUT in a reverberation chamber?
q_5895.ground_truth: The main factor affecting the standard deviation when measuring the DUT in a reverberation chamber is the number of different positions in which the DUT is measured and the average of the values that is then calculated. A typical standard deviation less than 0.5 dB can be achieved with 800 MHz frequency in a 1.2m~x~1.75m x 1.8m sized chamber in continuous mode stirring.

q_5896.question: When should an MS search for synchronization information after receiving a handover command towards a GSM cell to which it is not synchronized?
q_5896.ground_truth: The MS should search for synchronization information up to 300 ms.

q_5897.question: What message is transmitted to the MS to indicate the successful completion of a PDP context activation, and under what condition is this message transmitted?
q_5897.ground_truth: The ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message is transmitted to the MS to indicate the successful completion of a PDP context activation. This message is transmitted when the PDP address has been dynamically assigned.

q_5898.question: What does the Primary-CPICH-Usage-For-Channel-Estimation stand for in the ID-EXTENSION of CPC-InformationLCR?
q_5898.ground_truth: Primary-CPICH-Usage-For-Channel-Estimation indicates the usage of the primary CPICH for channel estimation in 1.28Mcps TDD.

q_5899.question: Which logical channels are mapped onto the radio blocks for Compact PDCH in EGPRS?
q_5899.ground_truth: In EGPRS, the mapping of channels onto multiframes for Compact PDCH is controlled by several parameters broadcast on PBCCH. A Compact 52-multiframe consists of 12 blocks of 4 consecutive frames, 2 idle frames, and 2 frames used for PTCCH. The ordered list of blocks defines the mapping of CPBCCH onto the radio blocks on the primary and secondary Compact carriers.

q_5900.question: How does the BM-SC manage YouTube video file delivery?
q_5900.ground_truth: In case of push-based ingestion, an HTTP(s) URL based resource location, identifying the BM-SC and associated directory structure for content ingestion, is provided to the CP server. The BM-SC is expected to be informed of the actual sizes, and if not possible, at least the minimum and maximum size of the video files to be provided by the CP via either pull- or push-based ingestion mode.

q_5901.question: What is a potential security issue when an external tool/application accesses the MnS of the 3GPP system without proper access control?
q_5901.ground_truth: An attacker could utilize a fraudulent tool to perform attacks, such as man-in-the-middle or DDoS, causing availability and confidentiality compromising.

q_5902.question: What information is reported by MS (Mobile station) to BTS (Base station transceiver subsystem) in SACCH blocks regarding uplink and downlink measurements?
q_5902.ground_truth: MS reports the downlink received level and quality from the serving cell and the received level from surrounding cells. The results from these measurements are reported by MS in Measurement Report messages on SACCH. Uplink received level and quality are measured by BTS/TRX.

q_5903.question: Which AVP holds the duration in seconds of the received talk bursts?
q_5903.ground_truth: The Received-Talk-Burst-Time AVP holds the duration in seconds of the received talk bursts.

q_5904.question: What is the purpose of defining an "Interception Area" in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_5904.ground_truth: The Interception Area (IA) is a subset of the network service area comprised of a set of cells that defines a geographical zone for lawful interception.

q_5905.question: What does the "Mandatory" qualifier indicate in the Interface IRP SS template?
q_5905.ground_truth: The "Mandatory" qualifier in the Interface IRP SS template indicates that a specific feature or capability is required to be supported by a particular technology in the 3GPP system.

q_5906.question: What is the role of SII2 (Service Interaction Indicators Two parameter) in the implementation of MSP Phase 2 in 3GPP?
q_5906.ground_truth: SII2 is one of the CAMEL Phase 3 features used for MSP Phase 2 in 3GPP, which enables the interaction between MSP and other supplementary services.

q_5907.question: What is the purpose of the FDD inter-frequency RSTD Measurement Reporting Delay test in CE Mode A for Category M1?
q_5907.ground_truth: The purpose of the FDD inter-frequency RSTD Measurement Reporting Delay test in CE Mode A for Category M1 is to verify that the RSTD measurement reporting delay for UE Category M1 meets the performance requirements in normal coverage mode in an environment with fading propagation conditions.

q_5908.question: What is the function of the NRF in the broadcast session activation procedure for Broadcast with no MBSF?
q_5908.ground_truth: The NRF returns a search result with the AMF instances, and the MB-SMF performs AMF selection based on the NRF results.

q_5909.question: What is the procedure followed for adding a trusted WLAN access in single-connection mode to an existing PDN connection?
q_5909.ground_truth: The procedure involves the UE performing the Initial Attach process with added steps for single-connection mode, negotiating single-connection mode, indicating handover, the same APN and including an NBIFOM indication in the PCO during EAP authentication. The TWAN then selects the same PDN GW as already allocated for the PDN connection and sends a Create Session Request, indicating NBIFOM capability.

q_5910.question: What should the MAC entity do if more than one set of Random Access resources is identified, based on the highest priority feature applicable to the current Random Access procedure?
q_5910.ground_truth: The MAC entity should repeat the procedure taking as input the identified sets of Random Access resources and the feature applicable to the current Random Access procedure with the highest priority assigned.

q_5911.question: What is the purpose of the "CPCNack" information element in the UE-Measurement-Forwarding message?
q_5911.ground_truth: The "CPCNack" information element in the UE-Measurement-Forwarding message is used to indicate whether a CPC (CRNTI-to-PhysicalCellID) mapping is available at the RRC layer.

q_5912.question: What will the IP-SM-GW send to the SMS user as a result of a Chat Session SIP INVITE request, if the operator policy mandates the SMS user to be informed of the invitation?
q_5912.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW will send a SMS-SUBMIT containing operator defined data that conveys information to the SMS user about the Chat Session invitation and instructions on how to accept, reject and leave the session.

q_5913.question: How does E-TFC selection work for different frequencies when the UE has more than one Activated Uplink Frequency in FDD?
q_5913.ground_truth: If E-TFC selection is invoked on only one frequency, the E-TFC selection behavior is performed as if only one uplink frequency is activated.

q_5914.question: Which message type and direction is the ENHANCED MEASUREMENT REPORT with respect to mobile stations, and what does it contain?
q_5914.ground_truth: The message type is ENHANCED MEASUREMENT REPORT, and the direction is from mobile station to network. It contains measurement results concerning signal strength on specified carriers.

q_5915.question: In what scenarios should the IBCF not perform the through-connect control of early media?
q_5915.ground_truth: The IBCF may decide not to perform the through-connect control of early media if the P-Early-Media header field includes the "gated" parameter and the IBCF does not decide to perform the through-connection control.

q_5916.question: What is the definition of an Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP's telecommunications management?
q_5916.ground_truth: An IRP is a logical interface that specifies the information flow between two functional entities responsible for telecommunications management.

q_5917.question: What is the prerequisite for implementing the solution in the Edge Data Network?
q_5917.ground_truth: Both the User Equipment (UE) and the Edge Computing Server (ECS) must support secondary authentication.

q_5918.question: What is the enhancement made to the Rel-16 PMF function in Solution 3 of the present TR?
q_5918.ground_truth: The Rel-16 PMF function is enhanced to support the RTT measurement per QoS flow, and measurement of the loss ratio and jitter per QoS flow in Solution 3 of the present TR.

q_5919.question: What is one of the functional requirements related to management regarding different types of managed devices in the 3GPP system?
q_5919.ground_truth: One of the functional requirements is having the capability to provide a single point of access allowing IRPManager to manage HNBs, HeNBs, and other types of managed entities such as macro eNBs.

q_5920.question: What values can the PSI or SI index parameter have within a consistent set of system information messages?
q_5920.ground_truth: The PSI or SI index parameter shall have a range from zero to N-1

q_5921.question: What is the expected mode for the sequence 1.3 command 1.3.1 in the PROACTIVE COMMAND?

q_5922.question: Which information does the ME read as part of the SUCI calculation procedure?
q_5922.ground_truth: The ME reads the SUPI, Home Network Public Key, Home Network Public Key Identifier, and the list of Protection Scheme Identifiers from the USIM.

q_5923.question: In the "UEMeasurementInitiationRequest-IEs" sequence, what is the criticality of the "id-MeasurementID" field?

q_5924.question: What is the media feature tag that should be included in the Accept-Contact header field for an Interworking Security Data message?

q_5925.question: What is the main function of the mediation function in the Iuant interface protocol structure?
q_5925.ground_truth: The mediation function provides a protocol that uses the implementation specific O&M bearer on one side and the Iuant protocol on the other, allowing the two different interfaces to communicate with each other.

q_5926.question: What is the scope of the BEST service?
q_5926.ground_truth: The BEST service provides security using battery efficient key agreement and secure transport services for low throughput data on battery constrained devices.

q_5927.question: What is the specification notations for procedures, messages, and control/data frames in the present document?
q_5927.ground_truth: A procedure is referred to as "Procedure Name" in upper case characters followed by the word "procedure". A message is referred to as "MESSAGE NAME" in all upper case characters followed by the word "message". A control/data frame is referred to as "CONTROL/DATA FRAME NAME" in all upper case characters followed by the words "control/data frame".

q_5928.question: What is the rule for mapping the bits to a PhCH with an odd number?
q_5928.ground_truth: The bits are mapped to a PhCH with an odd number in forward order.

q_5929.question: Which two procedures are assigned the same "successful outcome" message?

q_5930.question: What is the expected response time for the test as defined in 9.5.2.5?
q_5930.ground_truth: The expected response time is 12 seconds.

q_5931.question: What is a key feature of an AIPN mobility solution?
q_5931.ground_truth: An AIPN mobility solution must support UTRAN and GERAN based systems as possible access systems besides supporting alternative existing accesses such as WLAN and other emerging new technologies.

q_5932.question: What message is sent by the SMLC to the BSS to initiate U-TDOA location determination on the Lb interface?
q_5932.ground_truth: The SMLC sends a BSSMAP-LE Connection Oriented Information message to the BSS that contains the embedded BSSLAP U-TDOA Request message.

q_5933.question: What is the format of the CellAdjustmentInfoItemIE-SyncAdjustmntRqstTDD sequence?
q_5933.ground_truth: The CellAdjustmentInfoItemIE-SyncAdjustmntRqstTDD sequence is a sequence containing fields such as c-ID, frameAdjustmentValue, timingAdjustmentValue, and iE-Extensions.

q_5934.question: What should the DRNC do with the Traffic Class IE if the TrCH Source Statistics Descriptor IE is present with the value ``RRC'' in the HS-DSCH MAC-d Flows Information IE?
q_5934.ground_truth: The DRNC should ignore the Traffic Class IE in this case.

q_5935.question: Which system entities are impacted by Solution #38?
q_5935.ground_truth: PCF and UE are impacted by Solution #38. PCF gains the ability to identify ProSe Connection Capabilities and related Route Selection Descriptor in URSP rule. UE gains the ability to identify the Route Selection Descriptor for 5G ProSe Layer 3 UE-to-Network Relay PDU Session establishment.

q_5936.question: What is the location procedure that finishes first between the RAU (Routing Area Update) and LAU (Location Area Update) when the mobile station crosses both LA and RA boundaries and performs the RAU procedure before the LAU procedure?

q_5937.question: What is the NFDAF role in detecting rogue devices in the network?
q_5937.ground_truth: The NWDAF can identify rouge devices by detecting signalling storms, which can help rectify any excessive signalling issues in the network.

q_5938.question: What state(s) should the MS be in for the GANC not to send the GA-RC REGISTER REJECT message?

q_5939.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_5939.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_5940.question: What is used to deliver mobile terminated short messages?

q_5941.question: What should the UE not consider as candidate cells for cell reselection if it is exclude-listed?
q_5941.ground_truth: The UE should not consider any exclude-listed cells as candidate for cell reselection.

q_5942.question: Which 3GPP network elements are required to have the capability to temporarily stop QoE measurement reporting at RAN overload?
q_5942.ground_truth: The RAN, with the exception of UTRAN and E-UTRAN, shall have the capability to temporarily stop QoE measurement reporting at RAN overload.

q_5943.question: When can the target BSS choose to terminate the PS Handover Request procedure and send a PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST-NACK PDU?
q_5943.ground_truth: The target BSS can terminate the PS Handover Request procedure if a BSS Context could not be allocated for the MS, none of the PFCs in the PFCs To Be Set-up List IE of the PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST PDU could be granted the requested QoS, or no uplink TBF could be allocated for the MS in the BVCI.

q_5944.question: How many bearers are cumulated to the counter when the "Failed number of PDN-GW initiated Dedicated Bearer Modification without QoS update" is received by the PDN-GW in EPS packet switching, for each cause?
q_5944.ground_truth: Each bearer that is part of the "Update Bearer Response" message with the same EPS Bearer ID, when the "Cause" IE identifies a failed bearer handling with "Rejection Response" from the "Cause" IE, is cumulated to the counter.

q_5945.question: What type of service is supported by the 5G system in high-speed scenarios via the ProSe Communication path (direct)?
q_5945.ground_truth: Interactive services like VR and interactive conversations.

q_5946.question: What is the role of the SMF in determining whether multicast service data is transferred via the MBS session or PDU sessions?
q_5946.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for making the decision on whether multicast service data is transferred via the MBS session or PDU sessions.

q_5947.question: What is the requirement specified in 11.2.2 for the power increase in the pass band at the output of the repeater?
q_5947.ground_truth: The power in the pass band should not increase with more than 10 dB at the output of the repeater as measured in the centre of the pass band, compared to the level obtained without interfering signals applied.

q_5948.question: What message is sent if there is a change in the channel allocation during group call re-establishment by the BSS without A-interface link sharing?
q_5948.ground_truth: The "VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT STATUS message" is sent if there is a change in the channel allocation during group call re-establishment by the BSS without A-interface link sharing.

q_5949.question: What is the purpose of importing OPERATION and other identifiers from various modules?
q_5949.ground_truth: Importing the OPERATION and other identifiers from different modules allows for their usage and definition in the current module, ensuring consistency and standardization in the language used to describe various operations and their associated parameters.

q_5950.question: What information does the PDN GW inform the PCRF about when dynamic PCC applies and NBIFOM is supported?
q_5950.ground_truth: The PDN GW informs the PCRF about the UE and network support of NBIFOM capability, about the requested NBIFOM mode, and about the IP-CAN type and RAT type when dynamic PCC applies and NBIFOM is supported.

q_5951.question: What is the pre-test condition for test case 8.1.6.3.3.2.3?
q_5951.ground_truth: The pre-test condition for test case 8.1.6.3.3.2.3 includes NR Cell 1, NR Cell 2, WLAN AP 1 (Cell 27), and WLAN AP 2 (Cell 27b).

q_5952.question: What is the historical character T6 for the ANSWER TO RESET command in the initial conditions?

q_5953.question: What conditions necessitate the use of the GPRS suspension procedure in 3GPP networks?
q_5953.ground_truth: The GPRS suspension procedure is used in 3GPP networks when a mobile station in Class A mode of operation is handed over to a cell where the support of Class A mode of operation is not possible, or when a GPRS attached mobile station is in a cell that does not support DTM and a circuit switched service is initiated.

q_5954.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS Session Stop procedure?
q_5954.ground_truth: The purpose of the MBMS Session Stop procedure is to request the UTRAN to notify UEs about the end of a given MBMS Session and to release the corresponding MBMS RAB and MBMS Iu signalling connection for this MBMS Session.

q_5955.question: How are the special test functions in the MS activated and deactivated?
q_5955.ground_truth: The functions described in the present document can be activated and deactivated from a SS by sending appropriate layer 3 commands to the MS on the DCCH using SAPI 0 in acknowledged mode.

q_5956.question: What should the AMF include in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message when sending a single uplink 5GSM message which was not forwarded because the UE is registered to a PLMN via a satellite NG-RAN cell that is not allowed to operate at the present UE location?
q_5956.ground_truth: The AMF should include the PDU session ID in the PDU session ID IE, set the Payload container type IE to "N1 SM information", set the Payload container IE to the 5GSM message which was not forwarded, and set the 5GMM cause IE to the 5GMM cause #78 "PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location".

q_5957.question: What step follows after the AMF sends a DL NAS TRANSPORT message to the UE during the Control Plane UE Provisioning Procedures?
q_5957.ground_truth: The UE receives the DL NAS TRANSPORT message and verifies the Update Data's integrity and source.

q_5958.question: What is the structure of the Cells-Failed-to-be-Activated-List element in the 3GPP protocol?
q_5958.ground_truth: The Cells-Failed-to-be-Activated-List is a sequence (size 1.. maxCellinngeNBDU) of Cells-Failed-to-be-Activated-List-Item.

q_5959.question: What does the Cell Identification Discriminator in bits 1 to 4 of octet 4 of a CBS message indicate?
q_5959.ground_truth: The Cell Identification Discriminator indicates if the whole or a part of the Cell Global Identification is used for cell identification of the cells in the list.

q_5960.question: What is the purpose of AF triggered EAS migration in 5GC?
q_5960.ground_truth: AF triggered EAS migration in 5GC is used to move some UE(s) from the source EAS to the target EAS for load balancing purposes or to move all UEs being served by the source EAS to a target EAS for abnormal conditions. The AF influence content information that needs to be included in the AF triggered EAS migration includes a list of UE IP addresses and port numbers, source EAS IP address for the impacted DNAI, and target EAS IP address for the impacted DNAI.

q_5961.question: What is the format of the PLMN leaf in the one-to-one ProSe direct communication authorisation policy?
q_5961.ground_truth: The PLMN leaf is of format "chr" (character) and indicates the PLMN code of the operator in which the UE is authorized to use one-to-one ProSe direct communication.

q_5962.question: What action should the MME employ if the current location service attempt is permanently impeded?
q_5962.ground_truth: The MME should abort the current location service attempt and the associated signalling dialogue with the E-SMLC.

q_5963.question: What protocol is used to transfer data between the SGSN and the HLR in the Gr-interface?
q_5963.ground_truth: The Mobile Application Part (MAP), which in turn uses the services of Transaction Capabilities (TCAP), is used to transfer data between the SGSN and the HLR in the Gr-interface.

q_5964.question: What is the purpose of system selection or PLMN selection in a multi system terminal?
q_5964.ground_truth: The purpose of system selection or PLMN selection in a multi system terminal is to ensure 3GPP compliance and protection of 3GPP networks in cases where operators operate more than one system, either through choice or company merger/acquisition.

q_5965.question: What is the purpose of step 6 of the solution provided by Solution #6?
q_5965.ground_truth: In step 6 of the solution provided by Solution #6, the AAnF generates the KMBS and sends it to MBSF/MSF-C, while the MBSTF computes the MAC-I using KMBS and checks if it is the same with the received MAC-I from UE to authenticate and authorize the UE.

q_5966.question: What information is used as a password in the Digest calculation at step 5 in the procedures of solution 6.24.2.2.1?
q_5966.ground_truth: K~AF is used as the password in the Digest calculation.

q_5967.question: What should the RCAF send to the MME to request the list of IMSIs and APNs for multiple eNodeBs or E-UTRAN Cell Ids?
q_5967.ground_truth: The RCAF should send an NqAP-IMSI-APN-INFORMATION-REQUEST message with multiple instances of the RAN Entity Identifier IE.

q_5968.question: What is the difference between line-of-sight (LOS) and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) situations in the RF spatial fading emulator?
q_5968.ground_truth: LOS situations are when there is a direct, unobstructed path between the antenna and the DUT, while NLOS situations are when there are obstacles or reflections that cause a more complex radio propagation environment.

q_5969.question: What is the purpose of Solution#5 in 3GPP networks?
q_5969.ground_truth: Solution#5 in 3GPP networks is beneficial for clients that utilize SCTP as it allows for multiple SCTP applications to be multiplexed over the same assigned SCTP port using the SCTP Payload Protocol Identifier.

q_5970.question: What are the services offered by the Access Stratum of the GERAN architecture to the Non-Access Stratum?
q_5970.ground_truth: The Access Stratum of the GERAN architecture offers services to the Non-Access Stratum through the following Service Access Points (SAP): General Control (GC) SAPs, Notification (Nt) SAPs, and Dedicated Control (DC) SAPs.

q_5971.question: What is the appropriate signalling protocol for the eP-CSCF when it uses Gm towards the WIC?
q_5971.ground_truth: The appropriate signalling protocol for the eP-CSCF when it uses Gm towards the WIC is defined in 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_5972.question: What are the procedures for Information Provisioning to a 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay?
q_5972.ground_truth: The Registration procedures, UE Policy Association Establishment procedure, and UE Policy Association Modification procedure of TS~23.502 apply with additions to authorize UE as a 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay, and to determine and provide 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay Information to the UE.

q_5973.question: What is the function of the DF2 delivery function in the PTC architecture?
q_5973.ground_truth: The DF2 delivery function is used to convert the information on the X2-interface to the corresponding information on the HI2 interface and to distribute the intercept-related information to the relevant LEAs. It is also responsible for extracting intercepted SIP signalling information related to encryption and sending a request to the KMS to derive the encryption keys.

q_5974.question: What is the purpose of the RESET UE POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message in the NR A-GNSS sensitivity coarse time assistance test?
q_5974.ground_truth: The RESET UE POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message is used to reset the UE's positioning stored information before starting the NR A-GNSS sensitivity coarse time assistance test.

q_5975.question: What should be the reported bitmap size if V(Q) equals V(R)?
q_5975.ground_truth: The reported bitmap size should equal 0 bits if V(Q) equals V(R).

q_5976.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message within AUTHENTICATION REQUEST with ngKSI is already in use for the third time?
q_5976.ground_truth: The UE should locally release the RRC connection and treat the active cell as barred.

q_5977.question: When must an MME/SGSN ignore a message in SCTP associations?
q_5977.ground_truth: An MME/SGSN must ignore a message in SCTP associations if the message is too short, unknown or unforeseen, sent in the wrong direction, or contains missing mandatory information elements.

q_5978.question: What is the presence of the "dl-InitialTX-Power" field in the "PowerOffsetInformation-RL-SetupRqstFDD" sequence?

q_5979.question: What is the resulting action after the UE derives the KAUSF from MSK in the described passage?
q_5979.ground_truth: The UE derives the KAUSF from MSK instead of EMSK, either based on an indicator received from AMF or by interpretation of the realm part of the NAI that might indicate the use of external CdP.

q_5980.question: What is the purpose of the ADC-Rule-Report AVP?
q_5980.ground_truth: The ADC-Rule-Report AVP is used to report the status of ADC rules which cannot be installed/activated or enforced at the TDF.

q_5981.question: How should the UE request the GPS or GANSS almanac in A-GNSS test cases?
q_5981.ground_truth: The UE should request the GPS or GANSS almanac by setting the appropriate information element in the MO-LR request for assistance data.

q_5982.question: What is the requirement for determining authorization for cancelling an MCPTT imminent peril call?
q_5982.ground_truth: If the IWF receives a SIP request with the <imminentperil-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body set to a value of "false", the IWF may authorize the MCPTT imminent peril call cancellation request.

q_5983.question: What is the name of the famous clock tower in London?

q_5984.question: What is the purpose of the BVC-RESET procedure in the GPRS network?
q_5984.ground_truth: The BVC-RESET procedure synchronises the initialisation of GPRS BVC related contexts at a BSS and SGSN, enabling them to begin communication in known states by requiring that after the completion of the BVC-Reset procedure, the BSS initiates the block procedure for all affected BVCs that are marked as blocked at the BSS.

q_5985.question: What is the transport protocol used in the Proxy mode of the Transparent delivery method?
q_5985.ground_truth: The transport protocol used in the Proxy mode of the Transparent delivery method is UDP/IP.

q_5986.question: What is the impact of clearing errors using the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message?
q_5986.ground_truth: When the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message is used to clear errors, only all errors for one object can be cleared per message, and it is not possible to clear one out of several errors for one object.

q_5987.question: What must the UE include in the response to a RequestCapabilities message?
q_5987.ground_truth: The UE must include the capabilities of the device for each supported positioning method in the response message.

q_5988.question: What is the procedure if the mobile station does not receive an immediate assignment corresponding to any of its 3 last channel request messages, and T3122 has expired?
q_5988.ground_truth: The mobile station returns to CCCH idle mode (listening to its paging channel) and is not allowed to make a new attempt to establish a non-emergency RR connection in the same cell until T3122 expires.

q_5989.question: What information is returned in the WRITE-REPLACE COMPLETE message if the Write-Replace procedure was successful for all cells in the Cell List IE?
q_5989.ground_truth: The WRITE-REPLACE COMPLETE message contains the Message Identifier IE, the New Serial Number IE, and optionally the Channel Indicator IE, as well as the Number of Broadcasts Completed List IE or the Cell List IE, depending on the request of the WRITE-REPLACE message.

q_5990.question: What should the Node B do if the E-DCH Decoupling Indication IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
q_5990.ground_truth: The Node B should use this indication for E-DCH decoupling operation if supported.

q_5991.question: How does MExE enable access to various network node types?
q_5991.ground_truth: MExE enables access to various network node types by allowing the MExE UE to communicate with different network node types in the MExE service environment. This allows for intelligent nodes to process service requests from the MExE UE, with applications in the MExE service environment able to interact with UE applications using industry standard protocols.

q_5992.question: What is the importance of sub-test 5 in 3GPP 36.508 for LCS sub-test cases?
q_5992.ground_truth: The values for sub-test 5 are used for the default message content in subclause 5.4 of 3GPP 36.508, for LCS sub-test cases.

q_5993.question: What is the relationship between user profile and capability negotiation in MExE?
q_5993.ground_truth: The user profile contains the user's preferences, and the capability negotiation contains the preferences that the MExE device is able to support, allowing the MSE to serve the MExE device with the lowest common denominator of the user's preferences, device capabilities, and service characteristics.

q_5994.question: What is the purpose of the Plug and Connect (PnC) procedure described in the document?
q_5994.ground_truth: The PnC procedure describes the steps for a Network Element (NE) to connect to its management system and obtain basic connectivity information after being powered up.

q_5995.question: What were the conditions evaluated in the test for spatial audio localization?
q_5995.ground_truth: In addition to the Ambisonics of orders 1, 2 and 3, three additional conditions were evaluated in the test to span the quality scale better.

q_5996.question: What is a recommended requirement for the 3GPP network regarding managed streaming service?
q_5996.ground_truth: The 3GPP network needs to be able to allow the operator to collect QoE metrics of any managed streaming service.

q_5997.question: What is the maximum length of the control frame payload in the Common Control Channel control frames?
q_5997.ground_truth: The maximum length of the control frame payload in the Common Control Channel control frames is 239 octets.

q_5998.question: What subclause of TS 37.571-2 defines the MBS performance test cases for which scenario data is defined in Subclause 8.2?
q_5998.ground_truth: Subclause 8.1 of TS 37.571-2 refers to the MBS performance test cases for which scenario data is defined in Subclause 8.2.

q_5999.question: What should the "Polling bit" in the AMD PDU header be set to if a poll has been triggered but polling is not prohibited?
q_5999.ground_truth: The "Polling bit" in the AMD PDU header should be set to "1" if a poll has been triggered and polling is not prohibited.

q_6000.question: What is the purpose of using two different asymmetric windows for LP analysis in this process?
q_6000.ground_truth: The purpose of using two different asymmetric windows for LP analysis is to perform LP analysis twice per frame using two different window sets. The first window has its weight concentrated at the second subframe, while the second window has its weight concentrated at the fourth subframe. This is done to ensure that the windows are applied to 80 samples from past speech frames in addition to the 160 samples of the present speech frame, without using any samples from future frames.

q_6001.question: What size is the first RBG for a downlink carrier bandwidth part i of size PRBs in downlink resource allocation of type 0?
q_6001.ground_truth: The size of the first RBG is P, where P is the size of the carrier bandwidth part in PRBs.

q_6002.question: What is required for a UE to start monitoring E-AGCH when it has no E-DCH data to transmit?
q_6002.ground_truth: The TEBS needs to become larger than zero for a UE to start monitoring E-AGCH when it has no E-DCH data to transmit.

q_6003.question: What is required for the "Combination of CS and IMS services" to be applicable to GERAN access?
q_6003.ground_truth: A CSI capable UE requires DTM capability (Dual Transfer Mode) for the "Combination of CS and IMS services" to be applicable to GERAN access.

q_6004.question: What is the error protection scheme that is applied to the transport formats in the static part?
q_6004.ground_truth: The error protection scheme applied to the transport formats in the static part is turbo coding with a coding rate of 1/3 and a size of CRC of 24 bits.

q_6005.question: Which protocolIEs are mandatory in the MBMSCNDe-RegistrationResponse message?
q_6005.ground_truth: The mandatory protocolIEs in the MBMSCNDe-RegistrationResponse message are "id-TMGI" and "id-GlobalRNC-ID".

q_6006.question: What message flow is used in ProSe Direct Discovery for charging data collection in TS 23.303?
q_6006.ground_truth: ProSe operation flows are based on the procedures defined in TS 23.303, including ProSe Direct Discovery Announce Request, ProSe Direct Discovery Announce Response, and ProSe Direct Discovery Monitor Request.

q_6007.question: What message type is sent by the network at any time to ask the MS for setting of parameters and consequential actions?

q_6008.question: What is the preferred normalization for the abnormal releases of the service in the E-RAB Retainability KPI?
q_6008.ground_truth: The preferred normalization for the abnormal releases of the service in the E-UTRAN E-RAB Retainability KPI is time unit of transfer between abnormal releases, i.e. abnormal releases per served session time.

q_6009.question: What protocol is used as the basic session control protocol to create an IM (Internet Multimedia) session supporting telepresence in IMS-based telepresence?

q_6010.question: What should be used when a significant amount of symbols are not available?
q_6010.ground_truth: Option 6.1.3.3 should be used in this case.

q_6011.question: What factors should be considered when choosing how to transmit the eCall data?
q_6011.ground_truth: Factors to consider include minimizing delay, impact on the network, additional equipment required in the vehicle or PSAP, robustness of channel, error handling, delivery of the MSD to the same PSAP as the voice call, and avoiding interruption of the voice call when sending data.

q_6012.question: What should be the length argument if the tag data is to be appended to the proactive command buffer in the CatPutTLV function?
q_6012.ground_truth: The length should be the size of the value argument in bytes.

q_6013.question: What is the main objective of the "Optimized Transmit Pulse Shape for Downlink EGPRS2-B" study item?
q_6013.ground_truth: The main objective of this study item is to optimise pulse shapes based on agreed criteria and provide an evaluation of the optimized pulse shapes.

q_6014.question: What function is responsible for the bi-directional protocol translation between SIP and RTSP in IMS-based PSS and MBMS procedures?
q_6014.ground_truth: The PSS Adapter performs bi-directional protocol translation between SIP and RTSP to offer control of PSS servers and Recording servers.

q_6015.question: What is the role of the MBS Application Provider in the MBS User Services architecture?
q_6015.ground_truth: The MBS Application Provider plays the role of the AF/AS in the MBS User Services architecture.

q_6016.question: What is the main purpose of collecting data related to URSP enforcement from the UE and other NFs by the NWDAF?
q_6016.ground_truth: The main purpose of collecting this data is to derive analytics for usage of network slice and provide input for the PCF to check and update URSP rules if necessary.

q_6017.question: What information must the S-GW/BBIFF provide to the LMISF when an IMS Signalling Bearer or a Media Bearer is created, modified, or deleted?
q_6017.ground_truth: The S-GW/BBIFF must provide the IMSI value of the target UE and the location of the UE.

q_6018.question: What procedure does the ePDG initiate after receiving the accepted routing rules from the PDN GW?
q_6018.ground_truth: The ePDG sends an IKEv2 INFORMATIONAL Request message to the UE, which includes the accepted routing rules.

q_6019.question: What is the difference between supportedBandCombinationList and supportedBandCombinationList-UplinkTxSwitch?
q_6019.ground_truth: The supportedBandCombinationList is used to include as many NR-only band combinations as possible from the list of "candidate band combinations", while the supportedBandCombinationList-UplinkTxSwitch is used to include as many NR-only band combinations that support UL TX switching as possible.

q_6020.question: What is one potential drawback of using S1 based interface between eNB and HeNB, and between HeNBs?
q_6020.ground_truth: Increased functionality and processing load at the MME.

q_6021.question: What is the requirement for (U)SIM response coding when using SMS-PP?
q_6021.ground_truth: The (U)SIM response coding should comply with ETSI TS 102 226, including an added feature where no data is returned in the RE/RA when PoR is not requested, and the terminal is instructed to issue an RP-ACK. Here, the data returned by the (U)SIM is the complete Response Packet to be included in the User Data part of the SMS-DELIVER-REPORT.

q_6022.question: What is the range of spreading factors supported in the uplink by the 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_6022.ground_truth: The 7.68 Mcps TDD option supports spreading factors of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 in the uplink.

q_6023.question: What is another solution for the MBMS use case from a video coding point of view for premium and normal video services?
q_6023.ground_truth: SHVC, where one encoded SHVC bitstream with two layers of different spatial resolutions is transmitted, and each UE decodes and renders the video bitstream based on its service.

q_6024.question: What entity initiates the delivery of a service via individual MBS delivery when a UE moves out of MBMS coverage?

q_6025.question: After opening a channel between the ME and UICC, what status is indicated if the link is established?
q_6025.ground_truth: If the link is established, the channel status is indicated as "Channel identifier 1 and link established or PDP context activated".

q_6026.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects in the telecommunication management domain?
q_6026.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects in the telecommunication management domain is responsible for defining technical specifications related to telecommunication management, including the Home enhanced Node B Subsystem (HeNS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) and Solution Sets (SS).

q_6027.question: What is the action taken by the MSGin5G Server when a segment exceeds the maximum allowed packet size?
q_6027.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server reassembles subsequent segmented messages, until the Last Segment Flag indication is received, into a single MSGin5G message. The re-assembled message is then segmented such that each segment is smaller than the maximum allowed packet size of the targeted UE.

q_6028.question: What should the UE do if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the "NSSAA to be performed" indicator in the 5GS registration result IE, includes a pending NSSAI, but does not include an allowed NSSAI?
q_6028.ground_truth: The UE shall not initiate a 5GSM procedure except for emergency services or high priority access until the UE receives an allowed NSSAI, and shall not initiate a service request procedure except for cases f) and i) in subclause 5.6.1.1.

q_6029.question: What does the abbreviation "3GPP" stand for in the context of the document?

q_6030.question: What is the purpose of storing the low access priority indicator in EPS/PDP Bearer contexts?
q_6030.ground_truth: The purpose is to include it in charging records and not for making overload control decisions.

q_6031.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects, in relation to the Inventory Management (IM) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP)?
q_6031.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects is to provide the NRM-specific part related to the Inventory Management NRM IRP IS in 3GPP TS 28.632. This specification includes the Inventory Management (IM) Network Resource Model (NRM) IRP: Solution Set (SS) definitions.

q_6032.question: How many intermodulation interference frequency ranges are there for the GSM bands?
q_6032.ground_truth: There are 12 intermodulation interference frequency ranges for the GSM bands.

q_6033.question: What is the condition for the sub-test to be successful in the test requirements?
q_6033.ground_truth: For the sub-test to be successful, the ratio of successful reported values in each test point of the sub-test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_6034.question: What is one potential normative work on media level for media production use cases in 5G Systems?
q_6034.ground_truth: One potential normative work on media level could be the development of standardized media profiles for 5G Systems, specifying the required bit rates, loss rates, formats, latencies, and jitter for different media production workflows, enabling interoperability between devices and systems from different vendors.

q_6035.question: Which enumerated value in the GPS-UTC-Model enumeration indicates the future date in GPS UTC Model?

q_6036.question: What should be collected and reported as usage information in the UP function?
q_6036.ground_truth: Usage information involves collecting data in the UP function and reporting it to the CP function as defined in clause~5.3 and clause~7.4.

q_6037.question: What is the solution being investigated to align the media bandwidth for the sending direction with the uplink QoS parameters?
q_6037.ground_truth: The solution involves limiting the maximum bandwidth for both Alice and Bob to 32 kbps.

q_6038.question: When does the MS initiate SNDCP XID negotiation in 3GPP?
q_6038.ground_truth: The MS initiates SNDCP XID negotiation upon receipt of SNSM-ACTIVATE.indication if changes to the SNDCP XID parameters are required.

q_6039.question: What is the role of the "outgoingAccessRequest" parameter in the XML schema for CUG service?
q_6039.ground_truth: The "outgoingAccessRequest" parameter is used to indicate outgoing access in the XML schema for CUG service. If set to TRUE, it indicates that the originating user is requesting outgoing access.

q_6040.question: What is the effect of ROaming not allowed in this LA while using the stored list cell selection?
q_6040.ground_truth: If the ROaming is not allowed in this LA, the MS will not be able to use the stored list cell selection method and will have to use the normal cell selection method. This means that the MS will search for BCCH or CPBCCH carriers on the strongest RF channels, instead of searching for BCCH or CPBCCH carriers from a list pre-stored in the MS.

q_6041.question: What is the role of an "Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT)" in the 3GPP TS 37.571 specification series?
q_6041.ground_truth: An Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT) is a statement made by a supplier or implementer of an UEUT which contains or references all of the information related to the UEUT and its testing environment, which will enable the test laboratory to run an appropriate test suite against the UEUT.

q_6042.question: What is the effect of a BM-SC initiated Heartbeat procedure on the GCS AS?
q_6042.ground_truth: The GCS AS replies with a GNA including its own restart counter value to confirm that the MB2-C path is still operational.

q_6043.question: What should a UE do if the network decides to trigger fallback to EPS during a PDU session modification procedure?
q_6043.ground_truth: The UE should indicate rejection of the PDU session modification to setup QoS flow for IMS voice and initiate either handover or AN Release via inter-system redirection to EPS, taking into account UE capabilities. The UE should then initiate TAU procedure and include the active flag in the request in the case of inter-system redirection to EPS. After completion of the mobility procedure to EPS, the SMF+PGW-C re-initiates the setup of the dedicated bearer(s) for the maintained PCC rule(s) in step 4, including the dedicated bearer for IMS voice.

q_6044.question: What is the highest priority level defined in the eMLPP service for call set-up and continuity?
q_6044.ground_truth: The highest priority level is A, which is reserved for network internal use.

q_6045.question: What is the purpose of the Downlink Power Timeslot Control procedure?
q_6045.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to provide the DRNS with updated DL Timeslot ISCP values to use when deciding the DL TX Power for each timeslot.

q_6046.question: What are the procedures outlined in Subclause 8.1 for Cell ID and Enhanced Cell ID positioning methods?
q_6046.ground_truth: Subclause 8.1 outlines the procedures for the determination of the cell ID depending on the operational status of the target UE, provides a procedure for mapping of the cell ID to a corresponding SAI to be returned to the LCS application in the CN, and includes additional information on other Enhanced Cell ID methods.

q_6047.question: What is the requirement for the test described in clause 14.3.7.4?
q_6047.ground_truth: The RSTD measurement accuracy for Cell 2 shall fulfill the absolute requirement in clause 14.3.7.3. The test tolerances are defined in clauses C.1.6 and C.2.5.

q_6048.question: What is the difference between "push" mode and "pull" mode in the distribution of PFDs?
q_6048.ground_truth: In "push" mode, the PFDF distributes PFDs to PCEFs/TDFs while in "pull" mode, the PCEF/TDF requests PFDs from the PFDF.

q_6049.question: What are the two types of alerting the CTS-MS from the CTS-FP?
q_6049.ground_truth: The two types of alerting are group alerting, where all CTS-MSs are paged until one accepts the call, and individual alerting, where only the intended CTS-MS is paged.

q_6050.question: What are the different ways to deploy traffic steering control?
q_6050.ground_truth: Traffic steering control can be deployed using only PCEF, only TDF, only TSSF, using a combination of PCEF/TDF with traffic steering control feature and TSSF, or using PCEF/TDF with PCC/ADC Rules and traffic steering control information at service data flow level using TSSF.

q_6051.question: What information does the ng-eNB-DU report to the ng-eNB-CU in the UE CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message regarding the requested DRBs and SRBs?
q_6051.ground_truth: A list of DRBs/SRBs which are successfully established/modified, a list of DRBs/SRBs which failed to be established/modified.

q_6052.question: What is the function of a half-silvered mirror in a camera setup?
q_6052.ground_truth: A half-silvered mirror is used in a camera setup to allow a camera operator to view what the camera is seeing, while also allowing the camera to capture an image.

q_6053.question: What action does the PCRF take to establish a session with the TDF and provide ADC rules for the TDF session?
q_6053.ground_truth: The PCRF sends a TS-Request with necessary parameters, such as PDN information, UE IPv4 address, UE Ipv6 prefix, user identification, type of IP-CAN, and other relevant information, to uniquely identify the session between the PCRF and the TDF. The PCRF also includes the ADC rules in the TS-Request message for provisioning at the TDF.

q_6054.question: What is the purpose of the backup connection pre-establishment solution for single-radio UE?
q_6054.ground_truth: The purpose of the backup connection pre-establishment solution for single-radio UE is to achieve service continuity between SNPN and PLMN by pre-establishing a backup UP connection in the PLMN for SNPN services.

q_6055.question: What kind of identifier is used for the operating system in the "OSId" node?
q_6055.ground_truth: A Uuniversally Unique IDentifier (UUID) as specified in IETF RFC 4122 is used for the operating system identifier in the "OSId" node.

q_6056.question: What is the meaning of the "rb-IdentityForHOMessage" field in the "SRNC-RelocationInfo-r7-IEs" sequence?
q_6056.ground_truth: The "rb-IdentityForHOMessage" field in the "SRNC-RelocationInfo-r7-IEs" sequence is used to indicate the identity of the radio bearer (RB) used by the source SRNC (Source RNC) to send the HO (Handover) message to the target RNC (Target RNC) when the type is "UE involved". This field is included in the message only if the HO (Handover) procedure type is "UE involved".

q_6057.question: What message is sent by the HLR/HSS in response to a MAP Send Routing Info for LCS message for a Mobile Terminated Location Request (MT-LR)?
q_6057.ground_truth: The HLR/HSS returns a MAP Send Routing Info for LCS ack message that contains the H-GMLC address in response to a MAP Send Routing Info for LCS message for a MT-LR.

q_6058.question: What is the subject of the present document within the 3GPP Technical Specification family?
q_6058.ground_truth: IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP)

q_6059.question: What are the possible criticalities for the ProtocolIE-Single-Container as per the HNBAP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_6059.ground_truth: The possible criticalities are reject and ignore.

q_6060.question: What are the symbols and abbreviations used in the 3GPP TR technical report on Media Production over 5G NPN Systems (Release 17)?
q_6060.ground_truth: The report uses symbols such as <symbol> and <Explanation> to explain terminology, and includes various abbreviations such as AES, AIMS, AMWA, ARQ, CCU, DNS, and FEC, among others, to describe technical terms and concepts specific to the report.

q_6061.question: What information does the MOC record include when the call is forwarded?
q_6061.ground_truth: The MOC record includes O-CSI data when the call is forwarded.

q_6062.question: What is the maximum resident set size reported by the "time" command?
q_6062.ground_truth: The maximum resident set size reported was 165456 kbytes.

q_6063.question: What happens when a non-SMS mobile terminating request arrives during SMS activities in the MSC/VLR?
q_6063.ground_truth: The MSC/VLR continues the SMS activities and sends the SGs Paging message for the non-SMS activity to the MME. This may lead to disruption of the SMS delivery.

q_6064.question: What interactions occur between a V-PCF and HPLMN PCF for S-NSSAIs of HPLMN subject to Quota management/capping?
q_6064.ground_truth: The V-PCF detects that the S-NSSAI of HPLMN mapping to V-PLMN S-NSSAI of the PDU Session is subject to quota management and reports the establishment/release of PDU Session to H-PCF. The H-PCF updates the counters and communicates any required actions to the V-PCF, which then reports to the SMF any quota management related action.

q_6065.question: What is the purpose of the Procedure Indicator field in the Iu UP PDU Type 14 Format for procedure sending?
q_6065.ground_truth: The Procedure Indicator identifies the control procedure in the current frame.

q_6066.question: What is the response length limit for the "GET INPUT" command?
q_6066.ground_truth: The minimum length of the response is 0, and the maximum length is 10.

q_6067.question: What are the interoperability aspects to consider for using a codec in the context of 5G Media Streaming services in TS 26.511 and for TV Video profiles in TS 26.116?
q_6067.ground_truth: The interoperability aspects to consider are receiver requirements, encapsulation of an elementary stream, definition of a CMAF media profile, static and dynamic mapping of parameters, MPD-level signalling, encryption requirements, capability discovery, source buffer initialization, playback requirements, and relation to other specifications.

q_6068.question: What security framework is used for authentication and authorization in the multicast communication service?
q_6068.ground_truth: The AKMA (Authentication and Authorization for Converged IoT Medical Applications) framework is used for authentication and authorization in the multicast communication service.

q_6069.question: What happens to the free format data that is non-completed when new FCI operations are received?
q_6069.ground_truth: The non-completed data is discarded when new FCI operations are received to overwrite the non-completed data.

q_6070.question: What action should the GANC take upon receiving a GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-REQ message from the MS?
q_6070.ground_truth: The GANC releases the GA-PSR TC and sends the GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message to the MS indicating successful deactivation.

q_6071.question: What is used to assess quality and signal level during DTX for the CTS-MS and the CTS-FP on a TCH?
q_6071.ground_truth: The subset of TDMA frames specified in subclause 8.3 is used to assess quality and signal level during DTX for the CTS-MS and the CTS-FP on a TCH.

q_6072.question: What should the MGW-A' do when the received RFCI allocations do not match the stored RFCI allocation after the initialisation of the NbFP from MGW-A towards MGW-A'?
q_6072.ground_truth: The MGW-A' may re-initialize the IuFP towards RNC-A' at this point in time.

q_6073.question: What message is sent by the MS to acknowledge release of all GA-CSR related resources to the Serving GANC?

q_6074.question: What is the effect on the MS power setting in GPRS and EGPRS if there is an Y dB APD on the BCCH?
q_6074.ground_truth: In cases where down regulation is invoked, the MS may transmit with an alpha*Y dB too high power.

q_6075.question: Which UMTS UtranCells are TS0 to TS6 valid for, in terms of UtranCellTDDLcr and UtranCellTDDHcr?
q_6075.ground_truth: TS0 to TS6 are valid for both UtranCellTDDLcr and UtranCellTDDHcr.

q_6076.question: What is one potential impact of supporting a wider minimum channel bandwidth for a band?
q_6076.ground_truth: It could help limit the number of synchronization raster entries in the band, reducing the number of entries needed for initial access aspects.

q_6077.question: What are the two scheduling strategies investigated for multiplexing higher order modulation MS with legacy MS?
q_6077.ground_truth: Strategy 1, which does not take the USF problem into account, and Strategy 2, which is a simple attempt to reduce the USF problem.

q_6078.question: What is the purpose of the "Connect Terrestrial Signalling" message?
q_6078.ground_truth: The "Connect Terrestrial Signalling" message is used to connect a particular terrestrial transmission circuit to a Baseband Transceiver.

q_6079.question: What is the first PLMN in the EFOPLMNwACT with NG-RAN as the access technology?
q_6079.ground_truth: The first PLMN in the EFOPLMNwACT with NG-RAN as the access technology is 244 010 (MCC MNC).

q_6080.question: What possible cause values can the Relocation Cancel Response message have?
q_6080.ground_truth: The possible cause values for the Relocation Cancel Response message are "Request Accepted", "IMSI/IMEI not known", "Mandatory IE incorrect", "Mandatory IE missing", "Optional IE incorrect", and "Invalid message format".

q_6081.question: What is the difference between directional requirements and TRP requirements for a BS?
q_6081.ground_truth: Directional requirements apply to a single direction at a time, while TRP requirements are defined for all radiation space.

q_6082.question: What happens to the MBS session context information at the NG-RAN side after MBS session deactivation in solution #2, #4, #13?
q_6082.ground_truth: The MBS session context information at the NG-RAN side is released, including the shared tunnel.

q_6083.question: What is the term used to describe the act of adding a pixel level offset in an adaptive manner in H.265 (HEVC) for video coding?

q_6084.question: In what scenario should the UE include the NBIFOM container IE in the MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message or the REQUEST SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION message?
q_6084.ground_truth: The UE should include the NBIFOM container IE in the MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message or the REQUEST SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION message if the SGSN received an NBIFOM container IE in an Update Bearer Request message or a Create Bearer Request message and stored a Triggering SGSN initiated PDP Context Creation/Modification Indication in the PDP Context Creation Procedure.

q_6085.question: What should the IWF do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request from the controlling MCPTT function towards a terminating participating MCPTT function?
q_6085.ground_truth: The IWF shall check the presence of the isfocus media feature tag in the URI of the Contact header field and if it is not present then the IWF shall reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "104 isfocus not assigned" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4, and shall not continue with the rest of the steps.

q_6086.question: When will the IC-A1 add a Route header field to the initial INVITE request and what will it point to?
q_6086.ground_truth: The IC-A1 will add a Route header field to the initial INVITE request when the subsequent interconnection network is SIP-aware. It will point to the SIP proxy IC-A1.

q_6087.question: What is the minimum number of occurrences for the "serviceID" element in the "mbmsSecurityDeregister" complex type in the provided XML schema?
q_6087.ground_truth: The "serviceID" element must occur at least once and there is no upper limit for the number of occurrences.

q_6088.question: What is the term "resource pre-emption" defined as in the eMLPP service?
q_6088.ground_truth: Resource pre-emption is the termination of a call of a low priority user such that resources can be made available for a precedence call of higher priority.

q_6089.question: When is the contention resolution process on the network side successfully completed?
q_6089.ground_truth: The contention resolution is successful for the network when it receives an RLC data block with the correct TLLI and TFI values.

q_6090.question: In which state is no dedicated radio resource used and what procedures are used for mobility?
q_6090.ground_truth: In the URA Connected state, no dedicated radio resource is used. The mobility functionality in this state is provided by URA updating procedures.

q_6091.question: What shall a UE do upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the Identity type IE set to "SUCI" while timer T3519 is not running?
q_6091.ground_truth: The UE shall generate a fresh SUCI, send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message containing the SUCI, start timer T3519, and store the value of the SUCI sent in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.

q_6092.question: What does the target AMF do after initiating a new primary authentication with the UE?
q_6092.ground_truth: The target AMF generates a new Kamf-2 key shared with the UE and runs a new NAS SMC procedure between target AMF and UE to take the new Kamf-2 key into use.

q_6093.question: What are the considerations for message filtering in Instant Messaging?
q_6093.ground_truth: Harry may wish to be notified that an instant message has been delivered to his mailbox.

q_6094.question: Which command of the PC4a interface application is sent from the HSS to the ProSe Function for a reset operation?
q_6094.ground_truth: The Reset-Request (RSR) command is sent from HSS to the ProSe Function for a reset operation.

q_6095.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the request is a UE-terminating request, and the Request-URI changes when visiting an Application Server?
q_6095.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should use the initial Filter Criteria for the UE-originating case after retargeting and perform the matching procedure with SPTs within this initial Filter Criteria.

q_6096.question: In which message does the UE include the logged measurement information if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport, when sending the RRCSetupComplete message?
q_6096.ground_truth: The UE includes the logMeasAvailable, logMeasAvailableBT, or logMeasAvailableWLAN in the RRCSetupComplete message.

q_6097.question: What is the procedure for Explicit Communication Transfer when ICS UE B is playing the role of transfer recipient using Gm interface?
q_6097.ground_truth: UE A sends a REFER request to initiate transfer. The REFER message is sent to the S-CSCF and SCC AS, then to the ICS UE B. The ICS UE B initiates session establishment towards UE C. The S-CSCF sends the INVITE to the S-CSCF, which routes the request to UE C. UE C sends back session progress messages and releases the session. The ICS UE B provides indication that the communication transfer is complete by sending a NOTIFY message. The UE A initiates session release with ICS UE B and releases the session.

q_6098.question: What should the UE do when it is commanded to report the global cell identity of the neighbor E-UTRA cell in clause 5.3.5.3 of TS 38.331?
q_6098.ground_truth: When the UE is commanded to report the global cell identity of the neighbor E-UTRA cell, it should determine the global cell identity of the cell included in the associated measurement object by acquiring the relevant system information from the concerned cell, and report the global cell identity in the MeasurementReport.

q_6099.question: What is a desirable feature for user identification in a multi-party conference with a conference focus?
q_6099.ground_truth: A solid authentication of conference participants is a desirable feature for user identification in a multi-party conference with a conference focus.

q_6100.question: How many dB SNR gain was observed in source R1-2008378 for eMBB at 10% iBLER for FR1, when symbol level repetition was used, compared to Rel-16 PUSCH repetition type A?
q_6100.ground_truth: Around 0.4 dB SNR gain for UE speed 3km/h, and around 0.3dB SNR loss for UE speed 120km/h.

q_6101.question: What action does the PGW-U take when it receives a request to allocate a UE IP address during L2TP tunneling?
q_6101.ground_truth: The PGW-U (LAC) retrieves the IP address from the LNS when requested by the PGW-C for a PDN Connection, and requests DNS server addresses from the LNS if needed.

q_6102.question: What should the BSS do if the Service Handover information element indicates that "handover to UTRAN or cdma2000 should be performed" for Intersystem handover to other RAT's?
q_6102.ground_truth: The BSS should perform an Intersystem handover via directed retry instead of the assignment.

q_6103.question: Under what conditions is a station not allowed to send an I frame with a sequence number equal to the last received acknowledgement plus 7?
q_6103.ground_truth: A station shall not send the I frame if it is ready to send an I frame numbered N(S), where N(S) is equal to the last received acknowledgement plus 7, and instead follow the procedures described in clause 5.4.5.

q_6104.question: Which exception does the SIM Toolkit Framework throw when an applet attempts to issue a TIMER MANAGEMENT proactive command using a timer identifier, which is not allocated to it?
q_6104.ground_truth: The SIM Toolkit Framework throws an exception.

q_6105.question: What are the interfaces defined in the reference model for VAS SMS services provisioning?
q_6105.ground_truth: The interfaces defined in the reference model for VAS SMS services provisioning are Rf-a, Rf-b, Rf-c, and Rf-d. Rf-a is the interface between VAS AS and SMS Node, Rf-b is the interface between two SMS Nodes, Rf-c is the interface between VAS AS and Charging and Billing Function (BCF), Rf-d is the interface between VAS AS and Service Portal Function (SPF).

q_6106.question: What steps should the MS take if it wants to join a group call and the second segment of a segmented notification was not correctly received at the next but one PCH block after receiving the first segment?
q_6106.ground_truth: The MS may either read further PCH blocks to find the missing second segment or read the NCH to obtain the full description of the group call.

q_6107.question: What is the purpose of the procedure in 6.32.4 for determining applications, DNNs, and DNAIs in an area of interest?
q_6107.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure is to illustrate the enhanced mechanisms for NWDAF to determine the PDU sessions associated with certain Applications, DNNs and DNAIs within an area of interest specified per TA granularity.

q_6108.question: What is the effect of the UMTS mask on ACLR requirements for UTRA and E-UTRA?
q_6108.ground_truth: The UMTS mask results in higher ACLR values than the limits specified for both UTRA and E-UTRA, implying that ACLR requirements will be implicitly met by the UEM.

q_6109.question: What is the function of a RACH resource in the NR system?
q_6109.ground_truth: A RACH resource is a time-frequency resource to send a RACH preamble.

q_6110.question: What are the target identities that can be used for intercepting communications in 3GPP HNB?
q_6110.ground_truth: The target identities for 3GPP HNB interception can be IMSI, MSISDN or E.164 number for optional Non-Local ID, IMEI, or ME Id.

q_6111.question: What is the purpose of the ID id-CauseLevel-RL-SetupFailureTDD criticality in the RadioLinkSetupFailureTDD sequence?
q_6111.ground_truth: The ID id-CauseLevel-RL-SetupFailureTDD criticality in the RadioLinkSetupFailureTDD sequence indicates whether the cause of the radio link set up failure is a general cause or an RL-specific cause.

q_6112.question: What is the definition of a "mobile termination" in the context of 3GPP specifications?
q_6112.ground_truth: The mobile termination is the component of the user equipment which supports functions specific to management of the radio interface (Um).

q_6113.question: How do national UC legislations differ in defining relevant communication services to carry UC communication?
q_6113.ground_truth: National legislations may either explicitly list specific services (e.g. Email) or use a technology-independent definition, which may include or exclude certain services (e.g. VoIP, Fax, SMS, MMS, Instant Messaging).

q_6114.question: What is a requirement for Network Composition regarding regulatory support?
q_6114.ground_truth: The negotiation and realization of a composition agreement must be able to address regulations from regulatory bodies and be able to enforce such regulations.

q_6115.question: What is the "AlmanacAndSatelliteHealthSIB" sequence used for in the PCAP protocol?
q_6115.ground_truth: The "AlmanacAndSatelliteHealthSIB" sequence is used in the PCAP protocol to provide information about the almanac and satellite health for a given area. It includes the "satellite" field to specify the satellite information and the "lte-SIB" field to define the LTE system information.

q_6116.question: What is added to the "List of Transmitters" attribute of the PF-DC-CDR when a new transmitter is detected for a group?
q_6116.ground_truth: A new transmitter is added to the list in the PF-DC-CDR for the group with usage to report, when it is detected by the UE and then received by the ProSe Function in a usage information report.

q_6117.question: What is used in a Charging-Rule-Report AVP to indicate the reason that the PCC rules cannot be successfully installed/activated or enforced?

q_6118.question: What is the main benefit of using a dedicated channel for downlink flow in terms of bitrate variation?
q_6118.ground_truth: With a dedicated channel, there is no available rate variation on the air interface expected, providing a consistent bitrate.

q_6119.question: What is used to determine whether to activate or deactivate online charging?
q_6119.ground_truth: The charging characteristics profile is used to determine the activation or deactivation of online charging in P-GW and TDF.

q_6120.question: What message is sent by UE-1 to each member UE that was authorized to participate in the group communication?
q_6120.ground_truth: The Discovery Accept message includes the Application Layer Group ID, provided by the Application Server during group communication establishment.

q_6121.question: What is the method used to differentiate the codecs support and achievable code rates for each user in the HOM technique?
q_6121.ground_truth: The achievable code rate is the same as that of the legacy codec for every modulation, as the same payload size is maintained. Every legacy speech codec (TCH/FS, TCH/EFS, TCH/AFS, TCH/WFS, TCH/HS, TCH/AHS) is supported with separate DTX for each user in full and half rate codecs.

q_6122.question: What specification of the PA needs to be amended for 8-PSK at 27 dBm with a duty cycle of 75 %?
q_6122.ground_truth: The specification of the PA for supporting the maximum GMSK output power needs to be amended.

q_6123.question: How does the wireless service provider network return a negative indication to the Edison Power company server about the delivery of the trigger to the device?
q_6123.ground_truth: The wireless service provider network may return a negative indication to the Edison Power company server if it fails to deliver the trigger to the device.

q_6124.question: What is the task of the eNB in terms of user plane data?
q_6124.ground_truth: It is eNB's task to cipher and decipher user plane packets between the Uu reference point and the S1/X2 reference points and to handle integrity protection for user plane packets for the S1/X2 reference points.

q_6125.question: Which two main categories of RRC connection mobility procedures are defined in connected mode?
q_6125.ground_truth: The two main categories of RRC connection mobility procedures defined in connected mode are URA (UTRAN Registration Area) updating and handover. URA updating is used when the UE's position is known on a URA level, and handover is used to add or remove radio links when the UE's position is known on the cell level.

q_6126.question: What is the role of the E-SMLC in supporting location services for a target UE in E-UTRAN?
q_6126.ground_truth: The E-SMLC manages the support of different location services for target UEs, including positioning of UEs and delivery of assistance data to UEs. It determines a single location estimate for the target UE (hybrid positioning) and combines all the received results.

q_6127.question: What should the MS do if it receives a new QoS from the network that is different from its default QoS for a particular service type?
q_6127.ground_truth: The MS should accept the new QoS, unless it has insufficient internal resources to support the new QoS.

q_6128.question: What happens to lost QUIC datagram frames in this solution?
