q_6128.ground_truth: Lost QUIC datagram frames are not retransmitted; instead, the detection of lost packets is supported, and the congestion control per QUIC connection is in place to handle such situations.

q_6129.question: Which enumerated value in the 'TransportFormatSet-TransmissionTimeIntervalDynamic' set represents 16ms?

q_6130.question: What is the best filter for 8 and 16 PRB in terms of providing gain for most allocations within the channel?

q_6131.question: What is the minimum set of video frame rates and resolutions that an MCVideo UE shall support for receiving videos?
q_6131.ground_truth: An MCVideo UE that is able to receive videos shall support as a minimum, the reception, decoding and rendering of all 3GPP mandated video frame rates and resolutions.

q_6132.question: What is the difference between LAPDm and LAPD in terms of frame delimitation methods and transparency mechanisms?
q_6132.ground_truth: LAPDm and LAPD have different frame delimitation methods and transparency mechanisms to cater to the constraints set by the radio path in the mobile communication network.

q_6133.question: What should the network indicate in the UPLINK BUSY message when the NCH and the group channel are not used?
q_6133.ground_truth: The network should indicate "Group Channel" in the UPLINK BUSY message.

q_6134.question: What are the three types of broadcast messages defined in the document that enable MS to calculate its own location estimate?
q_6134.ground_truth: The three types of broadcast messages are: E-OTD Assistance Data Message, GPS Assistance Data Message, and GANSS Assistance Data Message.

q_6135.question: What should a UE do after receiving a list of service route values in the Service-Route header field of a REGISTER request, if multiple registration mechanism is used?
q_6135.ground_truth: The UE should bind the list of service route values either to the contact address or to the registration flow and the associated contact address, and the associated set of security associations or TLS session over which the REGISTER request was sent.

q_6136.question: What must the source RNC include in the RELOCATION REQUIRED message when SRVCC is performed during an intra-system Relocation?
q_6136.ground_truth: The source RNC must include the SRVCC HO Indication IE, the Source ID IE, the Target ID IE, and the Source to Target Transparent Container IE in the RELOCATION REQUIRED message.

q_6137.question: What should the Node B do if it receives a CELL SETUP REQUEST message including the Closed Loop Timing Adjustment Mode IE?
q_6137.ground_truth: The Node B should store the value and apply it when closed loop Feed-Back mode diversity is used on DPCH.

q_6138.question: What is the primary objective of Solution #18 in the context of VIAPA?
q_6138.ground_truth: The primary objective of Solution #18 is to address key issue #2 for VIAPA, allowing UEs to simultaneously connect to both NPN and PLMN while maintaining active data sessions with both networks.

q_6139.question: What is the responsibility of the UGC reception server during the UGC distribution procedure?
q_6139.ground_truth: The UGC reception server is responsible for repackaging and/or transcoding the uploaded or upstreamed content into a form that can be served to legacy PSS servers and BMSCs. It is also responsible for serving received UGC to legacy PSS servers and BMSCs in live and pre-recorded forms.

q_6140.question: What should not be included in the SDS message if the SDS message is for user consumption and the SDS message is intended for an application on the terminating MCData client?
q_6140.ground_truth: The Application ID IE and the Extended application ID IE should not be included in this case.

q_6141.question: What network element is responsible for mapping the request received over E/G to the right IP-CAN session in Architecture scenario C?

q_6142.question: What should the UE do if the IE "Positioning Methods" in IE "UE positioning reporting quantity" has been assigned to value "GPS" and some GPS assistance data was missing?
q_6142.ground_truth: The UE should set the IE "Error reason" to "Some GPS Assistance Data Missing" in this case.

q_6143.question: What is the purpose of the SGSN in implicit PTC de-activation due to MS de-registration?
q_6143.ground_truth: The SGSN responds to the GANC's Iu Release Command during the implicit PTC de-activation due to MS de-registration procedure.

q_6144.question: How is the channel quality indicator (CQI) derived in the HS-DSCH channel quality indication procedure?
q_6144.ground_truth: The CQI is derived by the UE estimating the highest single-transmission throughput for the allocated resources while achieving a BLER of no more than 10% for the next associated HS-DSCH transmission.

q_6145.question: What action should the UE take if it is aware that it is in the proximity of one or more CSG member cells on an enabled RAT's frequency?
q_6145.ground_truth: The UE should set the "CSG Proximity Indication" to "entering" and set the "CSG Frequency info for UTRA" or "CSG Frequency info for E-UTRA" to the frequency of the cell(s) for which the Proximity Indication was triggered.

q_6146.question: What are the conditions for the AMR speech codec with noise suppression activated to not significantly increase channel activity when used in conjunction with DTX?
q_6146.ground_truth: The VAF (Voice Activity factor) with AMR NS activated (w) should not be significantly more than the maximum of y and x. Y is the VAF measured without AMR NS active, and x is the VAF measured with AMR VAD active. W is the VAF measured with AMR NS active in both cases using standardized AMR VADs.

q_6147.question: What is the high quality criterion used during PLMN selection for UTRA cells?
q_6147.ground_truth: The high quality criterion for UTRA cells requires that the measured primary CPICH RSCP for FDD cells is greater than or equal to -95 dBm, and the measured P-CCPCH RSCP for TDD cells is greater than or equal to -84 dBm.

q_6148.question: What are the general requirements for CSICS (Circuit Switched IMS Combinational Service) service?
q_6148.ground_truth: The general requirements for CSICS include the ability to establish a combinational service between two users within the same PLMN or a CSICS capable UE with the capability to establish a combinational service between two users camped on identical or different RATs, and establish a combinational service when roaming. The combinational service itself should provide the ability to add an IMS session to a CS speech call or CS Multimedia call, and add a CS speech call or CS Multimedia call to an IMS session. The service mode depends on different UE implementations, and interoperability during a CS call should be enabled. Additionally, the service should provide a mechanism for user privacy and inform users about the service availability.

q_6149.question: What is the purpose of the DTX (Discontinuous Transmission) mechanism described in GSM 06.31?
q_6149.ground_truth: The DTX mechanism is implemented in the DTX handlers and is used to save battery life in the mobile station, reduce the interference level on the air, and improve the measurement of radio link quality by the radio subsystem.

q_6150.question: How does the UE determine the order in which to assemble segments of the same system information block type within one SYSTEM INFORMATION message or SYSTEM INFORMATION 2 message?
q_6150.ground_truth: The UE cannot determine the order in which to assemble segments of the same system information block type within one SYSTEM INFORMATION message or SYSTEM INFORMATION 2 message, as it does not know the order in which the segments were scheduled within the message.

q_6151.question: What is the purpose of the "PeakCheck" function?
q_6151.ground_truth: The "PeakCheck" function checks the sync peaks and takes in SyncSub* ssub (sync subsystem), const char* caller (modem identification), const Bool* pdet (vector of peak detection flags), const Int16* p (vector of frame numbers), const Int32* corrP (vectors of correlation values for positive peaks), const Int32* corrN (vectors of correlation values for negative peaks), Int16 pos1 (peak position 1), Int16 pos2 (peak position 2), Int16 npeaks (number of detected peaks) and Int16 delay (target delay if sync successful).

q_6152.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a response message containing one or more IEs marked as "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" that it does not comprehend?
q_6152.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the content of the not comprehended IEs, continue with the procedure using the understood IEs, and initiate the Error Indication procedure.

q_6153.question: What is the recommended approach for the NE management interfaces of Type 2?
q_6153.ground_truth: The recommended approach for NE management interfaces of Type 2 is to concentrate on Management-application-layer-protocol independent information models, allowing a mapping to several Management-application-layer-protocols.

q_6154.question: How is group paging triggered when using Solution #2 in the MBS session activation?
q_6154.ground_truth: The AMF performs group paging by including the Group Paging Identity (TMGI) in the Paging message, and the NG-RAN node triggers group paging based on the information received. Alternatively, the AMF determines the list of UEs to be paged, and the AMF sends a paging request message to the NG-RAN node(s) to page the UEs using the existing paging method.

q_6155.question: What state does the MBMS client transition to when a service is stalled and there is no longer resource availability?
q_6155.ground_truth: The MBMS client transitions to the STALLED state.

q_6156.question: What are the two layers in the architecture of Security Management?
q_6156.ground_truth: Layer A - Application Layer, Layer B - OAM&P transport network

q_6157.question: What is the function of a Base Station Subsystem in a GERAN?
q_6157.ground_truth: A Base Station Subsystem is responsible for the management and allocation of specific radio resources in a GERAN, and handles transmission and reception in a set of cells.

q_6158.question: What is the condition for the gsmSRF's SRSM-FSM to transit to the "User Interaction" state when the PlayTone procedure is performed?
q_6158.ground_truth: The gsmSRF's SRSM-FSM will transit to the "User Interaction" state when all information has been sent and "RequestAnnouncementCompleteNotification" is TRUE in the gsmSCF's requestAnnouncement operation.

q_6159.question: What is required for an MPS Service User to initiate MPS for all participants of an MMTEL voice conference call using a predetermined method?
q_6159.ground_truth: The 3GPP system needs to support means for an MPS Service User to initiate MPS for all participants of an MMTEL voice conference call using a predetermined method.

q_6160.question: What additional parameters may be included in the BSSAP-LE Perform Location Request message when starting the positioning procedure in CS domain in A/Gb mode, for a MS that supports EC-GSM-IoT?
q_6160.ground_truth: If a MS only supports EC-GSM-IoT, then only the TA based positioning method is supported.

q_6161.question: What is the purpose of the definitions, symbols, and abbreviations section in the document?
q_6161.ground_truth: This section provides definitions for terms and abbreviations used throughout the document.

q_6162.question: What communication service interface is specified in 3GPP TS 22.104 to support distributed automation applications?
q_6162.ground_truth: Communication Service Interface for Factory Process Automation Profile (CSIF)

q_6163.question: What are the names of the companies that have evaluated the performance of SIC receivers for the uplink and downlink?
q_6163.ground_truth: Telefon AB LM Ericsson and ST-NXP Wireless France

q_6164.question: What message does the MSC-1 server send to BSS-1 to inform it to clear the old call leg?
q_6164.ground_truth: The MSC-1 server sends the "LCLS Status Update" message with LCLS status "LCLS not connected" to MSC-2 server to inform BSS-1 to clear the old call leg.

q_6165.question: What are the two parts of the user registration to GAA-LAP interworking?
q_6165.ground_truth: The two parts of the user registration to GAA-LAP interworking are registration with general LAP usage and registration with the GAA-LAP interworking service.

q_6166.question: How many pictures can the user-defined animations consist of?
q_6166.ground_truth: The user-defined animations can consist of 4 pictures.

q_6167.question: What is the PDU type field used for in the described network?
q_6167.ground_truth: The PDU type field, present in the first octet of a BSSGP PDU, indicates the type of PDU. This field is used for distinguishing different types of PDUs in the network.

q_6168.question: What is the role of the Allocation and Retention Priority of the MBMS bearer service?
q_6168.ground_truth: The Allocation and Retention Priority of the MBMS bearer service allows for prioritization between MBMS bearer services at MBMS bearer service establishment.

q_6169.question: What happens to the timeslots that are not used for HS-PDSCH resources in 7.68Mcps TDD?
q_6169.ground_truth: The entire resource of these timeslots is scheduled to the UE with SF=1.

q_6170.question: What is a function of the X2AP and S1AP in the context of EPS bearers with a security policy of "UPIP required"?
q_6170.ground_truth: The X2AP and S1AP ensure that EPS bearers with a security policy of "UPIP required" are not handed over to eNBs that do not support UPIP.

q_6171.question: What is the interleaving structure used in the performance evaluation of turbo coding with 16-QAM?
q_6171.ground_truth: An interleaving structure is used to increase the efficiency and performance of turbo coding with 16-QAM in the link level simulations.

q_6172.question: What call gapping procedure is applied if a call matches multiple active "basicGapCriteria"?
q_6172.ground_truth: The treatment specified in the CallGap associated with the gapCriteria with the highest priority is applied.

q_6173.question: What does sending a RTCP Multiplexing packet indicating readiness to receive multiplexed data streams mean?
q_6173.ground_truth: It does not necessarily mean that the BSS/MGW is ready to send multiplexed data streams. Multiplexing may be applied on a single or on both directions for a given RTP session.

q_6174.question: What is the maximum size of the "CompleteSIB-List" and "CompleteSIB2-List" sequences?
q_6174.ground_truth: The "CompleteSIB-List" and "CompleteSIB2-List" sequences can contain up to "maxSIBperMsg" elements.

q_6175.question: In what unit is the "Hys" parameter expressed?
q_6175.ground_truth: The "Hys" parameter is expressed in dB.

q_6176.question: What type of data is the "SRVCC Capability" in the 5GS network?
q_6176.ground_truth: The SRVCC Capability in the 5GS network is temporary and conditionally stored data.

q_6177.question: Which error is used when the gsmSSF indicates to the gsmSCF that the requested information is not available?

q_6178.question: When should the UE start the Tsor-cm timer associated with a newly established PDU session or service if the matching criterion is found and the applicable Tsor-cm timer indicated the value "infinity"?
q_6178.ground_truth: The UE shall start the Tsor-cm timer associated with a newly established PDU session or service with the value set to infinity if the matching criterion is found and the applicable Tsor-cm timer indicated the value "infinity".

q_6179.question: What is the role of the registration reject message in case of more than one network slice?
q_6179.ground_truth: If the UE requests the registration for more than one network slice, the AMF returns the Registration Reject message only when the max number of UEs per network slice has been reached for all of them.

q_6180.question: In Iu mode, what is the condition for the SRNC to provide a RAI to a PMM-CONNECTED state MS?
q_6180.ground_truth: The new SRNC should indicate the RAI to the MS after an SRNS relocation.

q_6181.question: What should the RAN Access node do when it detects multiple consecutive frames loss over the M1 UP interface and MBSFN is used?
q_6181.ground_truth: The RAN Access node should cease to provide user data to the radio interface protocol entities and wait until the next dynamic scheduling interval.

q_6182.question: What is the purpose of the NITZ feature?
q_6182.ground_truth: The NITZ feature provides the means for serving PLMNs to transfer current identity, time, Daylight Saving Time, and the local timezone to Mobile Stations (MS)s, and for the MSs to store and use this information.

q_6183.question: What are the independent Tariff Switch Timers for the gsmSCF control of e-values called in CAMEL?
q_6183.ground_truth: Tsw(SCI) for controlling call duration and gsmSCF control of e-values.

q_6184.question: What is the role of the MAC field in the LLC frame?
q_6184.ground_truth: The MAC field, when present, shall contain the integrity protection information for the frame. The MAC field shall be included in the security protected frames when integrity protection has been activated.

q_6185.question: What is the function of the Voice Activity Detector (VAD) in speech processing?
q_6185.ground_truth: The VAD is used to indicate whether each 20 ms frame of a speech signal contains signals that should be transmitted (e.g. speech, music or information tones) and to output a Boolean flag indicating its presence.

q_6186.question: What information should not be included in an I1 message sent by the SCC AS to the ICS UE when initiating a mid-call supplementary service?
q_6186.ground_truth: The SCC-AS-id information element (that includes the SCC AS PSI DN) should not be included in the I1 message.

q_6187.question: What should the uplink and downlink HFN component of the COUNT-C of RB2 be set to if the radio bearer is not connected to a CS domain radio access bearer or the radio bearer uses AM RLC?
q_6187.ground_truth: The uplink and downlink HFN component of the COUNT-C of RB2 should be set to the maximum of the uplink and downlink HFN component of the COUNT-C of RB2.

q_6188.question: What is the impact of the '2 out of 3 approach' for the three measurement types defined in subclause 4.5?
q_6188.ground_truth: The '2 out of 3 approach' implies that two out of the three measurements (Attempted RRC re-establishments, Failed RRC re-establishments, and Successful RRC re-establishments) should be considered for evaluation and analysis.

q_6189.question: What is the significance of the alpha identifier data object in the USIM Application Toolkit commands?
q_6189.ground_truth: The alpha identifier data object in USIM Application Toolkit commands is intended to be a short one or two-word identifier for the ME to optionally display on the screen along with any other indications, at the same time as the ME performs the UICC command.

q_6190.question: What is the procedure followed by UE-1 when an early dialog has been established over IP-CAN 1 and it detects that a PS-PS Access Transfer to IP-CAN 2 is required for an incoming multimedia session?
q_6190.ground_truth: UE-1 connects to a new IP-CAN (IP-CAN 2), registers to the S-CSCF via IP-CAN 2, sends an INVITE message on IP-CAN2 towards the SCC AS indicating the STI and performing Access Transfer with full media transfer, and updates the session over the remote access leg.

q_6191.question: What message does the UE send when it has no assistance data and requires it to fulfill a location request in Sub-test 7 of 7.3.4.3.1?
q_6191.ground_truth: The UE sends a REQUEST ASSISTANCE DATA message followed by a PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION message containing a location estimate.

q_6192.question: What happens to the first octet of the V.110 80 bits frame format when converting to the TRAU frame format in the RAA function?
q_6192.ground_truth: The first octet (all bits coded binary~"0") in the CCITT V.110 80 bits frame is stripped off when converting to the TRAU frame format in the RAA function.

q_6193.question: What actions should the BM-SC take when it detects a GCS AS restart?
q_6193.ground_truth: The BM-SC deallocates all TMGIs assigned to the restarted GCS AS and stops all related MBMS bearers.

q_6194.question: What is the CKSN used for in the context of GSM authentication?
q_6194.ground_truth: The CKSN is used to ensure consistency of GSM authentication information (Kc) between the MS and the VLR and between the MS and the SGSN.

q_6195.question: In what scenario will the Node B reject the procedure using the RADIO LINK ADDITION FAILURE message, if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message does not include the Maximum MAC-d PDU Size Extended IE for a Priority Queue in the HS-DSCH MAC-d Flows Information IE in the HS-DSCH Information IE and the DL RLC PDU Size Format IE in the HS-DSCH Information IE has the value of "Flexible RLC PDU Size"?
q_6195.ground_truth: The Node B will reject the procedure if the above conditions are met, as the Maximum MAC-d PDU Size Extended IE is required to determine the maximum size of MAC-d PDUs for the priority queue.

q_6196.question: What is the purpose of the UA response in the LAPDm protocol?
q_6196.ground_truth: The UA response is used by an LLE to acknowledge the receipt and acceptance of the mode-setting commands (SABM or DISC) and shall indicate the clearance of any busy condition.

q_6197.question: What is the value of the "Command qualifier" field when the "Command type" is "SET UP EVENT LIST"?
q_6197.ground_truth: The value of the "Command qualifier" field is '00' when the "Command type" is "SET UP EVENT LIST".

q_6198.question: What should the fixed part do if there is no response from the mobile station (expiry of timer TC3202) in the CTS-RR connection failure case?
q_6198.ground_truth: The fixed part should maintain the old and the new CTSMSI to recover from unsuccessful CTSMSI update.

q_6199.question: What is the action taken if the receiving functional RUA entity receives IEs or IE groups that cannot be understood?
q_6199.ground_truth: This is handled as an Abstract Syntax Error and is based on the received Criticality information.

q_6200.question: Which parameters are not used for IMS in the InitialDPArg sequence?
q_6200.ground_truth: Several parameters in the InitialDPArg sequence are not used for IMS, including locationNumber, highLayerCompatibility, additionalCallingPartyNumber, bearerCapability, serviceInteractionIndicatorsTwo, carrier, cug-Index, cug-Interlock, cug-OutgoingAccess, ext-basicServiceCode, and callReferenceNumber.

q_6201.question: What occurs for interception of content of communications in the S8HR LI solution?
q_6201.ground_truth: For each intercepted IMS session, LMISF determines whether a CC interception is required and provides IMS Signalling Bearer information to the S-GW/BBIFF, which delivers media packets associated with the IMS Signalling Bearer to the LMISF. The LMISF includes the Correlation Information in the CC delivered to the Delivery Function 3. When interception is to be stopped, LMISF stops delivering the CC and providing the IMS Signalling Bearer information to the S-GW/BBIFF.

q_6202.question: What are the KPI categories covered in the present document for E-UTRAN?
q_6202.ground_truth: The KPI categories covered in the present document for E-UTRAN include Accessibility, Retainability, Integrity, Availability, Mobility, and Energy Efficiency.

q_6203.question: What happens when a user with a preferential CUG and the OA capability originates a call without CUG information?
q_6203.ground_truth: The call is established using the preferential CUG and with an indication of OA allowed.

q_6204.question: What are the required URLs in the metadata envelope when updating a metadata fragment during an MBMS User Service session?
q_6204.ground_truth: The URL in the metadata envelope shall be the same as the URL of the metadata fragment in the MBMS Download session and the metadata fragment in the metadata envelope shall be identified by the same URL as used in user service announcement.

q_6205.question: Which system information block type contains ANSI-41 system information?
q_6205.ground_truth: The system information block type 13 contains ANSI-41 system information.

q_6206.question: If none of the sets of Random Access resources are available for any feature applicable to the current Random Access procedure, what should the MAC entity select from the available sets of Random Access resources?
q_6206.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select the set(s) of Random Access resources that are not associated with any feature indication for this Random Access procedure.

q_6207.question: What are the two approaches for convolving the DUT antenna patterns with MIMO channel models?
q_6207.ground_truth: The two approaches are applying antenna patterns to geometric (Ray-based) channel models, and applying antenna patterns to correlation-based channel models.

q_6208.question: What information is sent from the MSC/SGSN to the UE in a LCS MO-LR Return Result message?
q_6208.ground_truth: The MSC/SGSN includes the LDR reference number, the H-GMLC address, any reporting PLMN list, and an indication whether MO-LR Short Circuit is allowed.

q_6209.question: What type of enumerated value is used to specify the role type details of PoC users?

q_6210.question: What is the role of the DVB-MABR Multicast gateway function in Collaboration D?
q_6210.ground_truth: In Collaboration D, the DVB-MABR Multicast gateway function could play the role of the 5MBS-Aware Application, handling media object reassembly, repair procedures, and onward delivery to a media player.

q_6211.question: What happens to QoS rules in the primary BBERF when the primary-BBERF reports failure to activate a QoS rule?
q_6211.ground_truth: The PCRF removes the same QoS rule from the non-primary BBERFs, if any are already installed, and the corresponding PCC rule from the PCEF.

q_6212.question: When should the MGCF defer sending the INVITE request?
q_6212.ground_truth: The MGCF should defer sending the INVITE request until both remote and local preconditions are met, if the incoming SIP INVITE request indicates that remote preconditions are not met or when local preconditions are not met.

q_6213.question: What are the two scenarios considered for NWDAF-assisted RAT/frequency selection in Use Case #1?
q_6213.ground_truth: The two scenarios considered for NWDAF-assisted RAT/frequency selection in Use Case #1 are enabling inter-RAT selection from NR to E-UTRAN and frequency selection from NR with high frequency to NR with low frequency.

q_6214.question: What action can the GANC take when it receives an updated identity of the serving cell while the MS is in UTRAN mode?
q_6214.ground_truth: The GANC may optionally send the GA-RC REGISTER REDIRECT message to redirect the MS to another serving GANC

q_6215.question: What is the purpose of Integrity protection in the RRC protocol?
q_6215.ground_truth: The purpose of Integrity protection in the RRC protocol is to add a Message Authentication Code (MAC-I) to those RRC messages that are considered sensitive and/or contain sensitive information.

q_6216.question: What are the functions of the S1-U interface between the eNB and UPE in EPC?
q_6216.ground_truth: The S1-U interface supports the tunnelling of end user packets between the eNB and the UPE, with functions such as indication of the SAE Access Bearer in the target node that the packet belongs to, means to minimize packet losses due to mobility, error handling mechanism, MBMS support functions, and packet loss detection mechanism.

q_6217.question: What is the length of the BCD number in the recorded data?
q_6217.ground_truth: The length of the BCD number is "03" in the recorded data.

q_6218.question: What should be possible for a UE to indicate when it is capable of becoming a Controller UE?
q_6218.ground_truth: It should be possible for a UE to indicate that it is capable of becoming a Controller UE.

q_6219.question: What should the UE do if it does not meet the pre-test conditions for sending a SERVICE REQUEST message with "Rejection of paging" request type?
q_6219.ground_truth: The UE should not attempt to send the SERVICE REQUEST message with "Rejection of paging" request type.

q_6220.question: Which section of the document discusses the co-existence summary of the needed studies for the additional band receiver?
q_6220.ground_truth: Section 7.85.3, 7.86.3, and 7.87.3 for the additional band receiver of DC LTE inter-band 2DL/1UL + inter-band NR 2DL/1UL.

q_6221.question: When is HS-SCCH type 4 used in 4.6D of the document?
q_6221.ground_truth: HS-SCCH type 4 is used for single stream transmission in MIMO mode or in MU-MIMO mode.

q_6222.question: What should the UE do when upper layers request a PDCP re-establishment for LWA bearers?
q_6222.ground_truth: The UE should process any received PDCP Data PDUs from lower layers, stop and reset the reordering timer, deliver stored PDCP SDUs to upper layers, set certain SN values, and apply the ciphering algorithm and key provided by upper layers.

q_6223.question: What does the "Allowed Queuing Time" parameter specify in the context of this given text?
q_6223.ground_truth: The "Allowed Queuing Time" parameter specifies the maximum queuing time that is allowed in the DRNS until the DRNS must start to execute the request.

q_6224.question: What is the requirement for the NRM defined in 3GPP TS 28.621 to be a member of the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM)?
q_6224.ground_truth: The NRM defined in 3GPP TS 28.621 shall support management of networks that include virtualized network functions and is a member of the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM), with its information derived from the FNIM Umbrella Information Model (UIM).

q_6225.question: What value should octet 2 have for a BTS object instance in the Object Instance field?
q_6225.ground_truth: Octet 2 should contain a binary presentation of the identifier of the addressed BTS when octet 1 is set to the BTS object class.

q_6226.question: What should the MGCF do if it receives a 3xx response to an outbound call?
q_6226.ground_truth: The default behavior of the MGCF is to release the call by sending to the preceding SIP-I based circuit-switched core network 480 Temporarily unavailable and encapsulate an ISUP REL message with a cause code value 127 (Interworking unspecified).

q_6227.question: What information is used to identify the mixing of associated media streams for a conference distinct from any other mixing or media handling in IMS conference events?
q_6227.ground_truth: The identity of the source (i.e., conference party identity) of a media stream, time stamp (optional), and direction (incoming or outgoing stream) are used to identify the mixing of associated media streams for a conference distinct from any other mixing or media handling in IMS conference events.

q_6228.question: What should a mobile station do upon successfully completing the PS handover procedure during A/Gb mode to A/Gb mode PS handover?
q_6228.ground_truth: The mobile station shall consider all radio bearers in the old cell as implicitly released, send the NAS Container for PS Handover IE to upper layers if it was included in the PS HANDOVER COMMAND message, start an instance of T3180 corresponding to each uplink TBF allocated by the PS HANDOVER COMMAND message, and start an instance of T3190 corresponding to each downlink TBF allocated by the PS HANDOVER COMMAND message.

q_6229.question: What are the two types of supplementary service actions that can be recorded in SS-action records?
q_6229.ground_truth: The two types of supplementary service actions that can be recorded in SS-action records are call related and non-call related actions.

q_6230.question: What should an SGSN do when conditions 1) or 2) are met for communication with an MS via a specific cell?
q_6230.ground_truth: The SGSN should stop sending LLC-PDUs to the cell for the MS.

q_6231.question: What does the PDN-GW send in the PMIP UPN message in case of a P-CSCF failure in step 2 of the network recovery information flow with S5 PMIP?
q_6231.ground_truth: The PDN-GW sends a PMIP UPN message with the new list of P-CSCF addresses and the P-CSCF failure Indicator in the PCO to the MME as part of the PGW initiated bearer modification without QoS update procedure.

q_6232.question: What is the capacity increase estimated for AMR using a C/I threshold of 18 dB and a safety margin of 7 dB?
q_6232.ground_truth: The capacity increase estimated for AMR using a C/I threshold of 18 dB and a safety margin of 7 dB is 30%.

q_6233.question: What should the MBMS client include in the message body of the HTTP response for partial files?
q_6233.ground_truth: The message body includes a multipart message body with one or more body parts, each with its own Content-Type and Content-Range fields indicating the byte range of the partial file being returned.

q_6234.question: When does the UE sends a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI and the same DNN upon PLMN change?
q_6234.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI and the same DNN in the new PLMN, if T3584 is running or is deactivated for the S-NSSAI, DNN, and old PLMN, but T3584 is not running and is not deactivated for the S-NSSAI, DNN, and new PLMN.

q_6235.question: What are the two main components of Timed Graphics in 3GPP?
q_6235.ground_truth: The two main components of Timed Graphics in 3GPP are the graphics description, i.e. the actual images, and the layout, i.e. a coordinate system describing the placement of the images.

q_6236.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the Moving scenario and periodic update, starting from Rel-14 of E-UTRA UE?
q_6236.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE with LPP Release 14 onwards that supports A-GNSS with periodical reporting, except Category M1 and Category M2 devices that do not support VoLTE.

q_6237.question: What is the purpose of PTC Party Retrieve event defined in the PTC Surveillance Events?
q_6237.ground_truth: The purpose of PTC Party Retrieve event defined in the PTC Surveillance Events is to indicate the target retrieving an on-going PTC Session after placing it on hold.

q_6238.question: What action will the SAS take if it cannot carry out the requested information provision?
q_6238.ground_truth: The SAS will send the INFORMATION EXCHANGE INITIATION FAILURE message, with the Cause IE set to an appropriate value such as "Information temporarily not available".

q_6239.question: What are the supported bit depths for the HEVC-UHD-Enc?
q_6239.ground_truth: The supported bit depths for the HEVC-UHD-Enc are 8 and 10 bit.

q_6240.question: When is a NULL frame transmitted using LLGMM-TRIGGER-REQ in the SGSN?
q_6240.ground_truth: A NULL frame with P=0 is transmitted on any SAPI in the SGSN when there is no frame waiting to be transmitted, and both cell update is indicated by the SGSN and the LLE is in ABM state.

q_6241.question: What is the difference between static and dynamic rate matching?
q_6241.ground_truth: Static rate matching is a part of the semi-static attributes of the Transport Channel, while dynamic rate matching adjusts the size of the physical layer data payload to the physical channel as requested by RRC.

q_6242.question: What should the RNC do if the UE was authenticated with UMTS AKA and the IK fulfils the given equation?
q_6242.ground_truth: The RNC can deduce that the UE was authenticated using GSM AKA.

q_6243.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Report on supporting NR operation from 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz?
q_6243.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to study the requirements and necessary changes for the 3GPP New Radio (NR) system to operate in the frequency range from 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz, which includes licensed and unlicensed bands.

q_6244.question: What action does the BSS take if it receives an UPLINK REJECT COMMAND message containing a talker priority that is less than or equal to the current talker priority and the uplink for the requesting MS needs to be released?
q_6244.ground_truth: The BSS releases the uplink for the requesting MS, sets the current talker priority to the value of the priority in the Current Talker Priority IE received in the UPLINK REJECT COMMAND message, and initiates the radio interface uplink busy procedure.

q_6245.question: What is one way that attackers can obtain information for social-network SPAMming?
q_6245.ground_truth: Attackers can obtain information for social-network SPAMming from prevalent social-network sites which provide them with names and contact information of whole relationship webs.

q_6246.question: What is the criterion for determining radio link failure in the BSS during a voice group call?
q_6246.ground_truth: The criterion for determining radio link failure in the BSS during a voice group call should be based upon either the error rate on the uplink SACCH(s) or on RXLEV/RXQUAL measurements of the MS.

q_6247.question: How does specializedResourceReportArg utilize its arguments, namely allAnnouncementsComplete or firstAnnouncementStarted?
q_6247.ground_truth: The specializedResourceReportArg operation uses the allAnnouncementsComplete argument to indicate that all announcements have completed, and it uses the firstAnnouncementStarted argument to denote that the first announcement has started during the playAnnouncement operation.

q_6248.question: What information does the PCRF provide to the PCEF for usage monitoring control?
q_6248.ground_truth: The PCRF provides usage monitoring control information to the PCEF by including a Usage-Monitoring-Information AVP per monitoring key. The threshold level is provided in its Granted-Service-Unit AVP. Threshold levels may be defined for total volume, uplink volume, downlink volume, uplink and downlink volume, or time. The PCRF may provide multiple usage monitoring control instances, and indicate if the usage monitoring instance applies to the IP-CAN session or to one or more PCC rules.

q_6249.question: What is the purpose of the address field in an LLC frame?
q_6249.ground_truth: The address field in an LLC frame consists of a single octet and identifies the SAPI and DLCI for which a downlink frame is intended and the DLCI transmitting an uplink frame.

q_6250.question: What is the function of the "IPFlow" node in the ISRP rules?
q_6250.ground_truth: The "IPFlow" node indicates the flow description for a particular flow distribution rule in the ISRP rules.

q_6251.question: What is the purpose of the "Authentication Service (ANS)" and "Authorization Service (ARS)" in the context of the present document?
q_6251.ground_truth: The "Authentication Service (ANS)" is responsible for proving the identity of a management service consumer or producer, while the "Authorization Service (ARS)" ensures that an authenticated management service consumer has the corresponding access rights to services and resources.

q_6252.question: How does the Core Network provide the SRNC with the list of MBMS services activated by a UE?
q_6252.ground_truth: The Core Network initiates the MBMS UE Linking procedure and sends a RANAP MBMS UE Linking Request message to the SRNC with the list of MBMS Service Ids activated by the UE.

q_6253.question: What should the network do when a new voice broadcast call is received while there is an ongoing call with identical group ID and group call area?
q_6253.ground_truth: The network should reject the new call with cause busy and the mobile station should read the notifications for the corresponding group ID on the NCH.

q_6254.question: What is the maximum open circuit voltage specified in IEC 61000-4-4 for the evaluation of fast transients on signal and control ports?
q_6254.ground_truth: The maximum open circuit voltage for fast transients on signal and control ports is 0.5 kV.

q_6255.question: What is the effect of "Call control result " Allowed with modifications", if the modifications involve changing the dialled number?
q_6255.ground_truth: If the "Call control result" is "Allowed with modifications" and the modifications involve changing the dialled number, the ME does not re-check this modified number against the FDN list when FDN is enabled.

q_6256.question: What is the challenge request used in GBA authentication?
q_6256.ground_truth: The challenge request is a HTTP response code 401 "Unauthorized" which contains a WWW-Authenticate header carrying a Digest authentication request. It is used by the NAF to initiate AA authentication. The "realm" attribute starts with the prefix "3GPP-bootstrapping@" or "3GPP-bootstrapping-uicc@".

q_6257.question: What happens if the eNB cannot comply with the UP IP policy received from the MME?
q_6257.ground_truth: The eNB will not overrule the policy if it is set to REQUIRED, and if it is set to PREFERRED, the eNB will try to enable UP IP.

q_6258.question: Which RLC PDU does an UM RLC entity deliver/receive for data transfer in the E-UTRA RLC?
q_6258.ground_truth: An UM RLC entity delivers/receives UMD PDU for data transfer in the E-UTRA RLC.

q_6259.question: What are some of the parameters assigned to an operation point for TV services in the 3GPP Technical Report?
q_6259.ground_truth: The parameters include spatial and temporal resolutions, bit depth, color space, signaling of SEI messages and service specific requirements for adaptive resolution switching.

q_6260.question: What should the UE do if it does not support the number of TFS or the coding of a certain transport channel on a Secondary CCPCH?
q_6260.ground_truth: The UE should still be able to decode other transport channels mapped on the same Secondary CCPCH that is consistent with what is supported by the UE.

q_6261.question: What is the difference between early assignment and very early assignment in mobile originating call establishment?
q_6261.ground_truth: In early assignment, the network allocates a traffic channel to the mobile station before it initiates call establishment in the fixed network, while in very early assignment, the network assigns the traffic channel at the earliest possible moment, i.e. in the immediate assignment procedure.

q_6262.question: What is ProSe Direct Discovery a procedure for in 3GPP systems?
q_6262.ground_truth: ProSe Direct Discovery is a procedure employed by a ProSe-enabled UE to discover other ProSe-enabled UEs in its vicinity using only the capabilities of the two UEs with E-UTRA or NR technology.

q_6263.question: Which of the listed abbreviations in the document pertains to a satellite-based navigation system developed by Russia?
q_6263.ground_truth: GLONASS (abbreviated as GLObal NAvigation Satellite System), which is a satellite-based navigation system developed by Russia.

q_6264.question: What is the maximum number of channels allowed per FLUTE session?
q_6264.ground_truth: Only one FLUTE channel is allowed per FLUTE session in the present document and thus there is no further need for a descriptor of the number of channels.

q_6265.question: What information about the UE does the PCRF provide to the TSSF when provisioning of traffic steering control information?
q_6265.ground_truth: The PCRF provides the UE IP address and the associated APN.

q_6266.question: What is the second command sent by the UICC to the ME for setting up a call with two alpha identifiers coded in UCS2 and Katakana characters?

q_6267.question: What entities are responsible for handling ProSe Direct Discovery functionality and charging?
q_6267.ground_truth: 5G DDNMFs in HPLMN, VPLMN, and local PLMNs are responsible for the ProSe Direct Discovery functionality, i.e. allocating the ProSe code and managing the ProSe UE's ProSe discovery context. The chargeable ProSe direct discovery events can be collected and reported by the 5G DDNMFs to the corresponding CHF in the same PLMN.

q_6268.question: What is the main difference between scenario 1 and scenario 2 in terms of the users they represent?
q_6268.ground_truth: Scenario 1 represents users on traffic channels that are tightly planned due to limited spectrum, while scenario 2 represents users on a broadcast channel that is sparsely planned to ensure secure signalling operation.

q_6269.question: What action does the SGSN take after receiving the Delete Bearer Response message?
q_6269.ground_truth: The SGSN deletes the bearer contexts related to the deactivated EPS bearer and acknowledges the bearer deactivation to the Serving GW by sending a Delete Bearer Response (TEID, EPS Bearer Identity, User Location Information) message.

q_6270.question: What is the S102 message header format?
q_6270.ground_truth: The S102 message header is a fixed-length header consisting of at least 7 octets. Octet 1 consists of A21 Message type, and Octets 2-7 contain the Correlation Identifier.

q_6271.question: What are the two possible indications that the PHY-ACCESS-CNF primitive can provide to MAC after a synchronization burst on its associated FPACH?
q_6271.ground_truth: The two possible indications are "ready for RACH data transmission" and "no response received on FPACH".

q_6272.question: What is the role of MTP3-user signalling messages in the IP-based SS7 signalling transport network?
q_6272.ground_truth: MTP3-user signalling messages are transported in accordance with the M3UA protocol architecture defined in the case of IP-based SS7 signalling transport network.

q_6273.question: What is the state of the UE at the beginning of the test procedure sequence?
q_6273.ground_truth: The UE is in state Switched OFF (state 0-A) at the beginning of the test procedure sequence.

q_6274.question: What is the purpose of the cipher sequence number (COUNT-C)?
q_6274.ground_truth: The cipher sequence number (COUNT-C) is used for synchronization of the keystream, allowing it to be synchronized every 10ms physical layer frame.

q_6275.question: Which protocol does the provided document define the parameters for?

q_6276.question: What is the meaning of "PC" in the technical report?
q_6276.ground_truth: PC stands for Power Class in the context of the technical report.

q_6277.question: What is the new 5GMM cause value used for in solution ~2.9?
q_6277.ground_truth: The new 5GMM cause value is used to conceal the failure cause and mitigate the linkability attack during the initial Registration procedure in UE.

q_6278.question: What is the mechanism defined in IETF RFC 8443 used for in the context of SIP call control signalling?
q_6278.ground_truth: The mechanism defined in IETF RFC 8443 is used to protect the integrity of MPS priority markings and convey trusted assertions of MPS authorization in SIP call control signalling.

q_6279.question: What is the responsibility of the 3GPP TS 48.060 and 3GPP TS 48.061 in the case of a 2 048 kbit/sec circuit?
q_6279.ground_truth: They are responsible for defining the speech, data and signalling channels with transmission rates of 8~kbit/s, 16 kbit/s or 64 kbit/s, and the rate adaptation and multiplexing to fit into the physical interface.

q_6280.question: What are some new service models that should be developed for different categories of mobile services?
q_6280.ground_truth: Different service models should be developed for person-to-content, person-to-person, and machine-to-machine type of services to enable faster, more flexible and more cost efficient service provisioning.

q_6281.question: What should the AS do upon receiving the first SIP 18x response to the initial INVITE request containing an Alert-Info header field with a URL of CRS media?
q_6281.ground_truth: The AS should forward the INVITE request after removing the Alert-Info header field if the CRS service provided by the AS serving the terminating UE has no priority.

q_6282.question: What is the default method for signaling application layer redundancy adaptation requests, as per GSMA IR.92?
q_6282.ground_truth: The default method for signaling application layer redundancy adaptation requests, as per GSMA IR.92, is RTP CMR using the Reserved CMR codepoints.

q_6283.question: What should a UE do if a new signalling connection request is received during the transition to idle mode?
q_6283.ground_truth: The UE should queue any new signalling connection requests and process them after it has entered idle mode.

q_6284.question: What should the SAS do in case the GANSS Code Phase Ambiguity IE and GANSS Code Phase Ambiguity Extension IE are not present within the GANSS Measurement Parameters IE for a given satellite in the GANSS Measured Results IE?
q_6284.ground_truth: The SAS shall use the default value of 1 (ms) for the GANSS Code Phase Ambiguity value to compute the value of the Total Code Phase for the related satellite.

q_6285.question: What shall the BM-SC do when it receives a GCS-Action-Request command including the TMGI-Deallocation-Request AVP?
q_6285.ground_truth: The BM-SC shall determine whether the GCS AS is authorized to deallocate the TMGIs and then send a GCS-Action-Answer (GAA) command including a TMGI-Deallocation-Response AVP for each TMGI contained in the TMGI-Deallocation-Request AVP.

q_6286.question: In the UTRAN-Streaming tab, what information is provided for both RFC 5053 and the Ideal code?
q_6286.ground_truth: The media bitrate supported by both codes for the UMTS streaming cases is provided in this tab.

q_6287.question: What are the requirements for the Play Message function in playing the messaging media stream?
q_6287.ground_truth: Detection of DTMF digits is not required, and the messaging media stream shall not be played in a loop. The MRFP message file formats shall comply with the file formats used inside MMS.

q_6288.question: What interface provides in-band rate and mode control via the EVS-CMR field in every Codec frame for EVS on the Nb interface?
q_6288.ground_truth: Only EVS-CMR, as specified in the present document, provides for in-band rate and mode control via the EVS-CMR field of every Codec frame (Speech or SID) and CMR-Only frame on the Nb interface.

q_6289.question: What is the purpose of the Local MBMS option in 3GPP TS 23.285?
q_6289.ground_truth: The Local MBMS was introduced in 3GPP TS 23.285 for the purpose of MBMS latency improvements.

q_6290.question: What is the role of the AMF in the N2 based procedure of multicast session path addition due to UE mobility?
q_6290.ground_truth: The AMF performs the steps for the N2 based handover procedure for all PDU Sessions, initiates the multicast session join procedure with the (MB-)SMF and (MB-)UPF to add the target gNB into the multicast session, and forwards the N2 MB Info to the (MB-)SMF for reserving forwarding resources.

q_6291.question: What should the network do if the request has no BasicServiceCode and the erasure was successful for all basic services?
q_6291.ground_truth: The network may send an empty return result to the MS.

q_6292.question: What is the role of the Notification of Charging information to served MS in mobile originated and mobile terminated calls?
q_6292.ground_truth: The network may indicate charging information to the MS at mobile originated and mobile terminated call set-up, to provide Advice Of Charge Charging or Advice Of Charge Information charging parameters to the MS.

q_6293.question: What does Solution #6 propose for addressing key issue #9?
q_6293.ground_truth: Solution #6 proposes to provision an Edge Data Network deployment for FFAPP.

q_6294.question: What are the two options for the locations of AI/ML Model Training and Inference for mobility solutions, and what is the additional option for CU-DU split scenario?
q_6294.ground_truth: The two options are (1) AI/ML Model Training function deployed in OAM and Model Inference function resides within the RAN node, (2) Both the AI/ML Model Training function and the AI/ML Model Inference function reside within the RAN node. The additional option for CU-DU split scenario is AI/ML Model Training located in CU-CP or OAM, and AI/ML Model Inference function located in CU-CP.

q_6295.question: When must the UE perform cell reselection evaluation for NR frequencies and inter-RAT frequencies?
q_6295.ground_truth: The UE must perform cell reselection evaluation for NR frequencies and inter-RAT frequencies that are given in system information and for which the UE has a priority provided.

q_6296.question: What is the purpose of zero-input response subtraction in hted signal processing?
q_6296.ground_truth: The purpose of zero-input response subtraction is to remove the zero-input response (ZIR) of the combination of the weighting filter and synthesis filter from the weighted signal, which helps to reduce the distortion and improve the quality of the signal.

q_6297.question: What is the alphabet used in the short message?

q_6298.question: What are the four functional components of GUP authorization?
q_6298.ground_truth: The four functional components of GUP authorization are management of authorization related data, access/storage of the authorization rules, encapsulation of a set of authorization rules together with transported actual data, and execution of authorization logic based on pre-defined authorization rules and information received in the request.

q_6299.question: When must the Node B initiate the Information Reporting procedure for the GANSS Generic Data IE so that it contains the GANSS Navigation Model And Time Recovery?
q_6299.ground_truth: When the GANSS Generic Data IE does not contain the GANSS ID IE, the Node B shall assume that the corresponding GANSS is "Galileo"; if the Information Report Characteristics IE is set to "On Modification" and the GANSS Generic Data IE does not contain the GANSS Navigation Model And Time Recovery, but the node expects it to become available after some acquisition time, the Node B shall initiate the Information Reporting procedure when it becomes available.

q_6300.question: What is one way for network service providers to alleviate the burden of delivering real-time, high data rate content to a large number of viewers?
q_6300.ground_truth: One way is for content providers to use multicast for large scale delivery of such content, coordinating with network service providers.

q_6301.question: What are the two operational modes supported by the LLC layer?
q_6301.ground_truth: The two operational modes supported by the LLC layer are unacknowledged peer-to-peer operation (Asynchronous Disconnected Mode, ADM) and acknowledged peer-to-peer operation (Asynchronous Balanced Mode, ABM).

q_6302.question: What should the SCC AS do when it becomes aware that the remote precondition is fulfilled on both legs of a call?
q_6302.ground_truth: The SCC AS will send a SIP UPDATE request to the ICS UE indicating that the precondition is met.

q_6303.question: What is the scope of the present document, TS 32.409, in relation to Performance Management?
q_6303.ground_truth: The present document describes the measurements of IMS and is valid for all measurement types provided by an implementation of an IMS network.

q_6304.question: How is the term "Codeword" defined in the context of the document?
q_6304.ground_truth: A Codeword is an access code used by a Requestor or LCS Client to gain acceptance of a location request for a Target UE. It is part of the privacy information registered by a Target UE user.

q_6305.question: What is a secondary serving HS-DSCH cell except the first one in the serving HS-DSCH cell list called in the document?
q_6305.ground_truth: The UE may refer to it as the n-th secondary serving HS-DSCH cell, where n is a positive integer greater than 1.

q_6306.question: What is the purpose of the "BroadcastGANSSAssistanceDataDecipheringKeys" in the "LocationRelatedDataResponseIEs" sequence?
q_6306.ground_truth: The "BroadcastGANSSAssistanceDataDecipheringKeys" in the "LocationRelatedDataResponseIEs" sequence is used to indicate the deciphering keys for broadcast GANSS assistance data.

q_6307.question: How does a server respond when it is not yet able to begin streaming after receiving a PLAY request?
q_6307.ground_truth: The server responds with a 202 (Accepted) success code and with the SDP, allowing the client to specify the streams it would like to receive in a later request.

q_6308.question: What happens to the send and transmit buffers when a suspension is initiated in the MS?
q_6308.ground_truth: When a suspension is initiated, no further layer~3 messages are taken from the send queue for SAPI=0. If there is a message in the send buffer which has not yet been transmitted, it is not transmitted and its contents are put back to the first position of the send queue. The send and transmit buffers are then cleared.

q_6309.question: What does the r12:FDTInstanceURI element provide when present in the session schedule?
q_6309.ground_truth: The r12:FDTInstanceURI element provides the location of an FDT Instance that describes all of the files delivered during the associated session occurrence when present in the session schedule and the index is described in the sessionSchedule. When the r12:FDTInstanceURI element is present and the index is not described in the sessionSchedule, then it provides the location of an FDT Instance that describes all the files delivered during the session.

q_6310.question: Which symbols are used to represent interfaces in the document?
q_6310.ground_truth: The Nc, Mc, and Nb interfaces are represented by the symbols Nc, Mc, and Nb, respectively.

q_6311.question: What is the expected sequence 1.1 for the PROVIDE LOCAL INFORMATION command?
q_6311.ground_truth: Expected sequence 1.1 is for the ME to return the requested local information such as Mobile Country Code (MCC), Mobile Network Code (MNC), Location Area Code (LAC), and cell ID of the current serving cell within a TERMINAL RESPONSE.

q_6312.question: Which network entities does the Performance Assurance MnS Producer collect information from in Potential Solution #1?
q_6312.ground_truth: The Performance Assurance MnS Producer collects OA&M performance measurements related to UPF load from UPF and SMF in Potential Solution #1.

q_6313.question: What is one of the considerations the UE uses when selecting a transmission duration for transmitting a voice packet on the uplink?
q_6313.ground_truth: The power headroom at the UE.

q_6314.question: How many hops can a chain of relays in a virtual cluster have in a typical case?
q_6314.ground_truth: A chain of relays in a virtual cluster typically has 2 to 3 hops in a typical case.

q_6315.question: What is the logical interface between the Node B and RNC components of the UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network (UTRAN)?

q_6316.question: What should the V-PCRF do when it detects an existing S9 subsession for a PDN connection that is linked to a different gateway control session?
q_6316.ground_truth: The V-PCRF shall follow the procedures in clause 4.5.2.5.

q_6317.question: What is the significance of the public/private key in the authorization token generation and verification process?
q_6317.ground_truth: The public/private key is significant in the authorization token generation and verification process as it is used to sign and verify the tokens to ensure they cannot be modified or forged by an attacker and to authenticate the user. The public key can also be used to check the policies/claims in the token by the receiving side to decide if it should continue the procedure.

q_6318.question: What type of positioning method is RF Pattern Matching (RFPM) in 3G UMTS network?
q_6318.ground_truth: RF Pattern Matching (RFPM) is a positioning method in 3G UMTS network that is based on predictions or models of the radio environment against which it performs an algorithmic comparison of the measurements to determine a best match estimation of the UE's location.

q_6319.question: What is the name of the message that the RAN sends in each cell belonging to the URA/GRA where the MS exists to page the MS?

q_6320.question: What features does the "Basic capability" in DCH Enhancements support?
q_6320.ground_truth: The "Basic capability" in DCH Enhancements supports Basic mode of DL FET (Mode 0), Pilot-free DL DPCH slot formats #17 and #18, Pseudo flexible rate matching, Uplink DPCCH slot format #5, and Uplink DPDCH dynamic 10ms transmission.

q_6321.question: What was the issue uncovered with the 3GPP EVS de-jitter buffer handling in the MBMS downlink packet scheduler?
q_6321.ground_truth: The issue uncovered was that the JBM was not exercising partial copy recovery logic in low jitter scenarios and was locking up in a low jitter, high FER scenario.

q_6322.question: What must the timer Tast be restarted after sending to the MSC?
q_6322.ground_truth: Timer Tast is (re-)started after sending either a VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT RESULT or a VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT STATUS message to the MSC.

q_6323.question: Which integrity protection algorithm is allowed for an unauthenticated UE, allowing establishment of emergency services?
q_6323.ground_truth: The "null integrity protection algorithm" 5G-IA0 is allowed for an unauthenticated UE for which the establishment of emergency services is allowed.

q_6324.question: In UE-initiated mode, when does the PCEF initiate an IP-CAN Session Modification procedure and provide the Routing Rule received from the UE to the PCRF as an NBIFOM Routing Rule?
q_6324.ground_truth: When the PCEF has received a request from the UE to create / modify / delete a Routing Rule.

q_6325.question: What value of the Revalidation-Time AVP indicates that the PCEF will have to re-request PCC rules before the specified NTP time?
q_6325.ground_truth: The Revalidation-Time AVP (AVP code 1042) is of type Time and indicates the NTP time before which the PCEF will have to re-request PCC rules.

q_6326.question: What message does the SMF create to initiate the service-level authentication and authorization procedure?
q_6326.ground_truth: The SMF creates a SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.

q_6327.question: Who decides to perform a switch from shared to individual MBS traffic delivery in Alternative 2?
q_6327.ground_truth: MBSF is the entity that decides to perform a switch from shared to individual MBS traffic delivery in Alternative 2.

q_6328.question: What benefits does TB processing over multiple slots PUSCH (TBoMS) provide in terms of coverage enhancement?
q_6328.ground_truth: TBoMS provides lower effective coding rate and/or energy per resource element (EPRE) increase, both leading to coverage enhancement for PUSCH except Msg3.

q_6329.question: What should the 3GPP system support when identifying and providing priority treatment to the affected signaling and media flows associated with an MPS Service User on an MMTEL video conference call with multiple participants when MPS is invoked?

q_6330.question: What is the purpose of the SS7 Security Gateway in a PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network)?
q_6330.ground_truth: The SS7 Security Gateway in a PLMN is responsible for protecting and de-protecting TCAP user signalling messages entering or leaving the PLMN. It performs protection of outbound messages, protection checking and de-protection or blocking of inbound messages, and unmodified passing of TCAP user messages in certain scenarios.

q_6331.question: When should a PDCP status report be triggered by the receiving PDCP entity?
q_6331.ground_truth: A PDCP status report should be triggered when the upper layer requests a PDCP entity re-establishment or a PDCP data recovery.

q_6332.question: What is the purpose of using RSRQ in the priority-based cell re-selection criteria?
q_6332.ground_truth: RSRQ is used for link quality determination for handover purposes in the priority-based cell re-selection criteria.

q_6333.question: When are the interchange circuits towards the modem switched to ON at the start of timer T for each of the allocated traffic channel(s)?
q_6333.ground_truth: They are switched to ON after the expiration of timer T of every allocated traffic channel, and after the establishment of the modem connection for mobile originated calls.

q_6334.question: What happens to the running Tsor-cm timers when the associated PDU sessions or services are released or stopped?
q_6334.ground_truth: The Tsor-cm timer is stopped when the associated PDU session is released or the associated service is stopped.

q_6335.question: What algorithms should the MME use when allowing an unauthenticated UE in LSM to establish bearers for emergency calls?
q_6335.ground_truth: EIA0 for integrity protection and EEA0 for ciphering

q_6336.question: What are the possible values of the privacy check related action indicator for call/session unrelated case?
q_6336.ground_truth: The possible values are: "Location allowed without notification", "Location allowed with notification", "Location with notification and privacy verification; location allowed if no response", "Location with notification and privacy verification; location restricted if no response", and "Location not allowed".

q_6337.question: What is the purpose of TP-Service-Centre-Time-Stamp in the SMS protocol?
q_6337.ground_truth: The TP-Service-Centre-Time-Stamp indicates the time that the message was sent by the service center, using the format of day, month, year, and hour, minute, second in GMT + 1.

q_6338.question: For what purpose is the ACT preference UTRAN/satellite NG-RAN test performed in the context of 3GPP?
q_6338.ground_truth: The ACT preference UTRAN/satellite NG-RAN test is performed to verify that the ACT with the higher priority takes precedence over the UPLMN with the lower priority during network selection, taking into account the new coding for RAT satellite NG-RAN.

q_6339.question: What is the TI flag value for the EVENT DOWNLOAD - CALL CONNECTED command in the Call Disconnected Event test?
q_6339.ground_truth: The TI flag value for the EVENT DOWNLOAD - CALL CONNECTED command in the Call Disconnected Event test is 1 (bit 8).

q_6340.question: What is the purpose of the access token in the authorization response in the domain-based mode?
q_6340.ground_truth: In the domain-based mode, the presence of an access token indicates that the BM-SC supports user-based authorization, allowing fine-grained authorization at the end-user level.

q_6341.question: What are the two main phases of testing for AMR-WB speech codec as reported in the technical report?
q_6341.ground_truth: The two main phases of testing for AMR-WB speech codec are the Characterisation Phase and the Verification Phase.

q_6342.question: What type of data does the "xs:doubleVectorType" complex type defined in the schema store?
q_6342.ground_truth: The "xs:doubleVectorType" complex type stores a list of double-precision floating-point values.

q_6343.question: What is the name of the mode that provides the results of the three binaural equalization methods compared to the data of ES202 for SWB mode?

q_6344.question: What is the purpose of the Reserve Units Request operation in the first step of the process?
q_6344.ground_truth: The Reserve Units Request operation in the first step is used by the ProSe Function to request service units for the Announcing UE.

q_6345.question: What are the possible values of "mbsfnBurstType4"?
q_6345.ground_truth: "mbsfnBurstType4" is an optional field in "MidambleShiftAndBurstType-VHCR", and it is defined as NULL.

q_6346.question: What is the requirement for measuring the N6 transmission delay in an unsynchronized scenario?
q_6346.ground_truth: The requirement for measuring the N6 transmission delay in an unsynchronized scenario is to obtain the Round Trip Time (RTT)/2 based on sending a Quality of Service (QoS) Monitoring Packet, which is specifically used for UL/DL packet delay measurement.

q_6347.question: What is a Network Element Front End (NE-FE) in the 3GPP UDC system?
q_6347.ground_truth: In the context of the 3GPP UDC system, a Network Element Front End (NE-FE) is a NE that stores persistent data in the User Data Repository (UDR) instead of storing it locally.

q_6348.question: What issue does a mobile station in DTM need to disable for the GPRS side?
q_6348.ground_truth: A mobile station in DTM must disable the timing advance features for the GPRS side. It must inhibit the transmission of timing advance access bursts and ignore the reception of GPRS timing advance messages if any.

q_6349.question: What is the role of the Delivery Method layer in MBMS-based services?
q_6349.ground_truth: The Delivery Method layer provides functionality such as security, reliability control, and delivery procedures. It defines four delivery methods, namely download, streaming, transparent, and group communication.

q_6350.question: What is a Dedicated Channel (DCH) in the Uu interface?
q_6350.ground_truth: A Dedicated Channel (DCH) in the Uu interface exists in uplink or downlink, and has the possibility to use beam forming, inner loop power control, and change rate fast. It is used for FDD and in uplink for TDD.

q_6351.question: What is the function of the "Set command" in 3GPP TS 23.040?
q_6351.ground_truth: The Set command is used to control the continuity of the SMS relay protocol link, allowing multiple messages to be sent much faster when enabled.

q_6352.question: In the context of FDD, when can the Node B use the CQI Feedback Cycle2 k value and CQI Cycle Switch Timer in HSDPA resources allocation for the UE?
q_6352.ground_truth: The Node B can use these values if the CQI Feedback Cycle2 k IE and the CQI Cycle Switch Timer IE are included in the HS-DSCH FDD Information IE.

q_6353.question: What should the UE do if the NAS-Container is included in the received masterKeyUpdate?
q_6353.ground_truth: The UE shall forward the nas-Container to the upper layers.

q_6354.question: What measurement rules should the UE follow for NB-IoT inter-frequency cell reselection?
q_6354.ground_truth: NB-IoT inter-frequency cell reselection should be based on ranking as defined in sub-clause 5.2.4.6 of TS 36.304.

q_6355.question: What is the role of the RAN regarding multicast data?
q_6355.ground_truth: The RAN selects PTP or PTM radio bearers to deliver the multicast PDUs to UEs that joined the multicast group.

q_6356.question: Who decides whether and how to align the PC5 DRX and the Uu DRX?
q_6356.ground_truth: The decision of whether and how to align the PC5 DRX and the Uu DRX needs coordination with RAN WGs.

q_6357.question: What is the role of the MBSF Client in retrieving the MBS User Service Description from the MBSTF Client?
q_6357.ground_truth: The MBSF Client can retrieve the MBS User Service Description from the MBSTF Client using procedures equivalent to those specified for unicast retrieval at reference point MBS-5. In this case, the MBSTF Client acts as a proxy for the MBS AF.

q_6358.question: What is used for quantization of LSF in SWB TBE channel aware mode?
q_6358.ground_truth: An 8-bit vector quantization is used for quantization of LSF in SWB TBE channel aware mode.

q_6359.question: What is the objective of the Iub interface specifications?
q_6359.ground_truth: The objective of the Iub interface specifications is to facilitate the interconnection of RNCs and Node Bs from different manufacturers, separating Iub interface Radio Network functionality and Transport Network functionality to facilitate the introduction of future technology.

q_6360.question: What protocols are used in the HNB-GW for supporting UTRAN functions in the HNB?
q_6360.ground_truth: The HNB-GW provides a concentration function for the control plane and may provide a concentration function for the user plane, supporting UTRAN functions in the HNB through RANAP and HNBAP protocols.

q_6361.question: How does a UE activate and deactivate the HOLD service?
q_6361.ground_truth: The HOLD service is activated at provisioning and deactivated at withdrawal; no specific registration is required.

q_6362.question: What are the two modes in which an RLP entity can be in?
q_6362.ground_truth: An RLP entity can be in one of two modes: Asynchronous Balanced Mode (ABM) or Asynchronous Disconnected Mode (ADM).

q_6363.question: Which requirement is specified in clause 6.5.3.2 from 38.101-1 for spurious emission band UE co-existence?
q_6363.ground_truth: The requirement is that the spurious emission band power in the affected UL band shall be below a certain level.

q_6364.question: What significance level did the Chi-square tests of the MANOVA roots show in the NB/ASY conditions, indicating that a single underlying variable accounts for the significant variation in the dependent variables?

q_6365.question: Which noise field simulation method shows the lowest RMSE values in NB mode?
q_6365.ground_truth: The TS 103 224 noise field simulation using the 8-channel noise recording shows the lowest RMSE values between 0.11 and 0.14 in NB mode.

q_6366.question: What is the response from the ME in the TERMINAL RESPONSE for Expected Sequence 2.1A?
q_6366.ground_truth: The ME responds with "Command performed successfully" and the IMSI information in the AT Response string

q_6367.question: For non-IP type PDN connection, what components are to be included in a single PCC Rule?
q_6367.ground_truth: A single PCC Rule for non-IP type PDN connection contains the following components: (1) a service data flow template matching all the packets, (2) a charging method, (3) a measurement method for offline charging, (4) a charging key (i.e. rating group), (5) a service identifier, and (6) a reporting level for the service data flow.

q_6368.question: What is the usage of the Macro eNodeB ID in a handover from GERAN/UTRAN to E-UTRAN Macro eNodeB or E-UTRAN Home eNodeB?
q_6368.ground_truth: The Macro eNodeB ID is used for handover from GERAN/UTRAN to E-UTRAN Macro eNodeB or E-UTRAN Home eNodeB and consists of 20 bits with the most significant bit in Octet 8 and the least significant bit in Octet 10. The coding of the Macro eNodeB ID is the responsibility of each administration.

q_6369.question: What shall the MRFP do when receiving a request for a host candidate for a media line?
q_6369.ground_truth: The MRFP shall allocate one host candidate for that media line and send it to the MRFC within the reply, with the IP address and port being the same as indicated separately as Local IP Resources.

q_6370.question: Which message type uses the "Circuit Identity Code List" information element?
q_6370.ground_truth: The "Circuit Identity Code List" information element is used in conjunction with a Circuit Identity Code to define a list of terrestrial channels.

q_6371.question: What are the three areas where MBMS and PSS service layer functionality do not fully support the recommended requirements for service interactivity?
q_6371.ground_truth: Notification of Interactivity Incidences, Personalization of Interactive User Experience, and Differentiating Contents in Bundled Delivery of Application Content.

q_6372.question: What waveform is supported for eMBB uplink for up to 40GHz, in addition to CP-OFDM?
q_6372.ground_truth: DFT-S-OFDM based waveform is supported for eMBB uplink for up to 40GHz, complementary to CP-OFDM waveform.

q_6373.question: Which exception is thrown if the 'offset' parameter would cause access outside array bounds in the 'setEventList' method?

q_6374.question: What is the role of a rate switching profile in the encoder program?
q_6374.ground_truth: A rate switching profile is an optional input to the encoder program that specifies the encoding bitrate for each frame of the input data. It is a binary file generated by the 'gen-rate-profile' tool, with 32-bit integer words representing the encoding bitrate for each frame. The rate switching profile can contain EVS primary mode bitrates and AMR-WB IO mode bitrates, allowing switching between the two modes to be specified by the rate switching profile.

q_6375.question: What happens if the MRFP supports the CVO feature but does not support the negotiation of the image size?
q_6375.ground_truth: The MRFC will ignore received generic image attributes and will return the SDP answer without any associated generic image attribute if it does not support the negotiation of the image size.

q_6376.question: How are SMS/CBS messages treated in the "Block Mode" and "PDU" mode in terms of modifications?
q_6376.ground_truth: In the "Block Mode" and "PDU" mode, a mobile is not permitted to modify any component of an SMS/CBS message received from the air interface or a TE before passing it on, except where defined by 3GPP TS 23.040 or 3GPP TS 23.041.

q_6377.question: How can the BSIC of a GSM cell be considered verified for a UE not requiring compressed mode?
q_6377.ground_truth: If the BSIC of a GSM cell is decoded and matches the expected value, it is considered as "verified".

q_6378.question: What is the purpose of the Monitoring-Flags AVP in the PCRF?
q_6378.ground_truth: The Monitoring-Flags AVP in the PCRF is used to exclude specific applications from TDF session level usage monitoring. It allows the PCRF to disable the exclusion of the application from session level monitoring by including the Monitoring-Flags AVP with the bit 0 not set in the corresponding ADC-Rule-Install AVP.

q_6379.question: What is the role of the Application Level Container in the monitoring procedure?
q_6379.ground_truth: The Application Level Container contains the Target RPAUIDs indicating what the UE is interested to monitor.

q_6380.question: What is the signal path where the base station transmits and the mobile receives in the E-UTRA system?

q_6381.question: What is the functional entity responsible for receiving and obtaining cost/tariff data in the IMS charging architecture?

q_6382.question: What does non-IP type PDN connection mean?
q_6382.ground_truth: Non-IP type PDN connection refers to connections that do not use the internet protocol (IP) for communication. This could include circuit-switched connections or other types of connections that do not use IP.

q_6383.question: What are the two types of spatial information feedback supported in CSI reporting?
q_6383.ground_truth: Type I feedback (codebook-based PMI feedback with normal spatial resolution) and Type II feedback (explicit feedback and/or codebook-based feedback with higher spatial resolution).

q_6384.question: What is the purpose of the "Decryption-KEY-URI" attribute in the FLUTE FDT?
q_6384.ground_truth: The "Decryption-KEY-URI" attribute in the FLUTE FDT indicates the association between a protected download file and the relevant decryption key file in the FLUTE FDT instance.

q_6385.question: When should the VLR send a BSSAP+-GPRS-DETACH-ACK message to the SGSN in the explicit GPRS detach procedure?
q_6385.ground_truth: The VLR should send a BSSAP+-GPRS-DETACH-ACK message to the SGSN if it receives a BSSAP+-GPRS-DETACH-INDICATION message in the explicit GPRS detach procedure, and stop the implicit detach timer if it is running.

q_6386.question: What is the event leading to the measurement of incoming PS data packets on the Gn interface, from SGSN to SGSN?
q_6386.ground_truth: Reception by the SGSN of a GTP Data PDU on the Gn interface from the SGSN triggers the measurement of incoming PS data packets on the Gn interface, from SGSN to SGSN.

q_6387.question: What does the sequence number N(R) indicate in I-frames and what is its purpose?
q_6387.ground_truth: N(R) in I-frames is used to acknowledge additional I-frames received by the data link layer entity.

q_6388.question: What is the minimum confidence level required in the test?
q_6388.ground_truth: The minimum confidence level required in the test is 95%.
