q_6389.question: What action does the UE take after receipt of th TrackingAreaUpdatComplete during registration message from the E-USS during the 7.4.5.4.2 procedure?
q_6389.ground_truth: The UE sends RRCConnectionRelease to the E-USS.

q_6390.question: What should a receiving node do if it receives a message initiating a procedure that contains one or more IEs/IE groups marked with "Reject IE" which it does not comprehend?
q_6390.ground_truth: The receiving node should terminate the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure.

q_6391.question: What does the acronym "IM" stand for in the title "Message Waiting Indication (MWI) using IP Multimedia (IM) Core Network (CN) subsystem"?

q_6392.question: What is the purpose of the ANR TDD Cell Information LCR IE?
q_6392.ground_truth: The ANR TDD Cell Information LCR IE provides information for a 1.28Mcps TDD cell that is a neighboring cell to the Base UTRAN cell in the ANR neighboring relation.

q_6393.question: What is the maximum number of "HSSCCHs" that can be specified for the "FDDFAP" complex type?

q_6394.question: What action does the MS EGAN Access Mode Switch take after receiving the SMREG-PDP-ACTIVATE-CNF during the handover from EGAN to GERAN/UTRAN?
q_6394.ground_truth: The MS EGAN Access Mode Switch sets the PDP context to ACTIVE on the GERAN/UTRAN side and submits subsequent uplink frames from the application to the SN-SAP of the Non Access Stratum of the MS.

q_6395.question: What information is indicated to the MS when the HSS has indicated "SMS in SGSN Support" in the MS?
q_6395.ground_truth: The MS is indicated that it can obtain SMS services via PS domain NAS from the SGSN.

q_6396.question: What message does the Serving GW send to the SGSN after receiving the Delete Bearer Response message?
q_6396.ground_truth: The Serving GW sends the Delete Bearer Response (TEID, EPS Bearer Identity, User Location Information) message to the SGSN.

q_6397.question: What are the five stages of the IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard?
q_6397.ground_truth: The five stages of the IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard are iPL3, iPL5, iPL7, iPL10, and iPL15.

q_6398.question: What must the DRNS do upon receiving a RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message in 1.28Mcps TDD mode, if the Multi-Carrier E-DCH Physical Layer Category LCR IE is included in the E-DCH TDD Information LCR IE?
q_6398.ground_truth: The DRNS must use this information for the related resource allocation operation and for multi-carrier E-DCH scheduling.

q_6399.question: What is the relationship between the different version number digits in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_6399.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the approval status, the second digit indicates technical enhancements, and the third digit indicates editorial changes.

q_6400.question: What event can result in network-initiated IP-CAN session deactivation in the OCS?

q_6401.question: What is the 8-bit optional internal CRC used for?
q_6401.ground_truth: The optional internal 8-bit CRC is used for error detection in the payload on the Nb interface.

q_6402.question: What message does the MS sends to the GANC in Mobile Originated Call Flow?
q_6402.ground_truth: The MS sends the CM Service Request to the GANC in the GA-CSR UL DIRECT TRANSFER in Mobile Originated Call Flow.

q_6403.question: What function does the MBMS_NSAPI serve in the MBMS context activation procedure?
q_6403.ground_truth: The MBMS_NSAPI associates the MBMS UE Context with the PDP context over which the UE sent the IGMP/MLD Join message.

q_6404.question: What is the test purpose in 9.1.2.1?
q_6404.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the RSTD measurement reporting delay meets the requirements in an environment with fading propagation conditions.

q_6405.question: What is the purpose of the si-Window in acquiring SI messages or SIBs in 5G NR?
q_6405.ground_truth: The si-Window is used to determine the start of the window for acquiring a specific SI message or SIB within a modification period.

q_6406.question: What does the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Report signify?
q_6406.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Report presents the document's stage, ranging from a TSG-presented informative document to a TSG-approved document under change control.

q_6407.question: What should the IWF do when confidentiality protection is enabled and a decrypted XML element needs to be sent in a SIP request?
q_6407.ground_truth: The IWF should re-encrypt the URI value of the XML attribute using the keying information and include the re-encrypted attribute value in the same XML MIME body of the outgoing SIP request.

q_6408.question: What should a receiving node do if a message initiating a procedure is missing one or more IEs with specified criticality "Ignore IE"?
q_6408.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore that those IEs are missing and continue with the procedure based on the other IEs/IE groups present in the message.

q_6409.question: What should the Node B consider if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate Enforcement Indicator IE in the E-DCH Logical Channel Information IE in the E-DCH MAC-d Flow Specific Information IE in the E-DCH FDD Information IE?
q_6409.ground_truth: The Node B should consider the data of the related E-DCH Logical Channel for UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate Enforcement if supported.

q_6410.question: What is the main difference between detachment and de-enrolment procedures?
q_6410.ground_truth: The detachment procedure is initiated by the mobile station, while the de-enrolment procedure is initiated by the fixed part.

q_6411.question: What is the network parameter setting for the second BCCH sent by the GSM SS after the registration of the UE?
q_6411.ground_truth: LAI (MCC/MNC/LAC) is set to 244/081/0001 and RAI (MCC/MNC/LAC/RAC) is set to 244/081/0001/05.

q_6412.question: What is the purpose of the document "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals; Name identification supplementary services; Stage 2 (Release 17)"?
q_6412.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to describe the name identification supplementary services (stage 2) within the 3GPP system.

q_6413.question: What message does a mobile station send to request one or more uplink TBFs when it supports multiple TBF procedures and the network also does?

q_6414.question: Which protocol is used for the interface between the UE and the SSF for retrieving service selection information?
q_6414.ground_truth: The interface between the UE and the SSF is based on the HTTP protocol.

q_6415.question: What is the maximum setting for the search window at the PSAP receiver for identifying a valid delay value?
q_6415.ground_truth: The maximum setting for the search window at the PSAP receiver for identifying a valid delay value is +/- 240 samples.

q_6416.question: When will the Communication Waiting service be offered if the terminating party has activated the CFNR service?
q_6416.ground_truth: A waiting communication shall still be offered to the terminating party if the CFNR service is activated, and if the CFNR timer expires before an answer is received then the CFNR service shall be invoked and the communication shall be forwarded.

q_6417.question: What is the purpose of the P-CCPCH in the 3GPP specification?
q_6417.ground_truth: The P-CCPCH is used to transmit the paging channel and is used for neighbor cell measurements in order to support cell reselection.

q_6418.question: What is the source device in the SEND SS 2.1.1 proactive command?
q_6418.ground_truth: The source device in the SEND SS 2.1.1 proactive command is the SIM card.

q_6419.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role do if the received SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification does not include the "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" media feature tag in the Accept-Contact header field?
q_6419.ground_truth: The IWF should reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not process the remaining steps.

q_6420.question: In the context of object set definitions, what does an "mandatory" presence field mean for an IE?
q_6420.ground_truth: An IE with a "mandatory" presence field must appear exactly once in the defined context.

q_6421.question: What message is sent by the BSS to the SGSN when it requests the modification of the contents of an existing BSS packet flow context?
q_6421.ground_truth: Modify BSS Packet Flow Context Request

q_6422.question: In case of internal sampling rate switching from 12.8 kHz to 16 kHz, what is the frequency range that the power spectrum of the LP filter will be computed at?
q_6422.ground_truth: The power spectrum of the LP filter will be computed at frequencies equispaced in.

q_6423.question: What is the role of the SEAL Location Management Service in enhancing the location information at the USS/UTM in the described solution?
q_6423.ground_truth: The SEAL Location Management Service provides supplementary UE location information from the 3GPP network to the USS/UTM in the described solution, enhancing the location information at the USS/UTM.

q_6424.question: How does the document define "speech-enabled services"?
q_6424.ground_truth: Speech-enabled services are applications that use speech as an input and/or output modality, and can be divided into speech-only services and multimodal/multi-device services.

q_6425.question: What should be the Srxlev value for a cell to be considered during cell reselection to a higher priority RAT/frequency?
q_6425.ground_truth: The Srxlev value for a cell should be greater than ThreshX, HighP during a time interval TreselectionRAT for it to be considered during cell reselection to a higher priority RAT/frequency.

q_6426.question: What should the UE do with the 5GMM parameters if the SUPI from the USIM does not match the SUPI stored in the non-volatile memory?
q_6426.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the 5GMM parameters if the SUPI from the USIM does not match the SUPI stored in the non-volatile memory.

q_6427.question: What is an Operation Point (OP) in the context of SVC bit rate adaptation?
q_6427.ground_truth: An Operation Point (OP) is a unique combination of temporal and quality levels, where reasonable combinations of different pairs of Temporal ID and Quality ID are selected in a way so that OPs can be dropped from the bit stream one after the other.

q_6428.question: What does the message "Semantic error in the TFT operation" indicate when trying to create a PDP context in a network?
q_6428.ground_truth: An error in the packet filter(s) specified during the TFT setup.

q_6429.question: What should the network do when it does not receive the EC PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT or EC PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK HIGHER CC message in the resources indicated by the RRBP field?
q_6429.ground_truth: The network should increment counter N3103 for the TBF and retransmit the EC PACKET~UPLINK~ACK/NACK message in the next available DL EC-PACCH occasion for the TBF, unless N3103 has exceeded its limit. The network should restart timer T3237 at transmission if the mobile station continues monitoring the EC-PACCH for some time before returning to packet idle mode.

q_6430.question: What is the purpose of Solution #17?
q_6430.ground_truth: Solution #17 aims to activate UP IP integrity in EPS

q_6431.question: What should the UE do when it receives a "Primary PLMN Identity" in a dedicated RRC message on the existing RRC connection?
q_6431.ground_truth: The UE sets the "PLMN identity" in the INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message to the latest PLMN information received via dedicated RRC messaging.

q_6432.question: What is the responsibility of the MB-SMF regarding MB sessions?
q_6432.ground_truth: The MB-SMF sets up MB sessions used for shared delivery, manages the MB session context for shared delivery, and associates and manages the UE's PDU session context for individual delivery.

q_6433.question: What is the purpose of the MPS for DTS feature in 5GS?
q_6433.ground_truth: The MPS for DTS feature in 5GS enables the prioritization of all traffic on the EPC default bearer and the 5GC QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule upon requests received via an AF.

q_6434.question: What source is used by both 5GS and AF for time synchronization?
q_6434.ground_truth: The 5GS time source or GPS time source can be used by both 5GS and AF for time synchronization.

q_6435.question: What are the three classes of mobile originating location services that can be provided to value-added services?
q_6435.ground_truth: The three classes of mobile originating location services that can be provided to value-added services are Basic Self Location, Semi-autonomous Self Location, and Transfer to Third Party.

q_6436.question: What happens when the MSC-A server receives the Relocation Complete message?
q_6436.ground_truth: The MSC-A server informs the MSC-B server about reception of this message and initiates call clearing towards the MSC-B server.

q_6437.question: What is the function of the Source RNC to Target RNC Transparent Container IE?
q_6437.ground_truth: It is an information element produced by the source RNC and transmitted to the target RNC in inter-system handovers to UTRAN.

q_6438.question: What should the MRFC do if the MRFP does not support the negotiation of the image size and if it sends the SDP body (offer or answer) on the Mr interface?
q_6438.ground_truth: The MRFC shall send on the Mr interface the SDP body (offer or answer) without any image attribute "a=imageattr" if the MRFP does not support the negotiation of the image size and if the MRFC sends the SDP body (offer or answer) on the Mr interface.

q_6439.question: What is the requirement for using EDN domain ID in the solution for Edge Application Server Discovery using DNS?
q_6439.ground_truth: For using EDN domain ID in the solution for Edge Application Server Discovery using DNS, the DNS should be enhanced to support EDN domain ID.

q_6440.question: On which systems has the C code been verified?
q_6440.ground_truth: The C code has been verified on Windows XP SP2 and Microsoft Visual Studio V8.0, and on Linux (Suse Linux) using the gcc v3.4.2 and v4.1.2 compilers.

q_6441.question: What information should not be included in the NWDAF output if the consumer NF is an Application Function (AF)?
q_6441.ground_truth: The "DNN" should not be included in the NWDAF output if the consumer NF is an AF.

q_6442.question: What is the purpose of the 0-delay resampling using the optimized cubic interpolation in the described passage?
q_6442.ground_truth: The purpose of the 0-delay resampling using the optimized cubic interpolation is to cover the transition region of 6.25 ms and to obtain a good estimation of the missing signal.

q_6443.question: What is a Transfer Syntax Error in the context of protocol errors?
q_6443.ground_truth: A Transfer Syntax Error occurs when the receiver is not able to decode the received physical message. It is always detected in the process of ASN.1 decoding and includes cases such as violation of value ranges, list element constraints, missing mandatory elements, and wrong order of elements.

q_6444.question: What is the function of the multiplexing and TSN setting entity in the MAC-e/es entity in the UE side?
q_6444.ground_truth: The multiplexing and TSN setting entity in the MAC-e/es entity in the UE side is responsible for concatenating multiple MAC-d PDUs into MAC-es PDUs, and to multiplex one or multiple MAC-es PDUs into a single MAC-e PDU, as instructed by the E-TFC selection function. It is also responsible for managing and setting the TSN per logical channel for each MAC-es PDU.

q_6445.question: What is the UDP source port for a GTP-C request message?
q_6445.ground_truth: The UDP source port for a GTP-C request message is a locally allocated port number at the sending GSN/RNC.

q_6446.question: What is used in UE-assisted A-GNSS to determine the horizontal position estimate?
q_6446.ground_truth: UE-assisted A-GNSS uses the UE GNSS code phase measurements, which are then converted into a horizontal position estimate using the procedure detailed in Annex F of the document.

q_6447.question: What should the IBCF do when it receives an incoming SDP offer containing the "a=ecn-capable-rtp" attribute?
q_6447.ground_truth: If all the required conditions are met, the IBCF should remove the "ice" initiation method from the "ecn-capable-rtp" attribute, forward the attribute with this modification in the outgoing SDP offer, and determine if ECN XR summary reports can be used. Otherwise, the IBCF should remove the "ecn-capable-rtp" attribute from the outgoing SDP offer.

q_6448.question: What is the purpose of the SCEF sending a Network-Status-Request (NSR) command with Ns-Request-Type AVP value of 1 (cancellation request)?
q_6448.ground_truth: The SCEF sends an NSR command with Ns-Request-Type AVP value of 1 to cancel an ongoing continuous reporting of network status.

q_6449.question: When is the MPS indicator provided in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message considered valid?
q_6449.ground_truth: The MPS indicator is valid until the UE receives a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the MPS indicator bit set to "Access identity 1 not valid in RPLMN or equivalent PLMN" or until the UE selects a non-equivalent PLMN.

q_6450.question: Which access technology is recognized from Rel-6 onwards as an alternative access system to access services of the mobile core network?
q_6450.ground_truth: WLAN (Wireless Local Area Network) is recognized from Rel-6 onwards.

q_6451.question: How does 3GPP TS 26.247 define support for QoS in DASH services?
q_6451.ground_truth: It specifies guidelines for QoS mapping from the DASH MPD for PCC architecture.

q_6452.question: What is returned as the value of the Hop counter in a single SCCP XUDT message if the message is not segmented?

q_6453.question: What message does the UTRAN transmit to initiate the UE capability enquiry procedure?
q_6453.ground_truth: The UTRAN transmits a UE CAPABILITY ENQUIRY message on the DCCH using UM or AM RLC.

q_6454.question: What is the name of the SIP request that is used in clause 6.3.1.2 and 6.3.1.3 and is sent from the IWF to the MCData client?

q_6455.question: How long should the uplink DPCCH transmission wait before starting on the activated uplink frequency if an activation time has been given?
q_6455.ground_truth: The uplink DPCCH transmission should not start on the activated uplink frequency before the downlink physical channel has been established and the activation time has been reached.

q_6456.question: What is the format of thesecondaryCPICH-InformationList-Cell-SetupRqstFDD field?
q_6456.ground_truth: It is a sequence (SIZE (1..maxSCPICHCell)) OF ProtocolIE-Single-Container that contains SecondaryCPICH-InformationItem-Cell-SetupRqstFDD.

q_6457.question: What is a requirement for the 5G system to support clock synchronization in integrated 5G/non-3GPP TSN networks when the sync master and sync devices are served by different UEs?
q_6457.ground_truth: The 5G system should be able to support the flow of clock synchronization messages in either uplink and downlink direction.

q_6458.question: How should a receiving node treat a missing IE/IE group with specified criticality ``Reject IE'' in a received message initiating a procedure?
q_6458.ground_truth: The receiving node should reject the procedure and report the missing IEs/IE groups using the message normally used to report unsuccessful outcome of the procedure.

q_6459.question: What is the difference between 6.17.3.2 and 6.17.4?
q_6459.ground_truth: 6.17.3.2 deals with paging, while 6.17.4 discusses the impacts on services, entities, and interfaces regarding the support of MUSIM Assistance Information and procedures.

q_6460.question: What is subclause 6.10.2.4.1.52.2.1 specifying?
q_6460.ground_truth: Subclause 6.10.2.4.1.52.2.1 specifies the transport channel parameters for Interactive or background / DL:128 kbps / PS RAB in the document.

q_6461.question: What percentage of the total output power is used as the limit in the 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
q_6461.ground_truth: 0.5% of the total output power is used as the limit in the 1.28 Mcps TDD option.

q_6462.question: What is one difference between approach 1 and approach 2 in triggering an activation of PDP contexts with dynamic IP addresses?
q_6462.ground_truth: Approach 2 allows presence servers in both VPLMN and HPLMN to be informed by the SGSN while approach 1 would need a mechanism to indicate the global user name to the VPLMN to a Push Initiators in the VPLMN to send Push Data that are not requested by the user.

q_6463.question: In what scenario would a TBF establishment failure occur due to a TLLI mismatch during the contention resolution procedure in 3GPP TS 44.060?
q_6463.ground_truth: A TBF establishment failure occurs due to a TLLI mismatch during the contention resolution procedure if the maximum number of repetitions for packet access has been reached and the mismatch has not been resolved.

q_6464.question: What is the common criticality value in rAB-ReleaseRequest RANAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_6465.question: What is the charging mechanism where charging information does not affect, in real-time, the service rendered?

q_6466.question: What is the purpose of the RAB ID List information element?
q_6466.ground_truth: The RAB ID List information element is used by the GANC to identify a set of circuit transport channel(s) or packet transport channel(s).

q_6467.question: What is the role of MBSF in the solution described?
q_6467.ground_truth: MBSF is responsible for generating a MTK (MBS Traffic Key) and securely distributing it to the MBSTF (Multicast Broadcast Single-Frequency Network Terminating Function) and UEs (User Equipments) for protecting MBS traffic.

q_6468.question: In the OpenID-GBA interworking solution, what is used to bind the first and second factor of authentication when receiving the username/password and OpenID token in the same TLS tunnel/HTTP session?
q_6468.ground_truth: The TLS tunnel/HTTP session is used to bind the first and second factor of authentication when receiving the username/password and OpenID token.

q_6469.question: What procedure should be used for relaying DTMF in the user plane when RTP Telephony Event is selected for the internal 3GPP CS CN connection and inband DTMF is selected for the BICC network?
q_6469.ground_truth: The MGW should filter out (delete) the DTMF from the default PCM codec when relaying the DTMF via the RTP Telephony Event to prevent potential double signalling of the same digit.

q_6470.question: What is the function of an MCVideo UE, described in the document?
q_6470.ground_truth: An MCVideo UE is a device that provides video acquisition (e.g., has a camera), video rendering (has a display), and normally also has encoding/decoding, communication, and storage capabilities.

q_6471.question: What will the MAC entity do with the drx-InactivityTimerPTM when it receives a PDCCH indication of a new multicast transmission for the corresponding G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI?
q_6471.ground_truth: The MAC entity will restart the drx-InactivityTimerPTM in the first symbol after the end of the PDCCH reception when it indicates a new multicast transmission for the corresponding G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI.

q_6472.question: What was the resolution of the testing used for the EVS codec?
q_6472.ground_truth: The listeners only used a scale from 1 to 5 to rank the different codecs.

q_6473.question: What value does the NSQ update to 0 when a UE or network initiated de-registration procedure is done?

q_6474.question: What is the purpose of the Multicall supplementary service?
q_6474.ground_truth: The Multicall supplementary service allows multiple simultaneous calls to be made or received by a single user on a 3GPP network.

q_6475.question: What are the four speech decoder input sequences provided for testing the GSM half rate speech decoder?

q_6476.question: What is one of the features of the rendering system for Scene-Based Audio in VR applications?
q_6476.ground_truth: In VR applications, the sound-field can be rotated relative to head-movement through a multiplication of a matrix F to the SBA signals.

q_6477.question: What message does the GANC send to redirect the MS to a different Serving GANC?

q_6478.question: What is the difference between Scenario 1 and Scenario 2 in the Network Sharing Scenarios section of the document?
q_6478.ground_truth: In Scenario 1, operators share the RAN elements but not the radio frequencies, and connect directly to their own dedicated carrier layer in the shared RNC in the shared RAN. In Scenario 2, operators with individual 3G licenses cover different parts of a country and provide coverage of the entire country together. This scenario can be divided into two cases: national roaming for users and multiple core networks connected to both radio access networks throughout the coverage area.

q_6479.question: Which UMTS bearer service attributes are mapped to the RAB Allocation/Retention Priority attribute and how is it done?
q_6479.ground_truth: The UMTS bearer service attributes Allocation/Retention Priority for PS services and the eMLPP priority level attribute and/or the CS Allocation/Retention Priority attribute and/or the Mobile Station Category attribute for CS services are mapped to the RAB Allocation/Retention Priority attribute. The mapping is done based on the network's available resources and the usage of other attributes can ensure that e.g. emergency calls would receive an appropriate RAB Allocation/Retention Priority.

q_6480.question: What message should the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST when it wants to use SMS over NAS?
q_6480.ground_truth: The UE should include the 5GS update type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with the SMS requested bit set to "SMS over NAS supported".

q_6481.question: How does the distribution of users as a function of speed affect the performance of MCS9 and MCS9-T4-16QAM in the TU channel?
q_6481.ground_truth: Many operators prefer EGPRS on the non-hopping layer for superior throughput performance for MCS7, MCS8, and MCS9 schemes, so MCS9 performance on the non-hopping channel is used for a fair comparison with MCS9-T4-16QAM.

q_6482.question: What is the recommended PSS attribute for representing the number of bits of colour or greyscale information per pixel in the context of HardwarePlatform?

q_6483.question: What action should the RNC take when it de-registers from an MBMS bearer service and there is no corresponding MBMS UE Context?
q_6483.ground_truth: The RNC requests de-registration from the MBMS bearer service to its parent SGSN and disables reception from the IP backbone of the particular MBMS bearer service if it is using IP multicast distribution.

q_6484.question: What does MESSAGE TYPE 10bis contain in relation to neighbour cells and voice group call?
q_6484.ground_truth: MESSAGE TYPE 10bis contains a description of the voice group call channel in one or more neighbour cells where the voice group call is active.

q_6485.question: What is the main disadvantage of using a UE-controlled timer for delaying public key updates in GSM/GPRS networks?
q_6485.ground_truth: UEs without a valid old public key will reject genuine warning messages received while a timer for a key update is running.

q_6486.question: What is the formula for the running maximum in the codebook search algorithm?
q_6486.ground_truth: The running maximum is the value of (Ci)2/Gi for the current best codeword. It is updated for each codeword evaluated, and the codeword which maximizes the running maximum is chosen as the best codeword.

q_6487.question: What are the two possible planes of the A-Interface, as defined by 3GPP TS 48.0xx?
q_6487.ground_truth: The two planes of the A-Interface are the Control Plane (signalling) and the User Plane (traffic).

q_6488.question: What should the IWF, performing the participating role, do upon receipt of a SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request?
q_6488.ground_truth: The IWF, performing the participating role, should perform the procedures of clause~9.2.1.2.10, which includes releasing the SIP resources associated with the MCPTT session.

q_6489.question: What LLc PDU is used by the MS to perform a cell update procedure?
q_6489.ground_truth: A cell update is any correctly received and valid LLC PDU carried inside a BSSGP PDU containing a new identifier of the cell.

q_6490.question: What action does the IMS-ALG take upon receipt of an SDP offer from the IMS access network with T.38 fax media using the "UDP/TLS/UDPTL" transport protocol?
q_6490.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG modifies the SDP offer by changing the transport protocol to "UDP/TLS/UDPTL", inserting the "3ge2ae" SDP attribute with a value "applied", inserting the fingerprint SDP attribute, inserting the "tls-id" SDP attribute with the new DTLS association identity, and inserting the setup SDP attribute with the value "actpass" before sending the SDP offer to the IMS core network.

q_6491.question: What is an approach to determining the presence of victim UEs in the vicinity of a HeNB based on detected uplink transmissions?
q_6491.ground_truth: The HeNB can detect uplink transmissions from victim UEs, such as data and control information on the uplink, and use it to determine the presence of victim UEs.

q_6492.question: What is returned by the ProSe Application Server to the application client in the UE in step 0?
q_6492.ground_truth: The ProSe Application Server returns the RPAUID (Restricted ProSe Application User ID) to the application client in the UE in step 0.

q_6493.question: When must the mobile station associate and indicate the PFI value for the LLC data to be transmitted in case no valid PFI value is assigned?
q_6493.ground_truth: An MS supporting PFC procedures must associate and indicate the following PFI values: PFI=0 for user data, PFI=1 for GMM/SM signalling, PFI=2 for Short Message Service, or PFI=3 for LLC SAPI~8 data.

q_6494.question: What action should the RNC2 take if the requested measurement cannot be initiated?
q_6494.ground_truth: The RNC2 should send a COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION FAILURE message including the Measurement ID IE and an appropriate cause value.

q_6495.question: What action does the IMS-ALG take if the P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) indicated to the IMS-AGW at step 2 that it shall ignore any incoming TCP connection establishment requests (TCP SYN)?
q_6495.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG indicates to the IMS-AGW to accept incoming TCP connection establishment (TCP SYN) only from the indicated remote transport address.

q_6496.question: Following which BC parameters in the SETUP message should be set to "32 kbit/s" and "transparent (for multimedia)" or "bothNT or bothT (If IWF supports PIAFS, UTRAN Iu mode only)", respectively?
q_6496.ground_truth: The Fixed network user rate and Connection element parameters in the SETUP message should be set to "32 kbit/s" and "transparent (for multimedia)" or "bothNT or bothT (If IWF supports PIAFS, UTRAN Iu mode only)", respectively.

q_6497.question: What happens when an error situation arises in the incoming message using MBMS-service-associated signalling?
q_6497.ground_truth: The Error Indication procedure uses MBMS-service-associated signalling and should contain at least either the Cause IE or the Criticality Diagnostics IE. In case the error indication procedure is triggered by utilising MBMS-service-associated signalling, the MCE MBMS M3AP ID IE and the MME MBMS M3AP IE shall be included in the ERROR INDICATION message.

q_6498.question: What is the use of the RAN-INFORMATION PDU in the MBMS data channel RIM application when the RIM Application Identity IE is set to "MBMS data channel"?
q_6498.ground_truth: The RAN-INFORMATION PDU is used by a serving BSS to send the information about the MBMS data channels established in a single reporting cell, to a controlling BSS in the MBMS data channel RIM application.

q_6499.question: What are the two alternatives for triggering reactivation when a UE is in a reduced power mode?
q_6499.ground_truth: The two alternatives are HARQ with possible UL power offset and a reactivation signal on E-DPCCH, each having its own method of transmission.

q_6500.question: What type of network interface is "X2" in the document?
q_6500.ground_truth: The X2 interface is a logical interface between two eNBs (E-UTRAN Node B).

q_6501.question: What should the PLMN BC parameter Information Transfer Capability be set to when interworking with an indirectly connected restricted 64 kbit/s network?
q_6501.ground_truth: The PLMN BC parameter Information Transfer Capability should be set to "Other ITC" and the Other ITC parameter should be set to "restricted digital" when interworking with an indirectly connected restricted 64 kbit/s network.

q_6502.question: How many bits are used for the transport block size in E-UCCH for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
q_6502.ground_truth: The transport block size in E-UCCH for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option is specified by 6 bits.

q_6503.question: What is the difference between the UI command and the UI Dummy command?
q_6503.ground_truth: The UI command is used to send information, while the UI Dummy command is a special command that should never be transmitted by an LLC entity, but it can be received and discarded by the LLC entity.

q_6504.question: What message is sent by the UE to the USS during registration on CS after receiving the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT message from the USS?

q_6505.question: What is the functionality of Terminating Identification Presentation (TIP) in a communication?
q_6505.ground_truth: TIP has no impact on the operation of other services, i.e., neither service will affect the operation of the other.

q_6506.question: What is the RCAF responsible for in the 3GPP architecture?
q_6506.ground_truth: The RCAF is responsible for reporting network status to the SCEF to enable the SCEF to take the RAN user plane congestion status into account.

q_6507.question: What should the UTRAN do in cases a), b), c), d), and e) when sending an ACTIVE SET UPDATE message on the downlink DCCH using AM or UM RLC?
q_6507.ground_truth: Create active sets that contain at least one common radio link across a DPCH or F-DPCH frame boundary as the result of one or multiple (parallel) active set update procedures.

q_6508.question: What is the mandatory interception for ProSe Function and ProSe Key Management Function?
q_6508.ground_truth: Interception of the following events is mandatory for ProSe Function and ProSe Key Management Function: ProSe Function sends authorisation to perform one-to-many communications to the target UE, ProSe Key Management Function sends keys to use in one-to-many communications to the target UE, and ProSe Function receives a one-to-many communications usage information report from the target UE.

q_6509.question: What is the definition of "Pan" in 3GPP technical documentation?
q_6509.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical documentation, "Pan" is a number measured in degrees corresponding to the compass direction of the component in the plane parallel to the earth's surface of any vector which points in the same direction that the camera is facing. For example, North corresponds to 0 degrees, East corresponds to 90 degrees, etc.

q_6510.question: What is the purpose of timer G in the "confirmed" state, if an unreliable transport-layer connection is used between the UE and the SCC AS?
q_6510.ground_truth: Timer G indicates that the ICS UE has received the I1 Success message and the ICS UE has stopped the retransmission of the I1 Invite message.

q_6511.question: What issue prevents dual carrier implementation in uplink using a wideband transmitter in an MRP network?
q_6511.ground_truth: The wideband transmitter cannot include dual carriers in uplink due to the large separation (greater than 1 MHz) between carriers in an MRP network, which includes the BCCH frequency in the hopping set.

q_6512.question: What is the subject of 3GPP Technical Specification document TS 28.709:17?
q_6512.ground_truth: The subject of the document is Evolved Packet Core (EPC) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) and its Solution Set (SS) definitions.

q_6513.question: When using the Object Distribution Indicator, what should be done if no specific indicator is present for a given information element?
q_6513.ground_truth: If no Object Distribution Indicator is present in an information element, the object may be freely distributed.

q_6514.question: What should be the IP source address of the GTP echo response message?
q_6514.ground_truth: The IP source address of the GTP echo response message should be the same as the destination IP address of the GTP echo request message.

q_6515.question: What should be selected as the signalling radio bearer when "SAPI 3" is requested for a GSM-MAP based CN?
q_6515.ground_truth: RB4 should be selected if available, otherwise RB3 should be selected.

q_6516.question: What action should the PCRF take upon receiving a reported usage from the PCEF?
q_6516.ground_truth: The PCRF should deduct the value of the usage report from the total allowed usage for that IP-CAN session, usage monitoring key, or both as applicable.

q_6517.question: What information element does the MSGin5G Server include in the message when communicating with a specific Application Client?
q_6517.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server includes the Application ID Information Element (IE) in the message, which contains the identities of the Application Clients within the Application domain. This allows the Application Server to communicate with a specific Application Client by including its identity in the message.

q_6518.question: What is needed to be included in the SGSN Context Request for an emergency attached MS that is UICCless or unauthenticated?

q_6519.question: What type of transform is used in H.265 (HEVC) instead of Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) for 4x4 intra transform blocks?
q_6519.ground_truth: Discrete Sine Transform (DST) is used in H.265 (HEVC) instead of Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) for 4x4 intra transform blocks.

q_6520.question: What is the purpose of service announcement in the context of MBMS multicast service?
q_6520.ground_truth: The purpose of service announcement in the context of MBMS multicast service is to distribute to users information about the service, parameters required for service activation, and possibly other service-related parameters. This mechanism allows users to discover MBMS user services, including operator-specific MBMS user services and services from content providers outside of the PLMN.

q_6521.question: What are the two types of handover defined in the Enhancement of Handover Optimization Work Item?
q_6521.ground_truth: Conditional Handover (CHO) and Dual Active Protocol Stack (DAPS) handover

q_6522.question: What does the "gsmSCF-gsmSRF" in the module name "CAP-gsmSCF-gsmSRF-ops-args" stand for?
q_6522.ground_truth: "gsmSCF" stands for "gsm Service Control Function," and "gsmSRF" stands for "gsm Service Response Function." Together, they refer to two functional components within the gsm network architecture that cooperate and communicate via a well-defined interface.

q_6523.question: What is the name of the protocol extension container in the context of Radio Link Addition Failure TDD that contains the radio link addition failure TDD-specific cause list?

q_6524.question: What is the purpose of the PDU session authentication and authorization procedure in the test scenario?
q_6524.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure is to enable the DN to authenticate and authorize the upper layers of the UE when establishing the PDU session.

q_6525.question: What happens if both the originator and the responder do not include a specific parameter in the negotiation?
q_6525.ground_truth: The value of the parameter remains unchanged.

q_6526.question: What is the purpose of the "cp:validity" condition in the communication barring service?
q_6526.ground_truth: The "cp:validity" condition specifies a period and evaluates to true when the current time is within the validity period expressed by the value of this condition.

q_6527.question: What happens when a Remote UE is connected to a Relay UE and uses SL-RSRP measurements on the sidelink unicast link?
q_6527.ground_truth: The Remote UE evaluates whether the PC5 link quality with the Relay UE satisfies the relay reselection criterion.

q_6528.question: What are the network options available for location dependent interception?
q_6528.ground_truth: The network options available for location dependent interception are target location versus Interception Areas (IAs) check in the 3G~ICEs and Delivery Functions (DFs), target location versus IAs check in the DFs, and location dependent interception not applicable to CSCF.

q_6529.question: What should the UE do if the value for Tsor-cm timer equals "infinity"?
q_6529.ground_truth: If the value for Tsor-cm timer equals "infinity", the UE shall wait until the PDU session is released or the service is stopped. The Tsor-cm timer is applicable only if the UE is in automatic network selection mode. Upon switching to manual network selection mode, the UE shall stop any Tsor-cm timer, if running. In this case, the UE is not required to enter idle mode and perform the de-registration procedure.

q_6530.question: What occurs in the pre-condition of the intent-driven NSI performance assurance scenario?
q_6530.ground_truth: The NSI consumer wants the NSI Producer to assure the performance of the provided NSI based on its intent, such as the type of services that need performance assurance and the granularity of performance assurance report notifications.

q_6531.question: What information is included in the an-APDU parameter of the HANDOVER REQUEST ACK message in a MAP PREPARE HANDOVER response?
q_6531.ground_truth: The an-APDU parameter of the HANDOVER REQUEST ACK message in a MAP PREPARE HANDOVER response includes a BSSMAP HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE.

q_6532.question: What is the role of a PoC Server performing the participating PoC function in relation to media and media-related signalling?
q_6532.ground_truth: A PoC Server performing the participating PoC function has a direct communication path for media and media-related signalling with a PoC Client and with the PoC Server performing the controlling PoC function for PoC session signalling.

q_6533.question: What is the function of layer 2 in the EMMI protocol structure?
q_6533.ground_truth: On layer 2, an extremely simple frame-oriented protocol is defined for transferring messages to and from layer 3. The SS only sends and receives layer 3 frames when the corresponding step within a test case is to be performed.

q_6534.question: What is the role of a MExE server in the MExE service environment?
q_6534.ground_truth: A MExE server is a node supporting MExE services in the MExE service environment, responsible for aspects such as charging, security level classification, and interaction with the MExE UE. However, the MExE servers themselves are not covered in this specification.

q_6535.question: What will the DRNS do in FDD, if the Serving Cell Change CFN IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
q_6535.ground_truth: The DRNS shall activate the resources that are allocated for the new serving HS-DSCH Radio Link at the next coming CFN with a value equal to the value requested by the SRNC.

q_6536.question: What should the UE do with the stored rejected NSAAI for the current PLMN when it has been switched off and then switched on?
q_6536.ground_truth: The UE should delete the stored rejected NSAAI for the current PLMN when it has been switched off and then switched on.

q_6537.question: What is the purpose of the high-pass filter used in this process?
q_6537.ground_truth: The high-pass filter serves as a precaution against low frequency components adversely affecting the processing.

q_6538.question: What shall the target device do when it receives a ProvideAssistanceData message as specified in TS 36.355, clause 5.2.4?
q_6538.ground_truth: The target device delivers the related assistance data to upper layers for each positioning method contained in the ProvideAssistanceData message.

q_6539.question: What is the method used by the SMF to forward packets to the AF for notifications on the DNS response?
q_6539.ground_truth: The SMF can create a PDI (packet detection information) in a PDR (data radio bearer) with a filter that matches e.g. with dst IP address = DNS resolver address and src IP address = L-DNS server address. The UPF (user plane function) forwards the matching packets to the tunnel towards SMF.

q_6540.question: What happens if the E-UTRAN Service Handover IE is not included in the RAB setup and modification process?
q_6540.ground_truth: If the E-UTRAN Service Handover IE is not included, the decision to perform an inter-system mobility to E-UTRAN is an internal UTRAN matter.

q_6541.question: Which message type is used to indicate the status of the received RLC data blocks, update the timing advance and power control parameters?

q_6542.question: What should a mobile station do if the DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message specifies an uplink PDCH that it does not support?
q_6542.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_6543.question: How does the network initiate a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message for a mobile station?
q_6543.ground_truth: The network implicitly orders the mobile station to send a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message by including the Single Block Allocation struct or Multi Block Allocation struct in the PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message.

q_6544.question: What is the focus of the technical specification group Services and System Aspects in 3GPP?
q_6544.ground_truth: The technical specification group Services and System Aspects in 3GPP is focused on telecommunication management.

q_6545.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the request is a UE-terminating request, the served user is not registered and no more of the initial filter criteria apply?
q_6545.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should reject the request.

q_6546.question: In the code construction for code groups 0 to 15, what is used to provide code group and frame position information for Case 1 and what is used to provide slot timing, frame position information, and code group information for Case 2?
q_6546.ground_truth: In Case 1, the secondary codes in the code set are used to provide code group and frame position information. In Case 2, the comma free property of the code word and the modulation of some of the secondary codes in the code set are used to provide slot timing, frame position information, and code group information.

q_6547.question: How does Solution #20 enable interaction between NWDAFs for UE abnormal behaviour analytics?
q_6547.ground_truth: Solution #20 enables interaction between NWDAFs by having one NWDAF provide UE abnormal behaviour analytics to other NWDAFs. This can generate new statistics/predictions for analytics IDs during a period of abnormal situations and provide updated analytics to the analytics consumer.

q_6548.question: What is the terminology used to describe the TTI in 4.6J?
q_6548.ground_truth: TTI stands for Time Division Duplex which refers to a method of time division multiplexing used by UMTS.

q_6549.question: What happens if the TAU/Registration Complete message is lost in the paging procedure of a 5G network?
q_6549.ground_truth: In case of lost TAU/Registration Complete message, normal stage 3 procedures are applied. This means that the MME/AMF pages with both old and new S-TMSIs using the old and new "offset value", respectively.

q_6550.question: How many QUIC connections are established between the UE and the UPF for a single QoS flow carrying QUIC-LL traffic?
q_6550.ground_truth: Two QUIC connections, one for each access.

q_6551.question: What action is taken if the PDU Session modification to setup QoS flow for IMS voice is rejected by NG-RAN?
q_6551.ground_truth: The PGW-C+SMF maintains the PCC rule(s) associated with the QoS Flow(s).

q_6552.question: What two groups of equipment are not supported in the UMTS PLMN environment?
q_6552.ground_truth: Group 1 and group 2 equipments are not supported in the UMTS PLMN environment.

q_6553.question: What is one requirement for the MIME body of a SIP INFO request for USSD operations in IMS?
q_6553.ground_truth: The MIME body must include a g.3gpp.ussd USSD+xml message.

q_6554.question: What is the difference between online charging and offline charging?
q_6554.ground_truth: Online charging requires charging to occur during the active connection, while offline charging allows for charging to occur after the fact.

q_6555.question: What is the primary objective of the 3GPP system in providing means to support UxNB?
q_6555.ground_truth: The primary objective is to provide continuous connectivity service to UEs within the rescue area, minimize power consumption of the UxNB, optimize signalling when a serving UxNB changes, and minimize interference among UxNBs in close proximity.

q_6556.question: What is the role of RAN and CN in handling a service request for a slice that may not be available in a given area?
q_6556.ground_truth: RAN and CN are responsible for handling a service request for a slice that may not be available in a given area, as some slices may be available only in part of the network.

q_6557.question: What are two properties of security that the Security Management concept and requirements aim to provide?

q_6558.question: What is the role of the ValidityArea node in the ForServiceBased node?
q_6558.ground_truth: The ValidityArea node acts as a placeholder for location conditions for a particular flow distribution rule. This node and its descendants are the same as defined in ANDSF/Policy/<X>/ValidityArea.

q_6559.question: What is the gain presented for test case A in subsection 8.2.2.1?
q_6559.ground_truth: The gain presented for test case A is approximately 14.2%.

q_6560.question: What are the common security procedures described in clause 5 of the present document?
q_6560.ground_truth: The common security procedures described in clause 5 of the present document include the security for interfaces between network entities, security requirements for the transmission of data between ProSe network entities, and security procedures for UE to ProSe Function interface.

q_6561.question: What happens when a multi-access PDN connection becomes unusable, as per TS 23.203?
q_6561.ground_truth: The Termination of service data flow chargeable event applies for all the service data flows carried under the IP-CAN bearer of the unusable access.

q_6562.question: What are the pre-conditions for initiating a public emergency call in the FRMCS system?
q_6562.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for initiating a public emergency call in the FRMCS system are that the underlying transport of the FRMCS System supports emergency calls and the FRMCS System allows FRMCS Users to make use of emergency calls.

q_6563.question: What is the role of the RRBP field in the redefined header of EGPRS DL data blocks?
q_6563.ground_truth: The RRBP field, when split, defines only two possible values for reaction time (20 ms and 40 ms) and is part of a new interpretation for the RRBP, RS, and ES/P fields.

q_6564.question: What value should be provided in the 3GPP-SGSN-MCC-MNC AVP when the PLMN change event trigger is used in a CCR command?
q_6564.ground_truth: The new value of the Mobile Country Code (MCC) and Mobile Network Code (MNC) after the PLMN change

q_6565.question: What is the consequence of receiving a 415 Unsupported Media Type response in the initial INVITE request?
q_6565.ground_truth: When receiving a 415 Unsupported Media Type response in the initial INVITE request, and the handling of all MIME bodies except for the SDP MIME body is optional, the O-MGCF shall send an ACK request and a new initial INVITE request with SDP as the only MIME body.

q_6566.question: What is the octet aligned HS-DSCH transport block size Lk for the HS-DSCH physical layer category is between 1 and 3 inclusively and k = 63?

q_6567.question: What happens when a CUG call is received with an interlock code but not an indication of OA allowed, and there is a match with the called user's CUGs and incoming calls are not barred within this CUG?
q_6567.ground_truth: The call is offered as a CUG call.

q_6568.question: How does DRX at the UE work in case of discontinuous transmissions or sustained DL and UL inactivity?
q_6568.ground_truth: The UE and UTRAN limit the number of subframes where the UE needs to monitor the HS-SCCH for DL scheduling, allowing the UE to shut-off the receiver circuitry and saving battery life.

q_6569.question: What is the function of the AMF component in this architecture?
q_6569.ground_truth: The AMF is enhanced to support MB session management between the NG-RAN and MB-SMF, and it selects appropriate NG-RAN nodes to cover the target service area based on the MB-SMF's instructions.

q_6570.question: What is the A-TRAU' frame format in transparent mode?
q_6570.ground_truth: An A-TRAU' frame consists of two consecutive A-TRAU frames, each with a length of 320 bit. In transparent mode, the number of data bits in an A-TRAU' frame depend on the user rate only, each user rate corresponds to a fixed number of data bits.

q_6571.question: What does the ValidityTimerT4005 leaf indicate in unit of minutes for how long the authorization policy is valid?
q_6571.ground_truth: The ValidityTimerT4005 leaf indicates the duration in minutes for which the authorization policy for using the relay service is valid.

q_6572.question: What type of noise is present in TEST17.INP and TEST18.INP?
q_6572.ground_truth: Babble noise and ambient noise, respectively.

q_6573.question: Which network entity is responsible for PWS key delivery in GERAN networks?
q_6573.ground_truth: MSC/SGSN can be used to deliver PWS keys to UEs in GERAN networks.

q_6574.question: When should the UE include the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_6574.ground_truth: If the UE supports MICO mode and requests the use of MICO mode, then the UE shall include the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_6575.question: What does the "B8 02 81 00" coding represent in the "GET STATUS" response?
q_6575.ground_truth: This indicates that Channel 1 is open, and the link is established or the PDP context is activated.

q_6576.question: What are the capabilities provided by the CM system to support the initial installation, short-term adaptation, updates, and upgrades of a PLMN network?
q_6576.ground_truth: The capabilities provided by the CM system include initial system installation to establish the network, system operation to adapt the system to short-term requirements, system updates to modify the system to overcome software bugs or equipment faults, and system upgrades to enhance or extend the network by adding features or equipment.

q_6577.question: When should a UE perform cell reselection to a higher priority E-UTRAN frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency?
q_6577.ground_truth: If more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell, and a cell of a higher priority EUTRAN, NR or UTRAN FDD RAT/frequency fulfills Squal > ThreshX, HighQ during a time interval TreselectionRAT or a cell of a higher priority UTRAN TDD, GERAN or CDMA2000 RAT/frequency fulfills Srxlev > ThreshX, HighP during a time interval TreselectionRAT.

q_6578.question: What procedure should a mobile station initiate after sending the maximum number of CHANNEL REQUEST or EGPRS PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST or EC PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST or EGPRS MULTILATERATION REQUEST messages and timer T3146 expires during the packet access procedure?
q_6578.ground_truth: The mobile station shall indicate a random access failure to upper layers and perform autonomous cell re-selection.

q_6579.question: What action does the L2R function take when the "BREAK" condition is received from the MS?
q_6579.ground_truth: The L2R function generates a "BREAK" condition towards the fixed network on receipt of a break indication from the MS.

q_6580.question: In what mode does the mobile station need to complete the transmission of the current upper layer PDU when the new upper layer PDU has a higher radio priority but a different RLC mode?
q_6580.ground_truth: The mobile station must complete the transmission using the countdown procedure, including acknowledgement from the network if in RLC acknowledged mode.

q_6581.question: What is the role of the Credentials Provider (CdP) in the SNPN solution that uses 3rd party credentials?
q_6581.ground_truth: The Credentials Provider (CdP) is an entity, separate from the SNPN, that supports its credentials to access the SNPN. It provides a credential management system that handles identifiers and security material used to identify and mutually authenticate devices within the SNPN.

q_6582.question: What is the name of the service signaling in ATSC that contains basic information for users to perform service selection?

q_6583.question: What is the purpose of using the "omr-s-att" and "omr-s-bw" attributes in the SDP offer?
q_6583.ground_truth: These attributes are used to encapsulate session-level information within an "omr-s-att" attribute and add it as a media level attribute for every media line.

q_6584.question: What is the actual sensitivity level in terms of input level for meeting the specified BER?
q_6584.ground_truth: The actual sensitivity level is the input level for which the specified BER is met, and it should be less than the reference sensitivity level.

q_6585.question: What message is transmitted by the eNB to trigger the measurement of "Number of octets of DL LWIPEP PDUs"?
q_6585.ground_truth: The DL LWIPEP PDUs by the eNB.

q_6586.question: What is the requirement for the multicarrier receiver in a multicarrier BTS?
q_6586.ground_truth: The manufacturer shall declare if the multicarrier BTS is equipped with multicarrier receiver and if any multicarrier receiver paths are equivalent in terms of radio performance. The Medium Range and Local Area classes may not be declared without multicarrier receiver.

q_6587.question: What should the UE and eNB do if UP integrity protection is not activated for DRBs?
q_6587.ground_truth: The eNB and the UE shall not integrity protect the traffic of such DRB and shall not put MAC-I into PDCP packet.

q_6588.question: How does the SNPN authenticate to a separate entity for access to non-3GPP services?
q_6588.ground_truth: The SNPN authenticates the separate entity using non-3GPP identities and credentials.

q_6589.question: What is the result of using the TFO codes for tandem-free operation?
q_6589.ground_truth: The use of TFO codes for tandem-free operation does not result in any change in frame timing.

q_6590.question: What should the UE do when transmitting a LPP PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION message including OTDOA-ProvideLocationInformation IE in the RSTD measurement reporting delay test?
q_6590.ground_truth: The UE should perform and report the RSTD measurements for both Cell 2 and Cell 3 with respect to the reference cell in the OTDOA assistance data, Cell 1. The number of successful tests is increased by one if both the rstd fields are included within the response time and the number of failure tests is increased by one if they fail to report within the response time.

q_6591.question: What is the resolution of the Reference Time IE in the broadcast message?
q_6591.ground_truth: The resolution of the Reference Time IE is 0.59 seconds.

q_6592.question: What is the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document and what does it indicate?
q_6592.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document indicates the status of the document. A value of 1 presented to TSG for information, 2 presented to TSG for approval, or greater than 2 indicates TSG approved document under change control.

q_6593.question: What should a mobile station do when it is unable to synchronize to the new cell after receiving a PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message?
q_6593.ground_truth: The mobile station should regard this as the network controlled cell reselection procedure has failed and stop timer T3174. It shall then start timer T3176, return to the old cell, and send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message to the network in the old cell.

q_6594.question: What should the DRNS include in the Radio Link Set Up Response message if the D-RNTI IE is present in the Radio Link Set Up Request message for a secondary UL frequency?
q_6594.ground_truth: The DRNS should include the Primary Scrambling Code IE, the UL UARFCN IE, and the DL UARFCN IE for the secondary UL frequency in the Additional E-DCH FDD Information Response IE in the Additional E-DCH Cell Information Response IE in the Radio Link Set Up Response message.

q_6595.question: What is the role of the UPF/NW-TT in the 5GS with respect to TSN network?
q_6595.ground_truth: The UPF/NW-TT realizes Ethernet forwarding functionality and makes use of the static forwarding rules to any port as provided by the CNC. The PDU Sessions serving TSC or non-TSC traffic correspond to 5GS bridge ports.

q_6596.question: In Solution #3, how does the system handle a UE reaching the quota limit in a Network Slice?
q_6596.ground_truth: When the quota is overflown in Solution #3, the NSSF returns either the UE is allowed to use the S-NSSAI but with an indication that the quota is overflown, or, if it is the policy, that the S-NSSAI is not allowed with cause "quota overflown". An optional back-off timer may also be provided.

q_6597.question: Which device is the source device when the SIM simulator is setting up a call to the network?
q_6597.ground_truth: The SIM simulator is the source device when setting up a call to the network.

q_6598.question: What is the maximum allowed magnitude of the error vector for QPSK, AQPSK, 8-PSK, 16-QAM, and 32-QAM modulated signals?
q_6598.ground_truth: The magnitude of the error vector shall be less than 17.5% (measured in percentages of the nominal constellation point amplitude) for all the mentioned modulation types.

q_6599.question: What is the role of the Transport Format Selection function in LTE MAC layer?
q_6599.ground_truth: The Transport Format Selection function in LTE MAC layer is responsible for selecting the appropriate transport format for each active transport channel depending on source rate, which maximizes the utilization of transport channels.

q_6600.question: What standard applies to equipment with an input current of greater than 16A per phase for harmonic current emissions and voltage fluctuations and flicker?

q_6601.question: What is the predetermined bit-rate value used in HQ MDCT coding bit-rate, if the CELP core is at 12.8 kHz?

q_6602.question: What is the format of the BurstModeParameters sequence?
q_6602.ground_truth: BurstModeParameters is a SEQUENCE that contains burstStart, burstLength, burstFreq, and iE-Extensions.

q_6603.question: What information must the PCRF include in an NRA command for reporting restrictions for a specific user id and PDN ID?
q_6603.ground_truth: The PCRF must include one or more Congestion-Level-Definition AVP(s) indicating the specific congestion level set and corresponding congestion levels in an NRA command to provide reporting restrictions for a specific user id and PDN ID.

q_6604.question: What is the difference between "native" and "mapped" operators in a shared network?
q_6604.ground_truth: In a shared network, an operator can be "native" (i.e. no RAT change) or "mapped" (i.e. RAT change) - meaning that the network uses a different radio access technology (RAT) for the operator compared to the one used for the same operator in a different network.

q_6605.question: Which PDU is used by an SME to determine which data formats within the Extended Object IE are supported by a specific terminal when using the SC?
q_6605.ground_truth: An SME uses the SMS-DELIVER PDU to determine which data formats within the Extended Object IE are supported by a specific terminal when using the SC.

q_6606.question: What should the Node B do regarding Transmission Gap Pattern Sequences when it receives a COMPRESSED MODE COMMAND message from the CRNC, with the Affected HS-DSCH serving cell List IE in the Active Pattern Sequence Information IE, and the Transmission Gap Pattern Sequence for affected HS-DSCH Serving Cells is activated on the HS-DSCH Primary Serving Cell but not for all the other serving cells?
q_6606.ground_truth: The Node B shall reject the procedure using the RADIO LINK FAILURE message with the cause value ``Invalid CM settings''.

q_6607.question: What is the value of the "ProtocolType" leaf in the IP flow description?
q_6607.ground_truth: The value of the "ProtocolType" leaf in the IP flow description is a value among the internet protocol numbers as defined in IANA Assigned Internet Protocol Numbers.

q_6608.question: In what situations should the RNC2 initiate the Information Reporting procedure for "Inter-frequency Cell Information"?
q_6608.ground_truth: When any change has occurred to the inter-frequency cell information broadcasted in the SIB11, SIB1ter or SIB12.

q_6609.question: In which situation are the 5GMM parameters CR 1 stored in the non-volatile memory in the ME?
q_6609.ground_truth: If the corresponding file is not present on the USIM, the 5GMM parameters are stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME together with the SUPI from the USIM.

q_6610.question: What is the role of the IWF/CN in source coding?
q_6610.ground_truth: Source coding is dependent on the IWF/CN and is a NAS functionality, while radio channel coding is supported by URAN to optimize the usage of radio resources.

q_6611.question: What is the parameter p in equation (7.6-46) used for?
q_6611.ground_truth: The parameter p in equation (7.6-46) is used to determine the proportion of mobile scatterers in the channel.

q_6612.question: What is the frequency domain resource allocation method used in the DL scheduling scheme?
q_6612.ground_truth: The frequency domain resource allocation method used in the DL scheduling scheme is exclusively using resource allocation type 1 with non-interleaved VRB-to-PRB mapping.

q_6613.question: When is the "Pre-Redirection info" information element included in the response for a UE that supports E-UTRA?
q_6613.ground_truth: The "Pre-Redirection info" information element is included in the response for a UE that supports E-UTRA if the UE was redirected by E-UTRA for signalling connection establishment and this is not the first attempt to establish the signalling connection.

q_6614.question: Which ITU-T Q.1912.5 annex should be followed for profile C sub-addressing procedures?
q_6614.ground_truth: ITU-T Q.1912.5 Annex B.5 for profile C

q_6615.question: How does the 3GPP Technical Specification define the use of the word "shall"?
q_6615.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something in the context of normative provisions.

q_6616.question: What is the requirement for supporting long forwarded-to numbers in the 3GPP system?
q_6616.ground_truth: It should be possible to register a long forwarded-to number for call forwarding supplementary services in the 3GPP system, and an additional clause defines the requirements when one or more network entities and/or the mobile station does not support Long Forwarded-to Numbers.

q_6617.question: What type of information is indicated in the node named "DefaultBroadcastDestinationLayer2ID"?
q_6617.ground_truth: It acts as a placeholder to indicate the default destination layer-2 ID for broadcast used for V2X broadcast mode communication over the NR-PC5.

q_6618.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message that can be accepted and includes the "null integrity protection algorithm" 5G-IA0 as the selected NAS integrity algorithm, but is not received during a specific scenario?
q_6618.ground_truth: The UE should not accept such a message, except when the UE is registered for emergency services, performing initial registration for emergency services or establishing an emergency PDU session.

q_6619.question: What is the purpose of the gsmSSF, gsmSCF, assisting gsmSSF and gsmSRF in the CAP protocol?
q_6619.ground_truth: The gsmSSF, gsmSCF, assisting gsmSSF and gsmSRF follow the normal error handling procedures when receiving an operation that is not part of the CAP or contains parameters that are not part of the CAP.

q_6620.question: What is the function of the Data Collection Coordination Function (DCCF) in the context of data collections for multiple NWDAFs?
q_6620.ground_truth: The DCCF is responsible for coordinating data collection from multiple NWDAFs by preventing multiple triggers of data collection for the same data from the same data provider, controlling signalling and receiving/forwarding data, and caching or storing collected data if needed.

q_6621.question: How does the Serving GW act as the signaling endpoint for each interface when either of the S2a or S2b interfaces is chained with a PMIP-based S8 interface?
q_6621.ground_truth: When a procedure is initiated by its peer on a given interface for a given PDN connection, the Serving GW shall trigger an equivalent procedure over the chained interface for the designated PDN connection.

q_6622.question: How many sources show SNR gain for joint channel estimation over multiple slots for eMBB?
q_6622.ground_truth: Eleven sources show SNR gain for joint channel estimation over multiple slots for eMBB.

q_6623.question: What is the role of the UE-to-Network relay in this process?
q_6623.ground_truth: The UE-to-Network relay is used to discover the remote UE and establish a secure PC5 unicast link.

q_6624.question: What action does the MS take upon expiry of the timer T3245?
q_6624.ground_truth: Upon expiry of the timer T3245, the MS shall erase the "forbidden PLMN list" and the "forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service" list and set the SIM/USIM to valid for non-GPRS services and GPRS services.

q_6625.question: What is the purpose of the Happy Bit in the MAC layer?
q_6625.ground_truth: The Happy Bit is used to indicate to the serving Node B whether the UE could use more resources or not, indicating to the serving Node B the amount of resources it requires.

q_6626.question: What actions should the Serving GW take when informed about the change of RAT type by the SGSN in the procedure Modify Bearer Request for a PMIP-based S5/S8?
q_6626.ground_truth: The Serving GW should inform the P-GW(s) about the change of RAT type and update its context field. MSISDN is included if available in the stored UE context.

q_6627.question: What is the use of the Delivery-Outcome AVP in the Device-Notification-Request command?
q_6627.ground_truth: The Delivery-Outcome AVP is used to indicate the outcome of the delivery of the trigger request to the MTC device.

q_6628.question: What does the GW (BBERF) do after receiving the response for the IP-CAN specific bearer removal procedure in the PCRF-Initiated Gateway Control Session Termination procedure?
q_6628.ground_truth: The GW (BBERF) replies to the PCRF with an PCRF-Initiated Gateway Control Session Termination acknowledgement.

q_6629.question: Which 3GPP organization is responsible for defining "3GPP defined radio access networks supporting non-Terrestrial Networks" (NRAN)?
q_6629.ground_truth: RAN (RAN1, RAN2, RAN3, RAN4) is responsible for defining radio access networks supporting non-Terrestrial Networks (NRAN) in Release 17.

q_6630.question: What is the difference between a SIM and a USIM in terms of the network they can support?
q_6630.ground_truth: A SIM supports a 2G network, while a USIM only accepts 3G commands and is not compatible with a 2G ME.

q_6631.question: What is the function of Timing Advance (TA) in UMTS system?
q_6631.ground_truth: Timing Advance (TA) is the amount of time, expressed in number of chips, by which the transmission of an uplink burst is anticipated by the UE in order to be received by the cell inside the corresponding time slot.

q_6632.question: What is the purpose of the Block Check Sequence (BCS) in the channel coding process?
q_6632.ground_truth: The Block Check Sequence (BCS) is used for error detection in the channel coding process.

q_6633.question: What message does the UE send to terminate the dialogue after the last location request operation?
q_6633.ground_truth: The UE sends a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

q_6634.question: What is the difference between SPUCCH format 1 and SPUCCH format 1b?
q_6634.ground_truth: SPUCCH format 1 is used for scheduling transmission on a physical uplink shared channel (PUSCH), while SPUCCH format 1b is used for transmitting uplink control information (UCI) on a physical uplink control channel (PUCCH).

q_6635.question: What should the MS do upon receiving a downlink message while the GA-PSR TC activation procedure is in progress in the GPRS network?
q_6635.ground_truth: The MS shall process the request as if the transport channel was active. The MS shall not initiate uplink GPRS user data transfer until the GA-PSR TC activation procedure is successfully completed as specified in the subclause 8.2. Also, the MS shall use the IP address and UDP port number received in the GA-PSR ACTIVATE UTC ACK message for sending uplink GPRS user data packets to the GANC on that transport channel.

q_6636.question: How is the "List of Traffic Data Volumes" attribute of the ePDG-CDR populated?
q_6636.ground_truth: The "List of Traffic Data Volumes" attribute of the ePDG-CDR consists of a set of containers that are added when specific trigger conditions are met. These conditions identify the volume count per Qos, separated for uplink and downlink traffic, on encountering that trigger condition.

q_6637.question: What restrictions does a QoS unaware client face in adapting the bitrate in response to congestion?
q_6637.ground_truth: A QoS unaware client may have to adapt down to virtually 0 kbps, causing poor video quality due to lack of information about GBR.

q_6638.question: What is a "Non-Local Identity" in the context of LI?
q_6638.ground_truth: A "Non-Local Identity" is an identity that is not connected to the operator network. It is based on a match between this target identity and identity type (e.g. IMPU) with the detected party fields. This type of interception is based on national regulations.

q_6639.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do with stored deprioritization requests when requested to perform a manual PLMN selection?
q_6639.ground_truth: The UE should delete the stored deprioritization requests and proceed with the PLMN selection.

q_6640.question: When does the Replaces information element indicate that the I1 session being established will replace the existing SIP dialog?
q_6640.ground_truth: The Replaces information element indicates that the I1 session being established will replace the existing SIP dialog identified by the Replaces information element.

q_6641.question: What is one of the functions of the Controller UE in a Collaborative Session?
q_6641.ground_truth: The Controller UE can initiate the addition, modification, or release of a media flow in a Collaborative Session.

q_6642.question: What is the factor by which the processing complexity increases for DSR compared to EDGE?
q_6642.ground_truth: The total processing complexity of DSR is in the order of 2-3 times higher than for EDGE, i.e. up to 50 % higher per bit.

q_6643.question: What is the purpose of the NBMP Client in the scenario?
q_6643.ground_truth: The NBMP Client is responsible for building the WDD, requesting the NBMP Workflow Manager to instantiate the Workflow, and acknowledging the workflow instantiation to the UA.

q_6644.question: What is the significance of the document versioning in 3GPP Technical Specifications?
q_6644.ground_truth: The version numbering in 3GPP Technical Specifications indicates the development stage of the document, with greater version numbers indicating TSG-approved documents under change control.

q_6645.question: What is the maximum number of packet filters supported by the UE for the PDU session?
q_6645.ground_truth: The Maximum number of packet filters supported by the UE for the PDU session is 16, unless specified differently in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

q_6646.question: What is the purpose of supporting identifiers in the 5G system for a non-public network (NPN)?
q_6646.ground_truth: The purpose of supporting identifiers in the 5G system for a non-public network is to uniquely identify a non-public network.

q_6647.question: What are the operation modes for a GPRS Mobile Station (MS) defined in 3GPP TS 23.060?
q_6647.ground_truth: A GPRS MS may operate in one of the following MS operation modes: MS operation mode A, MS operation mode B, or MS operation mode C.

q_6648.question: What message is sent by the HNB to the HNB-GW to initiate a connection-oriented data service?
q_6648.ground_truth: The CONNECT message is sent by the HNB to the HNB-GW to initiate a connection-oriented data service.

q_6649.question: What is the main motivation for the evolution of mobile networks?
q_6649.ground_truth: The main motivation for the evolution of mobile networks is to improve the user experience.

q_6650.question: What is the maximum allowable disconnection time for the UAV when switching between C2 communication modes in the 5G system?
q_6650.ground_truth: The maximum allowable disconnection time for the UAV when switching between C2 communication modes in the 5G system is below 10 ms.

q_6651.question: In accordance with TS 23.122, clause 4.4.3.1.1, what order should the MS attempt registration on other PLMN/access technology combinations when selecting a PLMN?
q_6651.ground_truth: The MS attempts registration on other PLMN/access technology combinations in the following order: HPLMN, EHPLMN list, data files in the SIM, PLMN/access technology combinations stored in the ME, PLMNs with received high quality signal, and PLMNs in order of decreasing signal quality. If the MS is in eCall only mode, it shall not consider PLMNs which do not advertise support for eCall over IMS, unless such PLMNs are available in GERAN or UTRAN.

q_6652.question: What is used to provide integrity protection, replay protection, and confidentiality protection for the EDGE-4 interface?
q_6652.ground_truth: TLS (Transport Layer Security) is used to provide these protections for the EDGE-4 interface.

q_6653.question: What is the purpose of the ISCP measurement in the HNB and HUE?
q_6653.ground_truth: The ISCP measurement in the HNB and HUE is used to estimate the interference from neighboring cells in both uplink and downlink. If the ISCP measurement value is larger than a predefined threshold, the HNB can shift to work in another carrier to avoid the strong uplink interference or communicate with the interfering cell to coordinate the interference.

q_6654.question: What message is sent by the relay to the Remote UE upon completion of the NSSAA procedure, indicating success and including the authorized S-NSSAI?
