q_6905.ground_truth: The `randomTimePeriod` parameter is used by the BM-SC to signal the duration of an interval for randomly deferring initiation procedures.

q_6906.question: What is the purpose of storing Classmark information by MSC-B?
q_6906.ground_truth: The purpose of storing Classmark information by MSC-B is to use the information at internal handover in MSC-B.

q_6907.question: Which standard specifies the NAS protocol for Evolved Packet System (EPS) in 3GPP Release 14?

q_6908.question: What exception is thrown if dataOffset is less than 0 in CRRP4?

q_6909.question: What should the transmitting PDCP entity do when it generates an EHC feedback packet?
q_6909.ground_truth: It should submit to lower layers the corresponding PDCP Control PDU without associating a PDCP SN or performing ciphering.

q_6910.question: What type of document is the 3GPP Technical Specification for E-UTRAN M1 data transport (Release 17) in terms of 3GPP's internal document versioning system?
q_6910.ground_truth: A TSG approved document under change control (greater than or equal to 3.x.z)

q_6911.question: What is the role of the MExE QoS manager in relation to the network specific QoS control?
q_6911.ground_truth: The MExE QoS manager can access the network specific QoS control through the network control API, and it can also perform some QoS control even if it is not provided in the network control.

q_6912.question: What is the type of the "id-Source-To-Target-TransparentContainer" IE?
q_6912.ground_truth: The type of the "id-Source-To-Target-TransparentContainer" IE is Source-To-Target-TransparentContainer.

q_6913.question: What is the capability required of the producer of performance assurance MnS to allow authorized consumers to collect the CCO related measurements on a per network slice instance basis?

q_6914.question: What is the procedure for T-ADS for IMS voice in the 5G system?
q_6914.ground_truth: The SCC AS initiates T-ADS query towards UDM via Sh interface. The UDM queries T-ADS information towards HSS FE to get T-ADS information related to EPS and UMTS. After receiving response of T-ADS query from HSS FE, UDM responds T-ADS query to SCC AS based on the T-ADS information received from HSS FE and T-ADS information in UDM.

q_6915.question: What must the Access Server (AS) include in a re-INVITE request when initiating third-party call control procedures?
q_6915.ground_truth: The AS must include a P-Asserted-ID header field with a valid identity of the REFER target and a Referred-by header field matching the P-Asserted-Identity of the REFER request in the re-INVITE request when initiating third-party call control procedures. The AS must also include a P-Served-User header field including a valid identity of the referor and Privacy header fields if the P-Asserted-Identity is included in the re-INVITE request.

q_6916.question: What is returned after the findAndCopyValue method is successful and copies the value into the destination buffer?
q_6916.ground_truth: dstOffset + length of the copied value

q_6917.question: What are the responsibilities of the "c-ID" element in the "RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD" sequence in NBAP?
q_6917.ground_truth: The "c-ID" element in the "RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD" sequence identifies the communication context of the CRNC.

q_6918.question: Which function transports charging information for online charging?

q_6919.question: What message does the RNC send to the CN when it decides to perform a direct retry in handover from UMTS to GSM?
q_6919.ground_truth: RANAP message Relocation Required with cause value "Directed Retry"

q_6920.question: What are the noise signal ratios for normal and maximum volume settings when measuring the sound pressure level at the right ERP of HATS in the mobile telephoning simulation, as measured in dB?
q_6920.ground_truth: The noise signal ratio is about + 9,5 dB for maximum volume, and approximately -4,8 dB for nominal volume setting.

q_6921.question: In the context of Rel-17 eType-II port selection codebook, what is the aspect that is shifted toward the gNB to reduce UE computational burden by exploiting angle-delay reciprocity?
q_6921.ground_truth: Spatial domain and frequency domain compression operation are shifted toward the gNB to reduce UE computational burden by exploiting angle-delay reciprocity in DL and UL which is applicable for both TDD and FDD.

q_6922.question: What is the procedure for defining new performance measurements and their addition to the present document?
q_6922.ground_truth: New performance measurements can be defined through the methodology discussed in Annex B of TS 32.404, and submitted for potential adoption and inclusion in the document based on the end-user's needs and potential suitability for multi-vendor network compatibility.

q_6923.question: What is the primary focus of the report regarding Virtual Reality in the context of 3GPP?
q_6923.ground_truth: The primary focus of the report is on 360 degrees video and associated audio, which support three degrees of freedom (3DOF).

q_6924.question: What does the TimeOfDay node in an ISMP rule specify?
q_6924.ground_truth: The TimeOfDay node in an ISMP rule specifies the time of day condition for the rule. The validity condition of TimeOfDay is considered fulfilled when the time of day in the current time zone, as indicated by the UE, matches at least one time interval indicated in the TimeOfDay node.

q_6925.question: What is the abbreviation "UTRAN" an acronym for in the context of 3GPP?
q_6925.ground_truth: UTRAN stands for Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network.

q_6926.question: What action does the DS-TT take if it is capable of acting as a (g)PTP GM?
q_6926.ground_truth: If the DS-TT is capable of acting as a (g)PTP GM and has received the appropriate parameters and instructions from the NEF or TSN AF through PMIC, it will generate (g)PTP Sync, Follow_Up, and Announce messages to devices attached to the UE. If the DS-TT is already active as a grandmaster, it will generate Announce messages to the Master port in the DS-TT and forward the Announce messages to the NW-TT for BMCA execution. If a better Announce message is received or a Sync or Announce receipt timeout is detected, the TSN AF may activate or deactivate the GM in DS-TT(s).

q_6927.question: What is the format of the Extension-FailureIndicationMeasurementItem message?
q_6927.ground_truth: The Extension-FailureIndicationMeasurementItem message is a sequence containing measurementID, cause, and iE-Extensions, which are optional.

q_6928.question: In the N2 based handover procedure, what is the function of the source NG-RAN once the UE has successfully accessed the target cell?
q_6928.ground_truth: The Source NG-RAN sends a Handover Confirm message to the Target NG-RAN to indicate the successful handover.

q_6929.question: What is the state transition model for CFU?
q_6929.ground_truth: The state transition model for CFU shows the successful cases of transition between the applicable logical states of CFU, which are caused by actions of the service provider, the mobile user, or the network.

q_6930.question: What is the unit of the "CLBSB-Rep" value in the calculations?
q_6930.ground_truth: The unit of the "CLBSB-Rep" value in the calculations is decibels (dB).

q_6931.question: What is the function of the MB-SMF in Solution #3 of the system architecture?
q_6931.ground_truth: The MB-SMF handles the multicast distribution session, while an SMF controlled by the MB-SMF handles the PDU session for a UE in the multicast session.

q_6932.question: What message is sent by the GERAN to implicitly establish 4 TBFs for SRBs 1 through 4 when the MS is in MAC-Idle state?
q_6932.ground_truth: The GERAN sends a MAC-layer dedicated assignment in response to an MS issuing a MAC-layer request.

q_6933.question: What event does the ME need to inform the UICC about, as defined in the 3GPP TS 31.111 clause 4.7 and 5.2?

q_6934.question: What should the SGSN do after releasing the Iu when the MS has no active PDP context?
q_6934.ground_truth: The SGSN should take the responsibility to release the Iu interface either immediately or after some timeout.

q_6935.question: Which standard provides the requirements for AT command set for User Equipment (UE) in 3GPP?

q_6936.question: How is the AMR-WB Core Frame divided based on speech bit and comfort noise bit?
q_6936.ground_truth: The AMR-WB Core Frame is divided into three classes based on speech bits and it utilizes a different bit ordering for comfort noise bits.

q_6937.question: What is the format of the eKSI parameter and what does it contain?
q_6937.ground_truth: The eKSI parameter contains a format which allows a recipient of such a parameter to distinguish whether the parameter is of type 'KSIASME' or of type 'KSIGSN', and a value field. The value fields of KSIASME and KSIGSN are three bits each, with seven values used to identify the key set.

q_6938.question: What must a mobile station (MS) do when it receives an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT or IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message before the TBF starting time has expired in the context of single block packet access?
q_6938.ground_truth: The mobile station shall wait until the block period indicated by the TBF starting time.

q_6939.question: What is the synchronization mechanism used by the A/R application to ensure correct recombination of images from the laparoscope and the ultra-sound probe?
q_6939.ground_truth: Medical images are synchronized together thanks to local clocks stabilized on the grand master clock with a very tight accuracy to ensure correct recombination of the two data streams in a single and accurate A/R image by the A/R application.

q_6940.question: What is the purpose of the Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) speech codec in 3GPP technical specifications?
q_6940.ground_truth: The Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) speech codec is used in 3GPP technical specifications for ensuring the correct operation of background acoustic noise evaluation, noise parameter encoding/decoding, and comfort noise generation during Source Controlled Rate (SCR) operation in mobile communications.

q_6941.question: What is the role of the MAC sublayer in controlling the timing of RACH transmissions in FDD?
q_6941.ground_truth: The MAC sublayer is in charge of controlling the timing of RACH transmissions on transmission time interval level in FDD, with retransmissions in case of erroneously received RACH message parts under the control of higher layers.

q_6942.question: What procedure is used to deactivate all the dedicated channels in use for an RR connection?
q_6942.ground_truth: The channel release procedure is used to deactivate all the dedicated channels in use for an RR connection.

q_6943.question: What is the purpose of the Recommended rate in the context of network assistance for DASH clients?
q_6943.ground_truth: The Recommended rate is a suggested video payload rate that the network provides to the client to assist in making better adaptation decisions, based on estimates of both radio link and transport link rates, radio quality, and network policies.

q_6944.question: What is the formula for computing the "Tracking Area Update Success Rate" KPI?
q_6944.ground_truth: The "Tracking Area Update Success Rate" KPI is calculated by taking the ratio of the number of successfully performed tracking area update procedures to the number of attempted tracking area update procedures. It is obtained by successful tracking area update procedures divided by attempted tracking area update procedures.

q_6945.question: What is the purpose of synchronizing operations in CAP protocol?
q_6945.ground_truth: The purpose of synchronizing operations is to avoid complicated fall-back procedures when introducing major functional changes in the protocol. This synchronization takes place before the new function is invoked in either application entity.

q_6946.question: What is the function of the Network Instance in enabling multiple network slice sharing in 5G networks?
q_6946.ground_truth: The Network Instance is used for traffic detection and routing as required by network slice.

q_6947.question: What should the BSS do when on a TCH or SDCCH in A/Gb mode or when on a DBPSCH in Iu mode?
q_6947.ground_truth: The BSS should make the same RXLEV and RXQUAL assessments as described for the MS for all TCH's, SDCCH's or DBPSCH's assigned to an MS, using the associated reporting periods.

q_6948.question: What is the assumed data rate for each mobile in all scenarios provided in the illustration?
q_6948.ground_truth: Both mobiles are assumed to be sending variable rate encoded video data at 15 frames per second (60 ms rate) in all scenarios.

q_6949.question: Which protocol extension is used to indicate the assisted GANSS data required in a Position Periodic Report?

q_6950.question: What state does the MSC-1 Server instruct MGW-1 to set the Handover Device after releasing the A-interface line towards BSS-1?
q_6950.ground_truth: The MSC-1 Server instructs MGW-1 to set the Handover Device to its final state by removing the bearer termination towards the BSS-1.

q_6951.question: In the context of RL-InformationResponse-RL-AdditionRspTDD768, what does the term "SAI" stand for?

q_6952.question: In the urban microcell environment, how are the multipath delays randomly associated with AoDs?
q_6952.ground_truth: In the urban microcell environment, the multipath delays are randomly associated with AoDs using a random process. This association is done so that the phases defined for each sub-path are maintained.

q_6953.question: What should be done with all L3-enabled processes when they are deactivated?
q_6953.ground_truth: They become inactive, regardless of whether they were active or inactive before deactivation.

q_6954.question: What is the purpose of "Number of RTP messages received on Nb interface" measurement in 5.3.2.1?
q_6954.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of RTP messages received on Nb interface, it is used to monitor the performance of the bearer transport in the Nb interface for GSM/UMTS networks.

q_6955.question: How does the SMLC determine the MS location using the information received from the BSS?
q_6955.ground_truth: The SMLC collects and validates all Multilateration Timing Advance, BTS Reception Accuracy Level, MS Sync Accuracy, and Cell Identifier information associated with a given MS for up to the length of the Multilateration Positioning Method timer after triggering the Multilateration Timing Advance procedure, using the provided Random ID or Short ID value. The SMLC then determines the MS location using validated information.

q_6956.question: What is the goal of radio frame size equalisation in the UL?
q_6956.ground_truth: The goal of radio frame size equalisation is to ensure that the output can be segmented in Fi data segments of the same size.

q_6957.question: What services does the RR sublayer provide in group receive mode to mobile stations supporting both VGCS listening and VGCS transmit?
q_6957.ground_truth: The RR procedures on the mobile station side provide the services: uplink access procedures to establish the RR connection; priority uplink request procedures to establish the RR connection, if talker priority is supported by the mobile station; and uplink access procedures to establish the RR connection for sending application-specific data to the network.

q_6958.question: What action should an IWF take if the MCPTT group for a served MCPTT group ID does not exist?
q_6958.ground_truth: The IWF should reject the SIP PUBLISH request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

q_6959.question: What is the function of the "Per Access Network Performance" analytics in NWDAF?
q_6959.ground_truth: The "Per Access Network Performance" analytics in NWDAF supports the collection of communication performance data per access type.

q_6960.question: What are the limitations of using multicast distribution in 3GPP networks?
q_6960.ground_truth: The limitations include the use of private IP addresses by 3GPP terminals which can prevent multicast spanning trees from spanning different private IP address domains, the absence of a standardized mechanism in 3GPP networks that enables the terminal to request assignment of an available multicast IP address for its use, and the security risk as the joining of a multicast spanning tree is not authenticated. Additionally, 3GPP terminals are generally assigned private IP addresses by the MNO, which can prevent multicast spanning trees from spanning different private IP address domains.

q_6961.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification in the context of NR Repeater type 2-O?
q_6961.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification is to specify the Radio Frequency (RF) test methods and conformance requirements for NR Repeater type 2-O.

q_6962.question: What is the purpose of preventing a UE from automatically repeatedly selecting an SNPN that rejects the UE's registration?
q_6962.ground_truth: The purpose is to handle permanently and temporarily forbidden SNPNs and can be defined by CT1.

q_6963.question: What is the scope of the Recommended Minimum Performance Requirements Specification (TBA) in relation to implementing noise suppression in the downlink?
q_6963.ground_truth: The Recommended Minimum Performance Requirements Specification (TBA) covers only the uplink case where the algorithm is implemented in the mobile station. It does not include the requirements or specifications for implementing noise suppression in the downlink.

q_6964.question: What is the role of Application Layer User ID and Application Layer Group ID in ProSe features?
q_6964.ground_truth: Application Layer User ID is an identity identifying a user within the context of a specific application, while Application Layer Group ID is an identity uniquely identifying a group of users within the context of a specific application.

q_6965.question: How is an UE PDN connection uniquely identified in the case where multiple PDN connections to the same APN are supported by both MAG and LMA?
q_6965.ground_truth: An UE PDN connection can be uniquely identified by a (MN-Id, APN, PDN connection ID) tuple.

q_6966.question: What is the main objective of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical specification group for the radio access network's work item on LTE TDD Home eNodeB RF requirements?
q_6966.ground_truth: The main objective is to first identify relevant scenarios and then write an RF requirements specification that is applicable to LTE TDD Home eNodeB.

q_6967.question: What type of information is received from the SI2quater message in a cell without a PBCCH allocated?
q_6967.ground_truth: GPRS Measurement Parameters, GPRS 3G Measurement Parameters and 3G Priority Parameters

q_6968.question: What are the two scenarios described to support service continuity?
q_6968.ground_truth: The two scenarios described to support service continuity are: Scenario 1 - Slice resource shortage in case of Intra-RA mobility and Inter-RA mobility, and Scenario 2 - Non-supported slice in case of Inter-RA mobility.

q_6969.question: What is a target identity and how is it used in the context of telecommunications?
q_6969.ground_truth: A target identity is a technical identity that uniquely identifies a target for interception. It is used in lawful authorization for telecommunications interception, and may be associated with one or more target services.

q_6970.question: What is the type used for query request in LA Data Service Template?

q_6971.question: When can a mobile station attempt to decode USF or PAN in a downlink radio block?
q_6971.ground_truth: Only in a downlink radio block transmitted using a TSC it has been assigned.

q_6972.question: What functions does the Edge Application Server of an Edge Data Network provide for Edge Application Server's service APIs publish and discovery?
q_6972.ground_truth: The Edge Application Server of an Edge Data Network provides the API exposing function, the API publishing function, and the API management function for Edge Application Server's service APIs publish and discovery. These functions enable invocation of service APIs exposed from the Edge Application Server, publishing of service APIs of edge applications to the CAPIF core function of the Edge Enabler Server, and managing service APIs of the Edge Application Server to the CAPIF core function of the Edge Enabler Server, respectively.

q_6973.question: How is the SNR emulated in the two-stage method for MIMO radiated test?
q_6973.ground_truth: The SNR is emulated in the two-stage method by setting the power of the AWGN correctly when measuring the throughput for the given MIMO antenna design. The first stage antenna pattern measurement does not require AWGN.

q_6974.question: What is the pass criteria for the RTCP Report Count Test?
q_6974.ground_truth: The pass criteria for this test are that all RTCP packets sent from the SUT fulfil the following: 1) The report count (RC) field is consistent with the number of report blocks observed to be included in the packet, regardless if the RTCP packet is a Sender Report or Receiver Report, and 2) The length field has a value that is the number of 32-bit words minus one occupied by that RTCP packet, including the RTCP packet header and any padding.

q_6975.question: What is the formula for the leaving triggered state condition for event 3c in inter-RAT measurements?
q_6975.ground_truth: The formula for the leaving triggered state condition for event 3c is MOther RAT > TOther RAT + CIOOther RAT + H3c, where MOther RAT is the measurement quantity for the cell of the other system, TOther RAT is the absolute threshold that applies for the other system in that measurement, CIOOther RAT is the cell individual offset for the cell of the other system, and H3c is the hysteresis parameter for event 3c.

q_6976.question: What is the role of Transcoder B' in the speech path when TFO-Negotiation is not successful?
q_6976.ground_truth: When TFO-Negotiation is not successful, Transcoder B' performs the necessary transcoding to PCM to carry compressed speech with high bandwidth efficiency on the Nb and Iu interfaces.

q_6977.question: When should the IMS-AGW send media using the highest priority candidate pair for which connectivity checks have been completed?
q_6977.ground_truth: After the initial SDP offer-answer exchange.

q_6978.question: What is the purpose of the procedure specified in clause 5.5.5 of TS 38.331?
q_6978.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer measurement results from the UE to the network.

q_6979.question: What is the function of the Mobile Additional Function MAF017 in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_6979.ground_truth: The Mobile Additional Function MAF017 is used to determine the authorizations relating to barring of all outgoing calls.

q_6980.question: What type of reference signals are used for CSI estimation in the LTE-Advanced system?
q_6980.ground_truth: Reference signals used for CSI estimation in the LTE-Advanced system are cell-specific, sparse in frequency and time, and punctured into the data region of normal/MBSFN subframes.

q_6981.question: What are the two DSR Front-ends developed by the ETSI STQ-Aurora working group?
q_6981.ground_truth: The two DSR Front-ends are ES 201 108 and ES 202 050.

q_6982.question: What is the purpose of the Relocation of application context solution?
q_6982.ground_truth: The Relocation of application context solution allows the Edge Application Server to determine whether the application context for a UE is to be relocated, it prepares the required UE application context to be relocated and transfers it to the target Edge Application Server, with this solution the UE will not be aware of the application context of the UE being relocated and preserves the service continuity.

q_6983.question: What is an Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP TM?
q_6983.ground_truth: An Integration Reference Point (IRP) in 3GPP TM is a specification that defines the information in the agent that is visible for the manager, the operations that the manager may perform on this information, and the notifications that are sent from the agent to the manager.

q_6984.question: What should the "3GPP-Adaptation" header be sent in the response and what does its presence indicate?
q_6984.ground_truth: The "3GPP-Adaptation" header should be sent in responses to requests containing this header, and its presence indicates to the client that the server acknowledges the request.

q_6985.question: What protocol is used for the bearer data transport in BICC-based Nc when transported over ATM?
q_6985.ground_truth: AAL2 (ATM Adaptation Layer Type 2) is used for the bearer data transport in BICC-based Nc when transported over ATM.

q_6986.question: For what purpose is the MEASUREMENT REPORT message used?
q_6986.ground_truth: The MEASUREMENT REPORT message is used by the mobile station to report measurement results about the dedicated channel and about neighbor cells to the network.

q_6987.question: When should the PLMN BC parameters be set to "transparent" and "non-transparent", respectively, if an LLC is received and indicates UIL1P=X.31?
q_6987.ground_truth: The PLMN BC parameters should be set to "transparent" if the ISDN-BC received consists of octets 1 to 4 only, and to "non-transparent" if the ISDN-BC received consists of octets 1 to 5 only and indicates UIL1P=X.31.

q_6988.question: What action does the MRFP take when it receives an RTP header extension for Predefined ROI and does not apply video transcoding?
q_6988.ground_truth: The MRFP passes any received RTP header extension for Predefined ROI to succeeding RTP streams.

q_6989.question: What are the steps taken by the AMF during the Verified N26 Handover with Serving GW Change procedure?
q_6989.ground_truth: Steps include validation of the TAU request message, requesting SM Context, providing mapped EBS context, and sending a Context Response message carrying mapped MM context.

q_6990.question: What is the Survival Time used for in 3GPP network functions?
q_6990.ground_truth: Survival Time is an optional parameter in the TSC Assistance container, used to indicate the amount of time a network slice instance can remain alive without requiring additional signaling with the user equipment (UE).

q_6991.question: What should the UE do if more than one cell meets the reselection criteria and the highest-priority cell is from a different RAT?
q_6991.ground_truth: The UE shall reselect the highest ranked cell among the cells on the highest priority frequency(ies) meeting the criteria of that RAT.

q_6992.question: What is the term used to represent a 48-bit anonymity key in the document?

q_6993.question: What is the definition of "Outgoing Access (OA)" in the context of the CUG Supplementary Service?
q_6993.ground_truth: Outgoing Access (OA) is an arrangement that allows a member of a CUG to place calls outside the CUG.

q_6994.question: If a UE chooses the high resolution representation with HEVC simulcast solution, how many layers of resolution will the UE receive?
q_6994.ground_truth: The UE will receive a single layer of 1080p resolution.

q_6995.question: What is the third primitive type used for the communication between the BMC sublayer and other entities?

q_6996.question: What is the maximum response time for the UE to send a WLAN-ProvideLocationInformation IE including the wlan-MeasurementList-r13 field in this test?
q_6996.ground_truth: The maximum response time is equal to the LPP time IE value of 21 seconds, minus T, where T = 150 ms, plus the test tolerance of 300ms.

q_6997.question: What is the purpose of the frame substitution and muting procedure defined in the document?
q_6997.ground_truth: The purpose of the frame substitution and muting procedure is to be used by the Receive (RX) Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) handler for the half rate speech traffic channels within the digital cellular telecommunications system, in case of lost or unreliable speech or SIdence Descriptor (SID) frames received from the Radio Sub System (RSS).

q_6998.question: What is the name of the parameter that is made up of the following: Original SCCP Calling party address, Original SCCP Message type, Original SCCP Protocol class in the intermediate unprotected representation?

q_6999.question: What information does the "Supported" header field in the initial INVITE request contain?
q_6999.ground_truth: The "Supported" header field in the initial INVITE request contains the option-tags "100rel" and "precondition".

q_7000.question: What is the purpose of the FEC Evaluation Procedure?
q_7000.ground_truth: The FEC Evaluation Procedure is defined for the evaluation and selection of FEC code performance. It includes procedures to measure theoretical FEC code performance, FEC performance in 3GPP services, as well as high-level and detailed decoder performance.

q_7001.question: What should the "Message authentication code" in the IE "Integrity check info" in the message be set to when calculating the message authentication code in step 8.5.10.3?
q_7001.ground_truth: The "Message authentication code" in the IE "Integrity check info" in the message should be set to the value of the IE "RB identity" for the signalling radio bearer.

q_7002.question: What is the time duration for each step in subclause 7.7.4.2.1 for the 3,84 Mcps TDD option?
q_7002.ground_truth: The time duration of each step should be sufficiently long to capture one even (transmit) time slot.

q_7003.question: What restriction applies to the distribution of IMSI and authentication data between MMEs belonging to different serving network domains?
q_7003.ground_truth: Unused EPS authentication vectors, or non-current EPS security contexts, shall not be distributed between MMEs belonging to different serving domains (PLMNs).

q_7004.question: What is the equation used to convert the average high band signal energy to the domain, before quantizing it in the SWB SID frame?
q_7004.ground_truth: The equation used is (1357) which is the average high band signal energy in domain.

q_7005.question: What information is provided to the CSE when the VPLMN/IPLMN network makes contact with it?
q_7005.ground_truth: The VPLMN/IPLMN network provides the CSE with the following information: event met, type of monitoring, cause for unsuccessful call establishment (if applicable), event specific data (such as received DTMF digits), the party in the call for which the event is detected and reported (calling or called party), and the type of monitoring (control or notification).

q_7006.question: What is the expected output for the memcmp function in Test Case 1 under the "Test Procedure" section for CatEndSelectItem?
q_7006.ground_truth: The expected output is that the two buffers contain the same data.

q_7007.question: When can a leg be moved from one call segment to another call segment?
q_7007.ground_truth: A leg can be moved from one call segment to another call segment as a result of a Move Leg or Split Leg information flow.

q_7008.question: How is the bootstrapping information transferred in GAA?
q_7008.ground_truth: NAF specific bootstrapping information is transferred from a BSF to a NAF and contains NAF and its service specific parts from bootstrapped data and needed key information derived from the bootstrapped data.

q_7009.question: What is the abbreviation for Group Call Control in 3GPP TS?

q_7010.question: What kind of standard is 3GPP?
q_7010.ground_truth: 3GPP (Third Generation Partnership Project) is a standardization project with the goal of developing specifications for mobile telecommunications. It is a collaboration of telecommunications standards bodies in seven countries, including ARIB, ATIS, CCSA, ETSI, TTA, TTC, and GSMA. These organizations work together to develop global technical specifications for 3G, 4G, and 5G mobile networks and services.

q_7011.question: What is one of the allowed CCTrCH combinations for one UE on the uplink?
q_7011.ground_truth: One of the allowed CCTrCH combinations for one UE on the uplink is several CCTrCH of dedicated type.

q_7012.question: What must the SS Version Indicator value be when the UE invokes a MO-LR by sending a REGISTER message?
q_7012.ground_truth: The SS Version Indicator value must be 1 or above.

q_7013.question: How much bit rate reduction, on average, does H.265 (HEVC) provide over H264 for the MTSI service in the medium bitrate range?
q_7013.ground_truth: The bit rate of H.265 (HEVC) is approximately 60% of that of H264 for the MTSI service in the medium bitrate range.

q_7014.question: What are the desired characteristics for the signal path in the described use case?
q_7014.ground_truth: The signal path should be resilient, with guaranteed bandwidth and QoS. Precision Time Protocol (IEEE 1588-2008) support and open standard-based broadcast workflows are also necessary for this application.

q_7015.question: What is the purpose of the measurement DBU.NbrPubUserIdentities with SIP URI format?
q_7015.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of Public Service Identities with SIP URI format stored in a HSS.

q_7016.question: What is the purpose of the Unified Access Control (UAC) procedure in 5G networks?
q_7016.ground_truth: The UAC procedure is used to perform access barring checks for a 5GS access attempt associated with a given Access Category and one or more Access Identities upon request from upper layers or the RRC layer.

q_7017.question: What is the effect of Downlink Dual Carrier in the allocation of uplink resources?
q_7017.ground_truth: If a mobile station supports Downlink Dual Carrier, the PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT or MULTIPLE TBF UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message may assign PDCHs on more than one carrier frequency, with the Extended Dynamic Allocation procedures operating independently on each of the two carriers.

q_7018.question: When is it necessary for the AS to send an INFO request including an Identification Request MIME body?
q_7018.ground_truth: The AS sends an INFO request including an Identification Request MIME body when the INVITE request does not contain the information of the originating party.

q_7019.question: What is the main purpose of Security risk assessment in the context of 5G network?
q_7019.ground_truth: The main purpose is to detect anomalies in managed objects, identify potential security risks, and propose countermeasures to mitigate them in order to ensure the security and stability of the network.

q_7020.question: What should the SGSN provide for the downlink MBMS-UNITDATA procedure?
q_7020.ground_truth: The SGSN provides the BSSGP with a current TMGI, MBMS Session Identity, PDU Lifetime, and identifies the MBMS Service Context for the downlink MBMS-UNITDATA procedure.

q_7021.question: What are some technical features that can be used to overcome the challenges in mmWAVE spectrum for televison production requirements?
q_7021.ground_truth: Some technical features used to overcome the challenges in mmWAVE spectrum for televison production requirements include advanced beam management and multi-carrier operation. Also, to operate scenario at a few hundred megabits per second, content delivery protocols and codecs are needed to compensate for mmWAVE channel characteristics, achieve high reliability and high bit rate.

q_7022.question: What is the main function of the SO's provisioning server in the solution?
q_7022.ground_truth: The SO's provisioning server provides N3GPP credential data to the successfully authenticated UE. It may reuse an existing provisioning server, such as a Certificate Authority (CA), for certificate issue.

q_7023.question: What is the difference in interference leakage between 23dBm interfering LTE UE and 31dBm interfering HPUE in NB-IoT UE and LTE UE transmissions?
q_7023.ground_truth: The interference leaked from LTE UL to NB-IoT UL with 31dBm interfering HPUE is 1.5dB, 0.6dB, 0.3dB, and 0.3dB higher (at 5%, 50%, 95%, and 99% CDF points, respectively) than that with 23dBm interfering LTE UE.

q_7024.question: What protocols does the SGW use to interact with the SS7 signalling function and the MGCF?
q_7024.ground_truth: The SGW uses SCTP and M3UA protocols to interact with the SS7 signalling function and the MGCF.

q_7025.question: What message does the BSS send to the SGSN to initiate an intra-BSS PS handover?
q_7025.ground_truth: The BSS sends a "PS Handover Required" message to the SGSN to initiate an intra-BSS PS handover.

q_7026.question: What type of data is the Service-ID AVP expected to contain?
q_7026.ground_truth: The Service-ID AVP is expected to contain a UTF8String that identifies the service the MRFC is hosting or AoC service.

q_7027.question: What is the purpose of the Echo Response message in the 3GPP TS 29.274 specification?
q_7027.ground_truth: The Echo Response message is sent as a response to a received Echo Request, and it includes the Recovery information element containing the local Restart Counter value for the node that sends the Echo Response message.

q_7028.question: From ITU-T SG16, what telepresence system feature is considered an advanced feature and recommended for SA4 to consider?
q_7028.ground_truth: Actual size high definition imaging of videoconferencing participants at the remote end is an advanced feature recommended for SA4 to consider.

q_7029.question: Which clause describes the more specific details about the test procedure?
q_7029.ground_truth: X.4.2y specifies the initial conditions and procedures for the test method, including details such as domain, range, weighting, and algorithms.

q_7030.question: What is the size of the non-MBSFN region in an MBSFN subframe when using, or ?
q_7030.ground_truth: For subframes using, or, the non-MBSFN region spans the first one or two OFDM symbols in an MBSFN subframe, depending on the length of the non-MBSFN region given in Clause 6.7.

q_7031.question: What are the two functions of the RUA in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_7031.ground_truth: The RUA has two main functions: transparently transferring RANAP messages and handling errors. The error handling function enables the reporting of general error situations for which function-specific error messages have not been defined.

q_7032.question: What port number will the new application X populate as the destination port in the request message?
q_7032.ground_truth: The new application X will populate the port number 50000 as the destination port in the request message.

q_7033.question: What procedure does the SCF (Service Capability Feature) follow when PSS to MBMS switching is available in 8.4.4.1.3?
q_7033.ground_truth: When PSS to MBMS switching is available for the UE, the SCF terminates the SIP session between it and the PSS Adapter by sending a SIP BYE message to the PSS Adapter in 8.4.4.1.3.

q_7034.question: When will the PCRF remove QoS rules from non-primary BBERFs in a RAR message?
q_7034.ground_truth: The PCRF will remove QoS rules from non-primary BBERFs in a RAR message when the primary BBERF rejects the installation of one or more QoS rules in a RA-Answer command.

q_7035.question: What information must the AF request the PCRF to report if an IP-CAN bearer establishment mode is to be negotiated for non-3GPP IP-CANs using Gxx?
q_7035.ground_truth: Negotiation of bearer establishment mode takes place via Gxx for non-3GPP IP-CANs using GTP, the PCRF must negotiate via Gxx for the rest of the cases.

q_7036.question: What is the purpose of the source Edge Enabler Server and Context ID in the registration process?
q_7036.ground_truth: If the Edge Enabler Client is moving from the purview of a source Edge Enabler Server to the new Edge Enabler Server, the request from the Edge Enabler Client may include the identity of the source Edge Enabler Server and an Edge Enabler Client Registration Context ID that was provided by the source Edge Enabler Server.

q_7037.question: What is the role of the CDF when it comes to Monitoring Event reports sent by the MECN?
q_7037.ground_truth: The CDF, based on operator implementation, generates a single ME-RE-CDR when a burst of Monitoring Event reports is reported by the CTF or may generate an individual ME-RE-CDR for each Monitoring Event report when a burst is reported by the CTF. The CDF, in the context of Monitoring Event reporting, is responsible for collecting charging information related to a single Monitoring Event report or a burst of Monitoring Event reports in a short time interval.

q_7038.question: In what situation does the UE need to initiate a UE-initiated modification procedure for a multi-access PDN connection over 3GPP accesses and untrusted WLAN?
q_7038.ground_truth: When the network-initiated NBIFOM mode is selected, the RAN rules control the WLAN access selection and traffic routing, the RAN rules handling parameter is set, and the local operating environment information in the UE does not contain non-radio-related conditions that prohibit the use of WLAN access.

q_7039.question: What is the potential consequence if the control message from the parent-node to the child-node is not protected in the IAB backhaul-RLF recovery scenario?
q_7039.ground_truth: An over-the-air attacker could potentially trigger backhaul-RLF recovery on the child-node, leading to abrupt loss of connection for a large number of UEs, short- or long-term degradation in throughput or speed, and loss of operator's reputation.

q_7040.question: Which service enables a user to establish a simultaneous communication involving several users?
q_7040.ground_truth: The 3PTY service enables a user to establish and control a simultaneous communication involving several users. This service is invoked by the served user involved in at least two communication sessions (one active communication and at least one held communication), which can be either incoming or outgoing.

q_7041.question: How does the Parent UE respond to a parental control request from the SCF?
q_7041.ground_truth: The Parent UE sends a SIP MESSAGE message back to the SCF with the XML document unchanged to accept the request, or with the ProgramID deleted to refuse the request.

q_7042.question: What should be the source IP address observed in incoming DNS query packets as client subnet option in 5GC?
q_7042.ground_truth: The source IP address observed in incoming DNS query packets as client subnet option should be added when forwarding a DNS query in 5GC.

q_7043.question: What should an MRFC do when it recognizes that the MRFP is available again?
q_7043.ground_truth: After an MRFP becomes available again, the MRFC can use the MRFP after receiving an MRFP Communication Up message or an MRFP Restoration message. The MRFC can also initiate the MRFC Ordered Re-register procedure if none of the three conditions (1, 2, or 3) occur.

q_7044.question: What are the two main categories of logical channels supported by the radio subsystem as defined in the document?
q_7044.ground_truth: The two main categories of logical channels supported by the radio subsystem as defined in the document are the traffic channels (TCH's) and the control channels.

q_7045.question: Which KPI is obtained by the sum of the number of successful session establishments and the number of failed session establishment due to user behavior factors divided by the number of attempted session establishments for originating side and terminating side respectively for IMS?

q_7046.question: What is the maximum value allowed for the Peak Code Domain Error in MBSFN-only operation?
q_7046.ground_truth: The peak code domain error shall not exceed -28 dB at spreading factor 16 for 3.84 Mcps TDD option and -31 dB at spreading factor 32 for 7.68 Mcps TDD option, in MBSFN-only operation.

q_7047.question: What is the procedure when the validity timer associated with a ProSe Response Code expires?
q_7047.ground_truth: When the validity timer associated with a ProSe Response Code expires, the ProSe Function removes the entry related to that ProSe Response Code from the UE context.

q_7048.question: What will the MTC-IWF do if the SCS does not acknowledge the receipt of the Device-Notification-Request command for MSISDN-less MO-SMS Delivery?
q_7048.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF will resend the Device-Notification-Request command to the SCS until an acknowledgment is received.

q_7049.question: What should the value of s be for each cell which belongs to the serving E-DCH radio link set, in the case where the E-DCH control data is received in the E-RGCH frame associated with SFN i?
q_7049.ground_truth: The value of s should be 1, in the case where the E-DCH control data is received in the E-RGCH frame associated with SFN i.

q_7050.question: When does the MBMS client provide persistent storage for received files?
q_7050.ground_truth: The MBMS client only provides persistent storage for received files to ensure they are made available to the requesting application. Once files are moved to the application space, the application is responsible for managing them.

q_7051.question: What is the difference between the "Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio" (ACLR) and the "Out-of-band emission" (OOBE) in 3GPP technical specifications?
q_7051.ground_truth: Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio (ACLR) is a measure of the unwanted signal emitted in the adjacent frequency band to the desired one and Out-of-band emission (OOBE) is a measure of the unwanted signal emitted in other than the desired frequency band.

q_7052.question: What is the system-dependent delay for Tsps?
q_7052.ground_truth: The system-dependent delay for Tsps is the delay of the speech encoder after reception of the last PCM sample until availability of the first encoded bit.

q_7053.question: What is denoted by S in the bit scrambling process?
q_7053.ground_truth: S is the number of bits input to the bit scrambling block, which is equal to the total number of bits on the CCTrCH.

q_7054.question: What is the recommended action when a message initiating a procedure is missing one or more IEs/IE groups marked as "Reject IE"?
q_7054.ground_truth: The receiving node should reject the procedure and report the missing IEs/IE groups using the message normally used to report unsuccessful outcome of the procedure. If the information received in the initiating message was insufficient to determine a value for all IEs required to be present in the procedure report, the receiving node shall instead terminate the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure.

q_7055.question: In FDD, what does the "ALL RLS" in the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message refer to?
q_7055.ground_truth: Measurement results should be reported for all existing and future Radio Link Sets within the UE Context.

q_7056.question: What should be triggered when SG is smaller than a certain value or TEBS is larger than zero, and an E-DCH serving cell change occurs?
q_7056.ground_truth: The transmission of Scheduling Information should be triggered on the new E-DCH serving cell.

q_7057.question: What defines a cell in GAN for the purpose of location services and billing?
q_7057.ground_truth: A cell in GAN for the purpose of location services and billing is defined by a Cell Global Identity (CGI), which is the concatenation of a Location Area Identity (LAI) and Cell Identity (CI).

q_7058.question: What is the Resource Management function of the CRNC in FDD?
q_7058.ground_truth: The CRNC in FDD controls cell coverage by sending a maximum total RTWP value to the Node B, which reflects the total interference including contributions from all uplink traffic and external interferers. The scheduling should be such that the maximum total RTWP value is not exceeded. The CRNC may also send to the Node B the Reference Received Total Wideband Power (RTWP) and the target value of Non-serving E-DCH to total E-DCH power ratio per cell. The Node-B should not send down the E-DCH Reporting area if both of the criteria of the Target RTWP and the Non-serving E-DCH to total E-DCH power ratio are not met.

q_7059.question: What is the role of the MS-BSS interface in the GSM PLMN?
q_7059.ground_truth: The MS-BSS interface in the GSM PLMN is the connection between the mobile station and the base station system, and it is specified to allow separate evolution of mobile stations and network equipment technologies.

q_7060.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's File Transfer Integration Reference Point (FileTransferIRP) as it applies to the Itf-N?
q_7060.ground_truth: The present document specifies the Information Service for the File Transfer Integration Reference Point (FileTransferIRP) as it applies to the Itf-N.

q_7061.question: Where is the Default APN for Trusted WLAN and the list of Access Information for Trusted WLAN permanently stored?
q_7061.ground_truth: The Default APN for Trusted WLAN and the list of Access Information for Trusted WLAN are both permanently stored in the HSS and 3GPP AAA Server.

q_7062.question: What is the role of the "serviceInteractionIndicatorsTwo" parameter in the "ConnectToResource" procedure?
q_7062.ground_truth: The "serviceInteractionIndicatorsTwo" parameter is used to control the through connection to the Calling Party in the "ConnectToResource" procedure.

q_7063.question: What network deployment scenarios should be taken into account for maritime communication in 3GPP?
q_7063.ground_truth: Network deployment scenarios for maritime communication should consider moving networks, isolated networks, or satellite access networks, as fixed mobile network deployments are used for most terrestrial mobile services.

q_7064.question: What is the difference in average BD-rate reduction between H.265 (HEVC) and H.264 (AVC) for the low-to-medium bit-rate ranges in the set of tests?
q_7064.ground_truth: The difference in average BD-rate reduction was in the range of 27.4 - 45.3%.

q_7065.question: What identifies a swMProcess instance uniquely?
q_7065.ground_truth: The identifier of the swMProcess, which is identical to the identifier of the NE.

q_7066.question: Which design criteria should be met by the 3GPP MILENAGE algorithm functions in order to be practically indistinguishable from independent random functions?
q_7066.ground_truth: Cryptographic Criteria 1 in section 7.1 states that the functions f1, f1*, f2, f3, f4, f5, and f5* should be practically indistinguishable from independent random functions of their inputs when knowledge of secret keys is absent.

q_7067.question: What is the operation that is used for obtaining deciphering keys broadcast in LCS assistance data?
q_7067.ground_truth: The Deciphering Keys Update Operation, which allows a SMLC controlling deciphering keys to send the keys to another SMLC Client within the same location area.

q_7068.question: What is the length of an OFDM symbol in NR, including the CP, when using a subcarrier spacing of 15 kHz * 2n (where n is a negative integer)?
q_7068.ground_truth: The length of an OFDM symbol, including the CP, for a subcarrier spacing of 15 kHz * 2n equals the sum of the corresponding 2n symbols of 15 kHz.

q_7069.question: What is the purpose of the signer's private key dA in the signature generation process?
q_7069.ground_truth: The signer's private key dA is used to calculate the value of s, which is one of the components of the signed message.

q_7070.question: What is the effect of expiring T3248 on the mobile station during the monitoring of DL EC-PACCH for an RLC/MAC control message?
q_7070.ground_truth: When T3248 expires, the mobile station releases the ongoing uplink TBF and may perform an abnormal release with access retry, unless timer T3248 is used with a non-zero timer value, in which case it starts timer T3248 and continues to monitor the DL EC-PACCH.

q_7071.question: What is the purpose of the BSSGP flow control model?
q_7071.ground_truth: The purpose of the BSSGP flow control model is to decide which LLC-PDUs are conforming to the flow to the PFC of an MS, to an MS or in a BSSGP virtual connection (BVC) over the Gb interface. It regulates the transmission of data by controlling the size of the bucket, the rate at which data is passed, and the time that data is delayed if the bucket limit is exceeded.

q_7072.question: How does a UE determine the schema version required to parse an instantiation of the Schedule Description?
q_7072.ground_truth: The UE uses the schema that has the highest schema version attribute value that is equal to or less than the value in the received schemaVersion element.

q_7073.question: How many satellites are required to be visible for BDS (including GEO, IGSO, and MEO) in Assisted GNSS minimum performance testing?
q_7073.ground_truth: In Assisted GNSS minimum performance testing, for BDS constellation, 5 GEO, 3 IGSO and 27 MEO Satellites of BDS should be visible, in total 35 satellites. But, we test using signals for only 6 satellites or 7 if SBAS is included.

q_7074.question: What is the minimum number of static power control steps required for each supported modulation?
q_7074.ground_truth: The minimum number of static power control steps required for each supported modulation is Nmax with respect to the declared output power of the manufacturer. For the modulation with the highest output power, Nmax shall be at least 6.

q_7075.question: How are messages in the IMS (SIP) system represented in TTCN-3?
q_7075.ground_truth: In IMS (SIP) system, messages are represented as records in TTCN-3, where each grammar rule in the ABNF has a corresponding TTCN-3 record type.

q_7076.question: What is the purpose of the "MTA Signature" option in the RLC data block method?
q_7076.ground_truth: The "MTA Signature" option in the RLC data block method is used to verify the integrity of the location estimated from the MTA positioning method.

q_7077.question: What is the purpose of generating a quintet in the HLR/AuC?
q_7077.ground_truth: In the HLR/AuC, a quintet is generated for the purpose of authentication and key derivation, consisting of RAND, XRES, CK, IK, and AUTN. If the sequence number is to be concealed, an additional anonymity key AK is generated and used to compute the concealed sequence number.

q_7078.question: When must the TDF include two instances of the Used-Service-Unit AVP in the usage report?
q_7078.ground_truth: The TDF must include two instances of the Used-Service-Unit AVP in the usage report, one to indicate the usage before the monitoring time and another one accompanied by the Monitoring-Time AVP under the same Used-Service-Unit AVP to indicate the usage after the monitoring time, if the monitoring time is provided within one instance of the Granted-Service-Unit AVP included within the Usage-Monitoring-Information AVP by the PCRF.

q_7079.question: What is the procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery Model B?
q_7079.ground_truth: The procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery Model B involves UE-1 performing the Group Member Discovery procedure and discovering its neighbours. UE-1 then realizes that the group member of interest is not within direct range and solicits potential UE-to-UE Relays by transmitting the Solicitation message. UE-R, in the role of Discoveree, realizes that it can act as a UE-to-UE Relay and replies with a Response message. UE-1 then establishes a one-to-one communication link with UE-R and engages in communication with UE-2 via UE-R.

q_7080.question: What should the MS do when it receives a message with an unrecognized transaction identifier?
q_7080.ground_truth: The MS should ignore messages with the transaction identifier value set to "111". If the transaction identifier value is not "111", it should follow different procedures depending on the type of message received.

q_7081.question: What is the Key Performance Indicator (KPI) used for evaluating the capacity of NR systems for XR applications?
q_7081.ground_truth: System capacity, identified as the maximum number of users per cell with at least Y % of UEs being satisfied, is used as the KPI for capacity evaluations.

q_7082.question: In what circumstances can the MS postpone periodic attempts during idle mode?
q_7082.ground_truth: Periodic attempts may be postponed by the MS while in power saving mode (PSM) or while receiving eMBMS transport service in idle mode.

q_7083.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of RLC blocks sent by the RNC including retransmitted blocks called?
q_7083.ground_truth: The measurement is named RLC.NbrBlocksSent and has different suffixes for each Mode: TM, UM, and AM.

q_7084.question: How many TTI pointers can a new HS-SCCH format contain for HS-DSCH semi-persistent scheduling transmission?
q_7084.ground_truth: A new HS-SCCH format for HS-DSCH semi-persistent scheduling transmission contains one TTI pointer.

q_7085.question: What is the role of a supplier of presence information in the presence service?
q_7085.ground_truth: A supplier of presence information is an entity that supplies presence information to the presence service.

q_7086.question: What are the two call control protocols used between the IM CN subsystem and CS networks and what do they stand for?
q_7086.ground_truth: The two call control protocols used are BICC (Bearer Independent Call Control) and ISUP (ISDN User Part).

q_7087.question: What does the USCH transport channel support in the context of UMTS?
q_7087.ground_truth: The USCH transport channel supports USCH data streams in UMTS.

q_7088.question: What should the M-HC do if it is operating in U mode and a context relocation of RFC3095 header compression protocol is to be applied?
q_7088.ground_truth: The M-HC should transit to FO state and send IR-DYN to re-synchronise the dynamic part of the uplink context.

q_7089.question: When will the UE consider the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLow node as matching when the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLowRAN node is present?
q_7089.ground_truth: If the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLowRAN node is present and the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLow threshold value has been received from E-UTRAN/UTRAN, the UE shall consider this node as matching if the measurement value of backhaul available downlink bandwidth is smaller than the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLow threshold value.

q_7090.question: How does a receiving entity verify the validity of the Flight Information from UAV Broadcast Remote Identification?
q_7090.ground_truth: A receiving entity can verify the validity of the Flight Information by using the UAV Broadcast Remote Identification information for e.g. collision avoidance.

q_7091.question: What are the two alternatives provided for storing NPN credential in UE?
q_7091.ground_truth: The two alternatives provided for storing NPN credential in UE are: alt1: storing NPN credential in ME, and alt2: storing NPN credential in UICC.

q_7092.question: What does the PCEF do when the AF requests to report on IP-CAN bearer level events?
q_7092.ground_truth: The PCEF shall report the IP-CAN bearer level events as requested by the AF and cancel the request when the AF ceases handling the user.

q_7093.question: What is used to update formula (1) each time a new Cn value is obtained?
q_7093.ground_truth: The current Cn value is used to update formula (1) in subclause 10.2.1 each time a new Cn value is obtained.

q_7094.question: What is the counter for in the measurement type "HSUPA.AttEdchAddUESide"?
q_7094.ground_truth: The number of attempted radio link additions to the E-DCH active set (UE side).

q_7095.question: What is the role of the MME in the "Obtaining Non-UE Associated Network Assistance Data" procedure?
q_7095.ground_truth: The MME in this procedure acts as a mediator between the E-SMLC and eNodeB. It receives the Network Positioning Information message from the E-SMLC and forwards it to the eNodeB in a S1-AP Transport Message. The MME includes a Routing identifier that represents the E-SMLC identity in the S1-AP Transport Message. Once the eNodeB returns the Network Positioning Information message to the MME, the MME forwards it to the E-SMLC, determining the E SMLC from the Routing identifier received in step 4.

q_7096.question: How does the introduction of virtualized network functions (VNFs) into mobile networks affect fault management?
q_7096.ground_truth: With the introduction of virtualized network functions (VNFs) into mobile networks, fault management functionality is distributed over different functional blocks, such as NFV Infrastructure (NFVI) level, NE level, NFV Management and Orchestration level, and 3GPP network management level.

q_7097.question: What are the three types of bearer supported for Dual Connectivity (DC) between LTE and NR, regardless of the connected CN?
q_7097.ground_truth: The three types of bearer supported for DC between LTE and NR are Split bearer via MCG, SCG bearer, and Split bearer via SCG.

q_7098.question: How is the rendering of Timed Graphics media units in 3GPP defined?
q_7098.ground_truth: The Timed Graphics media units shall be rendered on the parent canvas originating at the upper left corner, with a higher rendering order than other continuous media, and established based on the media identifiers or the order of appearance if not present.

q_7099.question: In FDD mode, what should the DRNS do if the Transport Layer Address IE and Binding ID IE is included for an E-DCH MAC-d flow in the Additional E-DCH MAC-d Flows Specific Information IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Setup IE?
q_7099.ground_truth: The DRNS may use the transport layer address and the binding identifier received from the SRNC when establishing a transport bearer for the concerned E-DCH MAC-d flow.

q_7100.question: How is the bit rate of a video stream decreased using the SVC bit rate adaptation approach?
q_7100.ground_truth: The bit rate of a video stream is decreased by choosing the next highest Operation Point (OP) for this stream and dropping all packets which are not needed for decoding the content at this OP.

q_7101.question: What is the function of the M1 interface when it comes to multicast group management?
q_7101.ground_truth: The M1 interface has the function to manage IP multicast groups for MBMS service data transmission. The packets are distributed to the eNBs through IP multicast, and the MBMS GW allocates and releases the IP multicast group address. At the eNB side, it joins and leaves the IP multicast group to receive the MBMS User Plane data.

q_7102.question: What action should the VPLMN/IPLMN take when a connection event occurs for a call it is processing?
q_7102.ground_truth: The VPLMN/IPLMN can either suspend call processing and notify the CSE, or notify the CSE and continue call processing.

q_7103.question: What is the purpose of the id-CellCapabilityContainer-FDD and id-CellCapabilityContainer-TDD fields in RNSAP-IEs?
q_7103.ground_truth: They specify the FDD and TDD cell capabilities, respectively.

q_7104.question: What is the minimum signal-to-noise ratio required for accurate measurement results in an antenna measurement system?
q_7104.ground_truth: At least 40 dB above the noise floor.

q_7105.question: What information does the BSS use to determine the target cell list for handover in the case where localized service area is supported?
q_7105.ground_truth: The LSA INFORMATION message sent by the MSC

q_7106.question: What information does the AF provide to the MBSF when requesting a broadcast service?
q_7106.ground_truth: The AF provides broadcast service related information, including service type, target service area, and QoS requirement information when requesting a broadcast service to the MBSF.

q_7107.question: What message must the mobile station send if it receives the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT or IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message after the TBF starting time has expired in the context of single block packet access?
q_7107.ground_truth: If a failure occurs and the packet access attempt was due to a request from upper layers to transfer a LLC PDU, a TBF establishment failure has occurred and the mobile station proceeds as specified in sub-clause~3.5.2.1.5.

q_7108.question: What are some factors that affect the channel realizations used for testing in an OTA performance/conformance system?
q_7108.ground_truth: Some factors that affect the channel realizations used for testing in an OTA performance/conformance system include the channel model, the device type, and the number of probes available in the chamber design.

q_7109.question: What is the required delivery guarantee for M2AP messages on the signalling connection?
q_7109.ground_truth: The signalling connection shall provide in-sequence delivery of M2AP messages and M2AP shall be notified if the signalling connection breaks.

q_7110.question: What is the function of the Public Network Integrated NPN (PNI-NPN) in the context of a PLMN?
q_7110.ground_truth: The PNI-NPN allows for a network slice instance to be made available by PLMNs, consisting of both public (RAN and network functions) and private (deployed using private 5G network resources) network resources.

q_7111.question: What are the three components of the version number in 3GPP technical specifications?
q_7111.ground_truth: The three components of the version number in 3GPP technical specifications are the major version, the minor version, and the revision number.

q_7112.question: What is the impact of using a new DPCCH slot format with fewer pilot bits during HS-DPCCH transmissions?
q_7112.ground_truth: There is degradation in HS-DPCCH performance for CQI, typically around 2dB.

q_7113.question: What is the role of the MME/SGSN in selecting an SGW-U for a UE session?
q_7113.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN provides the location of the UE, APN, relevant UE capabilities, and mapped UE Usage Type to the SGW-C when establishing a session, so that it can select an appropriate SGW-U.

q_7114.question: What is the typical topology of an indoor industrial scenario in the context of the 5G system?
q_7114.ground_truth: The typical topology of an indoor industrial scenario includes alleys, assembly lines, production areas, warehouse/storage, commissioning areas, and office spaces, all with metallic objects and structures.

q_7115.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of successful outgoing intra-frequency handovers?

q_7116.question: What is the default format value for an "m=" line in an SDP offer, when establishing WebRTC data channels?
q_7116.ground_truth: The default format value for an "m=" line is "webrtc-datachannel".

q_7117.question: What is the APN information retrieval procedure used for in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_7117.ground_truth: The APN information retrieval procedure is used between the RCAF and the SGSN to retrieve the APNs that are currently having PDP contexts activated for each IMSI provided by the RCAF.

q_7118.question: What open-source media transport protocol provides features such as controlled latency and sender bandwidth control?

q_7119.question: What is the purpose of timer T3170 in the packet access procedure?
q_7119.ground_truth: Timer T3170 is used to start the packet access procedure after at least one PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST message has been transmitted by the mobile station. If the packet access procedure is not successful, the procedure is aborted and a random access failure is indicated to upper layers.

q_7120.question: What would be the result of Potential Solution #1 for an EE KPI in a shared gNB scenario?
q_7120.ground_truth: Under Potential Solution #1, all participating operators would have the same EE KPI value, regardless of their traffic volume. However, this solution is not recommended as it has little value.

q_7121.question: Which network entity is responsible for authentication and authorization towards DCS in the onboarding and provisioning process?

q_7122.question: What should the MSC/IWF do for non-transparent service support in Iu mode regarding the user data re-constitution and the L2R functionality?
q_7122.ground_truth: The MSC/IWF should ensure user data re-constitution compatible with 3GPP TS43.010, and the L2R functionality should be selected based on bearer capability information and L2 protocol to be terminated.

q_7123.question: What is the function of the MBMS RAB ESTABLISHMENT INDICATION message?
q_7123.ground_truth: The MBMS RAB ESTABLISHMENT INDICATION message is used by the RNC to indicate to the CN the establishment of the MBMS RAB corresponding to the MBMS Iu signalling connection.

q_7124.question: What is the effect of releasing the RRC connection on the EPS Bearer/PDP context status?
q_7124.ground_truth: The release of the RRC connection does not modify the EPS Bearer/PDP context status, except when the release is due to an RRC failure that does not permit maintaining the negotiated QoS.

q_7125.question: What should the SMLC do when a location service request is interrupted by an unrecoverable error?
q_7125.ground_truth: The SMLC shall immediately terminate the location service attempt, return a BSSAP-LE Perform Location Response message containing the reason for cancellation, and may abort any dialogues used for the location service.

q_7126.question: What is the purpose of characterization in the context of a codec comparison?
q_7126.ground_truth: The purpose of characterization is to provide a summary of the expected gains a codec under test would provide, compared to a reference codec.

q_7127.question: What type of synthetic audio scenes was assessed in the listening test using the EVS codec?
q_7127.ground_truth: Synthetic first-order Ambisonics (FOA) representations encoded by the EVS codec were assessed.

q_7128.question: What is the largest key size approved in NIST for standards that use finite-field cryptography (FFC)?
q_7128.ground_truth: The largest key size approved in NIST for FFC is (L = 3072, N = 256)

q_7129.question: What is the purpose of setting the shift register feedback to zero before encoding the Most Significant Digit (MSD)?
q_7129.ground_truth: The purpose is to terminate the first and second constituent encoders and ensure that they are properly disabled after encoding all information bits.

q_7130.question: What are the scheduling opportunities for 2 RTTI TBFs on the same resources?
q_7130.ground_truth: The scheduling opportunities for 2 RTTI TBFs on the same resources allow for efficient use of radio resources by enabling the transmission of 2 RTTI TBFs on the same timeslots, but in different frames.

q_7131.question: What actions does the ATCF perform to switch the media path from the source access to the target access in the context of CS to PS access transfer?
q_7131.ground_truth: The ATCF switches the media path in the ATGW from the source access to the target access.

q_7132.question: In what circumstance should the NAS notify the upper layers that the access attempt is barred and not initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt?
q_7132.ground_truth: If the event which triggered the access attempt was an MO-MMTEL-voice-call-started indication or an MO-MMTEL-video-call-started indication, the UE is operating in the dual-registration mode, and the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred, then the NAS should notify the upper layers that the access attempt is barred and not initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message.

q_7133.question: What is the procedure to identify narrow band responses on receivers during immunity testing for FDD and 3.84 Mcps TDD option?
q_7133.ground_truth: The test shall be repeated with the UARFCN increased or decreased by 25 (DL / UL), and if the deviation does not disappear, the UARFCN should be increased or decreased by 50 from the original value. If the deviation still does not disappear, the phenomenon is considered wide band and the equipment fails the test.

q_7134.question: What action should the LLE take when it receives a supervisory frame with the A bit set to 1, and its own receiver busy condition still exists?
q_7134.ground_truth: The LLE should respond, at the earliest opportunity, with an appropriate supervisory frame as defined in subclause 8.6.4.1 to indicate the status of its receiver busy condition.

q_7135.question: What action does the MCData client 2 take when it receives a standalone SDS data request over signalling control plane containing MCData user consumption payload?
q_7135.ground_truth: The MCData client 2 notifies the target MCData user if it receives a standalone SDS data request containing MCData user consumption payload with a positive policy assertion.

q_7136.question: What is the procedure if the IMS-ALG decides to allocate a primary local MR?
q_7136.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should store the instance-number value k and apply the procedures in clause 6.1.4 or 6.1.5 to allocate a primary local MR.

q_7137.question: What kind of attacks can occur if the security protection for the one leg or two legs of UE-UE TSC communication lacks confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection?
q_7137.ground_truth: An attacker can eavesdrop, modify data, replay packets, spoof messages, and perform replay attacks on UE-UE TSC communication.

q_7138.question: Which command type is used in the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST in the test scenario described?
q_7138.ground_truth: The command type used is SET UP EVENT LIST.

q_7139.question: What is the function of the built-in WebSocket server in the ATSC 3.0 receiver?
q_7139.ground_truth: The built-in WebSocket server in the ATSC 3.0 receiver allows an interactivity application to query information that was gathered or collected in the receiver, receive notifications via broadcast signaling, and request the receiver to perform actions that are not otherwise available via the standard JavaScript APIs.

q_7140.question: What information is used by the AMF in the PLMN without a disaster condition in Solution #17 to determine the registration area for an inbound disaster roaming UE?
q_7140.ground_truth: The AMF in the PLMN without a disaster condition in Solution #17 determines the registration area for an inbound disaster roaming UE by using the area of the disaster condition of the PLMN with the disaster condition. This information can be obtained based on the solution for KI#2 and the solution for "How to provide information on the area where Disaster Condition applies."

q_7141.question: What timer supervises the queuing time for a free channel for the UMTS to GSM handover?

q_7142.question: What message is sent from the mobile station to the network, if the traffic channel is no longer needed?
q_7142.ground_truth: The mobile station sends a RELEASE COMPLETE message to the network.

q_7143.question: What IMD product is generated by dual Tx n3, n18 and falls into the third band n28 Rx in the first co-existence study?

q_7144.question: What is the trigger for setting the connectionFailureType to rlf in VarRLF-Report?
q_7144.ground_truth: The connectionFailureType is set to rlf in VarRLF-Report when the radio link failure is detected as specified in clause 5.3.10.3.

q_7145.question: Which technical provisions of the current document in 3GPP are contained in the SAGE Specification?
q_7145.ground_truth: All the technical provisions of the current document in 3GPP are contained in the SAGE Specification.

q_7146.question: What is the relationship between the NRM defined by this IRP and the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM)?
q_7146.ground_truth: The NRM defined by this IRP is a member of the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM) and its information is derived from the FNIM Umbrella Information Model (UIM).

q_7147.question: What is the significance of the "lost CDR indicator" in the CDR file?
q_7147.ground_truth: The "lost CDR indicator" indicates whether any CDRs were lost during their processing in the CGF and provides information on the number of lost CDRs or if the CGF cannot determine the number of lost CDRs.

q_7148.question: What should the Node B do if the "Report Characteristics IE" is set to "Event E" and the conditions for Report A have been met?
q_7148.ground_truth: The Node B shall initiate the Dedicated Measurement Reporting procedure and report the measured entity value, and if provided, initiate periodic reporting. If the conditions for Report B are met and any periodic reporting is ongoing, the Node B shall terminate it.

q_7149.question: What is the condition for performing the inter-row permutation for the rectangular matrix based on the pattern T(i)?
q_7149.ground_truth: The inter-row permutation for the rectangular matrix is performed based on the pattern T(i) when C is greater than or equal to 1 in step (2), and T(i) is the original row position of the i-th permuted row in the rectangular matrix.

q_7150.question: What is the UE's response to a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message containing a 5G-GUTI?
q_7150.ground_truth: CR3 states that the UE shall return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge the received 5G-GUTI, start timer T3519, and delete any stored SUCI.

q_7151.question: What is the purpose of the GSC hangover flag in this process?
q_7151.ground_truth: The GSC hangover flag is set to 1 to indicate that a soft hangover period will be applied after a frame with an extremely non-sparse spectrum is encoded using the GSC coding mode.

q_7152.question: What is the purpose of the SA2 5MBS study?
q_7152.ground_truth: The SA2 5MBS study aims to identify and evaluate potential enhancements to the 5G system architecture to provide multicast-broadcast services for different vertical businesses.

q_7153.question: What are the recommendations for codec development and selection suggested in the report?
q_7153.ground_truth: The recommendations emphasize submitting complete integrated solutions, testing with traditional static and new dynamic test methodologies, and resolving open design issues in a timely manner.

q_7154.question: What is the role of the "tunnel end identifier" in transport bearers signalled in the RNL control plane?
q_7154.ground_truth: The tunnel end identifier in transport bearers signalled in the RNL control plane is used to identify the corresponding GTP tunnel, which is allocated by the target eNB.

q_7155.question: Which transmission rates are supported for the physical layer?
q_7155.ground_truth: The physical layer supports digital transmission at a rate of 2 048 kbit/s or 1 544 kbit/s.

q_7156.question: What is the objective of Key Issue #10, NWDAF Assisted UP Optimization?
q_7156.ground_truth: The aim is to study what kind of analytics should be exposed to AFs or NFs to select optimal UP to improve end-to-end service experience and study what information the NWDAF outputs will contain, and whether new type of analytics are needed for UP optimization.

q_7157.question: What is the procedure followed by the MRFP when detecting the audio recording completion?
q_7157.ground_truth: The MRFP completes the audio recording when either the maximum time period of audio recording has elapsed, no input is detected, DTMF digits are detected and cancel the audio recording, the MRFC requests the MRFP to stop the audio recording, or the audio recording is not successful. The MRFP then notifies the audio recording completion event and the cause to the MRFC, which may indicate no voice has been input during a specific period, the maximum record time has elapsed, a DTMF digit that represents to finish or cancel the audio recording is detected by the MRFP, or the audio recording is not successful. Finally, the MRFC may indicate to the AS that the audio record has been stopped.
