q_7408.ground_truth: Shared iFC Set Identifiers identify sets of Initial Filter Criteria and are permanent data stored in the HSS and the S-CSCF.

q_7409.question: What does Candidate Solution #7 add in terms of requirements for the user equipment (UE) and Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF)?
q_7409.ground_truth: Candidate Solution #7 adds the requirement for the UE and AMF to use a sequenced List of Registration Areas instead of just a single Registration Area.

q_7410.question: What is the recipient's option when a video private communication is initiated?
q_7410.ground_truth: The recipient of a video private communication has the option of accepting or rejecting the communication.

q_7411.question: What should the UE do upon initiation of the access barring check procedure if timer T302 is running and the Access Category is neither '2' nor '0'?
q_7411.ground_truth: The UE should consider the access attempt as barred.

q_7412.question: What message is sent by the SS in the NR A-GNSS sensitivity coarse time assistance test to request the UE's capabilities?
q_7412.ground_truth: The SS sends an LPP REQUEST CAPABILITIES message to request the UE's capabilities in the NR A-GNSS sensitivity coarse time assistance test.

q_7413.question: What is the required Content-Type for the message body of a NPVR request from the UE?
q_7413.ground_truth: The Content-Type of the message body for a NPVR request from the UE should be set to "application/3gpp-ims-pss-mbms-npvr+xml".

q_7414.question: What measures can be taken to prevent and control network overload and congestion from increasing mobile devices?
q_7414.ground_truth: Some measures include: rejecting Location Updating Requests or IMSI Attach messages during congestion, providing a Mobility Management back-off timer to avoid synchronization of deferred requests, and increasing the time until an MS detects a potential need for changing the RAT or PLMN using longer values of the periodic LAU timer and implicit detach timer.

q_7415.question: What does the L2R function do in the PLMN connection?
q_7415.ground_truth: The L2R function performs protocol conversion between the user data structure and a structure more adapted to the radio link protocol. It also includes the data compression function.

q_7416.question: How are satellite cells mapped for 5G satellite access with large or moving radio coverage?
q_7416.ground_truth: The satellite coverage is mapped with satellite cells as close as technologically feasible to the national borders of countries. There are two approaches for mapping the satellite radio coverage: virtual cells with regular mapping, possibly with adjustments close to national borders; or geographical zones with irregular mapping, allowing for variable sizes of satellite cells.

q_7417.question: What should the MS (Mobile Station) do if it fails to establish a layer 2 link on the new channel after receiving a HANDOVER COMMAND on a full or half rate TCH?
q_7417.ground_truth: The MS should transmit the HANDOVER FAILURE message on the old TCH before T+1,1 seconds.

q_7418.question: What should the RNC do with the Broadcast Message Content IE when the Broadcast Message Content Validity Indicator IE is included in the WRITE-REPLACE message?
q_7418.ground_truth: The RNC should ignore the contents of the Broadcast Message Content IE when the Broadcast Message Content Validity Indicator IE is included in the WRITE-REPLACE message.

q_7419.question: What protocol is used for out-band flow control in the case of V.110 rate adaption?
q_7419.ground_truth: V.110 TA to TA "end-to-end flow control"

q_7420.question: What should the MS do if none of the preferred PLMNs are available while in the VPLMN?
q_7420.ground_truth: The MS should remain on the VPLMN if no higher priority PLMN is found.

q_7421.question: What is the structure of the Successful-RL-InformationRespItem-RL-SetupFailureFDD sequence?
q_7421.ground_truth: The Successful-RL-InformationRespItem-RL-SetupFailureFDD sequence consists of several fields, including rL-ID, rL-Set-ID, received-total-wide-band-power, diversityIndication, not-Used-dSCH-InformationResponseList, and not-Used-tFCI2-BearerInformationResponse.

q_7422.question: Under what conditions does the MME send a LCS-AP Location Abort message in the LCS protocol?
q_7422.ground_truth: The MME sends a LCS-AP Location Abort message to the E-SMLC if an ongoing location request is pre-empted by inter-eNB handover, if the main signalling link to the target UE is released by the MME, if a main signalling link failure persists for more than a certain timeout interval, or if there is a timeout waiting for the positioning response.

q_7423.question: How does the 3GPP system verify the trustworthiness of the USS/UTM address provided by the UAV UE?
q_7423.ground_truth: This verification process is covered at SA~WG3.

q_7424.question: What are the types of interfaces supported by the physical layer?
q_7424.ground_truth: The physical layer interfaces the Data Link Layer, the Radio Link Control and Medium Access Control layer, and the supported functional units of the application.

q_7425.question: When does the NAS initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt?
q_7425.ground_truth: The NAS initiates the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt if the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is allowed.

q_7426.question: What changes need to be made to the mobile station for the fast Ack/Nack reporting mechanism?
q_7426.ground_truth: The mobile station needs to be updated to schedule and send event-based ACK/NACK reports. It also needs to insert a short bitmap or Ack/Nack report in an UL RLC data block when polled accordingly and receive a short Ack/Nack report in a DL RLC data block.

q_7427.question: What is the approach and validity for the measurements in subclauses 5.1.4.1, 5.1.4.2, and 5.1.4.3 in the context of EPS packet switching?
q_7427.ground_truth: The "2 out of 3 approach" is followed for these measurements and they are applicable to PGW-C for EPC CUPS situations. They are valid for packet switching in EPS.

q_7428.question: What does the USS/UTM maintain during the authentication and authorization procedure?
q_7428.ground_truth: The USS/UTM maintains a context for the UAV and UAV-C respectively which may contain their identifiers, such as UAV UE ID (3GPP identifiers) and UPID (e.g. drone serial number).

q_7429.question: What should be recorded in the test report if it is not possible to maintain the environmental parameters within the specified limits?
q_7429.ground_truth: The actual values of barometric pressure, temperature, and humidity shall be recorded in the test report.

q_7430.question: What is the condition for the UE to switch to a higher priority PLMN in the test described in 6.3.1.10.3.1?
q_7430.ground_truth: The UE switches to a higher priority PLMN if there is a higher priority PLMN available and the UE is in automatic network selection mode.

q_7431.question: What is the function of the DNS Inspector in the case where it receives a DNS Response including the resolved IP address from the L-DNS?
q_7431.ground_truth: The DNS Inspector replaces the source and destination IP addresses of the DNS response with the stored C-DNS IP address and UE-IP respectively and forwards the response to the UL CL/BP UPF.

q_7432.question: What is the purpose of an Information Service (IS) in the context of 3GPP TS 32.661?
q_7432.ground_truth: An Information Service (IS) is a capability provided by an Integration Reference Point (IRP) for the management of a network. It enables the retrieval and notification of management information by an IRPManager from an IRPAgent.

q_7433.question: What must the UE do upon reception of the SIP 200 OK from the HTTP/SIP adapter?
q_7433.ground_truth: Once the UE receives the SIP 200 OK from the HTTP/SIP adapter, it sends an HTTP GET request to the URL obtained from the download session description. The HTTP "Connection" header should be set to "Keep-Alive" to indicate a persistent TCP connection.

q_7434.question: In the context of 3GPP management system, what potential requirement is related to mutual authentication between a MnS producer and an external MnS consumer?

q_7435.question: What type of information is provided by the CTSBCH logical channel in the GSM-CTS system?
q_7435.ground_truth: The CTSBCH logical channel provides frequency and synchronization information in the downlink direction in the GSM-CTS system.

q_7436.question: What type of traffic are the measurement types in clause 4.2.3.2 and 4.2.3.3 valid for?

q_7437.question: What does the NEF/MBSF do after receiving the Deallocate TMGI Request (TMGI) message from the AF?
q_7437.ground_truth: The NEF/MBSF sends a Deallocate TMGI Request (TMGI) message to the MB-SMF(s) that has been involved in the MB Session. If it was MBSF that made the TMGI allocation, MBMS releases the TMGI, otherwise MB SMF releases the TMGI.

q_7438.question: What service does the SMSF send a PATCH request to for updating the state of UE memory capacity for SMS in 3GPP access?
q_7438.ground_truth: The SMSF sends a PATCH request to the resource representing the UE's SMSF registration for 3GPP access.

q_7439.question: What is the RR Cause information element used for in a cellular network?
q_7439.ground_truth: The RR Cause information element provides the reason for release or the reason for completion of an assignment or handover in a cellular network.

q_7440.question: What does the "MSKID" represent in the "keyId" element?
q_7440.ground_truth: The "MSKID" in the "keyId" element identifies the key uniquely by specifying both the "keyDomainID" and "MSKID" as defined in sub-clause 6.3.2.1 of 3GPP TS 33.246.

q_7441.question: What is the procedure for establishing MA PDU Session with 3GPP access leg in EPC and non-3GPP access leg in 5GC?
q_7441.ground_truth: The UE sends a PDN Connectivity Request message to create the 3GPP leg and the UE includes MA PDU indication and ATSSS Capability in the PCO of the PDN Connectivity Request. Then, MME sends Create Session Request to the PGW-C+SMF and if accepted, the PGW-C+SMF selects an PGW-U+UPF and establishes user plane.

q_7442.question: What is the focus of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification document TS 28.680?
q_7442.ground_truth: The focus of TS 28.680 is the concepts and requirements of Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) management, specifically for WLAN performance monitoring and alarm notifications.

q_7443.question: Which network element in the 3GPP technical specification manages concurrent IP multimedia sessions?

q_7444.question: What is the initial request sent by EEC to establish a TLS tunnel between the EEC and the ECS?
q_7444.ground_truth: The EEC sends an Initial Provisioning request to the ECS to trigger client certificate provisioning for mutual authentication between the EEC and the ECS.

q_7445.question: What must the MSC/SGSN do if the UE cancels the periodic location procedure after a location estimate has been transferred to the LCS client?
q_7445.ground_truth: The MSC/SGSN shall notify the V-GMLC, H-GMLC, R-GMLC and LCS Client using the procedure in clause~9.1.12.4.

q_7446.question: In PLMN selection in shared network environment, what should an MS do when it has multiple PLMN identities on a shared cell, and one of them is the HPLMN (Home PLMN) but not the registered PLMN?
q_7446.ground_truth: The MS should attach to the HPLMN on the shared cell.

q_7447.question: What is the Bearer type in the "OPEN CHANNEL" command?
q_7447.ground_truth: The Bearer type used in the example was GPRS.

q_7448.question: In the context of 3GPP technical specification, what does "S1" refer to?
q_7448.ground_truth: S1 is a logical interface between an eNB within the E-UTRAN and an MME in the EPC.

q_7449.question: What is required for DMRS bundling across PUCCH repetitions to function properly?
q_7449.ground_truth: The restrictions for DMRS bundling across PUCCH repetitions include phase coherency across PUCCH repetitions, the same frequency resource allocation across PUCCH repetitions, and the same power across PUCCH repetitions.

q_7450.question: What must happen to the stored Local emergency numbers list in the user equipment when the UE moves to a new PLMN in a different country from where the currently stored Local emergency numbers list was received?
q_7450.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the stored Local emergency numbers list in the user equipment.

q_7451.question: What type of trigger does UE test loop mode E provide for communication transmit operation and what is used for V2X out-of-coverage scenarios?
q_7451.ground_truth: UE test loop mode E provides a trigger for transmission of ProSe Direct or V2X Communication packets for communication transmit operation. For V2X out-of-coverage scenarios, AT commands and an appropriate physical interface are used.

q_7452.question: In the context of RTP streams, what does the term "modal verb" refer to?
q_7452.ground_truth: In the context of RTP streams, "modal verbs" indicate mandatory requirements, recommendations, or permissions related to the RTP protocol.

q_7453.question: What action does the terminal take in step c) of the acceptance criteria of sequence A if the PIN has been unblocked successfully?
q_7453.ground_truth: The terminal indicates that the PIN has been accepted.

q_7454.question: What is the maximum number of seconds of validity of the provided assistance information, provided in the Assistance-Info AVP?

q_7455.question: What are the three caching directives defined in the caching functionality?
q_7455.ground_truth: The three caching directives defined in the caching functionality are "no-cache", "max-stale", and "Expires".

q_7456.question: What is the action taken if the user equipment does not support the fixed network user rate?
q_7456.ground_truth: The network may release the call for a transparent connection element.

q_7457.question: What does the message "PDP context without TFT already activated" indicate when trying to create a PDP context in a network?
q_7457.ground_truth: A PDP context has already been activated without a TFT for that MS.

q_7458.question: What are the available operations for an IP flow mobility routing rule in 3GPP technology?
q_7458.ground_truth: The available operations for an IP flow mobility routing rule in 3GPP technology are activation, deactivation, installation, modification, and removal.

q_7459.question: What subcarrier spacing (SCS) should be standardized for 5G NR operating in the frequency range 1 (FR1)?
q_7459.ground_truth: Some companies noted that standardization effort for 240 kHz numerology could be relatively smaller compared to 480 kHz or 960 kHz numerologies.

q_7460.question: What is the procedure if the BSS grants the uplink of the group call channel for sending application-specific data?
q_7460.ground_truth: The MS sends a SABM (DATA INDICATION) message with its mobile identity and the application data to the network. The serving BSS responds with a UA (DATA INDICATION) message and releases the group call channel uplink. The MS then returns to group receive mode.

q_7461.question: What does the Routing-IP-Address AVP contain in the 5.3.70 section?
q_7461.ground_truth: The Routing-IP-Address AVP contains the IP address used for transporting service data flows matching the IP flow mobility routing rule or NBIFOM routing rule in the 5.3.70 section.

q_7462.question: What is the type of data contained in the "protocolIEs" field in the "RadioLinkParameterUpdateIndicationTDD" sequence?

q_7463.question: What is the role of the playout delay in the NADU APP packet?
q_7463.ground_truth: The playout delay indicates the difference in milliseconds between the scheduled playout time of the next ADU and the current time, allowing the server to have a more precise value of the amount of time before the client will underflow.

q_7464.question: How does the RLC/MAC header need to be modified for 4 RLC blocks in EGPRS uplink?
q_7464.ground_truth: The RLC/MAC header in EGPRS uplink for 4 RLC blocks requires two additional octets to indicate block sequence numbers and 5 bits to enhance the Coding and Puncturing Scheme (CPS) indicator field.

q_7465.question: What is the role of MTP3-B, SCCP and SAAL-NNI in 5.2.2 for CS domain?
q_7465.ground_truth: MTP3-B provides message routing, discrimination and distribution, signalling link management, load sharing and changeover/back between link. SCCP provides connectionless service, Class 0, Class 2, connection oriented service and separation of the connections mobile by mobile basis. SAAL-NNI consists of sub-layers SSCF, SSCOP and AAL5. SSCF maps the requirements of the layer above to the requirements of SSCOP and provide SAAL connection management, link status, and remote processor status mechanisms. SSCOP provides mechanisms for the establishment and release of connections and the reliable exchange of signalling information between signalling entities.

q_7466.question: Which ECC public key format is allowed for SUCI calculation in Profile B?
q_7466.ground_truth: The ECC public key used with Profile B in the USIM might have been calculated in compressed format.

q_7467.question: What is the role of the CDR in the process of call completion?
q_7467.ground_truth: After the logical call record is completed, its free format data is moved to the corresponding CDR and the logical call record is deleted.

q_7468.question: What is the expected result of the ME in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command of the SEND USSD process?
q_7468.ground_truth: The ME is expected to perform the SEND USSD operation successfully and return a successful result in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command.

q_7469.question: What is the significance of a third digit increase in versioning in the 3GPP TS?
q_7469.ground_truth: A third digit increase in versioning of 3GPP TS indicates that only editorial changes have been incorporated in the document, not any technical enhancements or corrections.

q_7470.question: How long can satellite ephemeris and clock corrections data be used for?
q_7470.ground_truth: Satellite ephemeris and clock corrections data can be used for up to six hours.

q_7471.question: What are the different GNSS systems that can be used separately or in combination for network-assisted GNSS methods?
q_7471.ground_truth: The different GNSS systems that can be used are GPS, Modernized GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, Satellite Based Augmentation Systems (SBAS), Quasi Zenith Satellite System (QZSS), and BeiDou Navigation Satellite System (BDS).

q_7472.question: What type of connections are established by the MQTC in the UE with the MQTS in the UPF?
q_7472.ground_truth: The UE establishes one or more MPQUIC connections with the MQTS in the UPF.

q_7473.question: What action does an SMC entity take when it receives a release request from SM-RL while in the Wait for CP-ACK state?
q_7473.ground_truth: The request is stored until the next state (either MM Connection Established or Idle) is entered. If the Idle state is entered, the request is discarded; otherwise, an MM-connection release request is sent to the MM-sublayer and the SMC entity enters the Idle state.

q_7474.question: What is the maximum number of inter-frequency TDD cells that the UE is required to be capable of performing P-CCPCH RSCP measurements for, with a measurement period of Tmeasurment inter, if idle intervals are used for TDD inter frequency measurements?
q_7474.ground_truth: The UE is required to be capable of performing P-CCPCH RSCP measurements for a maximum of 6 inter-frequency TDD cells, every Tmeasurement inter milliseconds, if idle intervals are used for TDD inter frequency measurements.

q_7475.question: What are the conformance requirements specified in TS 38.331 for the test cases 8.1.6.3.1.2 and 8.1.6.3.1.3?
q_7475.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for the test cases 8.1.6.3.1.2 and 8.1.6.3.1.3 are the same as those specified in test case 8.1.6.3.1.1.

q_7476.question: What improvements were made to the Observed Service Experience Analytics in Rel-16 for 3GPP networks?
q_7476.ground_truth: The improvements to the Observed Service Experience Analytics in Rel-16 focus on including Application IDs that are present in the traffic mix and not necessarily linked to the AFs. This allows for better statistics reporting and the ability to target the top N applications experiencing the poorest service experience through the TOPN parameter and new Analytics Filter Information.

q_7477.question: What is the range and accuracy requirement for temperature control and measurement for the temperature controllable environment and temperature measuring device respectively?
q_7477.ground_truth: The temperature controllable environment shall be able to control the temperature of a chamber large enough to enclose the UICC and the card reader with the range of temperature control being between -25 oC and +85 oC to an accuracy of 0,5 oC. The temperature measuring device shall be able to measure the temperature of the UICC to within 0,5 oC with the range of measurement being between -25 oC and +85 oC.

q_7478.question: What determines the treatment of a priority level within a network, such as the selection of a target set-up time and pre-emption?
q_7478.ground_truth: The network operator can administer parameters that control the treatment of each priority level within its domain.

q_7479.question: What transmission protocol is used for the IP layer in 3GPP TS 36.423?
q_7479.ground_truth: The IP layer of X2 in 3GPP TS 36.423 supports point-to-point transmission for delivering X2-AP messages, and the eNB and en-gNB shall support IPv6 (IETF RFC 2460) and/or IPv4 (IETF RFC 791).

q_7480.question: What should the mobile station do if the Facility IE is encoded as "recall alignment not essential" and the decoding of the Facility IE is unsuccessful in the CC_ESTABLISHMENT message?
q_7480.ground_truth: The mobile station shall discard the SS Version IE and Facility IE and NOT copy them into the SETUP message.

q_7481.question: What modification is made to step 4 in clause 11.2.4.2 in the document for LPP Release 14 onwards?
q_7481.ground_truth: For LPP Release 14 onwards, step 4 in clause 11.2.4.2 is modified in the document to include sending an LPP PROVIDE ASSISTANCE DATA message to provide the MBS assistance data in accordance with TS 37.571-5.

q_7482.question: What is negotiated and agreed upon during the Composition Agreement (CA) negotiation phase?
q_7482.ground_truth: The policies to be followed in the composed CCN, the identifier of the composed CCN, how logical and physical resources are accessed, controlled and/or shared between the composing CCNs, compensation information, etc.

q_7483.question: What is the default procedure for reporting measurement results in the BTS?
q_7483.ground_truth: The default procedure is the basic measurement reporting procedure defined in sub-clause 4.5.1.

q_7484.question: If the Transport Bearer Request Indicator IE is set to "Bearer not Requested" in the COMMON TRANSPORT CHANNEL RESOURCES REQUEST message, what action should the DRNC take?
q_7484.ground_truth: The DRNC should use the transport bearer indicated by the Transport Bearer ID IE.

q_7485.question: In what type of network is the CSD Codec negotiation performed during call setup for best possible speech quality end-to-end?
q_7485.ground_truth: A mobile network using the A-interface.

q_7486.question: What is one criterion for dynamic blocking of incoming communications in the ICB service?
q_7486.ground_truth: One criterion is the barring of an identity or range of identities for a specific period or a maximum lifetime which is set by the network operator.

q_7487.question: What should the network do if the UE transmits an RRC STATUS message containing the IE "Protocol error information" after receiving an invalid SIGNALLING CONNECTION RELEASE message?
q_7487.ground_truth: The network should continue with any ongoing processes and procedures as if the invalid SIGNALLING CONNECTION RELEASE message has not been received.

q_7488.question: How does the SHVC spec define the upsampling filter for luma and chroma resampling?
q_7488.ground_truth: The upsampling filter is defined as an 8-tap filter for luma resampling, and a 4-tap filter for chroma resampling in the SHVC spec, enabling the use of arbitrary upsampling ratios.

q_7489.question: What is the role of the ACK-NACK Repetition Factor and ACK Power Offset IEs in the context of FDD specific parameters in a Local Cell?
q_7489.ground_truth: The ACK-NACK Repetition Factor IE indicates the number of consecutive repetitions of ACK and NACK for a particular transmission, while the ACK Power Offset IE indicates the power offset used in the uplink between the HS-DPCCH slot carrying HARQ ACK information and the associated DPCCH. Both are used to ensure proper transmission and reception of data and to manage radio resources in a Local Cell.

q_7490.question: What is a handover that is executed by the UE when one or more handover execution conditions are met, as defined in TS 38.300 9.2.3.4.1?

q_7491.question: What is the difference between minimal administration and full compliant mDNS resolver in the context of mDNS?
q_7491.ground_truth: A full compliant mDNS resolver has the capability to send mDNS query via unicast directly to the node, while minimal mDNS resolver sends mDNS query with a high-numbered ephemeral UDP source port.

q_7492.question: When should the UE indicate a ProSe Per-Packet Reliability (PPPR) value to lower layers for V2X communication over PC5?
q_7492.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the PPPR value when it receives a PPPR value from the upper layers and it meets the specified conditions as outlined in 3GPP TS 24.334 subclause 10.2.2.A.ii.

q_7493.question: What is the difference between registration procedures for UEs supporting CS, PS, and CS/PS?
q_7493.ground_truth: Registration procedures for UEs supporting CS are for circuit-switched connections, while those for UEs supporting PS are for packet-switched connections. Registration procedures for UEs supporting CS/PS are for connections that support both circuit and packet switching.

q_7494.question: What should the Nmb2 API support in terms of ingest of in-band ancillary information?
q_7494.ground_truth: The Nmb2 API should support the ingest of in-band ancillary information, and it is for study whether a separate ingest point should be supported or whether the ancillary information objects can be embedded in Nmb2.

q_7495.question: What are the main functional entities at the service layer used to realize session-level virtual leased line arrangements?
q_7495.ground_truth: The main functional entities from the IMS service layer that are used to realize session-level virtual leased line arrangements include the routing function and IBCF.

q_7496.question: In the example of the CTS paging request, which procedure is used to page a mobile station to which a connection shall be established and what message is sent in response?
q_7496.ground_truth: The paging procedure is used to page a mobile station to which a connection shall be established. The mobile station initiates the immediate assignment procedure in response to the CTS PAGING REQUEST message.

q_7497.question: What is the purpose of the Upa reference point in GBA Push?
q_7497.ground_truth: The Upa reference point is introduced in GBA Push to define the messages between the NAF and the UE. All messages over Upa are network initiated, and it defines the GBA-Push-Info.

q_7498.question: What is the main resource for pull mode in the Gw/Gwn interface?
q_7498.ground_truth: The main resource for pull mode in the Gw/Gwn interface is "pfds".

q_7499.question: What is the problem addressed in section 5.4.3.1 about 3D stereoscopic content provided in a frame packing arrangements?
q_7499.ground_truth: The problem addressed is the lack of MIME type support to signal frame packing arrangement in 3GPP services.

q_7500.question: What is the result-code set when the HSS receives a request from the S-CSCF to update SIP Digest authentication information due to a password change?
q_7500.ground_truth: The SIP-Auth-Data-Item AVP shall be present in the request if the command is sent in order to update SIP Digest authentication information due to a password change.

q_7501.question: Who or which entity decides the Disaster Condition in a PLMN?
q_7501.ground_truth: The decision of the Disaster Condition in a PLMN is typically made by the network operator or a regulatory authority.

q_7502.question: When does the UE store the QoS flow to DRB mapping of the DL SDAP PDU as the QoS flow to DRB mapping rule for the UL?
q_7502.ground_truth: When the UE receives a SDAP PDU with SDAP header and RDI fields set to 1.

q_7503.question: What is one way a GANC can provide accurate location information for the MS when placing an emergency call over GAN?
q_7503.ground_truth: The GANC can reference an AP-ID to location mapping database for the GAN service.

q_7504.question: What potential security requirement is identified for the authentication and authorization during edge data network change in TR 23.748?
q_7504.ground_truth: Authentication of the UE and the target Edge Data Network shall be supported during Edge Data network relocation.

q_7505.question: What is the mobile station's requirement to set fill bits if a length indicator is less than N201 in LAPDm frames?
q_7505.ground_truth: The mobile station must set each fill bit to a random value when sent, except for the first octet containing fill bits, which should be set to the binary value "00101011". The network should generally follow the same rule, except for the first octet containing fill bits, for which it should set all fill bits to the binary value "00101011".

q_7506.question: What information does the old SGSN return for each active PDP context when sending an SRNS Context Response to the old SRNS?
q_7506.ground_truth: The old SGSN returns for each active PDP context the next in-sequence GTP sequence number to be sent to the MS and the GTP sequence number of the next uplink PDU to be tunnelled to the GGSN. For each active PDP context using acknowledged mode, the SRNS also includes the uplink PDCP sequence number (PDCP-SNU).

q_7507.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals' work on Optimised Handover Procedures and Protocol between EUTRAN access and non-3GPP accesses (S102) in Release 17?
q_7507.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify the stage 3 of the Evolved Packet System S102 interface between the MME and the 1x CS IWS to relay the 1xCS signalling messages. The S102 interface is used to support UEs that do not transmit and receive on both the LTE and 1x radio interfaces simultaneously and to support CS fallback to 1xRTT procedures from E-UTRAN access to CDMA 1x RTT CS domain.

q_7508.question: What is the quality gain of AMR compared to the existing FR with ideal FH, power control, and 4 TRXs per cell?
q_7508.ground_truth: The quality gain of AMR compared to the existing FR with ideal FH, power control, and 4 TRXs per cell is approximately 3 dBQ.

q_7509.question: In the "Acknowledgement" super-field, what does the LSN acknowledge the reception of?
q_7509.ground_truth: The LSN acknowledges the reception of all AMD PDUs with "Sequence Number" < LSN that are not indicated to be erroneous in earlier parts of the STATUS PDU.

q_7510.question: What is the dynamic range specified as in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_7510.ground_truth: The dynamic range is a measure of the capability of the receiver to receive a wanted signal in the presence of an interfering signal inside the received channel bandwidth.

q_7511.question: Which algorithm is used for confidentiality protection at the SIP layer in IMS?
q_7511.ground_truth: The IMS specific encryption mechanism is based on IMS AKA.

q_7512.question: Which function is responsible for handling the charging characteristics in ProSe?
q_7512.ground_truth: The ProSe Function is responsible for handling the Charging Characteristics in ProSe.

q_7513.question: What must the UE do when there is a change in the 3GPP PS data off UE status for the PDU session?
q_7513.ground_truth: The UE must indicate this change by using the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure.

q_7514.question: What is the difference between the User Info ID and the 5G-GUTI in Solution #32?
q_7514.ground_truth: The User Info ID is used as an identifier of the UE during discovery, while the 5G-GUTI is used to identify the UE in the 5G network. The User Info ID is updated after each connection setup request to prevent tracing of the Remote UE and UE-to-Network Relay during subsequent discovery phase, while the 5G-GUTI is used to ensure that the UE has a globally unique identity in the 5G network.

q_7515.question: What are the two pairs of security associations (SAs) established for each registered contact between the UE and the P-CSCF?
q_7515.ground_truth: The two pairs of SAs are used for securing the communication between the UE and the P-CSCF

q_7516.question: What protocol is used to transfer data between the WSP client and server in WAP?
q_7516.ground_truth: The core of WSP is a binary version of the Hypertext Transfer Protocol - HTTP/1.1.

q_7517.question: What should the UE do if the "Non-scheduled transmission grant info" is included in the IE for FDD?
q_7517.ground_truth: MAC-d PDU's for logical channels belonging to this MAC-d flow shall only be included in a MAC-e or MAC-i PDU transmitted by allowed HARQ processes with a total contribution from the MAC-d flow not exceeding the size as signalled by the IE "Max MAC-e PDU contents size".

q_7518.question: What is the impact of the Mobility Management back-off timer on the UE's function to perform Cell/RAT and PLMN change?
q_7518.ground_truth: The Mobility Management back-off timer does not impact the UE's function to perform Cell/RAT and PLMN change. Cell/RAT and RA change do not stop the Mobility Management back-off timer.

q_7519.question: What is the importance of extending the STL2009 with additional basic operators and data types?
q_7519.ground_truth: Extending STL2009 with additional basic operators and data types is important to better leverage the capabilities of state-of-the-art processor architectures and the characteristics of DSP algorithms. Many recent audio/hybrid codecs make extensive use of 16bit x 32bit MAC (multiply and accumulate) and 32bit x 32bit MAC operations, but these are realized quite differently between VLIW and SIMD architectures and the current Basic Operators. The current STL2009 Basic operators require saturation and truncation after every multiply-accumulate (MAC) operation to maintain bit-exactness, which prevents use of SIMD parallelism, and results in higher MCPS and power on VLIW and SIMD capable devices. Higher precision variables, such as 64bit operands, are partitioned into smaller width operands, processed and then put back to the original width, which results in an overhead and processor cycles are wasted.

q_7520.question: What is the purpose of inter-UE coordination (IUC) in Mode 2 of NR sidelink?
q_7520.ground_truth: The purpose of inter-UE coordination (IUC) in Mode 2 of NR sidelink is to allow a UE-A to send information about resources to UE-B for resource (re)selection.

q_7521.question: What are the two main GBA key establishment methods?
q_7521.ground_truth: The two main methods are using GBA and GBA-Push for key establishment, where GBA is pull-based and GBA-Push is push-based.

q_7522.question: What is the role of the AUSF in the EAP-TLS Authentication Procedures over 5G Networks?
q_7522.ground_truth: The AUSF is responsible for selecting the EAP-TLS authentication method for one-way authentication and determining the authentication method between the UE and the DCS in the 5G Network.

q_7523.question: What is the limitation of the RAN rate matching scheme for a target coding rate greater than R=0.75 in EGPRS?
q_7523.ground_truth: Some of the parity symbols are never transmitted, making the scheme not optimal for coding rates greater than R=0.75.

q_7524.question: When is the construction "may not" used in a normative element in a 3GPP document?
q_7524.ground_truth: The construction "may not" is not used in normative elements in a 3GPP document. Instead, "might not" or "shall not" is used, depending on the meaning intended.

q_7525.question: How are the attempted session establishments measurements split?
q_7525.ground_truth: The attempted session establishments measurements are split into subcounters per network domain

q_7526.question: What is the maximum bandwidth for these new SCSs in the 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz frequency range?
q_7526.ground_truth: The new SCSs support wider bandwidths, up to 2 GHz.

q_7527.question: What is the purpose of the "Split Leg" information flow in 4.6.2.22?
q_7527.ground_truth: The "Split Leg" information flow is used in the gsmSCF to separate a leg from CSID1 and move it to a new call segment.

q_7528.question: What is the purpose of solution 1 in 5GC network slice selection for IMS traffic route via dedicated slice(s)?
q_7528.ground_truth: The purpose of solution 1 is to ensure IMS service uses specific slice(s) in the 5GC, where all IMS signalling related information is conveyed to the IMS network via a dedicated 5GC network slice and media associated to a particular IMS session can be routed via different 5G network slice(s) based on the application's requirements.

q_7529.question: What is the state of the GPRS PDP Context when a new PDP Context is being established?

q_7530.question: What is required for the local NEF to establish the Nx interface with the local UPF in the Nx definition alternative 2?
q_7530.ground_truth: The local UPF should support NF event exposure service in the Nx definition alternative 2 for the local NEF to establish the Nx interface with the local UPF.

q_7531.question: How is the RRC connection set-up time (Mean) measurement obtained?
q_7531.ground_truth: The RRC connection set-up time (Mean) is obtained by accumulating the time intervals for every successful RRC connection establishment between the receipt by the RNC from the UE of a "RRC CONNECTION REQUEST" and the corresponding "RRC CONNECTION SETUP COMPLETE" message using DER, and then dividing the end value of this time by the number of successful RRC connections observed in the granularity period.

q_7532.question: What should the IWF, performing the originating participating role, do if the calling user is not affiliated to the group on which the call is to be originated?
q_7532.ground_truth: The IWF, performing the originating participating role, should perform the actions specified in clause~9.2.1.2.9 for implicit affiliation.

q_7533.question: What was the restriction for training sequence evaluation in the selection of new TSCs?
q_7533.ground_truth: The restriction for training sequence evaluation was to use a single interferer scenario MTS-1 with the interferer either using GMSK or MUROS modulation type.

q_7534.question: What should the Node B do with the Maximum MAC-d PDU Size Extended IE for a Priority Queue in the HS-DSCH Information To Modify IE if it includes the MAC-hs Guaranteed Bit Rate IE in the HS-DSCH Information To Modify IE?
q_7534.ground_truth: The Node B should ignore the SID IE and MAC-d PDU Size IE in the MAC-d PDU Size Index IE and use Maximum MAC-d PDU Size Extended IE to optimize capacity allocation for the related HSDPA Priority Queue.

q_7535.question: What is a Solution Set (SS) in the 3GPP system and what does it specify?
q_7535.ground_truth: A Solution Set (SS) in the 3GPP system is a set of technical specifications that define the Telecommunication Management (TM) of 3G systems. It specifies the information that is visible for the manager, the operations that the manager may perform on this information and the notifications that are sent from the agent to the manager.

q_7536.question: What information element in a Send Routeing Information for GPRS Request message is used as a key to get the IP address of the SGSN?

q_7537.question: When should the IMS-ALG adjust SDP b=AS bandwidth modifiers?
q_7537.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should adjust any SDP b=AS bandwidth modifiers contained in the SDP when performing IP version interworking to prevent negative impacts on end-to-end media negotiation and inaccurate resource reservation.

q_7538.question: What is the main purpose of the 5G-enabled sensors in the plant?
q_7538.ground_truth: The 5G-enabled sensors are used to monitor inventory levels, utilities consumption, pump condition, heat exchanger efficiency, and leakages in the plant.

q_7539.question: What method is used for authentication and authorization between MSGin5G UE and MSGin5G server in Solution #5?
q_7539.ground_truth: TLS-PSK based authentication is used for authentication, and pre-shared key KMSG-PSK is used for establishing a TLS session.

q_7540.question: What is the role of the administrator in the context of MExE?
q_7540.ground_truth: The administrator is the entity that has control of the third-party trusted domain and all resources associated with it.

q_7541.question: What is the capacity performance for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for CG traffic model, 30Mbps, 15ms PDB, and 60 FPS, with SU-MIMO and 32TxRU, when the offset across UEs is synchronized, and there is zero, random, and equal offset?
q_7541.ground_truth: The capacity performance is 10.3 UEs per cell with zero offset across UEs, 10.2 UEs per cell with random offset across UEs, and 10.3 UEs per cell with equal offset across UEs.

q_7542.question: What is the purpose of the User Plane Integrity Protection (UP IP) in the 3GPP system?
q_7542.ground_truth: The User Plane Integrity Protection (UP IP) in the 3GPP system allows the network operator and the UE to detect if user plane data has been modified in transit between each other.

q_7543.question: What are the height parameters used in the COST 231 Walfish-Ikegami NLOS model for the microcell environment?
q_7543.ground_truth: The BS antenna height used in the COST 231 Walfish-Ikegami NLOS model for the microcell environment is 12.5 m, and the building height is 12 m.

q_7544.question: What is the role of the PFI value in UE-to-UE relay?
q_7544.ground_truth: The PFI value is used to identify the QoS flow in the UE-to-UE relay.

q_7545.question: What should the UE do if the cli-TriggeredList for a measId is empty in the VarMeasReportList?
q_7545.ground_truth: The UE should remove the measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId and stop the periodical reporting timer for this measId, if running.

q_7546.question: What information is included in the cell measurement event results of event 1d?
q_7546.ground_truth: The cell measurement event results of event 1d include the CPICH info of the best cell in the active set (i.e., the primary CPICH with the highest or lowest measurement result depending on the measurement quantity).

q_7547.question: What is the user identity information that the IdP must permanently store?
q_7547.ground_truth: The IdP permanently stores the IMPI or UID, which are the only GBA-related information stored persistently.

q_7548.question: Which measurement type is mainly dedicated to the "Operator Maintenance and Vendor Performance Modelling communities" in the "5.1.1.3 Failed session establishments" subclause?
q_7548.ground_truth: This measurement is mainly dedicated to these communities since it supersedes the detailed analysis required for each cause of PDP context activation failure.

q_7549.question: What are the maximum output power limits for the BS operating in the RMR1900 band?
q_7549.ground_truth: Based on ECC Decision (20)02, the maximum output power for BS operating in the RMR1900 band should not exceed 51 dBm / 10 MHz for 10 MHz channel bandwidth, as derived from the EIRP limits.

q_7550.question: What should the UE display during manual CSG selection by default?
q_7550.ground_truth: The UE should display all available CSGs for any PLMN by default.

q_7551.question: Which term is defined as an empty XML element that contains no XML content?
q_7551.ground_truth: An empty XML element is defined as an XML element that contains no XML content.

q_7552.question: What is the PROCEDURE CODE for the mBMSRABEstablishmentIndication RANAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_7553.question: What should the UE do if one or more Access Identities are indicated, and the corresponding bit in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity is set to zero?
q_7553.ground_truth: The UE should consider the access attempt as allowed.

q_7554.question: What type of multi-path capable solution is preferred over QUICv1 based approaches?
q_7554.ground_truth: A full multi-path capable solution based on MP-QUIC is preferred.

q_7555.question: What is the purpose of the acknowledged information transfer procedure?
q_7555.ground_truth: The purpose of the acknowledged information transfer procedure is for the originator to transfer I frames to the receiver and receive acknowledgements for these frames from the receiver.

q_7556.question: What is one of the stop conditions for the Interarrival Jitter Test?
q_7556.ground_truth: One of the stop conditions for the Interarrival Jitter Test is that at least one RTCP packet is sent from the SUT after the last RTP packet from data injection, for each delay and loss profile.

q_7557.question: What is the forwards and backwards compatibility mechanism in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_7557.ground_truth: The mechanism involves including Id and criticality fields in all current and future messages, IEs or groups of related IEs, coded in a standard format that will not be changed in the future. These parts can always be decoded regardless of the standard version, ensuring forwards and backwards compatibility.

q_7558.question: What is the role of the comfort noise factor in this speech coding system?
q_7558.ground_truth: The comfort noise factor enhances the perceived quality of the speech signal by adding noise to certain frequency components. It is quantized using 3 bits and is comprised between 0 and 1.

q_7559.question: What does the least common multiple between 'T' and the least common multiple of PRS periodicities among all DL PRS resource sets in the positioning frequency layer, help calculate in the context of PRS processing window applicable for measurements in the positioning frequency layer i?
q_7559.ground_truth: ' ' is used to derive the periodicity of the PRS RSTD measurement in positioning frequency layer i defined as ' ' in the context of PRS processing window applicable for measurements in the positioning frequency layer i.

q_7560.question: What kind of low-level data types have been defined in the typedefs.h file for this C code?
q_7560.ground_truth: The low-level data types defined in the typedefs.h file are Char, Bool, Shortint, UShortint, Longint, and ULongint.

q_7561.question: What is the role of the NPN service provider in providing a stand-alone NPN consisting of 3GPP segments only?
q_7561.ground_truth: The NPN service provider receives SLA information from the NPN service customer, converts it to SLA requirements, and sends 3GPP-related NPN requirements to the NPN operator to trigger the provisioning of the 3GPP segment for the NPN.

q_7562.question: What is the function of a MSGin5G client in the MSGin5G application architecture?
q_7562.ground_truth: A MSGin5G client provides client-side functionality for UE Application Clients with the sending and receiving of messages via the MSGin5G Service to/from Application Servers and/or other MSGin5G service endpoints. It exposes MSGin5G APIs, supports registration of a MSGin5G client to a MSGin5G Server, and exchanges MSGin5G messages with Application Servers and other UEs.

q_7563.question: What does the Used-Service-Unit AVP contain?
q_7563.ground_truth: The Used-Service-Unit AVP is a grouped AVP containing additional 3GPP-specific charging parameters such as Reporting-Reason, Tariff-Change-Usage, CC-Time, CC-Service-Specific-Units, and Event-Charging-TimeStamp.

q_7564.question: What conditions must be met for Y to be equal to 32 Tc?
q_7564.ground_truth: Y is equal to 32 Tc when the UE measures RSTD on PRS resources belonging to the same PFL, provided that the time offset between the two PRS resource instances from the reference cell and the neighbor cell used for a single RSTD estimate is no greater than 160 ms.

q_7565.question: What is the meaning of TRP and TRS in the context of 3GPP technical report on the measurement of UE radio performances for LTE/UMTS terminals?
q_7565.ground_truth: TRP stands for Total Radiated Power, which is the total amount of power that a UE transmits. TRS stands for Total Radiated Sensitivity (also known as Total Isotropic Sensitivity), which is the ability of a UE to receive a signal.

q_7566.question: What must be included in an SDES crypto attribute in an SDP for media security to be forwarded to the LEMF without additional key processing?
q_7566.ground_truth: The SDES crypto attribute contains the cryptographic key required for decrypting the encrypted IMS media.

q_7567.question: What should the mobile station do with common priorities when building the set of individual priorities?
q_7567.ground_truth: The mobile station should consider only individual priorities when building the set of individual priorities.

q_7568.question: Which network parameter changes can be used in Group 1 solutions to avoid PF/PO collision for multi-USIM devices?
q_7568.ground_truth: Solutions in Group 1, such as #14, #15, #16, partial #17, and #20, propose changing parameters related to PF/PO calculation or requesting extra NAS level ID to impact the PF/PO calculation for multi-USIM devices, which may lead to increased signaling.

q_7569.question: What is a requirement for standardized service types in the context of MBMS user services?
q_7569.ground_truth: One objective of the present specification is to express the requirements for standardized service types in MBMS user services.

q_7570.question: What kind of payload is supported within the PDU?
q_7570.ground_truth: The solution supports different types of payload within the PDU: UDP payload, IP payload, and QUIC payload.

q_7571.question: What are the two mandatory AVPs for all requests in the Diameter Multimedia Application as specified by 3GPP and ETSI?

q_7572.question: What information does the HSS return to the I-CSCF following interrogation for routing information when receiving a mobile terminated call setup?
q_7572.ground_truth: The HSS returns information that will enable the I-CSCF to progress the call towards an S-CSCF.

q_7573.question: What is the significance of the VGCS ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message in the A-interface link sharing scenario?
q_7573.ground_truth: The VGCS ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message in the A-interface link sharing scenario is used to request the establishment of voice group call channels, including cell identifiers if the entire list cannot fit into the initial message.

q_7574.question: What is the recommended method to avoid blind slot-format detection in non-serving Node Bs in soft handover?
q_7574.ground_truth: To avoid blind slot-format detection in non-serving Node Bs in soft handover, it seems preferable to set the pilot pattern for the new slot format 1* to be the same as the first bits of the pilot pattern for the associated slot format 1.

q_7575.question: What should the Node B do if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the Transport Bearer Not Requested Indicator IE set to "Transport Bearer may not be Established" for a DCH and the Node B establishes a transport bearer for the concerned DCH?
q_7575.ground_truth: The Node B shall include the Binding ID IE and Transport Layer Address IE for establishment of a transport bearer for the DCH being established in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message.

q_7576.question: What is the encapsulation method used for the GRE tunnels between the MAG and LMA in a Proxy Mobile IPv6 network?
q_7576.ground_truth: GRE encapsulation is used for the GRE tunnels between the MAG and LMA in a Proxy Mobile IPv6 network.

q_7577.question: What is the result when an MAA invokes deregisterStreamingApp() before exiting?
q_7577.ground_truth: The MBMS client no longer sends notifications and clears all context for the MAA.

q_7578.question: When does the MS reject the new USSD transaction if it receives it while another USSD transaction is in progress?
q_7578.ground_truth: If the MS receives a USSD transaction while another USSD transaction or a non-call related supplementary service transaction is in progress.

q_7579.question: What is the main difference between the interactive and background traffic classes in terms of how they are used by traditional Internet applications?
q_7579.ground_truth: The main difference is that interactive class is mainly used by interactive applications, e.g. interactive Email or interactive Web browsing, while Background class is meant for background traffic, e.g. background download of Emails or background file downloading.

q_7580.question: Which function provides the equivalent mechanism to the DVB Multicast rendezvous service to support transparent session bootstrapping to a 5GMS-Aware Application that is unaware of 5MBS operation?
q_7580.ground_truth: The function that provides the equivalent mechanism to the DVB Multicast rendezvous service to support transparent session bootstrapping to a 5GMS-Aware Application that is unaware of 5MBS operation could be provided by the Media Session Handler or by the MBSF Client.

q_7581.question: What value of ACIR is used outside ACIR1/2 regions in the uplink ACIR model for LTE-A UE?
q_7581.ground_truth: ACIR3 is used for all regions outside ACIR1/2 in the uplink ACIR model for LTE-A UE.

q_7582.question: When the UE performs the unified access control procedure during network access, what must be done if the access attempt is barred?
q_7582.ground_truth: If the access attempt is barred, the procedure ends.

q_7583.question: What is the method used to overcome the problem described in Question 2?
q_7583.ground_truth: The method involves generating synthetic noise on the receive (RX) side similar to the transmit (TX) side background noise, with comfort noise parameters estimated on the TX side and transmitted to the RX side before and after the radio transmission is switched off.

q_7584.question: What action does MSC-A take when it receives the AoIP-Selected Codec (Target) and AoIP-Available Codecs List (MAP) from MSC-B with the MAP-PREPARE-HANDOVER response?
q_7584.ground_truth: MSC-A knows that the target access supports A interface over IP.

q_7585.question: What is the role of Successive Interference Cancellation (SIC) or Joint Detection (JD) in receiving signals from two mobiles on simultaneous sub channels with individual propagation paths?
q_7585.ground_truth: They are used to create a 2x2 Multi User MIMO system where the different propagation paths from two users enable the full utilization of the degree of freedom of two receive antennas in typical BTS.

q_7586.question: What is the purpose of using RTP bearers multiplexing and RTP header compression in the A interface over IP?
q_7586.ground_truth: The purpose of using RTP bearers multiplexing and RTP header compression in the A interface over IP is to achieve better bandwidth efficiency.

q_7587.question: What is the role of the UE in the deferred location request cancellation procedure?
q_7587.ground_truth: The UE cancels the Area event deferred location request and sends the LCS Area Event cancellation ack., with no area event information included to VMSC/SGSN. Additionally, while the UE is monitoring for the area event to occur, the UE may cancel or terminate the deferred location request for the change of area on its own behalf by sending the LCS Area Event report with the LDR reference number, an indication of the cancellation and an appropriate error cause.

q_7588.question: How does the IVS receiver distinguish between higher-layer ACK message and link-layer ACK messages on the downlink?
q_7588.ground_truth: The IVS receiver distinguishes them by determining the signs of the autocorrelation pulses independently from the absolute peak values and peak distances.

q_7589.question: What is the primary role of the Common Media Application Format (CMAF) in this specification?
q_7589.ground_truth: The specification is aligned with the Common Media Application Format (CMAF) as defined in ISO/IEC 23000-19 to a large extent, ensuring a standardized and efficient media formatting for TV services on 3GPP defined radio bearers.

q_7590.question: What information does the V2X application layer provide to the V2X layer?
q_7590.ground_truth: The V2X application layer provides the Application Requirements to the V2X layer, which can be mapped to QoS parameters, as well as application traffic pattern information including message periodicity/interval and message size/burst information if available.

q_7591.question: Under what conditions are the RLC sizes for the logical channel with transport channel type "RACH" for the UL the same as the RLC sizes that apply for that logical channel with transport channel type "E-DCH" for the UL?
q_7591.ground_truth: The RLC sizes for the logical channel with transport channel type "RACH" for the UL are the same as the RLC sizes that apply for that logical channel with transport channel type "E-DCH" for the UL when the radio bearer is mapped to DCCH and IE "DCCH Fallback" is set to TRUE.

q_7592.question: How many CAG informations are included in the list provided by the ME?
q_7592.ground_truth: Two CAG informations are included in the list provided by the ME.

q_7593.question: At what level can the accuracy be reported for Emergency Services in some countries, if the UE and the serving network are capable of delivering a more accurate location?

q_7594.question: How are the polynomials used in the cosine domain represented in the LSF domain?
q_7594.ground_truth: The polynomials in the cosine domain are represented in the LSF domain using a vector of Line Spectral Frequencies (LSFs), which are the roots of the polynomials.

q_7595.question: What is the purpose of the "OneChargingSession" option in the MMTel charging function?
q_7595.ground_truth: The "OneChargingSession" option enables the correlation of session/transaction related charging data from different Nodes involved in the session used for MMTel service handling, based on IMS Charging Identifier (ICID).

q_7596.question: What is the effect of a non-V.44 compressed N-PDU being sent when V.44 Packet Method is used with SN-DATA primitives?
q_7596.ground_truth: When V.44 Packet Method is used with SN-DATA primitives and a non-V.44 compressed N-PDU is sent, the DCOMP field in the SN-PDU header of the first segment of the N-PDU is set to 0.

q_7597.question: How many bit blocks are used for the downlink PBCCH/PCCCH in 3GPP TS 44.060?
q_7597.ground_truth: 184 bit blocks (23 octets) or 187 bit blocks (21 octets) in case an eTFI is included are used for the downlink PBCCH.

q_7598.question: What is the operating band unwanted emissions requirement for the backhaul link?
q_7598.ground_truth: The operating band unwanted emissions requirement for the backhaul link is that the emissions should be within the limits of (0.1 PPM + 15 Hz) as per the document.

q_7599.question: What functional entities are used at the service layer to realize peering-based business trunking arrangements?
q_7599.ground_truth: The main functional entities from the IMS service layer that are used to realize peering-based business trunking arrangements include the routing function, IBCF, HSS containing NGCN specific data, and AS.

q_7600.question: What is the L4 protocol indicated in the 'col stack segment "SCTP Association over DTLS connection over L4/IP"'?

q_7601.question: What are IPv4 addresses commonly used for in the context of 3GPP systems?
q_7601.ground_truth: IPv4 addresses are used as routing identifiers in 3GPP systems.

q_7602.question: What is the additional gain achieved by using 4x4 antennas compared to 2x2 antennas in the LTE downlink system?
q_7602.ground_truth: The additional gain achieved was more than 60%.

q_7603.question: What is the role of SA4 in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group for SES?
q_7603.ground_truth: SA4 is responsible for agreeing on design constrains, test and processing plans, and recommendation criteria for selecting a codec for SES.

q_7604.question: What is required for the MDAS producer to provide the analytics report describing the coverage issue?
q_7604.ground_truth: The MDAS producer should have the capability to provide the analytics report describing the coverage issue and the analytics report should contain information about the coverage issue such as the type, start and end time, location, root cause, RAT indication, affected objects, severity level, and recommended actions to solve the coverage issue.

q_7605.question: In what cases "Start of interception with PDP context active" event is sent by the new SGSN in case of location dependent interception?
q_7605.ground_truth: "Start of interception with PDP context active" event is sent by the new SGSN if an Inter-SGSN RA update procedure, which involves different PLMNs, takes place for a target, which has at least one active PDP context, in case of location dependent interception.

q_7606.question: Who initiates the GPRS suspension procedure in 3GPP networks?
q_7606.ground_truth: The GPRS suspension procedure is initiated by the mobile station by sending a GPRS SUSPENSION REQUEST message with the appropriate suspension cause.

q_7607.question: What should be discussed further in the normative phase regarding RedCap UEs?
q_7607.ground_truth: The use of Access Identity(ies) and Access Categories for RedCap UEs, and the differentiation between RedCap and non-RedCap UEs using UAC are to be discussed further in the normative phase.

q_7608.question: What is the standard deviation used to select AoDs at the BS for the FSC in the channel generation procedure?
q_7608.ground_truth: The standard deviation used to select AoDs at the BS for the FSC in the channel generation procedure is equal to rAS*mean(AS), where the mean(AS) is equal to 8 degrees or 15 degrees.

q_7609.question: What is the maximum number of times a message is repeated if no response is received over the DTE/DCE interface?
q_7609.ground_truth: The message is repeated a maximum of 3 times.

q_7610.question: What CTS-MS messages does the CTS-FP ignore in the alive check procedure?
q_7610.ground_truth: The CTS-FP ignores unsolicited or out of sequence CTS~ACCESS REQUEST messages in the alive check procedure.

q_7611.question: What is the purpose of the "iE-Extensions" in the "CombiningItem-RL-SetupFailureFDD-ExtIEs" RNSAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
q_7611.ground_truth: The "iE-Extensions" in the "CombiningItem-RL-SetupFailureFDD-ExtIEs" RNSAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION is used to indicate additional information related to radio link setup failures in FDD.

q_7612.question: What is used in a Charging-Rule-Report AVP to indicate a specific PCC rule which cannot be installed/activated or enforced due to a specific PCC rule failure?

q_7613.question: What is the priority order for frequencies that support the highest prioritized NSAG(s) with the same NAS-provided priority?
q_7613.ground_truth: The frequencies are prioritized in the order of their highest nsag-CellReselectionPriority given for these NSAG(s).

q_7614.question: What is the difference between Delta Synchronization and full synchronization?
q_7614.ground_truth: Delta Synchronization delivers only the changes since a specific point in time, while full synchronization delivers the complete data at a specific point in time. Full synchronization would deliver too many data if only a few data have changed, and Delta Synchronization can be beneficial in these cases.

q_7615.question: What is the procedure for allocating a new TMSI/LAI pair to a user?
q_7615.ground_truth: The procedure for allocating a new TMSI/LAI pair to a user involves generating a new TMSI, storing the association of TMSI and permanent identity in the database, sending TMSIn and LAIn to the user, storing TMSIn in the user, removing the old association after receiving acknowledgement and removing the association between TMSI and IMSI from the database.

q_7616.question: What capabilities are required for the remote UE in this authorization process?
q_7616.ground_truth: The remote UE should be capable of providing SUCI for the Relay UE for authorization and supporting the authentication procedure via the Relay UE.

q_7617.question: What is the minimum performance requirement for the 2D position error in the LPP message of type PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION?
q_7617.ground_truth: The 2D position error is defined as the horizontal difference in meters between the ellipsoid point reported or calculated from the LPP message and the actual position of the UE in the test case considered.

q_7618.question: What is the function of the ANDSF in the 3GPP system?
q_7618.ground_truth: The ANDSF contains data management and control functionality for network discovery and selection assistance. It provides inter-system mobility policy and access network discovery information.

q_7619.question: What is the procedure for obtaining the Maximum DL cell PDCP SDU bit-rate measurement?
q_7619.ground_truth: The maximum DL cell PDCP SDU bit-rate is obtained by sampling at pre-defined intervals the DL cell PDCP SDU bit-rate summed across all QCIs, and then taking the arithmetic maximum of these samples. The result is represented as a single integer value, which indicates the maximum bit-rate measured in kbit/s.

q_7620.question: In what network operation mode the MSC-originated paging of GPRS-attached MSs is sent via the SGSN, allowing network co-ordination of paging?
q_7620.ground_truth: The network operates in mode I.

q_7621.question: Which function is used to open a channel using OPEN CHANNEL proactive command, parse the terminal response, and if successful, update the BearerDescription, BufferSize and ChannelIdentifier parameters?

q_7622.question: What information can HNB broadcast from the cell lists to the UEs it serves?
q_7622.ground_truth: Some of the cell list information, such as the preferred cell camping list, can be broadcasted in e.g. SIB11 to UEs served by the HNB.

q_7623.question: What action does the ProSe Function serving user A take when a Discovery Filter is to be revoked for a UE associated with a Banned PDUID in a different PLMN?
q_7623.ground_truth: The ProSe Function serving user A sends a Monitor Update (ProSe Restricted Code, Application ID, Banned RPAUID, Banned PDUID) message to the ProSe Function in the other PLMN, which then sends a Discovery Update Request to that UE.

q_7624.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives an RLC data block with the Final Block Indicator (FBI) set to '1' and with a valid RRBP field?
q_7624.ground_truth: The mobile station shall transmit the PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message in the uplink block specified by the RRBP field and stop timer T3190 for the TBF. If the RLC entity is the last remaining one on the TBF, the mobile station shall stop timer T3190. If EMST is used, the mobile station shall continue to monitor all assigned downlink PDCHs.

q_7625.question: What protocol is used for communications between the Presentity Presence Proxy and the Watcher Presence Proxy?
q_7625.ground_truth: Communications between the Presentity Presence Proxy and the Watcher Presence Proxy shall be based on SIP.

q_7626.question: What information is relayed by the DF3 in the document for Location Dependent Interception?
q_7626.ground_truth: The DF3 relays CC to the target's location if it matches the IA for certain LEAs in Location Dependent Interception.

q_7627.question: What is a ProSe Application ID Name and how is it structured?
q_7627.ground_truth: A ProSe Application ID Name is a string of labels that represents hierarchical levels, typically in the format of broad-level business category / business sub-category / business name / shop ID.

q_7628.question: What is the purpose of keeping PBCCH information before the establishment of an RR connection?
q_7628.ground_truth: The mobile station keeps PBCCH information before the establishment of an RR connection to avoid a complete acquisition of PBCCH information after the release of the RR connection.

q_7629.question: What is the purpose of Octet 1 in the User Defined Sound Information-Element-Data?
q_7629.ground_truth: Octet 1 in the User Defined Sound Information-Element-Data indicates the position in the SM data after which the sound shall be played.

q_7630.question: What are the three possible outcomes for a PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
q_7630.ground_truth: The three possible outcomes for a PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE are INITIATING MESSAGE, SUCCESSFUL OUTCOME, and UNSUCCESSFUL OUTCOME.

q_7631.question: What does the "PreferredSSIDList" in ANDSF/WLANSP/<X>/SelectionCriteria/<X> refer to?
q_7631.ground_truth: The PreferredSSIDList in ANDSF/WLANSP/<X>/SelectionCriteria/<X> refers to the list of preferred SSIDs for WLAN access network selection.

q_7632.question: What is the state of the GA-PSR layer when the MS is able to send and receive GPRS data to and from the GANC?
q_7632.ground_truth: The MS is in the GA-PSR-ACTIVE state when it is able to send and receive GPRS data to and from the GANC.

q_7633.question: What is the difference in channel access schemes in terms of the no-LBT scheme and the Tx side ED based omnidirectional sensing scheme (TxED-omni)?
q_7633.ground_truth: The no-LBT scheme has losses in all cases, while the TxED-omni scheme has tail and median benefits in certain cases for indoor scenario A.

q_7634.question: What is the requirement for the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement accuracy when the two measurements are within the same RxTx TEG?
q_7634.ground_truth: The relative UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement accuracy when the two measurements are within the same RxTx TEG shall be within the specified limits as specified in section 15.3.6.

q_7635.question: What is the purpose of the "iE-Extensions" field in the "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence?
q_7635.ground_truth: The "iE-Extensions" field in the "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence is used to define additional protocol extension information, as defined in the PCAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION.

q_7636.question: What shall the PCRF do when the PCEF informs it of the UE status including the Event-Trigger AVP sets to "UE_STATUS_RESUME" after the UE's status is resumed from suspend state?
q_7636.ground_truth: The PCRF shall update the PCEF with PCC Rules if necessary after receiving the "UE_STATUS_RESUME" indication from the PCEF.

q_7637.question: What is the term used to describe the ability to provide a "being there" experience for conversational audio and video sessions between remote locations in a telepresence conference?

q_7638.question: Under what condition can the UE begin measurements for a frequency that is the same as the frequency of the serving HS-DSCH cell, but not associated with the serving HS-DSCH cell or any secondary serving HS-DSCH cells in the same block of contiguous HS-DSCH cells?
q_7638.ground_truth: If the UE's measurement capabilities do not require compressed mode on all the frequencies associated with the serving HS-DSCH cell and the secondary serving HS-DSCH cells, and if after receiving the message, a compressed mode pattern sequence with the appropriate measurement purpose is active.

q_7639.question: What is a feature of the number-based segment templating used in on-demand services?
q_7639.ground_truth: It is used for the preparation of the newly introduced live service.

q_7640.question: What technology is the 3GPP physical layer based on in the UTRA radio interface?
q_7640.ground_truth: The 3GPP physical layer is based on WCDMA/TD-SCDMA technology in the UTRA radio interface.

q_7641.question: What is the effect of the absence of the EndSourcePortNumber leaf in a flow distribution rule?
q_7641.ground_truth: The source port number range of the IP flow described by the rule is equal to the source port number contained in ANDSF/ISRP/<X>/ForFlowBased/<X>/IPFlow/<X>/StartSourcePortNumber if the EndSourcePortNumber leaf is absent.

q_7642.question: What is the impact of using Direct Tunnel on transport network QoS in the 3GPP system?
q_7642.ground_truth: If two tunnels transport network QoS is used on Gn but not on Iu-PS, moving to Direct Tunnel requires the RNC to implement transport network QoS. Similarly, for ATM-based Iu-PS, the ATM connection needs to be terminated and interworked to IP.

q_7643.question: What action does the P-CSCF take when informed that resources for a Service Data Flow cannot be allocated?
q_7643.ground_truth: The P-CSCF takes action on the SIP session.

q_7644.question: What are the two types of systems that the Extended Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband codec is implemented on?
q_7644.ground_truth: The Extended Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband codec is implemented in two programs: an audio encoder and an audio decoder.

q_7645.question: What is the purpose of the list of forbidden PLMNs stored in the USIM?
q_7645.ground_truth: The list of forbidden PLMNs stored in the USIM is used to control registration attempts to appropriate networks in automatic PLMN selection mode.

q_7646.question: What is the purpose of the step~0A in the UE-to-Network Relay's PDU Session authorization process?
q_7646.ground_truth: In step~0A, the Relay UE sends Remote UE authorization information and PDU Session related parameters to the network if they are provisioned.

q_7647.question: What is the role of the operator-selected SRES Derivation Function in GSM-MILENAGE?
q_7647.ground_truth: The operator-selected SRES Derivation Function is used to derive the SRES (Authentication Result) from the MIL3G-RES (Oriented RES) generated by the MIL3G-f2 function in GSM-MILENAGE. The SRES Derivation function must be precisely specified for the GSM-MILENAGE A3 algorithm to be fully defined.

q_7648.question: What is the primary goal of the Iur interface specifications?
q_7648.ground_truth: The Iur interface specifications aim to facilitate inter-connection of RNCs supplied by different manufacturers, support continuation of UTRAN services offered via the Iu interface, and separate Iur interface Radio Network functionality and Transport Network functionality to enable introduction of future technology.

q_7649.question: What information can UE provide for AI/ML model training in the context of load balancing?
q_7649.ground_truth: UE can provide measurements such as RSRP, RSRQ, SINR of serving cell and neighboring cells, UE location information (e.g. coordinates, serving cell ID, moving velocity), and UE mobility history information.

q_7650.question: How does the mobile station prioritize the reception of multiple MBMS sessions with different priorities?
q_7650.ground_truth: If there is a clash of MBMS notification messages, the mobile station acts on the MBMS Notification with the highest associated priority. If the highest associated priority is the same for two or more MBMS Notifications, the mobile station shall perform an implementation dependent selection of the MBMS sessions. The mobile station shall not respond to other, lower (or equal) priority MBMS Notifications but may still receive the corresponding sessions, if the capabilities of the mobile station allow.

q_7651.question: What should a SMC-CS entity do after sending a CP-ERROR message in any state?
q_7651.ground_truth: After sending a CP-ERROR message, the SMC-CS entity should pass an MM-connection release request to the MM sublayer and then enter the Idle State.

q_7652.question: What is the role of the USS (Unified Security Service) in the NAF/OP and RP interworking?
q_7652.ground_truth: The USS may act as a central authorization and privacy data store, containing authorization information about the data that can be shared with the RP.

q_7653.question: What are the responsibilities of the CSI AS in a CSI session between a UE in IMS only mode and a CSI capable UE (CUA)?
q_7653.ground_truth: The CSI AS supports the procedure for multimedia session splitting, modifying, combining and releasing. Also, the CSI AS shall support capability exchange with the CUA in the terminating CS domain on behalf of the CUA in the originating IM CN subsystem. Additionally, the CSI AS can use the media feature tags obtained from the terminating CUA to perform termination logic.

q_7654.question: What is the key difference between HEVC simulcast and SHVC in the context of the MMVC use cases?
q_7654.ground_truth: In HEVC simulcast, each full or thumbnail video is an independently coded HEVC single-layer bitstream, while in SHVC, multiple spatial resolutions can be encoded into one SHVC bitstream. In SHVC, if both the high and medium resolutions need to be sent simultaneously, the participant UE encodes the two solutions into two layers of one SHVC bitstream.

q_7655.question: What is the purpose of the test tolerances defined in section 4.2?
q_7655.ground_truth: The test tolerances defined in section 4.2 are used to relax the minimum requirements in this specification to derive the test requirements. They are derived from test system uncertainties, regulatory requirements, and the criticality to system performance.

q_7656.question: What is the role of the USS/UTM in the UAV flight operation registration process?
q_7656.ground_truth: The USS/UTM is responsible for validating the UAV authorization request, determining Remote Identification & Tracking Info (RITI) for the UAV, validating the information based on security mechanisms, and forwarding the information to the SMF and UFES.

q_7657.question: How is Power control modelled for the main and adjacent interferer in the asynchronous link level model?
q_7657.ground_truth: The power variation between the different interfering bursts (main and adjacent interferer) is modelled by multiplying the adjacent burst with a coefficient A, which has an expected value of 1 in the linear domain to keep the average power level constant.

q_7658.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a UEInformationRequest message with logMeasReportReq present and has logged measurements available for NR?
q_7658.ground_truth: The UE transmits an UEInformationResponse message including logMeasReport.

q_7659.question: Which supplementary services are implemented in the PLMN that support line identity and name identity services?
q_7659.ground_truth: Calling Line Identification Presentation (CLIP), Calling Line Identification Restriction (CLIR), Connected Line Identification Presentation (CoLP), Connected Line Identification Restriction (CoLR), Calling Name Presentation (CNAP) are the supplementary services that support line identity and name identity in the PLMN.

q_7660.question: What is the command qualifier for the PROACTIVE COMMAND: GET INKEY 4.1.1?
q_7660.ground_truth: The command qualifier for the PROACTIVE COMMAND: GET INKEY 4.1.1 is characters from the UCS2 alphabet.

q_7661.question: What is the role of the BEGIN record in MBMS Lawful Interception (LI)?
q_7661.ground_truth: The BEGIN record in MBMS LI is used to convey the first event of MBMS service interception.
