q_7918.ground_truth: The "SMS-AddressString" data type is used in the "CallingPartysNumber" of "ConnectSMSArg" in the "CAP-SMS-ops-args" module.

q_7919.question: What is the difference between Modes 0 and 3 in estimating audio-visual quality for HTTP Adaptive Streaming services?
q_7919.ground_truth: Mode 0 implements a simple and efficient quality estimation by inputting parameters from the metadata description of audio-visual streams (codecs and bitrate). Mode 3 derives coding quality from the unencrypted bitstream by parsing the bitstream, considering codec information, video resolution, framerate, bitrate, GOP structure, and quantization parameters for more accurate estimation of video coding quality. Mode 3 requires more processing power and is not typically deployed on user end devices, but can be applied by splitting the processing for the model between the server and client.

q_7920.question: What type of data is the "MBMS Service Area" and where is it conditionally stored?
q_7920.ground_truth: The MBMS Service Area is permanent data conditionally stored in MBMS GW, MME, SGSN, and BM-SC.

q_7921.question: What is the significance of the Silence Descriptor (SID) frame in the GSM Enhanced Full Rate speech channel?
q_7921.ground_truth: The SID frame is used to encode comfort noise parameters and initiate comfort noise generation on the receive side, and is always sent at the end of a speech burst.

q_7922.question: What is one condition for the FRMCS system to provide service continuation by setting up the communication via the GSM-R system?
q_7922.ground_truth: One condition for the FRMCS system to provide service continuation by setting up the communication via the GSM-R system is that the GSM-R system is unavailable.

q_7923.question: What is the main difference between Solution 3 and Solution 42 in the context of 5G?
q_7923.ground_truth: Solution 3 addresses handover within a single RAT/CN type, while Solution 42 addresses interworking between two different RAT/CN types (5GS and EPS) by transferring the MBS session context to the associated unicast PDU Session before executing inter-CN-type handover.

q_7924.question: What is the data type of "neighbouringCellMeasurementInformation" in the "CommonMeasurementInitiationRequest-Extensions" section?
q_7924.ground_truth: The data type of "neighbouringCellMeasurementInformation" in the "CommonMeasurementInitiationRequest-Extensions" section is a sequence of choices.

q_7925.question: What is the uplink resource allocation scheme supported when transform precoding is disabled?
q_7925.ground_truth: Uplink resource allocation scheme type 0 is supported for PUSCH only when transform precoding is disabled.

q_7926.question: What capabilities does the IMS-ALG have regarding handling of RTCP streams in the IMS-AGW?
q_7926.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG and the IMS-AGW support control via the Iq interface of the specific RTCP behavior associated to an RTP flow. The IMS-ALG may request the IMS-AGW to reserve resources for the corresponding RTCP flow or not to reserve resources for the corresponding RTCP flow. If the IMS-AGW receives the indication to reserve RTCP resources, it shall allocate a local port with an even number for an RTP flow and shall allocate the consecutive local port with an odd number for the associated RTCP flow. If the IMS-AGW receives the indication to not reserve resources for an RTCP flow, it shall not allocate an RTCP port when allocating a port for an RTP flow and shall silently discard any received RTCP packets.

q_7927.question: What is the significance of the "3,1 kHz (External to the PLMN)" Bearer Service category?
q_7927.ground_truth: The "3,1 kHz (External to the PLMN)" Bearer Service category is used when interworking with the ISDN or PSTN "3,1 kHz audio" service and includes the capability to select a modem at the interworking function. The connection within the PLMN, user access point to the interworking function, is an unrestricted digital connection.

q_7928.question: What does the SMF use the USS/UTM address for during the PDU session establishment request in Case 2 and Case 3?
q_7928.ground_truth: The SMF uses the USS/UTM address to reach the USS/UTM for secondary authentication.

q_7929.question: How is the transport-block size information mapped if only one transport block is transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCH(s)?
q_7929.ground_truth: If only one transport block is transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCH(s), the hybrid-ARQ process information xhap,1, xhap,2, xhap,3, xhap,4 is the unsigned binary representation of the HARQ process identifier where xhap,1 is MSB.

q_7930.question: What happens when a UE initiates a de-registration for a S-NSSAI?
q_7930.ground_truth: When a UE triggers a de-registration request for a S-NSSAI, the AMF triggers the update of policy counter to the associated PCF during AM policy association termination procedure. Upon receiving a deregistration request from the AMF, the secondary PCF of the S-NSSAI increases the remaining local quota of the S-NSSAI by one. The response of the deregistration of the S-NSSAI is then sent to the UE by the serving AMF.

q_7931.question: What is the requirement for the event triggered measurement reporting delay on cells not belonging to monitored set, measured without L3 filtering?
q_7931.ground_truth: The event triggered measurement reporting delay on cells not belonging to monitored set, measured without L3 filtering, shall be less than the above defined Tidentify detected set. defined in Section 8.1A.2.2.1.

q_7932.question: What was the range of the mean power saving gain with a marginal loss in DL UE satisfied rate observed in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30 for the enhanced PDCCH for jitter handling scheme?
q_7932.ground_truth: The range of the mean power saving gain was 37.83~47.38%.

q_7933.question: What information does Solution 46 provide to the UE through the CellReselectionPriorities in the RRC connection Release?
q_7933.ground_truth: Solution 46 provides more information on what slices are supported in which bands, allowing the UE to prefer certain bands for registering with band specific slices.

q_7934.question: What is the role of the multiplexing function in the uplink and downlink for TCH/F28.8 in the transparent case?
q_7934.ground_truth: In the uplink, the multiplexing function maps one 290-bit block from each substream into every 580-bit TCH/F28.8 radio interface data block. In the downlink, the multiplexing function demultiplexes the two substreams by extracting the two 290-bit blocks from the received 580-bit radio interface blocks.

q_7935.question: Which variable is associated with the U format and is used to perform additional logical link control functions?
q_7935.ground_truth: The use of the U format provides additional logical link control functions and contains no sequence number

q_7936.question: What is the purpose of the group creation response provided by the group management server to the group management client?
q_7936.ground_truth: The purpose of the group creation response provided by the group management server to the group management client is to confirm the creation of the group and provide a response to the group creation request.

q_7937.question: What is the alpha identifier for the second SEND DATA command in the procedure?
q_7937.ground_truth: The alpha identifier for the second SEND DATA command is "Send Data 2".

q_7938.question: How is the retrieval of authentication vectors and authorization of the ProSe UE performed if the ProSe Function does not have an unused authentication vector associated with the ProSe UE?
q_7938.ground_truth: The ProSe Function shall request one Authentication Vector from the HSS over the PC4a interface.

q_7939.question: What is the difference between Class 1 and Class 2 Elementary Procedures in NBAP?
q_7939.ground_truth: Class 1 EPs in NBAP have a response (success or failure), while Class 2 EPs do not have a response and are considered always successful.

q_7940.question: What is the PEI monitoring interval for the UE in the 9.1.14.1.3 test procedure?
q_7940.ground_truth: The UE monitors one PEI occasion (PEI-O) per DRX cycle, where a PEI occasion is a set of PDCCH monitoring occasions (MOs) and can consist of multiple time slots (e.g. subframes or OFDM symbols) where PEI can be sent.

q_7941.question: What is the definition of "idle mode" in the context of user equipment (UE)?
q_7941.ground_truth: Idle mode is the state of UE when switched on but with no Radio Resource Control (RRC) connection.

q_7942.question: What is a key aspect addressed by this solution in terms of supporting service continuity between PLMN and PNI-NPN?
q_7942.ground_truth: The key aspect addressed is whether there are support for service continuity between PLMN and PNI-NPN with overlapping radio coverage areas.

q_7943.question: What is the function of the signalling RB for MCCH with 80 ms TTI?
q_7943.ground_truth: The signaling RB for MCCH with 80 ms TTI is support in Release 6 by UEs with capability for MBMS. It is used to convey information during the initial phase of the Multimedia Broadcast System between the UEs and the network. The TTI is the time duration for which the UE and the network share the frequency resource.

q_7944.question: Who provides the "MBS User Service Announcement Channel" in the MBS System?
q_7944.ground_truth: The "MBS User Service Announcement Channel" is generated by the MBSF to carousel MBS User Service Announcements to the MBS Client using the Object Distribution Method.

q_7945.question: What method was used to minimize the dominance of noise in the investigation of far end background noise?
q_7945.ground_truth: The Degradation Category Rating method was selected to minimize the dominance of noise, and the investigation of the two different types of noise was placed in separate experiments.

q_7946.question: What is the core objective of the 3GPP work item related to the Introduction of upper 700MHz A block E-UTRA band for the US?
q_7946.ground_truth: The core objectives are to study the need for co-location and/or co-existence requirements, standardize a new FDD E-UTRA operating band, specify band numbering and RF characteristics, ensure the new band supports only NB-IoT operation, and update related 3GPP E-UTRA technical specifications.

q_7947.question: What is the purpose of the pre-scan method described in 6.3.2.5.2?
q_7947.ground_truth: The pre-scan method is used to identify spurious frequencies with emission power levels above a threshold in a fast measurement over the entire spurious frequency range. It is not meant to provide an estimate of TRP.

q_7948.question: What is the general principle for achieving a consistent user experience across different access scenarios?
q_7948.ground_truth: The general principle is to strive for a consistent user experience across different access scenarios.

q_7949.question: What two events are dispatched based on the screen orientation?
q_7949.ground_truth: A portrait event is dispatched if the screen is taller than it is wide, and a landscape event is dispatched if the screen is wider than it is tall.

q_7950.question: How should trade names (brand names) be used in a 3GPP TS?
q_7950.ground_truth: Trade names (brand names) should be avoided in a 3GPP TS. If it is essential to give an example of a commercially available product, a correct designation or description of the product should be given, with a note indicating the nature of the trade name if it is used.

q_7951.question: In the Technical Report 3GPP TS 12.22, which entity handles processing phases that are included in the defined call phases for user signalling acknowledgement delay?
q_7951.ground_truth: The MSC/VLR handles the processing phases that are included in the defined call phases for user signalling acknowledgement delay.

q_7952.question: What is the role of the KDF function in generating the keys KE and KM?
q_7952.ground_truth: The KDF function is used to generate the keys KE and KM from the session anchor key KAUSF and the parameters specified in the key derivation function.

q_7953.question: What is the purpose of Self-healing in the context of SON?
q_7953.ground_truth: The purpose of Self-healing in SON is to solve or mitigate faults that can be solved automatically by triggering appropriate recovery actions.

q_7954.question: What are the two polynomials used for CRC calculation in this protocol?
q_7954.ground_truth: The two polynomials used for CRC calculation are gCRC6(D) = D6 + D5 + D3 + D2 + D1 + 1 and gCRC10(D) = D10 + D9 + D5 + D4 + D1 + 1.

q_7955.question: Which message is sent by the RNC to transfer the radio interface initial layer 3 message to the CN?
q_7955.ground_truth: The 9.1.33 INITIAL UE MESSAGE is sent by the RNC to transfer the radio interface initial layer 3 message to the CN.

q_7956.question: What is the definition of "active" media information for audio in the context of average codec bitrate calculation?
q_7956.ground_truth: In the context of average codec bitrate calculation, "active" audio media information is defined as frames containing audio.

q_7957.question: What is the purpose of the HNB Registration Procedure in 3GPP TS 36.468?
q_7957.ground_truth: The purpose of the HNB Registration Procedure is to register the HNB with the HNB-GW to enable the HNB-GW to provide service and core network connectivity for the HNB.

q_7958.question: What is the purpose of the error concealment procedure in the AMR-WB speech codec within the 3GPP system?
q_7958.ground_truth: The purpose of the error concealment procedure is to conceal the effect of erroneous/lost AMR-WB speech frames and to mute the output in the case of several erroneous/lost frames to indicate the breakdown of the channel to the user and to avoid generating possible annoying sounds as a result from the error concealment procedure.

q_7959.question: What does an MS need to perform in addition to the tasks in 6.5.6.1, if it is COMPACT-capable?
q_7959.ground_truth: If an MS is COMPACT-capable, it needs to perform the same tasks as in 6.5.6.1 for any CPBCCH, either transmitted in the serving cell or indicated in the BA-GPRS list.

q_7960.question: What is the function of the Direct Transfer Request message in the S101 messages used to support interworking between the MME and the non-3GPP access network?
q_7960.ground_truth: The Direct Transfer Request message is used to transport an HRPD or an E-UTRAN message to the peer HRPD access node or MME.

q_7961.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives an initial SIP INVITE with a valid SCC AS PSI DN, a valid E.164 number in the SDP offer, and a P-Asserted-Identity header field containing the same E.164 number?
q_7961.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall use the SCC AS PSI DN that was allocated in the above step 1 to associate SCC-AS-PDN with the existing session and the E.164 number received in the SDP offer from the ICS UE.

q_7962.question: What are the two directions in which downlink control channel (PDCCH) interference can occur in co-channel HeNB deployments?
q_7962.ground_truth: The two directions are HeNB (aggressor) to macro-UE (victim), and macro-eNB (aggressor) to HUE (victim) if the UE is connected to a weaker HeNB cell.

q_7963.question: What action should a UE take if uplink user data is pending for one or more PDU sessions when building a control plane service request message as an initial NAS message?
q_7963.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the respective PDU sessions, regardless of the access category, as specified in subclause 5.6.1.2.2 when building a control plane service request message as an initial NAS message.

q_7964.question: In the scenario where a priority service call is established with trunk queuing at the originating MSC, and an idle outgoing trunk is not available but the trunk queuing timer has not expired, what is the action taken by the MSC/VLR?
q_7964.ground_truth: The MSC/VLR places the call in an outgoing trunk queue based on a First-In, First-Out basis and starts the trunk queuing timer; the MSC/VLR then sends a Progress message to the MS with progress indicator information element set to #64 "Queuing".

q_7965.question: How is the "Call waiting" supplementary service activated?
q_7965.ground_truth: The "Call waiting" supplementary service is activated at the request of the user, through an activation request that specifies the basic services to which the activation refers.

q_7966.question: When must the peak code domain error requirements specified in sub-clause 6.8.3.1 apply at each active transmit antenna connector, as specified in sub-clause 6.8.3.1A, 6.8.3.1B and 6.8.3.1C?
q_7966.ground_truth: The requirements apply for UE with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD operation, UL CLTD activation state 1 and 2 or 3, and DB-DC-HSUPA operating simultaneously with CS.

q_7967.question: What information is exchanged between the CP function and the SX3LIF over the X3c reference point in the defined LI architecture for CUPS?
q_7967.ground_truth: The CP function provides intercept-related information (IRI) to the SX3LIF over the X3c reference point.

q_7968.question: What is the reporting range for P-CCPCH RSCP?
q_7968.ground_truth: The reporting range for P-CCPCH RSCP is from -120 to -25 dBm.

q_7969.question: What is the role of the TP-Status-Report-Qualifier in the Short Message Peer-to-Peer (SMPP) protocol?
q_7969.ground_truth: The TP-Status-Report-Qualifier is a 1 bit field located within bit 5 of the first octet of SMS-STATUS-REPORT, which indicates whether the status report is the result of a SMS-SUBMIT or an SMS-COMMAND.

q_7970.question: What are the two main approaches for storing and placing network slice quota information and management in the 5GC network?
q_7970.ground_truth: The two main approaches are to put them into an existing 5GC network function or to introduce a new network function/new service operation to be deployed in the existing 5GC network function.

q_7971.question: What does the abbreviation "3GMS" stand for in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_7971.ground_truth: 3GMS stands for Third Generation Mobile Communications System.

q_7972.question: What is the default value of T if the MS does not support EC-GSM-IoT, Category M1 or Category NB1?
q_7972.ground_truth: The default value of T is 60 minutes if the MS does not support any of the mentioned categories.

q_7973.question: How does an Edge Application Server de-register from the CAPIF core function?
q_7973.ground_truth: The Edge Application Server sends a registration update request to the CAPIF core function, indicating a de-registration to an existing registration. The CAPIF core function then validates the request and sends a registration update response message to the Edge Application Server.

q_7974.question: What is used as freshness input into KACPSK derivations, to mitigate replay attacks?
q_7974.ground_truth: The CounterECS is used as freshness input into KACPSK derivations, to mitigate replay attacks.

q_7975.question: When can the 3GPP system automatically revoke a DTS session in the RPLMN?
q_7975.ground_truth: The 3GPP system in the RPLMN shall automatically revoke the DTS upon UE detachment/deregistration, or when the connections under control of the DTS session are released.

q_7976.question: What information does the BSF supply to the UE when it continues protocol Ub after receiving the authentication vector?
q_7976.ground_truth: The BSF supplies key material (Ks) to the UE, derived from the confidential key (CK) and integrity key (IK), as well as the Bootstrapping Transaction Identifier (B-TID) and key lifetime (expiry time) for further use in GAA/GBA applications.

q_7977.question: What is the purpose of deploying security functions, such as firewalls, at the CN edge in a network slice?
q_7977.ground_truth: Deploying security functions, such as firewalls, at the CN edge (e.g. N6 interface) in a network slice can protect the network slice from attacks from the internet.

q_7978.question: What is the subject of the present document, "3GPP TS 34.229-3"?
q_7978.ground_truth: The present document is part of a multi-part conformance test specification for UE and is valid for 3GPP Release 5 and above. It contains a TTCN design framework and the detailed test specifications in TTCN for the UE conformance at the Gm reference point.

q_7979.question: What is the purpose of the Proximity-based Services (ProSe) charging in 3GPP?
q_7979.ground_truth: The Proximity-based Services (ProSe) charging in 3GPP specifies the offline, online, and converged charging description for ProSe, based on the stage 2 description of ProSe. It includes the charging architecture and scenarios specific to the Prose, as well as the mapping of the common 3GPP charging architecture onto the Prose. It further specifies the structure and content of the CDRs for offline charging, and the charging events for online charging.

q_7980.question: What is the main purpose of the V2X application server discovery using MBMS procedure?
q_7980.ground_truth: The purpose of the V2X application server discovery using MBMS procedure is to allow the UE to receive the V2X application server information over MBMS bearers.

q_7981.question: What does E-DCH stand for in the context of UMTS and what is its definition?
q_7981.ground_truth: E-DCH stands for Enhanced Dedicated Channel in UMTS. It is a resource that exists in the uplink only and is not visible in the logical channels provided by MAC. It is a transport channel subject to Node-B scheduling and is defined as an extension to DCH transmission.

q_7982.question: In the "UL-DPCH-InformationList-RL-SetupRspTDD" part of the protocol, what does the acronym "DPCH" stand for in the name of the "ProtocolIE-Single-Container" type?

q_7983.question: What is the purpose of Test 1 in 8.2.6.2.4.1, ensuring that the UE successfully transmits an RRCResumeComplete message after receiving an RRCResume message and so on?
q_7983.ground_truth: The purpose of Test 1 in 8.2.6.2.4.1 is to ensure that the UE can properly transmit an RRCResumeComplete message after receiving an RRCResume message, waiting for 10ms, and receiving an UL grant.

q_7984.question: What is the uncertainty in the power accuracy of the OTA test chamber for the TAE measurement?
q_7984.ground_truth: The uncertainty in the power accuracy of the OTA test chamber will not affect the TAE measurement uncertainty.

q_7985.question: What should the UE do if the "Multiple PLMN List" is not included in the Master Information Block?
q_7985.ground_truth: The UE should apply the domain specific access restrictions and paging permission with access control as indicated in the IE "Domain Specific Access Restriction Parameters For PLMN Of MIB" and "Paging Permission with Access Control Parameters for PLMN Of MIB".

q_7986.question: How does the IOPS MC connectivity function distribute group session packets carrying the IOPS MCData group standalone data request?
q_7986.ground_truth: The IOPS MC connectivity function can distribute the group session packets to discovered MCData clients over MBMS bearers or replicate and distribute them over unicast transmissions to MCData UEs associated with the target IOPS MCData group.

q_7987.question: What is the scope of the document "Application of Q.1900 series to bearer independent Circuit Switched (CS) core network architecture; Stage 3 (Release 17)"?
q_7987.ground_truth: The document describes the protocols used in a 3GPP bearer independent CS core network when ITU-T Q.1902 is used as the call control protocol, specifically for a 3rd generation PLMN (UMTS) that complies with Release 4 and later.

q_7988.question: How does the ADR control algorithm fulfill its objective in the VBR mode?
q_7988.ground_truth: The ADR control algorithm fulfills its objective in the VBR mode by adjusting the threshold (Tcn), frame pattern (LHH), PPP bump up threshold (R ss1, R sl2, R sns1, R sns2), and the open loop voiced and unvoiced decisions to reduce the rate. Additionally, it utilizes a speech quality improvement strategy if the global rate is less than the target rate.

q_7989.question: What is the purpose of the MIKEY extension payload in the BM-SC?
q_7989.ground_truth: The MIKEY extension payload is used to carry the MSK ID in the BM-SC. It is 4 bytes long, with byte 0 and 1 containing the Key Group part, and byte 2 and 3 containing the Key Number part.

q_7990.question: What is the purpose of the Average Data Rate (ADR) control in the EVS VBR mode?
q_7990.ground_truth: The purpose of the ADR control in the EVS VBR mode is to ensure the compliance of ADR requirements under a variety of language and noise type mix. It achieves this by adjusting the thresholds and frame selection patterns.

q_7991.question: How is the partial redundancy technology implemented in the EVS channel aware mode?
q_7991.ground_truth: The partial redundancy technology in EVS channel aware mode transmits partial copies of the current frame along with a future frame, allowing for retrieval of the partial copy from the jitter buffer in the event of loss of the current frame.

q_7992.question: In the CAMEL-CallResult choice, what is the meaning of legActive when its default value is TRUE?
q_7992.ground_truth: It indicates that the leg of the call is still active.

q_7993.question: What is the role of the Access Call Control Signalling in SCUDIF?
q_7993.ground_truth: The Access Call Control Signalling is used to request a service change and fallback functionality, while still maintaining the backwards compatibility with non-supporting terminals.

q_7994.question: What information is included in a TWAG-CDR when it is used to collect charging information related to the IP-CAN bearer data information?
q_7994.ground_truth: The TWAG-CDR includes details such as Record Type, Served IMSI, Sequence Number etc. and both the traffic data and FBC specific charging data.

q_7995.question: What is the main issue with using a JSON Merge Patch to replace resources with descendants?
q_7995.ground_truth: The main issue is that it goes against the principle of PATCH by requiring the inclusion of the representations of all descendant resources, leading to inefficiency.

q_7996.question: In which message can a mobile station use the alternative coding for encoding other access technology types during a GPRS TBF establishment?
q_7996.ground_truth: The mobile station may use the alternative coding for encoding other access technology types in the MS Radio Access Capability 2 IE sent within the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message.

q_7997.question: Which security functions are shared between ISIM and USIM applications in the UE?
q_7997.ground_truth: Only the sequence number checking mechanism, the algorithm, or the algorithm and sequence number checking mechanism can be shared between ISIM and USIM applications.

q_7998.question: What is the maximum size of the data payload containing the status information related to a freight wagon?
q_7998.ground_truth: The maximum size of the data payload is 2500 bytes.

q_7999.question: What is the response from the Node B if it cannot perform the cell synchronization adjustment as requested in the CELL SYNCHRONISATION ADJUSTMENT REQUEST message due to hardware failure or other problems?
q_7999.ground_truth: CELL SYNCHRONISATION ADJUSTMENT FAILURE with a radio network layer cause of "Cell Synchronisation Adjustment not supported" or "Power level not supported" or miscellaneous cause of "O&M Intervention" or "HW failure."

q_8000.question: What does the EES do with the EEC ID after receiving it from the ECS during the service authorization verification process?
q_8000.ground_truth: The EES verifies the mapping between the EEC ID and the Global PDU Session Identifier (GPSI) and validates the authorization of the EEC with the ECS using the EEC ID.

q_8001.question: What is the payload type for CS Data service with no redundancy in 3GPP TS 48.103?
q_8001.ground_truth: The specific payload type value for CS Data service with no redundancy in 3GPP TS 48.103 is 120.

q_8002.question: When should the expiration time be set in the served MCData user information entry?
q_8002.ground_truth: The expiration time should be set as determined by local policy in the served MCData user information entry.

q_8003.question: What is the upper limit of the eDRX cycle in seconds, as supported by 5GC for NB-IoT and LTE-MTC?

q_8004.question: What are some of the capabilities of the GSM MS-BSS interface in addition to the multiservice capability?
q_8004.ground_truth: Some of the capabilities of the GSM MS-BSS interface in addition to the multiservice capability include support for multidrop and other multiple terminal arrangements, choice of information bit rate and switching mode, and capability for compatibility checking.

q_8005.question: What is the consequence of failing to decode the BSIC of a GSM BCCH carrier within the specified time limit?
q_8005.ground_truth: If the UE fails to decode the BSIC of a GSM BCCH carrier within the time limit, it shall abort the BSIC identification attempts for that carrier and move on to the next carrier in signal strength order.

q_8006.question: Where does the information about the mapping of PRACH or CPRACH on the physical channel come from?
q_8006.ground_truth: A predefined fixed part of the multiframe structure for PDCH can be used as PRACH or CPRACH only, and the information about the mapping on the physical channel is broadcast on PBCCH or CPBCCH.

q_8007.question: What determines the use of IEC, SCUR, or PEC in converged charging?
q_8007.ground_truth: The use of IEC, SCUR, or PEC in converged charging depends on the MMTel supplementary service and/or operator's policy.

q_8008.question: What is the purpose of the Iu UP protocol in the UTRAN?
q_8008.ground_truth: The Iu UP protocol is used in the UTRAN to transfer user data for all Iu UP specific functions, except for initializing the RAB.

q_8009.question: What is the integer value that is associated with the measurement of the number of direct user plane path between HNB and Local GW successfully established, and what is its measurement name?
q_8009.ground_truth: The integer value is incremented for each RAB successfully established and added to the relevant measurement. The measurement name has the form RAB.EstabDirectPathLGWSuccNbr.

q_8010.question: Which software was used for stitching the video captured by the GoPro camera rig in 4.3.2?

q_8011.question: In the context of TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5, what triggers the measurement reporting procedure, and what subsequent actions does the UE take after triggering the procedure?
q_8011.ground_truth: The measurement reporting procedure, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5, is triggered for the measId for which the reporting event was met. The UE then sets the measResults within the MeasurementReport message, including the measurement identity that triggered the measurement report, the relevant serving cells, and, if applicable, neighboring cells. The UE then initiates the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

q_8012.question: What is the purpose of user-to-USIM authentication in user domain security?
q_8012.ground_truth: The purpose of user-to-USIM authentication in user domain security is to restrict access to the USIM to an authorized user.

q_8013.question: What is MIKEY used for in the context of ProSe Key Management Function and UE communication?
q_8013.ground_truth: MIKEY is used to transport the PSDKs from the ProSe Key Management Function to the UE and is used exactly as in subclause 6.2.3.3.2.3, except that the IDi payload is formed from the Key Type ID || PSDK ID @ FQDN of the ProSe Key Management Function at the PKMF, and an all-zero PSDK ID is used to trigger the UE to send a Key Request message.

q_8014.question: What is the aim of the solution described in section 7.18.1?
q_8014.ground_truth: The aim of the solution described in section 7.18.1 is to enable the management and provision of HD map dynamic information for the V2X application specific client on V2X UE. The solution consists of various mechanisms for tracking and managing UE location information.

q_8015.question: What is the function of UTRAN in multiplexing segments of system information blocks with different repetition periods?
q_8015.ground_truth: UTRAN is responsible for multiplexing segments of system information blocks with different repetition periods, and this function is performed by the RRC layer.

q_8016.question: What is the purpose of MTC Features as defined in the 3GPP Technical Specification for Network Improvements for Machine Type Communications?
q_8016.ground_truth: MTC Features are network functions to optimize the network for use by M2M applications. They provide structure for the different system optimization possibilities that can be invoked for MTC applications and can be individually activated.

q_8017.question: What is the value of FC used for in the KDF input S?
q_8017.ground_truth: FC is used as a constant value set to 0xYY in the input S for the KDF.

q_8018.question: What is the impact of this solution on roaming scenarios?
q_8018.ground_truth: The solution allows for simultaneous access to network slices in roaming scenarios, but the serving PLMN must ensure there are no conflicts with the HPLMN and VPLMN constraints on simultaneous use of network slices.

q_8019.question: What should the Node B use as the maximum DL power for each timeslot within a DSCH type CCTrCH when the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the CCTrCH Maximum DL Transmission Power IE?
q_8019.ground_truth: The Node B should use the CCTrCH Maximum DL Transmission Power IE as the maximum DL power for each timeslot within a DSCH type CCTrCH when the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the CCTrCH Maximum DL Transmission Power IE.

q_8020.question: What are the parameters included in UNITDATA indication primitives for sending and receiving data?
q_8020.ground_truth: The parameters include the Called and Calling Addresses, Sequence Control, Return Option, and User Data, with addressing parameters always mandatory.

q_8021.question: What triggers LCS to provide enhanced geographic capabilities for UE locations?
q_8021.ground_truth: LCS provides enhanced geographic capabilities for UE locations when IA is provisioned.

q_8022.question: What is the Media Type for identifying documents following the filter description schema?

q_8023.question: How does the NRM server collect 5GS TSN Bridge information?
q_8023.ground_truth: The NRM server collects 5GS TSN Bridge information by interacting with the 5GS via the N5 reference point and storing the binding relationship between 5GS Bridge ID, MAC address of the DS-TT Ethernet port, and 5GS bridge delay.

q_8024.question: What is the method of test defined in clause 10.1.5.4 for verifying that the ME adds the CSG ID to the allowed CSG list?
q_8024.ground_truth: The method of test for verifying that the ME adds the CSG ID to the allowed CSG list in a non-volatile memory in the ME together with the IMSI from the USIM in case this CSG ID belongs to the cell where the ME has sent the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message which was accepted by the E-USS. The test also includes verifying that the ME still has this CSG ID stored in the allowed CSG list available together with the IMSI after powered down and up in case the IMSI of the USIM has not changed, and removing the CSG ID from the allowed CSG list inside the terminal in case this CSG ID belongs to the cell where the ME has sent the ATTACH REQUEST message which was rejected with cause #25 by the E-USS.

q_8025.question: What is the difference between unintentional and intentional RFI in the context of GNSS?
q_8025.ground_truth: Unintentional RFI is caused by nearby radio devices broadcasting at a frequency that impacts GNSS signals, while intentional RFI is the deliberate action of blocking GNSS signal reception by broadcasting a strong signal on GNSS frequencies.

q_8026.question: What is the composition of IMEI as per the 3GPP TS 23.003?
q_8026.ground_truth: The IMEI is composed in such a way that each individual mobile station equipment can be separately identified and it directly or indirectly contains all necessary information for the network operator to make relations through its administrative system to trace the equipment to its origin of production.

q_8027.question: Which messages are relevant to the formats and codes listed in ITU-T Recommendation Q.704, clause 15?
q_8027.ground_truth: The formats and codes listed are relevant to the messages that are required, i.e. those not excluded in the rest of the recommendation.

q_8028.question: In the context of the Key agreement TLV, what does a Length value of 1 signify?
q_8028.ground_truth: A Length value of 1 signifies that the current keyset agreed for the specified KEY ID should be used.

q_8029.question: What are the three possible values of the Criticality Information for an IE/IE group?
q_8029.ground_truth: The three possible values of the Criticality Information for an IE/IE group are "Reject IE," "Ignore IE and Notify Sender," and "Ignore IE."

q_8030.question: What is the impact on the reduction in the number of HS-DSCH subframe formats transmitted without an HS-SCCH in the reduced complexity HS-SCCH-less operation?
q_8030.ground_truth: Four HS-DSCH subframe formats out of the total seven formats can be transmitted without an HS-SCCH in the first HARQ transmission, but HARQ retransmissions still have the HS-SCCH.

q_8031.question: What is the expected response from the conference focus to an REFER request received from a user requesting to invite another user to a conference?
q_8031.ground_truth: The conference focus shall send a final response in accordance with RFC 3515, generate an INVITE request to invite the referred user, and include a Referred-By header if one was included in the REFER request.

q_8032.question: What is the purpose of the GTP-U-CONTROL-RX-SETUP.request primitive in GTP-U protocol?
q_8032.ground_truth: The GTP-U-CONTROL-RX-SETUP.request primitive is used to allocate packet reception resources in accordance with a specified QoS profile. These resources are associated with a tunnel endpoint that is identified by the TEID parameter.

q_8033.question: What should the UE do if the security check is not successful and the UE is in automatic network selection mode?
q_8033.ground_truth: The UE shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN.

q_8034.question: What happens to the P-Preferred-Identity header field if the identity is not part of the implicit registration set?
q_8034.ground_truth: The P-Preferred-Identity header field will be removed and the P-CSCF will provide a default identity in the P-Asserted-Identity header field.

q_8035.question: What is the P2 puncturing pattern for the DBC-450 code?
q_8035.ground_truth: The P2 puncturing pattern is determined by the CPS values in the DBC-450 code, with patterns defined in 3GPP TS 44.060.

q_8036.question: What is the significance of UL Outer Loop Power Control in the Uplink Power Control functions, and how is it related to E-DCH connections?
q_8036.ground_truth: UL Outer Loop Power Control plays a crucial role in Uplink Power Control functions by setting the target quality for UL Inner Loop Power Control, and it receives the number of HARQ retransmissions as input in the case of E-DCH connections.

q_8037.question: What was the capacity performance of FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with VR/AR, 30Mbps, 60FPS, 10ms PDB, with MU-MIMO, when using Frame Level Integrated Transmission (FLIT) scheduler?
q_8037.ground_truth: The capacity performance was 14 UEs per cell.

q_8038.question: What should the CTS-FP do when it receives a message not compatible with the protocol state, and the message is not one of the messages listed in subclause 8.5.3 b), c), d), or e)?
q_8038.ground_truth: The CTS-FP should either try to treat the message or ignore the message and return a status message with cause #96.

q_8039.question: What information is included in the FORWARD SRNS CONTEXT message for each RAB?
q_8039.ground_truth: For each RAB, the FORWARD SRNS CONTEXT message includes the RAB ID IE, the sequence number for the next downlink GTP-PDU to be sent to the UE (DL GTP-PDU Sequence Number IE), the sequence number for the next uplink GTP-PDU to be tunnelled to the GGSN (UL GTP-PDU Sequence Number IE), the radio interface sequence number (PDCP) of the next uplink N-PDU expected from the UE (UL N-PDU Sequence Number IE), and the radio interface sequence number (PDCP) of the next downlink N-PDU that would have been sent to the UE by a source system (DL N-PDU Sequence Number IE).

q_8040.question: What action should the new SGSN take when it receives a RANAP Cause value higher than 255 from the target RNC?
q_8040.ground_truth: The new SGSN should include the RANAP Cause IE in the message and set it to an implementation dependent value. It should also copy it to the Extended RANAP Cause IE if it supports this IE.

q_8041.question: What action does B take when an incoming call from C is received while connected to A?
q_8041.ground_truth: B rejects the incoming call from C.

q_8042.question: What is the size of a resource element (RE) in NR?
q_8042.ground_truth: A resource element (RE) is defined as the physical layer resource Allocation of one subcarrier and one symbol.

q_8043.question: What is the minimum recommended timer value for the fallback to speech procedure in the call setup procedure?
q_8043.ground_truth: The recommended minimum timer value is 3 seconds for the fallback to speech procedure in the call setup procedure.

q_8044.question: What is the purpose of the Generic NRM IRP in 3GPP 28.621, 28.622, and 28.623?
q_8044.ground_truth: The Generic NRM IRP provides the generic network resources information that can be communicated between an IRPAgent and one or several IRPManagers for network management purposes.

q_8045.question: What is the effect of the HPLMN on forwarded-to numbers when TIF-CSI is provided?
q_8045.ground_truth: The HPLMN shall not check the forwarded-to number and only the category Barring of registration of any call forwarded-to number will take effect.

q_8046.question: What are the high level functions specified in 3GPP~TS~23.287 that have V2X application layer impact?
q_8046.ground_truth: The high level functions specified in 3GPP~TS~23.287 that have V2X application layer impact are authorization and provisioning for V2X communications over PC5 and Uu reference points, V2X message transmission/reception over PC5 or Uu reference points, V2X Application Server discovery, QoS handling for V2X communication over PC5 and Uu reference points, and interworking between EPS V2X and 5GS V2X.

q_8047.question: What information is used to forward the identities between the GSM-R system and the FRMCS system?
q_8047.ground_truth: The information from the Role management and presence application is used to forward the identities between the GSM-R system and the FRMCS system.

q_8048.question: What performance metric is evaluated for RTP-based streaming delivery in UTRAN?
q_8048.ground_truth: Maximum supported Media Rate (kbit/s) for Mean Time Between FEC Block Loss of 1 hour

q_8049.question: What is the input to the KDF function during the signature generation process?
q_8049.ground_truth: The input to the KDF function during the signature generation process is a point Q.

q_8050.question: Which command type is utilized in the SEND SS facility tests in section 27.22.4.11.4.9?

q_8051.question: What is the purpose of the first text in the example sequence diagram for network initiated mobile originating call using the option assignment after A and B party alerting?
q_8051.ground_truth: The first text in the example sequence diagram for network initiated mobile originating call using the option assignment after A and B party alerting is a description of the case with backward bearer establishment being considered.

q_8052.question: What is the type of the "traceInformation" field in the RNSAPRelocationParameters sequence?
q_8052.ground_truth: The "traceInformation" field in the RNSAPRelocationParameters sequence is of the type TraceInformation which is optional.

q_8053.question: When should the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure for event A4?
q_8053.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure for event A4 when the reportType is set to eventTriggered and the leaving condition for this event is fulfilled for one or more of the cells included in the cellsTriggeredList.

q_8054.question: What is one challenge for Interactive Cinematic VR in section 5.7.3?
q_8054.ground_truth: Directors lose control over framing and audio effects, as viewers can look anywhere and make story branching decisions.

q_8055.question: What is the role of DIMS in error resilience mechanisms?
q_8055.ground_truth: Among the error resilience mechanisms available in DIMS are priority, periodic random access points, and separation of static and dynamic data. By combining these methods, one can determine if a loss need repair or not, and increase the efficiency of Distributed Random Access Points.

q_8056.question: How is the reporting accuracy of CQI under MIMO single stream conditions determined?
q_8056.ground_truth: The reporting accuracy of CQI under MIMO single stream conditions is determined by the BLER performance when transmitting with a transport format indicated by the reported CQI median determined over all single transport block Type A CQI reports and all Type B CQI reports that were reported together with PCI reports matching the precoding vector embedded in the propagation channel.

q_8057.question: Given a block of N+8 bits, how does the first parity bit b(0) get calculated in the case when an eTFI field is included?
q_8057.ground_truth: It is calculated as that in the two preceding bits, b(-6) and b(-2), which are added after the N bits of the block, resulting in a block of N+8 bits.

q_8058.question: What is the PDP type organization value for a default PDP connection activation in Expected Sequence 1.2?
q_8058.ground_truth: The PDP type organization value is as declared by the ME in Expected Sequence 1.2 and 1.3.

q_8059.question: Which UTRAN mobility IEs contains the integrity protection mode info, ciphering mode info, new U-RNTI, new C-RNTI, new H-RNTI, ue-ConnTimersAndConstants, cn-InformationInfo, ura-Identity, support for change of UE, and dl-CounterSynchronisationInfo?

q_8060.question: What information does the SMF include in the N4 rule for the MA PDU session in step 4?
q_8060.ground_truth: The SMF includes QUIC functionality and ATSSS-LL functionality for the traffic in the N4 rule for the MA PDU session in step 4.

q_8061.question: What is the purpose of the Default SMS handling in the MT SMS TDP descriptions?
q_8061.ground_truth: The default SMS handling indicates whether the MT SMS delivery request shall be rejected or continued in the case of error in the dialogue between the gsmSSF and gsmSCF or between the gprsSSF and gsmSCF.

q_8062.question: What is the time interval when Cell 2 transmits PRS?
q_8062.ground_truth: Cell 2 transmits PRS only in T3.

q_8063.question: How is the gain computed to shape the excitation in high-band?
q_8063.ground_truth: The gain in high-band is computed based on the signal voicing. If the sub-frame is classified as unvoiced, the gain is computed as in equation (2037). Otherwise, if the sub-frame is not classified as unvoiced, the gain is computed as in equation (2041).

q_8064.question: What is the definition of the "Maximum number of simultaneous transport channels" in the downlink?
q_8064.ground_truth: This is the maximum number of downlink Transport Channels that the UE can process simultaneously, not taking into account the rate of each Transport Channel.

q_8065.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TR 21.905 in the present document?
q_8065.ground_truth: The 3GPP TR 21.905 gives the abbreviations and acronyms used in the present document, providing a common terminology for reference in the document.

q_8066.question: What is the recommended MUX-PDU size in the 3GPP TS 26.114 document?
q_8066.ground_truth: The recommended MUX-PDU size in the 3GPP TS 26.114 document is smaller than in typical GSTN use and is often in the range of 100-200 octets.

q_8067.question: What does the acronym "ALCAP" stand for in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_8067.ground_truth: ALCAP stands for a transport signalling protocol used to setup and tear down transport bearers.

q_8068.question: What changes were introduced in TS 25.308 REL-7 related to discontinuous UL transmission?
q_8068.ground_truth: The summary of discontinuous UL transmission, discontinuous DL reception, HS-SCCH-less HS-DSCH transmission, and usage of new UL DPCH slot format were added.

q_8069.question: In the communication optimized approach 2, what is the role of the MSK?
q_8069.ground_truth: In the communication optimized approach 2, the MSK is a key shared by the N UEs in the multicast group and is used to protect the update of the GK over the multicast channel.

q_8070.question: What is the main coding technique used in the EVS primary mode?
q_8070.ground_truth: Linear predictive (LP) coding techniques based upon ACELP (Algebraic Code Excited Linear Prediction)

q_8071.question: What is the role of the Default Credential Server (DCS) in the 5G System?
q_8071.ground_truth: The Default Credential Server (DCS) is responsible for authenticating a UE with default UE credentials or providing means for another entity to do it. It provides information that the UE has before the actual onboarding procedure to make it uniquely identifiable and securely.

q_8072.question: What should the MS do upon successful activation of a dual address PDP type (IPv4v6)?
q_8072.ground_truth: The MS should wait for the Router Advertisement from the network with the IPv6 prefix information or it may send Router Solicitation if necessary.

q_8073.question: What message does the HNB transmit to the HNB-GW when the UE initiates an initial NAS procedure?
q_8073.ground_truth: The HNB transmits a RRC Initial Direct Transfer message carrying the initial NAS message.

q_8074.question: What is the purpose of the HSDSCH-Information-to-Modify in the HS-DSCH-Secondary-Serving-Information-to-Modify?
q_8074.ground_truth: The HSDSCH-Information-to-Modify in the HS-DSCH-Secondary-Serving-Information-to-Modify is a list of IEs that modify the existing HSDSCH information for the serving cell. It includes one or more HSDSCH-MACdFlow-Specific-InfoList-to-Modify, a PriorityQueue-InfoList-to-Modify, and a SixtyfourQAM-UsageAllowedIndicator, as well as an optional IEs-Extensions field.

q_8075.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a SIP BYE request on the Source Access Leg with the Reason header field containing a SIP 503 (Service Unavailable) response code?
q_8075.ground_truth: If the SCC AS receives an I1 Invite message within a time defined by the operator policy after the SIP BYE request reception, then the SCC AS shall not initiate release of the dialog toward the remote UE, and if the SCC AS does not receive a I1 Invite message within a time defined by the operator policy after the SIP BYE request reception then the SCC AS shall initiate release of the dialog toward the remote UE.

q_8076.question: How does the solution propose to consider a UE in satellite access mode for setting timer T?
q_8076.ground_truth: The solution proposes to consider a UE in satellite access mode as a non-NB-IoT UE for setting timer T. The same use of any setting for timer T in the USIM and the MinimumPeriodicSearchTimer can be reused as it is today.

q_8077.question: What is the 3GPP encryption algorithm defined in the present document?

q_8078.question: What security information is contained in the header of the PDCP packet for user plane data?
q_8078.ground_truth: The 5 least significant bits of the PGK Identity, PTK Identity, and Counter are contained in the header of the PDCP packet for user plane data.

q_8079.question: What is the purpose of the AUSF in the UE-to-Network relaying procedure?
q_8079.ground_truth: The AUSF is responsible for authenticating the Remote UE via the AMF using the SUCI of the Remote UE, and for determining whether the Remote UE is authorized to use UE-to-Network relaying.

q_8080.question: What is the difference in PRS resource utilization between FR1 and FR2 in the 20ms PRS periodicity scenario?
q_8080.ground_truth: The PRS resource utilization is 3.21% in FR1 and 51.42% in FR2.

q_8081.question: What is the technology used to reduce the transmission delay in a GERAN network?
q_8081.ground_truth: Reduced TTI radio blocks and a Fast Ack/Nack reporting scheme are used to reduce transmission delay in a GERAN network.

q_8082.question: What is the difference between the "wTInitiatedWTModification" and "eNBInitiatedWTModification" procedures?
q_8082.ground_truth: Both procedures are used to modify wireless network parameters, but the "wTInitiatedWTModification" procedure is initiated by the wireless terminal (wT), while the "eNBInitiatedWTModification" procedure is initiated by the eNB.

q_8083.question: What is the purpose of the ICS as specified in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_8083.ground_truth: The ICS provides the delivery of consistent IMS services to the user regardless of the attached access type, enables IM CN subsystem services when using CS access for the media bearer, and supports the use of CS media bearer for IM CN subsystem sessions.

q_8084.question: What is the CP-UP separation introduced in Rel-17 for the enhancement of robustness?
q_8084.ground_truth: The CP-UP separation introduced in Rel-17 for the enhancement of robustness is a feature that allows an IAB-node, which is dual-connected with an IAB-donor and a gNB, to exchange F1-C via the backhaul with the IAB-donor or the path containing the access link between IAB-node and gNB and the Xn connection between gNB and IAB-donor.

q_8085.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) 32.331, 32.332, and 32.336, as part of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects?
q_8085.ground_truth: These specifications cover Telecommunication management, with TS 32.331 focusing on the requirements for the Notification Log (NL) Integration Reference Point (IRP), TS 32.332 specifying the IS for the NLIRP, and TS 32.336 defining solution sets for the NLIRP.

q_8086.question: What is the version numbering system for revisions of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_8086.ground_truth: The version numbering system for revisions of 3GPP technical specifications consists of three digits x.y.z. The first digit indicates the stage of development of the specification, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance (technical enhancements, corrections, updates), and the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated.

q_8087.question: In which subclause does the procedure for initiating the ETWS primary notification with security message occur?
q_8087.ground_truth: The procedure for initiating the ETWS primary notification with security message occurs in subclause 8.1.17.2.

q_8088.question: What information is shared between the ASP and the MNO as part of the SLA?
q_8088.ground_truth: The SLA between the MNO and the ASP determines the MNO AF for the ASP's UE Application Client to connect to, the information the ASP's UE Application Client shares with the MNO AF, the authentication info for MNO AF and the ASP's UE Application Client, and the data normalization algorithm for the collected data from UEs.

q_8089.question: How does the AMF approach handle UE reported PC5 charging data?
q_8089.ground_truth: The AMF approach passes in a container the info received from the UE as is to the CHF, and the CHF can handle it using data type "string".

q_8090.question: What is the role of the Continuity Check procedure in the MGCF?
q_8090.ground_truth: The Continuity Check procedure is used by the MGCF to request the generation of a continuity check tone on the TDM termination for a connection towards the CS network.

q_8091.question: What is the role of the "offset value" in the paging procedure of 5G networks?
q_8091.ground_truth: The "offset value" is used to calculate the Paging Occasion, which determines when a device is paged for incoming calls or messages. The MME/AMF adds the "offset value" to the value it would have otherwise sent in the UE Identity Index Value field in the S1-AP/NG-AP paging message.

q_8092.question: What information can be stored by the HLR and VLR related to USSD applications?
q_8092.ground_truth: The HLR and VLR can store information for services that are offered by USSD applications.

q_8093.question: What is the main feature of the Location Reporting API in the Edge Enabler Server?
q_8093.ground_truth: The Location Reporting API in the Edge Enabler Server supports tracking or checking the valid location of the UE for the Edge Application Server.

q_8094.question: What is the role of the Umbrella Information Model (UIM) in the FNIM?
q_8094.ground_truth: The UIM provides abstract definitions that are applicable across Domain/Technology-specific Concrete Models to ensure end-to-end consistency of definitions.

q_8095.question: What is the purpose of the application registration procedure?
q_8095.ground_truth: The purpose of the application registration procedure is to allow the MC application to consume MC services delivered over MBMS, identify the MC application registering with the MC MBMS user agent, and notify the MC application asynchronously of relevant events.

q_8096.question: After step j) in the acceptance criteria, what should the UE send to the SAT-NG-SS?
q_8096.ground_truth: The UE should send REGISTRATION COMPLETE during registration to the SAT-NG-SS.

q_8097.question: What type of mode cannot be used when a mobile station has enabled EC operation or PEO?
q_8097.ground_truth: Dual transfer mode cannot be used when a mobile station has enabled EC operation or PEO.

q_8098.question: What happens if call gapping is performed on a call for a particular service and triggering of this service is allowed, but no other gap criteria should be applied to the same service?
q_8098.ground_truth: Active gap criteria with assigned scfID will have higher priority than the others. In case an entry with scfID matching the current call exist, all other criteria without scfID are not evaluated.

q_8099.question: What is the role of the application function (AF) in the edge relocation sequence?
q_8099.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for handling the end-to-end application flows and determining whether a server relocation is necessary. The AF determines if there is a better LDN than the initially selected and initiates server relocation procedures if necessary. The AF also determines when the UE has handed over to a new (R)AN and UPF-PSA and initiates mechanisms to transfer UE context and related data.

q_8100.question: What is the role of the narrowband physical downlink shared channel (NPDSCH) in the NB-IoT system?
q_8100.ground_truth: The NPDSCH is used to transmit downlink data from higher layers to the NB-IoT user equipment (UE). It can be mapped to one or more subframes and transmitted multiple times for improved reliability.

q_8101.question: What is the primary concern of the operator BestCoverage Telecom in relation to DASH content delivery?
q_8101.ground_truth: The operator BestCoverage Telecom is concerned with potential intrusions during DASH content delivery from MyDASH.

q_8102.question: What is the role of the "reference cells" in the 1.28 Mcps TDD solution?
q_8102.ground_truth: The role of the "reference cells" is to initialise their SFN counter and synchronise other cells in the network by being synchronised by an external reference such as a GPS receiver. These cells serve as a reference for the RNC to evaluate the absolute time and synchronise other cells in the network.

q_8103.question: What should the ME operate in, as per the 27.22.4.2.6.5 test requirement?
q_8103.ground_truth: The ME should operate in the manner defined in expected sequences 6.1A to 6.4B.

q_8104.question: How does the DCCF manage the encryption and integrity keys?
q_8104.ground_truth: The DCCF manages the encryption and integrity keys, which are the same for all data consumers of a specific group of data collection and data producer, to establish security for data transfer.

q_8105.question: What should the AS do when receiving 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the initial INVITE request from the terminating UE?
q_8105.ground_truth: The AS should instruct the MRF to stop the media for the CRS service and forward the final response to the originating UE.

q_8106.question: What should the Node B do with the Transport Format Set IE in the case of a unidirectional DCH?
q_8106.ground_truth: If the DCH Specific Info IE includes the Unidirectional DCH Indicator IE set to "Uplink DCH only", the Node B shall ignore the Transport Format Set IE for the downlink for this DCH. Similarly, for "Downlink DCH only", the Node B shall ignore the Transport Format Set IE for the uplink for this DCH.

q_8107.question: What is the purpose of the interpolation step in the decoding process of LSP quantization indices?
q_8107.ground_truth: The interpolation step is used to obtain 4 interpolated LSP vectors from the received indices of LSP quantization. These vectors are then converted to LP filter coefficient domain, which is used for synthesizing the reconstructed speech in each subframe.

q_8108.question: What is the purpose of the UE recognizing the priority order of the User controlled PLMN selector list using an ACT preference in a 3GPP network?
q_8108.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that UEs prioritize network selection based on the user's preferred PLMN list, taking into account the new coding for RATs such as satellite NG-RAN. This helps to optimize the network selection process and improve connectivity for users.

q_8109.question: What does the "Change UCS2 Row" CH Extension Type indicate?
q_8109.ground_truth: The "Change UCS2 Row" CH Extension Type indicates that the initial UCS2 Row value should be overridden by the value specified in the CH Extension Value or subsequent CH octets of this type.

q_8110.question: What does the UE do if there is no match for barring check in access category mapping rules?
q_8110.ground_truth: The UE shall use the access category of the lowest rule number for which there is a match for barring check.

q_8111.question: What is a functional entity embedded in the Online Charging Function (OCF) within the Online Charging System (OCS) that performs online credit control functions?
q_8111.ground_truth: Service Data Flow Based Credit Control Function

q_8112.question: What are the three receiver-assisted channel access schemes that will not be further investigated in Rel-17?
q_8112.ground_truth: Class B1) Intra-operator only, Class B2) Also including inter-operator signaling, Class C) Receiver provides assistance information (signaling) to other NR nodes and nodes from other RAT.

q_8113.question: When can a UE initiate a PDU session establishment procedure for emergency services, even if timer T3585 is running?
q_8113.ground_truth: Always, as the UE is allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure for emergency services, regardless of the status of timer T3585.

q_8114.question: Where can the IRPAgent reside in relation to an NE and EM?
q_8114.ground_truth: The IRPAgent can reside in an Element Manager (EM) or a Network Element (NE). In the former case, the interface between the EM and the NEs is not the subject of the Interface IRPs for SuM NRM IRP.

q_8115.question: Which antenna is identified as the primary antenna for UE containing multiple Tx antennas as per section 6.2.1.1.1.4.1.2?
q_8115.ground_truth: The antenna with better TRP is identified as the primary antenna, and the corresponding TRP result will be used to determine the pass/fail compliance.

q_8116.question: What should the 3GPP management service producer be capable of in terms of EES termination?
q_8116.ground_truth: The 3GPP management service producer should have the capability to send a notification indicating the status of EES termination.

q_8117.question: What is the expected result of the PROACTIVE COMMAND 1.5.1 for the TEST REQUIREMENT 27.22.4.31?
q_8117.ground_truth: General result: Bearer Independent Protocol error (3A), Additional result: Channel identifier not valid (03).

q_8118.question: Which message is sent by either an HNB to a directly Iurh-connected HNB or an HNB to the HNB-GW or the HNB-GW to an HNB to transport a connectionless RNSAP message between the two nodes?
q_8118.ground_truth: CONNECTIONLESS TRANSFER message is sent by either an HNB to a directly Iurh-connected HNB or an HNB to the HNB-GW or the HNB-GW to an HNB to transport a connectionless RNSAP message between the two nodes.

q_8119.question: What should the MAC entity do if it determines if there is an SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB or a CSI-RS with CSI-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdCSI-RS?
q_8119.ground_truth: The MAC entity should use the latest unfiltered L1-RSRP measurement to determine if there is an SSB or CSI-RS with SS-RSRP or CSI-RSRP above the threshold.

q_8120.question: What is the role of NWDAF and NEF in NWDAF assisted UP optimization for EC in Solution #48?
q_8120.ground_truth: NWDAF provides analytics for UE mobility and DN performance, and NEF exposes DN performance analytics to AF for EC optimization.

q_8121.question: What message does an MS send to the GANC when it wants to initiate a handover to a GERAN A/Gb mode cell?

q_8122.question: What is the 3GPP's role in the development of the technical specification for MBMS User Services?
q_8122.ground_truth: The 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project) is the organization that produced the technical specification for MBMS User Services.

q_8123.question: What is the filter used to de-emphasize the signal in the initial step of the process?
q_8123.ground_truth: The filter de-emphasizes the high frequencies and enhances the low frequencies.

q_8124.question: What is the definition of BSSAP-LE in 3GPP?
q_8124.ground_truth: BSSAP-LE is an extension to BSSAP that contains messages and parameters specific to the support of LCS.

q_8125.question: What action does the MS take when it receives a RRLP message that is missing required information elements or component elements?
q_8125.ground_truth: The MS sends a Protocol Error component with indication "Missing Information Element or Component Element".

q_8126.question: What is the U-TDOA method based on?
q_8126.ground_truth: The U-TDOA positioning method is based on network measurements of the Time Of Arrival (TOA) of a known signal sent from the UE and received at four or more LMUs.

q_8127.question: What is the main threat associated with attackers modifying or replaying messages with flight information?
q_8127.ground_truth: The receiving party may be misled about the UAV's actions, potentially leading to a collision between different UAVs.

q_8128.question: How are PoC sessions established in the PoC architecture?
q_8128.ground_truth: There are two mechanisms for PoC session establishment signalling: on-demand sessions and pre-established sessions. An 1-1 PoC session along with PoC group session can be established on-demand or within a pre-established session.

q_8129.question: What is the role of the USS/UTM in the solution for sending the UAS security context after a successful UAA?
q_8129.ground_truth: The USS/UTM sends the UAS security context, along with the UAS ID, Auth Token, and its lifetime, to the UAV after a successful UAA to enable subsequent UAS service authorization.

q_8130.question: What should a BSS (or SGSN) do, upon receipt of an NS-BLOCK-ACK PDU or NS-BLOCK PDU?
q_8130.ground_truth: On receipt of an NS-BLOCK-ACK PDU or NS-BLOCK PDU, the originator of the NS-BLOCK PDU stops timer Tns-block. The NS-VC shall remain blocked until an NS-UNBLOCK PDU is received indicating that the NS-VC's state has been changed.

q_8131.question: What is the role of the Network Header Compressor and Decompressor (N-HCD) in the 3GPP network?
q_8131.ground_truth: The N-HCD is responsible for compressing and decompressing network layer, transport layer or upper layer protocol headers in the 3GPP network. It is located in the RNC and performs header compression for downlink (i.e. N-HC) and header decompression for uplink (i.e. N-HD).

q_8132.question: What action does the UE take when it receives an S-NSSAI not available in the current PLMN?
q_8132.ground_truth: The UE adds the rejected S-NSSAI(s) in the rejected NSSAI for the current PLMN and does not attempt to use this S-NSSAI in the current PLMN until switching off the UE or removing the USIM.

q_8133.question: What information is included in the UL SYNCHRONISATION control frame in the DCH synchronization procedure?
q_8133.ground_truth: The UL SYNCHRONISATION control frame includes the Time of Arrival (ToA) for the DL SYNCHRONISATION control frame and the CFN indicated in the received DL SYNCHRONISATION control frame.

q_8134.question: What should the GANC do when it receives a request from the upper layers to transfer a non-access stratum message?
q_8134.ground_truth: The GANC should include the contents of the upper layer message in the IE "L3 Message" and initiate the Downlink Direct Transfer procedure to transfer the message to the MS.

q_8135.question: What is started in the first symbol after the end of the first repetition of a PUSCH transmission for a corresponding HARQ process?

q_8136.question: What operation is used to compare the threshold in quiet with the actual threshold to avoid pre-echos?
q_8136.ground_truth: A maximum operation is used to compare the threshold in quiet with the actual threshold.

q_8137.question: What is the identifier used by the Relay UE to ensure the correct Remote UE is identified when they have different N ID of their serving PLMN?
q_8137.ground_truth: The Relay UE uses the Remote UE's identifier, which can be SUCI or 5G-GUTI, to identify the correct Remote UE.

q_8138.question: What information must the new BSS include in the handover message if it supports DTM and network sharing and the MS also supports it?
q_8138.ground_truth: The PLMN Index corresponding to the PLMN received in the Cell Identifier (Target) IE in the HANDOVER REQUEST message.

q_8139.question: What type of AVP is the Node-Functionality AVP, and what information does it include?
q_8139.ground_truth: The Node-Functionality AVP is of type Enumerated and includes the functionality identifier of the node, which can be one of 19 different node identifiers.

q_8140.question: What is used to identify all charging records produced in SGSN(s) and the GGSN for a PDP context?

q_8141.question: What is the error procedure used to indicate that the cancellation of a specific CAP operation was not successful by the gsmSRF?
q_8141.ground_truth: The error procedure "CancelFailed" is used to indicate that the cancellation of a specific CAP operation was not successful by the gsmSRF.

q_8142.question: What is the purpose of the Lifecycle management of EASDF in the management aspect of 5GC for supporting Edge Computing?
q_8142.ground_truth: The Lifecycle management of EASDF is responsible for managing the instantiation, termination, scaling, and other aspects of the Edge Application Server Discovery Function (EASDF) in the 5G Core Network (5GC) for supporting Edge Computing.

q_8143.question: What is the process for splitting E2E QoS parameters in UE-to-UE relay?
q_8143.ground_truth: In UE-to-UE relay, the E2E QoS parameters for the connection are split into two parts, one for the PC5 interface between the source UE and the UE-to-UE relay, and the other part for the interface between the UE-to-UE relay and the target UE.

q_8144.question: What records are produced for each event of IMEI check?
q_8144.ground_truth: An observed IMEI ticket is generated whenever tracklisted, blocklisted or non-allow listed mobile equipment is detected during an IMEI check. The ticket includes information describing when and where the equipment was used, and the call reference, if the ticket was triggered by a call attempt.

q_8145.question: What is the maximum time specified for the UE to shut its transmitter off after point B for the continuous transmission test case?
q_8145.ground_truth: The UE is required to shut its transmitter off before point C, which is Toff = 200 ms after point B for the continuous transmission test case.

q_8146.question: What is the difference between a resource focused view and a service impact focused view in the context of managed alarms?
q_8146.ground_truth: A resource focused view, as carried by the NEs, is centered around the resources and their status. In contrast, a service impact focused view, as transformed within the NM domain, considers the impact of the network condition on the overall network service.

q_8147.question: Which reference point (6a.9.1) is between the 3GPP AAA server and the HLR up to and including Rel-4 and the HSS in Rel-5?
q_8147.ground_truth: The D'/Gr' reference point is between the 3GPP AAA server and the HLR up to and including Rel-4 and the HSS in Rel-5. The functionality of this reference point is similar to that of the Wx reference point.

q_8148.question: What is the action taken when the information has been acknowledged by the MS?

q_8149.question: How does NWDAF determine slice service experience and slice load information in solution #2?
q_8149.ground_truth: NWDAF performs input data collection for slice service experience and slice load analytics in solution #2. Based on the overall input data collection information, NWDAF determines the slice service experience and slice load statistics and predictions and provides the output to the service consumer like NSSF or AMF.

q_8150.question: What is the technique used for reducing initial latency during stream switching in eMBMS?
q_8150.ground_truth: The technique used for reducing initial latency during stream switching in eMBMS is to retrieve the base data of the requested TV stream from the buffered preview data and decode low quality video instantly, while receiving the enhancement data stream in the background.

q_8151.question: What should the UE do after changing the source Layer-2 ID and/or source IP address?
q_8151.ground_truth: The UE should provide an indication to upper layers that the source Layer-2 ID and/or the source IP address are changed.

q_8152.question: What is the main difference between the end-to-end operation of MNO-provided Live Uplink Streaming service and the one with downlink distribution handled by a 3rd party?
q_8152.ground_truth: The main difference is that in the case of MNO-provided service, all network entities belong to the mobile operator, while in the 3rd party-provided service, some of the network entities belong to the 3rd-party LUS service provider. Additionally, in the 3rd party-provided service, UEs associated with viewers belong to both the 3rd-party provider and the mobile operator.

q_8153.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 36.301, what does the acronym "A-GANSS" stand for?

q_8154.question: Which types of protocols should be supported by MExE UE applications to provide wireless access to Internet and Intranet services?
q_8154.ground_truth: A primary goal of MExE is to provide access to Internet and Intranet services. Standard Internet applications, security, and transport protocols are one possible set of MExE protocols which can be supported. Additionally, a set of application, security, and transport protocols optimized for wireless access, and compliant to MExE requirements, shall be specified and form part of the MExE standards.

q_8155.question: What is the requirement for interfering signals in the test of a multi-carrier BS of equal or different E-UTRA channel bandwidths?
q_8155.ground_truth: There are no requirements for interfering signals between the wanted carriers in such cases.

q_8156.question: What type of error occurs when the receiver is unable to decode the received physical message due to issues with the transfer syntax?

q_8157.question: How are the starting symbol and allocation length of PUSCH determined for a CSI report on PUSCH by a CSI request field on a DCI?
q_8157.ground_truth: The starting symbol S and the allocation length L for PUSCH is determined based on the start and length indicator SLIV of the indexed row.

q_8158.question: How much MSD is needed in the n3 FDD band if the noise level is increased by 1.5dB in the Rx band due to RFIC/PA operation?
q_8158.ground_truth: A 0.7 dB MSD is needed in the n3 FDD band if the noise level is increased by 1.5dB in the Rx band due to RFIC/PA operation.

q_8159.question: In what scenarios is a re-INVITE not necessarily required when the answering terminal is a non-MMCMH MTSI terminal?
q_8159.ground_truth: A re-INVITE is not necessarily required when the answering terminal is a non-MMCMH MTSI terminal because it will not select more than one codec type per media, i.e., it will ignore the simulcast parameter and not select to send on multiple media lines. Therefore, a re-INVITE is only needed if the answerer has selected to encode or decode a codec that is not a common codec for an MRF-based conference and the MRF that sent the offer is unable to transcode between the selected codec and different codecs used by other participants.

q_8160.question: What is the mandatory mobility related requirement that an EC-GSM-IoT mobile station need not comply with?

q_8161.question: What action is taken by the UE and eNB when cryptographic protection is established for radio bearers?
q_8161.ground_truth: The UE generates RRC protection keys and UP protection keys, and the eNB sends an AS SMC to the UE to take the new NAS keys into use.

q_8162.question: What is the length of the Transport Layer Address signalled in F1AP messages?
q_8162.ground_truth: The Transport Layer Address can be a 32-bit string for an IPv4 address, a 128-bit string for an IPv6 address, or a 160-bit string for both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, with the IPv4 address contained in the first 32 bits.

q_8163.question: What is the definition of "Iuant interface" in the context of the "UTRAN Iuant interface: General aspects and principles (Release 17)" technical specification?
q_8163.ground_truth: The "Iuant interface" in the "UTRAN Iuant interface: General aspects and principles (Release 17)" technical specification refers to the interface between the UTRAN and the NA-NET between the RNC and the 3G-SGSN.

q_8164.question: What does the mobile station do if it receives a HANDOVER COMMAND message instructing it to use a frequency it is not capable of, in either the handover to UTRAN or handover to CDMA2000 procedure?
q_8164.ground_truth: The mobile station stays on the current channel(s) and returns a HANDOVER FAILURE message with cause "frequency not implemented".

q_8165.question: What is the numerical value for the ProtocolIE-ID "id-GSM-Cell-CM-Rqst"?

q_8166.question: Which choice needs RRC-TransactionIdentifier in CounterCheck?

q_8167.question: What is the purpose of the ActualTime AVP in the Diameter Rating application?
q_8167.ground_truth: The ActualTime AVP contains the actual timestamp of the current rating request message.
