q_9423.question: In what state is the UE in before starting the test procedure described in section 9.1.11.2.3.2?
q_9423.ground_truth: The UE is in the state Switched OFF (state 0-A) before starting the test procedure.

q_9424.question: What should the SCC AS do when it becomes aware that the remote precondition is fulfilled on both legs, towards the remote UE and the CS domain?
q_9424.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall send a SIP UPDATE request to the ICS UE indicating that the precondition is met.

q_9425.question: What is one of the storage requirements for IMS Messaging sessions?
q_9425.ground_truth: A participant in an IMS Messaging session can request to persistently store a sent message or all messages associated with a session in a network-based repository, if the IMS service provider provides such a service.

q_9426.question: What should the data link layer entity in the MS do when it receives the PH-READY-TO-SEND primitive from the physical layer after setting timer T200?
q_9426.ground_truth: The data link layer entity in the MS should set timer T200 right before transmitting a frame when the PH-READY-TO-SEND primitive is received from the physical layer.

q_9427.question: What tools are used for content rate adaptation and what are the main categories?
q_9427.ground_truth: Tools for content rate adaptation include bitstream switching and bitstream thinning, which fall into two main categories: bitstream switching and bitstream thinning (with the possibility of combining the two).

q_9428.question: What is the mandatory requirement for a normative provision in the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_9428.ground_truth: The terms "shall" and "shall not" are used to indicate a mandatory requirement for a normative provision in the 3GPP technical specifications.

q_9429.question: What is the effect of MBMS reception on the mobility between intra-frequency cells?
q_9429.ground_truth: The mobility between intra-frequency cells is not affected by MBMS reception.

q_9430.question: What action does the MB-SMF take if the Interest TMGIs are received and default QoS is not used?
q_9430.ground_truth: The MB-SMF interacts with PCF to get the MB QoS parameters with packet filters information corresponding to the Interest TMGIs.

q_9431.question: What restrictions apply to sending uplink user data packets via 3GPP access when the 3GPP PS data off UE status is "activated"?
q_9431.ground_truth: There are several restrictions on sending uplink user data packets via 3GPP access when the 3GPP PS data off UE status is activated including for certain services and procedures.

q_9432.question: What is the function of the MG-CSI in the cellular network?
q_9432.ground_truth: The MG-CSI indicates which Mobility Management for GPRS events shall be reported to the gsmSCF and it consists of the gsmSCF address, Service Key, and Mobility Management Triggers.

q_9433.question: Under what circumstances will the PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) take control over actions resulting from application detection in the PCEF?
q_9433.ground_truth: The PCRF will take control over actions resulting from application detection in the PCEF when the TDF provides the service data flow description for the detected applications to the PCRF.

q_9434.question: What is the objective of the 3GPP Technical Report on IMS messaging?
q_9434.ground_truth: The objective is to describe use cases for IMS messaging, derive 3GPP requirements for IMS messaging services, investigate interworking with networks outside the 3GPP domain, analyze possible interactions between IMS messaging services and existing 3GPP messaging services, and identify potential routes to standardization.

q_9435.question: What is the name of the function used in uplink to align the uplink radio signals from the UE to the UTRAN?

q_9436.question: What is the purpose of sending an initial request in a Diameter session on the St reference point?
q_9436.ground_truth: An initial request is used to initiate a Diameter session and contains information that is relevant to initiation.

q_9437.question: What is the relationship between the number of devices that need to be updated and the minimum number C of UEs that have joined/left/been compromised?
q_9437.ground_truth: As C increases, the number of devices that need to be updated also increases

q_9438.question: What is the mode of operation recommended by V.120 for data transfer?
q_9438.ground_truth: V.120 recommends the use of the multiple frame acknowledged information transfer procedure for data transfer.

q_9439.question: What should a data link layer entity do when timer T200 expires for N200 times?
q_9439.ground_truth: The data link layer entity shall indicate this by means of the primitive MDL-ERROR-INDICATION with cause "timer T200 expired N200 + 1 times: perform abnormal release" to layer~3. The data link layer remains in the timer recovery state until further actions are taken by layer~3.

q_9440.question: What protocol specifications is the ACDC MO compatible with?
q_9440.ground_truth: The ACDC MO is compatible with the OMA Device Management (DM) protocol specifications, version 1.2 and upwards.

q_9441.question: What is the maximum value of the IPOffset field in the IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard?
q_9441.ground_truth: The maximum value of the IPOffset field in the IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard is 9.

q_9442.question: What should the CTS-MS do when it receives a message with conditional IE errors?
q_9442.ground_truth: If the CTS-MS diagnoses a "missing conditional IE," "unexpected conditional IE," or receives a message with at least one syntactically incorrect conditional IE, it should return a status message with cause #100 if an RR connection exists.

q_9443.question: Which conformance clause of TS 31.111 is the ME required to support for the Proactive UICC: Send SS facility as per the conformance requirement in section 27.22.4.11.4.9.2?
q_9443.ground_truth: TS 31.111 clause 6.1, clause 6.4.11, clause 6.6.10, clause 8.12.1, clause 5.2, clause 8.6, clause 8.7, clause 8.2, clause 8.14, clause 8.31 and clause 6.5

q_9444.question: What is the role of AWGN (Additive White Gaussian Noise) in the multiple probe antenna based method for MIMO radiated test?
q_9444.ground_truth: AWGN is applied to each probe antenna with equal power to approximate spatial AWGN in the multiple probe antenna based methods. It can be superimposed on the probe antennas for signal generation or can be on independent probe antennas. At least 3 probe antennas are needed for a good approximation of spatial AWGN.

q_9445.question: What modification is made to the TCAP Component portion defined in ITU-T Recommendation Q.773 for use in this protocol, LLP?
q_9445.ground_truth: In this protocol, LLP, the TCAP Component portion has been modified by adding an 'invokeNotLast' component. This change impacts the coding of the Component type and thus the coding of the LLP messages.

q_9446.question: What are the services and functions that are applicable to the UL/DL DCCH logical channel in terms of RLC services?
q_9446.ground_truth: The services and functions that are applicable to the UL/DL DCCH logical channel are concatenation, padding, transfer of user data, error correction, in-sequence delivery of upper layer PDUs, duplicate detection, flow control, protocol error detection and recovery, ciphering, maintenance of QoS as defined by upper layers, notification of unrecoverable errors, mapping of services/functions onto logical channels, and data transfer.

q_9447.question: What is the purpose of the FACH Capacity Request procedure?
q_9447.ground_truth: The FACH Capacity Request procedure allows the SRNC to notify the DRNC about the user buffer size for a given priority level. It may be sent if no FACH FLOW CONTROL frame has been received within an appropriate time threshold, or to signal an event such as data arrival or user buffer discard.

q_9448.question: What action should the ng-eNB-DU take if the SCG Indicator IE is included in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message and set to "released"?
q_9448.ground_truth: The ng-eNB-DU should consider the SCG is removed if applicable.

q_9449.question: When switching from primary modes to AMR-WB IO mode, what is done with the CELP AMR-WB IO encoded frame memories if the AMR-WB IO frame is preceded by a CELP primary frame at 16 kHz internal sampling rate?
q_9449.ground_truth: The processing described in subclause 5.4.4 is performed, which may involve resampling with the method described in subclause 5.4.4.4 or resetting the adaptive codebook with zeros.

q_9450.question: What is the maximum frame length in RLP that may cause throughput restriction in the 64 kbit/s mode?
q_9450.ground_truth: The maximum frame length of 572bits in RLP may cause throughput restriction in the 64 kbit/s mode.

q_9451.question: What is the recommended form of dynamic notification mechanism to initiate DASH service interactivity?
q_9451.ground_truth: DASH Events, as defined in the MPEG DASH standard, could serve as an appropriate form of dynamic notification mechanism to initiate the execution of service application logic pertaining to service interactivity.

q_9452.question: What action shall an SDP answerer take if the precondition for including the SDP msrp-cema attribute is fulfilled?
q_9452.ground_truth: The SDP answerer shall include an SDP msrp-cema attribute, supported MIME types, an SDP path attribute (with specific requirements), and an SDP setup attribute in the SDP media description for an MSRP session.

q_9453.question: Which speech codecs are fully compatible with TFO for non-AMR types in GSM systems?
q_9453.ground_truth: The speech codecs that are fully compatible with TFO for non-AMR types in GSM systems are GSM_FR, GSM_HR, and GSM_EFR. These codecs are supported by the Transcoder Units and have a small additional processing complexity compared to the encoding/decoding functions.

q_9454.question: What information does the "serviceClass" parameter in the e Media Streaming Services provide?
q_9454.ground_truth: The "serviceClass" parameter identifies the service class which is associated with the service.

q_9455.question: What information is included in measResultLastServCell in VarRLF-Report?
q_9455.ground_truth: measResultLastServCell in VarRLF-Report includes the cell level RSRP, RSRQ, and available SINR of the last serving cell.

q_9456.question: What is the problem with tracking ad consumption in DASH?
q_9456.ground_truth: The problem with tracking ad consumption in DASH is that the standard DASH client only supports tracking by server-side tracking of HTTP requests, which does not allow for real-time viewing tracking or skipping rules.

q_9457.question: What is the length of a hyperframe in GSM?
q_9457.ground_truth: A hyperframe in GSM has a length of 3 hours, 28 minutes, 53 seconds, and 760 milliseconds.

q_9458.question: What is the role of the IMS in supporting telepresence?
q_9458.ground_truth: The IMS is an architectural framework for provision of IP multimedia services and is capable of delivering various service functionalities and easing integration with new kinds of application, such as telepresence. The IMS uses the IETF defined session control mechanism with the inherited capability to negotiate multiple multimedia streams in one single session, which is applied as a basis for supporting telepresence in IMS. This always involves producing and rendering various media streams with high qualities among the involved parties, even in the point to point case.

q_9459.question: What should the UE do upon termination of CS services when all PDN connections have been handed over to WLAN?
q_9459.ground_truth: The UE should perform an attach with handover indication when returning to E-UTRAN.

q_9460.question: What actions does the PGW-C+SMF take after successfully transferring the PDU Session(s) to EPS?
q_9460.ground_truth: The PGW-C+SMF initiates the release of the PDU Session(s) in 5GS transferred to EPS while not releasing the IP address/prefix(es) allocated for the PDU Session.

q_9461.question: What should the gsmSSF do if any relationship exists between the gsmSSF and the gsmSCF when an exception condition occurs?
q_9461.ground_truth: The gsmSSF should send an error information flow to close the relationships and indicate that any outstanding call handling instructions will not run to completion.

q_9462.question: What is the role of the Sh interface in the present document?
q_9462.ground_truth: The Sh interface is the point of interaction between an AS and the HSS or between an SCS and the HSS in the IM CN subsystem.

q_9463.question: What message does the S-GW send to the P-GW when it receives a Modify Bearer Request message without the additional information of HeNB Local IP address and the UDP port if NAT/NAPT is detected?
q_9463.ground_truth: The S-GW determines that the UE has left the femto cell and informs this event to the PCRF.

q_9464.question: What action should the MAC entity take if the next available PRACH occasion corresponds to the selected CSI-RS and the possible occurrence of measurement gaps is taken into account?
q_9464.ground_truth: The MAC entity should determine the next available PRACH occasion, taking into account the possible occurrence of measurement gaps when making this determination.

q_9465.question: What should the receiver do if the compressed reported bitmap covers more blocks than the uncompressed reported bitmap?
q_9465.ground_truth: The receiver should send the compressed reported bitmap if it covers more blocks than the uncompressed reported bitmap.

q_9466.question: When is the frame layout for codec mode 7,40 kBit/s used?
q_9466.ground_truth: The frame layout for codec mode 7,40 kBit/s is used when the Codec Mode Indication is defined to be 7,40 kBit/s, regardless of the phase of the RIF bit.

q_9467.question: When is the time information transferred from serving PLMN to MS in NITZ feature?
q_9467.ground_truth: The time information can be transferred from serving PLMN to MS upon registering on the network, when the MS geographically relocates to a different Local Time Zone, when the PLMN changes its Local Time Zone, when the PLMN changes its identity, and at any time during a signalling connection with mobile station.

q_9468.question: What is the difference between the first and second RTTI block in the 20 ms time unit for detecting the legacy stealing flags?
q_9468.ground_truth: In the first RTTI block, the MS can only discriminate between '0,0,0,0' and '1,1,1,0' for MCS5&6 and MCS7,8&9 respectively, while in the second RTTI block, the MS can discriminate between '0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0' and '1,1,1,0,0,0,0,1) for MCS5&6 and MCS7,8&9 respectively.

q_9469.question: What is one of the main challenges in the coexistence of automated train control with other train applications?
q_9469.ground_truth: One of the main challenges is to guarantee the premium priority of control-related communication over other types of communication, especially since the data bandwidth consumed for control is typically dwarfed by data traffic stemming from the other two application areas.

q_9470.question: What is a potential requirement for supporting multi-connectivity legs across independent networks?
q_9470.ground_truth: The potential new requirement is to expand the existing capability of coordinating multi-connectivity legs connected to the same network to support multi-connectivity legs across independent networks.

q_9471.question: What should a UE compliant with this specification do when the mimeType attribute of the r12:appService element is not supported?
q_9471.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the r12:appService element and its child elements if the mimeType attribute indicates a value not supported by the UE.

q_9472.question: What is the classification of system data elements based on the frequency of modification?
q_9472.ground_truth: The system data elements can be classified based on the frequency of modification as: modified once or twice during the life time of the system, modified required seldom, and modified is expected frequently and/or for a short term.

q_9473.question: In uplink rate matching, what action does the rate matching take if there are no input bits for all TrCHs within a CCTrCH in a radio frame?
q_9473.ground_truth: In this case, the rate matching outputs no bits for all TrCHs within the CCTrCH and no uplink DPDCH will be selected.

q_9474.question: What is the principle used in defining the IRPs to accommodate more than one specific technology?
q_9474.ground_truth: The principle used in defining the IRPs to accommodate more than one specific technology is to clearly separate the semantics of information definition from the protocol definitions (accessing the information) for external interfaces.

q_9475.question: What is the case where the GANC may have insufficient information to correctly route subsequent emergency calls?
q_9475.ground_truth: When the MS initiates the Discovery/Registration procedures and no GERAN/UTRAN coverage is available.

q_9476.question: In which scenario does the local NRF perform an ENUM query to select the target PLMN when the MSISDN belongs to a different PLMN?

q_9477.question: In the evaluation of UEP method against single layer H.264/AVC, what was the video file size for H.264/AVC and SVC?
q_9477.ground_truth: Due to slightly high coding overhead of SVC, the file size of SVC becomes 7% ~ 15% larger than H.264/AVC file. Foreman QCIF and CIF sequences are encoded with the JSVM 13.1. The bitrate of H.264/AVC stream is 398kbps, while those of SVC base layer and enhancement layer are 48kbps and 383kbps, respectively if PSNR is set to be identical. Bitrate of SVC in total is 431kbps, which is 8% more than that of H.264/AVC.

q_9478.question: What should the UE do if the maximum number of consecutive DTX is reached during HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection on PSFCH reception occasion?
q_9478.ground_truth: The UE should increment numConsecutiveDTX, if numConsecutiveDTX reaches sl-maxNumConsecutiveDTX, it should indicate the HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection to RRC.

q_9479.question: What is the difference between the first scenario and the "true" multi-lateral CA scenario in terms of the roaming consortium's management?
q_9479.ground_truth: In the first scenario, the management of the roaming consortium is very easy because the consortium itself doesn't need to be a legal entity/identity. However, dynamicity in the first scenario might require member CCNs to re-compose if they lose connectivity with a member CCN on which they rely for the consortium membership. On the other hand, in the "true" multi-lateral CA scenario, the roaming consortium is created as a true multi-lateral CA, and the management of the roaming consortium relies on the communication between the collaborating CCNs.

q_9480.question: What is the role of the HNB-GW in handling enhanced relocation and soft handover between RNC and HNB?
q_9480.ground_truth: The HNB-GW handles the routing of incoming enhanced relocation signalling from the Source HNB to the appropriate Target RNC, and from the Source RNC to the appropriate target HNB using the target cell identity provided in RNSAP: ENHANCED RELOCATION REQUEST.

q_9481.question: What is the purpose of producing partial records in the case of radio link failure and call re-establishment?
q_9481.ground_truth: The purpose is to record the duration of the call prior to the radio link failure and the subsequent duration of the call once the call has been re-established.

q_9482.question: What is the difference between the RL-Set-InformationItemIE-RL-FailureInd and RL-InformationItemIE-RL-FailureInd sequences within the NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_9482.ground_truth: The RL-Set-InformationItemIE-RL-FailureInd sequence is a part of the RL-Set-InformationList-RL-FailureInd sequence, and the RL-InformationItemIE-RL-FailureInd sequence is a part of the RL-InformationList-RL-FailureInd sequence.

q_9483.question: What should the RNC2/BSS2 include in the COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message if the Report Characteristics IE is set to "On Demand"?
q_9483.ground_truth: The COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message should contain the measurement result.

q_9484.question: What is the threshold condition evaluation if both ThreshChUtilWLANLowANDSF and ThreshChUtilWLANLowRAN nodes are present?
q_9484.ground_truth: ThreshChUtilWLANLowRAN node will take precedence over ThreshChUtilWLANLowANDSF node, i.e. the ThreshChUtilWLANLowRAN node is evaluated to be matching, the UE shall consider this node as matching.

q_9485.question: What action does the AMF take if the network slice quota has been reached for a requested S-NSSAI?
q_9485.ground_truth: If the network slice quota has been reached for a requested S-NSSAI, the AMF considers this requested V-PLMN S-NSSAI as a Rejected S-NSSAI and sends this Rejected S-NSSAI along with the rejection cause indicating that the network slice quota has been reached in the response to the UE. The AMF may also include a back-off timer for this Rejected S-NSSAI.

q_9486.question: What is the name of the counter for the number of failed CAMEL dialogues, error, or reject from gsmSCF, including all three measurement types?

q_9487.question: What should the media lines in the session be set to for media components that are terminated on the controllee UE and are not to be changed in a SIP REFER request to hold or resume a media component on a controllee UE?
q_9487.ground_truth: Media lines for those media components that are terminated on the controllee UE and are not to be changed with their current directionality and the current port number from the remote end.

q_9488.question: What action does the UE take when it receives an invalid UE CAPABILITY ENQUIRY message?
q_9488.ground_truth: The UE transmits an RRC STATUS message on the uplink DCCH using AM RLC, including information about the rejected message and transaction identifier.

q_9489.question: What is the expected action when the UE is switched on in the UE network selection mode?
q_9489.ground_truth: When the UE is switched on in the UE network selection mode, the UE selects the highest priority OPLMN and RAT combination and attempts to register on the selected cell and PLMN.

q_9490.question: How does the UE use the selected UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry during the initiation of the procedure?
q_9490.ground_truth: The UE uses the selected UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry irrespective of the uac-BarringForCommon included in SIB1 for the remainder of the procedure.

q_9491.question: What is the unit for the "PDCP SDU Data Volume" measurement in 4G E-UTRAN?
q_9491.ground_truth: The "PDCP SDU Data Volume" measurement is expressed in units of Mbit, which represents the Data Volume (amount of PDCP SDU bits) in the downlink delivered from the PDCP layer to the RLC layer per PLMN ID and per E-RAB QoS profile (QCI, ARP, and GBR).

q_9492.question: What information about the location of the UE does the Edge Enabler Server consider upon receiving a request from the Edge Application Server?
q_9492.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server considers the location granularity parameter, such as GPS Coordinates, Cell ID, Tracking Area ID, or civic addresses, requested from the Edge Application Server for retrieving the location of the UE from the 3GPP system.

q_9493.question: What is the expected sequence 2.3 in the described interface?
q_9493.ground_truth: The expected sequence 2.3 is to open a channel with alpha identifier.

q_9494.question: What is the purpose of the "ccm pause" in SDP in the context of negotiating pause/resume functionality?
q_9494.ground_truth: The "ccm pause" in SDP indicates that RTCP pause/resume signalling can be used for the streams related to the affected m-line.

q_9495.question: What is the impact of successful registration with a serving GANC on the stored PLMN list in the MS?
q_9495.ground_truth: Following successful registration with a serving GANC, the MS does not store the PLMN list and is not allowed to use it for background scanning.

q_9496.question: What should the UE do when it is transmitting a V2X communication on the frequency associated with the service and moves out of the geographical area?
q_9496.ground_truth: The UE cannot continue the V2X communication on the frequency associated with the service.

q_9497.question: How is the number of TFCI coded bits calculated for different TFC sizes?
q_9497.ground_truth: The number of TFCI coded bits varies depending on the TFC size, with 1 bit TFCI encoded to 8 bits, 2 bits TFCI encoded to 16 bits, 3 bits TFCI encoded to 24 bits, 4 bits TFCI encoded to 28 bits, and 5 bits TFCI encoded to 36 bits for GMSK full rate and 8PSK half rate channels. For 8PSK full rate channels, the coding is obtained by repetition of the coding defined for GMSK full rate channels. For GMSK half rate channels, the coding is obtained by using only the middle segment of the coding defined for GMSK full rate channels.

q_9498.question: What is required for proper access control between management functions/entities in the same management domain of the 3GPP management system?
q_9498.ground_truth: Access control, including identification, authentication, authorization and auditing, on a management function/entity of the same management domain is required to protect MnSs and corresponding managed resources from unauthorized reading and writing.

q_9499.question: In Network-initiated NBIFOM mode, what does the PCRF do when it receives a request to apply specific mappings of IP flows to an access?
q_9499.ground_truth: The PCRF determines and updates the impacted PCC rule, and sends the updated PCC rule to the PCEF, which triggers the sending of a Routing Rules creation / modification / deletion to the UE.

q_9500.question: What happens if the interconnection network is SIP-unaware or IC-A1 is only a SIP proxy?
q_9500.ground_truth: If the interconnection network is SIP-unaware, or if IC-A1 is only a SIP proxy, IC-A1 is not in the media path.

q_9501.question: What type is the Target-App-Layer-User-Id AVP and what does it contain?
q_9501.ground_truth: The Target-App-Layer-User-Id AVP is of type UTF8String and it contains an identity identifying a target user within the context of a specific application.

q_9502.question: In GSC mode of subclause 6.1.1.2.5, what is decoded first to obtain the number of subframes?
q_9502.ground_truth: The attack flag is decoded first in GSC mode to obtain the number of subframes.

q_9503.question: What is the measurement that provides the call traffic of a given Observed Destination, where the Observed Destination is a calling number, obtained by accumulating the time intervals between the call start and the call end over a granularity period?

q_9504.question: When an EC-GSM-IoT device is in packet idle mode, what does it do to the PBCCH, paging sub-channel, PCCCH, and BCCH?
q_9504.ground_truth: The device listens to the PBCCH and paging sub-channel for the paging group it belongs to in idle mode, and to the BCCH and relevant paging sub-channels if PCCCH is not present in the cell.

q_9505.question: How is X2 UP protocol data conveyed over the X2 interface?
q_9505.ground_truth: X2 UP protocol data is conveyed by GTP-U protocol means, specifically, by means of the "RAN Container" GTP-U extension header.

q_9506.question: How does a UE apply the HOLD service for individual media streams?
q_9506.ground_truth: A UE can hold or resume the media stream by changing the SDP attribute in the SDP offer, such as "inactive" or "sendonly" for hold, and "recvonly" or "sendrecv" for resume. If all media streams are to be held or resumed, a session level direction attribute can be used. If the directionality of media streams is changed, the UE shall send the generated SDP offer in a re-INVITE or UPDATE request to the remote UE.

q_9507.question: What is the purpose of the uplink bias asymmetry in a wireless communication system?
q_9507.ground_truth: The purpose of uplink bias asymmetry is to improve network performance by assigning more resources to the uplink compared to the downlink.

q_9508.question: What is the role of the RAN node in the delivery method switching using PDU session modification procedures?
q_9508.ground_truth: The RAN node supports handling multicast session information in UE AS context and determines if there are multiple PDU Sessions corresponding to the same TMGI to initiate delivery method switching from individual to shared.

q_9509.question: What is the implication of a node in Release 4 being backward compatible with a Release 99 or an earlier node as per 3GPP TS 23.205?
q_9509.ground_truth: A Release 4 node, or a later release, is capable of working with a Release 99 node, or an earlier release, which means that the newer release of the network can interact with the older release without any issues.

q_9510.question: What is the procedure for testing the initial conditions of the "SEND DTMF" test requirement 27.22.4.24.4.2.1 in the DTMF protocol?
q_9510.ground_truth: The ME is connected to the USIM Simulator, the elementary files are coded as USIM Application Toolkit default, and prior to this test, the ME shall have been powered on, performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure and be in updated idle mode on the USS.

q_9511.question: What is the subject of the technical specification provided by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_9511.ground_truth: The technical specification outlines the performance measurements for Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) as part of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects in the telecommunication management sector.

q_9512.question: What is the transport protocol used for end-to-end protection of media sessions using TLS and KMS?
q_9512.ground_truth: The transport protocol used for end-to-end protection of media sessions using TLS and KMS is TLS.

q_9513.question: What method can HeNB use to obtain frequency partition information of a nearby Macro eNB?
q_9513.ground_truth: HeNB can get frequency partition information of its neighbor Macro eNB through air link measurement if an additional receiver is enabled on HeNB.

q_9514.question: What does the MonitoringPolicy node act as a placeholder for in the ProSe Public Safety Direct Services Provisioning MO parameters?
q_9514.ground_truth: The MonitoringPolicy node acts as a placeholder for open ProSe direct discovery monitoring authorisation policy for non-public safety use.

q_9515.question: When must a UE not delay reading of MCCH until the next modification period when acquiring the MBMS ACCESS INFORMATION message for cells not operating in MBSFN mode?
q_9515.ground_truth: The UE must not delay reading of MCCH until the next modification period if the procedure that the UE would apply to respond to counting is ongoing (Idle mode: RRC connection establishment, connected mode: Cell update).

q_9516.question: In the context of M3AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE, what is the difference between "InitiatingMessage" and "value"?
q_9516.ground_truth: "InitiatingMessage" represents the message that initiates a procedure, while "value" represents the actual data content of the message, which contains the payload of the procedure.

q_9517.question: What is the procedure for handling the serving system report event at the HLR?
q_9517.ground_truth: The Serving System report event is generated at the HLR, when the HLR has detected that the target has roamed. The report elements will be delivered to the DF2 if available.

q_9518.question: What should be the TP-MTI (message type indicator) value of the SMS TPDU in SMS-PP (Data Download) Message 1.2.1 and 1.3.1 of the test procedure?

q_9519.question: How does the receiver determine if a message is discarded or not?
q_9519.ground_truth: After removal of any stuffing octets, the receiver can check the BCS by adding all of the octets in the message content and the 16-bit BCS modulo 65536. The correct result is 0000 hex. If any message is received with an incorrect BCS, then the message is discarded.

q_9520.question: What is the function of the Re-ordering Queue Identity parameter in MAC-hs headers?
q_9520.ground_truth: The Re-ordering Queue Identity parameter in MAC-hs headers is used to identify the re-ordering buffer destination of a MAC-hs PDU.

q_9521.question: What is the impact of inconsistent security context usage by the Target AMF in the indirect case of AMF re-allocation?
q_9521.ground_truth: Inconsistent security context usage by the Target AMF can result in registration failure and service failure, as the UE will reject the NAS message from the Target AMF due to a potential lack of access to the UE security context or due to inconsistent security context used by the Target AMF.

q_9522.question: In the low-frequency pitch enhancement, what type of filter is used to post-process the decoded signal in the lower branch?
q_9522.ground_truth: An adaptive pitch enhancer is used to post-process the decoded signal in the lower branch in the two-band pitch enhancer.

q_9523.question: When can DTMF tone generation occur?
q_9523.ground_truth: DTMF Tone Generation shall only occur if the RTP Telephony Event has not been negotiated and the default PCM codec is selected for the user plane.

q_9524.question: What must the AMF/MME do upon identifying a UAV UE during the registration/attach procedure?
q_9524.ground_truth: The AMF/MME must notify the relevant Remote ID USS about the presence of a UAV UE along with the CAA Level UAV Id and the UAV UE's GPSI.

q_9525.question: What information is included in the 183 (Session Progress) response received by UE-A?
q_9525.ground_truth: The 183 (Session Progress) response includes an answer to the SDP received in the INVITE request, a P-Early-Media header field set to "sendonly" if only announcement will be played, and the Require header field set to "100rel".

q_9526.question: What happens if barring of incoming calls when roaming outside the home PLMN country (BIC-Roam) is activated and a CCBS call is not permitted for a specific Basic Service Group?
q_9526.ground_truth: HLR~B will cancel the associated request related to the Basic Service Group and select the next non-suspended request in the queue for processing for other Basic Service Groups.

q_9527.question: When should the IWF include the warning text set to "149 SIP INFO request pending" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4 with the IWF acting as the MCPTT server?
q_9527.ground_truth: The IWF should include the warning text if a SIP 200 (OK) response is sent towards the originator as a response to a SIP INVITE request that contained authorised request(s) for an MCPTT emergency private call and optionally an MCPTT emergency alert.

q_9528.question: What should the mobile station do before requesting a new SI value, after receiving a DISCONNECT message from the network in a multicall environment?
q_9528.ground_truth: The mobile station should not request a new SI value before releasing any other call that leads to release any other bearers than the retained bearer.

q_9529.question: How is the M2-bit used in the 31-data block structure?
q_9529.ground_truth: The M2-bit carries substream numbering, V.24 status information, and NIC-codes in the 31-data block structure.

q_9530.question: What information is included in the Caller Identity Analytics function results, even if eCNAM identity data is not displayed?
q_9530.ground_truth: The results of the Caller Identity Analytics function are included in the eCNAM message delivered to the user, even if eCNAM identity data is not displayed.

q_9531.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a SIP final response from the controllee UE?
q_9531.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall send a SIP NOTIFY request containing the received response code in the sipfrag body and if the received SIP response was a SIP 200 (OK) response containing an SDP answer then also include in the sipfrag the Content-Type header field from the received SIP 200 (OK) response along with the media (m=) lines from the SDP answer.

q_9532.question: What is the primary purpose of the UIM in the FNIM context?
q_9532.ground_truth: The UIM provides abstract definitions applicable across the Domain/Technology-specific Concrete Models to ensure end-to-end consistency of management information semantics.

q_9533.question: What information do HeNBs report to the centralized coordinator in the downlink interference management based on mapping between PCIs and transmission patterns?
q_9533.ground_truth: HeNBs report the Cell ID of neighboring HeNBs to the centralized coordinator in the downlink interference management based on mapping between PCIs and transmission patterns.

q_9534.question: What is the maximum power allowed for a GSM 900 BSS in the band 851 - 866 MHz?

q_9535.question: What is the meaning of "shall" and "shall not" in the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_9535.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

q_9536.question: What is the minimum number of uncorrelated positions and orientations to be used for detecting directive spurs in the reverberation chamber?
q_9536.ground_truth: At least (3) uncorrelated locations should be used and (6) uncorrelated orientations per position when directive spurs are to be detected.

q_9537.question: What documents are included in the TS-family covering 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication management?

q_9538.question: What is the format used by the MBMS UE to request specific encoding symbols for file repair?
q_9538.ground_truth: The Symbol-Based File Repair Request Message Format

q_9539.question: What is the structure of ResetResourceItem within the ResetResource protocol?
q_9539.ground_truth: ResetResourceItem is a sequence containing iuSigConId and iE-Extensions. Here, iuSigConId is a mandatory field, and iE-Extensions is optional.

q_9540.question: What is the main functionality of a 3G-324M terminal in 3GPP circuit-switched networks?
q_9540.ground_truth: A 3G-324M terminal in 3GPP circuit-switched networks provides real-time video, audio, or data, in any combination, for both 1-way and 2-way communication. These terminals may be integrated into mobile, automobile, fixed, or stand-alone devices, and can interoperate with other multimedia telephone terminals using a gateway.

q_9541.question: What is the purpose of the Paging Request (IMSI, P-TMSI, Area, Channel Needed, QoS, DRX Parameters, Gb Coverage Class Information, cell associated with the Gb Coverage Class Information) message in the BSS?
q_9541.ground_truth: The Paging Request message is used by the BSS to page the MS with the given parameters in the identified area on the specified channel. The MS's IMSI is used to determine the paging group, and the P-TMSI is the unique identifier used to page the MS. The QoS and DRX parameters are used to optimize the radio paging procedure.

q_9542.question: What types of communication does the 5G system need to support between the UEs within the group of UEs connected by ProSe communication?
q_9542.ground_truth: The 5G system needs to support unicast and multicast communication between the UEs within the group of UEs connected by ProSe communication.

q_9543.question: What is the format for the SMS CDR generation when a single CDR is generated for each charging event?
q_9543.ground_truth: A single CDR is generated by the CDF for each event, and subsequently transferred to the Charging Gateway Function (CGF) for SMS related CDRs (i.e. SC-SMO, SC-SMT, ISM-SMO, ISM-SMT, SC-SMO-T4 and SC-DVT-T4 CDRs).

q_9544.question: What should the UE include in the logMeasInfoList in the logMeasReport within the UEInformationResponse message?
q_9544.ground_truth: The UE should include one or more entries from VarLogMeasReport starting from the entries logged first.

q_9545.question: What is the minimum time that should elapse before a UE performs cell reselection to a new cell?
q_9545.ground_truth: More than 1 second must elapse since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_9546.question: What protocols are used to establish the user plane transport bearers over the NG interface in the 3GPP 5G specifications?
q_9546.ground_truth: The GTP-U (GPRS Tunnelling Protocol User Plane) over UDP (User Datagram Protocol) over IP (Internet Protocol) is used to establish the user plane transport bearers over the NG interface in the 3GPP 5G specifications.

q_9547.question: What is the relationship between the estimated pathloss and the maximum allowable HUE transmit power in a CSG deployment?
q_9547.ground_truth: The HNB selects the maximum allowable HUE transmit power based on the estimated pathloss, a desired limit to the noise rise at the MNB, and the RSCP and/or RSSI levels of other neighbor NodeBs in CSG deployments.

q_9548.question: What command is sent by a Diameter client to a Diameter server to update user data in the server?

q_9549.question: Who is responsible for technical UC identification in the originating network?
q_9549.ground_truth: The originating network is responsible for technical UC identification as it is able to authenticate its users and detect anomalous traffic streams or communication sources.

q_9550.question: What are the pre-conditions for the use case: initiation of on-train outgoing voice communication by train staff?
q_9550.ground_truth: The pre-conditions include the FRMCS User being an authorized member of the train staff and the FRMCS System being able to retrieve location information of the FRMCS User at the train.

q_9551.question: When should an IWF consider an MCPTT group information entry as the served MCPTT group information entry?
q_9551.ground_truth: When the MCPTT group information entry is in the list of MCPTT group information entries and the MCPTT group ID of the MCPTT group information entry is equal to the served MCPTT group ID.

q_9552.question: What is the conformance requirement for the ME to support the SEND DTMF proactive UICC command with text attributes?
q_9552.ground_truth: The ME shall support the Proactive UICC: Send DTMF facility as defined in TS 31.111 clause 6.1, 6.4.24, 6.6.24, 8.12.2, 5.2, 8.6, 8.7, 8.2, 8.44, and 8.70.

q_9553.question: What is the percentage increase in capacity performance for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, 45Mbps, 10ms PDB, 30 FPS, with SU-MIMO and 64TxRU, when the offset across UEs is changed from zero to random?
q_9553.ground_truth: There is a 100.00% increase in capacity performance.

q_9554.question: What is the purpose of using ICMP ECHO packets for transporting NIP request?
q_9554.ground_truth: ICMP ECHO packets can be used to transport NIP request in case the length of the NIP request or response is larger than 40 bytes. This provides an alternative mechanism to the Option Field of the IP header or TCP header for transporting NIP response.

q_9555.question: What is the default value of the FromPreferred leaf and what does it indicate in the context of the 3GPP technical specification?
q_9555.ground_truth: The default value of the FromPreferred leaf is '0', which indicates that the From header field is not used for determination of the originating party identity in OIP service.

q_9556.question: Under what condition may an IM-MGW modify the EVS-CMRs to change the received channel-aware offset to a bigger one?
q_9556.ground_truth: An IM-MGW may modify the EVS-CMRs to change the received channel-aware offset to a bigger one when channel-aware mode is used and the IM-MGW observes the incoming stream of speech frames or packets and determines that other channel-aware mode parameters are more appropriate.

q_9557.question: What solution proposes reducing signalling and data transfer for NWDAF to keep a mapping of network properties and PDU session properties?

q_9558.question: For ECDSA, what security strength is associated with a key size of 160 bits?
q_9558.ground_truth: The security strength associated with a key size of 160 bits for ECDSA is 80 bits

q_9559.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the RSTD measurement accuracy for Cell 2 in the test case defined in clause 14.3.8?
q_9559.ground_truth: The RSTD measurement accuracy for Cell 2 shall fulfill the absolute requirement in clause 14.3.8.3.

q_9560.question: What must the UE do upon indication from SCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached in TC 8.2.6.1.2.1.2?
q_9560.ground_truth: Upon indication from SCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached, the UE must initiate the failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.5 to report RLC failure in TC 8.2.6.1.2.1.2.

q_9561.question: What should be the priority of warning notifications in a Public Warning System (PWS)?
q_9561.ground_truth: The priority of warning notifications is given in accordance with regional regulatory requirements or operator's policy.

q_9562.question: In what ways can the calling party request information regarding the called party in the context of IMS emergency communications and information of a called party?
q_9562.ground_truth: The calling party can request whether the called party is a premium rate number or international number, and the HPLMN of the called party.

q_9563.question: What information does the "GBR QoS Information" information element provide?
q_9563.ground_truth: The "GBR QoS Information" information element indicates the maximum and guaranteed bit rates of a GBR (guaranteed bit rate) bearer for downlink.

q_9564.question: What is used for addressing in the BSSGP to transfer information between the SGSN and the BSS?

q_9565.question: What HTTPS message body properties, besides the resource id, are required for the session creation request?
q_9565.ground_truth: All session properties, except for the resource id, are carried in the HTTPS message body for the session creation request.

q_9566.question: What is the impact of the MSGin5G trigger procedure in MSGin5G Service?
q_9566.ground_truth: The MSGin5G trigger procedure is agnostic to access network technologies and can be used over top of 3GPP as well as non-3GPP access networks. This enables the MSGin5G Service to trigger 3GPP as well as non-3GPP devices if/when required, without causing backwards compatibility issues or impact.

q_9567.question: What is the total average bitrate for the AVC and SVC streams in the source video?
q_9567.ground_truth: The total average bitrate for the AVC is approximately 270kbit and for SVC is 300kbit.

q_9568.question: What is the function of the Iu UP protocol layer in Transparent mode?
q_9568.ground_truth: The Iu UP protocol layer in Transparent mode transfers data transparently over the Iu interface and uses services of the Transport layers to transfer Iu UP PDUs over the Iu interface.

q_9569.question: How are the RNC and the BSS connected in the UTRAN and GERAN Iu mode?
q_9569.ground_truth: The RNC and the BSS are connected in the UTRAN and GERAN Iu mode through the Iur-g interface to support user equipment mobility between UTRAN and GERAN Iu mode.

q_9570.question: What is the interface specified between an E-UTRAN NodeB (eNB) and an Evolved Packet Core (EPC) for Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBMS) data delivery in 3GPP Technical Specification?

q_9571.question: How many sources out of 17 sources evaluated LOS/NLOS identification using additional specification changes relative to Rel.16 solutions in indoor factory scenarios?
q_9571.ground_truth: 9 sources out of 17 sources evaluated LOS/NLOS identification using additional specification changes relative to Rel.16 solutions in indoor factory scenarios.

q_9572.question: When should the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure for NR SpCell and the strongest cell among the applicable cells?
q_9572.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure immediately after the quantity to be reported becomes available for the NR SpCell and for the strongest cell among the applicable cells when the reportAmount is equal to 1.

q_9573.question: Who is responsible for specifying the UARFCNs (Universal Terrestrial Radio Frequency Channel Number) for RF channels B, M, and T when tests are performed by a test laboratory?
q_9573.ground_truth: The laboratory is responsible for specifying the UARFCNs for RF channels B, M, and T when tests are performed by a test laboratory.

q_9574.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of successful outgoing inter-RNC hard handovers via Iur?

q_9575.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Report on Downlink interruption for NR and EN-DC band combinations in the context of dynamic Tx Switching in Uplink?
q_9575.ground_truth: The purpose is to gather relevant background information and studies to address the band combinations requested for mandating no DL interruption to conduct dynamic Tx switching.

q_9576.question: What are the two types of packet identification methods in Solution Example A for 3GPP Quality of Service framework?
q_9576.ground_truth: The two methods for packet identification in Solution Example A are those using a UDP port number or an IP address for media flow specific treatment.

q_9577.question: What should a UE do if it receives a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message indicating the "null integrity protection algorithm" 5G-EA0 as the selected 5G NAS integrity algorithm?
q_9577.ground_truth: The UE shall accept the message only if it is received when the UE is registered for emergency services, performing initial registration for emergency services or establishing an emergency PDU session.

q_9578.question: How does the UAE-S interpret SDP for media session initialization?
q_9578.ground_truth: The current UAE-S does not support SDP interpretation.

q_9579.question: Why is character set consistency important in the Huffman coding algorithm?
q_9579.ground_truth: Consistent character set usage by both coder and decoder is essential for the algorithms involving pre-loaded frequencies, key word dictionaries, and punctuation processor to function correctly. Devices must convert an input stream to the native character set before coding and after decoding.

q_9580.question: What is the condition for adjusting the energy of the excitation during voiced speech segment erasures for bitrates other than 7.2 or 8 kb/s?
q_9580.ground_truth: The LP filter impulse response energy of the first frame after an erasure must be twice as high as the LP filter impulse response energy of the last frame before the erasure.

q_9581.question: What information does the Channel Needed IE convey in message type PAGING REQUEST TYPE 1 or 2?
q_9581.ground_truth: The Channel Needed IE in message type PAGING REQUEST TYPE 1 or 2 indicates the channels required for the identified mobile stations.

q_9582.question: What are the 2nd priority channels which display lower coverage than the reference PUCCH Format 1 with the relative differential MIL target for the Indoor 28GHz TDD NLOS scenario?
q_9582.ground_truth: The 2nd priority channels which display lower coverage than the reference PUCCH Format 1 with the relative differential MIL target for the Indoor 28GHz TDD NLOS scenario are PUCCH Format 0, PUCCH Format 2, PUSCH of Msg3, PUCCH with HARQ-ACK for Msg4.

q_9583.question: What should the UE do if the reportType is set to eventTriggered and if the entry condition for this event is fulfilled?
q_9583.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5.

q_9584.question: Which message is received at the target SGSN when a successful intra 3G-SGSN SRNS Relocation occurs?

q_9585.question: What is the general trend between PA efficiency and saturated power for PAs in the frequency range above 52.6 GHz and FR2?
q_9585.ground_truth: Both power efficiency and saturated power tend to decrease for PAs in the frequency range above 52.6 GHz compared to FR2.

q_9586.question: What are the communication attributes that are relevant for the FRMCS System in the UIC FRMCS URS?
q_9586.ground_truth: The relevant communication attributes are Type of communication, Latency, Session Reliability, Setup of communication, Talker assignment time in group communication, and Audio (Voice) Quality.

q_9587.question: How does the reduction of Server to BTS latency impact the performance of the HTTP download?
q_9587.ground_truth: Reducing Server to BTS latency results in a reduction of download time between 40 to 60 percent for HTTP download.

q_9588.question: In the 3GPP standard, what does RNC stand for?

q_9589.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the FAE server in the solution described in clause 7.18.2?
q_9589.ground_truth: One of the responsibilities of the FAE server in the solution described in clause 7.18.2 is to provide a higher abstraction level of the NEF monitoring events to the FF application specific server.

q_9590.question: What should a UE do during an E-RUCCH transmission triggered by Cell Reselection Indication, if an event that would initiate E-RUCCH transmission occurs?
q_9590.ground_truth: If a UE receives a Cell Reselection Indication via E-RUCCH during an ongoing E-RUCCH transmission triggered by another event, the UE should ignore that event and continue with the ongoing E-RUCCH transmission.

q_9591.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
q_9591.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify the telecommunication management and integration reference points for converged networks.

q_9592.question: What is the purpose of the NEF in this solution?
q_9592.ground_truth: The NEF receives tracing information from MnS producer for TCE, makes necessary control, filtering or parameter translation, and sends the updated information to the target.

q_9593.question: What is the bit used as a protocol discriminator between GTP (when PT is "1") and GTP' (when PT is "0")?
q_9593.ground_truth: The Protocol Type (PT) bit in the GTP header is used as a protocol discriminator between GTP and GTP'.

q_9594.question: What is the difference in Doppler frequency component for LOS and NLOS paths given by equations (7.6-45) and (7.6-46) respectively?
q_9594.ground_truth: The Doppler frequency component in equation (7.6-45) for LOS path assumes stationary scatterers, while the Doppler frequency component in equation (7.6-46) for NLOS path takes into account the maximum speed of the clutter and a random variable of Bernoulli distribution to model the proportion of mobile scatterers in the channel.

q_9595.question: For what type of connection is the Nb UP used in support mode in BICC CS CN?
q_9595.ground_truth: For BICC CS CN, the Nb UP is used in support mode for the relevant connections, where MGW-A is where the IWF resides.

q_9596.question: What is used to establish a TBF for a user radio bearer?
q_9596.ground_truth: "One Phase Access Request", "One Phase Access Request in RLC unack mode", "Short Access Request", "Two Phase Access Request"

q_9597.question: How does the UE decide which PLMN should receive paging notifications when it supports multiple PLMNs?
q_9597.ground_truth: The UE decides which PLMN should receive paging notifications based on its internal implementation. This decision could be influenced by factors such as the first PLMN it registered to or the PLMN where it is currently connected. Once the master PLMN is determined, it is responsible for receiving paging notifications from other PLMNs for the UE.

q_9598.question: What are the priority values that indicate an APN should not be used by the UE?
q_9598.ground_truth: The priority value 'Restricted APN' (254) indicates an APN that should not be used by the UE.

q_9599.question: What is the procedure for unsuccessful data volume transfer in the DATA VOLUME REPORT message?
q_9599.ground_truth: The RAB ID IE for each unsuccessfully transferred data volume report is included in the message, together with a Cause IE indicating the reason for the failure.

q_9600.question: What are the spreading factors applied to the PUSCH in LTE?
q_9600.ground_truth: The spreading factors applied to the PUSCH are SF = 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16.

q_9601.question: What information should the UE use when performing access barring checks, as per TS 38.331, clause 5.3.14.5?
q_9601.ground_truth: The UE should use the uac-BarringPerPLMN-List from SIB1 and the uac-BarringPerCat-List from uac-BarringInfoSet as "UAC barring parameter" for the access barring check.

q_9602.question: What actions should be taken by the Data Consumer when the user consent validity time has expired or upon request from URDCF if user consent was withdrawn?
q_9602.ground_truth: The Data Consumer (e.g. NWDAF, NF) should delete user data if the user consent validity time has expired or upon request from URDCF if user consent was withdrawn.

q_9603.question: What is the significance of Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) in speech processing?
q_9603.ground_truth: Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) is a significant aspect of speech processing as it is a single integrated speech codec with eight source rates from 4.75 kbit/s to 12.2 kbit/s, and a low rate background noise encoding mode. It is capable of switching its bit-rate every 20 ms speech frame upon command.

q_9604.question: How does the HTTP/SIP adapter respond when the user selects content that cannot be found?
q_9604.ground_truth: The HTTP/SIP adapter replies with an SIP error code 404 Not Found response if the requested content cannot be found.

q_9605.question: How is the paging group determined for a MS in EC-GSM-IoT using extended DRX cycles?
q_9605.ground_truth: The paging group is determined based on the MS's downlink Coverage Class and the 51-multiframe number where the paging group occurs. A set of procedures is used to derive the paging group when the MS belongs to a downlink CC other than CC1.

q_9606.question: What is counted in the measurement of HSDPA.EstabFailDCHSDSCH.Cause?
q_9606.ground_truth: The number of measurements is equal to the number of causes supported plus a possible sum value identified by the .sum suffix.

q_9607.question: What is the requirement to change the state of CT 109 or CT 106?
q_9607.ground_truth: At least two consecutive SB-bits or X-bits, respectively, carrying the same value is required.

q_9608.question: Which attributes indicate support for RTP profiles?

q_9609.question: Which AVP indicates the PLMN where the ProSe Function resides?
q_9609.ground_truth: The Role-Of-ProSe-Function AVP indicates the PLMN where the ProSe Function resides.

q_9610.question: What is the formula for calculating the final Network Slice EE KPI based on Data Volume for the RAN-only type of network slice?
q_9610.ground_truth: The final Network Slice EE KPI based on Data Volume for the RAN-only type of network slice is calculated as the total data volume in the RAN transmission points over the same observation period divided by ECRANonlyns, the energy consumption of the RAN-only network slice over the same observation period.

q_9611.question: In the transmission of a PDCP PDU, what should the PDCP entity do if it is associated with two RLC entities and PDCP duplication is activated?
q_9611.ground_truth: If the PDCP PDU is a PDCP Data PDU, the PDCP entity should duplicate the PDCP Data PDU and submit it to both associated RLC entities. If the PDCP PDU is a PDCP Control PDU, the PDCP entity should submit it to the primary RLC entity.

q_9612.question: What is the Frequency Stability test intended to measure?
q_9612.ground_truth: The Frequency Stability test is intended to measure the frequency deviation of the output signal with respect to the input signal for both the uplink and downlink paths of the Repeater.

q_9613.question: How do users of the first and second sub-channel in GSM re-use frequency hopping?
q_9613.ground_truth: Users of the first and second sub-channel in GSM re-use the frequency hopping in the same way it is defined in the GSM standard.

q_9614.question: What is the initial BSIC identification procedure in the context of GSM measurements?
q_9614.ground_truth: The initial BSIC identification procedure is a process of searching for and decoding the BSIC for the first time when there is no knowledge about the relative timing between the TDD and GSM cell. The requirements for initial BSIC identification can be found in section 8.1.2.5.2.1.

q_9615.question: What is the function of a local area identifier in Solution 21 for local MBS services?
q_9615.ground_truth: The local area identifier is comparable with the MBMS Flow Id, and is used to assign an ingress node for a specific location area within a multicast group.

q_9616.question: What is the maximum number of UEs that can be supported in a cluster managed by a UE and in a cluster managed by a gateway?
q_9616.ground_truth: A cluster managed by a UE should have a maximum of 4,000 UEs while a cluster managed by a gateway can support up to 50,000 UEs.

q_9617.question: What are the main interfaces involved in MMS delivery, and which messages are used to define performance measurements on a MMS Relay/Server basis?
q_9617.ground_truth: The main interfaces involved in MMS delivery are MM1 and MM4. The messages involved in the delivery, as depicted in the diagram, can be used to define performance measurements on a MMS Relay/Server basis.

q_9618.question: What is the maximum length of the GSM Measurement Information message when sent as a Bter UI frame on the SACCH?
q_9618.ground_truth: The maximum length of this message is 21 octets.

q_9619.question: What happens to MBS QoS Flows when the MBS Session is deactivated by 5GC?
q_9619.ground_truth: MBS QoS Flows are kept in 5GC when the MBS Session is deactivated.

q_9620.question: Which single receiver requirement has been defined for PC1 in NB-IoT BS receivers?
q_9620.ground_truth: The only defined requirement for PC1 UE is the exception due to the high-power leakage or blocking issue for band 20.

q_9621.question: What is a MAC-d PDU?
q_9621.ground_truth: A MAC-d PDU is a packet of data that is transmitted over the air interface in a 3GPP network. It is a sequence of MAC-d PDUs that are sent over the same MAC entity and are associated with the same MAC-d flow identity. The MAC-d PDUs are stored in the MAC-ehs queue and are transmitted to the UE by the MAC entity.

q_9622.question: What is the maximum number of times the LCS-AP Reset Request message can be retransmitted in the LCS protocol?
q_9622.ground_truth: The LCS-AP Reset Request message can be retransmitted a maximum of "n" times, where "n" is an O&M (Operation and Maintenance) administered parameter. Following "n" unsuccessful reset attempts, the procedure is terminated and maintenance is informed.

q_9623.question: What action does the MMEn take if it receives a response with an IMSI?
q_9623.ground_truth: The MMEn creates an entry and stores any EPS-authentication vectors and any EPS security context that may be included.

q_9624.question: What must the SGSN send in a BSS restart indication after receiving a BSS restart indication from the BSS?
q_9624.ground_truth: The SGSN sends to the BSS a Dummy Paging message including a IMSI and the extended idle mode DRX parameters to the BSS after receiving a BSS restart indication.

q_9625.question: What is the role of UAVF in detecting problematic UAV and UAVC in the 3GPP system?
q_9625.ground_truth: UAVF is responsible for detecting, identifying and reporting problematic UAV and UAVC to UTM for further action.

q_9626.question: In the heterogeneous-bandwidth MMVC use case, what are the two access network classes assumed for this scenario?
q_9626.ground_truth: The two access network classes assumed for this scenario are a fast connection capable of sending and receiving a high video resolution of 1080p@30fps, and a slow connection capable of sending and receiving a medium video resolution of 720p@30fps.

q_9627.question: What is the MWUS bandwidth and how is it mapped to resource elements?
q_9627.ground_truth: The MWUS bandwidth is 2 consecutive PRBs, and the frequency location of the lowermost PRB with index 0 is signaled by higher layers. The MWUS sequence is mapped to resource elements in sequence, starting with the first index and increasing over the 12 assigned subcarriers in each subframe.

q_9628.question: When should the Broadcast Empty Area List IE be included in a warning message?
q_9628.ground_truth: The Broadcast Empty Area List IE should be included in the STOP WARNING INDICATION when the MME has received at least one KILL RESPONSE without Broadcast Cancelled Area List IE.

q_9629.question: What abbreviation is used for Wireless Local Area Network?

q_9630.question: What is the maximum number of times that the "Content-Length" attribute can occur in the XML schema provided?
q_9630.ground_truth: The "Content-Length" attribute can occur up to 1 time in the XML schema provided.

q_9631.question: What is the purpose of extending the 3GP file format for 3D video playback?
q_9631.ground_truth: The purpose of extending the 3GP file format is to support 3D video playback by adding new boxes to describe the position of the timed text and graphics tracks and boxes in the 3D space.

q_9632.question: What action should the mobile station take if it is unable to process a request from the network in location services operations?
q_9632.ground_truth: If the mobile station is unable to process a request from the network, it should return an error indication by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a return error component.

q_9633.question: What is the difference between option A and option B in the described solution, in terms of the visibility of UDR to AMF/SMF/SMSF?
q_9633.ground_truth: In option A, UDR is visible to AMF/SMF/SMSF, while in option B, UDR is not visible to AMF/SMF/SMSF.

q_9634.question: What happens if periodic reporting was not requested, but the SAS is not able to yield a UE positioning estimate satisfying the requested accuracy?
q_9634.ground_truth: The SAS starts a new process from step 3 to obtain a more accurate UE positioning estimate.

q_9635.question: What should the IBCF do if it receives an SDP body containing the RTP header extension attribute(s) and indicates Coordination of Video Orientation (CVO) URN(s)?
q_9635.ground_truth: If the IBCF and the TrGW support the CVO feature, the IBCF shall include an "extended RTP header for CVO" information element when seizing resources in the TrGW and forward within SIP signalling the SDP body received from the preceding node to the succeeding node with unmodified "a=extmap" attribute(s).

q_9636.question: What is the role of Solution #21 in the 5G system?
q_9636.ground_truth: Solution #21 provides a method for the system to keep the multicast session ID when a user equipment (UE) moves across the local MBS session area. It also hides the dependencies of contents on Location Area(s) and their associating Location Area IDs from the UE.

q_9637.question: What issue may arise due to the reduced output power in the power amplifier (PA)?
q_9637.ground_truth: The efficiency of the power amplifier gets smaller when a smaller part of the supply voltage is used for the actual signal, and this may cause an increase in the peak power consumption and potentially affect the overall MS design.

q_9638.question: How are the Fourier coefficients grouped in blocks in spectrum pre-shaping?
q_9638.ground_truth: The Fourier coefficients are grouped in blocks of four consecutive coefficients, forming 8-dimensional real-valued blocks.

q_9639.question: What is the length of the Channel Data for the RECEIVE DATA command with command type 1.1.3?
q_9639.ground_truth: The length of the Channel Data for the RECEIVE DATA command with command type 1.1.3 is 200 bytes.

q_9640.question: How many bits are there in a 3GPP PDTCH block type 29, without any additional information (eTFI or PAN) included?

q_9641.question: What is the difference between the TUTRAN-GPS Change Limit IE and the Predicted TUTRAN-GPS Deviation Limit IE when used in the Common Measurement Type IE of "UTRAN GPS Timing of Cell Frames for UE Positioning"?
q_9641.ground_truth: The TUTRAN-GPS Change Limit IE sets a threshold for the change in TUTRAN-GPS value, while the Predicted TUTRAN-GPS Deviation Limit IE sets a threshold for the deviation of the predicted TUTRAN-GPS value from the actual measurement.

q_9642.question: Who is responsible for deactivating QoE measurement in the management-based deactivation procedure?
q_9642.ground_truth: OAM is responsible for sending the deactivation indication to the NG-RAN node to indicate which QoE measurement should be deactivated.

q_9643.question: What is the importance of including 4K TV scenarios for 5G video codec evaluation?
q_9643.ground_truth: Including 4K TV scenarios for 5G video codec evaluation is important because 4K TV sets are currently the most established way of displaying premium quality services using the latest technology improvements for video content, including High-Dynamic-Range (HDR) and Wide-Colour-Gamut (WCG).

q_9644.question: What is the duration for which the UE should evaluate an inter-RAT GSM cell for reselection if the Treselection timer has a non-zero value?
q_9644.ground_truth: The UE should evaluate the inter-RAT GSM cell for the Treselection time if this cell remains better ranked within this duration.

q_9645.question: What does the S-CSCF do with the AMF instance ID after receiving it from the HSS during a normal IMS registration procedure?
q_9645.ground_truth: The S-CSCF sends the AMF instance ID to the P-CSCF in the SIP 200 OK after receiving it from the HSS during a normal IMS registration procedure.

q_9646.question: What is the full set of TDMA frames for a full rate TCH in A/Gb mode or Iu mode on DBPSCH?
q_9646.ground_truth: The full set of TDMA frames is 100.

q_9647.question: When a MS is assigned a channel, what is the maximum allowable power emission in the frequency band 921 - 925 MHz for R-GSM MS?

q_9648.question: What is the suggested solution for MSs that do not correctly decode information elements if the Synchronisation Indication IE is omitted in the HANDOVER COMMAND message?
q_9648.ground_truth: The suggested solution is for the infrastructure to always send the Synchronisation Indication IE to a Phase~1 MS.

q_9649.question: What is the Klobuchar Model used for in the GNSS-IonosphericModel?
q_9649.ground_truth: The Klobuchar Model is used for GPS or GLONASS or BDS B1I supported by the UE in the GNSS-IonosphericModel.

q_9650.question: Which specification series defines the definitions, symbols, abbreviations and coding conventions applicable to the terminal?
q_9650.ground_truth: ETSI~TS~102~230 defines the definitions, symbols, abbreviations, and coding conventions applicable to the terminal.

q_9651.question: What indication is included in the Context Request if the new SGSN supports CIoT GSM Optimization?
q_9651.ground_truth: If the new SGSN supports CIoT GSM Optimization, CIoT GSM Optimization support indication is included in the Context Request indicating support for various CIoT Optimisations.

q_9652.question: What is the term "loop prevention indication" used for in the context of VAS4SMS?
q_9652.ground_truth: The term "loop prevention indication" is used in the context of VAS4SMS for an indication set by the VAS AS (Value-Added Service Application Server) to indicate that a VAS service has been applied to generate a new message, in order to prevent loops.

q_9653.question: What is the purpose of the RAN Information Management (RIM) procedures in the RAN?
q_9653.ground_truth: The RAN Information Management (RIM) procedures provide a mechanism for exchanging arbitrary RAN information between RAN applications. The RIM procedures are optional and are used to transfer RAN information via the SGSN core network node(s) through messages. The interfaces used for the exchange of RAN information include the Gb (BSSGP), Iu (RANAP), Gn (GTPv1), and S16 (GTPv2) interfaces.

q_9654.question: What are the key impacts of the solutions for network slice quota management in terms of storing the network slice quota information and enforcing the quota?
q_9654.ground_truth: All solutions propose to store an information related to the network slice quota information in the CN and to monitor and enforce the quota in the CN. The difference among those solutions are where to store the network slice quota information and where to place the network slice quota management and the network slice quota enforcement.

q_9655.question: What is the role of the CHF in the charging process of ProSe Groupcast mode of Direct Communication?
q_9655.ground_truth: The CHF is responsible for closing the CDR for the UE, generating a Charging Data Response corresponding to the received Charging Data Request, and collecting charging information for Groupcast mode ProSe Direct Communication.

q_9656.question: What should the target AMF do in Step 16 after receiving the keyAmfHDerivationInd indicator?
q_9656.ground_truth: The target AMF needs to run a NAS SMC procedure with the UE to take the new Kamf-1 into use with the UE and initiate a new primary authentication with UE to generate a new Kamf-2.

q_9657.question: What is the result of receiving a UA response after transmitting the SABM command in the MS?
q_9657.ground_truth: Upon receiving a UA response after transmitting the SABM command, the data link layer resets T200, sets send variable V(S), the receive state variable V(R), and the acknowledge state variable V(A) to 0, enters the multiple established state, confirms establishment to layer~3 using DL-ESTABLISH-CONFIRM, and sends the layer~3 message unit passed together with the DL-RESUME primitive.

q_9658.question: What is the requirement for the Rel-4+ ME (Mobile Equipment) when setting up an emergency call?
q_9658.ground_truth: The Rel-4+ ME shall use the category of the emergency service indicated when setting up an emergency call.

q_9659.question: What is the message type for the CTS system information type 3?
q_9659.ground_truth: The message type for the CTS system information type 3 is CTS SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 3.

q_9660.question: When should the UE release the current N1 NAS signalling connection locally and then attempt to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN?
q_9660.ground_truth: The UE should release the current N1 NAS signalling connection locally and then attempt to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN if the UE determines that there is a higher priority PLMN than the currently camped chosen VPLMN and the UE is in automatic network selection mode.

q_9661.question: How long should the duration of the audio tone be in 27.22.4.5.3.4, as per the described scenario?
q_9661.ground_truth: The duration of the audio tone should be 5 seconds, as the PROACTIVE COMMAND: PLAY TONE 1.1.1 has a Time interval value of 5.

q_9662.question: What is the target namespace in the XML schema for associated delivery procedure description instances in Release 14 extension?

q_9663.question: What interface provides the IMPI to the IdP/BSF in a collocated BSF and IdP?
q_9663.ground_truth: The Ub interface provides the IMPI to the IdP/BSF in a collocated BSF and IdP.

q_9664.question: What information should be included in the GA-RC DISCOVERY REJECT message if the Discovery Reject Cause is 'Network Congestion'?
q_9664.ground_truth: The TU3902 Timer should be included in the GA-RC DISCOVERY REJECT message if the Discovery Reject Cause is 'Network Congestion'.

q_9665.question: What is the coding scheme used in the speech encoder?
q_9665.ground_truth: The coding scheme used in the speech encoder is the Regular Pulse Excitation - Long Term prediction - Linear Predictive Coding (RPE-LTP).

q_9666.question: What should the RNC do if it receives the Transport Layer Address IE and the Iu Transport Association IE in the MBMS SESSION START RESPONSE message and the MBMS Synchronisation Information IE was received within the MBMS SESSION START message?
q_9666.ground_truth: The RNC shall not include the Transport Layer Address IE and the Iu Transport Association IE in the MBMS SESSION START RESPONSE message and shall join the indicated IP Multicast group only once for the indicated MBMS Service Id.

q_9667.question: What is the consequence of using EIA0 (NULL integrity) for unauthenticated emergency calls if the NAS COUNT values wrap around, and a new KASME has not been established before the NAS COUNT wrap around?
q_9667.ground_truth: In this case, the NAS connection shall be kept, and there is no need to re-establish a connection, as the initialization of the NAS COUNT values is not crucial for unauthenticated emergency calls where EIA0 is used.

q_9668.question: What is the relationship between the 3GPP Technical Specifications TS 28.674, TS 28.675, and TS 28.676?
q_9668.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specifications TS 28.674, TS 28.675, and TS 28.676 are related and together cover the telecommunication management domain, specifically focusing on the Home enhanced Node B Subsystem (HeNS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) and its requirements, protocol neutral Information Service, and Solution Set (SS) definitions, respectively.

q_9669.question: What is the name of the function that defines the fddRF Capability in the second sequence?

q_9670.question: In which 5G related data request type specific to GERAN Iu mode can the "id-LAI" parameter be included in the "Relocation-SourceRNC-ID" and "id-RAT-Type" parameters in the "IuSigConId-IE-ContainerPairList" sequence?
q_9670.ground_truth: The LAI parameter specifies the Location Area Identity in the 3GPP specifications and is used to identify a specific location in the network.

q_9671.question: What should a UE do when it receives a DL assignment for its G-RNTI, and the assigned slot is the same as the current slot for receiving DL MAC PDU for PTM transmission, after receiving a DL assignment for its stored G-CS-RNTI, with NDI set as 0 and PDCCH content indicates activation?
q_9671.ground_truth: The UE should receive DL MAC PDU as per the assignment for its G-RNTI, replacing the one for G-CS-RNTI.

q_9672.question: What is the consequence when the Serving E-UTRA cell becomes worse than the absolute threshold minus hysteresis and the periodical measurement reporting triggered by event A1 is ongoing?
q_9672.ground_truth: The UE should stop sending MeasurementReport messages.

q_9673.question: Which IE indicates the reason for a particular event for the M3AP protocol?
q_9673.ground_truth: The Cause IE indicates the reason for a particular event for the M3AP protocol.

q_9674.question: What is the purpose of the client buffer feedback functionality in PSS?
q_9674.ground_truth: The purpose of the client buffer feedback functionality is to allow the server to closely monitor the buffering situation on the client side and to avoid client buffer underflow. This helps prevent discarding useful data and provide interrupt-free playback of the media.

q_9675.question: What is the purpose of the "Deinterleave" function?
q_9675.ground_truth: The "Deinterleave" function is used to input and deinterleave an output sequence.

q_9676.question: Who controls the transitions (i.e. CPC initiation and CPC termination) in continuous connectivity concepts?
