q_9676.ground_truth: There are three general transition control approaches: transitions are controlled by the UE, the Node B, or by the "protocol in question", which means that transitions can be controlled by the network, the UE, or a predefined implicit rule or blind detection method.

q_9677.question: How many types of Elementary Procedures are there, and what differentiates them?
q_9677.ground_truth: There are two types of Elementary Procedures: Class 1 and Class 2. Class 1 consists of EPs with a response (success or failure), while Class 2 consists of EPs without a response. Class 1 EPs can have successful or unsuccessful outcomes, whereas Class 2 EPs are always considered successful.

q_9678.question: What is the identified security weakness in 2G systems that the 3GPP Technical Specification aims to address with 3G systems?
q_9678.ground_truth: The absence of security in Signalling System No.~7 (SS7) networks in 2G systems is identified as a security weakness.

q_9679.question: What is the role of the MBMS Session and Transmission function?
q_9679.ground_truth: The MBMS Session and Transmission function is responsible for transferring the actual MBMS session data to a group of MBMS UEs using MBMS bearer services or unicast bearer services.

q_9680.question: What frames can cause an invalid frame condition in the context of multiple frame operation in data link layer procedures?
q_9680.ground_truth: A frame received with incorrect parameters such as a length indicator with a non-zero value in frames where an information field is not permitted, an M bit set to "1", or a length indicator set to a value greater than N201 in frames permitted with an information field, can cause an invalid frame condition.

q_9681.question: What is the sampling rate used in the described scenario?
q_9681.ground_truth: A sampling rate of 48kHz is used in the scenario.

q_9682.question: What does the Network Service (NS) traffic consist of in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Gb interface?
q_9682.ground_truth: Network Service traffic in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Gb interface consists of data traffic (NS SDUs for PTP and PTM functional entities) and signalling traffic (NS SDUs for Signalling functional entities and all PDUs for IP Sub-Network Service Control)

q_9683.question: What message type is used to request the release of all tunnel resources for LWIP operation for a specific UE at the WT and is sent by the eNB to the WT?

q_9684.question: Who can request the modification of parameters in a PDP context by sending an Update PDP Context Request message in the 3GPP network?

q_9685.question: What is the Cellular Text Telephone Modem (CTM) intended for use in?
q_9685.ground_truth: The CTM is intended for use in end terminals (on the mobile or fixed side) and within the network for the adaptation between CTM and existing traditional text telephone standards.

q_9686.question: What abbreviation is defined for "Packet Control Function" in the provided document?

q_9687.question: What is one of the components missing in the Presence Server that could support NRPCA for a Push Function?
q_9687.ground_truth: The Presence Server lacks the ability to initiate the activation of a PDP Context on demand.

q_9688.question: What are the supported video resolutions and frames per second (fps) for MCVideo clients using the H.265 (HEVC) codec?
q_9688.ground_truth: MCVideo clients may support video encoding up to 1280x720 @ 30fps, and 1080p (3840x2160 @ 30fps) with the H.265 (HEVC) codec, depending on their capabilities and the MCVideo service.

q_9689.question: When would the IMS-AGW apply filtering to incoming IP packets?
q_9689.ground_truth: The IMS-AGW applies filtering to incoming IP packets when requested by the IMS-ALG for source IP address and possibly source port filtering.

q_9690.question: What must the VPLMN indicate to the HPLMN when contacting the CSE for a service that requires CAMEL if the VPLMN supports a lower CAMEL phase than the one negotiated between the HPLMN and the VPLMN?
q_9690.ground_truth: The VPLMN must indicate to the CSE which CAMEL phase it supports and the CAMEL capabilities that are supported in the VPLMN.

q_9691.question: What is the preferred format for encoding the bit pattern in the packet filter list parameter?
q_9691.ground_truth: The least significant bit should be in the rightmost position of the integer.

q_9692.question: What services are used in the common MAP services section?
q_9692.ground_truth: The common MAP services section includes the MAP-OPEN service, MAP-CLOSE service, MAP-DELIMITER service, MAP-U-ABORT service, MAP-P-ABORT service, MAP-NOTICE service, MAP-SECURE-TRANSPORT-CLASS-1 service, MAP-SECURE-TRANSPORT-CLASS-2 service, MAP-SECURE-TRANSPORT-CLASS-3 service, and MAP-SECURE-TRANSPORT-CLASS-4 service.

q_9693.question: What is the name of the procedure that enables the MRFC to request the MRFP to perform automatic speech recognition with guidance announcements and user input via speech and DTMF?

q_9694.question: What target value is used to specify the required receiver link performance in the SFN mode?
q_9694.ground_truth: The required target for receiver link performance in the SFN mode is 10% radio link control (RLC) block error rate (BLER)

q_9695.question: What is the purpose of the Internal Handover Command message in a BSS Internal Handover that does not modify LCLS status of a locally switched call?
q_9695.ground_truth: The Internal Handover Command message is sent by MSC-1 Server to indicate that local switching is permitted by the core network and to command the handover in step 4.

q_9696.question: What does bit 1 represent in the Channel field?
q_9696.ground_truth: Bit 1 in the Channel field indicates whether the channel is used for signalling only or for data transmission.

q_9697.question: What is the intended use of the broadcast mode of MBMS?
q_9697.ground_truth: The broadcast mode of MBMS is intended to efficiently use radio/network resources by transmitting data over a common radio channel. It is also used to efficiently transmit multimedia data (e.g. text, audio, picture, video) to all users in a broadcast service area.

q_9698.question: What message does the UP Function send to the CP Function to report the termination of a L2TP session or a L2TP tunnel?
q_9698.ground_truth: The UP Function sends a PFCP Session Report Request message to the CP, with an additional L2TP Cause IE indicating the reason for the termination.

q_9699.question: What conditions must be met for the requirements of subclauses 6.1.1.3 to apply for Home BS output power adjustment regarding adjacent channel protections?
q_9699.ground_truth: The requirements of subclauses 6.1.1.3 apply for Home BS output power adjustment regarding adjacent channel protections when one of the adjacent channels is licensed to a E-UTRA operator while the other adjacent channel is licensed to a UTRA operator, or if both adjacent channels are licensed to other operators and the most stringent requirement is applied for Pout. The requirements do not apply if the Home BS's operating channel and both adjacent channels are licensed to the same operator.

q_9700.question: What are the nine source rates available in the AMR-WB speech coder?
q_9700.ground_truth: The nine source rates available in the AMR-WB speech coder are from 6.60 kbit/s to 23.85 kbit/s.

q_9701.question: What are the two functions applied prior to the encoding process in the AMR codec?
q_9701.ground_truth: The two pre-processing functions applied prior to the encoding process in the AMR codec are high-pass filtering and signal down-scaling.

q_9702.question: What the SMR entity sends to Service Centre if the incoming RP-DATA requires an acknowledgement?
q_9702.ground_truth: After reception of an incoming RP-DATA, the SMR entity typically returns the acknowledgement RP-ACK, or an error indication, RP-ERROR, to the Service Centre.

q_9703.question: What is the purpose of the SNSM-DEACTIVATE.indication operation?
q_9703.ground_truth: The SNSM-DEACTIVATE.indication operation is used by the SM entity to inform the SNDCP entity that an NSAPI has been deallocated and cannot be used anymore. It also indicates that all buffered N-PDUs corresponding to this NSAPI are deleted.

q_9704.question: What are the requirements for supporting expeditious handling of software and data during system upgrade?
q_9704.ground_truth: The requirements for supporting expeditious handling of software and data during system upgrade include minimizing impact on ongoing traffic, following a required sequence of upgrades, creating additional logical NE/NR without physical resources, installing additional physical NE/NR without management functionality, and preventing the erroneous taking into service of a NE/NR which is not fully installed.

q_9705.question: What kind of messages are sent in cleartext (without security protection) in the communication between source UE and target UE via UE-to-UE Relay?
q_9705.ground_truth: Discovery messages and Direct Communication Request message are sent in cleartext.

q_9706.question: What is the call control result for "1.4.1 CALL CONTROL RESULT"?
q_9706.ground_truth: The call control result is '01', which means not allowed.

q_9707.question: What should the UE consider as the lowest priority frequency when in a normal camped state and has only dedicated priorities for a single frequency?
q_9707.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the current frequency to be the lowest priority frequency when it is in a normal camped state and has only dedicated priorities for a single frequency.

q_9708.question: What are the three components of the rich media system architecture?
q_9708.ground_truth: The rich media system architecture comprises of three main components: the rich media server, transport mechanisms, and the rich media client.

q_9709.question: What is the obligation for a VGCS capable mobile station regarding ciphering?
q_9709.ground_truth: A VGCS capable mobile station shall support USIM-based VGCS ciphering.

q_9710.question: What is the action taken when the ME executes the LAUNCH BROWSER command with an existing browser and a URL (different from the default URL) that can be reached from the gateway defined by default in the browser parameters of the mobile?
q_9710.ground_truth: The result is a successful command performance with the use of the existing browser launched in the first sequence of the corresponding expected test case.

q_9711.question: Why would the version number of the document be incremented by the third digit?
q_9711.ground_truth: The version number would be incremented by the third digit when only editorial changes have been incorporated into the document.

q_9712.question: What is the significance of the number of antenna probes used in a chamber design for spatial channel models?
q_9712.ground_truth: The number of antenna probes used in a chamber design for spatial channel models affects the accuracy of the emulated angle spreads. A higher number of probes may be required for larger devices or more complex channel models.

q_9713.question: What is the name of the sequence that represents the unsuccessful RL-InformationResponseList in the context of Radio Link Addition Failure FDD?

q_9714.question: Which European country did Albania achieve independence from in 1912?

q_9715.question: What is the critical latency requirement for remote commands and control communication between UAV and UAV controller in the 5G network?
q_9715.ground_truth: The latency requirement for remote control service is 50ms.

q_9716.question: What is the AVP code value of the LMSI AVP in the SLh interface protocol?
q_9716.ground_truth: The AVP code value of the LMSI AVP is 271.

q_9717.question: What action does the IM-SSF take after receiving an "EventReportBCSM" operation with the eventTypeBCSM set to "O-Disconnect" or "T-Disconnect"?
q_9717.ground_truth: The IM-SSF includes the releaseCause, if available, in the operation and sets the legID parameter to the party in the call for which the event is reported.

q_9718.question: What message is used by the LMA to initiate the PMIPv6 LMA Initiated Update Notification procedure?
q_9718.ground_truth: A PMIPv6 UPN message is used by the LMA to initiate the PMIPv6 LMA Initiated Update Notification procedure.

q_9720.question: What is the role of the Application Data Model (ADM) in the integrated model handling environment?
q_9720.ground_truth: The Application Data Model (ADM) is the result of implementing the Specialized Information Model (SpIM) and the Application Information Model (AIM) in the integrated model handling environment. The ADM gets implemented in the application FE and in the Application Data Model View in the UDR.

q_9721.question: What is the pre-condition for the TSC stream discovery procedure?
q_9721.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for the TSC stream discovery procedure include the existence of assigned UE-TSCs, established Ethernet PDU sessions, a populated NRM server management information base, and calculated bridge delays.

q_9722.question: How many operational modes does the EVS codec include?
q_9722.ground_truth: The EVS codec includes two operational modes: EVS Primary operational mode (EVS Primary mode) and EVS AMR-WB Inter-Operable modes (EVS AMR-WB IO mode).

q_9723.question: What is the goal of the 3GPP Technical Specification in relation to E-UTRA Radio Link Control (RLC) protocol for the UE-E-UTRAN radio interface?
q_9723.ground_truth: The goal is to specify the E-UTRA RLC sublayer architecture, E-UTRA RLC entities, services expected from lower layers by E-UTRA RLC, services provided to upper layers by E-UTRA RLC, E-UTRA RLC functions, elements for peer-to-peer E-UTRA RLC communication including protocol data units, formats and parameters, and handling of unknown, unforeseen and erroneous protocol data at E-UTRA RLC.

q_9724.question: What does the "Roaming" in ANDSF/WLANSP/<X>/Roaming refer to?
q_9724.ground_truth: The "Roaming" in ANDSF/WLANSP/<X>/Roaming indicates the roaming condition for the WLANSP rule, with values of 0 or 1, where 0 indicates that the rule is only valid when the UE is not roaming and 1 indicates that the rule is only valid when the UE is roaming.

q_9725.question: What is the result of the second scenario (reverberation chamber based) in terms of the channel model implementation?
q_9725.ground_truth: The conducted and radiated results align within +/- 0.5 dB, validating the framework concept using the isotropic channel model based on NIST.

q_9726.question: What is the concept of the ACCEPT, SELECT, SEND, INDICATION, and END functions in the present document?
q_9726.ground_truth: The ACCEPT function is for accepting a mobile terminated call, SELECT is for entry of information, SEND is for transmission of the entered information to the network, INDICATION is for call progress indications and other additional indications throughout the procedure, and END is for termination of or disconnection from the call.

q_9727.question: What is the difference between "Carrier Aggregation" and "Inter-band carrier aggregation"?
q_9727.ground_truth: "Carrier Aggregation" refers to the aggregation of two or more component carriers in the same operating band, while "Inter-band carrier aggregation" refers to the aggregation of component carriers in different operating bands.

q_9728.question: Which timer is started or restarted when the UE receives a RRCRelease message with a deprioritization request?
q_9728.ground_truth: Timer T325 is started or restarted when the UE receives a RRCRelease message with a deprioritization request.

q_9729.question: What does the Inter-stream Interference Compensation Index IE indicate in 9.2.2.183?
q_9729.ground_truth: The Inter-stream Interference Compensation Index IE indicates an offset that a UE applies while performing the E-TFC selection for the primary stream.

q_9730.question: What JSON format should be used for partial modification of a session resource in the 3GPP system?

q_9731.question: What shall the selection of the media flows to be transferred be based on when transferring one or more media flows to one or more target UEs?
q_9731.ground_truth: The selection of the media flows to be transferred may be based on the target UE(s) capabilities.

q_9732.question: What is the issue with the current procedure for uplink scheduling in non-terrestrial networks?
q_9732.ground_truth: The current procedure for uplink scheduling in non-terrestrial networks can take a long time due to large propagation delays, which can be problematic.

q_9733.question: What conditions must be met for an MS to report GSM neighbour cells with Enhanced Measurement Reporting?
q_9733.ground_truth: For Enhanced Measurement Reporting to be used, the BSIC for all GSM neighbour cells must have been sent to the MS, and it must be possible to identify valid cells based on the E-UTRAN Neighbour Cell list.

q_9734.question: How does a receiving entity handle the National Language Locking Shift IE if the DCS has indicated UCS-2 encoding?
q_9734.ground_truth: A receiving entity shall ignore the National Language Locking Shift IE if the DCS has indicated UCS-2 encoding.

q_9735.question: What is the consequence of a late participant joining an MPS for MMTEL voice conference after MPS was activated for all participants?
q_9735.ground_truth: MPS is provided to the late participant joining the conference.

q_9736.question: Which physical channel is used for transmitting the narrowband primary synchronization signal (NPSS) and narrowband secondary synchronization signal (NSSS) in the NB-IoT system?
q_9736.ground_truth: The NPSS and NSSS are transmitted on the NB-Physical Synchronization Channel (NPBCH), which is a downlink physical channel in the NB-IoT system.

q_9737.question: What type of charging events are specified for LCS?
q_9737.ground_truth: The specified charging events for LCS are: A location request for a MS/UE triggered by the MS/UE, triggered by an external entity, and triggered by the network.

q_9738.question: What is the purpose of the Compression Control information element?
q_9738.ground_truth: The Compression Control information element is used to indicate a compressed octet sequence, and it is used in association with one or more Extended Objects and/or Reused Extended Objects.

q_9739.question: What bands are supported by the GSM900 band supported in the Band (octet 2)?
q_9739.ground_truth: The GSM900 band supported by the Band (octet 2) is represented by 0 0 0 in the Bits.

q_9740.question: In the 5G AKA based authentication framework, where is the AUSF and what are its responsibilities?
q_9740.ground_truth: In the 5G AKA based authentication framework, the AUSF is located in the SNPN and provides the necessary isolation between the SNPN and the third-party network, which contains the rest of the necessary 5GS authentication functions.

q_9741.question: What is the purpose of the Service Announcement phase in MBMS broadcast service provision?
q_9741.ground_truth: The Service Announcement phase informs UEs about upcoming MBMS user services.

q_9742.question: What is the purpose of policy conflict detection in network policy management?
q_9742.ground_truth: Policy conflict detection is important to ensure that a newly activated policy does not conflict with an existing activated policy. The Policy MnS producer detects the conflict and reports the conflict information to resolve it.

q_9743.question: What is the primary goal for the communication reliability requirements for devices deployed inside hospitals?
q_9743.ground_truth: The primary goal is for the communication reliability to be higher than for devices deployed outside of hospitals.

q_9744.question: What is the purpose of the homing frames included at the start of the test sequence for the GSM half rate speech codec?
q_9744.ground_truth: The homing frames at the start of the test sequence are used to reset the speech encoder or decoder state variables to their initial value. In the case of a correct implementation, the resulting speech encoder or decoder output frames should be identical to the corresponding frames in the reference files.

q_9745.question: What is the purpose of the Xw UP protocol in the context of LTE-WLAN Aggregation?
q_9745.ground_truth: The Xw UP protocol in LTE-WLAN Aggregation is responsible for conveying control information related to user data flow management of E-RABs and successful transmission to the UE.

q_9746.question: What do "MSB" and "LSB" stand for in the context of bytes and bit representations?
q_9746.ground_truth: MSB stands for "Most Significant Bit" and LSB stands for "Least Significant Bit." In the context of bytes, each byte is represented by bits b8 to b1, where b8 is the MSB and b1 is the LSB.

q_9747.question: What is the condition for the UE actions for UE Test Loop Mode I operation to be performed?
q_9747.ground_truth: The condition for the UE actions for UE Test Loop Mode I operation to be performed is if UE test loop mode I has been selected, and UE test loop mode A, B, C, D, E, F, G, or H has not been selected.

q_9748.question: What entity is responsible for handling the HARQ protocol in MAC-hs?

q_9749.question: What must a mobile station do after receiving the PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message?
q_9749.ground_truth: After receiving the PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message, the mobile station must respond with a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message in the first allocated radio block.

q_9750.question: Which negotiation is performed using LLGMM-IOV-REQ and LLGMM-IOV-CNF in the SGSN?
q_9750.ground_truth: An XID negotiation of IOV-UI (if ciphering is used) and i-IOV-UI (if integrity protection is used) is performed between the LLC layer in the SGSN and a peer using LLGMM-IOV-REQ and LLGMM-IOV-CNF.

q_9751.question: What is the purpose of the "Usage-Monitoring-Support AVP" in 5.3.63?
q_9751.ground_truth: The Usage-Monitoring-Support AVP is used by the PCRF to indicate whether usage monitoring shall be disabled for certain Monitoring Key.

q_9752.question: What is the role of the Integrity Monitor (IM) function in the network?
q_9752.ground_truth: The Integrity Monitor (IM) function in the network detects unhealthy satellites, detects measurement quality in DGPS modes, informs the UE of measurement quality in DGPS modes, and provides the UE with a list of unhealthy satellites and adjusted UDRE value.

q_9753.question: What should the MS do if it doesn't have information about the Provisioning SEGW?
q_9753.ground_truth: The MS derives a FQDN of the Provisioning SEGW from the IMSI, performs a public DNS query to retrieve the IP-address and establishes a secure connection towards the Provisioning SEGW.

q_9754.question: What is the purpose of the UpdatePolicy leaf in an ISMP rule?
q_9754.ground_truth: The UpdatePolicy leaf in an ISMP rule indicates the update policy for the ISMP. It specifies whether the UE is required to request an update of the ISMP (1) or not (0).

q_9755.question: What is the URN used in the SDP to signal UL PLR information in 3GPP MTSI client?

q_9756.question: When is the UE allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure for emergency services while the timer T3585 is running?
q_9756.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure for emergency services at any time, even when the timer T3585 is running.

q_9757.question: What is the purpose of the TimeAndTimezone parameter in the eZone?
q_9757.ground_truth: The TimeAndTimezone parameter is used to specify the time and timezone in the eZone.

q_9758.question: What does the middle tier TS refer to in the context of 3GPP?
q_9758.ground_truth: The middle tier TS is a term used for the 3GPP charging TSs that specify the domain/subsystem/service specific, online and offline, charging functionality. These are all the TSs in the numbering range from 3GPP TS 32.250 to 3GPP TS 32.279. Currently, there is only one "tier 1" TS in 3GPP, which is 3GPP TS 32.240 that specifies the charging architecture and principles.

q_9759.question: What kind of equipment is typically available on the stage for a live event?
q_9759.ground_truth: PMSE (Professional Mobile Service in the European Spectrum) equipment is typically available on the stage for a live event.

q_9760.question: What is the purpose and format of the Event AVP?
q_9760.ground_truth: The Event AVP is of type UTF8String and holds the content of the "Event" header. It is of type Grouped and contains information about the type of chargeable telecommunication service/event for which the ACR and/or CCR messages are generated.

q_9761.question: What information should be sent to the ADMF from the 3G~ICEs for the activation of intercepted Content of Communications?
q_9761.ground_truth: The information sent from the ADMF to the Delivery Function for the activation of intercepted Content of Communications includes the target identity, the address(es) of delivery for CC, a DF3 activation identity, the IA in case of location dependent interception, interception of international outbound roaming IMS VoIP interception (allowed/not allowed), and the warrant reference number if required by national option.

q_9762.question: What happens when one RTP packet is lost in redundancy level 2?
q_9762.ground_truth: No data block will be lost when one RTP packet is lost in redundancy level 2.

q_9763.question: What is the action of the MNSMS-ABORT-REQuest service primitive in the CM-sublayer?
q_9763.ground_truth: The MNSMS-ABORT-REQuest service primitive in the CM-sublayer is used to request the release of a connection in abnormal cases. When the CM-sublayer receives this request, it may form and send the CP-ERROR message to release the connection and then release the lower layer services.

q_9764.question: What is the event that triggers the activation of a GA-PSR Transport Channel?
q_9764.ground_truth: The GA-PSR Transport Channel is activated when the MS GA-PSR is in GA-PSR-STANDBY state and the LLC layer requests the transfer of one or more uplink LLC-PDUs.

q_9765.question: What should be used to encode non-decimal characters such as '*', '#', 'a', 'b', 'c', and 'd' in Generic Digits?
q_9765.ground_truth: The IA5 character encoding scheme should be used

q_9766.question: How many power classes are defined for GSM 850 and GSM 900?
q_9766.ground_truth: For GSM 850 and GSM 900, there are five power classes defined.

q_9767.question: What should the NAS do upon detecting one of the events listed in subclause~4.5.1 while in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication, if there is uplink user data pending for one or more PDU sessions?
q_9767.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate the respective PDU sessions in the Uplink data status IE as specified in subclause~5.5.1.3.2 and 5.6.1.2, regardless of the access category for which the access barring check is performed.

q_9768.question: How are occluded areas handled in the depth adjustment process for stereoscopic 3D video content?
q_9768.ground_truth: Occluded areas are assigned a depth value that is inferior to the main objects depth value, thus causing them to be hidden in the right view. Dis-occluded areas in the new right view may be filled through inpainting, taking the original right view as a source of information.

q_9769.question: How does the MS route uplink PDP PDUs when in 'MS/NW' mode?
q_9769.ground_truth: When multiple PDP contexts exist for the same PDP address/APN pair of an MS in 'MS/NW' mode, the MS routes uplink PDP-PDUs to the different PDP contexts based on uplink packet filters in the TFTs assigned to these PDP contexts.

q_9770.question: What type of signal is used for the time-to-frequency conversion in 6.8.1.4.2.1?
q_9770.ground_truth: The time-to-frequency conversion is achieved with a type II DCT, giving a resolution of 25Hz.

q_9771.question: What is the difference between an in-band and out-of-band relay?
q_9771.ground_truth: An in-band relay is a Relay where the access link and backhaul link operate in the same operating band, while an out-of-band relay is a Relay where the access link and backhaul link operate in different operating bands.

q_9772.question: Can the information related with QoS be exposed to the Edge Application Server in the 3GPP network?
q_9772.ground_truth: Yes, the information related with QoS can be exposed to the Edge Application Server directly from the NEF in the 3GPP network.

q_9773.question: What is the issue when a User Equipment (UE) in a MCPTT call moves in or out of MBMS coverage?
q_9773.ground_truth: The delay for unicast reception and for MBMS reception may be different, which may distort the quality during handoffs.

q_9774.question: What is the function of the Call Gap IF?
q_9774.ground_truth: It is used to activate/modify/remove a call gap mechanism in the gsmSSF to reduce the rate of service requests sent to a gsmSCF.

q_9775.question: What should the UE do with the operator-defined access category definitions received in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_9775.ground_truth: If the UE receives the Operator-defined access category definitions IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message and the Operator-defined access category definitions IE contains one or more operator-defined access category definitions, the UE shall delete any operator-defined access category definitions stored for the RPLMN and shall store the received operator-defined access category definitions for the RPLMN. If the Operator-defined access category definitions IE contains no operator-defined access category definitions, the UE shall delete any operator-defined access category definitions stored for the RPLMN. If the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message does not contain the Operator-defined access category definitions IE, the UE shall not delete the operator-defined access category definitions stored for the RPLMN.

q_9776.question: What is the purpose of the "generic frame format" in the EVS Codec for 3G Circuit-Switched Networks?
q_9776.ground_truth: The "generic frame format" for the EVS Codec is used as a common reference point when interfacing speech frames between different elements of the 3G system in 3G Circuit-Switched Networks.

q_9777.question: What is the purpose of the reference sensitivity level in section 11.1.2.1?
q_9777.ground_truth: The reference sensitivity level in section 11.1.2.1 is the minimum mean power received at the UE antenna port at which the BIT Error Ratio (BER) shall not exceed a specific value.

q_9778.question: What information does the TAR coding in AID coding provide and how many bytes is it?
q_9778.ground_truth: The TAR coding in AID coding provides Applet instance number, Applet Class number, and Package number. It is composed of 3 bytes or 24 bits.

q_9779.question: What is the role of the RRC message UTRAN Mobility Information Confirm?
q_9779.ground_truth: The RRC message UTRAN Mobility Information Confirm is sent by the UE to acknowledge the RNTI reallocation.

q_9780.question: What is the maximum bit rate for downlink in the third set of network and bearer interfaces?

q_9781.question: What action should the UE perform if barring is alleviated for Access Category '8' and upper layers do not request RRC the resumption of an RRC connection?
q_9781.ground_truth: The UE should initiate RRC connection resume procedure in 5.3.13.2 with resumeCause value set to rna-Update if barring is alleviated for Access Category '8' and upper layers do not request RRC the resumption of an RRC connection.

q_9782.question: What should a UE do when it receives a new SOR-CMCI while one or more Tsor-cm timers are running and a matching criterion is found with a Tsor-cm timer value of infinity in the new SOR-CMCI?
q_9782.ground_truth: If the Tsor-cm timer associated to the PDU session or service is not running, the UE shall start the Tsor-cm timer associated to the PDU session or service with the value set to infinity. If the Tsor-cm timer associated to the PDU session or service is already running, the UE shall set the value of the Tsor-cm timer associated to the PDU session or service to infinity without stopping and restarting the timer.

q_9783.question: What is the codec quality characterization test in TS 26.118 and what does it assess?
q_9783.ground_truth: The codec quality characterization test in TS 26.118 is a method for assessing the Basic Audio Quality attribute at different bit-rates for a given audio profile.

q_9784.question: What is the effect of an IKEv2 INFORMATIONAL Request message with WLAN usable indication to the ePDG?
q_9784.ground_truth: The ePDG sends an IKEv2 INFORMATIONAL Response message to the UE with the WLAN usable indication, which is then sent from the ePDG to the PDN GW within a Bearer Resource Command. The PDN GW then provides updated Routing Rules to the UE based on the updated PCC rules received from PCRF.

q_9785.question: What should the AMF do if the UE includes the 5GS update type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with the SMS requested bit set to "SMS over NAS not supported" and the UE is not considered available for SMS over NAS?
q_9785.ground_truth: The AMF should store the SMSF address in the UE 5GMM context and consider the UE available for SMS over NAS.

q_9786.question: What kind of network connection was used in the example for the "OPEN CHANNEL" command?
q_9786.ground_truth: The network connection used was GPRS (General Packet Radio Service).

q_9787.question: How does the use of different QoS parameter settings in different networks impact an MTSI communication service?
q_9787.ground_truth: Different networks may use different QoS parameter settings, which could result in different bitrates in different networks, even if one user has a higher bitrate than GBR and the other user has a lower bitrate than GBR.

q_9788.question: What is required of an NGN to be capable of in terms of signalling extension that is not supported?
q_9788.ground_truth: An NGN must be capable of tolerating and passing on without modification any signalling extension that is not supported.

q_9789.question: How is the excitation signal shaped spectrally for bit rates below 24.4 kb/s?
q_9789.ground_truth: For bit rates below 24.4 kb/s, the excitation signal is shaped spectrally using a single LPC synthesis filter, resulting in the shaped excitation signal (723).

q_9790.question: In 6.2.4.2, what is the role of the IBCF when presenting a request originated in an untrusted NGCN in relation to a particular NGCN user?
q_9790.ground_truth: The IBCF removes any identity provided by the NGCN site in the P-Preferred-Identity header field or in the P-Asserted-Identity header field and instead provides a default identity in the P-Asserted-Identity header field that identifies a NGCN user who operates with the authority of the NGCN operator.

q_9791.question: What is the operation code for activating unconditional call forwarding in the REGISTER 2.1B coding?

q_9792.question: What role does the ProSe upper layer play in the transmission of a protocol data unit?
q_9792.ground_truth: The ProSe upper layer provides a ProSe Per-Packet Reliability from a range of 8 possible values when passing a protocol data unit for transmission to the PC5 access stratum. The ProSe access stratum uses this information to decide and adjust the transmission behavior.

q_9793.question: What is the purpose of the PHY-Data-IND primitive in the 3GPP L1-L3 interface?
q_9793.ground_truth: The PHY-Data-IND primitive is used to indicate L2 SDUs that are passed to and from the physical layer. It is submitted every Transmission Time Interval for each Transport Channel.

q_9794.question: What are the supplementary services that the user can access with the CTS-MS?
q_9794.ground_truth: The user can access all the standardized supplementary services provided in the GSM, and the operation of the services should be the same in GSM and cordless mode.

q_9795.question: What is the meaning of the construction "shall" in a 3GPP technical specification?
q_9795.ground_truth: In a 3GPP technical specification, the construction "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_9796.question: In what ways can the core network notify an RRC connected UE about a new MBMS session during an ongoing MBMS session?
q_9796.ground_truth: The SGSN sends the list of MBMS bearer services that the user has activated to the UTRAN, and the RNC notifies the RRC connected UE about the new MBMS session.

q_9797.question: Which message type is sent to provide broadcast information required by non-GSM networks?
q_9797.ground_truth: PACKET SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 7, message type 11.2.23b

q_9798.question: What is the requirement for an SC when supporting trigger SMS filtering for Tsms submissions?
q_9798.ground_truth: The SC shall use the TP-Protocol-Identifier containing a Device Triggering Short Message code as an indication of trigger SMS and compare it against a list of known SMEs to filter and block all short messages that do not originate from trusted SMEs.

q_9799.question: What is the difference between coarse-grained and fine-grained access control policies in 3GPP TS 33.234?
q_9799.ground_truth: Coarse-grained access control policy allows an application to have access to all possible GAA credentials, while fine-grained access control policy only allows certain applications to have access to certain GAA credentials.

q_9800.question: What should a UE do when it is required to perform BSIC re-confirmation for a GSM cell?
q_9800.ground_truth: The UE should perform the BSIC re-confirmation within the available transmission gap pattern sequence provided by the UTRAN.

q_9801.question: How many domains does the UMTS infrastructure consist of?
q_9801.ground_truth: The UMTS infrastructure is split into three domains: the Access Network Domain, the Core Network Domain, and the User Equipment Domain.

q_9802.question: What is the role of the 3GPP Diameter application in charging?
q_9802.ground_truth: The 3GPP Diameter application is used for LCS domain offline and online charging to enable real-time credit control and interaction with the telecommunications network.

q_9803.question: What should the IMS-ALG do if it determines that a secondary MR needs to be allocated for a certain combination of IP realm, nettype and addrtype in the outgoing SDP offer?
q_9803.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should allocate an MR context using the incoming connection address and port information as the remote connection address and port information for the incoming termination. It should also provide the allocated MR with the incoming codec information if available.

q_9804.question: What is the length of the BCD number in record 5?
q_9804.ground_truth: The length of the BCD number in record 5 is 3.

q_9805.question: What is the role of the USS/UTM in the association authorization phase?
q_9805.ground_truth: The USS/UTM checks certain information to authorize the association, such as verifying the UPID requested by the UAV-C corresponds to an authorized and available UAV, and the UAV's owner/pilot certificate matches that of the UAV-C.

q_9806.question: What is the responsibility of the operators in alarm handling in a 3GPP system?
q_9806.ground_truth: The operators are responsible for recognizing, acknowledging, verifying, getting enhanced information, analyzing, taking actions, and continuing the surveillance of alarms in the network.

q_9807.question: What occurs in step 1 of the HS-DSCH Transport Bearer Replacement procedure?
q_9807.ground_truth: In step 1 of the HS-DSCH Transport Bearer Replacement procedure, a new transport bearer is established, causing two transport bearers to exist in parallel. Normal communication continues on the old transport bearer, and the new transport bearer supports HS-DSCH DATA FRAMEs (TYPE 1 or TYPE 2), certain control frames, and HS-DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION (TYPE 1 or TYPE 2) Control Frames.

q_9808.question: What action is taken when the SGSN receives an Activate PDP Context request from the MS during the Idle state?
q_9808.ground_truth: The interface is idled and the request is analyzed.

q_9809.question: What is the potential issue with using the 40 MHz B2F full duplexer approach in the B2 option for the 6 MHz duplex gap?
q_9809.ground_truth: The 40 MHz B2F full duplexer approach has a higher insertion loss in the 6 MHz duplex gap and may not provide sufficient Tx-Rx isolation, particularly in challenging conditions. Additionally, this approach may negatively impact the REFSENS performance of the n71 band.

q_9810.question: What value should the IWF set the ICSI value to in the P-Asserted-Service header field of the SIP PUBLISH request when sending an affiliation request to the MCPTT server?

q_9811.question: What are the differences between SIP-based endpoints and legacy endpoints in terms of connectivity to a HES?
q_9811.ground_truth: SIP-based endpoints can be connected to the IMS via any IP-CAN valid for the current specification release, while legacy endpoints may be connected via a media gateway or a SIP-based Voice over IP Gateway (VGW). A media gateway is controlled by the AGCF, while a SIP-based Voice over IP Gateway plays the role of a UE with regards to the P-CSCF.

q_9812.question: What is the difference between LTE and this solution in terms of the use of UE-to-network relay?
q_9812.ground_truth: In LTE, UE-to-network relay is only used for public safety services, while in this solution, it is mainly used for commercial services.

q_9813.question: What is the HARQ feedback mode for the second HARQ-ACK reporting mode when the UE correctly decodes a transport block?
q_9813.ground_truth: The HARQ feedback is not transmitted.

q_9814.question: What initiative by AIMS (Alliance for IP Media Solutions) provides a lower-cost approach to synchronization using mezzanine compression and NMOS discovery and connection?

q_9815.question: Which command is sent by the TDF to the PCRF in response to the RAR command to acknowledge the report of the application's traffic start/stop and provision ADC rules and event triggers?
q_9815.ground_truth: The CCA command is sent by the TDF to the PCRF in response to the RAR command to acknowledge the report of the application's traffic start/stop and provision ADC rules and event triggers.

q_9816.question: What must the JAR file's manifest file contain as a minimum in order to be compliant with the MExE specification?
q_9816.ground_truth: The JAR file's manifest file must contain the "MExE-Implementation-Type" attribute.

q_9817.question: What happens if a target BSS/GANC cannot grant the requested QoS for the PS Handover procedure in the inter-RAT handover from E-UTRAN to GERAN A/Gb mode?
q_9817.ground_truth: The target BSS/GANC may reject the use of the PS Handover procedure and the new SGSN will release any allocated resources related to the specific MS.

q_9818.question: What is the CQI Type A versus Type B reporting ratio used to define the minimum performance requirements of CQI reporting under MIMO single stream conditions?
q_9818.ground_truth: The CQI Type A versus Type B reporting ratio used is 1 / 2.

q_9819.question: What should the IWF do if the received SIP re-INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the imminentperil-ind element set to "false" and is an unauthorized request for an MCPTT imminent peril call cancellation?
q_9819.ground_truth: The IWF should reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a 403 (Forbidden) response and include a specific application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the response.

q_9820.question: What is the expected result after reading a SMS stored on the ISIM if both USIM and ISIM are present?
q_9820.ground_truth: The correct text of the SMS on the ISIM is read and displayed to the user, and the EF_SMS record 1 of the ISIM contains the status byte set to SMS read with the entire content of the SMS unchanged.

q_9821.question: How many power reduction settings were tested in the scenarios that resulted in handover failures?
q_9821.ground_truth: Handover failures were observed in three power reduction settings.

q_9822.question: What should the UE do after receiving the changed AS IP address from the application layer?
q_9822.ground_truth: The UE recognizes the new EAS IP address provided by the lower layer and switches to the new EAS immediately.

q_9823.question: What is the purpose of the TC-CONTINUE service, as per clause 14.1.3.1.2?
q_9823.ground_truth: The TC-CONTINUE service is used to report the success of operations invoked in a TC-BEGIN service and to invoke or respond to any other operations.

q_9824.question: What is the purpose of the test for the secondary CPICH power offset accuracy in MIMO mode?
q_9824.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the BS under test delivers the advertised power offset for S-CPICH power within margins, thereby allowing reliable MIMO HS-DSCH demodulation and CQI reporting.

q_9825.question: What is the main objective of the European Public Warning System service features?
q_9825.ground_truth: The main objective of the European Public Warning System service features is to provide high speed notification delivery to a large audience, deliver messages within a planned specified time, offer sufficient details of the emergency situation, target specific audiences or geographies, be accessible to authorized users, and be intrusive to ensure the message is noticed.

q_9826.question: What is the size of the absolute grant (power) value field in the E-AGCH type 2?
q_9826.ground_truth: The absolute grant (power) value (xpg,1, xpg,2, ... xpg,5) is represented by 5 bits.

q_9827.question: Which network interface is the radio interface between the UTRAN and the UE in the 3GPP system?
q_9827.ground_truth: The abbreviation for the "User Equipment" in the context of 3GPP specifications is Uu.

q_9828.question: How does the PCRF provide a maximum allowed bit rate for an ADC rule to the TDF?
q_9828.ground_truth: The PCRF provides the maximum allowed bit rate (QoS) for an ADC rule to the TDF using the ADC rule provisioning procedure. The allowed QoS is encoded using a QoS-Information AVP within the ADC-Rule-Definition AVP of the ADC rule.

q_9829.question: What is the type of the "bindingID" attribute defined in the "ul-common-E-DCH-MACflow-Specific-InfoResponseList-Item" structure?
q_9829.ground_truth: The type of "bindingID" attribute is BindingID and it is optional.

q_9830.question: What is the purpose of the RAB-Parameter-MaxBitrateList and RAB-Parameter-GuaranteedBitrateList in the 3GPP TS 25.427 standard?
q_9830.ground_truth: The RAB-Parameter-MaxBitrateList and RAB-Parameter-GuaranteedBitrateList are used to define the maximum and guaranteed bit rates for the radio access bearer in the 3GPP TS 25.427 standard.

q_9831.question: What is the role of the Node B in the 3GPP network?
q_9831.ground_truth: The Node B is a logical node responsible for radio transmission and reception in one or more cells to/from the User Equipment, and it terminates the Iub interface towards the RNC.

q_9832.question: What is the event that causes the measurement to be incremented in the "SM.AttUpdPdpCtxtMsAndSgsn.Apn" counter in a GGSN?
q_9832.ground_truth: The event that causes the measurement to be incremented is the receipt of an UPDATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message by the GGSN.

q_9833.question: What must the UE do if it is receiving an MBMS Streaming User Service using MBMS delivery on Unicast in E-UTRAN and is interested in receiving the corresponding service via an MBMS Bearer instead?
q_9833.ground_truth: The UE shall handle counting requests as defined in TS 36.300 and TS 36.331.

q_9834.question: What is the definition of "V2X" in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_9834.ground_truth: V2X refers to Vehicle-to-Everything, which is a communication system that enables vehicles to communicate with each other and with their surroundings, such as other vehicles, infrastructure, and pedestrians.

q_9835.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what does it cover in terms of the TS-family?
q_9835.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a group that produces technical specifications for the 3GPP series, including TS 32.432, TS 32.435, and TS 32.436, which focus on the technical specification group for Services and System Aspects and Telecommunication Management. These specifications cover the requirements and information model necessary for the standardized Operation, Administration and Maintenance (OA&M) of a multi-vendor 3G PLMN.

q_9836.question: What does an Iur DSCH data stream correspond to in the UTRAN?
q_9836.ground_truth: An Iur DSCH data stream corresponds to the data carried on one DSCH transport channel for one UE.

q_9837.question: What are the input resolutions used in the test for video sequence coding?
q_9837.ground_truth: The input resolutions used in the test are 4K (4320x2160), 6K (6144x3072), and 8K (8192x4096).

q_9838.question: What is the purpose of talk burst control in PoC sessions?
q_9838.ground_truth: Talk burst control is a protocol for performing talk burst control, which includes media recording, transport and playback that occurs from the point the PoC Client has got the permission to send media until the permission is released.

q_9839.question: What is the maximum size of an I1 protocol message?
q_9839.ground_truth: The size of the I1 protocol messages is constrained by the limits of the transport-layer message size. For example, USSD allows for a message size of 160 octets, but this limit can vary depending on the specific transport-layer connection used.

q_9840.question: What is the impact of this procedure on the AMF?
q_9840.ground_truth: The AMF may need to provide the CdP-UE ID as requested by AUSF, depending on the indication from the UDM.

q_9841.question: What is the purpose of the Allocation/Retention Priority in the context of network traffic?
q_9841.ground_truth: The Allocation/Retention Priority is used to prioritize bearers with a high priority over bearers with a low priority when performing admission control in situations where resources are scarce.

q_9842.question: In Solution #10, what is the role of the Network Exposure Function (NEF) when verifying the association of GPSI and A-KID?
q_9842.ground_truth: In Solution #10, when verifying the association of GPSI and A-KID, the NEF is used if the ECS is located out of the 5GC. The NEF is responsible for sending an association check request to UDM, including the GPSI and A-KID.

q_9843.question: When can RTP Telephony Event DTMF digit detection be performed?
q_9843.ground_truth: The RTP Telephony Event DTMF digit detection shall be performed in accordance with IETF RFC 4733 and additional requirements for the bearer independent CS core network.

q_9844.question: What capabilities should the UE indicate in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports the paging indication for voice services and reject paging request?
q_9844.ground_truth: The UE should set the paging indication for voice services bit and the reject paging request bit to "supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_9845.question: What coding scheme is used to indicate the priority of a CBS message?
q_9845.ground_truth: The Category field in a CBS message uses a binary number, where specific values indicate the priority of the message such as high, normal, or background.

q_9846.question: What information is provided by the MS to the Provisioning GANC during the GA-RC DISCOVERY REQUEST message?
q_9846.ground_truth: The information provided includes: cell ID, AP-ID, IMSI, GAN Classmark which contains indications of A/Gb Mode supported, Iu Mode supported.

q_9847.question: What is the impact of invoking the OIR service in IMS Multimedia Telephony?
q_9847.ground_truth: When the OIR service has been invoked, the originating party's identity information shall not be presented to the forwarded-to party unless the forwarded-to party has an override capability. This means that the originating party's identity will be withheld and not presented to the terminating party.

q_9848.question: What should the Target NG-RAN do if a MB Session Context for the TMGI does not already exist?
q_9848.ground_truth: The Target NG-RAN creates a MB Session Context, sets it to active state, stores the TMGI, the QoS Profile and a list of AMF IDs in the MB Session Context, and invokes reception of the MB data.

q_9849.question: What action should the SCC AS take if the SIP final response was a non 2xx response when sending a SIP re-INVITE or SIP UPDATE request to the remote UE in a collaborative session?
q_9849.ground_truth: If the SIP final response was a non 2xx response when sending a SIP re-INVITE or SIP UPDATE request to the remote UE in a collaborative session, the SCC AS should consider the transfer operation failed and send a SIP re-INVITE request if a 2xx response has been received from the controller UE or a SIP UPDATE request if a final response has not yet been received from the controller UE. The SCC AS should include SDP reoffering the media component(s) that were offered to the UE that did not accept the SDP offer.

q_9850.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an EAP-success message and a partial native 5G NAS security context has not been generated?
q_9850.ground_truth: The UE should generate KAUSF from the EMSK, KSEAF from the KAUSF, and KAMF from the ABBA received with the EAP-success message, and create a partial native 5G NAS security context identified by the ngKSI value in the volatile memory of the ME. The UE should store the KAMF in the created partial native 5G NAS security context.

q_9851.question: What state is the GMLC in when it is awaiting a response from the home HLR/HSS of the UE to be located?
q_9851.ground_truth: The GMLC is in the INTERROGATION state when it is awaiting a response from the home HLR/HSS of the UE to be located.

q_9852.question: What decision triggers the RAN node to perform a mode switch in the multicast service data delivery method?
q_9852.ground_truth: The RAN node decides to perform a mode switch based on the number of interesting users for the multicast service.

q_9853.question: What is the format of the Extension-TerminationMeasurementList message?
q_9853.ground_truth: The Extension-TerminationMeasurementList message is a sequence of Extension-TerminationMeasurementItem, which is a sequence containing measurementID and iE-Extensions, which are optional.

q_9854.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives a downlink assignment for this PDCCH occasion and this serving cell on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's CS-RNTI and has received a downlink assignment for this PDCCH occasion and another serving cell on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's C-RNTI or Temporary C-RNTI?
q_9854.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the NDI for the corresponding HARQ process not to have been toggled, indicate the presence of a downlink assignment for this serving cell, and deliver the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity.

q_9855.question: What is the maximum number of pages and the total number of pages in the Cell Broadcast Download with a User Data Header?
q_9855.ground_truth: The maximum number of pages is 2, and the total number of pages is 1.

q_9856.question: What is the effect of intercarrier interleaving on CS Connection Setup while in packet transfer mode?
q_9856.ground_truth: Intercarrier interleaving in CS Connection Setup while in packet transfer mode avoids the need for any resource re-allocation during call setup, reducing the signaling load on the BSS.

q_9857.question: What is the purpose of the TU4001 timer in the GA-PSR Transport Channel?
q_9857.ground_truth: The TU4001 timer controls the life-time of the GA-PSR TC in the GA-PSR Transport Channel.

q_9858.question: What is the method used for UE power saving in MBMS TV service in the 9th release?
q_9858.ground_truth: Efficient power usage is achieved in the 9th release without incurring long switching delay by using IVS (Integrated Video Services) to provide quick view of low-quality video while the UE is performing stream switching.

q_9859.question: What is the difference between CTS-FP and CTS-MS in the context of the GSM Cordless Telephony System?
q_9859.ground_truth: CTS-FP is a device which offers personal cordless coverage and acts as a link between the CTS-MS and the fixed network or GSM network, while CTS-MS is a GSM MS with CTS capability.

q_9860.question: What is the purpose of converting CQI values to binary for channel quality indication in Type A CQI?
q_9860.ground_truth: The purpose of converting CQI values to binary for channel quality indication in Type A CQI is to map them to the channel quality indication bits (1 0 0 0 0) to (1 1 1 1 1).

q_9861.question: What is the purpose of the Reset procedure in the Lb interface?
q_9861.ground_truth: The Reset procedure in the Lb interface is an optional procedure that allows an SMLC or BSS that has undergone a failure to indicate this to a partner entity, resulting in the release of connection and transaction resources.

q_9862.question: What is the purpose of the P2 Rest Octets in message type PAGING REQUEST TYPE 2?
q_9862.ground_truth: The P2 Rest Octets in message type PAGING REQUEST TYPE 2 contains the channel needed indication related to the paging of Mobile Identity 3 and additional information regarding an MBMS notification.

q_9863.question: What should the MAC entity do when a drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-PTM expires and the corresponding HARQ process data was not successfully decoded, in the context of multicast DRX operation per G-RNTI or per G-CS-RNTI?
q_9863.ground_truth: The MAC entity should start the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the expiry of drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-PTM.

q_9864.question: What is the function of ROHC in UE test mode?
q_9864.ground_truth: ROHC functionality in PDCP Layer 2 is optional for UE implementations.

q_9865.question: What is the purpose of the 1.28 Mcps TDD Uplink Physical Channel Capability IE in the context of TS 25.306?
q_9865.ground_truth: The 1.28 Mcps TDD Uplink Physical Channel Capability IE defines the UE uplink radio access capacity in the context of TS 25.306.

q_9866.question: What type of PDU is sent from the BSS to the SGSN, indicating that the contained BVC shall be blocked at the recipient entity, and is used to block a BVC at the recipient entity?

q_9867.question: When does the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure?
q_9867.ground_truth: The UE initiates the measurement reporting procedure only after successful security activation, as specified in clause 5.5.5.1.

q_9868.question: What should the DRNS start if the Fast TTI switching Mode Requested Synchronized IE is included with Mode 1 in the E-DCH FDD Information To Modify IE?
q_9868.ground_truth: The DRNS shall start the TTI switch process preparation if it supports it.

q_9869.question: What must the PCRF ensure before indicating to the PCEF that an access is removed from a multiple access IP-CAN session?
q_9869.ground_truth: The PCRF must ensure that there is at least one PCC Rule that can be bound to the default bearer of each access.

q_9870.question: What are the tasks in the capacity optimization workflow that the telecom system can execute in Level 3 of network autonomy?
q_9870.ground_truth: In Level 3 of network autonomy, the telecom system can execute the tasks of analyzing the coverage optimization solution (Task E) and determining the coverage adjustment actions (Task F) to be executed based on coverage requirements and/or optimization policies specified by human.

q_9871.question: What is the mechanism of HS-SCCH-less HS-DSCH transmission?
q_9871.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH-less HS-DSCH transmission is a mechanism where the first HS-DSCH transmission of small transport blocks is performed without the accompanying HS-SCCH, and the subsequent retransmissions are accompanied by the HS-SCCH. The UE must maintain a cyclic soft buffer storing 13 contiguous TTIs for HS-SCCH-less HS-DSCH blind decoding.

q_9872.question: Which network-independent means of location verification are possible for implementation in UE?
q_9872.ground_truth: GPS is a commonly used network-independent location verification method in UE, but it can also be vulnerable to spoofing.

q_9873.question: What is the representation of the hybrid-ARQ process information when it is used to indicate the combination of HARQ-processes?
q_9873.ground_truth: The hybrid-ARQ process information is represented by the hybrid-ARQ process information (4 bits) xhap,1, xhap,2, xhap,3, xhap,4 which are the unsigned binary representation of HAPpb where xhap,1 is MSB.

q_9874.question: What is the aim when the MS is in the limited service state?
q_9874.ground_truth: The aim is to gain normal service rapidly, and only the establishment of emergency calls and the reception of warning notifications are available.

q_9875.question: What information about the EAS IP address replacement is included in steps 2, 3a, 4, 5, and 6 of the AF Influence procedure?
q_9875.ground_truth: The EAS IP address replacement information includes the Anchor EAS IP address, which is discovered by UE during the EAS discovery procedure, and the Serving Local EAS IP address per DNAI, which is provided by the AF for replacement in 5GC for outbound traffic.

q_9876.question: What is the meaning of an error distance of 0 in an Iu UP-Status indication?
q_9876.ground_truth: The error report relates to a local Iu UP function error.

q_9877.question: What is the name of the document that describes the GSM 06.60 codec and its mapping to encoded blocks of 244 bits?

q_9878.question: How does the receiving node treat a message initiating a procedure containing one or more IEs/IE groups marked with "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" which the receiving node does not comprehend?
q_9878.ground_truth: If a message initiating a procedure is received containing one or more IEs/IE groups marked with "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" which the receiving node does not comprehend, the receiving node shall ignore the content of the not comprehended IEs/IE groups, continue with the procedure as if the not comprehended IEs/IE groups were not received using the understood IEs/IE groups, and report in the response message of the procedure that one or more IEs/IE groups have been ignored.

q_9879.question: What is the abort reason used by the gprsSSF to indicate to the gsmSCF that a specific instance already has a TC dialogue open?
q_9879.ground_truth: The abort reason used is overlapping-dialogue.

q_9880.question: What is the performance requirement for frequency hopping under interference conditions?
q_9880.ground_truth: The performance requirement for frequency hopping under interference conditions is that the FER for TCH/FS should be less than 5% under the specified conditions.

q_9881.question: What happens if an Incoming calls barred within the CUG note is present and the call is a non-CUG call which invokes a CUG which does not have an Incoming Access capability?
q_9881.ground_truth: The call is rejected, reason for rejection "Incoming calls barred within the CUG".

q_9882.question: What message should a file repair server provide if it is temporarily unavailable due to overloading in 9.3.7.1?
q_9882.ground_truth: The file repair server should respond with the "503 Service Unavailable" and optionally include a Retry-After header indicating the time to wait before retrying.

q_9883.question: Which IEEE standard does AES67 use for synchronization via Precision Time Protocol (PTP)?
q_9883.ground_truth: AES67 uses IEEE 1588-2008 for synchronization via PTP.

q_9884.question: What action do the UEs take upon receiving the new list of P-CSCFs in step 12 of the network recovery information flow?
q_9884.ground_truth: Upon receiving the new list of P-CSCFs, the UE may perform an initial registration towards a new P-CSCF.

q_9885.question: What is the Evolved Packet System characterized by?
q_9885.ground_truth: The Evolved Packet System is characterized by reduced latency, higher user data rates equating to broadband performance, improved system capacity and coverage, and lower operational costs.

q_9886.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a SIP BYE request from the ICS UE and the CS bearer is not used by any other session?
q_9886.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP BYE request towards the MGCF to release the CS bearer.

q_9887.question: What feedback can be collected from NG-RAN nodes to optimize the performance of AI/ML-based network energy saving?
q_9887.ground_truth: The feedback that can be collected from NG-RAN nodes to optimize the performance of AI/ML-based network energy saving include resource status of neighboring NG-RAN nodes, energy efficiency, UE performance affected by energy saving actions, and system KPIs such as throughput, delay, and RLF of current and neighboring NG-RAN nodes.

q_9888.question: Who is informed about conference recording?
q_9888.ground_truth: Conference participants are informed prior to the start of a conference, or when joining an ongoing conference, that the conference will be or is being recorded.

q_9889.question: What should the DRNC include in the ERROR INDICATION message if there is no UE context in the DRNC while processing a message using connectionless mode of the signalling bearer?
q_9889.ground_truth: The DRNC shall include the D-RNTI from the received message in the D-RNTI IE and set the Cause IE to ``Unknown RNTI'' in the ERROR INDICATION message.

q_9890.question: What is the purpose of horizontal Kamf derivation in the 5G network?
q_9890.ground_truth: Horizontal Kamf derivation is the process of generating a new Kamf-1 key that can be used by the target AMF. This ensures that the target AMF has no access to the Kamf-0 key used by the initial AMF. The target AMF can then run a NAS SMC procedure with the UE to take the new Kamf-1 key into use.

q_9891.question: Which component in the UE selects a QUIC connection for each PDU based on the QUIC Connection Selection Descriptor in the matching ATSSS rule?

q_9892.question: What message does the MS transmit to indicate the completion of the handover procedure at its end in the GERAN to GAN handover scenario?
q_9892.ground_truth: The MS transmits the GA-RRC HANDOVER COMPLETE message to indicate the completion of the handover procedure at its end.

q_9893.question: What message is used by the Core Network to page a mobile station that is currently GPRS attached via the GAN for a Circuit Switched (CS) domain service?
q_9893.ground_truth: The PAGING CS message is used to page a mobile station that is currently GPRS attached via the GAN for a CS domain service.

q_9894.question: What is one technique that can be used for control channel protection in co-channel HeNB deployments?
q_9894.ground_truth: One technique is controlling HeNB downlink interference towards macro eNB control channels by frequency partitioning with per-subband interference estimation.

q_9895.question: Which criticality and type does the "id-RAB-ID" IE within the RAB-RelocationReleaseItem have?
q_9895.ground_truth: The critically of the "id-RAB-ID" IE within the RAB-RelocationReleaseItem is ignore and the type is RAB-ID.

q_9896.question: How does the 3GPP QoS framework handle traffic between the Guaranteed Flow Bit Rate (GFBR) and Maximum Flow Bit Rate (MFBR) for a guaranteed bit rate QoS flow?
q_9896.ground_truth: The 3GPP QoS framework does not define a specific behavior for the scheduling priority to achieve a target quality bitrate larger than GFBR, but less than MFBR. Instead, it focuses on general resource distribution not related to the useful target bitrate.

q_9897.question: How is ciphering provided in the RLC sublayer or in the MAC sublayer in 3GPP TS 45.005?
q_9897.ground_truth: In 3GPP TS 45.005, ciphering is provided by the RLC sublayer for ciphering/deciphering RLC data blocks in non-transparent RLC mode, and by the MAC sublayer for ciphering/deciphering user data in transparent RLC mode.

q_9898.question: What is the function of the General Access Resource Control (GA-RC) protocol in the CS domain control plane of the GAN Iu mode?
q_9898.ground_truth: The General Access Resource Control (GA-RC) protocol in the CS domain control plane of the GAN Iu mode manages the Up session, including the GAN discovery and registration procedures.

q_9899.question: What should the UE do with the stored list when it receives a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message containing a list of equivalent PLMNs?
q_9899.ground_truth: The UE should store the list as provided by the network, replace the stored list on each receipt of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, and delete the stored list if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message does not contain a list.

q_9900.question: In what memory location is the 5GS update status stored if the UE is SNPN enabled and operating in SNPN access mode?
q_9900.ground_truth: The 5GS update status is stored in the non-volatile memory in the ME.

q_9901.question: Which frequency band is shared between IMT and Radio Astronomy Service in India, on a primary basis?
q_9901.ground_truth: The band 608-614 MHz is shared between IMT and Radio Astronomy Service in India, on a primary basis.

q_9902.question: What is the Spare Extension in the RACH DATA FRAME used for?
q_9902.ground_truth: The Spare Extension in the RACH DATA FRAME is used to indicate the location where new IEs can be added in a backward compatible way. However, it should not be used by the transmitter and should be ignored by the receiver. Spare bits in the frame should be set to 0 by the transmitter and ignored by the receiver.

q_9903.question: What message does the CN use to signal the GANC to handover the MS to the GERAN, ending the handover preparation phase?
q_9903.ground_truth: The CN signals the GANC to handover the MS to the GERAN, using Handover Command message, ending the handover preparation phase.

q_9904.question: When is the card present in the reader?
q_9904.ground_truth: In the first and third scenarios, the card is present in the reader.

q_9905.question: What is the functional entity that acts as a single logical repository for storing converged user data in a 3GPP system?

q_9906.question: What should the ME do when it receives GPRS Kc (i.e. GPRS Kc) from CK and IK using conversion function c3 from the USIM?
q_9906.ground_truth: The ME should ignore such GPRS Kc and not store it on USIM or in ME.

q_9907.question: What provides the number of successful UE terminating CS multimedia calls?
q_9907.ground_truth: The measurement MMC.succTermi provides the number of successful UE terminating CS multimedia calls.

q_9908.question: What is the purpose of estimating the global gain in this speech coding system?
q_9908.ground_truth: The purpose of estimating the global gain is to ensure that the total number of bits used to represent each block in the speech signal remains within the total bit budget for the frame.

q_9909.question: What message is sent by the SS to the UE after receiving the LPP PROVIDE CAPABILITIES message, to provide the necessary assistance data that is supported by the UE?
q_9909.ground_truth: The SS sends an LPP PROVIDE ASSISTANCE DATA message to provide the assistance data that is supported by the UE, as indicated in the LPP PROVIDE CAPABILITIES message.

q_9910.question: What does the first digit of the version number in 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network documents indicate?
q_9910.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number in 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network documents indicates the document's status: presented to TSG for information, presented to TSG for approval, or TSG approved document under change control.

q_9911.question: What happens to terminals without access to a USIM when they receive PWS notifications?
q_9911.ground_truth: They display all PWS notifications to the user and optionally inform the user that the origin of the message is unverified.

q_9912.question: What is the maximum number of PDU sessions that can be established for a network slice if network slice admission control (NSAC) is applied and the SMF performs network slice admission control on the S-NSSAI?
q_9912.ground_truth: The maximum number of PDU sessions on a network slice associated with an S-NSSAI has been defined by the operator policy.

q_9913.question: What was the aim of the verification tests?
q_9913.ground_truth: The verification tests were conducted to obtain a better knowledge of the characteristics of the GSM half rate codec and its performance under different operational conditions. This included testing the codec with special background noise, DTX mode, DTMF tones, signalling tones, delay, frequency response, and complexity.

q_9914.question: What type of traffic is the measurement "Number of Path Update Successful at Secondary Node Additions" valid for?
q_9914.ground_truth: The measurement is valid for packet switched traffic.

q_9915.question: What is the advantage of Solution #46's approach to calculating the "windows of time" compared to other solutions?
q_9915.ground_truth: Solution #46's approach provides an upper bound for the wait time, thereby limiting the service interruption, and enforces back-off of the UE in case the UE was unable to register during a window of time, and retry of the UE during the next occurrence of the window of time.

q_9916.question: What is the number of tail bits used in the convolutional coding for the DBC-450 code?

q_9917.question: What information is carried through a substream when NIC compensation takes place in the overall data stream?
q_9917.ground_truth: Five consecutive N-bits carrying an NIC-code in the M2-sequence indicate 'negative compensation' or 'positive compensation' if such a compensation is required. Otherwise' no compensation' is indicated by the N-bits.

q_9918.question: What are the normalization factors used in the filter bank to compensate energy differences in the sub-band domain?
q_9918.ground_truth: Energy differences in the sub-band domain caused by different transformation lengths are compensated for by appropriate normalization factors in the filter bank, ensuring the accuracy of the analysis and synthesis processes.

q_9919.question: What information is present in the called party address when using single connections in Q.714 and T1.112.4?
q_9919.ground_truth: Subsystem number (SSN) only is present in the called party address for single connections.

q_9920.question: What should the MAC entity do if the random backoff time is not selected during the contention-free Random Access Resource selection procedure?
q_9920.ground_truth: The MAC entity should perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure for 2-step RA type Random Access after the backoff time.

q_9921.question: What is the possible values of the result parameter in the Protocol Negotiation Result event?

q_9922.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects in terms of fault management for mobile networks with virtualized network functions?
q_9922.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects is responsible for specifying the requirements applicable to fault management (FM) of mobile networks that include virtualized network functions.

q_9923.question: What is the format of the "MS Time Zone" IE?
q_9923.ground_truth: The "MS Time Zone" IE represents the time zone adjusted for daylight saving time in steps of 15 minutes, with the last semi-octet of octet 11 set to "1111" if only the IMEI is available.

q_9924.question: What is the maximum frame rate supported by the High Definition (HD) Media Profile and High Definition High bitrate (xHD) Media Profile?
q_9924.ground_truth: The maximum frame rate supported by both the High Definition (HD) Media Profile and High Definition High bitrate (xHD) Media Profile is 60 Hz.

q_9925.question: What is the validity of the provided measurements within the document for circuit-switched and packet-switched traffic?
q_9925.ground_truth: The provided measurements within the document are valid for circuit-switched and packet-switched traffic.

q_9926.question: What determines the unique identification of a service in a 3GPP location-based system?
q_9926.ground_truth: The unique identification of a service in a 3GPP location-based system is determined by the combination of the LCS client identifier and the service identifier.

q_9927.question: How is data requested and collected from NWDAF?
q_9927.ground_truth: Data can be requested and collected from NWDAF using Event Exposure for runtime mode, DRF functionality for storing data, or bulk data collection from NWDAF using a new data management service.

q_9928.question: What do HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-Response, HS-DSCH-First-DRX-Cycle-FACH, HS-DSCH-First-Rx-burst-FACH, HS-DSCH-Paging-System-InformationFDD refer to?
q_9928.ground_truth: These terms are used in 3GPP TS 25.423, related to the High Speed Downlink Shared Channel in UTRAN

q_9929.question: What is the expected sequence of events when a UE returns to the VPLMN after being registered in a higher priority PLMN?
q_9929.ground_truth: The USS (in case of a Terminal accessing UTRAN) or SS (in case of Terminal accessing a GERAN) transmits on a second BCCH with updated network parameters. The UE, after receipt of a RRC CONNECTION REQUEST on the cell related to the BCCH transmitting MCC/MNC 244/081, sends a LOCATION UPDATING REQUEST and then, after receipt of a LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT, responds with a TMSI REALLOCATION COMPLETE (for CS) or a ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE (for PS).

q_9930.question: What is the purpose of including the Supported-Features AVP in every NSR and NSA command in the Ns reference point?
q_9930.ground_truth: The Supported-Features AVP is included in every NSR and NSA command to identify features that have been defined by 3GPP in the Ns reference point.

q_9931.question: What should be included in the parameter for user information in every case?
q_9931.ground_truth: An Object Identifier that identifies the user information and the entity that sent it should always be present.

q_9932.question: What information element in the KILL FAILURE message indicates the list of cells for which the kill operation failed and the reason for the failure?

q_9933.question: What is the purpose of the RIM Protocol Version Number IE in the RAN-INFORMATION-REQUEST/Single Report PDU?
q_9933.ground_truth: The RIM Protocol Version Number IE is set if necessary to indicate the version of the RIM protocol being used in the PDU.

q_9934.question: What does the 3GPP SMIL Language Profile include in addition to the SMIL Basic Profile?
q_9934.ground_truth: The 3GPP SMIL Language Profile includes the MediaAccessibility, MediaDescription, MediaClipping, MetaInformation, PrefetchControl, EventTiming, and BasicTransitions modules in addition to the SMIL Basic Profile.

q_9935.question: What families of measurements are used in the present document?
q_9935.ground_truth: The families of measurements used in the present document are Call Control Management (CC), Mobility Management (MM), Signalling (SIG), Equipment resource (EQPT), Bearer Control (BC), Bearer Transport (BRT), and Service Control (SC).

q_9936.question: Which 3GPP TS provides a framework for Internet Protocol (IP) based streaming applications in 3G networks?
