q_10192.ground_truth: The getFdServices() API returns a list describing the available File Delivery Application Service, where each service is described by several output only parameters, and it does not have any input parameters.

q_10193.question: What parameters are used for second-level PLC method selection in case the last good frame prior to a loss was coded with HQ MDCT?
q_10193.ground_truth: The parameters used for second-level PLC method selection are output sampling rate, bit rate, voicing, correlation, transient condition, and spectral envelope stability based speech/music classification.

q_10194.question: What is required in the Symbol-Based File Repair Request Message when requesting repair data for a single file?
q_10194.ground_truth: The URI or an identifier of the file, and the MD5 hash value of the transport object if present.

q_10195.question: What is a 3DOF source system and how is it identified in the FLUS architecture?
q_10195.ground_truth: A 3DOF source system is a FLUS source system that can be defined in a way that enables the user to view the media content from a single observation point in 3D space. It is identified by the unique identifier urn:org:3gpp:flus:3dof:2017 and is defined with a coordinate system that consists of three axes and the ability to look around from a single observation point in 3D space.

q_10196.question: What does the Power Offset For Secondary CPICH for MIMO IE indicate in the context of TS 25.214?
q_10196.ground_truth: The Power Offset For Secondary CPICH for MIMO IE indicates the relative transmit power of the S-CPICH compared to the primary CPICH transmit power, when S-CPICH is used as a phase reference for a second transmit antenna in MIMO mode.

q_10197.question: In closed loop mode 1, what is the role of the feedback signaling message (FSM) and how are its bits transmitted?
q_10197.ground_truth: The FSM bits are transmitted in the FBI field of uplink DPCCH slot(s), and they are used to transmit power and phase settings.

q_10198.question: What is the SMS TPDU in the SMS-PP Download message 3.1.2?
q_10198.ground_truth: The SMS TPDU in the SMS-PP Download message 3.1.2 is used to download (U)SIM data.

q_10199.question: What is the impact of AMR-WB and WB, SWB, and FB modes of EVS on the intelligibility and quality of MCPTT systems compared to narrowband communication systems such as TETRA and P25?
q_10199.ground_truth: AMR-WB and WB, SWB, and FB modes of EVS significantly improve the intelligibility and quality of MCPTT systems compared to narrowband communication systems such as TETRA and P25.

q_10200.question: What is the purpose of the TP-UDHI bit in the TP-User-Data field?
q_10200.ground_truth: The TP-UDHI bit is used to indicate whether the TP-User-Data field contains only the short message or if it includes a header in addition to the message.

q_10201.question: What is the role of time-slots in wireless communication, in terms of resource allocation and quality?
q_10201.ground_truth: Time-slots within a cell do not offer equal quality in a short-term context. Combining channel mode adaptation and resource allocation helps to avoid Ping-Pong effects between modes, impacting re-packing efficiency and capacity gain.

q_10202.question: What does the "2 out of 3 approach" mean in the context of UMTS network measurements?
q_10202.ground_truth: The "2 out of 3 approach" refers to the rule that at least two out of the three measurements (successful, failed, and aborted GPRS attach procedures, for example) should be taken into account when evaluating the network performance.

q_10203.question: Is it true that If there was another war, Tom and Jerry would join the forces?

q_10204.question: What is the parameter used to adjust the delay spread in the DS of equation (7.6-17) in the angular power profile calculation?

q_10205.question: What is the purpose of the Cause IE in the M3AP protocol?
q_10205.ground_truth: The Cause IE in the M3AP protocol indicates the reason for a particular event for the M3AP protocol.

q_10206.question: What is the format for defining terms in a 3GPP technical document?
q_10206.ground_truth: The format for defining terms in a 3GPP technical document is "<defined term>: <definition>".

q_10207.question: When does the beginning of the time interval T2 align with in relation to the first PRS positioning subframe of a positioning occasion in the reference cell?
q_10207.ground_truth: The beginning of the time interval T2 aligns with 5 ms before the first PRS positioning subframe of a positioning occasion in the reference cell, with 5 ms being the necessary test tolerance.

q_10208.question: How does the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay determine the requirement of PC5 Connection?
q_10208.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-NW relay determines the requirement of PC5 Connection, e.g. S-NSSAI, DNN, QoS, based on other solutions for Key Issue #3.

q_10209.question: What is the function of the MBS Delivery Status Indication in Solution #44?
q_10209.ground_truth: The MBS Delivery Status Indication allows the MB-SMF to notify the AF of conditions affecting the delivery of service, such as the occurrence of a condition that may have been detected at the MB-SMF or reported to the MB-SMF by other entities involved in the MBS delivery.

q_10210.question: What is the role of the MSGin5G Server in handling segmented messages from the MSGin5G Client?
q_10210.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server checks for the Last Segment Flag in each of the received segment before proceeding to Step 4. If the next segment is not received within the expected time, the Server proceeds to Step 4.

q_10211.question: What procedure is used to inform the ng-eNB-CU that an ongoing PWS operation for one or more cells of the ng-eNB-DU has failed?
q_10211.ground_truth: The PWS Failure Indication procedure informs the ng-eNB-CU that ongoing PWS operation for one or more cells of the ng-eNB-DU has failed. The procedure uses non UE-associated signalling.

q_10212.question: In what situation would the UE set the Measurement Results for the Serving Cell within measResultServingMOList?
q_10212.ground_truth: The UE sets the Measurement Results for the Serving Cell within measResultServingMOList when SSB based serving cell measurements are available for the Serving Cell.

q_10213.question: Which coding scheme is used for the turbo coded MCSs defined for radio transmission?
q_10213.ground_truth: For the turbo coded MCSs defined for radio transmission, the same mother convolutional code as used in UTRAN (Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network) is used in combination with linear puncturing.

q_10214.question: What is the difference between the 3GPP JSON Merge Patch and the standard JSON Merge Patch?
q_10214.ground_truth: 3GPP JSON Merge Patch allows for updating, creating, or deleting descendant resources, whereas standard JSON Merge Patch does not. This is achieved by relaxing the constraint on providing the complete updated array value.

q_10215.question: What is the primary motivation for using a generic secure push layer?
q_10215.ground_truth: The main reason for using a generic secure push layer is to avoid duplication of work and specifications in various applications. By using a generic security layer, multiple applications can leverage the same secure push layer without having to implement and maintain individual security mechanisms.

q_10216.question: What are some considerations for signalling regarding whether or not the network would benefit from the knowledge of whether a mobile terminal supports a SAIC advanced receiver technique or not?
q_10216.ground_truth: Some considerations for signalling include eliminating signalling from the work item, having the network deduce from multiple uplink measurement reports whether SAIC is supported, and having the mobile terminal indicate to the network whether it supports advanced receiver capabilities.

q_10217.question: What should the eIMS-AGW be requested when receiving an SCTP stream reset request?
q_10217.ground_truth: The eIMS-AGW should provide a notification to the calling entity and autonomously answer the SCTP stream reset request.

q_10218.question: How much should the UL noise be de-rated when PC2 n77 cross band isolation into n25 is considered?
q_10218.ground_truth: The UL noise should be de-rated by 3.5 dB when PC2 n77 cross band isolation into n25 is considered.

q_10219.question: What is the role of the PCRF in 3GPP networks?
q_10219.ground_truth: The PCRF in 3GPP networks is responsible for provisioning and removal of PCC rules to the PCEF, and the transmission of traffic plane events from the PCEF to the PCRF in order to enforce policy and charging control decisions.

q_10220.question: What should the MGCF do when it receives a hold request and the Contact header in the initial INVITE request or in the 200 OK (INVITE) response has the "isfocus" media feature tag?
q_10220.ground_truth: The MGCF should request the IM-MGW to suspend sending media towards the IMS side by changing the through-connection of the IM CN subsystem side termination to "not through-connected".

q_10221.question: What will the IWF do if a SIP 404 (Not Found) response is not cached and it receives a SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group?
q_10221.ground_truth: The IWF will return a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the SIP INVITE request and include the Warning header field received in the SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

q_10222.question: What should the UE do if it does not find a supported band in the "Multiple E-UTRA frequency band indicator list" and the "Multiple E-UTRA frequency info extension list" is present in the current occurrence of "E-UTRA frequency and priority"?
q_10222.ground_truth: The UE should select the first entry in the "Multiple E-UTRA frequency band extension indicator list" that it supports and compute the corresponding EARFCN downlink (Nd) value.

q_10223.question: What is the purpose of the Media Source Extensions (MSE) API in HTML5?
q_10223.ground_truth: The Media Source Extensions (MSE) API in HTML5 allows integration of media streaming into HTML5 documents and provides a flexible solution that can be used in different environments and applications. It currently supports three byte stream formats, including the ISO BMFF Byte Stream Format.

q_10224.question: Which profiles and bit depths are used for H.265/HEVC anchors?
q_10224.ground_truth: The H.265/HEVC anchors use Main 10 Profile and an internal bitdepth of 10 for all sequences.

q_10225.question: If the server does not support the requested scale value or the content does not support it, what action does the server take for scaled playout?
q_10225.ground_truth: The server decides the level of scaled playout to serve to the client.

q_10226.question: Which algorithm is used to determine a minimum set of source symbols for successful recovery of a matrix?
q_10226.ground_truth: The algorithm described in option 6.1.3.1 uses maximum Gaussian elimination on matrix A to determine a minimum set of source symbols for successful recovery.

q_10227.question: What is the attribute name for the "appServiceDescriptionURI" element in the schema?
q_10227.ground_truth: The attribute name for the "appServiceDescriptionURI" element is "xs:anyURI".

q_10228.question: What action does the IP-SM-GW take when it detects that the UE is reachable for SMS over IP and the UE is registered with support of Converged IP Messaging, SIMPLE IM or SMSIP capability?
q_10228.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW clears local UNRI and informs HLR/HSS that the UE is available again.

q_10229.question: What should a mobile station do when timer T3168 expires and no uplink TBFs are ongoing or have received an uplink assignment with a TBF starting time?
q_10229.ground_truth: The mobile station shall stop all remaining instances of timer T3168 and perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_10230.question: What is the general format of the SYSTEM INFORMATION UPDATE REQUEST message?
q_10230.ground_truth: The SYSTEM INFORMATION UPDATE REQUEST message contains protocolIEs which is a mandatory presence and protocolExtensions that is optional.

q_10231.question: In which situations can the phase shifters change state for beam switching?
q_10231.ground_truth: The phase shifters can change state in a few nanoseconds when using the technology already available today. However, the complete radio system requires more time to change state. The phase shifters can change state during the initial access or during a separate guard time reserved for the link direction switching.

q_10232.question: What is the requirement for receiver resources allocation in a multicarrier BTS?
q_10232.ground_truth: The required receiver resources for the declared maximum supported number of wanted signals shall be allocated and activated simultaneously at frequencies as evenly distributed as possible over the declared maximum Base Station RF bandwidth including the band edges of the Base Station RF bandwidth during the complete test.

q_10233.question: What is the purpose of offering mandatory and optional codecs in a conference?
q_10233.ground_truth: The purpose of offering mandatory codecs is to guarantee that all terminals use these mandatory codecs and no transcoding would be required, while offering optional codecs can improve conference quality or performance.

q_10234.question: What information does the Midamble Shift and Burst Type information element indicate?
q_10234.ground_truth: It indicates burst type and midamble allocation, with three different midamble allocation schemes possible.

q_10235.question: What is the capacity performance for FR2, Indoor Hotspot DL, with 400MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, SU-MIMO, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, 30Mbps, Option 1 UE Antenna parameters: (M, N, P) = (1, 4, 2), 3 panels (left, right, top)?
q_10235.ground_truth: The capacity performance is 34 UEs per cell.

q_10236.question: What is the main purpose of alarm incident analysis in network operation and maintenance?
q_10236.ground_truth: The main purpose of alarm incident analysis is to improve the efficiency of network operation and maintenance by correlating and analyzing alarms and deteriorated performance measurements of the same root cause.

q_10237.question: What happens after VAE server 2 determines the local service information based on the UE location?
q_10237.ground_truth: VAE server 2 sends a local service information response, carrying the local service information, to VAE server 1, which then provides the local service information to the VAE client.

q_10238.question: When can an MS use Generic Access in a VPLMN (visited public land mobile network)?
q_10238.ground_truth: An MS can use Generic Access in a VPLMN only if its HPLMN (home public land mobile network) supports and authorizes it.

q_10239.question: What is the expected sequence 9.7 in the context of the 3GPP 31.111 clauses 6.5.4, 8.70 and 8.71?
q_10239.ground_truth: The ME shall parse and display a PROACTIVE COMMAND wrapped in an item with menuID value 9 in the menu tree rooted at the terminal. The word 'Italic' in the displayed name of the item shall be italicized and the word 'On' shall be displayed on the line below the item.

q_10240.question: Which network elements are responsible for interception when the network access is through S2a (trusted Non-3GPP access) for roaming without local breakout (PDN-GW in the HPLMN and S-GW in the VPLMN)?
q_10240.ground_truth: Interception at the PDN-GW is a national option in this case.

q_10241.question: What is the measurement method for intermodulation products with a frequency offset of 1.8 MHz or less from the active TRX in the non-multicarrier BTS class?
q_10241.ground_truth: The power of intermodulation products is measured selectively using video averaging over 50 to 90% of the useful part of the time slot, excluding the mid-amble. The averaging is done over at least 200 time slots, and only active bursts are included in the averaging process. The RF and video filter bandwidth of the measuring instrument should be 30 kHz.

q_10242.question: What parameter within SendAuthenticationInfoArg needs to be present for the Immediate-Response-Preferred AVP to be required within Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP?

q_10243.question: What is the algebraic codebook searchbased on in speech coding?
q_10243.ground_truth: The algebraic codebook search is based on minimizing the mean square error between the weighted input speech and the weighted synthesis speech in closed-loop pitch search.

q_10244.question: Which transmit diversity scheme is employed for the synchronisation channel and/or S-CCPCH in 4.6.2?

q_10245.question: What is the effect of an SGSN sending an SGSN Context Acknowledge message to the old SGSN during a combined RA/LA update?
q_10245.ground_truth: It informs the old SGSN that the new SGSN is ready to receive data packets belonging to the activated PDP contexts.

q_10246.question: What message does the SGSN send to the RAN along with the RANAP message after receiving a RAU Accept message via a hybrid cell, to indicate whether the UE is a CSG member?
q_10246.ground_truth: The SGSN sends an indication whether the UE is a CSG member to the RAN along with the RANAP message.

q_10247.question: What can be inferred about the origin of notifications, as per this clause?
q_10247.ground_truth: The notifications in this clause may originate from implementation objects, but they do not necessarily imply or identify that the notifications are originated from an instance of the class or its derived class.

q_10248.question: What device is used by the master unit controller to send an audio message to all handsets in the intercom system?

q_10249.question: What does the RSN field indicate in the context of HARQ information for FDD E-DCH?
q_10249.ground_truth: The RSN field conveys the uplink HARQ transmission number, and allows the receiver to determine the exact transmission number in combination with the transmission timing.

q_10250.question: What is the role of S-RNTI in a network?
q_10250.ground_truth: S-RNTI is a UE identifier which is allocated by the Serving RNC and unique within this SRNC. It is allocated for all UEs having a RRC connection. S-RNTI is reallocated always when the Serving RNC for the RRC connection is changed and deallocated when the RRC connection is released.

q_10251.question: What is the effect of enabling remote source address filtering in the IMS-ALG?
q_10251.ground_truth: If remote source address filtering is enabled in the IMS-ALG, it will include the information element "Remote source address filtering" in the request sent to the IMS-AGW, and the IMS-AGW will only pass incoming packets from the identified source and discard IP packets from other sources.

q_10252.question: When does the UE store the GUTI and TAI in the UE's non-volatile memory as per CR~1 in 5.1.9?
q_10252.ground_truth: The UE stores the GUTI and TAI in the UE's non-volatile memory as per CR~1 in 5.1.9 if the USIM has service "EMM Information" not available.

q_10253.question: What is the difference between the granularity period and the reporting period in the context of measurement reports?
q_10253.ground_truth: The granularity period is the length of time over which measurements are taken, while the reporting period is the length of time over which measurement reports are assembled. The number of measurement reports assembled into a measurement result file is based on the reporting period.

q_10254.question: What factor influences whether a client will be dis-satisfied during feedback cycles?
q_10254.ground_truth: A client is considered to be dis-satisfied during a feedback cycle if the user token parameter for the client exceeds a certain pre-defined threshold, based on the performance of the user during buffering rate monitoring.

q_10255.question: What is the purpose of the User Plane Interworking Unit (UP-IWU) as defined in 3GPP TS 23.726?
q_10255.ground_truth: The User Plane Interworking Unit (UP-IWU) is a logical function that performs user plane interworking between the SIP-I based CS Domain and external SIP-I networks, external ISUP networks, or BICC/ISUP based 3GPP CS networks.

q_10256.question: What is a playout curve in the context of buffering and bitrate control in data transmission?
q_10256.ground_truth: A playout curve shows the cumulative amount of data that the decoder has processed by a given time from the receiver buffer, and represents the progress of the media decoding process. It is a key element in bitrate control and buffering, along with the sampling curve, transmission curve, and reception curve.

q_10257.question: What steps should the MRFP take when receiving a corresponding SDP answer for MSRP media?
q_10257.ground_truth: When receiving a corresponding SDP answer for MSRP media, the MRFP shall provide the value of the received "a=path" SDP attribute to the MRFP in the "MSRP URI Path" information element and use the IP address and TCP port within the first entry of the "a=path" SDP attribute if the "a=msrp-cema" SDP attribute is not present.

q_10258.question: What is the number of TFCI bits transmitted when using slot formats nA or nB, where n = 0, 1, ..., 11?
q_10258.ground_truth: F = 32 when using slot formats nA or nB, where n = 0, 1, ..., 11.

q_10259.question: What are the administrative aspects that the operator should ensure when managing the network?
q_10259.ground_truth: The administrative aspects that the operator should ensure when managing the network include security, data validity, data consistency, and resource administration.

q_10260.question: What type of service does the "DOWNLOAD" value in the MBMS-User-Service-Type AVP (AVP code 1225) represent in the context of Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBMS)?
q_10260.ground_truth: The MBMS user service of type: download.

q_10261.question: What is the maximum end-to-end latency tolerated by a professional musician for their audio stream?
q_10261.ground_truth: The maximum end-to-end latency tolerated by a professional musician is 4 milliseconds between their wireless microphone (analogue audio source) and their in-ear monitoring device (analog wireless sink).

q_10262.question: What is the signalling interaction between the MGCF and the SS7 signalling function through the SGW?
q_10262.ground_truth: The SGW enables the signalling interaction between the MGCF and the SS7 signalling function, terminating the SCTP and M3UA protocol layers for signalling from the MGCF to the SS7 signalling function, and terminating SS7 MTP2 and MTP3 protocol layers for signalling from the SS7 signalling function to the MGCF.

q_10263.question: What should a UE do when the number of identities in a PLMN list exceeds the number of neighbor cells in the paired list?
q_10263.ground_truth: If the number of identities in a PLMN list exceeds the number of neighbor cells in the paired list, extra PLMN identities are considered as unnecessary and ignored.

q_10264.question: What needs to be studied to enable a UPF to support multiple network slices using the current protocol?
q_10264.ground_truth: The potential missing functionalities and possible protocol enhancements over PFCP.

q_10265.question: What is the role of the BSS/RNC identifier (BSS-ID/RNC-ID) in the GERAN/UTRAN part of the PLMN?
q_10265.ground_truth: The BSS-ID/RNC-ID is used to route GERAN/UTRAN interface messages to the correct BSS/RNC.

q_10266.question: What protocol is used over the Sy interface for Diameter messages?

q_10267.question: What is the Trigger-Type AVP used for and what type of AVP is it?
q_10267.ground_truth: The Trigger-Type AVP is of type Enumerated and indicates a single re-authorization event type. It is used to indicate a single re-authorization event type when included in the CCA or CCR command.

q_10268.question: What is the role of an intermediate SS7-carrier in a hub-and-spoke architecture for SS7SEGs?
q_10268.ground_truth: An intermediate SS7-carrier in a hub-andamp-spoke architecture for SS7SEGs performs tasks such as TCAP user payload modification, protocol interworking, message screening, and advanced reporting.

q_10269.question: What is the procedure for PMIPv6 PDN Connection Lifetime Extension?
q_10269.ground_truth: The PMIPv6 PDN Connection Lifetime Extension procedure is initiated by the MAG to prolong the lifetime of an existing PDN connection with the LMA for an UE that is already attached. The procedure starts with the MAG sending a PBU to the LMA to extend the binding lifetime for the UE's PDN connection, and the LMA confirms the extension by sending a PBA to the MAG.

q_10270.question: What is the action taken by the MS if the number of 3G frequencies or cells exceeds the MS monitoring capabilities?
q_10270.ground_truth: The MS behavior is not specified if the number of 3G frequencies or cells exceeds the MS monitoring capabilities.

q_10271.question: What is the role of the FFAPP application layer functional architecture as specified in subclause 6.2.1?
q_10271.ground_truth: The FFAPP application layer functional architecture is specified to support time sensitive communication services in subclause 6.2.1.

q_10272.question: What margin is used between the ACLR and the unwanted emission level for a UTRA base station to not limit co-existence?
q_10272.ground_truth: A 15 dB margin is used between the ACLR and the unwanted emission level for a UTRA base station to not limit co-existence.

q_10273.question: What is the leaving triggered state condition for a non-used frequency in event 2b?
q_10273.ground_truth: The non-used frequency must no longer have a quality better than the absolute threshold, considering the hysteresis parameter.

q_10274.question: How are the input bits divided for 16QAM modulated bits in the 2nd interleaving for Secondary CCPCH?
q_10274.ground_truth: Bits u(p,k) and u(p,k+1) go to the first interleaver and bits u(p,k+2) and u(p,k+3) go to the second interleaver.

q_10275.question: What is the initial command sent by the User Identity Module (UICC) to the Mobile Equipment (ME) for setting up a call with UCS2 coding and Katakana characters?

q_10276.question: What is the role of the "priority" indicator in the direct transfer of trace records by the trace control function?
q_10276.ground_truth: The "priority" indicator in the trace type controls whether the trace records are sent directly to the operations system (OSF) or stored on file within the NE filestore. If the priority indicator is not set, the trace records are stored on file.

q_10277.question: What is the outcome of a failed PS paging procedure in the SGSN over the Gb interface?
q_10277.ground_truth: When a PS paging procedure in the SGSN over the Gb interface times out and incremented, as a counter, and it is a result of a failed procedure.

q_10278.question: What is verified in CR~4 in the authentication procedure for EAP-AKA'?
q_10278.ground_truth: CR~4 in the authentication procedure for EAP-AKA' is verified if the 5G NAS security context parameters are stored on the USIM when entering state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED after a successful authentication procedure.

q_10279.question: How long should a MS retain PACKET NEIGHBOUR CELL DATA message instances?
q_10279.ground_truth: A MS should delete any PACKET NEIGHBOUR CELL DATA message instances 30 seconds after receiving the latest message instance.

q_10280.question: What is the function of the ValidityAreaRef leaf in the ANDSF/DiscoveryInformation/<X> element?
q_10280.ground_truth: The ValidityAreaRef leaf in the ANDSF/DiscoveryInformation/<X> element contains a reference to a ValidityArea interior node, which identifies a ValidityArea interior node in the UE management tree. This allows the network to specify which access networks are available for the UE.

q_10281.question: Which managed object class represents the trace collection process and generates the trace report notifications?
q_10281.ground_truth: traceControl is the managed object class that represents the trace collection process and generates the trace report notifications.

q_10282.question: What is the duration for which the SGSN associates an MS with the last used remote IP endpoint?
q_10282.ground_truth: The SGSN associates an MS with the last used remote IP endpoint as long as the SGSN has location information for the MS on cell level.

q_10283.question: What is the expected result after reading a SMS stored on the USIM if both USIM and ISIM are present?
q_10283.ground_truth: The correct text of the SMS on the USIM is read and displayed to the user, and the EF_SMS record 1 of the USIM contains the status byte set to SMS read with the entire content of the SMS unchanged.

q_10284.question: What action should a mobile station take if it receives an uplink assignment while timer T3172 is running?
q_10284.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_10285.question: Who initiates the UE radio bearer test mode procedure?
q_10285.ground_truth: The SS (Signalling Support Sublayer) initiates the UE radio bearer test mode procedure.

q_10286.question: How can QoS be maintained during varying reception conditions in the 9th release?
q_10286.ground_truth: A fine granular rate adaptation is applied to the video stream in the 9th release to avoid abrupt quality changes in an efficient manner when entering bad reception conditions.

q_10287.question: Was the card reader removable in Terminal Response 1.2?
q_10287.ground_truth: No, the card reader was not removable in Terminal Response 1.2.

q_10288.question: What is the focus of the performance measurement in the document?
q_10288.ground_truth: The focus of the performance measurement in the document is on the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects, specifically on the Home Node B (HNB) Subsystem (HNS) in Release 17.

q_10289.question: What action does a mobile station take if it receives a PAGING REQUEST message while T3234/T3236 is running?
q_10289.ground_truth: The mobile station stops T3234/T3236 and responds to the PAGING REQUEST message.

q_10290.question: What is the spreading factor of the Channelisation Code used for a Physical Channel in 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_10290.ground_truth: The spreading factor of the Channelisation Code used for a Physical Channel in 1.28Mcps TDD can be 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16.

q_10291.question: What is the method used to separate uplink and downlink transmissions in Frequency Division Duplex (FDD)?
q_10291.ground_truth: In FDD, uplink and downlink transmissions use two separated radio frequencies, with each uplink and downlink using different frequency bands.

q_10292.question: What is the send state variable V(S) used for and what is its range of values?
q_10292.ground_truth: V(S) is an associated send state variable of each point-to-point data link connection endpoint when using I-frame commands. It denotes the sequence number of the next in-sequence I-frame to be transmitted and can take on the value 0 through 7.

q_10293.question: What message is sent by the mobile station to the network on the PACCH or PCCCH to request a packet channel?

q_10294.question: What is the consequence of the network receiving a CALL CONFIRMED message with a stream identifier including the request entity cannot be provided?
q_10294.ground_truth: The network shall initiate call clearing with cause #44 "requested circuit/channel not available".

q_10295.question: What is the purpose of the "PTP RAB ID" field in MBMS PTP Radio Bearers for a particular UE?
q_10295.ground_truth: The "PTP RAB ID" field uniquely identifies a MBMS PTP radio bearer for a particular UE, and is used to relate MBMS PTP Radio Bearers to a MBMS RAB in RANAP messages and RRC messages.

q_10296.question: What is the role of the SID updater in the EVS primary CNG operation?
q_10296.ground_truth: The SID updater decides if any SID update is required in the EVS primary CNG operation. If an update is needed, the CNG Selector enables either the LP or the FD CNG encoder to calculate the noise generation parameter and create the related SID payload.

q_10297.question: In what case can MSC-B proceed with the handover to a CSG cell without checking the CSG membership of the UE?
q_10297.ground_truth: For subsequent handover of an emergency call to a CSG cell, MSC-B shall skip the CSG membership check and proceed with the handover procedure.

q_10298.question: What is the purpose of generating gateway records in MTRF procedure?
q_10298.ground_truth: The gateway records are produced to settle accounts with other networks and may be used to record traffic from particular origins or to particular destinations.

q_10299.question: How does the Push Function deliver data to the UE when the SMS environment is not adequate?
q_10299.ground_truth: The Push Function can push a notification to the user allowing the user to establish a direct connection to the Push Function or Push Initiator.

q_10300.question: What is the relationship between the input and output of the 1st interleaving in uplink?
q_10300.ground_truth: The bits input to the 1st interleaving are equal to the bits output from the 1st interleaving in uplink.

q_10301.question: What channel is used by the serving Node B to command the UE to disable or re-enable discontinuous uplink DPCCH transmission?

q_10302.question: What is the number of samples per frame and the sampling rate?
q_10302.ground_truth: NF = 160 (samples) and the sampling rate is 8 kHz

q_10303.question: What audio and video codecs and formats are required for efficient encoding and distribution in a 3GPP environment?
q_10303.ground_truth: A sufficient set of audio and video codecs are required to allow for encoding and distribution of legacy and new formats in an efficient manner. If legacy content is expected to be distributed, it may be transcoded prior to distribution.

q_10304.question: How can HeNB downlink interference among neighboring HeNB control channels be controlled by frequency partitioning?
q_10304.ground_truth: The LTE carrier can be segmented into separate frequency domain resources, with each interfering HeNB transmitting its control signalling in separate frequency domain resources. Release-8/9 UEs would access the HeNB as a 10 MHz carrier and receive control and broadcast signalling from HeNB within 10 MHz. However, Release-10 UEs can additionally be assigned PDSCH resource on the remaining 10 MHz frequency resources using carrier aggregation.

q_10305.question: What is the required attribute value for the "active" attribute in the call waiting document to indicate an active status?
q_10305.ground_truth: The "active" attribute should be set to "true" to indicate an active status for the call waiting document.

q_10306.question: What is the name of the physical channel on which E-DCH ACK/NACKs are transmitted in FDD mode and 3.84 Mcps and 7.68 Mcps TDD?

q_10307.question: What is the measurement type defined in e) that is subject to the "2 out of 3 approach" in the context of GTP signalling on the Gn interface?
q_10307.ground_truth: The three measurement types defined in e) - CC, Combined, and SgsnFunction - are subject to the "2 out of 3 approach" in the context of GTP signalling on the Gn interface.

q_10308.question: When should the SS transmit an LPP REQUEST LOCATION INFORMATION message, including the ECID-RequestLocationInformation IE?
q_10308.ground_truth: After the UE transmits an LPP PROVIDE CAPABILITIES message indicating the ECID capabilities supported by the UE in the ECID-ProvideCapabilities IE.

q_10309.question: What is the first step in setting up a Data Bearer in the User Plane?
q_10309.ground_truth: The first step is a signalling transaction by the Application Protocol in the Control Plane.

q_10310.question: What is the purpose of wPSNR metric in HDR sequences?
q_10310.ground_truth: The wPSNR metric in HDR sequences aims to compensate for a different distribution of codewords in HDR content.

q_10311.question: What is the length of the URCMP message header?
q_10311.ground_truth: The length of the URCMP message header is a multiple of 4 octets.

q_10312.question: What does the acronym "RNTI" stand for in the context of E-UTRAN?

q_10313.question: What is the requirement for the generation of a keystream in Solution 6.2.1.2.1.1 and Solution 6.2.1.2.1.2?
q_10313.ground_truth: The requirement for the generation of a keystream is by computing HMAC-SHA-256 with a KEY and RAND as input.

q_10314.question: What action should the Node B take if the COMMON TRANSPORT CHANNEL SETUP REQUEST message contains both the Broadcast Reference IE and the IP Multicast Indication IE?
q_10314.ground_truth: The Node B should reject the procedure using the COMMON TRANSPORT CHANNEL SETUP FAILURE message.

q_10315.question: Who is responsible for triggering the AN Release procedure (5GS) or S1 Release procedure (EPS) with a specific cause value in Solution #4?
q_10315.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the indication from the UE, the AMF (5GC) or MME (EPS) triggers the AN Release procedure (5GS) or S1 Release procedure (EPS) with a specific cause value in the N2 UE Release Context Command (5GS) or S1-AP:S1 UE Context Release Command (EPS) sent to RAN.

q_10316.question: What action should the PCEF take if the PCRF requests user location information but it is not provided to the PCEF?
q_10316.ground_truth: The PCEF should provide the serving PLMN identifier within the 3GPP-SGSN-MCC-MNC AVP.

q_10317.question: What are the limitations of 3GPP-based technologies in the maritime domain?
q_10317.ground_truth: Some of the legacy 3GPP enabling technologies and solutions may not be able to fully support the performances required by the maritime domain.

q_10318.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS pre-notification on CCCH?
q_10318.ground_truth: The purpose of MBMS pre-notification on CCCH is to pre-notify an MBMS session to the mobile station, indicating that the session is being pre-notified and the mobile station is required to receive it.

q_10319.question: In the context of the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE, what should the Node B do if the DL Power Balancing Information IE is present?
q_10319.ground_truth: The Node B should use the information in the same way as it is used on the primary uplink frequency.

q_10320.question: When should a 3GPP application support the replacement of its application PIN with the Universal PIN?
q_10320.ground_truth: A 3GPP application residing on a multi-verification capable UICC shall support the replacement of its application PIN with the Universal PIN.

q_10321.question: What actions shall the MRFP take when requested to act as a STUN server?
q_10321.ground_truth: The MRFP shall be prepared to answer STUN binding requests, and once a STUN binding request with the "USE-CANDIDATE" flag has been received, the MRFP may send media towards the source of the binding request.

q_10322.question: What is the action taken by the mobile station when a lower layer failure occurs before the ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message has been sent?
q_10322.ground_truth: The mobile station deactivates the new channels, reactivates the old channels, reconnects the TCHs if any and triggers the establishment of the main signalling link. It then sends an ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message, cause "protocol error unspecified" on the main DCCH and resumes the normal operation as if no assignment attempt had occurred. The operational parameters when returning on the old channel are those applied before the procedure.

q_10323.question: What happens if the BSS does not allocate the circuits when a CN initiated RESET is performed in a broadcast-based manner?
q_10323.ground_truth: The BSS will not release the affected calls and circuits, and will not initiate any BLOCK or CIRCUIT GROUP BLOCK procedures for circuits locally blocked on the BSS side.

q_10324.question: What condition should be met before an IWF responds with a SIP 200 (OK) response to a SIP PUBLISH request?
q_10324.ground_truth: An IWF should ensure that the "entity" attribute of the <presence> element is equal to the served MCPTT group ID, and the handled MCPTT ID is the same as the MCPTT ID in the "id" attribute of the <tuple> element.

q_10325.question: What is the recommended approach to handle a random access collision?
q_10325.ground_truth: In case of a likely collision or bad propagation environment, the Node B does not transmit the FPACH or cannot receive the SYNC-UL. The UE will not get any response from the Node B and has to adjust its Tx time and Tx power level based on a new measurement and send a SYNC-UL again after a random delay.

q_10326.question: What is the significance of the access-token in all requests that relate to a specific service?
q_10326.ground_truth: The access-token is always carried as part of HTTP Headers for all requests related to a specific service except for the service creation request.

q_10327.question: What is the EGPRS indicator field element used for?
q_10327.ground_truth: The EGPRS indicator field element indicates whether the MS has no TBF using E-GPRS or has a TBF using E-GPRS in the old cell.

q_10328.question: Under what conditions does the receiving UM RLC entity discard the received UMD PDU when it is placed in the reception buffer?
q_10328.ground_truth: The receiving UM RLC entity discards the received UMD PDU when its SN falls outside of the reassembly window.

q_10329.question: What is the purpose of the Service-Generic-Information AVP?
q_10329.ground_truth: The Service-Generic-Information AVP is used to transmit service information elements that are used for all services.

q_10330.question: What is the operation that requests the gsmSSF to reduce the rate of service requests to the gsmSCF?

q_10331.question: What action should the application take after invoking the getFdAvailableFileList() API?
q_10331.ground_truth: The application may access the files that are announced by the parameters in the callback function. If the storage is not defined by the locationPath, the application should access the file before the announced availabilityDeadline.

q_10332.question: How are real-valued chip sequences in the Q and I branches combined?
q_10332.ground_truth: The real-valued chip sequence on the Q branch is complex multiplied with j and then summed with the corresponding real-valued chip sequence on the I branch, resulting in a single complex-valued chip sequence.

q_10333.question: What security keys does the AS apply for the integrity protection and ciphering of RRC signalling and user data?

q_10334.question: What is the function of the PoC server in the IMS architecture?
q_10334.ground_truth: The PoC server is an application server that provides the application level network functionality for the PoC service in the IMS architecture. It communicates with the IMS core using the ISC interface.

q_10335.question: What information should the ProSe Function in charge of the Proximity request include in a ProSe Proximity Alert request to the targeted UE?
q_10335.ground_truth: It should include the Application Layer User ID and the EPC ProSe User Identity of the requesting UE entering into proximity, and may include assistance information for WLAN direct discovery and communication if the WLAN indication was included in the Proximity request.

q_10336.question: What should an MAA do if it receives the streamingServiceError() notification?
q_10336.ground_truth: The MAA should revalidate the capture call and update the service list by issuing a getStreamingServices().

q_10337.question: What is the mandatory use of all octets in the TP-VP (TP-Validity-Period) in the enhanced format?
q_10337.ground_truth: Although not all octets in the TP-VP may be used, any reserved or unused bits or octets must be set to zero as a mandatory requirement.

q_10338.question: What should the PCEF do when it receives a CCA that provisions an updated usage threshold in the CCA command?
q_10338.ground_truth: The PCEF should continue usage monitoring for that IP-CAN session, usage monitoring key, or both, using the updated threshold value provisioned by the PCRF.

q_10339.question: What is the quantization step size used in the AMR-WB-interoperable mode?
q_10339.ground_truth: The quantization step size used in the AMR-WB-interoperable mode is 2.625.

q_10340.question: What is the purpose of Priority Trunk Queuing in Priority Service?
q_10340.ground_truth: Priority Trunk Queuing provides the capability to place a Priority Service call that has experienced a congestion condition for trunk resources into a queue associated with a trunk group until a trunk becomes available.

q_10341.question: What are the pre-test conditions for test case 8.1.3.1.19 in terms of the NR cells and system information?
q_10341.ground_truth: NR Cell 1 is the PCell, NR Cell 10 is the inter-frequency neighbor cell, and system information combination NR-4 as defined in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.4.3.1.2 is used in the NR PCell.

q_10342.question: What is the role of the NPN operator in creating a 3GPP segment for an NPN service customer?
q_10342.ground_truth: The NPN operator provisions the 3GPP segment for the requested NPN, either by reusing an existing 3GPP segment or creating a new one based on the 3GPP-related NPN requirements received from the NPN service provider.

q_10343.question: What is a potential requirement for standardized features in a fully autonomous network level for management scopes in the network layer?
q_10343.ground_truth: A potential requirement could be the standardization of features that enable the network to analyze, make decisions, and execute changes to the network elements (NE) layer autonomously.

q_10344.question: In the context of potential solutions for energy efficiency in shared gNB, what is the difference between the two methods of calculating the energy efficiency KPI?
q_10344.ground_truth: The first method uses estimated energy consumption, while the second method uses measured energy consumption.

q_10345.question: When should the CONTINUE A-B AS NORMAL CALL CLEARING occur?
q_10345.ground_truth: It should be done when there is a disconnect or when the demand expires.

q_10346.question: In the process of inter-access flow mobility, what should a UE set the O (Overwrite) flag to when performing procedures described in subclause 5.7.2?
q_10346.ground_truth: The UE shall set the O (Overwrite) flag to 0.

q_10347.question: What is the role of the old SGSN when it receives a valid old P-TMSI Signature?
q_10347.ground_truth: The old SGSN validates the old P-TMSI Signature and responds with an appropriate error cause if it does not match the value stored in the old SGSN. This should initiate the security functions in the new SGSN.

q_10348.question: Which IE is used for E-DCH Semi-Persistent scheduling for 1.28 Mcps TDD?
q_10348.ground_truth: The E-DCH Semi-Persistent scheduling Information LCR IE.

q_10349.question: What message does the MSC/VLR send to the BSS to initiate the paging procedure in a mobile terminated call?
q_10349.ground_truth: A Paging message is sent by the MSC/VLR to the BSS to initiate the paging procedure in a mobile terminated call.

q_10350.question: What should an LLE do when it experiences multiple-TLLI assignment following the receipt of an unsolicited UA response frame?
q_10350.ground_truth: The LLE should assume a possible multiple-TLLI assignment, and LLME should inform GMM by means of the LLGMM-STATUS-IND primitive.

q_10351.question: What are the two types of ISO BMFF compliant file formats defined in A/331?
q_10351.ground_truth: The two types of ISO BMFF compliant file formats defined in A/331 are MPEG-DASH, further profiled by the DASH-IF Interoperability Point for ATSC 3.0, and MPU (Media Processing Unit) as defined by ISO-IEC 23008-1.

q_10352.question: What is the function of the PDU Type 14 in the Nb interface of a BICC-based CS Core Network?
q_10352.ground_truth: The PDU Type 14 is used for the initialization of the Nb-Interface on the User Plane level and is not used for Rate Control in EVS on the Nb interface.

q_10353.question: What action does an SMC-EP entity in the Idle state take when it receives a MNSMS-DATA-Req primitive in the MM-Connection Established state?
q_10353.ground_truth: When receiving a MNSMS-DATA-Req primitive in the MM-Connection Established state, the SMC entity forwards a CP-DATA message containing the RPDU to the MM-sublayer, sets the timer TC1* and enters the Wait for CP-ACK state.

q_10354.question: What are the two classes of USSD operations specified by the 3GPP TS?
q_10354.ground_truth: The two classes of USSD operations are Network initiated unstructured supplementary service data operations and Mobile initiated unstructured supplementary service data operations.

q_10355.question: In what modes is a MS required to operate in Network Control mode NC0 even if it has been ordered otherwise by the network?
q_10355.ground_truth: While in broadcast/multicast receive mode, and if in GMM Ready state when entering broadcast/multicast receive mode.

q_10356.question: What should the UE do when it is in the 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state and receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached" and the back-off timer value not provided?
q_10356.ground_truth: The UE should store the rejected NSSAI and start the timer T3526.

q_10357.question: In the context of 14.12.0a, how should the network node receiving an invalid RRC message prepare an RRC FAILURE INFO message if the received RRC message was unknown, unforeseen or erroneous?
q_10357.ground_truth: The network node should prepare the RRC FAILURE INFO message by including the IE "Failure cause" set to "Protocol error" and the IE "Protocol error information" including an IE "Protocol error cause" such as "ASN.1 violation or encoding error" or "Message type non-existent or not implemented".

q_10358.question: What should the HA do if the received Binding Update contains an Alternate Care-of Address option with different values in the Care-of Address and Source Address fields?
q_10358.ground_truth: The HA should reject the request by returning a Binding Acknowledgement with status code 128.

q_10359.question: What sub-frame structure is used by the HS-SCCH to carry downlink signaling related to HS-DSCH transmission?
q_10359.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH has a fixed rate of 60 kbps, and uses a SF=128. The sub-frame is further divided into a control signaling area and a data area. The control signaling area is used to carry control information such as transport format combination, HARQ-ACK feedback, CQI, and scheduling grants, while the data area is used to carry High Speed Shared Control channels.

q_10360.question: What should the SGSN do if it sends a BSSAP+-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message and does not receive a BSSAP+-IMSI-DETACH-ACK message before timer T10 expires?
q_10360.ground_truth: The SGSN should repeat the BSSAP+-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message a maximum of N10 times before sending the confirmation of the detach to the MS.

q_10361.question: What is the name of the ISF evaluation method used in the comfort noise evaluation algorithm on the transmit (TX) side in SCR?
q_10361.ground_truth: The ISF evaluation method computes the spectral distance between each of the ISF parameter vectors within the CN averaging period, and selects the ISF parameter vector with the smallest spectral distance as the median ISF parameter vector. It also has a median replacement threshold to replace the non-characteristic ISF parameter vectors prior to averaging the ISF parameters.

q_10362.question: What event can be subject to instructions from the AF for policy control?
q_10362.ground_truth: Authorization of the service based on incomplete service information, immediate authorization of the service, gate control, IP-CAN bearer level information or events forwarding, and credit denied.

q_10363.question: What security measures are required for the user plane data over the air between UE1 and gNB and between UE2 and gNB?
q_10363.ground_truth: Confidentiality protection and integrity protection of user plane data over the air between UE1 and gNB and between UE2 and gNB shall be supported.

q_10364.question: What is the criticality value of the MeasurementID field in the CommonMeasurementInitiationFailure-IEs sequence?
q_10364.ground_truth: The criticality value of the MeasurementID field in the CommonMeasurementInitiationFailure-IEs sequence is "ignore".

q_10365.question: When changing the Active Registration Area, what procedure does the UE follow to consider itself still registered without the need to initiate Mobility Registration Update?
q_10365.ground_truth: If the UE selects a cell in the next Registration Area in the sequenced Registration Area list, it makes the next RA in the list the Active Registration Area.

q_10366.question: What is the maximum length of an LLC PDU on the main DCCH for uplink messages?
q_10366.ground_truth: The maximum length of an LLC PDU on the main DCCH for uplink messages is specified in the 3GPP TS 44.060.

q_10367.question: How many alpha identifiers are specified in each "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND SS" command?
q_10367.ground_truth: Three alpha identifiers, namely "Text Attribute 1", "Text Attribute 2", and "Text Attribute 3", are specified in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND SS" commands.

q_10368.question: What are the challenges in fraud detection and prevention in a roaming scenario in mobile telephony?
q_10368.ground_truth: The challenges in fraud detection and prevention in a roaming scenario in mobile telephony include the inability of the service provider to physically access the network and the lack of complete information about the customer, as the caller is not the service provider's customer. Additionally, there is limited control over customers who are roaming, such as potential overuse of credit limits or usage after suspension.

q_10369.question: What is the definition of "BD-Rate Gain" in 3GPP technical documents?
q_10369.ground_truth: BD-Rate Gain is a measure of the bitrate reduction in percentage offered by a codec or codec feature under test compared to an anchor, while maintaining the same quality as measured by objective metrics.

q_10370.question: What is the maximum allowed spurious emissions for BS transmitters in frequency bands outside the operating band?
q_10370.ground_truth: Emissions outside of the specified frequency range are limited by a spurious emissions requirement.

q_10371.question: What parameter is used by both initiating and responding application processes to identify a specific TC dialogue to a remote CAP AE for a CAP AE?

q_10372.question: What are the two delivery methods for MBS multicast service from the perspective of 5G CN?
q_10372.ground_truth: The two delivery methods are the 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery method, where separate copies of MBS data packets are delivered to individual UEs via per-UE PDU sessions, and the 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery method, where a single copy of MBS data packets is delivered to a RAN node, which then delivers them to one or multiple UEs.

q_10373.question: What is the effect of the start-up of a communication service for train control on high data rate communication services with low priority?
q_10373.ground_truth: The start-up of a communication service for train control will acquire sufficient resources in the 5G network, even if high data rate communication services with low priority are already running.

q_10374.question: What information is used to uniquely determine the initial KeNB?
q_10374.ground_truth: The key set identifier eKSI and the uplink NAS COUNT are used to derive the initial KeNB.

q_10375.question: What is the purpose of the Partial Suspension of Itf-N IRP as defined in the document?
q_10375.ground_truth: The purpose of Partial Suspension of Itf-N IRP is to define an interface through which an IRPManager can suspend the forwarding of notifications via Itf-N which were generated in parts of the managed systems.

q_10376.question: What conditions must be met for a UE to consider a flow description when matching traffic?
q_10376.ground_truth: If the flow distribution rule contains more than one instance of the "ANDSF/ISRP/<X>/ForFlowBased/<X>/IPFlow/<X>" node, the UE shall consider the flow distribution rule if at least one of the flow descriptions matches the traffic.

q_10377.question: What should the MBMS UE do if the "Content-Encoding" of a file is set to "gzip" and the "File-ETag" or "Content-MD5" attributes are absent in the FDT Instance?
q_10377.ground_truth: The MBMS UE should request the complete file instead of using byte range requests.

q_10378.question: What is the name of the container for adding non-critical extensions after freezing of REL-15 in the "r14" choice of the "criticalExtensions" in the "MeasurementControl-LaterCriticalExtensions-r14-IEs" sequence?

q_10379.question: What is the difference between Collaboration C and Collaboration D in the context of 5MBS and 5G Media Streaming architectures?
q_10379.ground_truth: In Collaboration C, the externally generated multicast packet stream emulates the candidate 5MBS Delivery Method for segmented media, allowing the 5MBS Client to receive it and perform AL-FEC and unicast repair procedures. In contrast, Collaboration D involves an externally generated multicast packet stream in an application-specific format that differs from the candidate 5MBS Delivery Method, requiring the 5MBS-Aware Application to perform media object reassembly, repair procedures, and onward delivery to a media player.

q_10380.question: What should the VPLMN do after informing the CSE that the threshold has been reached in a GPRS session or PDP context?
q_10380.ground_truth: The VPLMN continues transmitting data packets to and from the GPRS terminal, restarts counting data transmitted and timing the duration of the GPRS session or PDP context.

q_10381.question: What is the difference between the GSM~900 and DCS 1800 propagation loss equations for medium sized cities and suburban centers?
q_10381.ground_truth: The difference is the constant term, being 142.9 dB for DCS 1800 and 132.8 dB for GSM~900.

q_10382.question: What is the duration of the streaming simulation in the UTRAN and LTE streaming test cases?

q_10383.question: What is the purpose of timer T in the context of the MS scanning for a new PLMN?
q_10383.ground_truth: Timer T determines the period between MS scanning attempts for a new PLMN.

q_10384.question: How does the UE generates the Home domain, Private and Public Identifier from NAI-based SUPI Identifiers in the IMS registration process?
q_10384.ground_truth: The Home domain consists of the string "ims" appended with the domain part of the non-IMSI SUPI. The Private User Identity is obtained as follows: the username is the same as the username in the non-IMSI SUPI NAI, and the domain portion is identical with the Home domain above. The temporary Public User Identity derived from the SUPI, consists of the string "sip:" appended with a username and domain portion equal to the non-IMSI SUPI derived Private User Identity.

q_10385.question: What is the suggested maximum size of the IRI (Intercept Related Information) for X2-interface?
q_10385.ground_truth: The maximum size of the IRI (Intercept Related Information) for X2-interface is not specified.

q_10386.question: What kind of SIP INFO request should the USSI AS send if it needs to request further information from the network to perform a USSD operation?
q_10386.ground_truth: The USSI AS should send an INFO request within the dialog, with the Info-Package header field containing the g.3gpp.ussd info-package name and an application/vnd.3gpp.ussd+xml MIME body including a <ussd-string> element and a <language> element.

q_10387.question: What is the function of the PACCH and EC-PACCH channels?
q_10387.ground_truth: PACCH conveys signalling information related to a given MS, while EC-PACCH is used in extended coverage.

q_10388.question: What does the CBS Transfer Type indicate in the 3GPP TS 23.040 specification?
q_10388.ground_truth: The CBS Transfer Type indicates to the MT which CBS messages are required to be transferred to the TE. It is coded as follows: 00, 01, 10, or 11. A receiving entity shall ignore the setting of bits 8-3.

q_10389.question: What is the variation range of the differences in magnitude for the background noises reproduced by the ES 202 396-1 simulation method with the different noise types?
q_10389.ground_truth: The differences in magnitude range from 5 dB up to 15 dB.

q_10390.question: What information must be included in the delivery report for the SM delivery report sent over IP?
q_10390.ground_truth: The Request-URI, From header, To header, and Content-Type header must be included in the delivery report for the SM delivery report sent over IP.

q_10391.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group evaluating the recognition performance of codecs for Speech Enabled Services (SES)?
q_10391.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide information on the recognition performance of the DSR Extended Advanced Front End and to recommend a codec for SES based on the performance results.

q_10392.question: What does IRP stand for in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
q_10392.ground_truth: IRP stands for Integration Reference Point.

q_10393.question: What is the IMS Communication Service Identifier (ICSI) used for?
q_10393.ground_truth: The IMS Communication Service Identifier (ICSI) is used to help triggering to application servers and internal routing in UEs, indicating IMS communication services through initial requests for a dialog or standalone transactions, and responding with the supported ICSIs values.

q_10394.question: What message is sent from the SGSN to the BSS when starting the Multilateration positioning method in GERAN over the Gb interface?

q_10395.question: What is the purpose of the PH-READY-TO-SEND-INDICATION primitive in the data link layer?
q_10395.ground_truth: The PH-READY-TO-SEND-INDICATION primitive is used to enable the data link layer to synchronize to the next instant of physical transmission.

q_10396.question: How does the sender maintain at least the target buffer level to prevent underflow?
q_10396.ground_truth: The sender maintains at least the target buffer level by monitoring the current receiver buffer delay and switching down to a lower content rate if the buffer level in time decreases, allowing the sender to send packets earlier and increase the receiver buffer level again.

q_10397.question: What action does the UAV take when receiving a Pairing Revocation Indication?
q_10397.ground_truth: The UAV deletes any pairing authorization information locally stored and sends a pairing revocation acknowledgement and CAA Level UAV ID to the MME. The MME sends a PDN connection Release Acknowledgement to SMF+PGW-C via SGW with the external ID, Pairing Revocation Ack indication and CAA Level UAV ID.

q_10398.question: What is the expected call control result in the CALL CONTROL RESULT 1.7.1, 1.8.1, and 1.9.1 logically described sections?
q_10398.ground_truth: Allowed with modifications, Allowed, and Allowed with modification, respectively.

q_10399.question: How is the PR value calculated in PR mode A and PR mode B?
q_10399.ground_truth: In PR mode A, the PR value is calculated relative to the P0 value of the MS to which the RLC block is addressed. In PR mode B, the network uses the same P0 value for all MS with a TBF established on the same PDCH, and the PR value is calculated relative to this P0 value.

q_10400.question: What information element specifies a public user identity of the calling user in an I1 message?

q_10401.question: In NR positioning, what is the periodicity of UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement in positioning frequency layer i?
q_10401.ground_truth: The periodicity of UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement in positioning frequency layer i is given by the least common multiple of the PRS processing window repetition periodicity and the PRS resource periodicity in positioning frequency layer i.

q_10402.question: What should the MME return to the GMLC if it is unable to provide a successful location estimate but the privacy checks were successfully executed?
q_10402.ground_truth: If the MME did not return a successful location estimate, but the privacy checks were successfully executed, the MME may return the last known location of the target UE if this is known and the LCS client is requesting the current or last known location.

q_10403.question: What should the 3GPP network do when the target's communication is no longer available to it due to redirection or handover to another network operator?
q_10403.ground_truth: It is a national option for the 3GPP network to provide the LEA with the identity of the network that has access to the target's communication.

q_10404.question: What is simulcast in the context of Multi-stream Multiparty Conferencing Media Handling (MMCMH)?
q_10404.ground_truth: Simulcast in the context of MMCMH refers to the usage of multiple RTP streams with different formats, negotiated via SDP offer/answer exchange, to support multi-stream multparty conferences.

q_10405.question: What is the intention of the GSM Cordless Telephony System (CTS)?
q_10405.ground_truth: The intention of the GSM Cordless Telephony System (CTS) is to provide cordless functionality to a standard GSM Mobile Station (MS) with minimum impact on the MS, by upgrading the ME and SIM software.

q_10406.question: What is the Command-Code value for the Device-Action-Request (DAR) command?
q_10406.ground_truth: The Command-Code value for the DAR command is 8388639.

q_10407.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of discarded RLC blocks in case of error detection in the UMTS RNC uplink transmission called?

q_10408.question: What is the primary use of the input weighted LSF vector in the encoding process?
q_10408.ground_truth: The primary use of the input weighted LSF vector is to generate the input of the two-stage VQ by subtracting the mean vector and the MA predicted contribution vector from it.

q_10409.question: What message does the HNB-GW generate when the RNA:CONNECTIONLESS TRANSFER message is issued by the Sending HNB for sending an RNSAP PDU to the Receiving HNB?
q_10409.ground_truth: The HNB-GW generates and routes the RNSAP PDU within an SCCP message towards the Receiving RNC when it receives the RNA:CONNECTIONLESS TRANSFER message.

q_10410.question: What is the format of "a=FEC-redundancy-level" attribute in FLUTE session?
q_10410.ground_truth: The "a=FEC-redundancy-level" attribute is in the form of "a=FEC-redundancy-level:<fec-ref><fec-redun-lev>", where <fec-ref> is as defined in sub-clause 7.3.2.8 and <fec-redun-lev> = "redundancy level="<redun-lev>, where <redun-lev> represent the redundant amount of FEC protection applied to the file object, expressed as an integer percentage value.

q_10411.question: What is the requirement specified in the second conformance requirement in 8.2.3.9.1.2?
q_10411.ground_truth: The second conformance requirement specifies that the measurement reporting procedure transfers measurement results from the UE to the network after successful security activation.

q_10412.question: What are the possible contents of the "From-id" information element, as indicated by the Code specific field?
q_10412.ground_truth: The "From-id" information element may contain a SIP URI, an E.164 number, a national number, or an unspecified number, or a public user identity that is an identifier, as indicated by the Code specific field.

q_10413.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives an RLC/MAC block containing a valid RRBP field for an EC TBF?
q_10413.ground_truth: The mobile station should not monitor the downlink RLC/MAC blocks during the radio block periods where it shall transmit the uplink response.

q_10414.question: What is the concept used for power control in the 3GPP 45.002 sequence generation?
q_10414.ground_truth: The Adaptive Symbol Constellation concept is used for power control in the 3GPP 45.002 sequence generation.

q_10415.question: How many transport channels can be present in a Radio Access Channel (RACH) CCTrCH?
q_10415.ground_truth: There can only be one transport channel in a RACH CCTrCH.

q_10416.question: What is Solution #3 in the functional model where FAE clients support direct UE-to-UE communications for supporting non-TSN communications?
q_10416.ground_truth: Solution #3 is a functional model where FAE clients support direct UE-to-UE communications for supporting non-TSN communications.

q_10417.question: What is the type of the "ueCapabilityContainer" information element in the SRNC-RelocationInfo-r13-IEs sequence?
q_10417.ground_truth: The type of the "ueCapabilityContainer" information element in the SRNC-RelocationInfo-r13-IEs sequence is BIT STRING (CONTAINING UE-CapabilityContainer-IEs).

q_10418.question: What should the AS do when instructed to release media resources in the CAT service?
q_10418.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP PRACK request including the P-Early-Media header field with an "inactive" value, the AS shall instruct the MRF to release the media resource reserved for the CAT service and forward the SIP PRACK request to the terminating UE.

q_10419.question: What should the ICS UE do if it receives an I1 Failure message at any time?
q_10419.ground_truth: The ICS UE should save the received Call-Identifier field value and the Sequence-ID, extract the Reason Value, and release the session.

q_10420.question: Under what conditions can a BSS block a BVC?
q_10420.ground_truth: A BSS can block a BVC due to operation and Maintenance intervention for a cell, equipment failure at the BSS, cell equipment failure at the BSS, or other causes not yet regarded in the implementation of GPRS.

q_10421.question: What is the role of the V2X application in the support for network slicing?
q_10421.ground_truth: The V2X application support for slices involves the interaction between the 5GS (e.g. slice management system) and the 3rd party (tenants) for the pre-commissioning, operation and management of the slice end-to-end.

q_10422.question: In what state does the SMC entity enter after receiving a CP-ACK message in the Wait for CP-ACK state?
q_10422.ground_truth: On receipt of the CP-ACK message in response to the CP-DATA message in the Wait for CP-ACK state, the SMC entity resets the timer TC1* and enters the Wait for CP DATA state.

q_10423.question: How can a mobile station initiate a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message?
q_10423.ground_truth: A mobile station can initiate a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message by requiring a two-phase access in the PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST or EGPRS PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST message.

q_10424.question: What is the purpose of CR 1 in 10.1.5.3?
q_10424.ground_truth: The purpose of CR 1 in 10.1.5.3 is to verify that the ME adds the CSG ID to the Allowed CSG list in a non-volatile memory in the ME together with the IMSI from the USIM in case this CSG ID belongs to the cell where the ME has sent the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message which was accepted by the E-USS as the corresponding file is not present on the simulated USIM.

q_10425.question: What information element is used to indicate a failure of synchronization in an authentication response, and to convey the expected response to the challenge used to authenticate the user?

q_10426.question: What network parameters are used for the second BCCH in this test?
q_10426.ground_truth: For the second BCCH in this test, the USS (in case of a Terminal accessing UTRAN) or SS (in case of Terminal accessing a GERAN) transmits with the following network parameters: LAI (MCC/MNC/LAC) 244/081/0001, and RAI (MCC/MNC/LAC/RAC) 244/081/0001/05 (only for UTRAN cell)

q_10427.question: What is the HS-SCCH reception pattern defined as?
q_10427.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH reception pattern is defined as the UE must receive one HS-SCCH sub-frame every HS-SCCH DRX cycle sub-frames.

q_10428.question: What is the effect of adding "EGAN" to the APN sent by the terminal before calling the DNS server in the visited PLMN?
q_10428.ground_truth: When the proxy-Gn is in the VPLMN, appending "EGAN" to the APN sent by the terminal before calling the DNS server for the VPLMN allows the SGSN to route towards the Proxy-Gn in the VPLMN, and the Proxy-Gn to route towards the GGSN.

q_10429.question: What is an XML document in the context of the specification?
q_10429.ground_truth: An XML document in the context of the specification is a file containing an XML document, composed of the succession of an optional XML declaration followed by a root XML element.

q_10430.question: What is the role of the NEF in stateful application relocation in 5G?
q_10430.ground_truth: The NEF plays a role in stateful application relocation in 5G by triggering to cache the corresponding application status information per UE per PDU session. This information is retrieved from the Source AF based on SMF's early notification.

q_10431.question: What should the UE do if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message includes operator-defined access category definitions or an extended emergency number list?
q_10431.ground_truth: The UE should return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF to acknowledge reception of the operator-defined access category definitions or the extended local emergency numbers list.

q_10432.question: What is the procedure used to indicate for the CRNC the incorrect arrival time of downlink data to the Node B?
q_10432.ground_truth: The Timing Adjustment procedure is used to indicate for the CRNC the incorrect arrival time of downlink data to the Node B. This procedure is initiated by the Node B if a DL frame arrives outside the defined arrival window.

q_10433.question: What should the IWF do when sending integrity protected content from the IWF to an MCData server?
q_10433.ground_truth: The IWF should use the appropriate keying information and perform the procedures specified in 3GPP TS 24.282 clause 6.5.3.3.3 to integrity protect XML MIME bodies.

q_10434.question: What event triggering condition is satisfied when the inequality Mn + Ofn + Ocn - Hys > Thresh is met?
q_10434.ground_truth: Entering condition for a measurement event

q_10435.question: What are the common resources managed by the CRNC in Node B for running a radio network?
q_10435.ground_truth: The common resources managed by the CRNC in Node B for running a radio network include the Cell, common physical channels, and common transport channels.

q_10436.question: What are the main issues with a completely distributed UC (identification, scoring) approach in IMS-to-IMS calls?
q_10436.ground_truth: The main issues include the need for UC equipment at multiple locations, high cost, unsynchronized and differing scoring results, influence on signaling enhancements, and longer connection setup time.

q_10437.question: What is a bearer service and how is it related to the ISDN and the PLMN?
q_10437.ground_truth: A bearer service is a type of telecommunication service that provides the capability for the transmission of signals between user-network interfaces. It is described by a number of attributes and, in the case of the PLMN, it equates to an ISDN 3,1 kHz audio bearer service.

q_10438.question: What is the 3GPP and what is its role in the development of the 3GPP TS 37.46x series of Technical Specifications?
q_10438.ground_truth: The 3GPP is a partnership project that produces technical specifications for mobile telecommunications. The 3GPP TS 37.46x series of Technical Specifications defines the Iuant Interface, which is applicable for UTRAN, E-UTRAN and NG-RAN. The 3GPP is responsible for the development and maintenance of these specifications.

q_10439.question: What is the function of the SignallingIndication parameter extension in the 3GPP TS 25.427 standard?
q_10439.ground_truth: The SignallingIndication parameter extension in the 3GPP TS 25.427 standard indicates that Interactive User Plane data is of a signalling nature.

q_10440.question: What is the role of the MExE service provider in terms of transferring applications, applets, and content to the MExE UE?
q_10440.ground_truth: The MExE service provider has the capability to transfer applications, applets, and content to the MExE UE, as well as request the version of such elements present on the MExE UE. It can also identify the UE's capabilities and support a request from the MExE UE for information on the services which may be transferred from the network.

q_10441.question: What is the difference between the VT-CSI and O-CSI in the VLR?
q_10441.ground_truth: The VT-CSI in the VLR is used for interworking with the gsmSCF for MT calls, while the O-CSI is used for MO and CF calls. The VT-CSI consists of a TDP list, CAMEL capability handling, and other related data, while the O-CSI contains a TDP list and CAMEL capability handling.

q_10442.question: What action does an IWF performing the participating role take when upgrading a MCPTT group session to an imminent peril call, as specified in clause 6.4.1.6?
q_10442.ground_truth: The IWF performing the participating role shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body populated as specified in clause 6.4.1.6 when generating the SIP re-INVITE request to upgrade the MCPTT group session to an imminent peril call. Additionally, the IWF shall include a Resource-Priority header field and comply with the procedures in clause 6.4.1.8.

q_10443.question: How does the SCC AS identify the correct anchored session for IMS session transfer?
q_10443.ground_truth: The SCC AS is able to identify the correct anchored session using either the C-MSISDN or the GRUU for session identification.

q_10444.question: When is the metadata offered by each service provider subject to expansion and modifications?
q_10444.ground_truth: The metadata offered by each service provider is subject to expansion and modifications over time, as more data or updated data becomes available about the originating party.

q_10445.question: Under which circumstances must the PCRF initiate removal of UE context to the old RCAF?
q_10445.ground_truth: The PCRF must initiate removal of UE context to the old RCAF when it receives a new non-aggregated RUCI report for the same user id and PDN ID but with a different RCAF id included in the RCAF-Id AVP, and when the PCRF needs to remove a UE context from the RCAF due to an event.

q_10446.question: How are MBS keys derived in this solution?
q_10446.ground_truth: MBS keys are derived using a key derivation function (KDF) specified in TS 33.220. The input parameters to the KDF, such as KMBS, TMGI, RANDMBS, CountMBS, PCI, ARFCN-DL, and security algorithm types are used to generate unique keys for every key generation.

q_10447.question: What are the four service requirements for the mobile content distribution service using PBS?
q_10447.ground_truth: The four service requirements are: 1) It should be possible for mobile users to provide content distribution service using PBS, 2) Interactivity should be supported between mobile content provider and service users, 3) Mobile content providers should be able to page multiple users, and 4) Mobile content providers should be able to limit the area of content broadcast based on geographical location information.

q_10448.question: What is the function of the "Set Radio Carrier Attributes" message?
