q_10448.ground_truth: The "Set Radio Carrier Attributes" message is used to set a Radio Carrier's RF-related attributes such as the frequencies and the power.

q_10449.question: What happens when the UE makes an outgoing call using a stored emergency number on the USIM in the first scenario?
q_10449.ground_truth: The UE establishes an RRC connection with the RRC establishmentCause set to "emergency", sends a SERVICE REQUEST message with Service type IE set to "emergency services", and establishes a New emergency PDU session by sending an UL NAS TRANSPORT message with Request type set to "initial emergency request" and a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST.

q_10450.question: What is the role of the V-PCRF when establishing and terminating a Gateway Control Session in a home routed access scenario?
q_10450.ground_truth: The V-PCRF provides functions to proxy Gxx interactions between the BBERF and the H-PCRF for Gateway Control Session establishment and termination in a home routed access scenario.

q_10451.question: What is the maximum bit rate for downlink in TERMINAL RESPONSE: OPEN CHANNEL 6.5.1B?
q_10451.ground_truth: The maximum bit rate for downlink is 64 kbps.

q_10452.question: How does the E-UTRAN architecture minimize the presence of "single points of failure"?
q_10452.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN architecture minimizes the presence of "single points of failure" by limiting their effects to eNB sites, which are defined without architectural redundancy.

q_10453.question: What RAN-initiated procedure is used to propose modifications to any negotiable RAB parameter for an MS after RAB establishment in Iu mode?
q_10453.ground_truth: The RNC-initiated RAB Modification procedure is used to propose modifications to any negotiable RAB parameter for an MS after RAB establishment in Iu mode.

q_10454.question: What is the maximum MBDV value that can be set by the application to support a required data rate of 10 Gbps?
q_10454.ground_truth: The maximum MBDV value that can be set by the application to support a required data rate of 10 Gbps is 12.5M byte.

q_10455.question: If a message containing IEs or IE groups is received with too many occurrences or erroneously present, what should the receiving node do?
q_10455.ground_truth: The receiving node should reject the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure.

q_10456.question: What is the relevant software implementation for AV1 in 3GPP testing?
q_10456.ground_truth: The AV1 codec library (libaom) is used for 3GPP testing.

q_10457.question: When should the spurious emission requirements be met for a BS with common RX and TX antenna port?
q_10457.ground_truth: The spurious emission requirements should be met when both the TX and RX are on and the TX port is terminated.

q_10458.question: Which UE-RadioAccessCapabBandFDD sequence includes the field txRxFrequencySeparation?

q_10459.question: What is the major decision step in the noise update logic?
q_10459.ground_truth: The major decision step in the noise update logic is whether an update is to be made or not, and this is formed by the evaluation of a logical expression that checks if any of the four pause detectors allow for an update.

q_10460.question: What action does the old MSC/VLR take upon receiving the MSRN from the new MSC/VLR during an ongoing Camel transaction?
q_10460.ground_truth: The old MSC/VLR terminates the ongoing Camel transaction upon receiving the MSRN from the new MSC/VLR.

q_10461.question: What is the purpose of 3GPP TR 26.911 in relation to 3G-324M terminals?
q_10461.ground_truth: The 3GPP TR 26.911 provides a recommended guide for the implementation of 3G-324M terminals. It suggests preferred options that enable cost-effective, high-quality terminals in 3GPP networks.

q_10462.question: What is the function of the "SEND SS" command with command qualifier "00" in the Simulator?
q_10462.ground_truth: The "SEND SS" command with command qualifier "00" is used to send a supplementary service (SS) command to the network.

q_10463.question: What is the frequency offset range for the interfering signal in the 3,84 Mcps TDD option?
q_10463.ground_truth: The frequency offset of the interfering signal covers the range from 1 MHz to 12,75 GHz, with a step increase of n in integer values starting from n=10.

q_10464.question: When the CES/P field is used to indicate what fields the next uplink radio block reserved by this field shall contain, how is the single uplink block defined?
q_10464.ground_truth: The single uplink block is defined by a delay relative to the first TDMA frame (N) of the downlink block containing the CES/P value.

q_10465.question: Which 3GPP audio codec out-performs the other in the MMS application in mono mode at 14 kbps?
q_10465.ground_truth: AMR-WB+ out-performs Eaac+ in the MMS application in mono mode at 14 kbps.

q_10466.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network in producing the Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA) technical specification for the physical layer measurements and their definitions?
q_10466.ground_truth: The purpose is to support operation in idle mode and connected mode by describing and defining the measurements done at the UE and network.

q_10467.question: What is the purpose of the "Timestamp" field in XML-based QoE metrics reporting?
q_10467.ground_truth: The optional "Timestamp" field indicates the time when codec changes have occurred, relative to the beginning of the measurement period.

q_10468.question: What are the two separate audio links used for in this application?
q_10468.ground_truth: The two separate audio links are used for bi-directional communication between the remote user and the broadcast centre. The main audio feed is separate from these audio links, which enable users at the remote site to communicate with the broadcast centre.

q_10469.question: What are the three types of virtualized network product class defined for implementing 3GPP functions?
q_10469.ground_truth: The three types are: Type 1 - implementing 3GPP defined functionalities only, Type 2 - implementing 3GPP defined functionalities and Virtualization layer, and Type 3 - implementing 3GPP defined functionalities, Virtualization layer, and hardware layer.

q_10470.question: What procedure was performed on Mark in his first appointment with Dr. Good?
q_10470.ground_truth: A small biopsy surgery was performed on Mark during his first appointment with Dr. Good.

q_10471.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in the delivery of MBMS content for GPRS and EPS?
q_10471.ground_truth: For GPRS, the BM-SC renders the content differently and works with the SGSN to deliver the content. For EPS, the BM-SC and MBMS-GW have to implement functionality to deliver the content, while the MME, S4-SGSN, RNC, and eNodeB remain transparent to this functionality.

q_10472.question: What is the advantage of the coordinated mode of RAN delay budget reporting over autonomous mode in terms of delay budget adaptation?
q_10472.ground_truth: The coordinated mode allows for faster delay budget adaptation and consequent larger number of retransmissions via real-time exchange of delay budget information using RTP/RTCP signalling compared to the autonomous mode which relies on measurements and inference at the UEs based on packet statistics.

q_10473.question: What is the role of an Element Manager (EM) in the context of 3G systems?
q_10473.ground_truth: An Element Manager (EM) in the context of 3G systems is responsible for establishing a schedule for the collection and recording of performance data by Network Elements (NEs) in the PLMN-system.

q_10474.question: What should the IWF include in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request if it determines that a SIP 200 (OK) response should be sent?
q_10474.ground_truth: The IWF should include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcdata.sds media feature tag along with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request.

q_10475.question: What is the EPIRP SupportIOC in 3GPP technical specifications and how is it used?
q_10475.ground_truth: The EPIRP SupportIOC is an interface in the Entry Point IRP (EPIRP) that implements the entry point management capabilities defined in 3GPP technical specifications. It is used as an initial access point to the managed systems. The EPIRP does not have any own attributes, it inherits all its attributes from ManagedGenericIRP.

q_10476.question: What information does the Code Resource Related Information field provide in the E-AGCH, and what is its size in bits for the 1.28Mcps and 3.84Mcps options?
q_10476.ground_truth: The Code Resource Related Information field in the E-AGCH indicates which node on the OVSF code tree has been allocated. It is represented by 5 bits for the 1.28Mcps option and 5 bits for the 3.84Mcps option.

q_10477.question: When does the UE stop sending MeasurementReport message in the measurement reporting procedure?
q_10477.ground_truth: The UE stops sending the MeasurementReport message when the leaving condition for event A4 is satisfied, or when the periodical measurement reporting is no longer triggered by event A4.

q_10478.question: What is the purpose of the "ProtocolIE-Container" field in the "Write-Replace-Warning-Request" and "Write-Replace-Warning-Response" sequences?
q_10478.ground_truth: The "ProtocolIE-Container" field in the "Write-Replace-Warning-Request" and "Write-Replace-Warning-Response" sequences is used to specify a container for the protocol information elements.

q_10479.question: What is the recommendation for PS and CS domain registration coordination in E-UTRAN?
q_10479.ground_truth: It is recommended that CS/PS coordination should be performed at registration when a redirect attempt flag is included in A/Gb/Iu messages carrying the NAS registration message. This ensures that the UE registers with the same operator for the CS and PS domains.

q_10480.question: What is the impact of solution #24 on the PLMN ID at Home IMS?
q_10480.ground_truth: The PLMN ID information is expanded to PLMN ID+NID in SIP signalling at Home IMS to indicate the PLMN ID+NID to P-CSCF, which is then included in SIP and Cx signalling to HSS.

q_10481.question: What is the definition of an attachment circuit as used in the context of Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS) Virtual Private Networks (VPNs)?
q_10481.ground_truth: An attachment circuit identifies uniquely the MPLS VPN used by all traffic using that circuit. In the context of MPLS VPNs, attachment circuits are used to connect Customer Edge (CE) devices to Provider Edge (PE) routers.

q_10482.question: When indicated to act as a TLS client, what shall the IMS-AGW do during the subsequent DTLS handshake with the served UE for a T.38 fax media stream over UDPTL/UDP transport requiring e2ae security?
q_10482.ground_truth: When indicated to act as a TLS client, the IMS-AGW shall verify that the fingerprint of the certificate passed by the served UE during DTLS handshake matches the certificate fingerprint received from the IMS-ALG during the DTLS session establishment.

q_10483.question: What are the maximum radiated power limits from the BTS, including its antenna system, for GSM 850 and MXM 850 base stations?
q_10483.ground_truth: The maximum radiated power from the BTS, including its antenna system, shall not exceed a maximum of 500 W ERP, per the applicable FCC rules for public mobile services.

q_10484.question: What is the importance of the TAR in relation to triggering a toolkit application?
q_10484.ground_truth: The TAR (Toolkit Application Resource) is a parameter that the Toolkit Framework uses to trigger a toolkit application. If the TAR is unknown or the security cannot be verified, the toolkit application will not be triggered.

q_10485.question: What standard document specifies solutions to address the paging occasion collision issue for single-Rx/single-Tx Multi-USIM (MUSIM) UE in 5G System?

q_10486.question: What kind of managed object is a Node B in the 3GPP network?
q_10486.ground_truth: A Node B is a logical node responsible for radio transmission/reception in one or more cells to/from the User Equipment, it terminates the Iub interface towards the RNC.

q_10487.question: How is the value of an information element (IE) represented in the specification?
q_10487.ground_truth: The "Value" of an information element (IE) is written as it is specified in the specification, enclosed by quotation marks.

q_10488.question: What is the role of the S-TMSI in the RRCConntectionRestablishmentRequest message sent by the UE?
q_10488.ground_truth: The S-TMSI is used by the target eNB to recognize that the RRCConntectionRestablishmentRequest message relates to the Control Plane CIoT EPS optimisation.

q_10489.question: What is the role of the PA in the UAS authentication process, as per Solution #11?
q_10489.ground_truth: The PA is used to authenticate the UAV and UAVC as normal UEs before they can get UAS services through the USS/UTM.

q_10490.question: What is the minimum requirement for the intermodulation response rejection for a BS in the presence of two interfering signals?
q_10490.ground_truth: For the minimum requirement, the BER should not exceed 0.001 for any UTRA carrier, and the throughput should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel for any E-UTRA carrier.

q_10491.question: What is the basis for creating the high frequency excitation spectrum in this process?
q_10491.ground_truth: The high frequency excitation spectrum is based on a copy of the decoded low frequency spectrum, with spectral anti-sparseness processing and dynamic range control applied.

q_10492.question: What is the definition of Personal Area Network (PAN) as per 3GPP TS 22.259?
q_10492.ground_truth: PAN is defined as a network of devices connected via short-range wireless communications, typically established by a user and operated in close proximity to the user.

q_10493.question: What is the scenario in which the Re-synchronization-Info AVP within Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP needs to be populated?
q_10493.ground_truth: When the re-synchronizationInfo parameter within SendAuthenticationInfoArg is present.

q_10494.question: How many bits are swapped in the second round of bit swapping for UAS-10 type 1?
q_10494.ground_truth: In the second round of bit swapping for UAS-10 type 1, 64 bits are swapped (0, 7, 31, 106, 130, 155, 226, 251, 298, 323,

q_10495.question: Which transmit diversity scheme uses Space Code Transmit Diversity (SCTD) for P-CCPCH?
q_10495.ground_truth: SCTD transmission scheme for beacon channels, specifically for P-CCPCH.

q_10496.question: What should the UE do if it has no Grant and the TEBS becomes larger than zero in 1.28 Mcps TDD and 3.84/7.68 Mcps TDD?
q_10496.ground_truth: In 1.28 Mcps TDD, the UE shall include Scheduling Information in the next MAC-e PDU sent and the scheduling information delay timer shall be restarted. In 3.84/7.68 Mcps TDD, the transmission of Scheduling Information shall be sent via E-RUCCH.

q_10497.question: What are the requirements on the satellite access with mobile coverage areas and on-board gNBs to limit the impact on the 5G CN and on the UE?
q_10497.ground_truth: This is a point expected to be studied within Key Issue 4.

q_10498.question: What is the use of Cell Notification in a cell update procedure?
q_10498.ground_truth: Cell Notification is an optimised Cell Update Procedure that the MS may use in order to perform a cell update. However, the network and the MS must support the Cell Notification for backward compatibility.

q_10499.question: What should a UE do when the RRC connection is released and UE test loop mode C is active for Broadcast MRB?
q_10499.ground_truth: The UE shall keep UE test loop mode C active.

q_10500.question: Which IE contains the IE called 'id-RL-Information-PhyChReconfRqstFDD'?

q_10501.question: What potential coexistence impacts were not analyzed for potential coverage recovery solutions in Rel-17 Coverage Enhancement SI?
q_10501.ground_truth: The potential coexistence impacts introduced by potential coverage recovery solutions described in clause 9.2.1 have not been analyzed.

q_10502.question: What is the permission granted to the UE if it receives a response indicating that the MO-LR request for periodic self location cannot be supported in the UMTS CS domain?
q_10502.ground_truth: If the UE receives a response indicating that the MO-LR request for periodic self location cannot be supported, the UE may periodically invoke the MO-LR procedure for self location defined in clause~9.2.1 for the CS domain (CS-MO-LR) and in clause~9.2.2 for the PS domain (PS-MO-LR) in the UMTS CS domain.

q_10503.question: In Coverage Evaluation Method 2, which frequency is used by Source 16 in the DL traffic model for FR2, InH, DL, CG8, #UE/cell=Capacity(32) with the AR30 option?
q_10503.ground_truth: In Coverage Evaluation Method 2, Source 16 used a frequency of -105dB in the DL traffic model for FR2, InH, DL, CG8, #UE/cell=Capacity(32) with the AR30 option.

q_10504.question: What is the time interval between two sequential UPLINK ACCESS messages when the priority of the current uplink access is privileged or emergency?
q_10504.ground_truth: The time interval between two sequential UPLINK ACCESS messages is 80ms plus a random delay between 0 and 20ms when the priority of the current uplink access is privileged or emergency.

q_10505.question: What is the base type for the reportType attribute in the reportProcedureType complexType?

q_10506.question: What is the impact of using two different background noise simulation systems on the S-, N-, and G-MOS scores in the normal position?
q_10506.ground_truth: The S-, N-, and G-MOS scores are very similar for the two background noise simulation systems in the normal position, with a tendency to slightly bigger differences in the vertical position.

q_10507.question: What is the purpose of GBA-Push-Info in GBA Push?
q_10507.ground_truth: GBA-Push-Info contains data relevant for key derivation in GBA Push and is sent via the Upa-reference point from the NAF to the UE.

q_10508.question: What is the purpose of the "Record-Route" header in the INVITE message sent from the P-CSCF to the S-CSCF in the scenario described?
q_10508.ground_truth: The "Record-Route" header in the INVITE message sent from the P-CSCF to the S-CSCF is used to specify that this S-CSCF should be included in the path of the message. The header is added by the P-CSCF and contains the URI of the S-CSCF, as well as any parameters that are necessary for the message to be processed by the S-CSCF.

q_10509.question: What determines the leak rate R for a PFC?
q_10509.ground_truth: The leak rate R for a PFC is determined by the BSS and is set in a FLOW-CONTROL-BVC PDU. It is transmitted to an MS's PFC until PFC flow control applies for the PFC, at which point R should not be greater than the value of R provided in the latest valid FLOW-CONTROL-PFC PDU.

q_10510.question: What message is sent by the fixed part to the service node, indicating that initialisation of the fixed part has been completed?
q_10510.ground_truth: The message type is "CTS-FP initialisation complete".

q_10511.question: What AVP should be populated in the MME-Number-for-MT-SMS if present in the UpdateGprsLocationArg?
q_10511.ground_truth: The AVP should be populated with the value received within the mmeNumberforMTSMS parameter of UpdateGprsLocationArg.

q_10512.question: What indicator indicates whether the Serving E-DCH RL is in the DRNS?

q_10513.question: In the context of the 3GPP technical specification, what does the acronym TMC stand for?

q_10514.question: How does the PCRF determine if an IP-CAN session relates to an IMS RLOS session for Restricted Local Operator Services?
q_10514.ground_truth: The PCRF determines if an IP-CAN session relates to an IMS RLOS session for Restricted Local Operator Services based on the RLOS APN used in the IP-CAN session.

q_10515.question: What action is taken by the Anchor Proxy-Gn after receiving the Create PDP Context Request during the handover from EGAN to GERAN/UTRAN?
q_10515.ground_truth: The Anchor Proxy-Gn registers the Gn signalling parameters, informs the GGSN to switch the user plane to the SGSN, and sends Create PDP Context Response to the SGSN via the "Interim" Proxy-Gn.

q_10516.question: What projections were used for coding the VVC bitstreams?
q_10516.ground_truth: The VVC bitstreams were coded with padded equirectangular projection (PERP) and generalized cubemap projection (GCMP).

q_10517.question: What is the purpose of the RAN-Information-REQUEST PDU in the SON Transfer RIM application when the RIM Application Identity IE is set to "SON Transfer"?
q_10517.ground_truth: The RAN-Information-REQUEST PDU is used by a controlling BSS to send the SON Transfer Request container to the serving BSS as specified in TS 36.413.

q_10518.question: When sending a PAGING-PS PDU to a BSS to trigger paging for a given MS, including the eDRX information, what is the condition for the MS to be paged if the cell does not support EC-GSM-IoT?
q_10518.ground_truth: The MS is paged on the PCH using the indicated eDRX information if the MS Radio Access Capability IE indicates that the MS supports GPRS/EGPRS.

q_10519.question: What is the purpose of event forwarding discriminators in short-term recording of tracing events and complex filter conditions?
q_10519.ground_truth: Event forwarding discriminators are used for short-term recording of tracing events and for more complicated filter conditions. They are extremely flexible, permitting the combination of various fields and logical operations with a wide variety of scheduling options, and controlling the destinations to which the event reports are sent.

q_10520.question: What is the objective of Key Issue 7, group message?
q_10520.ground_truth: The objective of Key Issue 7 is to support group message communication, where a UE sends a message to a group of UEs, and all the members in a group can send messages, regardless of the UE's location.

q_10521.question: What includes security algorithms and key derivation functions which shall be supported by the UE and is temporary data stored in MME?

q_10522.question: What is the role of the IC-T1 in the described message flow?
q_10522.ground_truth: The IC-T1 is responsible for forwarding the INVITE request to the remote network when the S-CSCF-hA1 decides not to loopback the INVITE request.

q_10523.question: What is the definition of remote surgery?
q_10523.ground_truth: Remote surgery, also known as telesurgery, is the ability for a doctor to perform surgery on a patient from a distance using technology and a high-speed data connection.

q_10524.question: Is it possible to differentiate the QoS requirements for the same type of Edge Application Servers?
q_10524.ground_truth: Yes, it is possible to differentiate the QoS requirements for the same type of Edge Application Servers by applying policy rules and using inputs such as UE (IP or MAC) address, Application identifier, traffic filtering information, AF Communication Service Identifier, and AF Record Identifier.

q_10525.question: What kind of handover does the Sv interface support between IMS based voice service and CS domain?
q_10525.ground_truth: The Sv interface supports inter-RAT handover from IMS based voice service over EPS to CS domain over 3GPP UTRAN/GERAN access.

q_10526.question: What does the acronym CRITICALITY stand for in ID id-UL-DPCH-Information-RL-SetupRqstFDD?
q_10526.ground_truth: CRITICALITY in ID id-UL-DPCH-Information-RL-SetupRqstFDD stands for the critical importance of the piece of information, in other words the severity of the impact if the information is not correct

q_10527.question: What is the purpose of the "Catalogue of General Security Assurance Requirements" referred to in the document?
q_10527.ground_truth: The Catalogue of General Security Assurance Requirements provides a set of security requirements and test cases that are applicable to multiple product classes, which the present document adapts and supplements with MME-specific requirements and test cases.

q_10528.question: In what scenario must the eNodeB inform the MME of the selected core network operator as part of the HO required message during a handover?
q_10528.ground_truth: When the serving PLMN in use is not supported in the target cell.

q_10529.question: What box is used to define the sample entry four-character code for scenes in DIMS streams?
q_10529.ground_truth: DIMSSampleEntry class sample entry is used to define the sample entry four-character code for scenes in DIMS streams.

q_10530.question: What should a Node B do if the Radio Link Addition Request message includes the UARFCN IE in a single frequency cell?
q_10530.ground_truth: The Node B should reject the Radio Link Addition procedure and respond with the RADIO LINK ADDITION FAILURE message.

q_10531.question: Which state is assigned to a UE when it has a valid 5G-GUTI and attempts initial registration procedure?
q_10531.ground_truth: The UE does not use the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state when a valid 5G-GUTI is available and the UE attempts initial registration.

q_10532.question: Under what condition should the SGSN_UPDATE_PROCEDURE value be set in the CancellationType AVP while constructing a CLR message in step 3.1?
q_10532.ground_truth: The SGSN_UPDATE_PROCEDURE value should be set in the CancellationType AVP if the TypeOfUpdate parameter in CancelLocationArg is set to sgsn-change.

q_10533.question: What is the nominal channel spacing for UTRA FDD in Frequency Division Duplexing (FDD) mode?
q_10533.ground_truth: The nominal UTRA channel spacing is 5 MHz for FDD.

q_10534.question: What should the UE do with the Tsor-cm timer if the value of the Tsor-cm timer in the new SOR-CMCI is infinity and the Tsor-cm timer associated to the PDU session or service is not running?
q_10534.ground_truth: The UE shall start the Tsor-cm timer associated to the PDU session or service with the value set to infinity.

q_10535.question: In multiple stream region-dependent encoding, what does the receiver select based on the actual viewport?
q_10535.ground_truth: The receiver selects to download and render the stream which emphasized region best corresponds to the actual viewport.

q_10536.question: What message is sent by the network immediately in a fast call set-up procedure, indicating the priority level?

q_10537.question: What does the network or operator do to ensure isolation of the usage of slices by the UE?
q_10537.ground_truth: The network or operator creates a UE profile accordingly, allocates different identities (SUPI and GPSIs) to use with sets of S-NSSAIs that require isolation, and ensures the UE registers with the identity corresponding to the S-NSSAI it wants to use.

q_10538.question: What is the time duration for the first fileSchedule in the first serviceSchedule of the first instantiation example?
q_10538.ground_truth: The time duration for the first fileSchedule in the first serviceSchedule of the first instantiation example is 10 minutes.

q_10539.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) do when operating with DCH Enhancements in DL FET Full mode and the IE "Early DCH quality target" is included in the message?
q_10539.ground_truth: The UE should set, at physical channel establishment, the initial downlink target SIR based on the value received in the IE "Early DCH quality target" for the transport channel(s) undergoing concatenation at the physical layer as indicated in the IE "TrCh Concatenation Info".

q_10540.question: What is the purpose of the "iE-Extensions" field in the "GeneralCauseList-RL-ReconfFailure" sequence?
q_10540.ground_truth: It is an optional field that contains a protocol extension container that can carry extension information for the GeneralCauseList-RL-ReconfFailure sequence.

q_10541.question: What are the two transport layer options specified for Common Channels (FACH, RACH, DSCH (TDD), USCH (TDD), HS-DSCH) data streams in Iur and Iub?
q_10541.ground_truth: The two transport layer options specified are ATM based Transport (ATM transport option) and IP based Transport (IP transport option).

q_10542.question: How does the AMR speech codec in a GSM system adapt to changing radio channel conditions?
q_10542.ground_truth: The AMR speech codec in a GSM system adapts to changing radio channel conditions by switching between different codec modes based on the propagation error conditions. It provides a different level of error protection through a dedicated distribution of the available gross bit rate between source coding and channel coding. A codec adaptation algorithm selects the optimized speech rate (or codec mode) as a function of the channel quality.

q_10543.question: What is the difference between the first and the second digit in the version number of the 3GPP technical specification?
q_10543.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the level of TSG approval, while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates.

q_10544.question: What does S-CCPCH stand for in the context of 3GPP?

q_10545.question: What is the message type, significance, and direction of System Information Type 1?
q_10545.ground_truth: The message type is SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 1, the significance is dual, and it is sent from the network to the mobile station.

q_10546.question: How do liability issues arise in relation to UC reputation systems and differing UC legislation?
q_10546.ground_truth: Liability arises when financial losses occur due to an erroneous UC score, and differing UC legislation may lead to different handling of liability by legislation, further complicating the situation.

q_10547.question: What should the preamble transmission power be set to if it exceeds the maximum allowed value?
q_10547.ground_truth: The preamble transmission power should be set to the maximum allowed power if it exceeds the maximum allowed value.

q_10548.question: What information does the AS (AS stands for "application server") store when it receives a received INVITE request?
q_10548.ground_truth: The AS stores the Destination Party Identity Information, Originating Party Identity Information, local time and date of the invocation, call diversion information, Referred-By header field, Contact header field, To header field, and From header field when it receives a INVITE request.

q_10549.question: What high-level requirements shall be supported for IP multimedia applications in the 3GPP network?
q_10549.ground_truth: The high-level requirements include support for IP multimedia sessions, negotiable QoS, end-to-end QoS, roaming and interconnection, identification of media types, multiple IP multimedia applications within a session, privacy and security, transcoding, and interconnection between two IMS domains.

q_10550.question: How does the Remote UE obtain a PRUK from the PKMF?
q_10550.ground_truth: The Remote UE can obtain a PRUK from the PKMF by sending a Key Request message to the PKMF and storing any PRUK and PRUK ID that the PKMF includes in the Key Response message.

q_10551.question: How many HS-SCCHs can be associated with an HS-DSCH for one UE, in the high speed downlink shared channel?
q_10551.ground_truth: The number of HS-SCCHs that are associated with an HS-DSCH for one UE in the high speed downlink shared channel can range from a minimum of one HS-SCCH (M=1) to a maximum of four HS-SCCH (M=4).

q_10552.question: Which codec out-performs the reference codec by a wide margin under both unimpaired and error conditions in the ST-HR series of tests?
q_10552.ground_truth: Eaac+ out-performs the reference codec by a wide margin under both unimpaired and error conditions in the ST-HR series of tests.

q_10553.question: What triggers the PDU session modification procedure in alternative 1 for user plane signalling?
q_10553.ground_truth: The reception of the join message by the UPF triggers the PDU session modification procedure in alternative 1 for user plane signalling.

q_10554.question: What should the VLR do if the ALERT-REQUEST timer T7 expires before it receives a BSSAP+-ALERT-ACK message?
q_10554.ground_truth: If the ALERT-REQUEST timer T7 expires before the BSSAP+-ALERT-ACK message is received, the VLR should retransmit the BSSAP+-ALERT-REQUEST message a maximum of N7 times. If no BSSAP+-ALERT-ACK message is received after that, a report shall be made to the O&M system.

q_10555.question: When can CoAP be used for the SEAL-X reference point?
q_10555.ground_truth: CoAP can be used for interactions between SEAL servers on their respective SEAL-X reference points, when there is a trust relationship between the interacting SEAL servers.

q_10556.question: What is the purpose of the interior node <X> in the FLUS Management Object?
q_10556.ground_truth: The purpose of the interior node <X> in the FLUS Management Object is to group together the parameters of a single object.

q_10557.question: How many message units are there in the SMS messages, as shown by the "TP-UDL" field?
q_10557.ground_truth: Each SMS message contains 1 message unit (TP-UDL value of "1" indicates 1 message unit for each message).

q_10558.question: What does the CHANNEL MODE MODIFY ACKNOWLEDGE message do?
q_10558.ground_truth: The CHANNEL MODE MODIFY ACKNOWLEDGE message is sent on the main DCCH by the mobile station to the network to indicate the successful or unsuccessful execution of a channel mode modify request.

q_10559.question: What is the impact of the Time Alignment feature on downlink delay in GSM and UMTS?
q_10559.ground_truth: The Time Alignment feature reduces downlink delay by up to 20 ms in GSM and UMTS by aligning the phase of the release of packets by the Media Gateway to the phase at which the BSS or the RNC transmits packets downstream to a given mobile station.

q_10560.question: What is the role of the RAB Assignment Request and Response messages in the video call establishment process?
q_10560.ground_truth: The RAB Assignment Request and Response messages are used to establish a Radio Access Bearer (RAB) between the mobile stations (UEs) and the radio network (RNCs) during the video call establishment process.

q_10561.question: How does the Node B determine the maximum DL power for each timeslot within a DSCH type CCTrCH for 1.28 Mcps TDD?
q_10561.ground_truth: If the CCTrCH Maximum DL Transmission Power IE is included, the Node B uses that power for the maximum DL power. Otherwise, the maximum DL power is the Maximum Downlink Power IE included in the RL Information IE.

q_10562.question: What documents are used for definitions, symbols, and abbreviations in the 3GPP technical specification document?
q_10562.ground_truth: TR~21.905 and the 3GPP Task Force Specification documents are used for definitions, symbols, and abbreviations in the 3GPP technical specification document.

q_10563.question: What is the equation for calculating Tadapt, the time required to switch from the current codec mode to a new supported codec mode?
q_10563.ground_truth: Tadapt equals 20 ms + 40 ms per codec mode switch.

q_10564.question: What is the message type of the short message being sent in the first example?

q_10565.question: What is the SNL interface used for when discussing PDU session management?
q_10565.ground_truth: The SNL interface is used for exchanging information between the gNB (or LTE eNB) and the UPGW related to the PDU session and related resources in the gNB (or LTE eNB).

q_10566.question: What is the function of sending one or more routing rules to the network or to the UE in NBIFOM mode to move selected IP flows from an old access to a new access?
q_10566.ground_truth: This function allows for IP flow mobility within a Multi-access PDN connection, either initiated by the UE or the network.

q_10567.question: In 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE / 5GMM-IDLE / Emergency call / Disabling N1 mode / Emergency call establishment over EPS / Success test case, what must the network indicate in order to ensure that UE selects the E-UTRA cell and requests the establishment of an Emergency call by transmitting an RRCConnectionRequest message with establishmentCause set to 'emergency'?
q_10567.ground_truth: The network must indicate that interworking without N26 interface is not supported and emergency service fallback is not supported.

q_10568.question: What is the purpose of Solution #17 in the document?
q_10568.ground_truth: The purpose of Solution #17 is for provisioning EC Parameters to the roaming UE related to PDU Sessions for edge applications.

q_10569.question: What should the IWF do upon receiving a SIP INFO request for an ongoing session?
q_10569.ground_truth: The IWF should follow the procedures for SIP INFO as specified in clause~11.1.1.1.1.

q_10570.question: What is the responsibility of NSQ in relation to a S-NSSAI?
q_10570.ground_truth: NSQ should be provisioned with the Slice-AMBR value for a S-NSSAI and should have the capability to provide the percentage of data rate (to be adjusted or reduced) to the SMF.

q_10571.question: What is the parameter indicated by the E-DCH TDD Maximum Bitrate?
q_10571.ground_truth: The Maximum Bitrate for an E-DCH in TDD mode.

q_10572.question: When does a mobile station have either zero or one RRC connections in Iu mode?
q_10572.ground_truth: An RRC connection in Iu mode is only established when the mobile station is transmitting or receiving data on a TBF.

q_10573.question: What is the procedure when the SS orders the MS to close its TCH loop and signal erased frames and unreliable frames (Type D loop)?
q_10573.ground_truth: When the SS orders the MS to close a Type D loop, the MS starts transmitting reliable speech frames received on the downlink TCH/HS to the uplink TCH, and sets the input frame to zero if it detects a bad speech frame, unreliable frame, or an FACCH frame.

q_10574.question: What system maps UE provided location information to a form that is understood by the 3GPP MBMS system, e.g. MBMS SAI(s) and/or ECGI(s)?

q_10575.question: What should the old BSS do with other messages received during the handover execution procedure?
q_10575.ground_truth: Whilst the handover execution procedure is in operation, any other messages received at the old BSS relating to this connection and concerning assignment, handover, or cipher mode control should be discarded.

q_10576.question: What is the name of the uncertainty assessment term that is the same for both the conducted measurement and the OTA measurement in the context of power control steps in TS~25.141~?
q_10576.ground_truth: The term is "Uncertainty of conducted measurement" and its value is 0.1 dB.

q_10577.question: What information is contained in the RAB Setup Information message from the new SGSN to the old SGSN?
q_10577.ground_truth: The RAB Setup Information message contains the RNC Tunnel Endpoint Identifier and the RNC IP address for data forwarding from the source SRNC to the target RNC.

q_10578.question: What should the MGW-A do if the RFCI allocations received from a new RNC do not match the stored RFCI allocation?
q_10578.ground_truth: The MGW-A may re-initialize the IuFP towards RNC-A' at this point in time.

q_10579.question: What is the main protocol entity in the UE used by the System Simulator (SS) to control the UE specific testing functions?

q_10580.question: What is the purpose of the Completion Phase in the Enhanced Serving RNS Relocation procedure?
q_10580.ground_truth: In this phase, the MS has been relocated to the Target RNC, and the Target RNC sends an Enhanced Relocation Complete Request message to the SGSN indicating relocated RABs and the status of the relocation.

q_10581.question: What is the type of the "id-TransportLayerAddress" extension in the RAB-SetupItem-RelocReqAck-ExtIEs RANAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
q_10581.ground_truth: The type of the "id-TransportLayerAddress" extension is "EXTENSION TransportLayerAddress".

q_10582.question: In the context of call duration in UTRAN cell for CS domain, what is the accumulation period used for converting the time interval RRC RADIO BEARER SETUP COMPLETE and the call completed RRC RADIO BEARER RELEASE into seconds for conversational service?
q_10582.ground_truth: The accumulation period used for converting the time interval RRC RADIO BEARER SETUP COMPLETE and the call completed RRC RADIO BEARER RELEASE into seconds for conversational service is a granularity period.

q_10583.question: What is the role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in the technical specification?
q_10583.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing the technical specification, which covers various aspects of telecommunication management and mobile networks with virtualized network functions.

q_10584.question: What should the system simulator set as the PCell, PSCell, and neighbor cell in the preamble for 8.2.3.11.3.3.1?
q_10584.ground_truth: NR Cell 1 is the PCell, NR Cell 10 is the PSCell and NR Cell 3 is Neighbour Cell on FR2.

q_10585.question: What action does the PCEF take when it receives a notification about the removal of an access of a multi-access IP-CAN session?
q_10585.ground_truth: The PCEF initiates an IP-CAN Session Modification procedure to notify the PCRF about the removal of an access, and modifies or deletes the corresponding PCC rules.

q_10586.question: What is the formula to compute the second independent threshold?
q_10586.ground_truth: It is computed as the product of the first independent threshold and the ratio of the sub-band energies at the beginning and the end of the pre-echo zone.

q_10587.question: What services are exempted from the SOR-CMCI criteria for the UE?
q_10587.ground_truth: Emergency services are exempted from the SOR-CMCI criteria.

q_10588.question: What is the method of load sharing for BSSs with more than one signalling link?
q_10588.ground_truth: Load sharing for BSSs with more than one signalling link is performed by means of the Signalling Link Selection (SLS) field.

q_10589.question: Over what period of time is the E-DCH related time slot information associated with the E-AGCH valid?
q_10589.ground_truth: The E-DCH related time slot information associated with the E-AGCH shall always refer to either the same or the following radio frame, and shall not refer to two subsequent radio frames.

q_10590.question: What is the purpose of the PS-NI-LR procedure in packet-switched networks?
q_10590.ground_truth: The PS-NI-LR procedure is used to initiate a location request to the GMLC in the event of an emergency situation, such as after emergency attach, service request for emergency, or PDP context activation towards an emergency APN. It is also used to transfer the SGSN address to the GMLC indicated by the old SGSN after the handover or relocation of an emergency PDP context from an old to a new SGSN.

q_10591.question: What is the response code used in support of ACR service?
q_10591.ground_truth: The response code 433 (Anonymity Disallowed) is used in support of ACR service.

q_10592.question: What interfaces are used for circuit switched services in GAN Iu mode?
q_10592.ground_truth: The Iu-cs interface is used for circuit switched services in GAN Iu mode.

q_10593.question: What is the expected sequence number for the SEND DTMF test with text attribute - Bold On?
q_10593.ground_truth: The expected sequence number for the SEND DTMF test with text attribute - Bold On is 4.6.

q_10594.question: What should the UE do upon receiving the RRCSetup message if it has connection establishment failure information available in VarConnEstReport and RPLMN is equal to the plmn-Identity stored in VarConnEstReport?
q_10594.ground_truth: The UE should include connEstInfoAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message.

q_10595.question: What is the purpose of the "Attempted SMS mobile terminating" measurement?
q_10595.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of SMS mobile terminating attempts and uses the "2 out of 3 approach" for three measurement types.

q_10596.question: What should be done with the exceeded part of the allocated power of a supported operating band, if it exceeds the declared Prated of the operating band?
q_10596.ground_truth: If the allocated power of a supported operating band exceeds the declared Prated,t of the operating band, the exceeded part should, if possible, be reallocated into the other band(s).

q_10597.question: What should be the value of the "Content-Disposition" header when carrying the information associated with USSD in the g.3gpp.ussd info package?

q_10598.question: Which measurement from TS 23.140 provides the number of Multimedia Messages (MM) submit responses sent by MMS Relay/Server to MMS User Agent on the Reference point MM1, split into subcounters per request status code?
q_10598.ground_truth: The measurement 4.1.2, "Number of Multimedia Messages (MM) submit responses sent by MMS Relay/Server" from TS 23.140, provides the information mentioned.

q_10599.question: What should the NAF do if it does not support the GBA type specified in the "requestGbaPushInfoResponse" message?
q_10599.ground_truth: If the NAF does not support the GBA type in the "requestGbaPushInfoResponse" message, it shall stop processing the message and indicate an error via the O&M subsystem.

q_10600.question: In the context of the 3GPP system, what is a personalized environment for a user that ensures consistent, personalized service, irrespective of the user's location or the terminal used?
q_10600.ground_truth: The "User Profile" is the set of information necessary to provide a user with a consistent, personalized service environment, irrespective of the user's location or the terminal used in the context of the 3GPP system.

q_10601.question: What is the purpose of timeslot allocation in the tri-sectored deployment model for MBMS transmissions?
q_10601.ground_truth: Each sector is assigned to a particular "MBMS transmission set", set 1, 2 or 3. An MBMS data unit is transmitted three times by each set in different timeslots.

q_10602.question: What is the function of the "Notification to CSE flag" in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_10602.ground_truth: The "Notification to CSE flag" is used to notify the gsmSCF(s) when the data for any Call Barring services are changed.

q_10603.question: What is the meaning of "UAS" in the context of the document?
q_10603.ground_truth: The acronym "UAS" stands for "Uncrewed Aerial System" in the document.

q_10604.question: What is a mobile phone virus, and what are the risks associated with it?
q_10604.ground_truth: A mobile phone virus is a serious threat for users that can result in sensitive information being lost, damages to software and hardware, unavailability of mobile phone services, and additional charges. For the operator, large quantities of junk data distribution will result in network traffic jam and degraded service quality.

q_10605.question: What determines the highest allowed Codec Mode for Tandem Free Operation?
q_10605.ground_truth: The worst of both radio legs determines the highest allowed Codec Mode for Tandem Free Operation.

q_10606.question: What is a Personal Area Network (PAN) in the context of Personal Network Management?
q_10606.ground_truth: A Personal Area Network (PAN) is a local network of the PN-User that consists of at least one UE and may also comprise a number of MEs/MTs, with own radio access means that allow them to directly access the PLMN of the UE. The UE and locally connected additional MEs/MTs are the PNEs of the PAN.

q_10607.question: What is used to indicate ongoing user data transmission in A/Gb mode in the SGSN?

q_10608.question: What are the functional entities in a 3GPP system called?
q_10608.ground_truth: The functional entities in a 3GPP system are referred to as "basic telecom management functional areas."

q_10609.question: What type of primitive is used to indicate a normal dialogue end when there is no component primitive?

q_10610.question: What is the role of Horizontal Dilution of Precision (HDOP) in 3GPP TS 37.571-1?
q_10610.ground_truth: Horizontal Dilution of Precision (HDOP) is a measure of position determination accuracy that is used in 3GPP TS 37.571-1 to indicate the geometric layout of the satellites used for the fix in relation to the receiver antenna. A lower HDOP value indicates a more accurate position fix while a higher HDOP value indicates a less accurate position fix.

q_10611.question: Under what circumstances can an UE receive paging messages for other services while engaged in packet data transfer?
q_10611.ground_truth: One mode of network operation allows for paging messages for other services to be received by an UE via the packet data channel without degrading packet data transfer.

q_10612.question: What is required to protect data transferred via the Messaging Framework in 5GS?
q_10612.ground_truth: The transfer of data between the data source and data consumer via the messaging framework shall be confidentiality, integrity, and replay protected. Confidentiality protection, integrity protection, and replay-protection shall be supported on the new interfaces between 3GPP entities and MFAF.

q_10613.question: What device is used to measure the radiated power samples in the e radiation power measurement procedure?
q_10613.ground_truth: A radio communications tester, a corresponding device, a measurement receiver, or a spectrum analyzer can be used to measure the radiated power samples.

q_10614.question: What is the recommended action if the paging policy needs to be changed in the described solution?
q_10614.ground_truth: The AMF may decide whether, when and where to page the UE if the paging policy needs to be changed.

q_10615.question: How many muting frames are there in NRF_WAKEUP?

q_10616.question: What should be done by the SGSN when it receives a Create MBMS Context Response message with the Cause value indicating "Request Accepted" from the GGSN?
q_10616.ground_truth: The SGSN may be required to register with the GGSN, following the MBMS Registration Request procedure.

q_10617.question: What is the primary function of the AMF upon receipt of the Registration Request message with the UE's indication of support of the MINT feature?
q_10617.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the Registration Request message with the UE's indication of support of the MINT feature, the AMF sends a new information element that contains a new timer, called T35xx, to the UE in Registration Accept message.

q_10618.question: What aspect does the connected ambulance use case prioritize in wireless, easy-to-apply on-body sensors in emergency healthcare?
q_10618.ground_truth: The use case emphasizes low-power operation, real-time operation, no-wires-needed, and reliability through communication path redundancy for on-body sensors and connected healthcare devices.

q_10619.question: What is the name of the key derived for integrity protection of user data when the UE is connected to E-UTRA/EPC and capable of user plane integrity protection?

q_10620.question: What is the purpose of the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) in this process?
q_10620.ground_truth: The DCT is used to convert the de-emphasized signal into the frequency domain.

q_10621.question: What action should the mobile station take after sending the first RLC data block on a TBF?
q_10621.ground_truth: The mobile station should stop timer T3164 for that TBF and perform any necessary actions for the received frequency parameters information element in the assignment message.

q_10622.question: When an NB-IoT UE is decoding a DCI with CRC scrambled by the P-RNTI and the DCI schedules an NPDSCH, in which NB-IoT DL subframes may the UE assume NRSs are transmitted for the scheduled NPDSCH?
q_10622.ground_truth: If the DCI with CRC scrambled by the P-RNTI schedules a NPDSCH, the UE may assume NRSs are transmitted in the NB-IoT DL subframes carrying the NPDSCH as well as 4 NB-IoT DL subframes before and after the scheduled NPDSCH, where NB-IoT DL subframes without NRS are not counted.

q_10623.question: What is the requirement for the Relative Code Domain Error (RCDE) for 64QAM modulated codes?
q_10623.ground_truth: The average Relative Code Domain Error for 64QAM modulated codes shall not exceed -21.9dB at spreading factor 16.

q_10624.question: What is the purpose of the DiscardReq parameter in RLC SDU transmission?
q_10624.ground_truth: The DiscardReq parameter indicates whether the transmitting RLC entity needs to inform the upper layers of the discarded RLC SDU. If required, the transmitting RLC entity notifies upper layers when the SDU is discarded.

q_10625.question: What is the network technology used by the eCall capable UE to establish an eCall in this test case?
q_10625.ground_truth: The eCall capable UE establishes the eCall using the CS domain, which can be UTRA (UTRAN) or GERAN (GSM EDGE Radio Access Network).

q_10626.question: What is the role of the Virtualization Infrastructure Service Provider (VISP) in the 5GC segment of the NPN?
q_10626.ground_truth: The VISP, played by a 3rd-party cloud service provider, is responsible for providing virtualization infrastructure services in the 5GC segment of the NPN.

q_10627.question: What TNL QoS IE value should the DRNS use if ALCAP is not used for a DCH or a set of co-ordinated DCHs?
q_10627.ground_truth: The DRNS may use this information to determine the transport bearer characteristics to apply for the uplink for the related DCH or set of co-ordinated DCHs.

q_10628.question: What is the responsibility of the ThresholdConditions node in the RANValidityCondition scenario?
q_10628.ground_truth: The ThresholdConditions node is responsible for evaluating the RAN validity condition for a particular flow distribution rule.

q_10629.question: What is the process of triggering session-oriented service establishment as per Solution #1?
q_10629.ground_truth: The V2X application-specific server triggers the VAE server to initiate a session-oriented service to the VAE client, which includes information such as the identity of the VAE client, the identity of the V2X application specific server, the identity of the service session, the V2X service ID, and the "type" or "QoS requirements" of the session. The VAE server then provides a session-oriented service trigger response to the V2X application-specific server, indicating its ability or inability to initiate a session-oriented service with the VAE client.

q_10630.question: What is the name of the module that is used for the presentation layer solution in 3GPP services, planned for Release 12?
q_10630.ground_truth: A common and modern scene description solution

q_10631.question: What does the 3GPP TR technical report on Media Production over 5G NPN Systems (Release 17) identify as standardization needs and potential gaps when using 5G Systems for media production?
q_10631.ground_truth: The report identifies the need to identify relevant media production use cases, develop reference media production architectures, identify QoS requirements for media production workflows, clarify the usage of 5G System features for media production, study media device and network orchestration solutions, and collaborate with relevant organizations for media-related aspects.

q_10632.question: What is the primary means of protection of multicast data in the solution?
q_10632.ground_truth: Multicast data protection is performed between UE and MBSTF, the anchor point of the multicast data. The MTK and KID, used for the multicast data protection, is generated by MBSF and securely distributed to UE over the control plane, and to MBSTF.

q_10633.question: What does the "num" value specify in the compact SDP parameters?
q_10633.ground_truth: The "num" value specifies the maximum number of supported concurrent encoders or decoders of the specified codec at the specified level and profile.

q_10634.question: What should the NAS do upon receiving an indication that the barring is alleviated for the access category, if the event was a request from upper layers to send a mobile originated SMS over NAS and the NAS did not initiate the NAS transport procedure?
q_10634.ground_truth: The NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the SMS in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message, if still needed.

q_10635.question: When shall an MCPTT group information entry be copied into a new MCPTT group information entry of the candidate list of the MCPTT group information entries?
q_10635.ground_truth: When the MCPTT group ID is in the served list of the MCPTT group information entries, the expiration time of the MCPTT group information entry has not expired yet, and the IWF determines the user is not to be affiliated with the group.

q_10636.question: What is the purpose of providing Quality of Service information in LCS?
q_10636.ground_truth: LCS Quality of Service information is characterized by three key attributes: LCS QoS Class, Accuracy, and Response Time, and is used to define the degree of adherence to the required QoS.

q_10637.question: What mandatory Diameter AVP is used to specify the network domain name of the targeted V2X Control Function?
q_10637.ground_truth: The Destination-Realm AVP is used to specify the network domain name of the targeted V2X Control Function.

q_10638.question: What is the purpose of the AS (CONF) generating an "ECT Session Identifier" in the ECT supplementary service?
q_10638.ground_truth: The AS (CONF) generates an "ECT Session Identifier" to replace User C as the new destination information and forwards SIP REFER towards User A. This identifier ensures that the SIP REFER request is correctly processed and forwarded to User A, who will then initiate a new session with User C.

q_10639.question: What kind of out of band emissions are specified in section 11.1.1.2.2.1?
q_10639.ground_truth: Out of band emissions specified in section 11.1.1.2.2.1 are unwanted emissions immediately outside the nominal channel resulting from the modulation process and non-linearity in the transmitter but excluding spurious emissions.

q_10640.question: What was the noise type that caused the maximum deviation in the TS103-4.0/-4.1/8.0 systems?
q_10640.ground_truth: The car noise was the most common noise type to cause the maximum deviations in the TS103-4.0/-4.1/8.0 systems.

q_10641.question: What information does the AF provide to PCF_1 and PCF_2?
q_10641.ground_truth: The AF provides TSN QoS parameters for specific ports and TSN parameters used for uplink and downlink TSCAI for the TSN flow to PCF_1 and PCF_2, respectively.

q_10642.question: What is the termination type value "001" reserved for in the termination ID?

q_10643.question: What does the term "Access Stratum" refer to in the context of 3GPP specifications?
q_10643.ground_truth: A functional grouping consisting of the parts in the infrastructure and user equipment specific to the access technique, and the protocols between these parts.

q_10644.question: What parameters are used to determine if the decoded frame contains more likely speech of generic audio in AMR-WB IO modes?
q_10644.ground_truth: The total frame energy and the statistical deviation of the energy variation history are used to determine if the decoded frame contains more likely speech of generic audio in AMR-WB IO modes.

q_10645.question: What information does the Default-EPS-Bearer-QoS AVP include when provisioning default EPS bearer QoS information?
q_10645.ground_truth: The Default-EPS-Bearer-QoS AVP includes the QoS-Class-Identifier AVP and the Allocation-Retention-Priority AVP when provisioning default EPS bearer QoS information.

q_10646.question: What are the three enumerations of the flow-direction field?
q_10646.ground_truth: The three enumerations of the flow-direction field are DOWNLINK, UPLINK, and BIDIRECTIONAL, indicating the direction(s) that a filter is applicable, downlink only, uplink only, or both down- and uplink (bidirectional).

q_10647.question: What is the purpose of the Criticality Diagnostics IE in the SABP protocol?
q_10647.ground_truth: The Criticality Diagnostics IE is used to indicate which IEs were not comprehended or were missing in a received message.

q_10648.question: What does the acronym "MUROS" stand for in the context of telecommunications?
q_10648.ground_truth: The acronym "MUROS" stands for "Multi-carrier Overhead Raising Scheme" in the context of telecommunications.

q_10649.question: What entity determines the number of units in the context of requesting resource usage in the first scenario?
q_10649.ground_truth: The CTF (Charging Trigger Function) determines the number of units based on the service requested by the UE-A.

q_10650.question: If the UE only supports Rx-Tx time difference type 1 measurement, what value should be set to the "Rx-Tx time difference type 2" IE?
q_10650.ground_truth: The "Rx-Tx time difference type 2" IE should be set to value "1279.9375" to indicate that the measurement is not supported.

q_10651.question: What should the DRNS do with the UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate parameters if it is contained in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
q_10651.ground_truth: The DRNS shall, if supported, store the received UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate parameters to control the aggregate data rate of non-GBR traffic for this UE.

q_10652.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network document "In-band control of remote transcoders and rate adaptors for full rate traffic channels (Release 17) Foreword"?
q_10652.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to specify the use and frame structure of 64 kbit/s and 16 kbit/s traffic channels on the Abis interface for full rate speech, enhanced full rate speech, Adaptive Multi-Rate speech, Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband speech, and full rate data service. The document also specifies the submultiplexing for Adaptive Multi-Rate speech and Wideband speech.

q_10653.question: What is the measurement provided in 4.39.1 HSPA evolution scheduling related measurements?
q_10653.ground_truth: The measurement provided in 4.39.1 HSPA evolution scheduling related measurements is the number of 64QAM scheduled TTIs in UTRAN cell.

q_10654.question: What is the procedure for switching from MBMS streaming to PSS streaming without channel change?
q_10654.ground_truth: In order to switch from MBMS to unicast reception of a stream via PSS, a SIP Re-INVITE is issued by the UE with an SDP offer and Request-URI included. After receiving the 200 OK, the UE leaves the multicast channel and starts playback.

q_10655.question: What is the use of a SIP RE-INVITE message during the MBMS Download Session initiation in clause 14.2?
q_10655.ground_truth: The SIP RE-INVITE message is used to initiate the file repair session and tear down the MBMS download session by sending a SIP Re-INVITE message to the IM CN subsystem, which is then forwarded to the SCF, and then to the HTTP/SIP adapter which selects a HTTP Server for the file repair service, and sends an HTTP POST message to the HTTP server.

q_10656.question: How is the frame rate deviation calculated?
q_10656.ground_truth: The frame rate deviation is equal to the pre-defined frame rate minus the actual playback frame rate.

q_10657.question: What is the condition for selective forwarding/logging/retrieval of measurement results in the PLMN measurement system?
q_10657.ground_truth: Selective forwarding/logging/retrieval of measurement results in the PLMN measurement system requires instantiating "simpleScanner" objects such that the scanner identity implicitly identifies the measured resource and measurement types.

q_10658.question: What is one advantage of the Multi-Rate concept in a GSM system?
q_10658.ground_truth: One advantage of the Multi-Rate concept in a GSM system is its ability to adapt to changing radio and traffic conditions, as well as being customizable to the specific needs of network operators. This can lead to improvements in robustness to channel errors, capacity, handover, and power control.

q_10659.question: What is the name of the security protocol used in GBA-Push for key establishment?
q_10659.ground_truth: The name of the security protocol used in GBA-Push for key establishment is GBA Push Layer (GPL).

q_10660.question: Which primitive is used by the DL layer in the MS to indicate the arrival of a random access burst?
q_10660.ground_truth: DL-RANDOM ACCESS-INDICATION primitive is used by the DL layer in the MS to indicate the arrival of a random access burst.

q_10661.question: What is the purpose of the P-TMSI Signature sent by the SGSN to the MS in Attach Accept and Routeing Area Update Accept messages, and how is it used in the 3GPP network?
q_10661.ground_truth: The P-TMSI Signature is used for identification checking purposes. If the signature is sent by the SGSN since the current P-TMSI was allocated, the MS shall include the P-TMSI Signature in the next Routeing Area Update Request, Detach Request, and Attach Request for identification checking purposes.

q_10662.question: What information does the PCRF provide to the TDF during the initial interaction, which defines the charging system addresses?
q_10662.ground_truth: The PCRF provides Charging information containing OFCS and/or OCS addresses to the TDF defining the offline and online charging system addresses respectively.

q_10663.question: What is the length of the START value used for initializing counters in ciphering and integrity protection algorithms?
q_10663.ground_truth: The length of the START value is 20 bits.

q_10664.question: What is the purpose of single transport format detection when no TFCI is available?
q_10664.ground_truth: Single transport format detection is used to detect the transport format of a CCTrCH that has only one transport format with more than zero transport blocks in its transport format set and that does not use guided detection.

q_10665.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
q_10665.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-Network Relay provides the functionality to support connectivity to the network for Remote UEs. It relays unicast traffic between the Remote UE and the network, and may also relay eMBMS traffic using one-to-many ProSe Direct Communication.

q_10666.question: What is the base type of the attribute "value" in the XML schema provided?
q_10666.ground_truth: The base type of the attribute "value" is "MBMS-Session-Identity-Type", which is a restriction of "xs:unsignedByte".

q_10667.question: What is the purpose of dictionaries in the Huffman coding algorithm?
q_10667.ground_truth: Dictionaries, which are essentially a list of key words or phrases of up to 255 characters, can result in very high compression rates when they match long strings in the input stream. These matching characters in the stream are replaced with a reference to the dictionary entry.

q_10668.question: In the 3GPP Iu Release procedure within the UTRAN to GAN CS handover procedure, what messages do the source RNC and GANC send, and in what order, after the CN sends the Iu Release Command message but before the CN tears down the connection to the source RNC?
q_10668.ground_truth: The source RNC sends the Iu Release Complete message, and the GANC sends the Handover Complete message, before the CN tears down the connection to the source RNC.

q_10669.question: What is the procedure when the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed, and the UE has stored a Local emergency numbers list?
q_10669.ground_truth: The UE must delete the stored Local emergency numbers list in the user equipment when the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

q_10670.question: What sequence of bits is used to derive the precoding weight information for HS-SCCH type 3 when one transport block is transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCHs?
q_10670.ground_truth: The sequence of bits x2,i-10 where i ranges from 1 to 10 is used to derive the precoding weight information for HS-SCCH type 3 when one transport block is transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCHs.

q_10671.question: What is the definition of an ECSP Management System as per the given document?
q_10671.ground_truth: An ECSP Management System, as per the given document, is a 3GPP Management System belonging to a mobile network operator or a 3rd party service provider that provides management of edge computing services.

q_10672.question: Which ETSI document defines energy efficiency metrics and measurement methods for NFV components including VNFs and NFVI?

q_10673.question: What action should the IWF performing the controlling role take if the in-progress emergency group state of the group is set to "false" and the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to "true" in an SIP UPDATE request?
q_10673.ground_truth: If the in-progress emergency group state of the group is set to "false" and the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to "true", the IWF performing the controlling role shall include a Resource-Priority header field populated with the values for an MCPTT imminent peril group call in the SIP UPDATE request.

q_10674.question: What is the approach to handle delay jitter for real-time services over IMS?
q_10674.ground_truth: A common solution to handle delay jitter is by introducing a jitter buffer that is designed to handle the variation in packet receiver timing. However, the mere presence of the buffer implicates that the service latency will be increased.

q_10675.question: What is expected from the network in network-initiated NBIFOM mode during the addition of an access?
q_10675.ground_truth: In network-initiated NBIFOM mode, the network does not provide any routing rules to the UE during the addition of an access. Instead, routing rules are provided using a separate IP flow mobility procedure.

q_10676.question: What are the procedures in the AF session release?
q_10676.ground_truth: At AF session release, the PCRF revokes QoS resource authorization for the AF session and the UE releases all QoS resources allocated for the AF session.

q_10677.question: What action does the SCC AS take when a new media flow is added to an existing CS session and delivered to UE-1 via PS access?
q_10677.ground_truth: The SCC AS uses the C-MSISDN for correlation and ensures the new session is delivered only to UE-1, not to other UEs of the user.

q_10678.question: What is the size of the BSN based short Ack/Nack report?
q_10678.ground_truth: The suggested report has the size of n*3 bytes, where n is the minimum number of segments needed for a report, and each segment consists of 5 fields and is 3 bytes in size.

q_10679.question: What is the name of the network function that is responsible for getting and conveying the keepExisting and timing indication to the SMF when communication is done via NEF?

q_10680.question: What is one of the requirements for expected sequence 1.15 in an E-USS/NB-SS setting up only a E-UTRAN/NB-IoT cell?
q_10680.ground_truth: One of the requirements for expected sequence 1.15 is 2 E-UTRA cells on the same frequency, with the second cell having EARFCN less than maxEARFCN.

q_10681.question: What action does the UE take after receiving an RRCConnectionRequest on the E-UTRAN-cell related to the BCCH transmitting TAI 246/081/0002 from the UE?
q_10681.ground_truth: The E-USS sends RRCConnectionSetup to the UE, followed by RRCConnectionSetupComplete sent by the UE to the E-USS.

q_10682.question: What is the role of the initial AMF in step 9 of the solution in providing NAS security context to the target AMF via RAN?
q_10682.ground_truth: The initial AMF may optionally perform horizontal Kamf derivation to ensure that the target AMF has no access to the Kamf, and share the NAS security context (e.g. horizontal key derivation) with the target AMF via RAN.

q_10683.question: What is the significance of the "M" bit in the Diameter protocol and what is its purpose?
q_10683.ground_truth: The "M" bit in the Diameter protocol is used to indicate that a message is a new application and has some new AVPs with "M" bit set, but the rules for its usage have been inconsistent across different 3GPP working groups.

q_10684.question: What is the effective isotropic sensitivity (EIS) in the context of TRS measurement?
q_10684.ground_truth: The effective isotropic sensitivity (EIS) is the minimum power level at which the throughput exceeds or equals 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel (RMC) at each sampling point.

q_10685.question: What is the significance of an increase in the second digit of the version number?
q_10685.ground_truth: An increase in the second digit indicates changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, or updates.

q_10686.question: What should the PCEF do when the UE requests to create new or modify existing NBIFOM routing rules in the 5G network?
q_10686.ground_truth: The PCEF shall include the Routing-Rule-Install AVP with one or more Routing-Rule-Definition AVPs containing the new/modified NBIFOM routing rule(s) in the CCR command.

q_10687.question: What is the purpose of subclause 6.7 in the document?
q_10687.ground_truth: The purpose of subclause 6.7 in the document is to verify that the RF transmit equipment is able to restrict the generation of signals in its nonlinear elements caused by the presence of the RF output from the transmitter and an interfering signal reaching the transmitter via its antenna to below specified levels.

q_10688.question: What is an EGPRS2 mobile station in 3GPP?
q_10688.ground_truth: An EGPRS2 mobile station is an EGPRS mobile station supporting additional modulation and coding schemes on the downlink and/or the uplink. The support of EGPRS2 is optional for the mobile station and the network.

q_10689.question: What is the RSTD measurement period equation based on, in terms of the UE support for ppw-durationOfPRS-Processing1-r17 or ppw-durationOfPRS-Processing2-r17?
q_10689.ground_truth: The RSTD measurement period follows the equation based on whether any of the positioning frequency layers are in Case 1 or all the positioning frequency layers are in Case 2.

q_10690.question: What are the three types of traffic forwarding methods for 5G VN group communication?
q_10690.ground_truth: The three types of traffic forwarding methods for 5G VN group communication are N6-based, Local-switch, and N19-based user plane.

q_10691.question: Who has control over the administration of speech or multimodal/multi-device services in a 3GPP system?
q_10691.ground_truth: The administration of the speech or multimodal/multi-device services (authorization, deauthorization, registration, deregistration, activation, deactivation) is under the control of the network operator.

q_10692.question: What interfaces are supported in Architecture scenario A for signalling between the BPCF and the 3GPP AF?

q_10693.question: What type of signal is being measured in the CATR testing procedure in step 2.3?
q_10693.ground_truth: The CATR testing procedure measures the Downlink Reference Symbol (DL RS) power in step 2.3.

q_10694.question: What is the purpose of the NS-STATUS PDU in the Sub-Network Service protocol?
q_10694.ground_truth: The NS-STATUS PDU is used to report errors to the remote NS entity in the Sub-Network Service protocol. It shall never be used to report an error detected in a received NS-STATUS PDU.

q_10695.question: What is the role of the 3G SGSN when handling an inter-SGSN Suspend and Resume procedure?
q_10695.ground_truth: The 3G SGSN requests the SRNS to stop sending downlink PDU's, starts buffering the downlink PDUs, and relays the Suspend Request message to the actual old SGSN.

q_10696.question: What is the potential impact of RLC persistent mode in MBMS on spectral efficiency when using unicast transmission with a separate resource?
q_10696.ground_truth: Its impact on spectral efficiency has yet to be determined.

q_10697.question: How many rated beam EIRP may be declared by a manufacturer for a passband where the supported fractional bandwidth is larger than 6%?
q_10697.ground_truth: Two rated beam EIRP may be declared by a manufacturer for a passband where the supported fractional bandwidth is larger than 6%: one for the lower supported frequency range, and one for the higher supported frequency range.

q_10698.question: What should the data link layer do when receiving a DL-RELEASE-REQUEST primitive from layer~3 with the release mode parameter set to "local end release"?
q_10698.ground_truth: The data link layer should return a DL-RELEASE-CONFIRM primitive and enter the idle state without issuing any commands to the peer entity.

q_10699.question: What must the NE do if a VLAN ID is not available?
q_10699.ground_truth: The NE uses the native VLAN where PnC traffic is sent and received untagged.

q_10700.question: What is the responsibility of the BSS in the RRLP MULTILATERATION REQUEST message handling?
q_10700.ground_truth: The BSS receives the RRLP message in the BSSGP Position Command message and relays it to the MS in an LLC UI frame while starting a supervision timer for the associated SCCP connection. It also releases the connection if the timer expires.

q_10701.question: What did the section 6.130.3 note about co-existence studies for single uplink?
q_10701.ground_truth: The UE coexistence is already considered in the fallback combinations in TS 38.101-1 for single uplink.

q_10702.question: What should the UE do if the "Reporting Cell Status" in the IE "Periodical reporting criteria on secondary UL frequency" is received?
q_10702.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "Cell Measured Results" in the IE "Measured results on secondary UL frequency" for cells that satisfy the condition specified in the IE "Reporting Cell Status" in the IE "Periodical reporting criteria on secondary UL frequency", in descending order by the measurement quantity. The maximum number of the IE "Cell Measured Results" in the IE "Measured results on secondary UL frequency" to be included in the IE "Measured Results on Secondary UL frequency" per reported frequency is the number specified in the IE "Reporting Cell Status" in the IE "Periodical reporting criteria on secondary UL frequency".

q_10703.question: What is used as the maximum supported transmission power for a certain E-TFC in the calculation of the blocking criterion?
q_10703.ground_truth: The maximum supported transmission power for a certain E-TFC is the minimum of the maximum UE transmission power and the calculated E-PUCH transmission power.

q_10704.question: What message does a BSS send to an SGSN to report that an exception condition occurred in the operation of the radio interface for an MS?

q_10705.question: What action must the UE take for a particular flow distribution rule to be valid, based on the RoutingCriteria node?
q_10705.ground_truth: If at least one instance of ANDSF/ISRP/<X>/ ForNonSeamlessOffload/<X>/RoutingCriteria/<X> node indicates matching validity condition, the UE shall consider the corresponding flow distribution rule as valid. If the ANDSF/ISRP/<X>/ ForNonSeamlessOffload/<X>/RoutingCriteria/<X> node is present and empty, the UE does not consider it when evaluating the validity of the corresponding flow distribution rule. If all the present interior nodes within a single instance of ANDSF/ISRP/<X>/ ForNonSeamlessOffload /<X>/RoutingCriteria/<X> node indicate matching validity condition, the UE will consider the flow distribution rule as valid.
