q_10948.question: What is the state of the new MCPTT group information entry upon adding it to the candidate list in the case where the MCPTT group ID does not have an MCPTT group information entry in the served list of the MCPTT group information entries?
q_10948.ground_truth: The affiliation status of the new MCPTT group information entry is set to the "affiliating" state.

q_10949.question: What should an IWU do if it receives an initial SDP offer from a preceding 3GPP SIP-I node without the RTP Telephony Event and only the default PCM codec is offered?
q_10949.ground_truth: The IWU can either send the SDP offer to the external SIP-I node without the RTP Telephony Event (no compressed codecs included in the offer) or send the SDP offer to the external SIP-I node without any additional non-PCM speech codecs and include the RTP Telephony Event.

q_10950.question: What happens when the HLR or SGSN detects that the MS has recovered operation and has memory capacity available to receive short messages?
q_10950.ground_truth: The HLR will invoke operations to alert the SCs within the MWD, and once the Alert SC operations have been invoked, the MNRF or MNRG is cleared in the respective VLR or SGSN and the GLR.

q_10951.question: What is the function of the SLm Setup procedure in the SLm interface?
q_10951.ground_truth: The SLm Setup procedure is used to exchange application level data, such as capability information, between the E-SMLC and LMU in order to establish the SLmAP contexts and ensure interoperability on the SLm interface. This procedure is originated by the LMU and is used to initiate the setup of the SLmAP contexts.

q_10952.question: What message is sent by the GTP-MAP protocol-converting GSN as a response to the Failure Report Request message to the GGSN that sent the request?

q_10953.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of initial E-RABs attempted to setup, split into subcounters per E-RAB QoS level (QCI)?

q_10954.question: Which codecs were identified in the 3GPP Technical Report on video codec characterization for 5G services?
q_10954.ground_truth: The codecs identified in the 3GPP Technical Report on video codec characterization for 5G services are H.266/VVC, MPEG-5 EVC, and AOMedia AV1.

q_10955.question: What does an active PCC rule mean in regard to service data flow detection and service data flow filters?
q_10955.ground_truth: An active PCC rule means that the service data flow template shall be used for service data flow detection, mapping of downlink packets to the IP-CAN bearer, and service data flow detection of uplink packets on the IP-CAN bearer determined by the bearer binding. Additionally, usage data for the service data flow shall be recorded. For service data flow detection with an application detection filter, the start or stop of the application traffic is reported to the PCRF. The notification for Start may include service data flow filters and application instance identifier associated with the service data flow filters.

q_10956.question: What are the round trip delay conditions in the conversation situation of Subjective evaluation of quality of communications in car hands-free radiotelephone context?
q_10956.ground_truth: The round trip delay conditions are 0 ms and 180 ms.

q_10957.question: What should the UE do regarding exclude-listed cells during the cell reselection process?
q_10957.ground_truth: The UE shall not consider any exclude-listed cells as candidate for cell reselection.

q_10958.question: What are the performance objectives for the GERAN enhancements?
q_10958.ground_truth: The GERAN enhancements are expected to provide 50% better spectrum efficiency/capacity, 100% better peak data rates, improved coverage, increased service availability, and reduced latency.

q_10959.question: What is the function of the adaptive pre-filter in the algebraic codebook for WB IC mode in subclause 5.2.3.4.1.1?
q_10959.ground_truth: The adaptive pre-filter in the algebraic codebook for WB IC mode in subclause 5.2.3.4.1.1 is designed to amend the pre-filter with a phase scrambling filter. It is used for ensuring the excitation component is missing in the equation for UC mode.

q_10960.question: In which format are the tariff parameters expressed?
q_10960.ground_truth: The tariff parameters are expressed in either a non-monetary or monetary format.

q_10961.question: What does the Acknowledgement Request (A) bit indicate in the I and S frames?
q_10961.ground_truth: The Acknowledgement Request (A) bit in the I and S frames is used to solicit an acknowledgement from the receiver and indicates that the receiver is not requested to send an acknowledgement.

q_10962.question: What is the purpose of the UE Measurement Hysteresis Time in 3G UMTS?
q_10962.ground_truth: The UE Measurement Hysteresis Time provides the duration during which a reporting criterion has to be fulfilled for the UE Measurement Reporting procedure to be triggered.

q_10963.question: What is the purpose of subchannel specific power control on DL in enhancing network capacity gains for MUROS-2?
q_10963.ground_truth: Subchannel specific power control on DL increases further network capacity gains due to OSC in the order of 7% to 16% for MUROS-2, showing a promising approach to improving system performance.

q_10964.question: Why are two orthogonal linear polarizations used when measuring the spherical sensitivity pattern of the Device Under Test (DUT)?
q_10964.ground_truth: Two orthogonal linear polarizations are used when measuring the spherical sensitivity pattern of the Device Under Test (DUT) to capture the sensitivity values at all possible polarization states of the antenna and to calculate the Total Radiated Sensitivity (TRS) and Mean Effective Sensitivity (MERS) by integration.

q_10965.question: What is the purpose of step 24 in the described process, and why is it skipped if the interconnection network is SIP-unaware?
q_10965.ground_truth: Step 24 is used to send a PROVISIONAL RESPONSE towards the originating UE-A to terminate the early dialog. It is skipped if the interconnection network is SIP-unaware because the additional step is not necessary for the process to work correctly.

q_10966.question: What are the parameters required for quantizing P0 and GS in the first step of the speech decoding process?
q_10966.ground_truth: The parameters required are Rcc(k,j), k=0, 1, j=k, 1, Rx(k), k=0, 1, RS, Rpc(k), k=0, 1 and a, b, c, d, e.

q_10967.question: What action should an ICS UE take upon receiving an I1 Success message from the SCC AS after sending an I1 Invite message for I1 augmentation?
q_10967.ground_truth: The ICS UE should treat the ongoing I1 session as established and the existing call being controlled by the respective I1 session.

q_10968.question: What may a DASH client use to select Adaptation Sets without accessing Representations?
q_10968.ground_truth: A DASH client can use information about preferred capturing parameters, such as camera quality or bandwidth, that is associated to the device types or the camera parameters. This information can be obtained from the user or found in the MPD at the Adaptation Set Level.

q_10969.question: What is the effect of re-deriving the reselection priority for a frequency based on the NSAG(s) supported by a cell in 3GPP TS 38.331?
q_10969.ground_truth: The re-derived reselection priority is used for a maximum of 300 seconds, or until new network slice(s) and/or NSAG information are received from NAS.

q_10970.question: What message does the SRNS send to the new 3G-SGSN upon successful receipt of the SRNS Context Request (IMSI) message from the old 3G-SGSN?
q_10970.ground_truth: SRNS Context Response (GTP-SNDs, GTP-SNUs, PDCP-SNDs, PDCP-SNUs) message.

q_10971.question: What should the UE do after sending a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message for de-registration due to switch off?
q_10971.ground_truth: The UE shall try for a period of 5 seconds to send the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message, during which the UE may be switched off as soon as the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message has been sent.

q_10972.question: What is the significance of the first digit in the versioning of 3GPP Technical Specifications?
q_10972.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of the document: (1) presented to TSG for information, (2) presented to TSG for approval, or (3) TSG approved document under change control.

q_10973.question: What is the outcome of the "Transfer of an incoming voice communication" use case?
q_10973.ground_truth: The incoming voice communication is transferred to a new FRMCS User.

q_10974.question: What should the IMS-ALG do if it receives an initial SDP offer with ICE candidate information but no "a=ice-lite" attribute?
q_10974.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should not forward the received candidate information in the SDP it sends towards the answerer and request the IMS-AGW for a host candidate for each media line with UDP as default transport where it decides to use ICE.

q_10975.question: What is the purpose of the XML Schema defined in the MCID service as per the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_10975.ground_truth: The XML Schema is defined to provide the MCID Request/Response and to invoke the temporary mode of the MCID Service. The application/vnd.etsi.mcid+xml MIME type used to provide the request of a missing originating ID and the delivery of the requested originating ID AS of the served user shall be coded as per this XML Schema.

q_10976.question: What is the role of the flow control function in the MAC-ehs?
q_10976.ground_truth: The flow control for MAC-ehs is identical to the flow control for MAC-hs. It provides independent flow control by MAC-d flow for a given MAC-hs entity, and reduces discarded and retransmitted data as a result of HS-DSCH congestion.

q_10977.question: What is the conclusion for multi-camera scenarios in terms of controlling media rates?
q_10977.ground_truth: For multi-camera scenarios, there is a need to dynamically control media rates such that not all cameras use the maximum rate all the time, in particular when this may exceed total cell capacity. Additionally, there is a need to reduce media rates of some cameras quickly to avoid data loss on important camera feeds in case of increased cell load or worsening radio conditions.

q_10978.question: What is the purpose of the architectural requirements document in the 23 series of specifications?
q_10978.ground_truth: The architectural requirements document in the 23 series of specifications outlines the high-level requirements for the Circuit Switched (CS) domain in 3GPP systems based on UTRAN, E-UTRAN, and Iu mode GERAN. It also details the stage 2 procedures that span more than one domain or subsystem.

q_10979.question: What does the ProSe Application Server do when it receives a PXR command for announce authorization for open ProSe direct discovery with application-controlled extension and the Application-Data AVP is valid?
q_10979.ground_truth: The ProSe Application Server assigns the ProSe Application Code Suffix(es) for the requesting ProSe Application ID based on the Application-Data AVP and sends a ProXimity-Action-Answer (PXA) command including one or more ProSe-Application-Code-Suffix-Range AVP(s) indicating the assigned ProSe Application Code Suffix(es).

q_10980.question: What is the purpose of the HNB-GW in the UTRAN architecture for 3G Home Node B?
q_10980.ground_truth: The HNB-GW appears to the CN as an RNC and serves as a concentrator of HNB connections. It is uniquely identified towards the CN on a particular Iu interface by the RNC ID.

q_10981.question: What are the benefits of using widely accepted open standards and new IT-technologies in a 3GPP system?
q_10981.ground_truth: The benefits of using widely accepted open standards and new IT-technologies in a 3GPP system include the ability to incorporate new successful technologies from the IT-world, realize TMN goals using commonly available technologies for a reasonable cost, and easily adopt new important technologies as they are introduced.

q_10982.question: What message is sent by the RNC to the CN to indicate that a Service Area broadcasting related restart situation has occurred in one or more Service Areas?

q_10983.question: What is used to apply charging differentiation for service data flows in a multi-access PDN connection?
q_10983.ground_truth: A different access type and rating group can be specified for each service data flow, identified by its PCC Rule.

q_10984.question: What does "ID" stand for in the abbreviation ICIDefinition"IDentifier"?
q_10984.ground_truth: An "identifier" refers to a unique name given to an element or object for identification purposes.

q_10985.question: What is the impact of handover on the control procedure and the operation of CFNRc?
q_10985.ground_truth: Handover will have no impact on the control procedure and the operation of the service.

q_10986.question: When should the mobile station start monitoring downlink RLC/MAC blocks identified by the assigned TFI and switch to the assigned PDCH?
q_10986.ground_truth: The mobile station should start monitoring downlink RLC/MAC blocks identified by the assigned TFI and switch to the assigned PDCH upon receipt of an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT or IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message or a matching pair of IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT messages.

q_10987.question: What happens when a FRMCS User or FRMCS-equipment interrogates the FRMCS System to recognize other functional identities within a certain context?
q_10987.ground_truth: When a FRMCS User or FRMCS-equipment interrogates the FRMCS System to recognize the functional identities of other FRMCS Users or FRMCS-equipment within a certain context, the FRMCS System returns a set of functional identities within the certain context. The requesting FRMCS User or FRMCS-equipment is informed about the own or other FRMCS Users / FRMCS-equipment with a functional identity within a certain context, such as train, region, communication group, Railway Emergency Communication, or all Drivers on a station.

q_10988.question: What is the responsibility of the GERAN Position Calculation Function (PCF)?
q_10988.ground_truth: The GERAN Position Calculation Function (PCF) is responsible for calculating the location of the MS by applying an algorithmic computation on the collected signal measurements to compute the final location estimate and accuracy.

q_10989.question: What should the mobile station do upon receiving a PS HANDOVER COMMAND message for PS handover from A/Gb mode to A/Gb mode regarding uplink transmission of user plane data?
q_10989.ground_truth: The mobile station shall suspend the uplink transmission of user plane data until the successful completion of the PS handover procedure.

q_10990.question: What should be the method for measuring the frequency error in the context of OTA frequency error for the Indoor Anechoic Chamber test procedure?
q_10990.ground_truth: The frequency error should be measured in the OTA conformance reference direction, not the beam peak direction of the OTA peak directions set reference direction.

q_10991.question: How can the IBCF derive the sustainable data rate from bandwidth parameters in an SDP media description?
q_10991.ground_truth: The IBCF can use the "b=AS" bandwidth modifier within an SDP body or the "maximum supported bandwidth for the receiving direction" property value from the "a=bw-info" SDP attribute if the IBCF supports the enhanced bandwidth negotiation mechanism.

q_10992.question: What is required for an IWU to advertise support of the UPDATE method towards an external SIP-I network?
q_10992.ground_truth: The IWU must include the UPDATE method in the ALLOW header of a SIP INVITE request towards the external SIP-I network.

q_10993.question: What is the definition and applicability of inner loop power control in the downlink?
q_10993.ground_truth: Inner loop power control in the downlink is the ability of the BS transmitter to adjust the code domain power of a code channel in accordance with the corresponding TPC symbols received in the uplink. The power control step is the required step change in the DL transmitter output power of a code channel in response to the corresponding power control command.

q_10994.question: What is the maximum number of retransmissions per RLC block in the Non-Persistent mode?
q_10994.ground_truth: The maximum number of retransmissions per RLC block in the Non-Persistent mode is 1 or 2.

q_10995.question: Where is the protocol termination for the BCH transport channel type in UMTS located?
q_10995.ground_truth: The protocol termination for the BCH transport channel type is distributed between the Node B and the CRNC, resulting in less signalling on Iub and lower processor load.

q_10996.question: Which SA WG is responsible for the charging architecture control?
q_10996.ground_truth: SA WG5 is responsible for the charging architecture control.

q_10997.question: What is the cause of the error returned by the function call in Test Case 17?
q_10997.ground_truth: The error is caused by the invalidation of the EF, which prevents further read or update operations on the EF due to its invalidated status.

q_10998.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request due to inter-UE transfer?
q_10998.ground_truth: The SCC AS should associate the received SIP INVITE request with an ongoing SIP dialog, identify the Source Access Leg by the dialog identifier present in the Replaces or the Target-Dialog header field of the SIP INVITE request, and send a SIP re-INVITE request towards the remote UE using the existing established dialog, including the media characteristics as received in the SIP INVITE request. Upon receiving the SIP ACK request originated from the SC UE, the SCC AS should initiate release of the Source Access Leg by sending a SIP BYE towards the SC UE.

q_10999.question: Which video codecs are relevant for today's TV services?
q_10999.ground_truth: The relevant video codecs for today's TV services are H.264/AVC High Profile, H.265/HEVC Main Tier Main Profile, and H.265/HEVC Main Tier Main-10 Profile.

q_11000.question: What is a requirement for the Tuak algorithm in terms of its difference from the MILENAGE algorithm?
q_11000.ground_truth: The Tuak algorithm should be fundamentally different from the MILENAGE algorithm, so that any advance in cryptanalysis that impacts one algorithm should be unlikely to impact the other.

q_11001.question: What is the definition of ICE lite and Full ICE in the document?
q_11001.ground_truth: ICE lite is the lite implementation of the Interactive Connectivity Establishment (ICE) specified in IETF RFC 8445, while Full ICE is the full implementation of the same.

q_11002.question: What is one of the factors that impact the system capacity gains when MUROS co-exists with older legacy handsets?
q_11002.ground_truth: The determining factor for system capacity gains remains the channel blocking, and MUROS gains are significant even at lower levels of penetration.

q_11003.question: What is the format of the UECapabilityInformation message for NB-IoT, as defined in TS 36.331, clause 5.6.3.3?
q_11003.ground_truth: The UECapabilityInformation message for NB-IoT should include UE Radio Access Capability Parameters within the ue-Capability-Container, ue-RadioPagingInfo, and the contents of UECapabilityInformation message as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.6.3.3.

q_11004.question: What is the 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) 17 focused on in terms of UMTS?
q_11004.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) 17 focuses on the services provided by the Access Stratum (AS) to the rest of the system in the context of UMTS. It specifies the main functions visible at the boundary between the AS and the rest of the system, describing in general terms the information flows, both control and user data, over this boundary.

q_11005.question: In Proximity alerted charging conditions, what is the meaning of the "Time expired with no renewal" change condition?
q_11005.ground_truth: This change condition indicates that the time allowed for proximity alerting has expired and there has been no renewal, leading to the closure of the associated service data container or ProSe group communication container.

q_11006.question: What is the purpose of the cell selection procedure in the 5G network during Idle state?
q_11006.ground_truth: The cell selection procedure in the 5G network during Idle state is used to determine which S-NSSAIs the UE wants to register with and to consider the list of PFBs for the S-NSSAIs included in the Requested NSSAI. This helps in prioritizing the S-NSSAIs and the PFBs to be used for cell selection.

q_11007.question: What does the "MAC-es Guaranteed Bit Rate" information element indicate?
q_11007.ground_truth: The "MAC-es Guaranteed Bit Rate" information element indicates the guaranteed number of bits per second to be delivered over the air interface for a specific Non-GBR bearer, as requested by the CN and provided to the RNC in the downlink and uplink directions.

q_11008.question: What type of error handling is described for the operation related errors in clause 10 and the TC services used for reporting operation errors are described in clause 14?
q_11008.ground_truth: Generic error handling for the operation related errors is described in clause 10 and the TC services used for reporting operation errors are described in clause 14.

q_11009.question: What is an example of an operation in the "CAP-SMS-ops-args" module?
q_11009.ground_truth: "opcode-connectSMS" is an example of an operation in the "CAP-SMS-ops-args" module.

q_11010.question: How many voice broadcast channels are established in a cell for a given voice broadcast call?
q_11010.ground_truth: Only one voice broadcast channel is established in each cell for any given voice broadcast call, although there may be a number of simultaneous voice broadcast calls within the same cell.

q_11011.question: What is the name of the user equipment (UE) protocol introduced in Rel-17 for enhancing satellite E-UTRAN radio access technology?

q_11012.question: What is one of the recommended requirements for distributing the same signal for both stationary TVs and mobiles?
q_11012.ground_truth: The ability to distribute encapsulation, media formats, and codecs supported by both types of end devices.

q_11013.question: What timer is started on the network side after the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT or IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message?

q_11014.question: What is the procedure for the "SET UP CALL" command when the ME is not busy with another call?
q_11014.ground_truth: When the ME is not busy with another call, the procedure for the "SET UP CALL" command involves executing a set of commands defined in the expected sequence (e.g., 4.9, 4.10) of the 3GPP standard.

q_11015.question: What is the procedure used between the Presentity Presence Proxy and the HSS, referred to as the Px interface?
q_11015.ground_truth: The procedures between the Presentity Presence Proxy and the HSS, referred to as the Px interface, are handled using the mechanisms defined for the Cx interface.

q_11016.question: What is the purpose of the 'dummy' field?
q_11016.ground_truth: The 'dummy' field shall be marked absent in SysInfoType5 and SysInfoType5bis. A failure to comply with this requirement may prevent the UE to receive any service in the cell. The UE may treat the cell as barred.

q_11017.question: What is the 3GPP Technical Specification Group that defines the 3GPP file format used by the PSS and MMS services?

q_11018.question: What should the network do if the erasure request for CFNRc is not successful?
q_11018.ground_truth: The network shall return an error indication to the MS, indicating that the erasure of CFNRc was unsuccessful.

q_11019.question: What were the specific spurious requirements defined for co-existence with GSM 900, DCS1800, and PHS?
q_11019.ground_truth: The values were derived from the requirements of the system under consideration.

q_11020.question: Do BCSs need to be differentiated for UL and DL in traditional BCSs?
q_11020.ground_truth: No, there is no need to differentiate BCS4/BCS5 for UL and DL in traditional BCSs.

q_11021.question: What does the Code specific field in the Session-identifier information element indicate?
q_11021.ground_truth: The Code specific field in the Session-identifier information element indicates the type of information that is used to identify the session across.

q_11022.question: What is the maximum length of the Routing-Rule-Identifier AVP in the 5.3.71 section?
q_11022.ground_truth: The maximum length of the Routing-Rule-Identifier AVP is 255 octets in the 5.3.71 section.

q_11023.question: How should the MAC entity select a set of Random Access resources when there are no sets associated with any feature indication?
q_11023.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the set of Random Access resources to not be associated with any feature indication.

q_11024.question: What determines the Multislot Capability of a mobile station?
q_11024.ground_truth: A value called Multislot Class implicitly determines the Multislot Capability of a mobile station.

q_11025.question: What is the role of RAN in supporting Network Slicing?
q_11025.ground_truth: RAN plays a crucial role in supporting Network Slicing by providing information to route NAS messages to the appropriate NGC CP function, supporting the selection of the RAN part of the network slice, and handling resource isolation between slices through RRM policies and protection mechanisms.

q_11026.question: In the SMLC and LCS system, what are the three signalling endpoints for the LCS signalling model?
q_11026.ground_truth: The three signalling endpoints for the LCS signalling model are the SMLC, the LMU, and the LCS-assisted MS.

q_11027.question: What does MBMS-service-associated signalling mean?
q_11027.ground_truth: It is a method in 3GPP network where M2AP messages associated to one MBMS service uses the MBMS-service-associated logical M2-connection for association of the message to the respective MBMS service in eNB and EPC.

q_11028.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of successful mid-call codec negotiation cases, including the successful codec modifications executed as part of the negotiation procedures?

q_11029.question: What information must be included in the first RAB ASSIGNMENT RESPONSE message?
q_11029.ground_truth: The first RAB ASSIGNMENT RESPONSE message must include the result for all the requested RABs, such as the list of RABs successfully established or modified, released, failed to establish or modify, or queued.

q_11030.question: What is a potential security requirement for adhering to user consent in a 3GPP system?
q_11030.ground_truth: The 3GPP system should adhere to a publicly specified, machine readable format for specifying processing purposes in order to enforce user consent.

q_11031.question: How does 3GPP TS 28.651 define a Network Resource Model (NRM) IRP?
q_11031.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 28.651 does not define a Network Resource Model (NRM) IRP, instead, it defines the requirements for a NRM IRP for the UTRAN network, in a series of documents including 3GPP TS 28.651, 3GPP TS 28.652, and 3GPP TS 28.653.

q_11032.question: What events are associated with one access of a multi-access PDN connection in IP-CAN bearer charging?
q_11032.ground_truth: IP-CAN bearer modification, except QoS change events, are associated with one access of a multi-access PDN connection in IP-CAN bearer charging.

q_11033.question: After step c) in the acceptance criteria, what should be contained in the EFPLMN (Forbidden PLMNs) in the USIM?
q_11033.ground_truth: The EFPLMN should contain the forbidden PLMN in the following format: PLMN1: 234 002 (MCC MNC).

q_11034.question: What is the implication of not supporting SMS transport over a generic IP-CAN?
q_11034.ground_truth: Users will receive the SMS service using another messaging service, if operator policy allows it.

q_11035.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects in the telecommunication management domain?
q_11035.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify technical requirements and information models for telecommunications management, in particular for the Notification Log Integration Reference Point (IRP) as defined in TS 32.331.

q_11036.question: What information should be included in the Vertical Accuracy Code, if available, in connection with Geographical Area?
q_11036.ground_truth: The Vertical Accuracy Code should be included, if available, in connection with Geographical Area to provide vertical position information.

q_11037.question: What standard specifies the GSM half rate speech codec for the digital cellular telecommunications system?

q_11038.question: What is the purpose of the Tunnel Endpoint Identifier Control Plane field in the Update PDP Context Request?
q_11038.ground_truth: It specifies a downlink Tunnel Endpoint Identifier for G-PDUs chose by the SGSN and the GGSN shall include this Tunnel Endpoint Identifier in the GTP header of all subsequent downlink G-PDUs that are related to the requested PDP context.

q_11039.question: What is the difference between ResetAcknowledge and Reset in the W1AP-PROTCOL-IES protocol?
q_11039.ground_truth: ResetAcknowledge is used to confirm the success of a reset request, while Reset is used to initiate the reset procedure.

q_11040.question: What is the objective of the 3GPP Technical Report on UICC power optimization for Machine-Type Communication?
q_11040.ground_truth: The objective is to describe the power consumption caused by UICC when it is idle and identify potential solutions to allow the reduction or removal of the UICC power supply when the UICC is not required for long periods of time.

q_11041.question: In the operation package scfActivationPackage, what is the operation signature invoking the initialDP?

q_11042.question: What is one of the elemental components of network controlled mobility for inter-gNB handover, as specified in TS 38.300 clause 9.2.3.1?
q_11042.ground_truth: One of the elemental components of network controlled mobility for inter-gNB handover, as specified in TS 38.300 clause 9.2.3.1, is that the source gNB initiates handover and issues a HANDOVER REQUEST over the Xn interface.

q_11043.question: What is the role of HLR in the CCBS service between GSM networks and ISDN networks?
q_11043.ground_truth: The HLR shall provide any necessary signalling interworking between the MAP protocol for call completion services on the MAP D-interface (between the VLR and the HLR) and ISDN CCBS-ASE protocol between the originating and destination networks.

q_11044.question: What protocol is used between the Application Server and the MRFC over the Mr' interface?
q_11044.ground_truth: The protocol used between the Application Server and the MRFC over the Mr' interface is based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP), as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_11045.question: What does the ho-NumberNotRequired parameter indicate when included by MSC-A in the Prepare-Handover request?
q_11045.ground_truth: The ho-NumberNotRequired parameter is included by MSC-A, when MSC-A decides not to use any circuit connection with MSC-B.

q_11046.question: How many subcarriers are punctured on the higher edge of narrowbands above the DC subcarrier if the value of ce-punctured-subcarriers-DL is '00'?

q_11047.question: What must the GANC ensure when requesting the uplink data rate for a PFC?
q_11047.ground_truth: The GANC must never request an uplink data rate that is lower than the guaranteed uplink bit rate for the PFC, unless the Traffic Class is Interactive class or Background class.

q_11048.question: What protocols are used over the Nc and Mc interfaces in the bearer-independent circuit-switched core network?
q_11048.ground_truth: The protocol used over the Nc interface is an enhanced call control protocol supporting call bearer separation such as BICC, and the protocol used over the Mc interface is H.248.

q_11049.question: What Command Code value is used for the ProSe-Authorization-Request (PAR) Command in this specification?
q_11049.ground_truth: The ProSe-Authorization-Request (PAR) Command is indicated by the Command-Code field set to 8388668.

q_11050.question: What is the function of the DISC command in the LAPDm protocol?
q_11050.ground_truth: The DISC command is used to terminate the ABM operation and cannot be transmitted with an information field.

q_11051.question: What is the central element of the IN-based solution for Mobile Number Portability (MNP)?

q_11052.question: What is the format of the homing frames used in the decoder?
q_11052.ground_truth: The homing frames used in the decoder are in 15-bit-long format, where the parameters are packed into 15-bit-long format in serial format.

q_11053.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a response message containing one or more IEs/IE groups marked as "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" which it does not comprehend?
q_11053.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the content of the not comprehended IEs/IE groups, continue with the procedure using the understood IEs/IE groups, and initiate the Error Indication procedure to report that one or more IEs/IE groups have been ignored.

q_11054.question: When is an E-CSCF used to forward the Re-INVITE in SRVCC for IMS emergency session when the IMS emergency session is active session?
q_11054.ground_truth: An E-CSCF is used to forward the Re-INVITE to the MGCF associated with the PSAP if the PSAP is located in the PSTN or CS Domain, or the Re-INVITE is sent directly to an IP-capable PSAP.

q_11055.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 11.2.4?
q_11055.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 11.2.4 is to verify that the UE correctly establishes and uses an EPS security context during network registration.

q_11056.question: What is exchanged between the S-CSCF supporting the hosted enterprise users and the entities supporting the remote side for charging issues?
q_11056.ground_truth: Inter Operator Identifiers (IOI) specific to the NGCN shall be exchanged between the S-CSCF supporting the hosted enterprise users and the entities supporting the remote side for charging issues.

q_11057.question: How is the adaptive selection performed in the excitation generation process?
q_11057.ground_truth: The adaptive selection is performed by sending 1 bit per sub-frame. The excitation is generated either through the adaptive codebook or its low pass-filtered version, and the path which results in minimum energy of the target signal is selected for the filtered adaptive codebook vector.

q_11058.question: Which value in the thirty-second to thirty-fourth bits of the Cell-Capability-Container bit string indicates support for three frequencies four cells?

q_11059.question: What metric was used to evaluate the playout robustness in the transmission simulation?
q_11059.ground_truth: Erroneous Seconds Ratio (ESR) was used to evaluate the playout robustness in the transmission simulation.

q_11060.question: What was the increase in capacity performance for FR1, Uma, DL, for VR/AR, with single stream traffic model, DDDUU/DDDSU TDD format, with MU-MIMO, 45Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, when using cooperative MIMO/precoding compared to zero-forcing precoding?

q_11061.question: What is the measurement provided in 4.3.1 a) in UMTS?
q_11061.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of attempts by RNC to establish an Iu control plane connection between the RNC and a CS CN in UMTS.

q_11062.question: When reassembling SN-PDUs, how are DCOMP, PCOMP and N-PDU number obtained?
q_11062.ground_truth: During reassembly, DCOMP and PCOMP for an N-PDU are retrieved from the first segment (F bit set to 1), and for acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation, the N-PDU number is also retrieved from the first segment.

q_11063.question: What does UL stand for in the context of UL-CCTrCH-InformationList-RL-AdditionRspTDD768?

q_11064.question: What is the expected call control result for Expected Sequence 4.3?
q_11064.ground_truth: The expected call control result for Expected Sequence 4.3 is "Allowed with modifications".

q_11065.question: What is the term used to describe the number of successfully handled GGSN-Initiated PDP context update procedures?

q_11066.question: What should the UE do when it detects physical layer recovery while T310 is running?
q_11066.ground_truth: The UE should resume the RRC connection without explicit signaling.

q_11067.question: What is the difference between the HUT and AAU models in terms of their uniformity and the XPR?
q_11067.ground_truth: The HUT model is uniform in the azimuth angle but non-uniform in the elevation angle with an XPR of 10.7 dB, while the AAU model is non-uniform in both azimuth and elevation angle with an XPR of 5.5 dB.

q_11068.question: What must the responding station do when it receives a power saving control command message?
q_11068.ground_truth: The responding station must acknowledge this command with a power saving control response message but need not obey the command to enter a low-power state.

q_11069.question: What is the maximum AIUR that the RA1'/RAA'' function supports?
q_11069.ground_truth: The RA1'/RAA'' function supports a maximum AIUR of 64 kbit/s.

q_11070.question: What was the reason for choosing a capacity of 512 bits for the Tuak function?
q_11070.ground_truth: A capacity of 512 bits was chosen for the Tuak function for close alignment with the forthcoming NIST standards.

q_11071.question: What IE is used to provide the required Quality of Service for the LCS (Location Services) Request, including horizontal accuracy, vertical accuracy, and allowed response time?

q_11072.question: What are the conditions under which a projection to the sub pyramid is made?
q_11072.ground_truth: If the pulse density ratio is larger than 0.5 unit pulses per coefficient and is larger than 1, a projection to the sub pyramid is made.

q_11073.question: What should the UE do with the MeasurementReportSidelink message after completing the periodical reporting for a sl-MeasId, as per the given requirements?
q_11073.ground_truth: Once the UE fulfills the periodical reporting requirements for a given sl-MeasId, it needs to submit the MeasurementReportSidelink message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends.

q_11074.question: What triggers the sending of a PCAP Position Parameter Modification message from the SRNC to the SAS in the context of periodic UE positioning measurement reporting?
q_11074.ground_truth: A change in serving cell status or a RRC state transition during the RRC measurement procedure, which does not result in a termination of the UE measurement reporting.

q_11075.question: What is the cell-ranking criterion Rs for serving cells and Rn for neighboring cells, as defined in TS 38.304, clause 5.2.4.6?
q_11075.ground_truth: The cell-ranking criterion Rs for serving cells is derived from the reference signal received power (RSRP) of the serving cell, and the cell-ranking criterion Rn for neighboring cells is derived from the RSRP of neighboring cells. The serving cell is selected if it has a higher ranking than the neighboring cells.

q_11076.question: What is the difference between the Path and Via header fields of a SIP message in 3GPP TS 24.229?
q_11076.ground_truth: The Path header field is used to indicate the path associated with the session or transaction and the Via header field is used to indicate the path followed by the SIP request from the originating UE to the receiving S-CSCF. The Via header field also includes the branch parameter which identifies each SIP request.

q_11077.question: What is the significance of KI#9 and Solution #30 regarding the Dispersion Analytics output provided by NWDAF?
q_11077.ground_truth: KI#9 focuses on Dispersion Analytics output provided by NWDAF, and Solution #30 provides the required input, output, and procedures to use Dispersion Analytics. Solution #30 provides procedures for user data congestion mitigation, enabling the PCF to update QoS parameters, and assisting the AMF and NSSF with slice load distribution procedures.

q_11078.question: What is the formula to calculate the number of filler bits for Xi < 40 and turbo coding?
q_11078.ground_truth: The formula to calculate the number of filler bits for Xi < 40 and turbo coding is Yi = 40 - Xi.

q_11079.question: What is the role of the RRC signalling in the WLAN positioning procedure?
q_11079.ground_truth: The RRC signalling is used to forward the WLAN positioning request from the SAS to the UE and to receive the WLAN measurements from the UE. The RRC signalling may also include a request for periodic reporting.

q_11080.question: What is the purpose of the input intermodulation test for a Repeater?
q_11080.ground_truth: The purpose of the input intermodulation test is to verify that the Repeater meets the intermodulation characteristics requirements as specified by the minimum requirements.

q_11081.question: Which XML schema file is referenced in the "xsi:schemaLocation" attribute in the provided XML documents, and what is its namespace?
q_11081.ground_truth: The XML schema file referenced in the "xsi:schemaLocation" attribute in the provided XML documents is "USD-schema-main.xsd" and its namespace is "urn:3GPP:metadata:2005:MBMS:userServiceDescription".

q_11082.question: What is the name of the reference point that supports access to MSGin5G Server and APIs to enable sending and receiving of MSGin5G messages?

q_11083.question: What action does the ICS UE take when it has sent an I1 Invite message but has not received a response in a reliable transport-layer connection?
q_11083.ground_truth: The ICS UE retransmits the original I1 Invite message with an exponentially increasing interval until it reaches T2 when using an unreliable transport-layer connection. If the reliable transport-layer connection is used, the ICS UE retransmits the I1 Invite message if the retransmission timer fires.

q_11084.question: Which solution is based on providing the AMFs with an optional maximum limit of PDU sessions and an optional time for Inbound disaster roamers at registration?
q_11084.ground_truth: Solution #54 prevents Disaster Inbound Roamers from establishing more than a certain minimum number of PDU sessions, which can reduce 5GSM signaling generated by Disaster Inbound Roamers.

q_11085.question: What must the SMSF do if it fails to deliver a short message to the UE within the time frame specified in the request body in step 6d alternative 1?
q_11085.ground_truth: The SMSF must reattempt to deliver the short message to the UE within the specified time frame.

q_11086.question: What happens when the HSS requests to update the user profile of an implicitly registered Public User Identity set?
q_11086.ground_truth: The user profile in the response contains the Public User Identities of the corresponding implicitly registered Public User Identity set with the associated service profiles.

q_11087.question: What is the definition of a "chargeable event" in the context of 3GPP TSs?
q_11087.ground_truth: A "chargeable event" is an activity that utilizes telecommunication network resources and related services for user-to-user, user-to-network, or inter-network communication, or for mobility, and that the network operator may want to charge for.

q_11088.question: What are the two approaches used to solve the problem of a beginning portion of the MDCT encoded frame not being properly reconstructed when a CELP encoded frame is preceded by a MDCT encoded frame?
q_11088.ground_truth: The two approaches are increasing the MDCT length, moving the left folding point towards the past and reducing the left overlap length (in the case of MDCT based TCX), or using constrained CELP coding and simplified time-domain BWE coding (in the case of HQ MDCT).

q_11089.question: Which 3GPP Technical Specifications is the present document related to?
q_11089.ground_truth: The present document is related to 3GPP TS 28.302 and 3GPP TS 28.303 versions of the 3GPP Technical Specifications.

q_11090.question: What is the purpose of the PCRF applying pre-emption in the context of 3GPP 29.214?
q_11090.ground_truth: The PCRF applies pre-emption to remove active PCC rules from the PCEF and retry the PCC rule provisioning or modification procedure. This allows the PCRF to handle failures or modify rules in a flexible manner.

q_11091.question: When can the DRNS use 64 QAM for the secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link in FDD?
q_11091.ground_truth: The DRNS may use 64 QAM for the secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link if the Sixtyfour QAM Usage Allowed Indicator IE is included in the HS-DSCH FDD Secondary Serving Information To Modify Unsynchronised IE and the value is set to "allowed".

q_11092.question: In the downlink, what kind of improvement in C/I is required for 4 users to be supported as compared to the legacy requirements using the 5.9 kbps codec?
q_11092.ground_truth: A 2 dB degradation in C/I is required for 4 users to be supported as compared to the legacy requirements using the 5.9 kbps codec.

q_11093.question: What is the expected TERMINAL RESPONSE when the CLOSE CHANNEL proactive command is sent with command qualifier set to 1?
q_11093.ground_truth: Upon receiving the CLOSE CHANNEL proactive command with command qualifier set to 1, the same PDN connection can be re-used for the next OPEN CHANNEL command by the ME.

q_11094.question: What message does the SS send after receiving the TBS-RequestLocationInformation IE from the UE in Release 13?
q_11094.ground_truth: The SS sends a LPP REQUEST LOCATION INFORMATION message, including the TBS-RequestLocationInformation IE.

q_11095.question: What is required for the client to support sending additional data to the server during a SRF session?
q_11095.ground_truth: The client should be able to support sending additional data to the server, such as keypad information and other terminal and audio events, and receiving data feedback to be displayed on the terminal screen.

q_11096.question: What is the purpose of the initialUE-Identity in the RRCConnectionSetup-IEs sequence?
q_11096.ground_truth: It is used to uniquely identify the UE established within the RRC connection.

q_11097.question: What is a user requirement for MBMS in terms of user selectivity for the broadcast mode?
q_11097.ground_truth: The user shall be able to discover what broadcast services are available at the user's current location and outside of the current location, and select between different broadcast services while receiving simultaneously more than one MBMS service.

q_11098.question: What information must the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the last visited registered TAI is available?
q_11098.ground_truth: The UE must include the last visited registered TAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_11099.question: What does the MGW include after relocation based on the speech coding information provided to each bearer termination in 8.1.6.5?
q_11099.ground_truth: The MGW may include a speech transcoder based upon the speech coding information provided to each bearer termination in 8.1.6.5.

q_11100.question: What is the first step in establishing a FLUS-NBMP session in the NBMP in the Application Server scenario?
q_11100.ground_truth: UE Application (UA) makes a request through F8 to Application (EA) to start a live session.

q_11101.question: How are ACKs/NACKs handled when a UE is in soft handover?
q_11101.ground_truth: When a UE is in soft handover, multiple ACK/NACKs may be received in an E-DCH TTI from different cells in the active set. ACK/NACKs from the same radio link set are soft combined into one ACK/NACK information and delivered to higher layers. If only one radio link is present, the detection is done as specified for the case where the UE is not in soft handover.

q_11102.question: What is the special value for the FDD field and what does it indicate?
q_11102.ground_truth: The special value for the FDD field is 255, which indicates that the Node B may ignore the RACH Measurement Results IE.

q_11103.question: What are the differences between Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 media production categories in terms of importance and usage characteristics?
q_11103.ground_truth: Tier 1 media production involves high-quality broadcasts, often live events, with the highest standards for video and audio quality. Tier 2 media production involves standard productions, such as news, documentaries, and sports broadcasting, with quality requirements being less stringent than Tier 1, but still important. Tier 3 media production involves lower-quality productions, such as webcasts and personal video recordings, with less stringent requirements for video and audio quality.

q_11104.question: How does the closed-loop mode-selection process work in determining the best mode combination?
q_11104.ground_truth: The closed-loop mode selection process works by encoding the signal in each 256-sample frame within an 1024-sample super-frame in several modes (ACELP, TCX256, TCX512, TCX1024) and making a mode selection based on the average segmental SNR between the weighted speech and the synthesized weighted speech. The signal in the super-frame is encoded in several modes before selecting the best combination using a segmental SNR measure.

q_11105.question: What is the impact of the Resource Distribution Function on the Load Sharing Function?
q_11105.ground_truth: The Resource Distribution Function overrides the Load Sharing Function for the selection of the remote IP endpoint, it overrides the data weight of a remote IP endpoint and can request data be sent to an IP endpoint that has a data weight=0.

q_11106.question: What is the role of MDAS producer in fault prediction analysis?
q_11106.ground_truth: The MDAS producer is responsible for monitoring and analyzing performance measurements and KPIs continuously, and providing predictive information of potential faults or abnormal states and corresponding recommendations to prevent faults from occurring.

q_11107.question: What should the UE do to the connection establishment failure or connection resume failure information after 48 hours?
q_11107.ground_truth: The UE should discard the connection establishment failure or connection resume failure information, i.e. release the UE variable VarConnEstFailReport, 48 hours after the last connection establishment failure is detected.

q_11108.question: What is the maximum size of the information elements stored by the SGSN?
q_11108.ground_truth: The maximum size of the information elements stored by the SGSN is 255 octets.

q_11109.question: What should the CTS-MS do with IEs that are unknown or repeated in a message?
q_11109.ground_truth: The CTS-MS should ignore IEs that are unknown or repeated in a message, and only process the first occurrence of the IE when repetition is not specified.

q_11110.question: In procedure "Activate Interworking Function", what command is sent by the MGC when preparing for the processing of command (1) in the procedure?
q_11110.ground_truth: A MOD.req command with relevant information is sent by the MGC.

q_11111.question: What is the performance change when the constellation diagram is switched between 1 square (QPSK burst) and 7 rectangular bursts for the signal corresponding to the SAIC mobile?
q_11111.ground_truth: The signal is attenuated by approximately 7.6592 dB when the rectangular burst is used.

q_11112.question: What is the "USIM" abbreviation used for in UMTS?

q_11113.question: Which procedure is triggered upon establishment of a new child SA for uplink and downlink IP flows?
q_11113.ground_truth: In procedure 1, the permanent user identity (IMSI in EPC root NAI format) is provided upon successful authentication in the reply from 3GPP AAA to Fixed Broadband Access AAA, for both STa and SWa.

q_11114.question: What is the purpose of the RRC message Radio Bearer Setup Complete, and when is it sent?
q_11114.ground_truth: The RRC message Radio Bearer Setup Complete is sent by the UE to the SRNC after receiving the Radio Bearer Setup message, indicating that the setup is complete.

q_11115.question: What is the maximum amount of logical channels that can be given in one RLC per credit in tenth generation UEs?

q_11116.question: What is the purpose of the Procedure of updating MOI(s) after a VNF is scaled?
q_11116.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to update corresponding MOI(s) after a VNF is scaled, triggered by NM or EM.

q_11117.question: What is the importance of early ultrasound examination in diagnosing aortic aneurysm?
q_11117.ground_truth: Early ultrasound examinations help reduce mortality in aortic aneurysm patients; early diagnosis significantly reduces mortality from 75% to 35%, making real-time ultrasound imaging in an ambulance crucial for faster and more accurate diagnoses.

q_11118.question: What information does the CN Domain Identity information element indicate in the GA-RRC message?
q_11118.ground_truth: The CN Domain Identity information element indicates the type of core network domain (CS or PS) to which the GA-RRC message applies.

q_11119.question: How is the initial DL power determined for each timeslot in a DCH type CCTrCH for 1.28 Mcps TDD?
q_11119.ground_truth: If the Initial DL Transmission Power IE is included in the DL Timeslot Information LCR IE, then the Node B uses that power for the initial DL power. Otherwise, the initial DL power is the Initial DL Transmission Power IE included in the RL Information IE.

q_11120.question: Who is responsible for media description in the AF-NEF/MBSF architecture?
q_11120.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for providing the media description in the AF-NEF/MBSF architecture.

q_11121.question: What is the purpose of the Edge Application Server registration and de-registration procedures in the 3GPP network?
q_11121.ground_truth: These procedures enable the Edge Application Server to provide profile/availability information such as the geographical area of availability and time of operation to the Edge Enabler Server. The Edge Application Server can de-register from the Edge Enabler Server when it is no longer available for service.

q_11122.question: What are the expected behaviors of IMS sessions during combinational calls?
q_11122.ground_truth: Users can place the IMS session on hold or put the CS call on hold based on their preference, receive alerts for incoming IMS sessions, and redirect incoming IMS sessions to a CS call.

q_11123.question: What does the RNC do if it is not able to stop the broadcast of the CBS message as requested in the KILL message?
q_11123.ground_truth: If the RNC fails to stop broadcasting the CBS message in at least one Service Area, it should return a KILL FAILURE message to the CN and indicate in the Failure List IE the Service Area(s) where the CBS message was not recognized or the broadcast could not be stopped together with the appropriate cause value.

q_11124.question: What is the gain in throughput for file sizes less than 6 MB?
q_11124.ground_truth: The gain in throughput for file sizes less than 6 MB is 73 %.

q_11125.question: Which function does the HSS use to generate user authentication, integrity and ciphering data for the CS and PS Domains and for the IM CN subsystem?
q_11125.ground_truth: The HSS generates user authentication, integrity and ciphering data for the CS and PS Domains and for the IM CN subsystem through its User security information generation functionality.

q_11126.question: When should the UE consider the leaving condition for event A2 to be satisfied and the measurement is for the E-UTRA PSCell with NE-DC?
q_11126.ground_truth: The UE should consider the leaving condition for event A2 to be satisfied when the serving E-UTRA cell becomes better than the absolute threshold plus hysteresis.

q_11127.question: What is the requirement for the ME's operation in expected sequence 4.10 (PLAY TONE with text attribute)?
q_11127.ground_truth: The ME shall support the PLAY TONE command as defined in TS31.111 and operate in the manner defined in expected sequence 4.10.

q_11128.question: What is the widely used mechanism for the application client to discover the application server in the solution described?
q_11128.ground_truth: The DNS (Domain Name System) is the widely used mechanism for the application client to discover the application server in the solution described.

q_11129.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving an I1 message with all bits in the Part-1 subfield set to values "1" from the ICS UE?
q_11129.ground_truth: The SCC AS should determine if this I1 message is for an existing end-to-end call and perform the requested supplementary service if it is.

q_11130.question: What is the purpose of interactive ads in Use Case #3: Dynamic Interactive Ads During Live Sports Event?
q_11130.ground_truth: The purpose of interactive ads in this use case is to provide users with more information on the products and services being advertised, and to offer the opportunity to enter a drawing or win a prize.

q_11131.question: What is the minimum requirement for narrowband blocking characteristics in the presence of an interfering E-UTRA signal?
q_11131.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for narrowband blocking characteristics is that the BER for any UTRA carrier should not exceed 0.001, and the throughput for any E-UTRA carrier should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

q_11132.question: What is the Umbrella Information Model (UIM) in the FNIM?
q_11132.ground_truth: The Umbrella Information Model (UIM) in the FNIM represents the agreed model structures that various SDOs or standard organizations including expert groups will use for their definitions of their respective Domain/Technology-specific concrete classes.

q_11133.question: What is the transport format for the default bearer in the TCP server mode?
q_11133.ground_truth: The transport format for the default bearer in the TCP server mode is TCP.

q_11134.question: What does the Partial Suspension of Itf-N IRP aim to define?
q_11134.ground_truth: An interface through which an IRPManager can suspend the forwarding of notifications via Itf-N which were generated in parts of the managed systems

q_11135.question: What is the role of MDA (Management Data Analytics) in the management loop?
q_11135.ground_truth: The MDA forms a part of the management loop, where it brings intelligence and generates value by processing and analysis of management and network data, providing analytics reports for root cause analysis of ongoing issues, prevention of potential issues, and prediction of network or service demands.

q_11136.question: What is the impact of the "Maximum number of DPDCH bits per 10 ms" reported capability on the UE's operation?
q_11136.ground_truth: The Maximum number of DPDCH bits per 10 ms reported capability defines the maximum number of DPDCH bits the UE is capable of transmitting per 10 ms. If the reported capability is lower than 9600, the number of DPDCH channel bits indicates the capability of the UE when operating in non-compressed mode. If the reported capability is equal to or greater than 9600, it indicates the maximum capability of the UE considering both compressed and non-compressed mode operation.

q_11137.question: What should the "Polling bit" in the AMD PDU header be set to if a poll has not been triggered?
q_11137.ground_truth: The "Polling bit" in the AMD PDU header should be set to "0" if a poll has not been triggered.

q_11138.question: What is the role of the Acquisition Indicator (AI) in AICH?
q_11138.ground_truth: The Acquisition Indicator (AI) in AICH represents a positive/negative acknowledgement, indicating the outcome of the PRACH or an E-DCH transmission.

q_11139.question: What is the outcome when a network detects a valid unmute request from a dispatcher?
q_11139.ground_truth: The network may choose to indicate the recognition of this request by playing a "grant tone" to the requesting dispatcher only, which is sent in-band with the call.

q_11140.question: What is the destination device and the general result of the SEND DTMF terminal response in expected sequence 1.1 and 1.2?
q_11140.ground_truth: In expected sequence 1.1, the destination device of the SEND DTMF terminal response is the SIM and the general result is "Command performed successfully". In expected sequence 1.2, the destination device of the SEND DTMF terminal response is also the SIM and the general result is "Command performed successfully".

q_11141.question: What is the maximum duration of the T3128 timer in the uplink investigation procedure when talker priority is not supported by the network?

q_11142.question: When should the UE remove a rejected S-NSSAI from the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached?
q_11142.ground_truth: The UE should remove the S-NSSAI from the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached when the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI expires.

q_11143.question: What is the csg-Indication and csg-Identity for Cell A and Cell B?
q_11143.ground_truth: Cell A: csg-Indication: FALSE, csg-Identity: not present. Cell B: csg-Indication: TRUE, csg-Identity: 04.

q_11144.question: What does the SS request the UE to set with the SET MUSIM UAI REQUEST message?
q_11144.ground_truth: The SS requests the UE to set its preferred RRC state and gap preference for MUSIM with the SET MUSIM UAI REQUEST message.

q_11145.question: What is the maximum number of active PDP contexts per group and APN that determines the application of APN level congestion control by the SGSN?
q_11145.ground_truth: The maximum number of active PDP contexts per group and APN determines the application of APN level congestion control by the SGSN.

q_11146.question: How are control symbols represented in the Huffman tree?
q_11146.ground_truth: Control symbols (e.g., New 7bit character, New 8bit character, New UCS2 Row, and Keyword symbols) need to be represented in the Huffman tree before processing the first character of an input stream. The initialization process determines which control symbols can occur in an input stream as per information in the CH and adds them to the tree accordingly.

q_11147.question: What is the purpose of the load indication procedure in this network?
q_11147.ground_truth: The load indication procedure is used to inform neighboring BSSs about the traffic situation of a cell, allowing them to consider the load information when deciding a handover.

q_11148.question: How does 5G utilize real-time communication and interaction services compared to 4G?
q_11148.ground_truth: 5G's resulting bandwidth and low latency can extend real-time communication with real-time interaction services, such as touch and move over the network, creating new types of use cases and facilitating a global shift from real-time communication to real-time interaction.

q_11149.question: What does the TP-SCTS (TP-Service-Centre-Time-Stamp) in a semi-octet representation indicate in the GSM SMS (Short Message Service)?
q_11149.ground_truth: The TP-SCTS represents the local time in which the first semi-octet's first bit (bit 3) of the seventh octet is the algebraic sign of the difference between the local time and GMT (Greenwich Mean Time), with 0 representing positive and 1 representing negative. It is expressed in quarters of an hour.

q_11150.question: What is the potential advantage of a single full-band filter for option B1, compared to other filtering options?
q_11150.ground_truth: The potential advantage of a single full-band filter for option B1 compared to other filtering options is reduced size and bill-of-materials of the required front-end, reduced complexity for intra-band carrier aggregation across the filters and inter-band carrier aggregation with another band in close frequency proximity when quadplexing is needed, and fewer out-of-band emissions.

q_11151.question: What is the purpose of the test in 10.2.1?
q_11151.ground_truth: The test purpose in 10.2.1 is to verify that the RSTD measurement reporting delay meets the requirements in an environment with fading propagation conditions.

q_11152.question: Which output power is applicable to the MS for point-to-multipoint services without ARQ?
q_11152.ground_truth: Power control is not applicable for point-to-multipoint services if transmission is without ARQ.

q_11153.question: What is the minimum number of pixels that should be used to detect an object with a width of 1.5 meters at a distance of 100 meters using a single pixel?
q_11153.ground_truth: An object of width 1.5 meter would be captured into 10 pixels at a distance of 100 meters.

q_11154.question: What message does the GGSN/PDN-GW send to inform UEs about P-CSCF failure in step 9 of the network recovery information flow?
q_11154.ground_truth: The GGSN/PDN-GW sends a message to inform UEs about P-CSCF failure by indicating that the P-CSCF is not available.

q_11155.question: What is one of the general requirements for the V2X message distribution?
q_11155.ground_truth: The VAE layer shall enable the delivery of V2X messages based on pre-established sessions.

q_11156.question: What does the "Detect DTMF" procedure do and when is it used?
q_11156.ground_truth: The "Detect DTMF" procedure is used to request detection of a DTMF tone. It may be combined with procedures such as "Prepare Bearer" or "Establish Bearer".

q_11157.question: What is the difference between "may" and "need not" in the context of the present document?
q_11157.ground_truth: "May" indicates permission to do something, while "need not" indicates permission not to do something.

q_11158.question: In how many substates can the MS be when in the GA-RRC-CONNECTED state?
q_11158.ground_truth: The MS can be in one of two substates (PTC-STANDBY or PTC-ACTIVE) when in the GA-RRC-CONNECTED state.

q_11159.question: What is the LPP time IE value used for in the response time calculation?
q_11159.ground_truth: The LPP time IE value is used as the maximum allowed RSTD reporting delay for the UE, which is 67.16 seconds.

q_11160.question: What was the network load in all the cases that were studied?
q_11160.ground_truth: The network load was about 75% in all the cases.

q_11161.question: What is the role of the FRMCS in the transfer of multimedia archives from the ground to the train?
q_11161.ground_truth: The FRMCS facilitates the transfer of multimedia archives from the ground to the train, ensuring that it is done in a time and resource-efficient manner when the train stops at stations, train stops, or at the depot.

q_11162.question: In what scenario is the I-MGCF required to include a P-Early-Media header field in the SIP 180 Ringing response, indicating that backward early media is not authorized?
q_11162.ground_truth: The I-MGCF is required to include the P-Early-Media header field in the SIP 180 Ringing response, indicating that backward early media is not authorized, when it has received the P-Early-Media header field in the initial INVITE request and has not already sent a reliable provisional response with a P-Early-Media header field, and the most recently sent P-Early-Media header field did not authorize backward early media.

q_11163.question: What event triggers the increment of the counter "Attempted number of PDN-GW initiated Dedicated Bearer Deletion" in the context of EPS packet switching?
q_11163.ground_truth: The counter is incremented when the PDN-GW sends a "Delete Bearer REQUEST" message containing multiple bearer IDs.

q_11164.question: What is the meaning of SEQUENCE versus a CHOICE in ASN.1?
q_11164.ground_truth: SEQUENCE is a data type that consists of a linear, ordered list of sub-IEs, whereas CHOICE is a data type in which a CHOICE is a set of defined sub-choices.

q_11165.question: What information is used by the UE to join the multicast group?
q_11165.ground_truth: The UE joins the multicast group by initiating a PDU session establishment/modification procedure including the multicast IP address information.

q_11166.question: What is the expected procedure for SEND SHORT MESSAGE in case the ME is not connected to the USS in 27.22.4.10.1.9?
q_11166.ground_truth: In case the ME is not connected to the USS in 27.22.4.10.1.9, it is required that that prior to this test, the ME shall have been powered on and performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure.

q_11167.question: What should the MAC entity do when the timeAlignmentTimer expires for the associated TAG?
q_11167.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the Serving Cells belonging to the associated TAG as not uplink time aligned.

q_11168.question: What action can a UE take if it autonomously re-registers with the network?
q_11168.ground_truth: The UE can request S-NSSAIs that are more adequate for running the applications the user is more interested in.

q_11169.question: What is the function of the SeGW (Security Gateway) in the Home NodeB (HNB) to HNB Management System (HMS) interface?
q_11169.ground_truth: The SeGW in the HNB to HMS interface terminates Secure tunnelling for TR-069 and Iuh, authenticates the HNB, and provides access to the HMS and HNB-GW.

q_11170.question: What is the function of the AUSF regarding the onboarding SUPI?
q_11170.ground_truth: The AUSF needs to support anchor key generation using nonce as additional input and store the PS address in the UDM for the duration of the onboarding registration.

q_11171.question: What is the purpose of the authorization tokens in the UE-to-UE relay solution?
q_11171.ground_truth: The purpose of the authorization tokens in the UE-to-UE relay solution is to indicate that the source UE or the UE-to-UE relay are authorized to use a specific relaying service or to serve a specific relaying service. The tokens have an expiration time and are signed with a private key of the core network.

q_11172.question: How is the LSF vector reconstructed for the VC mode at the 16 kHz internal sampling frequency?
q_11172.ground_truth: The LSF vector is reconstructed by decoding one bit at the Scheme selection block, which defines whether the predictive scheme or the safety-net scheme is used. For the safety-net scheme, the LSF vector is calculated from the prediction residual, which is decoded by BC-TCVQ. If the predictive scheme is used, the prediction vector is obtained and the LSF vector is decoded from the prediction residual, which is decoded by BC-TCVQ. The quantized LSF vector is then calculated by equation (1431) for the predictive scheme and equation (1432) for the safety-net scheme.

q_11173.question: What is the difference between a user identity and a user identifier in the 3GPP system?
q_11173.ground_truth: A user identity represents a user in a specific context, while a user identifier is a piece of information used to identify one specific user identity in one or more systems.

q_11174.question: What type of data does SMPTE ST 2110 support in video transport?
q_11174.ground_truth: SMPTE ST 2110 supports only the active part of the image, excluding ancillary data in the vertical blanking interval, which allows for future-proof support for high-resolution formats and specifications.

q_11175.question: What message type is used in the "UE test loop mode C MBMS packet counter response" message?

q_11176.question: What is the effect of the TNG2 timer on the TNG3 timer when handling an in-progress emergency group call?
q_11176.ground_truth: If the TNG2 timer is running for an in-progress emergency group call, the TNG3 timer is stopped. If the MCPTT emergency group call is cancelled, the TNG2 timer is stopped and the TNG3 timer is started instead.

q_11177.question: What is the role of the SMF in the CN/User Multicast Context Update procedure in Solution 4?
q_11177.ground_truth: The SMF supports sending NAS mode switch command messages and associating TMGI with PDU Session ID to the RAN node in the CN/User Multicast Context Update procedure in Solution 4.

q_11178.question: What channel types can be used for the radio interface connection element in the overall connection type?
q_11178.ground_truth: The radio interface connection element in the overall connection type can have the attribute values Full rate TCH, Full rate TCHs, Half rate TCH, and Dm.

q_11179.question: How can the MPEG DASH standard be employed for application-specific interactivity event notifications in an MBMS environment?
q_11179.ground_truth: The MPEG DASH standard defines the usage of Events for application-specific interactivity event notifications, where the related semantics and syntax are left to the owner of the Event scheme and associated application. The usage of MPD Events is indicated by the presence of one or more Period.EventStream elements, each instance denoting Events of a common type.

q_11180.question: What is the purpose of the Channel Mode Modify (CMM) procedure?
q_11180.ground_truth: The purpose of the Channel Mode Modify (CMM) procedure is to adjust the radio channel bit rate to match the message speed negotiated end-to-end between the facsimile machines.

q_11181.question: What actions should a UE take if the preferred frequency for the MBMS service is different from the currently used frequency?
q_11181.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "MBMS preferred frequency request" in the MBMS MODIFICATION REQUEST message and set it to the prioritised MBMS service identity.

q_11182.question: What procedure is initiated by the PCRF when the UE moves from the E-UTRAN to a HeNB and there is no Gateway Control Session for the target HeNB?
q_11182.ground_truth: The PCRF initiates the PCRF-initiated Gateway control session establishment procedure as defined in TS~23.203.

q_11183.question: What is Network sharing in 3GPP TS 23.060?
q_11183.ground_truth: Network sharing is an optional feature that allows different core network operators to connect to the same shared radio access network. When network sharing is in use, the network broadcasts within system information the PLMN identities of the PLMNs sharing the cell.

q_11184.question: What is one of the actions taken by the UE during the eCall inactivity procedure?
q_11184.ground_truth: One of the actions taken by the UE during the eCall inactivity procedure is stopping other running timers.

q_11185.question: What action should a UE take when it receives an RRCRelease message with a redirectedCarrierInfo?
q_11185.ground_truth: If a UE receives an RRCRelease message with a redirectedCarrierInfo that includes the core network type, the UE should provide the received cnType to upper layers.

q_11186.question: What function is employed to anchor IMS sessions at the SCC AS for enablement of Access Transfer?
q_11186.ground_truth: A 3pcc (3rd party call control) function is employed to anchor IMS sessions at the SCC AS upon session establishment for enablement of Access Transfer.

q_11187.question: What possible cause values can the HNB-GW include in a HNB REGISTER REJECT message when the Cause IE is set to "overload"?
q_11187.ground_truth: The HNB-GW can include "Overload" as a cause value in a HNB REGISTER REJECT message when the Cause IE is set to "overload".

q_11188.question: What action must the SGSN take if it receives a Delete PDP Context Request message for a non-existing PDP context from the GGSN?
q_11188.ground_truth: The SGSN shall send back a Delete PDP Context Response message with cause value "Non existent" and zero TEID.

q_11189.question: What is the required percentage of correct events for each neighbor cell during repeated tests?
q_11189.ground_truth: The required percentage of correct events for each neighbor cell during repeated tests is 90%.

q_11190.question: What is the function of Policy Management in the context of the present document?
q_11190.ground_truth: Policy Management is a function that governs the choices in behaviour of a system, specifying the actions to be taken when specified condition(s) occur.

q_11191.question: What are the actions taken when a SGSN receives a "Suspend Request" extension header?
q_11191.ground_truth: When a SGSN receives a "Suspend Request" extension header, it performs the actions specified in 3GPP TS~23.060 and returns a SGSN Context Response with the extension header included.

q_11192.question: What is the main benefit of the public transport information broadcast service using PBS?
q_11192.ground_truth: The main benefit of the public transport information broadcast service using PBS is the convenience it provides to users, including being able to monitor the location of public transport, plan routes and receive estimated arrival times of vehicles, all on their mobile devices.

q_11193.question: What are the radio protocols between the UE and the UE-to-Network Relay specified in?
q_11193.ground_truth: The radio protocols of E-UTRAN between the UE and the UE-to-Network Relay are specified in clause 5.1.2.1 of TS 36.300.

q_11194.question: What is the significance of the value 0000 0000 in the Time field of the Time Indication element?
q_11194.ground_truth: The value 0000 0000 in the Time field of the Time Indication element indicates that the information is valid for a period of 10 seconds.

q_11195.question: What document specifies the static conformance requirements for a UEUT in the context of the 3GPP TS 38.523-2 technical specification?
q_11195.ground_truth: A static conformance review is a review of the extent to which the static conformance requirements are claimed to be supported by the UEUT, by comparing the answers in the ICS(s) with the static conformance requirements expressed in the relevant specification(s).

q_11196.question: What should the UE do upon receiving the MPS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message being set to "Access identity 1 valid in RPLMN or equivalent PLMN"?
q_11196.ground_truth: The UE should consider access identity 1 to be valid.

q_11197.question: What is a significant development in GPRS systems that led to the need for security precautions in the core network?
q_11197.ground_truth: The significant development is the introduction of IP as the network layer in the GPRS backbone network and user traffic, which signifies a shift towards completely open and easily accessible protocols.

q_11198.question: What happens if the timer T390 is running for a specific Access Category, as per TS 38.331, clause 5.3.14.2?
q_11198.ground_truth: The access attempt is considered barred if timer T390 is running for the Access Category.

q_11199.question: What is the default value for ReportDataTransmitted and ReportDataReceived, if this leaf is not provisioned?
q_11199.ground_truth: The default value for ReportDataTransmitted and ReportDataReceived, if this leaf is not provisioned, is 1. This indicates that the UE shall report the amount of data transmitted or received during the collection period in the usage information, and whether with location information.

q_11200.question: What are the analysis targets for security attack analysis of 3GPP virtualized network products?
q_11200.ground_truth: The three types of 3GPP virtualized network product class (Type 1, Type 2, and Type 3) are the analysis targets for security attack analysis.

q_11201.question: What is the goal of Solution #13?
