q_11461.question: What are the contents of the InitiatingMessage sequence in the LCS-AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE class?
q_11461.ground_truth: The InitiatingMessage sequence contains the procedureCode, criticality, and value fields that define the requested procedure for data transmission.

q_11462.question: When is a MS considered to be "CAMEL-attached, MS may be reachable for paging" in the packet switched domain?
q_11462.ground_truth: The MS is registered to the GPRS data network, but there are no PDP contexts active for this MS, and the GPRS data network has not determined that the MS is not reachable for paging.

q_11463.question: Who provides the UE identifier and default UE credentials during the PS discovery process?
q_11463.ground_truth: The UE provides the provisioning server with the unique UE identifier and default UE credentials.

q_11464.question: Which type of relocation is supported in the UTRAN to GAN PS handover when the Iur interface is not supported?
q_11464.ground_truth: The "MS Involved" Relocation Type is supported.

q_11465.question: In which cases must a multi RAT MS indicate support of neither "UTRA CSG Cells Reporting" nor "E-UTRA CSG Cells Reporting"?
q_11465.ground_truth: When the MS has received the PCID to TA Mapping information element for the E-UTRAN frequency of the cell, and it belongs to the list of forbidden TAs for roaming or the PLMN is not indicated as equivalent to the registered PLMN, the MS may abandon monitoring and reporting this E-UTRAN cell and any E-UTRAN cell which belongs to the same Tracking Area.

q_11466.question: What response will the IWF return if a SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group is received and a SIP 404 (Not Found) response is cached?
q_11466.ground_truth: The IWF will return a SIP 404 (Not Found) response to the SIP INVITE request and include the Warning header field received in the SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

q_11467.question: How can noise contrast be reduced in a headset MS?
q_11467.ground_truth: Noise contrast can be reduced in a headset MS by maximizing the signal-to-noise ratio at the microphone input, which can be achieved by simultaneously increasing directivity, reducing sensitivity, and placing the microphone close to the mouth of the talker.

q_11468.question: Which discovery type is supported by Model B of ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_11468.ground_truth: Only restricted discovery type is supported by Model B of ProSe Direct Discovery.

q_11469.question: What is the definition of LSA only access in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_11469.ground_truth: LSA only access is a feature in 3GPP technical specifications where LSA users are allowed to access the PLMN only within their allowed LSAs, and are not allowed to receive or originate calls outside the LSA area.

q_11470.question: What happens to predefined PCC rules when 3GPP PS Data Off is activated?
q_11470.ground_truth: When 3GPP PS Data Off is activated, predefined PCC rules other than those representing 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Service can be modified or removed by the PCRF.

q_11471.question: What is the procedure to share the rekeying token with RAN nodes without sending the rekeying token list upfront?
q_11471.ground_truth: The rekeying token is sent directly to the RAN nodes at a certain step, without specifying the token ID.

q_11472.question: What should the mobile station do when timer T3238 expires while listening to the EC-PACCH?
q_11472.ground_truth: The mobile station should leave the TBF and return to packet idle mode.

q_11473.question: What is the process for the MBS Session leave procedure?
q_11473.ground_truth: When a UE is no longer using an MBS session, it notifies the network via the MBS Session Leave procedure. The MB-SMF then initiates the PDU session modification procedure to release the QoS flow of the PDU session of the UE corresponding to the MBS session which the UE is leaving.

q_11474.question: What action should the ICS UE take when an I1 Success message is received while the I1 session at the UE is in the "proceeding" state or "alerted" state?
q_11474.ground_truth: The ICS UE should transit the I1 session to the "confirmed" state and stop any locally generated alerting procedures if applied. The ICS UE should also discard any subsequent I1 Success message if it is received over an unreliable transport-layer connection.

q_11475.question: In the context of the MSR, what determines the dynamic range requirements for UTRA and E-UTRA?
q_11475.ground_truth: The dynamic range requirements for UTRA and E-UTRA are not modified for BC1, BC2 and BC3 in the context of the MSR, and they are specified in TS 25.104, section 7.3.1, TS 25.105, section 7.3.1, and TS 36.104, section 7.3.1.

q_11476.question: How many bits are used for the timeslot resource related information in the E-AGCH type 2?

q_11477.question: What action does the target RNC take if the UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE is included in the RANAP ENHANCED RELOCATION INFORMATION REQUEST message?
q_11477.ground_truth: The target side shall, if supported, store the received UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate parameters to control the aggregate data rate of non-GBR traffic for this UE.

q_11478.question: What was the cause of the streaming service issue in the business area #CBD in sub case #2?
q_11478.ground_truth: The issue was caused by a problem with a server in the CDN network.

q_11479.question: What action does the UE take when it has radio link failure information available and RPLMN is included in plmn-Identity stored in VarRLF-Report in test case 8.1.6.1.3.3.1 (2)?
q_11479.ground_truth: UE sends the RRCReestablishmentComplete message with rlf-InfoAvailable included after receiving an RRCReestablishment message.

q_11480.question: In the "Controlled power down UE" use case, what is the service flow that occurs when a FRMCS User initiates the power-down of the UE?
q_11480.ground_truth: When a FRMCS User initiates the power-down of the UE, the UE is deregistered from the FRMCS System, and the FRMCS Equipment de-registers from the FRMCS System. Finally, the UE is switched off.

q_11481.question: What mechanisms can a network node invoke based on the low access priority indicator?
q_11481.ground_truth: A network node can invoke one or more of the following mechanisms: based on the low access priority indicator in NAS request messages and based on the low access priority for RR(C) connection establishment.

q_11482.question: What action should the mobile station take when timer T3192 expires and there are no ongoing TBFs?
q_11482.ground_truth: The mobile station should enter packet idle mode or MAC-Idle state if it is in packet transfer mode or MAC-Shared state, or return to dedicated mode or MAC-Dedicated state if it is in dual transfer mode or MAC-DTM state.

q_11483.question: What is the total number of GTP data PDUs regardless of the GTP version used for incoming GTP data packets on the Gn interface, from GGSN to SGSN?

q_11484.question: How can the originating side HES scenario interoperate with other terminating scenarios?
q_11484.ground_truth: A break-out function needs to be deployed when traffic leaves the enterprise environment and becomes public network traffic for the originating side HES scenario to interoperate with other terminating scenarios.

q_11485.question: In what type of network would one typically find the "SRB-InformationSetupList-r8" field?
q_11485.ground_truth: The "SRB-InformationSetupList-r8" field is typically found in E-UTRA networks.

q_11486.question: What does the SAND (Server and Network Assisted DASH) technology, specified in ISO/IEC 23009-5, aim to enhance for DASH content delivery?
q_11486.ground_truth: The SAND technology aims to enhance the delivery of DASH content by introducing messages between DASH clients and network elements or between various network elements. This is done to provide information about real-time operational characteristics of networks, servers, proxies, caches, CDNs, and DASH client's performance and status, with the goal of improving efficiency of streaming sessions.

q_11487.question: What should the UE do when the condition A4-2 is fulfilled for event A4?
q_11487.ground_truth: The UE should consider the leaving condition for event A4 to be satisfied when the inequality A4-2 is fulfilled, which means that the neighboring cell is no longer better than the absolute threshold.

q_11488.question: What are the possible values for the SIR Target in the outer loop power control of the control frame for FDD 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_11488.ground_truth: The UL_SIR_TARGET can take values in the range of -8.2 dB to 17.3 dB with a granularity of 0.1 dB. The value range is determined by the 8-bit field in the payload structure for outer loop power control.

q_11489.question: What should be done at the UDM/HSS side for P-CSCF restoration in the 5GS when a terminating request does not proceed due to a P-CSCF failure?
q_11489.ground_truth: The UDM can either send a P-CSCF restoration indication to the serving SMF for IMS PDU session, triggering IMS PDU session update or re-establishment, or send the indication to the serving AMF for the UE, triggering IMS PDU session re-establishment.

q_11490.question: What should the SCC AS do when it wants to establish a new I1 session toward the ICS UE that uses an existing CS bearer leg?
q_11490.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send an I1 Invite message toward the ICS UE, setting the Reason in the I1 Invite message to value hex "003" to indicate that the existing CS bearer leg will be used for this call, and not include the SCC-AS-id information element. The SCC AS should also send a SIP re-INVITE request toward the CS domain that contains an SDP offer received in a SIP INVITE request from the remote UE.

q_11491.question: What information can be sent to the end-user by the gsmSRF using the inbandInfo parameter?
q_11491.ground_truth: The inbandInfo parameter can specify the inband information to be sent, which may be a single announcement, text to be sent and transformed to inband information by the gsmSRF, a sequence of announcements, or an announcement with one or more variable parts.

q_11492.question: What should a mobile station do if a failure in the uplink assignment occurs for any other reason?
q_11492.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_11493.question: What should the UE do as soon as possible after a change in priority layer for cell reselection?
q_11493.ground_truth: The UE should search for a higher priority layer for cell reselection as soon as possible after the change of priority.

q_11494.question: What is the duration of timer T3114, which is used by a VGCS mobile when receiving a complete RP-Data message on the SACCH that is not the next in sequence message to be sent to the upper layer?
q_11494.ground_truth: The value of the timer is 10 seconds.

q_11495.question: What does the CoAP-1 reference point consist of?
q_11495.ground_truth: The CoAP-1 reference point is based on CoAP and exists between the CoAP client and the CoAP proxy.

q_11496.question: What is the responsibility of the contact person for each band combination?
q_11496.ground_truth: The contact person for each band combination is responsible for ensuring that the TPs related to the band combination have been implemented.

q_11497.question: What is the format of the returned bytes for CatGetCHVStatus?
q_11497.ground_truth: The format of the returned bytes for CatGetCHVStatus is specified in 3GPP TS 31.101.

q_11498.question: What is the equation used to find the predicted fixed-codebook gain?
q_11498.ground_truth: The predicted fixed-codebook gain is found by taking the mean-removed innovation energy and using it to perform 4th order MA prediction with fixed coefficients.

q_11499.question: What is the definition of Frequency Error as per the document?
q_11499.ground_truth: Frequency Error is the measure of the difference between the actual relay transmit frequency and the assigned frequency.

q_11500.question: What information does the IP-SM-GW include in the MAP-SEND-ROUTING-INFO-FOR-SM message?
q_11500.ground_truth: When querying for routing information, the IP-SM-GW includes the Invoke-ID parameter, MSISDN parameter, SM-RP-PRI parameter, Service Centre Address parameter, SM-RP-MTI parameter, SM-RP-SMEA parameter, and GPRS Support Indicator parameter.

q_11501.question: What is the maximum length of the Alpha Identifier for the URL in PROACTIVE COMMAND: LAUNCH BROWSER 5.5.2?

q_11502.question: What is the role of the GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message in the GA-RRC connection establishment procedure?
q_11502.ground_truth: The GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message is used to transfer the "initial" upper layer message for the domain from the MS to the GANC. Receipt of the GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message by the GANC triggers the establishment of the signalling connection to the indicated CN domain for the MS.

q_11503.question: How are the two noise floor gains quantized for the low-frequency noise-fill in the generic mode?
q_11503.ground_truth: The two noise floor gains are scalar quantized with 5 bits on a log domain and transmitted to the decoder for the high-frequency noise-fill.

q_11504.question: What is the effect of switching off the UE on the operator-defined access category definitions?
q_11504.ground_truth: The operator-defined access category definitions are kept after switching off the UE, so that they can be used after switch on.

q_11505.question: What should the SRNC do when the UE is using dedicated resources in the DRNS after receiving the COMMON TRANSPORT CHANNEL RESOURCES RELEASE REQUEST message?
q_11505.ground_truth: The SRNC shall release only the C-RNTI and all its related RACH and/or FACH resources allocated for the UE.

q_11506.question: What is the purpose of the "Update PDP context/bearer at P-CSCF failure" mechanism?
q_11506.ground_truth: The "Update PDP context/bearer at P-CSCF failure" mechanism allows the P-CSCF to remain reachable even if it is temporarily unavailable, and enables the S-CSCF to reconnect to the same P-CSCF once it becomes reachable again.

q_11507.question: What are the pre-conditions for initiating a real-time video stream in the FRMCS system?
q_11507.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for initiating a real-time video stream in the FRMCS system are that the streaming FRMCS User or FRMCS Equipment has registered to a functional identity that is authorized to initiate a real-time video stream, and the receiving FRMCS User or FRMCS Equipment has registered to a functional identity that is authorized to receive a real-time video stream.

q_11508.question: What is the role of a Data Collection Coordination Function (DCCF) in 5GS?
q_11508.ground_truth: A DCCF is used to coordinate the collection of data from one or more NFs based on data collection requests from one or more Consumer NFs. DCCF and Data Repository Function (DRF) can be standalone NFs, possibly co-located with NWDAF, or can be hosted by NWDAF.

q_11509.question: What redundancy levels are supported in 3GPP TS 48.103 for CS Data service with Redundancy over AoIP?
q_11509.ground_truth: The redundancy levels 2 and 3 are supported in 3GPP TS 48.103 for CS Data service with Redundancy over AoIP.

q_11510.question: What is the purpose of the Voice Activity Detector (VAD) in the context of 3GPP digital cellular telecommunications?
q_11510.ground_truth: The VAD is used in the Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) system for Enhanced Full Rate (EFR) speech traffic channels within the 3GPP digital cellular telecommunications system to distinguish between noise with speech present and noise without speech present.

q_11511.question: In Solution #21, what does the source MME do after receiving the Handover Command message from the source eNB?
q_11511.ground_truth: The source MME forwards the parameters received in Handover Command message to the source eNB in the Handover Command message.

q_11512.question: What message does the new SGSN send to the old SGSN after receiving a valid old P-TMSI Signature or if the MS is known to the old SGSN?
q_11512.ground_truth: The new SGSN responds with an SGSN Context Request (IMSI, old RAI, MS Validated) message to the old SGSN if the old P-TMSI Signature is valid, or if the new SGSN indicates that it has authenticated the MS, or if the MS is known to the old SGSN.

q_11513.question: How are silence frames (SID-frames) treated in the calculation of average codec bitrate for audio media?
q_11513.ground_truth: Silence frames (SID-frames) are not counted as "active" and are excluded from the calculation of average codec bitrate for audio media.

q_11514.question: What is one solution for the Random Access Response (RAR) message delay issue in IoT NTN?
q_11514.ground_truth: One solution is adjusting the offset to delay the start of the RA Response window, allowing more time for the RAR message to be received in NTN.

q_11515.question: What is the purpose of the VNF PM data related to VR job creation procedure?
q_11515.ground_truth: The VNF PM data related to VR job creation procedure is for creating a PM job that identifies the VNF or VNFC for which the PM data is to be collected, and specifies the periodicity for collection and reporting of performance information.

q_11516.question: What are the applicable events for the PDG in 3GPP WLAN Interworking services?
q_11516.ground_truth: The applicable events for the PDG in 3GPP WLAN Interworking services are I-WLAN Tunnel Establishment, I-WLAN Tunnel Disconnect, and Packet Data Header Information.

q_11517.question: What is the purpose of storing the network personalisation indicator, network code(s), and NCK in the ME?
q_11517.ground_truth: The purpose is to support the network personalisation feature, enabling the ME to personalise to a particular network.

q_11518.question: What reference points are used at the service layer to realize peering-based business trunking arrangements?
q_11518.ground_truth: The main reference points from the IMS service layer that are used to realize peering-based business trunking arrangements include e2, Gq', Ici or Mm, Mx, Cx, Sh, and ISC or Ma.

q_11519.question: What is the modulation used for E-PUCH?
q_11519.ground_truth: An E-PUCH may use QPSK or 16QAM modulation symbols.

q_11520.question: What is the definition of the performance plots on the right hand side?
q_11520.ground_truth: The performance plots on the right hand side are based on the same simulations but are depicted FER versus C/I1, showing the fraction C2 of carrier power C which does not contribute to the wanted signal for user 1.

q_11521.question: What does the E-DCH TDD Maximum Bitrate parameter indicate for an E-DCH in TDD mode?
q_11521.ground_truth: The E-DCH TDD Maximum Bitrate parameter indicates the Maximum Bitrate for an E-DCH in TDD mode.

q_11522.question: What should the PCEF do when it cannot send an IP-CAN session modification request towards a PCRF that has restarted after the IP-CAN session establishment?
q_11522.ground_truth: If the PCEF cannot send the IP-CAN session modification request towards a PCRF that has restarted, the PCEF should not send the request and may tear down the associated PDN connection based on operator policy. Emergency, RLOS, and eMPS sessions should not be torn down. This mechanism enables the clean up of PDN connections affected by the PCRF failure and leads the UE to initiate a UE-requested PDN connectivity procedure for the same APN.

q_11523.question: If the UE supports S1 mode, what must it do if it also supports sending an ATTACH REQUEST message containing a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with request type set to "handover"?
q_11523.ground_truth: The UE must set the HO attach bit to "attach request message containing PDN connectivity request with request type set to handover to transfer PDU session from N1 mode to S1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_11524.question: What is the scaling factor for Rx beam sweeping in NR positioning, where the positioning frequency layer is in FR2 and the UE supports the capability for the band containing the positioning frequency layer?
q_11524.ground_truth: The scaling factor is equal to the value reported by the UE in supportedLowerRxBeamSweepingFactor-FR2 if the UE supports the capability for the band containing the positioning frequency layer, and the LMF indicates lowerRxBeamSweepingFactor-FR2 in NR-TDOA-RequestLocationInformation.

q_11525.question: What is the difference between Serving E-DCH cell and Non-serving E-DCH RL in the context of E-UTRAN?
q_11525.ground_truth: Serving E-DCH cell is a cell that is part of the E-DCH active set and from which the UE can receive the Serving E-DCH RLS, while Non-serving E-DCH RL is a cell that is also part of the E-DCH active set but from which the UE cannot receive the Serving E-DCH RLS. In FDD, a UE has one Serving E-DCH cell on the primary uplink frequency, and can have zero, one, or several Non-serving E-DCH RLs on the primary uplink frequency.

q_11526.question: How can IMS utilize the service based capabilities and service based interfaces of the 5GC for interactions between the IMS and the 5GC?
q_11526.ground_truth: IMS applications and network functions can utilize the service based capabilities and service based interfaces of the 5GC through the use of service based interfaces for interactions between the IMS and the 5GC. The specific 5GC functions that should be interfaced with IMS using service based interfaces will depend on the requirements of the network.

q_11527.question: Which message is sent by the MB-SMF to the UPF in the User Multicast Session Leave procedure when the UE no longer wants to receive multicast data of a specific TMGI?
q_11527.ground_truth: The Anchor MB-SMF interacts MB-UPF to stop delivering data to the UPF

q_11528.question: What is the value of the "m" line for an RTSP stream in the SIP 200 OK response sent by the PSS Adapter?
q_11528.ground_truth: The value of the "m" line for an RTSP stream in the SIP 200 OK response sent by the PSS Adapter is "m=<media> <port> <transport> <fmt>".

q_11529.question: What does the indication for a rejected CUG call be given to the MS (mobile station) by the network?
q_11529.ground_truth: The indication for a rejected CUG call is given to the MS in the form of "Diagnostics information in cause value #29 'Facility Rejected'" or a "standard call control cause value" in the first clearing message.

q_11530.question: What is the purpose of the RTCP Disable Test?
q_11530.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to ensure that setting RTCP bandwidth to zero in SDP disables RTCP transmission from the SUT.

q_11531.question: What is the difference between the MCX EUTRA test model and the MCX IPCAN test model in the document?
q_11531.ground_truth: The MCX EUTRA test model uses a TTCN implementation for E-UTRA/EPC conformance testing, while the MCX IPCAN test model uses an external E-UTRA/EPC implementation integrated with the SS. The MCX IPCAN test model supports signalling for the MCX PDN only and it is up to the SS implementation to handle potential registrations to other networks.

q_11532.question: When should the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure after expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a specific measId?
q_11532.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure immediately after the expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a specific measId.

q_11533.question: What is the test level for AC mains power input ports for RF common mode test?
q_11533.ground_truth: The test level for AC mains power input ports for RF common mode test is 1 kV open circuit voltage as given in IEC~61000-4-4.

q_11534.question: What should the receiver do if the Facility IE is checked for protocol errors as specified in subclause 2.2.8 and a protocol error is found?

q_11535.question: What is the role of the Physical Layer Common Control Channel (PLCCH) in 3GPP LTE?
q_11535.ground_truth: The Physical Layer Common Control Channel (PLCCH) is a Node B terminated channel which may be used to carry dedicated (UE-specific) TPC and SS information to multiple UEs. It carries TPC and SS information only, no higher layer data is mapped to PLCCH.

q_11536.question: What should the UE do if the IE "Use of HCS" is set to "used" in System Information Block type 11ter?
q_11536.ground_truth: If the IE "Use of HCS" is set to "used", the UE should use the default values specified for the IE "HCS neighbouring cell information" for the first new cell in System Information Block type 11ter and use the same parameter values as used for the preceding cell for any other new cell.

q_11537.question: What is the primary concern for security requirements in handover?
q_11537.ground_truth: The primary concern for security requirements in handover is that it shall not compromise the security of the network providing the new radio resources, the possibly different network providing the original radio resources, and the UE.

q_11538.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to eCall?
q_11538.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for standardizing the parts of the eCall service that affect the mobile communication system.

q_11539.question: What is the role of the QUIC Tunnel Client (QTC) in the QUIC-LL steering functionality?
q_11539.ground_truth: The QUIC Tunnel Client (QTC) is responsible for establishing N QUIC connections over 3GPP access and N QUIC connections over non-3GPP access with the QUIC tunnel server in the UPF. It receives UL PDUs from the upper layer and selects a QUIC connection to transmit the PDU based on the ATSSS rules and the Access Selection component.

q_11540.question: What are the three methods that the MMTel AS can use for converged charging?
q_11540.ground_truth: The MMTel AS can use Immediate Event Charging (IEC), Session based charging SCUR, or Post Event Charging (PEC) for converged charging.

q_11541.question: What is the purpose of Activity Log Security Service in IRP scenario?
q_11541.ground_truth: Activity Log Security Service is used to log request-related information transferred between communication entities in a secured IRP scenario.

q_11542.question: What is the purpose of the Service Announcement Function (SAF) in the MBMS system?
q_11542.ground_truth: The SAF creates the needed metadata fragments for the MBMS User Service and supports Service Continuity by adding base pattern elements to the USBD, which the UE matches against a portion of the request URL.

q_11543.question: What is the ASN.1 definition used for in the XwAP protocol?
q_11543.ground_truth: The ASN.1 definition specifies the structure and content of XwAP messages. It takes precedence over the tabular format in case of contradiction.

q_11544.question: What is the purpose of the dynamic STI-rSR provided to the UE from the ATCF in CS to PS SRVCC?
q_11544.ground_truth: The dynamic STI-rSR provided to the UE from the ATCF in CS to PS SRVCC is used to enable PS-CS service continuity of IMS multimedia-sessions.

q_11545.question: Which element has a complex type named "groupIdType"?
q_11545.ground_truth: The "groupId" element has a complex type named "groupIdType".

q_11546.question: How are the connected ambulance's medical devices authorized to share incident data with hospital personnel?
q_11546.ground_truth: The connected ambulance's medical devices are provisioned with parameters allowing establishment of a secure communication link to an authorized application in the hospital or ERC. These parameters enable the devices to share incident data with authorized personnel over the 5G network.

q_11547.question: What action is taken if reportType is set to reportSFTD and the quantity to be reported becomes available for each requested pair of PCell and NR cell?
q_11547.ground_truth: If reportType is set to reportSFTD and the quantity to be reported becomes available for each requested pair of PCell and NR cell, timer T322 is stopped and the measurement reporting procedure is initiated as specified in section 5.5.5.

q_11548.question: How many MAC-b entities are there in the UTRAN for each cell?
q_11548.ground_truth: There is one MAC-b entity in the UTRAN for each cell.

q_11549.question: What information should the IPLMN/VPLMN provide to the CSE when a called party alert event occurs?
q_11549.ground_truth: The IPLMN/VPLMN should provide the event met, the party in the call for which the event is reported, and the type of monitoring to the CSE.

q_11550.question: What should the CRNC do if new traffic is requesting to use the logical resources while they are being blocked and made idle?
q_11550.ground_truth: New traffic shall not be allowed to use the logical resources while the CRNC waits for the resources to become idle and once the resources are blocked.

q_11551.question: What is a Solution Set (SS) in the context of 3GPP TM?
q_11551.ground_truth: A Solution Set (SS) in 3GPP TM is a set of requirements, information service, and solution set definitions for each Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the Telecommunication Management (TM) of 3G systems.

q_11552.question: What should the UE do when the entry condition for a specific event is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells during the timeToTrigger defined for that event?
q_11552.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for that measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for that measId, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5.

q_11553.question: What does the "AnnouncingAuthorisationNotInEUTRAN" leaf indicate in the context of ProSe direct discovery model A when the UE is not served by E-UTRAN?
q_11553.ground_truth: It indicates whether the UE is authorized to perform ProSe direct discovery model A announcing when not served by E-UTRAN.

q_11554.question: In the context of SHVC Systems, what is the importance of the VPS extension structure and its contents?
q_11554.ground_truth: The VPS extension structure includes essential information on various aspects such as scalability type, layer set, cross-layer video usability information (VUI), and more, which are relevant for the decoding and display of video content in a scalable manner.

q_11555.question: What changes does FLO bring to the radio bearers in terms of flexibility and performance?
q_11555.ground_truth: The radio bearers offered by FLO, with enhancements such as reduced granularity and flexible interleaving, would not only fulfill the IMS requirements in terms of flexibility and performance but also significantly improve the link level performance of real-time IMS services compared to GERAN Release 5.

q_11556.question: What is the Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (ACLR) definition that was agreed upon by WG4?
q_11556.ground_truth: ACLR is the ratio of the transmitted power to the power measured after a receiver filter in the adjacent RF channel, both measured within a filter response that is nominally rectangular, with a noise power bandwidth equal to the chip rate.

q_11557.question: In what situation will a mobile station send a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message using the PACCH?
q_11557.ground_truth: A mobile station will send a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message using the PACCH if there is at least one ongoing uplink TBF.

q_11558.question: What information does the ANR Cell Information IE provide?
q_11558.ground_truth: The ANR Cell Information IE provides information about a UTRAN cell.

q_11559.question: What is the purpose of using a fixed length for the RLP frame in UTRAN Iu mode?
q_11559.ground_truth: The fixed length allows for alignment with the underlying radio transmission, eliminating the need for frame delimiters or bit-stuffing.

q_11560.question: What message is sent by the MT to the TE to indicate that the MT has received an incoming message and is waiting for an ACKNOWLEDGE MESSAGE?

q_11561.question: What does "Release 17" in the title indicate?
q_11561.ground_truth: "Release 17" refers to the version of the technical specification.

q_11562.question: What is maintained during handover of a PDN connection between GTP based connectivity 3GPP access and S2a/S2b GTP based connectivity non-3GPP access for the P-GW?
q_11562.ground_truth: The "EPS default bearer charging identifier" for the default bearer, and the "Charging Id" for the handed-over dedicated bearers

q_11563.question: What should a mobile station do if it is in a camped normal state and has valid individual priorities that do not include a priority for the serving cell?
q_11563.ground_truth: The mobile station should consider the serving cell to have the lowest priority.

q_11564.question: What is one limitation of Solution 30 and how does it propose to address it?
q_11564.ground_truth: Solution 30 does not explain how to handle the case where a UE attempts to maintain PDU Sessions in slices that are not all accessible in the same operating band. It proposes to optionally use NR/NR Dual Connectivity in such scenarios.

q_11565.question: What is the range of UE efficiency for on-demand MG with concentrated PRS?
q_11565.ground_truth: The range of UE efficiency for on-demand MG with concentrated PRS is 0%-40%.

q_11566.question: What kind of information can the PCEF enhanced with ADC or TDF provide?
q_11566.ground_truth: The PCEF enhanced with ADC or TDF can provide information such as detected application identifier, allocated application instance identifier, and detected service data flow descriptions.

q_11567.question: What is the purpose of system information block type 15.5?
q_11567.ground_truth: The system information block type 15.5 contains information useful for OTDOA UE-based Positioning method.

q_11568.question: What should the BOW bit be set to if SSN equals V(Q) + 1 modulo SNS?
q_11568.ground_truth: The BOW bit should be set to the value '1' if SSN equals V(Q) + 1 modulo SNS.

q_11569.question: What information must the V2X Control Function include in the V2X-Notify request when revoking authorization for V2X service?
q_11569.ground_truth: The V2X Control Function must include the V2X Permission, PLMN ID, and the IMSI in the request when revoking authorization for V2X service.

q_11570.question: What was the application layer FEC packet ratio used in the UEP performance test in the MBSFN channel of 9Mbps throughput in 7 sectors layout?
q_11570.ground_truth: Only the ratio of application layer FEC packets was manipulated to test the UEP performance in the MBSFN channel of 9Mbps throughput in 7 sectors layout.

q_11571.question: What is the role of the UE at mobility during PDU session re-anchoring?
q_11571.ground_truth: The UE starts using the IP address/prefix associated with the new PSA for new traffic flows, or proactively for existing traffic flows where possible. It may also trigger a new DNS request for the Application FQDN and switch to the new AS based on the response.

q_11572.question: When should the IP-SM-GW send an Instant Message Delivery Notification with a "failed" indication?
q_11572.ground_truth: If at least one of SMS-STATUS-REPORT for concatenated Short Messages contains the TP-Status element set between specific values, and the associated SIP MESSAGE request contains a Disposition-Notification header field with value "negative-delivery".

q_11573.question: How are cells ordered in the "Measured Results" in the 3GPP specification?
q_11573.ground_truth: The "Measurement Results" are ordered in the order of the value of the measurement quantity for intra-frequency and inter-frequency measurements, where the best FDD cell has the largest value when the measurement quantity is "Ec/No" or "RSCP" and the best TDD cell has the largest value when the measurement quantity is "Primary CCPCH RSCP".

q_11574.question: What is the limitation when EDA can only be combined with EDA for mobile allocations?
q_11574.ground_truth: If EDA can only be combined with EDA, then the possible combinations are more limited. For example, if mobile 1 transmits 3 or more slots, mobile 2 cannot transmit any slots, and if mobile 2 transmits any slot, mobile 1 cannot transmit more than 2 slots.

q_11575.question: What are the real-time transcoding capabilities of the FLUS Sink?
q_11575.ground_truth: The FLUS Sink is capable of real-time transcoding and packaging to different codecs and different bitrates. The system can add more transcoders if needed during the session.

q_11576.question: What is the impact of supporting smaller bandwidth channels in certain regions?
q_11576.ground_truth: Smaller bandwidth channels (e.g. 1.6 GHz) would allow for more channels (e.g., three instead of two) in these regions, easing frequency planning between operators at the cost of reduction in available channel bandwidth per carrier.

q_11577.question: What is the purpose of the key derivation function f5* in the 3GPP MILENAGE algorithm?
q_11577.ground_truth: The purpose of f5* is to ensure anonymity in re-synchronisation by deriving an anonymity key (AK) from a random number (RAND) and a long-term secret key (K). It should be computationally infeasible to derive K from RAND and AK.

q_11578.question: What is the role of the NFVO and VNFM functional blocks in the 3GPP mobile network management standards?
q_11578.ground_truth: The NFVO and VNFM functional blocks in the 3GPP mobile network management standards facilitate the installation, dimensioning, interconnection, healing and recovery of 3GPP-defined network functions that are virtualized.

q_11579.question: What is the role of envelope normalization in the PFSC process?
q_11579.ground_truth: The envelope normalization process is used to smooth the spectral characteristic of the low-frequency content by dividing it by the maximum amplitude value in each sub-band. This helps to improve the accuracy of the correlation calculation between the low-frequency and high-frequency bands.

q_11580.question: What is the primary difference between the User Data Silo and the User Data Convergence (UDC) in the 3GPP system?
q_11580.ground_truth: The User Data Silo is the traditional paradigm of user data deployment, where user data are stored and managed independently in different network entities. In contrast, the User Data Convergence (UDC) moves user data to a centralized repository, where they can be accessed and managed in a common way, regardless of the diversity of user data structures for different services.

q_11581.question: What does the Temporary Flow Identity (TFI) uniquely identify in the GPRS protocol?
q_11581.ground_truth: The Temporary Flow Identity (TFI) uniquely identifies either a single uplink Temporary Block Flow (TBF) or a single downlink Temporary Block Flow (TBF) in the GPRS protocol.

q_11582.question: What must the MS include in the Activate PDP Context Request message when initiating a PDP Context Request procedure for emergency services?
q_11582.ground_truth: The MS must include an emergency indication in the Activate PDP Context Request message.

q_11583.question: What does the "rSRVCC Information" IE contain in UTRAN?
q_11583.ground_truth: This IE contains information for rSRVCC operation.

q_11584.question: What public identities or identity ranges should a block list contain for Communication Diversions (CDIV)?
q_11584.ground_truth: The public identities or identity ranges of users from which incoming communications are not forwarded when CDIV is activated

q_11585.question: How is the probability of DASH QoE measurements being present in a reception report calculated when the reception reporting procedure is active and DASHQoESamplePercentage is present?
q_11585.ground_truth: The probability is given by the value of DASHQoEProcedure.DASHQoESamplePercentage.

q_11586.question: What is the role of the spectral smoothing operation in the adaptive spectral postfilter, and how is it performed?
q_11586.ground_truth: The spectral smoothing operation is performed to reduce computations needed to compute the spectrally smoothed numerator coefficients. It is done by performing the operation once per frame on the denominator coefficients corresponding to the uninterpolated coefficients. The numerator coefficients for subframes one, two, and three are interpolated using the same interpolation scheme that is used for the LPC synthesis coefficients. The output of the spectral postfilter is then multiplied by S'scale as the last step in reconstructing the speech signal in the speech decoder.

q_11587.question: How does the DHCP-based IPv4 address allocation work for one-to-one ProSe Direct Communication between two UEs?
q_11587.ground_truth: One of the two UEs acts as a DHCP server, dynamically allocating IPv4 addresses to the Remote UEs for the duration of the direct communication session.

q_11588.question: What is the clock accuracy requirement for source switching in medical imaging systems?
q_11588.ground_truth: The clock accuracy requirement for source switching in medical imaging systems is less than 1 microsecond.

q_11589.question: How does the UE determine the transmission slots for CQI reports when transmitting CQI reports for the 4th secondary serving HS-DSCH cell as specified in section 4c?
q_11589.ground_truth: The UE should transmit the CQI report of the 4th secondary serving HS-DSCH cell (if present) so that it starts in the same slot as the transmissions of CQI report of the serving HS-DSCH starts.

q_11590.question: What should be minimized to reduce the potential negative impact of ProSe on E-UTRAN services?
q_11590.ground_truth: The potential negative impact of ProSe on E-UTRAN services should be minimized.

q_11591.question: What is the specification that defines the charging principle, requirements, service operations, and charging information for URLLC service charging in 5G systems?

q_11592.question: In 3GPP technical specifications, what does "should" indicate?
q_11592.ground_truth: It indicates a recommendation to do something.

q_11593.question: What is the typical frequency range for UTRA/TDD operation?
q_11593.ground_truth: UTRA/TDD is designed to operate in the following frequency bands: 1900-1920 MHz, 2010-2025 MHz, 1850-1910 MHz, 1930-1990 MHz, 2570-2620 MHz, and 2300-2400 MHz.

q_11594.question: What is the maximum video resolution supported in WebMedia's DASH-based streaming services?
q_11594.ground_truth: WebMedia supports up to HD video in its DASH-based streaming services.

q_11595.question: In the scenario where the UE is in FDD or 1.28 Mcps TDD, and both variable H_RNTI and variable C_RNTI are set, what should be done?
q_11595.ground_truth: The UE should monitor its paging occasions on the selected PICH and receive PCCH on the HS-DSCH mapped on the HS-PDSCH, or DCCH and DTCH mapped on the HS-PDSCH and the associated HS-SCCH selected by the UE.

q_11596.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "shall, if supported" in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project documentation?
q_11596.ground_truth: If a procedure indicates that the receiving node "shall" perform a certain function under a certain condition, it means that the receiving node is required to execute the functionality. If the receiving node "shall, if supported" perform a certain function, it is required to execute the functionality only if it supports it.

q_11597.question: What message does UE1 send to the UE-to-UE Relay when it triggers the Link Identifier Update procedure and needs a new IP address?
q_11597.ground_truth: UE1 sends a Link Identifier Update Request message to the UE-to-UE Relay over the PC5 unicast link, which includes a "new IP address needed" indication and its peer UE info (i.e., UE2 IP address, UE2 User Info), in addition to the usual parameters sent on the Link Identifier Update request message, e.g., Layer-2 ID and security info.

q_11598.question: How are maximum bitrate, guaranteed bit rate, and maximum SDU size mapped between UMTS bearer service and Radio Access Bearer service?
q_11598.ground_truth: The attribute value for the UMTS bearer will normally be the same as the corresponding attribute value for the Radio Access Bearer for maximum bitrate, guaranteed bit rate, and maximum SDU size.

q_11599.question: Under which error conditions did the EFR codec perform worse than the TCH-FS reference in at least one laboratory?
q_11599.ground_truth: The EFR codec performed worse than the TCH-FS reference under severe error condition (EP3) in one laboratory.

q_11600.question: What value is set to the NPM Transfer Time timer when a new upper layer PDU begins transmitting in an MBMS bearer with an NPM Transfer Time limitation?
q_11600.ground_truth: The NPM Transfer Time timer is set to the value of the NPM Transfer Time for each new upper layer PDU that begins transmitting.

q_11601.question: What is the first step in the handover to UTRAN procedure, as initiated by the network?
q_11601.ground_truth: The suspension of normal operation except for RR management (layer 3).

q_11602.question: For which mode of operation UMTS MS is it possible to send and receive short messages in Iu mode?
q_11602.ground_truth: For any mode of operation UMTS MS is it possible to send and receive short messages in Iu mode.

q_11603.question: What are the main constraints and requirements provided in the EVS-4 Permanent Document?
q_11603.ground_truth: The constraints and requirements in the EVS-4 Permanent Document set the framework for the EVS codec, covering capability, resource usage, and performance requirements. These requirements include input-output sampling, coded bandwidths, maximum computational complexity, and other essential features and performance parameters.

q_11604.question: During a multi-party call with the MGW, what steps are taken if two parties remain in the connection and the codecs do not match?
q_11604.ground_truth: The MGW can either revert directly to a TrFO connection if both codecs match, modify one or both of the codec types using OoBTC procedures, or continue to resolve the difference in codecs by internal transcoding procedures. Codec modification procedures may also be employed if a common codec exists among all parties.

q_11605.question: What is the main specification defining TV profiles in DVB?
q_11605.ground_truth: The main specification defining TV profiles in DVB is the ETSI TS 101 154 v2.1.1. This specification defines, among others, video profiles based on H.264/AVC and H.265/HEVC, which are used for SDTV, HDTV, and UHDTV.

q_11606.question: What is the significance of the ISIM application in the 3GPP specification?
q_11606.ground_truth: The ISIM application in the 3GPP specification indicates the collection of IMS security data and functions on a UICC. It may be a distinct application on the UICC. The distinction between ISIM and ISIM application is useful for describing the IMS security architecture, and common authentication keys and functions can be used for IMS and PS domain authentication.

q_11607.question: What is the maximum frequency offset with respect to half of the bandwidth of the measuring filter?
q_11607.ground_truth: The frequency offset is equal to half of the bandwidth of the measuring filter.

q_11608.question: What are the advantages of Tandem Free Operation (TFO) in telecommunications?
q_11608.ground_truth: The advantages of TFO include an improvement in speech quality by avoiding double transcoding, possible savings on inter-PLMN transmission links, reduced processing power requirements for network equipment, and a reduction in end-to-end transmission delay.

q_11609.question: What field of the From-id information element should be set to "Identifier" if the public identity is not the default public user identity?
q_11609.ground_truth: The Code specific field of the From-id information element should be set to "Identifier".

q_11610.question: When should the MAC entity determine the next available PRACH occasion from the PRACH occasions corresponding to the selected SSB in the association period given by ra-AssociationPeriodIndex in the si-RequestPeriod permitted by the restrictions given by the ra-ssb-OccasionMaskIndex?
q_11610.ground_truth: The MAC entity should determine the next available PRACH occasion from the PRACH occasions corresponding to the selected SSB in the association period given by ra-AssociationPeriodIndex in the si-RequestPeriod permitted by the restrictions given by the ra-ssb-OccasionMaskIndex, if an SSB is selected and the Random Access procedure was initiated for SI request.

q_11611.question: What is the purpose of the "separation bit" in the AMF field of AUTN in the EMSDP Session Start message?
q_11611.ground_truth: The "separation bit" in the AMF field of AUTN is used to indicate whether UMTS authentication vectors or EPS authentication vectors have been received in the Session Parameters of the EMSDP Session Start message.

q_11612.question: What are the assumed mechanisms for UAV authentication and authorization in the 3GPP system?
q_11612.ground_truth: The UAV is authenticated at registration with the 3GPP using existing UE authentication mechanisms based on MNO credentials, and a separate UAV USS-registration for authorization takes place between the UAV and the USS/UTM. The 3GPP system only receives confirmation of the authorization from the USS and is not involved in authorizing the UAV.

q_11613.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do to request radio resources for V2X communication over PC5 when served by E-UTRAN?
q_11613.ground_truth: The UE should follow the procedure outlined in 3GPP TS 24.334 subclause 10.2.2.

q_11614.question: What message is sent by the UE to the USS after receiving the ATTACH COMPLETE message from the USS during registration on PS?

q_11615.question: What is the effect of including Closed User Group (CUG) information in a CCNL communication?
q_11615.ground_truth: CUG information is not included in the check for a compatible terminal. Therefore, a terminal may react positively to the check for a compatible terminal due to the absence of CUG information, but the terminal may not inform the user of the arrival of the CCNL call.

q_11616.question: What is the purpose of the error concealment procedure defined in the document?
q_11616.ground_truth: The purpose of the error concealment procedure is to conceal the effect of lost AMR speech frames and to mute the output in the case of several lost frames to indicate the breakdown of the channel to the user and avoid generating possible annoying sounds as a result from the error concealment procedure.

q_11617.question: What is the outcome if there is a recovery after a timer expiry?
q_11617.ground_truth: The CALL A-B WAITING or CALL A-B HELD/CALL C-B WAITING should be performed based on the specific scenario.

q_11618.question: What is the scope of 3GPP TS 37.571-2, User Equipment (UE) conformance specification for UE positioning; Part 2: Protocol conformance?
q_11618.ground_truth: The scope of 3GPP TS 37.571-2 is to specify the protocol conformance testing for UTRAN, E-UTRAN and NR User Equipment (UE) supporting UE positioning.

q_11619.question: What is the method used to conduct the subjective tests to verify the codec behavior on 3D-signals in the Audio Codec verification phase?
q_11619.ground_truth: The test method used is the ITU-R BS.1534-1 method, which includes hidden reference and bandwidth-limited anchor signals. Additionally, for this test, anchor points with reduced spatial image were introduced.

q_11620.question: What can happen if an attacker manipulates the allocation of virtualized resources in a GVNP?
q_11620.ground_truth: This can result in the reliability, availability, or even illegal termination of a GVNP, leading to a denial of service.

q_11621.question: What is the BD-rate gain provided by SHVC compared to HEVC simulcast for aligned IRAP pictures case?
q_11621.ground_truth: The BD-rate gain is up to 40.5%, with an overall average gain of 31.9% for QP delta 2 for aligned IRAP pictures case.

q_11622.question: What is the action taken when there is a request for information provision?

q_11623.question: What are the two scenarios described for NSI creation in PEC mode?
q_11623.ground_truth: The two scenarios described are for NSI Creation request with CTF internal to the Service Producer, and NSI Creation request with CEF.

q_11624.question: When should the UE stop the Tsor-cm timer associated with "SOR security check not successful", if running?
q_11624.ground_truth: The UE shall stop the Tsor-cm timer associated with "SOR security check not successful", if running, when the security check on the received steering of roaming information is successful.

q_11625.question: What are the five speech signal classes that can be classified based on the fixed signal classification parameters?
q_11625.ground_truth: The five speech signal classes that can be classified are UNVOICED CLASS, VOICED CLASS, VOICED TRANSITION CLASS, ONSET CLASS, and AUDIO CLASS.

q_11626.question: What is the recommended transport bearer addressing for the AAL2 transport layer in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_11626.ground_truth: The recommended transport bearer addressing for the AAL2 transport layer in the 3GPP Technical Specification is AAL2 signalling protocol Capability Set 2, which uses AAL2 transport layer addressing based on embedded E.164 or other AESA variants of the NSAP addressing format.

q_11627.question: What should the MB-SMF do if there is no UE in the MB-SMF for a specific MBS session?
q_11627.ground_truth: The MB-SMF should request the MBSF to release the tunnel between the MBSU and MB-UPF.

q_11628.question: When is registration not performed by UEs?
q_11628.ground_truth: Registration is not performed by UEs that are only capable of services that need no registration.

q_11629.question: What should be secured while converting application layer group ID to the destination L2 ID for 5G ProSe group communication?
q_11629.ground_truth: The conversion/mapping procedure should be secured in terms of privacy and traceability to prevent disclosure of group membership of specific UEs.

q_11630.question: What is the purpose of storing the Inter RAT handover information and MS Classmark~2 and MS Classmark~3 as information elements on the Gb interface?
q_11630.ground_truth: The purpose is to support the case that a SRVCC handover is needed following PS domain handover from GERAN to UTRAN/E-UTRAN.

q_11631.question: What determines the load sharing function for the IP sub-network's local and remote IP endpoints?
q_11631.ground_truth: The load sharing function for the IP sub-network is determined by the weight information provided by the peer NSE for both signalling traffic and data traffic.

q_11632.question: As per the 3GPP TS 25.214 v7.1.0 specification, what is used to indicate the location of the FACH?
q_11632.ground_truth: The location of the FACH is indicated on the BCH and both its capacity and location can be changed if required.

q_11633.question: In the naming convention, what does "N" represent in "N" marks a certain data block?
q_11633.ground_truth: "N" represents the number of a certain data block.

q_11634.question: What is the purpose of the "GAN Cell Description" information element in GAN A/Gb mode?
q_11634.ground_truth: The purpose of the "GAN Cell Description" information element is to provide a minimum description of a GAN A/Gb mode cell, e.g. to identify the GAN A/Gb mode cell in order to be handed over from GERAN/UTRAN.

q_11635.question: What should the IWF do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with a Resource-Priority header field set to the value indicated for emergency calls and the SIP re-INVITE request does not contain an emergency indication?
q_11635.ground_truth: The IWF should reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

q_11636.question: What is the conformance requirement CR~1 in the PIN2 verification procedure?
q_11636.ground_truth: Before allowing access to PIN2-protected data, the ME shall ask the user for PIN2 verification.

q_11637.question: When sending an SDP answer from the IMS core network to the eP-CSCF (IMS-ALG), what action does the eP-CSCF (IMS-ALG) take if the SDP answer includes "tra-m-line" media level SDP attributes and relates to a non-WebRTC IMS UE?
q_11637.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF (IMS-ALG) will de-encapsulate information to the optimized media from the received SDP answer and construct the SDP answer towards the WIC based on that de-encapsulated information.

q_11638.question: What action does the EAS take when charging for a one-time UE location request based on PEC?
q_11638.ground_truth: The EAS sends the UE location request to the EES, which then checks the UE location with the 3GPP network and sends the location response back to the EAS.

q_11639.question: What is PFDF and what does it do?
q_11639.ground_truth: PFDF stands for Packet Flow Description Function. It stores PFDs associated with application identifier(s) and transfers them to the PCEF via Gw interface to enable the PCEF to perform accurate application detection when the PFDs are managed by a 3rd party service provider.

q_11640.question: How are the band energies quantized in the Small symbol coding method?
q_11640.ground_truth: In the Small symbol coding method, the band energies are coded using either resized or context-based Huffman coding. The mode selection between resized and context-based coding is based on the estimated number of bits consumed by the respective coding modes. The resized Huffman coding is used for coding the differential indices when LC_MODE is set to 1, and context-based coding is used when LC_MODE is set to 0.

q_11641.question: What is the responsibility of the TR editor in the context of 3GPP technical documents?
q_11641.ground_truth: The TR editor is responsible for introducing all approved TPs in the current TR.

q_11642.question: What should be avoided when introducing a candidate solution for the BSS?
q_11642.ground_truth: Changes to BSS hardware and HW upgrades to the BSS.

q_11643.question: Which mobile terminated short message types can trigger a CAMEL service invocation?
q_11643.ground_truth: Short Message Delivery (TPDU type = SMS-DELIVER) and Short Message Status Report (TPDU type = SMS-STATUS-REPORT) are the short message types that can trigger a CAMEL service invocation.

q_11644.question: What is the impact of the versioning system used in the document, and how does it change?
q_11644.ground_truth: The versioning system used in the document has three digits, where the first digit refers to the level of approval of the document, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated.

q_11645.question: What does the new signalling enable in relation to BCS4 and BCS5?
q_11645.ground_truth: The new signalling allows for ignoring BCS4 or BCS5 with the new signalling.

q_11646.question: What is the consequence of using the ViewHandler.findTLV() methods in the context described?
q_11646.ground_truth: Using the ViewHandler.findTLV() methods in the context described is recommended to get each COMPREHENSION TLV, as it allows for easy and efficient retrieval of specific TLVs within the USATEnvelopeHandler.

q_11647.question: What operation does the "Change Character Group" CH Extension Type indicate should be overridden?
q_11647.ground_truth: The initialization parameters of the Character Group (de)coder

q_11648.question: How can MPD updates be used as a mechanism to influence the DASH client's selection of representations?
q_11648.ground_truth: MPD updates can be used as a mechanism to influence the DASH client's selection of representations by generating MPD updates and adding/removing representations that the client should or should not use, based on the detection of congestion in the core network or on the air interface.

q_11649.question: How does KASUMI process the input data block?
q_11649.ground_truth: KASUMI processes the input data block, I, by dividing it into two 32-bit strings, L0 and R0. Then, it iterates through 8 rounds, updating Li and Ri using a specific round function fi().

q_11650.question: What are the normal flow requirements for the SM Personal Signature Service?
q_11650.ground_truth: The normal flow requirements for the SM Personal Signature Service are that Joe enables the service and sets his personal signature, Joe sends a short message to Sally, the personal signature is appended to the original short message by the home network SM Personal Signature Service, and Sally receives the message with the personal signature.

q_11651.question: What are the two new features in H.265 (HEVC) specifically for parallel processing support?
q_11651.ground_truth: The two new features in H.265 (HEVC) for parallel processing support are tiles and wavefront parallel processing (WPP).

q_11652.question: What are the two primary principles for IRP development in 3GPP?
q_11652.ground_truth: The two primary principles for IRP development in 3GPP are NRM IRP Extendibility, which enables technology, organizational, and vendor-specific NRM extensions, and Interface IRP Flexibility, which enables broad industry adoption across multiple network technologies.

q_11653.question: What significance is assigned to the message type CTS AFA MONITORING COMMAND?

q_11654.question: What enhancements are specified in the NR Positioning for TS 22.261?
q_11654.ground_truth: The enhancements include improvement of positioning accuracy and latency, improvements of network and device efficiency, high integrity and reliability requirements, and support for A-GNSS positioning (BDS B2a, B3I, NavIC to NR) for NR positioning methods.

q_11655.question: What should the NGCN site provide in the P-Preferred-Identity header field when presenting a request as originated from a particular NGCN user?
q_11655.ground_truth: The NGCN site should provide the NGCN user identifier in the P-Preferred-Identity header field or in the P-Asserted-Identity header field to indicate the specific NGCN user that a request is originating from.

q_11656.question: Who is responsible for performing TSCAI calculation when the AF maintains the 5G VN Group information?
q_11656.ground_truth: The SMF indicates the (DS-TT, DS-TT) port pair to the PCF when the AF does not maintain the 5G VN Group information.

q_11657.question: What is the test procedure for measuring the Primary CCPCH power in subclause 6.4.5.4.2?
q_11657.ground_truth: The test procedure for measuring the Primary CCPCH power involves first measuring the power with the base station output power set to a specific value, then reducing the output power and repeating the measurement for a total of 4 measurements.

q_11658.question: What should the HA do before receiving a binding update with Lifetime set to "0" from the UE?
q_11658.ground_truth: The HA should remove the DSMIPv6 binding cache entry of the UE and send a Binding Revocation Indication message.

q_11659.question: When is the support for ingress TT operations mandatory for a DS-TT or NW-TT?
q_11659.ground_truth: The support for ingress TT operations is mandatory for a DS-TT when the egress TT is a DS-TT and the gPTP message is used. It is mandatory for a NW-TT when the gPTP message is used, and optional when the PTP message is used.

q_11660.question: What is required for a mobile station to be compatible with the LSA service?
q_11660.ground_truth: A mobile station is compatible with the LSA service if it provides specific functions such as cell reselection, notification of the current LSA, and complete functionality to allow the use of phase 2 services.

q_11661.question: What function does the 5G PKMF have in this solution for PC5 communication?
q_11661.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF is responsible for generating the K~PC5 key, authenticating and authorizing the UE-to-network relay, providing the K~PC5 key to the Remote UE, and generating the K~PC5-COM key for secure communication.

q_11662.question: What information does the V-GMLC include in the LCS Service Response message sent to the H-GMLC when the UE has relocated before the area event occurred?
q_11662.ground_truth: The LCS Service Response includes an indication of the event occurrence, the LDR reference number, the H-GMLC address, and the LCS Service Response is sent in accordance with the requested QoS Class. The LDR reference number and the H-GMLC address will be used to identify the source of the original deferred location request in the case that the UE has relocated before the area event occurred. The V-GMLC may record charging information.

q_11663.question: What is the interfering signal offset for the narrowband intermodulation requirement based on CW and E-UTRA 1RB interfering signals?
q_11663.ground_truth: The interfering signal offsets from the RF bandwidth edge are dependent on the RAT/E-UTRA channel bandwidth and are defined in such a way that the whole intermodulation product falls inside the effective channel bandwidth of the outermost carrier.

q_11664.question: What is the transport format and port number used in the described interface?
q_11664.ground_truth: The transport format used is UDP and the port number is 44444.

q_11665.question: What is the Advice Of Charge (AOC) service that relates to charging information during a communication?

q_11666.question: How many combinations of OSId and OSAppId values can be specified in the "OSApps" interior node?
q_11666.ground_truth: One or more combinations of OSId and OSAppId values can be specified in the "OSApps" interior node, indicated by its "OneOrMore" occurrence.

q_11667.question: What is the purpose of the GapCriteria parameter?
q_11667.ground_truth: The GapCriteria parameter is used to indicate the call gapping criteria for the GapOnService sequence and can contain either basic or compound gap criteria.

q_11668.question: What action is taken by MSC-A in case of a rejection or dialogue abortion performed by MSC-A?
q_11668.ground_truth: MSC-A responds with a MAP CLOSE or MAP U/P ABORT and releases the IU connection.

q_11669.question: Which algorithm is used by the SGSN to select the encryption algorithm in GERAN when attaching in GERAN?
q_11669.ground_truth: The SGSN selects the encryption algorithm to use in GERAN.

q_11670.question: Why are there compiled copies of the library and headers included in the document?
q_11670.ground_truth: The compiled copies of the library and headers are included in the document for convenience, so that it can be easily built for Windows.

q_11671.question: How do NF Service Consumers send a user data request with an additional IE 'DataPurposeID' in the 3GPP service exposure privacy rule framework?
q_11671.ground_truth: NF Service Consumers send a user data request with the 'DataPurposeID' in an appropriate IE along with the request to the NF Service Producer to determine how privacy-sensitive information should be processed based on a specific operator's privacy policies and requirements.

q_11672.question: What enhanced PDCCH monitoring adaptation mechanisms are provided to reduce UE power consumption on PDCCH monitoring in an active BWP?
q_11672.ground_truth: The enhanced PDCCH monitoring adaptation mechanisms include fast adaptation methods, such as reduced PDCCH monitoring at the end of or after a duration of data scheduling, and are triggered by scheduling DCI formats in Type3-PDCCH CSS sets or USS sets on the active DL BWP of the serving cell.

q_11673.question: What is the role of Network Control Key (NCK) in network personalisation?
q_11673.ground_truth: The Network Control Key (NCK) is used to network de-personalise a ME, meaning it is required to remove network personalisation from the ME.

q_11674.question: What are the two steps in determining the country of the UE's location?
q_11674.ground_truth: The two steps in determining the country of the UE's location are: (1) determining the UE geolocation (lat, long) and (2) determining the country that corresponds to the UE location.

q_11675.question: What is the duration unit used in 4.4.5.2 for the number of available circuits in trunk group measurement?

q_11676.question: What should a PSS client ignore when calculating session bandwidth from the received SDP?

q_11677.question: What is the use of the GAN Service Zone Information information element?
q_11677.ground_truth: The GAN Service Zone Information information element is used to provide the mobile station with GAN Service Zone related information applicable to the current location of the user. It consists of two fields, GAN Service Zone Name string and GAN Service Zone Icon Indicator.

q_11678.question: Which network element selects the same PCF for AMF and SMF in Rel-17?
q_11678.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management (AM) Function (AMF) selects the same Policy Control Function (PCF) for AMF and Session Management Function (SMF) when the governing DNN and/or S-NSSAI needs to be served by the same PCF in the UDM.

q_11679.question: What should be the value of the Expires header field if the IWF performing the role of the MCData server wants to receive the current status and later notification?
q_11679.ground_truth: The Expires header field should be set to 4294967295 if the IWF performing the role of the MCData server wants to receive the current status and later notification.

q_11680.question: What are the scenarios where the same content is provided through 5GMS unicast and 5MBS?
q_11680.ground_truth: Scenario 2 (unicast recovery), scenario 3 (session continuity), and scenario 4 (MooD).

q_11681.question: What is the purpose of the Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) Management Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP)?
q_11681.ground_truth: It is an integration reference point used for communication between an IRPAgent and one or more IRPManagers, allowing management of WLAN.

q_11682.question: What does the Carrier Group Index represent in the SNPL bitmap field?
q_11682.ground_truth: The Carrier Group Index ranks carrier groups by the smallest frequency value Fsmallest of the carrier group. The smaller the frequency Fsmallest in one carrier group is, the index in the SNPL bitmap is more near leftmost bit.

q_11683.question: What is the significance of the 'Coding' in the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND USSD command?
q_11683.ground_truth: The 'Coding' is likely refers to the encoding of the USSD string, which defines the method used to represent the USSD string.

q_11684.question: What are the main performance limitations and technical risk areas identified in the report?
q_11684.ground_truth: The main limitations and risks include codec performance, background noise, difficulty of measuring C/I distributions, channel and codec mode adaptation algorithms, channel quality metric accuracy, TFO implementation, and AMR system complexity.

q_11685.question: What should the VPLMN AMF do when receiving steering of roaming information from the UDM for the UE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_11685.ground_truth: The VPLMN AMF should transparently send the received steering of roaming information to the UE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

q_11686.question: What is a SOR-CMCI rule?
q_11686.ground_truth: A SOR-CMCI rule consists of a criterion such as PDU session attribute type criterion, service type criterion, SOR security check criterion, or match all type criterion, and a value for Tsor-cm timer associated with the criterion.

q_11687.question: In the IMS mechanism outline, what is the main advantage of using private SIP headers to build a lightweight marking mechanism for the intent of providing additional criteria for making a decision about unsolicited communications?
q_11687.ground_truth: The main advantage of using private SIP headers is that it allows for a reasonably lightweight implementation that complements existing information in IMS messages.

q_11688.question: What service provisions an MBS Distribution Session in the MBSTF by invoking the Nmbstf service at reference point Nmb2?
q_11688.ground_truth: The MBSF provisions an MBS Distribution Session in the MBSTF by invoking the Nmbstf service at reference point Nmb2 using the parameters from the newly created MBS Session Context.

q_11689.question: What is the total number of bits required to encode the 4 signed pulses in a track for cases 1, 2, or 3 in the 4 signed pulses per track section?

q_11690.question: What should the UE do with the "START" values in the subclause 8.5.9 if the USIM is absent, and a new security key set was received for this CN domain but was not used either for integrity protection or ciphering during this RRC connection?
q_11690.ground_truth: The UE sets the START value for this domain to zero and stores it for this domain in the volatile memory of the ME, regardless of whether a new security key set was received or not.

q_11691.question: What is the direction and use of the CONNECT message?
q_11691.ground_truth: The CONNECT message is sent by the network to the calling MS to indicate establishment of the requested broadcast call.

q_11692.question: Which function converts between the A-TRAU format and a synchronous stream?
q_11692.ground_truth: The RAA" function converts between the A-TRAU format and a synchronous stream. It also performs FPS and handles M1 and M2 bits as specified in 3GPP TS 44.021 in transparent operation.

q_11693.question: Which service defined in 3GPP TS 23.280 is supported in the IOPS mode of operation, as specified in the document?

q_11694.question: What is the name of the feature that enables fast stream switching similar to eMBMS in H.264/AVC?
q_11694.ground_truth: The similar feature of fast stream switching may also be achieved using simulcast of H.264/AVC.

q_11695.question: How do the coexistence scenarios between an UE aggressor in Band 5 and adjacent channel public safety operation compare with the scenarios between an UE aggressor in Band 26 and adjacent channel public safety operation?
q_11695.ground_truth: The coexistence scenarios are much alike, except for the 5 MHz difference in the uplink frequency bandwidth.

q_11696.question: What is the role of the SCC AS in the augmentation call flow?
q_11696.ground_truth: The SCC AS identifies the session to be augmented using the STI and updates the combined session towards the Remote Leg if the INVITE request contains additional PS media.

q_11697.question: How long is the longest sleep duration for FeMBMS/Unicast-mixed cell in LTE network, in ms, for sub-frame level sleep if Sub-frame 5 is used as the starting point?

q_11698.question: What is the minimum requirement for transmitter intermodulation for both the relay access and backhaul links as defined in TS~36.116 clause 6.6?
q_11698.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for transmitter intermodulation is as defined in TS~36.116 clause 6.6.

q_11699.question: What are the different codec modes in the AMR codec and their corresponding number of bits produced per 20 ms speech frame?
q_11699.ground_truth: The AMR codec modes include 4.75 kbit/s, 5.15 kbit/s, 5.90 kbit/s, 6.70 kbit/s, 7.40 kbit/s, 7.95 kbit/s, 10.2 kbit/s, and 12.2 kbit/s, corresponding to the number of bits produced per 20 ms speech frame as 95, 103, 118, 134, 148, 159, 204, and 244, respectively.

q_11700.question: What should be the value of the 'M' flag for RADIUS VSAs when they are re-used as Diameter AVPs?

q_11701.question: What is the consequence if an unrecognised cause value is received with an ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message?
q_11701.ground_truth: The Class of the cause value should be used to determine the MSC's action.

q_11702.question: What should a mobile station in broadcast/multicast receive mode do upon expiry of timer T3214 when receiving an MBMS session on CCCH?
q_11702.ground_truth: The mobile station in broadcast/multicast receive mode shall remain in broadcast/multicast receive mode upon expiry of T3214 and discard the corresponding notification.

q_11703.question: What is the purpose of introducing BCS4/BCS5 in NR band combinations?
q_11703.ground_truth: The purpose of introducing BCS4/BCS5 in NR band combinations is to reduce the workload in RAN4, by allowing the use of all channel bandwidths for the band in the band combination, without requiring operators to create new Bandwidth Combinations Sets for existing band combinations in NR CA and SUL.

q_11704.question: After receiving an RLC data block including the rTLLI but not the TLLI, what should the network include in the next EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message?
q_11704.ground_truth: The network should include the received rTLLI in its next EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message.

q_11705.question: What is the purpose of the Service Key in CAMEL?
q_11705.ground_truth: The Service Key is an identifier for a specific operator-specific service that is transparent to the IPLMN/VPLMN in CAMEL.

q_11706.question: What information elements are included in the GA-RC REGISTER UPDATE UPLINK message if the MS is in an area with GSM coverage?
q_11706.ground_truth: The GERAN Cell Identity, Location Area Identification, and Routing Area Code (if available) shall be included in the GA-RC REGISTER UPDATE UPLINK message if the MS is in an area with GSM coverage.

q_11707.question: What is the procedure if an alternative IP address is available only for the control plane or for the user plane, but not both, when sending the Alternative GGSN Address for control Plane IEs and Alternative GGSN Address for user traffic IEs?
q_11707.ground_truth: A pair of Alternative GGSN Address for control plane IE and Alternative GGSN Address for user traffic IE shall be encoded, where one of these IEs includes the alternative address and the other IE is set to a null IPv4 or IPv6 address (i.e. 4 or 16 octets set all to zero).

q_11708.question: What message does the GLR send to the IM-GSN to indicate the address of the SGSN that currently serves the MS?
q_11708.ground_truth: The GLR sends a 'Send Routeing Information for GPRS Ack (IMSI, SGSN Address, and Cause)' message to the IM-GSN indicating the address of the SGSN that currently serves the MS.

q_11709.question: What should be the originator's action, if no failure has occurred in the receive direction, when sending an NS-BLOCK PDU?
q_11709.ground_truth: The originator shall continue to accept NS-UNITDATA PDUs received on the NS-VC being blocked, until an NS-BLOCK-ACK PDU is received for this NS-VC. However, if the number of retries of the blocking procedures is exceeded, the originator shall stop to accept NS-UNITDATA PDUs.

q_11710.question: What is the performance difference between non-MUROS and MUROS mode in terms of voice codecs and SACCH?
q_11710.ground_truth: Link level simulations were performed to understand the relative performance degradation between voice codecs and SACCH in non-MUROS and MUROS mode.

q_11711.question: What protocol does the P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) set as the transport in the SDP answer, before sending it to the core network?

q_11712.question: What action is taken when the DL-RELEASE-REQUEST primitive is received in the MS?
q_11712.ground_truth: When the DL-RELEASE-REQUEST primitive is received, the data link layer initiates the release procedure of sub-clause 8.4.4.2 for normal release, or follows the procedures of sub-clause 8.4.4.4 for local end release. For normal release, the data link layer discards any outstanding DL-DATA-REQUEST primitive and any segmented layer~3 data units for which the last segment has not been received.
