q_11713.question: What action did operator #1 take to address the streaming service issue in a metro station in sub case #3?
q_11713.ground_truth: Operator #1 performed access control for certain type of traffic and diverted some type of traffic or users to a spare carrier.

q_11714.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification in the context of Circuit Switched (CS) fallback in Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
q_11714.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification defines the architecture and specification for CS fallback and SMS over SGs for EPS or CS Fallback and SMS over S102, including the enhancements for functionality to enable fallback from E-UTRAN access to UTRAN/GERAN CS domain access and to CDMA 1x RTT CS domain access.

q_11715.question: What should the SCF do when it wants to start content switching reports?
q_11715.ground_truth: The SCF should send a SIP UPDATE message with the Recv-Info header set to "content info" to the PSS adapter.

q_11716.question: What security context will the UE take into use when the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message can be accepted and the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure is successful?
q_11716.ground_truth: The UE will take the 5G NAS security context indicated in the message into use when the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message can be accepted, and the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure is successful.

q_11717.question: What is the role of the vector of bit-allocations in the adaptive bit-allocation scheme?
q_11717.ground_truth: The vector of bit-allocations is used to allocate the available bits among the bands. The size of this vector is equal to the number of sub-bands. Initially, all its entries are set to zero. This vector is then updated iteratively by assigning 1 bit for each spectral coefficient in the band which has the largest norm among the number of bands used, until the iterative procedure stops and the remainder bits are allocated to bands of a lower dimension than which caused the stop of the bit-allocation loop.

q_11718.question: What information do CSG and non-CSG cells broadcast on the shared carrier frequency?
q_11718.ground_truth: CSG cells broadcast the PSC range reserved for CSG cells, and non-CSG cells may also broadcast this range. This information is applicable to the UARFCN within the PLMN where the UE received this information.

q_11719.question: What is the purpose of early classmark sending in the immediate assignment procedure?
q_11719.ground_truth: Early classmark sending is the process of sending classmark information as early as possible after access to provide the CTS-FP with additional information. It is indicated in the classmark (ES IND bit) in the "Controlled Early Classmark Sending" option.

q_11720.question: What is the function of the Object ingest subfunction in the pull-based ingest method at reference point Nmb8?
q_11720.ground_truth: The Object ingest subfunction in the pull-based ingest method at reference point Nmb8 fetches one or more objects from the MBS Application Provider (AF/AS).

q_11721.question: What action must the UE take after receiving a (NAS) SecurityModeCommand message?
q_11721.ground_truth: The UE must send a (NAS) SecurityModeComplete message after activating NAS security.

q_11722.question: What is the initial value of the state variable pnup used in the high frequency dynamic range flag decision process?
q_11722.ground_truth: The initial value of pnup is 6.

q_11723.question: What can be neglected when testing ancillary RF amplifiers in a base station?
q_11723.ground_truth: The actual attenuation value of the connecting network and other characteristics and the temperature dependence of the attenuation of the connecting network can be neglected when testing ancillary RF amplifiers in a base station.

q_11724.question: What is the condition to consider the input signal as stationary in the PLC mode selection method?
q_11724.ground_truth: The energy difference (Ed) is less than 0.032209.

q_11725.question: In what way does the FRMCS system determine which FRMCS users will receive the railway emergency alert based on the initiated conditions by a Controller?
q_11725.ground_truth: The FRMCS system determines which FRMCS users will receive the alert based on factors such as location, direction of movement, speed, track, and functional identity of both the initiating entity and the FRMCS users concerned in the emergency.

q_11726.question: How is the expected playback time for jitter calculation determined in the QoE-Feedback header?
q_11726.ground_truth: The expected playback time is equal to the actual playback time of the last played frame plus the difference between the NPT time of the frame and the NPT time of the last played frame.

q_11727.question: In the "Cells-to-be-Deactivated-List" object, what does the "maxCellinngeNBDU" parameter represent?
q_11727.ground_truth: The "maxCellinngeNBDU" parameter is the maximum number of candidate cells that can be deactivated in the Served-Cells-To-Deactivate-List.

q_11728.question: What is the role of the Incoming MGCF (I-MGCF) and Outgoing MGCF (O-MGCF) entities in the 3GPP IM CN subsystem?
q_11728.ground_truth: The Incoming MGCF entity terminates incoming SIP calls from the IMS side and originates outgoing calls towards the CS side using BICC or ISUP. The Outgoing MGCF entity terminates incoming BICC or ISUP calls from the CS side and originates outgoing calls towards the IMS using SIP.

q_11729.question: What should the UE do if an update of IE "UE positioning GPS Ephemeris and Clock Correction parameters" has been provided for a satellite using the IE "Satellite Status"?
q_11729.ground_truth: The UE should act as specified in subclause 8.6.7.19.3.4 of TS 25.331.

q_11730.question: What is the purpose of the NELP coding scheme in encoding unvoiced segments of speech?
q_11730.ground_truth: The purpose of the NELP coding scheme is to accurately capture unvoiced segments of speech using a minimal number of bits per frame.

q_11731.question: What action does the NAS take when the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is allowed?
q_11731.ground_truth: If the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is allowed, the NAS takes different actions depending on the event which triggered the access attempt, such as initiating the NAS transport procedure, notifying the upper layers that the access attempt is allowed, or considering that the uplink user data packet is allowed to be sent.

q_11732.question: What is a potential security requirement to support secure communication between the remote UE and the network via UE-to-Network relays in 5G System?
q_11732.ground_truth: 5GS shall support secure communication between the remote UE and the network via UE-to-Network relays and shall support the generation of separate security contexts for remote UEs for ProSe relay communication.

q_11733.question: What must the Information Type IE be set to in order for the SAS to include the GANSS Time Model IE in the Requested Data Value IE with the requested time information?

q_11734.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an initial INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.ussd+xml MIME body containing the <UnstructuredSS-Request> or <UnstructuredSS-Notify> element?
q_11734.ground_truth: The UE should pass the USSD data to the USSD application handling and wait for the response of the application, then send a 200 (OK) response to the INVITE request following the procedures specified for the UE as a terminating UA.

q_11735.question: What is used to select the application protocol for each MPQUIC connection?
q_11735.ground_truth: The application protocol is decided by stage-3 and is negotiated during each MPQUIC connection.

q_11736.question: What is the meaning of "Content of Communication (CC)" and "Intercept Related Information (IRI)" in this specification?
q_11736.ground_truth: "Content of Communication (CC)" refers to the information exchanged between two or more users of a telecommunications service, while "Intercept Related Information (IRI)" includes collection of information or data associated with telecommunication services involving the target identity, specifically communication associated information or data, service associated information or data, and location information.

q_11737.question: What is the main challenge in Location information of unauthenticated users and what is its architectural requirement?
q_11737.ground_truth: The main challenge is requesting location information before user authentication but after the user has already registered to the SIP core. The architectural requirement is for the MC System to individually address a specific UE, which can be achieved using an existing or new UE-specific identity rather than the MC ID.

q_11738.question: What are the dimensions of the quiet zone that must be met in order to contain DUT attached to a phantom head and shoulders?
q_11738.ground_truth: The dimensions of the quiet zone must be slightly larger than the phantom dimension, with minimum radius of the quiet zone being 150mm, which is the approximate distance from a mobile phone to the edge of the head and shoulders phantom while the phone is placed in an "intended use" position.

q_11739.question: What is the purpose of the Reception buffer in the AM RLC entity?
q_11739.ground_truth: It stores AMD PDUs until a complete RLC SDU has been received and delivers them to the upper layers through the AM-SAP once reassembled.

q_11740.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the OCS in the IP-CAN Session Modification procedure?
q_11740.ground_truth: The OCS provides credit information to the TDF and acknowledges the credit report in step 12 of the IP-CAN Session Modification.

q_11741.question: What is the range of capacity performance decrease for FR1, Indoor Hotspot, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for CG traffic model, 15ms PDB, 60 FPS, with MU-MIMO when the data rate increases from 8Mbps to 30Mbps?
q_11741.ground_truth: The range of capacity performance decreased from >38.7~44.1 UEs per cell with 8Mbps to 7.2~16.2 UEs per cell with 30Mbps.

q_11742.question: What should be the value of extensionContainer in CancelLocationRes?
q_11742.ground_truth: extensionContainer should be absent in CancelLocationRes.

q_11743.question: What should the SRNC (Serving Radio Network Node) do if the requirements received in the Security Mode Command cannot be fulfilled?
q_11743.ground_truth: The SRNC shall send a SECURITY MODE REJECT message to the requesting VLR/SGSN if the received requirements for downlink integrity protection cannot be fulfilled.

q_11744.question: What procedure must the GCS AS use to modify an existing MBMS bearer?
q_11744.ground_truth: The GCS AS must send a GCS-Action-Request (GAR) command including one MBMS-Bearer-Request AVP for each bearer that is to be modified, with the MBMS-StartStop-Indication AVP set to "UPDATE", the TMGI AVP and the MBMS-Flow-Identifier AVP to designate the bearer to be modified, and the appropriate MBMS-Service-Area AVP, QoS-Information AVP, and/or MBMS-Cell-List AVP.

q_11745.question: Which network function is responsible for notifying the UE about the change of QoS in the 5G network?
q_11745.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for notifying the UE about the change of QoS in the 5G network. It uses the existing QoS Notification control defined in clause~5.7.2.4 in TS~23.501 to notify the UE when the QoS parameters change.

q_11746.question: When is it possible for a UE to initiate the EPC-MO-LR procedure?
q_11746.ground_truth: A UE can initiate the EPC-MO-LR procedure if the LCS Support Indication indicates EPC-MO-LR is supported and if the UE also supports EPC-MO-LR.

q_11747.question: What procedure is followed if a parent wants to block a program the child is watching via SIP MESSAGE for Parental Control?
q_11747.ground_truth: The parent UE issues a SIP MESSAGE for Parental Control, the SCF validates the request and updates the controlled use's profile, and then initiates the PSS/MBMS streaming session teardown procedure.

q_11748.question: What is the purpose of the "AlmanacAndSatelliteHealthSIB-ExtIEs" field in the "AlmanacAndSatelliteHealthSIB" sequence?
q_11748.ground_truth: The "AlmanacAndSatelliteHealthSIB-ExtIEs" field in the "AlmanacAndSatelliteHealthSIB" sequence is used to define additional extension information for the almanac and satellite health for a given area.

q_11749.question: What is the definition and applicability of E-DPCCH false alarm in 8.13.1.1?
q_11749.ground_truth: E-DPCCH false alarm is a conditional probability of detection of codeword when input is only DPCCH (+interference) and the E-DPDCH and E-DPCCH is turned off. The performance requirement is determined by the maximum detection probability allowed when the receiver input signal is at a specified EC/N0 limit, and the E-DPCCH false alarm shall be 10-2 or less for tests in Pedestrian A for the Home BS.

q_11750.question: What should a UE do if it is not operating in CS/PS mode 1 operation and T3410 timeout occurs during an attach procedure?
q_11750.ground_truth: The UE should abort the attach procedure and release the NAS signaling connection locally.

q_11751.question: What is the transmission delay objective specified in 3GPP TS 03.50 for speech channels in the GSM PLMN?
q_11751.ground_truth: The transmission delay objective specified in 3GPP TS 03.50 for speech channels in the GSM PLMN is 180 ms.

q_11752.question: What are the three types of LCS-CDRs used for collecting charging information, and under which conditions are they generated?
q_11752.ground_truth: The three types of LCS-CDRs are LCS-MO-CDR, LCS-MT-CDR, and LCS-NI-CDR, and they collect charging information for location requests originating from the UE/MS, external entities, and the network, respectively. They are generated when the SGSN receives a RANAP "Location Report" message from the RNC.

q_11753.question: What function makes the RNC aware of the UE's Common ID?
q_11753.ground_truth: Sending the UE Common ID (permanent NAS UE identity) to the RNC.

q_11754.question: What network do the two trains use for communication when they are still far enough apart?

q_11755.question: What is the purpose of bulk transferring CCTV archives from the on-board system to the ground system?
q_11755.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the retention time for the recordings in the on-board system is seven days, while the minimum retention time for the CCTV recordings in the ground system is 31 days.

q_11756.question: What should the BSS do in the UL-MBMS-UNITDATA procedure if the TMGI is not available?
q_11756.ground_truth: The BSS shall provide the TMGI and, if present in the MBMS Service Context, the MBMS Session Identity to the SGSN in order to identify the MBMS session in the UL-MBMS-UNITDATA procedure.

q_11757.question: What is the main focus of "Key issue #5 'QoS with satellite backhaul'" in the context of 5G systems?
q_11757.ground_truth: The main focus is on the use of satellite connectivity as backhaul between terrestrial RAN nodes and CN nodes, and its ability to provide appropriate QoS for all flows.

q_11758.question: What is the maximum size of an APPLICATION INFORMATION message in 3GPP TS 44.006?
q_11758.ground_truth: The maximum size of an APPLICATION INFORMATION message is 251 octets.

q_11759.question: What information is excluded when calculating the Effective File Size (EFS) of a bitstream?
q_11759.ground_truth: All information that is not needed for reconstruction of the anchor sequence is excluded when calculating the Effective File Size (EFS) of a bitstream.

q_11760.question: What should be done to indicate the establishment of a DRB and its corresponding eps-BearerIdentity to upper layers?
q_11760.ground_truth: The establishment of the DRB(s) and the eps-BearerIdentity of the established DRB(s) should be indicated to upper layers.

q_11761.question: Which modification mechanisms does the OoBTC procedures support?
q_11761.ground_truth: The OoBTC procedures support the modification of Selected Codec, modification of Available Codecs List, and Mid-call Codec Negotiation.

q_11762.question: What is the purpose of the AF priority information in the context of application session priority?
q_11762.ground_truth: The AF priority information represents session/application priority and is used by the PCRF to guarantee service for an application session of a higher relative priority. The AF priority information is separate from the MPS EPS Priority indicator, which represents user priority.

q_11763.question: What is the purpose of a ProSe UE-to-Network Relay in Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
q_11763.ground_truth: A ProSe UE-to-Network Relay provides functionality to support connectivity to the network for Remote UEs in ProSe.

q_11764.question: What value is used by the PCEF for setting the bearer's GBR for GBR bearers in a network initiated IP-CAN bearer establishment or modification?
q_11764.ground_truth: The sum of the GBRs of all PCC rules that are active and bound to that GBR bearer.

q_11765.question: What should be retained following the request for an emergency call if the IMS emergency call is handed over from the PS domain to the CS domain using SRVCC?
q_11765.ground_truth: The LRF that was originally assigned to the IMS emergency call shall be retained to avoid any impact to the emergency centre/PSAP.

q_11766.question: Which command type is used in the initial conditions for testing "SELECT ITEM (next action indicator support)"?

q_11767.question: Which HTTP method is used by the PCEF/TDF to retrieve PFDs information for a set of application identifier(s)?
q_11767.ground_truth: The HTTP GET method is used by the PCEF/TDF to retrieve PFDs information for a set of application identifier(s).

q_11768.question: When can the initiating UE initiate the PC5 unicast link release procedure?
q_11768.ground_truth: The initiating UE may initiate the procedure if the target UE has been non-responsive, if there is a need to establish a new PC5 unicast link, or upon expiry of the timer T5005.

q_11769.question: What does GCSE stand for in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification?

q_11770.question: What type of network entity is the TrGW?
q_11770.ground_truth: The TrGW (Translation Gateway) is a NAT-PT/NAPT-PT, which uses a pool of globally unique IPv4 addresses for assignment to IPv6 nodes on a dynamic basis as sessions are initiated across the IP version boundaries.

q_11771.question: What is the main impact of the parameters described in clause 4.2.3.1 on the results in WB mode?
q_11771.ground_truth: The main impact is on S-MOS, resulting in scattered G-MOS results.

q_11772.question: What is the unit of measurement for the "Number of octets of incoming IP data packets on the S1-MME interface from eNodeB to MME" and "Number of octets of outgoing IP data packets on the S1-MME interface from MME to eNodeB"?
q_11772.ground_truth: The unit of measurement for these parameters is the number of octets of IP data packets.

q_11773.question: What is the purpose of the Network Sharing Scenarios section in the document?
q_11773.ground_truth: The Network Sharing Scenarios section in the document describes various scenarios for network sharing, including common radio access network connected to multiple core networks and multiple radio access networks sharing one core network.

q_11774.question: What is the recommended solution for consistent naming of MBS session handling components?
q_11774.ground_truth: The recommendation is for consistent naming of MBS session handling components, including "MBS-C", "MSF", and "MBSF".

q_11775.question: In the context of GERAN, what does the abbreviation "G-RNTI" represent?

q_11776.question: What is the purpose of the UTM initiated PDU Session Release procedure?
q_11776.ground_truth: The UTM initiated PDU Session Release procedure is used to release PDU sessions that are not authorized by the UTM. This procedure can be triggered by the UTM when authorization for a UAV to fly is denied.

q_11777.question: What security requirements are necessary for interconnectivity via N6, N5 and NU1 reference points?
q_11777.ground_truth: Additional security requirements are necessary for interconnectivity via N6, N5 and NU1 reference points since these interfaces are inter-operator interfaces.

q_11778.question: What does the UE do if it receives an indication that the 5GSM message was not forwarded due to S-NSSAI only based congestion control along with a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the PDU session ID IE set to the PDU session ID of the PDU session?
q_11778.ground_truth: If the UE receives such an indication, it shall ignore the Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network, stop timer T3585 associated with the corresponding S-NSSAI (if running), and may not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI until timer T3585 expires or timer T3585 is stopped. If no S-NSSAI was provided during the PDU session establishment and the request type was different from "initial emergency request" and different from "existing emergency PDU session", the UE shall not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message without an S-NSSAI until the UE is switched off, the USIM is removed, or else it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message for a non-emergency PDU session for the same S-NSSAI from the network.

q_11779.question: What steps should a MSRP sender follow to send a new message?
q_11779.ground_truth: The MSRP sender should ensure the message length does not exceed SDP max-size and, depending on its length, chunk the message into multiple SEND requests. The message should include the Byte-Range header fields and comply with RFC 4975 and 6135 when sending a SEND request.

q_11780.question: What is the difference between the first digits in the version numbering system used in 3GPP technical specifications?
q_11780.ground_truth: The first digit in the version numbering system used in 3GPP technical specifications represents the level of approval of the document. A "1" indicates that the document is presented to the TSG for information, a "2" indicates that the document is presented to the TSG for approval, and a "3" or greater indicates that the document is TSG approved and under change control.

q_11781.question: Under what condition should an SGSN suspend downlink transmission of LLC-PDUs and what should it wait for?
q_11781.ground_truth: An SGSN should suspend downlink transmission of LLC-PDUs if condition 4) is met. It should then wait for either a cell update from the MS in a new cell or a new RADIO-STATUS PDU from the BSS with a different Radio Cause value.

q_11782.question: What must the BSS indicate in the HANDOVER PERFORMED message if localized service area is supported and the handover occurs to a cell that belongs to one of the LSA identities received in the latest LSA INFORMATION or HANDOVER REQUEST messages?
q_11782.ground_truth: The LSA identity of the target cell

q_11783.question: What is the minimum level of automation for a vehicle to share high resolution perception data and/or detailed planned trajectory with other vehicles or RSUs?
q_11783.ground_truth: The minimum level of automation for a vehicle to share high resolution perception data and/or detailed planned trajectory with other vehicles or RSUs is SAE Level 4 and Level 5.

q_11784.question: What is the role of TEC in the decoder and how many modes does it have?
q_11784.ground_truth: TEC shapes the temporal envelope of the high frequency band and has two modes: no smoothing mode and smoothing mode.

q_11785.question: What are the new SCSs (subcarrier spacing) being introduced for operation in the 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz frequency range?

q_11786.question: What should the BSS do if it has sent a BVC-RESET PDU for a BVCI and receives a BVC-RESET PDU indicating the same BVCI before receiving a BVC-RESET-ACK PDU?
q_11786.ground_truth: The BSS should interpret this as a BVC-RESET ACK PDU and stop the T2 timer.

q_11787.question: What is the purpose of storing the accumulated Session-AMBR and the accumulated MBR per SDFs for all PDU sessions of roamers within a S-NSSAI in V-)UDR?
q_11787.ground_truth: The purpose is to implement a solution for limiting data rate per network slice in UL and DL per UE without RAN involvement.

q_11788.question: Under which conditions should a mobile station be allowed to perform packet access in a cell?
q_11788.ground_truth: A mobile station may perform packet access in a cell if the cell supports GPRS or EC-GSM-IoT, depending on the mobile station's capabilities and the network's support.

q_11789.question: What is one application layer solution for discovering an Edge AS with no impact on 5GC when used with distributed anchor connectivity model?
q_11789.ground_truth: Solution #14 is an application layer solution to discover an Edge AS with no impact on 5GC when used with distributed anchor connectivity model. It is up to the application provider to adopt or not this mechanism if desired.

q_11790.question: What is the term used to describe the maximum value of geometry limited to 17 dB due to the 20 dB front-to-back ratio of the antenna?
q_11790.ground_truth: The term used to describe this concept is a "front-to-back ratio."

q_11791.question: What is the Technical Report 3GPP TS 12.22 containing performance design objectives produced by?

q_11792.question: What should be set as the SDS disposition notification type IE when sending a delivered and read notification?
q_11792.ground_truth: The SDS disposition notification type IE should be set as "DELIVERED AND READ" when sending a delivered and read notification.

q_11793.question: In the overall comparison, which equalization methods performed better than ES202 for all rooms regarding the error metrics defined in 5.3.5.2?
q_11793.ground_truth: The TS103-4.0, TS103-4.1, TS103-8.0 and TS103-HS (in the lower frequency domain) equalization methods performed better than ES202 for all rooms regarding the error metrics defined in 5.3.5.2.

q_11794.question: What is the new parameter included in each NWDAF profile in Option B for analytics ID aggregation?
q_11794.ground_truth: In Option B, the new parameter added to each NWDAF profile within NRF is the AP (Analytics Point) ID.

q_11795.question: What does the @maxWidth and @maxHeight signify in DASH-based signalling?
q_11795.ground_truth: The @maxWidth and @maxHeight signify the maximum width and height of the spatially encoded resolution in DASH-based signalling.

q_11796.question: What should the UE do when it receives a SERVICE ACCEPT message following a SERVICE REQUEST message with "NAS signalling connection release" request type?
q_11796.ground_truth: The UE should enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED after the completion of the Service Request procedure.

q_11797.question: What is the definition of spurious emissions, as it relates to a multicarrier base transceiver station?
q_11797.ground_truth: Spurious emissions for a multicarrier base transceiver station are defined as unmodulated or modulated transmissions outside the relevant transmit band, including contributions from noise, intermodulation, and non-harmonic emissions.

q_11798.question: What is the purpose of the network-assisted positioning provided to USS/UTM in the described solution?
q_11798.ground_truth: The purpose of network-assisted positioning provided to USS/UTM in the described solution is to enable more precise or reliable UAV tracking information and to verify the UAV reported live location information to USS/UTM.

q_11799.question: What are the network provisions for group and broadcast calls?
q_11799.ground_truth: For group and broadcast calls, the network provides a BA list in the SI TYPE 5, 5bis or 5ter message on the SACCH of the channel used for the group or broadcast call, indicating the BCCH carriers of the surrounding cells that MSs engaged in the call should monitor. The cells in the list may belong to different PLMNs.

q_11800.question: In the context of mobile terminating SMS in Active Mode, what modifications are made to the Mobile Terminating SMS in Idle Mode procedure?
q_11800.ground_truth: In the mobile terminating SMS in Active Mode procedure, there is no need for the MME to perform paging of the MS/UE after step 5. The MME immediately sends a Downlink Unitdata to the UE. Also, the MME includes the E-CGI and TAI in step 9d.

q_11801.question: What is the mandatory requirement for 3GPP system to enable UEs to obtain information on a Disaster Condition applying to a PLMN?
q_11801.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall enable UEs to obtain information that a Disaster Condition applies to a particular PLMN or PLMNs.

q_11802.question: What does the Contact Manager Java CardTM based API provide in terms of functionality?
q_11802.ground_truth: The Contact Manager Java CardTM based API provides methods to read, update, create, and delete contacts in the Contact Manager Server, manage groups of contacts, search for contacts in the Contact Manager Server storage, manage the contacts structure, and register/unregister the application to predefined events.

q_11803.question: What message is used to assign packet resources on one or more of the uplink carriers when the ongoing downlink TBF does not need to be modified?
q_11803.ground_truth: A PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message is used for this purpose.

q_11804.question: In which mode(s) shall an MS not search for CPBCCH carriers when it has voice capability or supports packet services?

q_11805.question: What should the RNC2 do if the Information Type Item IE is set to "GANSS Information" and the GANSS Information IE includes "GANSS Real-Time Integrity", and any change has occurred?
q_11805.ground_truth: The RNC2 should initiate the Information Reporting procedure for this specific GANSS Information Item.

q_11806.question: What message does the E-SMLC send to the MME for initiating a location session?
q_11806.ground_truth: The E-SMLC sends a Location Information message to the MME carrying Downlink Positioning Information and a Correlation identifier.

q_11807.question: How does a MS determine whether to ignore a BCC message received in unacknowledged mode?
q_11807.ground_truth: A MS should ignore a BCC message received in unacknowledged mode if the explicitly specified destination mobile identity is not one of its own mobile identities.

q_11808.question: How should alarms be generated by the faulty network entity in a 3GPP system?
q_11808.ground_truth: For each detected fault, appropriate alarms should be generated by the faulty network entity, containing all the information provided by the fault detection process, and regardless of whether it is an ADAC or an ADMC fault. The network entity should generate for each single fault, one single alarm, and additional events related to state management for all the physical/logical resources affected by the fault.

q_11809.question: What is the organization that produced the "Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA) LTE Positioning Protocol (LPP)" technical specification?

q_11810.question: Which transport layer protocol is used to transport LCS-AP messages in the network architecture described in the document?

q_11811.question: What are the IM-SSF preconditions for the normal procedure of responding to the ApplyCharging procedure in CAMEL Phase 4 for IP Multimedia call sessions?
q_11811.ground_truth: The IM-SSF preconditions for the normal procedure of responding to the ApplyCharging procedure in CAMEL Phase 4 for IP Multimedia call sessions are: (1) A control relationship exists between the gsmSCF and the IM-SSF, and (2) The IM-SSF is in one of the following states: "Waiting for Instructions", "Waiting for End of User Interaction", or "Monitoring".

q_11812.question: What kind of signal is used to measure ACS (Adjacent Channel Selectivity) in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_11812.ground_truth: An E-UTRA signal is used to measure ACS in the 3GPP technical specification.

q_11813.question: What is the condition to perform phase matching packet loss concealment processing on the current erased frame?
q_11813.ground_truth: The correlation scale accA is within a predetermined range.

q_11814.question: What does User A want to do after setting up the call A-C?
q_11814.ground_truth: User A wants to shuttle between B and C.

q_11815.question: What information does the "gapCriteria" parameter consist of and what does it identify?
q_11815.ground_truth: The "gapCriteria" parameter consists of basicGapCriteria or compoundGapCriteria and it identifies the criteria for a call to be subject to call gapping based on the called address, service key, or a combination of both.

q_11816.question: What is the purpose of Hybrid ARQ in HS-DSCH and E-DCH?
q_11816.ground_truth: The purpose of Hybrid ARQ in HS-DSCH and E-DCH is to enable the UE to identify the process being used for the transport block that is received and to indicate whether a new data block is transmitted for the first time or a retransmission.

q_11817.question: Which layer handles lower layer failure occurring during the immediate assignment procedure?
q_11817.ground_truth: The failure is handled by the procedure itself.

q_11818.question: What message does the SGSN send to the Serving GW when there is a change in the RAT type for charging purposes?
q_11818.ground_truth: The Modify Bearer Request message is sent by the SGSN to the Serving GW to inform it of the change in RAT type for charging.

q_11819.question: What is the approach taken by solution #30 for RAN initiated 5GC delivery method switch?
q_11819.ground_truth: Solution #30 suggests that when the RAN node detects multiple same MBS session individual delivery, it triggers a mode switch to shared delivery.

q_11820.question: What service collects charging information for MMTel chargeable events in converged charging?
q_11820.ground_truth: A MMTel charging CHF CDR is used to collect charging information related to MMTel chargeable events.

q_11821.question: What is the purpose of the Integrity Protection parameter in the TA-IND primitive?
q_11821.ground_truth: The Integrity Protection parameter in the TA-IND primitive indicates whether the GMM message was integrity protected with a MAC or not.

q_11822.question: In which unit is the sub-frame segmentation performed in 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
q_11822.ground_truth: The sub-frame segmentation is performed between 2nd interleaving unit and physical channel mapping unit when the TTI of the CCTrCh is greater than 5msec in 1.28 Mcps TDD option.

q_11823.question: What is the effect of the provisioned QoS per APN on the aggregate bit rate of all non-GBR bearers of the same APN?
q_11823.ground_truth: The provisioned QoS per APN limits the aggregate bit rate of all Non-GBR bearers of the same APN, i.e. the GBR bearers are outside the scope of QoS per APN.

q_11824.question: What is the root element of the Security Description as defined in Annex C.6?
q_11824.ground_truth: The root element of Security Description is the "securityDescription" element.

q_11825.question: What are the three families of usage scenarios for IMT (International Mobile Telecommunications) for 2020 and beyond defined by ITU-R?
q_11825.ground_truth: The three families of usage scenarios for IMT for 2020 and beyond defined by ITU-R are eMBB (enhanced Mobile BroadBand), mMTC (massive Machine Type Communications), and URLLC (Ultra-Reliable and Low Latency Communications).

q_11826.question: What is the role of the 5GC in quota enforcement for network slices?
q_11826.ground_truth: The 5GC supporting the slice quota enforcement considers the parameter on the priority among services allowed within the slice in the quota enforcement. The priority can be determined by the DNN, ARP, or default 5QI value, and can be provided by UDM, PCF, or the 5GC OAM.

q_11827.question: What is the purpose of the LMPF in real-time AV production for live immersive media?
q_11827.ground_truth: The LMPF is responsible for the media acquisition, production, and distribution for real-time AV production in live immersive media.

q_11828.question: What is the SRVCC handover approach used to avoid unnecessary handovers to 2G/3G CS, and why is it more efficient?
q_11828.ground_truth: The SRVCC handover approach is used to avoid unnecessary handovers to 2G/3G CS by making appropriate information available through Radio Resource Management functions. This ensures reliable VoLTE services, even in weak LTE coverage, by triggering handover only when required, ultimately improving user experience.

q_11829.question: What determines the active Codec Mode in Tandem Free Operation or Transcoder Free Operation?
q_11829.ground_truth: The worst of both radio legs determines the highest allowed Codec Mode in each direction.

q_11830.question: What multicast group address has the IANA assigned for NTP usage for IPv4?

q_11831.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification, such as in 3GPP TS 28.669?
q_11831.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number indicates the level of approval of the document by the TSG, with 1 indicating that it is presented to the TSG for information, 2 indicating that it is presented to the TSG for approval, and 3 or greater indicating that it is a TSG approved document under change control. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates.

q_11832.question: What action is taken by the NAS if the lower layers indicate that access barring is applicable for all access categories except categories 0 and 2 and the access category with which the access attempt was associated is other than 0 and 2?
q_11832.ground_truth: If the REGISTRATION REQUEST message has not been sent, the UE shall proceed as specified for case b. If the REGISTRATION REQUEST message has been sent, the UE shall proceed as specified for case e and, additionally, the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update is started, if still needed, when the lower layers indicate that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated. For additional UE requirements for both cases see subclause~4.5.5.

q_11833.question: What should be done with the UPLINK DIRECT TRANSFER message upon an inter-RAT handover from UTRAN to other RAT than E-UTRAN if the CN domain identity is set to "CS domain"?
q_11833.ground_truth: The NAS message should be retransmitted as specified in subclause 8.3.7.4.

q_11834.question: How does the multi-hop links feature of smart IoE terminals help with environment monitoring?
q_11834.ground_truth: The multi-hop links feature of smart IoE terminals allows real-time monitoring of the environment within 50 meters and improves the capacity of the cell by proximity traffic efficiency, overcoming the limitations of traditional environment monitoring.

q_11835.question: What access type should be used in the PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST message to request multiple TBFs?
q_11835.ground_truth: If the purpose of the packet access procedure is to request multiple TBFs, the mobile station shall indicate 'Two phase access' in the PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST message.

q_11836.question: What is the format of the EnhancedRelocationRequest sequence?
q_11836.ground_truth: The EnhancedRelocationRequest sequence consists of protocolIEs and protocolExtensions, where protocolIEs is a mandatory field and contains a ProtocolIE-Container of EnhancedRelocationRequest-IEs, and protocolExtensions is an optional field that contains a ProtocolExtensionContainer of EnhancedRelocationRequest-Extensions.

q_11837.question: What should the UE do if it receives extended and spare fields in CAG information list IE in REGISTRATION ACCEPT that it does not comprehend?
q_11837.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the contents of these octets and transmit REGISTRATION COMPLETE.

q_11838.question: What is the 3GPP series of technical specifications that define the S1 interface for the interconnection of the evolved NodeB (eNB) component of the Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN) to the Core Network (CN) of the Evolved Packet System (EPS)?

q_11839.question: What is the significance of the correlation number in HI3?
q_11839.ground_truth: The correlation number in HI3 is used to enable the LEMF to correlate the information on HI3. A new correlation number should not be generated within a CONTINUE record to enable this correlation.

q_11840.question: What should the UE do when the uplink data switching has been requested by upper layers, when indicating the data available for transmission to the MAC entity for BSR triggering and Buffer Size calculation?
q_11840.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the data available for transmission excluding the PDCP Control PDU for interspersed ROHC feedback associated with the source cell to the MAC entity associated with the target cell and indicate the data available for transmission of PDCP Control PDU for interspersed ROHC feedback associated with the source cell to the MAC entity associated with the source cell.

q_11841.question: What is the difference between the synchronous and asynchronous modes in the getAlarmList operation?
q_11841.ground_truth: In synchronous mode, the list of AlarmInformation instances is returned synchronously with the operation. In asynchronous mode, the list of AlarmInformation instances is returned via notifications, and a method for aborting an ongoing alarm alignment process is available.

q_11842.question: What is the difference between an InitiatingMessage and a SuccessfulOutcome in the LCS-AP-PDU structure?
q_11842.ground_truth: An InitiatingMessage represents a procedure request sent from the LCS application to the network, while a SuccessfulOutcome represents a successful procedure response sent from the network to the LCS application.

q_11843.question: What is the role of the TR editor in the 3GPP TSG?
q_11843.ground_truth: The TR editor is responsible for introducing all approved TPs in the current Technical Report and ensuring that the TPs related to the band combination have been implemented.

q_11844.question: What is the suggested approach when introducing new RF components in DC of x bands (x=1,2) LTE inter-band CA (xDL/1UL) and 4 bands NR inter-band CA (4DL/1UL)?
q_11844.ground_truth: If new RF components are introduced, more detail description will be captured in some specific EN-DC band combinations.

q_11845.question: What is the role of the SMF in the MBS session procedure?
q_11845.ground_truth: The SMF supports the MBS Session activate or deactivate procedure and retrieves information related to the multicast session from the UDR.

q_11846.question: How does the 3GPP network operators' roaming consortium operate?
q_11846.ground_truth: A roaming consortium is formed by 3GPP network operators through a multi-lateral Composition Agreement. Each operator offers equal terms for roaming towards all other members in the consortium. The multi-lateral CA is updated when new members join or leave the consortium.

q_11847.question: What are some ciphering elements used in enhanced uplink?
q_11847.ground_truth: Some ciphering elements used in enhanced uplink include ciphering mode, ciphering key, ciphering sequence number.

q_11848.question: What is the role of the RAN WG2 in the 3GPP?
q_11848.ground_truth: The RAN WG2 is a working group in the 3GPP that is responsible for identifying and agreeing on the RAN requirements related to the Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBMS).

q_11849.question: What is the minimum send and receive rate for UE-A and UE-B in IMS-A and IMS-B?
q_11849.ground_truth: The minimum send and receive rate for UE-A and UE-B in IMS-A and IMS-B is not defined and is left unknown.

q_11850.question: What is the role of the UTRAN UE Positioning calculating function in determining the position of a UE?
q_11850.ground_truth: The UTRAN UE Positioning calculating function is responsible for estimating the position of a UE and calculating the accuracy of the position estimate. This includes taking into account factors such as geometric dilution of precision, signal measuring hardware capabilities, multipath propagation, timing and synchronization unknowns, and the positioning method used.

q_11851.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in 27.22.14.1.4?
q_11851.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the ME interprets the UICC's response correctly after sending a specific type of DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

q_11852.question: How does the MCVideo system ensure the security of video communications?
q_11852.ground_truth: MCVideo communications are protected by the security mechanisms used for other MCX Services and defined in MCCoRe. MCVideo communications to and from external end points may be security protected and routed through the normal MCVideo system and then forwarded into the required network for onward delivery to the external end point.

q_11853.question: In the scenario described in 6b, under which conditions does the UE initiate the Attach procedure?
q_11853.ground_truth: The UE initiates the Attach procedure when it supports the "handover" request type flag for PDN connectivity request during the attach procedure and has received the indication that interworking without N26 is supported.

q_11854.question: What are the two options for the management of per cause measurement sub-types that may lead to a large number of sub-types?
q_11854.ground_truth: The two options are: supporting all the sub-types corresponding to the cause codes defined in the 3GPP TS that specifies the procedure or event being measured, or supporting only a subset of the causes (allowed only if the cause codes are specified in "other" 3GPP TSs).

q_11855.question: What is the service that restricts the presentation of the terminating party's identity to the originating party?

q_11856.question: What is the resulting block size for P1 puncturing in the DBC-450 code with a PAN and a CPS value of 15?

q_11857.question: What is an IP Addressing Domain in a 3GPP network?
q_11857.ground_truth: An IP Addressing Domain in a 3GPP network is a logically separate IP network that contains different parts of the overall system, and within it, IP packets may be routed from any node to any other node. IP Addressing Domains may have different and possibly overlapping address spaces.

q_11858.question: What is the effect of receiving a SIP 2xx response to a SIP request for a priority group call on the MCPTT emergency group state?
q_11858.ground_truth: If the MCPTT emergency group call state is set to "MEGC 2: emergency-call-requested" or "MEGC 3: emergency-call-granted", receiving a SIP 2xx response to a SIP request for a priority group call sets the emergency group state of the user homed in the IWF of the group to "MEG 2: in-progress" if it was not already set.

q_11859.question: By what percentage is the mean capacity performance decreased for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, with MU-MIMO and 32 TxRU BS antenna when the data-rate is increased from 30Mbps to 45Mbps?
q_11859.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is decreased by about 34.7%.

q_11860.question: What is the state of a call after the retrieval process is completed in the call hold and retrieve procedures?
q_11860.ground_truth: After the retrieval process is completed, the call is in the active and idle state.

q_11861.question: What is the exception that will be thrown in 6.2.9.6.1.2 if the reference to the applet ToolkitRegistry object is not valid?

q_11862.question: What message type should be set in the I1 Refer message when inviting other users to a conference?
q_11862.ground_truth: The message type should be set to indicate that this is an I1 Refer message.

q_11863.question: What is the procedure for modifying the contents of the present document?
q_11863.ground_truth: The contents of the present document can be modified by increasing the version number (e.g. from x.y.z to a.b.c) and re-releasing it by the TSG under change control.

q_11864.question: What is the purpose of the Trace Type attribute in the event of trace record transfer?
q_11864.ground_truth: The Trace Type attribute indicates the type of trace records to be produced and the way in which they will be reported, i.e., each event record being either directly sent to the OSF in real-time, or being collected in a file for later transfer.

q_11865.question: What information is stored by the RNC if the NNSF is active and the Temporary UE Identity IE is not included in the PAGING message?
q_11865.ground_truth: The RNC stores the Permanent NAS UE Identity IE along with the related Global CN-ID IE until the TNNSF timer has expired.

q_11866.question: What is the format of the sessionStart M2AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
q_11866.ground_truth: It is a sequence of INITIATING MESSAGE SessionStartRequest, SUCCESSFUL OUTCOME SessionStartResponse, PROCEDURE CODE id-sessionStart, CRITICALITY reject.

q_11867.question: What should the AS do upon receiving an initial INVITE request in the download and play model?
q_11867.ground_truth: The AS should insert an Alert-Info header field with the URI of the CRS media into the INVITE request and forward it to the terminating UE.

q_11868.question: What does the E2 field in the Extension bit 2 (E2) field indicate?
q_11868.ground_truth: The E2 field indicates whether or not a set of SOstart and SOend follows.

q_11869.question: What is the role of the UDM (User Data Management) in the authorization revocation procedure for Remote UE to use S-NSSAI?
q_11869.ground_truth: The UDM (User Data Management) is responsible for providing the ID of the AMF serving the Remote UE to the NSSAAF (Network Shared Service Container Authorization Function) when authorization revocation is initiated by the AAA-S. The UDM obtains information about the Relay UE and its AMF prior to this step.

q_11870.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of successful radio link additions during active link set update procedure (UE side) for each cell called?
q_11870.ground_truth: The name of the measurement is SHO.SuccRLAddUESide.

q_11871.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for E-UTRA FDD UE Category M2 release 14 and forward in terms of supported measurements for this test to apply?
q_11871.ground_truth: The UE-assisted OTDOA and inter-frequency RSTD measurements are required for this test to apply.

q_11872.question: What is the purpose of the PACKET PSI STATUS message?
q_11872.ground_truth: The PACKET PSI STATUS message indicates the present status of PSI messages stored in or requested but not received by the mobile station, allowing the network to determine which PSI message types the mobile station is able to receive.

q_11873.question: What are the Iupc interface capabilities as defined in the document?
q_11873.ground_truth: The Iupc interface connects a RNC and a SAS, enables exchanging positioning-related information between a RNC and a SAS, and enables an RNC to request specific GNSS (GPS or GANSS) related data from an SAS on demand, on modification, or at regular intervals.

q_11874.question: What is the purpose of the Inventory Management (IM) Network Resource Model (NRM) in telecommunication network management?
q_11874.ground_truth: The Inventory Management (IM) Network Resource Model (NRM) is used to communicate and manage inventory information between an IRPAgent and an IRPManager for telecommunication network management purposes. This includes managing converged networks, and specifying the semantics and behavior of information object class attributes and relations in a protocol and technology neutral way.

q_11875.question: What did RAN4 clarify regarding UE with tx diversity for SRS antenna switching?
q_11875.ground_truth: RAN4 clarified that a UE supporting ULFPTx feature should indicate if it implements tx diversity and meet the 1Tx MOP requirement for at least one antenna connector.

q_11876.question: What is the default value of the APN leaf in the ProSe UE-to-network relay if not provisioned?
q_11876.ground_truth: If the APN leaf is not provisioned, the default APN is used for PDN connectivity.

q_11877.question: What is the format of the "FirstSegment" and "FirstSegment2" sequences?
q_11877.ground_truth: "FirstSegment" and "FirstSegment2" are sequences containing three fields: "sib-Type", "seg-Count", and "sib-Data-fixed".

q_11878.question: What is required for an MPS Service User to request the upgrade of all participants on an ongoing MMTEL voice conference call to MPS using a predetermined method?
q_11878.ground_truth: The 3GPP system needs to support means for an MPS Service User to request the upgrade of all participants on an ongoing MMTEL voice conference call to MPS using a predetermined method.

q_11879.question: Which procedures and messages are required for the BSSAP using SCCP in point-to-point calls?
q_11879.ground_truth: Only those messages and procedures relating to non-replicated subsystems or nodes are required for the BSSAP using SCCP in point-to-point calls. At the BSS, the concerned point will be the parent MSC. The subsystems involved are the BSSAP and (in this case) the MAP.

q_11880.question: What should the HTTP/SIP adapter do upon detection of an MPD update?
q_11880.ground_truth: The HTTP/SIP adapter should send a SIP NOTIFY message to the SCF, containing the updated MPD in the message body.

q_11881.question: What is the step in the procedure that transforms an intermediate unprotected representation into an intermediate protected representation?

q_11882.question: What should the UE do with the measurement results when initiating the measurement reporting procedure for the measId that triggered it?
q_11882.ground_truth: The UE should set the measResults within the MeasurementReport message as specified in the procedure, including the measId, measResultServingCell, servCellId, and measResultNeighCells, as well as the physCellId, layer 3 filtered measured results, and sorting quantity.

q_11883.question: What should the MME verify when receiving the path-switch message from an eNB to prevent bidding down in X2-handovers?
q_11883.ground_truth: The MME should verify that the UE EPS security capabilities received from the eNB are the same as the UE EPS security capabilities that the MME has stored.

q_11884.question: When is a UP IP policy determined to be "not needed" in the context of a legacy UE?
q_11884.ground_truth: If a legacy UE cannot support UP IP but establishes a new PDN connection with an upgraded MME and eNB, the MME and eNB should handle the UE in the legacy way, and the MME should determine a UP IP policy to be set to "not needed".

q_11885.question: What is the benefit of defining redirectionInfo if present in the contents of RRCConnectionReject-r3-IEs and in the r3 Radio Bearer setup complete parameters in LTE and 5G?
q_11885.ground_truth: RedirectionInfo is an IE (Information Element) of the RRC Connection Reject message of LTE and 5G that is related to the E-UTRA (Access Network) used by the terminal for relocation towards a network or group of networks (a network next generation standard towards a target frequency list). The E-UTRA Target Frequency List (eutra-TargetFreqInfoList) is part of the cellDCH information of the BB-container in the serving cell of the LTE and 5G network for which the RRC Connection Setup request is directed.

q_11886.question: What happens if the mobile station receives a PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message while it is waiting for a response to a PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST message?
q_11886.ground_truth: The mobile station shall abort the packet access procedure and respond to the PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message to attempt establishment of an uplink TBF using the procedures defined in sub-clause 8.1.2.5.

q_11887.question: What is the power setting for the midamble transmit power of beacon channels?
q_11887.ground_truth: The midamble transmit power of beacon channels is equal to the reference power.

q_11888.question: What are the supported ways for GCSE Group management creation, modification and deletion functions?
q_11888.ground_truth: The 3GPP System supports GCSE Group management creation, modification and deletion functions, by authorized users and by third parties.

q_11889.question: How is MPS for Voice activated during an NS/EP condition?
q_11889.ground_truth: In most scenarios during an NS/EP condition, MPS for Voice is activated in response to service degradation or when the Service User is aware of network congestion. In limited situations, it is possible to proactively invoke MPS for Voice.

q_11890.question: What is the impact of Communication Forwarding on Not Logged-In (CFNL) on the FA service?
q_11890.ground_truth: CFNL of the FA Pilot Identity takes precedence over CFNL of the individual FA members. If the criteria to invoke the CFNL service is met with respect to an individual call leg (i.e. FA member), the CFNL service should be invoked on behalf of that member.

q_11891.question: What shall a device do upon receiving an Abort message as specified in TS 36.355, clause 5.5.3?
q_11891.ground_truth: A device shall abort any ongoing procedure associated with the transaction ID indicated in the message.

q_11892.question: What is the role of the MSGin5G server in forwarding message delivery reports?
q_11892.ground_truth: The MSGin5G server is responsible for forwarding message delivery reports from the MSGin5G client to the application server.

q_11893.question: When must MCPTT UEs use a de-jitter buffer with an MBMS bearer?
q_11893.ground_truth: MCPTT UEs must use a de-jitter buffer when receiving MCPTT voice traffic on an MBMS bearer and there is variable jitter in the uplink before the traffic is scheduled for transmission on the MBMS bearer.

q_11894.question: What is the purpose of the TNG3 timer in MCPTT group sessions?
q_11894.ground_truth: The TNG3 timer is used to manage the duration of MCPTT group sessions. It is mandatory for pre-arranged groups and optional for chat groups.

q_11895.question: What was the duration of each DTMF digit tested in the AMR codec mode tests?
q_11895.ground_truth: Two different durations were tested for DTMF digits: 50ms and 80ms.

q_11896.question: What are the issues that need to be considered when providing MSGin5G service in a roaming scenario?
q_11896.ground_truth: The issues include: (1) suitability of the options for different roaming scenarios, (2) impact of network architectures on MSGin5G services, (3) network layer support for MSGin5G roaming, (4) fulfillment of network triggering and end-to-end delay in roaming scenario.

q_11897.question: In the 3GPP technical specification, what is the definition of "Primary Absolute Grant" in the context of E-DCH?
q_11897.ground_truth: Primary Absolute Grant is an Absolute Grant received with the primary E-RNTI, which is the only E-RNTI for TDD.

q_11898.question: What does the Geographical-Coordinates field contain?
q_11898.ground_truth: The Geographical-Coordinates field is a coordinate value that contains the latitude, longitude, and optionally the altitude of a location.

q_11899.question: What is the role of the Interconnection Border Control Function (IBCF) in the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) as defined in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
q_11899.ground_truth: The Interconnection Border Control Function (IBCF) is an entry point for the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals. It provides border control capabilities and can act as a single network node entry point, including in cases where border control concepts are to be applied. If these border control concepts are not applied, the I-CSCF is considered as an entry point for the IMS network.

q_11900.question: What are the applicable events for interception of one-to-many communications in ProSe Function and ProSe Key Management Function?
q_11900.ground_truth: The applicable events for interception of one-to-many communications in ProSe Function and ProSe Key Management Function are: ProSe Function sends authorisation to perform one-to-many communications to the target UE, ProSe Key Management Function sends keys to use in one-to-many communications to the target UE, and ProSe Function receives a one-to-many communications usage information report from the target UE.

q_11901.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS UE De-Linking procedure?
q_11901.ground_truth: The MBMS UE De-Linking procedure is performed to unlink a specific UE from a MBMS service, removing its entry from the concerned MBMS service context(s) in the SRNC.

q_11902.question: How are chargeable events and CDRs related in the context of charging management?
q_11902.ground_truth: Chargeable events are telecommunication activities that network operators may charge for, while CDRs are formatted collections of information about a chargeable event recorded for billing purposes. Upon completion of a chargeable event, one or more CDRs are generated to refine charging for all parties involved.

q_11903.question: How does the PCEF handle authorized QoS information provided by the PCRF and predefined PCC rules?
q_11903.ground_truth: The PCEF combines the authorized QoS information provided by the PCRF and predefined PCC rules, and the PCRF takes the predefined PCC rules into account when activating them

q_11904.question: What is regarded as handover in the context of UTRA radio access modes?
q_11904.ground_truth: In the context of UTRA radio access modes, handover occurs when the radio resources providing a service change from one of the UTRA radio access modes to the other.

q_11905.question: What is the purpose of the TP-Loop-Prevention (TP-LP) in the SMPP protocol?
q_11905.ground_truth: The TP-Loop-Prevention is a 1-bit field located within bit no~3 of the first octet of the SMS-Deliver and SMS-Status-Report, which is used to prevent message loops by inhibiting further spawning or off-net forwarding of spawned messages.

q_11906.question: What is the purpose of the Contact Manager API for Java CardTM in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_11906.ground_truth: The Contact Manager API for Java CardTM in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project defines the internal interface characteristics of the Contact Manager for UICC applications, enabling Java CardTM platform-based applets to invoke and register to the Contact Manager Server services.

q_11907.question: What message does the MSC-1 Server send to the adjacent call node when the call is not possible to be locally switched and the Iu Relocation Complete message is received?
q_11907.ground_truth: The MSC-1 Server sends the LCLS-Status-Update message with the LCLS-Status IE indicating the LCLS is disconnected.

q_11908.question: What does the UDH Source Indicator facility do and where is it used?
q_11908.ground_truth: The UDH Source Indicator facility separates the UDH of the original message and provides information about the source of the UDH in the original message. It's used in Status Reports and messages created by the SMSC.

q_11909.question: What are the possible mechanical modes of a device under test (DUT) as declared by the manufacturer?
q_11909.ground_truth: The mechanical modes of a device under test (DUT) are declared by the manufacturer and can include one or more mechanical modes, with at least one mode being declared as the primary. Different mechanical modes can be declared for different user scenarios, such as Browsing mode and Talk mode usage.

q_11910.question: Which Spanish explorer was the first European to sight the Hawaiian Islands in 1778?

q_11911.question: What should happen if an NS-ALIVE-ACK PDU is received when it is not expected in the test procedure for an IP sub-network?
q_11911.ground_truth: The NS-ALIVE-ACK PDU shall be discarded if received when not expected.

q_11912.question: Which TS specifies the UE's behavior for NR frequencies and inter-RAT frequencies that are given in system information and for which the UE has a priority provided?

q_11913.question: What is required from the NG-RAN in the SNPN onboarding process?
q_11913.ground_truth: A new SIB indication informing whether the network supports UEs that do not have 3GPP credentials for the network is required.

q_11914.question: When does the SGSN abort the location procedure in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard?
q_11914.ground_truth: The SGSN aborts the location procedure when the POSITION-COMMAND PDU contains the Multilateration Timer IE and the SGSN determines that it has neither coverage class nor eDRX information available for the target MS in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard.

q_11915.question: What is the purpose of the "Intra-frequency reporting quantity" information for an intra-frequency measurement?
q_11915.ground_truth: The "Intra-frequency reporting quantity" information for an intra-frequency measurement is used to specify the quantity of the measurements and filtering of the measurements to be reported to the UTRAN.

q_11916.question: In the context of this clause, what do the "object class" and "object instance" parameters in the notification header identify?
q_11916.ground_truth: The "object class" and "object instance" parameters identify an instance of the class (or its direct or indirect derived class) defined by the encapsulating clause.

q_11917.question: What actions should a UE take when stopping timers T320, T319, and T305 when performing a cell update or URA update procedure?
q_11917.ground_truth: A UE should stop timer T320, T319, and T305 when performing a cell update or URA update procedure.

q_11918.question: What is the purpose of measuring the data volume at the PDCP SDU level for inter-vendor interoperability?
q_11918.ground_truth: Measuring the data volume at the PDCP SDU level for inter-vendor interoperability ensures standardization and compatibility between different vendors' implementations.

q_11919.question: Which logical channels in EC-GSM-IoT are considered EC-channels?
q_11919.ground_truth: Logical channels supporting operation in extended coverage are referred to as EC-channels

q_11920.question: What must the mobile station do when constructing the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST and ADDITIONAL MS RADIO ACCESS CAPABILITIES messages?
q_11920.ground_truth: The mobile station must ensure that these messages fit in one uplink radio block each when constructing them.

q_11921.question: When would a UE apply the integrity protection algorithm and key provided by upper layers during the PDCP entity re-establishment procedure for SRBs?
q_11921.ground_truth: When upper layers request a PDCP entity re-establishment, the UE shall apply the integrity protection algorithm and key provided by upper layers during the PDCP entity re-establishment procedure for SRBs.

q_11922.question: What function makes sure that the granularity levels required by the reporting keys in the Usage Reporting rules are satisfied without requiring a knowledge of the granularity levels by the UP function?

q_11923.question: How does the number of bits reserved for fine gain quantization affect the bit budget used for spectrum quantization?
q_11923.ground_truth: The number of bits reserved for fine gain quantization reduces the bit budget used for spectrum quantization, which is obtained from subclause 5.3.4.1.3. The available bit budget for spectrum quantization is the bit budget used for the spectrum quantization minus the number of bits reserved for fine gain quantization.

q_11924.question: What should be done if a fallback option was requested after a preactivation but before an activation?
q_11924.ground_truth: The IRPAgent should return internal local resources impacted by the preactivation back to their prior state.

q_11925.question: What is the maximum number of MAC-ehs PDUs per TTI in Dual Cell HSDPA and MIMO mode per cell?
q_11925.ground_truth: The maximum number of MAC-ehs PDUs per TTI in Dual Cell HSDPA and MIMO mode per cell is 8.

q_11926.question: What is the condition for the overall test to pass for single positioning frequency layer in FR1 SA and FR2 SA?
q_11926.ground_truth: For the overall test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each sub-test shall be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%. The UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement period fulfils the requirements specified in clause 15.3.1.3. The test tolerances are defined in clauses C.1.6 and C.2.5.

q_11927.question: What are the delta timers used for in GPRS session and PDP context control?
q_11927.ground_truth: Delta timers measure the response time of the gsmSCF after an Apply Charging Report GPRS information flow and are used for periodic timing and volume counting.

q_11928.question: What should be the behavior of the gprsSSF when there is a PDP Context release or detach initiated by any other entity than a gsmSCF?
q_11928.ground_truth: The gprsSSF shall end a GPRS dialogue with the EntityReleasedGPRS operation if the gprsSSF has no armed DP to report nor pending ApplyChargingReportGPRS which should reported.

q_11929.question: What should a ME do if the AUTN verification is not successful in UMTS AKA?
q_11929.ground_truth: The USIM shall respond with an appropriate error indication to the ME.

q_11930.question: What message is used both in uplink and downlink direction to tunnel GPRS signalling and SMS messages?

q_11931.question: How can NWDAF functional split be required in Rel-16?
q_11931.ground_truth: NWDAF functional split can be required in Rel-16 to study whether NWDAF functionality in TS 23.288 and TS 23.501 can be separated or placed in a different NF/NF Service. This can lead to standard-based services and complete analytics service from the decomposed set of NF/NF Services.

q_11932.question: What are the transmission powers for macrocells and microcells?
q_11932.ground_truth: The transmission power for macrocells is 30 dBm and for microcells is 20 dBm.

q_11933.question: What is the function of the Location System Control Function (LSCF) in the LCS network?
q_11933.ground_truth: The Location System Control Function (LSCF) is responsible for coordinating location requests in the LCS network. It manages call-related and non-call-related positioning requests, allocates network resources for handling them, and interfaces with other components to convey positioning requests, relay positioning data, and pass charging-related data.

q_11934.question: What are the reference points defined in the Proximity-based Services (ProSe) architecture model?
q_11934.ground_truth: The reference points defined in the Prose architecture model are PC1, PC2, PC3, PC4a, PC4b, PC5, PC6, PC7, S6a, and S1-MME. Each reference point serves a different purpose, such as defining application level signalling requirements, defining the interaction between the ProSe Application Server and the ProSe Function, authorizing ProSe Direct Discovery and EPC-level ProSe Discovery requests, and many others.

q_11935.question: What must the HLR do when it receives a notification that the MS has memory capacity available and the MSCEF is set in the HLR?
q_11935.ground_truth: The HLR will not invoke operations to alert the SCs within the MWD and will not clear data from the MWD. After each SC is alerted by the HLR, the address for that SC is deleted from the MWD.

q_11936.question: What are some examples offailure scenarios during the PS handover preparation phase on the Gb interface?
q_11936.ground_truth: Failure scenarios during the PS handover preparation phase on the Gb interface include no resource reservation or allocation, insufficient resource allocation by the target system, the target CSG cell not being allowed for the MS, and generic causes such as context transfer failure or procedure "PS Handover" not supported.

q_11937.question: How much higher is the power spectral density in the interfering region for E-UTRA systems with a narrower bandwidth than 5 MHz, such as 1.6 MHz, compared to a 5 MHz system, if we assume the same output power of an E-UTRA eNodeB?
q_11937.ground_truth: The power spectral density in the interfering region is 5 dB higher for E-UTRA systems with a narrower bandwidth than 5 MHz, such as 1.6 MHz, compared to a 5 MHz system.

q_11938.question: What is the purpose of the infoBinding element in the availabilityInfo element?
q_11938.ground_truth: The infoBinding element in the availabilityInfo element provides additional information about the availability of the MBS Distribution Session within the 5G Network, specifically the service area, mbsFSAId, and radioFrequency.

q_11939.question: What does it mean when bit 5 of the TP-Protocol-Identifier is set to 1?
q_11939.ground_truth: When bit 5 of the TP-Protocol-Identifier is set to 1, it indicates that the SME is a telematic device of a specific type, which is indicated in bits 4..0. In this case, the SC is requested to convert the SM into a form suited for that device type.

q_11940.question: What happens to ongoing voice communication when Assured Voice Communication (AVC) is stopped in FRMCS?
q_11940.ground_truth: The ongoing voice communication continues between the remaining FRMCS Users.

q_11941.question: What entity is responsible for sending the credentials and associated S-NSSAIs or DNNs to the AMF in a 5G system?

q_11942.question: What should the IWF include in the Accept-Contact header field of an outgoing SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT session?
q_11942.ground_truth: The IWF should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters in the Accept-Contact header field.

q_11943.question: What is the purpose of the direction identifier DIRECTION in 3G UMTS network?
q_11943.ground_truth: The direction identifier DIRECTION is used to avoid using identical set of input parameter values for the up-link and down-link messages in 3G UMTS network.

q_11944.question: What action does the source BSS take when it detects no indication of the MS in the target cell during a PS handover?
q_11944.ground_truth: The source BSS sends a PS Handover Cancel (TLLI, Cause = Radio Contact Lost with MS, Source Cell Identifier, Target Cell Identifier) PDU to the old SGSN.

q_11945.question: How are the LP parameters for the low-band and high-band signals analyzed and encoded in the SWB/FB operation of the LP-CNG encoding scheme?
q_11945.ground_truth: In SWB/FB operation, the LP analysis is performed for both low-band and high-band signals separately. The LP parameters for the low-band analysis include low-band excitation energy, low-band signal spectrum, and low-band excitation envelope. The high-band analysis includes only high-band energy. The LP parameters are analyzed and encoded separately for each band.

q_11946.question: What is the design basis for the Notification IRP?
q_11946.ground_truth: The design of the Notification IRP is based on the separation of notification Consumers (IRPManagers) from Producers (IRPAgents), and on the idea that notifications are sent to IRPManagers without the need for them to periodically check for new notifications.

q_11947.question: What is the structure of ResetResourceAcknowledgeIEs within ResetResourceAcknowledge protocol?
q_11947.ground_truth: ResetResourceAcknowledgeIEs is a container that lists all possible protocol messages in the ResetResourceAcknowledge protocol.

q_11948.question: What is the purpose of the PBU message in the Proxy Mobile IPv6 PDN Connection IPv4 address allocation procedure?
q_11948.ground_truth: The PBU message is used by the MAG to request a new IPv4 address for an existing PDN connection from the LMA.

q_11949.question: What should the UE use as a reference time for the data in IE "GANSS reference measurement information" in System Information Block type 15.6?
q_11949.ground_truth: The UE should use IE "GANSS TOD" as a reference time for the data in IE "GANSS reference measurement information" in System Information Block type 15.6.

q_11950.question: How is the shared key securely delivered to the Remote Device?
q_11950.ground_truth: The NAF Key Centre securely delivers the shared key to the Remote Device through a TLS tunnel, which is established between the NAF Key Centre and the Remote Device.

q_11951.question: In which RLC operation mode is the Status parameter applicable?
q_11951.ground_truth: The Status parameter is only applicable for AM (Acknowledged Mode) operation. This parameter indicates whether a RLC SDU is successfully transmitted or discarded.

q_11952.question: What is enabled by the USS/UTM via the UAS NF in the solution for Key Issue #1?
q_11952.ground_truth: The USS/UTM is able to revoke UAV authorization via the UAS NF in the solution for Key Issue #1, which can trigger a corresponding PDU Session release.

q_11953.question: What does the Failure List IE identify in the BC domain?
q_11953.ground_truth: The Failure List IE identifies the list of Service-Area(s) for which the RNC could not complete a requested action.

q_11954.question: Who is responsible for key generation, management, and distribution for MBS traffic security protection?
q_11954.ground_truth: The MBSSF, as a logical function co-located with either the MBSF or the MBSTF, is responsible for key generation, management, and distribution for MBS traffic security protection.

q_11955.question: What is the action the UE should take if it receives an "MBS join is rejected" with Rejection cause set to "User is outside of local MBS service area" in a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message?
q_11955.ground_truth: The UE should not request to join the same multicast MBS session if the current TAI or CGI of the current cell is not part of the received MBS service area.

q_11956.question: What action must the UE take when it receives a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with Rejected NSSAI and the reject cause is "S-NSSAI not available in the current PLMN"?
q_11956.ground_truth: The UE must add the rejected S-NSSAI(s) in the rejected NSSAI for the current PLMN and not attempt to use the Rejected NSSAI in the current PLMN until switching off the UE or the UICC containing the USIM is removed.

q_11957.question: What is the purpose of using carrier RSSI value in arranging GSM cells in signal strength order for BSIC identification?
q_11957.ground_truth: The purpose is to prioritize GSM cells with stronger signals in identifying and re-confirming their BSICs.

q_11958.question: What does the UDM compare the received UPU-MAC-IUE with if the PS requests acknowledgement?
q_11958.ground_truth: The UDM compares the received UPU-MAC-IUE with the expected UPU-XMAC-IUE that the PS stored temporarily.

q_11959.question: Upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message, what action does the UE take regarding the connEstFailReport in VarConnEstFailReport?
q_11959.ground_truth: The UE discards the connEstFailReport from VarConnEstFailReport.

q_11960.question: What is the effect of ignoring an invitation to a voice communication?
q_11960.ground_truth: The invited FRMCS User does not participate in the voice communication.

q_11961.question: What is the data coding scheme and the message coding used in the Cell Broadcast Download?
q_11961.ground_truth: The data coding scheme is not specified, and the message coding is English using the GSM 7-bit default alphabet.
