q_12734.ground_truth: The bits will be consecutively mapped to the first nmax available slots, and the remaining bits are not transmitted.

q_12735.question: What happens to the existing bearer when ALCAP is implemented by Q.AAL2 in step 7.8.1.1 and step 7.8.1.2?
q_12735.ground_truth: When ALCAP is implemented by Q.AAL2, it implies the release of the existing bearer and the establishment of a new one.

q_12736.question: What is the role of the CAA-Level UAV ID in the solution described?
q_12736.ground_truth: The CAA-Level UAV ID is used to tag onto information that the UAV needs to provide as part of Remote Identification and Tracking required for UAS operations. If step 2c is utilized, the EPC will provide the CAA-Level UAV ID to the UAV by EMM Information message after the attach procedure has already completed.

q_12737.question: What criteria are considered for fairness in sampling for data collection in the DCCF/messaging framework?
q_12737.ground_truth: Static criteria where a UE belongs to the same criteria as long as it is served by the NF.

q_12738.question: What security requirements are needed to obtain user authorization in enabling edge applications to access and expose user's sensitive information?
q_12738.ground_truth: The security requirements include enabling a mechanism for Edge Application Servers to obtain user's authorization in order to access and expose the user's sensitive information, as well as clarifying when user's consent is obtained, on what information it is obtained, and providing details on why user's consent is obtained.

q_12739.question: What is the role of the location management server in the primary MC system when requesting location information of an MC service user in the partner MC system?
q_12739.ground_truth: The location management server in the primary MC system sends the location information request to the location management server in the partner MC system.

q_12740.question: What is the main function of the BSSGP protocol in the context of the Gb interface?
q_12740.ground_truth: The main function of the BSSGP protocol is to provide the radio-related, QoS, and routeing information that is required to transmit user data between a BSS and an SGSN.

q_12741.question: Are the algorithms specified in the document mandatory for use as GSM authentication and key generation functions?
q_12741.ground_truth: No, the algorithms specified in the document are not mandatory. The A3 and A8 functions are operator-specifiable and not fully standardized.

q_12742.question: What does the '1' value of the TF bit in the A-Interface Type coding indicate for the Codec Type?
q_12742.ground_truth: TFO Support is selected for this Codec Type.

q_12743.question: What is the average basic audio quality score for 3rd order Ambisonics encoded with HE-AACv2 at 256 kbps, averaged across all test conditions?
q_12743.ground_truth: The average basic audio quality score for 3rd order Ambisonics encoded with HE-AACv2 at 256 kbps, averaged across all test conditions, is within the Fair range (40-60 MUSHRA points).

q_12744.question: What message is sent by the mobile station to the network to indicate that a commanded cell change order has failed?

q_12745.question: What should the terminating BSS do if the Network ID in the GCR is different from its own Network ID in 4.3.2.3?
q_12745.ground_truth: The terminating BSS should only store the GCR for the assigned call leg and not perform call leg correlation.

q_12746.question: What is UE-specific error handling in 3GPP Proximity-Based MIPv6?
q_12746.ground_truth: UE-specific error handling in 3GPP Proximity-Based MIPv6 allows a PMIPv6 node to send a message to the source PMIPv6 node when no binding exists for a packet received from a GRE tunnel. The receiving node may verify that no PMIPv6 binding exists and can discard the packet, then report the error to the peer PMIPv6 node in the form of an ICMP message as specified in IETF RFC2473.

q_12747.question: What is the role of the CGF in the 3GPP PS domain charging architecture?
q_12747.ground_truth: The CGF is responsible for providing non-volatile CDR storage and the Bp interface towards the Billing Domain (BD) in the 3GPP PS domain charging architecture.

q_12748.question: What information does LDNSR provide to SMF in late DNS handling?
q_12748.ground_truth: In late DNS handling, LDNSR provides only the FQDN in the DNS Query and requests notification after any PDU session update.

q_12749.question: What happens if a signalling connection breaks in the connection oriented data transfer service?
q_12749.ground_truth: If the signalling connection breaks, RNSAP shall be notified.

q_12750.question: What is the focus of the technical aspect 1 in the 5G Stage-1 Requirements for 3GPP Conversational Services?
q_12750.ground_truth: The focus of technical aspect 1 is on efficient speech user plane, including efficient user plane routing and achieved media quality per transmitted bit for speech.

q_12751.question: What is the AMF's response if a UE attempts to establish a PDU Session with Control Plane Only Indication over non-3GPP access?
q_12751.ground_truth: The AMF rejects the PDU Session establishment request, as the Control Plane CIoT Optimisation feature is not supported over non-3GPP accesses.

q_12752.question: What does the 1st level NWDAF do when it receives a query for UE related analytics IDs?
q_12752.ground_truth: The 1st level NWDAF requests data for the UE via the DCCF and adds the Analytics IDs and Source NWDAF ID in the response.

q_12753.question: What procedure does the LMA initiate when the PMIPv6 MAG Initiated IPv4 Address Release procedure is triggered to notify the LMA about the release of IPv4 address of UE for a certain PDN connection?
q_12753.ground_truth: The LMA releases an IPv4 Home Address of the UE's PDN connection.

q_12754.question: What is the size of the event area that the 5G system should be able to cover for live content production?
q_12754.ground_truth: The 5G system should be able to cover an event area of up to 10000 m2, both indoor and outdoor.

q_12755.question: Which physical channel does the HS-SCCH consist of in 4.6I.7?
q_12755.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH consists of two physical channels HS-SCCH1 and HS-SCCH2 in 4.6I.7.

q_12756.question: What is theMBMS Service Counting Results Report procedure used for?
q_12756.ground_truth: The MBMS Service Counting Results Report procedure is used for the eNB to provide the counting results to the MCE regarding the number of UEs receiving a specific MBMS service.

q_12757.question: What function does EATF provide while performing the session continuity when the Access Transfer request is indicated by the E-STN-SR?
q_12757.ground_truth: The EATF proceeds with the Access Transfer of the active session with bi-directional speech for the UE by updating the Remote Leg with the media description and other information using the Remote Leg Update procedure.

q_12758.question: What is the purpose of testing the support of text attributes in the SEND USSD test procedure?
q_12758.ground_truth: The purpose of testing the support of text attributes in the SEND USSD test procedure is to verify the display of the alpha identifier and the successful result in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command.

q_12759.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of the technical specification?
q_12759.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number indicates the level of TSG review and approval, while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements or corrections.

q_12760.question: What is the role of the location management server in the partner MC system when replying to an on-demand location information request from the primary MC system?
q_12760.ground_truth: The location management server in the partner MC system replies with a location information report after updating the location information of the target MC service user.

q_12761.question: What is the purpose of the Write-Replace procedure in SABP?
q_12761.ground_truth: The Write-Replace procedure in SABP is used to broadcast new information or replace a message already broadcast to a chosen Service Area(s).

q_12762.question: What kind of physical structure does the HS-DSCH transport channel have in HSDPA?
q_12762.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH transport channel in HSDPA has the following characteristics: it is processed and decoded from one CCTrCH, is associated with one CCTrCH per UE, can be mapped to multiple physical channels, exists only in the downlink, has the possibility to use beam forming, MIMO or four transmit antennas, and can apply link adaptation techniques other than power control.

q_12763.question: When does the SS send the LPP REQUEST LOCATION INFORMATION message in relation to the measurement period?
q_12763.ground_truth: The SS sends the LPP REQUEST LOCATION INFORMATION message T ms before the start of the measurement period, where T = 150 ms.

q_12764.question: What is not possible for a mobile FRMCS User during an ongoing railway emergency alert?
q_12764.ground_truth: A mobile FRMCS User, e.g. a Driver, maintenance staff or a member of a shunting team, is not able to leave or terminate the railway emergency alert.

q_12765.question: What is the modulation format for GMSK in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network GSM/EDGE Modulation?
q_12765.ground_truth: The modulation format for GMSK is a Gaussian Minimum Shift Keying (GMSK) modulation.

q_12766.question: What type of command is being sent in the initial command?
q_12766.ground_truth: The type of command is PROVIDE LOCAL INFORMATION.

q_12767.question: What does the Byte2Bit function do and what are its input and output arguments?
q_12767.ground_truth: The Byte2Bit function converts a byte vector to a bit vector. It takes two input arguments: an array of Ord8 bytes (in), and a length value for the input, and generates an array of Ord1 bit sequence (out) as the output.

q_12768.question: What should the UE do if the SOR information in DL NAS TRANSPORT message fails the security check and it is in manual mode of operation?
q_12768.ground_truth: The UE shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN, with an exception that the current registered PLMN or SNPN is considered as the lowest priority.

q_12769.question: What should the TWAN include in the PBU message for HSS/AAA initiated detach procedures in PMIPv6 mode?
q_12769.ground_truth: The TWAN should include the Access Network Identifier Option IE and the Access Network Identifier Timestamp IE, and shall set its content as specified in subclause 13.1.2 and 12.1.1.24 respectively. Additionally, the TWAN shall include the UE Time Zone IE and shall set its content as specified in subclause 12.1.1.23.

q_12770.question: Which system is interfaced for the travel plan setup of each container in the use case description?
q_12770.ground_truth: The 5G system is interfaced with a Container Tracking Management System for each container's travel plan setup.

q_12771.question: Who can initiate the Automatic Train Operation data communication in FRMCS?
q_12771.ground_truth: The Automatic Train Operation data communication in FRMCS can be initiated by an FRMCS Application that is authorized to initiate the automatic train operation data communication to the trackside control centre.

q_12772.question: What happens if file URLs are provided at a later stage in the pull ingest mode?
q_12772.ground_truth: In the pull ingest mode, file URLs can be provided at a later stage through the Session Update procedure.

q_12773.question: What should the Node B do in FDD if the Bundling Mode Indicator IE for an E-DCH MAC-d flow is set to "Bundling" in the E-DCH MAC-d Flow Specific Information IE in the E-DCH FDD Information IE in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message and the E-TTI IE is set to "2ms"?
q_12773.ground_truth: The Node B shall use the bundling mode for the E-DCH UL data frames for the related MAC-d flow.

q_12774.question: What are the additional requirements for co-existence between 3G and GSM networks?
q_12774.ground_truth: When GSM and UTRA networks are deployed in the same geographic area, the power measured in the conditions specified in subclause 4.2.1 with a filter and video bandwidth of 100 kHz shall be no more than -75 dBm. When GSM and UTRA BS are co-located, the power measured in the conditions specified in subclause 4.2.1 with a filter and video bandwidth of 100 kHz shall be no more than -56 dBm. These requirements should also be applied to BTS built to a hardware specification for R98 or earlier with an 8-PSK capable transceiver installed.

q_12775.question: What action does the MMEo take if the user cannot be identified or the integrity check fails?
q_12775.ground_truth: The MMEo sends a response indicating that the user identity cannot be retrieved.

q_12776.question: What is the measurement provided by the number of octets of outgoing GTP signalling packets on the Gn interface, from SGSN to GGSN?
q_12776.ground_truth: GTP.OutSigOctGnGGSN provides the total number of octets of outgoing GTP signalling packets on the Gn interface, from SGSN to GGSN, regardless of the GTP version used.

q_12777.question: How many fields does the RANAP-PDU ASN.1 definition contain?
q_12777.ground_truth: Five fields are present in RANAP-PDU: initiatingMessage, successfulOutcome, unsuccessfulOutcome, outcome, and ... (the wildcard).

q_12778.question: What information should be available in RNCs before the MBMS session setup in case the used parameter value in a cell depends on received RAB QoS and/or MBMS service area ID and/or TMGI value?
q_12778.ground_truth: Mapping information should be available in RNCs before the MBMS session setup in such a case.

q_12779.question: What does the absence of the APN leaf in the ForServiceBased node mean?
q_12779.ground_truth: If the APN leaf is omitted in the ForServiceBased node, the flow description applies to any APN. Additionally, it overrides flow descriptions of specific APNs whose Rule priority is not higher than the Rule priority of this flow description.

q_12780.question: What is the capability of the IMS system in VR Telepresence?
q_12780.ground_truth: The IMS system shall be able to select media server(s) at appropriate location(s) involved in the session based on the VR capabilities and UE information.

q_12781.question: How is the highest sum of energies determined for multi-channel operation?
q_12781.ground_truth: The highest sum of energies is determined by summing up the denominator from Formula (14) for all channels.

q_12782.question: What is the role of the ATCF (Access Transfer Control Function) in the serving network?
q_12782.ground_truth: The ATCF enables SRVCC Session Transfer mechanisms in the serving network for a UE.

q_12783.question: Which higher layers and MM sub-layer decide when to accept parallel GCC transactions and when/whether to accept GCC transactions in parallel to other CM transactions?
q_12783.ground_truth: Higher layers and the MM sub-layer

q_12784.question: In the user plane paging solution, what is the prerequisite for UE-1 to register with PLMN-1 the IP-2 and provides the security key?
q_12784.ground_truth: PLMN-1 needs to indicate support for paging notification via user plane of the other network.

q_12785.question: How does the collection and delivery of usage information reports affect the use of the ProSe Direct Communication service?
q_12785.ground_truth: The results of the collection and delivery of usage information reports should not affect the UE's use of the ProSe Direct Communication service.

q_12786.question: How many dB SNR gain was observed in source R1-2007954 when the actual number of repetition was doubled for eMBB with the TBS fixed at 136 bits at 10% iBLER for FR1 FDD, compared to Rel-16 PUSCH repetition type A with 8 repetitions?

q_12787.question: What happens when changes occur to the last reported channel description during the location determination process in CS U-TDOA?
q_12787.ground_truth: An updated channel description needs to be sent to the SMLC to avoid errors in the location determination.

q_12788.question: What is the purpose of the TEST REQUIREMENT section in the test cases?
q_12788.ground_truth: The purpose of the TEST REQUIREMENT section in the test cases is to define the expected sequences and test requirements for the test cases.

q_12789.question: What should the UE do with dedicated signalling priorities under what conditions?
q_12789.ground_truth: The UE should delete priorities provided by dedicated signalling when it enters a different RRC state, the optional validity time of dedicated priorities (T320) expires, or a PLMN selection is performed on request by NAS.

q_12791.question: In what scenarios can a UE operate as a UE-to-Network Relay UE?
q_12791.ground_truth: A UE can operate as a UE-to-Network Relay UE when it is served by the network and has the necessary parameters and authorization to do so.

q_12792.question: What is the difference in power scaling between full power TPMI and non-full-power TPMI in Mechanism-2, UE?
q_12792.ground_truth: For full power TPMI, Rel-16 power scaling factor s = 1 is applied, while for non-full-power TPMI, Rel-15 power scaling factor is applied.

q_12793.question: What is the fixed value used to fill the remainder of a message in TTCN, after encoding the message contents, when using encoding rule 4 or 5 for messages sent on the SACCH?
q_12793.ground_truth: The fixed value used to fill the remainder of a message in TTCN, after encoding the message contents, when using encoding rule 4 or 5 for messages sent on the SACCH is "spare padding".

q_12794.question: What is the improvement in peak throughput achieved by using MCS-11 compared to MCS-9?
q_12794.ground_truth: The peak throughput is increased by 38% by using MCS-11.

q_12795.question: What is the function of the Gxx Messages in the Diameter application?
q_12795.ground_truth: The Gxx Messages are carried within the Diameter Application(s) and use existing Diameter command codes from the Diameter base protocol and the Diameter Credit Control Application, with Gxx specific AVPs specified in the Gxx application identifier.

q_12796.question: What is the role of the BID identifier mobility option in inter-access flow mobility when a UE sends a Binding Update message?
q_12796.ground_truth: The BID identifier mobility option is used to identify the routing address used as the IP Source Address of the Binding Update message.

q_12797.question: What is the role of the complementary window in the ALDO window implementation?
q_12797.ground_truth: The complementary window is used to ensure perfect reconstruction of the signal at 32 kHz, which is a special case due to the non-integer ratio between 48 and 32 kHz.

q_12798.question: What does EVS-CMR stand for in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_12798.ground_truth: EVS-CMR stands for Codec Mode Request for EVS in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification.

q_12799.question: What is the role of the Home Service Provider (Home SP) in the solution for Visited-SNPN access?
q_12799.ground_truth: The Home SP is responsible for authenticating the UE and providing access to the V-SNPN's services using a local breakout scenario or access to Home SP services using a home-routed PDU session.

q_12800.question: How does the SAS send a PCAP message to the Receiving HNB if a connection oriented data transfer service is already established for a location session?
q_12800.ground_truth: The SAS sends the PCAP PDU to the HNB-GW within an SCCP message, and the HNB-GW routes the PCAP PDU to the correct HNB.

q_12801.question: Which reference points are used for enabling MSGin5G message exchange between different components of MSGin5G service?
q_12801.ground_truth: MSGin5G-1, MSGin5G-2, MSGin5G-3, MSGin5G-4, MSGin5G-5, MSGin5G-6 are used for enabling MSGin5G message exchange between different components.

q_12802.question: In the context of HS-DSCH, what should the DRNC do if the HS-DSCH Information IE is present in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
q_12802.ground_truth: The DRNS shall setup the requested HS-PDSCH resources on the Serving HS-DSCH Radio Link indicated by the HS-PDSCH RL ID IE.

q_12803.question: Which reference point allows interaction between an Application Server and an MRFC for media control?
q_12803.ground_truth: The Cr reference point allows interaction between an Application Server and an MRFC for media control.

q_12804.question: What action does the MAC entity take when the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL expires?
q_12804.ground_truth: The MAC entity starts the drx-RetransmissionTimerUL for the corresponding HARQ process.

q_12805.question: What is the maximum wanted air user rate?
q_12805.ground_truth: The maximum wanted air user rate is 28 800 or 14 400 bit/s.

q_12806.question: What should the user-plane resources on non-3GPP access be released when the UE receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND with Access type IE as "Non-3GPP access" while in PDU SESSION ACTIVE state with user-plane resources established on both 3GPP and non-3GPP access?
q_12806.ground_truth: The user-plane resources on non-3GPP access should be released.

q_12807.question: What is the Telecommunication Management (TM) of 3G systems?
q_12807.ground_truth: Telecommunication Management (TM) of 3G systems is a set of principles and specifications for managing 3G networks, including the interfaces between the managing system (manager) and the managed system (agent).

q_12808.question: What is the responsibility of the UE regarding local DN notification control?
q_12808.ground_truth: The UE supports to handle the local DN notification control (such as refresh/maintain DNS cache information related with the local DN or remove/maintain Layer 4 context related with local DN) if it received by the SMF.

q_12809.question: What parameter in the Discovery Request message indicates the length of validity timer associated with the ProSe Restricted Code that the UE expects to receive?

q_12810.question: What is the purpose of secondary authentication for a Layer 3 Remote UE?
q_12810.ground_truth: Secondary authentication for a Layer 3 Remote UE is used to ensure the security of the network when a UE connects to an application server via UE-to-Network Relay.

q_12811.question: What is the range of the index for a subframe with non-zero PHICH resources?
q_12811.ground_truth: The range of the index for a subframe with non-zero PHICH resources is from 0 to 14.

q_12812.question: When is the Measurement not available reported in the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT REPORT message?
q_12812.ground_truth: When the achieved measurement accuracy does not fulfill the given accuracy requirement or the measurement is temporarily not available in case Measurement Recovery Behavior is supported.

q_12813.question: What is the maximum coupling loss (MaxCL) target value for a basic MBB service with a downlink datarate of 2Mbps and an uplink datarate of 60kbps for stationary users?
q_12813.ground_truth: The maximum coupling loss (MaxCL) target value for a basic MBB service with a downlink datarate of 2Mbps and an uplink datarate of 60kbps for stationary users is 140dB.

q_12814.question: What existing features are not related to the relay feature but cover the use case functionality of asset tracking in the 5G system?
q_12814.ground_truth: The existing features that cover the use case functionality of asset tracking in the 5G system can be found in TR 22.836.

q_12815.question: What is the field mapping convention for EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT RLC data blocks and MCS-0 encoded RLC/MAC control blocks?
q_12815.ground_truth: For EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT RLC data blocks, when a field within a block is contained within a single octet, the lowest numbered bit of the field represents the lowest order value. When a field spans more than one octet of the physical block, the order of bit values within each octet progressively increases as the octet number increases. For MCS-0 encoded RLC/MAC control blocks, the order of bit values within each octet also progressively increases as the octet number increases.

q_12816.question: Which type of CP (cyclic prefix) in an OFDM communication system, based on the existing Rel-15 NR PTRS structure, was reported to have a minor performance difference between different SCS values up to 960 kHz for low and medium MCS (QPSK and 16QAM) in a large delay spread (i.e. 40 ns in TDL-A and/or 50 ns in CDL) when compared on the basis of equal TBS (equal throughput) for 10% BLER target?

q_12817.question: When is a DTM capable mobile station required to perform a Cell Update procedure in 3GPP GERAN?
q_12817.ground_truth: A DTM capable mobile station in GMM READY state is required to perform a Cell Update procedure when it enters dedicated mode from packet idle mode in a cell that supports dual transfer mode.

q_12818.question: What is the role of the FLUS source and the FLUS sink in the architecture of uplink streaming for MTSI?
q_12818.ground_truth: The FLUS source and the FLUS sink are responsible for media sourcing and sinking, respectively. In the context of MTSI, the FLUS source is instantiated as the MTSI tx client function, while the FLUS sink can be an MTSI rx client or another UE in the network.

q_12819.question: What is a key aspect for achieving a dynamic and automated operation of Network Composition?
q_12819.ground_truth: Policies are a key aspect for achieving a dynamic and automated operation of Network Composition.

q_12820.question: What does the Transport Format Combination indicate in the context of E-DCH?
q_12820.ground_truth: The Transport Format Combination indicates an authorized combination of valid Transport Formats that can be submitted simultaneously to L1 for transmission on a Coded Composite Transport Channel.

q_12821.question: What is the requirement for the on-demand PC5 one-to-one communication policies in the ProSe discovery procedure?
q_12821.ground_truth: Security flexibility is provided by introducing on-demand PC5 one-to-one communication policies, and the policy mismatch during one-to-one communication establishment can avoid connection failure caused by policy conflict. This contribution checks the policy match in advance with the help of the ProSe discovery procedures.

q_12822.question: What is the purpose of the Ga interface in the 3GPP PS domain charging architecture?
q_12822.ground_truth: The Ga interface is used for the CDF to forward CDRs to the CGF when the CGF is external to the PCN.

q_12823.question: What feature is not supported by the IWF in section 11.2 and 11.3?
q_12823.ground_truth: File distribution is not supported by the IWF in sections 11.2 and 11.3.

q_12824.question: What is the dialled number for record 7?
q_12824.ground_truth: The dialled number for record 7 is "007".

q_12825.question: What is the impact of including the MC UE identity in the location report in Solution 11.2.1?
q_12825.ground_truth: The size of messages will increase, which may decrease efficiency. A mechanism to query the association of MC UE ID to a MC service user may also be necessary.

q_12826.question: What mechanism is utilized by the UE for establishing a secure channel between the eUICC and the eUICC platform in the eSIM based UE onboarding procedure?
q_12826.ground_truth: The Bearer Independent Protocol (BIP) required in GSMA eSIM solution is used over the established PDU Session to receive the information from the eUICC platform. The underlying protocol used for BIP is TCP/IP, which is one of the options for M2M device communication as specified in GSMA GSMA SGP.21 and GSMA SGP.22.

q_12827.question: What message is sent as soon as conditions for establishment are met to indicate that the VGCS is established with the related group call reference as the connected number?

q_12828.question: What should the SRNC do when it receives a request for assistance data from a UE positioning procedure that uses A-GNSS?
q_12828.ground_truth: The SRNC should indicate this to the SAS by sending a Position Activation Response message. The Position Activation Response message shall include the assistance data types requested by the UE.

q_12829.question: What message is sent by MSC-B to MSC-A in the MAP-PREPARE-HANDOVER response to indicate support for A interface over IP for speech calls via BSS-B?
q_12829.ground_truth: AoIP-Selected Codec (Target) and AoIP-Available Codecs List (MAP)

q_12830.question: How does the network initiate the identification procedure to request specific identification parameters?
q_12830.ground_truth: The network initiates the identification procedure by sending an IDENTITY REQUEST message to the UE and starting timer T3570. The IDENTITY REQUEST message specifies the requested identification parameters in the Identity type information element, and the UE is expected to respond to the message at any time while in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

q_12831.question: What is the role of the RF in the described scenario?
q_12831.ground_truth: The RF retrieves the appropriate tariff to be applied for the bearer/session and returns the tariff information to the SBCF.

q_12832.question: What is the role of the MBMS client in the storage of received files?
q_12832.ground_truth: The MBMS client moves received files to the application space, but the application is responsible for managing the storage of requested files.

q_12833.question: What are the four aspects of the system modification concept and what is their impact on the network?
q_12833.ground_truth: The four aspects of the system modification concept include clearing the network elements from traffic, performing the necessary modifications, distributing the new data to the affected network elements, and putting the network elements back into traffic. These aspects aim to ensure data integrity, system data consistency, and minimization of network disruption during the modification process.

q_12834.question: What are the 3GPP system requirements for supporting media encryption for an active MPS for DTS session?

q_12835.question: What is the role of the multiplexing function for the TCH/F43.2 channel in the 3GPP TS 48.020 standard?
q_12835.ground_truth: The multiplexing function maps/extracts three 14.5 kbit/s substreams into/from a 43.5 kbit/s radio interface channel for TCH/F43.2 in the 3GPP TS 48.020 standard. In uplink, the multiplexing function maps one 290-bit block from each substream into every 870-bit TCH/F43.2 radio interface data block. In downlink, the multiplexing function demultiplexes the three substreams by extracting the 290-bit blocks from the received 870-bit radio interface blocks.

q_12836.question: What should the UE do if the IE "UE positioning GPS reference time" and "UE positioning GPS reference UE position" are included in the MEASUREMENT CONTROL message and the UE was able to calculate a position?
q_12836.ground_truth: The UE should include IE "UE positioning Position Estimate Info" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT with the calculated position.

q_12837.question: What conditions can users set for message filtering?
q_12837.ground_truth: Users can set certain conditions for message filtering, for example, based on the time or certain words in the message.

q_12838.question: What is the meaning of the informationToSend parameter?
q_12838.ground_truth: The informationToSend parameter is used to indicate the information to be sent, which can be either in-band information or a tone.

q_12839.question: What is the target set by UTRAN for the quality of the uplink?
q_12839.ground_truth: The SIR target value, which shall not be increased before the power control has converged on the current value.

q_12840.question: What action does the MRFC take when it receives an SDP offer with an "a=rtcp-fb" line for Arbitrary ROI and determines to accept the offer?
q_12840.ground_truth: The MRFC includes "a=rtcp-fb" lines related to the "3gpp-roi-arbitrary" parameter in the SDP answer that will be sent within the SIP signalling.

q_12841.question: What action must the new SGSN take if the old P-TMSI is not known?
q_12841.ground_truth: If the new SGSN does not know the old P-TMSI, it will send an Identification Request to the old SGSN or the old MME to request the IMSI.

q_12842.question: What does AMR-NS stand for in the document, and what is its intended application?
q_12842.ground_truth: AMR-NS stands for Adaptive Multi-Rate Noise Suppression. It is an optional feature designed to enhance speech quality in a range of environments where there is significant background noise. The AMR-NS is a preprocessing module used to improve the signal to noise ratio of a speech signal prior to voice coding.

q_12843.question: What happens when the SCC AS receives a new IMS registration for the UE for which the SCC AS just delivered a session?
q_12843.ground_truth: In this case, the S-CSCF releases the current terminating session setup toward SCC AS/T-ADS, and T-ADS redirects the session to the new MSC.

q_12844.question: What should be applied if the RLC PDU size is set to "flexible size" and no uplink RLC PDU is currently set in the RLC entity for a signalling radio bearer?

q_12845.question: What are the possible solutions for resource consumption optimization in 6.5.1.3.1?
q_12845.ground_truth: The possible solutions for resource consumption optimization in 6.5.1.3.1 include analyzing current and predictive resource consumption to decide if the target gNB is optimal for handover or not. The MDAS producer can correlate and analyze ongoing and potential handover optimization issues based on historical performance data as well as network load, E2E latency, retainability, radio conditions, UE measurements including MDT, location, and QoE for the network or network slices.

q_12846.question: What is the purpose of the one byte CA-ID field in the implicit certificate approach?
q_12846.ground_truth: The purpose of the one byte CA-ID field is to distinguish which public key is used for the message signer's public key in the implicit certificate approach.

q_12847.question: What is the role of the AS in the CUG service communication setup?
q_12847.ground_truth: The AS is responsible for checking the validity of the CUG service requests, performing validation checks based on the access capabilities contained in the user profile, and forwarding the INVITE request towards the terminating network with the appropriate CUG parameters.

q_12848.question: What is the role of Solution 13 in handling a UE's location awareness?
q_12848.ground_truth: Solution 13 allows the UE to use its knowledge of its location to select among the PLMNs of the country in which it is currently located. It also triggers the UE to change PLMN when it changes country. Additionally, if the UE is not aware of its location within a certain country, Solution 13 allows the network (5GCN or NG-RAN) to enforce the UE's registration to PLMNs of the country of the UE's location.

q_12849.question: In what scenarios does packet switched handover occur?
q_12849.ground_truth: Packet switched handover occurs between a source cell and a target cell, which can be located within the same BSS (Intra BSS HO), different BSSs within the same SGSN (Intra SGSN HO), or belonging to different SGSNs (Inter SGSN HO), or systems with different radio access types (Inter RAT HO, Inter mode HO). Additionally, PS handover may occur between a GAN cell and a GERAN A/Gb mode cell, or between a GAN cell and a UTRAN cell.

q_12850.question: What action does MSB take when it detects a page?
q_12850.ground_truth: MSB sends a channel request to BSSB, which responds with an immediate assignment command. MSB then sends a page response on the signalling channel, which BSSB relays to VMSCB.

q_12851.question: What is a possible alternative to the completely distributed UC approach for identifying and scoring UC measures in IMS-to-IMS calls?
q_12851.ground_truth: One potential alternative is a distributed, but centralized per operator approach, with UC functionality located in an application server communicating with all S-CSCFs, and other IMS functional entities not being UC-aware.

q_12852.question: What should 5GC entities support for traffic influenced routing as specified in TS 23.501 clause 5.6.7?
q_12852.ground_truth: AF, NEF, UDR, and PCF should support traffic influenced routing.

q_12853.question: What is the impact on the AMF in Solution #8?
q_12853.ground_truth: The AMF of PLMN A is impacted by managing the stored "disaster roaming PLMN and area list" upon reception of the same from the CBC (via the PWS-IWF) or the CBCF.

q_12854.question: What is the difference between UE behaviour in CM IDLE state with and without location tracking?
q_12854.ground_truth: If location tracking is not needed, a UE can access any radio cell supporting an allowed TA for the serving PLMN. If location tracking is required, a location-capable UE periodically checks its location and verifies presence in an allowed TA, and performs new registration when not inside an allowed TA or cannot find a supporting radio cell.

q_12855.question: What is the step where the IMS-AGW uses the "Reserve AGW Connection Point" procedure to request a termination for "TCP/TLS" media towards the access network in the IMS terminating session set-up procedures for one MSRP media stream using e2ae security?

q_12856.question: What is the function of the TrFO Break Function during a TrFO Break?
q_12856.ground_truth: The TrFO Break Function makes use of the stored RFCI values to perform the required Iu Framing protocol functions and interpret the payload during a TrFO Break.

q_12857.question: What is the difference between Blind Transfer and Consultative Transfer in IMS?
q_12857.ground_truth: Blind Transfer is a service procedure in IMS where a session exists between A-B and B initiates transfer A to C without consulting A first. Consultative Transfer is a service procedure in IMS where a session exists between A-B and B initiates transfer A to C by consulting A first.

q_12858.question: What is the frequency range that corresponds to the strongest third order intermodulation interference signal at the LNA input?
q_12858.ground_truth: The frequency range is 2685 MHz - 2790 MHz.

q_12859.question: What is the PLMN code used for in the ProSe Direct Services Provisioning MO?
q_12859.ground_truth: The PLMN code is used to indicate the PLMN code of the operator in which the UE is authorized to use ProSe direct discovery.

q_12860.question: What does the least significant bit of the Shared Network Area Code (SNAC) represent?
q_12860.ground_truth: The least significant bit of the Shared Network Area Code (SNAC) is octet 2 bit 1.

q_12861.question: What network interface is defined between the Prose Function and the HSS in 3GPP TS 23.303?

q_12862.question: What are the two types of applications for distributing 360 A/V content library in 3GPP?
q_12862.ground_truth: The two types of applications for distributing 360 A/V content library in 3GPP are primarily viewing with an HMD with head motion tracking, and secondarily viewing on a screen with the field-of-view adjusted by manual interaction.

q_12863.question: What is the primary objective of the logic of the solution in sorting the S-NSSAIs in priority order?
q_12863.ground_truth: The primary objective of the logic of the solution is to ensure that the UE gets the network slices it prioritizes, at least the highest priority slice.

q_12864.question: On which primary frequency is the DwPCH transmitted in a multi-frequency cell?
q_12864.ground_truth: The DwPCH is transmitted only on the primary frequency in a multi-frequency cell.

q_12865.question: What are some possible scenarios for deploying small cell BSs in urban areas?
q_12865.ground_truth: Some possible scenarios include above-rooftop backhaul in urban areas and street canyon scenarios where small cell BSs are placed at lamp posts.

q_12866.question: Which parameter is used for prioritization at ATM level in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_12866.ground_truth: The Path Type (PT) parameter is used for prioritization at ATM level in the 3GPP Technical Specification.

q_12867.question: What were the specific bandwidth modes used in the speech quality test methodology in the technical report?
q_12867.ground_truth: The specific bandwidth modes used in the speech quality test methodology were narrowband (NB) and wideband (WB) telephonometry.

q_12868.question: When should the entering condition for event A3 be considered satisfied?
q_12868.ground_truth: The entering condition for event A3 is considered satisfied when the condition A3-1 (Mn + Ofn + Ocn > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off) is fulfilled.

q_12869.question: In Cell Merging process in AAS, what is the MT-Cell assigned in general?
q_12869.ground_truth: The MT-Cell (Merge Target cell) is normally assigned with a new ECGI (physical cell identity) when cells are merged by AAS into one cell, but it may inherit the PCI (Physical Layer Cell Identity) from one of its MO-cells(Merge Origin cell) in the view of other cells.

q_12870.question: What does the Effective Frequency Load (EFL) represent in the context of mixed frequency reuse?
q_12870.ground_truth: The EFL represents the supported traffic in Erl as determined by simulation, divided by the product of the total number of frequencies (TCH and BCCH layers) and the average number of available full rate channels or time slots per TRX.

q_12871.question: How does the client algorithm based on buffer fill level determine the media rate?
q_12871.ground_truth: The client algorithm based on buffer fill level determines the media rate by gradually increasing it with the increase of buffer fullness, selecting the lowest media quality when the buffer fullness is 30% or lower, and the highest media rate when the buffer fullness is 80% or higher.

q_12872.question: What should the UE do when it needs to initiate an access attempt and the MPS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE is not set to "Access identity 1 valid in RPLMN or equivalent PLMN" in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
q_12872.ground_truth: The UE should not consider access identity 1 to be valid in this case.

q_12873.question: What is the recommended approach to the current BS OTA TAE requirements in clause 9.6.3 of TS 38.104?
q_12873.ground_truth: It is recommended to consider improvements to TAE requirements as the current requirement has been in place since UMTS, and the performance has improved in the past 20 years.

q_12874.question: How can a network operator deal with UC generated unintentionally by the user or a UC generating virus outside the MNO network?
q_12874.ground_truth: By providing security updates to devices sending UC and identifying UC through complaint calls to customer service centers.

q_12875.question: What is the impact of Delivery of erroneous SDUs being set to 'Yes' on UMTS bearer level and Radio Access Bearer level?
q_12875.ground_truth: If Delivery of erroneous SDUs is set to 'Yes' on UMTS bearer level, error indications can only be provided on the MT/TE side of the UMTS bearer. On the CN Gateway side, error indications can not be signalled outside of UMTS network in release 1999. Error indications can be provided on both end-points of the Radio Access Bearer.

q_12876.question: What is the purpose of the trackside maintenance warning system in the FRMCS system?
q_12876.ground_truth: The trackside maintenance warning system in the FRMCS system allows for ongoing data communication between various users, which can be terminated under specific conditions.

q_12877.question: What is the average overlap of PSNR ranges in Scenario 1 for AV1 and H.264/AVC?
q_12877.ground_truth: The average overlap of PSNR ranges in Scenario 1 for AV1 and H.264/AVC is 53%.

q_12878.question: What is the streaming protocol used by SCTP in the Xn-C signalling bearer in the NG-RAN?
q_12878.ground_truth: SCTP is used as the transport layer of the Xn-C signalling bearer, and supports two payload protocol identifiers (ppid) of 61 and 67 for XnAP and DTLS over SCTP, respectively. The byte order of the ppid is big-endian.

q_12879.question: What happens when a mobile phone is infected with a virus, in terms of network traffic and user charges?
q_12879.ground_truth: The infected mobile phone will distribute large quantities of junk data through SPIM/SPIT continuously to the telecommunication network, resulting in network traffic jam and additional charges to the user's account.

q_12880.question: How can a network de-personalisation process be initiated on a ME?
q_12880.ground_truth: A network de-personalisation process can be initiated by entering the correct NCK into the ME, and if a SIM/USIM is inserted, de-personalisation is offered regardless of the network personalisation check result. Alternatively, a network initiated process can be used where the control key is sent to the MS over-the-air.

q_12881.question: What is the effect of the RRBP allocation on one carrier colliding with a USF allocation on another carrier in EGPRS?
q_12881.ground_truth: This results in the same uplink block being granted on more than one carrier at the same time, which is defined as a conflict. The MS shall respond in one of them based on the priorities defined in 3GPP TS 44.060.

q_12882.question: What information is mandatory for the PCEF to include in the authorization request to the PCRF for IP-CAN Bearer establishment?
q_12882.ground_truth: The PCEF must include UE Identity, PDN identifier, IP-CAN type, IPv4 address and IPv6 network prefix (if available), PDN Connection Identifier, default charging method, and IP-CAN bearer establishment modes supported. It may also include the TDF IP address and information on whether PCEF is enhanced with ADC.

q_12883.question: In the provided code, what is the presence of "Heartbeat-Interval" in the "ServingCellInfo-FDD-v920"?
q_12883.ground_truth: The presence of "Heartbeat-Interval" in the "ServingCellInfo-FDD-v920" is optional.

q_12884.question: What is the function of an NGN in case of a public network traffic emergency call?
q_12884.ground_truth: An NGN forwards geographical location information received from an NGCN and possibly uses it for routing to an appropriate PSAP if it's a public network traffic emergency call.

q_12885.question: What is the blocking signal power level at the NB-IoT BS receiver with 23dBm interfering LTE UE and 31dBm interfering HPUE?
q_12885.ground_truth: The 99.99%-tile received blocking signal power levels are around -56dBm and -48dBm, respectively, with 23dBm interfering LTE UE and 31dBm interfering HPUE.

q_12886.question: What is the definition of a "chargeable event" in the context of 3GPP charging management?
q_12886.ground_truth: A "chargeable event" is an activity that utilizes telecommunication network resources and related services, for which the network operator may want to charge. It characterizes the resource/service usage and indicates the identity of the involved end user(s).

q_12887.question: What is the resulting action when the priority in the UPLINK REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message is greater than the current talker priority?
q_12887.ground_truth: When the priority in the UPLINK REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message is greater than the current talker priority, the BSS updates the current talker priority and releases the uplink for an MS being pre-empted if it is served by this BSS.

q_12888.question: What message does the IWF2 send to the HSS in the last step of the "Notification" procedure in a two IWFs scenario?
q_12888.ground_truth: The IWF2 sends NOA to the HSS in the last step of the "Notification" procedure in a two IWFs scenario.

q_12889.question: What is the purpose of the RSVP/IntServ Function in the UE?
q_12889.ground_truth: The RSVP/IntServ Function in the UE allows the device to request end-to-end QoS using RSVP messages and trigger PDP context activation/modification.

q_12890.question: What is the method to calculate the sum of all observed packet sizes for IPv6 packets in the EPS bearer packet flow?
q_12890.ground_truth: The sum of all observed packet sizes for IPv6 packets is the sum of the values contained in the Payload Length field for each packet as specified in IETF RFC 2460.

q_12891.question: What does the AN-GW-Status AVP indicate in the IKEv2 tunnel when a NAT is detected?
q_12891.ground_truth: The AN-GW-Status AVP indicates the status of the SGW and is sent from the PCEF to the PCRF.

q_12892.question: What is the difference between GPRS-Attach and GPRS-Detach?
q_12892.ground_truth: GPRS-Attach is the process of indicating the UE's presence to the PLMN for the purpose of using GPRS services, while GPRS-Detach is the process of indicating to the PLMN that the UE will no longer be using the GPRS services.

q_12893.question: In what scenario should a UE initiate the downlink direct transfer procedure in the UTRAN?
q_12893.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the downlink direct transfer procedure in the UTRAN when the upper layers request the transfer of a NAS message after the initial signalling connection is established, or when another RRC procedure is ongoing, and the state of the latter procedure should not be affected.

q_12894.question: What is the maximum run time requirement for the Tuak algorithm's functions?
q_12894.ground_truth: The maximum run time for the Tuak functions is 500 ms total execution time, implemented on a midrange microprocessor IC card with specific resource constraints.

q_12895.question: When interworking with networks which do not support CCBS, what is the action taken when the CCBS service may fail?
q_12895.ground_truth: The CCBS service may fail in such situations, and the network needs to be able to interwork through networks which do not support CCBS.

q_12896.question: What is the purpose of the Original Dialog Identifier (ODI) added by the Transit Function?
q_12896.ground_truth: The ODI is added by the Transit Function to allow it to identify the message on the incoming side, even if its dialog identification has been changed by the Application Server.

q_12897.question: What does the RL Set ID uniquely identify within a UE Context?

q_12898.question: When must the MS set the "Follow On Request" during an Emergency Attach?
q_12898.ground_truth: The MS must set the "Follow On Request" during an Emergency Attach if there is pending uplink traffic and it initiates the activation of an emergency PDP context after a successful Emergency Attach.

q_12899.question: What is the role of the Home SP Group Value in the Home SP Group Identity?
q_12899.ground_truth: The Home SP Group Value in the Home SP Group Identity can be based on IANA Private Enterprise Numbers and can be assigned using either Self-managed or Globally Managed mode, which supports both locally managed and globally managed assignments.

q_12900.question: What is the feature called that allows the exchange of new SOR-related information between the HPLMN UDM and the UE in a secure manner?
q_12900.ground_truth: This feature is called the "Secure Operations of Roaming with Centralized Manifest Cache Invocation" (SOR-CMCI).

q_12901.question: What is the effect of an MBR>GBR bearer compared to an MBR=GBR bearer in terms of bitrate adaptation?
q_12901.ground_truth: With an MBR>GBR bearer, the adaptation tries to maintain a bitrate in-between these values in most cases, while for an MBR=GBR bearer, the client is expected to use bitrates below GBR whenever adaptation is triggered.

q_12902.question: What information is retrieved by the application client in the UE and provided to the ProSe Application Server in step 0?
q_12902.ground_truth: The PDUID (ProSe Device Unique Identifier) is retrieved by the application client in the UE and provided to the ProSe Application Server in step 0.

q_12903.question: What system information combination is used in NR cells as defined in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.4.3.1.3?

q_12904.question: What types of cells does the UE distinguish in terms of measurement procedures?
q_12904.ground_truth: The UE distinguishes the following types of cells: the NR serving cell(s), listed cells, and detected cells.

q_12905.question: What is the section of the document that discusses the REFSENS requirements for the band combination of n1 and n20?

q_12906.question: What is the reason for the existence of empty default ACL in SMF associated with a PDU Session for C2?
q_12906.ground_truth: The default ACL is empty, indicating that no communication can occur on a PDU session for C2 until the USS/UTM has authorized an IP address in the ACL, ensuring that communication remains restricted to authorized IP addresses for the assigned PDU session.

q_12907.question: What should the uplink DPCCH transmission do if the post-verification fails in the initial scenario specified in 5.1.2.2.1.1?
q_12907.ground_truth: If the post-verification fails, the UE shall not transmit on the activated uplink frequency until higher layers consider the downlink physical channel established.

q_12908.question: What is the purpose of the QUIC-LL Control Information in Solution #1?
q_12908.ground_truth: The purpose of the QUIC-LL Control Information is to indicate to the UPF how many QUIC connections are needed per access, which is determined from the received PCC rules. This information is used to provide the QUIC-LL parameters, such as the "UE link-specific QUIC-LL" IP addresses and the "UPF link-specific QUIC-LL" IP addresses and port numbers per QUIC connection.

q_12909.question: What is the definition of a "PCC decision" and what does it consist of?
q_12909.ground_truth: A "PCC decision" consists of PCC rules and IP-CAN bearer attributes and is provided by the PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) to the PCEF (Policy and Charging Enforcement Function) for policy and charging control and, for PCEF enhanced with ADC, application detection and control.

q_12910.question: What is the difference between a Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN) and a Public network integrated NPN (PNI-NPN)?
q_12910.ground_truth: A Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN) is operated independently without relying on network functions provided by a PLMN, while a Public network integrated NPN (PNI-NPN) is deployed with the support of a PLMN.

q_12911.question: What is the objective of downlink compressed mode under this subclause?
q_12911.ground_truth: The downlink compressed mode is used to create gaps in the downlink transmission, allowing the UE to make measurements on other frequencies.

q_12912.question: Which AVPs should not be supported for the Np reference point if they are from existing Diameter Applications?
q_12912.ground_truth: AVPs from existing Diameter Applications, except for the AVPs from Diameter base protocol.

q_12913.question: What are the possible values for the 'OutofSyncWindow' enumerated type?
q_12913.ground_truth: The possible values for the 'OutofSyncWindow' enumerated type are ms40, ms80, ms160, ms320, ms640, spare3, spare2, and spare1.

q_12914.question: What are the four fields present in the fallbackRAR?
q_12914.ground_truth: The four fields in the fallbackRAR are R, Timing Advance Command, UL Grant, and Temporary C-RNTI.

q_12915.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in RLP?
q_12915.ground_truth: The version numbering system in RLP indicates the status and changes in the document. For example, a first digit of 'x' shows that the document is presented to the TSG, 'x+1' means it is presented for approval, and 'x+2' indicates that the document is approved and under change control. The second digit is incremented for changes of substance, while the third digit is incremented for editorial changes only.

q_12916.question: What feature allows an NB-IoT UE to use 16-QAM for unicast NPDSCH with a TBS up to 4968 bits for standalone and guard-band deployments and 3624 bits for in-band deployments in Rel-17?
q_12916.ground_truth: 16-QAM for unicast in UL and DL for NB-IoT

q_12917.question: What is subclause 7.1.73a.2.1.2 specifying?
q_12917.ground_truth: Subclause 7.1.73a.2.1.2 specifies the transport channel parameters for Interactive or background / DL:8 kbps / PS RAB in the document.

q_12918.question: What is the action taken by the mobile station when it receives a change in the Channel Coding Command in an EC PACKET~UPLINK~ACK/NACK message?
q_12918.ground_truth: The mobile station shall act upon the new Channel Coding Command and recalculate the CV for any untransmitted RLC data block using the new RLC data block size.

q_12919.question: When BSIC re-confirmation is performed, how many idle intervals can the UE use for BSIC re-confirmation?
q_12919.ground_truth: The UE is able to use for BSIC re-confirmation at least 8 identified GSM cells, with the timing information updated every time the BSIC is decoded.

q_12920.question: Which paging procedure optimization is used in idle mode on EC-PCH in EC-GSM-IoT, different from GPRS/EGPRS?
q_12920.ground_truth: A two burst block is used on EC-PCH, with the possibility to decode it after only one burst has been received.

q_12921.question: What symbol duration does the 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification use?
q_12921.ground_truth: The symbol duration used in the 7.68 Mcps TDD option is 5120 * Tc, where Tc is the chip duration equaling 130.2 ns.

q_12922.question: What must the PCRF determine at IP-CAN session establishment or at any later point of time to indicate traffic steering control?
q_12922.ground_truth: The PCRF must determine that the traffic steering control is needed for the IP-CAN session.

q_12923.question: How many columns are assigned to the matrix in frame related 2nd interleaving?
q_12923.ground_truth: C2 = 30 columns are assigned to the matrix in frame related 2nd interleaving.

q_12924.question: What is the expected sequence of messages for the 6.1.2.1.3 test?
q_12924.ground_truth: The expected sequence of messages for the 6.1.2.1.3 test includes the UE transmitting a REGISTER message with an LCS MO-LR request with the "MOLR-Type" set to "locationEstimate", responding with a MEASUREMENT REPORT message, sending a FACILITY message containing an MO-LR result, and finally transmitting a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

q_12925.question: In what type of network is the UE reflective QoS function enabled or disabled based on the network's indication during 3GPP based access authentication?

q_12926.question: What actions should the GCS AS take when it detects a BM-SC restart?
q_12926.ground_truth: The GCS AS assumes that all TMGIs assigned by the restarted BM-SC have been de-allocated and may restore MBMS delivery.

q_12927.question: What are the two types of ICE procedures supported by the MRFC?
q_12927.ground_truth: The two types of ICE procedures supported by the MRFC are ICE lite and Full ICE.

q_12928.question: In what situation should the "Removal of MME Registration for SMS" flag within the NOR-Flags AVP received within NOR be set in the Ready-For-SM message?
q_12928.ground_truth: The "Removal of MME Registration for SMS" flag within the NOR-Flags AVP received within NOR should be set in the Ready-For-SM message if removalofMMERegistrationforSMS was received within the UpdateGprsLocationArg.

q_12929.question: What is the purpose of defining the NRM by this IRP?
q_12929.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the NRM by this IRP is to support communications for telecommunication network management purposes, including management of converged networks.

q_12930.question: What are the modulation and coding schemes for PDTCH reused for EC-PDTCH?
q_12930.ground_truth: The EGPRS modulation and coding schemes for PDTCH are reused for EC-PDTCH

q_12931.question: What should the UE do when it has stored dedicated UE identity and monitors HS-SCCHs after receiving its specific paging indication on PICH?
q_12931.ground_truth: The UE shall continuously monitor HS-SCCHs in the M sub-frames after receiving its specific paging indication on PICH and initiate the uplink synchronization procedure on primary frequency if it detects a consistent HS-SCCH order intended for it.

q_12932.question: What type of header is used for UBS-7 and UBS-8 combined uplink RLC/MAC?

q_12933.question: What is the range of values for the "Error Cause value" field and what do they represent?
q_12933.ground_truth: The "Error Cause value" field has a range of values from 0 to 63, with values from 0 to 15 used for syntactical protocol errors, 16 to 41 used for semantical protocol errors, and 42 to 63 used for other errors.

q_12934.question: What is the input to the encoding process in the evaluated 3GPP video services?
q_12934.ground_truth: A source sequence in 3G file format.

q_12935.question: What is the main function of the Proxy-Gn in reducing signalling delay?
q_12935.ground_truth: The Proxy-Gn reduces signalling delay by ensuring a negligible signalling delay when relaying a PDP context creation of non E-GAN capable MS, which is an order of magnitude 100 times lower than the end-to-end signalling delay for a PDP Context Activation.

q_12936.question: What is the use of a ProSe Application Mask in ProSe Application Code matching?
q_12936.ground_truth: A ProSe Application Mask is used for partial matching of ProSe Application Codes or ProSe Restricted Codes received on the PC5 interface. It allows for more flexible and effective filtering of the received temporary identities in a monitoring UE.

q_12937.question: What is the test procedure for the Indoor Anechoic Chamber in stage 2 of the IAC testing procedure?
q_12937.ground_truth: The IAC testing procedure consists of several steps, including uninstalling the reference antenna, installing the BS, setting the BS to be satisfied with the desired RoAoA, rotating the BS, setting the test signal mean power, and measuring the throughput. This procedure is repeated for each conformance testing direction.

q_12938.question: What is the system responsible for signaling, transporting, and presenting enhanced and interactive applications on hybrid terminals with both a DVB compliant broadcast connection and a broadband connection, as per the HbbTV specification?

q_12939.question: What are the functional classifications of procedures for the Cx interface?
q_12939.ground_truth: The functional classifications of procedures for the Cx interface include location management procedures, user data handling procedures, user authentication procedures, and IMS Restoration Procedures.

q_12940.question: Under what conditions, based on FDD, will the DRNS reject the procedure using the RADIO LINK ADDITION FAILURE message due to invalid CM settings?
q_12940.ground_truth: If the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message contains the Affected HS-DSCH serving cell List IE in the Active Pattern Sequence Information IE, and the Transmission Gap Pattern Sequence for affected HS-DSCH Serving Cells is activated on the HS-DSCH Primary Serving Cell but not for all the other serving cells, the DRNS will reject the procedure using the RADIO LINK ADDITION FAILURE message with the cause value "Invalid CM settings."

q_12941.question: What is the purpose of the 5G-GUTI provided in the re-route assistance information?
q_12941.ground_truth: The 5G-GUTI provided in the re-route assistance information is used by the UE to re-initiate the Registration procedure via a new RRC Connection towards RAN, and by the Target-AMF to determine that it is a re-routed Registration request.

q_12942.question: What was the output level of the decoder when a single sinusoidal tone of frequency 1500 Hz was processed through the speech codec in section 21.8?
q_12942.ground_truth: A temporary instability in the decoder was observed for a single sinusoidal tone of frequency 1500 Hz.

q_12943.question: When should the UE perform SDS (Single Radio Voice Call Continuous) in terminating sessions if the media bearers cannot be accepted on the PS domain?
q_12943.ground_truth: The UE should perform SDS when it receives an incoming session requesting one or more media (i.e. bi-directional speech media) bearers in the PS domain and determines that the media bearers cannot be accepted on the PS domain.

q_12944.question: What is the purpose of the AllowedCSGEntries node in the Allowed CSG List MO?
q_12944.ground_truth: The AllowedCSGEntries node is used to allow a reference to a list of allowed CSG entries, and is a child of the <X> node.

q_12945.question: What is the role of the OCS in the process described?
q_12945.ground_truth: The OCS is responsible for performing the Reserve Units Request operation, granting service units, and performing the Debit Units operation.

q_12946.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_12946.ground_truth: The first digit represents the level of approval the document has received from the TSG, while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc.

q_12947.question: What is the objective of the PLAY TONE proactive SIM command, as per the described scenario?
q_12947.ground_truth: The objective of the PLAY TONE proactive SIM command is to verify that the ME plays an audio tone of a specified type and duration, and returns a successful response in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command sent to the SIM.

q_12948.question: What is the range of k values when at least one of the PRS and SRS resources for TUE Rx-Tx is in FR1?
q_12948.ground_truth: The range of k values is from 2 to 5.

q_12949.question: What is the purpose of the historical MDA reports in the MDA process?
q_12949.ground_truth: The historical MDA reports can be used by the consumer to retrieve data analysis results that were produced in the past, for example if the reports have been lost or could not be successfully parsed.

q_12950.question: What action should the MBMS Aware Application take after receiving the callback in fileAvailable() API?
q_12950.ground_truth: After receiving the callback, the MBMS Aware Application may access the file that is announced by the parameters in the callback function. If the storage is not defined by the locationPath, the application should arrange for a copy of the file to the application space before the announced availabilityDeadline.

q_12951.question: How can an active CFNRc be deactivated?
q_12951.ground_truth: It can be deactivated explicitly by the user through an appropriate control procedure, automatically when another registration is made, or as a result of the withdrawal of the service.

q_12952.question: What is the difference between mode~II and A/Gb mode in handling periodic RA updates and periodic LA updates?
q_12952.ground_truth: In mode~II, both periodic RA updates and periodic LA updates are performed independently, with RA updates sent to the SGSN and LA updates sent to the MSC/VLR. In A/Gb mode, the periodic RA update timer in the MS is stopped when an LLC PDU is sent and is reset and started when the state returns to STANDBY. In Iu mode, the periodic RA update timer in the MS is stopped when the MM context enters the PMM-CONNECTED state and is reset and started when the state returns to PMM-IDLE.

q_12953.question: What is the "ProtocolExtensionContainer" used for in the "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence?
q_12953.ground_truth: The "ProtocolExtensionContainer" in the "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence is used to define additional protocol extension information, as specified in the PCAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION.

q_12954.question: What is the maximum time difference allowed between the middle of the received GSM synchronization burst at the UE and the middle of the measurement occasion for the UE to decode a BSIC within a measurement occasion?
q_12954.ground_truth: The UE is able to decode a BSIC within a measurement occasion if the time difference between the middle of the received GSM synchronization burst at the UE and the middle of the measurement occasion is within TBD.

q_12955.question: What is the mode of operation for performing a Combined RA/LA Update in a GERAN network?
q_12955.ground_truth: Mode I in a GERAN network uses the Combined RA/LA Update mode.

q_12956.question: What does the Signalling Transport Network (STN) interface Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) specify?
q_12956.ground_truth: The protocol neutral STN interface NRM IRP

q_12957.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 QoS parameters that are provided to the UE-to-Network Relay during the PDU session modification procedure?
q_12957.ground_truth: The PC5 QoS parameters are used by the UE-to-Network Relay to modify the Layer-2 link based on the PC5 QoS parameters received from the CN.

q_12958.question: What is the use of N parameter in the RLC sublayer?
q_12958.ground_truth: The N parameter indicates that an RLC entity will not send a PDU with "Sequence Number" >=VT(S)+N for AM and "Sequence Number" >=VT(US)+N for UM, where N is a non-negative integer. This parameter is used to limit the number of PDUs sent by an RLC entity.

q_12959.question: What is the purpose of the controlled-object-scope field in Suspension-Control-Type of InformationTransferControlReq in RNSAP protocol?
q_12959.ground_truth: The controlled-object-scope field in Suspension-Control-Type of InformationTransferControlReq and Resume-Control-Type-ExtIEs of InformationTransferControlReq specifies the scope of the suspended or resumed object in the RNSAP protocol.

q_12960.question: What should the USSI AS do if the network successfully performs the USSD information and does not need any further information?
q_12960.ground_truth: The USSI AS should send a BYE request in order to terminate the dialog, populating it with an application/vnd.3gpp.ussd+xml MIME body including a <ussd-string> element and a <language> element.

q_12961.question: How often should the scrambling sequence be re-initialized for NPDCCH?
q_12961.ground_truth: The scrambling sequence is re-initialized at the start of every 4th NPDCCH subframe for NPDCCH transmission.

q_12962.question: What state must the UE be in for the test described in 9.1.9.5.1 to be applicable?
q_12962.ground_truth: The UE must be in the 5GMM-REGISTERED state and have a UE Radio Capability ID assigned in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message for the test to be applicable.

q_12963.question: What action is taken when timer T390 corresponding to Access Category '2' expires or is stopped?
q_12963.ground_truth: The barring for Access Category '2' is considered to be alleviated.

q_12964.question: What is the purpose of the integrity protection function in the PDCP Data PDU?
q_12964.ground_truth: The integrity protection function in the PDCP Data PDU ensures the protection of the confidentiality and integrity of the data transmitted over the radio interface, providing a secure means of communication between the user equipment (UE) and the 5G network.

q_12965.question: What is the criterion for whether "immediateResponsePreferred" should be included in the SendAuthenticationInfoArg or not?
q_12965.ground_truth: If a Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP or a Requested-UTRAN-GERAN-Authentication-Info AVP is present within AIR, then "immediateResponsePreferred" should be present if and only if the Immediate-Response-Preferred AVP is present within either of those AVPs.

q_12966.question: What is the purpose of the IMS Record created when performing a successful Location Update for a UE in ICS user registration via CS access?
q_12966.ground_truth: The IMS Record created when performing a successful Location Update for a UE in ICS user registration via CS access is used to perform 3rd party registration towards the SCC-AS.

q_12967.question: What is one action that the RNS may take when the CS service is released in CS fallback?
q_12967.ground_truth: The RNS may select to use RRC Connection Release with Redirect to send the UE back to E-UTRAN at release of the CS service.

q_12968.question: What is the total RSTD measurement time for an already detected cell in this test case?
q_12968.ground_truth: The total RSTD measurement time for an already detected cell in this test case is 55.64 s.

q_12969.question: What are the actions required by the UE when verifying the integrity of the NAS Security Mode Command message in the NAS SMC procedure?
q_12969.ground_truth: The UE shall verify the integrity of the NAS Security Mode Command message, including ensuring that the UE security capabilities sent by the MME match the ones stored in the UE, checking the integrity protection using the indicated NAS integrity algorithm and the NAS integrity key based on KASME indicated by the eKSI, and when creating a mapped context, ensuring the received NONCEUE is the same as the NONCEUE sent in the TAU Request and also calculating KASME' from CK, IK and the two nonces.

q_12970.question: In which writing direction should the glyphs be rotated if vertical text is requested for characters which the terminal cannot render vertically?
q_12970.ground_truth: If vertical text is requested for characters which the terminal cannot render vertically, the terminal may behave as if the characters were not available and the glyphs should not be rotated.

q_12971.question: How are MBS session keys generated and distributed in this solution?
q_12971.ground_truth: MB-SMF generates the MBS session key for a particular TMGI and provides it to the UE and the NG-RAN. If multiple MB-SMFs are used within the network, a Key Management Server (KMS) is used to generate the session key and the MBS Key index for the TMGI.

q_12972.question: What is the minimum measured RSRP value for an NR cell to be considered as a high-quality PLMN?
q_12972.ground_truth: The minimum measured RSRP value for an NR cell to be considered as a high-quality PLMN is -110 dBm.

q_12973.question: What is the purpose of the "Maximum number of reported cells on RACH" in the 3GPP specification?
q_12973.ground_truth: It specifies the maximum number of intra-frequency cells that are to be reported on RACH (Radio Access Control Heritage).

q_12974.question: How is the charging of the diverting user and the diverting party handled in MMTel charging?
q_12974.ground_truth: The charging of the diverting user is measured by the MMTel AS handling the CDIV service, and a separate charging dialog is needed for the diverting user. The diverting party is charged for the forwarded leg, and normal roaming charging principles apply.

q_12975.question: What is the meaning of "must" and "must not" in the context of the present document?
q_12975.ground_truth: These constructions are avoided in normative elements, but they are used in direct citations from external, referenced, non-3GPP documents, or to maintain continuity of style when extending or modifying the provisions of such a referenced document.

q_12976.question: What is a multiple scale lattice structure defined by in relation to the lattice codebook?
q_12976.ground_truth: A multiple scale lattice structure is defined by a set of three integers representing the number of leader vectors for each truncation and three positive real numbers representing the scale for each lattice truncation.

q_12977.question: What action shall the UE take if the de-registration request is not due to switch off and it is in the state 5GMM-REGISTERED or 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED?
q_12977.ground_truth: The UE shall start timer T3521 after sending the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED.

q_12978.question: What is the function of the HS-SCCH order in E-UTRAN?
q_12978.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH order is used to signal an HS-DSCH serving cell change command in the target cell, either in response to an Event 1d intra frequency event or an Event 1c intra frequency event on the primary frequency where the current serving HS-DSCH cell is the only active CPICH triggering the event and the target cell is the best cell in the current active set reported in the Event 1c measurement report.

q_12979.question: What is the outcome of the CTS enrolment procedure if the mobile station does not have the rights to be enrolled?
q_12979.ground_truth: The fixed part sends a CTS ENROLMENT REJECT message to the mobile station, containing a reject cause and the identity of the fixed part, and the CTS-MS enters in ENROLMENT REJECTED state.

q_12980.question: What is the reused interfering signal level for out-of-band blocking in both 6.425-7.125 GHz and 10.0-10.5 GHz frequency ranges?
q_12980.ground_truth: The reused interfering signal level for out-of-band blocking in both frequency ranges is -15 dBm CW.

q_12981.question: Which nodes perform mutual authentication on the Tsp interface between MTC-IWF and SCS?
q_12981.ground_truth: The nodes that perform mutual authentication on the Tsp interface between MTC-IWF and SCS are the MTC-IWF-side agent (or MTC-IWF) in the security domain of the MTC-IWF and the SCS-side agent (or SCS) in the security domain of the SCS.

q_12982.question: What is the role of the "extension" element in the request message?
q_12982.ground_truth: The BSF may use one or more "extension" elements to include additional data to the request, but the NAF may ignore the additional data.

q_12983.question: How many subcounters are provided for the "Failed session establishments for multi-party sessions" measurement in the MRFCFunction?
q_12983.ground_truth: The number of subcounters is equal to the number of status codes plus a possible sum value identified by the.sum suffix.

q_12984.question: What does the DCD replace-content-id parameter do in the DCD Content metadata?
q_12984.ground_truth: The DCD replace-content-id parameter is used to indicate which content item shall be replaced by the content item for which a content-id is provided in the same message.

q_12985.question: What is the focus of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification in the area of Telecommunication management and Charging management, specifically in the context of Push-to-Talk over Cellular (PoC) charging?
q_12985.ground_truth: The focus of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification is on providing a detailed description of the charging architecture and scenarios specific to PoC, as well as the mapping of the common 3GPP charging architecture onto the PoC service. It further specifies the structure and content of the CDRs for offline charging, and the charging events for online charging.

q_12986.question: What is the state of high mobility that is considered when entering idle mode if the "UE Mobility State Indicator" IE is present in an RRC Connection Release message?
q_12986.ground_truth: The high-mobility state is considered to have been detected when entering idle mode.

q_12987.question: Which RLC entity is used to transmit RLC SDUs in acknowledged mode, and what are the primitives associated with it?
q_12987.ground_truth: RLC-AM entity is used to transmit RLC SDUs in acknowledged mode. The primitives associated with it are RLC-AM-DATA-Req, RLC-AM-DATA-Ind, and RLC-AM-DATA-Conf.

q_12988.question: What is the purpose of the Wait for RP-ACK state (State 1) in short message transfer?
q_12988.ground_truth: The Wait for RP-ACK state (State 1) is entered for a mobile terminating short message transfer when the SMR has passed the RP-DATA message to the SMC entity and set the timer TR1N.

q_12989.question: What is the purpose of the Consent header block element and what is it used for?
