q_13481.ground_truth: The policy rules in solution #12 can indicate the preferred path, with options including only the PC5 path, only the Uu path, PC5 path preferred, Uu path preferred, or no preference.

q_13482.question: What information from the SIP REFER request is used to send a re-INVITE request to the remote UE when the final response from the controllee UE is a SIP 2xx response containing a SDP answer in the procedures for collaborative session establishment by transferring media?
q_13482.ground_truth: The SDP information from the SIP 2xx response from the controllee UE is used to send a re-INVITE request to the remote UE in this case.

q_13483.question: What is the requirement for the IMSI stored in the USIM in test 5.1.5.4.1?
q_13483.ground_truth: The requirement for the IMSI stored in the USIM in test 5.1.5.4.1 is that it should be "2460813579".

q_13484.question: What should a network do when it receives a T COMMAND message and regards it as erroneous?
q_13484.ground_truth: An ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message with cause "Protocol error unspecified" should be returned immediately, and no further action should be taken.

q_13485.question: What should the network request the UE to report on RACH P-CCPCH RSCP for the serving cell and up to 6 strongest monitored set cells and SFN-SFN observed time difference in the 3.84 Mcps TDD option?
q_13485.ground_truth: The SFN-SFN observed time difference between the serving cell and up to 6 different monitored set cells.

q_13486.question: What is the purpose of the Fixed Part Classmark information element?
q_13486.ground_truth: The purpose of the Fixed Part Classmark information element is to provide the service node with information concerning characteristics of the fixed part and affect the manner in which the service node handles the operation of the fixed part.

q_13487.question: What should the GGSN do if the SGSN returns a MAP Error Cause indicating that the IMSI is not known?
q_13487.ground_truth: The GGSN should send a Failure Report (IMSI, GGSN Number, GGSN Address) message to the HLR to request MNRG to be set for the IMSI.

q_13488.question: What is the purpose of the UFES in Solution 24?
q_13488.ground_truth: The UFES in Solution 24 is responsible for triggering UAV re-authentication and re-authorization at any time, and transferring updated authorization data, including RITI, to the UAV in 5GS and EPS.

q_13489.question: What is the significance of the EC-BCCH for an MS supporting EC-GSM-IoT?
q_13489.ground_truth: The EC-BCCH broadcasts EC-GSM-IoT specific cell re-selection parameters, including a 9-bit BSIC for each neighbour cell supporting EC-GSM-IoT.

q_13490.question: What should an MBMS UE do if it receives an FDT Instance describing a file after the end of the transmission time for that file, but before the expiration time of the FDT Instance?
q_13490.ground_truth: The MBMS UE should determine that the transmission of the file is incomplete and that more packets may arrive within the MBMS download session for that file.

q_13491.question: What is the definition of a "changed alarm" in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects telecommunication management?
q_13491.ground_truth: A "changed alarm" is a term defined in 3GPP TS 32.391, which is related to the Delta Synchronization IRP.

q_13492.question: What is the basis for determining the access identity applicable for the request in 3GPP TS 24.501, clause 4.5.2A?
q_13492.ground_truth: The UE checks whether the access identity is applicable in the selected SNPN or RSNPN for each of the access identities 1, 2, 11, 12, 13, 14, and 15. If none of these identities is applicable, then access identity 0 is applicable.

q_13493.question: What happens to quota consumption when there is no traffic in the base time interval?
q_13493.ground_truth: Quota consumption stops after the first base time interval with no traffic, and resumes only on the first subsequent traffic.

q_13494.question: What type of user channel is an Lm channel?
q_13494.ground_truth: An Lm channel is a user channel with a carrying capability lower than a Bm channel, and is able to carry voice encoded at some rate and data information corresponding to circuit switching user classes of services at bit rates compatible with the channel capability.

q_13495.question: What are the two communication session setup classes in the FRMCS System?
q_13495.ground_truth: The FRMCS User requires two classes for setup of a communication session: Immediate (the FRMCS User requires immediate setup of the communication session with a duration not exceeding 1 second) and Normal (normal communication session setup time range does not harm the use of the application with a time duration not exceeding 3 seconds).

q_13496.question: What is the minimum SNR required for UE to report RSTD of neighbor cells in 3GPP TS 36.211?
q_13496.ground_truth: The minimum SNR required for UE to report RSTD of the reference cell is -6 dB for all Frequency Bands and -13 dB for neighbor cell i for all Frequency Bands.

q_13497.question: What are some of the key principles of the 5G System architecture?
q_13497.ground_truth: Some of the key principles of the 5G System architecture include separating the User Plane (UP) functions from the Control Plane (CP) functions, modularizing the function design, defining procedures as services for re-use, enabling direct network function interactions, minimizing dependencies between the Access Network and the Core Network, supporting a unified authentication framework, and supporting stateless network functions.

q_13498.question: What is the purpose of establishing essential EMC requirements for UTRA terminal equipment and ancillary accessories?
q_13498.ground_truth: The purpose of establishing essential EMC requirements is to ensure that UTRA terminal equipment and ancillary accessories do not generate electromagnetic disturbances that may interfere with the operation of other equipment and have an adequate level of intrinsic immunity to operate as intended in their intended electromagnetic environments.

q_13499.question: How does the UE determine the order of decoding BSIC carriers when attempting to decode the BSIC of a GSM BCCH carrier?
q_13499.ground_truth: The UE uses all available measurements windows allocated for GSM initial BSIC identification in decreasing signal strength order to attempt to decode the BSIC from a GSM BCCH carrier with unknown BSIC.

q_13500.question: What should the IWF do when receiving a SIP INVITE request with an emergency indication set to "true"?
q_13500.ground_truth: If the SIP INVITE request contains an emergency indication set to "true", the IWF shall cache the information that the MCPTT user has initiated an MCPTT emergency private call to the targeted user and shall cache the information that the MCPTT user is in an in-progress emergency private call state with the targeted user homed in the IWF.

q_13501.question: What is the static reference performance requirement for Local area BS in case of two interfering signals?
q_13501.ground_truth: The static reference performance as specified in clause 7.2.1 should be met in case of a Local area BS when the following signals are coupled to BS antenna input: A wanted signal at the assigned channel frequency with a mean power of -101~dBm, and two interfering signals with certain parameters.

q_13502.question: What is the role of the Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the IM NRM?
q_13502.ground_truth: The Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the IM NRM is a reference point for communication between an IRPAgent and an IRPManager for telecommunication network management purposes. It specifies the semantics and behavior of information object class attributes and relations in a protocol and technology neutral way.

q_13503.question: What is the procedure for the SCC AS when it detects the loss of service control signalling path over Gm?
q_13503.ground_truth: When the SCC AS detects the loss of service control signalling path over Gm, it sends an I1 Failure message towards the UE and sets a CS bearer release timer value if there are no more I1 service control sessions using the CS bearer.

q_13504.question: What types of measurements does the "Event E" reporting apply to if the Common Measurement Type IE is set to "HS-DSCH Required Power"?
q_13504.ground_truth: If the Common Measurement Type IE is set to "HS-DSCH Required Power", the Node B shall initiate the Common Measurement Reporting procedure when the sum of the HS-DSCH Required Power measurements for each priority class rises above or falls below the specified thresholds.

q_13505.question: What is the Communication Surveillance (CS) in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_13505.ground_truth: The Communication Surveillance (CS) is a capability to monitor the communication between NM (Network Manager) and managed system, and to discover their breaks as early as possible.

q_13506.question: What is the minimum number of successful tests with a confidence level of 95% that the UE must achieve for the RSTD measurement reporting delay to meet the requirements?
q_13506.ground_truth: The minimum rate of successful tests during repeated tests must be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_13507.question: What was the main objective of the listening test using the EVS codec?
q_13507.ground_truth: The main objective of the test was to assess the suitability of encoding FOA for VR use cases using existing 3GPP speech and audio codecs.

q_13508.question: What is the purpose of the X2 interface in the E-UTRAN architecture?
q_13508.ground_truth: The X2 interface in E-UTRAN is used for the interconnection of E-UTRAN NodeB (eNB) components and between an eNB and an E-UTRAN gNodeB (en-gNB) within the E-UTRAN architecture. It is used to support the exchange of signalling information and the forwarding of PDUs between the eNBs.

q_13509.question: What is the purpose of the RNSAP Uplink Signalling Transfer Indication message in the SRNS Enhanced Relocation procedure?
q_13509.ground_truth: The RNSAP Uplink Signalling Transfer Indication message is used to forward the received uplink CCCH message towards the source RNC in the SRNS Enhanced Relocation procedure.

q_13510.question: In the S1 UE-initiated Detach procedure, what indication is sent from the SGW-C to the SGW-U to stop counting and discard uplink packets for the affected bearers?
q_13510.ground_truth: The SGW-C sends an Sx Session Modification Request to the SGW-U with an indication to stop counting and discard uplink packets for the affected bearers.

q_13511.question: What is the purpose of the de-registration procedure in MBMS?
q_13511.ground_truth: The de-registration procedure is used by the UE to de-register at the end of the user service consumption, in case a registration procedure has been performed.

q_13512.question: What should the UE do to re-establish secure exchange of NAS messages with the MME after inter-system change?
q_13512.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message integrity protected with the current 5G NAS security context and derive a mapped EPS security context.

q_13513.question: Which parameters are used in the multicast broadcast encryption and integrity key generation for MBS?
q_13513.ground_truth: TMGI, multicast group token, re-keying token, encryption and encryption algorithm ID, integrity and integrity algorithm ID.

q_13514.question: What is the role of the 3GPP in the context of the technical specification series for Support of Localised Service Area (SoLSA)?
q_13514.ground_truth: The 3GPP (Third Generation Partnership Project) is an organization that produces technical specifications for the telecommunications industry, including the technical specification series for Support of Localised Service Area (SoLSA).

q_13515.question: What enhancements were specified to facilitate hybrid RAT dependent positioning in NR positioning for TS 22.261?
q_13515.ground_truth: The enhancements include gNB reporting a set of measurements, including one SRS-RSRP, multiple UL-AOAs (AOA/ZoA pairs), one UL-RTOA or one gNB Rx-Tx time difference to facilitate hybrid RAT dependent positioning.

q_13516.question: What message is sent by the SGSN to the GGSN after receiving a successful MBMS context activation request from the UE?
q_13516.ground_truth: The SGSN sends a Create MBMS Context Response to the GGSN.

q_13517.question: What is indirect 3GPP communication?
q_13517.ground_truth: Indirect 3GPP communication refers to the signaling and communication between a User Equipment (UE) and 3GPP network via one or more UE-to-Network Relay UEs.

q_13518.question: What is the purpose of the LWAAP specification (Release 17) as produced by the 3GPP?
q_13518.ground_truth: The LWAAP specification (Release 17) defines the E-UTRA LTE-WLAN Aggregation Adaptation Protocol that is used in LTE-WLAN Aggregation.

q_13519.question: What is the effect of power limitations while transforming the results of a smaller bandwidth to a larger bandwidth on the KPIs?
q_13519.ground_truth: While simulating a smaller bandwidth than the aggregated system bandwidth, the transformation to a larger bandwidth should be described, including the modelling of power limitations.

q_13520.question: What is minimized in the technical implementation of MNP/NAGNP, as per this specification?
q_13520.ground_truth: The time that no service is available to the customer during the porting process and the additional delay in call set-up to ported numbers.

q_13521.question: What must be included in a 200 (OK) response when creating responses for an initial INVITE request at the conference focus?
q_13521.ground_truth: When creating responses for an initial INVITE request, the conference focus shall include the P-Charging-Vector header including the icid parameter as received in the initial request, the orig-ioi parameter as received in the initial request, and the term-ioi parameter indicating the network of the conference focus.

q_13522.question: What were the primary issues found with the VAD and CNI functions during the tests?
q_13522.ground_truth: The VAD functions worked well in most situations, but the Comfort Noise Insertion did not operate properly, being poorly matched in terms of quality and/or level.

q_13523.question: What is the function of the Authentication Proxy in the GAA Framework as defined in TR~33.919?
q_13523.ground_truth: The Authentication Proxy in the GAA Framework as defined in TR~33.919 is responsible for providing information to the PCRF for the purpose of selecting an appropriate PCC Rule in the context of UICC based authentication mechanisms for HTTP based services.

q_13524.question: What is the purpose of On-Demand PRS transmission in 5G network positioning?
q_13524.ground_truth: On-Demand PRS transmission allows the LMF to control and decide whether PRS should be transmitted and to change the characteristics of the ongoing PRS transmission. This procedure may be initiated by the UE or the LMF.

q_13525.question: What is the purpose of General Control SAPs in the AN/CN connection?
q_13525.ground_truth: General Control SAPs are used to enable the Core Network to provide information and commands that do not relate to specific users or sessions.

q_13526.question: What is the role of the secondary minimum required bits in the second-stage iterations of the bit allocation process?
q_13526.ground_truth: The secondary minimum required bits, represented by bits, indicate the number of bits that corresponds to 1 bit/sample in each band. In the second-stage iterations, the algorithm aims to allocate bits to the bands with more than bits while ensuring that the minimum required bits are met.

q_13527.question: What is the main challenge of the second IPv6 migration scenario?
q_13527.ground_truth: The main challenge of the second IPv6 migration scenario is the limited number of private IP addresses. In case more than 16 million UEs are active in the same network at the same time, the network will run out of private IPv4 addresses.

q_13528.question: In Section 7.4.3.4, what is the main challenge of sharing contextual information between operator networks, and which information is most useful for SPIT/UC feedback if provided by the originating network to the destination network?
q_13528.ground_truth: The main challenge of sharing contextual information between operator networks is that some of the information may be sensitive and not possible to share in some cases. However, identity strength and cost category are the most useful information for SPIT/UC feedback if provided by the originating network to the destination network.

q_13529.question: What is the purpose of the Following attach request information element?
q_13529.ground_truth: The Following attach request information element indicates that an attach request may be done on an existing RR connection.

q_13530.question: When should a mobile station send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message?
q_13530.ground_truth: A mobile station should send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message to the network in the old cell in case the network controlled cell reselection procedure has failed, if it is still on the old cell, and if it has synchronised and attempted to access the new cell successfully before returning to the old cell.

q_13531.question: What address conversion function does the GLR perform when it receives messages that include the HLR Number?
q_13531.ground_truth: The HLR Number is converted to the GLR Number when the GLR receives messages that include the HLR Number from the HLR.

q_13532.question: When can the CSE instruct the IPLMN/VPLMN to connect a held call party to the group during the active phase of the call leg?
q_13532.ground_truth: The CSE may instruct the IPLMN/VPLMN to connect a held call party to the group if at least one call leg in the group has reached the active phase and a control relationship exists.

q_13533.question: How does the windowing approach differ when compared to 3GPP TS 26.190?
q_13533.ground_truth: The main differences from 3GPP TS 26.190 are the window shape and position, along with the interpolation factors used in this process.

q_13534.question: When is the data demodulator used in the PSAP receiver and what is its function?
q_13534.ground_truth: The data demodulator is represented by a correlator matched to the modulated waveform applied by the data modulator of the IVS transmitter. It calculates correlations for all possible symbols to demodulate the data and then normalizes correlation values by their variance and subtracts by a mean value for demodulation.

q_13535.question: Who is responsible for implementing approved TPs in the current TR?
q_13535.ground_truth: A single company is responsible for introducing all approved TPs in the current TR.

q_13536.question: What should be supported to secure network information provisioning to local applications in low latency procedures?
q_13536.ground_truth: Mutual authentication mechanism, confidentiality protection, integrity protection, and replay protection should be supported on the new interface between UPF and local NEF.

q_13537.question: What are the two modes offered by the MBMS bearer service?
q_13537.ground_truth: The two modes offered by the MBMS bearer service are Broadcast Mode and Multicast Mode.

q_13538.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of attempted location updates to be performed by the MSC-S per location area, counted as attempts, in the case of a Normal Intra-VLR location update?
q_13538.ground_truth: 4.2.2.1 MM AttIntraVlrLU.G or MM AttIntraVlrLU.U, depending on the network type.

q_13539.question: What is the response from the SSOS in the second step of the SSO scenario with SAML v2.0 and <samlp:Response> transfer using HTTPS with TLS?
q_13539.ground_truth: The SSOS responds with an HTTP Response redirect URL containing a <samlp2:Response> header which includes a <saml2:Assertion> parameter and may include further LAP-related data.

q_13540.question: What should the UE do to determine whether a particular access attempt is allowed?
q_13540.ground_truth: The UE should determine whether a particular access attempt is allowed based on uac-BarringInfo broadcast in SIB1 and if the RPLMN is the HPLMN, EHPLMN, or visited PLMN of the home country.

q_13541.question: What is the "metric" attribute type in the "SEQUENCE" of the "r14" choice of the "criticalExtensions" in the "MeasurementControl-LaterCriticalExtensions-r14-IEs" sequence?

q_13542.question: What determines the access network and message delivery method to send the trigger request to the UE in MSGin5G Service?
q_13542.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server determines the access network and message delivery method based on the information provided during the MSGin5G Client registration procedure or the information provisioned in the MSGin5G Server.

q_13543.question: What message does the BM-SC send to initiate the MBMS Session Update procedure for EPS with E-UTRAN and UTRAN?
q_13543.ground_truth: Session Update Request (TMGI, Flow Identifier, QoS, MBMS Service Area, list of cell IDs if available, Session identifier, estimated session duration, etc.)

q_13544.question: Which technical specification describes the charging enhancements for the 5GS CIoT features?

q_13545.question: What is the significance of the second digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_13545.ground_truth: The second digit in the version number represents the level of change in the technical specification, with a higher digit indicating a greater degree of change such as technical enhancements or corrections.

q_13546.question: What is the AMR codec mode that is a compatible version of the IS-136 EFR speech codec ?
q_13546.ground_truth: The 12,2 and 7,4 modes of AMR are compatible versions of the GSM EFR and IS-136 EFR speech codecs.

q_13547.question: What role does the Frame Quality Indicator field play in the AMR-WB codec framework?
q_13547.ground_truth: The Frame Quality Indicator field in the AMR-WB Header indicates whether the data in the frame contains errors.

q_13548.question: What message is used to transfer RIM information between an eNodeB and the HRPD Access Network in the S121 interface?
q_13548.ground_truth: The RIM Information Transfer message is used to transfer RIM information between an eNodeB and the HRPD Access Network in the S121 interface.

q_13549.question: What does the UE need to support to perform UE GPS timing of cell frames measurement when the IE "GPS timing of Cell wanted" is set to TRUE?
q_13549.ground_truth: The UE must support the capability to provide the GPS timing of the cell frames measurement to perform UE GPS timing of cell frames measurement when the IE "GPS timing of Cell wanted" is set to TRUE.

q_13550.question: What is the function of a pool-area within a RAN?
q_13550.ground_truth: A pool-area is an area within a RAN where an MS (Mobile Station) can roam without the need to change the serving CN node (Core Network node).

q_13551.question: What is the trigger for increasing the "Attempted UE originating CS data calls" measurement?
q_13551.ground_truth: On receipt by the MSC-S of a "Setup" message from the UE with certain Information Transfer Capability for attempted UE originating CS data calls.

q_13552.question: What should the SCC AS include in the SIP 200 (OK) response for the SIP INVITE request on the leg with the CS domain?
q_13552.ground_truth: The SCC AS may include a Feature-Caps header field with a "+g.3gpp.ics" header field parameter in the SIP 200 (OK) response for the SIP INVITE request on the leg with the CS domain.

q_13553.question: What is the purpose of sending a RESET UE POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message and RRC MEASUREMENT CONTROL messages in the described process?
q_13553.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide assistance data to the UE for obtaining a fix using the specified procedure.

q_13554.question: What are the two different types of signalling procedures in Xw Signalling Bearer?
q_13554.ground_truth: Non UE-associated signalling and UE-associated signalling are the two different types of signalling procedures in Xw Signalling Bearer.

q_13555.question: What is the purpose of the MME reporting changes in the HeNB local IP address and/or port to the PCEF/PCRF?
q_13555.ground_truth: The purpose of the MME reporting changes in the HeNB local IP address and/or port to the PCEF/PCRF is for keeping the consistent and accurate information in the serving network for the PDN GW.

q_13556.question: What information is included in the analytics report in 6.5.1.3.3 on gNB resource consumption?
q_13556.ground_truth: The analytics report in 6.5.1.3.3 on gNB resource consumption includes information such as the number of ongoing and/or potential handover optimization issues, historical data on handover performance for intra-gNB and inter-gNB handover measurements, network load, E2E latency, retainability, and radio conditions, as well as UE measurements including MDT, location, and QoE.

q_13557.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in estimating application service experiences?
q_13557.ground_truth: The NWDAF estimates application service experiences per Application ID to rank and report the TOPN Application-IDs having in account the Application IDs served by AFs. It also includes in the statistic/prediction outcome, the TOPN Applications ID experiencing the poorest service experience.

q_13558.question: What are Elementary Procedures in the context of M2AP?
q_13558.ground_truth: Elementary Procedures (Eps) in M2AP are units of interaction between eNBs and the MCE, used to build complete sequences in a flexible manner for signalling procedures.

q_13559.question: Which phantom is used for radiated MIMO OTA performance measurements in case of LME plug-in DUT?
q_13559.ground_truth: A laptop ground plane phantom is used for radiated MIMO OTA performance measurements in case of LME plug-in DUT.

q_13560.question: What sequence of bits is used to derive the precoding weight information for HS-SCCH type 3 when two transport blocks are transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCHs?
q_13560.ground_truth: The sequence of bits x2,i-19 where i ranges from 1 to 20 is used to derive the precoding weight information for HS-SCCH type 3 when two transport blocks are transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCHs.

q_13561.question: What is the dialling number string for the ME in Expected Sequence 4.1.1A?
q_13561.ground_truth: The dialling number string for the ME in Expected Sequence 4.1.1A is "1357924680".

q_13562.question: What action does the mobile station take when T3216 expires during non-synchronized cell PS handover?
q_13562.ground_truth: When T3216 expires, the mobile station aborts the PS handover procedure, returns to the old cell, sends a Packet Cell Change Failure message using the first available uplink transmission opportunity, and attempts to continue all TBFs/RABs that were ongoing prior to the handover procedure.

q_13563.question: What is the purpose of the E1 Application Protocol (E1AP) in the 3GPP NG-RAN?
q_13563.ground_truth: The E1 Application Protocol (E1AP) is a part of the 3GPP NG-RAN that provides a connection between the base station and the core network. It is specified in TS 37.483.

q_13564.question: What are the AVC-FullHD-Enc capabilities as defined in TS26.511 in 3GPP services?
q_13564.ground_truth: The AVC-FullHD-Enc is capable of encoding a video signal with up to 245,760 macroblocks per second, up to a frame size of 8,192 macroblocks, and up to 240 frames per second, with chroma format 4:2:0 and 8 bit bit depth, decodable by an AVC-HD-Dec capable decoder.

q_13565.question: In 6.5.1.2 test case, when ATR is null, what will be received at the ATR in the ATR buffer?
q_13565.ground_truth: Nothing will be received as ATR is not returned in this case.

q_13566.question: What information does the source BSS include in the PS Handover Required message to the SGSN upon initiating the handover?
q_13566.ground_truth: The source BSS includes the 'Reliable INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO' indicator in the PS Handover Required message if it has received it from the SGSN in a PS Handover Complete Ack message or a PS Handover Request message with "Reliable INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO" set to "1" or a CREATE-BSS-PFC message.

q_13567.question: When does the User Service Initiation procedure for MBMS User Service take place?
q_13567.ground_truth: The User Service Initiation procedure for MBMS User Service takes place after the discovery of the MBMS user service.

q_13568.question: What is the effect of the Credits IE value being 0 in the DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION Control Frame?
q_13568.ground_truth: If the Credits IE equals 0 in the DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION Control Frame, the SRNC must immediately stop transmission of MAC-c/sh SDUs.

q_13569.question: What should a PDCP entity do when it needs to synchronize the DL PDCP SN following a RLC reset or RLC transmitting side re-establishment not caused by a lossless SRNS Relocation or a lossless DL RLC size change?
q_13569.ground_truth: The PDCP entity should trigger the PDCP SN synchronisation procedure by submitting one PDCP SeqNum PDU to the lower layer.

q_13570.question: What message is sent by the UE after receiving the LPP REQUEST CAPABILITIES message from the SS in GNSS scenario #3?
q_13570.ground_truth: The UE returns an LPP PROVIDE CAPABILITIES message indicating the assistance data supported by the UE.

q_13571.question: What is the main improvement of TC mode in speech coding?
q_13571.ground_truth: The main improvement of TC mode is its robustness to frame erasures and the ability to encode frames with an outdated past excitation buffer. This is achieved by replacing the adaptive codebook (inter-frame long-term prediction) with a codebook of glottal impulse shapes, which is independent from past excitation.

q_13572.question: What key issue does Candidate Solution #10 address completely?
q_13572.ground_truth: Candidate Solution #10 addresses Key Issue #3 completely, providing a solution to tackle the delays introduced by satellite links.

q_13573.question: What is the main goal of the test procedure outlined in 27.22.4.26.1.4.1?
q_13573.ground_truth: The goal is to ensure that the ME launches the browser session properly during the LAUNCH BROWSER command execution and returns a successful result.

q_13574.question: What is the meaning of "TON: International" and "NPI: ISDN / telephone numbering plan" in the "Address" section?
q_13574.ground_truth: "TON: International" stands for Type of Number - International and "NPI: ISDN / telephone numbering plan" stands for Numbering Plan Indicator - Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN)/telephone numbering plan.

q_13575.question: Who is responsible for delivering CS domain messages received over the radio interface to the MSC?
q_13575.ground_truth: The network is responsible for delivering these messages once they've been received by part of the network.

q_13576.question: What should be included in the "GANSS TOW msec" if the "GANSS timing of Cell wanted" is not included in the IE?
q_13576.ground_truth: The "GANSS TOW msec" should be set to the GANSS TOW when the position estimate was valid.

q_13577.question: What is the purpose of the Packet Timing Advance field in the GPRS General Packet Range (GPRS) protocol?
q_13577.ground_truth: The Packet Timing Advance field in the GPRS General Packet Range (GPRS) protocol describes the timing advance mode and timing advance value assigned to the mobile station for uplink and/or downlink TBF.

q_13578.question: How can the network operator provide consistent quality for users in its network?
q_13578.ground_truth: The network operator can provide sufficient QoE to all users that have been granted access to the network and can also actively support premium users to maintain a certain service quality when the user plane is congested.

q_13579.question: What is the stop condition for the packet count test?
q_13579.ground_truth: The stop condition for the packet count test is when at least three RTCP packets have been sent from the SUT, after sending the first RTP packet (one or more RTCP packets may be sent before the first RTP packet).

q_13580.question: What information does the SRNC pass to the CN regarding the position estimate?
q_13580.ground_truth: The SRNC passes the position estimate, including the positioning method used to obtain the estimate, to the CN. If the CN has requested accuracy for the position estimate, the Location response shall include an indication whether the position estimate satisfies the requested accuracy or not.

q_13581.question: What should be the value of the LENGTH field in the Relative List super-field when there is only one codeword in the super-field of type RLIST?
q_13581.ground_truth: The LENGTH field in the Relative List super-field should have a value of 0000 when there is only one codeword in the super-field of type RLIST.

q_13582.question: What does a LCS-QoS object contain?
q_13582.ground_truth: A LCS-QoS object contains a number of optional fields such as horizontal-Requested, vertical-Accuracy, response-Time, and others, as well as a LCS-Service-Type-ID value.

q_13583.question: What actions can UE-2, the new Controller UE, take regarding Media Flow-A if UE-2 only accepts the role of Collaborative Session Controller UE?
q_13583.ground_truth: UE-2 can initiate a media transfer from Controllee UE to another Controllee UE, release the media flow on the Controllee UE, or release the entire Collaborative Session.

q_13584.question: What is the role of the 5G PKMF-1(Remote UE) in Step 2 of the process, and what needs to be done to secure the connection?
q_13584.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF-1(Remote UE) server authenticates and authorizes the Remote UE's ID in Step 2. The same mechanism used to protect the PC3 interface can be reused to secure the connection, such as using solution #5 or solution #11.

q_13585.question: What should the UE calculate if it supports RSRQ measurement on all OFDM symbols and the "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" and "QqualminEUTRA-WB" IEs are both present in the "E-UTRA frequency and priority" occurrence?
q_13585.ground_truth: The UE should calculate the EUTRA-RSRQ-OnAllSymbolsOffset by subtracting the value of the "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" from the value of the "QqualminEUTRA"; the EUTRA-RSRQ-offsetWB by subtracting the value of the "QqualminEUTRA-WB" from the value of the "QqualminEUTRA"; and the QqualminEUTRA by subtracting the value of the EUTRA-RSRQ-offsetWB from the value of the QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols.

q_13586.question: What digital transmission rates are supported for transport over TDM in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_13586.ground_truth: The digital transmission rates supported for transport over TDM are 2048 kbit/s with a frame structure of 32 x 64kbit/s time slots for the E1 interface, and 1544 kbit/s with a frame structure of 24 x 64 kbit/s time slots for the T1 interface.

q_13587.question: What information is included in the From-id information element in the I1 protocol?
q_13587.ground_truth: The From-id information element in the I1 protocol includes either a SIP URI or an E.164 number, and it is used by the SCC AS to identify the ICS UE.

q_13588.question: What should the MS do with the bits from the downlink channel decoder to interface 1 of the uplink channel encoder after closing its TCH loop?
q_13588.ground_truth: The MS should loop back the bits, with the number of bits depending on the codec mode used by the MS to decode the downlink frame being looped back

q_13589.question: In the context of FDD operation, under what conditions should the DRNS use the Traffic Class IE for a specific E-DCH MAC-d flow to determine the transport bearer characteristics to apply between DRNC and Node B?
q_13589.ground_truth: The DRNS should use the Traffic Class IE for a specific E-DCH MAC-d flow to determine the transport bearer characteristics to apply between DRNC and Node B, unless the TrCH Source Statistics Descriptor IE is present with the value ``RRC'' in the E-DCH MAC-d Flows Information IE.

q_13590.question: Which level of the UC prevention pyramid discussed in the report can be realized without changing IMS interfaces and protocols?
q_13590.ground_truth: Levels 1 to 5, as long as UC feedback is not based on changes in SIP signaling

q_13591.question: In what mode should the LTE positioning protocol (LPP) be supported by the UE for the UE to set the LPP bit to "LPP in N1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_13591.ground_truth: The LTE positioning protocol (LPP) should be supported in N1 mode by the UE.

q_13592.question: How does a UE determine which CSG member cells to measure?
q_13592.ground_truth: A UE applies an autonomous search function, per UE implementation, to determine when and where to search for the CSG member cells, and it may ignore not allowed CSG cells in the ranking. The autonomous search procedure is disabled if the UE's CSG whitelist does not exist or is empty.

q_13593.question: What triggers the SMF to initiate a PDU Session Modification Procedure in the case of UPF initiated modification?
q_13593.ground_truth: The UPF initiates the PDU Session Modification procedure by transmitting an N4 Association Update Request, which includes a list of QoS limitations.

q_13594.question: Which procedure is included in the M2AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURES-CLASS-2?

q_13595.question: What should the ng-eNB-DU do if none of the requested modifications of the UE context can be successfully performed?
q_13595.ground_truth: The ng-eNB-DU should respond with the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION FAILURE message with an appropriate cause value.

q_13596.question: What should the H(e)NB check to verify the SeGW's identity?
q_13596.ground_truth: The H(e)NB shall verify the SeGW identity by checking the subjectAltName field of the SeGW certificate against the name of the SeGW used by the H(e)NB to connect to the SeGW.

q_13597.question: What is incremented on transmission by the GGSN of a CREATE PDP CONTEXT RESPONSE message with cause "Request Accepted", and decremented on transmission by the GGSN of a DELETE PDP CONTEXT RESPONSE message with cause "Request Accepted"?
q_13597.ground_truth: The measurement of the number of simultaneous GTP tunnels on Gn interface handled by the GGSN.

q_13598.question: What is the method used for generating CRC bits for the new RTTI coding schemes?
q_13598.ground_truth: The method used for generating the CRC bits for the new RTTI coding schemes is the same as for generating CRC bits for TCH/AFS logical channels.

q_13599.question: What should the UE do if the V2X control function does not receive a request for server-initiated provisioning of the management object within an implementation dependent time after sending of the notification?
q_13599.ground_truth: The V2X control function should determine that the V2X authorization update procedure is unsuccessfully completed if it does not receive a request for server-initiated provisioning of the management object within an implementation dependent time after sending of the notification.

q_13600.question: What information is included in a QoS monitoring event?
q_13600.ground_truth: A QoS monitoring event can include information such as high jitter for TSC flows, notification that maximum survival time is reached for the TSC service, or changes in UE mobility and inter-UE distance. This information is used to determine triggers for TSN policy updates.

q_13601.question: What is the role of the SMLC in the DTAP-LE Information Transfer procedure?
q_13601.ground_truth: The SMLC in the DTAP-LE Information Transfer procedure is responsible for initiating the transfer of LLP messages to a Type A LMU when it has an LLP message to transfer.

q_13602.question: What signalling protocol shall be used when using the SIP-I based CS core network?
q_13602.ground_truth: The signalling protocol used in the SIP-I based CS core network is SIP-I. It is used for call control signalling, and SDP offer and SDP answer information is relayed between ingress and egress signalling paths.

q_13603.question: What is the purpose of the CTS enrolment procedure?
q_13603.ground_truth: The CTS enrolment procedure defines an association between a certain CTS-MS and a certain CTS-FP, and ensures the rights of the CTS-MS to use CTS services on this CTS-FP.

q_13604.question: What is the type of the "traceActivationIndicator" field in the RNCTraceInformation sequence?
q_13604.ground_truth: The "traceActivationIndicator" field in the RNCTraceInformation sequence is of the type ENUMERATED with possible values of "activated" or "deactivated".

q_13605.question: What information can a HNB use to detect if a carrier is occupied by a neighbour cell's primary frequency?
q_13605.ground_truth: The HNB can detect if DwPTS or P-CCPCH is detected on a candidate carrier. If these are detected, the carrier can be affirmed to be occupied by one neighbour cell's primary frequency.

q_13606.question: In the context of FDD, what should the Node B do if the Secondary UL Frequency Activation State is present in the Multicell E-DCH Information IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE?
q_13606.ground_truth: The Node B should use the information as the initial activation state of the Radio Links on the secondary uplink frequency.

q_13607.question: What should the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity prioritize when transmitting data?
q_13607.ground_truth: The transmitting side of an AM RLC entity should prioritize transmission of RLC control PDUs over RLC data PDUs, and retransmission of RLC data PDUs over transmission of new AMD PDUs.

q_13608.question: What should be studied for the enhancement of reliability and reduced latency in sidelink resource allocation mode 2, and what should be considered for this enhancement?
q_13608.ground_truth: The feasibility and benefit of a solution to enhance reliability and reduce latency in sidelink resource allocation mode 2 should be studied. The solution should consider sidelink DRX and inter-UE coordination, where a set of resources is determined at UE-A and sent to UE-B in mode 2 for its own transmission.

q_13609.question: In what circumstances should the Multiple Downlink Assignment 2 information element be used?
q_13609.ground_truth: The Multiple Downlink Assignment 2 information element must only be used by the network for assigning resources to a mobile station that supports multiple TBF procedures in A/Gb mode.

q_13610.question: What should the UE do when it receives a SERVICE REJECT message with 5GMM cause value #28 (Restricted service area) after sending a SERVICE REQUEST message?
q_13610.ground_truth: The UE should perform the mobility registration update procedure.

q_13611.question: What is the purpose of the USAT execution environment?
q_13611.ground_truth: The USAT execution environment provides the mechanisms to operate single or multiple USAT-applications.

q_13612.question: Which source observed a mean UL coverage of -103.35dB in Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR2, DU, UL, AR 1 stream, #UE/cell=Capacity(8~9) in the second set of observations?
q_13612.ground_truth: Source 18 and Source 16 observed a mean UL coverage of -103.35dB in Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR2, DU, UL, AR 1 stream, #UE/cell=Capacity(8~9) in the second set of observations.

q_13613.question: What is the role of the P-TMSI or IMSI in the paging request message used for the packet paging procedure?
q_13613.ground_truth: The mobile station is identified by the P-TMSI (GPRS TMSI) or its IMSI in the paging request message used for the packet paging procedure. If the mobile station is identified by the P-TMSI, it shall proceed as specified in sub-clause 3.5.1.2.

q_13614.question: What is the purpose of the Extended Measurement Frequency List information element?
q_13614.ground_truth: The purpose of the Extended Measurement Frequency List information element is to provide the absolute radio frequency channel numbers of carriers to measure signal strength on.

q_13615.question: Which two service access points are defined in the GSM radio interface for layer 2 signalling, and what do they support?
q_13615.ground_truth: The two service access points defined in the GSM radio interface are SAPI 0 and SAPI 3, where SAPI 0 supports the transfer of signalling information including user-user information and SAPI 3 supports the transfer of user short messages.

q_13616.question: What is the format of the LIID in the context of Lawful Interception?
q_13616.ground_truth: The LIID format consists of alphanumeric characters and may contain a lawful authorization reference number and the date when the lawful authorization was issued.

q_13617.question: What is one of the main challenges in communication for cargo vessels?
q_13617.ground_truth: The main challenge is that containers are packed tightly in high density, often stacked, and many are stowed under-deck where signal propagation is limited.

q_13618.question: What processing is required when both the bit-rate and internal sampling rate change during rate switching?
q_13618.ground_truth: The processing described in clause 6.3.4 is performed first, followed by the processing described in clause 6.3.3 if the internal sampling rate is also changing.

q_13619.question: What is the threshold in quiet given for the first and second equation in the Bark scale?
q_13619.ground_truth: The threshold in quiet is given as 15dB/Bark for the first equation and 30dB/Bark for the second equation.

q_13620.question: How is the maximum output power determined in the case of a single uplink?
q_13620.ground_truth: In the case of a single uplink, there is no need to determine the maximum output power as it is not applicable.

q_13621.question: What are the experimental design constraints for the codec quality characterization test in TS 26.118?
q_13621.ground_truth: The experimental design constraints for the codec quality characterization test in TS 26.118 include each test material being no longer than 12 seconds in duration, no more than four codec operating points being tested for each test material, and each experiment containing no more than 10 test materials.

q_13622.question: What is the requirement for the automation of neighbour relation lists in E-UTRAN, UTRAN, and between different 3GPP Radio Access Technologies?
q_13622.ground_truth: The requirement is to define the necessary interface IPs to enable the automation of neighbour relation lists in E-UTRAN, UTRAN, and between different 3GPP Radio Access Technologies.

q_13623.question: When do fresh RRC and UP keys need to be derived in the eNB?
q_13623.ground_truth: Fresh RRC and UP keys are derived in the eNB during inter-eNB handovers and state transitions.

q_13624.question: What is the expected sequence 1.1 described in 27.22.4.29.4.2 (RECEIVE DATA) procedure?
q_13624.ground_truth: PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1, TERMINAL RESPONSE: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1, PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL 1.1.1, TERMINAL RESPONSE: OPEN CHANNEL 1.1.1A or TERMINAL RESPONSE: OPEN CHANNEL 1.1.1B.

q_13625.question: What is the condition for detecting a lack of low frequency energy?
q_13625.ground_truth: A lack of low frequency energy is detected if the relative energy ratio between two frequency regions is less than a threshold value, which is determined by the average normalized pitch correlation value and the low frequency smoothed energy ratio.

q_13626.question: What type of traffic was used to evaluate the system performance of the LTE uplink?
q_13626.ground_truth: VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol) traffic was used for the evaluation.

q_13627.question: What is the purpose of the correction factor in the independent noise filling algorithm used in IGF?
q_13627.ground_truth: The purpose of the correction factor is to adjust the energy of the inserted pseudo random numbers to match the original noise energy level in the decoded MDCT spectrum.

q_13628.question: What is the test purpose in the 5.3.9.3 section?
q_13628.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the READ EF commands are performed correctly by the ME, the ME correctly uses the 5G-GUTI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST, and the ME stores the new 5G-GUTI in its non-volatile memory if the corresponding file is not present in the USIM.

q_13629.question: How is the Packet Delay Budget (PDB) interpreted for different QCI values in terms of packet delay?
q_13629.ground_truth: Except for QCI 82 and 83, the PDB is interpreted as a maximum delay with a confidence level of 98% for services using a certain QCI in both uplink and downlink. For services using QCI 82 or 83, a packet delayed by more than the PDB is included in the calculation of the PELR if it is within the Maximum Data Burst Volume and GBR requirements.

q_13630.question: What is a codec that can be used for uplink and downlink sessions in the 3GPP speech recognition framework?
q_13630.ground_truth: Default uplink and downlink codec specifications are included in the 3GPP speech recognition framework.

q_13631.question: What are the enumerated values for the "PLMNType" element in the XML data?
q_13631.ground_truth: The enumerated values for the "PLMNType" element in the XML data are "GSM-MAP" and "ANSI-41".

q_13632.question: What are the two deployment models outlined in clause 5.4 of the present document for realizing Multicast ABR Scenario #2?

q_13633.question: What is the role of the RA1'/RAA' function when using the TCH/F14.4 channel coding in A/Gb mode with an AIUR of 64 kbit/s?
q_13633.ground_truth: The RA1'/RAA' function converts between the 64 kbit/s data stream and the input rate to the channel coder when using the TCH/F14.4 channel coding in A/Gb mode with an AIUR of 64 kbit/s.

q_13634.question: What is the role of the Slice PCF in quota management within VPLMN and HPLMN?
q_13634.ground_truth: The Slice PCF in VPLMN allocates quota to the UPF for a specific slice, indicating its association with HPLMN and HPLMN S-NSSAI. If quota management is handled by HPLMN, the Slice PCF in VPLMN needs to communicate with the Slice PCF in HPLMN for quota allocation.

q_13635.question: What is the difference between the 3GP-DASH and MPEG-DASH specifications in terms of transport protocol?
q_13635.ground_truth: In 3GP-DASH, the transport protocol when deployed within PSS is defined as HTTP, while MPEG-DASH does not explicitly define the transport protocol.

q_13636.question: What method is used by the Control Sink to respond when a session is successfully updated with partial modification?
q_13636.ground_truth: The Control Sink responds with a 200 OK success message indicating that the session was successfully updated and includes the session resource identifier of the session that is updated.

q_13637.question: What should be done if the mcdata-allow-short-data-service is set to "false" in the group document?
q_13637.ground_truth: Send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "206 short data service not allowed for this group" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.7.

q_13638.question: What happens to the MM context when a GPRS attach is rejected in the MS?
q_13638.ground_truth: The MM context moves to the PMM-DETACHED state and may be deleted in the MS.

q_13639.question: What is the value of the address field for the 4.4.1 case after the call is allowed with modifications?
q_13639.ground_truth: The value of the address field for the 4.4.1 case after the call is allowed with modifications is "987654321".

q_13640.question: What event triggers the QoS change scenario, and how is it handled?
q_13640.ground_truth: A Quality of Service (QoS) change in the network triggers the QoS change scenario. This request, including the number of units consumed so far, is sent from the serving network element to the SBCF. The SBCF rates the consumed resources, adjusts the account and counters, requests new tariff information, determines granted units and price, and continues bearer/session charging.

q_13641.question: What procedures shall be used when the network reallocates resources while the mobile station is in dual transfer mode?
q_13641.ground_truth: If the mobile station receives a DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message while in dual transfer mode, it shall follow procedures specified in sub-clause 3.4.23.2.

q_13642.question: When is the value of T used in the periodic attempts when the MS is using any of EC-GSM-IoT, Category M1 or Category NB1?
q_13642.ground_truth: The value of T is used in the range of 2 hours to 240 hours, using 2 hour steps from 2 hours to 80 hours and 4 hour steps from 84 hours to 240 hours.

q_13643.question: What kind of features do IRPs support in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
q_13643.ground_truth: IRPs support a set of generic features that allow the retrieval of IRP profile and IRP supported versions.

q_13644.question: How many attempted HTTP DELETE procedures are provided by the measurement XDM.AttHttpDel?

q_13645.question: Which document defines the 3GPP UTRAN NRM IRP XML Definitions for Release 17?
q_13645.ground_truth: Annex B of the present document defines the 3GPP UTRAN NRM IRP XML Definitions for Release 17.

q_13646.question: How are the interferers classified in the analysis?
q_13646.ground_truth: The interferers are classified into the following categories: IcX (dominant co-channel narrow or wide interference), IaX (dominant 1st adjacent channel narrow or wide interference), restIcX (sum of all co-channel interference powers excluding the dominant interferer), and restIaX (sum of all adjacent channel interference powers excluding the dominant interferer).

q_13647.question: What is the significance of bit 8 in the GA-PSR Message Type octet?
q_13647.ground_truth: Bit 8 of the GA-PSR Message Type value is the most significant bit, used to indicate the specific message type. It is defined as set to 0 for Basic GA-PSR indication and set to 1 for Combined GA-PSR confirmation.

q_13648.question: What is the effect of the fine grain modularity of requested analytics?
q_13648.ground_truth: The fine grain modularity of requested analytics enables the specification of which subsets of output elements need to be provided for a given analytics and which additional computations need to be provided on a given output element. This mechanism is specified on a per-analytics basis.

q_13649.question: What is the suggested requirement for making the network aware of the minimum and maximum supported bandwidth requirements negotiated between User Equipments (UEs) for each media direction?
q_13649.ground_truth: The suggested requirement is that "it should be possible to make the network aware of the minimum and maximum supported bandwidth requirements negotiated between the UEs for each media direction."

q_13650.question: What should the SMS Router do if the HLR returns error information when sending a routing information retrieval?
q_13650.ground_truth: The SMS Router should forward the returned error information transparently to the SMS-GMSC.

q_13651.question: What steps must the UE follow when receiving a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message over E-UTRAN?
q_13651.ground_truth: The UE must include the NBIFOM container IE and NBIFOM IP flow mapping parameter in the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message of the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure.

q_13652.question: What is the purpose of the Initial HeMS's FQDN or IP address in clauses 5.1.2.2 and 5.1.2.3?
q_13652.ground_truth: The Initial HeMS's FQDN or IP address in clauses 5.1.2.2 and 5.1.2.3 is required for the HeNB to establish a secure connection with Initial SeGW and Initial HeMS, as well as a TR-069 session with Initial HeMS for HeNB registration with Serving HeMS.

q_13653.question: What is the goal of the NPN support for Video, Imaging and Audio for Professional Applications (VIAPA) key issue?
q_13653.ground_truth: The goal of the key issue is to study support for service continuity between PLMN and NPN, and to enable a UE to receive data services from one network and paging as well as data services from another network simultaneously.

q_13654.question: What 5G MBS system architecture entity is responsible for storing multicast context information in the UDR for the PDU Session Modification procedure?

q_13655.question: How does the Total Accessible Resource Requested field of the Extended Resource Indicator IE affect the subsequent mode field?
q_13655.ground_truth: If the Resource Indication Method is not set to method ii) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, then the Subsequent Mode field is ignored. However, if the Resource Indication Method is set to method ii) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, then the Subsequent Mode field is decoded as method iv) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, and the subsequent mode shall be i) or iii) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, depending on the reporting mode prior to receipt of this IE. If the reporting mode prior to receipt of this IE is neither i) or iii) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, then the subsequent mode shall be method iv) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1.

q_13656.question: What is the maximum allowable delay that can be introduced by the IPE for in-band signalling information during normal operation?
q_13656.ground_truth: The maximum allowable delay is a multiple of 20 ms.

q_13657.question: What information shall the RNC1 include in the DIRECT INFORMATION TRANSFER message in the case of MBMS Channel Type Indication?
q_13657.ground_truth: The RNC1 shall include the Channel Type Information IE in the DIRECT INFORMATION TRANSFER message, which indicates the channel type and the PTM Cell List IE, the PTP Cell List IE and/or the Not Provided Cell List IE.

q_13658.question: What is the major aspect covered in this solution for PC5 service authorization and policy/parameter provisioning to a UE?
q_13658.ground_truth: The two major aspects covered in this solution are enhancing procedures related to PC5 service authorization and policy/parameter provisioning to a UE and identifying necessary information for PC5 service authorization and provisioning.

q_13659.question: What should the IM-MGW return if it receives a time alignment request on the Nb interface for the EVS codec?
q_13659.ground_truth: The IM-MGW shall return NACK indication time alignment not supported as there is no such procedure on the Mb interface.

q_13660.question: What measures should be taken to preserve the structure of ProSe Codes before security processing, as noted in NOTE 1?
q_13660.ground_truth: The measures should be taken in a way that does not affect the security of the ProSe Codes.

q_13661.question: What are the two 3GPP audio codecs that participated as reference codecs in the ITU-T tests?

q_13662.question: What is the MRFP's role when comparing session IDs in MSRP media handling?
q_13662.ground_truth: The MRFP shall compare only the session-id of the received MSRP packets with the stored session-id, which is in accordance with IETF draft-ietf-simple-msrp-sessmatch-10 and compatible with peers using IETF RFC 4975 or RFC 6714.

q_13663.question: What condition must be satisfied for the leaving condition C2-2 of the event?
q_13663.ground_truth: The leaving condition C2-2 is satisfied when the inequality C2-2, which involves the measurement result of channel busy ratio of the transmission resource pool and the threshold parameter, is fulfilled.

q_13664.question: How will the UE decide to perform measurements on NR inter-frequencies or inter-RAT frequency cells of equal or lower priority?
q_13664.ground_truth: The UE measures NR inter-frequencies or inter-RAT frequency cells of equal or lower priority when the serving cell does not meet Srxlev > SnonIntraSearchP and Squal > SnonIntraSearchQ.

q_13665.question: What is the purpose of the test described in clause 7.1.3.4.1.3?
q_13665.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in clause 7.1.3.4.1.3 is to ensure that when the UE is requested to make a non-lossless handover by SS, it is able to transmit and receive the next PDCP Data PDU with SN value 0.

q_13666.question: What conditions must be satisfied for the UE to consider the entering condition for event B2 to be met, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.4.9?
q_13666.ground_truth: The UE considers the entering condition for event B2 to be satisfied when both conditions B2-1 and B2-2, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.4.9, are fulfilled.

q_13667.question: What should the RNC do if it has received Redirection Indication IE from all attempted CN operators?
q_13667.ground_truth: The RNC shall select the most appropriate NAS-PDU among the NAS-PDU IEs received from the attempted CN nodes based on the stored information as part of the Rerouting function and send it back to the UE.

q_13668.question: What action should a mobile station take to initiate the notification response procedure?
q_13668.ground_truth: If access to the network is allowed, the mobile station should initiate the immediate assignment procedure as specified in 3.3.1 and send a NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message on a dedicated signalling link.

q_13669.question: What is the RIM routing address used for in the Radio Access Network?
q_13669.ground_truth: The RIM routing address identifies the source or destination BSS when RIM is used to support the exchange of information within the Radio Access Network. The routing address can be the cell identifier (RAI + CI) for GERAN and UTRAN, the eNB identifier for E-UTRAN, or the eHRPD Sector ID IE for eHRPD.

q_13670.question: What QoS attribute must be explicitly requested when the application in the UE requires streaming or conversational QoS?
q_13670.ground_truth: The guaranteed bit rate and the maximum bit rate should be explicitly requested when the application in the UE requires streaming or conversational QoS.

q_13671.question: What information does the UE include in the UE radio capability ID IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if both a network-assigned UE radio capability ID and a manufacturer-assigned UE Radio Capability ID are applicable?
q_13671.ground_truth: The UE includes the network-assigned UE radio capability ID in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_13672.question: What is the special type of roaming service called when a Disaster Condition is in effect?
q_13672.ground_truth: The special type of roaming service is called "Disaster Roaming."

q_13673.question: What is the Time-Usage AVP used for and what type of AVP is it?
q_13673.ground_truth: The Time-Usage AVP is of type Unsigned32 and holds the effective used time within the service data container reporting interval.

q_13674.question: What is the format of the IP addresses used in this text?
q_13674.ground_truth: The IP addresses used in this text follow the standard dotted decimal format (x.x.x.x) where each "x" represents a decimal number between 0 and 255.

q_13675.question: What is the purpose of the ExpiryTime parameter in the described scenario?
q_13675.ground_truth: The ExpiryTime parameter defines how long the tariff information is valid after the timestamp of the TariffRequest that triggered the response. It is used to ensure a subsequent tariff retrieval operation after a specified time period has passed or when handling multiple tariff switches.

q_13676.question: What should be done if 1 set of e-parameters is received and there is no Tariff Switch running for the Session, but there are e-parameters stored for it?

q_13677.question: Which entity decides the delivery mode for scenario 1 (Fast Start-up) and scenario 7 (time-shifted viewing)?
q_13677.ground_truth: In scenario 1, it is the Application that decides the delivery mode, and in scenario 7, it is unclear which entity makes this decision.

q_13678.question: What should be stored in the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" in the UE?
q_13678.ground_truth: Each entry in the list consists of the PLMN identity, the geographical location, if known, where 5GMM cause value #78 "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" was received, and a UE implementation specific distance value if the geographical location exists.

q_13679.question: What is the minimum requirement for the maximum power measured at step c) for a GSM 900 or DCS 1800 BSS in section 6.6.2.1.4?
q_13679.ground_truth: The maximum power measured shall not exceed -47 dBm for a GSM 900 BSS or -57 dBm for a DCS 1800 BSS

q_13680.question: What event triggers a UE to send a measurement report based on the SFN-SFN time difference measurement type 2 changing more than a defined threshold in a UTRAN measurement control message?
q_13680.ground_truth: The UE should send a measurement report when the SFN-SFN time difference measurement type 2 of any measured cell changes more than the threshold defined by the IE "Threshold SFN-SFN change."

q_13681.question: What is the maximum number of taps recommended for the TU channel model when using DSR?
q_13681.ground_truth: For TU channel model, it is recommended to use 6 taps for DSR.

q_13682.question: What is the initiated message for the "radioLinkDeletion" procedure?

q_13683.question: What should the 3GPP system support when differentiating the priority between the audio and video streams of a given MPS Service User on an MMTEL video conference call with multiple participants when MPS is invoked?

q_13684.question: What message is sent by the source GANC to the MS during the preparation phase of a PS handover from GAN mode to UTRAN in a GAN cell?
q_13684.ground_truth: The GA-PSR HANDOVER INFORMATION message is sent by the MS to the GANC to provide a list of target UTRAN cells, identified by a combination of LAI and 3G Cell Identity/CGI, in order of preference for PS handover.

q_13685.question: What is the impact of the solution on existing procedures, functions, and architecture in 3GPP?
q_13685.ground_truth: The solution does not imply any impacts on existing procedures, functions, and architecture as it is based on the Uplink Classifier and multi-homing, which are already specified in TS~23.501 and TS~23.502.

q_13686.question: What is the role of the block sequence numbers at the receiver in the HS-HARQ mechanism?
q_13686.ground_truth: The block sequence numbers at the receiver in the HS-HARQ mechanism are used to reorder the blocks from the various ARQ processes.

q_13687.question: What action is taken by the USS/UTM after a successful pairing authorization?
q_13687.ground_truth: After a successful pairing authorization, the USS/UTM sends the Authorization Response Information with Success Indication, UAV ID, UAV-C ID, UAS ID, and Session Security Information to the UAV, and stores the UAV ID and UAV-C ID along with the pairing authorization status and UAS ID for later use.

q_13688.question: What should be considered as a good frame in the absence of information from the codec layer?
q_13688.ground_truth: A good frame is derived based on N, which represents the maximum duration between two subsequent refresh frames in milliseconds.

q_13689.question: Within the "CommonTransportChannelResourcesFailure-IEs" RNSAP-PROTOCOL-IES, what is the importance of "id-Cause" and "id-CriticalityDiagnostics"?
q_13689.ground_truth: In the "CommonTransportChannelResourcesFailure-IEs" RNSAP-PROTOCOL-IES, two vital fields are CRITICALITY ignore and TYPE Cause and CriticalityDiagnostics respectively.Cause provides the reason or cause for the failure of common transport channel resources, and CriticalityDiagnostics deliver supplementary resolution, correlation, and context details. They are mandatory or optional depending on the construction.

q_13690.question: How are the MLP levels employed for ASC selection at the MAC sublayer when RACH transmission is performed in the UE?
q_13690.ground_truth: The MLP levels are employed for ASC selection at the MAC sublayer in the range of 1,...,8 when RACH transmission is performed in the UE.

q_13691.question: Who is responsible for deciding when the UE should indicate to the network that a PDN connection access can or cannot be used for traffic routing?
q_13691.ground_truth: The UE decides this using its Local Operating Environment (as defined in TS~23.261).

q_13692.question: What are the modulation symbols used by E-DPDCH?
q_13692.ground_truth: E-DPDCH can use BPSK, 4PAM, or 8PAM modulation symbols.

q_13693.question: In the context of cell selection, what is the difference between the cellBarred field in the MIB message and the cell status being "barred" due to being unable to acquire the MIB/SIB1?
q_13693.ground_truth: The cellBarred field in the MIB message is used to indicate if a cell is barred, and it is common for all PLMNs. If the cellBarred field is set to "barred", the UE shall not be permitted to select/reselect this cell, not even for emergency calls. On the other hand, if the cell status is being treated as if it is "barred" because the UE is unable to acquire the MIB or SIB1, the UE may exclude the barred cell as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for up to 300 seconds, and may select another cell on the same frequency if the re-selection criteria are fulfilled. However, if the intraFreqReselection in MIB message is set to "not allowed", the UE shall not re-select a cell on the same frequency as the barred cell.

q_13694.question: What does the P field in the PHR MAC CE indicate in relation to power backoff?
q_13694.ground_truth: The P field in the PHR MAC CE indicates whether the MAC entity applies power backoff due to power management.

q_13695.question: What is the puncturing rate and the length of the block of Kpc coded bits for each type of channel in the document?
q_13695.ground_truth: The puncturing rate is Kpc/((Kd+18)*3), where Kpc is the length of the block of Kpc coded bits, and (Kd+18)*3 is the length of the block of coded bits before puncturing. For EC-PACCH/D, Kpc = 114; for EC-CCCH/D and EC-PICH, Kpc = 116; for EC-PACCH/U/1, EC-PACCH/U/4, EC-PACCH/U/8, EC-PACCH/U/16 and Kpc = 106 for EC-PACCH/U/48.

q_13696.question: What is the purpose of using the Option Field of the IP header or TCP header for transporting NIP response?
q_13696.ground_truth: The Option Field of the IP header or TCP header can provide 40 bytes for transporting NIP response. However, if the length of the NIP request or response is larger than 40 bytes, it can be split into smaller parts and each part is delivered in the Option Field, but this can introduce implementation complexity.

q_13697.question: What should the UE do when it receives a PDCP status report in the downlink for radio bearers mapped on RLC AM?
q_13697.ground_truth: The UE should confirm the successful delivery of the corresponding PDCP SDU if the bitmap value is 1 or if the associated COUNT value is less than the identified PDCP SDU, and then process the PDCP SDU as specified in clause 5.4.

q_13698.question: What are some mechanisms provided to support interoperator interworking in IP Networks?
q_13698.ground_truth: Some mechanisms provided to support interoperator interworking in IP Networks include signalling along the flow path, interaction between network management entities, and service level agreements enforced by the border routers between networks.

q_13699.question: What is the impact of user mobility in the context of RAN user plane congestion information reporting and PCRF operation?
q_13699.ground_truth: The PCRF maintains the RCAF that last indicated that the UE is affected by congestion and sends a message to the old RCAF to release context when a new RCAF indicates that the UE is affected by congestion. RCAF nodes cannot detect mobility by themselves: an RCAF node cannot differentiate whether a UE that is no longer affected by congestion has moved to another RCAF or not.

q_13700.question: What happens if the requested QoS profile can not be provided in the Radio Access Bearer Assignment Request message?
q_13700.ground_truth: The SGSN may send a new Radio Access Bearer Assignment Request message with different QoS profile(s), and for each RAB re-established, the SGSN initiates a PDP Context Modification procedure to inform the MS and the GGSN of the new negotiated QoS profile for the corresponding PDP context.

q_13701.question: What condition must be met for the UE to establish an RRC connection for the registration procedure?
q_13701.ground_truth: The UE must find a cell which provides access by NR NTN RAT and must not have a valid GNSS position.

q_13702.question: How many possible values can a Temporary Flow Identity (TFI) have in GERAN?
q_13702.ground_truth: A TFI (Temporary Flow Identity) identifies a TBF (Temporary Block Flow) on PDTCHs and has one of 32 possible values.

q_13703.question: What should the gsmSRF/SSF do when all requested digits have been received in DTMF tone detection as per clause 14.1.2.3?
q_13703.ground_truth: After all requested digits have been received, the gsmSRF/SSF should report the digits to the gsmSCF as per the procedures described in clause 14.4.2.

q_13704.question: What is the purpose of re-normalizing the delay spread after scaling the powers in the channel model?
q_13704.ground_truth: The purpose of re-normalizing the delay spread after scaling the powers in the channel model is to ensure that the delay spread is still 1 after adjusting the K-factor.

q_13705.question: What does the 3GPP use to indicate recommendations and permissions in the technical specifications?
q_13705.ground_truth: The terms "should", "should not", "may", and "need not" are used to indicate recommendations and permissions in the 3GPP technical specifications.

q_13706.question: Which security feature is used in the mobile equipment identification feature within network access security?
q_13706.ground_truth: The IMEI or IMEISV of the terminal is used in mobile equipment identification feature to securely identify the mobile equipment to the network.

q_13707.question: When the UE requires the delivery of Assistance Data for GPS Assisted positioning method, what is the result of the MAP process access request?
q_13707.ground_truth: The result of the MAP process access request is the PERFORM LOCATION request, which includes the LOCATION RELATED DATA FAILURE with the BSSMAP information elements and the corresponding RANAP information elements.

q_13708.question: What are the two methods for transporting an MTP3-user signalling message in the IP-based SS7 signalling transport network?
q_13708.ground_truth: The two methods for transporting an MTP3-user signalling message in the IP-based SS7 signalling transport network are through M3UA and MTP3-M2PA.

q_13709.question: What is the role of the MBSF in 5GS?
q_13709.ground_truth: The MBSF controls the MBSUs for user plane management and acts as a media anchor for MBS traffic in 5GS.

q_13710.question: What is the issue with background acoustic noise during Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) in the GSM Enhanced Full Rate speech channel?
q_13710.ground_truth: The background acoustic noise might disappear when the radio transmission is cut, causing discontinuities in the background noise which can be very annoying for the listener.

q_13711.question: What information is an IRI record required to contain?
q_13711.ground_truth: IRI records are required to contain information available from normal provider operating procedures, as well as specific information for identification and control purposes.

q_13712.question: What is the range of the final response time with the test tolerance added?
q_13712.ground_truth: The response time ranges between 2.3s and 660.3s.

q_13713.question: What type of address is used for the Address field in the first Interface to Core Network and Bearer?

q_13714.question: What must the UE do to deregister from one or more MBMS User Services?
q_13714.ground_truth: The UE shall perform an MBMS User Service De-registration, which shall be done irrespective of the type of MBMS Transport Service.

q_13715.question: What method did operator #1 use to identify the problem in sub case #2?
q_13715.ground_truth: Operator #1 analyzed QoE metrics within a geographic area covering the business area #CBD and from neighbor cells.

q_13716.question: What should the local NEF do when the SMF reports a new local UPF ID or address for a UE due to UE IP address change?
q_13716.ground_truth: The local NEF should trigger another Nx establishment with the new local UPF when the SMF reports a new local UPF ID or address for a UE due to UE IP address change.

q_13717.question: What should a mobile station do when there is no other message scheduled on the SACCH and a layer 2 frame is due to be sent?
q_13717.ground_truth: The mobile station should send a MEASUREMENT REPORT message, an ENHANCED MEASUREMENT REPORT, or an EXTENDED MEASUREMENT REPORT message in that frame.

q_13718.question: What message does the SRNC send to the SAS in case of congestion or any other failure that prevents it from accepting a PCAP Position Activation Request message?
q_13718.ground_truth: The PCAP Position Activation Failure message is sent to the SAS on the Iupc interface.

q_13719.question: What is the purpose of Intent-driven MnS Producer when notifying Intent-driven MnS Consumer about the fulfilment information of UE throughput optimization?
q_13719.ground_truth: Intent driven MnS Producer may notify Intent driven MnS Consumer about the fulfilment information of UE throughput optimization during intent execution to provide feedback on the performance of the network.

q_13720.question: What is the difference in resource allocation between an USF received in the first reduced radio block period and an USF received in the second reduced radio block period, when in RTTI USF mode?
q_13720.ground_truth: The USF received in the first reduced radio block period allocates resources for one or four uplink RTTI radio blocks in the second reduced radio block period of the current and following basic radio block periods, while an USF received in the second reduced radio block period allocates resources for one or four uplink RTTI radio blocks in the first reduced radio block period of the next and following basic radio block periods.

q_13721.question: What is the unit of the IPSliceDuration field in the IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard?
q_13721.ground_truth: The unit of the IPSliceDuration field in the IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard is 10 milliseconds.

q_13722.question: What response should the IP-SM-GW send if service level interworking of Instant Message to Short Message is not possible due to unsupported media types?
q_13722.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW should send a SIP 415 (Unsupported Media Type) response with an Accept header field listing the types of text media supported by SM.

q_13723.question: What are the two delivery methods for an associated procedure description instance for the associated delivery procedures?
q_13723.ground_truth: The two delivery methods for an associated procedure description instance for the associated delivery procedures are during a User Service Discovery / Announcement prior to the MBMS download session along with the session description (out-of-band of that session), or in-band within a MBMS download session.

q_13724.question: Which message is sent by the RNC to establish a MBMS Iu signalling connection and if needed a MBMS RAB?
q_13724.ground_truth: The 9.1.58 MBMS SESSION START message is sent by the CN to establish a MBMS Iu signalling connection and if needed a MBMS RAB.
