q_13983.ground_truth: The number of channel status data objects in the GET STATUS command response is the same as the number of channels supported by the ME.

q_13984.question: What call handling features are affected by Priority Service?
q_13984.ground_truth: Call waiting, call forwarding, and call redirection are affected by Priority Service. Priority Service call users will not receive an incoming call indication while the call is being queued. Service users will not be allowed to invoke Priority Service calls through call forwarding or re-direction.

q_13985.question: What is the purpose of PLMN selection when a "Disaster Condition" applies?
q_13985.ground_truth: The UE shall perform PLMN selection as specified, with the addition that if all available PLMNs are in the UE's "forbidden PLMNs" list, the UE may indicate whether the available PLMNs can accommodate Disaster Inbound Roamers. Once the MS has registered on a PLMN without Disaster Condition and the PLMN without Disaster Condition is selected by the user, the MS shall not automatically register on a different PLMN unless the new PLMN is declared as an equivalent PLMN by the registered PLMN and the new PLMN can accommodate Disaster Inbound Roamers.

q_13986.question: How is the initial power of the HS-SCCH determined?
q_13986.ground_truth: The initial power of the HS-SCCH is at the discretion of the Node-B, and it can be optionally power controlled following the initial transmission using TPC commands sent by the UE.

q_13987.question: What is the role of the U AV in the solution for replacing the UAV Controller of a UAS?
q_13987.ground_truth: The UAV is required to register, authorize, and communicate with the UAV Controller 1 and 2 as necessary for the successful replacement of the UAV Controller.

q_13988.question: How does a UE segment the encoded RRC PDU when initiating the UL message segment transfer procedure?
q_13988.ground_truth: The UE segments the encoded RRC PDU based on the maximum supported size of a PDCP SDU specified in TS 38.323. The UE should minimize the number of segments and set the contents of the ULDedicatedMessageSegment messages accordingly.

q_13989.question: What is the Payload Protocol Identifier assigned by IANA for M2-AP and M3-AP in E-UTRAN?
q_13989.ground_truth: The Payload Protocol Identifier assigned by IANA for M2-AP is 43 and for M3-AP is 44 in E-UTRAN.

q_13990.question: What should the DRNS do with existing secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Links undergoing intra-DRNS secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link change?
q_13990.ground_truth: The DRNS should release the HS-PDSCH resources on the old secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link and setup the HS-PDSCH resources on the new secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link. If no E-DCH resources are allocated to the Radio Link, the DRNS shall remove the old secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link. Non cell specific secondary serving Radio Link and non cell specific secondary serving HS-DSCH parameters take the same values as for the serving HS-DSCH cell.

q_13991.question: What should the MME allocate as the default LAI for SMS over SGs when not all MSCs support the SGs interface?
q_13991.ground_truth: The MME should allocate a default (non-broadcast) LAI associated with a VLR that supports the SGs interface in such situations.

q_13992.question: How does the network verify the forwarded-to number before accepting a call forwarding request?
q_13992.ground_truth: The network verifies the forwarded-to number by checking if the number is within the allowed number range before accepting the call forwarding request.

q_13993.question: Which message is sent between RNCs during Relocation?
q_13993.ground_truth: The 9.1.43 RANAP RELOCATION INFORMATION message is sent between RNCs during Relocation.

q_13994.question: What is the requirement for the uplink control signalling of each stream in dual stream transmission?
q_13994.ground_truth: The uplink control signalling of each stream, including ACK/NACK, RMF, and RTBS information, shall be sent within one HS-SICH TTI. A new format of HS-SICH with SF=8 is used to maintain the same code rate as the legacy HS-SICH.

q_13995.question: How are the mixing parameters and estimated for bit rates less than 24.4 kb/s?
q_13995.ground_truth: The mixing parameters and are estimated using equations (1571) and (1572) respectively, in the case where the bit rates are less than 24.4 kb/s.

q_13996.question: What does the acronym FACH stand for in HSDSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify-Unsynchronised?

q_13997.question: Under what conditions should the Node B reject the procedure when the DCH Enhancements Information IE is present in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message in FDD?
q_13997.ground_truth: The Node B should reject the procedure if the DL DPCH Slot Format IE is not set to "17" or "18" or if the UL DPCCH Slot Format IE is not set to "5".

q_13998.question: What is the current status of the present document as per the 3GPP?
q_13998.ground_truth: The contents of the present document are subject to continuing work within the TSG and may change following formal TSG approval. It will be re-released by the TSG with an identifying change of release date and an increase in version number after TSG approval.

q_13999.question: How are the fine gain adjustment bits derived in the Harmonic mode for the bit allocation process?
q_13999.ground_truth: The fine gain adjustment bits are derived in the same manner as in the encoder, where more bits are allocated to the bands in a perceptually significant group than those in a less significant group.

q_14000.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the NBMP Workflow Manager?
q_14000.ground_truth: The NBMP Workflow Manager discovers various MPEs and finds enough number of MPEs to run the workflow.

q_14001.question: What makes codec re-negotiation more cumbersome for MCPTT compared to typical point-to-point calls?
q_14001.ground_truth: Codec re-negotiation for MCPTT requires waiting for confirmations from all participants, which can take longer due to poor radio conditions and additional information transmission.

q_14002.question: What are the three types of CC aggregation scenarios based on UE capability in LTE-Advanced?
q_14002.ground_truth: Intra band contiguous CC aggregation, Intra band non-contiguous CC aggregation, and Inter band non-contiguous CC aggregation are the three types of CC aggregation scenarios based on UE capability in LTE-Advanced.

q_14003.question: What is the size of the Serving Cell ID field in the Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE?
q_14003.ground_truth: The size of the Serving Cell ID field in the Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE is 5 bits.

q_14004.question: What sub-layer shall not be implemented on the Gb interface for Frame Relay?
q_14004.ground_truth: The DL-CONTROL sub-layer shall not be implemented on the Gb interface.

q_14005.question: What is the source device in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.7.1?
q_14005.ground_truth: The source device is UICC in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.7.1.

q_14006.question: What is used by the GA-CSR REQUEST message in the GA-CSR Connection Establishment procedure?
q_14006.ground_truth: The GA-CSR REQUEST message is used by the MS to initiate GA-CSR connection establishment and it contains the Establishment Cause indicating the reason for GA-CSR connection establishment.

q_14007.question: What is the condition to use a specified integrity protection algorithm?
q_14007.ground_truth: If the IE "Integrity protection algorithm" is present, the specified integrity protection algorithm should be used.

q_14008.question: How is the content of the present 3GPP Technical Specification document structured?
q_14008.ground_truth: The content of the document is structured into four main sections: Scope, Definitions and Abbraviations, Solution Set Definitions, and References. The scope section gives an overview of the document, the Definitions and Abbraviations section lays out the terms and abbreviations used in the document, the Solution Set Definitions section defines the contents of the two solution sets: CORBA SS and XML definitions, and References lists the documentation and standards used in the creation of the 3GPP Technical Specification.

q_14009.question: How is non-call related supplementary service information transmitted in IRI records?
q_14009.ground_truth: Non-call related service information is transmitted as received from the signalling protocol. It is a general principle to transmit such information as received from the signalling protocol.

q_14010.question: What is CR 2 in 10.1.7.2?
q_14010.ground_truth: CR 2 in 10.1.7.2 verifies that if the UE supporting CSG selection has attempted manual CSG selection, the UE, when receiving the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message, shall check if the CSG ID of the cell where the UE has sent the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message is contained in the Allowed CSG list. If not, the UE shall add that CSG ID to the Allowed CSG list EFACSGL.

q_14011.question: What must an MS do when a change of BSIC is detected on a carrier?
q_14011.ground_truth: Any existing received signal level measurement shall be discarded and the carrier shall be treated as a new carrier.

q_14012.question: In the reality TV show the voice is described as mellow, which means what?

q_14013.question: What is the effect of the third digit in the version numbering system used in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification?
q_14013.ground_truth: The third digit in the version numbering system (x.y.z) used in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated in the document.

q_14014.question: What information should the IWF cache if the SIP re-INVITE request is a valid request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call cancellation?
q_14014.ground_truth: The IWF should cache the information that the MCPTT user no longer has an outstanding MCPTT imminent peril group call, after successfully processing the SIP re-INVITE request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call cancellation.

q_14015.question: What is the spreading factor used for the HS-SCCH, HS-SICH, and E-PUCH?
q_14015.ground_truth: The spreading factor used for the HS-SCCH, HS-SICH, and E-PUCH is SF = 16.

q_14016.question: What is the role of the Tester Object (TO) in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_14016.ground_truth: The Tester Object (TO) is a managed object that is instantiated for the purpose of monitoring and controlling a test invocation. Each test invocation has one associated TO, which is created and deleted by managed objects with TARR functionality.

q_14017.question: What are some key modelling objectives for channel models in 5G systems?
q_14017.ground_truth: Some key objectives include taking into account the outcome of RAN-level discussions in the '5G' requirement study item, considering complexity in terms of description, generating channel coefficients, development complexity, and simulation time, supporting frequency range up to 100 GHz, and supporting large channel bandwidths.

q_14018.question: Which column provides the actual criticality information as defined in subclause 10.3.2?
q_14018.ground_truth: The "Assigned Criticality" column provides the actual criticality information as defined in subclause 10.3.2.

q_14019.question: What is the formula for calculating the minimum output power for intra-band con-current V2X operation for NR sidelink as specified in clause 6.3E.1 in TS38.101-1?
q_14019.ground_truth: The requirement for NR sidelink is specified in clause 6.3E.1 in TS38.101-1.

q_14020.question: What message does CDF send to CGF1 when it receives the Data Record Transfer Response message with the Cause value being "Request related to possibly duplicated packets already fulfilled"?
q_14020.ground_truth: CDF gives the CGF2 a command to release the corresponding CDR packet(s) from CGF2's buffer for potentially duplicated packets.

q_14021.question: What should the SGSN do if it receives a Delete MBMS Context Request as part of the GPRS Detach procedure?
q_14021.ground_truth: The SGSN shall delete the MBMS UE context and always reply to the Delete MBMS Context Request.

q_14022.question: What measures can be taken to deal with botnet scenarios in UC detection?
q_14022.ground_truth: Measures to deal with botnet scenarios in UC detection include content analysis, in-session detection, rating, and response methods, and careful trade-off between the complexity imposed to IMS and the expected threat.

q_14023.question: What information is included in the MBMS RADIO BEARER INFORMATION signalling flow?
q_14023.ground_truth: The MBMS Service Id, radio bearer, transport channel, and physical channel information per MBMS service is included in this signalling flow.

q_14024.question: What is the meaning of the "Cause Value" in the "Cause" element?
q_14024.ground_truth: The "Cause Value" in the "Cause" element is a code that indicates the reason for a particular event to have occurred, grouped into classes that represent normal events, resource unavailability, service or option not available but implemented, service or option not implemented or currently disabled, invalid message, protocol error, or interworking.

q_14025.question: What is the function of the Mobile Content Provider in section 5.3?
q_14025.ground_truth: The Mobile Content Provider, also known as Mobile PBCP, provides personal broadcasting service using mobile devices for outdoor group activities such as guided tours and carpooling.

q_14026.question: What does the "Timing Advance Command" field in the fallbackRAR indicate?
q_14026.ground_truth: The "Timing Advance Command" field in the fallbackRAR indicates the index value TA used to control the amount of timing adjustment that the MAC entity has to apply.

q_14027.question: What information is stored in the node named "V2XNRFrequency"?
q_14027.ground_truth: It contains the V2X NR frequency to which the V2X service identifier value associated to the same mapping rule is mapped.

q_14028.question: What is the general result for OPEN CHANNEL command in 27.22.11.5~Test requirement?
q_14028.ground_truth: Command performed successfully or Command performed with modifications

q_14029.question: What are the two cases identified for the specification of MMTEL data over Ud?
q_14029.ground_truth: The two cases identified for the specification of MMTEL data over Ud are: (1) the Ud interface between a TAS-FE and UDR, and (2) the Ud interface between a HSS-FE (supporting IMS) and the UDR.

q_14030.question: What should the controlling MCData function include in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request if the SIP MESSAGE is to be sent on behalf of a user homed in the IWF?
q_14030.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should create the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body, the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body, and the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload MIME body in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request.

q_14031.question: What should the UE do if the received UL grant value is different in size than the MSGA payload in a 2-step RA type procedure?
q_14031.ground_truth: The behavior of the UE is not defined in this situation.

q_14032.question: What are the advantages of the multi-loop decoding used in the SHVC architecture over the single-loop decoding used in SVC?
q_14032.ground_truth: The multi-loop decoding used in the SHVC architecture allows for more flexibility in inter-layer prediction, allowing all samples from the reference layers within the specified reference regions to be used, whereas the single-loop decoding of SVC has limitations such as not supporting arbitrary down-switching at any picture and negatively impacting coding efficiency.

q_14033.question: Who does the source RNC/BSS send a Relocation Required message to when deciding to initiate an inter RAT/mode PS handover towards the GERAN A/Gb mode?
q_14033.ground_truth: The source RNC/BSS sends a Relocation Required message to the 3G/2G SGSN when deciding to initiate an inter RAT/mode PS handover towards the GERAN A/Gb mode.

q_14034.question: What is the difference in performance between the "communication optimized approach 2" (green line) and the "default approach" (red line) in Solution 9?
q_14034.ground_truth: The "communication optimized approach 2" (green line) shows the best performance in all cases compared to the "default approach" (red line) in Solution 9.

q_14035.question: In which scenarios can the PCRF based P-CSCF restoration be used in roaming scenarios?
q_14035.ground_truth: The PCRF based P-CSCF restoration can be used in roaming scenarios if both HPLMN and VPLMN support it, or when HPLMN does not support it but VPLMN does and NAT is not performed.

q_14036.question: What does the abbreviation GPS stand for?

q_14037.question: What should the AMF do with the UE's PDU sessions when the UE de-registers for 5GS services over non-3GPP access?
q_14037.ground_truth: When the UE de-registers for 5GS services over non-3GPP access, the AMF shall release the PDU sessions for this particular UE locally without peer-to-peer signaling between the UE and the network.

q_14038.question: In EGPRS, what should a mobile station do if it is required to transmit in MCS-7, MCS-8, or MCS-9 but there is only one RLC block that can be transmitted in that MCS?
q_14038.ground_truth: The mobile station should transmit the RLC block in MCS-5 for MCS-7, MCS-6 for MCS-8 or MCS-9, and padding is permitted for case b (MCS-8).

q_14039.question: What message does the 3G/2G SGSN send to the target BSS during a PS handover preparation phase?
q_14039.ground_truth: The 3G/2G SGSN sends a PS Handover Request message to the target BSS during a PS handover preparation phase.

q_14040.question: Which organization is responsible for the PDP Type Number for Non-IP?
q_14040.ground_truth: ETSI is responsible for the PDP Type Number for Non-IP.

q_14041.question: What is the AMR-WB codec speech quality equivalent to when it comes to 90% of the cell area in VoLTE systems?
q_14041.ground_truth: The AMR-WB codec speech quality is equivalent to 90% of the cell area in VoLTE systems, with the speech quality starting to degrade in the remaining 10% at FERs above 2%.

q_14042.question: What type of traffic is the XDMS designed for?

q_14043.question: What action is taken if an odd number of PCOMP values are used by a compression algorithm?
q_14043.ground_truth: The last PCOMP value is set to 0 in the compression field by the transmitting SNDCP entity, and it is ignored by the receiving SNDCP entity.

q_14044.question: What is the effect of the absence of the "App-ID" node on the evaluation of an IP flow?
q_14044.ground_truth: The absence of the "App-ID" node indicates that the application identifier is not examined when matching packets against the IP flow description of the rule.

q_14045.question: Who is responsible for checking the area restriction and session start time based on the Interest TMGIs in the List of Allowed TMGI?

q_14046.question: What is the purpose of a test eCall?
q_14046.ground_truth: A test eCall is used to confirm that the IVS is capable of correctly sending the MSD to the Test PSAP and providing a voice circuit to enable communication between the tester and the PSAP.

q_14047.question: What is the purpose of charging data in the context of MBMS?
q_14047.ground_truth: Charging data is used to track and bill the usage of MBMS services. It is generated at the MBMS Transport Service layer and the MBMS User Service layer, and may be related to security procedures for the end user in addition to the usage of MBMS services.

q_14048.question: When does a PDN GW establish a GW control session in PDN connection over WLAN?
q_14048.ground_truth: A GW control session is established when the UE connects to a Trusted non-3GPP access and dynamic PCC is deployed.

q_14049.question: How may frequency parameters for a specific EC TBF be assigned in a packet assignment message?
q_14049.ground_truth: The frequency parameters for a specific EC TBF are assigned in the packet assignment messages by including a reference to one of the EC Mobile Allocation sets in the EC SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 1 message and a definition of the training sequence code (TSC) to use for the EC TBF.

q_14050.question: What should a UE do if an Inter-RAT handover from UTRAN to GERAN Iu mode occurs before the successful delivery of the INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message has been confirmed by RLC?
q_14050.ground_truth: The UE should retransmit the NAS message as specified in subclause 8.3.7.4.

q_14051.question: What is one drawback of introducing multiple new RAT Types for satellite orbits?
q_14051.ground_truth: The drawback is that a single RAT type for satellite access might prevent the 5G system from using certain QoS profiles (5QIs) that meet user requirements due to the wide range of latencies possible in satellite networks.

q_14052.question: In which FD-FDD operation can the UE transmit and receive at the same time, unlike half-duplex FDD?
q_14052.ground_truth: In full-duplex FDD, the UE can transmit and receive at the same time, while in half-duplex FDD, the UE cannot.

q_14053.question: What command is sent by the MGW when the "Distant Codec List" procedure is initiated?
q_14053.ground_truth: The MGW sends a NOT.req command with the necessary information.

q_14054.question: What values should the hyper frame numbers of the COUNT-I values for all signalling radio bearers be set to if new keys have been received prior to sending the first SECURITY MODE COMMAND?
q_14054.ground_truth: All bits of the hyper frame numbers of the COUNT-I values for all signalling radio bearers should be set to zero.

q_14055.question: Which network component sends the RAT type information to the PCRF when dynamic PCC is deployed?
q_14055.ground_truth: The P-GW sends RAT type information to the PCRF when dynamic PCC is deployed and RAT type information needs to be conveyed from the P-GW to the PCRF.

q_14056.question: What is the purpose of Load Balancing (LB) in LTE?
q_14056.ground_truth: The purpose of LB is to handle uneven distribution of the traffic load over multiple cells and maintain high radio resource utilization and QoS for in-progress sessions.

q_14057.question: How are supplementary services characterized in 3GPP specifications?
q_14057.ground_truth: Supplementary services are characterized by using a set of operations involved in service provision and usage, such as provision/withdrawal, registration/erasure, activation/deactivation, invocation, and interrogation.

q_14058.question: What is the required BER for multicarrier BTS equipped with a multicarrier receiver under static propagation conditions and for input levels up to -40 dBm for Wide Area class?
q_14058.ground_truth: The required BER for multicarrier BTS equipped with a multicarrier receiver under static propagation conditions and for input levels up to -40 dBm for Wide Area class is less than or equal to 10-3.

q_14059.question: What was agreed upon at 3GPP GERAN#39 regarding common Link to System Mapping for DL and UL?
q_14059.ground_truth: It was agreed not to investigate further for DL and UL a common Link to System Mapping based on some proposals, but instead perform verification of L2S mapping in MTS-1 to MTS 4 scenarios.

q_14060.question: What is the impact of E-RGCH from the non-serving cell on the sleep time of a UE in a 2 way soft handover?
q_14060.ground_truth: When averaging over n1 and n2, the UE can sleep 24.6% of the time.

q_14061.question: What is a Transfer Syntax Error in the context of ASN.1 decoding?
q_14061.ground_truth: A Transfer Syntax Error occurs when the receiver is not able to decode the received physical message due to issues such as violation of value ranges or list element constraints, missing mandatory elements, or wrong order of elements in ASN.1 SEQUENCE definitions.

q_14062.question: What is the end mark used to fill the identity digits field when the number of identity digits is even?
q_14062.ground_truth: The end mark used to fill the identity digits field when the number of identity digits is even is 1111, and it is coded using BCD.

q_14063.question: When must the UE meet the inner loop power control requirements?
q_14063.ground_truth: The UE must meet the inner loop power control requirements over the power range bounded by the Minimum output power as defined in subclause 6.4.3, and the Maximum output power supported by the UE.

q_14064.question: How many isolators are used in the TX paths of an uplink dual carrier mobile and what is their function?
q_14064.ground_truth: Two isolators are used in the TX paths of an uplink dual carrier mobile. They are used to satisfy the requirements for emissions in TX and RX bands, with one isolator in the upper TX path dedicated for uplink dual carrier and one in the lower TX path that can be reused for single carrier mode.

q_14065.question: Who is responsible for registering notification endpoints in the described solution?
q_14065.ground_truth: NRF allows end-service consumers to register notification endpoints, which can be discovered by RCF for sending notifications.

q_14066.question: What type of system simulators were used for both synchronous and asynchronous network evaluations?
q_14066.ground_truth: Synchronous system simulators were used for both synchronous and asynchronous network evaluations.

q_14067.question: What is the purpose of a COPS DRQ message in the context of 3G networks?
q_14067.ground_truth: A COPS DRQ message is used to indicate the release of a PDP Context to the PDF in 3G networks.

q_14068.question: What is the role of the S-CSCF in determining a P-CSCF as reachable or non-reachable?
q_14068.ground_truth: The S-CSCF considers the P-CSCF to be reachable as soon as a SIP request, including REGISTER, is received from that P-CSCF.

q_14069.question: What does the second bit of the CellCapabilityContainer-FDD type represent?
q_14069.ground_truth: The second bit of the CellCapabilityContainer-FDD type represents the Delayed Activation Support Indicator.

q_14070.question: Under what circumstances would the UE obtain session parameters for the related MBMS download session transport?
q_14070.ground_truth: The UE would obtain session parameters for the related MBMS download session transport by using one of the following methods: pre-storing the related session parameters in the MBMS UE, pre-storing the session parameters in the MBMS application, acquisition via delivery over OMA PUSH, or downloading the session parameters from an HTTP server resolved from the Service Announcement FQDN.

q_14071.question: What should be the criteria when considering cell reselection to a cell on a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency?
q_14071.ground_truth: The UE should reselect a cell on a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency if the serving cell fulfils Squal < ThreshServing, LowQ and a lower priority NR or E-UTRA frequency fulfils Squal > ThreshX, LowQ within the TreselectionRAT interval, and more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

q_14072.question: Which type of service is currently used by most MTC applications for sending MT messages, but not for MO messages?
q_14072.ground_truth: SMS service is currently used by most MTC applications for sending MT messages, but not for MO messages.

q_14073.question: What is the purpose of the reference architecture model, reference points, and functional entities described in TS~23.682?
q_14073.ground_truth: These elements are used to facilitate communications with packet data networks and applications.

q_14074.question: What should the Node B do if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the Serving HS-DSCH Radio Link Change information and the Node B is required to setup the requested HS-PDSCH resources on the Serving HS-DSCH Radio Link?
q_14074.ground_truth: The Node B shall setup the requested HS-PDSCH resources on the Serving HS-DSCH Radio Link and include the HARQ Memory Partitioning IE in the HS-DSCH FDD Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message.

q_14075.question: What is the method of time synchronization in a 5G system where the UE provides time information to attached devices using implementation specific means?

q_14076.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation for FR1, DL+UL joint evaluation, DU, AR30 with 2 UL streams and high load in Source 18?
q_14076.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided is 11.25%.

q_14077.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects in the context of telecommunication management?
q_14077.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects is responsible for defining the technical specifications of the 3GPP, including telecommunication management.

q_14078.question: When sending a notification or interrogation result including an SS-Status parameter from the VLR, what should be the values of the P, R, A, and Q bits?
q_14078.ground_truth: The VLR shall set the P, R, A and Q bits to the same values received from the HLR.

q_14079.question: What is the role of the MBMS UE in receiving MBMS data?
q_14079.ground_truth: The MBMS UE hosts the MBMS User Services receiver function, which may receive data from MBMS bearer services or from unicast bearer services.

q_14080.question: What action should be taken if the UE reports a UE positioning error in a MEASUREMENT REPORT message?
q_14080.ground_truth: In this case, one Bad Result should be recorded.

q_14081.question: What potential security requirements are listed for ensuring the security of the MSGin5G-1 to MSGin5G-4 interfaces?
q_14081.ground_truth: Confidentiality protection, integrity protection, and replay protection shall be supported on the MSGin5G-1-4 interfaces.

q_14082.question: What is the role of temporal ID in H.265 (HEVC)?
q_14082.ground_truth: The temporal ID in H.265 (HEVC) is used for improved temporal scalability by signalling temporal ID in the NAL unit header, restricting pictures of a particular temporal sub-layer from being used for inter prediction reference by pictures of a higher temporal sub-layer, and specifying that each sub-bitstream extraction output must be a conforming bitstream.

q_14083.question: What is the thermal noise power equal to, in dBm?
q_14083.ground_truth: The thermal noise power is equal to -99 dBm.

q_14084.question: What is the purpose of the Gm reference point when delivering the incoming session to the ICS UE?
q_14084.ground_truth: The Gm reference point can be used for communication of service control signalling, and if the CS bearer is used for the media, the Gm reference point may be used for communication of service control signalling.

q_14085.question: What information is required for PLMNs offering disaster roaming?
q_14085.ground_truth: PLMNs offering disaster roaming require the information of applicability of Disaster Condition, disaster area, and the PLMNs with at least one functioning NG-RAN node in the disaster area offering disaster roaming to UEs in the disaster area, and the HPLMN needs to provide the access identities appropriate for the visited country when the UE roams.

q_14086.question: What is the default mode that the MS operates in when it is not in broadcast/multicast receive mode and the network has not explicitly commanded a mode?
q_14086.ground_truth: The MS operates in Network Control mode NC0.

q_14087.question: What should the Node B do if it has received the COMMON MEASUREMENT TERMINATION REQUEST message for a measurement?
q_14087.ground_truth: The Node B should terminate reporting of the common measurements corresponding to the Measurement ID IE in the message.

q_14088.question: When extending the application by adding new AVPs for a feature, what should be the setting for the M bit of the new AVPs?
q_14088.ground_truth: The M bit of the new AVPs should be cleared.

q_14089.question: What are the two main programs for the implementation of the Enhanced aacPlus codec?
q_14089.ground_truth: The two main programs are enhAacPlusEnc.exe for encoding and enhAacPlusDec.exe for decoding.

q_14090.question: In subclause 10.2, what length of time is the TPI combining period, and when does it begin?
q_14090.ground_truth: The TPI combining period has a length of one slot and begins at the downlink slot boundary of the F-TPICH.

q_14091.question: What is the Delivery-Time value (absolute) for MMS User Preference Profile Information?

q_14092.question: What should a receiving node do if it receives a message initiating a procedure that does not have a message to report the outcome of the procedure and contains one or more IEs/IE groups marked with "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" which it does not comprehend?
q_14092.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the not comprehended IEs/IE groups, continue with the procedure as if the not comprehended IEs/IE groups were not received, and initiate the Error Indication procedure to report that one or more IEs/IE groups have been ignored.

q_14093.question: What is the purpose of the "Each failed attempt to add a radio link shall be considered separately" statement?
q_14093.ground_truth: The statement indicates that each failed attempt to add a radio link will be accounted for individually.

q_14094.question: How is user data carried between the MS and CN in the PS domain?
q_14094.ground_truth: User data is carried transparently between the MS and CN in the PS domain.

q_14095.question: What must the UE do if it does not receive any selection of NAS integrity and ciphering algorithms during a handover command in Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
q_14095.ground_truth: The UE continues to use the same algorithms as before the handover.

q_14096.question: Which information element is used to indicate the cause of a Position Periodic Report?

q_14097.question: What is the purpose of the measurements performed by HeNB for interference mitigation and maintaining coverage?
q_14097.ground_truth: The purpose of the measurements performed by HeNB for interference mitigation is to provide sufficient information to the HeNB for the purpose of interference mitigation, while the measurements for maintaining coverage are to provide sufficient information to the HeNB such that the HeNB coverage can be maintained.

q_14098.question: What is used to update PLMN controlled information for SNPN selection in the UE?
q_14098.ground_truth: UE Parameters Update via UDM Control Plane Procedure or Steering of Roaming (SoR) can be used to update PLMN controlled information for SNPN selection in the UE.

q_14099.question: What information must be included in the same SIP header as the encrypted information in the CBC mode of AES?
q_14099.ground_truth: The same initialization vector (IV) must be included in the same SIP header as the encrypted information in the CBC mode of AES.

q_14100.question: What should the IMS-ALG do when it receives a new SDP offer from a peer having different ICE user name fragment and password?
q_14100.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should apply the same procedures as for the initial SDP offer.

q_14101.question: What is the role of the SMF in the MBS session management without using UE IP address?
q_14101.ground_truth: The SMF derives a list of UEs which have established PDU Sessions associated with the MBS session and sends it to the AMF.

q_14102.question: What is the purpose of the RAB Assignment procedure?
q_14102.ground_truth: The RAB Assignment procedure is used to establish new RABs and/or to modify and/or release already established RABs for a given UE.

q_14103.question: What is the action taken by the CSI AS when it receives a SIP re-INVITE request or SIP UPDATE request with one or more 'm=' lines with the port number set to zero?
q_14103.ground_truth: The CSI AS shall act as specified in the clause 9.3.3.6.

q_14104.question: What does the abbreviation "eMLPP" stand for?

q_14105.question: What is the objective of generating the anchors in the described scenario?
q_14105.ground_truth: The objective of generating the anchors is to define detailed test conditions, verify the down scaling from 10 to 8 bit, set the verification status for the H.264/AVC anchors, and set the verification status for the H.265/HEVC test streams.

q_14106.question: What is the meaning of the criticality information "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" in HNBAP messages?
q_14106.ground_truth: When the criticality information of an IE/IE group in an HNBAP message is set to "Ignore IE and Notify Sender", the receiving node shall ignore the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure when a procedure is received with a Procedure Code marked with "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" which the receiving node does not comprehend.

q_14107.question: What determines whether an FA group is considered busy in the single user case and multiple user case?
q_14107.ground_truth: In the single user case, the group is considered to be busy when one of the members is considered to be busy. In the multiple user case, the group is considered to be busy when all of the accessible members are considered to be busy.

q_14108.question: What should the MS do when it is in sub-state U2ws and considers itself not to be the originator of the group call?
q_14108.ground_truth: The MS should consider the transaction identifier received in the next GCC message from the network to be the TI of the group call.

q_14109.question: What should be the size of the uplink CS payload stream's new speech sample in each RTP packet, not including any redundant speech sample, if AMR is used with FEC by sending redundant frames?
q_14109.ground_truth: The sample size is defined as the size of the new speech sample in each RTP packet, not including any redundant speech sample.

q_14110.question: What function is responsible for handling interrogation of CFB?
q_14110.ground_truth: The VLR is responsible for handling interrogation of CFB which returns the required information or error to the MS.

q_14111.question: What is a solution described to solve the long backhaul latency issue?
q_14111.ground_truth: The solution described is a UE assisted local cache solution, where local caching can be achieved by using a local path if the UE is legal for the selective acceleration (cache) request from the core network.

q_14112.question: What is the role of the adaptive post-processing procedure applied to the fixed codebook vector in the AMR codec?
q_14112.ground_truth: The adaptive post-processing procedure applied to the fixed codebook vector in the AMR codec is used to reduce perceptual artifacts from a sparse fixed codebook vector. It is referred to as anti-sparseness processing.

q_14113.question: What is the mechanism used to multiplex several RTP/UDP/IP packets in AoIP?
q_14113.ground_truth: The mechanism used to multiplex several RTP/UDP/IP packets in AoIP is to increase bandwidth utilization by combining them into larger but fewer IP packets. This is specified as optional functionality and requires the usage of RTCP for negotiation of multiplexing between the nodes.

q_14114.question: What message does the SRNC send to the UE to confirm a cell update in URA-PCH?
q_14114.ground_truth: The RRC Cell Update Confirm message is sent by the SRNC to the UE to confirm a cell update in URA-PCH.

q_14115.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of E-UTRA cell?

q_14116.question: What is one of the main challenges in the use case of pallet tracking?
q_14116.ground_truth: One of the main challenges is the tracking and optimization of pallet flows, including the retention on site and loss or theft of the pallets.

q_14117.question: What feature does the MRFP need to support for the MRFC to include "a=rtcp-fb" lines related to the "3gpp-roi-predefined" parameter in the SDP answer?

q_14118.question: What is the name of the key generated by the AKMA WID, used for providing secure TLS connections between the UE and the AF?

q_14119.question: What is the intended use of the test suites designed for the 5GS UE conformance testing in TS 38.523-3?
q_14119.ground_truth: The test suites designed in TS 38.523-3 are intended for use in the 5GS UE conformance testing, specifically for the testing of the communication protocols used by the UE to connect to the 5G System.

q_14120.question: What are the possible values of the privacy check related action indicator for call/session related case?
q_14120.ground_truth: The possible values are: "Location allowed without notification", "Location allowed with notification", "Location with notification and privacy verification; location allowed if no response", and "Location with notification and privacy verification; location restricted if no response".

q_14121.question: What is the function of the Remote ID USS after receiving the mapping between the CAA Level UAV ID and 3GPP level ID?
q_14121.ground_truth: The Remote ID USS uses the 3GPP Level ID to access any service exposed by the 3GPP system, for example, location tracking of the UAV.

q_14122.question: What happens in clause 6a during a handover from 5GS to EPS or inter-system redirection to EPS with N26 interface?
q_14122.ground_truth: The UE initiates the TAU procedure when connected to EPS.

q_14123.question: What is the function of the first two bits of the FI field?
q_14123.ground_truth: The first two bits of the FI field indicate whether the first byte of the Data field corresponds to the first byte of a RLC SDU and whether the last byte of the Data field corresponds to the last byte of a RLC SDU.

q_14124.question: What TC message includes the GPRS Reference Number in the gprsSSF-to-gsmSCF messages?
q_14124.ground_truth: The InitialDPGPRS operation includes the GPRS Reference Number in the gprsSSF-to-gsmSCF messages.

q_14125.question: What is the channel data length in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.6.1?
q_14125.ground_truth: The channel data length is 200 in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.6.1.

q_14126.question: What is the type of occurrence for the PLMN leaf in 5.2.151?
q_14126.ground_truth: The occurrence of the PLMN leaf in 5.2.151 is "One".

q_14127.question: What is the role of VNF application specific parameters and VNF non-application specific parameters in NFV?
q_14127.ground_truth: VNF application specific parameters are 3GPP service related and defined by 3GPP. Examples include network element name, network element address, etc. VNF non-application specific parameters are non-3GPP service related and defined by ETSI NFV ISG. An example of this is VM parameters.

q_14128.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 45.005, what does the abbreviation SCPIR stand for?

q_14129.question: What information does the DRNS use when adding E-DCH MAC-d flows if the MAC-es Maximum Bit Rate LCR IE is present in the E-DCH MAC-d Flows To Add IE?
q_14129.ground_truth: The MAC-es Maximum Bit Rate LCR IE is used by the DRNS to optimize MAC-e scheduling decisions.

q_14130.question: What is the main advantage of the "Error concealment tools" in the Enhanced aacPlus decoder?
q_14130.ground_truth: The "Error concealment tools" in the Enhanced aacPlus decoder make the decoder robust against transmission errors like frame loss, thus mitigating audible effects of such errors.

q_14131.question: What is the signalling message used to offer a waiting call to a busy MS?
q_14131.ground_truth: A waiting call is offered to a busy MS using a normal SETUP message including a "Signal" information element with value #7 (call waiting tone on)

q_14132.question: What should be done with the "UTRAN DRX cycle length coefficient" in the described scenario?
q_14132.ground_truth: It should be ignored and DRX should be stopped.

q_14133.question: How does the MS identify the identity of the GANC and its SGW for setting up a secure tunnel?
q_14133.ground_truth: The MS shall be made known to the identity of the GANC and its SGW, in terms of the IP address or equivalent, through various mechanisms such as provisioning in the terminal.

q_14134.question: What is the procedure for a mobile station to perform a packet access, if it has received an upper layer request to transfer a LLC PDU and access to the network is allowed?
q_14134.ground_truth: The RR entity of the mobile station initiates the packet access procedure as defined in sub-clause~3.5.2.1.2.

q_14135.question: What does the twenty-third bit of the "PA and Single Stream MIMO Dual Band Support Indicator" indicate?
q_14135.ground_truth: The twenty-third bit indicates MIMO with N transmit antennas Capability Adjacent-carrier.

q_14136.question: What latency impact may occur with MPEG-H 3D Audio in terms of lip-synch and user head orientation?
q_14136.ground_truth: With orientation sensor inputs of an MPEG-H 3D Audio decoder changing, there will be algorithmic and implementation latency (perhaps tens of ms) between user head movement and the desired sound field orientation, which will not impact audio/visual synchronization (i.e. lip synch), but only represents the lag of the rendered sound field with respect to the user head orientation.

q_14137.question: What is the MAC header for PCCH mapped on PCH?
q_14137.ground_truth: There is no MAC header for PCCH when mapped on PCH.

q_14138.question: In the context of subclause 14.12, how are RRC messages exchanged between network nodes?
q_14138.ground_truth: RRC messages that are exchanged between network nodes are transferred by means of RRC information containers.

q_14139.question: When the DPCH ID IE or DPCH ID 7.68Mcps IE is provided in the RL Information in TDD, what should be the applicability of the measurement request?
q_14139.ground_truth: The measurement request should apply for the requested physical channel individually.

q_14140.question: What does the ProSe Function in the HPLMN return after receiving the Auth Response from the ProSe Application Server in step 3.b?
q_14140.ground_truth: The ProSe Function verifies that the received PDUID belongs to the requesting UE and retrieves the ProSe Query Code and an associated validity timer in step 4.

q_14141.question: What does the bitmap in uplink resource allocation of type 0 indicate?
q_14141.ground_truth: The bitmap in uplink resource allocation of type 0 indicates the Resource Block Groups (RBGs) that are allocated to the scheduled UE, where an RBG is a set of consecutive virtual resource blocks defined by higher layer parameter rbg-Size.

q_14142.question: What action does the UE take if it receives a PDN MODIFICATION REJECT message with the NBIFOM container IE and a specific NBIFOM status parameter with an appropriate error value?
q_14142.ground_truth: The UE shall send a PDN MODIFICATION REJECT message with the NBIFOM container IE and include the NBIFOM status parameter with the appropriate error value.

q_14143.question: What should be done to unconnected ports during EMC testing?
q_14143.ground_truth: Ports which are not connected to cables during normal operation, such as service connectors, programming connectors, and temporary connectors, shall not be connected to any cables for the purpose of EMC testing.

q_14144.question: What is the main advantage of Solution#4 (uDNS)?
q_14144.ground_truth: The main advantage of Solution#4 (uDNS) is that it allows services to be discovered across domain boundaries and the target node can be outside the local link, as long as the clients support unicast DNS queries.

q_14145.question: What action must the mobile station take if the network cannot accept the call deflection request?
q_14145.ground_truth: If the network cannot accept the call deflection request, it will continue call clearing and send a RELEASE message with an error indication to the mobile station.

q_14146.question: What is the format of the blocks transmitted on the physical interface in A/Gb mode and Iu mode?
q_14146.ground_truth: The format of the blocks transmitted on the physical interface depends on the mode (A/Gb or Iu mode) in which the MS is connected to the network. Both A/Gb and Iu mode have unique formats for downlink and uplink blocks.

q_14147.question: What information is used to unambiguously identify a logical link between the MS and SGSN in the network layer routeing?
q_14147.ground_truth: In the MS, NSAPI identifies the PDP-SAP and between the MS and the SGSN, TLLI unambiguously identifies the logical link. The NSAPI may be related to either one IP address or two IP addresses (one IPv4 and one IPv6 if PDP Type IPv4v6 is supported and used).

q_14148.question: What is the mapping between RANAP and BSSMAP assignment messages used for in the MAP-E interface?
q_14148.ground_truth: It is used for mapping RANAP RAB Assignment Response messages to BSSMAP Assignment Complete or BSSMAP Assignment Failure messages, based on the result of the RANAP message.

q_14149.question: What mechanism does the 3GPP system use to provide a User Identifier for a non-3GPP device?
q_14149.ground_truth: The 3GPP system provides a User Identifier for a non-3GPP device that is connected to the network via a UE that acts as a gateway.

q_14150.question: What does the term "3G-324M codec" refer to in the 3GPP TS 26.114 document?
q_14150.ground_truth: The term "3G-324M codec" refers to the implementation of ITU-T Recommendation H.324 and all its elements adapted to the 3G environment, which consists of an encoder and a decoder.

q_14151.question: What information must the NAF provide to the BSF regarding user identity?
q_14151.ground_truth: The NAF shall be able to indicate the user identity to the BSF. Both public and private identities are allowed.

q_14152.question: What should the BSS do when all downlink RLC data blocks have been received by the mobile station in a downlink EC TBF?
q_14152.ground_truth: The BSS should include the "MS Transmission Offset" and "MS Sync Accuracy" parameters in the EC PACKET DOWLINK ACK/NACK message and use the "MS Transmission Offset" parameter to adjust the estimated timing advance for the mobile station.

q_14153.question: What message does the HPLMN ProSe Function send to the announcing UE after receiving the Announce Alert Response message from the UE?
q_14153.ground_truth: The HPLMN ProSe Function sends a Discovery Request (UE Identity, Discovery Entry ID, Update Info) message to the UE, indicating the UE's identity and Discovery Entry ID.

q_14154.question: What are the two categories of solutions for multiple NWDAF instances in Key Issue #2?
q_14154.ground_truth: The two categories of solutions for multiple NWDAF instances in Key Issue #2 are those proposing a new Analytics (with a new Analytics ID) and those proposing to enhance an existing Analytics (without proposing a new Analytics ID).

q_14155.question: What is the source device in the SEND DTMF proactive command in expected sequence 1.1 and 1.2?
q_14155.ground_truth: The source device in the SEND DTMF proactive command in expected sequence 1.1 is the SIM, and in expected sequence 1.2 is also the SIM.

q_14156.question: What is the difference between MO and MT messages in SMS?
q_14156.ground_truth: MO messages are those that are sent from a phone, while MT messages are those that are received on a phone.

q_14157.question: How can the sending data link layer entity deal with low priority Layer 3 messages when a "high" priority message arrives?
q_14157.ground_truth: When a "high" priority message arrives, the sending data link layer entity shall discard all preceding untransmitted Layer 3 messages using the same data link layer connection with "low" priority. If there are untransmitted octets in the low priority message, the first N201 untransmitted octets shall be discarded if the total number of untransmitted octets exceeds N201. The remaining N201 untransmitted octets, if any, shall be transmitted when permitted by flow control in a single I frame with the M bit set to "0". Low priority data that is not discarded shall be retransmitted if necessary until acknowledged.

q_14158.question: What type of control-type is used for Information Transfer Control Requests in the RNSAP protocol?
q_14158.ground_truth: Suspension and Resume are both used as control-types for Information Transfer Control Requests in the RNSAP protocol.

q_14159.question: What are the typical conditions that can trigger a network to initiate a handover?
q_14159.ground_truth: Handover may be initiated by the network based on RF criteria such as signal level, connection quality, power level propagation delay, and traffic criteria such as current traffic loading per cell, interference levels, maintenance requests, etc.

q_14160.question: What signal is sent by the RNC upon successfully releasing the MBMS Iu signalling connection in the MBMS Session Stop procedure?

q_14161.question: What should the RNC do if it receives a RAB ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message containing a RABs To Be Released IE while there is an ongoing RAB Assignment procedure for a RAB indicated within the RABs To Be Released IE?
q_14161.ground_truth: The RNC should discard the preceding RAB Assignment procedure for that specific RAB, release any related resources and report the released RAB within the RAB ASSIGNMENT RESPONSE message.

q_14162.question: Which metrics are used to gauge the distribution of RACH preambles sent based on the numberOfPreamblesSent-r9 value?
q_14162.ground_truth: The measurement is obtained by incrementing the measurement bin corresponding to the value of IE numberOfPreamblesSent-r9 reported by UE inside UEInformationResponse message. The measurement is incremented each time a UEInformationResponse message containing rach-Report-r9 IE is received.

q_14163.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 link in the UE-to-Network relaying procedure?
q_14163.ground_truth: The PC5 link is used for the connection between a Remote UE and a Relay UE, and is established in step 2 when the Remote UE provides its SUCI to the Relay UE.

q_14164.question: What is a use case for applying threshold conditions in the ATSSS work?
q_14164.ground_truth: Threshold conditions are used to specify how a steering mode should be applied based on a specific condition, such as requiring that the measured RTT of an access be less than 100ms for traffic to be transferred.

q_14165.question: What are the three BSSLAP messages used to handle error scenarios during the U-TDOA location process?
q_14165.ground_truth: The BSSLAP messages used for error handling are Reset, Reject, and Abort.

q_14166.question: What types of networks is the 3GPP Trace Management IRP Solution Set applicable to?
q_14166.ground_truth: The 3GPP Trace Management IRP Solution Set is applicable to UMTS networks and EPS networks.

q_14167.question: What are the PTC service events defined for PTC Service Registration in the PTC Surveillance Events?
q_14167.ground_truth: The PTC Service Registration event is defined for the PTC target registering, re-registering, or deregistering for a PTC service in the PTC Surveillance Events.

q_14168.question: What trigger event is responsible for generating the PF-DC-CDR for a specific group and ProSe one-to-many Direct Communication communication in event based charging?
q_14168.ground_truth: The trigger event for generating the PF-DC-CDR for a specific group and ProSe one-to-many Direct Communication communication in event based charging is the Received Direct Communication Usage Report event for a group.

q_14169.question: What is the name of the CR that provides the capability for management service consumers to discover the exposed management services in the 3GPP management system?
q_14169.ground_truth: 5G network and network slicing management supports a service-based management architecture where deployed management service instances are exposed by management service producers. This WI adds the capability for management service consumers to discover the exposed management services in the 3GPP management system.

q_14170.question: What type of changes are indicated by an increment in the second digit of the version number?
q_14170.ground_truth: An increment in the second digit of the version number indicates changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates.

q_14171.question: What are the responsibilities of the RNC in the implementation-specific O&M transport process?
q_14171.ground_truth: The RNC is responsible for routing implementation specific O&M signaling traffic and the traffic exchanged over this signaling link is completely transparent to the RNC.

q_14172.question: When using the Load-Balancing steering mode with a "UE-assistance indication" in the ATSSS work, what decisions can the UE make regarding the uplink traffic distribution for a data flow?
q_14172.ground_truth: The UE can decide how to distribute the UL traffic of the matching data flow based on its internal state, such as battery level, and also inform the UPF about its decision.

q_14173.question: What message does the MS send to the CN to release the call when CS call clearing is initiated by the MS?

q_14174.question: What functionality should be explicitly coded in TTCN to test the reassembly of PDUs in the UE side?
q_14174.ground_truth: Segmentation needs to be explicitly coded in TTCN to test the reassembly in the UE side.

q_14175.question: In the context of the presence service, what is the difference between a fetcher and a poller?
q_14175.ground_truth: A fetcher is a watcher that asks the presence service for presence information of one or more presentities without requesting future changes, while a poller is a fetcher that requests presence information on a regular basis, indicating periodic interest in the presence information of the presentities.

q_14176.question: What is the difference between the reportType being set to 'eventTriggered' and 'periodical' in the MeasurementReport message?
q_14176.ground_truth: When the reportType is set to 'eventTriggered', the MeasurementReport message includes the cells included in the cellsTriggeredList as defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId. On the other hand, when the reportType is set to 'periodical', the MeasurementReport message includes the best neighbouring cells up to maxReportCells in accordance with the given conditions.

q_14177.question: How was the performance of the SES codecs measured?
q_14177.ground_truth: The performance was measured by comparing the recognition word error rates of the DSR codec and the AMR-NB/AMR-WB codecs for a range of extensive evaluation databases.

q_14178.question: What is F-DPCH and what is it used for?
q_14178.ground_truth: F-DPCH (Fractional Dedicated Physical Channel) was introduced in REL-6 to support a high number of HSDPA users in the downlink, where the user stays connected over a long time span with only occasional active periods of data transmission, allowing a much faster reactivation for temporarily inactive users.

q_14179.question: What should be measured to assess the performance of the BS?
q_14179.ground_truth: The Bit Error Rate (BER) of the wanted signal should be measured.

q_14180.question: What happens to the UE when there are multiple applicable Tsor-cm timers?
q_14180.ground_truth: When there are multiple applicable Tsor-cm timers, all of them shall be started.

q_14181.question: What Cyclic Generator Polynomial G(x) is used for computing the CRC field in the AMR-WB codec?
q_14181.ground_truth: The Cyclic Generator Polynomial G(x) = D8 + D6 + D5 + D4 + 1 is used for computing the CRC field in the AMR-WB codec.

q_14182.question: Which network entity is responsible for SM.CreationDefaultBearerS5S8Succ measurement in EPS?

q_14183.question: What are the four supplementary services for line identification in the 3GPP system?
q_14183.ground_truth: The four supplementary services for line identification in the 3GPP system are Calling line identification presentation (CLIP), Calling line identification restriction (CLIR), Connected line identification presentation (COLP), and Connected line identification restriction (COLR).

q_14184.question: What is the client's action when choosing a target node, if more than one SRV is returned?
q_14184.ground_truth: The client should use lower-numbered priority instances in preference to higher-numbered priority instances, and instances with equal priority should be selected randomly in proportion to their relative weights.

q_14185.question: What action does the BSS take after receiving the PS Handover Request Acknowledge message from the SGSN?
q_14185.ground_truth: After receiving the PS Handover Request Acknowledge message from the SGSN, the BSS prepares to receive downlink LLC PDUs directed to the new cell and associated with the accepted PFCs.

q_14186.question: What does the IMS leaf value of 1 indicate for an IP-CAN bearer?
q_14186.ground_truth: If the IMS leaf value is set to "1", the UE shall not send IMS registration requests for a contact address containing the IP address of the bearer and shall not attempt to establish the bearer to be used only for IMS.

q_14187.question: For a given CCDF, which type of pulse shaping filter has a lower PAPR?
q_14187.ground_truth: More aggressive pulse shaping filtering would have a lower PAPR for a given CCDF.

q_14188.question: What is the responsibility of the MSGin5G server in the process of MSGin5G client receiving a message from a group?
q_14188.ground_truth: The MSGin5G server sends the Group Message Request to the MSGin5G client, and in case of a 3GPP message client, the server translates the MSGin5G Group message to a 3GPP message (e.g. SMS) and sends it to the 3GPP Message Client.

q_14189.question: Under what circumstances will the PCEF request the establishment of new IP CAN bearer(s) or modification of existing IP CAN bearer(s)?
q_14189.ground_truth: The PCEF will request the establishment of new IP CAN bearer(s) or modification of existing IP CAN bearer(s) if the enforcement of authorized QoS per QCI is not successful.

q_14190.question: How does the GANC determine the GAN cell ID for MS registration when the MS is in GERAN coverage?
q_14190.ground_truth: During GAN registration, if the MS is in GERAN coverage, it indicates to the GANC the cell id of the overlapping GERAN cell. The GANC then maps this information to a corresponding GAN cell id and stores it in the registration context of that MS.

q_14191.question: What information does the gsmSSF pass to the gsmSCF to indicate which service logic to apply?
q_14191.ground_truth: The gsmSSF passes the CAMEL service key to the gsmSCF to indicate which service logic it should apply.

q_14192.question: What should the MS do if it receives a GA-PSR HANDOVER COMMAND message that does not provide resources for at least one uplink TBF in the new cell for a handover to a GERAN cell?
q_14192.ground_truth: If the PS HANDOVER COMMAND message carried within the GA-PSR HANDOVER COMMAND message does not provide resources for at least one uplink TBF in the new cell for a handover to a GERAN cell, the MS should send the source GANC a GA-PSR HANDOVER FAILURE message and resume normal operation as if the GA-PSR HANDOVER COMMAND message had not been received.

q_14193.question: How does the H-PCRF provision event triggers to the V-PCRF?
q_14193.ground_truth: The H-PCRF provisions event triggers to the V-PCRF by including them within the Event-Trigger AVP. Event Triggers may apply to a specific S9 Subsession or to a specific S9 session. When Event Triggers are provided for a specific S9 session, the H-PCRF includes the list of event triggers within the Event-Trigger AVP at the command level. When Event Triggers are provided for a specific S9 subsession, the H-PCRF includes the Subsession-Decision-Info AVP for each of the affected S9 subsession.

q_14194.question: What does the PRS resource muting scaling factor depend on?
q_14194.ground_truth: The PRS resource muting scaling factor depends on the muting repetition factor and the size of the bitmap.

q_14195.question: What traffic model was used for EGPRS?
q_14195.ground_truth: The FTP traffic model with 120 kB file size was used for EGPRS.

q_14196.question: What is the maximum size limit for the Aggregated Group Message Request?
q_14196.ground_truth: The maximum size of Aggregated Group Message Request is less than or equal to maximum segment size allowed to be transmitted over available transport.

q_14197.question: What is the format of the length field preceding each DIMS Unit in a concatenated sequence?
q_14197.ground_truth: The length field is a two-byte field in network (big-endian) format, which precedes each DIMS Unit and indicates the length of the DIMS Unit not including the length field itself.

q_14198.question: What is the procedure for deriving Kedge and Kedge ID in Solution #2?
q_14198.ground_truth: Kedge is generated using a KDF defined in Annex B.2.0 of TS 33.220, taking KAUSF as input and Kedge ID is generated by AUSF and UE, containing the routing indicator, service identifier, and uniqueness part.

q_14199.question: What is the purpose of real-time data collection and analytics delivery by NWDAF?
q_14199.ground_truth: The purpose of real-time data collection and analytics delivery by NWDAF is to provide timely analytics outputs that assist control decisions at the consumer NF. This can improve network performance in scenarios such as network performance monitoring and anomaly analysis and report on detecting UE's malfunctions or hacking.

q_14200.question: What message does the MSC-1 Server send to BSS-2 Server to start UL bicasting during a BSS Internal Handover that does not modify LCLS status of a locally switched call?
q_14200.ground_truth: MSC-2 Server indicates to BSS-2 to start UL bicasting in step 3a.

q_14201.question: What is the procedure for terminating the RR connection establishment when it is established in response to an encapsulated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message on the network side?
q_14201.ground_truth: The RR connection establishment procedure is terminated on the network side when the main signalling link is established, Timer T3101 is stopped, the MM sublayer on the network side is informed that the RR entity has entered the dedicated mode, and the network may release the old packet resources.

q_14202.question: What should the CN do when the transferred information relates to a Trace Session and the Trace Activation Indicator IE indicates that the Trace Session is activated?
q_14202.ground_truth: If the transferred information relates to a Trace Session and the Trace Activation Indicator IE indicates that the Trace Session is activated, the CN should take the Equipments To Be Traced IE into account for anonymization of MDT data.

q_14203.question: Which information flow is used in the gsmSCF to check for the continued existence of a relationship between the gsmSCF and gsmSRF?

q_14204.question: What should the DRNS do if the DCH Information IE in the DCHs To Add IE does not include the Guaranteed UL Rate IE?
q_14204.ground_truth: The DRNS shall not limit the user rate of the uplink of the DCH.

q_14205.question: In GEA5 and GIA5, what does the "0x" prefix indicate in the present document?
q_14205.ground_truth: The prefix "0x" is used in the present document to indicate hexadecimal numbers.

q_14206.question: What is the purpose of the repetition mappings in DRSACCH for SACCH in the legacy channel organization?
q_14206.ground_truth: The purpose of the repetition mappings in DRSACCH for SACCH in the legacy channel organization is to avoid a SACCH repetition frame in one MUROS subchannel being paired with a normal SACCH frame, a shifted SACCH frame, or a SACCH repetition frame in the other MUROS subchannel.

q_14207.question: In what scenario will the deType parameter within SendAuthenticationInfoArg take the value of "mme"?
q_14207.ground_truth: When the requestingNodeType parameter within SendAuthenticationInfoArg takes the value of "mme".

q_14208.question: What is the purpose of sending the Event-Report-Indication AVP from the PCEF to the PCRF?
q_14208.ground_truth: It is used to provide the information about the required event triggers to the PCRF.

q_14209.question: What should the UE do when the data has not yet been successfully decoded in the HARQ process?
q_14209.ground_truth: The UE should combine the received data with the data currently in the soft buffer for this HARQ process.

q_14210.question: What is the goal of defining service profiles in the CMAS?
q_14210.ground_truth: The goal is to define service profiles and not specific delivery technologies. Multiple technologies are available for each service profile, and the operator has options to use any available technology that supports a given profile if they elect to transmit alerts.

q_14211.question: What does the OM parameter in the Single Codec Information Element for AMR Codec Types indicate?
q_14211.ground_truth: The OM parameter in the Single Codec Information Element for AMR Codec Types indicates whether the sending side supports the modification (optimisation) of its offered ACS for the needs of the distant side.

q_14212.question: When should the UE include the beam measurement results as indicated by reportQuantityRS-Indexes?
q_14212.ground_truth: If the includeBeamMeasurements is set to true.

q_14213.question: How many microphone positions are considered in the investigation for the noise field simulations?
q_14213.ground_truth: Only two microphone positions, 5 and 8, are considered in the investigation. These positions represent typical locations of primary/bottom and secondary/top microphones of a device under test.

q_14214.question: What is the definition of the term "receiver spurious emissions" in the context of the 3GPP technical specification?
q_14214.ground_truth: Receiver spurious emissions refer to the unwanted signals or energy that a LMU generates and emits, which falls outside the desired frequency range.

q_14215.question: What can the CSE instruct the VPLMN/IPLMN to do after making contact with it in the call set-up request procedure?
q_14215.ground_truth: The CSE can instruct the VPLMN/IPLMN to perform charging activities, activate subsequent control service events for the call, order in-band user interaction, and issue one of the following instructions: bar the call, continue the call processing, continue the call processing with modified information, or continue the handling of the calling party without routing the call to the destination.

q_14216.question: What does the SMLC send if the TA value is not available in the BSSAP-LE Perform Location Request message?
q_14216.ground_truth: The SMLC sends a BSSAP-LE Connection Oriented Information message with a BSSLAP TA Request APDU parameter.

q_14217.question: What is the subjective MOS score for EVS-SWB at 13.2 kbps with channel aware mode under a 10% FER for North American English with car noise at 15 dB SNR?
q_14217.ground_truth: Equivalent to AMR-WB 23.85 kbps at 3% FER

q_14218.question: What should the GPL protocol entity do if the SN field in the GPL message has a sequence number that has been received before?
q_14218.ground_truth: The message should be discarded and the processing should stop.

q_14219.question: What is the role of the ECS in the UE's communication with the EES?
q_14219.ground_truth: The ECS provides the UE with Edge Enabler Server (EES) information, such as the EES ID and AKMA capability.

q_14220.question: What is the role of the UAS Client in relation to C2 communication link selection and switching?
q_14220.ground_truth: The UAS Client engages in direct C2 communication while monitoring the current C2 link against the negotiated QoS thresholds for C2 switching.

q_14221.question: What is the idle pattern for ITU-T and ANSI based systems when timeslots are not assigned to a channel?
q_14221.ground_truth: The idle pattern in ITU-T based systems is 01010100 and 01111111 in ANSI based systems.

q_14222.question: What is meant by MBS QoS Flow?
q_14222.ground_truth: MBS QoS Flow is the finest granularity for QoS forwarding treatment for MBS data in the 5MBS system. Providing different QoS forwarding treatment requires separate MBS QoS Flow.

q_14223.question: What is the maximum number of times the RESET IP RESOURCE message can be repeated by the MSC?
q_14223.ground_truth: n times, where n is an operator-defined value.

q_14224.question: In the Frame Tunneling Mode (FTM), what does the L2R function use to transport asynchronous HDLC frames between the MS and the IWF?
q_14224.ground_truth: In FTM, the L2R function uses services defined in 3GPP TS 24.022 to transport asynchronous HDLC frames between the MS and the IWF.

q_14225.question: What must be provided when the P-CSCF changes and a transfer of all media flows is not possible?
q_14225.ground_truth: When the P-CSCF changes and a transfer of all media flows is not possible, a subset of the media flows shall be transferred (if possible) and the remaining flows will be released or kept in the transferred out access.

q_14226.question: What should a UE do when receiving the "MBSFN inter frequency neighbour list" and the "IMB indication" is included in the IE?
q_14226.ground_truth: The UE should consider that the cells on the corresponding frequencies are 3.84 Mcps TDD IMB cells providing MBMS service in MBSFN mode.

q_14227.question: How can the number of concurrently supported decoders vary for each codec type?
q_14227.ground_truth: This can vary due to different levels of decoding complexity for each codec type, with more complex decoders requiring the use of less concurrently supported decoders.

q_14228.question: What elements should an ADC rule for traffic steering control consist of?
q_14228.ground_truth: An ADC rule for traffic steering control consists of a rule identifier, either an TDF-Application-Identifier or service data flow filter(s), a Precedence AVP, and traffic steering policy identifier(s).

q_14229.question: What benefits did the asynchronous and synchronized network trials show for a single interferer in terms of the gain in C/I distribution at the 10% points?
q_14229.ground_truth: The asynchronous network trial provided gains ranging from 0 dB (when the delay was equal to about 80 symbols) to 5.3 dB (when the delay was less than 19 symbols). The synchronized network trial resulted in gains of approximately 4.5 dB with five interferers and 1.6 dB with three interferers when two of the three had a delay of more than 20 symbols.

q_14230.question: In the context of 3GPP, what does "PLMN" commonly stand for?

q_14231.question: What is the difference between TP-Coding in Message 2.1 and 3.1 in the SMS-PP (SEND SHORT MESSAGE) Message?
q_14231.ground_truth: In Message 2.1, TP-Coding is UCS2 (16-bit data) and in Message 3.1, TP-Coding is 8bit-data.

q_14232.question: What are the main factors that determine the latency requirements for live streaming systems in the 3GPP QoS framework?
q_14232.ground_truth: The main factors that determine the latency requirements for live streaming systems in the 3GPP QoS framework include end-to-end latency, encoding+distribution latency, distribution-only latency, CDN latency and other factors such as the distribution of content and the linear playout output. The latency requirements can also vary depending on the use case, such as TV distribution mechanisms or user-generated live uplink streaming to social networks.

q_14233.question: What is the purpose of the Forbidden PLMN list in a UE's USIM?
q_14233.ground_truth: The Forbidden PLMN list in a UE's USIM stores a list of PLMNs that the UE is not allowed to register with. In automatic PLMN selection mode, the UE controls registration attempts to appropriate networks based on this list.

q_14234.question: What message does the SS send to the UE during T1 in the test procedure?
q_14234.ground_truth: The SS sends a RESET UE POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message, an LPP REQUEST CAPABILITIES message, a LPP PROVIDE ASSISTANCE DATA message with the nr-DL-AoD-ProvideAssistanceData-r16 IE, and a LPP REQUEST LOCATION INFORMATION message with the nr-DL-AoD-RequestLocationInformation-r16 IE.

q_14235.question: Which network entity is responsible for determining SCEF authorization for network access in 3GPP networks?
q_14235.ground_truth: The 3GPP Network Entity determines if the SCEF is authorized to send requests for the 3GPP Network Entity, either per UE or per service per UE.

q_14236.question: What is required for the UE onboarding and remote provisioning?
q_14236.ground_truth: The UE should provide an indication at RRC and NAS levels that the registration request is for onboarding, and the network should support the functionality to restrict usage to only on-boarding service. Upon registration to an SNPN for Onboarding, the UE does not request to be registered over a network slice and as such the UE does not include Requested NSSAI in either RRC or NAS; it is up to the network to decide which network slice is used for the onboarding and provisioning procedures. After finishing the remote provisioning, the UE shall initiate de-registration from the on-boarding network.

q_14237.question: What is the role of the Serving GW in the new 2G-SGSN-initiated PDP context update in the inter-SGSN change?
q_14237.ground_truth: The Serving GW informs the P-GW(s) about the change of Serving GW Address and TEID, updates its context fields, and returns a Modify Bearer Response message to the Serving GW.

q_14238.question: What is the purpose of the maximum reporting time in the context of motion event reporting in LCS?
q_14238.ground_truth: The maximum reporting time ensures that the LCS client, R-GMLC, and H-GMLC remain aware of continuing support by the UE for the motion event, and can detect if motion event reporting may have been aborted due to UE power off.

q_14239.question: What security parameters are needed by a sending UE in model A of the ProSe Discovery procedure to protect a discovery message?
q_14239.ground_truth: The security parameters needed by a sending UE in model A of the ProSe Discovery procedure to protect a discovery message are provided in the Code-Sending Security Parameters.

q_14240.question: What is the action taken by the SCC AS when the final response from the controllee UE is a non-2xx response in the procedures for collaborative session establishment by adding new media to the controllee UE?
q_14240.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends a NOTIFY request including the SIP final response as a sipfrag body to the controller UE and considers the inter-UE transfer operation failed.

q_14241.question: What is the role of the NonceUI in the GBA_ME-based solution?
q_14241.ground_truth: The NonceUI is a value sent in the authentication challenge by the NAF to the GAA client in the terminal. It is also included in the request for NAF keys to the GAA server and is used in the NAF key derivation to bind the keys to the ongoing transaction.

q_14242.question: What is the procedure defined in 6.3.4.2.1 for modifying a PDN connection?
q_14242.ground_truth: The procedure defines interactions between the CP and UP function during the modification of a PDN connection, including Inter SGSN RA update procedure, Inter SGSN RA/LA update procedure, SRNS relocation procedure, and Intra-LAC handover procedure.
