The SGW-C sends an Sx Session Modification Request to the SGW-U, indicating SGW-U to stop counting uplink packets for the affected bearers and discard uplink packets received from eNodeB for the affected bearers. The SGW-U sends an Sx Session Modification Response to the SGW-C. The PGW-C sends an Sx Session Termination Request to the PGW-U, and the PGW-U sends an Sx Session Termination Response to the PGW-C confirming the release of the Sx session.

q_14243.question: What is the number of TFCI code word bits when using repetition for the coding of very short TFCIs?
q_14243.ground_truth: The number of TFCI code word bits is 6 for a single TFCI bit and 12 for 2 TFCI bits.

q_14244.question: What should the MAC entity do if the selected preamble and PRACH occasion is mapped to a valid PUSCH occasion?
q_14244.ground_truth: The MAC entity should deliver the UL grant and the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity for the MSGA payload in the selected PUSCH occasion.

q_14245.question: How does the system determine the applicable MB-SMF ID, area session ID, and location area in the 5G system?
q_14245.ground_truth: The SMF determines the applicable MB-SMF ID, area session ID, and location area by selecting location dependent multicast context information based on the location area where the UE is residing.

q_14246.question: How is the DC subcarrier handled in the NR transmitter for both downlink and uplink?
q_14246.ground_truth: In the NR transmitter, the DC subcarrier is modulated with data for both downlink and uplink, and the transmitter should avoid collisions on the uplink with at least the DM-RS. The location of the DC subcarrier in the uplink should be semi-statically signaled.

q_14247.question: Under what conditions should the NAS notify the upper layers that the access attempt is barred?
q_14247.ground_truth: If the event which triggered the access attempt was an MO-MMTEL-voice-call-started indication, an MO-MMTEL-video-call-started indication, or an MO-SMSoIP-attempt-started indication and the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred, the NAS shall notify the upper layers that the access attempt is barred.

q_14248.question: What information is provided in the MBMS REGISTRATION REQUEST message to request registration of the RNC for a Multicast Service, using connectionless signalling?
q_14248.ground_truth: MBMS Registration Request type, TMGI, Global RNC-ID, and the associated IP Multicast Address and APN corresponding to the MBMS Bearer Service identified by the TMGI.

q_14249.question: What should a mobile station do if uplink feedback channels are not allocated within its multislot capabilities while receiving an MBMS session?
q_14249.ground_truth: The mobile station should select the highest priority MBMS session with a feedback channel and any other MBMS sessions with feedback channels that fall within its multislot capabilities.

q_14250.question: What is the role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in GSM mobile communications?
q_14250.ground_truth: The 3GPP is an organization that develops technical specifications for GSM mobile communication systems.

q_14251.question: Which IE defines the QoS to be applied to an MBMS E-RAB in the M3AP protocol?
q_14251.ground_truth: The MBMS E-RAB QoS parameters IE defines the QoS to be applied to an MBMS E-RAB in the M3AP protocol.

q_14252.question: What is the function of the NSQ in 5G networks?
q_14252.ground_truth: The NSQ keeps track of the actual slice-AMBR for a S-NSSAI and dynamically adjusts data rates for network slices when the slice-AMBR limit has been reached.

q_14253.question: What are Solution #12's triggers for path selection policy rules in Rel-17?
q_14253.ground_truth: Solution #12's triggers for path selection policy rules are by the PCF, UE, or AF. The AF can receive and forward RAN QNC notifications, NWDAF analytics, and topology formation or changes to the PCF.

q_14254.question: What is the required frame rate for a Bitstream conforming to the H.265/HEVC UHD HDR Operation Point?
q_14254.ground_truth: A Bitstream conforming to the H.265/HEVC UHD HDR Operation Point shall have one of the following frame rates: 24, 25, 30, 50, 60, 24/1.001, 30/1.001, 60/1.001 Hz.

q_14255.question: What should the MAC entity do if it is in the Msg3 retransmission?
q_14255.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select the same group of Random Access Preambles as was used for the Random Access Preamble transmission attempt corresponding to the first transmission of Msg3.

q_14256.question: What is the frequency specified as the reference measurement channel for the 3.84 Mcps TDD option in the BS testing?
q_14256.ground_truth: The frequency specified as the reference measurement channel for the 3.84 Mcps TDD option in the BS testing is the UL reference measurement channel (12.2 kbps) defined in Annex A.2.1.

q_14257.question: When will the MAC entity flush the HARQ buffer of the identified HARQ process?
q_14257.ground_truth: If none of the conditions to start or restart timers or to determine the MAC PDU to transmit are met, the MAC entity will flush the HARQ buffer of the identified HARQ process.

q_14258.question: What does the presence of the r12:recurrenceAndMonitoring element in the session schedule indicate?
q_14258.ground_truth: The presence of the r12:recurrenceAndMonitoring element in the session schedule signals that the associated MBMS User Service is of the Datacasting type. The attribute mode of the r12:recurrenceAndMonitoring element indicates the scheduled-and-periodic delivery mode or the back-to-back delivery mode.

q_14259.question: What document format does the 3GPP Technical Report follow for its numbering system (e.g., "Version x.y.z")?
q_14259.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Report follows the numbering system of "Version x.y.z", where "x" represents different statuses, "y" indicates technical enhancements or corrections, and "z" is incremented for editorial changes.

q_14260.question: What procedure does the UE follow when performing a Tracking Area Update procedure in inter-system redirection to EPS?
q_14260.ground_truth: The UE uses the emergency indication in the RRC message and E-UTRAN provides the emergency indication to MME during the Tracking Area Update or Attach procedure.

q_14261.question: Which namespace specifies the XML schema for the versioning in the Schedule Description?
q_14261.ground_truth: The namespace "urn:3gpp:metadata:2009:MBMS:schemaVersion" specifies the XML schema for the versioning in the Schedule Description.

q_14262.question: What is the mode where the master unit controller, Alan, sends a message to a specific handset, Charles, in the intercom system?

q_14263.question: What protocol is used to transfer PDP PDUs between the 2G-SGSN and the MS?

q_14264.question: What is the function of the multiplexing function in the uplink direction for TCH/F28.8 and TCH/F43.2?
q_14264.ground_truth: The multiplexing function in the uplink direction for TCH/F28.8 and TCH/F43.2 demultiplexes data received through the respective radio interface channels into multiple TCH/F14.4 substreams, and then multiplexes the 290-bit blocks from these substreams back into the radio interface channel.

q_14265.question: What is the first action the S-CSCF takes when it receives a UE-originating request from a registered or unregistered user?
q_14265.ground_truth: The S-CSCF first checks whether the request is UE-originating or UE-terminating and then performs the matching procedure with SPTs within initial filter criteria based on the request type.

q_14266.question: What is IMS Credentials (IMC) in 3GPP network?
q_14266.ground_truth: It is a set of IMS security data and functions for IMS access by a terminal that does not support any 3GPP access technology or by a terminal accessing IMS via Standalone Non-Public Network access.

q_14267.question: What is the role of the PS in UE onboarding to a PNI-NPN?
q_14267.ground_truth: The PS supports provisioning and may be provisioned with the on-boarding credentials to authenticate the UE for onboarding and the vertical credentials for updating NPN credentials of UEs who are allowed for onboarding.

q_14268.question: What are the performance requirements for 5G system to support high resolution video live broadcast using UAV?
q_14268.ground_truth: The performance requirements include a round trip latency less than 150 ms, reliability near 100%, PPP mechanisms to ensure sufficient reliability metrics, position accuracy within 10 cm, continuous wireless coverage, high speed uplink bandwidth at least 20Mbps, and support for evolved high resolution video live broadcast application with seamless connection.

q_14269.question: What is the requirement for the managed system to detect promptly whether the link-b is functioning correctly?
q_14269.ground_truth: The managed system shall provide a service that allows the NM to detect promptly whether link-b, including the Notification Distribution Service, and NotificationIRP defined in 3GPP TS~32.302, are functioning correctly regarding notification sending.

q_14270.question: What is the presence of "id-MeasurementID" in the "CommonMeasurementInitiationResponse-IEs" section?
q_14270.ground_truth: The presence of "id-MeasurementID" in the "CommonMeasurementInitiationResponse-IEs" section is mandatory.

q_14271.question: What is the name of the metadata model used for file-based immersive audio production today?

q_14272.question: What is the definition of inadequately handled call attempts in the Technical Report 3GPP TS 12.22?
q_14272.ground_truth: Inadequately handled call attempts are attempts that are blocked or excessively delayed within the exchange, where excessive delays are those that are greater than three times the recommended 0,95 probability of not exceeding values.

q_14273.question: What shall the receiving entity do if it receives a message carrying a field with a reserved value?
q_14273.ground_truth: The receiving entity shall discard the message carrying a field with a reserved value.

q_14274.question: What is the purpose of the KSIASME and KSIGSN parameters?
q_14274.ground_truth: The KSIASME parameter is used to make it possible for the UE and the MME to identify a native KASME without invoking the authentication procedure, allowing re-use of the KASME during subsequent connection set-ups. The KSIGSN parameter is used to make it possible for the UE and the MME to indicate the use of the mapped KASME in inter-RAT mobility procedures.

q_14275.question: What response is sent from the MT to the TE to indicate that the attempt to insert an SMS message failed?

q_14276.question: In the context of call gapping, when is "calledAddressAndService" given priority over "calledAddressValue"?
q_14276.ground_truth: When both "manuallyInitiated" and "sCPOverloaded" "controlTypes" are active for a call to a controlled called number with the same number length.

q_14277.question: In the context of packet flow parameters, what does the "Allocation/Retention Priority" parameter represent?
q_14277.ground_truth: The "Allocation/Retention Priority" parameter denotes the priority of the packet flow in terms of allocation and retention, with higher values receiving preferential treatment.

q_14278.question: What is the role of timer Tno channell in the sub-state U2nc, and when is it running?
q_14278.ground_truth: Timer Tno channell is running in the sub-state U2nc, which indicates that no channel is currently available in the GCC entity.

q_14279.question: What is the difference between the first and the second digits in the version number of the present document?
q_14279.ground_truth: The first digit represents the maturity level of the TS (from information, to approval, to TSG approved), while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc.

q_14280.question: After step e) in the acceptance criteria, what should be contained in the EF5GS3GPPLOCI (5GS 3GPP location information) in the USIM?
q_14280.ground_truth: The EF5GS3GPPLOCI should contain the 5G-GUTI, Last visited registered TAI in 5GS for 3GPP access, and 5GS update status for 3GPP access.

q_14281.question: What information does the new SGSN send to the target RNC/BSS in the Relocation Request message?
q_14281.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends a Relocation Request message containing permanent NAS Identity, Cause, CN Domain Indicator, and other necessary information for establishing RABs and initiating the RAB setup procedures.

q_14282.question: What is the impact of latency in imaging systems, specifically for audio applications?
q_14282.ground_truth: High latency can affect lip sync and cause echo that may disrupt a performer's timing and concentration.

q_14283.question: When the UE receives the AS SMC without having received a NAS Security Mode Command, what should be used as the freshness parameter in the derivation of the K~eNB?
q_14283.ground_truth: The NAS uplink COUNT of the NAS message that triggered the AS SMC.

q_14284.question: In the context of the paging procedure, what should the UE do if the "Release indicator" in the "RRC connection release information" has the value "Release"?
q_14284.ground_truth: The UE should release all its radio resources, indicate the release of established signalling connections and established radio access bearers to the upper layers, clear the variables ESTABLISHED_SIGNALLING_CONNECTIONS and ESTABLISHED_RABS, pass the value of the "Release cause" to upper layers, and enter idle mode, performing the specified actions when entering idle mode.

q_14285.question: What type of images are considered timed graphics media entities?
q_14285.ground_truth: JPEG, GIF87a, GIF89a, and PNG images are timed graphics media entities.

q_14286.question: Under what conditions should a UE indicate available CN Type(s) and received cnType to upper layers after receiving a RRCRelease message with redirectedCarrierInfo indicating redirection to eutra?
q_14286.ground_truth: If the RRCRelease message includes redirectedCarrierInfo indicating redirection to eutra and cnType is included, the UE should indicate available CN Type(s) and the received cnType to upper layers after the cell selection.

q_14287.question: What is one potential requirement for supporting VR and interactive conversations via the ProSe Communication path (direct) in the 5G system?
q_14287.ground_truth: The 5G system should be able to control the radio resources associated with the ProSe Communication path (direct) between UEs.

q_14288.question: How long is the cipher key CK and how many cipher keys can be established between the user and the CS/PS service domains in 3G UMTS network?
q_14288.ground_truth: The cipher key CK is 128 bits long in 3G UMTS network, and there can be one CK for CS connections and one CK for PS connections in 3G UMTS network.

q_14289.question: What does the CHF generate in step 9ch-b in the message flows for ProSe UE-to-Network Direct Communication via Layer-3 procedures?
q_14289.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Direct communication via UE-to-Network Relay CDR is generated by the CHF for the Remote UE.

q_14290.question: What is the minimum coupling loss (MCL) assumed for the macro-cellular environment?

q_14291.question: Which item is mandatory in the "DSCH-InformationResponseList-RL-AdditionRspTDD-RL-AdditionRspTDD" sequence?

q_14292.question: What is the procedure for simulating a UTRA 3.84 Mcps TDD victim for uplink interference in Enhanced Uplink?
q_14292.ground_truth: The system should be synchronized and the simulation procedure should be the same as in Section 5.1.2.4, with the same number of users allocated to each cell within the HO margin of 3 dB.

q_14293.question: What are some expected functions for content adaptation and provisioning in the context of 3GPP-based TV profiles?
q_14293.ground_truth: Some expected functions include mapping of typical broadcast distribution formats to 3GPP TV Profiles, mapping of typical VoD and Ad content formats to 3GPP TV Profiles, encoding/transcoding such that efficient distribution is enabled, and mapping to 3GP-DASH formats.

q_14294.question: What is the purpose of the "Text Attribute" section in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL" coding?
q_14294.ground_truth: The "Text Attribute" section in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL" coding specifies the formatting of the alpha identifier in the message. It includes the formatting position, formatting length, formatting mode, colour, and text string.

q_14295.question: What is the new network-based MCData notification server introduced in Release 17 for the Mission Critical Data service?
q_14295.ground_truth: The new network-based MCData notification server provides the centralized notification function in the network that allows an application to create a communication channel to receive real-time notifications from the network in either Pull or Push mode.

q_14296.question: What is the difference between "UE positioning GANSS time model" and "UE positioning GANSS additional UTC models"?
q_14296.ground_truth: "UE positioning GANSS time model" contains a set of parameters needed to relate GNSS time to a selected time reference, while "UE positioning GANSS additional UTC models" contains several sets of parameters needed to relate GNSS system time to UTC, each set being appropriate for different GNSS-IDs and UE capabilities.

q_14297.question: What is the variable Ms in clause 5.5.4.3 of TS 38.331?
q_14297.ground_truth: Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell, not taking into account any offsets.

q_14298.question: What is the difference between the "TA not allowed flag" and the "RA not allowed flag"?
q_14298.ground_truth: The "RA not allowed flag" is applied to restrict service on a routing area basis, while the "TA not allowed flag" is applied to restrict service on a tracking area basis.

q_14299.question: What must the MRFC do when it determines to offer FECC in the SDP offer?
q_14299.ground_truth: The MRFC must include the "m=" and "a=" lines related to the "application/h224" media types in the SDP offer, and request the MRFP to provide a separate IP/UDP/RTP transport for the "application/h224" media stream.

q_14300.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what does it cover in terms of telecommunication?
q_14300.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between groups of telecommunications standardization bodies, covering the Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects in Telecommunication management.

q_14301.question: What is the requirement for the 7,68 Mcps TDD option in terms of limiting interference to other systems?
q_14301.ground_truth: The requirement is to limit the interference caused by unwanted transmitter effects to other systems operating at frequencies which are more than 25~MHz away from the UTRA band used.

q_14302.question: What is the first digit of the version number in a 3GPP technical specification and what does it indicate?
q_14302.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number in a 3GPP technical specification indicates the stage of development of the document. A value of 1 indicates that the document is presented to TSG for information, a value of 2 indicates that the document is presented to TSG for approval, and a value of 3 or greater indicates that the document is TSG approved and under change control.

q_14303.question: What should the UE do if the Contention Resolution is not successful after MSG3 (re)transmission(s)?
q_14303.ground_truth: If contention resolution is not successful after MSG3 (re)transmission(s), the UE goes back to MSGA transmission.

q_14304.question: What is the TAI (MCC/MNC/TAC) for Cell A and Cell B?

q_14305.question: Which reference point is used for the transport of charging events for offline charging?

q_14306.question: What is the purpose of the "presence-status" condition in the communication barring service?
q_14306.ground_truth: The "presence-status" condition evaluates to true when the called user's current presence activity status is equal to the value set for this condition.

q_14307.question: What information element does the CTS-CLASSMARK CHANGE message contain?
q_14307.ground_truth: The CTS-CLASSMARK CHANGE message contains the new mobile station classmark 2 information element.

q_14308.question: How does the network allocate additional resources for retransmission when it receives erroneous blocks?
q_14308.ground_truth: The network allocates additional resources for retransmission based on erroneous blocks received from the MS and sends Packet Uplink Ack/Nack message when needed.

q_14309.question: What is the purpose of the MB2 reference point in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_14309.ground_truth: The MB2 reference point in the 3GPP technical specification defines the protocol for communication between the Group Communication Service Application Server (GCS AS) and the Broadcast-Multicast Service Centre (BM-SC) in the Group Communication System Enablers for LTE.

q_14310.question: What is the user identity information that the IdP may retrieve through the HSS over the Zh reference point?
q_14310.ground_truth: The IdP may retrieve the UID as the user identity, which could be an IMPI or any other user identity.

q_14311.question: In what mode is an SMC entity, in the Idle state, unable to accept a CP-DATA message and what message does it send before entering the Idle state again?
q_14311.ground_truth: If an SMC entity in the Idle state is unable to accept a CP-DATA message, it sends a CP-ERROR message followed by an MM-connection release request and then enters the Idle state.

q_14312.question: What is the function of the "ccc-list" attribute in the compact SDP parameters?
q_14312.ground_truth: The "ccc-list" attribute is a compact SDP parameter that lists the different codecs supported by the terminal in order of decreasing complexity.

q_14313.question: What does the NBIFOM-Support AVP indicate when sent from the PCEF to the PCRF in the initial CCR command?
q_14313.ground_truth: It indicates that the UE and network support the NBIFOM procedures.

q_14314.question: What are the two choices for the signalling bearer in the radio network control plane for the ATM Transport Option?
q_14314.ground_truth: SAAL-UNI over ATM and SSCF-UNI on top of SSCOP and AAL Type 5

q_14315.question: What is the purpose of the "x-predecbufsize" header field in an RTSP PLAY response?
q_14315.ground_truth: The "x-predecbufsize" header field specifies the size of the pre-decoder buffer for the streaming session.

q_14316.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of successful UE Context Release?

q_14317.question: What is the function of the Note 2 in the MBMS User Service Registration procedure?
q_14317.ground_truth: Note 2 explains the requirement for unique Key Group parts within an operator if the Key Domain ID does not uniquely identify the BM-SC. This is to ensure that two BM-SCs within an operator do not use the same Key Group value.

q_14318.question: What information is used to extract the frame size for H.264 (AVC) streams?
q_14318.ground_truth: The frame size is extracted from the sprop-parameters-sets parameter in the SDP, when present.

q_14319.question: What is the purpose of the test for Out of band gain?
q_14319.ground_truth: The purpose of the test for Out of band gain is to verify that the Repeater meets the out of band gain requirements as specified in TS 25.106.

q_14320.question: What is the role of the DRA in determining the PCRF for a certain UE and IP-CAN session?
q_14320.ground_truth: The DRA keeps status of assigned PCRF for a certain UE and IP-CAN session, and ensures that the same PCRF is contacted for Rx, Gxa/Gxc, Gx, S9, Sd and Np.

q_14321.question: What is the requirement for IMS Network-Independent Public User Identities (INIPUI) with regards to associating SIP URIs?
q_14321.ground_truth: Multiple INIPUI Operators shall be able to associate SIP URIs of type "sip:user@domain" (also known as "alphanumeric SIP URIs") that share a single domain name.

q_14322.question: What is the default RRC and NAS message and information elements contents in 3GPP 38.508-1?
q_14322.ground_truth: The default values of common RRC and NAS messages and information elements are used as defined in 3GPP TS 38.508-1, with some exceptions like REGISTRATION ACCEPT, LPP Provide Assistance Data, LPP Request Capabilities, LPP Request Location Information, NR E-CID Request Location Information, NR Multi-RTT Request Location Information, NR DL-AoD Request Location Information, and NR DL-TDOA Request Location Information.

q_14323.question: What is the role of the coder type flag in generating the base frequency excitation signal?
q_14323.ground_truth: The coder type flag is used to determine whether the base frequency excitation signal is generated from the MDCT coefficients of the core decoded signal or from random noise. It is initialized to 1 and is set to 0 if the coder type is not AUDIO and the total bit-rate is not larger than 8000.

q_14324.question: How are base layer bitstreams handled in the SHVC architecture?
q_14324.ground_truth: The base layer bitstream can be embedded within the SHVC bitstream or provided via external means. If embedded, the input bitstream is de-multiplexed into separate layers, and the base layer bitstream is sent to the base layer decoder. If provided by external means, the SHVC decoder applies inter-layer processing to the reconstructed BL pictures for predictive coding of the EL video pictures.

q_14325.question: What is the purpose of the parameter rL-ID in the definition of Combining-RL-AdditionRspFDD and NonCombining-RL-AdditionRspFDD?
q_14325.ground_truth: The parameter rL-ID in the definitions of Combining-RL-AdditionRspFDD and NonCombining-RL-AdditionRspFDD represents the radio link ID assigned to each radio link addition procedure in a cell. It is used to identify which radio link addition procedure the parameters the other parameters in the definitions of Combining-RL-AdditionRspFDD and NonCombining-RL-AdditionRspFDD correspond to.

q_14326.question: What is the recommended action regarding making the equipment fully operational before taking it to lower operating temperature?
q_14326.ground_truth: It is recommended to make the equipment fully operational prior to taking it to its lower operating temperature.

q_14327.question: How should a single lost SID frame be substituted?
q_14327.ground_truth: A single lost SID frame should be substituted by the last valid SID frame, and the procedure for valid SID frames should be applied.

q_14328.question: As per NOTE 5, when should the highest RS EPRE be used for devices that do not reach target TP?
q_14328.ground_truth: The highest RS EPRE at which TP is measured should be -80 dBm/15 kHz for devices that do not reach target TP.

q_14329.question: What is a Radio Access Bearer (RAB) in the 3GPP UTRA network?
q_14329.ground_truth: A Radio Access Bearer (RAB) is a bearer between a User Equipment (UE) and the Core Network (CN) in the UTRA network, which provides the requested Quality of Service (QoS) for the user.

q_14330.question: What is the formula for calculating the event-based feedback interval in Section 5.3?
q_14330.ground_truth: The event-based feedback interval is calculated using the formula Events per interval = V / Trigger Angle, where V is the speed of the head mounted display and Trigger Angle is the minimum fixed distance of the head movement that triggers sending a feedback.

q_14331.question: What is the purpose of sending a Discovery Request in ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_14331.ground_truth: The Discovery Request is sent by the UE to be authorized to access discovery resources and perform ProSe Direct Discovery.

q_14332.question: As per the document, which frequency bands can a UTRA/FDD Repeater operate in?
q_14332.ground_truth: A UTRA/FDD Repeater can operate in one or several pass bands within any of the operating bands specified in the document, and deployment in other frequency bands is not precluded.

q_14333.question: What is the procedure for the PDN GW Initiated PDN Disconnection in 3GPP Proximity-Based MIPv6?
q_14333.ground_truth: The PDN GW shall follow the LMA procedure for the PMIPv6 LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion as outlined in subclause 5.5.3 when it receives a Binding Revocation Indication message with G bit set, removing the sessions identified by the Fully Qualified PDN Connection Set Identifier Mobility Option. When it sends a Binding Revocation Indication message with G bit set to the LMA, it includes the Fully Qualified PDN Connection Set Identifier Mobility Option. The receiving node follows the Local Mobility Anchor Revoke Bulk PMIPv6 Bindings or Mobile Access Gateway Revoke Bulk PMIP6 Bindings proceedings accordingly.

q_14334.question: What should the BSS do when it cannot create a PFC immediately and queuing is not allowed?
q_14334.ground_truth: If the BSS is unable to create the PFC immediately and queuing is not allowed, the BSS shall send a CREATE-BSS-PFC-NACK PDU with cause 'PFC create failure' to the SGSN, and the SGSN shall consider the create BSS PFC procedure terminated and failed.

q_14335.question: In the SIM Application Toolkit conformance test specification, what does the term "Toolkit" refer to in the "Terminal Profile" column?
q_14335.ground_truth: In the SIM Application Toolkit conformance test specification, the term "Toolkit" in the "Terminal Profile" column refers to the SIM Application Toolkit feature being tested.

q_14336.question: What is the name of the 3GPP TS that defines the procedures for registration in the IM CN subsystem for ICS UE?

q_14337.question: What information does SS (CI) provide in relation to information extraction from signaling/UC likelihood indication, and what is not available with only SS?
q_14337.ground_truth: SS (CI) provides a certain degree of information regarding data extraction from signaling/UC likelihood indication, whereas SS does not provide any information in this regard.

q_14338.question: Why must the TFCS used for RLC testing guarantee that Tr mode segmentation will not occur?
q_14338.ground_truth: The TFCS must guarantee that Tr mode segmentation will not occur to prevent transmission of more than one Tr PDU per TTI.

q_14339.question: What should a mobile station operating in A/Gb mode do if it is unable to perform a PS handover to Iu mode or E-UTRAN for any reason?
q_14339.ground_truth: The mobile station should consider the PS handover as having failed and proceed as if a PS handover from A/Gb mode to A/Gb mode failed.

q_14340.question: What is the role of the UTM in the procedure described in Solution 1?
q_14340.ground_truth: The UTM is responsible for identifying the UAVs in a target area, asking for the list of UAVs in the area, and initiating the current location procedure for each UE in the list to get finer granularity information about the target UAVs.

q_14341.question: In the context of 6a.9.1.1, what action does UE-3 need to take before requesting a media transfer from UE-1 to UE-3?
q_14341.ground_truth: UE-3 needs to obtain information about the existing sessions and their media flows.

q_14342.question: What is the formatting mode specified in the "Text Attribute" section for "Text Attribute 1" in the first "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND SS 4.5.1" and the equivalent "Text Attribute" section in the following "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND SS 4.X.Y"?
q_14342.ground_truth: The formatting mode is specified as "Left Alignment, Small Font, Bold Off, Italic Off, Underline Off, Strikethrough Off", indicating the appearance of the displayed text.

q_14343.question: What is the pre-condition for establishing the NR positioning protocol between the UEs and the Location Server in the network?
q_14343.ground_truth: The pre-condition for establishing the NR positioning protocol between the UEs and the Location Server in the network is that the UAV and UAV-C are both registered with the network and USS/UTM and are authorized for flight operations.

q_14344.question: What are the two types of network-assisted GPS methods used for position calculation?
q_14344.ground_truth: The two types of network-assisted GPS methods for position calculation are UE-based and UE-assisted, with the former being performed in the UE and the latter being performed in the UTRAN.

q_14345.question: In the DRX mode 2/8, what percentage of DTX/DRX time is achieved when averaging over 'n' for UE offset?
q_14345.ground_truth: A UE can achieve 31% of DTX/DRX time when using the DRX mode 2/8.

q_14346.question: What information does the file decoder provide to the MCC as defined in observation point 2?
q_14346.ground_truth: The file decoder provides information about media resolution, media codec, media frame rate, media projection, mono/stereo 360 video, and media decoding time to the MCC.

q_14347.question: Over what interval does the AMR Encoder generate and send SID frames about every 160ms?
q_14347.ground_truth: The AMR Encoder generates and sends SID frames about every 160ms during speech pauses in uplink and downlink.

q_14348.question: What is the maximum timing advance value for GSM 400?
q_14348.ground_truth: The maximum timing advance value TAmax shall be 219 for GSM 400.

q_14349.question: What message is sent by the UE to the USS during registration on PS after receiving the ATTACH ACCEPT message from the USS?
q_14349.ground_truth: ATTACH COMPLETE and P-TMSI signature value

q_14350.question: What should the MAC entity do if no set of Random Access resources is identified to be associated with any feature indication?
q_14350.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the set of Random Access resources to not be associated with any feature indication.

q_14351.question: What target identities are used for 3GPP HeNB interception?
q_14351.ground_truth: The target identities for 3GPP HeNB interception are IMSI, MSISDN, IMEI, ME Id, HeNB ID, or CSG ID.

q_14352.question: How does the anycast server address work in the application domain aware procedure?
q_14352.ground_truth: The anycast server address is a single URL/IP anycast address that identifies the application globally or across a wide area. The anycast address is used to select the closest edge application server (EAS) in the network, and the EAS issues an application-level redirect with a local URL that selects the same server instance.

q_14353.question: What is the purpose of the "Maximum header compression context space" parameter in UE radio access capabilities?
q_14353.ground_truth: This parameter is used to define the maximum header compression context size supported by the UE for all RFC 2507 protocol entities for all RBs.

q_14354.question: What function in the PCC architecture is responsible for activating application detection rules and controlling detected application traffic?
q_14354.ground_truth: The TDF (Traffic Detection Function) is responsible for activating application detection rules and the PCEF (Policy and Charging Enforcement Function) is responsible for controlling detected application traffic.

q_14355.question: What action is taken by the NAS if the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred and the UE is operating in the single-registration mode or dual-registration mode, in relation to an MO-MMTEL-voice-call-started indication or an MO-MMTEL-video-call-started indication?
q_14355.ground_truth: If the UE is operating in the single-registration mode or dual-registration mode, and the UE receives an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, the NAS shall notify the upper layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category and may initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message, if still needed.

q_14356.question: What type of response does the AS send to the S-CSCF after receiving the final response from user-C, when recording call forwarding execution?
q_14356.ground_truth: The AS sends a SIP 200(OK) response back to the S-CSCF.

q_14357.question: What is the role of the NSQ function in controlling and restricting the number of UEs per network slice?
q_14357.ground_truth: The NSQ function manages the network slice related quota for the maximum number of UEs, maintains a list of UE Ids that are registered with each network slice, and ensures that the maximum number of UEs per network slice is not exceeded when a UE registers for a network slice.

q_14358.question: What restriction is applied on padding in RTP as per RFC 3550?
q_14358.ground_truth: RTP-level padding is mandated to be set to 0 as per RFC 3550.

q_14359.question: What is the purpose of the context-based Huffman coding mode in envelope coding?
q_14359.ground_truth: The context-based Huffman coding mode is used to apply Huffman coding to the quantization differential indices in the current frame. It is selected for coding when it requires the least bits compared to other modes.

q_14360.question: What happens when the authentication request is unsuccessful in the described scenario?
q_14360.ground_truth: In case of unsuccessful authentication, the ProSe Function sends a Debit Units Request to the OCS for refund purposes.

q_14361.question: What type of identity must the H(e)NB certificate carry in the subjectAltName field?
q_14361.ground_truth: The H(e)NB certificate must carry the HNB unique identity in FQDN format in the subjectAltName field.

q_14362.question: What is the transmission delay requirement for RLP to avoid time-outs?
q_14362.ground_truth: The transmission delay requirement for RLP to avoid time-outs is for the round-trip delay between the MSC/IWF and the MS/TA to be lower than T1 - T2.

q_14363.question: What is the longest burst duration for straightforward mapping in the UAS-10 packet data block type?
q_14363.ground_truth: The longest burst duration for straightforward mapping in the UAS-10 packet data block type is 211+231+2 = 444.

q_14364.question: How much bit-rate reduction was achieved by the EVC reference encoder over the HEVC reference encoder using the HEVC Main 10 profile and the AVC Progressive High 10 profile?
q_14364.ground_truth: The EVC reference encoder achieved approximately 39% and 41% bit-rate reduction for UHD and HD SDR content respectively when compared to the HEVC reference encoder and approximately 39% and 34% bit-rate reduction for UHD and HD SDR content respectively when compared to the AVC reference encoder.

q_14365.question: What is the ideal frequency hopping full rate character error rate for a PCS 1900 AMR speech traffic channel using a Typical Urban channel profile and a speed of the mobile station of 3.0~km/h?
q_14365.ground_truth: The ideal frequency hopping full rate character error rate for a PCS 1900 AMR speech traffic channel using a Typical Urban channel profile and a speed of the mobile station of 3.0~km/h is less than or equal to 7.3%.

q_14366.question: What is the key Kc used for in the 48.008 29.002 cipher mode command?
q_14366.ground_truth: The key Kc is used for setting the ciphering mode in the 48.008 29.002 cipher mode command.

q_14367.question: What is the role of the Routing Function Entity (RFE) in the RRC layer model?
q_14367.ground_truth: The Routing Function Entity (RFE) in the RRC layer model is responsible for routing higher layer messages to different MM/CM entities on the UE side or different core network domains on the UTRAN side.

q_14368.question: What type of context should a UE establish with its home GGSN in a network with dual stack IMS and IPv4 GGSN, in order to use IPv6 IMS?
q_14368.ground_truth: The UE should initially attempt to establish an IPv6 context to its home GGSN.

q_14369.question: What is the structure of an RRC PDU in this specification?
q_14369.ground_truth: An RRC PDU is the concatenation of a basic production, an extension, and padding in that order.

q_14370.question: What are the two different mappings derived based on the strength of the unwanted sub channel and the strongest external GMSK modulated co-channel interference?
q_14370.ground_truth: The two mappings derived are SAIC (Subchannel and Adjacent Channel Interference Cancellation) and SAM (Subchannel and Multiple Access Interference), one for the case when the unwanted sub channel is stronger than the strongest external GMSK modulated co-channel interference, and the other for when the external GMSK modulated co-channel interference is stronger than the unwanted sub channel.

q_14371.question: What was the link delay set to for the network simulator?
q_14371.ground_truth: The delay was set to 0 or 200 ms on both links.

q_14372.question: What is the role of the pitch enhancer in the decoding process?
q_14372.ground_truth: The pitch enhancer modifies the total excitation by filtering the fixed codebook excitation through an innovation filter. This emphasizes higher frequencies in the signal, improving the overall quality of the reconstructed speech.

q_14373.question: What is the purpose of an MBMS Service Announcement?
q_14373.ground_truth: An MBMS Service Announcement is a mechanism that allows users to be informed about the MBMS user services available.

q_14374.question: What is the seed for the pseudo random number generator in the noise filling algorithm used in IGF?
q_14374.ground_truth: The seed for the pseudo random number generator is derived from the TCX noise filling seed by using a formula based on the TCX coefficient of the decoded core signal prior to application of the LPC filter.

q_14375.question: What is a MAC-ehs queue?
q_14375.ground_truth: A MAC-ehs queue is a buffer in the MAC layer that stores the MAC-d PDUs that are transmitted over the air interface. Each MAC-ehs queue is associated with a MAC-d entity and is used to store the MAC-d PDUs that are sent over the same MAC entity. The MAC-ehs queue is responsible for storing the MAC-d PDUs and for ensuring that they are delivered to the correct destination.

q_14376.question: What is the purpose of the logical link maintenance functions?
q_14376.ground_truth: The logical link maintenance functions supervise the logical link status and control link state changes.

q_14377.question: In the 8.1.3.1.18.3.2 section of the document, what are the conformance requirements mentioned that the test case follows?
q_14377.ground_truth: The conformance requirements covered in the current TC are specified in: TS 38.331, clauses 5.3.5.3, 5.5.2.1, 5.5.3.1, 5.5.4.1, and 5.5.5.1.

q_14378.question: In the EC-CCCH/D operation, what training sequence set is used for EC-PCH and EC-AGCH blocks that are designated to mobile stations in CC1 only?

q_14379.question: What is the measurement name for the number of failed incoming circuit switched inter-RAT handovers per cause where UMTS is the target network?
q_14379.ground_truth: IRATHO.FailIncCS.Cause where Cause identifies the failure cause.

q_14380.question: What does the MSGin5G server do after receiving a valid Group Message Request from an authorized MSGin5G client?
q_14380.ground_truth: The MSGin5G server resolves the MSGin5G Group ID, determines the registration status of non-IMS UEs, and validates the request based on the policy.

q_14381.question: What is the LWI measurement that provides the number of octets of outgoing LWA PDUs transmitted by the eNB over Xw interface to WT, incremented by 1 for each octet of the successfully transmitted downlink LWA PDUs?

q_14382.question: Under what conditions must the UE consider access identity 1 to be valid when it is not in the country of its HPLMN?
q_14382.ground_truth: The UE must receive the MPS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message indicating that access identity 1 is valid in the RPLMN or equivalent PLMN.

q_14383.question: Which function of the BM-SC sets the state attribute of its MBMS Bearer Context to 'Standby' in response to the Session Stop Request message for GERAN and UTRAN for GPRS?
q_14383.ground_truth: The BM-SC Proxy and Transport function

q_14384.question: What codecs are required to be supported by MCPTT clients?
q_14384.ground_truth: MCPTT clients are required to support the AMR-WB codec in accordance with 3GPP TS 26.171, 3GPP TS 26.190, 3GPP TS 26.173, and 3GPP TS 26.204, including all 9 modes and source-controlled rate operation.

q_14385.question: Which measurement provides the maximum time it takes to establish an E-RAB per QCI?
q_14385.ground_truth: The measurement "ERAB.EstabTimeMax.QCI" provides the maximum time it takes to establish an E-RAB per QCI.

q_14386.question: What should the Node B report to the CRNC when a common or dedicated channel cannot be supported due to capability changes?
q_14386.ground_truth: The Node B should report the impact to the CRNC with the relevant procedures when the capabilities and/or resource operational state of common physical channels and/or common transport channels have changed, and the new capability and/or resource operational state should be indicated in a RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message. If the power value for a common physical channel or common transport channel becomes unsupported, the Node B should report it to the CRNC in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message with the appropriate Cause IE.

q_14387.question: What is the purpose of the "Cell update" message sent by the UE to UTRAN?
q_14387.ground_truth: The "Cell update" message sent by the UE to UTRAN is used to initiate a cell update procedure.

q_14388.question: What is the role of the MME in the EPC Network Induced Location Request procedure?
q_14388.ground_truth: The MME is responsible for initiating the EPC Network Induced Location Request procedure, selecting an E-SMLC, and sending a Location Request message to the selected E-SMLC with the requested QoS and identity of the serving cell.

q_14389.question: What should the DRNS do if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the HS-SCCH Power Offset IE in the HS-DSCH Information IE in FDD?
q_14389.ground_truth: If the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the HS-SCCH Power Offset IE in the HS-DSCH Information IE, then the DRNS may use this value to determine the HS-SCCH power in FDD.

q_14390.question: What are the three major requirements for the system modification functions and how do they support the network management process?
q_14390.ground_truth: The three major requirements for the system modification functions are minimum disturbance of the network, physical and logical modifications as separate actions, and completion of all required actions before bringing the resources into service. These requirements ensure that network modifications are performed in a controlled manner, with minimal disruption to network services.

q_14391.question: In which mode of operation is the RLC function preserving the order of higher layer PDUs provided to it?
q_14391.ground_truth: In RLC acknowledged mode of operation, the RLC function preserves the order of higher layer PDUs provided to it.

q_14392.question: What is the effect of national regulations on the delivery of communications for an outbound international roaming target?
q_14392.ground_truth: National regulations may limit the delivery of communications (CC and communications-associated IRI) of an outbound international roaming target by the HPLMN. If roaming interception is not allowed, the HPLMN shall report IRI and CC for IMS VoIP sessions where the target is not participating in the IMS VoIP services.

q_14393.question: What should the AS do upon receiving specific DTMF digits for CAT stop and restart?
q_14393.ground_truth: The AS should instruct the MRF to stop the media for the CAT service and restart the media for the CAT service accordingly.

q_14394.question: What is the significance of the TONe parameter in the PROACTIVE COMMAND: PLAY TONE 1.4.1 command?
q_14394.ground_truth: The TOnE parameter in the PROACTIVE COMMAND: PLAY TONE 1.4.1 command specifies the type of standard supervisory tones to be played. In this case, the dial tone is being played in the example given.

q_14395.question: What should the Remote UE do when the reporting criteria are met in the usage reporting procedure?
q_14395.ground_truth: The Remote UE creates a corresponding usage information report and sends it to the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay UE when the reporting criteria are met in the usage reporting procedure.

q_14396.question: What is the purpose of performing end-to-end information exchange about the current radio environment during CS call setup?
q_14396.ground_truth: It allows UE to take the current radio environment information of the other UE into account when deciding what service options to present to the user and/or whether to initiate a UE capability information exchange.

q_14397.question: What is a separate PDU session used for in the context of UAS communications?
q_14397.ground_truth: A separate PDU session is used for UAS communications when a separate DNN from the one used to communicate with USS/UTM is required for communication with a UAV-C.

q_14398.question: What is the format of the RTP header extension block that contains a single variable timestamp extension element?
q_14398.ground_truth: The RTP header extension block that contains a single variable timestamp extension element is formatted as follows: 0xBEDE length=1 | ID | len=2 | timestamp-offset

q_14399.question: What type of data is the GERAN Cell Identity Age and UTRAN Service Area Identity Age, and where is it stored?
q_14399.ground_truth: The GERAN Cell Identity Age and UTRAN Service Area Identity Age are both types of temporary data that store the time elapsed since the last GERAN Cell Global Identity and UTRAN Service Area Identity were acquired, respectively. This data is stored in the SGSN.

q_14400.question: What should the MS take if SMS transfer via GPRS fails?
q_14400.ground_truth: As per 2.6, The MS shall use the circuit-switched domain instead of GPRS for SMS transfer for an implementation dependent time. When a different PLMN is selected, if the MS preferred method is the sending of SMS over GPRS, the MS shall revert to trying an SMS transfer via GPRS.

q_14401.question: What is the function of the Reduced Block Sequence Number (RBSN) bit in the RLC/MAC header?
q_14401.ground_truth: The RBSN bit in the RLC/MAC header indicates the sequence number of the downlink RLC/MAC control blocks.

q_14402.question: What is the purpose of the Network Resource Model (NRM) in 3GPP TS 28.651?
q_14402.ground_truth: The Network Resource Model (NRM) in 3GPP TS 28.651 is responsible for defining the information required to manage a UTRAN network for telecommunication management purposes, including the management of converged networks.

q_14403.question: What is one open issue for supporting Reflective QoS in case QoS Rules are applied to the outer header?
q_14403.ground_truth: An open issue is how to support Reflective QoS in case QoS Rules are applied to the outer header, as it is more straightforward to support in SMF when QoS Rules are applied to the inner header.

q_14404.question: What is the range of values for the bucket counter field?
q_14404.ground_truth: The bucket counter field ranges from zero (00000000) to two hundred and fifty five (11111111).

q_14405.question: In the context of network load, what does the term "temporal variation" refer to?
q_14405.ground_truth: The variation in network load at different times of the day.

q_14406.question: What actions does a mobile station take when timer T3232 expires during the acquisition of an ETWS Primary Notification message?
q_14406.ground_truth: At expiry of timer T3232, the mobile station discards all segments of the partially received ETWS Primary Notification message and re-enters DRX mode.

q_14407.question: What is the difference between a Broad conceptual model and Specific purpose models in the FNIM?
q_14407.ground_truth: A Broad conceptual model in the FNIM is a purpose-neutral view of the problem space, while Specific purpose models are purpose-specific views that articulate the solution to a specific problem.

q_14408.question: What technology is recommended for addressing and routing within an AIPN to accommodate a vast number of users and terminals?

q_14409.question: What is the purpose of defining a new SDP parameter for end-to-end RAN-assisted codec adaptation support?
q_14409.ground_truth: The purpose of defining a new SDP parameter for end-to-end RAN-assisted codec adaptation support is to indicate that both UEs and their respective eNBs support RAN-assisted codec adaptation, addressing the issues of determining support for this feature in the far-end UE, the near-end access network, and the far-end access network.

q_14410.question: What action should the IM-MGW take when receiving a request to provide the desired pacing value for connectivity checks (Ta timer value)?
q_14410.ground_truth: The IM-MGW shall calculate the Ta timer value based on the characteristics of the associated data or use the default value of 50 ms and provide it as the desired Ta timer value.

q_14411.question: What is the intended use of Priority Service in 3GPP systems?
q_14411.ground_truth: Priority Service in 3GPP systems is intended to be used by qualified and authorized users, such as key emergency service personnel and those with leadership responsibilities, only during times of emergency situations and network congestion to obtain priority access to available radio (voice or data traffic) resources.

q_14412.question: Which band has been identified by WRC-15 in Region 3 for use by administrations to implement terrestrial IMT systems?
q_14412.ground_truth: The band 470-698 MHz, or parts thereof, has been identified by WRC-15 in Region 3 for use by administrations to implement terrestrial IMT systems.

q_14413.question: What modulation types can be used for the Channelisation Code in 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_14413.ground_truth: The modulation types that can be used for the Channelisation Code in 1.28Mcps TDD are QPSK and 8PSK.

q_14414.question: What condition(s) must be met for the network to deliver mobile terminating point-to-point short messages via the CS domain on the SACCH of the voice group call channel?
q_14414.ground_truth: The network must not broadcast an SMS data confidentiality indication on the NCH, or it must broadcast an SMS data confidentiality indication on the NCH and the voice group call channel is ciphered.

q_14415.question: What is the assumed mechanism for USS/UTM to indicate revocation of UAV3 connectivity between the UAV and UAV Controller?
q_14415.ground_truth: The USS/UTM may indicate to the 3GPP system revocation of UAV3 connectivity between the UAV and UAV Controller when necessary.

q_14416.question: In which resolution does HMD1 result in the highest simulator sickness scores for content 2?

q_14417.question: What are the basic functional contents of the layer 2 protocol on the A-bis interface?
q_14417.ground_truth: The basic functional contents of the layer 2 protocol on the A-bis interface are: transparent layer 2 links and time fill, point-to-point dedicated layer 2 links addressing both physical entities and functional entities, point-to-multipoint addressed links used for layer 2 management, basic functions for TEI assignment and management, basic priority functions, basic supervision of links when not carrying traffic, sequence control, transmission error control, and control of errors not recoverable by retransmission.

q_14418.question: What happens when the maximum number of PDU sessions is reached and there are new requests for PDU sessions?
q_14418.ground_truth: New requests for PDU sessions are not handled, and there is no re-prioritization of established PDU sessions compared to new requests.

q_14419.question: What is the purpose of the link-to-system interface in the context of SAIC receivers?
q_14419.ground_truth: The purpose of the link-to-system interface in the context of SAIC receivers is to map the burst CIR and burst DIR to burst BEP in two stages, and use the resulting FEP to calculate whether the particular frame was in error.

q_14420.question: What is the purpose of an eNodeB utilizing CoMP and MU-MIMO in the downlink for a UE?
q_14420.ground_truth: The purpose of an eNodeB utilizing CoMP (Coordinated MultiPoint) and MU-MIMO (Multi User Multiple Input Multiple Output) in the downlink for a UE is to improve the system's spectral efficiency and cell-edge throughput. CoMP is a technique in which multiple eNodeBs work together to improve the signal quality at the cell edge. MU-MIMO, on the other hand, is a technique where multiple antennas at an eNodeB serve multiple UE devices simultaneously, increasing the system's capacity and efficiency.

q_14421.question: What is the purpose of the Connect procedure described in clause 9.8?
q_14421.ground_truth: The Connect procedure is used to request the IM-SSF to perform call processing actions to route a call to a specific destination. The parameters in the Connect operation replace the corresponding signaling parameters in the IP Multimedia session control for subsequent processing of the IM session. The IP Multimedia session control sends corresponding signaling parameters to a new call leg without using them in the subsequent processing of the IM session.

q_14422.question: Which version of NR UE and beyond does this test apply to?
q_14422.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 17 onwards that supports DL-AoD positioning and supportedDL-PRS-ProcessingSamples-RRC-CONNECTED.

q_14423.question: What is the purpose of Performance Management (PM) in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
q_14423.ground_truth: The purpose of PM is to collect performance related data from various Network Elements (NE) in a 3GPP system, which can be used to locate potential problems in the network.

q_14424.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a SIP 2xx response with the SDP answer from the remote UE during a media transfer?
q_14424.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP ACK request to the remote UE and a SIP re-INVITE request to the controllee UE, containing the current port number for the media component and the directionality attributes.

q_14425.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals in the "Service-based support for SMS in 5GC" document?
q_14425.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals in the "Service-based support for SMS in 5GC" document is to study the key issues and requirements for implementing SBA/SBI paradigm and associated enhancements for 5G SMS and potential solutions to resolve the identified issues.

q_14426.question: What kind of signal is used to measure ICS (In-channel selectivity) in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_14426.ground_truth: The interfering signal used to measure ICS is an E-UTRA signal as specified in Annex C and shall be time aligned with the wanted signal in the 3GPP technical specification.

q_14427.question: What should the originating BSS do upon initiation of the RAN Information Send procedure?
q_14427.ground_truth: The originating BSS sets the content of the RAN-INFORMATION PDU and sends it. If the ACK indicator is set to "ACK requested", it also starts a T(RI) instance for this RAN-INFORMATION PDU.

q_14428.question: How many functional new requirements are listed in the 5G system functional requirements?
q_14428.ground_truth: There are 10 functional new requirements listed in the 5G system functional requirements.

q_14429.question: How does the RA1'/RAA' function adapt the data stream when using the EDGE channel codings TCH/F43.2 or TCH/F28.8?
q_14429.ground_truth: The RA1'/RAA' function adapts the data stream to 14,5 kbit/s substreams as if multiple 14,5 kbit/s radio interface channels were used when using the EDGE channel codings TCH/F43.2 or TCH/F28.8.

q_14430.question: What is a potential impact or interaction of MPS for streaming video with existing services/features in the 3GPP system?
q_14430.ground_truth: One potential impact is the need for intermediate 3GPP networks to allow MPS priority markings to be passed transparently based on policy agreements.

q_14431.question: What is the procedure for the pre-test conditions in test case 8.2.6.1.2.2.3.1?
q_14431.ground_truth: In the pre-test conditions of test case 8.2.6.1.2.2.3.1, the UE is in state RRC_CONNECTED using the generic procedure parameter Connectivity (NR-DC) and with UE test loop mode A prepared. NR Cell 1 is the PCell, NR Cell 10 is the PSCell, and NR Cell 28 is the SCG SCell. The system information combination NR-4 as defined in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.4.3.1.2 is used in NR cells.

q_14432.question: Which measurement is used for the number of failed relocation preparation for outgoing inter-RNC hard handovers switching in the CN per cause?

q_14433.question: What is online charging?
q_14433.ground_truth: Online charging is a charging mechanism where charging information can affect, in real-time, the service rendered and therefore a direct interaction of the charging mechanism with bearer/session/service control is required.

q_14434.question: What information is specified in the AFA Monitoring Cycles information element?
q_14434.ground_truth: The AFA Monitoring Cycles information element specifies a number of AFA monitoring cycles.

q_14435.question: Which 3GPP messaging service is a real-time, text-based messaging service, with the ability to send attachments in a background mode?
q_14435.ground_truth: Instant Messaging is a real-time, text-based messaging service with the ability to send attachments in a background mode.

q_14436.question: What is the benefit of incorporating improved error resiliency into the scheduler for EVS mode compared to AMR-WB?
q_14436.ground_truth: It can result in power savings at the UE due to reduced ON time or reduced number of transmissions, and it can free up resources either to add more users or for best effort traffic.

q_14437.question: What is the impact of setting the supportOfMUMIMO field to 'uplink' in the UE-RadioAccessCapability-va40ext-IEs sequence?
q_14437.ground_truth: Setting the supportOfMUMIMO field to 'uplink' in the UE-RadioAccessCapability-va40ext-IEs sequence indicates that the user equipment is capable of supporting MIMO in the uplink direction. This allows the user equipment to receive and transmit data simultaneously on multiple antennas and frequency bands.

q_14438.question: What is the threshold used in the condition that checks if the cross-zero rate of the second half frame is greater than that of the first half frame by four times?
q_14438.ground_truth: The threshold used in this condition is 4.

q_14439.question: When must the UE require compressed mode to perform inter-frequency measurement or inter-RAT measurement type?
q_14439.ground_truth: The UE requires compressed mode if it requires compressed mode for the measurement type and the frequency to measure is not associated with the same band as the frequency of the serving HS-DSCH cell, and it can perform the measurement type on the frequencies associated with the serving HS-DSCH cell and the secondary serving HS-DSCH cells.

q_14440.question: In the USF decoding procedure, what is the time frame required for the second allocated DL timeslot?
q_14440.ground_truth: The second allocated DL timeslot is used for the USF decoding procedure in the second 10 ms of the next 20 ms time unit.

q_14441.question: What is the procedure for Iu framing protocol initialisation for TrFO calls?
q_14441.ground_truth: For TrFO calls, the UP initialisation procedure defined for the Nb UP shall be supported by the CN, when a CN MGW is required to establish a connection. During framing protocol initialisation, the informed RNCs/MGW shall only offer and/or accept UP versions listed in the "RAB assignment"/"Add request". The selected RNC and MGW have to be able to support at least one Iu/Nb UP version with TrFO capabilities.

q_14442.question: What is the purpose of user plane event notification in the IP preserving PSA relocation solution?
q_14442.ground_truth: User plane event notification can be used for triggering the application relocation from EAS#1 to EAS#2, but it is not required.

q_14443.question: What is the function of the MBS session key in protecting MBS traffic?
q_14443.ground_truth: The MBS session key is used to derive further keys that are used between the UE and the NG-RAN to protect MBS traffic. It provides integrity and confidentiality protection for MBS data traffic between the UE and the NG-RAN at the PDCP layer.

q_14444.question: What is the purpose of the IOPS connectivity client in the one-to-one SDS data transfer using signalling control plane?
q_14444.ground_truth: The IOPS connectivity client retrieves the connectivity information of the target MCData user, which is used by the MCData client to initiate SDS data transfer over the IOPS MC connectivity function.

q_14445.question: What information must be included in the location request for an LCS Client to be authorized by the LCS Server?
q_14445.ground_truth: The location request issued by the LCS client to GMLC shall optionally include also the identity of the originator of the location request, i.e. the Requestor, not only the identity of the LCS client. The requestor shall be authenticated by the LCS client and/or the network.

q_14446.question: What components may need to be performed for DTT-over-eMBMS service delivery?
q_14446.ground_truth: Transcoding of native DTT media encoding format to 3GPP media encoding format and conversion via de-capsulation and re-encapsulation of native DTT transport formats to 3GPP transport formats may need to be performed for DTT-over-eMBMS service delivery.

q_14447.question: What is the highest defined profile/level combination for H.264 (AVC) in 3GPP services?
q_14447.ground_truth: H.264 (AVC) Progressive High Profile Level 5.1, with the maximum VCL Bit Rate being constrained to 120 Mbps.

q_14448.question: What type of frames should the MS avoid for BSIC identification for cell re-selection?
q_14448.ground_truth: The MS should avoid frames used for TA-messages and frames used for transmitting access bursts for BSIC identification for cell re-selection.

q_14449.question: What must the MnS consumer request from the MnS producer to create an instance of AssuranceGoal?
q_14449.ground_truth: The MnS consumer must request the MnS producer to create an instance of AssuranceGoal using the "AssuranceGoal IOC" which includes the attributes "AssuranceTargetList" and "AssuranceGoalStatus".

q_14450.question: How many data blocks can be transmitted in a radio block using MCS1-6?
q_14450.ground_truth: 1 data block can be transmitted in a radio block using MCS1-6.

q_14451.question: What is the maximum BS power in the simulated scenario?
q_14451.ground_truth: The maximum BS (Base Station) power in the simulated scenario is 20 W.

q_14452.question: What should the ePDG or Trusted Non-3GPP Access do when initiating the PDN Connection Lifetime Extension procedure, as per clause 11.2.2, in PMIPv6 mode?
q_14452.ground_truth: Follow the MAG procedure for the PMIPv6 PDN Connection Lifetime Extension

q_14453.question: When does a UE establish a separate SWu instance for each additional PDN connection?
q_14453.ground_truth: The UE establishes a separate SWu instance (i.e. a separate IPSec tunnel) for each additional PDN connection when it already has an established PDN connection via a Fixed Broadband Access Network using GTPv2 or PMIPv6 based S2b and wishes to establish one or more additional PDN connections over the same access.

q_14454.question: What is the function of the X2 signalling bearer in 3GPP TS 36.423?
q_14454.ground_truth: The X2 signalling bearer in 3GPP TS 36.423 provides reliable transfer of X2-AP messages over the X2 interface, network and routing function, redundancy in the signalling network, and support for flow and congestion control.

q_14455.question: Which part of the 3GPP system consists of RNCs and Node Bs between Iu and Uu interfaces for UTRAN?
q_14455.ground_truth: UTRAN, or the Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network, is the part of the 3GPP system that consists of RNCs and Node Bs between Iu and Uu interfaces.

q_14456.question: What should an LLE do when it receives a valid I frame with V(R) < N(S) < V(R) + k, and the LLE is not in the own receiver busy condition?
q_14456.ground_truth: The LLE should store the I frame until all frames from V(R) to N(S) - 1 are correctly received, set its V(R) = N(S) + 1, and pass the information field of this I frame to layer 3 using the LL-DATA-IND primitive.

q_14457.question: What is the definition of "ancillary equipment" provided in the document?
q_14457.ground_truth: Ancillary equipment is defined as equipment used in connection with a receiver, transmitter, or transceiver, providing additional operational and/or control features for the radio equipment. It cannot be used on a stand-alone basis, and it is not a sub-unit of the main equipment essential for its basic functions.

q_14458.question: What is the minimum value that L can take in the pagation model?
q_14458.ground_truth: L shall in no circumstances be less than free space loss.

q_14459.question: What protocol is used to coordinate the mapping between QoS Flow and MP-QUIC Connection between UE and UPF?
q_14459.ground_truth: The protocol used for MASQUE (i.e. HTTP) may then be used to coordinate the mapping between QoS Flow and MP-QUIC Connection between UE and UPF.

q_14460.question: What is the component within the IM CN subsystem that controls the IM-MGW and performs SIP to BICC or SIP to ISUP call related signalling interworking?

q_14461.question: What is the resource indication value (RIV) for a uplink type 1 resource allocation field?
q_14461.ground_truth: The resource indication value (RIV) for a uplink type 1 resource allocation field consists of a resource indication value (RIV) corresponding to a starting virtual resource block (nrG) and a length in terms of contiguously allocated resource blocks (ng). The resource indication value is defined by if nrG>0 then else where 1 <= shall not exceed.

q_14462.question: What type of Detection Point (DP) initiates a CAMEL control relationship when encountered and there is no existing relationship due to the same CSI?

q_14463.question: What is the response if the addressed station is not ready or unwilling to establish the particular DLC during the establishment of a DLC?
q_14463.ground_truth: If the responding station is not ready or unwilling to establish the particular DLC, it will reply with a DM frame with the F-bit set to 1.

q_14464.question: What action should be taken when an "erroneous Sequence Number" is received?
q_14464.ground_truth: When an "erroneous Sequence Number" is received, the device should stop transmitting any AMD PDU or STATUS PDU, ignore incoming AMD PDUs, piggybacked STATUS PDUs, or STATUS PDUs. It should then increment the VT(RST) by 1.

q_14465.question: What is the purpose of the SMS "Memory Capacity Exceeded" Notification Flag in the last used TP-MR?
q_14465.ground_truth: It allows a process of flow control, informing the Network as memory capacity in the UE becomes available.

q_14466.question: What is the purpose of the K~PC5-COM~ key in Step 10?
q_14466.ground_truth: The K~PC5-COM~ key is generated by the 5G PKMF-1(Remote UE) for PC5 communication identified by K~PC5~ key ID. It is used for secure communication between the Remote UE and the UE-to-network relay.

q_14467.question: What are the KPIs for a positioning system typically specified by?
q_14467.ground_truth: The KPIs for a positioning system are typically specified by the positioning system provider, such as a vehicle OEM.

q_14468.question: What should the DRNS include in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message if the HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent Resource Reservation Indicator IE is present in the HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling Information LCR IE?
q_14468.ground_truth: The DRNS should include the Allocated HS-PDSCH Semi-persistent resource IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message.

q_14469.question: What does the term 'IRP' refer to within the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_14469.ground_truth: The term 'IRP' refers to the Integration Reference Point within the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project. It facilitates communication between different elements of the 3G network, such as Element Managers or Network Elements, and Network Managers.

q_14470.question: What are the typical sequence of steps to use edge computing services in the 5G Media Streaming Architecture?
q_14470.ground_truth: The typical sequence of steps involves service provisioning, registration, EAS discovery, and EAS relocation if necessary, with detailed key messages and elements for each step.

q_14471.question: What is the technology used in 5G mmWAVE that allows users to access the full potential of 5G by utilizing untapped frequency bands above 24 GHz?
q_14471.ground_truth: 5G mmWAVE technology, as part of 5G NR specifications, is well defined in 3GPP since Release 15. It allows users to access the full potential of 5G by utilizing untapped frequency bands above 24 GHz.

q_14472.question: What should the Node B do if the TNL QoS IE is included in the E-DCH MAC-d Flows Information TDD IE for an E-DCH MAC-d flow and ALCAP is not used?
q_14472.ground_truth: The Node B may use the TNL QoS IE to determine the transport bearer characteristics to apply in the uplink for the related MAC-d flow.

q_14473.question: What is the formula used to calculate Cn in the context of running average filtering in 3GPP TS 45.002?
q_14473.ground_truth: Cn = (1-b) * Cn-1 + b * SSn, where SSn is the received signal level of the measurement samples, b is the forgetting factor, and n is the iteration index.

q_14474.question: Which document in the series lists the input and output parameters for all the Tuak functions?

q_14475.question: In which clause of TS 38.331 does it specify that the hysteresis parameter for this event is expressed in dB?

q_14476.question: In what conditions can the source BSS/RNC initiate a PS handover to GAN A/Gb mode?
q_14476.ground_truth: The source BSS/RNC can initiate a PS handover to GAN A/Gb mode to prevent an MS from performing an autonomous rove-in to GAN A/Gb mode in favor of using the PS handover to perform a cell change.

q_14477.question: What is the basic structure of the e-ext?
q_14477.ground_truth: The e-ext is a Choice type with 15 alternatives, where each alternative is either a NULL value or a UEInformationResponse.

q_14478.question: What message receipt by the PDN-GW in EPS packet switching results in the increment of the "Successful number of PDN-GW initiated Dedicated Bearer Modification with QoS update" counter?
q_14478.ground_truth: The receipt of an "Update Bearer Response" message with a "Bearer Level QoS" IE and an "Acceptance Response" from the "Cause" IE indicates a successful PDN-GW initiated dedicated bearer modification with QoS update.

q_14479.question: Which section describes the initial conditions for the HD-FDD inter-frequency RSTD Measurement Accuracy test in CE Mode B for Category M1?
q_14479.ground_truth: Section 9.4.11.1.4.1 describes the initial conditions for the HD-FDD inter-frequency RSTD Measurement Accuracy test in CE Mode B for Category M1.

q_14480.question: What is the role of the NAF Key Centre in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_14480.ground_truth: The NAF Key Centre is responsible for performing the key establishment between a UICC Hosting Device and a Remote Device.

q_14481.question: What command type is used for the ME to request additional time from the SIM when the SIM application toolkit is busy?
q_14481.ground_truth: MORE TIME command type is used for the ME to request additional time from the SIM when the SIM application toolkit is busy.

q_14482.question: What happens to the PDU Sessions counter when a UE requests for a PDU session establishment and the quota is to be exceeded but no local quota is granted?
q_14482.ground_truth: The PCF makes a decision to delegate the request to the associated central enforcement point (i.e. a primary PCF) of the S-NSSAI whether to accept or reject the current PDU session establishment request.

q_14483.question: What is theName of the signal used to generate a flexible 900 Hz tone in 3GPP?
q_14483.ground_truth: Flexible Tone with signal ID ft (0x0050)

q_14484.question: What is the principle behind the routing of IMS traffic via a localized UPF with two IP addresses in Solution 5?
q_14484.ground_truth: The principle behind the routing of IMS traffic via a localized UPF with two IP addresses in Solution 5 is to offload selected IMS traffic flows as close to the network edge while enabling service continuity upon UE mobility. The UE uses a common IP address for SIP signalling and user plane traffic, and most of the time it uses only one IP address.

q_14485.question: What is the significance of the Dominant to rest of Interference Ratio (DIR) in SAIC receivers?
q_14485.ground_truth: DIR is a measure of the power of the dominant interferer to the sum of the powers of the rest of the interferers plus N0. It is used to capture the distribution of interferer powers in SAIC receivers.

q_14486.question: When does a UE consider a frequency to be the highest priority if it is capable of sidelink communication and can only perform it while camping on a frequency?
q_14486.ground_truth: A UE considers a frequency to be the highest priority if it is capable of sidelink communication and can only perform it while camping on a frequency.

q_14487.question: What is the purpose of X.31 flag stuffing in the asynchronous-synchronous conversion functions?
q_14487.ground_truth: X.31 flag stuffing is used to adapt the rate between the two conversion functions and provide data transparency through bit stuffing.

q_14488.question: What is the bitrate required for encoding the eye buffer for use case 5 in online gaming using H.264/AVC?
q_14488.ground_truth: The bitrate required for encoding the eye buffer for use case 5 in online gaming using H.264/AVC is in the order of 50 Mbps per eye buffer.

q_14489.question: What protocols can be used for the data link layer in the radio network control plane for IP Transport Option?

q_14490.question: What should the "Accept" header field indicate in the 3gpp.current-location-discovery info package?
q_14490.ground_truth: The "Accept" header field should indicate the "application/vnd.3gpp.current-location-discovery+xml" MIME type.

q_14491.question: What are the two purposes for receiving and using uplink reference signals at the Node B?
q_14491.ground_truth: Uplink channel estimation for uplink coherent demodulation/detection and uplink channel-quality estimation for uplink frequency- and/or time-domain channel-dependent scheduling.

q_14492.question: What should the SCC AS include in the SDP answer when sending a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response to the remote UE in a collaborative session?
q_14492.ground_truth: When sending a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response to the remote UE in a collaborative session, the SCC AS should set the port numbers to the discard port number "9" and set to "a=inactive" for all media lines indicated in the MIME body of the SIP 300 (Multiple Choices) response.
