q_15003.question: What message does a BSS send to an SGSN when it has new Radio Access capability information for a MS?

q_15004.question: What is used to assess the distribution of broadcast channel block error probability in a simulated network for establishing broadcast channel coverage?
q_15004.ground_truth: An appropriate link-system mapping is applied at each point in the simulated network

q_15005.question: What is the procedure if the SMLC receives a RRLP message with an unknown reference number?

q_15006.question: What does RNTI represent in the context of UMTS connected mode?
q_15006.ground_truth: RNTI, or Radio Network Temporary Identity, is a unique identifier assigned to a UE (User Equipment) when it establishes an RRC connection to UTRAN. There are two types of RNTI: Serving RNTI, which is assigned by the Serving RNC, and c-RNTI, which is assigned by the Controlling RNC for communication on DCCH (Dedicated Control CHannels).

q_15007.question: What is the purpose of the Performance Management (PM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) as specified in the document?
q_15007.ground_truth: The purpose of the PMIRP is to collect performance related data, which can be used to locate potential problems in the 3GPP network system.

q_15008.question: What is the primary purpose of throughput boosting in the context of client buffer filling?
q_15008.ground_truth: The primary purpose of throughput boosting is to speed up the filling of the client buffer, by temporarily increasing network throughput for this client. This can be used at the beginning of a session to shorten the time to playout and during the video session to re-fill the buffer quickly and avoid stalling of the video playout due to large changes in link throughput.

q_15009.question: How does the NRF in SNPN identify NRF in SP NW in a 5GC aligned SNPN architecture?
q_15009.ground_truth: The NRF in SNPN identifies NRF in SP NW based on the SP NW ID.

q_15010.question: For what purpose does the SAD algorithm output a Boolean flag?
q_15010.ground_truth: The SAD algorithm outputs a Boolean flag to indicate whether each 20 ms frame contains signals that should be transmitted, i.e. speech, music or other audio.

q_15011.question: What should the UE do after reading the HS-PDSCHs in terms of sending feedback?
q_15011.ground_truth: The UE should generate an ACK/NACK message and transmit this to the NodeB in the associated HS-SICH, along with the most recently derived CQI.

q_15012.question: Which TS standard is referred to for security aspects of Network Exposure Function, including the protection of NEF-AF interface and support of CAPIF, in order to protect the EDGE-2/7/8 interfaces?

q_15013.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receipt of a 2xx response for the re-INVITE request sent to the controllee UE, if other media components are still active at the controllee UE after the media transfer?
q_15013.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP re-INVITE request to the controllee UE, from which the media component was transferred, and set the port value of the associated media type(s) for the transferred media to zero.

q_15014.question: What is the unit for the Accumulated originating session time and Accumulated terminating session time measurements?
q_15014.ground_truth: The unit for the Accumulated originating session time and Accumulated terminating session time measurements is milliseconds.

q_15015.question: What should the UE do if timer T302 expires or is stopped and timer T390 corresponding to an Access Category is not running or if timer T390 corresponding to an Access Category other than '2' expires or is stopped and timer T302 is not running?
q_15015.ground_truth: The UE should consider the barring for that Access Category to be alleviated.

q_15016.question: What does it mean when bit 7 of the TP-Protocol-Identifier is set to 0 and bit 6 is set to 1?
q_15016.ground_truth: When bit 7 of the TP-Protocol-Identifier is set to 0 and bit 6 is set to 1, bits 5..0 are used as defined below. These values indicate specific message types, such as Short Message Type 0, Replace Short Message Type 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and Device Triggering Short Message.

q_15017.question: What is the scope of the 3GPP TS 48.0xx series of Technical Specifications?
q_15017.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 48.0xx series of Technical Specifications deals with the definition of the base station system (BSS) to mobile switching center (MSC) interface, known as the A-interface, for the GSM system.

q_15018.question: What is the region defined for the application of a slope in the 10 MHz region on both sides of the UMTS bandwidth?
q_15018.ground_truth: The region is applied to further improve protection between services.

q_15019.question: What are some measurements' definitions for GSM in the 3GPP TS 52.402 standard?
q_15019.ground_truth: Some measurements include call setup time, radio resource utilization, link quality, received radio signal strength, received radio signal code power, received signal quality, received signal strength indication, and received signal phase indication.

q_15020.question: What is the condition of the first call in the scenario "CALL A-B HELD/CALL C-B WAITING"?
q_15020.ground_truth: The first call (A-B) is held, and the second call (C-B) is waiting.

q_15021.question: What is the role of the MRFP in the "Media Stream Processing" function in relation to managing access rights to shared resources?
q_15021.ground_truth: The MRFP, under the control of the MRFC, provides media stream resources and manages access rights to these shared resources in a conferencing environment, such as floor control.

q_15022.question: What message does NFVO send to NM after deleting an NS instance identifier?

q_15023.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "must" in 3GPP technical specifications and reports?
q_15023.ground_truth: The construction "shall" is used instead of "must" in 3GPP technical specifications and reports, except in direct citations from external documents or to maintain continuity of style when extending or modifying provisions of such documents.

q_15024.question: What is the purpose of the audit and accreditation of vendor network product development and network product lifecycle management processes?
q_15024.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure the assurance requirements and evaluation activities are met for both physical network product classes and virtualized network product classes.

q_15025.question: What is the purpose of the SUSPEND UICC command?
q_15025.ground_truth: The SUSPEND UICC command is used to suspend the UICC after entering PSM if the UICC supports the UICC suspension mechanism, and to resume the UICC before it can leave the PSM.

q_15026.question: What is the purpose of the MUK in the communication optimized approach 1?
q_15026.ground_truth: The MUK is used to securely deliver transport keys in a point-to-point connection in the communication optimized approach 1.

q_15027.question: What action should the UE take when the TFT operation is "Delete existing TFT" for a dedicated EPS bearer context and the TFT is already empty?
q_15027.ground_truth: The UE should send a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message for the ongoing PDU session modification procedure and initiate a new PDU session modification procedure to delete the mapped EPS bearer context using 5GSM cause #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation".

q_15028.question: How does the BSS provide additional notification into ongoing voice broadcast, group calls and point-to-point calls in the cell?
q_15028.ground_truth: The BSS sends initial notification messages on FACCH to all other ongoing voice broadcast, group calls, and point-to-point calls in the cell, along with the broadcast call reference, priority level if eMLPP applies, and possibly the TCH description.

q_15029.question: Which clause in TS 38.321 determines how the HARQ process shall consider a transmission to be a new transmission or a retransmission based on the NDI?

q_15030.question: How many resource-element groups are there in a physical resource block for one or two cell-specific reference signals in the second OFDM symbol of the first slot in a subframe?
q_15030.ground_truth: There are three resource-element groups in a physical resource block for one or two cell-specific reference signals in the second OFDM symbol of the first slot in a subframe.

q_15031.question: What should the UE do when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message including 5GMM cause value #95?
q_15031.ground_truth: UE shall delete 5G-GUTI, last visited TAI and ngKSI, performs a PLMN selection after timer T3502 timeout.

q_15032.question: What must be available for an ADMC fault to be cleared in the NE?
q_15032.ground_truth: System operator functions must be available to request the clearing of ADAC alarms/faults in the NE.

q_15033.question: When should the Node B include the Multicell E-DCH Restriction IE in the Possible Secondary Serving Cell List IE?
q_15033.ground_truth: The Node B should include the Multicell E-DCH Restriction IE in the Possible Secondary Serving Cell List IE when a cell in the list is restricted for use as an Additional E-DCH on the secondary uplink frequency with the Local Cell as the corresponding cell of the primary uplink frequency.

q_15034.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the UE in 9.1.2.3 in terms of detecting and measuring intra-frequency RSTD for cells, including the reference cell?
q_15034.ground_truth: The UE shall be able to detect and measure intra-frequency RSTD for at least 16 cells, including the reference cell.

q_15035.question: What is the role of the FAE server in the 3GPP system connectivity between FF application specific clients?
q_15035.ground_truth: The FAE server provides necessary information such as identifiers of FF application specific clients and transport requirements in the request message for establishing or modifying the 3GPP system level connectivity between FF application specific clients.

q_15036.question: What is the first reason for changing the characteristics of the radio channel during a call?
q_15036.ground_truth: The first reason for changing the characteristics of the radio channel during a call is for the swap from speech to data and vice versa.

q_15037.question: Which Telecommunications requirements does SuM fulfill in the 3G environment?
q_15037.ground_truth: SuM fulfills the requirements of device diversity, access diversity, and service diversity in the 3G environment.

q_15038.question: What action does the UPF/NW-TT perform upon reception of the notification in step~5 if the time source for the Time Sync service requested to be activated is in the UPF/NW-TT?
q_15038.ground_truth: The UPF/NW-TT starts to create and distribute the (g)PTP messages of the 5G GM to the UE.

q_15039.question: What must the User Equipment (UE) do when it supports 3GPP PS data off and receives a REGISTER request?
q_15039.ground_truth: The UE must include the "+g.3gpp.ps-data-off" header field parameter in the REGISTER request.

q_15040.question: When is the IPSec tunnel modification procedure performed in this specification?
q_15040.ground_truth: The IPSec tunnel modification procedure is performed in this specification when the IPSec tunnel between the UE and the ePDG has been modified due to the UE initiated IPSec tunnel update procedure, or the UE local IP address updating, and the UE supports MOBIKE.

q_15041.question: What two factors contributed to the increased intelligibility of EVS-WB compared to AMR-WB in the NTIA report?
q_15041.ground_truth: The two factors were the use of a wideband (WB) codec and the cutoff frequency being within the range of 10dB to -5dB.

q_15042.question: What are the possible techniques that the UE can use to locate itself in a specific Geographical Area?
q_15042.ground_truth: When the UE is in coverage of a 3GPP RAT, it can use information derived from the serving PLMN. When the UE is not in coverage of a 3GPP RAT, it can use other techniques, e.g. Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS).

q_15043.question: What is the mechanism for reporting unsuccessful completion of a Class 1 EP in the CBSP?
q_15043.ground_truth: If a receiving node cannot perform the requested functionality in a Class 1 EP, it shall respond with the message used to report unsuccessful outcome, containing an appropriate cause value.

q_15044.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Device ID in ProSe Direct Discovery?
q_15044.ground_truth: The ProSe Device ID is used to determine if a Destination Layer 2-ID has been provisioned for the type of communication being requested (e.g. unicast, groupcast, or broadcast) in ProSe Direct Discovery.

q_15045.question: What action does the SCC AS take upon receiving a SIP ACK request from the CS domain after sending a SIP 200 (OK) response to the remote UE?
q_15045.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends a SIP ACK toward the remote UE, releases the SIP dialog on the Source Access Leg by sending a SIP BYE request via the SIP dialog over the Gm reference point on the Source Access Leg if the SIP dialog is still active, and sends an I1 Success message toward the UE over the I1 interface.

q_15046.question: What is the role of the Terminal Adaptation Function (TAF) in the 3GPP system?
q_15046.ground_truth: The Terminal Adaptation Function (TAF) is responsible for the functions needed for terminal adaptation within the 3GPP system. It enables non-voice traffic in the PLMN by connecting various kinds of terminal equipment to the Mobile Termination (MT).

q_15047.question: What is the number of layers used in the case of a single codeword mapped to multiple layers in 5G NR uplink transmissions?
q_15047.ground_truth: A single codeword is mapped to multiple layers (up to 4) in the case of a single codeword mapped to multiple layers for slot-PUSCH and subslot-PUSCH transmission.

q_15048.question: What is the key used in the TLS security tunnel establishment between the UE and the 5G MSG Server in Step 4?
q_15048.ground_truth: The key K5GMSG, which is generated through the key negotiation process between the UE and the 5G MSG Server in Step 1-3.

q_15049.question: What is the main requirement for the activation and deactivation of AOC service?
q_15049.ground_truth: The AOC service is activated at provisioning and deactivated at withdrawal. Once activated, it requires no registration and interrogation.

q_15050.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification in the context of facsimile group 3 in a 3GPP system?
q_15050.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification describes the technical realization of facsimile group 3 using non-transparent network support within the 3GPP system.

q_15051.question: What is the purpose of the list of recent invitations in MCVideo?
q_15051.ground_truth: The list of recent invitations is stored and presented to the user on demand, allowing users to manage their group communication preferences.

q_15052.question: What is the role of the Charge Generation Point (CGP) in the 3GPP's TS 183 058 (Release 17) document?
q_15052.ground_truth: The Charge Generation Point (CGP) is a network function that receives the tariff/add-on charge information that was added by a Charge Determination Point (CDP) and transfers the charging information to the appropriate SIP requests or responses.

q_15053.question: What is the role of the PDN GW in network-initiated NBIFOM mode if the UE successfully connects with the network but does not receive an NBIFOM indication from the network?
q_15053.ground_truth: If the UE successfully connects with the network but does not receive an NBIFOM indication, the UE assumes that its PDN connection over the first access was handed over to the new access.

q_15054.question: What is the sublayer that the PDCP entities are associated with?

q_15055.question: What entity verifies the P-TMSI Signature in the 3GPP network if the signature is included in a Routeing Area Update Request, Detach Request, or Attach Request message from a MS?

q_15056.question: What is the purpose of transmitting Silence Descriptor (SID) information during the SACCH/T block period in 3GPP TS~45.008 standard?
q_15056.ground_truth: The purpose is to transmit dummy information during the SACCH/T block period, which is specific to DTX operation and does not constitute a logical channel.

q_15057.question: What is the command type in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: RECEIVE DATA" with a command qualifier of RFU and a source device of UICC?

q_15058.question: What is the role of the CUG Manager?
q_15058.ground_truth: The CUG Manager represents the interests of all the members of a CUG and can provision and control the CUG service.

q_15059.question: What is the format of the ServiceType enumerated type?
q_15059.ground_truth: It is an ENUMERATED containing qMC-for-streaming-service, qMC-for-MSTI-service, and other values.

q_15060.question: How can reliability of uplink control signalling (PUCCH) be maintained for HeNBs and macro-eNBs?
q_15060.ground_truth: By making use of PUCCH offsets for enabling orthogonal PUCCH assignments between the HeNB and macro-eNB users.

q_15061.question: What is the agreement between RAN2 and RAN4 regarding release independent support of Rel-16 transparent TxD capability for PC2?
q_15061.ground_truth: RAN2 agreed to support release independent transparent TxD capability for PC2 in Rel-15, by allowing early implementation of the Rel-16 CRs.

q_15062.question: What is the assumed battery capabilities for the UE-to-Network Relay UE and the remote UE in the 5G system?
q_15062.ground_truth: The 5G system is required to support battery capabilities and battery lifetime of the UE-to-Network Relay UE and the remote UE in the 3GPP system.

q_15063.question: What are the three mechanisms by which the CTS-FP can receive necessary operation data?
q_15063.ground_truth: The three mechanisms are: 1) via a fixed network connection between CTS-FP and the CTS operator, 2) directly from the GSM network when the CTS-FP is connected via radio to a GSM PLMN, and 3) by means of network information via the radio interface from the cellular network to the CTS-MS.

q_15064.question: How is the received signal quality measured in A-Gb mode?
q_15064.ground_truth: The received signal quality in A-Gb mode is measured by the MS in a manner that can be related to the average BER before channel decoding, assessed over all received bursts, except bursts carrying a portion of a SACCH frame, during one EPC reporting period.

q_15065.question: During media flows transfer, after the SIP INVITE request is sent to the target UE, what action does the SCC AS take next?
q_15065.ground_truth: After sending the SIP INVITE request to the target UE, the SCC AS sends the SIP 200 (OK) response and SIP NOTIFY request to the target UE.

q_15066.question: What is the message type and direction of the message sent on the SCH?
q_15066.ground_truth: The message type is SYNCHRONIZATION CHANNEL INFORMATION and it is sent from the network to the mobile station.

q_15067.question: What is the default action for unrecognized header extensions in FLUTE?
q_15067.ground_truth: The default action for unrecognized header extensions is to ignore them.

q_15068.question: What was the communication system simulated in the test arrangement?
q_15068.ground_truth: The communication system was a packet switched interactive communication between two users, simulated using 3 PCs with VOIP Terminal Simulator Software of France Telecom R&D and Network Simulator Software.

q_15069.question: How many subframes are obtained per power step for the MPAC and RTS methodologies in the harmonization measurement campaign?
q_15069.ground_truth: A total of 20,000 subframes per power step are obtained for the MPAC and RTS methodologies.

q_15070.question: What action does the BSS take when it initiates the radio interface uplink release procedure?
q_15070.ground_truth: When the BSS receives the UPLINK RELEASE COMMAND message to initiate the radio interface uplink release procedure, it shall initiate the procedure and release the uplink for the requesting MS.

q_15071.question: What are the benefits of using an AIPN for offering IP-based services?
q_15071.ground_truth: An AIPN allows AIPN operators to offer IP-based services and provide inter-working methods with IP service providers, while supporting applications designed based on AIPN capabilities without the need for explicit standardisation.

q_15072.question: Which network component sends the small data rate control indication to the SMF during PDU session establishment?
q_15072.ground_truth: The AMF sends the small data rate control indication to the SMF during PDU session establishment if it has stored in the AMF for the PDU session.

q_15073.question: What are the two delivery methods defined for MBMS user services?
q_15073.ground_truth: The two delivery methods defined for MBMS user services are streaming and download.

q_15074.question: What are the general timing requirements for the delivery of Interception Related Information (IRI) data records?
q_15074.ground_truth: The IRI data records should be sent by the delivery function to the LEMF over the HI2 within seconds of the detection of the triggering event by the IAP at least 95% of the time. Additionally, each IRI data record should contain a time-stamp, based on the intercepting node's clock that is generated following the detection of the IRI triggering event.

q_15075.question: What does the ARF do when the L-DN DNS Server cannot provide an IP address for the requested FQDN in the L-DN DNS Server case?
q_15075.ground_truth: The ARF forwards the DNS query to a cloud DNS server or resolves the FQDN using its own DNS information. Once the FQDN is resolved to an IP address, the ARF sends the DNS Reply to the UE.

q_15076.question: What effect does the receipt of a COPS DRQ message have on the PDF in a 3G network?
q_15076.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the COPS DRQ message, the PDF may forward an indication to an application function over the Gq reference point indicating that network resources have been removed.

q_15077.question: When are the messages counted in UR.Request?
q_15077.ground_truth: On receipt of request messages (e.g, Diameter command Update-Location-Request) by HSS from other NEs.

q_15078.question: What happens when the account balance is not sufficient for a minimum number of granted units in the described scenario?
q_15078.ground_truth: The SBCF denies the online charging request, and the service usage request is rejected by the mobile network.

q_15079.question: When should the IWF performing the controlling role indicate to the media plane that all final responses are received?
q_15079.ground_truth: The IWF should indicate this when all non-controlling MCPTT functions hosting constituent MCPTT groups have responded with a SIP 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx, or 6xx response to the SIP INVITE request for non-controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group, and all expected SIP INFO requests containing a floor request have been received.

q_15080.question: Which propagation condition does not have to be met for a Home BS?
q_15080.ground_truth: The multipath fading Case 2 and Case 3 are not required to be met for a Home BS.

q_15081.question: What should a UE do when it receives an SDP offer in a network-initiated USSD session?
q_15081.ground_truth: A UE should also add a zero port number value to any media description received in the associated SDP offer.

q_15082.question: What should the UE do immediately after the quantity to be reported becomes available for a requested pair of PCell and NR cell in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5.1?
q_15082.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

q_15083.question: What is the difference between the first sampling frequency and the second sampling frequency used in the spectral analysis?
q_15083.ground_truth: The difference between the first sampling frequency and the second sampling frequency used in the spectral analysis is 128 samples.

q_15084.question: What standard defines the data channel establishment for SCTP association?

q_15085.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in providing analytics to the NF?
q_15085.ground_truth: The NWDAF derives and provides analytics to the NF, including UE Presence Pattern analytics.

q_15086.question: What is the eCall In-band Modem specified in the document?
q_15086.ground_truth: The eCall In-band Modem is a modem pair that operates full-duplex and allows reliable transmission of eCall Minimum Set of Data from IVS to PSAP via the voice channel of the emergency voice call through cellular and PSTN networks.

q_15087.question: What is the role of Node B in acquiring the entire channel estimation of the two antennas of the UE in dual stream transmission?
q_15087.ground_truth: The Node B acquires the entire channel estimation of the two antennas of the UE in dual stream transmission by selecting the transmit antenna based on HCSN or ECSN, which requires the UE to time switch transmit the uplink channels by the two antennas.

q_15088.question: What is the structure of the Single Resource MBMS URL?
q_15088.ground_truth: The Single Resource MBMS URL is composed of a prefix, mid-part, and suffix. The prefix is a URL that is the serviceId of the service on which the resource is available. The suffix contains a URI that is the identifier of the desired resource. The mid-part currently has no defined content.

q_15089.question: How does the NS entity select the remote IP endpoint for data traffic in the LSP?
q_15089.ground_truth: The NS entity selects a remote IP endpoint based on the LSP for sending the NS-SDU to the peer NSE, with equal proportion to the data-weights assigned to the peer NSE's endpoints.

q_15090.question: What service operation should the NWDAF invoke to process pre-analytics for specific Analytics ID(s) continuously after obtaining the necessary data?
q_15090.ground_truth: The NWDAF should support to process pre-analytics for specific Analytics ID(s) continuously after obtaining the necessary data.

q_15091.question: What is the number of basis vectors and the number of bits in a codeword for the VSELP codebook used in modes 1, 2, and 3?

q_15092.question: What is the result of the Activate PDP Context Confirmation during the GERAN to EGAN handover procedure?
q_15092.ground_truth: The data path between the MS and the GGSN is established across the EGANC.

q_15093.question: How does the SMF report the multicast and broadcast communication charging in Solution #3.3?
q_15093.ground_truth: The multicast and broadcast communication charging is covered by the unicast communication per PDU session per UE, which is the aggregation of the volume usage. When N19-based forwarding is used, the SMF reports the volume per PDU sessions for the 5G VN Group members, which the CHF may aggregate per 5G VG group.

q_15094.question: What is the purpose of the gprsSSF - gsmSCF interface defined in subclause 6.1.2.2?
q_15094.ground_truth: This interface is used by the gsmSCF to control a GPRS session or individual PDP context in a certain gprsSSF. GPRS dialogues between the gprsSSF and the gsmSCF on this interface are opened as a result of the gprsSSF sending a request for instructions to the gsmSCF.

q_15095.question: What is the name of the allocation (1RB4x) for which maximum boosting may be supported in the new-inner region?

q_15096.question: How are separate test antennas for the wanted and interfering signals accommodated in the test procedure?
q_15096.ground_truth: If separate test antennas are required for the wanted and interfering signals, they need to be carefully aligned with the transmitter and receiver, covering the same frequency ranges as the system under test.

q_15097.question: What is the purpose of the Max-Breadth header field in preventing forking loops within an NGCN site?
q_15097.ground_truth: The Max-Breadth header field limits the number of nodes that can forward the request within the NGCN site, preventing forking loops.

q_15098.question: What are the range of values for the unconfirmed sequence number N(U) in acknowledged operation?
q_15098.ground_truth: The unconfirmed sequence number N(U) for UI-frames in acknowledged operation can take on the value 0 through 7.

q_15099.question: What message type should be used for sending the BSSAP+-MS-INFORMATION-REQUEST message?

q_15100.question: How is the sequence number of a particular short message within the concatenated short message determined?
q_15100.ground_truth: The sequence number of a particular short message within the concatenated short message is indicated by an octet that contains a value in the range 0 to 255, indicating the sequence number of a particular short message within the concatenated short message. The value starts at 1 and increments by one for every short message sent within the concatenated short message.

q_15101.question: What is the purpose of the "options" parameter in the IPFilterRule type, as specified in IETF RFC 6733?
q_15101.ground_truth: The "options" parameter is not used in the IPFilterRule type, as specified in IETF RFC 6733.

q_15102.question: What is the purpose of the user plane data congestion analytics report provided by the MDAS producer?
q_15102.ground_truth: The user plane data congestion analytics report provided by the MDAS producer can support SLS assurance to perform further evaluation.

q_15103.question: What is the name of the default phase of the Codec Mode Indication in downlink direction when the transmission phase is odd?
q_15103.ground_truth: The default phase of the Codec Mode Indication in downlink direction when the transmission phase is odd is called "odd".

q_15104.question: What is the difference between Call Forwarding Unconditional and Call Forwarding on Busy, No Reply, or Not Reachable?
q_15104.ground_truth: Call Forwarding Unconditional is always active and forwards all incoming calls, while Call Forwarding on Busy, No Reply, or Not Reachable are only active under specific conditions (phone is busy, not answered after a certain number of rings, or phone is turned off or out of reach) and forwards calls only under those conditions.

q_15105.question: What is the primary purpose of the Container Prefix in the RAN messages?
q_15105.ground_truth: The Container Prefix consists of RIM Application Identity and message-specific information and it is used to supervise the end-to-end transport of the messages.

q_15106.question: What action should the SMLC take if it receives insufficient position measurements and cannot initiate another positioning attempt?
q_15106.ground_truth: The SMLC may return a BSSAP-LE Perform Location response containing a less accurate location estimate, or return a response message containing no location estimate and indicate the cause of failure.

q_15107.question: What information should the UTRAN include in the IE "Radio Link Addition Information" in cases a) and c)?
q_15107.ground_truth: Downlink DPCH information and other optional parameters relevant for the radio links to be added, along with the IE "Primary CPICH info" used for the reference ID to indicate which radio link to add.

q_15108.question: In the test architecture described in section 5.3, what is the role of the data injection?
q_15108.ground_truth: In the test architecture described in section 5.3, the data injection acts as a counterpart to the system under test, including both RTP/RTCP sender and receiver.

q_15109.question: What is the basic in-band emission measurement interval for the in-band emission measurement?
q_15109.ground_truth: The basic in-band emission measurement interval is defined over one slot in the time domain.

q_15110.question: What is the role of the node named "V2XServiceIdentifier" within the node "V2XServiceIDtoV2XNRFrequencyMappingRule"?
q_15110.ground_truth: It is used as a placeholder for one or more mapping rules for V2X communication over the NR-PC5.

q_15111.question: How does the network communicate with the DASH client in a DASH-based streaming delivery system?
q_15111.ground_truth: The network communicates with the DASH client in a DASH-based streaming delivery system by using regular TCP congestion control methods, such as delay and packet-losses, to modify the bitrate of the DASH session.

q_15112.question: What message is used by the UE to indicate to the SCF that it has switched to a new MBMS content channel?
q_15112.ground_truth: The UE sends a SIP INFO message with the included Info Package (Content Reporting) to inform the SCF about which channel is being received.

q_15113.question: What is the purpose of the document in relation to the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_15113.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide guidelines for the implementation of DARP, particularly for mobile stations that support DARP but conform to an earlier release than the one in which the DARP is specified.

q_15114.question: What is the difference between a "Management Information Model (MIM)" and a "Network Resource Model (NRM)"?
q_15114.ground_truth: A Management Information Model (MIM) is a generic term describing a management model, while a Network Resource Model (NRM) refers specifically to the model of the actual managed telecommunications Network Resources (NRs) in the context of 3GPP NRM.

q_15115.question: What is the default value of N if it is not signalled?
q_15115.ground_truth: If N is not signalled, it defaults to infinity for video or one frame duration for audio.

q_15116.question: How is the ThreshChUtilWLANHigh threshold condition evaluated if both ThreshChUtilWLANHighANDSF and ThreshChUtilWLANHighRAN nodes are present?
q_15116.ground_truth: If both the ThreshChUtilWLANHighANDSF and ThreshChUtilWLANHighRAN nodes are present, ThreshChUtilWLANHighRAN node will take precedence over ThreshChUtilWLANHighANDSF node, i.e. the ThreshChUtilWLANHighRAN node is evaluated to be matching, the UE shall consider this node as matching.

q_15117.question: What should the SMF do if it obtains the forwarding tunnel info from PSA2?
q_15117.ground_truth: The SMF should establish a Target UL CL and an N9 forwarding tunnel between the Source UL CL and UL CL2.

q_15118.question: What is the measurement referred to as that provides the number of failed relocation preparations with UE involved for CS domain per cause?

q_15119.question: When should a UE establish PDCP entity, RLC entity, and the logical channel of a sidelink SRB for PC5-S message of a specific destination?
q_15119.ground_truth: When transmission of PC5-S message for a specific destination is requested by upper layers for sidelink SRB.

q_15120.question: What should the H-PCRF do if the QoS validation fails or other error conditions occur when provisioning PCC rules using the RAR command?
q_15120.ground_truth: The H-PCRF should include the Charging-Rule-Remove AVP on the related S9 subsessions within the Subsession-Decision-Info AVP to remove the installed PCC rules without a request from the V-PCRF.

q_15121.question: How can SON target information be derived from Intent?
q_15121.ground_truth: SON target information can be derived from Intent by translating the intent to SON target information (e.g. UE throughput intent can be translated to SON target information for one or multiple SON) or by using the information in the intent for SON target directly.

q_15122.question: In the RECEIVE DATA 1.5.3 log, what is the position and length of the formatting for the formatting mode and colors in PROACTIVE COMMAND: RECEIVE DATA 2.1.1?
q_15122.ground_truth: The formatting position is 0, and the formatting length is 14 in PROACTIVE COMMAND: RECEIVE DATA 2.1.1.

q_15123.question: What procedure is used to prepare for the access bearer establishment in UMTS?
q_15123.ground_truth: The Prepare Bearer procedure is used to prepare for the access bearer establishment in UMTS.

q_15124.question: What is the purpose of a ProSe Application Code?
q_15124.ground_truth: A ProSe Application Code is used in ProSe Direct Discovery for identifying and filtering ProSe Application ID Names by temporary identities and PLMN ID.

q_15125.question: What is the purpose of using a harmonic model in the context-based arithmetic coding?
q_15125.ground_truth: The purpose of using a harmonic model in the context-based arithmetic coding is to classify all regions into two categories: peak part and normal or valley part. The peak part consists of 3 consecutive samples centered at a positive integer peak of a harmonic peak of x(n), where x(n) is a discrete-time signal. The other samples belong to the normal or valley part.

q_15126.question: What is the role of the physical layer in controlling timing advance, power control, and Repeated SACCH in dedicated physical channels?
q_15126.ground_truth: The physical layer implements a peer-to-peer protocol for controlling timing advance, power control, and Repeated SACCH at the operation on dedicated physical channels or dedicated basic physical subchannels.

q_15127.question: What is the purpose of the "MPQUIC Connection Setup Information" sent by the SMF to the UE?
q_15127.ground_truth: The "MPQUIC Connection Setup Information" sent by the SMF to the UE contains information for the UE to setup the MPQUIC connections with the UPF, such as the IP address and port number of the MPQUIC connections.

q_15128.question: What is the significance of the Iuh connectivity between the HNB and the HNB-GW for support of PCAP?
q_15128.ground_truth: The Iuh connectivity between the HNB and the HNB-GW for support of PCAP is performed via the HNB registration procedure.

q_15129.question: In the context of CW, what does the term "network based CW" mean?
q_15129.ground_truth: Network based CW refers to the case where the network detects the CW condition and informs the user's device about the situation.

q_15130.question: What should the PSS adapter do upon identification of a successful content switch?
q_15130.ground_truth: The PSS adapter starts the content switching timer for a particular session and sends a SIP INFO message with the Info Package (Content Reporting) to the SCF after timer expiration.

q_15131.question: What is the assumed period between measurements when simulating the movement of UEs in the MBSFN area?
q_15131.ground_truth: The period between measurements is 1 sec.

q_15132.question: Who can initiate the MBMS notification procedure and when?
q_15132.ground_truth: UTRAN initiates the notification procedure to inform UEs about a change applicable for one or more MBMS services available in a cell, this can be done when there are some types of MBMS service changes, such as the establishment of a p-t-m radio bearer, which involves a modification of MCCH messages other than the MBMS MODIFIED SERVICES INFORMATION message.

q_15133.question: What should the UDM do if it cannot provide the SOR-CMCI to the AMF due to the AMF not supporting receiving SoR transparent container?
q_15133.ground_truth: The UDM cannot provide the SOR-CMCI to the AMF in this case.

q_15134.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives IEs/IE groups with the "Ignore IE" marking that it does not understand?
q_15134.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the content of the not comprehended IEs/IE groups and continue with the procedure using the understood IEs/IE groups.

q_15135.question: What is the purpose of the Tsor-cm timer in the context of SOR-CMCI?
q_15135.ground_truth: The Tsor-cm timer determines the time the UE shall wait before releasing the PDU sessions or services and entering idle mode.

q_15136.question: In the context of TDD, what action should the DRNS take if the HS-DSCH Information IE is present in the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message?
q_15136.ground_truth: The DRNS should setup the requested HS-DSCH resources on the Serving HS-DSCH Radio Link indicated by the HS-PDSCH RL ID IE and include the HARQ Memory Partitioning IE in the HS-DSCH TDD Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message.

q_15137.question: What establishes an MBS Application Data Session between the MBSTF~Client and the MBS-Aware Application?
q_15137.ground_truth: The MBS-Aware Application selects the announced MBS User Service via MBS User Service Control, and as a result, the MBSF~Client activates reception of the corresponding MBS Distribution Session in the MBSTF~Client, establishing an MBS Application Data Session.

q_15138.question: What is the formula to calculate the GERAN service access success rate for CS domain?
q_15138.ground_truth: This KPI is obtained by the TCH seizures success rate multiplied by the SDCCH setup success rate.

q_15139.question: What information is included in the UAS authentication response message sent to the UFES?
q_15139.ground_truth: The UAS authentication response message includes an authentication result with Success Indication, GPSI, CAA Level UAV ID, UAS ID, UAS security context, Auth Token and lifetime.

q_15140.question: What are the two sources of radio resources that the UE can obtain to monitor using the Discovery Query Filter(s)?
q_15140.ground_truth: The two sources of radio resources that the UE can obtain to monitor using the Discovery Query Filter(s) are E-UTRAN and WLAN.

q_15141.question: What should the UE include in the contents of the logMeasReport in the UEInformationResponse message, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.7.10.3?
q_15141.ground_truth: The UE should include the absoluteTimeStamp, traceReference, traceRecordingSessionRef, and tce-Id in the logMeasReport of the UEInformationResponse message.

q_15142.question: What type of data is SequenceNumber, and where is it stored?
q_15142.ground_truth: SequenceNumber is temporary data and is conditionally stored at the UDM.

q_15143.question: Which Diameter AVP is used in the MCPTT-2 interface to contain the identifier used to identify the MC Service User in the MC Service User Database?

q_15144.question: What is the format of the errorIndication M2AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
q_15144.ground_truth: It is a sequence of INITIATING MESSAGE errorIndication, PROCEDURE CODE id-errorIndication, CRITICALITY ignore.

q_15145.question: What is the role of the "DNS Inspector" in this solution?
q_15145.ground_truth: The "DNS Inspector" is a logical functionality that assists in correctly resolving UE's DNS requests into IP addresses of EASs.

q_15146.question: What happens when the MGCF receives a CPG message with a "remote retrieval" Generic notification indicator and the media on the IMS side are "sendrecv" or "recvonly"?
q_15146.ground_truth: The MGCF shall forward the hold request by sending an UPDATE request on the early dialog which was last established containing an SDP offer with the appropriate "a=sendonly" or "a=inactive" SDP attribute.

q_15147.question: What are the specific capabilities of 5GC being studied for IMS integration?
q_15147.ground_truth: The specific capabilities under consideration are network slicing, routing IMS traffic via a localized UPF, placing IMS application servers in localized environments, and utilizing services provided by 5GC NFs other than PCF and HSS.

q_15148.question: How is the broadcast mode used to distribute multimedia services in MBMS?
q_15148.ground_truth: The broadcast mode enables the distribution of multimedia services, such as Audio and Video, to a large number of users. It is designed to efficiently use network resources and minimise power consumption for terminals.

q_15149.question: What is the requirement when sending a Short Message with the Minimum Security Level field length greater than zero?
q_15149.ground_truth: CRRN4 under 5.3.6.1.1.1 states that the Minimum Security Level is used to specify the minimum level to be applied to Secured Packets when the length of the Minimum Security Level field is greater than zero.

q_15150.question: What happens if the CTS-RR connection is lost before the CTSMSI UPDATE COMPLETE message is received in the fixed part side?
q_15150.ground_truth: All MM connections should be released and both the old and the new CTSMSIs should be maintained to recover from unsuccessful CTSMSI update.

q_15151.question: What is the format of the "id" in the "ID" field within the "RequestedDataValue-ExtIEs" structure?
q_15151.ground_truth: The "id" in the "ID" field within the "RequestedDataValue-ExtIEs" structure is a string that can represent various types of GPS data, such as "id-GPS-ReferenceLocation" or "id-GANSS-CommonAssistanceData".

q_15152.question: Under what condition would a radio link addition request be rejected if ALCAP is not used?
q_15152.ground_truth: If the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message does not include the Transport Layer Address IE and the Binding ID IE in the RL Specific DCH Information IE nor RL Specific E-DCH Information IE in the RL Information IE for a specific RL and the Diversity Control Field IE is set to "Must Not", the DRNC will reject the Radio Link Addition procedure and respond with the RADIO LINK ADDITION FAILURE message.

q_15153.question: What is the role of the MSGin5G Server?
q_15153.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server is an entity in the 5G system for routing messages between UEs and messages between application servers and UEs.

q_15154.question: What two types of pictures support non-cross-layer aligned IRAP for layer switching in HEVC version 2?

q_15155.question: What is the name of the write-replace failure message component in SABP that contains a list of protocol data units with their corresponding failure information, and is used to indicate the failure of a specific service in a controlled manner?

q_15156.question: Which protocol is used for the northbound APIs exposed to UAS application specific servers in the 3GPP system?
q_15156.ground_truth: openAPI specifications are used for the UAS server services exposed to UAS application specific servers in the 3GPP system.

q_15157.question: What is the role of the Default GANC in the registration process when the MS includes the identity of the current serving GSM network in the GA-RC REGISTER REQUEST message?
q_15157.ground_truth: The Default GANC uses the provided GSM network identity to identify the list of PLMNs to send to the MS in the response message, which is used by the MS to complete the registration process.

q_15158.question: What information can be contained in a service data flow filter with regard to the transport and application protocols used above IP?
q_15158.ground_truth: Such service data flow filters must be predefined in the PCEF and may be used to support filtering with respect to a service data flow based on the transport and application protocols used above IP, including HTTP and WAP.

q_15159.question: What is the interface between a gNB-DU and a gNB-CU called in the 3GPP technical specification?

q_15160.question: What is the advantage of using an in-band signaling channel for transmitting measurement and control data?
q_15160.ground_truth: An in-band signaling channel provides a protected means of transmitting quality information and control data over-the-air in the MS to BSS direction. This represents an intermediate stage in the computation of the metric, using in-band information and potentially other system parameters.

q_15161.question: What action does the mobile station take when timer T3124 times out in the non-synchronized case during a handover attempt?
q_15161.ground_truth: The mobile station deactivates the new channels, reactivates the old channels, reconnects the TCHs if any and triggers the establishment of the main signalling link. It then sends a HANDOVER FAILURE message on the main signalling link and resumes normal operation as if no handover attempt had occurred.

q_15162.question: What message type is sent on the PACCH from the mobile station to the network to indicate the status of downlink RLC data blocks received and to report the channel quality of the downlink?

q_15163.question: What are the expected frame rates for the raster-based split rendering in online gaming?
q_15163.ground_truth: The expected frame rates for the raster-based split rendering in online gaming are at least 60fps, potentially higher up to 90 fps.

q_15164.question: What is the size of the PI-bitmap field in this structure?
q_15164.ground_truth: The size of the PI-bitmap field can vary from 3 to 18 bytes (padded at the end up to an octet boundary), depending on the number of Paging Indications present in the bitmap.

q_15165.question: What are the functions performed by the SNDCP layer specific to the data transmission?
q_15165.ground_truth: The SNDCP layer performs several functions specific to the data transmission. This includes protocol control information compression, user data compression, segmentation of compressed information into SN-DATA or SN-UNITDATA PDUs, reassembly of SN-PDUs to N-PDUs, user data decompression, and protocol control information decompression.

q_15166.question: What is the impact of the COLR Supplementary Service on the COLP Supplementary Service?
q_15166.ground_truth: The COLR Supplementary Service takes precedence over the COLP Supplementary Service, unless the served user has an override category.

q_15167.question: What type of dynamic information related to HD maps can the VAE layer support?
q_15167.ground_truth: The VAE layer can support dynamic information related to other V2X UEs for HD maps.

q_15168.question: What is the purpose of the "Onboarding Support" IE in the NG interface of TS 38.413?
q_15168.ground_truth: The "Onboarding Support" IE in the NG interface of TS 38.413 is used to indicate that the AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) supports UE onboarding for the identified SNPN, as specified in TS 23.501.

q_15169.question: What is the purpose of the calibration values in the CATR testing procedure?
q_15169.ground_truth: The calibration values are used to set the required level for the wanted and interfering signals during the CATR testing procedure.

q_15170.question: What must the HLR do when it receives a notification that the MS has memory capacity available and the MWD is not empty?
q_15170.ground_truth: The HLR will invoke operations to alert the SCs within the MWD, and after each SC is alerted, the address for that SC is deleted from the MWD.

q_15171.question: What is the significance of the MBMS Announcement message type?
q_15171.ground_truth: The MBMS Announcement message type has a significance of "dual", which indicates that it has an effect on both the network and the mobile station.

q_15172.question: What should the IMS-ALG do if it supports ALTC procedures and decides to insert ALTC information in the SDP offer sent to the terminating side?
q_15172.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should request the IMS-AGW to reserve two sets of transport addresses/resources towards the access network to enable media to traverse the IMS-AGW.

q_15173.question: What is a characteristic of the CS bearer used in PS-CS Access Transfer?
q_15173.ground_truth: When using the CS bearer for the media of the IMS session(s), only one active session can be transferred over the CS bearer.

q_15174.question: What does the 3GPP TS 36.413 standard define for LTE networks?
q_15174.ground_truth: It defines the Source eNB to target eNB Transparent Container Information Element, which is used as a general container for passing eNB specific information transparently through the core network from BSS to eNB when CS to PS SRVCC to E-UTRAN is performed.

q_15175.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations in the steering of roaming information?
q_15175.ground_truth: The UE should replace the highest priority entries in the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list stored in the ME with the received list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations.

q_15176.question: What action does the SGSN take when it receives a request from the GGSN or the MS to modify parameters in a PDP context?
q_15176.ground_truth: The SGSN processes the request and sends an Update PDP Context Response message with the updated parameters

q_15177.question: What does the MS acknowledge in the Routeing Area Update procedure in the inter-system change?
q_15177.ground_truth: The MS acknowledges the new P-TMSI by returning a Routeing Area Update Complete message to the SGSN and confirms all mobile-terminated N-PDUs successfully transferred before the start of the update procedure.

q_15178.question: What is the action taken by the serving BSS when it receives a valid RAN-INFORMATION-REQUEST/Single Report PDU with an earlier sequence number than the one currently stored?
q_15178.ground_truth: The serving BSS discards the PDU without further actions.

q_15179.question: Which network function, in the context of monitoring event domain charging, embeds the CTF and generates charging events to the CHF?
q_15179.ground_truth: The Network Exposure Function (NEF) can embed the CTF and generate charging events to the CHF for monitoring event domain charging.

q_15180.question: What is the target for peak spectrum efficiency for Advanced E-UTRA in both downlink and uplink?
q_15180.ground_truth: The peak spectrum efficiency for Advanced E-UTRA in downlink should be 30 bps/Hz and 15 bps/Hz in uplink.

q_15181.question: What is the difference between "Number of RTP messages received on Nb interface" and "Number of RTP messages received on Iu interface" measurements?
q_15181.ground_truth: "Number of RTP messages received on Nb interface" measurement is applicable to the Nb interface, whereas "Number of RTP messages received on Iu interface" measurement is applicable to the Iu interface in UMTS networks. Both measurements are used to monitor the performance of the bearer transport, but for different interfaces in the network.

q_15182.question: How are Access Service Classes (ASCs) used for RACH transmission control in FDD?
q_15182.ground_truth: ASCs are used for RACH transmission control in FDD by dividing physical RACH resources between different ASCs, with each ASC having an associated persistence value and priority level, and the UE selecting the ASC based on the MAC Logical channel Priority (MLP) level.

q_15183.question: What is the purpose of the Sequence Number of the packet in the GTP' header?
q_15183.ground_truth: The Sequence Number of the packet is part of the GTP' header and is used to indicate the sequence of the packet.

q_15184.question: In what scenarios is the EC-GSM-IoT preliminary access barring check not barred?
q_15184.ground_truth: If none of the conditions that would authorize the barring of network access are met, the EC-GSM-IoT preliminary access barring check will indicate that network access is not barred.

q_15185.question: What is the range of the LPP time IE rounded up to the next second?
q_15185.ground_truth: The LPP time IE ranges between 1.506s and 657.01s.

q_15186.question: What is the role of the "Serving node Address" attribute in the PGW-CDR, and how are new addresses added to the list?
q_15186.ground_truth: The "Serving node Address" attribute in the PGW-CDR consists of a list of SGSN/S-GW/ePDG/TWAG addresses. New addresses are added to the list when the respective network node changes.

q_15187.question: In Option 2 of APN resolution in EGAN mode, how does the Proxy-Gn distinguish between incoming PDP creation requests from EGAN capable and non EGAN capable handsets?
q_15187.ground_truth: The Proxy-Gn is able to distinguish among the incoming PDP creation requests by checking the PCO field.

q_15188.question: In which circumstances would a new measurement reporting entry be included in the VarMeasReportList for a measId when the reportType is set to eventTriggered?
q_15188.ground_truth: When the entry condition for the event is fulfilled for one or more applicable transmission resource pools, and no measurement reporting entry exists for that measId, a new measurement reporting entry is included in the VarMeasReportList for that measId.

q_15189.question: What is the TeleserviceCode for all tele services in the REGISTER 2.1B coding?

q_15190.question: What is the benefit of the solution for AMF in providing satellite backhaul type to SMF?
q_15190.ground_truth: The benefit of the solution for AMF is that it enables SMF to decide whether the S-NSSAI and DNN requested by UE can be supported by the satellite backhaul.

q_15191.question: What is the issue with the QoS parameters when a UE moves from one network to another?
q_15191.ground_truth: A UE in network A may adapt down to a lower bitrate than a UE in network B, leading to potentially insufficient bitrate in network A if congestion occurs.

q_15192.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the maximum number of simultaneous online presentities in the presence enabler/AS?
q_15192.ground_truth: The name of the measurement is "Number of simultaneous online presentities (Maximum)".

q_15193.question: What is the work item objective for FR2 regarding SCell dropping solution for preventing transmission power dropping on the cell with lower priority for both FR1 and FR2 CA?
q_15193.ground_truth: The work item objective for FR2 regarding SCell dropping solution for preventing transmission power dropping on the cell with lower priority for both FR1 and FR2 CA is to develop a solution to address this potential in-field issue. However, due to the potential spec impact on other working groups and the lack of consensus, the discussion may be dropped in Rel-17.

q_15194.question: What is the Gx reference point used for in 3GPP networks?
q_15194.ground_truth: The Gx reference point is used for provisioning and removal of PCC rules from the PCRF to the PCEF, and the transmission of traffic plane events from the PCEF to the PCRF.

q_15195.question: In which clause in TS 38.331 is the procedure described for transferring measurement results from the UE to the network?

q_15196.question: What is the purpose of introducing cross-carrier scheduling from SCell to PCell/PSCell in Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS)?
q_15196.ground_truth: The purpose of introducing cross-carrier scheduling from SCell to PCell/PSCell in Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS) is to ensure sufficient scheduling capacity for NR UEs on the shared carriers as the number of NR devices in a network increases.

q_15197.question: Who acts as a service provider towards the UE in the described scenario?
q_15197.ground_truth: The I-WLAN acts as a service provider towards the UE in the described scenario.

q_15198.question: What should the PCRF do if it receives a request to terminate a prioritized GC session from the GCSE AS?
q_15198.ground_truth: The PCRF shall remove the PCC Rules corresponding to the Group Communication Service and if the PCRF detects that all prioritized GC sessions within the same IP-CAN session are released, the PCRF shall set the ARP of the default bearer as appropriate.

q_15199.question: What action should the DRNS take if the C-ID IE is not included in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Setup IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE, in the context of E-DCH setup on a secondary uplink frequency?
q_15199.ground_truth: The DRNS shall setup the additional E-DCH on the Radio Links indicated by the E-DCH Additional RL ID IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Setup IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE.

q_15200.question: What is the formula used to calculate the macro cell propagation model, assuming a base station antenna height of 15 meters?
q_15200.ground_truth: L = 128.1 + 37.6 Log10(R), where R is the base station - UE separation in kilometers

q_15201.question: What message is sent from the network to the mobile station on the PACCH to report enhanced measurement results?

q_15202.question: What is the purpose of the CTM transmitter and receiver in the Cellular Text Telephone Modem?
q_15202.ground_truth: The CTM transmitter and receiver in the Cellular Text Telephone Modem allow for the reliable transmission of text characters via the speech channel of cellular phone systems. The CTM transmitter converts text input into a modulated signal, while the CTM receiver converts the received signal back into text output.

q_15203.question: What command is used to open a new channel between the ME and the UICC?

q_15204.question: How is a bad stereo TCX frame of size 256 samples reconstructed in stereo error concealment?
q_15204.ground_truth: A parametric model with transfer function is applied to the windowed mono signal for reconstructing a substitution signal for the side signal.

q_15205.question: What is the type of the "id-RL-InformationList-RL-AdditionRqstFDD" in the RadioLinkAdditionRequestFDD-IEs RNSAP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_15205.ground_truth: The type of the "id-RL-InformationList-RL-AdditionRqstFDD" in the RadioLinkAdditionRequestFDD-IEs RNSAP-PROTOCOL-IES is a SEQUENCE of ProtocolIE-Single-Container containing RL-Information-RL-AdditionRqstFDD-IEs.

q_15206.question: What signal is used for transmission in the uplink that is not associated with PUSCH or (S)PUCCH?

q_15207.question: What message is sent from the target GANC to the MS in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to activate the transport channel to be used in the GAN cell?
q_15207.ground_truth: The GA-PSR ACTIVATE UTC REQ message is sent from the target GANC to the MS in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to activate the transport channel to be used in the GAN cell.

q_15208.question: What information should be included in the analytics report describing the network slice load problem?
q_15208.ground_truth: The identifier of the network slice load problem, indication of the network slice load problem, start time and end time of the network slice load problem, type of network slice load problem (overloaded or underutilized), the geographical area and location where the network slice load problem exists, cause(s) of network slice problem, root cause of the network slice load problem, applications affected by the network slice load problem, severity level of the network slice load problem, and recommended actions to solve the network slice load problem.

q_15209.question: What happens if there are no associated downlink transmissions between two uplink transmissions carrying related TPC commands?
q_15209.ground_truth: These TPC commands will be regarded as a single TPC command by the UTRAN.

q_15210.question: What is the purpose of the "Switch-Stream" header field in RTSP requests?
q_15210.ground_truth: The "Switch-Stream" header field is used to describe the replacement of media streams after a content switch, allowing the server to replace old media streams with new media streams, or to switch to a new media stream while releasing the resources for the old stream.

q_15211.question: What is the effect of including the Horizontal Accuracy Code IE in the POSITION CALCULATION REQUEST message?
q_15211.ground_truth: The SAS shall use the Horizontal Accuracy Code IE to assess whether the resulting position estimation fulfills the requested accuracy.

q_15212.question: When should the UE include the "MBMS Modification Period identity" information element in its response?
q_15212.ground_truth: The UE should include the "MBMS Modification Period identity" information element if it included one or more "MBMS Selected Service ID" information elements in its response.

q_15213.question: Which type of field is "rL-Specific-DCH-Info" in the RL-Information-RL-ReconfPrepTDD sequence?
q_15213.ground_truth: "rL-Specific-DCH-Info" is an optional element of the RL-InformationIE-RL-ReconfPrepTDD sequence.

q_15214.question: What is the unit used to express the hysteresis parameter Hys?

q_15215.question: What should the NAS do upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, if the event which triggered the access attempt was a request from upper layers to establish a new PDU session?
q_15215.ground_truth: The NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message, if still needed.

q_15216.question: What happens when a new MPD is available and the MIME type is application/dash+xml or application/dash+xml profiles='urn:mpeg:dash:profile:cmaf:2019'?
q_15216.ground_truth: The Media Presentation Description fragment is extracted by the MBMS client, stored in the Manifest parameter, and made available at the location specified in the MnifestURI parameter.

q_15217.question: What is the integrity protection algorithm used in cipher suite 1 for GPL?
q_15217.ground_truth: The integrity protection algorithm used in cipher suite 1 for GPL is HMAC-SHA256-32.

q_15218.question: What should the conference focus do to terminate a conference?
q_15218.ground_truth: The conference focus should remove all present conference participants and deallocate the conference URI.

q_15219.question: What are the two main classes of messaging in the IMS Messaging services?
q_15219.ground_truth: The two main classes of messaging in IMS Messaging services are Immediate messaging and Session based messaging.

q_15220.question: What should the MBMS client do if the getVersion() API call is not supported by the MAA?
q_15220.ground_truth: The MBMS client should not use the API, and the MAA should deregister if the version number is not supported by the MAA.

q_15221.question: What is the role of the PLMN in providing IMS services for SNPN UEs in Solution #19?
q_15221.ground_truth: The PLMN provides IMS services for SNPN UEs in Solution #19.

q_15222.question: What should a UE do if it is registered for emergency services and receives a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message with ngKSI value "000" and 5G-IA0 and 5G-EA0 as selected 5G NAS security algorithms?
q_15222.ground_truth: The UE shall locally derive and take in use 5G NAS security context and delete existing current 5G NAS security context.

q_15223.question: Which scenarios are chosen for drawing observations and bottleneck identification for FR1 and FR2?
q_15223.ground_truth: The scenarios chosen for FR1 are Urban 4GHz TDD, Urban 2.6GHz TDD, Rural 4GHz TDD NLOS O2I, Rural 700MHz FDD NLOS O2I, Rural 2GHz FDD NLOS O2I, Rural 2.6GHz TDD NLOS O2I, and Rural 4GHz with long distance TDD LOS O2O. For FR2, the chosen scenarios are Urban 28GHz TDD NLOS O2I and Indoor 28GHz TDD NLOS.

q_15224.question: What is the purpose of timer T101 in the handover device's procedures?
q_15224.ground_truth: Timer T101 supervises the queuing time for a free channel, and if it expires, a no channel indication is generated.

q_15225.question: What is the signaling range requirement for the transport channel BLER in the 9.1.1.7.2 range/mapping?
q_15225.ground_truth: The signaling range for the transport channel BLER may be larger than the guaranteed accuracy range.

q_15226.question: What is the confidentiality method used to protect signalling information elements on physical connections?
q_15226.ground_truth: A bit per bit or stream cipher is used, where the data flow on the radio path is obtained by the bit per bit binary addition of the user data flow and a ciphering bit stream generated by algorithm A5 using a key determined as specified in subclause 4.3.

q_15227.question: What is the minimum mean power for the CW and E-UTRA (or 1.28Mcps UTRA TDD) interfering signals in the generic MSR intermodulation requirement?
q_15227.ground_truth: The minimum mean power for the CW and E-UTRA (or 1.28Mcps UTRA TDD) interfering signals is -48dBm.

q_15228.question: What is the difference between ResetType-ExtIEs and ResetIEs in the "Reset" message?
q_15228.ground_truth: ResetIEs contains a list of mandatory Protocol IEs related to the reset procedure, while ResetType-ExtIEs contains optional IE extensions related to resetting the connection for specific scenarios.

q_15229.question: What is the significance of the "CSMT" flag in the location update request message in the CS Fallback flows for terminating calls?
q_15229.ground_truth: The "CSMT" flag in the location update request message indicates that the signaling link should be maintained for a longer duration in case the IAM (Initial Attach Message) is delayed by the old MSC/VLR.

q_15230.question: When determining the Maximum APN restriction based on the received APN Restriction of each PDP context in the new SGSN, what should be taken into account?
q_15230.ground_truth: The new SGSN should determine the Maximum APN restriction based on the received APN Restriction of each PDP context/EPS Bearer Context for using S4 from the GGSN/P-GW or old S4-SGSN for using S4, and then store the new Maximum APN restriction value.

q_15231.question: In step 4 of the solution, what do the UE-to-Network relay's AMF, AUSF, UDM, and PKMF do together for the Remote UE?
q_15231.ground_truth: They authenticate the Remote UE, verify if the Remote UE and the selected Relay UE are authorized to set up a relay connection for the given Relay Service Code and generate the respective key material for the remote UE and selected UE-to-Network relay.

q_15232.question: What is one of the content size requirements for IMS Messaging sessions?
q_15232.ground_truth: Content size in IMS Messaging sessions is not limited by technology.

q_15233.question: What does Cause represent in EnhancedRelocationResourceFailure-IEs as per RNSAP protocol?
q_15233.ground_truth: Cause defines the type of error that occurred during the relocation process in RNSAP protocol.

q_15234.question: How is the multicast group key message (MGKM1) structured in the communication optimized approach 1?
q_15234.ground_truth: The MGKM1 consists of encrypted values of the group key, one for each set of UEs, using the corresponding transport key. It also includes a hash of the group key for confirmation of the update.

q_15235.question: How many tail bits are added in the convolutional coding procedure for EGPRS?
q_15235.ground_truth: Six tail bits (TB) are added in the convolutional coding procedure for EGPRS.

q_15236.question: What is the end state shown for disconnection of a single remote party in the MPTY call?
q_15236.ground_truth: The end state shown for disconnection of a single remote party in the MPTY call is A-B ACTIVE / MPTY HELD, indicating that the disconnection will not necessarily cause the MPTY call to be released.

q_15237.question: What is the scope of Clause 6.2.1.2.1.3.2 in terms of release?
q_15237.ground_truth: The scope of Clause 6.2.1.2.1.3.2 is Release 18.

q_15238.question: What should the UE do if the RPLMN is not included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report upon receiving the UEInformationRequest message, with rlf-ReportReq set to true?
q_15238.ground_truth: The UE should submit the UEInformationResponse message to lower layers for transmission via SRB1 without the rlf-Report.

q_15239.question: What is the advantage of technical UC identification in the terminating network?
q_15239.ground_truth: The terminating network can perform technical UC identification using an IMR-based PUCI AS for the purpose of identifying forged sender identities, but this requires reliable authentication of the originating network.

q_15240.question: What information is included in the N2 MB Info message sent from the AMF to the (MB-)SMF for delivery method selection?
q_15240.ground_truth: The N2 MB Info message includes the PDU Session ID, the TMGI, and the associated QoS profile.

q_15241.question: How does the 16APK(8,8) R=1.5 modulation compare to the 16QAM modulation in terms of PAPR and dynamic range?
q_15241.ground_truth: The 16APK(8,8) R=1.5 modulation has far more relaxed PAPR and dynamic range compared to the 16QAM modulation.

q_15242.question: What is the short term filter order?

q_15243.question: What is the purpose of the MBS UE Context Activation procedure in the MBS session management without using UE IP address?
q_15243.ground_truth: The MBS UE Context Activation procedure is used to activate the MBS service without the need for the UE to join a multicast group or get an IP address.

q_15244.question: What is the purpose of the Credit Control Request (CCR) in the 3GPP charging architecture?
q_15244.ground_truth: The Credit Control Request (CCR) is used for credit control in the 3GPP charging architecture. The CCR is used to request credit control decisions from the CCF (Credit Control Function) and can include information about the user, the requested service, and the current usage.

q_15245.question: What is the procedure for withdrawal of the CLIP Supplementary Service?
q_15245.ground_truth: The CLIP Supplementary Service can be withdrawn at the customer's request or for administrative reasons. The withdrawal results in the deactivation of the CLIP Supplementary Service.

q_15246.question: What is the first independent threshold in the sub-sub-block index?
q_15246.ground_truth: It is a threshold that does not depend on the sub-sub-block index.

q_15247.question: Which procedure is used by the PCRF to initiate the provision of unsolicited PCC rules in 3GPP EPS?

q_15248.question: When does a UE apply the MCCH information acquisition procedure upon becoming interested to receive MBS broadcast services?
q_15248.ground_truth: A UE should apply the MCCH information acquisition procedure upon becoming interested to receive MBS broadcast services upon entering the cell providing SIB20, upon receiving SIB20 of an SCell via dedicated signalling, and upon receiving a notification that the MCCH information has changed due to the start of new MBS service(s).

q_15249.question: What should be done if the test system for a test has a measurement uncertainty greater than that specified in clause 4.1?
q_15249.ground_truth: If the test system for a test has a measurement uncertainty greater than that specified in clause 4.1, it is still permitted to use the apparatus. However, an adjustment must be made to tighten the test requirement, making the test harder to pass.

q_15250.question: What should the new BSS do if after sending a HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message, it receives a PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST-NACK PDU indicating a failure of the ongoing PS Handover Request procedure due to timer T24 expiry?
q_15250.ground_truth: The new BSS should send a PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST-NACK PDU to the SGSN with cause "DTM Handover - Timer expiry".

q_15251.question: What coding scheme is used in the DISPLAY TEXT command for transmission of 8-bit data?
q_15251.ground_truth: The unpacked coding scheme is used for transmission of 8-bit data in the DISPLAY TEXT command.

q_15252.question: In Solution #12, what method is used to transfer a paging message when the UE cannot listen to the Uu paging?
q_15252.ground_truth: In Solution #12, when the UE cannot listen to the Uu paging, the SMF or MME in PLMN A initiates direct paging in PLMN A, and after some delay, it provides MSISDN of the other USIM and SMS payload containing Push Notification to SMS-SC via NEF.

q_15253.question: What is required for the 5G system to support 5G LAN-type service to UEs using ProSe communication?
q_15253.ground_truth: The 5G system should be able to provide this support.

q_15254.question: What does the SCC AS perform before it requests the Controller UE-1 to authorize the pull request or it authorizes the request on behalf of UE-1 when transferring Collaborative Session Control to UE-2?
q_15254.ground_truth: The SCC AS performs authorization as specified in clause~6a.12, ensures that UE-2 can act as the Controller UE for this Collaborative Session, and that the Public User Identity used by UE-1 shares the service profile with the Public User Identity used by UE-2 for the Collaborative Session.

q_15255.question: What is the time alignment error requirement for UL OLTD operation with two active transmit antenna connectors?
q_15255.ground_truth: The time alignment error shall not exceed 0.4Tc for UE with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD operation.

q_15256.question: Which calculation method should the ME use if the ECIES scheme profile B is the highest priority in the protection schemes listed in the USIM?
q_15256.ground_truth: The ME shall calculate the SUCI using the ECIES scheme profile B.

q_15257.question: What should the UE do if the timer value of T3585 indicates zero and it received the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message?
q_15257.ground_truth: The UE can send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI or without an S-NSSAI.

q_15258.question: How many synchronous cells are used in the test environment?
q_15258.ground_truth: There are three synchronous cells used in the test environment, Cell 1, Cell 2 and Cell 3.

q_15259.question: What value of the Delivery-Outcome AVP indicates that the device action request was successfully completed?

q_15260.question: What happens when the requested IP version is not supported in the PDN connection in the UE initiates an allocation of IPv4 address or an IPv6 prefix?

q_15261.question: What happens to MBS traffic when a UE leaves the MBS session?
q_15261.ground_truth: The MBS traffic cannot be decrypted, and integrity protection check will fail as the rekeying token is never delivered to the UE which left the MBS session.

q_15262.question: What should the mobile station do if it receives the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message after the TBF starting time has expired?
q_15262.ground_truth: If the mobile station receives the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message after the TBF starting time has expired, it proceeds as specified in sub-clause~3.5.4.6.

q_15263.question: What does the Default-Access AVP indicate when sent from the PCEF to the PCRF?
q_15263.ground_truth: It indicates the default access selected by the UE.

q_15264.question: What type of AVP is the Transcoder-Inserted-Indication AVP, and what values does it have?
q_15264.ground_truth: The Transcoder-Inserted-Indication AVP is of type Enumerated and indicates if a transcoder is inserted or not for the SDP media component. The values are "Transcoder Not Inserted" and "Transcoder Inserted".

q_15265.question: In which mode is the transmission of an upper layer PDU suspended to transmit one or more upper layer PDUs of a higher priority and then resumed thereafter?

q_15266.question: What does the PCEF do when it receives a new IP flow mobility request in the Network-initiated mode?
q_15266.ground_truth: The PCEF assigns the NBIFOM rule identifier to the new NBIFOM routing rule and keeps the mapping with the routing rule identifier used in GTP signalling.

q_15267.question: What are the two parameters associated with each access attempt in UAC?
q_15267.ground_truth: Each access attempt in UAC is associated with an Access Category and one or more Access Identities.

q_15268.question: What is the main advantage of using a buffer filled with a priority scheduling algorithm in comparison to a standard buffer in poor reception conditions?
q_15268.ground_truth: With a priority scheduling algorithm, the high quality data runs out earlier than lower qualities, allowing for keeping the playout alive during longer outages than in the standard case.

q_15269.question: What is the procedure that determines the positioning method to be used for locating an UE, based on the requested QoS and the UE and network capabilities?

q_15270.question: What is the procedure used in order to signal to the Node B the adjustment to be performed by the UE in the uplink timing?
