If it is 1, the document is presented to the TSG for approval. If it is greater than 1, it indicates that the document is TSG approved and under change control.

q_15753.question: Who is responsible for providing the C2 communication link selection and switching policy to the UAV's UAE-C?
q_15753.ground_truth: The USS/UTM, via UAE-S in a U1-AE message.

q_15754.question: What authorization policy is applicable when the UE is not served by E-UTRAN for ProSe Direct Communication?
q_15754.ground_truth: When the UE is not served by E-UTRAN, the authorization policy indicates whether the UE is authorized to perform ProSe Direct Communication procedures.

q_15755.question: When does the UE initiate the eCall inactivity procedure?
q_15755.ground_truth: The UE initiates the eCall inactivity procedure when timer T3444 or T3445 expires, or both timers expire.

q_15756.question: What is the initial data transmission method in the punctured redundancy version of 16 bits?
q_15756.ground_truth: The initial data is transmitted using Transmission 1, which is a specific redundancy version of 16 bits.

q_15757.question: When should the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure immediately after the quantity to be reported becomes available for each requested pair of PCell and NR cell in the test described in 8.2.3.17.3.3?
q_15757.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure immediately after the quantity to be reported becomes available for each requested pair of PCell and NR cell in the test described in 8.2.3.17.3.3.

q_15758.question: What should the UE include in the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message during the authentication procedure after the verification of the AUTN fails on the USIM due to a synchronisation failure?
q_15758.ground_truth: The UE shall include the EAP-response/AKA'-synchronization-failure message in the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.

q_15759.question: What are the extra functionalities of the AMR-WB backward compatible functions compared to the AMR-WB coder?
q_15759.ground_truth: The extra functionalities of the AMR-WB backward compatible functions include support of input and output sampling frequencies other than 16 kHz, inclusion of jitter buffer management, and switching between AMR-WB IO bit rates and primary EVS bit rates at any 20 ms speech frame boundary.

q_15760.question: What does the TRAU need to do after receiving a time alignment command from AMR or AMR-WB speech in uplink No_Speech frame?
q_15760.ground_truth: The TRAU processes this data, sets the "Time Alignment" field in the next downlink frame as ordered and then delays the subsequent frame accordingly. It needs to send the TAE bits back only if the downlink frame is a No_Speech frame, too.

q_15761.question: What is the effect of the modification of a NBIFOM routing rule to change the Routing Filter or the Routing Rule Priority?
q_15761.ground_truth: The modification triggers the PCRF to modify the service data flow filter or precedence in the corresponding installed PCC Rule accordingly.

q_15762.question: How much SINR degradation does the victim NB-IoT UE experience when subjected to 23dBm interfering LTE UE and 31dBm interfering HPUE, respectively?
q_15762.ground_truth: The victim NB-IoT UE experiences a SINR degradation of less than 1dB at various CDF points when subjected to 31dBm interfering HPUE. When subjected to 23dBm interfering LTE UE, the SINR degradation is within 1.5dB difference at various CDF points compared to that caused by 31dBm interfering HPUE.

q_15763.question: Which layer is responsible for the services provided by layer 1 in the RRC layer model?
q_15763.ground_truth: Layer 1 is responsible for the services provided by layer 1 in the RRC layer model.

q_15764.question: What is the status condition returned by the UICC when an AUTHENTICATE command is sent to the UICC with an incorrect signed data?
q_15764.ground_truth: The status condition returned by the UICC when an AUTHENTICATE command is sent to the UICC with an incorrect signed data is SW1~=~'98', SW2~=~'62' - authentication error, incorrect MAC.

q_15765.question: What is the transmit power of the common midamble in the downlink when Common Midamble Allocation is used?
q_15765.ground_truth: The transmit power of this common midamble is such that there is no power offset between the data parts and the midamble part of the overall transmit signal within one time slot.

q_15766.question: What operation is invoked in the gprsProcessingPackage operation package?
q_15766.ground_truth: The CONSUMER INVOKES continueGPRS operation is invoked in the gprsProcessingPackage operation package.

q_15767.question: In the context of inter-frequency FDD cell re-selection, what is the condition for cell re-selection to an inter-frequency FDD cell for the interruption time requirement to apply?
q_15767.ground_truth: The condition is that the UE does not need measurement occasions to perform inter-frequency FDD measurements.

q_15768.question: What 1st priority channels do not meet the absolute MPL target in the Urban 28GHz TDD NLOS O2I scenario?
q_15768.ground_truth: PUSCH eMBB DDDSU, PUSCH eMBB DDSU, PUSCH VoIP DDDSU, PDSCH eMBB DDSU, PUCCH Format 1, PUCCH Format 3 11bits, PUCCH Format 3 22bits, SSB, PRACH Format B4: 20.30dB, PDCCH of Msg2, PUSCH of Msg3, PDSCH of Msg4, PDSCH eMBB DDDSU, PUSCH VoIP DDSU

q_15769.question: What is the role of the SCEF and the RCAF in the Ns Diameter application?
q_15769.ground_truth: The SCEF acts as the Diameter client, requesting reporting of network status, while the RCAF acts as the Diameter server, handling network status reporting requests for a particular location.

q_15770.question: What media packaging formats does the DVB-MABR Phase 1 technical specification maintain compatibility with?
q_15770.ground_truth: The DVB-MABR Phase 1 technical specification maintains compatibility with existing segmented media packaging formats such as DVB's profile of MPEG-DASH and MPEG-CMAF.

q_15771.question: What is the purpose of including the SS-Status parameter in the result of a successful CFNRy erasure request?
q_15771.ground_truth: The SS-Status parameter is included to provide backwards compatibility with phase 1.

q_15772.question: In what order should an MS order the PLMN/access technology combinations in Note 1h?
q_15772.ground_truth: In Note 1h, the MS should order the PLMN/access technology combinations in order of decreasing signal quality within each access technology, and the order between PLMN/access technology combinations with different access technologies is an MS implementation issue.

q_15773.question: What should be given precedence over encapsulated ISUP value in the alignment process when a SIP header maps to ISUP field(s)?
q_15773.ground_truth: The SIP header is given precedence over the encapsulated ISUP value in the alignment process.

q_15774.question: What information is stored in the MS for GPRS services when the GSIM is GPRS service-aware?
q_15774.ground_truth: If the GSIM is GPRS service-aware, then the IMSI, P-TMSI, P-TMSI Signature, Routeing Area, Kc, and CKSN stored in the GSIM shall be used for GPRS services.

q_15775.question: What is the name of the measurement that gives the number of failed PDP context activation procedures due to PDP context activation failure causes?

q_15776.question: What should the network return in response to a specific CFNRc interrogation request if it is not registered?
q_15776.ground_truth: The network shall return the SS-Status parameter indicating "not registered".

q_15777.question: Under what conditions should an MS not consider a PLMN as a PLMN selection candidate?
q_15777.ground_truth: An MS should not consider a PLMN as a PLMN selection candidate if voice service was not possible on that PLMN, unless that PLMN is available in GERAN or UTRAN or no other allowed PLMN is available, or if the MS only supports EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection and the PLMN does not advertise support for it, or if the MS is in eCall only mode and the PLMN does not advertise support for eCall over IMS.

q_15778.question: What should the UE do if all segments of a warning message have been received within a period of 3 hours?
q_15778.ground_truth: The UE should assemble the warning message, forward the received warning message, messageIdentifier, serialNumber, and dataCodingScheme to upper layers, stop reception of SIB7, and discard the current values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7.

q_15779.question: How does the power pre-allocation work for non-empty non-scheduled flow in each uplink frequency when the UE has more than one Activated Uplink Frequency in FDD?
q_15779.ground_truth: The power is pre-allocated for all non-empty non-scheduled flow on the Primary Uplink Frequency, and the remaining power is split among all the Activated Uplink Frequencies in proportion to the respective serving grants.

q_15780.question: Who triggers the paging procedure in Solution #11 when the UE does not respond to a paging message before the timer elapses?
q_15780.ground_truth: In Solution #11, when the UE does not respond to a paging message before the timer elapses, the network (AMF or MME) triggers the paging procedure.

q_15781.question: What condition triggers the Mobile Station to initiate the MBMS packet access procedure when it receives an MBMS notification with counting requested?
q_15781.ground_truth: The Mobile Station responds to an MBMS notification where counting is requested.

q_15782.question: What are the four types of networks that an AIPN should support to offer 3GPP services to users through Personal Networks, Personal Area Networks, Ad-hoc Networks, and Moving Networks?
q_15782.ground_truth: AIPN should support Personal Networks, Personal Area Networks (PAN), Ad-hoc Networks, and Moving Networks for offering 3GPP services to users.

q_15783.question: In what scenario is the Inter System Resume procedure applicable for handover?
q_15783.ground_truth: The Inter System Resume procedure is only applicable in the case of A/Gb mode to Iu mode handover.

q_15784.question: What is the relationship between policy counters and Charging key?
q_15784.ground_truth: Policy counters and Charging key can have a 1-1 relationship or services that share the same Charging key can be associated with different policy counters, and vice versa.

q_15785.question: What happens if there is repeated integrity checking failure during the Iu Release Request and Clear Request mapping?
q_15785.ground_truth: The message contents are invalid, and the request will be rejected due to signalling connection release or invalid message contents.

q_15786.question: What happens if the bearer(s) are still established after the GW (BBERF) removes the QoS rules in the PCRF-Initiated Gateway Control Session Termination procedure?
q_15786.ground_truth: The GW (BBERF) initiates an IP-CAN specific bearer removal procedure for the removed QoS rules.

q_15787.question: What is the initial condition for testing the SEND SHORT MESSAGE (normal) in 27.22.4.10.1.4.1?
q_15787.ground_truth: The ME should be connected to the SIM Simulator, powered on, and have performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure before this test.

q_15788.question: What does the "speech / data indicator" field in the "Channel Type" information element represent?
q_15788.ground_truth: The "speech / data indicator" field in the "Channel Type" information element represents the type of channel being requested, with possible values being speech, data, signalling, or speech + CTM Text Telephony.

q_15789.question: Which stage 3 features and improvements were included in Release 17 to support various enhanced UAV scenarios for commercial and government sectors?
q_15789.ground_truth: TR 22.829, TS 22.261, and TS 22.125 were included in Release 17 to support various enhanced UAV scenarios for commercial and government sectors.

q_15790.question: What is one of the differences between the processing and mapping of the Physical Multicast Channel (PMCH) and other downlink channels?
q_15790.ground_truth: The PMCH is not mapped to resource elements used for transmission of MBSFN reference signals.

q_15791.question: What is the required data type for the "serviceID" element in the "mbmsSecurityDeregister" complex type in the provided XML schema?
q_15791.ground_truth: The "serviceID" element must be of the "xs:anyURI" data type.

q_15792.question: What is the minimum requirement for ACK false alarm in multipath fading conditions?
q_15792.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for ACK false alarm in multipath fading conditions is that P(DTX->ACK) shall be 10-2 or less.

q_15793.question: What should the UE include in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports UAS services?
q_15793.ground_truth: If the UE supports UAS services, it should set the UAS bit to "UAS services supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_15794.question: When performing the automatic commencement mode procedures, what must the IWF performing the participating role include in the SDP answer in the SIP 200 (OK) response to the SDP offer in the incoming SIP INVITE request?
q_15794.ground_truth: The IWF must include an "m=audio" media-level section for the accepted MCPTT speech media stream consisting of specific media-level attributes and the "i=" field set to "speech".

q_15795.question: How is the channel coding for HS-SCCH type 9 done in 4.6I.4?
q_15795.ground_truth: Channel coding for the HS-SCCH type 9 shall be done with the general method described in 4.2.3 with the following specific parameters: the rate 1/3 convolutional coding shall be used for HS-SCCH type 9.

q_15796.question: What is the role of the 2G+3G-SGSN during the TMSI reallocation process?
q_15796.ground_truth: The 2G+3G-SGSN sends a TMSI Reallocation Complete message to the VLR after the MS confirms the VLR TMSI.

q_15797.question: What is the procedure for the SCC AS when it receives a SIP BYE message from a remote ICS UE?
q_15797.ground_truth: When the SCC AS receives a SIP BYE message from a remote ICS UE, it responds with a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE message, releases the I1 session, and sets a CS bearer release timer value if there are no more I1 service control sessions using the CS bearer.

q_15798.question: What is the subject of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Report 26.944?
q_15798.ground_truth: The report focuses on end-to-end multimedia service performance metrics for 3G networks.

q_15799.question: What action is taken by the RNC if the Non Searching Indication IE is present and UTRAN paging coordination is not required?
q_15799.ground_truth: The UTRAN paging coordination function is not activated.

q_15800.question: What is the purpose of the DAI tests, as per the documentation?
q_15800.ground_truth: The purpose of DAI tests is to determine the routing of speech data and which device is being tested (speech transcoder/DTX functions or A/D & D/A).

q_15801.question: What is one of the Key Issues that this solution addresses?
q_15801.ground_truth: This solution addresses the Key Issue #2.1, "The 5G system supports mechanisms to mitigate the linkability attacks". The solution fulfils this requirement by preventing the breach of the user's untraceability and mitigating the linkability attack.

q_15802.question: What kind of information does the "WLAN" leaf in "ANDSF/HomeNetworkPreference/RanMobilitySetUsed/<X>/WLAN" contain?
q_15802.ground_truth: The WLAN leaf in "ANDSF/HomeNetworkPreference/RanMobilitySetUsed/<X>/WLAN" indicates the SSID of a WLAN.

q_15803.question: What is the role of a TrGW in a 3GPP network?
q_15803.ground_truth: A TrGW, or Transition Gateway, is used in a 3GPP network to enable communication between IPv6 only terminals and IPv4 networks. It can translate IPv6 packets to IPv4 and vice versa.

q_15804.question: How does handover affect the control procedure and the operation of the service?
q_15804.ground_truth: Handover has no impact on the control procedure and the operation of the CFU service.

q_15805.question: What is the purpose of splitting the MS Classmark into distinct and independent information sets?
q_15805.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the introduction of new radio access technologies in the future and to ensure the information set is independent of the type of network the MS is about to attach (A/Gb mode or Iu mode).

q_15806.question: What device does Rosy use to establish a data connection to the network for her ECG?
q_15806.ground_truth: A smart phone acts as a gateway UE for Rosy's ECG.

q_15807.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving the UEInformationRequest message if the logMeasReport is present and the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport?
q_15807.ground_truth: The UE sets the absoluteTimeStamp, traceReference, traceRecordingSessionRef, and tce-Id, and includes one or more entries from VarLogMeasReport starting from the entries logged first. If there are additional logged measurement entries, the UE sets the logMeasAvailable to include them.

q_15808.question: What is the limit for Trdt in the context of AEC evaluation?
q_15808.ground_truth: The provisional limit for Trdt is 1 second, assuming an echo attenuation of at least 20 dB.

q_15809.question: What is the requirement for the computational feasibility of deriving K from the inputs and output of functions f1 to f5*?
q_15809.ground_truth: It should be computationally infeasible to derive K from knowledge of inputs and output for each of the algorithms f1 to f5*.

q_15810.question: What is the relationship between the NRM and the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM)?
q_15810.ground_truth: The NRM is a member of the FNIM, and its information is derived from the FNIM Umbrella Information Model (UIM).

q_15811.question: What phases are mandatory for all Decomposition Processes?
q_15811.ground_truth: The Composition Agreement Unrealization and Composition Agreement Invalidation phases are mandatory for all Decomposition Processes.

q_15812.question: What is the function of the BMCA function in the NW-TT port, when the Announce receipt timeout or Sync receipt timeout has expired for a SlavePort?
q_15812.ground_truth: The BMCA function in the NW-TT port re-evaluates the DS-TT and NW-TT port states, when the Announce receipt timeout or Sync receipt timeout has expired for a SlavePort.

q_15813.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP technical report on Dual Connectivity (DC) of 4 LTE bands and 1 NR band?
q_15813.ground_truth: The purpose is to gather relevant background information and studies to address DC of 4 LTE bands (4DL/1UL) and 1 NR band (1DL/1UL) for the Rel-17 band combinations.

q_15814.question: When would the Node B include the Power Local Cell Group ID IE for the Local Cell in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message?
q_15814.ground_truth: When the Node B internal power resources are pooled for a group of Local Cells, the Node B shall include the Power Local Cell Group ID IE for the Local Cell in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message.

q_15815.question: What action would be taken if call A-B is disconnected based on note 7?
q_15815.ground_truth: The network will continue with call A-B as a normal call clearing operation.

q_15816.question: In what frequency range should the DL frequency be if the "Frequency band indicator" is not included and Band I is part of the frequency bands supported by the UE?
q_15816.ground_truth: The DL frequency should be in the range of 2110MHz-2170MHz.

q_15817.question: What action should the GGSN take if it does not have the MBMS Bearer Context information for a requested MBMS bearer service?
q_15817.ground_truth: The GGSN sends a MBMS Registration Request to the BM-SC.

q_15818.question: What is the effect of an embedded TFO message on the TFO frame?
q_15818.ground_truth: The TFO frame synchronization pattern will be affected by the presence of an embedded TFO message, without compromising the synchronization performances.

q_15819.question: Under what condition can the UE use the MPS indicator?
q_15819.ground_truth: The MPS indicator can only be used if the SUPI from the USIM matches the SUPI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME.

q_15820.question: What is the difference between TrGW and ALG in the context of IMS interworking architecture?
q_15820.ground_truth: TrGW provides the translation function and ALG is the necessary application level gateway that is aware of SIP/SDP protocols.

q_15821.question: What are the two considered bitrates for the video encoding process?
q_15821.ground_truth: The two bitrates are 64 kbit/s and 128 kbit/s.

q_15822.question: What is the purpose of the MT Correlation ID in the SMS-GMSC's Status report?
q_15822.ground_truth: The MT Correlation ID is used by the IP-SM-GW to associate the Routing Info retrieval with the subsequent Forward Short Message messages to the UE. It ensures that the status report is properly linked with the corresponding message.

q_15823.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a SIP 18x response from the remote UE when sending SIP INVITE requests on both legs?
q_15823.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP 18x response from the remote UE, the SCC AS should send a SIP 18x response on both legs, i.e., with the ICS UE and with the CS domain.

q_15824.question: What is the purpose of the Core Network Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) as defined in the present document?
q_15824.ground_truth: The Core Network Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) defines requirements for the management of 3GPP network resources, specifically for the Core Network (CN) network resources, including support for converged networks and consistency between UTRAN/GERAN and CN parameters.

q_15825.question: What is the function of the PNI-NPN provisioning platform in the solution for UE onboarding for PNI-NPN with Provisioning Server integrated in PLMN?
q_15825.ground_truth: The PNI-NPN provisioning platform is responsible for provisioning NPN credential combined with S-NSSAI/DNN to UDM, and notifying UDM that NPN credential for particular S-NSSAI/DNN has changed.

q_15826.question: What are the requirements for architecture and migration of Next Generation Radio Access Technologies?
q_15826.ground_truth: The RAN architecture for the Next Generation Radio Access Technologies shall support tight interworking between the new RAT and LTE, connectivity through multiple transmission points, different options and flexibility for splitting the RAN architecture, and deployment flexibility e.g. to host relevant RAN, CN and application functions close together at the edges of the network.

q_15827.question: What is Non-Seamless WLAN Offload (NSWO)?
q_15827.ground_truth: Non-Seamless WLAN Offload (NSWO) is a capability of routing specific IP flows over WLAN access without traversing the EPC.

q_15828.question: How many mobile stations can be indicated in the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message?
q_15828.ground_truth: Up to four mobile stations can be indicated in the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message.

q_15829.question: What is required for IP-CAN bearer specific offline charging, as per TS 23.203?
q_15829.ground_truth: IP-CAN bearer specific rating group/service identifier, as defined in clause 5.3.1.1, is required for IP-CAN bearer specific offline charging.

q_15830.question: What is the effect of expiration of barring timers on access control?
q_15830.ground_truth: At expiry of barring timers, the indication of alleviation of access barring is indicated to the NAS on a per access category basis, allowing the NAS to reinitiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message if still needed.

q_15831.question: What information element indicates to the S-CSCF the Registered Private Identities, which were registered with the Public Identity received in the request command?

q_15832.question: What instruction does the AMF provide in the Registration Accept message regarding the registration of PDU Sessions in the UE?
q_15832.ground_truth: The AMF indicates the established PDU Sessions to the UE in the PDU Session status. The UE removes locally any internal resources related to PDU Sessions that are not marked as established in the received PDU Session status.

q_15833.question: What is the purpose of the Dynamic Resource Allocation Control (DRAC) procedure in the network?
q_15833.ground_truth: The Dynamic Resource Allocation Control (DRAC) procedure in the network regular broadcasts parameters to the UE, such as transmission probability and maximum total bit rate, to control the UE's uplink DCHs.

q_15834.question: How does the 5G system provide the real-time virtual scene to local users in IoE based social networking services?
q_15834.ground_truth: The real-time virtual scene is provided to local users as an AR scenario by proximity smart terminals.

q_15835.question: What is the network element that sends an "Info request" when a mobile number is roaming?

q_15836.question: What is the effect of a RRCConnectionReject message with deprioritisationReq on the UE?
q_15836.ground_truth: The UE considers all E-UTRA frequencies and inter-RAT frequencies to be of the lowest priority while T325 is running, and it deletes any stored deprioritisation request(s) when a PLMN selection is performed.

q_15837.question: What action does the HNB-GW take after receiving the HNBAP:RELOCATION COMPLETE message from the Target HNB?
q_15837.ground_truth: The HNB-GW switches the U-plane to the Target HNB.

q_15838.question: What is the purpose of the <Domain> portion in the Service Instance Name?
q_15838.ground_truth: The <Domain> portion of the Service Instance Name specifies the domain where the service is registered based on the nature of the interface on which the transport protocol is used, whether it is for an intra-domain or inter-domain scenario.

q_15839.question: What are the main components of the MExE service environment?
q_15839.ground_truth: The MExE service environment consists of two main parts: the user interface (buttons, menus, screens, and MMI) and the MExE MMI (providing support for services and functionality on the MExE device). The MExE MMI is not standardized, allowing for manufacturer innovation and catering to evolving market needs while MExE services operate within its capabilities.

q_15840.question: Which resources does Alice's PN contribute in the described use case?
q_15840.ground_truth: Alice's PN contributes two resources: 1) printing service and 2) Internet access.

q_15841.question: What issue can arise when using acoustic echo suppression in the mobile environment?
q_15841.ground_truth: Severe speech clipping and noise contrast can occur.

q_15842.question: What is the purpose of checking the topologically correct IPv4 Home address in the Binding Lifetime Extension procedure of the LMA?
q_15842.ground_truth: The LMA checks if the received IPv4 Home address is topologically correct to ensure a valid IPv4 Home address assignment for the UE's PDN connection.

q_15843.question: What are the service flow requirements for cloud rendering for gaming?
q_15843.ground_truth: The service flows for cloud rendering for gaming include low packet delay and high bandwidth requirements for uplink and downlink traffic, guaranteed data rate and high frame rate, and low packet loss rate for sensor data and rendered multimedia data.

q_15844.question: What is the final flag that is used to represent the activity of the signal?
q_15844.ground_truth: The final flag that is used to represent the activity of the signal is a combination of three flags, representing different trade-offs between quality and efficiency. This flag is set to one for active signals, which are any useful signals bearing meaningful information, and set to zero for inactive signals, which have no meaningful information.

q_15845.question: What determines the maximum allowed rate to be used in E-TFC selection for inactive processes in TDD?
q_15845.ground_truth: The maximum allowed rate to be used in E-TFC selection for inactive processes in TDD is 0.

q_15846.question: How is the Length Indicator (LI) field used in delimiting Upper Layer PDUs within the RLC data block in Iu mode?
q_15846.ground_truth: In Iu mode, a Length Indicator of value 63 indicates the presence of filler information within the RLC data block. A Length Indicator of value 62 is used to indicate the presence of a Selected PLMN Index field in the octet immediately following this Length Indicator. A singular case occurs when the end of the Upper Layer PDU would fit within the RLC data block but the addition of the corresponding Length Indicator octet causes the Upper Layer PDU to extend into the next RLC data block. In this case, this additional LI field shall take the value 0 whatever is the length of the last but one Upper Layer PDU segment.

q_15847.question: What is the name of the 3D video packing format that consists in sub-sampling the two views which compose a stereoscopic 3D video and pack them together in a 2D frame infrastructure?

q_15848.question: What memory component is used to generate the time-domain signal at the CELP sampling rate in the MDCT based TCX decoder?
q_15848.ground_truth: The MDCT based TCX decoder generates two time-domain signals, one at the output sampling rate and one at the CELP sampling rate. The signal at the CELP sampling rate is used to update the CELP memories.

q_15849.question: In which clause of TS 38.331 does it specify that if AS security has been successfully activated, the UE shall perform certain actions related to Rx-Tx time difference measurement?

q_15850.question: What is needed to allow the user to remain anonymous towards the Relying Party in scenarios 2 and 4 while still allowing GBA authentication?
q_15850.ground_truth: The user's AA identifier and the Relying Party's OpenID Authentication Request, which are needed to initiate the GBA authentication with the OP/NAF, can be done without any GBA specific user information in the initial User-Supplied Identifier. This allows the user to remain anonymous towards the Relying Party.

q_15851.question: What is the number of timing advance estimations used in the RLC Data Block method for obtaining a timing advance value?

q_15852.question: What happens when a network element involved in CFNRy is of Phase~1?
q_15852.ground_truth: If any network element involved is of Phase~1, only information concerning basic service groups for which the activation state has the value "Active and Operative" will be returned, and CFNRy Registration requests which use a subaddress and all CFNRy Activation and Deactivation requests will be rejected.

q_15853.question: What is the purpose of the Additional OTA transmitter spurious emissions requirements in section 6.5.4.5.4?
q_15853.ground_truth: These requirements are intended to protect systems operating in frequency ranges other than the repeater-Node, and may be applied as optional or mandatory protection by local or regional regulations for an NR operating band.

q_15854.question: What is the authentication mechanism used in the 3GPP system to access the network?
q_15854.ground_truth: Authentication is performed using a SIM/USIM application resident on a UICC. The USIM on the UICC is required to access the 3GPP system, and only a single USIM can be active at any time.

q_15855.question: What happens to a non-DRX mode period when the mobile station establishes an RR connection during any of the non-DRX mode periods?
q_15855.ground_truth: That period shall continue to run, if the mobile station establishes an RR connection during any of the non-DRX mode periods.

q_15856.question: What is the purpose of the Supported Codec List information element in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_15856.ground_truth: The Supported Codec List information element in 3GPP TS 24.008 is used to specify the coding of the supported codec list elements for the UMTS radio access technology.

q_15857.question: What technique is used for handling ASN.1/PER encoded parameters while copying them into one or more octets of the GTPv1 IE?
q_15857.ground_truth: Transparent copying of RANAP parameters across GTPv1 interfaces is used for handling ASN.1/PER encoded parameters while copying them into one or more octets of the GTPv1 IE. This approach ensures that GTPv1 is not impacted if the contents of such RANAP/S1AP parameter change over time.

q_15858.question: What is the role of the Composition Agreement in the new CCN?
q_15858.ground_truth: The Composition Agreement defines the rules for external interactions of the new CCN, governs the control and use of resources, and resolves possible contradictions and parallel control tasks.

q_15859.question: What is the purpose of the document "High power UE (power class 2) for EN-DC with 1 LTE band + 1 NR TDD band" in the 3GPP technical specification group?
q_15859.ground_truth: The purpose is to gather relevant background information and studies to address Power Class 2 EN-DC of 1 LTE band and 1 NR TDD band for the Rel-17 band combinations.

q_15860.question: What kind of document is the "GSM Cordless Telephony System (CTS), Phase 1; CTS supervising system layer 3 specification (Release 17)"?
q_15860.ground_truth: It is a Technical Specification produced by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) for the procedures used at the CTS system interface with the supervision part.

q_15861.question: What is the purpose of collocating the GBA BSF and the Liberty IdP in the co-hosting scenario of GBA?
q_15861.ground_truth: The purpose of collocating the GBA BSF and the Liberty IdP in the co-hosting scenario of GBA is to enable the authentication of users through the Ub bootstrapping procedure and other protocol fragments.

q_15862.question: What is the function of the BM-SC in MBMS user service provisioning and delivery?
q_15862.ground_truth: The BM-SC provides various MBMS user service specific services such as provisioning and delivery of MBMS user services.

q_15863.question: What is the purpose of the file format defined in 3GPP TS 32.432?
q_15863.ground_truth: The file format defined in 3GPP TS 32.432 is for the bulk transfer of performance measurement results to the NM. It specifies the format for measurement result files that can be transferred from the network (NEs or EM) to the NM.

q_15864.question: What is the purpose of the Common ID procedure in the specified context?
q_15864.ground_truth: The purpose of the Common ID procedure is to inform the RNC about the permanent NAS UE Identity (i.e. IMSI) of a user, which can be used for UTRAN paging coordination, access control, and authorizing the use of radio resources.

q_15865.question: How is the magnitude spectrum calculated for the sinusoidal analysis in Phase ECU?
q_15865.ground_truth: The magnitude spectrum is calculated by windowing the analysis frame buffer with a Hamming-rectangular window, passing it through a FFT, and saving the resulting spectrum. Then, the peaks of this magnitude spectrum are located by a peak picking method, and their positions are further refined by using parabolic interpolation to make them available in highest possible resolution.

q_15866.question: What IE specifies an integer in 40 bit binary representation, denoting compressed originator-to-dispatcher information in the GCC protocol?

q_15867.question: What is the purpose of the REPORT record in MMS service interception?
q_15867.ground_truth: The REPORT record is used to convey the events of MMS service interception.

q_15868.question: What should a BSS (or SGSN) do when it receives an NS-UNITDATA PDU with a BVCI not associated with the NS-VC where the PDU was received?
q_15868.ground_truth: The BSS (or SGSN) shall return an NS-STATUS PDU on that NS-VC with cause "BVC unknown on that NSE" and ignore the BVCI in the NS-UNITDATA PDU.

q_15869.question: What is the performance comparison of RSACCH and RSACCH-1 for SACCH information throughput at high and bad channel conditions?
q_15869.ground_truth: RSACCH-1, which is based on an ideal implementation, yields close or better performance than RSACCH-2 at bad channel conditions and close or better performance than the legacy SACCH at good channel conditions. This performance serves as a bound for the performance of RSACCH-2 and the legacy SACCH.

q_15870.question: How are the radio frequency (RF) front-end requirements approached in the report?
q_15870.ground_truth: The RF front-end requirements are described based on the band combination basis, and the actual requirements are added to the corresponding technical specification.

q_15871.question: What are the two formats for the "to-address" or "from-address" in the SMS message?
q_15871.ground_truth: The two formats for the "to-address" or "from-address" in the SMS message are "user@domain1.domain2" or "User Name <user@domain1.domain2>".

q_15872.question: What is the suggested value for the intermodulation components for testing purposes in some areas?
q_15872.ground_truth: In some areas, to avoid uncoordinated system impacts, it may be beneficial to use a more stringent value of -70 dBc rms for intermodulation components.

q_15873.question: What state is the remote party "B" in before disconnecting?

q_15874.question: What is the main challenge in addressing the main threats for non-IMS interconnection in 7.5.1?
q_15874.ground_truth: Ensuring secure VoIP exchanges at least at the signalling level and if possible at the media level also, while supporting the roaming scenario where the sender is in a visited network.

q_15875.question: What action should the network take if the UE sends an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message with a valid SQN and MAC, but the mapping of 5G-GUTI to SUPI is incorrect?
q_15875.ground_truth: The network should respond by sending a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to the UE.

q_15876.question: What action does the ProSe Function take when the value of the Requested Discovery Timer is set to zero in step~1?
q_15876.ground_truth: The ProSe Function shall remove the discovery entry indicated by the Discovery Entry ID and release the associated resources.

q_15877.question: What are the definitions of AP, IOC, IRP, NRM, PLMN, UML, and WLAN in the context of 3GPP's telecommunications management specifications?
q_15877.ground_truth: AP is an abbreviation for Access Point, IOC stands for Information Object Class, IRP means Integration Reference Point, NRM is Network Resource Model, PLMN represents Public Land Mobile Network, UML stands for Unified Modelling Language, and WLAN means Wireless Local Area Network.

q_15878.question: What is the measurement accuracy for all measured cells specified in section 9?
q_15878.ground_truth: The measurement accuracy for all measured cells is as specified in section 9.

q_15879.question: What should the ME do after step f) during the authentication procedure if the verification of the AUTN fails on the USIM due to a synchronisation failure?
q_15879.ground_truth: The ME shall return the EAP-Response/AKA-Synchronization-Failure.

q_15880.question: What technical group is responsible for investigating additional signalling to support UEs in reducing their performance in the described study?
q_15880.ground_truth: RAN2 is responsible for investigating additional signalling to support UEs in reducing their performance in the described study.

q_15881.question: In what scenario will the UE calculate the value of the received IE "QqualminEUTRA" minus the value of the received IE "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols"?
q_15881.ground_truth: This calculation will be done if the UE supports RSRQ measurement on all OFDM symbols and both "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" and "QqualminEUTRA" from the IE "E-UTRA frequency and priority extension" occurrence are present.

q_15882.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a UEInformationRequest message after having sent an RRCSetupComplete message with connEstFailInfoAvailable?
q_15882.ground_truth: The UE should include the connection establishment failure information in the RRCSetupComplete message, if available.

q_15883.question: What message does the SGSN send to the MS to indicate the activation of the PDP context?
q_15883.ground_truth: The SGSN sends a 'Request PDP Context Activation (TI, PDP Type, and PDP Address)' message to request the MS to activate the indicated PDP context.

q_15884.question: What is the content of the "RL-InformationResponseList-RL-AdditionRspFDD" sequence in NBAP?
q_15884.ground_truth: The "RL-InformationResponseList-RL-AdditionRspFDD" sequence, as its name suggests, contains a list of RL-Information-Responses for a given frame offset ID. The RL-Information-Responses from id-TimeslotISCP-Information-List-DL-PowerBalancing-Activation-Information-ItemIE-RL-AdditionalResponseTDD sequence in NBAP is used in FDD with TD-SCDMA. It includes 1..maxNrOfDLs-1 NR AND DL parameters for the response to an E-RNAP RLC-Specific-DCH-Info request (< reject> case) or ID-LCR (< reject> case) in the "ProtocolIEs" field for this RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD. The PSSCH mapping between the first and second cells, while oversampling is specified for 1.28 Mcps TDD such as when 15ms and 20ms frame lengths apply. The usage of the corresponding parameters fields in the response for this ID-LCR is determined by the frequency multiplexing rate chosen in the request.

q_15885.question: What is the result for the TERMINAL RESPONSE (Command Performed Successfully) in the sequence 1.2?
q_15885.ground_truth: The channel data length is more than 255 bytes of space available in the Tx buffer.

q_15886.question: What is the purpose of the second detailed scaling process on each of the two selected bands after the second bit allocation?
q_15886.ground_truth: The second detailed scaling process is implemented on each of the two selected bands after the second bit allocation to obtain the number of pulses for each of the two selected bands, same as the first detailed scaling process.

q_15887.question: What action does the UE take during initial registration if it has a valid 5G-GUTI and a SUCI?
q_15887.ground_truth: The UE first attempts to use the 5G-GUTI as its identity, but if the 5GS mobile identity IE is not present in the UE, the UE will use the SUCI as its identity.

q_15888.question: What is the threat related to forging network information, and what transport protocol is it relevant to?
q_15888.ground_truth: Forged network information, or spoofed IP source address, is a threat that is relevant only to connection-less transport protocol such as UDP.

q_15889.question: What is the 1st PLMN defined in the Operator Controlled PLMN Selector (EFOPLMNwACT) in the default E-UTRAN UICC?
q_15889.ground_truth: The 1st PLMN defined is 254 001 (MCC MNC) in the Operator Controlled PLMN Selector (EFOPLMNwACT) in the default E-UTRAN UICC.

q_15890.question: In what scenario must the UE initiate the PDP context modification procedure?
q_15890.ground_truth: When the PDN connection is a multi-access PDN connection for IP flows over GERAN or UTRAN and trusted WLAN using SCM, the move-traffic-to-WLAN indication is received from the access stratum layer of the 3GPP access, and the Local Operating Environment Information in the UE does not contain non-radio-related conditions that prohibit the use of WLAN access, then the UE must initiate the PDP context modification procedure.

q_15891.question: What are the synchronization functions implemented in the MS and BTS for circuit-switched handovers?
q_15891.ground_truth: The synchronization functions implemented in the MS and BTS for circuit-switched handovers are the pseudo synchronization scheme for circuit-switched handovers to support the scheme. This is optional, but the MS must measure and report the Observed Timing Difference (OTD).

q_15892.question: What is the difference between UTRA FDD and UTRA TDD in terms of the modulation of the interferer?
q_15892.ground_truth: UTRA FDD uses a WCDMA modulated signal for the interferer, while UTRA TDD uses an OFDM modulated interferer.

q_15893.question: What indicator is taken into account by the upper layers when selecting the access domain for voice sessions or calls in a UE with IMS voice over PS session capability?
q_15893.ground_truth: The IMS voice over PS session indicator

q_15894.question: What is the purpose of the FF application layer functional model in Solution #1?
q_15894.ground_truth: The FF application layer functional model in Solution #1 provides the architecture and functional model required for addressing the application layer support aspects.

q_15895.question: What is the format used for the uniform format in digital PCM to analogue conversion?
q_15895.ground_truth: The uniform format is represented in two's complement in digital PCM to analogue conversion.

q_15896.question: What is the parameter named in the "Update UE location information" message that indicates the direction of altitude (height or depth)?

q_15897.question: What is the required status line for a successful registration response?
q_15897.ground_truth: A successful registration response shall start with a 200 OK status line in the response header.

q_15898.question: What are the supported IP versions in the E1 signalling bearer based on 3GPP TS 38.413-0?
q_15898.ground_truth: IPv6 (IETF RFC 8200) and/or IPv4 (IETF RFC 791) are supported in the E1 signalling bearer based on 3GPP TS 38.413-0.

q_15899.question: What is the role of the IM CN Subsystem in the procedures for Forced Playout Constraints?
q_15899.ground_truth: The IM CN Subsystem handles the SIP dialog, while the SCF checks the user's service rights and issues the forced playout constraints policy to the UE and PSS Adapter.

q_15900.question: What is the margin of tolerance for power measurement in a non-fading channel in idle and connected mode at the MS side?
q_15900.ground_truth: The margin of tolerance for power measurement in a non-fading channel is +/- 1 dB in idle and connected mode at the MS side.

q_15901.question: What are the two main criteria used in the radio-subsystem directed handover process?
q_15901.ground_truth: The two main criteria are degradation of the quality of one or more of the current serving channel(s), and the availability of other channel(s) which can allow communication at a lower TX power level.

q_15902.question: How should the MME and UE derive KeNB during handover from UTRAN to E-UTRAN?
q_15902.ground_truth: The MME and UE shall derive KeNB by applying the KDF defined in Annex A.3 using the mapped key K'ASME and 232-1 as the value of the uplink NAS COUNT parameter.

q_15903.question: What shall the RNC2 do when the Reset Indicator IE is set to "Context Group" in the RESET REQUEST message?
q_15903.ground_truth: The RNC2 shall remove all the indicated UE Contexts and all the radio resources allocated for these UE Contexts for all indicated UE Context Groups identified by the S-RNTI Group IE.

q_15904.question: What does the term "3GPP" in the document stand for?

q_15905.question: If the event which triggered the access attempt was a request from upper layers to establish a new PDU session and the access attempt is barred, what action does 5GMM take?
q_15905.ground_truth: 5GMM shall not initiate the NAS transport procedure to send the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message. Upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, the NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5, if still needed.

q_15906.question: How is the cut-off frequency information sent when the coding mode is INACTIVE, at the lowest bitrate of 7.2 or 8.0 kbit/s?
q_15906.ground_truth: Only 1 bit is used to send the cut-off frequency information in this case.

q_15907.question: What event triggers the charging event in the 5G ProSe Direct Communication for PC5 QoS Flow Based Charging?
q_15907.ground_truth: The Received Direct Communication Usage Report event for a Broadcast, Groupcast or Unicast Direct Communication is triggered by the 5G-DDNMF receiving a usage information report from the UE over PC5.

q_15908.question: What is the procedure for finding the nearest neighbor in the RE8 lattice?
q_15908.ground_truth: The procedure for finding the nearest neighbor in the RE8 lattice involves rounding the components of the input vector to the nearest integer, then adjusting one component at a time to ensure that the sum of the components is an integer multiple of 4, and finally selecting the nearest neighbor from two possible lattice points.

q_15909.question: What is the purpose of the ROHC-Max-CID AVP in the TMGI-Allocation-Response AVP?
q_15909.ground_truth: The ROHC-Max-CID AVP, if included in the TMGI-Allocation-Response AVP, specifies the maximum number of concurrent ROHC identifiers (CIDs) for an MBMS bearer.

q_15910.question: What is required in the SIP URI of the controllee UE for media transfer between two controllee UEs?
q_15910.ground_truth: The SIP URI of the controllee UE needs to be a GRUU if the controllee UE and any other UEs share the same public user identity.

q_15911.question: How is the convolution between the glottal-shape codebook entry and the impulse response computed in the first step of the algorithm?
q_15911.ground_truth: The convolution is computed by first calculating the convolution between the glottal-shape codebook entry for a specific position and the impulse response. The convolution is then shifted to the right by one with a zero added at the beginning for the following rows.

q_15912.question: When applying FEC protection, what does the BM-SC use for the FEC scheme?
q_15912.ground_truth: When applying FEC protection, the BM-SC uses the MBMS FEC scheme as specified by section 8.2.2. The FEC protection covers UDP payload and can be applied in both the forward only and the proxy modes of the Transparent delivery method.

q_15913.question: What should the UE do when it enters a different RRC state, in terms of cell reselection?
q_15913.ground_truth: The UE should consider the priorities provided by dedicated signaling and the remaining validity time of T320 when selecting a cell in the new RRC state.

q_15914.question: In the context of adding media to another controllee UE, what is the purpose of the "Referred-By" header field in the SIP REFER request?
q_15914.ground_truth: The "Referred-By" header field in the SIP REFER request contains a currently registered public user identity of the user.

q_15915.question: What is one of the characteristics of the downlink peak spectral efficiency in LTE-Advanced?
q_15915.ground_truth: The downlink peak spectral efficiency in LTE-Advanced is already fulfilled in LTE Rel-8, and further improved performance can be achieved by using additional technology features such as downlink 8-layer spatial multiplexing.

q_15916.question: What does the `r12:appComponent` child element of the `deliveryMethod` element indicate?
q_15916.ground_truth: The `r12:appComponent` child element of the `deliveryMethod` element identifies the application content component(s) carried on the MBMS delivery session associated with that deliveryMethod instance. It indicates the number and types of application content component(s) carried on the corresponding delivery session. The collection of `r12:appComponent` attribute names across all deliveryMethod instances of an MBMS User Service represents the complete set of application content components available to the MBMS application affiliated with that MBMS User Service.

q_15917.question: What is the action taken when a UE receives a recommended PLMN list and all the recommended PLMNs are not available?
q_15917.ground_truth: In such cases, the UE will switch to limited service state.

q_15918.question: When is a PDCP status report for the DAPS bearer sent by the UE during an inter-frequency DAPS handover?
q_15918.ground_truth: A PDCP status report for the DAPS bearer is sent by the UE when the upper layer requests an uplink data switching or when the associated RLC entity is released for a radio bearer.

q_15919.question: How does the dual eye buffer model differ from the single eye buffer model in terms of packet arrival?
q_15919.ground_truth: In the dual eye buffer model, the left and right eye frames arrive separately with a time offset, which makes the arrival process effectively equivalent to have two times of frame rates and half mean packet size of that of single eye buffer model.

q_15920.question: What are the requirements for the UserUserService operation when activating UUS3 during call establishment?
q_15920.ground_truth: When activating UUS3 during call establishment, the MS A shall include Facility information element with UserUserService operation in an Invoke component indicating UUS3 in the SETUP message. The UserUserService operation shall also indicate whether the service is "UUS required" or "UUS not required".

q_15921.question: What must the DRNS do if the Multiflow Information IE is present in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message in FDD?
q_15921.ground_truth: The DRNS must setup the requested Multiflow operation.

q_15922.question: When could the UE determine the need to terminate the periodic location procedure if it moves out of coverage of the PLMN(s) in which the location reports are allowed?
q_15922.ground_truth: The UE may determine the need for termination if it is unable to instigate an MO-LR TTTP request for some period of time (e.g. some multiple of the required periodic location interval).

q_15923.question: What is the role of the SGW-C in the Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
q_15923.ground_truth: The SGW-C is responsible for providing the functionality of the SGW, except for the functions performed by the SGW-U, and for selecting and controlling the SGW-U.

q_15924.question: What should a UE do if the last running Tsor-cm timer for any PDU session or service stops or expires and the UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode but has not obtained service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN?
q_15924.ground_truth: The UE shall perform the deregistration procedure that releases all the established PDU sessions and services, if any, and once the UE enters idle mode it shall attempt to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN as specified in clause~4.4.3.3 by acting as if timer T that controls periodic attempts has expired or as specified in clause~4.9.3.

q_15925.question: What type of frames are classified as the INACTIVE CLASS and used only in the decoder?
q_15925.ground_truth: The INACTIVE CLASS comprises all inactive frames and it is used in the decoder to indicate the lack of speech activity in the signal.

q_15926.question: What should the MS use to indicate the codec mode of the looped back frame when it is not generating or sending codec mode requests?
q_15926.ground_truth: All in band signalling fields (Uplink CMI and CMR)

q_15927.question: In which section of the report does the 3GPP clarify the definition and measurement point of the Quality of Experience?
q_15927.ground_truth: Section 4.1 provides the 3GPP's definition and exact E2E measurement point of Quality of Experience (QoE).

q_15928.question: What should a SMLC do when it does not have any of the requested RIT information?
q_15928.ground_truth: The SMLC sends a RIT Query Error with the indication 'No RIT Information'.

q_15929.question: How many neighbouring cells should be included in the measResultNeighCells when available?
q_15929.ground_truth: At most, 6 intra-frequency and 3 inter-frequency neighbours per frequency, as well as 3 inter-RAT neighbours, per frequency/set of frequencies per RAT should be included in the measResultNeighCells.

q_15930.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what does the Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) work on?
q_15930.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between multiple standards organizations to create specifications for mobile communication systems, and TSG-RAN is a group within 3GPP that focuses on the radio access network technology.

q_15931.question: What action does the SGW take when it receives packets from an old Gn/Gp SGSN after receiving the reserved TEID and IP address parameters from the new SGSN?
q_15931.ground_truth: The SGW discards any packets received from old Gn/Gp SGSN.

q_15932.question: What are the two different filter bandwidths used in the transmitter shaping pulses to determine the performance impact of shaping filter?
q_15932.ground_truth: The two different filter bandwidths used in the transmitter shaping pulses are 240 kHz and 325 kHz.

q_15933.question: What should the MBSF do when transitioning into the DEACTIVATNG state?
q_15933.ground_truth: The MBSF should follow the deactivation procedure described in steps 4a to 4d to transition into the DEACTIVATNG state.

q_15934.question: What are the functions provided by the Logical Link Management Entity (LLME) in the LLC sublayer?
q_15934.ground_truth: The LLME manages the resources that have an impact on individual connections, and it provides the following functions: parameter initialisation, error processing, and connection flow control invocation.

q_15935.question: What is the expected response status code when attempting to read the NRM root resource?

q_15936.question: What message does the GANC receive to signal the need for handover to the CN and send a GA-RRC RELOCATION COMMAND message to the MS?

q_15937.question: What is not permitted to be included if the IE GAN PLMN List is included?
q_15937.ground_truth: If the IE GAN PLMN List is included, it is not permitted to include the Serving GANC-SEGW IP address, Serving GANC-SEGW FQDN, Serving GANC IP address, Serving GANC FQDN, and Serving GANC TCP port number.

q_15938.question: What is the positioning mechanism that uses measurements in the MS of the Enhanced Observed Time Difference of arrival of bursts of nearby pairs of BTSs?
q_15938.ground_truth: Enhanced Observed Time Difference (E-OTD) positioning mechanism

q_15939.question: What is the purpose of the Surplus redistribution process in TCQ quantization?
q_15939.ground_truth: The Surplus redistribution process is used to handle the surplus when the number of non-zero positions is not controlled by the scaling and redistribution operations.

q_15940.question: What must the H-GMLC do if the location request contains a pseudonym of the target UE?
q_15940.ground_truth: The H-GMLC shall use the pseudonym of the target UE in the location response to the R-GMLC or the LCS client.

q_15941.question: What should the T-gNB do if the UE's ongoing or re-mapped/fallback slice(s) is rejected based on the slice re-mapping policy?
q_15941.ground_truth: The T-gNB shall include the further re-mapped/fallback decision in the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message to the AMF.

q_15942.question: In what ways can service interaction be improved by using GUP mechanisms?
q_15942.ground_truth: By allowing services to access user data through GUP mechanisms, users or operators can allow certain services to access user data from other services, enabling better personalization and integration of services.

q_15943.question: What is required to support converged charging for 5G VN group communication, including unicast, broadcast and multicast communication?
q_15943.ground_truth: REQ-3GPPCH-VNC-01 states that the 5G system should support converged charging for 5G VN group communication, including the unicast, broadcast and multicast communication.

q_15944.question: What information is sent by the SGSN to GGSN in the Create MBMS Context Request message?
q_15944.ground_truth: The SGSN sends the Create MBMS Context Request message to the GGSN with information such as MSISDN, IMSI, End User Address, Access Point Name, and SGSN Address for control plane.

q_15945.question: What error indication message is used to inform that some error has been detected in the originating node and is sent in the direction of both WT and eNB?

q_15946.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits of the version numbering system used in 3GPP Technical Specifications?
q_15946.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the maturity level of the document, while the second digit represents the level of technical enhancements, corrections, or updates made to the document.

q_15947.question: What are the two subtypes of WVG objects supported in the WVG graphical primitive?
q_15947.ground_truth: The two subtypes of WVG objects supported in the WVG graphical primitive are the Standard WVG object and the Character Size WVG object.

q_15948.question: What should the GANC do when it receives the GA-RRC RELEASE REQUEST message from the MS, indicating that the MS needs to release the GA-RRC connection and signaling connection to a particular CN domain?
q_15948.ground_truth: The GANC should request the selected CN domain to release the Iu connection for the MS, including all active RABs for that domain.

q_15949.question: How do the UEs negotiate the individual Unicast PC5 DRXs in a Unicast Link communication?
q_15949.ground_truth: The individual Unicast PC5 DRXs of two UEs are negotiated in one procedure, which is initiated by the UE that triggers the PC5 signalling procedure. When the Unicast PC5 DRX of one UE needs to be updated, the Rx UE initiates the update procedure toward the other UE.

q_15950.question: When cannot voice services be guaranteed to be available for mobile terminated calls in the Mobility Management back-off timer?
q_15950.ground_truth: It cannot be guaranteed that voice services will be available for mobile terminated calls while the Mobility Management back-off timer is running.

q_15951.question: What must be guaranteed in the channel emulator method to ensure proper amplitude distribution?
q_15951.ground_truth: The number of fixed positions and emulator states must be at least enough to guarantee the proper amplitude distribution.

q_15952.question: What procedure can be used to obtain TRP estimate when antenna symmetries are compatible with pattern multiplication?
q_15952.ground_truth: The two-cuts with pattern multiplication method (clause~6.3.2.2.2) can be used to obtain TRP estimate when antenna symmetries are compatible with pattern multiplication.

q_15953.question: What should the MME do if the TAU Request contains a higher priority NAS algorithm?
q_15953.ground_truth: The MME shall run a NAS security mode command procedure to change the NAS algorithms.

q_15954.question: What is the difference between OPLMNs and UPLMNs in the context of network selection in a UE?
q_15954.ground_truth: OPLMNs are Operator Controlled PLMN selectors, meaning the UE will prioritize registering to these networks when they are not available in the User Controlled PLMN selector list. UPLMNs, on the other hand, are User Controlled PLMN selectors, which the UE prioritizes before the OPLMNs in the list.

q_15955.question: What is the maximum number of RLs in the RL-Information-RL-ReconfPrepTDD sequence?
q_15955.ground_truth: The maximum number of RLs in the RL-Information-RL-ReconfPrepTDD sequence is "maxNrOfRLs".

q_15956.question: In what cases cannot a solution handle the transfer of MM/SM-Contexts?
q_15956.ground_truth: A solution cannot handle the transfer of MM/SM-Contexts in cases 2.a.i, 2.a.ii, and 2.b.i (for Legacy UEs) as far as transferring of MM/SM-Contexts from old-AMF is concerned. However, in these cases, the solution allows the UE to get registered in the Target-AMF without the risk of running into an infinite loop of trying-and-failing to register.

q_15957.question: What is the effect of a new Ub bootstrapping procedure in the IdP storage?
q_15957.ground_truth: If a new Ub bootstrapping procedure was executed since the last contact between UE and IdP/BSF, the new temporary GBA related data is stored in the IdP storage as the IdP is also a BSF.

q_15958.question: What are the key aspects of the use case for 5MBS in the context of external hybrid service?
q_15958.ground_truth: The key aspects of the use case for 5MBS in the context of external hybrid service include service provisioning, enabling ingest, announcing and discovering the service, dynamically monitoring and switching on/off the service reception, expecting sufficient information to switch across delivery methods, and consuming media received on different delivery systems jointly.

q_15959.question: What condition must be met for the access attempt to be considered as allowed when one or more Access Identities are indicated and for a specific Access Identity the corresponding bit in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity is set to zero?
q_15959.ground_truth: The establishment of the RRC connection must be the result of release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication.

q_15960.question: What does the MSC-S switched call success rate KPI measure?
q_15960.ground_truth: The MSC-S switched call success rate KPI describes the ratio of the number of successful calls for MSC-S originating traffic and successful incoming calls from a given MSC-S to the number of attempted calls for MSC-S acknowledged for originating traffic and incoming calls from MSC-S, and is used to evaluate switched call performance.

q_15961.question: What action does the ePDG take after receiving the updated routing rules from the UE and before sending them to the PDN GW?
q_15961.ground_truth: The ePDG sends a Bearer Resource Command message to the PDN GW, which includes the updated routing rules and the default EPS bearer ID.

q_15962.question: In the naming convention, what does "B" stand for in the naming of bursts or blocks where "B0" marks the first burst or block carrying bits from the data block with n = 0 (first data block in the transmission)?
q_15962.ground_truth: "B" in "B0" stands for burst in the naming convention.

q_15963.question: What is the impact of the Service Domain Selection in the mobile terminated calls from the PSTN/CS domain?
q_15963.ground_truth: The Service Domain Selection (SDS) determines whether the mobile terminated call is to be delivered to the CS domain or the IMS in the PSTN/CS domain, giving the operator the ability to choose the best option for each case.

q_15964.question: What is the default handling of an exception condition in the CAMEL system?
q_15964.ground_truth: Default handling of the exception condition includes general actions to ensure that no resources remain inappropriately allocated.

q_15965.question: Who provides the analytics data for management purposes in the MDAS system?
q_15965.ground_truth: The MDAS producer provides the analytics data for management purposes based on the data related to different types of NFs or entities in the network, e.g., data reported from gNB and other core network functions.

q_15966.question: When is TPC-aided channel estimation more beneficial, for CQI or for ACK error rate?
q_15966.ground_truth: The degradation in ACK error rate is smaller for a new slot format with 4 pilot bits than for a new slot format with 5 pilot bits.

q_15967.question: What should be the position of Cell 4 in the OTDOA-NeighbourCellInfoList for Test 1?
q_15967.ground_truth: The position of Cell 4 in the OTDOA-NeighbourCellInfoList is randomly selected to be in the last 8 elements of the sequence for Test 1.

q_15968.question: What should the UE do with the stored rejected NSAAI for the current PLMN when the UICC containing the USIM is removed?
q_15968.ground_truth: The UE should delete the stored rejected NSAAI for the current PLMN when the UICC containing the USIM is removed.

q_15969.question: How are V2X message formats handled in the upper layer for V2X communication?
q_15969.ground_truth: The V2X message formats are handled by upper layer via Session Description Protocol (SDP).

q_15970.question: What are the interfaces used by the BEST service?
q_15970.ground_truth: The BEST service uses various interfaces, including S6a between the HSS and the HSE, EMKS, and UE, as well as BEST-C, BEST-U, EAS-C, and EAS-U between various components.

q_15971.question: What are the implications of installation/activation of one or more ADC rules failing in the TSSF?
q_15971.ground_truth: If the installation/activation of one or more ADC rules fails, the TSSF shall include one or more ADC-Rule-Report AVP(s) in the corresponding TSA command for the affected ADC rules. The TSSF shall identify the failed ADC rule(s) by including the ADC-Rule-Name AVP(s) or ADC-Rule-Base-Name AVP(s), shall identify the failed reason code by including a Rule-Failure-Code AVP, and shall include the PCC-Rule-Status AVP. The PCC-Rule-Status will be set to INACTIVE if the installation/activation of one or more new ADC rules fails.

q_15972.question: What are the three digits in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification and what do they represent?
q_15972.ground_truth: The three digits in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification represent the following: (1) the level of TSG approval, (2) significant technical changes, and (3) editorial changes.

q_15973.question: What procedures should the FA AS perform if CFU is active for the Pilot Identity?
q_15973.ground_truth: The FA AS shall perform the procedures related to CFU prior to executing the FA service. CFU of the FA Pilot Identity takes precedence over CFU of the individual FA members.

q_15974.question: What is the window size (WS) for GPRS in the EGPRS TBF mode?
q_15974.ground_truth: The window size for GPRS in the EGPRS TBF mode is 64.

q_15975.question: What action does the new SGSN take when it receives the Forward Relocation Request message and cannot support the indicated ciphering algorithm?
q_15975.ground_truth: If the new SGSN does not support the indicated ciphering algorithm, it selects a new ciphering algorithm, sends it transparently to the MS, and transfers the IOV-UI parameter used in the ciphering procedure to the MS.

q_15976.question: What attribute indicates whether the client is a Higher Granularity CVO capable receiver of 3GP files?

q_15977.question: What is the format of the public user identity in the context of the IMS service level tracing management object?
q_15977.ground_truth: The format of the public user identity is defined by 3GPP TS 23.003, which typically includes the SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) address, starting with "sip:" and followed by the user identity in the form of username@domain.

q_15978.question: What is the difference between the second and third version number digit in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_15978.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc. while the third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document.

q_15979.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a new TAI list during a mobility registration update procedure?
q_15979.ground_truth: The UE should delete its old TAI list and store the received TAI list.

q_15980.question: What is the purpose of the Bj variable in the Logical channel prioritization procedure?
q_15980.ground_truth: The Bj variable is used to maintain a priority for each logical channel, which is initialized to zero when the logical channel is established and incremented before every instance of the LCP procedure. The value of Bj can be greater than the bucket size, in which case it is set to the bucket size.

q_15981.question: What are the two integer values used to represent the mean number of OVSF codes used in the downlink of a UTRAN cell?
q_15981.ground_truth: The two integer values used are "TCR.DLMeanCodeResUsed.SF1" and "TCR.DLMeanCodeResUsed.SF16".

q_15982.question: What is the UE's behavior after receiving network slices incompatibility attributes per allowed S-NSSAI?
q_15982.ground_truth: The UE shall not attempt to establish or request user resources for simultaneous PDU sessions on network slices identified as incompatible based on the received attributes.

q_15983.question: What is the purpose of the RNSAP Common Transport Channel Resources Initialisation Request message in 7.18.3?
q_15983.ground_truth: The RNSAP Common Transport Channel Resources Initialisation Request message is used by the SRNC to setup a common channel for the UE via DRNC and obtain the C-RNTI needed for RRC messages.

q_15984.question: What are the two components of the Network Identifier (NID)?
q_15984.ground_truth: The two components of the Network Identifier (NID) are the Operator- (NO/AN/SP) identifier and the Network Element Identifier (NEID). The Operator- (NO/AN/SP) identifier uniquely identifies the network operator, access network provider, or service provider, while the Network Element Identifier (NEID) uniquely identifies the relevant network element carrying out the LI operations.

q_15985.question: How does the network ensure that a UE attaches to the same core network operator from which it detached in a shared network?
q_15985.ground_truth: The UE stores information about the core network operator it detached from in the UE (e.g. on the SIM/USIM). This information is used when the UE reattaches to the network to ensure that it attaches to the same core network operator from which it detached. For non-supporting UEs, the stored information indicates the common PLMN, which allows them to attach to the correct network.

q_15986.question: What is an Iub HS-DSCH Data Port in the UTRAN network?
q_15986.ground_truth: An Iub HS-DSCH Data Port represents a user plane bearer carrying one Iub HS-DSCH Data Streams between the Node B and the RNC.

q_15987.question: What are some areas that the channel model should cover in terms of coupling loss and UT mobility?
q_15987.ground_truth: The channel model should cover a range of coupling loss considering current typical cell sizes, such as km-range macro cells, and should accommodate UT mobility with mobile speeds up to 500 km/h.

q_15988.question: What is the structure of the Schedule Message in SMSCB?
q_15988.ground_truth: A Schedule Message consists of 4 consecutive blocks with Block Types "first schedule block", "second block", "third block" and "fourth block", containing a 2-octet header followed by three parts, the first of them of 6 octets, and the two others of variable length.

q_15989.question: What is the role of the 2G+3G-SGSN when resuming traffic flow in acknowledged mode SNDCP between the 2G+3G-SGSN and the SRNS?
q_15989.ground_truth: The 2G+3G-SGSN tunnels N-PDUs that were already sent to the MS in acknowledged mode SNDCP and have not been acknowledged by the MS to the SRNS.

q_15990.question: What is the Distant RNC Context in the context of RNSAP protocol?
q_15990.ground_truth: The Distant RNC context is created by the first Common Measurement Initiation Procedure or Information Exchange Initiation Procedure initiated by one RNC/BSS and requested from another RNC/BSS. It is deleted after the Common Measurement Termination, the Common Measurement Failure, the Information Exchange Termination or the Information Exchange Failure procedure when there is no more Common Measurement and no more Information to be provided by the requested RNC/BSS to the requesting RNC/BSS.

q_15991.question: What should the Node B include in the HS-DSCH Initial Capacity Allocation IE if it allows the CRNC to start the transmission of MAC-d PDUs for the Priority Queue(s) being established before the Node B has allocated user plane capacity?
q_15991.ground_truth: The Node B should include the HS-DSCH Initial Capacity Allocation IE for every HS-DSCH MAC-d flow being modified for which the establishment of one or several new Priority Queues was requested.

q_15992.question: What is the maximum allowed test tolerance for co-location out-of-band blocking?
q_15992.ground_truth: The maximum allowed test tolerance for co-location out-of-band blocking is zero decibels (dB).

q_15993.question: What should be done if the UE is unable to read the SFN of the reference cell in the "UE positioning GPS reference time" or "UE positioning acquisition assistance"?
q_15993.ground_truth: Set "Error reason" to "Reference Cell Not Serving Cell".

q_15994.question: What are the examples provided for short message processing?
q_15994.ground_truth: The VAS-SMS should be able to insert content, compile an SM, and use certain words in an SM as the filtering criteria. Additionally, the VAS-SMS should be able to convert the format of an SM into other formats (e.g. email, WAP message, etc).

q_15995.question: What is the purpose of the Single Stream MIMO Capability IE in the information element for local cells that are Single Stream MIMO capable when operating in FDD mode?
q_15995.ground_truth: The Single Stream MIMO Capability IE is included in the information element for local cells that are Single Stream MIMO capable. This indicates that the local cell can support Single Stream MIMO.

q_15996.question: What measures should be taken to determine a more fine-grained UE location for Lawful Interception?
q_15996.ground_truth: Additional positioning may be needed in order to determine a more fine-grained UE location, particularly if cells can cover a large area and the NG-RAN can verify that the UE has selected a PLMN in the country where the UE is located.

q_15997.question: What are the code sets used in Cases 1 and 2 for SCH code allocation?
q_15997.ground_truth: In Case 1, the code sets used for SCH code allocation are Code set 1 and Code set 2. In Case 2, the code sets used for SCH code allocation are Code set 1, Code set 2, Code set 3, and Code set 4.

q_15998.question: What should the Node B do in FDD if the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message includes the Serving Grant Value IE and Primary/Secondary Grant Selector IE for the initial grant for the serving E-DCH RL?
q_15998.ground_truth: The Node B may include the Serving Grant Value IE and Primary/Secondary Grant Selector IE in the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message for the initial grant for the serving E-DCH RL.

q_15999.question: What are the three modes defined in the present document for controlling SMS functions in a GSM/UMTS mobile telephone?
q_15999.ground_truth: The three modes are "Block Mode", "Text Mode", and "PDU Mode".

q_16000.question: What shall the IP-SM-GW send to the sender of an Instant Message if none of its contents could be interworked to a Short Message?
q_16000.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW sends a SIP 415 (Unsupported Media Type) response and also includes an Accept header field listing the types of text media supported by SM.

q_16001.question: What is the effect of entering 2 followed by SEND when there is a waiting call within the timeout period?
q_16001.ground_truth: The current call is held and the waiting call is accepted.

q_16002.question: What is the information included in the EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.1A?
q_16002.ground_truth: EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.1 includes the following information: Location status (normal service), MCC & MNC (001110), LAC (0001), and Cell ID (0001).

q_16003.question: What action does MSC-A take if the A-HO-DETECT/COMPLETE is received from MSC-B when the circuit between MSC-A and MSC-B has been established?
q_16003.ground_truth: MSC-A generates an answer signal, MSC-B releases the Handover Number and through-connects the circuit in MSC-A when the A-HO-DETECT or the A-HO-COMPLETE is received from MSC-B.

q_16004.question: What is the potential issue with using the B1 filter for rejecting CH36 in the n71 band?
