q_16004.ground_truth: Despite the B1 filter being technically feasible for rejecting CH36 in the n71 band, there is a potential increase in In-band Rx insertion loss, which can affect the overall performance of the filter design.

q_16005.question: What is the role of the 5G DDNMF in the user plane architecture of this solution?
q_16005.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF allocates the Prose APP code and gets the discovery root key from AAnF in the user plane architecture. It further generates discovery IK for open discovery and discovery IK and CK for restricted discovery.

q_16006.question: How many different speech codecs were tested for transparency to DTMF tones in the AMR codec mode tests?
q_16006.ground_truth: Nine different speech codecs were tested, including eight AMR modes and the full-rate GSM speech codec.

q_16007.question: What is the role of the RPT and NM in the context of RPTA IRP?
q_16007.ground_truth: The RPT is a Service Provider (SP) and the NM is a Service Consumer (SC) in the context of RPTA IRP.

q_16008.question: What does LLGMM-RESUME-REQ do in the context of an LLC suspended operation for an MS?
q_16008.ground_truth: LLGMM-RESUME-REQ orders LLC to resume a suspended operation for an MS, and the operation continues with the current set of buffered L3-PDUs, buffered unacknowledged I-frames, the state, and the state variables.

q_16009.question: When should a UE monitor paging occasion for SI modifications and/or PWS notifications in a L2 U2N Relay UE?
q_16009.ground_truth: A L2 U2N Remote UE is not required to monitor paging occasion for SI modifications and/or PWS notifications. It obtains the updated system information and SIB6/7/8 from the connected L2 U2N Relay UE.

q_16010.question: What action should the GGSN take if it receives an MBMS Session Stop Response with a Cause value other than "Request accepted"?
q_16010.ground_truth: If the Cause value is not "Request accepted", the procedure has not been successful, and the GGSN will no longer forward T-PDU for this MBMS context.

q_16011.question: What are the potential issues with using UC user feedback in Single Radio VCC, IMS Service Continuity, and IMS Centralized Services?
q_16011.ground_truth: The potential issues are that user feedback mechanisms may not be feasible during a call if the user transfers to a different access, which may result in a different end-user experience and capabilities depending on the access currently being used.

q_16012.question: What occurs when online charging is used for an application that is under charging control?
q_16012.ground_truth: The TDF allows the application's traffic to pass through it if and only if the OCS has authorized the applicable credit with that Charging key.

q_16013.question: What is the measurement type MM.AttInterVlrLU in the context of 4G/5G networks?
q_16013.ground_truth: This measurement type represents the number of attempted inter-VLR location updates in 4G/5G networks.

q_16014.question: What should be done to prevent HFN desynchronization problem when discarding or transmitting SDUs without acknowledgement in the PDCP sublayer?
q_16014.ground_truth: The prevention of the HFN desynchronization problem is left up to the implementation of the user equipment (UE).

q_16015.question: How many MUSHRA experiments were conducted in the ST-HR series of tests to characterize the intrinsic performance of one of the two 3GPP Release 6 audio codecs?
q_16015.ground_truth: Three MUSHRA experiments were conducted in the ST-HR series of tests.

q_16016.question: What is the performance requirement of DCH in static propagation conditions, as defined in clause 8.2.1.1?
q_16016.ground_truth: The performance requirement of DCH in static propagation conditions is determined by the maximum Block Error Ratio (BLER) allowed when the receiver input signal is at a specified Eb/N0 limit.

q_16017.question: What is the definition of a Diameter Multimedia client in the context of the 3GPP standards?
q_16017.ground_truth: A Diameter Multimedia client in the context of the 3GPP standards is a client that implements the Diameter Multimedia application. It is one of the communicating Diameter peers that usually initiates transactions.

q_16018.question: How can the user terminate the dialogue with a null response in network initiated USSD operation?
q_16018.ground_truth: The user can terminate the dialogue with a null response in network initiated USSD operation by providing an MMI command to allow the user to terminate the dialogue.

q_16019.question: What should the MS do upon receiving a PS (Packet Switched) paging request from the SGSN (Serving GPRS Support Node) for GAN (Generic Access Network) registered MS?
q_16019.ground_truth: Upon receiving a GA-PSR-PS-PAGE message from the GANC, the MS GA-PSR shall forward the indication to the GMM layer using the GMMRR SAP as per standard GPRS. Subsequently, the MS shall send an uplink LLC PDU as a page response per standard GPRS and send GA-PSR-DATA or GA-PSR-UNITDATA message to the GANC. The GANC processes the message as any other GPRS signalling/SMS or user data message, the processing of uplink GPRS signalling messages is described in sub-clause 8.8 and for uplink GPRS data messages in sub-clause 8.7.

q_16020.question: What action should be performed if no new security key set has been received and ciphering on signalling radio bearers using RLC-AM and RLC-UM in the downlink needs to be activated in step 5?
q_16020.ground_truth: Set the 20 most significant bits of the HFN component of the downlink COUNT-C to the value "START" in the most recently transmitted IE "START list" or IE "START" at the reception of the SECURITY MODE COMMAND for each signalling radio bearer.

q_16021.question: What is the role of NEF/CAPIF in determining user consent for processing personal data in 3GPP service exposure?
q_16021.ground_truth: NEF/CAPIF determines whether the service invoked needs to check user consent based on the operator's local policy. If user consent is required, it invokes the Nudm_SDM_Get Request service to retrieve related user consent parameters from the UDM.

q_16022.question: In which namespace is the groupFilterType complex type defined in the provided XML schema?
q_16022.ground_truth: The groupFilterType complex type is defined in the urn:3gpp:metadata:2013:MBMS:filterDescription namespace in the provided XML schema.

q_16023.question: What is the role of the adaptive gain control (AGC) in the post-processing of the shaped excitation?
q_16023.ground_truth: The adaptive gain control (AGC) is applied to compensate for any gain difference between the synthesized speech signal and the post-filtered signal, with the gain scaling factor calculated for each subframe using equation (735) and the post-processed shaped excitation being given by equation (736).

q_16024.question: Which two functions are required for the default SCR mechanism described in the document?
q_16024.ground_truth: A Voice Activity Detector (VAD) on the transmit side and evaluation of background acoustic noise on the transmit side are required for the default SCR mechanism.

q_16025.question: What is the purpose of using a reference antenna with standard gain during the calibration of a test range in a compact probe?
q_16025.ground_truth: The purpose is to measure the path loss between the reference antenna and the measurement equipment, which helps to ensure the accuracy of the EIRP measurement.

q_16026.question: What does the SGSN include in the RA-CAPABILITY-UPDATE-ACK PDU when it does not have the RA capability or IMSI available for the MS and replies to the request?
q_16026.ground_truth: The SGSN replies with a RA-CAPABILITY-UPDATE-ACK PDU in which the RA-CAP-UPD-Cause is set to: "no RA capability or IMSI available".

q_16027.question: What is the additional cost for each PDSCH or PUSCH assigned to a PUSCH or PDSCH set, if it is not the first PDSCH or PUSCH assigned to any user in a cell within a timeslot?

q_16028.question: What is the function of the N3IWF in Solution #34?
q_16028.ground_truth: The N3IWF in Solution #34 provides a mechanism for the remote UE to access a specific network slice or a DN that requires secondary authentication by establishing an IPsec connection with the N3IWF. It also performs slice-specific authentication and secondary authentication procedures via the N3IWF.

q_16029.question: What is the test purpose in 9.3.12.2.1 and 9.3.13.1?
q_16029.ground_truth: The test purpose in 9.3.12.2.1 is to verify that the RSTD measurement accuracy for UE Category M2 is within the specified limits in enhanced coverage mode in an environment with fading propagation conditions. The test purpose in 9.3.13.1 is to verify that the RSTD measurement reporting delay with longer PRS occasions for UE Category M1 and M2 meets the performance requirements in normal coverage mode in an environment with fading propagation conditions.

q_16030.question: What is the expected HTTP status code when the file repair server uses the HTTP response status code 302 (Found - Redirection) to indicate a redirect to the broadcast/multicast delivery?

q_16031.question: What message does the eNodeB send to the MME when it knows that both the UE and the network support PS handover?
q_16031.ground_truth: The eNodeB sends an S1-AP UE Context Modification Request message to the MME indicating that the UE should be moved to UTRAN/GERAN.

q_16032.question: What is the packet error ratio requirement for the wireless transmission of the on-site live audio presentation?
q_16032.ground_truth: The packet error ratio of the wireless transmission needs to be kept lower than 10-5.

q_16033.question: What is the recommended solution for the ingest of 5MBS User Service related in-band ancillary information in the existing xMB-C API?
q_16033.ground_truth: It is recommended that the 5MBS version of xMB-C (Nmbsf) should be evolved to include this support.

q_16034.question: What is the objective of using MDA in slice coverage optimization?
q_16034.ground_truth: The objective of using MDA is to translate the business slice coverage to the actual radio deployment without overprovisioning, while leveraging the benefits of flexible gNB radio features adjustment.

q_16035.question: What should the REGISTRATION REQUEST sent to the NG-SS contain in order to meet the acceptance criteria in 5.3.16.5?
q_16035.ground_truth: The REGISTRATION REQUEST sent to the NG-SS should contain the following: SUPI format = 0, Home Network Identifier = 246/081, Routing indicator = 01, Protection scheme id = 01, Home network public key Id = 30, and Scheme output = ECC ephemeral public key, encryption of 357935793 and MAC tag value.

q_16036.question: What is the purpose of timer T200 in the context of multiple frame operation in data link layer procedures?
q_16036.ground_truth: Timer T200 is used to take appropriate recovery action if a data link layer entity does not receive a single I-frame or the last I-frame(s) in a sequence of I-frames due to a transmission error.

q_16037.question: What is the role of the "User consent Related Data Coordination Functionality" (URDCF)?
q_16037.ground_truth: The URDCF tracks the distribution and usage of user related information and takes care to inform all entities having received a copy of the UE/user related data and UE related Output Analytics about the updated or revoked user consent. If the user consent is updated/revoked, the URDCF will request them to delete the data if the data is no longer covered by the user consent.

q_16038.question: What is the primary purpose of the jitter buffer in a voice call over a mobile network?
q_16038.ground_truth: The jitter buffer is used to delay the playback of the first frame of speech burst, accumulating the target delay for buffering. This allows for variances in packet arrival times and ensures smooth playback of the voice call.

q_16039.question: What is the major challenge in implementing Solution B to counter the PWS Security circumvention attack?
q_16039.ground_truth: The major challenge is securely determining the regulatory domain and verifying the current location independently, as any further information received from the network could be from the attacking network.

q_16040.question: What should the network do if N3105 equals N3105max when a control message is received?
q_16040.ground_truth: The network should release the downlink TBF internally and start timer T3195 for that TBF.

q_16041.question: What does the "Flags in RACH DATA FRAME" field in the RACH DATA FRAME indicate?
q_16041.ground_truth: The "Flags in RACH DATA FRAME" field in the RACH DATA FRAME indicates if a Cell Portion ID is present (1) or not present (0) in the byte following the New IE Flags IE.

q_16042.question: What is the unit used for the measurements GTP.OutSigOct.Bgrd, GTP.OutSigOct.Conv, GTP.OutSigOct.Intact, and GTP.OutSigOct.Strm?

q_16043.question: What is the function in the PLMN that receives the Push Data from the Push initiator and is responsible for delivering the push data to the Push recipient?

q_16044.question: What is the purpose of the File Transfer Integration Reference Point (FT IRP) as defined in 3GPP TS 32.341?
q_16044.ground_truth: The File Transfer Integration Reference Point (FT IRP) is used to specify the requirements for exchanging different types of management information files, such as performance measurement results and test results, between Network Elements (NEs), Element Managers (EMs), and Network Managers (NMs) over the Itf-N interface.

q_16045.question: What is the standard general-purpose mechanism for the management of logs containing selected notifications from the network, as defined in the TS 32.33x-series?

q_16046.question: What is the purpose of the present document?
q_16046.ground_truth: The present document specifies implementors' test data for the A5/3 and GEA3 specification.

q_16047.question: In which scenarios is the Access Class of the special categories valid in the NB-IoT network?
q_16047.ground_truth: The Access Class of the special categories is only valid in the HPLMN or HPLMN country.

q_16048.question: Which 3GPP Technical Specifications are referenced in defining the terms and definitions for the present document?

q_16049.question: What is the role of the targeted MSGin5G Client and/or Application Client on the UE in MSGin5G Service?
q_16049.ground_truth: The targeted MSGin5G Client and/or Application Client on the UE listens on its respective port number and receives the access network trigger request. It then parses the payload of the access network trigger request which contains the Trigger Purpose and performs the corresponding actions based on the Trigger Purpose.

q_16050.question: When is the usage of association (shared secret) advisable in OpenID Authentication?
q_16050.ground_truth: If the OP and RP do not both reside under the control of the same MNO, the usage of this option seems advisable.

q_16051.question: What should an IP-SM-GW do if it receives a Chat Session teardown request as a SIP BYE request that is to be delivered as a Short Message and SMS over IP is the highest priority for delivery attempts?
q_16051.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW should attempt to deliver the Chat Session teardown request as SMS over IP, and if successful, skip subsequent steps.

q_16052.question: What is the utilization of timeslots for the VoIP service in a 10ms TTI?
q_16052.ground_truth: The VoIP service has, on average, a utilization of approximately 0.72 timeslots for C/I of 9dB and 0.56 timeslots for C/I of 15dB in a 10ms TTI.

q_16053.question: What is the purpose of studying privacy protection of PDU session-related parameters for relaying in Key Issue #16?
q_16053.ground_truth: The objective is to find means to preserve the privacy of entities and identities while supporting NoN-IP unicast/multicast/broadcast communication between two UEs, and for communication via UE-to-UE and UE-to-Network relays.

q_16054.question: What is the human-readable network name for the second CAG information?
q_16054.ground_truth: The human-readable network name for the second CAG information is "CAG-00000002".

q_16055.question: What is the channel raster for GSM/EDGE and UTRA in Band Category 1, 2, and 3?
q_16055.ground_truth: All Radio Access Technologies (RATs) support a common 200 kHz raster in Band Category 1, 2, and 3.

q_16056.question: What is the expected sequence for the SEND SS proactive command in the UCS2 facility for coding Katakana characters?
q_16056.ground_truth: The expected sequences for the SEND SS proactive command are 6.1A and 6.1B, which represent SEND SS for call forward unconditional, all bearers, successful, and UCS2 text in Katakana.

q_16057.question: How is a location service support established between the originating and terminating sides?
q_16057.ground_truth: The location service support is established by establishing an MM-connection if it does not already exist. On the originating side, the REGISTER message is sent as the first CM-message on the MM-connection, while on the terminating side the location service support is regarded as established as soon as the MM-connection is established.

q_16058.question: In the comparison of uplink bandwidth between HEVC simulcast and SHVC, which of the two options has a lower uplink bandwidth for UE B?
q_16058.ground_truth: SHVC has a lower uplink bandwidth for UE B as it can use early termination and avoid the need for motion estimation, leading to lower encoding complexity.

q_16059.question: What is the process described in this specification called, where a number is transferred between network operators?

q_16060.question: What are the four main areas the 3GPP Technical Specification Group's study on improved end-to-end Quality of Service (QoS) handling for Multimedia Telephony Service for IMS (MTSI) aims to cover?
q_16060.ground_truth: The study aims to identify high-level use cases, evaluate current limitations and expected benefits, establish recommended high-level functional and technical requirements, discuss potential solutions, and study the impact of potential solutions on networks and terminals.

q_16061.question: What is the impact on the logical association when implementing Multi-slot mechanism 2 in HSCSD?
q_16061.ground_truth: The logical association is maintained with bi-directional timeslots when implementing Multi-slot mechanism 2 in HSCSD, as it loops all bi-directional timeslots, and leaves unidirectional slots not looped back.

q_16062.question: What are the supported CAT content types for this service?
q_16062.ground_truth: The CAT service supports the CAT content types of audio, video, image, graphic, text, location, and electronic business card.

q_16063.question: When is the Recovery information element included in the S101 messages used to support interworking between the MME and the non-3GPP access network?
q_16063.ground_truth: The Recovery information element is included if the node is contacting its peer for the first time or if the node has restarted recently and the new Restart Counter value has not yet been indicated to the peer.

q_16064.question: What unit is used to measure the number of symbols in the UTRAN and LTE streaming test cases?

q_16065.question: What procedures are performed in Step 8?
q_16065.ground_truth: Policy and Charging Control procedures are performed in the IMS core to set up relevant bearer Quality of Service (QoS) and charging functions.

q_16066.question: When should the numberOfReportsSent be incremented for a given measId in the VarMeasReportList?
q_16066.ground_truth: The numberOfReportsSent for a given measId should be incremented by 1 every time a MeasurementReport is transmitted for that measId.

q_16067.question: What is the requirement for the ATTACH ACCEPT message when the UE includes T3324 in the ATTACH REQUEST message during eDRX?
q_16067.ground_truth: If the ATTACH REQUEST message includes T3324, the ATTACH ACCEPT message shall contain T3324 set to "deactivated".

q_16068.question: What HTTP status code should be used in the response to a successful symbol-based repair request in 9.3.7.2?
q_16068.ground_truth: The HTTP status code should be set to "200 OK".

q_16069.question: What is the bearer type used in both sequences?

q_16070.question: What is the parameter that defines the number of Random Access Preambles in Random Access Preamble group A for each SSB?

q_16071.question: Which RFC provides the specification for Mobile IPv4 and its modes?

q_16072.question: What is the purpose of the HSS-based P-CSCF restoration mechanism in 5.4 for 3GPP access?
q_16072.ground_truth: The HSS-based P-CSCF restoration mechanism for 3GPP access is an optional mechanism executed when a terminating request cannot be serviced due to a P-CSCF failure in the IMS PDN connection. It consists of a basic mechanism that requests the release of the IMS PDN connection and an optional extension that avoids IMS PDN deactivation and re-activation.

q_16073.question: What is the maximum number of BCD digits that the terminal supports for global phonebook updating?
q_16073.ground_truth: The terminal manufacturer shall specify this value prior to the test execution.

q_16074.question: What is the role of the Access-Network-Charging-Identifier-Value AVP in the Diameter protocol?
q_16074.ground_truth: The Access-Network-Charging-Identifier-Value AVP is used to provide a charging identifier for correlation when installing or modifying QoS rules. This identifier is used by the BBERF for charging correlation.

q_16075.question: What is the role of the Application Function (AF) in the 3GPP REST reference point architecture?
q_16075.ground_truth: The Application Function (AF) is an element that offers applications that use IP bearer resources. It provides session information to the PCRF via the Rx reference point.

q_16076.question: What must the SGSN send to the UE in the Request PDP Context Activation if the End User Address is to be dynamically assigned?

q_16077.question: What should be the security policy in the target UTRAN after handover from E-UTRAN?
q_16077.ground_truth: The security policy in the target UTRAN is determined by the selected algorithms in the UTRAN HO command and the confidentiality protection begins immediately upon UE reception of the UTRAN HO command, while the integrity protection in UTRAN is activated by SMC procedure following the handover from E-UTRAN to UTRAN.

q_16078.question: What is the purpose of the test in 7.3.7.3 to verify that the OPLMN with higher priority takes precedence over the one with lower priority during network selection?
q_16078.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to ensure that the new coding for RAT E-UTRAN in NB-IoT mode and E-UTRAN in WB-S1 mode is handled correctly by the UE during network selection.

q_16079.question: What optional element is present in the SABP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_16079.ground_truth: The "iEsCriticalityDiagnostics" is an optional element of the SABP-PROTOCOL-IES.

q_16080.question: What is the minimum level of requirements defined in the present document for user procedures of call control and supplementary service control?
q_16080.ground_truth: The present document defines a minimum level of requirements for user procedures of call control and supplementary service control, with emphasis on standardized control procedures of access to services such as call establishment and invocation of supplementary services.

q_16081.question: What is the subject of the 3GPP Technical Specification document?
q_16081.ground_truth: The digital test sequences for the Enhanced Voice Services (EVS) Codec, used in conformance testing for various communication technologies.

q_16082.question: Which type is used in the PWS Cancel Response to indicate a list of cells where broadcast cancellation has been completed?
q_16082.ground_truth: The type Cells-Broadcast-Cancelled-List is used in the PWS Cancel Response to indicate a list of cells where broadcast cancellation has been completed.

q_16083.question: What is the test requirement for the TDD intra-frequency RSTD Measurement Accuracy in CE Mode A for Category M1?
q_16083.ground_truth: The test requirement for this test is the same as in clause 9.3.7.1.5, which requires the overall test to pass, and the ratio of successful reported values in each sub-test to be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_16084.question: What is the purpose of the SM-RL-MEMORY-AVAILABLE-REQest service primitive on the MS side?
q_16084.ground_truth: The SM-RL-MEMORY-AVAILABLE-REQest service primitive on the MS side is used to request the establishment of an SM-RL connection for transfer of the notification to the network that the mobile has memory available to receive one or more short messages. It forms the RP-SM-MEMORY-AVAILABLE message and transfer it as an RPDU in an MNSMS-EST-Req.

q_16085.question: What action does the BM-SC take when a UE fails to authenticate for deregistration request?
q_16085.ground_truth: If the authentication fails, the BM-SC Key Request function resends HTTP 401 Authorization required message with the WWW-Authenticate header.

q_16086.question: What is the summation algorithm used for the equipment-related measurements in virtualized IMS NFs?
q_16086.ground_truth: The summation algorithm used for the equipment-related measurements in virtualized IMS NFs is vendor specific.

q_16087.question: What is the expression for the bits of the permuted rectangular matrix, y'k, after intra-row and inter-row permutations and pruning?
q_16087.ground_truth: The expression for the bits of the permuted rectangular matrix, y'k, is the output of the Turbo code internal interleaver that is read out column by column from the intra-row and inter-row permuted RC rectangular matrix starting with bit y'1 in row 0 of column 0 and ending with bit y'CR in row R - 1 of column C - 1. The output is pruned by deleting dummy bits that were padded to the input of the rectangular matrix before intra-row and inter row permutations, i.e. bits y'k that corresponds to bits yk with k > K are removed from the output.

q_16088.question: What should the UE do when it is in SNPN access mode, is in limited service state, supports accessing a PLMN, and needs to make an emergency call with no available SNPN supporting emergency services?
q_16088.ground_truth: The UE should stop operating in SNPN access mode and attempts to camp on a cell of a PLMN so that emergency calls can be made.

q_16089.question: What does the TP-Parameter-Indicator (TP-PI) represent in the SMPP protocol?
q_16089.ground_truth: The TP-Parameter-Indicator is a series of octets that indicate which optional parameters are present in the fields that follow in an RP-ACK, RP-ERROR, or RP-DATA primitive.

q_16090.question: What is the difference between Solutions #4t and #4u for key issue #4b on charging for update of Session with QoS?
q_16090.ground_truth: The difference is that in Solution #4t, the EAS sends the Session with QoS update request to the EES, while in Solution #4u, the EES updates data session with specific QoS with the 3GPP 5G Core Network without receiving a request from the EAS.

q_16091.question: What is the general description of Solution #4.1 in the topic of charging the usage of 5G VN group communication?
q_16091.ground_truth: Solution #4.1 relies on CHF/5G Converged Charging System for total volume and duration of 5G VN group communication charging, and addresses the Key Issue #4.1 by aggregating the volume of the PDU sessions of the membership of the 5G LAN VN Group.

q_16092.question: What is the format of the RAB-Parameters in the 3GPP TS 25.427 standard?
q_16092.ground_truth: The RAB-Parameters is a sequence containing various parameters such as trafficClass, rab-AsymmetryIndicator, maxBitrate, guaranteedBitRate, deliveryOrder, and more.

q_16093.question: What information should be included in the BEGIN record?
q_16093.ground_truth: The BEGIN record should include information about the first event of EPS communication interception, such as successful EPS bearer activation or tunnel establishment, the interception of a target's communications, S-GW relocation, or the target entering an interception area with an active EPS bearer/tunnel.

q_16094.question: What does the first digit of the version number in the present document indicate?
q_16094.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number in the present document indicates the stage of development of the document within 3GPP.

q_16095.question: What are the traffic characteristics that are taken into account in small cell deployment for small cell enhancement?
q_16095.ground_truth: The traffic characteristics that are taken into account are fluctuating traffic and user distribution due to a small number of users per small cell node in a small cell deployment.

q_16096.question: What is the maximum number of symbols for which the UE assumes the same antenna port quasi-collocation parameters after detecting a DCI format with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI or MCS-C-RNTI in the search space set provided by recoverySearchSpaceId?
q_16096.ground_truth: The UE assumes the same antenna port quasi-collocation parameters for a maximum of 28 symbols after detecting a DCI format with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI or MCS-C-RNTI in the search space set provided by recoverySearchSpaceId.

q_16097.question: What should an RTP/RTCP implementation do to announce its conformance to the new specification on the network?
q_16097.ground_truth: The RTP/RTCP implementation should follow the method described in the document for announcing its conformance to the new specification.

q_16098.question: Which components are enhanced with additional functionality to support the new QoS limitations solution?
q_16098.ground_truth: The UPF, SMF, and PCF functions are enhanced with additional functionality to support the new QoS limitations solution.

q_16099.question: What authorization and provisioning does the UE require to become a UE-to-Network Relay or a Remote UE?
q_16099.ground_truth: The UE obtains authorization and provision for UE-to-Network Relay or Remote UE as defined for service authorization solutions, with authorized parameters outlined in clause 6.19.1.1.

q_16101.question: In case the MS has enabled EC operation and supports deferred system information acquisition in EC operation, what should the MS do before determining if cell reselection is possible?
q_16101.ground_truth: The MS should identify non-serving cells based on provided broadcast frequencies assigned to the IMM Cell Group and on BSIC for cells contained in the IMM Cell Group definition, synchronize to cells with these BCCH frequencies and read the EC-SCH content in two consecutive EC-SCH messages sent over 8*51-multiframes.

q_16102.question: What is the scope of the present document as per the 3GPP TS 32.366 V14.0.0?
q_16102.ground_truth: The present document specifies the Solution Set definitions for the IRP whose semantics are specified in the Entry Point IRP: Information Service (3GPP TS 32.362). This Solution Set definitions specification is related to 3GPP TS 32.362 V14.0.0.

q_16103.question: What is the role of the AMF in notifying the UE of a disaster condition that has impacted the 3GPP access?
q_16103.ground_truth: The AMF can notify the UE over the non-3GPP access about a disaster condition that has impacted the 3GPP access, optionally provide a list of target PLMNs, a "wait timer", and an "expected duration of disaster".

q_16104.question: In the context of the present document, what does the term "AGGREGATED CHANNEL BANDWIDTH" refer to?
q_16104.ground_truth: The term "AGGREGATED CHANNEL BANDWIDTH" refers to the RF bandwidth in which a UE transmits and receives multiple contiguously aggregated carriers.

q_16105.question: What is the role of the Network Common library in the WAP Telephony API?
q_16105.ground_truth: The Network Common library includes functions that are available in all networks, such as advanced call control, phonebook access, and sending and reading network text (SMS) messages.

q_16106.question: What should the intermediate node do if a Single Codec information element for an AMR codec is included in the Supported Codecs List (BICC) with the OM set to "Optimization of the ACS supported" in the 3GPP standard?
q_16106.ground_truth: The intermediate node may replace the original Single Codec information element by two or more new Single Codec information elements, but it should not do so without a good reason in interworking scenarios with TFO.

q_16107.question: What is the role of MBMS RB control in functionality 6.2?
q_16107.ground_truth: In functionality 6.2, MBMS RB control for p-t-m bearers is carried out in each cell based on information in the CRNC MBMS Service Context.

q_16108.question: What is the mechanism used to send notification messages for calls with a certain priority level to reduce delay for mobile stations not using DRX?
q_16108.ground_truth: Notification messages are sent on all possible paging or access grant channels.

q_16109.question: What is the purpose of the Random ID parameter in the described scenario?
q_16109.ground_truth: The Random ID parameter identifies the Random ID value used by the MS in the cell where it has performed the radio access part of the MTA procedure.

q_16110.question: What should be done if the in-progress emergency state of the group is false and the received SIP INVITE request contains an imminent peril indication set to true?
q_16110.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function should cache the information that the MCPTT user has initiated an imminent peril call, set the in-progress imminent peril state of the group to true, and generate SIP re-INVITE requests for the MCPTT imminent peril group call. If the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is already true, a SIP MESSAGE request notification should be generated for each of the other affiliated members of the group.

q_16111.question: What is the purpose of the Used DL Coverage Class?
q_16111.ground_truth: The Used DL Coverage Class indicates the DL Coverage Class and the number of blind physical layer transmissions for the current RLC/MAC message, as it is being transmitted.

q_16112.question: What should the AS do upon receiving a 200 (OK) response of the PRACK request from the terminating UE containing an SDP answer related to an early session?
q_16112.ground_truth: The AS should forward the 200 (OK) response after removing the SDP answer related to the early session.

q_16113.question: What are the two levels of AoC service?
q_16113.ground_truth: The two levels of AoC service are the information level and the charging level. The information level is used only to provide AoC information to the user, while the charging level is used to release the call immediately if there is no approval of the AoC information by the Mobile Station (MS) and no charging has been received.

q_16114.question: What is one user-related and social driver for the move towards an AIPN?
q_16114.ground_truth: One user-related and social driver for the move towards an AIPN is the consumer trend demanding diversification of mobile services. This includes diversified and flexible services that meet the varied needs of users, with services becoming more specialized to satisfy specific needs.

q_16115.question: What interfaces in a PLMN are the primary target for standardization?
q_16115.ground_truth: The interfaces between the Network Elements (NEs) and the Element Manager (EM) of a single PLMN Organisation are the primary target for standardization in a PLMN.

q_16116.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in 3GPP technical specifications?
q_16116.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical specifications, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_16117.question: What is the threshold value used to detect potential instability of mid-LSF in the sub-frame LSF interpolation?
q_16117.ground_truth: The threshold value used to detect potential instability of mid-LSF in the sub-frame LSF interpolation is if or interpolation might generate a mid-LSF outside the range of consecutive LSFs.

q_16118.question: What is the requirement for the maximum Base Station RF bandwidth in a multicarrier BTS?
q_16118.ground_truth: The manufacturer shall declare the supported combinations of number of carriers, output powers and the maximum Base Station RF bandwidth applicable for each connector. When the carriers in a transmitter test are required to be distributed over the maximum Base Station RF bandwidth, the supported maximum bandwidth at respective transmit antenna connector shall be applied.

q_16119.question: What is the value of the "targetNamespace" attribute in the root element of the "securityDeregistration.xsd" XML schema?
q_16119.ground_truth: The value of the "targetNamespace" attribute in the root element of the "securityDeregistration.xsd" XML schema is "urn:3GPP:metadata:2005:MBMS:securityDeregistration".

q_16120.question: What is the maximum data rate requirement for audio sensors in the 5G system?
q_16120.ground_truth: The maximum data rate requirement for audio sensors is approximately 5 Mbit/s.

q_16121.question: What is the purpose of the Cell Description information element in 3GPP TS 25.304?
q_16121.ground_truth: The Cell Description information element is used to provide a minimum description of a cell, e.g. to allow the mobile station to use its pre-knowledge about synchronization.

q_16122.question: How are the PCIs (Physical Cell IDs) allocated in the TDD frame structure based E-UTRA scenario?
q_16122.ground_truth: Shifted and truncated Shannon bound curves as specified in Annex A.4 are used for E-UTRA TDD simulations with LCR TDD frame structure based.

q_16123.question: What is the purpose of the ServiceInstanceUpdate header block?
q_16123.ground_truth: The ServiceInstanceUpdate header block allows a message receiver to indicate that a new endpoint, new credentials, or new security mechanisms should be employed by the sender of the message. It can also provide a token renewal mechanism.

q_16124.question: What is the main difference between basic point-to-point voice telephony in multimedia telephony and CS voice service in UTRAN and GERAN?
q_16124.ground_truth: The main difference is that in multimedia telephony, the transport layers are replaced with IP, rather than using the traditional CS voice service in UTRAN and GERAN.

q_16125.question: What is the source device and the destination device in the SMS-PP Download messages?
q_16125.ground_truth: In the SMS-PP Download messages, the source device is the network, and the destination device is the UICC.

q_16126.question: What does "Last Known Location" refer to in the context of location services?
q_16126.ground_truth: The Last Known Location is the current location estimate or Dispatchable Location and the associated time stamp for Target UE stored in the LCS Server.

q_16127.question: In the context of combined GPRS/IMSI attach procedures, what does the "3 out of 4 approach" mean?
q_16127.ground_truth: It implies that at least three out of the four defined measurements should be supported for the combined GPRS/IMSI attach procedures.

q_16128.question: What is the name of the 5G system feature that improves the messaging capability of the 5G system?

q_16129.question: What is the purpose of the "TU3907 Timer" information element in GAN?
q_16129.ground_truth: The purpose of this information element is to indicate to the MS the minimum period of time it should wait before attempting Registration at the current GANC.

q_16130.question: What should the CRNC do if it cannot block the logical resources as requested by the Node B?
q_16130.ground_truth: The CRNC shall respond to the Node B with the BLOCK RESOURCE FAILURE message, and the logical resources will remain unaffected.

q_16131.question: What is the field mapping convention for GPRS RLC data blocks and RLC/MAC control blocks?
q_16131.ground_truth: For GPRS RLC data blocks and RLC/MAC control blocks, when a field within a block is contained within a single octet, the lowest numbered bit of the field represents the lowest order value. When a field spans more than one octet of the physical block, the order of bit values within each octet progressively decreases as the octet number increases.

q_16132.question: What is the primary role of the Service Profile identifier in network slice management charging?
q_16132.ground_truth: The Service Profile identifier is used in network slice management charging to identify a set of charging parameters for a specific service profile.

q_16133.question: What numbering plan is recommended for efficient routing of messages within one or more networks in the SCCP using the generic numbering plan?
q_16133.ground_truth: The generic numbering plan is recommended for efficient routing of messages within one or more networks in the SCCP using the generic numbering plan. This numbering plan identifies SCCP nodes or SCCP subsystems unambiguously, and is useful for response messages to be sent back to the originating node. This numbering plan consists of an international and a national part that allows messages to be routed efficiently within and across networks.

q_16134.question: What is the first group of recommendations that should be enforced to provide basic GAA related security in the terminal?
q_16134.ground_truth: The first group of recommendations includes controlling access to UICC and to GAA master secret, controlling access to the GAA server, and only the manufacturer or the operator can grant access to the GAA functionality for the application.

q_16135.question: What is the final measurement used in the EC algorithm for excitation classification?
q_16135.ground_truth: The final measurement used is LPHaF, which is a moving average of LPH calculated over the past 3 frames and the current frame, with a slightly greater weighting for the latest values.

q_16136.question: What does the BMCA function do when it receives an Announce message from a port with a PTP state of SlavePort, after the BMCA evaluation?
q_16136.ground_truth: The BMCA function updates the Announce message and generates an Announce message separately for each DS-TT and NW-TT port with a state of MasterPort.

q_16137.question: In which mode of operation, UE performs E-TFC selection procedure as specified in sub-clause 11.8.1.4 assuming rank2 transmission parameters ?
q_16137.ground_truth: UE performs E-TFC selection procedure as specified in sub-clause 11.8.1.4 assuming rank2 transmission parameters in the case of primary stream.

q_16138.question: What are the two types of rate limitations that should be contained in the maximum data rate supported by a network slice?
q_16138.ground_truth: GBR and non-GBR resource types data rate limitations.

q_16139.question: What type of information is included in the S-CCPCH-768-InformationListExt-AuditRsp field?
q_16139.ground_truth: The S-CCPCH-768-InformationListExt-AuditRsp field contains information about the status and availability of an S-CCPCH-768 resource on a LTE network.

q_16140.question: What information is included in the BSSMAP-LE Perform Location Request message in 3GPP?
q_16140.ground_truth: The BSSMAP-LE Perform Location Request message includes the following mandatory, conditional, and optional parameters: Location Type, GANSS Location Type, Cell Identifier, Classmark Information Type 3, LCS Client Type, Chosen Channel, LCS Priority, LCS QoS, Requested GPS Assistance Data, BSSLAP APDU, LCS Capability, Packet Measurement Report, Measured Cell Identity List, IMSI of target MS, IMEI of target MS, and Requested GANSS Assistance Data.

q_16141.question: What is the purpose of the Mapping of uplink channels in 3GPP TS~45.008 standard?
q_16141.ground_truth: The purpose of mapping uplink channels is to indicate where the MS may expect occurrence of its (EC-)PDTCH/U(s) or (EC-)PACCH/U for a mobile originated transfer. This allocation is indicated in resource assignment messages, and the USF based allocation or Fixed Uplink Allocation is used in 3GPP TS~45.008 standard.

q_16142.question: What Information Element is only present if packet flow management procedures are supported?

q_16143.question: What must the UAS be capable of for a UAV flight to be ongoing and for C2 communication to be in-direct?
q_16143.ground_truth: The UAS must have two PDU sessions established, one for the UAV and one for the UAV-C, with the relation/pairing between UAV and UAV-C known at the UAE-S.

q_16144.question: What is the role of the schedule element in an MBMS User Service Description?
q_16144.ground_truth: If present, the schedule element includes a URI reference to the MBMS User Service schedule information, which corresponds to a Schedule Description metadata fragment as defined in sub-clause 11.2A.

q_16145.question: What is the objective of the EGAN study in Release 17 of the 3GPP?
q_16145.ground_truth: The objective of the EGAN study in Release 17 of the 3GPP is to identify an architectural solution that best meets the requirements for enhancements to Generic Access Networks (GAN), including evaluating potential architectural solutions and alternative architectures.

q_16146.question: What is the range for CTFC values when using the 16 bits encoding format?
q_16146.ground_truth: When using the 16 bits encoding format, the CTFC value can range from 0 to 65535.

q_16147.question: What should the SMLC do if it does not receive an Assistance Data Acknowledgement or Protocol Error component from the MS within a set time period after sending an Assistance Data component?
q_16147.ground_truth: The SMLC may abort the delivery attempt or send a new Assistance Data component.

q_16148.question: In the initial conditions of 5.3.15.4.1, what is the value of the IMSI in EF~IMSI?
q_16148.ground_truth: The value of the IMSI in EF~IMSI is 246081357935793.

q_16149.question: What are the two coupling loss values specified for Macro Cell and Micro Cell scenarios in Wide Area Base Stations?
q_16149.ground_truth: The coupling loss for Macro Cell is 70 dB and for Micro Cell is 53 dB.

q_16150.question: What is the definition of BLER in the context of HS-DSCH transmission?
q_16150.ground_truth: BLER is defined as the probability that a transport block transmitted using the RTBS and RMF is received in error if decoded in isolation.

q_16151.question: What is the role of MGCFFunction in IMS measurements?
q_16151.ground_truth: MGCFFunction is a function responsible for performing the measurements in IMS. It is used to indicate that the measurement is related to IMS.

q_16152.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Report on the measurement of User Equipment (UE) radio performances for LTE/UMTS terminals, specifically Total Radiated Power (TRP) and Total Radiated Sensitivity (TRS)?
q_16152.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to evaluate the applicability of existing measurement procedures for LTE devices with multiple receive antennas and make a simple extension to UE OTA TRP and TRS test methods, without considering all aspects of spatial channels.

q_16153.question: What should the initial AMF do if it determines to perform an indirect AMF reroute via RAN?
q_16153.ground_truth: The initial AMF sets the AMF service capability result as '0' and sends the SUPI, AMF Reroute Security Required Indication, AMF service capability result, Target AMF Information, and optionally SUCI to the AUSF.

q_16154.question: What SDP attribute does the IMS-ALG use to determine if the IMS-AGW needs to act as a TLS client or TLS server for an MSRP media stream?
q_16154.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG uses the IETF RFC 4145 "a=setup" SDP attribute to determine if the IMS-AGW needs to act as a TLS client or TLS server for an MSRP media stream.

q_16155.question: What is the purpose of the Language AVP when it is used for specifying the language of an announcement?
q_16155.ground_truth: The Language AVP is used for indicating the language of the announcement that should be played when it is used for specifying the language of an announcement.

q_16156.question: What happens to triggered BSRs when the UL grant(s) can accommodate all pending data?
q_16156.ground_truth: All triggered BSRs may be cancelled when the UL grant(s) can accommodate all pending data available for transmission, but it is not sufficient to additionally accommodate the BSR MAC control element plus its subheader.

q_16157.question: How can the system handle UE support of UP IP at the full uplink data rate?
q_16157.ground_truth: If performing cryptographic CRC for all user plane data is not desired, the security policy per PDU session may be extended to include a flag indicating whether to apply cryptographic CRC or not. A UE that supports multiple MAC entities can use one MAC entity to serve all PDU sessions with integrity protection switched on, and another MAC entity to serve all PDU sessions with integrity protection switched off. If a UE that does not support multiple MAC entities wants to establish an additional PDU session with a different value for cryptographic CRC, it may inform the user that the additional PDU session cannot be established due to device limitations.

q_16158.question: What is the function of the 5G PKMF in Solution #21?
q_16158.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF in Solution #21 provisions security keys to the Remote UE and the UE-to-network relay for PC5 communication.

q_16159.question: Which RF channels should be tested for ACK mis-detection in multipath fading conditions as specified in the document?
q_16159.ground_truth: The RF channels to be tested for ACK mis-detection in multipath fading conditions are B, M, and T.

q_16160.question: Under which condition should the terminating BSS through-connect two parties in a LCLS call in the 3GPP network?
q_16160.ground_truth: The terminating BSS should through-connect two parties only if it receives the LCLS-Connection-Status-Control IE set to "Connect" for both call legs.

q_16161.question: What is the result general result for the ME in expected sequence 6.1B when the requested icon could not be displayed?
q_16161.ground_truth: Command performed successfully but requested icon could not be displayed

q_16162.question: What is the role of the IBCF function at step 3 in the second protocol exchange?
q_16162.ground_truth: At step 3 in the second protocol exchange, the IBCF function checks the validity of the NOT-CONF message, and if valid, authorizes the call.

q_16163.question: How does the IP packet transport FTT-IMS procedure work?
q_16163.ground_truth: The IP packet transport FTT-IMS procedure transports IPv4 and IPv6 packets over an FTT-IMS by creating IP packet envelopes with the IP packet field populated with the IP packet, and sending the IP packet envelopes as TLS application data over the FTT-IMS.

q_16164.question: What would the SAS assume if the GANSS-UTRAN Time Relationship Uncertainty IE does not contain the GANSS ID IE in the INFORMATION EXCHANGE INITIATION REQUEST message?
q_16164.ground_truth: The SAS shall assume that the GANSS-UTRAN Time Relationship Uncertainty IE is associated with Galileo if the GANSS-UTRAN Time Relationship Uncertainty IE does not contain the GANSS ID IE in the INFORMATION EXCHANGE INITIATION REQUEST message.

q_16165.question: What is the purpose of the HS-DSCH FDD Update Information IE?
q_16165.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH FDD Update Information IE provides information for HS-DSCH to be updated. At least one IE shall be presented.

q_16166.question: When does the MBMS UE De-Linking procedure take place during MBMS service availability?
q_16166.ground_truth: The MBMS UE De-Linking procedure may happen before, during, or between MBMS sessions at any point in time after the UE has been linked towards the RAN while it is PMM-CONNECTED.

q_16167.question: What is the modulation format used in EGPRS and EGPRS2, and how is it signalled?
q_16167.ground_truth: The modulation format is signalled in EGPRS and EGPRS2 by the rotation factor of the training sequences. This enables blind detection in the receiver.

q_16168.question: What is not recommended in the 3GPP TS 26.114 document regarding retransmission procedure for video when using Adaptation Layer Type 3 (AL3)?
q_16168.ground_truth: The use of the optional retransmission procedure for video when using Adaptation Layer Type 3 (AL3) is not recommended in the 3GPP TS 26.114 document due to delay considerations. Receiving terminals should not send retransmission requests, and it is recommended that terminals support video also using Adaptation Layer Type 2 (AL2) where retransmission is not possible, and overhead is slightly smaller.

q_16169.question: What is the limit for the in-band sharing between systems in UTRA spurious emission limits?
q_16169.ground_truth: The limit for the in-band sharing between systems in UTRA spurious emission limits is -15 dBm/MHz.

q_16170.question: What are the two different protocol layers that the MBSTF may handle ingested content on for the Packet Distribution Method, Forward-only mode?
q_16170.ground_truth: The two different protocol layers that the MBSTF may handle ingested content on for the Packet Distribution Method, Forward-only mode are IP packets and MBS PDUs.

q_16171.question: What is the structure of an HTTP POST request used for notification of traffic steering rule enforcement failure?
q_16171.ground_truth: The HTTP POST request contains a JSON payload in the message body, with a host, content type, and content length in the header. The JSON payload includes a notification message, type, tag, and info, with a list of resources and their statuses.

q_16172.question: In the RECEIVE DATA command, what is the channel data sent back to the SIM after the last command in the sequence?
q_16172.ground_truth: The channel data sent back to the SIM after the last command in the sequence is 20 21.. E7 (200 Bytes of data).

q_16173.question: What are the difficulties faced with the top-down approach in the distribution of public root keys?
q_16173.ground_truth: The top-down approach involves producing country-specific versions of terminals, which is seen as quite problematic by terminal manufacturers. Therefore, a different approach is needed for incremental growth of PWS Security.

q_16174.question: What are the two limits of the MS power control range, as specified in 3GPP TS 45.005?
q_16174.ground_truth: The MS power control range is defined by its maximum output power and its minimum output power, with a nominal step size of 2 dB between them.

q_16175.question: What causes the cancellation of an operation in the 11.23.2.2 error handling procedure?
q_16175.ground_truth: A Cancel operation received before or during the processing of the operation.

q_16176.question: What should the UE do when the validity timer expires and the NR cell is on, after receiving V2XP over PC5 from SS due to initiating a UE-requested V2X policy provisioning procedure?
q_16176.ground_truth: The UE should initiate a UE-requested V2X policy provisioning procedure.

q_16177.question: What is the role of the MME in the "Delivery of Ciphering Keys to UEs for Broadcast Assistance Data" procedure?
q_16177.ground_truth: In this procedure, the MME stores the ciphering keys including their validity periods, applicable tracking areas, and the types of broadcast assistance data. Once the MME receives a TAU request with an indication that ciphering keys are requested or an Attach Request with an indication that ciphering keys are requested, it forwards one or more ciphering keys applicable to the current tracking area to the UE in the Attach Accept or TAU Accept.

q_16178.question: What is Key Issue #5 outlining for the solution to address?
q_16178.ground_truth: Key Issue #5 outlines the provisioning of application layer QoS requirements to the 3GPP system, QoS differentiation for UAV operations, enhancing UAE/SEAL layer to support QoS monitoring/provisioning and enhancing UAE/SEAL layer to support modifying QoS requirements as requested by the UAV-controller or the USS/UTM.

q_16179.question: What is the abbreviation for "Short Message Control" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?

q_16180.question: What is the duration of the validity timer for a ProSe Application Code?
q_16180.ground_truth: The validity timer for a ProSe Application Code is the length of time that the ProSe Application Code is valid for announcement. The UE will be authorized to announce the ProSe Application Code for the duration of validity timer as long as it remains in the HPLMN and the validity timer has not yet expired.

q_16181.question: What is the purpose of the re-ordering entity in the re-ordering and CRC entity for CCCH transmission?
q_16181.ground_truth: The re-ordering entity is responsible for eliminating duplicates and delivering the packets in order to RLC, based on the explicit TSN indication and the timing information provided by the Node B. It also discards MAC-c PDUs with incorrect CRC when received.

q_16182.question: When should the UE send a UEInformationResponse message with rlf-Report in it?
q_16182.ground_truth: If rlf-ReportReq is set to true and the UE has radio link failure or handover failure information available in VarRLF-Report where the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report.

q_16183.question: For TCH/FS FER measurements in frequency hopping under interference conditions, what type of signal is connected to the BSS receiver input via a combining network along with the wanted signal?
q_16183.ground_truth: The interfering signal shall be a random continuous, GMSK-modulated signal on only one of the carriers at a level 10 dB higher than the wanted signal.

q_16184.question: What are the two sub-functions of the Key Management function?
q_16184.ground_truth: The Key Management function includes two sub-functions: Key Request function and Key Distribution function.

q_16185.question: What should the IMS-ALG do when it receives an SDP answer also containing the "a=rtcp-fb" line(s) with a "pause" CCM parameter?
q_16185.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should include the "CCM pause-resume" information element to indicate that the IMS-AGW shall forward RTCP feedback "CCM PAUSE-RESUME" messages transparently.

q_16186.question: What action does VLRB take if the CSG cell is not allowed for the paged MS?
q_16186.ground_truth: VLRB rejects the Process Access Request if the CSG cell is not allowed for the paged MS.

q_16187.question: Which logical channels are prioritized first in 3GPP TS 38.321?
q_16187.ground_truth: In 3GPP TS 38.321, MAC CE for C-RNTI or data from UL-CCCH, and data from any Logical Channel, except data from UL-CCCH, are prioritized first, with equal priority logical channels served equally.

q_16188.question: What is the effect of Call Forwarding in the CSI termination scenario?
q_16188.ground_truth: If CSI AS gets the information that the CS call is forwarded or the IMS session is forwarded/will be forwarded, it may decide what the further action will be based on local policy.

q_16189.question: What is the name of the reference point between Content Provider and BM-SC?
q_16189.ground_truth: The reference point between Content Provider and BM-SC is named xMB.

q_16190.question: What do the terms ``shall'' and ``shall not'' typically indicate in the context of 3GPP technical documents?
q_16190.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical documents, the terms "shall" and "shall not" are used to indicate mandatory requirements. Specifically, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

q_16191.question: What is the maximum number of carriers for DL-HSPDSCH-MultiCarrier-Information?
q_16191.ground_truth: The maximum number of carriers for DL-HSPDSCH-MultiCarrier-Information is 8.

q_16192.question: On which transport bearers can the OUTER LOOP PC control frame be sent for a UE with multiple CCTrCHs carrying DCHs in 1.28 Mcps TDD?
q_16192.ground_truth: The OUTER LOOP PC control frame can be sent on any of the transport bearers carrying DCHs that belong to the CCTrCH for which the uplink SIR target shall be adjusted.

q_16193.question: What is the recommended approach for network operators who introduce 3GPP IMS using IPv6 to ensure GPRS roaming partners provide support for PDP contexts of PDP type IPv6?
q_16193.ground_truth: Network operators have a strong interest that their GPRS roaming partners provide support for PDP contexts of PDP type IPv6.

q_16194.question: Which IE (Information Element) is used for the establishment of E-DCH Logical Channels?
q_16194.ground_truth: The "E-DCH Logical Channel Information" IE is used for the establishment of E-DCH Logical Channels.

q_16195.question: For a single carrier, what is the relationship between subcarrier spacing and peak data rates, in general?
q_16195.ground_truth: Larger subcarrier spacing may potentially provide higher peak data rates due to the use of larger bandwidth.

q_16196.question: What is the purpose of the characterization results provided in clause 7.4.2.2?
q_16196.ground_truth: The purpose of the characterization results provided in clause 7.4.2.2 is to compare H.265/HEVC Screen-Extended Main 10 profile against H.265/HEVC Main 10 profile for different scenarios and metrics.

q_16197.question: What should the UE do to switch content of the PSS streaming session?
q_16197.ground_truth: The UE shall send an RTSP PLAY request with the new content URI as defined in TS 26.234 if the SDP file contains a different number of media components.

q_16198.question: What is the purpose of the Sx session modification procedure?
q_16198.ground_truth: The Sx session modification procedure is used to update the Sx session context of an existing PDN connection, IP-CAN session, TDF session, or TDF in unsolicited reporting mode at the UP function.

q_16199.question: What is the initial step in establishing an association between the client and the SCTP multiplexer?
q_16199.ground_truth: The client sends an INIT signal to the SCTP multiplexer on the dedicated port to initiate an association.

q_16200.question: What is the coding method for the control bits in Frames for Full Rate and Enhanced Full Rate Speech as specified in the 3GPP TS 48.051 standard?
q_16200.ground_truth: For Full Rate Speech, the speech block is transferred in the same order as output from the transcoder. For Enhanced Full Rate Speech, the speech block is subdivided into five subsets, and parity bits are added at the end of each subset using a shortened cyclic code, with the generator polynomial of g(D) = D3 + D + 1.

q_16201.question: What should an MS in limited service state do to receive emergency bearer services?
q_16201.ground_truth: The MS should initiate the GPRS Attach procedure and indicate that it is for emergency services.

q_16202.question: What is the procedure for attaining V.110 frame synchronization on incoming data from the RAN?
q_16202.ground_truth: The MSC/IWF will seek to attain V.110 frame synchronization on the incoming data from the RAN in line with the procedures described in subclause 9.2.3.4.1.1.

q_16203.question: What information does the network take into account to compute the desired thresholds for HNBs?
q_16203.ground_truth: The network takes into account macro NodeB load, number of active HNBs, distance of the HNB to the macro cell, fading environment, time-of-day, etc.

q_16204.question: What information is included in the RAB-DataForwardingList-SRNS-CtxReq in this protocol?
q_16204.ground_truth: The RAB-DataForwardingList-SRNS-CtxReq contains RAB-IE-ContainerList with RAB-DataForwardingItem-SRNS-CtxReq-IEs, which includes a RAB-ID and optional iE-Extensions.

q_16205.question: When does the coverage recovery for RedCap UE's uplink channels become necessary?
q_16205.ground_truth: The coverage recovery for RedCap UE's uplink channels is not necessary when they show better or similar coverage as the bottleneck channel of the reference NR UE.

q_16206.question: What GA-RRC message does the MS send to the GANC in response to the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message from the GANC in a mobile-terminated call?
q_16206.ground_truth: The MS sends the GA-RRC PAGING RESPONSE message in response, and transitions to the GA-RRC-CONNECTED state.

q_16207.question: What is the role of the DDNMF in this solution?
q_16207.ground_truth: The DDNMF performs the authorization function in this solution and is responsible for generating and provisioning the necessary security keys, such as the PSDK, for group member and relay discovery.

q_16208.question: What does the term "shall" indicate in the context of 3GPP technical documents?
q_16208.ground_truth: The term "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_16209.question: In the 5GS to EPS interworking handover, what information does the source AMF receive from the SMF?
q_16209.ground_truth: The source AMF receives the UP IP policy from the SMF in the Nsmf_PDUSession_ContextResponse message.

q_16210.question: What is the responsibility of the SMF in the solution for key issue 7?
q_16210.ground_truth: The SMF initiates the PDU (Packet Data Unit) session modification procedure and provides the Key-ID and KLE (Key derived from Key-ID) to the UPF.

q_16211.question: What does the measurement CC.SeizedOutCEG represent in clause 4.1.4.1?
q_16211.ground_truth: CC.SeizedOutCEG represents the number of seized outgoing calls to adjacent network per trunk group in clause 4.1.4.1.

q_16212.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 5.6.3?
q_16212.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in section 5.6.3 is to verify the UE's position estimates, after the first reported position estimate, meet the minimum requirements under GPS satellite signal conditions that simulate a moving scenario for certain location services.

q_16213.question: Which solutions provide a way for disaster no longer applicable notification to UE's in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access?

q_16214.question: What is the PDP Type Number for IPv4v6 when there is no IANA defined PDP type for IPv4v6?
q_16214.ground_truth: The PDP Type Number is chosen to be HEX(8D).

q_16215.question: What is the purpose of including the WLAN indication in the Proximity Request message?
q_16215.ground_truth: The purpose of including the WLAN indication in the Proximity Request message is to enable ProSe Function B to request UE B's last known location via the HSS if UE A has requested EPC support for WLAN direct discovery and communication.

q_16216.question: What are the LSA controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) operations and notifications that can be communicated between an IRPAgent and one or several IRPManagers?
q_16216.ground_truth: The LSA controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) operations and notifications that can be communicated between an IRPAgent and one or several IRPManagers include requestLcRegistration, requestLcDeregistration, getLSRAI, getLSRAIConfirmation, notifyLCRegistration, notifyLCDeRegistration, notifyZoneCreation, notifyZoneDeletion, notifyZoneModification, cellsUpdate, cellsConstraintsSatisfied, cellsConstraintsUpdate.

q_16217.question: What information does the NRF provide in the access token for the NF Service Consumer to access the services of data sources from ADRF?
q_16217.ground_truth: NRF, after verifying the request, authorizes the NF Service Consumer by adding in the access token claims the NF Type (or the NF Instance ID) of the NF Service Producers (i.e. the ADRF and the Data Producer) in step 5.

q_16218.question: What is the name of the reduction factor added to avoid that a 3rd order intermodulation product just falls onto the lowest downlink channel?
q_16218.ground_truth: The reduction factor K is added to avoid that a 3rd order intermodulation product just falls onto the lowest downlink channel.

q_16219.question: What is the INITIATING MESSAGE for the mBMSSessionUpdate RANAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_16220.question: What is the purpose of user diversity in the context of OSC?
q_16220.ground_truth: The purpose of user diversity in OSC is to increase variance on the number of simultaneous active users over an interleaving period, which provides better conditions for channel coding to operate, and is suited for both downlink and uplink.

q_16221.question: Which timer shall the UE start upon sending an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the stored SUCI upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the Identity type IE set to "SUCI" while timer T3519 is running?
q_16221.ground_truth: The UE shall not start any timer upon sending an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the stored SUCI when timer T3519 is already running.

q_16222.question: What should an SGSN do upon receiving a BSSAP+-LOCATION-UPDATE-ACCEPT message from the VLR if timer T6-1 is not running and timers T8 and T9 are not running either?
q_16222.ground_truth: If the state of the association to the VLR is different than GS-ASSOCIATED, the message shall be treated as incompatible with the protocol state of the SGSN.

q_16223.question: What is the response of VLRb when it receives the "send info ack" request?

q_16224.question: What is the approach for channel mode adaptation in the MUROS study?
q_16224.ground_truth: A non-MUROS / MUROS adaptation based on specified speech codecs is used for comparing the candidate techniques. No sophisticated channel mode adaptation with switching between full and half-rate channels is required for this comparison.

q_16225.question: What is the format of the name available to MS in the NITZ feature?
q_16225.ground_truth: When using the default character set, the serving PLMN makes both a "short" and a "long" name available to the MS, and as an alternative or in addition, it can make a name available in UCS2.

q_16226.question: What is the name of the 32-bit parameter that is constant for any given FRAMETYPE input in the GEA5 and GIA5 functions?

q_16227.question: What must the UE do in step 3, if a bootstrapped security association between UE and NAF/AS exists?
q_16227.ground_truth: If a bootstrapped security association between UE and NAF/AS exists, then UE and NAF/AS share the keys to protect reference point Ua and the UE may perform a subsequent authentication procedure if the SASL profile allows. In this case, step 3 is combined with the request in step 6, and step 4 and step 5 are omitted.

q_16228.question: What is the condition required to allow speech/data transition during a call?
q_16228.ground_truth: The condition required to allow speech/data transition during a call is CT108.2 ON condition towards MT.

q_16229.question: What is the term used to describe a change of serving satellite in Non-Terrestrial Networks?

q_16230.question: What is the expected sequence for testing the "SEND DTMF" facility in the DTMF protocol with center alignment?
q_16230.ground_truth: The expected sequence for testing the "SEND DTMF" facility in the DTMF protocol with center alignment is defined in expected sequence 4.2.

q_16231.question: What does the term "subordinate entities" refer to in the context of the 3GPP network management system?
q_16231.ground_truth: Subordinate entities refer to either Element Managers (EMs) or Network Elements (NEs) that are managed by the Network Manager (NM) in a 3GPP network.

q_16232.question: What is the effect of lower bandwidth on the quality aspects of a session in TS 26.114?
q_16232.ground_truth: If the used bandwidth is lower than the Minimum Supported Bandwidth, it can be expected that the encoding quality is reduced and the end-to-end delay is increased.

q_16233.question: What message type is sent on the EC-CCCH by the network to assign downlink packet resources to a mobile station with EC operation enabled?

q_16234.question: What measurement supports the Dual-Cell HSDPA related measurements in UMTS, providing the Dual-Cell HSDPA Scheduling duration in UTRAN cell?
q_16234.ground_truth: Dual-Cell HSDPA Scheduling duration in UTRAN cell

q_16235.question: What network functions does the 5G System architecture include?
q_16235.ground_truth: The 5G System architecture includes the following network functions: Application Function (AF), Access and Mobility Management function (AMF), Session Management Function (SMF), User Plane Function (UPF), Policy Control Function (PCF), Network Exposure Function (NEF), Network Repository Function (NRF), Unified Data Management (UDM), and Unified Data Repository (UDR).

q_16236.question: What mode is an MS operating in when it establishes a new GERAN serving cell as a result of an intra-RAT/inter-RAT handover while in GERAN/UTRAN/E-UTRAN mode?
q_16236.ground_truth: An MS operating in GERAN/UTRAN/E-UTRAN preferred mode establishes a new GERAN serving cell.

q_16237.question: What conditions determine whether a transmission is considered a new transmission or a retransmission?
q_16237.ground_truth: A transmission is considered a new transmission if the NDI has been toggled, if it is the first received transmission for the TB in the broadcast process, or if it is the very first received transmission for this TB. Otherwise, it is considered a retransmission.

q_16238.question: Which software were used for verifying the C code of the Enhanced aacPlus codec?
q_16238.ground_truth: The C code of the Enhanced aacPlus codec is verified to work with Microsoft Visual C++ v.6.0 compiler on Windows systems and GCC v.3.3 compiler on Linux systems.

q_16239.question: What is the objective of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's study on location enhancements for mission critical services (Release 17)?
q_16239.ground_truth: The objective is to identify key issues and associated solutions for enhancements to the existing location architecture in 3GPP mission critical services.

q_16240.question: What is added to the relevant measurement in case of E-RAB failed setup?
q_16240.ground_truth: Each E-RAB failed to establish is added to the relevant measurement per cause.

q_16241.question: What are the processes involved in Fault Management in a 3GPP system?
q_16241.ground_truth: The processes involved in Fault Management in a 3GPP system include fault detection, fault localisation, fault reporting, fault correction, fault repair, and associated features in the Operations System (OS) such as the administration of a pending alarms list, the presentation of operational state information of physical and logical devices/resources/functions, and the provision and analysis of the alarm and state history of the network.

q_16242.question: What is the difference between the second and third digits in 3GPP technical specification versioning?
q_16242.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, while the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated.

q_16243.question: When will the RNC initiate the requested function in the Location Related Data procedure?
q_16243.ground_truth: Upon reception of the LOCATION RELATED DATA REQUEST message, the RNC shall initiate the requested function indicated in the Location Related Data Request Type IE.

q_16244.question: What action does the MGCF take if the selected local codec(s) differ from the codec(s) received in the SDP?
q_16244.ground_truth: The MGCF sends the reserved speech codec(s), and the local IP address and UDP port in the PRACK to the IMS.

q_16245.question: In what situations is transcoding applied for interworking with DTX between CS and IMS networks?
q_16245.ground_truth: Transcoding is applied for interworking with DTX in its media-receive direction in the CS to IMS direction and for interworking with DTX in its media-send direction in the IMS to CS direction.

q_16246.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a CHANNEL RELEASE message in UI format from the network in group receive mode?
q_16246.ground_truth: On receipt of a CHANNEL RELEASE message, the RR entity shall go to idle mode and give an indication to the upper layer.

q_16247.question: What is the Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) codec capable of operating in a GSM system at?
q_16247.ground_truth: The Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) codec is capable of operating in a GSM system at gross bit-rates of 11.4 kbit/s (half-rate) and 22.8 kbit/s (full-rate).

q_16248.question: What are the conditions for initiating Inter-UE Transfer procedures without establishing a Collaborative Session?
q_16248.ground_truth: The whole IMS multi-media session is transferred from one UE to the other UE and the roles of the Controller and Controllee UEs are not applicable. Inter-UE Transfer procedures may be initiated by the UE based on the information it gets from Target UE discovery.

q_16249.question: How did the EFR codec perform compared to the TCH-FS reference in clear speech conditions across all laboratories?
q_16249.ground_truth: The EFR codec performed better than or equivalent to the TCH-FS reference for clear speech conditions (EP0) in all laboratories.

q_16250.question: Which LTE channels support service multiplexing for common transport channels?
q_16250.ground_truth: MAC should support service multiplexing for common transport channels in LTE, since the physical layer does not support multiplexing of these channels.

q_16251.question: What is the purpose of the "Onboarding Network (ON)" in the 5GS study?
q_16251.ground_truth: The Onboarding Network (ON) provides initial registration and/or access to the UE for UE Onboarding, which is used to enable 3GPP connectivity and remote provisioning of information to the UE.

q_16252.question: What is the frequency stability affected by in the macro cell synchronization scheme?
q_16252.ground_truth: The frequency stability is affected by the ambient temperature.

q_16253.question: What is the role of NRF in this process?
q_16253.ground_truth: NRF stores the supported DNAI in the service profile of the I-SMF/SMF.

q_16254.question: What is the purpose of the testing procedure described in 27.22.4.22.5.4.2 as Expected Sequence 5.1?
q_16254.ground_truth: To verify that the UCS2 coded text string is displayed by the ME as an idle mode text

q_16255.question: What is the purpose of the Radio Link Deletion Request message?
q_16255.ground_truth: The Radio Link Deletion Request message is used to request the deletion of one or more radio links in the network.

q_16256.question: What is the impact of the modification of the limits on UTRA with the addition of new frequency bands and the work on E-UTRA?
q_16256.ground_truth: The modification of the limits for UTRA is included in the specifications after 2006-12, ensuring compatibility with adjacent band services, including the potential impact on in-band sharing, and providing mutual advantages when multiple operators are deployed in the 3G operating bands.

q_16257.question: What does the abbreviation "MU" stand for in the document, and what is its definition?
q_16257.ground_truth: MU stands for "Mark up" in the document, and it is defined as an increase over the basic charge, either to provide extra revenue or to cover additional costs.

q_16258.question: What is the purpose of the SRVCC Preparation procedure?
q_16258.ground_truth: The purpose of the SRVCC Preparation procedure is the reception of the security parameters from the PS CN domain needed for successful SRVCC operation.

q_16259.question: What is the name of the message sent by the UTRAN RNC to the UE after a URA update has been registered?

q_16260.question: What protocol is used at the L4 layer for telepresence support?

q_16261.question: What is the role of the MCPTT client currently speaking during a MCPTT call based on the IP connectivity functionality?
