q_16261.ground_truth: The MCPTT client currently speaking performs the temporary floor arbitrator during speaking since there is no centralized MCPTT floor control server. The floor arbitrator controls the floor whether or not queue is supported, and when floor is requested with override. If queue is supported, the MCPTT client grants the right to speak to the next speaker and transfers the floor arbitrator role after completing the voice transfer and releasing the floor.

q_16262.question: Which TS-family document does the Solution Set definitions in the present document relate to?
q_16262.ground_truth: The Solution Set definitions in the present document relate to TS 28.305 V15.0.X.

q_16263.question: What message does the ICS UE A send to the conference AS to initiate a session?
q_16263.ground_truth: The ICS UE A sends a conference invitation message to the SCC AS via the I1 interface to initiate a session.

q_16264.question: What reference points are used at the service layer to realize session-level virtual leased line arrangements?
q_16264.ground_truth: The main reference points from the IMS service layer that are used to realize session-level virtual leased line arrangements include Mx, Ici or Mm, e2, and Gq'.

q_16265.question: What identifiers does the RAN use to learn which UEs are receiving the same multicast data?
q_16265.ground_truth: The RAN learns which UEs are receiving the same multicast data from the multicast group identity.

q_16266.question: What is the purpose of testing RUN AT COMMAND with italic text attribute?
q_16266.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the ME responds to a RUN AT COMMAND with italic text attribute and returns an AT Response within a TERMINAL RESPONSE to the UICC.

q_16267.question: What is the only potential for interworking between the ID-WSF Authentication Service and GAA/GBA?
q_16267.ground_truth: When a Liberty implementation of a WSC in a User Equipment wants to get access to a SP

q_16268.question: What does the acronym "IRP" stand for in the context of the present document?

q_16269.question: When should the "GPS TOW msec" information element be included in a measurement report?
q_16269.ground_truth: The "GPS TOW msec" information element should be included in a measurement report when the user equipment (UE) does not support the capability to provide the GPS timing of the cell, and the measurements were valid.

q_16270.question: What does Octet 1 of the Standard WVG object indicate?
q_16270.ground_truth: Octet 1 of the Standard WVG object indicates the position in the SM data after which the object shall be displayed in the SM data.

q_16271.question: When will the UE consider the access attempt as allowed during the initiation of the procedure?
q_16271.ground_truth: If timer T302 is not running and the Access Category is '0', the UE will consider the access attempt as allowed.

q_16272.question: What is the result of the "GET STATUS" command when no channel is available or activated?
q_16272.ground_truth: The command is performed successfully, but all channel statuses indicate "Link not established or PDP context not activated."

q_16273.question: What is the expected behavior of the S-CSCF when the HSS requests de-registration of an emergency registered Public Identity?
q_16273.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall not change the registration state of the Public User Identities present in the information element Identities with Emergency Registrations and shall keep unchanged the S-CSCF name associated with these Public User Identities. The HSS shall retain the emergency registration.

q_16274.question: What should the UE do after a CS voice call is terminated and PS services are suspended in step 11?
q_16274.ground_truth: The UE shall resume PS services if in GERAN, and if PS services resumption was unsuccessful before returning to E-UTRAN and ISR is active, the UE shall locally deactivate ISR before initiating the TAU procedure. The S-GW and P-GW resume the suspended bearers using implicit resume if triggered by a procedure in operation, and explicit resume if not. Upon termination of CS services, the UE moves to E-UTRAN using existing mechanisms with no specific CS Fallback mechanisms.

q_16275.question: What extension is optionally implemented for multi-slot transmission in this test mode?
q_16275.ground_truth: The MS may optionally transmit RLC/MAC blocks received on the second downlink timeslot in the second uplink timeslot and so on. If there are more transmit timeslots than receive timeslots, the contents of uplink timeslots that do not map to downlink timeslots shall be the same as in the last timeslot that maps to downlink.

q_16276.question: What technique is used to make the modem signals less susceptible to distortion when transmitted over the mobile voice channel?
q_16276.ground_truth: The eIM solution uses signals designed to pass through modern speech codecs with only moderate distortion, and employs turbo encoding with incremental redundancy.

q_16277.question: What message is the mobile station required to read if it supports EC operation and wants to determine if the EC SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 4 message is sent in the cell?
q_16277.ground_truth: The mobile station is required to read the EC SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 3 message in an attempt to determine if the EC SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 4 message is sent in the cell.

q_16278.question: What information does the HNB send to the HMS during the registration process?
q_16278.ground_truth: The HNB sends location parameters and HNB Identity to the HMS during the registration process.

q_16279.question: Who is responsible for requesting the collection of QoE information from a specified end user service or an individual UE for a specified end user service/end user service type?
q_16279.ground_truth: An operator technician via the management system to the traffic network.

q_16280.question: What is the requirement for the introduction of the wide bandwidth pulse in terms of implementing it in new mobile stations?
q_16280.ground_truth: The introduction of the wide bandwidth pulse should change MS hardware as little as possible.

q_16281.question: What is the method used to perform the memory update in all modes except for the 4.75 kbit/s mode?
q_16281.ground_truth: The memory update consists of filtering the error signal through the synthesis filter to find the perceptually weighted error for the next subframe.

q_16282.question: What is the initial threshold for frame scaling?
q_16282.ground_truth: The initial threshold for frame scaling is a positive value.

q_16283.question: What is the meaning of the "Maximum number of traffic channels" in the "GERAN Classmark" information element in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_16283.ground_truth: The "Maximum number of traffic channels" in the "GERAN Classmark" information element indicates the maximum number of traffic channels supported by the serving cell or, in case of handover, by the target cell.

q_16284.question: What is the difference between Intent-CSC, Intent-CSP, and Intent-NOP?
q_16284.ground_truth: Intent-CSC is expressed by Communication Service Consumer (CSC) to achieve a certain state/position for communication service management, Intent-CSP is expressed by Communication Service Provider (CSP) to achieve a certain state/position for network management, and Intent-NOP is expressed by Network Operator (NOP) to achieve a certain state/position for network resource management.

q_16285.question: What is the increment value for pnup when an active frame is detected?
q_16285.ground_truth: When an active frame is detected, pnup is incremented by 2.

q_16286.question: What is the maximum number of intra-frequency TDD cells that the UE physical layer is required to measure the Reference Signal Received Power (RSCP) for, every measurement period, if idle intervals are not used for inter-frequency TDD measurements?
q_16286.ground_truth: The UE physical layer is required to measure the RSCP for 10 intra-frequency TDD cells, every measurement period, if idle intervals are not used for inter-frequency TDD measurements.

q_16287.question: What information does the UE include in a Measurement Report if it has been able to calculate a position?
q_16287.ground_truth: The UE includes the "UE positioning Position Estimate Info" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT with the calculated position.

q_16288.question: What message does the SGSN send to the target BSS upon deciding to initiate an inter RAT/mode PS handover?
q_16288.ground_truth: The SGSN sends a Relocation Required message to the old SGSN with the Relocation Type set to "UE Involved in relocation of SRNS".

q_16289.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 38.412, what is the definition of the RRC Connection?
q_16289.ground_truth: An RRC Connection is a point-to-point, bi-directional connection between RRC peer entities on the UE and UTRAN sides, respectively, that is established during the initial access or during handover between UEs or cells.

q_16290.question: For FR2, Dense urban, DL, for VR/AR, with single stream traffic model, DDDSU TDD format, with SU-MIMO, 30Mbps, 10ms PDB, and network/outer coding (50% redundancy), 2CC (30&39GHz) CA, no blocking, what was the capacity performance compared to the case without network/outer coding?
q_16290.ground_truth: The capacity performance was 8.5 UE per cell.

q_16291.question: What message does the GANC send to the MS to modify parameters for the established call in CS channel modification?

q_16292.question: What is the purpose of the Access Barring Information Control Element (AC IE) in the ACDC (Access Control for Applications) feature in UMTS?
q_16292.ground_truth: The AC IE in the ACDC feature indicates whether to allow or block access to the network based on applications. It contains the category of application usage, the number of retries, and the time before the next retry in the AC IE.

q_16293.question: At how many offsets from the carrier frequency should the power be measured in step a) of 6.5.2.2?
q_16293.ground_truth: The power should be measured at the offsets of 400 kHz, 600 kHz, 1200 kHz, and 1800 kHz from the carrier frequency in step a) of 6.5.2.2.

q_16294.question: When should the "BDWI" be set to 1 in the SGSN Context Response message?
q_16294.ground_truth: The BDWI should be set to 1 when it is required to forward to the UE DL data buffered in the old SGW or in the old Gn/Gp SGSN during a RAU/TAU procedure.

q_16295.question: What is the maximum number of inter-frequency FDD cells that a UE shall be capable of performing CPICH measurements for, and what is the measurement period of Tmeasurement FDD inter for inter-frequency CPICH measurements?
q_16295.ground_truth: The UE shall be capable of performing CPICH measurements for Xmeasurement FDD inter inter-frequency FDD cells per frequency of the monitored set, and the UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting measurements to higher layers with the measurement period of Tmeasurement FDD inter.

q_16296.question: What is the format of the Unsuccessful-cell-InformationRespList-SyncAdjustmntFailureTDD field?
q_16296.ground_truth: The Unsuccessful-cell-InformationRespList-SyncAdjustmntFailureTDD field is a sequence of ProtocolIE-Single-Container with an ID id-Unsuccessful-cell-InformationRespItem-SyncAdjustmntFailureTDD and iE-Extensions.

q_16297.question: What is the purpose of the restricted ProSe Discovery UE ID for Restricted Direct Discovery?
q_16297.ground_truth: It is used for the identification of a UE in restricted ProSe Direct Discovery, applicable only to non-Public Safety UEs.

q_16298.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in the MBMS session start procedure?
q_16298.ground_truth: The BM-SC is responsible for sending the MBMS Session Start Request message to the GGSN when it is ready to send data for the indicated MBMS service and for providing the MBMS Service Type, MBMS Counting Information, MBMS Service Area, MBMS Session Identifier, MBMS Session Repetition Number, MBMS Time To Data Transfer, and MBMS 2G/3G Indicator in the message to the SGSN.

q_16299.question: What is one of the conditions that may cause the "Voice centric" UE to disable the E-UTRAN capability and re-select GERAN or UTRAN?
q_16299.ground_truth: If the UE is unable to obtain voice service in E-UTRAN, it will disable the E-UTRAN capability and re-select GERAN or UTRAN.

q_16300.question: What needs to be protected in the edge data network application regarding user identifiers and credentials?
q_16300.ground_truth: The user identifiers and credentials need to be protected in storage and transit in the edge data network application.

q_16301.question: In which state of the association are BSSAP+-PAGING-REQUEST messages accepted by the SGSN?
q_16301.ground_truth: The SGSN accepts BSSAP+-PAGING-REQUEST messages in any state of the association apart from Gs-NULL.

q_16302.question: What is the length of the TSN field in the MAC-is header for uplink transmissions?
q_16302.ground_truth: The length of the TSN field in the MAC-is header for uplink transmissions is 14 bits.

q_16303.question: How does the new CCN affect controlling tasks in the described use case?
q_16303.ground_truth: The new CCN coordinates control actions between entities responsible for controlling tasks, ensuring that there are no contradicting or parallel tasks. This coordination enables seamless integration and management of the contributed resources.

q_16304.question: What is the purpose of the "a=sendonly" or "a=inactive" attribute in the "m=" line when constructing the SDP offer in both point-to-point call and multiparty conference?
q_16304.ground_truth: These attributes represent the sender's encode ability and policies in the SDP offer.

q_16305.question: What is the default value for the Routing Indicator if it is not present in the USIM in 5.3.15.1?
q_16305.ground_truth: The ME shall set the Routing Indicator to a default value 0 if not present in the USIM.

q_16306.question: What should the network do if it wishes to reduce the number of PDCHs/PDCH-pairs allocated to a mobile station per basic/reduced radio block period in USF_GRANULARITY=four blocks allocation?
q_16306.ground_truth: The network may ignore the USF on all other PDCHs/PDCH-pairs during the first three block periods in which the mobile station has been granted permission to transmit.

q_16307.question: Which TS specification and clause are referenced for the conformance requirements for access identities and access categories in the network when the UE is in the country of its HPLMN?
q_16307.ground_truth: TS 24.501, clause 4.5.2 is referenced for the conformance requirements for access identities and access categories in the network when the UE is in the country of its HPLMN.

q_16308.question: What procedure does the Relay UE initiate when the SMF sends a release message for a Remote UE?
q_16308.ground_truth: The Relay UE initiates a PC5 link release procedure with the Remote UE.

q_16309.question: What values can the certificate advice field take and what do they mean?
q_16309.ground_truth: The certificate advice field can take the following values: 0 (enable all present and future Third Party certificates), 1 (disable all present and future Third Party certificates), 2 (enable present list only), 3 (enable CCM list), and 4 (disable CCM list). All other values are reserved for future use.

q_16310.question: What parameter indicates whether the normal or split mode is used for the TFCI in a cell relative BFN?

q_16311.question: What is the role of the 5G DDNMF in the 5G system?
q_16311.ground_truth: In the 5G system, the 5G DDNMF takes the role of "ProSe Function", replacing the DPF.

q_16312.question: What is the purpose of the STI in the process of Access Transfer of real time media of an IMS session in CS to PS direction or from CS to PS direction when using the I1 reference point for service control of sessions that use CS media?
q_16312.ground_truth: The STI is used to identify the active or held session in the process of Access Transfer.

q_16313.question: What should a 3GPP intermediate node do if it receives an answer with multiple codecs and without the OoBTC Indicator?
q_16313.ground_truth: The 3GPP intermediate node may map the (IETF type) codec list into a 3GPP Selected Codec and Available Codec List and forward this to the preceding node with the OoBTC Indicator.

q_16314.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects in the context of telecommunication management?
q_16314.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects in the context of telecommunication management is responsible for specifying the principles and architecture for telecommunication management in 3G systems.

q_16315.question: What is the function of the Interworking Unit (IWU) in the 3GPP circuit-switched core network?
q_16315.ground_truth: The Interworking Unit (IWU) is a logical entity that interworks SIP-I signalling in the 3GPP CS Domain with other signalling networks such as SIP-I based external networks, ISUP networks, BICC networks, or an IP Multimedia Subsystem.

q_16316.question: What is the purpose of the pre-condition in clause 6.8.2 for the MPS for DTS QoS and media encryption modifications use case?
q_16316.ground_truth: A MPS for DTS session has been successfully established and is active.

q_16317.question: How does the network activate and deactivate PDCP duplication for associated RLC entities?
q_16317.ground_truth: By receiving the Duplication Activation/Deactivation MAC CE or through RRC indication.

q_16318.question: In which message is the "ue-RadioAccessCapability" IE included?
q_16318.ground_truth: The "ue-RadioAccessCapability" IE is included in the RRC CONNECTION SETUP COMPLETE and UE CAPABILITY INFORMATION messages.

q_16319.question: What does RTCP provide in the context of RTP streams?
q_16319.ground_truth: RTCP provides means to feedback statistical characteristics of a received RTP stream from RTP receiver to RTP sender, and to carry RTP stream metadata from RTP sender to RTP receiver.

q_16320.question: What should the UE do if the IE "Uplink DPCH info" is included for FDD, and the "Number of TPC bits" is not included in the received message?
q_16320.ground_truth: The UE should use 2 TPC bits in the Uplink DPCH.

q_16321.question: When a UE accesses an SGSN the first time in a GWCN, how does the SGSN determine a serving CN operator?
q_16321.ground_truth: The SGSN determines a serving CN operator based on the Selected PLMN indicated by the RAN or, for a non-supporting UE, based on the RAN Selected CN operator (PLMN).

q_16322.question: What kind of potential solutions are being studied for F1 interface security for IAB?
q_16322.ground_truth: Solutions for F1 interface security for IAB are being studied for protection of the protocol layers in both control plane and user plane, and ensuring end-to-end security protection to prevent adversary attacks such as packet injection, modification, replay, and eavesdropping.

q_16323.question: What action is responsible for processing push requests that involve provisioning and notifying a set of changes for more than one set of PFDs atomically in the Gw/Gwn interface?
q_16323.ground_truth: A controller resource in push mode is responsible for this action in the Gw/Gwn interface.

q_16324.question: What is the purpose of the "Foreword" section in the 3GPP Technical Specification document?
q_16324.ground_truth: The "Foreword" section in the 3GPP Technical Specification document serves as a disclaimer, stating that the contents may change based on the organization's continuing work and approval process.

q_16325.question: What markup language is used in WAP to create applications for small displays of handheld devices?

q_16326.question: What are the specific steps taken during the 5G-SRVCC handover process from NG-RAN to 3GPP UTRAN?
q_16326.ground_truth: The handover process involves multiple steps, including establishing the PDU session for IMS, triggering 5G-SRVCC HO, sending a Handover Required message with relevant information, determining and selecting an MME_SRVCC, performing PS-CS handover procedure, receiving the response message, and completing the 5G-SRVCC HO command, among others.

q_16327.question: When may the MCVideo service intervene on an ongoing video transmission?
q_16327.ground_truth: The MCVideo service may interrupt the transmission of an MCVideo communication when there is no MCVideo User receiving it and restart it as soon as any affiliated/authorized user wants to receive the MCVideo communication.

q_16328.question: Which solution is feasible for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery over PC5 reference point?
q_16328.ground_truth: Solution #1.2 is feasible for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery over PC5 reference point, including ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery.

q_16329.question: What is the primary focus of the use case for container tracking?
q_16329.ground_truth: The use case for container tracking describes the ability of 5G systems to support the efficient, energy-saving tracking of containers throughout their journeys, making the supply chains more efficient and traceable.

q_16330.question: What message is sent as a response to the SRVCC CS to PS Complete Notification during the UTRAN/GERAN to E-UTRAN/UTRAN (HSPA) SRVCC procedure?
q_16330.ground_truth: A SRVCC CS to PS Complete Acknowledge message

q_16331.question: What is the AMR speech coder composed of?
q_16331.ground_truth: The AMR speech coder consists of a multi-rate speech coder, a source controlled rate scheme including a voice activity detector and a comfort noise generation system, and an error concealment mechanism to combat the effects of transmission errors and lost packets.

q_16332.question: What is the purpose of the IMS Credentials (IMC) in the 3GPP network?
q_16332.ground_truth: The IMS Credentials (IMC) is used for securing IMS access for terminals that do not support 3GPP access technologies or accessing IMS in an SNPN.

q_16333.question: What should the HCS priority be set to for serving cell and all neighbor cells when applying the given rules?
q_16333.ground_truth: The HCS priority should be set to HCS priority1 for serving cell and all neighbor cells.

q_16334.question: What is one of the C2 communication models supported by the 5G system for UAVs?
q_16334.ground_truth: Direct C2, Network-Assisted C2, Network-Assisted dual C2, and UTM-navigated C2 models are some of the C2 communication models supported by the 5G system for UAVs.

q_16335.question: What shall the UE do if it receives the IE "MBMS re- acquire MCCH" in the MBMS MODIFIED SERVICES INFORMATION message?
q_16335.ground_truth: The UE shall perform the MCCH acquisition procedure as specified in subclause 8.7.2.

q_16336.question: What is the role of the RRC layer in the establishment of packet data physical channels?
q_16336.ground_truth: The radio resource management of layer 3 controls the establishment of packet data physical channels on the physical layer, while packet access and radio resource reservation are controlled by the RLC/MAC layer in cooperation with layer 3.

q_16337.question: What value does the maxSMS-AddressStringLength parameter have?
q_16337.ground_truth: The maxSMS-AddressStringLength parameter has a value of 11.

q_16338.question: What is the location of the information flow for "Barring of all incoming calls related authorizations examination"?
q_16338.ground_truth: The location of this function is the HSS/HLR.

q_16339.question: What should the H-GMLC do if it notices that the current visited PLMN does not serve the target area in a deferred LCS service request?
q_16339.ground_truth: The H-GMLC may generate a modified deferred LCS service request to get notified when the target UE enters a PLMN that serves the target area.

q_16340.question: What is the security mechanism used for mutual authentication in UMTS/LTE network?
q_16340.ground_truth: UMTS/EPS AKA, a challenge response protocol.

q_16341.question: In the context of FDD, what should the Node B do if the E-DCH Processing Overload Level IE is included, and the Node B could not decode the E-DPCCH/E-DPDCH for the last consecutive number of TTIs, indicated in the E-DCH Processing Overload Level IE, because of processing issue?
q_16341.ground_truth: The Node B should notify the RNC by initiating the Radio Link Failure procedure.

q_16342.question: What type of video coding features does H.265 (HEVC) include for lossless coding and efficient screen content coding?
q_16342.ground_truth: H.265 (HEVC) includes features such as lossless coding that allows certain parts of the coded picture to be coded in a lossless manner, and screen content coding that includes tools to better code computer generated screen content, such as skipping the transform coding for certain blocks. These features are useful for specific use cases such as streaming the user-interface of a mobile device to a large display.

q_16343.question: What is the TI flag value for the EVENT DOWNLOAD - CALL CONNECTED command in the Call Connected Event test?
q_16343.ground_truth: The TI flag value for the EVENT DOWNLOAD - CALL CONNECTED command in the Call Connected Event test is 1 (bit 8).

q_16344.question: What is the condition to achieve the confidence level in the NR RSTD measurement accuracy test case for single positioning frequency layer with reduced number of samples in FR2 SA?
q_16344.ground_truth: The confidence level is achieved when the test passes the set number of times based on the confidence level and the rate of successful tests during repeated tests. In this test case, the rate of successful tests during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

q_16345.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of the Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN)?
q_16345.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between groups of telecommunications standardization bodies, to develop technical specifications for mobile networks. The Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) is responsible for the development of technical specifications for radio access network of 3GPP.

q_16346.question: Which 3GPP specification describes the EPS fallback procedure for IMS voice?

q_16347.question: What is the name of the message that the source GANC sends to the SGSN to indicate that it needs to perform a PS handover?

q_16348.question: What is the minimum C/I ratio at which the four highest AMR codec modes are at least equivalent to the EFR in error-free conditions?
q_16348.ground_truth: The four highest AMR codec modes are at least equivalent to the EFR in error-free conditions down to 10 dB C/I.

q_16349.question: What does the mobile station do during inactive periods in extended uplink TBF mode?
q_16349.ground_truth: The mobile station may stop sending RLC data blocks and continue allocating uplink radio blocks during the inactive period.

q_16350.question: When is the use of separate entities for SNPN authentication necessary?
q_16350.ground_truth: Studying 5GS enhancements specifically for SNPN with credentials owned by an entity separate from the SNPN is necessary to support main use cases for Non-Public Networks, such as wireless connectivity for industry, large residential buildings, campuses, malls, and merged SNPNs, where multiple separate entities are involved in the process. This allows for better network selection, authentication signaling exchanges, and architectural enhancements.

q_16351.question: What information does the DRNS use to optimize capacity allocation for the related E-DCH Logical Channel when adding/deleting E-DCH MAC-d flows?
q_16351.ground_truth: The Maximum MAC-d PDU Size Extended IE for a E-DCH Logical Channel is used by the DRNS to optimize capacity allocation, if it is included in the E-DCH MAC-d Flows To Add IE.

q_16352.question: Which three sources of potential delays are considered in the analysis of satellite delays in the 5G system?
q_16352.ground_truth: The three sources of potential delays are ground to satellite, inter-satellite link, and satellite to ground.

q_16353.question: When using FR1, Urban Macro, DL, with single stream traffic model, 45Mbps data rate, and SU-MIMO, what is the capacity performance range and mean capacity performance with PDB increase from 10ms to 15ms?
q_16353.ground_truth: The range of capacity performance is 4.4~5.4 UEs per cell, and the mean capacity performance is 5 UEs per cell with 45Mbps and 15ms PDB.

q_16354.question: What is the required measurement period for UTRAN GPS Timing of Cell Frames for UP measurement as per section 9.2.1.9?
q_16354.ground_truth: The measurement period for UTRAN GPS Timing of Cell Frames for UP measurement is 1 second.

q_16355.question: What is the function of the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) in the MBS service context?
q_16355.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) receives NAS indications from the UE containing MBS TMGI indication. Based on this information, the AMF forwards the UE's MBS context message to the NG-RAN or SMF and classifies UEs within the MBS service area based on their service interest into different MBS service groups associated with a QoS profile.

q_16356.question: What is the name of the document produced by the 3GPP that outlines channel models for deployment evaluation?
q_16356.ground_truth: The name of the document is "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network; Deployment aspects (Release 17)".

q_16357.question: In 4.6F, what is the HS-SICH type 1 information field mapping?
q_16357.ground_truth: In 4.6F, the HS-SICH type 1 information field mapping specifies the mapping of the recommended modulation format (RMF), recommended transport-block size (RTBS), and hybrid-ARQ information ACK/NACK to physical channels for 1.28 Mcps TDD.

q_16358.question: How many bits are there in a 3GPP PDTCH block type 39, with a PAN included?

q_16359.question: What is the test criteria for the destination number triggering criterion when it is enabling?
q_16359.ground_truth: When the destination number triggering criterion is enabling, the gsmSSF may establish a dialogue with the gsmSCF if the destination number matches one of the destination number strings defined in the list or the length of the destination number matches one of the destination number lengths defined in the list. The destination number matches one of the destination number strings in the list if the nature of address of the destination number is the same as the nature of address of the destination number string, the destination number is at least as long as the destination number string in the list, and all the digits in the destination number string in the list match the leading digits of the destination number.

q_16360.question: What is the purpose of the "partition criteria" parameter in the NWDAF Event Exposure service?
q_16360.ground_truth: The "partition criteria" parameter is used by the NF to group UEs before applying the sampling ratio in the NWDAF Event Reporting Information service.

q_16361.question: What does bit 7 in octet 5 indicate in the case of speech or speech + CTM Text Telephony?
q_16361.ground_truth: Bit 7 in octet 5 indicates the permitted speech version identifier when octet 3 indicates speech or speech + CTM Text Telephony.

q_16362.question: What is one possible criterion for reporting segment delay at a detailed level?
q_16362.ground_truth: One possible criterion for reporting segment delay at a detailed level is to only report segments that arrive later than a certain delay threshold (e.g. >0 ms, report only late segments).

q_16363.question: What is the role of AMF in the multicast service of 5G?
q_16363.ground_truth: AMF is responsible for accepting or rejecting MB Session Join Request from UE, performing area restriction in handover scenario, and sending a NAS MB Session Remove message to a UE if it receives a N2 MB Session Remove message from NG-RAN.

q_16364.question: What is the name of the optional extension of the PCRF-based P-CSCF restoration mechanism?
q_16364.ground_truth: The optional extension avoids the IMS PDN deactivation and reactivation.

q_16365.question: How many symbols are in the higher symbol rate burst (HB)?
q_16365.ground_truth: The higher symbol rate burst contains 138 encrypted symbols and includes a guard time of 10.5 reduced symbol periods.

q_16366.question: What interfaces are used between S-GW and PDN~GW in the Evolved Packet Core?
q_16366.ground_truth: The S5 and S8-interfaces are used between S-GW and PDN~GW in the Evolved Packet Core.

q_16367.question: How does the solution address the issue of QoS differentiation for UAV operations?
q_16367.ground_truth: The solution proposes that the 3GPP system retrieves the up-to-date QoS requirements from the USS/UTM during the UP connectivity establishment procedure for C2 communication, allowing for QoS differentiation for UAV operations.

q_16368.question: In what circumstances will the UE check for a matching criterion for any ongoing PDU session or service in the new SOR-CMCI?
q_16368.ground_truth: While one or more Tsor-cm timers are running, upon receiving a new SOR-CMCI without the list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations, the UE shall check if there is a matching criterion found for any ongoing PDU session or service in the new SOR-CMCI.

q_16369.question: What actions are taken if the LRF (Location Retrieval Function) needs a location estimate for the UE after handover has occurred?
q_16369.ground_truth: If the LRF needs a location estimate for the UE after handover, it may instigate an MT-LR request via either the target GMLC or a target E-SLP, depending on the location solution used on the target side.

q_16370.question: What is the requirement for input intermodulation for the Repeater?
q_16370.ground_truth: The input intermodulation for the Repeater shall not increase the power in the pass band with more than 10 dB at the output of the Repeater as measured in the center of the pass band, compared to the level obtained without interfering signals applied.

q_16371.question: Which supplementary services belong to the call restriction supplementary services and are described in this specification?
q_16371.ground_truth: The call restriction supplementary services that are described in this specification include Barring of outgoing calls (BAOC, BOIC, BOIC-exHC) and Barring of incoming calls (BAIC, BIC-Roam), as well as Anonymous Call Rejection (ACR).

q_16372.question: What is the responsibility of the AUSF in the solution?
q_16372.ground_truth: The AUSF is responsible for the ProSe key management function in the solution, including generating P-KID and deriving KR using at least Kausf, relay service code, KR freshness parameter, and Nonce 1 as input.

q_16373.question: What is the role of the role management in FRMCS, when the other Key Management application is attached to the GSM-R system?
q_16373.ground_truth: The role management in FRMCS provides the appropriate address or identity for routing the data communication, by mapping GSM-R identities and FRMCS identities.

q_16374.question: In the provided scenario, what functions are specified in the "Identity Check Procedures" clause of TS 23.060 and what is their optional nature?
q_16374.ground_truth: The "Identity Check Procedures" clause of TS 23.060 defines equipment checking functions, which are optional.

q_16375.question: What message must the UE transmit in response to the LPP REQUEST LOCATION INFORMATION message from the SS?
q_16375.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit a LPP PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION message including the NR-Multi-RTT-ProvideLocationInformation IE within the response time.

q_16376.question: What information does the DRNS use to determine the transport bearer characteristics for the related DCH or set of co-ordinated DCHs in the uplink?
q_16376.ground_truth: The DRNS uses the Traffic Class IE and the TNL QoS IE to determine the transport bearer characteristics for the related DCH or set of co-ordinated DCHs in the uplink.

q_16377.question: What is the first mechanism used for in HSCSD when there are more downlink slots than uplink slots?
q_16377.ground_truth: The first mechanism, Multi-slot mechanism 1, is used to loop the TCH data of a downlink slot onto the TCH of the main uplink slot when there are more downlink slots than uplink slots in HSCSD.

q_16378.question: What happens when the UE does not respond to the first paging attempt in Solution #18?
q_16378.ground_truth: If the UE does not respond to the first paging attempt, then a second paging attempt is made and the paging is repeated on two consecutive POs.

q_16379.question: What is the format of the Initializing Message for the M2AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE mbmsSchedulingInformation?

q_16380.question: What network protocols are required for the non-transparent MP-QUIC solution as defined in solution #8?
q_16380.ground_truth: The IETF protocol required for the non-transparent MP-QUIC solution is "The CONNECT-UDP HTTP Method" (IETF draft-ietf-masque-connect-udp).

q_16381.question: Which three identifiers can be used to select a new FRMCS User in the "Transfer of an incoming voice communication" use case?
q_16381.ground_truth: The new FRMCS User can be selected based on the FRMCS User Identity, FRMCS Functional Identity, or MSISDN.

q_16382.question: What is one of the options for providing a continuous, linear content stream for TV services in Full MBMS Service Mode?
q_16382.ground_truth: A TV content provider creates a continuous, linear content stream composed of a sequence of individual programs, advertisements, and other components.

q_16383.question: What message does the SAS send to the SRNC when sending the final location estimate to the CN?
q_16383.ground_truth: The SAS sends the final location estimate in a PCAP Position Initiation Response message to the SRNC, and the SRNC forwards the final location information to the CN.

q_16384.question: What is the role of the authorization token in PoC communication?
q_16384.ground_truth: The authorization token, delivered in the INVITE request or 200OK response, is used to authorize the session set-up between the terminals.

q_16385.question: What are the assumed values for the orthogonality factor in macrocells and microcells?
q_16385.ground_truth: The assumed values for the orthogonality factor in macrocells is 0.4 and in microcells is 0.06.

q_16386.question: What does the TDD DL DPCH Time Slot Format LCR IE provide for 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_16386.ground_truth: The TDD DL DPCH Time Slot Format LCR IE provides the time slot formats used in DL DPCH for 1.28Mcps TDD.

q_16387.question: What is the behavior of a terminal when presented with an unknown profile indicator or profile 255?
q_16387.ground_truth: A terminal presented with an unknown profile or profile 255 should assume it does not support the features required by the indicated profile.

q_16388.question: What should the mobile station do upon receiving the first IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message?
q_16388.ground_truth: The mobile station should discard the first IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message received.

q_16389.question: How can NWDAF assist in smart city applications?
q_16389.ground_truth: NWDAF can assist in smart city applications by providing analytics related to pedestrian or vehicle movement patterns and traffic information. These analytics can be used by Transportation Application Platform to make final decision-making and execution to alleviate urban traffic congestion.

q_16390.question: In what situations would the IP source address range of the IP flow described by the rule be equal to the address contained in "StartSourceIPaddress"?
q_16390.ground_truth: The IP source address range of the IP flow described by the rule would be equal to the address contained in "StartSourceIPaddress" if the "EndSourceIPaddress" leaf is absent.

q_16391.question: What is the transport layer protocol used in the S1 signalling bearer?
q_16391.ground_truth: SCTP (IETF RFC 4960) shall be used as the transport layer of the S1-MME signalling bearer in the E-UTRAN network.

q_16392.question: What type of information is included in the v7f0NonCriticalExtensions field?
q_16392.ground_truth: The v7f0NonCriticalExtensions field includes information about ue-RadioAccessCapability-v7f0ext and other optional fields related to the release 7f0 extension.

q_16393.question: What is the mode in which the MS measures the received RF signal strength of neighbour cells?
q_16393.ground_truth: The MS measures the received RF signal strength of neighbour cells in the network control mode NC2, when it is in Cell Change Notification (CCN) mode, or when performing PEO and EC operation.

q_16394.question: What is the impact of queuing on the end-to-end latency of a 25 fps camera mounted to a vehicle driving 90 km/h?
q_16394.ground_truth: Queuing can cause an increasing delay in the camera, as packets will start to become queued up in the radio interface.

q_16395.question: In the context of PTC modification, what information is included in the GA-RRC MODIFY CHANNEL message transmitted by the GANC?
q_16395.ground_truth: The GA-RRC MODIFY CHANNEL message transmitted by the GANC includes the IE "CN Domain Identity" (indicating PS domain) and IE "PTC Modification List", which includes the necessary parameters for modifying each packet transport channel.

q_16396.question: What action is taken by the network after the establishment of a voice group call, regarding the inclusion of remaining voice group call downlink channels and alerting related dispatchers?
q_16396.ground_truth: The network continues to try to include all remaining voice group call downlink channels and alert related dispatchers not yet alerted.

q_16397.question: What is the main problem discussed in the video transmission issue cases in the document?
q_16397.ground_truth: The main problem discussed is that video services that LTE operators have no control over, named "Over-The-Top" (OTT) video, may be transmitted via default bearer, which can lead to poor QoE. However, the QoS framework allows assignment of dedicated QCI for video.

q_16398.question: What message is sent by ProSe Function A to ProSe Function B in the ProSe EPC-level Discovery Proximity Request message flow to indicate a proximity alert for UE B?
q_16398.ground_truth: The Proximity Request message sent by ProSe Function A to ProSe Function B in the ProSe EPC-level Discovery Proximity Request message flow indicates if a Proximity Alert has been triggered for UE B.

q_16399.question: What should the USS do after receiving the RoutingAreaUpdateRequest message from the UE during registration, and the UE is registered on the 246/081/0002 cell?
q_16399.ground_truth: The USS should initiate authentication, start integrity by using the security procedure, and send the RoutingAreaUpdateAccept message to the UE.

q_16400.question: How can IMS leverage 5G support for edge computing in the 5GC?
q_16400.ground_truth: IMS can leverage 5G support for edge computing by making use of computing resources located close to the edge of the network. This can enable enhanced services for users, such as the storage and retrieval of IMS videos for playback on UE devices in a specific venue. It may require the addition of IMS and 5G support for edge computing capabilities, as well as the identification of localized IMS applications and management of IMS applications outside the local PLMN.

q_16401.question: What does the SDS feature refer to in the context of the MCData service?
q_16401.ground_truth: The SDS feature of the MCData service refers to a basic protocol carrying a limited size, variable content, message that can be used for one-to-one or group messaging.

q_16402.question: What are the time synchronization capabilities that are obtained from the NEF server?
q_16402.ground_truth: The time synchronization capabilities that are obtained from the NEF server include support for time synchronization, supported time synchronization methods, supported (g)PTP versions, minimum time synchronization accuracy supported, and maximum number of clients that can be supported.

q_16403.question: When does the entering condition for event B2, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.4.9, consist of both condition B2-1 and condition B2-2 being satisfied?
q_16403.ground_truth: The entering condition for event B2 is satisfied if both conditions B2-1 and B2-2 are fulfilled. Condition B2-1 is met if Mp + Hys < Thresh1, and condition B2-2 is met if Mn + Ofn + Ocn > Thresh2.

q_16404.question: What assistance information does the SMLC include in the RRLP Positioning Multilateration Timing Advance Request message for the MS to perform the Multilateration Timing Advance procedure?
q_16404.ground_truth: The SMLC includes multiple sets of co-sited cells in the RRLP Positioning Multilateration Timing Advance Request message, which the MS shall take into account when performing the Multilateration Timing Advance procedure, as well as neighboring cells to avoid using during the procedure.

q_16405.question: What must the network do if it wants to add a packet filter to a TFT with the Secondary PDP Context Activation Procedure and the resulting TFT will not include any uplink packet filter among the network-controlled packet filters?
q_16405.ground_truth: The network must add a packet filter that effectively disallows any useful packet flows in the uplink direction.

q_16406.question: What is the effect of activating CFU after CCNR has been requested on the same user?
q_16406.ground_truth: The CCNR request is cancelled and a notification "CCNR cancelled" is sent to the user.

q_16407.question: What are the standard positioning methods supported within the UTRAN?
q_16407.ground_truth: The standard positioning methods supported within UTRAN include Cell ID based method, OTDOA method, network-assisted GNSS methods, U-TDOA, Barometric Pressure method, WLAN method, Bluetooth method, and Terrestrial Beacon System methods.

q_16408.question: When shall the MS indicate the selected downlink CC to the network?
q_16408.ground_truth: The MS shall indicate the selected downlink CC using the Selected DL Coverage Class field in the EC Packet Channel Request message, in advance of the next occurrence of the paging group of the MS, and at least if any of the following conditions are fulfilled: the selected downlink CC is higher than the last downlink CC communicated to the network, the selected downlink CC is CC1 and the last downlink CC communicated to the network is CC4, or the MS has completed an uplink data transfer in a cell not supporting EC-GSM-IoT since the last time it communicated a downlink CC to the network.

q_16409.question: What is an essential component of the content re-targeting operation that is typically not available as part of the original stereo content?
q_16409.ground_truth: The depth map, which is extracted by estimating the disparity map through a dense stereo matching operation.

q_16410.question: When is the VAL server responsible for initiating the group creation notification towards UEs?
q_16410.ground_truth: The VAL server is responsible for initiating the group creation notification towards UEs when the identity list in the created group does not have a group management client on the UE.

q_16411.question: What information elements should be included in the GA-RC REGISTER REQUEST message if the MS is in an area with GSM coverage and connects via an AP over the unlicensed radio?
q_16411.ground_truth: The GERAN Cell Identity, Location Area Identification, 3G Cell Identity, and Routing Area Code should be included in the GA-RC REGISTER REQUEST message if the MS is in an area with GSM coverage and connects via an AP over the unlicensed radio.

q_16412.question: What are the quantities that the UE shall report in an intra-frequency measurement when the event is triggered in a UTRAN system?
q_16412.ground_truth: The quantities can include SFN-SFN observed time difference, cell synchronization information, cell identity, downlink Ec/N0, downlink path loss, downlink received signal code power, and ISCP measured on timeslot basis.

q_16413.question: What is the AUSF's action in step 7b if successful authentication verification is achieved and an AMF slice serving capability unknown was received from AMF/SEAF in step 2?
q_16413.ground_truth: The AUSF holds the UE security context until an acknowledgment is received from the initial AMF/SEAF that it is capable of serving the UE. Alternatively, the AUSF can provide security context as in the existing system and send AMF serving capability check required indication and slice isolation required indication.

q_16414.question: What should the SIP re-INVITE request contain to be considered a valid request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call cancellation?
q_16414.ground_truth: The SIP re-INVITE request should contain an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true" for a valid request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call cancellation.

q_16415.question: How does the usage of SVC improve the performance of the system in terms of cache-hit-ratio compared to the use of MR-VoD?
q_16415.ground_truth: The usage of SVC improves the performance of the system in terms of cache-hit-ratio compared to the use of MR-VoD by efficiently utilizing the available resources.

q_16416.question: Under what conditions may a mobile station in broadcast/multicast receive mode receive a notification of a lower priority MBMS session and act upon it in parallel with higher priority MBMS sessions?
q_16416.ground_truth: The mobile station may receive a lower priority MBMS session in parallel with the higher priority MBMS sessions if its capabilities allow it, and if the requirements defined in sub-clause 8.1.5.2.1 are fulfilled.

q_16417.question: Which UEs should implement UEA0, UEA1, and UEA2?
q_16417.ground_truth: UEs should implement UEA0, UEA1, and UEA2.

q_16418.question: What should a MS do if it does not find a matching response and is not sending an exception report?
q_16418.ground_truth: If a MS does not find a matching response and is not sending an exception report, it should examine the Implicit Reject Status (IRS) field sent as part of the EC-SCH INFORMATION message. If the IRS field indicates the access attempt is rejected, the MS shall abort the packet access procedure and initiate the EC Implicit Reject procedure.

q_16419.question: What is the scrambling sequence used for the NPDSCH in the NB-IoT system?
q_16419.ground_truth: The scrambling sequence used for the NPDSCH is initialized with specific values based on whether the NPDSCH is carrying the BCCH or not, and whether it is being transmitted in frame structure type 1 or 2. It is used to randomize the data before it is transmitted to the UE.

q_16420.question: What are the two alternative RACH uplink/uplink access burst block formats specified in 3GPP TS 44.060?
q_16420.ground_truth: The two alternative RACH uplink/uplink access burst block formats are 8~bit (1~octet) blocks and 11 bit blocks.

q_16421.question: What is the frame structure type 1 subframe used for the transmission of NPDCCH and NRS?
q_16421.ground_truth: Subframe 0 and 4 for frame structure type 1 are used for the transmission of NRS, while subframe 9 is used for NPDCCH transmission.

q_16422.question: What action does the V-PCRF take when a new S9 subsession is created?
q_16422.ground_truth: If new subsessions are created, the V-PCRF includes within the Subsession-Enforcement-Info AVP, the Subsession-Id AVP set to the value of a new subsession identifier, and the Subsession-Operation AVP set to the value "ESTABLISHMENT".

q_16423.question: What are the three GTT Host environments defined in the specification for text transmission?
q_16423.ground_truth: The three GTT Host environments are IP Multimedia based on IETF RFC 3261 (SIP), Circuit Switched Multimedia based on 3G.324, and Circuit Switched voice channel.

q_16424.question: What is the Test Tolerance (TT) for regulatory receiver directional requirements for OTA RX IMD?
q_16424.ground_truth: The Test Tolerance (TT) for regulatory receiver directional requirements for OTA RX IMD is zero.

q_16425.question: How is the global gain estimated in the process?
q_16425.ground_truth: The global gain is estimated by computing the energy of each block of 4 coefficients, and then performing a bisection search with a final resolution of 0.125dB to find the optimal gain.

q_16426.question: What is the purpose of the Terminal Endpoint Identifiers (TEI) on the A-bis interface?
q_16426.ground_truth: The Terminal Endpoint Identifiers (TEI) are used to address the different units on the A-bis interface for signalling links. The same unit may have more than one functional entity, with logical links between them identified by functional addresses called Service Access Points Identifiers (SAPI).

q_16427.question: What is the XML Definitions Solution Set in the SuM NRM IRP?
q_16427.ground_truth: The 3GPP SuM NRM IRP XML Definitions Solution Set (defined in Annex A) specifies the XML definitions used in the SuM NRM IRP.

q_16428.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives a downlink assignment for this PDCCH occasion and this serving cell on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's C-RNTI or Temporary C-RNTI and has not received a downlink assignment for this PDCCH occasion and another serving cell on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's C-RNTI or Temporary C-RNTI?
q_16428.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the NDI to have been toggled, indicate the presence of a downlink assignment, and deliver the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity.

q_16429.question: What is the purpose of the Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the EPC NRM?
q_16429.ground_truth: The Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the EPC NRM is the interface that is used to access the information defined by the NRM. It is used to communicate between an IRPAgent and an IRPManager for telecommunication network management purposes, including management of converged networks.

q_16430.question: How are the adjusted time envelopes encoded in the case of TRANSIENT frames?
q_16430.ground_truth: The adjusted time envelopes are rounded and quantized with four bits using uniform scalar quantization.

q_16431.question: What is the difference between a Managed Object (MO), a Managed Object Class (MOC), and a Managed Object Instance (MOI) in the context of 3GPP TS 32.661?
q_16431.ground_truth: A Managed Object (MO) is an abstract entity representing a network resource for management purposes, accessible through an open interface between two or more systems. A Managed Object Class (MOC) is a description of all the common characteristics for a number of MOs, such as their attributes, operations, notifications, and behavior. A Managed Object Instance (MOI) is an instance of a MOC, which is the same as a MO.

q_16432.question: What are the arguments against partial ciphering in GSM/GPRS networks?
q_16432.ground_truth: It requires changes to the BTS, which is considered unwelcome due to cost

q_16433.question: What happens to the downlink EC TBF when the uplink EC TBF is established in EC operation?
q_16433.ground_truth: The downlink EC TBF is released at the establishment of the uplink EC TBF.

q_16434.question: What action is triggered by the application client in the UE after receiving the Target RPAUIDs from the ProSe Application Server?
q_16434.ground_truth: The application client in the UE triggers the UE to perform the ProSe query procedure, providing its own RPAUID and the Target RPAUIDs.

q_16435.question: What is the length of the synchronization preamble used in the uplink waveform?
q_16435.ground_truth: The synchronization preamble is 1568 samples, or 196 ms, long.

q_16436.question: What does the MSGin5G Server do when it receives a registration request with a present AS service ID?
q_16436.ground_truth: The MSGin5G server considers it as an update registration, and includes the AS service ID and the newest UE list in the registration response.

q_16437.question: How does the EVS-SWB codec perform in mixed/music rate switching performance under clean channel and impaired channel conditions?
q_16437.ground_truth: The EVS-SWB performance is significantly better than the corresponding reference condition both under clean channel and under impaired channel for mixed/music content.

q_16438.question: What is the maximum number of radio frames within the transmission time intervals of all transport channels that are multiplexed into the same CCTrCH during a handover procedure that uses the TDD options?
q_16438.ground_truth: Fmax denotes the maximum number of radio frames within the transmission time intervals of all transport channels that are multiplexed into the same CCTrCH.

q_16439.question: What criteria must be met for satisfactory coexistence between two communication systems in the same geographical area?
q_16439.ground_truth: The two criteria are that the interfering transmitter's out of band emission received by the affected receiver is sufficiently below the affected receiver's noise floor, and the total interfering carrier power attenuated by the affected receiver's filters is sufficiently below the affected receiver's noise floor.

q_16440.question: What does the Edge Enabler Client determine in the first step of the Edge Enabler Client triggered application context relocation solution?
q_16440.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Client determines if the application context for the UE needs to be relocated based on the EDN service area and UE location information.

q_16441.question: What information does the break signal octet carry in a data stream for the DLC?
q_16441.ground_truth: The break signal octet carries information about a break signal detected in the data stream for the DLC.

q_16442.question: What information does the DNS AF check to determine if edge breakout is needed in step 2 of the detailed procedure using ECS option?
q_16442.ground_truth: The DNS AF checks if the App (FQDN) is under an SLA agreement for Edge and if an App Session Context exits for this IP in PCF, meaning that there is edge breakout already applied for an UE session.

q_16443.question: What conditions does the O-MGCF need to consider for the mapping of IAM to the INVITE request if Call Diversion services within the ISUP Network appeared?
q_16443.ground_truth: Additional procedures beyond the basic call and interworking procedures are needed in this case.

q_16444.question: How are the registers used to keep track of the history of SAD1-related decisions?
q_16444.ground_truth: The registers are updated to reflect the latest frames with regard to the decisions by removing the oldest decision and adding the latest, and updating to reflect the current number of active frames in the registers.

q_16445.question: What should a mobile station do if it receives a downlink assignment message with an invalid Frequency Parameters information element?
q_16445.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with system information, releasing the newly reserved resources and performing a partial acquisition of system information messages containing frequency information.

q_16446.question: What is the purpose of Common TA offset in NTN?
q_16446.ground_truth: Common TA offset is used to compensate for the propagation delay in NTNs by allowing the UE sufficient processing time between a downlink reception and an uplink transmission.

q_16447.question: What message does the DRNC send to the SRNC to inform that resources for CN domain have been released due to a failure of the enhanced relocation?

q_16448.question: What is the role of the AF and application domain controllers in determining the anycast IP route information for forwarding application packets from the UE to the "closest" application server?
q_16448.ground_truth: The AF and application domain controllers use N6 network measurements provided by OAM, along with other application domain policy for determining the anycast IP route information. This information is derived and pushed to N6 routers corresponding to EAS instances provisioned by the application domain.

q_16449.question: What should be the Squal value for a cell to be considered during cell reselection to a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency?
q_16449.ground_truth: The Squal value for a cell should be greater than ThreshX, LowQ during a time interval TreselectionRAT for it to be considered during cell reselection to a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency.

q_16450.question: What is the initialization value for the pseudo-random sequence generator to generate the NPRS sequence, and what is its significance?
q_16450.ground_truth: The initialization value for the pseudo-random sequence generator to generate the NPRS sequence is given by . It indicates the slot number within a radio frame and the OFDM symbol number within the slot. This value is used to ensure different NPRS sequences for different cells and subframes.

q_16451.question: What action shall be taken if a DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message is received with errors?
q_16451.ground_truth: A DTM ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message with cause "Protocol error unspecified" shall be returned immediately, and no further action will be taken.

q_16452.question: What are the general results of the commands performed?
q_16452.ground_truth: The first and third commands were performed successfully but the second command was performed successfully but with an unsuccessful request for an icon display.

q_16453.question: What is the purpose of the document "3GPP TS 37.571-3: User Equipment (UE) conformance specification for UE positioning; Part 3: Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS)"?
q_16453.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide the Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) proforma for UTRAN, E-UTRAN and NR User Equipment (UE) supporting UE positioning, in compliance with the relevant requirements, and in accordance with the relevant guidance given in ISO/IEC 9646-1 and ISO/IEC 9646-7.

q_16454.question: What information is used by the GGSN to indicate to the SGSN if a RNC has accepted IP multicast distribution in a MBMS Distribution Acknowledgement field?
q_16454.ground_truth: The MBMS Distribution Acknowledgement field can take on three values: a) all RNCs have accepted IP multicast distribution, b) no RNCs have accepted IP multicast distribution, or c) some RNCs have accepted IP multicast distribution.

q_16455.question: What should be the value of the stream identifier in the SETUP message if the network supports multicall and there are no other ongoing calls?
q_16455.ground_truth: The value of the stream identifier shall be equal to 1.

q_16456.question: What is the maximum allowed power for UE transmission on Primary and Secondary uplink frequencies when the UE has more than one Activated Uplink Frequency in FDD?
q_16456.ground_truth: The maximum allowed power for UE transmission on Primary Uplink Frequency is the sum of the power pre-allocated for all non-empty non-scheduled MAC-d flows and the power P(i) as a result of the power splitting for this frequency. For the Secondary Uplink Frequency, the maximum allowed power for UE transmission is the resulting P(i) power for this frequency.

q_16457.question: What should the MAC entity do when a PDCCH for BWP switching is received during an ongoing Random Access procedure on that serving cell?
q_16457.ground_truth: If the PDCCH for BWP switching is received while an ongoing Random Access procedure is ongoing, the MAC entity should stop the ongoing Random Access procedure and initiate a new Random Access procedure after performing the BWP switching.

q_16458.question: What is the role of the FRMCS security server in sharing FRMCS Equipment by FRMCS Users?
q_16458.ground_truth: The FRMCS security server confirms the user identification and provides authentication information to the trainborne UE to register the train driver as the user of the trainborne UE to relay a call.

q_16459.question: What is the parameter associated with the DL-RANDOM ACCESS-REQUEST primitives?
q_16459.ground_truth: The parameter associated with the DL-RANDOM ACCESS-REQUEST primitives is the random access message unit.

q_16460.question: What is the function of the De-multiplexing entity in Dual Cell E-DCH operation and 1.28 Mcps TDD Multi-Carrier E-DCH operation?
q_16460.ground_truth: In Dual Cell E-DCH operation, there is one De-multiplexing entity per E-DCH transport channel, and in 1.28 Mcps TDD Multi-Carrier E-DCH operation, there is one De-multiplexing entity for all E-DCH transport channels per UE.

q_16461.question: What is the role of an NGCN-to-NGCN relationship in the NGN business model?
q_16461.ground_truth: An NGCN-to-NGCN relationship represents a relationship between two NGCNs that may belong to different operators or represent parts of the same NGCN. This relationship is used to create communications in some scenarios, and both NGCNs have their own relationship with an NGN.

q_16462.question: What do the MSGin5G server provide to the Application Server for delivering a message to a recipient?
q_16462.ground_truth: The MSGin5G server provides the Application-to-Point Message Delivery API to the Application Server for delivering a message to a recipient.

q_16463.question: What are some trust models that can be used to establish a trust relationship between a MnS consumer and producer in a 3GPP management system?
q_16463.ground_truth: Some trust models include validated trust, direct historical trust, mediated trust, mandated trust, hybrid trust, direct trust, transitive trust, and delegating trust.

q_16464.question: What is the purpose of the "TrBk concatenation / Code block segmentation" step in the 3GPP TS?
q_16464.ground_truth: The "TrBk concatenation / Code block segmentation" step in the 3GPP TS is used to divide transport blocks into smaller code blocks, if necessary, before applying channel coding. This step can also involve the concatenation of multiple transport blocks into a single block, if required.

q_16465.question: What does the "AuthorizedV2XServiceList" node contain, and what is its significance in this authorization list?
q_16465.ground_truth: The "AuthorizedV2XServiceList" node contains V2X services identified by a V2X service identifier that are authorized for V2X communication over LTE-Uu. This node is significant as it specifies which V2X services are allowed to communicate over this network.

q_16466.question: What should be the operation of the ME in Expected Sequence 5.1, as defined in clause 27.22.4.23.5.4.2?
q_16466.ground_truth: The ME shall operate in the manner defined in expected sequence 5.1, which is to respond to an AT Command contained within a RUN AT COMMAND with UCS2 alpha identifier presented in Chinese.

q_16467.question: What is the maximum length supported by the system for a RAN-INFORMATION/Initial Multiple Report PDU in MBMS data channel?
q_16467.ground_truth: "RAN-INFORMATION/Initial Multiple Report or RAN-INFORMATION/Single Report PDU exceeds the maximum supported length" is one of the causes for sending an Application Error Container IE in MBMS data channel.

q_16468.question: What will the UE do if the list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations is received in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message while in the manual PLMN selection mode?
q_16468.ground_truth: The UE will not modify the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list in this case.

q_16469.question: What is the function of the "div" function in the arithmetic operations?
q_16469.ground_truth: The "div" function performs the fractional integer division of var1 by var2, where var1 and var2 are positive and var2 is greater than or equal to var1. The result is a positive (leading bit equal to 0) and truncated to 16-bits.

q_16470.question: What is the meaning of "E-RAB" as used in the context of the document?

q_16471.question: Why is it preferred to use the end-to-end architecture for message screening, if protection mode 1 is agreed upon by the communicating PLMNs?
q_16471.ground_truth: From a security point of view, using the end-to-end architecture for message screening is preferred when protection mode 1 is agreed upon by the communicating PLMNs, as it provides better protection against spoofing and unauthorized access.

q_16472.question: When is the SGSN required to adjust the mobile reachable timer and/or implicit detach timer to minimize unneeded signalling after the Mobility Management back-off timer expires?
q_16472.ground_truth: If the SGSN rejects a Routing Area Update Request or a Service Request with a Mobility Management back-off timer which is larger than the sum of the MS's periodic RA Update timer plus the implicit detach timer.

q_16473.question: What are the three features that are relevant to the specific TAFs for facsimile service in the Error Correction mode?
q_16473.ground_truth: The three features that are relevant to the specific TAFs for facsimile service in the Error Correction mode are the additional HDLC frame to be detected, the handling of the Message phase, and the modification of the Channel rate (CMM request).

q_16474.question: What is one of the functions of the RLC layer in EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT?
q_16474.ground_truth: The RLC layer in EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT is responsible for storing soft values of erroneous RLC data blocks and combining them with the retransmitted RLC data blocks in incremental redundancy (IR) mode.

q_16475.question: What does an Iub DCH Data Port represent in the UTRAN network?
q_16475.ground_truth: An Iub DCH Data Port represents one user plane transport bearer, which carries only one DCH data stream, except in the case of coordinated DCHs where data streams are multiplexed on one user plane transport bearer.

q_16476.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of attempted codec modification requests originated from MSC-S, including those executed during mid-call negotiation procedures?

q_16477.question: When can the CSE invoke CAMEL warning tones for a SCUDIF call?
q_16477.ground_truth: The CAMEL warning tone may be ordered by the CSE if the selected service is not multi media at the time of tone connection.

q_16478.question: What happening does the 'StartRIT' operation type represent in LLP?
q_16478.ground_truth: The 'StartRIT' operation type in LLP is invoked by the network to request RIT measurement information from an LMU.

q_16479.question: In the context of FDD, what must the DRNC include in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message when the Transport Bearer Not Requested Indicator IE is not included for an E-DCH MAC-d flow being established?
q_16479.ground_truth: The Binding ID IE and Transport Layer Address IE must be included for the establishment of a transport bearer for every E-DCH MAC-d flow being established.

q_16480.question: What is the required format of the source and destination device identifier in the call control communication process?
q_16480.ground_truth: The source device is always "ME" (short for Mobile Equipment), and the destination device is always "UICC" (short for Universal Integrated Circuit Card).

q_16481.question: What clauses provide additional details on BSSAP message transfer on E-Interface?
q_16481.ground_truth: Clauses 4.5.4 and 4.7.4.1 provide additional details on BSSAP message transfer on E-Interface.

q_16482.question: What is the risk if the MSGin5G server shares sensitive information with an unverified Application Server?
q_16482.ground_truth: The Application Server can use this information to mount attacks and get services without authorization.

q_16483.question: What is the role of the packed regions and the layering order in the RWP SEI message in the 360-degree video bitstream?
q_16483.ground_truth: The RWP SEI message does not define the role of the packed regions and the layering order in the 360-degree video bitstream. An RTP header extension (RHE) can be used for carrying this information.

q_16484.question: What is the purpose of calculating scaling factors for the predicted bands in the Normal mode PFSC decoding process?
q_16484.ground_truth: The scaling factors are used to adjust the energy of the predicted high-frequency spectrum based on the decoded band energies.

q_16485.question: What is the function of the OPF in the described procedure?
q_16485.ground_truth: The OPF is responsible for storing the provisioning data for the UE and performing onboarding authentication and authorization between the UE and the OPF owning the UE's provisioning data.

q_16486.question: What is the APDU remote command coding method defined in the document?
q_16486.ground_truth: The APDU remote command coding should comply with ETSI TS 102 226, as defined in the present document.

q_16487.question: What should a UE do if it, while one or more Tsor-cm timers are running, cannot recover the N1 NAS signalling connection?
q_16487.ground_truth: The UE shall stop the timer(s) in this case.

q_16488.question: What is the size of the security contents when using a Keyed-MAC signature scheme with an ECQV certificate structure at 112-bit security level?
q_16488.ground_truth: The security contents occupy 73-bytes in total.

q_16489.question: What is the test purpose in clause 8.2.1.3, in regards to DCH demodulation in static propagation conditions?
q_16489.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the receiver's ability to receive the test signal under static propagation conditions with a BLER not exceeding a specified limit.

q_16490.question: What must the H-GMLC do if the location estimate of the target UE is not allowed to be provided to the LCS Client due to privacy check failure?
q_16490.ground_truth: The H-GMLC must initiate a cancellation procedure.

q_16491.question: What is the difference in procedure for SRBs when the reordering function is used and not used?
q_16491.ground_truth: When the reordering function is not used, the UE directly delivers the resulting PDCP SDU to the upper layer, assuming integrity verification is passed or not applicable. When the reordering function is used, the UE follows the procedures specified in clause 5.1.2.1.4.1.

q_16492.question: What should the data link layer entity in the MS do if timer T200 expires before a UA response is received?
q_16492.ground_truth: If timer T200 expires before a UA response has been received, the data link layer entity shall retransmit the SABM command as in sub-clause 8.4.1.4, set timer T200 right before transmitting a frame, increment the retransmission counter by 1, and retransmit the SABM command N200 times. After N200 retransmissions, the data link layer shall enter the idle state and issue a DL-RELEASE-INDICATION primitive to the layer 3 entity.

q_16493.question: What happens in Step 8 of the session release: AoC-E - serving party clears?
q_16493.ground_truth: The CDF closes the MMTel-CDR with AoC-E and AoC Information included.

q_16494.question: What are the issues for application-to-point message exchange in Key Issue 9?
q_16494.ground_truth: The issues for application-to-point message exchange are identifying a logical application server in MSGin5G service, sharing the contact information of logical application server with different types of UE, and interacting between MSGin5G server and different logical application servers.

q_16495.question: What is the role of the 1st DTX insertion in the TrCH processing?
q_16495.ground_truth: The 1st DTX insertion block inserts DTX indication bits into the bits output from rate matching to indicate transmission gaps in the radio frame.

q_16496.question: What information does the AMF include in the Registration Accept message for the UE with regards to the Allowed NSSAI?
q_16496.ground_truth: The Allowed NSSAI provided in the Registration Accept is valid in the Registration Area and it applies for all the PLMNs which have their Tracking Areas included in the Registration Area. The Mapping Of Allowed NSSAI is the mapping of each S-NSSAI of the Allowed NSSAI to the HPLMN S-NSSAIs.

q_16497.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of attempts to add a radio link to the active link set on the UMTS UTRAN side made by the UE called?
q_16497.ground_truth: The name of the measurement is SHO.AttRLAddUESide.

q_16498.question: What operation mode handover is addressed only in the "NB-IoT/eMTC support for Non-Terrestrial Networks" work item in Rel-17?

q_16499.question: How can the OS retrieve measurement results that are stored in the NE?
q_16499.ground_truth: The OS can retrieve measurement results that are stored in the NE by using CMISE, SNMP, FTP, or FTAM services, as defined in ITU-T Recommendations X.735, X.710, and X.704, respectively.

q_16500.question: What is the role of the MBSF/MBSU component in the architecture?
q_16500.ground_truth: The MBSF/MBSU is responsible for managing the multicast MBS session signaling between the MB-SMF and the NG-RAN.

q_16501.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of its Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication Management?
q_16501.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is an organization that develops technical specifications for the telecommunications industry. The Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication Management is a part of these specifications that focuses on the management of telecommunication systems and services.

q_16502.question: What kind of CDR content is generated by the SMS-SC when the SC receives a "SMS Deliver" message in PEC mode?
q_16502.ground_truth: The SMS-SC generates a SC-DVT-T4 CDR when the SC receives a "SMS Deliver" message in PEC mode.

q_16503.question: What is the link layer performance impact of splitting the payload into 2 blocks in the case of MCS7 for an interference limited channel?
q_16503.ground_truth: Splitting the payload into 2 blocks causes a loss in performance of about 1.6 dB as compared to single block coding in the case of MCS7 for an interference limited channel.

q_16504.question: What is a significant feature of the IMS environment, compared to a general environment for offering SIP and VoIP services?
q_16504.ground_truth: The most salient feature of the IMS environment is that it is fully controlled by the operators.

q_16505.question: What action does the PGW-C take when it receives the PCEF-Initiated IP-CAN Session Modification Procedure with the PCRF?
q_16505.ground_truth: The PGW-C executes the procedure by sending an Sx Session Modification Request to the PGW-U for modifying the Sx session for the UE.

q_16506.question: What action does the old SGSN take upon expiration of a timer for supervising when resources in the old Serving GW should be released?
q_16506.ground_truth: When the timer for supervising when resources in the old Serving GW expires, the old SGSN releases the S-GW resources.

q_16507.question: What is the criticality of the "id-GlobalCN-ID" extension in the RelocationRequestExtensions RANAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
q_16507.ground_truth: The criticality of the "id-GlobalCN-ID" extension is "reject".

q_16508.question: What are some potential new requirements needed to support the use case of on-site audio contribution in live programs using 5G?
