q_16508.ground_truth: Some potential new requirements necessary to support this use case include the 5G system supporting hot-plugging for new devices to be dynamically added to and removed from a live performance application without any observable impact on the other devices and communication streams, supporting UE speeds of up to 5 km/h and UE rotations of 0.52 rad/s, supporting industry standards for precision clock synchronisation for IP based AV systems, and supporting power management functionality to enable multimedia streaming for several hours on a battery or hot swappable batteries.

q_16509.question: What is the role of the CS-MGW in a 3GPP network?
q_16509.ground_truth: The CS-MGW interfaces with the UTRAN and the core network over Iu. It provides media conversion, bearer control, and payload processing for circuit and packet networks. It also supports mobile specific functions such as handover and anchoring.

q_16510.question: What is the state of the MS in the network initiated PTC re-activation scenario?
q_16510.ground_truth: The MS is in the GA-RRC-CONNECTED state and the PMM-CONNECTED state during the network initiated PTC re-activation scenario.

q_16511.question: What is the role of the AM RLC entity in handling acknowledgments?
q_16511.ground_truth: When the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity receives a positive acknowledgement for an RLC data PDU, it updates the VT(A) state variable accordingly. If all AMD PDUs associated with a transmitted RLC SDU have been positively acknowledged, it sends an indication to the upper layers of successful delivery of the RLC SDU.

q_16512.question: How does the UE determine the presence of STTD encoding on a P-CCPCH in a UMTS network?
q_16512.ground_truth: The UE can determine the presence of STTD encoding on the P-CCPCH by receiving higher layer messages, by demodulating the Secondary Common Control Physical Channel (S-CCPCH), or by a combination of the above two. During power on and handover between cells, the UE can determine the presence of STTD encoding on the P-CCPCH, either by receiving the higher layer message or by demodulating the SCH channel.

q_16513.question: What should the SCC AS do if an existing leg for a session already exists using a different IP-CAN?
q_16513.ground_truth: The SCC AS should include a Target-Dialog header field in the SIP INVITE request so that the UE can correlate different requests as part of the same session.

q_16514.question: In case of P-CSCF failure, when should the application server send the originating service request directly to the I-CSCF?
q_16514.ground_truth: If the S-CSCF can not be contacted after the timeout for the originating service request, the application server shall resend the originating service request to the I-CSCF.

q_16515.question: What is the stance on service agnostic solutions for providing UC protection?
q_16515.ground_truth: Although it may be seen positively or negatively whether a solution is service agnostic, it is generally better if it implies the possibility to be service agnostic, as it can provide sufficient UC protection without being service-specific.

q_16516.question: What is the role of a Quality of Service (QoS) in 3GPP specifications?
q_16516.ground_truth: Quality of Service (QoS) is a collective effect of service performances which determine the degree of satisfaction of a user of a service. It is characterised by the combined aspects of performance factors such as service operability performance, service accessibility performance, service retention performance, and service integrity performance.

q_16517.question: What should a UE do with the Tsor-cm timer associated with "SOR security check not successful" if the security check is successful while one or more Tsor-cm timers are running?
q_16517.ground_truth: The UE shall stop the Tsor-cm timer associated with "SOR security check not successful", if running, and act on the received steering of roaming information.

q_16518.question: What actions can the CSE instruct the VPLMN to perform when a change of position event occurs during call processing?
q_16518.ground_truth: The CSE can instruct the VPLMN to notify it and continue call processing, perform charging activities, or activate other control service events for the call.

q_16519.question: What action is taken by the network when it decides to redirect a MS to another GANC during a Registration Update?
q_16519.ground_truth: The network shall send the GA-RC REGISTER REDIRECT message to the MS so that it is able to initiate the Registration procedure towards that GANC.

q_16520.question: What is the intended use of the Directed Retry feature in the context of Priority Service?
q_16520.ground_truth: The Directed Retry feature is used in Priority Service when no radio resources are available at a cell to set up a call. The BSS may try to set up the call on a neighboring cell if channels are free at that cell. This feature is also used for handover with cause "directed retry" when no radio traffic channel is available in the current cell.

q_16521.question: What type of interaction occurs between MRFC and MRFP in order to reserve resources for the announcement?
q_16521.ground_truth: The MRFC interacts with the MRFP in order to reserve resources for the announcement as part of the interaction with MRFP.

q_16522.question: What should be the content of the SIB1 in order to indicate eCallOverIMS-Support?
q_16522.ground_truth: The content of the SIB1 should include the eCallOverIMS-Support in order to indicate eCallOverIMS-Support.

q_16523.question: How can rate adaptation be approached when there are multiple receivers of the same switched, video stream in a group call?
q_16523.ground_truth: It is suggested to keep some separation of uplink (UE-MRFP) and downlink (MRFP-UE) in rate adaptation, letting the MRFP be involved in rate adaptation to the extent possible and feasible, and using video switching to avoid video transcoding in the MRFP while reflecting the worst observed UE-to-UE path in the MRFP's rate adaptation feedback to the stream sender. Additionally, dynamically applying transcoding towards downlink receiving UE that experiences particularly bad channel conditions or utilizing simulcast streams can help avoid unwanted quality degradations to downlink receivers with good channel conditions.

q_16524.question: What shall be included in the IE Serving GANC IP address if neither the IE Serving GANC FQDN nor the IE GAN PLMN List is included?
q_16524.ground_truth: The conditional IE Serving GANC IP address

q_16525.question: What action does the MBMS client take upon receiving a successful registerStreamingApp() call from an MAA?
q_16525.ground_truth: The MBMS client registers the app and responds with a registerStreamingResponse() call.

q_16526.question: What is the purpose of adaptive codebook resynchronization and fast recovery in 32 and 64 kbps?
q_16526.ground_truth: It is an approach to improve performance under frame erasures by arresting error propagation into future frames, synchronizing the adaptive codebook content, correcting the excitation memory, and significantly containing the error propagation into future frames and improving decoder convergence when good frames are received after the erased frame.

q_16527.question: What is the role of the Software Management function in the 3G network?
q_16527.ground_truth: The Software Management function in the 3G network provides operators with the ability to manage a large number of software entities residing in geographically dispersed managed elements.

q_16528.question: What is the maximum bit rate used in the test for the MPEG-H Low Complexity profile, and what was the resulting average basic audio quality score?
q_16528.ground_truth: The maximum bit rate used in the test for the MPEG-H Low Complexity profile was 256 kbps, and the resulting average basic audio quality score was within the Excellent range (80-100 MUSHRA points).

q_16529.question: What is the mode of operation that is only supported in EC TBF mode?
q_16529.ground_truth: Only RLC acknowledged mode is supported in EC TBF mode.

q_16530.question: What is the capital of Egypt?

q_16531.question: What is the role of the core ACELP/TCX decoder in the mono signal low-band synthesis?
q_16531.ground_truth: The core ACELP/TCX decoder is responsible for reconstructing the 0-Fs/4 kHz band of the mono signal in the ACELP and TCX modes of the decoder.

q_16532.question: What triggers the location update for non-GPRS services procedure in the SGSN in the 3GPP system?
q_16532.ground_truth: The location update for non-GPRS services procedure is triggered when an MS moves to a new LA and all conditions are met for MSs in class-A and class-B mode of operation.

q_16533.question: What is the expected status condition when sending a VERIFY PIN command with relevant PIN to the UICC using the USIM application and the USIM is not locked?
q_16533.ground_truth: The expected status condition is SW1~=~'90', SW2~='00'.

q_16534.question: What is the main concern of the Content Provider and Service Provider in Use Case B?
q_16534.ground_truth: The main concern of the Content Provider is to ensure its designated service provider can deliver protected live events with low start-up delay. The Service Provider wants to minimize or better control start-up delay given limited processing capability of its servers to handle rights/licenses acquisition traffic.

q_16535.question: What is the significance of the approval of TR 37.880 for the work item on high-power UE operation in bands 12, 5, and n71?
q_16535.ground_truth: The approval of TR 37.880 enables the work item to proceed with further discussions and agreements on the corresponding HPUE requirements for fixed wireless/vehicular-mounted use cases for each band independently during the RAN4 specifications phase.

q_16536.question: What is the purpose of the interworking management function in the NPN environment?
q_16536.ground_truth: The interworking management function coordinates the execution of activities across 3GPP and non-3GPP management systems, responsible for performing model translation when exchanging notifications across them.

q_16537.question: What is the role of the coordinating SMLC in the deciphering key delivery mechanism?
q_16537.ground_truth: The coordinating SMLC delivers the new deciphering key set to the other SMLCs and MS in the same location area when the deciphering key set changes.

q_16538.question: What should be the value of the HFN (Hybrid Framing Number) component of the COUNT-C variable for all transparent mode radio bearers of a CN domain when initializing it with the START value at the "COUNT-C activation time"?
q_16538.ground_truth: The HFN component of the COUNT-C variable should be set to the START value as indicated in the IE "START list" of the response message for the relevant CN domain.

q_16539.question: What is the purpose of the SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 2quater message?
q_16539.ground_truth: The SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 2quater message provides further information for Enhanced Measurement Report and may include UTRAN and/or E-UTRAN information for cell-reselection, measurement and reporting.

q_16540.question: What is the significance of using the same total bitrate for H.264/AVC and SVC streams in the performance evaluation?
q_16540.ground_truth: Using the same total bitrate for H.264/AVC and SVC streams ensures a fair comparison, as equal amount of radio resources should be allocated for transmitting the AVC and SVC streams.

q_16541.question: What is the type of the Payload information element in a SIP MESSAGE request for Interworking Security Data message?
q_16541.ground_truth: The Payload information element is a type 6 information element.

q_16542.question: What is the TAI (MCC/MNC/TAC) value in the network parameters transmitted on the BCCH?

q_16543.question: What is the function of the "HS-DSCH MAC-d PDU Size Format" information element in GERAN cell communications?
q_16543.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH MAC-d PDU Size Format information element provides information regarding the type of MAC-d PDU size format used for HS-DSCH, which helps determine the actual MAC-d PDU size and its corresponding information structure in the communications.

q_16544.question: How is the target identity determined when a Non-Local Id is used in MMS messages?
q_16544.ground_truth: The target is identified from the FROM field for MMS messages originated from a target with Non-Local ID, and from the TO, CC, and BCC fields for MMS messages to the target with Non-Local ID.

q_16545.question: What should the UE do when it receives a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the MICO indication IE indicating "all PLMN registration area allocated"?
q_16545.ground_truth: The UE shall treat all TAIs in the current PLMN as a registration area and delete its old TAI list.

q_16546.question: What message does the new SGSN send to the HLR to inform it of the change of SGSN?
q_16546.ground_truth: Update Location (SGSN Number, SGSN Address, IMSI) message

q_16547.question: How is reflective QoS supported in MPQUIC-LL operation?
q_16547.ground_truth: Reflective QoS is supported by sending "MPQUIC connection setup information" to UE that includes information for establishing a MPQUIC connection associated with a downlink-only QoS flow. The UE does not send uplink PDUs to a MPQUIC connection associated with a downlink-only QoS flow, because the UE has no associated QoS rule for this MPQUIC connection. However, the UE sends QUIC packets (e.g. PING, ACK, etc.) over this MPQUIC connection based on the normal MPQUIC protocol operation.

q_16548.question: What should the RNC2 do if the COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message contains the SFN-SFN Measurement Threshold Information IE but it does not contain at least one IE?
q_16548.ground_truth: The RNC2 should reject the procedure using the COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION FAILURE message.

q_16549.question: What is the function of the Policy and Charging Rules Function (PCRF) in the Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
q_16549.ground_truth: The PCRF in the EPS is responsible for requesting QoS bearers and interacting with network entities for QoS-based content delivery.

q_16550.question: What is the role of the PSA UPF in realizing the N6 transmission delay measurement procedure?
q_16550.ground_truth: The PSA UPF is responsible for constructing IPv6 extension header or In-band Network Telemetry (INT) header for carrying N6 delay measurement indication, inserting the delay measurement indication in the UL data packet, extracting the sending timestamp from the DL data packet, and reporting the calculated N6 transmission delay to SMF through N4 Association Update Procedure.

q_16551.question: What are some issues that need to be addressed to enable IMS application servers to operate in mobile edge space?
q_16551.ground_truth: Some issues that need to be addressed to enable IMS application servers to operate in mobile edge space include determining the capabilities required for IMS and 5GC to support the operation of IMS servers in the mobile edge space, determining any restrictions on IMS applications in the edge network, and determining the impacts on mobility, and service and application continuity.

q_16552.question: What information does the MS include in the paging response when triggered by a positioning event in idle mode?
q_16552.ground_truth: The MS includes MS accuracy related information, such as "MS Sync Accuracy" and "MS Transmission Offset" in the paging response.

q_16553.question: What message is sent by the SRNC to the DRNC to initiate a trace session for a given UE context?

q_16554.question: What does the BSSAP-LE Connection Oriented Information message contain if the TA value is immediately available?
q_16554.ground_truth: The BSSAP-LE Connection Oriented Information message contains the current TA value and current serving cell for the target MS.

q_16555.question: What is the function of the Facility message in the RetrieveMPTY operation during a held MultiParty call?
q_16555.ground_truth: The Facility message is used to retrieve the held MultiParty call. It contains a transaction identifier corresponding to any call in the MPTY. The network confirms the retrieval with another message containing the same transaction identifier.

q_16556.question: What is the purpose of the X2 tunnels in the X2 interface?
q_16556.ground_truth: X2 tunnels are used to support the forwarding of user plane data between the eNBs, allowing for the continuation of E-UTRAN services offered via the S1 interface.

q_16557.question: What is the operating band and channel bandwidth for NR SL enhancement in FR1?
q_16557.ground_truth: NR SL enhancement is designed to operate in the operating bands in FR1, and the maximum channel bandwidth for SL operation for NR SL enhancement in licensed band is 40MHz.

q_16558.question: What is the purpose of the ECS option in 6.3.2.2?
q_16558.ground_truth: The ECS option in 6.3.2.2 is used to determine the edge computing breakout for a UE session and to select the appropriate ECS option to be sent in the DNS query.

q_16559.question: What information does the UE include in the RRCSetupComplete message when it has radio link failure information available and RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report in TS 38.331, clause 5.3.3.4?
q_16559.ground_truth: UE includes rlf-InfoAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message.

q_16560.question: How many signals are used in the "B-Format", or First Order Ambisonics (FOA) format to represent a three-dimensional sound field?
q_16560.ground_truth: The B-Format, or First Order Ambisonics (FOA) format uses the first four low-order spherical harmonics to represent a three-dimensional sound field using four signals: W (omnidirectional sound pressure), X (front/back sound pressure gradient at the capture position), Y (left/right sound pressure gradient at the capture position), and Z (up/down sound pressure gradient at the capture position).

q_16561.question: What is the service that allows users to form restricted communication groups for incoming and outgoing communications?

q_16562.question: What technology is used to provide confidentiality, integrity and replay protection for the control plane signalling between the IAB node and the IAB-donor node?
q_16562.ground_truth: IPsec ESP and IKEv2 or DTLS is used to provide confidentiality, integrity and replay protection for the control plane signalling between the IAB node and the IAB-donor node.

q_16563.question: What is the purpose of multiplying the spectral tilt by 6 for narrowband signals?
q_16563.ground_truth: The multiplication by 6 compensates for the missing critical bands in the narrowband signal analysis.

q_16564.question: What is the purpose of performing BSIC verification in GSM measurements?
q_16564.ground_truth: BSIC verification is used to confirm that the UE is monitoring the same cell and to identify and decode the BSIC of a GSM cell. The verification process involves searching for and decoding the BSIC at least once every 6 times Tre-confirm abort seconds.

q_16565.question: What should a UE do if it is capable of MBMS Service Continuity or SC-PTM reception and is receiving or interested to receive an MBMS service, but can only receive the service while camping on a frequency?
q_16565.ground_truth: The UE should consider that frequency to be the highest priority during the MBMS session, as long as certain conditions are met.

q_16566.question: In PS handover, what is done as soon as radio resources are reserved in the target BSS/GANC/RNS?
q_16566.ground_truth: The old SGSN starts forwarding DL packets to multiple recipients, including the target BSS/GANC/RNS and the new SGSN, if involved, as part of the packet forwarding by the old SGSN.

q_16567.question: What spreading factor does the P-CCPCH always use?
q_16567.ground_truth: The P-CCPCH always uses a spreading factor of SF = 32.

q_16568.question: What is the function of the Sub Network Management Functions?
q_16568.ground_truth: The Sub Network Management Functions are a set of functions related to a network model for a set of network elements in a clearly defined sub-network, enabling additional functions on the sub-network level such as network topology presentation, alarm correlation, service impact analysis and circuit provisioning.

q_16569.question: What is the exclusion band for UTRA FDD, UTRA 3,84 Mcps TDD option and UTRA 1,28 Mcps TDD option?
q_16569.ground_truth: The exclusion band for these options is from the lower carrier frequency used - 12.5 MHz to the upper carrier frequency used + 12.5 MHz.

q_16570.question: What does the HS-DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION control frame do in HS-DSCH data transmission?
q_16570.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION control frame informs the CRNC about the allocation of resources for HS-DSCH data transmission, including HS-DSCH credits, HS-DSCH repetition period and maximum MAC-d PDU length.

q_16571.question: What should the UE do with the stored SNPN identity in the "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" if the initial registration request cannot be accepted by the network?
q_16571.ground_truth: The UE should store the SNPN identity in the "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" and should not remove it at least until 60 minutes or the UE is switched off.

q_16572.question: What does the BSS do if the MS is in the packet transfer mode and RLC/MAC blocks are available for transmission?
q_16572.ground_truth: The BSS shall use those blocks to locate the MS using the U-TDOA location method. If the number of uplink blocks is insufficient, the Packet polling procedure shall be executed on the existing uplink TBF for the balance of the requested blocks.

q_16573.question: In which scenarios is the UE's permanent identity required at the UP function?
q_16573.ground_truth: The UE's permanent identity is required at the UP function in scenarios involving UP function performing http header enrichment in a trusted environment.

q_16574.question: What is the "infinite seating" audio experience in VR?
q_16574.ground_truth: The "infinite seating" audio experience in VR refers to an optimized audio experience based on the individual viewer's actual position in the environment, with audio sources that adapt continuously as the viewer changes position.

q_16575.question: What does the "second digit" of the version number represent?
q_16575.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates, in the version number.

q_16576.question: What is the purpose of the guard timer Tgua in system A?
q_16576.ground_truth: The guard timer Tgua is used to avoid triggering new Push Notifications when system A has already stopped paging UE A when the "reverse" Push Notification is received.

q_16577.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA Proxy in the non-roaming scenario?
q_16577.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy in the non-roaming scenario relays accounting data received from the BBF AAA Proxy in fixed domain to the 3GPP AAA Server in HPLMN and reports per-user charging/accounting information to the VPLMN Charging System for inter-operator settlement for roaming users.

q_16578.question: What is the difference between Forward-only mode and Proxy mode in the Packet Distribution Method?
q_16578.ground_truth: In Forward-only mode, the MBS System treats the transport protocol on top of IP as opaque, and the User Service Announcement is handled by the MBS Application Provider via external means. In Proxy mode, the MBS Client is expected to make the UDP Payloads available directly to the MBS-Aware Application without further knowledge of the content carried.

q_16579.question: What should the MS do when it receives a GA-CSR REQUEST REJECT message?
q_16579.ground_truth: The MS should stop timer TU3908, remain in GA-CSR-IDLE state, and indicate to upper layers that GA-CSR was not able to enter dedicated state.

q_16580.question: What is used to create a Rayleigh fading environment in the reverberation chamber for HSDPA receive diversity tests?
q_16580.ground_truth: Three types of parameters are used to create a Rayleigh fading environment in the reverberation chamber for HSDPA receive diversity tests: an antenna with different polarizations, a rotating platform, and metallic stirrers near the walls of the chamber.

q_16581.question: What is the difference between the first digit in the version number of the 3GPP Technical Specifications?
q_16581.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of the 3GPP Technical Specifications indicates the stage of the specification's development. A value of 1 indicates that the specification is presented to the TSG for information, a value of 2 indicates that it is presented to the TSG for approval, and a value of 3 or greater indicates that the specification is TSG approved and under change control.

q_16582.question: Which message type in the Diameter base protocol contains the Session-Id, Origin-Host, Origin-Realm, and User-Name AVPs, but does not contain the Destination-Realm AVP?
q_16582.ground_truth: The TRS, <TariffResponse> message type includes these AVPs.

q_16583.question: What is the difference between a long transform and a series of short transforms in the transient detection algorithm?
q_16583.ground_truth: A long transform is used for normal frames, while a series of short transforms is used for transient frames. The series of short transforms provides higher time resolution, which is useful for detecting transients.

q_16584.question: What is the "Channel Data" for the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND DATA 2.8.1" and "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND DATA 2.9.1" commands?
q_16584.ground_truth: The "Channel Data" for the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND DATA 2.8.1" and "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND DATA 2.9.1" commands is "00 01.. 07 (8 Bytes of data)".

q_16585.question: What does PLMN-Identity represent in 9.2.4?
q_16585.ground_truth: PLMN-Identity represents a uMBMS public land mobile network in PLMN-ID.

q_16586.question: How is the start index for bandwidth extension calculated in the harmonic mode?
q_16586.ground_truth: The start index for bandwidth extension is calculated based on the value of the index of the highest frequency sub-band of the decoded low frequency band signal.

q_16587.question: What is the role of ANDSF in IP flow mobility procedures in 3GPP and WLAN access?
q_16587.ground_truth: ANDSF can be used to determine inter-system routing policies, and if present, the UE may skip certain procedures to check the IP flow mobility (IFOM) support of the PDN GW.

q_16588.question: How should the DNN of the PDU session be mapped to the APN of the default EPS bearer context in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message?
q_16588.ground_truth: The DNN of the PDU session shall be mapped to the APN of the default EPS bearer context.

q_16589.question: How can the TSN AF determine the bridge delay between two DS-TT ports?
q_16589.ground_truth: The TSN AF calculates the bridge delay between two DS-TT ports by adding the UE-DS-TT residence time and the UE-UPF delay for the two UEs and adding the UPF residence time for device-device.

q_16590.question: What is the role of the AS/NAF in the Liberty ID-WSF Authentication Service in an interworking scenario?
q_16590.ground_truth: The AS/NAF authenticates the user and interacts with the BSF in a transparent manner to the service provider.

q_16591.question: What is the maximum number of UTRAN cells that a multi-RAT MS can monitor on the same frequency in the GPRS 3G Cell Reselection list?
q_16591.ground_truth: There is no limit on the number of UTRAN cells on the same frequency in the GPRS 3G Cell Reselection list for the allowed time. However, there is only one frequency in the list (and no E-UTRAN frequencies in the E-UTRAN Neighbor Cell list) and no new GSM cells are activated at the same time under good radio conditions.

q_16592.question: When the PCRF sends a RAR command including the PCSCF-Restoration-Indication AVP set to value 0 to the PCEF for the corresponding Gx session, what must the PCEF do?
q_16592.ground_truth: The PCEF shall acknowledge the RAR command by sending an RAA command to the PCRF and shall initiate the corresponding bearer procedure for the IMS PDN connection as defined in 3GPP~TS~23.380.

q_16593.question: What triggers the broadcast of a PWS message for disaster roaming in PLMN A?
q_16593.ground_truth: The CBE will trigger the broadcast of a PWS message in PLMN A when PLMN A can provide disaster roaming to UEs of PLMN D in the area.

q_16594.question: What is the significance of the "op" property in a JSON Patch modification object?
q_16594.ground_truth: The "op" property in a JSON Patch modification object specifies the type of operation to be applied to the target resource.

q_16595.question: In the MCService User Profile data exchanged between the MC Service User Database and the MCPTT Server in the DPR/DPA and NDR/NDA operations, what AVP contains an XML document that describes the MCPTT User Profile data when the requested data managed by the MC Service User Database is an MCPTT User Profile?

q_16596.question: What is the Announcing Alert procedure in ProSe Function?
q_16596.ground_truth: The Announcing Alert procedure is triggered by the ProSe Function of HPLMN to notify the announcing UE to perform announcing, when the Announcing Enabled indicator is stored in the UE context and there is a valid ProSe Restricted Code match with a PC5 radio technology. If restricted Direct Discovery with application-controlled extension is used, the ProSe Restricted Code is replaced by the ProSe Restricted Code Prefix.

q_16597.question: What should the list server do when it verifies the identity of the user and authorizes the request?
q_16597.ground_truth: The list server should create a 202 (Accepted) response, including the P-Charging-Vector and P-Charging-Function-Addresses headers.

q_16598.question: What should the IBCF do if the TrGW detects an ECN-related error case as an ECN endpoint?
q_16598.ground_truth: The TrGW should notify the IBCF, and the IBCF should then initiate a session re-negotiation to disable ECN.

q_16599.question: What is the purpose of the Tunnel Endpoint Identifier Control Plane field in the MBMS Session Start Request message?
q_16599.ground_truth: The Tunnel Endpoint Identifier Control Plane field in the MBMS Session Start Request message specifies an uplink Tunnel Endpoint Identifier for control plane messages that is chosen by the GGSN. The SGSN shall include this Tunnel Endpoint Identifier in the GTP header of all subsequent uplink control plane messages which are related to the MBMS Bearer context.

q_16600.question: What is the name of the RANAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE that uses the id-RAB-ReleaseRequest procedure code?

q_16601.question: When should the mobile station stop timer T3228 and timer T3248 after receiving an EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message or an EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK AND CONTENTION RESOLUTION message?
q_16601.ground_truth: The mobile station should stop timer T3228 and timer T3248 if it is running when it receives an EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message or an EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK AND CONTENTION RESOLUTION message addressed to it with the TFI value associated with its uplink TBF.

q_16602.question: What are the two time offsets specified for the probability distribution in Eq 7.5.2a in the case of VAMOS mode?
q_16602.ground_truth: -1 Normal Symbol Periods and 1 Normal Symbol Periods

q_16603.question: What is the TON and NPI in Record 2 of EFSDN?
q_16603.ground_truth: The TON (Type of Number) is Telephony and NPI (Numbering Plan Indicator) is International in Record 2 of EFSDN.

q_16604.question: What is the data transmission direction on the access side of the IWF, as referred to in clause 11a.1.2?
q_16604.ground_truth: The data is transported on the access side of the IWF, as referred to in clause 11a.1.2.

q_16605.question: What feature does the CP Function need to support to address Key Issue #5 in the described solution?
q_16605.ground_truth: The support of the PDI Optimization feature (i.e. concept of Traffic EndPoints)

q_16606.question: What action should the BSS take if it has received the LCLS-Connection-Status-Control IE set to "Connect" for both call legs associated with an LCLS call?
q_16606.ground_truth: The BSS should locally switch the user plane between the two call legs and report the through-connection via LCLS-BSS-Status IE in the LCLS-Connect-Control Acknowledge message.

q_16607.question: How is buffer depth calculated in RTSP-based QoE metrics?
q_16607.ground_truth: The buffer depth is the number of seconds of future media which resides in the buffer. It is calculated as the difference between the latest playout time of the media units in the buffer minus the current playout time. If the calculation result is negative, the buffer depth shall be set to zero.

q_16608.question: What is the role of the expression (1295) in computing the autocorrelation?
q_16608.ground_truth: The expression (1295) is a recursion used for evaluating the cosine term of the autocorrelation by starting from a value and recursively generating subsequent values needed for computing the autocorrelation.

q_16609.question: What happens after the AMF requests the UE to provide the CAA Level UAV Id during registration?
q_16609.ground_truth: The UE includes the CAA Level UAV Id in the Identity Response, and the AMF creates an event notification containing the CAA Level UAV Id, GPSI, and location information of the UAV UE, which is sent to the USS via NEF.

q_16610.question: When should the UE submit an MBMS User Service De-registration message?
q_16610.ground_truth: The UE should submit an MBMS User Service De-registration message before releasing the PDP context used by the MBMS User Service Registration. This is to ensure that the BM-SC is aware of the correct UE IP address for the purpose of performing MSK deliveries from the BM-SC.

q_16611.question: What is the required confidence level for the FDD RSTD accuracy test to pass?
q_16611.ground_truth: The required confidence level for the FDD RSTD accuracy test to pass is 95%.

q_16612.question: What sensitive data can be protected by the reroute security context while rerouting the registration request via RAN?
q_16612.ground_truth: The reroute security context can protect sensitive data such as SUPI or security keys when rerouting the registration request via RAN.

q_16613.question: What should a network do if a 3G Neighbour Cell Description includes non-supported frequencies or Radio Access Technologies?
q_16613.ground_truth: The network should still increment the indices in the 3G Neighbour Cell list accordingly.

q_16614.question: What does the "Integration of satellite components in the 5G architecture" work item aim to address?
q_16614.ground_truth: The "Integration of satellite components in the 5G architecture" work item aims to add or enhance features in the 5GCore architecture to support Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) for several use cases, including coverage extension, Internet of Things, disaster communication, global roaming, and broadcasting. The work item also defines Key Performance Indicator (KPI) targets for satellite in 3GPP Release 17.

q_16615.question: What is the Screening Indicator set to in a broadcast call?
q_16615.ground_truth: The Screening Indicator is set to "Network Provided" in a broadcast call.

q_16616.question: What is required for Candidate Solution #1 to be implemented in the satellite NG RAN?
q_16616.ground_truth: The satellite NG RAN needs to be able to dynamically change the System Information Block (SIB) for Candidate Solution #1 to be implemented.

q_16617.question: What is the role of the BS-ID leaf in a WiMAX location description?
q_16617.ground_truth: The BS-ID leaf in a WiMAX location description indicates the BS identifier for a specific location description.

q_16618.question: What is the objective of the packet delay measurement in the DL per QCI?
q_16618.ground_truth: The objective of this measurement is to measure L2 Packet Delay for OAM performance observability or for QoS verification of MDT.

q_16619.question: What happens as a result of the PN UE redirection control logic execution for the UE-1?
q_16619.ground_truth: The PNM AS sends the redirected initial request containing the Request-URI of the GRUU of UE-2 and the identity of PNE-1 to the S-CSCF #1

q_16620.question: What is the purpose of method of test 27.22.4.10.1.4 for SEND SHORT MESSAGE?
q_16620.ground_truth: The purpose of method of test 27.22.4.10.1.4 for SEND SHORT MESSAGE is to verify that the ME correctly formats and sends a short message to the network (USS) as indicated in the SEND SHORT MESSAGE proactive UICC command, and returns a TERMINAL RESPONSE command to the UICC indicating the status of the transmission of the Short Message.

q_16621.question: What is the purpose of the test in 8.5A.4.2.4, regarding the measurement of BLER for each data rate applicable for the base station?
q_16621.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to ensure that the base station can receive signals with different data rates and meet the required BLER limits.

q_16622.question: What is the 3GPP SMIL Language Profile based on?
q_16622.ground_truth: The 3GPP SMIL Language Profile is based on SMIL 2.0 Basic and SMIL Scalability Framework.

q_16623.question: What is the identifier used in PS domain for correlation purpose within IP-CAN bearers?
q_16623.ground_truth: The EPS default bearer charging identifier is used for correlation purpose within IP-CAN bearers in PS domain.

q_16624.question: When is it necessary for the FRMCS end user device to provide service continuation by setting up communication via the GSM-R system?
q_16624.ground_truth: When the Key Management application on the FRMCS equipment is detached from the FRMCS system.

q_16625.question: What are the core media components in multimedia telephony sessions?
q_16625.ground_truth: The core media components in multimedia telephony sessions are voice and video.

q_16626.question: What are the three types of PLMN Operator Classes that provide location services to users?
q_16626.ground_truth: The three types of PLMN Operator Classes that provide location services to users are: clients broadcasting location-related information to UEs in a particular geographic area, O&M clients in the HPLMN, and O&M clients in the VPLMN.

q_16627.question: What is the general rule concerning all frames in this protocol?
q_16627.ground_truth: The general rule is that most significant bits are transmitted first, and a basic First-In First-Out functionality is implemented in the information passing process.

q_16628.question: Which handover option for an MB session during the RRC-CONNECTED state supports handover with forwarding, and what is required for packet loss/duplication determination?
q_16628.ground_truth: Alt 1 in Alternative 1, and the SN number of the packet assigned by CN

q_16629.question: What is the value of the RSTD (receive time difference) between Cell 1 and the OTDOA assistance data reference cell, Cell 2?
q_16629.ground_truth: The RSTD between Cell 1 and the OTDOA assistance data reference cell, Cell 2 is 31 Ts (about 1 s).

q_16630.question: What must the BBERF provide at Gateway Control Session establishment for the PCRF to maintain the linking between the new Gateway Control Session and an existing Gx session?
q_16630.ground_truth: The BBERF must provide a PDN ID and a PDN Connection ID at the Gateway Control Session establishment for the PCRF to maintain the linking between the new Gateway Control Session and an existing Gx session.

q_16631.question: What should the IWF do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body containing the <mcptt-Params> element with the <emergency-ind> element set to "false" during a private call, and the MCPTT ID in the <originated-by> element is the MCPTT ID of the receiving MCPTT user?
q_16631.ground_truth: The IWF should set the MCPTT emergency alert state to "MPEA 1: no-alert".

q_16632.question: What is required for Specification level requirement on Automated SWM?
q_16632.ground_truth: The specification level requirement on Automated SWM includes the ability for an IRPManager to retrieve information about how an NE or a group of NEs behaves during ASWM, the ability to select stop points to suspend the SWM process, the ability to resume a suspended ASWM process, and the ability to terminate an ongoing ASWM process.

q_16633.question: What is the minimum set of declarations for the OTA peak directions set?
q_16633.ground_truth: The minimum set of declarations covers the beams with the narrowest and the widest beam widths.

q_16634.question: What is the purpose of the group list fetch procedure in SEAL?
q_16634.ground_truth: The group list fetch procedure in SEAL is used to fetch the list of groups in which the MSGin5G service ID is a member, and it includes the necessary information elements for the request and response.

q_16635.question: What is the role of the Provisioning function in the External DN in Collaboration D?
q_16635.ground_truth: The Provisioning function in the External DN interworks with the MB-SMF in the Trusted DN to provision transport-only multicast delivery sessions for DVB-MABR multicast transport sessions.

q_16636.question: What should the IMS-ALG do if it did not allocate a primary local MR and received an SDP answer with a valid connection address?
q_16636.ground_truth: If the IMS-ALG did not allocate a primary local MR and received an SDP answer with a valid connection address, it should copy into the media line of the SDP answer the visited-realm or secondary-realm instance from the media line of the received SDP offer that was used to populate the connection address and port information in the forwarded SDP offer, and replace the connection-address and port information in the instance with the connection address and port information from the received SDP answer.

q_16637.question: What is sent periodically on the SACCH to allow mobile stations moving into the area to join the voice group call?
q_16637.ground_truth: Periodic messages that may include information of changes of notifications and information used for cell re-selection.

q_16638.question: What should be used in preference over the media level values when calculating session bandwidth from the received SDP, if both "b=TIAS" and "a=maxprate" are present at session level?

q_16639.question: What is the function of the retriever timer T in the Multi Party service?
q_16639.ground_truth: The retriever timer T is used to supervise the reception of the retrieve request in the Multi Party service, to prevent two calls from being placed on hold at the same time.

q_16640.question: What is the primary traffic handling strategy for the Dual Radio UE (2Rx/1Tx) solution?
q_16640.ground_truth: The strategy for Dual Radio UE (2Rx/1Tx) is to share the 1Tx for both networks' uplink (UL) traffic, while splitting the 2Rx for each network's downlink (DL) user plane traffic.

q_16641.question: What is the role of the target BSS in the PS handover procedure?
q_16641.ground_truth: The target BSS sends a Packet Physical information message to the MS containing the timing advance for synchronization, and if it is a pre-synchronised or synchronised handover, the timing advance information is included in the PS Handover Command message.

q_16642.question: What action should the SCC AS take upon receipt of a 2xx response for the re-INVITE request sent to the remote UE, if the transferred media component was the only active media component at the controllee UE?
q_16642.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP BYE request to the controllee UE from which the media component was transferred from.

q_16643.question: What agency is recommended to administer the alert aggregation function in the alerting initiation platform for authenticating and prioritizing alerts from all authorized sources?

q_16644.question: What is the purpose of test procedure 7.2.14.3?
q_16644.ground_truth: The purpose of test procedure 7.2.14.3 is to verify that the ACT with the higher priority takes precedence over the UPLMN with the lower priority when the UE performs a network selection. It also ensures that the new coding for RAT satellite NG-RAN is handled correctly by the UE.

q_16645.question: What happens if a right child SA is not found for encapsulating and transferring uplink and downlink IP flows?
q_16645.ground_truth: A new child SA shall be created by the ePDG/SeGW (downlink) and UE/H(e)NB (uplink).

q_16646.question: What parameters are used in the evaluation of background acoustic noise for the SID frame in GSM mobile communications?
q_16646.ground_truth: The unquantized frame energy value R0, the unquantized (normalized) autocorrelation sequence R(i), and the quantized energy tweak parameter GS are used in the evaluation of background acoustic noise.

q_16647.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of RABs establishment failures for packet switched traffic in a HNB?

q_16648.question: What are the access types and occurrence of the GuaranteedFlowBitRate leaf in V2X communication over the NR-PC5?
q_16648.ground_truth: The access types are Get and Replace, and it occurs zero or one time.

q_16649.question: What is the role of the PCRF in the Gx interface signalling?
q_16649.ground_truth: The PCRF uses the Gx interface to provide policy decision information to the GGSN and make gating control decisions for the authorized media stream.

q_16650.question: What does the Network Resource Identifier (NRI) uniquely identify within a pool-area?
q_16650.ground_truth: The NRI uniquely identifies an individual CN node within a pool-area, allowing for parallel serving of the pool-area by multiple CN nodes.

q_16651.question: What is the purpose of the Frame CRC in the control frame header?
q_16651.ground_truth: The Frame CRC is the result of the cyclic redundancy check (CRC) applied to the remaining part of the frame, which includes the header and payload. It is used for error detection in the control frame transmission.

q_16652.question: What type of message is sent by the network to reject a single block access request due to unavailability of uplink resources?

q_16653.question: What procedures should be invoked when changing the Selected Codec to the preferred speech codec during a BC-IE speech?
q_16653.ground_truth: The Out-of-Band Transcoder Control procedures should be invoked.

q_16654.question: What is the number of images exchanged per second over the 5G communication service in this use case?
q_16654.ground_truth: A total of 240 images are exchanged per second over the 5G communication service in this use case, with 120 images per second in each direction.

q_16655.question: What is the significance of the third digit in the version number of the technical specification?
q_16655.ground_truth: The third digit of the version number is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document and does not indicate any changes in the technical aspects.

q_16656.question: When the network removes the Trusted WLAN access from a PDN connection, what is the procedure followed in step 1?
q_16656.ground_truth: The PCRF indicates to the P-GW the removal of WLAN access for the multi-access PDN connection via IP-CAN Session Modification procedure by updating or removing all PCC rules that are bound to this access.

q_16657.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 Link Modification Request message in the Layer-3 based UE-to-UE Relay re-selection?
q_16657.ground_truth: The PC5 Link Modification Request message is used by the Source UE to inform the Relay and Target UE of the need to change the Relay, and it includes the IP addresses used to communicate via the current Relay 1 and a list of candidate Relay IDs.

q_16658.question: What should the UE transmit as a response message when the CELL UPDATE CONFIRM message includes "CN information elements" but does not include "Transport channel information elements" or "Physical channel information elements"?

q_16659.question: What is the revocation process for the authorization of a UAV's connectivity?
q_16659.ground_truth: The USS/UTM sends an Authorization Revoke request to the UFES, including the 3GPP UAV ID and details of the connectivity to be revoked. The UFES passes the request to the relevant SMF+PGW-C, which removes the connectivity and confirms the revocation to the USS/UTM.

q_16660.question: What is the purpose of the "List of Traffic Volumes" attribute in the S-CDR?
q_16660.ground_truth: The "List of Traffic Volumes" attribute in the S-CDR consists of a set of containers that identify the volume count per IP-CAN bearer, separated for uplink and downlink traffic. It stores the volume count accrued since the closure of the last container or since the IP-CAN bearer was opened.

q_16661.question: What is the role of the normative specification output of ITT4RT in MTSI-based FLUS?
q_16661.ground_truth: It is relevant in delivering immersive video using MTSI-based FLUS, both in-camera stitching and network-based stitching methods.

q_16662.question: How is the security-related information transferred between VLRs in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_16662.ground_truth: The MSC/VLRn needs some information for authentication and ciphering; this information is obtained from MSC/VLRo in the 3GPP technical specification.

q_16663.question: What is the maximum wsegSNR degradation allowed for TCX-256 mode compliance?
q_16663.ground_truth: A wsegSNR degradation of more than 1% is not allowed for TCX-256 mode compliance.

q_16664.question: What is the maximum output power allowed for a backhaul link in extreme conditions?
q_16664.ground_truth: The maximum output power in extreme conditions shall remain within +2.5 dB and -2.5 dB of the rated output power declared by the manufacturer.

q_16665.question: What is the minimum number of times a "MustInclude" element can appear in the "IntraFreqCell" complex type?

q_16666.question: What does NGNM bring to the NGN architecture compared to TMN LLA?
q_16666.ground_truth: NGNM brings a new set of grouping of management functionality compared to TMN LLA to better support the complexity of the NGN. For example, NGNM Resource Management layer encompasses the Network Management layer and the Element Management layer.

q_16667.question: What condition must be met for the UE to perform intra-frequency measurements of higher priority NR inter-frequencies or inter-RAT frequencies?
q_16667.ground_truth: The UE must perform measurements of higher priority NR inter-frequencies or inter-RAT frequencies if they have a reselection priority higher than the reselection priority of the current NR frequency.

q_16668.question: What should be done if only an alternative IP address is available for either the control plane or the user plane, but not both, when encoding IEs for a PDP context?
q_16668.ground_truth: If an alternative IP address is available for only one plane, encode a pair of Alternative GGSN Address for control plane IE and Alternative GGSN Address for user traffic IE, where one of these IEs includes the alternative address and the other IE is set to a null IPv4 or IPv6 address.

q_16669.question: What should the Node B do if the requested transmission or measurement on cell synchronisation bursts cannot be initiated?
q_16669.ground_truth: The Node B shall send a CELL SYNCHRONISATION INITIATION FAILURE message over the Node B control port, including the Cause IE set to an appropriate value, if the requested transmission or measurement on cell synchronisation bursts cannot be initiated.

q_16670.question: What digit occupies bits 0-3 of the sixth octet in the representation of a time?

q_16671.question: What is the role of the PDU Session Establishment Accept message in the pairing authorization process?
q_16671.ground_truth: The PDU Session Establishment Accept message indicates the successful establishment of a PDU session between the UAV and UAV-C, which includes session security information for setting up a secure connection.

q_16672.question: What are the two constraints that can be exploited by the network to better control the performance of the terminals?
q_16672.ground_truth: The two constraints are the Receive Diversity (RxDiv) mode and the Dual/Multi-carrier mode (MC).

q_16673.question: How does the communication optimized approach 2 improve upon the communication optimized approach 1?
q_16673.ground_truth: The communication optimized approach 2 reduces the overhead of the multicast message used to update the group key in the communication optimized approach 1 by sending the protected group key EMSK(GK) a single time through the multicast channel instead of requiring MGKM1 that includes M protected values of the group key. This provides limited benefits when the GK is used to protect a reasonable amount of data.

q_16674.question: In order to support NBIFOM, what is one of the functions of the ePDG?
q_16674.ground_truth: The ePDG needs to be capable of providing an indication to the PDN GW for its support for NBIFOM during the PDN connection establishment (over the first and over an additional access).

q_16675.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in user data congestion mitigation?
q_16675.ground_truth: Upon notification of user data congestion, the PCF requests the NWDAF to report the data dispersion analytics of users in the area of interest. The NWDAF then provides this information to the PCF, which can use it to make decisions about policies for mitigating congestion.

q_16676.question: What is the benefit of using standardized port numbers for new applications/interfaces in 3GPP?
q_16676.ground_truth: The benefit of using standardized port numbers for new applications/interfaces in 3GPP is that it has no impact on applications.

q_16677.question: What is the maximum number of elements in the "SEQUENCE SIZE (1..bound.&numOfSMSEvents)" of "RequestReportSMSEventArg"?
q_16677.ground_truth: The maximum number of elements in the "SEQUENCE SIZE (1..bound.&numOfSMSEvents)" of "RequestReportSMSEventArg" is equal to "bound.&numOfSMSEvents".

q_16678.question: What is the purpose of group management in SEAL location management procedures?
q_16678.ground_truth: Group management in SEAL location management procedures provides the capability to manage a group of devices, including creation, group membership update, and group deletion. This information is used by the FAE capabilities (FAE client and FAE server) to support 5GLAN services in a factory network.

q_16679.question: What is the difference between the Positive Empty Result and the Negative Result in the interworking between MSC-A and MSC-B?
q_16679.ground_truth: The Positive Empty Result triggers the clearing of Radio Resources on the A-Interface and the release of the SCCP connection between MSC-B and BSS-B, while the Negative Result triggers the abortion of the dialogue or the rejection of the component, leading to the clearing of the circuit connection between MSC-A and MSC-B and the release of the SCCP connection between MSC-B and BSS-B.

q_16680.question: When should a serving BSS send a RAN-INFORMATION-ERROR PDU containing the complete received PDU with the RIM Cause IE set to "Missing Conditional IE"?
q_16680.ground_truth: If an expected conditional Information Element is not included in the RIM container of a RAN-INFORMATION PDU, RAN-INFORMATION-REQUEST PDU, RAN-INFORMATION-ACK PDU or RAN-INFORMATION-APPLICATION-ERROR PDU.

q_16681.question: What should the network do when it receives repeated information elements in a message?
q_16681.ground_truth: The network should only handle the contents of the first repeated information element and ignore all subsequent repetitions, as long as the repetition of information elements is not specified.

q_16682.question: In the "tdd768" choice of "modeSpecificInfo", what two values are required for the "ul-DPCH-Info" field?
q_16682.ground_truth: The "ul-DPCH-Info" field requires the "UL-DPCH-InfoPostTDD" and "UL-DPCH-Info-r7" values in the "tdd768" choice.

q_16683.question: What should the network do in the case of location notification?
q_16683.ground_truth: In the case of location notification, the network invokes a location notification procedure by sending a REGISTER message containing a LCS-LocationNotification invoke component to the UE and the UE shall terminate the dialogue by sending a RELEASE message.

q_16684.question: What is the role of the Multi User Talker Control service in the FRMCS System?
q_16684.ground_truth: The Multi User Talker Control service in the FRMCS System manages the number of simultaneous talkers in a voice communication and decides which FRMCS Users are granted the permission to talk based on certain criteria.

q_16685.question: What action does the SMF take when there are insufficient resources for a specific network slice?
q_16685.ground_truth: The SMF rejects the request to establish user-plane resources and starts timer T3585 for the PDU session with the Back-off timer value provided in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message.

q_16686.question: What is the length of the X value in the termination ID?

q_16687.question: Which protocol layer do the "Transport channel IEs" typically operate at?
q_16687.ground_truth: The "Transport channel IEs" typically operate at the transport layer of the radio access network.

q_16688.question: What is the purpose of Step 3 in the L2 UE-to-Network relay connection establishment?
q_16688.ground_truth: In Step 3, the gNB and Relay UE perform relaying channel setup procedure over Uu. The Relay/Remote UE establishes an RLC channel for relaying of SRB1 towards the Remote UE over PC5, preparing the relaying channel for SRB1.

q_16689.question: What action should the mobile station take when it has received a DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message and a DTM RESOURCE FAILURE message?
q_16689.ground_truth: The mobile station should return a DTM ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message on the main DCCH with one of the corresponding cause values.

q_16690.question: What is the main focus of software management in 3rd Generation networks?
q_16690.ground_truth: The main focus is the management of new software releases and correction patches, ensuring their integration into the network without causing unnecessary service disruptions and maintaining high levels of quality.

q_16691.question: What is the prediction structure for case 2 in the test conditions for MTSI with temporal scalability?
q_16691.ground_truth: In case 2, each picA occurring at (or immediately after) the end of one second intervals uses the picture that precedes the output picA by roughly 300 ms and that belongs to the same or a lower temporal sub-layer as the reference picture for prediction. For all other pictures, the two pictures preceding in decoding order that belong to the same or a lower temporal sub-layer are used for prediction.

q_16692.question: What must an MCVideo user do to receive communications for a recently invited group?
q_16692.ground_truth: The MCVideo user can opt in to receive communications for any recently invited group for which they are affiliated.

q_16693.question: What is the factor that determines the nominal channel spacing for E-UTRA carriers?
q_16693.ground_truth: The nominal channel spacing between two adjacent E-UTRA carriers is defined as the average of the bandwidths of the two respective E-UTRA carriers.

q_16694.question: What should the UE do if the TTI signalled in the "E-DCH Transmission Time Interval" is equal to 10ms and the "PRACH preamble control parameters extension list Type 1 (for Enhanced Uplink)" is included in System Information Block 22?
q_16694.ground_truth: The UE should compile a list of candidate PRACH preamble control parameters and select one randomly from the list.

q_16695.question: What is the speech transcoding procedure described in GSM 06.10?
q_16695.ground_truth: The speech encoder takes its input as a 13-bit uniform PCM signal and encodes it into an encoded block consisting of 456 bits leading to a gross bit rate of 22.8 kbit/s. The encoded speech is then delivered to the channel coding function defined in GSM 05.03.

q_16696.question: Which timers are started when destination B is determined to be idle?
q_16696.ground_truth: The network starts the destination B idle guard timer T8 when destination B is idle or becomes idle. If destination B remains idle, the first non-suspended CCBS request is processed and the CCBS recall B timer T9 is started.

q_16697.question: What types of measurements are collected by the Quality of Experience (QoE) measurement function?
q_16697.ground_truth: The Quality of Experience (QoE) measurement function collects DASH, MTSI, and Virtual Reality measurements.

q_16698.question: What is the base type of the attribute "FEC-Redundancy-Level" in the XML schema provided?
q_16698.ground_truth: The base type of the attribute "FEC-Redundancy-Level" is "xs:unsignedInt".

q_16699.question: Which type of signal does theDARP receiver cancel interference from other cells?
q_16699.ground_truth: The DARP receiver cancels interference from other cells in the downlink (DL) signal modulation by using differential amplitude and phase recovery.

q_16700.question: Which reference point enables the PCRF to have dynamic control over the PCC behaviour at a PCEF?
q_16700.ground_truth: The Gx reference point, which resides between the PCEF and the PCRF, enables the PCRF to have dynamic control over the PCC behavior at a PCEF.

q_16701.question: Which two parameters are used to decide the accuracy requirements of uplink synchronization control during handover in the context of 3GPP TS 25.224?
q_16701.ground_truth: The accuracy of timing advance and the accuracy of SFN-SFN observed time difference type 2 measured by the User Equipment (UE).

q_16702.question: How many bits of information does each symbol carry in the modulation used for the uplink waveform?
q_16702.ground_truth: Each symbol carries 3 bits of information.

q_16703.question: Which system or device sent the "Set-up" message to the MSCb, and what action did it receive in response?
q_16703.ground_truth: The MSCa sent the "Set-up" message to the MSCb, and the MSCb responded with the "Info req" message.

q_16704.question: What is the definition of an IRP Information Service (IS) in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_16704.ground_truth: An IRP Information Service (IS) is a template for specifying the telecommunication management and integration reference points for converged networks, including the behavior and semantics of information object class attributes.

q_16705.question: What shall the mobile station do if the MULTIPLE TBF UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message contains invalid assignments?
q_16705.ground_truth: If the MULTIPLE TBF UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message contains invalid assignments, such as assignments for which no TBF was requested or assignments with more than one PFI value assigned to the same TFI, the mobile station shall not act upon those assignments.

q_16706.question: Which three systems are covered in the definition of performance measurement requirements by TS 32.401: Concept and requirements?

q_16707.question: What is the average bit rate of the surround sound extension that needs to be quantified in the first condition of the loudspeaker test?
q_16707.ground_truth: The average bit rate of the surround sound extension should be quantified at the typical bit rates.

q_16708.question: What is the mechanism that is triggered as soon as a P-CSCF failure is detected, in most cases causing massive radio signalling and IMS registration before the HSS-based P-CSCF restoration mechanism is triggered?
q_16708.ground_truth: The "Update PDP context/bearer at P-CSCF failure" mechanism.

q_16709.question: What is the impact on the IMSI population in terminating calls for outbound roamers when the PCRF based P-CSCF restoration is not supported by HPLMN?
q_16709.ground_truth: If HPLMN does not support the PCRF based P-CSCF restoration, the IMSI may not be available on terminating INVITE message.

q_16710.question: What is the role of the RNC in scheduling data packet transmission based on the provided timestamp?
q_16710.ground_truth: The RNC is responsible for scheduling the received data packets in the TTIs following the time point indicated by the timestamp.

q_16711.question: What is the focus of the 3GPP in the maritime domain?
q_16711.ground_truth: The 3GPP is focusing on the digitalization and mobilization of commercial and safety fields in the maritime domain.

q_16712.question: What entities are involved in the authentication and authorization of the UAV and UAV-C?
q_16712.ground_truth: The entities involved in the authentication and authorization of the UAV and UAV-C are the UAV, UAV-C, SMF (Session Management Function), UFES (5G System UE Function), and USS/UTM (UAV Service Supplier/UAV Traffic Management).

q_16713.question: What are the steps for the USS/UTM and UCF to establish the UAS Positioning Assistance Request in the described solution?
q_16713.ground_truth: Steps 4a, 4b, and 4c in the described solution outline the process for the USS/UTM and UCF to establish the UAS Positioning Assistance Request. These steps include receiving the UAS Positioning Assistance Request from the USS/UTM, responding to the request, and activating positioning report transmission by the UCF.

q_16714.question: What is stored by the ICS UE when it receives an I1 Progress message with Reason set to 183 (Call Progress) ?
q_16714.ground_truth: The ICS UE stores the received Call-Identifier field value, verifies the sequence of the message, stores the SCC AS PSI DN value, and stores the STI value if received.

q_16715.question: What role does the P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) play in establishing the TCP connection?
q_16715.ground_truth: The P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) forwards the SDP offer, receives the SDP answer, and sets the "a=setup:passive" SDP attribute in the SDP answer before sending it to the core network.

q_16716.question: What is the maximum number of reporting criteria a UE can support in parallel per measurement category for the 3.84 Mcps option?
q_16716.ground_truth: The UE can support up to Ecat reporting criteria per measurement category for the 3.84 Mcps option.

q_16717.question: Which parameters in the InitialDPArg sequence are not used for IMS?
q_16717.ground_truth: Several parameters in the InitialDPArg sequence are not used for IMS, including locationNumber, highLayerCompatibility, additionalCallingPartyNumber, bearerCapability, serviceInteractionIndicatorsTwo, carrier, cug-Index, cug-Interlock, cug-OutgoingAccess, locationInformation, ext-BasicServiceCode, callReferenceNumber, calledPartyBCDNumber, timeAndTimezone, and gsm-ForwardingPending.

q_16718.question: What is the use of the successful RRC Connection Establishment Rate for UTRAN access purposes in the UTRAN service access success rate for idle mode UEs KPI?
q_16718.ground_truth: It is used to evaluate service accessibility provided by UTRAN, and is obtained by the Successful RRC Connection Establishment Rate for UTRAN access purposes multiplied by the RAB Establishment Success Rate for all RAB types.

q_16719.question: What bands, when operating in DC, can cause IMD2 and IMD4 to fall into the own Rx of band n78, based on co-existence studies?

q_16720.question: What should the UE do if it is in the state 5GMM-REGISTERED and receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message when attempting to initiate a mobility registration update?
q_16720.ground_truth: The UE should abort the registration procedure, reset the attach attempt counter, set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED and enter state EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH, and then start the timer T3346 and apply the normal cell reselection process. The UE should then start the registration procedure if still needed when the timer T3346 expires or is stopped.

q_16721.question: What are the issues identified in off-network location management and which entities might be required?
q_16721.ground_truth: The issues include determining which procedures and information flows to use for off-network location management, deciding which new entities are required, determining functional requirements such as immediate request, event-triggered, and client-triggered options, and evaluating authorization and privacy restrictions. New entities might include the location management client and location management server.

q_16722.question: What are the requirements for the FFAPP application layer functional architecture as per AR-6.2.2-a, AR-6.2.2-b, and AR-6.2.2-c?
q_16722.ground_truth: The FFAPP application layer functional architecture shall provide support for time sensitive communication services (AR-6.2.2-a), support control plane mechanisms related to TSN AF (AR-6.2.2-b), and support mechanisms for adapting the TSN 5GS bridge as per application requirements (AR-6.2.2-c).

q_16723.question: Under what circumstances should the DRNS setup the E-DCH on a secondary uplink frequency and setup the requested E-DCH resources on the Radio Links and in the cells indicated by the E-DCH Additional RL ID IE and the C-ID IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Setup IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE?
q_16723.ground_truth: When the C-ID IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information ToSetup IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE is included and indicates the cell in which the additional E-DCH shall be setup.

q_16724.question: What is the minimum measurement period for FDD measurements for a UE that does not require measurement occasions and idle intervals?
q_16724.ground_truth: If the UE does not require measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform inter-frequency measurements, the measurement period for FDD measurements is 480 ms.

q_16725.question: What actions does the BSS take upon receiving an uplink LLC PDU and determining that a MPM timer is running for the corresponding MS in the network?
q_16725.ground_truth: The BSS informs the SMLC that no additional timing advance information is pending for the current MTA procedure, stops the corresponding MPM timer, and terminates the MTA procedure.

q_16726.question: What information must the IMS-ALG (ATCF) include in the "a=imageattr" when sending the SDP body with image attribute(s) on the Mw/Mx interface?
q_16726.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG (ATCF) must include the "recv" keyword and corresponding image sizes supported in the receiving direction and the "send" keyword with corresponding image sizes supported in the sending direction.

q_16727.question: What statement is used when a class does not support any notification, as per this clause?
q_16727.ground_truth: "This class does not support any notification."

q_16728.question: What is the requirement for avoiding media tromboning in IMS networks?
q_16728.ground_truth: It is desirable to avoid media tromboning, such as in the case where a call traverses a NAT and then is routed back into the same network.

q_16729.question: What is the field length of the Spare Extension IE in DL DATA FRAME structure?
q_16729.ground_truth: The field length of the Spare Extension IE in DL DATA FRAME structure is 0-30 octets.

q_16730.question: What protocol provides a reliable logical link between the MS and its SGSN in the RLC layer?

q_16731.question: What is the main benefit of using a unified format for MAC failure and synchronization failure in the 5G mobile network?
q_16731.ground_truth: The main benefit is that it improves the resilience against identifier linkability, which is a key issue in the 5G mobile network.

q_16732.question: When SCUDIF is not supported and the UE initiates Access Transfer, what is done after the transfer?
q_16732.ground_truth: After the transfer, the video channel is closed via H.245 negotiation if the voice session is to be activated.

q_16733.question: What is the bit-rate of the EVS mode that can achieve the highest capacity gains in SWB mode while maintaining HD voice speech quality?

q_16734.question: What frequency band has overlap with the TX band and both the RX and TX bands in the GSM bands?
q_16734.ground_truth: The Ft3 band has overlap with the TX band and both the RX and TX bands in the GSM bands.

q_16735.question: What is an alternative to solution #3 for service discovery in the absence of a DNS server in the domain?
q_16735.ground_truth: One alternative is to use multicast address on the local link using Multicast DNS (mDNS), which provides the ability to perform DNS-like operations on the local link and advertises the services of a device with no further user interaction.

q_16736.question: What does the PSS Adapter do upon receiving a SDP Offer from the UE in the initial INVITE request?
q_16736.ground_truth: The PSS Adapter shall include a media description for the RTSP content control channel and one for the content delivery channel in the initial INVITE request, in accordance with media capabilities and policies available for the PSS session and with the parameters received from the SSF during service selection procedure. The RTSP content control media description shall be carried by TCP and the content delivery channel shall be a "receiver only" media description set as defined in 3GPP TS 26.234, clause 5.3.3.

q_16737.question: What are the BLE advertising channels used in the BLE test conditions in section 4.10.1?
q_16737.ground_truth: The BLE advertising channels used in the BLE test conditions in section 4.10.1 are Channel 37 (2402 MHz), Channel 38 (2426 MHz), and Channel 39 (2480 MHz).

q_16738.question: Which function is used for channel codings TCH/F14.4 if the AIUR is equal to 64 kbit/s?

q_16739.question: What is the impact of using COLR in the context of CSI?
q_16739.ground_truth: If the presentation of her COL is suppressed, then automatic combination of the IMS session and the CS call is unavailable.

q_16740.question: What is necessary for 5G ProSe to establish a reliable one-to-one communication over PC5?
q_16740.ground_truth: 5G ProSe needs a reliable mechanism to establish and to use one-to-one communication over PC5.

q_16741.question: What are the minimum requirements for the power measured outside the relevant TX band of a BTS?
q_16741.ground_truth: The power measured at step e) shall not exceed: -36 dBm for frequencies up to 1 GHz and -30 dBm for frequencies above 1 GHz.

q_16742.question: What is the requirement for the media feature tag in the Contact header field when a SIP REFER request is used for transferring control of a collaborative session?
q_16742.ground_truth: The media feature tag should be set to "g.3gpp current-iut-controller" and the value should be set to "passive".

q_16743.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request from the remote party containing an SDP offer indicating one or more media components to be released on the controller UE?
q_16743.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall set the port number on the media line(s) which are not on the controller UE to zero and forward the SIP re-INVITE request towards the controller UE.

q_16744.question: What must be present when defining the id-S-SCH-Information field in the S-SCH-Information-ResourceStatusInd container?
q_16744.ground_truth: The id-S-SCH-Information field in the S-SCH-Information-ResourceStatusInd container must be present and its type must be Common-PhysicalChannel-Status-Information.

q_16745.question: What service provisioning procedure is used for EAS-End Point update in solution #37?
q_16745.ground_truth: The Service Specific Parameter provisioning service is used for EAS-End Point update in solution #37, where the AF provides the new EAS End-Point Address to the UDR via the NEF. If the procedure is successful, the UDR notifies the NF (e.g., the SMF) the new EAS End-Point Address information.

q_16746.question: What should the Node B include in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message when the F-DPCH capability has changed for the Local Cell?
q_16746.ground_truth: When the F-DPCH capability has changed for the Local Cell, the Node B should include the F-DPCH Capability IE in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message and indicate the new capability.

q_16747.question: When is the card powered?
q_16747.ground_truth: In none of the scenarios is the card powered.

q_16748.question: What is the role of the application delivery layer in the RESTful Rx reference point between AF and PC?
q_16748.ground_truth: The application delivery layer provides the transport of the specific application communication data using HTTP/1.1, and constitutes the transport of the XML documents that describe the data structure accepted by the Rx software applications.

q_16749.question: What interfaces are used for communication in UE Positioning operations?
q_16749.ground_truth: There are five interfaces used for communication in UE Positioning operations: Iu, Iur, Iub, Uu, and Iupc.

q_16750.question: How long will the UE not consider a cell as a candidate for reselection if the cell is part of the "list of forbidden TAs for roaming"?
q_16750.ground_truth: The UE will not consider this cell and other cells on the same frequency as candidates for reselection for a maximum of 300 seconds.

q_16751.question: What is the primary function of the LCCF in the LCS server functional group?
q_16751.ground_truth: The LCCF manages the external interface towards LCF, handles mobility management for location services, determines if the final positioning estimate satisfies the QoS, provides flow control of positioning requests, orders transformations to local co-ordinates, transforms local co-ordinates to network identities, and generates charging and billing related data for LCS.

q_16752.question: What is the purpose of the Advice of Charge (AoC) framework specified in the document?
q_16752.ground_truth: The AoC framework provides for both offline and online charging models, specifying the AoC architecture, governing principles, the IMS AoC framework function, message flows, and interface data description.

q_16753.question: What is the role of the Active Codec Set (ACS) in the Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) speech service?
q_16753.ground_truth: The Active Codec Set (ACS) in the Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) speech service is a set of codec modes (including 1 to 4 AMR codec modes) associated with a list of 1 to 3 switching thresholds and hysteresis. The ACS is used by the DL Mode Request Generator and the UL mode control unit to generate Codec Mode Requests and Codec Mode Commands for uplink and downlink adaptation. The ACS, thresholds, and hysteresis can be defined at call setup and modified at handover or during a call.

q_16754.question: What is a MAC-d Flow?
q_16754.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP, a MAC-d flow refers to a data flow that is transmitted over a MAC entity's MAC-ehs queue. It is a sequence of MAC-d PDUs that are sent over the same MAC entity and are associated with the same MAC-d flow identity. The MAC-d flow identity is used to identify the MAC-d flow and is assigned by the network.

q_16755.question: When is the TPC command to transmit "1" instead of "0" for the uplink DPCCH2?
q_16755.ground_truth: The TPC command to transmit "1" instead of "0" for the uplink DPCCH2 is sent when the HS-DSCH serving cell in the active set detects a decrease in the DPCCH2 quality and provides a TPC command to adjust the uplink DPCCH2 transmit power.

q_16756.question: What is the "legIDToMove" parameter used for in the MoveLeg procedure?
