q_17012.question: How can the IWF determine the handled MCPTT ID in the SIP request?
q_17012.ground_truth: The handled MCPTT ID is identified in the `<mcptt-calling-user-id>` element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the SIP request.

q_17013.question: What does the eCall service provide in addition to an emergency voice call?
q_17013.ground_truth: The eCall service provides reliable full-duplex data communications between the In-Vehicle System (IVS) and the Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) in addition to the emergency voice call.

q_17014.question: What is the scope of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects Telecommunication management Trace Management Integration Reference Point (IRP) document?
q_17014.ground_truth: The scope of the document is to specify the overall requirements for the Trace Management Integration Reference Point (Trace IRP) as it applies to Itf-N.

q_17015.question: What is the TP-MTI value in the SMS-PP (SEND SHORT MESSAGE) Message 2.1 and 3.1?
q_17015.ground_truth: TP-MTI value in the SMS-PP (SEND SHORT MESSAGE) Message 2.1 and 3.1 is SMS-SUBMIT.

q_17016.question: What must the GW (PCEF) do after receiving IP-CAN session signalling for IP-CAN Session modification in step 2 of the IP-CAN Session Modification?
q_17016.ground_truth: The GW (PCEF) may make a decision to trigger IP-CAN Session modification based on the signalling received.

q_17017.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication Management?
q_17017.ground_truth: The purpose is to define the Home Node B Subsystem (HNS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) for telecommunication network management, including management of converged networks.

q_17018.question: What is one potential use case for 5MBS delivery?
q_17018.ground_truth: A Broadcast operator operates a HPHT distribution and primarily targets non-TV devices but also provides the services to TV devices. The Broadcast operator provides multiple services, for example public free-to-air or private, and has the ambition to run a hybrid service from day one.

q_17019.question: What is the logical interface between a New RAN node and an NGC node in the NG interface?
q_17019.ground_truth: The NG interface is a point-to-point logical interface between a New RAN node and an NGC node.

q_17020.question: What is the purpose of the "serviceID" element in the "mbmsSecurityDeregister" complex type in the provided XML schema?
q_17020.ground_truth: The "serviceID" element is used to specify the identification of the service for which the MBMS security deregistration is being performed.

q_17021.question: What certificates are used by the UE for one-way authentication of the O-SNPN during the registration procedure?
q_17021.ground_truth: The UE uses the set of roots of trust certificate information provided during manufacturing for one-way authentication of the O-SNPN.

q_17022.question: When is a PDN GW required to execute appropriate 3GPP resource release procedures based on routing rules provided by the UE during an addition of an access in UE-initiated NBIFOM mode?
q_17022.ground_truth: This happens when the UE provided Routing Rules to the network when adding trusted WLAN access to the PDN Connection during the initial PDN connection establishment.

q_17023.question: What does CUG communication refer to?
q_17023.ground_truth: CUG communication is a communication which is restricted to a pre-defined group of users.

q_17024.question: What is the expected sequence 2.1A in the procedure for the ME in the test method described in 27.22.4.11.2.4.2?
q_17024.ground_truth: The expected sequence 2.1A is "SEND SS, call forward unconditional, all bearers, successful, basic icon self-explanatory, successful."

q_17025.question: What is the scientific study of ants called?

q_17026.question: What is high latency communication and what is its purpose?
q_17026.ground_truth: High latency communication is a feature used to handle mobile terminated communication with UEs being unreachable while using power saving functions. The purpose of this feature is to handle initial response time before normal exchange of packets is established, and includes extended buffering of MT data at the Gn/Gp-SGSN or at the Serving GW, and establishing the user plane for delivering the buffered data when the UE contacts the SGSN by signalling.

q_17027.question: What is the advantage of the multicast model over multi-unicast in terms of savings on uplink capacity, uplink coverage, and terminal battery life?
q_17027.ground_truth: The multicast model allows each participant to send a single copy of its media stream to a common multicast group, and the underlying multicast infrastructure then distributes the media to each participant. This reduces the need for the sending terminal to send individual copies of the media to each of the other participants, resulting in savings on uplink capacity, uplink coverage, and terminal battery life.

q_17028.question: What is the role of Resource Performance Management in relation to Resource Trouble Management?
q_17028.ground_truth: Resource Performance Management provides monitoring, analysis, control, and reporting on the performance of resources. If an analysis identifies a resource quality problem, it passes the information to Resource Trouble Management or Service Quality Management, which decide on and carry out the appropriate actions.

q_17029.question: What is one strategy for optimizing the overall speech quality during intra-cell handover when repacking for higher radio efficiency under high load conditions?
q_17029.ground_truth: One strategy is to handover calls with good to best radio conditions from the old codec type to the new codec type, while keeping calls with low radio conditions in the old codec type.

q_17030.question: What are the two main components of Uplink Time Synchronization for TSN system clocks?
q_17030.ground_truth: The two main components of Uplink Time Synchronization for TSN system clocks are distribution time mechanisms for 5GS internal clock and TSN system clocks.

q_17031.question: Which country is the "mbms-PL-ServiceRestrictInfo" derived from?

q_17032.question: What is the meaning of LTE, UTRA, and E-UTRA in the context of 3GPP technical report on the measurement of UE radio performances for LTE/UMTS terminals?
q_17032.ground_truth: LTE stands for Long Term Evolution, UTRA stands for Universal Terrestrial Radio Access, and E-UTRA stands for Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access, they all refer to the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) standards for mobile broadband communications.

q_17033.question: What happens in dual transfer mode if there is radio resource allocation co-ordination in the network?
q_17033.ground_truth: Dual transfer mode is a subset of class A mode of operation, only possible if there is radio resource allocation co-ordination in the network.

q_17034.question: What is the parameter named in the "UE test loop mode F setup" that determines the type of communication transmission or reception?

q_17035.question: In what circumstances is reduced U-plane latency expected in Advanced E-UTRA and Advanced E-UTRAN?
q_17035.ground_truth: U-plane latency reduction is expected in situations where the UE does not have a valid scheduling assignment and when the UE needs to synchronize and obtain a scheduling assignment.

q_17036.question: Which procedure is used to remove a profile or selected GUP components from the repository?
q_17036.ground_truth: The Delete procedure is used by the application to remove a profile or selected GUP components from the repository, requiring the attached resource identity and component type.

q_17037.question: What is the function of the HRPD RAT in the HRPD RAT location condition for the ISMP rule?
q_17037.ground_truth: The HRPD RAT in the HRPD RAT location condition for the ISMP rule represents the AAA, Roaming, and Traffic management related to the High Rate Packet Data (HRPD) functionality in the Evolved Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Services (E-MBMS).

q_17038.question: How does the MCVideo service help MCVideo Administrators to authorize an MCVideo User to remotely activate another MCVideo User's camera?
q_17038.ground_truth: The MCVideo service provides a mechanism that allows MCVideo Administrators to grant specific permissions to an MCVideo User, which includes the ability to remotely activate another MCVideo User's camera.

q_17039.question: What is the maximum number of EDCH MACd flows that can be specified in the "EDCH-MacdFlowSpecificInformationList-RL-CongestInd" container?
q_17039.ground_truth: The maximum number of EDCH MACd flows that can be specified in the "EDCH-MacdFlowSpecificInformationList-RL-CongestInd" container is maxNrOfEDCHMACdFlows.

q_17040.question: What is the minimum requirement for narrowband blocking in the context of MSR based on a E-UTRA 1RB interfering signal with mean power of -49dBm?
q_17040.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for narrowband blocking in the context of MSR based on a E-UTRA 1RB interfering signal with mean power of -49dBm is that the interfering signal offsets may be dependent on the victim E-UTRA channel bandwidth. The 240~kHz offset correspond to the first RB (closest to the RF bandwidth edge) of an E-UTRA interfering signal.

q_17041.question: What are the two main privacy aspects considered within the scope of the Generalized Privacy capability?
q_17041.ground_truth: The two main privacy aspects considered are protection of personal data and non-disclosure of identity.

q_17042.question: When can the new BSS take the old BSS's pre-emption recommendation into account?
q_17042.ground_truth: The new BSS may take into account the old BSS's recommendation to allow pre-emption or not allow pre-emption when performing the Handover resource allocation procedure.

q_17043.question: What transport protocol is used as the default for establishing data channels in the ICE procedure?

q_17044.question: What were the two coding solutions tested in the ITU-R BS.1534-3 binaural listening test, along with a third solution for diversifying the MUSHRA test?
q_17044.ground_truth: The two coding solutions tested were the HE-AACv2 codec used to encode stereo pairs and the MPEG-H Low Complexity profile. The third solution was not relevant for 3GPP analysis purposes.

q_17045.question: What happens if a control relationship exists and the CSE instructs the IPLMN/VPLMN to initiate a new call leg for a mobile originated call or mobile terminating call in the VPLMN?
q_17045.ground_truth: The new call leg will be subject to the Outgoing Call Barring Supplementary Services and the Outgoing Operator Determined Barring categories, but the CSE can suppress the invocation of conditional barring of outgoing calls.

q_17046.question: What is the purpose of the FRMR response in the LAPDm protocol?
q_17046.ground_truth: The FRMR response is used to report a frame rejection condition not recoverable by retransmission of the identical frame and can be caused by an undefined control field, a supervisory or unnumbered frame with incorrect length, or an I~frame with an information field that exceeds the maximum established length.

q_17047.question: When should the network include the fields broadcasted in E-UTRA SystemInformationBlockType1 associated to 5GC in the cgi-Info-5GC within a Measurement Report?
q_17047.ground_truth: The network should include the fields broadcasted in E-UTRA SystemInformationBlockType1 associated to 5GC in the cgi-Info-5GC within a Measurement Report if the UE is E-UTRA/5GC capable and all mandatory fields of the cgi-Info-5GC for the concerned cell have been obtained.

q_17048.question: What is the role of the 5G PKMF-1 in checking if the Remote UE and the UE-to-network relay are allowed to communicate with each other?
q_17048.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF-1 can perform this check if it has an SBI to the UDM (of Remote UE). If not, the 5GDDNMF-1 performs the check instead.

q_17049.question: What does the third digit (z) in the version numbering scheme indicate?
q_17049.ground_truth: The third digit (z) is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document and does not reflect technical enhancements, corrections, updates, or concepts such as wideband, super-wideband, and fullband.

q_17050.question: How does GAN provide support for GSM based SMS?
q_17050.ground_truth: GAN provides support for GSM based SMS by utilizing the same mechanism as GSM mobility management and call control. The SMS layers utilize the services of the MM layer to transfer SMS messages, which is relayed between the MS and CN in the same manner as in the other call control and mobility management scenarios.

q_17051.question: What should the (target) BSS do if it expects but does not receive a PS HANDOVER ACCESS message from the mobile station?
q_17051.ground_truth: The (target) BSS should consider the PS handover procedure to have failed and release all TBFs allocated to the mobile station in the new cell.

q_17052.question: What is the importance of the noise factor in the predicted spectrum generation for the high-frequency region?
q_17052.ground_truth: The noise factor is used to control the amount of noise inserted in the predicted spectrum at the decoder. It is calculated using the energies of the selected coefficients in the high-frequency region and scalar quantized using a 2-bit scalar quantizer.

q_17053.question: What is the function of the RAN Information Management (RIM) protocol in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard?
q_17053.ground_truth: The RIM protocol allows the exchange of the information between two BSSs or between a BSS and an RNS or between a BSS and an eNodeB or between an eNodeB and an eHRPD eAN transparently through the core network in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard.

q_17054.question: What message does an eNodeB/RNC send to indicate a user's MBMS UE Context status during a Routing Area Update procedure?
q_17054.ground_truth: The eNodeBs/RNCs send IP multicast Join or Leave message to the received user plane IP multicast address allocated by the MBMS GW.

q_17055.question: What is the definition of transmit OFF power in sub-clause 6.5.1.1?
q_17055.ground_truth: The transmit OFF power is defined as the RRC filtered mean power in a duration of at least one timeslot excluding any transient periods, and the requirement for the transmit OFF power shall be less than -56 dBm.

q_17056.question: What should the UE do if the IE "Cell selection and reselection info" is not included for a new neighbouring cell in System Information Block type 12?
q_17056.ground_truth: The UE should use the default values specified for the IE "Cell selection and reselection info" for that cell except for the IE "HCS neighbouring cell information".

q_17057.question: What type of messages is reported as Intercept Related Information for the interception of multi-media service?
q_17057.ground_truth: SIP messaging is reported as Intercept Related Information for the interception of multi-media service.

q_17058.question: What can be used to mitigate uplink control signalling (PUCCH) interference from HUE to macro-eNB and from MUE to HeNB?
q_17058.ground_truth: Enabling orthogonal transmissions and making use of PUCCH offsets for orthogonal PUCCH assignments between HeNBs and macro-eNBs users.

q_17059.question: How should subsequent lost speech frames be handled?
q_17059.ground_truth: A muting technique should be used that gradually decreases the output level, resulting in silencing of the output after a maximum of 320 ms.

q_17060.question: What is the purpose of establishing an N4 session between the SMF+PGW-C and the UPF+PGW-U?
q_17060.ground_truth: The purpose of establishing an N4 session between the SMF+PGW-C and the UPF+PGW-U is to provide connectivity between the UAV and the networked UAV controller.

q_17061.question: What architectural framework does 3GPP use for the PLMN management architecture?
q_17061.ground_truth: The 3GPP PLMN management architecture is based on ITU-T TMN and Telecom Operations Map from TeleManagement Forum, which addresses operation support and management for any communications service from a top-down customer-oriented standpoint.

q_17062.question: Which interfaces are defined for communication between GUP entities in the 3GPP Generic User Profile (GUP) architecture?
q_17062.ground_truth: Two interfaces, Rp and Rg, are defined for communication between GUP entities in the 3GPP Generic User Profile (GUP) architecture.

q_17063.question: What is the mean DL coverage in Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR1, InH, DL, VR/AR30, #UE=Capacity(5~11) in the first set of observations?
q_17063.ground_truth: The mean DL coverage in Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR1, InH, DL, VR/AR30, #UE=Capacity(5~11) in the first set of observations is -76.62dB.

q_17064.question: What is the command type in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 1?

q_17065.question: What is generated by the USS/UTM upon successful UAS authentication for authorizing the UAV for subsequent UAS services?
q_17065.ground_truth: The USS/UTM generates an Authorization Token (Auth Token) with a validity period or time duration for the 3GPP network to authorize the UAV for subsequent UAS services.

q_17066.question: What should a UE in EMM-IDLE mode do if at least one PLMN reported by lower layers is in the list of authorized PLMNs for V2X communication over PC5 and provides radio resources for V2X communication over PC5, and the UE does not have an emergency PDN connection?
q_17066.ground_truth: The UE in EMM-IDLE mode should perform PLMN selection triggered by V2X communication over PC5 as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122.

q_17067.question: What are the two modes of the MBMS bearer service?
q_17067.ground_truth: The two modes of the MBMS bearer service are Broadcast Mode and Multicast Mode. Broadcast Mode is supported for EPS and GPRS, and Multicast Mode is supported for GPRS.

q_17068.question: What is the size of a radio block in bits for the UAS-10 packet data block type?
q_17068.ground_truth: The size of a radio block in bits for the UAS-10 packet data block type is 42x211 + 231x2 + 2 = 1838.

q_17069.question: What is the main challenge when using a pre-provisioned list of PLMNs for disaster roaming?
q_17069.ground_truth: The main challenge is that all PLMNs in the pre-provisioned list may be damaged by the same disaster, making it impossible for the UE to select a PLMN offering disaster roaming.

q_17070.question: What is the difference between using a GBR flow/bearer and a non-GBR flow/bearer with high PL for video traffic in a 3GPP network?
q_17070.ground_truth: Using a non-GBR flow/bearer with high PL is often better for video traffic in a 3GPP network, as it is likely cheaper and does not require the same level of radio resource consumption as a GBR flow/bearer aimed to carry the video traffic at the target quality level. However, it may lead to less optimal quality/cost trade-off and an increased risk of the system rejecting/dropping the QoS bearer.

q_17071.question: What are the network options affected by Solution #6?
q_17071.ground_truth: Solution #6 is applicable to the following network options: Option 4 - 5G core based Dual Connectivity (NR master - eUTRA secondary), Option 5 - 5G core with eUTRA, and Option 7 - 5G core based Dual Connectivity (eUTRA master - NR secondary).

q_17072.question: Which AMR codec modes are significantly better than the GSM FR codec in all error conditions?
q_17072.ground_truth: The two lowest AMR codec modes, 5.15 and 4.75, are significantly better than the GSM FR codec in all error conditions.

q_17073.question: What action does the MRFP take when it receives an RTP header extension for Arbitrary ROI and applies video transcoding?
q_17073.ground_truth: The MRFP keeps the predefined ROI information unchanged during the transcoding and copies the received RTP header extension for Arbitrary ROI to the succeeding outgoing RTP stream(s) after transcoding the associated group of packets.

q_17074.question: What is the purpose of leveraging NWDAF analytics for monitoring the number of UEs registered in the Network Slice and their Observed Service Experience?
q_17074.ground_truth: Leveraging NWDAF analytics for monitoring the number of UEs registered in the Network Slice and their Observed Service Experience can ensure that the SLA on Service Experience provided by the MNO can be guaranteed at any time.

q_17075.question: In which downlink direction are the block formats shown in 7.6.1 through 7.6.8 valid, as explicitly stated in 3GPP TS 44.060?

q_17076.question: Which timer is used by the MME to limit the amount of time waiting for a location response from the E-SMLC?

q_17077.question: Under what conditions is a UE not allowed to request 5GS services except emergency services when camped on a cell of a TA?
q_17077.ground_truth: When the TA belongs to the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service".

q_17078.question: What message is sent from the CRNC to the Node B to terminate CS transmission or measurement procedure?
q_17078.ground_truth: The CELL SYNCHRONISATION TERMINATION REQUEST message

q_17079.question: What are the conditions for the creation of a new logical CDR by the IM-SSF when it receives an FCI operation in the "Waiting for Instructions" or "Waiting for End of User Interaction" state?
q_17079.ground_truth: An FCI operation will create a Logical Call Data Record (CDR) if such a record does not already exist for the indicated leg when the IM-SSF receives this operation in the "Waiting for Instructions" or "Waiting for End of User Interaction" state.

q_17080.question: What should the MS do if it is in the process of GANC selection and receives a GA-RC REGISTER REJECT message from the GANC with a reject cause value of 'AP not allowed'?
q_17080.ground_truth: The MS shall stop the timer TU3904, release the TCP connection established to the GANC if still established, release the secure connection towards the SEGW associated with the GANC as defined in sub-clause 4.5, and store the AP-ID in the AP Exclude List. The MS shall not initiate a new Register Request from this AP until the AP-ID is removed from the AP Exclude List.

q_17081.question: What is the function of the HSS/HLR in the management of the incoming calls barring program?
q_17081.ground_truth: The HSS/HLR stores the logical state of the incoming calls barring program for each applicable elementary basic service group.

q_17082.question: What should a UE do if it loses coverage of the registered PLMN?
q_17082.ground_truth: The UE can either automatically select a new PLMN (automatic mode) or give an indication of available PLMNs to the user for manual selection (manual mode).

q_17083.question: When should cell reselection to another RAT be based on the Srxlev criteria instead of the Squal criteria?
q_17083.ground_truth: If the UE supports Squal (RSRQ) based cell reselection to E-UTRAN from all the other RATs provided by system information which UE supports, then the UE should reselect a cell based on the Squal criteria. Otherwise, cell reselection should be performed based on Srxlev criteria.

q_17084.question: Which three claims are verified by the NF Service Producer in Home SP during the service authorization based on token verification in step 2.2 of the procedure?
q_17084.ground_truth: Integrity of the token, claims in the token, and matching V-SNPN ID and PLMN/H-SNPN ID in the API request and access token.

q_17085.question: What is the function of the content ingestion negotiation in the provisioning procedures for MBMS User Services?
q_17085.ground_truth: The content ingestion is negotiated as part of the provisioning procedures for MBMS User Services to enable the BM-SC to start service announcement and activate MBMS bearer services.

q_17086.question: What is the formula for the entering condition A3-1 and leaving condition A3-2 for event A3 in 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.5.4.4?
q_17086.ground_truth: The entering condition A3-1 is represented by the inequality (Mn+Ofn+Ocn - Hys) > (Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off) and the leaving condition A3-2 is represented by the inequality (Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys) < (Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off), where the variables are defined within clauses 5.5.4.4 and 5.5.5.1.

q_17087.question: What is the significance of the C32 criterion?
q_17087.ground_truth: The C32 criterion is an improvement of the C2 criterion, which applies individual offset and hysteresis values to each pair of cells, and provides a more general tool for cell planning in GPRS.

q_17088.question: What is required for an entity to be an aggregation of SOA basic elements in clause 5.4.2?
q_17088.ground_truth: An entity can be an aggregation of SOA basic elements if it consumes services from SPs, adds its own value using internal functions, and provides a new set of enhanced service to other potential SCs.

q_17089.question: What is the role of the Network Exposure Function (NEF) in the 5G network?
q_17089.ground_truth: The NEF is responsible for exposing network information to edge network applications in a timely manner to optimize existing services and provide new types of services based on up-to-date radio conditions.

q_17090.question: What are the two different sizes of user-defined animations?
q_17090.ground_truth: The two different sizes of user-defined animations are small (8x8 pixels) and large (16x16 pixels).

q_17091.question: What is the main difference between the Compact Antenna Test Range and the Indoor Anechoic Chamber testing procedures?
q_17091.ground_truth: Both the Compact Antenna Test Range and the Indoor Anechoic Chamber testing procedures are used for assessing the OTA total power dynamic range, but the main difference is the type of test environment, the compact antenna test range is typically used to test antennas mounted on a vehicle or other large structure, whereas the Indoor Anechoic Chamber is typically used for testing smaller devices such as smartphones.

q_17092.question: What are the two steps in the two-step signalling approach for indicating which UE has been scheduled and for signalling the necessary information for the UE to decode the HS-PDSCHs in FDD?
q_17092.ground_truth: The two steps in the two-step signalling approach for indicating which UE has been scheduled and for signalling the necessary information for the UE to decode the HS-PDSCHs in FDD are in the first step, the information about the set of HS-SCCHs, channelisation code set, HS-DSCH channelisation codes, number of transport blocks, and the modulation scheme is signalled to the UE, followed by the second step where the information about the precoding weight, transport block size, and H-ARQ related information is signalled to the UE.

q_17093.question: What is the purpose of the steering of roaming connected mode control information (SOR-CMCI) in 5G networks?
q_17093.ground_truth: The purpose of the SOR-CMCI in 5G networks is to enable the HPLMN to control the timing of a UE in connected mode so that the UE can enter IDLE mode and perform SOR to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN when it is more appropriate based on the type of ongoing communication and other business arrangements.

q_17094.question: What is the purpose of Roaming Forwarding for CS fallback in mobile network operations?
q_17094.ground_truth: Roaming Forwarding for CS fallback is used to allow a UE (User Equipment) to return to the last used LTE PLMN after CSFB (Circuit Switched Fallback) for mobile terminated calls, where the MSC/VLR (Mobile Switching Center/Visitor Location Register) that the UE sends the LAU (Location Area Update) to is different from the one that sent the paging message to the UE.

q_17095.question: What is the purpose of the "MGW Resource Congestion Handling - Activate" procedure?
q_17095.ground_truth: The "MGW Resource Congestion Handling - Activate" procedure is used to activate the congestion handling mechanism in the MGW.

q_17096.question: What is the performance difference between SACCH and other codecs in MUROS mode with 0dB pairing?
q_17096.ground_truth: In MUROS mode (0dB pairing), SACCH performance stays relatively the same (or slightly worse) to other codecs with regards to DTS1.

q_17097.question: What is the function of the IWF (IP Multimedia Subsystem-aware IP Multimedia-public available station type of interface) when determining the user's Mission Critical Organization identity?
q_17097.ground_truth: The IWF determines the user's Mission Critical Organization identity, but the specifics of how it does this are out of scope for the current document.

q_17098.question: Under what circumstances may the UE attempt to select an E-UTRA cell connected to EPC if the access attempt is barred?
q_17098.ground_truth: The UE may attempt to select an E-UTRA cell connected to EPC if the UE is operating in the single-registration mode, the UE's usage setting is "voice centric," the UE has not disabled its E-UTRA capability, and the event which triggered the access attempt was an MO-MMTEL-voice-call-started indication or an MO-MMTEL-video-call-started indication.

q_17099.question: What should be considered when using BCCH carrier power reduction operation for network energy savings and preventing coverage loss effects?
q_17099.ground_truth: Operators need to carefully select values of involved network parameters, limit the maximum number of time slots carrying modulation types other than GMSK, and consider areas with very low cell overlap.

q_17100.question: What should the UE do if it is in the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION, and has received an initial REGISTRATION REJECT message with the T3346 value IE present and indicating a non-zero non-deactivated value?
q_17100.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3346 if it is running, and then wait for the back-off timer T3346 to expire before starting the initial registration procedure.

q_17101.question: What is required for converged charging for 5G VN group communication using N6 tunnel?
q_17101.ground_truth: REQ-3GPPCH-TFM-01 states that the 5G system should support converged charging for 5G VN group communication using N6 tunnel.

q_17102.question: What is the difference between NAT44 and NAPT44 in the context of Network Address Translation?
q_17102.ground_truth: NAT44 is a type of Network Address Translation that translates IPv4 addresses to IPv4 addresses. NAPT44, on the other hand, is a type of Network Address and Port Translation that translates IPv4 addresses and ports to IPv4 addresses and ports. NAPT44 is a more specific type of translation than NAT44 and is typically used in Network Address Translation at the edge of a network, where multiple devices share a single public IP address.

q_17103.question: What is the resolution and range of the Chip Offset parameter and what is its significance in Node B timing?
q_17103.ground_truth: The resolution of the Chip Offset parameter is 1 chip, and its range is from 0 to 38399. It is used as an offset for the DL DPCH or the F-DPCH relative to the PCCPCH timing in the Node B.

q_17104.question: When should the PCEF report accumulated usage for a monitoring key if usage monitoring is explicitly disabled by the PCRF?
q_17104.ground_truth: The PCEF should report accumulated usage for a monitoring key when usage monitoring is explicitly disabled by the PCRF as a result of receiving a CCR.

q_17105.question: What are the responsibilities of an authorised Public Safety ProSe-enabled UE when acting as a relay for other Public Safety ProSe-enabled UEs?
q_17105.ground_truth: Authorised Public Safety ProSe-enabled UEs, whether or not it is served by E-UTRAN, shall be capable of acting as a relay for other Public Safety Prose-enabled UEs, mutually authenticating each other when not served by E-UTRAN, receiving a ProSe Group Communications transmission, and acting as a relay for ProSe E-UTRA Communication, ProSe Broadcast Communication and ProSe Group Communication. It shall also be capable of relaying communications for one or more Public Safety Prose-enabled UEs that are within Communication Range of the ProSe UE-to-UE Relay.

q_17106.question: How does the SGW-C select the SGW-U for a UE in the EPS?
q_17106.ground_truth: The SGW-C selects the SGW-U for a UE based on the service area of the SGW-C partition and the coverage of the SGW-U functions. If more than one SGW-U is selected to serve a given UE, these SGW-Us need to cover an area including at least the service area of the SGW-C.

q_17107.question: What should the mobile station do when timer T3214 is running and it receives repeated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT messages on the same CCCH timeslot?
q_17107.ground_truth: The mobile station shall re-send the MBMS SERVICE REQUEST message if it receives repeated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT messages while timer T3214 is running.

q_17108.question: What is the format of the ITU-T V.110 80 bits frame used in rate adaptation?
q_17108.ground_truth: The ITU-T V.110 80 bits frame consists of 8 rows, each containing 10 octets (80 bits). Each row (except for the last) is followed by a framing bit. The first bit of the first row is 1, followed by 0s, while all other bits are 0, followed by 1. The rightmost bit of the last row is 1, indicating the start of the frame, while all other bits are 0.

q_17109.question: What is the expected sequence if the requested icon could not be displayed and the icon is non self-explanatory?

q_17110.question: What is the purpose of the Re-Auth-Request message in 3GPP online charging?
q_17110.ground_truth: The Re-Auth-Request message is used to request re-authorization for a service usage session, and is used to inform the server of changes to the charging conditions during the session.

q_17111.question: What is the minimum processing time for the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message and the OTDOA assistance data in the UE?
q_17111.ground_truth: T = 150 ms is the minimum processing time.

q_17112.question: How does the FD-CNG noise estimation algorithm reduce the dynamic range of the input energies for facilitating the fixed-point implementation of the noise estimation algorithm?
q_17112.ground_truth: The FD-CNG noise estimation algorithm reduces the dynamic range of the input energies for facilitating the fixed-point implementation of the noise estimation algorithm by applying a non-linear transform before noise estimation, and using the inverse transform on the resulting noise estimates to recover the original dynamic range.

q_17113.question: What is the role of the SMF in establishing a PDU session with N6 delay measurement?
q_17113.ground_truth: During the PDU session establishment, the SMF sends N4 rule to PSA UPF for N6 delay measurement, which may include traffic direction, IP 5 tuples, the frequency of N6 delay measurement, and observation period. The SMF also contacts the PCF to get PCC Rules with QoS monitoring parameters and sends N4 rules related with N6 delay measurement during the PDU session establishment procedure.

q_17114.question: What does the AMR-WB backward compatible operation of the EVS coder provide?
q_17114.ground_truth: The AMR-WB backward compatible operation of the EVS coder allows frames generated by an EVS AMR-WB IO encoder to be decoded by an AMR-WB decoder, and vice versa, without the need for transcoding.

q_17115.question: What is the role of the ACT identifier in the preferred list, when registering onto a VPLMN?
q_17115.ground_truth: When registering onto a VPLMN, the UE must take into account the priority of the ACT identifier in the preferred list on the USIM.

q_17116.question: What is the role of the broadband antenna in the calibration of the reverberation chamber?
q_17116.ground_truth: The broadband antenna is used to measure the losses in the chamber with a network analyzer to calibrate the reverberation chamber, which takes less than 10 minutes.

q_17117.question: What message does the Target MSC-Server send to the Target RNC when requesting to reserve Tt towards the Target RNC?

q_17118.question: What metadata should be recorded by the device for multiple spectator views offered with DASH?
q_17118.ground_truth: The device should record location and orientation information dynamically as media content is recorded, such as latitude, longitude, altitude, pan, tilt, rotation, and the amount of optical or digital zoom.

q_17119.question: What is the expected time before radio bearers can be established or the MS can be reached used by the SGSN for determining the buffer time when it stores the buffer time as a new value for the DL Data Buffer Expiration Time in the MM context for the MS in power saving state?
q_17119.ground_truth: The SGSN derives the expected time before radio bearers can be established to the MS (Iu case) or the MS can be reached (Gb case).

q_17120.question: How many conversion factors were agreed upon in SMG2 ad hoc meeting in April 1992 for the alignment of different RF requirements?
q_17120.ground_truth: Three conversion factors were agreed upon in SMG2 ad hoc meeting in April 1992 for the alignment of different RF requirements.

q_17121.question: What steps should be taken when synchronisation between handover cells is not possible, and a DPCH is assigned in the new TDD cell?
q_17121.ground_truth: The new TDD cell must use a burst type with a large enough transmission window to allow immediate data transmission without timing advance adjustment. If a DPCH is not assigned, the UE obtains timing advance before transmitting data using TA Request.

q_17122.question: What is the AMF's role in assigning Tracking Areas during the registration process for UAVs in 5G?
q_17122.ground_truth: The AMF assigns Tracking Areas as Non-Allowed Areas when restricted services are applicable, preventing the UAV from establishing a PDU session for UAS services like USS or C2 connectivity. When differentiated services are applicable, the AMF allows access to non-UAS PDU sessions like software update over Internet connectivity but restricts UAS services like connectivity to USS or UTM/USS.

q_17123.question: What is the definition of "Current Location" in the document?
q_17123.ground_truth: After a location attempt has successfully delivered a location estimate and its associated time stamp, the location estimate and time stamp is referred to as the "current location" at that point in time.

q_17124.question: In the provided architecture, when the group communication service is provided using Unicast Delivery, which network entity does the GCS AS need to access to establish QoS control in the visited PLMN?
q_17124.ground_truth: The GCS AS needs to access hPCRF and establish QoS control via the S9 interface towards the vPCRF directly to deliver the group communication service using Unicast Delivery in the visited PLMN.

q_17125.question: What logical channel is always mapped onto contiguous blocks reserved for access grants in a position given by the NCP parameter?

q_17126.question: What event triggers the location updating procedure in a mobile station?
q_17126.ground_truth: The location updating procedure is initiated by the mobile station when it finds itself in a different location area from the one it was registered in before.

q_17127.question: What is the benefit of utilizing existing 3GPP Network capabilities to provide enhanced services to Application Servers in this solution?
q_17127.ground_truth: This solution enables an optional capability of the MSGin5G Server to provide multiple functionalities (e.g., store and forward, triggering) by leveraging the monitoring procedures on behalf of multiple Application Servers. It helps in providing enhanced and efficient services to the Application Servers.

q_17128.question: What is the purpose of transmitting the activation flag and differential pitch lag as side information in the bitstream?
q_17128.ground_truth: The purpose of transmitting this side information is to obtain better pitch lag estimates and excitation signal for the future frame to be concealed.

q_17129.question: What action should the UE take if the access attempt is considered barred and T390 is already running for the Access Category?
q_17129.ground_truth: The UE should draw a random number and start timer T390 for the Access Category with a value calculated using the uac-BarringTime included in the "AC barring parameter".

q_17130.question: What action should the mobile station take if it receives an encapsulated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message which specifies a starting time that has already elapsed, and one or more uplink TBFs are in progress?
q_17130.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with access retry (see sub-clause 8.7.2).

q_17131.question: What is the type of id-WT-UE-XwAP-ID in the WTStatusResponse-IEs?
q_17131.ground_truth: The type of id-WT-UE-XwAP-ID in the WTStatusResponse-IEs is UE-XwAP-ID.

q_17132.question: Who is responsible for the activation and deactivation of the MSP service?
q_17132.ground_truth: The MSP service is activated by the service provider after provisioning and deactivated by the service provider as a result of withdrawal.

q_17133.question: What was the simulated example of spectrum due to modulation with GaAs HBT PA model for DSR?
q_17133.ground_truth: The simulated example of spectrum due to modulation with GaAs HBT PA model for DSR was 35% power added efficiency (PAE).

q_17134.question: What should the old SGSN include in the SGSN Context Response message if there is a valid packet flow identifier value assigned to a PDP context?
q_17134.ground_truth: The old SGSN shall include a Packet Flow Id IE in the SGSN Context Response message for each PDP context that has a valid packet flow identifier value assigned to it.

q_17135.question: What message does the UE transmit after step 7, if the measurement command has the value "setup"?
q_17135.ground_truth: The UE transmits a MEASUREMENT REPORT message containing the IE "UE positioning GPS measured results".

q_17136.question: What must the GCS AS include in the GCS-Action-Request (GAR) command to deallocate resources for MBMS bearer(s)?
q_17136.ground_truth: The GCS AS must include one MBMS-Bearer-Request AVP for each bearer that is to be deactivated, with the MBMS-StartStop-Indication AVP set to "STOP", the TMGI AVP, and the MBMS-Flow-Identifier AVP to designate the bearer to be deactivated.

q_17137.question: What is the function of the PS Handover Command message in the handover procedure?
q_17137.ground_truth: The PS Handover Command message is sent from the old SGSN to the source BSS, indicating the handover treatment for the PFC. It also contains the RN part and CN part as transparent information. The MS, upon receiving this message, shall suspend the uplink transmission of user plane data.

q_17138.question: What is the minimum coupling loss between unsynchronized TDD base stations for the Wide Area BS in the 3.84 Mcps TDD option?
q_17138.ground_truth: The minimum coupling loss between unsynchronised TDD base stations for the Wide Area BS in the 3.84 Mcps TDD option is 67 dB.

q_17139.question: What is the key functionality of WTA in WAP telephony services?
q_17139.ground_truth: WTA (Wireless Telephony Applications) allows access to telephony functionality such as call control, phone book and messaging from within WMLScript scripts.

q_17140.question: How can a data link layer entity exit the timer recovery condition?
q_17140.ground_truth: The timer recovery condition is cleared if the data link layer entity receives a valid supervisory frame response with the F bit set to "1," and the N(R) of this received supervisory frame is within the range from its current state variable V(A) to its current send state variable V(S) inclusive.

q_17141.question: What is the MCC & MNC for "ENVELOPE CALL CONTROL 1.7.1B"?

q_17142.question: What are the criteria for defining minimum call quality performance?
q_17142.ground_truth: The criteria for defining minimum call quality performance are: 1) blocked calls less than 2, 2) satisfied user criterion, 3) relative performance of associated signalling channels against the traffic channel.

q_17143.question: What is the purpose of the "UE positioning GPS assistance data" and "UE positioning GANSS assistance data" information elements in the MEASUREMENT CONTROL message for A-GNSS test cases?
q_17143.ground_truth: These information elements contain the assistance data required for the UE to perform A-GNSS positioning. If set to "Not present", it indicates that inadequate assistance data is provided.

q_17144.question: What command is executed when the mobile is busy in a browser session and a new browser session is launched with a specified URL?

q_17145.question: What must an LLE do when a timer T201 associated with an acknowledged I frame is active?
q_17145.ground_truth: The LLE must reset timer T201 if the I frame transmitted with sequence number N(R) + 1 is acknowledged.

q_17146.question: What is the condition for determining whether Access Identity 1 is valid?
q_17146.ground_truth: Access Identity 1 is valid if the RPLMN is the HPLMN, EHPLMN or visited PLMN of the home country.

q_17147.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of successful immediate messaging procedures at S-CSCF?

q_17148.question: What does the Buffer Occupancy (BO) parameter indicate in the context of MAC?
q_17148.ground_truth: The BO parameter indicates for each logical channel the amount of data in number of bytes that is available for transmission and retransmission in RLC layer.

q_17149.question: What is the role of the moving network operator in the scenario described in section 5.3.3?
q_17149.ground_truth: The moving network operator, typically a commercial vehicle like a train or a bus, acts as a network in its own right and offers Internet access and 3G services to its passengers. It has composition agreements with network operators and AAA providers for connectivity and authentication.

q_17150.question: What is the purpose of the DiversityIndication-RL-SetupFailureFDD choice in the Successful-RL-InformationRespItem-RL-SetupFailureFDD sequence?
q_17150.ground_truth: The DiversityIndication-RL-SetupFailureFDD choice indicates whether the connection is combining (combining) or non-combining or first RL (nonCombiningOrFirstRL) in the RL-SetupFailureFDD.

q_17151.question: What is the purpose of the Supported-Features AVP in the S9 reference point?
q_17151.ground_truth: The Supported-Features AVP is used during session establishment to inform the destination host about the required and optional features that the origin host supports.

q_17152.question: What occurs after a disaster condition in the PLMN, in terms of node selection by a UE?
q_17152.ground_truth: After a disaster condition applies, a UE can perform PLMN selection as-is, and will still select the same PLMN.

q_17153.question: What is the maximum number of hops expected for a validly routed call in the Max-Forwards and Hop Counter mapping principle?
q_17153.ground_truth: The maximum number of hops expected for a validly routed call in the Max-Forwards and Hop Counter mapping principle is based on network demands/provisions.

q_17154.question: How does the UE-to-UE Relay inform UE2 about UE1's new IP address/prefix?
q_17154.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay sends a new PC5 Relay Update Request message to UE2 (including UE1's old IP address/prefix, UE1's User Info, and UE1's new IP address/prefix) to inform UE2 about UE1's new IP address/prefix.

q_17155.question: What is the role of an XML document in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification on Advanced Alarm Management?
q_17155.ground_truth: An XML document is a key component in the communication between different systems and entities in the 3GPP Technical Specification on Advanced Alarm Management. It is used to define the structure and content constraints of alarms and network faults, and to store and exchange information between different entities or systems, such as an Information Service (IS) and an Integration Reference Point (IRP).

q_17156.question: Which operating systems are the C code of the Enhanced aacPlus codec verified to work on?
q_17156.ground_truth: The C code of the Enhanced aacPlus codec is verified to work on Windows XP, 2000, and Linux OS.

q_17157.question: What is the purpose of using pre-faded signals at each probe in a spatial channel model?
q_17157.ground_truth: The purpose of using pre-faded signals at each probe is to accurately reproduce the spatial characteristics of a narrow angle spread signal with a reduced number of antenna probes.

q_17158.question: What is the role of the adaptive codebook in the decoding process?
q_17158.ground_truth: The adaptive codebook provides the adaptive codebook vector, which is a representation of the past excitation at the pitch delay. This vector is used to reconstruct the speech signal.

q_17159.question: What action does the SCTP multiplexer take when the Payload Protocol Identifier is not supported?
q_17159.ground_truth: The SCTP multiplexer aborts the created SCTP association, sending an ABORT chunk to the client that contains a User-Initiated Abort cause code (12) and a specific Upper Layer Abort Reason (e.g. "Unsupported Payload Protocol Identifier").

q_17160.question: What action does the UE take when it is able to calculate a position after performing measurements and a Measurement Report is triggered?
q_17160.ground_truth: The UE includes the "UE positioning Position Estimate Info" IE in the Measurement Report and sets the contents of the IE based on the calculated position. If a GANSS timing of the cell frame measurement was taken, the UE also includes the GANSS TOD when the position estimate was valid. Additionally, if the UE supports providing GANSS timing, the UE includes the GANSS TOD when the position estimate was valid, potentially with a GANSS Time ID to identify the GNSS system time.

q_17161.question: What is the stage 3 specification provided in the document for?
q_17161.ground_truth: The Gw and Gwn reference points of the 3GPP technical specification for sponsored data connectivity.

q_17162.question: What is the definition of RRC in the context of 3GPP Release 17?
q_17162.ground_truth: RRC stands for Radio Resource Control and it is a protocol specification for the UE-UTRAN radio interface in 3GPP Release 17.

q_17163.question: What should the SMF do if it includes the 'seamless Edge relocation' indication in the PCC rule?
q_17163.ground_truth: For Option 1, the SMF should send an N4 Session Modification Request to the PSA1 to establish forwarding tunnel towards PSA2 and send End Marker per QoS Flow to ensure in-order delivery. For Option 2, the SMF should provide the Flow End Marker to the UL CL2 and indicate it to send it to the PSA1 before it starts to forward the traffic to the PSA2.

q_17164.question: What are the features of the video push service in the MCVideo system?
q_17164.ground_truth: The video push service in the MCVideo system allows an authorized MCVideo user to push video to another MCVideo user, with the mechanism provided by the MCVideo service. An authorized user can push a video to another user, with authorization from the MCVideo administrator. The user can enable and disable the automatic sending of notification, as well as blacklist or whitelist specific MCVideo users for pushing video.

q_17165.question: What is the function of UE history information in EN-DC?
q_17165.ground_truth: UE history information in EN-DC helps avoid the ping-pong effect by storing and correlating UE history information, forwarding UE history information and optional UE history information to connected SNs, and collecting SCG UE history information for use in subsequent handover preparation.

q_17166.question: What is the purpose of a Simultaneous Usage Group (SUG) in this solution?
q_17166.ground_truth: The SUG is used to distinguish which network slices can be grouped together and served by the same AMF Set, allowing them to be simultaneously used.

q_17167.question: Which three solutions are selected as the basis for normative work for addressing Key Issue #6?
q_17167.ground_truth: Solution#6, Solution#7 and Solution#9 are selected based on the UAE Client assisted/UAE Server controlled principles, addressing various aspects of C2 communication link selection and usage for UAVs and UAV-Controllers.

q_17168.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of successful HSS initiated user profile update procedures at S-CSCF, with a single integer value, and has the format UP.SuccPPA?
q_17168.ground_truth: Successful HSS initiated user profile update procedures

q_17169.question: What should the LMA do when it receives a PBU message for the PMIPv6 MAG Initiated PDN Connection Deletion procedure in terms of returning IP addresses and GRE keys to their respective pools?
q_17169.ground_truth: The LMA returns the IPv6 Home Network Prefix assigned to the UE's PDN connection to the pool of free IPv6 Home Network Prefixes, the IPv4 Home Address assigned to the UE's PDN connection to the pool of free IPv4 Home Network Addresses, and the PDN connection's uplink and downlink GRE keys to their respective pools of free GRE keys.

q_17170.question: What is the term used to describe the process where the logical channels are dedicated to a hopping TRX in frequency hopping?

q_17171.question: What is the effect of the "Preemption Vulnerability" bit in the ASSIGNMENT REQUEST?
q_17171.ground_truth: If the "Preemption Vulnerability" bit is set to 1, then this connection is vulnerable and shall be included in the preemption process or procedure and as such may be subject to forced release or forced handover.

q_17172.question: What are the roles in a CMMC conference?
q_17172.ground_truth: The roles in a CMMC conference are conference host, floor chair (per media), and conference participant.

q_17173.question: What is the LSA controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication Management?
q_17173.ground_truth: The LSA controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a management interface in 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication Management that defines the operations, notifications and their parameters for the LSA controller and other network elements.

q_17174.question: What information is stored in the VLR/SGSN/MME for the incoming calls barring program?
q_17174.ground_truth: No information is stored in the VLR/SGSN/MME for the incoming calls barring program.

q_17175.question: What is the scope of the 3GPP charging management specifications?
q_17175.ground_truth: The 3GPP charging management specifications cover the core network charging architecture and principles, the content of CDRs per domain/subsystem/service, the content of real-time charging messages per domain/subsystem/service, the functionality of online and offline charging for those domains/subsystems/services, and the interfaces used in the charging framework to transfer the charging information.

q_17176.question: What layer of the TCP/IP model does the SBc-AP interface support for point-to-point transmission in the IP layer?
q_17176.ground_truth: The SBc-AP interface supports point-to-point transmission for delivering messages in the IP layer.

q_17177.question: What should be taken into account by the UE when deciding which access to use for outgoing sessions, performing UE assisted T-ADS, or before considering initiating Access Transfer?
q_17177.ground_truth: The UE should take into account operator policy, user preferences and the Local Operating Environment Information when deciding which access to use for outgoing sessions, performing UE assisted T-ADS, or before considering initiating Access Transfer.

q_17178.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of successful initial registrations at the P-CSCF or S-CSCF, given as a single integer value?

q_17179.question: When different spreading factors are used on DPCHs to which different CCTrCHs are mapped, where is the Layer 1 control information transmitted?
q_17179.ground_truth: The Layer 1 control information is transmitted only on the first DPCH in this case as well.

q_17180.question: Which IEC standard applies to equipment covered by the scope of the present document for harmonic current emission requirements?
q_17180.ground_truth: IEC 61000-3-2 applies for equipment covered by the scope of the present document for harmonic current emission requirements. For equipment with an input current greater than 16 A per phase, IEC 61000-3-12 applies.

q_17181.question: What is the status word for the R-APDU in the TERMINAL RESPONSE PERFORM CARD APDU 1.1.2?
q_17181.ground_truth: Command performed successfully - length '1B' of response data

q_17182.question: How is the onboarding procedure done when O-SNPN and Home service provider are different?
q_17182.ground_truth: When O-SNPN and Home service provider are different, after successful authentication, the Local Provisioning Server will not find IMEI2 details. In this case, either it will provide the CPS address to UE or the LPS will directly direct the request to CPS so that the UE can be provisioned directly by the CPS. After the onboarding procedure is completed, UE deregisters from the S-NPN1/SP1 network and attaches to S-NPN2 or another network using the credentials received as part of the provisioning procedure to get normal service.

q_17183.question: What are the performance metrics expected to be reported for BD-Rate computation and SDR in the scenario?
q_17183.ground_truth: The expected performance metrics to be reported for BD-Rate computation and SDR in the scenario are Peak-Signal to Noise Ratio PSNR(Y) of luma component, Average colour component PSNR, Structural similarity metric MS-SSIM, and Video Multimethod Assessment Fusion (VMAF).

q_17184.question: What does srb-InformationSetupList contain in the RRCConnectionSetup-IEs sequence?
q_17184.ground_truth: SRB-InformationSetupList contains a list of SRB (Signaling Radio Bearer) information for each direction, including the SRB Identity, the SRB Type, and other information.

q_17185.question: What kind of SI/PSI messages are indicated by the Type field in the NACC application when it contains the value 3?
q_17185.ground_truth: System Information messages as specified for BCCH (3GPP TS 44.018)

q_17186.question: What is the maximum amount of timing change in one adjustment, as specified for UE transmit timing?
q_17186.ground_truth: The maximum amount of timing change in one adjustment is 1/4 chip.

q_17187.question: What should the O-MGCF do upon receipt of the first 200 OK (INVITE), if the Address Complete Message (ACM) has already been sent?
q_17187.ground_truth: The O-MGCF shall send the Answer Message (ANM) to the preceding exchange.

q_17188.question: What type of AVP is used to identify the PoC user role?

q_17189.question: What is required for the UE to be fully unaware of the EAS change in Solution #27?
q_17189.ground_truth: For the UE to be fully unaware of the EAS change in Solution #27, it requires the migration of the L4 context between the source and target EAS to keep the L4 context.

q_17190.question: What should be done if a negative acquisition indicator corresponding to the selected signature is detected in the downlink access slot corresponding to the selected uplink access slot?
q_17190.ground_truth: L1 status ("Nack on AICH received") should be passed to the higher layers (MAC) and the physical random access procedure should be exited.

q_17191.question: What are the two types of physical uplink control channels used in 3GPP LTE ?
q_17191.ground_truth: The E-DCH Physical Uplink Channel and the E-RUCCH (E-DCH Random Access Uplink Control Channel) are the two types of physical uplink control channels used in 3GPP LTE.

q_17192.question: What are the three possible frequencies for the E-UTRA signal used for in-band blocking?
q_17192.ground_truth: The three possible frequencies for the E-UTRA signal used for in-band blocking are 1.4 MHz, 3 MHz, and 5 MHz.

q_17193.question: What are the responsibilities of the AMF in authorizing a UE as a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay or Remote UE?
q_17193.ground_truth: The AMF determines whether a UE is authorized to be a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay or Remote UE, selects a PCF for authorization policy and parameter, and forwards the UE's PC5 capability to the PCF for further processing.

q_17194.question: In which message type are up to 96 3G Neighbour Cells and/or UTRAN frequencies listed?
q_17194.ground_truth: The 3G Neighbour Cell list may contain up to 96 3G Neighbour Cells and/or UTRAN frequencies for RSSI reporting, and this list is given by one or more instances of the SI2quater or PSI3quater message with the same value.

q_17195.question: Which type of cells does the Neighbouring TDD Cell Information IE provide information for?
q_17195.ground_truth: The Neighbouring TDD Cell Information IE provides information for 3.84Mcps TDD or 7.68Mcps TDD cells that are neighboring cells to a cell in the DRNC.

q_17196.question: What are the guidelines for the version numbering format adopted in the specification?
q_17196.ground_truth: The specification uses a version number format consisting of three parts separated by dots (x.y.z). The first digit (x) denotes the level of approval, with '1' for TSG information, '2' for TSG approval, and '3' or higher for TSG approved documents under change control. The second digit (y) indicates technical enhancements, corrections, or updates, and is incremented with each change of substance. The third digit (z) is used for editorial changes and is incremented independently from the first two digits.

q_17197.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a specific type of message with the Final Ack Indicator bit set to '1' and meets certain conditions while timer T3192 is running?
q_17197.ground_truth: The mobile station should stop the current instance of timer T3192, consider the downlink TBF released, and act upon the new assignments.

q_17198.question: What is the purpose of the "Delivery of Ciphering Keys to UEs for Broadcast Assistance Data" procedure?
q_17198.ground_truth: This procedure is used by the E-SMLC and the MME to distribute ciphering keys to UEs, enabling them to decipher broadcast assistance data that was ciphered by the E-SMLC. This procedure is not associated with a UE location session.

q_17199.question: What abbreviation is used to define a Public Warning System (PWS) in the Technical Report?
q_17199.ground_truth: The abbreviation used to define a Public Warning System (PWS) in the Technical Report is PWS.

q_17200.question: What is the purpose of the Code-Receiving Security Parameters in the ProSe Discovery procedure?
q_17200.ground_truth: The Code-Receiving Security Parameters provide the necessary information by the Monitoring UE to undo the protection applied by the announcing UE and are stored with the ProSe Code or Discovery Response Code.

q_17201.question: What is the state of the MBMS Bearer Context in which bearer plane resources are required for transferring MBMS data?
q_17201.ground_truth: The 'Active' state of the MBMS Bearer Context is when bearer plane resources are required for transferring MBMS data.

q_17202.question: What must an NSE do to obtain the new IP endpoint for NS SDUs when the "Request Change Flow" bit is set?
q_17202.ground_truth: The NSE must obtain the new IP endpoint from the source IP endpoint (i.e. in the UDP/IP header) of the NS SDU in which the "Request Change Flow" bit was set.

q_17203.question: What type of measurement is used to determine the maximum time it takes for the SGSN to establish a PDP context initiated by the network during each collection interval, split into subcounters per traffic class per APN?

q_17204.question: What is the P-TMSI Signature used for in 3GPP TS 23.003 and 3GPP TS 23.060?
q_17204.ground_truth: The P-TMSI Signature is used for identification checking purposes during mobile communication.

q_17205.question: Which message is sent by the SMS-SC to MTC-IWF if the SMS-MO is successfully authorized but fails at a later stage in the MSISDN-less SMS MO via T4 - failure at the MTC-IWF scenario?
q_17205.ground_truth: The SMS-SC sends the "MO payload delivery Request" message to the MTC-IWF with the SMS payload and the destination SME address, but it returns the failure delivery indication to SMS-SC if it fails at a later stage.

q_17206.question: What information element in the UTRAN mobility IEs contains the dedicated priority information?

q_17207.question: What is the term for unwanted emissions caused by harmonics, parasitics, intermodulation products, and frequency conversion products?

q_17208.question: What are the three layers required for signalling on the MS-BSS interface in the GSM PLMN?
q_17208.ground_truth: The three layers required for signalling on the MS-BSS interface in the GSM PLMN are the physical layer, the data link layer, and layer 3.

q_17209.question: What is the general principles that solutions for the issues discussed in the document should preferably follow?
q_17209.ground_truth: Solutions should preferably avoid impacts to LTE/EPC functions and principles of operation, including security, policy control, charging, QoS, mobility anchor, UE IP address allocation, and lawful interception.

q_17210.question: What is the filename of the Filter Description schema in this version?
q_17210.ground_truth: The filename of the Filter Description schema in this version is FilterDescription.xsd.

q_17211.question: What is the requirement for the 5G DDNMF in the UE-to-network relay security flow?
q_17211.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF has the logic to understand and check the match of PC5 security policies, and it needs to support monitoring request/response to be supported on N65/N66 between the 5G DDNMFs for checking PC5 security policy match. A new procedure might be needed or the existing procedure can be used, which is up to SA2.

q_17212.question: What happens during T2 or T3 when the call is disconnected?
q_17212.ground_truth: When the call is disconnected, the disconnect demand is sent and the channel state changes to idle.

q_17213.question: What procedure is followed for the CTSBCH transmission in GSM-CTS?
q_17213.ground_truth: The CTS-FP transmits the CTSBCH on the selected CTSBCH frequency at the maximum permitted output power.

q_17214.question: When do the minimum requirements specified in sub-clause 6.4.4.1 apply at each transmit antenna connector?
q_17214.ground_truth: The minimum requirements specified in sub-clause 6.4.4.1 apply at each transmit antenna connector for UE with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD operation, UL CLTD activation state 1, and UL MIMO operation.

q_17215.question: What are the channels used to page an MS prior to downlink packet transfer?

q_17216.question: How should a UE process simultaneous RRC procedures?
q_17216.ground_truth: After receiving a message that invoked a procedure, the UE should be prepared to receive and act on another message that may invoke a second procedure, unless specified otherwise in the relevant subclause.

q_17217.question: What should the Node B do if the Reference Received Total Wide Band Power Reporting IE is included in the COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message in FDD systems?
q_17217.ground_truth: The Node B should include the Reference Received Total Wide Band Power Support Indicator IE or the Reference Received Total Wide Band Power IE in the COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE.

q_17218.question: What happen when a Liberty session is explicitly terminated?
q_17218.ground_truth: When a Liberty session is explicitly terminated, the temporary GBA related data is deleted from the IdP storage, and for the next user login, the UE would be required to execute the Ub bootstrapping procedure again.

q_17219.question: What are the two main options for SACCH signalling in OSC full rate channels in the downlink?
q_17219.ground_truth: The two main options for SACCH signalling in OSC full rate channels in the downlink are straightforward application of SACCH signalling as for legacy channels, but mapped to the subchannels and the usage of Repeated SACCH as standardized in GERAN Rel-7 for full rate traffic channels.

q_17220.question: How many pulses are contained in the innovation vector for the 6.70 kbit/s mode?
q_17220.ground_truth: The innovation vector contains 3 pulses for the 6.70 kbit/s mode.

q_17221.question: What is the equation for calculating the spectral envelope in the low frequency portion of the frequency representation in the LP residual?
q_17221.ground_truth: The spectral envelope is calculated as (1345) where Re and Im are the real and imaginary parts of the i-th frequency bin, and NFFT is the size of the FFT analysis.

q_17222.question: What carries the parameters relevant for the MS and the core network in PS handover in 3GPP TS 23.401?
q_17222.ground_truth: The Radio Network part (RN part) of the transparent container in PS handover in 3GPP TS 23.401 carries the radio interface related parameters relevant for the MS and the radio network (BSS/RNC/eNB) sent transparently through the core network.

q_17223.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group's presentation layer for 3GPP services?
q_17223.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group's presentation layer for 3GPP services specifies an HTML5 profile as a common presentation layer for 3GPP services such as PSS, MBMS, and MMS.

q_17224.question: What signalling response is sent by the SCC AS to the TAS via the CSCF when the user is determined to be unreachable over the I1 reference point during call setup?
q_17224.ground_truth: An appropriate SIP response indicating that the user is unreachable.

q_17225.question: What does the @serviceId attribute in the userServiceDescription element represent?
q_17225.ground_truth: The @serviceId attribute in the userServiceDescription element signals a unique identifier in the format of a URI.

q_17226.question: What is the definition of "Personal mobility" in the context of IP multimedia services?
q_17226.ground_truth: Personal mobility refers to the mobility for those scenarios where the user changes the terminal used for network access at different locations. It is the ability of a user to access telecommunication services at any terminal on the basis of a personal identifier, and the capability of the network to provide those services delineated in the user's service profile.

q_17227.question: Which EVS mode offers the highest gain in terms of link budget and coverage?
q_17227.ground_truth: The 13.2 kbps channel aware mode (Option 1) offers the highest gain in terms of link budget (2.8 dB) and coverage (17%) compared to AMR 12.2 kbps and AMR-WB 12.65 kbps.

q_17228.question: What are the three different actions described in RFC 4006 that a P-GW can support when the failure handling mechanism is executed in case charging per IP-CAN session is active?

q_17229.question: What should be included in the "UE GANSS timing of cell frames" if the UE supports the capability to provide GANSS timing of the cell and the "GANSS timing of Cell wanted" is not included in the IE "GANSS Positioning Methods"?
q_17229.ground_truth: The "UE GANSS timing of cell frames" should be set to the GANSS TOD when the measurements included in the MEASUREMENT REPORT were valid.

q_17230.question: What is the qualifier value for the SET UP EVENT LIST command in the Call Connected Event test?
q_17230.ground_truth: The qualifier value for the SET UP EVENT LIST command in the Call Connected Event test is '00'.

q_17231.question: How is the "To-id" information element constructed when transporting an International number?
q_17231.ground_truth: The "To-id" information element contains the E.164 digit-string, which is binary encoded in the octet 3, octet 4, octet 5, etc. The most significant digit of the E.164 digit-string is encoded in the bits numbers 8, 7, 6, and 5 of octet number 3. The bit-pattern "1111" is used as the end-delimiter for the E.164 digit-string.

q_17232.question: What is required of the NRM defined by the State Management Data Definition IRP in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_17232.ground_truth: The NRM defined by the State Management Data Definition IRP in the 3GPP Technical Specification must support communications for telecommunication network management purposes, including the management of converged networks. It is also required to be a member of the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM) and its information is derived from the FNIM Umbrella Information Model (UIM).

q_17233.question: What are the two high-level variants for the local NEF to receive MnS output from MnS producer?
q_17233.ground_truth: The two high-level variants are: (1) variant relying on local NEF interrogating the MnS producer for usage of MDT tracing, and (2) variant relying on local NEF interrogating the MnS producer for NG RAN.

q_17234.question: What is a Road Side Unit (RSU) as defined in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_17234.ground_truth: A Road Side Unit (RSU) is a stationary infrastructure entity supporting V2X applications that can exchange messages with other entities supporting V2X applications. In 3GPP specifications, RSU is a logical entity that supports V2X application logic using the functionality provided by either a 3GPP network or an UE (referred to as UE-type RSU).

q_17235.question: In the context of a UE-initiated Detach procedure for GERAN/UTRAN with ISR activated, what message does the SGSN send to the associated MME in step 4 when the UE performs an IMSI Detach only procedure?
q_17235.ground_truth: The SGSN sends a Detach Notification (Cause, Detach type) message to the associated MME, where Cause indicates "IMSI Detach only".

q_17236.question: What procedure is used to ensure that the best fit of dedicated resources are allocated to the ongoing call?

q_17237.question: What RF channels should be tested for single carrier in the test environment?
q_17237.ground_truth: The RF channels to be tested for single carrier in the test environment are B, M and T as specified in subclause 5.3.

q_17238.question: What is the resolution of the video sequences used in the external characterization results described in clause 7.5.2?
q_17238.ground_truth: The resolution of the video sequences used in the external characterization results described in clause 7.5.2 are UHD, 1080p, 720p, and 480p.

q_17239.question: Who is the main character in the movie "The Karate Kid"?

q_17240.question: What is the effect of constraining dual carriers to be adjacent on link enhancement and losses?
q_17240.ground_truth: Constraining dual carriers to be adjacent slightly reduces both the gains and losses in performance resulting from inter-carrier interleaving. However, the case of widely separated, non-hopped carriers remains to be assessed.

q_17241.question: What enhancement is made to Solution #8 in this solution?
q_17241.ground_truth: Small enhancements are made to Solution #8 on Edge Enabler Client registration.

q_17242.question: What is the TP-UDL (User Data Length) value for the SMS TPDU in Expected Sequence 4.6?

q_17243.question: What is the function of the OIP service in IMS Multimedia Telephony?
q_17243.ground_truth: The OIP service in IMS Multimedia Telephony provides the terminating party with the Identity of the originating party. This allows the terminating party to receive the identity of the originating party in a communication session.

q_17244.question: What should a mobile station do when it receives an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT or IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message during the packet access procedure indicating a packet downlink assignment procedure?
q_17244.ground_truth: The mobile station shall abort the packet access procedure and respond to the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT or IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message.

q_17245.question: What command qualifier is used in the test cases for OPEN CHANNEL?
q_17245.ground_truth: The command qualifier used in the test cases for OPEN CHANNEL is immediate link establishment.

q_17246.question: What triggers the sending of the MAP PREPARE HANDOVER response with the AN-APDU parameter of the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE?
q_17246.ground_truth: Positive result in the response to Prepare-Handover request, triggering the sending of the RELOCATION CMD in 3G-MSC-A.

q_17247.question: What is the pre-condition for message delivery between MSGin5G UEs in different PLMNs as per Solution 18.2?
q_17247.ground_truth: The pre-condition is that MSGin5G UE1 (MSGin5G Client1) is registered to the MSGin5G Server1 in one PLMN, and MSGin5G UE2 (MSGin5G Client2) is registered to the MSGin5G Server2 in another PLMN. MSGin5G Server 1 and MSGin5G Server 2 should have established a secured connection.

q_17248.question: When is a ProSe EPC-level Discovery record generated in 5G ProSe offline charging?
q_17248.ground_truth: A ProSe EPC-level Discovery record is generated for each EPC-level discovery request for a specific user received from a ProSe enabled UE in 5G ProSe offline charging.

q_17249.question: What is the result when a UE receives an Attach Accept message with no MBMS feature support indication?
q_17249.ground_truth: The UE deactivates all active MBMS UE Contexts locally.

q_17250.question: What number do you press to release a specific active call X and end communication with it?

q_17251.question: In the LP-CNG decoding procedure, what are the smoothed low-band excitation energy and LSP vector used for?
q_17251.ground_truth: The smoothed low-band excitation energy and LSP vector are used to synthesize a smoothed final excitation signal, which is then filtered through the low-band CNG synthesis filter to generate low-band comfort noise.

q_17252.question: What is the function of the I-CSCF in IMS registration?
q_17252.ground_truth: The I-CSCF initiates standard procedures for S-CSCF location/allocation, verifies the incoming REGISTER's origin, and forwards the REGISTER to the S-CSCF.

q_17253.question: In the context of GERAN Evolution, what is the priority for uplink enhancement, considering that spectrum efficiency is already high in the uplink?
q_17253.ground_truth: A method to increase data rates has higher priority than a method for higher spectrum efficiency in the uplink.

q_17254.question: What is the main consideration for applying results from UTRA co-existence studies to future technologies in the UTRA bands?
q_17254.ground_truth: The main consideration for applying results from UTRA co-existence studies to future technologies in the UTRA bands is the very large margin of more than 20 dB between the limit of -15 dBm/MHz and the level where studies show an adverse impact from BS emissions on a victim system in the band.

q_17255.question: What is the device identity of the source device in the initial command?
q_17255.ground_truth: The source device is the UICC.

q_17256.question: What is the HLR's response to incoming CUG calls?
q_17256.ground_truth: The HLR's response to incoming CUG calls may include no CUG information, CUG Interlock Code, Interlock Code and Outgoing Access indicator.

q_17257.question: What message type and direction does the "Request" passage describe?
