q_17503.ground_truth: The capacity performance is increased from 7 UEs per cell with legacy BSR to 8.4 UEs per cell with enhanced BSR, a 20% improvement.

q_17504.question: What is timer T3190 used for and what is its value?
q_17504.ground_truth: Timer T3190 is used during packet downlink assignment on CCCH. It is started at the receipt of an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message or an IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message (if supported) when in dedicated mode. It has a value of 5 seconds.

q_17505.question: What is the power backoff that is required for a 5 timeslot allocation in the uplink as compared to 4 timeslots?
q_17505.ground_truth: For a 5 timeslot allocation in the uplink, a 7dB backoff from maximum power is required as compared to a 6dB backoff for 4 timeslots.

q_17506.question: How does the UE determine if a PLMN can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers?
q_17506.ground_truth: The UE determines if a PLMN can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers by checking if the PLMN is in the DRS-supported PLMN list and if the PLMN's NG-RAN cell broadcasts the "disaster roaming PLMN list" including the PLMN ID of the PLMN D.

q_17507.question: What should the MBSF Client include in the User-Agent request header field when identifying itself to the MBSSF at reference point MBS-5?
q_17507.ground_truth: The MBSF Client should include the product identifier token set to the value MBSF Client in the User-Agent request header field when identifying itself to the MBSSF at reference point MBS-5.

q_17508.question: What will the V-PCRF do when it receives an AAR command for the establishment of the AF signalling session from the V-AF and is not required to forward the message to the H-PCRF?
q_17508.ground_truth: The V-PCRF will handle the AF signalling session locally and acknowledge the AAR command by sending an AAA command to the V-AF.

q_17509.question: What is the purpose of the "establishment of the secure connection" in the 3GPP's GAN technical specification?
q_17509.ground_truth: The "establishment of the secure connection" refers to the process by which the MS and GANC-SEGW set up an IPsec tunnel for secure communication. This includes the use of EAP-SIM or EAP-AKA for mutual authentication of the MS and the core network, and the negotiation of Traffic Selectors (TS) for securing the communication.

q_17510.question: What should be the value of the skip indicator for a message received in the Radio Resource management protocol?
q_17510.ground_truth: A message received with skip indicator '0000' should not be ignored, unless it is ignored for other reasons.

q_17511.question: What is one of the input parameters for Intent driven MnS Producer when executing a CSIatEdge intent?
q_17511.ground_truth: The input parameters for Intent driven MnS Producer include service type, service requirements, service availability, and edge identification information.

q_17512.question: What video codec and audio codec are required for sharing videos on WhatsApp?
q_17512.ground_truth: H.264/AVC video codec and AAC audio codec are needed today for sharing videos on WhatsApp.

q_17513.question: What should the mobile station do if the Facility IE is encoded as "simple recall alignment" in the CC_ESTABLISHMENT message?
q_17513.ground_truth: The mobile station shall copy the Facility IE and SS Version IE from the set-up container to the SETUP message without verifying or modifying the contents of these information elements.

q_17514.question: Which TS (Technical Specification) clause specifies the network's possible actions when resuming a suspended RRC connection?

q_17515.question: What does the new SGSN do after updating the PDP context fields?
q_17515.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends an Update PDP Context Response (TEID) message to the GGSN to receive new incoming downlink IP packets.

q_17516.question: What is the significance of the high level MExE requirements for MExE UE's?
q_17516.ground_truth: The high level requirements for MExE UE's include providing a common set of APIs and development tools for MExE service provider specific services, more sophisticated user interfaces with various MMI concepts, user control over the "look and feel" of applications, personalization of user interface, services, and multimedia components, a wide variety of applications and applets support, and security architecture for authentication, encryption, and access control. These requirements are crucial as they ensure a consistent user experience and security across various classes of MExE UE's.

q_17517.question: What information does the Secondary CPICH Information IE provide when it can be used for channel estimation?
q_17517.ground_truth: The information on the Secondary CPICH

q_17518.question: What happens if the GPI corresponds to an already existing NAF SA?
q_17518.ground_truth: The UE will not invoke a UICC application, but silently drop the GPI and terminate the GPI processing.

q_17519.question: What is the interruption time for a UE not requiring idle intervals and measurement occasions in GSM?
q_17519.ground_truth: The interruption time for a UE not requiring idle intervals and measurement occasions in GSM is 480 ms.

q_17520.question: What is one challenge associated with reverse intermodulation in dual carrier RF?
q_17520.ground_truth: One challenge associated with reverse intermodulation is the need for good isolation between transmitters to avoid intermodulation products. With 40 dB of isolation, it is possible to obtain about -70 dBc IMD levels, but this is not trivial.

q_17521.question: What is the maximum number of radio terminals in an IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard?
q_17521.ground_truth: The maximum number of radio terminals in an IPDL-TDD-ParametersLCR sequence in the ITU-T Q.311 standard is 16.

q_17522.question: Under what condition should the CatFindNthTLV function return the pointer to the found TLV in the proactive command buffer?
q_17522.ground_truth: The function should return the pointer when the occurrence argument is 1 (first) and the Tag argument is the TLV tag being searched for.

q_17523.question: What is the purpose of the IF Side Initiated Radio Access Bearer Establishment operations?
q_17523.ground_truth: The IF Side Initiated Radio Access Bearer Establishment operations allow the transfer of control messages for radio access bearer establishment between non-access strata elements on each side of the access interface, initiating a radio access bearer and requesting transmission resource allocation.

q_17524.question: What is the definition of the Calling Line Identification Restriction (CLIR) Supplementary Service?
q_17524.ground_truth: The CLIR Supplementary Service enables the calling party to prevent presentation of its line identity to the called party.

q_17525.question: What geographical areas may be associated with NR-PC5 unicast security policies as per 3GPP TS 33.185?
q_17525.ground_truth: The NR-PC5 unicast security policies are associated with one or more geographical areas where the NR-PC5 unicast security policy applies.

q_17526.question: In what network operation mode~I should the MS initiate the periodic location update procedure immediately after being IMSI-attached to a network?

q_17527.question: What are the main processes involved in the centralized energy saving process within an energy efficiency management group?
q_17527.ground_truth: The main processes involved in the centralized energy saving process within an energy efficiency management group are monitoring, analysis, decision, execution, and evaluation.

q_17528.question: What is the adjustment of scaling done prior to performing the flip-and-decimate-by-4 operation for signals with relatively higher energy in the high band in the fixed point operation?
q_17528.ground_truth: A headroom of 3 bits is provided prior to decimation to avoid any saturation in the decimation operation.

q_17529.question: What should a WT include in a WT STATUS REPORT message for each BSS?
q_17529.ground_truth: The BSS Load IE, the WAN Metrics IE, and the Available Channel Utilization IE, if the corresponding bits are set in the Report Characteristics IE included in the WT STATUS REQUEST message

q_17530.question: Are there any data framing requirements for the WebRTC Web Server Function (WWSF)?
q_17530.ground_truth: No, there are no data framing requirements for the WWSF.

q_17531.question: What is the role of the hybrid ARQ functionality in E-DCH transport channel?
q_17531.ground_truth: The hybrid ARQ functionality matches the number of bits at the output of the channel coder to the total number of bits of the E-DPDCH or S-E-DPDCH set to which the E-DCH transport channel is mapped.

q_17532.question: What message is sent by the GANC to the MS to confirm the release of the GA-CSR connection?

q_17533.question: What is the purpose of the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP CALL command in the test description?
q_17533.ground_truth: The PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP CALL command is used to simulate a set up call proactive command, which is a command from the SIM to the ME to set up a call.

q_17534.question: What is the significance of the version number x.y.z of the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_17534.ground_truth: The first digit denotes the stage of the document's approval in the TSG, the second digit indicates technical enhancements, corrections or updates, and the third digit signifies editorial changes.

q_17535.question: What are the main properties of the Full MBMS service mode in the IP-based mode of the pass-through system?
q_17535.ground_truth: The main properties of the Full MBMS service mode include the ability to reuse existing 3GPP service layer for consumption of the media and the Content Provider offers the service conforming to 3GPP TV services, where the DASH Server and DASH client comply with the 3GPP DASH formats as defined in TS 26.247.

q_17536.question: What modulation techniques are used for the current EGPRS coding schemes?
q_17536.ground_truth: 8-PSK, 16-QAM and 32-QAM modulations are used for the current EGPRS coding schemes.

q_17537.question: What must be included in the "Positioning Methods" if the UE wants to perform GANSS measurements on multiple GANSS frequencies?
q_17537.ground_truth: "GANSS Multi-frequency Measurement Requested" IE with a supported GANSS and one of its signals measured.

q_17538.question: In the acknowledged mode data, what is the maximum RLC PDU size allowed when using "Flexible RLC PDU size"?
q_17538.ground_truth: The maximum size of the data field of the RLC PDU is 1503 octets when using "Flexible RLC PDU size".

q_17539.question: In what ways can the network autonomy be implemented in different management scopes?
q_17539.ground_truth: The network autonomy can be implemented in different management scopes, including autonomy in NE layer, autonomy in domain layer, autonomy in cross domain layer, and autonomy in communication service layer.

q_17540.question: How many service level groups are defined in TS 22.261 for V2X high accuracy positioning requirements?
q_17540.ground_truth: Seven service level groups are defined in TS 22.261 for V2X high accuracy positioning requirements: Service level 1 to Service level 7.

q_17541.question: What information does the Extended-APN-AMBR-DL AVP indicate for non-GBR bearers in the downlink direction across the same APN?
q_17541.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate bit rate in kbit per second.

q_17542.question: What exception is thrown by the array manipulation methods if there is an attempt to access an element outside of the array's bounds?

q_17543.question: What should the UE do when the CELL UPDATE CONFIRM message includes "CN information elements" but does not include "RAB information to setup" or "RB information elements"?

q_17544.question: What are the reference points of the EPC-level Discovery ProSe Function?
q_17544.ground_truth: The EPC-level Discovery ProSe Function has reference points towards the Application Server (PC2), towards other ProSe Functions (PC6), towards the HSS (PC4a), and towards the UE (PC3).

q_17545.question: Which SCCP primitives are necessary for the E1 interface?
q_17545.ground_truth: The necessary SCCP primitives for the E1 interface are those specified in ITU-T Recommendations Q.711, Q.712, Q.713 and Q.714.

q_17546.question: What is the initial version of an operator's Specialized Information Model (SpIM) created from?
q_17546.ground_truth: The initial version of an operator's Specialized Information Model (SpIM) is generated through operator-specific specialization of CBIM, such as through definition of operator-specific end-user groupings.

q_17547.question: What is the name of the "special cell" in the LTE-Advanced system that provides security input and NAS mobility information?
q_17547.ground_truth: The "special cell" is a term used to describe the cell in the LTE-Advanced system that provides specific security input and NAS mobility information, such as one ECGI, one PCI, and one ARFCN, to the user equipment (UE).

q_17548.question: What is the functionality of the lawful interception (LI) entities in EPS nodes for Evolved Packet System?
q_17548.ground_truth: The LI functional entities (ADMF, DF, MF, LEMF) are responsible for lawful interception in EPS nodes.

q_17549.question: Under what circumstances may a UE, which has already been onboarded, need to be onboarded again?
q_17549.ground_truth: A UE, which has already been onboarded, may need to be onboarded again if it needs to be reset to its default factory state, if it did not attempt onboarding within the time window, or if it has expired.

q_17550.question: What action should the UE take when activating a 5G NAS security context during a security mode control procedure?
q_17550.ground_truth: If the UE is activating a 5G NAS security context resulting from a security mode control procedure, it should send a SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message with the entire REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

q_17551.question: What should the MAC entity do if a fallbackRAR is received during the RACH procedure with contention resolution?
q_17551.ground_truth: If the MAC entity receives a fallbackRAR during the RACH procedure with contention resolution, it must transmit a MSG3 using the UL grant scheduled in the fallbackRAR.

q_17552.question: What is a requirement for point-to-point delivery verification in MBMS user services?
q_17552.ground_truth: A potential requirement for point-to-point delivery verification for delivered content is one characteristic of service examples in MBMS user services.

q_17553.question: What are the mechanisms that can be used to trigger service announcements in MBMS?
q_17553.ground_truth: The mechanisms include MBMS bearer capabilities, PUSH mechanism (WAP push), URL (WAP, HTTP), SMS (point-to-point), and SMS-CB cell broadcast.

q_17554.question: What type of command is used in the 3.1.1 proactive SIM command?

q_17555.question: What is the purpose of the AlarmIRP class in the document?
q_17555.ground_truth: The AlarmIRP class in the document represents the alarm management capabilities specified by the document and inherits attributes from the ManagedGenericIRP class.

q_17556.question: What is the purpose of providing Discovery Codes (DC) and Discovery Filters (DF) in 5G Direct Discovery using Model A?
q_17556.ground_truth: The purpose of providing DC and DF in 5G Direct Discovery using Model A is that the Announcing UE can broadcast its presence and ProSe application using DC, while Monitoring UEs can recognize and identify the Announcing UE using DF.

q_17557.question: What is the primary aim of the Tandem Free Operation (TFO) feature?
q_17557.ground_truth: The primary aim of the TFO feature is to realize improvements in speech quality by avoiding tandeming speech codecs in mobile to mobile speech calls.

q_17558.question: What is the purpose of the half rate speech processing functions in the GSM system?
q_17558.ground_truth: The half rate speech processing functions in the GSM system are responsible for the speech processing functions in the half-rate channel, which includes speech transcoding, Discontinuous Transmission (DTX), Voice Activity Detector (VAD), and comfort noise aspects.

q_17559.question: Who is assigned as the floor chair for a whiteboard in a data conference?
q_17559.ground_truth: The conference host or the creator of the whiteboard

q_17560.question: What network entity is responsible for supporting the transfer of short messages between the Service Centre and mobile stations in GSM/UMTS/EPS networks?

q_17561.question: What is the role of the FLUS sink's reception queue?
q_17561.ground_truth: The FLUS sink's reception queue is used to recover the encoder frame rate and compensate for network jitter.

q_17562.question: What is the type of network composition between 3GPP operators?
q_17562.ground_truth: The composition type is Network Interworking, which means that 3GPP operators maintain their rights to control their contributed resources and do not gain any new resource controls through the composition.

q_17563.question: Which two companies' TSC Sets (Training Sequence Candidates Sets) were selected for further evaluation in the successive work item VAMOS?
q_17563.ground_truth: Huawei Technologies Ltd and Research in Motion Ltd

q_17564.question: What is the role of the authorization proxy (AP) in HTTPS communication between a UE and an application server?
q_17564.ground_truth: The AP is the TLS end point that authenticates the UE and sends the authenticated UE identity to the application server.

q_17565.question: Which sequence out of "RadioLinkSetupRequestFDD" and "RadioLinkSetupRequestTDD" contains the "RadioLinkSetupRequestTDD-Extensions" field?

q_17566.question: What should the network do if the PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message or the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message for the TBF is not received, or if EMST is used for the RLC entity in the radio block indicated by the RRBP field?
q_17566.ground_truth: The network should increment counter N3103 and retransmit the PACKET~UPLINK~ACK/NACK message for the TBF, or if EMST is used, the RLC entity. If counter N3103 exceeds its limit, the network should stop scheduling new uplink resources for the TBF and start timer T3169 for the TBF.

q_17567.question: What are the two types of applications that can be distinguished in the FRMCS System?
q_17567.ground_truth: The two types of applications that can be distinguished are applications that are aware of their transport service requirements and those that are not.

q_17568.question: What must the BM-SC include in the MBMS-Bearer-Response AVP for a successful MBMS bearer modification?
q_17568.ground_truth: The BM-SC shall include the TMGI AVP and the MBMS-Flow-Identifier AVP, and may include Radio-Frequency AVP(s) indicating the modified radio frequency.

q_17569.question: What is the difference between a "Conference" and a "Telepresence" in the context of IP multimedia services?
q_17569.ground_truth: A "Conference" is an IP multimedia session with two or more participants, while "Telepresence" is a specific type of conference with interactive audio-visual communications experience between remote locations, optimizing various attributes such as audio and video quality, eye contact, and spatial audio.

q_17570.question: What is the name of the message type used in the "UE test loop mode C MBMS packet counter request" message?

q_17571.question: What should the mobile station do upon receiving a PACKET MBMS ANNOUNCEMENT message with an MBMS p-t-m channel description?
q_17571.ground_truth: If the mobile station receives the PACKET MBMS ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MBMS p-t-m channel description while it is in packet idle mode, it shall start listening to downlink RLC blocks identified by the assigned TFI on the defined PDCHs.

q_17572.question: What is the main criterion for triggering DNS handling functionalities in the SMF in Option 1?
q_17572.ground_truth: The main criterion for triggering DNS handling functionalities in the SMF in Option 1 is when certain criterion, such as FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name), is matched in the received DNS response message.

q_17573.question: What should the DRNS include in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message in FDD, if it supports dynamic DTXDRX related HS-SCCH orders and the UE DTXDRX related HS-SCCH orders uniform behavior indicator is set to 0 in the HS-DSCH FDD Information IE?
q_17573.ground_truth: The DRNS shall include the Support of Dynamic DTXDRX Related HS-SCCH Order IE in the HS-DSCH FDD Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message.

q_17574.question: Who is responsible for managing a private enterprise's access in a controlled environment, such as a company office?
q_17574.ground_truth: The management of a private enterprise's access in a controlled environment is typically the responsibility of the company itself.

q_17575.question: What are the user requirements for multiband MSs, as outlined in the document?
q_17575.ground_truth: The user requirements for multiband MSs, as outlined in the document, state that no special actions by the user should be necessary to use a multiband MS, and the possibility for the user to decide to operate the MS in a single band mode should be supported. Indications may also be given to the user of which band is being used. The user of a multiband MS should be able to roam between PLMNs operating in any of the MS's frequency bands of operation.

q_17576.question: How does the User Plane Function (UPF) deliver the QUIC packet over N6?
q_17576.ground_truth: Once the UPF receives the QUIC packet with a QUIC datagram frame, the UPF extracts the UDP payload, adds (re-creates) appropriate UDP/IP headers based on the "Datagram-Flow-Id", and forwards the PDU via N6.

q_17577.question: Which user plane protocol stack is used for L3 UE-to-NW Relay access via N3IWF?
q_17577.ground_truth: The user plane protocol stack for L3 UE-to-NW Relay access via N3IWF is the same as the user plane protocol stack for untrusted non-3GPP access.

q_17578.question: What should a UE do if it does not receive the group common PDCCH in a slot?
q_17578.ground_truth: The UE should be able to receive at least PDCCH in a slot, at least if the gNB did not transmit the group common PDCCH.

q_17579.question: What forms the majority of the delay in the transition from Idle to Connected mode in LTE-Advanced, and how much of an improvement can be achieved by reducing processing delays?
q_17579.ground_truth: Processing delays in the different nodes form around 75% of the delay in the transition from Idle to Connected mode in LTE-Advanced. Any improvement in processing delays can have a large impact on the overall latency.

q_17580.question: What interfaces and functions are included in the online charging architecture for the PS domain based on P-GW with included PCEF and TDF?
q_17580.ground_truth: The Ro interface and the associated Diameter application are used in the online charging architecture for the PS domain based on P-GW with included PCEF and TDF.

q_17581.question: What is the purpose of the separate STUN server used by the served UE while it gathers ICE candidates?
q_17581.ground_truth: The separate STUN server is used by the served UE while it gathers ICE candidates to establish interactive connectivity.

q_17582.question: What information does the User Equipment (UE) convey to the network when it is not able to sort all the Slice-Network Slice Selection Assistance Information (S-NSSAIs) in priority order?
q_17582.ground_truth: The UE conveys to the network the number of S-NSSAIs it has sorted in priority order.

q_17583.question: What is the default adopted MU value for the Indoor Anechoic Chamber and Compact Antenna Test Range in the context of OTA frequency error for the NFTR test procedure?
q_17583.ground_truth: The default adopted MU value is adopted for the OTA MU for both the Indoor Anechoic Chamber and Compact Antenna Test Range.

q_17584.question: What is the purpose of the "Terms" section in a 3GPP TS or 3GPP TR?
q_17584.ground_truth: The "Terms" section in a 3GPP TS or 3GPP TR provides formal definitions of terms used in the document.

q_17585.question: What message does the IMS-ALG (ATCF) send to the IMS-AGW (ATGW) in step 2 of the PS to CS access transfer procedure if media transcoding is required?
q_17585.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG (ATCF) sends a H.248 ADD request command to create the target access leg termination and to request IP resources to execute ATGW function.

q_17586.question: What should the MS do if it receives an RRLP message that it is not expecting?
q_17586.ground_truth: The MS may discard the message.

q_17587.question: What is the purpose of the GA-RRC RELOCATION ACCESS message?
q_17587.ground_truth: The GA-RRC RELOCATION ACCESS message is sent by the MS to the GANC to indicate that the MS has been commanded to handover a CS domain session to GAN Iu mode but the GA-RRC CS domain sub-layer entity in the MS is not yet in the GA-RRC CONNECTED state.

q_17588.question: What is the role of the TR editor in this process?
q_17588.ground_truth: The TR editor is responsible for introducing all approved TPs in the current TR, and it is the responsibility of the contact person of each band combination to ensure that the TPs related to their band combination have been implemented.

q_17589.question: In the context of OTA requirements, what is the role of the coordinate system reference point for the conducted tests?
q_17589.ground_truth: In conducted tests, analyzing a single test method is sufficient, while for OTA tests the chamber is an integral part of the test environment, and the coordinate system reference point is a location in reference to an identifiable physical feature of the BS enclosure.

q_17590.question: What message from the AMF indicates to the UE that the paging collision avoidance procedure is requested?
q_17590.ground_truth: The AMF includes the paging collision avoidance indication along with N2 paging message to RAN.

q_17591.question: What optimized procedure is suggested to skip primary authentication for the Relay UE?
q_17591.ground_truth: As an optimization to skip primary authentication, the Remote UE may optionally provide its 5G-GUTI when connecting for relayed communication authorization.

q_17592.question: What should the DRNS do when the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the E-DCH Processing Overload Level IE in the E-DCH TDD Information IE for a specific E-DCH in the 3.84Mcps TDD system, and the DRNS cannot decode the E-PUCH for the last consecutive number of TTIs because of a processing issue?
q_17592.ground_truth: The DRNS should notify the SRNC by initiating the Radio Link Failure procedure.

q_17593.question: What should the AS do upon receiving an initial INVITE request in the Gateway model?
q_17593.ground_truth: The AS should forward the initial INVITE request to the terminating UE with an inserted Alert-Info header field and a "precondition" option tag in the Supported header field if necessary.

q_17594.question: In short message mobile terminated procedure, what does the term "TPDUs" refer to?
q_17594.ground_truth: TPDUs refer to Transfer Protocol Data Units, which are messages or status reports exchanged between the Short Message Service Center and the Mobile Station in a Short message mobile terminated procedure.

q_17595.question: What error handling behavior is applied to QoS control rules when the BBERF receives the RAR Command?
q_17595.ground_truth: The same error handling behavior as defined in clause~4.5.12 is applied to QoS control rules, but the QoS-Rule-Report AVP is used to report the affected QoS rules instead of Charging-Rule-Report AVP.

q_17596.question: Which network entity shall be capable of supporting online charging using IETF techniques for TDF?
q_17596.ground_truth: The TDF may support online charging using IETF techniques.

q_17597.question: What UE-specific capability is defined by the "UE specific capability Information LCR TDD" parameter?
q_17597.ground_truth: The "UE specific capability Information LCR TDD" parameter defines the maximum number of frequencies supported in the multi-carrier HS-DSCH transmission.

q_17598.question: Under what circumstances should the old BSS transmit the (RLC/MAC) DTM HANDOVER COMMAND radio interface message to the MS in the case of DTM Handover?
q_17598.ground_truth: The old BSS should transmit the (RLC/MAC) DTM HANDOVER COMMAND radio interface message to the MS if it has received a PS-HANDOVER-REQUIRED-ACK PDU (if it has not already), stopped timer T23, and included the DTM Handover Command Indication field element within the New BSS to Old BSS Information IE in the BSSMAP HANDOVER COMMAND message.

q_17599.question: What should the UE do if the information relates to an SSF not known by the UE?
q_17599.ground_truth: The UE should create a new entry for this SSF with all indicated parameters.

q_17600.question: Who is the intended audience for the VAD specification in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_17600.ground_truth: The specification is mandatory for any VAD to be used in the GSM Mobile Stations (MS) and Base Station Systems (BSS).

q_17601.question: In what situation would the H-GMLC send a SRI for LCS message to the HLR/HSS in step 6?
q_17601.ground_truth: If the privacy profile is stored in a PPR but the network address of the PPR is not available, or if the key of the UE user's privacy profile (MSISDN or IMSI) is not available, the H-GMLC would send a SRI for LCS message to the HLR/HSS in step 6.

q_17602.question: What is the requirement for the test management service in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_17602.ground_truth: The requirements for the test management service are based on ITU-T Recommendation X.745, and they include the ability for the manager to initiate and terminate tests, monitor the test execution, report the test results to the manager, and log test results in the agent.

q_17603.question: What is the requirement for the ordering of IEs in a SBC-AP message?
q_17603.ground_truth: IEs in a SBC-AP message shall be ordered in the same order as they appear in the object set definitions.

q_17604.question: What is the nominal channel spacing for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
q_17604.ground_truth: The nominal channel spacing for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option is 1.6MHz.

q_17605.question: What should a mobile station perform first when reselecting a new cell while receiving multiple MBMS sessions in decreasing order of priority, if the mobile station has received MBMS NEIGHBOURING CELL INFORMATION messages for these sessions in the target cell?
q_17605.ground_truth: The mobile station should first perform fast reception resumption of as many MBMS sessions as possible.

q_17606.question: What is the purpose of the solution described in section 6.55?
q_17606.ground_truth: The purpose of the solution is to enable a UE to receive data services from one network (e.g. NPN) and paging as well as data services from another network (e.g. PLMN) simultaneously.

q_17607.question: What is the role of KMS in Prose, as specified in the present document?
q_17607.ground_truth: KMS in Prose is a functional entity responsible for key management, in particular, the management of ProSe security keys. KMS interacts with the ProSe Function to support ProSe features, and PC8 is used to transport security material to UEs for ProSe one-to-many communications.

q_17608.question: When shall the MGCF send a "Notify IMS RTP Tel Event" procedure to request the MGW to play out DTMF to the IM CN subsystem?
q_17608.ground_truth: The MGCF shall use the "Send IMS RTP Tel Event" and may use the "Stop IMS RTP Tel Event" procedures to request the MGW to play out DTMF to the IM CN subsystem whenever it receives out-of-band DTMF indications from the BICC network.

q_17609.question: What is the role of NWDAF as defined in the document?
q_17609.ground_truth: NWDAF interacts with different entities within 5GS for data collection and provides analytics to 5GC NFs and OAM.

q_17610.question: Which procedure is associated with the initiating message "Disconnect" in the PUA-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE list?

q_17611.question: What is the result of the incoming call request procedure if the CSI criterion is satisfied?
q_17611.ground_truth: The IPLMN/VPLMN shall suspend call processing, make contact with the CSE, and await further instructions.

q_17612.question: What is the action taken when a successful transmission of the RRC Connection Release Complete message is confirmed by the lower layers when releasing a signalling connection in state CELL_FACH?
q_17612.ground_truth: Release all radio resources and indicate to upper layers the release of the established signalling connections and radio access bearers. Clear any entries for the RRC Connection Release message, clear established signalling connections and established radio access bearers, pass the release cause to upper layers, and enter idle mode.

q_17613.question: What is one of the capabilities of the RAN design for the Next Generation Radio Access Technologies in terms of vehicular communication?
q_17613.ground_truth: The RAN design for NR V2X shall provide communication via infrastructure, including MBMS support, for V2X services and advanced V2X services, and communication via sidelink for V2X services and advanced V2X services.

q_17614.question: What information is sent from the SMF to the UE in the PDU Session Establishment Accept message?
q_17614.ground_truth: The ATSSS rules, network steering functionalties information, and QUIC Connection Setup information.

q_17615.question: In the scenario where the UE is connected to both 3GPP access and WLAN access, what needs to be done before moving an IP flow from WLAN to 3GPP access?
q_17615.ground_truth: The UE needs to request appropriate resources in the 3GPP access and include the packet filters related to the requested resources.

q_17616.question: What signalling bearer connection is used for the Information Exchange Context in this procedure?
q_17616.ground_truth: The procedure uses the signalling bearer connection for the Information Exchange Context.

q_17617.question: What are the two service attributes from the FRMCS User point of view in the FRMCS System?
q_17617.ground_truth: The two service attributes from the FRMCS User point of view in the FRMCS System are latency and communication reliability.

q_17618.question: What should the UE do if the criterion in 5.7.4.4 is met for a period of TSearchDeltaP-StationaryConnected as per TS 38.331 clause 5.7.4.1?
q_17618.ground_truth: If the criterion in 5.7.4.4 is met for a period of TSearchDeltaP-StationaryConnected, the UE should initiate transmission of the UEAssistanceInformation message to indicate that the criterion for RRM measurement relaxation for connected mode is fulfilled.

q_17619.question: What are the three possible interfaces over which command and control (C2) communication can be exchanged if not protected?

q_17620.question: What is the role of the PDCP sublayer in the LTE protocol stack?
q_17620.ground_truth: The main services and functions of the PDCP sublayer include header compression and decompression using ROHC, transfer of user data, ciphering of U-plane and C-plane data, and integrity protection of C-plane data (NAS signalling). The U-plane and C-plane PDCP entities are located in the UE and MME, respectively.

q_17621.question: What is the function of ResetResourceList within the ResetResource protocol?
q_17621.ground_truth: ResetResourceList is a container for ResetResourceItemIEs within the ResetResource protocol.

q_17622.question: What should the mobile station do when it has transmitted the last RLC data block with CV=0 before receiving the EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message with the Final Ack Indicator bit set to '1'?
q_17622.ground_truth: The mobile station should consider all transmitted RLC data blocks as acknowledged, release the uplink TBF, and act on the assigned resources.

q_17623.question: Which minimum UE categories support the combination described in 7.4.12?

q_17624.question: If the CCTrCH Initial DL Transmission Power IE is included for that CCTrCH, what can the Node B do for the initial CCTrCH DL power for each DCH type CCTrCH by the following rule?
q_17624.ground_truth: The Node B shall use that power for the initial CCTrCH DL power.

q_17625.question: How does the receiving side acknowledge correctly received RLC data blocks in acknowledged RLC mode using selective ARQ?
q_17625.ground_truth: The receiving side sends a Packet Ack/Nack message when needed, acknowledging all correctly received RLC data blocks up to an indicated block sequence number.

q_17626.question: What action should a VLR take if it receives a BSSAP+-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message?
q_17626.ground_truth: Upon receipt of this message, the VLR stops timer T6-2 and considers the new TMSI as valid.

q_17627.question: What is the target date for the completion of the AMR codec specifications?
q_17627.ground_truth: The target for the completion of the AMR codec specifications is Release 1998, i.e. end of 1998.

q_17628.question: What should the SGSN do when it receives a Session Stop Request message and sets the state attribute of its MBMS Bearer Context to 'Standby'?
q_17628.ground_truth: The SGSN releases the MBMS Bearer Context in case of a broadcast MBMS bearer service and responds with a Session Stop Response to indicate that the bearer plane resources can be released.

q_17629.question: What message does the MS send to the new SGSN during a combined RA/LA update when it is requesting the LA update or IMSI attach only for obtaining SMS and not any other services from CS domain?

q_17630.question: What is the process for handling supplementary service processes in the GLR?
q_17630.ground_truth: The co-ordinating process for functional supplementary service in the GLR starts with the GLR receiving a MAP-OPEN service indication, if successful, the GLR can handle supplementary service indications from the VLR.

q_17631.question: What is the definition of a UE in receive only mode as per the document?
q_17631.ground_truth: A UE in receive only mode is defined as a device capable only of receiving eMBMS broadcast on a pre-determined range of TMGIs and not capable of establishing unicast connectivity with the network, which does not require UICC or USIM.

q_17632.question: What is the main function of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's TE-UE multiplexer protocol?
q_17632.ground_truth: The main function of the TE-UE multiplexer protocol is to allow a number of simultaneous sessions over a normal serial asynchronous interface, permitting various kinds of data to be transferred, such as voice, fax, data, SMS, CBS, phonebook maintenance, battery status, GPRS, USSD, etc.

q_17633.question: What is a Neighbour Cell Relation (NCR) in E-UTRAN?
q_17633.ground_truth: A Neighbour Cell Relation (NCR) in E-UTRAN defines a list of frequencies and supporting information to be used for neighbor cell measurements. The NCR contains entries for E-UTRAN and supported Inter-Radio Access Technologies (IRATs).

q_17634.question: What is the procedure for starting the ciphering and deciphering processes on the DCCH and TCH?
q_17634.ground_truth: The ciphering and deciphering processes start on the MS side after the message "Start cipher" has been correctly received by the MS. Enciphering on the BSS side starts as soon as a frame or a message from the MS has been correctly deciphered at the BSS.

q_17635.question: What is recommended to be used as DL DSCP values in the ADC-Rule-Definition AVP if an application does not match any standardized DSCP value in IETF?
q_17635.ground_truth: DSCP values with no standardized meaning in IETF, specifically those in ranges reserved by IANA for "experimental or Local Use", are recommended to be used as DL DSCP values in the ADC-Rule-Definition AVP for applications that do not match any standardized DSCP value in IETF.

q_17636.question: What MIME type should be included in the Accept header field of the g.3gpp.current-location-discovery info package?
q_17636.ground_truth: The MIME type that should be included in the Accept header field of the g.3gpp.current-location-discovery info package is "application/vnd.3gpp.current-location-discovery+xml".

q_17637.question: What should a mobile station do upon reception of a pre-notification for an MBMS session on CCCH?
q_17637.ground_truth: Upon reception of a pre-notification, the mobile station shall enter non-DRX mode, start timer T3220, and proceed with the notified session upon expiry of timer T3220.

q_17638.question: What is the role of Common Services in ensuring security in a telecom network?
q_17638.ground_truth: Common Services provide the security infrastructure components such as a directory for storing user information and a PKI for handling certificates.

q_17639.question: What should the H-GMLC do when it sends the LCS Service Response to the R-GMLC?
q_17639.ground_truth: The H-GMLC should include the LDR reference number assigned by the H-GMLC when it returns the LCS Service Response to the R-GMLC. The R-GMLC should then include the LDR reference number in the LCS Service Response when it is sent to the LCS Client.

q_17640.question: What does the eP-CSCF overwrite the To header field and From header field values received in the SIP REGISTER request from the WIC with?
q_17640.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF overwrites the To header field and From header field values received in the SIP REGISTER request from the WIC with the private user identity and public user identity.

q_17641.question: Which solutions provide a way for disaster no longer applicable notification to UE's in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over 3GPP access?

q_17642.question: Which codec was used as a reference for background noise conditions assessment, and what was the perceived degradation of the EFR codec when compared to this reference?
q_17642.ground_truth: The G.728 codec was used as a reference for background noise conditions assessment, and the degradation introduced by the EFR codec compared to the DIRECT connection in background noise conditions was rated between "unnoticeable" and "noticeable but not annoying".

q_17643.question: What should the I-MGCF do if it supports a PSTN XML body as a network option and has received an ANM or CON message containing an ATP with the Bearer Capability set to "unrestricted digital information with tones/announcement" and without the TMU parameter?
q_17643.ground_truth: The 200 OK message sent by the I-MGCF should contain the PSTN XML Bearer Capability "unrestricted digital information with tones/announcement".

q_17644.question: What is the purpose of the Credits field in the FACH FLOW CONTROL in the 3GPP TS 25.321 specification indicating the number of MAC-c/sh SDUs that a user may transmit?
q_17644.ground_truth: The Credits field indicates the number of MAC-c/sh SDUs that a user may transmit, with 0 being "stop transmission" and 255 being "unlimited."

q_17645.question: What kind of functions are used in the signal adaptation module?
q_17645.ground_truth: The functions used in the signal adaptation module are initialization routines, main signal processing functions, and functions used for the conversion between CTM and Baudot code.

q_17646.question: What is Follow Focus used for in a camera setup?
q_17646.ground_truth: Follow Focus is used to help the operator be more precise while adjusting the focus and maintaining it while the camera is moving relative to the subject/object.

q_17647.question: What is the role of SFN-SFN observed time difference in HNBs' synchronization with the macro station?
q_17647.ground_truth: SFN-SFN observed time difference is used to detect the time difference of the reception times of frames from two cells, serving and target cells. In HNBs, it is used to amend low stability problem to enable working frequency and timing accuracy and to align with the macro station's timing.

q_17648.question: What is the role of the DRNC in the second step of the HS-DSCH mobility procedure?
q_17648.ground_truth: The DRNC allocates radio resources for the new radio link and requests the target Node B to establish a new radio link.

q_17649.question: What is the purpose of the Broadcast control channel (BCCH) in a radio sub-system?
q_17649.ground_truth: The BCCH broadcasts general information on a base transceiver station per base transceiver station basis, such as the organization of the common control channels, the number of blocks on each common control channel reserved for access grant messages, and whether or not packet switched traffic is supported.

q_17650.question: What happens if the Priority Level value of a new or modified QoS Rule is higher than the derived Priority Level value of an existing QoS Rule in the PCEF?
q_17650.ground_truth: The PCRF will remove the QoS Rule with the highest Priority Level from the PCEF and retry the QoS rule provisioning or modification procedure for the QoS rule that failed.

q_17651.question: What is the charging architecture specified for ProSe in TS~32.277?
q_17651.ground_truth: The charging architecture specified for ProSe in TS~32.277 is based on EPS system and supports charging for ProSe Direct Discovery, one-to-many Direct Communication, and one-to-one Direct Communication including UE-to-Network Relay (for public safety use). Offline charging is supported for ProSe Direct Communication through the PC3ch control protocol and the Accounting Data Forwarding (ADF) function block.

q_17652.question: In case the higher layer parameter maxNrofCodeWordsScheduledByDCI indicates that two codeword transmission is enabled, when is a transport block disabled by DCI format 1_1?
q_17652.ground_truth: A transport block is disabled by DCI format 1_1 if IMCS = 26 and if rvid = 1 for the corresponding transport block.

q_17653.question: What should the 2G+3G-SGSN do after validating the MS's presence in the new RA?
q_17653.ground_truth: The 2G+3G-SGSN updates MM and PDP contexts for the MS, initiates the establishment procedure, and returns a Routeing Area Update Accept message to the MS with a new P-TMSI and acknowledgements for successfully transferred N-PDUs.

q_17654.question: How does the AF in the MNO domain correlate the external Application Id provided by the UE and the internal Application Id provided by the NWDAF in the NF profile?
q_17654.ground_truth: The AF in the MNO domain correlates the external Application Id provided by the UE and the internal Application Id provided by the NWDAF using the internal Application Id (or any relevant Event ID) that is stored along with the external Application Id in the NRF.

q_17655.question: Why is there a need for a modification of the header format in the context of block transmission using different modulation sequences?
q_17655.ground_truth: The header format needs to be modified in order to manage the signalling of a block using different modulation sequences, as it is possible that the header of the first version of the BSN transmission is not decoded correctly. If the header is not decoded correctly, the block can be moved to a different MCS in the family as no redundancy information is yet stored at the receiver. Alternatively, the transmitter can change modulation in the middle of a block, and allow the IR combining mechanism to reduce the code rate.

q_17656.question: What is the purpose of the Direct Tunnel feature in the 3GPP system?
q_17656.ground_truth: The Direct Tunnel feature is an optional feature in Iu mode that allows the SGSN to establish a direct user plane tunnel between RAN and GGSN within the PS domain, offloading control plane signalling to the SGSN.

q_17657.question: What is the main goal of GPRS in terms of network resource usage?
q_17657.ground_truth: GPRS enables cost-effective and efficient use of network resources for packet mode data applications with characteristics such as intermittent, non-periodic (bursty) data transmissions, frequent transmissions of small volumes of data, or infrequent transmissions of larger volumes of data.

q_17658.question: What action must the ME take if the higher priority protection scheme is not supported?
q_17658.ground_truth: The ME should use the lower priority protection scheme to calculate the SUCI if the higher priority protection scheme is not supported by the ME.

q_17659.question: What happens to the input data buffer reading position when a "slice offset index" of two is used?
q_17659.ground_truth: The input data buffer reading position is incremented by two, causing it to move forward in the buffer by two positions.

q_17660.question: What must the UE check to determine if PLMN A without Disaster Condition can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers from PLMN D with Disaster Condition?
q_17660.ground_truth: The UE must check if it receives a PWS message with a particular Message Identifier and the "disaster roaming PLMN list" containing PLMN D via PLMN A's NG-RAN cell.

q_17661.question: When does the mobile station start the countdown procedure for an uplink TBF in non-extended mode?
q_17661.ground_truth: The mobile station starts the countdown procedure for an uplink TBF in non-extended mode when the RLC data blocks include CV values different from '15'.

q_17662.question: When can a non-dispatcher group call member request access to the uplink?
q_17662.ground_truth: Any non-dispatcher group call member can request access to the uplink when the uplink is not in use.

q_17663.question: What is the format of the E-DCH Resource Information for the first frequency repetition in 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_17663.ground_truth: The E-DCH Resource Information for the first frequency repetition in 1.28Mcps TDD is defined in the id-PLCCH-InformationList-ResourceStatusInd field.

q_17664.question: What is the problem that occurs when the allocated Hopping Frequency Set (HFS) for two TRXs is not modified, resulting in a large difference in ARFCN for the two carriers?
q_17664.ground_truth: This problem can result in reduction of total system capacity or the requirement for the MS (Mobile Station) to support a carrier separation equal to the total bandwidth of the BCCH and TCH group.

q_17665.question: When does the Local PSA send the event notification for QoS monitoring?
q_17665.ground_truth: The Local PSA sends the event notification to the notification endpoint of the Local NEF carrying UL, DL or round trip packet delay measurement report when the reporting trigger(s) is satisfied, such as when the measured packet delay value exceeds the reporting threshold, the reporting period expires, or the PDU Session is released.

q_17666.question: What is the alpha identifier and text attribute in the second CLOSE CHANNEL command in the second sequence?
q_17666.ground_truth: Alpha Identifier: "Close ID 1", Text Attribute: Center Alignment, Normal Font, Bold Off, Italic Off, Underline Off, Strikethrough Off, Colour: Dark Green Foreground, Bright Yellow Background

q_17667.question: What information is included in the Relocation Request Acknowledge message for each RAB to be set up?
q_17667.ground_truth: A Transport Layer Address, which is the target RNC Address for user data, and a Iu Transport Association which corresponds to the downlink Tunnel Endpoint Identifier for user data

q_17668.question: What is the purpose of reducing the ArringFactor in the access barring condition evaluation?
q_17668.ground_truth: The purpose is to manage the access to the network during disaster situations, ensuring a more even distribution of users between available PLMNs without disaster condition.

q_17669.question: Which node in the FLUS MO contains vendor-specific information?
q_17669.ground_truth: The node "/<X>/Sink/<X>/Ext" and "/<X>/Ext" contain vendor-specific information.

q_17670.question: What is the main focus of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group in the "Identity management and 3GPP security interworking" report?
q_17670.ground_truth: The main focus is to extend the current identity management as outlined in TS 33.220, TS 33.222, TS 29.109 and TR 33.980 with the latest developments on identity management outside of the 3GPP sphere.

q_17671.question: What action does the SMF take when creating a SM policy association for the UE?
q_17671.ground_truth: The SMF sends the N1 info (QoS rules) to UE and N2 info (QoS profiles) to RAN to complete the MA PDU Session Establishment.

q_17672.question: What is the accuracy requirement for rise and fall time of the signals generated by the signal generation device?
q_17672.ground_truth: The rise and fall time of the signals generated by the signal generation device shall be controlled to an accuracy of 1% or 5ns, whichever is worse.

q_17673.question: What does the SPR provide in terms of sponsored data connectivity profile information?
q_17673.ground_truth: The SPR provides a list of Application Service Providers and their applications per sponsor identity.

q_17674.question: What are the two types of discovery procedures in the proximity based services in the 5G system?
q_17674.ground_truth: The two types of discovery procedures are Open Discovery and Restricted Discovery.

q_17675.question: When should the MAC entity select the Random Access Preambles group B?
q_17675.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select the Random Access Preambles group B if the potential Msg3 size is greater than ra-Msg3SizeGroupA and the pathloss is less than PCMAX when the Random Access procedure was initiated for the CCCH logical channel and the CCCH SDU size plus MAC subheader is greater than ra-Msg3SizeGroupA.

q_17676.question: What is the purpose of the TFI fields in the DL DATA FRAME?
q_17676.ground_truth: The TFI fields in the DL DATA FRAME indicate the local number of the transport format used for the transmission time interval for each DCH multiplexed in the same transport bearer.

q_17677.question: What should the VLR do when it receives a BSSAP+-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message?
q_17677.ground_truth: The VLR should send a BSSAP+-IMSI-DETACH-ACK message to the SGSN and mark the association as 'IMSI detached for non-GPRS services' or 'IMSI detached for GPRS and non-GPRS services' as appropriate. The VLR should also move the state of the association for the MS to Gs-NULL.

q_17678.question: What information element contains an International E.164 number representation of the SCC-AS-PSI-DN in an I1 message?

q_17679.question: What is the role of the Remote ID USS after receiving the CAA Level UAV Id from the UAV UE?
q_17679.ground_truth: The Remote ID USS sends a notification event to the USS with the CAA Level UAV Id, GPSI, and current location information of the UAV UE, and may authenticate the UAV UE.

q_17680.question: What should the RNC include in the Area Identity IE of the LOCATION REPORT message in case of direct report for Service Area?
q_17680.ground_truth: If the LOCATION REPORT message is sent as an answer to a request for a direct report of Service Area and the current Service Area cannot be determined by the RNC, the RNC shall include the Last Known Service Area IE instead of the Area Identity IE, and a cause value to indicate that the request could not be fulfilled.

q_17681.question: Which core network components are impacted by CSI in the radio access network?
q_17681.ground_truth: For CSI to function, the radio access network requires DTM support for GERAN access and multiRAB support for UTRAN access. However, the PS Core and the CS Core Network remain unchanged.

q_17682.question: What is the purpose of the Requests Responded information element in a Data Record Transfer Response?
q_17682.ground_truth: The Requests Responded information element identifies the Data Record Transfer Requests that are being responded to by a Data Record Transfer Response.

q_17683.question: What is the Iu Framing Initialisation Procedure used for in Iu Framing in Support Mode?
q_17683.ground_truth: The Iu Framing Initialisation Procedure is used to initialize the Iu Framing Protocol on the Iu Interface (Iu-RAN) or the Nb Interface (Iu-CN), and it can be specified as Incoming or Outgoing to indicate the originating or terminating RNC interface.

q_17684.question: What should the MS do if it fails to complete the periodic RA update procedure after a retry scheme while in GERAN/UTRAN PS coverage?
q_17684.ground_truth: The MS shall wait a back-off time equal to the periodic LA update timer broadcast by the network before restarting the periodic RA update procedure.

q_17685.question: What must the UE do if the emergency services fallback is available and the lower layers indicate that the emergency services fallback attempt failed?
q_17685.ground_truth: The UE may behave as if the emergency services fallback is not available.

q_17686.question: What type of traffic is the "Number of simultaneous online watchers (Mean)" measurement valid for?

q_17687.question: What is a called party alert event, and how should the IPLMN/VPLMN respond when it occurs?
q_17687.ground_truth: A called party alert event is a procedure used to manage an outgoing call setup when the called party is alerted. When the IPLMN/VPLMN detects this event, it should suspend call processing and notify the CSE, or notify the CSE and continue call processing.

q_17688.question: What is the purpose of an Edge Enabler Client sending an Edge Application Server discovery request to the Edge Enabler Server?
q_17688.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Client sends a discovery request to the Edge Enabler Server to retrieve information about a particular Edge Application Server or a category of Edge Application Servers, along with query filters for access permissions, features, and location availability.

q_17689.question: In the context of UL DPCCH2 handling, what should the DRNS do if the serving HS-DSCH RL is in the DRNS and the UL DPCCH2 Information IE includes the Extended E-DPCCH Power Offset IE and if the E-DCH FDD Information IE is present in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
q_17689.ground_truth: The DRNS shall use the value to calculate the E-DPCCH gain factor.

q_17690.question: What is the range of values that can be assigned to the protocolIEs in the CommonMeasurementReport-IEs sequence, as defined by the NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES standard?
q_17690.ground_truth: The range of values that can be assigned to the protocolIEs in the CommonMeasurementReport-IEs sequence is defined by the NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES standard, and includes the values "Cell", "RACH", "CPCH", "S-Measurement", "ERAB", "E-RACH", "BM-SFR", and "CG-RPT".

q_17691.question: What is the purpose of up-sampling the lower band synthesis signal from 12.8 kHz to 16 kHz in the high frequency band?
q_17691.ground_truth: The purpose of up-sampling the lower band synthesis signal from 12.8 kHz to 16 kHz in the high frequency band is to compensate for the down-sampling that occurred in the pre-processing stage.

q_17692.question: What events can lead to a network-initiated GPRS detach in the context of CAMEL?
q_17692.ground_truth: The network can initiate a GPRS detach if the network has not received a periodic routeing area update from the MS, indicating that the MS is unreachable.

q_17693.question: Which CHOICE value in BasicGapCriteria indicates a called address value?

q_17694.question: What is the mapping of a burst for EC-CCCH/D/M and EC-PICH in the document?
q_17694.ground_truth: The mapping of a burst is given by the rule e(B,j) = pc(j) for j = 0,1,...,115 and B=0,1 for EC-CCCH/D/M and EC-PICH in the document.

q_17695.question: Which data type is used for the "LAC" element in the "InterRATCell" complex type?

q_17696.question: What happens in steps 6-7 of the process?
q_17696.ground_truth: In steps 6-7, the ProSe Function sends a Debit Units Request to the OCS indicating that granted units have been used. If authorization for the Announce command is unsuccessful, granted units are returned.

q_17697.question: What is the initial request in the described flow and who is it sent from?
q_17697.ground_truth: The initial request is an INVITE request sent from IBCF-hA2 to I-CSCF-hA1.

q_17698.question: What is the principle used for the Edge application to invoke the service API for RAN QoS Information in solution #43?
q_17698.ground_truth: The principle used for the Edge application to invoke the service API for RAN QoS Information is that the UE and Edge application have established a session, and this triggers the Edge application to invoke the service API for RAN QoS Information.

q_17699.question: What performance change of the SACCH signalling channel is necessary to provide additional fringe coverage and greater depth on in-building coverage using a 'Robust' codec?
q_17699.ground_truth: An additional 2-3 dB of C/I margin is necessary for operators to improve the SACCH signalling channel performance using a 'Robust' codec.

q_17700.question: What profile is used to generate the H.266/VVC bitstreams in the provided scenario?
q_17700.ground_truth: The Main 10 Profile is used to generate the H.266/VVC bitstreams in the provided scenario.

q_17701.question: What is the purpose of the DTXd parameter in the uplink TRAU speech frame in the downlink direction?
q_17701.ground_truth: The DTXd parameter in the uplink TRAU speech frame in the downlink direction is used to inform the DTX handler in the remote transcoder whether downlink DTX shall be applied or not.

q_17702.question: What is the number of paging indicators per radio frame if the paging indicator length is 8 symbols?
q_17702.ground_truth: The number of paging indicators per radio frame is given by the paging indicator length, which is 32 in this case.

q_17703.question: What is the modulation scheme that the IWF V.34 modem is required to initiate for ITU-T Recommendation V.8 handshaking?
q_17703.ground_truth: The IWF V.34 modem must initiate the ITU-T Recommendation V.34 modulation scheme for the V.8 handshaking.

q_17704.question: What is one of the suggested GSM/GPRS solutions for distributing the public key to the UE?
q_17704.ground_truth: One solution is to re-use the current GSM/GPRS security mechanism with initiating ciphering using a UE-controlled timer.

q_17705.question: What is the role of the 5G DDNMF in the ProSe Direct Discovery procedure?
q_17705.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF supports charging for Direct Discovery, transfers charging data for Direct Discovery to CHF, and reports chargeable events to the CHF.

q_17706.question: What is the purpose of Service Information in a 3GPP network?
q_17706.ground_truth: Service Information is optional transparent information that is not processed by the HSS or the S-CSCF. It may be included in the body of a SIP request sent from the S-CSCF to the AS if available in the initial filter criteria.

q_17707.question: What are the security threats associated with open platforms in relation to GAA in 3GPP TS 33.234?
q_17707.ground_truth: The security threats include a malicious application accessing the UICC directly to function as a GAA server, accessing the GAA server private data, or accessing the GAA server API to obtain NAF specific GAA credentials. These can result in a loss of private data.

q_17708.question: What is the reference sensitivity power level REFSENS as defined in clause 7.2 of the document?
q_17708.ground_truth: The reference sensitivity power level REFSENS is the minimum mean power applied to both the backhaul antenna ports at which the throughput shall meet or exceed the requirements for the specified reference measurement channel.

q_17709.question: What is CSG Cells Reporting used for in 3GPP TS 23.060?
q_17709.ground_truth: CSG Cells Reporting refers to the ability of the mobile station to report measurements, CSG-ID and routing parameters of CSG cells in dedicated mode and dual transfer mode.

q_17710.question: What is the difference between integer lags and fractional lags in the AMR codec?
q_17710.ground_truth: Integer lags are a set of lag values having whole sample resolution, while fractional lags are a set of lag values having sub-sample resolution. In the AMR codec, a sub-sample resolution of 1/6th or 1/3rd of a sample is used for fractional lags.

q_17711.question: What error is returned by the gsmSSF to the gsmSCF when the connection establishment fails?

q_17712.question: When should the UE reselect a new cell based on a range of R values of cells?
q_17712.ground_truth: A UE should reselect a new cell based on a range of R values of cells if the R value of the highest ranked cell is within rangeToBestCell of the R value of the highest ranked cell among the cells meeting the cell reselection criteria.

q_17713.question: What algorithm is used to compute the 32-bit MAC in GIA5?

q_17714.question: What is the requirement for a UE to meet the measurement accuracy for RXLEV stated in TS 45.008, as per 8.4a.2.5.1?
q_17714.ground_truth: The UE must take at least 3 GSM carrier RSSI samples per GSM carrier in the monitored set during the measurement period.

q_17715.question: What is the role of the bit separation and collection function in the rate-matching process for uncoded TrCHs, convolutionally encoded TrCHs, and turbo encoded TrCHs with repetition?
q_17715.ground_truth: The bit separation and bit collection functions are transparent for uncoded TrCHs, convolutionally encoded TrCHs, and turbo encoded TrCHs with repetition in the rate-matching process.

q_17716.question: What should the Core Network Operator PLMN ID be communicated in when the SGSN and GGSN pertain to the same PLMN and support UEs?
q_17716.ground_truth: The Core Network Operator PLMN ID should be communicated in RAI.

q_17717.question: What information should be contained in the analytics report describing the RAN user plane congestion problem?
q_17717.ground_truth: The analytics report describing the RAN user plane congestion problem should contain information such as the type of congestion, start and end time, geographical area, root cause, affected objects, severity level, and recommended actions to solve the problem.

q_17718.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with 5GSM cause #26 "insufficient resources" and a non-zero Back-off timer value, and a DNN was provided during the PDU session establishment?
q_17718.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3396 associated with the corresponding DNN, if it is running, and not send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same DNN until timer T3396 expires or is stopped.

q_17719.question: How are the number of per-band peak candidates determined in the described classification system?
q_17719.ground_truth: The number of per-band peak candidates is determined by comparing the absolute values of transform coefficients to a threshold, and extracting those that exceed it.

q_17720.question: What is the definition of "W1" in the context of the document?
q_17720.ground_truth: W1 is the interface between an ng-eNB-CU and an ng-eNB-DU, providing an interconnection point between the ng-eNB-CU and the ng-eNB-DU.

q_17721.question: What action does the UE take when the entering condition for event A4 is satisfied?
q_17721.ground_truth: When the entering condition for event A4 is satisfied, the UE sends the MeasurementReport message at regular intervals while the condition is still met.

q_17722.question: What information is indicated by a Length Indicator value of 118 in the RLC data block for a mobile station supporting MS assisted Dedicated Core Network selection?
q_17722.ground_truth: The presence of a DCN-ID value in the two octets immediately following this Length Indicator.

q_17723.question: What is the role of the attenuator and phase shifter in the calibration process of the RF signals?
q_17723.ground_truth: The attenuator and phase shifter are adjusted so that the RF signals received by the slotted cylindrical antenna at the center have the same values in amplitude and phase, which is a crucial step in the calibration process.

q_17724.question: Which new radio based services can inter-work with an AIPN and potentially create revenue for an AIPN operator?
q_17724.ground_truth: Personal Networks, RFIDs, and multi-hop access networks.

q_17725.question: What information does the "CS to PS SRVCC Allowed" indicator represent and where is it stored?
q_17725.ground_truth: The CS to PS SRVCC Allowed indicator represents whether the user is allowed to have CS to PS Single Radio Voice Call Continuity or not, and it is stored in the HSS and VLR.

q_17726.question: Which organization created the CAP-errortypes module?

q_17727.question: What should the BSS do if any type of BSSGP PDU is received with a syntactical error in a mandatory IE?
q_17727.ground_truth: The BSS should discard the PDU and send a STATUS PDU (cause "Invalid mandatory information") to the source of the PDU.

q_17728.question: What is the procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery Model A?
q_17728.ground_truth: The procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery Model A involves UE-1 performing the Group Member Discovery procedure and discovering UE-R as its only neighbour. UE-R then performs the Group Member Discovery procedure and discovers both UE-1 and UE-2. UE-R decides that it can act as a UE-to-UE Relay and announces this by periodically transmitting an Announcement message. UE-1 then establishes a one-to-one communication link with UE-R and engages in communication with UE-2 via UE-R.

q_17729.question: When UE test loop mode B is used in Standalone NR, what entity's SDUs does the UE loop back?
q_17729.ground_truth: The UE loops back SDAP SDUs for bi-directional QoS Flows when UE test loop mode B is used in Standalone NR.

q_17730.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of received MAC-e PDUs including acknowledged and unacknowledged PDUs during the period of measurement, detected in MAC-e layer in the serving E-DCH cell?

q_17731.question: What should the PCEF do when the UE requests the default NBIFOM access?
q_17731.ground_truth: The PCEF shall indicate the default NBIFOM access selected by the UE by including the type of default access within the Default-Access AVP in the same CCR command.

q_17732.question: In the case where the initial registration request cannot be accepted by the network and the AMF sends a REGISTRATION REJECT message to the UE, what action should the UE take when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with cause #3 (Illegal UE) or #6 (Illegal ME)?
q_17732.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, reset the registration attempt counter, and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.

q_17733.question: What is the subject of 3GPP Technical Specification TS 28.653 for Release 17?
q_17733.ground_truth: The present document specifies the Solution Sets for the UTRAN NRM IRP.

q_17734.question: What is the role of the MME when interworking with 3GPP CS?
q_17734.ground_truth: When the MME supports the interworking to 3GPP CS, it supports the following functions: performing the PS bearer splitting function, handling the non-voice PS bearers handover, initiating the SRVCC handover procedure, coordinating PS handover and SRVCC handover procedures, and supporting interworking and SRVCC related functions for 1xRTT CDMA access.

q_17735.question: What is the function of the comfort noise evaluation algorithm in GSM mobile communications?
q_17735.ground_truth: The comfort noise evaluation algorithm calculates the comfort noise parameters over a period of time to overcome the problem of background acoustic noise disappearing when the radio transmission is switched off.

q_17736.question: What is the general blocking requirement level for an MSR base station for both band categories?
q_17736.ground_truth: The same general blocking requirement level of +16~dBm is applicable for both band categories.

q_17737.question: What is the component that manages the MB session context for shared delivery and may manage the UE's PDU session context for individual delivery in the described architecture?

q_17738.question: What is the purpose of the Technical Specification Group (TSG) in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP)?
q_17738.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group (TSG) is responsible for producing and maintaining the set of specifications applicable to 3G-324M multimedia terminals in the 3GPP system.

q_17739.question: What is the purpose of the HNBAP ASN.1 definition in the HNBAP standard?
q_17739.ground_truth: The HNBAP ASN.1 definition specifies the structure and content of HNBAP messages, allowing for a standardized communication between network functions in 3GPP cellular networks.

q_17740.question: What is the consequence of a mismatch in the HLC/LLC information element during a call set-up request?
q_17740.ground_truth: The MS will reject the offered call using the cause No.88 "Incompatible Destination".

q_17741.question: What action should be taken if the UE is unable to report the requested measurement results due to missing GPS assistance data?
q_17741.ground_truth: A measurement report containing the IE "UE positioning error" should be sent to the network, with the IE set as specified in subclause 8.6.7.19.5. The UE should not send another measurement report for at least 20s, unless after releasing the current RRC connection.

q_17742.question: When is a new data block added to the "List of Application Specific Data" attribute of the PF-DC-CDR?
q_17742.ground_truth: A new data block can be added to the list for all open group PF-DC-CDRs, when the UE sends usage information report(s) to the ProSe Function.

q_17743.question: What is the purpose of the 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_17743.ground_truth: The 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification is an evolution of the 3.84 Mcps TDD option to a higher chip rate, providing significant enhancements in terms of user experience and capacity, with a focus on low-speed to medium-speed mobility scenarios.

q_17744.question: What is the recommended mechanism for bundling an interactivity application with other associated content?
q_17744.ground_truth: The recommended mechanism is to define a means for uniquely identifying the interactivity application among the bundled content items.

q_17745.question: What does the "RelayServiceCode" leaf indicate in the ProSe UE-to-network relay?
q_17745.ground_truth: The RelayServiceCode leaf indicates the connectivity service that the ProSe UE-to-network relay provides to public safety applications.

q_17746.question: What must a UE do when the 3GPP PS data off status is activated and the UE is being made to initiate a video call?
q_17746.ground_truth: If the 3GPP PS data off status is active, the UE does not send INVITE for video call.

q_17747.question: In the unacknowledged mode data and acknowledged mode data, what is the constraint on the length of RLC SDUs?
q_17747.ground_truth: The length of RLC SDUs is constrained to a multiple of 8 bits in unacknowledged mode data and acknowledged mode data.

q_17748.question: What is the purpose of the V(UR) variable in thesequence number of the next in-sequence UI~frame expected to be received?
q_17748.ground_truth: V(UR) can take on the value 0 through 511, and represents the expected sequence number of the next UI~frame that the receiver is waiting for in acknowledged operation.

q_17749.question: What should the HNB-GW include in the UE REGISTER ACCEPT message in case of CSG membership status update for a UE?
q_17749.ground_truth: The HNB-GW shall include the CSG Membership Status IE for the UE registering to the cell in the UE REGISTER ACCEPT message.

q_17750.question: What procedure is used for terminating a call in a network interface user plane over IP with immediate MGW selection?
q_17750.ground_truth: The procedures described in Clause 6.2.3 of 3GPP TS 23.205 are used in addition to the SIP-I based core network side procedures.

q_17751.question: What standard specifies the procedures for CS to PS handover within 3GPP access networks in the context of TS 23.216?
q_17751.ground_truth: TS 23.216 specifies the procedures for CS to PS handover within 3GPP access networks in the context of TS 23.216.

q_17752.question: What information does the AMF determine to check the satellite backhaul for UE?
q_17752.ground_truth: The AMF determines whether the UE is accessing the network via satellite backhaul and the satellite category (GEO, MEO, LEO) if yes.

q_17753.question: What is the purpose of the "user-level blacklist" in the user profile?
q_17753.ground_truth: The user-level blacklist in the user profile enables the user to create and manipulate a list of users, identified by their addresses, from whom they do not want to receive messages.

q_17754.question: What is the role of the Signature Re-Transmission Counter in the random access procedure?
q_17754.ground_truth: The Signature Re-Transmission Counter determines the maximum number of times a signature can be retransmitted before reporting a random access failure to the MAC sub-layer.

q_17755.question: What is the agreed power class for capability signaling for all releases in RAN4?
q_17755.ground_truth: RAN4 agreed that the capability signaling applies for all power classes for both Rel-15 and Rel-16, in a release-independent manner.

q_17756.question: Where does the Session node appear in the hierarchical structure of session level QoE metrics definitions?
q_17756.ground_truth: The Session node is the starting point of the session level QoE metrics definitions.

q_17757.question: What does the AMR-WB codec use as an interface format, referred to as AMR-WB IF1?
q_17757.ground_truth: The AMR-WB IF1 is a generic frame format for both the speech and comfort noise frames of the AMR-WB speech codec.

q_17758.question: What are the minimum requirements for the reported CQI value to be in the range of +/-2 of the reported median for UE HS-DSCH categories 1-20 under AWGN environments?
q_17758.ground_truth: The reported CQI value should be in the range of +/-2 of the reported median more than 90% of the time. If the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by median CQI is less than or equal to 0.1, the BLER using the transport format indicated by the (median CQI +2) shall be greater than 0.1. If the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI is greater than 0.1, the BLER using transport format indicated by (median CQI -1) shall be less than or equal to 0.1.

q_17759.question: What would be the source of the one-to-one communication security policy for the A-DDNMF and M-DDNMF in the discovery procedures?
q_17759.ground_truth: The security policy is obtained by the A-DDNMF and M-DDNMF from PCF or other selected methods during the normative phase.

q_17760.question: What is the impact of multi-homing based PSA addition to the PDU Session for IMS on the UE?
q_17760.ground_truth: Multi-homing based PSA addition to the PDU Session for IMS has an impact on the UE as it requires the addition of an additional PDU Session Anchor and Branching Point or UL CL, which can affect the UE's behavior.

q_17761.question: What is the purpose of the Supplier/Partner Relationship Management (S/PRM) processes?
q_17761.ground_truth: The S/PRM processes support the core operational processes, both customer instance processes (Fulfilment, Assurance, and Billing) and functional operations processes. They align closely with a supplier's or partner's Customer Relationship Management processes and manage issues related to purchasing, billing verification, quality management, and more.

q_17762.question: What type of bearer service is used for the channel that is opened between the ME and UICC?
