q_17762.ground_truth: The bearer service used is GPRS (General Packet Radio Service), a type of mobile data communication service.

q_17763.question: What are the essential components for providing communication services in a 5G network?
q_17763.ground_truth: The group of NG-RAN and 5GC nodes are essential for providing communication services in a 5G network.

q_17764.question: What is the potential issue with implementing Option B2a with a single duplexer using current filter technology?
q_17764.ground_truth: The potential issue with implementing Option B2a with a single duplexer is the small duplex gap, which makes it challenging to protect the upper part of the RX band from the own TX. This issue still exists even if the band is split into n71 and the additional frequency range as Option B2a.

q_17765.question: What does the Network Service Control (NS) PDU type NS-ALIVE indicate in the context of GSM Technical Specification?
q_17765.ground_truth: The NS-ALIVE PDU type is used to test a Network Service Connection VC (NS-VC).

q_17766.question: In FR1, DL+UL evaluation, DU, VR30, what is the mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced PDCCH monitoring adaptation with jitter handling scheme with marginal loss in DL+UL UE satisfied rate?
q_17766.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced PDCCH monitoring adaptation with jitter handling scheme in FR1, DL+UL evaluation, DU, VR30 is 40.64%.

q_17767.question: What is the function of the Mapping Resource Duration Indicator in the E-AGCH, and what is its size in bits?
q_17767.ground_truth: The Mapping Resource Duration Indicator in the E-AGCH indicates the duration of resource allocation. It is represented by 3 bits, if present.

q_17768.question: What is the bearer for the second set of network and bearer interfaces?

q_17769.question: How does a time-to-trigger parameter limit the measurement signalling load in a UTRAN system?
q_17769.ground_truth: The time-to-trigger parameter delays the report triggering until a specified time, only reporting the event if it has existed for the designated duration.

q_17770.question: What is the main function of the CRC attachment step in the coding/multiplexing process in Flexible Layer One?
q_17770.ground_truth: The main function of the CRC attachment step is to provide error detection on transport blocks through a Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC).

q_17771.question: Which scenario requires testing both at the repeater passband edges and inside the sub-block gaps?
q_17771.ground_truth: For non-contiguous spectrum operation, some requirements apply both at the repeater passband edges and inside the sub-block gaps.

q_17772.question: Which mechanism is used to securely negotiate the algorithm and integrity algorithm used for securing data on the network access link?
q_17772.ground_truth: A security mode negotiation between the user and the network is used to securely negotiate the algorithms.

q_17773.question: What action does the PCRF take if the usage allowance for a certain IP-CAN session is exceeded?
q_17773.ground_truth: The PCRF deducts the value of the usage report from the totally allowed usage for that PDN and UE, minimizing the risk of exceeding the usage allowance.

q_17774.question: What were the three options identified to resolve the issue of supporting type B PUCCH repetitions with different PUCCH formats?
q_17774.ground_truth: Option 1: restrict type B PUCCH repetition applicable to actual repetitions with the same PUCCH format, Option 2: allow type B PUCCH repetition with different PUCCH formats, Option 3: introduce and specify PUCCH format 3/4 of length 1/2/3 OFDM symbols to support type B PUCCH repetition.

q_17775.question: What message does the UE send in the first step of the SIP based MBMS User Service Registration procedure?
q_17775.ground_truth: The UE sends a SIP INVITE message to the SCF via the IM CN subsystem.

q_17776.question: What are the key aspects of system performance that the evaluation and selection process in the 3GPP technical report aims to improve?
q_17776.ground_truth: The key aspects include improving bandwidth efficiency, reliability, decoding resource requirements, and addressing backward compatibility issues.

q_17777.question: What is the purpose of the "Horizontal with Vertical Velocity" IE?
q_17777.ground_truth: The "Horizontal with Vertical Velocity" IE contains information about the movement of a user in a wireless network, including both horizontal and vertical velocity.

q_17778.question: Which fields are included in the FCS calculation for UIH frames?
q_17778.ground_truth: The FCS is calculated for UIH frames over the address, control, and length fields only, not the information field.

q_17779.question: Who triggers the HTTP digest authentication procedure towards the UE in 10.2.2?
q_17779.ground_truth: The SSF (Service Switching Function) triggers the HTTP digest authentication procedure towards the UE in 10.2.2.

q_17780.question: What interfaces support the use of FQPCs and RPCs in EPC for the Ga interface?
q_17780.ground_truth: Both FQPCs and RPCs can be supported on the Ga interface in EPC, with the support of FQPCs being mandatory and RPCs being optional.

q_17781.question: What are the functions of the RLC entity?
q_17781.ground_truth: The RLC entity is responsible for the segmentation and reassembly of variable-length upper layer PDUs into/from smaller RLC PDUs, concatenation, padding, transfer of user data, error correction, in-sequence delivery of upper layer PDUs, duplicate detection, flow control, sequence number check, protocol error detection and recovery, ciphering, and SDU discard.

q_17782.question: What is the purpose of P.R.5.9-001 in the 3GPP system?
q_17782.ground_truth: The purpose of P.R.5.9-001 is to provide a method that minimizes the decline of service experience from UAV to UAV controller due to data network reasons.

q_17783.question: What are the disadvantages of using independently decodable tiles in tiled video delivery?
q_17783.ground_truth: The disadvantages of using independently decodable tiles in tiled video delivery are the need for multiple decoders or serializing the decoding process, which can introduce latency, and the limited bit rate savings.

q_17784.question: What are the target MOS scores for the bit rate calculation in the subjective tests?
q_17784.ground_truth: The target MOS scores for the bit rate calculation are 3.5, which is in between "Fair" and "Good".

q_17785.question: What is the role of the ARF in the L-DN DNS Server case when it provides an IP address?
q_17785.ground_truth: The ARF resolves the FQDN into an IP address, sends a DNS Reply to the UE, and triggers the 5G core network to insert a local UPF in the data path for routing traffic between the Application Client in the UE and the Application Server in the L-DN.

q_17786.question: What is the responsibility of the RAN if a location request is made on a non-speech circuit call?
q_17786.ground_truth: If a location request is made on a non-speech circuit call, it is up to the RAN to decide whether positioning is possible based on the applicable position methods and requested QoS.

q_17787.question: What should be the Call-Identifier field set to when the ICS UE sends an I1 Bye message to leave the conference?
q_17787.ground_truth: The Call-Identifier field should be set to a value that identifies the I1 session between the ICS UE and SCC AS that was used to create or join the conference.

q_17788.question: What is the purpose of including the Length of the Command Packet and the Length of the Command Header in the calculation of RC/CC/DS when using concatenated Short Messages?
q_17788.ground_truth: The purpose is to achieve a modulo 8 length of the data before the RC/CC/DS field in the Command Header.

q_17789.question: What sublayers make up the radio network layer in LTE, and what services and functions do they provide?
q_17789.ground_truth: The three sublayers of the radio network layer in LTE are the Physical (PH) layer, Medium Access Control (MAC) sublayer, and Radio Link Control (RLC) sublayer. The MAC sublayer is responsible for mapping between logical channels and transport channels, multiplexing/demultiplexing of RLC PDUs, traffic volume measurement reporting, error correction through HARQ, priority handling between logical channels and UEs, and transport format selection. The RLC sublayer provides data transfer services on logical channels and is responsible for segmentation, resegmentation, in-sequence delivery, duplicate detection, protocol error detection and recovery, and reset.

q_17790.question: Which system information block type contains ciphering information and real-time integrity information, and for which GNSS only?
q_17790.ground_truth: System Information Block type 15.8 contains ciphering information and real-time integrity information, and it is specific for GNSS.

q_17791.question: What is the maximum time allowed to read the EC-BCCH data when being synchronized to a BCCH carrier of an EC-GSM-IoT cell?
q_17791.ground_truth: The maximum time allowed to read the EC-BCCH data when being synchronized to a BCCH carrier of an EC-GSM-IoT cell is 12 seconds or equal to the scheduling period for the EC-BCCH data, whichever is greater.

q_17792.question: What is a potential issue when relying solely on visual or auditory recognition of participants in a multi-party conference?
q_17792.ground_truth: It cannot be assumed that a user is always capable of identifying who is speaking or is shown in the conference solely based on recognizing their voice or even by looking at them.

q_17793.question: What is the condition for the NAS to stop the search for PLMNs?
q_17793.ground_truth: The NAS can stop the search for PLMNs on request from the UE.

q_17794.question: What optional RTP-related features are available in comparison with current RIST specifications in media production workflows?
q_17794.ground_truth: Congestion Control (CC) through the use of RTCP-signalled feedback mechanisms, such as that described in RFC 8888 alongside congestion control algorithms like NADA, SCReAM, Google-CC or Shared Bottleneck Detection are available as optional RTP-related features in comparison with current RIST specifications in media production workflows.

q_17795.question: What happens when an unknown or unforeseen message type is received by the LMU?
q_17795.ground_truth: When the LMU receives a message type not defined for the protocol discriminator or not implemented by the receiver, it shall send a RELEASE COMPLETE message with cause value #97 "message type non-existent or not implemented". If the LMU receives a message type not consistent with the transaction state, a RELEASE COMPLETE message shall be sent with cause value #98 "message not compatible with control state".

q_17796.question: Which TSs are extended to add new data to support discovery of management services in 5G?
q_17796.ground_truth: TS 28.622 and TS 28.623 are extended to add new data to support discovery of management services in 5G.

q_17797.question: In the context of UE Transmitted Power, what is the action taken in Event 6b?
q_17797.ground_truth: In Event 6b, the UE Transmitted Power becomes less than an absolute threshold.

q_17798.question: What is the priority level range for services that are authorized to receive prioritized treatment within an operator domain?
q_17798.ground_truth: The priority level range for services that are authorized to receive prioritized treatment within an operator domain is from 1 to 8.

q_17799.question: What information does the IP-SM-GW receive in a SIP NOTIFY request?
q_17799.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP NOTIFY request, the IP-SM-GW stores the information about the UE registration status and its ability for receiving Instant Messages, i.e. if the public user identity has a contact registered with the ability to receive Instant Messages.

q_17800.question: What additional change was considered to further reduce the intermodulation interference and intermodulation interference signal power at the receiver input?
q_17800.ground_truth: The additional change was to replace the standard GSM filters with filters that offer a higher rejection in the TX frequency band.

q_17801.question: What parameters does the UE use to evaluate Srxlev and Squal of non-serving cells for reselection purposes?
q_17801.ground_truth: The UE shall use parameters provided by the serving cell when evaluating Srxlev and Squal of non-serving cells for reselection purposes.

q_17802.question: What is the proactive method provided by Solution #54 to prevent 5GSM congestion in a PLMN without Disaster Condition?
q_17802.ground_truth: Solution #54 provides a proactive method for preventing 5GSM congestion in a PLMN without Disaster Condition by enabling the PLMN to control the level of 5GSM signalling that can be generated by disaster inbound roamer UEs. This is achieved by indicatng a limit on the number of PDU sessions that a UE can request, which may be done when such congestion control mechanism is activated at the AMF.

q_17803.question: What is the node "ServicePrivacyList" used for in V2X communication over PC5 that requires privacy?
q_17803.ground_truth: The node "ServicePrivacyList" contains the V2X service identifiers of the V2X services which require privacy for V2X communication over PC5.

q_17804.question: What command is sent from the SIM to the ME in Expected Sequence 1.2 and 1.3?

q_17805.question: What is the purpose of the ENVELOPE (CELL BROADCAST DOWNLOAD) in Expected Sequence 1.4?
q_17805.ground_truth: The purpose of the ENVELOPE (CELL BROADCAST DOWNLOAD) in Expected Sequence 1.4 is to indicate that the Cell Broadcast (UMTS) message is not displayed on the ME.

q_17806.question: What is the minimum number of measurements used for filtering the PCCPCH RSCP of the serving cell in the 7.68 Mcps TDD option of the cell re-selection procedure?
q_17806.ground_truth: The UE shall filter the PCCPCH RSCP measurement of the serving cell using at least 2 measurements, which are taken so that the time difference between the measurements is at least TmeasureTDD/2.

q_17807.question: What is the impact on the TCH of the other MUROS subchannel due to DRSACCH or SSACCH+DRSACCH?
q_17807.ground_truth: The performance impact is negligible, with a worst-case TCH performance degradation of about 0.05 dB at a 1% FER of speech channels for both DRSACCH and SSACCH+DRSACCH.

q_17808.question: What information is requested by the NEF to store in the UDR for a multicast session?
q_17808.ground_truth: The NEF requests to store the multicast session ID, selected MB-SMF ID, and location area in the UDR for a multicast session.

q_17809.question: How can the UE overcome the issue of choosing the wrong PLMN network due to crossing country borders?
q_17809.ground_truth: The UE should limit its PLMN selection to only PLMNs of the country of the present UE location if it is aware of its current country.

q_17810.question: What is the structure of the DPCH in the test models, and how are the DPDCH and DPCCH power levels determined?
q_17810.ground_truth: The structure of the DPCH in the test models is adopted from TS 25.211-slot format 10 and 6. The DPDCH and DPCCH have the same power level.

q_17811.question: What is the goal of Solution #24?
q_17811.ground_truth: The goal of Solution #24 is to reduce the complexity of deploying 3GPP technology into already well-defined ecosystems, which includes provisioning schemes. The actual provisioning protocol is out of scope for this solution, and the provisioning is performed over an industry-defined protocol or framework. The solution enables mutual authentication between the UE and the Provisioning Server (PS) and allows for the final provisioning of the SO-SNPN credentials over this industry-defined protocol or framework.

q_17812.question: Which reference point is used for transferring information between the CSCF and HSS?
q_17812.ground_truth: The Cx reference point is used for transferring information between the CSCF and HSS.

q_17813.question: What is the application category that matches the priority of a railway emergency alert in the FRMCS System?

q_17814.question: If both "Pre-emption Capability" and "Pre-emption Vulnerability" bits are set to 1, what is the consequence for the connection?
q_17814.ground_truth: This connection is vulnerable and shall be included in the pre-emption process or procedure and as such may be subject to forced release or forced handover.

q_17815.question: What is a feature of the SIP Identity mechanism that distinguishes it from P-Asserted-Identity?
q_17815.ground_truth: A significant advantage of the SIP Identity mechanism is that it provides protection against manipulation of a malicious user in the originating network and protection against manipulation of intermediate transit networks.

q_17816.question: What should an LLE that is unable to enter the ABM state do when it receives a SABM command?
q_17816.ground_truth: The LLE shall respond to the SABM command with a DM response with the F bit set to the same binary value as the P bit in the received SABM command.

q_17817.question: What should the UE do if it has connection establishment failure or connection resume failure information available in VarConnEstFailReport and if the RPLMN is equal to plmn-Identity stored in VarConnEstFailReport?
q_17817.ground_truth: The UE should include connEstFailInfoAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message.

q_17818.question: Which uplink physical channel corresponds to a set of resource elements carrying information from higher layers?

q_17819.question: When can the R-FA start transmitting the training to the R-FAX?
q_17819.ground_truth: The R-FA can start transmitting the training to the R-FAX after changing the modem to V.17, V.27ter or V.29, if the R-FA receives facsimile coded data from the radio network within 3s of receiving MCF from the R-FAX.

q_17820.question: What does the AS do upon successful completion of the procedure in step 8?
q_17820.ground_truth: In step 8, the AS responds with a SOAP response, which contains the authenticated EPR, ID-WSF EPR (EndpointReference) parameter which refers to the SSOS instance and necessary credentials for the UE to invoke the SSOS.

q_17821.question: What disadvantage is there in using wideband interference estimation in controlling HeNB downlink interference towards macro eNB control channels?
q_17821.ground_truth: When wideband interference estimation is used, all the bits are affected and the probability of successfully decoding the message decreases.

q_17822.question: What is the set of security features that secure access to mobile stations?

q_17823.question: What is used to provide smooth switching between Representations in WebMedia's DASH-based streaming services?
q_17823.ground_truth: MPEG DASH functionalities, such as segment ".

q_17824.question: Which function provides a SAP for a particular service in the UE?
q_17824.ground_truth: Service specific function for Non Access Stratum messages

q_17825.question: In case System Information Block type 11ter is scheduled on BCH, which IE should the UE consider for Connected mode PLMN identities?
q_17825.ground_truth: The IE "Connected mode PLMN identities for SIB 11ter" should be considered by the UE for Connected mode PLMN identities in case System Information Block type 11ter is scheduled on BCH.

q_17826.question: What does ICS stand for in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_17826.ground_truth: ICS stands for "IP Multimedia (IM) Core Network (CN) subsystem centralized services".

q_17827.question: What mode does the LCH-id value in the MAC header identify MAC-d flows containing CCCH data in FDD and 1.28 Mcps TDD?
q_17827.ground_truth: The LCH-id value in the MAC header identifies MAC-d flows containing CCCH data in FDD and 1.28 Mcps TDD.

q_17828.question: After the CN receives the Handover Request message in the GERAN to GAN CS handover procedure, what message does it send next in the handover process?
q_17828.ground_truth: The CN sends the Handover Command message to the GANC to initiate the handover after receiving the Handover Request message.

q_17829.question: What is the purpose of clause 6.3.3?
q_17829.ground_truth: The purpose of clause 6.3.3 is to specify that information about groups homed in the IWF is stored and retrieved by the IWF, but the procedures to perform these actions are not defined in the present document.

q_17830.question: How do the CTM transmitter and receiver enable the Voice Carry Over/Hearing Carry Over feature in cellular phone systems?
q_17830.ground_truth: The CTM transmitter and receiver allow for voice and text to be transmitted alternately in the same speech channel. This is achieved by generating a zero-valued output signal in the uplink and downlink directions when there are no text characters to transmit, enabling the use of Voice Carry Over/Hearing Carry Over feature in cellular phone systems.

q_17831.question: What should the transmitting side of an AM RLC entity do after transmitting an RLC data PDU when there is no new RLC data PDU to transmit and the buffer is not empty?
q_17831.ground_truth: The transmitting side should include a poll in the RLC data PDU and start or restart t-PollRetransmit.

q_17832.question: Which protocol is used for User Plane traffic transport in PMIPv6 as per IETF RFC 2784 and RFC 2890?

q_17833.question: What is the algorithmic delay of the AMR-WB+ codec in mono operation for the typical internal sampling frequency of 25.6 kHz?

q_17834.question: What is the role of the CCO Monitor Function in capacity and coverage optimization?
q_17834.ground_truth: The CCO Monitor Function is used for monitoring capacity and coverage optimization, such as monitoring related performance counters, UE measurements, or alarms.

q_17835.question: What action does the P-GW take when the Failure Handling mechanism is executed, and the value is set to Continue, and the user is only online charged?

q_17836.question: What is the effect of the MBMS Bearer Context Superseded cause value in the MBMS Session Start Response message?
q_17836.ground_truth: If the SGSN receives the MBMS Session Start Response message with the MBMS Bearer Context Superseded cause value, it shall not request establishment of the bearer plane.

q_17837.question: What is the meaning of "Cells to be excluded in non-used frequency detected cells" in inter-frequency measurement?
q_17837.ground_truth: The IE "Cells to be excluded in non-used frequency detected cells" notifies the UE to exclude indicated cells from corresponding measurement report and UE shall exclude indicated cells from measurement report for inter-frequency detected set measurement.

q_17838.question: What information is duplicated and sent to DF3 for further delivery to the LEA in the S-GW and/or PDN-GW Intercept Product?
q_17838.ground_truth: Packet data is duplicated without modification and sent to DF3 for further delivery to the LEA, along with additional information in a header.

q_17839.question: What protocol is used for the Transport Network Layer of the Xw Signalling Bearer?
q_17839.ground_truth: The Transport Network Layer is based on IP transport, comprising SCTP on top of IP.

q_17840.question: What are the two factors that are used to evaluate the final system performance gain in the dynamic system level simulation?
q_17840.ground_truth: The two factors are the average cell uplink throughput and 5%-tile cell-edge uplink throughput.

q_17841.question: What happens if the mobile station receives a SETUP message with Signal IE indicating Call Waiting during a call clearing initiated by the network?
q_17841.ground_truth: The mobile station shall not request an additional traffic channel.

q_17842.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in creating the Technical Specification for the Radio Access Network?
q_17842.ground_truth: The 3GPP creates the Technical Specification for the Radio Access Network to standardize the requirements for individual equipment types and their interworking, including special GSM/EDGE conformance testing functions.

q_17843.question: What are the two types of requirements that should be satisfied when selecting an EDN based on grouped selection criteria?
q_17843.ground_truth: The two types of requirements that should be satisfied when selecting an EDN based on grouped selection criteria are the individual requirements and the requirements specified as part of a group.

q_17844.question: What is the purpose of the attribute "assuranceTargetList" in AssuranceGoal?
q_17844.ground_truth: The attribute "assuranceTargetList" defines a list of assurance targets, which represents a subset of attributes from an SLS that needs to be assured by the AssuranceClosedControlLoop.

q_17845.question: What additional information is sent from the PDN-GW to DF2 for interception with active PMIP tunnel?
q_17845.ground_truth: The following additional information is sent from the PDN-GW to DF2 for interception with active PMIP tunnel: events and associated parameters, target location or IAs in case of location dependent interception, date/time of Location if target location is provided, correlation number, QoS information if available, and encryption parameters if available and necessary.

q_17846.question: What happens when the UE initiates the Access Transfer of the first held session after transferring the active session from PS to CS when using the I1 reference point for service control of sessions that use CS media?
q_17846.ground_truth: The media path established upon transfer of the currently active session is reused for the held session when it is resumed.

q_17847.question: In 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery method, how many PDU sessions are required for each UE associated with a multicast session?
q_17847.ground_truth: One PDU session is required for each UE associated with a multicast session in 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery method.

q_17848.question: What are the high level requirements to enable speech and multimodal / multi-device services?
q_17848.ground_truth: Users of the Speech service shall be able to initiate voice communication, access information or conduct transactions by voice commands. The speech-enabled service will be offered by the network operators and shall be compatible with the IMS.

q_17849.question: What should the RNC do if the relocation or enhanced relocation becomes necessary during the RAB Assignment procedure?
q_17849.ground_truth: The RNC may interrupt the ongoing RAB Assignment procedure and initiate the Relocation Preparation or Enhanced Relocation procedure, depending on whether the RAB setup or modification was successful or not. The RNC should report the outcome of the procedure in one RAB ASSIGNMENT RESPONSE message.

q_17850.question: What is the definition of a Network Resource Model (NRM) in the context of 3GPP specifications?
q_17850.ground_truth: A Network Resource Model (NRM) is a model that enables additional functions on the sub-network level, typically in the areas of network topology presentation, alarm correlation, service impact analysis and circuit provisioning.

q_17851.question: How does the 5G system ensure local service without location-dependent content?
q_17851.ground_truth: If a UE tries to join a location dependent multicast session outside an area where location dependent content for the multicast session is provided, or the UE moves out of an area with location dependent content for the multicast session, the UE is removed from the multicast session.

q_17852.question: What is the function of Handover Control Procedures MSC-B?
q_17852.ground_truth: Handover Control Procedures MSC-B provides overall control of the handover procedure and interworking between the internal interfaces in MSC-B.

q_17853.question: What should the TRAU do when it detects a framing bit error in Data 14.5 kbit/s case?
q_17853.ground_truth: The TRAU uses the control bit UFE (uplink Frame Error) in the next downlink Extended Data TRAU Frame to indicate the error to the CCU.

q_17854.question: What does the MM.SuccInterSgsnRaUpdate.G measurement type define in packet switching within GSM?
q_17854.ground_truth: The number of successful inter-SGSN routing area update procedures in GSM networks.

q_17855.question: How does the UICC respond when it receives the SUSPEND UICC command?
q_17855.ground_truth: The UICC returns the "Maximum duration of the suspension negotiated by the UICC" and a SW 9000.

q_17856.question: What is the interim conclusion reached for the normative phase regarding limiting the area of service to inbound disaster roamings in Key Issue #4?
q_17856.ground_truth: The interim conclusion reached for the normative phase is that the AMF in the PLMN offering disaster roaming service determines a registration area for the UE by providing the mobility restriction list to the RAN with the service area information set to the area that corresponds with the area of the disaster condition.

q_17857.question: What does the UE stand for in the context of the solution in section 6.23.1?

q_17858.question: When does the UE clear the content included in VarConnEstReport except for the numberOfConnFail?
q_17858.ground_truth: The UE clears the content included in VarConnEstReport except for the numberOfConnFail when it has connection establishment information and RPLMN is not equal to plmn-Identity stored in VarConnEstReport, or when the cell identity of the current cell is not equal to the cell identity stored in measResultFailedCell in VarConnEstReport.

q_17859.question: What are the advantages of defining cells and Tracking Areas (TAs) independently from one another?
q_17859.ground_truth: Defining cells and TAs independently allows for simpler definition, reduces data storage and signaling, and enables cells to be constrained within fixed TAs. Additionally, this independence allows for cells to overlap with two or more TAs, which may not matter since global cell IDs do not contain a TAI and are used for paging and mobility instead of identifying a unique TA.

q_17860.question: What should the AUSF do if it receives an AMF service capability result set to '1' and no Reroute via RAN is determined?
q_17860.ground_truth: The AUSF provides the Anchor key, SUPI and authentication result to the initial AMF and the initial AMF can then setup NAS Security similar to the existing system.

q_17861.question: What is the purpose of the Packet Data Header Information reporting in 3G GGSN?
q_17861.ground_truth: Packet Data Header Information reporting is used to provide packet header reports on a per packet basis or in a summary report, derived from the packet headers of each packet sent or received by the target, providing source and destination information, as well as summary information for the number of packets and bytes transmitted or received by the target for each unique packet flow within a PDP context.

q_17862.question: What is the resolution used for the latitude and longitude offsets in UE location calculations?
q_17862.ground_truth: The resolution used for the latitude and longitude offsets is 90/2E23 for the latitude offset values and 360/2E24 for the longitude offset values.

q_17863.question: How does the fast Ack/Nack reporting mechanism impact uplink capacity and transfer delay?
q_17863.ground_truth: The mechanism provides a huge benefit in terms of reduced transfer delay, as it reduces the retransmission time of a single RLC block by one third. It also provides a consistent improvement in uplink capacity, which can increase from 66.6% to 80% in the worst case, and up to 95% to 97% if higher MCSs are used in the UL.

q_17864.question: In which order does the HSS check the identity type in step 4 of its process?
q_17864.ground_truth: The HSS checks the identity type in the following order: If the identity in the request is a distinct Public User Identity, the HSS continues with step 5. If not, it checks the server-assignment-type for specific possible values. If it is a Public Service Identity, the HSS checks the PSI Activation State for that identity to see if it is active.

q_17865.question: What is the structure of the SRNS-ContextRequest message in this protocol?
q_17865.ground_truth: The SRNS-ContextRequest message consists of protocolIEs and protocolExtensions, where protocolIEs is a Required ProtocolIE-Container containing SRNS-ContextRequestIEs, and protocolExtensions is an Optional ProtocolExtensionContainer containing SRNS-ContextRequestExtensions.

q_17866.question: How is the "DL scheduled IP throughput distribution" obtained in 4G E-UTRAN?
q_17866.ground_truth: The "DL scheduled IP throughput distribution" is obtained by counting the number of samples with DL UE IP throughput in different throughput ranges during one measurement period. The provided measurement samples are used to distinguish the scenarios when some UEs experience poor downlink throughput.

q_17867.question: What is the purpose of this test in 5.3.13.3 to verify that the ME performs the SUCI calculation procedure using the null-scheme?
q_17867.ground_truth: To ensure that the ME calculates the SUCI correctly when there is no Protection Scheme Identifier in the USIM.

q_17868.question: What message does the target Node B send to the target RNC when it detects uplink synchronization on the Uu?
q_17868.ground_truth: The target Node B sends a NBAP message Radio Link Restore Indication to the target RNC.

q_17869.question: What is the purpose of using a discovery root key in this solution?
q_17869.ground_truth: The discovery root key is used to secure over the air group member and relay discovery and communications and to derive other keys from it. It can be provisioned by the DDNMF or PKMF.

q_17870.question: What is the purpose of the "Symbols" section in the document?
q_17870.ground_truth: The "Symbols" section provides definitions of various acronyms and abbreviations used throughout the document.

q_17871.question: What is the meaning of the " CapabilityUpdateRequirement" field in the "UECapabilityEnquiry-r3-IEs" structure?
q_17871.ground_truth: It indicates whether the network supports UEs with the capability of handling only a single NB, two NBs, or more than two NBs in a single cell.

q_17872.question: What is the role of the SEAL NRM server and when is it utilized?
q_17872.ground_truth: The SEAL NRM server performs network resource adaptation when the UAE server sends a QoS adaptation request. It also notifies the QoS update to the UAE server.

q_17873.question: What command is indicated by the Command-Code field set to 8388673 and the "R" bit cleared in the Command Flags field?

q_17874.question: What is the role of the GCS AS in the non-roaming architecture?
q_17874.ground_truth: The GCS AS provides service information to the PCRF and BM-SC, which is mapped to QoS parameters in the respective EPS network.

q_17875.question: What is used to determine the slots for a PUCCH transmission for unpaired spectrum?
q_17875.ground_truth: The UE determines the slots for a PUCCH transmission starting from a slot indicated to the UE, having an UL symbol as a first symbol, and consecutive UL symbols equal to or larger than a number of symbols provided by nrofsymbols.

q_17876.question: What does the term "syntactically incorrect" mean in the context of an information element in a message?
q_17876.ground_truth: An information element is syntactically incorrect if it contains at least one value defined as "reserved" in sub-clause 11 or if its value part violates rules of clause 11.

q_17877.question: What is the difference between highband coder types in the process of generating the final excitation?
q_17877.ground_truth: If the lowband coder type is un-voiced, the final excitation is calculated using equation (1569). Otherwise, it is calculated differently based on the bit rate.

q_17878.question: What are transient failures in the context of the Result-Code AVP in Diameter?
q_17878.ground_truth: Transient failures are temporary conditions in which the Diameter server cannot fulfill a service request, usually due to end-user service denial or insufficient credit limit. The client may retry the request after a specified period or addressing the root cause.

q_17879.question: What indication of the HOLD service is the document measuring, specifically for packet switched traffic in an IMS network?
q_17879.ground_truth: The number of used Communication Hold (HOLD) service procedure

q_17880.question: What is the maximum SNR difference between no-filter and FDSS filter when the Bler is 10%?
q_17880.ground_truth: The maximum SNR difference between no-filter and FDSS filter when the Bler is 10% is about 1dB.

q_17881.question: What are the two basic types of identifiers in the UTRAN Radio Network, divided into Radio Network Control Plane Identifiers and Transport Network Identifiers?
q_17881.ground_truth: Application Part level identifiers and Transport Network identifiers

q_17882.question: Upon inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode, what are the two substates that the UE shall enter if there is at least one active PDU session for which interworking with EPS is supported?

q_17883.question: What should the UE do in case of no cell change if the IE "Uplink Timing Advance" or the IE "Extended UL Timing Advance" is included in the message?
q_17883.ground_truth: In 3.84 Mcps TDD or 7.68 Mcps TDD, the UE should evaluate and apply the timing advance value for uplink transmission as indicated in the IE "Uplink Timing Advance" or the IE "Extended Uplink Timing Advance" in the Activation Time indicated in the message.

q_17884.question: Which delivery procedure description fragments are not allowed to be included in the Associated Delivery Procedure Description instance in MBMS?
q_17884.ground_truth: The Consumption Reporting Description shall not be included in the Associated Delivery Procedure Description instance, instead, it is described in a separate Associated Delivery Procedure Description instance referenced by the consumptionReporting element.

q_17885.question: What is the function of the overlap and add process in spectral combining?
q_17885.ground_truth: The overlap and add process is used to combine the noise filled spectrum and the generated high frequency spectrum in the partial overlap band, where the noise filled spectrum is used directly if there are any allocated bits from the spectral quantizer. If not, an overlap and add process between the two spectra is performed.

q_17886.question: How does the redundancy version (RV) of the HARQ transmission be derived in FDD in the MAC-e/es entity in the UE side?
q_17886.ground_truth: In FDD, the redundancy version (RV) of the HARQ transmission is derived by L1 from RSN, CFN and in case of 2 ms TTI from the sub-frame number.

q_17887.question: What is the overload point conversion equation used in the measurement results presented in clause 13.4.1.1?
q_17887.ground_truth: The overload point conversion equation used in the measurement results presented in clause 13.4.1.1 is Tmax = -3.01 dBov, where Tmax refers to a full-scale sine wave with a level of -3.01 dBov.

q_17888.question: What is the impact of Network Assistance messages on network load?
q_17888.ground_truth: The amount of data traffic transmitted as Network Assistance query/response messages will be insignificant in relation to the amount of data traffic transmitted as video content.

q_17889.question: Which type of files are defined in clause 4.1 of the document, and at what level are they located?
q_17889.ground_truth: There are four EFs (Elementary Files) at the Master File (MF) level.

q_17890.question: How does the version numbering system work in the document?
q_17890.ground_truth: The version number is in the format: x.y.z where the first digit represents the approval status, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial changes only.

q_17891.question: When is fallback to legacy point-to-point distribution used in GERAN Iu-mode and UTRAN for GPRS?
q_17891.ground_truth: Fallback to legacy point-to-point distribution is used for RNC nodes which do not support IP Multicast distribution in GERAN Iu-mode and UTRAN for GPRS.

q_17892.question: In FDD, when should the DRNS include the E-DCH RL Set ID IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message?
q_17892.ground_truth: The DRNS shall include the E-DCH RL Set ID IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message for each E-DCH RL which has or can have a common generation of E-RGCH information with another RL when the DRNS would contain the E-DCH serving RL, to identify the E-DCH RLs that have or can have a common generation of E-RGCH information.

q_17893.question: In which clause of TS 38.304 is it specified that the UE monitors the associated PO if the corresponding bit for subgroup the UE belongs to is indicated as 1 by PEI corresponding to its PO?
q_17893.ground_truth: It is specified in clause 7.3.0 of TS 38.304.

q_17894.question: Which procedure must the UAS follow when it receives a QoS downgrade notification for the UAV session?
q_17894.ground_truth: There are two cases when a QoS downgrade notification is received: (1) when Alternative QoS profiles are provided, and (2) when Alternative QoS profiles are not provided.

q_17895.question: What should the MAC entity do if a PDCCH transmission is received during the ra-ResponseWindow on the Serving Cell where the preamble was transmitted and the PDCCH transmission is addressed to the C-RNTI, indicating a successfully completed Random Access procedure?
q_17895.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the Random Access procedure successfully completed.

q_17896.question: What is the difference between KPIs and KQI on the WebTV Quality Monitoring use case?
q_17896.ground_truth: KPIs are specific performance indicators, such as initial stalling and freezing of the video, while KQI (Key Quality Indicator) is a single number combining the quality impact of occurring stalling and coding effects. This makes the monitoring of the service more efficient through KQI.

q_17897.question: What is the requirement for UL spurious emission when there is only single UL in uplink?
q_17897.ground_truth: The requirement for each band is applicable, as specified in clause 6.5.3.2 from TS 38.101-1.

q_17898.question: What does the "Transparency indicator" in octet 6 of the CHANNEL MODE information element represent when octet 4 indicates data?
q_17898.ground_truth: The "Transparency indicator" in octet 6 of the CHANNEL MODE information element indicates whether the data is transparent or non-transparent when octet 4 indicates data.

q_17899.question: What timer is used during the BuildMPTY operation in the MultiParty service?
q_17899.ground_truth: The MS starts the timer T(BuildMPTY) during the BuildMPTY operation and stops it when a response is received from the network.

q_17900.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives one or more IEs/IE groups marked with ``Ignore IE'' which it does not comprehend in a response message?
q_17900.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the content of the not comprehended IEs/IE groups and continue with the procedure as if the not comprehended IEs/IE groups were not received using the understood IEs/IE groups.

q_17901.question: Which reference signal(s) are at least supported for NR uplink?
q_17901.ground_truth: The following reference signals are at least supported for NR uplink: SRS (with main functionalities of CSI acquisition, beam management), DM-RS (with main functionalities of data and control demodulation), and Reference signal for phase tracking.

q_17902.question: What information should the GMLC include in the location estimate message to the LCS client when the event causing the message is PS-NI-LR and the location estimate was obtained in steps 1 to 3?
q_17902.ground_truth: The GMLC should include the MSISDN of the UE, the identity of the LCS client, the event causing the message (PS-NI-LR), the location estimate and its age, the indication received from RAN about the accuracy of the location estimate, the serving cell identity or SAI of the UE, the address of the SGSN, and the UE identity if it was not authenticated.

q_17903.question: What is the role of NWDAF profiles in the inter-NWDAF instance cooperation solution?
q_17903.ground_truth: The NWDAF profile contains information about the NF instance ID in the profile. The NWDAF queries the NRF to get the profiles of other NWDAF instances, and based on the profile, it finds other NWDAF instances providing processed data of 5GC NFs for analytics.

q_17904.question: What is the objective of the guidance given in the document regarding the precautions, measures and minimum requirements for successful interworking of the PLMN with the national and international PSTN?
q_17904.ground_truth: The objective is to reach a quality as close as possible to ITU-T standards in order to safeguard the performance seen by PSTN customers.

q_17905.question: What should the UE do to complete ongoing PRS-RSRP measurements if handover occurs during the process?
q_17905.ground_truth: The UE should complete the ongoing PRS-RSRP measurements session, and the PRS-RSRP measurement period can be longer.

q_17906.question: What decision does the target BSS make based on the ABQP for each PFC when accommodating resources during an inter-RAT/mode handover?
q_17906.ground_truth: The target BSS decides which PFCs to assign radio resources to and allocates TBFs for accommodated PFCs during an inter-RAT/mode handover.

q_17907.question: What is the negotiation procedure for RLP and layer 2 Relay function in terms of XID frames?
q_17907.ground_truth: The negotiation procedure involves one side sending an XID command with a certain set of parameters from the applicable parameter repertoire that it wants to negotiate. The other side then responds with an XID response, either confirming the parameter values or offering higher or lower ones.

q_17908.question: Which network option is affected by key issue #4, involving ensuring UP IP is applied in mobility from 5G to LTE?

q_17909.question: What is the main function of the LLC layer in the data transfer process?
q_17909.ground_truth: The LLC layer ensures data sequence integrity between the data source and data sink by means of a cyclic numbering scheme, and each logical data link has an independent numbering scheme, as identified by the Data Link Connection Identifier (DLCI).

q_17910.question: What should the UE prioritize in deriving reselection priorities for slice-based cell reselection if at least one NSAG received from NAS is supported on multiple frequencies?
q_17910.ground_truth: The UE should prioritize the frequencies based on the NAS-provided priority for the NSAG with the highest priority supported on the frequency.

q_17911.question: What is the significance of the "Cell-Frequency-Delete-LCR-MulFreq-Cell-ReconfRqstTDD" protocol extension?
q_17911.ground_truth: This protocol extension is used to delete the frequency of a secondary cell in a Time Division Duplex (TDD) system. It contains information about the frequency to be deleted and any optional extension information.

q_17912.question: What action is taken by the ProSe Function in the HPLMN when the UE removes and stops using for monitoring the Discovery Filter(s) corresponding to the Discovery Entry ID?
q_17912.ground_truth: The ProSe Function in the HPLMN responds to the UE with a Discovery Response (Discovery Entry ID) message containing only the Discovery Entry ID.

q_17913.question: What type of channel is used for the delivery of audio in theReference Model for MCPTT support over UC and BC?
q_17913.ground_truth: The reference model shows audio being delivered over both Unicast (UC) and Broadcast (BC) channels in the MCPTT support system.

q_17914.question: What action should the UE take if the estimated NAS downlink COUNT is greater than all the estimated NAS downlink COUNTs used for key derivation in a handover or received in a NAS message that passed its integrity check?
q_17914.ground_truth: The UE shall update its stored NAS downlink COUNT as though it has successfully integrity checked a NAS message with the estimated NAS downlink COUNT.

q_17915.question: What is the purpose of a Discovery Hash Chain User Integrity Key (DHCUIK) in the DUIHC solution?
q_17915.ground_truth: The DHCUIK is used in the creation of the MIC of the message m to provide interoperability with the existing TS 33.303 solution and to show that the DUIHC solution is as secure as the existing one.

q_17916.question: What is the role of the Service Capability Exposure Function (SCEF) in the Nu reference point?
q_17916.ground_truth: The SCEF is a functional element that securely exposes the services and capabilities provided by the 3GPP network interfaces. It manages PFDs provided by the 3rd party SCS/AS and provisions them to the PFDF via the Nu reference point.

q_17917.question: What is the method for obtaining the distribution P(O) in the code performance evaluation?
q_17917.ground_truth: The distribution P(O) is obtained using a statistical evaluation procedure, where data to be transmitted is partitioned into K symbols, which are used to generate N total symbols to be transmitted through an erasure channel with erasure probability Pe. The decoding failure probability distribution is then obtained as a function of O, which is the number of symbols received in excess of K.

q_17918.question: When does the PCRF cancel spending limit reporting for policy counters?
q_17918.ground_truth: The PCRF may cancel spending limit reporting for specific policy counter(s) using the Intermediate Spending Limit Report Request procedure or for all policy counter(s) using the Final Spending Limit Report Request procedure.

q_17919.question: What the UE shall do if it fails to receive the MBMS MODIFIED SERVICES INFORMATION message within the current modification period?
q_17919.ground_truth: The UE shall acquire the MBMS MODIFIED SERVICES INFORMATION and the MBMS UNMODIFIED SERVICES INFORMATION messages without delaying reading of MCCH until the next modification period and with stopping at the end of that modification period, and act upon the received MBMS MODIFIED SERVICES INFORMATION and the MBMS UNMODIFIED SERVICES INFORMATION messages as specified in subclause 8.7.2.4.

q_17920.question: What is the role of the AC name in the supplementary service version negotiation process?
q_17920.ground_truth: The AC name is used in the dialogue control portion of the BEGIN message to indicate the version of the supplementary service being used, and is selected based on the version indicator received from the MS and the highest AC name supported by the network.

q_17921.question: When is the use of the "id-Non-rectangular-resource-allocation-indicator" extension criticality set to "reject"?
q_17921.ground_truth: It is set to "reject" when non-rectangular resource allocation indicator is used in the RL-InformationResponseItem-RL-ReconfReady-ExtIEs protocol extension.

q_17922.question: What is the definition of telepresence in the context of 3GPP services?
q_17922.ground_truth: A conference with interactive audio-visual communications experience between remote locations, where the users enjoy a strong sense of realism and presence between all participants by optimizing a variety of attributes such as audio and video quality, eye contact, body language, spatial audio, coordinated environments and natural image size.

q_17923.question: How many bits are required to encode each two pulses in the same section in the case of encoding 3 signed pulses per track?

q_17924.question: What is the maximum size of one broadcast message for E-OTD assistance data?
q_17924.ground_truth: The typical size of one broadcast message will be less than 82 octets.

q_17925.question: What role does the MCData Service play in robot communication and identification?
q_17925.ground_truth: The MCData Service supports MCData communication between robots, allows communication initiation and termination by a controller, identifies robots in the organization, and provides location, characteristics, and other relevant information related to robots.

q_17926.question: What should an old SGSN do when it receives a reject indication from a new SGSN after sending a routeing area update?
q_17926.ground_truth: The old SGSN should continue as if the SGSN Context Request was never received.

q_17927.question: What happens to an EPS security context when one of the stated conditions in the specification is met?
q_17927.ground_truth: When any of the specified conditions in the EPS specification are met, the EPS security context shall be deleted from the ME. The specification lists different scenarios that would result in the deletion of an EPS security context, such as the removal of the UICC, or the discovery of a different UICC inserted to the ME, or the ME having no UICC inserted at all.

q_17928.question: What is the criterion used to specify the mid-call event in the VPLMN network?
q_17928.ground_truth: The criterion used to specify the mid-call event in the VPLMN network consists of the following: minimum number of digits to be collected, maximum number of digits to be collected, maximum delay between successive digits, digit(s) used to indicate the start of the input (optional), digit(s) used to indicate the end of the input (optional), and digit(s) used to indicate that the input shall be cancelled (optional).

q_17929.question: How does the E-UTRAN architecture support end-to-end QoS?
q_17929.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN architecture supports end-to-end QoS by providing the appropriate QoS requested by the RNL. The TNL shall provide the appropriate QoS requested by the RNL.

q_17930.question: What is the feature that can be added to the ACR service that contains a list of certified public identities or identity ranges of users from which incoming anonymous communications are allowed or not allowed?

q_17931.question: What should the Sender perform each time an AMD PDU is scheduled for transmission or retransmission?
q_17931.ground_truth: Each time an AMD PDU is scheduled for transmission or retransmission, the Sender shall increment the value of the corresponding VT(DAT), notify the lower layer that data is available for transmission, and perform the actions specified in subclause 11.3.2.2.

q_17932.question: What is the procedure for DNS Query handling in the PDU session established for edge applications?
q_17932.ground_truth: If no rules correspond to the DNS destination address, the message is forwarded to the central UPF-PSA. If there is a rule with a corresponding destination address (e.g., DoH in private networks), the ULCL forwards the request to the local UPF-PSA. The DNS resolver returns a response with an A/AAA record (srv-IP1), and the UE sends an application request with the destination address of "srv-IP1". The UPF-ULCL checks rules for a match and forwards the packet to the local UPF-PSA if there is a successful match. The same applies for VPNs, and the inspection of DNS message (query/response) is not necessary, supporting Do53 (classic), DoT, and DoH.

q_17933.question: What follows after the last LI when an AMD PDU header consists of an odd number of LI(s) and the length of the LI field is 11 bits?

q_17934.question: What message is used by the GANC or MS to confirm GA-PSR Transport Channel activation?

q_17935.question: What can policies control in the context of Network Composition?
q_17935.ground_truth: Policies can control the negotiation and the result of Network Composition, including the ability to decide with which other CCNs a CCN is willing to compose, negotiate resource usage and control, and calculate a new set of policies for the new common CCN.

q_17936.question: What is the difference between e.i.r.p. and e.r.p. in antenna measurement?
q_17936.ground_truth: Effective isotropically radiated power (e.i.r.p.) is the total power radiated by an antenna in all directions, while effective radiated power (e.r.p.) is the power radiated in a particular direction, often compared to a half-wave tuned dipole antenna. There is a constant difference of 2.15 dB between e.i.r.p. and e.r.p.

q_17937.question: What is the difference between Domain/Technology-specific Concrete Models and the UIM in the FNIM?
q_17937.ground_truth: Domain/Technology-specific Concrete Models are instantiated to provide meaningful management services, while the UIM is an abstract model used for end-to-end consistency of management information semantics.

q_17938.question: What must the AS do if it receives an INVITE request that fulfils the "approaching NDUB" condition for user B?
q_17938.ground_truth: The AS shall determine that a CW condition has occurred when it receives an INVITE request that fulfils the "approaching NDUB" condition for user B.

q_17939.question: What action should a UE take upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the Identity type IE set to "SUCI" and timer T3519 running?
q_17939.ground_truth: The UE should send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the stored SUCI.

q_17940.question: What should a UE do with an activated pattern sequence after receiving a message that includes the IE "Activation time"?
q_17940.ground_truth: If the pattern is activated with a message that includes the IE "Activation time," and if the CFN value indicated by the IE "Activation Time" and the CFN value indicated by the TGCFN are included in the same TTI common to all the transport channels that are multiplexed onto the reference CCTrCh and the CFN value indicated by the TGCFN is equal or higher than the CFN value indicated by the IE "Activation Time," the UE behavior is not specified.

q_17941.question: In the differentiated-service MBMS use case, what are the two classes of video services provided?
q_17941.ground_truth: The two classes of video services provided in the differentiated-service MBMS use case are the normal video service of 720p@30fps and the premium video service of 1080p@30fps.

q_17942.question: What is the structure of the DirectTransferInformationItem-RANAP-RelocInf in the DirectTransferInformationItem-RANAP-RelocInf?
q_17942.ground_truth: The DirectTransferInformationItem-RANAP-RelocInf is a SEQUENCE that consists of NAS-PDU, SAPI, cN-DomainIndicator, and iE-Extensions.

q_17943.question: What information does AF1 provide to AF2 during the AF relocation information transfer?
q_17943.ground_truth: AF1 provides application status, UE ID, PDU session information (such as the UE IP address, the current DNAI serving the UE, and N6 traffic routing information) to AF2.

q_17944.question: How many bit rates were selected for each video resolution in the subjective tests?
q_17944.ground_truth: Five bit rates were selected for each video resolution in the subjective tests.

q_17945.question: What is the role of NWDAF in Alternative 1 of the solution for Key Issue #16?
q_17945.ground_truth: NWDAF in Alternative 1 is responsible for collecting performance data of Application Server Instances from each EDN and deriving analytics that contain a list of Application Server Instances and their associated performance data at the requested UE location and target period.

q_17946.question: What is the function of the GTP-U-UNIT-DATA SAP in GTP-U protocol?
q_17946.ground_truth: The GTP-U-UNIT-DATA SAP is used to send and receive T-PDUs in an unacknowledged mode. This includes transferring T-PDUs and any conditionally present system-dependent information.

q_17947.question: What should a UE do when it receives a mandatory IE with a value reserved for future extension in another IE?
q_17947.ground_truth: The UE should consider the IE to have an undefined value and apply the corresponding generic error handling to the IE.

q_17948.question: What REPORT Records should be reported by DF2 to the LEMF when SMS over IMS is used?
q_17948.ground_truth: SMS over IP REPORT Record, HSS related REPORT Records (Serving System or Serving Evolved Packet System, Registration termination or Cancel Location, Register location REPORT Record, and Location information request REPORT Record) should be reported by DF2 to the LEMF when SMS over IMS is used.

q_17949.question: When does the target AMF need to send a request message to the source AMF to obtain security parameters for the Remote UE?
q_17949.ground_truth: The target AMF sends a request message to the source AMF to obtain security parameters for the Remote UE when the source and target AMFs are different and the Remote UE's 5G-GUTI is used.

q_17950.question: What is the type of the proactive command when the command number is 1 and the immediate link establishment is used?

q_17951.question: What happens in the "Bulked data generation used to generate an analytics output" step?
q_17951.ground_truth: In the "Bulked data generation used to generate an analytics output" step, NWDAF#2 generates bulked data used to produce the analytics output.

q_17952.question: What are the options for the multi-streams DL traffic model?
q_17952.ground_truth: The options for the multi-streams DL traffic model are: Option 1 (I+P), Option 2 (video + audio/data), and Option 3 (FOV + omnidirectional view).

q_17953.question: What happens if the procedure is not requested and only steps 3 and 4 are needed in the Non-3GPP message processing?
q_17953.ground_truth: The process will stop after step 3, and step 4 will not be needed.

q_17954.question: Which diversion service, if activated by the forwarding party, takes precedence over the communication forwarding unconditional service?

q_17955.question: What is the difference between the two test points in the test described in section 8.1.3.4 of the document?
q_17955.ground_truth: The two test points have time delays starting at 32 Ts and 5008 Ts, respectively.

q_17956.question: What action should the RNC take when it receives a MBMS CN DE-REGISTRATION REQUEST message for a certain MBMS Bearer Service from multiple CN nodes?
q_17956.ground_truth: The RNC should only proceed with the first MBMS CN DE-REGISTRATION REQUEST message received and inform all CN nodes except the one it confirmed the successful MBMS CN De-Registration procedure with.

q_17957.question: What event is represented in the PF-DD-CDR when the ProSe Function of the VPLMN responds to Discovery Request from the ProSe Function of HPLMN?

q_17958.question: What is the role of the Notification Log (NL) Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the 3GPP system?
q_17958.ground_truth: The Notification Log (NL) Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a mechanism that provides a standard general-purpose mechanism for the management of logs containing selected notifications from the network. It is used for historical analysis of faults and conditions in the network.

q_17959.question: Under what circumstances should the data link layer entity transmit an RNR response frame with the F bit set to "1" when its own receiver is busy?
q_17959.ground_truth: The RNR response frame with the F bit set to "1" shall be transmitted when the data link layer entity receives a command frame with the P bit set to "1" while entering an own receiver busy condition. It should also be transmitted when receiving I frames with the P bit set to "1" or when entering an own receiver busy condition due to the expiry of timer T200.

q_17960.question: What is RoAoA in the context of a BS's receiver directional requirements?
q_17960.ground_truth: RoAoA is the region of arrival angles of a BS, and is used to determine the extreme directions subject to conformance testing for the receiver.

q_17961.question: What kind of signalling is used between the RAN and CN nodes in the CS domain?
q_17961.ground_truth: The CS domain related signalling between RAN and CN applies to UTRAN only and uses one common RRC connection and two Iu signalling connections.

q_17962.question: What happens if the UE has uplink user data pending for one or more PDU sessions when it builds a REGISTRATION REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST message as initial NAS message?
q_17962.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate the respective PDU sessions in the Uplink data status IE, regardless of the access category for which the access barring check is performed.

q_17963.question: What are the requirements for the GPRS transparent transport procedure in 3GPP networks?
q_17963.ground_truth: The GPRS transparent transport procedure is used in 3GPP networks while in dedicated mode, to transport GPRS information transparently over the radio interface when DTM operation is supported by both the mobile station and the network. The information from upper layers shall be carried inside the GTTP Information message, and the procedure is only applicable when the information from upper layers is signalling information and the GTTP length of the message is below the maximum indicated by the network.

q_17964.question: What is the purpose of the NRM as defined by this IRP?
q_17964.ground_truth: The NRM defined by this IRP supports communications for telecommunication network management purposes, including management of converged networks. It is a member of the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM) and its information is derived from the FNIM Umbrella Information Model (UIM).

q_17965.question: What is supported for NR RACH Msg. 1 retransmission at least for multi-beam operation?
q_17965.ground_truth: NR supports power ramping and the option for UE to change the uplink beam during retransmissions.

q_17966.question: What is the purpose of UTM-Navigated C2 communication in the UAS context?
q_17966.ground_truth: UTM-Navigated C2 communication refers to the UAV being provided a pre-scheduled flight plan for autonomous flying. However, UTM maintains a C2 (command and control) communication link with the UAV to monitor the flight status, verify the flight status with up-to-date dynamic restrictions, provide route updates, and navigate the UAV whenever necessary.

q_17967.question: When does the HSS/AAA initiate a detach procedure leading to a PMIPv6 De-Registration, as per clause 11.4.1?
q_17967.ground_truth: The HSS/AAA can initiate a detach procedure resulting in a PMIPv6 De-Registration.

q_17968.question: What information does the Data Volume Reference IE provide in the DATA VOLUME REPORT message?
q_17968.ground_truth: The Data Volume Reference IE indicates the time when the data volume is counted.

q_17969.question: What is the number of subframes for ISF interpolation for HF-256, HF-512, and HF-1024?
q_17969.ground_truth: For HF-256, the number of subframes for ISF interpolation is 4. For HF-512, it is 8. For HF-1024, it is 16.

q_17970.question: Which message type is sent from the network to the mobile station on the PACCH to indicate that the ongoing RR connection will be released in Iu mode?

q_17971.question: What should the UE do when the memory reserved for the logged measurement information becomes full?
q_17971.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T330 and perform the same actions as upon expiry of T330, which includes sending a UEInformationResponse message with the logged measurement information.

q_17972.question: When can the MBS Application Provider update the MBS Distribution Session parameters, except for the MBS Session Identifier and the Location-dependent service flag?
q_17972.ground_truth: The MBS Application Provider can update the MBS Distribution Session parameters when the session is in the INACTIVE state.

q_17973.question: What protocol should be used as the Path Protocol in the GTP' transfer scenarios?

q_17974.question: What is the advantage of triggering a Codec re-negotiation in the core network in high-overload situations?
q_17974.ground_truth: It can significantly improve call quality by avoiding multiple transcoding steps.

q_17975.question: What is the software or device associated with a Push recipient that interprets Push Data to the user?

q_17976.question: What is the purpose of the Unit-Quota-Threshold AVP (AVP code 1226) in the context of Multiple-Service-Credit-Control AVP?
q_17976.ground_truth: It contains a threshold value in service specific units and indicates that the Credit-Control client shall seek re-authorization from the server for the quota when the quota contents fall below the supplied threshold.

q_17977.question: What is the message type and significance of SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 10 message for mobile stations supporting VGCS and VBS listening?
q_17977.ground_truth: The message type is SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 10 and the significance is dual.

q_17978.question: Which two solutions specify that the FAE server should determine the transport QoS requirements for communication with the 3GPP core network?

q_17979.question: What is the role of a UE in the context of 6.2.1?
q_17979.ground_truth: A UE implements the role of a CUA as specified in clause 6.3.1.

q_17980.question: What are some privacy preferences provided by the CMMC service for conference participants?
q_17980.ground_truth: Participants can select the identity they want to show, request that their identity is excluded from the Conference state information and have the option to use a nickname, which is unique in the conference.

q_17981.question: What is the significance of the "scfID" and "correlationID" parameters in the "EstablishTemporaryConnectionArg" sequence?
q_17981.ground_truth: The "scfID" parameter is used to identify the specific SCF that initiated the connection, while the "correlationID" parameter is used to correlate the temporary connection to the specific call in the SCF.

q_17982.question: What two changes were considered in regards to the PA output power to make the required linearity values more reasonable?
q_17982.ground_truth: The two changes considered were reducing the PA's maximum output power and backing off the TX output power at the duplexer.

q_17983.question: What must the network function do if it fails to authorize the USIM for ProSe services during the request of a GPI for GBA push based shared key-based mutual authentication?
q_17983.ground_truth: The network function shall refrain from establishing a TLS connection with PSK authentication together with GBA push.

q_17984.question: Which information element is used to indicate the measured results list in a Position Periodic Report?

q_17985.question: When is an IPFlow instance ignored due to the absence of a corresponding "StartSourceIPaddress" or "EndSourceIPaddress" leaf?
q_17985.ground_truth: The UE ignores an IPFlow instance with a "StartSourceIPaddress" leaf without a correspondent "AddressType" leaf or an "EndSourceIPaddress" leaf without a correspondent "StartSourceIPaddress" leaf. If the IPFlow instance is the only one contained in the flow distribution rule, the UE ignores the flow distribution rule.

q_17986.question: Which modal verb indicates a recommendation in the document?

q_17987.question: What information must the PGW-C provide to the PGW-U in order to setup L2TP tunneling towards an L2TP network server?
q_17987.ground_truth: The PGW-C must provide L2TP information such as LNS IP address, LNS host name, LNS address, tunnel password, and any other necessary parameters to the PGW-U.

q_17988.question: What entity determines if PSS to MBMS switching is available for the UE in 8.4.4.1.3?
q_17988.ground_truth: The SCF (Service Capability Feature) determines if PSS to MBMS switching is available for the UE in 8.4.4.1.3.

q_17989.question: What is the role of the EOL character during the message phase in the UMTS PLMN environment?
q_17989.ground_truth: The EOL character identifies the start of the message phase, controls the transcoding procedure, and marks the end of the message phase.

q_17990.question: What is the role of the profile, tier and level syntax structure in H.265 (HEVC)?
q_17990.ground_truth: The profile, tier and level syntax structure in H.265 (HEVC) includes 12 bytes data for the entire bitstream and may include more profile, tier and level information for temporal scalable layers. It also indicates whether the bitstream is free of frame-packed content, interlaced source, and field pictures, allowing clients/players with no special support of post-processing functionalities to stay away from those contents.

q_17991.question: What is the criticality of resource status indication?

q_17992.question: What is the purpose of the CTS operation data update procedure, and what timers are associated with the data sent in this procedure?
q_17992.ground_truth: The purpose of the CTS operation data update procedure is to provide the fixed part with the necessary data to operate. This procedure is initiated by the fixed part at the expiry of timer Trecal. The data sent in this procedure are associated with two timers: Tval, which indicates the maximum duration where the data should be used, and Trecal, which requires the fixed part to contact the service node on a regular basis to update the necessary data before the validity period expires.

q_17993.question: What network nodes are used for intercepting communications in IMS VoLTE with S8HR?
q_17993.ground_truth: The ADMF provisions LMISF with target identities for interception in the VPLMN with S8HR.

q_17994.question: What is the meaning of the User-Data AVP in 3GPP~TS~29.228?
q_17994.ground_truth: The User-Data AVP contains the user data required to give service to a user in 3GPP~TS~29.228.

q_17995.question: What is added in the preparation phase of the unified solution for issues #1, #2, #3, and #4?
q_17995.ground_truth: In the preparation phase of the unified solution for issues #1, #2, #3, and #4, the following steps are added: (1) UDR responds to a request to create or update a resource by including a Reset-ID, (2) the front-end forwards the Reset-ID to the NF, and (3) the NF stores the Reset-ID and the name of the procedure in a relevant profile.

q_17996.question: What kind of documents produced by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project have a subject that can be modified by the TSG?
q_17996.ground_truth: Technical specifications, technical reports, and study documents.

q_17997.question: What is the number of notification indicators (Nn) in each MICH frame?
q_17997.ground_truth: Nn is 16, 32, 64, or 128 notification indicators in each MICH frame.

q_17998.question: What is the role of the PLMN operator in defining additional non-standardized service types?
q_17998.ground_truth: The PLMN operator can define additional non-standardized service types that do not need to be globally unique.

q_17999.question: What is the use of the Supported-Features AVP on the St reference point?
q_17999.ground_truth: The Supported-Features AVP is used during session establishment to inform the destination host about the required and optional features that the origin host supports.

q_18000.question: What information is included in the packet downlink assignment message?
q_18000.ground_truth: The packet downlink assignment message includes the list of PDCH(s) that will be used for downlink transfer, timing advance and power control information, and the mobile station's multislot capability.

q_18001.question: What should the AS do based on operator policy if the initial INVITE destined to the served user includes a Supported header field with the "early-session" option-tag and the AS supports the "early-session" extension?
q_18001.ground_truth: The AS shall follow the procedures in clause 4.5.5.3.3 to provide CAT service if the AS supports the "early-session" extension and there are no intermediaries in the network that do not understand the procedures.

q_18002.question: What message does the remote party receive after requesting to disconnect in the described scenario?
q_18002.ground_truth: The remote party receives a notification of the disconnect request.

q_18003.question: What is the purpose of the PDN GW initiated bearer deactivation procedure in step 10.2.4.1 of TS 23.401?
q_18003.ground_truth: The purpose of the PDN GW initiated bearer deactivation procedure in step 10.2.4.1 of TS 23.401 is to release resources in EPC for the PDN connections that have been transferred to 5GS.

q_18004.question: What are the events that can be reported with the intercepted IMS conference content for AS/MRFC?
q_18004.ground_truth: Start of Conference, Party Join, Party Leave, Conference Bearer Modification, Start of Intercept on an Active Conference, End of Conference, Creation of Conference, and Update of Conference are the events that can be reported with the intercepted IMS conference content for AS/MRFC.

q_18005.question: What is the purpose of the "diversityControlField" in the "RL-Information-RL-AdditionRqstFDD" SEQUENCE?
q_18005.ground_truth: The "diversityControlField" in the "RL-Information-RL-AdditionRqstFDD" SEQUENCE is used to indicate the diversity control for radio link additions in FDD.

q_18006.question: What is the formula for calculating the interruption time in the case of intra-frequency hard handover without the need for compressed mode, and the UE does not need to perform any synchronization procedure for timing maintenance?
q_18006.ground_truth: The interruption time is given by the formula Tinterrupt3=20*KC+150*OC +10*Fmax ms, where KC is the number of known target cells, OC is the number of target cells that are not known, and Fmax is the maximum number of radio frames within the transmission time intervals of all transport channels that are multiplexed into the same CCTrCH.

q_18007.question: What should the UE do if it receives a handover-related information UEInformationRequest message with successHO-ReportReq set to true and it has successful handover related information available in VarSuccessHO-Report and the RPLMN is included in the plmn-IdentityList stored in VarSuccessHO-Report?
q_18007.ground_truth: The UE should set upInterruptionTimeAtHO in VarSuccessHO-Report to include the time elapsed between the time of arrival of the last PDCP PDU received from the source cell of the concerned handover and the time of arrival of the first non-duplicate PDCP PDU received from the target cell of the concerned handover, as measured at the time of arrival of the first non-duplicate PDCP PDU received from the target cell. It should also set the successHO-Report in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of successHO-Report in the VarSuccessHO-Report, if available and discard the VarSuccessHO-Report upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers.

q_18008.question: What should the IWF do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body containing the <mcptt-Params> element with the <emergency-ind> element set to "true" during a private call?
q_18008.ground_truth: The IWF should set the MCPTT emergency private priority state to "MEPP 2: in-progress" for this private call.

q_18009.question: What is the TP-Data-Coding-Scheme used for in the SMS protocol?
q_18009.ground_truth: The TP-Data-Coding-Scheme indicates the type of data contained in the short message, the character set used, and whether the data is compressed or not.

q_18010.question: What interface has been adapted for IP technology in the BICN, in addition to the Iu interface?
q_18010.ground_truth: The A interface control plane signaling has been introduced for IP technology in 3GPP release 7, in addition to the Iu interface.

q_18011.question: What is the purpose of the test framework described in the 3GPP Technical Report on the update to fixed-point basic operators (Release 17)?
