q_18011.ground_truth: The purpose of the test framework described in the 3GPP Technical Report on the update to fixed-point basic operators (Release 17) is to compare the fixed-point arithmetic accuracy of the extended basic operators against a floating-point implementation of the extended basic operators. Each basic operator will be tested for 4 different data patterns. The test framework will validate the extended STL2009 Basic Operators implementation against a reference floating-point implementation and log the error value generated from the fixed-point output of the DUT against the reference floating-point implementation output.

q_18012.question: How is the number of RTP packets lost in succession reported in MBMS reception reporting?
q_18012.ground_truth: The number of RTP packets lost in succession is summed up over each resolution period of the stream and stored in the vector TotalNumberofSuccessivePacketLoss.

q_18013.question: What is the assumed frequency range for the LNA and post-filter receiver characteristics in the analysis discussed in section 15.2.7a.2?
q_18013.ground_truth: The frequency range assumed for the LNA and post-filter receiver characteristics in the analysis discussed in section 15.2.7a.2 is the cell band (850MHz).

q_18014.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project, Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Working Group 4 (Codec) responsible for?
q_18014.ground_truth: They are responsible for producing technical specifications for reliable transmission of text telephone conversations via the speech channel of cellular or PSTN networks.

q_18015.question: What is the role of the "URI-DN-prefix" in the construction of a FQDN?
q_18015.ground_truth: The "URI-DN-prefix" is a part of the authority component of a URI, which can be registered into a name resolution service such as DNS.

q_18016.question: What is timer T3146 used for and what is its minimum and maximum value?
q_18016.ground_truth: Timer T3146 is started during the packet access procedure, either after sending the maximum allowed number of CHANNEL REQUEST messages or on receipt of an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message. The minimum value of this timer is equal to the time taken by T+2S slots of the mobile station's RACH, and the maximum value is 5 seconds.

q_18017.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in producing the Technical Specification for charging management in 3GPP networks?
q_18017.ground_truth: The 3GPP produces the Technical Specification to standardize the charging functionality and charging management in 3GPP networks.

q_18018.question: Which primitive type is used by a layer providing a service to notify the next higher layer of activities related to the REQUEST primitive type?

q_18019.question: What is the maximum threshold for filling the transmit buffers towards the UE before flow control is initiated?
q_18019.ground_truth: The transmit buffer becomes half full, and then flow control is initiated if it is provided at the L2R function.

q_18020.question: What is the purpose of the P-Private-Network-Indication header field in a request or a response message as per 3GPP TS 24.229?
q_18020.ground_truth: The P-Private-Network-Indication header field is used to distinguish private network traffic from public network traffic. The business trunking application shall verify the presence of the header field and its value when it receives a request or a response message. The business trunking application shall forward the received P-Asserted-Identity header field unchanged if this header field is present.

q_18021.question: What is the default FLUS Factory URI construction in a FLUS system?
q_18021.ground_truth: The default FLUS Factory URI construction in a FLUS system is defined in two formats, depending on whether the UE of the FLUS source contains the ISIM application or not. The first format is "sip:flus@flus-factory.operator.com" and the second format is "sip:flus@flus-factory.ims.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org".

q_18022.question: What is the main goal of SON conflict prevention and resolution in the context of 5G network?
q_18022.ground_truth: The main goal is to prevent and resolve conflicts caused by SON functions and non-SON functions, in order to ensure the stability and performance of the network.

q_18023.question: What are the requirements on the Xn and on the NG interfaces to ensure the mobility of the RAN with respect to the 5CN?
q_18023.ground_truth: This is expected to be addressed within Key Issue 6.

q_18024.question: What changes are required for the AMF/UDM in this authorization process?
q_18024.ground_truth: The AMF should support the new service operation Nudm_Check_Authorization or use the existing Nudm_SDM_Get. It needs to verify whether the candidate Relay UE is allowed to act as a Relay UE for any other UE. The UDM should be provisioned with the association between all authorized Remote UEs and Relay UE to allow the AMF to decide whether the Remote UE is allowed to access via the Relay UE.

q_18025.question: What is not required when using a TDM-based A-interface and voice call uses AMR?
q_18025.ground_truth: Re-framing and transcoding of the CS domain user plane between RTP/UDP speech bearer and the speech bearers over the A-interface is not required.

q_18026.question: How is the initial pitch lag estimate calculated for the future 1st and 2nd sub-frame?
q_18026.ground_truth: The initial pitch lag estimates are obtained by adding the differential pitch lag to the pitch lag of the last sub-frame, if the pitch lag difference is inside the valid range of +-7.

q_18027.question: How much SNR gain was observed in source R1-2008874 when the actual number of repetition was increased from 3 to 8 for VoIP at 2% rBLER for FR1 TDD, compared to Rel-16 PUSCH repetition type A with 8 nominal repetitions?

q_18028.question: What is the feature that allows a model component to include model elements from another model component?
q_18028.ground_truth: This feature is called "import" and it allows a model component to include model elements, such as classes, from another model component, potentially specified by another organization.

q_18029.question: When are the frequency parameters, given in the message, used for channel access before the starting time?
q_18029.ground_truth: If the starting time information element is present and any of the information elements referring to before the starting time are also present.

q_18030.question: What is the purpose of the reroute security context in the initial registration process?
q_18030.ground_truth: The reroute security context ensures NAS security context availability for the reallocated AMF during the registration procedure. This context is generated by the AUSF and stored in the form of a hash code of security anchor key, SUPI, and Target AMF information.

q_18031.question: In which cells is the timing advance value set to zero, and UE autonomous adjustment of timing advance upon handover is disabled?
q_18031.ground_truth: In cells that have a small enough radius, such that timing advance doesn't need to be used.

q_18032.question: What is the role of the PCF in Solution 3 of the present TR?
q_18032.ground_truth: The PCF supports authorizing the new steering modes for the SDF in Solution 3 of the present TR.

q_18033.question: What is the test requirements for relay access link ACS as defined in TS~36.141 clause 7.5?
q_18033.ground_truth: The test requirements for relay access link ACS are defined in TS~36.141 clause 7.5.

q_18034.question: Which layer of key in ProSe Direct One-to-one communication is shared between two entities and refreshed using nonces exchanged between the communicating entities?
q_18034.ground_truth: KD, a 256-bit root key in ProSe Direct One-to-one communication.

q_18035.question: What is the purpose of the "MDT PLMN List" in UTRAN?
q_18035.ground_truth: The purpose of the MDT PLMN List IE is to provide the list of PLMN allowed for MDT.

q_18036.question: In the best case scenario, what is the maximum sleep time that the UE can achieve in a 2 way soft handover?
q_18036.ground_truth: The UE can sleep up to 29.3% of the time.

q_18037.question: What is the interface that the MBSTF exposes for the 5MBS media delivery functions?
q_18037.ground_truth: The interface that the MBSTF exposes for the 5MBS media delivery functions is xMB-U based.

q_18038.question: What is the size and type of the L2 Pseudo Length Information element in 3G UMTS?
q_18038.ground_truth: The L2 Pseudo Length Information element is an element with 2 octets length and it is a type 1 information element.

q_18039.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA) Layer 2 measurements document?
q_18039.ground_truth: The document contains the description and definition of the measurements performed by E-UTRAN or the user equipment (UE) that are transferred over the standardized interfaces to support E-UTRA radio link operations, radio resource management (RRM), network operations and maintenance (OAM), minimization of drive tests (MDT), and self-organising networks (SON).

q_18040.question: How many different Iurh connectivity options does this version of the specification support?
q_18040.ground_truth: This version of the specification supports three different Iurh connectivity options: Option1, Option2, and Option3.

q_18041.question: What is the potential requirement for the 3GPP system to support MPS for MMTEL voice and voice conference call/sessions between two 3GPP networks supporting MPS?
q_18041.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support MPS for MMTEL voice and voice conference call/sessions between two 3GPP networks supporting MPS. Intermediate 3GPP networks between an originating network and terminating network should allow MPS priority markings to be passed transparently based on policy agreements.

q_18042.question: What is the purpose of the non-MSGin5G UE de-registration process described in section 6.27.4?
q_18042.ground_truth: The purpose of the non-MSGin5G UE de-registration process described in section 6.27.4 is for the Message Gateway to de-register the MSGin5G service ID associated with the non-MSGin5G UE from the home serving MSGin5G server when the non-MSGin5G UE de-registers from its message delivery service.

q_18043.question: What is the ultimate goal for VR Systems in terms of user movement?
q_18043.ground_truth: The ultimate goal for VR Systems is to allow users to look around from observation points in 3D space and move within that space under their own control with full freedom.

q_18044.question: What should the SGSN include in the User Location Information IE if it is available?
q_18044.ground_truth: The SGSN shall include the CGI or SAI in the "Geographic Location" field depending on whether the MS is in a cell or a service area respectively.

q_18045.question: What parameter is suggested to be sent by the network with the broadcast message in the NAS-based solution?
q_18045.ground_truth: The NSUC, PKID, and signature algorithm and/or domain set indicator are suggested to be sent by the network with the broadcast message in the NAS-based solution.

q_18046.question: What is the recommended cause value to be used in the DISCONNECT message during call failure procedures?
q_18046.ground_truth: The recommended cause value to be used in the DISCONNECT message during call failure procedures is 31 (normal, unspecified), with coding standard set to "Standard defined for the GSM PLMNs" and location set to "network beyond interworking point".

q_18047.question: What action should the RAN take if it does not receive the Release RRC Connection Acknowledge message after sending a Release RRC Connection message?
q_18047.ground_truth: The RAN should send a failure message to the SGSN, and the SGSN should stay in the MM-CONNECTED state.

q_18048.question: What does the source RNC/BSS do upon deciding to initiate an inter RAT/mode PS handover?
q_18048.ground_truth: The source RNC/BSS sends a Relocation Required message to the old SGSN with the Relocation Type set to "UE Involved in relocation of SRNS" and the Target ID containing the identity of the target cell.

q_18049.question: How do the Minimum Requirements and Test Requirements for UTRA and E-UTRA differ in terms of measurement uncertainty?
q_18049.ground_truth: The Minimum Requirements in the core specifications for UTRA and E-UTRA make no allowance for measurement uncertainty, while the Test Requirements for UTRA and E-UTRA are relaxed with Test Tolerances. The measurement results returned by the Test System are compared against the Test Requirements, without modification using the shared risk principle.

q_18050.question: What are the two types of TV services that the MNO aims to make available through stationary roof-top antennas?
q_18050.ground_truth: Linear TV services and on-demand TV services.

q_18051.question: What network entity can directly interface with different network elements for the O&M-based solution in Solution #6?
q_18051.ground_truth: The PLMN NMS can directly interface with different network elements, such as core network functions and RAN nodes, for the O&M-based solution in Solution #6.

q_18052.question: What is the maximum length of certain GSM System Information messages (SI 5 and SI 6) when sent as a B4 frame on the SACCH?
q_18052.ground_truth: The maximum length of these messages is 19 octets.

q_18053.question: How does the RAP distance differ between the two options for SHVC encoding in multi-stream multiparty video conferencing?
q_18053.ground_truth: The RAP distance is 2 seconds for both layers in the first option, and 2 seconds for the base layer and 4 seconds for the enhancement layer in the second option.

q_18054.question: What message does the MS send to the GANC to initiate the CTC activation as specified in sub-clause 8a.4.1 during the exception case for CS domain handover?

q_18055.question: What is the difference between selecting the UE-initiated NBIFOM mode and the network-initiated NBIFOM mode for IP flow mobility?
q_18055.ground_truth: The UE-initiated NBIFOM mode is selected by the UE to trigger the IP flow mobility procedure, while the network-initiated NBIFOM mode is selected by the network to trigger the IP flow mobility procedure.

q_18056.question: What is the function of 4-wire circuits in the PLMN?
q_18056.ground_truth: The 4-wire circuits in the PLMN provide transmission systems and do not affect the overall system requirements for digital circuits without speech processing devices. However, for analogue links, the transmission characteristics, such as attenuation, attenuation distortion, and noise, will affect the overall system requirements of the PLMN.

q_18057.question: What is the requirement for the MPS indicator to be used in the UE, as specified in CR~3?
q_18057.ground_truth: The MPS indicator must match the SUPI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME for it to be used.

q_18058.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 36.301, what is the role of the "Device Under Test (DUT)"?
q_18058.ground_truth: The device that is being tested for compliance with the 3GPP technical specification.

q_18059.question: What keys are derived from the 64-bit GSM cipher key Kc during a PS intra SGSN handover?
q_18059.ground_truth: UMTS cipher/integrity keys CK and IK.

q_18060.question: What happens if the Serving GANC wishes to redirect the MS to another Serving GANC during the GAN Registration procedure?
q_18060.ground_truth: If the GANC wishes to redirect the MS to another Serving GANC, it sends a GA-RC REGISTER REDIRECT providing the FQDN or IP address of the target Serving GANC and the associated SEGW, and the GAN Mode Indicator if required. The TCP connection is released and the secure IPsec tunnel is optionally released depending on if the network indicates that the same IPsec tunnel can be reused for the next registration.

q_18061.question: What interfaces need to be enhanced for the new L2TP functionality?
q_18061.ground_truth: The Sx/N4 interface needs to be enhanced to convey information required to setup the L2TP sessions/tunnels to the UP Function.

q_18062.question: Which type of data is carried in the "RRC-Container" field in the RNCTraceInformation sequence?
q_18062.ground_truth: The "RRC-Container" field in the RNCTraceInformation sequence is of the type OCTET STRING, which represents a variable-length bit string.

q_18063.question: What is the purpose of the MO-LR Short Circuit request?
q_18063.ground_truth: The MO-LR Short Circuit request allows the UE to communicate directly with the LCS client for location estimates instead of going through the H-GMLC and other intermediaries.

q_18064.question: What parameter indicates whether the returned position estimate satisfies the requested accuracy or not?

q_18065.question: What should the UE do if it receives a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message or a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message?
q_18065.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the NBIFOM status parameter of the NBIFOM container IE of the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message or a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message as the cause of failure.

q_18066.question: What should be done by the GGSN when the GGSN does not support the PDP type or the PDP address in the Create MBMS Context Request from the SGSN?
q_18066.ground_truth: The GGSN should return "Unknown PDP address or PDP type" as the Cause value in the Create MBMS Context Response message.

q_18067.question: Which two IP-CAN types are applicable for the RAI change and user location change event triggers?

q_18068.question: What should the Node B do in FDD if the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message includes the MAC-es Guaranteed Bit Rate IE in the E-DCH Logical Channel Information IE in the E-DCH FDD Information IE?
q_18068.ground_truth: The Node B shall use this information to optimise MAC-e scheduling decisions for the related reordering queue.

q_18069.question: What is the purpose of critical extensions in an RRC PDU?
q_18069.ground_truth: Critical extensions in an RRC PDU are used to govern a new version of the PDU contents, which should be agreed upon between the encoder and the decoder of the PDU to prevent sending a critically extended version of the PDU type that is not comprehended by the decoder.

q_18070.question: Which component is responsible for delivering content to the BM-SC in the xMB reference point?
q_18070.ground_truth: The Content Provider delivers content to the BM-SC through the xMB reference point.

q_18071.question: How many priority levels does the system support for Group Communication?
q_18071.ground_truth: The system shall provide a mechanism to support at least n priority levels for Group Communication.

q_18072.question: What is the structure attribute value for the overall connection type in 6.3.7?
q_18072.ground_truth: The structure attribute values for the overall connection type in 6.3.7 are Unstructured or Service Data Unit Integrity.

q_18073.question: What are the tail bits in the described data transmission system?
q_18073.ground_truth: The tail bits are four 0-valued bits added to the information and parity bits, making the total number of bits 228.

q_18074.question: What is the role of the MT sub-function in the NWDAF?
q_18074.ground_truth: The MT (Model Training) sub-function of the NWDAF is responsible for training a model for analytics with the collected data. It may also include preprocessing of the collected data. MT can share trained models with other NWDAFs to enable and improve analytics.

q_18075.question: In the ECT supplementary service, what are the two states for the invocation of the ECT supplementary service?
q_18075.ground_truth: The two states for the invocation of the ECT supplementary service are: a) First Call (Active, Held), Second Call (Active, Idle); and b) First Call (Active, Held), Second Call (Call Delivered, Idle).

q_18076.question: How is the tonal stability calculated?
q_18076.ground_truth: The tonal stability is calculated in three stages, including searching for local minima of the spectrum, calculating a spectral floor, and creating a correlation map.

q_18077.question: What is the role of the Network Assistance Server (NAssS) in the FLUS Network Assistance workflow?
q_18077.ground_truth: The Network Assistance Server (NAssS) is responsible for realizing the Uplink Network Assistance (UNA) feature in FLUS, typically operated in the Operator Network Edge or in the Operator Network/Cloud. It is incorporated as a separate feature within the FLUS architecture, with a dedicated client function in the FLUS UE and a dedicated server function in the operator RAN or core network.

q_18078.question: What are the random offset values required to be applied to assistance data IEs for certain tests in TS 37.571-1 subclauses 6, 7, and 13?
q_18078.ground_truth: The random offsets that are required to be applied to certain assistance data IEs for certain tests in TS 37.571-1 subclauses 6, 7, and 13 include GNSS TOW, GNSS/cellular time offset, and GNSS TOD offset. These offsets shall have a uniform random distribution and are calculated by selecting the next random number from a standard uniform random number generator with the specified range and resolution.

q_18079.question: What is the purpose of the Data Link Connection Identification in the LLC sublayer?
q_18079.ground_truth: A logical link connection is identified by a DLCI consisting of two identifiers: a SAPI and a TLLI. The SAPI is used to identify the service access point on the SGSN side and the MS side of the LLC interface, while the TLLI is used to identify a specific MS.

q_18080.question: What is the effect of activating FANR for a downlink TBF?
q_18080.ground_truth: When FANR is activated for a downlink TBF, the mobile station is required to use the SSN-based encoding to encode the PAN field in the RLC data blocks and use the relevant RLC/MAC header form specified in sub-clause 10.3a.3.

q_18081.question: What is the effect of including the Guaranteed bitrate (kbps) as a Radio Access Bearer service attribute?
q_18081.ground_truth: RAB attributes, e.g. delay and reliability attributes, are guaranteed for traffic up to the Guaranteed bitrate. For the traffic exceeding the Guaranteed bitrate the RAB attributes are not guaranteed. It is also used for facilitating admission control based on available resources, and for resource allocation within RAN.

q_18082.question: In the context of TDD, what should the DRNC do if the indicated PDSCH RL ID is not in the DRNS and there was a DSCH-RNTI allocated to the UE Context?
q_18082.ground_truth: The DRNC should release the DSCH-RNTI allocated to the UE Context.

q_18083.question: How are ongoing sessions in multimedia telephony affected by optimizations?
q_18083.ground_truth: Media components can be added or dropped during an ongoing session in multimedia telephony, as required by the end-user or controlling nodes in the network, assuming the UE supports the additional component.

q_18084.question: What is the role of the ML Model Consumer NWDAF in the relationship between the ML Model Consumer NWDAF and ML Model Provider NWDAF?
q_18084.ground_truth: The ML Model Consumer NWDAF can further train or combine the ML model/model parameters obtained from the ML Model Provider NWDAF instances and become a ML Model Provider NWDAF by registration of the further trained/combined ML model in NRF.

q_18085.question: What is a "QoS rule" and what does it consist of?
q_18085.ground_truth: A "QoS rule" is a set of information enabling the detection of a service data flow and defining its associated QoS parameters.

q_18086.question: In which scenario is the GBA session initiated asynchronously by the user on the authenticating agent AA?
q_18086.ground_truth: The GBA session is initiated asynchronously by the user on the authenticating agent AA in the fourth scenario.

q_18087.question: In the "MBMS-RLC-Sequence-Number-Information-List" data type, what does the "MBMS-RLC-Sequence-Number-Information-List" data type include?
q_18087.ground_truth: The "MBMS-RLC-Sequence-Number-Information-List" data type in the context of the provided snippet includes a sequence of elements with two parameters, "mBMS-Bearer-Service-List-RLC" and "li."

q_18088.question: What should the UE do if the corresponding random-access procedure was performed on an SCell of MCG?
q_18088.ground_truth: The UE should set the spCellId to the global cell identity of the PCell if the corresponding random-access procedure was performed on an SCell of MCG.

q_18089.question: What is the effect of HUE transmit power on surrounding macro NodeBs operating on adjacent channels?
q_18089.ground_truth: The effect of HUE transmit power is not significant on surrounding macro NodeBs operating on adjacent channels, making HUE power adjustment an operator choice.

q_18090.question: What does the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP document indicate?
q_18090.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP document indicates the status of the document within the TSG.

q_18091.question: What does the IP-SM-GW do if the user is not authorized for service-level interworking in the service-level interworking process between an SMS user and a CPM capable UE?
q_18091.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW shall not forward the message, and shall return the appropriate error information to the UE in a failure report.

q_18092.question: What is the size of the "Barometric-Pressure" field?
q_18092.ground_truth: The "Barometric-Pressure" field is an integer with a range of 30000 to 115000.

q_18093.question: What is the purpose of the UE Identifier API provided by the Edge Enabler Server?
q_18093.ground_truth: The UE Identifier API is provided by the Edge Enabler Server to the Edge Application Server for providing valid UE identifier for the capability exposure API(s) over EDGE-3. This enables the Edge Application Server to point to a user anonymously over different service APIs exposed by the Edge Enabler Server. The UE Identifier API is used to determine the Edge UE ID based on the user information received from the Edge Application for capability exposure APIs.

q_18094.question: What message is sent from the SRNC to the DRNC to initiate the Secondary UL Frequency Reporting procedure?
q_18094.ground_truth: The SECONDARY UL FREQUENCY REPORT message

q_18095.question: What is the role of the hybrid QMF filterbank in the 3GPP system's general audio service using the aacPlus general audio codec?
q_18095.ground_truth: The hybrid QMF filterbank is used to analyze and synthesize audio signals, and is integrated into the Parametric Stereo system in the 3GPP system's general audio service using the aacPlus general audio codec.

q_18096.question: What does the Frame Offset indicate in the context of dedicated channel downlink transmission frames and broadcast channel frame offsets?
q_18096.ground_truth: The Frame Offset is the required offset between the dedicated channel downlink transmission frames and the broadcast channel frame offset, and is used in the translation between Connection Frame Number (CFN) on Iub/Iur and least significant 8 bits of SFN (System Frame Number) on Uu. The Frame Offset is UE and cell specific.

q_18097.question: What message is sent by the source RNC to the source SGSN to request security information for SRVCC operation?

q_18098.question: What should be the primary precoding vector applied to if the UE reports a preference for a single transport block and the highest CQI value?
q_18098.ground_truth: The preferred primary precoding vector should be applied to the primary transport block in this case.

q_18099.question: What is the procedure for mapping UE provided location information to a form that is understood by the 3GPP MBMS system, e.g. MBMS SAI(s) and/or ECGI(s)?
q_18099.ground_truth: The V2X Application Server shall provide the MBMS broadcast area parameters to BM-SC and BM-SC process the MBMS broadcast area parameters as defined in TS 23.468. Additionally, a UE may provide its geographic location information in the V2X message and Cell ID information in the signalling to the V2X Application Server. The V2X Application Server may use such information for determining the target MBMS broadcast area as defined in TS 23.468.

q_18100.question: What format is used for logical link supervisory control functions?

q_18101.question: In which time unit does the leftmost chip in the secondary synchronization code sequence correspond to the chip transmitted first in time?
q_18101.ground_truth: The leftmost chip in the secondary synchronization code sequence corresponds to the chip transmitted first in time in the order of chips.

q_18102.question: What is the action to be taken if the UE sends the first LPP PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION that contains GNSS Measurement Information or Location Information later than 240s after the start of the GNSS scenario for UE based testing?
q_18102.ground_truth: If the UE sends the first LPP PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION that contains GNSS Measurement Information or Location Information later than 240s after the start of the GNSS scenario, the UE should be failed and the test should be stopped early for UE based testing.

q_18103.question: What is the role of the User Equipment (UE) Test Loop functionality in E-UTRA/EPC conformance testing?
q_18103.ground_truth: The UE Test Loop functionality is a mandatory feature for E-UTRA/EPC conformance testing that directly impacts the design of the UE. It is used to define the location of the data loop in the protocol stack and the procedure and specific messages to activate/deactivate the Test Loop functionality in the UE, as specified in RF Conformance Test Specification TS 36.521-1, Protocol Conformance Test Specifications TS 36.523-1, and TS 36.523-3.

q_18104.question: Which information element defines a state or a sub-state of the group call protocol?

q_18105.question: What data does the MDAS producer collect per UE per day for paging optimization?
q_18105.ground_truth: The MDAS producer collects the following per UE per day data: UE location reports and UE paging data.

q_18106.question: What are the essential pre-conditions to transfer multimedia databases from ground to train?
q_18106.ground_truth: The train must have stopped at the station or depot, and the FRMCS User equipment responsible for the bandwidth allocation for the transfer of on-board multimedia database must be registered into the FRMCS System.

q_18107.question: What are the initial conditions for the HD-FDD intra-frequency RSTD Measurement Accuracy test in CE Mode A for Category M1?
q_18107.ground_truth: The initial conditions for this test are the same as in clause 9.3.7.1.4.1, but with changes specified in clause 9.3.8.1.4.1-1.

q_18108.question: Which are the two possible functionalities of a session border controller described in IETF RFC 5863 in the interoperability scenario?
q_18108.ground_truth: The two possible functionalities of a session border controller are interworking with existing solutions not based on IMS and being limited by SIP extensions that are supported across the interface.

q_18109.question: What is the meaning of the term "CA" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_18109.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, "CA" stands for Carrier Aggregation, which is a technology that allows a device to use multiple carriers to increase data transfer rates and/or improve coverage.

q_18110.question: What type of connection is used between the two asynchronous-synchronous conversion functions in the IWF and the remote terminal adapter for data transmission?
q_18110.ground_truth: A 64 kbit/s UDI or a 56 kbit/s RDI connection is used between the two asynchronous-synchronous conversion functions in the IWF and the remote terminal adapter for data transmission.

q_18111.question: What is one of the performance metrics used to quantify the variance of the noise field simulation systems in TS 103 224?
q_18111.ground_truth: RMSE is one of the performance metrics used to quantify the variance of the noise field simulation systems in TS 103 224.

q_18112.question: In which two sets are the inter-layer reference pictures included depending on their view ID values, when compared to the current picture?
q_18112.ground_truth: If the base view has a greater view ID than the current picture, then those with greater view IDs are included into RefPicSetInterLayer0 and those with smaller view IDs into RefPicSetInterLayer1, and vice versa.

q_18113.question: What is the meaning of MSD in section 7.167.5 regarding DC?
q_18113.ground_truth: No need for additional MSD analysis

q_18114.question: What is the message sent by the CN to each RNC that is connected to the CN when an MBMS session is started?
q_18114.ground_truth: The MBMS SESSION START REQUEST message, containing the MBMS Service Id, optionally the MBMS Session ID, MBMS Bearer Service Type and the MBMS Session Attributes.

q_18115.question: What is the purpose of the "Physical Layer Procedures in the TDD mode of UTRA" described in the document?
q_18115.ground_truth: The document outlines the physical layer procedures for the Time Division Duplex (TDD) mode of UTRA (Universal Terrestrial Radio Access).

q_18116.question: What is the length and type of the Starting Time information element?
q_18116.ground_truth: The Starting Time information element is a type 3 information element with 3 octets length.

q_18117.question: What is the procedure for MBMS notification using paging subchannel on CCCH?
q_18117.ground_truth: The paging procedure for MBMS notification on CCCH involves sending a PACKET PAGING REQUEST message including the MBMS notification for the session on one or more paging subchannels on CCCH.

q_18118.question: What is the PDU Session Release procedure with reactivation indication specified in clause 5.8.2.4?
q_18118.ground_truth: It is a P-CSCF Failure Detection mechanism that allows the SMF to detect P-CSCF failure, providing an exact network function to trigger the procedure depending on the P-CSCF restoration method used. When failure occurs, the SMF initiates PDU session release with reactivation indication for IMS PDU session. The UE then re-establishes the IMS PDU session.

q_18119.question: How many times and with what interval should the UTRAN repeat transmitting the RRC CONNECTION RELEASE message?
q_18119.ground_truth: The number of repeated messages and the interval between the messages is a network option.

q_18120.question: What is the ranking method used for NB-IoT inter-frequency cell reselection?
q_18120.ground_truth: For NB-IoT inter-frequency cell reselection, ranking is defined in sub-clause 5.2.4.6.

q_18121.question: What software was used to generate the H.264/AVC anchor bitstreams?
q_18121.ground_truth: AVC reference software implementing H.264 (AVC) High Profile called JM and its versions were used to generate the H.264/AVC anchor bitstreams.

q_18122.question: What is the main purpose of the message transferred from the CN to the GANC to indicate the completion of the bearer path?

q_18123.question: How is the ALDO window at 25.6 kHz related to the ALDO window at 48 kHz?
q_18123.ground_truth: The ALDO window at 25.6 kHz is defined as the ALDO window at 48 kHz, except for specific parameter values.

q_18124.question: What does the measurement "an number of RACH preambles received in a cell in one second" signify?
q_18124.ground_truth: This measurement indicates the total number of RACH preambles, which are used to initiate the random access procedure, received in a cell during one second. The measurement is divided into dedicated preambles, randomly chosen preambles in group A (low range), and randomly chosen preambles in group B (high range).

q_18125.question: What happens when a UE moves between 5GS and EPS during a PDU session handover?
q_18125.ground_truth: The regular 5GS-EPS handover applies, and the MBS data will be transported via PDN connection corresponding to the PDU session.

q_18126.question: What should a UE do if it is in a different RRC state, the optional validity time of dedicated priorities (T320) expires, or a PLMN selection is performed on request by NAS?
q_18126.ground_truth: The UE should delete priorities provided by dedicated signalling in these cases.

q_18127.question: What happens when a frame is within the transmit window but marked for retransmission?
q_18127.ground_truth: The originator has decided to retransmit that specific I frame.

q_18128.question: What kind of threats, generically described in TR 33.926, also apply to GVNP of type 1?
q_18128.ground_truth: The threats described in clauses 5.3.6, 5.3.8, and 5.3.10 of TR 33.926 also apply to GVNP of type 1.

q_18129.question: What is the metric used to evaluate the quality of H.265 (HEVC) within the test cases?
q_18129.ground_truth: Bjontegaard Delta Bitrate (BD rate) metric is used to evaluate the quality of H.265 (HEVC) within the test cases.

q_18130.question: What frequency bands does the network operate on, in addition to GSM 900?
q_18130.ground_truth: The network operates in the frequency bands 873-876 MHz in the UL and 918-921 MHz in the DL.

q_18131.question: What is the purpose of the 2G SIM access forbidden requirement in the document?
q_18131.ground_truth: The 2G SIM access forbidden requirement ensures that access to E-UTRAN with a 2G SIM or a SIM application on a UICC is not granted, thereby preventing unauthorized access to the network using older SIM cards.

q_18132.question: What should the NWDAF service consumer do when expecting real-time communication with NWDAF?
q_18132.ground_truth: During the NWDAF discovery procedure, the NWDAF service consumer indicates whether it expects real-time communication with NWDAF (i.e. the NWDAF needs to return network data analytics within its Supported Analytics Delay) for specific Analytics ID(s) in the service discovery request. The NRF will then select a candidate NWDAF list for the NWDAF service consumer based on this information.

q_18133.question: When is the UE not allowed to initiate the creation of a child security association pair in the DSMIPv6 tunnel?
q_18133.ground_truth: If the UE determines that the trust relationship of the non-3GPP access network is "untrusted", it shall not initiate the creation of a child security association.

q_18134.question: What is one of the conditions that indicate the termination of PC5 group communication?
q_18134.ground_truth: The group communication is over in the application layer. For example, an interactive game that UE-1, UE-2 and UE-3 play together ends.

q_18135.question: What is the purpose of the LLGMM-ASSIGN-USERPLANE primitive in the GPRS mobility management entity?
q_18135.ground_truth: The LLGMM-ASSIGN-USERPLANE primitive is used in the GPRS mobility management entity to request to start integrity protection of user plane data in the LLC layer in a network that supports integrity protection in the LLC layer.

q_18136.question: What is the purpose of the application selection mechanism in a multiapplication environment of 3GPP networks?
q_18136.ground_truth: The purpose of the application selection mechanism is to allow the user to select and activate one application amongst those which are available and supported by the ME. This will permit the user to choose, for instance, between different USIM applications.

q_18137.question: What data rate is indicated by bits 6-1 in octet 5 for transparent service?
q_18137.ground_truth: Bits 6-1 in octet 5 for transparent service indicate data rates of 101032,0 kbit/s, 100128,8 kbit/s, 100014,4 kbit/s, 00009,6 kbit/s, 00016,8 kbit/s, 00102,4 kbit/s, 01011 200/75 bit/s (1 200 network-to-MS / 75 MS-to-network), 000014,4 kbit/s, 000024,0 kbit/s.

q_18138.question: What are the operations that involve both the Infrastructure side and User Equipment side regarding General Control SAP?
q_18138.ground_truth: The operations include information broadcast, which consists of the broadcast from IF toward User Equipment of some information in a geographical area.

q_18139.question: What is the condition for the source NG-RAN node to forward multicast MBS session data via data forwarding tunnels to a target NG-RAN node that does not support MBS?
q_18139.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN node must support MBS, and the target NG-RAN node must not support MBS.

q_18140.question: Which message is used as a trigger for the measurement "MR.Rsrp.y" in the RSRP related measurements?
q_18140.ground_truth: The MeasurementReport message is used as a trigger for the measurement "MR.Rsrp.y" in the RSRP related measurements.

q_18141.question: What is the name of the operation that starts a session state machine and initializes temporary entities in the IRPAgent?

q_18142.question: What is the first phase of the Enhanced Serving RNS Relocation procedure?
q_18142.ground_truth: The Preparation Phase, where the Source RNC decides to relocate the UE to a neighboring RNC (Target RNC) and triggers the RNSAP: Enhanced Relocation procedure.

q_18143.question: What is the basic idea of NDS/IP architecture and what does it provide?
q_18143.ground_truth: The basic idea of NDS/IP architecture is to provide hop-by-hop security for chained-tunnels or hub-and-spoke models of operation. It makes it easy to operate separate security policies internally and towards other external security domains.

q_18144.question: What is the maximum length of the security information field in ETWS Primary Notification in E-UTRAN?
q_18144.ground_truth: The maximum length of the security information field in ETWS Primary Notification in E-UTRAN is 210 bytes.

q_18145.question: What happens if a user receives a CCNR recall while their queue is being processed as a terminating party?
q_18145.ground_truth: The CCNR recall takes priority over the handling of the queue.

q_18146.question: What is the role of the MME when the UE is using Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation and is in ECM-IDLE state?
q_18146.ground_truth: The MME performs a network triggered service request or Mobile Terminated Data Transport in Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation to establish a signalling connection with the UE.

q_18147.question: What should the AMF verify during the registration procedure over satellite access?
q_18147.ground_truth: The AMF should verify the UE location during registration procedure over satellite access, as it cannot be guaranteed that the UE would always be aware of its present location.

q_18148.question: What is the status code for the IMS Registration event in the "EVENT DOWNLOAD - IMS Registration 7.1.1" log?

q_18149.question: Which interface (6a.7.22) is used by the Interrogating-CSCF to forward SIP requests to an Application Server?
q_18149.ground_truth: The I-CSCF - AS interface (6a.7.22) is used to forward SIP requests destined to a Public Service Identity hosted by an Application Server directly to the Application Server.

q_18150.question: How should a Mobile Station (MS) handle Information Elements (IEs) that are unknown or not implemented in a message?
q_18150.ground_truth: If the MS receives a message type not defined for the protocol discriminator or not implemented by the receiver, it should send a RELEASE COMPLETE message with cause #97 "message type non-existent or not implemented".

q_18151.question: What is the role of an Element Manager (EM) as defined in 3GPP TS 32.661?
q_18151.ground_truth: An Element Manager (EM) provides a package of end-user functions for management of a set of closely related types of Network Elements (NEs). It supports both Element Management Functions for management of NEs on an individual basis and Sub-Network Management Functions for a set of NEs constituting a clearly defined sub-network.

q_18152.question: What message does the TRX return if it cannot activate a channel as requested by the CHANnel Activation message?
q_18152.ground_truth: The TRX returns a CHANnel ACTIVation Negative ACKnowledge message with the most appropriate cause value.

q_18153.question: What is the action required by the S-CSCF if the UE sends an unprotected REGISTER message and does not have an already active pair of security associations?
q_18153.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall authenticate the user by means of the AKA protocol.

q_18154.question: What are the requirements for user-user information element and more data information element in USER INFORMATION message?
q_18154.ground_truth: User-user information element is mandatory, and more data information element is optional in USER INFORMATION message.

q_18155.question: What is the role of TPC commands in the closed loop power control for uplink DPCH and PUSCH?
q_18155.ground_truth: TPC commands are used to instruct an increase or decrease in the level of transmission power from the UE in the closed loop power control for uplink DPCH and PUSCH. They can be sent in the TPC field of associated downlink CCTrCHs or on PLCCH.

q_18156.question: What does the abbreviation UTC stand for in the context of GPS-UTC-Model?

q_18157.question: What are the performance enhancements introduced in Rel-17 for BH transport and scheduling?
q_18157.ground_truth: The performance enhancements introduced in Rel-17 for BH transport and scheduling include the extension of LCG space for 256 instead of 8 LCGs, the ability to apply DL local re-routing for congestion mitigation, and the ability to report congestion with child BH RLC channel granularity to the IAB-donor-CU-CP.

q_18158.question: What is the requirement for the UE while T330 is running and SDT procedure is not ongoing, if measurement logging is suspended and IDC problems have been resolved during the last logging interval?
q_18158.ground_truth: The UE shall resume measurement logging.

q_18159.question: What should the DRNS setup if the C-ID IE is included in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Setup IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE?
q_18159.ground_truth: The DRNS shall setup the Additional E-DCH on the secondary uplink frequency and setup the requested Additional E-DCH resources on the Radio Links and in the cells indicated by the E-DCH Additional RL ID IE and the C-ID IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Setup IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE.

q_18160.question: Who can use the Multimedia Priority Service and in what situations is it intended to be used?
q_18160.ground_truth: The Multimedia Priority Service is intended to be used by qualified and authorized users, such as emergency service personnel, during times of emergency situations and network congestion.

q_18161.question: What information does the BSS include in a "BSSMAP-LE Connection Oriented Information" message to the SMLC if an MTA reporting anomaly is detected?
q_18161.ground_truth: If an MTA reporting anomaly is detected, the BSS includes the "MTA Report Instance" and "Final MTA Report Indicator" fields in a "BSSMAP-LE Connection Oriented Information" message to the SMLC, indicating the anomaly.

q_18162.question: What are the two options for obtaining dual stack connectivity for IPv4 and IPv6 services/peers?
q_18162.ground_truth: The two options are obtaining a dual stack connection by requesting a PDP Type IPv4v6 or PDN Type IPv4v6, or requesting two separate connections for IPv4 and IPv6 in parallel to the same dual-stack APN.

q_18163.question: In Indoor Scenario A, under which traffic conditions and ED threshold did TxED-Dir LBT provide consistently better performances than TxED-Omni?
q_18163.ground_truth: TxED-Dir LBT provided consistently better performances than TxED-Omni for DL traffic, regardless of loading levels.

q_18164.question: What should a URCMP entity do when it receives a URCMP message with an unknown Message Type value?
q_18164.ground_truth: A URCMP entity shall silently discard the message when receiving a message with an unknown Message Type value.

q_18165.question: What does the procedure in Clause 7.6.3 involve in terms of spatial consistency?
q_18165.ground_truth: In Clause 7.6.3, the procedure involves enforcing spatial consistency by modeling the correlation distances in the two dimensional horizontal plane through the exponential function.

q_18166.question: How is the BLER at a particular reported CQI obtained, as specified in 9.3.2.2.1 and 9.3.3.2.1?
q_18166.ground_truth: The BLER at a particular reported CQI is obtained by associating a particular CQI reference measurement period with the HS-PDSCH subframe overlapping with the end of this CQI reference measurement period and calculating the fraction of erroneous HS-PDSCH subframes.

q_18167.question: What is the 3GPP and what is the purpose of the "3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects; Source code for 3GP file format (Release 17)" document?
q_18167.ground_truth: The 3GPP is an organization that develops technical specifications for 3G and 4G mobile telecommunications. The purpose of the document is to serve as a "cover note" for the source code of the 3GPP file format, providing information on obtaining the reference software for the 3GPP File Format.

q_18168.question: Under what conditions will the UE perform measurements of higher priority NR inter-frequency or inter-RAT frequencies?
q_18168.ground_truth: The UE will perform measurements of higher priority NR inter-frequency or inter-RAT frequencies if the reselection priority of the current NR frequency is lower than that of the inter-frequency or inter-RAT frequency.

q_18169.question: What should the LCS client use to identify a target UE for value added services?
q_18169.ground_truth: The LCS client can identify a target UE for value added services using the MSISDN or SIP URL, or by IP addressing.

q_18170.question: What is the "NoMultipleResources" result code used for in a message response?
q_18170.ground_truth: The "NoMultipleResources" result code is returned if a single Query element contains several Query Items, but the receiver implementation supports only one.

q_18171.question: What information does the AF include in the AF request for edge application relocation when triggered by the EAS?
q_18171.ground_truth: The AF request for edge application relocation includes the information of the target application server, which may be the information on the target application server for the application (e.g. the IP address of the target application server) or the indication for application server relocation (e.g. a trigger for UE re-initiating DNS Query for the application), corresponding DNAI, and the FQDN of the target application server.

q_18172.question: What is the message contents for the TDD intra-frequency RSTD Measurement Accuracy in CE Mode A for Category M1?
q_18172.ground_truth: The message contents for this test are the same as in clause 9.3.7.1.4.3.

q_18173.question: What is the function of the Sharing-Key-UL AVP and/or Sharing-Key-DL AVP in resource sharing between QoS rules?
q_18173.ground_truth: The Sharing-Key-UL AVP and/or Sharing-Key-DL AVP are used to indicate that the related QoS rule may share resources with other QoS rules bound to the same bearer. The BBERF applies resource sharing if at least two QoS rules bound to the same bearer share the same value in the Sharing-Key-UL AVP and/or Sharing-Key-DL AVP.

q_18174.question: What is Authorization Security Service in IRP scenario?
q_18174.ground_truth: Authorization Security Service is a security service that controls access to resources based on an enforced access control policy.

q_18175.question: What does the TFCI Coding describe in the manner of coding TFCI bits?
q_18175.ground_truth: The TFCI Coding describes the way how the TFCI bits are coded. By default, 1 TFCI bit is coded with 4 bits, 2 TFCI bits are coded with 8 bits, 3-5 TFCI bits are coded with 16 bits and 6-10 TFCI bits are coded with 32 bits.

q_18176.question: What is the state of CT106, 107 and 109 after the expiration of the timer T of each allocated traffic channel for the call at the MT/DTE interface during the synchronization process in the V-series interface?
q_18176.ground_truth: CT106, CT107 and CT109 are changed from OFF to ON, CT103 is mapped to the data bits sent towards the IWF, and the transmitted SB, SA and X bits shall be set to "ON".

q_18177.question: What is the measurement system description for the Plane Wave Synthesizer in 9.9.5.1?
q_18177.ground_truth: The measurement system description for the Plane Wave Synthesizer is captured in clause 7.6.1.

q_18178.question: What is the SCCP Class used by the Mobile Application Part within the 3GPP system?
q_18178.ground_truth: The Mobile Application Part makes use of only the connectionless classes (0 or 1) of the SCCP (Signalling Connection Control Part) of signalling System No. 7.

q_18179.question: What is the recommended approach for supporting data and fax calls in the A interface over IP?
q_18179.ground_truth: The recommended approaches for supporting data and fax calls in the A interface over IP are to leave rate adaptation functionality in BSS and transfer 64 kbps over the A-interface using clearchannel, or to move rate adaptation functionality to the core network and use new RTP profiles for lower bit rates.

q_18180.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of outgoing handover related events that fail related with MRO?
q_18180.ground_truth: 4.3.1.3.3 Number of handover failures related with MRO

q_18181.question: What should be done to the traffic flow template when setting up an EPS bearer context?
q_18181.ground_truth: The traffic flow template should be set to the mapped traffic flow template of the EPS bearer received in the mapped EPS bearer context, or the stored traffic flow template associated with the QoS flow, if available.

q_18182.question: What is the force application range and accuracy requirement for the precision force-inducing contacting device?
q_18182.ground_truth: The precision force-inducing contacting device shall be able to apply a prescribed and maintained level of force onto one or more contacts of the UICC in the range of 0 to 0,5 N and accurate to 0,01 N.

q_18183.question: What is one of the conclusions agreed on regarding the realization of multicast ABR on top of the generic 5MBS architecture?
q_18183.ground_truth: The potential solution for Scenario #1 documents how the multicast ABR feature could be directly integrated into a 5MBS System.

q_18184.question: What is the default information transfer rate, if not specified in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_18184.ground_truth: The default information transfer rate is 64 kbit/s.

q_18185.question: What is the purpose of the reserved MAC-e SI for indicating a transition in L2 signalling?
q_18185.ground_truth: The reserved MAC-e SI for indicating a transition has its own HARQ profile with an additional power offset to ensure reliable detection by all NodeBs in the active set within reasonable latency.

q_18186.question: What are the two delivery modes for 5G multicast-broadcast services specified in the Rel-17 NR MBS WI?
q_18186.ground_truth: The two delivery modes are MBS multicast and MBS broadcast.

q_18187.question: What should the VLR do if timer T6-2 expires and no BSSAP+-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message is received?
q_18187.ground_truth: The VLR will consider the old TMSI if available, as deleted and still perform the TMSI reallocation procedure via the A or Iu-CS interface. The VLR may use either the IMSI or the new TMSI or, if available, the old TMSI for paging.

q_18188.question: When can the mobile station resume to DRX mode after receiving an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message?
q_18188.ground_truth: The mobile station may resume to DRX mode two multiframe periods following the first IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message.

q_18189.question: What is the procedure when an APM message is received from the BICC side relating to the BICC APM user in the SIP-I based circuit-switched core network?
q_18189.ground_truth: The APM message should not be encapsulated in any triggered SIP message.

q_18190.question: What is a "tra-contact" session level SDP attribute used for in the context of a received SDP offer?
q_18190.ground_truth: A "tra-contact" session level SDP attribute is used to encapsulate a "contact-line" in the received SDP offer.

q_18191.question: What does IRP stand for in the context of 3GPP TS 28.651?
q_18191.ground_truth: IRP stands for Integration Reference Point.

q_18192.question: What does the Power Level field in octet 2 of the CHANNEL ACTIVATION message indicate?
q_18192.ground_truth: The Power Level field in octet 2 of the CHANNEL ACTIVATION message indicates the number of 2 dB steps by which the power shall be reduced from its nominal value, Pn, set by the network operator to adjust the coverage.

q_18193.question: What should the target UE do if there is a pending PC5 signaling message or PC5 user plane data when it receives a DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE REQUEST message?
q_18193.ground_truth: The target UE should pass the PC5 signaling message to the lower layers for transmission along with the target UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication and the initiating UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication, or perform the data transmission over the PC5 unicast link as specified in clause~6.1.2.9.

q_18194.question: What is the format of an XML document as defined in the 3GPP Technical Specification for Trace Management?
q_18194.ground_truth: An XML document, as defined in the 3GPP Technical Specification for Trace Management, is composed of an optional XML declaration followed by a root XML element, which may contain other XML elements with start-tags, end-tags, or empty-element tags.

q_18195.question: What mechanism is used to ensure a smooth transition between the CELP and MDCT signals at the output sampling rate in a specific scenario?
q_18195.ground_truth: A smoothing mechanism is applied, which involves generating a zero-input-response (ZIR) of the LPC synthesis filter and adding it to the beginning portion of the decoded MDCT signal at the output sampling rate.

q_18196.question: What is the purpose of the User Data Repository Access Protocol over the Ud interface?
q_18196.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify the stage 3 of the Ud interface between the Front-Ends (FEs) and the User Data Repository (UDR) in the User Data Convergence (UDC architecture).

q_18197.question: What would the H-GMLC do if the location service request is to be barred as a result of the privacy check?
q_18197.ground_truth: If the location service request is to be barred after the privacy check, the H-GMLC would terminate the request towards the R-GMLC or the LCS client with the appropriate error code.

q_18198.question: Who can establish data communication in real-time with User B in FRMCS?
q_18198.ground_truth: In FRMCS, User A, who is an authorized FRMCS User (e.g., administrator with authorization to the data), can establish data communication in real-time with User B (e.g., intelligent on-train systems) without any intermediary party, while User C (e.g., user without authorization to the data) cannot.

q_18199.question: What is the term used in the 3GPP specification to define the minimum coupling loss between the base station and user equipment for Wide Area Base Stations?
q_18199.ground_truth: The minimum coupling loss between the base station and user equipment for Wide Area Base Stations is 70 dB.

q_18200.question: What action should the USS take when it receives a URL request that does not match the Default URL or the URL provided in the proactive command during the execution of "LAUNCH BROWSER" command?
q_18200.ground_truth: The USS should respond with an HTTP status error code (4xx "Client Error" or 5xx "Server Error") and ignore the URL request regarding the test case verdict generation.

q_18201.question: Who is responsible for allocating the tunnel identifier for the downlink in the carrier network (CN)?
q_18201.ground_truth: The UTRAN (UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network) is responsible for allocating the tunnel identifier for the downlink in the CN.

q_18202.question: What is the minimum delay for redundancy level 1?
q_18202.ground_truth: The delay is at its minimum for redundancy level 1.

q_18203.question: What is the order in which the UE includes measurement quantities in measResultListNR of measResultNeighCells, in case both SS/PBCH block measurements and CSI-RS based measurements are available?
q_18203.ground_truth: The UE includes CSI-RS based measurement quantities first, listed such that the cell with highest CSI-RS RSRP is listed first if CSI-RS RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise the cell with highest CSI-RS RSRQ is listed first if CSI-RS RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise the cell with highest CSI-RS SINR is listed first.

q_18204.question: What is the role of the HSS in handling a concatenated Short Message that exceeds the maximum payload size of an Instant Message?
q_18204.ground_truth: The HSS retrieves routeing information and returns the address of the IP-SM-GW or the address(es) of the current MSC, SGSN, MME and/or SMSF for subsequent message delivery.

q_18205.question: What should the BSS do if it receives a DL-UNITDATA message containing the Old Routing Area Identification but cannot identify a CN operator in the shared network?
q_18205.ground_truth: The BSS should initiate the MS Registration Enquiry procedure in the CS domain to determine the CN operator that the MS is registered with.

q_18206.question: What is the channel bandwidth to be tested for 10.1B.4.1?
q_18206.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth to be tested for 10.1B.4.1 is 5 MHz.

q_18207.question: What should the SS PER decoder accept in the UL direction when distinguishing the extension and padding parts is not required?
q_18207.ground_truth: The SS PER decoder should match and accept RRC PDUs with any bit string in the extension and padding parts, and discard the remaining part of the received bit string regardless of the RLC mode.

q_18208.question: What is the behavior of the UE when the loopback buffer capacity is exceeded in UE test loop mode A or B?
q_18208.ground_truth: The behavior of the UE when the loopback buffer capacity is exceeded in UE test loop mode A or B is unspecified.

q_18209.question: In the context of 3GPP System Architecture Evolution Security Architecture, what is forward security in the context of KeNB key derivation?
q_18209.ground_truth: In the context of KeNB key derivation, forward security refers to the property that, for an eNB with knowledge of a KeNB, shared with a UE, it shall be computationally infeasible to predict any future KeNB, that will be used between the same UE and another eNB.

q_18210.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in 3GPP technical specifications and reports?
q_18210.ground_truth: "Shall" in 3GPP technical specifications and reports indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

q_18211.question: What RDF schema is used for the PSS device capability profile structure?
q_18211.ground_truth: The PSS device capability profile structure follows the RDF schema of the CC/PP framework and UAProf.

q_18212.question: What is the maximum allowed intermodulation component level in dBm for all intermodulation products in the relevant TX band, for multicarrier BTS in the case where the RF transmit equipment is operating with one carrier?
q_18212.ground_truth: The intermodulation products shall never exceed -16 dBm, measured in a 100 kHz bandwidth.

q_18213.question: What is the Uplink Information Exchange Request sequence used for?
q_18213.ground_truth: The Uplink Information Exchange Request sequence is used in 3GPP network protocols to request the transfer of specific information from a remote network.

q_18214.question: What is the functional area that allows the operator to detect the occurrence of faults in the network in real-time?

q_18215.question: What must the HSS/HLR send to the VLR/SGSN/MME when the provisioning state for the outgoing calls barring program is "Provisioned"?
q_18215.ground_truth: The HSS/HLR shall send the VLR/SGSN/MME information about the logical state of the program for all relevant elementary basic service groups.

q_18216.question: What is the first method described for preserving the user plane state when a user equipment (UE) relocates, called the "application domain aware procedure"?
q_18216.ground_truth: In this method, the edge application server (EAS) in the current location sends a URL for a local anycast address that primarily selects the same server instance, even when a new location is chosen for the UE. This is done to ensure that the flow state is persisted in the same server instance during any relocation procedures.

q_18217.question: In TDD, when the Dedicated Measurement Type IE is set to "HS-SICH reception quality", what type of measurements should be initiated by the DRNS?
q_18217.ground_truth: The DRNS shall initiate measurements of the failed, missed and total HS-SICH transmissions on all HS-SICH assigned to the UE Context.

q_18218.question: What is a potential solution to interoperability issues caused by multiple options co-existence?
q_18218.ground_truth: Recommending or mandating the support of certain core features for NFs complying with 3GPP Release 17.

q_18219.question: What is the purpose of the cross-polarization measurement in the channel model validation process?
q_18219.ground_truth: The cross-polarization measurement verifies the correct power ratio of the different polarizations in the channel model.

q_18220.question: What is the 3GPP organization responsible for in the context of mobile telecommunications?
q_18220.ground_truth: The 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project) is a collaboration between multiple telecommunications standard development organizations, responsible for producing technical specifications for mobile communications systems, including E-UTRA (Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access) and the Packet Data Convergence Protocol (PDCP).

q_18221.question: What is the purpose of the Iupc interface in the UTRAN architecture?
q_18221.ground_truth: The Iupc interface in the UTRAN architecture connects the RNC to a supported Positioning NodeB (SAS) to provide full internal support for the user equipment (UE) positioning method.

q_18222.question: What modifications are made to the coding schemes in section 11.7?
q_18222.ground_truth: The coding schemes of RLC data are modified by aggregating two uplink allocated timeslots of RTTI TBF and bearing the short bitmap, thus the RLC data payload and its coding scheme can be maintained as before.

q_18223.question: What is the role of the 'layer' value in visually composed tracks including video and text?
q_18223.ground_truth: The 'layer' value is used for layering visually composed tracks, comparing to z-index in SMIL. More negative layer values are towards the viewer.

q_18224.question: What is the difference between direct and indirect interaction between the Application Function (AF) and the PCRF/PCF for QoS support in the 3GPP QoS framework?
q_18224.ground_truth: Direct interaction involves the AF directly communicating with the PCRF/PCF for QoS support, while indirect interaction involves the AF communicating with the PCRF/PCF through a mediation function, such as the SCEF in EPS or the NEF in 5GS.

q_18225.question: What is the CAMEL Prepaid Warning Tone signal used for?
q_18225.ground_truth: The CAMEL Prepaid Warning Tone signal is used to generate a CAMEL prepaid warning tone to inform the party that the Max Call Period Duration is about to expire.

q_18226.question: What occurs if the T-NG-RAN supports 5MBS services and the UE is receiving 5MBS Shared Delivery in the S-NG-RAN?
q_18226.ground_truth: The T-AMF may decide to switch to 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery for an MB Session based on local policies and potential presence of a DisableIndividualDelivery indicator.

q_18227.question: What is the purpose of the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message in the context of reporting errors?
q_18227.ground_truth: When the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message is used to report an error, only one cause value for all reported objects can be sent in one message.

q_18228.question: What does the HS-DSCH FDD Information response IE provide?
q_18228.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH FDD Information Response IE provides information for HS-DSCH MAC-d flows that have been established or modified, and additional HS-DSCH information determined within the DRNS.

q_18229.question: What is the behavior of the gsmSCF if it returns a Continue information flow for an MO, MF, or TO call?
q_18229.ground_truth: If the gsmSCF returns a Continue information flow, the call shall continue with the original CUG information unchanged.

q_18230.question: What kind of data does the MDAS producer require to generate the traffic analytics report?
q_18230.ground_truth: The MDAS producer requires performance measurements, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and data defined in specific technical standards such as TS 28.552, TS 28.554, TS 37.320, and TS 32.422.

q_18231.question: What is the role of the PoC AS (A) in the pre-established session with automatic answer?
q_18231.ground_truth: The PoC AS (A) establishes the pre-established session for PoC communication and routes the session establishment request to the PoC AS (A). It also sends an INVITE request to PoC AS (B) and acknowledges the media establishment request message, sending a talk burst confirm to UE-A.

q_18232.question: What is the role of timing advance in the uplink in a wireless communication system?
q_18232.ground_truth: Timing advance is used in uplink to align the uplink radio signals from the user equipment (UE) to the UTRAN both in case of uplink Dedicated Physical Channels (DPCH), E-PUCH, E-RUCCH and of Physical Uplink Shared Channels (PUSCH). The handling of timing advance can be divided into four main categories: measurement, initial assignment, updates during operation, and setting on handover.

q_18233.question: How does the SGSN indicate support for MS Info Change Reporting?
q_18233.ground_truth: The SGSN indicates support for MS Info Change Reporting by including the MS Info Change Reporting Action IE in the message and setting the value of the Action field appropriately.

q_18234.question: Which circuit numbers are used in the transparent mode for mapping DTE/DCE signalling information to Dm channel and in-band signalling information?
q_18234.ground_truth: The circuit numbers used are those specified in V.24 for mapping DTE/DCE signalling information to Dm channel and in-band signalling information in the transparent mode.

q_18235.question: What is the requirement for decoder conformance testing?
q_18235.ground_truth: The decoder conformance testing is carried out using "black-box" tests, where the decoder's output is compared to the reference decoder's output for specific input test vectors, various codec operation modes, and bit rates.

q_18236.question: What is the impact of the Delivery order (y/n) attribute in the Radio Access Bearer service?
q_18236.ground_truth: It specifies whether the UMTS bearer shall provide in-sequence SDU delivery or not. This information cannot be extracted from the traffic class. Whether out-of-sequence SDUs are dropped or re-ordered depends on the specified reliability.

q_18237.question: What action must an MS take when no BSIC can be decoded on a surrounding cell BCCH carrier or the BSIC is not allowed?
q_18237.ground_truth: The MS shall discard the received signal level measurements on that channel and continue to monitor that channel.

q_18238.question: What is the condition for the UE to deliver the reassembled SDU to upper layers when the RLC entity receives an UMD PDU?
q_18238.ground_truth: The UE delivers the reassembled SDU to upper layers when all byte segments with a specific SN are received and placed into the reception buffer.

q_18239.question: How many cells are not simulated (dummy cells) in the assistance data neighbor cell list?

q_18240.question: What is used as the HARQ process identifier for UL transmission with an UL grant in RA Response or for UL transmission for MSG payload?

q_18241.question: For which scenarios is no characterization possible in the process of comparing a codec against H.265/HEVC SCC (Screen-Extended Main 10 profile)?
q_18241.ground_truth: Scenario 1 and scenario 4 have no characterization possible.

q_18242.question: When must the UE return the OTDOA measures to the SRNC?
q_18242.ground_truth: The UE returns the OTDOA measures to the SRNC after the SRNC requests measurement of the OTDOA for the signals in the active and neighborhood sets in step 4.

q_18243.question: What does the solution 12 focus on, based on the 3GPP specification?
q_18243.ground_truth: Solution 12 presents a new SBA service to optimize Cx operations between IMS and CSCF, in order to avoid the issues associated with using existing Release 15 UDM services for the same purpose.

q_18244.question: What should the UE do if the last established PDU session is an emergency PDU session and the UDM has not requested an acknowledgment from the UE?
q_18244.ground_truth: The UE shall attempt to perform the PLMN selection after the release of the emergency PDU session and expiration of timer T.

q_18245.question: What is the purpose of defining several permutations for each given MAIOA size?
q_18245.ground_truth: It requires another parameter, a MAIO permutation number (MAIOPN), to be signaled to the mobile station to select the specific permutation to use.

q_18246.question: What parameter does the postAsBERTLV method take in addition to statusType?

q_18247.question: What is the role of the AF in determining port pairs for DS-TT ports?
q_18247.ground_truth: The AF determines port pairs for DS-TT ports based on the DS-TT information of the DS-TT ports and calculates the bridge delay for the port pair.

q_18248.question: In the context of the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message, what should the Node B include in the Additional E-DCH Cell Information Response RL Add IE if it supports activation of power balancing for the Additional E-DCH RL by the message and the power balancing is active for the Additional E-DCH RL?
q_18248.ground_truth: The Node B should include the DL Power Balancing Activation Indicator IE.

q_18249.question: Which H.248 command causes the count to increase for the "Number of seizure attempts for MFH" measurement?
q_18249.ground_truth: The H.248 commands "Add Request" or "Modify Request" trigger an increase in the count for the "Number of seizure attempts for MFH" measurement.

q_18250.question: What happens when T1 expires?
q_18250.ground_truth: When T1 expires, either a disconnect demand is sent, or there is no user responding.

q_18251.question: What is HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-Response used for?
q_18251.ground_truth: HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-Response is used to convey information to the secondary UE related to the Uplink Secondary Serving Resources

q_18252.question: What action does a UE need to take if the de-registration type is "re-registration not required" and the 5GMM cause is "Illegal UE"?
q_18252.ground_truth: The UE may enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH for PLMN selection.

q_18253.question: What is the potential security issue if an attacker injects a fake BAP Control PDU to the parent IAB-node or to the IAB-donor?
q_18253.ground_truth: It can lead to QoE degradation of the UE served by the victim IAB-node and may result in unnecessary link release and re-establishment.

q_18254.question: Which network type does the MCVideo service primarily focus on, but not limited to?
q_18254.ground_truth: The MCVideo service primarily focuses on transport over commercial and dedicated 3GPP networks, although it may be used in other networks.

q_18255.question: What action is taken by the IBCF-hA1 when receiving a 183 (Session Progress) response?
q_18255.ground_truth: The IBCF-hA1 releases resources reserved in the media gateway and keeps the content of the SDP unchanged.

q_18256.question: In what scenarios will the PCEF initiate an IP-CAN session termination procedure?
q_18256.ground_truth: If there is no PCC rule active for a successfully established IP-CAN session at any later point in time, the PCEF shall initiate an IP-CAN session termination procedure.

q_18257.question: What is the difference between a 2G ME and a 2G/3G dual mode ME?
q_18257.ground_truth: A 3G ME is a single mode ME that only supports a 3G radio access network, while a 2G/3G dual mode ME supports both a 2G and a 3G radio access network.

q_18258.question: What action does the SCF take if the parent has the rights to perform Parental Control on the child when the SCF receives a SIP MESSAGE for Parental Control?
q_18258.ground_truth: The SCF updates the child's profile with adding a forbidden program, and initiates the PSS streaming teardown procedure or MBMS streaming teardown procedure.

q_18259.question: What are the different coverage scenarios that the coverage mechanisms should effectively cope with?
q_18259.ground_truth: The different coverage scenarios include limited coverage in a 'sea' of coverage provided by another radio system or radio access mode, selective operation at a geographical boundary with extensive UTRAN coverage on one side and extensive coverage from another radio system on the other side, and geographically co-located areas of UTRAN coverage and another radio system.

q_18260.question: What should the mobile station do when it detects a radio link failure as specified in 3GPP TS 45.008?
q_18260.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform a local end release on all signalling links, deactivate all dedicated channels, abort the packet resources if it is in dual transfer mode, and indicate an RR connection failure to the MM sublayer.

q_18261.question: What protocol specifications is the Communication Continuity Management Object compatible with?
q_18261.ground_truth: The OMA Device Management protocol specifications, version 1.2 and upwards

q_18262.question: How is the band used defined when a frequency band change is commanded via an immediate assignment message?
q_18262.ground_truth: The band used is understood as the band used for the channel request message or one of the bands indicated by the immediate assignment message.

q_18263.question: What happens to the UAV's registration in the 3GPP system if the UUAA fails?
q_18263.ground_truth: If the UUAA fails and the network keeps the UAV registered, the network should not allow the UAV to establish connectivity for any DNN/APN associated with UAVs services. If the 3GPP CN is to deregister the UAV, the reason for de-registering the UAV is made known to the UAV.

q_18264.question: What shall the DRNC include in the UPLINK SIGNALLING TRANSFER INDICATION message if the cell is multicell adjacent and/or non-adjacent carrier operation capable and if the cell can be the serving HS-DSCH?
q_18264.ground_truth: The Secondary Serving Cell List IE, and if supported, the Multicell E-DCH Restriction IE set to "TRUE" for each cell in the Secondary Serving Cell List IE that is Multi Cell E-DCH capable and restricted for use as an Additional E-DCH on the secondary uplink frequency with the accessed cell as the corresponding cell of the primary uplink frequency.
