q_18265.question: What should the ME do with the GPRS Kc received from the USIM during the authentication procedure if the USIM computes it from CK and IK using conversion function c3?
q_18265.ground_truth: The ME shall ignore the GPRS Kc and not store it on USIM or in ME.

q_18266.question: What does the FLUS Sink do after receiving the data?
q_18266.ground_truth: The FLUS Sink forwards the received data to the post-processing unit for storage or further processing.

q_18267.question: When is the REPORT record triggered for a target ProSe Remote UE in ProSe UE-to-NW Relay?
q_18267.ground_truth: The REPORT record is triggered when the target ProSe Remote UE connects to or disconnects from a ProSe UE-to-NW Relay in ProSe remote UE communications.

q_18268.question: How many types of Common Pilot Channels are there in a UMTS network?
q_18268.ground_truth: There are two types of Common Pilot Channels in a UMTS network, the Primary and Secondary CPICH.

q_18269.question: What is the difference between a Type A LMU and a Type B LMU in the context of GERAN Network Location Procedures?
q_18269.ground_truth: A Type A LMU operates in A/Gb Mode CS Domain and can support positioning of mobile stations in Iu Mode, while a Type B LMU operates independently of the mode of the MS and can also support positioning of mobile stations in Iu Mode.

q_18270.question: What is the RF responsible for in the SCUR (Session Charging with Unit Reservation) scenario?
q_18270.ground_truth: The RF is responsible for retrieving the appropriate tariff, reserving counter values, and performing final rating for the consumed resources in the SCUR scenario.

q_18271.question: What information does the old SGSN extract upon receiving the Forward Relocation Request message?
q_18271.ground_truth: The old SGSN extracts the NSAPIs, SAPIs, and PFIs from the PDP Contexts contained in the Forward Relocation Request message.

q_18272.question: In what circumstance can the multi-access PDN connection be removed?
q_18272.ground_truth: The multi-access PDN connection can be removed when the multi-access PDN connection via 3GPP access network is removed and the multi-access PDN connection via WLAN access network is maintained or the multi-access PDN connection via WLAN access network is removed and the multi-access PDN connection via 3GPP access network is maintained.

q_18273.question: What is the message type for the paging request in mobility management?
q_18273.ground_truth: The message type for the paging request in mobility management is CTS PAGING REQUEST.

q_18274.question: What is the expected result for the SEND USSD procedure to be considered successful?
q_18274.ground_truth: The ME shall operate in the manner defined in expected sequence 4.10 (or 5.1, or 6.1 depending on the question)

q_18275.question: When should the target BSS initiate the PS Handover Complete procedure?
q_18275.ground_truth: The target BSS should initiate the PS Handover Complete procedure on reception of the first correct RLC data block (sent in normal burst format) from the MS in the target cell in the case of PS Handover or on receipt of an RR HANDOVER COMPLETE message on the main DCCH in the target cell in the case of DTM Handover.

q_18276.question: When does the V-AMF consider an S-NSSAI as an Allowed S-NSSAI?
q_18276.ground_truth: The V-AMF considers the S-NSSAI as an Allowed S-NSSAI, if the requested S-NSSAI is subject to network slice quota checking and the network slice quota has not been reached yet. Additionally, if no S-NSSAI can be provided in the Allowed NSSAI, then the AMF provides an empty Allowed NSSAI.

q_18277.question: What are the main uses of the broadcast connection in the HbbTV context?
q_18277.ground_truth: The main uses of the broadcast connection in HbbTV are the transmission of broadcast TV, radio and data services, signaling of broadcast-related applications, transport of broadcast-related applications and associated data, and synchronization of applications and TV/radio/data services.

q_18278.question: Which 3GPP Technical Specifications were updated in Release 11 regarding acoustic requirements and test specifications?
q_18278.ground_truth: TS 26.131 and TS 26.132 were updated in Release 11 to accommodate many advances in acoustic requirements and test specifications.

q_18279.question: What information does the UPF send to the SMF for the MA PDU session if non-transparent MP-QUIC functionality is applied in the UPF?
q_18279.ground_truth: The UPF sends MP-QUIC functionality information including the MP-QUIC functionality IP address and UDP port number, uniflow ID with corresponding access type and the MP-QUIC connection ID, to the SMF.

q_18280.question: What must the UE do when it is registered, in PDU SESSION ACTIVE state, and in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, and the PS Data Off status is changed to "active"?
q_18280.ground_truth: The UE must perform a PDU session modification procedure, providing the PS Data Off status set to "active".

q_18281.question: What should the S-CSCF do when the SCC AS invokes it as part of originating or terminating iFC execution?
q_18281.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should establish or terminate a Remote Leg toward the remote end for an originating or terminating IMS session, and coordinate the signalling exchange between the Access Leg and the Remote Leg associated with the anchored IMS session.

q_18282.question: What should the SCC AS include in the SIP INVITE request if multiple contacts are registered in the PS domain and it decides to establish all media types over the same IP-CAN?
q_18282.ground_truth: The SCC AS should include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.accesstype media feature tag value associated with the selected PS domain IP-CAN.

q_18283.question: What information does the new MSC/VLR include in the MAP Update Location message if the MTRF Supported flag is present?
q_18283.ground_truth: The new MSC/VLR includes the new LMSI in the MAP Update Location message if the MTRF Supported flag is present, which allows the VLR to set up the Mobile Terminating Roaming Forwarding call during the mobile terminated CS service delivery via an alternative MME in MME pool procedure when the new SGs association is established towards a new VLR.

q_18284.question: Which IE is mandatory in DL-PowerTimeslotControlRequest if Mcps is 7.68?

q_18285.question: Which content leads to the lowest quality scores for both HMD1 and HMD2?

q_18286.question: What is a pre-determined method for invoking the MPS for MMTEL voice from a public UE?
q_18286.ground_truth: A pre-determined method for invoking the MPS for MMTEL voice from a public UE is using a predetermined access number.

q_18287.question: What statistical technique is used in the GAL test plan for the conversation tests to evaluate the results of experiments with multiple dependent variables?

q_18288.question: What should the UE do upon expiration of T319 and failure of the random access procedure in NR?
q_18288.ground_truth: The UE should store the connection resume failure information in this situation.

q_18289.question: In what situations does the V-PCRF request for PCC or QoS rules from the H-PCRF?
q_18289.ground_truth: The V-PCRF requests for PCC or QoS rules from the H-PCRF in the following instances: when it receives a Diameter CCR command from the PCEF requesting PCC for a roaming user, when it receives a Diameter CCR command from the BBERF requesting QoS Rules for a roaming user, and when it receives a Diameter CCR command from the TDF requesting ADC Rules for a roaming user.

q_18290.question: What is the recommended prioritization scheme for uplink CPRACH (Compact Packet Random Access Channel) in EGPRS?
q_18290.ground_truth: A prioritization scheme is recommended for uplink CPRACH in EGPRS. The mobile station (MS) may choose to either ignore the USF (Uplink State Flag) or use the USF to determine the CPRACH in the same way as for the other blocks. Optionally, the first blocks in the ordered list of blocks can only be used as CPRACH.

q_18291.question: What was the mean power saving gain provided by making evenly spaced traffic arrival offset in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30Mbps-30Fps?
q_18291.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by making evenly spaced traffic arrival offset in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30Mbps-30Fps was 8.48%.

q_18292.question: What is the name of the reference point between the UDR and Application Front Ends (e.g. HSS/HLR/AuC-FEs, and AS-FEs)?

q_18293.question: What is the abbreviation for Multimedia Broadcast and Multicast Service in the 3GPP Technical Specification?

q_18294.question: What is the purpose of the public emergency call handling in the FRMCS system?
q_18294.ground_truth: The FRMCS System is able to route the emergency call based on the current position of the initiating FRMCS User. This feature allows FRMCS Users to indicate events that endanger public safety or require public safety involvement.

q_18295.question: Which interfaces does the Iub share the transmission with?
q_18295.ground_truth: Transmission sharing between the GSM/GPRS Abis interface and the Iub interface shall not be precluded.

q_18296.question: What does the RulePriority leaf indicate in the WLANSP rules?
q_18296.ground_truth: The RulePriority leaf represents the priority given to one particular rule in the WLANSP rules.

q_18297.question: What is the maximum frames per second that the HEVC-UHD-Enc can support?
q_18297.ground_truth: The HEVC-UHD-Enc can support up to 480 frames per second.

q_18298.question: What are the causes of power consumption related to the UICC during ME's power cycle?
q_18298.ground_truth: The causes of power consumption related to the UICC during ME's power cycle include the USIM performing authentication commands, reading or writing data stored in the UICC, or during proactive sessions and toolkit events. Also, the UICC consumes power at all times, including in clock stop mode, which is a concern for devices that have long use cases.

q_18299.question: What is the meaning of the "p" symbol in the dialling number string "012340123456p1p2"?
q_18299.ground_truth: The "p" symbol in the dialling number string represents a pause between the called number and the supplementary services information.

q_18300.question: What is the purpose of CR 1 in the context of 5.4.10.2 conformance requirements?
q_18300.ground_truth: The purpose of CR 1 is to ensure that the ME reads the access control value as part of the USIM initialization procedure and afterwards adopts this value.

q_18301.question: What is the Radio Planning Tool Access (RPTA) Integration Reference Point (IRP) and what is its purpose?
q_18301.ground_truth: The Radio Planning Tool Access (RPTA) Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a technical specification that defines the solution set for allowing the network management (NM) to read planned site and antenna data from the RPT.

q_18302.question: What is the purpose of the Application Transport Mechanism (APM) and Application Transport Message (ATM) in the 3GPP bearer independent CS core network?
q_18302.ground_truth: The Application Transport Mechanism (APM) and Application Transport Message (ATM) are used in the 3GPP bearer independent CS core network to provide message transport for the BICC protocols.

q_18303.question: What does the Release Identifier represent in the equation for determining the lowest CDR identifier?
q_18303.ground_truth: The Release Identifier is a component of the equation that helps identify the CDR with the lowest identifier in the file.

q_18304.question: When is reporting of changes of UE presence in a Presence Reporting Area supported during inter-RAT mobility?
q_18304.ground_truth: Reporting of changes of UE presence in a Presence Reporting Area is supported at inter-RAT mobility if the target MME/S4-SGSN supports location information change reporting.

q_18305.question: What is a PDCH in the context of 3GPP TS~45.008 standard?
q_18305.ground_truth: A PDCH is a physical channel allocated to carry packet logical channels, and a PDCH shall carry packet logical channels only.

q_18306.question: What are the security mechanism options for the X2-interface?
q_18306.ground_truth: The security mechanism options for the X2-interface are CUG/VPN, COLP, CLIP, authentication, and encryption.

q_18307.question: When shall the UE derive the TLS premaster secret?
q_18307.ground_truth: The UE derives the TLS premaster secret from the NAF specific key (Ks_ext_NAF if the initiating HTTPS client resides on the ME or Ks_int_NAF if the initiating HTTP client resides on the UICC) when the UE receives a ServerHello message containing a PSK-based ciphersuite and a ServerKeyExchange message containing at least one of the constant strings "3GPP-bootstrapping", "3GPP-bootstrapping-uicc", or "3GPP-bootstrapping-digest" as the PSK identity hint.

q_18308.question: Which network entity receives the service packets from the MB-UPF via unicast bearer when switching from MBMS to 5G MBS before the IRAT mobility?

q_18309.question: Under what conditions may the SGSN activate the APN based Session Management congestion control?
q_18309.ground_truth: The SGSN may activate the APN based Session Management congestion control in case of congestion situation at SGSN, or by OAM at SGSN, or by a restart or recovery condition of a GGSN or PDN~GW, or by a partial failure or recovery of a GGSN or PDN~GW for a particular APN(s).

q_18310.question: When does the SMS-SC send a "Delivery Report Request" to MTC-IWF in the SMS delivery from SMS-SC for Device Triggering?
q_18310.ground_truth: The SMS-SC sends a "Delivery Report Request" to MTC-IWF with appropriate result associated to the successful delivery of the device trigger to the UE, after the SMS-SC receives "SMS Deliver Answer" message as the delivery success of the SM transfer.

q_18311.question: When does an MS set the DRX cycle length that is specific to the PS domain?
q_18311.ground_truth: An MS sets the DRX cycle length that is specific to the PS domain during the attach procedure and when changing from A/Gb mode to Iu mode in the routeing area update procedure.

q_18312.question: What action is taken by the UAV upon receiving the UAA Revocation indication?
q_18312.ground_truth: The UAV deletes all the UAS authorization and security information locally stored corresponding to its CAA Level UAV ID.

q_18313.question: What is the name of the problem faced when higher order modulation MS are multiplexed with legacy GPRS/EGPRS MS on the same downlink PDCH:s?
q_18313.ground_truth: The multiplexing issues of higher order modulations.

q_18314.question: What is the purpose of the Bootstrapping initiation function within the Key Request function?
q_18314.ground_truth: The Bootstrapping initiation function is used to retrieve GBA keys from the BSF and perform MBMS User Service Registration, Deregistration, and MSK request procedures, as well as related user authentication using MRK.

q_18315.question: Which type of data is used for short message support and where is it stored?
q_18315.ground_truth: Data for short message support includes MWD, MNRF, MCEF, MNRG, UNRI, MNRR-MSC, MNRR-SGSN, UNRR, and the MME number for MT SMS. These are temporarily stored in the VLR, MME, and/or HLR, and in some cases, conditionally stored in the HLR.

q_18316.question: What exception is thrown if the compareOffset or compareLength or both would cause access outside array bounds or if compareLength is negative in the findAndCompareValue method?

q_18317.question: What command is indicated by the Command-Code field set to 8388674 and the "R" bit set in the Command Flags field?

q_18318.question: What does "HS-DSCH Specific Definitions - Multiflow (FDD)" refer to in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_18318.ground_truth: Multiflow (FDD) is a mode of operation with two simultaneous HS-DSCH transport channels per carrier frequency, where the HS-DSCH transport channels may belong to the same or different Node Bs.

q_18319.question: How does the Evolved Allocation/Retention Priority differ from the regular Allocation/Retention Priority?
q_18319.ground_truth: The Evolved Allocation/Retention Priority enhances the Allocation/Retention Priority with an increased value range of the priority level and includes additional information about the pre-emption capability and the pre-emption vulnerability of the bearer.

q_18320.question: What is the purpose of the "RA not allowed flag" and where is it stored?
q_18320.ground_truth: The "RA not allowed flag" is set to restrict service on a routing area basis. It is stored in the SGSN.

q_18321.question: When is the network required to send valid RLC data blocks or RLC/MAC control blocks continuously on all subchannels on PCCCH where paging can appear?
q_18321.ground_truth: When the network sends paging messages to a mobile station

q_18322.question: What is the action taken if no LLC is received and only octets 1 to 4 are received in the ISDN BC-IE?
q_18322.ground_truth: The following PLMN-BC parameters shall be set to their respective values (fixed network user rate: 64 kbit/s, connection element: transparent) if no LLC is received and only octets 1 to 4 are received in the ISDN BC-IE.

q_18323.question: What exception is thrown if the compareBuffer is null in the findAndCompareValue method?

q_18324.question: What message is used to initiate the Secondary UL Frequency Update procedure for FDD?
q_18324.ground_truth: The SECONDARY UL FREQUENCY UPDATE INDICATION message is used by the Node B to initiate the Secondary UL Frequency Update procedure for FDD.

q_18325.question: What is the role of the MME in confirming the UE's capability to support UP IP over E-UTRA when connected to EPS?
q_18325.ground_truth: The MME includes the UE's capability to support UP IP over E-UTRA when connected to EPS in the Source to Target Transparent container when the source AMF includes the UE's capability in the UE Context Modification Request message. The target eNB then takes it into use if there is a mismatch.

q_18326.question: What is the purpose of improved random accessibility support in H.265 (HEVC)?
q_18326.ground_truth: The purpose of improved random accessibility support in H.265 (HEVC) is to include signalling of IRAP pictures beyond IDR pictures and provide six different NAL units to signal the properties of the IRAP pictures, which can be used to better match the stream access point types as defined in the ISOBMFF.

q_18327.question: In the context of RL-InformationResponse-RL-AdditionRspTDD768, what does "primary-CCPCH-Info-TDD768" refer to?
q_18327.ground_truth: Primary Common Control Physical Channel Information for TDD.

q_18328.question: What are the three conditions for aborting the MTA procedure with enhanced security in the BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION ABORT message?
q_18328.ground_truth: The three conditions for aborting the MTA procedure with enhanced security are: detecting a duplicate RLC data block, detecting a RLC data block with a greater ``MTA Instance'' field value, and detecting a RLC data block with "Final MTA Access" = TRUE for which the corresponding "MTA Instance" field has the same value as a RLC data block for which "Final MTA Access" = FALSE.

q_18329.question: What action must the network take upon reception of an MBMS SERVICE REQUEST message from a mobile station?
q_18329.ground_truth: The network, upon reception of an MBMS SERVICE REQUEST message from a mobile station, estimates the number of mobile stations interested in the session in a given cell, and may use this estimate to establish an MBMS bearer.

q_18330.question: What type of channel is a Bm channel?
q_18330.ground_truth: A Bm channel is a bi-directional or uni-directional user channel, able to carry a variety of bit streams, including voice encoded at 13 kbit/s, and data transmission at different bit rates.

q_18331.question: What should the UE do if it receives a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with the EPS bearer context of a default EPS bearer context and ESM cause~#39 "reactivation requested" over the 3GPP access?
q_18331.ground_truth: If the corresponding PDN connection is established over both 3GPP access and WLAN, the UE shall complete the EPS bearer context deactivation, locally release the corresponding PDN connection over trusted WLAN and untrusted WLAN, and then re-establish the PDN connection(s) at least over one access with the choice of the access being implementation specific.

q_18332.question: How does the SMF perform network slice admission control for redundant PDU sessions?
q_18332.ground_truth: The SMF performs network slice admission control for each PDU session independently for a set of redundant PDU sessions.

q_18333.question: How many dB better than the current serving cell should an inter-frequency cell be for filtering to start the evaluation process?
q_18333.ground_truth: The filtering shall be such that the UE shall be capable of evaluating that an inter-frequency cell has become better ranked than the serving cell within (Ncarrier-1) * TevaluateTDD from the moment the inter-frequency cell became at least 3 dB better than the current serving cell.

q_18334.question: What should the UE do if it is in the state 5GMM-REGISTERED and in 5GMM-IDLE mode over non-3GPP access, and needs to change the SMS over NAS capability?
q_18334.ground_truth: The UE should initiate and successfully complete the registration procedure for mobility registration update.

q_18335.question: What RFC specifies the GZip algorithm used for content encoding of files in the download delivery method?

q_18336.question: How does HeNB determine its operating frequency based on the measured RSRP of surrounding frequency layers?
q_18336.ground_truth: If the measured RSRP of both higher and lower priority frequency layers exceeds a predefined set of thresholds, the HeNB should select its operating frequency that is being used by the cell that has the lower priority for interference mitigation.

q_18337.question: What should a receiving node do if it receives a message containing IEs or IE groups in wrong order or with too many occurrences?
q_18337.ground_truth: The receiving node should reject the procedure and report the cause value "Abstract Syntax Error".

q_18338.question: What data does AF provide in Alternative 2 of the solution for Key Issue #16?
q_18338.ground_truth: AF in Alternative 2 provides measured MOS performance data per Application Server Instance.

q_18339.question: What should the UE do if the HPLMN updates the SOR-CMCI in the USIM such that it contains no SOR-CMCI rules?
q_18339.ground_truth: The UE behaviour described in clause~C.4.2 applies.

q_18340.question: What message type is sent on the EC-CCCH by the network when there are no other messages to send?

q_18341.question: What is the purpose of TMSI reallocation procedure?
q_18341.ground_truth: The purpose of the TMSI reallocation procedure is to allocate a new TMSI/LAI pair to a user after the initiation of ciphering, ensuring the ciphering of communication over the radio path.

q_18342.question: What is the role of the SGSN when using S4 interface in packet routing and transfer?
q_18342.ground_truth: If packet routing and transfer takes place between the SGSN and the S-GW using S4, PDP contexts need to be mapped into EPS bearer contexts and vice versa. Context mapping is handled by the SGSN when using S4. This is transparent to the MS.

q_18343.question: What is the maximum send rate for UE-A and UE-B in IMS-A and IMS-B?
q_18343.ground_truth: The maximum send rate for UE-A and UE-B in IMS-A and IMS-B is 315 kbps.

q_18344.question: What is the default value of SBGP and SBSP in special burst transmission?
q_18344.ground_truth: The default value for both SBGP and SBSP is 8.

q_18345.question: What is the meaning of the "RB-Identity" and "RB-IdentityForHOMessage" fields in the "SRNC-RelocationInfo-r4-IEs" sequence?
q_18345.ground_truth: The "RB-Identity" field in the "SRNC-RelocationInfo-r4-IEs" sequence is used in the RB Relocation procedure, and it identifies the RB used by the source SRNC to send the message contained in the IE "TargetRNC-ToSourceRNC-Container". The "RB-IdentityForHOMessage" field is included only if the type is "UE involved" in the "UE involved" Handover procedure, and it identifies the RB used by the source SRNC to send the HO message.

q_18346.question: What should the eNB start after receiving and successfully verifying the AS security mode complete message?

q_18347.question: What is the error type that occurs when a required parameter is missing in a CAP operation?

q_18348.question: What is the impact of adopting the alternative method based on bin-averaging for the -3 dB geometry case?
q_18348.ground_truth: The change was made to obtain a consistent and accurate interference profile for the -3 dB geometry case, as there was a significant difference in link level throughput results using the random draw method for this case.

q_18349.question: What is the role of the MME in LCS?
q_18349.ground_truth: The MME in LCS is responsible for charging and billing, coordination of LCS, selection of E-SMLC, processing location requests, authorization and operation of LCS services, and informing HLR/HSS about the UE's LCS capabilities.

q_18350.question: What are the three different conditions under which the TCH/FS FER measurements in frequency hopping under interference conditions are tested?
q_18350.ground_truth: The three different conditions under which the TCH/FS FER measurements in frequency hopping under interference conditions are tested are the Normal condition, the Extreme Temperature condition, and the Vibration condition.

q_18351.question: What is the consequence when the transport-block size information is set to '111111' and the number of transport blocks indicated is equal to 2, 3 or 4?
q_18351.ground_truth: If the number of transport blocks indicated is equal to 2, the primary transport block is not transmitted. If the number of transport blocks indicated is equal to 3, the primary transport block is not transmitted. If the number of transport blocks indicated is equal to 4, the primary and fourth transport blocks are not transmitted.

q_18352.question: What are the main components of the Silence Descriptor (SID) frame in the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_18352.ground_truth: The Silence Descriptor (SID) frame includes evaluated comfort noise parameters, such as the averaged LSF parameter vector and averaged logarithmic frame energy, which provide information on the level and spectrum of background noise.

q_18353.question: What is the role of the IBCF in the IMS network?
q_18353.ground_truth: The IBCF function is responsible for providing policy enforcement between IMS networks and other SIP-based multimedia networks.

q_18354.question: What is the role of the Membership function?
q_18354.ground_truth: The Membership function is used to verify if a user is authorized to register, receive keys, or establish a MBMS bearer for MBMS Multicast Mode.

q_18355.question: Can existing Connection Management mechanisms be reused for a UE accessing 5GC via satellite 3GPP access?
q_18355.ground_truth: This is a point expected to be studied within Key Issue 3.

q_18356.question: What should the NAF do if it cannot obtain any NAF-specific key from the BSF?
q_18356.ground_truth: The NAF should respond with an appropriate error message not containing the realm attributes from step 3.

q_18357.question: What is the purpose of the Resource-Allocation-Notification AVP within a Charging-Rule-Install AVP?
q_18357.ground_truth: The Resource-Allocation-Notification AVP within a Charging-Rule-Install AVP defines whether the allocation of resources for the related PCC rules needs to be notified. If it is included, it indicates that the allocation of resources for the related PCC rules shall be confirmed.

q_18358.question: What additional tasks does the telecom system perform in Level 2 network autonomy for RAN NE provisioning?
q_18358.ground_truth: In Level 2 network autonomy for RAN NE provisioning, the telecom system performs the tasks of connecting the RAN NE to the management system and collecting the RAN NE information, in addition to the tasks performed by the human in Level 1.

q_18359.question: What happens if verification fails in step 5 of the authentication procedure?
q_18359.ground_truth: If verification fails in step 5 of the authentication procedure, the message is discarded, and the UDM will regard it as a replayed message.

q_18360.question: What should a BSS do if an unexpected conditional Information Element is received in the RIM container of a RAN-INFORMATION PDU, RAN-INFORMATION-REQUEST PDU, RAN-INFORMATION-ACK PDU or RAN-INFORMATION-APPLICATION-ERROR PDU?
q_18360.ground_truth: The BSS should send a RAN-INFORMATION-ERROR PDU containing the complete received PDU and with the RIM Cause IE set to "Unexpected Conditional IE" back to the originating BSS and discard the received PDU.

q_18361.question: What is the absolute power calculation used for in 6.8.2.3.2, step 8?
q_18361.ground_truth: The absolute power calculation is used to determine the TRP measurement for the assigned channel frequency in the passband.

q_18362.question: What should the PCRF do to request the termination of an existing bearer caused by the removal of PCC rules?
q_18362.ground_truth: The PCRF may request the removal of the PCC rules by using the PCC rule provisioning procedures and the network will instantly start the bearer termination procedure when all the PCC rules applied to one bearer have been deleted and/or deactivated.

q_18363.question: In the ECT supplementary service, what does the NI (Notification Indicator) indicate to each remote party?
q_18363.ground_truth: The NI indicates to each remote party in which state of the other remote party the ECT was performed (active or alerting).

q_18364.question: What is the IRI data record transmission requirement in relation to the detection of the triggering event by the IAP?
q_18364.ground_truth: Each IRI data record shall be sent by the delivery function to the LEMF over the HI2 within seconds of the detection of the triggering event by the IAP at least 95% of the time.

q_18365.question: What is the role of the Broadcast Multicast Service Centre (BM-SC) in MBMS architecture?
q_18365.ground_truth: The BM-SC provides a set of functions for MBMS User Services. It may support functions for different MBMS User Services from the same or different physical network elements.

q_18366.question: What is the name of the procedure for requesting past location information from the location management server?

q_18367.question: What operation is represented by the measurement "Failed number of PDN-GW initiated Dedicated Bearer Creation" in the context of EPS packet switching?
q_18367.ground_truth: The operation is the failed creation of a dedicated bearer by the PDN-GW (PDN Gateway) in EPS (Evolved Packet System) packet switching.

q_18368.question: What is the observed PDCCH blocking rate for A2 with UE group scheduling?

q_18369.question: What is the minimum requirement for Test 1 and Test 2 in terms of the UE's behavior in soft handover?
q_18369.ground_truth: Test 1 verifies that the UE follows only the reliable TPC commands in soft handover, while Test 2 verifies that the UE follows all the reliable TPC commands in soft handover.

q_18370.question: How many paging indicators are transmitted in each radio frame for the PICH?
q_18370.ground_truth: NPI paging indicators are transmitted in each radio frame for the PICH, where NPI depends on the paging indicator length and the burst type.

q_18371.question: What should the Terminal do after receiving an unblock code and new PIN from the user in order to unblock the PIN?
q_18371.ground_truth: The Terminal should send an UNBLOCK PIN command to the UICC, with the correct parameter P2 set as specified.

q_18372.question: What must the CRNC manage between cells to ensure equal bitrate allocation in a multi-cell RLS?
q_18372.ground_truth: Load excess indicator to signal when the frequency of "Down" commands towards UEs exceeds a pre-defined level.

q_18373.question: What action does the network take when it wants to re-associate a DRB with a different key (KeNB to S-KeNB or vice versa)?
q_18373.ground_truth: The network provides the drb-Identity value in the (target) drb-ToAddModList and sets the reestablishPDCP flag, without listing the drb-Identity in the (source) drb-ToReleaseList. Additionally, the network also ensures that the RLC receiver entities do not deliver old PDCP PDUs to the re-established PDCP entity.

q_18374.question: What is described in the 5.3.4 use case?
q_18374.ground_truth: The 5.3.4 use case describes a mobile specialist practice, which is a healthcare solution where a mobile practice is located in a truck and contains medical imaging equipment and a network of dedicated 5G access points for transmitting diagnostic data in real-time to a remote expert.

q_18375.question: What should the MS do if a change in cell re-selection parameters is detected after re-tuning?
q_18375.ground_truth: The MS shall check if the cell re-selection criterion is still valid using the changed parameters. If the cell selection criteria are still valid, the MS shall camp on the cell. If they are not still valid, the MS shall repeat the process for the cell with the next highest value of C2 or corresponding GPRS parameter or SoLSA parameters, respectively.

q_18376.question: What is the purpose of Framing Pattern Substitution (FPS) in the RAA' function?
q_18376.ground_truth: The purpose of FPS in the RAA' function is to avoid transmitting a sequence of eight zeroes and to prevent erroneous synchronization to the A-TRAU or V.110. It replaces the Z sequence with a ZSP field to avoid false occurrences of a Z sequence.

q_18377.question: Where is security enforced between the endpoints in a remote UE and gNB, and how is traffic relayed securely over two links without exposing plaintext data to the UE-to-Network Relay?
q_18377.ground_truth: Security is enforced at the PDCP layer between the endpoints in a remote UE and gNB. The PDCP traffic is relayed securely over two links between the Remote UE and the UE-to-Network Relay UE and between the UE-to-Network Relay UE to the gNB without exposing any plaintext data to the UE-to-Network Relay.

q_18378.question: In the context of GNSS, what is the purpose of the gnss-SystemTime IE and gnss-ReferenceTimeForCells IE?
q_18378.ground_truth: The gnss-SystemTime IE is used to signal coarse and fine time assistance, while the gnss-ReferenceTimeForCells IE is used to signal fine time assistance to the UE.

q_18379.question: What are the differences between the Transparent and Non-Transparent mode of PDCP?
q_18379.ground_truth: Transparent mode does not change the incoming service data units, while Non-Transparent mode performs header adaptation of IP data streams and supports header compression, header removal, or no header adaptation. Additionally, only the Transparent mode has a relocation support function for applicable QoS requirements.

q_18380.question: What is the role of the Access Network in handling positioning procedures in LCS?
q_18380.ground_truth: The Access Network is involved in the handling of various positioning procedures in LCS.

q_18381.question: What is the role of the first digit of the version number presented in the document's foreword, as it pertains to the document's stage of approval and change control?
q_18381.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of approval and change control: 1 - presented to TSG for information; 2 - presented to TSG for approval; or 3 or greater - TSG approved document under change control.

q_18382.question: What is required for UE-1 to add existing CS media in a new IMS Session and Gm Service Control (6.3.3.2) per the mentioned document?
q_18382.ground_truth: The existing session must have CS media, and UE-1 must send an INVITE towards SCC AS to control the CS media using ICS capabilities and to establish a new session indicating that the control of the existing CS media is transferred to the new session.

q_18383.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS Indicator Channel (MICH) type1 in carrying MBMS notification indicators on a non-MBSFN dedicated carrier?
q_18383.ground_truth: The MBMS Indicator Channel (MICH) type1 is used to carry the MBMS notification indicators on a non-MBSFN dedicated carrier to make decisions on individual MBMS notification indicators.

q_18384.question: What was the buffer size that was set for the "OPEN CHANNEL" command in the example?
q_18384.ground_truth: The buffer size was set to 1000 for the "OPEN CHANNEL" command.

q_18385.question: What should the target UE do upon receiving a DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE REJECT message?
q_18385.ground_truth: The target UE should stop timer T5007, provide an indication to the lower layer of deactivation of the PC5 unicast security protection and deletion of security context for the PC5 unicast link, and abort the ongoing procedure that triggered the initiation of the link security mode control procedure.

q_18386.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 32.401, what does the term "NEs" mean?
q_18386.ground_truth: In the document, "NEs" is used as an abbreviation for Network Elements.

q_18387.question: When does the UE consider the access attempt as allowed if one or more Access Identities are indicated?
q_18387.ground_truth: The UE considers the access attempt as allowed if the corresponding bit is set to zero in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity contained in the "UAC barring parameter" for at least one of the indicated Access Identities.

q_18388.question: What is the role of the UE in V2X-based group communication for commercial services?
q_18388.ground_truth: The UE obtains the Application Layer Group ID for the group communication from the Application Server by using application layer signalling, determines the Destination Layer-2 ID based on the Application Layer Group ID, and sends service data using V2X-based group communication over PC5 when group communications can take place.

q_18389.question: What should the MSC-A server do when it receives a codec list with the IAM message?
q_18389.ground_truth: The MSC-A server should follow the procedures specified in clause~6.2.2 when it receives a Supported Codecs List (BICC) with the IAM message.

q_18390.question: What is the difference between low and high frequency resolution SBR envelopes in the Enhanced aacPlus general audio codec?
q_18390.ground_truth: In the Enhanced aacPlus general audio codec, low frequency resolution SBR envelopes have a larger number of frequency bands compared to high frequency resolution SBR envelopes, which have a smaller number of frequency bands.

q_18391.question: What action does the UE take if the "UE positioning GPS Navigation Model" is included and an update is provided for a satellite in step 2?
q_18391.ground_truth: The UE acts as specified in subclause 8.6.7.19.3.4 and stores the IE "UE positioning GPS Ephemeris and Clock Correction parameters" at the position indicated by the "Sat ID" in the "UE positioning GPS Navigation Model".

q_18392.question: What is the maximum length of a short message within the TP-UD field when using uncompressed 8-bit data?
q_18392.ground_truth: The maximum length of a short message within the TP-UD field when using uncompressed 8-bit data is 134 octets.

q_18393.question: What happens when the transmission of an Upper Layer PDU is suspended in EMSR to transmit a higher priority Upper Layer PDU?
q_18393.ground_truth: An LI with a value of 124 is included as the first LI field within the next transmitted RLC data block, where an octet containing the TFI value associated with the higher priority Upper Layer PDU immediately follows.

q_18394.question: What is the type of extension data in Record 1 of EXT3?
q_18394.ground_truth: The type of extension data in Record 1 of EXT3 is '02'.

q_18395.question: What does the BSS do before sending the PS Handover Required Acknowledge message to the source BSS in the execution phase?
q_18395.ground_truth: Before sending the PS Handover Required Acknowledge message, the SGSN, based on QoS, may suspend downlink data transfer for any PDP contexts, and the source BSS, based on QoS, may try to empty the downlink BSS buffer for any BSS PFCs.

q_18396.question: What is the purpose of defining PLMN connection types?
q_18396.ground_truth: The definition of PLMN connection types provides the necessary input to identify the network capabilities of a PLMN and facilitates the specification of network-to-network interfaces. It may also assist in the allocation of network performance parameters and in determining the network capabilities required to support a specific telecommunication service.

q_18397.question: What is the requirement for H(e)NB device authentication with the SeGW?
q_18397.ground_truth: If the operator chooses not to use IPsec, mutual authentication between the H(e)NB device and the SeGW is required. The interface between the H(e)NB and SeGW shall then be secured with a mechanism that provides layer 2 security for confidentiality and integrity protection of communications. This mechanism then shall also bind this secure communications to device authentication between H(e)NB and SeGW and optional HPM authentication.

q_18398.question: What is the role of the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay in unicast uplink traffic?
q_18398.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-Network Relay uses the uplink TFTs to select the uplink EPS bearers for relayed uplink packets independently from the ProSe Per Packet Priority applied over PC5 by Remote UEs.

q_18399.question: What is the main impact when applying higher order modulations with increasing degree?
q_18399.ground_truth: The main impact is on the RF receiver and transmitter, with modest increases in computational complexity at the receiver.

q_18400.question: What is the responsibility of the MB-SMF in the broadcast session activation procedure?
q_18400.ground_truth: The MB-SMF selects the involved NG RAN based on the service area, sends the Broadcast Session Resource Setup Request to the NG RAN nodes, and transfers the Broadcast Session Resource Setup Request message to the NG RAN nodes controlling the target cells.

q_18401.question: What happens when a FRMCS User joins a voice communication in progress?
q_18401.ground_truth: Other FRMCS Users involved in the communication receive a notification that the FRMCS User has joined, and the user is identified to them.

q_18402.question: What is one of the main requirements for the 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_18402.ground_truth: One of the main requirements for the 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification is to minimize the user equipment (UE) and network complexity while maintaining a given system performance level.

q_18403.question: What should the UE indicate in the de-registration type IE when the de-registration procedure is triggered due to USIM removal?
q_18403.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate "switch off" in the de-registration type IE.

q_18404.question: What is the response message from the BSS to a BSSMAP-LE Assistance Information Request message?
q_18404.ground_truth: The BSS responds with a BSSMAP-LE Assistance Information Response message, which may include the (EC-)RACH control parameters, Coverage class thresholds, and BTS Reception Accuracy Capability applicable to the set of cells requested for assistance information.

q_18405.question: In MBMS Broadcast Mode, how is user authorization validated for a MBMS User Service?
q_18405.ground_truth: In MBMS Broadcast Mode, authorization for a MBMS User Service is validated without the help of Membership function in the BM-SC, as the Membership function is only defined in the context of MBMS Multicast Mode.

q_18406.question: What should the Initial AMF do in Step 12 after performing horizontal key derivation?
q_18406.ground_truth: The Initial AMF should include the new Kamf-1 and the keyAmfHDerivationInd indicator in the Registration Request message before forwarding it to the RAN.

q_18407.question: What is the procedure for setting the contents of UECapabilityInformation message if the ue-CapabilityRequest includes eutra and the UE supports both FDD and TDD, as defined in TS 36.331, clause 5.6.3.3?
q_18407.ground_truth: The fields for FDD and TDD should be set to include the values applicable for both modes, except for fdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities and tdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities (including their sub-fields) which should reflect the additional functionality applicable for FDD or TDD respectively.

q_18408.question: What entities does the MBMS User Service interface with in the MBMS system?
q_18408.ground_truth: The MBMS User Service interfaces with the BM-SC, the GGSN or MBMS-GW, and the UE. In addition, for MBMS delivery of Group Communication Services, it interfaces with the GCS Application Server via the MB2 interface.

q_18409.question: What is the command type for the SEND DTMF service?
q_18409.ground_truth: The command type for the SEND DTMF service is "SEND DTMF".

q_18410.question: When is the CS connection released in enhanced CS release?
q_18410.ground_truth: The CS connection is released after the MS has received the required set of system information, initiated by the network sending the PACKET CS RELEASE INDICATION message.

q_18411.question: What is the role of the "Conference Focus" in IP multimedia services?
q_18411.ground_truth: The "Conference Focus" is an entity that has the abilities to host conferences, including their creation, maintenance, and manipulation of the media. It implements the conference policy, such as rules for talk burst control, assigning priorities, and participant rights.

q_18412.question: When should the UE delete stored deprioritisation requests?
q_18412.ground_truth: The UE shall delete stored deprioritisation requests when it enters a different RRC state, the optional validity time of dedicated priorities (T320) expires, or when a PLMN selection is performed on request by NAS.

q_18413.question: What happens to the TCX gain if only the second packet is lost in a TCX512 frame?
q_18413.ground_truth: The full TCX gain is obtained from the first packet.

q_18414.question: What is the fundamental mechanism used in the solution for establishing a broadcast session within the context of MBS?
q_18414.ground_truth: The solution uses the procedure for an Application Function (AF) to request the establishment of a Multicast Session as a fundamental mechanism, with modifications to include a broadcast area.

q_18415.question: What is the feature on phones that emulates key press feedback, similar to key press signaling on analogue telephones?
q_18415.ground_truth: Mobile or SIP phones provide features that emulate the key press feedback.

q_18416.question: What is one of the roles of the controllee UE in inter-UE transfer procedures?
q_18416.ground_truth: The controllee UE does not have any specific procedures for collaborative session establishment. It follows the procedures prescribed by 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_18417.question: What is the name of the two states that the GA-RC sub-layer in the MS can be in?
q_18417.ground_truth: The GA-RC sub-layer in the MS can be in either the GA-RC-DEREGISTERED or GA-RC-REGISTERED state.

q_18418.question: What procedure is applicable if the UE accesses over a Fixed Broadband Access network which is considered untrusted, for EPC-routed traffic?
q_18418.ground_truth: Network-Initiated Dynamic PCC for S2c when accessing untrusted Fixed Broadband Access for EPC-routed Traffic

q_18419.question: Which uplink and downlink frequency spacing is required for the additional requirements for DC-HSDPA, DB-DC-HSDPA, DC-HSUPA, single band/dual band 4C-HSDPA or single band 8C-HSDPA or single band NC-4C-HSDPA?
q_18419.ground_truth: The spacing of the carrier frequencies of the two cells in both downlink and uplink should be 5 MHz.

q_18420.question: What is the purpose of indicating traffic pattern information in the V2X layer?
q_18420.ground_truth: The purpose of indicating traffic pattern information in the V2X layer is to assist the calculation of PC5 DRX cycle and on/off duration.

q_18421.question: What is the role of the true RSTD in the NR RSTD measurement accuracy test case for dual positioning frequency layer in FR2 SA?
q_18421.ground_truth: The true RSTD is the receive time difference for frame 0 between cell 2 and cell 1 as seen at the UE antenna connector, and is set to 1966.08 Tc in this test case.

q_18422.question: How does the UE set the rrm-MeasRelaxationFulfilment in the UEAssistanceInformation message if the criterion for RRM measurement relaxation for connected mode is fulfilled?
q_18422.ground_truth: The UE sets the rrm-MeasRelaxationFulfilment to true in the UEAssistanceInformation message if the criterion for RRM measurement relaxation for connected mode is fulfilled.

q_18423.question: In the non-extended uplink TBF mode, what triggers the countdown process for the mobile station to release the uplink TBF?
q_18423.ground_truth: The mobile station initiates the release of the uplink TBF by beginning the countdown process when it has sent the RLC data block with CV = 0 and there are no elements in the V(B) array set to the value Nacked.

q_18424.question: What does it mean when a User Equipment (UE) is "not served by E-UTRA" and "not served by NR" in the context of ProSe discovery and communications over PC5 reference point?
q_18424.ground_truth: It means that the UE is not currently connected to either E-UTRA (LTE) or NR (5G) network.

q_18425.question: What is the interface used between the 3G mobile network and the PSTN as defined in the document?
q_18425.ground_truth: The interface between the 3G mobile network and the PSTN is generally at the 2~048~kbits/ level at an interface in accordance with ITU-T Recommendation G.703/G.704 or STM1 155Mbit/s.

q_18426.question: Why is it important to have granular access control in a 3GPP management system?
q_18426.ground_truth: Granular access control helps to differentiate the exposure of MnSs for the consumers, preventing unauthorized access to sensitive information or functions.

q_18427.question: In what mode is the UE operating if it is in the 5GMM-IDLE mode and using single-registration mode?

q_18428.question: What are some spatial channel models used for emulating spatial characteristics of signals in a channel model?
q_18428.ground_truth: Some spatial channel models include SCM, SCME, Winner I & II, and ITU-A.

q_18429.question: In the context of the Additional E-DCH Information Response IE, what action should the Node B take if the Secondary UL Frequency Activation State IE is present?
q_18429.ground_truth: The Node B should use the information as the initial activation state of the radio links on the secondary uplink frequency.

q_18430.question: What information is sent on RACH in a CHANNEL REQUEST or EGPRS PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST message?
q_18430.ground_truth: The information includes an establishment cause, a random reference, and a capability indication.

q_18431.question: What must the GGSN do if it receives a Delete PDP Context Request message with the Direct Tunnel Flags IE absent and the Teardown Indicator set to 1, but there are still other active PDP contexts sharing the same PDN connection?
q_18431.ground_truth: The GGSN shall only tear down the PDP context identified by the NSAPI included in the Delete PDP Context Request message and keep the other active PDP contexts.

q_18432.question: What action is taken if the UE supports the capability to perform the UE GPS timing of cell frames measurement and the UE does not have enough assistance data to compute a position?
q_18432.ground_truth: The UE shall include the IE "GPS Additional Assistance Data Request" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT to request assistance data when it does not have enough assistance data to compute a position.

q_18433.question: What is the minimum number of bands sent to the PVQ for quantization, and how are the bands picked from the initial spectrum of the difference signal?
q_18433.ground_truth: The minimum number of bands sent to the PVQ for quantization is 5 out of 16. The bands are picked from the initial spectrum of the difference signal based on the quantized gain of this band, with the 5 first bands always sent to the PVQ.

q_18434.question: What is a similarity between solutions #12 and #23 for discovering PLMNs offering disaster roaming?
q_18434.ground_truth: Both solutions allow the UE to select and camp on PLMN D on PLMN D's cells located outside of the disaster area when the UE is informed that Disaster Condition applies for PLMN D.

q_18435.question: What is the largest value that all state variables related to UM data transfer can take when using a 12 bit SN?
q_18435.ground_truth: All state variables related to UM data transfer can take values from 0 to 4095 when using a 12 bit SN.

q_18436.question: What is the GERAN service abnormal release rate KPI used to measure and what are the KPIs calculated from?
q_18436.ground_truth: The GERAN service abnormal release rate KPI describing the ratio of mobiles which having successfully accessed the TCH, subsequently suffer an abnormal release, caused by loss of the radio link, is obtained by the number of lost radio links while using it, unsuccessful internal handovers intra-cell, unsuccessful internal handovers with reconnection to old channels and with loss of connection divided by the total number of successful TCH/PDTCH seizures, successful internal handovers intra-cell and successful incoming Internal inter cell handovers.

q_18437.question: What are the potential impacts or interactions with existing services for using cloud rendering for gaming?
q_18437.ground_truth: The potential impacts or interactions with existing services for using cloud rendering for gaming include the need for load balancing among cloud rendering servers, QoS support, QoS prediction, and potential congestion in the cloud rendering server when QoS changes, and the potential need for redundant resources to achieve the required reliability for URLLC treatment.

q_18438.question: What is the role of the PNM AS in processing initial requests in the IM CN subsystem?
q_18438.ground_truth: The PNM AS is responsible for processing initial requests for session setup in the IM CN subsystem. It checks for the presence of the originating UE in the access control list of the controllee UE. If the UE is not found in the list, the PNM AS sends a query to the controller UE for further processing.

q_18439.question: How many cycles are required for the original reference C code to process 4 elements of the array?
q_18439.ground_truth: The original reference C code requires 4 cycles to process 4 elements of the array.

q_18440.question: When should the TDF set an ADC rule active and make it inactive?
q_18440.ground_truth: If Rule-Activation-Time has been specified and has not yet occurred, then the TDF shall set the ADC rule inactive and make it active at that time. If Rule-Deactivation-Time has been specified and has not yet occurred, then the TDF shall set the ADC rule active and make it inactive at that time.

q_18441.question: What is the maximum energy change allowed in a segment to detect a transient?
q_18441.ground_truth: A transient is detected if the energy of a segment exceeds the accumulated energy by a constant factor of 8.5.

q_18442.question: When performing inter-system handover towards the GSM CS domain and GSM PS domain in parallel, what should the RNC include in the Target ID IE and Old BSS to New BSS Information IE?
q_18442.ground_truth: The RNC should include the same cell global identity of the cell in the target system for both CS and PS domains in the Target ID IE, and set the appropriate information about the nature of the CS/PS inter-system handover in the Old BSS to New BSS Information IE.

q_18443.question: What does the 'missing' status indicate in the anchor/test documentation?
q_18443.ground_truth: The 'missing' status in the anchor/test documentation indicates that cross-checks are still pending and have not been completed.

q_18444.question: What is the purpose of using the same U-plane protocol for both S1-U and X2-U interfaces in EPC?
q_18444.ground_truth: The purpose of using the same U-plane protocol for both S1-U and X2-U interfaces in EPC is to minimize protocol processing for the eNB at the time of data forwarding.

q_18445.question: What is the role of the BMSC.UPF in transmitting RTP flows?
q_18445.ground_truth: The BMSC.UPF is responsible for transmitting the RTP flows and is not involved in the reporting of content switching information.

q_18446.question: What procedure does the UE initiate if the CS Fallback procedure is rejected by the MME?
q_18446.ground_truth: The UE sends an Extended Service Request for mobile originating CS fallback to the MME, which is encapsulated in RRC and S1-AP messages.

q_18447.question: What is the importance of a secondary authentication procedure in the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay scenario?
q_18447.ground_truth: The secondary authentication procedure is used to ensure the security of the remote UE's access to the network through the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay, even when multiple remote UEs connect almost at the same time.

q_18448.question: What is the frequency relationship between f0, f1, and f2 in the intermodulation requirements for MS and BTS?
q_18448.ground_truth: The relationship between the frequencies is f0 = 2f1 - f2 and |f2 - f1| = 800 kHz.

q_18449.question: What is the PLMN leaf used for in ISRP rules?
q_18449.ground_truth: The PLMN leaf is used by the UE to determine if an ISRP rule is valid in ISRP rules.

q_18450.question: In the Local Breakout scenario case 2b, when does the V-PCRF initiate Gateway Control Session and QoS Rules Request/Provisioning procedures locally without notifying the H-PCRF?
q_18450.ground_truth: If the AF requested it, the PCRF notifies the AF of related bearer level events.

q_18451.question: What is a (digital) connection as defined in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_18451.ground_truth: A (digital) connection is a concatenation of (digital) transmission channels or (digital) telecommunication circuits, switching and other functional units set up to provide for the transfer of (digital) signals between two or more points in a telecommunication network to support a single communication.

q_18452.question: What should the RNC do if the Security Mode Control procedure is ongoing on another core network domain and it receives a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message for a new integrity protection and ciphering keys?
q_18452.ground_truth: The RNC shall select the same ciphering and integrity alternative for the two domains, meaning that if ciphering has not been started for the first core network domain, it shall also not be started for the second domain.

q_18453.question: What technique can be used to improve power efficiency and increase output power in digital dual carrier mode with a single PA and two 8-PSK modulated carriers?
q_18453.ground_truth: Allowing minor deviations from the normal spectrum mask for the unused frequency channel(s) between the two carriers can be considered to reduce PAR and improve power efficiency.

q_18454.question: What is the role of the NGN in handling anonymous calls in private network traffic?
q_18454.ground_truth: The NGN does not handle requirements for anonymous calls in private network traffic, as it's outside the scope of NGN documents.

q_18455.question: What is the purpose of the rate-loop in the envelope based arithmetic coder section?
q_18455.ground_truth: The rate-loop is used to determine the optimal scaling of the spectral lines such that the expected bit-consumption matches the desired bit-rate, by adjusting the scaling of the spectral lines and calculating the bit-consumption until it is sufficiently close to the desired bit-rate.

q_18456.question: What is the purpose of the map-based hybrid channel model in comparison to the standard channel model methodology?
q_18456.ground_truth: The map-based hybrid channel model is an alternative to the standard channel model methodology that can be used to evaluating or predict system performance using a digital map to take into account the impacts from environmental structures and materials.

q_18457.question: What does Solution#5 propose to support QoS monitoring and provisioning for C2 applications?
q_18457.ground_truth: Solution#5 proposes to use SEAL services (GM server and NRM server) to cover QoS monitoring/provisioning aspects, grouping the UAV and UAV-C and applying existing resource adaptation mechanisms to the group.

q_18458.question: What should the MME do if it receives the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message without confidentiality protection but a confidentiality algorithm different from EEA0 was selected?
q_18458.ground_truth: The MME should reject the message as the NAS confidentiality protection algorithm was not applied correctly.

q_18459.question: Which two types of service quality are required for IMS control plane and media plane procedures when FLUS is offered as part of a 3GPP non-IMS/MTSI service?
q_18459.ground_truth: The two types of service quality are IMS control plane and media plane procedures.

q_18460.question: What is the conformance requirement for CatPollingOff in 6.8.3.1.1?
q_18460.ground_truth: The conformance requirement for CatPollingOff in 6.8.3.1.1 is that the entry point with the following header shall be compliant to its definition in the API.

q_18461.question: What is the purpose of the Test Management IRP in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_18461.ground_truth: The purpose of the Test Management IRP is to define the requirements for testing the functionality and performance of the 3G managed network.

q_18462.question: What protocol does the TE and MT negotiate for link termination if the PDP Context activation is rejected?

q_18463.question: What does the "Signal Info string" contain in the External Signal Info IE?
q_18463.ground_truth: The Signal Info string in the External Signal Info IE contains the MLC-LMU messages defined by ASN.1 and coded by PER (ITU-T Recommendation X.691). It represents the coded and encoded MLC-LMU messages.

q_18464.question: How does the UE determine the modulation scheme when 64QAM is supported?
q_18464.ground_truth: If 64QAM is supported by the UE, the UE calculates the physical resource bearer capability and the transmission bit rate, and then determines if the physical resource bearer capability multiplied by R is less than the transmission bit rate. If it is, the modulation scheme is 64QAM, otherwise it is QPSK.

q_18465.question: What should the SMF do if the requirements in clause 5.8.2.2 are fulfilled and the address of the failed P-CSCF is received in the notification from UDM?
q_18465.ground_truth: The SMF should initiate the P-CSCF address list update procedure to trigger the P-CSCF reselection by the UE, taking into account the address of the failed P-CSCF to build the list of available P-CSCFs.

q_18466.question: When does the network consider 3GPP access as unusable?
q_18466.ground_truth: The network considers 3GPP access as unusable when its usage is prevented based on a UE implementation specific mechanism.

q_18467.question: In which scenarios can the paging procedure be performed in this given passage?
q_18467.ground_truth: The paging procedure can be performed if the ISR activated UE is in idle mode.

q_18468.question: What is the role of the Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_18468.ground_truth: The Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a concept in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project that enables the integration of different network elements and facilitates communication between them. It is used to define the NRM (Network Resource Model) and IRP (Integration Reference Point) requirements for managing shared radio equipment in GSM, UTRAN, and E-UTRAN networks.

q_18469.question: What is the primary function of the On-Demand Session mechanism in SIP?
q_18469.ground_truth: The On-Demand Session mechanism in SIP provides a mechanism to negotiate media parameters such as IP address, ports and codecs between the PoC Client and the home PoC Server when the user wants to establish a PoC session.

q_18470.question: What was the rendering approach for presenting the test materials to the participants?
q_18470.ground_truth: All test materials were rendered to a 22.2 speaker layout (CICP 13) and binauralized for presentation over headphones.

q_18471.question: What information is used for routing purposes in a broadcast call?
q_18471.ground_truth: The Country Code (CC) and National Destination Code (NDC) are used for routing purposes in a broadcast call.

q_18472.question: How long are the sequence numbers (SQN) in 3GPP authentication and key agreement functions?
q_18472.ground_truth: The sequence numbers (SQN) in 3GPP authentication and key agreement functions are 48 bits long.

q_18473.question: What is the name of the approach used to calculate DIP values based on the 'weighted average throughput gain'?
q_18473.ground_truth: The name of the approach is the 'weighted average throughput gain' method.

q_18474.question: In the context of FDD, what should the Node B do if the Dual Cell E-DCH Operation Enhancements Information IE is present in the Additional E-DCH FDD Information IE?
q_18474.ground_truth: The Node B should, if supported, use the information for the Secondary uplink frequency.

q_18475.question: What is the value of Ttb and Tra for a multislot class type 1 MS supporting MBMS?
q_18475.ground_truth: The values of Ttb and Tra are equal to 1, covering multislot classes 31-34, 41-45.

q_18476.question: What should be the first port number in a port number block for the RTP connection in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_18476.ground_truth: The first port number in a port number block for the RTP connection should be even and assigned to the RTP protocol.

q_18477.question: What is the action taken by the UE upon receiving the "MBMS modified services information" message from UTRAN?
q_18477.ground_truth: The UE modifies the services it has available in the current cell based on the "MBMS modified services information" message from UTRAN.

q_18478.question: What technology is used to resolve the xlink in the context of MPEG-DASH for live service?
q_18478.ground_truth: In the context of MPEG-DASH for live service, the xlink is resolved using the onLoad method, which immediately requests the xlinked resource.

q_18479.question: What subfield of the Call-Identifier field should be set to all values "1" when the SCC AS sends an I1 Success message to the ICS UE indicating a successfully established I1 session?
q_18479.ground_truth: The Call-Identifier (Part-2) subfield should be set to all values "1".

q_18480.question: What is the general observation regarding the computational complexity of a SAM receiver?
q_18480.ground_truth: The computational complexity of a SAM receiver depends upon subtle implementation details, but some general observations include the number of state transitions in the trellis, synchronization and estimation challenges, and potential re-use of known interference suppression algorithms from legacy DARP Phase I receivers.

q_18481.question: What is the procedure for terminating the RR connection establishment when it is established in response to an encapsulated DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message on the mobile station side?
q_18481.ground_truth: The procedure is terminated on the mobile station side when the establishment of the main signalling link is confirmed, the MM sublayer is informed that the RR entity has entered the dual transfer mode.

q_18482.question: What is the criterion for cell ranking in 3GPP TS 38.304, clause 5.2.4.6?
q_18482.ground_truth: The cell ranking criterion Rs for the serving cell and Rn for neighboring cells is defined by Rs = Qmeas,s - Qmeas,n, where Qmeas,s is the measured reference signal received power (RSRP) of the serving cell, and Qmeas,n is the measured RSRP of a neighboring cell, averaged over a certain time interval.

q_18483.question: What are the two methods described for TDM circuit management message handling at the SNSF?
q_18483.ground_truth: The two methods are message distribution based on circuit mapping data and message distribution based on broadcast mechanism.

q_18484.question: Which E-DCH physical channels are transmitted with equal power from the two antennas without STTD encoding when using the SF=512 DPCH?
q_18484.ground_truth: The TPC bits for the SF=512 DPCH, as well as the TPC bits for F-DPCH and F-TPICH are transmitted with equal power from the two antennas without STTD encoding.

q_18485.question: What is the primary motivation for the evolution of mobile networks?
q_18485.ground_truth: The primary motivation for the evolution of mobile networks is to improve the user experience.

q_18486.question: What must a mobile station do to indicate EGPRS capability in the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message?
q_18486.ground_truth: A mobile station supporting EGPRS must indicate its EGPRS capability in the MS Radio Access Capability 2 IE of the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message.

q_18487.question: What is the range of capacity performance for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, with MU-MIMO and 64 TxRU BS antenna when the data-rate is increased from 30Mbps to 45Mbps?
q_18487.ground_truth: The range of capacity performance is decreased from 7 to 5.3 UEs per cell with 30Mbps to 4.1 to 8.4 UEs per cell with 45Mbps.

q_18488.question: What message does the MGCF send to the IM-MGW when it receives a "Bearer Released" procedure from the IM-MGW in a session release initiated by the IM-MGW?
q_18488.ground_truth: The MGCF sends a BYE/CANCEL message to the IM CN subsystem side and releases the resources in the IM-MGW serving the relevant Mb interface connection by using the "Release IMS Termination" procedure.

q_18489.question: What should the SGSN include in the RAB Assignment Request message when establishing RABs for a given MS?
q_18489.ground_truth: The SGSN should include the MSISDN, APN, and charging characteristics in the RAB Assignment Request message when establishing RABs for a given MS.

q_18490.question: What is the purpose of implementing the SON Coordination Function as a separate function entity?
q_18490.ground_truth: Implementing the SON Coordination Function as a separate function entity allows it to coordinate all SON functions as a centralized control point, fulfilling the requirements of SON coordination in a large area scope.

q_18491.question: What is the meaning of the terms "Operating System (OS)", "Operating System Identifier (OSId)", and "OS specific Application Identifier (OSAppId)" as defined in the document?
q_18491.ground_truth: Operating System (OS) refers to a collection of UE software that provides common services for applications. Operating System Identifier (OSId) is an identifier that identifies the operating system, while OS specific Application Identifier (OSAppId) is an identifier that is associated with a given application and uniquely identifies the application within the UE for a given operating system.

q_18492.question: What does the Bitmap field in the Bitmap SUFI indicate?
q_18492.ground_truth: The Bitmap field in the Bitmap SUFI indicates the status of the radio resources granted by the upper layers, and is used to indicate the correctness of the reception of PDUs.

q_18493.question: What are the three layers of the protocol model that the Iuant interface is based on?
q_18493.ground_truth: The Physical Layer (Layer 1), The Data Link Layer (Layer 2), and The Application Layer (Layer 7)

q_18494.question: What is the relationship between a TEID and NSAPI/IMSI in the user plane?
q_18494.ground_truth: Each PDP context has a one-to-one relationship between the TEID and NSAPI and IMSI in the user plane.

q_18495.question: What factor is used to determine which part of the first stage codebook is searched in the first stage of the LP-CNG synthesis filter computation?
q_18495.ground_truth: The last component of the 16-dimensional LSF vector is used to determine which part of the first stage codebook is searched in the first stage of the LP-CNG synthesis filter computation, with a threshold of 6350.

q_18496.question: What is the benefit of not updating the remote UE with a new SDP offer when there is only one CS bearer associated with the SIP dialog on the Source Access Leg?
q_18496.ground_truth: The existing CS media is left intact, reducing the need for additional media negotiation and making the process more efficient.

q_18497.question: What is the comparative methodology used in the first listening test over headphones?
q_18497.ground_truth: The first test plan used the "comparative MUSHRA" methodology in the first listening test over headphones.

q_18498.question: What should the UE do when it receives an OPEN UE TEST LOOP message, and one or more user plane radio bearer test loops are closed?
q_18498.ground_truth: The UE shall open all test loops and send back to the SS an OPEN UE TEST LOOP COMPLETE message.

q_18499.question: What is the purpose of the initial counting procedure?
q_18499.ground_truth: The purpose of the initial counting procedure is to count the number of mobile stations interested in a session when starting an MBMS broadcast session or to determine if at least one user is interested in the MBMS channel before assigning the MBMS bearer in a cell at the time of the notification of the MBMS session.

q_18500.question: What message type is used to indicate that the eNB initiated WT Modification procedure has failed and is sent from WT to eNB?

q_18501.question: What is the 3GPP system feature used for real-time UAV connection status monitoring and location reporting?
q_18501.ground_truth: HTTP protocol is used for these functionalities and they are specified in TS 24.257.

q_18502.question: What measure is suggested for protecting the MSGin5G-5 interface, which is an internal interface between application client and a 5GMSGS client within the UE?
q_18502.ground_truth: The protection is taken care of by the UE implementation.

q_18503.question: What is the meaning of the term "Autonomous Network" as defined in the document?
q_18503.ground_truth: Autonomous Network is a telecommunication system (including management system and network) with autonomy capabilities which is able to be governed by itself with minimal to no human intervention.

q_18504.question: During the inter-system redirection procedure, what does the UE use for the emergency indication?
q_18504.ground_truth: The UE uses the emergency indication in the RRC message as specified in clause~6.2.2 of TS~36.331.

q_18505.question: How does the SFR enabled Feed Reader receive information about available feeds from the SFR server?
q_18505.ground_truth: The SFR enabled Feed Reader receives information about available feeds from the SFR server by retrieving it.

q_18506.question: What is the reason for the "Handover Required Not Supported Due To PUESBINE Feature" mapping in Relocation Failure to BSSMAP Handover Required Reject?
q_18506.ground_truth: This mapping indicates that the incoming relocation is not supported due to a PUESBINE feature.

q_18507.question: What are the two types of services provided by the AoC Function in the IMS charging architecture?
q_18507.ground_truth: AoC Service (AoCC) and AoC Information service (AoCI)

q_18508.question: What is the purpose of the bit scrambling process defined for scheduled and non-scheduled transmissions?
q_18508.ground_truth: The bit scrambling process is used to scramble the output of the spreading stage for scheduled and non-scheduled transmissions, which helps to randomize the data and protect it from being decoded by unintended receivers.

q_18509.question: When does a UE always consider HSDN cells to be the highest priority, and when are they considered to be the lowest priority?
q_18509.ground_truth: A UE always considers HSDN cells to be the highest priority when it is in High-mobility state, and the lowest priority when it is not in High-mobility state.

q_18510.question: What contains the features and bands supported by the UE and the eNodeB and is temporary data stored in the MME?

q_18511.question: What is the qualifier value for the soft key preferred in a proactive SIM command as per expected sequence 5.1?
q_18511.ground_truth: The qualifier value for soft key preferred is '01'.

q_18512.question: What is the purpose of the new resource in the UDR for issues #1, #2, #3, and #4?
q_18512.ground_truth: The purpose of the new resource in the UDR for issues #1, #2, #3, and #4 is to store restoration-related information, consisting of impacted components (i.e. Reset-IDs or SUPI ranges), lastReplicationTime, and recoveryTime.

q_18513.question: What is the role of an SDAP entity in the process of reflective QoS flow to DRB mapping?
q_18513.ground_truth: The SDAP entity receives/delivers SDAP SDUs from/to upper layers and submits/receives SDAP data PDUs to/from its peer SDAP entity via lower layers.

q_18514.question: What is the purpose of the minimum wait time in staggering the return of UEs trying to register in a PLMN with Disaster Condition?
q_18514.ground_truth: The minimum wait time is used to distribute and stagger the return of UEs trying to register in a PLMN with Disaster Condition, allowing them to make registration attempts only during specific windows of time. This helps to spread out registration attempts over time and keep the number of UEs attempting to register simultaneously within a manageable limit.

q_18515.question: What should the BSS do upon reception of the Redirection Completed IE with the Outcome value field set to "MS is accepted" or "MS is already registered" if it includes the Layer 3 Information LLC-PDU?
q_18515.ground_truth: The BSS shall send the LLC-PDU to the MS and terminate the Rerouting procedure.

q_18516.question: What does the APDU parameter contain in the BSSMAP-LE CONNECTIONLESS INFORMATION message?
q_18516.ground_truth: The APDU parameter contains an embedded APDU, which can be an LLP APDU or an SMLCPP APDU, depending on the source and destination of the message.

q_18517.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Report on Diameter-based protocols usage and recommendations in 3GPP (Release 17)?
q_18517.ground_truth: The report aims to ensure consistent and correct usage of Diameter within all 3GPP working groups, address the re-use of AVPs and other Diameter BASE related decisions, and serve as a placeholder for Diameter inter-operator considerations.

q_18518.question: What is the impact on the RAN when the UE-initiated RRC leaving procedure with (NAS) release assistance info is triggered?
q_18518.ground_truth: The RAN is responsible for providing release assistance info to the AMF, sending a response message to the UE, and releasing the UE locally if no response is received from the network before the UE RRC timer expires.

q_18519.question: How does downlink adaptation work in the Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) speech service?
q_18519.ground_truth: During downlink adaptation, the DL Mode Request Generator within the mobile compares the DL Quality indicator with certain thresholds and generates a Codec Mode Request indicating the preferred codec mode for the downlink.
