q_19273.question: What is the purpose of the "UE Positioning GPS Reference Time Uncertainty" information element in a measurement report?
q_19273.ground_truth: The "UE Positioning GPS Reference Time Uncertainty" information element is included in a measurement report to provide the uncertainty of the GPS Time of Week (TOW) when the measurements were valid.

q_19274.question: What is the notation used for referring to an Information Element in the specification?
q_19274.ground_truth: The notation for referring to an Information Element in the specification is to write the Information Element Name with the first letters in each word in upper case characters and all letters in Italic font followed by the abbreviation "IE".

q_19275.question: What is the maximum time that the UE will wait for the user to grant or withhold permission for location before returning a notification result to the SGSN?
q_19275.ground_truth: The UE waits for the user to grant or withhold permission, or until a predetermined time period expires.

q_19276.question: What is the benefit of using alphq-QPSK to support legacy non-SAIC terminals to be VAMOS allocated?
q_19276.ground_truth: The benefit is an increase in gain from 49% to 70% using VAMOS I terminals and from 49% to 76% using VAMOS II terminals.

q_19277.question: What is the main reason for the significant performance improvement of the coding schemes at higher symbol rate?
q_19277.ground_truth: Most of the gain is coming because of additional code space.

q_19278.question: How does the distributed CAPIF approach support the Edge Application Server's service APIs publish and discovery?
q_19278.ground_truth: The distributed CAPIF approach allows the Edge Application Server to access the service APIs offered by other Edge Application Servers within and across the Edge Data Network by providing CAPIF functions. The Edge Enabler Server of an Edge Data Network provides the CAPIF core function to support onboarding of Edge Application Servers, publish Edge Application Server's service APIs, discover Edge Application Server's service APIs, and charge Edge Application Server's service API invocations.

q_19279.question: What action will the UE take when it encounters an IPFlow instance with a EndSourcePortNumber leaf without a correspondent StartSourcePortNumber leaf?
q_19279.ground_truth: The UE ignores the IPFlow instance with a EndSourcePortNumber leaf without a correspondent StartSourcePortNumber leaf. If the IPFlow instance is the only one contained in the flow distribution rule, the UE ignores the flow distribution rule.

q_19280.question: How many BSRs can be included in one MAC PDU?
q_19280.ground_truth: The MAC entity shall transmit at most one BSR in one MAC PDU.

q_19281.question: What is the maximum size of a video packet in multimedia telephony over IMS?
q_19281.ground_truth: The size of each packet shall be kept smaller than 512 bytes.

q_19282.question: What is the action taken when the Pending-time-after-trigger for an event elapses for event type "4a"?
q_19282.ground_truth: If the TCTV is larger than the threshold in IE "Reporting threshold", a report for the corresponding measurement identified by the IE "Measurement Identity" is triggered, and the Pending-time-after-trigger timer for this event is started with the value in this IE. If the TCTV is smaller than the threshold in IE "Reporting threshold", the Time-to-trigger timer for this event is started with the value in the IE "Time to trigger".

q_19283.question: In what situation does the RF need to respond with new tariff information multiple times during an online charging session?
q_19283.ground_truth: This can occur when the defined tariff has a limited number of valid units and the granted units are used completely, causing the SBCF to request new tariff information in order to continue bearer/session charging.

q_19284.question: Which functional entity in CAMEL provides various specialized resources?

q_19285.question: What is the purpose of the jitter buffer in the eCall verification system?
q_19285.ground_truth: The jitter buffer in the eCall verification system is used to compensate for variance in end-to-end delay and ensure the timely arrival of data packets at the gateway.

q_19286.question: What should users be careful about when it comes to mobile phone software installation?
q_19286.ground_truth: Users should be careful when installing unauthentic software onto their mobile phones and should only install software from known and trusted sources.

q_19287.question: What is the difference between the roles of an NPN service provider in the example of NPN service provider A?
q_19287.ground_truth: NPN service provider A acts as a management service consumer when obtaining the allowed management capability to manage a provided NPN from an NPN management service producer (e.g., NPN operator A). It acts as a management service producer when offering the allowed management capability to another NPN service provider B to manage the NPN service provider A's NPN as an NPN management service consumer.

q_19288.question: What is the difference between a shared session leg and an individual session leg in the multicast communication service?
q_19288.ground_truth: A shared session leg is between a MSA and a UPF or between a MSA and a RAN node, while an individual session leg is between a MSA and a UE, which may be via a UPF.

q_19289.question: What is the eCall In-band Modem used for?
q_19289.ground_truth: The eCall In-band Modem is used for the reliable transmission of the eCall Minimum Set of Data (MSD) from an IVS to the PSAP via the voice channel of cellular and PSTN networks.

q_19290.question: In the test procedure, what delay is applied to the downlink timing for Cell 1 in step 3?

q_19291.question: Which filter parameter is required to be at least 56dB in Scenario 2a for co-location of UTRA-FDD and UTRA-TDD?
q_19291.ground_truth: The filter attenuation requirement in the range 1900 - 1915 MHz should be at least 56dB for co-location of UTRA-FDD and UTRA-TDD in Scenario 2a.

q_19292.question: Which MAC function performs the identification of UEs on common transport channels?
q_19292.ground_truth: The MAC function that performs the identification of UEs on common transport channels is the identification of UEs on common transport channels.

q_19293.question: What action does one of the remote parties (e.g. B) request before holding the conversation?
q_19293.ground_truth: The remote party requests to hold the conversation

q_19294.question: What happens to the resources associated with the RABs indicated as failed to set up during the Relocation Resource Allocation procedure?
q_19294.ground_truth: The resources associated with the RABs indicated as failed to set up are not released in the CN until the relocation is completed.

q_19295.question: What is the packet data protocol used in the first OPEN CHANNEL command?
q_19295.ground_truth: The packet data protocol used in the first OPEN CHANNEL command is IP.

q_19296.question: Which color icons were used in the AT Response String?
q_19296.ground_truth: Dark Green Foreground and Bright Yellow Background.

q_19297.question: What should the MS do upon successfully completing the handover from GAN Iu mode?
q_19297.ground_truth: Switch to the target radio access technology mode, enter the GA-RC-REGISTERED state, release all GAN radio resources and may deregister from the GANC.

q_19298.question: In clause 5.3.14.5 in TS 38.331, what should the UE do if one or more Access Identities are indicated and the corresponding bit in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity is set to zero?
q_19298.ground_truth: The UE should consider the access attempt as allowed.

q_19299.question: For 64 PRB, which filter offers the best performance in central allocations, and in edge band allocations, which filter provides up to 0.8-1.1 dB gain?
q_19299.ground_truth: In central allocations, Triang B offers the best performance; in edge band allocations, the 0.335 filter provides up to 0.8-1.1 dB gain.

q_19300.question: When should a random IOV-I value be negotiated for ciphering in the LLE?
q_19300.ground_truth: A random IOV-I value shall be negotiated in the following situations: after a change of ciphering key to a different value, or after ABM is re-established for an LLE if the ciphering key is not changed to a different value since ABM was last established for this LLE.

q_19301.question: What should the WT take into account when it receives the WT ADDITION REQUEST message containing the Serving PLMN IE?
q_19301.ground_truth: If the WT ADDITION REQUEST message contains the Serving PLMN IE, the WT may take it into account for the allocation of resources for LWA.

q_19302.question: What is the type of the "rb-IdentityForHOMessage" information element in the SRNC-RelocationInfo-r13-IEs sequence?
q_19302.ground_truth: The type of the "rb-IdentityForHOMessage" information element in the SRNC-RelocationInfo-r13-IEs sequence is RB-Identity.

q_19303.question: What is the access technology of the network measurement result in the later proactive command?

q_19304.question: What is the purpose of the Synchronisation Report Characteristics IE?
q_19304.ground_truth: The Synchronisation Report Characteristics IE indicates how the reporting of the cell synchronisation burst measurement shall be performed.

q_19305.question: What should the Node B do when it receives a TNL CONGESTION INDICATION control frame indicating "TNL Congestion - detected by frame loss"?
q_19305.ground_truth: The Node B should reduce the bit rate for the MAC-d flow on which the congestion indication control frame was received.

q_19306.question: Which component is responsible for handling the interrogation of CFNRc in the data request procedure?

q_19307.question: What is the procedure of VNF package on-boarding?
q_19307.ground_truth: The procedure involves NM sending OnboardVnfPackageRequest to NFVO with input parameters to on-board a VNF package, and NFVO sending OnboardVnfPackageResponse to NM with vnfPackageId to indicate a VNF package has been on-boarded.

q_19308.question: What should the Node B do if it supports the "C" or "RACH" Common Measurement Object Type and receives a COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message with that Common Measurement Object Type?
q_19308.ground_truth: The Node B should include the C-ID IE in the COMMON MEASUREMENT REPORT message.

q_19309.question: What is the name of the entropy coding engine used in H.265 (HEVC) for video coding?
q_19309.ground_truth: The name of the entropy coding engine used in H.265 (HEVC) for video coding is Context Adaptive Binary Arithmetic Coding (CABAC).

q_19310.question: What is the role of the virtualisation layer in abstracting hardware resources?
q_19310.ground_truth: The virtualisation layer in a generic virtualised network product abstracts hardware resources and decouples the VNF software from the underlying hardware, providing virtualised resources and an execution environment for network functions.

q_19311.question: What is the pass criteria for the "Initial SSRC Value Test"?
q_19311.ground_truth: The pass criteria for this test are application-level output (audio and/or video) from the SUT that is equal to or compatible with the expected output and is not distorted. The test result is agnostic to whether RTP packets are sent by the SUT or not.

q_19312.question: What is the size range of DUTs that use the PDA alignment procedure in 5.1.6.3?
q_19312.ground_truth: The PDA alignment procedure in 5.1.6.3 is used for DUTs that are from 56 to 72 mm wide.

q_19313.question: What is the role of the spectral tilt in this process?
q_19313.ground_truth: The spectral tilt is used to adjust the high frequency TRANSIENT signal classification of the current frame based on the energy distribution in the low frequency signal.

q_19314.question: What does the term 'TMGI' refer to in the document?
q_19314.ground_truth: TMGI stands for Temporary Mobile Group Identity, which is used to identify a Multimedia Broadcast multicast Service (MBMS) service.

q_19315.question: When would a TBF establishment failure occur if the information available in the mobile station after the reception of an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT or IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message does not satisfactorily define a PDCH?
q_19315.ground_truth: A TBF establishment failure occurs if the information available in the mobile station after the reception of an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT or IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message does not define a PDCH, indicating an issue with the packet data channel assignment.

q_19316.question: What is the source device in the SEND SHORT MESSAGE command?

q_19317.question: Which field is mandatory and which one is optional in the UEContextReleaseCompleteIEs list?
q_19317.ground_truth: The "id-ngeNB-CU-UE-W1AP-ID" and "id-ngeNB-DU-UE-W1AP-ID" fields are mandatory in the UEContextReleaseCompleteIEs list, while the "id-CriticalityDiagnostics" field is optional.

q_19318.question: What should be done when on receipt of a message, and a "missing mandatory IE" error is diagnosed?
q_19318.ground_truth: The receiver should ignore the message and return a BSSAP+-MOBILE-STATUS message with the Gs Cause Value set to "missing mandatory information element" and shall return the Erroneous message information element containing the received message.

q_19319.question: What satellite system's clock model (Model-2) is used when the UE only supports Modernized GPS?
q_19319.ground_truth: The GNSS-NavigationModel (Model-2) for GPS is used when the UE only supports Modernized GPS.

q_19320.question: What is the purpose of the CTS mobile group list information element?
q_19320.ground_truth: The CTS mobile group list information element provides a list containing up to 8 CTSMSI.

q_19321.question: In the context of FDD, what should the DRNS do if there is an additional E-DCH resource request with a common generation of E-RGCH information with another E-DCH resource request?
q_19321.ground_truth: The DRNS should set the same value for the E-DCH RL Set ID IE for the additional E-DCH RL in the Additional E-DCH FDD Information Response IE.

q_19322.question: What is the purpose of Discontinuous Reception (DRX) in the GSM system?
q_19322.ground_truth: The purpose of DRX is to allow the mobile station to power down its internal circuitry for a high percentage of the time when it is in idle mode, while ensuring it is aware of exactly when page requests for it may be transmitted.

q_19323.question: What measures does the 3GPP system support for security and policy in MPS MMTEL video or video conference calls?
q_19323.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support measures to verify policy and admit an incoming MPS for MMTEL video or video conference call/session received from another network with priority.

q_19324.question: What is the purpose of the location management and mobility management concept areas?
q_19324.ground_truth: The purpose of the location management and mobility management concept areas is to provide mobility functionality for different services. The areas used include LA and RA in the CN as well as UTRAN Registration Area, GERAN Registration Area and Cell areas in the RAN.

q_19325.question: What should the UTRAN do to set a new TFC sub-set and specify its duration and activation time?
q_19325.ground_truth: The UTRAN should set the allowed TFCs in the "Transport Format Combination subset" (TFC subset) IE, specify the duration for which the new TFC sub-set applies by using the "TFC Control duration" IE, and independently specify the time at which a new TFC sub-set shall be applied using the "Activation time for TFC subset" IE.

q_19326.question: What is the function of the Service Centre (SC) in the context of Short Message Service (SMS)?
q_19326.ground_truth: The Service Centre (SC) is responsible for relaying and storing short messages between an SME and an MS. It is not a part of the GSM/UMTS PLMN, but it may be integrated with the MSC.

q_19327.question: What is the procedure when the trusted WLAN access becomes unusable in Network-initiated NBIFOM mode?
q_19327.ground_truth: The UE sends a Request Bearer Resource Modification message including a WLAN unusable indication, which is then processed by the MME, PDN GW, and PCRF, resulting in the movement of IP flows from WLAN to 3GPP.

q_19328.question: In the case of a QUIC Connection per QoS Flow, what are the two options for triggering a QUIC Connection?
q_19328.ground_truth: The two options for triggering a QUIC Connection per QoS Flow are: triggered by "QUIC Connection Setup information" sent from UPF to SMF to UE, or triggered when UE receives a new QoS Rule.

q_19329.question: What is the function of the Circuit End Point Subgroup (CEG) in the Core Network (CN)?
q_19329.ground_truth: The Circuit End Point Subgroup (CEG) is a network element in the Core Network (CN) responsible for managing circuit switched connections in the 3G system.

q_19330.question: When can the IM-MGW ignore the request to notify the start of a digit?
q_19330.ground_truth: An IM-MGW not supporting the notification about the detection of the start of a digit may ignore the request to provide this notification.

q_19331.question: What should be the behavior of a network if a cell/UTRAN frequency is provided for an index higher than 95 in the 3G Neighbour Cell list?
q_19331.ground_truth: The network should not include the cell/UTRAN frequency in the 3G Neighbour Cell list if it is provided for an index higher than 95.

q_19332.question: What is the purpose of the Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) in network communication?
q_19332.ground_truth: The ARP is used to contain information about the priority level, pre-emption capability, and pre-emption vulnerability of a resource request. This allows for appropriate resource allocation decisions to be made, such as during admission control of GBR traffic or network resource management.

q_19333.question: What is the compatibility requirement for the SCCP interfaces between networks in a portability domain when using call-related MAP messages?
q_19333.ground_truth: The SCCP addressing mechanism used for call-related MAP messages should be agreed upon by the networks in a portability domain.

q_19334.question: What is the function of the UE Selected MBMS Service Information?
q_19334.ground_truth: This IE defines the parameters used for the UE selected MBMS service for 1.28 Mcps TDD.

q_19335.question: What is the trigger for the Xn based individual to shared switch procedure in Solution 29?
q_19335.ground_truth: The Xn based individual to shared switch procedure in Solution 29 is triggered by UE mobility and a switch from individual to shared delivery method.

q_19336.question: What is the purpose of the network slice throughput statistics/predictions in the MDAS producer's analytics report?
q_19336.ground_truth: The network slice throughput statistics/predictions in the MDAS producer's analytics report provide a means to identify throughput degradation issues and the root cause, as per 6.3.4.3.5.

q_19337.question: What message does the old SGSN send to the new SGSN in inter-SGSN inter-RAT/mode PS handover to initiate the relocation resource allocation procedure?
q_19337.ground_truth: A Forward Relocation Request message containing various information such as IMSI, Target Identification, MM Context, PDP Context, and more.

q_19338.question: What action should the HA take if it receives a Binding Update from the UE with a BID mobility option and a Flow summary mobility option?
q_19338.ground_truth: The HA should process the received Binding Update message and send a Binding Acknowledgement message as specified in subclause~5.1.3.2.

q_19339.question: What is provided by the MPD URL in the "Dynamic Interactive Ads During Live Sports Event" use case?
q_19339.ground_truth: The resolution of the MPD URL may be used to serve custom ads in this use case.

q_19340.question: What is the purpose of the system impact described in section 6.9.3 of the document?
q_19340.ground_truth: The purpose of the system impact described in section 6.9.3 of the document is to indicate that the UDM acts as the DCS to provide default credentials for the onboarding of UE.

q_19341.question: What is the maximum bitrate that UE-B wants to receive, as indicated in the SDP answer?
q_19341.ground_truth: UE-B wants to receive a maximum of 5.2 Mbps, including IPv6/UDP/RTP overhead.

q_19342.question: What timer is started when a mobile station receives a PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message in the allocated radio block on the assigned PDCH for an MBMS session?

q_19343.question: What is the purpose of steps 6 and 7 in PC5 communication?
q_19343.ground_truth: In step 6, the UE-to-network relay is authenticated and authorized by the network to act as a relay. In step 7, the UE-to-network relay retrieves a discovery key from the network for UE-to-network relay discovery.

q_19344.question: What does the "Queuing Indicator" element's second octet's first bit (qri) indicate, regarding queuing recommendations by the BSS?
q_19344.ground_truth: The "Queuing Indicator" element's second octet's first bit (qri) indicates whether queuing is recommended to be allowed or not.

q_19345.question: What are the three types of REFRESH defined in "27.22.4.7.1.2 Conformance requirement" for file change notification for the SIM initialization?
q_19345.ground_truth: The three types are SIM Initialization, File Change Notification, and Full File Change Notification.

q_19346.question: How is the calibration antenna replaced with the Equipment Under Test (EUT) in the measurement stage?
q_19346.ground_truth: In the measurement stage, the calibration antenna is replaced with the EUT and the measured EIRP level produced by the EUT is measured at the PM.

q_19347.question: How does the NWDAF request collected data from lower levels of hierarchy?
q_19347.ground_truth: The NWDAF sends a request to lower level NWDAFs for the necessary data, and this process can be recursively performed until reaching NFs or OAM that directly collect from NFs/OAM.

q_19348.question: What is the effect of successfully completing the SNDCP XID negotiation in 3GPP?
q_19348.ground_truth: When the SNDCP XID negotiation is successfully completed, the SNDCP layer resumes the transfer of LL-DATA primitives, and if the transfer of LL-UNITDATA primitives was suspended, it is also resumed.

q_19349.question: What is the 3GPP technical specification for the 4th phase of Customized Applications for Mobile network Enhanced Logic (CAMEL) feature within the 3GPP system?
q_19349.ground_truth: The technical specification is IM CN Interworking (Release 17).

q_19350.question: In A/Gb mode, what is the maximum number of assigned PDTCH/Ds for one broadcast/multicast session, excluding the (P)BCCH and (P)CCCH?
q_19350.ground_truth: The maximum number of assigned PDTCH/Ds is 4.

q_19351.question: What should be done if a mobile receives "1111" in a position prior to the last semi-octet?
q_19351.ground_truth: Processing should commence with the next semi-octet and the intervening semi-octet shall be ignored.

q_19352.question: What is one of the functions of the hovering RAN mounted on the UAVs in the rescue operation?
q_19352.ground_truth: The hovering RAN adjusts its coverage based on the users it needs to serve to save power.

q_19353.question: How does the DCCF ensure the security of data transfer between AF and NWDAF?
q_19353.ground_truth: The DCCF provides keys to data consumers and data producers to establish security for data transfer and uses current NAS and SBA based security mechanisms for authentication, confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection.

q_19354.question: What should the UE do after receiving the SIB1 in LTE?
q_19354.ground_truth: The UE shall store the acquired SIB1, use the specified PLMN-IdentityInfo if the cellAccessRelatedInfo contains an entry with the PLMN-Identity of the selected PLMN, and perform the actions specified in clause 5.2.2.4.2 in LTE after receiving the SIB1.

q_19355.question: What is the main functionality of the CSI AS in IMS?
q_19355.ground_truth: The main functionality of the CSI AS is to retrieve CSI related capabilities of UEs, control CSI termination with third-party call control logic, perform termination logic, map a SIP URI to an associated Tel URI, decide whether to keep itself in the session path or not, and handle session separation/forwarding for session initiation, modification, and termination requests.

q_19356.question: How many GSM frequency carriers should a UE measure per FDD frequency in the monitored set for FDD measurements?
q_19356.ground_truth: The UE shall be capable of performing FDD measurements for 6 inter-frequency cells per FDD frequency of the monitored set.

q_19357.question: What is the purpose of the UAS security context in the solution?
q_19357.ground_truth: The UAS security context is used to set up a secure connection between the UAV and the USS/UTM.

q_19358.question: What is the role of the relay in the PDU Session secondary A&A procedure?
q_19358.ground_truth: The relay is responsible for forwarding authentication messages between the SMF and Remote UE. It also stores any received authorization info associated with the Remote UE and proceeds with the rest of the PC5 link setup with Remote UE upon successful secondary A&A.

q_19359.question: What should the UE do with the stored SOR-CMCI in the non-volatile memory of the ME when it receives a new USIM?
q_19359.ground_truth: The UE should delete the SOR-CMCI when a new USIM is inserted.

q_19360.question: What is the scope of the present document, "Performance Management (PM) Integration Reference Point (IRP): Information Service (IS)"?
q_19360.ground_truth: The present document specifies the Information Service for the Performance Management Integration Reference Point (PM IRP) as it applies to the Itf-N. It defines the semantics of operations and their parameters in a protocol and technology neutral way, and is aligned with ITU-T M.3704 in terms of the definitions of operations for Performance management.

q_19361.question: What is the interface between the MCData User Database and the MCData Server referred to as in 3GPP TS 23.282?

q_19362.question: In which state will the UE remain if it is in EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substate and needs to construct the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message for inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode?
q_19362.ground_truth: The UE will remain in EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.

q_19363.question: What is the purpose of the Re-Auth-Request message in the scenario?
q_19363.ground_truth: The Re-Auth-Request message from the OCS to the IMS-GWF/AS is used to request new Reserve Units Request after cancelling any pending announcements.

q_19364.question: Which type of animal has the longest gestation period?

q_19365.question: What are the possible reasons for a routeing area update procedure to take place in a GPRS network?
q_19365.ground_truth: A routeing area update procedure takes place when a GPRS-attached MS detects that it has entered a new RA, when the periodic RA update timer has expired, when the MS has to indicate changed access capabilities or DRX parameters to the network, or when other specific conditions occur.

q_19366.question: What should UTRAN do upon receiving an indication about the failure of a handover from the other radio access technology?
q_19366.ground_truth: UTRAN should release the associated resources and the context information concerning this UE.

q_19367.question: What is the impact of adding new SDP parameters on the IMS-AGW, TrGW, and MRFP nodes?
q_19367.ground_truth: The new bandwidth information would need to be provided to the IMS-AGW, TrGW and MRFP via the Iq interface, Ix interface and Mp interfaces, respectively.

q_19368.question: What is the definition of survival time in the context of 5G system design?
q_19368.ground_truth: Survival time is defined as the time that an application consuming a communication service may continue without an anticipated message, indicating to the communication service the time available to recover from message delivery failures.

q_19369.question: What is the effect of the Time Alignment feature on queuing delay in AoIP?
q_19369.ground_truth: The Time Alignment feature can eliminate queuing delay for over 30% of the calls in AoIP and increase the percentage of calls experiencing no queuing delay as the loading factor is reduced. This is because independent channels processed on the same Media Gateway CPU may have overlapping phase requirements, and a lower loading factor and higher CPU channel capacity can increase the effectiveness of Time Alignment.

q_19370.question: What is the rule for the rate matching pattern determination?
q_19370.ground_truth: The rule for the rate matching pattern determination is that if puncturing is to be performed, then the bit is punctured if the error between current and desired puncturing ratio is less than or equal to zero. IfPUnturing is not to be performed, then the bit is repeated if the error is less than zero. The error is updated after each check and the next bit is checked in the subsequent steps. A repeated bit is placed directly after the original one.

q_19371.question: How does the Incoming Communications Barring (ICB) service impact a user's ability to originate outgoing communications?
q_19371.ground_truth: The ICB service does not affect a user's ability to originate outgoing communications.

q_19372.question: What should an EATF instance do if there is no dialog associated with the domain transfer request in step 3a in the procedure described in clause 6c.2.3.1?
q_19372.ground_truth: The EATF instance rejects the session transfer request.

q_19373.question: What method can be used to control the transmission power of HUE based on path loss from the HUE to its worst victim MeNB?
q_19373.ground_truth: Smart power control based on path loss to worst victim macro eNodeB, either by the Power Cap Method or Power Control based on PL from HUE to its serving HeNB and PL from HUE to its worst victim MeNB.

q_19374.question: What is the position of the dSCH-InformationResponse field in the DSCH-InformationListIEs-RL-AdditionRspTDD structure?
q_19374.ground_truth: DSCH-InformationListIEs-RL-AdditionRspTDD structure is a ProtocolIE-Single-Container that contains the DSCH-InformationListIEs-RL-AdditionRspTDD field.

q_19375.question: What is one of the steps taken by Intent driven MnS Producer when executing a network provisioning intent?
q_19375.ground_truth: Intent driven MnS Producer may analyze network requirements indicated in the network provisioning intent and decide to use a network with or without slicing to satisfy the intent.

q_19376.question: What happens if the cli-TriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for a specific measId is empty and reportType is set to cli-Periodical?
q_19376.ground_truth: If the cli-TriggeredList for a measId is empty and reportType is set to cli-Periodical, the measurement reporting entry for that measId is removed from the VarMeasReportList and the periodical reporting timer for that measId, if running, is stopped.

q_19377.question: What is the purpose of the test in 8.1.3.1.13.1 (1), given that the SS/PBCH block sorting quantity is above absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation for each beam of the Neighbour Cell?
q_19377.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to ensure that the UE sends a MeasurementReport message containing rsIndexResults with resultsSSB-Indexes.

q_19378.question: What is the difference between CALL CONTROL RESULT 1.7.1 and CALL CONTROL RESULT 1.8.1 in terms of the call control result?
q_19378.ground_truth: Both CALL CONTROL RESULT 1.7.1 and CALL CONTROL RESULT 1.8.1 have the same call control result "Allowed, with modification". However, they differ in the values of TON, NPI, and Address value in the Address field.

q_19379.question: What is the purpose of the number comparison procedure described in 4.2.1.2.2.3 of the document?
q_19379.ground_truth: The purpose of the number comparison procedure is to compare the destination number triggering criterion and the address information in the correct order, taking into account the numbering plan indicators and the type of number/nature of address indicators.

q_19380.question: What actions do MCData clients take when the payload contains application data or command instructions?
q_19380.ground_truth: If the policy assertion is positive, the MCData clients notify the target MCData users. If the payload is addressed to a known local non-MCData application, the MCData client starts the local non-MCData application and passes the payload content to it.

q_19381.question: When does the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.1?
q_19381.ground_truth: The UE initiates this procedure only after successful AS security activation and for the measId that triggered the measurement reporting.

q_19382.question: How does the IC-A1 handle the Via header field while the interconnection network is SIP-unaware?
q_19382.ground_truth: The IC-A1 does not add any "transit-ioi" header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field while the interconnection network is SIP-unaware.

q_19383.question: What is the NOTE~3 in the media flow transfer process between UE-2 and UE-1 (Controller UE)?
q_19383.ground_truth: If there are other media flows in the Collaborative Session besides the Media Flow-A (Media-A), these other media flows are not impacted by the Inter-UE Transfer operation.

q_19384.question: What happens when the eP-CSCF (IMS-ALG) receives an SDP offer or answer from the IMS core network that disables media streams transported within a WebRTC data channel, but maintains other media streams?
q_19384.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF (IMS-ALG) forwards the SDP offer or answer to the WebRTC access network with the corresponding WebRTC data channel disabled.

q_19385.question: What is the impact of timing offset on the performance of frequency layer aggregation?
q_19385.ground_truth: One source observed that the performance of aggregation of frequency layers degrades if timing offset is increased.

q_19386.question: Where must the MPS indicator be stored in the UE?
q_19386.ground_truth: The MPS indicator is stored in the UE together with a PLMN identity of the PLMN that provided it, and is valid in that RPLMN or equivalent PLMN.

q_19387.question: What must the UE and P-CSCF do if the UE has an already active pair of security associations?
q_19387.ground_truth: The UE should use this to protect the REGISTER message. If the S-CSCF is notified by the P-CSCF that the REGISTER message from the UE was integrity-protected, it may decide not to authenticate the user. However, the UE may send unprotected REGISTER messages at any time, and the S-CSCF shall authenticate the user by means of the AKA protocol. In particular, if the UE considers the SAs no longer active at the P-CSCF, it should send an unprotected REGISTER message.

q_19388.question: What should the UE do with the stored list of equivalent PLMNs when the forbidden PLMN list changes?
q_19388.ground_truth: The UE should remove any PLMN code that is already in the list of forbidden PLMNs from the list of equivalent PLMNs when the UE is registering for a non-emergency service and when the forbidden PLMN list changes.

q_19389.question: What is the purpose of the mechanical stirrers and metallic stirrers in the reverberation chamber?
q_19389.ground_truth: The mechanical stirrers and metallic stirrers are used to simulate the Rayleigh fading at each antenna of the terminal inside the reverberation chamber, which allows for the measurement of several UE metrics such as throughput and total isotropic sensitivity.

q_19390.question: How should the type of device that recorded the media be indicated in 3GP-DASH?
q_19390.ground_truth: The type of the device that recorded the media might be useful to the 3GP-DASH client, this information should be indicated in the Metadata of the MPD, and could be used to customize the MPD or content for the user based on their selections.

q_19391.question: What is the procedure for initiating a new registration procedure for an incompatible slice?
q_19391.ground_truth: When the UE wants to initiate a PDU session for an incompatible slice, it needs to implicitly release the PDU sessions for the incompatible slice by sending a Registration Request and indicating that the PDU session for the incompatible slice is implicitly released. The AMF then proceeds with the registration procedure and sends a Registration Accept if the slice is allowed.

q_19392.question: What IP versions are supported by the 3GPP technical specification for transport over IP?
q_19392.ground_truth: IPv4 (RFC 791) is supported, and IPv6 (RFC 2460) may be supported as an option.

q_19393.question: How many accounting data types are used for session based charging in offline charging?
q_19393.ground_truth: Three accounting data types (START, INTERIM, and STOP) are used for session based charging in offline charging.

q_19394.question: When is the End User Address IE Length set to 22, if both addresses are static?
q_19394.ground_truth: The End User Address IE Length is set to 22 if both the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are static.

q_19395.question: What is the range of the reflection coefficients, r(i), as calculated by the Schur algorithm?
q_19395.ground_truth: The range of the reflection coefficients, r(i), as calculated by the Schur algorithm is -1 < = r(i) < = +1.

q_19396.question: What is one of the enhancements made to the Load-Balancing steering mode in Rel-17 of the ATSSS work?
q_19396.ground_truth: In Rel-17, the network can provide an "autonomous load-balance indicator" in the Load-Balancing steering mode, allowing the UE and UPF to freely select their own percentages for each access type.

q_19397.question: When should the mobile station send a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message?
q_19397.ground_truth: The mobile station should send a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message if upper layers have requested the transfer of an upper layer PDU with a different PFI, radio priority, peak throughput class, or RLC mode than the one which is in transfer, and the new upper layer PDU shall be transferred with the same RLC mode as the current uplink TBF.

q_19398.question: What is the definition of Synchronized PS handover?
q_19398.ground_truth: Synchronized PS handover is a type of PS handover where the time bases of the involved cells are synchronized, and no timing advance is required.

q_19399.question: What should the DRNC include in the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message for neighboring cells controlled by the DRNC if the number of neighboring UMTS RNCs is beyond the predefined maximum number?
q_19399.ground_truth: If the number of neighboring UMTS RNCs is beyond the predefined maximum number, the DRNC should include the remaining neighboring information in the Neighbouring UMTS Cell Information Extension IE.

q_19400.question: Which bandwidth value is used for sub-carriers in the uplink and sidelink in the LTE system?
q_19400.ground_truth: Single-Carrier Frequency Division Multiple Access (SC-FDMA) with a cyclic prefix

q_19401.question: What is one of the main concerns regarding the use of robotic surgery in kidney transplants?
q_19401.ground_truth: The main concerns are the longer procedure duration and the higher medical costs compared to open surgery.

q_19402.question: What is the definition methodology for the protocol in the CAMEL Application Part (CAP) specification?
q_19402.ground_truth: The definition of the protocol is split into three sections: the definition of the Single Association Control Function (SACF)/Multiple Association Control Function (MACF) rules for the protocol, the definition of the operations transferred between entities in Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN.1), and the definition of the actions taken at each entity in terms of state transition diagrams.

q_19403.question: What should the NAS do if the event which triggered the access attempt was a request from upper layers to modify an existing PDU session, and the NAS did not initiate the NAS transport procedure?
q_19403.ground_truth: Upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category, the NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

q_19404.question: How does the RDS protocol support multiple applications on the UE to simultaneously conduct data transfers with their peer entities on the network using a single PDN connection or a PDU session between the UE and the network?
q_19404.ground_truth: The RDS protocol enables applications to reserve source and destination port numbers for their use and also subsequently release the reserved port numbers. It also provides functionality for flow control and sequence control to maintain the sequential order of frames across the logical link.

q_19405.question: When should the VLR receive supplementary service data?
q_19405.ground_truth: When the service is provisioned and the SS data is EBSG-related.

q_19406.question: What actions are taken when the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM for the corresponding HARQ process expires in the 5G NR system?
q_19406.ground_truth: If the data of the corresponding HARQ process was not successfully decoded, the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM is started for the corresponding HARQ process.

q_19407.question: What is the name of the command line option used for HDR content in Scenario 1?

q_19408.question: Which information element provides the CTSMSI for paging purposes?
q_19408.ground_truth: The CTSMSI information element is used to provide the CTSMSI for paging purposes.

q_19409.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals - Generic Authentication Architecture (GAA)?
q_19409.ground_truth: The GAA defines procedures, message contents, and coding for implementing Diameter and Web Services based interfaces in GAA, including Zh, Zn, and Zpn interfaces for HSS resolution and security association bootstrapping.

q_19410.question: What is the role of the UE-to-UE Relay in Solution #8?
q_19410.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay in Solution #8 plays the role of forwarding communication between the source UE and target UE using asymmetric cryptography for confidentiality and integrity protection.

q_19411.question: What should the mobile station do if it has performed the GPRS suspension procedure and the GPRS Resumption information element is not included in the message?
q_19411.ground_truth: The mobile station should indicate a RR GPRS resumption failure to the MM sublayer and not perform the GPRS resumption.

q_19412.question: What is the function of the SMF in Solution #23: N3GPP for MUSIM Service Concurrency?
q_19412.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for deciding how to handle the PDU session after receiving the MT data handling info from the AMF and initiating MT data handling instructions to the UPF.

q_19413.question: What is the purpose of Fault Management (FM) in a 3GPP system?
q_19413.ground_truth: The purpose of FM is to detect failures as soon as they occur and to limit their effects on the network Quality of Service (QoS) as far as possible.

q_19414.question: What information is included in the I-WLAN tunnel establishment-event?
q_19414.ground_truth: The I-WLAN tunnel establishment-event includes information such as the target identity, events and associated parameters, target location, correlation number, Quality of Service (QoS) identifier (if available), and packet data header information (if available).

q_19415.question: What should be done when it is necessary to insert a new clause in the middle of existing clauses in a 3GPP TS?
q_19415.ground_truth: A new clause may be inserted with an appropriate alphanumeric designation (e.g. clause 8A) to minimize disruption to the existing numbering scheme.

q_19416.question: What is the LWI measurement that provides the mean number of UEs associated with WLAN on the Xw interface, obtained by sampling at a pre-defined interval, and taking the arithmetic mean of the number of UEs associated with WLAN on the Xw interface by the eNB?

q_19417.question: What are the two security mechanisms that can be used to protect H(e)MS traffic when it is accessible on the MNO Intranet?
q_19417.ground_truth: The two security mechanisms are protecting H(e)MS traffic in a hop-by-hop way and protecting H(e)MS traffic end-to-end between the H(e)NB and the H(e)MS by utilizing a TLS tunnel.

q_19418.question: What is the name of the PDU (Protocol Data Unit) in the SABP (Short Message Peer-to-Peer) protocol that contains the version number and the SABP-PDU-Contents?

q_19419.question: What is the purpose of the "UE positioning GANSS measured results" information element in a measurement report?
q_19419.ground_truth: The "UE positioning GANSS measured results" information element is included in a measurement report when the UE performs a positioning measurement using GANSS, and the results of the measurement include the GANSS Time of Week (TOW) and the GANSS position.

q_19420.question: What is the role of the Controlling RNC in a UTRAN?
q_19420.ground_truth: The Controlling RNC has overall control of the logical resources of its UTRAN access point's and there is only one Controlling RNC for any UTRAN access point.

q_19421.question: When is the SGSN not required to provide CC and IRI for communications when connecting an UE to a S-GW through the S4 interface?
q_19421.ground_truth: When the SGSN connects an UE to a S-GW through the S4 interface, it is not required to provide CC for that communication, and it is also not required to provide IRIs for PDP contexts associated with CC and correlation in this situation.

q_19422.question: What architecture is required for the eNB to remotely control an entity implementing NR PDCP functionality?

q_19423.question: What is the philosophy of the interaction with T.30 protocol in this specification?
q_19423.ground_truth: The philosophy of the interaction with T.30 protocol is to allow it to pass transparently wherever possible, and make manipulations only when necessary to overcome problems resulting from the differences between the PSTN and the PLMN system.

q_19424.question: What is the purpose of the CorrelatedNotification class in the document?
q_19424.ground_truth: The CorrelatedNotification class identifies a MonitoredEntity and a set of notification identifiers. It is used to correlate information from the AlarmInformation class to other types of information.

q_19425.question: What is the syntax of the "a=FEC-OTI-extension" attribute as defined in the 3GPP TS 26.244?
q_19425.ground_truth: The syntax of the "a=FEC-OTI-extension" attribute as defined in the 3GPP TS 26.244 is: "a=FEC-OTI-extension:" fec-ref SP oti-extension CRLF, where fec-ref is the SDP-internal identifier for the associated FEC-declaration, and oti-extension is the OTI extension specified in base64 format.

q_19426.question: What is the function of the Extended S-RNTI Group in the SRNC?
q_19426.ground_truth: The Extended S-RNTI Group identifies a group of UEs in the SRNC by indicating all Extended S-RNTI values whose bits, starting from the most significant bit and including the bit indicated by the Extended S-RNTI bit mask index, are equal to the corresponding bits of the Extended S-RNTI in the IE.

q_19427.question: What should the CDF do when it receives a Data Record Transfer Response message with the Cause value being "Request Accepted" for earlier unacknowledged Data Record Transfer Request message(s)?
q_19427.ground_truth: The CDF sends empty test packet(s) (with no CDR payload in the Data Record Packet IE but just the other parts of the message frame) to CGF1.

q_19428.question: When does the Receiving HNB complete the release of the signaling connection in the Iurh connectivity via the HNB-GW?
q_19428.ground_truth: The Receiving HNB completes the release of the signaling connection when it receives the DISCONNECT message from the Sending HNB.

q_19429.question: What is one of the requirements for IP addressing in IMS?
q_19429.ground_truth: The operator of an IMS infrastructure may base the implementation on IPv4 only, IPv6 only or both. The choice is an operator option.

q_19430.question: How does the UE behave when within a Random Access procedure, an uplink grant provided in the Random Access Response has a different size than the first uplink grant?
q_19430.ground_truth: The UE behavior is not defined in this situation.

q_19431.question: What is the AVP that is not included in any command sent by Diameter nodes supporting applications defined in this specification?

q_19432.question: In which frame structure is the pilot field of the last slot in the transmission gap transmitted, and transmission is turned off during the rest of the transmission gap for downlink compressed frames?

q_19433.question: What kind of access methods does NBIFOM consider for IP flow mobility?
q_19433.ground_truth: NBIFOM considers 3GPP access and WLAN access methods for IP flow mobility.

q_19434.question: What does the notation 'n/a' mean when discussing NGCN capabilities in relation to sending or receiving messages?
q_19434.ground_truth: 'n/a' means that there is no requirement for an NGCN to support this capability when sending or receiving a message.

q_19435.question: What step initiates the handover from the BSS for the PS domain in the GERAN to GAN handover procedure?

q_19436.question: What operation is used by the SNDCP layer to establish the acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation for a specific SAPI?
q_19436.ground_truth: The SNSM-MODIFY.indication operation is used by the SNDCP layer to establish the acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation for a specific SAPI.

q_19437.question: What is the structure of the PKI used for TLS implementation and usage in the Tsp interface?
q_19437.ground_truth: The profile for TLS implementation and usage in the Tsp interface follows the provisions given in TS~33.310, Annex E. The mutual authentication is based on certificates, and the structure of the PKI used for these certificates is out of scope of the present document.

q_19438.question: What does the PDCP entity do to the padding in PDCP PDU for octet alignment?
q_19438.ground_truth: The PDCP entity adds or removes the padding in PDCP PDU for octet alignment.

q_19439.question: What is the action taken when the SOR-CMCI timer value is infinity?
q_19439.ground_truth: When the Tsor-cm timer value is infinity, the UE shall wait until the PDU session is released or the service is stopped.

q_19440.question: What is the bearer type and bearer parameter used in the test cases?
q_19440.ground_truth: The bearer type used is GPRS and the bearer parameter is not specified in the tests.

q_19441.question: What is the applicability of the test case defined in clause 14.3.8?
q_19441.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 17 onwards that supports UE assisted DL-TDOA positioning and nr-UE-RxTEG-ID-MaxSupport.

q_19442.question: What changes can the network make after starting ciphering with algorithm A5/1?
q_19442.ground_truth: The network may change the contents of certain information elements in System Information messages after ciphering is started with algorithm A5/1.

q_19443.question: What does the "GANSS Time Model" information element contain?
q_19443.ground_truth: The "GANSS Time Model" information element contains a set of parameters needed to relate GANSS time to a selected time reference.

q_19444.question: What is the role of F-TEID for S12, and where is it temporarily stored?
q_19444.ground_truth: F-TEID for S12 is temporary data defined in 3GPP TS 29.274 and conditionally stored in RNC, S-GW, and S4-SGSN.

q_19445.question: Which two 3GPP entities are responsible for discussing the reduction of PDCCH monitoring to support UE Power Saving in NTN?
q_19445.ground_truth: RAN1 and RAN2 are the two 3GPP entities responsible for discussing this matter.

q_19446.question: When does solution #22 propose that the NG-RAN perform the delivery method switch between PTP and PTM?
q_19446.ground_truth: Solution #22 proposes that the NG-RAN perform the delivery method switch between PTP and PTM based on RAN internal decision without requiring the involvement of 5GC. It does not include any change between shared delivery and individual delivery.

q_19447.question: What is the function of the Serving E-DCH cell in the E-DCH operation?
q_19447.ground_truth: The Serving E-DCH cell is responsible for transmitting the E-DCH Absolute Grant in the Dual Cell E-DCH operation.

q_19448.question: What is the purpose of including the Data Forwarding TNL Information IE in the RANAP ENHANCED RELOCATION INFORMATION REQUEST message?
q_19448.ground_truth: It indicates Iur UP resources, made available by the source RNC for forwarding of UL user data.

q_19449.question: What is the treatment given to a Priority Service call during call progression in the originating network?
q_19449.ground_truth: The originating Service Provider applies enhanced call-completion capabilities to increase the probability of successful call setup for a Priority Service call in the originating network.

q_19450.question: What is a MAC-d PDUs?
q_19450.ground_truth: A MAC-d PDUs is a packet of data that is transmitted over the air interface in a 3GPP network. It is a sequence of MAC-d PDUs that are sent over the same MAC entity and are associated with the same MAC-d flow identity. The MAC-d PDUs are stored in the MAC-ehs queue and are transmitted to the UE by the MAC entity.

q_19451.question: What is the procedure initiated by the GANC to transmit paging information to the MS over the Iu interface from a CN domain?
q_19451.ground_truth: The GANC sends the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message to the MS when the GANC receives a PAGING message from the CN and the IE "Mobile Identity" includes the IMSI of the MS. The MS shall indicate reception of paging to upper layers and forward the "IE Mobile Identity" and "Paging Cause" to the upper layers.

q_19452.question: What is the purpose of the "Analytics handover procedure" described in Step 6.59.2.1?
q_19452.ground_truth: The "Analytics handover procedure" is designed to allow one NWDAF to transfer or handover its ongoing analytics to another NWDAF when it can no longer progress the analytics due to graceful shutdown, overload situation, user mobility, or other reasons.

q_19453.question: What is the fundamental idea behind Multiple Reuse Planning (MRP) in terms of frequency planning?
q_19453.ground_truth: The fundamental idea behind MRP is to apply different reuse patterns with different degrees of tightness, where the number of transceivers in a cell is equal to the number of assigned frequencies.

q_19454.question: What is the effect of deactivating an element in the DOM tree?
q_19454.ground_truth: When an element is deactivated, the system treats the DOM tree as if that element and its descendents were not present in the DOM tree and invisible to everything except commands and scripts. Commands and scripts can still reference it as if it were still in the DOM tree. When activated, the element is then restored to visibility in the same location in the tree.

q_19455.question: What type of AVP is the Content-Size AVP and what information does it contain?
q_19455.ground_truth: The Content-Size AVP is of type Unsigned32 and it indicates the size in bytes of the specified content type.

q_19456.question: How many new samples are added to the PCM buffer every frame in parametric stereo?
q_19456.ground_truth: 2048 new samples are added to the PCM buffer every frame in parametric stereo.

q_19457.question: What is the purpose of the MS Information procedure in the VLR?
q_19457.ground_truth: The MS Information procedure is used by the VLR to request specific parameters about the MS. The outcome of the procedure does not change the state of the association at the VLR or SGSN.

q_19458.question: What information must be included in the APN and End User Address information elements in the MBMS Session Start Request message?
q_19458.ground_truth: The APN and End User Address and, if present, the MBMS Flow Identifier information elements shall uniquely identify the MBMS bearer context.

q_19459.question: What should the SGSN do after sending the BSSAP+-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message to the VLR?
q_19459.ground_truth: After sending the BSSAP+-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message, the SGSN should move the state of the association to Gs-NULL, start timer T9 and if timer T6-1 is running, stop and reset it.

q_19460.question: What is the effect of the Mobility Management back-off timer on PLMN reselection?
q_19460.ground_truth: The Mobility Management back-off timer is not a trigger for PLMN reselection.

q_19461.question: What action does the GANC take if it receives a GA-RRC PDU message that is associated with a GA-RRC PTC that does not exist?
q_19461.ground_truth: The GANC shall discard the message and initiate PTC deactivation as defined in sub-clause 8a.8.

q_19462.question: What is the relevance of concurrent codec capabilities in a conference?
q_19462.ground_truth: Concurrent codec capabilities can enable in-terminal mixing of media in the participants without exceeding their concurrent codec capabilities and avoid the need to transcode any media.

q_19463.question: What is the role of the modulator in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network GSM/EDGE Modulation?
q_19463.ground_truth: The modulator receives the bits from the encryption unit and produces an RF signal.

q_19464.question: Under what conditions does the UE use the SOR-CMCI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME?
q_19464.ground_truth: If the UE has no SOR-CMCI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME and the security check of the received steering of roaming information is not successful.

q_19465.question: In what form is control information represented in the Compressed Data stream?
q_19465.ground_truth: Control information is represented by Huffman encoded symbols (characters) with a value greater than 255 decimal in the Compressed Data stream.

q_19466.question: Which profile was used to evaluate the objective performance evaluation results on EVS channel aware mode in 3GPP TS 26.114?
q_19466.ground_truth: The four VoLTE profiles were used for EVS Characterization Testing. The profiles are defined in Annex D of the EVS-7c document and used for EVS Characterization Testing.

q_19467.question: What is the role of network-controlled authorization in this solution?
q_19467.ground_truth: Network-controlled authorization is a process used in this solution to ensure that a Remote UE is authorized by the network to perform secondary A&A before granting it access to a PDU Session with secondary A&A. It helps to maintain compliance with the prerequisites for existing PDU Sessions.

q_19468.question: What information does bulked data contain in NWDAF-to-NWDAF interactions?
q_19468.ground_truth: Bulked data includes bulked data identification, type of bulked data, associated feature type and values, event ID, and timestamp when the data sample is associated with a bulked data.

q_19469.question: Under which conditions can a UE switch to another cell on the same frequency?
q_19469.ground_truth: The UE may select to another cell on the same frequency if the reselection criteria are fulfilled, and if the currently connected cell is barred.

q_19470.question: What security services does the Generic Push Layer (GPL) provide?
q_19470.ground_truth: The GPL provides the security services confidentiality, integrity protection, and replay protection for a GPL session.

q_19471.question: Which Octet is included in the uplink RLC data block if the first instance of the Length indicator in the RLC data block is 123 and both the network and MS support MS assisted Dedicated Core Network selection?
q_19471.ground_truth: Octet M+1 and the following two Octets.

q_19472.question: How is a message referred to in the specification?
q_19472.ground_truth: When referring to a message in the specification, the MESSAGE NAME is written with all letters in upper case characters followed by the word "message".

q_19473.question: What is the effect of the "ServiceChangeMGCId" parameter being present in the MGW Register response?
q_19473.ground_truth: If the "ServiceChangeMGCId" parameter is present in the MGW Register response, the MGW shall not consider itself registered and should preferably attempt to re-register with the MGC specified in the ServiceChangeMGCId before any further alternate MGCs.

q_19474.question: Which operation code is associated with the 'initialDP' in the CAP-operationcodes module?

q_19475.question: What is the impact of providing the (unconditional) Authorized APN-AMBR in every interaction with the PCEF?
q_19475.ground_truth: The PCEF shall apply the Authorized APN-AMBR as APN-AMBR for all IP-CAN sessions of the UE to the same APN and shall communicate the changed APN-AMBR to the UE.

q_19476.question: What is the role of the Controller UE in inter-UE transfer procedures?
q_19476.ground_truth: The Controller UE is responsible for managing the communication sessions and coordinating with other UEs and the SCC AS during inter-UE transfer procedures.

q_19477.question: How is the synthesized full band signal de-emphasized in the high band coding information?
q_19477.ground_truth: The synthesized full band signal is de-emphasized by moving correcting the spectrum, de-emphasizing the spectrum, and modulating the signal with gain shape values and overall frame gain parameter.

q_19478.question: What is the purpose of the LCLS-Status IE in the LCLS-Status-Update message?
q_19478.ground_truth: The LCLS-Status IE in the LCLS-Status-Update message indicates the LCLS disconnection.

q_19479.question: In what situations is the UE required to initiate initial registration?
q_19479.ground_truth: The UE must initiate initial registration when performing initial registration for 5GS services, initial registration for emergency services, initial registration for SMS over NAS, and when moving from GERAN to NG-RAN coverage or from UTRAN to NG-RAN coverage.

q_19480.question: What are the tasks in the radio network coverage optimization workflow that are accomplished by a human in Level 0 of network autonomy?
q_19480.ground_truth: In Level 0 of network autonomy, all the tasks in the radio network coverage optimization workflow, including Task A to Task G, are accomplished by human.

q_19481.question: At what bit/s rate is the Binary Coded Signalling supported in the UMTS PLMN environment?
q_19481.ground_truth: Only the standard 300 bit/s Binary Coded Signalling is supported in the UMTS PLMN environment.

q_19482.question: What causes the mapping between RELOCATION REQUIRED and HANDOVER REQUEST in the context of handover between UMTS and GSM networks?
q_19482.ground_truth: The mapping between RELOCATION REQUIRED and HANDOVER REQUEST in the context of handover between UMTS and GSM networks is caused by the handover of a mobile station between two systems or cells.

q_19483.question: What steps are taken when the default UE (UE-2) cannot setup the session and the PN UE redirection is required for the other UE of the next lower priority?
q_19483.ground_truth: The gsmSCF performs the PNM session redirection for the other UE of the next lower priority (UE-3) by forwarding the redirected initial request containing the Request-URI of the UE-3 public user identity to the UE-3.

q_19484.question: What value should be encoded in the skip indicator when sending a Radio Resource management message or GPRS Transparent Transport protocol message?
q_19484.ground_truth: The skip indicator should be encoded as '0000' when sending a Radio Resource management message or GPRS Transparent Transport protocol message.

q_19485.question: What does the file server do in the Home NodeB (HNB) to HNB Management System (HMS) interface?
q_19485.ground_truth: The file server in the HNB to HMS interface may be used for file upload or download as instructed by the TR-069 manager, and it may also be used by other applications in the MNO (Mobile Network Operator) domain.

q_19486.question: What is the maximum allowable Error Vector Magnitude when 16QAM modulation is used on any of the uplink code channels in a carrier?
q_19486.ground_truth: The maximum allowable Error Vector Magnitude when 16QAM modulation is used on any of the uplink code channels in a carrier is 14%.

q_19487.question: What is the procedure for IPsec tunnel establishment if the H(e)NB only supports IPsec?
q_19487.ground_truth: The procedure for IPsec tunnel establishment if the H(e)NB only supports IPsec is using IKEv2 protocol to set up at least one IPsec tunnel to protect the traffic with SeGW, i.e. a pair of unidirectional SAs between H(e)NB and SeGW. All signalling, user, and management plane traffic over the interface between H(e)NB and SeGW shall be sent through an IPsec ESP tunnel (with NAT-T UDP encapsulation as necessary) that is established as a result of the authentication procedure.

q_19488.question: What is the purpose of Announce messages in the context of TSN and IEEE 802.1AS?
q_19488.ground_truth: Announce messages are used for exchanging clock information between systems in a TSN domain, containing the system identity and root clock for the given TSN entity.

q_19489.question: What are the particular features of the UMTS facsimile group 3 Teleservice?
q_19489.ground_truth: The UMTS facsimile group 3 Teleservice uses point-to-point communication, has an information transfer mode of circuit, duplex, asynchronous, supports both mobile originated and mobile terminated calls, allows different end-to-end message speeds within the same connection, and envisages the use of the standard asynchronous terminal adaptation function for non-transparent network support.

q_19490.question: When does the SS send a LPP PROVIDE ASSISTANCE DATA message in the test procedure?
q_19490.ground_truth: The SS sends a LPP PROVIDE ASSISTANCE DATA message after the UE sends an LPP PROVIDE CAPABILITIES message.

q_19491.question: What is the role of SMF and S-EDN in solution #22, step 6 and 8?
q_19491.ground_truth: SMF sends the Authorization request to the S-EDN, including GPSI and T-EDN info, and S-EDN sends the Authorization response message to the SMF, including the authorization token.

q_19492.question: What information elements should be included in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message when it is sent as part of the registration request for inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode?
q_19492.ground_truth: The TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message should include only mandatory information elements and the EPS update type IE set to "TA updating". If the UE has a current EPS security context, the UE shall include the eKSI in the NAS Key Set Identifier IE and integrity protect the message.

q_19493.question: What action does the target NG-RAN take when it receives an N2 Path Switch Request from the target NG-RAN during handover preparation phase?
q_19493.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN sends a response to the AMF, indicating whether it supports MBS to the SMF in the N2 SM information. If it does, the SMF knows that the target NG-RAN supports MBS and determines the delivery method. If not, the 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery or 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery is still used for MBS data transferring.

q_19494.question: What part of the message is the subject of the "modeSpecificInfo" choice?
q_19494.ground_truth: The "modeSpecificInfo" choice is made for the "RAB-Info", "frequencyInfoFDD", and "frequencyInfoTDD" parts of the message.

q_19495.question: What is the name of the multiplexing scheme used in EC operation?

q_19496.question: What is the performance difference between SACCH and AHS4.75 in MTS-2 when the Shifted SACCH is employed?

q_19497.question: What is the mechanism used to determine if the UE should use a 320 ms or 160 ms estimation period for burst quality evaluation and special burst detection window?
q_19497.ground_truth: The UE uses a 320 ms estimation period for the burst quality evaluation and for the Special Burst detection window if the beacon channel reception level is 10 dB above the handover triggering level. Otherwise, it uses a 160 ms estimation period.

q_19498.question: What is the difference between the three versions of the released document and what do they indicate?
q_19498.ground_truth: The three versions of the released document indicate the stage of approval and change. Version 3.x.z indicates that the TSG has approved the document under change control (x > 0). The second digit (y) indicates technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc., while the third digit (z) is incremented for editorial only changes.

q_19499.question: What is the pre-test condition specified for the UE in these test cases?
q_19499.ground_truth: The UE begins the test with no assistance data stored for all sub-test cases dependent on the positioning method(s) supported by the UE.

q_19500.question: What is the process of dividing the resulting residual signal in the NELP coding scheme?
q_19500.ground_truth: The resulting residual signal is divided into smaller sub-frames whose gains are computed and quantized. The quantized gains are then applied to a randomly generated sparse excitation which is shaped by a set of bandpass filters.

q_19501.question: What action does the MGCF take when it receives an ISUP:ANM answer indication message?
q_19501.ground_truth: The MGCF requests the IM-MGW to both-way through-connect the terminations using the Change IMS Through-Connection or Change TDM Through-Connection procedures.

q_19502.question: What is the role of the iE-Extensions field in the definitions of Combining-RL-AdditionRspFDD and NonCombining-RL-AdditionRspFDD?
q_19502.ground_truth: The iE-Extensions field in the definitions of Combining-RL-AdditionRspFDD and NonCombining-RL-AdditionRspFDD represents the protocol extensions container for the sub-parameters of each procedure. This field allows for additional data to be added to each procedure, if necessary. The specific extensions that are allowed in the container depend on the specific implementation of the protocol, and are defined in the protocol extension container.

q_19503.question: What is the purpose of the high-band log energy sum in this process?
q_19503.ground_truth: The high-band log energy sum is used to calculate the high-band high sparseness flag, which indicates whether the high-band spectrum of the frame is highly sparse.

q_19504.question: What is the role of the MASQUE functionality in the MA PDU Session?
q_19504.ground_truth: The MASQUE functionality in the MA PDU Session is responsible for handling the mapping of packets from the IP interface to the QoS flows, and creating proxy states for the UDP flows as needed.

q_19505.question: When should the SGSN send a Ready for SM (IMSI, MS Reachable) message to the HLR?
q_19505.ground_truth: The SGSN should send a Ready for SM (IMSI, MS Reachable) message to the HLR when it contains an MM context of the MS and MNRG for that MS is set.

q_19506.question: How many received signal level measurement samples are required for a UE not using measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform GSM measurements for a GSM carrier RSSI measurement?
q_19506.ground_truth: At least 3 received signal level measurement samples are required for a UE not using measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform GSM measurements for a GSM carrier RSSI measurement.

q_19507.question: What is KI#5 enforced by the AMF for maximum data rate per network slice?
q_19507.ground_truth: The AMF sums the Slice-MBR of all UEs in Connected mode which have established PDU Sessions in the network slice and ensures the total data rate does not exceed the allowed value in the quota for the network slice.

q_19508.question: What event can trigger the PCEF to report to the PCRF if the IP-CAN session is not terminated due to a credit management session failure and the UE is resumed from suspend state?
q_19508.ground_truth: The UE resumed from suspend state event trigger

q_19509.question: What information is included in the Auth Response message from the ProSe Application Server?
q_19509.ground_truth: The Auth Response message from the ProSe Application Server includes the PDUID, which corresponds to the RPAUID stored in the server, a response type set to "restricted discovery/query ack", and each Target ProSe Discovery UE ID returned with the corresponding Target RPAUID that the RPAUID is allowed to discover.

q_19510.question: What pre-conditions must be met for an FRMCS User to join an ongoing video conference?
q_19510.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for joining an ongoing video conference are that there is an ongoing video conference and the FRMCS User is authorized to join it.

q_19511.question: What video resolution and frame rate were used for LTE-OTT Test1 and Test2 in driving conditions?

q_19512.question: What is the difference between near real-time and real-time charging billing information processing?
q_19512.ground_truth: Near real-time charging and billing information processing should take less than one minute, while real-time processing should take less than one second.

q_19513.question: What information should be contained in a SUSPEND PDU sent from a BSS to an SGSN during a suspension process?
q_19513.ground_truth: A SUSPEND PDU contains the TLLI of the MS and the Routeing Area of the MS as received in the Layer 3 Um interface message GPRS Suspension Request.

q_19514.question: What action does the BSS take when an idle radio traffic channel becomes available before BSSMAP timer T11 expires?
q_19514.ground_truth: The BSS sends an Assignment Command message to MS-B and starts BSSMAP timer T10 and RR timer T3107.

q_19515.question: What is the quality assessment conclusion for C7-C2, i.e the evaluation codec with binaural post-processing versus the server-side surround anchor?
q_19515.ground_truth: For all but one lab, the evaluation codec with binaural post-processing is statistically equivalent to the server-side surround anchor, implying that the MPS + binaural postprocessing at 64 kbps is "same as" C7 (server-side binaural conversion + HE-AAC at 64 kbps).

q_19516.question: What must a UE do upon initiating a Random Access procedure on a Serving Cell when the MAC entity switches the active DL BWP?
q_19516.ground_truth: If the MAC entity switches the active DL BWP after receiving a PDCCH for BWP switching and the defaultDownlinkBWP-Id is different from the current DL BWP or if the UE is a RedCap UE and initialDownlinkBWP-RedCap is different from the current DL BWP, the UE must start or restart the bwp-InactivityTimer associated with the active DL BWP.

q_19517.question: If the embedded lAdd-ext parameter was not defined in LTE and 5G, then what is the parameter defined as?
q_19517.ground_truth: A bit string of unknown length and meaning

q_19518.question: In the context of 8.6.9.8, what should be included in the "MBMS Selected Services Short" information element?
q_19518.ground_truth: The "MBMS Selected Services Short" information element should include the "MBMS Selected Service ID" for each MBMS Selected Service that is indicated on MCCH and for which the UE initiates the counting response, ordered by priority.

q_19519.question: What is the throughput requirement for an E-UTRA carrier in the presence of two interfering signals?
q_19519.ground_truth: The throughput for an E-UTRA carrier shall be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

q_19520.question: What is a Managed Object (MO) in the context of 3GPP TS 28.622?
q_19520.ground_truth: A Managed Object (MO) is a managed entity that is being managed by a management system. It is defined in the Management Information Model (MIM) and can represent a network resource or a network element.

q_19521.question: What type of compensation in an OFDM communication system, which is based on the existing Rel-15 NR PTRS structure, was reported to have a better performance for high MCS (64QAM) with normal CP when using 480 kHz and 960 kHz SCS compared to 120 kHz and 240 kHz SCS, when only CPE (compensation phase) compensation is used based on the existing Rel-15 NR PTRS structure?

q_19522.question: What is the name of the first procedure defined in the PUA-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE list?

q_19523.question: What is the operation code used in the "RELEASE COMPLETE" command with error code 1.1?
q_19523.ground_truth: The operation code used in the "RELEASE COMPLETE" command with error code 1.1 is "REGISTER SS RETURN ERROR".

q_19524.question: What is one method to reduce overall latency from Idle mode to Connected mode in LTE-Advanced by approximately 20ms?
q_19524.ground_truth: Combining the RRC Connection Request and NAS Service Request messages so that they can be processed in parallel at the eNB and MME respectively.

q_19525.question: What is the main functionalities of policy control?
q_19525.ground_truth: The policy control includes functionalities such as binding, gating control, event reporting, QoS control, redirection, and IP-CAN bearer establishment

q_19526.question: In what situation will a UE start or restart the bwp-InactivityTimer associated with the active DL BWP?
q_19526.ground_truth: A UE starts or restarts the bwp-InactivityTimer associated with the active DL BWP in several situations, including receiving a PDCCH indicating downlink assignment or uplink grant, successfully completing a Random Access procedure, transmitting or receiving a MAC PDU, and switching to a DL BWP that is not indicated by the defaultDownlinkBWP-Id.

q_19527.question: How does the decoding complexity of SHVC solution compare to HEVC simulcast solution in multi-stream multiparty video conferencing?
q_19527.ground_truth: The decoding complexity of SHVC solution depends on the resolution of each layer, whereas for HEVC simulcast solution, only one single layer stream needs to be decoded.

q_19528.question: What is the method for computing the mean MOS-LQO value in the speak quality loss in sending direction?
q_19528.ground_truth: For both the reference and test conditions, perform the measurement 20 times and discard the first measurement. Compute a score for each 6 s speech sentence pair and average to produce a mean MOS-LQO value.

q_19529.question: What happens if the value 10 hex (DLE) is transmitted in the message content?
q_19529.ground_truth: An additional 'stuffing' octet of value 00 hex (NUL) is transmitted immediately following the octet containing 10 hex.

q_19530.question: What is the purpose of SECAM SCAS for a 3GPP virtualized network product class?
q_19530.ground_truth: The Security Assurance Specification (SECAM SCAS) for a given 3GPP virtualized network product class provides a description of the security requirements and associated test cases for that class.

q_19531.question: What field in the PDP Context information element indicates whether the MS is allowed to use the APN in the domain of the HPLMN only or both in the domain of the HPLMN and the VPLMN?
q_19531.ground_truth: The VPLMN Address Allowed (VAA) field in the PDP Context information element indicates whether the MS is allowed to use the APN in the domain of the HPLMN only or both in the domain of the HPLMN and the VPLMN.
