q_19785.ground_truth: The UE shall abort any ongoing 5GMM signalling procedure, stop any of the timers T3510, T3516, T3517, T3519, or T3521 (if they were running), delete stored SUCI, and enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

q_19786.question: In the context of the present document, which documents define the terms and abbreviations used in the report?
q_19786.ground_truth: The terms and abbreviations used in the report are defined in TR 25.990, TS 25.401, and TS 25.423.

q_19787.question: How does the solution address the key issue of mitigating linkability attacks in the 5G mobile network?
q_19787.ground_truth: The solution addresses this by encrypting the authentication failure cause value using the method of calculating the SUCI, so that only the network can decrypt and obtain the specific failure cause.

q_19788.question: In what situation is the IP-SM-GW required to return a MSISDN-less correlation ID along with an indication of temporary error to the originating IMS network?
q_19788.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW is required to return a MSISDN-less correlation ID along with an indication of temporary error to the originating IMS network when IP-SM-GW receives a SM from the originating IMS network via SIP MESSAGE and fails to deliver the SM to the recipient, and future retry is allowed and possible.

q_19789.question: What is the requirement in 8.3.1.1, for DCH demodulation in multipath fading Case 1?
q_19789.ground_truth: The requirement in 8.3.1.1 is the maximum BLER allowed when the receiver input signal is at a specified Eb/N0 limit in multipath fading Case 1.

q_19790.question: What is stored to show the quantities of the last logged cell the UE was camping on in the UE's camping state?

q_19791.question: What is the basic principle behind the C/I based power control algorithm?
q_19791.ground_truth: The C/I based power control algorithm compares the C/I value at the receiver with the minimum required and the maximum allowed C/I value to keep the received C/I in its fixed boundaries. If the C/I is in the required scope, the transmission power is varied to keep the received power in its fixed boundaries.

q_19792.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the Serving GW after receiving the Delete Bearer Request message?
q_19792.ground_truth: The PDN GW sends a Delete Bearer Response (TEID, EPS Bearer Identity, User Location Information) message to the Serving GW.

q_19793.question: In what scenario is only static PDP addressing applicable in the network-requested PDP context activation case?
q_19793.ground_truth: Only static PDP addressing is applicable in the network-requested PDP context activation case.

q_19794.question: What positioning method is based on one or more BSS acquiring Timing Advance (TA) information from a set of cells?

q_19795.question: What is the measurement condition for ACK mis-detection in multipath fading conditions?
q_19795.ground_truth: The ACK mis-detection rate should be measured only on those slots corresponding to the ACK/NACK field of HS-DPCCH.

q_19796.question: What does the SABM frame represent in the 3GPP A-bis interface?
q_19796.ground_truth: The SABM frame is a specific frame used in the LAPD protocol for link establishment and release. In this specification, the BTS sends an SABM frame as part of the Link establishment request and release procedures.

q_19797.question: What is the purpose of the PFSC-based gap filling in the decoder for SWB and FB input signals?
q_19797.ground_truth: The purpose is to fill the gaps in the high frequency region which has zero bit allocation with the new generated spectrum. This is because not all transform coefficients are transmitted to the decoder for spectral coefficients which belong to bands which are assigned zero bits from the bit-allocation subclause.

q_19798.question: What should the IWF performing the participating role do when it receives a SIP INFO request where the Request-URI contains an MCPTT session ID identifying an ongoing group session?
q_19798.ground_truth: The IWF performing the participating role shall follow the actions specified in clause~6.4.1.9 of the document.

q_19799.question: What action can the SCS request from the MTC-IWF by sending a Device-Action-Request command with the Action-Type AVP set to Device Trigger Recall (3)?
q_19799.ground_truth: The SCS can request the MTC-IWF to perform a device trigger recall.

q_19800.question: What is the source device for the ENVELOPE (TIMER EXPIRATION) command?
q_19800.ground_truth: The source device for the ENVELOPE (TIMER EXPIRATION) command is the ME (ME denotes Mobile Equipment).

q_19801.question: What should be used instead of "may not" in normative elements in 3GPP technical specification?
q_19801.ground_truth: In normative elements of 3GPP technical specifications, "might not" or "shall not" should be used instead of "may not".

q_19802.question: What systems were used for the verification of the C code specified in the 3GPP TS 26.445 document?
q_19802.ground_truth: The C code specified in the 3GPP TS 26.445 document was verified on IBM PC compatible computers with Windows 7 or 8 operating system and Microsoft Visual C++ 2010 compiler, and IBM PC compatible computers with Linux operating system and GNU gcc compiler version 4.3.x.

q_19803.question: What is the procedure for switching from PSS streaming to MBMS streaming with channel change?
q_19803.ground_truth: In order to switch from PSS to MBMS reception of a stream, a SIP Re-INVITE is issued by the UE and sent to the SCF. The SCF sends a SIP BYE message to PSS Adapter to terminate the SIP session, and the UE can then activate the corresponding MBMS User Service. After switching to MBMS reception, the PSS session is terminated.

q_19804.question: What is the function of the public key ID in the communication process of the PWS?
q_19804.ground_truth: The public key ID is used to identify the corresponding public key used in the signature verification process, ensuring the authenticity and integrity of the warning messages.

q_19805.question: What is one of the existing features that partly covers the use case functionality for time-sensitive networking in cyber-physical control applications?
q_19805.ground_truth: A solution has been adopted in downstream groups where a UE uses dual connectivity to establish PDU Sessions through separate UPFs, reducing single points of service failure in the end-to-end path except for the UE.

q_19806.question: What should the IP-SM-GW do if the SMS-SUBMIT RESULT contains the User error parameter, as a result of sending a SIP INVITE request for a Chat Session, and operator policy mandates the SMS user to be informed of the invitation?
q_19806.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW shall send a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response to the associated SIP INVITE request and release the specific MSISDN assigned for this Chat Session if one had been assigned.

q_19807.question: What is the purpose of steps 6 and 7 in OpenID Authentication?
q_19807.ground_truth: These steps are optional and only allowed if the user has entered an OpenID identifier indicating OP driven identifier selection. They allow the user to remain anonymous towards the RP while still enabling GBA authentication.

q_19808.question: What is the upper bound for the state variable pnup in the high frequency dynamic range flag decision process?
q_19808.ground_truth: The upper bound for pnup is 6.

q_19809.question: What should the IWF do if it receives a SIP 4xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request to cancel the in-progress emergency condition on an MCPTT emergency private call?
q_19809.ground_truth: The IWF should set the MCPTT emergency private priority state as "MEPP 2: in-progress", the MCPTT emergency alert (MPEA) state shall revert to its value prior to entering the current procedure, and the state of the session does not change, i.e. continues with MCPTT emergency private call level priority.

q_19810.question: In the application plane, what is the role of the IOPS distribution function entity?
q_19810.ground_truth: The IOPS distribution function entity provides support for distributing IP packets containing MC service application data received from an MC service UE in the IOPS mode of operation.

q_19811.question: What services are provided by RR procedures in Idle mode?
q_19811.ground_truth: The services provided by RR procedures in Idle mode include alive check, hunting, connectionless group alerting, and CTS system information broadcasting.

q_19812.question: When should the UE send a periodic Binding Update to the HA in DSMIPv6?
q_19812.ground_truth: The UE should send a periodic Binding Update to the HA before the expiration of the lifetime indicated in the received Binding Acknowledgement, even if it is not changing its primary Care-of Address.

q_19813.question: What action does the old SGSN take if none of the PDP Contexts forwarded from the old SGSN has a valid PFI allocated?
q_19813.ground_truth: If none of the PDP Contexts forwarded from the old SGSN has a valid PFI allocated, the new SGSN deems this a failure case and rejects the request for PS handover.

q_19814.question: What is a Personal Area Network (PAN) in the context of an AIPN?
q_19814.ground_truth: A PAN in the context of an AIPN consists of more than one device controlled by the same user, with all the devices within a PAN using the same USIM and connected together using internal PAN means.

q_19815.question: What is the potential new requirement to support the use case of distributing high-precision timing information in the 5G system?
q_19815.ground_truth: The 5G system shall be able to distribute high-precision timing information as per the Precision Time Protocol (IEEE 1588-2008) in SMPTE ST2059 profile to enable the synchronous timing of broadcast devices over the network.

q_19816.question: What is the maximum size limit for the Minimum Set of Data (MSD) sent by the In-vehicle System (IVS) in eCall?
q_19816.ground_truth: The MSD should not exceed 140 bytes

q_19817.question: What is a pre-arranged PoC group session?
q_19817.ground_truth: A pre-arranged PoC group session is a persistent PoC session Identity that has an associated set of PoC members, and the establishment of a PoC session to a pre-arranged PoC group results in all members being invited.

q_19818.question: What is the role of the "IFP packet" in the IFP packet?
q_19818.ground_truth: The IFP packet in the IFP packet is used to relay ITU-T Recommendation T.30 BCS frames, including the possibility to transmit parts of an entire BCS frame (segmentation).

q_19819.question: What is the purpose of Cell Update and GRA update procedures in GERAN?
q_19819.ground_truth: Cell Update and GRA update procedures are used in GERAN to notify the serving BSS about any cell or GRA change when the GERAN is in charge of tracking the location of the MS, either at cell or GRA level.

q_19820.question: What is the default behavior of a terminal when receiving Warning Notifications with an unknown authenticity?
q_19820.ground_truth: The default behavior of a terminal is to accept all Warning Notifications even if their authenticity is unknown.

q_19821.question: Which entities provide data for the "Per Access Network Performance" analytics in NWDAF?
q_19821.ground_truth: UPF provides data for the "Per Access Network Performance" analytics in NWDAF.

q_19822.question: What is the role of the information element in the CCBS service?
q_19822.ground_truth: The CCBS Description information element contains the number of the destination B dialled by the A-user during the CCBS activation.

q_19823.question: What is required for the 3GPP system to support authentication of a User Identity used by devices that are connected via a UE that acts as a gateway?
q_19823.ground_truth: The 3GPP system needs to support a mechanism to perform authentication of a User Identity used by devices connected via a UE that acts as a gateway. This is in addition to the requirements for storing and applying user-specific settings, operator-deployed services, and charging.

q_19824.question: What is the objective of the 3GPP work item "Future GERAN Evolution"?
q_19824.ground_truth: The objective of the 3GPP work item "Future GERAN Evolution" is to increase capacity, coverage and data rates, reduce latency, and enhance service continuity with other RATs while minimizing impacts to infrastructure.

q_19825.question: What are the allowed air interface data rates for TCH/F14.4 in octet 5a when bit 7 in octet 5 indicates non-transparent service?
q_19825.ground_truth: The air interface data rates indicated by bits 7-1 in octet 5a for TCH/F14.4 when bit 7 in octet 5 indicates non-transparent service are 43,5 kbit/s, 14,5 kbit/s, 11,2 kbit/s, 9,6 kbit/s.

q_19826.question: How many HARQ entities are there per E-DCH transport channel in the MAC-i/is entity in the UE side?
q_19826.ground_truth: There is a HARQ entity per E-DCH transport channel in the MAC-i/is entity in the UE side.

q_19827.question: What is the interface between the MCVideo User Database and the MCVideo Server referred to as in 3GPP TS 23.281?

q_19828.question: What is the relationship between PRS resource periodicity in positioning frequency layer i and the periodicity of PRS resource sets given by the higher-layer parameter DL-PRS-Periodicity?
q_19828.ground_truth: PRS resource periodicity in positioning frequency layer i is derived by considering the least common multiple of the periodicities among DL PRS resource sets, where DL-PRS-Periodicity is a higher-layer parameter.

q_19829.question: In which situation would a person want to use the audio distribution service in the described use case?
q_19829.ground_truth: A person might want to use the audio distribution service in several situations, for instance if they are located far from the loudspeakers, between two stages, or next to one stage but wanting to listen to another stage. Another situation could be when a person wants enhanced audio quality in addition to using other data services during a live event.

q_19830.question: What are the four measurement methods that the TDF supports for charging?
q_19830.ground_truth: The four measurement methods are data volume, duration, combined volume/duration, and event-based measurement.

q_19831.question: What information is required to address a 2G RAN node using A/Gb mode in the RAN information messages?
q_19831.ground_truth: The Cell Identity (CI) is used to address the target RAN node in A/Gb mode.

q_19832.question: In the case where a non-service-user attempts a priority service call, what is the response from the MSC/VLR to the non-service-user?
q_19832.ground_truth: The MSC/VLR responds with a Release Complete message to the MS with cause #63 "Service or option not available" and releases the MM connection.

q_19833.question: What is the purpose of the CSI AS in the described network?
q_19833.ground_truth: The CSI AS acts as a 3rd party call control entity for initiating and controlling two sessions in this network.

q_19834.question: What is the call control result for default PDP connection activation, not allowed in Expected Sequence 1.2?

q_19835.question: Which function is responsible for sending the MBMS Session Update procedure to downstream nodes?
q_19835.ground_truth: The BM-SC initiates the MBMS Session Update procedure and sends the Session Update Request to downstream nodes to inform them of changes in the MBMS Service Area or the list of downstream nodes for GGSN.

q_19836.question: What is the default value of timer T when the MS is not capable of supporting any of EC-GSM-IoT, Category M1 or Category NB1?
q_19836.ground_truth: The default value of timer T is 60 minutes.

q_19837.question: What is the purpose of the DP Value in the MT SMS TDP descriptions?
q_19837.ground_truth: The DP Value identifies the point in the MT SMS State Model where service triggering may take place. In the case of MT-SMS-CSI, the only allowed DP value is DP SMS-Delivery-Request.

q_19838.question: What is the purpose of the "requestAnnouncementCompleteNotification" parameter in the gsmSCF's requestAnnouncement operation?
q_19838.ground_truth: This parameter indicates whether or not a "SpecializedResourceReport" shall be sent to the gsmSCF when all information has been sent.

q_19839.question: How many non-zero pulses are in the innovation vector for the 12.65 kbit/s mode?

q_19840.question: What information should be included in the Information Element Criticality Diagnostics IE when reporting not comprehended or missing IEs/IE groups?
q_19840.ground_truth: The Repetition Number IE should be included in the Information Element Criticality Diagnostics IE, and if the not comprehended or missing IE/IE group is not at message hierarchy level 1 (top level), the Message Structure IE should also be included. Additionally, when reporting not comprehended or missing IEs/IE groups using the Error Indication procedure, the Procedure Code IE, the Triggering Message IE, and the Procedure Criticality IE should be included.

q_19841.question: What is the purpose of measuring Peak Code Domain Error, as specified in clause 6.7.2.3 of the document?
q_19841.ground_truth: The purpose of measuring Peak Code Domain Error is to discover and limit inter-code cross-talk.

q_19842.question: What is the impact of the solution described in Section 6.8 on N4/Sx signaling when setting up an L2TP session?
q_19842.ground_truth: The solution described in Section 6.8 requires the CP Function to send a PFCP Session Establishment Request to the UP Function, and if the L2TP tunnel parameters are available at the CP Function, the CP Function provides the necessary information in the request to the UP Function to establish the L2TP tunnel and session.

q_19843.question: What are two different bearer service types defined within the GPRS network?

q_19844.question: What is the spreading factor used for the uplink PRACH?
q_19844.ground_truth: The uplink PRACH uses either spreading factor SF=16 or SF=8.

q_19845.question: What is the purpose of the TP-Protocol-Identifier field in a Short Message Transfer (SMS-SUBMIT or SMS-DELIVER) message?
q_19845.ground_truth: The TP-Protocol-Identifier field serves to indicate the type of protocol or device that the short message is intended for. It consists of one octet, with bits used to indicate various types of protocols, devices, or other specific uses.

q_19846.question: What is the length of the channel data in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE: RECEIVE DATA" command with a command number of 1.3.10?
q_19846.ground_truth: The length of the channel data in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE: RECEIVE DATA" command with a command number of 1.3.10 is 100 bytes.

q_19847.question: What happens to communication if the ACR service has been activated by the terminating party before the originating party originates a communication?
q_19847.ground_truth: There is no impact on the other IMS supplementary service.

q_19848.question: What is the effect of setting the "Pre-emption Capability" bit to 1 in the HANDOVER REQUEST message?
q_19848.ground_truth: This allocation request can trigger the pre-emption procedure

q_19849.question: What is the data model defined by the Contact Manager API?
q_19849.ground_truth: The Contact Manager API gives the user application a view of the data stored by the Contact Manager Server. The data is composed of a collection of contacts, fields, field descriptors, and groups. Each contact belongs to a unique contact manager, has a collection of fields, and may belong to one or multiple groups. Each field is defined by its type and attributes, and each field descriptor belong to a unique contact manager.

q_19850.question: What happens when the RAN could not obtain a location estimate for the target UE?
q_19850.ground_truth: The RAN returns a Location Report message containing a failure cause and no location estimate to the SGSN.

q_19851.question: What information is included in the SYNC PDU towards the RAN Access node when supported?
q_19851.ground_truth: The length of each packet is included in the SYNC PDU towards the RAN Access node when supported.

q_19852.question: What is the purpose of the P-Charging-Vector header field in the message sent by IBCF-hA1?
q_19852.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header field is used to indicate various charging information such as the orig-ioi, transit-ioi, and term-ioi. This information is important for the charging process in the IMS network.

q_19853.question: What is the role of the Stand-Alone SMLC (SAS) in the context of the UTRAN Iupc interface PCAP?
q_19853.ground_truth: The Stand-Alone SMLC (SAS) is a logical node that interconnects to the RNC over the Iupc interface via the PCAP protocol. It provides GNSS-related data to the RNC, performs the position calculation function based on UE Positioning measurement data, and in SAS centric mode, selects the positioning method and controls the positioning procedure.

q_19854.question: What are the two types of NPNs as classified by 3GPP?
q_19854.ground_truth: The two types of NPNs as classified by 3GPP are Standalone NPN (SNPN), which does not rely on network functions or services provided by a PLMN, and Public Network Integrated NPN (PNI-NPN), which is deployed with the support of at least one PLMN.

q_19855.question: How does the 3GPP study treat coverage scenarios, requirements, and relay selection for UE-to-Network Relay?
q_19855.ground_truth: The UE-to-Network Relay considers two main coverage scenarios, UE-to-Network Relay UE in coverage and Remote UE out of coverage, and UE-to-Network Relay UE and Remote UE in coverage. These scenarios support L2 and L3 UE-to-Network Relay integration. For L2 UE-to-Network Relay, after Remote UE connects via Relay UE, the Relay UE and Remote UE are under Relay UE's serving cell control. For L3 UE-to-Network Relay, the Relay UE and Remote UE can be in different cells after establishing PC5-RRC connection. For relay selection, the study uses radio signal strength measurements in the PC5 interface and re-selection criteria for UE-to-Network Relay.

q_19856.question: What is the effect of Voice Call Continuity (VCC) in IMS Multimedia Telephony?
q_19856.ground_truth: In IMS Multimedia Telephony, when VCC is invoked during an ongoing voice call, it enables a smooth transition of the voice call between the two systems (CS and PS/IMS).

q_19857.question: What should the MAC entity do if the MSG3 buffer is empty after receiving a Random Access Response with a non-empty successRAR MAC subPDU?
q_19857.ground_truth: The MAC entity should obtain the MAC PDU to transmit from the MSGA buffer and store it in the MSG3 buffer, and then process the received UL grant value.

q_19858.question: What handles the mobility of a remote UE within an NG-RAN node, allowing it to maintain service during a change from a direct to an indirect network connection?
q_19858.ground_truth: The NG-RAN and the UE-to-Network Relay handle the mobility of a remote UE within an NG-RAN node.

q_19859.question: What is the format of the ID in the ID-NonCellSpecificTxDiversity in the HS-DSCH-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify-ExtIEs?
q_19859.ground_truth: The ID id-NonCellSpecificTxDiversity in the HS-DSCH-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify-ExtIEs is a protocol extension with an optional presence and a criticality of reject in the RNSAP protocol extension. The format is a two-letter code that represents a type of transmit diversity for the RNTI. Examples of possible values include "oms" for "Outer-loop cell-specific Tx diversity" and "icsm" for "Individual CSI-based Tx diversity", which are both defined in the specification.

q_19860.question: What is the context for the 3GPP authentication and key generation algorithms, referred to as f1, f1*, f2, f3, f4, f5, f5*?
q_19860.ground_truth: The context for these algorithms is the non-standardized 3GPP authentication and key generation functions for mobile communication systems.

q_19861.question: What is the difference between a Stand-Alone LMU and an Associated LMU in UTRAN UE positioning?
q_19861.ground_truth: A Stand-Alone LMU communicates with RNCs via the Uu interface, while an Associated LMU communicates with RNCs via the Iub interface.

q_19862.question: What is the intended usage of HTTP as the minimum transport protocol for SAND-enabled elements as defined in ISO/IEC 23009-5?
q_19862.ground_truth: HTTP is used as the minimum transport protocol to be supported by SAND-enabled elements for Metrics messages, Status messages, and PER messages in a DASH-based streaming system.

q_19863.question: What is the objective of eSafety initiative?
q_19863.ground_truth: The eSafety initiative aims to accelerate the development, deployment and use of Intelligent Integrated Safety Systems that use information and communication technologies in intelligent solutions, in order to increase road safety and reduce the number of accidents on Europe's roads.

q_19864.question: Which transport options should be provided for each implementation of the Mc interface?
q_19864.ground_truth: Each implementation of the Mc interface should provide the appropriate protocol options: MTP3B, SCTP, or M3UA layer over SCTP for pure IP signalling transport and IPsec for communication across different operator's secure domains.

q_19865.question: What are the two types of access networks supported by ICS for media bearers?
q_19865.ground_truth: ICS supports CS (Circuit Switched) access networks, such as 3GPP~TS~24.008 or 3GPP2~C.S0001-D, and IP-CAN (IP-Connectivity Access Network) for media bearers.

q_19866.question: What is one of the exit statuses recommended to be provided but not required?
q_19866.ground_truth: One of the exit statuses recommended to be provided but not required is the error-free decoding status.

q_19867.question: What kind of traffic is the measurement defined in 4.4.4 and 4.4.5 valid for?

q_19868.question: What is the format of the FEC-declaration reference attribute in SDP session descriptions?
q_19868.ground_truth: The FEC-declaration reference attribute in SDP session descriptions is a media-level only attribute, used as a short hand to reference one of one or more FEC-declarations, with the format "a=FEC: fec-ref".

q_19869.question: When forwarding an SDP offer, when should an IMS-ALG perform proactive transcoding based on the SDP answer?
q_19869.ground_truth: An IMS-ALG should avoid the potential need to retain a media resource to perform format mapping by adding a codec to the format list of the m-line that does not require translation between the received and forwarded SDP offer.

q_19870.question: What is the format of the UserInfoID leaf when used for ProSe direct discovery parameters in group member discovery?
q_19870.ground_truth: The UserInfoID leaf for ProSe direct discovery parameters for group member discovery is a character string format.

q_19871.question: What information does the SGSN send to the RCAF in response to an APN information request?
q_19871.ground_truth: The SGSN sends the APN information response to the RCAF, which contains the list of APNs of the active PDN connections of each IMSI.

q_19872.question: What is the multiplexing loss for the VoIP cases when using MCS to multiplex RTTI and legacy mobiles?
q_19872.ground_truth: The multiplexing loss for the VoIP cases is between 3 % and 13 %.

q_19873.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the 3GPP management system for the creation of a Network Slice Instance (NSI) for a NPN?
q_19873.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system needs to determine the requirements for both the RAN part and the CN part based on the NPN SLA requirements from the NPN customer.

q_19874.question: What is the definition of a Restricted ProSe Application User ID in the context of Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
q_19874.ground_truth: A Restricted ProSe Application User ID is an identifier associated with the Application Layer User ID in the ProSe Application Server to hide or protect the application level user identity from the 3GPP layer. It unambiguously identifies the user within a given application.

q_19875.question: What does the acronym "OTA" stand for in the context of the present document?
q_19875.ground_truth: "OTA" stands for "Over-The-Air" in the context of the present document.

q_19876.question: When does the IMS-ALG recalculate the received bandwidth properties in the SDP body?
q_19876.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG recalculates the received bandwidth properties if it receives an SDP body containing the "a=bw-info" SDP attribute and if the IMS-AGW interconnects call legs in IP domains where different IP versions (IPv4 or IPv6) are used and the received "a=bw-info" SDP attribute lines related to the same payload type and the same direction do not contain bandwidth properties for both IPv4 and IPv6.

q_19877.question: What is the function of Offline Charging System (OFCS) in a GPRS network?
q_19877.ground_truth: The Offline Charging System (OFCS) collects charging records from SGSNs, S-GWs and P-GW/GGSNs.

q_19878.question: What is the resynchronization procedure used when the construction of the periodic part of the excitation results in a drift of the glottal pulse position?
q_19878.ground_truth: The resynchronization procedure involves adjusting the position of the glottal pulses in the concealed frame to be synchronized with the estimated true glottal pulses positions. This is done by estimating the phase information and aligning the maximum pulse in each pitch period of the concealed frame to the estimated position of the glottal pulse.

q_19879.question: What is the name of the SCI format used for the decoding of PSSCH with HARQ operation?

q_19880.question: Which measurement provides the number of total modulation mode scheduled TTIs in UTRAN cell?
q_19880.ground_truth: The measurement provided in 4.39.3 HSPA evolution scheduling related measurements is the number of total modulation mode scheduled TTIs in UTRAN cell.

q_19881.question: What should the SGSN do if the IMSI is not present in the Permanent NAS UE Identity IE in the Relocation Request message during the UTRAN to GAN PS handover?
q_19881.ground_truth: The SGSN should send the Relocation Failure message to the SGSN including Cause value "Relocation Failure In Target CN/RNC Or Target System" and abort the relocation procedure.

q_19882.question: What enhancements were implemented as part of the Coverage and Handoff Enhancements for Multimedia (CHEM) feature that went beyond SRVCC and LTE in general handoffs?
q_19882.ground_truth: The CHEM feature included intra-domain handoffs, such as intra-system and inter-system handoffs, for any type of media, as well as inter-domain handoffs, as specified in 3GPP TS 26.114 annexes.

q_19883.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a change of area type deferred location request in the LCS Area Event Invoke message and supports this type of request?
q_19883.ground_truth: The UE starts monitoring for the change of area event after sending an acknowledgement to the MSC/SGSN if it receives a change of area type deferred location request in the LCS Area Event Invoke message and supports this type of request.

q_19884.question: In 1.28Mcps TDD mode, what should the DRNS do if the Multi-Carrier E-DCH Transport Bearer Mode LCR IE is set to "Separate Iur Transport Bearer Mode"?
q_19884.ground_truth: The DRNS should use "Separate Iur Transport Bearer Mode" for the transport bearer mode and apply separate transport bearers for the MAC-d flows.

q_19885.question: What is the role of the duplicate avoidance and reordering function for unacknowledged mode in the UE?
q_19885.ground_truth: The duplicate avoidance and reordering function combines PDU sequences received from several sources and repeat transmissions from a single source to form a single ordered PDU sequence that is passed to the header removal and reassembly functions. It completes duplicate detection, discard, and re-ordering based on the UM PDU sequence number.

q_19886.question: In HS-DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION TYPE 1 Control Frame, what does a value of 0 in the HS-DSCH Credits IE indicate?
q_19886.ground_truth: There are no resources allocated for transmission, and transmission should stop.

q_19887.question: In the event of an in-progress emergency state with a new emergency indication, what actions should the IWF perform if the other affiliated members need to be notified?
q_19887.ground_truth: For each of the other affiliated members of the group, generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the MCPTT user's emergency indication, with the <emergency-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body set to a value of "true." If the received SIP re-INVITE contains an alert indication set to "true" and this is an authorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert meeting the specified conditions, perform the procedures as specified in clause~6.6.3.1.7.

q_19888.question: What is the energy ratio used to pick the interpolation factors in adaptive interpolation of LSFs?
q_19888.ground_truth: The energy ratio of synthesis filters resulting from the LSF vectors is used to pick the interpolation factors in adaptive interpolation of LSFs.

q_19889.question: Which general result is given when the command is performed successfully for launch browser 8.3.1?
q_19889.ground_truth: The general result given is "Command performed successfully".

q_19890.question: When is an element in the array V(N) set to the value RECEIVED in a TBF with FANR activated?
q_19890.ground_truth: When an RLC data block is received with BSN within the receive window in a TBF with FANR activated, the corresponding element in V(N) is set to the value RECEIVED.

q_19891.question: What is the minimum UE class supporting the combination of DL: 64 kbps with interactive/background 32 kbps PS RAB, SRBs for CCCH, DCCH and BCCH in 9.4.2 classes?
q_19891.ground_truth: The minimum UE class supporting this combination is DL: 64 kbps.

q_19892.question: What is the situation when a call from A to B is active, and C attempts to contact B while B is waiting for A's response?
q_19892.ground_truth: In this situation, the call from C is held in a waiting state.

q_19893.question: What is the responsibility of the RM&O Support & Readiness processes in regards to new or enhanced resource classes?
q_19893.ground_truth: The RM&O Support & Readiness processes are responsible for managing classes of resources, ensuring their availability, and conducting operations readiness testing and acceptance for new or enhanced resource classes.

q_19894.question: What should be populated within sgsn-Capability in UpdateGprsLocationArg when received ULR contains a SupportedRAT-TypesIndicator AVP?
q_19894.ground_truth: The supportedRAT-TypesIndicator shall be populated with the value received within the RAT-Type AVP in the received ULR.

q_19895.question: What is the format of the "ProtocolIE-Single-Container" in the DelayedActivationInformationList-RL-ActivationCmdFDD and DelayedActivationInformationList-RL-ActivationCmdTDD sequences?
q_19895.ground_truth: The "ProtocolIE-Single-Container" in the DelayedActivationInformationList-RL-ActivationCmdFDD and DelayedActivationInformationList-RL-ActivationCmdTDD sequences is a container for a single Protocol IE that can be used to transfer information related to the activation of radio links.

q_19896.question: What information is used by the NRF for selecting the target PLMN when using service-based interfaces?
q_19896.ground_truth: The NRF uses MSISDN to select the target PLMN when the recipient's identity is known and, optionally, includes an indication for the NRF to determine the target PLMN and interface to be used in the discovery request.

q_19897.question: What type of server update, request, or notification is being performed in a Server-Assignment-Request operation in 3GPP~TS~29.228?
q_19897.ground_truth: The Server-Assignment-Type AVP is of type Enumerated and indicates the type of server update, request, or notification being performed in a Server-Assignment-Request operation in 3GPP~TS~29.228.

q_19898.question: What is the maximum difference in output power allowed between a timeslot used for BCCH/CCCH and the timeslot preceding it in the BCCH carrier power save mode operation?
q_19898.ground_truth: The maximum difference in output power allowed between a timeslot used for BCCH/CCCH and the timeslot preceding it in the BCCH carrier power save mode operation is 3 dB.

q_19899.question: What is the purpose of the document "3GPP TS 36.579-5: Mission Critical (MC) services over LTE; Part 5: Abstract test suite (ATS)"?
q_19899.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to specify the protocol and signalling conformance testing in TTCN-3 for the Mission Critical services over LTE signalling and protocol requirements defined by 3GPP.

q_19900.question: What message is sent by the CN to order the RNC to release all MBMS resources related to the Iu connection?

q_19901.question: What is the Iur interface in UTRAN and what does it do?
q_19901.ground_truth: The Iur interface is a logical interface between the two Radio Network Controllers (RNCs) in the UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network (UTRAN). It is used for transporting Radio Network Subsystem Application Part (RNSAP) signalling messages between the two RNCs.

q_19902.question: What is the content of step 4 in the test procedure for the E-UTRAN FDD UE Rx-Tx time difference case, as per clause 8.1.1.4.2?
q_19902.ground_truth: The SS transmits an LPP REQUEST CAPABILITIES message, followed by an LPP PROVIDE CAPABILITIES message indicating the ECID capabilities supported by the UE in the ECID-ProvideCapabilities IE.

q_19903.question: What is the procedure defined in 3G TS 33.102 that 2G AKA has to support for a mixed 2G/3G network environment?

q_19904.question: What is the overall algorithmic delay for WB, SWB and FB output in the EVS codec?
q_19904.ground_truth: The overall algorithmic delay is 32 ms for WB, SWB and FB output in the EVS codec.

q_19905.question: What is the HTTP response when the PFDF cannot ensure that the PCEF/TDF will pull the PFDs in time?
q_19905.ground_truth: The PFDF sends an HTTP response with a failure reason and the caching time value used in the comparison, and may still store the PFDs for this application identifier.

q_19906.question: What is the role of the NG-RAN in providing the UE specific PC5 DRX cycle to the UE?
q_19906.ground_truth: The NG-RAN provides the UE specific PC5 DRX cycle to the UE based on the PC5 QoS parameters which are provided from the AMF during the registration procedure.

q_19907.question: What indication is sent by the initial AMF to the AUSF in step 3 for the purpose of AMF re-allocation?
q_19907.ground_truth: A related indication along with target AMF information, SUPI, and privacy protected UE ID

q_19908.question: What is the logical interface specified in the document between the NG-RAN and the 5GC?

q_19909.question: What are the conditions for test case c) regarding frequency offsets, when the same total number of exceptions M for N active carriers shall apply as given above for test case a)?
q_19909.ground_truth: The same total number of exceptions M for N active carriers shall apply as given above for test case a), including the range of frequency offsets between 0.6 MHz above the uppermost carrier of the lower sub-block and 0.6 MHz below the lowermost carrier of the upper sub-block.

q_19910.question: What is the purpose of the paging indication message on EC-PICH (EC PAGING INDICATION)?
q_19910.ground_truth: The purpose of the paging indication message is to convey a wake-up or sleep indication to a mobile station capable of receiving EC-PICH in a specific coverage class condition (CC3 or CC4). It enables the mobile station to detect its paging block by correlation with the transmitted sequence.

q_19911.question: What are the four medium access modes supported in this wireless communication system?
q_19911.ground_truth: The four medium access modes supported are Dynamic allocation, Fixed Uplink Allocation, Extended Dynamic allocation, and Exclusive allocation.

q_19912.question: What message does the SMLC send to the serving BSS to request for assistance information needed for the Multilateration Timing Advance procedure?
q_19912.ground_truth: The SMLC sends a BSSMAP-LE Assistance Information Request message to the serving BSS to request for assistance information.

q_19913.question: What is Inter-cell Interference Coordination (ICIC) concerned with in LTE?
q_19913.ground_truth: ICIC is concerned with managing radio resources to keep inter-cell interference under control in LTE.

q_19914.question: What status is the conversation between A and B in?
q_19914.ground_truth: The conversation between A and B is currently active and held.

q_19915.question: What is the rationale behind the classification of unwanted emissions as out-of-band and spurious in 3GPP specifications?
q_19915.ground_truth: Out-of-band emissions result from the modulation process and non-linearity in the transmitter but excluding spurious emissions. Spurious emissions are emissions on a frequency, or frequencies, outside the necessary bandwidth that do not affect the corresponding transmission of information.

q_19916.question: What information is included in a Routeing Area Identity (RAI)?
q_19916.ground_truth: RAI includes MCC, MNC, LAC, and RAC. RAC identifies one or several cells, while the rest of the parameters identify the PLMN and LA.

q_19917.question: What should be the format for referencing documents in a 3GPP TS or 3GPP TR?
q_19917.ground_truth: References should be given to Standards and Recommendations issued by recognized standardization bodies. Referencing of documents other than Standards and Recommendations are allowed only if they are publicly available in the English language during the approval phases and for the expected lifetime of the 3GPP TS or 3GPP TR, via the originating body or via the 3GPP Support Team.

q_19918.question: What is the fundamental operating principle of the VAD?
q_19918.ground_truth: The VAD is a binary flag that indicates whether each 20 ms frame produced by the speech encoder contains speech or not. It uses energy detection, filtering, and threshold comparison to distinguish between noise with speech present and noise without speech present.

q_19919.question: What does the Index Count field indicate in the 3GPP TS 23.040 specification?
q_19919.ground_truth: The Index Count identifies the number of short message indices contained in a MESSAGE LIST response from the MT to the TE and is an 8-bit number.

q_19920.question: What is the purpose of the administrator root public key in a MExE device?
q_19920.ground_truth: The administrator root public key is primarily used for designating an administrator of the third party certificates in a MExE device.

q_19921.question: What is the purpose of redefining the RRBP and ES/P fields in the header of EGPRS DL data blocks?
q_19921.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable the network to dynamically request either the short bitmap (default case) or the conventional Ack/Nack message when necessary to recover from the loss of several successive polling requests/polling responses.

q_19922.question: What security measures should be met for MTC optimizations to not degrade communication security compared to non-MTC communications?
q_19922.ground_truth: MTC optimizations should follow security requirements outlined in 3GPP TS 22.368 to prevent security degradation in 3GPP networks.

q_19923.question: Which test case should be used to test the invocation behavior of the CatStatus API when the "Status" argument is NULL?
q_19923.ground_truth: Test Case 4: Status with NULL argument

q_19924.question: What must the network consider in order to avoid wasting radio resources when sending RLC blocks to a mobile station?
q_19924.ground_truth: The network should avoid (re)transmitting RLC blocks that will not be considered as valid by the mobile stations, as this would lead to a waste of radio resources.

q_19925.question: What is the procedure for data notification from PLMN when UE is accessing SNPN?
q_19925.ground_truth: The procedure involves sending a N1 message from the UE in step 2, sending a N2 message with release assistance info and reachability indicator from the PLMN AMF to the PLMN N3IWF in step 3, forwarding the N1 message from the PLMN N3IWF over SNPN UP to the UE in step 4, sending a release message related to the security tunnel to the N3IWF in step 5, and sending the IPSec protocol data to the UE via the SNPN UP in step 6.

q_19926.question: What is the purpose of the "TransmittedCarrierPowerOfAllCodesNotUsedForHS-PDSCH-HS-SCCH-E-AGCH-E-RGCHOrE-HICHTransmissionCellPortionValue" field?
q_19926.ground_truth: The "TransmittedCarrierPowerOfAllCodesNotUsedForHS-PDSCH-HS-SCCH-E-AGCH-E-RGCHOrE-HICHTransmissionCellPortionValue" field stores the transmission power of all codes that are not used for HS-PDSCH, HS-SCCH, E-AGCH, E-RGCH, or E-HICH transmission on a cell.

q_19927.question: What was the increase in capacity performance for FR1, Uma, DL, for CG, with single stream traffic model, DDDUU/DDDSU TDD format, with SU-MIMO, 30Mbps, 15ms PDB, 60 FPS, when using cooperative MIMO/precoding compared to zero-forcing precoding?

q_19928.question: What should the BSS do when it fails to respond to a PERFORM-LOCATION-REQUEST PDU?
q_19928.ground_truth: The BSS should return a PERFORM-LOCATION-RESPONSE PDU with a LCS cause value indicating the failure cause.

q_19929.question: What protocol is used to transport the CS domain user plane between the MS and GANC in the GAN architecture?
q_19929.ground_truth: The CS domain user plane is transported over RTP/UDP between MS and GANC in the GAN architecture.

q_19930.question: What is the UE's action in response to receiving UEInformationRequest message with idleModeMeasurementReq if the measurement procedure was unsuccessful and RRC connection re-establishment occurred?
q_19930.ground_truth: UE does not report measurement results in UEInformationResponse message

q_19931.question: What does the AttenuationFactor represent in the HS-DSCH throughput for fixed reference channels for MU-MIMO requirements?
q_19931.ground_truth: The AttenuationFactor represents the ratio of user's signal power to interference user's signal power in the HS-DSCH throughput for fixed reference channels for MU-MIMO requirements.

q_19932.question: What is the MCL value for the Local Area base station in the same geographic area for the adjacent channels where the ACLR requirement applies and the carrier separation is 5 MHz or less?
q_19932.ground_truth: The MCL value for the Local Area base station in the same geographic area for the adjacent channels where the ACLR requirement applies and the carrier separation is 5 MHz or less is 87 dB.

q_19933.question: What is the role of the NF Service Consumer in accessing services from the data producer?
q_19933.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer, such as NWDAF, accesses services from the data producer by sending a service request to the DCCF, which includes a Client Credentials Assertion (CCA) token for authentication. The DCCF then determines the appropriate NF Service Producer for the requested data and requests an access token from the NRF to access the services on behalf of the NF Service Consumer.

q_19934.question: Which attribute is set to "passive" when the SCC AS acts as a routing B2BUA?
q_19934.ground_truth: The "a=setup" attribute is set to "passive" in this case.

q_19935.question: How does the IVS modem determine if the PSAP is ready to receive the MSD transmission in push mode?
q_19935.ground_truth: By detecting START messages from the PSAP or a timeout occurs.

q_19936.question: What is the Primitive Type of BMC-Data41-REQ?
q_19936.ground_truth: The Primitive Type of BMC-Data41-REQ is request.

q_19937.question: What mechanism provides transport network redundancy with SCTP?
q_19937.ground_truth: Transport network redundancy may be achieved by SCTP multi-homing between two end-points, of which one or both is assigned with multiple IP addresses, resulting in SCTP end-points supporting a multi-homed remote SCTP end-point.

q_19938.question: What is the difference between locally managed NIDs and universally managed NIDs in the management of Stand-alone Non-Public Networks (SNPNs)?
q_19938.ground_truth: Locally managed NIDs are chosen individually by SNPNs during deployment time and use a different numbering space, while universally managed NIDs are globally unique and managed by 3GPP system.

q_19939.question: In the case of AM RLC entity for SRB#2, what happens when the UE's reply is received successfully during lossless SRNS relocation in the "UE not involved" scenario?
q_19939.ground_truth: The RLC entities for affected radio bearers (other than SRB#2) are re-established, and the HFN values for each RB are set to the START value in the message for corresponding CN domain. Data buffers are also flushed for each RB.

q_19940.question: How is the Multimedia Priority Service invoked and when does it receive priority treatment in the network?
q_19940.ground_truth: The Multimedia Priority Service is invoked only when requested and an idle voice or traffic channel is not available. It receives priority ingress treatment for session origination and priority egress treatment for session delivery.

q_19941.question: What is the format of the Resource-Release-Notification AVP in the Charging-Rule-Remove AVP?
q_19941.ground_truth: The Resource-Release-Notification AVP in the Charging-Rule-Remove AVP is of type Enumerated and can have the values 0 or 1, indicating whether resource release should be notified or not.

q_19942.question: What conditions should be met before the UE sets the logMeasAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 8.1.6.1.2.1.2.1?
q_19942.ground_truth: The UE should set the logMeasAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message if it has logged measurements available for NR, the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport, and the logged measurements are not included in the logMeasReport in the UEInformationResponse message.

q_19943.question: What action does the GANC take when it receives the GA-RRC UPLINK DIRECT TRANSFER message from the MS in the GA-RRC-CONNECTED state?
q_19943.ground_truth: The GANC transfers the NAS message to the CN using the existing signalling connection.

q_19944.question: What is the difference between the 7.6.3.1 and 7.6.3.2 call flows in terms of sending the SIP INVITE request?
q_19944.ground_truth: In 7.6.3.1, the MGCF defers sending of INVITE until preconditions are met, while in 7.6.3.2, the MGCF sends the SIP INVITE request to the next IMS node before preconditions are fulfilled and requests support for preconditions.

q_19945.question: What was the issue raised in RAN4#93 regarding the "famous sentence" in Rel-15 CR for EN-DC power class clarification?
q_19945.ground_truth: The issue was that the "famous sentence" regarding the UE's power class in EN-DC was unclear, and some vendors wanted to revise the related parameters for more precise PHR reporting.

q_19946.question: What is the function of the Direct Tunnel in the Home eNodeB Subsystem?
q_19946.ground_truth: The Direct Tunnel in the Home eNodeB Subsystem allows for a direct connection between the Home eNodeB Subsystem and the GGSN or Serving GW nodes, bypassing the need for a separate user plane entity.

q_19947.question: What information related to a user's location does the SGSN need to collect for charging purposes in a GPRS network?
q_19947.ground_truth: The SGSN needs to collect information about the user's location, including HPLMN (Home PLMN), VPLMN (Visited PLMN), and optional higher-accuracy location information such as RAI/CGI/SAI.

q_19948.question: What is the main difference between inter-DRNC and intra-DRNC synchronised serving HS-DSCH cell change at a hard handover?
q_19948.ground_truth: The main difference is that in inter-DRNC, the source and target nodes are controlled by two different DRNCs, and in intra-DRNC, both nodes are controlled by the same DRNC. The HS-DSCH mobility procedure is performed in one step for inter-DRNC, and two steps for intra-DRNC.

q_19949.question: In which scenario would the UE receive a 5GMM cause #90 along with the 5GSM message from the Payload container IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message?
q_19949.ground_truth: The UE receives a 5GMM cause #90 along with the 5GSM message from the Payload container IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message when the UE is registered to a PLMN via a satellite NG-RAN cell that is not allowed to operate at the present UE location, and the payload of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message cannot be forwarded due to a routing failure.

q_19950.question: What is the meaning of the Result-Code AVP values defined in Diameter BASE for the Success category?
q_19950.ground_truth: Result-Code AVP values defined in Diameter BASE for the Success category are used to inform a peer that a request has been successfully completed.

q_19951.question: What is the condition for the old SGSN to initiate the relocation resource allocation procedure?
q_19951.ground_truth: The old SGSN initiates the relocation resource allocation procedure in case of inter-SGSN SRNS relocation.

q_19952.question: What is the definition of transmit OFF power and in what condition the transmitter is considered OFF?
q_19952.ground_truth: Transmit OFF power is the TRP in the channel bandwidth when the transmitter is OFF. The transmitter is considered OFF when the UE is not allowed to transmit on any of its ports.

q_19953.question: What is the criticality of "id-RL-Information-RL-ReconfPrepTDD" in the RL-Information-RL-ReconfPrepTDD sequence?

q_19954.question: What message is sent to the GTP-MAP protocol-converting GSN to set the MNRG flag for the IMSI in the HLR?

q_19955.question: What does the '1' value of bit 1 in octet 1 of the GTP' header indicate?
q_19955.ground_truth: In GTP' v0, the '1' value of bit 1 in octet 1 of the GTP' header indicates the usage of the 6 octets header. For all other versions of GTP, this bit is not used and is set to '0'.

q_19956.question: What is an "association" between a VLR and an SGSN in the context of the 3GPP system?
q_19956.ground_truth: An association consists of the SGSN storing the number of the VLR serving the MS for circuit switched services and the VLR storing the number of the SGSN serving the MS for packet switched services. This association is only applicable to MSs in class-A mode of operation and MSs in class-B mode of operation.

q_19957.question: What is the impact of reducing the number of unique BSIC code points to 8 in a BSIC plan on the EC-GSM-IoT synchronization performance?
q_19957.ground_truth: Reducing the number of unique BSIC code points to 8 in a BSIC plan does not have a significant impact on the EC-GSM-IoT synchronization performance.

q_19958.question: What are the main issues discussed in the document related to the backhaul long latency problem?
q_19958.ground_truth: The main issues discussed are the impact of long distances between the RAN and the node hosting the application content, and the number of routers on this route, which can result in long transportation latency and affect certain kinds of service.

q_19959.question: What is the bearer type for the first interface to the core network and bearer?
q_19959.ground_truth: The bearer type for the first interface to the core network and bearer is GSM-CSD.

q_19960.question: What is the purpose of timingslots ISCP measurement in 3GPP TS 36.104 V17.0.0?
q_19960.ground_truth: The timingslots ISCP measurement is a measure of intercell interference in the 3GPP TS 36.104 V17.0.0, which applies only for TDD mode.

q_19961.question: What are the main sets of procedures introduced for NACC in Release 4?
q_19961.ground_truth: The two main sets of procedures introduced for NACC in Release 4 are: 1) sending neighboring cell system information to an MS for initial access after a cell change, and 2) Cell Change Notification (CCN) mode procedures, which support an MS with a cell re-selection and put the MS into CCN mode before the cell change.

q_19962.question: What is the minimum requirement for the Transmit OFF power for 1.28Mcps TDD MC-HSUPA?
q_19962.ground_truth: The transmit OFF power is defined per carrier as the RRC filtered mean power in a duration of at least one timeslot excluding any transient periods. The requirement for the transmit OFF power in each carrier shall be less than -65 dBm, when the transmissions in all carriers are turned off.

q_19963.question: What does a UE use for CSG cell selection and reselection in 3GPP mobile networks?
q_19963.ground_truth: A UE uses the CSG whitelist along with the CSG Identity and associated PLMN ID broadcast by the CSG Cells in CSG cell selection and reselection.

q_19964.question: Which algorithm was selected as the winner of the SHA-3 competition and is used in the Tuak design?

q_19965.question: What data type is specified for the "Enable" element in this XML schema?
q_19965.ground_truth: The data type specified for the "Enable" element is boolean.

q_19966.question: What are the two modes between which the network can switch to trade-off capacity vs peak data rate?
q_19966.ground_truth: The two modes are Receive Diversity (RxDiv) mode and the Dual/Multi-carrier mode (MC).

q_19967.question: What does the DestinationIDType AVP indicate in the DestinationID AVP?
q_19967.ground_truth: The DestinationIDType AVP indicates which kind of destination information is contained in the DestinationIDData AVP in the DestinationID AVP.

q_19968.question: What is the DIR2 measure used for in the link level modelling for SAIC receivers?
q_19968.ground_truth: The DIR2 measure is used to investigate the validity of using a simple two cochannel interferer model when evaluating the SAIC link level performance.

q_19969.question: Which interface is used for delivering PTC Intercept Product based on duplication of packets without modification at the PoC/MCPTT server?
q_19969.ground_truth: The X3-interface is used for delivering PTC Intercept Product based on duplication of packets without modification at the PoC/MCPTT server.

q_19970.question: What should the UE do if it identifies a HS-SCCH to be incorrect?
q_19970.ground_truth: The UE should discard the data on the HS-SCCH and return to monitoring.

q_19971.question: What is the purpose of the Overall Description of the GPRS Radio Interface in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_19971.ground_truth: The Overall Description of the GPRS Radio Interface provides the services offered to higher-layer functions, the distribution of required functions into functional groups, a definition of the capabilities of each functional group, service primitives for each functional group, including a description of what services and information flows are to be provided, and a model of operation for information flows within and between the functions.

q_19972.question: What is the difference in processing required for the EVS codec compared to the AMR-WB codec?
q_19972.ground_truth: The EVS codec requires 69% more processing on average to reproduce twice the audio bandwidth in a SWB capable UE than the AMR-WB codec providing WB.

q_19973.question: What is the state of the UE when the eCall inactivity procedure is started?
q_19973.ground_truth: The UE is in any 5GMM-REGISTERED substate except 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH or 5GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE, or in 5GMM-IDLE mode.

q_19974.question: What is the encoding method for the absolute vector in the indexing of codevector in base codebook?
q_19974.ground_truth: The encoding method for the absolute vector is a multi-level permutation-based index encoding method.

q_19975.question: What is the role of the EVS Receiver architecture in the communication process?
q_19975.ground_truth: The EVS Receiver architecture is built on top of the EVS Jitter Buffer Management solution, which depacketizes received EVS frames and feeds them to the Jitter Buffer Management (JBM) for smooth playout. The JBM smoothes the inter-arrival jitter of incoming packets and provides PCM buffers for uninterrupted playout.

q_19976.question: What actions does the Transit Function take if the triggers of the list do not match with the SPTs of the request?
q_19976.ground_truth: The Transit Function proceeds with the next Transit Invocation Criteria in the list until the last criteria has been checked.

q_19977.question: What is the purpose of the HS-SCCH orders in Dual Cell E-DCH operation?
q_19977.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH orders are used by the Node-B to activate and deactivate the Secondary Downlink Frequency and Secondary Uplink Frequency in Dual Cell E-DCH operation.

q_19978.question: What is the role of SCTP in 3GPP TS 36.423?
q_19978.ground_truth: SCTP (IETF RFC 4960) is the transport layer of X2 signalling bearer in 3GPP TS 36.423, and it is used for reliable delivery of X2-AP messages between eNB and en-gNB.

q_19979.question: What does the "clientId" attribute represent in the "rackType" complex type in the XML syntax for a reception report request?
q_19979.ground_truth: The "clientId" attribute in the "rackType" complex type in the XML syntax for a reception report request represents the identifier for a client.

q_19980.question: What does the MGCF do when it receives a 2xx final response for an early dialogue and the remote resources at IM-MGW do not match?
q_19980.ground_truth: The MGCF requires updating the allocated resources and creates an encapsulated ANM or CON message, sends it within a final 200 OK response to the initial INVITE to the SIP-I based circuit-switched 3GPP core network. To avoid transcoding, the MGCF constructs a new SDP offer based upon the remote resources and sends it within an UPDATE or re-INVITE request.

q_19981.question: In the prediction of TUTRAN-GPS measurements, what is the variable B used for?
q_19981.ground_truth: B is the last reported TUTRAN-GPS value used for calculating the predicted TUTRAN-GPS value when n measurement results have been received after the first Common Measurement Reporting at initiation or after the last event was triggered.

q_19982.question: What action should the MS take if it receives an unexpected GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message response while the GA-PSR is in GA-PSR-STANDBY state?

q_19983.question: What does the term "IRP" stands for in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_19983.ground_truth: IRP stands for Integration Reference Point, which is a way of communication between network elements.

q_19984.question: What does "SUL" stand for in the document?

q_19985.question: What message does the network send to the mobile station if uplink resources are not available?
q_19985.ground_truth: The network sends an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message to the mobile station if uplink resources are not available.

q_19986.question: Which mode of H(e)NB provides services to non-CSG members as well as CSG members?
q_19986.ground_truth: Hybrid access mode is the mode of H(e)NB that provides services to non-CSG members as well as CSG members.

q_19987.question: What is the required interruption time when the UE receives a RRC message implying FDD/TDD handover with the activation time "now" or earlier than RRC procedure delay seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command?
q_19987.ground_truth: The UE shall be ready to start the transmission of the new uplink DPCH within Dhandover seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command, where Dhandover is the RRC procedure delay plus the interruption time.

q_19988.question: What operation type is specified in the Notify sent by the VNFM to the EM in step 4.2.3.1.2 to indicate the result of VNF scaling?

q_19989.question: What is the effect of using the "allRequests" parameter in the Cancel operation for the gsmSSF?
q_19989.ground_truth: When the "allRequests" parameter is used, all armed EDPs are disarmed, and any pending "ApplyChargingReport" and "CallInformationReport" are cancelled, causing the gsmSSF FSM to transit to the state "Idle".

q_19990.question: What is the implementation-dependent delay for Ttransc?
q_19990.ground_truth: The implementation-dependent delay for Ttransc is the speech encoder processing time, from input of the last PCM sample to output of the final encoded bit.

q_19991.question: What is the role of the SMF during MBS session establishment procedure?
q_19991.ground_truth: The SMF determines PCC rules for the MBS session, which includes QoS parameters for multicast/broadcast mode and optionally QoS parameters for unicast mode. The SMF then provides N4 rules for the MBS session to the UPF and QoS profiles to the RAN.

q_19992.question: What is the procedure for short message forwarding when it is active for terminating user?
q_19992.ground_truth: When short message forwarding is active for terminating user, the VAS AS B takes a loop check for original SM, decides the message needs to be forwarded or not, and delivers the original short message to the MS C or the terminating user accordingly. The VAS AS B then sends a report to SMS Node B, and the SMS Node B notifies the originating side of the delivery status.

q_19993.question: What is the FAE server's response after the 3GPP system establishes or modifies the requested connectivity?
q_19993.ground_truth: The FAE server notifies both FAE clients of the established connection including its properties such as a FFA-2 direct service connection identifier and duration, regardless of traffic routing between FAE client 1 and FAE client 2 over FFA-2.

q_19994.question: What is the required capability of the signal generation device in terms of clock signal frequency?
q_19994.ground_truth: The signal generation device shall be capable of generating square wave signals for the clock on the UICC in the range of 1~MHz to 5~MHz.

q_19995.question: What is the difference between the RA1/RA1' function and the RA1'/RAA' function?
q_19995.ground_truth: The RA1/RA1' function is applied to substreams for AIURs less than or equal to 38.4 kbit/s, while the RA1'/RAA' function is applied to substreams for TCH/F14.4, TCH/F28.8, or TCH/F43.2 channel coding. The RA1/RA1' function converts 290-bit blocks into E-TRAU frames, while the RA1'/RAA' function converts 290-bit blocks into A-TRAU frames.

q_19996.question: What is the role of Quality of Experience (QoE) information collection in mobile networks?
q_19996.ground_truth: Quality of Experience (QoE) information collection provides detailed information at the session level on a number of User Equipment (UEs) and is vital for network operators, especially for real-time services that require high data rates and low latency.

q_19997.question: What is the purpose of the PDN-Connection-ID AVP in 5.3.58?
q_19997.ground_truth: The PDN-Connection-ID AVP indicates the PDN connection to which specific information refers.

q_19998.question: What procedure does the source HNB execute after receiving the RRC Cell Update Confirm message from the target HNB?
q_19998.ground_truth: The source HNB may execute the SRNS Relocation/Enhanced SRNS Relocation procedure towards the target HNB to transfer the UE context or initialise the UE context in the target HNB via RNSAP Common Transport Channel Resources Initialisation procedure.

q_19999.question: What is the implication of the GGSN detecting that the 3GPP PS Data Off UE Status is active in Iu mode of operation?
q_19999.ground_truth: The GGSN shall indicate this to the charging system for offline and online charging.

q_20000.question: What is the purpose of the response/report control function in network monitoring?
q_20000.ground_truth: The response/report control function in network monitoring allows the operator to specify where and when the information should be sent, and enables or disables information forwarding, directs information to any of various NMs, and forwards information as soon as it is available.

q_20001.question: How many HARQ processes are assigned for HS-DSCH operation on every carrier for every user in a 1.28 Mcps TDD multi-frequency HS-DSCH cell?
q_20001.ground_truth: Multiple HARQ processes are assigned for HS-DSCH operation on every carrier for every user in a 1.28 Mcps TDD multi-frequency HS-DSCH cell. Only one HARQ process in HARQ sub-entity is allowed to receive HS-DSCH in one TTI for each carrier.

q_20002.question: What is the requirement for determining authorization for initiating an MCPTT imminent peril call?
q_20002.ground_truth: The IWF shall obtain the MCPTT user profile and the group information if the MCPTT user is authorized to initiate an imminent peril call and if the IWF allows the group to support imminent peril calls.

q_20003.question: What is the number of columns in the matrix for the 2nd interleaving?

q_20004.question: What should the MGCF do when a speech transcoder is included upon the speech coding information provided to each termination in the IM-MGW?
q_20004.ground_truth: The MGCF may include a speech transcoder based upon the speech coding information provided to each termination in the IM-MGW.

q_20005.question: What is the spectral shape constraint used for computing the FIR filter for the mid-band processing?
q_20005.ground_truth: A novel spectral shape constraint is used for computing the FIR filter for the mid-band processing.

q_20006.question: If the SIM Toolkit Framework uses the SET UP IDLE MODE TEXT proactive command, can another applet overwrite this text at a later stage?
q_20006.ground_truth: The SIM Toolkit Framework cannot guarantee that if the SET UP IDLE MODE TEXT proactive command is used by a toolkit applet, another toolkit applet will not overwrite this text at a later stage.

q_20007.question: What should the IP-SM-GW do upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP INVITE request when sending a large Instant Message?
q_20007.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP INVITE request, the IP-SM-GW sends MSRP SEND request(s) containing the content of the concatenated Short Messages, and generates a SIP BYE request to release the session.

q_20008.question: Which interface definition is not provided in the document for standardized X2?
q_20008.ground_truth: The standardized X2 interface is not provided in the document for transporting IRI.

q_20009.question: What are the signalling interworking procedures between ISUP and SIP protocols defined in ITU-T Recommendation Q.1912.5, profile C?
q_20009.ground_truth: The signalling interworking procedures between ISUP and SIP protocols defined in ITU-T Recommendation Q.1912.5, profile C include interworking for ISUP capabilities, signalling information, SIP messages and SDP parameters, among others.

q_20010.question: What is the use of LegID in CAP V4?
q_20010.ground_truth: In CAP V4, two types of LegID may be exchanged between the gsmSCF and the gsmSSF - Sending Side LegID and Receiving Side LegID. Sending Side LegID is used in operations sent from the gsmSCF to the gsmSSF, and Receiving Side LegID is used in operations sent from the gsmSSF to the gsmSCF.

q_20011.question: In the ST-LR test series, how were the codecs tested for performance characterization over bit-rate?
q_20011.ground_truth: Two experiments involved the two selected 3GPP audio codecs operating at different bit-rates in mono and stereo modes. In each experiment, the MUSHRA ratings from 15 subjects, 12 test items, and two listening labs created the results.

q_20012.question: If the security check is successful, what should the UE do with the secured packet after receiving it from the AMF?
q_20012.ground_truth: The UE shall upload the secured packet to the USIM using procedures in 3GPP~TS~31.111.

q_20013.question: What is the purpose of the measurement named SC.SuccSession180.AT in the context of 4.1.2.16 Successful session establishments per access technology?
q_20013.ground_truth: The purpose of the measurement named SC.SuccSession180.AT is to provide the number of successful session establishments from the UE belonging to a given access technology at P-CSCF.

q_20014.question: Under what conditions will the gprsSSF transit to the state "Idle" after the RequestReportGPRSEvent procedure?
q_20014.ground_truth: The gprsSSF transits to the state "Idle" after the RequestReportGPRSEvent procedure if there are no pending reports or armed events.

q_20015.question: What does bit 7 in octet 5 indicate in non-transparent service?
q_20015.ground_truth: Bit 7 in octet 5 indicates the type of service for non-transparent service: 0 indicates transparent service, 1 indicates non-transparent service.

q_20016.question: What message does the MS send upon receiving the Packet Physical Information message in a pre-synchronised handover?
q_20016.ground_truth: The MS sends uplink LLC PDUs, e.g. a Routing Area Update Request message or uplink user data packets to the SGSN immediately after receiving the Packet Physical Information message or, in a synchronised or pre-synchronised handover, immediately if the PS Handover Access message is not required to be sent.

q_20017.question: What is the purpose of the "Message Identifier" in the H.248 package?
q_20017.ground_truth: The "Message Identifier" is used to identify the originator of the message. It consists of the fully qualified domain name of the TrGW and IBCF.

q_20018.question: Under what circumstances should an IWF reject a request to send SDS to an MCData group?
q_20018.ground_truth: If the <mcdata-allow-short-data-service> element under the <list-service> element, in the group document, is set to "false" for the MCData group.

q_20019.question: What is the procedure for storing user data in non-volatile memory in the secondary device?
q_20019.ground_truth: The secondary device stores user data in non-volatile memory starting with the relative memory address offset given in the initiating message and ensures that the number of octets to write is less than or equal to MaxDataReceiveLength minus 3.

q_20020.question: How long can the discovery UE ID be valid?
q_20020.ground_truth: The ProSe Discovery UE ID can be valid up to 525600 minutes as per the 4.2.36 ValidityTimerT4015 definition.

q_20021.question: What field in the sequence HS-DSCH-serving-cell-change-information refers to the information regarding the reporting period L within the HSDSCH?
q_20021.ground_truth: The field "hSDSCH-FDD-Information" refers to the information regarding the HSDSCH in FDD mode.

q_20022.question: What is the significance of the "name: value" pair in the manifest file?
q_20022.ground_truth: The "name: value" pair in the manifest file provides information about the data in the JAR file, such as the type of the contained files and their intended usage.

q_20023.question: What are the required interfaces between ASP and MNO for implementation of this solution?
q_20023.ground_truth: The required interfaces between ASP and MNO are ASP registration for IPv4/v6 multicast delivery with certain QoS requirement, ASP notification of UE IP addresses, and MNO notification of success/failure status of ASP notifications.

q_20024.question: What is the purpose of the RTI field in the downlink RLC/MAC control block header?
q_20024.ground_truth: The RTI field in the downlink RLC/MAC control block header performs a modulo 32 count of the downlink RLC/MAC control messages sent on a PDCH and allows the transmitting and receiving entities to distinguish between up to 32 RLC/MAC control messages in a single transmit direction.

q_20025.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation scheme in FR1, DL only evaluation, InH, VR/AR30 and low load?
q_20025.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided is 23.33%.

q_20026.question: What is the function of the User Multicast Service Create procedure?
q_20026.ground_truth: The User Multicast Service Create procedure creates a multicast service context for the user, such as for authentication and authorization, service parameters provisioning, etc.

q_20027.question: What is the purpose of the radio bearer test mode in the context of UE test loop function?
q_20027.ground_truth: The radio bearer test mode is used to set up radio bearers to be terminated in the UE test loop function without involving CC or SM, and to disable any control mechanisms in NAS protocols or in any UE applications that could release the RRC connection.

q_20028.question: What is the purpose of the Initial-DL-DPCH-TimingAdjustment_Allowed field in NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
q_20028.ground_truth: The Initial-DL-DPCH-TimingAdjustment_Allowed field in NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION is for specifying the initial Lolin TX WINDOW phase difference accepted by the NoDE, the first value is 0 and last value is 100, the value is for 3GPP, please refer to 3GPP TS 45.001 for more information

q_20029.question: Which solution proposes a dedicated integrity protection enabled PDU session for UP signalling messages when the integrity protection of a PDU session is not activated?
q_20029.ground_truth: Solution #1 addresses key issue #5 using a dedicated integrity protection enabled PDU session.

q_20030.question: What information can be included in the SAND header of an HTTP request in the described messaging protocol?
q_20030.ground_truth: The SAND header of an HTTP request in this messaging protocol can include status messages on proxy caching, such as anticipated requests, accepted alternatives, and next alternatives.

q_20031.question: What is the role of the User Plane Function (UPF) during the network switch from PLMN to SNPN and PDU session anchor re-selection?
q_20031.ground_truth: The User Plane Function (UPF) plays a vital role in re-selecting a new PDU session towards the local DN via a different UPF belonging to the SNPN for the dedicated application.

q_20032.question: What is the system information combination for NR Cells 1 and 3, as defined in TS 38.508-1?
q_20032.ground_truth: The system information combination for NR Cells 1 and 3 is NR-1.

q_20033.question: Which command type is used in the TERMINAL RESPONSE message with 3G Session Reset procedure?
q_20033.ground_truth: The REFRESH command type is used in the TERMINAL RESPONSE message with 3G Session Reset procedure.

q_20034.question: What are the three general architectures to offer energy savings functionalities?
q_20034.ground_truth: The three architectures are Distributed, NM-Centralized, and EM-Centralized.

q_20035.question: In the "Write-Replace-Warning-Request-IEs" sequence, what does the "ID id-Number-of-Broadcasts-Requested" field indicate?
q_20035.ground_truth: The "ID id-Number-of-Broadcasts-Requested" field specifies the number of broadcasts requested for the warning message.

q_20036.question: What does the NF do when it receives partial update indicator true in the NFR procedure?
q_20036.ground_truth: The NF compares the received NF status data with the NF profile locally stored and recognizes out which data is changed. The UDM stores received recovery time and user identifier ranges if the recovery time or user identifier ranges are changed. The UDM may include UDR recovery indication, recovery time of UDR, and impacted user identifier ranges in response headers via NF service consumers. The NF service consumers synchronize data related to the indicated users based on local policy.

q_20037.question: In what situations is the UE required to receive E-HICH subframes?
