q_20037.ground_truth: The UE is required to receive E-HICH subframes when it has received DRX de-activation or when it shall receive E-HICH subframes corresponding to an E-DCH transmission.

q_20038.question: What is a CS call in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_20038.ground_truth: A CS call, or Circuit Switched call, is a call routed through the CS domain. It can be a speech call, fax call, or data call, and it uses one bearer at a time.

q_20039.question: What is the role of the weighting factors in the quantization process?
q_20039.ground_truth: The weighting factors are used to weight the quantization error in the LSP domain. This is done to optimize the quantization process and improve the overall performance of the speech processing system.

q_20040.question: What is the main challenge in mapping the desired slice coverage into a geographical coverage area?
q_20040.ground_truth: The challenges are mapping the coverage area in the service profile to TA list assigned to cells, and ensuring that the desired slice coverage can be mapped to the coverage footprint of a cell or set of cells.

q_20041.question: When the UE determines the number of resource elements (NRE) for a PUSCH within a slot, what is used to determine the number of subcarriers in the frequency domain in a physical resource block (PRB)?
q_20041.ground_truth: The number of subcarriers in the frequency domain in a PRB is determined by the numerology used for the uplink, which is specified in TS 38.214.

q_20042.question: What is the general principle of LPC (Linearly Predictive Coding) shaping in MDCT domain?
q_20042.ground_truth: LPC shaping is performed in the MDCT domain by applying gain factors computed from weighted quantized LP filter coefficients to the MDCT spectrum.

q_20043.question: What actions does the PSS Adapter take upon receipt of a SIP INVITE message?
q_20043.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a SIP INVITE message, the PSS Adapter resolves the RTSP URI based on the R-URI, SDP parameters and selected PSS Server, may send a DESCRIBE message to the PSS Server to fetch the SDP file, constructs and sends RTSP SETUP message(s) to setup the relevant media streams, and returns the answer SDP to the UE in the SIP 200 OK.

q_20044.question: What is the mechanism that the 3GPP System needs to support for indicating active or inactive identities on a UE?
q_20044.ground_truth: The 3GPP System needs to support a mechanism that allows an authorized user to set user preferences to indicate which identities are active or inactive on a specific UE.

q_20045.question: What message does the CN sends to the GANC for Mobile-terminated call?
q_20045.ground_truth: The CN sends a Paging message to the GANC identified through the last Location Update received by it and includes the TMSI if available.

q_20046.question: What is the maximum allowed message size for messages transmitted on CCCH?
q_20046.ground_truth: The maximum allowed message size for messages transmitted on CCCH is as per 3GPP TS 34.101.

q_20047.question: What is the transmission mode state with a duration of 20ms for a TFC in 3.84 Mcps TDD mode and 7.68 Mcps TDD mode?

q_20048.question: When should a mobile station provide its radio access capabilities for a frequency band to the network?
q_20048.ground_truth: When the network assigns an EGPRS TBF and requests information about the radio access capabilities of the mobile station in the PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message.

q_20049.question: In the context of 6a.9.1.3, what action does UE-1 take when it receives a status update from UE-2 soliciting media flow transfer?
q_20049.ground_truth: UE-1 uses the relevant IUT procedure to transfer the media flow to UE-2.

q_20050.question: What is a trigger condition for converged charging in 5G ProSe Direct Discovery with 5G DDNMF and Direct Discovery over PC5 reference point?
q_20050.ground_truth: The UE receives a Direct Discovery Request with a ProSe Application Code for open discovery.

q_20051.question: Which type of NAS messages are transferred by the signalling radio bearer set up for high priority by the higher layers?
q_20051.ground_truth: The NAS messages set to "high priority" by the higher layers are transferred by the signalling radio bearer set up for high priority by the higher layers.

q_20052.question: What happens if both manually initiated and sCPOverloaded control types are active for the same gap criteria?
q_20052.ground_truth: The manually initiated control is applied.

q_20053.question: What are the main components of the Jitter Buffer Management (JBM) for EVS?
q_20053.ground_truth: The JBM for EVS consists of the RTP Depacker, De-jitter Buffer, EVS decoder, Time-Scale Modification, Receiver Output Buffer, Playout Delay Estimation Module, Network Jitter Analysis, and Adaptation Control Logic components.

q_20054.question: In the "Release 9x ME" column, what does the "M" notation indicate?
q_20054.ground_truth: The "M" notation in the "Release 9x ME" column indicates that the capability is required to be supported.

q_20055.question: Which sub-layer of Layer 2 interfaces the physical layer (Layer 1) in the LTE system?

q_20056.question: What should be the modulation scheme used when the repeater supports 64QAM without power back off for RUL-FR2-TM3.1?

q_20057.question: What type of AVP is the NIDD-Submission AVP and what information does it hold?
q_20057.ground_truth: The NIDD-Submission AVP is of type Grouped and holds information about the NIDD submission for CP data transfer. It has the following components: Submission-Timestamp, Event-Timestamp, Accounting-Input-Octets, Accounting-Output-Octets, and Change-Condition.

q_20058.question: What is the purpose of the Protocol Converter (PC) in the 3GPP REST reference point architecture?
q_20058.ground_truth: The Protocol Converter (PC) is responsible for converting application level information received from the AF to Diameter session information, and communicates with the PCRF via the Diameter based Rx reference point.

q_20059.question: What is the main reason for focusing on energy saving solutions for GSM/EDGE base transceiver stations (BTS)?
q_20059.ground_truth: The main reason is that energy consumption is a significant operational cost factor for mobile network operators, and it is expected to increase further with the rise in voice and data usage, as well as denser networks. Additionally, up to 80% of base stations in some regions use diesel as the primary or backup power source, contributing significantly to CO2 emissions.

q_20060.question: What type of phantom is used for testing laptop mounted equipment DUT?
q_20060.ground_truth: A laptop ground plane phantom is used for testing laptop mounted equipment.

q_20061.question: What is the purpose of the "Cell Identification discriminator" field in the protocol extension container?
q_20061.ground_truth: The "Cell Identification discriminator" field in the protocol extension container is used to identify a UTRAN cell for cell load information. It is coded as the RNC-ID (0..4095) or the Extended RNC-ID (4096..65535).

q_20062.question: What is the format of the payload in the RTP packet that contains redundant data blocks?
q_20062.ground_truth: The format of the payload in the RTP packet that contains redundant data blocks could use the format defined in RFC2198.

q_20063.question: What is the mapping of a burst for EC-PACCH/U/M in the document?
q_20063.ground_truth: The mapping of a burst is given by the rule e

q_20064.question: What is the difference between TCL and TCLw in the context of the present document?
q_20064.ground_truth: TCL is the frequency dependent coupling loss between the receiving port and sending port of a terminal, while TCLw is the weighted Terminal Coupling Loss using the weighting of CCITT Recommendation G.122.

q_20065.question: What is the maximum output power requirement for a base station in normal operating conditions?
q_20065.ground_truth: In normal conditions, the base station maximum output power shall remain within +2 dB and -2 dB of the manufacturer's rated output power.

q_20066.question: What is the requirement for the Peak Code Domain Error for 7.68 Mcps with a spreading factor of 32?
q_20066.ground_truth: The Peak Code Domain Error for 7.68 Mcps with a spreading factor of 32 shall not exceed -31 dB.

q_20067.question: What is the meaning of the g.3gpp.current-iut-controller set to "active" in the Contact header field from the received SIP 2xx response?
q_20067.ground_truth: The g.3gpp.current-iut-controller set to "active" in the Contact header field from the received SIP 2xx response indicates that the UE that sent the SIP 2xx response is the controller of the collaborative session.

q_20068.question: What is the meaning of SDU transfer delay in the context of ITU-T X.140?
q_20068.ground_truth: The value of elapsed time between the start of transfer and successful transfer of a specified service data unit (SDU).

q_20069.question: What is the action taken when the reported measurement result plus the hysteresis value is less than the threshold for a given event?
q_20069.ground_truth: The entering condition for the event is considered satisfied, meaning that the event is triggered.

q_20070.question: What must the P-CSCF do if the UE did not include any confidentiality algorithm in SM6?
q_20070.ground_truth: The P-CSCF will select the NULL encryption algorithm if the UE did not include any confidentiality algorithm in SM6.

q_20071.question: What is the primary role of the primary PCF in local quota distribution and redistribution?
q_20071.ground_truth: The primary PCF proactively distributes the local quotas to the associated PCFs of the specific S-NSSAI and redistributes the local quotas of the specific S-NSSAI based on the status reported by the secondary PCFs.

q_20072.question: What shall the UE do upon receipt of a service-level-AA payload from the upper layers?
q_20072.ground_truth: The UE shall create a SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message and set the service-level-AA payload of the Service-level-AA container IE to the received payload.

q_20073.question: What is the threshold parameter T1h used for in reporting event 1i?
q_20073.ground_truth: T1h is the threshold for event 1i, it is used in Equation 1 to evaluate if a P-CCPCH has triggered reporting event 1i.

q_20074.question: What should the UE assume as the transport block size when the Transport Block Size index value is equal to 111111 in the HARQ process?
q_20074.ground_truth: The UE should assume that the transport block size is identical to the last valid transport block size signaled for this HARQ process.

q_20075.question: How many radio frequency channels does GSM 900 support, including the guard band?
q_20075.ground_truth: GSM 900 supports 194 radio frequency channels, including a guard band of 200 kHz at each end of the sub-bands.

q_20076.question: How is the header part of the Radio Block encoded in EGPRS and EGPRS2?
q_20076.ground_truth: The header part of the Radio Block is encoded independently from the data part of the Radio Block in EGPRS and EGPRS2. An 8-bit CRC is calculated over the header, followed by rate 1/3 convolutional coding and possibly puncturing for error correction. Additionally, a PAN field is included for transmission using FANR, which is independently coded from the header and data parts of the Radio Block.

q_20077.question: What is the purpose of the power measurements in the test regarding the "maximum output power"?
q_20077.ground_truth: The purpose of the power measurements in the test regarding the "maximum output power" is to ensure that the maximum RF carrier power of the BTS fulfills the requirements defined in 3GPP TS 45.005, clause 4.1.2.4 for ER-GSM 900 BTS.

q_20078.question: What is the purpose of UE pseudonymity in V2X services?
q_20078.ground_truth: The purpose of UE pseudonymity in V2X services is to conceal personal data from attackers, and to provide privacy for the V2X enabled UE.

q_20079.question: How are initial pitch lags determined?
q_20079.ground_truth: Initial pitch lags are determined by searching for the maximum weighted normalized correlation in the four sections in each of the three segments or half-frames, for both pitch delay ranges.

q_20080.question: What should the UE do with the random access report information after 48 hours of the last successful random access procedure or the failed or completed on-demand system information acquisition procedure?
q_20080.ground_truth: The UE may discard the random access report information.

q_20081.question: What information is provided by the UE in step 6 of the test procedure?
q_20081.ground_truth: The UE provides ECID capabilities supported in the ECID-ProvideCapabilities IE in step 6.

q_20082.question: What is the definition of Advice of Charge (Information) (AoCI) in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_20082.ground_truth: Advice of Charge (Information) (AoCI) is a charging supplementary service that allows the served Mobile Station (MS) to receive charging information on every successful request for an applicable telecommunications service.

q_20083.question: What action should the RNC2 take if the Common Measurement Type IE is set to ``UTRAN GPS Timing of Cell Frames for UE positioning'' and the Report Characteristics IE is set to ``On Demand'' or ``On Modification''?
q_20083.ground_truth: If the Common Measurement Type IE is set to ``UTRAN GPS Timing of Cell Frames for UE positioning'' and the Report Characteristics IE is set to ``On Demand'' or ``On Modification'', the RNC2 should include in the TUTRAN-GPS Measurement Value Information IE the TUTRAN-GPS Quality IE and the TUTRAN-GPS Drift Rate Quality IE, if available.

q_20084.question: What is contained in a DGANSS Information IE if the GANSS Signal ID IE is not present?
q_20084.ground_truth: It is associated with the default GANSS signal defined in TS 25.331, clause 10.3.3.45a.

q_20085.question: What is the duration of each segment of the ALDO window at 48 kHz?
q_20085.ground_truth: The first segment is 690 samples, the second segment is 690 samples, the third segment is 420 samples, and the fourth segment is 270 samples.

q_20086.question: What event triggers the use of the "Reactivation Requested" cause in 3GPP TS~23.203~?
q_20086.ground_truth: The GGSN uses "Reactivation Requested" while tearing down all the PDP Context(s) associated with the same PDN connection to indicate that it is requesting the UE to re-initiate the PDP Context Activation procedure for the corresponding APN.

q_20087.question: What is the peak throughput for the new MCSs defined for 32QAM?
q_20087.ground_truth: The peak throughput for the new MCSs defined for 32QAM is up to 99.2 kbps.

q_20088.question: Who has the authority to accept or refuse the request to initiate periodic location?
q_20088.ground_truth: Any entity (MSC/SGSN, V-GMLC, H-GMLC, R-GMLC, and LCS Client) is enabled to accept or refuse the request to initiate periodic location.

q_20089.question: Which TS (Technical Specification) clause specifies the measurement object addition/modification procedure?
q_20089.ground_truth: TS 38.331, clause 5.5.2.5 specifies the measurement object addition/modification procedure.

q_20090.question: What type of equipment does not require an additional communication port for basic functionality?
q_20090.ground_truth: Radio communications equipment can operate with ancillary equipment, but it is not dependent on it for basic functionality.

q_20091.question: What action should the CRNC take if the RESET REQUEST message is received and there is an ongoing procedure related to a CRNC Communication Context indicated in the message?
q_20091.ground_truth: The CRNC shall abort the ongoing procedure related to the indicated CRNC Communication Context.

q_20092.question: What information does the SMF include in the SM Policy Control Create message to indicate MP-QUIC functionality?
q_20092.ground_truth: The SMF includes an "MA PDU Request" indication and the ATSSS Capability of MA PDU Session, which indicates the MP-QUIC functionality, in the SM Policy Control Create message.

q_20093.question: What should the UE store the occurrence information together with for later use in relation to System Information Block type 15.3bis?
q_20093.ground_truth: The UE should store the occurrence information together with its identity and value tag for later use in relation to System Information Block type 15.3bis.

q_20094.question: What is the recommended solution for mapping RAN coverage service in Company-NB in a NetworkSliceSubnet instance and SliceProfile?
q_20094.ground_truth: It is recommended to map the RAN coverage service in Company-NB to a NetworkSliceSubnet instance and SliceProfile to ensure the definition of network slice remains aligned across 3GPP WGs.

q_20095.question: What is the role of the BSS in the rate adaptation process?
q_20095.ground_truth: The BSS uses information contained in the ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message on the A-interface to set the "E bits" and map the "D bits" for channel coding and setting the correct channel type.

q_20096.question: What is the role of 3GPP UEs with PSS and/or MBMS client in the 3GPP Technical Report scenario?
q_20096.ground_truth: The 3GPP UEs with PSS and/or MBMS client in the scenario are responsible for receiving and decoding the content received over 3GPP networks, which may be heterogeneous in terms of capabilities, such as display resolutions, decoding capabilities, audio rendering capabilities and more.

q_20097.question: What is the set of cells that contains at least the Serving E-DCH cell and from which the UE can receive and combine one Relative Grant called in the document?
q_20097.ground_truth: Serving E-DCH RLS or Serving RLS (FDD only)

q_20098.question: What is the definition of TCL in the context of Acoustic Echo Controllers (AEC)?
q_20098.ground_truth: TCL, or Terminal Coupling Loss, is the overall attenuation of the echo resulting from the acoustic coupling of the terminal combined with the effect of the echo canceller.

q_20099.question: What are the preconditions required on the device for the system to work?
q_20099.ground_truth: A 3GPP supported encoder should be installed, the UE's application should be installed with NBMP client functionalities, and a 3GPP FLUS Source should be installed on the device.

q_20100.question: What is the focus of the NG-RAN technical specification in Release 17?
q_20100.ground_truth: The specification outlines the standards for implementing layer 1 on the NG interface

q_20101.question: When should the UE include the Uplink data status IE and the Allowed PDU session status IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message?
q_20101.ground_truth: The UE should include the Uplink data status IE and the Allowed PDU session status IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message for cases other than o) and p) in subclause 5.6.1.1.

q_20102.question: What should be ensured when performing receiver tests with a duplexer fitted, as noted in NOTE 1?
q_20102.ground_truth: When performing receiver tests with a duplexer fitted, it is important to ensure that the output from the transmitters does not affect the test apparatus. This can be achieved using a combination of attenuators, isolators and filters.

q_20103.question: What is the purpose of the ECGI (E-UTRAN Cell Global Identity) in the CS domain?
q_20103.ground_truth: The ECGI is used to define the E-UTRAN CS domain identity in the CS domain. When the MME/SGSN and PGW/GGSN pertain to the same PLMN, the ECGI shall be communicated via ECGI to the PGW for both supporting and non-supporting UEs.

q_20104.question: What does GA-AltitudeAndDirection in the provided code represent?
q_20104.ground_truth: GA-AltitudeAndDirection represents the altitude and direction of a point with uncertainty, as it includes altitudeAndDirection which is an object holding the altitude and direction of the point, uncertaintyAltitude which is an integer representing the uncertainty of the altitude, and confidence which is an integer representing the confidence level of the altitude.

q_20105.question: What is the purpose of the RP-SMMA message?
q_20105.ground_truth: The RP-SMMA message is sent by the mobile station to relay a notification to the network that the mobile has memory available to receive one or more short messages.

q_20106.question: What should a mobile station do if the DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message does not specify any uplink or downlink PDCH?
q_20106.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_20107.question: What is the impact of providing a null value argument to the CatPutOneByteTLV function?
q_20107.ground_truth: If the value is null, the invocation is a No-Operation (NOP), and the contents of the proactive command buffer are not changed.

q_20108.question: What is the consequence of the TSG modifying the contents of the document?
q_20108.ground_truth: If the TSG modifies the contents of the document, it will be re-released with an identifying change of release date and an increase in version number.

q_20109.question: What must the ME do if the Home Network Public Key or the priority list are not provisioned in the USIM?
q_20109.ground_truth: The ME shall calculate the SUCI using the null-scheme if the Home Network Public Key or the priority list are not provisioned in the USIM.

q_20110.question: What should the RNC include in the UPLINK INFORMATION EXCHANGE REQUEST message if the Information Exchange Type IE is set to "request"?
q_20110.ground_truth: If the Information Exchange Type IE is set to "request", the RNC should include the Information Request Type IE in the message to indicate the nature of the information requested.

q_20111.question: What is the function of the CN in assigning the Allocation and Retention Priority for the MBMS bearer service?
q_20111.ground_truth: The CN assigns the Allocation and Retention Priority for the MBMS bearer service to allow prioritization between MBMS bearer services and between MBMS bearer services and non-MBMS bearer services in the UTRAN.

q_20112.question: When modifying information derived from SIP or default values, what can local ISUP procedures do?
q_20112.ground_truth: Local ISUP procedures may modify information derived from SIP or default values.

q_20113.question: What are the five measurements defined for GTP data packets?
q_20113.ground_truth: The five measurements are: Number of incoming GTP data packets on the Gn interface, Number of outgoing GTP data packets on the Gn interface, Number of discarded GTP data packets, Number of octets of incoming GTP data packets on the Gn interface, and Number of octets of outgoing GTP data packets on the Gn interface

q_20114.question: What information does the "3GPP-Link-Char" header take as arguments?
q_20114.ground_truth: The "3GPP-Link-Char" header takes one or more arguments, including GBW (link's guaranteed bit-rate), MBW (link's maximum bit-rate), and MTD (link's maximum transfer delay).

q_20115.question: What media formats can be played by the MRFC when using the General Play Multimedia function?
q_20115.ground_truth: The MRFC can play any combination of audio, video, and messaging media streams, as long as they comply with the 3GPP multimedia file formats.

q_20116.question: How can a UE access the Network Assistance function?
q_20116.ground_truth: Access to the Network Assistance function in the UE can be realized flexibly, and may be subject to certification against a compliance regime that includes testing of its Network Assistance client functionality before being authorized to access this feature in a real service.

q_20117.question: What should the UE do when the TFT operation results in no IP packet ever fitting this packet filter?
q_20117.ground_truth: If a packet filter consists of conflicting packet filter components which would render the packet filter ineffective, i.e. no IP packet will ever fit this packet filter, the network should send a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #44 "semantic errors in packet filter(s)".

q_20118.question: What is the purpose of removing the IQ offset power in UE Relative CDP accuracy measurement?
q_20118.ground_truth: The purpose of removing the IQ offset power in UE Relative CDP accuracy measurement is to ensure the accuracy of the measurement, as this power can impact the accuracy of the measured CDP ratio.

q_20119.question: What enhancements does MP-QUIC connection per PDU Session offer compared to solutions 6 and 14?
q_20119.ground_truth: MP-QUIC connection per PDU Session uses Datagram-Flow-Id to identify IP flows in a single MP-QUIC connection, eliminating the need for Global Datagram-Flow-Id across multiple MP-QUIC connections. It can also transport traffic via the DL-only QoS flow, removing the requirement for specific uplink QoS rules for messages such as PING, ACK frames for the DL-only QoS flow.

q_20120.question: What was the main reason for updating the 3GPP test specifications?
q_20120.ground_truth: Recently, User Equipment (UE) have come to market featuring other means of radiating sound to the user, such as through vibrating displays, which necessitated an update of 3GPP test specifications.

q_20121.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Report on Dual Connectivity (DC) of LTE and NR bands?
q_20121.ground_truth: The purpose is to gather relevant background information and studies to address DC of 5 LTE bands and 1 NR band for Rel-17 band combinations.

q_20122.question: What are the typical heights for mounting base stations (BSs) in office environments and shopping malls?
q_20122.ground_truth: In both office environments and shopping malls, BSs are typically mounted at a height of 2-3 meters on ceilings or walls.

q_20123.question: What is the reference interference level defined for in the context of 3GPP TS 45.005 subclause 6.2?
q_20123.ground_truth: The reference interference level is a measure of the capability of the receiver to receive a wanted modulated signal without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted modulated signal at the same carrier frequency (co-channel interference) or at any adjacent carrier frequencies (adjacent channel interference).

q_20124.question: When should the DRNS activate the Single Stream MIMO for the HS-DSCH Radio Link?
q_20124.ground_truth: The DRNS shall activate the Single Stream MIMO for the HS-DSCH Radio Link when the "Single Stream MIMO Activation Indicator IE" is included in the "HS-DSCH FDD Information IE".

q_20125.question: What are the benefits of on-demand DL-PRS functionality from a physical layer perspective?
q_20125.ground_truth: The benefits of on-demand DL-PRS functionality from a physical layer perspective include efficiency, reduced latency, and improved accuracy. It avoids unnecessary transmission and waste of energy, provides more flexibility in meeting response time requirements, and allows for dynamic adjustment of DL-PRS parameters to meet accuracy requirements.

q_20126.question: What are the basic physical subchannel block sizes that can be produced by the coding/multiplexing unit for FLO?
q_20126.ground_truth: The basic physical subchannel block sizes for FLO are 464 bits for full-rate GMSK, 232 bits for half-rate GMSK, 1392 bits for full-rate 8PSK, and 696 bits for half-rate 8PSK.

q_20127.question: Which sublayer is responsible for mapping a QoS flow and a data radio bearer in the new user plane protocol layer?
q_20127.ground_truth: The main services and functions of a new AS sublayer include mapping between a QoS flow and a data radio bearer.

q_20128.question: In what scenario does the UE select a cell of the EHPLMN and attempt a Registration on the selected cell?
q_20128.ground_truth: When the UE is in Automatic network selection mode, and the EHPLMN, UPLMN, and OPLMN/access technology combinations are available and the UE is fitted with a USIM with Access Technology data files for each PLMN.

q_20129.question: What is the component name of the expected behavior model of the S-CSCF?
q_20129.ground_truth: The components include the Combined I/OLSM, the ILCM, the OLCM, and the Registrar and Notifier.

q_20130.question: Which devices showed significant SIG degradations in double talking conditions for handset mode?
q_20130.ground_truth: Devices I and K showed significant SIG degradations in double talking conditions for handset mode.

q_20131.question: Which component is responsible for taking appropriate decisions to save energy in the 5G core network based on the analytics provided by the MDAF in Potential Solution #1?
q_20131.ground_truth: A Management Function, in charge of energy saving.

q_20132.question: What is the rule for including TFCs in the TFCS for a CCTrCH in TDD?
q_20132.ground_truth: The TFCS of a CCTrCH should include those combinations that include a TF with one transport block for a transport channel used in that CCTrCH, and the "empty" TFC should be included in the TFCS of every CCTrCH.

q_20133.question: What argument does the splitLeg operation accept?

q_20134.question: What is the maximum allowed timing difference between different BTSs (allowed tolerance) for extended DRX (eDRX) in a routing area (RA)?
q_20134.ground_truth: The maximum allowed timing difference between different BTSs (allowed tolerance) for extended DRX (eDRX) in a routing area (RA) is less than 4 seconds, measured at the BTS antenna.

q_20135.question: Who were the members of the listening panel?
q_20135.ground_truth: The listening panel consisted of 12 subjects, most of them experienced in audio but not only professionally involved, all remaining listeners were respectful regarding the listening instructions.

q_20136.question: How does the NEF handle overlapping PFD scenarios?
q_20136.ground_truth: The NEF checks if the new PFD information provided by the NWDAF or provisioned by the ASP has been stored in the UDR. If not, it stores the new PFD information into the UDR.

q_20137.question: What is the purpose of Service Primitives in the RR sublayer?
q_20137.ground_truth: Information flow between layers is performed by the use of Service Primitives. Service Access Points (SAP) and their corresponding Service Primitives for the RR sublayer are defined in 3GPP~TS~24.007.

q_20138.question: What is the purpose of the Security Mode Complete message in the NAS signalling procedure?
q_20138.ground_truth: The Security Mode Complete message is used to confirm that the MS and the GANC have successfully performed the mutual authentication and that the integrity key is now available in both entities, once the GA-RRC connection is established.

q_20139.question: What is the state of the UE after it is registered on PLMN1 (NR Cell 1) using the specified procedure?
q_20139.ground_truth: The UE is in state 3N-A on NR Cell 1 (serving cell) after registration.

q_20140.question: What identifies the target for the relocation of SRNS in the case of UMTS-UMTS relocation?
q_20140.ground_truth: The Target ID may be the target RNC-ID.

q_20141.question: What is the action taken when the O-MGCF receives a Q.850 Cause Value of 28 in the SIP response?
q_20141.ground_truth: When the O-MGCF receives a Q.850 Cause Value of 28 in the SIP response, it shall send a REL message with a Cause Value of 28 towards the BICC/ISUP network.

q_20142.question: What action does the IP-SM-GW take if a received Short Message is associated with a Chat Session and the originator is the SM user invited to the Chat Session?
q_20142.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW shall deliver the received Short Message to the Chat Session.

q_20143.question: What should be considered during normative phase regarding MBS Session context and N3 tunnel at RAN node?
q_20143.ground_truth: If MBS Session context and N3 tunnel need to be kept at the RAN node should be evaluated during normative phase.

q_20144.question: How would the IWF handle cancelling MCPTT emergency private call states, and what would the MCPTT emergency private priority state and Resource-Priority header be for a regular MCPTT private call?
q_20144.ground_truth: To cancel MCPTT emergency private call states, the IWF performing the participating role would generate a SIP re-INVITE request with specific parameters, and set the MCPTT emergency private priority state to "MEPP 3: cancel-pending". For a regular MCPTT private call, the Resource-Priority header would be populated with the values for a normal MCPTT private call as specified in clause~6.4.1.11.

q_20145.question: What is the impact of the Common E-RNTI selection procedure on the CCCH transmission schedule?
q_20145.ground_truth: The Available Scheduling Window of each CCCH transmission is equal to the length of K E-RUCCH TTIs, which means that the CCCH only can be scheduled within the consecutive K frames or sub-frames upon receiving the E-RUCCH by the Node B scheduler.

q_20146.question: What procedures are applied with additions for PCF based Service Authorization and Provisioning to 5G ProSe UE?
q_20146.ground_truth: The Registration procedures as defined in clause~4.2.2.2 of TS~23.502, UE Policy Association Establishment procedure as defined in clause~4.16.11 of TS~23.502 and UE Policy Association Modification procedure as defined in clause~4.16.12 of TS~23.502 apply with additions for PCF based Service Authorization and Provisioning to 5G ProSe UE.

q_20147.question: What is the range of values that the acknowledge state variable V(A) can take on in RLC acknowledged mode for an MBMS bearer?
q_20147.ground_truth: V(A) can take on the values 0 through SNS - 1.

q_20148.question: What are viewport margins used for in viewport-dependent delivery?
q_20148.ground_truth: Viewport margins in viewport-dependent delivery are used to minimize motion-to-high-quality delay and reduce the need for frequent viewport updates in case of head motion.

q_20149.question: What is the significance of the "qualifiers" used in the IS template in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_20149.ground_truth: The qualifiers (M, O, CM, CO, and C) define the characteristics of class attributes and operation/notification parameters in the IS template.

q_20150.question: What determines if the criterion on the basic service is satisfied during an incoming call request event procedure?
q_20150.ground_truth: The criterion on the basic service is satisfied if the basic service used for the call corresponds to any basic service code defined in the criterion or if no basic service criterion is specified.

q_20151.question: What are the possible consequences of not having the radio channel requirement met in the network?
q_20151.ground_truth: The mobile station may cease receiving data, and there may be a release of the connection during a data phase.

q_20152.question: Which interface is fully standardized for the purpose of Fault Management of 3GPP systems, as seen from the Network Manager (NM)?
q_20152.ground_truth: The Itf-N is fully standardized for the purpose of Fault Management of 3GPP systems, as seen from the Network Manager (NM).

q_20153.question: What is the role of the IK (Integrity Key) in the data integrity process?
q_20153.ground_truth: The IK is a 128-bit key that is used as an input parameter in the function f9 to derive a MAC-I for data integrity authentication.

q_20154.question: What is the purpose of the Indoor Anechoic Chamber testing procedure in relation to output power dynamics?
q_20154.ground_truth: The Indoor Anechoic Chamber testing procedure is used to assess compliance for the OTA total power dynamic range by measuring the EIRP of the BS transmitting at Prated,c,EIRP on all PRBs and then a second time with the BS transmitting on a single PRB.

q_20155.question: What message does the eNB send to the WT to initiate the addition of resources for LWA?
q_20155.ground_truth: The eNB sends the WT ADDITION REQUEST message to the WT to initiate the procedures for adding resources for LWA.

q_20156.question: What should the DRNS do if the Additional E-DCH Cell Information RL Add Req IE is present in the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message and the choice of Setup Or Addition Of E-DCH On Secondary UL Frequency is ``Setup'' and the C-ID IE is included in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information ToSetup IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE?
q_20156.ground_truth: The DRNS shall setup the Additional E-DCH on the secondary uplink frequency and setup the requested Additional E-DCH resources on the Radio Links and in the cells indicated by the E-DCH Additional RL ID IE and the C-ID IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information ToSetup IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE.

q_20157.question: What is a physical resource block defined as in sidelink transmissions?
q_20157.ground_truth: A physical resource block in the sidelink consists of resource elements, corresponding to one slot in the time domain and 180 kHz in the frequency domain.

q_20158.question: What is RAN-visible QoE information and how is it derived?
q_20158.ground_truth: RAN-visible QoE information is simplified QoE information derived from individual SA4-defined QoE metrics, which the RAN may use for various types of optimizations. It can be derived from individual metrics such as buffer level or combinations of these values. SA4 should be consulted on how the values are derived.

q_20159.question: When is the current BA list modified at the transition from idle mode to a TCH or SDCCH in A/Gb mode?
q_20159.ground_truth: The BA list is modified when a SI~5ter message is subsequently received and not ignored.

q_20160.question: What is the expected sequence 1.1A in the simulator?
q_20160.ground_truth: The expected sequence 1.1A is a successful SEND SS command for call forward unconditional, all bearers.

q_20161.question: How are the test data sets selected for Rijndael and the other 3GPP security functions?
q_20161.ground_truth: The test data sets are chosen to ensure that every S-Box entry is used, and each input bit of the functions is given a '0' and '1' state. The Rijndael test data sets are used to choose the initial values for the other functions in a way that each input bit to those functions is also in a '0' and '1' state.

q_20162.question: What action should the Node B take upon receiving an INFORMATION EXCHANGE TERMINATION REQUEST message?
q_20162.ground_truth: The Node B shall terminate the provision of information corresponding to the Information Exchange ID.

q_20163.question: What is the SSRC parameter used for in the RTP-Info header field?
q_20163.ground_truth: The SSRC parameter gives the synchronization source (SSRC) of the RTP flow to which the RTP timestamp and sequence number apply, it is used when the SSRC changes after a fast content switching operation.

q_20164.question: What is the significance of ECN in network information provisioning to local applications?
q_20164.ground_truth: ECN is significant as it provides information about network status to the UE and AS, and is not specific to 3GPP access. It is used to indicate potential congestion and help keep low latency traffic uncongested.

q_20165.question: What message is returned by the BSS if it receives a VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message that calls up a blocked terrestrial circuit?
q_20165.ground_truth: A VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message is sent (Cause value: "requested terrestrial resource unavailable") and a BLOCK message is sent for the concerned terrestrial circuit.

q_20166.question: What is required for taking a PCC rule into service or out of service at a specific time of day without any PCC interaction?
q_20166.ground_truth: This can be done without requiring any PCC interaction as long as the conditions for taking the PCC rule into service or out of service are fulfilled.

q_20167.question: What is the warning message format used in common for CMAS, KPAS, and EU-Alert?
q_20167.ground_truth: The warning message format used in common for CMAS, KPAS, and EU-Alert is defined in TS 23.041 and differs slightly depending on the access technology, but the main content remains the same.

q_20168.question: What is the significance of the channel data length in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: RECEIVE DATA" commands?
q_20168.ground_truth: The channel data length specifies the maximum number of bytes that the channel can transmit.

q_20169.question: What is the purpose of the CTSARCH in the GSM-CTS system?
q_20169.ground_truth: The CTSARCH is transmitted in the uplink by the CTS-MS to request dedicated radio resources from the CTS-FP in the GSM-CTS system.

q_20170.question: What is the definition of Correlation ID in the context of LIPA PDN connection?
q_20170.ground_truth: Correlation ID is a parameter that enables direct user plane path between the HNB and L-GW for a LIPA PDN connection.

q_20171.question: What are the valid values for @frameRate as per clause 5.1.3?

q_20172.question: What are the performance requirements for the initial convergence time for the Noise Suppression feature?
q_20172.ground_truth: The initial convergence time for the Noise Suppression feature must be a maximum of 2 seconds. The definition of this time interval is based on subjective listening experiments, where the first 2 seconds of each sample processed through the AMR speech codec with and without noise suppression active, is deleted before presentation to listeners.

q_20173.question: What type of measurement provides the number of 403-Forbidden response messages generated for UEs belonging to other IMS network domains with roaming agreements, split into subcounters per network domain, and has a sum subcounter if only a subset of per network measurements is supported?
q_20173.ground_truth: Number of SIP 403 (Forbidden) messages for the roamers

q_20174.question: What is the attribute name for a list of content types relevant for streaming over RTP or HTTP?

q_20175.question: How does the PLMN serving the UAV initiate the release of network resources used for C2 communication in the UTM initiated PDU Session Release procedure?
q_20175.ground_truth: The PLMN serving the UAV releases the network resources used for C2 communication based on an indication from the UTM in the UTM initiated PDU Session Release procedure. The UTM may provide an explicit reason for the revocation and the PLMN may also perform other safety checks before proceeding with the release of connectivity resources that have been revoked.

q_20176.question: What is the Signalling radio bearer 2 used for in the context of RNSAP protocol?
q_20176.ground_truth: The signalling radio bearer 2 is used by the UE to access a GERAN cell in order to perform RRC procedures.

q_20177.question: What is the alpha or transparency value range in this terminal specification?
q_20177.ground_truth: The alpha or transparency value ranges from 0, indicating a fully transparent colour, to 255, indicating a fully opaque colour.

q_20178.question: What is the required minimum bit rate for 3G-324M terminals?
q_20178.ground_truth: 3G-324M terminals shall support at least 32 kbit/s minimum bit rate at the mux to wireless network interface.

q_20179.question: Which element is responsible for incrementing the measurement of the number of successful HNB to UMTS macro cell hard handovers, and what is its measurement name?
q_20179.ground_truth: The HNB is responsible for incrementing the measurement after receiving the Iu Release Command from the core network with cause "Successful Relocation" or "Normal Release" during handover execution and when the handover is a hard handover to a UMTS macro cell. The measurement name has the form HHO.SuccHnbUmtsInterFreq or HHO.SuccHnbUmtsIntraFreq.

q_20180.question: What is the requirement for the "SIMViewException" constructor in the API?
q_20180.ground_truth: The requirement is that the method with the header public SIMViewException(short reason) throws SIMViewException complies with its definition in the API.

q_20181.question: How does the mobile station send application-specific data on the voice group call channel?
q_20181.ground_truth: The mobile station sends UPLINK ACCESS messages on the voice group call channel with the establishment cause "UL request for sending application-specific data" and establishes the main signalling link by sending a SABM command containing a DATA INDICATION message in the information field.

q_20182.question: In the context of 6a.9.1.2, what request does UE-2 send to the network to transfer media flow from UE-1 to UE-2?
q_20182.ground_truth: UE-2 sends an IUT media transfer request to transfer the media flow from UE-1 to UE-2.

q_20183.question: What are the frequency bands and channel arrangement for the GSM-CTS?
q_20183.ground_truth: The frequency bands and channel arrangement for the GSM-CTS are as specified in GSM 05.05 clause 2.

q_20184.question: What action should the BBERF take if it receives a request to terminate an AF session for an IMS Emergency service?
q_20184.ground_truth: The BBERF should remove QoS Rules assigned to the terminated IMS Emergency Service from the BBERF by using clause~4a.5.2.1 to provision QoS Rules.

q_20185.question: What functionality is responsible for handling service continuity when a UE leaves or enters MBMS bearer coverage?
q_20185.ground_truth: The Service Layer in UE and network handles service continuity when a UE leaves or enters MBMS bearer coverage.

q_20186.question: How does Network Interworking differ from Control Delegation in Network Composition?
q_20186.ground_truth: In Network Interworking, composing CCNs maintain control of their own resources, while in Control Delegation, at least one resource's control is delegated from one CCN to the other.

q_20187.question: How much time does the MS have to transmit the CLASSMARK CHANGE message during a contention resolution procedure if the last timeslot of the block containing a Layer 2 UA frame occurs at time T?
q_20187.ground_truth: The MS should transmit the CLASSMARK CHANGE message, if applicable, before T+40 ms.

q_20188.question: What is the smooth transition region in the filtering process of the time-domain excitation contribution in the frequency domain?
q_20188.ground_truth: The smooth transition region is situated above the cut-off frequency and below the zeroed bins, allowing for a smooth spectral transition between the unchanged spectrum below and the zeroed bins in higher frequencies.

q_20189.question: What is required for CAMEL Phase 3 or later to support mobility management events?
q_20189.ground_truth: The gsmSCF can setup the UE registration status in the PN to 'registered', and then send the UE status to the PNM AS for a new registration or de-registration of a UE or PNE.

q_20190.question: What is the format of the RRCConnectionSetupComplete message that supports non-critical extensions for releases up to and including 380?

q_20191.question: How should the Source to Target Transparent Container IE be encoded when PS handover to E-UTRAN is required?
q_20191.ground_truth: The Source to Target Transparent Container IE should be encoded as the Source RNC to Target RNC Transparent Container IE as specified in 3GPP TS 25.413.

q_20192.question: Where do the radio interface protocols get terminated for DCH in the UTRAN?
q_20192.ground_truth: The radio interface protocols for DCH are terminated in the Serving RNC, but if no macrodiversity applies, the physical layer is terminated in Node B.

q_20193.question: What is the maximum time allowed for a UE to switch back to its serving cell frequency during MBMS reception?
q_20193.ground_truth: The UE is required to start switching back to its serving cell frequency 1 timeslot prior to the start of the MBMS reception.

q_20194.question: What is the difference between integrity availability and target integrity risk?
q_20194.ground_truth: Integrity availability is the percentage of time that the positioning error is below the required alert limit, while target integrity risk is the probability that the positioning error exceeds the alert limit without warning the user within the required time-to-alert.

q_20195.question: What must the TWAN do to allow the PGW to use the P-CSCF restoration extension?
q_20195.ground_truth: The TWAN must advertise the support of the WLCP PDN connection modification request procedure over S2a at establishment (or handover) of the IMS PDN connection.

q_20196.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives a Recommended bit rate MAC CE from the gNB for a specific logical channel and direction?
q_20196.ground_truth: Upon reception of a Recommended bit rate MAC CE, the MAC entity should indicate the recommended bit rate for the indicated logical channel and direction to upper layers.

q_20197.question: In order to achieve a modulo 8 length of the data before the RC/CC/DS field in the Response Header, what fields should be included in the calculation of RC/CC/DS if used for a Response Packet in a single SMS-PP?
q_20197.ground_truth: The RPL, the RHL and three octets set to '02' '71' '00' shall be included in the calculation of RC/CC/DS if used.

q_20198.question: What signal is sent to functional unit 4 to indicate successful handover of a call in the UMTS network?
q_20198.ground_truth: Iu-RELOCATION-COMPLETE or A-HANDOVER-COMPLETE is sent to functional unit 4 to indicate successful handover of a call in the UMTS network.

q_20199.question: In subclause 4.2.7.2.1.3, what should be used if repetition is to be performed on convolutionally encoded TrCHs?
q_20199.ground_truth: The parameters listed in subclauses 4.2.7.1.2.1 and 4.2.7.1.2.2 should be used for determining eini, eplus, and eminus, and a is set to 2.

q_20200.question: What is the purpose of the 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery method and 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery method?
q_20200.ground_truth: The 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery method is required in all MBS deployments, while the 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery method is required for mobility to/from non-homogeneous support of MBS in NG-RAN.

q_20201.question: What is the total number of cycles required for the implementation of MILENAGE, including the f1-f5 functions?

q_20202.question: What is the GAA Service Identifier and where it is stored?
q_20202.ground_truth: The GAA Service Identifier (GSID) is an integer, which uniquely identifies a GAA Service. It is stored in the HSS, BSF and NAF.

q_20203.question: Which network options are affected by the issue of informing the network about the UE's support for UP IP over eUTRA?

q_20204.question: What information element may optionally be included in an I1 message and identifies alternative addresses the UE should attempt to use?

q_20205.question: What is the role of the jitter in the packet arrival model?
q_20205.ground_truth: The jitter is a random variable added to the periodic packet arrival to model varying frame encoding delay and network transfer time in a real system.

q_20206.question: What is the minimum requirement for the peak code domain error for the Repeater output signal?
q_20206.ground_truth: The peak code domain error for the Repeater output signal shall not exceed -30 dB at spreading factor 16.

q_20207.question: What must the IWU do when it receives an ISUP message from an external SIP-I network prior to preconditions being met?
q_20207.ground_truth: The IWU shall queue the ISUP message and propagate it to the preceding 3GPP node once preconditions are met.

q_20208.question: What are the two classes of Elementary Procedures (EPs) in the M3AP protocol?
q_20208.ground_truth: Class 1 EPs are those with a response (success and/or failure), and Class 2 EPs are those without a response.

q_20209.question: How are the tests referenced in the 3GPP Technical Specification for testing the (U)SIM API for Java CardTM?
q_20209.ground_truth: Each test is referenced using the name of the API, package, class, and method, along with any input parameters.

q_20210.question: What is the effect of setting the administrative state of a Channel to locked?
q_20210.ground_truth: It discontinues all transmission and reception of information on Air interface and all telecommunication (traffic and signalling) information transmission on A-bis interface.

q_20211.question: What is the role of Sensitivity and DARP test scenario-2 in link level performance characterization for uplink scheme?
q_20211.ground_truth: Sensitivity is evaluated for noise distortions and DARP test scenario-2 for interference limited scenarios. The performance is characterized for full rate and half rate AMR channels using selected codec rates.

q_20212.question: What limits are specified for the radio frequency tolerance for the CTS-FP in clause 4.3.4?
q_20212.ground_truth: The radio frequency tolerance for the CTS-FP is defined in GSM~05.10.

q_20213.question: What parameters are expected to be signaled on what level in DASH?
q_20213.ground_truth: In DASH, the (Display) Picture Resolution, frame rates, video codec profile level, and color primaries and transfer function are expected to be signaled on the Adaptation Set level, while the encoded picture resolution, frame rates, and video codec level are expected to be signaled on the Representation level.

q_20214.question: What is the purpose of requiring a mechanism to enable the non-transmission of MBMS multicast mode in a cell that does not contain any MBMS UEs joined to the multicast group?
q_20214.ground_truth: The purpose is to optimize the use of resources in the cell and to avoid unnecessary transmissions.

q_20215.question: What are the functions provided by the LLC sublayer?
q_20215.ground_truth: The LLC sublayer provides the following functions: the provision of one or more logical link connections, sequence control, detection and recovery from transmission, format, and operational errors, notification of unrecoverable errors, flow control, ciphering, and integrity protection.

q_20216.question: Which parameter is mandatory in the "DCH-Information-RL-AdditionRspTDD" sequence?

q_20217.question: What procedure is used to acknowledge or retransmit RLC/MAC data blocks in downlink data transfer?
q_20217.ground_truth: Acknowledged RLC/MAC mode operation is used for selective ARQ operation, while unacknowledged RLC/MAC mode operation and non-persistent RLC/MAC mode operation are used for other retransmission procedures.

q_20218.question: What are the source and destination devices for the "SET UP CALL 1.5.1A" command?
q_20218.ground_truth: The source device is ME, and the destination device is UICC.

q_20219.question: What is the Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband (AMR-WB) speech codec and what is it used for?
q_20219.ground_truth: The Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband (AMR-WB) speech codec is a technology used for speech processing in multimedia and packet-based applications. It is a standard for encoding and decoding speech signals in a wideband frequency range, resulting in improved audio quality.

q_20220.question: What is the purpose of the PH-primitives used in the interface between the physical layer and the data link layer?
q_20220.ground_truth: The PH-primitives are used for the transfer of layer 2 frames and to indicate the establishment of channels to layer 2.

q_20221.question: How is the identity information of source UE and target UE used for forwarding or routing messages in the Adaptation Layer?
q_20221.ground_truth: The details of the identity information of source UE and target UE used to forward or route messages in the Adaptation Layer will be defined in cooperation with RAN WGs during normative phase.

q_20222.question: What is the definition of quasi co-location (QCL) in the context of NR?
q_20222.ground_truth: In NR, QCL defines that the channel properties of one antenna port can be inferred from the channel of another antenna port. It supports beam management, frequency/timing offset estimation, and RRM management functionality.

q_20223.question: What is one of the risks associated with false Base Stations (BSs) broadcasting false Warning Notifications?
q_20223.ground_truth: One risk is to induce panic in the population by sending false warning messages.

q_20224.question: What is the response time including test tolerance for Test 1 defined in 9.4.3.2.5?
q_20224.ground_truth: The response time including test tolerance for Test 1 defined in 9.4.3.2.5 is 16.3 seconds.

q_20225.question: Which bands are being considered for deployment of Advanced E-UTRA and Advanced E-UTRAN?
q_20225.ground_truth: The identified bands for deployment of Advanced E-UTRA and Advanced E-UTRAN include the 450-470 MHz band, 698-862 MHz band, 790-862 MHz band, 2.3-2.4 GHz band, 3.4-4.2 GHz band, and 4.4-4.99 GHz band.

q_20226.question: What is the recommended action to take when the term "shall" is used in a normative context in a referenced non-3GPP document?
q_20226.ground_truth: The recommended action is to follow the normative requirement stated in the referenced non-3GPP document.

q_20227.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects related to Telecommunication management in releasing the document "Key Performance Indicators (KPI) for Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN); Requirements"?
q_20227.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to specify requirements related to Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for E-UTRAN, including business level requirements, specification level requirements, and use case descriptions.

q_20228.question: What is the transmission time interval for transport channels in a BCH CCTrCH?
q_20228.ground_truth: The transmission time interval for transport channels in a BCH CCTrCH is always 10 ms.

q_20229.question: How can the PCRF provide time conditioned policy information in an RAR or CCA command?
q_20229.ground_truth: The PCRF can provide up to four Conditional-Policy-Information AVPs in an RAR or CCA command to change the authorized QoS per APN and/or the authorized default EPS bearer QoS based on time conditions. Each instance of the Conditional-Policy-Information AVP shall include an Execution-Time AVP, and at the time indicated, the PCEF shall perform the requested change without interaction with the PCRF.

q_20230.question: What should the Max-Forwards and Hop Counter values be for a given message as they successively visit a SIP entity?
q_20230.ground_truth: The Max-Forwards and Hop Counter values for a given message should be monotone decreasing with each successive visit to a SIP entity.

q_20231.question: What is the type of attach procedure that a GPRS-attached MS uses when performing a GPRS attach while already IMSI attached in A/Gb mode?
q_20231.ground_truth: The Attach Type in this case is "GPRS Attach while already IMSI attached".

q_20232.question: When should the leaving condition for event A3 be considered satisfied?
q_20232.ground_truth: The leaving condition for event A3 is considered satisfied when the condition A3-2 (Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off) is fulfilled. Note that Mn, Ofn, Ocn, Mp, Ofp, Ocp, Hys, and Off are expressed in dB, and Mn, Mp are expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR.

q_20233.question: What should be the average time interval between successive RAPs in a video Bitstream?
q_20233.ground_truth: It is recommended that RAPs occur in the video Bitstream on average at least every 2 seconds.

q_20234.question: What should the old SGSN include in the SGSN Context Response message if there is a valid radio priority value available for the MS?
q_20234.ground_truth: The old SGSN shall include Radio Priority SMS or Radio Priority LCS in the SGSN Context Response message if there is a valid radio priority value available for the MS.

q_20235.question: What is the purpose of an "Elementary Procedure" in the RNSAP User Adaptation (RNA)?
q_20235.ground_truth: An Elementary Procedure (EP) is a unit of interaction between HNBs, defining a unit of interaction between two Home Node Bs (HNBs) in the RNSAP User Adaptation (RNA). They are used to build up complete sequences in a flexible manner and can be invoked independently of each other as standalone procedures.

q_20236.question: What happens if the resource representation contains only "attrC" with some value?
q_20236.ground_truth: The new representation after the update contains only "attrC". The existing attributes "attrA" and "attrB" are deleted.

q_20237.question: What is the measurement name for failed user location query procedures due to a specific failure cause at I-CSCF?
q_20237.ground_truth: The measurement name has the form LIQ.FailLIA.Cause, where Cause identifies the failure cause.

q_20238.question: What is the effect of dithering in the comfort noise generation?
q_20238.ground_truth: Dithering in the comfort noise generation introduces random fluctuations in the ISF vector and energy parameters to avoid artificial patterns and ensure a natural sounding noise.

q_20239.question: What should the UE do if only "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" is present in the IE "E-UTRA frequency and priority extension"?
q_20239.ground_truth: Calculate the value of "QqualminEUTRA" - "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" and store it in "EUTRA-RSRQ-OnAllSymbolsOffset", and store the value of "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" in "QqualminEUTRA".

q_20240.question: What is the purpose of the cell-ranking criterion Rs for a serving cell?
q_20240.ground_truth: The purpose of the cell-ranking criterion Rs for a serving cell is to determine the rank of the serving cell compared to other cells. The rank is used to determine which cell the UE should select for camping.

q_20241.question: Which African country did Morocco gain independence from in 1956?

q_20242.question: Which entity generates ACKs or NACKs in the HARQ protocol?
q_20242.ground_truth: The HARQ entity in the MAC-hs is responsible for generating ACKs or NACKs in the HARQ protocol.

q_20243.question: What are the two groups of service attributes used to describe circuit telecommunication services in this TS?
q_20243.ground_truth: The two groups of service attributes are low layer attributes and high layer attributes.

q_20244.question: What is the significance of the TERMINAL RESPONSE in the command response?
q_20244.ground_truth: The TERMINAL RESPONSE indicates that the command was performed successfully and also contains the channel status.

q_20245.question: What is the purpose of defining two patterns for discontinuous uplink DPCCH operation?
q_20245.ground_truth: To adapt to the data transmission activity and achieve higher DTX gain based on standardized rules.

q_20246.question: What is the purpose of the discontinuous transmission (DTX) in the GSM half rate speech codec?
q_20246.ground_truth: The discontinuous transmission (DTX) for half rate speech traffic channels specifies the method of reducing the amount of data that needs to be transmitted when there is no voice activity.

q_20247.question: What is the function of the am-RLC-ErrorIndicationRb5orAbove field in the CellUpdate message?
q_20247.ground_truth: The am-RLC-ErrorIndicationRb5orAbove field in the CellUpdate message indicates whether the UE has received an AM RLC Error Indication RB5 or above in the last AM RLC cycle. The value of this field is a boolean value, with true meaning that the UE has received such an indication and false meaning that the UE has not received such an indication.

q_20248.question: What is the value used for the <dest-address> subfield in the source-filter attribute of the SDP file?
q_20248.ground_truth: The value used for the <dest-address> subfield in the source-filter attribute of the SDP file is the * value.

q_20249.question: Which reference point supports the communication between the UE and the IM CN subsystem?
q_20249.ground_truth: The Gm reference point supports the communication between the UE and the IM CN subsystem.

q_20250.question: What is the additional optional packetization time for PCM encoded speech in a BICC based Core Network over the Nb interface?

q_20251.question: What are the benefits of user data convergence in 3GPP networks?
q_20251.ground_truth: User data convergence in 3GPP networks can significantly enhance the ability to offer complex and combined services, reduce data redundancy, unify the user data access interface and its protocol, and promote new service application development.

q_20252.question: What are the possible statuses that the LCLS Status IE can indicate?
q_20252.ground_truth: The LCLS Status IE can indicate that LCLS is to be released, LCLS is to be released due to handover, LCLS is to be re-connected after LCLS break, or Indicate DL data after handover - Handover Detected.

q_20253.question: What happens to stored operator-defined access category definitions when the UE receives a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with no operator-defined access category definitions?
q_20253.ground_truth: The UE shall not delete the operator-defined access category definitions stored for the RPLMN.

q_20254.question: What is the ACLR requirement for a BS operating in multiple bands, where multiple bands are mapped on the same antenna connector, in the 6.6.2.2.1.2 TDD option?
q_20254.ground_truth: The ACLR requirement for the first adjacent channel applies inside any inter RF bandwidth gap with a gap size larger than 4.8MHz, and the ACLR requirement for the second adjacent channel applies inside any inter RF bandwidth gap with a gap size larger than 6.4MHz.

q_20255.question: What is the function of "rrc-TransactionIdentifier" in the "measurementControl-r3-IEs" data structure?
q_20255.ground_truth: "rrc-TransactionIdentifier" is a field in the "measurementControl-r3-IEs" data structure that is used to identify the RRC transaction that is related to the current measurement.

q_20256.question: What is the function of the Proxy-CSCF (P-CSCF) in the IMS architecture?
q_20256.ground_truth: The Proxy-CSCF (P-CSCF) is responsible for handling SIP signaling towards the IM SS and providing the point of entry and exit of IMS for the UE.

q_20257.question: Which SCCP messages are supported on the E1 Interface?
q_20257.ground_truth: All ITU-T Recommendation Q.712 subclauses 1.1 to 1.14 SCCP messages are supported on the E1 Interface, but SOG and SOR messages are not used.

q_20258.question: When should a mobile station indicate its radio access capability for the serving BCCH frequency band during an EGPRS TBF establishment?
q_20258.ground_truth: It should indicate its supported Access Technology Types within the ones that are requested by the network or the access technology of the serving BCCH frequency band.

q_20259.question: What is the purpose of the RAB-TrCH-Mapping and RAB-TrCH-MappingItem sequences in the 3GPP TS 25.427 standard?
q_20259.ground_truth: The RAB-TrCH-Mapping and RAB-TrCH-MappingItem sequences allow the definition of mappings between the radio access bearer (RAB) and transport channel (TrCH), including parameters like rab-ID, trCH-ID-List, and iE-Extensions.

q_20260.question: What reference point is introduced to remove unnecessary protocol stacks between UE and the EGANC in the enhanced Up reference point?

q_20261.question: What information is provided from the "Monitor" step to the "Analyze" step in the closed control loop?
q_20261.ground_truth: The information provided from the "Monitor" step to the "Analyze" step includes performance measurements, KPI's, performance threshold monitoring events, and fault supervision events.

q_20262.question: In what situation can the immediate assignment procedure be initiated by the RR entity of the mobile station?
q_20262.ground_truth: The immediate assignment procedure can be initiated by the RR entity of the mobile station in response to a request from the MM sublayer to enter the dedicated mode or in response to a CTS~PAGING~REQUEST message.

q_20263.question: Which timer is started for each of the allocated traffic channels when sending synchronization patterns to the UE?
q_20263.ground_truth: Timer T is started for each of the allocated traffic channels when sending synchronization patterns to the UE.

q_20264.question: In which situation should the MAC entity select any SSB?
q_20264.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select any SSB if no SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB is available or if it is in contention-based Random Access preamble selection for the second transmission of Msg3.

q_20265.question: What should the UE do when it considers the leaving condition to be satisfied for the A6 event?
q_20265.ground_truth: The UE should remove the concerned cell(s) from the cellsTriggeredList and stop the periodical reporting timer, if running.

q_20266.question: What should the UE do after receiving a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #79 (UAS services not allowed), and it is operated in single-registration mode?
q_20266.ground_truth: If the UE is operating in single-registration mode and receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #79 (UAS services not allowed), it shall set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, reset the tracking area updating attempt counter, and enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.

q_20267.question: What are the three sets of functions required for a GSM PLMN connection?
q_20267.ground_truth: The three sets of functions required for a GSM PLMN connection are: (i) connection means for user information, including transmission and switching, (ii) control functions and protocols, including signalling, flow/congestion control and routing functions, and (iii) operations and management functions, including network management and maintenance functions.

q_20268.question: Which documents, as listed in the 3GPP series, are related to the half rate speech traffic channels and voice activity detection?

q_20269.question: In the test requirement 27.22.4.9.3.5, which expected sequence is the ME meant to operate in accordance with?

q_20270.question: What information does the MSC/IWF use for selecting the modem type and speed for non-transparent service support?
q_20270.ground_truth: The MSC/IWF uses the Compatibility information contained in the call set-up or call confirmed message for selecting the modem type and speed for non-transparent service support.

q_20271.question: What is the role of the AAA server in the GAN application?
q_20271.ground_truth: The AAA server is used to authenticate the MS when it sets up a secure tunnel in GAN application.

q_20272.question: What is the procedure followed if the UE decides to accept only non-speech media in the request that includes bi-directional speech or CS media?
q_20272.ground_truth: The SCC AS splits the non-speech media from the bi-directional speech or CS media for this UE and re-attempts the terminating call setup directly towards the same UE over the CS domain if possible.

q_20273.question: What is the main objective of provisioning 5G network to support UAS services?
q_20273.ground_truth: To avoid safety risks such as mid-air collision with another UAV, loss of control of a UAV, intentional misuse of a UAV, and sharing of airspace by various UAS users. This is done by guaranteeing QoS for the C2 communication.

q_20274.question: What should the UE do at switch on or following recovery from lack of coverage, in automatic network selection mode, with HPLMN, UPLMN, and OPLMN NG-RAN cells available and a USIM with Access Technology data files for each PLMN?
q_20274.ground_truth: The UE should select a cell of the highest priority PLMN and attempt registration with mobility on the selected cell.

q_20275.question: What is the significance of the N2 message sent from the source gNB to AMF during the Xn based leg addition in the multicast session path addition?
q_20275.ground_truth: The N2 message sent from the source gNB to AMF during the Xn based leg addition contains the list of TMGIs/MBS Session IDs and SMF IDs for the target gNB, and is used for the target gNB to initiate the multicast session join procedure with the SMF and UPF to add the target gNB into the multicast session.

q_20276.question: What is the role of the Pre-emption Capability IE and Pre-emption Vulnerability IE in the MBMS session establishment process?
q_20276.ground_truth: The Pre-emption Capability IE and Pre-emption Vulnerability IE are used to determine whether the session has to be started unconditionally and immediately, and to determine whether the session shall be included in the pre-emption process.

q_20277.question: What is the purpose of performing Downlink DSCP marking on the outer header for EPC routed traffic in the WLAN case?
q_20277.ground_truth: The purpose of performing downlink DSCP marking on the outer header for EPC routed traffic in the WLAN case is that the P-GW in the 3GPP domain sets a per-flow DSCP marking on each packet outer header.

q_20278.question: What is the format of the "SignallingConnectionRelease-r3-IEs" sequence?
q_20278.ground_truth: "SignallingConnectionRelease-r3-IEs" is a sequence containing two fields: "rrc-TransactionIdentifier" and "cn-DomainIdentity".

q_20279.question: What is the criticality of the "id-E-AI-Capability" in the provided code?

q_20280.question: Which entity is responsible for handling the MAC functions relating to the HARQ protocol?
q_20280.ground_truth: The HARQ entity in the MAC-hs is responsible for handling the MAC functions relating to the HARQ protocol.

q_20281.question: What is the purpose of the Initial Record (IRI) in the context of MBMS?
q_20281.ground_truth: The Initial Record (IRI) in the context of MBMS is used to convey the first event of MBMS service interception.

q_20282.question: What is the entry condition CEModeB in the test procedure in 9.4.4.2.4.2?
q_20282.ground_truth: CEModeB is a condition that applies to UE physical layer capabilities and PRS positioning occasions in the test procedure in 9.4.4.2.4.2.

q_20283.question: What should the gsmSRF/SSF request the MGW to do when playing an announcement as per clause 14.1.2.2?
q_20283.ground_truth: The gsmSRF/SSF should request the MGW to play the announcement as per the procedures described in clause 14.6.

q_20284.question: What is one of the main considerations for the evolution of the 3GPP system to an AIPN?
q_20284.ground_truth: Extensibility to enable step-by-step implementation without negatively affecting basic system performance.

q_20285.question: What is the difference between the on-network and off-network group information update procedures?
q_20285.ground_truth: The on-network procedure involves the V2X application specific server informing the VAE server about the updates, while the off-network procedure involves the V2X application specific client in V2X UE A informing the VAE client in V2X UE A.

q_20286.question: What are the files provided for assisting in codec type approval testing?
q_20286.ground_truth: SEQ05.INP and SEQ05.DEC are two homing sequences provided for assisting in codec type approval testing.

q_20287.question: What is the main advantage of using frequency hopping capability in a network?
q_20287.ground_truth: The main advantage of using frequency hopping capability in a network is to provide diversity on one transmission link and average the quality on all communications through interferers diversity.

q_20288.question: What should the MAC entity do during contention-based Random Access preamble selection if the potential Msg3 size is greater than ra-Msg3SizeGroupA and the pathloss is less than a certain value?
q_20288.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select the Random Access Preambles group B.

q_20289.question: What should the NAS (non-access stratum) do upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, if the event which triggered the access attempt was a request from upper layers to send a mobile originated SMS over NAS?
q_20289.ground_truth: The NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the SMS in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message, if still needed.

q_20290.question: What should the IP-SM-GW do after receiving a single Short Message within a MT_FORWARD_SHORT_MESSAGE or a full set of concatenated Short Messages not exceeding the size limit of a SIP MESSAGE request based Instant Message?
q_20290.ground_truth: After receiving a single Short Message or a full set of concatenated Short Messages not exceeding the size limit, the IP-SM-GW sends a SIP MESSAGE request to an AS acting as an originating UA.

q_20291.question: What is the abbreviation for "International Alphabet No. 5" in the context of telecommunications?

q_20292.question: What is the purpose of the HomeNetworkIndication leaf in the selection criteria node?
q_20292.ground_truth: The HomeNetworkIndication leaf indicates whether only the WLANs that are operated by the home operator could match the group of selection criteria or not.

q_20293.question: How many bits are used for the "Time domain resource assignment" field in the DCI, when the DCI is not for a random access procedure?

q_20294.question: What are the valid cells for E-UTRAN FDD in the context of the E-UTRAN Neighbour Cell list?
q_20294.ground_truth: Valid cells for E-UTRAN FDD are identified cells on frequencies included in the E-UTRAN Neighbour Cell list for which the physical-layer cell identity has been correctly detected and is not included in the list of not allowed cells for that frequency.

q_20295.question: What is the impact of the solution on the SMF in 5GC and EPC?
q_20295.ground_truth: In 5GC and EPC, the SMF and SMF+PGW-C must support "secondary authorization/authentication by a DN-AAA server" during PDU session establishment via a SBI interface. They must retrieve the USS/UTM address and CAA-Level UAV ID from the PDU session establishment request.

q_20296.question: What is the command number for the GET INKEY type command in the expected sequence 6.1A?

q_20297.question: What is the effect of cascading a channel emulator and reverberation chamber on the fading produced by the system?
q_20297.ground_truth: The fading produced by the cascaded channel emulator and reverberation chamber has a double-Rayleigh amplitude distribution, which is not commonly available in performance simulations.

q_20298.question: What is the difference between the multicast mode and broadcast mode of MBMS?
q_20298.ground_truth: In the multicast mode, data is efficiently transmitted from a single source to a multicast group in the associated multicast service area. While in the broadcast mode, data is transmitted from a single source entity to all users in a broadcast service area.

q_20299.question: What is the purpose of the property "initdir" and what are its possible values?
q_20299.ground_truth: The property "initdir" indicates whether or not the termination in the MGW should expect initialisation information or initiate UP initialisation itself. The possible values it can take are "In" (for incoming) and "Out" (for outgoing).

q_20300.question: What should be the value of the "numberOfRequestedVectors" in the SendAuthenticationInfoArg when there is no Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP and Requested-UTRAN-GERAN-Authentication-Info AVP is present within AIR?
q_20300.ground_truth: The value of the Number-Of-Requested-Vectors AVP received within the Requested-UTRAN-GERAN-Authentication-Info AVP.

q_20301.question: What is the function of the PLMN component MAF009 (Call forwarding on no reply authorizations examination)?
q_20301.ground_truth: MAF009 is a function that authorizes a PLMN component to determine the authorizations relating to call forwarding on no reply.

q_20302.question: What channels are not modified in the additional assignment procedure?
