q_20552.question: What should the MME do if the Location Timer expires before receiving a location response from the E-SMLC while in the LOCATION state?
q_20552.ground_truth: The MME should indicate a location failure to the original requesting entity and re-enter IDLE state.

q_20553.question: Which protocol stack can be used to implement speech recognition capabilities in IMS?
q_20553.ground_truth: IMS provides a protocol stack, including SIP/SDP, RTP, and QoS, that can be used to implement speech recognition capabilities.

q_20554.question: What action does the network take after establishing a new downlink TBF for a mobile station and receiving the EC PACKET~DOWNLINK~ACK/NACK or EC PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK HIGHER CC message with the Final Ack Indicator bit set to '1' from the mobile station?
q_20554.ground_truth: The network releases the old TBF and stops timer T3193.

q_20555.question: What type of GSM physical channel handles uplink packet random access for MBMS?

q_20556.question: What technique can be used for dual-carrier in BTS equalizer when additional Adjacent Channel Rejection (ACR) is required?
q_20556.ground_truth: The synchronous nature (time and frequency offset) of dual-carrier transmission can be exploited in the BTS equalizer by using dual-carrier joint detection.

q_20557.question: What is the lowest bitrate that UE-B could achieve when encapsulating 8 non-redundant frames in the packets in the B->A direction in Use case B?
q_20557.ground_truth: The lowest bitrate that UE-B could achieve is 14 kbps.

q_20558.question: What is the purpose of establishing a secure channel between a UICC and a terminal?
q_20558.ground_truth: The purpose is to protect the communication between the UICC and the terminal when sensitive applications are split between the two and data is exchanged between them.

q_20559.question: What is the message functional definition and content for RAB ASSIGNMENT REQUEST?
q_20559.ground_truth: This message is sent by the CN to request the establishment, modification or release of one or more RABs for the same UE. The message is sent in connection oriented mode.

q_20560.question: What are the three functions of the Layer 1 transmitter that the BSS needs to verify in this test?
q_20560.ground_truth: The three functions of the Layer 1 transmitter that the BSS needs to verify in this test are the RF equipment, the multiplexing and multiple access functions, and the interleaving and the channel encoding on the transmit side.

q_20561.question: What technology is the state planning to use for the sensors' communication system?
q_20561.ground_truth: The state is planning to use a wireless network for the sensors' communication system.

q_20562.question: What is the purpose of XID frames when the P/F-bit is set to "1"?
q_20562.ground_truth: XID frames with the P/F-bit set to "1" are used for negotiating parameters of RLP and layer 2 Relay function. They can be sent in both ADM and ABM.

q_20563.question: What is the requirement for testing the SEND DTMF proactive UICC command with UCS2 Display in Katakana?
q_20563.ground_truth: The requirement for testing the SEND DTMF proactive UICC command with UCS2 Display in Katakana is that the ME shall support the Proactive UICC: Send DTMF facility as defined in specific clauses of TS 31.111. Additionally, the ME shall support the UCS2 facility for the coding of the Katakana characters, as defined in ISO/IEC 10646. The testing should verify that the ME sends the DTMF string contained in the SEND DTMF proactive UICC command to the network, and returns a successful response in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command sent to the UICC. The testing should also verify that the ME does not locally generate audible DTMF tones and play them to the user. If the ME is in idle mode, it should inform the UICC using

q_20564.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an EAP-failure message during the EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure?
q_20564.ground_truth: The UE should delete the partial native 5G NAS security context, if any, and consider the procedure complete. If the EAP-failure message is received in an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message, the UE should set the update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete the stored 5G-GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI and ngKSI, and set the USIM as invalid until switching off the UE or removing the UICC containing the USIM.

q_20565.question: What is one approach to time synchronization between the UE and the PWS message signer?
q_20565.ground_truth: One approach to time synchronization is through the use of a PWS timer provisioned in UEs at manufacture with a conservative time, which can then be adjusted by a PWS timestamp update message similar in concept to the PWS CA update message.

q_20566.question: What is the main objective of the MMCMH work item in the context of multimedia group communication?
q_20566.ground_truth: The main objective of the MMCMH work item is to enable multi-stream audio/video support at the terminals and enable the conference focus and the terminals to receive stereo streams for further processing and rendering.

q_20567.question: What is the definition of an alarm in the context of the 3GPP TS 37.46x series of Technical Specifications?
q_20567.ground_truth: An alarm is a persistent indication of a fault.

q_20568.question: What is the service area ID or cell ID used for in the context of the VLR and SGSN association?
q_20568.ground_truth: The service area ID or cell ID is used to identify the location of the mobile station (MS) in the network, specifically the cell in which the MS last established radio contact.

q_20569.question: What modification is required for a UE to support a MA PDU Session over EPC based 3GPP access?
q_20569.ground_truth: A UE needs to be able to indicate whether it supports a MA PDU Session over EPC based 3GPP access.

q_20570.question: What is the purpose of Key Quality Indicator (KQI) in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
q_20570.ground_truth: KQI is used as the primary input for management of internal or supplier/partner SLAs that calculate actual service delivery quality against design targets or in the case of supplier/partner contractual agreements.

q_20572.question: What is the primary purpose of BMCA function in the U-plane of 3GPP networks?
q_20572.ground_truth: The primary purpose of the BMCA function in the U-plane is to avoid message loops for time synchronization and determine the port state of the gPTP instance. It runs the BMCA algorithm to select the best master clock and generate Announce messages accordingly, assisting in establishing time synchronization among network devices.

q_20573.question: What is the role of the PCF in ensuring Quality of Experience (QoE) for users?
q_20573.ground_truth: The PCF deploys SM policies to the SMF managing QoS based on step 6 to assure the QoE for UEs that their SLA is predicted will be compromised, or is being compromised due to one or more of reported TOPN Application-IDs.

q_20574.question: What should the MAG do during the PMIPv6 PDN Connection Handover procedure for generating a downlink GRE key?
q_20574.ground_truth: The MAG should generate a downlink GRE key that is not already in use locally for the PDN connection's downlink traffic to that UE, as specified in the GRE Key Option for PMIPv6 specification.

q_20575.question: What is the significance of the MPTY bridge in the Multi Party service?
q_20575.ground_truth: The MPTY bridge in the Multi Party service is responsible for connecting multiple parties in a call and allowing them to communicate with each other.

q_20576.question: What is the purpose of the TP-UDL bit in the SMPP protocol?
q_20576.ground_truth: The TP-UDL bit indicates whether the TP-UDL field or the TP-UD field is present in the TP-User-Data field. A receiving entity shall assume a value of 0x00 for the TP-DCS field if the TP-UDL bit is set to zero.

q_20577.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS CHANGE INFORMATION signalling flow?
q_20577.ground_truth: The MBMS CHANGE INFORMATION signalling flow is used to indicate MBMS services whose MCCH information is changed in that modification period.

q_20578.question: What is the role of the AS-OLCM in the functional model of the AS?
q_20578.ground_truth: The AS-OLCM stores transaction state and may optionally store session state depending on the specific service being executed. It also interfaces to the S-CSCF (OLCM) for an outgoing leg.

q_20579.question: What are the different 5GS ingress points for different service areas in the 5G system?
q_20579.ground_truth: The proposal is to support different 5GS ingress points for different service areas in the 5G system.

q_20580.question: What is the difference between the terms "version" and "release" when describing the document's changes?
q_20580.ground_truth: "Version" refers to a document presented to the TSG for information, approval, or under change control, while "release" refers to a new version of the document with a change of release date and an increased version number.

q_20581.question: What standards or specifications apply in the context of the IMS service level tracing management object?
q_20581.ground_truth: The 3GPP technical specifications (TS), TS 24.229, TS 23.003, and TR 21.905, as well as OMA Device Management protocol specifications, version 1.2 and onwards, and the OMA DM Device Description Framework (DDF) are relevant to the IMS service level tracing management object.

q_20582.question: What is the subject of TS 37.483 in relation to the 3GPP?
q_20582.ground_truth: TS 37.483 is a technical specification produced by the 3GPP for the radio access network (NG-RAN) and the E1 Application Protocol (E1AP), as detailed in Release 17.

q_20583.question: What new capabilities does the UE need to support in order to initiate Mobility Registration Update signalling only when moving out of the predicted sequence of Registration Areas?
q_20583.ground_truth: UE needs to support decoding of more than one Registration Area in Registration Accept message and omitting Mobility Registration Update when cell re-selection or validity period moves the UE from the current Registration Area to the next one in the ordered Registration Area List.

q_20584.question: What is the purpose of the synthesis filter (denominator) part of the formant postfilter in speech processing?
q_20584.ground_truth: The synthesis filter (denominator) part of the formant postfilter is used for estimating the original speech signal in speech processing applications.

q_20585.question: What are the two classifications of latency from the FRMCS System point of view?
q_20585.ground_truth: From the FRMCS System point of view, the two classifications of latency are Low (user data delay harms the functioning of the application) and Normal (user data delay does not harm the sequence and progress of the application).

q_20586.question: Which discovery procedures will be determined by SA~WG3 for network-controlled authentication and authorization of a Remote UE using a Relay UE's serving network resources?
q_20586.ground_truth: The network-controlled authentication and authorization procedures for a Remote UE to use the network resources (e.g. PDU Session and Network Slice) of the Relay UE's serving network.

q_20587.question: What is the purpose of Solution #12, Port Registration and Retrieval via NRF?
q_20587.ground_truth: The purpose of Solution #12, Port Registration and Retrieval via NRF, is to allow port information registration to the NRF and port information retrieval from the NRF. This solution is applicable for those NFs have entry in the NRF and provide specific protocols for non-SBI interfaces.

q_20588.question: What information is included in an eNB UE context when an active state for a UE is completed or after handover resource allocation during handover preparation?
q_20588.ground_truth: At least UE state information, security information, UE capability information and the identities of the UE-associated logical S1-connection.

q_20589.question: What is a MAC PDU in the context of DRX operation?
q_20589.ground_truth: A MAC PDU is a MAC protocol data unit, which consists of a set of RLC data blocks and control elements. It is used in MAC entity's C-RNTI, CS-RNTI, INT-RNTI, SFI-RNTI, SP-CSI-RNTI, TPC-PUCCH-RNTI, TPC-PUSCH-RNTI, and TPC-SRS-RNTI.

q_20590.question: Which test methodology provided higher resolution power in the subjective testing of 360-degree videos using HMD?
q_20590.ground_truth: DSIS provided higher resolution power as compared to the other two test methodologies.

q_20591.question: What should the BSS do if it is unable to buffer the paging request until the next occurrence of the nominal paging group for the indicated MS during the paging procedure?
q_20591.ground_truth: The BSS shall respond to the PAGING-PS PDU by sending a PAGING-PS-REJECT PDU to the SGSN and includes information indicating the time until the next paging occasion therein.

q_20592.question: Who is the service consumer that uses potential congestion condition as a trigger to request for the SMCCE analytics?

q_20593.question: What is the unit of the intra-cluster delay spread and the corresponding intra-cluster angular spreads in 7.6.2.2?
q_20593.ground_truth: The intra-cluster delay spread is given in seconds (s), and the corresponding intra-cluster angular spreads are given in degrees.

q_20594.question: What is the requirement for the MS when the MS on a CAG cell is not switched on or returned to coverage, and a CAG cell with a PLMN ID becomes available?
q_20594.ground_truth: If the MS is in Automatic network selection mode and is not switched on or returned to coverage, and a CAG cell with a PLMN ID becomes available, then the MS shall not select the CAG cell if its CAG-ID is not present in the "Allowed CAG list" associated with that PLMN in the "CAG information list".

q_20595.question: What is the true RSTD value between neighbour Cell 3 and OTDOA assistance data reference cell, Cell 2, in the test scenario?
q_20595.ground_truth: The true RSTD value is 31 Ts, which is about 1 second.

q_20596.question: What is the version of the schema used in the first instantiation example?
q_20596.ground_truth: The schema version used in the first instantiation example is 3.

q_20597.question: What should the UE do when timer T3512 expires?
q_20597.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update and indicate "periodic registration updating" in the 5GS registration type IE.

q_20598.question: What is the format of the test signals provided for use in testing compliance to the minimum performance requirements?
q_20598.ground_truth: All signals are raw data, linear 16-bit signed PCM coded audio data at a sampling rate of 8000 Hz, coded in Big-Endian format.

q_20599.question: What should be performed before the VLR/SGSN determines which UIAs and UEAs are allowed to be used for integrity and ciphering?
q_20599.ground_truth: The MS sends the Initial L3 message, which contains the user identity and the KSI (Key Set Identifier), to the VLR/SGSN. Additionally, user identity request and authentication of the user, and generation of new security keys may be performed.

q_20600.question: What is the purpose of the T1, T2, and T3 parameters in the Node Synchronisation procedure?
q_20600.ground_truth: T1 is the RNC specific frame number (RFN) that indicates the time when the RNC sends a frame to the transport layer, T2 is the Node B specific frame number (BFN) indicating the time when Node B receives the corresponding DL NODE SYNCHRONISATION control frame, and T3 is the BFN indicating the time when Node B sends a frame to the transport layer.

q_20601.question: What should be the PLMN parameter Information Transfer Capability when an LLC element is not present?

q_20602.question: What is the maximum default information field size supported on the Gb interface for Frame Relay?
q_20602.ground_truth: The default maximum information field size supported is 1600 octets.

q_20603.question: What is the role of the IDLE mode SIGnaling Reduction (ISR) function in GERAN and E-UTRAN networks?
q_20603.ground_truth: The IDLE mode Signaling Reduction function provides a mechanism to limit signalling during cell-reselection in idle mode between GERAN and E-UTRAN networks.

q_20604.question: Who is responsible for determining the timing advance (TA) at handover access and random access?
q_20604.ground_truth: TRX determines the TA at handover access and random access.

q_20605.question: Which procedure is used to report to the MRFC the result of an ASR request, where the MRFP has recognized and matched the detected speech to the specified grammar file?

q_20606.question: What is the role of the Default Credential Server (DCS) in the Control Plane-based onboarding solution?
q_20606.ground_truth: The Default Credential Server (DCS) is responsible for authenticating the Device Vendor (DV) or the UE and authorizing the UE to perform the onboarding procedure in the Control Plane-based onboarding solution.

q_20607.question: What is the first step in securing downloading a Third Party application to a MExE device?
q_20607.ground_truth: The first step in securing downloading a Third Party application to a MExE device is installing root public keys for a number of Certification Authorities (CAs) in the MExE device at manufacture.

q_20608.question: What is the initial condition of the system simulator for the 6.1.2.3.4 test?
q_20608.ground_truth: The initial condition of the system simulator for the 6.1.2.3.4 test is a 1 cell with default parameters and satellite signals as specified in 4.2.

q_20609.question: Which AVP is used to identify a specific QoS rule at the BBERF to be removed from a Gateway Control session?

q_20610.question: What are the Phase 2 requirements for wireless service providers regarding emergency calls in North America?
q_20610.ground_truth: The phase 2 requirements for wireless service providers regarding emergency calls in North America is to have the ability to provide the actual caller's location to the E911 PSAP with different location accuracy requirements depending on whether a network-based or handset-based approach is chosen.

q_20611.question: What is the requirement for the Network Resource Models (NRMs) in regard to State Management IRP version?
q_20611.ground_truth: All Network Resource Models (NRMs) of one release must support the same State Management IRP version.

q_20612.question: What is the purpose of the deferred session linking procedure in clause 4.5.2.6?
q_20612.ground_truth: The deferred session linking procedure assists the PCRF to avoid linking the Gateway Control Session with an obsolete Gx Session at initial IP-CAN Session Establishment and during inter-system BBERF relocation.

q_20613.question: What is the role of an Element Manager (EM) in 3GPP TS 28.621?
q_20613.ground_truth: An Element Manager (EM) provides a package of end-user functions for management of a set of closely related types of Network Elements (NEs) in the 3G network. It can be divided into two main categories: Element Management Functions for management of NEs on an individual basis and Sub-Network Management Functions related to a network model for a set of NEs.

q_20614.question: What should a mobile station in packet idle mode do upon receiving a paging message and immediate assignment messages on the paging subchannels on CCCH?
q_20614.ground_truth: The mobile station in packet idle mode is required to receive and analyse the paging messages and immediate assignment messages sent on the paging subchannels on CCCH, as they contain a page mode information element.

q_20615.question: Which extension in the "PowerOffsetInformation-F-DPCH-RL-SetupRqstFDD-ExtIEs" sequence has CRITICALITY reject and EXTENSION RL-Specific-DCH-Info?

q_20616.question: What does the reference time choice mean in the provided code?
q_20616.ground_truth: The reference time choice in the provided code is used to determine the type of clock used to reference the position of the UE. It is a choice that determines if the UE will use the GpsReferenceTimeUncertainty, GANSS-Reference-Time-Only, or UTRAN-GANSSReferenceTimeResult, or another unknown or extended result.

q_20617.question: What techniques have been implemented in the codec to improve performance in frame erasure conditions?
q_20617.ground_truth: The techniques include the TC mode, the safety-net approach for LSF quantization, memory-less gain quantization, and the transmission of concealment/recovery parameters in the bitstream to the decoder.

q_20618.question: When a voice group call is initiated, how is the network notifying the group call members?
q_20618.ground_truth: Notification messages are sent on the Notification CHannel (NCH) and voice group call channel FACCHs to notify the group call members, both participating and not participating. This process is carried out throughout the call to provide the late entry facility. In case of emergency mode, the network sends an emergency mode indication in the notification messages.

q_20619.question: What is the purpose of the Write-Replace procedure?
q_20619.ground_truth: The purpose of the Write-Replace procedure is to broadcast a new CBS message or emergency message or to replace an ongoing CBS message or emergency message broadcast with a new CBS message or emergency message.

q_20620.question: What recent draft multipath extension is relevant to media production workflows and what is its primary purpose?
q_20620.ground_truth: A recent draft multipath extension adopted by the IETF QUIC Working Group allows a pair of QUIC endpoints to use multiple network paths simultaneously (i.e. link bonding) to increase the aggregate capacity of a connection, improve the robustness/resilience of the connection, or a combination of both in media production workflows.

q_20621.question: What is the function of the most local DNS resolver and proper authoritative server, and why are they not always reachable via the most local PSA?
q_20621.ground_truth: The most local DNS resolver and the proper authoritative server are responsible for resolving domain names to IP addresses. They may not always be reachable via the most local PSA because the PSA is not the only network element that can communicate with the DNS servers. Other network components, such as the UPF, can also interact with the DNS servers while serving the UE.

q_20622.question: When would the network reject a radio link addition request if frequency specific compressed mode is not supported?
q_20622.ground_truth: If the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the Transmission Gap Pattern Sequence Status IEs in the Active Pattern Sequence Information IE, and it does not address exactly all ongoing compressed mode patterns, the DRNS will reject the Radio Link Addition procedure and respond with a RADIO LINK ADDITION FAILURE message with the Cause IE value "Invalid CM settings".

q_20623.question: What beam assessment method is used in Enhancement 3 to determine the mobility status?
q_20623.ground_truth: It uses beam level measurement results to assess UE's movement more accurately.

q_20624.question: What is the corresponding RTP payload size that fits most ideally into the transport format for the 258.4 kbps PS RAB with 40 ms TTI?
q_20624.ground_truth: The corresponding RTP payload sizes that fit most ideally into the transport formats are 936, 2232, 3528, 4792, 5136, 6328, 7720, 8872, and 10304 bits.

q_20625.question: What is the purpose of sending a preamble before the actual RACH message in the testing procedure?
q_20625.ground_truth: The purpose of sending a preamble before the actual RACH message is to check if the receiver can detect the preamble correctly, which indicates that the RACH message can be properly received and decoded.

q_20626.question: What should the UE do if it is unable to report the requested measurement results due to missing GANSS assistance data?
q_20626.ground_truth: The UE may send a measurement report containing the IE "UE positioning error" and set the contents of this IE as specified in subclause 8.6.7.19.5. After sending the measurement report, the UE shall not send another measurement report to request the same GANSS assistance data for at least 20s.

q_20627.question: In what scenarios would an IWF include a Resource-Priority header in a SIP request for MCPTT emergency private calls, and which header value would correspond to an emergency priority level?
q_20627.ground_truth: The IWF would include a Resource-Priority header in the SIP request for MCPTT emergency private calls if the MCPTT emergency private call state is set to "MEPC 2: emergency-pc-requested", "MEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted", or if the MCPTT emergency private priority state of a call is "MEPP 2: in-progress". In case of an MCPTT emergency priority level, the header value would include the priority as specified in clause~6.4.1.11, aiding earlier priority adjustment by the infrastructure.

q_20628.question: What should the UE do if the new cell is not better ranked than the serving cell during a time interval TreselectionRAT?
q_20628.ground_truth: The UE shall not reselect the new cell in this case.

q_20629.question: What is the responsibility of the contact person of each band combination in 3GPP technical documents?
q_20629.ground_truth: The contact person of each band combination is responsible for ensuring that the technical specifications (TPs) related to the band combination have been implemented in the 3GPP technical document.

q_20630.question: What does the mobile station do when it receives an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message that is the first message in a two-message assignment?
q_20630.ground_truth: The mobile station continues to listen to the full CCCH, and may receive a second IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message within 2 multiframe periods specifying the packet channel description and, if required, a mobile allocation for the assignment. If the second IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message is not received within 2 multiframe periods, the mobile station discards the first message.

q_20631.question: In what scenarios should the 20 MSB of the hyper frame number component of COUNT-C be initialized with the latest transmitted START for CS domain?
q_20631.ground_truth: This should be done when the IE "RB information to setup" is received in a message other than HANDOVER TO UTRAN COMMAND, and the IE "SR-VCC Info" is not present or does not contain the IE "NONCE" in the stored procedure.

q_20632.question: What is the relationship between 3GPP TS 28.669 and 3GPP TS 28.668?
q_20632.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 28.669 is related to 3GPP TS 28.668, with 3GPP TS 28.669 specifying the solution set definitions for the Radio Planning Tool Access (RPTA) Integration Reference Point (IRP) and 3GPP TS 28.668 specifying the requirements for the Radio Planning Tool Access (RPTA) Integration Reference Point (IRP).

q_20633.question: What is the role of the Integration Reference Point (IRP) as defined in the 3GPP TS 28.734 technical specification?
q_20633.ground_truth: The Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a part of the Network Resource Model (NRM) in the Signalling Transport Network (STN) interface, which defines the requirements for network management in 3GPP networks. It is used for telecommunication network management purposes, including the management of converged networks.

q_20634.question: What should an MAA call to stop consuming a Media service?
q_20634.ground_truth: The stopStreamingService() API should be called by an MAA to stop consuming a Media service.

q_20635.question: What is the format of the XML document included in the Parental Control Allowing Request from the child to the SCF?
q_20635.ground_truth: The XML document includes the following parameters: ChildUserID, ParentUserID, and ProgramID.

q_20636.question: What is the difference between contiguous and non-contiguous spectrum in the context of UTRA Base Stations?
q_20636.ground_truth: Contiguous spectrum consists of a contiguous block of spectrum with no sub-block gap(s), while non-contiguous spectrum consists of two or more sub-blocks separated by sub-block gap(s).

q_20637.question: What does the StreamingAccept attribute specify for each content type?
q_20637.ground_truth: A set of MIME parameters to signal receiver capabilities for each content type that supports multiple parameter sets.

q_20638.question: What should the UE do when the periodical reporting timer expires for event A4?
q_20638.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5 when the periodical reporting timer expires for event A4.

q_20639.question: What are the supported video resolutions and frames per second (fps) for MCVideo clients using the H.264 (AVC) codec?
q_20639.ground_truth: MCVideo clients should support video encoding up to 720p (1280x720 @ 30fps) and 1080p (3840x2160 @ 30fps) with the H.264 (AVC) codec, depending on their capabilities and the MCVideo service.

q_20640.question: What is the difference between DL-DATA primitives and DL-UNIT DATA primitives in the context of multiple frame operation?
q_20640.ground_truth: DL-DATA primitives are used to pass message units to and from the data link layer layer~3 for transmission and reception using multiple frame acknowledged operation, while DL-UNIT DATA primitives are used for unacknowledged operation.

q_20641.question: What is the recommended method for NR sidelink communication device operating in the resources that UE is expected to use for transmission and reception via PC5 interface?
q_20641.ground_truth: The recommended method for NR sidelink communication device operating in the resources that UE is expected to use for transmission and reception via PC5 interface is to use NR-SS-UE 1 and 2.

q_20642.question: What is the device identity of the destination device in the initial terminal response?
q_20642.ground_truth: The destination device is the UICC.

q_20643.question: What state does the MSC-A server requests MGW-A to set the Handover Device to when it receives the MAP Prepare Subsequent Handover response message or the Relocation Detect message?

q_20644.question: What limitations arise with channel mode changes in AMR operation?
q_20644.ground_truth: Limitations arise with channel mode changes in AMR operation to avoid ping-pong and too numerous channel mode changes, which can cause extensive use of layer 3 signaling and degrade the call quality. This decreases the capacity gain from AMR. The exact effect of these limitations depends on the AMR handover algorithm, which is manufacturer-specific.

q_20645.question: Which three IT standards are used in the XML Definitions annex of the document?
q_20645.ground_truth: The XML Definitions annex (Annex B) uses the IDL, WSDL, and XML standards.

q_20646.question: What message does the GANC send to the MS to indicate resource release after the handover is completed?

q_20647.question: What is the purpose of using an RF-controlled spatial fading emulator in handset testing?
q_20647.ground_truth: The RF-controlled spatial fading emulator can reproduce a multipath radio propagation environment, measure radiation characteristics of a handset antenna, and evaluate the MIMO characteristics of a multiple antenna device in a multipath fading environment.

q_20648.question: What is the mechanism that enables the receiver to determine if a short Ack/Nack report is included in the UL RLC data block?
q_20648.ground_truth: A spare bit in the RLC/MAC header is used to indicate the presence of a piggy-backed Ack/Nack report in the UL RLC data block. This mechanism is applicable to all three EGPRS header types.

q_20649.question: What is the maximum user rate in the PLMN BC-IE when the connection element is "transparent" for unrestricted digital interworking?
q_20649.ground_truth: 8 kbit/s or 16 kbit/s, depending on the user rate.

q_20650.question: How many transport blocks are indicated by the one bit indication in four stream transmission?
q_20650.ground_truth: Two transport blocks are indicated by the one bit indication in four stream transmission.

q_20651.question: What information does the UE include in the measResultListNR of measResultNeighCells when the SS/PBCH block-based measurement quantities are available?
q_20651.ground_truth: The UE includes all the available measurement quantities of the best measured cells, other than the source PCell(in case HO failure) or PCell (in case RLF), ordered based on SS/PBCH block RSRP or SINR.

q_20652.question: In the track header box, what unit are the values tx, ty, width, and height defined in?
q_20652.ground_truth: The values tx, ty, width, and height in the track header box are defined in the same units as the track dimensions.

q_20653.question: What components of the protocol stack are hosted on the eNB-CP in E-UTRAN?
q_20653.ground_truth: The eNB-CP in E-UTRAN hosts the RRC, RLC, MAC, and PHY layers of the control plane, and the control plane part of the PDCP protocol.

q_20654.question: What is the purpose of the "id-Cause" parameter in the "ProtocolIE-Container" sequence in the Iu-ReleaseCommand message?
q_20654.ground_truth: The "id-Cause" parameter in the "ProtocolIE-Container" sequence in the Iu-ReleaseCommand message indicates the cause of the release, such as the type of release, with a variety of options like "unsuccessful linking list", indicating the reason for the failure, and "NAS-PDU", indicating a NAS-PDU type.

q_20655.question: What does "MIMO" stand for in the names of the variables?
q_20655.ground_truth: MIMO stands for "Multiple Input Multiple Output," which is a type of wireless communication technology. It is commonly used in telecommunications to improve data rates and coverage.

q_20656.question: Which positioning methods are used for each mode in 3GPP TS 37.571-1?
q_20656.ground_truth: The positioning methods used for each mode are Assisted Global Positioning System (A-GPS) and Assisted Global Navigation Satellite Systems (A-GNSS) for UTRA, Assisted Global Navigation Satellite System (A-GNSS), Observed Time Difference of Arrival (OTDOA), Enhanced Cell ID (ECID), Metropolitan Beacon System (MBS), Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN), and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for E-UTRA, Observed Time Difference of Arrival (OTDOA) and others for NB-IOT, and Assisted Global Navigation Satellite System (A-GNSS), Observed Time Difference of Arrival (OTDOA), Enhanced Cell ID (ECID), Metropolitan Beacon System (MBS), Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN), and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for NR.

q_20657.question: What ITU-T Recommendation is used for establishing AAL2 connections towards the circuit switched domain in the ATM transport option?

q_20658.question: What is the role of the GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message in the NAS signalling procedure?
q_20658.ground_truth: The GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message is used to transfer the initial NAS PDU from the MS to the core network during the NAS signalling procedure.

q_20659.question: What action does the MRFP take when it receives a request from the MRFC to modify the media properties based on the provided Floor Request Decisions notification?
q_20659.ground_truth: The MRFP modifies the Floor status of the associated Client

q_20660.question: In what conditions is a PRS resource not subject to measurement requirements?
q_20660.ground_truth: A PRS resource is not subject to measurement requirements if it spans two sampling durations of N in the measurement period, or if the time span of the PRS resource instance is greater than the UE reported capability N.

q_20661.question: What triggers the location update type IMSI attach (MM.AttIntraVlrIMSILU)?
q_20661.ground_truth: A location update of type IMSI attach (MM.AttIntraVlrIMSILU) is triggered when a UE sends a "LOCATION UPDATING REQUEST" service request message to a VLR.

q_20662.question: Which software and hardware platforms has the bit-exact C code for the Cellular Text Telephone Modem been verified on?
q_20662.ground_truth: The bit-exact C code has been verified on Sun Microsystems workstations with SUN SolarisTM operating system and the Gnu C Compiler, as well as on IBM PC/AT compatible computers with WindowsNTM 4.0 operating system and Microsoft Visual C++ 6.0TM compiler.

q_20663.question: How does the number of representations influence the saved traffic on the transit link?
q_20663.ground_truth: The number of representations significantly influences the saved traffic on the transit link, with a higher number of representations leading to greater savings.

q_20664.question: What is the purpose of the HES application in the 3GPP network?
q_20664.ground_truth: The HES application in the 3GPP network supports service profiles for SIP URIs with a URI parameter of user=phone and represents a PNP number.

q_20665.question: What is the definition of MAC-hs Guaranteed Bit Rate in 3GPP TS 25.331?
q_20665.ground_truth: The MAC-hs Guaranteed Bit Rate IE indicates the guaranteed number of bits per second that Node B should deliver over the air interface under normal operating conditions (provided there is data to deliver).

q_20666.question: When is the Location Area Identification IE included in the GA RC REGISTER REJECT message?
q_20666.ground_truth: The Location Area Identification IE shall be included if the Register Reject Cause 'Location not allowed' or 'Network Congestion' is returned to the MS.

q_20667.question: What is the risk that RS GMSK blocks will be misinterpreted as valid information?

q_20668.question: With what priority level shall the RNC consider the requested RAB if the Extended Alternative Maximum Bit Rate IE is signalled in one direction?
q_20668.ground_truth: If the Extended Alternative Maximum Bit Rate IE is signalled in one direction, the RNC shall use it in both directions for that entry or discrete value. If the Supported Alternative Maximum Bit Rate IE is present, it shall be used in both directions for all entries in the list or discrete values.

q_20669.question: What is the time period used to calculate the measurement period Tmeasurement inter for inter-frequency P-CCPCH RSCP measurements?

q_20670.question: What should the UE do if the SI message cannot be decoded from the accumulated SI message transmissions by the end of the SI-window?
q_20670.ground_truth: The UE should continue reception and accumulation of SI message transmissions on DL-SCH in the next SI-window occasion for the concerned SI message.

q_20671.question: Which node in the S9 protocol acts as a Diameter server and which acts as a Diameter client?
q_20671.ground_truth: In the S9 protocol, the H-PCRF acts as a Diameter server, and the V-PCRF acts as the Diameter client.

q_20672.question: What type of AVP is the Coverage-Status AVP and what values are defined for it?
q_20672.ground_truth: The Coverage-Status AVP is of type Enumerated and it indicates whether UE is served by E-UTRAN or not. The defined values are: Out of coverage, In coverage.

q_20673.question: What is the expected input from the Content Provider in the high-level requirements regarding content ingestion?
q_20673.ground_truth: The BM-SC ought to be informed by the CP on whether the video files can be fetched by the UE over unicast from the CP server, the basic characteristics of the service such as service name and service language, and the time that a given file is expected to be available to the MBMS-aware application for rendering.

q_20674.question: What information does the RANAP ENHANCED RELOCATION INFORMATION REQUEST message contain?
q_20674.ground_truth: The message contains various IEs (Information Elements) such as Source RNC To Target RNC Transparent Container IE, Old Iu Signalling Connection Identifier CS domain IE, Global CN-ID for CS, RABs to be Setup List, etc.

q_20675.question: What is the role of the Receiving RNC in the ANR reporting procedure for UTRAN cells over the Iur interface?
q_20675.ground_truth: The Receiving RNC in the ANR reporting procedure for UTRAN cells over the Iur interface is responsible for retrieving the ANR report over the Uu interface, terminating the relevant ANR report entry, and forwarding the ANR report to the Base RNCs over Iur with the RNSAP Direct Information Transfer procedure. The Receiving RNC may also use the RNSAP Information Exchange Initiation procedure to request cell information from a neighbour RNC.

q_20676.question: What is the activation indicator for the call forwarding unconditional feature in the RELEASE COMPLETE (SS RETURN RESULT) 2.1 coding?

q_20677.question: What is the size of data blocks exchanged on control channel SAPs?
q_20677.ground_truth: The size of data blocks exchanged on control channel SAPs is 23 or 21 octets.

q_20678.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role do if the received SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification indicates a successful delivery and the MCPTT function is controlling the emergency alert?
q_20678.ground_truth: The IWF should generate a SIP 2xx response and follow the procedures specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

q_20679.question: How can requirements for conformance be identified in a 3GPP TS?
q_20679.ground_truth: Clear rules for the use of verbal forms, including modal auxiliaries, are essential to identify the requirements that are obligatory in a 3GPP TS.

q_20680.question: What is the length of the PGK Index field?
q_20680.ground_truth: The PGK Index field is 5 bits in length.

q_20681.question: What is the basic approach to generate HDR metrics?
q_20681.ground_truth: The basic approach to generate HDR metrics involves transforming YUV sequences to 4:4:4 and then to floating point RGB to obtain 32-bit EXR floating point representation, and then computing PSNRL100 and DE100.

q_20682.question: What is the purpose of the solution described in 7.22.2 for Edge Application Server discovery?
q_20682.ground_truth: The purpose of this solution is to enable discovery of Edge Application Servers running in different Edge Data Networks, via Edge Enabler Servers responsible for the service areas of the aforementioned Edge Application Servers. This distributed topology for discovery allows Edge Enabler Clients to connect only to a single Edge Enabler Server, saving resources on the UE and reducing data traffic in the network.

q_20683.question: How many vertical columns represent a call level in the encode call graph?
q_20683.ground_truth: Each vertical column represents a call level in the encode call graph, with main() at level 0, encode() at level 1, and the deepest level being level 6.

q_20684.question: What is the purpose of the DataPurposeID in the 3GPP service exposure privacy rule framework?
q_20684.ground_truth: The DataPurposeID is used to indicate the purpose of a user data request and determine how privacy-sensitive information should be processed by the NF Service Producer before sending a service response to the requester.

q_20685.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group in relation to the Noise Suppression for the AMR codec?
q_20685.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group is responsible for producing specifications for the Noise Suppression for the AMR codec, which enhances the input speech signal corrupted by acoustic noise.

q_20686.question: Which measurement indicates the total number of UL (Uplink) TBs, excluding HARQ retransmissions, received in a cell?
q_20686.ground_truth: The measurement TB.TotNbrUl provides the total number of UL TBs received in a cell for each measurement granularity interval.

q_20687.question: What types of data can be contained in the bulked data?
q_20687.ground_truth: Bulked data can contain raw data samples, pre-processed data samples, or a combination of both. If the type of bulked data is pre-processed data samples, the data type and associated feature type are included in the bulked data.

q_20688.question: What should the UE do when timer T323 expires?
q_20688.ground_truth: The UE may determine whether there are subsequent indications from upper layers that there is no more PS data for a prolonged period in which case it triggers the transmission of a single SIGNALLING CONNECTION RELEASE INDICATION message.

q_20689.question: What is the network slice selection in SC Mode 1?
q_20689.ground_truth: The network slice selection in SC Mode 1 is 01 01 01 01 with ST: MBB and SD: 010101.

q_20690.question: What is the function of the User Service Discovery/Announcement function?
q_20690.ground_truth: The User Service Discovery/Announcement function provides service description information necessary to initiate an MBMS user service.

q_20691.question: What is the purpose of the Linked NSAPI IE in the context of the 3GPP specification for communication between an SGSN and a GGSN?
q_20691.ground_truth: The Linked NSAPI IE is used by the SGSN to indicate the NSAPI assigned to an already activated PDP context of the PDN connection.

q_20692.question: What is the difference between E-DPDCH power extrapolation formula and E-DPDCH power interpolation formula used in the calculation of the E-DPDCH gain factor?
q_20692.ground_truth: The E-DPDCH power extrapolation formula is used to compute the gain factor of an E-DPDCH when the E-TFCI of the i-th E-DPDCH is greater than or equal to the E-TFCI of the M-th reference E-DPDCH and less than the E-TFCI of the (M-1)-th reference E-DPDCH. On the other hand, the E-DPDCH power interpolation formula is used when the E-TFCI of the i-th E-DPDCH is smaller than the E-TFCI of the 1st reference E-DPDCH and greater than or equal to the E-TFCI of the M-th reference E-DPDCH.

q_20693.question: What are the values for the Range leaf for V2X groupcast mode communication over the NR-PC5?
q_20693.ground_truth: The values are 1-65535, a 16 bits unsigned integer value indicating range in meters.

q_20694.question: What should the Node B do if the UE TS0 Capability LCR IE is included in the UE Capabilities Information IE in the HS-DSCH Information IE in a 1.28Mcps TDD system?
q_20694.ground_truth: The Node B may use this information in HSDPA resources allocation for the UE.

q_20695.question: In the GEA5 algorithm, what is the assignment operator "=" used as in several programming languages?
q_20695.ground_truth: The assignment operator "=" in GEA5 is used to assign a new value to a variable, which takes place after the assignment took place.

q_20696.question: What information should the BM-SC include in the MBMS Session Start procedure if BM-SC trace is activated and BM-SC supports both IPv4 and IPv6?
q_20696.ground_truth: The BM-SC should include both an IPv4 and an IPv6 IP Multicast address together with the corresponding IP addresses of the multicast source.

q_20697.question: What is the main focus of urban micro-environmental services?
q_20697.ground_truth: Urban micro-environmental services focus on real-time monitoring and feedback of various environmental indicators in the living environment of residents, aiming to improve residents' comfort in daily living and traveling and support environmental protection.

q_20698.question: What is the role of the SEAL NRM service enabler in exposing Time Sensitive Communication (TSC) capabilities of the 5G system?
q_20698.ground_truth: The SEAL NRM service enabler exposes TSC capabilities of the 5G system, which supports integration with an IEEE TSN system as well as 5G-native TSC services.

q_20699.question: What information shall the UE store upon receiving a UTRAN MOBILITY INFORMATION message containing the IE "UE Timers and constants in connected mode"?
q_20699.ground_truth: The UE shall store the values of the IE "UE Timers and constants in connected mode", and start using the new values for any updated timer and constant the next time they are started. If the IE "CN domain specific DRX cycle length coefficient" is also present, the UE shall use the value to determine the connected mode paging occasions.

q_20700.question: When should a new functionality be defined as optional in the V4 interface?
q_20700.ground_truth: A new functionality should be defined as optional in the V4 interface when it is introduced and if backwards incompatible changes cannot be avoided.

q_20701.question: What is the general relevance of the test results in the present document?
q_20701.ground_truth: The test results in the present document are generally valid for all Release 6 services and applications which are based on the Release~6 audio codecs, including Packet switched Streaming Service (PSS), Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS), Multimedia Broadcast and Multicast Service (MBMS), IMS Messaging Service and Presence Service, and apply to all similar applications with similar constraints (e.g. bit-rate, mono/stereo).

q_20702.question: What measures can be taken to mitigate RAN user plane congestion during Rx session establishment?
q_20702.ground_truth: Existing bandwidth limitation parameters on the Rx interface can be utilized to mitigate RAN user plane congestion during Rx session establishment.

q_20703.question: What must the SGSN return if it receives a LCS Location Notification Return Result message indicating that permission for location is not granted?
q_20703.ground_truth: The SGSN shall return an error response to the GMLC.

q_20704.question: What should the MS discriminate to identify the second RTTI block in the 20 ms time unit as an "8-PSK 2-burst RTTI block"?
q_20704.ground_truth: The MS should discriminate between '0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0' and '1,1,1,0,0,0,0,1' in the stealing flags.

q_20705.question: What is the scrambling sequence initialization period for PDSCH in consecutive subframes of a given block for BL/CE UEs, if the PDSCH is not carrying SIB1-BR or a SI message (except for SIB1-BR), and is associated with P-RNTI or SC-RNTI?
q_20705.ground_truth: The scrambling sequence initialization period is one subframe.

q_20706.question: Who maintains the reference software for the 3GPP file format?
q_20706.ground_truth: The reference software for the 3GPP file format is maintained by ISO/IEC, as part of the overall reference software.

q_20707.question: What is the technology studied for NR that allows the aggregation of NR carriers?
q_20707.ground_truth: Both lower layer aggregation like Carrier Aggregation (CA) for LTE and upper layer aggregation like DC are investigated.

q_20708.question: How is an E.164 number included in the "From-id" information element when it is transporting an International number?
q_20708.ground_truth: The E.164 number, when included in the "From-id" information element to transport an International number, is binary encoded in the octet 3, octet 4, octet 5, etc., with the most significant digit of the E.164 digit-string encoded in the bits numbers 8, 7, 6, and 5 of octet number 3, and the bit-pattern "1111" used as the end-delimiter for the E.164 digit-string.

q_20709.question: What message is sent by the GGSN to the SGSNs in the list of downstream nodes parameter of the corresponding MBMS Bearer Context when a broadcast MBMS bearer service is started?
q_20709.ground_truth: The MBMS Session Start Request message containing the session attributes and the 2G/3G indicator.

q_20710.question: What is the role of the lease time in the management of PDU sessions in 5GC?
q_20710.ground_truth: The lease time is the duration for which an IP address is reserved for a UE in a PDU session in 5GC. It is chosen by the operator of the AAA server and stored in the PDU session context. SMFs of an SMF set share their contexts, allowing any SMF that may take over the control of the PDU session to determine if the lease time is approaching expiry and initiate a AAA re-authorization to renew the IP address.

q_20711.question: What is the format of USSD messages that are transported in SIP INFO requests, SIP INVITE requests, and SIP BYE requests in IP Multimedia Core Network Subsystem (IMS)?
q_20711.ground_truth: USSD messages are transported in SIP INFO requests, SIP INVITE requests, and SIP BYE requests in IP Multimedia Core Network Subsystem (IMS) using the application/vnd.3gpp.ussd+xml MIME body.

q_20712.question: What is the maximum number of Base Station RF Bandwidth for non-contiguous operation in UTC2?
q_20712.ground_truth: The Base Station RF Bandwidth consists of one sub-block gap and two sub-blocks located at the edges of the declared maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth.

q_20713.question: When UE-2 receives a notification on PLMN-1, and it decides to accept the paging notification, what steps should it take?
q_20713.ground_truth: When UE-2 decides to accept a paging notification on PLMN-1, it indicates this to AMF-1 via a mobility registration message. In response, AMF-1 notes that the new PLMN will receive paging notifications on the user plane at IP-2 for UE-1. UE-2 then proceeds to execute a service request in PLMN-2, and PLMN-1 stops paging the UE on the control plane.

q_20714.question: What is the function of the Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) in the EVS codec?
q_20714.ground_truth: The Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) function in the EVS codec allows for the input signal to be encoded at a lower average rate by taking speech inactivity into account. This helps conserve UE power and improve network capacity.

q_20715.question: What action should a BSS take if it receives an IE with semantically incorrect contents within a RIM container?
q_20715.ground_truth: The receiving BSS should ignore that IE and treat the rest of the RIM container. If the rest of the RIM container can no longer be handled because this IE was ignored, the receiving BSS should send a RAN-INFORMATION-ERROR PDU containing the complete received PDU and with the RIM Cause IE set to "Semantically incorrect PDU" back to the originating BSS and discard the received PDU.

q_20716.question: What should the UE do when it detects consistent uplink LBT failure indication from SCG MAC in NR-DC?
q_20716.ground_truth: The UE should consider radio link failure to be detected for the SCG, suspend SCG transmission for all SRBs and DRBs, reset SCG MAC, stop T304 for the SCG if running, and initiate the SCG failure information procedure to report the SCG radio link failure.

q_20717.question: What should the UE do if the "PDCP context relocation info" IE is included in a message?
q_20717.ground_truth: The UE shall, for each radio bearer included in this IE, perform specific actions based on the value of "Downlink RFC 3095 context relocation indication" and "Uplink RFC 3095 context relocation indication".

q_20718.question: What information is instructed by the criticality information in the RNA messages?
q_20718.ground_truth: The criticality information in the RNA messages instructs the receiver how to act when receiving an IE or an IE group that is not comprehended.

q_20719.question: What is the external network type information element used for in the Interworking Security Data message?
q_20719.ground_truth: The external network type information element is used to identify the type of the network represented by the IWF.

q_20720.question: What is the purpose of DCCF when reselecting NWDAF?
q_20720.ground_truth: DCCF is used to support the context transfer at reselection of NWDAF when a change of a consumer NF happens, as explained in bullet i.2).

q_20721.question: When sending CFU information to a Phase 1 VLR, what action should the HLR take based on the logical state held?
q_20721.ground_truth: The HLR should convert the logical state held into a form that the VLR can accept.

q_20722.question: What are the potential charging requirements for ProSe services in 5GS?
q_20722.ground_truth: The potential charging requirements include supporting converged charging and charging information reporting for ProSe Communication, collecting charging information from UE, identifying chargeable events, charging for PDU Session types of IP, Ethernet, and Unstructured, and charging for Layer-2 and Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay in the 5G system.

q_20723.question: What should be the format of the UE's request for file repair when the server only supports byte range requests?
q_20723.ground_truth: The Byte-Range-Based File Repair Request Message Format using HTTP/1.1 GET or partial GET requests.

q_20724.question: What services do mobile stations supporting Voice Group Call Service (VGCS) or Voice Broadcast Service (VBS) typically implement?
q_20724.ground_truth: Mobile stations supporting VGCS or VBS may implement the following services: VBS listening, VBS originating, VGCS listening, VGCS talking, and VGCS originating.

q_20725.question: When should the Sender submit AMD PDUs to the lower layer for transmission?
q_20725.ground_truth: The Sender should submit AMD PDUs to the lower layer for transmission if the AMD PDU has a "Sequence Number" less than VT(MS) or the AMD PDU has a "Sequence Number" equal to VT(S)-1, and if the AMD PDU is not restricted to be transmitted by the local suspend function.

q_20726.question: What is the role of the UPFs in reporting bitrate to the PCF in Method 1 and Method 2?
q_20726.ground_truth: In Method 1, the UPFs measure the N6/N19 interface UL/DL throughputs for the S-NSSAI and report the average N6/N19 interface UL/DL bitrate per S-NSSAI to the PCF via the SMFs frequently. While in Method 2, the UPFs measure the N6/N19 interface UL/DL throughputs for the S-NSSAI and report the average N6/N19 interface UL/DL bitrate per S-NSSAI to the PCFs via the SMFs frequently. The PCFs store the latest received report from the UPFs in the UDR. Each PCF involved can read the latest report of all the UPFs in the slice from the UDR and calculate the actual data rate of the whole slice.

q_20727.question: What is the purpose of the "colour codes" in the independent definition of cells and TAs?
q_20727.ground_truth: The color codes are used to ensure unique cell IDs when a cell may not be wholly within a single TA. The color codes can be used to split a base cell that overlaps with multiple TAs into separate cell portions, allowing for a serving cell ID to be determined from both the base cell and the TA within which the UE is located. This ensures unique cell IDs as long as no two TAs that share part of the same boundary or vertex have the same color code.

q_20728.question: What should the target BSS include in the SI/PSI messages if the MS supports network sharing and the target cell supports network sharing?
q_20728.ground_truth: The target BSS should include the same PLMN ID in the SI/PSI messages as the one received in the Target Cell Identifier IE in the PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST PDU.

q_20729.question: What is the impact of the network function NSQ on dynamic adjustment of data rate per slice?
q_20729.ground_truth: The NSQ performs dynamic adjustment of data rate per slice via NAS signalling, on reaching the allowed Slice-AMBR limit.

q_20730.question: What should the UE do if it has radio link failure or handover failure information available and the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report?
q_20730.ground_truth: The UE includes rlf-InfoAvailable in the RRCReestablishmentComplete message.

q_20731.question: What is the aim of the requirement in TS 22.261 that a 5G system with satellite access shall be able to select the communication link providing the UE with the best service options?
q_20731.ground_truth: The aim of this requirement is to ensure that the 5G system with satellite access is able to select the communication link that provides the best service options for the UE, in terms of bandwidth, connectivity, coverage, and other factors. This is important due to the unique challenges posed by satellite communication, such as high latency and limited bandwidth.

q_20732.question: What should the SGSN include in the Routeing Area Update Accept message if it decides to enable extended idle mode DRX for an MS that included the extended idle mode DRX parameters?
q_20732.ground_truth: The SGSN should include the extended idle mode DRX parameters information element in the Routeing Area Update Accept message if it decides to enable extended idle mode DRX for an MS that included the extended idle mode DRX parameters.

q_20733.question: What event occurs when the channel changes from idle to call C-B waiting?
q_20733.ground_truth: C releases the waiting call, causing the channel to change from idle to call C-B waiting.

q_20734.question: What action should an MRFC take upon reception of an RTCP feedback message with the "DBI" signalling and the "query parameter q" set to '0'?
q_20734.ground_truth: The MRFC may use the additional delay budget to improve the reliability of its outgoing media stream to reduce packet loss.

q_20735.question: What protocol is used between a SIP-I based CS CN and an Interworking Unit for signalling, where the underlying signalling transport is IP?
q_20735.ground_truth: The protocol used is IP (IETF~RFC~791 or IETF~RFC~2460), SCTP (IETF~RFC~4960), and SIP-I.

q_20736.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "should" in the context of 3GPP documentation?
q_20736.ground_truth: "Shall" is a mandatory requirement and indicates that a specific action must be taken, while "should" is a recommendation and suggests that a certain course of action would be preferable.

q_20737.question: What is the impact of a high number of inactive users on the HS-SCCH signalling load?
q_20737.ground_truth: A high number of inactive users (e.g. 80) would only have a smaller impact on the HS-SCCH signalling load (1.6%).

q_20738.question: What is the purpose of the parameter SnonIntraSearchP in the context of 3GPP TS 38.304, clause 5.2.4.5?
q_20738.ground_truth: The parameter SnonIntraSearchP specifies the Srxlev threshold (in dB) for NR inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurements.

q_20739.question: What information is added at the end of each UDP payload to create FEC source packets in the streaming delivery service of MBMS?
q_20739.ground_truth: A 3-byte FEC source payload ID field is added at the end of each UDP payload to create FEC source packets in the streaming delivery service of MBMS.

q_20740.question: What values should the internal timer in 7.4.2.5 NOT exceed after step e)?
q_20740.ground_truth: The internal timer should not exceed 6 minutes, with a allowed guard time of 10% greater than the required 6 minutes.

q_20741.question: When should the HSS include S-CSCF Restoration Information in the response message, instead of the Associated-Registered-Identities AVP?
q_20741.ground_truth: The HSS should include S-CSCF Restoration Information in the response message if it returns all the S-CSCF Restoration Information in the response, then the S-CSCF can ignore the Associated-Registered-Identities AVP and skip additional server-assignment-request since the information is already made available.

q_20742.question: What is the role of the Content Provider (CP) in the first use-case described in the document?
q_20742.ground_truth: The Content Provider in the first use-case is responsible for offering multiple camera angles of a sports match into stadiums. They negotiate service-related aspects like broadcast areas, times, and media quality with the network operator and use APIs or a self-service GUI for session and content provisioning.

q_20743.question: What is the expected client behavior when a new server location is available in Use Case E?
q_20743.ground_truth: Clients are expected to probe the new server location and when observing better download experience, they are expected to use this new server location and move away from the old one.

q_20744.question: What is required for the solution in 6.15.1.2 to enable message reply from Non-3GPP UE to MSGin5G UE?
q_20744.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP Message Gateway needs to be aware of the Non-3GPP message client on the Non-3GPP UE and provide the mapping to MSGin5G service ID. The Non-3GPP UE must also be registered with the MSGin5G server, and it should not impact the current Non-3GPP Message Service procedure.

q_20745.question: What is the role of the MGW-Id in the network?
q_20745.ground_truth: The MGW-Id is information sent on the Nc interface to aid Media Gateway selection by the succeeding/preceding node. It is bearer independent and can be translated into a signalling address towards the appropriate MGW.

q_20746.question: Which value in MBMS-E-RAB-QoS-Parameters indicates preemption?
q_20746.ground_truth: Preemption is indicated by 7 in the MBMS-E-RAB-QoS-Parameters ProtocolIE.

q_20747.question: What is the input format for the speech encoder in the GSM system?
q_20747.ground_truth: The input for the speech encoder in the GSM system is a 13-bit uniform Pulse Code Modulated (PCM) signal.

q_20748.question: When constructing an UpdateGprsLocation-Arg message, under what condition should the 'add-info' parameter be present?
q_20748.ground_truth: The 'add-info' parameter should be present if a Terminal-Information AVP was present in the received NOR.

q_20749.question: What is the procedure for inter-system redirection to EPS without N26 interface if the UE supports a specific flag for PDN connectivity request during the attach procedure?
q_20749.ground_truth: The UE initiates the Attach with PDN connectivity request with request type "handover" if interworking without N26 is supported.

q_20750.question: What are the two RPS lists introduced in HEVC version 2 for inter-layer reference pictures?

q_20751.question: What is the purpose of the "permitted algorithms octet" in the "Encryption Information" element?
q_20751.ground_truth: The "permitted algorithms octet" in the "Encryption Information" element is a bit map that indicates the allowed encryption algorithms or no encryption for controlling any encryption equipment at the BSS.

q_20752.question: What kind of communication can take place within an Isolated E-UTRAN, in terms of quality and services provided to users?
q_20752.ground_truth: Voice, data and group communications, compatible with the service principles, are supported within the Isolated E-UTRAN, but there are no quality of service expectations for user plane data.

q_20753.question: In the COMMON MEASUREMENT REPORTING procedure, if the Common Measurement Type IE is set to "UTRAN GANSS Timing of Cell Frames for UE Positioning", in the TUTRAN-GANSS Measurement Threshold Information scenario, when the Predicted TUTRAN-GANSS Deviation Limit IE is included, under what condition the Node B shall initiate the Common Measurement Reporting procedure and set n equal to zero?
q_20753.ground_truth: When the absolute value of Fn rises above the threshold indicated by the Predicted TUTRAN-GANSS Deviation Limit IE.

q_20754.question: What should a location measurement unit (LMU) do when it receives unknown or out of sequence information elements (IEs) that are not marked as "comprehension required" in a message?
q_20754.ground_truth: The LMU should ignore these unknown or out of sequence IEs.

q_20755.question: What are the two power saving features used in PEO?
q_20755.ground_truth: The two power saving features used in PEO are extended Discontinuous Reception (eDRX) and Power Saving Mode (PSM).

q_20756.question: In which situation would a collision of activation requests for Service 3 (UUS3) occur?
q_20756.ground_truth: A collision of activation requests for Service 3 (UUS3) occurs when there is an outstanding request for service 3 and a subsequent request is received from the remote user.

q_20757.question: What new stage 2 features were added in Release 17 for attestation and verification of MPS authorization?
q_20757.ground_truth: New stage 1 requirements were added for the attestation and verification of MPS authorization in Release 17.

q_20758.question: What does the term "EIRP" stand for in the regional requirement notation?
q_20758.ground_truth: EIRP stands for Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power.

q_20759.question: When should an MS that is in CS/PS mode of operation perform the Combined RA / LA Update procedures during a periodic RA update?
q_20759.ground_truth: When the network operates in mode~I and the MS is engaged in a CS connection.

q_20760.question: What requirements does CCBS place on the Location Update procedure when the MS is monitored?
q_20760.ground_truth: CCBS places extra requirements on the Location Update procedure in the HLR when the MS is monitored. Refer to clause~6.4 for more details.

q_20761.question: How does the UE handle forced playout constraints policy during playback of a PSS service?
q_20761.ground_truth: The UE identifies SIP INFO messages containing forced playout constraints policy, extracts the policy from the message body, and stores it. During playback, the UE should not issue any RTSP request message that is not supported as indicated in the policy.

q_20762.question: What happens when an emergency attached MS's periodic RA update timer expires in PMM-IDLE state?
q_20762.ground_truth: The MS enters PMM-DETACHED state and remains emergency attached to allow for subsequent emergency services without a need to emergency attach again.

q_20763.question: What is the role of the MAC-d PDU Length field in this structure?
q_20763.ground_truth: The MAC-d PDU Length field in this structure indicates the length of every MAC-d PDU (Protocol Data Unit) in the payload of the HS-DSCH DATA FRAME in number of bits. The value range is from 0 to 5000.

q_20764.question: What procedure is followed by the ProSe UE-to-NW Relay and Remote UE in steps 1-4 of solution 6 for Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay?
q_20764.ground_truth: ProSe UE-to-NW Relay and Remote UE follow the procedures described in steps 1-4 in clause 6.6.2 Procedures, of solution 6: Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay, with the below enhancements for N3IWF support.

q_20765.question: How does haptic technology enable new services for telecommunication operators?
q_20765.ground_truth: Haptic technology enables operators to provide new services built upon haptic sense, provide a source of additional revenue, enrich existing services, and develop new services by extending existing ones with haptic sense.

q_20766.question: What does SHVC refer to in the context of 3GPP multimedia services?
q_20766.ground_truth: SHVC stands for Scalable High Efficiency Video Coding, a scalable extension of H.265/HEVC for 3GPP multimedia services that improves coding efficiency by employing inter-layer prediction.

q_20767.question: What does the Information Service (IS) part of the CSIRP define in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_20767.ground_truth: The Information Service (IS) part of the CSIRP defines the semantics of the information and the interactions visible across the interface (Itf-N) between the managing system and the managed system. It specifies the information by means of Information Object Classes (IOCs) and the interactions by means of operations and notifications.

q_20768.question: What are the parameters in location estimate in LCS Authorisation Request?
q_20768.ground_truth: Location estimate may contain the same information as the LCS Identity request, i.e. the pseudonym of the target UE, if needed, Type of location, i.e. "current location", "current or last known location" or "initial location", Velocity of the UE, if needed, LCS capability sets of serving nodes, if needed, and Location estimate, if needed and available.

q_20769.question: What is the functionality of volume based charging for VoLTE services in P-GW?
q_20769.ground_truth: The P-GW collects charging information for VoLTE service through FBC which is applicable to VoLTE service data flows. This functionality is supported by the P-GW, with PGW-CDR keeping a record of offline charging data.

q_20770.question: What is the role of the SNSM-STATUS.request primitive in the SNDCP layer?
q_20770.ground_truth: The SNSM-STATUS.request primitive is used by the SNDCP layer to inform the SM sub-layer that the SNDCP cannot continue its operation due to errors at the LLC layer or at the SNDCP layer. The Cause parameter in the primitive indicates the cause of the error.

q_20771.question: What is the name of the RNSAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION that contains the HCS-Prio extension in the context of Successful RL-InformationResponse-RL-AdditionFailureFDD?

q_20772.question: How many dB link budget gain is shown for sub-PRB transmission with multi-slot aggregation in source R1-2008874?
q_20772.ground_truth: Around 0.8 dB link budget gain is shown for sub-PRB transmission with multi-slot aggregation in source R1-2008874.

q_20773.question: What are the two methods for the 3GPP network to support the delivery of IMS VoIP and IMS VoIP supplementary services to the LEMF for LI purposes?
q_20773.ground_truth: Intercepted IMS VoIP communications (e.g. IRI or IRI/CC) are delivered separately from other IMS services; Intercepted IMS VoIP communications are delivered as part of all other services.

q_20774.question: What was the order of degradation of a MNRU at 30 dB S/N compared to the original speech sample in the AMR codec mode tests?
q_20774.ground_truth: The order of degradation was not as bad as a being qualified as 'Slightly worse' in the 7-point CMOS scale.

q_20775.question: What organization is responsible for defining SCTE-104 and SMPTE ST 2110-41?
q_20775.ground_truth: SMPTE (Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers)

q_20776.question: What information should be included in the I1 Invite message when the ICS UE wants to add I1 control to an ongoing call?
q_20776.ground_truth: The I1 Invite message should include a Reason field set to hex "002" to indicate that augmentation is requested.

q_20777.question: What indicates the mapping of the MPRACH on a particular PDCH?
q_20777.ground_truth: The network indicates the value of the USF associated with the MPRACH on a particular PDCH in the notification message.

q_20778.question: What is one solution for the MBMS use case from a video coding point of view for premium and normal video services?
q_20778.ground_truth: HEVC simulcast, where two independently encoded HEVC bitstreams representing the same video content, but with different spatial resolutions, are transmitted.

q_20779.question: What is the result of TERMINAL RESPONSE for sequence 1.3, step 4, in which the TIMER MANAGEMENT command is used with the qualifier "deactivate the Timer"?
q_20779.ground_truth: The timer is deactivated and the corresponding value is implied to be less than the value specified before deactivation.

q_20780.question: What is done when the PoR is sent using SMS-DELIVER-REPORT but the Response Packet is larger than a single SMS-DELIVER-REPORT TP element?
q_20780.ground_truth: When the PoR is sent using SMS-DELIVER-REPORT but the Response Packet is too large, a single Response Packet is sent as SMS-DELIVER-REPORT with no additional data and immediate resubmission in a complete SMS-SUBMIT packet.

q_20781.question: What are the two methods of key transfer supported by GBA-Push?
q_20781.ground_truth: The two methods of key transfer supported by GBA-Push are Pull and Push.

q_20782.question: What is the purpose of UL DRX/DRX at the Node B?
q_20782.ground_truth: The purpose of UL DRX/DRX at the Node B is to save resources (e.g. processing) by restricting on the MAC level the starting points of new UL data transmissions (after inactivity) of a UE. This allows UL EDCH transmissions to fall together with UL DPCCH bursts.

q_20783.question: What are the possible values of "burstType"?
q_20783.ground_truth: The possible values of "burstType" are Type1 and Type3, which are defined in 3GPP TS 33.220.

q_20784.question: What should the IWF include in the Contact header field when sending a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response as the non-controlling role of a 3GPP MCPTT group?
q_20784.ground_truth: The IWF should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Contact header field.

q_20785.question: What procedure does the SCC AS follow when adding new PS media to an existing IMS session with CS media and Gm Service Control?
q_20785.ground_truth: The SCC AS initiates a new session using the Gm reference point with ICS capabilities, establishing the Gm Service Control Signalling Path together with the media addition.

q_20786.question: What is the expected response when roam is set to No?
q_20786.ground_truth: When roam is set to No, it is expected that the call will not be roaming.

q_20787.question: What is a security requirement for ProSe open discovery for mitigating replay and impersonation attacks?
q_20787.ground_truth: The system shall support a method to mitigate the replay and impersonation attacks for ProSe open discovery.

q_20788.question: What action should the V-PCRF take if it receives a CCR command for IP-CAN session establishment with the NBIFOM-Support AVP and NBIFOM-Mode AVP from the PCEF, and the H-PCRF supports NBIFOM feature?
q_20788.ground_truth: The V-PCRF shall forward the NBIFOM-Support AVP, NBIFOM-Mode AVP and RAN-Rule-Support AVP (if applicable) received from the H-PCRF to the PCEF.

q_20789.question: What is the overall length of the IE when the optional Extended RNC-ID is not included?
q_20789.ground_truth: The overall length of the IE is 11 octets when the optional Extended RNC-ID is not included.

q_20790.question: What does CTFC stand for and what is its purpose in FLO mode?
q_20790.ground_truth: CTFC stands for Calculated Transport Format Combination. It is used to signal the transport format combination set, with every possible transport format combination being uniquely identified by one CTFC.

q_20791.question: What is the purpose of the Accumulated Call Meter (ACM)?
q_20791.ground_truth: The Accumulated Call Meter (ACM) accumulates the total units for both the current call and all preceding calls. It is essential for certain applications, and if the ACM is equal to or greater than the value of ACMmax, then all calls in progress, chargeable to the user, shall be terminated by the ME once the chargeable interval determined by the CAI has elapsed.

q_20792.question: What is rebuffering defined as in the context of media streaming?
q_20792.ground_truth: Rebuffering is defined as any stall in playback time due to any involuntary event at the client side in media streaming.

q_20793.question: What steps does the MS take if sequencing has been activated for the PTC, and it receives a GA-RRC PDU message from the GANC using the PTC?
q_20793.ground_truth: The MS shall increment the expected downlink GA-RRC PDU sequence number for each GA-RRC PDU message received from the GANC using the PTC.

q_20794.question: What action will the SGSN take if it receives an MS Info Change Notification Response with a Cause value of "IMSI/IMEI not known"?
q_20794.ground_truth: The SGSN will stop the MS Info Change Reporting mechanism for all PDP Contexts associated with the IMSI (or the IMEI if the MS is emergency attached and the MS is UICCless or the IMSI is not authenticated) received and the GGSN from which the response was received, and then delete and release all associated resources.

q_20795.question: How are tail bits used in the Turbo code internal interleaver to terminate the constituent encoders?
q_20795.ground_truth: The first three tail bits are used to terminate the first constituent encoder, while the second constituent encoder is disabled. The last three tail bits are used to terminate the second constituent encoder, while the first constituent encoder is disabled.
