q_22051.question: What should the UE do if the reportType is set to eventTriggered and if the entry condition for this event is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells for all measurements in 8.1.3.1.5.2?
q_22051.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure.

q_22052.question: What must the DRNS do if the E-TFCS Information IE in the E-DPCH Information IE contains the E-DCH Minimum Set E-TFCI Validity Indicator IE in FDD?
q_22052.ground_truth: The DRNS must ignore the value in E-DCH Minimum Set E-TFCI IE.

q_22053.question: What is the change in the lower tolerance limit for the maximum output power requirement when it is relaxed?
q_22053.ground_truth: The lower tolerance limit is reduced by 1.5 dB when the maximum output power requirement is relaxed.

q_22054.question: What is a motivation and driver for the development of an AIPN?
q_22054.ground_truth: A motivation and driver for the development of an AIPN is that the technical and commercial evolution of the mobile communications industry points towards an AIPN, which provides the ability to offer enhanced and flexible mobile services, quickly and cost-effectively.

q_22055.question: What is the purpose of the "related-icid" header field parameter in the 200 (OK) response?
q_22055.ground_truth: The "related-icid" header field parameter in the 200 (OK) response contains the "icid-value" header fields parameter used in the original call and can be used for charging correlation of generated CDR records in the visited network A (i.e. "visited-a").

q_22056.question: What is the intended use of the network deployment described in Scenario One - S6a/S6d Pre Rel8 Gr interworking scenario with one IWF?
q_22056.ground_truth: The intended use of the network deployment described in Scenario One is to allow users of a Pre Rel8 UMTS/GPRS network to access a visited EPS with only E-UTRAN. The Pre Rel8 HLR will be upgraded to support Rel-8 EPS security and Pre Rel8 Gr will be upgraded to support transfer of Rel-8 security parameters.

q_22057.question: What is the format of the nonCriticalExtensions field in the ApplicationLayerMeasurementReporting-r15 sequence?
q_22057.ground_truth: The nonCriticalExtensions field in the ApplicationLayerMeasurementReporting-r15 sequence is a SEQUENCE that contains no elements and is optional.

q_22058.question: What is the action taken by the RNC if the requested Information Type in the Information Exchange Initiation procedure indicates an unsupported type of information?
q_22058.ground_truth: The RNC will reject the Information Exchange Initiation procedure.

q_22059.question: What does the SymbolMod function do with the given input arguments?
q_22059.ground_truth: The SymbolMod function generates a modulated output sequence (mPulse) based on the modulator struct (ms) and a symbol index (symbol).

q_22060.question: How does the FLUS source determine when to apply rate adaptation techniques?
q_22060.ground_truth: The FLUS source starts rate adaptation when the reception buffer on the FLUS sink can no longer compensate for link bitrate variations.

q_22061.question: What should the NAF do if the received message has an invalid Bootstrapping Transaction Identifier (B-TID)?
q_22061.ground_truth: In this case, the NAF should request the UE to bootstrap again.

q_22062.question: What measurement provides the number of attempted outgoing handovers when DRX is used?

q_22063.question: What is the purpose of the Sx management procedures?
q_22063.ground_truth: The Sx management procedures are used by the CP function to manage the UP function independent of any Sx session, allowing tasks such as provisioning, modifying, or terminating PFD sets belonging to an Application ID.

q_22064.question: What value shall be used for the local MUX UDP port, if multiplexing is applied with RTP header compression?
q_22064.ground_truth: The local MUX UDP port value shall be the same as the local MUX UDP port divided by two.

q_22065.question: What is the method used for quantizing the bass post-filter gain in speech coding?
q_22065.ground_truth: At 16.4 and 24.4 kbps, the bass post-filter gain is quantized on 2 bits by first reconstructing the signal as defined in subclause 6.1.3. The bass post-filter is then applied and the enhancement signal is computed. The residual signal is low pass filtered in time domain by a convolution with the impulse response. The optimal gain adjustment is computed and quantized on 2 bits. The quantization is adjusted in case the delta SNR provided by the estimated gain is detected as positive.

q_22066.question: What must an MS (Mobile Station) in eCall only mode do if it cannot select any PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) to register to?
q_22066.ground_truth: The MS will indicate "no service" to the user, wait until a new PLMN is available and allowable, and then repeat the procedure.

q_22067.question: When should the "Required" header field be used in RTSP requests?
q_22067.ground_truth: The "Required" header field is used to ensure that a certain feature is supported by the PSS server, causing the request to fail with a 551 reply code and "Option not supported" as the reason if the feature is not supported.

q_22068.question: What is the role of the 64-ary orthogonal modulation used in mapping information bits onto the E-RUCCH?
q_22068.ground_truth: The 64-ary orthogonal modulation is used to modulate the data onto the E-RUCCH, which allows for more efficient use of the radio frequency spectrum and higher data rates.

q_22069.question: How many access technology types can a mobile station indicate during a GPRS TBF establishment?
q_22069.ground_truth: As many as possible of its supported Access Technology Types, depending on the remaining bits left in the RLC/MAC message.

q_22070.question: What information is requested in the announce authorization procedure for restricted ProSe direct discovery (Model A)?
q_22070.ground_truth: The announce authorization procedure for restricted ProSe direct discovery (Model A) is used to request the mapping of the UE's Restricted ProSe Application User ID (RPAUID) to the corresponding ProSe Discovery UE ID(s) (PDUID(s)) from the ProSe Application Server.

q_22071.question: Which message is sent by the GANC to the Core Network to indicate that the mobile station has responded with a GAN-RR PAGING RESPONSE?

q_22072.question: What should the network do when timer T3169 expires for the TBF?
q_22072.ground_truth: The network may reuse the TFI and USF resources. If EMST is used for the TBF, the USF resources may be reused only once the TBF is released, i.e. the last RLC entity allocated on the uplink TBF is released.

q_22073.question: What is the purpose of studying transport security for the MSGin5G interfaces in the 3GPP document?
q_22073.ground_truth: The purpose of studying transport security for the MSGin5G interfaces in the 3GPP document is to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection for the new interfaces introduced in the MSGin5G service.

q_22074.question: What is the purpose of repetition coding in the field coding of ACK/NACK for HS-SICH type 2?
q_22074.ground_truth: The purpose of repetition coding in the field coding of ACK/NACK for HS-SICH type 2 is to increase the reliability of the ACK/NACK information by repeating the coded bits 36 times for each stream.

q_22075.question: What is the purpose of the "Schedule Messages" in SMSCB DRX?
q_22075.ground_truth: The Schedule Messages provide information about the CB messages that will be sent immediately afterwards, allowing the MS to restrict reception to those messages the customer is interested in receiving.

q_22076.question: What is a Transport Bearer in the context of the 3GPP TS 36.300 document?
q_22076.ground_truth: A Transport Bearer is a service provided by the transport layer and used by the frame protocol for the delivery of Frame Protocol PDU.

q_22077.question: What parameter is used in the adaptive lag window to control the strength of the window?
q_22077.ground_truth: The pitch gain is used in the adaptive lag window to control the strength of the window. A larger pitch gain corresponds to a stronger (heavy smoothing with larger) window, while a smaller pitch gain corresponds to a weaker window (light smoothing with smaller).

q_22078.question: What are the benefits of calculating the final MOS value in the QoE server rather than in the client?
q_22078.ground_truth: Calculating the final MOS value in the QoE server allows for the use of advanced network optimization, flexible MOS windowing, and avoids issues when the MOS model calculation needs to be updated. It also ensures standardized interpretation of DASH QoE metrics and enables evaluation of network delivery performance based on the result A/V MOS for streaming content with different encoding schemes and network bandwidth.

q_22079.question: What are the frequency ranges for measuring the received power in steps a) and b) of the BSS test in 8-3?
q_22079.ground_truth: The frequency range for measuring the received power in step a) of the BSS test in 8-3 is 30 MHz to 12,75 GHz, excluding the BTS relevant transmitter band. The frequency range for measuring the received power in step b) of the BSS test in 8-3 is the same as step a) but including the BTS relevant transmitter band.

q_22080.question: What is the difference between the gross bit rate and average bit rate of encoded bit stream in the VSELP coding?
q_22080.ground_truth: The gross bit rate of encoded bit stream in the VSELP coding is 228 bits, leading to a gross bit rate of 11,4 kbit/s, whereas the average bit rate for the encoded bit stream is 5,6 kbit/s.

q_22081.question: What is the purpose of the parameters (ICS) in the context of the 3GPP TS 38.523-2 technical specification?
q_22081.ground_truth: The parameters (ICS) are used to formally express the applicability of every test case, indicating whether it is recommended, optional, or not applicable based on the capabilities of the UE.

q_22082.question: When is the BM-SC responsible for starting the streaming session for a "Streaming" service type?
q_22082.ground_truth: The BM-SC starts the streaming session when the session state becomes active, for a "Streaming" service type.

q_22083.question: Which solution proposes to enhance SEAL to support device monitoring for FFAPP?

q_22084.question: What signalling is used in the SRVCC Preparation procedure?
q_22084.ground_truth: The SRVCC Preparation procedure uses connection oriented signalling.

q_22085.question: What is one of the design principles for the new RAT's Multimedia Broadcast/Multicast Service?
q_22085.ground_truth: The new RAT should support static and dynamic resource allocation between Multicast/Broadcast and unicast.

q_22086.question: How does the Remote UE send its SRB1 message to the gNB via the Relay UE in L2 UE-to-Network relay?
q_22086.ground_truth: The Remote UE sends its SRB1 message (e.g. an RRCSetupComplete message) to the gNB via the Relay UE using SRB1 relaying channel over PC5. Then the Remote UE is RRC connected over Uu.

q_22087.question: What is the unique identifier of the MBMS service used by the UE to select the target application?
q_22087.ground_truth: The serviceId element in the download header fragment

q_22088.question: What is the main difference between unconstrained, constant, and constrained variable rate coding in terms of buffer size and playout curve?
q_22088.ground_truth: Unconstrained variable rate coding requires a large buffer size and has a varying playout curve, while constant rate coding requires a smaller buffer size with a constant playout curve, and constrained variable rate coding requires a moderate buffer size with a slightly varying playout curve.

q_22089.question: How are the MDCT coefficients divided for the computation of the frequency sharpness in this process?
q_22089.ground_truth: The 288 MDCT coefficients in the 6400-13600 Hz frequency range are split into nine sharpness bands, with 32 coefficients per band.

q_22090.question: What is the role of the hysteresis parameter (Hys) in the A5-1 and A5-2 inequalities?
q_22090.ground_truth: The hysteresis parameter (Hys) is used to determine the cell triggering conditions for A5-1 and A5-2 by comparing the measurement results (Mp, Mn) with the hysteresis parameter and threshold parameters (Thresh1, Thresh2).

q_22091.question: What does the SIP cause code "0" indicate in a successful session termination?
q_22091.ground_truth: The cause "Normal end of session" indicates that an ongoing SIP session has been normally released either by the user or by the network.

q_22092.question: What is the function of the "Last RFCI Indicator" field in the error handling procedure?
q_22092.ground_truth: The "Last RFCI Indicator" field is used to indicate which is the last RFCI in the current INITIALISATION control frame, allowing for the detection of a spare extension field.

q_22093.question: What should the UE do when it receives a NSSAI DELETE REQUEST message with Delete NSSAI type equal to 10, access type equal to 01 and octets 3, 4, and 5 not set to "00000000"?
q_22093.ground_truth: The UE should delete allowed NSSAI associated with non-3GPP access for the PLMN indicated by octets 3, 4, and 5 stored at the UE if any.

q_22094.question: What should the UE do if it receives a Network Slice-Specific Authentication Command message while in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state?
q_22094.ground_truth: If the UE receives a Network Slice-Specific Authentication Command message while in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state, it should ignore the message and proceed with the de-registration procedure.

q_22095.question: What message does the new 3G-SGSN send to the old 2G-SGSN to get the MM and PDP contexts for the MS?

q_22096.question: What is the effect of timer F firing while the session is in the "progressing" or "alerting" state?
q_22096.ground_truth: Session establishment has failed and the SCC AS or UE clears the session.

q_22097.question: What is the requirement for the response time in the PRS-RSRP measurement reporting delay test case for single positioning frequency with reduced number of samples in FR2 SA?
q_22097.ground_truth: The response time in this test case should be equal to the LPP time IE value plus the test tolerance, where the LPP time IE value is derived from the PRS-RSRP measurement period plus T, and ranges between 11s and 84s. The test tolerance for the response time is 300ms, resulting in a total response time range of 11.3s and 84.3s.

q_22098.question: What does the IP-SM-GW create when it interrogates the HSS to retrieve routing information in the service-level interworking process between an SMS user and a CPM capable UE?
q_22098.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW creates a MT Correlation ID.

q_22099.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group's work on the Cellular Text Telephone Modem?
q_22099.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide a reliable transmission of text telephone text via the speech channel of cellular networks using the signals and character set of the Baudot type.

q_22100.question: What is the difference between S5-AV1-01 and S5-AV1-02 in terms of frame encoding?
q_22100.ground_truth: S5-AV1-01 encodes frames with no fixed random access, while S5-AV1-02 encodes frames with fixed random access every second.

q_22101.question: What is the definition of "transient phenomena" as per IEC 60050-161?
q_22101.ground_truth: Transient phenomena pertains to or designates a phenomenon or a quantity that varies between two consecutive steady states during a time interval short compared with the time-scale of interest.

q_22102.question: Which sources achieved sub-meter level horizontal positioning accuracy in the InF-SH scenario (Scenario 1) without synchronization and gNB/UE TX/RX timing errors?
q_22102.ground_truth: The horizontal positioning accuracy of sub-meter level @ 90% was achieved by Rel.16 solutions from 13 sources in FR1 and 9 sources in FR2 for the InF-SH scenario.

q_22103.question: What action should the IWF perform upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request with an imminent peril indication and the in-progress emergency state of the group already set to "true"?
q_22103.ground_truth: The IWF should generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the MCPTT user's imminent peril indication and send it to the other affiliated members of the group.

q_22104.question: Which abbreviations are commonly used in the performance measurements of UTRAN?
q_22104.ground_truth: Multiple abbreviations are used, such as AOA, ASN.1, BER, BLER, CN, CS, DT, etc. Each of these abbreviations refers to specific parameters or components within UTRAN measurement, allowing for precise communication when discussing the various performance measurement components.

q_22105.question: What is the percentage increase in mean capacity performance when bandwidth is increased from 100MHz to 400MHz for FR2, Dense Urban, DL, AR/VR (45 Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60FPS), DDDUU TDD format based on Source 16?
q_22105.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is increased by about 560%.

q_22106.question: What is the definition of closed loop power control in the Uplink?
q_22106.ground_truth: Closed loop power control in the Uplink is the ability of the UE transmitter to adjust its output power in accordance with one or more TPC commands received in the downlink.

q_22107.question: What does the term "absolute position" refer to in the context of the document?
q_22107.ground_truth: Absolute position is an estimate of the UE (User Equipment) position in 2D/3D geographic coordinates (e.g., latitude, longitude, elevation) within a coordinate system.

q_22108.question: What is the purpose of applying K=9 convolutional coding fully to the input sequence in step 4.6D.6, 4.6D.7, and 4.6D.8 of the sequence of bits z1,1, z1,2, ..., z1,48, and in step 4.7.6, 4.7.7.1, and 4.7.7.2 of the sequence of bits z2,1, z2,2, ..., z2,132?
q_22108.ground_truth: The purpose of applying K=9 convolutional coding fully to the input sequence in step 4.6D.6, 4.6D.7, and 4.6D.8 of the sequence of bits z1,1, z1,2, ..., z1,48, and in step 4.7.6, 4.7.7.1, and 4.7.7.2 of the sequence of bits z2,1, z2,2, ..., z2,132 is to ensure the coded sequence lengths are consistent with the termination of K=9 convolutional coding being fully applied. This is a common convention in source coding, and it allows for efficient decoding of the output sequence as the length of the input sequence may exceed the maximum length allowed by the convolutional coding scheme.

q_22109.question: What is the purpose of Performance Management in the context of 3G systems?
q_22109.ground_truth: The purpose of Performance Management in the context of 3G systems is to collect performance related data, which can be used to locate potential problems in the network.

q_22110.question: What are two primary factors MUROS techniques should consider carefully in order to increase capacity?
q_22110.ground_truth: MUROS techniques should consider the balance between low frequency reuse and high time slot reuse, as well as properly handle potential increases in co-channel and adjacent channel interference, which can lead to a decrease in C/I and frequency reuse.

q_22111.question: What is the role of the Uplink State Flag (USF) in GPRS?
q_22111.ground_truth: The USF is used in the uplink direction to allow multiplexing of radio blocks from a number of MSs on a PDCH. The USF values are used to reserve the uplink for different MSs in dynamic and extended dynamic medium access modes.

q_22112.question: What is the recommended minimum requirement for modulation accuracy to ensure sufficient receiver performance and limit extra noise power in a WCDMA uplink?
q_22112.ground_truth: A value of 17.5% is recommended for the minimum requirement for WCDMA uplink modulation accuracy.

q_22113.question: What should the receiving side of an AM RLC entity do when it receives an AMD PDU where the SN (sequence number) is not within the receiving window or has been received before?
q_22113.ground_truth: The receiving side of an AM RLC entity should discard the received AMD PDU if the SN falls outside of the receiving window or if the byte segment numbers of the RLC SDU with SN = x have been received before.

q_22114.question: What should the tBSS do if the oBSS Node ID in the GCR is the same as its own BSS Node ID in 4.3.3.3?
q_22114.ground_truth: The tBSS should perform call leg correlation.

q_22115.question: What is one of the advantages of using multiple links to PLMN(s) and NPN(s) for uplink video stream transmission?
q_22115.ground_truth: It increases video quality and time duration during which the uplink video stream could be transmitted with required QoS in case of mobile cameras.

q_22116.question: What should a mobile station consider as irrelevant when determining whether a consistent set of system information messages has been received?
q_22116.ground_truth: A mobile station should consider message types PSI3quater, PSI6, PSI7, SI 18, and SI 20 as irrelevant if it lacks all non-GSM capabilities defined for these message types.

q_22117.question: What is the information content in the FACILITY message sent in the FACILITY message sent in clause 1.1?
q_22117.ground_truth: The FACILITY message sent in clause 1.1 includes the Facility information element with an invoke of the Notification operation indicating that the call is waiting.

q_22118.question: How can an attacker enforce unciphered communication between a user equipment (UE) and a false BS in a GSM/GPRS network?
q_22118.ground_truth: By not sending a Cipher Mode command or setting the algorithm to A5/0 or GEA0

q_22119.question: What is the function of the short-term post-filter in the shaping of the excitation signal?
q_22119.ground_truth: The short-term post-filter is applied to the synthesized high band signal to obtain a short-term post-filtered signal, which shapes the spectral envelope of the synthesized high frequency band signal to be closer to the shape of the spectral envelope of the high-frequency band signal.

q_22120.question: What should a UE in idle mode do if the IE "Used paging identity" in a PAGING TYPE 1 message is a CN identity that matches with one of its allocated CN UE identities?
q_22120.ground_truth: The UE should indicate reception of paging and forward the IE "CN domain identity", the IE "UE identity" and the IE "Paging cause" to the upper layers.

q_22121.question: What information shall the eP-CSCF (IMS-ALG) provide to the eIMS-AGW in the SDP answer if application aware handling of the contents within the data channel is required?
q_22121.ground_truth: The information received in SDP "a=dcsa" attributes as "remote dcsa" information elements, taking into account specific procedures defined for the subprotocols within the data channel.

q_22122.question: What action does the 5GC take in Step 6 to prompt the UE to setup the new PDU session with slice 11?
q_22122.ground_truth: The 5GC triggers towards the UE the NAS PDU Session Modification Command to invoke SSC mode 3, and includes (end slice 10, new 11) towards the UE to prompt the setup of the new PDU session 2 with slice 11.

q_22123.question: What is the difference between Alternative 1 and Alternative 2 in Step 6?
q_22123.ground_truth: In Alternative 1, the UE-to-Network relay's AMF adds the decrypted Relay Service Code and the encrypted and integrity protected new Relay Service Code alias and User Info ID to the NAS Relay Authorization Response/Key Response message. In Alternative 2, the UE-to-Network relay's AMF adds the PDU session parameters for the requested Relay Service Code and the encrypted and integrity protected new Relay Service Code alias and User Info ID to the NAS Relay Authorization Response/Key Response message.

q_22124.question: What is used to specify which of the Service announcement modes are to be used to advertise the MBS User Service?
q_22124.ground_truth: The MBS Application Provider provisions the parameters of a new MBS User Service by invoking the Nmbsf service, specifying which of the Service announcement modes are to be used.

q_22125.question: What will the IWF include in the SIP 403 (Forbidden) response if it receives an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency call?
q_22125.ground_truth: The IWF will include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and set the <emergency-ind> to "true".

q_22126.question: What is the structure of the RL-InformationResponseItem-RL-SetupRspFDD sequence?
q_22126.ground_truth: The RL-InformationResponseItem-RL-SetupRspFDD sequence is a SEQUENCE containing the following elements: rL-ID, rL-Set-ID, uRA-Information, SAI, gA-Cell, gA-AccessPointPosition, received-total-wide-band-power, not-Used-secondary-CCPCH-Info, dl-CodeInformation, diversityIndication, sSDT-SupportIndicator, maxUL-SIR, minUL-SIR, closedlooptiming adjustment mode, maximumAllowedULTxPower, maximumDLTxPower, minimumDLTxPower, primaryScramblingCode, uL-UARFCN, dL-UARFCN, primaryCPICH-Power, not-Used-dSCHInformation, neighbouring-UMTS-CellInformation, neighbouring-GSM-CellInformation, pC-Preamble, sRB-Delay, and iE-Extensions.

q_22127.question: What does the term "transport channel" (TrCH) mean in the 3GPP TS?
q_22127.ground_truth: A transport channel (TrCH) is a logical channel in the 3GPP TS that is used to transmit user data and control information. It represents the protocol structure used for the physical transport of data over the radio interface.

q_22128.question: Who is the main character in the movie "The Terminal"?

q_22129.question: What is the purpose of the USAT proactive capability in the UICC?
q_22129.ground_truth: The USAT proactive capability in the UICC allows for an interactive dialogue with the ME by issuing proactive commands, establishing and maintaining an interactive dialogue with the user and/or communicating with the network or an external device.

q_22130.question: What action is taken after entering an incorrect PIN2 three times in sequence A?
q_22130.ground_truth: The Terminal indicates that the PIN2 has been blocked.

q_22131.question: What service does the application service provider (ASP) provide in Use Case #6 and what capabilities does the network operator provide?
q_22131.ground_truth: The ASP provides a service for 5G CIoT UEs while the network operator provides 5GS access service with 5GS CIoT features in Use Case #6.

q_22132.question: What should be the value of "Inter-frequency cell indication- SIB12" if "System Information Block Type 12" is not being broadcast?
q_22132.ground_truth: The value of "Inter-frequency cell indication- SIB12" can be set to any value.

q_22133.question: What is the response to the Prepare-Handover request in its AN-APDU parameter, identifying the GSM-08.06 protocol?
q_22133.ground_truth: The response to the Prepare-Handover request can include in its AN-APDU parameter, identifying the GSM-08.06 protocol, either a BSSMAP QUEUING INDICATION, or a BSSMAP HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE or a BSSMAP HANDOVER FAILURE.

q_22134.question: What is the expected RSTD value for Test 1?
q_22134.ground_truth: The expected RSTD value for Test 1 is -92 Ts (about -3 s).

q_22135.question: What is the effect of invocation of call waiting on the radio path?
q_22135.ground_truth: Invocation of call waiting causes no signaling on the radio path.

q_22136.question: What does the SMF generate based on its decision regarding multicast service data transfer?
q_22136.ground_truth: The SMF generates the PDR (Paul Downward Requirement) and FAR (Forwarding Action Requirement) to the UPF based on its decision regarding multicast service data transfer.

q_22137.question: What is the significance of MSD analysis in DC?
q_22137.ground_truth: MSD analysis is important in DC because it is used to ensure that adequate isolation is achieved between uplink and downlink transmissions in a multiple carrier system. This helps avoid interference and excessive interference, which can negatively impact the performance of the network and other network components.

q_22138.question: What command is indicated by the Command-Code field set to 8388675 and the "R" bit cleared in the Command Flags field?

q_22139.question: What does the Location Retrieval Function (LRF) do in LCS support and how is it related to the GMLC?
q_22139.ground_truth: The Location Retrieval Function (LRF) is responsible for retrieving or validating location information, providing routing and/or correlation info of an UE that has initiated an IMS emergency session. It may be collocated with the GMLC or separate, and it provides the location information to the E-CSCF via the Ml interface.

q_22140.question: What is the role of the SMF during local PSA insertion in 6.34.2.1?
q_22140.ground_truth: The SMF selects the local PSA-UPF1, establishes a N4 session with ULCL UPF and local PSA-UPF1, and sends the uplink classifier information (IP 3-tuple) to the ULCL UPF. The SMF also sends the local DN information to the UE, which includes an indication of the addition of a local DN, the identifier of the local DN, IP address range of the local DN, local DNS address, domain name for the local DN, and uplink classifier information (IP 3-tuple) sent to the ULCL UPF.

q_22141.question: What does the V field in the PHR MAC CE represent in relation to the PH value?
q_22141.ground_truth: The V field in the PHR MAC CE indicates whether the PH value is based on a real transmission or a reference format.

q_22142.question: How many HS-DSCH cells can be active when using Eight Carrier HSDPA operation if the maximum number of MAC-ehs PDUs per TTI is 16?

q_22143.question: What is the procedure for the IP realm indication in the TrGW?
q_22143.ground_truth: The TrGW assigns the IP termination in the IP realm indicated whenever requesting a new IP media-path

q_22144.question: What is the initial value of the scrambling sequence generator for PUSCH transmissions using sub-PRB allocations in BL/CE UEs?
q_22144.ground_truth: The scrambling sequence generator is initialized with CSI-RS scrambling sequence at the first valid uplink subframe of every subframe comprising the allocated UL resource unit(s).

q_22145.question: In GPS scenario #1, what should be the initial carrier phase difference between taps of the multi-path model?
q_22145.ground_truth: The initial carrier phase difference between taps of the multi-path model should be randomly selected between 0 and 2 radians.

q_22146.question: What is the purpose of the "genericIRPVersionOperations Interface" in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
q_22146.ground_truth: The "genericIRPVersionOperations Interface" allows an IRPManager to find out the IRP SS versions supported by an IRP. The IRP shall respond with a set of supported IRP SS version(s), and the list of returned IRPVersions is such that the IRPManager can use any of these versions without having to specify an IRPVersion to the IRPAgent.

q_22147.question: What indicator indicates whether the STTD can be applied to DL DPCH and F-DPCH in the cell or not?

q_22148.question: What is the function of AMF in 5GS in the context of Session Join procedure for multicast sessions?
q_22148.ground_truth: The AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) in 5GS is responsible for the Session Join procedure for multicast sessions. During the Session Join procedure, the AMF receives the LL MC and Source host addresses of MB-UPF so that the PSA-UPF can join the multicast tree of MB-UPF and receive MBS session data from MB-UPF.

q_22149.question: What must a RELOCATION REQUEST message contain in order for the RNC to associate a permanent identity to the RRC Connection of a user?
q_22149.ground_truth: The RELOCATION REQUEST message must include the Permanent NAS UE identity (i.e. IMSI) for the RNC to associate the permanent identity to the RRC Connection of a user.

q_22150.question: What is the condition for an MCPTT group information entry to have the "affiliating" affiliation status in the first scenario?
q_22150.ground_truth: The MCPTT group information entry has the "affiliating" affiliation status, the MCPTT group ID is set to the handled MCPTT group ID, and the expiration time has not expired yet.

q_22151.question: What is the purpose of calculating the OACS (Optimal Adaptive Multi-Rate Codec Set) in AMR-NB TFO decision?
q_22151.ground_truth: The purpose of calculating the OACS is to enable immediate TFO (Turbo-coded, Frame-based, and Adaptive Multi-Rate coding for Narrow Band speech) between 3G channels and 2G FR and 2G HR channels.

q_22152.question: What kind of information can be included in the vendor extension node?
q_22152.ground_truth: The vendor extension node (Ext) can include vendor-specific information, such as application or device vendor information.

q_22153.question: How can the UE retrieve OMA BCAST Service Guide information from the SSF?
q_22153.ground_truth: The UE can retrieve OMA BCAST Service Guide information from the SSF by sending an HTTP request to the SSF and providing personalized information if needed.

q_22154.question: What is the purpose of the avoidance of spectral holes in the AAC encoder?
q_22154.ground_truth: The avoidance of spectral holes is used to ensure that the scalefactor band energy and spreaded energy do not exceed certain criteria, which ultimately helps to minimize the distortion and preserve the quality of the audio signal.

q_22155.question: What must the Node B include in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message when the capacity credits and consumption laws are shared between several Local Cells?
q_22155.ground_truth: The Local Cell Group ID IE for the Local Cell, and if not already reported, the capacity credits and the consumption laws in the Local Cell Group Information IE.

q_22156.question: What information does the S-CSCF request from the HSS during a normal IMS registration procedure for obtaining the AMF instance ID?
q_22156.ground_truth: The S-CSCF requests the AMF instance ID in the SAR from the HSS/UDM during a normal IMS registration procedure for obtaining the AMF instance ID.

q_22157.question: When a mobile originated location request is requested by upper layers, what action does 5GMM take if the NAS transport procedure is not allowed due to access barring?
q_22157.ground_truth: 5GMM shall not initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in clause~5.4.5 to send an LCS message in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message. Upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, 5GMM may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in clause~5.4.5 to send the LCS message in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message, if still needed.

q_22158.question: What is the difference between the Normal Performance Group and the Reduced Performance Group in UE carrier monitoring?
q_22158.ground_truth: The Normal Performance Group contains inter-frequency carriers or inter-RAT carriers with better delay performance, while the Reduced Performance Group has worse delay performance in UE carrier monitoring.

q_22159.question: What is the hearability problem and how can it be reduced in 3G UMTS network?
q_22159.ground_truth: The hearability problem is a term used to describe a situation in which a UE cannot hear other Node Bs on the same frequency as its serving Node B, making it difficult to calculate the UE's position. It can be reduced by implementing the IPDL method, in which each Node B ceases its transmission for short periods of time (idle periods), allowing terminals within the cell to measure other Node Bs and reducing the hearability problem. This method is based on downlink and can provide location service efficiently to a large number of terminals simultaneously.

q_22160.question: What formatting mode is used for the SEND DATA proactive command in expected sequence 2.1.1?
q_22160.ground_truth: The formatting mode used for the SEND DATA proactive command in expected sequence 2.1.1 is Left Alignment, Normal Font, Bold On, Italic On, Underline Off, Strikethrough Off.

q_22161.question: If the access attempt is considered as barred, what should the UE do if a random number 'rand' is lower than the value indicated by uac-BarringFactor?
q_22161.ground_truth: The UE should consider the access attempt as allowed.

q_22162.question: What is the maximum allowable inter-tone noise reduction in the critical band?
q_22162.ground_truth: The maximum allowable inter-tone noise reduction in the critical band is -1.25 dB.

q_22163.question: What protocol is used to carry speech and data in 3GPP CS CN?
q_22163.ground_truth: The Iu/Nb User Plane Protocol is used to carry speech and data in 3GPP CS CN.

q_22164.question: What are some of the security threats to be addressed in the 5G system?
q_22164.ground_truth: The security threats include eavesdropping on MBS traffic, unauthorized access to MBS services, and compromised devices in a group that may access or inject fake content.

q_22165.question: In what access mode would the MS place an emergency call if a GSM PLMN is available and the operator has indicated an operator preference for emergency calls origination?
q_22165.ground_truth: The MS would switch from GAN mode to 3GPP mode and place the emergency call over GERAN/UTRAN to leverage the location determination infrastructure in GERAN/UTRAN.

q_22166.question: In the SMLC and LCS system, what are the five functions performed by the network layer for message transfer over any interface where network level segmentation is not supported?
q_22166.ground_truth: The five functions are segmentation at the application level, reliable delivery of the message segments, sequenced delivery of the message segments, support for intermediate level segmentation, and support for both network and intermediate level segmentation by certain intermediate entities.

q_22167.question: When is a UICC required to support at least two consecutive voltage classes?
q_22167.ground_truth: When the UICC holds a 3GPP application.

q_22168.question: What action does the UE take upon receipt of a SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and a PDU session ID?
q_22168.ground_truth: The UE passes the service-level-AA payload received in the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message to the upper layers.

q_22169.question: What is the form of the addressing information in the N-CONNECT request primitive for single connections?
q_22169.ground_truth: The addressing information may take the following form in the N-CONNECT request primitive: DPC+SSN (for single connections).

q_22170.question: What is the main difference between Group Member Discovery and UE-to-Network Relay Discovery for Public Safety use?
q_22170.ground_truth: In Group Member Discovery, the announcing UE sends a Group Member Discovery Announcement message, while in UE-to-Network Relay Discovery, the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay sends a UE-to-Network Relay Discovery Announcement message.

q_22171.question: What is the tag value of the Home Network Domain Name TLV data object in EF~DOMAIN?
q_22171.ground_truth: The tag value of the Home Network Domain Name TLV data object in EF~DOMAIN should be '80'.

q_22172.question: When DNS resolution with ECS option is used, what information can the Service Provider use to tailor the DNS response for the UE in the 3GPP network?
q_22172.ground_truth: FAMILY, SOURCE PREFIX-LENGTH, ADDRESS, and SCOPE PREFIX LENGTH

q_22173.question: What is the maximum luma sample size per second that the HEVC-UHD-Enc is capable of encoding?
q_22173.ground_truth: The HEVC-UHD-Enc is capable of encoding a video signal with up to 534,773,760 luma samples per second.

q_22174.question: What action does one remote party (e.g. C) want to perform in order to end the multi-party call in the described scenario?
q_22174.ground_truth: The remote party wants to disconnect.

q_22175.question: What type of connections can be used on the Gb interface in the context of Frame Relay?
q_22175.ground_truth: Point-to-point connections or connections via a Frame Relay network.

q_22176.question: What is the difference between the pre-conditions for Type b and Type c FRMC Equipment registration?
q_22176.ground_truth: Type b FRMC equipment can be registered to a functional identity related to the equipment, while Type c FRMC equipment allows a FRMCS User to login and register to functional identities related to the user.

q_22177.question: What are the two solutions extended in 6.3.3 to describe triggers for location information reporting?
q_22177.ground_truth: Solution #1 and solution #2 are the two additional solutions integrated in 6.3.3 to provide a more comprehensive set of triggers for location information reporting.

q_22178.question: In the user plane paging solution, what is the role of the push notification server?
q_22178.ground_truth: In the user plane paging solution, the push notification server acts as a transparent relay carrying secure notifications towards the IP address of one USIM to the IP address obtained in the PLMN where the other USIM is registered, which becomes the master PLMN for paging notifications.

q_22179.question: What is the limitation on implementing the 3GPP authentication and key agreement functions in the network equipment?
q_22179.ground_truth: The network equipment, including RNC and AuC, may be subject to more stringent restrictions regarding export or use. UE and USIMs, on the other hand, should be free from such restrictions to allow the free circulation of 3G terminals.

q_22180.question: Why would a radio link addition request be rejected if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message does not include the Transport Layer Address IE and the Binding ID IE in the RL Specific E-DCH Information IE in the RL Information IE for the first E-DCH RL if ALCAP is not used?
q_22180.ground_truth: The DRNC will reject the Radio Link Addition procedure and respond with the RADIO LINK ADDITION FAILURE message.

q_22181.question: What is the purpose of the WAP Gateway in WAP network topology?
q_22181.ground_truth: The WAP Gateway acts as a WAP to HTTP/1.1 proxy that translates the WAP request into an HTTP/1.1 request and vice versa.

q_22182.question: What should the IMS-AGW do when it recovers from a failure and registers to its known IMS-ALGs?
q_22182.ground_truth: The IMS-AGW can indicate whether the service has been restored or whether it has restarted with a cold or warm boot.

q_22183.question: What are the general requirements for Delta Synchronization between an IRPManager and an IRP Agent?
q_22183.ground_truth: The general requirements include the data that requires delta synchronization (CM and FM data), scenarios when delta synchronization can be required (such as when the IRPManager recognizes its data may not be up-to-date or during the interruption and re-establishment of Manager-Agent communication), and time aspects (time parameters in the context of delta synchronization refer to the IRPAgent's time).

q_22184.question: What are the properties of the source signal for 4K-TV?
q_22184.ground_truth: The properties of the source signal for 4K-TV include a variety of resolutions, frame rates, and chroma formats, as well as High Dynamic Range (HDR) and Wide Color Gamut (WCG) capabilities.

q_22185.question: What kind of KPI is RRC connection establishment success rate?
q_22185.ground_truth: The type of this KPI is RATIO, and it is used to evaluate UTRAN and RNC or cell admission capacity for UE and/or system load.

q_22186.question: What is the format of the "APN" leaf, as indicated by its format type?
q_22186.ground_truth: The "APN" leaf has a "chr" format type, which means that it contains character string data.

q_22187.question: What is the significance of the "OmcId" element in the BSS INVOKE TRACE message?
q_22187.ground_truth: The "OmcId" element in the BSS INVOKE TRACE message indicates the OMC to which the record is destined, which helps to identify the intended recipient of the trace record.

q_22188.question: What is the function of the NRF in PDU session re-anchoring?
q_22188.ground_truth: The NRF stores the supported DNAI list in the service profile of the I-SMF/SMF.

q_22189.question: What should the Node B do if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the Serving E-DCH RL IE indicating that the Serving E-DCH RL is in this Node B and it includes the E-DCH FDD DL Control Channel Information IE in the E-DCH Serving Cell Change Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message?
q_22189.ground_truth: The Node B should allocate a primary E-RNTI identifier or a secondary E-RNTI identifier or both for the corresponding RL and include these E-RNTI identifiers and the channelisation code of the corresponding E-AGCH in the E-DCH FDD DL Control Channel Information IE in the E-DCH Serving Cell Change Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message.

q_22190.question: What is a reasonable estimate for the lower and higher values of the fetch time (FT) in DASH?
q_22190.ground_truth: A reasonable estimate for the lower value of FT is the time when the request for the new MPD is issued, while the higher value of FT is when the MPD is received.

q_22191.question: In the test case scenario, how does the BSS allocate RF channels to transmitters if they are not designated as dedicated BCCH?
q_22191.ground_truth: The BSS allocates RF channels to transmitters in the following order: first to RF channel B, then to T, and then distributed as evenly as possible throughout the BSS operating transmit band.

q_22192.question: How are noise estimates quantized in the encoding process?
q_22192.ground_truth: The noise estimates are first converted to dB and then normalized. They are quantized using a Multi-Stage Vector Quantizer (MSVQ) with 6 stages, 7 bits in the first stage and 6 bits in the other stages, producing 37 bits in total.

q_22193.question: Who has awareness of network conditions in the Feedback-enabled Control of Uplink Streaming use case?
q_22193.ground_truth: The MNO, either in the role of the SNS provider or the FLUS service provider, has awareness of network conditions such as core network congestion, access network availability, UE location, and downlink distribution technology in the Feedback-enabled Control of Uplink Streaming use case.

q_22194.question: What is the requirement for the E-UTRA donor cell in NB-IOT inband mode in section 4.11.2?
q_22194.ground_truth: The E-UTRA donor cell shall use the settings defined in Clause 4.4.1 in NB-IOT inband mode.

q_22195.question: What is the predefined packetization time for PCM-coded speech (ITU-T G.711, A-law and -law) in AoIP?

q_22196.question: What actions does the RNC take when it receives an IU RELEASE COMMAND message without an active Iu signalling connection for the other domain?
q_22196.ground_truth: The RNC performs UE de-linking for any multicast services the UE is linked to in UTRAN.

q_22197.question: What is the Tracking Area Code (TAC) for the NG-RAN system simulator?
q_22197.ground_truth: The TAC for the NG-RAN system simulator is 000001.

q_22198.question: What should the UE do when it needs to establish a new emergency PDU session?
q_22198.ground_truth: The UE shall set the SSC mode IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message to "SSC mode 1".

q_22199.question: What are the main considerations for QoS provisioning in the context of UAV application server?
q_22199.ground_truth: The main considerations are providing application layer QoS requirements to the 3GPP system, supporting QoS differentiation for UAV operations, enhancing the UAE/SEAL layer to support QoS monitoring/provisioning, and modifying QoS requirements as requested by UAV controllers or USS/UTM.

q_22200.question: What is the definition of "Header" in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
q_22200.ground_truth: In the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals, a "Header" refers to a set of data that is added to a packet or message to provide additional information. This can include information such as the source and destination of the packet or message, as well as any additional data required for routing or processing.

q_22201.question: Which upgrade is used for CHOICE r3 for sequence r3 message 4.0-0-9?

q_22202.question: When should the UE ignore all the priorities provided in system information and apply priorities provided in dedicated signalling?
q_22202.ground_truth: The UE should ignore all the priorities provided in system information and apply priorities provided in dedicated signalling if the UE receives RRCRelease message with deprioritisationReq.

q_22203.question: What is the mean capacity performance of FR1, Indoor Hotspot, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, 45Mbps, with SU-MIMO?
q_22203.ground_truth: 4.44 UEs per cell in a range of 3.27 to 5 UEs per cell.

q_22204.question: When should the Receiver construct the status report using one STATUS PDU?
q_22204.ground_truth: The Receiver should construct the status report using one STATUS PDU if all SUFIs can be accommodated in one STATUS PDU and the SUFIs included do not fill the entire STATUS PDU.

q_22205.question: What is the cell reselection criteria for cell reselection to NR?
q_22205.ground_truth: The cell reselection to NR is based on the Srxlev criteria, taking into account the parameter q-RxLevMinSUL.

q_22206.question: What is the document produced by?

q_22207.question: What is the requirement for the personalisation process to be carried out in an ME?
q_22207.ground_truth: The SP personalisation indicator must be set to "off" and the ME should not be already personalised.

q_22208.question: What action is taken when entering "0" followed by SEND during a call?
q_22208.ground_truth: Releases all held calls or sets User Determined User Busy (UDUB) for a waiting call.

q_22209.question: What are the main services provided by the Physical Link layer in the GPRS radio interface?
q_22209.ground_truth: The Physical Link layer provides a physical channel between the MS and the Network, conveys information across the GSM radio interface, supports multiple MSs sharing a single physical channel, maintains communications capability over the physical radio channel between the Network and MSs, and includes synchronization procedures, monitoring and evaluation procedures for radio link signal quality, cell (re-)selection procedures, transmitter power control procedures, and Battery power conservation procedures.

q_22210.question: What is the purpose of the New IE Flags in the RACH DATA FRAME?
q_22210.ground_truth: The New IE Flags in the RACH DATA FRAME indicate the presence of new IEs in the frame, such as a Cell Portion ID, Extended Propagation Delay, Extended S-RNTI, Rx Timing Deviation, and other parameters. The presence of these new IEs changes the position of all subsequent IEs on an octet level.

q_22211.question: What is required for intermediates to allow the usage of the "telephone-event" media subtype for CAT control?
q_22211.ground_truth: Intermediates should allow the telephone-event packages to traverse from the UE to the AS during the early dialog.

q_22212.question: What is the purpose of the Lawful Interception Identifier (LIID) in MMS interception?
q_22212.ground_truth: The Lawful Interception Identifier (LIID) is used for identification and correlation purposes in MMS interception, making it easier to keep the knowledge about a specific target limited within the authorized operator (CSP) and the handling agents at the LEA, and to assign unique LIIDs for each target identity that is intercepted by more than one LEA.

q_22213.question: What is the maximum value for the intermodulation components for a multicarrier BTS, in case of third order intermodulation components?
q_22213.ground_truth: In case of multicarrier BTS, the power of the intermodulation components may increase up to -60 dBc or -36 dBm, whichever is less stringent, in a 600 kHz band centered at the center frequencies of the third order intermodulation components.

q_22214.question: What should be the sorting rules for LTE combinations?
q_22214.ground_truth: LTE combinations should be sorted by the first band number, then the first bandwidth character, then the second band number, and so on.

q_22215.question: What should the MAA do upon receiving the serviceStalled() notification?
q_22215.ground_truth: The MAA should stop the Media client playback and inform the user of the temporary service interruption, but should not issue a stopStreamingService() call.

q_22216.question: What is the relationship between User-to-User Signalling and CAMEL?
q_22216.ground_truth: User-to-User Signalling activation requests and information are passed to the CSE in call control messages.

q_22217.question: What decision can the AMF make if the UE's ongoing slices are not supported by the T-gNB?
q_22217.ground_truth: The AMF may make an initial slice re-mapping/fallback decision and include it in the HANDOVER REQUEST message to the T-gNB.

q_22218.question: What is the purpose of the greatest common divisor function in the rate-matching algorithm?
q_22218.ground_truth: The greatest common divisor function is used to calculate the value of q', which is not an integer but a multiple of 1/8, in the rate-matching algorithm.

q_22219.question: What type of record is used to report non-communication related target actions (events) in ProSe UE-to-NW Relay?
q_22219.ground_truth: The REPORT record is used to report non-communication related target actions (events) in ProSe UE-to-NW Relay.

q_22220.question: What is the role of the DUSK in the protected message processing in the receiving UE?
q_22220.ground_truth: The DUSK in the protected message processing in the receiving UE can be used to protect exactly one ProSe Code that the receiver matches, or to provide message-specific confidentiality without the need for the receiving UE to check the MIC.

q_22221.question: What is the operational requirement for the HOLD service?
q_22221.ground_truth: The HOLD service is typically provided after prior arrangement with the service provider.

q_22222.question: What is one of the pre-conditions for the MSGin5G Server to store and forward messages?
q_22222.ground_truth: One of the pre-conditions for the MSGin5G Server to store and forward messages is that the MSGin5G Client has registered with the MSGin5G Server and shared UE contact information.

q_22223.question: What is the purpose of the Information Exchange service in PCAP?
q_22223.ground_truth: The Information Exchange service enables the RNC to obtain GPS or GANSS related data from an SAS.

q_22224.question: What information must be reported to the NAS if the high-quality criterion is not met?
q_22224.ground_truth: Along with the PLMN identities, the NAS must be reported the corresponding RSRP values and any associated CAG-ID if the high-quality criterion is not met.

q_22225.question: What is required to be included in the Requested Data Value IE if the GANSS Generic Assistance Data IE is included and contains any GANSS-specific assistance data?
q_22225.ground_truth: At least one of the GANSS Reference Time, GANSS Ionospheric Model, GANSS Reference Location, GANSS Additional Ionospheric Model, or GANSS Earth Orientation Parameters IEs must be present.

q_22226.question: What information must the PCRF provide to the AF upon indication of change of IP-CAN type?
q_22226.ground_truth: The PCRF shall provide to the AF the information about the IP-CAN type the user is currently using and upon indication of change of IP-CAN type, notify the AF on changes of the type of IP-CAN.

q_22227.question: What procedure is initiated in the MS when it receives a paging request from the RAN?

q_22228.question: What does the Rijndael kernel function refer to in the 3GPP authentication and key generation functions?
q_22228.ground_truth: The Rijndael kernel function is a cryptographic kernel function used as a building block in the 3GPP authentication and key generation functions.

q_22229.question: What is the consequence of applying DTX to HS-PDSCH, HS-SCCH, E-AGCHs and E-HICHs physical channels if no data is to be transmitted in a given TTI?
q_22229.ground_truth: Rate matching is used to fill resource units completely, but if after rate matching and multiplexing no data at all is to be transmitted in a resource unit, the complete resource unit is discarded from transmission (DTX). This applies to HS-PDSCH, HS-SCCH, E-AGCHs and E-HICHs physical channels if no data is to be transmitted in a given TTI.

q_22230.question: When do you consider the Random Access procedure for an SCell unsuccessfully completed?
q_22230.ground_truth: The Random Access procedure for an SCell is considered unsuccessfully completed when the preamble transmission counter exceeds the preambleTransMax + 1 and the preamble was transmitted on an SCell.

q_22231.question: What are some traditional TV distribution formats considered in the analysis for defining TV profiles by 3GPP?
q_22231.ground_truth: The analysis was conducted based on information collected from organizations such as the Advanced Television Systems Committee (ATSC), the DASH Industry Forum (DASH-IF), the Digital Entertainment Content Ecosystem (DECE) and the Digital Video Broadcasting (DVB) Project.

q_22232.question: What is the validity timer indicating for how long the ProSe Restricted Code is valid in step~3?
q_22232.ground_truth: The validity timer shall indicate for how long this ProSe Restricted Code is going to be valid.

q_22233.question: What entity is responsible for deciding if QoS parameters fulfill the QoS requirements in the deterministic communication solution?

q_22234.question: What is the maximum code rate of the coding scheme used in the HARQ scheme for MSD messages?
q_22234.ground_truth: The maximum code rate of the coding scheme is approximately 0.83.

q_22235.question: What are the two interworking alternatives specified for IP-ATM interworking?
q_22235.ground_truth: The two alternatives are ATM/IP Dual Stack implemented in the IP UTRAN node, and an Interworking Function (IWF) which can be internal or external to the UTRAN/CN node.

q_22236.question: What should the UE do in 8.2.3.13.1.3.2 when it has the necessary timing information already?
q_22236.ground_truth: In 8.2.3.13.1.3.2, the UE may omit reading the MIB (Master Information Block) if it already has the required timing information or if the timing information is not needed for random access.

q_22237.question: What is the USAT execution environment's capability to make automatic calls?
q_22237.ground_truth: The USAT execution environment is allowed to make automatic calls but only with user confirmation.

q_22238.question: What happens to the MS's registration context when the GANC sends the GA-RC DEREGISTER message to the MS?
q_22238.ground_truth: The GANC removes the MS context in the GANC when it sends the GA-RC DEREGISTER message to the MS.

q_22239.question: What is the message sent by the MS to initiate the re-establishment of RABs?
q_22239.ground_truth: The MS initiates the re-establishment of RABs by using the Service Request (Service Type = Data) message.

q_22240.question: What are the two types of Resource Units (RUs) defined for uplink data multiplexing?

q_22241.question: What is the primary difference between the measurement methodologies for OTA co-location spurious emissions and OTA transmitter intermodulation measurements in General Chamber under normal test conditions (FR1)?
q_22241.ground_truth: The primary difference is that for OTA co-location spurious emissions measurements, the interferer is injected into the antenna from a co-located base station, while for OTA transmitter intermodulation measurements, the interferer is injected into the CLTA from a signal generator.

q_22242.question: What defines the reporting level for the PCEF to report usage for the related PCC rule?
q_22242.ground_truth: The Reporting-Level AVP defines on what level the PCEF reports the usage for the related PCC rule.

q_22243.question: What is the impact on the UE when PLMN A can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers from PLMN D?
q_22243.ground_truth: The UE is impacted with the determination that PLMN A can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers from PLMN D and can select PLMN A for registration using legacy principles as long as PLMN D is not in the UE's forbidden PLMNs list.

q_22244.question: What are the allowed frequency bands for operation in the GSM 450 band?
q_22244.ground_truth: The allowed frequency bands for operation in the GSM 450 band are 450.4 - 457.6 MHz for mobile transmit, base receive and 460.4 - 467.6 MHz for base transmit, mobile receive.

q_22245.question: What information does the SGSN send to the VLR when initiating a location update procedure towards the new MSC/VLR?
q_22245.ground_truth: The SGSN sends a Location Update Request (new LAI, IMSI, SGSN Number, Location Update Type) message to the VLR.

q_22246.question: What services can be reused in CMMC?
q_22246.ground_truth: Presence service, group management service, messaging services, and IMS Multimedia Telephony service can be reused in CMMC.

q_22247.question: What should the MS not monitor during the Fixed Uplink Allocation for uplink allocation?
q_22247.ground_truth: The MS should not monitor the USF on the DL PDCH for uplink allocation.

q_22248.question: What is the purpose of the life cycle management (LCM) stage 3 specification for mobile networks?
q_22248.ground_truth: The life cycle management (LCM) stage 3 specification for mobile networks that include virtualized network functions outlines the procedures and requirements for managing the life cycle of mobile networks. This includes the management of network functions, network services, and software updates.

q_22249.question: What shall the eP-CSCF (IMS-ALG) provide to the eIMS-AGW when it determines that it needs to set up a new DTLS association and SCTP association?
q_22249.ground_truth: A new termination towards the WebRTC access network, a deaggregation stream to handle the SCTP association and DTLS association, the local UDP port and SCTP port, a request for the eIMS-AGW to provide its own local SCTP maximum message size, "UDP/DTLS/SCTP" as the transport protocol, a Local certificate fingerprint Request information element, and the SCTP maximum message size received from the eIMS-AGW.

q_22250.question: What is the recommended action for the S-CSCF if it receives an integrity-protected REGISTER message from the UE?
q_22250.ground_truth: The S-CSCF may decide not to authenticate the user by means of the AKA protocol.

q_22251.question: What should the MAC entity do after determining the UL grant for the MSGA payload and the associated HARQ information if the Random Access Preamble was selected among the contention-based Random Access Preamble(s)?
q_22251.ground_truth: The MAC entity should deliver the UL grant and the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity, and perform the MSGA transmission procedure.

q_22252.question: What is the application of the "Broadcast communications" key issue in the context of UAS communications?
q_22252.ground_truth: Broadcast communications are the required support for communication amongst UAVs, both on-network and off-network scenarios, in UAS services.

q_22253.question: What is the role of an AS in the context of 3GPP PS Data Off exempt services?
q_22253.ground_truth: An AS is responsible for enforcing the 3GPP PS data off status. If the 3GPP PS data off status is active and the service is not a 3GPP PS Data Off exempt service, the AS prevents downlink IP packets of the service from reaching the UE over EPS IP-CAN, GPRS IP-CAN and 5GS IP-CAN.

q_22254.question: What should the UE include in the IE "GANSS Additional Assistance Data Request" when some GANSS assistance data was missing and the IE "Additional Assistance Data Request" is set to TRUE?
q_22254.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "GANSS Additional Assistance Data Request" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT when some GANSS assistance data was missing and the IE "Additional Assistance Data Request" is set to TRUE.

q_22255.question: Which entity performs the interworking between the isdn-subaddress parameter in a tel or SIP URI and the ISUP Access Transport Parameter?

q_22256.question: What are the UTRAN parameters for the system simulator for the 1.3 test sequence, as defined in the 3GPP TS 31.111 clause 7.5.12?
q_22256.ground_truth: Mobile Country Code (MCC) = 001; Mobile Network Code (MNC) = 01; Location Area Code (LAC) = 0001

q_22257.question: When should the separate requirements for micro-BTS be applied?
q_22257.ground_truth: The separate requirements for micro-BTS should be applied only when a micro-BTS is directly being tested. If there is no separate requirement for a micro-BTS, the requirements for the BTS apply to a micro-BTS.

q_22258.question: Which three protocols are used in the defined measurement types?
q_22258.ground_truth: The three protocols used in the defined measurement types are GSM, UMTS, and Combined (don't care).

q_22259.question: What does the Pre-emption-Capability AVP indicate when provided within the QoS-Information AVP?
q_22259.ground_truth: The Pre-emption-Capability AVP (AVP code 1047) indicates whether a service data flow can get resources that were already assigned to another service data flow with a lower priority level if provided within the QoS-Information AVP.

q_22260.question: Which network function is responsible for triggering network slice quota event notification when the threshold is reached or the periodic timer expires?
q_22260.ground_truth: The NSQ-NF is responsible for triggering network slice quota event notification when the threshold is reached or the periodic timer expires.

q_22261.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in controlling the content broadcasted in different areas for location-dependent MBMS user services?
q_22261.ground_truth: The BM-SC controls the content broadcasted in different areas by establishing a separate MBMS bearer service for each content data flow. The BM-SC allocates the Flow Identifier during the MBMS Session Start procedure and initiates a separate session for each content data flow. A UE is unaware of the Flow Identifier and the existence of multiple sessions for the same MBMS user service.

q_22262.question: What functional entities are used at the service layer to realize roaming for NGCN users in NGN?
q_22262.ground_truth: The main functional entities from the IMS service layer that are used to realize roaming for NGCN users in NGN include the P-CSCF and IBCF.

q_22263.question: What is the effect of the timer-regrouping procedure on MCPTT group sessions?
q_22263.ground_truth: When a MCPTT group is regrouped, the floor control messages in the media plane include a grouped regrouped indication, and the warning text "148 MCPTT group is regrouped" is included in a Warning header field.

q_22264.question: What occurs if the access attempt is considered barred and rand is higher than the value indicated by uac-BarringFactor?
q_22264.ground_truth: In this case, the UE considers the access attempt as barred.

q_22265.question: What is the assumed maximum relay distance in indoor settings for the 5G system?
q_22265.ground_truth: The assumed maximum relay distance in indoor settings for the 5G system is 10 meters, allowing for a maximum of 3 hops in most homes.

q_22266.question: What is the security assurance requirement that only applies in decoupling scenarios for Type 2 and Type 3 virtualized network product class?
q_22266.ground_truth: The security assurance requirements on the interface between 3GPP VNF and Virtualization layer for Type 2, and the security assurance requirements on the interfaces between components of Type 3.

q_22267.question: In what situation is access identity 2 considered valid by the UE?
q_22267.ground_truth: Access identity 2 is considered valid by the UE if the RPLMN is the HPLMN, EHPLMN, or visited PLMN of the home country.

q_22268.question: What type of radio transmission is used for RLP frames in A/Gb mode?
q_22268.ground_truth: In A/Gb mode, RLP frames are sent with strict alignment to radio transmission. Whenever a frame is to be sent, the RLP entity is required to provide the necessary protocol information to be contained in it.

q_22269.question: What is the expected operation for lawful interception in 5.2?
q_22269.ground_truth: The expected operation for lawful interception in 5.2 is the administration of intercepts by the CSP, the activation and deactivation of interception, and the security of interception processes. These functions shall only be accessible by authorized personnel and no indication shall be given to any party to the communication that the intercept function has been activated.

q_22270.question: In what scenario should the Associated-Registered-Identities AVP be added to the answer message in the HSS?
q_22270.ground_truth: The Associated-Registered-Identities AVP should be added to the answer message in the HSS when there are multiple Private User Identities being registered with the Public Identity and the IMS Restoration Procedures are supported in the HSS.

q_22271.question: What can the MRFC request the MRFP to send to parties connected in a call/session?
q_22271.ground_truth: The MRFC can request the MRFP to send tones or announcements, with specific identifiers and durations.

q_22272.question: What actions does the non ICS UE take to trigger the service control signalling path transfer when it detects a loss of Gm reference point?
q_22272.ground_truth: The non ICS UE sends the service control signalling path transfer notification to the SCC AS over I1, requesting a switch to I1 for Service Control Signalling Path.

q_22273.question: What is the only function of the IMS-AGW if it only supports ICE lite?
q_22273.ground_truth: If the IMS-AGW only supports ICE lite, it will only contain a STUN server.

q_22274.question: In the context of establishing a transport bearer for E-DCH MAC-d flows, what should be included in the Binding ID IE and Transport Layer Address IE for a set of coordinated DCHs when the Transport Bearer Not Requested Indicator IE is not included in FDD?
q_22274.ground_truth: The Binding ID IE and Transport Layer Address IE should be included for only one of the DCHs in a set of coordinated DCHs when the Transport Bearer Not Requested Indicator IE is not included in FDD.

q_22275.question: What is the role of the DF2 in the context of 12.2.3 events?
q_22275.ground_truth: The DF2 is an entity that receives elements from various events in the 12.2.3 section, for example, attach, detach, bearer activation, bearer deactivation, etc., but only if it is available.

q_22276.question: What does the LCS-AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE class contain?
q_22276.ground_truth: The LCS-AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE class contains the definition of different procedures for data transmission, such as location-Service-Request, connection-Oriented-Information-Transfer, connectionless-Information-Transfer, location-Abort, and ciphering-Key-Data-Delivery.

q_22277.question: How is a missing IE/IE group handled in SABP?
q_22277.ground_truth: An abstract syntax error occurs due to a missing IE/IE group when the presence of the IE/IE group is mandatory or conditional but not present in the received message.

q_22278.question: What is the purpose of IPSEC in securing point to point communications links?
q_22278.ground_truth: IPSEC is a cost-effective and efficient method for securing point to point communications links.

q_22279.question: What is one benefit of segmenting and distributing the content in the network for the IMS CoD service?
q_22279.ground_truth: Segmenting and distributing the content in the network helps reduce the time-to-market of CoD since the segments of video content are smaller and can be downloaded to the cache servers more quickly.

q_22280.question: What is the expected format of the message transmitted by the UE in the test procedure?
q_22280.ground_truth: The UE is expected to transmit a LPP PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION message including the nr-DL-AoD-ProvideLocationInformation-r16 IE with the required parameters within the response time.

q_22281.question: What mechanisms are defined for the transport of CDR files from the CGF to the BD?
q_22281.ground_truth: Two mechanisms are defined for the transport of CDR files from the CGF to the BD: a basic transport mechanism and the use of the File Transfer IRP.

q_22282.question: What is the main purpose of the "5.1.1.1 Attempted session establishments" measurement in the context of the 3GPP GGSN performance counters?
q_22282.ground_truth: The main purpose of this measurement is to monitor the number of attempted session establishments, including the subcounters per traffic class and allocation/retention priority as indicated in the QoS profile.

q_22283.question: Which method is used in the second stage to replace the RF cables with the radiated channel inside the chamber?
q_22283.ground_truth: The method used is spatial multiplexing techniques, which recreates the equivalent of isolated cable-conducted conditions at the receiver but with radiated self-interference now included.

q_22284.question: What action does the MS GA-SM take when it receives De-activate PDP Context Response from the serving GA-SM?
q_22284.ground_truth: The MS GA-SM releases all the resources related to that PDP context and sends SMREG-PDP-DEACTIVATE-CNF via the unchanged SMREG-SAP interface.

q_22285.question: What is the main function of the Element Manager (EM) in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
q_22285.ground_truth: The main function of the Element Manager (EM) within the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project is to provide a package of end-user functions for management of a set of closely related types of Network Elements (NEs).

q_22286.question: What happens to the CC links when a conference is released in a multi-party call?
q_22286.ground_truth: If the conference is released and the initial state (1 held, 1 active call) is re-established, the required CC links are still available.

q_22287.question: What is the purpose of the "time remaining until the next paging group occurrence" parameter and when is it used?
q_22287.ground_truth: The "time remaining until the next paging group occurrence" parameter determines the occurrence of ongoing paging group occurrences for a given MS, and is used by the SGSN to reattempt paging if the initial paging message was not sent on the radio interface, and to adjust the paging timing for all MSs that are subject to extended Idle mode DRX.

q_22288.question: What must be done to ports which are not connected to cables during normal operation before EMC testing?
q_22288.ground_truth: They shall not be connected to any cables for the purpose of EMC testing.

q_22289.question: What is the percentage increase in mean capacity performance when bandwidth is increased from 100MHz to 400MHz for FR2, Dense Urban, DL, AR/VR (30 Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60FPS), DDDSU TDD format based on Source 16?
q_22289.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is increased by about 300%.

q_22290.question: What is a network feature described by the P-Asserted-Identity mechanism in the context of SIP?
q_22290.ground_truth: The P-Asserted-Identity mechanism in SIP allows a network of trusted SIP servers to assert the identity of authenticated users.

q_22291.question: How does the network handle the delivery of the calling line identity in the CLIP Supplementary Service?
q_22291.ground_truth: The network shall deliver the calling line identity to the called party at call set-up time, regardless of the terminal capability to handle the information.

q_22292.question: What is the maximum number of GPS satellite almanacs that can be included in a GANSS Measured Results List?

q_22293.question: What is a requirement for the MCVideo service when operating off-network to determine which Participants are allowed to transmit at a point in time?
q_22293.ground_truth: The MCVideo service when operating off-network shall determine at a point in time which off-network Participant(s) are allowed to transmit to other off-network Participants.

q_22294.question: What must the SM-PCF (i.e. secondary) and H-PCF (primary) interact for in the case of a roaming UE's request to a serving PLMN on a PDU session establishment or release of S-NSSAI?
q_22294.ground_truth: The interaction between SM-PCF (i.e. secondary) and the H-PCF (primary) is for control and enforcement of the Roaming UEs' requests, e.g. via N24.

q_22295.question: What is the purpose of the Prototype Pitch Period (PPP) encoding in speech coding?
q_22295.ground_truth: PPP is a technique that exploits the fact that pitch-cycle waveforms in a voiced segment do not change quickly in a frame. It allows for encoding of speech by transmitting a representative prototype pitch period in the voiced segment. At the decoder, the non-transmitted pitch-cycle waveforms can be derived by means of interpolation. This method is used to achieve very low bit-rate coding while maintaining high-quality reconstructed voiced speech.

q_22296.question: What should an MS do with the PLMN list provided during the registration procedure?
q_22296.ground_truth: The MS should not store the PLMN list or use it for background scanning after successful registration with a serving GANC.

q_22297.question: In the context of UE-initiated IP flow mobility in UE-initiated NBIFOM mode, what should the PCEF and PCRF do if they receive the resource request and NBIFOM routing rule for the same packet filter in the same request?
q_22297.ground_truth: The PCEF and PCRF shall behave as defined in subclause 4.5.25.2.5.

q_22298.question: What are the two key approaches defined in Rel-17 for frequency offset compensation in HST-SFN scenario?
q_22298.ground_truth: UE-based (scheme A) and TRP-based (scheme B) compensation schemes are the two key approaches defined in Rel-17 for frequency offset compensation in HST-SFN scenario.

q_22299.question: Who triggers the multicast session establishment in solution #2, #4, #32 when the MB-SMF is activated for MBS Session?
q_22299.ground_truth: The SMF triggers the multicast session establishment.

q_22300.question: What may occur if the ON-OFF transition at the MS is set wrongly?
q_22300.ground_truth: Loss of data and potentially release of the connection may occur.

q_22301.question: What condition causes the "Network failure" cause in 3GPP TS~23.203~?
q_22301.ground_truth: The SGSN uses the "Network failure" cause in the Delete PDP Context Request message to indicate that it is sending the message due to a network problem.

q_22302.question: What is the condition for determining whether or not a particular access attempt is allowed in the unified access control procedure?
q_22302.ground_truth: The UE determines whether or not a particular access attempt is allowed based on uac-BarringInfo broadcast in SIB1 and if the RPLMN is the HPLMN, EHPLMN or visited PLMN of the home country.

q_22303.question: What is the maximum attenuation used in the base station antenna radiation pattern in 3-sector cell sites?
q_22303.ground_truth: The maximum attenuation used in the base station antenna radiation pattern is 20dB.
