q_22304.question: What should a Terminal do after receiving an ATTACH REJECT message during registration on PS in the USIM with the cause "PLMN not allowed"?
q_22304.ground_truth: The Terminal should update the EFPLMN in the USIM.

q_22305.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects in the document?
q_22305.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects is responsible for creating technical specifications for mobile communication systems, including performance management and telecommunication management.

q_22306.question: What should the UE do if it does not have a valid 5G NAS security context and needs to send the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
q_22306.ground_truth: The UE should send the REGISTRATION REQUEST message without including the NAS message container IE and set the Payload container type IE to "UE policy container", including the entire REGISTRATION REQUEST message in the NAS message container IE that is sent as part of the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.

q_22307.question: What is the defined Pfa value in 8.8.1.1 and 8.8.2A.1 for the RACH preamble detection?
q_22307.ground_truth: The Pfa value is defined as a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the preamble when input is only noise (+interference), and it should be 10-3 or less.

q_22308.question: Which INTEGER value in the GPS-UTC-Model range (0..7) represents 24 bit a1 in GPS UTC Model?

q_22309.question: What is the value of the Status byte after a SMS is received but not yet read in EF_SMS?
q_22309.ground_truth: The Status byte is set to SMS to be read (logically: 000) when a SMS is received but not yet read in EF_SMS.

q_22310.question: What triggers the removal of old EAS information in the UE when the network sets up a new local PSA due to UE mobility in IPv6 multi-homing with a BP?
q_22310.ground_truth: The UE gets a new IPv6 prefix (and routing rules) and removal of old prefix, which triggers the UE to remove the old EAS information bound to the old prefix.

q_22311.question: How is the timer Treset used in the MAC-ehs reordering functionality?
q_22311.ground_truth: The timer Treset is used to initiate a MAC-ehs reset and is started when a reordering PDU is correctly received under certain conditions.

q_22312.question: What happens to the discardTimer associated with a PDCP SDU when it is received from upper layers?
q_22312.ground_truth: The discardTimer associated with the PDCP SDU is started when it is received from upper layers.

q_22313.question: What measures have been taken by MyDASH to ensure the integrity of delivered content and MPD?
q_22313.ground_truth: MyDASH has decided to enable authentication mechanisms for the operator to validate the integrity of the delivered content and MPD.

q_22314.question: Which document specifies application specific tests for applications residing on an UICC?
q_22314.ground_truth: TS~31.121 specifies application specific tests for applications residing on an UICC.

q_22315.question: What are the two classes of LCS Applications and how are they identified?
q_22315.ground_truth: The two classes of LCS Applications are Internal applications and External applications. Internal applications are identified by LCS client internal ID and External applications are identified by LCS client external ID.

q_22316.question: What is the usage of the protocol extension mechanism for non-standard use in SBC-AP?
q_22316.ground_truth: The protocol extension mechanism for non-standard use in SBC-AP may be used for special operator- (and/or vendor) specific features or by vendors for research purposes.

q_22317.question: Which device identity is used in the TERMINAL RESPONSE message with 3G Session Reset procedure?
q_22317.ground_truth: The source device is ME and the destination device is UICC in the TERMINAL RESPONSE message with 3G Session Reset procedure.

q_22318.question: Which 3GPP specification provides the stage 2 details of the AKMA TLS protocol profiles for 5G?

q_22319.question: How does a UE select a consumption report server to send a consumption report?
q_22319.ground_truth: A UE randomly selects one of the serviceURI elements currently present under consumptionReporting, with uniform distribution as the destination of the consumption report message, if more than one serviceURI elements are present under consumptionReporting.

q_22320.question: What information must be provided to the CSE when a change of position event occurs?
q_22320.ground_truth: The VPLMN must provide the CSE with information about the event met, type of monitoring, event specific data (which includes location information), and charge result if charging supervision is provided.

q_22321.question: What action should the BTS take if it is not possible to stop a specified measurement?
q_22321.ground_truth: The BTS should send a NACK message instead of an ACK message to indicate that it is not possible to stop the measurement.

q_22322.question: What is the difference between the Route and Record-Route header fields in the INVITE request?
q_22322.ground_truth: The Route header field in the INVITE request identifies the next IBCF or I-CSCF node in the signaling path while the Record-Route header field contains the entries included in the received INVITE request plus an entry of the incoming IBCF-hA2.

q_22323.question: In the context of the Mobile profile, what media types are required to be supported in profile 10?
q_22323.ground_truth: The media types required to be supported in profile 10 are Still Image, Bitmap Graphics, Speech, Audio, Video, 3GP file format, and SVG fonts.

q_22324.question: How often does the UE need to verify the BSIC of the GSM BCCH carrier in inter-RAT cell reselection?
q_22324.ground_truth: The UE should verify the BSIC of the GSM BCCH carrier at least every 30 seconds in inter-RAT cell reselection.

q_22325.question: What is the procedure followed when a successfully authenticated radio connection is already established before an Abort message is received in the VLR?
q_22325.ground_truth: The VLR ignores the Abort message in this case.

q_22326.question: What is the purpose of the programmatic library in the MBMS Control Application Programming Interface (API)?
q_22326.ground_truth: The purpose of the programmatic library in the MBMS Control API is to abstract the implementation-specific interactions with the MBMS Client from the MAA, communicate with a particular MBMS Client implementation, and expose a set of simple interfaces to the MAA.

q_22327.question: When MBMS reception is active, what requirement must a UE ensure if it is required to perform inter-frequency measurements as indicated by the cell reselection measurement rules in 25.304?
q_22327.ground_truth: The UE must switch back to its serving cell frequency in time to perform demodulation of MTCH signals.

q_22328.question: Which parameters can RRC control for DRX operation?
q_22328.ground_truth: RRC can control the following parameters for DRX operation: drx-onDurationTimer, drx-SlotOffset, drx-InactivityTimer, drx-RetransmissionTimer-DL, drx-RetransmissionTimer-UL, drx-LongCycleStartOffset, drx-ShortCycle, drx-ShortCycleTimer, drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL, and drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL.

q_22329.question: What is the meaning of "Ks" and "Kw" given in the naming convention of bits in the technical specification?
q_22329.ground_truth: "Ks" refers to the number of symbols in a data block of a certain data type, and "Kw" refers to the number of symbols in a data block before burst-wise channel encoding.

q_22330.question: How does QUIC-PROXY support round-trip and packet loss measurements?
q_22330.ground_truth: The QUIC-PROXY supports round-trip measurements per QoS Flow and packet loss measurements per QoS Flow, as it can provide round-trip and packet loss measurements per QUIC connection.

q_22331.question: When should the UE not perform the registration procedure for mobility?
q_22331.ground_truth: If the UE is in the 5GMM-REGISTERED state and treats all TAIs in the current PLMN as a registration area and has deleted its old TAI list as a result of REGISTRATION ACCEPT message that included MICO indication IE indicating "all PLMN registration area allocated", then the UE does not perform the REGISTRATION procedure for mobility.

q_22332.question: In the single-source compressed outside broadcast contribution, what is the purpose of bi-directional audio links?
q_22332.ground_truth: The bi-directional audio links are used to ensure separate communication between the user at the remote site and the broadcast centre, enabling user-to-user communication and remote control of camera functions.

q_22333.question: What is the implication of using "on demand" announcing in ProSe with a validity timer of zero and no ongoing monitoring request?
q_22333.ground_truth: The ProSe Function does not provide a ProSe Restricted Code to the UE, and the UE does not initiate announcing or monitoring.

q_22334.question: What is the role of the Visitor Location Register (VLR) in PS domain location management procedures?
q_22334.ground_truth: The VLR is responsible for storing relevant data concerning an MS as long as it is within the area controlled by the VLR, but the location management procedures for the PS domain are not covered in the present document.

q_22335.question: What is the difference between FDD and TDD modes of operation in the context of UTRA UE?
q_22335.ground_truth: In FDD mode, frequency division duplexing is used, meaning that separate frequency bands are used for uplink and downlink transmission. In TDD mode, time division duplexing is used, meaning that the same frequency band is used for both uplink and downlink transmission, but at different times.

q_22336.question: What should a UE do if it cannot determine the full contents of the minimum SI of a cell?
q_22336.ground_truth: The UE should consider the cell as barred and not camp on it if it cannot determine the full contents of the minimum SI.

q_22337.question: What is the significance of the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_22337.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification indicates the status of the document. A "1" indicates that the document is presented to the TSG for information, a "2" means that the document is presented to the TSG for approval, and a "3" or greater indicates that the document is TSG approved and under change control.

q_22338.question: What is the name of the message that the MS sends in response to the Setup message indicating compatibility with the requested bearer service?

q_22339.question: What benefits does QUIC offer in comparison with current RIST specifications in media production workflows?
q_22339.ground_truth: QUIC, which has a predominant use in underpinning HTTP/3, offers the benefit of being well understood by many application firewalls and proxies and allows connections to be migrated between network endpoints without interrupting application-level flows.

q_22340.question: What is the role of the DCS in the UE onboarding process?
q_22340.ground_truth: The DCS stores the UE's credentials information required for the authentication of the UE and provides mutual authentication with UEs for the purpose of initial access to the ON.

q_22341.question: What is the purpose of timer T3126 and what are the conditions for starting it?
q_22341.ground_truth: Timer T3126 is started either after sending the maximum allowed number of CHANNEL REQUEST messages during an immediate assignment procedure or on receipt of an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message. It is also started when a mobile station accessing the network with low priority has initiated the immediate assignment procedure, sent one or more CHANNEL REQUEST messages and received an implicit reject for the CS domain.

q_22342.question: How does a simulcast sender indicate the willingness to receive simulcast streams in the SDP?
q_22342.ground_truth: A simulcast sender typically indicates a slightly higher b-line value for the m-line containing the simulcast.

q_22343.question: What is the effect of the revised DIP for geometry -3 dB on the average throughput and gain values?
q_22343.ground_truth: There is a small reduction in the average relative gains for geometry -3 dB, and a lesser degradation for geometry 0 dB, especially for QPSK values.

q_22344.question: How does the UE determine if the entering condition for event A5 is satisfied?
q_22344.ground_truth: The UE considers the entering condition for event A5 to be satisfied when both condition A5-1 and condition A5-2 are fulfilled. Condition A5-1 is inequality A5-1 and condition A5-2 is inequality A5-2, which are defined in TS 38.331.

q_22345.question: What is the purpose of the "RELEASE COMPLETE (SS RETURN RESULT)" operation code in the registration process?
q_22345.ground_truth: The "RELEASE COMPLETE (SS RETURN RESULT)" operation code is used to release a call and return the result of the Call Forwarding Unconditional for All Tele Services activation. This operation code returns a variety of information including the forwarding information, SS-Code, and forwarding feature status.

q_22346.question: What interfaces are involved in the paging process for a mobile station in an UMTS network?
q_22346.ground_truth: The paging signal towards the mobile station (MS) goes from VMSCB via VLRB and the SGSN to the BSS.

q_22347.question: What is the role of the Serving GPRS Support Node (SGSN) in the SMS architecture?
q_22347.ground_truth: The Serving GPRS Support Node (SGSN) is responsible for performing packet switching functions for mobile stations located in a geographical area designated as the SGSN area.

q_22348.question: Which codec software is used for the coding efficiency test for H.265 (HEVC) and H.264 (AVC)?
q_22348.ground_truth: HM version 10 is used for H.265 (HEVC) and JM version 18.4 is used for H.264 (AVC).

q_22349.question: Which two parameters are carried in the Access Stratum headers as defined in RAN specification in discovery messages?
q_22349.ground_truth: Source L2 ID and Destination L2 ID

q_22350.question: What was the purpose of the training phase before the actual test?
q_22350.ground_truth: The training phase took about half an hour, it was used to describe the listening instructions, answer listeners' questions if any, and to help the listeners assess the quality of the test items if they faced difficulties.

q_22351.question: What should a receiver do if it receives an SBc-AP message with an IE or IE group that it does not comprehend, based on the criticality information set in the message?
q_22351.ground_truth: The receiver should treat the entire item (IE or IE group) which is not comprehended in accordance with its own criticality information as specified in clause 4.5.3.4.

q_22352.question: What information does the Enhanced Voice Mail Notification IEI convey and in what format?
q_22352.ground_truth: The Enhanced Voice Mail Notification IEI is set to 0 to specify that the following Information Element Data Parameters contain an Enhanced Voice Mail Notification. It is part of the Enhanced Voice Mail Notification Information Element Data with strict order following the IEDL.

q_22353.question: What are the initial conditions for the test procedure for verifying the ME's response to a RUN AT COMMAND with a specific text attribute?
q_22353.ground_truth: The ME is connected to the USIM Simulator, powered on, and connected to the TE. The TA-TE interface is set to 8-bit operation, and the ME has been powered on and performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure prior to this test.

q_22354.question: When is a new ePDG-CDR opened for a MS in the ePDG?
q_22354.ground_truth: A new ePDG-CDR is opened for a UE/MS in the ePDG when the IP-CAN bearer is activated, or when the charging conditions change and a new ePDG-CDR is required for the changed conditions.

q_22355.question: What is the additional data in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE: LAUNCH BROWSER 2.3.2" command?
q_22355.ground_truth: The additional data in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE: LAUNCH BROWSER 2.3.2" command is "Browser unavailable".

q_22356.question: What should the MS do if it receives a new RRLP message while engaged in a different RRLP procedure?
q_22356.ground_truth: The MS should abort the first procedure and start the new one.

q_22357.question: What should the GPL protocol entity do if the GPL-SA SAID has already been set and matches the SAID in the GPL message?
q_22357.ground_truth: The GPL message should be discarded and the processing should stop.

q_22358.question: What is the importance of network performance in VR services?
q_22358.ground_truth: Network performance is important for real-time streaming of VR services. It ensures that relevant high-resolution video tiles or FOV segments are delivered within certain latency limits, enabling a seamless and believable experience for the user.

q_22359.question: What is the purpose of the Channel needed information element in the BSSAP+ protocol?
q_22359.ground_truth: The purpose of the Channel needed information element is to indicate which type of channel is needed for the transaction linked to the paging procedure.

q_22360.question: What are the two mechanisms by which the UE can release the MBMS RB?
q_22360.ground_truth: The two mechanisms by which the UE can release the MBMS RB are Explicit MBMS RB Release and Implicit MBMS RB Release.

q_22361.question: What should the IWF do if the SIP re-INVITE request contains an unauthorized request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call cancellation?
q_22361.ground_truth: The IWF should reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the SIP re-INVITE request and include in the SIP 403 (Forbidden) response an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "false".

q_22362.question: In the case where the initial registration request is rejected by the network due to general NAS level mobility management congestion control, what action should the UE take when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with cause #22 (Congestion) from the AMF?
q_22362.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, reset the registration attempt counter, store the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMN list", and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH to perform a PLMN selection.

q_22363.question: What information does the Remote UE Report message sent by the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay include?
q_22363.ground_truth: The Remote UE Report message sent by the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay includes TCP/UDP port ranges assigned to individual Remote UEs and their corresponding Remote User IDs, and for IPv6, the UE-to-network Relay reports IPv6 prefixes assigned to individual Remote UE along with their Remote User IDs.

q_22364.question: What is the role of the IRPManager in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_22364.ground_truth: The IRPManager is responsible for requesting and obtaining network management services provided by an IRP. It uses the Reference, such as the Reference to PMIRP, to invoke operations and access domain-specific management services.

q_22365.question: In step 4.1.i), when sending a SIP re-INVITE request toward the CS domain, what does the SCC AS ensure is not included in the request?
q_22365.ground_truth: An SDP offer is not included in the SIP re-INVITE request.

q_22366.question: What should be the value of "requestingNodeType" in the SendAuthenticationInfoArg when a Requested-UTRAN-GERAN-Authentication-Info AVP and a Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP are both present within AIR?

q_22367.question: Which European country did Croatia achieve independence from in 1991?

q_22368.question: What security threat is posed if the OPc value is obtained by an unauthorized network element or person?
q_22368.ground_truth: It increases the risk of unauthorized USIM creation

q_22369.question: How is the length of the Check Value determined?
q_22369.ground_truth: The length of the Check Value depends on the network operator.

q_22370.question: What is the role of the ProSe Function in authorizing ProSe Direct Discovery and ProSe Direct Communication?
q_22370.ground_truth: The ProSe Function performs the following functions: the UE gets authorization to use E-UTRA based ProSe Direct Discovery on a per PLMN basis, the UE gets authorization to use ProSe Direct Communication on a per PLMN basis in the serving PLMN by the ProSe Function in the HPLMN, and the ProSe Function in the HPLMN requests authorization information from the ProSe Function of the serving PLMN and Local PLMN(s). The final authorization always comes from the ProSe Function in the Home PLMN.

q_22371.question: What are the maximum video dimensions and file format for TikTok on Android?
q_22371.ground_truth: The maximum video dimensions for TikTok on Android is 1080 x 1920, and the video should be in MP4 or MOV file format, H.264/AVC encoded.

q_22372.question: What is the maximum bitrate that UE-A can receive, as indicated in the SDP offer?
q_22372.ground_truth: UE-A can receive up to 440 kbps, including IPv6/UDP/RTP overhead.

q_22373.question: What is the difference between the "user plane" and the "control plane" in the 3GPP system?
q_22373.ground_truth: The "user plane" refers to the data plane, carrying user traffic, while the "control plane" is responsible for signaling related to network management and control.

q_22374.question: Who makes the final decision on the applicability of the requested DRX schedule?
q_22374.ground_truth: The AS layer makes the final decision on the applicability of the requested DRX schedule.

q_22375.question: In the context of PDN sessions, when should the PDN type be set to "IPv4v6"?
q_22375.ground_truth: The PDN type should be set to "IPv4v6" if the PDU session type is "IPv4v6".

q_22376.question: What is the role of the PCRF in relation to IP flow mobility routing rules in 3GPP technology?
q_22376.ground_truth: The PCRF is responsible for selecting the bearer binding function, either the PCEF or any applicable BBERF, for each service data flow based on the Routing Address included in the IP flow mobility routing rules received from the PCEF.

q_22377.question: What happens in Local PSA UPF during the initial EAS IP address replacement procedure?
q_22377.ground_truth: During the initial EAS IP address replacement procedure in Local PSA UPF, the destination IP address that equals the Anchor EAS IP address for uplink traffic is replaced with the Serving Local EAS IP address. For downlink traffic, the source IP address of the current Serving Local EAS is replaced with the Anchor EAS IP address for the UE.

q_22378.question: What is the purpose of the CSG-ProximityIndicationCapability field in the UE-RadioAccessCapability-v920ext-IEs sequence?
q_22378.ground_truth: The CSG-ProximityIndicationCapability field in the UE-RadioAccessCapability-v920ext-IEs sequence is used to indicate whether a user equipment is capable of indicating its proximity to a CSG cell. This is used for features such as automatic group roaming and presence notification.

q_22379.question: How does the solution propose to determine the country of the UE's location?
q_22379.ground_truth: The solution proposes to determine the country of the UE's location in an implementation-specific way. Since GNSS capabilities are assumed, it is not necessary to rely on the MCC of the serving PLMN to determine the country of UE's physical location. If the UE is served by a satellite NG-RAN cell, it needs to determine the country of its physical location using its own capability.

q_22380.question: When do zeros get padded in the MSB of the "Antenna ports" field?
q_22380.ground_truth: Zeros are padded in the MSB of this field if the mapping type of the PDSCH corresponds to a smaller value than the number of available bits in the "Antenna ports" field.

q_22381.question: What action does the mobile station take when it receives an UPLINK BUSY message indicating a priority that is equal or higher than the priority of the current uplink access?
q_22381.ground_truth: The mobile station stops T3130 and stops sending UPLINK ACCESS messages for this uplink request and remains in the group receive mode.

q_22382.question: What should a ME capable of UMTS AKA with a USIM active and attached to a UTRAN do regarding GSM AKA participation?
q_22382.ground_truth: It shall only participate in UMTS AKA and not participate in GSM AKA.

q_22383.question: What effect does the discontinuous DPCCH transmission have on the F-DPCH performance?
q_22383.ground_truth: The discontinuous DPCCH transmission has no negative impact on the F-DPCH performance, and the pattern of UL DPCCH transmission, whether DTX or F-DPCH closed loop PC ON/OFF, has only a minor impact on the performance. The performance seems to be slightly better for patterns with shorter power-controlled slots compared to the number of not power-controlled slots.

q_22384.question: What is the measurement provided by the best UTRAN cell of active set in the user equipment side?
q_22384.ground_truth: This measurement provides the mean number of the radio link established by the best UTRAN cell of active set (UE side).

q_22385.question: What is the policy of the Home Network (HN) regarding authentication for the registration of different IMPUs belonging to the same or different service profiles?
q_22385.ground_truth: It is the policy of the HN that decides if an authentication shall take place for the registration of different IMPUs belonging to the same or different service profiles.

q_22386.question: What is the role of an RNC in a 3GPP network?
q_22386.ground_truth: An RNC, or Radio Network Controller, is responsible for controlling a set of NodeBs in a 3GPP network. It performs functions such as radio resource management and handover management.

q_22387.question: What should the MNC dig 3 digit be set to if a 2-digit MNC is used?
q_22387.ground_truth: The MNC dig 3 digit should be set to '1111' if a 2-digit MNC is used.

q_22388.question: What is the overflow in the case of a 4792-bit RTP packet with uncompressed header in the 129.2 kbps PS RAB with 40 ms TTI?
q_22388.ground_truth: The overflow in the case of a 4792-bit RTP packet with uncompressed header in the 129.2 kbps PS RAB with 40 ms TTI can be avoided by reducing the packet size to 4776, at the cost of a small amount of application bandwidth.

q_22389.question: What codec was used for encoding the four B-format components in the main test?
q_22389.ground_truth: The EVS codec was used for encoding the four B-format components in the main test.

q_22390.question: What is the name of the system that provides the management solution for mobile networks with virtualized network functions, as specified by the 3GPP?

q_22391.question: Which parameter of the Protocol Negotiation Result event indicates whether the protocol negotiation has been successful?

q_22392.question: What is the function of the NG RAN node in the broadcast communication service setup?
q_22392.ground_truth: The NG RAN node establishes the N3 tunnel for broadcast session and allocates the DL tunnel information if transport layer IP Multicast (i.e. multicast on N3) is used. The NG RAN joins the IP Multicast (identified by the IP multicast address and the IP address of the multicast source) to enable reception of broadcast communication service data.

q_22393.question: What should the UE do if it supports multi-band signaling and the EARFCN value in the "EARFCN extension" is not supported, but the UE does understand the EARFCN downlink (Nd) value?
q_22393.ground_truth: If the UE does not find a supported E-UTRA Frequency Band in the "Multiple E-UTRA frequency band indicator list," it should search for a supported band in the "Multiple E-UTRA frequency band extension indicator list" instead. If a supported band is found, the UE should extract the band and compute the corresponding EARFCN downlink (Nd) value.

q_22394.question: What is the capability defined for UEs in relation to UDC in NR?
q_22394.ground_truth: There are four capabilities defined for UEs in relation to UDC in NR, including supporting basic UDC function, supporting standard dictionary, supporting operator-defined dictionary, and supporting UDC continuity.

q_22395.question: What are the primary objectives of the solutions described in 6.6 and 6.7 (Solution 6 & Solution 7)?
q_22395.ground_truth: Solution 6 aims to address key issue #2 (Location History Reporting) by having the location management client locally store event-triggered location information reports when it can't send reports to the location management server. Solution 7 focuses on requesting on-demand location information history from the location management client after returning to on-network operation, based on different criteria.

q_22396.question: What is the purpose of the "Multilateration Timing Advance Cause" field in the Application Error Container IE for the Multilateration Timing Advance Application?
q_22396.ground_truth: The "Multilateration Timing Advance Cause" field in the Application Error Container IE for the Multilateration Timing Advance Application indicates the cause why the Application Error Container IE is sent.

q_22397.question: What information is included in the Forward Relocation Response message for each RAB?
q_22397.ground_truth: The RNC Tunnel Endpoint Identifier and RNC IP address for data forwarding from the source SRNC to the target RNC.

q_22398.question: In the context of MIPv4 Agent Advertisement, what address should the Foreign Agent (FA) set as the destination address when it has not received a MIPv4 Agent Solicitation from the UE?
q_22398.ground_truth: The FA shall set the destination address of the MIPv4Agent Advertisement to the "limited broadcast" address (i.e. 255.255.255.255).

q_22399.question: How is the location service support released at the end of the location service procedure?
q_22399.ground_truth: At the end of the location service procedure, the established location service support is released by sending the RELEASE COMPLETE message to its corresponding entity and both location service support entities release the MM-connection locally.

q_22400.question: What is the role of S-CSCF-1 in the media flow transfer process between UE-1 and UE-2?
q_22400.ground_truth: S-CSCF-1 is responsible for forwarding the request to transfer Media-B from UE-1 to UE-2, and removing Media-B from UE-1 after the transfer.

q_22401.question: Which protocol data unit specified in the OverloadIEs is related to the overload priority level?
q_22401.ground_truth: The ID id-Priority-Class-Indicator in the OverloadIEs is related to the overload priority level.

q_22402.question: Which CRs were agreed upon for introducing BCS4 and BCS5 in the 3GPP core part specifications?
q_22402.ground_truth: The CRs agreed upon for introducing BCS4 and BCS5 in the 3GPP core part specifications are 38.306, 38.331, 38.101-1, 38.101-1, 38.101-1, 38.101-1, 38.101-3, 38.101-3, 38.101-3, 38.307, and 11.17.

q_22403.question: What does the term "AMR" in the present document refer to?
q_22403.ground_truth: In the present document, "AMR" refers to both narrow-band and wide-band Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) codecs unless otherwise stated.

q_22404.question: What is the specificity of the V2XASAddresses node within each authorized V2X service, and what does its absence indicate?
q_22404.ground_truth: The V2XASAddresses node within each authorized V2X service contains V2X application server addresses for a specific V2X service. Its absence indicates that the UE cannot receive V2X messages of the V2X service with the V2X service identifier indicated, nor can it send V2X messages of the same V2X service without using TCP.

q_22405.question: What protocol is used by the MPQUIC-LL steering functionality for unreliable tunnelling service between the UE and the UPF?
q_22405.ground_truth: The QUIC protocol (version 1) specified in draft-ietf-quic-transport, along with accompanying documents that describe QUIC's loss detection and congestion control (draft-ietf-quic-recovery) and the use of TLS for key negotiation (draft-ietf-quic-tls) is used by the MPQUIC-LL steering functionality for unreliable tunnelling service between the UE and the UPF.

q_22406.question: What does the "Network Standard Time Information" IE contain, and under what conditions is it used?
q_22406.ground_truth: The "Network Standard Time Information" IE contains information about the Network Standard Time and a related SFN value. It is used in the 1.28Mcps TDD.

q_22407.question: What is a potential security requirement to protect the privacy of identities exchanged in the communications between peer UEs over the UE-to-UE Relay in 5G System?
q_22407.ground_truth: The 5GS should provide means for mitigating trackability and linkability attacks on peer UEs during communications over a UE-to-UE Relay, including during the UE-to-UE Relay path switch.

q_22408.question: What should the receiver do when the first octet of an information element does not correspond to an IEI known in the message?
q_22408.ground_truth: The receiver should determine whether the IE is of type 1 or 2 (i.e. it is an information element of one octet length) or of type 4 (i.e. that the next octet is the length indicator indicating the length of the remaining of the information element). This allows the receiver to jump over unknown information elements and to analyze any following information elements.

q_22409.question: What is the role of the IOPS connectivity client functional entity in the application plane of an IOPS MC system?
q_22409.ground_truth: The IOPS connectivity client functional entity provides support for enabling a user at the MC service client to be registered and discovered by the IOPS MC system in the IOPS mode of operation.

q_22410.question: What is the minimum number of bits used to quantize the noise level in the GSC mode?
q_22410.ground_truth: 2 bits are used to quantize the noise level in the GSC mode for bit rates of 7.2 and 8 kbit/s, while 3 bits are used for the UC SWB mode at 13.2 kbit/s, with values ranging from 8 to 15.

q_22411.question: What should the PCRF do when it receives an indication of invocation/revocation of MPS for DTS from the AF?
q_22411.ground_truth: The PCRF should make the corresponding policy decisions, such as changing the ARP and/or QCI, and initiate a RAR command to provision the modified data. For invocation of MPS for DTS, the PCRF sets the ARP and QCI of the default bearer to appropriate values, while for revocation, it sets the ARP and QCI of the default bearer to the values appropriate for PCRF decision.

q_22412.question: What should the MS provide when initiating the Secondary PDP Context Activation Procedure?
q_22412.ground_truth: The MS should provide a TFT (Traffic Flow Template) that specifies an IP header filter for routing downlink N-PDUs to the newly activated PDP context.

q_22413.question: What is gating control in policy control?
q_22413.ground_truth: Gating control is a feature of policy control that is applied by the PCEF on a per service data flow basis. The AF reports session events such as session termination or modification to the PCRF to enable gating control decisions. For example, session termination may trigger the blocking of packets or "closing the gate".

q_22414.question: What is the initial connection established between the HNB and the HMS?
q_22414.ground_truth: The initial connection between the HNB and the HMS is established using TLS/SSL security through TR-069 session establishment.

q_22415.question: What node functionality enhancements are needed for SBI-based SM MO?
q_22415.ground_truth: The node functionality enhancements needed are enhancements of SMS-IWMSC, SMSF, NRF, and other related node functionalities.

q_22416.question: What is the purpose of the Notification Channel (NCH) in the VBS?
q_22416.ground_truth: The Notification Channel (NCH) is a common control channel on which the network sends notifications to inform group members of the existence of voice broadcast calls.

q_22417.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of the "GSM/EDGE Overall description; Stage 2 (Release 17)" document?
q_22417.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between multiple standards organizations to create specifications for mobile communications, including 3G and 4G technologies. The "GSM/EDGE Overall description; Stage 2 (Release 17)" document is a technical specification that describes the stage 2 service description for a GSM/EDGE Radio Access Network (GERAN). It illustrates how the services requested by a GSM/UMTS Core Network are realized by the GERAN and focuses on functionality related to the Iu interfaces.

q_22418.question: What is the purpose of Visited Network Preference information?
q_22418.ground_truth: Visited Network Preference information helps the UE select a WLAN and a 3GPP-based authentication method over WLAN in a V-PLMN.

q_22419.question: How can Company-NB use the NSaaS (Network Slice as a Service) for a service provided by Company-NA?
q_22419.ground_truth: Company-NB can use the NSaaS for a service provided by Company-NA to allow for the management of a network slice service. If required, additional management capabilities in provisioning or monitoring areas can be exposed by Company-NB, but only those capabilities related to the service provided to Company-NA.

q_22420.question: What should the IWU do if the incoming SIP INVITE request indicates that remote preconditions are not met or local preconditions are not met?
q_22420.ground_truth: The IWU shall include the tag "precondition" in the REQUIRE header or SUPPORTED header in the SIP INVITE request and shall encode preconditions in the SDP offer that the related local preconditions for QoS are not met.

q_22421.question: What is the purpose of the first step in the BC-TCVQ encoding process?
q_22421.ground_truth: The first step in the BC-TCVQ encoding process is to find the closest codeword and corresponding distortion in each subset for each input vector.

q_22422.question: What should be the range of value T if the MS supports EC-GSM-IoT, Category M1 or Category NB1?
q_22422.ground_truth: The value of T should be in the range 2 hours to 240 hours, using 2 hour steps from 2 hours to 80 hours and 4 hour steps from 84 hours to 240 hours.

q_22423.question: What state is an RLC entity in when it is not possible to transfer data through it?

q_22424.question: How should a mobile station handling UTRA Multiple Frequency Band Indicators (MFBI) treat FDD ARFCN values that correspond to different frequency bands but designate the same physical UTRAN frequency?
q_22424.ground_truth: A mobile station supporting UTRA Multiple Frequency Band Indicators (MFBI) should assign each occurrence of a FDD ARFCN an index in the 3G Neighbour Cell list, but only consider the highest index in the list that corresponds to a supported frequency band for measurement reports.

q_22425.question: What is the role of the impulse response in the weighted synthesis filter?
q_22425.ground_truth: The impulse response of the weighted synthesis filter is computed each subframe and is needed for the search of adaptive and fixed codebooks.

q_22426.question: In the context of subclause 14.1.1, under what conditions will the UE update the virtual active set to consist of all cells on frequency Fi considered in that inter-frequency measurement?
q_22426.ground_truth: The UE will update the virtual active set to consist of all cells on frequency Fi if event 1a is not defined for the used frequency in other stored measurements of type "intra-frequency" and the CSG virtual active set is not used for the measurement.

q_22427.question: What does the EVM measurement interval refer to in the uplink direction?
q_22427.ground_truth: The EVM measurement interval in the uplink direction is one slot in the time domain.

q_22428.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with the "Always-on PDU session not allowed" value while the old PDU session is still needed?
q_22428.ground_truth: The UE should not consider the established PDU session as an always-on PDU session.

q_22429.question: What is performed at UE when RRC requests an SDAP entity establishment for unicast, groupcast or broadcast of NR sidelink communication?
q_22429.ground_truth: The UE shall establish an SDAP entity and follow the procedures in clauses 5.2.3 and 5.2.4.

q_22430.question: When does a combined RA/LA update take place during network operation mode I?
q_22430.ground_truth: A combined RA/LA update takes place when the MS enters a new RA, performs an IMSI attach, indicates changed access capabilities or DRX parameters, or undergoes a change in conditions requiring a change in extended idle mode DRX parameters, among other situations.

q_22431.question: What does the AMF provide for MBS session management?
q_22431.ground_truth: The AMF supports MB session management between the NG-RAN and MB-SMF, and notifies the MB-SMF of the MBS capability of NG-RANs in the local service area.

q_22432.question: What are the categories of Information Elements in Diameter commands?
q_22432.ground_truth: The categories of Information Elements in Diameter commands are Mandatory, Conditional, or Optional.

q_22433.question: What is the message that GANC forwards to the MS in Mobile Terminated Call Flow after CN signals that the call resources have been allocated?
q_22433.ground_truth: The GANC signals the completion of the bearer path to the MS with the GA-CSR ACTIVATE CHANNEL COMPLETE message. An end-to-end audio path now exists between the MS and the CN. The MS can now connect the user to the audio path.

q_22434.question: What are the two ways the Secondary PDP Context Activation procedure can be performed?

q_22435.question: What is the requirement for the IRPAgent regarding the logging and alarming of suspended notifications?
q_22435.ground_truth: It's the IRPAgent's decision whether or not the suspended notifications are logged, whether or not they go into the alarmList.

q_22436.question: Which three combinations of CSI-RS transmission and CSI reporting are supported in NR?
q_22436.ground_truth: Periodic CSI-RS, semi-persistent CSI-RS, and aperiodic CSI-RS.

q_22437.question: What information is collected and recorded for 5GS CIoT access and usage in Use Case #7 and #10?
q_22437.ground_truth: In Use Case #7 and #10, the network operator collects and records the 5GS CIoT access information (e.g., NB-IoT RAT type) and usage information (in a PDU session) in terms of NB-IoT technologies.

q_22438.question: What is the main purpose of the analysis of 8.2.2.2, 8.2.2.3, and 8.2.2.4 in DASH-based signalling?
q_22438.ground_truth: The purpose is to identify gaps in the signaling methods of DASH-based signalling.

q_22439.question: How many slots are there in a sidelink subframe, and what is the duration of each slot?
q_22439.ground_truth: A sidelink subframe consists of two consecutive slots, and each slot has a duration of 0.5 milliseconds.

q_22440.question: What message does the UE send to the SRNC to confirm the Active Set Update?
q_22440.ground_truth: The UE sends the RRC message Active Set Update Complete to the SRNC to confirm the Active Set Update.

q_22441.question: What action should the UE take when the received data in the soft buffer has been successfully decoded and no error was detected?
q_22441.ground_truth: The UE should deliver the decoded MAC-hs PDU to the reordering entity and generate a positive acknowledgement (ACK) of the data in this HARQ process.

q_22442.question: What service state is the UE in when there is no connection established between the UE and the RAN?
q_22442.ground_truth: In the UE, this state corresponds to power off or possibly a "no SIM" condition. In the CN, the NULL state corresponds to CS-DETACHED and PS-DETACHED.

q_22443.question: What is the maximum number of cell IDs that can be included in a CellIdList?
q_22443.ground_truth: The maximum number of cell IDs that can be included in a CellIdList is maxNrOfCellIds.

q_22444.question: What are the conditions for the UE Policy Container with indicating the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Information Provisioning request during registration procedure?
q_22444.ground_truth: The UE includes the UE Policy Container with indicating the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Information Provisioning request during registration procedure if it supports 5G ProSe capability as a Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay and does not have valid 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay information.

q_22445.question: What is the significance of the three digits in the version number (x.y.z) of the Technical Specification?
q_22445.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of approval of the document by the TSG. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates. The third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been made to the document.

q_22446.question: What is the expected eCall adoption timeline for new vehicles in the European Union?
q_22446.ground_truth: It is envisioned that eCall will be offered on all new vehicles in the EU by 2010.

q_22447.question: What is the node named "V2XServiceIDtoV2XNRFrequencyMappingRule" used for in the V2XoverNRPC5 node?
q_22447.ground_truth: It contains the mapping rules between the V2X service identifier and V2X NR frequency for V2X communication over the NR-PC5.

q_22448.question: Under which circumstances is the insertion of a transcoder allowed after call set-up?
q_22448.ground_truth: The insertion of a transcoder after call set-up is allowed when there is a change in the call state, such as interruptions, handover to an incompatible partner, or synchronization loss.

q_22449.question: What is the system's capability with regards to negotiating the user's desired language(s) and modalities, per media stream and/or session, in the context of a user equipment (UE)?
q_22449.ground_truth: The system should be able to negotiate the user's desired language(s) and modalities, per media stream and/or session, in order of preference.

q_22450.question: What should the UDM include in the SOR-CMCI if the UE is registered in the HPLMN?
q_22450.ground_truth: If the UE is registered in the HPLMN, the UDM should include the SOR-CMCI, the "Store SOR-CMCI in ME" indicator, and the HPLMN indication that no change of the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list stored in the UE is needed.

q_22451.question: What is the function of the CCA command in the Diameter protocol?
q_22451.ground_truth: The CCA command is used by the PCRF to provision PCC rules and event triggers for the bearer/session and to provide the selected bearer control mode for the IP-CAN session.

q_22452.question: What is the default data rate for both layer 1 options on the Iuant interface in UTRA, E-UTRA, and NR?
q_22452.ground_truth: The default data rate for both layer 1 options is 9.6 kbps.

q_22453.question: What is the primary focus of the NWDAF in terms of data collected from 5GC?
q_22453.ground_truth: The NWDAF calculates the volume of data and amount of transactions dispersed by the UE at each visited location and slice during a period of interest.

q_22454.question: What is the role of the "3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP)" in the production of the present document?
q_22454.ground_truth: The 3GPP is the organization that produced the present document.

q_22455.question: What is the post-condition for an MPS for MMTEL video or video conference call/session?
q_22455.ground_truth: Upon end of the MPS for MMTEL video or video conference call/session, the UE returns to normal conditions, i.e., use of normal MMTEL video service.

q_22456.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network document?
q_22456.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide a descriptive recommendation for cell planning in mobile networks.

q_22457.question: What is the general concept described in section 6.3 of the document which aims to solve key issue #1?
q_22457.ground_truth: The general concept described in section 6.3 of the document aims to use the IMS AS to determine if routing of media traffic via a localized UPF is necessary, then indicating this to the P-CSCF, so that the P-CSCF can use the "AF influence of traffic routing" feature of the 5GC to direct the traffic for a specific media flow to the local UPF.

q_22458.question: What should the HLR do if it receives an unsupported IE from the gsmSCF or the IP-SM-GW?
q_22458.ground_truth: The HLR shall return an error if it does not functionally support an IE which it receives.

q_22459.question: When can a UE use different ProSe Restricted Codes to announce without having to contact the ProSe Function again?
q_22459.ground_truth: If the ProSe Restricted Code Suffix pool contains multiple suffixes, the UE may use different suffixes to form different ProSe Restricted Codes to announce, as long as the ProSe Restricted Code Prefix is valid.

q_22460.question: In what scenario should the UE set the "ME support of SOR-SNPN-SI" indicator to "supported"?
q_22460.ground_truth: The UE may set the "ME support of SOR-SNPN-SI" indicator to "supported" if it supports access to an SNPN (Single Network Packet) using credentials from a credentials holder and the UE is in a PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network).

q_22461.question: What replaces the Charging Key to correlate charging information in the second scenario when both sponsored and non-sponsored IP flows use the same Charging Key?
q_22461.ground_truth: Sponsor Identity and Application Service Provider Identity

q_22462.question: What is the effect of an SS-Status parameter in the CFNRy registration result?
q_22462.ground_truth: The SS-Status parameter in the CFNRy registration result is used to provide backwards compatibility with phase~1 and can be ignored by the MS. The network sets it to reflect the state of the service.

q_22463.question: What is the recommended implementation of IP version for IUR data transport in TSG RAN UTRAN Iur Interface Data Transport and Transport Signalling (Release 17)?
q_22463.ground_truth: IP dual stack support is recommended for the potential transition period from IPv4 to IPv6 in the transport network.

q_22464.question: How many polynomials are used to encode the 23 bits block in sub-clause 5.3a.6.4?

q_22465.question: What is the public user identity for an NGCN site in NGN arrangements?
q_22465.ground_truth: The public user identity, also known as the NGCN site identifier, is a valid corporate network user identifier that has to be owned and managed by the enterprise.

q_22466.question: What action must the MRFC take upon receipt of an SDP offer with Predefined ROI mode?
q_22466.ground_truth: The MRFC must determine based on local policy and ROI negotiation results on other call legs whether to accept the Predefined ROI offer and include the accepted set of predefined ROIs in the SDP answer.

q_22467.question: What is the time alignment timer common included in SIB1?
q_22467.ground_truth: The time alignment timer common included in SIB1 is a timer that is applied in the UE to control the time alignment of the uplink transmission. It is specified in TS 38.304, clause 5.2.2.2.2.

q_22468.question: What is an Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP?
q_22468.ground_truth: An Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a functional capability realized over the Itf-N interface, which is built up by a number of IRPs and a related Name Convention. An IRP usually consists of an IRPManager and an IRPAgent, and there are typically three types of transactions between them: operation invocation, notification, and file transfer.

q_22469.question: What is the difference between network initiated and mobile initiated location services operations?
q_22469.ground_truth: Network initiated location services operations are requested by the network and sent to the mobile station, while mobile initiated location services operations are requested by the mobile station and sent to the network.

q_22470.question: What is the role of the BSF in GBA Push?
q_22470.ground_truth: The BSF, in GBA Push, is the network entity that receives the GBA-Push-Info intended for the UE from the NAF over the Zpn reference point and forwards it over Upa. Additionally, the BSF generates GPI and finds the private identity corresponding to a public identity.

q_22471.question: What is the format of the PDNType leaf in the ProSe UE-to-network relay?
q_22471.ground_truth: The PDNType leaf is of format "chr" (character).

q_22472.question: What function is to enable the transfer of NAS information between UE and CN?
q_22472.ground_truth: The transport of NAS information between UE and CN.

q_22473.question: When is the uplink DPCCH not transmitted in the described procedure?
q_22473.ground_truth: The uplink DPCCH is not transmitted when all of the specified conditions are met for that uplink frequency, which include there being no HARQ-ACK transmission on HS-DPCCH, no CQI transmission on HS-DPCCH, no E-DCH transmission during the UL DPCCH slot, and others.

q_22474.question: What input parameter is added to the calculation of AK in the solution #4.1 to ensure a fresh input in the case of synchronization failure for AKA?
q_22474.ground_truth: MACS is added as an input parameter to the calculation of AK.

q_22475.question: What was the secondary objective of the verification laboratory in checking the source code of the AMR-WB+ decoder?
q_22475.ground_truth: The secondary objective was to ensure that the source code can easily be ported on a DSP target by mapping basic operators or combination of basic operators onto the native intrinsic functions from the target platform.

q_22476.question: What are some examples of possible PTP interactive teleservices offered by a GPRS network administration?
q_22476.ground_truth: Examples include retrieval services (e.g., accessing information from databases), messaging services (e.g., user-to-user communication with store-and-forward mailbox functions), conversational services (e.g., real-time end-to-end information transfer like the Internet's Telnet application), and tele-action services (e.g., low data-volume transactions such as credit card validations).

q_22477.question: What is the procedure for monitoring downlink signals in the 3GPP MS measurement procedure?
q_22477.ground_truth: The procedure for monitoring downlink signals in the 3GPP MS measurement procedure involves the MS measuring the downlink RX signal level and quality from its serving cell and the downlink RX signal level and BSIC of surrounding BTS.

q_22478.question: Under what circumstances will the MS reject a USSD request made by the user or the application in the MS?
q_22478.ground_truth: The MS will reject the request if it is already involved in a USSD or a non-call related supplementary service transaction.

q_22479.question: What is the message unit parameter used for in the context of layer-to-layer communication?
q_22479.ground_truth: The message unit parameter contains additional layer-to-layer information concerning actions and results associated with requests in the context of layer-to-layer communication.

q_22480.question: What should the mobile station do if the network indicates a request for retransmission of the ADDITIONAL MS RADIO ACCESS CAPABILITIES message in the next PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message in the context of multiblock packet access?
q_22480.ground_truth: The mobile station shall send the ADDITIONAL MS RADIO ACCESS CAPABILITIES message as requested.

q_22481.question: What services can be performed by an intermediate SS7-carrier when using a hub-and-spoke architecture for SS7SEGs?
q_22481.ground_truth: An intermediate SS7-carrier can perform tasks such as TCAP user payload modification, protocol interworking, message screening (e.g. SPAM control), advanced reporting, and other security-related functions when using a hub-and-spoke architecture for SS7SEGs.

q_22482.question: What is the initial value of the PTK ID stored in non-volatile memory of the ME?
q_22482.ground_truth: The initial value of the PTK ID stored in non-volatile memory of the ME is one.

q_22483.question: What happens when the MS receives a network initiated USSD request while it is waiting for a response to a mobile initiated request?
q_22483.ground_truth: The MS will process the network initiated USSD request and continue to wait for the response to the mobile initiated request.

q_22484.question: What are the factors that affect the Full sphere bit rate(FS bit rate) in the representative viewport V?
q_22484.ground_truth: The factors that affect the FS bit rate in the representative viewport V include the advertised bit rate for the highest quality for viewport tiles and the lowest quality for non-viewport tiles. The FS bit rate is calculated for the representative viewport V using a higher quality level for the viewport tiles and a lower quality level for the non-viewport tiles, and the viewport with the median FS bit rate is chosen as V.

q_22485.question: In what scenario should the Node B assign the RL Set ID IE included in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message a value that uniquely identifies the RL Set within the Node B Communication Context?
q_22485.ground_truth: For each RL not having a common generation of the TPC commands in the DL with another RL, the Node B shall assign the RL Set ID IE included in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message a value that uniquely identifies the RL Set within the Node B Communication Context.

q_22486.question: What information element is used by the VLR to request open identification of an MS in the MAP_PROVIDE_IMSI request?
q_22486.ground_truth: Identity type is set to IMSI.

q_22487.question: What is required for MExE classmark 2 devices in terms of application installation?
q_22487.ground_truth: MExE classmark 2 devices shall support the Implementation-Title, Main-Icon, and Main-Class and Class-Path JAR file manifest entries for application installation.

q_22488.question: What action does the ng-eNB-CU take when it doesn't receive the Cell Broadcast Cancelled List IE in the PWS CANCEL RESPONSE message?
q_22488.ground_truth: If the Cell Broadcast Cancelled List IE is not included in the PWS CANCEL RESPONSE message, the ng-eNB-CU shall consider that the ng-eNB-DU had no ongoing broadcast to stop for the public warning message identified by the Notification Information IE.

q_22489.question: What does the ReportGroupParameters leaf indicate regarding one-to-many ProSe direct communication in the usage information?
q_22489.ground_truth: The ReportGroupParameters leaf indicates whether or not the UE shall report the group parameters for one-to-many ProSe direct communication in the usage information. The default value is 0, which indicates that the UE shall not report the group parameters for one-to-many ProSe direct communication in the usage information.

q_22490.question: What is the outcome if the PLMN has made contact with the CSE in request mode and the unsuccessful call establishment event occurs?
q_22490.ground_truth: When the PLMN has made contact with the CSE in request mode, the CSE can instruct the PLMN to perform charging activities and activate subsequent control service events for the call by specifying the service events to be detected and reported. The PLMN can then notify the CSE and continue call processing, or suspend call processing, notify the CSE, and await further instructions. In both cases, the PLMN should provide information regarding the event met, type of monitoring, and cause of unsuccessful call establishment.

q_22491.question: What are the two basic building blocks used to describe the layer 3 procedures in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_22491.ground_truth: The two basic building blocks used to describe the layer 3 procedures are elementary procedures and structured procedures.

q_22492.question: What is the expected sequence of commands and responses when the link is dropped?
q_22492.ground_truth: The expected sequence includes the "GET STATUS" command resulting in "Link dropped" and corresponding codes for each channel.

q_22493.question: What kind of information does the generic name of a primitive represent in the context of layer-to-layer communication?
q_22493.ground_truth: The generic name of a primitive represents the activity that the identified layer should perform in the context of layer-to-layer communication.

q_22494.question: What is the role of the Network Manager (NM) in the 3GPP TS 32.432 standard?
q_22494.ground_truth: The Network Manager (NM) is responsible for the management of a network, mainly supported by the EM(s), but it may also involve direct access to the Network Elements. The NM communicates with the network through open and well-standardized interfaces, supporting management of multi-vendor and multi-technology Network Elements.

q_22495.question: What is the effect of activating the Communication Hold (HOLD) service in a communication?
q_22495.ground_truth: Activating the HOLD service will not result in the CCNL communication being established if the originating party is busy or CCNL busy, and the terminating party is available.

q_22496.question: What should the UE do with the timer T3396 if it is running and a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message was received for a non-emergency PDU session?
q_22496.ground_truth: The UE should not stop the timer T3396 associated with no DNN if it is running.

q_22497.question: What is the main difference between "CommonTransportChannelResourcesResponseFDD" and "CommonTransportChannelResourcesResponseTDD"?
q_22497.ground_truth: Although both sequences share a common purpose of providing transport channel resource response information, the main difference between them lies in the frequency division duplex (FDD) and time division duplex (TDD) aspects. The FDD version focuses on FDD-related information, while the TDD variant handles TDD-specific information.

q_22498.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with Identity type IE set to "SUCI" and timer T3519 is not running?
q_22498.ground_truth: The UE generates a fresh SUCI, sends an IDENTITY RESPONSE message with the SUCI, starts timer T3519, and stores the SUCI sent in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.

q_22499.question: Under what conditions should the IWF include the warning text "149 SIP INFO request pending" in a Warning header field in the SIP 200 (OK) response?
q_22499.ground_truth: The IWF should include this warning text in the SIP 200 (OK) response if the received SIP re-INVITE request contains an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert cancellation and a value of "true" for the alert-ind element.

q_22500.question: What modifications are required in Step 11 and Step 12 for the restricted discovery model A in the DUIHC solution?
q_22500.ground_truth: In Step 11, the broadcasted MIC should be computed using links in the DUIHC, and in Step 12, the source authenticity of the received message should be verified using the received anchor of the DUIHC.

q_22501.question: What should the mobile equipment (ME) do if it identifies an emergency number dialed by the end user as a valid emergency number?
q_22501.ground_truth: The ME should initiate emergency call establishment if it occurs under one or more of the specified conditions, and normal call establishment otherwise.

q_22502.question: What is the purpose of the Virtual Noise Generator (VNG) in the SS and controlled by TTCN?
q_22502.ground_truth: The VNG in the SS is used to provide noise interference at a well-defined level for one or several NR cells.

q_22503.question: What is the role of the polyphase index in the LTP filtering process?
q_22503.ground_truth: The polyphase index of the filter is determined by the fractional pitch lag. It is used in the polyphase FIR filter to predict the signal in the LTP filtered signal computation.

q_22504.question: When calculating a position after performing measurements, what action should the UE take if it supports UE GPS timing of cell frames measurement or if the "GPS timing of Cell wanted" is set to FALSE?
q_22504.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "GPS TOW msec" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT.

q_22505.question: What message does the UE optionally send in response to a EMSDP Session Start Confirmation?
q_22505.ground_truth: The UE optionally sends an EMSDP Session Start Confirmation message, if requested.

q_22506.question: In equation (1100), what does the noise filling factor represent?
q_22506.ground_truth: The noise filling factor is a value that determines the amount of noise to be added to the decoded coefficients in the noise filling process. It is calculated based on the smoothed noise gain and the inverse of the square root of the sub-band energy.

q_22507.question: What is the equation for calculating the block maximum xmaxc in the APCM quantization of the selected RPE sequence clause?
q_22507.ground_truth: The maximum of the absolute values of xM(i) is selected and quantized logarithmically with 6~bits as xmaxc in the APCM quantization of the selected RPE sequence clause.

q_22508.question: When is the provisioning of an interface for file contents verification necessary, with regards to the UE and the EUT?
q_22508.ground_truth: The provisioning of an interface for file contents verification is necessary when the implicit verification of test results is not sufficient in some test cases and additional verification methods are required for the EUT.

q_22509.question: What is the purpose of the TFO Information field in TRAU frames and when should it be used?
q_22509.ground_truth: The TFO Information field is used to indicate support for Tandem Free Operation (TFO) in TRAU frames. It should be used when TFO is supported and enabled, and the corresponding codes should be ignored if TFO is not supported or disabled.

q_22510.question: What is the purpose of the Edge Enabler Server in de-registering an Edge Application Server?
q_22510.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server de-registers an Edge Application Server for load balancing purposes.

q_22511.question: What is the goal of EAS Termination in the specification level use cases and requirements?
q_22511.ground_truth: The goal of EAS Termination is to enable the ASP to request for termination of the EAS in a particular EDN and manage the lifecycle of the EAS (instantiation, termination, scaling, etc.).

q_22512.question: How many interfaces are there in the 3GPP management system, as per the given document, and what are they responsible for?
q_22512.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system consists of a PLMN management system, responsible for the orchestration and management of the mobile networks, and an ECSP management system, responsible for the orchestration and management of the EDN.

q_22513.question: Which carrier frequency are all cells on in the test?
q_22513.ground_truth: All cells are on the same carrier frequency in the test.

q_22514.question: What information does the ProSe Key Management Function include in the Key Response message if the UE supports the required algorithm?
q_22514.ground_truth: If the UE supports the required algorithm, the Key Response message includes the Group Member Identity and the EPS encryption algorithm identifier that the UE should use when sending or receiving protected data for this group.

q_22515.question: What is the purpose of the Measurement Results information element in 3G UMTS?
q_22515.ground_truth: The Measurement Results information element is used to provide the results of the measurements made by the mobile station on the serving cell and the neighbor cells in 3G UMTS.

q_22516.question: What is the action taken by the initial AMF when it obtains the old security context from the old AMF in case of AMF reallocation?
q_22516.ground_truth: When the initial AMF obtains the old security context from the old AMF in case of AMF reallocation, it sends a security mode command (SMC) message if it decides to take into use the derived security context.

q_22517.question: What is the procedure for Distributed anchor and multiple sessions (SSC mode 3) where the 5GC triggers move of PSA due to UE mobility?
q_22517.ground_truth: The UE has ongoing application traffic, 5GC triggers move of PSA, UE sets up a new PDU session and gets a DNS server address from 5GC, UE issues a discovery of a new AS, and once new AS address is received, the UE can start using the new AS based on UE's application implementation.

q_22518.question: What is the purpose of the "UE Reachability" monitoring event in high latency communication?
q_22518.ground_truth: The "UE Reachability" monitoring event is used to send event notifications to application servers when a UE becomes reachable, indicating that the UE is available for data transfer.

q_22519.question: What are the BER values corresponding to the 8 levels of RXQUAL outlined in subclause 8.2.4?
q_22519.ground_truth: The BER values corresponding to the 8 levels of RXQUAL are given for each RXQUAL level in subclause 8.2.4.

q_22520.question: What should be done if no positive or negative acquisition indicator corresponding to the selected signature is detected in the downlink access slot corresponding to the selected uplink access slot, and the Preamble Retransmission Counter is greater than 0?
q_22520.ground_truth: The Preamble Retransmission Counter should be decreased by one, and if it is still greater than 0, the procedure should be repeated from step 5. Otherwise, L1 status ("No ack on AICH") should be passed to the higher layers (MAC) and the physical random access procedure should be exited.

q_22521.question: What happens in the post-condition of the Cell Re-home scenario?
q_22521.ground_truth: The operator's intent that the selected Cell is re-homed to the destination RAN Node is fulfilled by the MnS Producer.

q_22522.question: What BMI threshold is considered for Jack to undergo a kidney transplant operation, given his medical history?
q_22522.ground_truth: Jack's BMI should be below 40 kg/m2 to qualify for a kidney transplant operation.

q_22523.question: What is the instruction for the C-APDU in the PROACTIVE COMMAND PERFORM CARD APDU 1.1.1?

q_22524.question: What should the Node B do if the Serving Cell Change CFN IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
q_22524.ground_truth: The Node B should activate the resources that are allocated for the new additional serving E-DCH Radio Link at the next coming CFN with a value equal to the value requested by the RNC.

q_22525.question: Where is rrc-StateIndicator used in the RRCConnectionSetup-IEs sequence?
q_22525.ground_truth: It is used to indicate the RRC state of the UE into which the DRB will be setup.

q_22526.question: What is the purpose of PDU Session secondary A&A for a Remote UE via Relay UE?
q_22526.ground_truth: The purpose of PDU Session secondary A&A for a Remote UE via Relay UE is to provide a secondary authentication and authorization for a Remote UE over a PDU Session using a network-controlled authorization procedure. This helps to ensure that the Remote UE is compliant with the necessary prerequisites for accessing the PDU Session.

q_22527.question: What are the additional back-off requirements for the PC2 2Tx MPR measurements?
q_22527.ground_truth: The additional back-off required was 1dB for outer allocations and 1dB for inner allocations compared to the corresponding 1Tx PC2 MPR.

q_22528.question: What is the purpose of the bulk transfer of multimedia from ground to train in the FRMCS system?
q_22528.ground_truth: The bulk transfer of multimedia from ground to train in the FRMCS system is to minimize the excessive consumption of network capacity between train and ground by transferring multimedia databases during stops at stations, stops, and depots with minimum one gigabit transfer speed.

q_22529.question: What command is sent by the USIM simulator to the ME in expected sequence 1.1?
q_22529.ground_truth: PROACTIVE COMMAND: GET STATUS 1.1.1 is sent by the USIM simulator to the ME in expected sequence 1.1.

q_22530.question: What are the source and destination devices for the initial PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP CALL command?
q_22530.ground_truth: The source device for the initial PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP CALL command is the UICC, while the destination device is the Network.

q_22531.question: What type of interface does a 3G ME of R99 or Rel-4 provide for supporting a 2G SIM in addition to the 3G UICC interface?
q_22531.ground_truth: A 3G ME of R99 or Rel-4 provides a 2G SIM interface for supporting a 2G SIM in addition to the 3G UICC interface.

q_22532.question: What is the task of the PSAP transmitter upon detecting the synchronization frame in eCall?
q_22532.ground_truth: Upon detecting the synchronization frame in eCall, the PSAP transmitter sends a series of NACK messages until a successful CRC check of the MSD message is obtained. After successful MSD detection, the PSAP transmitter sends link-layer ACK messages and/or the higher-layer ACK (HL-ACK).

q_22533.question: What is the requirement for using the Supported-Features AVP on the S9 reference point in terms of diameter session?
q_22533.ground_truth: Any further command messages shall always be compliant with the list of supported features indicated in the Supported-Features AVPs during session establishment. Features that are not advertised as supported shall not be used to construct command messages for that Diameter session.

q_22534.question: What is the function of the Timing Advance (TA) and common TA parameters in the NTN cell?
q_22534.ground_truth: The Timing Advance (TA) and common TA parameters in the NTN cell are used to achieve uplink synchronization. A UE must acquire its GNSS position, satellite ephemeris, and common TA before connecting to an NTN cell.

q_22535.question: What does the measurement 4.34.1.1.2 signify in the context of HSUPA?
q_22535.ground_truth: The measurement 4.34.1.1.2 provides the number of successful Mac-d setups for HSUPA, which suggests the successful establishment of E-DCH connections for uplink packet data transmission.

q_22536.question: What is the first action of the AS when applying the early session model in the CAT service?
q_22536.ground_truth: Upon receiving the first SIP 18x response containing an early-session SDP offer with a "g.3gpp.cat" value, the AS will decide which CAT service should have priority based on the operator policy and the calling party's preferences.

q_22537.question: What is the purpose of the UE SS-RSRPB per receiver branch reporting?
q_22537.ground_truth: The UE SS-RSRPB per receiver branch reporting is used to command the UE to report SS-RSRP per UE receiver branch. The report from the UE is a vector of values, where the number of the reported values equals the number of receiver branches on the UE.

q_22538.question: What is the basic information contained in the minimum system information (SI) in this network?
q_22538.ground_truth: The minimum SI comprises basic information required for initial access to a cell and information for acquiring any other SI broadcast periodically or provisioned on-demand, such as scheduling information.

q_22539.question: What is the role of the "business trunking application" in the NGN?
q_22539.ground_truth: The business trunking application in the NGN is an application that provides transit capabilities between NGCNs, as well as break-in capabilities from NGN to NGCN and break-out capabilities from NGCN to NGN. It can also provide additional services beyond basic break-in, break-out, and transit capabilities to the NGCN.

q_22540.question: What is the out-of-band Test Tolerance (TT) value for the frequency range 0 - 10 MHz from the carrier for OTA OBUE and OTA SEM?
q_22540.ground_truth: The out-of-band TT value is 0 dB for the frequency range 0 - 10 MHz from the carrier for OTA OBUE and OTA SEM.

q_22541.question: What is the Repeater Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) as defined in section 6.6.1.1?
q_22541.ground_truth: The Repeater EVM is a measure of the difference between the input symbols provided to the repeater and the measured output symbols after equalization by the measurement equipment.

q_22542.question: What is a hybrid cell in the context of 3GPP mobile networks?
q_22542.ground_truth: A hybrid cell is a cell that is broadcasting a CSG identity which is accessible as a CSG cell by UEs which are members of the CSG and as a normal cell by all other UEs.

q_22543.question: What is the protocol used for the Nt application in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_22543.ground_truth: The Nt application is defined as a vendor specific Diameter application, where the vendor is 3GPP and the Application-ID for the Nt application in the present release is 16777348. The PCRF acts as a Diameter server, and the SCEF acts as the Diameter client in the Nt application.

q_22544.question: What is the function of the MAC-is PDU descriptor field in TDD?
q_22544.ground_truth: The MAC-is PDU descriptor field in TDD contains the Length (L), Logical channel identifier (LCH-ID) and Flag (F) fields, which are mapped directly from the "MAC-i Header n" field received over the Uu.

q_22545.question: What is the role of the CHF in the process of creating a Session with QoS?
q_22545.ground_truth: The CHF stores received information and creates a CDR related to the event when it receives a charging data request for the creation or update of a Session with QoS.

q_22546.question: How does the ITT4RT-Rx client decode a tiled video with mixed-quality in a single RTP stream?
q_22546.ground_truth: All tiles can be packaged and delivered in a single RTP stream and can be decoded using a single decoder when all tiles are decoded together. In case of mixed-resolution, packing information needs to be signaled to the receiver, which uses it for rendering after decoding.

q_22547.question: What should the DRNC do when the UL Uu synchronisation of one or more Radio Link Sets is re-established in FDD?
q_22547.ground_truth: The DRNC shall send the RADIO LINK RESTORE INDICATION message to the SRNC when the E-DCH processing issue condition has ceased, and if the re-established UL Uu synchronisation concerns one or more Radio Link Sets, the DRNC shall include the RL Set Information IE to indicate the affected Radio Link Set(s).

q_22548.question: Who is responsible for keeping the Collaborative Session control after transferring Media-B in the scenario where UE-1 invites UE-2 to participate in the Collaborative Session?
q_22548.ground_truth: UE-1 keeps the Collaborative Session control after transferring Media-B in the scenario where UE-1 invites UE-2 to participate in the Collaborative Session.

q_22549.question: What factor determines the difference in subcarrier spacing between the random access preamble and uplink data transmission in the generation of the time-continuous random access signal?
q_22549.ground_truth: The variable q accounts for this difference.

q_22550.question: What should the UE do if both the "Frequency info" and the "Second Frequency info" IEs are included in a 1.28 Mcps TDD message, and the secondary frequency is different from the currently used frequency?
