q_22550.ground_truth: The UE should store and use the secondary frequency as the working frequency.

q_22551.question: What must the AS do upon expiry of the T~AS-CW timer?
q_22551.ground_truth: Upon expiry of the T~AS-CW timer, the AS shall send a CANCEL request and a 480 (Temporarily unavailable) response towards the respective users.

q_22552.question: What is the role of the ECSP in the deployment of edge enabler server(s)?
q_22552.ground_truth: The ECSP is responsible for instantiating and terminating one or more EES on the EDN in the deployment of edge enabler server(s), based on the requests and deployment requirements from the ASP or PLMN operator.

q_22553.question: Which request primitive does the SGSN use to send the Radio Access capability of an MS to the BSS in 5.3.6?

q_22554.question: In what situation does the HSS return the S-CSCF name assigned for a Public Identity in the registration procedure?
q_22554.ground_truth: The HSS returns the S-CSCF name assigned for a Public Identity when the user is registered and has terminating services related to unregistered state or when the request contains the Originating-Request AVP.

q_22555.question: What does Octet 6..7 in the Extended Object specify?
q_22555.ground_truth: Octet 6..7 in the Extended Object indicates the absolute character position within the message text after which the object shall be played or displayed.

q_22556.question: What happens to the MBS Session context when the MBS Session is deactivated by 5GC?
q_22556.ground_truth: The MBS Session context is kept in 5GC but changed to Inactivate state.

q_22557.question: Which document defines the interface models and mapping functions for 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication management, Home Node B (HNB) and Home eNode B (HeNB) management, Type 2 interface?

q_22558.question: What is the purpose of the network publishing server and indication of UAS flight authorization solution?
q_22558.ground_truth: This solution addresses the key issue of providing the UAS with the address of the approved database for network publishing when seeking flight authorization from the USS. This allows for optimal choice of location of the database for network publishing.

q_22559.question: Which category of evaluation criteria does "Resilience against forged information on the UC originating source and UC source versatility" belong to in the context of UC prevention?
q_22559.ground_truth: This evaluation criterion belongs to the 'Essential' category, as it is essential for providing basic and reliable UC protection functionality in UC prevention.

q_22560.question: What is the importance of the first digit in the version number of 3GPP technical documents?
q_22560.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of 3GPP technical documents indicates the stage of the document, such as whether it is presented for information, for approval, or is a TSG approved document under change control.

q_22561.question: What is the purpose of sending the CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE message during a mobile terminating call establishment?
q_22561.ground_truth: It indicates that the network has completed the through connection of the communication path.

q_22562.question: In the CAMEL-FCIBillingChargingCharacteristics choice, what does the parameter freeFormatData represent?
q_22562.ground_truth: It is an octet string that contains free format data for billing and charging characteristics, with a size between a minimum and maximum length.

q_22563.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group's study on improved end-to-end Quality of Service (QoS) handling for Multimedia Telephony Service for IMS (MTSI)?
q_22563.ground_truth: The study investigates potential improvements for the end-to-end QoS handling with the purpose to improve the network resource allocation for variable bit-rate codecs, rate-adaptive codecs and asymmetric sessions (i.e. different bitrates for different directions) in MTSI.

q_22564.question: How does the UE determine whether to allow access attempts in the NB-IoT network?
q_22564.ground_truth: The UE allows access attempts if it is a member of at least one access class which corresponds to the permitted classes as signalled over the air interface, and the access class is applicable in the serving network.

q_22565.question: How should the value of the schemaVersion element and version attribute be increased for future releases?
q_22565.ground_truth: The value of the schemaVersion element and version attribute should be increased by 1 in every future release where new elements or attributes are added.

q_22566.question: How many slots are there in a 10 ms radio frame in UTRA TDD?
q_22566.ground_truth: In UTRA TDD, a 10 ms radio frame is divided into 15 slots (2560 chip/slot or 5120 chip/slot depending on the option).

q_22567.question: What is the purpose of the back-off mode for MBMS download?
q_22567.ground_truth: The back-off mode for MBMS download is used to provide information on when a receiver, that did not correctly receive some data from the MBMS sender during a transmission session, can start a request for a repair session.

q_22568.question: Why is ciphering disabled for all RLC test cases?
q_22568.ground_truth: Ciphering is disabled for all RLC test cases to be tested implicitly by other test cases that have ciphering enabled.

q_22569.question: What is the document that defines CAP (Cellular Advanced Protocol) for Rel-6, including operation codes, data types, and error types?
q_22569.ground_truth: The document that defines CAP for Rel-6 is CAP-object-identifiers, with the object identifier 'itu-t(0) identified-organization(4) etsi(0) mobileDomain(0) umts-network(1) modules(3) cap-object-identifiers(100) version8(7)'.

q_22570.question: What information does the Radio Resource Loading List IE present?
q_22570.ground_truth: The Radio Resource Loading List IE presents the available bandwidth available for Broadcast purposes of a specific Service Area.

q_22571.question: What information elements are specified in Assistance Data Reference Time in 5.1.3.1 of TS 25.331?
q_22571.ground_truth: Reference Time, occurring once per message, is specified in Assistance Data Reference Time in 5.1.3.1 of TS 25.331.

q_22572.question: In the same scenario as Question 1, how is a message originating from an authorized Application Server delivered to a Legacy 3GPP UE?
q_22572.ground_truth: The MSGin5G application layer delivers the message to the Legacy 3GPP Message Gateway, which then converts the message format and delivers it to the Legacy 3GPP UE.

q_22573.question: What kind of authentication vectors does UDM support generating?
q_22573.ground_truth: UDM supports generating UTRAN authentication vectors, as well as converting them into 5GS authentication vectors, to support authentication in 5G.

q_22574.question: What was the processing step that was applied to all original source sequences in the test setup?
q_22574.ground_truth: The processing steps applied to all original source sequences in the test setup were pre-processing, video encoding & decoding, transcoding, and video upscale and rendering by terminals.

q_22575.question: What does the UE-RadioAccessCapability sequence contain in terms of the 3GPP specification?
q_22575.ground_truth: The UE-RadioAccessCapability sequence contains the capability of a user's equipment to connect to a 3GPP network. It includes information about the user equipment's physical channel capabilities, RLC capabilities, and various other network-related capabilities.

q_22576.question: What should a UE, acting as a Participant, do during session initiation for mobile originating cases in session-mode messaging?
q_22576.ground_truth: The UE must use the call initiation procedure specified in 3GPP TS 24.229, with the Request URI header including the URI of the terminating participant.

q_22577.question: What are Public Safety ProSe-enabled UEs capable of when operating on public safety spectrum even when not served by E-UTRAN?
q_22577.ground_truth: Public Safety ProSe-enabled UEs can use ProSe when operating on public safety spectrum even when not served by E-UTRAN, with at least a one-time pre-authorization needed.

q_22578.question: What is the purpose of Mobile-services Switching Centre/Interworking Functions (MSC/IWFs) within the 3GPP system?
q_22578.ground_truth: The Mobile-services Switching Centre/Interworking Functions (MSC/IWFs) in the 3GPP system support interworking between PLMN and PSTN or PLMN and ISDN for circuit-switched services.

q_22579.question: What is the purpose of the Out-of-sequence Extended Highest Sequence Number Received Test?
q_22579.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to check if the "extended last sequence number received" field in the receiver report sent from the SUT is consistent with RTP "sequence number" field sent by data injection, even when the "sequence number" field in RTP packets sent by data injection is not monotonically incrementing.

q_22580.question: In what scenarios is a mobile station not required to decode the paging subchannels while in packet transfer mode?
q_22580.ground_truth: A mobile station in packet transfer mode is not required to decode the paging subchannels on neither CCCH nor PCCCH if it is not capable of handling an RR connection and a TBF simultaneously (GPRS class B mode of operation) or if it requires the BSS to co-ordinate the allocation of radio resources for an RR connection and one or more simultaneous TBFs (GPRS class A mode of operation by means of DTM).

q_22581.question: What message type is sent on the EC-CCCH by the network to assign uplink packet resources to a mobile station using the RACH and having enabled EC operation?

q_22582.question: What is the purpose of the SIP REFER request during a media transfer from the controller UE to the controllee UE?
q_22582.ground_truth: The SIP REFER request is used to trigger the sending of a SIP re-INVITE request from the SCC AS to the controllee UE for the media transfer.

q_22583.question: What is one possible solution for RedCap UAC with no specification impact?
q_22583.ground_truth: Using some of the operator defined Access Categories for RedCap is a possible solution for RedCap UAC with no specification impact.

q_22584.question: What does the "Voice Support Match Indicator" indicate in UTRAN?
q_22584.ground_truth: This element indicates if the SRVCC and frequency supported by the UE match those the network relies upon for voice coverage.

q_22585.question: How does the encoding complexity at the UE compare between simulcast and SHVC encoding for the MBMS use case?
q_22585.ground_truth: SHVC encoding at the UE is typically less complex than simulcast encoding.

q_22586.question: What is the purpose of the network policy management in 5G mobile networks, as specified in the document?
q_22586.ground_truth: The network policy management in 5G mobile networks specifies the concepts, requirements, and use cases for managing network policies in 5G networks.

q_22587.question: What is the purpose of the present document in the 3GPP Technical Specification family?
q_22587.ground_truth: The present document is part of a TS-family that covers the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects; Telecommunication management; as identified in 32.601, 32.602, and 32.606. This specific document defines the mapping of the Basic CM IRP to the IS for implementation in a CORBA/IDL and SOAP/WSDL environment.

q_22588.question: What is the difference between Element Management Functions and Sub-Network Management Functions in the context of 3GPP specifications?
q_22588.ground_truth: Element Management Functions are used for management of network elements on an individual basis, while Sub-Network Management Functions are used for a network model for a set of Network Elements constituting a clearly defined sub-network, which may include relations between the Network Elements.

q_22589.question: What action does the P-CSCF take if it receives a REGISTER request that is not integrity protected?
q_22589.ground_truth: The P-CSCF attaches an indication that the REGISTER request was not integrity protected.

q_22590.question: What should be the redirection behavior for terminating a service when more than one device is activated?
q_22590.ground_truth: When more than one device is activated for a terminating service, the service should be directed to all devices that are currently reachable for the network (PS attached or IMS registered). The PN-User should be made aware of charging implications caused by activation of more than one UE for directing of the same service.

q_22591.question: What is the requirement for CR~3 in the PIN2 unblocking procedure?
q_22591.ground_truth: Indication of a successful and unsuccessful PIN2 verification is presented to the user and only the new PIN2 shall be accepted for further PIN2 verification.

q_22592.question: What is the purpose of the "a=rtcp-fb" attribute in MMCMH?
q_22592.ground_truth: The "a=rtcp-fb" attribute in MMCMH is used to negotiate RTP-level pause and resume functionality via SDP offer/answer exchange, allowing for pausing and resuming of RTP streams between conference participants.

q_22593.question: How does the UE or HA indicate the trust relationship to the other party during the creation of child security association procedure in the DSMIPv6 tunnel?
q_22593.ground_truth: The trust relationship is indicated in the procedure by the selectors in the CREATE_CHILD_SA message. If the trust relationship is "untrusted", the child security association establishment is rejected.

q_22594.question: How many deliveryMethod element instances are present in the fourth example User Service Description?
q_22594.ground_truth: There are four deliveryMethod element instances in the fourth example User Service Description.

q_22595.question: What is the action taken by the higher layers of the TE upon the initiation of the establishment of a DLC from the UE?
q_22595.ground_truth: The action taken by the higher layers of the TE upon the initiation of the establishment of a DLC from the UE is outside the scope of the present document.

q_22596.question: What are the two major types of interfaces to other management systems in PLMN management?
q_22596.ground_truth: The two major types of interfaces to other management systems in PLMN management are to the Operations Systems of another PLMN Organisation and to the Operations Systems of a non-PLMN Organisation.

q_22597.question: What shall a UE in camped normal state consider as the lowest priority frequency?
q_22597.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the current frequency to be the lowest priority frequency in this case.

q_22598.question: What is the purpose of the Logical Link Control (LLC) layer in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_22598.ground_truth: The Logical Link Control (LLC) layer in the 3GPP technical specification defines the protocol used for packet data transfer between the Mobile Station (MS) and Serving GPRS Support Node (SGSN) in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) network.

q_22599.question: Which interfaces does the AMR speech codec support in the 3GPP system?
q_22599.ground_truth: The AMR speech codec supports the Iu, Uu, and Nb interfaces in the 3GPP system.

q_22600.question: What is the role of an Enterprise System in the management of a telecommunications network?
q_22600.ground_truth: Enterprise Systems are Information Systems that are used in the telecommunication organisation but are not directly or essentially related to the telecommunications aspects.

q_22601.question: What should a BSS or SGSN do if it does not receive a BVC-RESET-ACK PDU within T2 seconds after sending a BVC-RESET PDU?
q_22601.ground_truth: If the BSS or SGSN does not receive a BVC-RESET-ACK PDU within T2 seconds after sending a BVC-RESET PDU, the BVC-RESET procedure should be repeated a maximum of BVC-RESET-RETRIES attempts. If the BVC-RESET-RETRIES attempts fail, the procedure should be stopped and the O&M system should be informed.

q_22602.question: What is the purpose of the DedicatedMeasurementReport-IEs data type?
q_22602.ground_truth: The DedicatedMeasurementReport-IEs data type is used to define a set of ProtocolIEs for the DedicatedMeasurementReport structure.

q_22603.question: Which downlink reference channels are used to fulfill the open loop diversity performance requirement for the HS-DSCH, as specified in section 9.2.2, in multi-path fading environments with QPSK modulation, and using the fixed reference channels H-Set 1/2/3/3A/3B/3C/3E?
q_22603.ground_truth: The reference channels H-Set 1/2/3/3A/3B/3C/3E (QPSK version) specified in Annex A.7.1.1, A.7.1.2, and A.7.1.3 should be used for this requirement.

q_22604.question: Which solution proposes to enhance SEAL location management to support FFAPP geographic location and high accuracy positioning requirements?
q_22604.ground_truth: Solution #7 proposes to enhance SEAL location management to support FFAPP geographic location and high accuracy positioning requirements.

q_22605.question: What does the first digit of the version number in the document represent?
q_22605.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number represents the stage of approval of the document by the TSG. A value of 0 indicates that the document is presented to the TSG for information, 1 indicates that it is presented for approval, and 3 or greater indicates that it is a TSG approved document under change control.

q_22606.question: What are the conditions that a User Equipment (UE) needs to evaluate for traffic steering from WLAN to UTRAN in terms of Qrxlevmeas and Qqualmeas?
q_22606.ground_truth: The UE needs to evaluate if Qrxlevmeas is greater than ThreshServingOffloadWLAN, High and Qqualmeas is greater than ThreshServingOffloadWLAN, High2 for traffic steering from WLAN to UTRAN.

q_22607.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with an Authorized QoS rules IE?
q_22607.ground_truth: The UE processes the QoS rules sequentially starting with the first QoS rule and replaces the stored authorized QoS rules, authorized QoS flow descriptions, and session-AMBR of the PDU session with the received value(s), if any, in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message.

q_22608.question: Which INTEGER value in the GPS-UTC-Model range (0..7) represents 32 bit a0 in GPS UTC Model?

q_22609.question: What constraint does Rel-15 MR-DC handling have in UP IP, specifically in the NGEN-DC scenario when the UP security policy is "required"?
q_22609.ground_truth: In NGEN-DC scenario and UP security policy is "required", the MN (eNB) rejects bearer establishment.

q_22610.question: Which QoS coordination method needs to be studied to support QoS based communications for one or more FFAPP applications between the devices when not using TSN?
q_22610.ground_truth: QoS coordination method for device-to-device type FFAPP applications not based on TSN

q_22611.question: What must the CSI AS include when it sends a SIP re-INVITE request or SIP UPDATE request to the MGCF with updated SDP media description for voice?
q_22611.ground_truth: The CSI AS must include the Request-URI and the To header field set to the URI received from the MGCF in the Contact header field, and a new SDP offer, including the media characteristics as received in the SIP re-INVITE or a SIP UPDATE request.

q_22612.question: What is the purpose of the "GPS Assistance Data" information element in 3GPP TS 24.008?
q_22612.ground_truth: The "GPS Assistance Data" information element is used to indicate the requested GPS assistance data in a variable length information element.

q_22613.question: Which type of normative element should not use the construction "may not"?
q_22613.ground_truth: Ambiguous normative elements should not use the construction "may not".

q_22614.question: What is one of the general requirements applicable to multimedia sessions between UEs that use IMS origination and UEs that use CSI termination?
q_22614.ground_truth: It shall be possible to interwork between IMS origination and CSI termination for sessions that include a real-time (e.g. voice) components.

q_22615.question: What message is used by the MS to indicate failure to establish the channel to the GANC?

q_22616.question: What is one of the actions taken by the BSS during the execution phase of the handover?
q_22616.ground_truth: During the execution phase of the handover, the BSS sends the "PS Handover Required Acknowledge" message to the SGSN to continue the handover process.

q_22617.question: What is the purpose of the ExpiryTime parameter in the RF?
q_22617.ground_truth: The ExpiryTime parameter is used to ensure correct charging of different scenarios by setting the validity period for tariff information between two tariff switches.

q_22618.question: What type of data is contained in Event CDRs?
q_22618.ground_truth: Event CDRs contain accumulated or detailed talk burst usage data, which includes duration, volume, and number of talk bursts.

q_22619.question: In which scenario is a pre-quota announcement requested at IMS session initiation along with a post-quota announcement at final quota exhaust?

q_22620.question: What message does the CTS-MS send in response to a CTS PAGING REQUEST message with an indication of Alive Check?
q_22620.ground_truth: The CTS-MS sends 2 CTS ACCESS REQUEST messages.

q_22621.question: In what situations can the MME use alternative approaches for LAI and TAI list allocation for CS fallback?
q_22621.ground_truth: The MME can use alternative approaches in situations such as SMS over SGs without overlapping GERAN/UTRAN coverage or when not all MSCs in the VPLMN support the SGs interface.

q_22622.question: In which order should the MS attempt to access higher priority PLMN/access technology combinations?
q_22622.ground_truth: The MS should limit its attempts to access higher priority PLMN/access technology combinations to those of the same country as the current serving VPLMN, and only consider the priority levels of Equivalent PLMNs of the same country.

q_22623.question: What should be done before executing the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: LAUNCH BROWSER" sequence in the LAUNCH BROWSER (UCS2 Display in Chinese) test?
q_22623.ground_truth: The mobile should be busy in a WAP session, the browser's cache should have been cleared before the execution of the test sequence and the Bearer Parameters defined in 27.22.4.26.1.4.1 should be used.

q_22624.question: What information might the sender need to send to the user regarding overlays in the first scenario?
q_22624.ground_truth: The sender needs to send information about the overlays such as number of overlays, layering, priority, etc. to the user via SDP offer.

q_22625.question: What is the structure of the RL-Set-InformationItemIE-RL-FailureInd sequence within the NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES?
q_22625.ground_truth: The RL-Set-InformationItemIE-RL-FailureInd sequence is a SEQUENCE containing an rL-Set-ID, a cause, and an optional iE-Extensions within the NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES.

q_22626.question: What is the difference in SSB link budget between 120 kHz and 480 kHz SCS for coverage?
q_22626.ground_truth: The MCL and MIL difference between 120 kHz SCS and 480 kHz SCS for coverage in SSB link budget is about 5 dB.

q_22627.question: What should be the maximum MAC-d PDU length when transmitting the MAC-ehs PDU on the Uu interface using the dedicated H-RNTI for DCCH/DTCH when the actual HS-DSCH physical layer category is not known to Node B?
q_22627.ground_truth: If the actual HS-DSCH physical layer category is not known to Node B or the usage of the actual UE category is not supported, the Node B should use category 12 and limit the MAC-ehs PDU size to not more than 1572 bits.

q_22628.question: What is the result of a successful GA-RC REGISTER UPDATE UPLOAD message processing in the network?
q_22628.ground_truth: If the network accepts the Registration Update, no message is returned to the MS.

q_22629.question: What threat is introduced if the two UEs cannot be mutually authenticated during one-to-one communication?
q_22629.ground_truth: A peer may connect to an attacker.

q_22630.question: What should the MS discriminate to identify the second RTTI block in the 20 ms time unit as a "GMSK RTTI block"?
q_22630.ground_truth: The MS should discriminate between '0,0,0,1' and the other stealing flags settings indicating CS1/CS2/CS3 in the second RTTI block in the 20 ms time unit.

q_22631.question: What is the length of the time-domain SHB signal in this process, before it is divided into sub-frames?

q_22632.question: What is the mix of technologies used in the downlink and uplink of the subclause discussed?
q_22632.ground_truth: There is a mix of EDGE and HOT MS in both uplink and downlink.

q_22633.question: What is the consequence if the interface between 3GPP VNF and VNFM is not protected in a GVNP of type 1?
q_22633.ground_truth: If the interface is not protected, an attacker can attack all the requests/responses sent between the VNF and the VNFM, potentially causing denial-of-service (DoS) attacks, information leakage, or affecting the normal operation of the instantiated GVNP of type 1.

q_22634.question: What is the maximum value that "maxNrOfCellPortionsPerCell" can take?
q_22634.ground_truth: The maximum value that "maxNrOfCellPortionsPerCell" can take is determined by the implementation of this specification.

q_22635.question: What is the purpose of the Tsp reference point in the 3GPP network?
q_22635.ground_truth: The Tsp reference point lies between the Service Capability Server (SCS) and the Machine Type Communication Inter Working Function (MTC-IWF) to enable them to communicate through specific 3GPP defined services with UEs used for MTC and with the MTC-IWF in the HPLMN.

q_22636.question: What is the function of the MinBackhaulThreshold node in the selection criteria?
q_22636.ground_truth: The MinBackhaulThreshold node acts as a placeholder for minimum WAN bandwidth in the WLAN access networks.

q_22637.question: What action does the NWDAF take upon receiving an event notification of PDU session establishment or modification for a UE in its service area?
q_22637.ground_truth: The NWDAF registers the UE in the UDM with its ID, NWDAF's FQDN or IP address, NWDAF instance ID, and the Analytics IDs it can produce.

q_22638.question: What is the post-condition upon end of the MPS for MMTEL voice or voice conference call/session in the 3GPP system?
q_22638.ground_truth: Upon end of the MPS for MMTEL voice or voice conference call/session, the UE returns to normal conditions (i.e., use of normal MMTEL voice service).

q_22639.question: What is the role of the NSSF in the 5G NAS security context transfer process?
q_22639.ground_truth: The NSSF stores the key, key identifier/token, and the provided input (RR, target AMF address(es)). It also provides the protection key(s) to the target AMF and deletes the Kamfreal and Kamfreal ID after verification.

q_22640.question: What is the unit used for Local Time Zone information in NITZ?
q_22640.ground_truth: The Local Time Zone (LTZ) information in NITZ is provided as an offset from Universal Time in units of 15 minutes.

q_22641.question: What is currently lacking in the MTSI specification to enable a data channel usage?
q_22641.ground_truth: The MTSI specification in TS 26.114 does not currently include any possibility for data channel usage.

q_22642.question: How long may operations in the old cell be continued after a cell reselection has been determined?
q_22642.ground_truth: Under no circumstances and independent of whether CCN mode is supported, operations in the old cell shall be continued more than 5~s after a cell reselection has been determined.

q_22643.question: What is the function of the Xn-C signalling bearer in the Xn interface of the NG-RAN?
q_22643.ground_truth: The Xn-C signalling bearer provides the functions of reliable transfer of XnAP messages over the Xn-C interface, network and routing function, redundancy in the signalling network, and support for flow and congestion control.

q_22644.question: What is the impact of increased PAR on coverage in uplink digital dual carrier transmission?
q_22644.ground_truth: The increased back-off to compensate for the higher PAR can potentially impact coverage, but applying the reduction of MS maximum output power specified in 3GPP TS 45.005 to an uplink dual carrier transmission, no significant changes to cell coverage is expected compared to a single-carrier multislot transmission with the same total number of time slots assigned.

q_22645.question: What is the minimum controlled output power of the TDD BS when the power control setting is set to a minimum value?
q_22645.ground_truth: The minimum transmit power is when the power control indicates a minimum transmit output power is required.

q_22646.question: What is the difference between the CSG-ProximityIndicationCapability field in the UE-RadioAccessCapability-v920ext-IEs sequence and the csg-ProximityIndication field in the UE-Capability-v3g-IEs sequence?
q_22646.ground_truth: The CSG-ProximityIndicationCapability field in the UE-RadioAccessCapability-v920ext-IEs sequence is used to indicate whether a user equipment is capable of indicating its proximity to a CSG cell (i.e., a cell that is part of a closed subsystem). The csg-ProximityIndication field in the UE-Capability-v3g-IEs sequence, on the other hand, is used to indicate whether a user equipment is capable of indicating its proximity to a CSG cell in general, regardless of whether the cell is part of a closed subsystem.

q_22647.question: What is the function of the Bootstrapping Server Function (BSF) in IMS-based PSS and MBMS procedures?
q_22647.ground_truth: The BSF performs GBA/GAA procedures with the UE to authenticate the user for signalling outside IMS and generates the Long Term Key.

q_22648.question: What is the action taken if the "Rplmn information" IE is present when receiving an RRC Connection Release message in the lower layers for transmission on the DCCH to the UTRAN?
q_22648.ground_truth: The UE may store the IE along with the PLMN id for which it applies, and utilize this information during subsequent Rplmn selections of the indicated PLMN.

q_22649.question: What information is used to form the overlap code for the current frame in the MDCT based TCX coder?
q_22649.ground_truth: The overlap code for the current frame is formed from the short/long transform decision bit and the binary code for the overlap width as defined in subclause 5.3.2.3.

q_22650.question: What happens when a UE performs PLMN non-3GPP access registration via an SNPN?
q_22650.ground_truth: The UE establishes a non-3GPP access PDU session in the PLMN, which is anchored in the PLMN UPF. This is subject to handover procedures.

q_22651.question: What is the definition of "intent" in the context of Intent-driven MnS?
q_22651.ground_truth: An intent is a desire to reach a certain state/position for a specific entity for instances such as service assurance or network deployment tasks.

q_22652.question: What should the UE include in the IE "UE GPS timing of cell frames" when the IE "GPS timing of Cell wanted" is set to TRUE?
q_22652.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "Primary CPICH Info" for FDD or the IE "cell parameters id" for TDD, the SFN when the position was determined, the IE "UE GPS timing of cell frames", and the IE "UE Positioning GPS Reference Time Uncertainty" when the IE "GPS timing of Cell wanted" is set to TRUE.

q_22653.question: What information does the SGSN include in an SNS-SIZE-ACK PDU sent to the BSS NSE?
q_22653.ground_truth: The SNS-SIZE-ACK PDU sent to the BSS NSE contains the NSEI IE and may contain the Cause IE.

q_22654.question: What is the impact of introducing Shifted SACCH on degradation when DTX is on and there's Shifted SACCH?
q_22654.ground_truth: The degradation is improved by 'd' dB.

q_22655.question: What is the method call that clears the ProactiveHandler before initializing it?
q_22655.ground_truth: A call to the method "initDisplayText" or "initGetInkey"

q_22656.question: What should the Node B do if the Report Characteristics IE is set to "Event C" in the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message?
q_22656.ground_truth: The Node B shall initiate the Dedicated Measurement Reporting procedure when the measured entity rises by an amount greater than the requested threshold within the requested time, as specified in the Report Characteristics IE.

q_22657.question: When is the TSG likely to formally approve the technical specifications?
q_22657.ground_truth: The technical specifications are subject to continuing work within the TSG and may change following formal TSG approval.

q_22658.question: What should the UE do to determine whether a particular access attempt is allowed, as specified in CR~6?
q_22658.ground_truth: The UE should determine if the access attempt is allowed based on uac-BarringInfo broadcast in SIB1 and if the RPLMN is the HPLMN, EHPLMN, or visited PLMN of the home country.

q_22659.question: What is the average channel bandwidth used in the test?
q_22659.ground_truth: The average channel bandwidth used in the test is 7.5 MHz.

q_22660.question: What is the purpose of the temporary variable 'tmp' in this code snippet?
q_22660.ground_truth: The purpose of the temporary variable 'tmp' is to store the result of the multiplication of 32 and the minimum value in the array 'x'.

q_22661.question: What is the main purpose of using RTP redundancy in CSData calls?
q_22661.ground_truth: RTP redundancy is used to reduce the data loss rate and improve the success rate of sensitive CSData services (e.g. fax) in the case of noticeable RTP packet losses.

q_22662.question: What is the definition of an "application detection filter" as per the document?
q_22662.ground_truth: A logic used to detect packets generated by an application based on extended inspection of these packets, e.g. header and/or payload information, as well as dynamics of packet flows.

q_22663.question: When is it allowed for an NGN to remove or invalidate a cryptographically signed request part?
q_22663.ground_truth: An NGN is allowed to remove or invalidate a cryptographically signed request part only when negotiated by operators or required by regulatory requirements.

q_22664.question: What information is indicated by a Length Indicator value of 123 in the RLC data block for a mobile station supporting network sharing?
q_22664.ground_truth: The presence of the Selected PLMN Index field in the octet immediately following this Length Indicator.

q_22665.question: What is the purpose of RNC Registration and De-registration?
q_22665.ground_truth: RNC Registration is the process where the CN becomes aware of an RNC hosting UEs which have activated a certain MBMS Service. RNC De-registration is the process where the CN becomes aware that an RNC registered at a CN node does not host any more PMM-CONNECTED UEs which have activated that MBMS Service. RNC Registration allows for the set-up of a corresponding MBMS distribution tree, while RNC De-registration results in the release of all associated MBMS Service Contexts and resources.

q_22666.question: What is the consequence of not activating signalling confidentiality protection in a connection?
q_22666.ground_truth: UEs shall treat their user plane confidentiality policy for the V2X service for this connection as NOT NEEDED and the receiving UE shall set confidentiality for the user plane to off.

q_22667.question: What is the purpose of using the atLeastOneValidId input parameter in the clearAlarms operation?
q_22667.ground_truth: The atLeastOneValidId input parameter is used to ensure that at least one valid alarm identifier is provided for the clearAlarms operation.

q_22668.question: What should the Node B do if it allows UE to use HSDPA resources distributed over multiple carriers in a 1.28Mcps TDD system?
q_22668.ground_truth: The Node B should allocate HS-SCCH parameters corresponding to the HS-DSCH over multiple carriers and include the HS-SCCH Specific Information Response LCR per UARFCN IE in the HS-DSCH TDD Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message. Additionally, the Node B should include the HARQ Memory Partitioning per UARFCN IE in the HS-DSCH TDD Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message.

q_22669.question: What is the significance of the "Half rate speech transcoding" in the context of GSM specifications?
q_22669.ground_truth: Half rate speech transcoding refers to the process of converting half rate speech to full rate speech or vice versa, in order to ensure compatibility and interoperability between different systems and networks.

q_22670.question: What is used when dynamic PCC is not deployed in a multi-access PDN connection?
q_22670.ground_truth: Pre-defined PCC Rules in P-GW and charging characteristics can be used to apply charging differentiation.

q_22671.question: When should the specific HARQ profile be applied in 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_22671.ground_truth: The specific HARQ profile should be applied when Scheduling Information needs to be transmitted without any higher-layer data.

q_22672.question: What are the two parts of the transparent container in PS handover in 3GPP TS 23.401?
q_22672.ground_truth: The two parts of the transparent container in PS handover in 3GPP TS 23.401 are the Radio Network part (RN part) and the Core Network part (CN part).

q_22673.question: What should the NAS do if the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is allowed?
q_22673.ground_truth: The NAS should initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt.

q_22674.question: When is it required for the mobile station to send four HANDOVER ACCESS messages in the pseudo-synchronized cell case?
q_22674.ground_truth: The mobile station sends four HANDOVER ACCESS messages in the pseudo-synchronized cell case if it is not indicated as optional in the HANDOVER COMMAND message.

q_22675.question: When does the Node-B use the initial transmit power for the next HS-SCCH transmission?
q_22675.ground_truth: When the transmission interval of HS-SCCHs, which are in the same time slot, is more than or equal to a certain threshold, which is signalled by higher layers.

q_22676.question: What is the purpose of the interface procedures between the UE and ProSe Function, as noted in 6.1.3.1?
q_22676.ground_truth: The purpose of these procedures is to protect the messages between the UE and ProSe Function over PC3.

q_22677.question: What should the IWF performing the participating role include in the SIP INVITE request when it receives a request to upgrade the MCPTT group session to an MCPTT emergency call?
q_22677.ground_truth: The IWF performing the participating role shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body populated as specified in clause~6.4.1.1 and include a Resource-Priority header field, complying with the procedures in clause~6.4.1.2.

q_22678.question: For which scenario is H.265/HEVC HM characterization possible against H.264/AVC JM?
q_22678.ground_truth: Scenario 3 has characterization possible for H.265/HEVC HM against H.264/AVC JM.

q_22679.question: When does a TX UE restart its timer for the SL inactivity timer in groupcast?
q_22679.ground_truth: A TX UE restarts its timer corresponding to the SL inactivity timer for the destination L2 ID upon reception of new data with the same destination L2 ID.

q_22680.question: What information overrides ISUP information derived from default values?
q_22680.ground_truth: De-encapsulated ISUP information overrides ISUP information derived from default values.

q_22681.question: How will the 3GPP Technical Specification be updated following formal TSG approval?
q_22681.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification will be updated by changing the release date and increasing the version number (x.y.z) with the first digit indicating the level of TSG approval.

q_22682.question: What is the initial state of the UE at the start of the 3GPP TS 25.331 mobile-terminated location request procedure?
q_22682.ground_truth: The UE is in the "CS-CELL DCH Initial (State 6-1)" state as specified in clause 7.4.1 of TS 34.108, and have no stored GPS assistance data.

q_22683.question: What triggers WLAN AP to send a notification when monitoring alarms?
q_22683.ground_truth: WLAN AP sends a notification when the value of the ifOperStatus object changes, with the value indicating the current operational state of the interface.

q_22684.question: What changes does Solution 21 propose for selecting the appropriate interface when a P-CSCF supports both Rx and N5 interfaces?
q_22684.ground_truth: Solution 21 proposes to use the UE's contact IP address to determine the appropriate protocol/interface to use. If the IP address is associated with a combined node, the P-CSCF will use the N5 interface; if the IP address is associated with a non-combined node, the P-CSCF will use the Rx interface.

q_22685.question: What must be done to maintain the IPsec tunnel over Nwu and update the UE Context in RAN when the UE is allowed to request the NPN that it should preferably always be released to RRC-Inactive?
q_22685.ground_truth: The AF forwards the information from the AF to the UE using NAS transport message and the UE requests the NPN AMF to update the UE Context in RAN through PDU Session Modification request

q_22686.question: What is used in the pilot field if pilot bits are not used in a CCPCH?
q_22686.ground_truth: DTX is used in the pilot field if pilot bits are not used in a CCPCH.

q_22687.question: What should the CRNC do if the PAGING REQUEST message contains the URA ID IE?
q_22687.ground_truth: The CRNC shall page in all cells that it controls in the indicated URA.

q_22688.question: What information does the CN include in the RAB ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message if it initiates a service-based intersystem handover from UMTS to GSM?

q_22689.question: What message does the GANC send to the MS for network initiated signalling or SMS?
q_22689.ground_truth: The GANC sends GA-CSR DL DIRECT TRANSFER message to the MS for network initiated signalling or SMS.

q_22690.question: Which alertReason is used for the "Successful ms-Present" attribute in GSM?
q_22690.ground_truth: The alertReason used for the "Successful ms-Present" attribute in GSM is "MS present".

q_22691.question: In the BS testing, what is the procedure for measuring the dynamic range of a BS receiver's ability to handle a rise of interference?
q_22691.ground_truth: In BS testing, the dynamic range of a BS receiver is measured by verifying the ability of the BS to receive a prescribed single-code test signal of maximum input power under defined conditions (specified interference, no multipath) with a BER not exceeding a specified limit.

q_22692.question: What command is sent by the TDF to the PCRF in response to the CCR command to provision ADC rules and event triggers for the TDF session?
q_22692.ground_truth: The CC-Answer (CCA) command is sent by the TDF to the PCRF in response to the CCR command to provision ADC rules and event triggers for the TDF session.

q_22693.question: Which function entity in the RRC layer model is responsible for handling all functions specific to one UE?
q_22693.ground_truth: The Dedicated Control Function Entity (DCFE) in the RRC layer model is responsible for handling all functions specific to one UE.

q_22694.question: What is the purpose of the Payload Protocol Identifier in SCTP?
q_22694.ground_truth: The Payload Protocol Identifier in SCTP identifies the application which uses the services of SCTP, allowing for demultiplexing SCTP packets to the correct receiving endpoint/application in a similar way to the SCTP destination port number. This allows multiple applications to be multiplexed over a single well-known SCTP port using the SCTP Payload Protocol Identifier instead of requesting IANA for allocation of a new well-known SCTP port number each time a new application is defined.

q_22695.question: What should the UE and the SCC AS do to execute the Source Access Leg Release after the session modification procedures are complete?
q_22695.ground_truth: For non-emergency sessions, the UE and the SCC AS shall initiate the Session Release procedure when the switch to the Target Access Leg is complete. For emergency sessions, the UE and the EATF shall initiate the Session Release procedure when the switch to the Target Access Leg is complete. For (v)SRVCC, the source access leg release is only performed if the UE retains Gm after the PS-CS access transfer is completed.

q_22696.question: What is the role of Authentication Security Service in IRP scenario?
q_22696.ground_truth: Authentication Security Service in IRP scenario is used to authenticate the IRPManager and IRPAgent by exchanging credentials and validating them.

q_22697.question: What are the two MBMS Service Types for TV service?
q_22697.ground_truth: The MBMS Service Types for TV service are: a) MBMS transport only mode - 3GPP network provides transparent content transportation and broadcast only TV service, b) MBMS full service mode - 3GPP MBMS system provides full service capability and BM-SC can transform the content stream into a 3GPP compliant stream.

q_22698.question: In what circumstances is the Uplink Busy message broadcasted on the voice group call channel?
q_22698.ground_truth: The Uplink Busy message is broadcasted on the voice group call channel to inform the mobile station of the uplink status of the voice group call channel, but it is only required for mobile stations supporting VGCS talking and sending of application-specific data.

q_22699.question: What is the purpose of the code written in ANSI-C programming language in the 3GPP TS 26.445 document?
q_22699.ground_truth: The purpose of the code written in ANSI-C programming language in the 3GPP TS 26.445 document is for a bit exact implementation of the EVS Codec and other related systems such as Voice Activity Detection (VAD), Comfort Noise Generation (CNG), Discontinuous Transmission (DTX), Packet Loss Concealment (PLC) of Lost Packets, Jitter Buffer Management (JBM), and AMR-WB Interoperable Function.

q_22700.question: What should be the maximum level of intermodulation product in the frequency band 9 kHz to 1 GHz for a repeater to comply with the given specifications?
q_22700.ground_truth: The maximum level of intermodulation product in the frequency band 9 kHz to 1 GHz for a repeater to comply with the given specifications is -36 dBm (250 nW).

q_22701.question: What should the MME do when it receives a Send Write-Replace-Warning-Indication IE in a warning message?
q_22701.ground_truth: The MME should send the WRITE-REPLACE WARNING INDICATION to the CBC for the warning message.

q_22702.question: What is the additional cost for each DPCH assigned to any user in a cell within a timeslot, if it is not the first DPCH assigned for any user in a cell within a timeslot?

q_22703.question: During which period should the MBMS UE randomize the termination procedure?
q_22703.ground_truth: The MBMS UE should randomize the termination procedure during the protection period.

q_22704.question: What is the main determining factor for SLR and RLR values in the PLMN?
q_22704.ground_truth: The main determining factor for SLR and RLR values in the PLMN is the characteristics of the MS, including the analogue to digital conversion (ADC) and digital to analogue conversion (DAC).

q_22705.question: What sets the required IIP3 value for either the LNA or the post-filter receiver in the analysis of the pre-existing LNA and post-filter receiver?
q_22705.ground_truth: The power of the TX signal and the power in the strongest interference signal in the third order intermodulation interference bands.

q_22706.question: What is the role of the adaptive postfilter in the GSM enhanced full rate codec?
q_22706.ground_truth: The adaptive postfilter is a cascade of two filters, a formant postfilter and a tilt compensation filter, applied to the output of the short term synthesis filter to enhance the perceptual quality of the reconstructed speech in the GSM enhanced full rate codec.

q_22707.question: What is the principle taken into account for Type III capabilities of a UE supporting both LTE and NR?
q_22707.ground_truth: The use of the capability in one RAT has impacts to the other RAT and is understood by the NW side of the other RAT.

q_22708.question: What is the expected length of the alpha identifier in the initial conditions of the test?
q_22708.ground_truth: The length of the alpha identifier is 32 characters in the initial conditions of the test.

q_22709.question: What must be true for the CatSendUSSD function to return the message output data?
q_22709.ground_truth: MsgOutDCS, MsgOutLength, and MsgOut cannot be null.

q_22710.question: What information does the access token request from DCCF to NRF contain, as specified in step 4?
q_22710.ground_truth: The access token request from DCCF to NRF contains the following information in step 4: NF Instance IDs of the NF Service Consumer (e.g. NWDAF) and the DCCF, NF Type (or NF Instance ID) of the NF Service Producers (i.e. ADRF and the Data Producer).

q_22711.question: What are some media-format related challenges that motivate the definition of TV Video Profiles in the context of 3GPP?
q_22711.ground_truth: Some challenges include the use of different broadcast standards, legacy distribution, VoD assets and ads in different content formats, new formats for enabling new experiences, and contribution formats containing specific properties or metadata.

q_22712.question: In the macrocell environment, how many sub-paths and what is the per-path angle spread for each path?
q_22712.ground_truth: In the macrocell environment, there are M = 20 sub-paths for each of the N paths at the BS. The resulting per-path angle spread is 5 degrees, instead of 2 degrees for the macrocell case. The direct component, used with the LOS model, has no per-path angle spread.

q_22713.question: What should the mobile station do upon receipt of a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message indicating a change of RLC mode?
q_22713.ground_truth: The network shall release the uplink TBF and the mobile station shall perform a change of RLC mode by establishing a new TBF after stopping timer T3168.

q_22714.question: How does a recipient entity handle an LCS-AP Reset Request message in the LCS protocol?
q_22714.ground_truth: On receiving an LCS-AP Reset Request message, the recipient entity releases all references and state information for the location service transactions on the SCTP association on which the Reset Request was received and sends a LCS-AP Reset Acknowledge message back to the initiating entity.

q_22715.question: What is the effect of power back off on the results of GMSK, 8PSK, and 16QAM modulations?
q_22715.ground_truth: With power back off, all three modulations use the same output power.

q_22716.question: What message does an MTC-IWF send to the SMS-SC after receiving a MO payload delivery request from the SMS-SC and forwarding the SMS to the SCS/AS?
q_22716.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF sends a success or failure delivery indication to the SMS-SC, along with the external identifier associated with the transaction.

q_22717.question: What action is taken by the target SRNC when it receives specific RRC messages indicating successful exchange of new SRNC-ID + S-RNTI with the MS during SRNS relocation in UTRAN?
q_22717.ground_truth: The target SRNC triggers a Relocation Complete procedure by sending the Relocation Complete message to the new SGSN to indicate the completion of SRNS relocation to the CN.

q_22718.question: What does the "Packet System Information Type 1" message contain and what is its direction?
q_22718.ground_truth: The "Packet System Information Type 1" message contains information for cell selection, control of the PRACH, description of the control channel(s) and global power control parameters, and is sent by the network on the PBCCH or PACCH to the mobile station.

q_22719.question: In which clause of the technical specification are the physical characteristics tests specified?
q_22719.ground_truth: The physical characteristics tests are specified in Clause 4 of the technical specification.

q_22720.question: What are some of the parameters used for calculating the energy efficiency of base stations?
q_22720.ground_truth: The energy efficiency of base stations is calculated by taking the ratio of mobile network data Energy Efficiency (EEMN,DV) to energy consumption (ECMN).

q_22721.question: What should the ng-eNB-DU do if it receives the UL PDU Session Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
q_22721.ground_truth: The ng-eNB-DU should replace the received UL PDU Session Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE and use it for non-GBR bearers for the concerning UE.

q_22722.question: What should the MME do if the selected integrity algorithm is EIA0, as specified in TS 33.401, clause 5.1.4.1, when sending the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message to the UE?
q_22722.ground_truth: The MME should use a different integrity algorithm than EIA0, as EIA0 should only be used for unauthenticated emergency calls.

q_22723.question: What is the purpose of the DHCPv4 Address Allocation Procedure Indication in the context of 3GPP networks?
q_22723.ground_truth: The DHCPv4 Address Allocation Procedure Indication is used to indicate that DHCPv4 is to be used in allocating the IPv4 address to the UE if the option is present in the PBA message.

q_22724.question: What message is sent by the SMS-SC to the MTC-IWF when an MSISDN-less UE originates SMS-MO via T4 to a recipient SCS/AS?
q_22724.ground_truth: The SMS-SC sends the "MO payload delivery Request" message to the MTC-IWF address, with the SMS payload and the destination SME address (long/short code of the SCS/AS).

q_22725.question: What is the purpose of the "EAS" (Edge Application Server) in the 5G Media Streaming Architecture?
q_22725.ground_truth: The purpose of the EAS is to perform server functions in the Edge Data Network for the Application Client(s), providing benefits of Edge Computing.

q_22726.question: What is the difference between inter-frequency cell reselection and re-selection to a GSM cell in FDD state?
q_22726.ground_truth: Inter-frequency cell reselection refers to the case where the UE switches to a cell with a different frequency in FDD state, whereas re-selection to a GSM cell in FDD state specifically refers to the case where the UE switches to a GSM cell in FDD state.

q_22727.question: What is a requirement for the introduction of CTS (Cordless Terminal System) in a GSM network?
q_22727.ground_truth: The introduction of CTS shall not destabilize any existing GSM mobile equipment or degrade the mobile equipment's dedicated or idle mode performance.

q_22728.question: What is the first scenario considered for evaluating performance of CRS interference handling schemes in an overlapping spectrum for LTE and NR?
q_22728.ground_truth: The first scenario (Scenario 1) considers serving and interference cells operating in DSS (NR+LTE) mode.

q_22729.question: What are the pre-conditions for the use case "Radio Access Node on-board UAV"?
q_22729.ground_truth: The pre-conditions are: An UAV should be equipped with base station functionality, DBS should be able to fly to designated area, UxNB should be able to connect the 5G core network, and UxNB should be authorized by the 5G system.

q_22730.question: What happens to radio bearers during the relocation of SRNS if they are not related to any RAB accepted by the target RNC?
q_22730.ground_truth: The radio bearers are ignored during the relocation of SRNS and released by the radio interface protocols after completion of relocation of SRNS.

q_22731.question: What are the phases of administration of performance measurements in telecommunications networks?
q_22731.ground_truth: The phases of administration of performance measurements are: management of the performance measurement collection process, generation of performance measurement results, local storage of measurement results in the NE or VNFM, transfer of measurement results from the NE or VNFM to an OS, and storage, preparation and presentation of results to the operating personnel.

q_22732.question: What should the UE do after receipt of a AttachReject message during registration with cause "PLMN not allowed"?
q_22732.ground_truth: The UE should update the EFPLMN in the USIM after receipt of a AttachReject message during registration with cause "PLMN not allowed".

q_22733.question: What does the BSSMAP-LE CONNECTIONLESS INFORMATION message convey?
q_22733.ground_truth: This message conveys signaling information associated with a higher protocol level between an SMLC and another entity when there is no existing signaling connection association.

q_22734.question: What should the MAC entity do if the Random Access procedure was initiated for SI request and the Random Access Resources for SI request have been explicitly provided by RRC?
q_22734.ground_truth: If the Random Access procedure was initiated for SI request and the Random Access Resources for SI request have been explicitly provided by RRC, the MAC entity should select an SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB amongst the SSBs in candidateBeamRSList. If the potential Msg3 size is greater than ra-Msg3SizeGroupA and the pathloss is less than PCMAX - preambleReceivedTargetPower - msg3-DeltaPreamble - messagePowerOffsetGroupB, the MAC entity should select the Random Access Preambles group B. Otherwise, the MAC entity should select the Random Access Preambles group A.

q_22735.question: When is the integrity protection of signalling messages stopped at handover to GSM BSS?
q_22735.ground_truth: The integrity protection of signalling messages is stopped at handover to GSM BSS.

q_22736.question: Which role does the ATCF/ATGW function have in the TrGW, and what does it provide an interface between?
q_22736.ground_truth: The ATCF/ATGW function in the TrGW provides an interface between two IP-transport domains.

q_22737.question: Which network entity is responsible for storing the network authorization information as part of the UE context in the 3GPP system?
q_22737.ground_truth: The AMF stores the network authorization information as part of the UE context in the 3GPP system.

q_22738.question: What does the message "APN Congestion" indicate when trying to create a PDP context in a network?
q_22738.ground_truth: The GGSN has detected congestion for the requested APN and performs overload control for that APN which does not allow the PDP Context to be created.

q_22739.question: What is the purpose of the LL-ESTABLISH.request primitive in the SNDCP layer?
q_22739.ground_truth: The LL-ESTABLISH.request primitive is used by the SNDCP layer to establish or re-establish acknowledged peer-to-peer operation for a SAPI in the LLC layer.

q_22740.question: What information is sent in a ProSe Direct Discovery Announce Request in TS 23.303?
q_22740.ground_truth: A ProSe Direct Discovery Announce Request allows a ProSe-enabled UE to request a set of ProSe App Code from the HPLMN ProSe Function, with associated validity timer and security materials, to announce over the air.

q_22741.question: What is the implication of QoS awareness for UE in IMS?
q_22741.ground_truth: QoS awareness for UE in IMS allows it to get information about local QoS parameters through cross-layer communication for offering and answering SDP. However, there is no requirement for such an API in TS 26.114.

q_22742.question: What should the UE do if IE "SFN offset validity" is set to FALSE?
q_22742.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the IE "SFN offset" if IE "SFN offset validity" is set to FALSE.

q_22743.question: What is the reduced NCH monitoring mechanism used for by the mobile station in idle mode?
q_22743.ground_truth: The reduced NCH monitoring mechanism is used to receive notification messages for voice broadcast calls and voice group calls, and to reduce the reception load.

q_22744.question: When does the EATF indicate in the reINVITE that it shall exclude INFO requests for any Info Packages related to eCall over IMS?
q_22744.ground_truth: When the EATF performs the session continuity for SRVCC session transfer of an eCall over IMS, it indicates in the reINVITE that it shall exclude INFO requests for any Info Packages related to eCall over IMS as defined in RFC 6086 clause 5.2.2.

q_22745.question: How is the position of harmonics estimated for the first two bands in the predicted spectrum?
q_22745.ground_truth: The position of harmonics for bands i = 0, 1 in the predicted spectrum is estimated using equation (1161), which takes into account the first tonal position of the HF spectrum and the pulse resolution for the predicted spectrum.

q_22746.question: In what scenario is the user rate of the PLMN BC set to the value for the fall-back bearer service?
q_22746.ground_truth: When the user equipment does not support the fixed network user rate and the call confirmation message does not contain the fixed network user rate parameter.

q_22747.question: What actions can the UE take upon receiving a notification of a disaster condition that has impacted the 3GPP access?
q_22747.ground_truth: The UE can handle the notification, optionally handle a list of PLMNs for registering in a PLMN without a disaster condition, handle a "wait timer" for attempting to register on a target PLMN, and handle an "expected duration of disaster" timer to decide when to return to the PLMN that faced the disaster condition.

q_22748.question: What system is used to calculate the paging frame and paging occasions in the 5GS?
q_22748.ground_truth: The paging frame and paging occasions in the 5GS are calculated based on a temporary identifier (5G-S-TMSI), which can be reassigned over time.

q_22749.question: What is the role of a Virtualisation Container in the NFVI node?
q_22749.ground_truth: A Virtualisation Container is a partition of a NFVI Compute Node that provides an isolated virtualised computation environment, where a VNFC (Virtualised Network Function Component) runs.

q_22750.question: What is the role of the N1 SM container in the multicast group session modification?
q_22750.ground_truth: The N1 SM container (PDU Session Modification Command) is provided to the UE to request session modification for the multicast group.

q_22751.question: When is the limitation on considering cells for reselection removed?
q_22751.ground_truth: The limitation is removed when the highest ranked cell changes, if the UE has to perform an any cell selection procedure, or if the UE is redirected under UTRAN control to a frequency for which the timer is running.

q_22752.question: What should an intermediate entity do if it receives a BSSMAP-LE Connection Oriented Information message containing unrecognized or invalid information?
q_22752.ground_truth: If a received BSSMAP-LE Connection Oriented Information message contains unrecognized or invalid information, the message should be discarded by the intermediate entity.

q_22753.question: What should the UE do if it receives SECURITY MODE COMMAND with the existing 5G NAS security context parameters and the SUPI is changed?
q_22753.ground_truth: The UE should reject the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message in this case.

q_22754.question: What is the interface used for normal call control procedure during vSRVCC session continuity procedures in 3GPP TS 23.216?

q_22755.question: What message should the BSS send to the SGSN if the MS is not registered with any of the CN operators in the shared network during the MS Registration Enquiry procedure in the CS domain?
q_22755.ground_truth: The BSS shall perform CS/PS domain registration coordination based on the received IMSI and re-initiate the procedure towards the SGSN of the identified CN operator.

q_22756.question: How is the Frame Quality Classification (FQC) used in the EVS Codec generic frame format in CS Networks?
q_22756.ground_truth: The EVS Codec generic frame format has no own Frame Quality Indicator. If transported on Iu and Nb, the FQC of the Iu and Nb framing protocol is used instead.

q_22757.question: What information is included in the MEASUREMENT REPORT message if the UE supports the capability to provide the GPS timing of the cell frames measurement in the 3GPP protocol?
q_22757.ground_truth: The UE includes the IE "Primary CPICH Info" for FDD or the IE "cell parameters id" for TDD, the IE "Reference SFN" and the IE "UE GPS timing of cell frames" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT message if the UE supports the capability to provide the GPS timing of the cell frames measurement.

q_22758.question: What is the blocking level relaxation for P-GSM 900 and E-GSM 900 in the frequency range 925 MHz to 935 MHz?
q_22758.ground_truth: The blocking level is relaxed to 0 dBm for P-GSM 900 and E-GSM 900 in the frequency range 925 MHz to 935 MHz.

q_22759.question: What is the purpose of the Discovery procedure in the GA-RC elementary procedures for GANC Discovery?
q_22759.ground_truth: The purpose of the Discovery procedure is to allow the network to allocate a Default GANC to a MS, consisting of the IP address or FQDN of the Default GANC-SEGW, and the IP address or FQDN and TCP port of the Default GANC to be used for the Registration procedure.

q_22760.question: What is the cross modulation power proportional to?
q_22760.ground_truth: The cross modulation power is proportional to the adjacent channel power and proportional to the square of the TX power (in Watts).

q_22761.question: What function is used to judge whether a requested location updating is necessary to be indicated to the HLR or not?
q_22761.ground_truth: The Location Updating Screening Function is used to judge whether a requested location updating is necessary to be indicated to the HLR or not.

q_22762.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in section 15.3.5?
q_22762.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement accuracy with reduced number of samples is within the specified limits for FR2 SA.

q_22763.question: What is the message used by the UE to send interest TMGIs in the N2 based shared to individual switch?
q_22763.ground_truth: The UE sends an AN message with interest TMGIs to the source gNB in the N2 based shared to individual switch.

q_22764.question: What shall the conference focus do if it receives a 1xx or 2xx response to an INVITE request in the context of conference creation or user joining a conference?
q_22764.ground_truth: The conference focus shall include the "isfocus" feature parameter in the conference URI of the Contact header in the response.

q_22765.question: What action does the old SGSN take if the timer in step 2 expires and no Cancel Location message is received from the GLR?
q_22765.ground_truth: The old SGSN stops forwarding N-PDUs to the new SGSN.

q_22766.question: How many Codec Modes should be included in the Single Codec Information Element for the Selected Codec (BICC) for UMTS AMR and UMTS AMR2?
q_22766.ground_truth: At least one, but not more than four modes should be included in the Single Codec Information Element for the Selected Codec (BICC) for UMTS AMR and UMTS AMR2.

q_22767.question: What should the SCC AS do if only one contact is registered in the PS domain?
q_22767.ground_truth: The SCC AS should create a SIP INVITE request in accordance with 3GPP TS 24.229 and include SDP for all the media types contained in the initial SIP INVITE request.

q_22768.question: What is the result of the call control when no modification is required for PDP context activation?
q_22768.ground_truth: The result is '00', which means allowed with no modification.

q_22769.question: What is the length of the PTK Identity used as part of the derivation of PTK?
q_22769.ground_truth: The PTK Identity is a 16-bit counter.

q_22770.question: What information element is included in the Notify sent by the VNFM to the EM in step 4.2.3.1.2 to indicate the result of VNF scaling?

q_22771.question: What action does the UE take upon detecting an SCG radio link failure or other specified conditions?
q_22771.ground_truth: Upon detecting an SCG radio link failure or other specified conditions, the UE initiates the procedure to report SCG failures by suspending SCG transmission for all SRBs and DRBs, resetting SCG-MAC, stopping T304 if it is running, and transmitting the SCGFailureInformationNR message with the appropriate failure type if applicable.

q_22772.question: What is the role of the ProSe Function in the PC2 reference model?
q_22772.ground_truth: The ProSe Function is the logical function that is used for network related actions required for ProSe. It plays different roles for each of the features of ProSe, including supporting EPC-level discovery, open ProSe direct discovery, and restricted ProSe direct discovery.

q_22773.question: What service modes does the signalling transport provide for the RNSAP?
q_22773.ground_truth: The signalling transport provides two service modes for the RNSAP: a connection oriented data transfer service and a connectionless data transfer service.

q_22774.question: Which UE categories are required to support uplink MIMO with QPSK and 16QAM when used for simultaneous HS-DSCH/E-DCH operation?

q_22775.question: What does the Mb reference point in the 3GPP technical specification define?
q_22775.ground_truth: The Mb reference point is an IP-based reference point for communication between the IM CN subsystem and IP multimedia networks

q_22776.question: What are some examples of teleservices which may be supported by a PTM bearer service?
q_22776.ground_truth: Examples include distribution services (unidirectional flow of information from a given point in the network to other locations), dispatching services (bi-directional flow of information from a given point in the network and multiple users), and conferencing services (multi-directional communication between multiple users).

q_22777.question: What happens if, before a PDP Context Establishment Acknowledgement event is detected and there is no Tsw running for this PDP Context, 2 sets of e-parameters are received?

q_22778.question: What is the required Application-ID for all commands defined in this specification?
q_22778.ground_truth: The required Application-ID for all commands defined in this specification is 16777340.

q_22779.question: What information does the CTS Channel Description information element provide?
q_22779.ground_truth: The CTS Channel Description information element provides a description of an allocable channel together with its SACCH.

q_22780.question: What should the Node B do when it receives the Transport Layer Address IE and Binding ID IE in the USCH Information IE when establishing a transport bearer for the USCH?
q_22780.ground_truth: The Node B may use the transport layer address and the binding identifier received from the CRNC when establishing a transport bearer for the USCH.

q_22781.question: What conditions clear an SREJ condition?
q_22781.ground_truth: An SREJ condition can be cleared by the receipt of an information frame with N(S) equal to the N(R) of the SREJ, a time out, or a reset (SABM).

q_22782.question: What is the minimum data rate guaranteed in the Guaranteed Data Rate definition of the document?
q_22782.ground_truth: The Guaranteed Data Rate is the minimum data rate which is different from peak data rate or average data rate.

q_22783.question: What is the difference between Level 2 and Level 3 preliminary and intermediate autonomous networks?
q_22783.ground_truth: In Level 2, all execution tasks and some awareness and analysis tasks are accomplished automatically, while in Level 3, all execution and awareness tasks are accomplished automatically, and some analysis and decision tasks are also accomplished automatically.

q_22784.question: What should the ProSe Function check to ensure the ProSe Application Code is authorized to be transmitted on the monitored PLMN in the Prose Match Report Procedure?
q_22784.ground_truth: The ProSe Function should confirm that the ProSe Application Code is authorized to be transmitted on the monitored PLMN using the Prose Match Report Procedure.

q_22785.question: In the Sidelink model, which physical-layer-processing chain has a TTI of 160 ms, not including V2X sidelink communication?
q_22785.ground_truth: The Sidelink Broadcast Channel processing chain has a TTI of 160 ms when not including V2X sidelink communication.

q_22786.question: Under what conditions does the most stringent limit of Pout apply for the Home BS?
q_22786.ground_truth: The most stringent limit of Pout applies when both adjacent channels are licensed to other operators.

q_22787.question: What is the role of the MS EGAN Access Mode Switch in PDP context activation on the GERAN/UTRAN side?
q_22787.ground_truth: The MS EGAN Access Mode Switch forwards the SMREG-PDP-ACTIVATE-REQ to the GSM/UMTS SM layer via the unchanged SMREG-SAP interface.

q_22788.question: Which coding method is used for HS-SCCH type 6 and 7 in channel coding?
q_22788.ground_truth: The rate 1/3 convolutional coding method is used for HS-SCCH type 6 and 7 in channel coding.

q_22789.question: What is the difference between 4.5 and 4.6 in terms of 6.6.11 in TS 31.111?
q_22789.ground_truth: In 6.6.11 of TS 31.111, the component USSD String of the USSD String received from SS is mandatory in 4.5 but optional in 4.6.

q_22790.question: What is the format of the "Accuracy-Fulfillment-Indicator" field?
q_22790.ground_truth: The "Accuracy-Fulfillment-Indicator" field is an enumeration containing the values "requested-accuracy-fulfilled" and "requested-accuracy-not-fulfilled".

q_22791.question: What is the requirement for obtaining the measurement specified in 4.18.7?
q_22791.ground_truth: The measurement is obtained by sampling at a pre-defined interval, the transmitted carrier power of all codes not used for HS-PDSCH, HS-SCCH, E-AGCH, E-RGCH or E-HICH transmission of a given UtranCell, and then taking the arithmetic mean of the measurement values obtained during the granularity period.

q_22792.question: What is the entering condition for the event A3-1 in the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in clause 5.5.4.4 of TS 38.331?
q_22792.ground_truth: Mn + Ofn + Ocn > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off, where Mn is the measurement result of the neighboring cell, Ofn is the measurement object specific offset of the reference signal of the neighbor cell, Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbor cell, Mp is the measurement result of the SpCell, Ofp is the measurement object specific offset of the SpCell, Ocp is the cell specific offset of the SpCell, and Off is the offset parameter for this event.

q_22793.question: What should the MS include in the GA-RRC RELEASE message to the GANC when it needs to release the GA-RRC connection and signaling connection to a particular CN domain?
q_22793.ground_truth: The MS should include the IE "CN Domain Identity" and the IE "GA-RRC Cause" with the value #40 (UE generated signaling connection release) or #115 (unspecified failure) in the GA-RRC RELEASE message.

q_22794.question: What types of variants can the MRFC indicate to the MRFP for a variable announcement?
q_22794.ground_truth: The MRFC can indicate to the MRFP the following variants for a variable announcement: date, time, digits, money, and integer, which can be spoken as a cardinal or ordinal value.

q_22795.question: What is the purpose of the second algorithm described in subclause 5.3.4.1.4.3.3.2?
q_22795.ground_truth: The second algorithm described in subclause 5.3.4.1.4.3.3.2 fills the unquantized bands up to the transition frequency where the transition frequency is estimated based on the received bit allocation.

q_22796.question: How many USFs are given to a mobile station for each PDCH-pair assigned in uplink when using BTTI USF mode?
q_22796.ground_truth: For each PDCH-pair assigned to the mobile station, the network shall give two USFs (R0... R7) to the MS when using BTTI USF mode.

q_22797.question: What is the main focus of Solution #17 for addressing KI#8?
q_22797.ground_truth: Solution #17 focuses on addressing a complete solution for KI#8 by covering the potential enhancement to PCF based procedures and the ProSe direct discovery and communication related policy and parameters.

q_22798.question: What thresholds are specified for RAN assistance parameters for RAN-assisted WLAN interworking?
q_22798.ground_truth: The specified thresholds for RAN assistance parameters for RAN-assisted WLAN interworking are ThreshServingOffloadWLAN, Low, ThreshServingOffloadWLAN, High, ThreshServingOffloadWLAN, Low2, ThreshServingOffloadWLAN, High2, ThreshChUtilWLAN, Low, ThreshChUtilWLAN, High, ThreshBackhRateDLWLAN, Low, ThreshBackhRateDLWLAN, High, ThreshBackhRateULWLAN, Low, ThreshBackhRateULWLAN, High, ThreshBeaconRSSIWLAN, Low, and ThreshBeaconRSSIWLAN, High.

q_22799.question: What is the difference in parameters between the RANAP Radio Access Bearer Assignment Request message for the establishment of a DCH and RACH/FACH?
q_22799.ground_truth: For DCH establishment, the RANAP Radio Access Bearer Assignment Request message includes the radio access bearer parameters, User Plane Mode, Transport Address, and Iu Transport Association. For RACH/FACH establishment, it includes the radio access bearer parameters, User Plane Mode, and Transport Address. Additionally, the Iu Transport Association is only required to be modified for the CS domain in the case of DCH establishment.

q_22800.question: What does the correlation header block do and what attribute is used to identify individual messages?
q_22800.ground_truth: The correlation header block provides a means for correlating messages and message correlation is achieved by using the messageID attribute to identify individual messages.

q_22801.question: What is the role of UFES in the communication between UAV and UFES for UAV remote identification and tracking?
q_22801.ground_truth: UFES can communicate with UAV for UAV remote identification and tracking using two-way query/response communications between UFES and UAV, or by allowing UAV and network UAV controller to periodically send their remote identification information to the UFES.

q_22802.question: What is added to the measurement cause 'No Reply' in case no ACTIVE SET UPDATE COMPLETE message is received?
q_22802.ground_truth: Each expected ACTIVE SET UPDATE COMPLETE message not received by the RNC is added to the measurement cause 'No Reply'.

q_22803.question: Which IEs should the UE ignore as specified in subclause 8.1.1.6.15, in this version of the specification?
q_22803.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the following IEs: "Delta PRC2", "Delta RRC2", "Delta PRC3" and "Delta RRC3".

q_22804.question: In 6.4.2.4.2.3, what is the procedure for the 1,28 Mcps TDD option in step (2)?
q_22804.ground_truth: In 6.4.2.4.2.3, step (2) for the 1,28 Mcps TDD option is to set the BS tester to produce a sequence of TPC commands related to the active DPCH with content "Decrease Tx power" and "Increase Tx power". Each of these series should be sufficiently long so that the code domain power of the active DPCH is controlled to reach its minimum and its maximum, respectively.
