q_23061.ground_truth: The purpose of decomposing each sub-ray into vertical and horizontal components is to sum the components at the receive antennas and decompose each of the vertical and horizontal components into components that are co-polarized with the receive antennas.

q_23062.question: In the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure or the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure, what action must the UE include in the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message or the BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message?
q_23062.ground_truth: The UE must include the NBIFOM container IE in these procedures, with the NBIFOM Access stratum status parameter indicating the indication received from the access stratum layer of the 3GPP access.

q_23063.question: What are the two abbreviations BS and UE stands for in the Layer 1 of Iuant Interface?
q_23063.ground_truth: BS stands for Base Station and UE stands for User Equipment in the Layer 1 of Iuant Interface.

q_23064.question: Which entities are impacted by the introduction of BMCA functionality for the U-plane in 3GPP?
q_23064.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP TSN Traffic Tunneling (NW-TT), User Plane (UP), and Non-3GPP Interworking Function (NEF) are affected by the introduction of BMCA functionality for the U-plane in 3GPP network. The NEF includes a BMCA function that helps establish time-synchronization spanning trees for the IEEE 802.1AS protocol in the 5GS logical TSN Bridge.

q_23065.question: What is the role of the LTP analysis block in the RPE-LTP encoder?
q_23065.ground_truth: The LTP analysis block estimates and updates the parameters of the long term analysis filter and performs the basic compression function using Regular Pulse Excitation analysis.

q_23066.question: What is the role of the NBMP Workflow Manager in the deployment scenario?
q_23066.ground_truth: The NBMP Workflow Manager is responsible for instantiating the workflow in the assigned MPE and responding to the NBMP Client with updated WDD.

q_23067.question: What is the formula used for calculating the peak-level in the described classification system?
q_23067.ground_truth: The peak-level is calculated as the maximum absolute value of the transform coefficients within a 32-bin interval.

q_23068.question: In what situation would a listener use the RACH to send application-specific data?
q_23068.ground_truth: When the network does not indicate the uplink as free and the listener is not in the current cell, the listener would use the RACH to send application-specific data by requesting an SDCCH from the BSS.

q_23069.question: What should the IWF do if the MCData ID in the <mcdata-calling-user-identity> element does not match any group member?
q_23069.ground_truth: The IWF should reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, including warning text set to "116 user is not part of the MCData group" in a Warning header field.

q_23070.question: Between which two cells is the RSTD measurement performed in the test to verify the accuracy of inter-frequency RSTD measurement between the PCell and an SCell?

q_23071.question: What is the role of the Frame Offset parameters in Transport Channel synchronization?
q_23071.ground_truth: The Frame Offset parameters are used to map the Connection Frame Number (CFN) to the SFN of the first radio frame used for the transmission of the TBS. This synchronization mechanism is valid for all downlink transport channels.

q_23072.question: Does the OSC solution with improved frequency hopping support legacy mobiles?
q_23072.ground_truth: Yes, the OSC solution with improved frequency hopping supports legacy mobiles, provided that they can be supported by the MUROS concept and are allocated to sub-channel one.

q_23073.question: What is the purpose of the Entry Point (EP) Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the 3GPP system?
q_23073.ground_truth: The Entry Point (EP) Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a special function in the 3GPP system that provides a convenient mechanism for the Network Manager (NM) to discover the managed systems and their related IRPs. It is one of the Integration Reference Points (IRPs) that define the information in the agent that is visible for the manager, the operations that the manager may perform on this information and the notifications that are sent from the agent to the manager.

q_23074.question: How many interactions can be applied simultaneously among the operations BuildMPTY, SplitMPTY, HoldMPTY and RetrieveMPTY?
q_23074.ground_truth: None of these operations can be applied simultaneously. Once the mobile station has initiated one of these operations, it shall not initiate another until the first one is completed.

q_23075.question: What is the protocol structure of the SLm interface based on and what is its main function?
q_23075.ground_truth: The SLm interface uses the SLm Application Protocol (SLmAP) and is based on IP transport, comprising SCTP on top of IP. The main function of the SLm interface is to handle all procedures between the E-SMLC in the EPC and LMUs in the E-UTRAN, such as requesting LMUs to perform UL RTOA measurements of target UE SRS transmissions and transferring completed UL RTOA measurements from the LMU to the E-SMLC.

q_23077.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification in the field of immersive audio systems?
q_23077.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification aims to provide subjective test methodologies for the assessment of immersive audio systems, including channel-based, object-based, scene-based, and hybrids of these formats.

q_23078.question: What is the requirement for all SGSNs in a PLMN that supports IMS and emergency bearer services in UTRAN to have the same capability to support emergency bearer services?
q_23078.ground_truth: All SGSNs in the PLMN shall have the same capability to support emergency bearer services.

q_23079.question: What encryption algorithm shall be used for network hiding in the CBC mode of AES?
q_23079.ground_truth: The encryption algorithm to be used for network hiding in the CBC mode of AES is AES with 128-bit block and 128-bit key.

q_23080.question: Which RRC message includes the "UE-RadioAccessCapability-r6" IE?
q_23080.ground_truth: The RRC CONNECTION SETUP COMPLETE message includes the "UE-RadioAccessCapability-r6" IE.

q_23081.question: What is the role of the PRACH Control Parameters IE in the packet access procedure?
q_23081.ground_truth: The PRACH Control Parameters IE contains the access persistence control parameters, which are used in the packet access procedure to determine when the mobile station is allowed to make successive attempts to send a PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST message.

q_23082.question: What information does the Resource Available Information Element contain regarding the interference bands?
q_23082.ground_truth: The Resource Available Information Element contains the number of half rate TCHs and full rate TCHs available in each of the five interference bands.

q_23083.question: Which system is used to perform QoS treatment and QoS remapping based on DSCP value of the outer IP header in the context of fixed broadband access networks?

q_23084.question: What is the criticality of the "id-RAB-RelocationReleaseItem" IE within the RAB-RelocationReleaseList?
q_23084.ground_truth: The criticality of the "id-RAB-RelocationReleaseItem" IE within the RAB-RelocationReleaseList is ignore.

q_23085.question: When should the UE perform MBMS frequency layer selection procedure?
q_23085.ground_truth: Upon receiving the IE "MBMS Preferred frequency information" or when the priority for an MBMS service changes.

q_23086.question: What is the action taken when an IE with semantically incorrect contents is received, and the procedural part of 3GPP~TS~29.018 does not specify a reaction?
q_23086.ground_truth: The receiving entity should ignore that IE and treat the rest of the message. If, because this IE was ignored, the rest of the message can no longer be handled then the receiving entity shall return a BSSAP+-MOBILE-STATUS message with the Gs Cause Value set to "semantically incorrect message" and shall return the Erroneous message information element containing the received message.

q_23087.question: What is the unit of measurement for the ValidityTimerT4005 leaf in 5.2.152?
q_23087.ground_truth: The unit of measurement for the ValidityTimerT4005 leaf in 5.2.152 is in minutes.

q_23088.question: What is the format of the protocolIEs in the "CommonMeasurementInitiationResponse" sequence, as defined by the NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES standard?
q_23088.ground_truth: The format of the protocolIEs in the "CommonMeasurementInitiationResponse" sequence is a ProtocolIE-Container containing CommonMeasurementInitiationResponse-IEs.

q_23089.question: What is the purpose of the Xk interface in KMS-based IMS media security?
q_23089.ground_truth: The Xk interface in KMS-based IMS media security is defined for the DF2/MF to request encryption keys from the KMS for an ongoing communication.

q_23090.question: What is the role of TTCN-2 in the testing architecture?
q_23090.ground_truth: TTCN-2 is used as a specification language for the design of the ATSs and provides important features such as the importation of ASN.1 modules and modular TTCN-2.

q_23091.question: What process is used by the AF in the MNO domain for interacting with SMF for a PDU session, when provided with a SUPI as the target of analytics reporting?
q_23091.ground_truth: The AF in the MNO domain retrieves from UDM the UE context data using the provided SUPI, and then retrieves the UE IP address/prefix allocated for a PDU session from the SMF per SUPI using existing Event Exposure in the SMF. The mapping of SUPI to UE IP address is stored for future use.

q_23092.question: What message does a BSS send to an SGSN when it has LCS related information available to transfer?

q_23093.question: What is the purpose of the FDD DCHs To Modify IE?
q_23093.ground_truth: The FDD DCHs To Modify IE provides information for DCHs to be modified.

q_23094.question: What is the purpose of the Forward SRNS Context message in the PS handover procedure?
q_23094.ground_truth: The Forward SRNS Context message is sent from the old SGSN to the new SGSN if there is at least one PDP context that requires delivery order to be preserved. This message includes the GTP-U sequence numbers for uplink and downlink directions, and after sending this message, the old SGSN will not forward any further uplink N-PDUs for that PDP context.

q_23095.question: What is the difference between the second and the third digit in the version number of the 3GPP technical specifications, such as TS 28.301, TS 28.302, and TS 28.303?
q_23095.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc. The third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document.

q_23096.question: What timer setting guideline should be considered for the implementation of ITU-T Recommendation H.245 in the 3G system, due to the expected higher end-to-end transmission delay?
q_23096.ground_truth: The implementation should consider using ITU-T Recommendation H.324 Annex E for initializing the timer T401, as mandated by 3G-324M.

q_23097.question: What is the purpose of FRMCS User roaming capabilities in the FRMCS system?
q_23097.ground_truth: FRMCS Roaming capabilities enable an FRMCS User to make use of FRMCS Applications when provided service by a network different from their Home FRMCS Network. This functionality is critical for the operation of international trains, enabling seamless communication and service provision across countries and regions.

q_23098.question: What action should a UE take when PC5-S transmission for a specific destination is terminated in upper layers?
q_23098.ground_truth: The UE should release the PDCP entity, RLC entity, and the logical channel of the sidelink SRB(s) for PC5-S messages of the specific destination.

q_23099.question: What happens if the RR message received by the mobile station after initiating the immediate assignment procedure indicates an implicit reject for the CS domain?
q_23099.ground_truth: The mobile station shall abort the immediate assignment procedure and initiate the Implicit Reject procedure.

q_23100.question: What data rate is indicated by bits 6-1 in octet 5 when bit 7 in octet 5 indicates transparent service?
q_23100.ground_truth: The data rates indicated by bits 6-1 in octet 5 when bit 7 in octet 5 indicates transparent service are 101032,0 kbit/s, 100128,8 kbit/s, 100014,4 kbit/s, 00009,6 kbit/s, 00014,8 kbit/s, 00102,4 kbit/s, 00111,2 kbit/s, 0100600 bit/s, 01011 200/75 bit/s (1 200 network-to-MS / 75 MS-to-network).

q_23101.question: How does SMPTE ST 2110 handle audio transport?
q_23101.ground_truth: SMPTE ST 2110 uses ST 2110-30 and ST 2110-31 based on AES67 to carry uncompressed 48~kHz or 96~kHz Pulse Code Modulated (PCM) audio. Up to 64 channels can be bundled in one stream, and both 16- and 24-bit depth is supported.

q_23102.question: What should a SMLC do when it detects an error situation connected with the contents of a Send Deciphering Keys Request message?
q_23102.ground_truth: The SMLC sends a Send Deciphering Keys Error message with the indication 'Deciphering Keys Error'.

q_23103.question: In a BICC based CS core network, when must the 3G-324.M codec be indicated to the MGW as a codec media stream property?
q_23103.ground_truth: The 3G-324.M codec shall be indicated to the MGW as a codec media stream property when a network-initiated service change from speech to multimedia is initiated.

q_23104.question: What is the motivation behind the introduction of Domain Specific Access Control (DSAC) in UMTS?
q_23104.ground_truth: The original motivation behind the introduction of DSAC in UMTS was to enable PS service continuation during congestion in CS Nodes in the case of major disasters like earthquakes or tsunamis.

q_23105.question: In the context of 5G NR, what does TBS stand for and what is it used for?
q_23105.ground_truth: TBS stands for Transport Block Size. It is used in 5G NR to indicate the number of information bits that are transmitted in a single transmission time interval.

q_23106.question: What is the purpose of the LLC sublayer in the ISO 7-layer model?
q_23106.ground_truth: The purpose of LLC is to convey information between layer-3 entities in the MS and SGSN, and it supports multiple MSs at the Um interface and multiple layer-3 entities within an MS.

q_23107.question: What is the message when T2 expires in the scenario with a disconnect demand?

q_23108.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of successful EPS attach procedures, including retransmissions, within a specific MME area?

q_23109.question: How does the receiving side of an AM RLC entity handle the reception of an RLC data PDU from the lower layer?
q_23109.ground_truth: When the receiving side of an AM RLC entity receives an RLC data PDU from the lower layer, it either discards the received RLC data PDU or places it in the reception buffer, updates state variables, reassembles and delivers RLC SDUs to upper layer, and starts/stops t-Reordering as needed.

q_23110.question: What is the primary method of watching content on VOD platforms like Netflix and YouTube?
q_23110.ground_truth: The primary method of watching content on VOD platforms like Netflix and YouTube is through fixed TV screens, covering 70% of devices for VOD platforms and with 250M of hours viewed per day on TV screens for YouTube.

q_23111.question: What is the problem with providing more information from the clients to the network for solving over-allocation?
q_23111.ground_truth: The problem is that such information is not included in the first offer-answer.

q_23112.question: What action should a data link layer entity take when it receives one or more I-frames with sequence errors in the same direction of information transfer?
q_23112.ground_truth: An REJ frame should be used by a receiving data link layer entity to initiate an exception condition recovery (retransmission) following the detection of an N(S) sequence error. The entity should initiate sequential transmission (retransmission) of I-frames starting with the I-frame indicated by the N(R) contained in the REJ frame.

q_23113.question: What is the specific application communication layer that constitutes the transport of the JSON content type?
q_23113.ground_truth: The specific application communication layer that constitutes the transport of the JSON content type is the HTTP layer.

q_23114.question: What is the difference between IPv4 and IPv6 addressing for MTC in a 3GPP network?
q_23114.ground_truth: For MTC in a 3GPP network, IPv6 addressing is the primary mechanism for IP addressing, while IPv4 based addressing is considered a transition solution and is deprecated for MTC over 3GPP accesses.

q_23115.question: What is the purpose of the X-3GPP-Asserted-Identity header included in the HTTP POST request?
q_23115.ground_truth: The X-3GPP-Asserted-Identity header, which includes the identities of the UE, is used to authenticate the UE, as the UE has been authenticated by the IMS, and indicate that the SCF has authorized the UE to receive the specified MSK(s).

q_23116.question: What are the two power saving resource allocation methods defined for NR sidelink in Mode 2?
q_23116.ground_truth: The two power saving resource allocation methods defined for NR sidelink in Mode 2 are partial sensing-based resource allocation and random resource selection.

q_23117.question: What happens if an enhanced variant of the Concatenated Short Message facility (9.2.3.24.8) is used, and the 16-bit reference number is not present in every subsequent segment of the concatenated SM?
q_23117.ground_truth: If the 16-bit reference number is not contained in every subsequent segment of the concatenated SM, and an out-of-sequence segment delivery occurs or the first segment is not delivered, processing difficulties may arise, and the concatenated SM may be totally or partially discarded.

q_23118.question: What is the role of the Temporal Noise Shaping in decoding the audio signal?
q_23118.ground_truth: The Temporal Noise Shaping (TNS) is used to shape the spectral coefficients in a way that reduces noise in the signal. It is applied to selected regions of the spectral coefficients and then the filtered coefficients are used to modify the spectral envelope of the synthesized signal.

q_23119.question: What is the purpose of the Quality Estimate (QE) in a data frame?
q_23119.ground_truth: The Quality Estimate (QE) in a data frame represents the quality estimate, which is derived from the transport channel BER for FDD or physical channel BER for TDD.

q_23120.question: What shall the UE do if it does not have a valid 5G-GUTI or SUCI when registering in the same PLMN over 3GPP and non-3GPP access?
q_23120.ground_truth: The UE shall populate the 5GS mobile identity IE with its PEI.

q_23121.question: What should the ISIM do if the AMF is used in an improper manner?
q_23121.ground_truth: The ISIM should abandon the function, as this indicates an error in the processing of the command.

q_23122.question: What are the minimum requirements for the (U)SAT Framework when it processes a concatenated short message?
q_23122.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the (U)SAT Framework is to process a concatenated short message with the following properties: the Information Element Identifier is equal to the 8-bit reference number and it contains uncompressed 8-bit data or uncompressed UCS2 data.

q_23123.question: What is the impact of frequency hopping including the BCCH carrier on reception quality for fast moving MS in connected mode?
q_23123.ground_truth: The reception quality for some fast moving MS may be degraded, especially if the used APD is larger than 2~dB.

q_23124.question: What happens if the L-DNS cannot resolve the IP address for the requested FQDN of EAS but it is connected to a C-DNS?
q_23124.ground_truth: The L-DNS will communicate with the C-DNS to recursively resolve the EAS IP address.

q_23125.question: What is the solution for authentication between EEC and ECS in key issue #2 based on the AKMA?
q_23125.ground_truth: The solution requires the 5GC to provide the AKMA capability of ECS(s) to the UE, then the UE can determine to use AKMA when establishing a connection with ECS. Additionally, both EEC and ECS should support the AKMA.

q_23126.question: Which network function is responsible for identifying onboarding registrations and Onboarding PDU Session establishment in the onboarding process?
q_23126.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) is responsible for identifying onboarding registrations and Onboarding PDU Session establishment in the onboarding process.

q_23127.question: In what way do operators use AMR, AMR-WB, and EVS codecs for voice-only sessions in Use case K and L?
q_23127.ground_truth: In Use case K, both operators want to use EVS for super-wideband (SWB), but in slightly different ways. Operator A (originating side) wants to ensure SWB quality in the 9.6-24.4 kbps bitrate range for most operating conditions, while adaptation down to WB or even NB speech at lower bitrates is allowed but should happen quite rarely. Operator B (terminating side) wants to use the EVS codec only for SWB and only with the 13.2 kbps bitrate. In Use case L, Operator A wants to ensure SWB-FB quality in the 32-64 kbps bitrate range for most operating conditions, while adaptation down to WB or even NB speech at lower bitrates is allowed. Operator B wants to use the EVS codec primarily between WB and SWB and in the 5.9-13.2 kbps bitrate range.

q_23128.question: What is the role of the "VPLMNswithPreferredRules" node?
q_23128.ground_truth: The "VPLMNswithPreferredRules" node acts as a placeholder for one or more VPLMNs with ISMP, ISRP or WLANSP rules which should be preferred for a roaming UE. The "VPLMNswithPreferredRules" node contains one or more interior nodes (<X>) which act as a placeholder for one or more VPLMNs with ISMP, ISRP or WLANSP rules which should be preferred for a roaming UE.

q_23129.question: What is the role of the SID code word in the SID-frame encoding algorithm?
q_23129.ground_truth: The SID code word is used to mark the SID-frame by means of a fixed bit pattern, called the SID code word, and it consists of 95 bits which are all set to one. The bits of the SID code word are inserted in the SID field in the SID frame.

q_23130.question: What is the purpose of the activation operation in predefined QoS rules?
q_23130.ground_truth: To allow the QoS rule to be active.

q_23131.question: What is the function of the IMS-PARAMETERS-BOUND class in the CAP specification?
q_23131.ground_truth: The IMS-PARAMETERS-BOUND class in the CAP specification defines the parameters used for IMS operations, such as the called and calling party numbers, media types, media type list, and SIP CallId.

q_23132.question: Which network element sends the Location Update Request to the VLR during the Intra-SGSN change from A/Gb mode to Iu mode?
q_23132.ground_truth: The 2G+3G-SGSN sends the Location Update Request to the VLR during the Intra-SGSN change from A/Gb mode to Iu mode.

q_23133.question: What is one of the challenges with current instant messaging services on the internet?
q_23133.ground_truth: One of the challenges with current instant messaging services on the internet is that they are usually based on closed and proprietary protocols, making interoperability between different service providers impossible.

q_23134.question: When does the PCF instance maintain the local quota in the quota enforcement procedure?
q_23134.ground_truth: Each PCF instance of the S-NSSAI maintains the local quota sent by its primary PCF for the associated number of allowed registered UEs during the quota enforcement procedure when the S-NSSAI needs quota control.

q_23135.question: What action does the RNC take after receiving the MS measurement reports and making its own internal algorithms, if the IMSI is present in the Relocation Request message?
q_23135.ground_truth: The RNC decides to initiate handover to the GAN Iu mode cell by sending a Relocation Required message to the MSC, identifying the target (GAN Iu mode) cell.

q_23136.question: What are some of the functions supported by the S1 interface between the eNB and MME in EPC?
q_23136.ground_truth: The S1 interface supports mobility functions, connection management functions, SAE bearer management, general S1 management and error handling functions, paging of a UE in the eNB, transport of NAS information between EPC and UE, and MBMS support functions.

q_23137.question: What are the differences between Solution #25 and Solution #26?
q_23137.ground_truth: Solution #25 addresses key issue #1, #2, and #8, and is applicable to Option 1 and Option 3. Solution #26 only addresses key issue #1 and #2 and is applicable to Option 1 and Option 3. Solution #25 uses the EIA7 of existing UE EPS security capability IEs to signal the capability of the UE to support UP security with eNB, while Solution #26 uses the UE's EPC UPIP capabilities encoded in the UE Radio Access Capability information element.

q_23138.question: What should a UE do when it receives a new SOR-CMCI while one or more Tsor-cm timers are running and a matching criterion is found with a Tsor-cm timer value that is smaller than the current value of the running Tsor-cm timer for the associated PDU session or service?
q_23138.ground_truth: The Tsor-cm timer value for the associated PDU session or service shall be replaced with the value in the new SOR-CMCI without stopping and restarting the timer.

q_23139.question: What action should the conference focus take upon receiving a BYE message from a conference participant?
q_23139.ground_truth: The conference focus should respond to the BYE request and release the resources related to the conference participant from the conference mixer.

q_23140.question: What is the role of DCS in the onboarding process for UEs without a UICC?
q_23140.ground_truth: DCS is used to verify that the UE is subject to onboarding based on the UE identifier and the associated default UE credentials. It is used for UE authentication/authorization in the O-SNPN during the establishment of a PDU Session for onboarding purposes.

q_23141.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 16.3.2?
q_23141.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the PRS-RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limits.

q_23142.question: Which entities does the solution require changes to?

q_23143.question: What message does the Serving GANC send to the MS to confirm resource release?

q_23144.question: What information must the SGSN include in the Update Location message for an initial attach?
q_23144.ground_truth: The SGSN must include the SGSN Number, SGSN Address, IMSI, IMEISV, Update Type, Homogenous Support of IMS Voice over PS Sessions, UE SRVCC capability, equivalent PLMN list, Registration For SMS Request, and SMS in SGSN offered in the Update Location message for an initial attach.

q_23145.question: What should a mobile station do if it receives a PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message that assigns resources on two carriers with different frequency bands?
q_23145.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_23146.question: What was the capacity performance for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, for VR/AR, with single stream traffic model, DDDUU/DDDSU TDD format, with SU-MIMO, 30Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, when using cooperative MIMO/precoding compared to zero-forcing precoding?
q_23146.ground_truth: The capacity performances were 9.4 UEs per cell with cooperative MIMO/precoding, compared to 7.6 UEs per cell with zero-forcing precoding.

q_23147.question: For which protocols are the measurements defined for claimed supported EGPRS categories and GPRS supported multislot class, in section 4.2.22 and 4.2.23 respectively?
q_23147.ground_truth: The measurements for claimed supported EGPRS categories and GPRS supported multislot class are defined for packet switching in GSM and UMTS networks.

q_23148.question: What are the two types of test environment for the Modulation Accuracy test?
q_23148.ground_truth: The two types of test environment for the Modulation Accuracy test are Normal and Extreme Power supply.

q_23149.question: What should be done if a FRMCS User or equipment is registered in both GSM-R and FRMCS coverage areas?
q_23149.ground_truth: The functional identity registration for users and equipment travelling this route shall be made in two parallel entries in the respective GSM-R functional addressing and FRMCS Functional Aliasing databases.

q_23150.question: What is one of the features of the MPEG-H 3D Audio System?
q_23150.ground_truth: The MPEG-H 3D Audio System provides the possibility to carry audio channels, audio objects, and scene-based-audio signals, and metadata inside a single audio bitstream.

q_23151.question: What is the maximum number of logical channels that can be multiplexed on an E-DCH transport channel?
q_23151.ground_truth: Up to 15 logical channels can be multiplexed on an E-DCH transport channel.

q_23152.question: What information is contained in the MS radio access capability information element?
q_23152.ground_truth: The MS radio access capability information element contains the A/Gb mode radio capabilities of the MS such as multislot capability, power class, and information that the BSS needs for inter-RAT handover to other RATs.

q_23153.question: What is the purpose of late-entrant cells being roughly synchronized via Iub interface messages?
q_23153.ground_truth: The purpose of late-entrant cells being roughly synchronized via Iub interface messages is to determine the deviation from the reference SFN. This helps in updating the SFN in the late-entrant cells and ensuring that they meet the timing requirements before entering the Steady State phase.

q_23154.question: What should be considered when the reportType is set to eventTriggered and the entry condition for this event is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells for all measurements after layer 3 filtering taken during timeToTrigger?
q_23154.ground_truth: A measurement reporting entry should be included within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, the numberOfReportsSent should be set to 0, the concerned cell(s) should be included in the cellsTriggeredList, and the measurement reporting procedure should be initiated.

q_23155.question: What information is sent in the CDR generated by the S-CSCF during a session for charging purposes?
q_23155.ground_truth: The CDR contains information about the charging of the session.

q_23156.question: What should be the condition for CRRC6 to be true that an error occurs that is not expected and thus not handled?
q_23156.ground_truth: If a method call causes an unexpected error which is not handled by the current method.

q_23157.question: What regulatory domains may require data controllers to delete user data if user consent is modified or revoked?
q_23157.ground_truth: Some regulatory domains where the "right to be forgotten" exists.

q_23158.question: With respect to the NG-RAN segment of the PNI-NPN, what is the responsibility of the Network Operator?
q_23158.ground_truth: The Network Operator is responsible for granting access to the Vertical to the NG-RAN, operating the NG-RAN, establishing a roaming agreement or RAN sharing agreement, and defining Closed Access Groups (CAG).

q_23159.question: What should the DRNS do if the Serving Cell Change CFN IE is included in the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message for the new secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link?
q_23159.ground_truth: The DRNS should activate the resources that are allocated for the new secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link at the next coming CFN with a value equal to the value requested by the SRNC, or earlier, and deactivate those resources at the next coming CFN with a value equal to the value requested by the SRNC if the DRNS decides to de-allocate the HS-PDSCH resources of the old secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link.

q_23160.question: What is one of the negotiable Quality of Service (QoS) parameters for Value Added Services and PLMN Operator Services in the context of LCS?

q_23161.question: What is required to ensure full European coverage during the lifetime of the car?
q_23161.ground_truth: The terminal shall be dual mode GSM/GPRS and UMTS (WCDMA) to ensure full European coverage.

q_23162.question: Who determines the transmission schedule information for Application 3?
q_23162.ground_truth: UE-1's V2X layer determines the transmission schedule information for Application 3 based on the UE level DRX schedule.

q_23163.question: What is the role of a Query Filter (QF) in 5G Direct Discovery using Model B?
q_23163.ground_truth: A Query Filter (QF) in 5G Direct Discovery using Model B is used by Discoveree UEs for recognizing the query sent by the Discoverer UE.

q_23164.question: What are the two types of short messages defined in the technical specification?
q_23164.ground_truth: Mobile Originated and Mobile Terminated Short Message Service Teleservices

q_23165.question: How many hops are assumed for multi-hop communication along the freight train in the freight wagon use case?
q_23165.ground_truth: There are 10 to 15 hops assumed in the freight wagon use case, with each hop covering a distance greater than 100 meters.

q_23166.question: What is the purpose of the provisioning process described in provisioning solution #38?
q_23166.ground_truth: The purpose of the provisioning process described in provisioning solution #38 is to provide identities and credentials for PNI-NPN required for secondary authentication (NSSAA or secondary authentication for a DNN) for a PLMN using a dedicated S-NSSAI(s) or DNN(s).

q_23167.question: What is the role of HI3 interface in 3GPP system from a Lawful Interception administration perspective?
q_23167.ground_truth: HI3 interface is used to handle the signalling and the bearer transport for CC in 3GPP system. It shall be able to distribute Content of Communication to the relevant LEAs.

q_23168.question: What event triggers the start of timer T3176 on the mobile station side?
q_23168.ground_truth: An abnormal condition occurring in the network controlled cell reselection procedure or the expiry of timer T3174.

q_23169.question: What is the result when the card is present and powered in the card reader 1, and the GET CARD READER STATUS command is issued?
q_23169.ground_truth: Identity of card reader: '01', Card reader removable: 'No', Card reader present: Yes, Card reader ID-1 size: 'Yes', Card present in reader: Yes, Card powered: Yes

q_23170.question: What should the list server do when it receives a MESSAGE request with a URI-list included in the multipart body?
q_23170.ground_truth: The list server should inform the UE that it has received the MESSAGE request by returning the 202 (Accepted) response and create a MESSAGE request for each intended recipient in the URI-list.

q_23171.question: What message does the UE send when it detects an alteration in the Replayed UE security capabilities IE?
q_23171.ground_truth: The UE sends a SECURITY MODE REJECT message with a cause value of #23 "UE security capabilities mismatch" when it detects an alteration in the Replayed UE security capabilities IE.

q_23172.question: What is the purpose of the HA in IP flow mobility procedures?
q_23172.ground_truth: The HA (Home Agent) plays a key role in IP flow mobility procedures by handling mobility bindings, installing IP flow mobility routing rules, and sending Binding Acknowledgement (BA) messages to the UE. In some cases, the HA function may be located in the PDN GW and perform IP-CAN session establishment procedure with the PCRF.

q_23173.question: What is the purpose of the TP-MR field in the SMS-SUBMIT or SMS-COMMAND message?
q_23173.ground_truth: The TP-MR field in the SMS-SUBMIT or SMS-COMMAND message is used to give an integer representation of a reference number of the message submitted to the network by the MS (Mobile Station). The value in the TP-MR field is used by the MS to store the SMS-SUBMIT or SMS-COMMAND message and can be used to request a retransmission in case of failure.

q_23174.question: What is the purpose of the ApplyChargingReport procedure in CAMEL Phase 4 for IP Multimedia call sessions?
q_23174.ground_truth: The ApplyChargingReport procedure is used by the IM-SSF to report charging related information to the gsmSCF as requested by the gsmSCF using the "ApplyCharging" operation.

q_23175.question: What is the minimum number of NPRS subframes per cell measurement for the RSTD TDD intra-frequency measurements for NB-IoT?
q_23175.ground_truth: The minimum number of NPRS subframes per cell measurement is 5.

q_23176.question: What message does the SS send to the UE to request its capabilities in the test procedure?
q_23176.ground_truth: The SS sends an LPP REQUEST CAPABILITIES message to the UE, which is expected to transmit an LPP PROVIDE CAPABILITIES message indicating its DL-AoD capabilities in the NR-DL-AoD-ProvideCapabilities IE.

q_23177.question: What information is included in the UE REGISTER REQUEST message from the HNB to the HNB-GW?
q_23177.ground_truth: The UE REGISTER REQUEST message from the HNB to the HNB-GW includes at minimum: UE Identity, UE Capabilities, and Registration Cause.

q_23178.question: How does the MAC layer handle the same transport block being sent twice in a row in 3GPP TS 45.005?
q_23178.ground_truth: The MAC layer sends the same transport block twice in a row by using different values of R for each radio packet.

q_23179.question: What is the difference between a "compatible" and a "non-compatible" Mobile Station in the context of the eMLPP service?
q_23179.ground_truth: A "compatible" Mobile Station is one that supports eMLPP and has precedence and pre-emption capabilities, while a "non-compatible" Mobile Station does not support eMLPP.

q_23180.question: In the second scenario, when would the switch between Network-Assisted/Direct C2 communication and UTM-navigated C2 communication occur?
q_23180.ground_truth: The switch between Network-Assisted/Direct C2 communication and UTM-navigated C2 communication may occur for air traffic control, when the UAV is approaching a No Drone Zone, or when detecting potential security threats.

q_23181.question: What should the target MME do after receiving the UE EPS security capabilities and the NAS algorithms used by the source MME, if the algorithms selected by the target MME are different from the ones received from the source MME?
q_23181.ground_truth: The target MME should initiate a NAS security mode command procedure and include the chosen algorithms and the UE security capabilities to the UE to detect modification of the UE security capabilities by an attacker.

q_23182.question: What events can the CSE activate for subsequent control service events for a call?
q_23182.ground_truth: The CSE can activate subsequent control service events for the call by specifying one or more of the following events: called party alert, called party connection, call disconnection, calling party abandon, unsuccessful call establishment, mid call event (DTMF or out-of-band information), or change of basic service.

q_23183.question: What should be used for the initialization of the scrambling sequence generator in 9.5.1 and 9.6.1?
q_23183.ground_truth: The number of bits transmitted on the physical sidelink discovery channel in one subframe in 9.5.1 and the number of bits transmitted on the physical sidelink broadcast channel in one subframe in 9.6.1

q_23184.question: What is the purpose of the CTM-SRF core network node solution?
q_23184.ground_truth: The CTM-SRF core network node solution is used to place the CTM detection/conversion function in the core network as a separate CTM Special Resource Function (CTM-SRF) for detecting and converting text-based communications.

q_23185.question: What should the mobile station do if more than one cell with the same index in the 3G Neighbour Cell list is provided by different instances?
q_23185.ground_truth: In case the same 3G Cell / UTRAN frequency occurs more than once in the resulting 3G Neighbour Cell list, each occurrence shall be assigned an index but only the cell / UTRAN frequency with the highest index in the 3G Neighbour Cell list shall be referred to in measurement reports.

q_23186.question: What is the typical behavior of an SGSN when suspending a mobile station within the BSS and the SGSN?
q_23186.ground_truth: The SGSN should not typically page suspended MSs, and the handling of suspended MSs is implementation-dependent.

q_23187.question: What is the range of port numbers that the EndSourcePortNumber leaf can indicate for the source port numbers range of the IP flow description when applying the rule to uplink traffic?
q_23187.ground_truth: The EndSourcePortNumber leaf indicates the last source port number of the source port numbers range of the IP flow description, with any value in the range 1-65535.

q_23188.question: What is the meaning of "Maximum output power, Pmax" as used in the document?
q_23188.ground_truth: Maximum output power, Pmax, is the mean power level per carrier measured at the antenna connector of the Repeater in specified reference condition.

q_23189.question: What is the effect of the NACC feature on the service outage time for an MS in packet transfer mode in Release 4?
q_23189.ground_truth: The NACC feature reduced the service outage time for an MS in packet transfer mode from a couple of seconds down to 300-700 ms in Release 4.

q_23190.question: In the context of HS-DSCH, if the HS-DSCH MAC-d flow includes a Transport Layer Address IE and Binding ID IE, what may the DRNC do with this information when establishing a transport bearer for the concerned HS-DSCH MAC-d flow?
q_23190.ground_truth: The DRNC may use the transport layer address and the binding identifier received from the SRNC when establishing a transport bearer for the concerned HS-DSCH MAC-d flow.

q_23191.question: What is the purpose of the Radio Interface Parameter Update procedure in FDD?
q_23191.ground_truth: The Radio Interface Parameter Update procedure is used to update radio interface parameters that are applicable to all RL's or E-DCH Serving Radio Link Set for a specific UE. It consists of a RADIO INTERFACE PARAMETER UPDATE control frame sent by the SRNC to the Node B.

q_23192.question: What should the AS do upon receiving a reliable provisional response from a terminating UE?
q_23192.ground_truth: Upon receiving a reliable provisional response from a terminating UE containing an SDP answer, the AS may forward the provisional response to the originating UE, shall insert a P-Early-Media header field with an "inactive" value, and may save the SDP answer contained in the reliable provisional response for that particular early dialog.

q_23193.question: What is the difference between UL DPCH 10ms Mode and UL DPCH 20ms Mode?
q_23193.ground_truth: UL DPCH 10ms Mode follows physical channel procedures specific to this mode with a TTI of 10ms, while UL DPCH 20ms Mode follows physical channel procedures specific to this mode with a TTI of 20ms.

q_23194.question: What is the main difference between the procedure for a UE joining a 5G MBS session and a regular EPS bearer?
q_23194.ground_truth: During a UE joining a 5G MBS session, the PGW-C+SMF receives QoS flow information of the service, whereas for a regular EPS bearer, the PGW-C+SMF maps the service to EPS bearer(s) and requests the related EBI.

q_23195.question: What are the potential solutions for addressing the issues of confirming support for RAN-assisted rate adaptation and ECN-based rate adaptation?
q_23195.ground_truth: The potential solutions for addressing these issues include defining a new SDP parameter for end-to-end RAN-assisted codec adaptation support, defining an SDP parameter for link-by-link RAN-assisted codec adaptation support, and supporting RAN-assisted codec adaptation over NR.

q_23196.question: What is the format of the "Cause" field in the "Unsuccessful-PDSCHSetItem-PSCH-ReconfFailureTDD" sequence?
q_23196.ground_truth: The "Cause" field is of type "Cause," which is a common data type used to indicate the specific cause of an event or error in the NBAP protocol.

q_23197.question: What modification is made to the key used in the integrity and confidentiality protection algorithms for the PC5 unicast link?
q_23197.ground_truth: The key used in the integrity algorithm is NRPIK, and the key used in the confidentiality algorithm is NRPEK.

q_23198.question: When is a limited number of puncturing schemes supported in EC TBF mode compare to EGPRS TBF mode?
q_23198.ground_truth: Only one puncturing scheme (PS 1) is used for MCS-1 and MCS-2 and only two puncturing schemes (PS 1 and PS 2) are used for MCS-3 and MCS-4

q_23199.question: Which information element is used to pass Field Elements from the old BSS to the new BSS in the HANDOVER REQUIRED message?
q_23199.ground_truth: The "Old BSS to New BSS information" information element.

q_23200.question: What message does the CN send to the MS in the GAN-RR DL DIRECT TRANSFER to indicate the call resources have been allocated?

q_23201.question: What is the role of the IM CN subsystem in the SIP dialog?
q_23201.ground_truth: The IM CN subsystem handles the SIP dialog as defined in 3GPP TS 23.228.

q_23202.question: What is the threshold value for the DS or ToS values in the QoS leaf, and what is the format of these values?
q_23202.ground_truth: The threshold value for the DS or ToS values in the QoS leaf is any value in the range 0-63, and these values are expressed in a binary form.

q_23203.question: What happens after the location service support is established?
q_23203.ground_truth: After the establishment of the location service support, both users may exchange FACILITY messages by use of the location service support.

q_23204.question: What message is sent from the RNC to the CN as a successful response to a WRITE-REPLACE message?

q_23205.question: In MCPTT, how can the participants ensure that a new caller to the existing session can support the session's codec?
q_23205.ground_truth: The participants would need to know beforehand that the new caller can support the codec, or they will have to renegotiate their codec, causing disruption and likely degrading call quality.

q_23206.question: What is the purpose of the Local DNS based edge server address discovery solution in the 3GPP network?
q_23206.ground_truth: The Local DNS based edge server address discovery solution in the 3GPP network addresses the issue of discovering the Edge Application Server by deploying DNS locally and authoritatively to provide the Address Inquiry Service for Edge Server in the local serving area.

q_23207.question: What is required for the baseband modulator to support MUROS operation in the BTS transmitter?
q_23207.ground_truth: The baseband modulator needs to have an Abis bandwidth that can carry twice as much as the voice data before MUROS deployment, two voice channel inputs with four combinations, two different TSCs for corresponding streams of burst payload, a new baseband combining function, and a linear PA capable of handling small percentage of zero crossings.

q_23208.question: Which transmission diversity scheme is required to be supported mandatory at the UE for downlink transmissions?
q_23208.ground_truth: Downlink Transmit Diversity for PDSCH, DPCH, P-CCPCH, S-CCPCH, PICH, MICH, HS-SCCH, HS-PDSCH, E-AGCH, E-HICH and DwPCH.

q_23209.question: What is the role of the PCRF in handling the Priority EPS Bearer Service and PCC/QoS rules when the MPS Priority EPS Bearer Service is activated or deactivated?
q_23209.ground_truth: The PCRF is responsible for modifying the ARP and QCI values of the default bearer and PCC/QoS rules when the Priority EPS Bearer Service is activated or deactivated, ensuring the prioritization of all traffic on the same bearer.

q_23210.question: What is the attenuation factor used for attenuating the LP residual signal in WB SID frame, if the bandwidth is not WB or the latest bitrate used for actively encoded frames is larger than 16.4 kbps?
q_23210.ground_truth: The attenuation factor is calculated as (1344)

q_23211.question: What is the role of the Generic Bootstrapping Architecture (GBA) in the 3GPP system?
q_23211.ground_truth: The Generic Bootstrapping Architecture (GBA) is a function in the 3GPP system that establishes a shared secret between the network and a user equipment (UE) by running a bootstrapping procedure. The shared secret can be used between network application functions (NAFs) and UEs for authentication purposes.

q_23212.question: What is one use case for L2TP tunnelling in 5G?
q_23212.ground_truth: Establishing a secured connection from the UE to a third-party network, such as a corporate network, for industrial applications.

q_23213.question: What type of data does the "API-Result-Code" AVP hold and what is its data type?
q_23213.ground_truth: The "API-Result-Code" AVP is of type Unsigned32 and holds the result of API Invocation.

q_23214.question: What is used as a UE identifier within UTRAN/GERAN A/Gb mode and in signalling messages between UE and UTRAN/GERAN A/Gb mode?

q_23215.question: What does a "Mandatory IE missing" error in URCMP messages mean?
q_23215.ground_truth: A "Mandatory IE missing" error in URCMP messages means that the IE is not present in the message and the receiver diagnoses an error.

q_23216.question: How are signature sequences combined for Non-Scheduled E-HICH?
q_23216.ground_truth: For Non-Scheduled E-HICH, each user is assigned one group of 4 sequences from a total of 20 groups. Each user's two signature sequences are QPSK modulated and combined. Then, a summation is performed across M users' signature sequences mapped to the same channelisation code.

q_23217.question: What are the tasks in the capacity optimization workflow that the telecom system can execute automatically without human intervention in Level 4 of network autonomy?
q_23217.ground_truth: In Level 4 of network autonomy, the telecom system can execute the tasks of determining coverage optimization policies (Task B), and translating the intent to capacity optimization target information (Task A). The telecom system can also execute the tasks of analyzing the current and historical performance data related to resource usage and network traffic for the network or network slices (Task C), identifying the ongoing issues on resource utilization and predict the potential issues (Task D), and deciding recommended solutions to optimize capacity and resource utilization (Task E) without human intervention.

q_23218.question: What should the UE do when the IE "UTRAN estimated quality" is set to TRUE in subclause 8.6.7.6?
q_23218.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the IE "UTRAN estimated quality" if it is received and included in the "Inter-RAT reporting quantity" when the CHOICE system is E-UTRA.

q_23219.question: What is the purpose of the Iub interface in UE Positioning operations?
q_23219.ground_truth: The Iub interface is used to communicate among the UE Positioning entities associated with the CRNC, the Node B, and the associated LMU. It passes the request for measurements, the measurement results, and requests for UE Positioning related transmissions or other radio operations.

q_23220.question: What is the minimum number of occurrences for the `feature` element in the `requirementsType` complex type?
q_23220.ground_truth: The minimum number of occurrences for the `feature` element in the `requirementsType` complex type is 1.

q_23221.question: What message indicate the successful completion of the 3GPP TS 25.331 mobile-terminated location request procedure?
q_23221.ground_truth: The UE sends a RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a LocationNotification return result, this message indicate the successful completion of the mobile-terminated location request procedure.

q_23222.question: What procedure is followed for initial delivery of SMS without MSISDN?
q_23222.ground_truth: The UE-A registers to S-CSCF, submits the SMS-SUBMIT to the S-CSCF, S-CSCF forwards the message to IP-SM-GW, IP-SM-GW acknowledges the SIP message and performs service authorization, constructs and sends the SMS-DELIVER towards the terminating IMS network, and handles the response from terminating IMS network.

q_23223.question: Under what conditions should the SOR-CMCI be stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME?
q_23223.ground_truth: The SOR-CMCI should be stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME when the UE receives SOR-CMCI in the USAT REFRESH with command qualifier of type "Steering of Roaming" or when the UE receives steering of roaming information containing the SOR-CMCI over N1 NAS signalling and the "Store SOR-CMCI in ME" indicator is set to "Store SOR-CMCI in ME".

q_23224.question: What organization is responsible for producing the contents of the present document and other technical specifications in the TS-family of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication Management?

q_23225.question: What is used for counting and mode switch coordination between RNCs in the context of MBMS?
q_23225.ground_truth: The RNSAP function, Information Exchange, is used for counting and mode switch coordination between RNCs in the context of MBMS.

q_23226.question: What does the "2 out of 3 approach" mean in the context of HNB registration measurements?
q_23226.ground_truth: It means that only three out of the six HNB registration related measurements are required for successful HNB registration.

q_23227.question: What should the power ratio between DPCCH and HS-DPCCH or between DPCCH2 and HS-DPCCH be, in order to meet the requirements of subclauses 5.1.2.5, 5.1.2.5A and 5.1.2.5B.1?
q_23227.ground_truth: The power ratio between DPCCH and HS-DPCCH or between DPCCH2 and HS-DPCCH should be as required by subclauses 5.1.2.5, 5.1.2.5A and 5.1.2.5B.1.

q_23228.question: What is the use of the "Communication Port Identity" information element in GAN?
q_23228.ground_truth: The Communication Port Identity information element is used to identify the TCP or UDP port for the connection in GAN.

q_23229.question: What is the role of the NeighCellSI-AcquisitionCapability field in the UE-RadioAccessCapability-v920ext-IEs sequence?
q_23229.ground_truth: The NeighCellSI-AcquisitionCapability field in the UE-RadioAccessCapability-v920ext-IEs sequence is used to indicate whether a user equipment is capable of acquiring neighboring cell system information. This is used for features such as inter-cell measurements and cell reselection.

q_23230.question: What data is temporarily stored in the MME/S4 SGSN/Gn/Gp SGSN related to the SGW node name and co-located GGSN-PGW FQDN?
q_23230.ground_truth: The SGW node name and co-located GGSN-PGW FQDN are both temporary data that is conditionally stored in the MME/S4 SGSN/Gn/Gp SGSN.

q_23231.question: What message type is used to send data volume reports from the UTRAN to the CN?

q_23232.question: What is the purpose of the Common Control Type Channels (CCCH) in 3GPP TS 44.003?
q_23232.ground_truth: The CCCH, when combined, forms a common control channel known for downlink communication between the network and the mobile station. It includes the Paging channel (PCH), the Random access channel (RACH), the Access grant channel (AGCH), and the Notification channel (NCH).

q_23233.question: What is the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document indicating?
q_23233.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document indicates the status of the document in the TSG approval process.

q_23234.question: What information does the EL need to access from the BL DPB for inter-layer prediction in the SHVC codec?
q_23234.ground_truth: The EL needs to access the reconstructed pictures, including reconstructed texture samples and typically BL motion information, from the BL DPB for inter-layer prediction in the SHVC codec.

q_23235.question: What should a network do when it receives a valid RLC/MAC block for a TBF and counter N3101 has reached its maximum value?
q_23235.ground_truth: The network shall stop the scheduling of RLC/MAC blocks for that TBF and start timer T3169. When T3169 expires, the network may reuse the USF and TFI(s) assigned to that TBF.

q_23236.question: What shall the mobile station do when a PAN field is received in an RLC/MAC block while monitoring downlink PDCHs?
q_23236.ground_truth: The mobile station shall attempt to decode the PAN field in the RLC/MAC block addressed to other mobile stations if present in the header of the EGPRS RLC/MAC block for data transfer received on these PDCHs.

q_23237.question: What is the measurement range for RX Timing Deviation in the 3.84 Mcps TDD option?
q_23237.ground_truth: The reporting range for RX Timing Deviation in the 3.84 Mcps TDD option is from -1023,9375 to 1023,9375 chips.

q_23238.question: What is the unit of the measurement provided by UE transmitted power?

q_23239.question: What is the function of Node B in combining/splitting of DCH data streams?
q_23239.ground_truth: Node B may perform combining/splitting of DCH data streams communicated via its cells, while RNC performs combining/splitting of Iub data streams received from/sent to several Node B(s).

q_23240.question: What does UE-AMBR limit the aggregate bit rate for?
q_23240.ground_truth: The UE-AMBR limits the aggregate bit rate that can be expected to be provided across all Non-GBR PDP contexts of a UE.

q_23241.question: What does the "SS Screening indicator" indicate in the context of the CUG procedure?
q_23241.ground_truth: The "SS Screening indicator" is used by the network to indicate to the MS (mobile station) that a CUG has been invoked for a call.

q_23242.question: How many SSB (Synchronization Signal Block) beams are supported for licensed and unlicensed operation in the 52.6 GHz to 71 GHz frequency range?
q_23242.ground_truth: Up to 64 SSB beams are supported.

q_23243.question: What is the requirement for the UE and the EES in order to use AKMA?
q_23243.ground_truth: Both the UE and the EES need to support AKMA for this solution to work. Additionally, the ECS must provide the AKMA capability of the EES(s) to the UE, so that the UE can determine to use AKMA when establishing a connection with the EES.

q_23244.question: What should the UE do if the security check of the steering of roaming information is not successful and the UE is in automatic network selection mode?
q_23244.ground_truth: If the security check is not successful and the UE is in automatic network selection mode, the UE shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN as specified in the clauses. If the UE has an established emergency PDU session, the UE shall attempt to perform the PLMN selection after the emergency PDU session is released and after the UE enters idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication.

q_23245.question: Which ciphering and integrity settings are enabled in the NR/5GC Layer 3 normal mode for the SS side?
q_23245.ground_truth: In the NR/5GC Layer 3 normal mode, ciphering and integrity are enabled for L1, MAC, RLC, PDCP, and SDAP in the SS side, and perform all their functions normally.

q_23246.question: What is the counter that stores the total number of attempted outgoing intra-DeNB handover preparations from DeNB cell to RN, regardless of the cause?

q_23247.question: What is the role of spectral diversity in noise estimation?
q_23247.ground_truth: Spectral diversity is used as an auxiliary parameter for the complementary non-stationarity to detect significant spectral changes in certain music signals.

q_23248.question: What is required to be sent by the MRFC for the media line to be set up for a CLUE data channel?
q_23248.ground_truth: The MRFC shall send the remote UDP port and SCTP port, shall request the local UDP port and SCTP port from the MRFP, shall indicate the MRFP to start a DTLS bearer session establishment at the termination towards the SDP offerer, shall send the dcmap-stream-id parameter, shall send the subprotocol value of "CLUE", shall indicate the maximum message size if it is contained in the received SDP offer, and shall request the maximum message size from the MRFP if not contained in the received SDP offer.

q_23249.question: What exception is thrown if dataLength is less than 0 in CRRP5 or CRRP6?

q_23250.question: How does the PSS client become aware of the scale values supported for the content?
q_23250.ground_truth: The PSS Client is made aware of the scale values supported for the content via the "X-Scale" media level attribute, or by using the "scales" parameter in the GET_PARAMETER and SET_PARAMETER.

q_23251.question: Why would the LLE send an "LL-RELEASE-IND (Cause='Invalid XID Response')" to layer 3, and enter ABM state after retransmitting the SABM or XID command N200 times?
q_23251.ground_truth: This is done when the LLE has retransmitted the SABM or XID command N200 times due to an invalid XID response.

q_23252.question: What are the considerations for existing clients regarding the addition of quality information in DASH MPD?
q_23252.ground_truth: Existing clients should be operational by simply ignoring the quality information, while new and more advanced client designs should be able to read and take advantage of it.

q_23253.question: What is the signalling protocol used between the CSS and the VLR in the Hv reference point?
q_23253.ground_truth: The Mobile Application Part (MAP), which in turn uses the services of Transaction Capabilities (TCAP), is used between the CSS and the VLR in the Hv reference point.

q_23254.question: What should an eP-CSCF do for each media line that relates to a data channel within one SCTP association in the SDP offer it forwards to the WIC?
q_23254.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF should encapsulate each received media level attribute, except for "fingerprint" and "tls-id" attributes, into an "tra-att" attribute and add this attribute as a media level attribute for the media line.

q_23255.question: What is the expected action from the MBMS client after the MAA invokes the startPacketService() API in clause 6.4.3.7?
q_23255.ground_truth: The MBMS client starts the Packet service if possible, and sends a serviceStarted() notification or an appropriate error message in response to the startPacketService() API call.

q_23256.question: WhichSprintf"%s" primitive is used for the reliable transmission of an LL-PDU?
q_23256.ground_truth: The GRR-DATA-REQ primitive is used for the reliable transmission of an LL-PDU.

q_23257.question: What should the UE do upon the initiation of the resume procedure when responding to NG-RAN paging?
q_23257.ground_truth: The UE should select Access Category '0', perform the unified access control procedure, and transmit the RRCResumeRequest message or RRCResumeRequest1.

q_23258.question: What should the SGSN do if an MS in PMM-CONNECTED state has a CSG membership change while connected via a CSG or hybrid cell?
q_23258.ground_truth: The SGSN initiates the procedure in clause~9.2.3.7.

q_23259.question: What is the function of the V-PCRF in the visited network?
q_23259.ground_truth: The V-PCRF in the visited network encompasses policy control decision and flow-based charging control functionalities. It provides functions for both home routed and visited access and interacts with the H-PCRF to validate QoS based on operator policies.

q_23260.question: In the 3GPP technical specification, what is the name of the protocol layer responsible for integrity protection of signalling messages in Iu mode?

q_23261.question: What is required for the initial conditions of the method of test?
q_23261.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the method of test require that the device (ME) is connected to a USIM simulator and a USS, with the necessary files coded as USIM Application Toolkit default. The device must have been powered on and performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure prior to the test. Additionally, a valid access to 2 different Wap gateways is required.

q_23262.question: What is the relationship between out-of-band emissions and necessary bandwidth in the context of UTRA UE?
q_23262.ground_truth: Out-of-band emissions are emissions on frequencies immediately outside the necessary bandwidth, which results from the modulation process. Emissions that fall at frequencies separated from the center frequency of the emission by less than 250% of the necessary bandwidth are generally considered out-of-band emissions.

q_23263.question: What protocol is used to provide connectionless, best-effort, unreliable delivery of datagrams between nodes on IP networks?

q_23264.question: What is the purpose of the initial conditions in the test procedures?
q_23264.ground_truth: The initial conditions in the test procedures ensure that the ME is connected to the USIM Simulator and USS, and that the elementary files are coded as Toolkit default. They also state that the ME has been powered on and performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure prior to the test.

q_23265.question: What polynomial is obtained by adding bit-wise modulo 2 the three eTFI bits to the last three parity bits, in the 3GPP TS 44.060 eTFI field parity check addition operation?
q_23265.ground_truth: pt(k) for k = 0,1,...,7 where k = 4 implies the 5th undefined parity bit

q_23266.question: What should the pairing of PLMN lists and cells lists be based on for System Information Block type 11 and 11bis, when type 11bis is scheduled on BCH?
q_23266.ground_truth: The PLMN lists should be paired with the list of cells of the same type derived from System Information Block type 11 and 11bis if scheduled on BCH.

q_23267.question: In the context of FDD, what action does the Node B take if the Transmission Gap Pattern Sequence Code Information IE in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message has the Downlink Compressed Mode Method IE set to "SF/2"?
q_23267.ground_truth: The Node B uses an alternate scrambling code for each DL Channelisation Code in the Transmission Gap Pattern Sequence as indicated in the message.

q_23268.question: What does the acronym "ICIC" represent in the field of telecommunications?

q_23269.question: How does the achievable activity depend on the stationarity and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the noise?
q_23269.ground_truth: The achievable activity strongly depends on the type of noise, with more stationary noises such as car having reasonably low activity levels, and less stationary noises and music background signals having higher activity levels. The dependence on SNR varies, with a minor dependence observed for more stationary noises such as car.

q_23270.question: What is the alpha identifier for the menu in "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP MENU 1.2.1"?
q_23270.ground_truth: The alpha identifier for the menu is "LargeMenu1".

q_23271.question: What is the long-term correlation map used for in the tonal stability calculation?
q_23271.ground_truth: The long-term correlation map is used to indicate the correlation between the spectral peaks in the current frame and the past frame, and it is updated in every frame.

q_23272.question: How does the UE calculate the CN domain specific DRX cycle length coefficient?
q_23272.ground_truth: The UE sets k to the value of the IE "CN domain specific DRX cycle length coefficient", and stores the result of MAX(2k, PBP) as the CN domain specific DRX cycle length for the indicated CN domain.

q_23273.question: What is the purpose of the protocol extension mechanism in the common information element category supplementary service protocol?
q_23273.ground_truth: The protocol extension mechanism in the common information element category supplementary service protocol allows controlled evolution of the protocol by allowing optional information to be introduced into operations without causing receiving entities, who do not recognize this information, to reject the entire operation.

q_23274.question: What information must a PLMN component be able to determine for the Mobile Additional Function "Barring of all incoming calls related authorizations examination"?
q_23274.ground_truth: A PLMN component must be able to determine the authorizations relating to barring of all incoming calls for this function.

q_23275.question: Which type of AVP is the Account-Expiration AVP in the Transfer-Information AVP?
q_23275.ground_truth: The Account-Expiration AVP in the Transfer-Information AVP is of type Time.

q_23276.question: What is the measurement reporting delay for Event Triggered reporting?
q_23276.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for Event Triggered reporting is less than T identify,E-UTRAN + TRA, where T identify,E-UTRAN is defined in Section 8.4.2.6.1 and TRA is the additional delay caused by the random access procedure.

q_23277.question: In FDD mode, for each HS-DSCH TTI, which physical channel indicates whether the UE could use more resources or not when the E-DCH operation is applicable?
q_23277.ground_truth: A single bit is transmitted on the E-DPCCH physical channel per activated uplink frequency to indicate whether the UE could use more resources or not when the E-DCH operation is applicable in FDD mode.

q_23278.question: What is the difference between PDC and TDMA modulation accuracy requirements and WCDMA uplink modulation accuracy requirements?
q_23278.ground_truth: PDC and TDMA have a similar modulation as WCDMA but have a minimum requirement of 12.5% for EVM, whereas WCDMA uplink modulation accuracy requirements are 25% for a typical minimum requirement and 17.5% for a reasonable minimum requirement.

q_23279.question: What is the Vendor ID that shall be contained in the Vendor-Id AVP for features defined in the specification?
q_23279.ground_truth: The Vendor-Id AVP shall contain the vendor ID of 3GPP (10415) for features defined in the specification.

q_23280.question: What information is included in a SLRB mapping rule for V2X communication when the UE is not served by E-UTRA and not served by NR in 3GPP TS 23.287?
q_23280.ground_truth: Each SLRB mapping rule contains a PC5 QoS profile, which in turn contains a PQI, PC5 flow bit rates or PC5 link aggregated bit rate, priority level, averaging window, and/or maximum data burst volume.

q_23281.question: Which LBT technique, Omni LBT or Dir LBT, provided better performance for low ED thresholds in Indoor Scenario A?
q_23281.ground_truth: Dir LBT provided better performance for low ED thresholds in Indoor Scenario A.

q_23282.question: What is the purpose of the Start of Interception with E-UTRAN attached UE REPORT record?
q_23282.ground_truth: The Start of Interception with E-UTRAN attached UE REPORT record is used to convey the start of interception with an E-UTRAN attached UE when the ICE is not aware of the activation of multiple lawfully authorized interceptions.

q_23283.question: What does the UMTS PDP context activation success rate Key Performance Indicator (KPI) measure in a UMTS PS core network?
q_23283.ground_truth: The UMTS PDP context activation success rate KPI describes the ratio of the number of successfully performed PDP context activation procedures to the number of attempted PDP context activation procedures in a UMTS PS core network and is used to evaluate service accessibility provided by UMTS and network performance to provide GPRS.

q_23284.question: What is the Key Issue #1 addressed in Solution #23?
q_23284.ground_truth: Key Issue #1 addressed in Solution #23 is the determination of Disaster Condition for a PLMN.

q_23285.question: What is the purpose of the SIP 183 (Session Progress) response in the AS's actions for early session model?
q_23285.ground_truth: The SIP 183 (Session Progress) response is sent to the originating UE to indicate that the AS has received the initial INVATE request and is processing it, while also allowing the AS to negotiate session parameters with the MRF.

q_23286.question: What is the format of the RP-Cause element in the RP-ERROR message?
q_23286.ground_truth: The format of the RP-Cause element in the RP-ERROR message is TLV, where T represents type (1 octet), L represents length (1 octet), and V represents value (variable length).

q_23287.question: What is the requirement that is explicitly verified at step 4) in section 6.1.9.5 for the UE to give an indication of a successful execution of the command and new (Universal) PIN is accepted?

q_23288.question: Which extension mechanism is the preferred option when forming an octet group for type 4 information elements?
q_23288.ground_truth: The preferred option for forming an octet group for type 4 information elements is by extending an octet through the next octets using bit 8 in each octet as an extension bit.

q_23289.question: What is the significance of the "OSId" leaf in the ISRP rules?
q_23289.ground_truth: The "OSId" leaf indicates an operating system identifier and is used to determine if the IP flow is sent by an application associated with an OS specific application identifier in one of the OSAppId leaves.

q_23290.question: Where does the UE send the INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message and what happens after submission?
q_23290.ground_truth: The UE sends the INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message on the uplink DCCH using AM RLC on signalling radio bearer RB3. Upon the successful delivery of the message, the procedure ends.

q_23291.question: What is an Elementary Procedure in the context of RNSAP protocol?
q_23291.ground_truth: An Elementary Procedure (EP) is a unit of interaction between two RNCs in the RNSAP protocol. It consists of an initiating message and possibly a response message, and can be classified as either Class 1 (with a response of success or failure) or Class 2 (considered always successful).

q_23292.question: What action does the UP function take when it receives an Sx session termination request message?
q_23292.ground_truth: The UP function identifies the Sx session context to be terminated by the Session ID and removes the whole session context.

q_23293.question: What command is used by the SIM to power on the card in the card reader 1?

q_23294.question: Which alternative is recommended for interworking with UMTS_EVS on Nb interface?
q_23294.ground_truth: Mb-alt 1 is the preferred and recommended alternative for interworking with UMTS_EVS on Nb interface.

q_23295.question: What is the role of the UE in the solution?
q_23295.ground_truth: The UE sends a request for a PDU session establishment/modification and includes the multicast group ID it wishes to join, receives MTK and KID from SMF, uses the received MTK to decrypt the protected multicast data and/or verify the integrity of the protected multicast data.

q_23296.question: Which technique is used in Enhanced Uplink for faster retransmissions between UE and Node B?

q_23297.question: What is the document produced by in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) that specifies the standards for implementing Layer 1 on the Iur interface?
q_23297.ground_truth: The name of the document is "3GPP TS 25.411".

q_23298.question: What service is enabled in the USIM Simulator for the tests?
q_23298.ground_truth: The Barred Dialling Number service is enabled in the USIM Simulator for the tests.

q_23299.question: Which IE indicates whether the Node B is allowed to use 64 QAM modulation for HS-DSCH transmission or not?

q_23300.question: What is the effect of communication services of lower priority running in parallel on high priority communication services, especially their end-to-end latency and availability?
q_23300.ground_truth: High priority communication services, especially their end-to-end latency and availability, shall not be affected by communication services of lower priority running in parallel.

q_23301.question: What is the format of the "DCH-InformationResponseList-RL-ReconfReady" protocol IEs?
q_23301.ground_truth: It is a protocol IE single container that contains an "ID" and a "DCH-InformationResponse" with CRITICALITY ignore and mandatory presence.

q_23302.question: What is one consequence of UP-IP termination in the DU?
q_23302.ground_truth: The F1-C interface is extended with one or more new messages to supply the DU with the required information for the integrity protection of this solution, in addition to applying IPsec on the F1-U interface. This provides integrity protection between the UE and the DU. The security mechanisms for the F1-C interface need to be applied to protect the key K.

q_23303.question: What is the maximum transmit power of the HS-SCCH that the Node-B should not exceed?
q_23303.ground_truth: This value is indicated by higher layers and should not be exceeded by the Node-B when setting the HS-SCCH power.

q_23304.question: What should the UE include in the SDP answer for CRS service if the telephone-event media subtype is used?
q_23304.ground_truth: The UE should indicate support of the SIP INFO mechanism for DTMF transport by including a Recv-Info header field with a "infoDtmf" value.

q_23305.question: How many HS-SCCH orders can be simultaneously received by the UE across the serving and all the activated secondary serving HS-DSCH cells?
q_23305.ground_truth: The maximum number of HS-SCCH orders simultaneously received by the UE across the serving and all the activated secondary serving HS-DSCH cells is 2.

q_23306.question: What should a WIC do when it receives a response indicating that a UE non-detected emergency call has happened and was not supported by the network?
q_23306.ground_truth: The WIC should indicate to the user that an attempt for an UE non-detected emergency call has happened and was not supported by the network, and should not retry the emergency call via W2 interface.

q_23307.question: What should a 3GPP UE comply with as a minimum to support IPv6?
q_23307.ground_truth: A 3GPP UE should comply with the Basic IP group of specifications as defined in RFC 3316 as a minimum to support IPv6.

q_23308.question: Which technical specification is required for the ME to support the DISPLAY TEXT command with Chinese characters?
q_23308.ground_truth: The ME shall support the UCS2 alphabet for the coding of the Chinese characters, as defined in the ISO/IEC 10646 technical specification.

q_23309.question: What is the role of the IM CN subsystem in the PSS download service?
q_23309.ground_truth: The IM CN subsystem forwards the SIP INVITE message to the SCF, forwards the SIP 200 OK from the SCF to the UE, and handles the SIP dialog.

q_23310.question: What is sent in the IOPS call setup request in the automatic commencement mode procedure?
q_23310.ground_truth: The IOPS call setup request contains an SDP offer, an automatic commencement mode indication, and an element that indicates that the originating MCPTT client is requesting the floor. It may also include location information.

q_23311.question: How are parameters coded in the DATA FRAMEs?
q_23311.ground_truth: The parameters are coded based on their value range. The lowest value in the range is coded as a sequence of 0's, while the highest value in the range is coded as a sequence of 1's.
