q_23565.question: What is a watcher in the context of the presence service?
q_23565.ground_truth: A watcher is any uniquely identifiable entity that requests presence information about a presentity or watcher information from the presence service.

q_23566.question: What does the NG-RAN do if it receives multiple MB Session Resource Setup Request messages for the same TMGI?
q_23566.ground_truth: The NG-RAN only performs the resource setup once

q_23567.question: What compression schemes were considered for the eCall verification system?
q_23567.ground_truth: Two compression schemes were considered for the eCall verification system: Simple G.711 A-law companding and G.729 encoding.

q_23568.question: When can the UE return the position and optional velocity estimate to the SRNC after performing measurements for a UE-based method?
q_23568.ground_truth: The UE returns the position and optional velocity estimate to the SRNC after calculating the estimate, which includes the position, optional velocity estimate, estimated accuracy of the results, and time of the estimate.

q_23569.question: What must the UE do if the SUCI is included in the 5GS mobile identity IE and the timer T3519 is not running?
q_23569.ground_truth: The UE must start timer T3519 and store the value of the SUCI sent in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message. The UE must include the stored SUCI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message while timer T3519 is running.

q_23570.question: What message does UDM send when there is no match for any field requested for analytics IDs?
q_23570.ground_truth: UDM sends to the NF an indication of no applicable ASI for any of the requested fields.

q_23571.question: In the password registration procedure, what is the second step if the password check procedure has returned an indication of successful password check?
q_23571.ground_truth: The second step in the password registration procedure, after a successful password check, is that the network sends an invoke component of the operation "get password" with "new password?" as the value of the mandatory GuidanceInfo information element. This is embedded in a FACILITY message, prompting the MS to return the required new password.

q_23572.question: What is the main objective of the Immersive media conversations use case?
q_23572.ground_truth: The main objective of the Immersive media conversations use case is to transmit 360 video and multi-channel audio from a media sender to a media receiver and transmit lower quality video bit-streams in the opposite direction for real-time voice conversation.

q_23573.question: How can a UE determine the DL, UL, and other symbols in a slot?
q_23573.ground_truth: The UE can derive at least which symbols in a slot that are DL, UL, and other based on the slot format related information received on a group common PDCCH.

q_23574.question: What exception is thrown if the 'incr' array is null in the increase method?
q_23574.ground_truth: If the 'incr' array is null, an instance of NullPointerException is thrown.

q_23575.question: Which delivery methods are mentioned for the first User Service?
q_23575.ground_truth: The first User Service is delivered over both the MBMS bearer and the unicast bearer.

q_23576.question: What is the role of a Data Repository if it's not standardized by 3GPP?
q_23576.ground_truth: A non-standardized Data Repository interacts as a Data Consumer or Data Source using services not defined by 3GPP, such as those native to the Messaging Framework.

q_23577.question: What action does the BSS-1 take when it cannot receive DL data at the same time as it receives local data during a handover?
q_23577.ground_truth: The BSS-1 sends any DL data it receives directly to the served UE to minimize the break in user plane data.

q_23578.question: What is the Correlation Number used for in EPS bearer/tunnel?
q_23578.ground_truth: The Correlation Number is used to correlate call content with intercept-related information, to correlate different intercept-related records within one bearer/tunnel, and to correlate lawful assessment reports with the intercept records of the triggering events.

q_23579.question: Which digest algorithm is supported for backward compatibility in 3GPP~TS~29.228?
q_23579.ground_truth: The "AKAv1-MD5" digest AKA algorithm is supported for backward compatibility in 3GPP~TS~29.228.

q_23580.question: Which CAP-datatypes are used in CAP for Rel-6 for ApplyChargingGPRSArg to define the charging characteristics of a GPRS session?
q_23580.ground_truth: The CAP-datatypes used in CAP for Rel-6 for ApplyChargingGPRSArg to define the charging characteristics of a GPRS session are ChargingCharacteristics.

q_23581.question: When can the UE initiate the PDP context activation procedure in the context of adding GERAN or UTRAN access to an existing NBIFOM PDN connection?
q_23581.ground_truth: The UE can initiate the PDP context activation procedure only if the NBIFOM applies to a PDN connection and if the UE is operating in A/Gb mode or Iu mode (but cannot trigger an inter-system change to execute the procedure).

q_23582.question: What should the UE do if one or more Access Identities are indicated and for at least one of these Access Identities the corresponding bit in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity is set to zero?
q_23582.ground_truth: Consider the access attempt as allowed.

q_23583.question: What are the major conclusions from the study for MSGin5G service?
q_23583.ground_truth: The architecture requirements, UE definitions, message reply from Legacy/Non-3GPP UE, interconnection, and interaction with Application Server will be considered for technical specification with necessary enhancements.

q_23584.question: What is the conformance requirement referred to in TS 38.508-1, 9.1.9.7.2?
q_23584.ground_truth: The conformance requirements covered in the current TC are specified in TS 24.501, clauses 4.16, 5.4.4.1, 5.4.4.2, 5.4.4.3, 5.5.1.2.4. Unless otherwise stated, these are Rel-16 requirements.

q_23585.question: What is the purpose of the NRI attribute in a TLLI?
q_23585.ground_truth: The NRI attribute is used to route uplink LLC frames to the correct SGSN, even if the NRI of the TLLI points to a different SGSN.

q_23586.question: What is one of the recommended requirements for a change in proxy cache in 5.4.2?
q_23586.ground_truth: A recommended requirement for a change in proxy cache is that it should have minimum impact on the user experience of the DASH service.

q_23587.question: What are the two possible network modes the UE can end up in after the leaving procedure?
q_23587.ground_truth: After the leaving procedure, the UE/USIM may end up in either CM-IDLE mode or RRC Inactive mode.

q_23588.question: What message is sent by the SRNC to the DRNC when a UE measurement failure occurs?

q_23589.question: How does the 3GPP Technical Specification Group define normative and informative elements in the present document?
q_23589.ground_truth: Normative elements are indicated by "shall" and "shall not", while informative elements are indicated by "may", "need not", "can", "cannot", "is", "is not", "shall", "shall not", "will", "will not", "might", and "might not".

q_23590.question: What is the purpose of the Supported-Features AVP in the Diameter protocol on the Sy interface?
q_23590.ground_truth: The Supported-Features AVP is used during session establishment to inform the destination host about the required and optional features that the origin host supports.

q_23591.question: What is the purpose of the downlink assignment in the MAC entity in 5G?
q_23591.ground_truth: The downlink assignment in the MAC entity in 5G is a scheduling control signal that informs the UE of the resources allocated to it and the redundancy version for the dedicated broadcast HARQ process.

q_23592.question: What is the role of the RRC protocol in the control of radio resources?
q_23592.ground_truth: The RRC protocol controls and signals the allocation of radio resources to the UE and allows MAC to arbitrate between users and Radio Bearers within the radio resource allocation.

q_23593.question: Which network options are affected by the interworking handover solution from 5GS to EPS?
q_23593.ground_truth: The interworking handover solution from 5GS to EPS is applicable to Options 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 7.

q_23594.question: What are some of the high-level requirements for the NRM defined in 3GPP TS 28.621 to support?
q_23594.ground_truth: The NRM defined in 3GPP TS 28.621 shall support management of UMTS-GSM Inter-system handover, telecommunication network management purposes including management of converged networks, and networks that include virtualized network functions.

q_23595.question: What type of data is Validity Area and Time of the Day in system mobility policy, and where is it conditionally stored?
q_23595.ground_truth: Validity Area and Time of the Day in system mobility policy is a set of information that indicates where and when the policy can be applied by the UE. It is conditionally stored in the Access Network Discovery and Selection Function (ANDSF).

q_23596.question: What are the three codec types that speech quality and delay should be measured for in Scenario 1 and 2?
q_23596.ground_truth: AMR-WB, AMR, and EVS SWB at various bit rates.

q_23597.question: Who is the patron saint of music and poetry?

q_23598.question: What are some conditions that determine the delivery mechanism for a MM?
q_23598.ground_truth: The roaming status of the recipient, the identity of the MM originator, the time of day, and the upper limit to the MM size.

q_23599.question: What is the importance of REFSENS requirements?
q_23599.ground_truth: REFSENS requirements ensure the proper functioning and performance of the system, by specifying sensitivity thresholds for various CA combinations.

q_23600.question: What does the acronym RSVP stand for in networking?

q_23601.question: What is the role of the CTS-FP in the intracell handover procedure?
q_23601.ground_truth: The CTS-FP initiates the intracell handover procedure by sending a CTS INTRACELL HANDOVER COMMAND message to the CTS-MS on the main signalling link, commands the switching to the assigned channel, and initiates the establishment of lower layer connections.

q_23602.question: What is the purpose of EVENT accounting data in offline charging?
q_23602.ground_truth: EVENT accounting data is used for simple registration, interrogation, successful service events, and unsuccessful session establishment attempts, which are not related to actual sessions.

q_23603.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification in the field of mobile communication?
q_23603.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification defines rate adaptation functions for PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) Base Station Systems in mobile-services switching centres interface to adapt data rates to the 64 kbit/s used at the A-interface in A/Gb mode and Iu interface in GERAN Iu mode.

q_23604.question: In the context of MSCs acting as different entities, what does the MSC-I act as in the case of internal handover indication?
q_23604.ground_truth: The MSC-I acts as the BSS for the Internal handover indication.

q_23605.question: What is the document specifying for User Equipment (UE) in UMTS system, the UE functions required for conformance testing purposes?
q_23605.ground_truth: The present document, Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network; Terminal logical test interface; Special conformance testing functions (Release 17) by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), specifies such functions.

q_23606.question: What should the MRFC do if it receives an SDP offer with the SDP "a=bw-info" attribute?
q_23606.ground_truth: If the MRFC receives an SDP offer containing the SDP "a=bw-info" attribute(s), the MRFC shall select the payload types, construct appropriate SDP "a=bw-info" attribute(s) and include the "Additional Bandwidth Properties" information element in the remote descriptor when requesting the MRFP to reserve resources.

q_23607.question: What is the role of the TERMINAL RESPONSE command in the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND USSD process?
q_23607.ground_truth: The TERMINAL RESPONSE command is sent from the network to the ME (Mobile Equipment) to indicate the result of the SEND USSD process.

q_23608.question: What is the pre-test condition for the number of cells in the Intra-NR measurements testing?
q_23608.ground_truth: The pre-test condition states that there are three cells in the Intra-NR measurements testing, where NR Cell 1 is the PCell, NR Cell 3 is the SCell, and NR Cell 12 is the intra-frequency neighbor cell of NR Cell 3.

q_23609.question: What message is sent by the ProSe Function in the HPLMN after receiving a Discovery Request in open discovery, if the ProSe Function of the local PLMN does not return any mask?
q_23609.ground_truth: The ProSe Function in the HPLMN notifies the UE that the Discovery Request has been rejected.

q_23610.question: How does a UE determine whether a single * in a Supplementary Service procedure is an activation or registration?
q_23610.ground_truth: A UE determines whether a single * in a Supplementary Service procedure is an activation or registration based on the context, such as whether it contains a forwarded-to number or not.

q_23611.question: What is the role of the BVCI (BSSGP Virtual Connection Identifier) information element in the described network?
q_23611.ground_truth: The BVCI identifies a BVC in the network.

q_23612.question: What is the role of the NAS in the UAC procedure?
q_23612.ground_truth: The NAS detects an access event and performs the mapping of the kind of request to one or more access identities and one access category. The RRC layer then performs access barring checks for that request based on the determined access identities and access category.

q_23613.question: What is the accepted access technology for the HPLMN stored in EFHPPLMN on the USIM?
q_23613.ground_truth: E-UTRAN is the accepted access technology.

q_23614.question: What is the purpose of the classmark updating procedure?
q_23614.ground_truth: The purpose of the classmark updating procedure is to inform the receiving entity about classmark information received from the MS.

q_23615.question: What is the effect of turning off cDRX on downlink in terms of available delay budget for uplink retransmissions?
q_23615.ground_truth: Turning off cDRX on downlink can provide up to 40ms of additional delay budget for uplink and result in improved end-to-end performance in terms of PLR, delay reduction, and POLQA scores.

q_23616.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network in producing the Location Measurement Unit (LMU) conformance specification for Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN)?
q_23616.ground_truth: The purpose is to establish the conformance requirements for E-UTRAN Location Measurement Units (LMU) operating in the FDD or TDD mode.

q_23617.question: What action does the SMF take upon receipt of a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and a PDU session ID?
q_23617.ground_truth: The SMF creates a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and starts timer T3590.

q_23618.question: How many bits are allocated for the SNPL and SNPL bitmap fields in a carrier's scheduling information?
q_23618.ground_truth: The SNPL field is 5 bits long, and the SNPL bitmap is also 5 bits long.

q_23619.question: What information is held by the GCR for static broadcast call attributes?
q_23619.ground_truth: The GCR stores a list of static Broadcast Call Attributes for a given group call reference, which includes a list of cells, a list of group call relay MSCs or redundancy pools, information on the cipher algorithm and group key, information on the allowed codecs, a list of dispatcher identities, and eMLPP priority level.

q_23620.question: What is the impact of Solution #13 on UDR internal logic?
q_23620.ground_truth: For ensuring that AuthEvent containing newer result is allowed to be stored, the UDR internal logic is impacted.

q_23621.question: What is the mapping used in the proxy AA network function?
q_23621.ground_truth: The mapping used in the proxy AA network function is of EEC ID and KProxy.

q_23622.question: What is the procedure if a UE-originating request from an unregistered user does not match the highest priority initial filter criteria?
q_23622.ground_truth: The S-CSCF checks for matching of the following filter criteria priorities until one applies and, if no more (or none) of the initial filter criteria apply, forwards the request downstream based on the route decision.

q_23623.question: What is the purpose of the HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling Deactivate Indicator LCR IE?
q_23623.ground_truth: It is used to deactivate HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling operation for 1.28 Mcps TDD.

q_23624.question: What should be the value of NAS key set identifier and TSC in the REGISTRATION REQUEST during step l) in the test method?
q_23624.ground_truth: The NAS key set identifier should be set to '000' and TSC should be set to '0'.

q_23625.question: What type of services support real-time exchange of 3D video information over mobile networks?
q_23625.ground_truth: 3D conversational services and multiple-party 3D video conference are the services that support real-time exchange of 3D video information over mobile networks.

q_23626.question: What is the order of values for the message contents in sub-clause 9.1.12a?
q_23626.ground_truth: The message contents in sub-clause 9.1.12a defines a sequence of bits in decreasing order of value, where the first bit of the message represents the highest order value and the last bit represents the lowest order value.

q_23627.question: What element and attribute in the sessionScheduleOverride element are used to cancel a session occurrence?
q_23627.ground_truth: If the cancelled attribute of the sessionScheduleOverride element is set to "true" or "1", then the transmission of the session identified by the index attribute is cancelled.

q_23628.question: What are the core components of the solution for MBS session management without using UE IP address?
q_23628.ground_truth: The core components of the solution are: MBS UE Context Activation and Deactivation procedure, impacts on services, entities and interfaces, and the definition of functions and procedures.

q_23629.question: How many preamble scrambling codes are there for the PRACH preamble part?
q_23629.ground_truth: There are 8192 PRACH preamble scrambling codes in total.

q_23630.question: What must the SGSN follow when deactivating a PDP context initiated by the network?
q_23630.ground_truth: The SGSN must follow the procedure in 3GPP TS 24.008.

q_23631.question: What shall the UE do to the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message received over the non-current access when the UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode and the horizontal derivation parameter indicates "KAMF derivation is required" and the new 5G NAS security context is taken into use?
q_23631.ground_truth: The UE and the AMF shall activate the new 5G NAS security context over the non-current access, setting the downlink NAS COUNT and uplink NAS COUNT to zero for the non-current access.

q_23632.question: What is the maximum allowed intermodulation component level in dBc for a BTS that does not belong to a multicarrier BTS class, at frequency offsets from the wanted signal carrier frequency of less than 6 MHz?
q_23632.ground_truth: The maximum allowed intermodulation component level in dBc is specified in subclause 6.5.1.4 and can be up to -70 dBc or -36 dBm, whichever is higher.

q_23633.question: What action does the DRNC take if the Primary CPICH Ec/No IE is present in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
q_23633.ground_truth: The DRNC should use the indicated value when deciding the Initial DL TX Power.

q_23634.question: What is the function of the two-level hierarchical NWDAFs Architecture?
q_23634.ground_truth: The two-level hierarchical NWDAFs Architecture allows for the use of multiple NWDAF instances by having a first level NWDAF that is common and a second level NWDAF that registers with the NRF with associated 5GC NF IDs. This architecture ensures data analytics are covered and available in case of NF failure.

q_23635.question: What is the alpha identifier in the SELECT ITEM 2.1.1 command in the expected sequence 2.1 for "SELECT ITEM (next action indicator, successful)"?

q_23636.question: What is the role of the location service support entity in the location service procedures?
q_23636.ground_truth: The location service support entity provides the means to transfer messages for the location service procedures between the users of the location service support.

q_23637.question: What should the ME display as the Operator 5G PLMN name after the UE registers to a TAI with the MCC/MNC of 244/040 using ECIES scheme profile B for SUCI calculation?
q_23637.ground_truth: The ME should display the registered MCC and MNC as the Operator 5G PLMN name.

q_23638.question: What is the function of the "a= 3gpp.iut.replication" attribute in the media component?
q_23638.ground_truth: The "a= 3gpp.iut.replication" attribute in the media component indicates that the replication request is sent from the controllee UE and it uses the network based solution.

q_23639.question: What is the purpose of Correlation Number in the telecommunication system?
q_23639.ground_truth: The Correlation Number is used to correlate CC with IRI and correlate different IRI records within one conference session for a given target.

q_23640.question: How does the ME calculate the SUCI using the null-scheme in the 5G network?
q_23640.ground_truth: The ME shall select the protection scheme from its supported schemes that has the highest priority in the list obtained from the USIM, and subsequently calculate the SUCI using the null-scheme if the highest priority of the protection schemes listed in the USIM is the null-scheme.

q_23641.question: What mobile station actions are taken if the network sends a PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message in a PCCCH block while in packet idle mode?
q_23641.ground_truth: The mobile station shall obey the PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message and switch to the specified new cell, obeying the relevant RLC/MAC procedures on this new cell, if not involved in an RR connection.

q_23642.question: What is the original intended use of TS 26.132 in acoustic testing of terminals?
q_23642.ground_truth: TS 26.132 is originally intended for acoustic testing of terminals.

q_23643.question: What event is used to report to DF2 when the HSS sends a registration termination request to the S-CSCF or 3GPP AAA Server?

q_23644.question: What is the role of the PDN-GW in interception for PMIP based S5/S8 interfaces?
q_23644.ground_truth: The PDN-GW provides correlation number and target identity to the DF2 for interception in PMIP based S5/S8 interfaces.

q_23645.question: What is the maximum number of times an INFO request can be sent in association with the g.3gpp.ussd info package per second?
q_23645.ground_truth: There is no maximum rate defined for sending INFO requests associated with the g.3gpp.ussd info package.

q_23646.question: What is the maximum difference in performance metrics for S-MOS in the noise field simulations in TS 103 224?
q_23646.ground_truth: The maximum difference is 0.86 for the per-background noise results and 0.40 for the per-DUT results for S-MOS in TS 103 224.

q_23647.question: What is the difference between Class 1 and Class 2 elementary procedures in the RETAP and TMAAP protocol?
q_23647.ground_truth: Class 1 elementary procedures are those that include a response message indicating success or failure, while Class 2 elementary procedures do not include a response message.

q_23648.question: What is the primary difference between Solution #3 and Solution #18 for ProSe code allocation?
q_23648.ground_truth: Solution #3 proposes a user plane based solution, while Solution #18 proposes a control plane based solution for ProSe code allocation.

q_23649.question: What is returned by the CatGetByte function when it is called during CatTest?
q_23649.ground_truth: The CatGetByte function returns the byte at the current buffer pointer and advances the pointer by one byte during the testing process.

q_23650.question: What does the INACTIVE value represent for the 3GPP-PS-Data-Off-Status AVP?
q_23650.ground_truth: The UE deactivates the 3GPP PS Data off.

q_23651.question: What is the effect of trackingAreaCode not being provided for cell barring?
q_23651.ground_truth: If barring of a cell is triggered by the condition of trackingAreaCode not being provided, the barring only applies to this PLMN and the UE can re-evaluate the barring condition again due to selection of another PLMN.

q_23652.question: What is the Frame Start Identifier (FSI) value for indicating each consecutive sequence of ITU-T V.110 80 bit frames?
q_23652.ground_truth: The Frame Start Identifier (FSI) value is 00 01 10 11.

q_23653.question: What is the purpose of the Deferred MT-LR Area Event procedure in location services operations?
q_23653.ground_truth: The Deferred MT-LR Area Event procedure is used to request verification for an MT-LR and send it to the mobile station. If the mobile station is unable to process the request, it should return an error indication.

q_23654.question: What is required for a ME to be network personalised to more than one network?
q_23654.ground_truth: The ME shall have storage for the network personalisation indicator, the network code(s), and the NCK to support the network personalisation feature for multiple networks.

q_23655.question: What happens after the CDR for the ProSe unicast Direct Communication is updated by the CHF for the UE in step 9ch-b?
q_23655.ground_truth: The CHF sends the corresponding Charging Data Response to the NF (CTF) in step 9ch-c.

q_23656.question: What is the main goal of Radio Admission Control (RAC) in LTE?
q_23656.ground_truth: The main goal of RAC is to ensure high radio resource utilization and proper QoS for in-progress sessions.

q_23657.question: How does the UE determine if NBIFOM applies to the PDN connection during the PDP context activation procedure?
q_23657.ground_truth: The UE determines that NBIFOM applies to the PDN connection if the network responds with the NBIFOM container IE containing the NBIFOM status parameter set to "Accepted" in the ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message during the PDP context activation procedure.

q_23658.question: Who is the father of modern physics?

q_23659.question: What is the role of the Upper Tester (UT) in the testing architecture?
q_23659.ground_truth: The Upper Tester (UT) interfaces with the UE and provides coordination primitives for automatic tests or MMI commands for the UE to perform certain actions or observations.

q_23660.question: What is the accurate range for CPICH Ec/Io measurement?
q_23660.ground_truth: The accurate range for CPICH Ec/Io measurement is from -24...0 dB.

q_23661.question: What is the role of the Signalling Gateway Function (SGW) in the interworking reference model?
q_23661.ground_truth: The Signalling Gateway Function (SGW) performs the call related signalling conversion to or from BICC/ISUP based MTP transport networks to BICC/ISUP based SCTP/IP transport networks, and forwards the converted signalling to or from the MGCF.

q_23662.question: Which environmental conditions should be within the ranges specified in subclause 5.4.1 for vibration conditions?
q_23662.ground_truth: Other environmental conditions, including barometric pressure, temperature, and humidity, shall be within the ranges specified in subclause 5.4.1 for vibration conditions.

q_23663.question: What is the purpose of the "AK" variable in the Tuak algorithm set?
q_23663.ground_truth: "AK" is a 48-bit anonymity key generated by either the f5 or f5* function in the Tuak algorithm set.

q_23664.question: What is defined in the present document regarding the service provider in relation to a user?
q_23664.ground_truth: The service provider can either be the home operator or a third party service provider.

q_23665.question: What is the consequence of the mobile station not sending an EXTENDED MEASUREMENT REPORT message within 10 seconds after receiving the EXTENDED MEASUREMENT ORDER message?
q_23665.ground_truth: No EXTENDED MEASUREMENT REPORT message shall be sent if the mobile station has not started to send it within 10 seconds after the reception of the EXTENDED MEASUREMENT ORDER message.

q_23666.question: What occurs after the VPLMN has received instructions from the CSE when a PDP Context Establishment Acknowledgement is reported as a Subsequent Service Event in the PDP Context relationship?
q_23666.ground_truth: After the VPLMN receives instructions from the CSE, the VPLMN can activate subsequent control service events for the life of the PDP context, perform charging activities that apply to the PDP Context, and then receive one of two final instructions: Release the PDP Context or Continue the processing.

q_23667.question: What is the channel numbering scheme for E-UTRA, UTRA, and GSM in the context of MSR?
q_23667.ground_truth: The frequency numbering scheme for each RAT will remain the same in the context of MSR, and the E-UTRA Absolute Radio Frequency Channel Number (EARFCN) supports inter-band mobility and inter-RAT inter-working.

q_23668.question: In the above equation, what are the units for OFF and Tm?
q_23668.ground_truth: OFF has the unit Frames and Tm the unit Chips.

q_23669.question: What should the network do if it receives an interrogation with the value "all forwarding SS" or "all conditional forwarding SS"?
q_23669.ground_truth: The network should send a return error component.

q_23670.question: What is the purpose of registering with a non-zero registrationValidityDuration when consuming File Delivery Application Services?
q_23670.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the MBMS client to collect files matching outstanding capture requests from the application even after the application has been de-registered, and keep them in its cache for the duration of the registration validity period.

q_23671.question: What is the difference in scope between Type 2 and Type 3 virtualized network product class in a decoupling scenario?
q_23671.ground_truth: In a decoupling scenario, Type 2 only includes decoupled 3GPP defined functionalities and Virtualization layer, while Type 3 includes decoupled 3GPP defined functionalities, Virtualization layer, and hardware layer.

q_23672.question: Which TS31.111 clauses should the ME conform to for the PLAY TONE command with UCS2 display in Katakana?
q_23672.ground_truth: The ME should conform to clauses 5.2, 6.4.3, 6.6.3, 6.8, 6.11, 8.6, 8.7, 8.2, 8.16, and 8.8 in TS31.111, and support the UCS2 facility for Katakana encoding.

q_23673.question: What is the name of the TDD only extension with criticality reject in the RNSAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?

q_23674.question: Which components are being used in "TIMER" for "applyChargingReport" and "callInformationReport"?
q_23674.ground_truth: The components being used in "TIMER" for "applyChargingReport" and "callInformationReport" are "Tacr" and "Tcirp".

q_23675.question: What is the purpose of the Diameter-based SLh interface in this specification?
q_23675.ground_truth: The Diameter-based SLh interface is defined between the GMLC and the HSS to allow the GMLC to request routing information from the HLR or HSS for a particular target UE whose location has been requested.

q_23676.question: What is the purpose of the Fetch target Edge Application Server API exposed by the Edge Enabler Server to the Edge Application Server?
q_23676.ground_truth: The purpose of the Fetch target Edge Application Server API is to obtain the IP address of the target Edge Application Server which can serve the UE in mobility.

q_23677.question: What should the MS do if the registered SNPN is unavailable during recovery from lack of coverage?
q_23677.ground_truth: The MS may, optionally, continue looking for the registered SNPN for an implementation dependent time.

q_23678.question: What does the first digit in the version number of the 3GPP technical specification document indicate?
q_23678.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of the 3GPP technical specification document indicates the stage of approval of the document within the TSG.

q_23679.question: Which two components are collocated in the architecture for transport only mode and full service mode?

q_23680.question: What is one of the management requirements for IMS Messaging sessions?
q_23680.ground_truth: IMS Messaging sessions shall be able to support a request from the user to enable or disable message delivery and submission.

q_23681.question: What is the maximum code block size for convolutional coding?
q_23681.ground_truth: The maximum code block size for convolutional coding is 504.

q_23682.question: What is the central part for any viewport-related handling in the DASH media?
q_23682.ground_truth: The adaptation sets are the central part for any viewport-related handling of the DASH media. Each adaptation set covers a certain spatial area of the sphere, and it may also contain additional information on the relative quality ranking between the sets.

q_23683.question: What is the purpose of the 5G-S-TMSI in the context of 5G networks?
q_23683.ground_truth: The 5G-S-TMSI is used as a UE identifier for CN paging in 5G networks.

q_23684.question: What is the procedure for terminating sessions that use PS media via IMS, where the S-CSCF inserts the SCC AS in the IMS session path using terminating initial filter criteria?
q_23684.ground_truth: The S-CSCF inserts the SCC AS in the IMS session path using terminating initial filter criteria. The SCC AS is the last AS inserted into the session path and it performs the necessary interworking between the IMS network and the CS network.

q_23685.question: What should be the test procedure for assessing the throughput of the IAB-DU downlink using a communication link established between the transmitter and the test equipment?
q_23685.ground_truth: The test equipment should meet the requirements for throughput assessment defined in TS38.176-1 and TS38.176-2 for the bearer used in the immunity tests. The signal supplied to the equipment should be within the range for which the assessment of throughput is not impaired. Power control should be OFF during the immunity testing.

q_23686.question: What is the network deployment scenario described in scenario 1, and what is the coverage scenario described in scenario 1?
q_23686.ground_truth: In scenario 1, the networks may consist of LTE cells deployed as capacity enhancement, overlaying existing and optimized 2G/3G network. The LTE cells boost the capacity and basic coverage is provided by 2G/3G network. LTE-only capable devices may not have service.

q_23687.question: What is the aim of the negotiation between the SCEF and the H-PCRF for future background data transfer?
q_23687.ground_truth: The negotiation aims to determine the time window and the related conditions for future background data transfer, with the H-PCRF storing the selected transfer policy and the corresponding network area information in the SPR.

q_23688.question: What network application function interface specification is used as a basis for the AKMA TLS protocol profiles?
q_23688.ground_truth: TS 24.109, "Bootstrapping interface (Ub) and network application function interface (Ua); Protocol details"

q_23689.question: What does the abbreviation "UMTS" stand for in the context of mobile communication?

q_23690.question: What are the two types of operation defined for layer 3 information transfer in LAPDm?
q_23690.ground_truth: The two types of operation defined for layer 3 information transfer in LAPDm are unacknowledged operation and acknowledged (multiple frame) operation.

q_23691.question: What is the MMTel service and what does it encompass in terms of multimedia telephony?
q_23691.ground_truth: The MMTel service refers to multimedia conversational communications between two or more users, with speech as a typical usage. It also includes other combinations of media.

q_23692.question: In the field of 3GPP security architecture, what does a partial native EPS security context consist of?
q_23692.ground_truth: A partial native EPS security context consists of KASME with the associated key set identifier, UE security capabilities, and uplink and downlink NAS COUNT values, which are initially set to zero before the first NAS SMC procedure for this security context.

q_23693.question: What is the relationship between MUROS and SACCH performance in terms of AMR codecs?
q_23693.ground_truth: The performance of SACCH is not as good as some AMR codecs, but if MUROS is going to be used with HR and AHS, then SACCH is about the same performance and should be fine.

q_23694.question: What must a UE do when it receives DL MAC PDU's with DL grant indicating different priorities?
q_23694.ground_truth: The UE must transmit HARQ feedback using the correct PUCCH resource as per priority.

q_23695.question: Which term is used in the document to indicate that something is possible?
q_23695.ground_truth: The term "can" is used in the document to indicate that something is possible.

q_23696.question: What value range can be used for the "StartDestPortNumber" and "EndDestPortNumber" in the IPFlow?
q_23696.ground_truth: The values for "StartDestPortNumber" and "EndDestPortNumber" in the IPFlow should be within the range of 1-65535.

q_23697.question: How does an MBMS client determine the transmission completeness of a file when there are multiple FDT Instances with different TOI values for the same file?
q_23697.ground_truth: The FDT Instance with the highest FDT Instance ID defines the TOI for the most recent instance of the file and determines the end of transmission time for that file. A UE shall only determine transmission completeness for a file for the most recent instance of the file.

q_23698.question: What information is included in the "PS Handover Required" message sent from the BSS to the SGSN?
q_23698.ground_truth: The "PS Handover Required" message sent from the BSS to the SGSN includes the following information: old TLLI, cause, source cell identifier, target cell identifier, source BSS to target BSS transparent container (RN part), and active PFCs list.

q_23699.question: What is the role of the Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange Protocol in OpenID Authentication?
q_23699.ground_truth: The Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange Protocol is used to establish a shared secret (called association) between the RP and OP for securing subsequent messages and verifying those messages.

q_23700.question: What should the IWF do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with a risk of congestion and the MIME body includes an emergency indication set to "true"?
q_23700.ground_truth: The IWF can choose to accept the request.

q_23701.question: What information does the Node B use to establish a transport bearer for the DSCH when it receives a UP REQUEST message?
q_23701.ground_truth: The Node B uses the Transport Layer Address IE and Binding ID IE in the DSCH Information IE to establish a transport bearer for the DSCH.

q_23702.question: Which type of data is carried in the "RTLoadValue" field?
q_23702.ground_truth: The "RTLoadValue" field in the RANAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION sequence is of the type INTEGER and its range is (0..100).

q_23703.question: What is the difference between Alternative A and Alternative B for receiving IP services with MT IMS on a PLMN without requiring the UE to be connected to the PLMN over 3GPP access?
q_23703.ground_truth: In Alternative A, the UE switches to PLMN2 to receive IP service, while in Alternative B, the ePDG/N3IWF in PLMN2 uses the user plane connectivity with PLMN1 to establish IP service.

q_23704.question: What are the capabilities that the recipient's network may take into account for Immediate messaging?
q_23704.ground_truth: The recipient's network may take into account the recipient's terminal capabilities such as display capabilities, media content types and formats supported, media storage capacity, and encryption/security mechanisms supported.

q_23705.question: What should the transmitting PDCP entity do when the discard timer expires for a PDCP SDU?
q_23705.ground_truth: The transmitting PDCP entity should discard the corresponding PDCP SDU along with the corresponding PDCP Data PDU when the discard timer expires for a PDCP SDU.

q_23706.question: What is one of the issues addressed in the RAN study for LTE video streaming enhancements presented in TR 36.933?
q_23706.ground_truth: Backhaul long latency is addressed in the RAN study for LTE video streaming enhancements.

q_23707.question: What is the method for testing CR~1 in 5.3.14.4.1 to verify the correct execution of the READ commands in step 1) for EFs A.2/1 and A.2/2?
q_23707.ground_truth: The test should explicitly verify the correct execution of the READ commands for the specified EFs.

q_23708.question: What is the function of the Talk-Burst-Time AVP?
q_23708.ground_truth: The Talk-Burst-Time AVP holds the duration in seconds of the sent talk bursts in a SIP session.

q_23709.question: What is the Test Procedure for CatGetTerminalProfile in 6.8.1.2?
q_23709.ground_truth: The Test Procedure for CatGetTerminalProfile in 6.8.1.2 is to set the test to CatGetTerminalProfile and execute the two test cases mentioned.

q_23710.question: When performing traffic volume event evaluation or reporting, what should the UE do when an additional RB is established on a transport channel used for event triggering or reporting?
q_23710.ground_truth: The UE should consider all RBs which are mapped to the concerning transport channel for traffic volume event evaluation or reporting.

q_23711.question: What should the DRNS do if the Diversity Control Field IE is set to "Must" in the context of combining a new RL with existing RLs?
q_23711.ground_truth: The DRNS must combine the new RL with one of the other existing RLs, and can choose which RL(s) to combine it with.

q_23712.question: What is the time period measured by IVS in PULL mode to assess the complete round-trip time of the PSAP, called IVS-PULL-RTT?
q_23712.ground_truth: The time period measured by IVS in PULL mode to assess the complete round-trip time of the PSAP, called IVS-PULL-RTT, is from the time instance when IVS detects the first START message from PSAP until it detects the first HLACK message.

q_23713.question: What is the role of the PCRF when routing rules are received by the PDN GW during the IP-CAN session modification procedure with a network-initiated NBIFOM mode?
q_23713.ground_truth: The PCRF may accept or reject the routing rules and it also indicates the default access for the PDN Connection to the PDN GW.

q_23714.question: Which three SEI messages are recommended for one-to-one video telephony scenarios in the context of omnidirectional media?
q_23714.ground_truth: The recommended SEI messages for one-to-one video telephony scenarios are the equirectangular projection SEI message, the cubemap projection SEI message, and the sphere rotation SEI message.

q_23715.question: What should the SGSN do if the secondary PDP context activation procedure fails or if it returns an Activate Secondary PDP Context Reject message?
q_23715.ground_truth: The MS may attempt another activation with a different TFT, depending on the cause.

q_23716.question: Which function is responsible for the user authentication?
q_23716.ground_truth: The function f2, a MAC function, is responsible for the user authentication.

q_23717.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals Line Identification supplementary services document?
q_23717.ground_truth: The document specifies the procedures used at the radio interface for normal operation, registration, erasure, activation, deactivation, invocation, and interrogation of line identification supplementary services within the 3GPP system.

q_23718.question: What is the maximum number of RLs (Radio Links) in the "RL-InformationList-RL-SetupRqstFDD" sequence?

q_23719.question: What is the usage of the PNSI bit field in the Extended Common Flags II element?
q_23719.ground_truth: The PNSI (Pending Network Initiated PDN Connection Signalling Indication) bit field is used in the Extended Common Flags II element to indicate if there is pending network initiated PDN connection signalling for a PDN connection. The bit field is set to 1 when there is pending network initiated PDN connection signalling and indicates that the UE is available for end-to-end signalling.

q_23720.question: How is the OTA performance of a MIMO device described by taking statistical evaluations into account?
q_23720.ground_truth: The OTA performance of a MIMO device can be described by taking statistical evaluations into account by obtaining a relative throughput value as a function of subcarrier power for each test point and plotting the results in a histogram. This allows for the indication of the conditions required to achieve a given throughput value.

q_23721.question: What is the expectation regarding the communication between PLMNs?
q_23721.ground_truth: It is expected that there will be a need for authentication and confidentiality of the communication made between PLMNs.

q_23722.question: For which types of SRS, other than positioning, is comb-8 supported in Rel-17?
q_23722.ground_truth: Comb 8 is supported for SRS other than positioning in Rel-17.

q_23723.question: What is an example of a personalized audio mixing scenario in which participant D gives more importance to participant A's audio?
q_23723.ground_truth: Participant D may choose to mute all participants except for participant A during multiple active talkers, or use a personalized HRTF function to emphasize participant A's audio relative to participants B and C.

q_23724.question: What are the required video decoder parameters for an MBMS client for Television (TV) over 3GPP Services?
q_23724.ground_truth: An MBMS client supporting Television (TV) over 3GPP Services shall comply with the H.264/AVC 720p HD Operation Point Receiver requirements as specified in TS 26.116 clause 4.4.2.6.

q_23725.question: What entity can request N4 Session related input data from SMF or UPF for the purpose of NWDAF-based user plane optimization?

q_23726.question: What should the UE do with the Tsor-cm timer if the value of the Tsor-cm timer in the new SOR-CMCI is smaller than the current value of the running Tsor-cm timer for the associated PDU session or service?
q_23726.ground_truth: The UE shall replace the Tsor-cm timer value for the associated PDU session or service with the value in the new SOR-CMCI without stopping and restarting the timer.

q_23727.question: What standard is used to define the ISDN sub-address encoding type when the "isub" parameter is present in a particular context?

q_23728.question: How are identities managed in the NGN for enterprise users and business communication capabilities?
q_23728.ground_truth: The NGN uses a trust domain for identity management within enterprise network interconnection. When the business communication capability is outside the trust domain, the NGN asserts an identity associated with the enterprise and delivers the enterprise user's identity as provided by the NGCN. When the business communication capability is inside the trust domain, the NGN presents the enterprise user's identity as the asserted identity, and the NGN accepts the asserted identity received from the NGCN. Additionally, an alias identity of the enterprise user may be needed for interworking with the PSTN/ISDN or other purposes.

q_23729.question: What should a UE do when a PC5-RRC connection release for a specific destination is requested by upper layers or when a sidelink radio link failure is detected for a specific destination?
q_23729.ground_truth: The UE should release the PDCP entity, RLC entity, and the logical channel of the sidelink SRB for PC5-RRC messages of the specific destination, and consider the PC5-RRC connection as released for the destination.

q_23730.question: Are Traffic Management procedures supporting signalling routes required for point to point working?
q_23730.ground_truth: No, they are not applicable for point to point working.

q_23731.question: What is the total RSTD reporting delay for Test 2 in 9.4.4.2.5?
q_23731.ground_truth: The total RSTD reporting delay for Test 2 in 9.4.4.2.5 is 10240 ms.

q_23732.question: What does the term "IRP" stand for in the context of the document?

q_23733.question: What action does UE-2 take if it wishes to transfer the Collaborative Session Control from UE-1 to itself and none of the existing media flows are affected?
q_23733.ground_truth: UE-2 sends a Collaborative Session Control transfer request to the SCC AS to obtain Collaborative Session Control.

q_23734.question: What is the purpose of the new PWS message in the PLMN providing disaster roaming?
q_23734.ground_truth: The new PWS message is used to inform UEs about a list of PLMNs for which disaster roaming is offered by the PLMN with Disaster Condition. The PLMN with Disaster Condition must notify the CBE and the CBE must notify the PLMNs with disaster roaming in the area. The PWS SIB broadcast must continue for the duration the PLMN is offering disaster roaming.

q_23735.question: In the SRNC-RelocationInfo-r13-IEs sequence, what is the type of the "calculationTimeForCiphering" information element?
q_23735.ground_truth: The type of the "calculationTimeForCiphering" information element in the SRNC-RelocationInfo-r13-IEs sequence is CalculationTimeForCiphering.

q_23736.question: What is the interference level that should be met for meeting the specified performance for CTS-FP in the TI5 no FH propagation channel?
q_23736.ground_truth: The CTS-FP should meet a performance equal to that for the TU50 no FH for a useful signal 3dB greater than the relevant reference interference sensitivity in the TI5 no FH propagation channel.

q_23737.question: What action must the DRNS take after sending the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message and successfully establishing a new radio link in 1.28Mcps TDD mode for which the Delayed Activation IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message, and if the Delayed Activation IE indicates ``CFN''?
q_23737.ground_truth: The DRNS must start transmission on the new RL at the CFN indicated in the Activation CFN IE as specified in TS 25.427.

q_23738.question: What does the "Scheduled IP Throughput in DL" measure in 4G E-UTRAN?
q_23738.ground_truth: The "Scheduled IP Throughput in DL" measures the volume of a data burst during IP throughput measurement in downlink, excluding the data transmitted in the TTI when the buffer is emptied. It is maintained separately for each QCI and measures the IP throughput between the eNodeB (or RN) and UEs.

q_23739.question: What is the procedure when a UE moves from a source RAN that supports MBS to a target RAN that also supports MBS?
q_23739.ground_truth: If the MBS Session is established in Target RAN, it is reused. If the MBS Session is not established in Target RAN, it can be established during the handover procedure. The source RAN may temporarily forward MBS data to the T-RAN during handover.

q_23740.question: Which event in intra-frequency measurement reporting criteria represents the change of best cell in TDD?
q_23740.ground_truth: Event 1g in intra-frequency measurement reporting criteria represents the change of best cell in TDD.

q_23741.question: In what situations can the UE choose to not recheck the status of an MBSFN cluster during the time corresponding to the maximum value for Tbarred?
q_23741.ground_truth: When this MBSFN cluster is not considered as a candidate during the MBSFN cluster selection and re-selection procedures.

q_23742.question: What is the measurement provided by CC.SuccTermiCalls?
q_23742.ground_truth: The number of successful calls for MSC-S terminating traffic.

q_23743.question: What is the basic structure of the DL-CCCH-Message?
q_23743.ground_truth: The DL-CCCH-Message is a Sequence type containing an IntegrityCheckInfo object and a DL-CCCH-MessageType.

q_23744.question: What system can the Edge Enabler Server interact with to retrieve the location of the user equipment (UE) in the 3GPP network?
q_23744.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server can interact with 3GPP systems such as 5GS, EPS, through APIs exposed by SCEF/NEF, LCS, or NWDAF as specified in 3GPP TS 23.502.

q_23745.question: What is the HTTP status code that SMSF returns if MT SMS delivery fails due to SMSF internal errors?
q_23745.ground_truth: The HTTP status code that SMSF returns if MT SMS delivery fails due to SMSF internal errors is "500 Internal Server Error".

q_23746.question: What should the UE do if the IE "Downlink information per radio link list on secondary UL frequency" is present in the IE "Uplink Secondary Cell Info FDD" in the received message?
q_23746.ground_truth: The UE should keep the active set as it was before the ACTIVE SET UPDATE message was received and transmit an ACTIVE SET UPDATE FAILURE message on the DCCH using AM RLC.

q_23747.question: What is the "Service Identifier" parameter used for in Solution #1e for correlating 5GS charging related messages with edge application?
q_23747.ground_truth: The "Service Identifier" parameter is used in Solution #1e for correlating 5GS charging related messages with edge application to identify the instance of the edge application and not only the identity of the service (e.g., edge computing service). This solution requires that the "Service Identifier" parameter is able to identify the instance of the edge application.

q_23748.question: What is the Cellular Text Telephone Modem (CTM) and what type of technology is it?
q_23748.ground_truth: The Cellular Text Telephone Modem (CTM) is a technology that is used for reliable transmission of text telephone text via the speech channel of cellular or PSTN networks. It is a general technology, independent of text telephone types.

q_23749.question: What should a mobile station do if the BC-IE received from the network contains the parameters 'fixed network user rate', 'other modem type', and 'user initiated modification' in the circuit switched set-up?
q_23749.ground_truth: The MS has two options: a) discard these parameters in the call confirmed message, or b) include the possibly modified values for the 'fixed network user rate' and 'other modem type' in the BC-IE of the call confirmed message, and include additional parameters for non-transparent services.

q_23750.question: Which information is encapsulated in the an-APDU MAP parameter of the Prepare-Handover MAP request?
q_23750.ground_truth: The RELOCATION REQUEST message and, if tracing activity has been invoked, the trace related messages are encapsulated in the an-APDU MAP parameter of the Prepare-Handover MAP request.

q_23751.question: What action does the UE take when it detects that the ngKSI received in the authentication request message is already in use?
q_23751.ground_truth: The UE rejects the core network and returns an authentication failure message with a 5GMM cause value indicating the reason for the failure (in this case, 5GMM cause #71 "ngKSI already in use").

q_23752.question: What is the purpose of the Broadcast Channel (BCH) in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_23752.ground_truth: The Broadcast Channel (BCH) is a downlink transport channel used to broadcast system- and cell-specific information to all UEs within a cell.

q_23753.question: What message is used to perform handover from GERAN A/Gb mode/GAN mode to UTRAN and is sent within the PS Handover Command message for PS handover from GERAN A/Gb mode or within the GA-PSR Handover Command message for PS handover from GAN mode?
q_23753.ground_truth: The Handover to UTRAN Command message

q_23754.question: What happens after the MS receives the PS Handover Command message?
q_23754.ground_truth: The MS associates its RAB IDs to the respective PFIs based on the NSAPI, suspends uplink transmission of user plane data, and accesses the cell using access bursts.

q_23755.question: What happens if the location updating procedure is not successful in the case of GLR introduction during second and subsequent locations?
q_23755.ground_truth: There will still be interaction between the GLR and the HLR for the regional restriction service.

q_23756.question: What information does the L1 header of SACCH from UE to network carry?
q_23756.ground_truth: The L1 header of SACCH from UE to network carries information of timing advance and UE uplink transmission power level.

q_23757.question: How many CLUE data channels can be established per SCTP association in telepresence support?
q_23757.ground_truth: Only one CLUE data channel can be established per SCTP association in telepresence support.

q_23758.question: What are the main objectives of the centralized HNB power control approach?
q_23758.ground_truth: The main objectives are to optimize system performance, communicate with HNBs at a slower or faster time-scale, and not rely on all HNBs being able to "hear" the network for the network command.

q_23759.question: What is the relationship between the correlations of DS and AS, SF and AS, and SF and DS, in the intra-site correlation matrix?
q_23759.ground_truth: The correlation between DS & AS is +0.5, between SF & AS is -0.6, and between SF & DS is -0.6.

q_23760.question: What should the RA2 transmit over the A-interface for a user data rate of 64 kbit/s?
q_23760.ground_truth: The 64 kbit/s stream over the A-interface is transmitted as it is without any modification by the RA2.

q_23761.question: What is the purpose of the P-Access-Network-Info header field in the INVITE request due to STN-SR?
q_23761.ground_truth: The P-Access-Network-Info header field identifies the location of the UE in the 3G access network, the time-zone and daylight saving on that location.

q_23762.question: What is the suggested enhancement for the switching algorithm in static and CASE1 propagation channels?
q_23762.ground_truth: The suggested enhancement is to look at the Block Error Rate (BLER) estimation or Symbol Error Rate (SER) estimation. If the UE finds that the BLER estimation is below its BLER target (with some margin), then it will decide to switch off the RxDiv. This enhancement helps in test cases in which the BS does not perform power control.

q_23763.question: What is the test purpose of the intermodulation characteristics in the 7,68 Mcps TDD option?
q_23763.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the ability of the BS receiver to inhibit the generation of intermodulation products in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of two high-level interfering signals at frequencies with a specific relationship to the frequency of the wanted signal.

q_23764.question: What is the purpose of the "DN priorities for appDomains" information and how is it used in the 5G core network?
q_23764.ground_truth: The "DN priorities for appDomains" information is used to provide the 5GC with information about the relative precedence of data to use to reach different domains based on the UE location and DNN/S-NSSAI negotiated with the operator. This information is used to control the DNS resolver used by the UE, enforce URSP rules based on the relative precedence of DNN/S-NSSAI, and set preferences for internet applications reachable via both a specific DNN and S-NSSAI.

q_23765.question: What is the function of mapping between DDI (Data Description Indicator) fields and MAC-d flows in MAC-es entity?
q_23765.ground_truth: The mapping between the DDI (Data Description Indicator) fields and the MAC-d flows and MAC-d PDU size is provided to the Node B by the SRNC. This mapping allows MAC-e PDU demultiplexing to form MAC-es PDUs aimed for one or more MAC-d flows.

q_23766.question: What is the group notification mechanism used for when there is no data to be sent for a multicast session in RRC IDLE/INACTIVE state?
q_23766.ground_truth: The group notification mechanism is used to notify the UEs in RRC IDLE/INACTIVE state when a multicast session has been activated by the CN or the gNB has multicast session data to deliver. Upon reception of the group notification, the UEs reconnect to the network.

q_23767.question: What should the UE do when it receives a TRANSPORT FORMAT COMBINATION CONTROL message on AM RLC or UM RLC?
q_23767.ground_truth: The UE shall act upon all received information elements as specified in 8.6, perform the actions for the transport format combination subset specified in the IE "DPCH/PUSCH TFCS in uplink," and forward the content of the "UL AMR rate" IE to upper layers if it is included in the message.

q_23768.question: What is the measurement that gives the mean time it takes for the SGSN to establish a PDP context during each collection interval?
q_23768.ground_truth: SM. SuccActPdpContextAPNTimeMOMean.Conv, SM. SuccActPdpContextAPNTimeMOMean.Strm, SM. SuccActPdpContextAPNTimeMOMean.Intact, SM. SuccActPdpContextAPNTimeMOMean.Bgrd.

q_23769.question: What type of information element is the DTM Information Details, and what is its minimum length?
q_23769.ground_truth: The DTM Information Details is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 5 octets.

q_23770.question: What is the purpose of ADC Rule authorization in the context of TDF session?
q_23770.ground_truth: It determines which predefined and/or dynamic ADC rules to activate for a TDF session and involves the selection of parameters for dynamic ADC rules.

q_23771.question: What is the effect of the PDN GW initiated resource releasing procedure on the connections and PDN address when it is performed due to a handover?
q_23771.ground_truth: When the PDN GW initiated resource releasing procedure is performed due to a handover, the connections associated with the PDN address are released, but the PDN address is kept in the PDN GW.

q_23772.question: Which information element specifies the addressed application within the target BSS node?
q_23772.ground_truth: The RIM Application Identity information element

q_23773.question: What stores the UE Radio Access Capability Information received from the eNodeB without any truncation and has a maximum S1-AP SCTP packet size of 65535 bytes?

q_23774.question: What does the resourceOperationalState field represent in the HS-DSCH-Resources-Information-AuditRsp field?
q_23774.ground_truth: The resourceOperationalState field indicates whether a resource is currently in use or available for allocation.

q_23775.question: When should the mobile equipment start charging calculations in the AoC supplementary services?
q_23775.ground_truth: The mobile equipment should start charging calculations as soon as possible after receiving the charging information in the AoC supplementary services.

q_23776.question: What is the objective of the Thresholds node inside the ThresholdConditions node?
q_23776.ground_truth: The Thresholds node acts as a placeholder for all 3GPP and WLAN access thresholds to be considered while evaluating the RANValidityCondition node.

q_23777.question: What should the UE include in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message during inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode?
q_23777.ground_truth: The UE shall include the eKSI indicating the 5G NAS security context value in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

q_23778.question: What was agreed for Sub-Topic 3-3 during the GTW session on the 5th of November?
q_23778.ground_truth: The agreed condition for Sub-Topic 3-3 during the GTW session on the 5th of November is that PC1.5 should be allowed extra 3dB only because of power class declaration.

q_23779.question: What is the CSE initiated call release procedure in CAMEL?
q_23779.ground_truth: The CSE initiated call release procedure in CAMEL enables the CSE to initiate a call release at any moment of the call. It can be used if the originating VPLMN has reported an initial service event to the CSE and is waiting for instructions, or if the CSE is waiting for the report of a subsequent service event.

q_23780.question: What is the MIME type of the alternative content in the third example User Service Description?
q_23780.ground_truth: The MIME type of the alternative content in the third example User Service Description is "application/dash+xml;profiles=urn:3GPP:PSS:profile:DASH10".

q_23781.question: What is the role of the Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals in the 3GPP?
q_23781.ground_truth: The Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals is responsible for defining the technical specifications for the core network and terminals within the 3GPP. This includes the development of the IP Multimedia (IM) Core Network (CN) subsystem and the management of the 3GPP's Device Management protocol.

q_23782.question: What should the DRNS do to the Power Balancing Adjustment Type of the UE Context if the value of the Power Adjustment Type IE is set to "Individual"?
q_23782.ground_truth: The DRNS should set the Power Balancing Adjustment Type of the UE Context to "Individual" if the value of the Power Adjustment Type IE is set to "Individual".

q_23783.question: When can the IP-SM-GW remove unsupported media from an Instant Message when interworking to Short Message?
q_23783.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW may remove the unsupported content from the Instant Message if it contains other media than text content.

q_23784.question: What does GMSK stand for in the document?
q_23784.ground_truth: GMSK stands for Gaussian Minimum Shift Keying, a type of modulation method used in the GSM standards.

q_23785.question: What is the meaning of the term "shall" in a 3GPP Technical Specification document?
q_23785.ground_truth: The term "shall" in a 3GPP Technical Specification document indicates a mandatory requirement to do something. It is used in the context of normative provisions.

q_23786.question: What is the recommended 'maxptime' value in TS 24.229 for defining the 'maxprate' parameter as an optional SDP parameter?
q_23786.ground_truth: The recommended 'maxptime' value in TS 24.229 is 240 ms.

q_23787.question: What is the purpose of the low pitch lag emphasis function in the timated pitch-lag calculation?
q_23787.ground_truth: The low pitch lag emphasis function reduces the likelihood of selecting a multiple of the correct delay by emphasizing lower pitch lag values in the calculation.

q_23788.question: Which network options are affected by Key Issue #8, which involves control of UP IP usage by the HPLMN in EPC?

q_23789.question: What should the UE do when it receives N310 consecutive "out-of-sync" indications for the SpCell from lower layers due to radio link failure?
q_23789.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell, and upon timer expiry, initiate the NR SCG failure information procedure to report SCGFailureInformationNR with failure type set to 't310-Expiry'.

q_23790.question: What is the mechanism used in in-game communications to provide each player with a 3D audio scene that matches their 3D visual scene?
q_23790.ground_truth: Each player obtains the audio signals of its nearest players and a local audio rendering client renders those signals at the relative positions provided by the game engine.

q_23791.question: What type of modulation is used in EGPRS2-B, as defined in 3GPP TS 45.004 clause 5?

q_23792.question: What message does the IWF2 receive from the HSS in the first step of the "Purge" procedure in a one IWF scenario?
q_23792.ground_truth: The IWF receives a PUR message from the MME, SGSN, or combined MME/SGSN in the first step of the "Purge" procedure in a one IWF scenario.

q_23793.question: What is the name of the SEQUENCE in the RNSAP-PROTOCOL-IES with ID id-RL-Set-InformationItem-DM-Rsp and the presence mandatory in the RNSAP-PROTOCOL-IES?

q_23794.question: What is the role of the SECAM Accreditation Body in the evaluation of virtualised network products?
q_23794.ground_truth: The SECAM Accreditation Body is responsible for accrediting the actors performing the evaluation tasks and maintaining fairness in the virtualised network product evaluation process.

q_23795.question: What is the function of the Discovery Query Filter in Model B restricted discovery?
q_23795.ground_truth: The Discovery Query Filter is used to monitor a query in Model B restricted discovery.

q_23796.question: What is SCEF-Reference-ID used for in Architecture Enhancements for Service Exposure (AESE)?
q_23796.ground_truth: SCEF-Reference-ID is used to uniquely identify an event created by an SCEF in AESE.

q_23797.question: What is one of the benefits of using both broader and narrower bandwidth pulse shaping for different VAMOS users as per the suggested adaptation scheme?
q_23797.ground_truth: The benefit of using both broader and narrower bandwidth pulse shaping for different VAMOS users is that each user can improve their performance based on their specific RF power and C/I needs.

q_23798.question: What are the benefits of the new QoS limitations solution?
q_23798.ground_truth: The benefits include enabling high-latency satellite backhaul connections to be used in combination with the standardized 5GS UPF selection mechanism, providing a mixture of UPFs with varying QoS limitations, and supporting various deployment scenarios involving terrestrial or satellite backhauls.

q_23799.question: What is the role of the MME in the EPS?
q_23799.ground_truth: The MME is the control plane entity within EPS that supports various functions such as mobility management, NAS signalling and security, inter-CN node signalling, tracking area list management, PDN GW and Serving GW selection, roaming, authentication, bearer management functions, and lawful interception of signalling traffic.

q_23800.question: What is used for addressing at the LLC layer?

q_23801.question: What layer does the Nq-AP protocol use for encoding messages in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_23801.ground_truth: The Nq-AP protocol uses a Type, Length and Value (TLV) encoding of messages over an SCTP transport.

q_23802.question: What should the SME (Short Message Entity) do if it does not receive a response or an RP-ERROR with an appropriate cause value after an SMS-SUBMIT?
q_23802.ground_truth: The SME should automatically repeat the SMS-SUBMIT using the same TP-MR value and set the TP-RD bit to 1. The number of automatic attempts is in the range of 1 to 3.

q_23803.question: Where can PSS and MBMS user profile and UE capabilities information be stored?
q_23803.ground_truth: The information can be stored in Application Server functions, a stand-alone server associated with one or more Application Server functions, or in the HSS as transparent data associated to these Application Server functions.

q_23804.question: What does the term "Logical Model" mean in the context of 3GPP network?
q_23804.ground_truth: It is an abstract view of a network or network element by means of information objects representing network element, aggregations of network elements, the topological relationship between the elements, endpoints of connections (termination points), and transport entities (such as connections) that transport information between two or more termination points.

q_23805.question: What message is sent by the MS to indicate the completion of the GERAN to EGAN handover procedure?

q_23806.question: What is the maximum value of Altitude in the AltitudeAndDirection element?
q_23806.ground_truth: The maximum value of Altitude in the AltitudeAndDirection element is 32767.

q_23807.question: In the 3GPP TS 25.214 v7.1.0 specification, what are P-CCPCH 1 and P-CCPCH 2 mapped onto?
q_23807.ground_truth: P-CCPCH 1 and P-CCPCH 2 are mapped onto timeslot#0 using the channelisation codes with a spreading factor of 16.

q_23808.question: What is the value of the constant ABS(a)?

q_23809.question: What is the power consumption comparison between EVS modes and AMR/AMR-WB?
q_23809.ground_truth: The EVS modes offer power consumption gains over AMR/AMR-WB due to reduced ON time.

q_23810.question: How is the registration procedure initiated by an Inbound Disaster Roamer performed?
q_23810.ground_truth: The registration procedure is typically initiated by the Inbound Disaster Roamer sending a registration request to the Disaster Roaming PLMN, which then authenticates the UE and registers it for service.

q_23811.question: Which HSS related event is generated when the HSS detects that the target has roamed?
q_23811.ground_truth: The Serving Evolved Packet System for IoT UE event is generated when the HSS detects that the target has roamed.

q_23812.question: What should the UE do when the SUPI from the USIM does not match the SUPI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME as specified in CR~3?
q_23812.ground_truth: The UE must delete the MPS indicator in this case.

q_23813.question: What operation is included in a FACILITY message when the Explicit Call Transfer supplementary service is signaled towards the network?
q_23813.ground_truth: The ExplicitCT operation is included in a FACILITY message when the Explicit Call Transfer supplementary service is signaled towards the network.

q_23814.question: Which protocol extension specified in the InitialUE-MessageExtensions is mandatory?
q_23814.ground_truth: There is no mandatory protocol extension in the InitialUE-MessageExtensions.

q_23815.question: What is the sequence b'L(n) described as in the implementation?
q_23815.ground_truth: The sequence b'L(n) is the zero state response of H(z) to the adaptive codebook output for lag L.

q_23816.question: What are the types of information that can be contained in the E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeReleased-ModReqdList and E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeModified-ModReqdList sequences, which contain information about E-RABs that are to be released or modified?
q_23816.ground_truth: Both E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeReleased-ModReqdList and E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeModified-ModReqdList are sequences of size (1..maxnoofBearers) containing a ProtocolIE-SingleContainer with an E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeReleased-ModReqdItem or E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeModified-ModReqdItem as the ProtocolIE-SingleContainer type.

q_23817.question: What is the result of the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1?
q_23817.ground_truth: The result of the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1 is Command performed successfully.

q_23818.question: Which IP network protocol stack is used in EPS?
q_23818.ground_truth: EPS (Evolved Packet System) uses Evolved Packet Core (EPC) and Long Term Evolution (LTE) network protocol stacks.

q_23819.question: What is the system capacity measured in reports per 200 kHz per hour?

q_23820.question: What are the three categories of interfaces related to application integration?
q_23820.ground_truth: The three categories of interfaces related to application integration are high-level generic interfaces, high-level (technology-independent) interfaces, and detailed (product-specific) interfaces.

q_23821.question: What is the main function of the Fax Adaptation functions in the described Teleservice?
q_23821.ground_truth: The main function of the Fax Adaptation functions is to contain all the protocol modules specific for this Teleservice.

q_23822.question: What is the difference between the various types of V2X services defined in the 3GPP specifications?
q_23822.ground_truth: The four types of V2X services (V2V, V2I, V2N, and V2P) differ in terms of the parties involved in the communication and the specific V2X applications they use.

q_23823.question: What is the definition of End-to-End Latency as per the document?
q_23823.ground_truth: End-to-End Latency is the time that takes to transfer a given piece of information from a source to a destination, measured at the communication interface, from the moment it is transmitted by the source to the moment it is successfully received at the destination.

q_23824.question: What is one method for invoking an MPS for DTS as specified in the 3GPP system?
q_23824.ground_truth: A method for MPS for DTS invocation may include using a web browser to enter a predetermined address (e.g., URL) or using a specialized MPS application on the UE.

q_23825.question: What is one of the methods to distribute objects such as music and effects, and different languages in a cost and spectrum-efficient manner?
q_23825.ground_truth: Objects can be distributed separately and combined at the receiver.

q_23826.question: What is one of the high-level requirements for preventing unsolicited communication in IMS?
q_23826.ground_truth: IMS should provide means for a user to inform the network of an unsolicited communication.

q_23827.question: What is transmitted in NR-PBCH for minimum system information delivery?
q_23827.ground_truth: At least part of the SFN (system frame number), and CRC are transmitted in NR-PBCH.

q_23828.question: What is the function of the PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) in 3GPP systems?
q_23828.ground_truth: The PCRF acts as a policy decision point for policy and charging control of service data flows/applications and IP bearer resources. It selects and provides the applicable policy and charging control decision to the PCEF and, if applicable, application detection and control decision to the TDF or PCEF with application detection and control feature.

q_23829.question: When should the PCRF include the Required-Access-Info AVP within the QoS-Rule-Definition AVP or QoS-Rule-Remove AVP?
q_23829.ground_truth: The PCRF should include the Required-Access-Info AVP within the QoS-Rule-Definition AVP if it is installing or modifying a QoS rule, and within the QoS-Rule-Remove AVP if it is removing QoS rules based on the AF requests.

q_23830.question: What type of signalling transport service does PCAP require for connectionless data transfer?
q_23830.ground_truth: PCAP requires a connectionless data transfer service that notifies PCAP in case a message does not reach the intended peer PCAP entity.

q_23831.question: What are the three digits in the version number of the 3GPP Technical Specification and what do they represent?
q_23831.ground_truth: The three digits in the version number of the 3GPP Technical Specification represent the following: (i) the first digit shows the status of the document in the TSG, (ii) the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc., and (iii) the third digit is incremented when editorial-only changes have been incorporated in the document.

q_23832.question: What 3GPP standard defines the IOPS MC service ID for the MCPTT service in the IOPS mode of operation?
q_23832.ground_truth: The IOPS MC service ID for the MCPTT service in the IOPS mode of operation is defined in 3GPP TS 23.379.

q_23833.question: What is the purpose of the KASUMI algorithm in the 3GPP security architecture?
q_23833.ground_truth: The KASUMI algorithm is the building block for the confidentiality and integrity algorithms (f8 and f9) in the 3GPP security architecture.

q_23834.question: What should the MS prepare when sending a GA-CSR CLASSMARK CHANGE message and a GA-CSR UTRAN CLASSMARK CHANGE message?
