q_24086.ground_truth: The PCRF checks if policy set-up information received from the AF is consistent with operator policies, authorizes QoS resources for the AF session and decides if new QoS authorization is needed for mid-call media or codec changes.

q_24087.question: Which data should be collected and provided for jitter assurance by the MDAS producer?
q_24087.ground_truth: The MDAS producer should collect various data such as S-NSSAI, performance measurements, NRM, planning data, delay related performance measurements, jitter related measurements, QoE data, and network service experience analysis results for generating the jitter analysis report.

q_24088.question: What is the feature being introduced in Rel-17 for UE RF FR1 regarding uplink performance enhancement with 2Tx transmission on one uplink carrier for inter-band UL CA, inter-band EN-DC, and SUL?
q_24088.ground_truth: The feature being introduced in Rel-17 for UE RF FR1 regarding uplink performance enhancement with 2Tx transmission on one uplink carrier for inter-band UL CA, inter-band EN-DC, and SUL is the ability for the user equipment (UE) to indicate its capability for uplinkTxSwithingPeriod and the ability for the UE to indicate whether UL-MIMO coherence is supported during dynamic Tx switching.

q_24089.question: What is the performance of Turbo coding schemes with the same coding rate as the current EGPRS coding schemes?
q_24089.ground_truth: The performance of Turbo coding schemes with the same coding rate as the current EGPRS coding schemes is much improved as compared with EGPRS.

q_24090.question: What should the BBERF do if it determines that a PCRF has restarted and a Gateway Control Session modification request needs to be sent towards the PCRF?
q_24090.ground_truth: The BBERF should not send the Gateway Control Session modification request towards the PCRF. Instead, it may tear down the associated PDN connection based on operator policy, by initiating PDN connection deactivation procedure. However, emergency and eMPS sessions should not be torn down.

q_24091.question: How does the "doScript" command function in the DIMS namespace?
q_24091.ground_truth: The "doScript" command is used to execute a script for immediate execution, including the ability to update the DOM. It has a single attribute, the type of the script. The script is in the body of the element. Processing this command involves executing the script in the context of the DIMS stream in which it occurs. It can be used to update the DOM or execute other scripts in the DIMS stream.

q_24092.question: What message does the GANC send to the RNC upon acknowledging the relocation request message?
q_24092.ground_truth: The GANC sends the Relocation Command message to the RNC, completing the relocation preparation.

q_24093.question: Which message type is sent from the mobile station to the network to inform about radio access capabilities of the mobile station in Iu mode?

q_24094.question: What should the network do when it detects a lower layer failure during a channel assignment procedure?
q_24094.ground_truth: The network should set the uplink free and provide an UPLINK FREE message on the main signalling channel when appropriate.

q_24095.question: What is one advantage of using Supplementary Services for SPIT/UC prevention?
q_24095.ground_truth: Supplementary Services can be used at once and provide effective means for SPIT/UC protection. They also work in all types of networks, enabling a unified approach to combat SPIT/UC.

q_24096.question: What is the unique identifier used by the EATF to correlate two access legs in an IMS emergency session?

q_24097.question: What should the UE do if the received rlf-TimersAndConstants is set to release?
q_24097.ground_truth: The UE should use values for timers T301, T310, T311 and constants N310, N311, as included in ue-TimersAndConstants received in SIB1.

q_24098.question: What is the capacity performance for FR2, Indoor Hotspot DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, SU-MIMO, 10ms PDB, 120 FPS, 45Mbps, Option 1 UE Antenna parameters: (M, N, P) = (1, 4, 2), 3 panels (left, right, top)?
q_24098.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is 5.77 UEs per cell in a range of 5.5~6.03 UEs per cell.

q_24099.question: What is the purpose of the "Definitions, symbols and abbreviations" section in the present document?
q_24099.ground_truth: The purpose of the "Definitions, symbols and abbreviations" section in the present document is to provide definitions, symbols, and abbreviations that are used in the document. This section is intended to ensure a common understanding of the terms and abbreviations used in the document.

q_24100.question: What should the PCRF do when it receives service information from the AF and the requested service is not 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Service?
q_24100.ground_truth: The PCRF shall reject the service request if the requested service is not 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Service.

q_24101.question: How does the HSS-based mechanism for P-CSCF restoration over WLAN work for trusted and untrusted WLAN accesses?
q_24101.ground_truth: The HSS-based P-CSCF restoration mechanism for WLAN extends to trusted and untrusted WLAN accesses and is based on the same principles to disconnect the UE, which then re-establishes the connection via an available P-CSCF.

q_24102.question: What is the role of the T1 parameter in the Node Synchronisation procedure?
q_24102.ground_truth: The T1 parameter is the RNC specific frame number indicating the time when the RNC sends the DL NODE SYNCHRONISATION control frame through the SAP to the transport layer.

q_24103.question: What are the actions taken by the UE when it receives a specific message in state 5GMM-DEREGISTRERED?
q_24103.ground_truth: When the UE receives a REGISTRATION REQUEST message in state 5GMM-DEREGISTRERED, it initiates the registration procedure for initial registration. This can occur in various scenarios, such as initial registration for 5GS services, initial registration for emergency services, or moving from GERAN/UTRAN coverage to NG-RAN coverage.

q_24104.question: What is the threshold value used to determine if the pitch stability is true?
q_24104.ground_truth: The pitch stability is true if the value of pc is less than 12.

q_24105.question: Which key performance requirement is defined as the mean time before the communication service becomes unavailable?
q_24105.ground_truth: Communication service reliability is defined as the mean time between failures, indicating how long the communication service is available before it becomes unavailable.

q_24106.question: What is a PDCP entity associated with in the 3GPP 5G system?
q_24106.ground_truth: A PDCP entity is associated with either the control plane or the user plane, depending on which radio bearer it is carrying data for.

q_24107.question: When would SMS-DELIVER indications be routed to the TE using unsolicited result code +CMTI: <mem>,<index>?
q_24107.ground_truth: SMS-DELIVER indications are routed to the TE using unsolicited result code +CMTI: <mem>,<index> when SMS-DELIVERs are stored into ME/TA memory.

q_24108.question: What is the role of the HLR in the dispatcher call establishment process?
q_24108.ground_truth: The HLR in this process is responsible for supplying an MSRN related to the respective group call reference in the MSC/VLR or interrogating the appropriate MSC/VLR to obtain an MSRN.

q_24109.question: What does the UE do when a message on SRB 3 is received and fails the integrity protection check?
q_24109.ground_truth: When a message on SRB 3 is received and fails the integrity protection check, the UE is required to transmit the SCGFailureInformationNR message with the failure type as srb3-IntegrityFailure.

q_24110.question: How can an ME tell if a Response Packet from the UICC should treat the UDHI bit as set?
q_24110.ground_truth: An ME should treat the UDHI bit as set for a Response Packet originating from the UICC because the UICC cannot indicate to a ME that it should set the UDHI bit.

q_24111.question: What are the two deciphering keys used in the deciphering key set for overcoming the unsynchronized nature of the periodic location updates?
q_24111.ground_truth: The Current Deciphering Key and the Next Deciphering Key

q_24112.question: How many CDPs can be present for a single service usage?
q_24112.ground_truth: There can be one or more CDPs per service usage.

q_24113.question: What action should the Node B take when the internal resource capabilities of a Local Cell are affected?
q_24113.ground_truth: When the internal resource capabilities of a Local Cell are affected, the Node B should report the new capacity in the DL Or Global Capacity Credit IE if the internal resources are modeled as shared resources between Uplink and Downlink. If the internal resources are modeled independently in the Uplink and Downlink direction, the Node B should include the DL Or Global Capacity Credit IE and the UL Capacity Credit IE in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message.

q_24114.question: What should an IWU do if it receives a SDP offer from the external SIP-I network without the RTP Telephony Event but only the default PCM speech codec is offered to the succeeding node?
q_24114.ground_truth: The IWU may include the RTP Telephony Event in the offer to the succeeding SIP-I CS CN node if it receives a SDP offer from the external SIP-I network without the RTP Telephony Event but only the default PCM speech codec is offered to the succeeding node.

q_24115.question: In the PROTECTED BEARERS SETUP message, when should a UE use the same START value to initialise the COUNT-C and COUNT-I variables for all the signalling radio bearers?
q_24115.ground_truth: The UE should use the same START value to initialise the COUNT-C and COUNT-I variables for all the signalling radio bearers if the IE "Signalling RB information to setup list" is received in a PROTECTED BEARERS SETUP message.

q_24116.question: What is the function of NAT (Network Address Translation) as defined in the document?
q_24116.ground_truth: NAT is a function that provides various types of network address and port translations, including NAT44, NAPT44, NAT64, and NAPT64.

q_24117.question: What is the role of the GAN RR entity in the GAN mode of operation?
q_24117.ground_truth: The GAN RR entity in the GAN mode of operation serves the upper layers over the Up interface. It operates similarly to the GSM RR entity but serves the upper layers over the Up interface in GAN mode as opposed to the Um interface in 3GPP mode.

q_24118.question: What does the "Number of Broadcasts Completed List" indicate in a CBS message?
q_24118.ground_truth: The "Number of Broadcasts Completed List" indicates the number of times a CBS message has been broadcasted in each cell specified in the Cell List IE.

q_24119.question: What is the purpose of the "TERMINAL RESPONSE: SEND SS 1.1.1A" and "TERMINAL RESPONSE: SEND SS 1.1.1B"?
q_24119.ground_truth: These terminal responses indicate that the command performed successfully, with the operation code and SS parameters provided in the additional information.

q_24120.question: What is the definition of the TP-User-Data-Length field in SM-TL?
q_24120.ground_truth: The TP-User-Data-Length field is a part of the TP-User-Data field and is used to indicate the total length of the TP-User-Data field, including the header if present.

q_24121.question: What is the purpose of the "disaster roaming PLMN list" in Solution #7?
q_24121.ground_truth: The "disaster roaming PLMN list" is a list of PLMN IDs of PLMNs for which Disaster Condition applies in a specific area, used by PLMN A's NG-RAN nodes serving the area.

q_24122.question: What is one of the supported alternatives for UE reporting of TRxP Tx beams in the context of beam management procedures?
q_24122.ground_truth: Alt 1: UE reports information about TRxP Tx Beam(s) that can be received using selected UE Rx beam set(s) where a Rx beam set refers to a set of UE Rx beams that are used for receiving a DL signal. The UE can report TRxP Tx Beam(s) and an identifier of the associated UE Rx beam set per reported TX beam(s).

q_24123.question: Which server is responsible for adding the Coordination of Video Orientation (CVO) payload onto the last RTP packet in each group of packets for PSS RTP-streaming context?

q_24124.question: What are the candidate pitch lags selected for each half-frame?
q_24124.ground_truth: The candidate pitch lags are selected by searching the maximum of the weighted normalized correlations in each of the four sections across both pitch delay ranges. In case of VBR operation, the normalized correlations are also searched, and the secondary pitch lag candidate is selected instead of the firstly selected one if the normalized correlation of the candidate lag is very high and can be considered a halved value of the corresponding candidate identified in the weighted normalized correlation search.

q_24125.question: What is the role of the originating network in the eCNAM service?
q_24125.ground_truth: The eCNAM operations rely on information received from the originating network, such as the originating user's E.164 telephone number to retrieve eCNAM data from trusted data sources.

q_24126.question: What is the maximum throughput class for the default bearer in the OPEN CHANNEL command?
q_24126.ground_truth: The maximum throughput class for the default bearer in the OPEN CHANNEL command is 31.

q_24127.question: What is the effect of the frequency response of the chamber on the accuracy of the Occupied BW measurement?
q_24127.ground_truth: A 40 MHz bandwidth is unlikely to introduce any significant frequency ripple in a RF chamber, so this effect can be ignored.

q_24128.question: What should the ICS UE do before accepting a request for an I1 session?
q_24128.ground_truth: The ICS UE should ensure that there is only one existing CS bearer leg between the ICS UE and the MSC/MGCF. Otherwise, it should reject the request for the I1 session establishment.

q_24129.question: What is required to be included in the Device-Action-Request command for Device Trigger Replace (4) by the SCS?
q_24129.ground_truth: The SCS must include the Old-Reference-Number AVP containing the assigned reference number for the trigger to be replaced.

q_24130.question: What is the MB-SMF responsible for in establishing a session leg with the UPF using the N9 DL Tunnel Info?
q_24130.ground_truth: The MB-SMF interacts with the UPF to setup FAR for forwarding the IP multicast data received in the N9 DL Tunnel via the PDU Session to the UE.

q_24131.question: What is the result when an initiator extends assured voice communication to a new user in FRMCS?
q_24131.ground_truth: The new user is supervised by the assured voice communication.

q_24132.question: What event is generated when the PTC Intercept target attempts to change the access control lists?

q_24133.question: How is transport block level integrity protection controlled in this solution?
q_24133.ground_truth: When the system wants to use UP-IP at the Transport Block level, it starts a PDCP entity that uses one integrity algorithm identifier from a set of new integrity algorithm identifiers. The ciphering algorithm attribute can use any of the existing ciphering algorithm identifiers.

q_24134.question: What is the postcondition of the IM-SSF after receiving the "DisconnectForwardConnection" operation in the "Waiting for End of User Interaction" state?
q_24134.ground_truth: The IM-SSF releases the connection to the MRFC, resets TSSF, and goes to the "Waiting for Instructions" state.

q_24135.question: What is the effect of enabling EMSR on the resource allocation and determination of transmission priority of upper layer PDUs?
q_24135.ground_truth: If EMSR is enabled for a given RLC entity, uplink resource reallocation/downlink resource reassignment is not performed whenever RLC data block transmission priority decisions result in switching between PFCs assigned to the same RLC entity. The determination of the relative transmission priority of upper layer PDUs is implementation specific.

q_24136.question: How many new MCS schemes may be needed for different levels of aggregation at the physical layer?
q_24136.ground_truth: For different levels of aggregation at the physical layer, different sets of MCS schemes may need to be defined, for example, a total of 27 new MCS schemes may be needed for an aggregation of 2 to 4 timeslots on uplink.

q_24137.question: What should the UE do when the TFT Operation includes two or more packet filters with identical packet filter precedence values?
q_24137.ground_truth: If two or more packet filters among all TFTs associated with this PDN connection have identical packet filter precedence values, and none of them belongs to the default EPS bearer context, the UE should further process the new request and delete the old packet filters with identical packet filter precedence values. If one or more old packet filters belong to the default EPS bearer context, the UE should initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #45 "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

q_24138.question: How does the SMLC handle the reception of an invalid RRLP message during the Position Measurement Procedure?
q_24138.ground_truth: If the SMLC receives a RRLP message with a Protocol Error component, it may try to resend the Measure Position Request, abort location, or start a new position measurement procedure with updated assistance data.

q_24139.question: Which LTE features were not included in all the evaluations, potentially allowing for further enhancements in LTE uplink performance?
q_24139.ground_truth: The possibility for a variable TTI for overhead/delay optimization and different schemes for interference mitigation were not included in all evaluations.

q_24140.question: What happens when PSS to MBMS switching is not available for the UE in 8.4.4.1.3?
q_24140.ground_truth: If PSS to MBMS switching is not available for the UE, the session modification is rejected and the old PSS session is maintained in 8.4.4.1.3.

q_24141.question: What is the role of the PCF in authorizing a UE as a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay or Remote UE?
q_24141.ground_truth: The PCF sends the authorization policy and parameter to a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay or Remote UE, and determines the 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay information based on the received 5G ProSe capability as a Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay.

q_24142.question: What is the best strategy for a UE that only needs to exchange data with the network rarely from a power perspective?
q_24142.ground_truth: A UE that only needs to exchange data with the network rarely should keep the UICC in idle mode without exchanging any APDU, as the comparison in the report shows that it consumes less power compared to the initialization of the UICC and an attach procedure to the network.

q_24143.question: What is the CMR value when C1.C2.C3 is 1.0.0 and D1.D2.D3 is 1.0.0 in the 3GPP TS 48.060 coding?

q_24144.question: Which restart procedures should the SGSN and MSC/VLR implement?
q_24144.ground_truth: The SGSN and the MSC/VLR shall implement the restart procedures specified in ANSI T1.111.4, clause 9.

q_24145.question: What is the effect of having the dASHContent@rule attribute set to 2 in the mooDHeaderAttachment element?
q_24145.ground_truth: If the dASHContent@rule attribute is set to 2 in the mooDHeaderAttachment element, it specifies that the MooD header shall be attached to each MPD request by the DASH client.

q_24146.question: What is the difference between the pulse mode and the scale mode in the large symbol coding method?
q_24146.ground_truth: In the pulse mode, an indicator is used to transmit the first index and pulse information, while in the scale mode, the indices are split into upper bits and lower bits and encoded using a Huffman coding.

q_24147.question: What is the role of the Interactivity Agent in the service application?
q_24147.ground_truth: The Interactivity Agent is responsible for executing the interactive application logic and providing rendering capabilities of scenes during an interactivity sequence. It also implements a pre-determined overall layout for a given interactivity use case.

q_24148.question: What is the type and length of the "Handover To cdma2000 Command" information element?
q_24148.ground_truth: The "Handover To cdma2000 Command" is a type 4 information element with a length of 4 to n octets.

q_24149.question: What is the impact of reducing RLC RTT on the end-to-end average bit rates for FTP application in EDGE MCS-6?
q_24149.ground_truth: Reducing RLC RTT to below 100 ms for EDGE MCS-6 results in end-to-end average bit rates above 90 kbps.

q_24150.question: What is the process for establishing a shared N3 tunnel for data transport in an MBS service area?
q_24150.ground_truth: For data transport of shared delivery in an MBS service area, the MB-SMF establishes a shared N3 tunnel with the NG-RAN(s) to the MB-UPF selected in step 9 via the serving AMF. The NG-RAN decides the delivery mode of the MBS data based on the UE population sharing the target service UE group ID, MBS service session ID, etc.

q_24151.question: What does the Ack/Nack Description information element contain?
q_24151.ground_truth: The Ack/Nack Description information element contains the RLC parameters used to acknowledge or negatively acknowledge a group of RLC data blocks.

q_24152.question: What is the minimum linearity that is required for the LNA and post-filter receiver when the existing values prove insufficient?
q_24152.ground_truth: Minimum linearity values for the LNA and the post-filter receiver are given.

q_24153.question: What is one key security requirement for the protection of multicast traffic?
q_24153.ground_truth: The primary security requirement for MBS traffic protection is ensuring proper security measures are implemented in the air interface when transferring MBS data between UE and external services/networks.

q_24154.question: What is the role of VMSCB in the paging process if there is a valid association between VLRB and the SGSN for the MS?
q_24154.ground_truth: The paging signal towards the MS goes from VMSCB via VLRB and the SGSN to the BSS.

q_24155.question: What are the two scenarios considered for Home NodeB deployments to ensure reasonable behaviour with Macro NodeB?
q_24155.ground_truth: Home NodeB deployments are considered in two scenarios: a) cell edge and b) cell centre.

q_24156.question: What should the MS not do if the registered PLMN is available among the listed PLMNs?
q_24156.ground_truth: The MS should not choose a different PLMN.

q_24157.question: What message does the network pass to the UE after a location procedure, for the UE to include in the MEASUREMENT REPORT?
q_24157.ground_truth: The network passes the result of the location procedure to the UE by sending a FACILITY message to the UE containing a LCS-MOLR return result component.

q_24158.question: What does the AMF do after sending the Deactivate MBS Bearer Request (TMGI) message to the NEF/MBSF?
q_24158.ground_truth: The AMF sets its MB Session Context to inactive state.

q_24159.question: What is the MRFP required to do regarding the BFCP media stream that requires e2e security?
q_24159.ground_truth: For the each BFCP media stream requiring e2e security, the MRFC shall indicate "TCP/TLS/BFCP" as transport protocol when requesting resources from the MRFP, and determine via SDP negotiation if the MRFP needs to act as TLS client or TLS server.

q_24160.question: When is the timeAlignmentTimer associated with an SCell considered expired, leading to the MAC entity not performing any uplink transmission except the Random Access Preamble transmission?
q_24160.ground_truth: When the maximum uplink transmission timing difference between TAGs of the MAC entity or between TAGs of any MAC entity of the UE is exceeded.

q_24161.question: What is defined in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) with the term "Repeater"?
q_24161.ground_truth: A repeater is a device that receives, amplifies and transmits the radiated or conducted RF carrier both in the down-link direction (from the base station to the mobile area) and in the up-link direction (from the mobile to the base station).

q_24162.question: What is the main function of the 3GPP TS in the context of Support of Optimal Routeing (SOR)?
q_24162.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS specifies the technical realization of the first phase of the network feature SOR within the 3GPP system.

q_24163.question: What percentage of calls will have queuing delay of 2 ms or less without TA, regardless of CPU load?

q_24164.question: What are the supported bandwidths for the physical layer in the evolved UTRA?
q_24164.ground_truth: The supported bandwidths for the physical layer in the evolved UTRA include 1.25MHz, 1.6MHz, 2.5MHz, 5MHz, 10MHz, 15MHz, and 20MHz.

q_24165.question: What are the input level requirements for BTS in non-static propagation conditions for channels with 16QAM, 32QAM and QPSK modulations?
q_24165.ground_truth: The requirements for the receiver performance in non-static channels with 16QAM, 32QAM and QPSK modulations are specified for training sequence 6 (TSC-6) in 3GPP TS 45.002.

q_24166.question: Which procedure is responsible for releasing a wireless connection, and what is its criticality level?
q_24166.ground_truth: The "eNBInitiatedWTRelease" procedure is responsible for releasing a wireless connection, and its criticality level is "ignore", which means that the failure to execute this procedure does not have a critical impact on the system.

q_24167.question: What is the difference between offline charging and online charging within the 3GPP charging architecture?
q_24167.ground_truth: Offline charging is a charging mechanism where charging information does not affect, in real-time, the service rendered, while online charging is a charging mechanism where charging information can affect, in real-time, the service rendered, requiring direct interaction of the charging mechanism with session/service control.

q_24168.question: What is the delay budget value in an RTCP feedback message when the query bit is set to '1'?
q_24168.ground_truth: The delay budget value in this case is the additional delay budget requested by the sender of the RTCP feedback message for the reverse link.

q_24169.question: What is the purpose of the UE being allowed to measure on other occasions in addition to the ordered measurement occasions?
q_24169.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to measure on other occasions in case the UE moves "out of service" area or in case it can simultaneously perform the ordered measurements, this allow a UE to maintain its measurements in different scenarios.

q_24170.question: What action does UDM take when there is a match for some or all of the fields in the request for analytics IDs?
q_24170.ground_truth: UDM sends to the NF the list of restricted analytics IDs for UEs and/or group of UEs and the associated ASI.

q_24171.question: What command line option is used for encoding clips with no fixed random access in Scenario 3?

q_24172.question: What should the mobile station do when timer T3228 expires and timer T3248 is used with a value greater than 0?
q_24172.ground_truth: The mobile station should start timer T3248 and continue to monitor the DL EC-PACCH using the next higher DL Coverage Class.

q_24173.question: What information element in the BSSAP+-LOCATION-UPDATE-REQUEST message indicates the type of location update performed by the MS?
q_24173.ground_truth: The GPRS location update type IE in the BSSAP+-LOCATION-UPDATE-REQUEST message indicates the type of location update performed by the MS. If the MS has performed a combined attach request or a combined routing and location area update request with IMSI attach, the SGSN indicates 'IMSI attach', otherwise the SGSN indicates 'Normal location update'.

q_24174.question: What is the GGSN Address Length defined for?
q_24174.ground_truth: It represents the length of the GGSN Address field, excluding the GGSN Address Length octet.

q_24175.question: When must the UE perform the ranking of all cells that fulfill the cell selection criterion S, as specified in TS 38.304, clause 5.2.4.6?
q_24175.ground_truth: The UE must perform the ranking of all cells that fulfill the cell selection criterion S when the UE performs the initial cell selection.

q_24176.question: What event does the ME need to inform the SIM about in the initial conditions described in the Call Connected Event test?
q_24176.ground_truth: The ME needs to inform the SIM about the Event: Call Connected in the initial conditions described in the Call Connected Event test.

q_24177.question: What are the relevant selection parameters for video Adaptation Sets in DASH?
q_24177.ground_truth: The relevant selection parameters for video Adaptation Sets in DASH are frame rates (Hz), video codecs and video codec profile, random access point, display picture resolution, and color primaries and transfer function.

q_24178.question: What is the purpose of the AID of ISIM?
q_24178.ground_truth: The AID of ISIM is used to uniquely identify the IP Multimedia Services Identity Module application on the UICC card, and is defined in ETSI TS 101 220.

q_24179.question: What is the definition of the Default-QoS-Information AVP in the IKEv2 tunnel when a NAT is detected?
q_24179.ground_truth: The Default-QoS-Information AVP defines the Default QoS information for the IP-CAN session in the Fixed Broadband Access.

q_24180.question: What needs to be in place for the MPS Service Provider PLMN to manage the MMTEL video conference service?
q_24180.ground_truth: The MPS Service Provider PLMN should be the service provider which manages the MMTEL video conference service, and any camera controlled related features should be considered to be associated with the video conference service.

q_24181.question: How do the revised DIP values based on field measurements compare to the weighted revised DIP values?
q_24181.ground_truth: The relative gain results for QPSK H-Set 6 using the revised DIP based on field measurements are within 15% or less of the similar values for the weighted revised DIP values.

q_24182.question: What is the basis for the amount of data counted in P-GW when Charging per IP-CAN session is active?
q_24182.ground_truth: The amount of data counted in P-GW is based on the inner IP packets in the GTP-U packet in case of GTP based tunnelling and interworking with external IP networks, T-PDU packets in case of GTP based tunnelling and interworking with external networks handling other data services, payload of the GRE tunnel in case of PMIP based protocol, and payload of the tunnelling layer in case of DSMIPv6 based protocol.

q_24183.question: What event triggers the clearing of all resources in 3G-MSC-B?
q_24183.ground_truth: An abnormal end of the procedure

q_24184.question: What messages does the UE send to the ProSe Key Management Function to request keys for a group?
q_24184.ground_truth: The UE sends a Key Request message to the ProSe Key Management Function, which includes the Group Identity of the group for which it wants to fetch keys and its EPS security capabilities.

q_24185.question: What is the purpose of broadcasting the PLMN ID+NID and the supported SO-ID list by the onboarding SNPN?
q_24185.ground_truth: The purpose of broadcasting the PLMN ID+NID and the supported SO-ID list by the onboarding SNPN is for the UE to discover and select the onboarding SNPN.

q_24186.question: What actions are taken by the gprsSSF when it receives a Release GPRS information flow for the Session in the GSM SCF to gprsSSF information flows?
q_24186.ground_truth: The gprsSSF removes the 'Waiting-for-AC' markers for the Session.

q_24187.question: What is the value of the Key Set Identifier in the first and second records of the 5GS 3GPP Access NAS Security Context in clause 4.11.3?
q_24187.ground_truth: The Key Set Identifier value is '07' in both the first and second records in clause 4.11.3.

q_24188.question: What is the subject matter of the UTRAN Iuant interface: Layer 1 (Release 17) specification?
q_24188.ground_truth: The UTRAN Iuant interface: Layer 1 (Release 17) specification focuses on the technical details of the radio access network component of the 3GPP's specifications for mobile networks.

q_24189.question: What is the role of the LCS Server in verifying the service type indicated by the LCS client?
q_24189.ground_truth: The LCS Server can verify that the service type indicated by the LCS client is correct, and this verification can be done by the LCS server or by the user of the target mobile.

q_24190.question: What is the capability required of the producer of provisioning MnS to allow authorized consumers to update the RRM policies?

q_24191.question: What is the default condition associated with the requirements specified in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_24191.ground_truth: Ideal radio link with an insignificant bit error rate, no other signalling is in progress on the main DCCH, messages sent by the network are correctly formed, and messages sent by the network may contain any set of optional IEs, and any permitted set of conditional IEs.

q_24192.question: What is the responsibility of the H-PCRF when the same changes are applied to all BBERFs?
q_24192.ground_truth: The H-PCRF shall not include AN-GW-Address AVP within the CCA command and provides the updated QoS rules and event triggers to the remaining BBERF(s) within RAR command(s) by initiating the QoS rule provision procedure for each of the remaining BBERF(s).

q_24193.question: What can the CSE do when it has reported the reaching of the threshold to the CSE and assuming the continuation of the dialogue?
q_24193.ground_truth: The CSE can perform charging activities, activate subsequent control service events for the PDP context or GPRS session, and issue instructions for the applicable dialogue.

q_24194.question: What is the purpose of the Reference Location IE in the DGPS Correction Data?
q_24194.ground_truth: The Reference Location IE provides a 2-D location (without uncertainty) to improve GPS receiver performance.

q_24195.question: What should be used as input to derive Kedge using KDF?
q_24195.ground_truth: The input to derive Kedge using KDF includes FC, P0 (SUPI), and L0 (length of SUPi).

q_24196.question: What is the role of the naming convention in the technical specification?
q_24196.ground_truth: The naming convention is used throughout the technical specification to provide a consistent and clear way of referring to the bits in the data blocks, data blocks, bursts, and physical layer transmissions.

q_24197.question: What is the time given for the UE to report RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbour cells in 9.1.2.3?
q_24197.ground_truth: The time given for the UE to report RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbour cells is specified in 9.1.2.3, which includes the time for receiving the OTDOA assistance data and OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message, as well as the measurement time for a single PRS positioning occasion.

q_24198.question: What is the result of the "TERMINAL RESPONSE: SELECT ITEM 3.1.1" command in the expected sequence 3.1 for "SELECT ITEM (default item support)"?

q_24199.question: What information does the location number, geodetic information, and geographical information consist of?
q_24199.ground_truth: This information is derived from the service area ID or cell ID and is used to provide more detailed location information about the MS. The mapping from service area ID or cell ID to location number is network-specific and outside the scope of the UMTS and GSM standards.

q_24200.question: What is the relationship between 3GPP TS 28.632 and the present document?
q_24200.ground_truth: The present document is related to 3GPP TS 28.632 V 14.0.X, providing the NRM-specific part related to the Inventory Management NRM IRP IS, specifically in terms of Solution Set definitions.

q_24201.question: What is the structure of the DataVolumeReportRequest in this protocol?
q_24201.ground_truth: The DataVolumeReportRequest contains protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container with DataVolumeReportRequestIEs. It includes ID id-RAB-DataVolumeReportRequestList, which is a RAB-IE-ContainerList with RAB-DataVolumeReportRequestItemIEs. Each RAB-DataVolumeReportRequestItem contains a RAB-ID and optional iE-Extensions.

q_24202.question: What is the restriction placed on selecting PLMN D when the Disaster Condition applies in solution #25?
q_24202.ground_truth: The UE is prohibited from selecting available PLMN D when the Disaster Condition applies for PLMN D.

q_24203.question: What is the purpose of the frequency acquisition phase in an RNS area?
q_24203.ground_truth: The frequency acquisition phase is used to bring cells of an RNS area to within frequency limits prior to initial synchronization. No traffic is supported during this phase.

q_24204.question: How does a UE determine which CSG identity to choose when performing a manual CSG selection?
q_24204.ground_truth: In manual CSG selection, a UE shall display the available CSGs in the following order: CSGs from the Allowed CSG list, CSGs from the Operator CSG list, and any other CSG. The UE shall provide an indication as to which of the available CSGs is contained in the Allowed CSG List or Operator CSG list.

q_24205.question: What is the policy for handling delimiters in the SIP/IMS codec implementations?
q_24205.ground_truth: The SIP/IMS codec implementation handles delimiters only when encoding or decoding TTCN-3 types, and works at a lower granularity than the BNF. The codec preserves double quotes for quoted strings and removes them for tokens to distinguish them.

q_24206.question: What is the purpose of adding hangover to the combined in the final DTX decision for better performance?
q_24206.ground_truth: The purpose of adding hangover to the combined is to improve DTX performance by using two concurrent hangover logics that can extend the active period. This helps to better cover short pauses and increase the system capacity by saving unnecessary hangover frames.

q_24207.question: What is the action taken by the SCC AS when UE-1, the Controller UE, loses Collaborative Session Control?
q_24207.ground_truth: The SCC AS activates the Collaborative Session Control loss preference and selects a new Controller UE based on that preference.

q_24208.question: What should the MAC entity assume regarding MSG3 repetition for the current Random Access procedure if the BWP selected for the procedure only has sets of Random Access resources with MSG3 repetition indication?
q_24208.ground_truth: MSG3 repetition is applicable for the current Random Access procedure.

q_24209.question: What message is used to initiate the MBMS UE Linking procedure by the CN?

q_24210.question: What action should the DRNC take if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message indicates that a transport bearer for a DCH shall not be established in FDD?
q_24210.ground_truth: The DRNC shall not establish a transport bearer for the concerned DCH, and include the Transport Bearer Not Setup Indicator IE for the corresponding DCH in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message.

q_24211.question: What are the possible bases for CONF Charging for the conference owner and participants?
q_24211.ground_truth: CONF Charging for the conference owner could be based on the establishment of the conference, the number of participants, and duration. CONF Charging for the conference participants could be based on duration.

q_24212.question: What is the tool used for objective conformance criteria for fixed-point encoder implementations for the Enhanced aacPlus encoder?
q_24212.ground_truth: The fixed-point encoder test tool is used for objective conformance criteria for fixed-point encoder implementations for the Enhanced aacPlus encoder for AAC, SBR and PS.

q_24213.question: What is the "INITIATING MESSAGE" for the iurhsetup procedure?
q_24213.ground_truth: The "INITIATING MESSAGE" for the iurhsetup procedure is IurhSetupRequest.

q_24214.question: What is the source for performance measurements in E-UTRAN and NG-RAN?
q_24214.ground_truth: The performance measurements for E-UTRAN are available in TS 32.425, and similar measurements can be defined for NG-RAN in TS 28.552.

q_24215.question: What should the mobile station do upon receiving the first correctly received RLC data block that comprises the TLLI during contention resolution?
q_24215.ground_truth: The network responds by including the TLLI in the PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message.

q_24216.question: What information is sent from the old SGSN to the new SGSN in a prioritized order in the SGSN Context Response message?
q_24216.ground_truth: The PDP Contexts/EPS Bearer Contexts are sent from old to new SGSN in a prioritized order, i.e. the most important PDP Context/EPS Bearer Context first.

q_24217.question: When is the Delay Tolerant Connection Indication set to 1 in the Extended Common Flags II IE?
q_24217.ground_truth: The Delay Tolerant Connection Indication is set to 1 when the GGSN indicated that the PDN connection is delay tolerant.

q_24218.question: What is the process that allows authorized applications to request and use a certain range class when discovering other ProSe-enabled UEs?

q_24219.question: What is the service that identifies an incoming communication as malicious and registers the related information?

q_24220.question: What is the reference point that supports the interactions between the FF AS and the PCF in the 5GS?

q_24221.question: What is the minimum total number of carrier frequency layers, including the intrafrequency serving layer, that a UE supporting E-UTRA measurements in RRC_IDLE state must be capable of monitoring?

q_24222.question: What is the focus of Key Issue 2 in the 5G system?
q_24222.ground_truth: The focus is on studying security protection of 5G MBS PDU sessions/flows at the transport or service level.

q_24223.question: In 3GPP TS 38.304, clause 5.3.1, when should UEs assigned to Access Identity 11 or 15 operating in their HPLMN/EHPLMN treat a cell as a candidate during cell selection and reselection procedures?
q_24223.ground_truth: UEs assigned to Access Identity 11 or 15 operating in their HPLMN/EHPLMN shall treat a cell as a candidate during the cell selection and reselection procedures if the field cellReservedForOperatorUse for that PLMN set to "reserved".

q_24224.question: What information does the MME include in the cancellation request message when transferring from the MME to a V-GMLC?
q_24224.ground_truth: The MME includes the H-GMLC address, LDR reference number, and IMSI of the UE in the cancellation request message.

q_24225.question: Which clause describes the establishment of one or more additional PDN connections when the UE has already an established PDN connection?
q_24225.ground_truth: 8.3.9 UE-Initiated Connectivity to Additional PDN with DSMIPv6 on S2c over untrusted Fixed Broadband Access

q_24226.question: What is the value of the SM-RP-UI parameter when sending concatenated Short Messages?
q_24226.ground_truth: The SM-RP-UI parameter shall be set to SMS-DELIVER when sending concatenated Short Messages.

q_24227.question: What should the T(RIAE) instance do upon expiration in the controlling or receiving BSS?
q_24227.ground_truth: As an implementation option, the controlling or receiving BSS shall inform the application that the procedure has failed or restart the RAN Information Application Error procedure a finite number of times.

q_24228.question: What happens when the RRC release with suspend operation is triggered in the RAN?
q_24228.ground_truth: When the RRC release with suspend operation is triggered in the RAN, the current MT data is handled based on the RAN's implementation. RAN paging may not be triggered for a certain period that is up to RAN implementation, or until the UE initiates the resume procedure.

q_24229.question: What is the first event listed in the proactive command set up event list 1.1.1?
q_24229.ground_truth: The first event listed in the proactive command set up event list 1.1.1 is Network Rejection.

q_24230.question: In what circumstances will the UE keep the stored Extended local emergency numbers list in the user equipment?
q_24230.ground_truth: When the UE moves to a new PLMN in the same country as the PLMN from which the currently stored Extended Emergency Numbers List was received, and the Extended Emergency Number List Validity field within the Extended emergency number list IE indicates "Extended local Emergency Numbers List is valid in the country of the PLMN from which this IE is received".

q_24231.question: What action does the AMF take if UE-1 and UE-2 are part of the same MUSIM UE and the UE-2 is in CM-CONNECTED state?
q_24231.ground_truth: The AMF sends a NAS NOTIFICATION message over N1 NAS signalling connection of UE-2 indicating the type of the traffic pending to be delivered to the UE.

q_24232.question: What key is used by the UE and the HSE to calculate BEST UE-to-HSE keys?
q_24232.ground_truth: KASME (Key Agreement and Security Management Element) is used by the UE and the HSE to calculate BEST UE-to-HSE keys.

q_24233.question: What is the role of the PCRF when an access of a PDN connection becomes usable?
q_24233.ground_truth: The PCRF updates the PCC rules by changing the Routing Access Type of PCC Rules and provides the updated PCC rules to the PDN GW, which then provides updated Routing Rules to the UE based on the updated PCC rules received.

q_24234.question: What should a mobile station do if it has not received the PSI1 message within the last 30 seconds?
q_24234.ground_truth: The mobile station should attempt to receive the PSI1 message each time it is scheduled on PBCCH, during packet idle mode, packet transfer mode, MAC-Idle state, or MAC-Shared state.

q_24235.question: What is one of the requirements for short message service (SMS) transport over a generic IP-CAN?
q_24235.ground_truth: Appropriate security mechanisms shall be supported.

q_24236.question: What are the three types of metering used in talk burst exchange as a session based service?
q_24236.ground_truth: The three types of metering used in talk burst exchange as a session based service are duration, volume, and number.

q_24237.question: What information does the "Traffic volume measurement quantity" contain?
q_24237.ground_truth: The "Traffic volume measurement quantity" contains measurement quantity information for a traffic volume measurement.

q_24238.question: What other condition is required for outgoing international communications except those directed to the home PLMN country to be true?
q_24238.ground_truth: In addition to the above condition, it also evaluates to true when the request URI does not point to a destination served within the served user's home network.

q_24239.question: What is a 3GPP PS data off status and how does the network learn about it?
q_24239.ground_truth: A 3GPP PS data off status is a feature which indicates if a user's mobile data is currently active or not. The network is informed about the user's 3GPP PS data off status by the inclusion of a g.3gpp.ps-data-off media feature tag in all REGISTER requests sent over GPRS IP-CAN, EPS IP-CAN or 5GS IP-CAN.

q_24240.question: What is the third gap identified in Scenario #1 for MABR operation of 5MBS-enhanced 5GMS~System?
q_24240.ground_truth: The means to announce these unicast-hosted session descriptions to the 5MBS~Client at MBS-5.

q_24241.question: Which information is added per each online charged service in the PS Furnish Charging Information procedure when FBC is enabled for a specific APN?
q_24241.ground_truth: Online charging session specific information is added to the PGW-CDR and TDF-CDR, and can be sent per each online charged service.

q_24242.question: In which UE service state is the UE reachable by paging for CS services and initiates LA updates at LA changes, but does not initiate periodic CS service updates?

q_24243.question: What is required for a UE to be temporarily admitted in the target hybrid cell in case of enhanced relocation to a RNC from a hybrid HNB for CSG UEs?
q_24243.ground_truth: The UE should be CSG capable from Rel-9 onwards, SIB-reading capable, and its reported CSG membership status should be provided by the Source RNC to the Target HNB within the CSG Membership Status IE included in the RNSAP: ENHANCED RELOCATION REQUEST message.

q_24244.question: What should be done if none of the sets of Random Access resources are available for any feature applicable to the current Random Access procedure?
q_24244.ground_truth: Select the set(s) of Random Access resources that are not associated with any feature indication for this Random Access procedure.

q_24245.question: What should the IWF do if the user identified by the MCPTT ID is not affiliated to the group, and this is an authorized request for originating a priority call?
q_24245.ground_truth: The IWF shall perform the actions specified in clause~9.2.1.2.9 for implicit affiliation.

q_24246.question: What is the requirement for the USAT environment to maintain the same high levels of security?
q_24246.ground_truth: The USAT environment shall maintain (or improve) the same high levels of security as the UICC and ensure adequate future measures are taken to fulfill this requirement with future advances in technologies/services.

q_24247.question: What should the initiating UE include in the DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message when the PC5 unicast link modification procedure is to add new PC5 QoS flow(s) to the existing PC5 unicast link?
q_24247.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall include the PQFI(s) and the corresponding PC5 QoS parameters, including the V2X service identifier(s) in the DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

q_24248.question: What is the function of the I-CSCF or S-CSCF in the 403 (Forbidden) measurements?
q_24248.ground_truth: The I-CSCF or S-CSCF generates or receives the 403 (Forbidden) response message

q_24249.question: What is the requirement for the AF to generate the applicable events when providing service information to the PCRF due to AF session signalling?
q_24249.ground_truth: The PCRF instructs the PCEF to report events related to the corresponding PCC rules for the PCRF to generate the applicable events.

q_24250.question: What is the first step taken when using the RDS protocol in the EPS for data transfer between the UE and the network?
q_24250.ground_truth: In EPS, the UE establishes a PDN connection with the SCEF or P-GW through the Attach procedure or through UE requested PDN connectivity.

q_24251.question: What is the purpose of the "ue-RadioAccessCapability" field in the "SRNC-RelocationInfo-v7e0ext-IEs" and "SRNC-RelocationInfo-v7f0ext-IEs" sequences?
q_24251.ground_truth: The "ue-RadioAccessCapability" field in the "SRNC-RelocationInfo-v7e0ext-IEs" and "SRNC-RelocationInfo-v7f0ext-IEs" sequences represents the radio access capability of a UE, which includes the Rel-5 radio access capability extensions and earlier.

q_24252.question: What HTTP methods can be used in the RESTful Rx reference point to indicate actions that can be performed by the server on a resource?
q_24252.ground_truth: The HTTP methods that can be used in the RESTful Rx reference point to indicate actions that can be performed by the server on a resource are POST, PUT, and DELETE.

q_24253.question: What is the initialization procedure for PSN interworking in the Iu user plane?
q_24253.ground_truth: The initialization procedure for PSN interworking in the Iu user plane is the same as that for the modem case, but the IWF may establish the connection before the fixed network leg has been synchronized.

q_24254.question: What abbreviation is used to define CDMA2000 1x Radio Transmission Technology in the context of the present document?

q_24255.question: What is the limitation of IRC techniques in the constrained DCU application when using a single transmit antenna?
q_24255.ground_truth: The limitation is that the multipath channel to the respective desired and interfering signals are identical, which could limit the differentiation of spatio-temporal interferer covariance matrix from the desired waveform.

q_24256.question: What is the first defined compatibility objective for MUROS?
q_24256.ground_truth: The first compatibility objective (C1) is to introduce the candidate techniques for MUROS without decreasing perceived voice quality for the user, ensuring a voice quality better than for GSM HR.

q_24257.question: What is the focus of the first phase of the GSM Cordless Telephony System (CTS)?
q_24257.ground_truth: The first phase of the GSM Cordless Telephony System (CTS) aims primarily at an application supporting the speech teleservice (including DTMF support) in a residential single cell environment, by focusing on the requirements necessary to elaborate the radio interface and the security aspects for such an application.

q_24258.question: What do the Basic Encoding Rules (BER) specify in the context of 3GPP and how do they apply to ASN.1 formatted files?
q_24258.ground_truth: The Basic Encoding Rules (BER) specify the encoding and decoding of data in the context of 3GPP. For ASN.1 formatted files, BER encoding rules are used to ensure compliance with the standardized ASN.1 file format.

q_24259.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a valid RRBP field as part of the RLC/MAC control block containing the EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK and CONTENTION RESOLUTION message?
q_24259.ground_truth: The mobile station should transmit an EC PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT or EC PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT HIGHER CC message in the uplink resources specified.

q_24260.question: What is the difference between the full-band and the high-band regression coefficients?
q_24260.ground_truth: The full-band regression coefficient is normalized by the sub-band energies when the threshold is different to 0, while the high-band regression coefficient is estimated as the sign of the average of the input samples in the pre-echo zone and is not normalized.

q_24261.question: What is the requirement for transmit OFF power for the 1.28 Mcps TDD Option for a base station (BS) capable of multi-band operation during the transmitter OFF period in all supported operating bands?
q_24261.ground_truth: The transmit OFF power shall be less than -82 dBm.

q_24262.question: In section 6.1.2.4.2, what is the criterion for cell re-selection when more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell, if a higher priority NR or E-UTRAN RAT/frequency fulfills Srxlev > ThreshX, HighP?
q_24262.ground_truth: Cell re-selection to a cell on a higher priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency is performed.

q_24263.question: What is the 3GPP TS 23.216 defining in relation to the EPS?
q_24263.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 23.216 defines SRVCC in relation to the EPS.

q_24264.question: What does AoC Information contain, and how is it provided to the user?
q_24264.ground_truth: AoC Information contains Cost and/or Tariff for the requested service, provided either in monetary or non-monetary format. It can be provided in real-time during or after communication establishment, depending on the AoC service type and obligatory type.

q_24265.question: What are the functions that a UE supporting ProSe UE-to-Network Relaying must include?
q_24265.ground_truth: The functions that a UE supporting ProSe UE-to-Network Relaying must include are ProSe Direct discovery for ProSe UE-to-Network Relay, One-to-one ProSe Direct Communication, acting as a default router to the Remote UEs forwarding IP packets, Relaying eMBMS traffic using one-to-many ProSe Direct Communication, ProSe Per-Packet Priority handling for unicast and eMBMS downlink traffic, IPv6 prefix allocation and delegation if IPv6 is used, and IPv4 address allocation and IPv4 NAT function if IPv4 is used.

q_24266.question: What type of test signal is used for testing the wideband telephony service provided by the UE, as defined in the 3GPP TS 26 series of specifications?
q_24266.ground_truth: The test signal used is band limited between 100 Hz and 8 kHz with a bandpass filter providing a minimum of 24 dB/oct. filter roll-off

q_24267.question: What should the UE do if a measurement result is available and the reportType is cli-Periodical?
q_24267.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure for this measId immediately after the quantity to be reported becomes available for at least one CLI measurement resource.

q_24268.question: What is the role of the vPCRF in the roaming case when accessing a trusted Fixed Broadband Access network for EPC-routed traffic?
q_24268.ground_truth: The vPCRF forwards messages between the BPCF and the hPCRF in the HPLMN in the roaming case.

q_24269.question: What is the role of LDNSR in handling DNS requests in late DNS handling?
q_24269.ground_truth: In late DNS handling, LDNSR buffers the DNS request if it applies.

q_24270.question: What is the role of the TOM protocol in the exchange of RRLP messages in A/Gb mode?
q_24270.ground_truth: The TOM protocol is used for transfer of RRLP messages between the MS and the SGSN in A/Gb mode.

q_24271.question: How does the 3GPP system prioritize media flows during an MPS for DTS session?
q_24271.ground_truth: The 3GPP system provides priority treatment to the affected media flows end-to-end between the UE and the enterprise network when MPS for DTS to an authorized MPS capable enterprise network is activated.

q_24272.question: What is the SUCI linkability attack about?
q_24272.ground_truth: The SUCI linkability attack is an attack where an attacker records a SUCI that is used over the radio interface and uses it to find out whether a UE observed at some location/time X is identical to a UE observed at some location/time Y.

q_24273.question: What is the 3GPP and what is the purpose of the DIMS technical specification?
q_24273.ground_truth: The 3GPP is a collaboration of groups that develop specifications for mobile communication. The DIMS technical specification defines a dynamic, interactive, scene-based media system for display and control of multimedia data such as audio, video, graphics, images, and text.

q_24274.question: Which protocols are compatible with the IMS conferencing management object?
q_24274.ground_truth: The IMS conferencing management object is compatible with OMA DM 1.2.

q_24275.question: In the process of ACDC access control, what is the consequence if the access for the ACDC category indicated by upper layers is changed from barred to not barred?
q_24275.ground_truth: If the access for the ACDC category indicated by upper layers is changed from barred to not barred, the ACDC capable UE should act on the IE "ACDC-ACB-barringBitmap" when initiating an RRC Connection establishment to the PS domain.

q_24276.question: In the context of FDD, under what circumstances would the DRNS initiate a RADIO LINK PARAMETER UPDATE INDICATION message with the HARQ Process Allocation For 2ms Scheduled Transmission Grant?
q_24276.ground_truth: When the DRNS needs to update the HARQ process allocation for scheduled Transmission.

q_24277.question: Which device is the source device for the ME in RECEIVE DATA command with command type 1.1.1?
q_24277.ground_truth: The source device for the ME in the RECEIVE DATA command with command type 1.1.1 is RFU.

q_24278.question: What is the definition of ID id-RANAP-Message in RerouteNASRequestIEs?
q_24278.ground_truth: ID id-RANAP-Message is a CRITICALITY ignore, TYPE OCTET STRING, with a presence of mandatory in RerouteNASRequestIEs, representing a RANAP message.

q_24279.question: What information should the DRNS use when the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the MAC-es Guaranteed Bit Rate IE for an E-DCH Logical Channel in the E-DCH MAC-d Flows Information TDD IE?
q_24279.ground_truth: The DRNS should use this information to optimize MAC-e scheduling decisions for the related queue.

q_24280.question: What protocol is used for the W1-C interface, which connects an ng-eNB-DU and an ng-eNB-CU-CP?
q_24280.ground_truth: The E1 signalling transport supporting for ng-eNB-CU-CP/ng-eNB-CU-UP, eNB-CP/eNB-UP, based on the SCTP/IP protocol stack, is used for the W1-C interface.

q_24281.question: What is the role of the Fax Adaptor in the PLMN facsimile service?
q_24281.ground_truth: The Fax Adaptor is intended to specifically complement the Group 3 facsimile apparatus in order to communicate over a PLMN. It can be functionally partitioned into an analogue section and a digital section, which handle modulation and demodulation processes, signalling on the 2-wire path, T.30 protocol monitoring, and overall control of the adaptor.

q_24282.question: Which reference point enables the H-PCRF to provide dynamic QoS control policies from the HPLMN to a BBERF in the VPLMN?
q_24282.ground_truth: The S9 reference point resides between a PCRF in the HPLMN (H-PCRF) and a PCRF in the VPLMN (V-PCRF), and enables the H-PCRF to provide dynamic QoS control policies from the HPLMN to a BBERF in the VPLMN for roaming with a home routed access.

q_24283.question: What is the target identity that needs to be transferred from the PDN-GW, ePDG or the HSS to the DF2 in order to perform its functionality?
q_24283.ground_truth: The target identity is one of the pieces of information that needs to be transferred from the PDN-GW, ePDG or the HSS to the DF2 in order to perform its functionality.

q_24284.question: Who are the main actors involved in the use cases of PBS and what are their roles?
q_24284.ground_truth: The main actors involved in PBS use cases are Personal Broadcast Content Provider (PBCP), Personal Broadcast Service Provider (PBSP), Broadcast Service User (BSU), and Mobile Broadcast/Multicast Network Operator (MBNO). PBCP generates the content, PBSP facilitates content delivery between PBCP and mobile operator, BSU consumes the content, and MBNO provides content distribution services.

q_24285.question: What is the overall process for intra-cell handover?
q_24285.ground_truth: The overall process for intra-cell handover is implemented in the CTS-MS and CTS-FP. The CTS-MS monitors the downlink RX signal level and quality from its serving CTS cell, while the CTS-FP measures the uplink performance for the CTS-MS being served. The CTS measurement results are then used to make an intra-cell handover decision based on defined thresholds and strategies.

q_24286.question: How does the UE derive IMPI/IMPU from the SUPI in the IMS registration process?
q_24286.ground_truth: The UE can derive IMPI/IMPU from the SUPI or the SNPN or an IMS provider provisioned with the SUPI can do the same.

q_24287.question: What is the main advantage of including ACK/NACK in the header of an RLC data block?
q_24287.ground_truth: The main advantage is that it allows for immediate NACK of lost RLC blocks, resulting in low latency and no reduction of uplink capacity.

q_24288.question: What is the procedure triggered when a UE updates its Allowed NSSAI?
q_24288.ground_truth: When a UE updates its Allowed NSSAI, the AMF compares the updated Allowed NSSAI with the stored Allowed NSSAI and notifies the status to the PCF. The PCF decides whether to update the policy counter(s) of associated S-NSSAI(s).

q_24289.question: What information should be contained in the "body" URI header field from the SIP URI in the Refer-To header in the SIP re-INVITE request when triggering media component renegotiation?
q_24289.ground_truth: The media type(s) present in the hname "body" URI header field from the SIP URI in the Refer-To header in the SIP REFER request should be used in the SIP re-INVITE request.

q_24290.question: Under what circumstances should the S-CSCF send a synchronization failure back to the S-CSCF in SM7?
q_24290.ground_truth: When the UE receives SM6 and detects that the SQN is out of range.

q_24291.question: What action should an IPv6 capable SGSN take if it receives an IPv6 address in the GGSN Address for Control Plane field with a MBMS Session Start Request message?
q_24291.ground_truth: An IPv6 capable SGSN should include its own IPv6 address in the SGSN Address for Control Plane field of the response message.

q_24292.question: In what mode is the BSS packet flow context procedures executed in the RAN?
q_24292.ground_truth: In A/Gb mode, BSS packet flow context procedures may be executed.

q_24293.question: What are the two groups of W1AP services?
q_24293.ground_truth: The two groups of W1AP services are Non UE-associated services and UE-associated services.

q_24294.question: What security requirement does the system need to support for the F1-C control plane signalling between the terminating nodes of the F1-C interface in the IAB network?
q_24294.ground_truth: The system needs to support end-to-end confidentiality protection, end-to-end integrity and replay protection for the F1-C control plane signalling between the terminating nodes of the F1-C interface in the IAB network.

q_24295.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group in relation to the Enhanced aacPlus audio codec?
q_24295.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group is responsible for specifying the digital test sequences and conformance criteria for the Enhanced aacPlus audio codec.

q_24296.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE after the receipt of RRC CONNECTION RELEASE from the USS in Expected Sequence A?
q_24296.ground_truth: The UE shall not be soft powered down after connection termination to allow examination of the USIM values.

q_24297.question: When can ProSe Direct Communication be used while the UE is out of coverage?
q_24297.ground_truth: ProSe Direct Communication can be used when the UE searches for a cell operating the provisioned radio resources and authorization for ProSe Direct Communication to this PLMN is confirmed.

q_24298.question: For which values of Npilot is the diversity antenna pilot pattern obtained by STTD encoding both the shadowed and non-shadowed pilot bits?
q_24298.ground_truth: For Npilot = 4, the diversity antenna pilot pattern is obtained by STTD encoding both the shadowed and non-shadowed pilot bits.

q_24299.question: What should be included in the "mcdatainfo" element in a group standalone SDS message?
q_24299.ground_truth: The "mcdatainfo" element should contain the "mcdata-Params" element with the "request-type", "mcdata-request-uri", and "mcdata-client-id" elements in a group standalone SDS message.

q_24300.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of outgoing RTP packets at MRFP?

q_24301.question: How is the same antenna port used for all symbols of the MWUS within a subframe?
q_24301.ground_truth: The same antenna port is used for all symbols of the MWUS within a subframe, and the UE shall not assume that the MWUS is transmitted on the same antenna port as any of the downlink reference signals or synchronization signals.

q_24302.question: What is the gain factor for the j:th TFC in normal frames, given the nominal power relation Aj?
q_24302.ground_truth: The gain factor for the j:th TFC in normal frames is Aj.

q_24303.question: What action should the DRNS take if the value of Uu Activation State IE is "Activated" in the SECONDARY UL FREQUENCY REPORT message?
q_24303.ground_truth: The DRNS should use this information for resource allocation operation of the secondary E-DCH radio link(s), F-DPCH transmission and DPCCH detection.

q_24304.question: What two possibilities exist for synchronization during serving HS-DSCH cell change with respect to transmission and reception?
q_24304.ground_truth: The two possibilities for synchronization during serving HS-DSCH cell change with respect to transmission and reception are synchronized serving HS-DSCH cell change, where start and stop of HS-DSCH transmission and reception is performed at a certain time typically selected by the network, and unsynchronised serving HS-DSCH cell change, where start and stop of HS-DSCH transmission and reception is performed "as soon as possible" at either side.

q_24305.question: What is the function of the Evolved Packet Core (EPC) Network Resource Model (NRM) in 3GPP TS 28.707?
q_24305.ground_truth: The EPC NRM, as specified in 3GPP TS 28.707, defines the network resource model for the Evolved Packet Core network, and specifies the requirements for the Integration Reference Point (IRP).

q_24306.question: What is the expected sequence for the CALL CONTROL BY SIM, set up call attempt resulting from a set up call proactive command, allowed without modification?

q_24307.question: What activities must be performed when providing information needed to decrypt the content of communication for an already established IMS media secured session?
q_24307.ground_truth: When LI is activated for an established IMS media secured session, the CSCF shall extract the SDP and  SIP headers exchanged during the IMS session setup for possible later retrieval, and the DF2/MF shall forward the Start of interception with established IMS session message to the LEMF over HI2, and retrieve session keys and encryption related information from the KMS.

q_24308.question: What is the role of the SGW in the signalling network between SS7 networks and IP networks?
q_24308.ground_truth: The SGW supports the services of MTP and M3UA/SCTP to ensure seamless operation of the MTP3-User part information between SS7 and IP networks.

q_24309.question: What should the source eNB include in the HANDOVER REQUEST message for UP integrity protection if it receives the UP integrity protection policy from other entities?
q_24309.ground_truth: The source eNB should include the UP integrity protection policy, the UE EPS security capability, and the corresponding E-RAB ID in the HANDOVER REQUEST message.

q_24310.question: What information is used in a radio interface paging message if the Temporary UE Identity IE is not included and no signaling connection exists?
q_24310.ground_truth: The Permanent NAS UE Identity (i.e. IMSI)

q_24311.question: Which networks are involved in CCBS Call Reporting?
q_24311.ground_truth: CCBS Call Reporting is required from both the A-side (originating network HLR~A and VLR~A) and the B-side (destination network HLR~B) during CCBS call processing.

q_24312.question: What message transmission indicates a successful relocation resource allocation with UE involved for PS domain?
q_24312.ground_truth: Transmission of a RANAP message RELOCATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE from the target RNC to the PS CN (Target side)

q_24313.question: In the structure of the PDCP sublayer, which RLC (Radio Link Control) modes are supported for the PDCP entities?
q_24313.ground_truth: The PDCP sublayer supports both AM (Acknowledged Mode) RLC and UM (Unacknowledged Mode) RLC modes for the PDCP entities.

q_24314.question: What function does the PCRF perform for each received downlink IP packet within an IP CAN session?
q_24314.ground_truth: The PCRF selects a PCC rule for the packet by evaluating it against downlink service data flow templates of all active PCC rules of the IP CAN session

q_24315.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink Tunnel Endpoint Identifier Control Plane in the Update PDP Context Request message?
q_24315.ground_truth: To identify the Tunnel Endpoint used between the old SGSN and the GGSN in up link direction for control plane purpose.

q_24316.question: What is the role of the UAV in supporting remote patient monitoring in rural areas with limited cellular coverage?
q_24316.ground_truth: In the use case for rural areas connected healthcare, a UAV is utilized as a relay UE near Ava's home for a period to ensure better real-time monitoring during her remote treatment, despite limited cellular coverage in the area.

q_24317.question: What is the effect of receiving the VGCS Target cell Ciphering information IE if a mobile station does not support "VGCS talking"?
q_24317.ground_truth: Receiving the VGCS Target cell Ciphering information IE by a mobile station not supporting "VGCS talking" triggers an exception handling. This IE should only be accepted by mobile stations supporting "VGCS talking".

q_24318.question: When the UE deregisters over an access type or enters a certain state, what shall be deleted from the rejected NSSAI for the current registration area corresponding to the access type?
q_24318.ground_truth: The rejected NSSAI for the current registration area corresponding to the access type shall be deleted.

q_24319.question: What is the function of the Serving GW in the EPS?
q_24319.ground_truth: The Serving GW is the gateway which terminates the interface towards E-UTRAN. Its functions include serving as the local mobility anchor point for inter-eNodeB handover, mobility anchoring for inter-3GPP mobility, ECM-IDLE mode downlink packet buffering, lawful interception, packet routing and forwarding, uplink and downlink bearer binding, and mobile access gateway functions.

q_24320.question: What is the Role of NSAPI in SNDCP?
q_24320.ground_truth: NSAPI is an index to the PDP context of the PDP that is using the services provided by the SNDCP layer. Each active NSAPI shall use the services provided by the Service Access Point Identifier (SAPI) in the LLC layer.

q_24321.question: What is the name of the field that the third sequence of UE-RadioAccessCapabBandFDD has to omit if the third and fourth sequences have the same UTRA band capabilities?

q_24322.question: When creating a new visited-realm instance for a media line in an SDP offer, what value should the IMS-ALG assign to the instance-number?
q_24322.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should assign an instance-number value for the instance that is "1" higher than the highest existing instance-number value for any visited-realm attribute for any media line in the received SDP offer, starting with the value "1" if there are no such attributes in the SDP offer.

q_24323.question: What is the role of the UE in this process?
q_24323.ground_truth: The UE establishes a PDU Session and gets an IP address. It then uses the IP address to access the EAS, which can include the NIP request in the Option field of the DL IP/TCP header or generate an ICMP ECHO packet with the request in the data field.

q_24324.question: What are the three capabilities covered by the Communication Continuity MO?
q_24324.ground_truth: Voice Call Continuity (VCC), Service Continuity (SC), and inter UE transfer.

q_24325.question: Under what circumstances is the mobile station required to consider the absence of the VGCS target mode indication as no ciphering on the assigned channel?
q_24325.ground_truth: If the VGCS cipher mode setting IE is omitted and the ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message is sent on a ciphered VGCS channel for assigning a dedicated channel.

q_24326.question: In what ways can 3GPP specifications be modified to better meet the requirements of Service Specific Access Control (SSAC) in EPS?
q_24326.ground_truth: The study identifies various ways 3GPP specifications can be modified, such as studying use cases and clarifying issues in SSAC in EPS, describing the considerations and the problems with existing access control in identified use cases, and identifying candidate requirements and aspects for providing SSAC in EPS.

q_24327.question: What is the purpose of optimized access to Internet in 3GPP specifications?
q_24327.ground_truth: The purpose of optimized access to Internet is to minimize information transmitted, optimize encryption protocols/algorithms and inter-operate QoS mechanisms over the radio interface.

q_24328.question: What is the length of each sub-sequence xm in the adaptive sample rate decimation by RPE grid selection clause?
q_24328.ground_truth: Each sub-sequence xm is of length 13 in the adaptive sample rate decimation by RPE grid selection clause.

q_24329.question: What message does the BSS return if the TA value is not available and the MS is in Packet Transfer Mode?
q_24329.ground_truth: The BSS sends an EC Packet Polling Request message to the MS.

q_24330.question: What procedure may be used by the GCS AS to immediately release a set of TMGIs?
q_24330.ground_truth: The TMGI Deallocation Procedure may be used by the GCS AS to immediately release a set of TMGIs.

q_24331.question: What should the UTRAN do if the CN domain set in the IE "CN Domain Identity" in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message was not provided with new keys, and if this was not the first SECURITY MODE COMMAND message for this RRC connection?
q_24331.ground_truth: The UTRAN should use the value "START" in the most recently received IE "START list" or IE "START" that belongs to the CN domain to initialise all hyper frame numbers of the downlink and uplink COUNT-I values respectively for all the signalling radio bearers other than RB2.

q_24332.question: When is the bulk transfer of CCTV archives performed in this use case?
q_24332.ground_truth: The bulk transfer is performed only when the train approaches stations and comes to a stop at the depot.

q_24333.question: What is the procedure followed for coding the CON message in the described scenario?
q_24333.ground_truth: The procedure for coding the CON message includes setting the Called Party's status indicator of the BCI parameter to "no indication" and applying the same procedure as described for ANM in clause~7.2.3.2.9.1, 7.2.3.2.9.2 and 7.2.3.2.9.3 for access transport parameter, transmission medium used parameter and bearer capability respectively.

q_24334.question: What does the MSB and LSB refer to in the context of mapping bits for HS-SCCH cyclic sequence number?
q_24334.ground_truth: MSB refers to the Most Significant Bit, while LSB refers to the Least Significant Bit.

q_24335.question: What is the improvement of EVS over AMR for the coding modes of AMR in terms of perceptual quality?
q_24335.ground_truth: The EVS codec shows improvement over all of the coding modes of AMR in terms of perceptual quality.

q_24336.question: How is a 3GPP network divided in terms of radio access and core network?
q_24336.ground_truth: A 3GPP network is divided into two main domains: the radio Access Network (RAN) and the Core Network (CN). The RAN includes UTRAN and/or GERAN in Iu mode and/or E-UTRAN. The CN consists of the PS Domain, IM Subsystem, and CS Domain.

q_24337.question: What would be the result of reducing ON time by 10% when operating in EVS SWB channel aware mode in terms of capacity gains?

q_24338.question: What is the role of an NSAPI in the communication between an SGSN and an MS in A/Gb mode?
q_24338.ground_truth: An NSAPI is assigned when the MS initiates the PDP Context Activation function and is used to uniquely address an SGSN or MS PDP context in combination with a TLLI.

q_24339.question: Which feature allows for an open interface between the GCSE client on the UE and the network?
q_24339.ground_truth: The interface between the GCSE client on the UE and the network is an open interface.

q_24340.question: What is the role of the NRF in 5G networks?
