q_24340.ground_truth: The NRF calculates the per-slice session number using SMF status information and provides it to the AMF.

q_24341.question: What procedure is referred to in step 1.2 of the calibration procedure for the Indoor Anechoic Chamber?
q_24341.ground_truth: The procedure in step 1.2 refers to installing the base station (BS) with the manufacturer declared coordinate system reference point in the same place as the phase center of the reference antenna.

q_24342.question: What is the impact of Communication session Hold (HOLD) on the FA service?
q_24342.ground_truth: No impact, i.e. neither service shall affect the operation of the other service.

q_24343.question: What was the duration of the music items used in the tests?
q_24343.ground_truth: The duration of the different music items lasts in the range between 8 and 10 seconds.

q_24344.question: What should 5GMM do if it receives an uplink user data packet for a PDU session with suspended user-plane resources and barring is still in effect for the associated access category?
q_24344.ground_truth: 5GMM shall consider that the uplink user data packet is not allowed to be sent.

q_24345.question: What is the parameter that determines the maximum number of cells to be reported in the reportType eventTriggered or periodical?

q_24346.question: Which solution proposes an architecture to expose Time Sensitive Communication (TSC) capabilities of the 5G system for the integration of an IEEE TSN system as well as 5G-native TSC services?
q_24346.ground_truth: Solution #22 proposes an architecture to expose Time Sensitive Communication (TSC) capabilities of the 5G system for the integration of an IEEE TSN system as well as 5G-native TSC services.

q_24347.question: What happens to the HFN component of COUNT-C when the UE performs ciphering at the activation time as specified in the IE "Ciphering activation time for DPCH" and the IE "COUNT-C activation time" is set to zero in the received message?
q_24347.ground_truth: The HFN component of COUNT-C is incremented by one, even if the "COUNT-C activation time" is set to zero.

q_24348.question: Who can benefit from the positioning information provided by the UTRAN UE Positioning function?
q_24348.ground_truth: The positioning information provided by the UTRAN UE Positioning function can be used by UTRAN, value-added network services, UEs, and third-party services.

q_24349.question: What is the transmission mode state with a duration of 10ms for a TFC in 3.84 Mcps TDD mode and 7.68 Mcps TDD mode?

q_24350.question: What is the role of the Iur-g interface between a BSS and an RNS in the 3GPP specification?
q_24350.ground_truth: The Iur-g interface between a BSS and an RNS is used to enable the possibility to perform GRA/URA update procedures with the serving BSS/RNC, and to prevent unnecessary signalling when a mobile changes cells or RANs.

q_24351.question: What two parameters are specified in the "APN-Rate-Control-Downlink" AVP for each APN?
q_24351.ground_truth: The "APN-Rate-Control-Downlink" AVP includes the parameters for controlling data PDU transfers in downlink for each APN, such as the maximum rate, maximum message size, and the time unit for controlling the rate.

q_24352.question: What information does the "Binding ID" IE contain in the case of transport bearer establishment with ALCAP?
q_24352.ground_truth: In the case of transport bearer establishment with ALCAP, the "Binding ID" IE contains the identifier that is allocated at the Node B and that is unique for each transport bearer under establishment to/from the Node B.

q_24353.question: How is the reference cell ID determined in soft handover?
q_24353.ground_truth: The cell ID may be selected as the cell that provides an active connection for the UE at the time of receiving the UE Positioning request at the SRNC or by utilizing parameters such as the best reference signal, RTT in FDD, Rx Timing Deviation in TDD, and knowledge of the UE timing advance in TDD, as well as antenna beam direction parameters.

q_24354.question: Which message format does the IWF not support?
q_24354.ground_truth: The IWF does not support the FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message.

q_24355.question: What is the function of a Discovery Filter (DF) in 5G Direct Discovery using Model A?
q_24355.ground_truth: A Discovery Filter (DF) in 5G Direct Discovery using Model A is used by Monitoring UEs for recognizing and identifying the Announcing UE based on the ProSe application broadcast.

q_24356.question: What is the purpose of the Equipment Id, Equipment Type, Equipment Version and Location fields in the HW Description list?
q_24356.ground_truth: These fields distinguish a piece of equipment out of others of the same type, code the type of equipment, version of the equipment, and the place where the piece of equipment is found.

q_24357.question: When does the mobile station perform an abnormal release with access retry in case of timer T3168 expiry?
q_24357.ground_truth: If timer T3168 expires and the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message has already been transmitted four times, the mobile station shall perform an abnormal release with access retry.

q_24358.question: What is the purpose of the IEC scenario in the PriceRequest method?
q_24358.ground_truth: The IEC scenario in the PriceRequest method is used when the EBCF (Event Based Charging Function) receives an online charging request for a certain event/service.

q_24359.question: What value of the Request-Status AVP indicates any unspecified temporary errors?

q_24360.question: What is the response time including test tolerance for the RSTD measurement reporting delay for UE Category 1bis in clause 9.2.2A?
q_24360.ground_truth: The response time including test tolerance is 11.3 s for UE Category 1bis in clause 9.2.2A.

q_24361.question: In what means can the SP code group(s) be entered into the ME during the SP personalisation process?
q_24361.ground_truth: The SP code group(s) can be entered into the ME by reading from the SIM/USIM, using the Co-operative Network List (CNL), through keypad entry, or by a manufacturer defined process.

q_24362.question: In the HS-DSCH-Update-Response, what does HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify refer to?
q_24362.ground_truth: It refers to the information used to modify the secondary UE's HS-DSCH resources.

q_24363.question: Which interface is used by the AoC Function to receive RTTI from Auxiliary AoC Function (AACF) and provide AoC Information to the UE?

q_24364.question: What is the MBMS-API and MBMS-URL defined for in the present document?
q_24364.ground_truth: The MBMS-API is an Application Programming Interface between the MBMS Client and the MBMS-Aware application for a specific Application User Service. The MBMS-URL is a Universal Resource Locator that enables a general application to access resources delivered through an MBMS User Service using the MBMS URL handler.

q_24365.question: What is the difference in performance between highly correlated antennas and very low correlated antennas when it comes to processing AWGN?
q_24365.ground_truth: Highly correlated antennas would see the same AWGN signal at each receiver, but very low correlated antennas would expect to see uncorrelated AWGN, which is easier to process. This difference has been measured at around 0.5 dB for typical devices.

q_24366.question: What is the band-limited white noise source adjusted for in step 1 of 8.3.3.4.2.2 and 8.3A.4.2.2.2?
q_24366.ground_truth: The band-limited white noise source is adjusted so that its power spectral density measured at the BS antenna connector takes on the value Ioc.

q_24367.question: What is the purpose of the Information-Element-Data field in a concatenated short message?
q_24367.ground_truth: The Information-Element-Data field in a concatenated short message contains information set by the application in the SMS-SUBMIT that allows the receiving entity to reassemble the short messages in the correct order.

q_24368.question: What is the maximum length of the IA Rest Octets information element?
q_24368.ground_truth: The IA Rest Octets information element is a type 5 information element with 0-11 octets length.

q_24369.question: What are the network elements involved in generating PS domain CDRs for offline charging in the 3GPP PS domain?
q_24369.ground_truth: The network elements involved in generating PS domain CDRs for offline charging in the 3GPP PS domain are SGSN, S-GW, ePDG, TWAG, P-GW, GGSN, MME, and TDF.

q_24370.question: What is the transport layer option required by GERAN for the Iu-cs protocol stack, which is inherited from UMTS specifications?
q_24370.ground_truth: GERAN expects more transport layer options than ATM (3GPP Work Item "IP Transport in UTRAN") for the Iu-cs protocol stack.

q_24371.question: What is the result of the TERMINAL RESPONSE command in the SEND SS 2.1.1AB sequence?
q_24371.ground_truth: The result of the TERMINAL RESPONSE command in the SEND SS 2.1.1AB sequence is "Command performed successfully, but requested icon could not be displayed".

q_24372.question: What is the purpose of the RESource INDication message in the context of channel interference measurement?
q_24372.ground_truth: The RESource INDication message reports the interference level for each of the channels that have been idle for the whole measurement period.

q_24373.question: What is the purpose of the SIP Transfer of Tariff Information XML schema in the 3GPP's TS 183 058 (Release 17) document?
q_24373.ground_truth: The SIP Transfer of Tariff Information XML schema is used to define the MIME type for the Tariff Information, which shall be transported as a SIP MIME body. This schema provides a common format for exchanging tariff information between different network entities.

q_24374.question: What is the significance of the "P-CSCF" in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group's study on improved end-to-end Quality of Service (QoS) handling for Multimedia Telephony Service for IMS (MTSI)?
q_24374.ground_truth: The P-CSCF, acting as a Proxy Call Server Control Function (AF), is responsible for analyzing the SDP offer and answer, and determines the session information and media information that will be allocated. It then instructs the Policy Charging and Rules Function (PCRF) to allocate resources for the Service Data Flow.

q_24375.question: What is the main advantage of using PUCCH offsets for enabling orthogonal PUCCH assignments between HeNB and macro-eNB users?
q_24375.ground_truth: It helps maintain uplink control signaling reliability for both HeNBs and macro-eNBs.

q_24376.question: What occurs when both the UL transport block has been completely transmitted and DL has been successfully decoded early during a TTI?
q_24376.ground_truth: The UE discontinues the transmission of UL DPCCH for the remaining duration of the TTI.

q_24377.question: What information should the UE set in the VarRLF-Report, if the failure is detected due to radio link failure?
q_24377.ground_truth: The UE should set the connectionFailureType to rlf, the rlf-Cause to the trigger for detecting radio link failure and the nrFailedPCellId in failedPCellId to the global cell identity and the tracking area code of the PCell where radio link failure is detected.

q_24378.question: What is the effect of the RulePriority node in ISRP rules?
q_24378.ground_truth: The RulePriority node enables the UE to determine which flow distribution rule, out of potentially several flow distribution rules, contained in every supported flow distribution container of the 'active' ISRP rule, it should apply to an IP flow matching the data traffic description of the multiple flow distribution rules.

q_24379.question: How does the range of phase noise output of multiple LOs vary from a single LO to small sub-arrays driving their own LO?
q_24379.ground_truth: The actual LO-architecture of an antenna array can vary from a single LO driving the whole antenna array up to small sub-arrays each having their own LO. When multiple LOs are considered, the phase noise output of those can have a varying degree of correlation. The LO-structure is an implementation-specific aspect and does not need to be considered in the standard.

q_24380.question: What is the role of BSS (BSS of Company-NB) in the interaction between Company-NA and Company-NB?
q_24380.ground_truth: BSS of Company-NB can use 3GPP management APIs towards its own management system as part of handling requests from Company-NA.

q_24381.question: What is the consequence of the absence of the "AddressType" leaf in an IP flow description?
q_24381.ground_truth: The absence of the "AddressType" leaf indicates that the IP flow described by the rule can have both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

q_24382.question: In which cases are the output of the bit stream writer for each sub-frame for a TCX10 frame written to a temporary buffer, instead of being fed directly to the bit stream?
q_24382.ground_truth: The output of the bit stream writer for each sub-frame for a TCX10 frame is written to a temporary buffer in case of a TCX10 frame, where two sub-frames are coded dependently within one 20ms frame.

q_24383.question: How does the MSGin5G UE originate a message to a non-3GPP UE?
q_24383.ground_truth: The MSGin5G UE sends a message to the non-3GPP UE by initiating a MSGin5G message request to the MSGin5G server and the non-3GPP message gateway translates the MSGin5G message to the non-3GPP message with delivery report requested and sends it to the non-3GPP message client.

q_24384.question: What is the role of the TR editor in the 3GPP Technical Report maintenance process?
q_24384.ground_truth: A single company is responsible for introducing all approved TPs in the current TR, i.e. TR editor. However, it is the responsibility of the contact person of each band/band combination to ensure that the TPs related to the band/band combination have been implemented.

q_24385.question: What is the bit demand calculation based on in the AAC encoder?
q_24385.ground_truth: The bit demand of the current frame in the AAC encoder depends on the current fullness of the bit reservoir and the relative difficulty of the frame, which is measured by the perceptual entropy based on the unmodified psychoacoustic thresholds.

q_24386.question: Can BCS4/BCS5 be used for FR2 intra-band combinations?
q_24386.ground_truth: BCS4/BCS5 are probably not needed for FR2 intra-band combinations as all FR2 combinations only have BCS0 and new channel bandwidth have not been added.

q_24387.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced CDRX scheme in FR1, UL only evaluation, DU, AR UL 1 & 2 streams?
q_24387.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced CDRX scheme in FR1, UL only evaluation, DU, AR UL 1 & 2 streams is 25.56%.

q_24388.question: What is the role of the OAM in assisting an SMF's addition or removal from an SMF set?
q_24388.ground_truth: The OAM plays a crucial role in reporting available UE IP addresses/prefixes, assigning appropriate UE IP addresses/prefixes, and updating IP address pools in both the SMF and the SMF set. The OAM helps avoid disrupting existing IP address pool planning and ensures the continuity of UE IP address/prefix allocation policy.

q_24389.question: What procedure is followed when the network initiates group call abortion or termination?
q_24389.ground_truth: The MS reacts as specified in subclause 6.4 when the network initiates group call abortion or termination.

q_24390.question: Which information element indicates the wait time for Delay Tolerant access request, to be passed to the UE upper layers?
q_24390.ground_truth: The Expiration Time Factor IE (Expiration Time Factor 2) indicates the wait time for Delay Tolerant access request, to be passed to the UE upper layers.

q_24391.question: What is the definition of a successful cross-check for anchor reconstruction verification?
q_24391.ground_truth: A successful cross-check for anchor reconstruction verification is achieved when the same md5 for the anchor sequence is obtained by using a verified anchor bitstream in two different implementations of a reference decoder.

q_24392.question: What addressing information must be replaced when transporting payload messages between networks in the user plane?
q_24392.ground_truth: At the receipt of a payload message, the TrGW shall replace the received destination IP address(es) and port number(s) in the payload message with the corresponding IP address(es) and port number(s) signalled by the IBCF, and replace the received source IP address(es) and port number(s) in the payload message with the corresponding IP address(es) and port number(s) allocated by the TrGW at its own terminations.

q_24393.question: What actions does the AS take when it receives an Identification response INFO request with the originating identity?
q_24393.ground_truth: When the AS receives an Identification response INFO request with the originating identity, it stops the timer T<sub>O-ID</sub>, stores the MCID information, and sends a 180 (Ringing) response towards the originating user.

q_24394.question: In Solution #6, what is the role of SMSF in the key generation and authentication process for the authentication between legacy UE and the MSGin5G server?
q_24394.ground_truth: SMSF acts as the key management function in the key generation and authentication process for the authentication between legacy UE and the MSGin5G server.

q_24395.question: What are the functions of the PDN GW?
q_24395.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides PDN connectivity to both GERAN/UTRAN and E-UTRAN capable UEs. Its functions include per-user based packet filtering, lawful interception, UE IP address allocation, transport level packet marking, uplink and downlink service level charging, DL rate enforcement based on the accumulated MBRs of the aggregate of SDFs with the same GBR QCI, DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 functions, and user plane anchor for mobility between 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

q_24396.question: What is the purpose of the stream identifier (SI) information element in the 3GPP system?
q_24396.ground_truth: The purpose of the stream identifier (SI) information element is to associate a particular call with a Radio Access Bearer (RAB), and to identify whether a new traffic channel is requested for the call.

q_24397.question: What shall the IWF assign when a Diameter message reaches it to set up a new Diameter session?
q_24397.ground_truth: The IWF shall assign an SS7 number for the Diameter node MME/SGSN and shall assign a Diameter identity for the SS7 node HSS.

q_24398.question: What changes are envisaged for the AN/CN connection point?
q_24398.ground_truth: Two changes are envisaged: introducing a new SAP type and creating a mapping example between the two communication segments.

q_24399.question: What is not permitted in scheduling new transmissions in MAC-hs?
q_24399.ground_truth: Scheduling new transmissions, including retransmissions originating in the RLC layer, within the same TTI, along with retransmissions originating from the HARQ layer.

q_24400.question: What is the consequence of using non-standardized DSCP values in the operator's transport network?
q_24400.ground_truth: Using DSCP values with no standardized meaning in IETF may interfere with appropriate traffic handling in the operator's transport network and may also get remarked by routing entities within the operator's networks, which may result in unintended QoS and charging for the traffic.

q_24401.question: How can the V2X authorization update procedure be initiated?
q_24401.ground_truth: The V2X authorization update procedure can be initiated by the V2X control function sending a notification requesting the UE to initiate server-initiated provisioning of the management object specified in 3GPP TS 24.385 to the UE.

q_24402.question: What message is sent to the MS when the default call handling is release, due to the default Call Handling parameter being release in the relevant CSI?
q_24402.ground_truth: A BYE indication is sent to the MS in this case.

q_24403.question: What message is sent by RNS-A to 3G-MSC-A to initiate the handover procedure?

q_24404.question: What is the size of the input blocks of speech samples in the AMR-WB speech codec?
q_24404.ground_truth: The input blocks of speech samples are of size 320 samples.

q_24405.question: What should be done when the "Multiple E-UTRA frequency info list" is present in the "E-UTRA frequency and priority"?
q_24405.ground_truth: When the "Multiple E-UTRA frequency info list" is present in the "E-UTRA frequency and priority", the UE should create a new entry in the "IE "Frequency Info List"" and store the IEs "EARFCN", "Measurement bandwidth", and the exclude-listed cells information in that new entry.

q_24406.question: What is required when using the Multimedia Conference function to record the messaging media stream?
q_24406.ground_truth: The MRFC may request the MRFP to filter the message of the recipient, and the MRFP shall utilize the Message Session Relay Protocol (MSRP) to transport messages carrying different media. The media types shall be MIME encoded.

q_24407.question: What is the standard for which the baseband interface is specified in GSM technical specification 05.05?
q_24407.ground_truth: The baseband interface is specified in GSM technical specification 05.05, which is part of the technical specifications for the Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM).

q_24408.question: What is the method used to transmit data in the MBMS Streaming Delivery Method?
q_24408.ground_truth: Data is transmitted continuously and immediately played out via the display and/or loudspeaker in the MBMS Streaming Delivery Method.

q_24409.question: What should be done when the candidate number of MCPTT group IDs is bigger than the N2 value of the served MCPTT ID?
q_24409.ground_truth: The IWF should reduce the candidate MCPTT group IDs to that equal to N2 based on service provider policy.

q_24410.question: What identification information is used to indicate dynamic identity information such as who is an active speaker?
q_24410.ground_truth: Participant identification relates to a media level identification that is traceable end-to-end from media sender, across the conference focus, all the way to the media receiver. It is further assumed that the conference focus has information about what media streams are switched to different participants, including switching criteria that are used, such as active speaker.

q_24411.question: When sending the SGSN Context Acknowledge message, which Cause value indicates that the request has been accepted?
q_24411.ground_truth: The Cause value "Request accepted" in the SGSN Context Acknowledge message indicates that the request has been accepted.

q_24412.question: What should the UE do if the inter-RAT cell reselection fails before the UE has initiated the RRC connection establishment?
q_24412.ground_truth: The UE may return back to the other radio access technology.

q_24413.question: What is the requirement for resuming a suspended RRC connection triggered by upper layers?
q_24413.ground_truth: The UE shall perform the unified access control procedure, and if the access attempt is barred, the procedure ends. If the resumption occurs after release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication, the resumeCause is set to mps-PriorityAccess.

q_24414.question: What is the format of the Protocol identifier and Protocol version number in the first octet of the I1 message common part?
q_24414.ground_truth: The Protocol identifier is "0001" and the Protocol version number is "0001", indicating that the message is an I1 protocol message and this is the first version of the specification.

q_24415.question: What is the role of SEPP in the communication via NRFs in the 5GC aligned SNPN architecture?
q_24415.ground_truth: The communication above via NRFs may happen via SEPP, providing a secure means of communication between NRF in SNPN and NRF in SP NW.

q_24416.question: In which LTE mode, the data to be transported are represented in terms of sets of resource units?
q_24416.ground_truth: In LTE TDD mode, the data to be transported are represented in terms of sets of resource units.

q_24417.question: What action does the AMF take if it receives a Supported NSSAI from the NG-RAN containing incompatible S-NSSAIs with respect to the UE capabilities?
q_24417.ground_truth: The AMF modifies the Allowed NSSAI as needed, and indicates to the SMF(s) which PDU Session ID(s) corresponding to the incompatible S-NSSAIs should be released.

q_24418.question: What does the mobile station do when T3220 expires while waiting for a PACKET PAGING REQUEST message containing an MBMS notification part?
q_24418.ground_truth: When T3220 expires, the mobile station discards the MBMS-related information stored upon receipt of the corresponding PACKET MBMS ANNOUNCEMENT message and returns to DRX mode if it is not already engaged in any other MBMS session.

q_24419.question: What is the equation used to limit the adaptive codebook gain search range in quantization?
q_24419.ground_truth: The adaptive codebook gain search range is limited to values less than the limited adaptive codebook gain in the quantization search.

q_24420.question: In the context of FDD, what values should the Node B use for non cell specific Radio Link related parameters and non cell specific E-DPCH, UL DPCH, E-DCH, and F-DPCH parameters on the secondary uplink frequency?
q_24420.ground_truth: The Node B should use the same values as for the corresponding cell of the Primary uplink frequency.

q_24421.question: What should the MAC entity do if the Random Access Preamble was selected among the contention-based preambles?
q_24421.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select a PUSCH occasion corresponding to the selected preamble and PRACH occasion, determine the UL grant for the MSGA payload and associated HARQ information, and if the selected preamble and PRACH occasion is mapped to a valid PUSCH occasion, deliver the UL grant and associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity.

q_24422.question: What information is sent by the MGW when the "CTM report" procedure is initiated?
q_24422.ground_truth: The MGW sends a NOT.req command with the necessary information.

q_24423.question: What is the Occurrence value for the node named "GeographicalArea"?
q_24423.ground_truth: The Occurrence is One, meaning this node is required to exist exactly once.

q_24424.question: What should the UE do when the timer T3526 associated with a specific rejected S-NSSAI due to maximum number of UEs reached expires?
q_24424.ground_truth: The UE shall remove the S-NSSAI from the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached.

q_24425.question: What is the role of the SMF+PGW-C in the process of UAV and networked UAV controller pairing?
q_24425.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C verifies the authorization of UAV and networked UAV controller pairing, and performs flight path authorization/registration for flight.

q_24426.question: What information does the UE include in the MO-LR Invoke message when requesting periodic transfer of location to a third party LCS client?
q_24426.ground_truth: The UE includes the periodic location related parameters (reporting interval and total number of reports), the identity of the LCS client, the address of the GMLC if available, and a request for use of MO-LR Short Circuit if the UE supports UE based positioning.

q_24427.question: What is the issue that overlays cause to viewport-dependent streaming?
q_24427.ground_truth: The issue is that when an overlay with different content is sticked on top of (part of) the viewport, the content behind the overlay does not need to be sent at higher quality. This allows saving bandwidth or increasing the quality in the viewport for the non-overlaid parts.

q_24428.question: What is the potential impact of a PWS Security circumvention attack?
q_24428.ground_truth: A PWS Security circumvention attack can be used by an attacker to create panic or significant damage by sending false warning messages via a false BS to a sufficiently large number of users.

q_24429.question: What is the role of the P-CSCF in routing IMS traffic via a localized UPF?
q_24429.ground_truth: The P-CSCF selects an IMS-AGW or an IMS-AGW list based on the UE's location and requested services and sends AAR with policies to influence the SMF to select a UPF which is closer to the IMS-AGW and the UE.

q_24430.question: What is the effect of the MNRG flag on the SGSN?
q_24430.ground_truth: The MNRG flag on the SGSN remains set independently of whether the MSC/VLR was successful in delivering the SM or not. In certain cases, this can cause a small amount of duplicate signalling between the SGSN and the HLR/HSS.

q_24431.question: What is the role of the Operators and Vendors in using the FNIM?
q_24431.ground_truth: Operators may use the whole or part of the FNIM depending on their own business cases, while Vendors can supply products using part of the FNIM depending on their own business cases.

q_24432.question: How does a UE switch from multicast to unicast bearer when moving out of the multicast service area?
q_24432.ground_truth: A UE can switch from multicast to unicast bearer by initiating unicast bearer establishment when detecting it's moving out of the multicast service area based on multicast channel signal quality or MBS service availability information in neighboring cells. The UE indicates the multicast service information to be stopped to the AS layer, which then initiates the PDU session establishment through the NAS layer. After the AN resource is established for the PDU session, the UE stops receiving multicast service via the multicast channel. The network may then perform handover procedures if the UE moves to a cell not supporting multicast service.

q_24433.question: What is the purpose of the Open Platform in relation to 3GPP TS 33.234?
q_24433.ground_truth: The Open Platform is a trusted platform that must have secure authentication and authorization mechanisms to protect against eavesdropping, malicious modification of sensitive data, and operator applications residing on the Open Platform.

q_24434.question: What message is considered as failed to be written in a cell if an emergency message broadcast is already ongoing?
q_24434.ground_truth: A write request is considered as failed if it is received for a cell where an emergency message broadcast is currently ongoing.

q_24435.question: What should the UE do when the neighbor NR cell becomes offset better than the serving?
q_24435.ground_truth: Upon this condition, the UE sends the MeasurementReport for event A3.

q_24436.question: When is the MCS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE used to determine if access identity 2 is valid?
q_24436.ground_truth: When the UE is not in the country of its HPLMN prior to receiving the MCS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message being set to "Access identity 2 valid in RPLMN or equivalent PLMN".

q_24437.question: What functions does the DVB-MABR logical reference architecture include?
q_24437.ground_truth: The DVB-MABR logical reference architecture includes logical functions of the system such as a Multicast server function responsible for ingesting media objects and a population of Multicast gateway functions that consume the multicast transport sessions.

q_24438.question: What function is used to determine the ZOAs in the LOS case?
q_24438.ground_truth: In the LOS case, the ZOAs are determined by applying the inverse Laplacian function (7.5-14) with input parameters Pn and RMS angle spread ZSA.

q_24439.question: What is the purpose of the NWDAFdsf (Network Data Analytics Fapability with Data Storage Function) in the mitigation of the load for data collection solution?
q_24439.ground_truth: The NWDAFdsf is introduced to support data collection from 5GC NFs, cache the collected data, and expose the cached data to authorized NWDAF instances. This way, signalling load for the same data collection can be mitigated.

q_24440.question: What details would the IWF include in the SIP re-INVITE request if an emergency alert needs to be cancelled by a user other than its originator?
q_24440.ground_truth: If an MCPTT emergency alert is cancelled by a user other than its originator, the IWF would include an "<originated-by>" element set to the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user who originated the MCPTT emergency alert. This is to identify which MCPTT emergency alert is being cancelled, as multiple MCPTT users could have originated emergency alerts to the same group.

q_24441.question: In the context of the document, what does "SECAM" stand for?

q_24442.question: In what condition should a UE attempt to receive notifications on one of the frequencies for which the IE "All MBSFN services notified" is included?
q_24442.ground_truth: When at least one frequency is listed for which "MBSFN services not notified" is indicated in the IE "MBSFN inter frequency neighbour list" and the UE supports reception in MBSFN mode on that band.

q_24443.question: What is the required range for the input variable 'ttyCode' in the function 'convertTTYcode2char'?
q_24443.ground_truth: The input variable 'ttyCode' in the function 'convertTTYcode2char' must be within the range 0 to 63.

q_24444.question: What is the format of the URL used in the "3GPP-Asset-Information" attribute?
q_24444.ground_truth: The URL used in the "3GPP-Asset-Information" attribute is as defined in RFC 4566.

q_24445.question: What entity identifies SDES keys when Session Description Protocol (SDP) Security Descriptions for Media Streams is used in ICE?
q_24445.ground_truth: The DF2 shall identify the SDES keys from the SDP offer and SDP answer messages and provide the DF3 with the necessary SDES related parameters.

q_24446.question: What should MSC-A do if MSC-B indicates that either the assignment or Handover Number allocation cannot be completed in the MAP-PREPARE-HANDOVER response?
q_24446.ground_truth: MSC-A shall terminate the circuit establishment attempt and maintain the existing connection to the UE/MS, if possible.

q_24447.question: What action should the RNC take when all RABs included in the RABs Setup List IE in the ENHANCED RELOCATION COMPLETE REQUEST message are successfully established in the target RNC?
q_24447.ground_truth: The RNC includes the Transport Layer Address IE and the Iu Transport Association IE in the RABs Setup List IE in the ENHANCED RELOCATION COMPLETE REQUEST message.

q_24448.question: What information does the E-DCH Non-scheduled Grant Information return when determining any non-scheduled resource to be granted for the radio link?
q_24448.ground_truth: The E-DCH Non-scheduled Grant Information returns the non-scheduled resource to be granted for the radio link in the E-DCH Information Response IE for the respective Mcps rate.

q_24449.question: What is the procedure for terminating a multimedia IMS session to a CSI UE?
q_24449.ground_truth: UE 2 initiates the multimedia session for voice and MSRP by sending an INVITE message towards UE 1, which triggers the S-CSCF2 of the originating network to send the INVITE message for the voice and MSRP to the S-CSCF1 of the terminating network. The S-CSCF1 of the terminating network then sends the INVITE message for the voice and MSRP to the CSI AS, which ultimately sends the message to UE 1. This procedure follows the normal IMS procedure for IMS/CS interworking, but has been simplified for clarity by omitting some entities.

q_24450.question: How does the Entry Point concept help in network management?
q_24450.ground_truth: The Entry Point concept allows the NM to discover the outline information of IRPs, including the DN of IRPs, the supported IRPVersions, and their scope of management in the managed systems. It also allows the NM to obtain the References of the IRPs of a specific IRPVersion by inputting the DN of the IRP which supports the IRPVersion number it needs.

q_24451.question: What is not required for no checking in the NO MORE field in the STATUS PDU?
q_24451.ground_truth: The NO MORE field in the STATUS PDU does not require any checking.

q_24452.question: How can multi-hop relays improve coverage in 5G systems?
q_24452.ground_truth: Multi-hop relays can improve the coverage of the 5G system with good energy efficiency, by helping to relay messages between remote UEs and gNBs.

q_24453.question: What is the mechanism specified in the 3GPP TS 32.33x-series for managing Notification Logs in telecommunications management?
q_24453.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 32.33x-series specifies a standard general-purpose mechanism for the management of Notification Logs containing selected or all notifications from the network for historical analysis on faults and conditions in the network.

q_24454.question: What is the role of the FF Application Server (AS) in the FF application layer functional model?
q_24454.ground_truth: The FF Application Server (AS) consists of the FAE server and the FF application specific server(s), providing the FF application layer support functions to the FF application specific server(s) via FAE-S reference point.

q_24455.question: Which UE categories does the intra-frequency RSTD Measurement Reporting Delay in CE Mode A test apply to?
q_24455.ground_truth: The intra-frequency RSTD Measurement Reporting Delay in CE Mode A test applies to UE categories M1 and M2.

q_24456.question: What are the exceptions allowed for the micro and pico-BTS in the combined range 600 kHz to 6 MHz above and below the carrier frequency?
q_24456.ground_truth: In the combined range 600 kHz to 6 MHz above and below the carrier frequency, in up to three bands of 200 kHz width centered on a frequency which is an integer multiple of 200 kHz, exceptions at up to -36 dBm are allowed for the micro and pico-BTS.

q_24457.question: What is the frequency range for the new 5G band defined in 3GPP Release 17?
q_24457.ground_truth: The frequency range for the new 5G band defined in 3GPP Release 17 is 47.2 - 48.2 GHz.

q_24458.question: How does either station initiate a wake-up from the reduced power state?
q_24458.ground_truth: Either station may initiate a wake-up from the reduced power state by the transmission of the wake-up signal which consists of continuous flag characters.

q_24459.question: What are the system information blocks that can be broadcasted in a MBSFN cluster?
q_24459.ground_truth: In a MBSFN cluster, the system information blocks that can be broadcasted are MIB, system information blocks 3, 5/5bis, and 11.

q_24460.question: What SDP attribute is used to signal the 3GPP MTSI client's support for this RTCP feedback message?
q_24460.ground_truth: The a=rtcp-fb attribute in conjunction with the 3gpp-delay-budget parameter is used to signal the 3GPP MTSI client's support for this RTCP feedback message.

q_24461.question: What should the SGSN do upon receipt of a HLR reset indication from the HLR?
q_24461.ground_truth: The SGSN shall set the NGAF for all registered MSs in the SGSN for which a valid MSC/VLR-association exists and report to the VLR if there is any activity from the MS.

q_24462.question: What is the minimum downlink rate on DPCH for the combination described in 7.4.5a?

q_24463.question: What are the typical sizes of most containers used in supply chains?
q_24463.ground_truth: The typical sizes of most containers are either 20 feet (6,058 m) or 40 feet (12,192 m) long, with a width of 8' (2,438 m) and a height of 8'6" (2,591 m).

q_24464.question: What does the abbreviation "CA" stand for in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?

q_24465.question: In the absence of an "Absolute Grant" and the last SG update being due to a Primary Absolute Grant, what shall the UE calculate its new SG by applying?
q_24465.ground_truth: A Delta compared with its last used power ratio.

q_24466.question: What is the role of a Network Element Manager (EM) and a Network Manager (NM) in the 3GPP series?
q_24466.ground_truth: A Network Element Manager (EM) provides a set of end-user functions for the management of a set of closely related types of Network Elements (NEs), while a Network Manager (NM) provides a package of end-user functions with the responsibility for managing a network, mainly through EM(s) but also through direct access to NEs. The communication between the network and the NM is based on open and well-standardized interfaces, supporting the management of multi-vendor and multi-technology NEs.

q_24467.question: What is the procedure where a mobile station uses to derive the timing advance value for uplink transmission?
q_24467.ground_truth: The mobile station uses the continuous timing advance update procedure to derive the timing advance value for uplink transmission. This procedure is carried out on the PTCCH assigned to the mobile station.

q_24468.question: What action does the new SGSN take when it triggers the release of resources in the target cell during a PS handover?
q_24468.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends an Iu Release Command message to the target RNC, which then releases all resources allocated for the handover.

q_24469.question: What is the purpose of the CDIV services?
q_24469.ground_truth: The CDIV services allow for the redirection of incoming communications to another user based on different conditions, such as unconditional forwarding, forwarding on a busy line, or forwarding if there is no reply.

q_24470.question: What is the requirement of the service provider in Use Case C?
q_24470.ground_truth: The service provider requires the ability to dynamically change encryption keys and introduce new keys, over the duration of a program transmission, as well as the ability to carry time-varying encryption keys inband with the live program delivery.

q_24471.question: What happens on the CTS-FP side when the main signalling link is disconnected in the channel release procedure?
q_24471.ground_truth: When the main signalling link is disconnected on the CTS-FP side, timer TC3107 is started. When it times out, the CTS-FP deactivates the channels. If timer TC3106 times out, the CTS-FP also deactivates the channels.

q_24472.question: What message does the IM-GSN send to the GLR when it needs to request for routeing information for GPRS?
q_24472.ground_truth: The IM-GSN sends a 'Send Routeing Information for GPRS (IMSI)' message to the GLR.

q_24473.question: How is the total number of REs for PUSCH determined in the scenario when the UE is scheduled to transmit a transport block on PUSCH by a DCI and transform precoding is disabled?
q_24473.ground_truth: By multiplying the number of REs within the slot by the number of RBs assigned to the UE for the PUSCH transmission.

q_24474.question: What is the drawback of using a wideband transmitter with a limited carrier separation in terms of frequency planning?
q_24474.ground_truth: The drawback is that it can have a negative impact on the frequency diversity in the case of inter-carrier interleaving, due to the reduced carrier separation.

q_24475.question: What should the 5G system be able to support for open standard based broadcast workflows?
q_24475.ground_truth: PR 5.6.6-010, PR 5.7.6-003, PR 5.7.6-005 (combined requirement from multiple use cases)

q_24476.question: What is the format of the UE-Measurement-Forwarding-ExtIEs NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION structure?
q_24476.ground_truth: The UE-Measurement-Forwarding-ExtIEs NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION structure is a sequence of at least one item, where each item is a set of extensions to the UE-Measurement-Forwarding-ExtIEs NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION structure.

q_24477.question: What does the Location Exclude List indicator information element indicate?
q_24477.ground_truth: The Location Exclude List indicator information element is used to indicate which part of the Location Area Identification is to be added in the Location Exclude List.

q_24478.question: What is the difference in speech intelligibility between EVS-SWB and AMR-WB under the same bearer conditions?
q_24478.ground_truth: EVS-SWB offers significant speech intelligibility improvements over AMR-WB under the same bearer conditions.

q_24479.question: What should be used on RACH for handling the packet channel requests received than can be served?
q_24479.ground_truth: Packet Queuing Notification shall be transmitted to the sender of the Packet Channel Request

q_24480.question: What type of IP-CAN is associated with any kind of Fixed Broadband Network access convergence via the IP Edge?

q_24481.question: What should the PDN GW do if it initiates the PDN GW Initiated Resource Allocation Deactivation procedure and supports the P-CSCF restoration procedure over WLAN access?
q_24481.ground_truth: The PGW should include the 3GPP Specific PMIPv6 error code IE and set it to the cause "Reactivation requested" in the LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion procedure.

q_24482.question: What action should the MS take when it receives a message that is too short to contain a complete message header and all mandatory information elements?
q_24482.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the message.

q_24483.question: Which reference point enables transport of service data flow based offline charging information?
q_24483.ground_truth: The Gz reference point allows transport of service data flow based offline charging information from the PCEF to the OFCS.

q_24484.question: What is the objective of enhancing Radio Access Network (RAN) slicing for NR in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group RAN study?
q_24484.ground_truth: The objective is to enable fast access to the cell supporting the intended slice and to support service continuity.

q_24485.question: Which Solution Set definitions are defined in the specification?
q_24485.ground_truth: The 3GPP Generic IRP management CORBA SS and 3GPP Generic IRP management SOAP Solution Set.

q_24486.question: What is the benefit of using Incremental Redundancy in EGPRS and Turbo coded logical channels?
q_24486.ground_truth: It provides more accurate throughput simulation for EGPRS and Turbo coded logical channels.

q_24487.question: What is the purpose of the "Cells-Status-Item" in the Cells-Status-List object?
q_24487.ground_truth: The "Cells-Status-Item" is used to communicate the status of a particular cell in the list of cells for which a status change has been requested. The status could be "Add", "Modify" or "Deactivate".

q_24488.question: What is the minimum requirement for Pico BTS in terms of maximum power measured at step b)?
q_24488.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for Pico BTS in terms of maximum power measured at step b) is -62 dBm.

q_24489.question: What actions does the BCC entity in the MS take when it receives a TERMINATION REJECT message and is in the U5 state?
q_24489.ground_truth: When the BCC entity in the MS receives a TERMINATION REJECT message and is in the U5 state, it informs higher layers and stops Tterm.

q_24490.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 link establishment procedure with L3 UE-to-Network relay in this solution?
q_24490.ground_truth: The PC5 link establishment procedure with L3 UE-to-Network relay is used to establish a secure link between a Remote UE and a network for the purpose of performing a PDU Session with secondary A&A using an existing PDU session that requires secondary authentication.

q_24491.question: What is the difference between the three versions of the first digit in the 3GPP document versioning system?
q_24491.ground_truth: The first digit's versioning in the 3GPP document indicates if the document is presented for information, presented for approval, or is a TSG approved document under change control.

q_24492.question: What must the business trunking application do when it receives a terminating request for an NGCN?
q_24492.ground_truth: The business trunking application shall identify the particular NGCN the enterprise user belongs to, and also the P-CSCF(s) or IBCF(s), respectively serving the NGCN, and shall forward the request towards the NGCN. Therefore, the business trunking application shall create a route to the NGCN by adding a SIP URI of the P-CSCF or IBCF, respectively serving the NGCN and the NGCN in a Route header field as bottommost entries.

q_24493.question: What is the average difference in MOS values for S-MOS, N-MOS and G-MOS when using the ES 202 396-1 noise field simulation with binaural noises from TS 103 224 in NB mode?
q_24493.ground_truth: The average difference is about 0.3 to 0.4 MOS.

q_24494.question: What should the CRNC do if the Reset Indicator IE is set to "Node B" in the RESET REQUEST message from the Node B?
q_24494.ground_truth: The CRNC shall remove the information related to this Node B and all the radio resources allocated in the CRNC. The CRNC shall also initiate release of the user plane transport bearers towards the Node B involved in the CRNC Communication Contexts related to this Node B. After clearing all related resources, the CRNC shall return the RESET RESPONSE message to the Node B.

q_24495.question: What is the purpose of the "a=rtcp-fb" line with a "pause" CCM parameter in the SDP offer/answer?
q_24495.ground_truth: The "a=rtcp-fb" line with a "pause" CCM parameter in the SDP offer/answer is used to indicate to the MRFP which RTCP feedback "CCM PAUSE-RESUME" messages it may send to the conference participant and to indicate the full "RTP-level pause and resume" functionality that will be offered.

q_24496.question: In the process of encoding 5 pulses in a section, how are the 3 pulses in that section encoded?
q_24496.ground_truth: The 3 pulses in that section are encoded using 3(M-1)+1 bits in each section.

q_24497.question: What is the role of the Bootstrapping Server Function (BSF) in the MBMS security architecture?
q_24497.ground_truth: The BSF is a part of GBA, responsible for establishing shared keys between the UE and the BM-SC, which in turn are used to protect the point-to-point communication between the UE and the BM-SC.

q_24498.question: What record is generated by MSC-A for both the A -> B and A -> C legs of the conference in the described scenario?
q_24498.ground_truth: The MOC records produced by MSC-A for both the A -> B and A -> C legs of the conference shall contain the supplementary service code for multi-party in the described scenario.

q_24499.question: What is the purpose of the UTRAN Cell Identifier List and UTRAN Received Signal Level List information elements?
q_24499.ground_truth: The UTRAN Cell Identifier List and UTRAN Received Signal Level List information elements are used to rank UTRAN cells in descending order of received signal level when requesting handover to a UTRAN cell.

q_24500.question: What does the UDM do when it receives a Send Routing Info for SM request from SMS-SC or SMS GMSC?
q_24500.ground_truth: The UDM retrieves the SMSF address from 5GS UDR and forwards the MAP Send Routing Info for SM request to HSS FE to query more routing addresses for MT SMS.

q_24501.question: What is the variable Pn representing in the context of TUTRAN-GPS measurements?
q_24501.ground_truth: Pn is the predicted TUTRAN-GPS value when n measurement results have been received after the first Common Measurement Reporting at initiation or after the last event was triggered.

q_24502.question: In the context of FDD, what should the Node B do if the Serving Cell Change CFN IE is not included in the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message?
q_24502.ground_truth: The Node B shall activate immediately the resources that are allocated for the new serving E-DCH Radio Link.

q_24503.question: How many spare bit locations does the E-HICH contain?
q_24503.ground_truth: The E-HICH contains 8 spare bit locations.

q_24504.question: What is the impact of the PLMN environment on the T.30 protocol procedure?
q_24504.ground_truth: In the PLMN environment, some additional protection is necessary in the T.30 protocol procedure to ensure a correct change-over from one modem type to another, especially during two consecutive segments that require different transmission speeds without any interposed acknowledgement.

q_24505.question: What is the function of the up-sampling module in the SHVC two-layer spatial scalability encoder architecture?
q_24505.ground_truth: The up-sampling module maps reconstructed sample values from the base layer to the higher-resolution sampling grid of the enhancement layer, allowing the use of the reconstructed base layer sample values for enhancement layer prediction.

q_24506.question: Which network component is responsible for forwarding received content for unicast delivery to appropriate functions in the context of the xMB reference point?
q_24506.ground_truth: The BM-SC may forward the received content for unicast delivery to appropriate functions (e.g., MBMS user service fallback) in the network.

q_24507.question: What are the conditions for being able to apply the pattern multiplication method for TRP estimation?
q_24507.ground_truth: The conditions for being able to apply the pattern multiplication method for TRP estimation include the vertical cut (and the main beam) being in the xz-plane, the frequency of the emission being within the downlink operating band, the bandwidth of the emission being the same as the bandwidth of the in-band modulated signal, the emission appearing/disappearing when the TX power is turned on/off, and the antenna arrays of the BS having rectangular grids of antenna element positions, symmetry planes that are vertical and horizontal, and parallel antenna planes.

q_24508.question: What is required for an FRMCS User to initiate a video conference?
q_24508.ground_truth: An FRMCS User can initiate a video conference if they are an authorized user, and there is a bearer service established by the FRMCS System for the video conference.

q_24509.question: What are the post-conditions of a successful video conference?
q_24509.ground_truth: The post-conditions of a successful video conference are that real-time video (synchronized video and audio information) can be transmitted and received among authorized FRMCS Users involved in the ongoing video conference.

q_24510.question: What should be included in the User-Agent request header field when making requests to an HTTP endpoint in the present document?
q_24510.ground_truth: The User-Agent request header field should include a product identifier indicating the type of client function making the request in its token element, and an optional product-version suffix indicating the version number of the present document with which the client implementation complies.

q_24511.question: What is the role of the HSS/AuC in the synchronization failure mechanism described in subsection 6.3.5?
q_24511.ground_truth: The HSS/AuC acts as a mediator in the synchronization failure mechanism described in subsection 6.3.5 by retrieving the SQNMS from the USIM, verifying AUTS, resetting the SQNHE to SQNMS, and sending a new batch of authentication vectors to the VLR/SGSN.

q_24512.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the 3GPP system - fixed broadband access network interworking?
q_24512.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing technical specifications for the 3GPP system, including its interworking with fixed broadband access networks.

q_24513.question: What is the role of RTP / RTCP in a TP UE in relation to CLUE?
q_24513.ground_truth: No media handling requirements and recommendations have been specified in TS 24.103 for a TP UE regarding the usage of RTP / RTCP in relation to negotiation and establishment of the CLUE data channel.

q_24514.question: What variable is used to store the value of the received IE "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" when the UE supports RSRQ measurement on all OFDM symbols and the "QqualminRSRQ-OnAllSymbols" is present?

q_24515.question: What action does the TRAU take when it receives the first uplink frame for a FR or EFR speech or data call?
q_24515.ground_truth: The TRAU sets the mode of operation accordingly and sends downlink frames with the set "Frame Type" and intermediate rate adaption bit rate as an acknowledgement indication.

q_24516.question: How can the Edge Application Server request specific QoS from the 3GPP network?
q_24516.ground_truth: The Edge Application Server can request specific QoS from the 3GPP network by using the Nnef_AFsessionWithQoS_Create service operation and Nnef_AFsessionWithQoS_Notify service operation in TS23.502.

q_24517.question: What is the number of redundancy versions in ARQ_MAX?

q_24518.question: What fields are included in the MAC header for SHCCH mapped to RACH and USCH/FACH and DSCH in the case where SHCCH is the only channel?
q_24518.ground_truth: The TCTF field is included in the MAC header for SHCCH in this case.

q_24519.question: What is the function of an application server in the context of 6.2.2?
q_24519.ground_truth: An application server may be included for a CSI call, but it is not assigned any specific CSI role.

q_24520.question: What is the requirement when reusing a 3GPP segment from an existing NPN?
q_24520.ground_truth: To reuse a 3GPP segment from an existing NPN, the requested NPN and the existing NPN must be able to share with each other.

q_24521.question: What is the dominant factor for NB-IoT operation when considering SINR degradation in the co-existence study?
q_24521.ground_truth: The UE ACLR is the dominant factor for NB-IoT operation when considering SINR degradation in the co-existence study.

q_24522.question: What is the method to perform the HARQ bit collection in the case of HS-DSCH?
q_24522.ground_truth: The HARQ bit collection is done using a rectangular interleaver, which is determined based on the number of rows and columns, which varies depending on the modulation mode used. Sequential Write operation is used to read values column by column, and transmitted systematic bits are written row by row. The remaining space is filled with parity bits written column-wise and in alternating order.

q_24523.question: What are the parameters used in E-DCH Scheduling Information in the standard?
q_24523.ground_truth: The E-DCH Scheduling Information parameters include: Logical channels for which Scheduling Information is expected to be reported by the UE, Logical channel identity of logical channels mapped to E-DCH, Period for sending Scheduling Information (applicable when UE is not allowed to transmit scheduled data), Period for sending Scheduling Information (applicable when UE is allowed to transmit scheduled data), and for FDD, power offset to use when sending Scheduling Information alone.

q_24524.question: What is the purpose of the User Data Convergence (UDC) in the 3GPP system?
q_24524.ground_truth: The User Data Convergence (UDC) in the 3GPP system supports a layered architecture, separating the data from the application logic, and stores user data in a logically unique repository allowing access from core and service layer entities, named application front-ends.

q_24525.question: What is the primary goal of the flow control procedure?
q_24525.ground_truth: The flow control procedure is used to regulate traffic flow for TRX processor overload, downlink CCCH overload, and ACCH overload.

q_24526.question: What information element of the PDU Notification Request message contains the PDP type and PDP address that the SGSN shall request the MS to activate?
q_24526.ground_truth: The End User Address information element.

q_24527.question: What should the MS do if the TCD timer expires?
q_24527.ground_truth: If the TCD timer expires, the MS shall assume that the call deflection request has failed, locally release the invokeID, inform the user of the failure and continue call clearing as defined in 3GPP TS 24.008.

q_24528.question: What should be passed to higher layers (MAC) as L1 status if a positive acquisition indicator on AICH is detected in the downlink access slot corresponding to the selected uplink access slot?
q_24528.ground_truth: Pass L1 status (''Ack on AICH received'') with the default E-DCH resource index corresponding to the selected signature.

q_24529.question: What action does the gsmSSF take if it encounters a TDP and call gapping hasn't been initiated for the same gsmSCF or for any call gapping without a provided gsmSCFAddress?
q_24529.ground_truth: The gsmSSF may send an "InitialDP" operation.

q_24530.question: Which ID has a criticality value of "reject" and a presence indicator of "mandatory" in the MBMSSessionStartRequest-IEs?
q_24530.ground_truth: id-MME-MBMS-M3AP-ID, id-TMGI, id-MBMS-E-RAB-QoS-Parameters, id-MBMS-Session-Duration, id-MBMS-Service-Area, id-MinimumTimeToMBMSDataTransfer, and id-MBMS-Cell-List have a criticality value of "reject" and a presence indicator of "mandatory" in the MBMSSessionStartRequest-IEs.

q_24531.question: What message does the SGSN send to the MS to confirm the re-allocation of the new P-TMSI?
q_24531.ground_truth: Routing Area Update Accept (P-TMSI, TMSI, P-TMSI signature, Receive N-PDU number) message

q_24532.question: When does the S-GW include the current values for HeNB local IP address and UDP port number in a Modify Bearer Request over S5/S8?
q_24532.ground_truth: The S-GW includes the current values for HeNB local IP address and UDP port if the UE is accessing the network from a HeNB for any other reason not listed in the procedure.

q_24533.question: When is the Match Report procedure skipped in step 5?
q_24533.ground_truth: The Match Report procedure is skipped in step 5 when the Target RPAUID, corresponding to the ProSe Restricted Code in the Discovery Filter, is included in the Discovery Response message.

q_24534.question: Which protocol element is optional in "DSCH-InformationResponseList-RL-AdditionRspTDD-RL-AdditionRspTDD" sequence?

q_24535.question: What does DCCF send to NRF after verifying that the NF Service Consumer is authorized to access its services?
q_24535.ground_truth: An access token request containing information to identify the target NFs, source NF, and CCA provided by the NF Service Consumer

q_24536.question: In the context of FDD, what should the Node B do if the DL Reference Power IE, the E-AGCH Power Offset IE, the E-RGCH PowerOffset IE, and/or the E-HICH Power Offset IE are present in the Multicell E-DCH RL Specific Information IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Add IE, or if the DL Reference Power IE, the Primary CPICH Usage For Channel Estimation IE, the Secondary CPICH Information Change IE, the E-AGCH Power Offset IE, the E-RGCH Power Offset IE, the E-HICH Power Offset IE and/or the E-DCH DL Control Channel Grant IE are present in the Multicell E-DCH RL Specific Information IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Modify IE?
q_24536.ground_truth: The Node B should use the information the same way as in the information is used on the Primary uplink frequency.

q_24537.question: What should be added to the MCData client ID list in the served MCData user information entry?
q_24537.ground_truth: The MCData client ID derived from the received SIP request, if it is not already present.

q_24538.question: What should the SCC AS take into account when determining the g.3gpp.accesstype media feature tag values to use in the SIP INVITE request?
q_24538.ground_truth: The SCC AS should take into account the access-type, access-class of the P-Access-Network-Info header field and the value of the g.3gpp.accesstype media feature tag to determine the IP-CAN to use.

q_24539.question: What are the conformance requirements specified for this test case?
q_24539.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for this test case are specified in TS 38.214 clauses 6.1.2.1 and 6.1.4, and TS 38.321 clauses 5.4.1, 5.4.2.1 and 5.4.2.2, and are applicable as Rel-17 requirements.

q_24540.question: What is the maximum number of TimeSlots that can be specified in the TimeslotInfo-CellSyncInitiationRqstTDD field?
q_24540.ground_truth: The maximum number of TimeSlots that can be specified in the TimeslotInfo-CellSyncInitiationRqstTDD field is 15.

q_24541.question: What is the definition of "eNB" in the context of E-UTRA Layer 2 measurements?
q_24541.ground_truth: In the E-UTRA Layer 2 measurements document, eNB stands for "Evolved NodeB" and is used to refer to the radio access point in the E-UTRA network, specifically the base station that communicates with UEs.

q_24542.question: What is the target cost of harmonization set for device set 3 in the harmonization analysis?
q_24542.ground_truth: The target cost of harmonization, assuming 100% statistical significance of the sample size, is set to be 1.5 dB for device set 3.

q_24543.question: What potential requirement is suggested to ensure the integrity and replay protection on the interface between AF and NWDAF for UE data collection?
q_24543.ground_truth: The suggested potential requirement is to support integrity and replay protection on the interface between AF and NWDAF for the UE data collection.

q_24544.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in the 3GPP technical specifications?
q_24544.ground_truth: The version numbering system indicates the level of approval and changes made to the document. A version number with a first digit of "3" or greater indicates a TSG approved document under change control.

q_24545.question: What is the function of the "precondition" mechanism in the scenario described?
q_24545.ground_truth: The "precondition" mechanism is a negotiation mechanism that allows the user agent to negotiate the media parameters for a session before the session is established. It allows the user agent to specify the codecs that it supports and the parameters that it needs for the session. The user agent can use the "precondition" mechanism to request that the other party supports specific codecs or parameters before the session is established.

q_24546.question: How are congestion related packet drops handled for services using a Non-GBR QCI?
q_24546.ground_truth: Services using a Non-GBR QCI should be prepared to experience congestion related packet drops, except for QCI 80. For services using QCI 80, more than 2 percent of packets might exceed the PDB of QCI 80 due to its low latency objective.

q_24547.question: What is the purpose of using the Session ID in the file download delivery process?
q_24547.ground_truth: The MBMS Identity field can be used by the BM-SC and terminal to establish an n-to-m mapping between the files of a file download sessions and their corresponding MBMS bearer sessions over which the files are transported.

q_24548.question: What is the purpose of the Drift RNTI (D-RNTI) in the GERAN/UTRAN?
q_24548.ground_truth: The D-RNTI is allocated by the TBSS and is used to identify the MS/UE during a handover via the Iur-g interface.

q_24549.question: What is required for the authorization of UAV and networked UAV controller pairing?
q_24549.ground_truth: During the authorization of UAV and networked UAV controller pairing, the UAV can provide the information necessary to identify the networked UAV controller, and as a result of successful authorization, the USS/UTM provides authorized UAV and networked UAV controller pairing information to the 5GS.

q_24550.question: What is the purpose of the source eNB including AS algorithms used in the source cell in the source to target transparent container that is sent to the target eNB for S1-handover?
q_24550.ground_truth: The purpose of including AS algorithms used in the source cell in the source to target transparent container that is sent to the target eNB for S1-handover is so that the target eNB can decipher and integrity verify the RRCReestablishmentComplete message on SRB1 in the potential RRCConnectionRe-establishment procedure.

q_24551.question: What should a mobile station do if it is in a camped state on any cell and has valid individual priorities received through dedicated signaling?
q_24551.ground_truth: The mobile station should ignore the individual priorities received through dedicated signaling and should apply priorities received from the system information of the serving cell.

q_24552.question: When should the DRNS include the Secondary CPICH Information IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Information Response IE in the Additional E-DCH Cell Information Response RL Add IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message if Secondary CPICH may be used as a Phase Reference for this Radio Link on the secondary UL frequency?
q_24552.ground_truth: The DRNS should include the Secondary CPICH Information IE if Secondary CPICH may be used as a Phase Reference for this Radio Link on the secondary UL frequency.

q_24553.question: What is the indication for a barred cell in the MIB message for NTN?
q_24553.ground_truth: cellBarred with a value of "barred" in the MIB message

q_24554.question: What is the purpose of the SBCF requesting tariff information in the described scenario?
q_24554.ground_truth: The SBCF requests tariff information to determine the granted units and the price for the bearer/session.

q_24555.question: What actions should the UE take if timer T3346 is running and it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message from the network?
q_24555.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED and change to state 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE.

q_24556.question: What criteria must be fulfilled for the uplink DPCCH transmission to be turned off?
q_24556.ground_truth: The uplink DPCCH transmission would be turned off if the DPCCH transmission pattern does not require the transmission, there is no HS-SCCH triggered HARQ ACK/NACK feedback, no immediate CQI report to be sent, no immediate E-DPCCH/E-DPDCH transmission taking place, and there has been no HS-DPCCH or E-DPCCH/E-DPDCH transmission in the last N slots.

q_24557.question: What is the length of the BCD number of Record 1 in the local phonebook?
q_24557.ground_truth: The length of the BCD number of Record 1 in the local phonebook is 11.

q_24558.question: What is the function of the Broadcast Control Channel (BCCH) in LTE?
q_24558.ground_truth: The Broadcast Control Channel (BCCH) is a downlink channel used in LTE for broadcasting system control information.

q_24559.question: Who are the actors involved in the operator-GRX Network Composition scenario?
q_24559.ground_truth: The actors are 3GPP operators on one hand and the GSMA running the GRX network on the other hand.

q_24560.question: What should be done during the registration and activation of a UE in the PN?
q_24560.ground_truth: The registration and activation procedures should include a validation and update of identities and capabilities associated with the UE. For this to happen, the UE should either send a registration/activation request to the network or the network should "invite" the UE based on a request received from another UE belonging to the PN. Additionally, registration and activation should only be done for UEs that are currently attached/registered to the network.

q_24561.question: What is the required format for the nodes interior nodes and leaf nodes in the MO for Multi-Device and Multi-Identity in IMS?
q_24561.ground_truth: Interior nodes are drawn as rectangles, not rectangles with rounded corners; and leaf nodes are plain text, not rectangles.

q_24562.question: What are the scene description restrictions for SVG-based Timed Graphics in 3GPP?
q_24562.ground_truth: The scene description restrictions for SVG-based Timed Graphics in 3GPP include the use of SVG Tiny 1.2 for the description of the scene, the absence of continuous media such as audio or video in the scene, and limitations on interactivity and scene commands.

q_24563.question: What is the purpose of the private message mechanism in M3AP?
q_24563.ground_truth: The private message mechanism in M3AP is used for special operator or vendor-specific features and research purposes, but not for basic functionality.

q_24564.question: Where is the handover strategy employed in the network for radio link control?
q_24564.ground_truth: The handover strategy employed by the network for radio link control determines the handover decision that will be made based on the measurement results reported by the MS/BSS and various parameters set for each cell.

q_24565.question: What does the CTS-MS measure when fulfilling the performance requirement specified in 3GPP TS~45.005 at levels down to reference sensitivity level or reference interference level?
q_24565.ground_truth: The CTS-MS should fulfill the performance requirement of detecting and synchronizing to a CTSBCH carrier at reference sensitivity level and reference interference levels as specified in 3GPP TS~45.005.

q_24566.question: What is the role of the QoS Profile in the BSSGP?
q_24566.ground_truth: The QoS Profile in BSSGP defines the (peak) bit rate, the type of BSSGP's SDU (signalling or data), the type of LLC frame (ACK, SACK, or not), the precedence class, and the transmission mode used when transmitting the LLC-PDU across the radio interface.

q_24567.question: What is the use of ProSe Group Member Discovery parameters in the context of direct discovery over PC5 interface?
q_24567.ground_truth: ProSe Group Member Discovery parameters, such as Application Layer Group ID, Layer-2 Group ID, User Info ID (Announcer Info, Discoverer/Discoveree Info), are used for direct discovery over PC5 interface to identify an application layer group that the UE belongs to, a layer-2 ID for Discovery Group ID, and information about the announcing user or the discoverer/discoveree UE.

q_24568.question: What function is invoked when the GLR determines that the request of location update can be handled without involving the HLR?
q_24568.ground_truth: The HLR emulation function is invoked when the GLR determines that the request of location update can be handled without involving the HLR.

q_24569.question: What information does the DRNS use for the related resource allocation operation if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the E-DCH MAC-d Flow Multiplexing List IE for an E-DCH MAC-d flow in FDD?
q_24569.ground_truth: The DRNS uses this information for the related resource allocation operation.

q_24570.question: What are the functional impacts on the 5G CN when considering a satellite access with moving coverage areas and on-board gNBs?
q_24570.ground_truth: This is a point expected to be studied within Key Issue 3.

q_24571.question: What is the structure of Information frames (I-frames) on layer 2 of the EMMI protocol?
q_24571.ground_truth: I-frames consist of two octets that indicate the start and stop of a frame, and information from higher layers is transferred in I-frames with a variable length.

q_24572.question: How is the ETWS Secondary Notification distributed in E-UTRAN?
q_24572.ground_truth: In E-UTRAN, the ETWS Secondary Notification is distributed using SIB 11, while the other warning systems use SIB 12.

q_24573.question: Which steps should be taken when setting the affiliation status of the MCData group information entry added to the candidate list by the procedures of clause 8.3.2.12?
q_24573.ground_truth: The affiliation status of the MCData group information entry added to the candidate list of the MCData group information entries should be set to "affiliated" if the IWF has received a SIP 2xx response from the controlling MCData function to a SIP request that had triggered performing the procedures of clause 8.3.2.12.

q_24574.question: What information does the Packet Flow Identifier (PFI) provide in the context of an LLC PDU?
q_24574.ground_truth: The PFI identifies the packet flow context associated with the LLC PDU. It is included by the SGSN if the packet flow context feature is negotiated, and the mobile station supports it. If the mobile station does not support the PFC feature or if the PFI is not known, the SGSN uses the pre-defined PFI to indicate best-effort QoS.

q_24575.question: What interaction takes place between the CP and UP function during the IP-CAN session establishment procedure where TDF-C selects a new TDF-U and creates Sx session?
q_24575.ground_truth: The new TDF-C selects a new TDF-U and creates Sx session with TDF-U during the IP-CAN session establishment procedure.

q_24576.question: What is the policy applied to a stream associated with multiple flows when remote NAT Traversal is applied?
q_24576.ground_truth: When remote NAT Traversal is applied to a stream associated with multiple flows, the IMS-AGW performs individual latching and/or re-latching on the various flows. This means that RTP and RTCP flows of a single stream can be latched to different remote addresses/ports.

q_24577.question: What type of CDRs is used for collecting charging information related to the transmission of Short Messages through the SGSN and MME in MO or MT direction?
q_24577.ground_truth: S-SMO-CDR for MO direction transfer and S-SMT-CDR for MT direction transfer are used to collect charging information related to the transmission of Short Messages.

q_24578.question: What is the HS-DSCH transport block size Lk for 7.68 Mcps TDD when k = 63 and the HS-DSCH physical layer category is between 1 and 3 inclusively?

q_24579.question: What should the UE do when it receives a RRCSetup message in response to an RRCConnectionReestablishment message?
q_24579.ground_truth: The UE should start T311 timer and initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure, and if the re-establishment is successful, the UE should resume the RRC connection without explicit signaling.

q_24580.question: What should the eIMS-AGW do when the eP-CSCF (IMS-ALG) requests the release of an entire H.248 Stream group or termination associated with an SCTP Association?
q_24580.ground_truth: The eIMS-AGW should execute appropriate bearer control procedures to release the DTLS connection associated with the SCTP Association.

q_24581.question: What is the alpha identifier for record 4?
q_24581.ground_truth: The alpha identifier for record 4 is "Contact004".

q_24582.question: What authorization information does the eP-CSCF obtain upon validating the access token from the Authorization header field?
q_24582.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF obtains the associated authorization information, including the private user identity and public user identity of the associated user, the WAF and WWSF identities, and the authorization information scope.

q_24583.question: What is the outcome if the IP-CAN bearer modification is not upgrading the QoS and not providing traffic mapping information?
q_24583.ground_truth: The IP-CAN bearer modification is always acknowledged by the GW (PCEF).

q_24584.question: What bit in the L2 frame identifies the command and what is its value for short L2 header type 1?
q_24584.ground_truth: The C/R bit identifies a frame as either a command or a response. In short L2 header type 1, it takes a value of 0.

q_24585.question: What message does the UE send to the serving AMF upon successfully verifying and updating the UE Parameters Update Data?
q_24585.ground_truth: The UE sends the UL NAS Transport message to the serving AMF, including the generated UPU-MAC-IUE in a transparent container.

q_24586.question: What is the purpose of decorrelating the filtered codevectors in the GSM half rate speech encoder?
