q_25348.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide a standardized test methodology for measuring speech transmission quality and delay through a UE (User Equipment) headset electrical interface, which will help to interpret results consistently and make accurate conclusions about network and UE performance.

q_25349.question: Which message type is sent by the mobile station to the network to indicate a classmark change or as a response to a classmark enquiry?

q_25350.question: What is the purpose of the Arbitration use case in the FRMCS System?
q_25350.ground_truth: The FRMCS System performs arbitration based on the context of the communication to determine the behavior of the end user device in case of multiple competing communications, and the System may ask the FRMCS User to select the communication to accept.

q_25351.question: What is the purpose of the Information Service (IS) in the Self Organizing Networks (SON) Policy Network Resource Model (NRM) IRP?
q_25351.ground_truth: The Information Service (IS) in the SON policy NRM IRP specifies the protocol neutral SON policy NRM IRP, which allows an IRPAgent to communicate management information to one or several IRPManagers concerning SON policies.

q_25352.question: What is the purpose of the Message Identifier IE in 5G networks?
q_25352.ground_truth: The Message Identifier IE identifies the warning message in 5G networks.

q_25353.question: What is the assembling convention for EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT RLC data blocks?
q_25353.ground_truth: The different components of an EGPRS or EC-GSM-IoT RLC data block are assembled sequentially, and a component may consist of a non-integer number of octets. Each octet is treated as a separate field when mapped into the physical block, and the lowest numbered bit represents the lowest order value.

q_25354.question: What is the OUTCOME for the mBMSUELinking RANAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

q_25355.question: Under what circumstances will the UE consider cells as candidates for cell reselection?
q_25355.ground_truth: The UE shall not consider any exclude-listed cells as candidates for cell reselection.

q_25356.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the initial BSIC identification of a single GSM cell?
q_25356.ground_truth: Tidentify abort = 5000 ms, indicating the time necessary to identify one new GSM cell.

q_25357.question: What is the purpose of the MIMO Capability IE in the information element for local cells that are MIMO capable when operating at 1.28Mcps TDD?
q_25357.ground_truth: The purpose of the MIMO Capability IE is to indicate that the local cell is MIMO capable. This information element is included in the local cell information for every MIMO capable local cell.

q_25358.question: What font is recommended for use in 3GPP TSs and TRs for letter symbols, style of lettering, and labelling?
q_25358.ground_truth: Arial font is recommended for use in 3GPP TSs and TRs for letter symbols, style of lettering, and labelling.

q_25359.question: How many RLC blocks are present in MCS-10 and MCS-11, and what families do they belong to?
q_25359.ground_truth: Both MCS-10 and MCS-11 consist of 3 RLC blocks. MCS-10 falls into families B, and MCS-11 falls into family A.

q_25360.question: What is the role of the BSSLAP APDU in the Connection Oriented Information Transfer procedure?
q_25360.ground_truth: The BSSLAP APDU contains the information that needs to be transferred concerning a particular target MS. In this procedure, it is included in the BSSMAP-LE Connection Oriented Information message and transferred between the SMLC and the BSS serving the target MS.

q_25361.question: What is the role of the PFDs in the management of packet flow descriptions in clause 6.1.20?
q_25361.ground_truth: The PFDs are used in the application detection and enforcement actions in the PCEF and TDF. They are provided by the ASP and become part of the application detection filters in the PCEF/TDF.

q_25362.question: What command type is used when the ME needs to send data to the UICC?

q_25363.question: What should the old BSS do in case of an unsuccessful DTM Handover to UTRAN when using the existing handover procedure inside the CN?
q_25363.ground_truth: The old BSS should not initiate a cell load based handover procedure if it has knowledge of the load in the target cell and, after a successful completion of the handover procedure, this load would be higher than in the old cell.

q_25364.question: How many possible scenarios are there for a particular MS/UE in the GERAN/UTRAN part of the PLMN?
q_25364.ground_truth: There are three possible scenarios for a particular MS/UE.

q_25365.question: What is the purpose of the 6.3.1.1 operation setPartialSuspensionOfItfN?
q_25365.ground_truth: Allows an IRPManager to suspend the forwarding via Itf-N of notifications generated by scoped managed object instances and all other notifications not related to managed NRM IOC instances.

q_25366.question: How are the LPC coefficients transformed into the ISP domain, and then back to the LP filter coefficients?
q_25366.ground_truth: The LPC coefficients are transformed into the ISP domain for quantization and interpolation purposes. The interpolated and quantized filters are then converted back to the LP filter coefficients to construct the synthesis and weighting filters at each subframe.

q_25367.question: With FR1, Urban Macro, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for CG traffic model, 15ms PDB, 60 FPS, and SU-MIMO, what is the capacity performance range and mean capacity performance with a PDB increase from 10ms to 15ms and 30Mbps data rate?
q_25367.ground_truth: The range of capacity performance is 4.05~10.6 UEs per cell, and the mean capacity performance is 7.72 UEs per cell with 30Mbps and 15ms PDB.

q_25368.question: What is the role of the "Reserve IMS resources" procedure in the described multimedia conference establishment procedure?
q_25368.ground_truth: The "Reserve IMS resources" procedure is used by the MRFC to request resources from the MRFP before creating an ad-hoc conference.

q_25369.question: What action does the UP Function take when the last L2TP session in a L2TP tunnel is terminated?
q_25369.ground_truth: The UP Function may terminate the L2TP tunnel as well, but it is also possible to retain the L2TP tunnel even if all L2TP sessions are terminated.

q_25370.question: What is the name of the statistical analysis method used to identify outliers in the test results?

q_25371.question: What are the channels used to send resource assignment to an MS prior to packet transfer?

q_25372.question: What should a mobile station do if it fails to establish the main signalling link?
q_25372.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with RR connection establishment retry.

q_25373.question: What information should be inserted in the SDP offer for the H.248 stream grouping and the H.248 component stream(s) with SCTP semantics?
q_25373.ground_truth: The eIMS-AGW should indicate the H.248 stream grouping of the H.248 deaggregation stream and the H.248 component stream(s) with SCTP semantics to the eIMS-AGW in the SDP offer.

q_25374.question: What is the PROCEDURE CODE for the positionCalculation PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
q_25374.ground_truth: The PROCEDURE CODE for the positionCalculation PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE is id-PositionCalculation.

q_25375.question: What is the length of the speech frame for all 3GPP Codec Types when using compressed speech on the A-Interface?

q_25376.question: How is the input signal filtered in the 3GPP digital cellular telecommunications system to distinguish speech from noise?
q_25376.ground_truth: The input signal is adaptively filtered to reduce its noise content before the voice activity decision is made.

q_25377.question: How is the depth range of a stereoscopic 3D video provided in a DASH service?
q_25377.ground_truth: The maximum and minimum disparity, screen width (or diagonal) or range of screen widths (or range of diagonals) could be signalled as part of MPD describing DASH service. This information would allow DASH client to choose version of stereoscopic 3D video which would ensure the highest quality of the 3D experience on a given hardware.

q_25378.question: What is the objective of the restricted HS-SCCH concept?
q_25378.ground_truth: The objective of the restricted HS-SCCH is to reduce HS-SCCH power requirements compared to the existing Rel-6 HS-SCCH by eliminating HS-SCCH transmissions during HARQ retransmissions, reducing the payload carried over the HS-SCCH during new transmissions, and jointly encoding the entire HS-SCCH payload and transmitting the codeword over all three slots of HS-SCCH transmission.

q_25379.question: What does the NAS do if the access attempt is barred and the UE is operating in the single-registration mode and the MO-SMSoIP-attempt-started indication or the MO-IMS-registration-related-signalling-started indication triggered the access attempt?
q_25379.ground_truth: The NAS should notify the upper layers that the access attempt is barred, and upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, the NAS shall notify the upper layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category and may initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message, if still needed.

q_25380.question: How many synchronous cells are present in this test scenario and what are their names?
q_25380.ground_truth: There are two synchronous cells in this test scenario: Cell 1 and Cell 2.

q_25381.question: What is the name of the FLUS Media Plane instantiation using a continuous sequence of CMAF Chunks with HTTP Delivery?
q_25381.ground_truth: This FLUS media instantiation is called "FLUS Media Plane instantiation using a continuous sequence of CMAF Chunks with HTTP Delivery."

q_25382.question: When the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is received in order to take a 5G NAS security context into use created after a successful execution of the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure, what should the UE do to the uplink NAS COUNT counter in the new 5G NAS security context after taking it into use?
q_25382.ground_truth: The UE shall reset the uplink NAS COUNT counter.

q_25383.question: What is the IPv6/UDP/RTP overhead when sending 8 non-redundant frames (80 ms) in the packets in the A->B direction in Use case B?

q_25384.question: What happens when the UE sends an LCS Periodic Location Cancellation request to the MME?
q_25384.ground_truth: The UE stops the periodic and triggered event reporting and returns an LCS Periodic Location cancellation ack. to the MME, even when the UE has no knowledge of the location procedure being cancelled.

q_25385.question: What is the difference between disabling HARQ feedback and enabling it for downlink HARQ processes in the network?
q_25385.ground_truth: Disabling HARQ feedback allows scheduling a HARQ process before one HARQ RTT has elapsed since last scheduled, while enabling HARQ feedback requires waiting for the HARQ RTT before scheduling the next HARQ process.

q_25386.question: What action does the SBCF take upon receiving a successful service delivery indication in the context of the TariffRequest scenario with successful service delivery?
q_25386.ground_truth: The SBCF sends a PriceRequest with a debit instruction to the RF for the final calculation of the price.

q_25387.question: What is required for the PS-PS in conjunction with PS-CS Access Transfer: PS to CS?
q_25387.ground_truth: The flow requires that the user is in an active or inactive IMS originating or terminating session, and the Gm reference point of ICS is used for control of IMS sessions that use CS media.

q_25388.question: What are the preconditions and postconditions for the gsmSSF in the case of cancel(allRequests)?
q_25388.ground_truth: The gsmSSF FSM should be in the "Waiting_for_Instructions" or "Monitoring" state for the preconditions, whereas the postconditions include disarmed EDP and cancelled reports, with the gsmSSF FSM transiting to the "Idle" or remaining in the "Waiting_for_Instructions" state.

q_25389.question: What is the UE location calculation method for TTFF test cases in general?
q_25389.ground_truth: For every test instance in each TTFF test case, the UE location is randomly selected to be within 3 km of the reference location using a uniform random distribution. The altitude of the UE is randomly selected between 0 m to 500 m above WGS84 reference ellipsoid. The UE locations are calculated as an offset from the reference location.

q_25390.question: What must the S-CSCF verify when it receives a UE-originating request from an unregistered user?
q_25390.ground_truth: The S-CSCF must verify if the public user identity of the served user is barred. If so, it shall respond with a 4xx error code and stop further processing of the request.

q_25391.question: What is the purpose of the AOC-E service procedure in IMS?
q_25391.ground_truth: The AOC-E service procedure in IMS provides a single integer value for the number of recorded AOC information used in the communication.

q_25392.question: What are the UTRAN Identifiers defined in the UTRAN architecture?
q_25392.ground_truth: UTRAN Identifiers include PLMN Identity, CN Domain Identifier, RNC Identifier, Service Area Identifier, Cell Identifier, Local Cell Identifier, and UE Identifiers (RNTI). Each of these identifiers has a unique role in identifying resources, cells, and user equipment in the UTRAN architecture.

q_25393.question: How does the UE reachability procedure impact the core network's delivery of messages to the UE?
q_25393.ground_truth: Use of the reachability procedure in the application layer has no impact on how the core network delivers messages to the UE. This helps maintain the efficiency and performance of message delivery in the core network.

q_25394.question: What are the two fundamental energy saving states for a network element?
q_25394.ground_truth: The two fundamental energy saving states for a network element are notEnergySaving state and energySaving state.

q_25395.question: What is the role of the OCF in the SCUR method?
q_25395.ground_truth: The OCF is responsible for calculating the price and keeping the account balance reservation in the SCUR method.

q_25396.question: What is the main focus of Group 3 solutions in enabling paging reception for multi-USIM devices?
q_25396.ground_truth: Group 3 solutions, such as #7, #8, #12, #24, #26, #27, and #12, aim to deliver MT service notifications in the current system. These solutions may introduce additional NFs in the Core Network and impact system performance regarding cost, complexity, delay, and paging resource wastage.

q_25397.question: What is the role of ALLOCATIONOrRetentionPriority in network management?
q_25397.ground_truth: ALLOCATIONOrRetentionPriority is a SEQUENCE containing various priority level and pre-emption related information, used to control the allocation or retention of resources in a network.

q_25398.question: What is the formula for calculating the value of timer T390 when the access attempt is considered as barred?
q_25398.ground_truth: The formula for calculating the value of timer T390 when the access attempt is considered as barred is T390 = (0.7+ 0.6 * rand) * uac-BarringTime.

q_25399.question: Under what circumstances would an operator choose to use AOG mode #3 for analytics generation?
q_25399.ground_truth: An operator would choose to use AOG mode #3 if they cannot share collected data in a certain area of their network with other areas due to privacy issues, or if they want to reduce the volume of data exchanged among NWDAFs.

q_25400.question: What is the typical CMR value for the downlink direction in the TRAU?
q_25400.ground_truth: The typical CMR value for the downlink direction in the TRAU is "1.1.1".

q_25401.question: What is the purpose of the MGW-id provided to the succeeding node in the IAM in CFNRy call forwarding?
q_25401.ground_truth: The MGW-id is provided to the succeeding node in the IAM, to indicate the Media Gateway (MGW) that will be used for the waiting call in CFNRy call forwarding.

q_25402.question: What should the UE do if it does not find the master information block in a position fulfilling the condition SFN mod 32 = 0?
q_25402.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the master information block as not found, consider the cell to be barred, and consider the barred cell as using the value "allowed" in the IE "Intra-frequency cell re-selection indicator" and the maximum value in the IE "Tbarred".

q_25403.question: What is the purpose of Task C in fault management workflow?
q_25403.ground_truth: Task C is responsible for collecting fault-related information, including alarm information and other relevant data.

q_25404.question: What is the difference between an SM-MO and an SM-MT short message?
q_25404.ground_truth: An SM-MO short message is sent from a mobile station to a service center, while an SM-MT short message is sent from a service center to a mobile station.

q_25405.question: What action should the Node B take if the number of HARQ retransmissions should not influence the SIR target level?
q_25405.ground_truth: The Node B should insert the value 13 into the Number of HARQ Retransmissions IE.

q_25406.question: What organization is responsible for maintaining the list of assigned port numbers?
q_25406.ground_truth: IANA (Internet Assigned Numbers Authority) maintains the list of assigned port numbers.

q_25407.question: What message is sent by the source UE in the Layer-2 based UE-to-UE Relay re-selection procedure to request the re-selection of the new UE-to-UE Relay?
q_25407.ground_truth: A Link Modification Request message is sent by the source UE in the Layer-2 based UE-to-UE Relay re-selection procedure to request the re-selection of the new UE-to-UE Relay.

q_25408.question: In the message broadcast scenario, what is responsible for broadcasting the message in the designated service area?
q_25408.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server is responsible for forwarding the MSGin5G message to the 5G System, which then takes care of broadcasting the message in the designated service area.

q_25409.question: What is the main cause of clipping in digital networks?
q_25409.ground_truth: The main cause of clipping is voice switching controlled by voice activity detection.

q_25410.question: What is the function of the MBMS RAB Release procedure?
q_25410.ground_truth: The MBMS RAB Release procedure is used to enable the UTRAN to request the release of an MBMS RAB. The MBMS RAB is defined for the PS domain only.

q_25411.question: What further enables the ProSe Function to verify the authorization of the announcing UE to announce the ProSe App Code at that time instance, in addition to protecting the messages in open discovery?
q_25411.ground_truth: Integrity protection via Message Integrity Check (MIC) that uses UTC-based counter associated with the discovery slot further enables the ProSe Function to verify the authorization of the announcing UE.

q_25412.question: Which field of the reference station message specifies the relationship between GPS time and air-interface timing in the BTS transmission of the serving cell?

q_25413.question: What is the use of the Random Number, Signed Response, and Ciphering Key triplet vector?
q_25413.ground_truth: The Random Number, Signed Response, and Ciphering Key triplet vector is used for authentication and encryption in I-WLAN. It is calculated in the 2G AuC for SIM-based users and derived from quintuplet vectors in the 3G HLR/HSS for USIM-based users.

q_25414.question: Which ID has a criticality value of "ignore" and a presence indicator of "optional" in the MBMSSessionStartResponse-IEs?
q_25414.ground_truth: id-CriticalityDiagnostics has a criticality value of "ignore" and a presence indicator of "optional" in the MBMSSessionStartResponse-IEs.

q_25415.question: What regulatory mechanism is used to ensure the forwards and backwards compatibility of the protocol in SLmAP?
q_25415.ground_truth: The mechanism used is the inclusion of ID and criticality fields in messages and information elements (IEs) that are coded in a standard format that will not be changed in the future.

q_25416.question: What is the main factor that determines the required number of channels in the setup of the OTA chamber antennas?
q_25416.ground_truth: The main factors that determine the required number of channels are channel model, DUT size, and polarization.

q_25417.question: What is the purpose of the File Repair Procedure in MBMS?
q_25417.ground_truth: The File Repair Procedure in MBMS is designed to repair lost or corrupted file fragments from the MBMS download data transmission.

q_25418.question: What is the purpose of the Monitoring UE in the 5G ProSe restricted discovery?
q_25418.ground_truth: The Monitoring UE sends a Discovery Request message containing the ProSe Application ID to the DDNMF in its HPLMN to get the parameters for monitoring. Based on the Discovery Filter, it listens for a discovery message that satisfies its filter.

q_25419.question: When is the TCP management function used in the UTRAN-CN interface?
q_25419.ground_truth: The TCP management function is used to establish and release TCP connections between the CN and UTRAN over Iu-BC.

q_25420.question: What is the method for determining user location information at the SCC AS?
q_25420.ground_truth: The method for determining user location information at the SCC AS is implementation dependent.

q_25421.question: What is the benefit of using UE analytics information in UE Context transfer between NFs?
q_25421.ground_truth: The benefit of using UE analytics information in UE Context transfer between NFs is that other NFs can re-use the same analytics, thus avoiding contacting NWDAF again for collecting data and computing analytics.

q_25422.question: What is the role of the M2 interface in E-UTRAN?
q_25422.ground_truth: The M2 interface is a logical interface between the eNB and the MCE in E-UTRAN, used for transporting M2-AP signalling messages.

q_25423.question: What happens if the ProtocolType leaf is not supported by the UE in a flow distribution rule?
q_25423.ground_truth: The UE ignores the IPFlow instance if the ProtocolType leaf is not supported by the UE.

q_25424.question: How many alternatives does TS 26.445 specify for transporting CMR on the Mb interface?
q_25424.ground_truth: TS 26.445 specifies four different alternatives for transporting CMR on the Mb interface.

q_25425.question: How is the LOS channel coefficient determined in the LOS case?
q_25425.ground_truth: The LOS channel coefficient is determined by equation (7.5-29), which includes the field patterns of receive and transmit antenna elements, the Dirac's delta function, and the 3D distance between the transmitter and receiver.

q_25426.question: What is the impact of introducing semi-persistent scheduling in downlink?
q_25426.ground_truth: By introducing semi-persistent scheduling in downlink, it can reduce the control channel overhead and increase the VoIP capacity, as the HS-SCCH is no longer required for HS-DSCH transmissions after the first transmission. The Node B can assign and re-assign the UE's semi-persistent resource for downlink transmission.

q_25427.question: What should the UDM do if the time period T between the first and latest received SUCI is less than or equal to T3519?
q_25427.ground_truth: The UDM initiates authentication procedure otherwise determines either the UE is fake or there is a man in the middle on receiving SUCI 1 and rejects the authentication procedure.

q_25428.question: What is the term used in the present document to describe the version number string of the IRP document?

q_25429.question: What should the values of xhap,1, xhap,2, xhap,3, xhap,4, xrvpb,1, and xrvpb,2 be for an HS-SCCH order?
q_25429.ground_truth: They should be set to xodt,1, xodt,2, xodt,3, ord,1, ord,2, and ord,3, respectively.

q_25430.question: What happens in step 13 of the Edge Enabler Client triggered application context relocation solution?
q_25430.ground_truth: Upon receiving the Context relocation response, the Edge Enabler Client reroutes the UE application data traffic.

q_25431.question: What action should an SGSN take if it receives a combined routing area update request from an MS and detects that the VLR serving the MS is no longer in service?
q_25431.ground_truth: The SGSN may select an alternative VLR that is in service for the MS and immediately perform the location update for non-GPRS services procedure towards the selected VLR.

q_25432.question: What action should the MS take if it receives a GA-PSR TC activation message from the GANC while the GA-PSR TC is active?
q_25432.ground_truth: The MS should send the GA-PSR-ACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message to the GANC including the MS UDP port allocated to the existing GA-PSR TC. In parallel, if the GANC provided new IP Address and UDP port number, the MS should update the GA-PSR TC attributes accordingly.

q_25433.question: What is the purpose of UP path establishment for C2 communication?
q_25433.ground_truth: The UP connection establishment for C2 communication is used to set up a secure and reliable communication link between the UAV and UAV-C, enabling them to exchange control commands and operational data.

q_25434.question: What action will the V-PCRF take when it is handling the AF signalling session locally with the V-AF and is notified of the loss or release of resources associated with the PCC Rules corresponding to V-AF Signalling IP Flows?
q_25434.ground_truth: The V-PCRF will inform the V-AF about the Loss of the Signalling Transmission Path by sending a Re-Authorization Request (RAR) command to the V-AF.

q_25435.question: What should the Node B do if the UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
q_25435.ground_truth: The Node B should store the UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate parameters if supported, to control the aggregate data rate of non-GBR traffic for this UE.

q_25436.question: Which layer determines the ciphering method and key to be used in the MAC PDU ciphering process?

q_25437.question: What parameter in BSSMAP-LE CONNECTION ORIENTED INFORMATION message identifies the specific Multilateration positioning method that has been triggered by the SMLC?
q_25437.ground_truth: The Multilateration Positioning Method parameter in the BSSMAP-LE CONNECTION ORIENTED INFORMATION message identifies the specific Multilateration positioning method that has been triggered by the SMLC.

q_25438.question: What is the role of the HLR in USSD operations?
q_25438.ground_truth: The HLR, in USSD operations, examines the alphabet and contents of the message, and takes appropriate actions based on the format of the message. If it does not support the alphabet indicated, it informs the UE.

q_25439.question: What should be done when the candidate expiration interval is zero and the current time is outside the expiration time of the MCPTT group information entry?
q_25439.ground_truth: The MCPTT group information entry should be copied into a new MCPTT group information entry of the candidate list of the MCPTT group information entries, with the affiliation status set to "de-affiliating" and the expiration time to some time in the future.

q_25440.question: When should the SGSN include the RAT Type IE during Primary PDP Context Activation procedure?
q_25440.ground_truth: The SGSN shall include the RAT Type IE during Primary PDP Context Activation procedure in all cases.

q_25441.question: What is the primary motivation behind following the "Untrusted non-3GPP access" architecture principle in the solution for SNPN?
q_25441.ground_truth: The choice to follow the Untrusted non-3GPP access architecture principle is rooted in its prior success in Release 16, and can also apply to Trusted non-3GPP access when supported by SNPN.

q_25442.question: What is the main difference in the session activation procedure for broadcast with and without an MBSF?
q_25442.ground_truth: With an MBSF, the AF sends an Allocate MBS service request to MBSF-C, while without an MBSF, the AF provides a Broadcast service area and indicates that the MBS session request is for Broadcast.

q_25443.question: What should the UE do when the IE "CSG PSC Split Information" is included in a received message?
q_25443.ground_truth: The UE should consider the CSG PSC split information received on this cell to be valid for the UARFCN of the carrier on which it was received, any cell not referenced in SIB18, and any cell referenced in SIB18 that has the same PLMN as the PLMN of the cell where the CSG PSC split information was received.

q_25444.question: What operation does the PLMN management system send to notify the consumer that the request to select a UPF is in progress?
q_25444.ground_truth: PLMN management system sends a selectUpfResp to notify the consumer that the request is in progress.

q_25445.question: What is the main challenge when using the 3GPP system to access pre-encoded videos from Internet services?
q_25445.ground_truth: The main challenge is that the 3GPP system needs to take care of the appropriate delivery quality and the delivered bit rate since external networks do not consider the special needs of the 3GPP system.

q_25446.question: How should user service announcements over point-to-point push bearers be transmitted to the MBMS terminal?
q_25446.ground_truth: User service announcements over point-to-point push bearers can either be transmitted by embedding the metadata fragment within the metadata envelope or by referencing the metadata fragment in a multipart MIME container. The metadata envelope and fragments are transported together and in-band of the same transport session.

q_25447.question: What does a Network-Element value represent?
q_25447.ground_truth: A Network-Element value is a choice between Global-eNB-ID and E-SMLC-ID, which both represent the identity of the network element involved in a certain procedure.

q_25448.question: Which mechanisms should be incorporated by the network to accommodate evolving enabling mechanisms and service requirements in 3GPP location-based systems?
q_25448.ground_truth: The supporting mechanisms in a 3GPP location-based system should incorporate flexible modular components with open interfaces to facilitate equipment interoperability and the evolution of service-providing capabilities.

q_25449.question: What is the requirement for inter frequency CPICH measurements when the UE does not require measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform inter-frequency FDD measurements?
q_25449.ground_truth: If the UE does not require measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform inter-frequency FDD measurements, the measurement period for inter frequency CPICH measurements shall be 480 ms.

q_25450.question: What are the three parts of the Iu UP PDU Type 14 format for procedure sending?
q_25450.ground_truth: The Iu UP PDU Type 14 is made up of the Iu UP Frame Control part (fixed size), the Iu UP Frame Check Sum part (fixed size), and the Iu UP Frame Payload part (variable length, rounded up to octet).

q_25451.question: What is the purpose of service continuity in the Evolved Packet System?
q_25451.ground_truth: The Evolved Packet System is designed to maintain service during and following changes of access systems and networks, inter-PLMN handover with seamless service continuity, and support for multicast and broadcast services during access system changes.

q_25452.question: In which field is id-MIMO-N-M-Ratio used?
q_25452.ground_truth: Used in the HSSDCH Physical Layer

q_25453.question: What is the name of the procedure that stops an announcement and may also be stopped by releasing the IMS termination?

q_25454.question: What is the purpose of the SI 20 Rest Octets information element?
q_25454.ground_truth: The SI 20 Rest Octets information element includes parameters for non-GSM networks and is a type 5 information element with 20 octets long.

q_25455.question: What is the difference between online and offline charging in 3GPP TSs?
q_25455.ground_truth: Online charging is a charging mechanism where charging information can affect, in real-time, the service rendered and requires a direct interaction of the charging mechanism with bearer/session/service control. Offline charging, on the other hand, collects information related to a chargeable event and stores it as a Charging Data Record (CDR) for later processing.

q_25456.question: What should the MAC entity do if the MSGA transmission is for the CCCH logical channel and it's the first MSGA transmission within this Random Access procedure?
q_25456.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate to the Multiplexing and assembly entity to include a C-RNTI MAC CE in the subsequent uplink transmission.

q_25457.question: What is the role of the AAA-S entity in the 5G network?
q_25457.ground_truth: The AAA-S entity in the 5G network is responsible for authentication and authorization of the user equipment (UE) in the network.

q_25458.question: What is the input S to the KDF in the derivation of P-TID process?
q_25458.ground_truth: The input S to the KDF in the derivation of P-TID includes FC, P0, L0, P1, and L1, where FC, P0, L0, and L1 are predefined values, and P1 is the relay service code.

q_25459.question: What is the difference between the two options the mobile station has to signal an uplink request in the voice group call with A-interface link sharing?
q_25459.ground_truth: If the priority uplink access parameter indicates "RACH access", then the mobile station sends an uplink access message on the RACH. If the priority uplink access parameter indicates "group call channel uplink access", then the mobile station always sends an uplink access message on the group call channel uplink.

q_25460.question: What is the role of the Xib reference point in the S8HR LI solution?
q_25460.ground_truth: The Xib reference point is used to exchange control plane information between the LMISF and the S-GW/BBIFF. It is used for the LMISF to provide S8HR APN information, instruct the S-GW/BBIFF to notify of bearer creation, modification, or deletion, and receive target identity information from the ADMF.

q_25461.question: How does the UE-to-network relay generate KD?
q_25461.ground_truth: The UE-to-network relay generates KD by using the PKMF-retrieved PRUK, a KD Freshness Parameter (a locally generated random number), a nonce sent by the Remote UE, and the Relay Service Code the Remote UE wishes to access.

q_25462.question: What message does the SGSN send to the GANC when requesting the activation of Packet Transport Channels for PS handover purposes?

q_25463.question: What should the UE do if the field useFullResumeID is signalled in SIB1?
q_25463.ground_truth: The UE should select RRCResumeRequest1 as the message to use and set the resumeIdentity to the stored fullI-RNTI value.

q_25464.question: What is the purpose of using RTP payload type 97 in the SDP answer?
q_25464.ground_truth: The purpose of using RTP payload type 97 in the SDP answer is to indicate the use of AMR, max 123.2 kbps and bandwidth-efficient payload format.

q_25465.question: What is the purpose of the "Termination of an Automatic Train Protection data communication" use case?
q_25465.ground_truth: The "Termination of an Automatic Train Protection data communication" use case allows the FRMCS User to release an ongoing Automatic Train Protection related data communication.

q_25466.question: What is the format of the Per-Link Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate value for V2X unicast mode communication over the NR-PC5?

q_25467.question: What is the user information rate, which must be transmitted over the air interface in DC-HSDPA?
q_25467.ground_truth: The total received power spectral density, including signal and interference, as measured at the UE antenna connector.

q_25468.question: What is the purpose of the Reused Extended Object facility?
q_25468.ground_truth: The Reused Extended Object facility is used to reuse an Extended Object in a message that has already been defined in the same message.

q_25469.question: How are the network functions in the 5G System architecture represented and interacted with?
q_25469.ground_truth: Network functions in the 5G System architecture are represented in a service-based manner, where network functions (e.g., AMF) within the Control Plane enable other authorized network functions to access their services. The interaction between network functions is also represented by point-to-point reference points, such as N11 between AMF and SMF. In the non-roaming case, service-based interfaces are used within the Control Plane, and the 5G System architecture is depicted using the reference point representation to show how various network functions interact.

q_25470.question: What are the LCS-Capabilities-Set values indicated by the HSS to the GMLC?
q_25470.ground_truth: The LCS-Capabilities-Set value is set to indicate support of Capability Set 5 if the HSS registered an SGSN via the S6d reference point. If the HSS registered an MME, the LCS-Capabilities-Set AVP is absent in the SLh message.

q_25471.question: What action should the IP-SM-GW take if it receives a SIP INVITE request for a Chat Session, but operator policy mandates the SMS user to be informed of the invitation?
q_25471.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW will proceed with the procedures in subclauses 6.1.8.2, 6.1.8.3 and 6.1.8.4.

q_25472.question: What are the main benefits of Network Composition?
q_25472.ground_truth: Network Composition offers new business opportunities, reduces development time and cost, saves infrastructure costs, allows quick reaction to changing resource demands, and provides increased coverage, QoS, and service availability to end-users.

q_25473.question: What is the difference between DCH and E-DCH in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
q_25473.ground_truth: DCH (Dedicated Channel) is used for carrying user or control information between the UTRAN and a UE, while E-DCH (Enhanced Dedicated Channel) is used specifically for up-link data transmission in the 1.28Mcps TDD option.

q_25474.question: What are the necessary procedures defined for the NF Producer?
q_25474.ground_truth: The necessary procedures defined for the NF Producer include the application of procedures and node functionality enhancements for SBI-based MT SMS, the registration of new services in NRF, and the querying of NRF to invoke the services for SM MT.

q_25475.question: What should the UE do if the IE "Secondary CCPCH system information MBMS" is included?
q_25475.ground_truth: The UE should apply the Secondary CCPCH and FACH indicated by the IE "FACH carrying MCCH" for receiving MCCH.

q_25476.question: What is the role of the MB-SMF in the MBS session establishment procedure?
q_25476.ground_truth: The MB-SMF is responsible for establishing a transport tunnel between MBSU and MB-UPF for the delivery of MBS data, and sending an MB session setup notification to MBSF upon session establishment.

q_25477.question: What should be the state of the cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer before initiating the CG-SDT procedure?
q_25477.ground_truth: The cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer should be running before initiating the CG-SDT procedure.

q_25478.question: What is the principle behind the noise contrast effect in the GSM system?
q_25478.ground_truth: The noise contrast effect is the perceived annoyance caused by the sudden drop in background noise when the transmission is off during DTX operation. In the GSM system, this is reduced by inserting artificial comfort noise at the receiving end when speech is absent.

q_25479.question: What is the role of the Proxy A&A function in the solution for Key Issue #1?
q_25479.ground_truth: The Proxy A&A function is responsible for handling the authentication of USS/UTM by means of provisioned aviation domain certificates in the solution for Key Issue #1.

q_25480.question: What are the two candidate receiver types considered for dealing with neighboring LTE CRS interference for CRS-IM?
q_25480.ground_truth: The two candidate receiver types for dealing with neighboring LTE CRS interference for CRS-IM are CRS interference cancellation (CRS-IC) and Log-likelihood ratio (LLR) weighting.

q_25481.question: What is the authentication type for the gateway?
q_25481.ground_truth: The authentication type for the gateway is HTTP BASIC.

q_25482.question: What is the purpose of the authorization model in GUP?
q_25482.ground_truth: The authorization model in GUP supports the issuance of assertions which convey information regarding the resource to be accessed, the entity attempting to access the resource, the mechanism by which the accessing entity must use to demonstrate its identity to the recipient, and the ability for the accessing entity to access the resource on behalf of another system entity. Therefore, the authorization model supports a constrained proxy mechanism, allowing a proxy to access the resource on behalf of the intended sender.

q_25483.question: What happens when the EAP-SIM or EAP-AKA authentication procedure fails, and the current GANC-SEGW is the SEGW associated to the Default GANC or a Serving GANC?
q_25483.ground_truth: The MS shall act as if it had received GA-RC REGISTER REJECT with the Reject Cause value 'IMSI not allowed' as defined in sub-clause 6.2.3.3.

q_25484.question: Which measurements are used to calculate the final Network Slice EE KPI based on summing up the number of active UEs in the DL per cell and the number of active UEs in the UL per cell for MIoT type of slice?
q_25484.ground_truth: DRB.MeanActiveUeDl.SNSSAI and DRB.MeanActiveUeUl.SNSSAI are used to calculate the final Network Slice EE KPI based on summing up the number of active UEs in the DL per cell and the number of active UEs in the UL per cell for MIoT type of slice.

q_25485.question: What should the IWF do upon receiving a SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the SIP INVITE request in the participating procedure?
q_25485.ground_truth: The IWF should perform the procedures for SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx responses as specified in clause~10.1.2.1 if the implicit affiliation procedures were invoked, and shall perform the steps for the received SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx as specified in clause~10.1.2.1.

q_25486.question: What is the function of the UAV Flight Enablement Subsystem (UFES) in the authentication and authorization solution for a UAV?
q_25486.ground_truth: The UFES is used as a single point of contact between the PLMN and USS/UTM to limit the impact on the 3GPP system and perform authentication and authorization procedures. It ensures only authorized USS/UTMs can provide authorization for UAVs.

q_25487.question: What are the MRFC and MRFP responsible for in the described multimedia conference establishment procedure?
q_25487.ground_truth: The MRFC is responsible for requesting resources from the MRFP, sending an SIP INVITE request with the SDP offer, receiving the 200 (OK) final response with the SDP answer, and providing additional bandwidth properties information to the MRFP. The MRFP is responsible for providing resources to the MRFC, receiving the SIP INVITE request with the SDP offer, sending the 200 (OK) final response with the SDP answer, and using the media bandwidth range for rate adaptation.

q_25488.question: What attribute is used to define the start time for initiation procedure randomization in the `initiationRandomization` element?
q_25488.ground_truth: The `initiationStartTime` attribute is used to define the start time for initiation procedure randomization in the `initiationRandomization` element.

q_25489.question: What is the purpose of the "Text Attribute" section in the "OPEN CHANNEL" command?
q_25489.ground_truth: The "Text Attribute" section in the "OPEN CHANNEL" command specifies the formatting of the alpha identifier, such as formatting position, formatting length, formatting mode, and color.

q_25490.question: What is the purpose of Tally in a camera setup?
q_25490.ground_truth: Tally is used to indicate which camera is currently "on-air" or being used for filming.

q_25491.question: Who is responsible for specifying the security functions f1, f1*, f2, f3, f4, f5, and f5* within the 3GPP system?
q_25491.ground_truth: The security functions f1, f1*, f2, f3, f4, f5, and f5* within the 3GPP system are to be specified by each operator rather than being fully standardized.

q_25492.question: What is the source device and destination device for the 3.1.1 proactive SIM command?
q_25492.ground_truth: Source device is SIM and destination device is ME (ME means Mobile Equipment)

q_25493.question: What is the name of the 3GPP file format defined in TS 26.244 that provides a common multimedia file format for 3GPP multimedia services?

q_25494.question: How can the "telephone-event" media subtype be signaled for DTMF transport between the UE and the AS?
q_25494.ground_truth: The AS should include the "telephone-event" in the SDP for CAT media, sent to the UE.

q_25495.question: When does the 3G/2G SGSN send the Forward SRNS Context message?
q_25495.ground_truth: The 3G/2G SGSN sends the Forward SRNS Context message to the target RNC/BSS if there is at least one PDP context that requires "delivery order" to be preserved.

q_25496.question: What are some of the charging models supported by PCC charging?
q_25496.ground_truth: PCC charging supports volume based charging, time based charging, volume and time based charging, event based charging, and no charging.

q_25497.question: What networks and access technologies does the IM CN subsystem support for IP multimedia applications?
q_25497.ground_truth: The IM CN subsystem supports various IP Connectivity Access Networks, including E-UTRAN, UTRAN, GERAN, fixed line, I-WLAN, DOCSIS, WiMAX, cdma2000, and DVB-RCS2 access.

q_25498.question: What should the IBCF do when an 18x provisional response with the P-Early-Media header field is received from the functional entity other than the functional entity within the trust domain?
q_25498.ground_truth: The IBCF shall set the Through-Connection information element to "inactive" or set the value of the Through-Connection information element based on the value of the direction attribute in the last received SDP answer.

q_25499.question: What is the initial approach suggested for the global roll-out of PWS Security?
q_25499.ground_truth: The initial approach suggested is a bottom-up approach, where a single country or a group of countries with a common regulation can go ahead with the implementation without being dependent on the rest of the world.

q_25500.question: What event triggers the transmission of the NBAP message RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST with the "E-DCH FDD Information" IE?
q_25500.ground_truth: The RNC transmits this message to set up a new E-DCH connection for packet switched traffic in FDD mode using the Node B Application Part (NBAP).

q_25501.question: What must a user service announcement be associated with in order to be described by a Service Announcement User Service in non-ROM services?
q_25501.ground_truth: A user service announcement in non-ROM services must be associated with an operator-specific MCC+MNC value or correspond to one of the reserved values as defined in TS 24.116.

q_25502.question: What are the two key aspects evaluated in Key Issue #1 for NWDAF functional decomposition?
q_25502.ground_truth: The two key aspects evaluated in Key Issue #1 for NWDAF functional decomposition are the number of entities decomposing NWDAF and their functionality, and the standardization effort required to provide new services offered by the decomposed functionalities.

q_25503.question: What is the blocking requirement for UMTS interferers when the body loss is increased to 12 dB (6 dB per UE)?
q_25503.ground_truth: The blocking requirement for UMTS interferers when the body loss is increased to 12 dB (6 dB per UE) is -26 dBm.

q_25504.question: In the "UL-SIR-Target-CCTrCH-InformationItem-RL-SetupRspTDD" part of the protocol, what does the acronym "SIR" stand for?

q_25505.question: What is the purpose of the RESET UE POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message in the test procedure for A-GNSS in section 7.1.1.5.2?
q_25505.ground_truth: The purpose of the RESET UE POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message is to ensure that the UE is initialized with the correct assistance data.

q_25506.question: What are the two parts of an Access Point Name (APN)?
q_25506.ground_truth: The two parts of an APN are the APN Operator Identifier and a reference to the GGSN or P-GW to be used, which may optionally identify the packet data network and a specific service to be offered.

q_25507.question: What should a MS do if it has not received all required instances of the PACKET NEIGHBOUR CELL DATA message before changing cells?
q_25507.ground_truth: A MS should first obtain the PBCCH description and missing system information messages before making initial access in the new cell.

q_25508.question: What is the definition of the Output RF spectrum in the context of the CTS-FP radio subsystem?
q_25508.ground_truth: The output RF spectrum of the CTS-FP is a combination of two effects: the modulation process and the power ramping up and down (switching transients). These effects are specified separately in dBm relative to a measurement in 30 kHz on the carrier.

q_25509.question: What does the CatStatus function return?
q_25509.ground_truth: The CatStatus function returns the file status of the currently selected file.

q_25510.question: What happens when a UE with basic network connectivity attempts to establish an MMTEL video conference call and fails?
q_25510.ground_truth: The UE can invoke MPS for the MMTEL video conference call or to upgrade an already established MMTEL video conference call if it is unable to establish a successful call due to congestion or unavailability of resources.

q_25511.question: What should the UE do if it detects an alteration in the Replayed UE security capabilities IE received from the AMF during the security mode control procedure in 5G NAS?
q_25511.ground_truth: The UE should set the cause value to #23 "UE security capabilities mismatch" if it detects an alteration in the Replayed UE security capabilities IE received from the AMF.

q_25512.question: How many ROM bytes are required for the implementation of the f1-f5 construction of the modes in MILENAGE?

q_25513.question: What kind of parameters are used in the computation of the reference LSF parameter vector?
q_25513.ground_truth: The reference LSF parameter vector is computed by averaging the quantized LSF parameters over the hangover period of 7 frames.

q_25514.question: What standard defines the Bluetooth scenario data for the test cases in Subclause 10.1 of TS 37.571-2?
q_25514.ground_truth: Subclause 10.1 of TS 37.571-2 defines the Bluetooth scenario data for signalling test cases.

q_25515.question: What is the role of the Video Aware Controller (VAC) in the described network resource management system?
q_25515.ground_truth: The Video Aware Controller (VAC) is the central intelligence for video-aware resource management in the network. It communicates Maximum Bit Rate (MBR) values to DASH clients, which influences their video rate adaptation behavior, effectively managing network resources at various parts of the network.

q_25516.question: What radio positioning methods are supported by 3GPP in determining the location of a mobile station?
q_25516.ground_truth: 3GPP supports various positioning methods in the different access networks, including Modernized GPS, SBAS, QZSS, GLONASS, BDS, Galileo, U-TDOA, E-OTD, IPDL-OTDOA, Network Assisted GNSS, UE ambient condition sensors-based positioning, TBS, Beacon identity for location lookup (e.g., WiFi access points or BLE beacons), RF Pattern Matching, and Means using cell site or sector information and Timing Advance or RoundTrip Time measurements.

q_25517.question: What are the supported sampling frequencies for the background noise level estimation in the TCX time domain concealment?
q_25517.ground_truth: The background noise level estimation is supported for the sampling frequencies 9.6, 16.4, 24.4, 48, and 128 kbps.

q_25518.question: What triggers the initiation of an S9 session termination by the V-PCRF?
q_25518.ground_truth: The V-PCRF initiates a termination of the S9 session when it receives a trigger that removes the last existing S9 subsession associated with the referred S9 session.

q_25519.question: What is the purpose of identifying RedCap UEs during the cell access procedure?
q_25519.ground_truth: The purpose of identifying RedCap UEs during the cell access procedure is to ensure proper scheduling of UEs and possibly restrict the UE's access to the network.

q_25520.question: What alternatives are available for realizing the services related to data collection in NWDAF-to-NWDAF interactions?
q_25520.ground_truth: Three alternatives are available for realizing data collection services. Alternative 1: Applying Event Exposure Framework Principles, Alternative 2: Extensions to NWDAF Services, and Alternative 3: New Dedicated Service. Each alternative has its own specific features and benefits.

q_25521.question: In which entity of the network is the MBMS Session Stop procedure propagated for E-UTRAN and UTRAN for EPS?
q_25521.ground_truth: To all MBMS GWs, MMEs, and SGSNs that are registered for the corresponding MBMS bearer service and to E-UTRAN/UTRAN that have accepted to receive IP multicast distribution for E-UTRAN and UTRAN for EPS

q_25522.question: What are the available enablers for providing multiple language support in a 3GPP environment?
q_25522.ground_truth: 3GP-DASH supports late binding, so language can be distributed independently of the video. Additionally, 3GP-DASH supports signalling multiple languages by using the @lang attribute with Adaptation Sets. The mixing of the music and effects and the language track is done at the sender.

q_25523.question: What information is required for an intra-SGSN routing area update procedure?
q_25523.ground_truth: The MS sends a Routing Area Update Request (P-TMSI, old RAI, old P-TMSI Signature, Update Type, MS Radio Access Capability, DRX parameters, extended idle mode DRX parameters, MS Network Capability, Support for restriction of use of Enhanced Coverage, additional P-TMSI/RAI, Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting) to the SGSN.

q_25524.question: Which 3GPP messaging service is designed to allow users to send and receive messages with various media types, including text, images, audio, and video?
q_25524.ground_truth: Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS) is a 3GPP messaging service designed to allow users to send and receive messages with various media types, including text, images, audio, and video.

q_25525.question: What are the two modes of operation defined for CS data services in UMTS?
q_25525.ground_truth: The two modes of operation defined for CS data services in UMTS are Iu mode and A/Gb mode, indicating a system or sub-system that operates accordingly to the use of an Iu-CS or Iu-PS interface and A or Gb interface, respectively.

q_25526.question: What is the parameter bound for the gprsConnectPackage operation package?
q_25526.ground_truth: The parameter bound for the gprsConnectPackage operation package is "bound".

q_25527.question: What is the class that defines the constants for the ToolkitException class?
q_25527.ground_truth: The ToolkitException class itself defines the constants for the ToolkitException class, as there is no separate class for these constants.

q_25528.question: What is the role of the DRA in handling multiple and separately addressable PCRFs in a Diameter realm?
q_25528.ground_truth: The DRA, when deployed, is responsible for selecting the PCRF at IP-CAN session establishment by the PDN GW and being involved in unsolicited service reporting over Sd. It also selects the PCRF at initial attach (IP-CAN session or Gateway Control session establishment) and ensures that all Diameter sessions reach the same PCRF for a given IP-CAN session in a Diameter realm.

q_25529.question: Under what condition is a UE allowed to request 5GS services when camped on a cell of a TA that is in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"?
q_25529.ground_truth: When the UE needs to request emergency services.

q_25530.question: What should the UE do with the concerned cells included in the cellsTriggeredList during event B1 measurement?
q_25530.ground_truth: The UE should include the concerned cells in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for the measId.

q_25531.question: How many bits are used for quantization in the AMR-WB-interoperable mode?

q_25532.question: What action does the mobile station take upon receipt of the INTER SYSTEM TO UTRAN HANDOVER COMMAND message?
q_25532.ground_truth: The mobile station initiates the release of link layer connections and disconnects the physical channels, including the packet resources if in class A mode of operation.

q_25533.question: What is the value of CAMEL Capability Handling for GPRS-CSI in SGSN?
q_25533.ground_truth: The CAMEL Capability Handling for GPRS-CSI in SGSN shall have the value CAMEL phase 3.

q_25534.question: What needs to be in place to ensure secure identity mapping in the GBA framework?
q_25534.ground_truth: Proper security measures need to be in place to verify that a person is authorized to request mapping, and to ensure that the USS is stored securely to prevent unauthorized access.

q_25535.question: What should the Terminal do to unblock a blocked PIN?
q_25535.ground_truth: The Terminal should support the Unlock PIN command and initiate a MMI dependent procedure to unblock the PIN with the correct unblock code and new PIN.

q_25536.question: What information is contained in the parameters of the PHY-Data-IND primitive?
q_25536.ground_truth: The parameters of the PHY-Data-IND primitive include TFI, E-TFI (E-DCH only), Transport Block Set, CRC check result, TD (RX Timing Deviation measurement) (optional, TDD only), Process Id (HS-DSCH and E-DCH only), and Retransmission number (E-DCH only).

q_25537.question: What are the steps for the MBMS announcement procedure in dedicated mode in 3GPP networks?
q_25537.ground_truth: The MBMS announcement procedure in dedicated mode in 3GPP networks is initiated by the RR entity of the network side and triggered by the network being informed of a starting MBMS session or of an ongoing MBMS broadcast session with an updated MBMS service area list. The network initiates the procedure by sending the mobile station a MBMS ANNOUNCEMENT message on the main DCCH. Upon receipt of the MBMS ANNOUNCEMENT message, the RR sublayer of the mobile station shall discard the message if the MBMS capable mobile station has not joined the service, or indicate the receipt of a message and pass the MBMS specific information contained within the MBMS ANNOUNCEMENT message to the GMM sublayer if the MBMS capable mobile station has joined the service.

q_25538.question: What is the minimum transmitted power level that defines the "off" state of the UE transmitter as specified in subclause 6.5.1?
q_25538.ground_truth: The transmitted power is below the level defined in subclause 6.5.1, in this case the transmitter is considered "off".

q_25539.question: What is the mechanism that ensures in-order delivery for an IP flow when it comes to UIC Connections?
q_25539.ground_truth: There is no such mechanism that ensures in-order delivery for an IP flow split over both accesses when using UIC Connections.

q_25540.question: In the context of 3.2.2.88 VGCS Feature Flags, what does Bit 1 of octet 3 represent?
q_25540.ground_truth: Bit 1 of octet 3 in VGCS Feature Flags is the Talker Priority not supported/supported indicator.

q_25541.question: What happens if the R-GMLC receives only the MSC/VLR address in step 9?
q_25541.ground_truth: The MT LR proceeds as the CS post positioning notification and verification procedure described in clause~9.1.10.

q_25542.question: When should a BSS include the "MultilaterationTiming Advance", "MS Sync Accuracy" and "BTS Reception Accuracy Level" information elements in a positioning request to the SMLC?
q_25542.ground_truth: A BSS should include these information elements in a positioning request to the SMLC when it receives a PERFORM-LOCATION-REQUEST PDU with these elements from the SGSN.

q_25543.question: What happens when the ANR function cannot rely on Iur connectivity between the involved RNCs?
q_25543.ground_truth: When the ANR function cannot rely on Iur connectivity between the involved RNCs, the Receiving RNC may report the neighbour relation to O&M. On reception of an ANR report over Uu, the Receiving RNC uses the globally unique cell identities in the report to determine the network address of the Base RNCs that are controlling the Base UTRAN cells. If any Base RNC involved in the logged neighbour relations in the ANR report is another RNC than the Receiving RNC, and no Iur connectivity exists to this RNC, the Receiving RNC may report the neighbour relation to O&M.

q_25544.question: How does the ME-based authentication mechanism differ from the UICC-based authentication mechanism?
q_25544.ground_truth: In ME-based authentication, the authentication mechanism is mandatory for ME and optional for NAF, while the UICC-based authentication mechanism is mandatory for UICC but optional for the NAF. This distinction affects the key management and access control for HTTPS communication with the NAF.

q_25545.question: What is the purpose of the key refresh procedure in the DCCF initiated key refresh procedure?
q_25545.ground_truth: The purpose of the key refresh procedure is to frequently change the keys KE and KI either with a limited lifetime or sequence number wrap around in data source, ensuring the security and protection of data transferred between AF and NWDAF.

q_25546.question: After a measurement report has been triggered and the UE suspended transmission of user data, when can the UE resume transmission of user data?
q_25546.ground_truth: The UE can resume transmission of user data when it receives from the UTRAN a message allocating a dedicated physical channel or when the time period indicated by the IE "Tx Interruption after trigger" elapses.

q_25547.question: What is the effect of successful FurnishChargingInformation operation on Logical and physical CDRs?
q_25547.ground_truth: A successful FurnishChargingInformation operation will create a Logical Call Data Record (CDR) if it does not already exist for the indicated leg, and will be associated for a given call into one or more physical CDRs.

q_25548.question: What is the role of NRF in SP NW when it receives a "NF Discovery" request from NRF in SNPN?
q_25548.ground_truth: The NRF in SP NW may further query an appropriate local NRF in SP NW based on the input information received from NRF of the SNPN to get the expected NF profile(s) of the NF instance(s) deployed in the SP NW.

q_25549.question: Which protocol extension container is used in HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-Respons-ExtIEs NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?

q_25550.question: What message does the ePDG send to the UE in response to the updated routing rules requested by the UE?
q_25550.ground_truth: The ePDG sends an IKEv2 INFORMATIONAL Response message to the UE, which includes the updated routing rules requested by the UE.

q_25551.question: What is the purpose of the enumeration 'PortState' in this C-code?
q_25551.ground_truth: The enumeration 'PortState' defines the different states of a port, including CtrlRxIdle, CtrlRxSync, CtrlRxLock, CtrlTxIdle, and CtrlTxSend.

q_25552.question: What is the role of an IRPAgent in the context of management of Next Generation Networks?
q_25552.ground_truth: The IRPAgent, in the context of management of Next Generation Networks, represents the provider reference point and is managed via an IRPManager. The IRPs are the prime enabler of flexibility in the design of management physical blocks (OSs).

q_25553.question: What should the UE do with the list of "PLMNs where registration was aborted due to SOR" when the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed?
q_25553.ground_truth: The list of "PLMNs where registration was aborted due to SOR" is deleted when the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

q_25554.question: What is the purpose of finding the energy of each block in the speech signal?
q_25554.ground_truth: The purpose of finding the energy of each block is to estimate the amount of information required to represent that block, which is then used to calculate the initial estimate of the global gain.

q_25555.question: What are the possible values for the Participant-Access-Priority AVP?
q_25555.ground_truth: The Participant-Access-Priority AVP can take the values of Pre-emptive priority, High priority, Normal priority, and Low priority.

q_25556.question: Which TS specifies the common functional architecture to support mission critical services?

q_25557.question: How are the smoothed scaling gains updated in the spectral analysis?
q_25557.ground_truth: The smoothed scaling gains are updated for all frequency bins in the entire spectrum in every spectral analysis. They are initially set to 1 and are reset to 1 each time a non-tonal sound frame is processed to reduce any possible reduction in the next frame.

q_25558.question: What is the purpose of the Gathering ISCs block in the process flow?
q_25558.ground_truth: The Gathering ISCs block constructs a new buffer by selecting the Important Spectral Components (ISCs) and excluding the zero-band and the position which is not selected.

q_25559.question: When should the MAC entity not transmit periodic SRS and semi-persistent SRS defined in TS 38.214?
q_25559.ground_truth: The MAC entity should not transmit periodic SRS and semi-persistent SRS defined in TS 38.214 if the drx-onDurationTimer is not started for the current DRX cycle and the MAC entity would not be in Active Time considering grants/assignments/DRX Command MAC CE/Long DRX Command MAC CE received and Scheduling Request sent until 4 ms prior to symbol n.

q_25560.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network Stage 2 functional specification of User Equipment (UE) positioning in UTRAN (Release 17)?
q_25560.ground_truth: The purpose is to define the UTRAN UE Positioning architecture, functional entities and operations to support positioning methods.

q_25561.question: What are the requirements of the Per Slice UP resource allocation and usage report solution in 5GC?
q_25561.ground_truth: The Per Slice UP resource allocation and usage report solution in 5GC requires UP Function to allocate the UP resources per network slice, and report the usage of UP resources at per slice granularity. N4 interface needs enhancements to support the report of UP resources at per slice granularity.

q_25562.question: What is the purpose of the "MM.FailImsiCombiIntraSgsnRAUpdate.Cause" measurement in the context of "combined RA/LA with IMSI Attach" intra-SGSN Routing Area update procedures?
q_25562.ground_truth: The "MM.FailImsiCombiIntraSgsnRAUpdate.Cause" measurement tracks the number of failed GPRS "combined RA/LA with IMSI Attach" intra-SGSN Routing Area Update procedures, with the possibility to categorize the failures based on specific reject causes.

q_25563.question: What is the main idea behind the single stream approach in 360 video delivery?
q_25563.ground_truth: The server encodes an exact or over-provisioned viewport for each user or the full 360 video, and the receiver decodes and shows only the viewport.

q_25564.question: What is the format of the E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeReleased-ModReqdList and E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeModified-ModReqdList sequences, which contain information about E-RABs that are to be released or modified after an Evolved Radio Access Bearer (E-RAB) has been established?
q_25564.ground_truth: Both E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeReleased-ModReqdList and E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeModified-ModReqdList are sequences of size (1..maxnoofBearers) containing a ProtocolIE-SingleContainer with an E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeReleased-ModReqdItem or E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeModified-ModReqdItem as the ProtocolIE-SingleContainer type.

q_25565.question: What is the gap duration for BL/CE UEs in frame structure type 1, for PRACH CE level 2 or 3, after a transmission duration of time units?
q_25565.ground_truth: The gap duration is also time units.

q_25566.question: In the context of UTRAN, what does "SRNS" stand for?

q_25567.question: Which mode of operation determines, initiates, and controls the positioning method to be used for each positioning request in the context of the PCAP protocol?
q_25567.ground_truth: In RNC Centric Mode of Operation, the RNC determines, initiates, and controls the positioning method to be used for each positioning request. In SAS Centric Mode of Operation, the SAS determines, initiates, and controls the positioning method to be used for each positioning request.

q_25568.question: When is the MT-Wait for RP-ACK state entered in the mobile terminating case?
q_25568.ground_truth: The MT-Wait for RP-ACK state is entered after the MT-SMC has received the message CP-DATA (including sending of the associated CP-ACK).

q_25569.question: What are the operational recommendations and requirements for video codecs for the MCVideo service?
q_25569.ground_truth: The video codecs for the MCVideo service should be able to compress/record variable resolution video information, support video coding and decoding for license plate reading, facial and fingerprint recognition, and support MCVideo UEs that are capable of only receiving, transmitting, or both receiving and transmitting videos. The video codecs should work effectively with stored or just acquired video information and beable to render video clips in industry-standard widely-used formats.

q_25570.question: What is the minimum requirement for transmit OFF power in the 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
q_25570.ground_truth: The transmit OFF power should be less than -82 dBm.

q_25571.question: What is the condition for initializing the test procedure in 9.3.4.1.4.2 and 9.3.5.1.4.2?
q_25571.ground_truth: The condition for initializing the test procedure in 9.3.4.1.4.2 and 9.3.5.1.4.2 is using condition CEModeB.

q_25572.question: What should the eP-CSCF do upon receipt of an SDP offer from the served WIC containing a DTLS-SRTP based media stream with end-to-access-edge protection?
q_25572.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF should invoke IMS-ALG procedures, remove the "a=3ge2ae:requested" attribute and the SDP fingerprint attribute, and act as defined in 3GPP TS 24.229 as far as SDP and RTP is concerned.

q_25573.question: What is the role of the error concealment algorithm in the Enhanced aacPlus general audio codec?
q_25573.ground_truth: The error concealment algorithm in the Enhanced aacPlus general audio codec is responsible for reducing the negative impact of errors or corrupted data in the input bitstream on the decoded audio signal.

q_25574.question: In the movie Back to the Future, what car did Doc Brown drive?

q_25575.question: What information is contained in the Session State Information sent by the SCC AS for enablement of PS-CS service continuity?
q_25575.ground_truth: The Session State Information sent by the SCC AS for enablement of PS-CS service continuity contains information such as calling party, called party, needed STI, and further session information.

q_25576.question: What types of traffic is the measurement "RRC.ConnEstabSucc.Cause" valid for?
q_25576.ground_truth: The measurement "RRC.ConnEstabSucc.Cause" is valid for packet switched traffic.

q_25577.question: Which clause in TS 31.111 does the ME support for the testing of the USIM Application Toolkit?
q_25577.ground_truth: clause 6.4.22, clause 6.6.22, clause 6.4.16, clause 6.6.16, clause 7.5.6, clause 6.8, clause 7.5, clause 7.5.1, clause 8.25, clause 8.70, clause 6.4.7 and clause 6.6.13

q_25578.question: In the "fdd" choice of "modeSpecificInfo", what information is not present in the "tdd384" and "tdd128" choices?
q_25578.ground_truth: "primaryCCPCH-TX-Power" is not present in the "tdd384" and "tdd128" choices.

q_25579.question: What function does the Shared Secret Value (SSV) serve in the establishment of a secure ProSe Direct communication?
q_25579.ground_truth: The Shared Secret Value (SSV) is used as a root key (KD) to derive other keys for secure communication.

q_25580.question: What is the next step after determining the total number of REs allocated for PUSCH in a slot?
q_25580.ground_truth: The next step is to proceed with steps 2-5 as defined in Subclause 5.1.3.2 of the document.

q_25581.question: What is the purpose of the User Data Convergence (UDC) in 3GPP networks?
q_25581.ground_truth: The User Data Convergence (UDC) is a concept that proposes to move user data from where it has been distributed and siloed in Network Elements, Applications, and other network resources to a single logical consolidated facility called User Data Repository (UDR) where it can be accessed, stored and managed in a common way.

q_25582.question: What is the role of Security Gateways (SEGs) in the network domain control plane of an NDS/IP-network?
q_25582.ground_truth: SEGs are responsible for enforcing the security policy of a security domain towards other SEGs in the destination security domain, typically coinciding with operator borders.

q_25583.question: What type of service is represented by the measurement EQPT.NbrSeizureAttDTMF?
q_25583.ground_truth: This measurement represents the number of successful attempts to seize DTMF services.

q_25584.question: What determines the network support of the Multicall supplementary service?
q_25584.ground_truth: The network supports Multicall if the Network Capabilities (NW CC) capabilities that indicate the network supports Multicall are included in the CALL PROCEEDING message.

q_25585.question: What are the different models of ProSe Direct Discovery in EPS?
q_25585.ground_truth: Model A involves one UE announcing "I am here", while Model B involves one UE asking "who is there" and/or "are you there".

q_25586.question: What is the maximum allowed response time including test tolerance for the RSTD measurement reporting delay in the intra-frequency RSTD measurement period test case with longer PRS occasions in CE Mode B?
q_25586.ground_truth: The maximum allowed response time including test tolerance for the RSTD measurement reporting delay in the intra-frequency RSTD measurement period test case with longer PRS occasions in CE Mode B is 6300ms.

q_25587.question: What is the UE location calculation method for the Nominal Accuracy test defined in TS 37.571-1 subclauses 6, 7, and 13?
q_25587.ground_truth: The UE location is calculated as a random offset from the reference location using the method described in subclause 6.2.1.2.6. The reference location for GNSS scenario #3A is Sigar India.

q_25588.question: What is the method used to avoid divisions in the maximization update decision?
q_25588.ground_truth: A cross-multiplication of the saved best squared correlation numerator and the saved best energy denominator is used.

q_25589.question: How many measurement opportunities out of four are allocated for GSM carrier RSSI measurements when a UE is performing GSM measurements using measurement occasions and idle intervals?
q_25589.ground_truth: Three measurement opportunities out of four are allocated for GSM carrier RSSI measurements when a UE is performing GSM measurements using measurement occasions and idle intervals.

q_25590.question: What is the purpose of the NG-RAN Technical Specification Group in 3GPP?
q_25590.ground_truth: The NG-RAN (Next-Generation Radio Access Network) Technical Specification Group in 3GPP is responsible for specifying the standards for user data transport protocols and related signaling protocols over the Xn interface.

q_25591.question: What is the role of the adaptive codebook approach in the AMR-WB codec, and how does it differ from the fixed codebook?
q_25591.ground_truth: The adaptive codebook approach in the AMR-WB codec is used to implement the long-term, or pitch, synthesis filter. Unlike the fixed codebook, the adaptive codebook approach adapts to the specific input speech by generating a unique excitation signal in the analysis-by-synthesis search process. This allows for a more efficient coding of speech at various rates, as the adaptive codebook can better capture the specific pitch characteristics of a given speech signal.

q_25592.question: What action should a GSN take when it receives a Delete MBMS Context Request for a non-existing MBMS UE context?
q_25592.ground_truth: A GSN should ignore such a request and send back a Delete MBMS Context Response message with a cause value of "Non existent".

q_25593.question: How many CBS-Message-Information-Pages can the Ge Content NG-RAN IE contain at maximum?
q_25593.ground_truth: The Ge Content NG-RAN IE can contain a maximum of 15 CBS-Message-Information-Pages.

q_25594.question: When should the UE apply priorities provided by system information from current cell?
q_25594.ground_truth: If the UE is in camped on any cell state, UE shall only apply the priorities provided by system information from current cell and preserve priorities provided by dedicated signalling unless specified otherwise.

q_25595.question: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, what is the difference between Passive, Dual SIM Dual Standby (DSDS), and Dual SIM Dual Active (DSDA) devices?
q_25595.ground_truth: A Passive device has two SIMs but can only use one at any given time, DSDS devices support two SIMs for idle-mode network connection but only one active radio connection, and DSDA devices support two SIMs in both idle and connected modes with each SIM having a dedicated transceiver.

q_25596.question: What type of error occurs when the receiver is unable to decode the received physical message's transfer syntax?
q_25596.ground_truth: A Transfer Syntax Error occurs in this situation.

q_25597.question: What is the responsibility of UDM when supporting IMS related procedures in 5G?
q_25597.ground_truth: UDM, which is a combo node supporting UDM and HSS functionalities, is the only access point both to 5GC, EPC and IMS. The UDM needs to forward all the requests received from IMS via Cx/Dx or Sh interfaces to HSS FE to handle, and further forwards all the responses from HSS FE to IMS.

q_25598.question: What procedure does the NAS perform when it detects an access event?
q_25598.ground_truth: The NAS performs the mapping of the kind of request to one or more access identities and one access category and lower layers will perform access barring checks for that request based on the determined access identities and access category.

q_25599.question: What is the role of the Local Gateway (L-GW) in the HNB access network?
q_25599.ground_truth: The Local Gateway (L-GW) is present when the HNB operates in LIPA mode or when the HNB operates in SIPTO@LN mode. It is co-located with the HNB, and the HNB has a Gn/S5 interface towards the SGSN/SGW which does not use the HNB-GW, and a Gi interface towards the residential/IP network.

q_25600.question: Which property defines the required versions of the User Plane mode of operation and what are the possible values it can take?
