q_26114.question: What is the 16-bit CRC used to calculate the CRC for HS-SCCH type 3 when one transport block is transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCHs?
q_26114.ground_truth: The 16-bit CRC used to calculate the CRC for HS-SCCH type 3 when one transport block is transmitted on the associated HS-PDSCHs is calculated based on the sequence of bits x2,1, x2,2, ..., x2,16 where ck=p(17-k) for k ranging from 1 to 16.

q_26115.question: Which functional entity provides control plane functionality for connecting SIP entities following different profiles?
q_26115.ground_truth: The IBCF (Intermediate Border Control Function) provides control plane functionality for connecting SIP entities following different profiles.

q_26116.question: In what scenarios can the SAS initiate a Bluetooth positioning procedure?
q_26116.ground_truth: The SAS can initiate a Bluetooth positioning procedure whenever it receives a request for positioning information about a UE from an application in the core network, or if periodic reporting information is present in the location request.

q_26117.question: What action shall the UE take upon receiving a UTRAN MOBILITY INFORMATION message containing the IE "Dedicated Priority Information"?
q_26117.ground_truth: The UE shall act upon the received IE as specified in subclause 8.6.

q_26118.question: What information is provided by the measurement "Call release initiated by IM CN subsystem"?
q_26118.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of call release initiated by IM CN subsystem, with subcounters per message type.

q_26119.question: What is the minimum UE class that supports the combination of the 258.4 kbps RB for MTCH with 40 ms TTI?
q_26119.ground_truth: The minimum UE class supporting this combination is DL: 32 kbps plus support for 5 AM entities.

q_26120.question: What should the mobile station do if there is no response from the fixed part (expiry of timer TC3254) in the CTS enrolment procedure?
q_26120.ground_truth: The mobile station should warn the mobile station user and may initiate a new enrolment attempt.

q_26121.question: What is the effect of the VoIP roaming indication with the choice value of "roamingS8HR" or "roamingLBO" on IMS events and CC?
q_26121.ground_truth: Including the VoIP roaming indication with the choice value of "roamingS8HR" or "roamingLBO" in IMS events and CC indicates that the IMS events are generated in the VPLMN with S8HR or LBO as the roaming architecture.

q_26122.question: What is the requirement for a UE when it receives a LOCATION UPDATING REJECT message during registration on CS in the USIM with the cause "PLMN not allowed"?
q_26122.ground_truth: The UE should update the EFPLMN in the USIM.

q_26123.question: What is the role of the DiversityIndication-RL-SetupRspFDD choice within the RL-InformationResponseItem-RL-SetupRspFDD?
q_26123.ground_truth: The DiversityIndication-RL-SetupRspFDD choice determines whether combining or non-CombiningOrFirstRL is used in RL-InformationResponseItem-RL-SetupRspFDD.

q_26124.question: In subclause 6.1.1.3.4.1, how many past excitation samples and future excitation samples are used to increase the frequency resolution?
q_26124.ground_truth: 192 past excitation samples and 192 future excitation samples are used to increase the frequency resolution.

q_26125.question: What should be the format of the SUPI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST sent to the NG-SS?
q_26125.ground_truth: The format of the SUPI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST sent to the NG-SS should be '0'.

q_26126.question: What is a MAC-d PDU size?
q_26126.ground_truth: A MAC-d PDU size is the size of a MAC-d PDU in bytes. It determines the number of MAC-d PDUs that can be transmitted in a single MAC-d PDU size information list. The MAC-d PDU size is an important parameter in the MAC layer and is used to ensure that data is transmitted efficiently.

q_26127.question: Which approach is applied to measurements in 6.3.3, 6.4.1, and 6.4.2 in 3GPP TS 32.425?
q_26127.ground_truth: The "2 out of 3 approach" is applied to these measurements.

q_26128.question: What does the DirectCommunicationPolicy node act as a placeholder for in the ProSe Public Safety Direct Services Provisioning MO parameters?
q_26128.ground_truth: The DirectCommunicationPolicy node acts as a placeholder for one-to-many ProSe direct communication authorisation policy.

q_26129.question: What is the difference between MSGin5G service ID and AS service ID in the 5G messaging service?
q_26129.ground_truth: The MSGin5G service ID is used by the UE to communicate with other UEs and the MSGin5G server, while the AS service ID is used by an application server within the MSGin5G service to perform mutual authentication with the MSGin5G server for establishing a secured service connection.

q_26130.question: What is the difference between Transparent mode and Support mode in the Iu UP protocol?
q_26130.ground_truth: In Transparent mode, the protocol does not perform any Iu UP protocol information exchange, while in Support mode, the peer Iu UP protocol instances exchange Iu UP frames.

q_26131.question: What shall the PSS server do when the PSS Client knows that a particular request for scaled playback is impossible to complete due to the buffer?
q_26131.ground_truth: The PSS Client shall not request this scale value in such cases.

q_26132.question: What occurs during the initial maximum rate control in TrFO?
q_26132.ground_truth: The first subflow combination in the IuUP initialisation is treated as an initial maximum rate control.

q_26133.question: What is the purpose of the "Reset Timer" information flow in 4.6.2.20?
q_26133.ground_truth: The "Reset Timer" information flow is used in the gsmSCF to reset a timer.

q_26134.question: What is required for an MCVideo User to view a stored video with simple video player functions?
q_26134.ground_truth: The MCVideo service shall provide a mechanism for an authorized MCVideo User to view a video with simple video player functions such as pause, rewind, and forward.

q_26135.question: What are the possible negative outcomes of the handover procedure?
q_26135.ground_truth: The possible negative outcomes of the handover process are user error detected, component rejection, and dialogue abortion performed by MSC-B, handover number allocation unsuccessful, or radio resources allocation failure.

q_26136.question: What is the maximum allowed power for spurious emissions in a GSM 900 BSS operating transmit band?
q_26136.ground_truth: The maximum allowed power for spurious emissions in a GSM 900 BSS operating transmit band is -47~dBm.

q_26137.question: What is a pre-condition for terminating a railway emergency alert?
q_26137.ground_truth: The Controller is authorized to terminate the railway emergency alert and there is an ongoing railway emergency alert.

q_26138.question: What resolution and frame rates are permitted for auxiliary video services in DASH-based distribution?
q_26138.ground_truth: More luminance resolutions and frame rates are permitted for auxiliary video services in DASH-based distribution, enabling seamless adaptive switching.

q_26139.question: What is carried out in compatibility checking for interworking to the PSTN?
q_26139.ground_truth: Compatibility checking is carried out on low layer and high layer items using low layer compatibility and bearer capability information elements and high layer compatibility information element.

q_26140.question: What is the purpose of the 'Confirmed by Radio Contact' restoration indicator being 'false' in the VLR?
q_26140.ground_truth: If the 'Confirmed by Radio Contact' restoration indicator is 'false', the VLR may send paging messages on the Gs, A and Iu-CS interfaces, reducing subsequent paging signalling by avoiding a complete search of the MS on the entire VLR area.

q_26141.question: What action is taken if the receiving identifies an IE or IE group that is defined to be part of a message but is received in the wrong order or with too many occurrences?

q_26142.question: What determines whether a SS (node B emulator) should use a 2Rx or 4Rx module for cells on bands supporting multiple reception bands in the test?
q_26142.ground_truth: The SS should use the 2Rx module for cells on bands supporting 2Rx and the 4Rx module for cells on bands supporting 4Rx.

q_26143.question: What makes victim UEs most vulnerable to downlink interference from a HeNB?
q_26143.ground_truth: Victim UEs are most vulnerable to downlink interference from a HeNB when they are at or near the edge of their own cells and relatively close to the HeNB, resulting in high SINR at the HeNB.

q_26144.question: What is the address type for the gateway?
q_26144.ground_truth: The address type for the gateway is Ipv4.

q_26145.question: What is the purpose of the training sequences used in burst types?
q_26145.ground_truth: The training sequences, also called synchronization sequences, facilitate synchronization, channel estimation, and blind detection of modulation on the radio interface.

q_26146.question: What method returns the length of the Short Message from the User Data part in the SMS TPDU (simple or concatenated) or Cell Broadcast Page Comprehension TLV contained in the USATEnvelopeHandler?
q_26146.ground_truth: The method getShortMessageLength() follows this definition.

q_26147.question: How many maxima of the correlation are found and retained in the open-loop pitch analysis?
q_26147.ground_truth: Three maxima of the correlation are found and retained in the open-loop pitch analysis.

q_26148.question: How are the Relative North/East values included in the broadcast message determined?
q_26148.ground_truth: The Relative North/East values are included in the broadcast message based on the Neighbour List and Sectored BTS ID groups in the Message Structure Definition IE.

q_26149.question: What is the Dedicated Core Network Identifier, and where is it conditionally stored?
q_26149.ground_truth: The Dedicated Core Network Identifier is temporary data that is conditionally stored in a Gn/Gp-SGSN, S4-SGSN, and MME.

q_26150.question: What does the parameter "Maximum number of physical channel bits on E-PUCH that can be transmitted in a 10ms TTI" define for uplink?
q_26150.ground_truth: This parameter defines the maximum number of physical channel bits, Ndata, that the UE is capable of transmitting on E-PUCH in a 10ms TTI for uplink.

q_26151.question: What should the BSS include in the UL-UNIDATA PDU when handling a mobile station supporting network sharing?
q_26151.ground_truth: The BSS should include the selected PLMN ID within the UL-UNIDATA PDU when a foreign TLLI or a random TLLI is included in the same UL-UNIDATA PDU.

q_26152.question: What is the default GANSS associated with the GANSS Generic Assistance Data IE if the GANSS ID IE is not included?
q_26152.ground_truth: If the GANSS Generic Assistance Data IE does not contain the GANSS ID IE, the corresponding GANSS is "Galileo".

q_26153.question: What is the purpose of the LCR IE in the Continuous Packet Connectivity DRX operation for 1.28 Mcps TDD?
q_26153.ground_truth: The LCR IE in the Continuous Packet Connectivity DRX operation for 1.28 Mcps TDD is used to inform the CRNC the parameters used for this operation.

q_26154.question: What unique identifier is used to identify a cell in the E-UTRAN?

q_26155.question: What are the possible positive outcomes of the handover procedure?
q_26155.ground_truth: The possible positive outcomes of the handover procedure are successful radio resources allocation and handover number allocation or radio resources allocation queued with successful handover number allocation, in which case the handover is done later with successful radio resources allocation.

q_26156.question: What is the maximum time it takes for the UE to evaluate that an intra-frequency cell has become better ranked than the serving cell within TevaluateFDD, provided that Treselection timer is set to zero?
q_26156.ground_truth: The UE shall be capable of evaluating that an intra-frequency cell has become better ranked than the serving cell within TevaluateFDD from the moment the intra-frequency cell became at least 3 dB better ranked than the current serving cell.

q_26157.question: What are some common channel types?
q_26157.ground_truth: Some common channel types are Random Access Channel(s) (RACH), Forward Access Channel(s) (FACH), Broadcast Channel (BCH), and Paging Channel (PCH).

q_26158.question: What is the function of the PSS Adapter when it receives a SIP OPTIONS request with a Content Identifier in the TO header that it does not have the user service description information for?
q_26158.ground_truth: The PSS Adapter sends an RTSP DESCRIBE message to the PSS server to retrieve the user service description information when it does not have the user service description information for the Content Identifier present in the TO header of a SIP OPTIONS request.

q_26159.question: What is the role of the SCC AS in fetching a CSRN for routing a call to the CS domain?
q_26159.ground_truth: The SCC AS fetches a CSRN for routing a call to the CS domain based on the correlation MSISDN.

q_26160.question: Which network element sends the 9.1.31 DATA VOLUME REPORT REQUEST message?
q_26160.ground_truth: The CN (Core Network) sends the 9.1.31 DATA VOLUME REPORT REQUEST message.

q_26161.question: What is the UE complexity reduction technique for higher layers that was not studied as an explicit objective during the study and might require further evaluation in normative phase if it is to be considered?
q_26161.ground_truth: The UE complexity reduction technique for higher layers that was not studied as an explicit objective during the study and might require further evaluation in normative phase if it is to be considered is the relaxation of RRC processing delay requirements.

q_26162.question: What are the two instructions the VPLMN can receive upon contacting the CSE for a PDP Context Establishment Acknowledgement reported as an Initial Service Event?
q_26162.ground_truth: The two instructions the VPLMN can receive are: (1) Suspend processing, make contact with the CSE and await further instructions, or (2) Send a notification and continue.

q_26163.question: What is the difference between a repeater type 1-C and a repeater type 2-O in terms of compliance with the specification?
q_26163.ground_truth: A repeater type 1-C only has conducted requirements and does not require compliance to this specification, while a repeater type 2-O has only radiated requirements and requires compliance to this specification.

q_26164.question: What is the Xw interface used for in the context of LTE-WLAN Aggregation and LTE WLAN Radio Level Integration with IPsec Tunnel?
q_26164.ground_truth: The Xw interface is a logical interface between the eNB and the WT, used for transferring user data for LTE-WLAN Aggregation and LTE WLAN Radio Level Integration with IPsec Tunnel.

q_26165.question: In the context of Deployment Option 2, what action does the VLR take when it is requested to buffer the Short Message, and the Paging message includes the SM-Delivery-Timer and SM-Delivery-Start-Time IEs?
q_26165.ground_truth: The VLR buffers the Short Message until the time indicated in the Paging message or until receipt of any earlier SGs Service Request message. Steps 7a-9 and 12-14 are not performed in this case.

q_26166.question: What is the primary difference between the procedures described in 7.8.1.1 and 7.8.2?
q_26166.ground_truth: The difference is in the type of transport channel used: in 7.8.1.1, a dedicated channel (DCH) is used, while in 7.8.2, a common transport channel (RACH/FACH) is used, which cannot support macrodiversity.

q_26167.question: What are the steps involved in the solution for reliable MBS session handover with mapped QoS flow?
q_26167.ground_truth: The steps involved are: 1) multicast service data is delivered via the MBS session, 2) the source RAN decides to initiate the Xn Handover procedure for the UE, 3) the source RAN may buffer the multicast data for the UE, 4) the source RAN sends HO request to the target RAN, 5) the target RAN sends HO response to source RAN, 6) the source RAN sends HO command message to the UE, 7) the source RAN forwards buffered multicast data to the target RAN, 8) the unicast PDU session and mapped Qos flow of UE corresponding to the MBS session is handed over to the target RAN after path switch.

q_26168.question: What should be the beam correspondence for Tx/Rx used in multi-beam operation?
q_26168.ground_truth: The Tx/Rx beam correspondence should hold at both TRxP and UE for multi-beam operation.

q_26169.question: What is the responsibility of the E-DCH Node B scheduler?
q_26169.ground_truth: The E-DCH Node B scheduler is responsible for allocating uplink resources to UEs for which it acts as the serving Node B, monitoring other-cell interference and sending relative grants to UEs for which it does not act as the serving Node B, and reporting to the SRNC on the lack of processing resources.

q_26170.question: What are some pieces of information that a UAV may provide to the USS/UTM system for authentication and authorization purposes?
q_26170.ground_truth: A UAV may provide the UAV Serial Number to identify the UAV HW, a CAA-Level UAV ID, USS/UTM-specific identifiers for the UAV controller or pilot, aviation-specific information like Current location, flight information, and location of the UAV controller, etc.

q_26171.question: What international standards describe the object-oriented interface between OSI System Management and network elements in TS 32.401?
q_26171.ground_truth: The international standards that describe this interface in TS 32.401 are Common Management Information Service (CMIS), Common Management Information Service Element (CMISE), and Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP).

q_26172.question: What are the definitions of test tolerances and shared risk in the context of test limits for the UE?
q_26172.ground_truth: Test tolerances are individually calculated values for each test that account for measurement uncertainty. Shared risk refers to the comparison of measurement results to test limits, defined in ETSI TR~102 273-1-2, taking into account the respective test tolerances for each test.

q_26173.question: What are the potential impacts on the 5GS when introducing backhaul multi-connectivity with a satellite link?
q_26173.ground_truth: The potential impacts include the need to ensure the use of a core network of the country in which the UE is physically located, selecting a core network for UEs in aeronautical or maritime locations, enabling per-country, UE specific prohibition of satellite access, routing an emergency call to the correct PSAP, handling Lawful Interception, and addressing Public Warning System and charging/tariff notifications.

q_26174.question: What is the purpose of the IF Initiated Connection Release Request operation?
q_26174.ground_truth: The IF Initiated Connection Release Request operation is used to request the termination of a connection at the request of the non-access strata on the Infrastructure side.

q_26175.question: What should the IWF include in the SIP re-INVITE request if it is to be sent within an on-demand session?
q_26175.ground_truth: The IWF should include an SDP containing the current media parameters used by the existing session and a Resource-Priority header field.

q_26176.question: What is the effect of including the SS-Status parameter in a response?
q_26176.ground_truth: The network shall set the SS-Status to reflect the state of the service, but the MS shall ignore the contents of the SS-Status parameter if received.

q_26177.question: What is the content of Octet 2 in the User Defined Sound Information-Element-Data?
q_26177.ground_truth: Octet 2 in the User Defined Sound Information-Element-Data contains the sound number, encoded as an integer value.

q_26178.question: When does LCLS require the access bearer assignment?
q_26178.ground_truth: The access bearer assignment is required to be performed after LCLS Negotiation through Core Network during call establishment.

q_26179.question: What does the term "shall not" signify in the context of normative provisions in the 3GPP technical specification?
q_26179.ground_truth: Shall not indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

q_26180.question: In which cases must the mobile station always send the EGPRS PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK TYPE 2 message or EGPRS PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK TYPE 3 message when it has one or more downlink TBFs using EGPRS2 and is ordered to send an EGPRS~PACKET~DOWNLINK~ACK/NACK message?
q_26180.ground_truth: The mobile station must send the EGPRS PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK TYPE 2 message or EGPRS PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK TYPE 3 message when it has one or more downlink TBFs using EGPRS2 and is ordered to send an EGPRS~PACKET~DOWNLINK~ACK/NACK message or EGPRS~PACKET~DOWNLINK~ACK/NACK TYPE 2 message or EGPRS PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK TYPE 3 message.

q_26181.question: What is the function of the Maximum MAC-c/sh SDU Length field in the DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION Control Frame in the 3GPP TS 25.321 specification?
q_26181.ground_truth: The Maximum MAC-c/sh SDU Length field indicates the maximum allowable SDU size in MAC-c/sh SDUs, which contain the C/T field of the MAC header followed by one RLC PDU.

q_26182.question: What is the basic mode of transferring broadcast information in GC SAP service?
q_26182.ground_truth: The basic mode of transferring broadcast information in GC SAP service is unacknowledged mode, where the delivery of the broadcast information cannot be guaranteed.

q_26183.question: What is the objective of scaling the envelope shape in the envelope scaling section?
q_26183.ground_truth: The objective of scaling the envelope shape is to match the expected bit-consumption of signals matching that shape to a pre-defined level (e.g. a target bit-rate) when encoding all lines of the spectrum with an arithmetic coder.

q_26184.question: What does the message "User authentication failed" indicate when trying to create a PDP context in a network?
q_26184.ground_truth: The external packet network has rejected the service requested by the user, e.g. the authentication check in the RADIUS server failed.

q_26185.question: What determines the precedence when multiple ADC rules overlap in the application traffic detection?
q_26185.ground_truth: The ADC Rule with the highest precedence will be applied. When a dynamic ADC rule and a predefined ADC rule have the same precedence, the dynamic ADC rule takes precedence.

q_26186.question: When does the HNB initiate the UE registration procedure for HNB-GW?
q_26186.ground_truth: The HNB initiates UE registration towards the HNB-GW when the UE capabilities indicate that CSG is not supported, the HNB does not support CSG, and the UE identity is unknown at the HNB being accessed, i.e., no context id exists for the UE.

q_26187.question: What is the condition for a UE to treat a cell as a candidate during cell selection and cell re-selection procedures in Idle mode and Connected mode?
q_26187.ground_truth: A UE shall treat a cell as a candidate if the cell status is indicated as "not barred", "not reserved" for operator use, and "not reserved" for future extension.

q_26188.question: What is the definition of the new coding schemes in section 11.7.3?
q_26188.ground_truth: NBRTTI (New Burst RTTI) coding schemes are defined to allow Reduced TTI operation and aggregated bursts, while keeping the header and data bits unchanged.

q_26189.question: What systems and standards organizations are involved in the production of the present document?
q_26189.ground_truth: The present document has been produced by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), which is a collaboration of several standards organizations including GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications).

q_26190.question: What information does the UE report in standalone Bluetooth positioning mode?
q_26190.ground_truth: In standalone Bluetooth positioning mode, the UE reports the latitude, longitude, and possibly altitude, along with an estimate of the location uncertainty and an indication of the TBS method used.

q_26191.question: What is the subject of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical specification TS 38.523-3?
q_26191.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical specification TS 38.523-3 covers the 5G System (5GS) User Equipment (UE) protocol conformance specification, specifically part 3, which focuses on Protocol Test Suites.

q_26192.question: What is the name of the technical specification that defines the requirements for the correct operation of the background acoustic noise evaluation, noise parameter encoding/decoding, and comfort noise generation in the narrowband telephony speech service employing the Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband (AMR-WB) speech coder within the 3GPP system?

q_26193.question: What does the first digit in the version number of the 3GPP technical specification document signify?
q_26193.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of the 3GPP technical specification document indicates the stage of approval of the document by the TSG.

q_26194.question: Which type of measurements belong to the MME control of overload related measurements for EPC as per 3GPP specifications?
q_26194.ground_truth: NM.OverLoadStartAtt and NM.OverLoadStopAtt represent the number of attempted Overload Start and Stop procedures, respectively.

q_26195.question: What is the message type used for a mobile station to inform the network that the criteria for cell change are now fulfilled?

q_26196.question: What procedure does the MGCF use to both-way through-connect the terminations during the Establish Bearer procedure?
q_26196.ground_truth: The MGCF uses the Change Through-Connection procedure to request the IM-MGW to backward through-connect the BICC termination.

q_26197.question: What is the type of the Restoration-Info AVP?
q_26197.ground_truth: The Restoration-Info AVP is of type Grouped.

q_26198.question: What is the state that a GPRS-attached MS enters after having executed the GPRS attach procedure in Iu mode?
q_26198.ground_truth: The MS enters the PMM-CONNECTED state after having executed the GPRS attach procedure in Iu mode.

q_26199.question: What is the purpose of the hangover in the transient detection algorithm?
q_26199.ground_truth: The hangover is used to ensure that a transient affects two consecutive frames. If a transient is detected in a certain frame, then a transient is also triggered in the next frame.

q_26200.question: What is the abbreviation for "Component Carrier" in LTE-Advanced?
q_26200.ground_truth: CC stands for "Component Carrier" in LTE-Advanced.

q_26201.question: What is the meaning of an "Abstract Syntax Error" in SBc-AP messages?
q_26201.ground_truth: An "Abstract Syntax Error" in SBc-AP messages occurs when an IE or an IE group is not comprehended, i.e. the entire item (IE or IE group) which is not (fully or partially) comprehended.

q_26202.question: What does the FDD in E-DCH-FDD-DL-Control-Channel-Information stand for in the E-DCH-FDD-DL-Control-Channel-Information field in the NonCombiningOrFirstRL-RL-SetupFailureFDD sequence?
q_26202.ground_truth: FDD stands for Frequency Division Duplex, which refers to the method used for separating the uplink and downlink frequencies in a cell.

q_26203.question: What is the purpose of the Create Session command in the 5.4.3 procedure?
q_26203.ground_truth: The purpose of the Create Session command is for the content provider to create a new session for an available service.

q_26204.question: What must the DRNS do if the Sixtyfour QAM Usage Allowed Indicator IE is included in the HS-DSCH FDD Information IE and the value is set to "not allowed"?
q_26204.ground_truth: The DRNS must not use 64 QAM for the HS-DSCH Radio Link.

q_26205.question: What was the activity undertaken in a liaison between 3GPP and CEPT/ERC TG1 when developing the R99 specifications?
q_26205.ground_truth: The activity involved the development of spurious and out-of-band emissions limits, including Category B limits, which were directly transposed from SM.329 and included in the 3GPP specifications until the 2006-12 versions.

q_26206.question: What is the purpose of the "3GPP shall not use 'may not'" statement?
q_26206.ground_truth: To avoid ambiguity and use the unambiguous constructions "might not" or "shall not" instead.

q_26207.question: What is the role of the Transport Format Combination Set in the context of E-DCH?
q_26207.ground_truth: The Transport Format Combination Set is a set of Transport Format Combinations on a Coded Composite Transport Channel. This set is given to MAC for control, but the assignment of the Transport Format Combination Set is done by L3. MAC has control over the dynamic part of the Transport Format Combinations, while L3 controls the semi-static part and guarantees the L1 services are fulfilled.

q_26208.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a SIB12 with changed value tag and stored segments?
q_26208.ground_truth: The UE should discard all stored segments and store the newly received one.

q_26209.question: What is the maximum performance loss when comparing the coded MCSs to TU3iFH?
q_26209.ground_truth: The maximum performance loss was 1.3 dB, observed with MCS-2 using radio block format 2 in the first IR retransmission.

q_26210.question: What is the allowed frequency for an AMR Encoder in the core network to change the Codec Mode in send direction?
q_26210.ground_truth: An AMR Encoder in the core network shall obey a Codec Mode change period of 40ms. Codec Mode changes by the AMR Encoder in the core network node are only permissible at every second frame, ensuring maximum interoperability with any AMR receiver.

q_26211.question: What is the function of a Performance Manager (PM) within the 3GPP TS 32.436 and what does it do in terms of performance measurement?
q_26211.ground_truth: A Performance Manager (PM) is responsible for managing and monitoring the performance of a network within the 3GPP TS 32.436. It collects performance measurement results and provides information on network load and grade of service, allowing for informed decision-making in the daily operation and future network planning of a PLMN.

q_26212.question: What should a UE registered over both 3GPP and non-3GPP access in the same PLMN do to initiate a UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure?
q_26212.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the procedure over a selected access, either 3GPP access or non-3GPP access.

q_26213.question: What was the main new Feature introduced in Release 17?
q_26213.ground_truth: The main new Feature introduced in Release 17 is the support of satellite access, with dedicated chapters covering this topic.

q_26214.question: What happens when the accumulated usage is reported in a CCR command and usage monitoring is to continue for that TDF session, usage monitoring key, or both?
q_26214.ground_truth: When usage monitoring is to continue for specific level(s), the PCRF shall provide the new thresholds for the level(s) in the CC-Answer using the same AVP as before (CC-Total-Octets, CC-Input-Octets, CC-Output-Octets or CC-Time AVPs within the Granted-Service-Unit AVP). If the PCRF wishes to stop monitoring for specific level(s) the PCRF shall not include an updated threshold in the CCA command for the stopped level(s).

q_26215.question: What is the purpose of the "Overview" section in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
q_26215.ground_truth: The "Overview" section in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals provides a summary of the contents of existing 3GPP technical specifications relevant for roaming architecture and procedures. It also describes how to format the Inter Operator Identifiers in the P-Charging-Vector header field, gives examples of used identities within the roaming use case, and describes how to determine the II-NNI traversal scenario type.

q_26216.question: What does the USS (in case of a Terminal accessing UTRAN) do after receipt of a LOCATION UPDATING REQUEST from the UE during registration on CS?
q_26216.ground_truth: The USS initiates authentication, starts integrity by using the security procedure, and sends LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT to the UE with the LAI (MCC/MNC/LAC) 244/082/0001 and a TMSI of "34567890".

q_26217.question: What does the acronym EVS stand for in the context of the document?

q_26218.question: What should the UE do if it is not in the country of its HPLMN and the MCS indicator bit is not set to "Access identity 2 valid in RPLMN or equivalent PLMN"?
q_26218.ground_truth: The UE should not consider access identity 2 to be valid.

q_26219.question: What is the requirement for PDU Session Establishment for UAV3/UAV5 connectivity in 5GS?
q_26219.ground_truth: Authorization of UAV and networked UAV controller pairing, and flight path authorization/registration for flight operation, may take place during PDU Session Establishment for UAV3/UAV5 connectivity in 5GS.

q_26220.question: In the MS-initiated Detach Procedure, when the MS sends a Detach Request (Detach Type, P-TMSI, P-TMSI Signature, Switch Off) to the SGSN, what does the P-TMSI Signature indicate?
q_26220.ground_truth: The P-TMSI Signature indicates the validity of the Detach Request message.

q_26221.question: What is the purpose of the frame substitution and muting in case of lost speech or SID frames?
q_26221.ground_truth: To improve the subjective quality of the speech, the frame parameters shall be appropriately modified prior to the execution of the speech decoder functions for lost speech or SID frames.

q_26222.question: What was the increase in capacity performance for FR1, Dense urban, DL, with VR/AR GOP-based multi-stream traffic model, 30Mbps, 60FPS, 10ms PDB, with DDDSU, MU-MIMO, when using the PF scheduler and prioritizing the transmission of I frame?
q_26222.ground_truth: The capacity performance increased by 23.3% (from 6 UEs per cell to 7.4 UEs per cell).

q_26223.question: What does the target AMF do after verifying the integrity and confidentiality of the protected NAS container?
q_26223.ground_truth: The target AMF decrypts the security context and fetches additional information about established PDU sessions from the old AMF if there is connectivity between the two.

q_26224.question: What is required before starting UE test loop mode B?
q_26224.ground_truth: A prerequisite for UE test loop mode B is that at least one EPS bearer context has been established between SS and UE.
